wsl.zh: WSL 与 Windows 互操作

description.en: Self-evolving agent framework on DeepSeek Harness (dsh): 40 Cordis plugins and 4 presets covering memory, reflection, gates, metrics and an auditable evolution loop. Not a one-command install. Clone the repo and run install/install.sh --profile=web (needs bash, Node 20+, python3, DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 or newer with an initialized profile), then restart.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的自进化智能体框架：40 个 Cordis 插件、4 套 preset，含记忆、反思、门禁、度量与可审计的进化闭环。不是一条命令装完。需克隆仓库并运行 install/install.sh --profile=web（依赖 bash、Node 20+、python3、DSH 0.1.7-rc.1 及以上且目标 profile 已初始化），装完重启。

description.en: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.
description.zh: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 原生智能体预设与 Cordis 插件：提供 13 大认知工程模块、持久化控制器与状态外化工作区。

description.en: Harness² recursive self-improvement for DSH agents: Propose–Probe–Compose, isolated probes, anonymous selection, and a per-domain experience library.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Harness² 的 Propose–Probe–Compose 循环，从真实执行证据中持续改进提示词、技能、脚本与领域经验库。

description.en: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的一句话补成完整任务书（角色/目标/约束/输出格式）。引擎是 linshenkx/prompt-optimizer 的逐字节移植：三种优化模式、10 个模板与上游一致；历史为授权制、带版本链与结构对比；每次润色的 token 消耗可见。未经点击不写回、不发送。

description.en: Per-session execution gears for the DSH composer: an OVERDRIVE toggle turns Turbo on for the current session only, the Fast and Max gears swap the agent's planning and verification policy and may lower the request's reasoning effort, and the Host keeps the authoritative mode plus per-turn latency, step count, tool calls and whether a verification command ran.
description.zh: DSH 输入区的按会话执行档位：OVERDRIVE 开关只对当前会话开启 Turbo，极速/极限两档替换 agent 的规划与验证策略、并按档位调整请求的 reasoningEffort；Host 持有权威状态，并记录每轮耗时、模型步骤、工具调用与是否跑过验证命令。

description.en: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 智能体回答审查器：每一轮 agent 的最终输出由独立 LLM 重新打分（1-100），低于阈值时携带具体反馈引导 agent 自我修正；评分以角标形式展示在该回答的操作行上（通过=绿、未达标=红，悬停可见重试次数与原因）。闸值配置可从输入框上方视图栏的「Reviewer 配置」标签页（对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置）、本机 127.0.0.1 HTTP 服务或 dsh-better-sidebar 侧栏标签页实时修改。

description.en: Audit each finished assistant turn with an independent reviewer model and steer the agent to fix failed output, with at most 2 review rounds per turn and SOP-folder standards injected as an extra review dimension.
description.zh: 每轮回复结束时用独立审查模型审核输出，判定不合格则引导 agent 修复，每轮最多追问 2 次；可注入 SOP 文件夹标准作为额外审核维度。

description.en: Agent preset with adaptive tool presentation and environment-aware shell routing. Ports modules from yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite and xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard (the former is listed here), so do not enable it alongside those presets.
description.zh: 提供自适应工具呈现与环境适配 Shell 路由的智能体预设。复用了从 yjh051108/dsh-routing-suite 与 xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard 移植的模块（前者已收录），不要与这两个预设同时启用。

description.en: Executor/advisor workflow ported from pi-advisor-flow: the executor calls ask_advisor for a second opinion at key decisions, after repeated failures and before completion; equivalent repeated tool calls are intercepted before execution for an advisor review with a proceed/revise/blocked verdict, and hard mode force-reviews every turn before it closes. Per-call token and cost ledger with /advisor status readout, privacy tiers for repo context and file contents, six-shape secret redaction, and a web settings card; advisor failures never stall the main loop.
description.zh: 移植自 pi-advisor-flow 的执行者/顾问工作流：执行者经 ask_advisor 工具按需请求第二意见（可附问题、草稿、仓库上下文档位与点名文件）；等价工具调用重复达到阈值时在执行前拦截，由顾问以 proceed/revise/blocked 三值裁决，硬模式下回合收口前强制评审；提供逐次 token 与成本台账、/advisor status 状态读数、仓库上下文与文件内容分级授权、六类密钥形状脱敏与 web 设置卡；advisor 失败不停摆主循环。

description.en: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.
description.zh: 以证据为准的研究用智能体预设：每一步只能靠系统核验过的观测推进，L3 以上的结论交给独立评估者，整场会话折成一份可重放的账本，并长成可浏览的领域本体。需要 DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1。

description.en: Native generation-time Mixture-of-Agents: every turn, reference models run the same session context in parallel as pre-run drafts and one aggregator executes with full tooling; config-as-model recipes, F mirror / R trimmed views, enforced subagent gating (dual-shape session indexing), derived per-recipe vision (vision refs relay image reads to text-only aggregators), tiered cadence with separate steering and patrol rosters plus frozen reuse between beats, degeneration guard dropping degenerate reference output, anonymized model face (failure notices carry no provider identity).
description.zh: 原生生成时 MoA：每轮参考模型并行预演同一会话上下文产出草稿，单一聚合模型带完整工具循环执行；配置即模型配方、F 镜像 / R 裁剪双视野、子会话门控（双形态会话目录索引，修复后实效）、按成分派生的配方级视觉（视觉参考路可为纯文本聚合转述图像）、节拍节奏（定调与巡检两套阵容、拍间冻结复用）、退化守卫（剔除退化的参考输出）、模型面匿名（失败提示零供应商身份）。

description.en: On the first real work message of each chat window, asks for the missing goal, deliverable, constraints and acceptance criteria, then turns the answers into a short task sheet and injects it into the chat. Pure greetings are ignored.
description.zh: 每个聊天窗口的第一段工作内容前，先问清缺失的目标、交付物、限制与验收标准，再把回答整理成简短的任务说明注入聊天；纯寒暄不会触发。

description.en: Forced collaboration: a composer picker sets 0–6 sub-agents, and while it is on every hands-on task must be split across exactly that many child agents through a collab_fanout tool that has no count parameter, then merged by the main agent.
description.zh: 强制协作：在输入框左侧选 0–6 个子 Agent，开启后每个动手的任务都必须通过没有数量参数的 collab_fanout 工具拆给正好这么多个子 Agent 并行，再由主 Agent 汇总。

description.en: Meta's Muse Code CLI inside DSH: a composer switch starts muse serve, a right-sidebar panel and five chat tools (muse_open, muse_prompt, muse_read, muse_status, muse_interrupt) share one Muse session, approvals are decided only in the panel, and a local spend guard hard-stops at $10 by default. Windows only; needs the Muse Code CLI installed and signed in. The $10 cap is a local estimate for the muse serve this plugin starts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里使用 Meta 的 Muse Code CLI：输入框开关启动 muse serve，右侧边栏面板与五个聊天工具（muse_open、muse_prompt、muse_read、muse_status、muse_interrupt）共享同一个 Muse 会话，审批只能在面板里决定，本地花费护栏默认到 $10 硬停止。仅限 Windows；需已装好并登录 Muse Code CLI。$10 上限为本机估算，只管本插件启动的 muse serve。

description.en: Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自适应拓扑多智能体预设，提供点对点通信、任务交接和实时网络可视化。

description.en: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.
description.zh: 让领导不亲自干活的 agent preset：非管理类工具调用在 harness 边界一律被拒，任务只能外包给子智能体，选人前先一次性摸清可选子智能体模型、再按任务逐个选型；另一个 preset 故意挑最不适合该任务的模型。

description.en: White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.
description.zh: 白箱AGI架构探索：元认知（自我认知循环）、持续学习（知识飞轮）、世界模型（条件空间+语义时空图）、自我改进（自举纪律）、零LLM白箱管线与可审计信任护栏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness port of Claude Code Game Studios (CCGS v1.1.2, MIT): 76 skills, 49 agents, hook bridge.
description.zh: Claude Code Game Studios（CCGS v1.1.2，MIT）的 DeepSeek Harness 移植：76 个技能、49 个代理与钩子桥。

description.en: Records recurring task corrections and tool failures locally, then compiles them into changes to eight harness components through explicitly started evolution, paired baseline/candidate checks, trial activation and rollback. Includes a budget and audit ledger; requires Node.js 24+ and a compatible DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later 0.2.x host.
description.zh: 在本地记录重复的任务纠正与工具错误，通过显式启动的演化将经验编译为八类运行组件的改动，经过基线与候选成对验证、影子试用和回滚，并提供预算与审计账本。需要 Node.js 24+ 及兼容的 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起的 0.2.x 宿主。

description.en: Injects conclusions already established in the previous reasoning block after each tool result, so the model continues from them instead of re-deriving the same conclusions.
description.zh: 在每次工具结果后注入上一段思考中已确立的结论，使模型直接沿用而非重复推导。

description.en: Expert roster for DeepSeek Harness: 636 experts across 22 divisions with full Chinese names and bios, summoned as subagents from the @ menu or by the model through list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts, plus custom experts and a skill on/off switch.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的专家名册：22 个分类、636 位专家，中文名与简介全量覆盖；从 @ 菜单或由模型经 list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts 三个工具召唤为子代理，另可自建专家，并带一个技能开关。

description.en: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 提供拟真生活上下文：每轮对话自动注入工作区 .life/ 目录近 24 小时的生活事件（滑动窗口过滤、会话内智能去重与增量更新、世界近况），并提供 life_react 工具让 Agent 把感受、思考与行动回填到自己的生活日志，反哺下一轮世界演化——把 DSH Agent 变成有日常生活的角色扮演人设（适合酒馆式 RP、AI 陪伴）；配合每日世界演算工作流可获得持续的模拟人生式生活轨迹。

description.en: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据驱动目标校验插件。通过 /ultragoal 锁定目标，并依据命令退出码与生成产物验证完成状态，防止模型虚报任务完成。

description.en: An agent that wakes up on its own schedule: by default every 60 minutes, ±20% (48–72). It browses the interests you set, drops what it finds into a local pool of notes, and keeps a profile of what you like. When it has enough worth sharing it hands the session you linked a short package of notes — whether to speak, and which note to use, is that session's agent's call in the moment. Quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit and a cooldown are decided in code; when the answer is no, the decision and expression phases after the gate call no model at all — browsing runs before the gate and is counted separately. Windows, Linux and macOS (Linux and macOS are minimal support).
description.zh: 让 agent 不定期醒来的插件：默认 60 分钟一次，上下浮动 20%（48~72 分钟）。按你设的兴趣范围上网逛逛，看到的东西存进本地素材池，顺手维护一份你的兴趣画像。攒够值得说的，就往你绑定的会话递一份短素材——说不说、说哪条，交给那个会话里的 agent 按眼前处境定。静默时段、忙时窗口、每日上限、冷却都在代码层判；判别说时，闸门之后的决策与表达两相不再调用模型（闲逛相在闸门之前，另算）。支持 Windows、Linux 与 macOS（Linux / macOS 为最小支持）。

plugins.name: dsh-engram

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory as a local SQLite store: dual scopes (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval fused with RRF, an evidence gate that forces an explicit sufficiency judgement, provenance audit chains, SM-2 spaced-repetition review, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a nine-view "Memory Palace" sidebar panel. 22 narrow-parameter tools, no external service, no API key, no Docker.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆，纯本地 SQLite：双层分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合检索、强制给出充分性判定的证据门、来源审计链、SM-2 间隔重复复习、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及九视图「记忆宫殿」侧栏面板。22 个窄参数工具，无外部服务、无 API Key、无 Docker。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.
description.zh: 通过零参数 advisor() 咨询和按步巡逻检查，为执行模型接入更强的审查模型，返回计划、纠偏或停止信号。

plugins.name: dsh-maoying

description.en: Web-novel writing assistant preset for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent acts as editor-in-chief and delegates outlining, drafting, review, lore-keeping and research to five helpers across a seven-phase workflow, with the whole novel kept as a structured markdown/YAML novel/ directory (character cards, a foreshadowing state machine, timeline, narrative memory), plus a sidebar creator panel and six zero-dependency CLI commands.
description.zh: 网文创作辅助插件：主 agent 任主编，把大纲、写作、审校、设定维护、素材考据委派给五个帮手，按七阶段工作流推进；整部小说就是工作区里结构化的 novel/ 目录（角色卡、伏笔状态机、时间线、叙事记忆），另带侧栏创作台面板与六条零依赖 CLI 命令。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.idpf.org

description.en: Control plane for the harness's own Agent Teams: members are ordinary independent sessions created through the same seam the GUI uses, each with its own model, so they open and continue like any other conversation while a sidecar roster and task board coordinate them. Task entries carry a definition of done, a member's completion is submitted and waits for the Lead's review, and availability tells idle apart from awaiting-review or a failed last turn. With delegationEngine=auto it uses independent sessions, continuable subagents, or the kernel roster depending on what the composition provides.
description.zh: 内核 Agent Teams 的控制面：团队成员是与 GUI 同一条缝创建的普通独立会话（各自有模型），能像任何对话一样打开与继续；名册与任务板在侧车里协调它们——任务带完成标准，成员完成后提交并等待 Lead 审议，状态区分空闲 / 待审议 / 上一轮失败。delegationEngine=auto 会按组合提供的能力选择独立会话、可续接子代理或内核 roster。

description.en: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable autonomous configuration and testing, while Agents with different models and personalities can chat, role-play, or form nested control chains. Supports conversational setup, user-like operations, incremental reading, saved references, and remote session/workspace search.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供直接操控本机完整 DSH 实例的能力：目标 DSH 无需安装任何插件或额外组件，零侵入，环境隔离便于用户直接让agent为另一环境进行修改配置到自主测试,也能让不同模型、不同人格的 Agent 互相聊天、角色扮演或层层套娃，探索趣味玩法，可通过对话由 Agent 自主配置连接，并支持接近用户的操作语义、增量读取、引用保存以及远端会话与工作区搜索。

description.en: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.
description.zh: 提供 /pua，在 Agent 失败后促使其换方法，并在宣称完成前核验收据；含 15 种公司风格、角色模式、全局与会话设置，以及可选验收循环（直到验收命令通过、达到迭代上限或用户取消）。

description.en: Old conversation is folded into short summaries by a side model before the window fills (on-disk ledger survives restarts and re-anchors after host compaction), so long sessions stop getting more expensive every turn — one real full-day session: 6 folds replaced 209 old messages and the live context stayed in the tens of thousands of tokens. The session model picks the model per subtask across six pools (economy/mechanical/main/hard/vision/review); or pick Auto and a small intent classifier routes each message itself, switching only past a confidence threshold to keep prompt caches warm. A three-line watermark ends in an automatic four-step handover (fork backup, handover doc, compact, wake) without losing in-flight subagents; /ctx-pause, /ctx-resume and /ctx-handover keep it manual when wanted. Optional Agent Teams mode adds teammates and a shared task board; /vision gives text-only models eyes via the vision pool; tiered verification sends bigger diffs to a tester plus an independent reviewer. Settings UI, READMEs and language preferences cover the same 11 languages. Bundles three skills: read-only MySQL/Redis verification, commit-message generation, and a requirements/design document convention.
description.zh: 旧对话在窗口塞满前由侧模型自动折成短摘要（折叠账本写在磁盘上、重启不丢、宿主压缩后自动重锚），长会话不再越聊越贵——一个真实整天的会话：6 次折叠换掉 209 条旧消息，模型实际背着的上下文始终停在几万 token。会话模型自己给子任务选模型，六个派发池（轻量/机械/主力/高难/多模态/复审）；也可以选「自动（意图识别）」，小分类模型逐条决定交给谁，置信度不足不切换、护住提示词缓存。三条水位线到顶自动四步交接（fork 备份、交接文档、压缩、唤醒续跑），跑着的子智能体不丢；/ctx-pause、/ctx-resume、/ctx-handover 随时手动接管。可选 Agent Teams 模式带来常驻队友与共享任务板；/vision 让纯文本模型看图；分级验证给大改动配 tester 和独立复审。设置界面、README 与语言偏好覆盖同一套 11 种语言。内置三个技能：MySQL/Redis 只读核验、commit 文案生成、需求与设计文档规范。

description.en: Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.
description.zh: 连接小沐的 dsh 插件：和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务。

description.en: Recovers a DeepSeek Harness turn that ended with reasoning only, with no text and no tool call, by steering the same turn one more step. Structure-only detection, so it costs no extra model call.
description.zh: 识别「整轮只有思考、既无正文也无工具调用」的空回合，让同一轮再走一步；纯结构判定，不额外调用模型。

description.en: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.
description.zh: 基于 @michengai/dsh-pua 的修订版：解除上游「全局总闸」，让入口恒常显示、功能默认关闭并可按会话开关；入口改为下拉菜单（打开 / 关闭 / 选项），选项面板更紧凑。

description.en: Measures what your assembled system prompt is actually made of - rules, identity, workspace policy, tool descriptions - in bytes and percentages, then moves the operating protocol ahead of the rule block so the model reads who it works for before it reads the prohibitions. Config-driven via ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json; two hooks, no build step, no dependencies.
description.zh: 先按字节与占比量出组装后的系统提示词到底由什么构成——规则、身份、工作区策略、工具描述各占多少，再把操作规程提到规则块之前，让模型先读到「在为难干活」再读到一堆禁令。通过 ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json 配置；两个钩子、无需构建、无依赖。

description.en: Keeps a DSH agent turn open when the model ends it by narrating work it has not done: on agent/turn-stopping the guard replays the turn log and classifies the trailing message with regexes — in the default mode wait / ask / done / gray end the turn with no model call, and only a promise of pending work reaches the judge — then has a judge chain of four dialect kinds (System One three-question noul, OpenAI-compatible, OpenAI Decisions, or the session LLM) rule on whether the turn is really over, and steers the same turn with agent.steer when it is not.
description.zh: 模型叙述了「接下来要做什么」却什么都没做就结束回合时，保住 DSH 的 agent 回合：插件在 agent/turn-stopping 回放该回合日志，用正则分类末条消息——默认模式下 wait / ask / done / gray 直接结束回合、不调模型，只有承诺了未完成工作的消息才交给裁判——再由四种裁判方言组成的链（System One 三题 noul、OpenAI 兼容、OpenAI Decisions 或当前会话 LLM）判定回合是否真的结束，未结束就用 agent.steer 推进同一回合。

description.en: Reflective self-evolution plugin for local Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash and online APIs: a coding-loop convergence steerer curbs Qwen3.8 27B/Flash repeated-verification deep-thinking to converge faster and cut thinking time; a five-state delivery guard detects and corrects stuck turns and infinite loops; model-agnostic host logic, mostly compatible with online APIs; per-use continual self-improvement with counter-reason self-checks, critic escalation, inverted-index memory retrieval, coding-loop convergence steering, and a five-state delivery guard.
description.zh: 面向本地 Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash 及线上 API 的反思进化插件：编码循环收敛器针对 Qwen3.8 27B/Flash 的重复验证大思考加速收敛、减少思考时间；五态交付护栏检测并纠正卡住/死循环；model-agnostic 宿主逻辑，线上 API 多数可通用；每次使用持续自进化，带反问式自检、批评升级、倒排索引记忆检索、编码循环收敛提示与五态交付护栏。

description.en: Exposes DSH as an MCP server so another agent can watch its thinking, tool calls and file writes in real time, share intent, take a floor lock that denies DSH's write/edit/git tools, inject mid-turn alerts, and delegate reviews.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成一个 MCP server：让另一个 agent 实时看见它的思维、工具调用和文件改动，共享意图，持地板锁期间拒绝 DSH 的 write/edit/git 工具，插入中途提醒，并委托审查。

description.en: A philosopher's way of thinking made executable: dialectics and practice-testing to govern hallucination and long-session drift, so done is a verifiable fact rather than a claim.
description.zh: 把哲学家的思考方式变成可执行的东西：用辩证法和实践检验治理幻觉与长会话漂移，让「做完了」是可核事实而不是一句自述。

description.en: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻的 Endeavour 与 Challenger 对等会话：负责规划、按序执行任务，并核验汇报的结果。

description.en: Checks each claim in a finished answer against the tool output that same turn read: a contradiction whose quote is found in that output steers one correction in the same turn, and claims the output does not back are flagged in the session log and on stderr. A free scan for absolute words and unmatched numbers runs first, and a turn that ran no tool never reaches the model.
description.zh: 把成品回答里的每条断言，和同一回合工具实际读到的内容对照：引用能在输出里找到的矛盾会在同一回合触发一次纠正；输出不支撑的断言则写进会话日志与 stderr。先跑一遍绝对化措辞与对不上数字的免费扫描，整回合没调用工具的就不进模型。

description.en: Deterministic goal-completion gate for DSH: a contract-first AC grammar with named failable check commands, a gate that re-runs every check itself (zero model trust), verdicts bound to a tree digest so file changes void passing verdicts, and a hard deny on false completion at update_goal via tools/pre-execute with a false-complete counter that blocks after two catches; scope-aware task-level claim handling (strict or goal-only) keeps multi-task Agent Teams loops from deadlocking.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性目标门控插件：契约先行的 AC 文法（每条检查都是可失败的具名命令），门控自己重跑每条检查、零模型参与；verdict 绑定文件树摘要，文件改动即作废已过审结论；通过 tools/pre-execute 硬拦 update_goal 的完成声明，配合假完成计数，两次被抓住即 BLOCKED；任务级完成声明按作用域分级（strict/goal-only），多任务 Agent Teams 循环不会死锁。

description.en: Five-tier reasoning protocol injected into the system prompt — off / light / standard / deep / multi-agent, 0 / 3 / 9 / 17 / 19 rules — with the tokens each tier adds per request shown beside it. Alongside it: a claim ledger that marks a load-bearing claim with no evidence or check as unsupported, read-only analyst briefs, JSON-declared custom tools that work in the same turn, one persistent PowerShell session, and re-injection of host context after a configurable message gap. Tier 0 injects nothing and mounts no tools. A derivative of husongan/dsh-deepseek-2027 (MIT); do not install both — each injects its own reasoning-protocol section into the system prompt.
description.zh: 注入系统提示的五档推理协议——关 / 轻 / 标准 / 深 / 多智能体，分别 0 / 3 / 9 / 17 / 19 条规则——每档旁边标出它给单次请求增加多少 token。此外还有结论台账（承重结论没有证据或检查就判为不支持）、只读分析员简报、当轮即生效的 JSON 声明式自建工具、一个持久的 PowerShell 会话，以及按可配置的消息间隔重发宿主上下文。0 档不注入任何内容，也不挂工具。衍生自 husongan/dsh-deepseek-2027（MIT），不要与上游同装——两者都会往系统提示里注入各自的推理协议段。

description.en: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 四厂商（迪普/新华三/华为/锐捷）交换机路由器命令知识库：32 篇文档随插件以技能形式分发（含来源链接与 verified 分级），KB 优先检索、跨厂商语法对照、拓扑与回显截图识别、联网查官方手册并注明出处、高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；只回答网络工程主题。

description.en: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: DSH 智能体经验记忆与反思插件：任务后自动整理候选经验，经用户审阅采纳后在相关任务中自动召回。支持来源追溯、按项目检索、冲突处理、使用反馈和到期复核；整理与召回可分别开关，写入 AGENTS.md 需预览并手动应用。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Story Mode preset for DeepSeek Harness: role-play GM persona, three-way choices, .md character cards and world book, context distillation and prompt wrapping.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的故事模式预设：叙事 GM 人格、三条走向、.md 角色卡与世界书记忆、上下文提纯与前后置提示词。

description.en: Adds a `muse` subagent provider and the `subagent_muse` tool to DeepSeek Harness, so the main agent can hand one self-contained task to the Meta Muse Code CLI and get back only its final report. A patched fork of `@pascapone/dsh-muse-code` that loads on DSH 0.2.1: it carries local equivalents of the removed `settleRun` export and `subagents.start` method, and documents an optional proxy for the gateway stream-phase bug. Needs the `muse` CLI installed. Install either this fork or the upstream @pascapone/dsh-muse-code, not both: both register the same subagent-muse loader row.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 `muse` 子代理提供方与 `subagent_muse` 工具，主代理可把一整段任务外包给 Meta Muse Code CLI，只取回最终报告。这是 `@pascapone/dsh-muse-code` 的修补分叉，可在 DSH 0.2.1 上加载：内含被移除的 `settleRun` 导出与 `subagents.start` 方法的本地等价实现，并附网关流式 phase 缺陷的可选代理修正。需已安装 `muse` CLI。本分叉不能与上游 @pascapone/dsh-muse-code 同装：两者注册同一个 subagent-muse 加载行。

description.en: Prepares a workspace management protocol for an agent — three libraries (cognition, tools, external information), an optional preloaded session that has already read the workspace, and a re-read card when the workspace has changed enough.
description.zh: 为 agent 准备一套工作区管理协议——认知、工具、外部信息三库，一条可选的、已读过工作区的预加载会话，以及工作区变化达到阈值后弹出的重读卡片。

description.en: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的判断内核：认知循环让判断有来处、反馈有归因、规划收口；海马体把运行经历沉淀为可复用知识（序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘）；判分身份职责入架构（口径一致、判据绑定来源）；联动 dsh-linghun-assembler 的 A2A 记忆管理团队。需要 DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7（支持 rc.2）。

description.en: Memory-assembly team for DeepSeek Harness: every message triggers a five-step cognition loop (judge, retrieve, assemble, feedback, calibrate) carried by role-playing subagents (judge, retriever, archivist, advocate, editor, scribe), using BM25 retrieval, time-ordered material, and LLM assembly to build useful material packs injected into linghun. Works with dsh-linghun.
description.zh: 灵魂的记忆提取侧·认知循环团队版：判断→捞取→组装→被判定→校准五步闭环，判官/捞手/史官/辩手/编辑/书记角色化子智能体承载，BM25 检索 + 时序素材 + LLM 组装「有用素材包」注入 linghun。与 dsh-linghun 组合使用。

plugins.name: deepseek-servant

description.en: Autonomous AI assistant and multi-agent collaboration for DSH: discuss goals, plan work in the background, coordinate multiple Workers to execute tasks and review results, pause and resume work, recover after interruptions, keep task history and deliverables, and build working memory and skills; offers a standard local mode and optional experimental private-Git collaboration.
description.zh: DSH 自主 AI 助理与多 Agent 协作：通过前台对话明确目标，后台规划、多 Worker 执行与结果验收，支持暂停接续、故障恢复、任务历史与成果记录、工作记忆和技能积累，提供标准本地模式及可选的实验性私有 Git 协作。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration preset: a lead agent dispatches subagents from a built-in role roster over separate read and write lane pools with per-role model binding, and collects each subagent report on a shared board; adds go_work/continue/need_help/forward tools, a tree-view panel and a settings page.
description.zh: 多智能体编排预设：主编（Sisyphus）调度 + 内置工种名册 + 报告落板；读/写双泳道池化编排、按工种绑定模型，含 go_work/continue/need_help/forward 通信，以及 Web UI 树状图面板与设置页。

plugins.name: portable-dsh-multi-agent-plugin

description.en: Route each task to one model and its review to a different one, with qualification evidence, failover and a durable journal.
description.zh: 把任务派给一个模型、把评审交给另一个模型，并带有资格证据、故障转移与持久日志。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Makes the agent narrate its process: every turn opens with how it reads the message and what it will do first, then short interim notes between tool-call batches, with in-app settings for style, sentence cap and toggles.
description.zh: 让 agent 边做边说：每轮先用一两句说明怎么理解消息、准备怎么做、第一步是什么，并在工具调用批次之间写过程叙述；插件页可直接调整详略、句数上限与开关。

description.en: Peer collaboration between a DeepSeek Harness agent and the local Codex CLI: split a goal into a shared work list, hand tasks over, review what comes back, and keep every prompt, event stream, and answer on disk.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness agent 与本机 Codex CLI 对等协作：把目标拆成共享工作清单、派活与交接、互相审查，并把每一步的提示词、事件流与回答留档在本地。

description.en: Expose a second-opinion tool: when the main agent is stuck it hands the problem to an independent session, receives a plan back, and continues — without waking or impersonating the user.
description.zh: 跨会话「第二意见」：一个会话卡住时，把问题交给另一个独立会话单独思考，把方案拿回来继续。不冒充用户发言，也不唤醒闲置会话。

description.en: Resumes an agent turn that ended after narrating its next action without calling a tool: the guard replays the turn log on agent/turn-stopping, asks a judge model one true/false question, and steers the same turn to run one more step.
description.zh: 续跑「叙述了下一步动作却没调用工具」就结束的 agent 轮次：插件在 agent/turn-stopping 回放该轮日志，让裁判模型回答一次 true/false，命中的话把同一轮再推进一步。

description.en: Animated personal assistant with independent chats, shared conversation memory, natural-language reminders and background tasks.
description.zh: 带动态表情的个人助手，提供独立聊天、跨聊天记忆、自然语言提醒和后台任务。

description.en: Claude Code-style workbench in DSH: workspace/session sidebar, streaming document-style transcript with unified tool cards and thinking, Markdown and Mermaid rendering, dark theme, and a draggable overlay panel backed by an in-host HTTP/WebSocket service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内提供 Claude Code 风格工作台：工作区/会话侧栏、流式文档式对话与统一工具卡、思考过程、Markdown 与 Mermaid 渲染、暗色主题，以及由宿主内 HTTP/WebSocket 服务驱动的可拖动悬浮面板。

description.en: A collaboration front-office for AI agents and humans — department boards, tickets, approvals and industry calculations run inside the DSH conversation and panel, so agents do the work in chat while humans stay accountable in the panel. It calls the 01men/ybkkasi governance base over existing contracts (asset ledger, IAM, OIDC SSO, RBAC and scene-level authorization) instead of re-implementing governance. Ships as a Cordis bundle and mounts at /gate01; the selftest suite is green on every push. Do not install this and 01men/ybkkasi as dsh bundles in the same profile: both register the ops-platform-core / ops-iam / ops-authn rows. Requires DSH >=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0.
description.zh: AI 代理与人类的协作前台——部门看板、工单、审批与行业计算都在 DSH 会话与面板里完成，代理在对话里干活，人在面板里负责。它通过既有契约调用 01men/ybkkasi 治理底座（资产台账、IAM、OIDC SSO、RBAC 与场景级授权），不重复实现治理。以 Cordis bundle 形式安装，挂载在 /gate01；自测套件每次推送全绿。请勿在同一 profile 同时安装本插件与 01men/ybkkasi 的 dsh bundle：两者都会注册 ops-platform-core / ops-iam / ops-authn 行。要求 DSH >=0.1.0-rc.7 <0.2.0。

description.en: Rotates the dsh turn-status label through 1059 bilingual phrases with typewriter output, an animated rainbow gradient, danmaku, 12 toggleable theme packs, live placeholders and tab-title rotation. Two star packs ship disabled by default; the stargazer pack carries one phrase per stargazer, refreshed weekly by a workflow.
description.zh: 把 dsh 回合状态行换成 1059 条中英文案的轮播：打字机输出、流动彩虹渐变、弹幕、12 个可开关的主题词库包、实时占位符与标签页标题轮换。两个 star 包默认关闭；星标者包每位星标者一条文案，由工作流每周刷新。

description.en: Workspace/chat context menu for the DSH home page: pin, rename, open in file explorer, archive, fork, copy, and open in a new window.
description.zh: DSH 主页工作区/会话增强菜单：置顶、重命名、资源管理器打开、归档、分叉、复制、新窗口打开。

description.en: Sticky-notes board for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry opens a Markdown note panel with auto-save, colors, image paste and task-list rendering.
description.zh: dsh 便签插件：侧栏入口打开 Markdown 便签面板，支持自动保存、颜色标签、粘贴图片与任务清单。

description.en: Keyboard-first command palette for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 键盘优先的命令面板（command palette）。

description.en: Adds an "About" settings page to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, showing the running DSH version and recent release notes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置面板添加“关于”页，展示运行中的 DSH 版本与最近更新日志。

description.en: Session-based task board in the sidebar: drag sessions into todo/doing/review/done columns, create sessions with model and reasoning-effort selection, trash with restore, notes, export/import.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话化任务看板：拖拽会话到待办/进行中/评审中/已完成四列，新建会话可选模型与推理强度，回收站可恢复，支持备注与导出导入。

description.en: Chinese frontend UI design spec for dsh: injects the zh-ui-design skill and prompt rules (section-name headings, no filler copy, one signature element), plus a 10-rule UI copy/style linter.
description.zh: 中文前端界面设计规范：注入 zh-ui-design 技能与系统提示，标题即功能、去除解释性占位文案、单一记忆点签名元素；附带 10 条界面文案/样式 lint 规则。

description.en: A restart button at the sidebar foot, just above the account entry, for the DSH desktop app on Windows: two clicks stop the app and bring it back, with no console window.
description.zh: DSH Windows 桌面端侧栏底部的重启按钮，就在账号入口上方：点两次即结束应用进程并自动重启，全程不弹命令窗口。

description.en: Composer expand/collapse toggle for the Web UI: a ⬆/⬇ button in the composer tool row grows the input to a tall 70vh writing view for long drafts.
description.zh: Web UI 输入框展开/收起：composer 工具行新增 ⬆/⬇ 按钮，一键把输入框扩大到 70vh 高度，方便写长 prompt。

description.en: Input-bar prompt optimizer: rewrites drafts with 6 strategies × 3 languages plus custom instructions, optional goal/todo/compaction-summary/tool-result and chat context, a confirm dialog, last-5 history and three-tier settings persistence.
description.zh: 输入栏提示词优化：6 种策略 × 3 种语言与自定义指令重写草稿，可选携带目标、任务清单、压缩摘要、工具结果与聊天上下文，附结果确认弹窗、最近 5 次历史与三级设置持久化。

description.en: Restarts the DeepSeek Harness desktop app from three places: a Settings row, the account menu above Sign out, and a configurable keyboard shortcut. Asks before interrupting running tasks. If a newer update is already downloaded and waiting, restarting installs it first. Windows desktop app only.
description.zh: 从三处重启 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端：设置里的按钮、账号菜单「退出登录」上方的一项、以及可自定义的快捷键；有运行中的任务时会先确认；若新版本更新已下载并等待安装，重启时会先静默安装更新。仅支持 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: Anatomy panel for the Agent-Body organs: serves a live vitals dashboard at /anatomy inside the harness itself - organs, heartbeat, healing ledger, self-training counters and the real pulse stream - read straight from the runtime files rather than retyped. Host-only, no client bundle and no build step.
description.zh: Agent-Body 器官的解剖面板：在 harness 内部的 /anatomy 提供实时体征看板——器官、心跳、自愈账本、自训练计数与真实脉冲流，数据直接读自运行时文件而非誊写。仅 host 端，无客户端 bundle、无构建步骤。

description.en: Adds a "Text Injection" section to the DSH Settings sidebar: user-maintained blocks in a standalone Markdown file are injected into the system prompt every turn or into session context with keyword gating, with hot reload and automatic history backups.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页左侧栏新增「文字注入」分区：独立 Markdown 文件中的文字块可注入系统提示词（每轮生效）或会话上下文（关键词门控、去重），支持热加载与自动历史备份。

description.en: Restores the DSH right sidebar divider drag after whole-interface zoom shifts the host handle off it, and widens the hit area to 12px with a hover affordance.
description.zh: 修复整页缩放后右侧栏拖拽手柄偏移、分割线拖不动的问题，把命中区加宽到 12px 并显示悬停提示线。

description.en: Whole-interface zoom for the DSH Web UI from 70% to 160%, driven by Ctrl+wheel, DSH's shortcut center or an inline pill, with content-width compensation so zooming out fits more text instead of narrowing the column.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面整体缩放（70%–160%），可用 Ctrl+滚轮、DSH 快捷键中心或输入框旁的胶囊操作，带正文栏宽度补偿，缩小后是一行更多字而不是一条更窄的栏。

description.en: Browser-style Session tab bar for the DSH Web GUI - one tab per Session in a full-width strip at the top of the window, Sessions grouped per Workspace in collapsible boxes, tabs created only for the Sessions you actually open.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 的浏览器式顶部会话标签栏：窗口顶部一条整宽标签，一个标签对应一个会话，会话按工作区收在可折叠的方框里，只有真正打开过的会话才会成为标签。

description.en: A live crypto ticker card in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar footer, above the balance and Settings, showing BTC, ETH, SOL and JUP prices, 24-hour change and 24-point sparklines, with a pulse on each price tick, zero dependencies and no API key.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏左下角的实时加密货币行情卡片，位于余额与设置上方，显示 BTC、ETH、SOL、JUP 的价格、24 小时涨跌幅与 24 点迷你走势图，价格跳动时有脉冲反馈，零依赖、免密钥。

description.en: Windows desktop floating assistant for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top chat panel with streaming answers, model switching, and region-screenshot questions.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮助手：常驻置顶的对话面板，框选屏幕区域直接提问，支持流式回答、模型切换与历史记录。

description.en: Adds ChatGPT-style stop, edit-and-resend, native quote annotations, and an independent sidebar follow-up chat with model and image input for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 增加接近 ChatGPT 的停止、编辑重发、原生引用注释，以及支持模型和图片输入的独立侧边栏追问对话。

description.en: A 3D neural memory map panel for the meow-memory store inside DeepSeek Harness. Sidebar entry + desktop embed, with 8-region memory classification and retrieval. Requires the meow-memory plugin (it reads .dsh-meow/memory.db) and Node 22.5+ (node:sqlite).
description.zh: 记忆星脑：meow-memory 记忆库的 3D 神经脑图面板，左侧栏入口 + 桌面内嵌，支持八分区归类与记忆检索；需先安装 meow-memory 插件（读取其 .dsh-meow/memory.db），并要求 Node 22.5+（node:sqlite）。

description.en: Session-scoped diff view for the DSH Web right sidebar: opening a file the current conversation changed renders it in place with git-style added/removed line backgrounds, +/− gutter markers and dual old/new line numbers under syntax colouring, a header with +added −removed counts, a Changes only / Whole file toggle and a Re-read button, plus a companion tab that lists every file the session changed and opens each one in the same view. Files the conversation did not touch keep the shipped text viewer.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 右侧栏提供按会话的 diff 视图：打开当前对话改动过的文件时原位渲染，按 git 风格显示新增/删除行底色、+/− 行标记、新旧双行号与语法高亮，头部带 +新增 −删除 计数、「仅看改动 / 整个文件」切换和「重新读取」按钮；另有一个配套标签页列出本次会话改动过的所有文件，点开即进入同一视图。当前对话没有改动过的文件仍使用自带文本查看器。

description.en: Persists unsent composer attachments per session, so images and files pasted into the input box survive page switches, conversation switches and app restarts: the bytes are mirrored in IndexedDB and handed back through the official createDrafts/addAttachments channel, and are dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.
description.zh: 按会话持久化输入框中尚未发送的附件：切页、切换会话乃至重启应用后回到该会话，草稿图片与文件会经官方 createDrafts/addAttachments 通道自动恢复；消息发出或手动移除后不会再出现。

description.en: Adds two visual pages to DSH Settings. MCP servers are kept as a JSON source of truth that rewrites the profile patch managed block, with YAML validation and timestamped backups, plus import of a pasted mcpServers JSON that first lists what will be added or overwritten. Thinking unlock probes each OpenAI-compatible gateway for the reasoning efforts it really declares and writes the per-level config back while leaving other hand-written YAML byte ranges untouched; the available model list syncs from a separate button that previews additions and removals, then writes levels and models in one atomic pass, and can also run on the page schedule.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里加两个可视化页面。MCP 管理以 JSON 为真理源整体重写 profile patch 受管区块（写入前做 YAML 校验与时间戳备份），并支持粘贴 mcpServers JSON、先列出将新增/将覆盖的条目再写入。思考解锁对每个 OpenAI 兼容网关探测它真正声明的思考档位并逐模型写回，手写的其他 YAML 片段逐字节保留；可用模型清单由独立按钮同步，先预览将新增/将移除，确认后与思考档位同批写入，也可绑定页面上的定时更新。

description.en: Marks paragraphs or a single code line in an answer and asks the model about it in a docked right-hand column, leaving the conversation itself unmodified.
description.zh: 点选回答中的段落或某一行代码，在右侧独立栏里向模型提问；左侧对话内容不被修改。

description.en: A Claude Code-style reasoning-effort slider for the DSH Web UI: stepless drag, snap-on-release, a WebGL fire trail, and real, working thinking-effort control for any custom third-party model or provider.
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的推理等级滑块：无极拖动、松手吸附、WebGL 火焰跟随，任何自定义第三方模型/提供商都能获得真实生效的思考强度调节。

description.en: Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.
description.zh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

description.en: Batch-archive or restore all conversations of a workspace from a sidebar panel or its row menu, hide a workspace from the sidebar once every conversation in it is archived, and pin workspaces to the top. Hiding never deletes logs, moves directories, or changes membership.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板或会话行菜单里批量归档/恢复整个工作区的全部会话；工作区会话全部归档后从侧栏隐藏，恢复任一会话即重新出现；并支持工作区置顶。隐藏不删除日志、不移动目录、不改会话归属。

description.en: Right-side overlay panel for DSH sessions showing git status, background jobs, skills and MCP usage, artifacts and visited pages, with a commit/push dialog and one-click GitHub publish.
description.zh: DSH 会话右侧独立监控面板：git 状态、后台进程、技能与 MCP、产出与网页查阅，附提交/推送对话框与一键发布到 GitHub。

description.en: Adjust chat bubbles and message spacing with comfortable or compact density on verified Windows Desktop RC2/RC3/RC5/0.2.2-rc.1 layouts, retaining native styles for unknown host fingerprints.
description.zh: 在已核验的 Windows Desktop RC2/RC3/RC5/0.2.2-rc.1 布局中调整聊天气泡和消息间距，支持舒适或紧凑密度，未知宿主指纹保留原生样式。

description.en: Icon, Chinese display name and a one-line note for every DSH plugin, organized with folders, favorites, drag or pinyin ordering, list and grid views. Icons are auto-assigned to all installed plugins and can be overridden; import and export cover icons, names, notes, folders and order. Display-only: plugin files and cordis config are never modified; enable switches call the official plugin manager.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件换自定义图标、中文显示名和一句话说明；用文件夹与收藏整理，支持拖拽排序、按备注名拼音排序、列表与铺陈两种视图。所有已安装插件自动分配图标（可手动覆盖）；导入导出覆盖图标、备注名、说明、文件夹与排序。只改显示，不修改插件文件与 cordis 配置；启用开关转调官方插件管理器。

description.en: Opens .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: Blender headless exports a cached GLB with scene statistics, rendered by a dependency-free WebGL viewport. Requires Blender 3.6+ on PATH (or set blenderPath).
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB 与场景统计，由零依赖 WebGL 视口渲染。需本机装有 Blender 3.6+（或在设置里指定 blenderPath）。

description.en: A pinned-sessions group in the sidebar, above the workspace list: every pinned session across all workspaces in one collapsible, searchable list, with click-to-open and a hover-revealed unpin button.
description.zh: 侧栏「工作区」上方的一个置顶分组：跨工作区汇总所有置顶会话，可折叠、可就地搜索，点行打开、悬停出现取消置顶按钮。

description.en: Open .blend files in the right-Sidebar document preview: cached Blender headless GLB export plus a dependency-free WebGL viewport and scene statistics. Requires Blender 3.6 or later installed locally.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 .blend：Blender headless 导出缓存 GLB，零依赖 WebGL 视口与场景统计。需要本机安装 Blender 3.6 或更高版本。

description.en: Play video and audio in the right-Sidebar document preview, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route with desktop seek.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里播放视频/音频，经带鉴权的 HTTP Range 路由流式读取，桌面端可拖动进度。

description.en: Open STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: browser-side binary/ASCII parsing, a WebGL viewport, and size/volume/surface-area/watertightness statistics.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII，WebGL 视口 + 尺寸/体积/表面积/水密统计。

description.en: Opens STL meshes in the right-Sidebar document preview: binary/ASCII parsing in the browser, a WebGL viewport, and size, volume, surface-area and watertightness statistics.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏文档预览里打开 STL：浏览器解析二进制/ASCII 网格，用 WebGL 视口展示尺寸、体积、表面积与水密性。

description.en: AI-native expressions for two-way chat: people see images, while text-only models read fixed meanings; includes a picker, custom expressions, import/export, and two visual styles.
description.zh: 用于双向聊天的 AI 原生表情：人看图片，纯文本模型读取固定语义；支持表情选择、自建表情、导入导出和两套画风。

description.en: Sidebar panel for a weekly, human-curated Chinese ranking of the DSH ecosystem: 31 tracked projects (17 installable plugins plus tools/skills) ranked by live GitHub stars with week-over-week deltas, and a real-call availability survey of the "free" models. Sponsor slots are labelled and sit outside the ranking.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：每周更新的中文 DSH 生态榜单——收录 31 个项目（其中 17 个是可安装插件，其余为周边工具/Skill），按实时星数排行并给出较上期涨星；另有「免费」模型的真实调用可用性实测。赞助位明确标注，且不参与排序。

description.en: Edge breathing border showing DeepSeek peak/valley hours, with flowing light and scheduled push reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷提醒：贴屏呼吸边框（高峰橙/低峰蓝）、流光效果与消息推送提醒。

description.en: Vault button beside the DSH composer: save keys, servers, phone numbers, addresses and URLs, auto-collected from conversations, password-protected with WebDAV backup; click to insert, Ctrl+click to send.
description.zh: 输入栏旁的保险箱按钮：保存密钥、服务器、手机号、地址与网址，自动识别会话中的敏感信息提醒收录，密码保护并支持 WebDAV 备份；点击填入输入框，Ctrl+点击直接发送。

description.en: An embedded Douyin window docked in the DSH sidebar: a real Electron webview guest, so douyin.com's X-Frame-Options: DENY no longer applies.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏底部的内嵌抖音窗口：用 Electron webview 租约绕过 douyin.com 的 X-Frame-Options: DENY。仅桌面版。

description.en: Bilingual Chinese and English typing practice with timed passages, IME-aware scoring, per-character feedback, and locally stored records.
description.zh: 中英双语打字练习，提供计时短文、输入法友好评分、逐字反馈和本地记录。

description.en: Skills and MCP management console in the settings panel: merged skill catalog across every provider (hierarchical browse by source, online create/edit, independent model and user invocation switches, recoverable trash), GitHub install with multi-select batch install and update checks, MCP server add/edit/remove and enable/disable through the profile patch layer, cross-agent import from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Cline, Roo Code, Continue and Windsurf, and an independent SDK connection probe.
description.zh: 设置面板里的技能与 MCP 管理控制台：跨全部来源合并的技能目录（按来源分级浏览、在线新建与编辑、模型 / 用户调用独立开关、可恢复回收站）、GitHub 安装（多选批量安装、检查更新）、通过 profile patch 层增删改与启停 MCP 服务器、从 Claude Code / Cursor / Codex / Cline / Roo Code / Continue / Windsurf 一键导入，以及独立的 SDK 连通性探测。

description.en: Rhine Lab-style boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: six acts from a black title plate through irradiated white-out to a warm dossier panel, five access-authorization steps (the first two can wait for a click or Enter, and Esc skips), real-voice recordings for the first five lines, and a settings page that switches between warm-light and dark themes and live-edits 33 playback, identity, voice and visual options.
description.zh: 莱茵生命风格的 DeepSeek Harness 启动动画：黑幕标识 → 过曝洗白 → 暖白档案底板 → 五步访问授权（前两步可设为等点击/回车，Esc 可跳过）→ 色散揭幕，前五句为真声台词；设置页提供暖白/暗色两套主题，并可实时调整播放、身份、语音与视觉等 33 项参数。

description.en: Drag-to-resize the chat content width in the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a handle on the column right edge overrides the built-in 748px width (default 1040px, 520-2400 range, persisted per browser, double-click resets).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可拖拽的聊天内容宽度：文字列右缘的把手覆盖内置的 748px 宽度（默认 1040px、范围 520~2400、按浏览器记忆，双击恢复默认）。

description.en: Follow list above the sidebar conversation list: a status dot per conversation (unread, waiting for you, running, failed), newest reply first, running ones last, and a follow toggle beside the model selector.
description.zh: 在侧边栏对话列表上方增加关注区：每行一个状态圆点（未读、待回复、运行中、失败），有新回复的置顶、运行中的置底，模型选择器左侧还有关注按钮。

description.en: Live progress bar under the composer with a percentage and an estimated time left for the current DeepSeek Harness turn; the estimate re-anchors as the turn runs and never reads 100% until the turn ends, and the bar turns red when the turn fails or is interrupted.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示当前这一轮 DeepSeek Harness 任务的实时进度条、百分比与预计剩余时间；估计随轮次实时重锚，任务失败或中断时进度条变红。

description.en: A restart button in the window title strip, right of the sidebar toggle, that stops every process the desktop app owns (Electron shell, Host, renderers and tool subprocesses) and starts the executable again, then reloads the page once the new instance answers. Windows desktop app only, and it hides itself on any other Host.
description.zh: 窗口标题栏左上角、收起侧边栏按钮右侧的重启按钮：一次点击停掉这个桌面应用的全部进程（窗口外壳、宿主、渲染进程与工具子进程），再重新拉起可执行文件，新实例就绪后自动刷新页面。仅支持 Windows 桌面版，其它宿主里按钮自动隐藏。

description.en: See what you actually installed: a chip shows how many plugins your profile really loads, and a searchable panel lists every one with its version, its author-written one-liner, and whether it is built-in or third-party. Read-only, zero config.
description.zh: 「我装的插件」：顶栏一颗药丸告诉你这个 DSH 到底加载了多少插件，点开是可搜索的清单——每个插件的名字、版本、一句人话作用，自带和第三方分开标。只读、零配置。

description.en: A right-sidebar gallery of every image and video in your workspace, newest first, with thumbnails, type filters, search, and a lightbox.
description.zh: 在右侧栏把工作区里所有图片和视频按时间倒序铺开，带缩略图、类型筛选、搜索和灯箱查看。

description.en: Live Markdown rendering inside the DSH composer plus Markdown-rendered user messages; the submitted text stays literal Markdown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框内实时渲染 Markdown，并让已发送的用户消息按 Markdown 显示；提交文本保持字面 Markdown 不变。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the Windows title bar, left of the minimize control, that stops and relaunches the desktop shell together with its Harness Host so a newly installed plugin takes effect.
description.zh: 在 Windows 标题栏最小化按钮左侧加一个重启按钮，结束并重新拉起桌面外壳与 Host，让刚装好的插件立即生效。

description.en: Judges the working model's own emotion each turn and silently re-injects it before the next turn, closing a self-observation → state carry-over → behavior shift loop. Ships a host plugin plus a composer-dock panel, a read-only emotion_status tool and an optional read-only HTTP route.
description.zh: 每回合判定工作模型自身的情绪，并在下一回合开始前静默回注给它，形成「自省 → 状态留存 → 行为调整」 的闭环。包含宿主插件、输入框上方的情绪面板、只读的 emotion_status 工具与可选的只读 HTTP 路由。

description.en: Adds searchable filtering to the model selector by provider, model name, and model ID; spaces act as wildcards.
description.zh: 为模型选择器增加按提供方、模型名称和模型 ID 搜索的筛选框，空格表示任意字符。

description.en: Codex-style workflow auto-collapse: finished turns fold into a single "processed in Xs" row leaving only the final answer; tool calls and think blocks collapse into live-summary chips that follow streaming; expand level by level, fully reversible on uninstall.
description.zh: Codex 风格工作流自动折叠：回合完成收成一行「已处理 X秒」只留最终正文，工具/思考块折叠成实时摘要 chip（运行中跟随流式滚动），逐级点击展开；卸载完整还原。

description.en: OpenViking in the DSH web GUI: a Studio panel, a per-session memory-commit status pill with its commit timeline, and a right-sidebar tab showing what the current session retrieves.
description.zh: 把本地 OpenViking 记忆服务接进 DSH 界面：左侧边栏的 Studio 面板、输入框下方的会话提交状态胶囊与提交时间线，以及右侧边栏查看当前会话检索到哪些记忆的面板。

description.en: WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.
description.zh: WorkBuddy 同款技能选择器：输入框旁 ⚡ 按钮弹出全部技能列表，支持搜索与最近/常用排序，点选即插入官方 `/技能名` 手势，随消息发出自动加载执行。

description.en: Interactive chat table of contents with bookmarks, turn pinning, global shortcuts, and heading extraction.
description.zh: 对话大纲目录导航：支持书签标记、轮次置顶钉住、全局快捷键与智能标题提取。

description.en: Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.
description.zh: DSH 回复中的文件路径可点击：Codex 风格行内打开、文件管理器定位、回合尾部文件 chip 列表。

plugins.name: dsh-hud

description.en: HUD status panel: Git status, MCP servers, skills, model and token usage in a floating side panel.
description.zh: HUD 状态面板：Git 状态、MCP 服务器、技能列表、模型与 token 用量，悬浮侧栏一览无余。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: One-click enter/exit Plan mode for the DSH web input bar, a quick-click shortcut for /plan.
description.zh: 输入框一键进/出 Plan 模式（/plan 的快捷点击），常驻小按钮。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
description.zh: 更安静的 DeepSeek Harness 阅读视图：原生过程细节、实时推理，以及干净的最终回答。

description.en: Adds drag-and-drop attachments for local files, folders, ZIP archives and Office documents.
description.zh: 支持拖放本地文件、文件夹、ZIP 压缩包和 Office 文档作为附件。

description.en: Read-only session work-path observer: fold turns into stage, run, duration and tok/s summaries, then expand parallel branches, tool results and vendor-visible reasoning.
description.zh: 只读会话工作路径观察器：收起轮次看阶段数、执行数、耗时与 tok/s，展开看并行分支、工具结果与供应商可见推理。

description.en: Adds text-selection quote cards above the composer and temporary native sidebar chats, with a Save button to keep a chat in its source workspace.
description.zh: 在输入框上方添加划词引用卡片，并提供临时原生侧边聊天，可通过保存按钮将会话保留到来源工作区。

description.en: GitHub-style alert cards for DSH assistant Markdown: a qualifying `> [!NOTE]`, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING, or CAUTION blockquote becomes a theme-aware card. Stored session content is left unchanged.
description.zh: 把 DSH 助手 Markdown 里合格的 `> [!NOTE]`、TIP、IMPORTANT、WARNING、CAUTION 块引用渲染成跟随主题的 GitHub 风格提示卡片，不改会话存档。

description.en: Keyboard shortcuts for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+Q toggles the left sidebar, Ctrl+E toggles the right panel, and Ctrl+S opens Settings. Physical key codes can be overridden in the profile patch.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供快捷键：Ctrl+Q 切换左侧栏，Ctrl+E 切换右侧栏，Ctrl+S 打开设置。物理键码可在 profile 补丁中覆盖。

description.en: Bundled LXGW WenKai (霞鹜文楷) typeface plugin: switches the Web GUI interface and conversation text to the kai-style font with no configuration, using a system-installed copy when present and otherwise serving the packaged offline web font.
description.zh: 内置霞鹜文楷（LXGW WenKai）字体的插件：零配置把网页界面与对话文字切换为楷体风格，优先使用系统已安装字体，未安装时按需加载包内离线字体。

description.en: Add independent opacity controls for the sidebar, message panels and composer in dsh web.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 的侧边栏、正文框和输入框提供独立的不透明度控制。

description.en: In-session question navigator for the DSH Web UI: a dot minimap on the conversation edge (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hover shows the full question text, click jumps to it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话内提问导航：对话栏左/右缘（可在设置中切换）的圆点迷你地图，一个圆点对应一个用户提问——悬停显示全文，点击跳转到该提问。

description.en: Adds a native sidebar menu item in DSH that opens chat.deepseek.com in a standalone browser window with persistent login, and supports bidirectional text selection transfer between DSH and the web page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧边栏添加原生菜单项，一键打开 chat.deepseek.com 独立窗口（登录态持久化），支持 DSH 与网页端双向划词互传。

description.en: Adds a Ctrl+F-style find bar to the DSH interface: highlights every match in the conversation or on the current page, and steps between them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面加一条 Ctrl+F 式查找条：高亮会话或当前页面里的全部匹配，并逐条跳转。

description.en: Folds the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's global panel list into a single row, with a popover to switch panels.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的全局面板列表收进一行，点击弹出浮层切换面板。

description.en: Mobile layout fixes for the Web UI on narrow screens: full-screen settings panel, one-row plugin nav, full-screen sidebar, centered popups, icon-only session-log button.
description.zh: Web UI 移动端布局修复：窄屏下设置面板全屏化、插件导航单行排满、侧边栏全屏、弹层居中、会话日志按钮图标化。

description.en: Adds a sparkle button to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt with a single tool-free LLM call, then writes the result back into the input.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏加一个 ✨ 按钮，用一次无工具的单轮 LLM 调用把草稿改写成更清晰、更具体的提示词，再把结果写回输入框。

plugins.name: dsh-livebench-rankings

description.en: LiveBench leaderboard for DSH — discovers the release the official site currently publishes, then reads its CSV and category JSON, and renders model rankings in an isolated same-origin iframe opened from a button beside the composer. Search, organization / open-weight / reasoning filters, per-category sorting, task-level detail, up to four models side by side, CSV export; refreshes every 60 s by default (configurable 30–3600) and caches only to the plugin's own .cache/rankings.json.
description.zh: DSH 内的 LiveBench 能力排行榜：识别官网当前发布的榜单版本，再读取其官方 CSV 与分类 JSON，在由输入框按钮打开的独立同源 iframe 中渲染模型排名。支持搜索、机构／开放权重／推理模型筛选、按能力维度排序、任务级明细、最多 4 个模型并排对比与 CSV 导出；默认每 60 秒同步（可配 30–3600），缓存只写入插件自身的 .cache/rankings.json。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.ibm.com

description.en: Right-to-left reading mode for the conversation answer area, with a button to switch back to left-to-right.
description.zh: 为对话回答区域提供从右到左的阅读模式，并提供按钮一键切回从左到右。

description.en: A session-header 3-dots menu: download the session log, switch each chat's transcript between Normal and Verbose, and define what Verbose expands (thinking blocks, tool calls, terminal output).
description.zh: 会话标题栏的三点菜单：可下载会话日志，把每个会话的转录在普通与详细视图间切换，并自定义详细视图展开哪些内容（思考块、工具调用、终端输出）。

description.en: Temporary side conversations seeded from the main context, with quoted questions, main-task status updates, and replies returned to the main draft.
description.zh: 继承创建时主线上下文的临时侧聊，支持引用提问、主线状态提醒与回复回传草稿。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar foot, directly above the account avatar. The row shows the top-up balance plus any bonus, turns amber with a warning mark below an adjustable threshold and green above it, and refreshes when a task finishes.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部、账号头像正上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。整行显示充值余额（含赠金），低于可调阈值时变黄并显示告警标记，高于为绿色；任务结束后自动刷新。

description.en: Persistent tmux control-mode cockpit for DSH Web that mirrors native panes in a dock.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供持久的 tmux 控制模式驾驶舱，在停靠栏中镜像原生窗格。

description.en: One-click brand replacement for the DSH web GUI — logo, product name, version badge, hero headline, tab title and favicon.
description.zh: 一键替换 DSH Web GUI 品牌信息（商标、产品名、版本徽标、Hero、标签页标题与 favicon），方便二改分发。

description.en: Coding workbench for DSH: docked workspace panels, a grouped project sidebar, split editor tab groups with hibernate/resume, file preview and diff views — built on parallel git worktree development with cross-session collaboration primitives.
description.zh: coding 工作台：停靠式工作区面板、项目分组侧栏、可休眠/恢复的分栏编辑器 TAB 组、文件预览与 DIFF 查看，以 git worktree 并行开发与跨会话协作为地基。

description.en: Shows the lyrics LX Music is playing in a floating panel on the right of the DSH conversation page, with previous / play-pause / next controls. Scroll the lyric window to read ahead, double-click a line to start the song there, and if the player is not running, pressing play starts it in the system tray. Windows only, and LX Music has to be installed with its local Open API enabled.
description.zh: 把落雪音乐（LX Music）正在播放的歌词贴在 DSH 对话页右侧，配上上一首 / 播放暂停 / 下一首。可滚动歌词窗看前后几句、双击某句从那里开始唱；播放器没开时点播放会自动把它从系统托盘拉起来。仅 Windows，需要本机装好落雪并打开它的开放 API。

description.en: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.
description.zh: 停靠在 dsh Web 对话区右缘的会话代码地图：色块/缩略图双模式、拖动调宽（10–320px）、悬停放大镜预览、点击跳转与拖动滚动（带实时视口指示条）、可收起为 4px 细条。

description.en: Adds a session status pill to the composer dock that expands into a panel of turn, token, performance and context readings.
description.zh: 在输入框停靠区加一个会话状态胶囊，点开是一块面板，显示回合、token、性能与上下文读数。

description.en: Global back/forward navigation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: remembers every session and whole-page panel you visit, shows a configurable 1-7 entry history strip you can click, and supports browser-style shortcuts plus mouse side buttons.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供全局后退/前进：记录访问过的会话与整页面板，底部历史条可配置显示 1-7 个位置并可直接点击跳转，支持浏览器式快捷键与鼠标侧键。

description.en: Watchlist panel for A-share, Hong Kong and US quotes plus Eastmoney boards, with intraday sparklines and an agent stock_quote tool.
description.zh: A 股 / 港股 / 美股与板块自选面板，带分时迷你走势图，并向 agent 提供 stock_quote 工具。

description.en: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.
description.zh: 可停靠的 DSH Web UI 布局插件，将对话组织为标签页，并支持拖拽拆分对话分组。

description.en: Enhanced desktop shell for DSH: auto-starts the local backend on launch (no browser tab), asks before closing the backend on quit, and starts the backend in parallel with Electron for faster cold start. Fork of dsh-clean-desktop-shell.
description.zh: DSH 桌面壳增强版：启动即自动拉起后端（不弹浏览器）、退出时询问是否关闭后端、后端与窗口并行启动加速冷启动。基于 dsh-clean-desktop-shell 的 fork。

description.en: A whip for DeepSeek V4 Pro: it watches the reasoning fingerprint of every thinking block and pulls the model back when it slips from focused "We will / I will" mode into scattered "let me" mode.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的鞭子：实时监听每个思维块的指纹，当模型从专注的 We will / I will 模式滑向发散的 let me 模式时把它拉回来。

description.en: Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.
description.zh: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

description.en: Prompt manager for DSH: imports prompts from JSON or Markdown sources and DSH's own system sections, then controls what is injected into the system prompt — per prompt, or per agent preset — with title editing, drag ordering, LLM translation and the option to inject either the original text or its translation.
description.zh: DSH 提示词管理面板：从 JSON/Markdown 来源与 DSH 自身的系统提示词段收集提示词，按条、按 agent 预设控制哪些内容注入系统提示词，支持改标题、拖拽排序、调用大模型翻译，并可选择注入原文或译文。

description.en: Desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: a Win32 layered window that keeps a whale-girl above other applications, speaks through a bubble, comments on its own when you stay on one window for ten seconds, and answers a single question typed into a right-click input box.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面桌宠：一个 Win32 分层窗口，让鲸鱼娘待在别的应用窗口之上，气泡说话；你在同一个窗口停够十秒它会自己开口，右键弹出的输入框里可以问它一个问题。

description.en: Workbench plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: collects your own projects and mounted plugin entries with rename, icon, sort, show/hide, project-to-session binding and a per-project file cabinet, adds a split-pane workspace engine with draggable panes, tabbed windows and built-in Explorer, terminal, browser, animation and custom panes, and auto-mounts an agent output into the matching window when it writes widget-result.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工作台插件：收集自建项目与挂载的插件条目，支持改名、图标、排序、显示隐藏、项目与会话绑定和项目文件柜；内置自研分栏工作区引擎，窗格可拖拽分割、标签页管理，带资源管理器、终端、浏览器、动画与自定义窗口；项目内 agent 写完 widget-result.json 后，产物会自动挂载进对应窗口。

description.en: Enhances the native right-sidebar Files tab rather than replacing it: each row gets an @ reference button that inserts the canonical path mention into the composer, plus a size column, a sortable modification-time column, and a status dot for untracked, unstaged and staged files. Below the tree a git bar shows the branch with ahead/behind counts and expands upward into the 20 most recent commits, with a repository selector when a workspace has independent repositories in subdirectories. A header search box walks the workspace recursively and can open a result or expand the tree at it, preview tabs offer reveal-in-tree and one-click @, the tree is keyboard navigable with ARIA tree semantics, and a right-click entry on the Files tab switches back to the native tree at runtime.
description.zh: 增强右侧栏原生的「文件」标签页而非替换它：每行带一个 @ 引用按钮，把规范路径提及插入输入框；另有大小列、可排序的修改时间列，以及按未跟踪/未暂存/已暂存着色的状态点。文件树下方有 git 栏，显示分支与领先/落后数量，并可向上展开最近 20 条提交；当工作区的子目录是独立仓库时提供仓库选择器。页头搜索框递归遍历工作区，可打开结果或在文件树中展开定位；预览页签提供「在文件树中定位」与一键 @；文件树支持键盘导航与 ARIA tree 语义；右键「文件」标签页可在运行时切回原生树。

description.en: Shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently billing at the off-peak or peak rate in the sidebar brand row, with the Chinese statutory-holiday calendar built in and zh/en copy.
description.zh: 在侧边栏品牌位显示 DeepSeek API 当前按空闲还是高峰时段计费，内置中国法定节假日与调休日历，中英双语。

description.en: Redraw the left-hand workspace sidebar to add color highlighting, sorting, status indicators, and system notifications. You can also switch back to the original sidebar, which likewise implements some of these features.
description.zh: 通过重绘左侧工作区侧栏，为工作区侧栏添加颜色高亮、排序、收藏、状态指示以及系统通知等功能。同时可切换回原版侧栏，也具有部分功能实现。

description.en: Reasoning-effort slider in the model menu for DeepSeek Harness that also appears for providers and models with no declared effort metadata. Based on Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider — uninstall that upstream plugin before installing this one.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型菜单里提供推理等级滑条，未声明推理档位的 provider 与模型同样出现。基于 Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider 改造，不能与上游同装。

description.en: File-drag fork: drop documents as removable chips above the composer, send without typing.
description.zh: 拖放 fork：文档以可删除「文件芯片」挂在输入框上方，不打字也能发送。

plugins.name: dsh-xiaoke-widget

description.en: A Claude-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, and custom character/audio. Ships animated roles that breathe and blink, plus a balance-alert variant that switches to a crying face when the balance falls below the alert line; 256/384 animation tiers and an optional 512 HD pack installed from the resource manager. 63 Claude-flavored lines. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).
description.zh: 右下角的 Claude 拟人桌宠「小克」：显示余额、今日已用、峰谷定价与每轮消耗，泡泡内容可编辑（文本、余额、今日、峰谷、图片、随机语句与并列加权选择），支持逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效与自定义角色/音效；内置会呼吸、会眨眼的动态角色，余额低于预警线时切换成哭脸，动图分 256/384 两档，并可在资源管理里安装 512 高清包；台词 63 条。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（MIT）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: VSCode-style workbench shell for the DSH Web UI: activity bar, side bar, editor area, panel and status bar, with a registry service (ctx.workbench) for mounting panels, views and commands.
description.zh: DSH Web 工作台基座插件：提供 VSCode 风格布局外壳（活动栏/侧边栏/编辑器区/面板/状态栏）和 ctx.workbench 开放注册表，供功能插件挂载面板、视图与命令。

description.en: Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.
description.zh: dock 系列文本查看与编辑器：支持撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存、未保存确认和二进制检测，作为 dock-files 的默认文本查看器。

description.en: File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.
description.zh: dock 系列文件浏览插件：侧边栏目录树浏览会话工作区，支持新建/重命名/复制粘贴/删除、拖放导入、粘贴本地文件与剪贴板图片。

description.en: Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.
description.zh: dock 系列 Git 历史可视化插件：泳道式提交图、分支/标签管理、暂存/提交/推送与远端操作。

description.en: Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.
description.zh: dock 系列图片查看器：支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 格式，SVG 仅以安全方式渲染。

description.en: Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.
description.zh: dock 系列 Markdown 查看器：GFM 渲染 + DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，可一键切换编辑。

plugins.name: dock-spreadsheet

description.en: Read-only XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV and TSV viewer for dock-files with worksheet tabs, sorting, filters, search and cell links.
description.zh: dock-files 的只读表格查看器，支持 XLSX、XLS、ODS、CSV、TSV 格式以及工作表切换、排序、筛选、搜索和单元格链接。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: System status floating widget: live CPU/memory/disk usage in the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web UI with threshold colour warnings.
description.zh: DSH Web 右下角系统状态悬浮窗：实时显示 CPU、内存、磁盘占用率，带阈值变色告警。

description.en: Adds a full-screen panel to the DSH composer for writing multi-line text, movable and resizable, sharing one draft with the composer; Enter inserts a newline and only Ctrl+Enter sends, so an IME cannot turn Shift+Enter into a send.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的输入框加一个全屏输入面板，用于书写多行文本，可移动、可调整大小，与主输入框共用同一份草稿；Enter 只换行、仅 Ctrl+Enter 发送，因此中文输入法不会把 Shift+Enter 变成发送。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to the DSH web UI for files and for links: a file-tree row, a file path or file mention in a chat message, or a hyperlink opens a menu that previews a file in DSH, opens it in the default application or a chosen associated one, reveals it in the file manager, copies the path, the workspace-relative path, the file name, the link address, the link text or the file contents, saves a copy elsewhere, and opens an HTTP(S) link in the sidebar browser or in the system browser, while a right-click that is not on a file or a link keeps the browser's own menu.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的右键菜单，覆盖文件与链接：在文件树一行、对话消息里的文件路径或文件提及、以及超链接上右键，可预览、用默认程序或指定关联程序打开、在资源管理器中定位、复制路径／相对路径／文件名／链接地址／链接文字／文件内容、另存为，并可把 http(s) 链接在侧边栏浏览器或系统浏览器中打开；在非文件非链接处右键仍保留浏览器原生菜单。

description.en: Turns an uploaded picture into a floating desk pet by cutting out its background in the page, with idle animation and a live account-balance bubble.
description.zh: 上传一张图片，在页面内抠掉背景做成浮在 Harness 上的桌宠，带呼吸摇摆动画和实时账户余额气泡。

description.en: Render interactive diagrams, charts and staged learning visuals alongside native prose in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中结合正文呈现交互图形、图表与分阶段学习演示。

plugins.name: dsh-custom-plugin

description.en: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and DeepSeek balance and daily token usage.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 便利套件，提供外观控制、时间线导航、项目文件夹、提示词、会话导出、Mermaid 渲染、引用回复，以及 DeepSeek 余额和每日 token 用量。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面化 UI 增强：自适应对比度壁纸、带活动流与投喂玩法的桌面宠物、@file 工作区文件引用，以及可缩放的文件/预览右侧面板。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement: rewrite the draft through the harness LLM, preview the result, then apply or send it, with style presets, model-aware reasoning effort, cost estimate and a settings page.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强：通过宿主模型改写草稿，预览后再替换或发送；支持风格预设、按模型自适应思考档位、费用估算与设置页。

description.en: A phone shell for the web GUI - the sidebar becomes an overlay drawer that closes when a session is tapped, the settings sheet goes full-screen single column, and the transcript is retuned for phone reading.
description.zh: 网页版界面的手机外壳：侧栏改为覆盖式抽屉、点会话自动收起，设置面板改全屏单列，正文排版按手机阅读距离重调。

description.en: Customize the "deep diving" thinking status label to anything you like.
description.zh: 把鲸鱼娘思考时的 "deep diving" 状态文案自定义成任意你想要的样子。

description.en: Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and `/soul` commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes `soulConfig` for other plugins and a `set_persona` tool the agent can call.
description.zh: 为 Agent 提供个性化设置：Web 设置栏目（关于你、回复风格和语调、标题与列表 / 表情符号特质、输出语言、自定义指令）与 `/soul` 命令；昵称 / 职业 / 介绍 / 风格 / 特质 / 语言编译进提示词并推送给所有活动会话。向其他插件暴露 `soulConfig` 服务，并注册 Agent 可调用的 `set_persona` 工具。

description.en: Refine prompts with guided questions and editable previews using Harness AI or native Codex across Web, desktop and TUI, applying drafts only after user confirmation.
description.zh: 在 Web、桌面端和 TUI 中使用 Harness AI 或原生 Codex 澄清并优化提示词，预览可编辑，确认后仅填入草稿。

description.en: Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width compact header and activity rail; publishes as @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23 on npm.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 完整工作台 fork：资源管理器、编辑器、终端、Git、浏览器与分屏，外加仿 VSCode 外壳重构（全宽紧凑顶栏与活动栏）；npm 包名 @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23。

description.en: Performance optimization and smoothness enhancement for DSH Desktop (renderer-side only; host code untouched, no on-disk config): skips offscreen message rendering, stops frames and timers while the window is hidden, lazily loads media, coalesces session-list repaints and pre-warms large session files; shows the measured main-thread saving in settings. A lightweight speed-up for lag, dropped frames, slow large-session opening and background CPU use.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端性能优化与流畅度增强（纯客户端：只改渲染进程、不改宿主代码、不落盘配置）：长对话省渲染、窗口隐藏不排帧、后台暂停定时器、媒体懒加载、会话列表节流、大会话文件预热，设置页显示实测省下的主线程时间。遇到卡顿、掉帧、打开大会话慢、后台吃 CPU 时先试它，也可以当作轻量加速与渲染优化工具。

description.en: Two composer actions for the DSH Web UI: /new in the slash-command menu starts a new conversation without sending anything to the model, and Shift+Tab toggles plan mode while the conversation has focus.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的两个操作：斜杠菜单里的 /new 新建对话且不向模型发送任何内容，对话区按 Shift+Tab 切换计划模式。

description.en: Obsidian daily notes, tasks and Day Planner time blocks in the DSH sidebar: a Monday-first month grid with per-day word-count and task dots, a compact timeline for HH:mm time blocks, the selected day's diary excerpt and task list, and write-back of checkbox state, task text and times to the Markdown files; a first-run wizard detects the vault or accepts a path.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的 Obsidian 日记、待办与 Day Planner 时间块：周一起始的月历（带每天的字数点与任务点）、紧凑时间轴（HH:mm 时间块）、选中日的日记摘要与任务列表；勾选状态、任务内容与时间都会写回 Markdown 文件，首次使用有向导，可自动找到知识库或手填路径。

description.en: Middle-click closes a session or a sidebar tab in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. A session closes through the row's own archive action, so the confirmation for running work and the undo notice stay exactly as the Harness renders them; a tab closes through its own close control, leaving the rule that a lone guide tab cannot be closed untouched. The gesture settles on press-and-release on the same element, so a middle drag never closes anything. Two switches on the plugin's own Settings tab turn each half off, remembered per browser.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面里，用鼠标中键关闭会话或侧边栏标签页。会话走这一行自带的归档操作，因此运行中任务的确认框和撤销通知仍由 Harness 原样渲染；标签页走自己的关闭按钮，「唯一的指南页不能关」这条规则不受影响。手势要求在同一元素上按下并松开，所以中键拖动不会误关。插件自带独立设置页，两个开关分别关闭这两项，并按浏览器记住。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin adding an OKX perpetual-futures price dashboard: BTC/ETH candlesticks at 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D, EMA overlays, line/Fibonacci/ruler drawing tools, close-line alerts through desktop notification, sound or email (email delivery additionally needs the dsh-qq-email plugin), and an in-panel backtester. Market data comes from OKX public endpoints and no API key is required.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OKX 永续合约看板插件：BTC/ETH 的 1m/3m/15m/1h/4h/1D K 线、EMA 均线叠加、直线/斐波那契/尺子画线、收线预警（桌面通知/提示音/邮件；邮件通道需另装 dsh-qq-email 插件）与面板内回测。行情来自 OKX 公开接口，不需要 API key。

description.en: Shows local glossary definitions when hovering over terms in chat messages.
description.zh: 悬停聊天消息中的术语时显示本地词库释义。

description.en: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano interaction.
description.zh: 提供完整历史轮次导航、过程步骤折叠、最终结果与结构化问答琴键，以及鼠标连续跟随交互。

description.en: Unify third-party plugin settings in DeepSeek Harness. Auto-discover, group, and reorder plugin settings under one collapsible nav entry with drag-and-drop support.
description.zh: 统一收纳 DeepSeek Harness 里的第三方插件设置：自动发现、分组，并在一个可折叠的导航入口下拖拽排序。

description.en: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.
description.zh: 桌面修改：F11 全屏切换；使终端使用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴，从通用设置内开启/关闭。

description.en: Adds a lightweight follow-up row under each DSH answer: one anchor question plus 1-3 user-voice quick replies, so the next turn is one click away; supports always / balanced / conservative strategies and optional refusal or emotional-context skips.
description.zh: 在每条 DSH 回答下方加一行轻量 follow：一句锚定正文的追问 + 1–3 条用户口吻快捷回复，让下一轮对话一键继续；支持 always / balanced / conservative 策略，并可跳过拒绝回答与情绪场景。

description.en: Declarative interactive cards for DSH: the model writes a spec, the Host compiles it into a JSON program, and the client renders forms, tables, charts and lists with local state and explicit submit.
description.zh: DSH 的声明式交互卡片：模型写 spec，Host 编译成 JSON program，客户端渲染表单、表格、图表和列表，本地交互、显式提交。

description.en: Mouse gestures for files in the DSH Web GUI: Ctrl+click a file-tree row, a file mention in a chat message or a file link to open it with the desktop default application; right-click opens a menu with open, the operating system own Open With chooser, save a copy, copy the absolute path, copy the file contents and reveal in the file manager, while a right-click on an ordinary hyperlink offers Copy Link. A plain click is left to DSH own sidebar preview and directory rows are left to the page. Open and reveal go through DSH own sessionController, the Open With chooser is the operating system dialog (Windows Shell verb, open -a on macOS) rather than an application list kept by the plugin, and file reads stop at 8 MiB.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的文件手势：Ctrl+左键点击文件树行、对话中的文件提及或文件链接，用系统默认应用打开；右键弹出菜单，可打开文件、调用系统自带的「打开方式」选择框、另存为、复制绝对路径、复制文件内容、在文件管理器中定位，右键普通超链接则提供「复制链接」。普通左键仍交给 DSH 自带的侧边栏预览，目录行交给页面处理。打开与定位走 DSH 自己的 sessionController，「打开方式」直接交给操作系统对话框（Windows 的 Shell 动词、macOS 的 open -a），插件不维护自己的应用列表；读取文件内容上限 8 MiB。

description.en: Windows disk manager for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: volume overview with usage bars, a session-grouped list of the documents each conversation produced, drag files straight into the chat composer, multi-select with batch delete to Recycle Bin, an expandable folder tree with real app icons, workspace documents no session touched, on-demand folder sizes, and an explorer-style context menu. Delete goes to the recycle bin.
description.zh: DSH 右栏里的 Windows 磁盘管理：卷总览带用量条、按会话分组列出每次对话产出的文档、把文件直接拖进对话输入框、多选与批量删除（只进回收站）、可展开的目录树带程序真图标、补上会话没碰过的工作区文档、按需统计文件夹大小，右键菜单对齐资源管理器；删除一律进回收站。

description.en: Adds a sidebar tab that folds a session into user turns (input, tool steps, output) with one-click jump back into the conversation.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按用户轮次折叠会话（输入、工具步骤、输出），一键跳回对话原位。

description.en: Adds a restart control at the DSH Web sidebar foot: the host exits through its own graceful path and the detected supervisor (systemd, Kubernetes or Docker) boots the replacement, or the plugin starts one directly when it finds no supervisor; a frame-wide notice polls the host pid until a new process answers.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部添加重启控件：宿主经自身的优雅退出通道退出，由检测到的进程守护（systemd、Kubernetes 或 Docker）拉起新进程，没有守护时插件自行拉起；右下角提示条轮询宿主 pid，直到新进程应答。

description.en: FanFrame (繁界, “Fanxing’s realm”) lightly polishes the DeepSeek Harness Desktop UI for a more comfortable everyday experience.
