description.zh: 繁界 - 意思是“繁星的域界”，这个插件通过对DSH桌面版的UI界面进行轻度的打磨，带来更舒适的日常交互体验。我为DSH带来了放置图标的统一侧边栏，给对话列表充足的空间，同时避免插件喜欢随意摆放自己的图标造成的混乱。此外，为对话正文增加了染色处理，让文字阅读更轻松愉快。最后，通过冷峻的无圆角风格和大量增加的细微交互动画，增加一些小小的精致感。

description.en: Restores title-bar window dragging and double-click zoom in DeepSeek Harness Desktop on macOS.
description.zh: 恢复 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（macOS）标题栏的窗口拖动与双击缩放。

description.en: TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint.
description.zh: 侧栏浮动窗口里的抖音式刷视频：本地/SMB NAS 文件夹上下滑动，或粘贴在线视频地址（yt-dlp 解析，支持 bilibili/YouTube 与 cookies.txt 登录态）；窗口随视频宽高比自适应，支持全屏、拖动缩放、Range 流式播放，并提供 agent 视频推送队列端点。

description.en: Live2D companion for DSH: a floating Cubism model with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking; config-driven geometry (size/position from the plugin config); official Haru sample bundled (© Live2D Inc.).
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：悬浮的 Cubism 模型，表情随状态变化并跟随鼠标；尺寸与位置由插件配置驱动；内置官方 Haru 示例模型（© Live2D Inc.）。

description.en: Clean-mode for the Web GUI: hover any element and right-click to remove it; removals survive reloads and are restorable from the settings page.
description.zh: Web 界面清理：清理模式下悬浮元素右键即可移除，刷新后依然生效，设置页中可原样恢复。

description.en: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click menu with quiet mode and a session list, and a bundled skill that turns one photo into a full eighteen-pose skin on your own image tool and credentials; system Python and ctypes, no Electron and no dependencies.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 页面之外的 macOS 桌宠：一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住；六种状态跟着本地 DSH 走，原生右键菜单里有免打扰与会话清单；自带的 skill 用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片变成整套十八个姿势的皮肤。跑系统自带的 Python 与 ctypes，不用 Electron，零依赖。

description.en: Responsive card grid for the DeepSeek Harness composer model picker, grouped by provider. Host-only: injects a stylesheet through webserver/index-inject without rebuilding the client bundle, and supports both the stock picker and the dsh-peakrate menu.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 输入框的模型选择器改成按供应商分组的响应式卡片网格。纯宿主端：通过 webserver/index-inject 注入样式、无需重建前端包，同时支持官方选择器与 dsh-peakrate 菜单。

description.en: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus separate copy-command and copy-output buttons.
description.zh: 用自定义 Shell 命令卡片替换 DSH Web 原版 bash/pwsh 工具行：长命令自动换行带行号不再截断，并提供独立的复制命令/复制输出按钮。

description.en: Next-step suggestions for the DSH composer: after each completed turn, one auxiliary call on the session's current model returns 3 clickable follow-up suggestions above the input box, and clicking one fills the draft.
description.zh: 下一步建议：每轮回答结束后，用会话当前模型做一次辅助调用提炼 3 条可点击的后续提问建议，显示在输入框上方，点击任意一条即填入草稿。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file attachments as Codex-style cards, with in-app PDF/text/video/audio previews and system-default opening for other formats.
description.zh: 拖拽文件以 Codex 风格附件卡片呈现，支持 PDF/文本/音视频应用内预览，其余格式调用系统默认应用打开。

description.en: Customize the username (phone number or email) and avatar shown at the bottom-left account row — for personalization, or to keep screenshots from exposing them. The editor opens from the menu you get by clicking that row.
description.zh: 自定义左下角账号处的用户名（手机号/邮箱）和头像，从而提升个性化或避免截图泄露隐私。编辑入口位于点击此处的菜单内。

description.en: Removes the Preview badge on DSH.
description.zh: 去除在DSH上的预览版标签。

plugins.name: dsh-WallpaperAndCost

description.en: Merged plugin: wallpaper customization (original-resolution uploads, crop editor, per-area opacity, MP4/WebM dynamic wallpapers) + Steam Workshop wallpaper extraction (parses scene.pkg/.tex via a bundled Python script, preview/download) + DeepSeek balance & usage widget + OpenCode Go plan usage (rolling/weekly/monthly percents in a top header pill; expand for progress bars & reset countdowns). API keys are read from DSH's credential store by the host — never stored in source or the browser.
description.zh: 合并插件：壁纸定制（原图不压缩、裁剪编辑器、左/中/右分区不透明度、MP4/WebM 动态壁纸）＋ Steam 创意工坊壁纸提取（内置 scripts/extract_scene_pkg.py 解析 scene.pkg/.tex，支持预览/下载）＋ DeepSeek 余额与用量小组件 ＋ OpenCode Go 套餐用量（会话顶部药丸按钮显示滚动/周/月用量百分比，点开展开进度条与重置倒计时）。各 API key 均由 host 从 DSH 凭据库读取，不入源码/浏览器。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it registers, and paste-import MCP configs from 14 tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and more) in one go.
description.zh: DSH 设置中的 MCP 管理页：列出、启停、重启、删除 MCP 服务器，表单与 JSON 双模式编辑，展开可查看各服务器注册的工具，并支持一次粘贴导入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、VS Code 等 14 种工具的 MCP 配置。

description.en: Conversation font-size controls for the Web UI: a stepper in the composer row, keyboard shortcuts, and Ctrl+wheel zoom, all writing through the theme service setFontSize.
description.zh: Web 界面的对话字号控制：输入区步进器、键盘快捷键与 Ctrl+滚轮缩放，统一走主题服务的 setFontSize。

description.en: ChatGPT-desktop-style model picker whose thinking-level slider carries a particle trail, plus a visual-only fast-mode toggle and a hold-to-lock for it.
description.zh: ChatGPT 桌面风格的模型选择控件：思考档位滑杆带粒子拖尾，另有纯视觉的快速模式开关与长按锁定。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the macOS DSH desktop sidebar that fully quits and reopens the app; on other platforms the button hides itself.
description.zh: 在 macOS 版 DSH 桌面端侧栏添加重启按钮，一键完全退出并重新打开应用；其他平台按钮自动隐藏。

description.en: Session model selector with search: two-stage loose matching (normalised substring first, subsequence as fallback, so glm53 finds GLM-5.3 and ds finds DeepSeek), providers with recent successful calls pinned first, and a reasoning-effort pane that remembers each model's last explicitly chosen effort.
description.zh: 搜索增强的会话模型选择器：两段式宽松匹配（先归一化子串，未命中再退子序列，glm53 命中 GLM-5.3、ds 命中 DeepSeek）、近七天成功调用过的供应商置顶，推理档位面板记住每个模型上次显式选择的档位。

description.en: Teaching board view: agent-generated self-contained HTML is projected into a sandboxed iframe as a board, annotated by hand (brush, four colours, eraser, undo), extended in place across several tool calls, and screenshotted back into the conversation as a real user message.
description.zh: 教学平面视图：agent 生成的自包含 HTML 投影进沙箱 iframe 当板书，可用画笔手写勾画（四色、橡皮、撤销）、在同一块板上增量续写，并把画面截图作为真实用户消息发回对话。

description.en: In-conversation source deck for DSH Desktop: the current chat model runs LLM search rounds, candidates render as GitHub-aware cards, and keep/exclude feedback, favorites, and the selected sources stay in the same conversation.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的会话内资料台：由当前对话模型执行搜索轮次，候选以 GitHub 卡片展示，保留/排除反馈、收藏夹与筛选结果都留在同一会话。

description.en: Freezes the DSH chat scroll position: new replies no longer drag the viewport to the bottom — it stays where you left it. Only after you send a message does it follow to the bottom so you can see your own input, then it locks again once the answer starts streaming. Each session remembers its own position (persisted across reloads), a settings toggle turns it off, and it never intercepts your own scrolling.
description.zh: 冻结 DSH 聊天区的滚动位置：新回答出现时视口不再自动贴到底部，停在你最后停留的地方。只有你发消息时才先跟到底，好让你看见自己发的话；回答一开始出字就重新锁住。每个会话各记各的位置（刷新还在），设置里有总开关，你自己滚动时永远不被拦。

description.en: Persistent work-progress row in the band below the composer: task completion, a progress bar, and what the agent is doing right now (generating a reply or running a tool), expandable into the full task list with turns, steps, timings and context usage.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻的工作进度行：任务完成度、进度条，以及此刻正在做什么（生成回复或执行工具）；展开可见完整任务清单与轮次、步骤、耗时、上下文占用。

description.en: Split the DSH sidebar workspace list into Active, Session tasks and Inactive sections with manual pins and an activity threshold, keeping the official search, archive filters, row menus and drag and drop, with a one-click switch back to the shipped list. The Session tasks section uses a fixed Windows workspace at D:\files\history-tasks; other platforms must create that directory manually.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏工作区列表分为「活跃 / 会话任务 / 不活跃」三段，支持手动钉住与活跃阈值，保留官方搜索、归档筛选、行菜单与拖拽，并可一键切回官方列表。「会话任务」段固定用 Windows 路径 D:\files\history-tasks，其他平台需自行预建该目录。

description.en: Replaces the composer Effort switch with a Claude Desktop-style five-level slider (Low/Medium/High/Max/Ultracode): a pill opens a popover above the composer, dragging snaps with a spring and writes once, and Ultracode maps to the model's maximum reasoning effort. Ships the Ultracode WebGL2 energy grid, a per-session Ultracode mode, and passes modifier-click through to the shipped level list.
description.zh: 把 composer 的 Effort 切换换成 Claude Desktop 风格的五档滑块（Low/Medium/High/Max/Ultracode）：药丸打开 composer 上方的弹层，拖动带弹簧吸附、松手只写一次，Ultracode 映射到模型的最大推理强度。含 Ultracode 的 WebGL2 能量网格、按会话记录的 Ultracode 模式，修饰键 + 点击仍走官方等级列表。

description.en: Replace the dsh-whale-widget mascot with your own image through a built-in cutout pipeline, plus a session-header restart button, a browser heartbeat, and an opt-in patch self-heal that is off by default.
description.zh: 给 dsh-whale-widget 换图的插件：内置抠图流水线把任意图片替换成小鲸鱼，另有会话头部重启按钮、浏览器心跳，以及默认关闭的挂件补丁自愈（需显式开启）。

description.en: Adds upload, download, new folder, delete, drag-to-move, drag-to-chat and in-place text editing with auto-save to the workspace Files tab and file previews.
description.zh: 为工作区「文件」标签页和文件预览添加上传、下载、新建文件夹、删除、拖拽移动、拖入对话，以及支持自动保存的原地文本编辑。

description.en: One-click prompt refinement for the DSH composer: the ✦ button next to Send rewrites the draft into an agent-ready prompt in Standard or Light mode, with Revert and Retry; asks follow-up questions through the question card when the draft is missing information; checks that paths, identifiers, numbers, URLs, inline code and @mentions survive the rewrite and adds back any that were dropped; runs on the conversation model or a dedicated model chosen on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框一键改写提示词：点「发送」旁的 ✦，按「标准」或「轻」档把草稿改写成 Agent 可直接执行的提示词，可撤回或重试；草稿缺少信息时通过提问卡片追问；校验路径、标识符、数字、URL、行内代码与 @ 提及在改写后逐字保留，丢失的会补回；可使用会话模型，或在插件页面指定专用模型。

description.en: Annotatable file editor for the DSH right sidebar with a lazy file tree, inline annotations, cross-file annotation navigation, Markdown preview, and composer-draft handoff.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏可批注文件编辑器，提供懒加载文件树、行内批注、跨文件批注导航、Markdown 预览，以及批注加入对话草稿。

description.en: Add six languages (繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI language options, with hand-polished per-language translations and automatic fallbacks (Simplified-to-Traditional conversion for zh-TW, English for the others) covering upstream updates and third-party plugins.
description.zh: 為 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 語言選單新增六種語言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français、Deutsch、Español）：各語言逐條精譯，缺字串自動兜底（繁中即時簡轉繁、其他語言回退英文），官方更新與第三方插件都能覆蓋。

description.en: Scans MCP configs from the tools it knows (28 built-in sources plus custom ones), syncs diffs into DSH, and lets you import, write back, or edit MCP servers from the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 扫描本机各工具的 MCP 配置（28 个内置源，支持自定义源），把差异同步进 DSH，并在 DSH 侧栏直接导入、写回或增删改 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with the token cost of that answer. The call is auxiliary — it writes nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中一个术语、点旁边的「搜索」按钮，就地解释基本含义、用途与用法，并显示这次回答消耗的 token；该调用是旁路调用，不写入会话日志。

description.en: Hides unused panels in the left rail grouped by origin, and turns the rail More button into an expand/collapse toggle that lays out every panel.
description.zh: 把左侧栏用不到的面板按来源分组收起；「更多」按钮变成一键展开/折叠全部面板的开关。

description.en: AGENTS & Skills Studio: edit AGENTS.md, create spec-compliant SKILL.md files with structured frontmatter, manage and rename skill folders, and install from Anthropic, OpenAI, Cursor, and Matt Pocock catalogs.
description.zh: AGENTS & Skills 工作台：编辑 AGENTS.md，按 Agent Skills 规范创建 SKILL.md，管理和重命名技能文件夹，并从 Anthropic、OpenAI、Cursor、Matt Pocock 四源技能目录安装技能。

description.en: Right-edge user-message navigator with an adaptive block layout that fits the available height, plus hover previews, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.
description.zh: 右侧用户消息导航条，根据消息数量与可用高度自适应排布导航块，并支持悬停预览、键盘操作与点击跳转。

description.en: Adds interactive agent-switch CLI terminals with tab and grid layouts, Codex delegation cards, and live or saved task output in the right sidebar. Requires agent-switch on PATH, at least one target coding CLI, and a node-pty build allowlist; implemented and tested on Windows.
description.zh: 提供支持页签和网格布局的 agent-switch CLI 交互终端、Codex 委派任务卡片，以及右侧面板中的实时与历史任务输出。需 PATH 上有 agent-switch、至少一个目标编码 CLI，并在插件页放行 node-pty 原生构建；目前只在 Windows 验证过。

description.en: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment path anchoring, dir: and file: prefixes, Tab directory drilling and :line jumps, opens the picked file in the native right sidebar, and drops a file reference into the conversation draft with Ctrl+Enter. Also adds in-file find (Ctrl+F) and a selection-to-reference action to the built-in file preview.
description.zh: Web GUI 的快速打开面板：Ctrl+P 在会话工作区的内存索引上做模糊检索（约 5.1 万条目，查询中位数 5 ms），支持逐段路径锚定、dir: 与 file: 前缀、Tab 目录下钻与 :行号 跳转；选中文件走 DSH 原生右栏打开，Ctrl+Enter 把文件引用放进会话草稿。另为内置文件预览补上文件内查找（Ctrl+F）与选中加入会话。

description.en: Watches a turn for long silences and, once the threshold passes, injects a user message asking the model to state in prose what it is doing before carrying on, so the turn keeps going. The same text is mirrored in a lower-left overlay above the composer. The silence threshold and the minimum gap between reports are set in minutes, the prompt can be replaced wholesale, and it runs with no runtime dependencies. Requires DSH 0.2.1+ and Node.js 18+.
description.zh: 盯着回合里的长时间沉默：超过阈值就注入一条用户消息，让模型先用正文说清正在做什么、做到哪了再接着干，回合不中断。这段原文同步显示在输入框上方的左下角浮窗。静默阈值与两次汇报的最小间隔都在设置卡里按分钟调，提示词可整段替换，零运行时依赖。需 DSH 0.2.1+ 与 Node.js 18+。

plugins.name: dsh-bot-codex-ui

description.en: Unified install for DS Bot and the Codex-style sidebar: one package that mounts both and fixes their layout conflicts (composer alignment, sidebar footer, account entry, conversation width).
description.zh: DS Bot 与 Codex 风格侧栏的合一安装：一个包同时挂载两者并修复共存时的布局冲突（输入框对齐、侧栏底部、账户入口、对话宽度）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Personalize DSH with glass surfaces, independent light and dark themes, image/video/HTML backgrounds, particles, custom greetings, overlay sidebars, task and Artifact cards, message bubbles, smooth answer streaming, and settings import/export.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH 玻璃材质与独立明暗主题，支持图片、视频与 HTML 背景、粒子、自定义问候与开屏、覆盖侧栏、任务与 Artifact 卡片、消息气泡、回答逐字渐显，以及配置导入导出。

description.en: Video workbench for DeepSeek Harness that parses a link, downloads the source, transcribes it, trims or merges clips and exports GIFs. Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe and yt-dlp; whisper.cpp plus a model is optional for videos without subtitles.
description.zh: 视频工作台：贴链接解析并下载、转写文案、截取拼接片段、按目标体积导出 GIF。需自备 ffmpeg/ffprobe 与 yt-dlp；无字幕视频的本地转写另需 whisper.cpp 与模型（可选）。

description.en: A grey ASCII ocean behind the whole window: whales swim continuously across the sidebar and the chat area, so a creature can drift from one column into the other. Once a conversation starts, every creature leaves through its own edge — up, down, right, or left — while the sea calms, and the sidebar keeps one frosted surface whose height follows its content, so a passing whale becomes a soft shadow behind the labels; an empty conversation brings them back in from the edges. Streaming replies reveal from blur to clear, and reduced motion falls back to a still frame and the native renderer. Neutral ink only, with day and night palettes.
description.zh: 整个窗口背后是一片灰色字符海洋：鲸群在侧栏与聊天区之间连续游动，能从一栏游进另一栏。开始对话后，生物各自向上、下、右或左侧边缘游走，海面缓缓平静，侧栏留一整片跟随内容高度的磨砂面，鲸鱼经过时只在文字背后留下模糊的影子；回到空白会话时，生物再从边缘游入。流式回复从模糊到清晰逐字浮现，开启减少动态效果时改用静态画面与原生渲染。只用中性墨色，日夜两套配色。

description.en: Pins the conversation column of the dsh UI to a fixed width — a pixel value or a percentage of the column — from a row in General settings, and hides the built-in drag handles so the width stays put.
description.zh: 把 dsh 界面的对话框固定为像素宽度或列宽百分比，设置项在「通用」设置页；锁定后隐藏内置拖动手柄，宽度不再被误拖。

description.en: Folders for the DSH Plugins page: group installed plugins, toggle a whole group, batch move with undo, search across groups, long-press drag to reorder, reinstall removed plugins from their record, and restart Harness with one click.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件页加文件夹：把已装插件分组、整组开关、批量移动并可撤销、跨分组搜索、长按拖动排序，卸载后按记录一键装回，还能一键重启 Harness。

description.en: Wallpaper-aware readability repair for the DSH Web GUI: it lifts the three low-contrast secondary text tokens with color-mix plus an adjustable text halo, adds content rules (bold, permanently underlined or recoloured links, tinted headings and body text) scoped to conversation Markdown only, offers adjustable rainbow-edge and gradient-fill heading effects, loads custom fonts from the plugin folder or the DSH home, and ships a draggable WYSIWYG preview with a WCAG contrast badge.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的「壁纸感知」可读性修复：用 color-mix 把三个低对比次级文字 token 向主文字靠拢，并叠加可调强度的文字光晕；提供仅作用于会话 Markdown 的内容规则（链接加粗 / 常驻下划线 / 变色、标题与正文变色）、可调的彩虹描边与渐变填充标题特效、从插件目录或 DSH_HOME 加载的自定义字体，以及带 WCAG 对比度徽标的可拖动 WYSIWYG 预览窗。

description.en: Schedule-send button and panel to the right of the composer, with smart time slots, a custom date/time picker, several queued sends at once, and localStorage persistence that restores pending tasks after a page reload.
description.zh: 在输入框右侧提供「定时发送」按钮与配置面板，支持智能时段、自定义日期时间、多个定时任务并行，任务经 localStorage 持久化，刷新页面后自动恢复。

description.en: Replaces the Web GUI trajectory tab with a new-user-friendly round-by-round storyline, plain-language tool labels, category filters and fuzzy search.
description.zh: 把 Web GUI 的轨迹页签替换为新手友好的回合故事线：工具名通俗中文化，支持类别筛选与模糊搜索。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Windows 桌面启动器插件，创建受管理的快捷方式，后续启动会在后台重启 DSH 并刷新已有浏览器页面。

description.en: Chat turn accordion: every interaction folds into one row with a time pill and question summary, only the newest turn stays open, and switching sessions or starting a new turn resets the open state; the execution process opens only on its own click.
description.zh: 会话交互折叠：每次交互压成一行（时间胶囊 + 提问摘要），只保留最近一次展开；切换工作区/会话或产生新交互都会重置到最新一条；执行过程仅在单独点击时展开。

description.en: Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.
description.zh: 恢复 DSH 0.1.6 及以前在对话流末尾显示的蓝色流光深度求索中回合状态行.

description.en: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling, hover title scroll, shadows, gradients and JS motion one category at a time, to cut browser rendering cost.
description.zh: 在设置里新增 "前端特效" 页, 按分类关掉 DSH Web 的动画与过渡, 加载与进度动画, 毛玻璃, 平滑滚动, 标题 hover 滚动, 阴影, 渐变与 JS 动效, 降低浏览器渲染负担.

description.en: System-level desktop floating-window plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a global hotkey opens a floating window; the plugin supports workspace and session switching, approval and follow-up handling, and export of its own diagnostic logs for plugin troubleshooting.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的系统级桌面悬浮窗插件：按下全局快捷键即可呼出桌面悬浮窗口，支持工作区与会话切换、审批与追问处理，以及插件自身的诊断日志导出。

description.en: Shows the signed-in DeepSeek account's remaining balance in the DSH composer bottom bar, next to the shipped turn/step and token-usage pills, and refreshes it periodically and after each turn.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话底栏（输入框下方的统计行）显示当前 DeepSeek 账户的剩余余额，定时刷新，并在每轮对话结束后立即更新。

description.en: Gives the DSH conversation the Visual Studio Code editor chrome: a 14px always-visible scrollbar with a flat, translucent thumb, plus a VS Code-style minimap in the right margin (half-window column, media not painted, hover-only minimapSlider, click/wheel scrolling) and auto-expanded older pages.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话界面改成 Visual Studio Code 编辑器风格：14px 常驻滚动条、扁平半透明滑块，并在右侧加上 VS Code 式 Minimap（小地图）：高度不超过半屏、悬停才显示滑块、点击/滚轮即可跳转滚动，同时自动展开“加载更早”的过往对话。

description.en: Adds a Chinese-mode toggle beside the composer that opens a panel for switching reply, reasoning, and tool-narration language, persisted in the profile.
description.zh: 在输入框左侧加一个中文模式开关，点开可分别切换回复、思考与工具说明的语言，配置随 profile 持久化。

description.en: Whole-window opacity for the DSH desktop window from one button at the sidebar foot: a 0-90% slider whose value is remembered between runs. It only sets the window alpha - no restyling, no extra panels, and no other feature is touched. Windows only.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部一个按钮，点开是 0-90% 的滑块，用来调整整个 DSH 窗口的透明度，数值自动记住。只设置窗口 alpha，不改样式、不加面板、不影响其它功能。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: PaperFlight is an experimental future-retro DSH Web workbench with session management, file previews, approvals, and optional preset-scoped browser and terminal tools.
description.zh: 纸航 PaperFlight 是实验性的未来复古 DSH Web 工作台，提供会话管理、文件预览、审批和按预设启用的可选浏览器与终端工具。

description.en: Replaces the model button in the DSH composer with its own two-level panel (provider list, then a searchable model list) built around a continuous draggable reasoning-effort slider: blue-to-violet fill, nebula and star particles on higher levels, and a distinct color per level. Picking a model keeps the panel open and moves the slider to that model's middle level. The implementation started from Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider 1.0.0 (credited in the README); the panel, the seat takeover, the offline test suite and the docs are new here.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 输入框的模型按钮，点开是自建的两级面板（provider 列表 → 模型列表，带搜索），核心是一条连续可拖动的推理等级滑条：填充由蓝渐变到紫罗兰，高档位带星云与星尘粒子，一档一色。点模型不关面板，滑条落到该模型的中间档。实现起点是 Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider 1.0.0（README 中有致谢），面板、接管、离线测试与文档为新增。

description.en: Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then finished-but-unopened, then just read - and draws those rows with a state bar, tinted surface and coloured title, plus a one-shot settle pulse when a run stops. Every colour is taken from the active theme's own tokens, and the three windows that decide how long a finished session stays promoted are settings.
description.zh: 把含“需要注意的会话”的工作区按紧急度排到侧栏会话列表最前——待你处理优先，其次运行中，再次完成未读，最后刚读过的——并为这些行画状态竖条、着色底与着色标题，一次运行结束时播放一次收敛动效。所有颜色都取自当前主题自身的变量；决定完成会话置顶时长的三个窗口都是可配置项。

description.en: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.
description.zh: 工作区侧边栏行内两击归档：点一次变红确认，再点即归档，归档项不再出现在 ⋮ 菜单里。

description.en: Command history for the DSH composer: press Up/Down to cycle through previously sent instructions, then restore the draft at the end of the history; works in the official desktop app and web-profile builds.
description.zh: DSH 输入框命令历史：按 ↑/↓ 浏览此前发送的指令，回到历史末尾时恢复原草稿；官方桌面端与 Web profile 均可用。

description.en: Enhances the DSH web session view — one-click collapse of reasoning and tool chains, numbered history quick-jump, Markdown export, AI avatars.
description.zh: 增强 DSH Web 会话视图：一键折叠思考链与工具链、历史快速定位、Markdown 导出、AI 头像。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that restates your draft, then asks a few questions with clickable options — every question offers an "I don't know, you decide" escape — and only then rewrites the draft into a request an agent can start on. The whole flow can be finished without typing, and it never sends for you.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮：先复述你的草稿，再用可点的选项问几个问题——每题都带一个「我不知道，你替我定」的逃生项——最后把草稿改写成 AI 能直接开工的需求。全程可以一个字都不打，而且它不会替你发送。

description.en: Drag or paste any local file onto the DSH page; it resolves the real absolute path (Spotlight + size/mtime + head/tail fingerprint match) and inserts it into the composer, with a content-cache fallback.
description.zh: 把本机任意文件拖拽或粘贴到 DSH 页面，静默反查真实绝对路径并插入输入框（Spotlight + 大小/时间 + 首尾指纹校验），未找到时内容缓存兜底。

description.en: Turn any DSH selection into a reviewable quote — chat, file preview, terminal and diff; code quotes carry path#line. A sent quote keeps a source highlight and ordinal and jumps back, then joins a searchable review list with status, tags, multi-select insert, and Markdown/JSON export. Quotes collect above the composer as a 引用 ×N bar with per-chip edit and remove; side threads can bring their conclusion back to the main draft; a sent quote can be revised, with the old capsule marked superseded; replies can answer each quote by number.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的任意选区变成可审阅的引用对象：正文、文件预览、终端、diff 都能引，代码引用带 path#line。发送后原句留下高亮与序号、可跳回；输入框上方「引用 ×N」可逐条编辑或移除；右侧栏引用清单可搜索、按状态与标签审阅、多选插入、导出 Markdown/JSON；侧边线程的结论可回流主会话；已发送的引用能追加修订，旧胶囊标「已修订」；模型可按「引用N」逐条回应。

description.en: Selection comments and quoted conversations (dsh划词评论 / dsh-huaci-pinglun), based on the MIT-licensed BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote 0.11.1 with attached textarea measurement, border-aware height and long-text scrolling.
description.zh: dsh划词评论（dsh-huaci-pinglun）：基于 BangBang-03/dsh-client-ui-quote 0.11.1 的 MIT 修补分支，提供划词评论与引用对话，修复引用文本框在挂载并可见后测量、补齐边框高度与长文滚动。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the DSH Web UI through a loopback-only endpoint that requests a relaunch using the current process executable, arguments and working directory.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面添加基于本机回环接口的重启按钮，按当前进程的可执行文件、参数和工作目录请求重新启动。

description.en: Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings page with live status, manual hold, and display-on options.
description.zh: 任意 agent、subagent 或后台任务运行时持有系统唤醒锁，全部结束后按可配置宽限期释放；提供中英双语 Web 设置页，实时显示活动与唤醒锁状态，支持手动保持与阻止屏幕关闭。

description.en: Live download progress in the DSH session header — percentage, transfer speed, ETA and phase per download, with file-size probing before a transfer starts and byte-range resume after an interruption. The progress cards render as a fixed overlay at the top-right of the chat window.
description.zh: DSH 会话头里的下载进度：百分比、速率、剩余时间与阶段，下载前先探测文件大小，中断后按字节区间续传。进度卡片以固定浮层显示在聊天窗口右上角。

description.en: Customizable startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with eight bundled clips, random rotation, tail fade and time-of-day greetings. Based on lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation, so do not install it with the upstream plugin; bundled clips and the welcome voice carry their own media terms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 启动动画定制版，内置 8 段短片，随机轮播、片尾淡入，还有分时段问候。基于 lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation 定制，不可与上游插件同装；随包短片与欢迎音按各自媒体授权。

description.en: Keyboard-driven quick switching for DSH — model palette with colored provider tags, suffix tags and pins, a two-column session palette with per-question prompt preview and archived-session restore, recency-ordered session cycling, find-next-answered jump, composer focus, and configurable permission cycling, managed from a sidebar control panel.
description.zh: 键盘驱动的快速切换：模型面板（彩色提供方标签、后缀与推理标签、置顶）、两栏会话面板（提问预览、归档会话恢复）、按活动时间顺序的会话循环、查找下一个已回答的会话、聚焦输入框、可配置的权限循环，侧栏控制面板统一管理开关与改键。

description.en: Hierarchical session tree for the sidebar - native subagent trees plus an optional organization-derived hierarchy, with collapsed branch counters and orphan/cycle defense.
description.zh: 侧栏会话树 - 原生子代理树,外加可选的组织汇报层级;折叠分支计数,孤儿/环路防御。

description.en: Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an external editor.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面右侧滑出 Monaco 编辑器与文件树面板，直接在对话里编辑本地工作区代码，无需切到外部编辑器。

description.en: Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed characters inside replaced lines.
description.zh: 接管浏览器端 edit/write 工具卡片，用近线性行级 diff 只显示真正变化行，并对替换对做行内字符下划线高亮，消除内置 diff 对未变化相同行的重复渲染。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab that would raise the soft keyboard after a session switch is suppressed.
description.zh: 窄屏下侧栏收起为左上角 44 像素悬浮方块、展开为 280 像素覆盖式抽屉，点会话自动收起，并压掉切会话时自动抢焦点导致的软键盘顶起。

description.en: Auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DSH Web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling no-op/expand/collapse and the state persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 自动展开 DSH 界面里新到达的工具调用卡片，侧栏开关在不干预/展开/折叠三态间循环，档位持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Independent per-pane zoom for the DSH web shell: Ctrl+wheel over a pane, Ctrl+± / Ctrl+0 for the focused pane. Works with the official look and every skin.
description.zh: 支持 DSH Web 上的每个面板独立缩放：鼠标悬浮在面板上 Ctrl+滚轮，或对选中的面板 Ctrl+±，Ctrl+0恢复。兼容官方界面风格及皮肤。

description.en: Browser tab status indicator for dsh web: paints the document favicon from the session list (blue spinning while work runs, amber while waiting on the user, green when finished).
description.zh: 为 dsh web 绘制浏览器页签状态指示：根据会话列表把 favicon 画成状态圆环（执行中蓝色旋转、等待用户琥珀色、完成绿色）。

description.en: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus error and unread status dots, hover-card details, one-click delete for archived rows, and a settings panel that switches each menu item on or off; the interface is available in English and Chinese.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话右键菜单补上标记未读、复制会话信息、在访达中显示或换 IDE 打开、永久删除（连子会话一起删），并给会话行加上报错与未读状态点、悬浮卡信息、归档行的一键删除，以及一个可逐项开关菜单的设置面板；界面提供中英文两套文案。

description.en: Select text anywhere in DeepSeek Harness, click the quote pill next to the pointer, and the selection lands in the composer as a small quote chip; hover the chip to read the full quote.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里选中文字，点鼠标旁的「引用」胶囊，选区就变成输入框里的迷你引用条；悬停引用条可看被引用全文。

description.en: Full-screen boot animation for DeepSeek Harness: a wave sweeps the screen, a whale assembles from particles inside three breathing dot rings, and a four-language salute lands over a segmented progress bar; ships an 18-second cut and 3.8-4.5-second short cuts, a language picker in settings, and a four-language preview queue.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画：水波扫过、粒子聚成鲸鱼、三层呼吸点阵圆环与四语问候落在分段进度条上；含 18 秒完整版与 3.8-4.5 秒简版、设置页语言选择与四语连播预览。

description.en: Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.
description.zh: 对话区左侧 Codex 风格短横线锚点，悬停预览，点击跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: Steam Big Picture-style six-second Canvas startup animation for DSH Desktop with a variable-width terminal-to-whale transition, optional stereo startup audio, volume controls, preview, Escape skip, and reduced-motion support.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端加入 Steam 大屏幕风格的 6 秒 Canvas 开屏，粗细渐变的终端标志变为 DeepSeek 鲸鱼，支持可选双声道音效、音量设置、预览、Esc 跳过及减少动态效果。

description.en: Cross-platform file drag-and-drop with raw path insertion, no file copying.
description.zh: 跨平台文件拖拽与原始路径插入，无需复制文件。

description.en: In-chat image viewer for DeepSeek Harness: wheel and trackpad pinch zoom at the pointer, two-finger and drag panning, gallery navigation, downloads named from the image description and timestamp, and opening workspace originals in the system default app.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的聊天图片查看器：滚轮 / 触控板捏合以指针为中心缩放，双指 / 拖动平移，支持图集切换、下载按图片说明与时间戳自动命名，以及用系统默认应用打开工作区原图。

description.en: A sticky-note wall in the DSH sidebar: nine paper colors, categories, search, archive, to-do checklists with stable item ids, and agent read/write tools.
description.zh: 常驻 DSH 侧边栏的便签墙：九种纸色、分类、搜索、归档、带稳定条目 id 的待办清单，并支持 agent 读写。

description.en: Enhanced model selector for the DSH composer with searchable provider groups, keyboard and accessibility support, and an inline reasoning-effort slider.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 输入区的模型选择器：可搜索供应商分组、键盘与无障碍支持，以及内联推理强度滑杆。

description.en: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention.
description.zh: 输入框右下角 GitHub 图标打开当前仓库的 issue/PR 搜索弹窗，数据来自本机 gh CLI，点选即以 URL 或 @owner/repo#number 形式插入引用。

description.en: Hide the duplicate DeepSeek account / official API entries, sidebar items and the Feedback / Sign out items; on DSH Desktop, add Reload / Restart to the application menu with a one-click patch to the app shell main.js (needs an app restart, and a DSH update reverts the patch); pin a reasoning level and auto-fill new providers and models.
description.zh: 收起 DSH 里重复的 DeepSeek 账号 / 官方 API 入口，隐藏侧边栏项目、账号菜单的意见反馈与退出登录；桌面版可一键给应用外壳的 main.js 打补丁，把刷新与重启加进应用菜单（需重启应用，DSH 升级后补丁会失效）；推理等级一键写死，新供应商新模型自动补齐。

description.en: A pixel companion living in the chat area: hatches from an egg into one of three sprites or an LLM-drawn custom one from a text description, platform-jumps over message bubbles on its own, WASD controllable, chats in character through the models you already configured, and carries a nurture system (mood/power/health, levels, shop) driven by real token usage.
description.zh: 聊天区里的像素小宠物：从蛋孵化三选一，也可用一句话描述让 LLM 画出自定义形象，自动在消息气泡间平台跳跃，支持 WASD 操控与拖拽，用已配置的模型角色扮演陪聊，养成系统（心情/电量/健康、等级、商店）由真实 token 消耗驱动。

description.en: Terminal coding agent for DeepSeek Harness with a full-screen alternate-screen UI, turn-aware session navigation, and a gated /ship workflow that takes one-line requirements through specification, TDD, and rerun acceptance checks.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的终端编码 Agent，提供全屏备用屏幕 UI、轮次感知的会话导航，以及将一句话需求经过规格、TDD 和验收复跑的分阶段 /ship 流程。

description.en: Chinese summaries for the dsh-skill-mcp-panel skill cards: each expanded card gets a short Chinese overview, a category tag and a few bullet points, while the English description the panel already renders is folded behind a "原文" toggle. Skills missing from the bundled map are translated on demand by the host with your current default model and cached on disk, keyed by a hash of the original text, so a new skill needs no manual entry. Skills whose own description is already Chinese are skipped.
description.zh: 给 dsh-skill-mcp-panel 的技能卡片加中文说明：展开卡片时显示一句话中文速览、分类标签和几条要点，面板原本渲染的英文描述折进「原文」按钮。手写映射表里没有的英文技能，由宿主用你当前的默认模型按需现场生成并落盘缓存，缓存按原文哈希失效，所以新装的技能不用再手工补条目。技能自带描述已是中文的自动跳过。

description.en: macOS 14.2+ only: the macOS counterpart to Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail — the DSH conversation rail pulses with whatever the Mac is playing, a real 12-band spectrum that only changes bar length, leaving the host state colours and lengths untouched. Requires the Audio Recording permission on first run. Do not install it alongside dsh-audio-rail: both drive the same rail and register the same /audio-rail/events and /audio-rail/status routes.
description.zh: macOS 14.2+ 专享：Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail 的 macOS 对应版，让 DSH 会话页右侧的锚点跟着 Mac 播放的音乐律动，12 段真实频谱只改长度，不覆盖宿主的状态颜色与长度。首次运行需授予「音频录制」权限；请勿与 dsh-audio-rail 同装——两者驱动同一处锚点并注册相同的 /audio-rail/events 与 /audio-rail/status 路由。

description.en: Composer-dock badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing on a Beijing-time calendar whose China holiday schedule is fetched online at runtime (off-peak costs half the peak rate); auto-hides for non-DeepSeek models and cycles seven readouts on click.
description.zh: 输入栏下方显示峰谷时段徽标：按北京时间与中国法定节假日日历计算峰谷（空闲时段价格为高峰一半），节假日安排在运行时联网自动同步，非 DeepSeek 模型自动隐藏，点击循环切换 7 种显示内容。

description.en: Local text-to-image automation for DeepSeek Harness: captures the conversation, sends it to a prompt session, renders with your own ComfyUI, and brings the images back to a sidebar tab, a floating frame and a gallery.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的本地文生图自动化：捕获会话正文，交给提示词会话写成提示词，调用本机 ComfyUI 出图，再把图片送回侧栏、悬浮图片框和图库。

description.en: Pins each message's action row — copy/like/dislike/branch controls, timestamp, and third-party additions — so it stays visible without hovering.
description.zh: 让每条消息的操作栏（复制、点赞、点踩、分支按钮，时间，以及其他插件添加的内容）无需悬停即可常显。

description.en: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
description.zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

description.en: Auto-expands every Think row after switching sessions, with a header switch to turn it on or off.
description.zh: 切换会话后也会自动展开全部 Think 行，标题栏有开关可以打开或关闭。

description.en: Highlights sidebar session rows by state (pending approval, running, just finished) with color, animation and a matching status dot.
description.zh: 按待审批、运行中、刚完成三种状态给侧边栏会话行上色并加呼吸动效，行尾配同色状态点。

description.en: Bottom terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI, providing multi-tab interactive terminals powered by node-pty (Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty) with split panes, a side terminal list, and a dropdown new/split menu. Also compatible with DSH-better-sidebar — auto-detected at runtime, it switches to a bottom workbench tab so PTY sessions do not bind the DSH session write handle.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 底部终端面板插件，基于 node-pty 提供多标签交互式终端（Windows ConPTY / POSIX openpty），支持拆分面板、右侧终端列表与下拉新建/拆分菜单。同时兼容 DSH-better-sidebar——运行时自动检测并切换为底部工作台 tab，PTY 会话不绑定 DSH session 的 write handle。

description.en: Adds an optional note field under each selected option in the DSH Web UI ask_user_question popup; submitted notes travel to the model in the answer's custom field.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页端 ask_user_question 弹窗中为每个选中选项增加可选的补充说明输入框，提交时补充内容随答案一并传给模型。

description.en: A fork of dsh-boot-animation that plays an intro clip when DSH opens, ships four embedded clips with an in-app library, and adds batch deletion for clips you added yourself. It reuses the same plugin id as upstream, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: dsh-boot-animation 的社区分支：打开 DSH 时播放片头动画，内置四段片头并可管理片库，新增片库批量删除（同步删除自己加入的视频文件）。沿用上游同一插件 id，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Sidebar category groups for DSH workspaces: the flat project list becomes collapsible named sections, workspaces re-file by dragging a row onto a group or picking one from a dropdown, one toolbar button collapses every group at once, an appearance panel sets font size, text color and background tint for each of the three levels, and Ctrl+Tab cycles recently opened sessions.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的工作区加自定义分类：平铺的项目列表变成可折叠的分组，工作区可拖到别的分组或在下拉框里改归类，工具栏一键收起全部分组，外观面板能分别调三层字号、文字颜色与底色，Ctrl+Tab 在最近打开的会话之间切换。

description.en: Session code collector for DeepSeek Harness: a composer-side panel gathering every code block the model produced in the current session, with by-language / by-file views, per-file version history, live search, per-entry copy, copy-all, download-all as Markdown, and click-to-jump back to the exact turn (Alt+Shift+C).
description.zh: 会话代码收集器：输入框右侧按钮一键汇总当前会话中模型产出的全部代码块，支持按语言/按文件双视图、同一文件的版本历史、实时搜索过滤、单条/全部复制、下载合并 Markdown，点击直接跳转到产出该代码的回合（Alt+Shift+C 快捷开关）。

description.en: Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the exact chat position.
description.zh: 对话时间线横条：输入框上方按轮次聚合的时间线，悬停显示该轮用户提示词，点击直接跳转到对话中的对应位置。

description.en: Split view for the Web UI: tiles 1-3 columns x 1-3 rows of live sessions from several workspaces in one grid, with draggable dividers, sidebar-follow routing, an in-pane file preview and an in-pane changes review.
description.zh: Web 界面里的多工作区分屏视图：用 1–3 列 × 1–3 行的网格同时显示多个工作区的实时会话，支持拖动分栏、侧边栏会话进入格子、格内文件预览与改动评审。

description.en: Feishu multi-agent robot console: start, stop and reconnect the daemon, view status and recent activity, and jump to the task workspace.
description.zh: 飞书多助手机器人控制台：开启/关闭/重连守护进程、状态与最近动态、直达任务工作区。

plugins.name: dsh-my-music

description.en: Full-page NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH: daily recommendations, playlist browsing by category, charts, new releases, search, playlist/album/artist pages, QR-code login, synced lyrics, queue and downloads, plus four agent tools for search, song URLs, lyrics and playlist tracks.
description.zh: 整页式网易云音乐播放器：每日推荐、按分类浏览歌单广场、排行榜、新碟上架、搜索、歌单/专辑/歌手页、扫码登录、逐行歌词、队列与下载，并提供搜索、歌曲直链、歌词、歌单曲目四个 agent 工具。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 116.25.146.177 for network access

description.en: Tick-rail conversation navigator: one tick per message you sent, a lit peak that follows the mouse with an even falloff, hover previews, click or keyboard to jump.
description.zh: 会话刻度线导航条：你发的每条消息一格刻度，点亮峰值随鼠标移动、两侧均匀衰减，悬停预览消息摘要，点击或键盘跳转到对应位置。

description.en: Adds touch-friendly navigation, layout refinements, and standalone PWA styling to the existing DeepSeek Harness web interface.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 现有 Web 界面加上触屏友好的导航、布局微调与独立 PWA 样式。

description.en: Puts a key badge in the bottom-right corner of the dsh Web GUI that shows the port this instance is listening on and the remote-access token printed by dsh web at startup, with a copy button per value; clicking the badge rotates the key into a cross, and clicking it again or anywhere beside it collapses the panel.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 界面右下角放一个钥匙徽标，点开显示本实例的监听端口和 dsh web 启动时打印的远程访问令牌，每项都可一键复制；钥匙图标旋转成叉号，再点一次或点旁边空白即可收起。

description.en: Adds host file management and an interactive Bash terminal to the DSH WebUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH WebUI 添加好用的独立文件管理与终端页面，及附属实用功能。

description.en: Windows Electron companion sharing the DSH Web profile, conversations and plugins, with startup logs, update recovery and diagnostics.
description.zh: 共用 DSH Web 配置、对话与插件的 Windows Electron 客户端，提供启动日志、更新恢复与诊断。

description.en: Composer enhancements: caches unsent drafts per workspace for new sessions and per Session id for existing ones, restoring them after switching away and dropping them once sent or cleared; adds an @plugin completion group that mentions an installed plugin so the agent receives that plugin's metadata as runtime context for the turn.
description.zh: 输入框增强：按工作区缓存新会话草稿、按会话缓存已有会话草稿，切换后自动恢复，发送或清空后不再回填；同时在 @ 补全中增加“插件”分组，选中已安装插件后会把该插件信息作为运行时上下文交给 Agent。

description.en: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

description.en: Auto-fold context/system messages in DSH conversation — collapse think blocks, tool calls, and tool results into grouped expandable bars.
description.zh: 自动折叠 DSH 对话中的系统/上下文消息——将思考块、工具调用和工具结果合并为可展开的分组折叠条。

plugins.name: dsh-TUI

description.en: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar pane.
description.zh: DSH Web 活动会话总览窗格：将运行中、等待响应与近期活跃的会话集中到一个侧边窗格，含子代理层级、进度、模型与推理级别。

description.en: Side panel with file browser, terminal, and Git review for quick file previews.
description.zh: 侧边栏集成文件浏览器、终端和 Git 审查，方便预览文件。

description.en: Pinned prompt shortcuts in a single row above the composer — one click replaces the draft with the saved text — plus a searchable panel for pinning, editing and deleting prompts, overflow collapsed into a "More" menu, storage in a Host-side JSON file, and a prompt_shortcuts agent tool that reads and writes the same file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的一行置顶提示词按钮，点击即替换草稿内容；另有可搜索的维护面板用于置顶、编辑、删除，放不下的按钮收进「更多」菜单，数据存于 Host 侧 JSON 文件，并注册 prompt_shortcuts 工具读写同一份数据。

description.en: Manage MCP servers from the Web settings panel: view, add, edit, remove, enable or disable them, with hot reload on save.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中查看、添加、编辑、删除、启用或停用 MCP 服务器，保存后热重载。

description.en: Turns each long dsh conversation into a three-level trail (topic to progress steps to milestone timeline) and shows it in a draggable overlay, where one click jumps back to the matching message in the transcript. Topics are distilled by the DeepSeek model with a zero-cost rule-based fallback, can be renamed, locked, merged by drag and drop, and support per-conversation notes plus a vector drawing board.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的每次长对话实时提炼成「线索 → 进度步骤 → 阶段历程」三级结构，以可拖动的悬浮窗呈现，点一下就能跳回对话里的对应消息。线索由 DeepSeek 模型总结，模型不可用时自动回退到零成本的规则模式；支持重命名、锁定、拖拽合并，附带每个对话独立的笔记与矢量画笔。

description.en: Page zoom for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+mouse wheel scales the entire interface in 5% steps (30%-200%), remembers the zoom level locally, and shows a magnifier with the percentage in the bottom-right corner.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 页面缩放：Ctrl+鼠标滚轮以 5% 步长缩放整个界面（30%-200%），在本地记住缩放比例，并在右下角显示放大镜与百分比。

description.en: Brings active DSH sessions into a 3D 'Overcooked' kitchen: AI agents work, whale-girls wander the kitchen, and you watch from the side; status bubbles show who's cooking, waiting, or done with one-click navigation — originally built to check progress, now you just can't stop watching the whales.
description.zh: 把活跃会话放进 3D 胡闹厨房：AI 在跑任务，鲸鱼娘在厨房溜达，你在旁边看鱼；常驻气泡一眼看清谁在干活、谁在等回应、谁已交作业，点击直达会话继续干活——本来是为了看进度，现在只想再看一眼鱼。

description.en: Codex-style turn folding for the DSH Web UI: keeps final answers visible, groups consecutive reasoning and tool activity, and shows configurable live duration, tool-call, and token metrics with multilingual summaries.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的 Codex 风格回合折叠：保留最终答复，合并连续的推理与工具活动，并以多语言摘要展示可配置的实时耗时、工具调用和 token 指标。

description.en: Scratchpad panel for DeepSeek Harness: tagged notes, image/file attachments, Markdown task lists, send-to-chat, a wake-up shortcut, JSON export/import, and Agent tools.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的左栏便签插件：带标签的随手记、图片/文件附件、Markdown 待办、发到对话、唤起快捷键、JSON 导入导出，以及 Agent 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-beginner-hub

description.en: Beginner panel for DeepSeek Harness: routes a plain-language request into ready-to-use plans (prompt variants, matching skills, advanced moves) with a local keyword engine and fills the chosen plan into a new session in one click.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 新手的说人话需求路由面板：用本地关键词引擎把一句大白话需求路由成可直接用的方案（提问话术变体、匹配技能、进阶玩法），选中的方案可一键填入新会话。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Dockable side panel that keeps an XEChat chat session connected over a single WebSocket: markdown messages with images and emoji, server switching through #showServer and #login, an online member list, a full-screen panic overlay, and dock side, width and visibility persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 可停靠的侧边面板，用一条 WebSocket 保持 XEChat 聊天在线：支持图片与表情的 Markdown 消息、通过 #showServer 与 #login 切换服务器、在线成员列表、全屏伪装覆盖层，停靠位置、宽度与可视状态持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Shows a spinner on a sidebar workspace row while any of its sessions are running, and a short-lived finished mark after they stop.
description.zh: 侧边栏的工作区行会在其下会话运行时显示转圈，会话停止后短暂保留一个已完成标记。

description.en: Draggable sticky notes with 9 skins, image notes, and agent-readable to-do lists for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 可拖动的便签纸,9 款皮肤与图片便签,AI 模型可读取并追加待办条目。

description.en: Markdown visual enhancement and session workbench for DSH Web Composer: live syntax presentation with caret-row source reveal (inactive-line markers can be hidden or faded), deterministic local completions, and list/quote continuation on line break with ordered-list renumbering; long pastes fold into persistent chips with inline context or file-mode delivery (@path across 50+ extensions) plus sidebar LLM rewrites (stop, preview diff, undo/redo); real-time context map with token gauge, composition breakdown, per-turn growth chart with anchor lines, in-place /compact, turn forking, and a Context Doctor workspace (overview, diagnostics, analysis, feedback).
description.zh: DSH Web Composer 视觉增强与会话工作台：实时 Markdown 呈现与光标行源码还原（非焦点行语法标记可完全隐藏或淡化显示）、确定性本地补全、列表与引用的换行自动续行及有序列表重编号；超长粘贴自动收纳为持久化引用 chip，支持直接内联或文件送达（支持 50+ 种扩展名），并在右栏抽屉提供大模型智能改写（支持中止、预览对比、应用与撤销重做）；集成实时上下文地图，包含 Token 仪表盘、构成穿透钻取、逐轮增长图与锚定刻线、一键 /compact 及会话分叉，并内置 Context Doctor 工作区（概览、诊断、分析、反馈）。

description.en: MUV engine for DeepSeek Harness: runs the regex_scripts from a character card against model output, tracks variables, renders a status bar, expands macros and LaTeX, and styles tagged code blocks such as letter, terminal, newspaper and phone. Needs dsh-muv-table installed as well, which is its companion plugin.
description.zh: MUV 引擎：执行角色卡的 regex_scripts 实时替换模型输出，追踪变量、渲染状态栏、展开宏与 LaTeX、为标签代码块（信纸／终端／报纸／手机）套样式。需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-table。

description.en: MUV variable table editor for DeepSeek Harness: a tree view of the variables being tracked, a macro test panel for random, pick and roll, a dice shortcut bar and pick-cache management. Companion plugin for dsh-muv-engine.
description.zh: MUV 变量表格编辑器：树形变量面板、宏测试浮窗（random／pick／roll）、骰子快捷栏与 pick 缓存管理。dsh-muv-engine 的伴生插件。

description.en: Live progress for long-running DSH tasks: a script appends JSON lines to a per-session progress file, the Web UI draws them in a floating overlay and a right-sidebar tab that also lists background jobs which reported nothing, and `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` wraps a command that cannot report for itself.
description.zh: DSH 长任务的实时进度：脚本往该会话自己的进度文件追加 JSON 行，不能自报进度的命令可用 `dsh-progress run -- <cmd>` 包装，Web 界面用悬浮窗与右侧栏 tab 展示，未上报的后台任务也会列成任务行。

description.en: A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: CPU, GPU and memory usage in three compact rows that float directly over the interface without any card background, snapping to the nearest window corner so resizing or maximising keeps them in place; CPU package temperature comes from an optional elevated helper (LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO) and the plugin itself stays at a fraction of a percent of CPU. Windows only.
description.zh: DSH 界面上的透明性能悬浮窗：三行小字直接浮在界面上显示 CPU、GPU、内存占用率，没有底色也没有边框，可拖动并吸附到最近的窗口角，最大化或改变窗口大小都不会跑位；CPU 封装温度由可选的高权限助手（LibreHardwareMonitor + PawnIO）读取，插件自身开销不到单核百分之一。仅 Windows。

description.en: Markdown editing aids for the DSH web composer: ordered and unordered list continuation with continuous renumbering, Tab-nested list levels, inline-code styling, and code-fence auto-closing, with the sent draft kept as literal Markdown.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的 Markdown 编辑增强：有序与无序列表续行且组内序号恒连续、Tab 层级缩进、行内代码样式、代码块围栏自动闭合；发送的草稿保持字面 Markdown。

description.en: A pale rose-and-gold Mushoku Tensei skin for the DSH web GUI: an arcane sigil and two full-body Eris figures behind the conversation, a young Eris standee and gilt plugin glyphs in the sidebar, and its own settings card.
description.zh: 《无职转生》艾莉丝主题皮肤：淡绯金配色与魔法阵纹章，对话区铺魔法大陆场景与两幅全身立绘，侧栏立幼年艾莉丝立牌并重绘图标，自带设置面板。

description.en: VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格文件管理器：侧边栏文件树浏览当前对话工作区，中间列用 Monaco 编辑文件，支持主题导入导出与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: Web UI for capturing and reviewing raw LLM requests, streamed responses, token usage and tool calls.
description.zh: 用于捕获和查看原始 LLM 请求、流式响应、Token 用量和工具调用的 Web 界面。

description.en: Adds an editable conversation canvas to DeepSeek Harness, where graph connections select context for canvas requests, with branching, merging, and local agent session imports.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中嵌入可编辑对话画布，通过连线选择画布请求的上下文，支持分支、合并与本地 Agent 会话导入。

description.en: Offline-first UI/UX design intelligence library for DeepSeek Harness: design_recommend, design_review and design_search tools with a built-in database of 84 design styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 99 UX guidelines, 25 chart types and 22 tech stacks, Chinese-first with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供离线可用的 UI/UX 设计智能库：内置 84 种设计风格、192 个配色、74 组字体、99 条 UX 规范、25 种图表与 22 个技术栈，提供 design_recommend / design_review / design_search 三个工具，中文优先、零运行依赖。

description.en: Change review for a turn's edited files: a pill above the composer counts this turn's files and lines and floats the file list up on hover, and a right-sidebar page shows each file's diff with syntax highlighting and a one-click revert.
description.zh: 本轮改动审查：输入框上方的气泡统计本回合改动文件数与行数，悬停时向上浮出文件清单；右侧边栏按标签页展示逐文件语法高亮 diff，并支持一键还原。

description.en: Adds lightweight selected-text references to DSH assistant replies: selections stay outside the editor as removable draft contexts, remain marked beside the source, and render as hoverable annotations after submission.
description.zh: 为 DSH 助手回复添加轻量选中文本引用：选区以可删除的草稿上下文独立于编辑器保存，在原文旁保留标记，并在发送后显示为可悬浮查看的注释。

description.en: Browse local image, video, and SVGA artifacts from conversation nodes in a Finder-style column view.
description.zh: 以访达式分栏浏览对话节点中的本地图片、视频与 SVGA 产物。

description.en: DSH sidebar footer ordering: forces the sidebar.footer.action slot into a vertical stack and lets users configure the top-to-bottom order of its entries.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏页脚排序：将 sidebar.footer.action 槽位改为上下堆叠，并允许用户配置各条目自上而下的排列顺序。

description.en: File-based CSS overrides for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — edit ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css and reload to restyle any plugin's elements, for example making the quote bar fully opaque.
description.zh: 基于本地 CSS 文件的界面覆盖——编辑 ~/.dsh/ui-overrides.css 并刷新，即可改任意插件元素的外观，例如让引用浮层完全不透明。

description.en: Current-session message outline rail for the DSH web UI — your messages show as slim bars on the left edge; hover to expand the full outline (line number + text), click to jump instantly to that message. Pure frontend, zero external service dependencies, sessions-snapshot driven with zero polling.
description.zh: 当前会话消息大纲（左缘横杠）——你的消息在对话区左缘显示一列细横杠，hover 展开完整大纲（行号+文本），点击瞬间定位到对话里那条消息。纯前端、零外部服务依赖、sessions 快照驱动零轮询。

description.en: In-place HTML document preview annotation: pick elements, leave notes saved per file, send batches to the conversation, and let the agent apply changes directly.
description.zh: HTML 文档预览就地批注插件：点选元素写批注，按文件保存批注，可整批发送到当前对话，由 Agent 直接修改源文件。

description.en: A collapsible column beside the conversation that organises conversations into a workspace/topic tree, opens the real sessions in place, and exposes the tree to the assistant through 9 model tools.
description.zh: 会话列旁的可折叠栏：把对话按工作区与主题组织成树，就地打开真实会话，并通过 9 个模型工具让助手读写这棵树。

description.en: One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter headings, lists and blocks, a rounded quote bar, and Tidy Tables with a themed header, row/column rules, full-width short tables and contained scrolling for wide tables; no settings or DOM rewriting, with real before/after captures.
description.zh: 一张样式表，按实测的 Codex 版式重排 DSH 对话页：14/22 px 正文，收紧标题、列表与块级节奏，使用圆角引用条，并把表格补成带主题化表头、行列分隔、短表铺满和宽表容器内滚动的 Tidy Tables；无设置项、不改写 DOM，仓库内附真实前后对比图。

description.en: Open the current registered Workspace from the Session Header or Workspace menu in a detected or configured editor, with hot re-detection and a remembered browser preference.
description.zh: 从 Session 页头或 Workspace 菜单用检测到或配置的编辑器打开当前已登记 Workspace，支持热重新检测和浏览器首选项记忆。

description.en: Context-aware next-message suggestions in the DSH composer, with repeated Trigger cycling and explicit user review before sending.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的上下文感知下一句建议：重复 Trigger 可持续换一条，发送前始终由用户确认。

description.en: File search palette for the DSH workspace: find files by name or content, open results in DSH's native right-sidebar preview, and edit text files inline with version-conflict checks.
description.zh: 工作区文件查找面板：按文件名或内容搜索，用 DSH 原生右侧栏预览打开结果，需要时在内置编辑器里修改文本，并在保存前检查版本冲突。

description.en: Whole-interface zoom from 75% to 200% in 5% steps via a Settings row, a session-header stepper or Ctrl/⌘+wheel, with a shim that converts rects, viewport units, media queries and pointer coordinates so fixed overlays stay anchored to their triggers.
description.zh: DSH 整体界面缩放（75%–200%，5% 一档）：设置行、会话头部步进器、Ctrl/⌘+滚轮三种入口；内置 shim 换算 rect、视口单位、媒体查询与指针坐标，使 position: fixed 浮层始终贴住触发元素。

description.en: Cherry Studio-style paste: multi-line/indented/fenced text or code pasted into the DSH Web composer collapses into a bordered, collapsible, language-tagged card and is restored as a fenced code block on send.
description.zh: Cherry Studio 式粘贴：把多行/缩进/围栏文本或代码粘进 DSH Web 输入框时收成带边框、可折叠、带语言标签的卡片，发送时还原为围栏代码块。

description.en: Sidebar layout fix for the DSH Web UI: caps and scrolls the plugin-action area, shrinks the inline pairing QR code and tightens the brand row, so the workspace and session list stays clickable when footer plugins grow tall.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏布局修正：给插件动作区限高并允许滚动、缩小内联配对二维码、收紧品牌行——底部插件变高时，工作区与会话列表依然点得到。

description.en: Adds four extra UI locales to DeepSeek Harness — Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), Japanese, Korean and French. All translation data is bundled, so it works fully offline.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加四种界面语言（繁體中文、日本語、한국어、Français），语料随包内置，完全离线。

description.en: Adds an optimize-prompt button to the left of the composer's send button; it rewrites the draft with the session's own model route and writes the result back through the normal editor path, so a single undo restores the original.
description.zh: 在输入框发送按钮左侧添加「优化提示词」按钮，用当前会话的模型路由改写草稿并通过编辑器原有路径原地回填，一次撤销即可还原原文。

description.en: Adds a reforge control to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a sharper prompt in place, as one undoable edit, with one-click revert and cancellation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏加一个「重铸」按钮，把当前草稿就地改写成更精准的提示词——整段替换只占一步撤销，可一键恢复原文，也可中途取消。

description.en: Live2D avatar stage and desktop companion for DSH: bundled Haru sample, custom Cubism 2/3+ model loading with scale and position controls, a draggable in-page pet, an optional transparent always-on-top desktop pet window, per-conversation expression prompt control, and opt-in voice with self-hosted ASR/TTS.
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 形象舞台与桌宠：内置 Haru 示例、自定义 Cubism 2/3+ 模型加载与缩放/位置控制、页面内可拖动桌宠、可选透明置顶桌面独立桌宠窗口、按对话授权的表情 control prompt，以及默认关闭、需自部署 ASR/TTS 的语音功能。

description.en: A 3×3 pad of saved phrases sitting to the left of the composer and tracking the input box's height: clicking a cell inserts its text at the caret as one undoable edit. Presets are editable in place, 9 cells per page up to 12 pages, and the UI follows the DSH language setting. Falls back to a panel above the composer when the window leaves no room.
description.zh: 输入框左侧的九宫格快捷短语面板，高度跟随输入框：点一格就把该条短语以一次可撤销的编辑插入光标处；面板内可就地编辑，每页 9 格、最多 12 页，界面跟随 DSH 语言设置。窗口放不下时退回输入框上方浮层。

description.en: Adds a 3D model library in its own conversation tab, where agents store models built from CadQuery scripts or supplied as tessellated meshes; the library previews them with three-cad-viewer, organises them into folders and exports them to 10 formats including STEP, BREP, STL and DXF.
description.zh: 在对话界面新增「3D模型」标签页作为模型库：agent 把 CadQuery 脚本或已剖分的网格存入服务端，标签页用 three-cad-viewer 预览、按文件夹整理，并可导出 STEP、BREP、STL、DXF 等 10 种格式。

description.en: Lets the AI insert streaming-generated UI into the conversation or a side panel, written in TSX — already one of the model's native languages, so there is no JSON schema to teach it. Rendered without flicker, state kept across frames with no hard remount, and a click in the card driving the next chat turn. Inline is where streaming matters most; the side Canvas is the more agentic shape. Cards get agentic capabilities of their own — run bash, curl, call the model, read and write files.
description.zh: 让 AI 在对话中或侧边栏里插入流式生成的 UI，以 TSX 书写——模型的母语之一，不必再教它一套 JSON schema。流式渲染不闪烁，状态跨帧保留、无硬刷新，对 UI 的点击直接驱动下一轮对话。inline 形态流式最重要，side canvas 形态更 agentic。卡片内部同样具备 agentic 能力——执行 bash、curl、调用模型、读写文件。

description.en: A floating board over the chat for DS Bot's team: who is running and on which tool, who is waiting for another Bot to hand work back, who needs your approval or answer, and who failed, with a hand-off table grouped by sender, a per-Bot drawer showing the pending command or question, and a collapsed one-line pill. Read-only — it never writes to DS Bot's data. Needs the DS Bot plugin installed (built against 0.1.7 and 0.2.0); the panel stays hidden without it.
description.zh: DS Bot 团队的一块浮动看板：谁在跑、在跑什么工具，谁在等别的 Bot 交活，谁在等你批或等你答，谁报错了；带按发送方分组的交接表、显示待批命令或待答问题的单个 Bot 抽屉，收起后是一条状态胶囊。只读，不写 DS Bot 的数据。需要先装 DS Bot（按 0.1.7 与 0.2.0 开发）；没有 DS Bot 时面板不显示。

description.en: Transforms DSH into a dual-column Codex workspace with an integrated Activity Bar, unified topbar, avatar quick access, session history navigation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造Codex 双列活动栏与顶栏一体化视觉体验，支持水晶头像与会话历史导航。

description.en: Chinese-first UI enhancement: translates slash-command names and plugin-inventory cards with three display modes (Chinese only / Chinese + English / off), switching instantly without losing English.
description.zh: 斜杠命令名与插件清单卡片中文化：三种显示模式（只显示中文 / 中英都显示 / 不翻译），中文为主、英文不丢，切换即时生效。

description.en: Replaces the terminal tool on Windows with Git Bash.
description.zh: 可将 Windows 环境下的终端工具替换为 Git Bash

description.en: Recalls prompts sent earlier in the current session with the up and down keys in an empty composer, and shows a position badge while browsing.
description.zh: 在空输入框里用 ↑/↓ 翻出本会话之前发过的提示词，翻动时显示位置角标。

description.en: Continues numbered and bulleted lists in the DSH composer, so Shift+Enter after "1. item" starts a new line with the next marker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里写列表时，Shift+Enter 换行后自动补上下一个编号（1. → 2.）或项目符号。

description.en: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.
description.zh: 像素鲸鱼桌宠,29 个逐帧验收状态:等批准时贴屏敲玻璃并让标签页标题闪烁,任务完成开口汇报,并为 web 端提供斜杠命令面板。

plugins.name: Copree#dsh-copree

description.en: Embeds Copree (formerly AIsChat) into the DSH web UI as a native sidebar board. Copree is an open-source framework for AI group chat and programmable worlds: the AIs are residents, not tools — each has its own memory, state and personality, they talk to each other on their own, and you can watch or join in. Group World goes further: every group chat can bind a living world (its own web page + world AI + code + clock) that the world AI builds and edits through DSH workspace tools. This plugin ships the native sidebar board (contacts, pinned DMs and groups), real-time chat over a same-origin HTTP/WS proxy, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, group invites and image messages, immersive full-frame pages, and one-click mirroring of your worlds into DSH workspaces (folder + DSH session + world_* tools). Front end only: it proxies to a Copree backend you run yourself (default 127.0.0.1:5228, same repository).
description.zh: 把 Copree（前身 AIsChat）以原生侧边栏形式嵌入 DSH Web 界面。Copree 是一个开源的「AI 群聊 + 可编程世界」框架——AI 不是工具，而是群里的「居民」：每个都有自己的记忆、状态与性格，它们会自己聊起来，你可以旁观也可以插话；「群视界」再进一步，让每个群聊绑定一个「活的世界」（专属网页 + 世界 AI + 代码 + 时间），世界 AI 能通过 DSH 工作区工具直接改这个世界。本插件提供：原生侧边栏板块（联系人 / 置顶私信与群聊）、经同源 HTTP/WS 代理的实时聊天、Markdown/LaTeX 渲染、群邀请卡片与图片消息、沉浸式整屏页面，以及把世界一键镜像成 DSH 工作区（目录 + DSH 会话 + world_* 工具集）。插件只是前端，它代理到你自己运行的 Copree 后端（默认 127.0.0.1:5228，后端在同一仓库内）。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to ip-api.com

description.en: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX formulas, Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code in streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 为助手回答渲染带编号的引用角标和来源面板（针对联网搜索结果）、带来源说明的正文配图，并在流式 Markdown 中渲染 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图和代码高亮。

description.en: Adds a ✨ button and an /enhance command to the composer that rewrite the draft into a structured prompt, flag open questions below the input, follow the current session model, and offer an undo.
description.zh: 在输入框加入 ✨ 按钮与 /enhance 命令，把草稿改写成结构化提示词、在输入框下方列出待确认项，跟随当前会话模型，并可撤销改写。

description.en: Manage skins, themes, backgrounds, and widgets in separate layers and save appearance presets for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 分层管理皮肤、主题、背景与装饰件，并保存和应用整套外观方案。

description.en: Re-speaks each assistant report in a chosen persona outside the working prompt, with four built-in presets, per-session switches, and the original available on demand.
description.zh: 在系统提示词之外，用选定人格转述每条助手汇报；内置四个预设，支持会话级开关，原文随时可查。

description.en: Drag or paste files into the Web composer with one image-and-file preview rail; native PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF keep the image attachment path, while other files reuse a matching local path or stream to Host staging and become @ references only at send time. Includes browser media/PDF and bounded text previews; Office and archives show identity cards, and unsent file entries are page-local.
description.zh: 把文件拖入或粘贴进 Web 输入框，图片与文件共用预览栏；PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 保留出厂图片通道，其他文件优先引用匹配的本地路径，否则流式暂存到 Host，发送时才追加 @ 引用。提供浏览器媒体/PDF 和限长文本预览；Office 与压缩包显示身份卡，未发送文件清单仅保存在页面内。

description.en: Model-facing display_file tool that renders 36 file extensions inline in the web UI: images with a click-to-zoom lightbox, seekable video, audio, PDF, Office and OpenDocument files converted to PDF on the host via LibreOffice, and local HTML in a sandboxed frame; bytes stream from a signed HTTP route with range support, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF also enter model context on image-capable routes.
description.zh: 面向模型的 display_file 工具，在网页 UI 内联渲染 36 种扩展名：图片（点击开灯箱）、可拖进度条的视频、音频、PDF、经 LibreOffice 在 Host 转为 PDF 的 Office 与 OpenDocument 文件，以及沙箱 iframe 中的本地 HTML；字节由带 Range 支持的签名 HTTP 路由流式传输，PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 在支持图像输入的路由上同时进入模型上下文。

description.en: Arknights-flavoured startup animation for the DSH Web GUI: a PRTS terminal boot, sonar scan, hologram lock-on and an operator-file splash that end in a deep-sea lockup, about 4.6 seconds, with four selectable original score presets (or sound off), skippable with a click or Esc and switchable, re-timed or replayed from Settings.
description.zh: 明日方舟风格的 DSH 启动动画：PRTS 终端自检、声呐扫描、全息锁定、干员档案，最后定格在「深海回响」，约 4.6 秒，自带 4 套可切换的原创合成配乐（也可关闭音效）；点击或 Esc 跳过，并可在设置中改时长与重播。

description.en: Adds a low-key companion panel with a pomodoro timer, a todo list, drink-water and stand-up reminders, plus lesson explanations and homework tutoring through the installed desktop pet.
description.zh: 给桌宠加一个不惹眼的陪伴面板：番茄钟、待办清单、喝水/久坐提醒，以及借桌宠模型通道的课程讲解与作业辅导。

description.en: Four adjustable terse levels plus independent switches for reasoning effort, web search and subagents, on the conversation header and in the Settings page. No output ceiling.
description.zh: 四档「简洁模式」常驻对话页顶部，思考强度、联网搜索、子代理三个开关独立可调，设置页里也有一份；四个档位都不设输出上限。

description.en: Polish button in the composer that rewrites the draft with the model the current conversation already uses: four styles, a fidelity guard that keeps every concrete fact verbatim, one-click revert, and no API key of its own.
description.zh: 输入框润色按钮：用当前会话正在使用的模型改写草稿，四种风格，代码层保真校验确保数字、版本、路径、URL、引号内容与代码标识符逐字保留，支持一键还原，无需自备 API Key。

description.en: Conversation question index for the DSH Web UI: every question you asked in a session, searchable, paginated, with one-click jump to the exact message.
description.zh: DSH 对话问题索引：列出会话中你提过的所有问题，支持搜索、分页与一键定位。

description.en: Puts a More row at the end of the sidebar main panel list and lets you decide, entry by entry, which panels stay visible and which move into it: a menu lists every entry with a one-click switch in either direction, a search box filters long lists, and a single Restore all clears both kinds of key. Also hides the footer action buttons, keeps the plugins entry un-collapsible, and writes each choice to the profile config so it survives a restart.
description.zh: 在侧边栏主导航列表末尾放一行「更多」，每个入口单独决定留在外面还是收进去：菜单列出全部入口，一行一个开关，两个方向的切换都只要点一下；入口多了能用搜索框筛，一个「全部恢复」把两类键一起清空。底部工具区的按钮也能收，插件入口锁死不可收；选择写进 profile 配置，DSH 重启后照样生效。

description.en: Adds a 24px capsule to the composer status row that plays seven preset internet radio stations, with a live spectrum, now-playing metadata for Nightride FM and Radio Paradise, and remembered volume and station.
description.zh: 在 composer 状态行加一条 24px 胶囊，播放 7 个预置网络电台；带实时频谱、Nightride FM 与 Radio Paradise 的当前曲目，并记住音量和上次电台。

description.en: Pops the DSH side chat into a frameless, always-on-top Windows desktop window that can sit over any other application, with its own settings page for appearance, pinning, remembered geometry, opacity, ephemeral threads and cache cleanup.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的侧边对话弹成一个无边框、可置顶的 Windows 独立浮窗，可覆盖在其他应用之上；自带设置页，可调外观、置顶、记忆窗口几何、不透明度、即用即焚与缓存清理。

plugins.name: dsh-ssh-tui

description.en: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection (resume it from the log).
description.zh: 跳板机与高延迟 SSH 上的 DeepSeek Harness 终端：纯 ANSI、增量重绘；SSH 掉线后会话不丢，可用 --resume 接回。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Johari cognition-quadrant dialog prompt composer — adds a button above the composer that opens a 2×2 quadrant panel (known/unknown × AI-known/AI-unknown) to groom conversation context into a structured prompt written back into the draft.
description.zh: 乔哈里认知四象限对话梳理工具——在输入框上方添加按钮，弹出 2×2 象限面板（我知道/不知道 × AI知道/不知道），将对话上下文梳理为结构化 Prompt 并写回输入框。

description.en: Preview local HTML in the right sidebar, annotate elements or regions, and send the selections with current and target styles into the current session.
description.zh: 在右侧栏预览本地 HTML，点选元素或框选区域写批注，把选中项、当前样式与目标样式一起发进当前会话。

description.en: Adds a circular restart button to the session header, plus an optional app.asar patch that also puts a Restart row in the tray menu.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏加一枚圆形重启按钮；配合可选的 app.asar 等长补丁，还能在托盘菜单加一项「重启」，先结束进程再把应用拉起来。

description.en: Small DeepSeek Harness affordances for everyday actions — locate the current session from the sidebar header (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+D), copy a session ID from the session row menu (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C), open links in the system default program including localhost, open or copy inline code from a context menu, open changed-file cards with a local IDE or reveal them in the file manager, swap Enter with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, recall sent messages with Up/Down, and show the current workspace name inside the header open button; every one of them has its own switch in a Flow settings page.
description.zh: DSH 的一组小改动，把日常动作改回直觉——侧栏标题行的定位当前会话按钮（⇧⌘D）、会话行菜单里的复制会话 ID（⇧⌘C）、链接交给系统默认程序打开（含 localhost）、行内代码的打开或复制右键菜单、改动文件卡片用本机 IDE 打开或在文件管理器中显示、Enter 与 ⌘/Ctrl+Enter 对调、↑↓ 回填发过的消息，以及把当前工作区名写进标题行「打开」按钮；每一项在设置的「心流」页各有一个开关。

description.en: Auto-hide a sidebar workspace the moment its last unarchived session is archived, and add a "隐藏工作区" entry to each workspace row's own "..." menu. The restore entry sits at the bottom of the sidebar. It only toggles display and never archives, deletes or rewrites a workspace.
description.zh: 某个工作区的未归档会话从 1+ 掉到 0 的那一刻自动隐藏它的侧栏行，并在工作区行自带的「…」菜单里追加「隐藏工作区」，另配侧栏底部恢复入口。只切 display，不归档、不删除、不改写任何工作区。

description.en: Workspace-free chats that promote real files into their own project workspace - a maintained fork of dsh-scratchpad, kept working on current DSH.
description.zh: 免工作区自由对话，产物自动提升为独立项目工作区；dsh-scratchpad 的持续维护 fork，跟当前 DSH 保持可用。

description.en: Search inside the New-Session workspace picker: pinyin initials and full pinyin spelling for Chinese titles, substring matching anywhere for English titles, and separator-insensitive matching.
description.zh: 在「新建会话」的工作区下拉里直接搜索：中文支持拼音首字母与全拼，英文支持任意位置子串与忽略分隔符匹配。

description.en: Hides the built-in DSH Desktop update badge (the download-arrow "新版本" pill beside the account button): a CSS rule for the current build plus accessible-label matching with a throttled MutationObserver, so it keeps working after a DSH upgrade. Update checking, the manual "Check for updates" menu item and the connection indicator are untouched.
description.zh: 隐藏 DSH 桌面版自带的更新角标（账号按钮右边那颗「下载箭头 + 新版本」胶囊）：当前构建用一条 CSS 规则压掉，再叠一层按无障碍标签识别 + 节流 MutationObserver 的兜底，宿主升级后仍大概率有效；更新检查、菜单里的「检查更新」和连接指示器都不受影响。

description.en: Save reusable prompt snippets with categories and {{placeholders}}; manage them with /snippet commands (add, list, rm, optimize) and insert into the composer from a draggable dock panel, with one-click AI refinement through the default model.
description.zh: 保存带分类与 {{占位符}} 的可复用提示词片段：用 /snippet 命令（add/list/rm/optimize）管理，从输入框下方可拖拽面板一键插入草稿，并支持用默认模型一键 AI 优化。

description.en: Adds a Teams sidebar dashboard that lists every Agent Teams chat with its roster and task roadmap, token spend in USD and RUB, work and online time, and an archive of older teams. Requires the Agent Teams plugin.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加一个「团队」面板，列出每个 Agent Teams 会话的成员与任务路线图、按时间段统计的 token 消耗与美元/卢布成本、总工时与在线时长，并可归档旧团队。需先安装 Agent Teams 插件。

description.en: Multi-window wall for the DSH Web UI: run and monitor N conversations side-by-side in one screen, with auto-discovery, per-window controls, and an authenticated LAN gateway for phone/tablet access.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面里并排运行、监控多个对话实例：多窗口墙 + 自动发现 + 单窗控制，内置带口令认证的局域网网关，手机/平板也能看。

description.en: A newspaper-style front page for a session you left running, as a Conversation View tab beside Chat and Trajectory: a per-turn timeline (duration, steps, tools, tokens, outcome), file churn counted per file, where the wall clock went and how much of it was the model rather than tools, which single turn ate the spend, failures nobody retried quoted with their failing command, and a context-pressure gauge measured against the routed model's own declared capacity. The briefing is folded from the durable session log and never generated by a model, so it costs no tokens, cannot hallucinate, and is byte-identical for the same log and clock; it appends nothing to the session and reaches no model, and it reports a pending approval without ever answering it. Pages are offered only when they have content, and the tab refreshes itself on turn settle and on a two-speed poll backed by a metadata-only tail probe.
description.zh: 把跑着的会话排成一张报纸式头版，作为 Chat 与 Trajectory 旁的 Conversation View 标签页：逐轮时间线（耗时、步数、工具、token、结果）、按文件统计的改动热度、墙钟时间去向以及其中多少是模型而非工具、哪一轮吃掉了花费、无人重试的失败（附失败命令），以及对照该路由模型自报容量的上下文压力仪表。简报由持久会话日志折算而成、从不调用模型：零 token、不会编造、同一份日志与时钟下字节一致；不向会话追加任何内容、也不触达模型，只报告待批准项而绝不代为应答。仅在某一页有内容时才提供该页；标签页在轮次结束时自刷新，并用只读日志尾部的探针做两档轮询。

description.en: Reorder the messages queued while a DSH agent is busy, from inside the official queue dock: a drag handle and per-row ↑ / ↓ buttons on the dock's own rows, applied on the host as one concurrency-checked inbox splice. The dock is decorated rather than replaced, so previews, inline editing, steering, removal and attachments stay as shipped. A move is refused when the queue has changed since the caller last saw it, when the row is not a user prompt (a goal round prompt, for example), or when the queue belongs to a subagent session.
description.zh: 在官方队列 dock 内直接重排忙碌时排队的消息：每一行带拖拽手柄与上下移动按钮，移动在宿主端以一次带并发校验的 inbox splice 完成。只装饰官方 dock 而不替换它，因此预览、行内编辑、插话、删除与附件保持原样。队列已变化、该行不是用户消息（例如目标轮次提示）、或队列属于子代理会话时，移动会被拒绝。

description.en: Right-panel system for the dsh web GUI: a pixel-faithful AionUi Explorer + Preview (file tree, diff view, preview).
description.zh: dsh web GUI 右侧面板系统：像素级还原 AionUi 的资源树 + 预览（文件树、差异视图、预览）。

description.en: LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset.
description.zh: dsh web GUI 的梁神 agent 预设：两阶段锚定标准预设。

description.en: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar entry plus a multi-column kanban view with local persistence.
description.zh: dsh web GUI 任务看板：侧边栏入口 + 多列看板视图，本地持久化。

description.en: Web UI plugin group card in the dsh settings page: enable switches and config for the dsh-web-ui family.
description.zh: dsh 设置页的 Web UI 插件组卡片：dsh-web-ui 全家插件的开关与配置。

description.en: Renders installed DSH plugin titles and descriptions in Simplified Chinese: at startup it translates the plugins the local JSON cache lacks through the harness LLM service, then projects { en, zh } metadata for resolveText() to render — no DOM changes, no third-party API.
description.zh: 把已安装插件的显示名与描述变成简体中文：启动时用 DSH 自带的模型服务翻译缓存尚未收录的插件，再投影 { en, zh } 元数据供 resolveText() 渲染——不改 DOM，也不调用第三方 API。

description.en: Adds a button beside the composer and a global hotkey palette (default mod+shift+k) that hand one-off questions to a web chat instead of into the harness context: the draft is lifted out of the composer, copied to the clipboard and opened in the templated URL. Ships target-site presets (DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, 豆包, 腾讯元宝, GLM, Gemini), a local question history that can be re-opened, copied, or inserted back into the composer, and a settings tab for site, URL template, hotkey, clipboard and history.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个按钮，并提供全局快捷键（默认 mod+shift+k）浮层，把一次性的小问题交给网页版对话而不是送进 harness 上下文：草稿会从输入框取出、复制到剪贴板并打开模板 URL。内置目标站点预设（DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen、豆包、腾讯元宝、GLM、Gemini），带本地问题历史（可重新打开、复制或回填到输入框），以及设置页（站点、URL 模板、快捷键、剪贴板、历史）。

description.en: Real-time inspector of the files the agent reads and edits, with a file tree, in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: M/A/R badges, side-by-side diffs and live agent activity tracking.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏实时文件变更检查器与文件树：根据智能体的读/写/编辑调用显示 M/A/R 标记与并排 diff，实时追踪智能体活动。

description.en: Adds a refresh button and a power menu (restart / close DeepSeek Harness) to the conversation header. Client-only, zero tokens, no dependencies. The power menu is Windows-only.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话头部加一个刷新按钮和一个电源菜单（重启 / 关闭 DeepSeek Harness）。纯客户端、零 token、零依赖。电源菜单目前仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Browse 90 prompt methods with usage guidance and sources, insert a selected requirement, or compare and edit a full rewrite before applying it in the DSH composer.
description.zh: 提供90张含适用说明和参考来源的方法卡，可插入一条补充要求，或对照原稿编辑整段候选后采用。

description.en: Opens chat.deepseek.com in the right sidebar pane from one row in the left sidebar, leaves the current conversation untouched, expands to fullscreen on demand, and shares the sidebar browser cookie jar; a bundled script makes the login survive restarts. Desktop (Electron) only; keeping the login across restarts needs the bundled PowerShell patch, which is Windows-only and must be re-applied after every DSH upgrade.
description.zh: 左侧栏一行把 chat.deepseek.com 开进右侧栏标签页，不影响当前对话，可随时全屏；与侧边栏浏览器共用同一 cookie 分区，附带脚本让登录跨重启保留。仅限桌面版（Electron）；跨重启保留登录需运行自带的 PowerShell 补丁，该补丁仅支持 Windows，且每次升级 DSH 后都要重跑。

description.en: Region screenshot for the composer on Windows: a full-virtual-screen selector frames the region (drag the frame, eight grips, Ctrl+drag to annotate), and the finished PNG lands in the composer as a pending attachment.
description.zh: Windows 上的区域截图：全虚拟屏选择器框选区域（拖动边框、八个手柄、Ctrl 拖动标注），完成后的 PNG 作为待发附件落进输入框。

description.en: All-in-one UI enhancement layer for DeepSeek Harness web: prompt library with quick-insert and management, two-step AI polish, predicted-reply dock with click-to-send, MCP tool management, scheduled automation, smart session titles, adjustable chat width, full-width AI messages without gray background, auto-collapse for long user messages with smooth expand/collapse animations, and scene-specific entrance animations across all plugin surfaces.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 一站式界面增强：提示词库（快选+管理）、两步 AI 润色、预测回复栏（点击直接发送）、MCP 工具管理、定时自动化、智能会话标题、对话宽度可调、AI 回复占满无灰底、超长用户消息自动折叠（带平滑展开/收起动效），以及各面板的场景化入场动效。

description.en: Shows the current conversation's working directory in a draggable directory panel with adjustable opacity.
description.zh: 在可拖动、透明度可调的目录面板中显示当前对话的工作目录与文件列表。

description.en: Adds a Continue button left of the model selector: after a turn ends aborted by the user, interrupted by a crash or errored, one click sends notices asking the model to pick that turn back up, and the button collapses while you type or attach a file.
description.zh: 在模型选择器左侧加一个「继续」按钮：上一轮被用户中止、崩溃中断或报错结束后，点一下让模型接着把那一轮做完；开始输入或添加附件时按钮收窄隐藏。

description.en: Writes the harness agent live state (thinking, working, waiting, done, error) to a state file that a bundled Electron Live2D desktop pet polls, so the pet bubble and face follow what the agent is doing.
description.zh: 把 harness agent 的实时状态（思考、干活、等待、完成、出错）写入状态文件，配套的 Electron Live2D 桌宠轮询该文件，气泡与表情随 agent 的实际动作变化。

description.en: Your real Obsidian vault in the DSH right Sidebar: vault tree, full-vault search, read-view typography, wikilinks and heading anchors, properties, backlinks, highlights, in-place editing, an outline, and a right-click menu for handoff, rename and .trash.
description.zh: 把你真实的 Obsidian 知识库放进 DSH 右侧栏：目录树、全库搜索、阅读视图排版、双向链接与标题锚点、属性区、关系图谱、高亮、就地编辑、大纲，以及右键菜单（引入对话、重命名、移到 .trash）。
