description.en: WeChat-style in-app screenshot button: drag a region, fine-tune with 8 resize handles, Enter to capture and Esc to cancel; auto-numbered PNGs plus a \[Shot N HH:mm] marker written into the composer. Windows-only, tested on DeepSeek Harness Desktop.
description.zh: 微信式界面内截屏按钮：拖动框选、8 个手柄微调，Enter 确认截取、Esc 取消；PNG 自动编号保存，\[Shot N HH:mm] 标记自动写入输入框。仅 Windows，已在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 实测。

description.en: User message jump bar for the DSH web GUI: a minimap-style dash strip on the right edge of the conversation, with hover preview, click-to-jump, drag-to-scrub and a viewport marker.
description.zh: DSH Web 用户消息跳转条：对话区右缘 minimap 式横杠条带，悬停预览消息内容、点击跳转置顶、拖拽快速浏览，并带当前视口标记。

description.en: ⭐ Drag-and-drop uploads of any file or whole folders, anywhere in the window; remote-safe — bytes go straight into the session workspace on the server, so a DSH deployed on a remote machine works exactly like localhost.
description.zh: ⭐ 支持拖拽上传：任意文件、整个文件夹，拖到窗口任意位置即可；支持远程上传——字节直传服务器的会话工作区，部署在服务器上的 DSH 也能像本地一样拖了就发。

description.en: Right-click menu for file links in chat: open with registered apps, save as, copy path or content, reveal in Finder or Explorer.
description.zh: 聊天区文件超链接右键上下文菜单增强：在常用应用中打开、打开方式、另存为、复制路径与内容、在资源管理器/Finder 中显示。

description.en: Select response text or code to ask contextual follow-ups with streaming replies in a native sidebar.
description.zh: 选中回答里的文字或代码，在原生侧边栏中结合上下文实时追问。

description.en: Draggable weather bar in the shell overlay with forecast and geocoding from Open-Meteo; the position persists across sessions.
description.zh: shell 浮层中的可拖动天气条，预报与地理编码来自 Open-Meteo；位置跨会话持久保存。

description.en: Local file manager served by the DSH web server itself: whole-disk browsing, previews for images, PDF, video and audio, text, Markdown, JSON, CSV, sandboxed HTML, docx and xlsx, Range downloads, folder ZIP, drag-and-drop upload, copy/paste, conflict-checked text editing, create/rename/delete-to-trash, and xlsx cell editing saved as a copy.
description.zh: 由 DSH web server 直接提供的本地文件管理页：整盘浏览，图片/PDF/音视频/文本/Markdown/JSON/CSV/沙箱 HTML/docx/xlsx 预览，Range 下载与目录 ZIP，拖拽上传、复制粘贴、带冲突检测的文本编辑、新建/重命名/删除（进回收目录），以及 xlsx 单元格编辑另存为副本。

description.en: Visual design studio for websites, app prototypes, posters, cards, reports, and magazines, with templates, direct element editing, selection-aware AI draft handoff, and export.
description.zh: 可视化设计工作室，支持网站、App 原型、海报、信息卡、报告和杂志的模板创建、元素编辑、选区级 AI 草稿衔接与导出。

plugins.name: deepseek-design#deepseek-ivideo

description.en: Visual video studio with an editable timeline, animation and media controls, 27 templates, whole-video and selection-aware AI draft handoff, validation, preview, and export.
description.zh: 可视化视频工作室，支持可编辑时间线、动画和素材控制、27 个模板、整段与选区级 AI 草稿衔接、校验、预览和导出。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to selected text in the Harness Web UI that replaces it with a Simplified Chinese translation in place, and restores the original on a second right-click.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 中为选中文字添加右键翻译菜单，可就地替换为简体中文译文，再次右键还原原文。

description.en: Puts Grok Bot's own face in the DSH sidebar session list: each row's status dot becomes a living GrokBot avatar whose six motions read as idle, working, waiting, blocked, thinking and done — color marks the project, motion marks the state.
description.zh: 把 Grok Bot 本人那张脸装进 DSH 侧栏会话列表：每行的状态圆点变成会动的 GrokBot 头像，六种动作分别对应空闲、处理中、等待、已阻止、思考与完成——颜色标记项目，动作标记状态。

description.en: A status bar in the composer footer showing the current phase, how long it has been running, the current step token count and a no-progress warning, projected from session logs without polling the host, plus a detail panel that opens on click.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前阶段、阶段已耗时、本步 token 数与无进展告警的状态条（纯日志投影，不轮询宿主），点击可展开详情面板。

description.en: PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment lighting, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe); scalar channels shown as grayscale per PBR spec, via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.
description.zh: 游戏美术 PBR 3D 模型预览：GLB/GLTF 带贴图纹理、IBL 环境光照、轨道控制，以及材质通道检查器（基础色/法线/粗糙度/金属度/AO/自发光/线框），标量通道按 PBR 规范以灰度显示，通过 pbr3d 围栏与 pbr_render 工具使用。

description.en: Send by dragging instead of clicking. Press the composer and pull up to arm the gesture; releasing sends, dragging back into the composer cancels, and dragging outside the conversation area cancels on the spot. Mouse and pen only.
description.zh: 用拖拽代替点击发送。按住输入框向上拉即武装：松手发送，拖回输入框取消，拖出对话区当场取消。仅响应鼠标与笔。

description.en: Button beside the composer that rewrites the current draft into a more executable prompt in place. Ships four built-in presets spanning light polish to aggressive expansion, accepts user-defined presets, and switches preset, prompt model and reasoning effort directly from the button without leaving the composer. The button appears only when the draft has content, shows a running timer while enhancing, and surfaces failures with a retry.
description.zh: 输入框旁的按钮：把当前草稿原地改写成更可执行的提示词。内置四档预设，从轻润色到激进扩写，并支持自定义预设；预设、提示词模型与思考强度都能直接在按钮上切换，不用离开输入框。草稿有内容时按钮才出现，增强期间在按钮上计时，失败会显示原因并可重试。

description.en: Input experience enhancement: voice input, AI polish, anti-overwrite, prompt optimization with diff preview, and auto locale switching following DSH UI language.
description.zh: 输入体验增强插件，目前已实现语音输入、AI提示词润色（反覆盖保护、带差异预览的提示词优化）、跟随 DSH 界面语言自动切换中英文界面。

description.en: Draws workspaces and conversations as a 3D star map in the stock panel slot: eight layouts (spiral, rings, armillary sphere, solar system, double helix, irregular web, cubic lattice, radial tree), eight colour themes, a memory-library map of instruction files, skills and skill calls, star-to-star fly-throughs, and a 中/EN switch. Links are drawn only where a workspace owns a conversation or one conversation descends from another.
description.zh: 把工作区与对话画成三维星空，占住原版面板槽位：八种布局（螺旋、星环、浑天仪球、太阳系、双螺旋、不规则星团、立体方阵、中心放射星树）、八套配色主题、一张把指令文件/技能/调用记录画成环的记忆库图、星体间飞行，以及中/EN 切换。连线只画真实的从属关系：工作区→对话，以及父→子。

description.en: A customizable video splash screen plugin for DSH. Replace the default startup with your own local video.
description.zh: 一个为 DSH 打造的自定义视频开屏插件，支持播放你自己的本地视频，完美兼容桌面端。

description.en: Adds the dshmarket plugin market to the DSH sidebar as a panel of its own, ordered above the built-in Plugins entry. Clicking the entry renders the market through the client service dshmarket publishes for hosts, so the catalog, category filters, comments and install and update flows are the ones dshmarket ships rather than a copy of them. Nothing to learn or configure: the panel is the market, with its own sidebar entry, label in Chinese or English to match the interface language, and icon. If dshmarket is not loaded the panel says so instead of failing client composition, and its locale keys, slots and style tag are released when the plugin unloads.
description.zh: 把 dshmarket 插件市场作为独立面板放进 DSH 侧边栏，排在「插件」之上。点击即通过 dshmarket 对外发布的 host 端 client service 渲染市场本身，因此目录、分类筛选、评论与安装/更新流程都是 dshmarket 自己的，而不是一份副本。无需学习或配置：这个面板就是市场，有自己的侧边栏条目、跟随界面语言的中英文名与图标。dshmarket 未加载时面板会明说，而不是让客户端组装失败；插件卸载时其语言键、插槽与 style 标签一并释放。

description.en: A small pet in the corner of the interface that reads the real event stream instead of guessing: it drifts when idle, speeds up while the agent is thinking, draws a flowing line per running tool call, turns red and shakes with the error summary on a failure, and celebrates a turn that ran longer than ten seconds. The same widget is the at-a-glance busy and error indicator, so there is no spinner to stare at. The host half folds real harness events into a snapshot and the client half only draws it; it performs no content recognition, and it positions itself away from the composer so it never sits over what you are typing.
description.zh: 界面角落里的一只小宠物，读的是真实事件流而不是猜：空闲时慢慢飘，agent 思考时动得更快，每个正在运行的工具调用拉一条流动的连线，出错时变红、抖一下并显示错误摘要，跑超过十秒的回合结束时庆祝。它同时就是那个一眼可见的忙碌/出错指示器，不用再盯着转圈。宿主半区把真实 harness 事件折叠成快照，客户端半区只负责画；它不做内容识别，并且会主动避开输入框，不会趴在你正在打字的地方。

description.en: Adds a full-screen dialog for writing long messages: Markdown on the left rendered live by marked on the right, with a draggable splitter that remembers its ratio. Confirming writes the text back to the composer draft, keeping command tokens and @-reference chips as a fixed prefix; Esc asks whether to discard or write back before closing.
description.zh: 为输入框加一个写长内容的全屏弹窗：左侧写 Markdown、右侧 marked 实时渲染，中间分栏可拖动并记住比例。确认后写回输入框草稿，指令 token 与 @ 引用 chip 作为固定前缀保留；Esc 关闭前询问「不写回」还是「写回」。

description.en: Left-edge conversation rail for the Web UI: one bar per turn, length scaled to the turn text, hover for a question and answer preview, click to jump; bars come from a host-side outline of the whole session log, so turns outside the loaded window are drawn too and history is paged in on click.
description.zh: 对话左缘的导航轨：一根杠一轮对话，杠长按该轮文字体量，悬停出提问与回答预览，点击跳转；杠来自 host 侧读整份会话日志折出的大纲，未加载进窗口的轮次也画得出来，点击时再翻页补历史。

description.en: All-in-one UI plugin for DSH Desktop (Windows): conversation-width slider with fullscreen preview and follow-window mode, thinking-block enhancements (forced Chinese, expand/collapse, Markdown rendering), an Open With header button, UI label localization, a resizable settings dialog, session delete, and workspace tabs.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版多功能 UI 插件：对话宽度滑块（按下全屏预览、跟随窗口宽度）、思考块增强（思考/回复强制中文、展开收起、Markdown 渲染）、Open With 头部打开按钮、界面英文标签中文化、设置弹窗窗口化、会话删除与工作区分页。

description.en: macOS desk pet forked from anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet, in a real always-on-top window that covers fullscreen Spaces: the pose follows whatever the local DSH is doing across six states, the right-click menu is a real AppKit one carrying quiet mode and a session list, and seven skins ship with it. Two of the seven are drawn from geometry by a script in the repo rather than generated, so making a skin needs no image model and no API credits; the bundled skill still expands one photo into all eighteen poses on your own image tool and credentials. There is no Electron and nothing to install alongside it: the window is driven through ctypes on the Python that ships with macOS.
description.zh: 分叉自 anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet 的 macOS 桌宠，一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住：姿势跟着本地 DSH 在六种状态之间走，右键菜单是真的 AppKit 菜单，里面有免打扰和会话清单，随包带七套皮肤。七套里有两套是仓库中的脚本用几何画出来的，不是生成的，所以做一套皮肤不需要图像模型、也不烧 API 额度；自带的 skill 仍用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片扩写成十八个姿势。没有 Electron，也不用另装任何东西：窗口是用 macOS 自带的那个 Python 经 ctypes 驱动的。

description.en: Tints the strip above the composer green or red to match DeepSeek's off-peak and peak billing windows, shows the remaining time of the current window as a progress bar, and ships six themes plus a custom-CSS hook.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 峰谷计费时段给输入卡上方那条染色（谷绿峰红），以进度条显示当前时段剩余时长，带六套主题与自定义 CSS。

description.en: Closes right-sidebar tabs with a middle click or a left double click, reusing the built-in close button so the native rules (such as the last docked guide card being unclosable) still apply.
description.zh: 右侧栏标签页支持鼠标中键关闭与左键双击关闭，关闭动作复用原生 × 按钮，原生规则（例如唯一停靠的 guide 卡片关不掉）保持不变。

description.en: Adds two UI surfaces: a composer image editor (numbered marks with per-mark instructions, background removal, brush-mask erase, resize with crop/padding preview, keyboard-accessible markers; results return as attachments plus a version-1 manifest) and a Settings → vision/generation provider panel (explicit provider picker, providerId normalization, ChatGPT-web accounts synced into channels, per-channel test/try-run/copy-command, script readiness scan, save validation with .env preview, probing that only disables on explicit quota errors, Chinese/English UI) that writes providers back to the skills .env files.
description.zh: 为 img2img-studio 提供两个界面：① 输入框上方的图片编辑器（编号标记 + 每处改法、纯色背景移除、涂抹掩码擦除、比例与尺寸调整（含裁切/留白预览）、标记键盘微调，结果以附件 + version 1 manifest 回填输入框）；② 设置页「识图与生图」供应商面板（显式选择供应商、providerId 归一化、ChatGPT 网页账号库同步为通道、每通道测试/试跑/复制命令、脚本就绪扫描、保存校验与 .env 预览、只对明确欠费码自动关停、中英双语），保存后写回两个 skill 的 .env。

description.en: Replaces the model button with a Claude Desktop-style model and reasoning-effort switcher, with per-model effort memory, theme-aware styling, smooth slider feel, rounded track, hover highlight, and pixel-dot animation.
description.zh: 将模型按钮替换为Claude Desktop 同款风格的模型与思考力度切换器，支持逐模型记忆力度、主题自适应，滑动手感、圆角轨道、悬停高亮，点阵动画，都是熟悉的味道。

description.en: OLED burn-in care for the Web GUI with pure-black surfaces, gamma-aware text dimming on an idle/focus ladder, a true-black nap screensaver with live agent status, and slow accent-hue rotation.
description.zh: Web GUI 的 OLED 烧屏防护：纯黑底色、按空闲/聚焦档位做伽马感知的文字调暗、带实时 agent 状态的纯黑小憩屏保，以及缓慢轮转的强调色。

description.en: A file editor in the DSH web GUI right sidebar: open any text file, edit it, and save in place, with a version gate on every save — if the file changed on disk during the edit it stops and asks instead of overwriting. The document preview gains an edit button and a two-step delete button, and a separate File editor sidebar tool brings its own file tree for create, rename or move, copy, cut and paste (including a file taken from the system clipboard), delete and drag to reorganize. Two renderer bands cover 107 plain-text, config and source extensions; the second is offered only as an open-with choice, leaving the shipped Markdown and highlighted-code views as the default. All mutations run through the plugin's own trusted host routes, behind the connection trust fence, the workspace containment check and the sandbox policy.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧栏的文件编辑器：打开任意文本文件即可编辑并原地保存，每次保存都带版本闸——编辑期间磁盘上的文件被改过就停下来问，不静默覆盖。文档预览多出「编辑」按钮和两步确认的「删除」按钮；另有一个「文件编辑」侧栏工具，自带文件树：新建、改名 / 移动、复制、剪切 / 粘贴（含把系统剪贴板里的文件粘进工作区）、删除、拖拽整理。两档文档渲染器共覆盖 107 个纯文本、配置与源码扩展名，其中第二档只作为「打开方式」出现，官方 Markdown 排版与代码高亮仍是默认视图。所有变更都走插件自己的 Host 路由，过连接信任围栏、工作区包含性检查与沙箱策略三道闸。

description.en: Enlarges the DSH web settings dialog (default 1180x920, 20px steps, remembered per browser) and adds an Advanced Settings page that resizes it and hosts Host operations: restart dsh with a 3-second delay and a busy confirmation, restart once all sessions have been idle for 10s (cancellable, repeat clicks idempotent), last start time with uptime, and a dsh version/update check that compares npm dist-tags across selectable channels without upgrading. The same bundle replaces the sidebar brand area with a machine name, adds a read-only provider, model and thinking-level cell beside the composer stats pills, and a switch that registers or unregisters the three dsh_restart_* agent tools at runtime. Zero dependencies, no build step; all routes sit behind the connection trust fence.
description.zh: 放大 DSH Web 设置弹窗（默认 1180×920，20px 一档，只记本浏览器），并新增「设置 → 高级设置」页：同一页调尺寸，也收进 Host 运维——延迟 3 秒重启 dsh（忙时二次确认）、所有会话空闲 10 秒后自动重启（可取消、重复点击幂等）、最后启动时间与已运行时长，以及按所选 npm dist-tag 通道比较的 dsh 版本/更新提示（只提示、不代升级）。同一插件还用机器名字顶替侧栏品牌区、在输入框下方「性能与用量」行旁加一格只读的「供应商 · 模型 · 思考档位」，并提供一个即时注册/注销三个 dsh_restart_* 模型工具的开关。零依赖、无构建；所有路由都过官方信任围栏。

description.en: Adds a Restart row to the desktop app's sidebar foot beside Settings that restarts the app and reloads the page onto the newly installed plugin bundle.
description.zh: 在桌面版侧边栏底部、「设置」旁边新增一个「重启」按钮，重启应用，并在页面重连后加载到刚安装的插件包。

description.en: Adds a Settings → General row that opens ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md in the system editor, so the instruction file can be opened without hunting for it. On Windows it launches Notepad and raises the window.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」里增加一行，用系统编辑器打开 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md，不必再去文件管理器里翻这个指令文件；Windows 上直接拉起记事本并把窗口提到前台。

description.en: Adds a Windows Explorer folder context-menu entry that registers the folder as a DSH project, with a switch for the menu entry in Settings → General. Windows only, and nothing extra has to be installed.
description.zh: 在 Windows 资源管理器文件夹右键菜单中加入「用 DeepSeek Harness 打开」，点击后把该文件夹登记为 DSH 项目；设置 → 通用 里有一个开关用于添加或移除该菜单项。仅支持 Windows，无需额外安装任何组件。

description.en: Folds Think and tool-call rows into a floating summary pill with red failure counts, for a cleaner writer-friendly chat view.
description.zh: 把 Think / 工具调用等过程行折叠成右下角摘要浮条，失败步骤红色计数，面向文字工作者的干净对话视图。

description.en: AOCI cognition panel for DSH: multi-workspace AOCI overview, per-repo index and governance view, MCP binding diagnosis, and guided or batch initialization. Governance, verification and guided/batch initialization require the external aoci CLI on the host; index browsing works without it.
description.zh: DSH 的 AOCI 认知面板：多工作区总览、单仓库索引与治理视图、MCP 绑定诊断，以及引导式/批量初始化。治理、校验与引导式/批量初始化需宿主机装有 aoci CLI；仅浏览索引不需要。

description.en: Sidebar chip showing the current DeepSeek price period (peak or off-peak), the selected model's price per million tokens for cache hits, cache misses and output, the account balance and today's spend.
description.zh: 侧边栏价格小挂件：显示当前 DeepSeek 时段（高峰或空闲）、所选模型每百万 token 的缓存命中、未命中与输出价格，以及账户余额和今日消费。

description.en: Generative, interactive UI for DeepSeek Harness: the agent picks per reply between 26 validated native components and sandboxed streaming HTML widgets, patches a rendered UI in place by component ID, restores tabs, sorts, filters and form values after a reload, and computes slider and filter changes in the browser without another model call.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供生成式交互界面：模型每次回答自行在 26 个校验过的原生组件与沙箱流式 HTML widget 之间选择，可按组件 ID 就地修补已渲染的界面，标签页、排序、筛选与表单值在刷新后恢复，滑块与筛选的重算在浏览器本地完成，不回调模型。

description.en: A floating panel that lights up which HowNet semantic primitives the current answer touches, as a brain-shaped node graph, EEG-style channel traces and a composition card.
description.zh: 悬浮面板：把当前这段回答点亮了哪些 HowNet 语义基元实时画出来——脑形节点网络、脑电样式的多导联曲线、构成指纹卡。

description.en: Right-click menus for the DSH Web UI — copy, cut, paste and select all on text and input areas, plus copy path, reveal in the file manager and open with the default app on file references and links.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面补上右键菜单：文字与输入框可复制/剪切/粘贴/全选，文件引用与链接可复制路径、在文件管理器中定位、用默认应用打开。

description.en: Manually zoom the Harness Web UI from 75% to 200% via a Settings row, Ctrl+wheel, or a Session-header control, keeping text crisp and readable on high-DPI displays.
description.zh: 在高 DPI 显示器上手动缩放 Harness Web UI（75%–200%）：设置行、Ctrl+滚轮与会话标题栏控件三种入口，让文字更清晰易读。

description.en: A Claude Desktop-inspired composer slider for adjusting model reasoning effort with click, drag, or keyboard controls.
description.zh: 借鉴 Claude Desktop 的思考强度滑块，在输入框中通过点击、拖拽或键盘调整模型推理档位。

description.en: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from the client controllers rather than the DOM, and yielding the keys back to the composer while a draft is being edited.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的方向键导航：上/下在当前工作区内切换会话，左/右切换工作区；会话身份来自客户端控制器而非 DOM；输入框存在草稿时把方向键交还给光标。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed: no eval, no bundler, no sandbox iframe), with a file-viewer takeover for `.tsx` and a bundled Skill for authoring the format.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把 Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` 静态解析为结构化页面渲染在右侧栏（不执行源码，无 eval / bundler / 沙箱 iframe），并附带 `.tsx` 文件查看器接管与一个教 LLM 写该格式的 Skill。

description.en: Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: Turns large text pastes into pastes/*.txt attachments with a dock above the composer and a minimal, recognisable badge in the draft.
description.zh: 大段文本粘贴自动存为 pastes/*.txt 附件,输入框上方 dock 卡片管理,草稿内只留可辨识的最小徽标。

description.en: Folds the sidebar's add-on panel rows (schedules, agent teams, plugin market, context pages, …) under the shipped "More" row: a 28x28 chevron toggle on that row collapses them into a single header line and expands them back, the fold state persists per window, the rows kept visible are chosen with per-row switches read from the live sidebar, and each managed row's icon + label can be aligned left, centre or right. Client-only plugin: adds DOM, patches no host bundle, and uninstalls back to the shipped sidebar. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 exactly; other versions install but stay inert.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的加项面板行（自动化任务、agent 团队、插件市场、上下文页等）收进宿主「更多」行：在该行挂一个 28x28 箭头按钮，点一下把它们收成一行、再点复原；折叠状态按窗口持久化，保持可见的行用逐行开关从当前侧边栏实时枚举后选择，被管理行的图标与文字还能切换左/中/右对齐。纯 client 插件：只新增 DOM，不打宿主补丁，卸载后恢复原样。仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3，其它版本装上也不会生效。

description.en: Honest merge of two community plugins into one calmer display: the streaming reading view from dsh-better-display (fork) and the message rail from dsh-tidychat. For theme lovers it wraps reasoning prose and tool-call output in translucent message bubbles, so text no longer sits directly on busy wallpapers or skins where it is hard to read. Cross-version rc adaptation attempted across DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 (all rc); no obvious problems so far.
description.zh: 诚实说明：将两个社区插件合并为一个更安静的显示层——流式阅读视图来自 dsh-better-display（fork），消息轨道来自 dsh-tidychat。为主题爱好者把思考正文与工具调用输出包裹进半透明消息泡泡框，避免文字直接铺在复杂壁纸或皮肤上难以分辨。已在 DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 各 rc 版本间尝试跨版本适配，目前无明显问题。

description.en: Plugin-tree terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness — streaming markdown transcript, tool cards, fuzzy slash commands, and live theming, with every component a hot-swappable Cordis plugin.
description.zh: 插件树式终端界面：流式 markdown 会话流、工具卡片、模糊命令补全与主题热切换，每个界面组件都是可热替换的 Cordis 插件。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强插件：工作区一键打开（复制路径、访达显示、自动发现编辑器打开）、用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、单列表增强与硬性重启按钮。

description.en: Aggregated status badges on collapsed sidebar groups in DSH: a folded folder row shows in-progress / awaiting-approval / done / scheduled / review-pending counts, with numbers and hover detail. (sidebar badge / group status / aggregate)
description.zh: DSH 侧栏折叠分组聚合徽标：收起的文件夹行显示进行中/待审批/已完成/定时任务/等待评审的聚合状态，带数字与悬停明细。（侧栏徽标 / 分组状态 / 聚合）

description.en: Input prediction for the DSH composer: your next prompt suggested as ghost text after each turn, accepted with Tab. (autocomplete / input prediction / prompt suggestion)
description.zh: 给 DSH 输入框加上输入预测：回合结束后自动建议你的下一句话，Tab 一键采纳；输入时按会话历史做前缀补全。（输入预测 / 自动补全 / 提示词建议 / 补全）

description.en: Adds a one-click prompt optimization button to the DSH composer, with undo and an optional dedicated optimizer model.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁添加一键提示词优化按钮，支持撤回，并可在设置中单独指定优化模型。

description.en: Sidebar conversation actions: open the row menu on right-click, rename by double-click, copy the session id, and delete a conversation together with its storage after a confirmation.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话操作：右键打开行菜单、双击重命名、复制会话 ID，以及二次确认后连同存储一起删除会话。

description.en: Adds a prompt-refine button to the DSH composer and, when auto mode is on, refines the prompt before the agent starts by rewriting the text with recent session context through a side-channel model call, asks on the native question card when the rewrite cannot be decided, reports each stage as a command card in the chat, and keeps the original text when analysis fails.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框添加「提示词优化」按钮；开启自动模式后，在助手开始执行前先用旁路模型结合最近会话上下文改写提示词，无法确定改写方式时先用原生提问卡片确认，各阶段以命令卡片在主对话中播报，分析失败时按原文继续。

description.en: Right-click files, folders, web links, and workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness chat and sidebars to reference, copy, preview, open in a chosen app or browser, reveal, or save.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话区和侧边栏右键文件、文件夹、网页链接和工作区：引用、复制、预览、用默认或选择的应用/浏览器打开、定位或另存为。

description.en: Adds a Restart page to the DSH Web settings panel. The page shows the PID, port, start time and uptime of the running host and restarts it through a detached helper that waits until the port stops answering before replaying the same launch invocation; the page reloads itself once the replacement host answers with a new boot id.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置面板里增加一个「重启」页：显示当前宿主的 PID、端口、启动时间与运行时长，重启由分离的 helper 完成——等端口不再应答后再按同一启动命令拉起新进程；替代宿主返回新的 boot id 后页面自动刷新。

description.en: Roll back to before any of your questions or edit the last one and resubmit, with the workspace files of the discarded turns restored.
description.zh: 回退到任意一条提问之前，或编辑上一条问题重新提交；被丢弃轮次产生的工作区文件会一并还原。

plugins.name: dsh-popout-sidebar

description.en: Pop-out sidebar: lists artifacts and a file tree with multiple preview formats, pops out into a separate browser tab you can drag to another monitor, and coexists with other sidebar plugins simultaneously.
description.zh: 可弹出式侧边栏：侧边栏展示产物与文件树，支持多种文件预览形式；并可弹出为独立浏览器标签页（可拖至另一显示器）；兼容其他sidebar插件，可以同时显示。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.xfa.org

description.en: Gacha banner and event schedule lookup for anime games: sidebar button with current banners, events and countdowns for 28 gacha games, with auto-refresh, search, Windows expiry reminders and .ics export.
description.zh: 二游卡池/活动排期速查：侧边栏按钮展示 28 款二游的当期卡池与活动起止，支持自动刷新、搜索、Windows 到期提醒与 .ics 导出。

description.en: Keeps the DSH desktop window the size you left it: records the last outer frame of the main window in physical pixels and restores it, centred on the work area, on the next start - and it acts before the window is ever shown, so the boot animation plays at the right size. The settings page offers 12 presets (1024x768 to 3840x2160), free-form custom width and height, a centre-on-restore switch and an apply-now action; a choice takes effect immediately and persists. Resizing goes through a small helper executable compiled on the user's own machine: the C# source ships inside the plugin, is built on first run with the in-box Windows csc.exe (measured ~110 ms once, cached next to the state file, ~90 ms to start), and falls back to a short-lived powershell.exe process when that is not possible. The package ships no binary, declares no npm dependencies and makes no outbound network request. Windows only.
description.zh: 让 DSH 桌面端窗口保持你离开时的大小：记录主窗口最后一次的外框尺寸（物理像素），下次启动恢复并居中到工作区，而且赶在窗口露面之前改完，启动动画不会播在错误的分辨率上。设置页有 12 个常用分辨率（1024×768 到 3840×2160）、任意自定义宽高、「恢复时居中」开关与「立即应用」，选中即生效并持久化。改尺寸走一个在使用者本机现编的小助手 exe：C# 源码随插件一起发布，首次运行用 Windows 自带的 csc.exe 编一次（实测约 110 毫秒），产物与同名 .cs 缓存到状态文件同目录，之后起进程约 90 毫秒；编不出来时退回临时 powershell.exe 进程。包里不含二进制、package.json 不声明任何依赖、不发任何外部网络请求。仅限 Windows。

description.en: A sticky-notes wall pinned to the sidebar: one click opens a full-page wall, notes save as you type, and writing #tags in the text turns them into one-click filter chips. Six paper colors, pinning, search, JSON export and import.
description.zh: 钉在侧栏的便签墙：一键打开整页墙面，边写边自动保存，正文里写 #标签 就会变成可点击的筛选胶囊。六种纸色、置顶、搜索，支持 JSON 导出与导入。

description.en: Select reply text, edit numbered annotations, and send several with a question using native DSH composer references, draft persistence, and submission; requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later within the 0.2.x series.
description.zh: 选取回复文字、编辑编号批注并随问题一起发送，复用 DSH 原生输入框引用、草稿保存和发送流程；需 DSH 0.2.x 系列中的 0.2.1-rc.2 或更新版本。

description.en: Bring GrokBot into DeepSeek harness.
description.zh: 将GrokBot带入DSH。

description.en: Adds a Run button to shell code blocks in replies, executing the snippet through the host shell service and showing its output in a floating bottom-right dock, or in one bottom-panel tab per run.
description.zh: 为回答里的命令行代码框加「运行」按钮，通过宿主 shell 服务执行该命令，输出显示在右下角浮动面板，或每个运行一个底部面板标签页。

description.en: Smooth think-row experience for the DSH Web UI: think rows expand as a capped 24-line preview that glides to the bottom while reasoning streams, collapse with a short height animation on settle, and the main conversation view follows with a reader-safe smooth chase (no snaps, no yanks).
description.zh: DSH Web 端的丝滑思考盒体验：think 行展开为 24 行限高预览并随流式推理平滑追底，settle 时以短动画收起，主对话视图以读者友好的平滑追逐跟随（无跳变、无拉扯）。

plugins.name: canvas-workbench#canvas-workbench

description.en: Pluggable design canvas inside DSH — standalone Excalidraw board, session image tools (edit, erase, background removal, OCR, vectorize, PSD/text rebuild), project asset library, and a Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ canvas bridge.
description.zh: DSH 内的可插拔设计画布——独立 Excalidraw 画布、会话图片工具（修图、擦除、去背景、OCR、转矢量、PSD/文字重建）、项目素材库，以及 Photoshop/Illustrator ⇄ 画布桥接。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to canvas-workbench.local

description.en: Folds the durable todo and goal events the dsh pet ignores into a percentage bubble on the pet, and falls back to a one-line activity summary for a session that never wrote a todo list. Requires the dsh web pet plugin (@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0).
description.zh: 把 dsh 宠物忽略的 todo 与 goal 事件折成宠物气泡上的百分比进度；会话没有任务列表时退化为一行当前活动摘要。需先安装 dsh web pet 插件（@linxin666/dsh-pet >= 0.4.0）。

description.en: Takes over the model button in the DSH composer and opens its own two-level panel (provider list, then model list with search) built around a continuous draggable reasoning-effort slider: the fill runs blue to violet, higher levels add nebula and dust particles, and every level has its own color. Drag moves one level at a time, and picking a model keeps the panel open and repositions the slider to that model's middle level.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 输入框的官方模型席按钮，点开是自建的两级面板（provider 列表 → 模型列表 + 搜索），核心是一条连续可拖动的推理等级滑条：填充由蓝渐变到紫罗兰，高档位带星云与星尘粒子，一档一色；拖动一档一格，点模型不关面板、滑条立刻落到该模型的中间档。

description.en: Adds a Quick Chat entry to the Web UI sidebar that opens a floating chat window with its own model and reasoning-effort picker, optionally seeded with the current session's transcript, and keeps every side conversation in a resumable, renamable, deletable history.
description.zh: 在侧边栏加入「快速会话」入口，打开一个小窗对话，可切换模型与思考强度、可选携带当前主会话全文，历史可继续、重命名、删除。

description.en: Colors each DSH sidebar session title by state: unread (blue while the model is running, green once it has finished) and pinned (yellow, read from DSH's own pinned set), composed into one left-to-right gradient. Pinning, archiving and ordering stay with DSH itself — the plugin reimplements no pinning and rewrites no official bundle — and a settings section lists every unread session.
description.zh: 按状态给 DSH 侧栏会话标题上色：未读（模型运行中＝蓝、已跑完＝绿）与置顶（黄，读取 DSH 官方置顶集合），两者合成一条从左到右的渐变。置顶、归档与排序由 DSH 官方提供，本插件不重复实现置顶、也不改写官方 bundle；另含列出全部未读会话的设置分节。

description.en: Adds quick installation and switching for workbench templates in DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供工作台模板的快捷安装与切换。

description.en: Interactive terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness: tables, Mermaid and chart rendering, side conversations, and the same Cordis plugin model as dsh Web.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 交互式终端界面：表格、Mermaid 与图表渲染、旁支会话，以及与 dsh Web 相同的 Cordis 插件模型。

description.en: A floating in-conversation find bar docked over the DSH composer (Ctrl/⌘+F or the magnifier beside the input): hits list with a match counter as you type, Enter jumps to the next hit, hovering a hit pops a scrollable full-text card with a one-click copy of the whole message, the up arrow in an empty composer recalls previously sent messages one at a time with their image and file attachments restored as drafts, hovering any image in the conversation shows a copy button that writes it to the clipboard as PNG, and every finished answer gains a regenerate button while the newest also gets continue. Client-side only, searches the messages already loaded in the conversation, and never jumps.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方加一条浮动的会话内查找（Ctrl/⌘+F 或输入框左侧放大镜打开）：输入即列命中并显示计数，回车跳到下一处，悬浮结果在面板侧边浮出可滚动的全文卡片，一键复制整条消息；空输入框按 ↑ 逐条取回发过的消息，图片与文件附件一并还原成草稿；悬浮对话里的任意图片出现【复制图片】，一键以 PNG 写入剪贴板；每条完成的回答下方补上【重新生成】，最新一条另有【继续生成】。纯客户端实现，只搜当前会话已加载的消息，不做跳转。

description.en: Theme skin plugin for DeepSeek Harness — built-in themes / static image / dynamic 360°-follow video, one-click from the sidebar & Settings; imports persist, default skins protected.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主题皮肤插件：内置主题 / 静态图片 / 动态视频（鼠标环绕跟随帧），侧边栏一键切换，设置页完整管理；导入持久化、默认皮肤不可删。

description.en: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with search, EN/ZH toggle and department filter; draggable Canvas 2D pixel characters that stand, type and pace, with idle chat that can plug into AI. One-command npm install, no dsh source changes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 主窗口添加「工作角色」页签 + 像素办公室浮层：内置 508 张角色卡（The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253），支持搜索 / 中英切换 / 分部分类；Canvas 2D 像素小人可站立、打字、踱步，闲聊台词可接 AI。一条命令安装，不改 dsh 源码。

description.en: Adds a sentient floating eye to DeepSeek Harness — injects a taming kernel that makes the AI truly understand you, with 11 dynamic eye skins, ghost mode, and zero token cost when AI mode is off.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上会开智的智子：注入驯兽内核让 AI 真正懂你，11 款动态皮肤、幽灵模式，关闭 AI 模式即零 token 消耗。

plugins.name: dsh_session_folders

description.en: One-level session folders for the web sidebar - group sessions per workspace, move them by drag-and-drop or context menu, archive and restore, server-side persistence.
description.zh: 为网页侧边栏提供单层会话文件夹——按工作区分组会话，支持拖拽或右键菜单移动、归档与恢复，数据在服务端持久化。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Replace the model picker with global search, favorites, recent selections, model-family navigation, and reasoning effort selection.
description.zh: 替换模型选择器，提供全局搜索、收藏、最近使用、模型家族导航与思维强度选择。

plugins.name: dsh-better-left-sidebar

description.en: A clearer DeepSeek Harness sidebar with separate navigation and conversation regions and built-in widgets.
description.zh: 分区更清晰的 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏，内置时钟、余额等小组件。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: One-click native conversations with independent workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键原生对话入口，每次创建独立工作区和会话。

description.en: Shows a Chinese translation under each English thinking block in the DSH web chat, without modifying the session transcript; per-chunk caching, a configurable translation model, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页对话里把每段英文思考的中文译文显示在原文正下方，不改动会话记录；按译文块缓存、可指定翻译模型，并带设置面板。

description.en: Marks models in use by other running sessions in the DSH model menu, and restores the remembered reasoning effort and group collapse state for each model.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的模型菜单看见会话占用、记住模型推理档位与折叠状态。

description.en: Renders every file mutation in the web chat as one collapsed diff card with per-line highlighting — MCP filesystem edit_file/write_file and the built-in edit/write.
description.zh: 把网页对话里的每次文件改动渲染成一张折叠的 diff 卡片并逐行高亮，涵盖 MCP filesystem 的 edit_file/write_file 与内置的 edit/write。

description.en: Plays a character entrance card beside the composer when you switch model: identity name, six scored axes (intelligence, coding, speed, stability, cost, context), quota hint and a dialogue line. 23 curated cards across 15 providers; models without a curated card fall back to a data card derived from public benchmarks, or a generic card when no benchmark data exists. A web client plugin with no dependencies and no hooks.
description.zh: 切换模型时在会话输入框旁播一张角色登场卡：身份名、六轴分数（智力／编码／速度／稳定／性价比／上下文）、额度提示与台词；23 张精选卡覆盖 15 个 provider，库里没有精选卡的模型按公开基准派生数据卡；基准集里也没有分数的则回退为通用卡。web 客户端插件，无依赖、无 hooks。

plugins.name: dsh-tui-pi

description.en: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch — all as pure cordis plugins with zero upstream patches.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全功能 TUI：流式对话、powerline 状态栏、实时思考/工具/待办面板、子代理双视图、主题热切换——全部以纯 cordis 插件实现，不 fork、不 patch 上游一行代码。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

plugins.name: dsh-composer-ux

description.en: Configurable send and newline keys, a composer context menu with three sources (leave it to DSH and other plugins / browser menu / plugin-styled custom menu), a quick-command panel with categorized prompt lists where each prompt can append on every send or only on the first message of a session, a create-and-move row at the bottom of each category, a prompt optimizer that rewrites the draft with a separate model call, settings-panel size memory, and automatic x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode routes. Prompt lists live in a global ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json that is independent of the session and the project.
description.zh: 可配置发送/换行键位、输入框右键菜单三种来源（插件不介入 / 浏览器菜单 / 自定义样式菜单）、带分类的快捷指令面板（每条可设「每次发送都附加」或「仅在本会话第一条消息附加」，并有跨分类移动与新建）、用另一次模型调用把草稿整理成清晰指令的提示词优化、设置面板尺寸记忆，并为 OpenCode 路由自动注入 x-opencode-session 请求头。快捷指令存在全局文件 ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json 里，与会话、项目无关。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A cosmic reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer. Off, Low, High, and Max each have their own starfield and aurora, with smooth cross-fades and real per-session model selection.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 输入框的推理强度滑轨做成一片小宇宙。Off、Low、High、Max 各有专属星场与极光，档位之间平滑过渡，并绑定真实的当前会话模型选择。

description.en: Moves conversation views into the Windows caption row and header utilities into a compact right rail on DSH Desktop with Codex UI, reclaiming a full row of vertical space while preserving the session title, fullscreen control, dynamic status counts and menus.
description.zh: 将会话视图移入 Windows 标题栏、其余顶栏工具压缩进紧凑右轨，在 DSH Desktop 与 Codex UI 中保留会话标题、全屏、动态状态计数与菜单功能，同时省下一整行垂直空间。

description.en: Model quick picker for DeepSeek Harness: a button left of the model dropdown opens a full model-selection dialog with provider grouping, live search, provider filter, capability tags read from the user's own input config, reasoning badges, recent-model shortcuts and a reasoning-effort picker; the choice writes back to the native dropdown immediately.
description.zh: 模型速选器：在模型下拉框左侧添加按钮，弹出全量模型选择窗口（提供商分组、实时搜索、提供商筛选、读取用户配置的真实能力标签、推理徽章、最近使用与推理档位选择器），选中后立即回写原生下拉框并生效。

description.en: Adds a button left of the built-in Open In... in the session header that opens the current workspace directory in VS Code, fixing the desktop ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE environment leak that makes the built-in open-in-app fail with HTTP 502. Windows only: it locates Code.exe, so macOS and Linux are not supported yet.
description.zh: 在会话头部「打开方式」左侧新增按钮，一键在 VS Code 中打开当前工作区目录，修复桌面宿主 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 环境变量泄漏导致内置 open-in-app 启动 VS Code 失败（HTTP 502）的问题。仅支持 Windows：按 Code.exe 路径定位，macOS / Linux 尚未适配。

description.en: Office workspace & session dashboard: a floating 6-column sprite panel visualizing workspaces, sessions, token usage and subagents, plus Agent Mail and an office log tab. Feishu/Lark views (message feed, meeting schedules, transcripts) additionally require the `@larksuite/cli` tool installed and authenticated separately.
description.zh: 办公室工作区/会话仪表盘：悬浮 6 列精灵面板，可视化工作区、会话、token 用量与子代理，并提供 Agent Mail 与办公日志页签。飞书相关视图（消息流、会议日程、妙记逐字稿）另需自行安装并授权 `@larksuite/cli`。

description.en: IM Companion for dsh-im: groups Feishu/WeChat/QQ bots by Agent in DSH workspaces and enhances DSH native session states (blue/orange/red rail markers for running, needs-review and error), with left badges, one-click filter, fleet overview and drag-to-move. Clean uninstall.
description.zh: dsh-im辅助插件：创造助理/家的概念，把飞书/微信/QQ等机器人收进DSH工作区，并提供更多强大的扩展功能。增强DSH原生会话状态:哪些在执行任务、哪些在等你回复、哪些有异常。感谢使用🌹。

description.en: 🌹 Save every repetitive, tiresome templated prompt — one mouse click injects it into the composer and spares you the effort.
description.zh: 🌹将一切重复、烦躁的模板化提示词保存下来，只需要鼠标点击就注入对话框，节省您的精力损耗

description.en: ⚠️ Internal beta, do not download ⚠️ iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.
description.zh: ⚠️内测中勿下载⚠️爱生活-覆盖你居家生活的方方面面。

description.en: Right-click a dash in the conversation's right-edge turn rail to bookmark that turn: the dash grows to the rail's full width and takes the accent colour so it stays easy to find, and right-clicking again unbookmarks it. Bookmarks are scoped per conversation, keyed by the selected Session id, and persisted so they survive reloads. No layout shift - the rail keeps its fixed pitch.
description.zh: 在对话右侧轮次导航条上右键收藏某一轮：该短横线变为导航条满宽并换成强调色，便于之后一眼找到，再次右键取消。收藏按对话隔离（取当前选中会话 id）并持久保存，刷新后仍在；不引起布局跳动，导航条保持固定间距。

description.en: Read-only unread-mail board for the accounts configured in dsh-email — unread messages appear as per-account cards in the DSH right sidebar (sender, subject, time) and refresh on demand.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 未读邮件看板——把 dsh-email 里配置的各账号未读邮件按账号列成右侧栏卡片（发件人、主题、时间），按需手动刷新。

description.en: A floating, semi-transparent market ticker for DeepSeek Harness showing real-time level and change percentage for the Shanghai Composite, ChiNext, STAR 50 and Hang Seng Tech indices.
description.zh: 一个悬浮的半透明行情小窗，实时显示上证指数、创业板指、科创50 与恒生科技的当前点位与涨跌幅。

description.en: Draggable recent-deliverables panel for DSH Web that merges declared deliverables with recently modified workspace files, with filename search, type filters, inline PDF/HTML/image/text previews, and desktop open or reveal actions.
description.zh: DSH Web 的可拖动最近成品面板，合并已声明交付的文件与工作区最近修改的文件，支持文件名搜索、类型筛选、PDF/HTML/图片/文本内嵌预览，以及用桌面应用打开或在文件管理器中定位。

description.en: Highlights answered ask blocks (question n/n answered) in the conversation with a soft card style; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look; optional expand-by-default and a settings page.
description.zh: 提问块高亮：把对话里已答复的「提问 n/n 已回答」工具块用柔和卡片样式凸显；等待中的提问块与其它工具块保持原样；可选择让提问块默认展开，设置页可配。

description.en: PWA icon: sets the icon (and manifest app name) used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop; ships a default icon set and accepts a custom image.
description.zh: PWA 图标：把 Web GUI 安装/添加到桌面时使用的图标（以及 manifest 应用名）换成自定义内容，包内自带默认图标集，也可配置自己的图片。

description.en: Portrait layout for desktop windows: navigation takes the full left column, the file/terminal panel moves above the conversation, and a draggable splitter sets its height; touch devices are unaffected.
description.zh: 竖屏布局：电脑竖屏窗口下，导航占左列整高，文件/终端面板移到对话区上方，中间的分隔线可拖拽调整高度；手机/平板不受影响。

description.en: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row title, with disk caching.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话标题图标：标题生成时用同一路由的辅助模型调用画一枚 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，显示在每行标题左侧，带磁盘缓存。

description.en: Line-range selection: browse workspace files, preview code with line numbers, visually select a line range, and write a `@path:start-end` reference into the composer; the agent receives the exact selected lines on send.
description.zh: 行选区：浏览工作区文件、带行号预览代码、可视化选中行范围，一键把 `@path:start-end` 引用写入输入框，agent 发送时自动收到所选行原文，精准修改指定行。

description.en: IDE tab in the dsh web client: a Monaco editor with the Dark Modern theme plus a file tree, git source control (stage/commit/push), an integrated xterm terminal and ripgrep workspace search, opened as a conversation view tab.
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端里的 IDE 标签页：Dark Modern 主题的 Monaco 编辑器，配文件树、Git 源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送）、xterm 集成终端与 ripgrep 全工作区搜索，作为会话视图标签打开。

description.en: Predicts the user's next prompt after each assistant reply and shows it as gray ghost text inside the composer; accept it whole with Tab, accept it piece by piece with Alt+→, reroll it, or dismiss it with Esc.
description.zh: 助手回复结束后预测用户的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 浮在输入框里；Tab 整条采纳、Alt+→ 逐段采纳、↻ 换一条、Esc 忽略。

description.en: Dot-matrix backdrop for the DSH Web UI: the dots form the DeepSeek whale or a transparent PNG you import (alpha-masked), each dot carries its own low-frequency force and follows the cursor in manual mode, while an auto screensaver mode sweeps 360-degree waves and full-screen breathing across the artwork; sliders and toggles live under Settings > Plugins.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一层点阵背景:点阵可组成鲸鱼剪影,或导入透明 PNG 按 alpha 取主体;每颗粒子各自持有低频外力,手动模式下跟随光标扰动,自动屏保模式则用 360° 任意方向的扫波与全屏呼吸带动整幅图案;鼠标/自动与鲸鱼/照片在参数面板里切换,入口在 设置 → 插件。

description.en: Maximizes the DeepSeek Harness desktop window automatically on startup, equivalent to clicking the maximize button once. Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), best-effort, host-only.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版启动时自动最大化主窗口，等价于手动点一次最大化按钮。跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），尽力而为，host-only 插件。

description.en: Claude-styled terminal panel for the DSH web GUI: agent shell commands run in a persistent real PTY with a genuine prompt, echo and exit codes, auto-open in the right sidebar and are scoped per conversation; optional live_terminal_* tools for reading, searching and screenshotting. Fork of Lancang-hzau/dsh-live-terminal (MIT); it shares its live_terminal_* tools and right-sidebar panel, so do not install it together with the upstream plugin in the same profile.
description.zh: DSH 网页版的 Claude 风格终端面板：agent 的 shell 命令跑在常驻真终端里（真提示符、真回显、真退出码），右侧栏自动弹出并按会话隔离；可选 live_terminal_* 工具用于读取、搜索与截屏。本项目是 Lancang-hzau/dsh-live-terminal（MIT）的衍生版，沿用同一套 live_terminal_* 工具与右侧栏面板，不能与上游插件装在同一 profile。

description.en: Code workbench in the right sidebar: a workspace file tree and a multi-tab Monaco editor with syntax highlighting and version-guarded saving, Tab completion from DeepSeek fill-in-the-middle, per-save checkpoints with rollback, codebase search (plus a codebase_search tool for the agent), and reference chips that insert a selection into the chat as an @path mention.
description.zh: 右栏的代码工作台：工作区文件树 + 多标签 Monaco 编辑器（语法高亮、版本守卫保存），基于 DeepSeek FIM 的 Tab 补全，按次保存的检查点与回滚，代码库检索（另提供 codebase_search 工具给 Agent），以及把选中代码以 @路径 mention 插入对话的引用胶囊。

description.en: Two-pane model picker that replaces the composer model menu with a searchable provider-grouped list on the left and a detail card on the right showing the selected model's context window, output cap, capability tags and reasoning-effort levels, all read from that model's own provider. The npm name dsh-model-picker belongs to another author; install through this GitHub source.
description.zh: 双栏模型选择器，替换输入框的模型菜单：左栏可搜索并按供应商分组，右栏详情卡显示所选模型的上下文窗口、输出上限、能力标签与推理档位，全部取自该模型自己的供应商。npm 上的 dsh-model-picker 属于另一位作者，请按本仓库的 GitHub 源安装。

description.en: A companion playlist panel for the dsh-boot-animation intro-video plugin: add clips without leaving the app, order them, and switch between sequential, random and single-clip playback. Sequential order is made deterministic by parking every clip except the one due to play in a disabled/ subdirectory of the same asset folder and rotating it back in on each boot, leaving the upstream plugin unpatched. Also supports recycling instead of deleting, pinning one clip for every launch, per-clip opt-out, and .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov files including non-ASCII names.
description.zh: 给开屏动画插件 dsh-boot-animation 配的播放入口面板：不用离开 app 就能加入视频、排好先后，并在「顺序播放 / 随机播放 / 单次播放」之间切换。顺序播放不修改上游插件也能做到确定性——除该播的那支外，参与播放的素材都停在同一个素材目录下的 disabled/ 里排队，每次启动自动轮换。还支持回收而不是删除、固定每次播同一支、逐条取消参与，以及 .mp4/.webm/.m4v/.mov（含非 ASCII 文件名）。

description.en: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3 clickable follow-up suggestions appear above the input box and send on click. Ghost completion, suggestions and the suggestion count can be toggled in Settings, Built-in plugins.
description.zh: 输入预测：在输入框里用灰字续写你草稿最可能的后续，按 Tab 接受后落进输入框、可继续编辑；每轮回答结束后在输入框上方给出 1–3 条你可能会发的下一条，点一下就发送。灰字补全、回复后推荐与推荐条数都能在「设置 → 内置插件 → 输入预测」里开关。

description.en: A collapsible Recent tasks folder at the top of the sidebar above 工作区: the most recently updated sessions, pinning that ignores recency, running-state spinners, and a per-row menu with rename, fork and archive.
description.zh: 侧边栏「工作区」上方多一个可折叠的「最近任务」文件夹：最近更新的会话一目了然，可置顶常用会话（不参与时间排序），运行中的任务带转圈标记，行内菜单支持重命名、在新会话里接着聊与归档。

description.en: Download pets from petdex.dev and keep one on the desktop, following the DSH session status; the appearance is adjustable and an enterprise WeChat bot can push a notification when the agent needs confirmation or finishes a turn. Desktop mode needs macOS 12+ or Windows 10 1903+; the bundled companion is prebuilt.
description.zh: 从 petdex.dev 下载宠物并常驻桌面，跟随 DSH 会话状态显示；外观可调，Agent 需要确认或一轮结束时可通过企业微信机器人推送通知。桌面模式需要 macOS 12+ 或 Windows 10 1903+，桌面端已随安装包预编译。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness desktop app icon (exe, tray and Start Menu) with any uploaded .ico, and restores the stock icon on demand.
description.zh: 更换 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端应用图标（exe、托盘、开始菜单），支持上传任意 .ico，并可随时还原官方默认图标。

description.en: Full-screen workspace panel for DSH: a project sidebar with per-project tabs for session, files, explorer, project search, terminal, browser, source control and a Markdown notes vault.
description.zh: DSH 全屏工作台面板：项目侧栏加按项目隔离的 tab，覆盖会话、文件、资源管理器、全项目搜索、终端、浏览器、源代码管理与 Markdown 笔记库。

description.en: Adds download buttons to the document preview toolbar and the Files tree, packs a folder download into a streamed ZIP, and adds a Files-tree upload button that streams to the Host one file at a time, capped at 1 GiB and renamed with an (n) suffix instead of overwriting.
description.zh: 在文档预览工具栏与 Files 文件树添加下载按钮（文件夹下载打包为流式 ZIP），并在文件树增加上传按钮：逐个文件流式写入 Host，单文件上限 1 GiB，重名自动改为 (n) 后缀而不覆盖。

description.en: Workspace sticky notes for DSH, saved as multiple Markdown files under the current workspace.
description.zh: DSH 工作区极简便签：在各个工作区保存多张 Markdown 便签，记录你的想法和项目进程。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Codex 风格的消息导航轨道，方便在长会话中快速定位历史提问。

description.en: Adds a Restart application section to the desktop app Settings; quits gracefully and relaunches the whole application.
description.zh: 在桌面应用设置中新增「应用重启」区块，优雅退出并自动重启整个应用。

description.en: Project canvas for DSH sessions, with linked conversation cards, text-selection follow-up branches, notes, and a document-style reader.
description.zh: 为 DSH 项目提供会话画布，支持对话卡片连线、选中文字创建追问分支、笔记和文档式阅读。

description.en: Fills in a Chinese description for every installed DSH plugin that ships only an English one, at startup and again after each plugin change, and never rewrites a plugin name. Plugins that already export a locale folder show the new text on refresh; the rest are patched too — the in-memory layer shows Chinese immediately, and the on-disk locale pack it writes needs one restart.
description.zh: 给只提供英文简介的已安装 DSH 插件自动补上中文简介，启动时以及每次插件变动后各跑一次，插件名称一律不改。原本已导出语言包的插件刷新页面即生效，原本没有语言包导出的也会自动补上：内存注入层即时生效，写入磁盘的语言包需重启一次。

description.en: Sidebar overhaul for the dsh web UI: long-press drag to reorder the panel icon rail, one arrow to fold it away, whole-row height caps on both the panel list and the pinned section (30% of the rail, rounded down to whole rows), a pinned-session section that mirrors the shipped row's live status (spinner, waiting-for-reply, relative time), drag-to-reorder conversation view tabs, archived Sessions sunk to the bottom of each group newest-first, forked child Sessions following their parent into the pinned section, and a generic lift that moves any plugin's sidebar-footer entry up into the rail. Each subsystem starts behind its own guard, so one that fails returns null and the rest of the plugin still mounts.
description.zh: dsh 网页端侧边栏整体增强：长按拖拽重排面板图标栏，一个箭头即可整栏折叠；面板列表与置顶区都按整行限制高度（占侧栏 30%，向下取整行）；置顶会话区镜像原生行的实时状态（转圈、待回复、相对时间）；顶部会话视图标签可拖拽换位；归档会话按时间新到旧沉到每组末尾；分叉出的子会话自动跟进父会话所在的置顶区；并把任意插件注册在侧栏底部的入口提升到同一栏内。每个子系统各自带启动守卫，单个失败只返回 null，不影响整个插件挂载。

description.en: Persistent agent-preset (mode) selector docked in the composer input bar: switch the mode for new tasks, and set the new-task default from any running session.
description.zh: 对话框常驻的 Agent 预设（模式）选择条：新任务直接切换模式，运行中的会话可一键设为新任务默认。

description.en: Chat column width and alignment control, numbered question history with keyboard navigation and auto-load of older questions, and markdown outline rails for both the conversation and the file preview.
description.zh: 对话列宽度与位置调节、带序号与快捷键跳转的提问历史（支持自动加载更早提问），以及对话区和文件预览区的 Markdown 大纲目录。

description.en: Reads a few lines of a txt or epub novel inside the sidebar bottom panel, styled to pass for scratch notes; pages with Ctrl+Alt+J/K and keeps progress locally. Requires dsh-better-sidebar 0.26+ - the reader exists only as a tab in its bottom panel.
description.zh: 把 txt / epub 小说藏进侧栏底部面板，一屏只显示几行、看着像随手记的草稿；Ctrl+Alt+J/K 翻页，进度存在本地。需要 dsh-better-sidebar 0.26 以上，阅读器只存在于它的底部面板里。

description.en: Prompt library above the DSH composer — a 📚 button expands a searchable panel to insert saved prompts into the draft with one click (appends, never overwrites), persisted in a host-side JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框上方的提示词库：📚 按钮展开可搜索面板，点条目一键填入草稿（追加不覆盖）；数据以 JSON 文件保存在 Host 侧。

description.en: Persistent image or MP4 wallpaper for the DSH Web profile: a wallpaper card under Settings -> General selects a local image or MP4 (up to 300 MB), tunes surface opacity and blur, compresses video locally to H.264 when ffmpeg/ffprobe are on PATH, stores media under ~/.dsh/wallpapers, and pins the Web server to port 9191 so the saved wallpaper survives restarts.
description.zh: DSH Web 持久化背景图/视频插件：在 设置 -> 通用 中提供壁纸卡片，可选本地图片或 MP4（最大 300 MB），调节表层透明度与模糊；检测到 ffmpeg/ffprobe 时在本机把视频压缩为 H.264；媒体保存到 ~/.dsh/wallpapers；并将 Web 服务固定到 9191 端口以便重启后恢复壁纸。

description.en: Codex-style `@file` mentions: search workspace files in the composer and attach their contents to prompts.
description.zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用，输入框里直接搜索并引用工作区文件。

description.en: Adds a Home panel to the sidebar for choosing a workspace; focus mode then shows only that workspace's sessions and folds the other workspaces below, and exiting focus restores the shipped sidebar.
description.zh: 在侧栏新增「主页」面板用于选择工作区；进入专注后侧栏只显示该工作区的会话，其他工作区折叠在底部，退出专注即恢复原生侧栏。

description.en: Shows a Live2D character in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI: blinking, breathing, lip-sync while talking, seven moods, and a speech bubble with its own chat, memory, corpus and stickers. Models are never bundled; every user drops in their own folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页右下角放一个 Live2D 角色：会眨眼、会呼吸、说话时嘴动、心情变了眉毛跟着动，用自己的对话气泡聊天，记得住之前说过的，能喂语料，也会配表情包。模型不用内置，谁装谁放自己的文件夹。

description.en: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的设置弹窗以整页全屏打开，并把退出入口移到左上角的返回行。

description.en: Adds a General settings row choosing where the Add-workspace directory picker opens: a fixed custom path (typed, pasted, or picked visually) or the last directory you confirmed. Quoted and CJK paths are accepted, and a This PC level reaches other Windows drives.
description.zh: 在通用设置中新增一行，控制点击"添加工作区"时目录选择框从哪里打开：固定自定义路径（可输入、粘贴或可视化选取），或上次确认的目录。容忍带引号与中文路径，并提供「此电脑」层以跨盘选择。

description.en: Makes the DSH Settings dialog resizable from its edges and corners and movable by its top strip, remembering the chosen size across opens.
description.zh: 让 DSH 设置弹窗可拖动边和角改变大小、按住顶部横带移动位置，并记住尺寸。

description.en: Desktop-grade companion: browser native notifications for user questions and approval interactions, screen capture model tool, multi-agent tiling grid view, and lightweight Tauri desktop shell.
description.zh: 桌面级增强套件：原生提问/审批交互通知、屏幕截图工具、多智能体平铺网格视图与轻量级 Tauri 桌面外壳。

description.en: Per-region UI zoom for DeepSeek Harness — Ctrl + wheel sets independent zoom levels for the conversation header, the left sidebar, the conversation body and the right sidebar (sidebars 25%-300%), and dragging the header bottom edge makes that header shorter or taller, growing by height only so label size stays unchanged.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分区域缩放：Ctrl + 滚轮分别为会话顶栏、左侧栏、会话正文和右侧面板设置独立比例（侧栏 25%–300%）；拖动顶栏整条下边界可以把它调矮或调高，调高只增加高度、字大小不变。

description.en: Adds a Windows-only button at the foot of the sidebar that restarts the DSH desktop app and reloads the page when it comes back.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部加一个按钮（仅 Windows），一键重启 DSH 桌面应用，应用回来后页面自动恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-composer-plus

description.en: Composer and sidebar helpers in one plugin, each switchable in Settings: a git Changes panel (uncommitted / unstaged / staged / branch diffs), ↑/↓ input history, Shift+Tab /plan toggle, one-click ▶ Continue after a stopped or failed turn, drag-and-drop queue reordering, Copy deeplink, Auto Review "Allow for this chat", project status markers with active projects first, background notifications, 11 extra UI languages and automatic updates from GitHub releases through the plugin manager.
description.zh: 一个插件集成多项输入框与侧边栏增强，均可在设置中单独开关：git 改动面板（未提交 / 未暂存 / 已暂存 / 分支差异）、↑/↓ 输入历史、Shift+Tab 切换 /plan、对话中断或失败后一键 ▶ 继续、拖拽调整排队消息顺序、复制会话链接、Auto Review「本对话内允许」、项目状态标记与活跃项目置顶、后台通知、11 种额外界面语言，以及通过插件管理器从 GitHub Releases 自动更新。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 100.64.0.0 for network access

description.en: Drag a session onto another workspace in the DSH sidebar and it really moves: the session-log header cwd is rewritten and the log directory is re-homed under the target project, with a progress bar while it runs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏把会话拖到别的工作区，归属真的会变：改写会话日志 header 的 cwd 并把日志目录迁到目标项目下，迁移过程中显示进度条。

description.en: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app to explain or translate it with the Harness agent, answered in a native always-on-top overlay.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，用 Harness 自己的 agent 解释或翻译（自动带上选区所在的上下文段落），结果落在可拖动、可缩放的原生置顶浮窗里。

plugins.name: mcp-server-fanqie#deepseek-harness

description.en: Fanqie reader for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: search book and media metadata, browse covers and chapter lists, read website-visible chapters, and view your bookshelf and saved highlights after QR sign-in.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏番茄阅读：搜索小说及其他作品元数据，查看封面和目录、阅读官网可见章节，并在本人扫码登录后查看书架与收藏划线。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 7.0.1.32 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-sidenote

description.en: Side chats and selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness, preserving full conversation history and bringing findings back to the main thread.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边追问与划选注释，保留完整对话历史，将结论带回主线。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Customizes the DSH home sidebar plugin entries without harness source changes: one- or two-column panel list, icon-only mode with 500ms hover tooltips, and per-entry ordering, hiding, and a settings page for the upper panel area and the footer plugin row.
description.zh: 无需改动 Harness 源码即可自定义主页侧边栏的插件入口：上方面板列表支持单栏/双栏与仅图标（悬浮 500ms 显示名称），底部插件行支持默认横向/单列/双列，两个区域均可逐条目排序、显示或隐藏，并提供设置页。

description.en: A right-sidebar workbench for legal practice backed by a folder of Markdown notes: SOP lookup, recordings with live transcription and line-level annotations, an inline glossary, and full-text search. Optional email rules library, Pkulaw points and usage badges. Notes, recordings and annotations stay on the local machine; live transcription needs your own Volcengine key and sends audio to Volcengine.
description.zh: 以 Markdown 笔记文件夹为事实源的法律实务工作台：SOP 速查、录音实时转写与逐句批注、可编辑术语表、全文搜索；可选邮件规则库、法宝积分与用量角标。笔记、录音与批注只存本机；实时转写需自备火山引擎密钥，音频会发往火山引擎。

description.en: Adds a Plan/Build mode toggle to the composer, switched with the Tab key or a toolbar button, and remembers a separate model for each mode from the native model selector.
description.zh: 在输入框中提供 Plan/Build 模式切换：按 Tab 键或点击工具栏按钮即可切换，并按模式分别记住右侧原生模型选择器中所选的模型。

description.en: Control the Web UI left sidebar width: lower the 264px drag minimum and optionally tune the drag maximum and the expanded default width, applied by a startup patch of the ui-layout bundle.
description.zh: 调整 Web UI 左侧会话列表栏宽度：调低 264px 拖动下限，可选调整拖动上限与展开默认宽度，启动时自动修补 ui-layout bundle。

description.en: Draggable ring gauge showing live model output speed (tok/s) with an expandable per-step detail panel (exact speed, TTFT, cache-hit rate, cache read/write, reasoning and input tokens, model, cumulative tokens).
description.zh: 可拖拽环形表盘，实时显示模型输出速度（tok/s），点击展开每步详情（精确速度、TTFT、缓存命中率、缓存读写、推理/输入 token、模型、累计 token）。

plugins.name: dsh-balance

description.en: Composer-dock balance/usage readout for DeepSeek, Kimi Coding, OpenCode Go, Zhipu, MiniMax, OpenRouter and OpenAI Codex — provider-based, 2s polling, 5min cache.
description.zh: 输入框下方按 provider 展示 DeepSeek、Kimi Coding、OpenCode Go、智谱、MiniMax、OpenRouter、OpenAI Codex 的余额/用量，2 秒轮询、5 分钟缓存。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Conversation-map rail down the left edge of the transcript: one tick per user turn, read from the full session log on the host rather than from the rendered page, so long sessions are covered end to end. Hovering fans the neighbouring ticks open by pixel distance and floats a scrollable preview of that turn prompt and its last reply; clicking scrolls to the turn, paging older history in first when it has not been rendered yet; the tick for the visible turn stays highlighted while you scroll.
description.zh: 主对话区左缘的对话地图刻度列：每条刻度是一轮用户提问，刻度由宿主直读会话完整日志得来，不受客户端分页窗口限制，长会话也是全量覆盖。hover 时邻近刻度按像素距离连续展开，右侧浮出该轮提问与最后一次回复的预览卡（可进卡滚动看完）；点击跳转到该轮，老轮次尚未渲染时先自动分页加载再跳；滚动对话时当前轮次的刻度保持高亮。

description.en: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or wandering off when idle, with click-to-view work monitors and in-place approval cards.
description.zh: 把多 agent 会话的实时活动渲染成 Web UI 侧边栏里的像素风办公室--每个会话是一名牛/马员工，忙时伏案敲键盘、闲时起身摸鱼，支持点击查看工位监控、就地处理审批。

description.en: Typography settings page: text, code and terminal font size and family, plus interface, conversation and code text colour, weight, italic, letter spacing and line height, with a live preview.
description.zh: 字体设置页：正文、代码与终端的字号和字体族，外加界面、会话与代码的文字颜色、字重、斜体、字间距与行高，带实时预览。

description.en: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.2+. Dialog-style model picker for the DSH Web UI: fuzzy search, collapsible provider groups, favorites with a favorites-only filter, and a thinking-level dropdown, replacing the built-in model selector with official UI primitives and DSW tokens.
description.zh: 需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2+。Web UI 模型选择器替换插件：对话框式选择，支持模糊搜索、供应商折叠分组、收藏与只看收藏过滤，以及思考档位下拉，复用官方组件库与 DSW 设计 token。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt through a one-shot LLM call, with one-click revert and cancel.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，一键调用 LLM 把当前草稿改写成更清晰具体的提示词，支持一键恢复原文与取消。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app to explain, summarize, translate, or read it aloud with DeepSeek Harness — answered in a streaming always-on-top overlay with a horizontal capsule menu.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，弹出解释 / 总结 / 翻译 / 朗读，结果以流式输出落在原生置顶浮窗里，菜单为横向胶囊条。

description.en: A time module in the DSH session header: current time, time since your last message, reminders, and countdowns. Pure browser-side - data lives in localStorage and the host half registers nothing. Alerts are a border glow plus an in-app toast; no system notifications.
description.zh: DSH 会话头部的时间模块：现在时间、距你上次发言、提醒与倒计时。纯前端插件——数据存浏览器 localStorage，host 半不注册任何东西；到点提示是边框呼吸灯加界面浮条，不发系统通知。

description.en: Adds a Download PNG button next to the assistant message copy button in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 的助手消息复制按钮旁增加一个下载 PNG 按钮。

description.en: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js; multi-tab sessions, dock/floating window, clipboard support.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

description.en: DailyBoard — a daily work task board for the DSH Web GUI with a one-month calendar of colored timeline bars and day tasks, a daily checklist, a seven-day week view with completion checkboxes and drag-to-reschedule, a draggable 24-hour day timeline, ordered per-day subtasks, weekly and every-N-days recurring tasks with per-occurrence result records, a long-term progress view opened from the calendar header, per-day completion for long-term tasks, a collapsible daily email reminder for any mailbox, and AI extraction of tasks from natural language.
description.zh: DailyBoard 是 DSH Web GUI 的日常工作任务板：单月日历（彩色时间条 + 当天任务）、日常清单、七天周视图（勾选完成、可拖动改期）与可拖拽的 24 小时时间轴，支持按天记录的有序子任务、按周几或每隔几天的周期任务及每次出现的结果记录、从日历标题栏打开的长期任务进展视图、长期任务按天完成标记、任意邮箱的每日邮件提醒，以及 AI 自然语言提取任务。

description.en: Two split composer controls for output style: a tone switch with its own preset menu, and an output-form switch with its own preset menu; each session's system prompt follows the selections, with a preset settings page.
description.zh: 输出风格：输入框里两个分体控件（沟通基调、产出形态各带独立开关与预设菜单），按会话注入系统提示词，并带预设管理设置页。

description.en: Pomodoro timer with four-quadrant tasks: bind focus rounds to a task, grow a desktop pet with EXP and achievements, and let the agent start rounds or propose tasks.
description.zh: 番茄钟搭配四象限任务：专注轮次可绑定任务，桌宠随经验成长并解锁成就，Agent 可开始专注或提议任务。

description.en: Conversation navigator panel: turn-folded outline of the current session with per-step kind badges (assistant, tool, command, compaction, error), a hover bubble showing the full user question, a minimal mode that hides turn numbers for an all-badge view, keyword filter over user questions and assistant replies, click-to-jump with reading-position tracking, and load-earlier/load-all history paging. Host >= 0.1.2-rc.1; legacy hosts install @legacy/0.2.5.
description.zh: 会话导航面板：按轮折叠的当前会话大纲与步次类型徽标（助手/工具/命令/压缩/出错），悬停气泡显示用户提问全文，可隐藏轮次号的极简徽标视图，仅检索提问与助手回复的关键词过滤，点击跳转与阅读位置跟踪，支持加载更早/加载全部历史分页。宿主 ≥ 0.1.2-rc.1，旧宿主装 @legacy/0.2.5。

description.en: Codex-style drag-drop: drag any file into the DSH web GUI, it lands in ~/.dsh-dropbox, and the path is inserted into the composer as a whole blue chip.
description.zh: Codex 式拖拽：把任意文件拖入 DSH Web 界面，文件存入 ~/.dsh-dropbox，路径以整块蓝色 chip 插入输入框。

description.en: The menu bar app itself is a separate AppKit build from the repo's app/ directory (swift build -c release on macOS); the plugin only provides the host bridge.
description.zh: 菜单栏应用不在插件里：需在 macOS 上用仓库 app/ 目录自行执行 swift build -c release 构建，插件只提供宿主桥。

description.en: MQTT client and embedded broker for DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar panel with saved connections, a live message log and a local broker, plus nine mqtt_* agent tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MQTT 面板：客户端连接池、实时消息日志与内嵌 Broker，并提供九个 mqtt_* 智能体工具。

description.en: Make development more fun. A subtle layer of motion for DeepSeek Harness, with customizable effects and reduced-motion support.
description.zh: 让开发，有趣一点。为 DeepSeek Harness 添一层恰到好处的动效，支持效果调整并跟随系统「减少动态效果」。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each turn and shows it as gray ghost text in the composer: Tab takes the whole line, Alt+Right takes one word at a time, Enter takes it and sends, Esc dismisses, and Alt+R asks the model again without repeating the old one. Typing a few characters completes from prompts already sent in the session, Up in an empty composer recalls the last one, and a plugin-page form sets the provider, model, reasoning effort, per-key toggles and generation limits.
description.zh: 每轮结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 显示在输入框：Tab 整条采纳、Alt+→ 逐词采纳、Enter 采纳并发送、Esc 忽略、Alt+R 换一条且不重复旧的那条；输入几个字时用本会话发过的提示做前缀补全，空输入框按 ↑ 回填上一条；插件页可设置服务商、模型、思考强度、各按键开关与生成参数。

description.en: Quote text selected in a DSH Web conversation, then either attach it to the current composer or dispatch it to a subagent session: the quote sits on a bar above the composer, or opens that subagent in a new pane on the right. When the target has no subagent yet, the quote is held and the composer is seeded with a spawn request, then picked up automatically once the new session appears. Client-only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页版会话里划词后，把选中内容引用到当前输入框，或分派到子智能体会话：引用落在输入框正上方的引用条上，或在右侧新开一格打开该子智能体会话。目标还没有子智能体时先挂起这条引用，并在输入框写入派生请求，新子会话一出现就自动接续。纯客户端。

description.en: Adds Russian as a native option in Settings - General - Language for DeepSeek Harness, covering both the core UI and companion plugins. Localized Markdown export, in-message translation, live typography, slash-command aliases and an Alt+L layout fix, plus a settings card, all applied through a runtime locale snapshot rather than by modifying core files.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用 - 语言」加入俄语，覆盖核心界面与生态插件的词条。提供会话 Markdown 导出、消息内嵌翻译、实时排版、斜杠命令别名与 Alt+L 布局更正，以及一张设置卡片，全部通过运行时 locale 快照实现，不修改核心文件。

description.en: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮命令甲板：把所有斜杠命令列成可执行按钮，悬停看介绍，按使用次数排序。

description.en: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.
description.zh: 在会话头部的后台任务列表里停止正在运行的任务，确认弹窗会再次显示完整命令。

description.en: Adds human-facing TypeSafe Jev advice to DSH multiple-choice prompts, on demand by default with optional automatic requests, recommendations, probabilities, confidence, close-call warnings, copyable suggestions, one-click adoption, profile-scoped card layouts, temporary decision preferences, optional request previews with common-credential masking, and local health checks with sanitized diagnostic exports.
description.zh: 为 DSH 选择题提供面向用户的 TypeSafe Jev 第二意见，默认按需询问、可选自动获取，展示推荐、概率和置信度，支持分歧提示、复制建议、一键采纳、按 profile 保存卡片布局、临时决策偏好、可选发送前预览与常见凭证遮盖，并提供本地健康检查和脱敏诊断复制。

description.en: Adds a sticky effort slider inside the composer model menu to select reasoning levels, with generic stops for custom models.
description.zh: 在输入框模型菜单底部固定推理强度滑块，无需进入子菜单即可切换思考档位，并为自定义模型自动补齐通用档位。

description.en: Rewrites the composer draft into a tighter prompt in one click and restores the exact original in another, running on Harness's own models by default or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with an editable polishing prompt.
description.zh: 一键把输入框草稿改写为更紧凑的提示词，再点一次还原原文；默认用 Harness 自带模型，也可接任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，润色提示词与长度、超时限制均可自行设置。

description.en: Rewrites the composer draft, or only the selected text, with one model call that uses the recent conversation as context, with cancel, revert, fidelity and length checks, and an optional preview.
description.zh: 用一次模型调用改写输入框草稿（或仅选中片段），参考最近对话，支持取消、回退、保真与长度校验，以及可选预览。

description.en: Adds a Restart item to the DeepSeek Harness desktop account menu, with confirmation, progress and failure reporting.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版账号菜单中加入「重启」项，带二次确认、进度与失败原因提示。

description.en: One-click plain-text prompt enhancement with optional local checks and sentence review in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中一键优化纯文本提示词，并提供可选的本地检查和句级审阅。

description.en: Hermes in the DSH sidebar: start and stop the gateway and dashboard, watch the dashboard beside the chat, and bridge DSH to Hermes. Windows only; requires an existing Hermes install.
description.zh: 把 Hermes 放进 DSH 右侧栏：启停网关和 dashboard，聊天旁边就能看 dashboard，再把 DSH 和 Hermes 接起来。仅 Windows；需已安装 Hermes。

plugins.name: draw2code

description.en: An Excalidraw prototyping tab for dsh-better-sidebar with structured product clarification, conflict-aware human and Agent board updates, and prototype-guided frontend generation.
description.zh: 运行在 dsh-better-sidebar 中的 Excalidraw 协作原型插件：结构化澄清产品需求、保护用户手工修改的人机画板更新，以及基于原型的前端生成。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to docs.excalidraw.com

description.en: Conversational Markdown mindmap workspace: edit complete documents step by step, keep a live right-side visualization synchronized, and open, manage, and export mindmaps from the working directory.
description.zh: 对话式 Markdown 思维脑图工作台：逐步编辑完整文档，实时同步右侧可视化，并在工作目录中打开、管理和导出脑图。

description.en: A temp note in the DSH right sidebar with session, workspace, and global scopes, browser-local autosave, one-click copy, and one-click LLM polish through the default model.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的临时笔记，支持会话级、工作区级与全局三种范围、自动保存、一键复制，以及用默认模型一键优化为 Markdown。

description.en: Desktop only. DeepSeek web chat, temporary side conversations, the API platform and conversation migration in DSH.
description.zh: 仅 Desktop。在 DSH 中使用 DeepSeek 网页聊天、临时侧栏对话、API 平台与会话迁移。

description.en: Native interactive answers, editable cards and on-demand UI skills for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 原生交互式回答、可编辑卡片与按需界面技能。

description.en: A green interrupt button beside the send box: silently stops a running agent, which then summarizes its progress and asks for your new requirements, with a customizable interrupt prompt.
description.zh: 发送按钮旁的绿色打断按钮：运行时一键静默中断 AI，AI 停止后总结进展并向你征求新要求，支持自定义打断提示词。

plugins.name: dsh-game-hud

description.en: Game-style floating HUD: balance HP bar, context MP bar, official peak/valley pricing with countdown, auto-compaction under 5% remaining, and memory-carrying new conversation.
description.zh: 游戏风格悬浮 HUD：余额血条、上下文蓝条、官方峰谷定价与切换倒计时、上下文不足5%自动压缩、携带记忆开启新对话。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Icon console for the DSH desktop app: import one icon and apply it to the desktop and Start Menu shortcuts (immediately), the application window image and the system tray image (after a restart), with automatic backup, one-click restore, a named icon library, and restart/exit controls.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端图标控制台：导入一个图标即可应用到桌面与开始菜单快捷方式（立即生效）、应用窗口图标与系统托盘图标（重启后生效），带官方图标自动备份、一键恢复、图标库管理，以及重启/退出控制。

description.en: Adds a restart button next to the shutdown button in the bottom-right of the DSH Web GUI; the server comes back up and the browser reopens.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面右下角"关机"按钮旁新增一个"重启"按钮，点击并确认后重启 dsh web，服务器自动拉起并重新打开浏览器。

description.en: Use DeepSeek's web chat inside DSH: real chat history in the leftmost sidebar, a Chat/Work switch beside the agent mode, plus streaming answers, thinking, web search and file uploads.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 DeepSeek 网页版对话：最左侧边栏显示真实聊天记录，Agent 模式旁提供 Chat/Work 切换，支持流式回答、深度思考、网页搜索和文件上传。

description.en: Shows JeV-selected task plans, progress updates and stage summaries in DSH chat, with native translation or lightweight summaries. Requires a JeV key; the Jev service is called externally and may bill. and hierarchical serial/parallel task flows.
description.zh: 通过 JeV 筛选并外显思考中的任务规划、进展和阶段小结，支持轻量摘要、DSH 原生翻译（需 JeV Key，会外部调用 Jev 服务并可能计费）及父子任务、串并行流程图。

description.en: One-click collapse of every expanded section (Think rows, tool cards) with a live-count pill and a customizable hotkey.
description.zh: 一键收起会话中所有展开的区块（Think、工具卡等），常驻计数按钮 + 自定义快捷键。

description.en: UI butler for every plugin UI: official/plugin categories, per-widget toggles, drag move/resize, collision avoidance and one-click auto arrange.
description.zh: UI 管家：官方/插件 UI 分区折叠、逐条开关，拖拽移动/改大小，碰撞避让与一键自动排布。

description.en: Windows-only desktop floating ball with a bilingual WebView2 quick-chat window, including in-window question and approval cards.
description.zh: Windows 桌面悬浮球，内置中英文 WebView2 快捷聊天窗口，支持在窗口内回答提问和审批操作。

description.en: Adds an animated DeepSeek Chan reasoning-effort slider to DSH's native model selector, following model-declared levels with a running animation that speeds up while dragging.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生模型选择器加入大肥鱼思考强度滑块，按模型声明的档位调节推理强度，拖动时奔跑动画随之加速。

description.en: Adds a Download button to DSH Web GUI delivery cards, so files delivered with present save straight from the browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 交付卡片上增加下载按钮，present 交付的文件可直接从浏览器下载。

description.en: Persistent prompt history for the DSH composer — Up/Down recalls sent prompts across restarts, Up with text typed filters by prefix, and cleared drafts are not recorded.
description.zh: DSH 对话框的持久输入历史：↑/↓ 回溯已发送内容（重启不丢），输入框有内容时按 ↑ 仅在前缀匹配项中翻找，清空未发送的草稿不会入历史。

description.en: Select any text in a conversation and tap the Explain button to get a streaming Markdown explanation bubble, with recursive follow-up questions.
description.zh: 对话中框选任意文字后点击「解释」按钮，弹出 Markdown 实时流式解释气泡，支持递归追问。

description.en: Composer code-quote collapse for the DSH Web UI: pasting a `path:line` header followed by code folds the input into one compact inline quote chip, and at send time the `agent/pre-step` hook injects the full pasted snapshot to the model as a separate context message. 0.5.x also folds sidebar file-selections that insert only a `path:lines` line (large selections), fetching the code from disk by session cwd, and preempts Ctrl+V paste interception.
description.zh: 输入框代码引用折叠：粘贴「路径:行号 + 代码」时自动折叠为「文件图标+文件名:行号」引用芯片（Ctrl+Z 可还原），发送时由 agent/pre-step 钩子将完整代码快照作为独立上下文消息注入给模型。0.5 起支持侧边栏「添加到对话框」大段选区（仅插路径行时按会话工作目录读磁盘取代码），并在捕获阶段抢权接管 Ctrl+V 粘贴。

description.en: Select any passage in a DSH conversation to annotate it in place; the quoted text, the turn it came from and your comment are folded into the message on send, so the model can tell exactly what each remark refers to.
description.zh: 在对话里划选任意一段文字即可就地批注：原文高亮并带编号角标，发送时把原文、出处（谁说的、第几轮）和你的批注一起折进消息，模型能对上每一句指代。

description.en: Resize the Settings dialog and set its transparency from three sliders in General settings; the choice persists across restarts.
description.zh: 在「通用设置」里用三个滑动条调节设置弹窗的宽度、高度与透明度，重启后仍然保留。

description.en: A kanban board in the dsh sidebar. Every project gets its own section with four fixed columns (todo, in progress, feedback, done); add, rename, recolor, reorder and delete projects and tasks, advance a task with one click, reorder by drag and drop or with the card menu, undo a deletion, and collapse a project. Colors, radii and shadows come from the dsh theme, so it follows light and dark, and the layout reflows from four columns to two to one.
description.zh: dsh 侧边栏里的项目看板。每个项目一个区块，固定四列（待办 / 进行中 / 待反馈 / 已完成）：新建、重命名、换色、排序、删除项目和任务，点一下把任务推到下一列，拖拽或卡片菜单调整顺序，删除可撤销，项目可折叠。颜色、圆角和阴影取自 dsh 主题变量，跟随浅色/深色，宽度不够时从四列变两列再变单列。

description.en: Inline +N −M badges on edit/write tool rows and a collapsible per-turn file-change summary card with aligned diffs, review and undo — covers native edit/write, str_replace_editor and Code Dispatch sub-calls, no git required.
description.zh: 在编辑/写入工具行内联 +N −M 徽标，每轮末尾给出可折叠的文件变更汇总卡：对齐差异、逐文件审查与撤销；覆盖原生 edit/write、str_replace_editor 与 Code Dispatch 子调用，不依赖 git。

description.en: Auto thinking-effort routing for dsh: a locally fine-tuned 7-question classifier (ModernBERT, 842MB, <1s CPU inference) picks low/high/max for no-intent messages; in-session retries escalate the tier (low to high to max) under exclusion constraints; the judge service fails safe to low if unreachable. A tier chip in the input bar shows the live tier and the last 20 judgments. All inference is local - task text never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动思考档位路由：本地微调的 7 题分类模型（ModernBERT，842MB，CPU 推理 <1s）对无档位指令的消息自动选择 low/high/max；会话内检测到重试自动沿阶梯升档，受「别用 max」类排除约束压制；判定服务不可达时熔断降级，会话不断。前端档位芯片实时显示当前档位与最近 20 轮判断原因。判定全程本地推理，任务文本不出本机。

description.en: Native terminals for DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 on macOS, with local terminal AI sessions, SSH terminals that reconnect to the same remote task, bounded Terminal Group discussions, and handoffs with acceptance and rework.
description.zh: 面向 macOS 上 DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 的原生终端，支持本地终端 AI 会话、可接回原任务的 SSH 远程终端、有限轮次群讨论，以及任务交接、验收与返工。

description.en: Codex-style `@file` mentions for the web GUI: search and reference workspace files of every format (.java, .vue, PDF, images, extension-less, hidden) with no index truncation. Replaces dsh-at-file.
description.zh: Codex 风格的 `@file` 文件引用：输入框里搜索并引用工作区所有格式的文件（.java、.vue、PDF、图片、无扩展名、隐藏文件），无索引上限。dsh-at-file 的替代品。
