description.en: Turn-rail settings for the DSH conversation locator: tick thickness, rail on the left or right, a curved length gradient on the hovered tick, and a plain-text hover preview with adjustable line count, font size and width.
description.zh: DSH 对话定位条的轮次轨道设置：刻度粗细、轨道在左还是在右、锚在悬停那根的曲线长度渐变，以及行数、字号、宽度都可调的纯文本悬停预览。

description.en: Searches wallhaven.cc from a settings page and sets any wallpaper as the DSH web GUI background, with opacity, blur and scrim controls, a sidebar shuffle button and one-click original download; all fetching runs in the host process, so the browser never needs to reach wallhaven.
description.zh: 在设置页搜索 wallhaven.cc,把任意壁纸铺成 DSH Web GUI 背景,支持透明度、模糊与遮罩调节,侧边栏一键换图,可下载原图;图片全部由宿主进程取回,浏览器无需能访问 wallhaven。

description.en: Flip the DSH page over to a glass task board showing live jobs, subagents and session state, with an infinite canvas that unrolls a card into draggable controls, embedded web-app frames, and a conversation box that edits the canvas.
description.zh: 把 DSH 页面翻到背面变成玻璃任务台（会话 / 后台任务 / 子代理 / 工作区卡片），并提供无限画布：能把卡片拆成可拖动的控件、内嵌网页应用，还能用对话框直接改画布。

description.en: Select a passage in a DSH conversation and read a plain-language explanation in a floating panel, which carries the surrounding message as the context. Three explanation depths (plain / general / pro) that re-explain on the spot when switched; optional web search and local file lookup (the model decides by default, and a button can force one lookup that reports only what is new); follow-up questions; and a button that hands the whole exchange to a new session in standby mode - the background is queued without waking the model or spending tokens. Settings live on the host in settings.json, and nothing is written until you press save. The repository also ships an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and a browser extension (source).
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里划词即得大白话解释，浮窗显示，并自动带上这段话所在的那条完整消息作为语境。三档讲解深度（小白 / 通识 / 专业），切换后当场重讲；可选联网搜索与本地文件查找（默认交给模型自己判断，也可一键强制查一次，查完只补充新内容而不复述）；可继续追问；还能把整段问答「待命式」交接给一个新会话——背景放好即止，不唤醒模型、不耗额度。设置保存在宿主侧 settings.json，不点保存不落盘。仓库内另含一个 OpenAI 兼容端点与一个浏览器扩展（源码）。

description.en: Web UI plugin that folds each staged response's think and tool calls into per-segment bounded, scrollable slide windows with a configurable height, keeping every intermediate response visible.
description.zh: Web UI 插件：以阶段性文字回复为界分段，把每段的 think 与工具调用收进限高可滚动、高度可配置的 slide 窗口，中间过程始终可见。

description.en: A tab in the conversation view bar that keeps the lines your agent wanted to keep, with tools that let it add, list and remove them.
description.zh: 会话视图标签栏里的「鲸语」页：收着 agent 想留下的句子，并带三个工具让它自己增、查、删。

description.en: Declutters the DSH chat: hides agent execution-log rows, tightens spacing and fonts, wraps messages in bubbles, and injects an editable reply-concisely system instruction.
description.zh: 简化 DSH 聊天界面：隐藏执行日志、收紧间距与字号、把消息做成气泡，并注入可编辑的“简洁回复”系统指令。

description.en: Fluid conversation width for the DSH web UI: the chat column follows the window minus a 64px margin, capped at 1560px and floored at 640px, while the built-in drag handles still override it.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面的对话列自适应宽度：随窗口取「列宽 − 64px」，上限 1560px、下限 640px，内置拖拽把手仍然优先。

description.en: AI short-drama workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with a dedicated drama agent preset, 35 agent tools and 10 bundled skills covering outline, characters, script, storyboard and export.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 短剧工作区：独立的「短剧模式」Agent 预设、35 个 Agent 工具与 10 个随包技能，覆盖立项、总纲、人物、剧本、分镜与导出。

description.en: Select text in the DSH Web GUI and ask about it in place (floating button, or the Alt+Q shortcut): an independent subagent that inherits no parent context answers, streaming into a side card hosted by the native right sidebar, dsh-better-sidebar, or a built-in overlay — and the question can be routed to the main conversation instead.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词就地追问（浮出按钮，或 Alt+Q 快捷键）：答案由不继承父上下文的独立子代理流式产出到侧边卡片，承载面为原生右侧栏 / dsh-better-sidebar / 内置浮层，也可把问题改为落回主对话。

description.en: Composer prompt enhancement for DSH Web: a ✨ button rewrites the current draft in place after asking only about genuine ambiguity, and an empty composer shows a grey next-message ghost that Tab or a click fills into the draft without sending.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框提示词增强：✨ 按钮先判断歧义、再原地改写草稿；空草稿时以灰色 ghost 给出下一步建议，Tab 或点击填入草稿且不自动发送。

description.en: Local music player: scans a folder for audio and video files, plays them in a Music tab with crossfade, a 10-band EQ and ReplayGain, and can write matched tags, covers and filenames back to the files with atomic replacement.
description.zh: 本地音乐播放器：扫描目录中的音频与视频文件，在「音乐」标签页播放，支持交叉淡化、10 段均衡器与响度归一化，并可按歌手-歌名重命名回写标签、封面与文件名（原子替换）。

plugins.name: dsh-ppt-canvas

description.en: Element-level PowerPoint canvas that edits the opened .pptx in place: click, marquee-select or pick a whole slide, describe the change, and the AI writes byte-preserving OOXML patches with undo and redo.
description.zh: 元素级 PPT 画布，就地改写已打开的 .pptx：点选、框选或整页选中后用自然语言描述改动，AI 以字节保真的 OOXML 补丁写入，支持撤销与重做。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Adds a strip above the composer that lists sent-but-unread (steering) text messages and recalls them before the model reads them, one by one or all at once.
description.zh: 在输入框上方列出已发送但模型尚未读取的插话消息，可在模型读取前逐条或一次性撤回。

description.en: Clickable next-step suggestions under every reply; one click sends that sentence as your message.
description.zh: 在每条回复下方给出可点的下一步建议，点一下就把那句话作为你的消息发出去。

description.en: Puts your own animated vector logo over the DSH brand mark in the sidebar and beside the start-page headline, taking over the three single slots sidebar.brand.mark, sidebar.brand.name and conversation.hero.brand.mark. The bundled patch only inserts the plugin into the loader — the official brand plugin (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official) holds those slots too, so you must disable it in the profile's cordis.patch.yml and restart. Ships a swimming whale that follows light and dark themes through currentColor and is tuned to stay legible at the sidebar's 24 px.
description.zh: 把自己做的矢量 Logo 换到 DSH 侧栏与首屏标题旁，接管 sidebar.brand.mark / sidebar.brand.name / conversation.hero.brand.mark 这三个 single 槽位。包里自带的补丁只把自己插进 loader——这三个槽位同时被官方品牌插件 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-brand-official 占着，所以要先在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里把它 disabled，再重启 DSH。默认那只鲸鱼会游动，用 currentColor 跟随明暗主题，动效按侧栏 24px 的可读性调过。

plugins.name: seektty

description.en: Terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness with local VS Code JSON/JSONC theme import, inherited terminal background effects, mouse text selection, structured tool and diff views, Session/Profile/plugin management, and Skill/MCP browsers.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的终端工作区，支持导入本地 VS Code JSON／JSONC 主题、继承终端背景效果、鼠标文本选择、结构化工具与 Diff 视图、Session／Profile／插件管理，以及 Skill／MCP 浏览。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Merges AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper and zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix — two composer model-seat plugins that cannot be installed together — into one control: a Provider / Model trigger opening a two-column card where hovering the provider column swaps the models without moving the card, a separate reasoning-effort trigger with a particle slider, and a search that spans every provider while the card keeps its size.
description.zh: 把 AprilCrystal/dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper 与 zszz3/dsh-model-provider-prefix 这两个无法同时安装的输入框模型控件合并成一个控件：「供应商/模型」钮点开是两栏卡片，鼠标所指供应商的模型就地切换、卡片不移动；推理强度是旁边的独立钮，带粒子滑杆；搜索跨全部供应商，且卡片尺寸保持不变。

description.en: Pressing Enter with an empty composer steers the first queued message into the running turn while the agent is busy.
description.zh: agent 正在处理任务时，输入框空着按回车，队列第一条消息就会插话送进当前回合。

description.en: UI polish layer for the DSH web client: frosted-glass menu surfaces, a draggable reasoning-effort slider that replaces the level radio list, and model-menu navigation that reaches the model list in one click and closes on a single Esc.
description.zh: DSH 网页端界面打磨层：补上浮层毛玻璃材质，用可拖动滑杆替换推理等级单选列表，模型菜单一次点击直达列表、Esc 一次关闭。

description.en: Turns the composer send button into a tomato button while a task is running and the draft is empty. One or two taps hand the model a hidden note on its next step asking it to reflect on the approach and to finish by asking the user how to continue; three taps within a second stop the run first and send the same kind of note. Thrown-tomato animations and sound can be switched off in settings, which also counts every tomato thrown.
description.zh: 任务运行中且输入框为空时，把发送键换成番茄键。点一两下会让模型在下一步收到一条不对用户显示的提醒，要求它反思做法并以提问用户如何继续收尾；一秒内连点三下则先停止任务，再发同样的提醒。丢番茄特效与音效可在设置中关闭，设置页同时显示累计扔出的番茄总数。

description.en: A Codex-style conversation navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Codex 式对话导航与预览。

description.en: Radial right-click menu on conversation turns in the DSH web GUI for forking a session from a chosen turn, interrupting generation, copying the working directory path or session ID, opening the working directory, and exporting session logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话轮次上点击右键弹出的圆盘菜单：从此轮分叉出新会话、打断生成、复制工作目录路径与会话 ID、打开工作目录、导出会话日志。

description.en: Replaces the chat model picker with a collapsible provider-grouped list (640x720 max) that shows each model name, provider name, provider ID and exact model ID, plus a manually managed uncommon list and a separate favorites list. Classification is user-driven only: no usage tracking and no auto-sorting. Search covers model name, model ID, provider name, provider ID and account notes.
description.zh: 把聊天模型选择器换成按服务商分组的可折叠列表（最大 640x720），每款模型显示名称、服务商名称、服务商 ID 与精确模型 ID，另有手动整理的「不常用」列表和独立的收藏列表。分类只由用户决定：不统计使用频率、不自动分类。搜索覆盖模型名称、模型 ID、服务商名称、服务商 ID 与账号备注。

plugins.name: dsh-file-upload

description.en: Claude-style drag-and-drop/paperclip file upload with content sniffing, document-to-Markdown via Microsoft MarkItDown (built-in JS fallback), text inlining, and a read_document tool for agents.
description.zh: Claude 风格拖拽/回形针文件上传：内容嗅探、文档转 Markdown（微软 MarkItDown，内置 JS 兜底）、文本直插输入框、read_document 工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Turbo Vision-style character-cell window manager for dsh agents: overlapping framed windows with drop shadows, a Borland menu bar, a function-key strip, mouse drag and resize, approvals as modal dialogs, and five skins including the classic Borland blue.
description.zh: Turbo Vision 式字符窗口管理器：带投影的重叠窗口、Borland 菜单栏、功能键提示条、鼠标拖拽缩放、模态审批对话框，五套皮肤含经典 Borland 蓝。

description.en: Ghost-text completion for the composer: FIM suggestions stream in inline after a typing pause (SSE, first token rendered immediately), Tab accepts one word at a time and Shift+Tab takes all, in-flight requests are truly cancelled on retyping or Esc. Plus two-layer typo checking: a browser-local dictionary scan (Chinese wrong phrases, English misspellings and proper-noun capitalization, user-defined per-browser entries) with a debounced LLM context pass, underlined in red in the text with per-item navigation and click-to-fix.
description.zh: 输入框 ghost 补全：停笔后 FIM 建议内联流式渐显（SSE，首 token 即上屏），Tab 逐词采纳、Shift+Tab 全量，重新输入或 Esc 会真正取消在途请求；错别字双层检查：浏览器本地词典扫描（中文错词、英文错拼与专名大小写、本浏览器自定义词条）叠加防抖 LLM 上下文校对，文中红波浪线标注、逐条导航、点击修正。

description.en: Output gallery in the DSH sidebar: watches your on-disk output folder, shows auto-refreshing image thumbnails with zoom and pan, lists documents, code, data, archives and links that open in DSH native preview, and filters by outputs produced in the current conversation. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 把 DSH 右侧栏变成产出目录的实时画廊：监控磁盘产出目录，图片缩略图自动刷新、支持缩放拖动，文件卡片点击即调用 DSH 原生侧栏预览，还能按「本对话产出」筛选。零依赖。

description.en: Read-only Raindrop.io dashboard in the sidebar with collection and tag distribution, top source domains, content types, a 12-month trend and a cleanup backlog, plus two read-only agent tools for analyzing saved bookmarks. Requires a Raindrop.io API token (create an app and paste the token).
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Raindrop.io 只读仪表盘：分类与标签分布、域名来源 Top、内容类型、近 12 个月趋势与待清理项，并提供两个只读 Agent 工具分析收藏。需 Raindrop.io API token（创建应用后粘贴）。

description.en: Todoist-style todo management in the sidebar with projects, labels and priorities, CJK-aware natural-language quick-add, repeat rules, a stats dashboard, import and export, seven agent tools and due-time reminders.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的类 Todoist 待办管理：项目/标签/优先级、中英双语自然语言快速添加、重复规则、统计仪表盘、导入导出、七个 Agent 工具与到期提醒。

description.en: DSH productivity plugin: timeline navigation, prompt library, conversation export, quick notes, and more.
description.zh: DSH 效率插件：时间轴、提示词库、导出对话、闪记等提效功能。

description.en: One-click prompt improvement for the DSH composer: press the sparkle button to rewrite the draft into an agent-ready prompt, replaced in place and undoable, with a deterministic fidelity check that keeps every path, identifier, number, URL and backticked token verbatim, plus a length ceiling that blocks inflation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键增强提示词：点 ✦ 把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并可一键撤回；保真闸机械校验硬事实（路径、标识符、数字与版本、URL、反引号代码）逐字存活，长度闸防止把一句话需求膨胀成规格书。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH Web requests: sends a queued 「继续」 after network, timeout or host-crash failures, with error classification, adaptive backoff, templated continue text and browser notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web 请求中断自动续跑：网络、超时或宿主崩溃等非人为失败后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、模板化继续文本与浏览器通知。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: Embeds upstream quota and usage progress rings from your local Magpie gateway (127.0.0.1:3425) right beside the composer context meter, with session-aware active model tracking and 5-hour limit reset tooltips.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：将 Magpie 本地网关（127.0.0.1:3425）的配额与用量进度圆环嵌入输入框底部状态栏（与上下文比例并列），支持各会话模型自动跟随嗅探、置顶卡片自动置顶与 5 小时重置倒计时微型面板。

description.en: DeepSeek App-style mobile shell for the DSH Web UI with drawer navigation, app-like composer and settings; best paired with the dsh-android app, which supplies the native Android back key (standalone use works but is not recommended).
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供接近 DeepSeek App 的移动端壳层：抽屉导航、App 风格输入与设置；Android 返回键需搭配 dsh-android App（单独安装也能用，但作者不建议且可能有 bug）。

description.en: Adds deliverable-file buttons to the end of each agent turn (opens files with the OS default app) and a floating dot rail for jumping between conversation turns.
description.zh: 在每轮对话末尾添加产出文件按钮（用系统默认程序打开），并提供可在轮次间快速跳转的悬浮圆点导航栏。

description.en: Switch providers and models, adjust reasoning effort; each model remembers its own level.
description.zh: 切换供应商、模型与思考强度，每个模型各自记住档位。

description.en: Adds one button beside the composer that rewrites the draft into a more complete prompt in place, with no preview step, plus undo, a stop action, and optional conversation context.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个按钮，把草稿直接原地改写成更完整的提示词（无预览步骤），支持撤销、随时停止、可选参考本会话上下文。

description.en: Select text in a conversation to ask a context-free side question in a floating card, and browse every question as a network graph.
description.zh: 在对话里选中文字横向追问（空上下文的浮卡），所有追问连成一张可浏览的网状图，支持导出 PNG。

description.en: Monitor workspace sessions, subagents, todo progress and token usage in a floating panel.
description.zh: 在浮动面板中查看工作区会话、子代理状态、待办进度与 Token 用量。

description.en: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.
description.zh: 对话内悬浮药丸导轨：等距药丸、悬停预览、点击/拖拽跳转、分页自动加载，开关在设置-插件-插件配置。

description.en: Conversation outline panel for the DSH web surface: user questions as root nodes (index, time, tool count and text volume per turn) with the Markdown headings of assistant replies hanging beneath them, plus level slider, search scope, bookmarks, copy and export as Markdown, section jump, keyboard navigation, a right-edge density rail and per-session reading-position memory. Read-only UI: it never touches prompts, tool results or provider traffic, and writes nothing outside its own localStorage keys.
description.zh: Web 端会话大纲面板：用户提问为根节点（序号、提问时间、该轮工具数与正文量），助手回复的 Markdown 标题按层级挂在其下；带层级滑块、搜索范围、收藏、复制与导出 Markdown、节级跳转、键盘导航、右侧密度刻度条与按会话记忆的阅读位置。纯只读 UI：不接触提示词与工具结果，不向提供方发起请求，只写自己的 localStorage 键。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict protection.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: Renders LaTeX in the chat — formulas inside your own message bubble, plus a live preview of the composer draft while you type.
description.zh: 在聊天里渲染 LaTeX：你自己的消息气泡内联渲染公式，输入时还会实时预览草稿里的公式。

description.en: LaTeX snippet expansion in the composer, built from Obsidian LaTeX Suite's own defaults — 138 triggers expand as they are typed, Tab walks the tabstops, and the table of 142 is editable in one JSON file.
description.zh: 输入框里的 LaTeX 片段展开，触发词表直接取自 Obsidian Latex Suite 的默认片段——138 条打完即出，Tab 依次跳 tabstop，142 条全在一份可编辑的 JSON 里。

description.en: Search field on the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page that filters the installed and official plugin cards as you type, matching each card title, description and package name; space-separated keywords must all match.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness「插件」页加一条关键词搜索框：边输入边过滤已安装与官方插件卡片，命中范围是卡片标题、描述与包名，空格分隔的多个关键词之间是 AND。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web client and a translate button appears at the end of the selection; clicking it translates that text in place. Translation goes through the host llm service, so it reuses the model the current session already has selected and needs no separate API key; an OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be configured instead. The result opens in a popover that stays inside the viewport, with one-click copy, a row of language buttons for instant retranslation, and smart Chinese-to-English / other-to-Chinese as the default. Configuration is stored host-side and its API key is never sent to the browser.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页客户端里选中文字，选区末尾会出现一个翻译按钮，点击即就地翻译这段文字。翻译走宿主 llm 服务，直接复用当前会话已选的模型，无需另外配置 API Key；也可改用任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。结果在保持于视口内的浮层中展示，支持一键复制、一排语言按钮即时重译，默认智能中英互译（中文译英、其他语言译中）。配置保存在宿主端，其中的 API Key 永不下发到浏览器。

description.en: Floating phone-pairing QR button for the DSH WebUI. One click opens the dsh-remote-link pairing QR (image + 6-digit code + TTL) in an in-app overlay — works in both browser and DSH Desktop (same-origin img, no iframe).
description.zh: DSH WebUI 右下角悬浮「手机连接」二维码按钮：点击在应用内弹层显示配对二维码、6 位短码与倒计时，浏览器与 DSH 桌面端通吃（同源 img 渲染，无 iframe）。

description.en: One-click search-engine switcher beside the DeepSeek Harness model picker; changes the dsh-free-search provider, handy on overseas university networks that block the DeepSeek Official search endpoint.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁一键切换搜索服务商的下拉菜单；海外大学网络常拦截 DeepSeek 官方搜索，可借此切到其他引擎规避。

description.en: A sidebar assistant plugin for the Web interface, allows users to select any text, displays the model’s reasoning process and final answer in a floating panel.
description.zh: Web 界面的侧边栏助手插件,在 Web 聊天界面里选中任意文本，在浮层面板里流式显示思考过程与最终答案。

description.en: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.
description.zh: 给每个子代理标注它实际运行使用的模型路由：父会话目录行增加「mode · 活动状态 · 模型」徽标行，子代理会话页头显示同一读数。

description.en: Adds separate Chat and Work modes to DeepSeek Harness, embeds DeepSeek's official chat page, and provides an animated desktop companion with quick chat and task-completion notifications.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加聊天与工作双模式，内嵌 DeepSeek 官方聊天网页，并提供支持快捷聊天和任务完成提醒的桌面伙伴。

description.en: Shows the provider behind a session's current model as a compact badge in the DSH Web composer tool row, left of the model selector.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框工具行、模型选择器左侧显示当前会话所用模型的供应商。

description.en: A terminal UI (TUI) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端 UI（TUI）。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DSH with a whale-girl icon, background server startup, and a Chromium app-mode window without browser chrome.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面启动器，提供鲸鱼娘图标、后台服务启动和无浏览器工具栏的 Chromium 应用窗口。

description.en: Local-first character archive in the DSH sidebar: it interviews you about someone and writes the answers into Markdown cards, imports SillyTavern character cards, writes a novel chapter by chapter, and roleplays with a card plus its world book; anything written into a card has to be quotable from material you wrote.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的本地优先人物档案：访谈你身边的人并写成 Markdown 卡，能导入酒馆角色卡，也能逐章写小说、拿角色卡和世界书演一段；写进卡的每一条都要能在你写过的材料里找到原句。

description.en: Reads EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, TXT and PDF books in a side panel with pagination, table-of-contents jumping, highlights, notes, bookmarks, full-text search, anchored AI questions, per-chapter distillation, Legado-compatible book-source search that adds online books chapter by chapter, and a bundled reading-coach skill. PDF support is text-based only; scanned or encrypted PDFs are rejected.
description.zh: 在侧边栏里读 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、TXT、PDF 五种格式的书：分页、目录跳转与书内链接跳转、划线笔记与书签、全文搜索、带原文锚点的 AI 问答、按章蒸馏，并能导入 Legado 格式书源按章抓取在线书籍，随包还带一个陪读教练 skill。PDF 只支持文字版，扫描件与加密 PDF 会被拒绝。

description.en: Adds two buttons beside the sidebar toggle at the top-left of the DSH desktop UI, on macOS, Windows and Linux. Reload refreshes only the UI layer while a turn already generating keeps running; restart asks for one confirmation, quits the whole app and reopens it with sessions and workspaces intact. Restart is a POST that must carry a random per-boot token read from the plugin's status route. The plugin makes no network calls, reads no session content and has zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版界面左上角「收起侧边栏」按钮旁加两个按钮，macOS、Windows、Linux 三端都可用。刷新只重载界面层，宿主里正在生成的回合不中断；重启会在确认一次后退出整个应用并自动重新打开，会话与工作区都在。重启是 POST，必须带每次启动随机生成的 token（由插件状态接口提供）；插件不联网、不读会话内容、零运行时依赖。

description.en: A split-flap salary board for the DSH Web UI. Enter monthly salary, hours per day, working days per month and a start time, and the board settles today's earnings every 2 seconds on eight flip cells (currency symbol, four integer digits, decimal point, two decimals). Shows 0.00 before the shift, caps at the daily wage after it, and handles shifts that cross midnight. Six color schemes, drag anywhere (the position is kept on this machine), and a close button that collapses the board into a pill in the session header. Pure client-side bundle: no network calls and no dependencies.
description.zh: 挂在 DSH 网页界面上的翻牌工资看板。填好月薪、每天工时、每月工作天数、上班时间，板子每 2 秒结算一次今天赚了多少，用八格翻牌显示（人民币符号、四位整数、小数点、两位小数）。上班前显示 0.00，下班后封顶日薪，跨午夜的班次同样处理。六套配色，可拖到任意位置（位置存在本机），点关闭按钮收进会话顶栏的胶囊。纯前端 bundle，不联网、无依赖。

description.en: Workspace groups for the DSH sidebar with group navigation and session status indicators.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏提供工作区分组、组间导航和会话状态提示。

description.en: Work todo reminders in a sidebar panel with four stage tabs (not started, in progress, overdue, done) plus separate recurring and paused filters, priority derived from the end time in real time, pinning that survives overdue, and enable/disable for recurring tasks. Recurrence covers workdays (following China's statutory holidays and make-up workdays), selected weekdays, monthly dates with month-end rollover, and 5-field cron; one-off tasks default to start and end reminders (start optional, end required); meetings can disable the end reminder. Alerts appear in a page overlay with optional browser notifications, snooze and quiet hours. Twelve agent tools; weekly/monthly reports, natural-language quick add, and cross-view search; data is a single local JSON file with completed tasks archived per quarter.
description.zh: 侧边栏「工作待办」面板：未开始 / 进行中 / 已超期 / 已完成四阶段页签 + 循环任务与已暂停独立筛选，优先级按结束时间实时派生，置顶任务超期也不下沉，循环任务可随时启停。循环规则覆盖工作日（跟随中国法定节假日与调休）、指定星期、每月指定日期（月末顺延）与 5 段式 cron；单次任务在开始与结束两个时间点各提醒一次。提醒以页面浮层呈现，可选浏览器系统通知，支持稍后提醒与免打扰。提供 12 个 Agent 工具，支持周报/月报、自然语言快速新建与跨视图搜索；数据为本地单个 JSON 文件，已完成任务按季度归档。

description.en: A retro macOS System 7-style workstation UI for DeepSeek Harness with desktop windows, Workspace and Agent management, Finder, Terminal, Monitor, context tools, and desk accessories.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供复古 macOS System 7 风格工作站界面，包含桌面窗口、工作区与 Agent 管理、Finder、终端、监视器、上下文工具和桌面附件。

description.en: The missing backend for the dsh-artifacts sidebar tab — serves the /report artifact index and the artifact bytes it renders.
description.zh: 为 dsh-artifacts 侧边栏补上缺失的后端，提供 /report 产物索引与预览所需的文件内容。

description.en: Full-screen Changzhengji-themed boot animation for DSH with a six-step authorization sequence, seven built-in real-voice packs, two switchable emblems, five switchable character portraits, and an optional access-password gate.
description.zh: DSH 全屏长征机主题开机动画，包含六步授权流程、七款内置真声音色、两款可切换图案、五款可切换人物立绘，并支持可选的访问密码校验。

description.en: Generative UI: the model calls render_ui with a React snippet and the answer renders as an interactive card in the conversation. The snippet runs in a sandboxed iframe with an opaque origin, so it cannot read the host page, its storage or its cookies, and the frame CSP blocks the network; a message from a card is only sent after the user confirms it, and a failing card shows its error with the source behind a toggle.
description.zh: 生成式 UI：模型调用 render_ui 写一段 React，回答就地渲染成可交互卡片。代码跑在 opaque origin 的沙箱 iframe 里，读不到宿主页面、存储与 cookie，帧内 CSP 挡掉网络；卡片要发消息必须由用户确认，卡片出错时显示原因、源码放在开关后面。

description.en: Next-prompt suggestions: after each answer it predicts your next message as grey ghost text in the composer. Tab fills it without sending, and the prediction model is selectable.
description.zh: 下一句：每轮回答后预测你的下一条输入，以浅灰 ghost 文本显示在输入框。按 Tab 填入但不发送，预测模型可选。

description.en: Separate font slots for content, code and terminal text, plus an interface font, an interface-size stepper and an inline-code size stepper, with line-height and letter-spacing controls. Typography only — it never touches colour.
description.zh: 内容、代码与终端文字各一个字体槽，另加界面字体、界面字号步进器与行内代码字号步进器，附行距与字距。只改排印，不动配色。

description.en: Tauri 2 desktop app for DeepSeek Harness (macOS + Windows; installers on the repository's Releases page) with a built-in dsh runtime: tray-resident launcher with per-profile ports and windows, a process guardian that auto-heals up to three times, local or remote dsh, task-completion notifications with a Dock badge, and a live startup console. This plugin is the app's in-page half — its desktop chrome and notification bridge only take effect when DSH runs inside the desktop app; added to a regular DSH with `dsh plugin add`, it provides the bundled skill for packaging a DSH Web GUI as a Tauri app.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows，安装包见仓库 Releases，内置 dsh 运行时）：托盘常驻启动器（按 profile 分端口与窗口）、最多自愈 3 次的进程守护、本地或远程 dsh、带 Dock 角标的任务完成通知、实时启动控制台。本插件是该应用的页面内半区——桌面 chrome 与通知桥只在 DSH 运行于桌面应用内时生效；在普通 DSH 里用 `dsh plugin add` 安装时，提供的是随附的「把 DSH Web GUI 打包成 Tauri 应用」技能。

description.en: Adds a capsule split-button to the conversation header: launch VS Code, terminal, or File Explorer at the current workspace directory in one click.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部添加胶囊拆分按钮，一键在当前工作区打开 VS Code、终端和文件资源管理器。

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供按 profile 管理的键盘快捷键：支持 Question 和 Approval 卡片、Standard/Vim/Custom 配置，并按能力提供 Session 与 Workspace 导航。

description.en: Host page for kit plugin configuration in the DSH Web GUI: registers a "Plugin configuration" section in Settings — peer to the built-in General section — through the official settings.section slot and declares a settings.kit.item child slot, which dsh-plugin-kit plugins render their own config cards into. Installing it alone shows an empty page; cards appear as slot-registering kit plugins are installed.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中 kit 插件配置的宿主页：经官方 settings.section 扩展点在「设置」里注册一行与「通用设置」平级的「插件配置」页，并声明子 slot「settings.kit.item」，供 dsh-plugin-kit 各插件把自己的配置卡片渲染到该页。只装本包时该页显示「暂无可用配置项」，卡片随注册该 slot 的 kit 插件出现。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-kit#tty

description.en: Terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar "Terminal" entry opens a multi-tab xterm.js interactive terminal over a real PTY (node-pty), with SSH remote tabs (ssh2, agent / key / password auth), a cwd following the current session, and tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的终端面板：侧边栏「终端」打开多标签页 xterm.js 全交互终端（node-pty 真实 PTY），支持 ssh2 原生 SSH 远程标签页（agent/key/password 三种认证），cwd 跟随当前会话，并提供 tty_list / tty_capture / tty_send 三个 agent 工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a sparkle button beside the model picker that rewrites the current draft into a spec sized to the draft — two or three steps for a small ask, a longer checklist only when the request has several parts — and puts the original text back when pressed again. Greetings and small talk pass through untouched without calling the model.
description.zh: 在模型选择器旁加一个 ✨ 按钮，把草稿改写成规模随草稿而变的执行规格（小请求只给两三条步骤，多部分请求才展开成清单），再按一次按钮恢复原文；问候与闲聊直接放行，不调用模型。

description.en: Legal training workbench: three-pane academic UI that reads the "Minglü" (lawagent preset) learning profile (case dossiers, flashcards, wrong-answer book, notes) and sends instructions into a Minglü session with one click.
description.zh: 法学学习实训工作台：三栏学术风界面，直读「明律」（lawagent preset）的学习档案（案件卷宗/背诵卡/错题本/笔记），并可一键把指令送进明律会话。

description.en: Legal knowledge-base workbench: hybrid keyword/statistical/vector retrieval over local statute .doc/.docx corpora, faceted filtering, charge-name and civil-cause trees, a document editor, and four AI tools (citation check, contract review, AI analysis, AI drafting).
description.zh: 法律知识库工作台：直读本地法规 .doc/.docx 语料，关键词/统计语义/向量三路融合检索、双维度筛选、案名索引与民事案由树、文书编辑器，以及引用核验/合同审查/AI 分析/AI 文书生成四件套。

description.en: Chat agent for a DeepSeek Harness session: create characters and write their personas, keep several archive threads per character, undo or rewind the locally stored transcript, and record story beats in an event book.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的一个会话变成聊天 agent：新建人物并写人设、为同一人物开多条档案线、本地保存的对话可撤销可回溯、剧情节点记进事件簿。

description.en: Clean desktop shell for DSH: launch by double-clicking a desktop shortcut like any normal desktop app, live backend monitoring with one-click tray start/restart/stop (progress dialogs), offline auto-reconnect, single instance. Reuses your existing web profile, no restyling of the web UI. Windows + macOS.
description.zh: DSH 纯净桌面壳：双击桌面快捷方式即可像普通桌面软件一样启动；后端活性实时监测 + 托盘一键启停/重启（带进度弹窗）、离线自动重连、单实例。复用现有 web profile，不改动 web 界面。Windows + macOS 双平台。

description.en: In-session "Files" tab (conversation.view, order 20) for dsh Web that browses the active session's workspace directory with breadcrumbs and previews files inline — sanitized Markdown (marked + DOMPurify), images, line-numbered text and PDF — served by read-only /dsh-files host routes registered on ctx.webServer; no write endpoints. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: dsh Web 会话内「文件」页签（conversation.view，order 20）：以当前会话工作区为根的面包屑目录浏览，内联预览消毒渲染的 Markdown（marked + DOMPurify）、图片、带行号文本与 PDF；目录与读取全部经 ctx.webServer 注册的只读 /dsh-files 宿主路由，无任何写端点（中英双语）。

description.en: Workspace-first enhanced sidebar for dsh Web that shadows the built-in workspace browser at low priority (one-click toggle back to the official one) and adds soft workspace archive/restore, per-workspace SVG icons and accent colors, drag reorder and title/path/session-content search, plus a ⌘K Spotlight palette fuzzy-searching workspaces and sessions; the host half ships read-only workspace_find/workspace_list model tools and /workspace-find /workspace-list slash commands. Bilingual zh/en.
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web 的工作区优先增强侧栏：以低优先级 shadow 内置工作区浏览器（可一键切回官方版），提供软归档/恢复、每工作区 SVG 图标与强调色、拖拽排序与标题/路径/会话内容搜索；另提供 ⌘K Spotlight 面板模糊搜索工作区/会话；宿主侧附带只读 workspace_find/workspace_list 工具与 /workspace-find /workspace-list 斜杠命令（中英双语）。

description.en: Composer attach button for DSH Web: multi-file picks become inline draft capsules, files are stored under the workspace uploads root with an auto-extracted UTF-8 .txt sidecar (txt/docx/xlsx/pptx/zip/odt, zero dependencies), and sent messages carry only the file name — never a raw path.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框附件按钮：多选文件以内联草稿胶囊形式插入；文件存储到工作区 uploads 目录并自动生成 UTF-8 .txt 提取件（txt/docx/xlsx/pptx/zip/odt，零依赖），任何纯文本 Agent 都能直接读取；发送消息只带文件名，不泄漏路径。

description.en: Adds a Restart button beside the permission control in the composer toolbar that relaunches DSH in one click, so freshly installed plugins apply without closing and reopening the app.
description.zh: 在对话框工具栏「完全权限」右侧加一个「重启」按钮，点击即重启 DSH，装完插件不用再手动关掉重开。

description.en: Manageable one-tap text chips above the session composer; idle sessions queue the message and running sessions steer at the next safe boundary without rewriting the draft.
description.zh: 在会话输入区上方提供可管理的一点即发文本 chip；空闲时 queue、运行中 steer，不改写草稿。

plugins.name: dsh-update-status

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar version chip that shows the running DSH version, npm latest/next/alpha channels, compatibility labels, and a copy-only upgrade command.
description.zh: 只读的 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧栏版本芯片，显示当前运行版本、npm latest/next/alpha 通道、兼容性标识，以及仅复制的升级命令。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.microsoft.com

description.en: Shows a 0-100 conversation coherence badge and commentary by running parallel contradiction analysis on the live DSH session, with a manual trigger and interval-based auto-analysis (on by default, editable per session or globally).
description.zh: 对当前 DSH 会话做并行矛盾分析，在会话标题栏显示 0–100 连贯性徽章与评注，支持手动触发和按轮数的自动分析（默认开启，可按会话或全局调整）。

description.en: Adds a docked-first vertical shorts wall to the DSH Web UI with YouTube Shorts and Bilibili sources, keyword rotation, four-corner resizing, and Alt+S/Alt+M shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入默认贴边的竖屏短视频墙：YouTube Shorts 与 B站双源、关键词轮换、四角缩放及 Alt+S/Alt+M 快捷键。

description.en: Shows DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing status, a countdown to the next rate change, and the estimated session cost as inline text beside the model selector.
description.zh: 在模型选择器旁以行内文字显示 DeepSeek 峰谷定价状态、距下一次调价的倒计时，以及本次会话的预估费用。

plugins.name: dsh-mosaic

description.en: Renders a dsh-view fence in an assistant reply as cards — text, tables, charts, Mermaid diagrams and sandboxed HTML widgets — with an editable model prompt, a render_view tool and a bundled skill.
description.zh: 把回答里的 dsh-view 围栏渲染成卡片——文本、表格、图表、Mermaid 图与沙箱 HTML 组件——并提供可编辑的模型提示、render_view 工具和内置技能。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

description.en: Adds conversation naming, file drag references, edit-and-resend, a message timeline, and a floating settings panel to the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 增加对话命名、文件拖拽引用、编辑重发、消息时间线和悬浮设置面板。

description.en: Claude Code-style sidebar for the macOS desktop app: hovering the collapsed sidebar toggle peeks the sidebar over the content, selecting a session collapses it, clicking the toggle pins it; plus back/forward session history arrows (⌘\[ / ⌘]).
description.zh: 仿 Claude Code 的侧栏（macOS 桌面版）：悬停在折叠的侧栏按钮上即可将侧栏浮层展开，选择会话后自动收起，点击按钮固定；另有会话历史前进/后退箭头（⌘\[ / ⌘]）。

description.en: Hold Ctrl and roll the mouse wheel to zoom the whole Harness Web UI around the pointer, 50-200% in 10% steps; Ctrl +/- and Ctrl 0 from the keyboard; a bottom-right chip and a Page zoom row in Settings → General show and reset the level.
description.zh: 按住 Ctrl 滚动鼠标滚轮即可缩放整个 Harness 网页界面，以指针位置为锚点、50%–200% 每档 10%；另支持 Ctrl 加减号与 Ctrl+0 快捷键；右下角缩放胶囊与「设置 → 通用」里的页面缩放行显示当前档位并可一键复位；档位保存在 localStorage。

description.en: Native DSH plugin that renders structured data as inline charts directly inside the conversation, with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 原生 DSH 插件：把结构化数据渲染成对话流内联图表，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into the GUI once ready, plus a desktop_launch tool.
description.zh: Windows 一键启动器：无边框 WPF 启动动画（HARNESS 逐笔描边），后台拉起 dsh web 并在 GUI 就绪后淡入，附 desktop_launch 工具。

description.en: Fonts and code-font settings for the UI with an English-only glyph scale (100-160%), a -4..+8 px content-size offset that actually applies, and settings kept across refreshes - a maintained fork of lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts.
description.zh: 在设置页自定义界面中英文与代码字体，支持只放大拉丁字形的英文字形缩放（100-160%）与 -4..+8 px 的内容字号偏移，刷新后保留设置；lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts 的维护分支。

description.en: Configures from the settings window's General page whether Enter, Shift+Enter and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter send the message or insert a line break; the engine default is kept until you change it.
description.zh: 在设置窗口的通用页配置 Enter、Shift+Enter、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 是发送消息还是换行；未改动前完全保持引擎默认行为。

description.en: Shares one right-sidebar across every conversation in the same workspace, so you don't have to reopen it when creating or switching conversations, with a switch in Settings → General.
description.zh: 让同一工作区内的所有对话共用同一份右侧边栏，不用新建或者切换对话时候重新打开，并在「设置 → 通用」提供开关。

description.en: Counts the prompts you send in the Web GUI and turns them into a push-up debt, shown as a chip under the composer with one-click pay-off, partial payments and a day streak.
description.zh: 统计你在 Web 界面中发送的消息并换算成俯卧撑欠账，在输入框下方以计数器显示，支持一键结清、部分还款和连续天数记录。

description.en: A 44x44 always-on-top desktop ball for DSH that reflects what the agent is actually doing (thinking, searching, web fetch, error, waiting for input) and shows an exclamation or question-mark badge when a task finishes or needs an answer while you are away. Windows only; it downloads its own Electron runtime on first use.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的桌面情绪小球：44×44 置顶小挂件，实时反映 agent 正在做什么（思考、检索、联网、出错、等待输入）；任务在你不看时完成、或有问题等你回答时，右上角亮「!」「?」角标。仅 Windows；首次使用会自行下载 Electron 运行时。

description.en: Live flowgraph visualization for DeepSeek Harness sessions, including tool calls, parallel groups, subagent branches, and drill-down details.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话实时流程图，可查看工具调用、并行分组、子代理分支和逐层详情。

description.en: Manage skills and MCP servers from one DSH settings panel. Skills are read from disk: browse, search, preview the body, create, rename and delete, with a backup written before every removal. Global MCP servers are the real cordis.patch.yml loader rows; per-project entries mount only for sessions in that project. Each expanded card lists the tools that server actually registered, and a per-server allow/deny rule keeps only the ones you need — a blocked tool never enters the tool registry, so it costs no context on every turn. Every MCP card carries a connection status tag (connected with a tool count, retrying, gave up, activation failed) plus a one-click reconnect, so a server that fails at startup is visible instead of silently missing its tools. Imports existing configs from 26 other MCP clients.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板里一站式管理技能与 MCP 服务器。技能以磁盘为准：浏览、搜索、预览正文、新建、重命名、删除，删除前自动写一份备份。全局 MCP 就是 cordis.patch.yml 里的真实 Loader 行，项目级条目只挂到对应项目的会话。展开卡片会列出该服务器实际注册的工具，并可只保留需要的那些——被挡下的工具不进工具注册表，因此不占用每一轮的上下文。每张卡片带连接状态标签（已连接并显示工具数 / 重试中 / 已放弃重试 / 激活失败）与一键重连，让启动时连不上、工具悄悄消失的服务器看得见。另可从 26 个 MCP 客户端导入既有配置。

description.en: One-click screenshot button that floats over every DSH page, with a second one in the composer tool row: it captures the DeepSeek Harness window (or the whole desktop with a modifier) using the host capture tooling and puts the PNG where it is useful — straight into the composer draft as an attachment, or on the clipboard when no composer is mounted. Windows-verified, with macOS and Linux backends; no dependencies and no build step.
description.zh: 悬浮在任意 DSH 页面上的一键截图按钮（输入框工具行里另有一个）：用宿主侧工具截取 DeepSeek Harness 窗口（按住修饰键可截整个桌面），并把 PNG 放到用得上的地方——直接作为附件落进输入框草稿，没有输入框时放进剪贴板。Windows 实测，另带 macOS/Linux 后端；零依赖、无构建步骤。

description.en: Replaces the composer model button with one panel holding a provider-grouped model list with search, pinned favorite models, and a reasoning-effort slider with one stop per level the model advertises, whose aurora gradient and glow grow with the level; the last effort used with each model is restored when switching back, and the built-in selector stays registered underneath as a fallback.
description.zh: 用一个面板替换输入框的模型按钮：按服务商分组的模型列表与搜索、置顶的收藏模型，以及按模型声明档位分级的思考程度滑杆，其极光渐变与光晕随档位增强；切回某个模型时恢复上次用过的档位，内置选择器仍作为备用保持注册。

description.en: Displays real-time CPU and memory usage for the machine running the DSH Web server.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面右上角实时显示运行 DSH 服务端机器的 CPU 与内存使用情况。

description.en: A floating Bot / ADE switch for the DSH web UI. One click moves between ds-bot's Bot surface and the classic DSH Agent surface, while ds-bot keeps running with its data untouched.
description.zh: 悬浮在 DSH 界面上的 Bot / ADE 切换开关：一键在 ds-bot 的 Bot 界面与经典 DSH Agent 界面之间切换，ds-bot 保持加载、数据不受影响。

description.en: A draw.io editor as a .drawio file viewer in the DSH sidebar: diagrams are ordinary workspace files (new ones default to docs/diagrams/), edits autosave, and a file changed outside the editor is refused with a conflict bar instead of being overwritten; the editor is downloaded once from a pinned upstream release with a SHA-256 check and then runs fully offline.
description.zh: 把 draw.io 编辑器接进 DSH 侧边栏的 .drawio 文件预览器：图纸就是工作区里的普通文件（新建默认落在 docs/diagrams/），改动自动保存，文件被编辑器以外的东西改过时会拒绝覆盖并弹出冲突条；编辑器首次使用时从固定上游版本下载并校验 SHA-256，之后完全离线运行。

description.en: Renders mermaid code blocks in dsh web chat as diagrams. Each block gets a toggle in its header to switch between the diagram and the source; blocks still streaming stay as code until the message settles. Mermaid loads lazily the first time a diagram is shown. The terminal UI is unaffected.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话里把 mermaid 代码块渲染成图：每个代码块头部有切换按钮，可在图与源码之间切换；仍在流式输出的块保持源码，等消息结束后再渲染；首次显示图时才懒加载 mermaid；终端 UI 不受影响。

description.en: Beyond the built-in @: line ranges (@src/a.ts:12-40), skills, plugins and any git repo — with the token cost of each reference shown before you send.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内置 @ 引用之上扩展：精确到行的行区间（@src/a.ts:12-40）、Skill、插件与任意 git 仓库，并在发送前显示每条引用的 token 成本。

description.en: Small-window mode for DSH NEXT on Windows: a 425px-wide always-on-top sticky window with a drawer sidebar and animated transitions. Requires DSH NEXT; the other desktop client (dsh desktop) is not supported.
description.zh: DSH NEXT（Windows）的小窗模式：把主窗口切成 425px 宽、置顶的便签式小窗，侧栏变抽屉、进出带过渡动效。只支持 DSH NEXT，另一个桌面端 dsh desktop 不支持。

description.en: Renders edit and write tool calls as always-expanded side-by-side diffs styled like git diff, with optional syntax coloring and word-level highlighting.
description.zh: 将编辑与写入工具调用渲染为常开的双栏 diff，样式类似 git diff，可选语法配色与词级高亮。

description.en: Mobile-first DeepSeek Harness UI with an installable PWA, responsive navigation, and Web Push notifications when an agent completes successfully.
description.zh: 面向手机的 DeepSeek Harness 界面，提供可安装 PWA、响应式导航，以及 Agent 成功完成时的 Web Push 通知。

description.en: Flight recorder panel for DSH sessions: live monitoring, timeline replay with a tool waterfall and event inspector, per-agent cost attribution, and a cross-session cost overview.
description.zh: DSH 会话飞行记录仪面板：实时监视、时间轴回放（工具瀑布与事件检查器）、按 agent 归因成本，以及跨会话成本总览。

description.en: MCP server and skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel and a plugin-page config section with search, status lights, per-row switches, expandable details, and an add-server form following Codex mcp_servers fields.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器与技能管理面板：侧栏面板加插件页配置区，支持搜索、状态灯、逐行开关、详情，以及按 Codex mcp_servers 字段设计的添加服务器表单。

description.en: Two buttons beside the chat input: one rewrites the draft with the current directory in view, the other inserts a role template from 85 curated entries generated from the bundled `agents/` role library, which the settings card can extend with your own `.md` role files.
description.zh: 对话输入框旁的两个按钮：一个结合当前目录改写草稿，另一个插入角色模板——默认 85 条精选模板由随包携带的 `agents/` 角色库生成，设置卡可用自己的 `.md` 角色文件扩充。

description.en: Select any text in a DSH conversation and tap Ctrl to get an inline sub-topic card: streaming answer, follow-up tree, and drag-to-quote reference chips.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话里选中一段文字按 Ctrl，就地开出子话题卡片：流式解答、追问树，还能把树行拖成引用卡片。

description.en: Fairy III (Zenless Zone Zero) H.D.D skin for DeepSeek Harness: boot video, an eye-core dock that can be dragged vertically so it never covers text, and time-of-day greeting voices written by a model every day (5 lines, each <= 20 characters) and synthesized locally with GPT-SoVITS, with a fallback chain of today -> latest -> bundled audio so there is always something to hear. Replies can be spoken: a trailing marker line takes priority over length heuristics, and long replies can be compressed into one sentence first. The reader hashes the utterance it just played (MD5) so each reply is voiced exactly once, and switching sessions stays silent. Personal fork of dsh-fairy-zzz with its own package, route and storage namespace, plus a rate-limited summarize endpoint, POST-only engine control and bounded TTS and greeting caches. Two diagnostic logs (client revision, decision trace) are written next to the plugin and stay on the local machine. A personal fork of AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin (upstream package dsh-fairy-zzz): install this fork or the upstream, not both - both mount the full-screen skin on the same DSH surfaces. Dynamic greetings and spoken summaries need a DeepSeek-compatible API key in ~/.dsh/fairy-tts.json (or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY); without it only the bundled greeting audio plays.
description.zh: 《绝区零》Fairy Ⅲ 的 H.D.D 皮肤：开机动画、可沿纵轴拖动（X 轴固定）的常驻眼徽，用来避开正文；每天由模型生成 5 段时段问候台词（每句不超过 20 字），用本地 GPT-SoVITS 合成，取用顺序为「今日 → 最近一份 → 内置语音」，生成失败也有声音。回复可选朗读：末尾标记行优先于字数判断，长回复可先压成一句结论；朗读器对刚念过的句子做 MD5 去重，保证每条只念一次，切换会话保持安静。本仓库是 dsh-fairy-zzz 的个人定制分支，包名、路由与存储命名空间独立，并做了摘要接口限流、引擎启停改 POST、TTS 缓存与问候语定期清理。插件会在自身目录写两份本地诊断日志（客户端版本、决策追踪），只留本机、不外传。本仓库是 AssassinVIX/fairy-zzz-plugin（上游包名 dsh-fairy-zzz）的个人定制分支：与上游二选一安装，不要同时装——两者都会在相同的 DSH 界面挂载全屏皮肤。每日动态问候与朗读摘要需要 ~/.dsh/fairy-tts.json（或 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY）提供 DeepSeek 兼容 API key；未配置时只播放内置问候音频。

description.en: Folder-style session panel: organize sidebar sessions into your own folders with drag-to-assign, per-session aliases and archived dimming. Display-only — it never touches DSH grouping.
description.zh: 文件夹式会话面板：把侧栏会话装进自建文件夹，支持拖拽归类、会话别名与归档变淡；只做显示，不改 DSH 自己的分组。

description.en: Load, edit, manage, and hot-reload trusted JavaScript and TypeScript userscripts in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加载、编辑、管理和热重载可信的 JavaScript / TypeScript 用户脚本。

description.en: Finder clipboard paste for macOS: Cmd+C files or folders in Finder, then Ctrl+V in the DSH composer inserts their absolute paths; ordinary text paste with Cmd+V is untouched.
description.zh: macOS Finder 剪贴板粘贴：在 Finder 里 Cmd+C 复制文件或文件夹，回到 DSH 按 Ctrl+V 把绝对路径插入输入框；普通文本粘贴的 Cmd+V 不受影响。

plugins.name: dsh-ux

description.en: Solarized light theme, compact layout, think/tool-chain collapse capsules, and balance, session cost, and usage dashboards for the DSH web UI.
description.zh: Solarized 浅色主题、紧凑布局、思考/工具链折叠胶囊，以及余额、本轮成本与用量看板的 DSH Web 界面增强插件。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Pins an always-on-top progress bar while the agent runs a turn — the percentage is estimated from tool calls and filled to 100% when the turn ends — and badges the DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing window so large token operations ask for confirmation only during peak hours. The bar runs as a separate Electron process and is skipped when no Electron binary is found.
description.zh: 模型跑一次回合时，屏幕顶部常驻一条进度栏（百分比按工具调用次数递增估算，回合结束才补到 100%），并标出当前是 DeepSeek 峰时还是谷时——大额 token 的操作只在峰时先问你一句。进度栏是独立 Electron 进程，找不到 Electron 二进制时会跳过。

description.en: Gathers custom plugin settings pages and cards into draggable top tabs under a unified Plugin settings navigation row.
description.zh: 在设置弹窗中增加「插件设置」导航，将各插件的设置页与卡片统一收纳到可拖拽排序的顶部标签页中。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for the DSH Web GUI composer: pick a style before generating (logic-only, structured, or concise), or supply or clear a custom system prompt in settings; a sparkle button or Shift+Tab rewrites the current draft through the harness model, streams the result into an inline preview (original vs enhanced) with a live thinking timer, fills it back with one click, keeps an undo bar, and offers settings for model route, temperature, length limits, context awareness, undo-bar behavior and shortcuts.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 输入框旁的提示词增强插件：生成前可选仅优化逻辑、结构化重写或精简压缩，也可在设置页自定义或清空系统提示词；点 ✨ 或在输入框内按 Shift+Tab，把当前草稿交给宿主模型重写，结果流式显示在原文/增强的对比预览里并显示思考计时，一键回填并保留撤销条，设置页可调模型路由、温度、长度上限、上下文感知、撤销条行为与快捷键。

description.en: Composer-side prompt library: a button next to the input opens a picker with group chips and word-split AND search over saved snippets, inserting one into the draft or appending it, filling {{variables}} before insertion, with 13 built-in templates. Snippets live in one local JSON file behind a rev lock, a per-save backup, and whole-library JSON import/export; a settings page handles editing, grouping, pinning and a 6-second delete undo.
description.zh: 输入框旁的本地提示词库：按钮打开取用浮层，按分组 chips 与分词 AND 搜索筛选，插入或追加到草稿，插入前填充 {{变量}}，内置 13 套模板；数据存单个本地 JSON 文件，带 rev 乐观锁、每次保存前备份与整库 JSON 导入导出；设置页管理编辑、分组、置顶与 6 秒删除撤销。

description.en: A full-page console panel opened from the sidebar, with eight tabs: an overview; a session list read from the sessions service (title, directory, running state, updated time, with filters); installed bundles and Loader entries from pluginInventory and pluginManager, with per-bundle enable switches; a plugin market listing public topic:dsh-plugin repositories from the GitHub search API; a model and provider editor that writes the llm-pi-ai settings namespace through remote.settings.mutate (switch a session model, add or edit providers and their model lists, and store API keys via remote.credentials, merging over the stored profile so fields the form does not expose survive an edit); MCP and skills tabs; and a usage tab that reads the host's loopback /api/dsh-usage/overview document. Services are declared through ctx.inject, so a deployment that omits one mounts without the console rather than crashing.
description.zh: 从侧栏打开的整页控制台面板，含八个标签：总览；从 sessions 服务读取的会话列表（标题、目录、运行状态、更新时间，带筛选）；从 pluginInventory 与 pluginManager 读取的已装 bundle 与 Loader 条目，每个 bundle 带启用开关；列出 GitHub 搜索 API 中 topic:dsh-plugin 公开仓库的插件市场；一个模型与供应商编辑器，通过 remote.settings.mutate 写入 llm-pi-ai 配置命名空间（切换会话模型、新增或编辑供应商及其模型列表、经 remote.credentials 保存 API Key，并以合并方式写入以免表单未暴露的字段被覆盖）；MCP 与技能两个标签；以及一个读取宿主回环 /api/dsh-usage/overview 文档的用量标签。所需服务通过 ctx.inject 声明，缺少任一服务的部署只是不挂载该面板，不会崩溃。

description.en: Composer prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: a button beside the model selector rewrites the draft through one auxiliary LLM call and writes the result back in place, with composer undo left intact; a /prompt-enhance slash command returns the rewritten prompt as a command result line without touching the draft; the enhancement call can be pinned to its own fast provider and model in the profile patch; the rewrite policy is faithful - original intent, language and information are kept, code, commands and paths are preserved verbatim, and nothing is invented or padded with placeholder text.
description.zh: 输入框提示词一键增强：模型选择器旁的按钮把草稿经一次辅助模型调用改写后直接写回输入框，输入框撤销不受影响；/prompt-enhance 命令把改写结果以命令结果行显示、不改动草稿；可在 profile 补丁里为增强调用单独固定 provider 和模型；改写忠实原文，保留意图、语言与信息量，代码、命令与路径原样保留，不编造事实、不输出占位文字。

description.en: Drag files and folders from the sidebar Files pane into the message composer. A dropped file becomes an inline chip inside the sentence, an uploaded attachment card, or a plain @ path, switchable in Settings.
description.zh: 把右侧文件区的文件和文件夹拖进输入框：落下的文件变成句中内嵌的小卡片、附件卡片或 @ 路径，可在设置里切换。

description.en: Uses a configurable system-prompt section to request a chosen reasoning language (Simplified Chinese by default), and expands thinking rows by default while preserving rows the user manually collapses.
description.zh: 通过可配置的系统提示词章节要求模型使用指定语言推理（默认简体中文），并默认展开思考行，同时保留用户手动折叠的状态。

description.en: Right-click any file reference in the chat to open it, open it with an associated application, reveal it in the file manager, copy its path or contents, and save it.
description.zh: 右键聊天里的任意文件引用，即可打开、用系统关联应用打开、在文件管理器中定位、复制路径或文件内容、另存为。

description.en: Select completed assistant text, add comments, and send compact annotation labels with source navigation in official DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web; no host patches required.
description.zh: 在官方 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 Web 中选中已完成的助手回复添加评论，以紧凑批注标签发送并跳转原文，无需修改主体。

description.en: Sidebar leaderboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): LMArena blind-test ratings, Artificial Analysis intelligence index, LiveBench 2.0 capability, OpenRouter weekly/monthly usage and market share, price, speed and context — plus a local token-usage dashboard built from your own session logs (tokens, estimated cost, per-model ranking), model detail drawers and CSV export. Daily snapshot, instant open, no API key; locally configured models are highlighted.
description.zh: 侧栏大模型排行榜：LMArena 盲测评分、Artificial Analysis 智能指数、LiveBench 2.0 能力榜、OpenRouter 周榜/月榜与市场份额，附价格、速度与上下文；另有本机用量仪表盘（只读会话日志统计 tokens、估算花费与模型用量排行）、明细抽屉与 CSV 导出。数据由宿主每日快照，面板打开即显示，并高亮本机已接入的模型。

description.en: Windows only; needs PowerShell and the bundled install.ps1. Adds an interface menu to the left of the model selector with three actions that run immediately: reload the interface, restart DSH, and close DSH. The Windows build ships no built-in reload or restart entry, so this adds one.
description.zh: 仅 Windows，需 PowerShell 与附带的 install.ps1。在模型选择左侧加一个「界面」菜单：刷新界面、重启 DSH、关闭 DSH，三项都即点即执行；Windows 版 DSH 没有内置的重载或重启入口，这里补上。

description.en: One stylesheet plus two small DOM patches that line third-party sidebar entries up with the host: matching row height, padding and icon size, one consistent active background, and mutual exclusion so the cron panel and the host panels never overlap.
description.zh: 一张样式表加两个很小的 DOM 补丁，把第三方侧栏入口拉回与宿主一致：行高、内边距与图标尺寸对齐，选中底色统一，并让定时任务面板与宿主面板互斥、不再互相覆盖。

description.en: Adds a Restart button to the DSH Desktop sidebar. It opens the same native confirmation dialog as the tray Exit item and, once approved, shuts the app down gracefully and relaunches it. This plugin only draws the button: it also needs the companion shell patch shipped in shell-patch/ in the same repository, which has to be applied from outside DSH while the app is closed. Installed on its own, the button stays disabled and a tooltip explains why. The companion shell patch is Windows only and rewrites the installed app.asar.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 侧边栏底部加一个「重启」按钮：弹出与托盘「退出 DeepSeek Harness」完全相同的原生确认框，确认后优雅关闭并重新拉起。注意：本插件只负责画这个按钮，必须同时应用同一仓库 shell-patch/ 里的外壳补丁，且该补丁要在 DSH 关闭时由 DSH 之外的脚本执行。单独安装插件时按钮为禁用状态，悬停提示会说明原因。配套外壳补丁仅支持 Windows，会改写已安装的 app.asar。

description.en: Conversation Canvas tab: live-preview workspace HTML artifacts and export PNG/JPG/SVG locally (`npx dsh-canvas-preview`).
description.zh: Conversation Canvas 标签页：实时预览工作区内的 HTML artifact，并支持本地导出 PNG/JPG/SVG（`npx dsh-canvas-preview`）。

description.en: Standalone workspace file-tree panel for the DSH web UI: a session-header icon opens an animated popup of the current workspace tree; click or drag a file to insert its reference into the composer, with search, inline preview, live settings, and zh/en i18n; single-purpose, zero-config, one-command install.
description.zh: 独立单功能的工作区文件树面板：会话头部图标打开当前工作区目录树的动画弹窗；点击或拖拽文件即可把引用插入输入框；自带搜索、行内预览、实时设置与中英双语；零配置，一条命令即装即用。

description.en: Korean UI language pack that adds 한국어 to Settings → General → Language through the official language-pack API.
description.zh: 韩语界面语言包，通过官方语言包 API 在 设置 → 通用 → 语言 中添加韩语（한국어）。

description.en: Plays an intro full-frame when you open DSH, when you open a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. The built-in footage is themed on a Wandering Earth-style space station and the quantum AI MOSS (550W): a red single eye ignites while the Earth’s curve slides past the viewport. Four clips ship embedded in the code — no separate video files — and the library lets you tick any number to rotate at random (never the same clip twice in a row), preview the rotation, or swap in your own videos. Sound plays without a click; the pin button sits beside Settings.
description.zh: 打开 DSH 时、打开新对话时，或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，播放一段全屏片头动画。内置素材是《流浪地球》风格的太空站与量子 AI MOSS（550W）：红色单眼点亮，地球弧线从视窗外掠过。四段片子直接内嵌在代码里，不需要单独的视频文件；片库可勾选任意几段随机轮换（不会连续两次同一段）、预览轮换，也能换成你自己的视频。声音无需点击即可播放；钉住按钮就在设置旁边。

description.en: 1:1 port of DeepSeek's official web right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav): hover-expandable rail, reading-position highlight, click-to-jump.
description.zh: 1:1 复刻 DeepSeek 官网右侧对话导航栏（ScrollNav）：悬停展开面板、阅读位置高亮、点击跳转。

description.en: Liquid Glass refraction input card for the DSH web GUI, with coupled-spring press animation. Published on npm: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 输入卡加上液态玻璃折射效果与弹簧按压动画。已发布 npm：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liquid-glass-input。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness with auto-collapsing process, a minimap-style message navigation rail, in-page search, unified failure cards, and generative MCP Apps (SEP-1865) in sandboxed iframes.
description.zh: 阅读视图增强插件——执行过程自动收起、右缘消息导航导轨、页内查找、统一失败卡片，支持生成式 MCP Apps（SEP-1865）沙箱交互。

description.en: Live btop-style CPU/memory/temperature/GPU monitor tab for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的实时监控标签页，以 btop 风格展示 CPU／内存／温度／GPU。

description.en: Add a Harness start page with session search, recent conversations, daily tasks, and a focus timer.
description.zh: 为 Harness 添加起始页，集中查看会话搜索、最近会话、今日待办和专注计时。

description.en: Mobile-first Web UI quality-of-life pack for the DeepSeek Harness: a Chrome-style active-session tab bar, full-screen sidebar swipe open/close, overlay sidebar, collapsed-sidebar recents, keyboard-suppressing session switching, viewport/IME keyboard adaptation, touch feedback, code/table inner scrolling, hidden permission dropdown, a full-screen settings rewrite with tab memory, and a compositor-driven status pulse, no-touch-drag long-press protection — 14 features, each independently toggleable from the Settings QoL section with instant effect, persisted per browser in localStorage; pure client-side CSS/JS, mobile rules locked to viewports of 768px and below so desktop stays untouched.
description.zh: 面向 dsh Web GUI 的移动优先体验优化包：Chrome 式活跃会话标签页（Tab Bar）、全屏侧栏滑动开合、侧栏浮层与折叠态最近会话、切换会话不拉起输入法、viewport/键盘安全区适配、按钮触摸反馈、代码块表格内滚、隐藏权限下拉、设置页全屏重写与页签记忆、合成器线程状态动画、长按拖拽卡死修复——14 项功能均可在设置页 QoL 分区独立开关、即时生效，并按浏览器持久保存在 localStorage；纯客户端 CSS/JS，移动规则锁定 ≤768px 视口，桌面端零影响。

description.en: Zen Mode view tab and foreground time tracker for DeepSeek Harness: while the agent works, a calm conversation view shows running/done status, your latest user message, live activity hints and the final AI reply in markdown with one-line turn stats, plus screen-watching (focus) time tracking with daily/weekly Zen scores, a chat-hide toggle that hides tool calls and reasoning rows, auto enter/exit Zen on task start/complete, an Alt+Z shortcut and a Zen settings panel — pure client-side, stored in localStorage, no network.
description.zh: 禅模式视图 + 前台盯屏时间统计插件：智能体后台运行时提供极简 Zen 标签页（进行中/结束状态文案、用户消息、动态提示、Markdown 渲染最终回复、单行轮次统计），统计前台盯屏时长并给出每日/每周禅值，支持一键隐藏中间过程（工具调用/推理行）、任务开始完成时自动进出禅、Alt+Z 快捷键与 Zen 设置面板——纯前端实现，数据存 localStorage，无网络请求。

plugins.name: dsh-no-setup-mode

description.en: No-setup mode for the DSH web UI: hides advanced surfaces, auto-applies best defaults (chat mode, full access, account balance), and one-click role-play personas (maid/butler).
description.zh: DSH 网页免设置模式：隐藏复杂界面、自动套用最佳设置（聊天模式、Full Access、账户余额），并提供一键人设角色扮演（女僕/管家）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-md-plus

description.en: Markdown display enhancements for the DSH Web chat, applied on top of the host renderer rather than replacing it: code blocks become cards with a language label and icon-only wrap and copy buttons, long code blocks, tables and Mermaid diagrams fold behind an expand control, Mermaid fences render as SVG with a diagram and code toggle, a fullscreen viewer with wheel zoom, drag and double-click to fit, and SVG or PNG export, tables get a sticky header and CSV or Markdown copy buttons, and a settings panel adjusts the diagram palette, code font size, the default diagram view and the three fold thresholds.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话的 Markdown 显示增强，在宿主渲染之上加样式与按钮而不替换渲染器：代码块变成带语言名和图标按钮（换行、复制）的卡片；超长的代码块、表格与 Mermaid 图会折叠，底部可展开收起；Mermaid 围栏渲染成 SVG，可在图形与代码间切换，支持全屏查看（滚轮缩放、拖拽、双击适应）以及导出 SVG 或 PNG；表格表头吸顶，并提供 CSV 或 Markdown 复制；设置面板可调图表配色、代码字号、图表默认视图和三类折叠阈值。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

description.en: Composer meter for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a pill under the input shows draft character count, estimated tokens and this session's estimated cost from DeepSeek's published prices (peak/off-peak, Flash/Pro or custom rates), and opens a panel with the token breakdown, a six-snapshot per-session draft vault and a draft cleaner; every write goes through the host setDraft API instead of touching the editor DOM.
description.zh: dsh 输入框计量：输入框下方的 pill 显示草稿字数、预估 token 与本会话估算费用（内置 DeepSeek 官方价目，高峰/空闲与 Flash / Pro 自动换价，可自定义）；点开面板可看 token 明细、最近 6 份草稿快照（保险箱）与草稿清洗，写回只走宿主的 setDraft 接口。

description.en: Visual MCP manager for the DSH web UI: inspect, add, remove, enable/disable MCP servers and view their live connection status from Settings → MCP.
description.zh: DSH 网页 MCP 可视化管理插件：在「设置 → MCP」中查看/新增/删除/启停 MCP 服务器，实时显示连接状态与工具数。

description.en: Session minimap in the scrollbar gutter: to-scale bands coloured by event kind, anchor dots for user messages and failures, auto-loading history at the top, a hover wall of every prompt in the session, and a three-step map scale switcher.
description.zh: 滚动条槽位里的会话缩略图：按事件类型着色的等比色块、用户与失败锚点、滚到顶自动补载历史、悬停线索墙铺开全部发言，附近/中/全三档地图尺度切换。

description.en: Set the startup window size of DeepSeek Harness Desktop from a settings page, with 4:3, 16:9 and 16:10 presets and up to 12 custom presets.
description.zh: 在设置页设置 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版启动时的窗口大小，内置 4:3、16:9、16:10 比例预设，支持保存最多 12 个自定义预设。

description.en: Adds Korean (한국어) as a native option in Settings - General - Language and translates all 2,775 Web UI strings of dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2, experimental features included. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「设置 - 通用设置 - 语言」加入韩语（한국어），翻译 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-alpha.2 Web UI 的全部 2,775 条文案，包括实验功能。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

description.en: Scales the whole DeepSeek Harness interface from 50% to 200%, menus and pop-ups included, set from Settings - General with a slider, a percent field or presets. Works in dsh web and the desktop app, which has no zoom of its own.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 整个界面（包括菜单和弹窗）缩放到 50% 至 200%，在「设置 - 通用设置」中用滑块、百分比输入或预设调整。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用，桌面应用本身没有缩放功能。

description.en: Cross-project session grouping for the DSH sidebar: define named sections, assign sessions from any project into them, then collapse, rename, archive or move a whole project in one action; a toggle in the Sections panel swaps the host session browser for the section tree and restores it on demand, and each row flags live work or a completion you have not looked at yet.
description.zh: 把不同项目的会话收进左侧边栏里可折叠的自定义分组：会话行与项目行各有菜单，可加入分组、移出分组、重命名、归档，或把整个项目一次性移入某个分组；分组面板里的开关可把宿主侧栏切换成分组树、随时恢复，行尾还会提示会话正在跑或跑完还没看过。

description.en: A collapsible, draggable popup in the top-right corner of the DSH web interface for watching A-shares, ETFs, Hong Kong and US stocks and OKX spot crypto side by side: real-time quotes, intraday and daily/weekly/monthly candlestick charts with moving averages, buy/sell target prices, group switching with drag-to-reorder, rename and delete, cross-market search, and light/dark themes. A fork of Awu12277/dsh-stock-watch that adds US quotes via Eastmoney and crypto via OKX.
description.zh: A 股 / ETF / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币行情盯盘插件：在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面右上角显示可折叠、可拖动的弹窗，同时盯多个市场——实时行情、分时与日/周/月 K 线（含均线）、买卖目标价、分组管理（切换、拖动排序、重命名、删除）、跨市场搜索、明暗主题。fork 自 Awu12277/dsh-stock-watch，新增东方财富美股行情与 OKX 现货加密货币行情。

description.en: Switch providers from the left column and choose a model from the right; hover, focus or click a provider to update the model list.
description.zh: 左侧切换供应商，右侧直接选择模型；悬停、聚焦或点击供应商即可切换右侧模型列表。

description.en: Embeds a real VSCode editor (code-server, or your local desktop VS Code via the bundled bridge extension) as a GUI tab: agent file edits open turn-scoped red/green diffs that survive tab closes and page reloads, files lock while the agent writes, and a watchdog supervisor keeps zero orphan processes.
description.zh: 在 GUI 页签内嵌真实的 VSCode 编辑器（code-server，或通过自带 bridge 扩展连接本机桌面 VS Code）：Agent 的文件改动弹出按对话轮次累计的红绿 diff，关标签、刷新页面都不丢，写入期间文件自动锁定，看门狗托管进程、崩溃升级不留孤儿。

description.en: Folds the built-in subagent dropdown into History / Today / Previous / Current groups by usage batch, keeping the current batch expanded; the original header is left untouched.
description.zh: 把原生子代理下拉按使用批次折叠为 历史 / 今日 / 上次 / 本次 四组，本次始终展开；不改动原版头部。

description.en: Subagent Toolkit: folds the built-in subagent dropdown into History / Today / Previous / Current groups by usage batch, adds per-row and whole-group deletion of subagent sessions, and keeps the subagent model allowlist live per delegation. The original header is left untouched.
description.zh: 子代理工具箱：把原生子代理下拉按使用批次折叠为 历史 / 今日 / 上次 / 本次 四组（本次常展开），支持行内/整组删除子代理会话，并让子代理模型名单实时生效（逐任务选模型）；不改动原版头部。

description.en: A per-turn change bar above the composer showing which files the turn changed and the line deltas, for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 through 0.1.7.
description.zh: 输入框上方的本轮改动统计条，显示这一轮改了哪些文件、增删多少行，适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 至 0.1.7。

description.en: A study tab with course-map, tutor and blackboard columns that turns markdown files, local folders or GitHub repos into guided courses, with lesson unlocking, mastery tracking, spaced repetition and a tutor-designed course import.
description.zh: 学习页签（课程｜导师｜黑板三栏）：把 markdown 文件、本地文件夹或 GitHub 仓库变成导学课程，提供课时解锁、掌握度追踪、间隔重复和导师设计式课程导入。

description.en: Mobile web shell for DSH Web with drawer navigation, touch-sized controls, safe areas and a full-width conversation; the desktop layout stays unchanged.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供手机端外壳：抽屉导航、触控尺寸控件、安全区适配和全宽对话区，桌面端布局保持不变。

description.en: Font switcher for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: 99 UI fonts + 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换字体的插件：99 个界面字体 + 31 个代码字。

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree for the DSH sidebar: every slash in a workspace title becomes a virtual folder (arbitrarily deep), the add-workspace directory flow gains a parent-group popup, renames re-derive the tree instantly, sessions nest on the same rule with separate visual styling, and every row carries right-click actions plus per-row appearance customization (color, text-only glow, font weight, primitives-family icon).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏「工作区」列表的层级树插件：工作区与会话名称中的 / 即虚拟分组（任意多级），添加工作区的目录流附带「所属分组」弹窗，重命名即时重排；每层行均支持右键操作与外观自定义（颜色、文字发光、字体粗细、原版图标库图标）。

description.en: Fork of FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt with draggable custom template ordering — drag the handle in Settings to reorder custom prompts (saved to the host); preset ordering unchanged. Do not install alongside upstream dsh-prompt: both register the same UI and /_dsh/dsh-prompt/ route.
description.zh: FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt 的分支版，支持自定义模板拖拽排序：设置页拖动 ⠿ 手柄即可调整顺序并自动保存；预制模板顺序不变。不能与原版 dsh-prompt 同装：两者注册同一套界面与 /_dsh/dsh-prompt/ 路由。

description.en: Plays a video while DSH opens, then dissolves over 0.3 seconds once it has played out. Ships with a default video so it works on install, and the path can be changed or cleared from the plugin settings page.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段自定义开屏动画：自带默认视频，装好即可用；也能换成自己的视频，播完后 0.3 秒渐隐露出界面，并顶掉壳自己的加载画面。清空路径即彻底关闭。

description.en: Piano-key in-conversation navigation for the Web UI: one key per user message with hover ladder, message-preview tooltip, and active-message highlight; click to smooth-scroll.
description.zh: 钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

description.en: RainbowSpeak — a flowing rainbow marquee border around the chat composer card, driven by a conic-gradient ring. Live settings for speed, width, seven color schemes, direction, sides and breathing, plus session-state awareness that reacts to running, attention, error and celebration moments.
description.zh: 虹语（RainbowSpeak）——沿聊天输入框边界持续流动的彩虹跑马灯，由锥形渐变环带驱动。支持流速、宽度、七种配色、方向、边与呼吸效果的实时设置，并具备会话状态感知：运行中加速、需关注变琥珀、出错红脉冲、庆祝闪动。

description.en: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.
description.zh: 在会话区新增「图谱」Tab，把单个会话的执行过程渲染为可交互 DAG：轮次、LLM 步骤、工具、技能、子代理、代码改动与测试，支持实时状态、重试聚合、关键路径与轨迹双向联动。

description.en: Reading workbench for DSH: a cover-grid bookshelf and a paginated single/double-page reader for Markdown, TXT, HTML, EPUB, MOBI and PDF, with highlight notes anchored to text offsets and three agent tools for listing books, reading highlights and pulling text excerpts.
description.zh: DSH 阅读工作台：封面网格书架 + 单/双页分页阅读器，支持 Markdown、TXT、HTML、EPUB、MOBI、PDF，划线笔记以文本偏移锚定，并提供书目、划线、正文节选三个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Hebrew RTL rendering for the web GUI: any line with Hebrew reads right-to-left (messages, GenUI, question cards, the composer and input fields), and RTL-aware Cmd+Left/Right line navigation.
description.zh: 为 Web 界面提供希伯来语 RTL 渲染：任何包含希伯来文的行都从右向左显示（消息、GenUI、提问卡片、输入框与各类输入字段），以及在 RTL 行上方向正确的 Cmd+左/右 行内跳转。

description.en: Restart / exit power buttons in the conversation header.
description.zh: 会话右上角的「重启 / 注销」电源按钮。

description.en: Floating toolbar on text selection in conversations: add the quote to the composer, start a new discussion from it, or copy it; quotes collapse into a card aligned to the composer and double-clicking jumps back to the quoted turn.
description.zh: 会话内选中文字即弹出工具条：添加到对话、新开讨论或复制；引用折叠为输入框旁的引用卡片，双击跳回被引用轮次。

description.en: Moves the sidebar account avatar out of the bottom strip with four placements, including a zero-height inline mode in the brand row, and three heights down to an avatar-only row, with adjustable spacing and a settings card on the Plugins page, while other plugins' footer widgets stay pinned at the bottom.
description.zh: 把侧栏底部的账号头像移出，支持四种位置（含零高度的品牌行内嵌）、三档高度（最小仅头像）、可调间距，并在插件页提供设置卡；其他插件的底栏小组件保持原位贴底。

description.en: Right-click menu for DeepSeek Harness conversation content: copy the selection or the whole message, copy message images and the preview lightbox to the clipboard as PNG (or save them), open file paths (absolute, relative to the session working directory, or ~/), reveal them in the file manager, open them with another registered application, and copy paths or links. Every candidate path is verified by the Host filesystem before an open action appears.
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话区加右键菜单：复制选中内容或整条消息；把消息图片和点击预览后的大图复制为 PNG 到剪贴板或另存为文件；识别绝对路径、相对会话工作区的路径、~/ 以及代码内联路径，一键打开、 在文件管理器中显示、用其他应用打开、复制绝对/相对路径；链接可打开或复制。所有候选路径都会 先由 Host 文件系统校验存在性，再显示打开项。

description.en: A terminal workbench for dsh with streaming chat, tool execution, session management, provider management, and image input.
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的终端工作台，提供流式对话、工具执行、会话管理、Provider 管理与图片输入。

description.en: Per-session question index for the DSH Web UI: a time-proportional dot rail on the right edge and an expandable chain panel showing every user question with its time, including branch/subagent sessions; clicking a node jumps to that message and highlights it.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话提问索引：右缘时间比例圆点窄条与可展开链面板，展示每次用户提问的问题与时间，含分支/子会话；点击节点跳转并高亮对应消息。

plugins.name: dsh-balance

description.en: Shows the selected model provider's account balance next to the composer's model seat once a model and reasoning effort are selected.
description.zh: 在选择模型与推理强度后，于输入框模型选择器旁显示当前模型提供方的账户余额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Assign per-session duotone SVG icons and colors from the sidebar menu or a model tool, with browser-local persistence and cross-tab updates.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置双色 SVG 图标和颜色，可通过侧边栏菜单或模型工具操作，并支持浏览器本地持久化与跨标签页更新。

description.en: Side conversations forked from the main session, with native conversation rendering, selection annotations and handback.
description.zh: 从主会话分叉独立侧聊，支持原生会话渲染、划选注释和结论回流。

description.en: Localizes the DeepSeek Harness approval panel in the web client and translates authorization reasons from English to Chinese, with a built-in phrase dictionary first and a model-router fallback for reasons the dictionary does not cover.
description.zh: 在 Web 客户端把 DeepSeek Harness 的权限审批面板本地化为中文：授权原因优先走内置词表翻译，词表未收录的由宿主侧模型路由兜底。

description.en: Category tree for the DSH sidebar workspace browser: workspaces and their sessions nest under user-made categories (collapsed state remembered), rows drag between categories, a new workspace can be created straight into one through the directory picker, categories rename and delete in place, sessions archive and unarchive from their own row (the built-in browser's stop-active-work confirmation included) alongside a hide / show / only-archived filter, row buttons carry the app's own hover tooltips, and a footer toggle switches the panel back to the built-in list.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏工作区浏览器的分类树：工作区与其会话挂到自建分类下（折叠状态记忆），行可在分类间拖拽，新建工作区可直接落进某个分类（走系统目录选择器），分类可原地重命名与删除，会话行可归档 / 取消归档（运行中的会话走官方同款「停止并归档」确认）并配隐藏 / 含归档 / 仅归档三态筛选，行内按钮悬停有应用自带样式的提示，底栏开关可把面板切回原生列表。

description.en: Renders a TXT novel as a dim text layer behind the DSH chat, with a draggable controller for table of contents, chapter paging, auto-scroll and reading settings.
description.zh: 把 TXT 小说渲染成 DSH 聊天背后的淡色文字层，配一个可拖动的悬浮控件，用于目录、翻章、自动滚动与阅读设置。

description.en: macOS arm64 only; requires dsh-pet installed (the bundled binary is a closed prebuilt). Desktop switch for the dsh-pet pet: one click to show or hide it, and it can start DeepSeek Harness when that is closed.
description.zh: 仅 macOS arm64，需先安装 dsh-pet（自带的是闭源预编译二进制）。桌宠开关：一键开/关桌面上的 dsh-pet 桌宠，Harness 关闭时还能顺手把它启动起来。

description.en: Vertical message pointer rail on the left edge of the chat: one dash per user message, click to scroll to that message, hover for a preview bubble.
description.zh: 聊天区左侧的消息指针导轨：每条用户消息一个横条，点击滚动定位，悬停显示预览气泡。

description.en: Adds a draggable restart button and a plugin panel to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: it prompts when the profile plugin list changes, records additions and removals per profile, tracks trials, reports host startup state, and offers rollback, minimal boot and recoverable cleanup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端添加可拖动重启按钮与插件面板：插件清单变化时提醒重启，按 profile 记录新增与移除、跟踪试用、显示宿主启动状态，并提供回滚、最小启动与可恢复的残留清理。

description.en: DSH prompt library and reusable snippets plugin: save, edit, delete, and append prompt templates, workflow instructions, and reusable text from a button beside the composer without sending.
description.zh: DSH 常用内容、提示词收藏与 Prompt 管理插件：在 composer 输入框旁保存、编辑、删除和一键回填常用提示词、Prompt 模板、工作流指令与可复用文本，不自动发送。

plugins.name: dsh-hud

description.en: Read-only Git panel for the current workspace — branch, changed files, diffs and image before/after compare — plus three capsules above the composer (Git status, tool and skill activity, session running time) and per-session change attribution with review progress.
description.zh: 当前工作区的只读 Git 面板：分支、改动清单、差异与图片前后对比，外加输入框上方的三枚胶囊（Git 状态、工具与技能活动、会话运行时长），以及本会话改动归因与审阅进度。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Interactive terminal chat app for dsh: streaming conversation, tool cards, jobs panel, full-text search, trajectory replay, multi-session tabs, and A2A dispatch (Ink-based).
description.zh: dsh 交互式终端聊天应用：流式对话、工具卡片、任务面板、全文搜索、轨迹回放、多会话标签与 A2A 派发（Ink 实现）。

description.en: Renders inline code in DSH chat as pills with syntax colours and optional file badges, styles chat file paths, and offers optional folded-row tinting and thinking-text ink, with a settings page for six presets, colours and fonts.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话中的行内代码渲染为带语法色和可选文件标记的胶囊，并处理聊天中的文件路径；可选折叠动作行着色与思考文字彩虹刷入，设置页提供六套预设、颜色与字体选项。

description.en: Adds a native Restart DeepSeek Harness item to the Windows system tray menu and the account menu of the DSH desktop app: the plugin prepares a patched resources/app.asar at startup, a detached helper backs up the original and swaps it in after a normal exit, the patch is re-applied after each desktop update, and either item relaunches the app gracefully on the next launch. Windows desktop only; other hosts report 409 not_desktop.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面端的 Windows 系统托盘菜单和账户菜单各加一项原生「重启 DeepSeek Harness」：插件启动时准备好补丁版 resources/app.asar，由一个分离的 helper 在正常退出后备份原文件并替换，桌面端每次更新覆盖后自动重打补丁，下次启动即可看到两个入口，点击走 app.relaunch() 优雅重启。仅支持 Windows 桌面端，其它宿主返回 409 not_desktop。

description.en: A pomodoro timer docked below the composer in DeepSeek Harness, with focus/short/long cycles, a resumable countdown, chime, optional system notifications and bilingual settings.
description.zh: 输入框下方的番茄钟：专注/短休息/长休息循环、可恢复倒计时、提示音、可选系统通知与中英双语设置。

description.en: Adds a Branch Chat tab to dsh-better-sidebar that opens independent archived sessions with a head/middle/tail context digest and the same tools as the main agent.
description.zh: 在 dsh-better-sidebar 新增分支对话页签：开出独立封存 session，注入头／中／尾脉络摘要，并使用与主对话相同的工具。

description.en: Composer prompt refinement for DSH: rewrites a rough draft into a structured, unambiguous prompt with one-click undo, reference-chip protection, three model sources (composer / account / any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and disconnect-aware cancellation.
description.zh: DSH 输入框提示词优化：把粗糙草稿改写成结构清晰、无歧义的提示词，支持一键撤回、引用芯片保护、三种模型来源与断连即停。

description.en: Read-only writing-workspace panel for projects that contain a .writing-anything/ workspace: per-work overview cards, a unit tree, YAML artifact views as semantic cards or highlighted source, the source list and the decision/review queues, and in-panel unit review whose feedback is written back by wa-cli.
description.zh: writing-anything 工作区的只读写作面板：作品总览卡片、单元树、YAML 产物的语义卡片与源码高亮视图、素材清单与决策／复核清单，以及面板内单元审阅（反馈经 wa-cli 写回）。

description.en: DSH sidebar and panel for courses, tasks, plans, connections, course materials, automation and settings.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏与面板：课程、任务、计划、连接、课程资料、自动化与设置。

description.en: Markdown input for the composer that keeps the typed Markdown as the sent text while drawing bullets and checkboxes, styling bold, italic, inline code, strikethrough, headings, quotes and fenced code blocks, continuing lists on Shift+Enter, and wrapping selections with Cmd/Ctrl+B, I and E.
description.zh: 输入框 Markdown 书写辅助：发送内容保持原始 Markdown，同时把列表显示为圆点和复选框，实时呈现粗体、斜体、行内代码、删除线、标题、引用与代码块，Shift+Enter 自动续写列表，选中文字可用 Cmd/Ctrl+B、I、E 加格式。

description.en: Startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: an animated avatar with aurora, stardust, pointer parallax and a module-assembly entrance, plus the same image as the main-UI wallpaper; both images can be swapped from a settings page that previews the animation live.
description.zh: DSH 启动动画 + 主界面壁纸：头像、极光、星尘、指针视差与模块组装入场，同一张图兼作主界面壁纸；两张图都能在设置页里更换并实时预览。

description.en: ChatGPT-style rich answers inside DeepSeek Harness: entity panels, KPI cards, series charts, sortable tables, nested layers, flow diagrams and local controls.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中呈现 ChatGPT 风格的富文本回答：实体面板、指标卡、多序列图表、可排序表格、嵌套分层图、流程图与本地控件。

description.en: Adds cross-workspace pinned and recent session sections to the DSH sidebar, with status indicators and display settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏跨工作区汇总置顶与最近会话，提供状态标记和显示设置。

description.en: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.
description.zh: 从 Web 输入框上传任意本地文件，以待发送卡片展示，并在设置中管理已存文件。

description.en: Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供流畅的彗星光标：以发光的彗星拖尾取代原生闪烁光标，随输入平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细与拖尾，并适配中文等 IME 输入。

description.en: Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices.
