description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入栏提供按 provider 折叠的模型选择器，并使用模型目录中的真实推理档位。

description.en: A Markdown-based draft-board plugin for dsh: live-preview editing and local persistence.
description.zh: 基于 Markdown 的 dsh 草稿板插件，支持实时预览编辑，本地持久化。

description.en: Visible terminal panel that streams the agent's shell commands into an in-app terminal and lets the agent capture the terminal screen as text.
description.zh: 可见终端面板：把 agent 的 shell 命令实时显示在应用内终端，并支持 agent 以文本方式截取终端屏幕。

description.en: Codex-style Create Workspace dialog: name it and the folder is created for you, or pick one with a native chooser that remembers where you were (the native chooser is Windows-only; elsewhere use the name field).
description.zh: Codex 式的创建工作区对话框：填名称就自动建出目录，或者选文件夹——原生选择窗口会记得你上次在哪（原生选择窗口仅 Windows 可用，其它平台请直接填名称）。

description.en: Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.
description.zh: 需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。dsh web profile 的手机端体验修复：窄屏抽屉与设置标签、全宽模型菜单、卡住请求的网络状态芯片，以及把会话层级、subagent 与后台任务芯片收进一张可点开面板的窄屏头部收纳器。

description.en: Local TXT novel reader in the DSH right sidebar: bookshelf with file, directory and path import, chapter table of contents with jump, click-to-turn or vertical-scroll paging, reading progress restored across restarts, and font, line-spacing, background and night themes.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏本地 TXT 小说阅读器：书架三种导入、章节目录跳转、点击翻页与上下滚动、重启后进度恢复、字体/行距/背景/夜间阅读主题。

description.en: Image and video wallpapers for the DSH web workspace: auto-detected GIF/APNG/animated WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM backgrounds with blur, brightness and dimming, tint-following UI, per-component transparency, and one-click preset wallpapers.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供图片/视频壁纸背景：GIF/APNG/动图 WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM 魔数自动识别，压暗/亮度/高斯模糊，界面色调与字体颜色自动跟随背景，各组件独立透明度，预置壁纸一键应用。

description.en: Fluid streaming rendering and smooth scrolling for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供流畅流式渲染和丝滑滚动。

description.en: Adds a right-sidebar panel that lists the skills available to the current session, searches and tags them, combines them with your own saved prompts, appends the selection to the composer in one click, and can pin skills and prompts as always-on context injected through the system prompt.
description.zh: 在右侧栏列出当前会话可用的 Skill，支持搜索与标签，可与自存提示词组合后一键追加到输入框；还能把 Skill 与提示词设为常驻，经系统提示注入每个新对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness UI polish: one Markdown style across every renderer, select-text annotations with numbered pins, a sidebar that drags down to 214px and remembers its width, a first launch that fills the screen, sidebar panel and plugin icons collected into one top row of five, and a colour-cycling marker for running sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面增强：统一各处 Markdown 排版、划词批注（带编号的段落标记）、可拖到 214px 并记住宽度的侧栏、首次启动铺满屏幕、侧栏面板与插件图标合并为顶部一行（每行 5 个），以及运行中会话的彩色状态环。

description.en: Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.
description.zh: 面向长提示词的 Web Composer 布局：输入框可保留在底部，也可停靠到可调宽度的右栏，与长回答并排阅读和写作。

description.en: Adds a prompt-enhancement button to the DSH composer that rewrites drafts into agent-ready prompts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框添加提示词增强按钮，将草稿改写为可直接交给 Agent 执行的提示词。

description.en: DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器：浏览、启用/禁用、从 Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork 导入，自动发现技能并支持软链接。

description.en: Message timeline rail for DeepSeek Harness web chat: evenly spaced ticks for each user message on the right edge, click to jump, hover to preview.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页会话消息时间轴导航条：消息区右侧等间距刻度，点击跳转，悬浮预览。

description.en: Unofficial Claude UI-inspired model and reasoning-effort selector using the current model's available levels, with animated purple pixel effects.
description.zh: 模仿 Claude UI 的非官方模型与推理强度选择器，使用当前模型实际提供的档位，带紫色像素动画。

description.en: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 右侧文件工作区，提供源码预览、DSH 捕获差异、多文件标签页和工作区文件树。

description.en: A 60-frame theme-aware monochrome whale-dive animation with reactive water for the DSH Web turn status: embedded assets, seamless closed-loop playback, a reduced-motion PNG fallback, and lifecycle-clean removal.
description.zh: DSH Web 回合状态旁的 60 帧随主题适配的单色鲸鱼深潜动画：传播式水面、无缝闭环、资源内嵌、减少动态效果 PNG 回退，且随生命周期完整清理。

description.en: Collapsible section headers for the DSH sidebar: fold the functions list, the workspace list and the footer status area behind labelled header rows; sections are identified by position so cards the host or other plugins append to the footer join the status section automatically, and the account row stays pinned to the bottom (client-only DOM enhancement, no host patch).
description.zh: DSH 侧栏分区折叠：功能区、工作区、状态区三段各自独立收放，设置与账号那排钉死在最底部不随折叠移动；纯客户端 DOM 增强，不打宿主补丁。

description.en: Multiple named launch targets in the DSH composer: left-click starts the default target, right-click opens the list.
description.zh: 对话输入框的多启动项按钮：左键启动默认项，右键弹出列表，每项可绑定一个程序或目录。

description.en: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.
description.zh: 在 Diff 面板中审查 Agent 的文件改动、添加评论以继续修改，并撤销已编辑或新建的文件。

description.en: A Codex-like effort switcher for Deepseek Harness.
description.zh: 为DSH添加一个类似于Codex的推理强度切换器。

description.en: WeChat-style screenshot: freeze the desktop, drag a region or click a window, and the crop lands in the composer. A Windows-only fork of Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin.
description.zh: 微信式截图：点一下冻结桌面，框选区域或单击窗口，截图直接进输入框。Windows 专用的 Durandalw/dsh-plugin-screenshot 衍生版，请勿与原版同时安装。

description.en: Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.
description.zh: 将 DSH 设置界面归一为同一套设计语言：统一各设置页的排版、卡片、控件、焦点与动效，包括其他插件贡献的页面。

description.en: Adds a My Groups tab to the DSH Installed plugins page: custom groups with drag reordering, colored text tags, Chinese notes, group locking, real enable switches, and two preset snapshot slots.
description.zh: 在 DSH「已安装插件」页新增「我的分组」标签页：自定义分组与拖拽排序、彩色文字标签、中文备注、分组锁定、真实启停开关，以及两个预设快照槽位。

description.en: Click a delivered-file card to open the file with the system default application instead of DSH's built-in sidebar preview; hold Shift to keep the original preview.
description.zh: 点击交付文件卡片时用系统默认程序打开文件，而不是在 DSH 侧边栏里预览；按住 Shift 保留原来的预览行为。

description.en: Adds a Long text button to the composer tool row: write or paste the body in an editor overlay, and on save it is written to <workspace>/.dsh-longtext/<timestamp>_<title>.md and an @ path reference to that file is appended to the composer, leaving the conversation free of the long text itself.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏新增「长文本」按钮：在编辑器浮层里写或粘贴正文，保存后写入 <工作区>/.dsh-longtext/<时间戳>_<标题>.md，并把该文件的 @ 路径引用追加到输入框，让正文不进入对话。

description.en: Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.
description.zh: 在发送前优化当前聊天输入，采用前先对比原文与优化结果。

description.en: Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 schemaJson 代码块在 DSH 回复内渲染 OpenTiny GenUI 图表、表单、计算器等迷你应用，用户操作自动回传对话。

description.en: Floating audio control panel in the Web GUI: play/pause/next/previous for Windows media sessions (SMTC) and the system master volume/mute, served by a Node route half that runs a PowerShell helper.
description.zh: Web 界面里的悬浮音频控制面板：控制 Windows 媒体会话（SMTC）的播放/暂停/上一首/下一首与系统主音量/静音，由注册路由的主机半调用 PowerShell 助手实现。

description.en: JetBrains-style IDE workbench in the DSH sidebar: Project file tree, Commit panel, Git history with a swimlane graph, a real PTY terminal and an embedded editor with Markdown preview and Find in Files, plus chat file links and send-to-chat references.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的 JetBrains 式 IDE 工作台：Project 文件树、Commit 面板、泳道图 Git 历史、真实 PTY 终端与内置编辑器（Markdown 预览、全项目查找），并支持聊天文件链接与发送到聊天框的 @ 引用。

description.en: Groups the sessions of every workspace in the DSH sidebar by day, with explicit date labels, a live running indicator and date-based search.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的每个工作区内把会话按日期分组、标注具体日期，并保留运行中状态灯与按日期搜索。

description.en: Runs a chosen power action (shutdown / restart / hibernate / sleep / lock / logoff) once every Agent session and background job has gone idle: the plugin samples in-process sessions once per second, counts running sessions as always busy, checks running background jobs through a configurable option (considerJobs, on by default, shown with its live count in Settings), waits a confirm window and then a cancellable countdown, and shows a draggable bottom-right card with the current phase and remaining seconds; the enable toggle never survives a host restart, any newly started session or Cancel aborts the countdown, and if the agents service is unavailable the machine is treated as busy so nothing ever fires. Windows only (the built-in shutdown / rundll32 actions); every action except none degrades to none elsewhere.
description.zh: 会话全部结束、后台任务也安静下来后自动执行电源动作（关机 / 重启 / 休眠 / 睡眠 / 锁定 / 注销）：插件每秒采样进程内会话，运行中的会话始终算「在忙」；后台任务检测是可配置项 considerJobs（默认开启，设置页直接显示当前计数）；确认窗口后进入可取消倒计时，右下角浮窗卡片显示当前阶段与剩余秒数并支持拖动；开关不会随宿主重启保留（重启后一律回到关闭），任何会话新启动或点取消都会中止倒计时；拿不到 agents 服务时一律按「在忙」处理，绝不触发。仅支持 Windows（使用系统自带 shutdown / rundll32），其他平台除 none 外均降级为 none。

description.en: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.
description.zh: 给 dsh 的网页输入框加上 Alt+Enter 换行。

description.en: A long conversation that renders many LaTeX formulas at once can become laggy, because the browser keeps styling, laying out and painting content that is off screen. This plugin applies content-visibility: auto to the off-screen message bodies and block formulas, so that work is skipped and the lag is reduced.
description.zh: 一段渲染了大量 LaTeX 公式的长会话容易卡顿：屏幕外的消息和公式仍会被浏览器反复计算样式、布局和绘制。本插件给屏幕外的消息体与块级公式加上 content-visibility: auto，让这部分工作被跳过，卡顿随之减少。

description.en: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.
description.zh: Web 客户端只读文件预览面板，支持图片、PDF、CSV/TSV、文本、源代码、Markdown、JSON 与 YAML 渲染、大文件分段读取，以及面向非本地内容的 provider API。

description.en: A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面边缘的跑马灯氛围光环：随会话状态自动变色（运行中绿色流动、完成粉色、有待处理黄色警告），设置面板可调颜色、光圈宽度、转速与闪动频率。

description.en: Task panel for the DSH Web sidebar: publish tasks, auto-distill related sessions, and drive plan/develop/review stages with subagents plus in-panel acceptance.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏任务面板：发布任务、自动蒸馏历史会话，由子代理分阶段（规划/开发/复核）执行，并在面板内验收。

description.en: Turns the composer's reasoning-effort menu into a draggable slider and takes over the stock model-and-reasoning-level chip. Dragging follows the pointer continuously; releasing snaps to the nearest level and submits one session update per drag. The track draws its own fill, tick marks and white knob, only the highest levels (xhigh, max, ultra) get a flowing brand-colour gradient, and both ends carry the lowest and highest level names. The same card expands into the official model list. Arrow keys step one level, PageUp and PageDown two, Home and End jump to the ends, and each move submits. A generation counter on the directory object discards late responses, and reduced-motion turns the animations off. All data comes from the stock modelDirectories directory; no new capabilities are added.
description.zh: 把输入框右侧的「推理等级」从菜单点选换成可拖拽滑条，并接管官方那枚「模型 · 推理等级」chip。拖动中连续跟手，松手吸附到最近档位，且一次拖拽只提交一次会话更新。轨道内自绘填充、刻度点与白圆钮，只有最高档（xhigh/max/ultra）才铺品牌色流动渐变，两端标出最低与最高档名；同一张卡片可展开官方模型清单。方向键移动一档、PageUp/PageDown 移动两档、Home/End 跳到两端，每次移动都会提交。目录对象上的世代计数器丢弃迟到的响应，prefers-reduced-motion 下关闭动画。数据全部取自官方 modelDirectories，不新增任何能力。

description.en: Replaces the shipped sidebar workspace browser with Recents, a project editor that adds extra source folders, and pin, rename, fork, and archive row actions.
description.zh: 替换出厂侧边栏工作区浏览器，补上最近会话、可添加额外源文件夹的项目编辑器，以及置顶、重命名、派生和归档行操作。

description.en: Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes each session's full history on open, persists it locally, and jumps to older questions by growing the window on demand.
description.zh: 提问索引：在会话右侧按序展示你提过的问题列表，可收起；点击某条即可把会话滚动跳转到对应位置。打开会话自动索引全部历史提问并本地持久保存；点击更早的提问会按需翻页加载后跳转。

description.en: A continue button in the composer tool row, immediately left of the send key: one click writes an interruption-aware prompt into the draft and submits it, so an interrupted task resumes without retyping the context. The prompt names the interruption and appends the current task plus the tail of the last reply; Alt-click or right-click sends a bare 继续, and a non-empty draft is appended to rather than overwritten.
description.zh: 输入框工具行里、紧挨发送键左侧的「继续」按钮：点一下就把续接指令写进草稿并提交，让中断的任务接着跑，不用重新交代上下文。指令会写明中断原因，并附上当前任务与上一轮回复的结尾片段；按住 Alt 点击或右键点击只发裸的「继续」，草稿非空时只追加不覆盖。

description.en: A music dock for the DSH web GUI. A draggable capsule in the bottom-right corner opens into a player card with a queue, previous and next, a draggable progress bar, a volume knob driven by drag or mouse wheel, three loop modes and per-track cover art for resolved links (local files show a vinyl placeholder); audio files dropped onto the card play immediately. Paste a Bilibili, NetEase Cloud Music or QQ Music track or playlist link to resolve it: NetEase and QQ audio is signed by the host into an opaque HMAC token, so the browser never receives a plain CDN address and cannot forge one. A spectrum canvas along the page bottom reads a real AnalyserNode and draws in six styles (dots, bars, blocks, mirror, line, wave) with adjustable width, bar count, sensitivity, glow, height, frame rate and placement; the row is fitted to the container width, falling back to a slight overflow when the gaps would fall below half a pixel. Seven colour themes (whale blue-white, aurora, mint, sunset, rose, neon, mono). The settings section is grouped into interface, theme, playback, links and spectrum, and carries favorites and history tables.
description.zh: DSH 网页端音乐台。右下角一枚可拖动的胶囊，点开是播放器卡片：播放列表与上一首/下一首、可拖动的进度条、音量旋钮（滚轮或拖动）、三种循环模式、逐曲封面（仅解析出的链接曲目，本地文件用黑胶占位）；音频文件拖到卡片上即播。粘贴 B 站、网易云、QQ 音乐的歌曲或歌单链接即可解析；网易云与 QQ 的音频由宿主签发不透明 HMAC 票据再交给浏览器，浏览器拿不到明文 CDN 地址，也无法伪造。页面底部一条频谱画布，数据来自真实 AnalyserNode，支持圆点/粗柱/方块阵列/对称声波/折线/时域波形六种画法，宽度、柱数、灵敏度、光晕、高度、帧率与位置均可调，整排按容器宽度铺排，间隙会压到半像素下限，再窄就如实略微溢出。另含七套配色主题（鲸鱼蓝白、极光青紫、薄荷绿、落日橙、玫瑰粉、霓虹赛博、极简灰白）。设置分区按界面 / 主题 / 播放 / 链接与频谱分组，并带收藏与历史两张表。

description.en: Live preview inside the sidebar session hover card: what the session is doing right now (running tool with elapsed time, thinking, last tool duration), an attachment thumbnail with click-to-enlarge, the latest user prompt and assistant reply with injected system scaffolding stripped out, a recent-tool icon strip, turn count plus token totals plus model name on one line, and a 12-item settings page (11 switches plus a slider) persisted to the profile.
description.zh: 侧边栏会话悬停卡片里的实时预览：这个会话此刻在干什么（正在跑的工具与已运行时长、思考中、上次工具耗时）、附件缩略图点击放大、剥掉注入壳子后的最近一问一答、最近工具图标条、轮数 · token 合计 · 模型名一行概况，外加一个写入 profile 的 12 项设置页。

description.en: Persistent conversation outline: per-turn questions and final replies, keyword filter, one-click jump, light/full history modes, and Ctrl/Shift+click to open the same position in the Trajectory view.
description.zh: 对话栏左侧常驻大纲：按轮次列出提问与最后回复，关键词过滤与一键跳转，轻便/全面两种历史模式，按住 Ctrl/Shift 单击可跳到轨迹视图同一位置。

description.en: DSH Web right-side output dock: session-scoped tabs for reports, images, data, video, and audio, with inline previews, output quality checks, and a searchable per-turn history.
description.zh: DSH Web 原生右侧产物栏：按会话管理报告、图片、数据、视频与音频，提供内联预览、产物质检和可按轮次检索的历史目录。

description.en: A bilingual overlay layer for DSH: it overlays Chinese names and functional descriptions for plugins, commands and skills, supports three display modes and manually-triggered AI translation, and does not modify a single line of DSH source code.
description.zh: DSH的双语覆盖层：为插件、命令与技能叠加中文名和功能说明，支持三种显示模式与纯手动触发的AI翻译，且不修改一行DSH源码。

description.en: Native, instant region-screenshot button for the DeepSeek Harness composer: one click freezes the screen, a WeChat-style overlay (gray mask, green selection) appears, and the cropped PNG is inserted into the current draft. An optional eye toggle hides the whole DSH window before capturing, then restores it. No ms-screenclip, about 10 ms per drag frame, coexists with voice input. Windows 10/11 x64 only; the first capture compiles a helper with the built-in .NET Framework csc.exe.
description.zh: 输入框里的原生秒开截屏按钮：点一下冻结全屏，微信风格选区浮层（灰色遮罩、绿色边框），确认后截图自动插入当前会话草稿。相机旁的小眼睛可选「先隐藏整个 DSH 窗口再截屏」，截完自动恢复。不调用系统截图浮层，拖动约 10ms/帧，与语音输入并排共存。仅 Windows 10/11 x64；首次截屏会用系统自带的 .NET Framework csc.exe 编译辅助程序。

description.en: Offline Beijing-time peak/idle indicator below the conversation composer, with a 2026 calendar, uncertainty labels, and brief peak reminders; no API key or runtime network access required.
description.zh: 会话输入框下方的离线北京时间峰谷指示器，内置 2026 年日历、待确认状态和短暂高峰提醒，运行时无需密钥或联网。

description.en: Moves the composer to the top of an active conversation and renders the transcript plus the turn navigator newest-first, so replies appear right under the composer.
description.zh: 把活跃会话的输入框固定在视口顶部，转写列表与右侧回合导航按最新在上渲染，新回复紧贴输入框出现。

description.en: Session-scoped Markdown writing pad docked beside the conversation, with edit/preview modes, selection-based AI rewrites, diff review, undo, and draft recovery.
description.zh: 停靠在对话旁的会话级 Markdown 写作板，支持编辑/预览、选区 AI 改写、Diff 审核、撤销与草稿恢复。

description.en: Makes the provider groups in the composer model menu collapsible, keeping only the provider of the current model expanded.
description.zh: 让输入框模型菜单的厂商分组可折叠，默认只展开当前模型所属厂商。

description.en: Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it reports for, and alerts you when a task completes while you work elsewhere.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 打造的永远置顶的水豚任务播报宠物——透明悬浮气泡逐条播报运行轨迹、标明所属项目，任务完成时提醒正在别处忙碌的你。

description.en: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app; clicking anywhere skips ahead, and reopening the window from the tray replays it. The first cold start may hitch once, then runs smoothly.
description.zh: 桌面端全屏启动动画：在 DSH 加载卡出现前接住首帧，播放 4.5 秒五阶段罗盘序列后交接；点按任意处可跳过，从托盘重开窗口会重播。冷启动首帧可能顿一下，之后流畅。

description.en: Press a chord, then type a letter label to click or focus any visible target.
description.zh: 按下组合键后，用字母标签选中并点击或聚焦任意可见目标。

description.en: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.
description.zh: 在会话视图中新增「执行图」标签页，把每个轮次的提问、模型回复与工具调用/结果渲染为可折叠的时间轴，并带详情面板与 PNG 导出。

description.en: Adds a configurable dsh-ui status card before each DSH agent reply, with bilingual templates and a live settings preview. Requires @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui from dsh-market; without it, the card markup is emitted unrendered.
description.zh: 为每次 DSH Agent 回复添加可配置的 dsh-ui 状态卡片，提供双语模板和实时设置预览。需要先从 dsh-market 安装 @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui，否则卡片标记会以未渲染的形式输出。

plugins.name: dsh-intelligent-UI

description.en: Optional source-preserving chat rendering with selectable themes, offline Uiverse component tools and a report-local evidence workspace. Preview for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 可选接管对话渲染，保留原文与数据，提供可切换主题、离线 Uiverse 组件工具和报告内证据工作区。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的预览版。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

description.en: Window-like controls for every Web UI modal: drag by title bar, eight-way resize, pin against outside clicks, maximize to the full viewport, removable backdrop blur, and per-dialog persistent state.
description.zh: 为所有 Web UI 弹窗添加窗口化操作：标题栏拖动、八向缩放、钉住防误触关闭、全屏最大化、移除背景模糊，以及按弹窗持久化的状态。

description.en: Floating community panel for the Web UI: 24h hot topics and hot plugins TOP10 with a draggable, always-on-top button.
description.zh: Web UI 的社区热门悬浮面板：24 小时热门话题与热门插件 TOP10，悬浮按钮可拖动置顶、点击居中展开。

description.en: A floating sticky-note pad for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with a note directory, text editing, pasted images and local persistence.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的悬浮便签本，支持便签目录、文本编辑、粘贴图片和本地持久化。

description.en: Composer model selector grouped by provider: pick a provider card, then drill into that provider to choose a model, with cross-provider search and Reasoning Effort kept.
description.zh: 按来源分块的输入框模型选择器：先选来源渠道卡片，再下钻进该渠道选择模型，保留跨来源搜索与推理强度调节。

description.en: Windows screenshot overlay: highlights the window, screen or taskbar under the cursor and dims the rest, then annotates (shapes, arrows, pen, text, mosaic) and drops the image into the composer without sending it.
description.zh: Windows 截图覆盖层：自动高亮光标下的窗口、整屏或任务栏并压暗其余区域，随后标注（形状、箭头、画笔、文本、马赛克），确定后把图片放进会话输入区，不自动发送。

description.en: JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的 JIRA 任务面板：按工作区配置项目 Key 与可选 JQL，展示指派给当前用户的问题，带状态、优先级与类型标签、总数徽标、收起与刷新、跳转 JIRA，并在设置页卡片配置 JIRA 地址与令牌（含连接测试）。

description.en: Turns the browser PWA shortcut already on your desktop into a real launcher: it adopts that shortcut and keeps its icon, then starts dsh web silently on double-click and opens the app window; adds restart and dsh self-update (with rollback) controls to the web UI. Windows only.
description.zh: 接管你桌面上已有的浏览器 PWA 快捷方式（保留原图标），双击即静默拉起 dsh web 并以应用窗口打开界面；网页右上角提供重启与 dsh 自助升级（失败自动回滚）两个控件。仅 Windows。

description.en: Keeps quotes out of the message body: quoting any passage from an assistant turn opens an editable quote tray above the composer, the quotes are injected into the next turn as system-prompt context (attributed with source and time), and an expandable quote row under that turn shows exactly which quotes were used. Quotes persist across page reloads and are claimed per turn; the host and client halves hand-shake on version and report a compatibility verdict.
description.zh: 把引用与消息正文彻底分开：引用任意助手回合里的段落会打开输入框上方的引用行，随下一回合作为 system-prompt 上下文注入模型（带来源与时间标注），并在回合尾部以可展开的「引用(N)」行显示这一轮到底用了哪几条；引用本地落盘、刷新不丢、按回合认领；宿主与客户端两半体做版本握手并上报兼容结论。

description.en: A permanent status card in the top-right corner of the DSH content area: one line for where this turn's time went (model, tools, waiting), plus collapsible to-dos with a progress bar, the session goal (edit/pause/resume/clear), submitted plans that open in the preview pane, the files this session changed, subagents with their token and duration figures, and this session's background jobs: running rows carry a two-step stop button, finished ones fold into a count line that stays collapsed until opened; it yields space to the content as the area narrows and folds into a round button at the limit.
description.zh: 内容区右上角的常驻状态卡片：一行写清本轮时间去向（模型/工具/等你），另列可折叠的任务与进度条、会话目标（可编辑/暂停/继续/清除）、已提交计划（可点开在右栏预览）、本次变更文件、带 token 与耗时数字的子智能体行，以及本会话的后台任务（运行中的行带两段确认的终止按钮，已结束的收进一行计数、默认收起）；内容区收窄时正文向左让位，推到极限自动收成一颗圆钮。

description.en: Adds a paperclip image-picker button to the conversation composer - pick reference images through the system file dialog and feed them straight into the official attachment pipeline (thumbnails, limit checks, upload with message).
description.zh: 在会话输入框添加 📎 选图按钮，通过系统文件选择器选取参考图并注入官方附件管线（缩略图、数量与大小校验、随消息上传），绕开拖拽环境问题。

description.en: Adds a mobile hotkey mode to the DSH web composer that auto-detects touch and mobile devices and switches to Ctrl+Enter for send and plain Enter for a newline while leaving the desktop keymap untouched, with a Settings toggle, a /mobilekeys command and a window.__dshMobileKeys console API.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框增加「移动端热键模式」：自动检测移动/触控设备后切换为 Ctrl+Enter 发送、裸 Enter 换行，桌面键位保持不变，并提供设置面板开关、/mobilekeys 命令与 window.__dshMobileKeys 控制台 API。

description.en: Annotate replies and documents for the next message, edit past user messages and rerun from that point, and use keyboard shortcuts to navigate user messages or recall previous inputs in the composer.
description.zh: 为回复和文档添加随下一条消息发送的注释，编辑历史用户消息并从该处重新执行，使用快捷键浏览用户消息或在输入框调出历史输入。

description.en: Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards it and clears the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框用 ↑ 调回本会话已发送的消息；↓ 前翻并恢复你正在写的草稿，再按一次 ↓ 丢弃草稿、清空输入框。

description.en: Beads issue-graph panel in the left sidebar of the Web GUI: filter ready, in-progress, open, and all beads, read a bead's description, notes, dependencies, and comments, and create, claim, or close beads through the bd CLI. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a workspace with a Beads database.
description.zh: Web 界面左侧栏的 Beads 任务图谱面板：按可领取、进行中、待处理、全部筛选，查看任务描述、备注、依赖与评论，并通过 bd CLI 新建、领取或关闭任务。需要 PATH 上的 bd CLI，以及已初始化 Beads 数据库的工作区。

description.en: A simulated search engine page in the DSH sidebar that queries the local web search API and lists the top 10 results.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的模拟搜索页：调用本地搜索接口，列出前 10 条结果。

description.en: Windows x64 preview that detaches workspace/session navigation into a separate .NET Framework 4.6.2+/WebView2 Evergreen window, with grouped trees, overview/focused modes, logical drag-and-drop, activity/manual ordering and a resizable focused-view preview; no DSH Core patch and no Better Workspace runtime dependency. Derived from KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace — do not install both.
description.zh: Windows x64 预览版：将工作区与会话导航分离到独立的 .NET Framework 4.6.2+/WebView2 Evergreen 窗口，支持分组层级、总览与聚焦模式、逻辑拖放、活动或手动排序，以及可调整高度的聚焦预览区；不修改 DSH Core，不运行时依赖 Better Workspace。衍生自 KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Smart prompt optimization & dynamic thinking effort adaptation with composer capsule, DSH/custom models, undo/re-optimize, and native settings.
description.zh: 提示词智能优化与思考强度动态自适应插件，支持会话输入框胶囊控制条、DSH已配置/自定义第三方双模型来源、一键撤销与重新优化及原生配置面板。

description.en: Boot film for the web UI: a blue whale floods black from below as the page loads, then glides left and pulls the | deepseek HARNESS wordmark out of itself before the app appears.
description.zh: 网页界面的启动动画：页面加载时蓝鲸由下往上被墨色淹没成黑鲸，随后左移、从身后拉出 | deepseek HARNESS 字标，再把窗口交给应用。

description.en: Gives an installed dsh web app a native-looking window caption through Window Controls Overlay - the manifest route is served with display_override, the app's own sidebar brand row and session header become the drag region, and the app's own trailing controls are inset clear of the browser's caption chrome.
description.zh: 通过 Window Controls Overlay 让已安装的 dsh Web 应用拥有原生观感的窗口标题栏——清单路由带 display_override 返回，应用自身的侧边栏品牌行与会话 header 成为拖拽区，应用自身右侧控件自动让开浏览器标题栏 chrome。

description.en: A plain-notebook calendar in the DSH sidebar: a 70-day, Monday-first grid whose cells print that day's note; one note per day is stored in a .xlsx you choose, in the DesktopCal two-column layout (Excel date serial plus free text, newest date first). Clicking a day opens the editor for it, and import/export move that same format in and out, with a preview step and a conflict policy (keep, overwrite, concat or skip).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里的纯记事本日历：周一起始的 70 天网格，格子里直接显示当天内容；每天一条，写进你自己指定的 .xlsx，沿用 DesktopCal 两列格式（Excel 日期序列号 + 自由文本，新日期在前）。点某天即打开该日编辑框；导入导出走同一格式，导入先预览，冲突可选保留、覆盖、拼接或跳过。

description.en: Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH Web 工作清单，支持富文本笔记、分类、折叠、拖拽排序、搜索、JSON 导入导出和可还原回收站。

description.en: Adds a configurable SAO-inspired full-screen startup animation to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可配置的 SAO 风格全屏启动动画。

description.en: Composer infinity switch: while the highest reasoning effort is selected, one click appends a configurable notice to the system prompt.
description.zh: 输入框 ∞ 开关：最高推理档位下点一下，向系统提示词追加一段可配置的宣告。

description.en: Plays a short ink-wash whale-leap animation over the DeepSeek Harness web UI when it loads, then fades out on its own.
description.zh: 网页加载时在 DeepSeek Harness 界面上播放一段水墨鲸跃动画，随后自行淡出。

description.en: Renders an Agent Teams swimlane canvas above the composer: lead centred with members below, tasks laid out in lanes by longest dependency path, and four SVG connector families drawn as dashed paths (task dependency as a cubic bezier from the upstream card edge to the downstream card edge, lead bus, peer bus, member-to-task tether). Cards are absolutely positioned DOM, connectors are one SVG layer sharing the same geometry constants. Layout constants and path algorithms are ported from cc-haha. Reads the live per-session agentTeam projection (roster, shared tasks, dependency edges, running state) and falls back to the session todo list when the session has no team; team messages are not part of the projection yet, so the communication panel shows an empty state. Body colours come from host theme tokens; the eight member identity colours are the deliberate exception — fixed hues mixed with the theme accent via color-mix, declared as CSS variables because the same values feed an SVG stroke attribute that rejects colour functions. Ships zh/en dictionaries with identical keys.
description.zh: 在输入框上方渲染 Agent Teams 泳道看板：队长居中、成员在下，任务按最长依赖路径分泳道排列，四类连线用 SVG 虚线绘制（任务依赖是上游卡片右缘到下游卡片左缘的三次贝塞尔，另有队长总线、成员同级总线、成员到任务的 tether）。卡片是绝对定位 DOM，连线是一层 SVG，两者共用同一组几何常量。布局常量与路径算法移植自 cc-haha。数据读当前会话实时的 agentTeam 投影（名册、共享任务、依赖边、执行态）；会话没有团队时回退到本会话的工作清单。团队消息暂不在投影里，通讯面板显示空态。主体配色走宿主主题 token；八名成员的身份色是刻意的例外——色相固定，饱和度与明度用 color-mix 从主题强调色派生，且以 CSS 变量声明，因为这些值同时喂给 SVG 的 stroke 属性，而该位置不接受颜色函数。带中英文字典，两份键位一致。

description.en: Adds a Polish button to the composer tool row right of the permission control: it reads the draft you have already typed, has the current model infer your intent and rewrite the draft into a clearer prompt, then turns the button into Cancel so one click restores the exact pre-polish text.
description.zh: 在对话框工具行「权限」按钮右侧加一个「润色」按钮：读取输入框里已写好的草稿，先让当前模型推断你的意图再改写成更清晰的提示词，润色完成后按钮变为「取消」，一键回退到润色前的原文。

description.en: A full-screen terminal workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a durable assistant, workspace-grouped project sessions, transcript-only scrolling, and structured thinking, tool, diff, plan, and subagent views.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端工作台，提供独立持久助手、按工作区分组的项目会话、仅聊天区滚动，以及结构化思考、工具、diff、计划和子代理视图。

description.en: Turns the "deep diving" thinking status into a pixel font, with an animated pixel blue whale spouting and wagging its tail beside it.
description.zh: 把「深度求索中」变成像素字，旁边一只像素蓝鲸喷水摆尾。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-balance

description.en: Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.
description.zh: DSH Web 余额与会话用量插件：头部余额按钮（Session log 左侧），下拉展示账户余额、实时 token 明细（缓存未命中/命中、缓存写入、输出）、缓存命中率，以及按官方峰谷价自动切换的费用估算。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A shared right sidebar for the DSH web client — other plugins register tabs into the `rightbar.tab` slot instead of each pinning a `position:fixed` panel; ships a `rightbar-tab` skill for agents and an opt-in mode that moves legacy fixed panels aside.
description.zh: DSH 网页端的共享右栏——别的插件往 `rightbar.tab` 槽位注册标签页，不必各自 `position:fixed` 抢位置；随包附带给 agent 用的 `rightbar-tab` skill，另有一个默认关闭的让位模式把老面板挪开。

description.en: Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent's next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 输入框的斜杠菜单里单独一组插件命令：/steer 在模型下一步注入内容且不打断当前回合，/new 开启空白会话，/skill 与 /docs 在 /steer 基础上附加完成后写入 skill 或 docs，并可在设置里为常用 /steer 内容配置自定义快捷命令。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-workbench-plugin

description.en: Fills in the Web UI's missing IDE workbench: resizable chat / editor / files-and-Git columns in Conversation, multi-tab file editing with save and new-file, workspace Terminal, a file tree with name filter and open-in-external-editor, SCM (stage/commit/push/pull, branch switch, Git graph, inline diffs), a status bar, and git_* model tools.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 补齐缺失的 IDE 工作台：对话页可拖拽三栏（对话 / 编辑器 / 文件与 Git），多标签编辑（保存、新建、路径面包屑、行内 diff）、工作区 Terminal、文件树（按名筛选、用外部编辑器打开）、源代码管理（暂存/提交/推送/拉取、分支切换、提交图）、状态栏，以及 git_* 模型工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

description.en: Replaces the sidebar's More menu with a single button that opens Settings.
description.zh: 把侧栏左下角的「更多」菜单换成一个直接打开设置的按钮。

description.en: Adds a Canvas drawer and eight model tools to create, patch, version, and export HTML, Markdown, Mermaid, SVG, and React artifacts.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 增加 Canvas 抽屉与八个模型工具，用于创建、局部补丁、版本管理和导出 HTML、Markdown、Mermaid、SVG 与 React 工件。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement and structuring button for DSH composer.
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键提示词结构化增强与润色插件。

description.en: Ask the user a question about a local image; the DSH Web card offers zoom, pan, box, brush and lasso annotation, NG/OK/unsure verdicts and a note, and the agent receives annotations back in source-image pixel coordinates.
description.zh: 带本地图片向用户提问；DSH Web 卡片支持缩放平移、框选、画笔与套索标注、NG/OK/不确定判定和说明，Agent 收回原图像素坐标下的标注。

description.en: Markdown live rendering for the DSH Web UI composer: typed Markdown (bold, lists, code fences) renders as you type in a CodeMirror-based takeover composer; sent user messages render as Markdown; pasted rich text becomes clean Markdown.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 输入区 Markdown 实时渲染：输入中的粗体/列表/代码块即时成型（CodeMirror 接管卡）；已发送的用户消息按 Markdown 呈现；粘贴富文本转为干净 Markdown。

description.en: Visual frontend revision workbench: point at a real page element, describe the change, send it into the current DSH session, then review fixed-viewport before/after screenshots (1280x800 and 390x844) beside a captured source diff, accepting each revision item by item. Revision records are kept per session under .dsh-revise/ and export as a single portable HTML report.
description.zh: 可视化前端改稿台：点选真实页面元素、描述改动并送入当前 DSH 会话，再把固定视口的改动前后截图（1280x800 与 390x844）与抓取的源码 diff 并排复核，逐条验收。改稿记录按会话存放在项目的 .dsh-revise/ 目录，可导出为单文件 HTML 报告。

description.en: Auto-pairs brackets and quotes in the DSH chat composer, inserting the closing half with the caret in between; it also wraps selected text with the typed pair and handles brackets committed by an IME.
description.zh: DSH 聊天输入框的括号/引号自动配对：输入左半边自动补右半边并把光标停在中间；也支持用符号包裹选中文字，以及中文输入法提交的括号。

description.en: A native reasoning-effort control for the composer: a blue-to-violet tier bar with a starfield and a sheen sweep. It owns the model seat and drives the official model-directories service, so the ladder comes from each model's own reasoning declaration and no other plugin is required.
description.zh: 原生推理档位控件：蓝紫渐变档位条，带星点与流光。它自己占用模型座位并只对接官方 modelDirectories 服务，档位由每个模型自身的 reasoning 声明决定，不依赖任何其它插件。

description.en: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每个由会话支持的消息编辑器旁提供全局快捷动作。一键发送预置或你自己保存的文本，每个动作可单独设置发送确认。

description.en: Turns every file artifact the agent names in chat into a clickable entry — and refuses to paint one that does not resolve. Hover resolves asynchronously, and only a file that really exists becomes a hand pointer with a dashed blue outline (30 s TTL cache, so repeated hovers cost nothing); confirmed non-artifacts stay plain text and the right-click falls through to the host menu untouched. Left click reveals the file in Explorer already selected (Shell.Application Explore plus SelectItem with SVSI_ENSUREVISIBLE, so the pane scrolls to it; explorer.exe /select is deliberately not used because it silently drops the selection when an instance is already running). Right click offers seven actions: preview in DSH's built-in sidebar, open with the default app, reveal in Explorer, save as, copy the file itself to the clipboard, copy the absolute path, or insert the path into the composer. Ctrl or Shift with left click opens with the default app, Alt with left click copies the path. Names resolve through the absolute path, the session workspace and every profile workspace, then a cached basename index built with a depth budget, shrinking from the left when a mention swallows leading words. The host half also keeps six system-prompt rules resident, so absolute paths stay in tool arguments while the body shows only file names, and every route is loopback-only.
description.zh: 把对话里出现的每个文件产物变成可点入口，并且拒绝给解析不到的文件画芯片。悬停时先异步解析，只有文件真的存在才变手型并画蓝色虚线框（结果进 30 秒 TTL 缓存，反复悬停不重复请求）；确认不是产物的片段保持普通文字，右键直接放行宿主原生菜单。左键在资源管理器里定位并选中该文件（Shell.Application 的 Explore + SelectItem，带 SVSI_ENSUREVISIBLE 所以会自动滚到可见处；刻意不用 explorer.exe /select，因为已有窗口时它会静默丢掉选中）。右键七项：在侧边栏预览、用默认程序打开、在文件夹中显示、另存为、复制文件、复制文件路径、添加到对话框。Ctrl/Shift+左键用默认程序打开，Alt+左键复制路径。路径按绝对路径、会话工作区、各 profile 工作区、以及带深度预算的同名文件索引逐级解析，遇到「提及吞掉了前面几个词」时从左收缩重试。宿主侧还常驻六条系统提示词铁律，让绝对路径留在工具参数里、正文只写文件名；所有路由仅回环可用。

description.en: Full-screen lightbox for chat images: click any image to open the full-resolution original with zoom (wheel, buttons, shortcuts), drag panning, prev/next paging, filename caption and download, plus keyboard-arrow and touch-swipe navigation. One "image display control" popover next to the composer collapses every image in the conversation into a thumbnail grid whose column count (1-12) is configurable and remembered, or hides them entirely so the space closes up and restores them later; images are styled in place and no node is ever moved or reparented. The host-side display_image tool takes a local path or directory (TIFF/HEIC transcoded, originals still saved on download), a remote URL, or a keyword search over Bing, Huaban and Sogou that samples loadability before picking a source, re-saves images blocked by hotlink protection and drops dead links after a magic-byte check, returning paste-ready Markdown. It also keeps a system-prompt rule that every delivered image must appear in the reply body as ![](…) markdown, because collapsed tool rows are invisible to the reader.
description.zh: 聊天图片全屏查看器：点击任意图片打开原始分辨率大图，支持缩放（滚轮、按钮、快捷键）、拖拽平移、左右翻页、文件名显示、下载保存，以及键盘方向键与移动端滑动切换。输入框旁一个「对话图显控制」面板，可一键把整个会话的图收成可调列数（1–12，自动记忆）的缩略图网格，或整块隐藏并收掉占位、随时还原；图片只原地加样式，绝不搬移或重挂节点。宿主侧 display_image 工具支持本地路径或目录（TIFF/HEIC 自动转码，下载仍保存原文件）、网络直链、以及 Bing、花瓣、搜狗的关键词搜图（按抽样可加载率选源，被防盗链拦截的自动转存，坏链按字节校验剔除），返回可直接粘贴的 Markdown；并在 system prompt 常驻一条投递规则，要求发出的图必须写进回复正文（![](…)），因为折叠的工具行读者看不到。

description.en: DIY the DSH UI typography and colours: 10 built-in regions plus box-select region creation, each with its own Chinese and English font, size, line-height, weight (100-900), italic switch and text colour picker; 18 Chinese and 18 English fonts ship in the pickers, every region can be overridden by one unified setting, and named theme presets can be saved, applied, renamed and deleted. Random font assignment and random colour generation work for the whole UI or per region, and 8 fonts (LXGW WenKai, Smiley Sans, ZCOOL KuaiLe, Comic Neue, Baloo 2, Fredoka, Nunito, Caveat) can be downloaded and installed with one click (only Comic Neue ships in the package) alongside your own .ttf/.otf files, with a factory-default reset that restores the shipped palette. A 字 floating ball opens the panel, which carries a collapsible quick-start guide, and position and settings persist across restarts. The ball is shown or hidden from the DSH settings floating-ball section together with the other two balls, which share one 130-skin catalogue with a per-ball sync switch.
description.zh: DIY 你的 DSH 界面字体与颜色：10 个内置区域 + 框选建区，每区域独立设中英文字体、字号、行距、字重（100–900）、斜体开关与文字颜色取色器；内置 18 款中文字体与 18 款英文字体，支持全局统一覆盖，主题方案可保存、应用、重命名与删除。随机字体可按整站或单区域生成，配色可随机生成高区分度颜色；另有 8 款字体（霞鹜文楷、得意黑、站酷快乐体、Comic Neue、Baloo 2、Fredoka、Nunito、Caveat）可一键下载安装（仅 Comic Neue 随包），也支持选本地 .ttf/.otf 安装，并可一键恢复出厂默认配色。右下角「字」悬浮球打开面板，面板内含可折叠的快速上手栏，位置与配置重启后依然保留。可在 DSH 设置页「悬浮球导航」分区与另两个球一起显隐，三球共享 130 款皮肤且各带同步开关。

description.en: Turns the LobsterDaddy multi-account console into a floating ball in the DSH window: drag it anywhere and the position persists, and the panel can be set to follow the ball. Clicking it slides out a drawer that renders the console as native DOM (no iframe) from the loopback-only same-origin proxy, showing action buttons, the account LobsterAI is currently signed in as, and a per-account list with balance, check-in state and last check-in time; a resizable persisted drawer, a live online/offline dot and an account-count badge are included.
description.zh: 把 LobsterDaddy 多账号控制台变成 DSH 界面上的悬浮球：可拖到任意位置并自动记忆坐标，面板可设置为跟随悬浮球移动；点开以抽屉呈现控制台——界面由原生 DOM 渲染（不用 iframe），数据经仅限本机的同源反向代理获取，自上而下为操作按钮、当前登录账号、以及含积分余额与签到状态（附最近签到时间）的账号列表；抽屉可拖动缩放并记忆尺寸，另有在线状态圆点与账号数徽标。

description.en: Browse and govern the skill library from a floating-ball panel with three tabs — skills, call ledger and quick start. You choose the skill root yourself through a native directory chooser (defaults to ~/.dsh/skills, no path is shipped with the plugin); skills are grouped into two levels of categories, with manual, keyword-based and AI grouping available and a tree or flat view toggle, and grouping is purely visual so no skill file is ever moved. Descriptions are read from each SKILL.md frontmatter, search filters by skill name, description or original text, and a card opens the full SKILL.md. Skills can be switched on and off per card, per category or for the whole library — the toggle rewrites disable-model-invocation in that SKILL.md and writes a SKILL.md.bak-toggle-<timestamp> backup before saving, rolling back if the write fails; disabled cards grey out until restored. The call ledger separates automatic from manual entries, records skill successes and failures by listening to tools/result events, and reports call counts, success rate, trend and a ranking, reusing an existing ledger file found in the library. Hot reload picks up skill edits without a restart. The DSH settings page gains a floating-ball section that shows or hides the three balls, offers one-click restore of a ball dragged off-screen, and picks the shared 130-skin catalogue for all three balls.
description.zh: 悬浮球面板直接浏览与治理技能库，分「技能浏览 / 调用台账 / 快速上手」三页。技能库位置由你自己指定（弹系统目录选择框，默认 ~/.dsh/skills，插件不含任何预设路径）；技能按两级分类归组，支持手动分组、关键词分组与 AI 分组三种方案，并可切树状/平铺视图，分组只改视图不动任何技能文件。中文简介直接读各 SKILL.md 的 frontmatter，支持按技能名、简介或原文实时搜索，点卡片查看 SKILL.md 全文。技能可单个卡片、按分类或全库批量启停——启停即改写该 SKILL.md frontmatter 的 disable-model-invocation，写盘前自动备份为 SKILL.md.bak-toggle-<时间戳>，写失败自动回滚；停用卡灰显带徽章、随时一键恢复。调用台账分「自动 / 人工」两栏显示，监听 tools/result 事件自动登记成功与失败，并给出调用次数、成功率、趋势与排行；初始化时会先在技能库内搜索已有台账文件复用。支持一键热重载，改完技能无需重启。DSH 设置页新增「悬浮球导航」分区，可控制三个悬浮球的显隐、一键复位被拖出屏幕的球，并为三球统一挑选共享的 130 款皮肤。

description.en: Draggable floating ball that shows the current DSH session todo checklist live — done/total on its face (capsule mode also shows the running task title) plus a matching progress ring. Click to expand or fold the full list, right-click to switch capsule mode, and state colours mark in-progress (pulsing), done, pending and empty. Replaced plans are archived as history rows that can be hidden one by one, cleared and restored instead of counting towards progress, and other sessions can be pinned side by side. Data comes from the runtime sessions projection first with the official todo panel as a fallback, so the full list survives even when the official strip is collapsed. Text colour can be forced to auto, black or white, the ball snaps back to the bottom-right corner on demand, and it stays draggable right up to the top edge of the window. 130 shared skins — including two official dark and light skins that follow the client light/dark theme automatically, plus a per-ball sync switch so each ball either follows the shared skin or keeps its own — with Shadow DOM style isolation and position remembered per profile, identical on desktop and web.
description.zh: 常驻可拖动悬浮球实时显示当前会话的 todo 清单：球面显示完成数/总数（胶囊模式另显示进行中任务名），外环进度环同步百分比；点击展开或收起完整清单，右键切胶囊模式，状态用颜色区分（进行中橙色脉动、完成绿、待办蓝、无清单灰）。被替换的旧计划自动归档成历史行（可逐行隐藏、批量清理、一键恢复），不再计入进度；其他会话可固定并排查看。数据以 runtime 的 sessions 投影为准，官方 todo 面板仅作兜底——所以官方计划条收起时球上仍是完整清单。文字颜色可强制为自动/黑/白，球被拖走后可一键归位到右下角，拖到窗口最顶部也照样能拖。130 款共享皮肤——含两款随客户端深/浅主题自动切换的官方深色与浅色皮肤，另有每球独立的同步开关，可跟随共享皮肤或保留自己的皮肤——Shadow DOM 样式隔离，位置按 profile 记忆，桌面端与网页端表现一致。

description.en: DSH input assistant for next-message prediction, draft autocomplete (text completion), and prompt polishing/rewrite. Session-local suggestions; Tab accepts into the draft without sending. Requires a configured model; calls may incur charges. Source-available; modifications require prior written permission.
description.zh: DSH 输入助手：输入预测、草稿补全（自动补全）、提示词润色（prompt 优化）；根据对话给出下一句建议。Tab 接受只填入草稿、不自动发送，建议按会话保留。需配置模型，调用可能计费。源码可见，修改须事先取得书面许可。

description.en: A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.
description.zh: dsh 的 Live2D 看板娘插件。

description.en: Plan review enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web: reply to the plan-review card inline to have the model revise the plan, and browse, compare, edit and archive every plan version in a full-screen overlay.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的计划评审增强：在评审卡片内直接回复意见让模型修订计划，并在全屏浮层中回看、对比、编辑和留档每一版计划。

description.en: Hierarchical workspace tree plus browser-style session tabs for the DSH sidebar: a "/" in a workspace or session title creates a virtual folder, with sections, pinning, time buckets, drag ordering, unified 6px status dots, per-row appearance customization (colour, glow, weight, icon) and a floating full-text search over session titles and message bodies. Several settings switches restore any behaviour to the host default, and a host-side route deletes sessions permanently (DSH ships archive only). Fork of KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的工作区层级树与浏览器式会话标签页：工作区或会话标题中的 / 自动成为虚拟分组，另含分区、置顶、时间分桶、拖拽排序、统一 6px 状态点、按行定制外观（颜色 / 发光 / 字重 / 图标），以及覆盖会话标题与消息正文的浮层全文检索。配置页多个开关可把任一行为还原为宿主默认；宿主侧另有永久删除会话的路由（DSH 只有归档）。fork 自 KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace。

description.en: Shows a dimmed suggestion of the user's next message in the empty composer after a settled turn; Tab accepts it into the draft and Escape or typing dismisses it.
description.zh: 在一轮对话结束后，用灰字在空的输入框里给出下一句建议；Tab 填入草稿，Esc 或打字忽略。

description.en: Customize the UI's Chinese and English fonts, code font, and global font-size offset on a settings page, with a live preview and one-click reset.
description.zh: 在设置页自定义界面中英文/代码字体与全局字号偏移，实时预览，一键恢复默认。

description.en: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 重排为三栏工作台，提供文件编辑、Git 视图、Markdown 预览和工作区终端。

description.en: A local overview of installed DSH plugins. It does not install packages — pair it with a plugin market. Fold third-party settings, organize notes/groups with AI, check health and toggle plugins, so nothing gets lost in clutter.
description.zh: 本地已装插件总览：不下载插件，和插件市场搭配；一键收纳第三方插件设置，AI 整理备注与分组，配合健康诊断和启停，让插件不再乱而不知。

description.en: Adds a sidebar card to DeepSeek Harness (Windows only) that shuts the machine down once every task finishes and the card is armed, holding back while background jobs, errored sessions or manual interruptions are still in play.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏加一张卡片（仅 Windows），武装后等所有任务结束自动关机；后台任务在跑、本批次有会话报错、或你手动中断过，都会按条件暂缓并说明原因。

description.en: Read-only /btw side questions for DeepSeek Harness: forks the current session, injects the running turn's task, recent tool calls and partial answer so a mid-turn question has context, denies every tool call at execution time, and keeps a per-session topic history with follow-up, stop, retry and delete.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的只读 /btw 旁问：fork 当前会话，并在主回合仍在运行时补入当前任务、最近的工具调用和流式输出作为上下文；执行期拒绝所有工具调用；按会话保留支持追问、停止、重试和删除的主题历史。

description.en: Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.
description.zh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

description.en: An Artifacts tab in the DSH sidebar that lists the files an agent produced and previews them in place with live reload, plus artifact template tools for agents.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的 Artifacts 标签页：列出 agent 产出的文件并就地预览、支持实时刷新，另提供 artifact 模板工具。

description.en: Replaces the DSH sidebar list with a workspace rail: pinned chats and folders, projects that are folders with their own AGENTS.md and files, a virtualized Recents list ordered by the last finished turn, a project_search tool, unread markers, a collapsed icon column with an unread count and a live browser tab title.
description.zh: 用工作区栏替代 DSH 侧栏列表：置顶会话与文件夹；项目即带自有 AGENTS.md 和文件的文件夹；Recents 为按最后一次完成 turn 排序的虚拟列表；提供 project_search 工具、未读标记、带未读数的折叠图标栏，以及随会话实时更新的浏览器标签标题。

description.en: A draggable desktop pet for the DSH web interface with interactive actions and growth states.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 界面的可拖拽桌宠，支持互动动作与成长状态。

description.en: Compact 56px app navigation rail with a separate conversation list and sidebar collapse control for the DSH web UI; also hides embedding, rerank and image/video generation models from the chat model menu and /model.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 56px 紧凑应用导航栏、独立对话列表与侧栏展开/收起控制；并在对话模型菜单和 /model 中筛除向量、重排及生图/视频型号。

description.en: Adaptation packs for third-party DSH plugin panels on phones — 44px touch floor, width reclaim, shell hit targets and floating-widget clearance — loaded by the dsh-mobile plugin from its extensions directory (dsh-mobile must be installed for them to take effect), with a settings page that installs them and a per-plugin compatibility list.
description.zh: 第三方 DSH 插件面板的手机适配包：44px 触控地板、宽度回收、外壳命中区与浮动控件让位；由 dsh-mobile 插件从其 extensions 目录加载（须先装 dsh-mobile 才会生效），附设置页一键装/卸与插件兼容清单。

description.en: Global cross-session todo list in the sidebar that the person and the agent both write to: ten global_todo_* tools add, batch-capture, update, attach documents and links to, append progress notes to and complete items from any session, and each item can be handed to an agent session in one of four modes with the outcome recorded on the item. The list is a single JSON file.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的全局跨会话待办清单，人和 agent 共用同一份：十个 global_todo_* 工具可在任意会话中新增、批量抓取、修改、挂文档与链接、追加进展记录、标记完成；每条待办可按四种方式交给 agent 会话，派发结果记回条目本身。清单存成一个 JSON 文件。

description.en: Lightweight sidebar UI for DeepSeek Harness: five fold switches, three density presets and three width presets, served from one footer row plus a settings section — no dependencies and no background service.
description.zh: 轻量级侧栏 UI：五个折叠开关、三档密度预设与三档宽度预设，入口收在底部一行与设置分区；无依赖、无后台服务。

description.en: Context-based next-message suggestions and draft rewriting for DeepSeek Harness, with candidate paging, shortcut recording, and companion MCP tools.
description.zh: 根据会话生成下一条消息建议并优化草稿，支持候选翻页、快捷键录制和配套 MCP 工具。

description.en: Drag a session out of the DSH sidebar and it opens in its own native OS window, showing the full standard conversation UI (Markdown, toolbar, settings) with only the sidebar trimmed away, so several sessions can be watched side by side instead of switching back and forth. Windows verified; macOS and Linux untested. Runs in the DSH desktop app (Electron).
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧边栏里的会话拖出来，即在独立的原生系统窗口中打开；窗口内是完整的标准会话界面（Markdown、工具栏、设置都在），只裁掉侧边栏，因此可以同时盯住多个会话，不必来回切换。Windows 已验证，macOS/Linux 未实测；需在 DSH 桌面端（Electron）中使用。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens DeepSeek web chat in an in-app window for quick questions while working. Fork of zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat (already listed); it uses its own settings namespace, so both can coexist. Needs the desktop bridge (window.dsh.desktop.openWindow).
description.zh: 在侧边栏增加网页对话入口，将 DeepSeek 网页对话打开在应用内窗口中，方便工作时临时提问。基于 zerorigin-studio/dsh-deepseek-chat（已在目录内）的分支；使用独立设置命名空间，可与上游共存。需要桌面端桥（window.dsh.desktop.openWindow）。

description.en: Global cross-session todo inbox for DSH web: any session's agent records human-action todos (merge MRs, approve work orders, reviews) via inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list; a sidebar entry shows a count badge and an expandable list to open and complete them, persisted to ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json.
description.zh: DSH Web 全局跨会话待办收件箱：任意会话的 agent 通过 inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list 登记等待人类处理的事项（合并 MR、审批工单、评审等）；侧边栏入口显示未完成数角标与可展开的待办列表，支持打开与完成，数据持久化到 ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json。

description.en: Adds a restart button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop app — it asks before restarting while work is running, and afterwards reports how long the app was down. Entries can live in the sidebar, the conversation header, the account menu or the settings page, and each one can be turned off. Extras include checking how much sign-in data is stored (a cause of startup failures) and previewing leftover temp files, counted but never deleted. Desktop app only.
description.zh: 在桌面版加一个「重启」按钮：有任务在跑时先问过你，重启后告诉你停机了多久。入口可放在侧栏、会话标题栏、账号菜单或设置页，不想要的能逐个关掉。附带功能：检查登录数据占用（避免应用启动失败）、预览遗留临时文件（只统计不删除）、隐藏账号菜单里的「意见反馈」。仅适用于桌面版。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort card for the composer: takes over the model selector and shows the current level, the model row and a segmented slider over the model's own adapter-provided levels, with a model list, a reset, and a purple aurora with twinkling particles at the maximum level.
description.zh: 输入框里的 Codex 风格推理强度卡片：接管模型选择器，显示当前档位、模型行，以及覆盖模型适配器所报全部档位的分段滑块；另带模型列表、重置，以及最高档时的紫色极光与闪烁粒子。

description.en: Adds a refresh button to the DeepSeek Harness desktop title bar next to the Edit menu, reloading the interface without restarting the app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端顶部标题栏「编辑」右边加一个「刷新」按钮，只重载界面、不重启应用。

description.en: Adds a visible vertical scrollbar to the DSH Web settings navigation when its sections exceed the viewport.
description.zh: 当 DSH Web 设置导航的分区超出视口时，为其添加可见的纵向滚动条。

description.en: Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a dropdown of presets below the model default, the choice applies to the next request of that session only, and a new session falls back to the profile default. It writes no config file and appends nothing to the session log.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型弹窗的「推理等级」旁增加会话级上下文窗口选择器：显示当前生效窗口的胶囊按钮可展开默认窗口以下的档位下拉，选择只作用于该会话的下一次请求，新建会话自动回到 Profile 默认值。不改任何配置文件，也不向会话日志写入内容。

description.en: Replace tool-card leading icons with emoji while preserving the original cards.
description.zh: 把工具卡片前面的图标换成 emoji，同时保留原卡片全部内容。

description.en: Replaces the kernel boot page with a full-window video clip that dissolves into the app; the clip pool, enter mode and fade length are configurable in Settings → Plugins.
description.zh: 用全窗口短片替换内核启动页，片尾交叉溶解进入界面；素材池、进入方式与淡入时长都能在「设置 → 插件」里调整。

description.en: Adds an Optimize button to the composer that rewrites a one-line idea into a structured product brief: a positioning sentence, 3–6 key features, visual references and design tokens; it sits beside your original text in a compare dialog where you can accept it into the input, generate another version, or cancel and keep the draft untouched. No settings page and no API keys — it calls the model channel you already configured.
description.zh: 输入框右侧加一个「优化」按钮：把一句话的口语需求改写成结构化产品简报——一句话定位、3–6 条核心功能、视觉参考、设计规范（配色/尺寸等令牌），左右并排对照原文，可接受回填输入框、重新生成一版，或取消保持原文；不占布局、没有设置页，直接调用你已配置的模型渠道。

description.en: A font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height, weight, tracking, word gap, paragraph gap and first-line indent, the interface font follows it, code keeps its own axis with ligature control; light and dark can each hold their own set, whole setups save as presets, and a floating panel puts every axis a dot away.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的字体插件：对话有自己的字体、字号、行高、字重、字距、词距、段距与首行缩进，界面字体跟随对话，代码独立成轴并支持连字；亮色与暗色可各调一套，整套配置存为预设，另有一个悬浮调参面板。

description.en: Effort slider in the model menu, a live tokens-per-second and turn-total readout beside the running status, a per-answer input/output/cached report, and a completion notification when a turn finishes, for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 模型菜单里的思考强度滑块、运行状态旁的实时速度与本轮用量、每条回答的输入/输出/缓存成绩单，以及每轮结束的完成通知；各自独立开关，只作用于界面。

description.en: Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: the Markdown headings of the whole session, grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews can be pinned for comparison, bookmarks keep the places you come back to, and a right-click jumps to a section or copies a heading and the levels below it. Six theme colours and a translucent material, title/prompt/full-text/cross-session search, reading-position follow and a Chinese/English interface.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话大纲：按回合整理整段会话的 Markdown 标题，侧边面板与全屏「幕布」两种视图；悬停预览可钉住对照，书签留住常回看的几处，右键即可跳转到某一节或复制标题及其下面所有层级。支持六种主题色与半透明材质、标题/提问/全文/跨会话搜索、阅读位置跟随与中英双语界面。

description.en: Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.
description.zh: DSH 右侧 details 列项目资源管理器（多选、拖拽移动、上传、下载、重命名、废纸篓、系统打开），会话内只读预览 Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/Notebook/PDF 与代码高亮，附带模型实时吞吐徽标与多行 GoalBar。

description.en: Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.
description.zh: 在会话头显示实时状态徽标，并在不打断当前回合的前提下投递运行中新增的指导。

description.en: An always-on-top desktop pet (a washing machine) that renders session state as washing actions: four switchable skins, multi-session counters, and proactive done / stuck / approval alerts on macOS and Windows, plus a detail panel with recent turns and timings.
description.zh: 常驻桌面的桌宠（桌面宠物）：一台滚筒洗衣机，把会话状态渲染成洗衣动作，四套皮肤（精密家电 / 复古奶油 / 工笔重彩 / 太空舱）可切换，多会话计数、洗完 / 卡住 / 等你确认主动提醒；macOS 与 Windows 均可运行，详情面板可看最近几轮与耗时。

plugins.name: dsh-coros-plugin

description.en: COROS Sport panel for DeepSeek Harness: sign in to COROS inside the panel, read the account, bound devices, recovery, fitness, recent workouts, daily health and the training schedule in one dashboard, and get a plan from the model with /coros-plan. The plan page writes a fixed four-week, 16-session plan to the account only after a two-step confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内登录高驰（COROS）账号，用一个面板查看账号、绑定设备、恢复、体能、近期运动、每日健康与训练安排，并可用 /coros-plan 让模型按账号数据给出训练计划；计划页只在二次确认后才把固定的四周 16 节课写入账号。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.
description.zh: 把 agent 的文件改动审查放进 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab 或对话尾部行，支持行级 diff 与撤销。

description.en: Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH Web 侧边栏与会话页的品牌图标和名称，插件详情页内置设置卡片，保存即生效。

description.en: Manchester United 2026/27 fixtures in the sidebar with kickoff times in your local timezone, finished matches with W/L/D results.
description.zh: 在侧边栏查看曼联 2026/27 赛季赛程，开球时间按你的本地时区显示，已结束比赛带 W/L/D 比分结果。

description.en: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用可切换的阿里云百炼与火山方舟图像服务生成 UI 线框图和高保真设计稿。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-zh_pro

description.en: UI enhancement suite for the DSH web client: Chinese locale completion, one-row stats, auto-expanded thinking, chat width, session archiving and delete, plus an optional prompt-injection switch (off by default).
description.zh: DSH 网页 UI 综合增强：中文补全、统计单行显示、思考自动展开、对话宽度、会话归档与删除，并可选的提示词注入（默认关闭）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Automatically loads the full conversation history when a session opens, so older messages are ready without clicking "Load earlier".
description.zh: 打开会话时自动加载全部历史消息，免去反复点击「加载更早」。

description.en: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.
description.zh: 会话标题栏按钮循环切换对话宽度（748–1600px），消息区、输入框、用户气泡同步加宽。

description.en: Local long-term schedule panel: top-bar "日程" text button, today/week/history month-calendar views with stats, completion checkmarks with per-day history, schedule↔conversation links with click-to-jump, recurring tasks (daily/weekly), optional auto carry-over for unfinished one-time tasks, and dailytask_* agent tools.
description.zh: 本地长期日程面板:顶栏「日程」文字按钮、今天/本周/历史月历统计视图、完成打勾(按天记录历史)、日程↔会话链接点击跳转、重复日程(每天/每周)、一次性日程可选未完成自动顺延,以及 dailytask_* agent 工具。

description.en: Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.
description.zh: 会话左侧消息标记条：每发一条消息多一根条条，点击跳转到该消息、悬停预览内容，当前消息对应的条条变白。

description.en: Four-tier prompt enhancer for the composer — the system tier always emits a LangGPT-structured system prompt (# Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization), upgrading task drafts into the system prompt of the agent that runs them, while the other tiers rewrite as a light tidy-up, a single paragraph, or a five-section brief; the iterate workbench refines an editable base under an optional requirement, with fill-back and undo. Never changes intent, never invents requirements.
description.zh: 输入框四档提示词增强——系统档无条件输出 # Role / Profile / Skills / Rules / Workflows / Initialization 的 LangGPT 结构化系统提示词（任务型草稿升格为对应智能体），其余三档改写为轻度整理、单段或五段任务书；迭代工作台以可编辑基准加可选要求继续改写，支持回填与撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Find bar in the sidebar text preview, with whole-file match counts for plain text and code, highlighted hits, and jumps between them.
description.zh: 侧边栏文本预览的查找栏：纯文本与代码按整份文件计数，命中高亮并可逐处跳转。

description.en: Configurable statistics row below the composer via a ${variable} display template — which segments appear and how they are labelled is fully user-defined.
description.zh: 用 ${变量} 显示模板自定义输入框下方的会话统计行——显示哪些统计段、单位文案怎么写，全部由模板决定。

description.en: Adds a single “Restart DeepSeek Harness” item to the Windows system tray menu of the DSH desktop app by patching the installed app.asar in place and re-applying that patch after each desktop update; it needs a writable DSH installation directory and adds no other tray actions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端的 Windows 系统托盘菜单中只增加一个“重启 DeepSeek Harness”项，做法是原位修改已安装的 app.asar 并在桌面端每次更新后重打补丁；需要 DSH 安装目录可写，不添加其他托盘操作。

description.en: Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service.
description.zh: 为输入区提供富 Markdown 笔记本：工具行开关加 CodeMirror 编辑卡片，支持 Codex 风格列表编辑，经会话服务提交。

description.en: Edit global AGENTS.md and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md custom instructions in DeepSeek Harness settings, with project-chain discovery, byte-budget display, and save-conflict handling.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页编辑全局 AGENTS.md 和项目 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md 个性化指令，提供项目指令链浏览、字节预算显示与保存冲突处理。

description.en: Scores sessions and workspaces 0-100% by time since their last activity, then shows that heat as a sidebar icon, a small heat dot before every session title, a heat line in the session hover card, and a filterable sessions/workspaces panel that also totals the turns, steps, tokens and conversation time of each workspace.
description.zh: 按距最后一次活动的时间给会话与工作区打 0–100% 热度分，并在侧边栏图标、会话标题前的小热度圆点、会话悬浮卡片和可筛选的会话/工作区面板中呈现；工作区卡片还汇总该工作区的轮次、步数、Token 与会话时长。

description.en: Fixes the Windows workspace-open action. The shipped opener runs `explorer.exe "<file:// URI>"`, which on some hosts reports success without raising a window — the exit-code verdict cannot tell an opened window from nothing happening. This routes that one action to `explorer.exe /e,<dir>`, which raises a window reliably, and leaves every other application in the menu on the shipped path.
description.zh: 修正 Windows 上「打开工作目录」的行为。官方调用 `explorer.exe "<file:// URI>"`，在某些主机上会报告成功却不弹窗口——因为成功判据是退出码，分不出「窗口开了」和「什么都没发生」。本插件把该操作改走 `explorer.exe /e,<目录>`，稳定新开窗口；菜单里其它应用仍走官方路径。

description.en: RGB lighting effects for DeepSeek Harness: animated composer ring, sidebar rail, session indicator, and glowing brand logo.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 RGB 动效：消息输入框光环、侧边栏光条、活动会话指示器与品牌 Logo 矢量发光。

description.en: Codex-style paste collapse for the DeepSeek Harness composer: a paste of more than 1000 characters becomes a `[Pasted Content N chars]` placeholder, a second paste of the same size is numbered `#2`, and the host expands it back to the full text before the model reads it, so the model still receives every character. A pill on the top edge of the composer shows the preview, the sent message shows the same pill, and clicking either opens the whole paste in a side panel with a copy button. Pure in memory: nothing is written to disk and no token is saved.
description.zh: Codex 同款粘贴折叠：DSH 输入框里超过 1000 字符的粘贴变成 `[Pasted Content N chars]` 占位符，同样长度再粘一次编成 `#2`；模型读到之前宿主把占位符换回全文，一个字符不少。输入框上沿留一枚胶囊显示预览，发出的消息里也是同一枚胶囊，点开在右侧抽屉看全文并复制。全部在内存里：不写磁盘，也不省 token。

description.en: Automatically highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions in completed assistant answers using one separate model call.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的助手回答完成后，额外调用一次模型，自动高亮其中的关键点、定义、警告和问题。

description.en: Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover unfolds a canvas with full message previews, and clicking jumps to any history message; animates in sync with better-sidebar panels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 画卷式消息导航栏：会话面板右侧一条竖排导轨，每条用户消息一个指示点，scroll-spy 跟随阅读位置，hover 展开画卷查看完整消息预览，点击跳转任意历史消息；与 better-sidebar 面板动画同步避让。

description.en: Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），附带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

description.en: Plugin-button aggregator with carrier + on-site-LLM extensibility: gather any plugin's scattered buttons into one entry (SSiD title bar / web floating ball), LLM registers per environment, right-click deregisters — pure data, no plugin source touched.
description.zh: 插钮聚合器（载体+驻场 LLM 范式）：把任何插件的散落按钮聚合到统一入口（SSiD 标题栏 / web 悬浮球）——LLM 按环境注册、右键删除=注销，纯数据零代码，不动插件源码。

description.en: Edit user messages and add or remove attachments inline, with settings to fork a conversation or regenerate its latest eligible task-starting message in place.
description.zh: 原地修改用户消息文字及增删附件，可在设置中选择新建分支，或在当前对话重新生成最近一条符合条件的任务主消息。

description.en: Live step pill in the DSH session header: folds the durable session event stream into the agent's current action (tool name plus its argument summary), the step index inside the running turn, the elapsed turn time and the todo progress, polls it every 1.2 seconds, and renders blue pulse while working, green for a finished turn and red for a failed tool call; hides itself 9 seconds after a turn ends. On Windows it also opens an always-on-top desktop HUD (set DSH_AGENT_STATUS_HUD=0 to disable).
description.zh: DSH 会话标题栏里的实时进度胶囊：把持久化的会话事件流折叠成 agent 当前动作（工具名 + 参数摘要）、本轮第几步、已耗时与待办进度，每 1.2 秒轮询一次；干活时蓝点脉冲、一轮结束转绿、工具调用失败转红，空闲 9 秒后自动收起。在 Windows 上还会打开常驻置顶桌面小窗（设 DSH_AGENT_STATUS_HUD=0 可关闭）。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-kit

description.en: macOS desktop shell for the DSH web UI: a plugin plus a small Tauri/WKWebView window over the loopback web surface — real macOS fullscreen, single instance, external links delegated to the system browser, and browser-style zoom.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 装进原生 macOS 桌面窗口：插件 + 轻量 Tauri/WKWebView 外壳跑在同一个 loopback 地址上——真 macOS 全屏、单实例、外链交给系统浏览器、类浏览器页面缩放。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to applicationslink

description.en: Personal workbench panel with an overview dashboard, custom kanban boards, a note pad and a file library, persisted to local JSON by the host.
description.zh: 个人工作台面板：总览仪表盘、自定义看板、随手记与资料库，数据由 Host 持久化到本地 JSON。

description.en: Durable, reversible installer that patches DSH Desktop session-reference UX — workspace-prioritized @ candidates, title-first display, two-line menu layout, and sidebar drag-to-composer session references.
description.zh: 可回滚的 DSH Desktop 会话引用体验补丁安装器——@ 菜单当前工作区优先、标题优先展示、两行布局，以及侧边栏拖拽会话到输入区形成引用。

description.en: Animated Claude-style reasoning-effort slider and model picker that replaces the native DSH model selector.
description.zh: Claude 风格动画推理等级滑块与模型选择器，替换原生模型选择器。

description.en: Adapts the DSH Web GUI for mobile screens and adds a workspace file browser with previews and downloads.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供移动端适配，并增加支持预览和下载的工作区文件浏览器。

description.en: Auto-migrate Codex desktop-pet skins into DSH: an animated corner pet that mirrors agent state (thinking, tool use, awaiting approval, failed, done), with per-session frosted-glass dialogs and a full settings panel.
description.zh: 把 Codex 桌宠皮肤自动迁移到 DSH：右下角动画桌宠随 agent 状态实时变化（思考/工具/等待批准/出错/完成），多会话毛玻璃对话框 + 完整设置面板。

description.en: Turns the DSH sidebar into a message view, where a bell button groups sessions by priority and date and each row carries its preview and workspace name.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏切成消息视图：铃铛一键把会话按优先级与日期分组，每行带预览与所属工作区。

description.en: Weather dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with city switching, current conditions, an eight-hour trend, and a five-day forecast.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 天气看板，支持城市切换、当前天气、八小时趋势图和五日预报。

description.en: Quick sticky notes on the composer toolbar: jot ideas or TODOs, auto-saved as Markdown, one click to send into the chat.
description.zh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

description.en: Version badge above the sidebar settings button: shows the current dsh version, expands to list every core package version, and checks npm for updates with one-click deploy.
description.zh: 侧边栏设置按钮上方的版本徽标：常驻显示当前 dsh 版本，展开可查看全部核心包版本，并支持检查 npm 更新与一键部署。

description.en: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.
description.zh: 把消息之间连续的工具调用与思考步骤折叠成单个可展开的括号条目。

plugins.name: DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget

description.en: A fixed-corner whale widget for the DSH web GUI — balance, today's usage and per-turn cost with peak/off-peak pricing, editable balance-alert and daily-budget bubbles, a module-based custom bubble queue with A/B weighted choices and random lines or images, 30+ vendor templates (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Kimi, SiliconFlow, Ark, Zhipu, MiniMax and more) with per-model balance and subscription quota, plus task-end sound, imported audio, custom roles and a resource manager. Local-only, no telemetry.
description.zh: 右下角常驻的小鲸鱼挂件：余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗（含峰谷价），余额预警与今日预算的泡泡内容都可编辑；泡泡点击序列模块化自定义，支持并列加权 A/B、随机台词与随机图片；内置 30+ 厂商模板（OpenAI / OpenRouter / Kimi / 硅基流动 / 方舟 / 智谱 / MiniMax 等），按模型查余额与订阅额度；另有任务结束音效、导入音频、自定义角色与资源管理。数据全在本机，无遥测。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads and sent cards sit on the user bubble.
description.zh: 接近原生的 DSH 附件：PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 走官方缩略图，其它文件经拖入、粘贴或回形针变成 64px 卡片；非图片落到 .dsh-uploads，发送后贴在用户气泡旁。

description.en: Split the DSH conversation area into unlimited native panes — side by side, stacked, 2×2 and an automatic grid — each a real session with its own composer, streaming and approvals.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话区拆成任意数量的原生窗格：左右、上下、田字 2×2 与自动网格，每个窗格都是独立会话。

description.en: In-place text editing from the right-Sidebar document preview with ⌘S save and an external-change conflict check, plus a workspace Files tab (fuzzy search, create/rename/delete, per-file git status) and a Git changes tab whose baseline is the remote upstream — files that match the remote drop off the list.
description.zh: 右侧预览里直接编辑保存文本文件（⌘S、外部改动冲突提示），另带一个可模糊搜索、新建 / 重命名 / 删除、并显示每个文件 git 状态的「文件」页签，以及以远程上游为基准的「Git 改动」页签 —— 改回与远程一致的文件会自动从列表消失。

description.en: Sidebar balance row for DSH Desktop — account balance and a top-up button, right under the version row; refreshes every 10 minutes and whenever the window regains focus, with explicit signed-out and error states.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 侧栏余额行——在「版本 / 检查更新」下面显示账户余额与「充值」按钮，每 10 分钟或窗口重新聚焦时刷新，未登录与读取失败都有明确状态。

description.en: DSH Desktop control center: one-click app updating (progress dialog, unattended install, resume), plus Skills / MCP / Agents / Import settings pages — import agent presets and chat history from Codex, Claude Code, TRAE and WorkBuddy, search remote sources by address, and push notes straight into the composer.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面控制中心：更新中心（侧栏版本号 + 进度条弹窗 + 一键装好 + 断点续传），外加「技能 / MCP / 智能体 / 导入」四个设置页——可从 Codex、Claude Code、TRAE、WorkBuddy 导入智能体预设与历史对话，按源地址联网搜索，侧栏笔记可多选插入聊天输入框。

plugins.name: my-dsh-desktop-extra

description.en: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面增强：一键检查更新、DeepSeek 余额与 API Key、导入其他 AI 工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Codex-style message navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a tick per user message along the conversation edge, hover or click to preview and smooth-jump to the message, with full history auto-loading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Codex 风格的消息导航器：对话边缘为每条用户消息生成刻度，悬停或点击即可预览并平滑跳转到对应消息，自动加载完整历史记录。

description.en: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness web sidebar, workspace tree, search, and turn navigation in a Codex-style layout.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端重构 Codex 风格侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索和轮次导航。

description.en: Drags the official reasoning-effort row into a continuous track: blue-to-violet fill, a starfield on the higher levels, and the official value text tinted to the current level. Off stays gray; no official text is rewritten.
description.zh: 把官方「推理等级」那一行改成一条可拖动的连续轨道：填充从蓝渐变到紫罗兰，较高档位带星尘粒子，官方数值文字跟着档位变色。Off 档保持官方灰，不改写官方任何文字。

description.en: Adds a "Terms" action to finished assistant answers that explains the computer-science terms it detects with Chinese definitions, occurrence counts, highlighted context snippets, and clickable nested explanations from a built-in offline dictionary, with no model calls.
description.zh: 在每条已完成回答的操作条增加「术语」入口，用内置离线词典给出回答中计算机术语的中文释义、提及次数、高亮上下文，并支持点击释义中的术语展开次级解释，不调用模型。

description.en: Composer button that rewrites the current draft with four style presets, selection-only rewriting, a keyboard shortcut and instant undo; no settings page.
description.zh: 输入框一键改写草稿：四种风格档位、划词改写、快捷键与即时撤销，无设置页。

description.en: Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面右下角的一键重启按钮：全屏遮罩原地重启 dsh 进程并自动刷新页面；无需启动脚本，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

description.en: On touch devices, supplies the keys a phone's soft keyboard lacks (Escape, Tab, Enter, Ctrl-C and the arrow keys) as a translucent on-screen column beside the active terminal.
description.zh: 在触屏设备上补齐手机软键盘缺少的按键（Esc、Tab、回车、Ctrl-C、方向键），以半透明按键列浮在活动终端旁。

description.en: Starts the DSH desktop New Workspace folder picker in a directory you configure (Windows only) and adds a settings page for it, falling back to the stock picker when the saved folder is missing.
description.zh: 让 DSH 桌面端「新建工作区」的文件夹选择框从你设定的目录开始（仅 Windows），并在设置里提供配置入口；目录不存在时静默回退到原生选择框。

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with hand-polished translations, runtime fallbacks, and automatic translation of market and third-party text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: A to-do list that lives in the right sidebar instead of the conversation: add an item, tick it off, delete it, and drag rows to reorder them. Items are kept only in the browser's localStorage, and the plugin registers no model-facing tools; a button in the conversation header opens the panel.
description.zh: 放在右侧边栏、不进入对话的待办清单：添加、勾选完成、删除，拖动行即可排序。数据只保存在浏览器的 localStorage 里，插件不注册任何给模型用的工具；会话头部有个按钮可打开面板。

description.en: Codex-style tool call folding, collapsing multiple tool calls into a single line.
description.zh: Codex 风格的工具调用折叠，将多个工具调用折叠到一行内。

description.en: Startup animation picker with three bundled DeepSeek, Codex and Claude Code themes, local MP4/WebM imports and an in-app community library; optional first-screen install and restore on supported Windows DSH NEXT builds.
description.zh: 启动动画选择器，内置DeepSeek、Codex和Claude Code三套主题，支持本地MP4/WebM导入和插件内社区动画库；已支持的Windows DSH NEXT构建可选安装和恢复首屏兼容层。

description.en: Adds a shared Sup composer switch on Windows to start or gracefully stop a separate Super-agent process and release its memory. Requires a working DSH NEXT install with Node 24+, the standalone DSH CLI and an already-configured independent Super-agent profile (verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.4/rc.5); the bundled bridge.js must also be registered in the Super-agent profile — installing the desktop package alone does not complete setup.
description.zh: 在 Windows 输入栏添加全局 Sup 开关，按需启动或正常关闭独立的 Super-agent 后台进程，关闭后释放其占用的内存。前置条件：已装好 DSH NEXT、Node 24+、独立 DSH CLI，且 Super-agent 已在独立 profile 中配置好（已在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.4/rc.5 验证）；还需在 Super-agent profile 中注册包内的 bridge.js——只安装桌面包并不能完成整套安装。

description.en: Sidebar activity bell: a red badge counts sessions that finished, and clicking it swaps the sidebar list from workspace grouping to a day-grouped recent-activity list with a green dot on completions that have not been opened.
description.zh: 侧边栏活动铃铛：会话跑完后铃铛显示红色角标，点一下把工作区列表换成按天分组的最近活动列表，尚未打开过的完成项带绿点。

description.en: Adds usage statistics, a highlighted footer, piano navigation, projectless sessions, and model and document helpers to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加使用统计、高亮底栏、钢琴键导航、无项目会话以及模型和文档辅助功能。

description.en: Four assistant output layouts with full reasoning, independent tool details, and frame-synchronized or fading text.
description.zh: 提供四种助手输出布局、完整思考展示，以及刷新率同步或新增文字淡入效果。

plugins.name: dsh-better-ux

description.en: Web interface enhancements for DeepSeek Harness with session rename/fork shortcuts, a searchable model picker with provider filters, mobile layouts, global font scaling, context usage alerts, DeepSeek balance and tariff rates, sent-message navigation, and conversation summaries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页交互增强，提供会话重命名与分叉快捷操作、带搜索和供应商筛选的模型选择器、移动端布局、全局字体缩放、上下文用量提醒、DeepSeek 余额与峰谷价格、已发消息导航和对话情况总结。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
