description.en: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.
description.zh: 搜索、监控、打断与批量归档工作区子代理，支持实时活动/思考流式展示与活跃浮窗。

description.en: Interactive HTML or flowchart cards inside the conversation: the tool blocks until the user submits, then returns the clicked action, fields, comments and card state.
description.zh: 在对话里发可交互的 HTML 或流程图卡片；工具阻塞到用户提交，再把点击、字段、评论和卡片状态作为结果交还。

description.en: Windows desktop integration, a one-click launcher and tray controller for DSH, plus a sidebar button that puts DSH and a chat.deepseek.com window side by side with one shared taskbar button. Installing it writes a desktop shortcut and registers a dshsplit: protocol, both removed by lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove.
description.zh: Windows 桌面集成：一键启动器 + 托盘控制器，另加侧边栏按钮把 DSH 和 chat.deepseek.com 并排放置并共用一个任务栏按钮。安装会写入桌面快捷方式并注册 dshsplit: 协议，两者都可用 lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode remove 清除。

description.en: Reskins the DSH conversation hero — brand mark and workspace picker — with a Wordless-style landing view. The native composer stays untouched, and the picker still adds new workspaces (the entry declares its own directory-flow child hole, exactly like the shipped picker).
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话首屏的品牌标识与工作区选择器换上 Wordless 风格的着陆视图。原生输入框保持不变；选择器仍可在弹窗内添加新工作区（本条目像原生选择器一样自带 directory-flow 子槽位）。

description.en: Live CPU, memory and GPU readout in the DeepSeek Harness composer status bar — a clickable badge with a details panel, per-metric toggles, and three refresh speeds.
description.zh: 在输入框下方的状态栏里实时显示 CPU、内存与 GPU 读数：可点击的徽章、详情面板、逐项开关与三档刷新速度。

description.en: Rewrites the reasoning row: instead of the raw chain of thought it shows first-person working notes, written segment by segment while the reasoning streams in, with a toggle back to the original. Notes are stored per session so history rows keep them after a reload, the note writer runs on a configured provider or a downloadable local llama.cpp model, and the model still reads the full reasoning.
description.zh: 改写思考行：不显示原始思维链，而是随流按段写成第一人称的工作笔记，可随时切回原文。笔记按会话落盘，刷新后历史行仍有；写笔记可以用已配置的供应商，也可以下载本地 llama.cpp 模型；模型下一轮读到的仍是完整推理。

description.en: Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.
description.zh: 纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

description.en: Predicts your next message after each completed turn and shows it as ghost text in the composer: press → to accept, or keep typing and finish it word by word with Ctrl+→, Esc to dismiss. The prediction model follows the session by default or can be picked in the settings card, which also has an on/off switch and a speed test.
description.zh: 每轮对话结束后预测你的下一句话，以灰色幽灵文字显示在输入框里：按 → 接受，也可以直接开始打字、用 Ctrl+→ 逐词补齐，Esc 关闭。预测模型默认跟随当前会话，也能在设置卡片里指定；卡片里还有总开关和测速。

description.en: Markdown preview and rendered side-by-side compare for the changes-review tab.
description.zh: 评审页的 Markdown 预览与渲染态双栏对比。

description.en: Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.
description.zh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

description.en: Plugin-owned grouping layer for the DSH sidebar: nest sessions from different workspaces into draggable groups without changing workspace membership or logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏官方工作区管理之上增加一层独立自由分组：不同工作区的会话可归入同一多层分组，支持拖拽、搜索、恢复和可选 AI 控制，不改变原工作区归属与日志。

description.en: Node-based GLSL workbench: wire a shader graph on a canvas and preview it live, compile it to Shadertoy-compatible GLSL with multi-pass buffers (BufferA–D), hot-reload as you edit, cross-compile to HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V, and keep projects, materials, snapshots and resources (images, audio, lyrics) in a local workspace. Ships 57 built-in nodes, 8 bundled examples and 11 agent tools. No runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 节点式 GLSL 工作台：在画布上连节点图并实时预览，编译成 Shadertoy 兼容的 GLSL（支持 BufferA–D 多 Pass 反馈与热重载），可跨编译导出 HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V，并在本地工作区管理项目、材质、快照与资源（图片 / 音频 / 歌词）。内置 57 个节点、8 个自带示例与 11 个 agent 工具，无运行时依赖。

description.en: A file-upload plugin for the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的文件上传插件。

description.en: Turns a plain-browser DSH session into the WhaleHarbor lite client: a standalone browser --app window with a client-style top bar and task notifications, while the full desktop installer downloads in the background (multi-source, SHA-256 verified) and an install prompt appears when ready.
description.zh: 把浏览器里的 DSH 会话变成鲸港简版客户端：独立 --app 窗口、客户端顶栏与任务通知；后台多源下载完整桌面安装包（SHA-256 校验），完成后提示安装。

description.en: Adds two buttons to the sidebar footer: one reloads the interface and client plugins only, the other restarts the desktop app together with its Host. A restart is refused while a plugin install is running. Restart is Windows only and returns 409 elsewhere; reload works on all platforms.
description.zh: 在侧栏底部添加两个按钮：一个只重新加载界面与客户端插件，另一个连同 Host 重启整个桌面应用；插件安装期间拒绝重启。重启仅支持 Windows，其他平台返回 409；刷新全平台可用。

description.en: Re-sorts sidebar workspaces by last activity once per day; stable order within the day.
description.zh: 侧边栏工作区每日按最近活动排序一次，当天顺序稳定。

description.en: Folds every panel row in the sidebar (slot-registered and plugin-injected alike) into one Plugin Hub entry, giving the workspace list its vertical space back.
description.zh: 把侧边栏里所有面板行（slot 注册与插件直接注入两类）折叠成单独一行「插件大全」，把被挤掉的工作区高度还给会话列表。

description.en: Draggable grid-aligned workbench of 28 mini-cards in the margins of the conversation (API balance, token usage, cost, context pressure, todos, goal, usage heatmap, GitHub repo, image relay), with S/M/L/XL size tiers.
description.zh: 对话两侧空白区的可拖动卡片工作台，28 个小组件（余额、Token 用量、成本、上下文压力、待办、目标、用量热力图、GitHub 仓库、图片中转等），支持 S/M/L/XL 四档尺寸。

description.en: A download-progress indicator for the DSH session header: it reads the background-job roster and parses what downloaders already print — curl --progress-bar, wget, aria2, or a JSON progress file — into a progress ring, animated bars, transfer speed and ETA. Jobs that report nothing show as unknown progress instead of being hidden. A finished file opens with one click, or reveals in the file manager. No third-party plugin required; the package ships zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 会话头里的下载进度指示器：读取后台任务名册，把下载器自己已经打印出来的进度（curl --progress-bar、wget、aria2，或 JSON 进度文件）解析成环形进度、动画进度条、传输速率与剩余时间；不上报进度的任务显示为未知进度而不是被隐藏。已完成文件单击即开，也可在文件管理器里定位。不依赖任何第三方插件，运行时零依赖。

description.en: Shows which provider the composer's currently selected model belongs to, and stays silent for providers another plugin already presents.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框展示当前所选模型所属的供应商；已被其他插件接管的供应商自动让位，不重复显示。

description.en: Renders agent-authored HTML/CSS/JS inside the conversation as sandboxed iframes, with POST and SSE back to the model and reusable templates.
description.zh: 让模型写出 HTML/CSS/JS，在会话里以沙箱 iframe 渲染，并通过 POST 与 SSE 与模型互通，支持模板复用。

description.en: Adds a power button to the DSH sidebar - Shut down or Restart, each behind a confirmation - and ships a Windows tray launcher that starts DSH without a console window, supervises it so Restart can relaunch it, and offers the same start-at-logon switch.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏加一个电源按钮——关机 / 重启（各自二次确认）；并自带 Windows 托盘启动器：无窗口启动 DSH、托管它以让「重启」能自动拉起，并提供同一个开机自启开关。

description.en: Drag a file or folder from the right Sidebar's file tree onto the composer to insert an @ reference to it; also works while answering a question card.
description.zh: 从右侧文件栏把文件或文件夹拖进输入框，插入指向它的 @ 引用；回答提问卡片时也同样可用。

description.en: A greeting card that speaks — 156 prebuilt voice clips with a one-click mute — plus per-turn completion reports, long-run companionship notes and a takeover approval panel in the DSH conversation area.
description.zh: 会说话的问候卡（156 句预生成语音，卡角一键开声/静音）、每轮任务的完成报告、长跑时的陪伴提示，并在需要授权时接管输入框请示。

description.en: Adds a one-click Continue button beside Send that resumes a stopped turn by sending the "continue" prompt; hidden while a turn is running or the session is empty.
description.zh: 在「发送」旁加一个一键「继续」按钮：用 continue 提示词续跑已停止的一轮；轮次进行中或会话为空时不显示。

description.en: Notched reasoning-effort slider grouped with the model picker in the composer, with theme variables and English, French and Chinese labels.
description.zh: 与模型选择器连为一体的带刻度推理强度滑杆，位于输入框内，支持主题变量与中英法三语。

description.en: Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself, embedded in code with no separate video files, and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The picker has two independent sections, so the intro animation and the workspace wallpaper are picked separately; the wallpaper can be a still or a looping tail of the last N seconds, with independent transparency for the picture and the sidebar plus three blur levels. The sidebar and the workspace also get a text colour each, for when the picture is at full strength and the theme own text no longer reads.
description.zh: 打开新对话、或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，铺满窗口播放一段片头动画。插件自带四段片头，直接内嵌在代码里（不带独立的视频文件）；界面里的片库可切换、可预览，也能随时换成你自己的片子。片库分成「入场动画」和「工作区壁纸」两个分区，两者各自独立选段；壁纸可以是静帧，或只循环片尾 N 秒的动态，画面与侧边栏各有独立透明度，另有三档模糊。工作区与侧边栏还各有一个字体颜色，画面全强度时主题自带的字看不清，就靠它。

description.en: Replaces the composer model selector with a "model · reasoning level" trigger: a slider across every level a model reports, three switchable modes (the DSH native selector, a gradient particle rail, an energy-charge track), and a per-provider one-click fill for models that declare no reasoning levels.
description.zh: 把 composer 的模型选择器换成「模型名 · 推理等级」触发区：滑块覆盖模型上报的全部等级，可切换三种模式（DSH 官方原生选择器、渐变粒子轨道、能量充能轨道），并可按代理商一键为未声明等级的模型补齐四档。

description.en: A floating stock ticker for DeepSeek Harness: real-time quotes for Nikkei 225 and TOPIX ETF out of the box, plus worldwide markets via Yahoo Finance — Japan (.T), US, Hong Kong (.HK), China (.SS/.SZ) and any other symbol — with a customizable watchlist, display aliases and 16 UI languages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全球股市行情悬浮窗：默认显示日经225 与 TOPIX ETF，另支持通过 Yahoo Finance 实时报价全球市场——日本 .T、美国、香港 .HK、中国 .SS/.SZ 及任意代码，带自选列表、显示别名与 16 种界面语言。

description.en: Universal on-screen translator for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: translates text, attributes, Shadow DOM, and iframes across 45+ languages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面即时屏幕翻译：支持菜单、设置、Shadow DOM 与嵌套 iframe，覆盖 45+ 种语言。

description.en: Adds three settings pages to DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable and remove MCP servers; write agent skills by hand or install them from a GitHub repository; and keep a library of global personas with one active.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 增加三页设置界面：增删改查与启停 MCP 服务；手写 Skill 技能或从 GitHub 仓库安装；维护多人设库并启用其中一份。

description.en: Conversation enhancements: a history-input overlay (Alt+Up with workspace/session/global/prompt scopes), recall of unapplied interjected messages, conversation forking with fork-family version switching, and optional auto-resend after forking (off by default).
description.zh: 对话增强：历史输入浮层（Alt+↑，workspace/session/global/prompts 四范围搜索回填）、未应用插话撤回、对话分叉与家族版本切换、分叉后自动重发（默认关）。

description.en: Section icons for the settings navigation: replaces the uniform gear icons with per-section glyphs and fills the plugin-market card avatar slot with each plugin icon; a page reload after uninstall restores the official icons.
description.zh: 设置导航分区图标：把千篇一律的齿轮换成各分区专属图形，并为插件市场卡片头像槽提供插件图标，卸载后重载页面即恢复官方图标。

description.en: Auto-expands streaming thinking: always keeps the latest thinking block expanded, manual actions take priority, only the last block expands when opening a session, and nothing remains after uninstall.
description.zh: 流式思考自动展开：始终显示最新一条思考，手动操作优先，打开会话仅展开最后一条，卸载无残留。

description.en: Folder-scoped sidebar for DSH Web: by default only folders you load are listed with their sessions; unload a folder without deleting its registration, mark folders to load at startup, and opening a session loads its registered workspace so it does not fall into Ungrouped.
description.zh: DSH Web 的按目录加载侧栏：默认只列出已加载目录及其会话；卸载目录不会删除注册，可设置启动时自动加载；打开会话时会加载其已注册的工作区，避免落入「未分组」。

description.en: Turns completed DeepSeek Harness public-content work into a browser-local visual magazine with explicit updates and reviewed one-article sharing.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 中已完成的公开内容工作整理为浏览器本地的视觉杂志，支持显式更新和经审核的单篇文章分享。

description.en: In-conversation generative UI: the model renders interactive HTML cards into the chat stream, with streaming preview and sandboxed rendering.
description.zh: 对话内生成式 UI：模型把交互式 HTML 卡片直接画进会话流，带流式预览与沙箱渲染。

plugins.name: dsh-custom-ui

description.en: Right-side file-tree sidebar that opens workspace files, plus a DeepSeek account balance meter in the composer stats line.
description.zh: 右侧文件树侧栏，可打开工作区文件；并在输入框状态行显示 DeepSeek 账户余额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a space-key Quick Look preview to DSH deliverable cards. Hovering a card and pressing Space opens the native macOS QLPreviewPanel for the file, which covers docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, images and media that the sidebar preview cannot render. The panel zooms out from the card's position, returns focus to the composer when closed, and exposes hover delay, focus-return and double-click behaviour in Settings > General.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的交付卡片加「按空格用 macOS 原生 Quick Look 预览」的入口。鼠标停在卡片上按空格即打开系统预览面板，覆盖侧栏预览渲染不了的 docx、xlsx、pptx、pdf、图片与音视频。面板从卡片位置放大出现，关闭后焦点回到输入框；悬停延迟、关闭后聚焦、双击预览三项可在设置 > 常规里调。

description.en: Scope manager for DeepSeek Harness: binds presets, persona cards, tools, skills and MCP connections to global / workspace / session layers, with a sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的作用域管家：把预设、角色卡、工具、技能与 MCP 连接按「全局 / 工作区 / 会话」三层作用域绑定，带侧边栏。

description.en: Right-click menu and drag support for the Files sidebar on Windows - copy absolute or workspace-relative paths, create files and folders, rename, move entries to the Recycle Bin, and drop a row into the composer to insert an @ reference.
description.zh: Windows 上给 Files 侧栏补右键菜单与拖拽：复制绝对或工作区相对路径、新建文件与文件夹、重命名、把条目移到回收站，以及把行拖进对话栏插入 @ 引用。

description.en: Native Anki workspace backed by one real headless Anki collection: browse, edit, add and review notes, suspend cards, import and export APKG, and sync with AnkiWeb, with the same collection exposed to the anki AI tool. No Anki desktop app, AnkiConnect or Qt is started. Windows x64 only; the matching headless Anki core, CPython and all Python runtime dependencies are bundled, so no separate Anki or Python installation is required.
description.zh: 原生 Anki 工作区，由真实的独立无界面 Anki 牌库驱动：浏览、编辑、添加与复习笔记，暂停卡片，导入导出 APKG，并与 AnkiWeb 同步；同一牌库同时提供给 anki AI 工具。不启动 Anki 桌面程序，也不依赖 AnkiConnect 或 Qt。仅支持 Windows x64；已内置匹配的无界面 Anki 核心、CPython 与全部 Python 运行依赖，无需另外安装 Anki 或 Python。

description.en: Adds a comet-like light band that flows along the window edge of DeepSeek Harness — up to four in parallel, colored by each session's model, reversing direction while waiting for your reply, and returning to the composer or the workspace once the conversation ends.
description.zh: 为你的 DeepSeek Harness 添加沿窗口边缘流动的流星式光带 —— 最多四条并行、按会话模型配色、等待回复时反向流动，在对话结束后自行返回对话框或工作区。

description.en: Windows-only power card injected into the DSH page: the artwork carries two hit zones (left shuts down, right restarts), the first click only turns the card into a yes/no question and the second click fires, and the restart engine stops only this instance's process tree, waits for the port to free, relaunches outside the host's Job Object and confirms the new instance answers on the plugin's own status route.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows：注入 DSH 页面的电源卡片，图案左右各带一块命中区（左关机、右重启），第一次点击只把卡片变成一句是否确认，第二次点击才执行；重启引擎只停本实例的进程树，等待端口释放后在宿主 Job Object 之外重新拉起，并用插件自己的状态路由确认新实例已经应答。

description.en: Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself — embedded in code, with no separate video files — and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The pin button sits beside Settings.
description.zh: 打开新对话、或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，铺满窗口播放一段片头动画。插件自带四段片头，直接内嵌在代码里（不带独立的视频文件）；界面里的片库可切换、可预览，也能随时换成你自己的片子；设置旁一键钉住会话。

description.en: The real ComfyUI editor as a sidebar tab in DeepSeek Harness, with per-session tools that read and edit the graph on screen and a panel that can start, stop and restart ComfyUI without installing anything into it.
description.zh: 把真正的 ComfyUI 编辑器作为侧栏标签嵌进 DeepSeek Harness，每会话的工具直接读写屏幕上那张工作流，面板可启停 ComfyUI，且不向 ComfyUI 安装任何东西。

description.en: Renders the open conversation's Mermaid diagrams as a right-sidebar page, one card per diagram, each clickable to open full screen with zoom and pan; the chat's own code block is left untouched, so copying or quoting the source still works.
description.zh: 把当前对话里的 Mermaid 图表渲染成右侧栏的一个页面，一图一卡片；点击卡片可全屏查看并缩放、拖动，对话里的原始代码块保持不动，因此复制或引用源码照常可用。

description.en: Adds Pin/Unpin to the sidebar session-row menu and a collapsible Pinned Sessions group above the session list, with host-side persistence, hover quick-unpin, collapse memory, and live running-state dots.
description.zh: 在会话行菜单加入 Pin/Unpin，并在侧边栏列表上方提供可折叠的 Pinned Sessions 分组：主机端持久化、悬停快速取消置顶、折叠状态记忆与实时运行状态点。

description.en: Adds a Workspaces / Recent-sessions switcher above the sidebar list, with a pinned-sessions group, a per-row menu (pin/unpin, copy session id), title filtering, and browser-local pin storage with a one-shot migration from dsh-plugin-pin-session.
description.zh: 在侧栏列表上方加「工作区 / 最新会话」切换条，含固定会话分组、行级菜单（固定/取消固定、复制 Session ID）、标题过滤；pin 存于浏览器 localStorage，并对 dsh-plugin-pin-session 做一次性迁移与过渡双写。

plugins.name: dsh-widget-center

description.en: Native macOS desktop widgets for DSH: manage any number of widget instances — share quote tickers (5-provider fallback, trading-phase-aware throttling) and notes memos — each an independent NSPanel+WKWebView window spawned detached from the host, dragged anywhere, with a type-aware right-click menu. Instances are edited as cards in a three-view settings page (list / type picker / detail), and a market_quote model tool serves standardized quotes to any session. A Type Studio flow seeds a creation-mode session with an issue-template prompt for authoring new widget types.
description.zh: DSH 原生 macOS 桌面小组件中心：管理任意多个 widget 实例——行情小窗（5 源 fallback、交易时段感知节流）与便签，每实例一个独立 NSPanel+WKWebView 窗口（detached 独立进程、任意拖动、类型感知右键菜单）。实例以三层视图（列表 / 类型选择 / 详情）在 DSH 设置页卡片式配置；market_quote 模型工具供任意会话拉标准化行情；Type Studio 一键创建「创造模式」空会话并预填 issue-template 模板，起草新的 widget type。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to qt.gtimg.cn

description.en: Shows a local image or short video in the current conversation card, with click-to-preview.
description.zh: 在当前对话卡片里展示本地图片或短视频，点击可预览。

description.en: Adds Chilean Spanish (es-CL) to the Web UI language list: 2,603 strings across 57 namespaces, with per-key fallback to English.
description.zh: 为 Web 界面新增智利西班牙语（es-CL）：57 个命名空间、2603 条文案，缺失项按 key 回退英文。

description.en: Opens the NeoXider Agent Deck desktop widget (chat, the slime pet avatar or the hinge handle) from a Harness session, and reports its mode, installed version, running state and whether it follows the same Harness.
description.zh: 在 Harness 会话里打开 NeoXider Agent Deck 桌面挂件（对话、史莱姆宠物头像或铰链把手），并报告其模式、已安装版本、运行状态以及是否跟随同一个 Harness。

description.en: Adds a draggable power pill to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a live status dot plus restart and stop actions, where restart is handed to a detached helper that resumes the same boot invocation once the port is released.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面加一个可拖动的电源胶囊：实时状态点，加上重启与结束两个动作；重启交给脱离终端的辅助进程，等端口释放后按原启动命令重新拉起。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar workspace region with a two-tab browser: several workspace roots stay registered side by side while conversations are filed under the real working directory of each session, with a read-only resource tree that previews files in the right sidebar. Hiding is per tab, display-only and fully reversible; a resource folder or file can be copied as a path or dragged into the composer as a native reference, and @ completion covers every registered root rather than the working directory alone.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的工作区区域换成双选项卡浏览器：多个工作区根并列登记、各自固定不变，对话按每个会话真实的工作目录归入目录树，资源是只读文件树、点击即用右侧栏预览。两个选项卡各自独立隐藏、只影响显示且完全可逆；资源文件夹或文件可复制路径，也可拖进输入框成为原生引用块；@ 补全覆盖全部已登记工作区，而不只是当前工作目录。

description.en: Beautified archive-manager settings section listing archived sessions grouped by workspace, with a hover unarchive action and relative timestamps.
description.zh: 美化版归档管理设置页：按工作区分组展示归档会话，悬停即可取消归档，附相对时间显示。

description.en: Fork of z-col/dsh-workspace-groups (MIT): a grouped workspace sidebar for the DSH web client, with a science icon set and a docked default workspace; cannot be installed alongside the upstream plugin (same bundle row).
description.zh: z-col/dsh-workspace-groups（MIT）的分支：DSH Web 客户端的分组工作区侧栏，带材料与实验图标集，默认工作区停靠底栏；不能与上游插件同装（同一个 bundle row）。

description.en: Adds a management page for the official DeepSeek Harness ACP subagent provider, with one-click presets, a read-only connectivity check, live switches for all three entry points, and online preset updates.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 官方 ACP 子智能体 provider 提供目标管理页、一键预设、只读连通性检测、三个入口的实时开关与在线预设更新。

description.en: Adds a conversation view that maps which skills, MCP tools and subagents a session actually used, with an attribution tree, a call table and an unused inventory.
description.zh: 在会话中新增一个视图，用归因树展示本会话实际调用了哪些技能、MCP 工具与子代理，并附调用明细与未使用清单。

description.en: Three draggable, resizable, auto-positioning floating desktop widgets for DSH Desktop — daily schedule, goals tracker, and calendar planner.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的三个可拖动、可缩放、自动记忆位置的悬浮桌面小组件：每日时间安排、目标设置与日期规划。

description.en: Interactive whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: live balance/usage/context occupancy, slingshot toss, easter-egg bubbles, eco mode. 346KB package, zero extra processes.
description.zh: 会卖萌、会记账、会弹跳的鲸鱼娘桌宠：实时余额/用量/上下文占用、中键弹弓抛掷、彩蛋气泡、省电模式；安装包 346KB，零新进程。

description.en: Review DeepSeek Harness responses with inline annotations, document reading, comment threads, and text revisions, then bring a reading summary back to the main conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型回复添加多处批注、文档阅读、评论线程和正文修订，并将阅读摘要带回主对话。

description.en: Open and copy local files and web links from a chat turn.
description.zh: 打开和复制本轮的本地文件与网页链接。

description.en: Collapses and reorders global sidebar navigation; adds opt-in Workspaces, Activity, and Favorites tabs.
description.zh: 折叠并排序全局侧栏导航；可按需开启工作区、活动与收藏三栏（默认关闭）。

description.en: One-click 💪 prompt enhancement (prompt): thin draft? continue 🔜, unhappy? regenerate 🔄; auto-archive history 🕐 with rollback ↩️; result syncs back to the composer with a line-by-line diff; 🗺️show the panel 🎨 customise the 🪄 prompt-button icon 📍 and button position yourself.
description.zh: 一键增强💪提示词(prompt)——嫌短就继续生成🔜，不满意就重新生成🔄；自动存档历史记录🕐，支持回退 ↩️；结果同步回输入框，差异逐行对比；🗺️显示界面🎨 提示词🪄按钮图标📍按键位置自己定制

description.en: Open DSH workspace directories in installed file managers, terminals, and supported editors from the Web UI.
description.zh: 从 DSH Web UI 使用已安装的文件管理器、终端和受支持的编辑器打开工作区目录。

description.en: Renders the final fenced card block of an answer as a typographic card, with card and article layouts, twelve block types and credited images.
description.zh: 把回答末尾的 card 围栏块渲染成排版卡片，支持 card 与 article 两种布局、十二种块类型和带来源的配图。

description.en: Multi-workspace manager: bind a docs anchor plus ordered code-project repositories into one session, injecting their absolute paths, a recursive file index, a server/client endpoint index and optional coding standards, and syncing writable directories into the sandbox.
description.zh: 多工作区管理器：把文档锚点目录与若干代码项目仓库组合进同一会话，注入绝对路径、递归文件索引、前后端端点落点索引与可选的开发规范，并把可写目录同步进沙盒。

description.en: Offline-replayable charts and interactive explanations in DSH rc.2 Web chat, with optional AMap itineraries, confirmed follow-ups, and HTML export.
description.zh: 在 DSH rc.2 Web 对话中生成可离线重放的图表与交互式原理演示，支持可选高德行程、确认式追问和 HTML 导出。

description.en: Link local project directories from a project context menu, with scoped search, source reading and explicit per-session snapshot synchronization. Supports DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 and 0.2.1-rc.2 only.
description.zh: 从项目右键菜单关联本机目录，支持跨目录搜索、源码读取与显式会话快照同步；仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.4 与 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: In-chat image viewer for the web UI: takes over content image clicks (Markdown images, message attachments rendered as blob: URLs, and read_image results) and opens a dialog with pointer-centered wheel zoom and an editable percentage, drag pan, 90° rotation, download with progress, copy as PNG, open with the default app, and ←/→ gallery browsing across the conversation.
description.zh: Web UI 的聊天图片查看器：接管内容图片点击（Markdown 图、以 blob: URL 渲染的消息附件图、read_image 结果），打开弹层后支持以指针为中心的滚轮缩放与可编辑百分比、拖动平移、90° 旋转、带进度下载、复制为 PNG、用默认应用打开，以及会话内 ←/→ 图集浏览。

description.en: Adds a produced-files card row to the chat and a resizable split-screen preview panel for workspace artifacts (Markdown, source code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML), plus a localhost port preview.
description.zh: 在对话中新增产出文件卡片行，并提供可拖拽分屏的产物预览面板，支持 Markdown、源码、CSV、JSON、图片、HTML，以及本地端口预览。

description.en: Adds a Settings row to the sidebar header before Plugins, which opens the shell's Settings panel.
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部 Plugins 之前新增「设置」一行，点击即打开原生设置面板。

description.en: Collapses the composer to an iPhone-style home indicator while you scroll, then restores it on hover, click, or scroll up. Corner arcs dock the real composer into the left or right gutter.
description.zh: 阅读时把输入栏收到底部 Home 指示条，悬停预览、点击钉住或上滑还原。左右圆角弧线把原来的输入框停到两侧留白。

description.en: JupyterLab-style notebook for DSH: code and output side by side with a draggable divider, outputs that stick to the viewport while a long cell scrolls, Jupyter keyboard shortcuts (a/b/dd, m/y, Shift+Enter vs Ctrl+Enter), a scissors button to delete a cell and a chip to switch it between code and Markdown. Modified fork of @beihaizb/dsh-notebook: both register the same nb_* tools, so remove the original before installing; the Python kernel you pick needs ipykernel, jupyter_client and nbformat.
description.zh: DSH 的 JupyterLab 风格 notebook：代码与输出左右分栏并可拖动，长 cell 滚动时输出贴住视口，支持 Jupyter 快捷键（a/b/dd、m/y、Shift+Enter 与 Ctrl+Enter 区分）、左侧剪刀删除 cell、py/md 标签切换代码与 Markdown。基于 @beihaizb/dsh-notebook 的修改版：两者注册同一批 nb_* 工具，不能与上游同装，装前请先卸载原版；所选 Python 内核需安装 ipykernel、jupyter_client 与 nbformat。

description.en: Freezes the DSH Web GUI reading column at a fixed width and re-aligns the reading position after the window is resized or zoomed.
description.zh: 固定 DSH Web GUI 的正文列宽度，并在窗口缩放后把阅读位置对回原处。

description.en: Always-on quotes strip pinned to the top of the DSH window: watchlist, holdings with share counts and cost price, P&L, candlestick and intraday charts, 5-level order book, trade ledger, price alerts, and streamed AI review of the selected symbol.
description.zh: 钉在 DSH 窗口顶部的常驻行情条：自选股、带股数与成本价的持仓、盈亏、K 线与分时图、五档盘口、交易流水、价格预警，以及用 DSH 已配置模型流式生成的 AI 复盘。

description.en: Codex-style details sidebar for DSH with Files, Review, Browser, and Terminal panes, transcript file links and diff stats, annotations, and Host-managed browser controls.
description.zh: DSH 的 Codex 风格详情侧栏：提供 Files、Review、Browser 与 Terminal 面板、对话文件链接和 diff 统计、批注，以及 Host 管理的浏览器控制。

description.en: Resident Web overlay seat with its own assistant session: chat, images, reminders, a duty heartbeat, and on-demand read-only task reference.
description.zh: 常驻 Web 席位，背后是独立助理会话：对话、图片、提醒、值班心跳，以及按需只读引用当前任务。

description.en: Mounted owner of the LLM Providers Settings page: provider cards, drag-reorder card order, and picker sort.
description.zh: LLM Providers 设置页的挂载 owner：provider 卡片、拖拽排序与 picker 排序。

description.en: Draggable splitter between the sidebar panel list and the workspace region, so the session list can grow. Double-click restores the default layout.
description.zh: 侧边栏「工作区」与导航之间的可拖动分隔条，上拖把高度让给会话列表，双击恢复默认。

description.en: Shell-style prompt history in the DSH composer: ↑ in an empty composer recalls the previous prompt and keeps walking back, ↓ walks forward to the empty draft; history is kept per workspace, persisted across restarts and records only human input, while typing or editing a draft returns ↑/↓ to normal caret movement. Adds a Settings page to export, import and clear the history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里提供 shell 风格的提示词历史：空输入框按 ↑ 取回上一条并继续向前翻，按 ↓ 向后回到空草稿；历史按工作区隔离、落盘并在重启后保留，且只记录人工输入，一旦手动输入或编辑草稿，↑/↓ 就恢复为正常的光标移动。另提供设置页可导出、导入和清空历史。

description.en: Manage the left global panel list from Settings → General: show or hide entries, reorder them by dragging in the sidebar or in the dialog, and keep entries that have their own sidebar switch in step with it.
description.zh: 在 设置 → 通用 里集中管理左侧全局面板图标：显示或隐藏、拖动排序；自带侧栏开关的插件，其开关与本插件保持同步。

description.en: Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.
description.zh: DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史：按 ↑/↓ 翻阅发过的消息。只有方向键，别无其他。

description.en: Workspace file tree for the Web UI: multi-tab preview (text/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/images), inline Markdown editing, a Git changes panel, and file operations (rename/delete/copy/move/create) via context menu.
description.zh: 工作区文件树插件：多标签预览（文本/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/图片）、Markdown 内联编辑、Git 变更面板与右键文件操作（重命名/删除/复制/移动/新建）。

description.en: Monochrome UI and motion with scoped styles, local skills, context recall and native agent collaboration.
description.zh: 黑白灰淡紫界面与动效、作用域样式、本机技能、上下文召回及原生智能体协作。

description.en: Browse local file directories inside Harness with target highlighting and eight view layouts; image thumbnails and native file icons are Windows-only.
description.zh: 在 Harness 内浏览本地文件目录，支持目标文件高亮与八种查看布局；图片缩略图和系统文件图标仅在 Windows 下提供。

description.en: Four whale-tail animations for the DeepSeek Harness thinking indicator, cycling on every thinking turn.
description.zh: 针对 DSH 思考模式鲸鱼尾巴的动画，丰富成 4 种动画。

description.en: Adds an extensible Functions menu to the DSH top bar, where plugins register one-click actions with staged confirmations and submenus. Since 0.4.0 it bundles a built-in "Restart DSH" action, so no separate restart plugin is needed.
description.zh: 给 DSH 顶端加一个可扩展的「功能」栏：插件注册的一键动作都在这里，支持分级确认与二级菜单。0.4.0 起自带了「重启 DSH」功能，不再需要单独安装重启插件。

description.en: Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.
description.zh: 通过关键词、拼音、意图或 AI 一键搜索 DSH 设置面板，并直达目标设置页、标签或选项。

description.en: Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.
description.zh: 修复 dsh web GUI 的手机视口体验：抽屉式侧栏与滑动手势、纯图标 composer 与「权限·模型·思考深度」状态行、浮窗居中、横向溢出与滚动条挤压居中修复。

description.en: A transparent always-on-top desktop fish that mirrors the current DSH session - turn, step, tool calls, todos, background jobs and team tasks - with optional login autostart, an option to stay after DSH exits, and a right-click hide.
description.zh: 常驻 Windows 桌面的透明置顶悬浮鱼，实时显示当前 DSH 会话的轮次、步骤、工具调用、todo、后台任务与团队任务；可选开机自启、DSH 退出后保留，右键可隐藏。

description.en: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.
description.zh: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。

description.en: Full sidebar workbench with file rendering and editing, terminal, Git, and subagents; third-party plugins can register new tabs.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
description.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。

description.en: Settings extensions for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 的设置扩展。

description.en: Web Components support.
description.zh: Web Components 支持。

description.en: Completes @path references in the Web composer: type @ (optionally ./src/ma) to list matching files and directories, pick one with the arrow keys, and the draft receives an @./relative/path reference (quoted when the path has spaces).
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框补全 @ 路径引用：输入 @（可继续输入 ./src/ma）即列出匹配的文件与目录，用上下键选择后草稿得到 @./相对路径引用（路径含空格时自动加引号）。

description.en: Puts a WuwaTappo desktop pet's bubbles to work: shows the DeepSeek balance, today's spend and a per-turn cost bubble, and keeps an amber reminder bubble up while the agent waits for an answer or an approval. Talks to the pet over CDP, enabling its debug port with a one-time, revertible byte patch.
description.zh: 把 WuwaTappo 桌宠头顶的气泡用起来：显示 DeepSeek 余额、今日已用与每轮消耗，Agent 等待回答或授权时挂一个琥珀色常驻提醒气泡。通过 CDP 与桌宠通信，首次使用会给 WuwaTappo.exe 打一个可还原的等长字节补丁来开启调试端口。

description.en: File-browser web app for DSH: React frontend and REST API served by the host webserver, a /dsh-agfs command that opens at the current session workspace, and a browse_files model tool.
description.zh: 文件浏览器 Web 应用：React 前端与 REST API 由宿主 webserver 托管，/dsh-agfs 命令自动定位当前工作区，附 browse_files 模型工具。

description.en: Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the model dsh is already configured with, so it needs no API key.
description.zh: 在输入框内提供同义词替换与以下划线触发的补全：一行以 _ 结尾即自动补全，拼写错误在输入时即时标出。它走 dsh 已配置好的模型，因此无需额外的 API key。

description.en: A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Rust/ratatui Agent TUI，支持流式工具调用、子代理、持久会话和可扩展的 Cordis 客户端界面。

plugins.name: dsh-design-studio

description.en: Design workbench in the right sidebar. When the model builds web pages, app screens, WeChat mini programs, posters, slides or emails, each HTML file shows up as a screen on a canvas inside a device frame and refreshes when the file changes; local dev servers are proxied with hot reload intact. Mini program screens get the WeChat capsule in the top-right corner, which turns white over a dark top bar, and the design check flags text and buttons hidden under it. Click an element or drag a region to put its selector, source file and styles into the composer. It can extract a brand design system from your website or project (colors by role, fonts, type scale, radius, shadows, buttons, inputs and cards) and use it for every new design. The model adds a few tweak sliders to each design (spacing, radius, brand color, layout variants) that update all screens live and write back to the stylesheet in one click. A finished design can be turned into React, Vue, Next.js or plain HTML code, with each built screen diffed pixel by pixel against the design. Also has a design tokens panel, fifteen style presets, a style panel (font size, colors, radius, padding and more) that writes back to the HTML or hands the change to the model together with the CSS rule and line behind each property, versions saved before and after each turn with drag-to-compare and restore, export to images, PDF and PPTX (links between screens stay clickable), a LAN QR link for viewing on a phone, link arrows and a click-through demo mode, a multi-size view, in-place text editing, reference-image palettes, and a design check (overflowing, clipped or overlapping text, contrast, tap target size and more). Bundles a ui-design skill and six tools: preview_page opens a preview; check_design measures every screen at real sizes in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (bars covering content, script errors, missing assets, dead links; CSS file and line for contrast and font-size issues; cropped screenshots of serious problems); look_design hands real screenshots to the model; extract_design_system builds a design system from a site or project; handoff_design writes a handoff pack (screenshots, routes, tokens, shared components); compare_design diffs the built local page against the design and marks what differs. Adds a Design mode for new sessions (Standard mode's tools plus the skill, the six tools and a design persona); each part has its own switch on the Plugins page. When DSH is opened from a phone or another computer, local-file designs are bundled into a sandboxed frame so they still show.
description.zh: 右侧栏的设计工作台。模型做网页、App 界面、微信小程序、海报、幻灯片、邮件时，每个 HTML 文件在画布上显示为一屏，套设备外框，文件一改就刷新；本地开发服务器经代理接入，热更新照常。小程序屏画上微信右上角的胶囊，顶栏是深色时胶囊自动变白，设计体检会查出被胶囊挡住的字和按钮。点一个元素或框一块区域，选择器、源文件和样式就整理进输入框。能从你的官网或项目里提取品牌设计系统（按角色的配色、字体、字号阶梯、圆角、阴影，按钮、输入框、卡片的样子），以后做新设计都照它来；模型给每套设计配几个专属调节滑块（留白、圆角、主色、版式几选一），拖动时所有屏一起变，一键写回样式；做好的设计能转成 React / Vue / Next.js / 纯 HTML 代码，每屏做完和设计稿逐像素对比。另有设计变量面板、十五套风格卡、调样式面板（字号、颜色、圆角、内边距等，可以写回 HTML，或连同每项由哪条 CSS 规则、在第几行决定一起交给模型）、每轮对话前后自动存版本（拖动对比、回到某一版）、导出图片 / PDF / PPTX（屏和屏之间的跳转照样能点）、局域网扫码在手机上看、页面跳转箭头和点击演示、多尺寸并排、预览里直接改字、参考图取色，以及设计体检（文字超出、截断、叠在一起，对比度、点击区大小等）。自带 ui-design 技能和六个工具：preview_page 打开预览；check_design 在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里按真实尺寸量每一屏（顶栏底栏压住内容、脚本报错、资源没载到、死链；对比度和字号问题写明 CSS 文件和行号；严重问题附局部截图）；look_design 把真实截图交给模型；extract_design_system 从网站或项目提取设计系统；handoff_design 写交接包（每屏截图、路由、设计变量、该抽的组件）；compare_design 把做出来的本机页面和设计稿逐像素比，标出差在哪。新会话可以选「设计模式」（标准模式的工具，加上这个技能、这六个工具和做设计的人设），各部分在插件页里各有开关。从手机或别的电脑打开 DSH 时，本地 HTML 做的设计打包进沙盒框里，照样能看。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Lets the model turn an answer into a web page that lives right inside the chat. The show_page tool either fills one of 8 built-in templates (report, compare, checklist, dashboard, timeline, flashcards, quiz, flow), where the model writes only the content and the plugin does layout, interaction and saving, or saves a full page the model wrote itself (calculators, games, custom layouts). Hand-written pages get the same design as base styles inside a CSS @layer, so the page's own CSS still wins. The page appears under the reply at its content height, interactive and following DSH's light/dark theme. The page's localStorage is stored in DSH per page, so what users tick or type survives reopening and new versions, and the same page open in the chat and the right sidebar stays in sync. Each edit is saved as a new version you can flip back to. After saving, the page is checked in a hidden local Chrome or Edge (script errors, horizontal overflow, dark mode not applied) and problems go back to the model. The right sidebar shows the page full-size with versions, a gallery of all pages and export to PNG, PDF or HTML. Pages run in a sandboxed, separate-origin frame with a strict CSP: no access to DSH data and no fetch, XHR or WebSocket. Works on phones with dsh-mobile.
description.zh: 让模型把回答做成一页网页，直接放在对话里。show_page 工具可以套 8 种内置模板（报告、对比、清单、数据看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验、流程图），模型只写内容，排版、交互和保存由插件做；也可以存模型自己写的整页（计算器、小游戏、特别的版式）。自己写的页面也套上同一套设计，放在 CSS @layer 里，页面自己的样式照样盖得过它。页面按内容高度嵌在回复下面，能点能用，深浅色跟着 DSH 走。页面里的 localStorage 按页面存在 DSH 里，勾过、填过的东西重开、改出新版本都还在；同一页同时开在对话里和右侧栏，两边实时同步。改一次存一版，旧版能翻。存好后在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里体检（脚本报错、横向溢出、深色没跟上），问题交回模型改。右侧栏看整页、翻版本、看所有做过的页面，导出 PNG / PDF / HTML。页面跑在不同源的沙箱框里，CSP 很严：读不到 DSH 的数据，也不能联网取数据。配合 dsh-mobile 手机上也能用。

description.en: Plays local video and audio inside the conversation. Media files the model writes during a turn - screen recordings, transcodes, voiceovers - get a player under its final reply automatically when their paths appear in its commands, the command output or the reply; the play_video tool plays any other file. Video shows as compact cards with a hover preview, audio as a slim seek bar, streamed over HTTP Range so long files seek instead of loading into memory. Also registers a sidebar media preview renderer, since the built-in previewer treats mp4 as unviewable. The look_video tool lets the model see a video itself: a hidden local Chrome or Edge grabs frames into a time-labelled contact sheet (or big frames at given times, or a short range frame by frame), checks the audio (silence, too quiet, clipping, one channel only) and the picture (black or frozen frames), and reads MP4 / MOV headers for phone compatibility (codec, HDR, faststart and more), with ffmpeg fixes.
description.zh: 在对话流里直接播放本地视频和音频。模型这一轮写出的媒体文件（录屏、转码、配音），只要路径出现在它跑的命令、命令输出或回复里，回合收尾时播放器就自动出现在回复正下方，不用调工具；别的文件用 play_video 工具播放。视频是带悬停预览的小卡片，音频是可拖进度的细条，走 HTTP Range 流式传输，长视频能拖进度条、不会整个读进内存。同时注册了侧边栏媒体预览渲染器——内置预览器把 mp4 当作不可预览。look_video 工具让模型自己看视频：在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里按时间截帧，拼成一张每格标时间的图交给模型（也能看某几刻的大图、逐帧看一小段），顺便量声音（没声、太小、爆音、只有一边声道）、找黑屏和卡住的画面，并读 mp4 / mov 文件头查手机上能不能放（编码、HDR、文件头位置等），附 ffmpeg 改法。

description.en: A read-only Cordis Inspect provider that lets an agent see the interface it is driving: outline() reports which UI regions the running shell actually rendered, with occupancy, geometry and current or past failure state; snapshot() returns one region's rendered node tree (tag, role, aria-label, own text, geometry, computed styles) addressed by slot key or CSS selector; failures() keeps a history of regions that failed to render and whether they recovered. Regions are addressed by the anchor the shell already writes for every slot, so it needs no region list and covers regions added later or contributed by other plugins. No UI, no tools, no dependencies, no network access.
description.zh: 只读的 Cordis Inspect provider，让 agent 能看见自己正在驱动的界面：outline() 报告运行中的壳实际渲染了哪些 UI 区域，含占用、几何与当前/历史失败状态；snapshot() 按 slot key 或 CSS 选择器返回某区域的渲染节点树（标签、角色、aria-label、自身文本、几何、计算样式）；failures() 保留「哪些区域渲染失败过、是否已恢复」的历史。寻址用壳为每个 slot 已写好的锚点，无需区域清单，也覆盖以后新增或其他插件贡献的区域。无界面、无工具、无依赖、不发网络请求。

description.en: Replaces the left sidebar session list with a tree of every session and its nested subagent descendants, with click-through to each conversation's multi-turn history and a tree_send tool for messaging any continuable session anywhere in the tree.
description.zh: 把左侧栏的会话列表替换为完整会话树：展示全部会话及其多层子智能体，点击节点即可进入该会话的多轮对话；并附带 tree_send 工具，可向树中任意可续接的子会话投递消息。

description.en: Full-screen boot animation for the DSH web client: the boot HTML paints a cover-fit artwork on its first frame, adds a slow settle, a scanning light sweep and a progress HUD, then hands the viewport over when the app mounts. Click or press Esc / space / Enter to skip.
description.zh: 用图片做全屏开机动画：启动 HTML 首帧即铺满画面并缓慢推近，横向光带扫过，左下进度与阶段提示，应用挂载完成后淡出。点击任意处或按 Esc / 空格 / 回车可跳过。

description.en: Draws every question and answer in the DSH Web conversation blurred until the pointer rests on that row, and locks the mask to always-blurred while the window is unfocused; one control below the composer switches between off, hover to reveal, and always blurred, remembered per browser.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 对话里的提问与回答画成模糊，鼠标停在哪一条才显示哪一条；窗口失焦时自动全糊，谁都看不到指针留下的那条。输入框下方一个按钮在「关闭 / 悬停显示 / 始终模糊」三档间切换，选择按浏览器记住。

description.en: Session-header fishbone panel for sub-agent assignments, live status, available token and duration metrics, shared task-board entries, and native child-session navigation.
description.zh: 会话标题栏鱼骨图面板，展示子代理分工、实时状态、可用的 Token 与耗时指标及共享任务，并支持跳转子会话。

plugins.name: dsh-statusline-plus

description.en: Displays account quotas, Git state, context usage, public API reference costs, Subagent activity, and streaming speed in DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 显示账户额度、Git 状态、上下文、公开 API 参考费用、Subagents 活动和生成速度。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: To-do list in the session header: the button cycles through unfinished items and is tinted red, amber or green by due time, and the floating panel adds, edits and ticks off tasks with an optional deadline, with a collapsible done section. Items persist in localStorage and follow the DSH theme.
description.zh: 会话标题栏里的待办清单：按钮轮播未完成事项，按截止时间以红、黄、绿整块着色；浮动面板可新增、编辑、勾选待办并设置截止时间，已完成收进可折叠区域；数据存 localStorage，跟随 DSH 主题。

description.en: Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.
description.zh: 可弹出侧边栏：文件树、Git 未提交变更列表与多标签文件/diff 预览，一键弹出为独立浏览器标签页。

description.en: A Cursor-like sidebar for DeepSeek Harness with file browsing, code editing, Git diffs, terminal, side chat, and Ctrl+L references.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 Cursor 侧边栏，支持文件浏览、代码编辑、Git 差异、终端、侧边对话及 Ctrl+L 文件引用。

description.en: Live done/now/next card above the composer while the agent is still working.
description.zh: 输入框上方的「已做 / 正在做 / 接下来」实时卡片，回答还没出来时就能看到进度。

description.en: Adds a sparkle button left of the model selector in the composer toolbar: one click rewrites the draft in place through the host and briefly offers an undo that restores the original text. A Prompt Enhancement settings section picks the lane — the conversation model (the provider/model the next message would use, falling back to the configured default) or a keyless Pollinations channel that needs no login and no token budget but allows one reply per 30 seconds. During that cooldown a click completes through the conversation model instead of being refused, and the first click after the window reopens returns to the keyless channel on its own. The rewrite keeps the draft's language, and a result in a different language is rejected rather than pasted over the draft.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏、模型选择器左侧加一枚 ✨ 按钮：点一下把草稿经宿主改写成可直接执行的提示词并原地回填，随后短暂显示「撤销」可一键还原原文。设置侧栏「提示词增强」分区可选择改写通道——对话模型（取下一次发消息实际会用的 provider/model，无则回退已配置的默认模型），或 Pollinations 免登录通道（无需登录、不消耗模型额度，但每 30 秒只允许 1 次）。冷却期内点击不会报错也不会被拒，而是自动改用对话模型完成改写；冷却结束后第一次点击自动切回免登录通道。改写结果始终保持与草稿相同的语言，若返回语言不一致则直接报错而不是覆盖草稿。

description.en: Adds a Keyboard Shortcuts page to the DSH Settings panel with six rebindable commands — permission-mode cycling, reasoning-effort stepping, a status-page and a task-list shortcut — plus PgUp/PgDn input navigation and an optional composer Enter remap.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置面板增加「快捷键」页面：六个可改键命令（权限模式切换、思考强度调节、状态页、任务清单），并展示翻页键跳转与可选的输入框 Enter 重映射。

description.en: Find text inside the open conversation with Ctrl+F: matches are highlighted in the message text, previous/next step through them, clicking the count lists the matches and jumps to any of them, and the count grows while the scan runs. No collapsed block is opened and the reading position does not move.
description.zh: 在当前对话里用 Ctrl+F 查找文字：命中处在正文中高亮，上一个/下一个逐个跳转，点计数可列出命中位置并直接跳过去，计数随扫描逐步增长；不展开任何折叠块，也不改变阅读位置。

description.en: Opens a dedicated question chat in the right sidebar for text selected in a DSH conversation, so follow-up questions do not push the main conversation away and never appear in the session list.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中选中一段文字，右侧栏即开出独立的提问对话，与主对话分屏并排，追问不会顶走正在学的内容，也不会出现在左侧会话列表里。

description.en: Category tabs (All, Appearance & UI, Usage & account and more) for the Installed list on the Plugins page, remembering the chosen tab; patch plugins named in an editable parent table are indented under the plugin they patch. Display-only, writes no files.
description.zh: 给插件页「已安装」列表加一行分类 Tab（全部 / 界面与外观 / 用量与账户 …），记住选中的分类；在可编辑对照表里登记的补丁插件会缩进挂在它修的插件下面。纯显示层，不写任何文件。

description.en: Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export, keeps Markdown notes and snippet library, and sends code plus a question into the current conversation for the main model to answer.
description.zh: 编程学习悬浮面板：编辑并运行 Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell（含退出码与耗时），JSON 课程包关卡自动评判并可导出进度，提供 Markdown 笔记与代码片段库；代码分析以用户消息直投当前对话，由对话主模型直接输出。

description.en: One-button prompt optimizer: rewrites the composer draft via a configurable strategy, with an editable template, few-shot examples, pinned models and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 一键提示词优化：按可配置策略改写输入框草稿，提供可编辑模板、Few-shot 示例、指定模型与推理强度。

description.en: Select text in a reply and quote it into the composer as an atomic reference chip: delete the whole chip in one keystroke, click it to scroll back and highlight the quoted turn, and expand it into a bounded reference block at send time so the model can tell the quote apart from what the user typed. Also opens the snippet in a side chat, or copies it to the clipboard.
description.zh: 在回复里选中文字，把引用作为原子 chip 写进输入框：一次按键整体删除、点击回跳并高亮被引用的轮次、发送时展开成带边界的引用块，让模型能分清引用与用户输入。另可把片段送进侧边对话，或复制到剪贴板。

description.en: Power button in the DSH Web UI session header that lets you close or restart the whole DSH process.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 会话头部的关机按钮，点击可关闭或重启整个 DSH 进程。

description.en: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.
description.zh: 将非图片文件或文件夹以原生 @path 引用粘贴进聊天输入框，或拖放插入绝对路径，替代仅支持图片的报错。

description.en: Adds a VS Code-style workspace file explorer to the dsh web GUI: file tree, editable preview with syntax highlighting, tabs, line numbers, right-click file operations, and inline image preview.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页添加 VS Code 风格工作区文件浏览器：文件树、可编辑预览（语法高亮、标签页、行号）、右键文件操作与图片内联预览。

description.en: Provider-first three-level model selector for the DSH Web model seat: pick a provider, then a model from that provider, with inline search on both levels, failed-provider retry rows, and a Model · Provider trigger.
description.zh: Provider-first 三级模型选择器：先选供应商再选模型，两级均可行内搜索，失败供应商以可重试行展示，触发器显示 Model · Provider。

description.en: Sidebar system monitor for the DSH Web UI: live host overview (CPU/memory/network/disk), process list, and Docker container status, all read-only.
description.zh: 侧边栏系统监控：实时查看宿主机概览（CPU/内存/网络/磁盘）、进程列表与 Docker 容器状态，全程只读。

description.en: Two round buttons at the foot of the DSH desktop sidebar on Windows: restart the app without a console window ever flashing on screen, and open the DeepSeek top-up page in your browser. The restart path launches the helper through WMI and wscript so the new process never inherits a console; it verifies the executable path before killing anything and preserves the original command line. Windows 10/11 only (the package declares os: win32).
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面端侧边栏底部加两个圆形按钮：重启应用（全程不闪黑窗）和打开 DeepSeek 充值页。重启走 WMI + wscript 拉起 helper，新进程不继承控制台；动手前会先核对可执行文件路径，并保留原始命令行。仅支持 Windows 10/11（包声明 os: win32）。

description.en: Ctrl+click file paths and links in chat: paths open their folder in the OS file manager (with the file selected), links open in a new browser tab.
description.zh: 在对话中 Ctrl+点击文件路径与链接：路径在文件管理器中定位所在文件夹，链接在新标签页打开。

description.en: Code-first React and TypeScript task apps rendered inline, in Canvas, full screen, or on localhost, with interaction state available to later agent turns and approval-gated MCP and API access.
description.zh: Code-first React + TypeScript 任务应用，支持 Inline、Canvas、全屏与 localhost；交互状态可供 Agent 后续轮次读取，MCP 和 API 访问在用户授权后执行。

description.en: In-place prompt editing in the web chat: cleanly forks session history at the edited turn, preserves image and file attachments, and auto-archives the superseded branch.
description.zh: DSH Web 聊天就地编辑历史提示词：在目标轮次干净分叉会话历史，原样保留图片与附件，并自动归档旧会话。

description.en: Adds a Community Bench tab that reads the public task-conditioned registry and shows the same score everyone sees; it does not compute a local score.
description.zh: 增加社区基准标签页，读取公开的、按任务条件计算的 registry，展示所有人看到的同一分数；不在本地计算分数。

description.en: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.
description.zh: Web 作曲器终端风格输入历史：边缘优先的方向键召回并精确还原草稿与光标、浏览器本地持久化历史、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，以及滑动上下文感知；0.5.0 再加智能输入层——跨会话片段库（/save、/load）、带变量的提示词模板、复用洞察与压缩摘要高亮。

description.en: JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 JARVIS 风格科幻 HUD 外壳：电光青色 VITAL SIGNS 生命体征 / RT-MONITOR 实时监控 / RT-LOG 事件日志左栏，右侧 POWER CORE 能源核心仪表、旋转扫描的 RADAR 雷达盘与上下行流量图，左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及带 JARVIS 头部横幅、跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 eDEX-UI 风格外壳：左侧系统遥测栏（含每核 CPU 迷你趋势图）、右侧 encom-globe 世界地图与上下行流量图、左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。

description.en: Mobile-first UX polish for the DSH Web UI: composer auto-fold, enter-as-newline on phones, compact sidebar/header/settings, zoom and overscroll lock, plus approval/question/completion notifications via in-page cards, Web Push, and webhook — zero dsh changes.
description.zh: 手机优先的 DSH 前端体验优化：输入框自动折叠、手机回车换行、侧边栏/顶部栏/设置页压缩、禁缩放回弹，以及审批/提问/任务完成通知（页面卡片、Web Push、webhook）；零 dsh 本体改动。

description.en: Adds F5 / Ctrl+R page reload to the DeepSeek Harness desktop web UI, which production builds lack by default (the "Reload Page" menu item and bare-F5 accelerator are development-gated). Binds soft reload (F5, Ctrl+R) and cache-busted hard reload (F5 with a modifier, Ctrl+Shift+R, appending a _dsh_refresh timestamp) through a capture-phase client key listener.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面 Web UI 补上 F5 / Ctrl+R 页面刷新功能（生产版默认没有刷新菜单项与裸 F5 快捷键）。通过客户端捕获阶段按键监听绑定软刷新（F5、Ctrl+R）与防缓存硬刷新（F5 加修饰键、Ctrl+Shift+R，附加 _dsh_refresh 时间戳）。

description.en: Right-side message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness: per-message tick marks, hover-to-expand preview drawer, smooth jump to any historical message, star bookmarks, realtime slide animation with interrupt support, full session index with virtualization, dynamic panel avoidance, official --dsw-* token styling.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧消息导航轨道：逐条消息刻度、悬浮预览抽屉、平滑跳转、星标回看、实时平移动画（可打断）、完整会话索引与虚拟化、面板动态避让、官方 --dsw-* token 样式。

description.en: UI harmonizer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official design tokens — with live-customizable chat width, markdown font size, workspace scale, UI font stack and a rounded center-column card from Settings → General; client-only dsh bundle, zero model cost, no host side, removable without residue.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness UI 协调器：规范化官方未完善、自相矛盾的界面，协调已装插件间的样式冲突并统一视觉语言（全部遵循官方设计令牌）——支持实时自定义对话宽度、markdown 字号、工作区缩放、UI 字体栈，并在设置页提供圆角中栏卡片；纯客户端 dsh bundle，零模型开销，无 host 端，可无残留移除。

plugins.name: dsh-widgets

description.en: A customizable widget rail for the right side of DeepSeek Harness: 61 cards covering session stats, tokens and cache, context, background jobs, subagents, machine metrics, OpenCode Go and Command Code quota, session cost, peak pricing and the GitHub review queue. Cards install from an in-rail market into 1-4 column grids and 2x2 or 2x4 tiles, with per-instance settings, a magnification wave under the pointer and a one-click hide. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x, web UI and desktop app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧的可自定义部件栏：61 个部件覆盖会话统计、token 与缓存、上下文、后台任务、子代理、机器指标、OpenCode Go 与 Command Code 额度、会话成本、峰谷定价与 GitHub 待审队列；部件可在栏内市场安装，支持 1-4 列网格与 2x2 / 2x4 尺寸、逐实例配置、指针划过放大波峰与一键整栏收起。支持 DSH 0.1.x / 0.2.x，网页版与桌面端通用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to www.gstatic.com

description.en: Live per-turn progress capsule with an empirical ETA table and a click-to-open turn history, docked under the composer.
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻显示当前对话的进度与预估剩余时间，点击可回看该会话的历史任务记录。

description.en: Popup and overlay motion for DeepSeek Harness: spring clip-morph entrances for nearby popups, fade-up far dialogs, coherent hover bubbles, image-zoom FLIP, and a live-preview settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的弹窗与浮层提供动效：近距浮层从触发按钮液态长出、远距弹窗从下方浮出、连贯气泡切换、图片放大 FLIP，并带可实时预览的设置页。

description.en: Creates a Windows desktop shortcut that starts DeepSeek Harness when needed and opens the Web UI in a Chrome or Edge app window.
description.zh: 创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式，必要时启动 DeepSeek Harness，并用 Chrome 或 Edge 应用窗口打开 Web UI。

description.en: Lets users quote selected conversation text with optional notes, then attaches the references to their next message.
description.zh: 引用选中的对话文本并添加可选备注，在发送下一条消息时自动附带引用内容。

description.en: Sidebar panel that lists every plugin installed in the current profile and gives each one an enable/disable switch.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：列出当前 profile 已安装的插件，每行带一个启用/停用开关。

description.en: Renders agent HTML output as real UI in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with visual cards, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, built-in open-source fonts, and design-spec injection.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 把 agent 输出的 HTML 渲染成真实界面，支持视觉卡片、KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图表与内置开源字体，并向 agent 注入设计规范。

description.en: A UX enhancement pack for the DSH web chat: one plugin that collects small interface conveniences, each with its own switch under Settings → UX Plus applied immediately — chat-area font size and reading width under Settings → General → Chat area, a session-row menu that copies the session ID or inherits the conversation into a new session on a chosen model, workspace and session rows ordered by recent activity with 24-hour idle auto-collapse and age labels, and settled ask_user_question cards left expanded. The switch list is generated from its own feature registry, so the pack grows as conveniences are added instead of being fixed at a count.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话界面的 UX 增强包：一个插件持续收纳各种界面小改进，每项都有独立开关，位于 设置 → UX Plus，改动即时生效——对话字号与阅读宽度（设置 → 通用 → 对话区）、会话行菜单可复制会话 ID 或把当前对话继承到所选模型的新会话里继续、工作区与会话行按最近活跃排序（闲置超过 24 小时自动收起并显示上次更新时间）、已结束的提问卡片默认展开。开关列表由插件自身的功能注册表生成，功能会持续增加，不固定在某个数量。

description.en: Stacks the sidebar footer actions into one full-width row each, and lines their icons up on one left edge.
description.zh: 把侧边栏底部的动作按钮改成一行一个、铺满整行，并让各行的图标落在同一条竖线上。

description.en: Swaps the composer's model control for a PI-Desktop style picker: a two-pane menu with search and provider grouping, a reasoning-effort slider, ArrowUp/ArrowDown prompt-history recall, and a prompt-rewrite button with undo.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型控件换成 PI-Desktop 风格的选择器：双栏菜单（搜索、按 provider 分组、上下文窗口与能力徽标）、推理强度滑块、↑/↓ 提示词历史回溯，以及带撤销的提示词改写按钮。

plugins.name: dsh-restart-button

description.en: Restart button at the right end of the session header that restarts the whole client: the Windows desktop app (Electron shell and Host, through the Host's own graceful shutdown) or the dsh web server. It can wait until running turns and background jobs finish, reopens the open session afterwards with one-click continue for interrupted sessions, flags plugin updates that only take effect after a restart, and shows Host uptime and memory on hover.
description.zh: 会话标题栏右端的重启按钮，可重启整个客户端：Windows 桌面版（Electron 外壳与 Host，走 Host 自身的优雅关闭流程）或 dsh web 服务。可等正在运行的回合与后台作业结束后再重启；重启后回到原会话，被中断的会话可一键继续；提示需重启才生效的插件更新；悬停显示 Host 运行时长与内存。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Copies selected assistant text to the clipboard and shows a Comment chip that opens the inline comment box in DeepSeek Harness; the right-click quote menu and Cmd+L still work.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的助手消息里选中文字即自动复制，并弹出「注释」浮框，点开才是评论框；右键引用菜单与 ⌘L 仍然保留。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: show a provider + model icon in the sidebar for every session, updated live from the composer model selector with a last-request fallback for history sessions; aggregator routes render the provider logo with a 10px model logo in the corner.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在侧边栏为每个会话显示 provider 与 model 图标，跟随输入框选择器即时更新，历史会话回退到最近一次请求；聚合路由（如 opencode-go、traex）显示 provider 主图并叠加 10px model 小图标。

plugins.name: dsh-aide

description.en: VS Code-style local IDE for DeepSeek Harness: Monaco editor, explorer, search, Git, terminal, and language services. With pnpm, run `pnpm approve-builds --all` so the native build of node-pty is allowed.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供 VS Code 风格的本地 IDE：Monaco 编辑器、资源管理器、搜索、Git、终端与语言服务。用 pnpm 安装时需运行 `pnpm approve-builds --all`，允许 node-pty 的原生构建。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Three-window workbench for dsh web: chat, construct, and a read-only review window side by side for each workspace, per-window hooks, and an anonymous multi-model review that asks before it runs, groups findings by issue, and reports in Markdown.
description.zh: dsh web 的三窗工作台：每个工作区并排显示聊天、施工和只读审核三个窗口，各窗口独立配置 hook；审核窗提供匿名多模型评审，先确认再运行，按同一件事归组，报告为 Markdown。

description.en: Expand button for the DSH Web UI composer — appears at 3+ lines, stretches to near-fullscreen height, auto-collapses on send, and inserts a newline on Enter or Shift+Enter in expanded mode while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends.
description.zh: 输入框全屏扩展按钮——内容达 3 行以上时出现，点击扩展至全屏高度，发送后自动折叠；扩展模式下 Enter 与 Shift+Enter 换行，Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 发送。

description.en: Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.
description.zh: 人与 Agent 共用的确定性项目任务：一份 actions.json，右侧栏运行面板与 Agent 工具双入口。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, skills, and tools for your agent — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.
description.zh: 一站式管理 MCP 服务器、技能与工具——真实的在上下文状态(已加载/已截断/已挤出),并按会话开关。

plugins.name: dsh-bili-widget

description.en: Floating Bilibili video mini-player for DSH — always-on-top window with discover/search/follow-UP channels, auto-playlist, mini & focus modes, persisted watch history and window minimize-to-ball.
description.zh: DSH 里的 B站悬浮看片小窗：置顶窗口，含推荐/热门/排行/精选/关注/AI 频道与搜索，自动连播、迷你专注模式、历史持久化与最小化悬浮球。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to api.bilibili.com

description.en: Sidebar weather panel: current conditions, 5-day and 24-hour forecasts, an hourly rain chart, temperature history, CMA alerts with graded reminders and county-level matching, a radar mosaic, FY-4B satellite imagery, typhoon tracks, and ECMWF / NW Pacific sea surface temperature charts.
description.zh: 侧边栏天气面板：当前天气、5 天与 24 小时预报、逐小时降水、历史气温、中央气象台预警（分级提醒、区县级匹配）、雷达拼图、风云四号 B 星卫星云图、台风路径，以及 ECMWF 与西北太平洋海表温度专业图。

description.en: Adds a per-answer Process drawer that streams, in Simplified Chinese, the agent thinking, tool calls and errors for that turn.
description.zh: 在每条回答旁加「进程」抽屉，用简体中文流式讲解该回合 agent 的思考、工具调用与报错。

description.en: Sidebar panel management for DeepSeek Harness: a grouped Panels launcher collects global panel rows and third-party plugin entry rows into one searchable menu — the full panel inventory (pinned and unpinned, unpinned open via temporary-pin peek), collapsible group memory, in-menu search with keyboard navigation, and hover pin/top quick-actions. A Ctrl+K command palette mirrors the inventory with quick commands; a keyboard-reachable right-click context menu covers open/pin/top/keep-in-sidebar. Supports icon-only panel rows, top-pinning with drag-to-reorder, a compact footer with granular sub-toggles, and a Settings page with height sliders, a locale-safe whitelist, pin management, and settings export/import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏面板收纳：把全局面板行（含未钉住的，未钉面板临时打开后还原）与第三方插件入口收进一个可搜索的分组「面板」菜单——分组折叠记忆、菜单内搜索与全键盘导航、悬停钉住/置顶快捷操作；Ctrl+K 命令面板镜像同一清单并附带快捷命令；右键上下文菜单（键盘可达）覆盖打开/钉住/置顶/常驻侧栏；支持面板行仅图标、置顶拖拽排序、紧凑底部区细分开关，设置页提供高度滑块、语言切换安全的白名单、钉住管理与配置导出/导入。

description.en: Todo sidecar for DeepSeek Harness: turn selected text into a todo, capture todos from a conversation, review them in a left sidebar panel, get due reminders as an in-app popup or an IM bot message, and export everything to HTML, Markdown, Excel, CSV or JSON.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供待办清单：把划选的文字存成待办、从对话里捕获待办、在左侧栏面板里查看与处理、到期用应用内弹窗或机器人推送提醒，还能把全部记录导出成 HTML、Markdown、Excel、CSV 或 JSON。

description.en: Five web UI tools in one plugin: a provider + model two-button selector with reasoning-level control, collapse/expand-all for sidebar workspace groups, a session tab listing the files the session changed (needs kernel 0.1.2-alpha.1+, silently absent on older kernels), a workspace badge next to the session title, and a settings page that toggles them.
description.zh: 一个插件装五个 Web UI 工具：供应商 + 模型双按钮选择器（含推理等级调节）、侧边栏工作区折叠/展开全部、会话「修改的文件」选项卡（需内核 0.1.2-alpha.1+，旧内核上静默缺席）、会话标题旁的工作区徽章，以及集中开关这些功能的设置页。

description.en: Inline image chips for the DeepSeek Harness composer — paste an image and it lands in the text as a numbered chip (image-1.png) with hover preview. Images still ship through the official attachment pipeline, names restart per message, the dock and sent-message thumbnails carry a sequence badge, and a pre-send self-check warns when the names in the text no longer match the images in that message.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里粘贴图片，即在文字中插入 image-1.png 编号胶囊；图片仍走官方附件管线随消息发出。鼠标悬浮名字弹出缩略图预览卡，dock 与已发送气泡的缩略图带序号角标，发送前还会自检「文字里的名字」与「本条消息的图片」是否对得上。

description.en: Top-centered weather bar for the DSH Web UI: geolocation, current conditions, 12h/7d forecasts and severe-weather notifications via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).
description.zh: DSH Web 顶部居中的天气栏：定位 + 当前天气 + 未来 12 小时/7 天预报与恶劣天气提醒，数据来自 Open-Meteo（免费、无需 API key）。

description.en: Draws an ambient glow along the window edge and a moving light band around the composer, sharing one colour table and each with its own switch.
description.zh: 在窗口边缘画一圈环境光、在输入框边缘画一条流动的光带，两者共用同一套配色，各自独立开关。

description.en: Screenshot button for the DSH composer on Windows: drag a region over the frozen screen and the picture lands in the draft as a normal image attachment, with a global hotkey and an editable shortcut.
description.zh: 给 DSH 打字框加一个截图键：点剪刀、拖框选中屏幕区域，图片作为普通附件直接进草稿；另带全局热键与可自定义的快捷键，仅 Windows。

description.en: Native DSH /side conversation tabs with a clean transcript and inherited context, hidden from the main session list using independent Session forks and the official chat UI, with timestamps, token usage, streaming and the command menu. Extracted from dsh-better-sidebar 0.29.0 (MIT); do not enable it alongside dsh-better-sidebar's own /side entry — the two command entries conflict, so stop one before using the other. Requires Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 and dsh-delete-session for confirmed permanent cleanup.
description.zh: 不进入左侧列表、空白开场且保留上下文的 /side 临时侧边对话，复用 DSH 原生分支和聊天界面，包含时间、用量、流式回复和原生命令菜单。核心代码提取自 dsh-better-sidebar 0.29.0（MIT），不能与 dsh-better-sidebar 自带的 /side 入口同时启用（命令冲突，使用前停用其一）。完整使用要求 Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5，并启用 dsh-delete-session 完成关闭后的永久清理。

description.en: Windows terminal dock inside the DSH web GUI. It is the occupant of the shipped shell.bottom slot: showing it splits the screen (the columns shrink instead of being covered), hiding it returns the space and keeps the PTY session alive. Each session is a local ConPTY child spawned through node-pty and rendered by xterm.js over a loopback-fenced WebSocket (backpressure, debounced resize). Other plugins can add terminal or DOM views through a host registerView API and a window CustomEvent channel.
description.zh: 嵌入 DSH Web GUI 的 Windows 终端 dock。它占用官方 shell.bottom 槽位：显示时真正分屏（三列高度自动让位而非被盖住），隐藏后空间归还且 PTY 会话不销毁。每个会话是 node-pty 起的本地 ConPTY 子进程，浏览器用 xterm.js 渲染，经 loopback 限定的 WebSocket 传输（带背压与 resize 去抖）。其他插件可通过宿主 registerView API 与 window CustomEvent 通道注册终端或 DOM 视图。

description.en: Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.
description.zh: 本地优先的小说创作工作台，将大纲、章节、人物、时间线、写作规则与一致性检查联动到对话。

description.en: Hide or show each button under an assistant reply, reorder them by dragging, and collect the hidden ones behind a single ⋯ button.
description.zh: 隐藏或显示助手回答底部的每个按钮，可拖动调整顺序，并把隐藏的收进一个「⋯」。

description.en: Rebind which key sends a message and which key starts a new line in the DeepSeek Harness composer; Enter sends and Cmd/Ctrl+Enter breaks the line by default, and either chord can be re-recorded from a settings page.
description.zh: 自定义 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里哪个键发送消息、哪个键换行；默认 Enter 发送、Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 换行，两个组合键都可以在设置页里重新录制。

description.en: Quote any message of the current conversation into the composer: pick one from the @ menu, click the quote button on a user or assistant message, or select text and use Quote in the right-click menu. Quotes show as numbered chips in the composer and as summary bubbles above it; after sending, each quote becomes a fenced block so the model can tell quoted text from new text.
description.zh: 把本对话里的任意一条消息引用进输入框：@ 菜单选择，或点用户消息、AI 回复上的引用按钮，也可以选中文字后右键「引用」。引用在输入框里是带序号的芯片，上方浮出摘要气泡；发送后每条引用展开成独立块，模型能分清引用内容与新写内容。

description.en: Adds Restart App and Host, Reload Page and Force Quit items to the Windows system tray of the official DSH desktop app by patching app.asar in place, and re-applies that patch after each desktop update.
description.zh: 给官方桌面端的 Windows 系统托盘加「重启应用与 Host」「刷新页面」和「彻底退出 Harness」三项（原位修改 app.asar），并在桌面端每次更新覆盖后自动重打补丁。

description.en: Composer history that restores the whole input state: composer contents, image and file attachments, @ references and slash commands, plus the model, thinking effort, permission and agent preset used.
description.zh: 记录并还原整个输入框状态：文字、图片/文件附件、@ 引用和 / 指令，以及当时的模型、思考程度、权限预设和使用模式；还原后与记录时一致。

description.en: Rearranges the panel entries at the top of the DSH sidebar: drag to reorder or sort alphabetically, hide an entry without unloading its plugin, and split entries into named groups that render as titled separators; group headers collapse on click. A layout guard caps the entry list height and makes it scroll, so a growing list no longer squeezes the session and workspace panes out of view. An optional switch lets the profile's default model propose groups, and the host whitelists the returned ids and labels before they are stored locally.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 侧栏顶部的全局面板入口：拖动排序或按名称排序、逐项隐藏（不卸载插件）、分成命名分组并渲染为带标题的分隔线，分组标题可点击折叠。布局兜底会给入口列表限高并允许滚动，入口变多时不再把会话/工作区列表挤到看不见。可选开关让当前 profile 的默认模型提议分组，模型返回的 id 与组名先经宿主白名单清洗再写入本地。

description.en: Custom branding for the shared DSH Web UI: a Settings → Branding panel for the name, badge, and local logo/wordmark images with size and rounding, live preview, optional page-title brand, and reset to the official look.
description.zh: DSH 共享网页界面的自定义品牌：在「设置 → 品牌」中修改名称、徽章，选择本地 logo 和字标图片并调整大小与圆角、实时预览、可选自定义页面标题、一键恢复官方外观。

description.en: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
description.zh: Codex 风格推理等级滑块，内嵌于模型选择器，拖动切换推理档位。

description.en: Draggable bubble graph of DeepSeek Harness workspaces and sessions in the Web UI: workspaces are large bubbles, sessions are small ones, and lines show real membership. The canvas supports pan, zoom and fit; filters cover workspace, status, type and archive state; search covers workspace names, paths and session titles; native actions open or create sessions, rename workspaces, and archive or restore sessions. Layouts are saved in the browser.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中的工作区与会话可拖动气泡图谱：大泡为工作区、小泡为会话，连线表示真实所属关系。画布支持平移、缩放与适应；筛选覆盖工作区、状态、类型和归档情况；搜索覆盖工作区名称、路径与会话标题；原生操作可打开或新建会话、重命名工作区、归档或恢复会话。布局保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Seeyon workbench that mounts OA to-dos and meetings, the skill catalog, and one-click aTrust VPN in one panel. Its vendored modules replace the author's dsh-seeyon-todo, dsh-skillhub and dsh-vpn — install this bundle or those plugins, not both. Requires a Seeyon OA account; the VPN part is Windows-only and needs the Sangfor aTrust client.
description.zh: 致远工作台：把 OA 待办、会议、技能市场和 aTrust VPN 一键登录合成一个面板。内含模块替代作者的 dsh-seeyon-todo / dsh-skillhub / dsh-vpn，二选一，不可同装。需要致远 OA 账号；VPN 部分仅限 Windows，且需先安装深信服 aTrust 客户端。

description.en: Persona wardrobe for DeepSeek Harness: save multiple personas, apply them globally or per workspace, with a master switch, an adjustable API balance guard, and a lazy token-loving tired mode that speaks on the agent's behalf when quota runs out. Files-as-config, hot reload, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 agent 穿上主人钦定的人设：多套人格随心换，全局或按工作区生效，内置人设库、总开关、余额预警与没电模式（80 句随机话术）。文件即配置、保存即生效、零依赖。

description.en: Restores Cmd+, to open the existing Settings dialog in DeepSeek Harness on macOS.
description.zh: 为 macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 恢复 Cmd+, 设置快捷键。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-translate

description.en: Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the dsh web GUI: live translation of the model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.
description.zh: dsh 网页端全链路中文翻译：思考过程实时翻译、英文回复就地中文、工具输出中文摘要与工具调用注释；翻译为独立提供方请求，不进入会话上下文。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Toolbar picture button in the DSH Web composer: click to pick multiple images through the native file dialog — they join the same draft-image rail as drag-and-drop and paste, with the host image-format, per-message-count and per-image-size limits enforced inline.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框工具栏图片按钮：点击调用系统文件选择器直接多选取图，进入与拖拽/粘贴相同的草稿图片栏，并内联校验宿主的图片格式、单条张数与单张大小限制。

description.en: Rewrites the composer draft into a precise prompt with a configurable model and a fully editable rewriting instruction; reads the content behind @file, @folder and @session references for context and keeps the reference chips intact; offers a one-click undo that restores the text you wrote yourself, and places the button in either composer toolbar with an adjustable colour and size.
description.zh: 用可配置的模型和整段可改的改写指令，把输入框草稿改写成精确提示词；会读取 @文件、@文件夹、@会话 引用指向的内容作为上下文，并原样保留引用标记；支持一键撤销优化、恢复你自己敲的原文；按钮可放在输入框左侧或右侧工具栏，颜色与大小均可调整。

description.en: Adds an ETA widget to the DSH web and desktop UI that estimates when the current turn will finish from the todo list and step pace, and shows the remaining time, a progress bar and a confidence badge.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页端与桌面端加一个 ETA 挂件：按 todo 清单与步进节奏估算本轮何时完成，显示剩余时长、进度条与置信度徽章。

description.en: Panellist manager: reorder the entries on the left rail, rename them, replace their icons, hide them, and fold several into a Group with a flyout menu, from a Settings tab.
description.zh: 面板列表管理器：在设置页里调整左侧轨道上的页签顺序、改名、换图标、隐藏，并把若干页签收进带飞出菜单的分组。

description.en: Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.
description.zh: DSH Web 时事热点面板：AI 大事与工科热点实时聚合，每条含要点提炼与来源链接；侧边栏入口、三视图、关键词与来源筛选、已读标记与快捷键。

description.en: Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.
description.zh: `?session=` / `?workspace=` 深链直达指定项目对话。

description.en: Model picker control for the DSH composer: a settings section beside the built-in Models page renames model display names and provider group names, adds a short coloured suffix capsule after a name, groups models from different providers into a new partition, reorders provider groups by drag or keyboard, sorts models inside a group by catalog order or name, and hides a provider or a single model without removing it from the catalog. Edits stay in a draft until you press Save, and the built-in 1017 tag and a custom capsule can be shown side by side.
description.zh: DSH 输入框模型选择器的总控：在与宿主「模型」页平级的设置分区里，可以改模型显示名与 provider 分组名、在名称后加一枚三色后缀胶囊、把不同 provider 的模型合并成新分区、用拖拽或键盘重排分组顺序、按目录原序或名称排序组内模型、隐藏整个 provider 或单个模型（不删除目录条目）。改动先进入草稿，按保存才生效；宿主自带 1017 标签与自定义胶囊可同时显示。

description.en: Adds an avatar to the left of each turn's final AI reply and to the right of each user message; upload your own image and set its size and circle or square frame.
description.zh: 在每轮 AI 回复左侧与你的每条输入右侧各显示一个头像，可上传自己的图片并设置尺寸与圆形/方形头像框。

description.en: Translates visible Chinese UI and content in DeepSeek Harness Web, using a browser-local OPUS-MT model for session titles, workspace names, messages, search results, and opted-in plugin prose while keeping remote translation limited to allowlisted UI labels.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中翻译可见的中文界面与内容：会话标题、工作区名称、消息、搜索结果和插件主动标记的正文使用浏览器本地 OPUS-MT，远程翻译仅限白名单界面标签。

description.en: Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.
description.zh: Windows 托盘桌面壳：自动从 GitHub Releases 安装并升级 exe、创建应用与网页端两个桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

description.en: Russian for the dsh web GUI: the whole interface plus the menus of 520 third-party plugins — 584 sections, 67,666 strings.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面提供俄语：整个界面，加上 520 个第三方插件的菜单——584 个分区、67 666 条文案。

description.en: A draggable task-tree panel inside the chat page: capture tasks by voice or text, drag to reorder, edge-snapping collapse, and a plain-text queue file you can edit or version yourself.
description.zh: 藏在页面里的任务树面板：语音或打字入库、拖动排序、贴边收起，数据是工作区里的纯文本 queue.md，随时可改可用 git 管。

description.en: Weather card once per session: remembers your home city so a VPN never moves it, inline city picker, theme presets, custom separators, optional TTS hook for third-party voices.
description.zh: 每次启动出现一次的天气卡片：记住没开 VPN 时的家城市、VPN 不再让城市跑偏、城市可手选、主题预设与自定义分隔线，并留了给第三方语音库的可选朗读接口。

description.en: Shares sidebar navigation scrolling with Projects lists; supports native workspace scroll handoff and legacy outer scrolling (DSH 0.2.2-rc.1).
description.zh: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 侧栏共享滚动：功能菜单与 Projects 列表共用滚动区，工作区支持原生滚动接力或旧版外层滚动。

description.en: Full-screen terminal TUI for DeepSeek Harness with Web-GUI parity, live streaming, agent presets, and DeepSeek blue styling.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端 TUI 界面，具备 Web GUI 级对齐能力，支持实时流式输出、智能体预设与经典蓝配色。

description.en: Shows an aggregated session-status dot in front of every folder in DSH Web's sidebar workspace tree — waiting for input, just finished, or running — and bubbles the sessions of nested workspaces up to their parent folder.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏工作区树的每个目录名前显示聚合状态点（等你输入 / 刚完成 / 运行中），父目录自动汇总嵌套工作区的会话状态。

description.en: Sidebar workspace panel that switches between running tasks and all conversations, shown as one freely sortable card list with per-card pin, rename, copy ID, fork, stop, and archive actions.
description.zh: 侧栏工作区面板，在运行中任务与全部对话之间切换，统一为一张可自由排序的卡片列表，每张卡片可置顶、重命名、复制 ID、分叉、停止与归档。

description.en: A tiny behavioral mood ring for AI coding agents — folds session behavior (consecutive failures, repeated calls, activity) into a four-state Mood (GOOD / CONFUSED / FRUSTRATED / OVERWHELMED) shown as a low-friction session-header status light.
description.zh: 给 AI 编程 Agent 的轻量心情指示器——把会话行为（连续失败、重复调用、活动强度）折叠成四态 Mood（顺利 / 困惑 / 受挫 / 过载），以低干扰的会话头部状态灯呈现。

description.en: A browser pixel-art and sprite animation editor with Aseprite-compatible files, local crop/outline blueprints, and optional LLM workflow nodes.
description.zh: 浏览器像素画与精灵动画编辑器，支持兼容 Aseprite 的文件、本地裁剪/描边蓝图和可选的 LLM 工作流节点。

description.en: Live preview tab for DSH — embed any dev server in an iframe with transparent SPA proxying.
description.zh: DSH 实时预览标签页：把任意 dev server 嵌入 iframe，透明代理 SPA 路由。

description.en: Highlight or quote any passage of an answer, attach a note to it, then send the excerpt back to the composer as a quoted instruction.
description.zh: 在回答里标出任意一段文字、写上备注，再把引用放回输入框当作带上下文的指令发出。

description.en: Edge glow for DeepSeek Harness: blue while it drives your mouse and keyboard, amber while it asks a question, red while it waits for approval, plus a top banner naming the current action. Desktop only: the overlay is a separate Electron process (auto-detected from the DSH desktop app or dsh-pet; override with DSH_ELECTRON_PATH) and stays dark without one.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 加光：模型接管键盘鼠标时屏幕四边亮蓝光、提问时琥珀、等你批准时红色，并在屏幕中上方显示正在做什么。仅桌面端：覆盖层是独立 Electron 进程（从 DSH 桌面版或 dsh-pet 自动查找，可用 DSH_ELECTRON_PATH 覆盖），没有 Electron 时不会亮。
