description.en: An opencode-inspired terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness that boots as a dsh profile app plugin, with a session sidebar, streaming chat, markdown tool cards, todo lists, slash-command suggestions, a telemetry footer with a context meter and inline approval prompts.
description.zh: 受 opencode 启发的 DeepSeek Harness 终端界面，以 dsh profile 应用插件形式启动，提供会话侧栏、流式聊天、markdown 工具卡片、待办列表、斜杠命令建议、带上下文用量表的遥测底栏与内联审批提示。

description.en: Per-session note list beside the conversation: a button at the top right of the chat badges the open count and opens a resizable right-side panel where notes are added, checked off, copied, edited or appended to the chat input, with panel size and drafts kept in the browser.
description.zh: 对话旁的会话级便笺：会话右上角入口用角标显示未完成数量，点开是可拖拽调宽高的右侧面板，便笺可添加、勾选完成、复制、编辑和一键转发到输入框，面板尺寸与草稿保存在浏览器本地。

description.en: Drag or paste files or pictures into the DSH Web composer as one scrolling row of chips, sent as @path references.
description.zh: 把文件或图片拖进 DSH Web 输入框，以一排小卡片展示，发送时以 @path 引用传给模型。

description.en: DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock.
description.zh: dsh 插件（dsh-desktop-launcher）：在对话中一键启动 dsh-desktop Windows Electron 桌面壳——双击即用、无需终端；支持选区截图提问（GPU 实时框选、自动粘贴到聊天框、配合识图插件 AI 直接看图回答）、系统托盘、会话管理、环境自动引导、可换端口、单实例锁。

description.en: Embeds chat.deepseek.com directly inside DeepSeek Harness desktop with persistent login sessions and dual-entry chat panels.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端内嵌 chat.deepseek.com，提供双入口聊天面板与持久登录会话。

description.en: Render Mermaid fenced code blocks as native diagram cards with 8 design-system themes and adaptive layout.
description.zh: 在 Markdown 中将 Mermaid 围栏代码渲染为原生图表卡片，内置 8 套设计系统主题与自适应布局。

description.en: A Deepseek Harness plugin that gives its UI color themes.
description.zh: Deepseek Harness 的一款插件，可为其用户界面添加颜色主题。

description.en: Composer UI for DeepSeek Harness that does two things. The reasoning-effort row in the model menu becomes a continuous slider drawn on the row itself, with the rungs read live from the model adapter so any ladder length works; each rung paints its own ember plume into a canvas behind the knob. Separately, the permission trigger renders in the theme error colour whenever full access is the active preset, including its row in the permission menu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的输入框增强，做两件事。模型菜单里的推理等级行变成直接画在该行上的连续滑块，档位实时读取模型适配器，因此档位数不限；每档会在旋钮背后的 canvas 上喷出各自的余烬尾焰。另外，只要当前是完全权限，权限触发器就用主题的错误色渲染，权限菜单里对应那一行同样变红。

description.en: Adds a gear button beside the sidebar account row that opens the Settings panel in one click. It runs the host's own settings.open command, so it reaches the shell store directly instead of going through the account menu, and the behaviour is identical on desktop and on a phone over the LAN where no keyboard shortcut is available.
description.zh: 在侧边栏账号行右侧添加一个齿轮按钮，点击一次即打开设置面板。它调用宿主自带的 settings.open 命令直达 shell 状态，不经过账号菜单；桌面端与手机局域网访问行为一致，后者没有键盘快捷键可用。

description.en: Agent enhancements for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: prompt history, one-click optimize with undo, next-prompt prediction, conversation and tracked-file restore, model bill, context details with compact, Auto routing, and per-provider DeepSeek balance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 智能体增强：提示词历史、一键优化与撤销、下一条预测、对话与已跟踪文件恢复、模型账单、上下文明细与压缩、Auto 路由，以及分账号 DeepSeek 余额显示。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens a card gallery of all Red Fox Community skills from the redfox-community-dsh plugin.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部加入「红狐 Skills」入口，点击后切换为卡片式技能画廊，集中展示 redfox-community-dsh 插件内的红狐社区技能。

description.en: Host plugin for the macOS menu bar companion: live DeepSeek Harness session state, Approve/Deny for tool approvals, stop the current turn, open the exact session. The native app is a free universal build in GitHub Releases.
description.zh: macOS 菜单栏伴侣的宿主插件：实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 会话状态，可直接批准/拒绝工具审批、停止当前回合、打开对应会话。原生应用以通用二进制免费发布于 GitHub Releases。

description.en: Right-click any attachment or path in the transcript and hand it to your own action: send it to a WeChat contact, open it in Chrome, or anything else you configure — one right-click, anything you want. Ships with quote-into-composer, reveal in the OS file manager, copy path and Send to…, and lets you add your own entries (command, open with, shortcut, link, PowerShell). Menus are drawn in the app's own style, never the system one.
description.zh: 对话里的附件和路径，右键就是你自己的入口：发给微信好友、用谷歌浏览器打开，或者你想到的任何处理——一个右键，做你想做的任何事。开箱带引用回输入框、在文件管理器里定位、复制路径、发送到…，再往下自己加一条入口（命令、打开方式、快捷指令、链接、PowerShell）。菜单跟着 App 的深浅色和圆角走，不是系统弹窗。

description.en: A read-only overview tab beside the conversation: what this round asked, what was observed, what still needs checking, and a bounded history you can step through round by round.
description.zh: 对话旁的只读概览页：本轮问了什么、观察到什么、还在验证什么；已结束的轮次可以一条条往回看。

description.en: Collapse noisy messages (Think, Bash, etc.) in conversations.
description.zh: 折叠对话中的 Think、Bash 等「无用消息」。

description.en: Count-up Pomodoro: focus counts up with no ceiling and never stops itself at 25 minutes, finishing drops straight into a short break, and a status board plus the four quadrants keep the task list in view.
description.zh: 正计时番茄钟：专注时段不设上限，不会在 25 分钟自动停止，结束即进入短休息；附带状态看板与四象限任务管理。

description.en: Obsidian-style notes panel in the DSH right sidebar: a tree over a local folder, Markdown preview with line numbers, edit and save, Obsidian callouts, tables and wikilinks, screenshot paste into the vault, one-click insert of a note path into the chat input, and batch archive or delete for sessions and workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 Obsidian 风格笔记面板：本地文件夹目录树、带行号的 Markdown 预览与编辑保存、Obsidian callout 与表格和双链渲染、粘贴截图存入 vault、一键把笔记路径插入对话输入框，以及会话/工作区的批量归档与删除。

description.en: Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓ stepping, Esc-return. Event-log powered — works beyond the loaded window. Dual-half plugin on the official composer.dock slot.
description.zh: 会话内轮次导航视频进度条：全图分段、悬停富元信息卡（工具/文件/token）、拖动 scrub、⌘K 全会话搜索、⌘↑/⌘↓ 逐轮跳转、Esc 返回原位——基于会话事件日志，超出已加载窗口仍可用。

description.en: Streaming fold for the DSH web transcript: the newest thinking window opens itself, older process rows fold into one summary, and a finished turn glides back to your prompt, which stays pinned while you read.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话流式折叠：运行中只展开最新的思考小窗、其余过程行折成一条摘要，一轮结束滑回你提的那句话；读到哪一轮那轮提问就钉在顶部。

description.en: A diamond button in the composer that rewrites your draft into a structured prompt and puts the original draft back when clicked again.
description.zh: 输入框里的菱形按钮：把草稿改写成结构化提示词，再点一次还原原始输入。

description.en: Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.
description.zh: 按工作区（工程）启停 Skill 与 MCP：每个项目单独控制新会话加载哪些技能与 MCP 工具。

description.en: Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面中长时间后台任务的实时进度：有任务的会话里浮着一个小球，可拖动，点开是含已完成/总量、速度与剩余时间的面板。

description.en: Explain a selected word or sentence from a DSH conversation in a floating window: a channel of its own that leaves the session untouched, and the answer can be pinned to a session of its own.
description.zh: 在浮窗里解释 DSH 对话中选中的词或句子：走独立通道、不污染当前会话，解答可以固定成独立会话。

description.en: Beads issue browser in the right sidebar: filter and search the tracker with live ready and waiting counts, read issue Markdown with clickable project-file and issue links, and copy or insert the issue id. Requires the bd CLI on PATH and a project with a Beads workspace.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 Beads 议题浏览器：按可开工、受阻与各状态筛选并搜索 tracker，阅读渲染后的议题正文，其中的项目文件与议题 id 可直接点击，并可一键复制或插入 id。需要 PATH 上的 bd CLI，以及已初始化 Beads 工作区的项目。

description.en: Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.
description.zh: Web UI 可自定义键盘快捷键：34 个预置功能（会话、视图、剪贴板、模型、静默权限切换、设置），一键录制自定义组合键，内置快捷键速查表与诊断面板。

description.en: Windows-only floating percentage meter for the DSH desktop (0.2.x) cookie jar: it estimates how much of the request-header budget the dsh-auth cookies occupy, turns red past half, and clears the jar on the next launch with one click, avoiding the lockout that hits after roughly 72 launches.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版（0.2.x）cookie 占用百分表，仅支持 Windows：浮窗按 dsh-auth cookie 条数估算其占请求头的百分比，超过一半数字变红提醒，点一次即可安排在下一次启动时清空 cookie 库，避免启动约 72 次后被 431 挡住。

description.en: Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端原生 TUI 前端，通过 Harness 能力提供会话、模型、插件、任务、子代理、待办事项和 Provider 配置，并保留真实的终端滚动历史。

description.en: Turns the DSH turn-navigation rail into a music visualiser: each thin bar grows and thickens with its own frequency band, from system audio captured with WASAPI loopback. Geometry only, no colour or glow, and the rail keeps its native hover preview, click-to-jump and wheel scrolling.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的轮次导航条变成音乐可视化：每根细横条按自己的频段变长变粗（系统声音用 WASAPI loopback 采集）。只改几何、不加颜色或发光，导航条原有的悬停预览、点击跳转与滚轮滚动都保留。

description.en: Collapses the global panel entries above the workspace in the DSH Web sidebar into a single toggle in the sidebar footer.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 侧栏里工作区上方的全局面板入口收成侧栏底部的一个开关。

description.en: Get back what you typed and walked away from: a new Web conversation you leave before sending never appears in the sidebar, so its draft is out of reach. This plugin lists those drafts above the composer of the next new conversation, newest first, with their workspace and time; Open takes you back with the text and chips in place, and Discard drops one, with Undo.
description.zh: 找回打了字却没发送就离开的内容：未发送就离开的新 Web 对话不会出现在侧栏，里面的草稿也就找不到了。本插件在下一个新对话的输入框上方按时间倒序列出这些草稿，并显示所属工作区与时间；「打开」带你回到原对话，文字和引用条原样还在；「丢弃」可撤销地删除草稿。

description.en: Show the model exactly which part you mean: select passages in a Web conversation and they go into your next message as composer chips, each with an optional note you can edit. Quoted passages stay highlighted until you send, hovering a chip shows the full quote, and the sent message shows each quote as a card.
description.zh: 让模型准确知道你指的是哪一段：在 Web 对话中选中段落，它们会作为引用条进入下一条消息，每条可附可编辑的备注。被引用的段落在发送前保持高亮，悬停引用条显示全文，发送后的消息把每条引用显示为卡片。

description.en: Mobile layer for DSH Web: swipe-gesture drawer sidebar with adjustable width, layered back key, bigger tap targets, Enter inserts a newline instead of sending, keyboard avoidance and a 15px font floor.
description.zh: 手机上的 DSH 界面优化：侧边栏变可滑动抽屉、手势开关侧栏、宽度可调、返回键逐层退出、按钮放大、回车换行而不是直接发送、键盘不挡输入框、字号不小于 15px。

description.en: Right-click a file or folder in the right sidebar file tree to add it to the composer as an @ reference (⌘/Ctrl and Shift multi-select insert a whole batch), open it with the default application, or reveal it in the system file manager. Open and reveal go through the built-in open-in-app host capability, so those entries appear unless the host explicitly reports the capability as unsupported.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文件树里右键，可把文件或文件夹作为 @ 引用加进输入框（⌘/Ctrl 与 Shift 多选可整批插入）、用默认应用打开，或在系统文件管理器中显示。打开与显示走宿主内置的 open-in-app 能力，只有宿主明确回答不支持时才隐藏这两项。

description.en: A polish button in the composer trailing controls that rewrites the draft in place with the model. Context is matched by topic, not by recency: anchors from the draft (paths, identifiers, quoted text, CJK bigrams) pick the earlier messages about the same task, so a session that interleaves several tasks does not leak another task goal or files into the rewrite — and the prompt explicitly lets the model ignore the extract when it does not fit. The result goes back through the same undo-able editor path a human edit uses. Drafts holding reference chips (@file, folder, session) or a claimed /command, and drafts mid-submission, disable the button instead of silently dropping references.
description.zh: 输入框右下工具区里的 ✨ 按钮，把草稿原地改写成更清楚的请求。上下文按话题挑而不按时间取：从草稿里抽锚点（文件路径、标识符、引号文字、中文二字词），在最近消息里挑同一话题的几条，所以一个会话里夹着多个任务时不会把别的任务的目标或文件带进改写结果；提示词也明确允许模型在上下文不像时完全忽略它。改写走与人工编辑同一条可撤销路径，⌘Z 即可还原。草稿里有引用 chip（@文件、文件夹、会话）或已认领的 /命令、以及正在提交时，按钮禁用 —— 宁可不动，也不悄悄丢掉引用。

description.en: Collapses the DSH Web sidebar panel menu (plugins, extensions, scheduled tasks, IM) from a vertical labelled list into a horizontal row of 36×36 icon buttons with hover tooltips; a Settings → General option switches back to the list and is remembered per browser.
description.zh: 把 dsh Web 侧边栏的全局面板菜单（插件、扩展管理、定时任务、IM）从竖排文字列表收起为一行 36×36 图标按钮，悬停显示名称；可在「设置 → 通用」里切回列表，选择按浏览器记忆。

description.en: Like Codex/Claude Code: drag any file or folder (no format limit) onto the DSH web page and its real absolute path is inserted into the composer instantly — no typing paths by hand. Workspace-first smart lookup, size checks, same-name picker, batch and clipboard paste support, Windows/macOS.
description.zh: 像 Codex/Claude 一样：拖入任意格式文件或文件夹，真实绝对路径立即插入输入框，不用一个个打字。工作区优先智能定位、大小校验、同名弹候选选择器，支持批量拖入与粘贴，兼容 Windows/macOS。

description.en: Project Atlas: a local-first visual workbench for DeepSeek Harness projects, skills, sessions, runtimes, and artifacts.
description.zh: Project Atlas：本地优先的可视化工作台，把 DeepSeek Harness 的项目、技能、会话、运行状态与产出收进一张地图。

description.en: Ask a sidebar assistant about selected assistant text: an ephemeral right-side panel answers from a snapshot of the main conversation's LLM history with streaming Markdown, collapsible thinking and multi-turn follow-ups, without touching the main conversation.
description.zh: 选中助手回答中的文本，在临时右侧面板向侧边栏助手提问：基于主对话 LLM 历史快照回答，支持流式 Markdown、可折叠思考与多轮追问，不打扰主对话。

description.en: Fast `@` file/session reference caching for the DSH Web GUI: preloaded indexes, browser-local keystroke filtering and native mention serialization.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框 `@` 文件/会话引用加速：预加载索引、浏览器本地按键过滤、保留原生 mention 序列化。

description.en: Folds streaming reasoning and tool calls into collapsed step bars and collapses each finished turn into a single summary bar; step bars show native tool icons, filenames, edited line counts, and failure counts, finished turns restore duration, first-token time, token usage, generation speed, and cache hit metrics from recorded Session events, and preferences persist on the Host. Changes browser presentation only. Requires DSH 0.1.5-alpha.1.
description.zh: 流式回复期间将推理与工具调用折叠为收起的步骤栏，回合完成后整轮收拢为一条摘要栏；步骤栏显示原生工具图标、文件名、编辑增删行数与失败计数，已完成回合从记录的 Session 事件恢复耗时、首字延迟、Token 用量、生成速度与缓存命中率，偏好由 Host 持久保存。仅改变浏览器呈现，需要 DSH 0.1.5-alpha.1。

description.en: Adds a button to the composer that rewrites the unsent draft into a clearer, more specific prompt, with one-click restore, a settings page and an optional per-request model override.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，把未发送的草稿改写为更清晰、更具体的提示词；支持一键还原、独立设置页，以及单次调用的模型覆盖。

description.en: Token-free Chinese classical poetry tab in the DSH conversation view with search, filters, 飞花令, daily poem, favorites, festival topics and a share-card image; AI explanation reuses your own DSH session.
description.zh: 免 token 诗词查询插件，在会话页头新增「诗词」标签页，支持搜索、筛选、飞花令、每日一首、收藏、简繁、节日专题与分享卡片图；AI 解读复用 DSH 会话。

description.en: A conversation-view tab for DeepSeek Harness Web showing solar/lunar dates, ganzhi year/month/day, Chinese zodiac, 24 solar terms, festivals, China public holidays including make-up workdays, multi-city weather, an epoch↔date timestamp converter with a time-zone picker, and bundled offline "on this day" history from free sources without an API key.
description.zh: 会话页头的「熊猫日历」标签页：公历/农历、干支、生肖、24 节气、传统与外国节日、中国法定节假日（含调休）、多城市天气、时间戳转换（秒/毫秒 ↔ 年月日时分秒，可选时区）与内置离线的「历史上的今天」，数据免费、无需 API Key。

description.en: View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with locale-aware zh/en copy and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 视图标签管理器（逃咪）：管理会话页头视图标签（对话/轨迹）——启停、隐藏、排序与重命名，文案随界面语言中英切换，并带 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F search inside the current conversation.
description.zh: 搜索 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）各工作区普通对话的标题和已保存正文，可包含归档；也可按 Ctrl+F / Cmd+F 查找当前对话。

description.en: Desktop only. DeepSeek Web in the Harness right Sidebar with synchronized theme, automatic launch, one-time web sign-in, and one-click question transfer.
description.zh: 仅 Desktop。把 DeepSeek 网页版放进 Harness 右侧栏：同步主题、自动打开、网页登录一次即可保持，并一键把提问带入当前对话。

description.en: Desktop profile for dsh: native Tauri window over the harness web surface with tray, native notifications, a file-manager panel, and one-click updates.
description.zh: dsh 桌面配置：原生 Tauri 窗口承载 harness Web 界面，支持托盘、原生通知、文件管理器面板与一键更新。

description.en: Makes plain Enter insert a newline in the composer and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter submit, toggleable in settings.
description.zh: 让对话框中普通 Enter 换行、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter 提交，可在设置中开关。

description.en: Russian UI language pack for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 with 2,909 strings based on official translations, version-specific compatibility fixes, and no app archive patching.
description.zh: 基于官方翻译，为 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 提供俄语界面，包含 2,909 条文本及版本兼容修正，不修改应用归档文件。

description.en: Compact macOS strip above the composer showing CPU, GPU, RAM, swap, memory pressure and local Ollama model ON/OFF status. Tested on Harness 0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: 输入框上方的 macOS 资源指标行：显示 CPU、GPU、RAM、交换空间、内存压力及本地 Ollama 模型 ON/OFF 状态。已在 Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 上验证。

description.en: Turns file and directory paths in DSH chat into clickable buttons: click one to preview the file in the right sidebar, or open it with the system default application.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话中的文件与目录路径变成可点击按钮：点击即在右侧侧边栏预览，或用系统默认程序打开。

description.en: A file-view enhancement plugin that extends the official DSH sidebar, providing source view, in-place editing, line number display, search, and font zoom.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 官方侧边栏的文件视图增强插件，提供源码视图、原位编辑、行号显示、搜索和字体缩放功能。

description.en: Personalises the DSH running-turn status line: rotating bilingual quips, a configurable animated loading icon (5 styles x 3 sizes) and one-click matching to the active theme colour, all in a General-settings panel, plus a # Chinese / # English sectioned quips editor. Ships with no dependencies, no build step and no config file.
description.zh: 为 DSH 运行中状态行做轻量个性化：可轮换的中英俏皮话、可配置的动态加载图标（5 种样式 x 3 档尺寸）、一键匹配当前主题色，全部集中在「通用设置」里，外加一个用 # Chinese / # English 分段的俏皮话编辑框。零依赖、无构建、不写配置文件。

description.en: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box; with dsh-better-sidebar installed, the paste pill opens the file in the sidebar editor and saves it back.
description.zh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件；装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，药丸上的「查看」可在侧栏编辑器打开并保存回原文件。

description.en: Shows download, install, fetch and search progress in a floating overlay or in a compact chip above the composer, and lists background jobs that have no progress to draw.
description.zh: 在浮层或输入框上方的胶囊里显示下载、安装、抓取、搜索的进度，并列出没有进度可画的后台任务。

description.en: Turn any DeepSeek Harness answer into a polished PNG share card: click a button under the reply, the answer is re-typeset on a canvas (8 gradient presets, light/dark, three fonts, width 720/880/1080, radius, padding, font size, line height, 1x-3x export, code wrap/highlight/line numbers, custom title and footer). Fully local rendering — no upload, no third-party dependency.
description.zh: 把任意一条 AI 回答一键变成精美的 PNG 分享卡片：点回复下面的按钮，回答会被重新排版画到画布上（8 套渐变预设、深浅主题、三种字体、宽度 720/880/1080、圆角、内边距、字号、行高、1×–3× 导出倍率、代码折行/高亮/行号、自定义标题与页脚）。纯本地渲染，不联网、不上传、无第三方依赖。

description.en: Splash and exit animations for DeepSeek Harness. Five hand-drawn styles (whale light-sweep, pulse, stardust, typewriter, radar rings) — or drop in your own video / GIF. A settings panel controls speed, particle count, accent colour, wording, mute and fit. The exit animation needs the bundled one-time desktop-shell patch (node tools/patch-asar.mjs --apply, reversible); without it closing only hides the window.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的开场 / 退场动画：5 套纯代码自绘样式（鲸鱼光扫 / 极简脉冲 / 星尘汇聚 / 打字机 / 雷达环），也可以换成你自己的视频或动图；设置页可调速度、粒子数、主色、文案、静音与画面适配。退场动画需先运行 node tools/patch-asar.mjs --apply 给桌面壳打补丁（可回滚）；不打补丁时关闭只隐藏窗口。

description.en: Custom Chinese nicknames for dsh plugins, displayed directly in the native plugin list.
description.zh: 给 dsh 插件列表里的插件自定义中文备注名，直接显示在原生设置页。

description.en: Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.
description.zh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

description.en: Fridge-magnet quick-task stickers docked above the composer: one-click sends a preloaded prompt into the current session, grouped long-term/short-term.
description.zh: 输入框上方的冰箱贴纸栏：把常用任务（科技新闻、GitHub 推荐等）做成贴纸，点击即向当前会话发送预置 prompt 并执行，按长期/短期分组。

description.en: Settings page for per-model capabilities: reasoning-effort levels with their wire spellings, input modalities, and token capacities, written as declarations or sparse catalog overrides.
description.zh: 在设置页按模型编辑能力：推理档位及其发往端点的取值写法、输入模态与 token 容量，以声明或官方目录稀疏覆盖的形式写入。

description.en: Windows-only process control for the harness: a sidebar button that shuts DSH down through the host's own graceful exit path, an app-window / normal-tab switch on the Plugins card that rewrites the desktop shortcut and restarts, and advanced settings for the wait before exit, the process exit code and a force-quit option.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的进程控制插件：侧边栏按钮经宿主的优雅退出通道关闭 DSH；插件卡片可切换「应用窗口 / 普通标签页」——会改写桌面快捷方式并重启；另有退出前等待、进程退出码与强制结束三项高级设置。

description.en: Reorder the settings panel nav by long-pressing and dragging a section: the dragged row turns translucent and follows the pointer, the order is saved to the plugin's own folder, and uninstalling restores the official order.
description.zh: 长按拖动即可重排设置面板左侧大项：被拖项半透明并跟随指针，顺序保存在插件自己的目录而非 settings.yaml，卸载后自动恢复官方原序。

description.en: Renders `latex` / `tex` code blocks in the chat as KaTeX formulae, and injects a system-prompt section that tells the model to write `$...$` and `$$...$$` instead of fenced code blocks.
description.zh: 把对话里的 `latex` / `tex` 代码块渲染成 KaTeX 公式，并向系统提示词注入「用 `$...$` / `$$...$$` 写公式」的规范。

description.en: Adds mind maps and an Excalidraw canvas to the DSH sidebar, with local blueprint-file editing, Excalidraw file previews and standalone CLIs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏提供思维导图和 Excalidraw 自由画布，支持本地思维导图文件编辑、Excalidraw 文件预览与独立 CLI。

description.en: Yueling (月令) — a solar-term card for the DSH Web UI: a dot under the conversation header unfolds into today's term, its three pentads, how long until the next term, a day-pillar reading, and a year table of all 24 terms. The hexagram page casts coins and keeps a seven-day log; the jieqi skill is bundled.
description.zh: 月令：DSH Web UI 的二十四节气卡片，标题栏下沿一颗圆点，展开今日节气与三候、距下个节气几天几时辰、日柱三行提示和全年交节时刻；卦页可以用铜钱摇一卦并回看七天。内置 jieqi skill。

description.en: Browser-style in-page find bar (Cmd/Ctrl+F) for the desktop app, with highlight-all, a match counter, and a scope picker for the conversation or the right panel.
description.zh: 桌面端浏览器式页内查找条（Cmd/Ctrl+F）：全文高亮、匹配计数，可在对话区与右侧面板间切换搜索范围。

description.en: All-in-one inline media previewer for mip-img/mip-video/mip-audio fences with streaming playback, ffmpeg transcoding fallback, lightbox, and trust-fenced LAN/mobile access.
description.zh: 全能内联媒体预览插件，支持 mip-img/mip-video/mip-audio 围栏的流式播放、ffmpeg 转码回退、灯箱浏览及信任围栏局域网/移动端访问。

description.en: Upload any file to DSH, isolated per workspace and session — a composer file library with server-side thumbnails and a context menu to open, copy, re-download or delete.
description.zh: 允许将任意文件上传给 DSH，按工作区与会话隔离。输入框内置文件库，服务端生成缩略图，右键菜单可打开、复制、重新下载或删除。

description.en: Model sampling sliders (temperature / maxTokens) in the composer: override every model request for all providers via the agent/request hook, with hot/persist modes.
description.zh: 对话输入区的模型采样滑杆（temperature / maxTokens）：通过 agent/request 钩子对所有供应商的每次请求生效，支持热调/持久化两种模式。

description.en: Redraws line-level diffs on edit, write, insert and str_replace_editor tool cards — unchanged lines render once and changed characters are underlined — covers run_code (PTC) sub-calls, adds a per-turn changed-files card, and opens or copies any of those paths from the card rows and the tool rows through a host route the plugin serves itself.
description.zh: 接管 edit / write / insert / str_replace_editor 四种工具行：行级对齐后相同行只渲染一次、行内改动字符带下划线；run_code(PTC) 子调用同样覆盖；轮末给出本轮改动汇总卡片；工具行与卡片行都能右键「在资源管理器中打开」或复制文件/文件夹绝对路径，由插件自己的宿主路由完成。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-pet

description.en: A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format, you can use hatch-pet or Petdex to add your pets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物：完全支持 Codex 桌宠格式，可使用 hatch-pet Skill 创建宠物，或通过 Petdex 导入宠物。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Publishes the desktop shell's file-path bridge as the host-path seam the composer reads, so files and folders dropped into the composer become @path references instead of uploaded copies (images still upload through the native image channel).
description.zh: 把桌面壳的文件路径桥接发布为输入框读取的 host-path 接口，让拖入输入框的文件与文件夹变成 @path 引用而不是上传副本（图片仍走原生图片通道上传）。

description.en: In-place Markdown editing for the right-sidebar document preview: a file keeps the shipped renderer's look, clicking a paragraph, heading, list, fence, or table cell puts the caret exactly where you clicked, and only the edited range is written back through ctx.fs.writeText, optionally guarded by the version it read.
description.zh: 让右侧栏的 Markdown 预览就地可编辑：文档保持自带渲染器的排版，点段落、标题、列表、代码围栏或表格单元格时光标落在点击处，只有被编辑的那段经 ctx.fs.writeText 写回，并可带上读取时的版本作为护栏。

description.en: Group installed skills and manage MCP servers from a left-panel UI: filter the model skill catalog by enabled groups (union-deduped) and toggle MCP servers independently.
description.zh: 将已安装的技能分组管理、独立开关 MCP 服务器：按启用分组过滤模型可见的技能目录（并集去重），全部操作集中在左侧面板。

description.en: Adds a corner card that estimates how much a session spent repeating a failed or empty tool call with the same arguments.
description.zh: 在左下角显示这一场里，失败或空结果之后又用同一组参数重试花了多少钱。

description.en: Snipping tool for the composer: freeze the screen, drag a region, annotate it, and drop the result into the message box. Windows only; the selector is a bundled WinForms binary (rebuilt from the included C# source if missing) and uses the built-in .NET Framework 4.x.
description.zh: 输入框旁的截图标注工具：冻结屏幕、拖框选区、就地标注，完成后直接插入输入框。仅 Windows；选区器为内置 WinForms 程序（缺失时用随包的 C# 源码重建），依赖系统自带 .NET Framework 4.x。

description.en: Select text in any Windows app and read the translation in an always-on-top card next to the cursor: streaming text follows the newest line, up to 15000 characters per request. Windows only.
description.zh: 在任意 Windows 应用里划词，鼠标旁弹出只含译文的置顶卡片；译文流式出现并跟随最新一行，单次上限 15000 字。仅 Windows。

description.en: Adds a cross-workspace activity sidebar for running, waiting and unread sessions, with search, optional pinned and scheduled-delivery groups, local read tracking and confirmed archiving.
description.zh: 跨工作区聚合运行中、待回复和未读会话，支持搜索、可选的置顶与定时交付分组、插件本地已读记录，以及经确认的归档操作。

description.en: Local-first achievement collection for DeepSeek Harness. Normal use earns 67 stamped badges across 7 series, completes 9 voyage chapters holding 36 ocean collectibles, unlocks a configurable ASCII aquarium and exports a five-badge voyage card as PNG or offline HTML. No check-ins, no model calls, no chat uploads.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DeepSeek Harness 成就系统：正常使用即点亮 7 个系列共 67 枚印章徽章，完成 9 段航程并收集 36 件海洋收藏，解锁可配置的 ASCII 水族馆，还能把五枚珍藏导出为 PNG 航海名片或可离线游动的 HTML。无需打卡、不新增模型调用、不上传聊天内容。

description.en: Four-step WHOOP account connection (you create your own WHOOP developer app and paste its Client ID/Secret) with automatic sync on dashboard visits, plus recovery, strain, sleep and workout charts inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 四步连接 WHOOP 账号（需自行创建 WHOOP 开发者应用并填入 Client ID/Secret），打开看板即自动同步，在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看恢复、负荷、睡眠与训练图表。

description.en: Immersive read-only reading panel for DSH — the model delivers pre-formatted Markdown to a native right-sidebar tab via `reading_pad_send`, with three low-blue-light themes and 30em measure typography; also browse manuscript chapters read-only.
description.zh: DSH 沉浸式只读阅读板：模型用 `reading_pad_send` 把已排版 Markdown 推到原生右侧栏「📖 阅读板」tab，三套低蓝光主题、30em 限宽排版；也可只读浏览当前写作工程的章节。

description.en: Read books in the DSH sidebar - import EPUB/TXT/Markdown, get a five-part close reading for every chapter (paragraph summary, best sentences, what the author is doing, the AI's own opinion, what is missing), listen with TTS, ask questions while listening, and export the whole book to one HTML page. Export collects the chapters that already have a close reading rather than unread chapters.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏读书：导入 EPUB/TXT/Markdown，逐章给出五段式精读（本段落概括 / 文章美句 / 作者表达 / AI 观点 / AI 认为需要补充点），可朗读、边听边问，还能把整本讲解导出成一份网页。导出只装订已经生成精读的章节，未读章节不会包含在内。

description.en: Conversation node navigation rail for the DSH Web UI: one dash per user message on the right edge, reading-position tracking, hover preview card, click-to-jump with highlight line, sliding window, and auto-hide.
description.zh: 对话节点导航条：对话区右缘一列短横线节点对应每条用户消息，支持阅读位置跟踪、悬停预览卡片、点击跳转高亮、滑动窗口与自动隐藏。

description.en: Grouped skill picker for the composer. A button beside the input box opens a panel that browses every installed skill by scene (research, office, data, writing, media, dev), with auto-classification for new skills, Chinese annotations, search and drill-down; picking one inserts the /skill-name gesture.
description.zh: 输入框技能分组选择器：🧩按钮弹出按场景分组（科研、办公、数据、写作、媒体、开发）的技能面板，新装技能自动分类，中文说明、搜索与双层下钻，点选即插入 /技能名 手势。

description.en: Collapses each settled turn's process rows into one expandable disclosure in the DeepSeek Harness Web conversation while keeping the final answer visible.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话中已结束回合的过程行折叠成一个可展开的总结，同时保留最终答案可见。

description.en: Manage DSH MCP servers from the web settings panel: list, add, edit, remove, enable/disable with live status.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板管理 DSH 的 MCP 服务器：实时状态、新增、编辑、删除、启用/禁用。

description.en: Renders ```mermaid code blocks in DSH Web chat as SVG diagrams, with a diagram/source toggle, light/dark theme following and source-preserving error fallback.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话消息中的 mermaid 代码块渲染为 SVG 图形，支持图形与源码切换、跟随深浅色主题，渲染失败时保留源码并显示错误。

description.en: Custom sidebar workspace groups for DeepSeek Harness - group directories, drag to regroup and reorder, per-group session browsing and content search, with a one-click fallback to the official workspace list.
description.zh: 在侧边栏以自定义分组组织工作目录 - 拖拽变更分组与顺序、组内会话浏览与内容搜索，可一键切回官方工作区列表。

description.en: Markdown notepad in the right sidebar, side by side with the chat, with a formatting toolbar and local autosave.
description.zh: 右侧栏 Markdown 记事本，与聊天并排，带格式工具栏与本地自动保存。

description.en: Registers Mol* file viewers with dsh-better-sidebar for PDB, mmCIF, MRC maps, small molecules and Chimera .cmm markers, including .gz, with a BioViewer workspace tab and bio_open / bio_add tools.
description.zh: 向 dsh-better-sidebar 注册 Mol* 文件预览器，支持 PDB、mmCIF、MRC 密度图、小分子和 Chimera .cmm 标记（含 .gz），并提供 BioViewer 工作区标签以及 bio_open / bio_add 工具。

description.en: Adds a Compact context button and a New session button to the context meter panel; compact submits /compact through the same command channel, and new session starts a fresh session in the same workspace.
description.zh: 在上下文计量面板中添加「压缩上下文」与「新建会话」两个按钮：压缩按钮通过与手敲 /compact 相同的通道提交命令，新建会话按钮在同一 workspace 中开启新会话。

description.en: Windows floating status lamp outside the DSH window: a borderless always-on-top glowing orb on a fully transparent background — green with a breathing halo while tasks run, orange shaking for approval, blue floating for your input, dim grey idle, dark grey host offline; hovering lists each session's latest task, drag to move, and the lamp self-extinguishes within seconds when the plugin is switched off.
description.zh: 悬浮在 DSH 应用之外的 Windows 状态灯：无边框置顶发光圆灯，背景完全透明——绿灯光晕呼吸表示运行中、橙灯抖动待授权、蓝灯漂浮待你交互、灰灯空闲、暗灰宿主离线；悬停逐行列出各会话正在运行的任务，可拖动记忆位置，插件被关闭后数秒内自动熄灭。

description.en: Bottom multi-tab terminal panel (node-pty + xterm.js) pinned to the viewport bottom, always below the input box.
description.zh: 底部多标签终端面板（node-pty + xterm.js）：贴底全宽，输入框始终在终端上方。

description.en: Adds an Agent docs tab to the conversation view: it lists the AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md instruction files DSH actually loads for the current session (the ~/.dsh and ~/.agents roots, plus every directory from the project root to the working directory), previews each as Markdown with per-file sizes and the 64 KiB instruction budget, edits and saves them in place after a sha256 version check, and opens the workspace folder from the path button; a saved file takes effect on the next message.
description.zh: 在对话页签栏新增「智能体文档」页签：列出当前会话实际加载的 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.local.md / CLAUDE.local.md 指令文件（~/.dsh 与 ~/.agents 两个全局根，以及项目根到工作区的每一级目录），以 Markdown 预览并显示各文件大小与 64 KiB 指令预算，点「编辑」可就地改写、保存前做 sha256 内容冲突校验，点击工作区路径会在文件管理器中打开；保存后从下一条消息生效。

description.en: Renders model answers as interactive cards inside DeepSeek Harness chat, with 24 whitelisted components and persistent turn cards.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 对话里的回答渲染成可交互卡片，内置 24 个白名单组件和回合尾部持久卡片。

description.en: Panel hotkeys for the web UI: Enter presses the confirm action and Esc presses the cancel action on every interaction panel (approval, question, plan review).
description.zh: Web UI 面板快捷键：在审批、提问、计划审查等交互面板上，Enter 触发确认操作、Esc 触发取消操作。

description.en: Drag folders into the DeepSeek Harness web composer instead of hitting 'only the desktop app supports folders'. Adds a host folder dialog, /folder, and drag/paste into @path mentions. Plain browser, no desktop app.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版直接拖文件夹进输入框，不再提示「只有桌面端支持添加文件夹」。新增主机文件夹选择框、/folder 命令，拖入/粘贴自动解析为 @路径 引用。纯浏览器可用，无需桌面端。

description.en: Ctrl+wheel page zoom (60–180%, remembered) for the whole DSH UI, plus a bottom-right Settings entry that opens the host settings panel, with Ctrl+0 to reset.
description.zh: Ctrl+滚轮整页缩放（60%–180%，记住比例），右下角常驻「设置」入口可打开宿主设置面板，Ctrl+0 复位。

description.en: Customize the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut icon: pick a preset or upload an image, auto-remove the white backdrop, build a multi-size ICO, and write the shortcut in one click.
description.zh: 自定义 DeepSeek Harness 桌面快捷方式图标：选预设或上传图片，自动去除白底、生成多尺寸 ICO，一键写入桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Adds a removable quote banner above the web chat composer for text selected from an AI reply, included in the next message.
description.zh: 在网页聊天输入框上方为选中的 AI 回复内容添加可移除的引用横幅，随下一条消息一并发送。

description.en: A draggable floating clock for the DSH Web GUI with analog and digital faces, a focus timer, four themes, and persistent placement.
description.zh: 可拖动的 DSH 网页悬浮时钟：支持数字与指针表盘、专注计时、四套主题，并会记住窗口位置。

description.en: Side chat for the right dock: branches the current conversation into its own Session so follow-ups never derail the main thread. Reuses the product Conversation surface, so streaming, tool calls, Stop and the composer behave exactly like the main chat.
description.zh: 右侧栏辅助对话：把当前会话分支成独立 Session，追问不打断主线。直接复用产品自带的对话界面，流式输出、工具调用、Stop 与 composer 与主对话完全一致。

description.en: Replaces the native DSH reasoning-level option list in place with a draggable Off, Low, High, and Max slider while preserving the official model-selection flow.
description.zh: 在原位置将 DSH 原生推理等级选项替换为可拖动的 Off、Low、High、Max 滑块，并保留官方模型选择流程。

description.en: Right-click menu for the DSH workspace file tree: open a file, expand or collapse a folder, copy the absolute path, relative path or name, and reveal the item in the file manager.
description.zh: DSH 工作区文件树的右键菜单：打开文件、展开或折叠文件夹、复制绝对路径/相对路径/文件名，并在资源管理器中定位。

description.en: Publishes a project plan the agent writes: ordered steps in a panel docked to the right of the frame, and the framework graph as an auto-laid-out diagram in its own centre tab, downloadable as SVG or PNG. Charts are rebuilt from the session log, so they survive restart and resume.
description.zh: 把 agent 写出的项目规划显示出来：有序步骤在窗口右侧停靠的面板里，框架图在单独的中间标签页中自动排版，可下载为 SVG 或 PNG。图表由会话日志重建，重启与恢复后依然保留。

description.en: A liquid glass UI plugin for the DSH desktop app. Works alongside most wallpaper plugins. Currently supports dark mode only.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 桌面端的液态玻璃 UI 美化插件，可与大部分壁纸插件联动使用，目前仅适配深色模式。

description.en: Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three thmanyah cuts — Sans for the interface, Serif Text for reading, Serif Display for headings — placed behind whatever font the app itself is set to.
description.zh: 让 DSH 界面说阿拉伯语：混合阿拉伯文与英文的双向文本排版，通过 DSH 官方语言服务注册完整阿拉伯语界面包（3,307 条），并内置三款 thmanyah 字体（界面 Sans、正文 Serif Text、标题 Serif Display），置于应用自身字体设置之后。

description.en: Adds folders to a running DSH Web workspace from the Windows Explorer context menu and starts dsh web automatically when needed; the menu itself requires a one-time per-user PowerShell installer run from a repository clone (no admin rights).
description.zh: 从 Windows 资源管理器右键把文件夹加入正在运行的 DSH 网页版工作区，并在需要时自动启动 dsh web；右键菜单需先从仓库克隆运行一次按用户的 PowerShell 安装脚本（无需管理员权限）。

description.en: Git-style dot timeline on the right edge of the DSH web UI: one dot per user message, hover for content and metadata (time, turn, duration, TTFT, tokens), click to jump. Also adds a full-session message list, in-session and cross-session search, bookmarks with #msg= deep links, and keyboard navigation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的圆点时间轴：每条提问一个圆点，悬停查看内容与元信息（时间、轮次、耗时、TTFT、token），点击即跳转。附带全会话消息列表、站内与跨会话搜索、书签深链接（#msg=）和键盘导航。

plugins.name: dsh-manim-card

description.en: Adds a manim_card tool that renders Manim Python into a playable animation card in the chat stream; the code runs in the browser on a bundled runtime, so no local Python is needed, and video export goes through the local Manim CLI when installed or frame by frame in the browser otherwise.
description.zh: 新增 manim_card 工具，把 Manim Python 渲染为聊天流中可播放的动画卡片；代码经随包分发的运行时在浏览器内执行，本机无需安装 Python；导出视频时，本机装了 Manim 就走 CLI 渲染，否则在浏览器内逐帧导出。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to jspdf.default.namespaceuri

description.en: Reasoning translation for the DSH Web UI: template HTTP translation sites, or a model route through a Harness-registered provider or a custom OpenAI-compatible provider declared in the plugin.
description.zh: 把展开的思考内容翻成界面语言：翻译来源可以是任意 HTTP 站点模板，也可以是模型（DSH 已注册提供商，或插件自带的自定义 OpenAI 兼容提供商）。

description.en: Audible feedback for the DSH web interface: button presses are classified by semantics (normal, primary, toggle, send, close, danger, link) and the current session's task transitions (started, finished, failed) plus any pending interaction play a cue, each scenario with its own cue picker and switch on a settings page. All 78 cues and 12 sound packs are synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API, so the package ships no audio files and makes no network request. A community port of dsh-plugin-uisfx to DSH 0.2.0, with the ported changes recorded in PROVENANCE.md.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面补上可听的语义反馈：按钮按下按语义分类发声（普通、主要、开关、发送、关闭、危险、链接），当前会话的任务开始、成功结束、失败结束以及出现待处理交互也各有一声，每个情景都能在设置页单独挑音效、单独开关。78 个 cue 与 12 个音色包全部由浏览器用 Web Audio API 实时合成，因此包里不含音频文件、也不发起网络请求。这是 dsh-plugin-uisfx 向 DSH 0.2.0 的社区移植版，改动逐条记录在 PROVENANCE.md。

description.en: Embeds charts, comparison tables, and interactive blocks between answer paragraphs, with locally saved state and revision history.
description.zh: 在回答段落之间嵌入图表、比较表和交互块，支持本地状态保存与历史版本。

description.en: Prompt optimization, next-sentence prediction, inline completion, and per-session draft stashing for the DSH input box.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框提供提示词优化、下一句预测、输入续写与当前会话草稿暂存。

description.en: Optimize Prompt button under the composer: one click rewrites your draft into a clearer, more executable prompt, with a before-and-after dialog and one-click replacement.
description.zh: 输入框下方「优化提示词」按钮：一键把草稿重写为更清晰、更可执行的提示词，弹出前后对比，支持一键替换回输入框。

description.en: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

description.en: Suggests the next user reply in an empty composer after the assistant finishes, using the session model and rolling context summaries, with Tab to accept.
description.zh: 助手完成后，沿用会话模型与滚动上下文摘要，在空输入框中建议下一条用户回复，按 Tab 接受。

description.en: Adds a Trade Desk panel to the DSH sidebar for foreign-trade documents and container loading: quotation, PI/CI/PL/contract/customs documents, carton loading plans and a step-by-step loading animation. The existing offline single-file workbench is served same-origin inside the panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏增加外贸工作台入口，用于外贸单证与装柜计算：报价单、PI/CI/PL/合同/报关资料、装柜方案与逐层装柜动画。现有离线单文件工作台通过同源页面嵌入面板。

description.en: Adds a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a precise prompt in place, in one click, with a revert action.
description.zh: 在输入框加一个按钮，点一下就把草稿原地改写成精确提示词，可一键恢复原文。

description.en: Sidebar panel for the announcement file and the ticket status table. It lists the announcements together with how many sessions have seen each one, shows the delivery status, and lets the user post, edit and delete entries. Requires the third-party dsh-better-sidebar plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板：把公告和投递状态表放进 DSH 界面 —— 列出公告以及每条有几个会话见过，并让用户发布、编辑、删除条目。需要第三方插件 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Adds download actions to DSH delivery cards, changed-file review, and the document preview, and hides native open controls that cannot work when the Host is remote or headless. Needs DSH Web; the native open controls are hidden by default and can be restored per browser.
description.zh: 在交付卡片、变更审查和文档预览上增加下载按钮，并隐藏 Host 远程或无桌面时无法生效的原生打开控件。需 DSH Web；原生打开控件默认隐藏，可在浏览器里恢复。

description.en: Moves Settings out of the sidebar footer account menu into its own row at the top of the sidebar, hides the 新会话 new-session button, and hides the sidebar footer: the account launcher, the footer settings cell, and the plugin-runtime badge. Cmd/Ctrl+N still starts a session and Settings is still reachable.
description.zh: 把侧边栏「设置」从底部账号菜单移成顶部独立一行，隐藏「新会话」按钮，并隐藏侧边栏底部：账号菜单、底部设置单元与插件运行时条。Cmd/Ctrl+N 仍可新建会话，设置仍可打开。

description.en: Make F5, Ctrl+F5, and Ctrl+Shift+R reload the DeepSeek Harness page.
description.zh: 让 F5、Ctrl+F5 和 Ctrl+Shift+R 都能刷新 DeepSeek Harness 页面。

description.en: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

description.en: Browse the directories/files of the workspace in DeepSeek Harness Web GUI and display file changes in conjunction with Git.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中浏览工作区的目录/文件，并结合 Git 显示文件改动。

description.en: Live, bidirectional mind map for DSH Web built on Mind Elixir: the agent and the user edit the same tree in real time in a docked panel or fullscreen, with PNG export and open-in-desktop.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时双向思维导图：Agent 与用户共编同一棵树，改动即时互相同步，支持停靠分屏与全屏两种视图。

description.en: Adds a sidebar Restart button to DeepSeek Harness Desktop on Windows that stops the whole application process tree and reopens the app.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版侧边栏添加「重启」按钮：结束整个应用进程树并重新打开应用。

description.en: Interactive cards in replies, built from a fixed catalog of 31 components (sliders, inputs, sortable tables, charts, function plots, typeset formulas, tabs, checklists, flowcharts, quiz buttons, an animation player): controls recompute in the browser without another model call, and the model never writes HTML or JavaScript. Includes a calculus engine (integrals, derivatives, limits, sums, roots, Taylor polynomials) and a bundled skill that teaches the model when to use a card.
description.zh: 渐进式交互：回复里的可交互卡片，由 31 个固定组件搭成（滑块、输入框、可排序表格、图表、函数图像、公式排版、分页、勾选清单、流程图、答题按钮、动画播放器）。调节控件在浏览器内重算，不再调用模型；模型不写任何 HTML 或 JavaScript。内置微积分引擎（定积分、导数、极限、求和、求根、泰勒多项式）和一个教模型何时用卡片的技能。

description.en: Conversation Flow observability for DeepSeek Harness swarms, with topology, routed-message inspection, HITL pauses, Live follow, and child-session navigation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness swarm 的 Conversation Flow 可观测性，支持查看拓扑、检查路由消息、HITL 暂停、Live 跟随和子会话导航。

description.en: Tab autocomplete for the DeepSeek Harness desktop and web composer: next-message ghost text, inline draft completion, and Alt+Up/Alt+Down candidate cycling.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端与 Web 界面的输入框提供 Tab 自动补全：下一条消息的灰色幽灵文本、草稿行内续写，以及 Alt+Up/Alt+Down 切换候选。

description.en: Visual reference moodboard for DeepSeek Harness: drag-and-drop images with tags and notes, and pinned style guides the agent reads before it generates or restyles UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可视化参考情绪板：拖入图片并打标签、写备注，固定风格指南，智能体在生成或改版界面之前先读取这些参考。

description.en: Adds an Optimize prompt control next to the composer send button that rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (plain, sections, or role-task-goal) streamed from the session model, with Use, Undo, Copy and Close.
description.zh: 在输入框发送按钮旁加上「优化提示词」控件，用当前会话模型把草稿流式改写为结构化提示词（plain、sections、role-task-goal 三种风格），并提供使用、撤销、复制与关闭。

description.en: Colored status marks on DeepSeek Harness sidebar workspace rows — waiting for you, running, or recently finished — aggregated per workspace, plus a pinned-conversations section above the list and pinned-only notifications, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的工作区行上显示彩色状态标记（等待你处理、运行中、刚刚完成，按工作区聚合），并在列表上方提供已置顶会话区与仅针对置顶会话的通知，持久保存。

description.en: Quote board for A-shares, Hong Kong and US stocks, FX, Chinese and global commodity futures and indices, with watchlists, custom groups, auto-refresh and host-side persistence.
description.zh: A股、港股、美股、外汇、国内外商品期货与指数的行情看板，支持自选、自定义分组、自动刷新与宿主端持久化。

description.en: Select text in assistant replies, add optional comments, and send the annotations with the next message.
description.zh: 在助手回复中选中文字，添加可选评论，并将注释随下一条消息一起发送。

description.en: A composer control: shows the current model's context window, the tokens in use and a rough system / tools / messages breakdown, switches the model's reasoning effort in one click (writing reasoningEfforts into the model config when the provider declares none), and edits the model's contextWindow from the same panel so custom-provider models stop silently inheriting the adapter default. Makes no model calls; reads only the official session projections, model directory and config-forms services.
description.zh: 对话输入区控件：显示当前模型的上下文上限、已用 token 与「系统 / 工具 / 消息」三段启发式构成；一键切换思考等级（provider 未声明等级时会把 reasoningEfforts 写进该模型配置）；并可在同一面板里改写模型的 contextWindow，免去自定义 provider 的模型静默沿用适配器默认值。不发起模型调用，只读官方的 session 投影、模型目录与 config-forms 服务。

description.en: After each completed agent turn, a bounded auxiliary LLM call writes one suggested next prompt into the session log; the web composer renders it as ghost placeholder text, adopted via Tab.
description.zh: 每次完成的 agent 回合后，一次有界的辅助 LLM 调用把一条建议的下一句 prompt 写入会话日志；Web 输入框将其渲染为幽灵占位文字，按 Tab 采纳。

description.en: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.
description.zh: 在会话头部新增「目录」tab：把当前会话的用户消息整理成可点击的目录，自动翻页加载全部历史，点击即跳回对话并定位。

description.en: Cross-session TODO board as a draggable floating panel: tasks are grouped by working directory and reorderable by drag, each one carries a run mode (remind only, continue in the current session, or open a new session in the same directory), up to four attached images sent to the model as real image attachments, and an optional local time it may run at; two checkboxes track AI-done and user-verified, and the agent picks up the next unfinished task in that directory when it finishes one.
description.zh: 跨会话 TODO 板：可拖动浮窗按工作目录分组、拖拽排序，每条待办带一个执行模式（仅提醒 / 在当前会话续跑 / 在同目录新开会话）、可附最多 4 张图片（派发时作为真正的图片附件发给模型）、以及一个可选的定时执行时间；两个勾选框分别记录 AI 已完成与用户已验收，AI 完成一项后自动接续该目录下一条未完成待办。

description.en: Adds a pin button to the DSH Desktop title bar that toggles always-on-top for the main window. Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 标题栏加一枚图钉，一键切换主窗口置顶。仅 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Tab to toggle plan mode on/off.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框中按 Tab 键开/关 plan 模式。

description.en: Live change review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session, lists changed files above the composer and opens each file's line-level diff in a plugin-registered right-sidebar tab, with session-log / initial-version / Git comparison modes, per-change and per-file revert, subagent aggregation and SSE updates. A fork of cirelir/dsh-change-review rebuilt around the right sidebar.
description.zh: 实时审查插件：追踪会话内 write/edit 工具调用，改动列表常驻输入框上方，点开即在插件自注册的右侧栏标签页里查看行级 diff，支持「会话记录 / 初始版本 / Git 版本」三种对比、单项与整文件撤回、子代理聚合与 SSE 实时刷新，配色可自定义；fork 自 cirelir/dsh-change-review，审查界面整体重构到右侧栏。

description.en: Quote earlier content of the current session into the composer: select text in any message for a Quote pill, or type @ to pick a whole message; the quote travels as a native reference chip and is serialized into the prompt as a blockquote. Client-only, no host routes, no custom session events.
description.zh: 把本会话里更早的内容引用进输入框：在任意消息里划选文字出现"引用"按钮，或输入 @ 选择整条消息；引用以原生 chip 形式存在，发送时序列化为引用块进入 prompt。纯客户端，无宿主路由，无自定义会话事件。

description.en: Adds an ✦ button to the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt in the same language, with one click to restore the original, plus an enhance_prompt tool the agent can call; the rewrite replaces the draft and is never sent automatically.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁加一个「✦ 增强」按钮：把当前草稿改写成更清晰、更具体的提示词（保持输入语言），一键恢复原文，并为 agent 提供 enhance_prompt 工具；改写结果只替换草稿，不会自动发送。

description.en: Adds a chevron row under New Session that folds the sidebar panel list in place, returning the height to the workspace and session list. The hiding is driven by one attribute on the page root plus CSS: no host bundle is patched and no row is unregistered, and plugin entries injected outside the panel slot fold too because they are matched by their own data attributes. The state is remembered per browser and the control hides itself in the 56px rail.
description.zh: 在侧边栏「新会话」下方加一行箭头开关，就地折叠面板列表，把高度还给工作区和会话列表。隐藏由一个页面根属性加纯 CSS 驱动：不打宿主补丁、不注销任何条目；插件注入在面板槽位之外的入口，也按各自的 data 属性一并折叠。状态按浏览器记忆，56px 窄栏下开关自动隐藏。

description.en: Codex-style text annotation for conversations: select text, add a quote with your comment, inject it into the composer, and expand sent annotations as a pill.
description.zh: Codex 风格对话文字批注：选中原文加注释、引用进对话、发送后以「N 条注释」胶囊展开。

description.en: Codex-style @file/@folder mentions for the DSH web composer: workspace file/folder picker menu, plain-text colored mention tokens via the platform lexicon scan, and a nested-git-aware file index.
description.zh: Codex 式 @文件/@文件夹提及插件：输入框弹出工作区文件与文件夹选择菜单，通过平台词法扫描插入纯文本着色提及 token，内置嵌套 git 感知的文件索引。

description.en: Input history switcher for the DSH composer that locally persists every submitted prompt (text plus attachments, max 50) and re-fills the empty composer with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, re-attaching file references and image previews.
description.zh: DSH 输入框历史记录切换器：本地保存每条已提交的提示词（含附件，最多 50 条），空输入框时用上下方向键召回，并自动恢复文件引用与图片预览。

description.en: Select English text in the conversation or the sidebar file preview to translate it in place — single words get a dictionary entry with IPA, part-of-speech senses, web meanings and pronunciation, while sentences use machine translation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的对话或侧栏文件预览里选中英文就地翻译——单词出词典条目（英/美音标、按词性分组的释义、网络释义、真人发音），句子走机器翻译。

description.en: Adds custom icons to the DSH Settings sidebar and exposes a keyed `settings.section.icon` slot for third-party settings sections.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置侧边栏添加自定义图标，并开放 keyed `settings.section.icon` 槽位供第三方设置分区注册图标。

description.en: Development-preview A2UI v0.9/v0.9.1 conversation surfaces using official schemas and renderer, session-scoped form actions and non-executing history replay; verified only in bounded synthetic DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 workflows.
description.zh: A2UI v0.9/v0.9.1 对话界面开发预览，使用官方 schema 与渲染器，提供会话内表单动作及不重放动作的历史恢复；仅在 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的有界合成流程中验证。

description.en: Codex-style right-edge workspace for the dsh web UI: file tree with preview tabs (Markdown/source), an embedded browser (direct/proxy iframe), and a side chat streaming from the host LLM — all as switchable tabs in the native details column.
description.zh: Codex 式右侧工作区：文件树 + 预览页签（Markdown/源码）、嵌入式浏览器（直连/代理 iframe）、侧边聊天（直连 host LLM 流式对话），全部收敛为原生 details 右栏的页签，可开关多开。

description.en: Draws the sidebar navigation as a compact two-column grid at every viewport; on narrow, short or coarse-pointer screens it additionally caps the navigation at 34vh with scrolling so the workspace and session history keep a 38vh floor. Also repairs dsh-resource:// records whose protocol the browser URL parser reports as empty.
description.zh: 把侧栏导航在所有视口下都重画成紧凑双列网格；窄屏、矮窗口或粗指针设备上再加一层限制——导航最高 34vh 并允许滚动，给工作区与会话历史留出 38vh 下限。同时修复浏览器把 dsh-resource:// 记录协议判空导致的资源不可用。

description.en: Rewrites the New Session hero headline with a short greeting written by the model the session already uses, from the local time, the current city and the live weather; falls back to a local time-based greeting when no model is reachable.
description.zh: 用新会话已选定的模型，按当地时间、城市与实时天气写一句简短问候，替换首屏标题；没有可用模型时退回本地按小时计算的问候。

description.en: Hide chosen workspaces from the DSH sidebar and archive their sessions along with them, so those sessions never spill into the ungrouped list. Fully local and reversible; with dsh-archive-manager installed the archiving is real and undoable, otherwise it stays a display-only layer. Restore any hidden workspace from Settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏隐藏指定工作区，并把它的会话一并归档，避免这些会话溢出到「未分组」列表。纯本地、完全可逆；装了 dsh-archive-manager 时执行真归档且可撤销，未装时退化为纯显示层。随时可在设置页恢复。

description.en: Sidebar panel that embeds chat.deepseek.com full-width in the DSH main area (desktop shell only), restores the last conversation, and keeps a crashed embedded page inside the panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏加入 DeepSeek 聊天入口，主内容区全宽内嵌 chat.deepseek.com（仅桌面版），恢复上次会话，并把内嵌页崩溃限制在面板内。

description.en: Direct web search button and /search slash command plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的直接联网搜索按钮与 /search 斜杠命令插件。

description.en: Adds text selection annotation tools and annotation chips to the dsh web composer.
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 输入框增加选中文字标注工具和标注 chip。

description.en: Tick which models appear in the DSH model selector, and fold provider groups in the settings panel.
description.zh: 在设置里逐个勾选要显示的模型，未勾选的从模型选择器菜单中隐藏；provider 分组可在设置面板中折叠。

description.en: A draggable whale-maid physics widget for the DSH Web UI: throw it around, catch token coins, and eat rice bowls.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的「鲸鱼女仆」物理挂件：拖拽投掷、吃 token 币计分、每满 500 个 token 冒一碗白饭。

description.en: Select foreign text in a DSH conversation and a Simplified Chinese translation card appears right below the selection.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用鼠标选中外文，选区正下方就地浮出简体中文译文卡片。

description.en: Adds a custom right-click context menu to the sidebar workspace files tree, with new folder, rename, reveal in file manager, open in browser, open in VS Code, copy path, streaming ZIP download, and delete.
description.zh: 为侧边栏「工作区文件」树添加自定义右键菜单：新建文件夹、重命名、在文件管理器中显示、浏览器打开、VS Code 打开、复制路径、流式 ZIP 下载、删除。

description.en: Region screenshot tool with annotations, a magnifier colour picker and clipboard output, following the DSH UI language. Windows only.
description.zh: 区域截图工具，支持标注、放大器取色与剪贴板输出，并跟随 DSH 界面语言。仅限 Windows。

description.en: Compact interface with borderless messages, a light queue, composer controls, and adjustable corners. Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; while enabled it replaces the stock sidebar module, and removing it restores the original.
description.zh: 紧凑界面：无边框消息、轻量队列、输入区控制，以及可调圆角。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；启用期间会替换官方侧栏模块，移除后恢复原样。

description.en: Two icon buttons in the top-left corner of the DSH header — reload the UI (a full reload when the client-plugin manifest is still valid, an in-place re-sync when it is stale, so no blank page) and restart the app (on the desktop app it closes the shell and relaunches itself; on dsh web it ends the kernel process for your own supervisor to bring back).
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面左上角放两个图标按钮：刷新界面（清单有效就整页重载，过期就地重同步客户端插件，不出白屏）与重启应用（桌面端关掉界面壳后自动重开；dsh web 下结束内核进程，重开交给你自己的启动方式）。

description.en: File upload with color-coded attachment cards (session-isolated storage, sha256 dedup, TTL sweep) plus a content-sniffing read_document tool for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT.
description.zh: 文件上传（彩色附件卡片、会话隔离存储、sha256 去重、TTL 清扫）+ 内容嗅探的 read_document 文档读取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）。

description.en: The dock-base Workbench adapter for the DSH Quick Control panel. The panel core ships separately as `dsh-flash`; this package is what mounts it into dock-base — sidebar/floating panel, activity-bar ⚡, editor view and the dock-flash:openQuickControl command. Requires dock-base; a broken install fails loudly instead of silently doing nothing.
description.zh: DSH 快捷控制面板的 dock-base 工作台适配器。面板本体（开关注册表、皮肤系统、i18n、告警面、host 路由）由 `dsh-flash` 核心单独提供；本包只负责把它挂进 dock-base：侧栏/浮动面板、活动栏 ⚡、编辑器视图与 dock-flash:openQuickControl 命令。需安装 dock-base；装错时会明确报错而不是静默失效。

description.en: The Quick Control panel core for DSH Web: a standalone floating shortcut panel whose switches other plugins register through the quickControl service, with the skin system and zh/en i18n. The dock-base Workbench integration ships separately as the dock-flash adapter.
description.zh: DSH Web 快捷控制面板核心：可独立浮动的快捷面板，开关项由其它插件通过 quickControl 服务注册，内置皮肤系统与中英文 i18n；dock-base 工作台集成由 dock-flash 适配器单独提供。

description.en: Mobile adapter for the DSH web shell: overlay sidebar/details drawers, responsive composer and settings below 768px, zero desktop regression.
description.zh: DSH Web 移动端适配插件：侧边栏/详情抽屉浮层化、输入栏与设置页响应式适配，桌面零回归。

description.en: Heap-allocated stack-safe fork tree with two-track indentation, title marquee, and physical cascade purge.
description.zh: 非递归显式栈侧边栏分支树，支持双轨缩进解耦、平滑跑马灯与物理级联删除事务。

description.en: Configurable chat auto-scroll — paced section-by-section reading with size-proportional pauses, smooth follow, step and hold modes, hotkeys, and per-session open positions.
description.zh: 可配置的聊天自动滚动——按节定速阅读（停顿时长与篇幅成比例）、平滑跟随、单步与固定模式，支持快捷键与按会话记忆打开位置。

description.en: Comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing trail glides to the text position, with configurable accent color, thickness, trail, and a 500 ms idle blink. Extends the surface to ask-question card inputs, and fixes the caret vanishing on an empty composer or first focus, forward drag-selection not following the pointer, soft line breaks measuring against the previous line, and the caret painting outside the composer when long input scrolls. Maintained fork of Lacquervii/smooth-cursor.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的彗星光标：发光拖尾随文字位置平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细、拖尾，并在静止 500ms 后呼吸。覆盖 ask-question 交互卡片的输入框，并修复空输入框或首次聚焦时光标消失、正向拖选不跟随鼠标、软换行按上一行测量、长内容滚动时光标绘制到输入框之外等问题。Lacquervii/smooth-cursor 的维护分支。

description.en: Un-clamps the composer stats footer: long turn and token stats lines span the full composer width instead of truncating with an ellipsis.
description.zh: 解除输入框统计行的宽度限制：较长的轮次与 token 统计行横跨输入框全宽居中显示，不再以省略号截断。

description.en: Session board in the left sidebar: every chat session's current work, todos and progress, with a searchable overview heatmap and one-click navigation back to the session.
description.zh: 在左侧栏提供会话看板：集中展示每个会话的当前工作、待办与进度，附带可搜索的概览热力图，点击卡片即可跳回会话。

description.en: Adds an installed-plugin group to the @ menu, split into System and User, groups session mentions by folder, and gives section headers sticky positioning, row counts, and fold controls.
description.zh: 在 @ 菜单里增加已安装插件（系统 / 用户分组），会话按所在文件夹归类，分组标题吸顶、显示行数、可折叠。

description.en: Adds an installed-plugin picker beside the composer: drag a plugin name into the prompt at the drop point, open a draggable plugin rail in the right sidebar by double-clicking the entry, and choose which plugins (and remarks) appear in Settings.
description.zh: 在输入框旁增加已安装插件选择器：把插件名拖到提示词的落点插入，双击入口在右侧边栏打开可拖动插件栏，并可在设置中选择显示哪些插件、填写备注。

description.en: Switches every session's thinking and answers to Chinese — terse, a little wry, plain-spoken — while keeping proper nouns in English, and adds an "answer only what was asked" interaction rule. One global system-prompt section (order 10): no UI, no binaries, no network calls. Inactive under the minimal preset, which replaces the whole prompt with its own persona.
description.zh: 让所有会话的思考与回复都说中文：简洁、略沾文言、说人话，专有名词保留英文原形；并附一条「只答所问、不主动跑命令、动手前先提醒」的交互偏好。实现只是一条全局 system-prompt 段落（order 10）：没有界面、没有二进制、不联网。切到极简预设时不生效——那个预设会把整个 prompt 换成它自己的人设。

description.en: A Workspaces-native Recent sessions section for the DSH left sidebar: favorites, running, waiting-for-you and unread sessions at a glance, with a one-click ☆ on every session row, one-line collapse and in-section search. It takes over the sidebar shell (the shipped sidebar package is disabled) and renders the official workspace/session browser inside it; its recent-sessions panel id conflicts with huangxp12/whybebabo, so do not install them together.
description.zh: 像官方「工作区」一样融入左侧栏的「最近会话」分区：收藏、运行中、等待你的回应、完成未读、最近活跃一屏直达；每个会话行 ☆ 一键收藏，可收起到一行、支持就地搜索。它会接管侧栏外壳（禁用官方侧栏包）并在其中原样渲染官方工作区/会话浏览区；其 recent-sessions 面板 id 与 huangxp12/whybebabo 冲突，不要同装。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine local library, background layer, native Scene panel, and desktop-mode controls for the DSH desktop shell.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 桌面壳的 Wallpaper Engine 本地库、背景层、原生 Scene 面板与桌面模式控件。

description.en: Enhances the DSH Web GUI file tree with inline sizes and modification dates, plus a right-click menu for download, upload, and copy-path actions.
description.zh: 增强 DSH Web GUI 的文件树：行内显示大小与修改时间，右键菜单支持下载、上传、复制路径。

description.en: Codex-style sidebar: a pinned band for projects and conversations, collapsible 置顶/项目/组件 sections, a bell activity view of recently used conversations, and per-project emoji icons.
description.zh: Codex 风格侧边栏：项目和对话共用的置顶区、置顶/项目/组件 三段可折叠分区、小铃铛活动视图（含最后一条回答的预览）、可为每个项目换 Emoji 图标。

plugins.name: dsh-vscode-workbench

description.en: VS Code-style local workbench for DSH with a file explorer, Monaco editor, full-text search and a Git panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 VS Code 风格的本地工作台，含文件资源管理器、Monaco 编辑器、全文搜索与 Git 面板。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Right-Sidebar tab menu enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: adds a 'Close other tabs' item that closes every content tab of the session except the one whose menu is open and the docked guide.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏增强：右键 tab 菜单增加「关闭其他标签」，一键关闭当前会话中除当前 tab 与引导页外的所有内容标签。

description.en: Session-scoped @file/@folder mentions in the composer with Git-aware indexing, drag-drop and paste managed uploads, and validated path markers.
description.zh: 输入框内 session 范围的 @文件/@文件夹提及：Git 感知索引、拖放与粘贴受管上传、经校验的路径标记。

description.en: Restart button for DSH Desktop placed directly above the sidebar account button.
description.zh: 用于重启 DSH 桌面的按钮，直接放在侧边栏账号按钮上方。

description.en: Browser-side preset visibility and ordering controls for the new-session page.
description.zh: 在新会话页控制 Agent 预设的显示与排序。

description.en: After each reply, shows a gray next-prompt suggestion in the empty composer that Tab or → accepts; in an empty composer, ↑ / ↓ browse the messages you sent in the session. Settings can be changed on the Plugins page; nothing is sent automatically.
description.zh: 回答结束后在空输入框里显示一条灰色的下一句建议，按 Tab 或 → 采纳；空输入框按 ↑ / ↓ 翻看本会话发送过的内容；可在插件页直接修改设置；不会自动发送。

description.en: Adds two enhancements to DSH ask_user_question choice cards: right-clicking an option expands a per-option note that is merged into the submitted custom answer, and a footer field asks a side question answered by a fork subagent from the session context, read-only, with no write-back. Keeps left-click, skip, paging and the countdown working as before, and only claims generic choice cards, not plan review or approval cards. Supports DSH 0.2.x from 0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.2-rc.1) and Node.js 20+. Derived from buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note (MIT) and inspired by MichengAI/dsh-btw (Apache-2.0); do not install it together with dsh-question-note — both take over the same ask_user_question card.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 ask_user_question 选择题卡片增加两项能力：右键选项展开补充说明，并合并进提交的 custom 答案；卡片底部可以先问一句，由 fork 子代理带着当前会话上下文只读作答，不改写会话。左键选择、跳过、分页与倒计时照旧，且只接管普通选择题卡片，不接管计划确认与审批卡片。适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上的 0.2.x（已在 0.2.2-rc.1 验证），需 Node.js 20+。由 buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note（MIT）派生、并受 MichengAI/dsh-btw（Apache-2.0）启发；不要与 dsh-question-note 同装——两者会接管同一张 ask_user_question 卡片。

description.en: Adds custom ordering and tucking away to seven strips of buttons and cards in DSH (the left sidebar, sidebar footer, conversation tabs, composer dock, session header icon strip, right sidebar and settings navigation), plus per-area drag switches and JSON layout import/export. Tucked rows land in the built-in More menu of that region and can be dragged back out.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的七处按钮与卡片区域（左侧边栏、侧栏底部、对话标签、输入框工具条、会话头部图标条、右侧栏、设置导航）提供自定义排序与收纳，并支持分区拖动开关和布局 JSON 导入/导出；收纳项会进入该区域内置的「更多」菜单，可随时拖回。

description.en: Right-click menus for DSH sidebar rows: on DSH 0.2.2+ both rows use the host menus — workspace rows follow the session grouping (new session, copy path and reveal, pinned open-with apps, an open-with submenu, bulk delete) and session rows extend the menu that opens at the pointer with pinned open-with apps, an open-with submenu and permanent deletion of archived sessions; entries stay in the right-click menu by default and can be opted one by one into the shared "…" menu. On 0.2.1 the workspace menu is drawn by the plugin. Adapted from miao-ge/dsh-sidebar-context-menu and 0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu; do not install it alongside either - all of them attach right-click menus to the same sidebar rows.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏行右键菜单：在 DSH 0.2.2 及以上，两类行用的都是宿主菜单——工作区行按会话菜单的分组排入新建会话、复制路径与在文件夹显示、置顶打开方式、打开方式子菜单与批量删除；会话行在指针处展开菜单，并追加置顶打开方式、打开方式子菜单以及已归档会话的永久删除。条目默认只出现在右键菜单，可在设置里逐项开启「同时放进「…」菜单」；0.2.1 上工作区菜单由插件自绘。 改编自 miao-ge/dsh-sidebar-context-menu 与 0imzero/dsh-workspace-menu，请勿与它们同时安装——三者都会给同一批侧边栏行挂右键菜单。

description.en: Full-screen terminal client for DeepSeek Harness built on pi-tui: session replay/resume, streaming responses, collapsible tool cards, in-terminal approvals and questions, model/preset/permission/plan/goal management, shell mode, and a trajectory ledger.
description.zh: 基于 pi-tui 的 DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端客户端：会话回放/续接、流式响应、可折叠工具卡片、终端内审批与提问、模型/预设/权限/计划/目标管理、Shell 模式，以及轨迹（trajectory）事件台账。

description.en: Inline visualizer for DSH: the model loads a design contract first, then renders an SVG or a sandboxed HTML card in place inside the conversation, with light/dark tokens and a source/download toggle.
description.zh: 对话内联可视化：模型先按需加载设计契约，再把 SVG 或沙箱 HTML 卡片就地渲染在对话里，支持深浅色令牌与源码/下载切换。

description.en: Interactive topic graph for DSH session history: groups questions into topics, drills into per-topic Q&A timelines, supports semantic regrouping, and exports HTML, SVG, and Bluepin vaults.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话历史整理成可下钻的专题/问题图谱，支持语义整理，并可导出 HTML、SVG 和 Bluepin vault。

description.en: Replaces the composer's model and reasoning-effort selector with a two-level menu and six slider skins.
description.zh: 把输入框右下角的模型 / 推理等级选择器换成两级菜单，并提供六种滑杆视觉。

plugins.name: dsh-jot

description.en: Adds a human-editable notes workspace with folders, full-text search, rich text, checklists, resizable tables, attachments, exports, and opt-in agent collaboration.
description.zh: 提供可直接编辑的笔记空间，支持文件夹、全文搜索、富文本、核对清单、可调整列宽的表格、附件、导出和可选的 Agent 协作。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.aiim.org

description.en: One plugin for DeepSeek Harness with durable autonomous loops, sidebar GitHub discovery, AI-assisted installation, and workspace shortcuts.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：提供持久自主循环、侧边栏 GitHub 插件发现、AI 安装和工作区快捷入口。

description.en: Live decode speed (tok/s) pill in the composer status bar that tracks the currently streaming response.
description.zh: 在输入栏状态栏中实时显示当前流式响应解码速度（tok/s）的插件。

plugins.name: dsh-side-assistant

description.en: A right-sidebar assistant that knows the main session's finished turns, follows the main agent's running steps and background jobs, and answers in the panel; its model, context budget and answer style are configurable.
description.zh: 侧边栏助手：知道主会话已完成的回合，跟随主 Agent 正在跑的步骤与后台 job，在面板里回答问题；模型、上下文预算与回答风格可配置。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Quote selected conversation text into the Web composer as native reference chips for focused follow-up turns.
description.zh: 在网页会话中划选文本，以原生引用 chip 插入输入框，进行针对性追问。

description.en: Compact top tools, untitled inbox and lower Working/Settled shelves; native menus, search highlighting, keyboard navigation, metadata backups and an original-layout switch. Chinese UI. On DSH 0.2.1-rc.5: macOS Desktop verified; Windows Desktop checked for cold starts, compact/original layouts at 1280x820 and 1471x1200, search, project filtering and native session menus. Linux and arbitrary third-party plugin combinations remain unverified.
description.zh: 顶部工具区与原布局切换，上方直接查看会话，下方收纳工作中与已整理；支持原生菜单、搜索高亮、键盘操作及整理备份。中文界面。DSH 0.2.1-rc.5：macOS 桌面版已验证；Windows 桌面版已检查冷启动、1280×820 与 1471×1200 下的紧凑/原布局、搜索、项目筛选和原生会话菜单。Linux 及任意第三方插件组合仍未验证。

description.en: Audio/video FileViewer for dsh-better-sidebar: native inline playback for mp4/webm/mkv/mov and mp3/flac/wav, served by a Range-capable streaming media route.
description.zh: better-sidebar 音视频预览器：原生播放器内联播放 mp4/webm/mkv/mov 等视频与 mp3/flac/wav 等音频，自带支持 HTTP Range 拖动的流式媒体路由。

description.en: VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.
description.zh: VS Code 式工作区关键词搜索 Tab（better-sidebar 扩展）：同时匹配文件名与文件内容，结果按文件分组带行号，点击在侧栏编辑器打开。

description.en: Floating DeepSeek API time-of-day pricing window with Chinese legal-holiday awareness, account balance and estimated project spend; includes a green/orange 24-hour timeline and collapsible model, billing-rule and holiday sections.
description.zh: DeepSeek API 时段价格悬浮窗，联网读取中国法定节假日，显示账户余额与本项目花费估算；含绿/橙 24 小时时间轴和可折叠的模型、计费规则、节假日区块。

description.en: Select text in the chat transcript, right-click, and quote it into the composer. The quote travels as an atomic chip and renders as a collapsible card, while the model receives the full block with message role, turn, block index and character range.
description.zh: 在对话里框选文字后右键引用：引用以原子标签进入输入框，发送后显示为可折叠的引用卡；模型拿到的始终是带消息角色、轮次、段落与字符区间的完整引用块。

description.en: Model picker for the DSH web composer that replaces the model seat: a search-first popup whose left column indexes the suppliers and scrolls the grouped list, with a favorites group pinned at the top, image icons separating native from bridged vision input, and a reasoning-effort panel opened from the right zone of the trigger.
description.zh: 顶替 DSH Web 编辑器模型座位的模型选择器：检索优先的弹层，左栏是供应商索引、点击滚动右侧分组列表，收藏组固定在首位，用图片图标区分原生与桥接的视觉输入，点触发器右区单独打开推理档位面板。

description.en: Adds a 最近 (Recent) section below the workspace list in the DSH web sidebar that flattens the newest sessions of every workspace into one timeline, reusing the session rows and hover cards the shell already renders, paging in earlier sessions as you scroll, and folding the workspace list itself to the five folders with the newest history. Requires DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏的工作区列表下面加一个「最近」区块，把所有工作区的最新会话平铺成一条时间线，行与悬停卡片复用外壳自己渲染的会话行，滚到底继续加载更早的会话；同时把工作区列表本身折叠为最近有记录的 5 个文件夹。需要 DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1。

description.en: Display-layer text replacement for DSH chat messages: rewrite how any configured text appears on screen without touching the real conversation, with per-rule whole-word matching and code-block protection.
description.zh: 显示层文本替换：自定义消息中任意文本的界面显示而不改动真实对话，支持逐条整词匹配、长词优先与代码块保护。

description.en: Word auto-completion in the Web composer: prefix-matched suggestions sorted by closeness, arrow-key selection and Enter to confirm.
description.zh: 输入框词自动补全：按前缀匹配与接近程度排序弹出当前会话词建议，↑/↓ 选择、回车确认。

description.en: A chip at the left end of the composer tool row showing whether DeepSeek bills at peak or off-peak right now. Clicking it opens a card with the current state and rate, the next switch with a countdown, and why this instant is in that state: a weekend, a named statutory holiday, a 调休 make-up workday, or simply outside the peak windows. Times are resolved in Beijing time with an explicit UTC offset, so the verdict does not depend on the machine clock; a hard-coded 2026 Chinese holiday table carries the 33 holiday days and the six 调休 workdays, and a year beyond the table says so instead of guessing.
description.zh: 输入框工具行左端的小胶囊：点一下就知道此刻 DeepSeek 按高峰价还是空闲价计费。点开是当前状态与计费方式、下次切换时间与倒计时，以及此刻为什么是这个状态：周末、具名的法定节假日、调休上班日，或者只是不在高峰时段内。判定用北京时间并显式写死 UTC 偏移，不看本机时钟；内置 2026 年中国法定节假日表（33 天节假日、6 个调休上班日），表外的年份直接说不知道，不猜。

description.en: Adds an "Open folder" item to the session-row ⋯ menu in the DSH workspace sidebar, opening the session's workspace folder with the host OS file manager.
description.zh: 在工作区侧边栏的会话行 ⋯ 菜单中增加「打开文件夹」项，用系统文件管理器打开该会话所属工作区的文件夹。

description.en: Skips offscreen chat and trajectory rows so long sessions scroll smoothly; measured row heights keep the scrollbar steady, visible content unchanged.
description.zh: 让视口外的聊天行与轨迹行不参与渲染，长会话滚动更稳；行高按实测保留，滚动条不跳，屏幕内画面不变。

description.en: Local hardware monitor for DSH: a sidebar dashboard, a composer-dock CPU/memory/GPU/temperature widget, and a hardware_monitor_status tool backed by a local Python service installed separately from the repository root with install-dsh.ps1 (Windows, Python 3.10); installing only the DSH plugin leaves the panel and tool offline.
description.zh: DSH 本机硬件监控插件：侧边栏完整面板、输入框下方的 CPU/内存/GPU/温度挂件，以及 hardware_monitor_status 工具。数据来自另装的本地 Python 服务：需在仓库根用 install-dsh.ps1 安装（Windows、Python 3.10）；只装 DSH 插件时面板与工具均不可用。

description.en: Mobile UI for the Web GUI on narrow screens: full-width responsive layout, overlay session drawer, 44px touch targets, safe-area support, and reading enhancements with zero desktop impact.
description.zh: Web GUI 移动端适配：窄屏全宽响应式布局、会话抽屉、44px 触摸目标、安全区适配与阅读增强，桌面端零影响。

plugins.name: dsh-model-visibility

description.en: Manage which models appear in the composer model menu. A settings page lists every provider's models with a per-model switch, provider-level show/hide, collapsible groups and filters by kind; switched-off models leave the menu while the model in use in the current session stays. The list can be searched by name or ID and filtered by capability (multimodal, reasoning) and by minimum context window (128K / 256K / 512K / 1M). Rows show the model kind, and chat models also show reasoning support with the adapter's effort levels, their context window and input modalities. Labels merge manual overrides, the settings document, the adapter, the relay's GET /models response, a built-in pi-ai / models.dev catalog, name inference and vendor corrections in that priority order, with the source named on hover and dashed borders marking inferred values. Any model can be edited by hand (kind, context window, modalities, effort levels); those edits are stored outside the profile and can be written back into the model provider's settings. A hard re-fetch drops every cache and asks the adapter and all relays again. A switch, on by default, lets relay routes whose models declare text-only input accept images in memory, without editing configuration files. The hidden list is stored in the profile patch and mirrored to $DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 管理哪些模型出现在输入框的模型菜单里。设置页按 Provider 列出模型，支持逐模型开关、渠道级批量显隐、整组折叠和按类型筛选；关闭的模型从菜单中消失，当前会话正在使用的模型保留。还能按名称 / ID 搜索，按能力（多模态、支持推理）和上下文下限（128K / 256K / 512K / 1M）过滤。每行标注模型类型，对话模型另外标注是否支持推理、适配器公布的思考强度档位、上下文窗口和输入模态。标签按优先级合并手动覆盖、设置文档、适配器、中转站 GET /models 响应、内置 pi-ai / models.dev 目录、模型名推断和厂商校正，悬停显示来源，虚线边框表示推断值。任意模型都可以手动指定类型、上下文窗口、输入模态和思考强度档位；这些覆盖不写 profile 补丁，并且可以写回模型提供商的设置。工具栏的「重新获取能力」会让全部缓存作废并重新询问适配器与所有中转站。一个默认开启的开关让声明纯文本输入的中转站模型真正能接收图片，只在内存里生效，不改配置文件。隐藏列表保存在 profile patch 中，并镜像到 $DSH_HOME。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-valley-meter

description.en: Peak-Valley Meter (峰谷电表) — a tiny DeepSeek usage companion: a minimal two-part balance chip above the composer (currency symbol + number, nothing else), official balance refreshed every 5s; click the symbol to open the official top-up page in a new tab; hovering the chip fades in a circular backdrop under the symbol, its left arc flush with the chip's own left edge, and expands a 24h peak/valley timeline (orange=peak, blue=valley, glowing marker at the current local time) so off-peak hours are obvious; independent today-spend metering; a settings panel with 10 muted color presets plus custom valley/peak colors, detailed/minimal styles and readout toggles; all-Chinese UI.
description.zh: 峰谷电表——DeepSeek 用量小助手：输入框上方一枚极简余额徽章，框内只有「货币符号 + 余额数字」两组，官方余额每 5 秒实时刷新；点击符号即在新页签打开官方充值页；光标移入徽章时，符号身下浮现一枚圆形底色（左弧与徽章左端圆角完全重合），并展开 24 小时峰谷时间轴（橙=峰时、蓝=谷时、白色发光指针标当前本地时刻），谷时省钱时段一目了然；今日消耗独立计费；设置面板提供 10 套沉稳配色预置与谷/峰色自定义、详细/极简样式与各项读数开关；全中文界面。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Turns one plain-language request into a live workbench window: a sidebar panel asks a few clarifying questions, the model writes a single-file HTML artifact, and the plugin mounts it in a resizable floating window or a standalone browser tab. Declared window actions are recorded as info-level project journal entries (without their payloads), and workbenches can be imported, exported, or installed from a market index.
description.zh: 用一句大白话换来一个能用的工作台窗口：侧边栏面板先问几个带推荐选项的问题，模型据此写一个单文件 HTML 产物，插件把它挂成可缩放的浮层窗口或独立标签页。窗口里声明的动作会以 info 级别记进项目日志（不含动作数据）；工作台还能导入、导出，或从市场索引一键安装。

description.en: A rail of four circular buttons in the DSH Web conversation that step to the previous or next user message, or to the top or bottom, paging older history in automatically.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话区提供一组圆形按钮，逐条跳到上一条或下一条用户消息，或直接到顶部与底部，并自动翻页加载更早历史。

description.en: Folds each DSH Web turn's thinking, tool calls and context into bordered process boxes cut at every piece of model text; a collapsed box shows its latest two items, the stacked lines above its border open that one box, the border itself folds it back, and user dialogue, interactive questions and model text stay outside.
description.zh: 把每轮 DSH Web 会话中的思考、工具调用与上下文折叠进带边框的过程框，在每段模型文本处切开；折叠时每框只显示最新两项，点上边框的堆叠线展开这一个框、再点上边框收回，用户对话、交互式提问与模型文本始终留在框外。

description.en: A right-sidebar session panel that lists every Skill, MCP tool call and file read or write by turn and step, with per-failure error detail.
description.zh: 右侧边栏的会话面板：按轮次与步骤列出全部 Skill、MCP 工具调用与文件读写，并展开每次失败的报错详情。

description.en: Translate DSH reasoning, tasks, answers and review reasons into 9 languages. Ollama, custom OpenAI/Anthropic APIs or Google/Bing; ordered fallback, local model memory controls, originals preserved.
description.zh: DSH Web 显示层翻译：思考链、任务、可选回答和审查拒绝理由，支持 9 种语言；本地 Ollama、自定义 OpenAI/Anthropic API、Google/Bing，按序回退与本地模型内存管理，原文保留。

description.en: Floating workspace file-preview window for the Web client: lazy file tree, CodeMirror preview and in-window edit with save, Markdown and image preview, Quick Open search, and opening paths clicked in the conversation.
description.zh: Web 客户端悬浮文件预览窗：懒加载文件树、CodeMirror 预览与窗内编辑保存、Markdown 与图片预览、Quick Open 搜索，以及点击会话中的路径直接打开。

description.en: Docks the dsh-whale-widget desktop pet flush against the right sidebar edge, following sidebar width changes and collapse/expand, with a toggle in the widget menu.
description.zh: 让 dsh-whale-widget 桌宠紧贴右侧栏边缘：展开时贴其左缘、折叠时贴窗口右缘，右栏改宽时实时跟随，开关在挂件菜单里。
