description.en: Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a one-click whale icon plus a sidebar More menu with Settings / Restart-Refresh / graceful Full Exit, and a scrollable multi-DSH picker on the cold-start card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面启动器：一键鲸鱼图标 + 侧栏「更多」菜单（设置 / 重启/刷新 / 优雅完全退出），冷启动卡片支持可滚动的多 DSH 候选选择。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-card

description.en: Shows the API balance of the provider behind the current model as a dsh Web sidebar card, with per-package progress bars, currency/credit-aware units, a settings tab, and subscription and credit quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在当前会话所用模型的厂商 API 余额，以 dsh Web 侧边栏卡片常驻展示，含每套餐进度条、货币/积分单位区分、设置页，以及订阅与积分额度监测。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Brain-shaped relationship graph viewer for DeepSeek Harness with a Markdown knowledge-base pipeline that imports documents and builds the graph. The viewer ships demo data and needs no Python; rebuilding the graph from your own notes needs Node.js 20+ and Python 3.8+ and runs from the command line.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 笔记编译成脑形关系图谱的 DSH 侧栏查看器，附带文档导入与图谱构建管线。查看器自带演示数据、无需 Python；用自己的笔记重建图谱需要 Node.js 20+ 与 Python 3.8+，在命令行里运行。

description.en: Hover to reveal and leave to hide the left sidebar on Windows desktop and Web, with manual pinning, configurable delays and reduced-motion support.
description.zh: Windows 桌面版与 Web 左侧栏悬停展开、移开收起，支持手动固定、自定义延迟和减少动态效果。

description.en: Drag-and-drop reordering, official/third-party dividers and a stash panel for the buttons DSH renders in the sidebar, the sidebar footer, the conversation tabs, the composer dock and Settings. Only display position changes; the plugin registry is untouched.
description.zh: 对 DSH 投放到侧边栏顶部、侧边栏底部、对话标签、输入框停靠行与设置页导航的插件按钮做拖拽排序、官方/第三方分隔线与按钮收纳。只改变显示位置，不改动插件注册表。

description.en: Adds an Amadeus-inspired launch panel with a clock and navigation shortcuts.
description.zh: 添加 Amadeus 风格启动面板，包含时钟和导航快捷入口。

description.en: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 对话轮次导航。

description.en: Three-party collaboration protocol for dsh: Step List state machine, five-tier review chain (Gemini/web/Claude Code/dialog/manual), alternatives adjudication, cross-restart resume with heartbeat, and capability persistence.
description.zh: dsh 三方协作协议插件：Step List 状态机、五级审核链（含本地 Claude Code 混合审）、alternatives 裁决、无介入续跑与能力持久化体系。

description.en: Adds a Reading tab to the DSH web client that shows process steps and live reasoning in source order, collapses successful turns to the final answer, and keeps the original tabs, composer, and tooling intact.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端新增「阅读」页签：按源顺序呈现过程步骤与实时思考，成功轮次收起只留最终回答，原有页签、输入框与工具保持不变。

description.en: Shows a character avatar and an editable ID beside every assistant reply, and reads the reply aloud with the system voice or a local TTS service you point it at; includes presets, a playback bar with pause and sentence skipping, tone and speed controls, and one-click launching of that service.
description.zh: 在每轮回复左侧显示角色头像与可编辑 ID，并可用系统语音或你自己指定的本地 TTS 服务朗读回复；含预设、带暂停与上下句的播放控制条、语气与语速调节，以及一键启动该服务。

description.en: CLI-style chat history recall for the DSH input box: press ArrowUp/ArrowDown to recall previously sent messages.
description.zh: 给 DSH 聊天输入框加 CLI 风格历史记忆：按上下方向键召回之前发送过的消息。

description.en: Conversation node navigation bar for quick jumps between user messages.
description.zh: 对话节点导航条，右缘节点串快速跳转 user 消息。

description.en: Disk review canvas: agent-written semantics, human decisions, previewed cleanup with undo.
description.zh: 磁盘审查盘面：Agent 写语义、你做决定，清理前预览、执行后可撤销。

description.en: Background task status bar: progress plus live output tail on the chat page.
description.zh: 后台任务状态条：对话页任务进度 + 实时输出 tail。

description.en: A Gemini kitten widget for the DSH Web UI: live Google Gemini API free-tier quota per model, a model switcher, color-coded warnings, drag-to-snap, and click-to-change lines.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 Gemini 猫娘额度挂件：每个模型的 Gemini API 免费层配额实时显示、按型号切换、按额度变色预警、拖拽吸附、点击换台词。

description.en: Layered syntax highlighting for bash/pwsh command and read code output in the DSH web GUI (VS Code Dark+ palette: keywords/strings/numbers/functions/comments each get a color); colors only what it recognizes, keeps tables/logs plain; pure frontend, zero token overhead.
description.zh: DSH web 插件：给 bash/pwsh 命令与 read 的代码输出做分层语法染色（VS Code Dark+ 配色：关键字/字符串/数字/函数名/注释各一色）；认得出来才染，表格/日志保持原样；纯前端渲染，零 token 开销。

description.en: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight session over the official /api RPC — the main conversation is never touched. Streaming text, collapsible reasoning, tool chips, stop button, agent-preset selector, and an automatic context snapshot from the visible main chat.
description.zh: ChatGPT 式侧边快速提问：在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧悬浮面板中就当前话题提小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，绝不写入、不影响主对话。流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。

description.en: Official-style composer model trigger with a floating reasoning-effort slider popup.
description.zh: 官方风格输入框 + 浮动推理能力滑块弹窗，节点与滑块对齐，弹窗跟随 Harness 主题自适应。

description.en: Glass weather pill in the session header with 23 weather states, each with its own tint, SVG icon and canvas particle layer, per-field visibility switches, and a get_weather tool backed by keyless Open-Meteo data.
description.zh: 会话顶栏的玻璃天气胶囊：23 种天气状态各自配色、SVG 图标与 canvas 粒子层，可按字段开关显示内容，并注册 get_weather 工具（Open-Meteo 免密钥数据）。

description.en: Knowledge-base browser panel: tree browsing plus drag-to-cite (path-only or full content) into the composer.
description.zh: 知识库浏览器面板：目录浏览，支持把节点拖进输入框生成引用（仅路径或附全文）。

description.en: Browser tab favicon mirrors the DSH session state (idle / running / asking / done), recolored and animated from one base SVG entirely in the browser, with colors and effects configurable from the Settings page.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 favicon 实时反映 DSH 会话状态（待机 / 运行中 / 提问 / 完成）：单个 base.svg 在浏览器端上色与动画，颜色与特效均可在设置页配置。

description.en: Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair tooltip, hot list, search, 7x24 news, plus a draggable mini index badge — no login needed.
description.zh: 雪球行情面板：嵌入输入框上方，免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、指数与自选股，K线蜡烛图（成交量/均线/十字光标）、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯，另有可拖动迷你指数徽章。

description.en: Plain click on an Obsidian vault file in the DSH conversation opens it in the right app: notes in the Obsidian app, configured types (for example .tex) in VS Code with their project folder as the workspace; Cmd/Ctrl-click keeps the in-app preview. The open_vault_file tool follows the same routing, and every open is confined to the configured vaultRoot.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里普通点击 Obsidian 库内文件会打开到对应 App：笔记进 Obsidian，配置的类型（例如 .tex）进 VS Code 并以项目目录作为工作区；Cmd/Ctrl+点击保留内置预览。open_vault_file 工具走同一套路由，所有打开都限定在配置的 vaultRoot 内。

description.en: Workspace file tree and code editor in the DSH right sidebar: browse the workspace of the session it belongs to, create, rename and delete files and folders (to a trash folder by default), edit in place with line numbers and syntax highlighting (Ctrl+S saves, Ctrl+D duplicates the current line), preview images and play audio or video, list and unpack archives or pack a folder into a .zip through the system tar, search by file name or jump by a pasted path, and draw file rows with the icons Windows itself uses (SHGetFileInfo, Windows only).
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的工作区文件树与代码编辑器：跟随所在会话的工作区，新建 / 重命名 / 删除文件与文件夹（默认进回收站），带行号与语法高亮地编辑、Ctrl+S 保存、Ctrl+D 复制当前行，可预览图片、播放音频视频、查看并解压压缩包或用系统 tar 打包成 zip，能按文件名搜索或粘贴路径跳转，Windows 下图标用系统自己那套（SHGetFileInfo）。

description.en: Adds a knowledge-base picker and a native-attachment paperclip to the DSH composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中加入知识库选择器与原生附件回形针。

description.en: Replaces the add-workspace folder dialog with a path input, drive shortcuts, and the native folder picker.
description.zh: 把添加工作区的目录对话框换成路径输入、盘符快捷和系统文件夹选择。

description.en: Adds a time-aware greeting line under the DSH home hero headline: seven local-time slots with tsundere whale-girl lines, phrase overrides through ~/.dsh/greeting.json, and Ctrl+R / F5 bound back to a real page reload.
description.zh: 给 DSH 主页 / 新会话 hero 区加一行按时段变化的问候语：按本地时间分 7 个时段随机抽句、内置傲娇鲸鱼娘台词、可用 ~/.dsh/greeting.json 覆盖任意时段，并顺手把 Ctrl+R / F5 接回页面刷新。

description.en: A one-line caption above the composer that tells you what the AI is doing right now: the step number, the action (e.g. running npm test), and whether it is still going, done, or failed with a short plain-language reason. Inferred locally from tool calls and the thinking text; no model calls, no network requests, no writes to DSH data.
description.zh: 在输入框上方加一行小字，告诉你 AI 现在第几步、在做什么、成没成，比如「第 3 步 · 正在执行命令 npm test · 琢磨中」。全部靠本机规则推断，不调模型、不联网、不改 DSH 的任何数据。

description.en: Font engine for the Web GUI: system font enumeration, global and per-component font-size tuning with a Spy++-style picker, settings page.
description.zh: 网页界面字体引擎：系统字体枚举、准星点选的全局与逐组件字号微调、设置页。老花眼友好，自定义字体和页面部件字体和字体大小，支持SPY模式扫UI和其他插件。

description.en: Provides an always-on-top window feature for the DSH window, preventing it from being hidden unexpectedly, Windows only; requires PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) on PATH.
description.zh: 提供 DSH 软件窗口置顶功能，让其不会乱隐藏，仅 Windows；需 PATH 上有 PowerShell 7（pwsh.exe）。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel entries and footer entries into one row of icon-only squares with hover names, adds four icon-size presets, per-entry show/hide switches and up/down ordering, and puts a Settings shortcut in the footer row.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏的面板入口与底部入口改成只显示图标的并排方块，悬停显示名称；提供四档图标大小、逐项显隐开关与上下排序，并在底部加一个设置入口。

description.en: Quick temporary conversation and workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 临时对话工作区自动化管理插件。

description.en: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.
description.zh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

description.en: Usage dashboard: offline-scans session logs to chart daily/weekly/monthly tokens, estimated costs, model/tool/skill/command leaderboards, output speed, working hours and quality metrics; gridstack+ECharts cards are drag-and-drop composable, with custom formulas and AI arrangement (prompt round-trip import).
description.zh: 使用量仪表盘：离线扫描会话日志，统计每日/每周/每月 token、估算费用、模型/工具/技能/命令榜、输出速度、工作时段与质量指标；gridstack+ECharts 卡片可拖拽编排，支持自定义公式与 AI 编排（提示词往返导入）。

description.en: Customizes the native settings window: preset or custom window sizes, fullscreen, background transparency, and theme, solid-color, or image backgrounds, with a floating ball for quick access; saved in the local browser.
description.zh: 设置界面自定义：调整原生设置窗口大小（全屏/预置大尺寸/自定义宽高）、背景透明度与背景（主题/自定义颜色/图片），悬浮球即开即调，存本机浏览器。

description.en: Sidebar tidy: when plugins pile up, the rows under 'New session' get crowded with panel and plugin entries. This plugin folds them all — global panel rows, plugin-injected entry rows (own and third-party alike), and bottom entries — into a single menu button whose secondary menu triggers each entry exactly as before; keep any entry permanently visible with a name whitelist, and the button turns into an icon when the sidebar collapses to a narrow rail.
description.zh: 侧栏收纳：把「新会话」下方被各插件塞满的入口行——全局面板行、插件入口行（自家/第三方一律识别）、底部入口——统统收进一个菜单按钮，点开二级菜单原样触发各入口；想常驻的加名称白名单即可，侧栏折叠成窄轨时按钮自动变纯图标。

description.en: Adds a non-uniform conversation density map(chat history markers) to the right of the DSH chat area: one tick per turn, with tick length and spacing reflecting message size, clickable to jump to a turn and expanding on hover when crowded.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天区右侧添加非等长非等距对话密度地图（历史聊天标签），一轮对话一个刻度，刻度长度与纵向距离反映消息大小，点击刻度可跳转至对应对话，标签繁杂时鼠标悬停会自动拉伸便于点击。

description.en: Adds customizable switch shortcut buttons to the left of the DSH Web GUI chat input for one-click slash-command insertion.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 聊天输入框左侧添加可自定义的 switch 快捷按钮，一键插入斜杠命令。

description.en: Two-level model picker for the DeepSeek Harness composer: browse providers, then models, search across all providers or within one provider, select supported reasoning-effort levels, and navigate with arrow keys, Enter and Esc.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框的两级模型选择器：先选供应商再选模型，支持全局与供应商内搜索、可用思考强度设置，以及方向键、Enter 和 Esc 操作。

description.en: Per-session status chips in the GNOME top bar for DeepSeek Harness — gray for running, green for done, yellow for waiting — configurable from the sidebar, with a self-installed GNOME extension.
description.zh: 在 GNOME 顶栏显示 DSH 各会话状态色块（灰=运行中，绿=已完成未确认，黄=等待回复/审批），可在侧边栏配置，自动安装 GNOME 扩展。

description.en: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格上下键历史回溯、双击 Esc 历史搜索、选中文本引用/自动复制与鼠标右键直接粘贴。

description.en: Replace the DSH solid background with a local image, with a draggable editor for fit, blur, veil and interface opacity.
description.zh: 用本地图片替换 DSH 的纯色背景，并提供可拖动面板来调整铺满方式、模糊、遮罩和界面不透明度。

description.en: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
description.zh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。

description.en: Presets message-injection content combos and auto-injects them into every message.
description.zh: 预设消息注入内容组合，每条消息自动注入输入框首行。

description.en: Adds an independently toggled native file explorer beside the conversation, with local and SSH file operations, fast remote @ completion, and native previews in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 在聊天左侧显示可独立开关的原生文件栏，支持本地和 SSH 工作区的文件操作与远程 @ 补全，文件继续由右侧原生侧栏预览。

description.en: Floating glass status bar for DSH on Windows 11 x64: an always-on-top capsule that mirrors session progress, the current step and pending approvals from a local DSH web profile, with peek and detail views; approval cards stay read-only until DSH returns its own decision receipt, and connecting to the official Desktop app is experimental and unverified.
description.zh: Windows 11 x64 上的 DSH 悬浮玻璃状态栏：常驻胶囊显示本地 DSH web profile 的会话进度、当前步骤与待处理审批，可展开速览与详情；审批卡在 DSH 返回正式回执前保持只读，连接官方 Desktop 应用属实验性、未验收。

description.en: Opens a full-screen 3-D black-hole stage from a sidebar card, where 24,514 real internet radio stations orbit inside an accretion disc; drag to orbit, hold to cross a wormhole into a star cluster, click a star to play, with search, 13 genre filters, favourites and ICY now-playing titles.
description.zh: 从左栏卡片打开全屏 3D 黑洞舞台，2.45 万台真实网络电台嵌在吸积盘里环绕运行；拖动环绕、按住穿过虫洞进入星团、点星点播放，带搜索、13 个流派筛选、收藏与流内 ICY 曲目信息。

description.en: Adds one 28x28 icon button per dsh-im channel that holds an account to the official Workspaces header row. Pressing one puts the sidebar into that channel's view, drawing only its conversations and hiding every other row; pressing it again drops back to the official list. Buttons appear only for channels with a connected account.
description.zh: 在官方「工作区」标题行上，为每个已接入账号的 dsh-im 通道添加一个 28x28 图标按钮。点击后侧栏切到该通道视图，只显示它的会话、隐藏其余所有行；再次点击回到官方列表。只有已接入账号的通道才会出现按钮。

description.en: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the session open in the main view, purple for finished-but-unviewed, and a static rainbow title for pinned rows. Every colour is mode-scoped — dark keeps the vivid stop, light takes a darker variant solved to clear 4.5:1 against the light wall — and the split reads DSH's own dark marker. Reads official Client services only: it owns no state, never polls, and ships no host-side half.
description.zh: 按官方状态给 DSH 侧栏会话行染色，配色取自福音战士：等你处理的会话为蓝色左轨，主视图打开的那条为红色左轨，已结束但未查看为紫色左轨，置顶行的标题为静态彩虹。左侧轨道按模式分档——暗档保留原色，亮档换成对浅底 ≥4.5:1 的压暗变体——分档读的是 DSH 自己的暗色标记；未读的紫色轨道两种模式共用。只读取官方 Client 服务，自身不持有状态、不轮询，也没有宿主侧代码。

description.en: Consumer panel for OpenBiliClaw inside DSH: a right-hand drawer with recommendations, saved lists, Socratic dialogue, profile and settings, plus 22 Agent Bridge tools so the agent can read recommendations, answer probes and save items. Requires a running OpenBiliClaw backend with Agent Bridge v2 (default 127.0.0.1:8420).
description.zh: OpenBiliClaw 的 DSH 消费侧插件：右侧抽屉提供推荐、收藏/稍后再看、苏格拉底式对话、画像与设置，并注册 22 个 Agent Bridge 工具，让 Agent 能读推荐、答探测、存内容。需要预先运行 OpenBiliClaw 后端并开启 Agent Bridge v2（默认 127.0.0.1:8420）。

description.en: Search and insert workspace file and directory paths with `@`, plus a `/h` menu for reusing prompts from the current session.
description.zh: 在组合框中使用 `@` 搜索并插入工作区文件和目录路径，并通过 `/h` 菜单复用当前会话的问题。

description.en: MCP server management panel in Settings: add, edit, enable/disable and delete servers across user and workspace scopes with form or JSON editing, and auto-register discovered MCP tools as native conversation tools.
description.zh: 在设置中提供 MCP Servers 管理面板：新增、编辑、启停、删除服务器，支持用户/项目作用域与表单/JSON 双模式编辑，并自动把发现的 MCP 工具注册为对话原生工具。

description.en: Embedded terminal for DeepSeek Harness: opens an in-app terminal panel in the right sidebar (DockKit) or bottom composer dock, with PSReadLine geometry protection and full theme sync.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内嵌终端插件：在右侧栏（DockKit Tab）或输入框下方以沉底抽屉形式提供界面内嵌的交互式终端，跟随官方主题与工作区目录，支持 PSReadLine 尺寸保护与位置热切换。

description.en: Topic grouping layered over the native workspace list: emoji folder groups, filtering and search, batch archive, and safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 在原生工作区列表之上叠加主题分组：emoji 分组文件夹、筛选与搜索、批量归档，以及带安全边界的永久删除。

description.en: Code preview for dsh-better-sidebar with per-language syntax highlighting, symbol outline, in-file search, and selection-to-conversation.
description.zh: 为 dsh-better-sidebar 提供代码预览：按文件类型语法高亮、符号大纲、文件内查找，选中代码可直接加入对话。

description.en: Plays video and audio files in the right Sidebar preview pane, streamed over an authenticated HTTP Range route so a remote browser can play and seek a large file without launching a native player on the Host.
description.zh: 在右側欄預覽區直接播放影片同音訊，經帶認證的 HTTP Range 路由串流，令遠端瀏覽器可以播放同跳轉大型檔案，唔使喺主機開原生播放器。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar leaves the shell frame entirely and is opened as an overlay drawer from a header button, so the conversation gets the full viewport width; wider layouts are untouched.
description.zh: 視窗闊度細過 1024px 時，側欄完全移出 shell frame，改由頁首按鈕以浮動抽屜方式打開，令對話可以用盡整個螢幕闊度；闊螢幕版面唔受影響。

description.en: Replaces the host-side folder chooser in the Add workspace flow with a name dialog, so a remote browser can create and open a workspace instead of an OS dialog appearing on the Host screen.
description.zh: 將「新增工作區」流程中喺主機彈出嘅資料夾選擇器，改成輸入名稱嘅對話框，令遠端瀏覽器可以直接建立並開啟工作區。

description.en: Adds a Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) language to the web GUI, registered through the locale service with one dictionary per namespace and selectable in Settings, General, Language.
description.zh: 為網頁介面加入繁體中文（zh-Hant）語言，經語言服務註冊，每個 namespace 各有一份字典，並可在「設定 → 一般 → 語言」揀選。

description.en: Folds each 4-50 KB paste in the DSH composer into its own chip (expand or delete it individually), and turns a paste of 50 KB or more into a real file attachment. Declares DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, so it stays visible on the 0.2 release line.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里每次 4–50 KB 的粘贴折叠成独立的一枚 chip（可单独展开或删除），50 KB 及以上的粘贴转成真附件。声明 DSH >=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0-0，因此在 0.2 版本线上保持可见。

description.en: Polishes the draft in the composer into a clearer, better-structured prompt from the ✨ button or Alt+O; streams the result live over SSE with reasoning shown first, and follows the session's default model with zero configuration or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 在输入框按 ✨ 或 Alt+O 一键把草稿润色成更清晰、更结构化的 prompt；默认零配置复用当前会话模型（SSE 真流式、推理过程先出），也可自配任意 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: An always-last, collapsible Recent tasks workspace group in the DSH sidebar: a sidebar entry and the Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N shortcut start a chat in a dedicated folder, so it lands in that group instead of 未分组. The group is a genuine workspace record rather than a plugin-drawn look-alike, so collapse, rename, search and drag order behave normally, and its folder, group name, pin-last and auto-repair are live settings.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏里常驻末位、可折叠的「最近任务」工作区分组：侧边栏入口与 Mod+Alt+N / Mod+Shift+N 快捷键在专用目录里开新对话，对话因此归入这个分组，而不是「未分组」。该分组是真正的工作区记录，而非插件画出来的仿制品，折叠、改名、搜索与拖拽排序都正常可用；目录、分组名、常驻末尾与自动重建都是实时设置。

description.en: Floating translucent DeepSeek whale elf on the DSH page that opens a draggable, minimizable temporary chat window using the session model or a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with real-time streaming.
description.zh: DSH 页面悬浮的半透明 DeepSeek 鲸鱼小精灵：点击打开可拖动、可最小化的临时聊天浮窗，支持跟随会话模型或自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点实时流式输出。

description.en: A frosted-glass status card that floats on the Windows desktop and shows what DSH is doing — running tasks with elapsed time and current activity, pending approvals, today's token usage and the countdown to the off-peak window — and collapses into a 14×120 bar that stays out of the way.
description.zh: 浮在 Windows 桌面上的磨砂玻璃状态卡片，显示 DSH 正在做什么——运行中的任务及已跑时长与当前动作、待审批项、今日 Token 用量与谷时倒计时——不用时可缩成一根 14×120 的细柱贴在屏幕边缘。

description.en: Four right-Sidebar panels for the dsh web client: artifacts, long-term memory, terminal and notes. They pair two per tab with a draggable split, so two panes show all four at once. The host half ships nine memory_* tools, artifacts_list, the /memory command, and the /api/artifacts/* and /api/terminal-notes/* routes. The terminal runs one bash command per line, with a default 120-second deadline and a stop button. Requires dsh 0.1.5 or newer, and 0.2.
description.zh: 给 dsh web 客户端加四个右侧栏面板：产物浏览、长期记忆、终端、记事本。两两配成一个标签、中间可拖拽分栏，因此两个窗格就能同时看到四个。终端每行执行一条 bash 命令，默认 120 秒期限、可随时终止。宿主侧一并提供 9 个 memory_* 工具、artifacts_list、/memory 命令，以及 /api/artifacts/* 与 /api/terminal-notes/* 路由。需要 dsh 0.1.5 及以上，以及 0.2 系列。

description.en: A prompt optimizer in the composer input tool row: pick a category and a template, then ✨ rewrites the draft in place with one-click undo. Pick from the Basic, Context and Image categories; you can cancel a run, and it shows elapsed time and token usage. Ships 15 templates covering task-instruction rewriting, step planning, safety-research framing, system-prompt role cards, and text-to-image / image-to-image prompts; context templates read the recent turns of the session for coreference resolution. Calls go through the host model service, and a settings section exposes the model and the budgets. Output guards check that user-written constraints survive, warning rather than auto-retrying. Adapted for dsh 0.1.7 and 0.2.
description.zh: 给对话输入框工具行加一个提示词优化器：选类别（基础 / 上下文 / 图像）与模板，点 ✨ 即原地改写草稿，支持一键还原。可取消，并显示耗时与 token 用量。内置 15 个模板，覆盖任务指令改写、需求步骤化规划、逆向/安全研究语境与系统提示词角色卡，以及文生图与图生图提示词。上下文类模板会读取当前会话最近几轮用于消歧。调用走宿主模型服务，设置分区可调模型与各项预算；输出守卫会核对用户明写的约束是否保留，只告警不自动重试。适配 dsh 0.1.7 与 0.2 系列。

plugins.name: dsh-code-studio

description.en: File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted editor, one-click revert, change history, workspace switcher, and per-session isolation.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的文件修改监视器与代码工作台。Agent 修改代码时实时浮现逐行 Diff，内置语法高亮编辑器，支持一键还原、修改历史、工作区切换与按会话隔离。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 8.8.8.8 for network access

description.en: Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and click-to-jump controls, and local conversation search.
description.zh: 左侧用户轮次导航轨道：随阅读位置高亮，悬停预览单轮指标与模型回答摘要，支持键盘和点击跳转及本地会话搜索。

description.en: Rotates the model status line through a 53-phrase English/Chinese deep-theme pool: a random pick at turn start, event-driven switching on new thinking segments or tool calls (3s throttle), and a click on the status line toggles the language.
description.zh: 把内置 'Deep diving...' 思考状态行扩展为 53 条 deep 系英/中双语短语池：回合开场随机一条，随新思考段/工具调用事件轮换（最短间隔 3 秒），点击状态行切换中英文。

description.en: A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live metrics (duration, TTFT, token, tok/s, cache hit) — only the final summary stays visible; customizable leading icons with animated poker cards built in (suit-cycling card animation while running, a deck when collapsed, a fan when expanded), a settings row for the official fold mode, compatible with both new and old DSH versions. Zero intrusion into DSH source.
description.zh: 更好的折叠栏：将工具调用与 Think 段自动折叠为步骤折叠栏，回合结束后整回合收拢为带实时指标（耗时/首字/token/tok/s/缓存命中）的回合折叠栏，只保留最终总结正文；前导图标可自定义，内置动态扑克牌（运行中花色循环卡牌动画、收起牌堆、展开扇形），提供官方折叠方式设置行，适配 DSH 新旧版本。零侵入 DSH 源码。

plugins.name: DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget-Bowl

description.en: A fixed-corner DeepSeek balance whale widget for the DSH web GUI: three switchable skins (default / bowl-on-head / bowl-in-hand), balance with today usage, per-turn cost popups, peak/off-peak price conversion, press sound effects and random talk lines. Modified from MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面右下角的 DeepSeek 余额鲸鱼挂件：三套形象切换（默认 / 顶碗 / 拿碗）、余额与今日已用、每轮对话消耗提示、峰谷价换算、按压音效与随机台词。基于 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget 修改。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Replaces the chat composer with an editor-style input panel on CodeMirror 6: line numbers, edit + markdown-preview split, a floating window mode and a full-height sidebar tab — one input surface at a time. Drafts ride the official input machine; the official voice-input button is rendered when the host provides one, and the stats row and context meter read the same data as the official dock.
description.zh: 把聊天输入框换成 CodeMirror 6 的编辑器式输入面板：行号、编辑 + Markdown 预览分屏、悬浮窗与全高侧栏标签，同一时刻只有一个输入入口。草稿走官方输入机；宿主有语音输入按钮时原样渲染官方语音组件，数据行与上下文小圈与官方 dock 同源。

description.en: Sparkle button immediately left of the model selector that rewrites the composer draft into an executable prompt in place, modelled on WorkBuddy: the host calls the conversation LLM with a prompt-engineering system prompt, multi-level undo keeps up to 8 previous drafts, and a token-level diff card shows added and removed spans, the number of changed spots and the net character delta. Runs on the session model, is disabled while the draft is empty, and keeps the browser-session cookie fence in front of the LLM call.
description.zh: 模型选择器左侧的 ✨：把草稿原地改写成可执行的提示词（对标 WorkBuddy），调用在宿主侧完成；多层撤销最多保留 8 版，逐字差异卡标出新增与删除、改动处数与净增字数；增强跟随会话当前模型，草稿为空时自动置灰，调用前做浏览器会话 Cookie 校验。

description.en: Publishes the running dsh Web server's PID, port and tokenized URL to a runtime file for the DeepSeek Harness Switch Dock app, and removes it on shutdown.
description.zh: 为「DeepSeek Harness 开关」程序坞应用写出运行中 dsh Web 服务的 PID、端口与带 token 的地址（运行时文件权限 0600），并在退出时删除。

description.en: Orders and folds the DSH left sidebar by what is actually running — a workspace floats to the top when one of its sessions starts and keeps that place when the session finishes, only the N most recently active workspaces stay expanded, and six switches plus one count control each rule.
description.zh: 按实际运行状态排序与折叠 DSH 左侧栏：有会话开跑的工作区浮到最前，会话跑完仍留在原位，只有最近活跃的 N 个工作区保持展开；六个开关加一个数量控制各条规则。

description.en: Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.
description.zh: Web UI 悬浮预览与代码窗口：Google AI Studio 风格的 iframe 预览（宽幅比/分辨率预设、一键放大），VS Code 风格代码窗支持直接编辑，保存需确认并写入会话日志。

description.en: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 添加文件与文件夹拖放附件，提供输入栏卡片、持久化历史记录与工作区路径。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-tweaks

description.en: Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.
description.zh: 从设置面板实时调教 DSH 网页对话界面：消息字体大小、Claude Desktop 风格 Markdown 表格、对话框宽度、可选时间线侧栏，以及带分支管理、逐文件 Diff 和提交推送功能的 GitBar。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds one Prompt button beside the composer: clicking it rewrites the draft with an editable prompt-engineering doctrine and returns the result as pickable rows instead of overwriting the draft, and the same panel edits the plugin's own settings in place.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个 ✦ Prompt 按钮：点一下就按可替换的提示词心法改写草稿，结果按行返回而不是直接覆盖草稿；同一个面板里还能直接改插件设置。

description.en: Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active agent loop.
description.zh: 交互式侧边助手坞：用 /btw 快速提问，实时显示思考状态，历史记录分页浏览。

description.en: Adds an icon button to the composer that optimizes the current draft prompt through the active model.
description.zh: 在输入框新增图标按钮，一键调用当前模型把提示词优化得更清晰具体。

description.en: Composer button that opens a panel listing every skill available to the current session with Chinese titles, purposes and usage examples, and lets you catalogue newly installed skills in one click (saved locally).
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏提供一个按钮，一键打开技能面板，列出当前会话的全部技能（中文标题、用途与例句），并可一键收录新安装但尚未录入词典的技能（保存在本机）。

description.en: Adds a system tray icon to DSH Desktop, with settings to hide the main window to the tray on minimize or close and self-healing after app updates.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 增加系统托盘图标，可在设置中选择最小化或关闭时隐藏到托盘，应用更新后自动恢复。

description.en: Adds a refresh button to the sidebar footer that reloads the plugin list and the page so newly installed plugins take effect without restarting the desktop app.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部添加一个刷新按钮，一键重载插件列表与页面，让新安装的插件无需重启应用即可生效。

description.en: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with translations, persistent playback queue, QR-code or Cookie login, colors following the DSH skin theme.
description.zh: 网易云音乐浮窗播放器：可拖拽/折叠浮窗与迷你条，歌单发现（搜索/热门歌单），逐行同步歌词与翻译，播放队列持久化，扫码或 Cookie 登录，颜色跟随 DSH 皮肤主题。

description.en: Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.
description.zh: DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1 输入框历史：空输入框按 ↑ 召回当前会话刚发过的话，↓ 前进，Esc 还原正在打的草稿。

description.en: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的轮末改动卡：编辑/写入行显示 +N −M，点开审 diff；macOS 和 Windows 可用系统应用、文件夹或 VS Code 打开文件。

description.en: Keyboard confirmation for approval cards: the card takes focus when it appears, so Enter allows once and Esc rejects, and those two keys are forwarded through the card handler when focus has moved elsewhere. It never auto-approves and never steals focus from a text field.
description.zh: 审批卡片的键盘确认：卡片出现时自动聚焦，按 Enter 允许一次、按 Esc 拒绝；焦点离开卡片后这两个键仍会转交给卡片处理。不会自动批准，也不会抢输入框的焦点。

plugins.name: dsh-pdf-bookmarks

description.en: PDF outline navigation and local reading bookmarks in the existing right-sidebar file preview; supports adding, renaming, deleting and revisiting page positions, with version and integrity guards. Verified on macOS Apple Silicon with dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 在现有右侧文件预览中提供 PDF 内嵌目录导航与本地阅读书签，可添加、改名、删除和跳回页内位置，并有版本与完整性保护。已验证 macOS Apple Silicon 上的 dsh Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.3。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.mozilla.org

description.en: **DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content.
description.zh: **DeepSeek Chat（chat.deepseek.com）同款附件**：回形针上传按钮、240×64 DS 风格文件卡片（官方彩色文档图标，从 DS 前端 bundle 提取）、拖拽上传、文本提取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）注入消息、对话流中渲染真实附件卡片（自定义 user 渲染器）且模型读取完整内容。

description.en: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.
description.zh: 为模型添加推理强度滑块，支持原生与动画模式、明暗配色，以及全局或按模型配色。

description.en: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished step keeps its duration on screen until the next one starts, so a slow step can be identified after the fact.
description.zh: 在网页版输入框上方用一句中文显示当前正在执行的智能体步骤：步号、正在执行的工具、以及已运行多久。步骤结束后会保留该步用时，直到下一步开始，因此慢步骤事后也能查证。

description.en: Composer input toolkit: arrow-key session history (first/last-line gated, IME and command-menu safe), an instructions viewer/editor for global and project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and a prompt library of 780 Chinese prompts (Cherry Studio agents-zh corpus, AGPL-3.0) inserted into the composer in one click. Ships on npm as `dsh-composer-tools`.
description.zh: 输入框工具集：方向键调取历史消息（限首/末行触发，兼容输入法与命令菜单）、指令查看/编辑器（全局与项目级 AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md）、提示词库（780 条中文提示词，源自 Cherry Studio agents-zh 语料，AGPL-3.0，一键插入输入框）。npm 包名 `dsh-composer-tools`。

description.en: Compact right-edge turn rail with hover summaries and click-to-jump navigation. Ships on npm as `dsh-turn-scrubber`.
description.zh: 右侧紧凑回合刻度条，悬停显示回合摘要，点击跳转到对应用户回合。npm 包名 `dsh-turn-scrubber`。

description.en: Drag-and-drop / paste / upload files and images; on non-multimodal models images are auto-described by a configured VLM.
description.zh: 拖拽/粘贴/上传文件和图片，非多模态模型下图片自动调用已配置 VLM 识别。

description.en: Offline vocabulary panel: a capsule beside the composer opens a word card, and a dockable tabbed panel tracks today, progress, the mistake book and settings.
description.zh: 离线背词面板：输入框旁一颗胶囊点开是词卡，可钉住的分页面板管着今日、进度、生词本与设置。

description.en: Keeps DSH reasoning in Simplified Chinese and auto-expands every Think row in the Web UI.
description.zh: 让 DSH 用简体中文思考，并自动展开 Web 界面里的所有 Think 行，展开的思考块与回复有视觉区分。

description.en: Read-only side branch in the right sidebar: quote text to ask follow-ups without polluting the model context of the main session; every follow-up rebuilds the branch from the latest settled turns of the main session, and writes are refused at the tool-execution layer so the prompt prefix stays cacheable.
description.zh: 右侧栏的只读侧枝会话：划选文字即可追问，答案不进入主会话的模型上下文；每轮追问都用主会话最新的已结算内容重建，写操作在执行层被拒，以保住提示词前缀缓存。

description.en: Opens a temporary side conversation in the right Sidebar that reuses the host conversation UI, so answers render with the same markdown, tool steps, timing and token usage as the main thread. Selecting part of an answer opens that conversation side chat with the passage quoted: the quote waits as a pill inside the composer, rides along with the next message, and joins the side chat context. The side chat runs on its own memory-only session: the parent snapshot is reference context only, and nothing is written to the session log.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏打开一个临时侧边对话，复用宿主原生会话界面，回答的 Markdown 渲染、工具步骤、用时与 Token 用量都与主对话一致；在主对话里选中一段回答，即可唤起该对话的侧聊并把选中内容作为引用胶囊停在输入框内，随下一条消息一起生效，并计入侧聊上下文。侧聊运行在独立的内存会话上：主对话快照只作为参考上下文，不写入会话日志。

description.en: Codex-style keyboard answers for the pending command-approval panel — 1 allows once, 2 rejects, Enter confirms the highlighted choice, arrow keys move it, and Esc rejects, with the buttons still usable by mouse.
description.zh: 审批面板的 Codex 风格键盘应答：按 1 允许一次、2 拒绝、回车确认高亮项、方向键切换高亮、Esc 拒绝，鼠标点按依旧可用。

description.en: Bottom-left floating panel that uploads and switches your own background images, with scrim and blur sliders and three bundled wallpapers.
description.zh: 左下角浮窗，上传并切换自定义背景图片，带遮罩与模糊滑块，内置三张壁纸。

description.en: Adds an action to the session menu and the session title bar that opens the artifacts folder of that conversation: it reads the session log, works out which directories the conversation wrote files to, and opens them in Explorer.
description.zh: 在会话列表菜单和会话标题栏加一个动作：直接打开这个对话的产物文件夹。它读会话日志算出该对话往哪些目录写过文件，再用资源管理器打开，不必自己翻工作区根目录。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu to DeepSeek Harness inside desktop shells that ship no context menu: cut, copy, paste and select all in the composer, copy and copy-as-plain-text on selected text elsewhere, and a search entry that opens the default browser with a configurable engine.
description.zh: 在没有自带右键菜单的桌面外壳中为 DeepSeek Harness 补上右键菜单：输入框内的剪切、复制、粘贴、全选，别处选中文字的复制与复制为纯文本，以及用可配置引擎在默认浏览器中搜索。

description.en: Full-screen boot animation covering the loading page until the app UI is ready. Ships a built-in video/wallpaper/audio library, accepts your own files, and adds uninstall and one-click update buttons on its settings page.
description.zh: 全屏开机动画，盖住加载页直到应用就绪再淡出。内置视频、壁纸与开机音频素材库，支持上传自己的文件；设置页内带卸载与一键更新按钮。

description.en: WeChat Reading (WeRead) right-sidebar bookshelf and chapter reader: QR or Cookie login, store search, resume reading, and weread_shelf / weread_search / weread_book / weread_chapter agent tools.
description.zh: 微信读书右侧栏书架与章节阅读器：支持扫码或 Cookie 登录、书城搜索与续读，并提供 weread_shelf / weread_search / weread_book / weread_chapter 工具。

description.en: iPhone-style agent phone: dual-panel calls & SMS, RCS group chat with trust gates, cross-device agent messaging via the registry inbox bridge, L0–L4 trust badges and evidence audit. Experimental: trust summaries are not a security guarantee, and SMS/signalling is relayed through the operator's inbox (visible to them); E2E encryption is planned.
description.zh: 苹果风格智能体手机：双面板电话/短信、RCS 群聊（信任门禁）、跨设备智能体消息（registry 收件箱桥）、L0–L4 信任徽章与证据审计。实验性：信任摘要非安全保证，短信/信令经运营方收件箱中继（运营方可见）；E2E 加密为演进方向。

description.en: Launch splash screen for DSH — a row of white marquee dots lights up, then the DeepSeek Harness wordmark is written stroke by stroke before the main window takes over. Installs as a runtime-injected overlay plugin; the repository also ships an optional native build.
description.zh: DSH 启动画面：亮白跑马灯点亮后一笔写出 DeepSeek Harness，主窗口就绪后淡出。以运行时注入的插件形态安装；仓库另附可选的原生补丁版。

description.en: Replaces the new-session hero with a combined picker: role cards for the agent presets and a workspace card, collapsed into capsule buttons that expand into two scrollable rows.
description.zh: 把新建会话界面的选择器换成组合面板：角色预设卡与工作区卡各自成排，折叠时是胶囊按钮，展开后是两行可滚动的紧凑卡片。

description.en: Folder explorer for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: open any local folder, browse a tree with file-type icons, rename/create/delete/copy files and folders, and add files to the chat as @ references.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的文件夹资源管理器：打开任意本地文件夹、按类型显示彩色图标、重命名/新建/删除/复制文件与文件夹，并可把文件作为 @ 引用添加到对话。

description.en: Codex-style left-side message navigation rail for the Web UI: one tick per user message, hover previews, and click-to-jump across the whole history.
description.zh: Codex 风格左侧消息导航轨道：每条用户消息一个刻度，悬停预览、点击跳转，全历史一次索引。

description.en: Anchors an approve/answer bubble to each DSH Web sidebar session row — one-click handling of authorization, questions, plan reviews and blocked goals without opening the conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏锚定气泡：会话待授权、提问、计划确认、目标阻断时在会话行旁自动弹出并一键处理，无需点进会话。

description.en: Sidebar notebook with titled notes and inline images (videos rejected); click a title to copy its body to the clipboard, reference a note in the composer with @, and optionally open the notebook for every new session.
description.zh: 侧边栏记事本：带标题与正文的记事，可插入图片（拒收视频）；点标题把正文复制到剪贴板；输入框里可用 @ 引用某条记事；可选在新会话时自动打开记事本。

description.en: Zero-friction quick ask for DSH: select text in chat, Markdown/code, rendered HTML reports, or the better-sidebar editor. The default answer starts automatically (English prose is translated, a term is explained, a question is answered); typing cancels it. Answers stream from a one-shot completion on the main window's model, inherit a read-only conversation snapshot, read the selected file as context (up to 20,000 characters by default), and never write to the main session. One-line install; host routes, client slots, document renderers and the iframe selection bridge are separable extension points.
description.zh: DSH 的零摩擦快问：对话、Markdown/代码、渲染后的 HTML 报告、better-sidebar 编辑器里都能划词。默认回答会自动开始（英文正文先翻译、术语解释概念、问句直接回答），输入即取消。答案由一次性 completion 流式产出，沿用主窗口模型，继承只读对话快照，把所选文件作为上下文读取（默认上限 2 万字符），且不写入主会话。一行命令安装；宿主路由、客户端插槽、文档 renderer、iframe 选区桥都是可分离的扩展点。

description.en: Minimal DSH Web transcript toggle: hide thinking, tool-call, and turn-process rows from the session header while preserving assistant answer text.
description.zh: DSH Web 极简会话切换：从会话头部隐藏思考、工具调用和轮次流程行，同时保留助手回答文本。

description.en: Session-header task capsule with color-coded run states, click-to-jump and a multi-task dropdown, plus task notification cards (done / error / waiting-for-confirmation) with synthesized sound and optional system notifications.
description.zh: 会话 header 常驻任务胶囊（圆点颜色分态、点击跳转、多任务下拉），任务完成、出错、等待确认时弹通知卡，支持合成提示音与可选系统通知。

description.en: Adds a decode-speed reading to each reply action row, right of the usage control: open it for the turn time breakdown, first-token latency, decode output, prefill, speed ranges and total usage. A setting can keep every message action row visible.
description.zh: 在每轮回复的操作行里增加显示解码速度（用量右侧），可以显示这一轮回复的时间构成与速度：回答耗时、首字延迟、解码输出、预填充、速度区间与总用量等。设置 → 通用 另有「始终显示消息操作行」开关，可以始终显示所有对话消息的操作行。

description.en: Manage DSH rules from the web settings panel — edit global/project AGENTS.md, or auto-split pasted rules into layered AGENTS.md and skills via LLM.
description.zh: 在设置面板统一管理 DSH 规则：编辑全局/项目 AGENTS.md，或由 LLM 自动拆分粘贴的规则为分层 AGENTS.md 与技能。

description.en: Client-side writing panel for the Web UI: project volumes and stats, corpus library, full-text search, evolution version-chain diffs, and an SVG thread graph, shown only in writing-preset sessions.
description.zh: Web 客户端「写作」面板：项目分卷与统计、书库与全文检索、设定演化版本链 diff、线索 SVG 图谱，仅在写作预设会话显示。

description.en: SDD task progress (todos) and progress ledger (sdd/progress.md) as a right-sidebar tab bound to the current session, rendered with the official MarkdownText, auto-refresh every 5s.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏以当前会话为维度展示 SDD 任务进度（todos）与进度台账（sdd/progress.md），采用官方 MarkdownText 渲染，每 5 秒自动刷新。

description.en: Adds a right-click menu on file references in chat output, listing registered applications with icons for open-with, revealing files in the file manager, and copying absolute or relative paths resolved against the session workspace, while code blocks, plain text and external links keep the native menu.
description.zh: 为聊天输出中的文件引用添加右键菜单，列出系统关联应用（带图标）供选择打开，在文件管理器中定位文件，并复制基于会话工作区解析的绝对或相对路径；代码块、普通文本与外部链接保持原生菜单。

description.en: VS Code style 44px icon rails for the side panels DSH collapses: the left rail keeps the sidebar navigation and the bottom action rows, the right rail lists the sidebarRightTabs ledger so third-party tabs appear on their own, and the right panel is drag-resizable between 300px and 60% of the window. Two switches under Settings → Activity Bar, saved in this browser.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 收起后的两侧栏变成 VS Code 那样的 44px 图标条：左条接管侧边栏导航与底部动作行，右条按 sidebarRightTabs 清单自动列出第三方面板，右侧面板可拖动改宽（300px 至窗口 60%）。设置里的「活动栏」两个开关，按浏览器保存。

description.en: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the DSH web background: embedded video, time-of-day switching, unified frosted blur, local wallpaper library & rotation.
description.zh: 在浏览器里直接加载 Wallpaper Engine 的 .mpkg 作为 DSH 网页背景：内嵌视频、多时段切换、统一磨砂虚化、本地壁纸库与轮换。

description.en: Applies OpenQuantum branding, browser metadata, and PWA assets to the native DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 原生 Web 界面应用 OpenQuantum 品牌、浏览器元数据与 PWA 资产。

description.en: Turn histogram navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness Web with mixed, DeepSeek, and Codex visual variants.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 对话轮次导航轨，支持 mixed / DeepSeek / Codex 三种视觉风格。

description.en: A launcher panel for DSH: manages the capability composer, the plugin inventory and the MCP bridge, and walks you through installing the browser tab-bridge extension.
description.zh: 启动器面板：统管能力组合、插件清单与 MCP 桥，并引导安装浏览器标签页扩展。

description.en: A right-Sidebar video player with a folder playlist (first-frame thumbnails, duration badges, sort by name/duration/modified/size, fullscreen, and a context menu for rename/copy/delete/refresh when the folder is opened with write access), live playback telemetry (buffered range, decoded FPS, dropped frames) and a read-only MP4/MOV reader for codec profile/level, exact frame count, per-track bitrate and rotation. Registers no agent tool; file writes use the browser File System Access API only after a write-permission folder choice.
description.zh: 右侧栏视频播放器：文件夹播放列表支持首帧缩略图、时长、按名称/时长/修改时间/大小排序、全屏，以及写权限文件夹下的重命名/复制/删除/刷新右键菜单；同时显示缓冲区间、解码帧率与丢帧，并只读解析 MP4/MOV 的编码档次/级别、精确帧数、每轨码率与旋转；不注册智能体工具，文件写入仅在用户以写权限选择文件夹后通过浏览器 File System Access API 执行。

description.en: Adds a draggable, position-persisted chip bar of configurable quick phrases to DeepSeek Harness, plus a /-triggered phrase menu with per-phrase pin, slash-menu, bar-visibility, and click-to-send toggles.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加可拖拽、位置会记住的快捷短语条，以及 `/` 触发的短语菜单；每条短语可单独设置置顶、斜杠菜单、是否上条和点击即发送。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: Renders local audio/video paths as inline, playable previews in DSH chat: replaces paths with <audio>/<video> players backed by same-origin /api/media-preview/* route, with explicit error statuses.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天记录中自动将本地音视频路径渲染为可播放预览：将路径替换为同源 /api/media-preview/* 路由支持的 <audio>/<video> 播放器，并返回明确的错误状态码。

description.en: Windows resource monitor for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar: samples CPU, memory and clock speed once a minute, keeps a 30-day history and draws separate 24h / 7d charts for CPU and memory (with 85% / 90% alert lines) plus a frequency chart that marks load-time throttling. Reports sustained CPU >= 85% (10 min), memory >= 90% (10 min) and frequency <= 70% of maximum clock under load (5 min).
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的 Windows 资源监控：每 60 秒采集 CPU、内存与主频，保留 30 天历史，CPU 与内存各一张 24 小时 / 7 天独立曲线（带 85% / 90% 告警线），另有一张频率曲线标注有负载时的降频，并判定 CPU 持续 ≥ 85%（10 分钟）、内存持续 ≥ 90%（10 分钟）、有负载时频率 ≤ 最高频率 70%（5 分钟）三类异常。

description.en: ChatGPT-style question nav rail with up/down arrow buttons — per-question tick marks on the chat edge, hover-triggered drawer listing every user question with real-time search filter, one-click smooth-scroll jump, and active-question highlight synced to scroll position.
description.zh: ChatGPT 风格问题导航胶囊，带 ⏫⏬ 上下箭头 — 对话区右侧逐条刻度尺，悬停展开抽屉列出全部用户问题，实时搜索过滤、一键平滑跳转、滚动同步高亮当前问题，会话切换自动重挂载。

description.en: Novel generator: builds a world snapshot along a story timeline and, from the latest snapshot and the most recent chapters, deduces the next chapter. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 小说生成器：按时间线生成世界快照，通过世界快照和最近章节自动推演新章节。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Phone-portrait layout shell for the DSH Web UI: the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer opened by swiping from the left, a persistent 56px action bar sits under the composer, and the settings panel plus the model and permission pickers are reflowed for touch. Ships native, merged and floating layout presets, all scoped to html\[data-dshm-mode="mobile"], so desktop, tablet and landscape keep the stock layout.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的手机竖屏布局壳：侧边栏变成左侧右滑打开的抽屉，输入区下方常驻一条 56px 操作栏，设置页与模型 / 权限选择器按触控重排；提供原生、融合、悬浮三套布局预设，全部样式受 html\[data-dshm-mode="mobile"] 作用域保护，桌面、平板与横屏保持官方原样。

description.en: Puts one collapsible row above the sidebar panel icons. Click it to hide the icons, click again to show them. The choice is remembered in the browser. Because folding is done in CSS, icons from plugins you install later are folded too. It does not depend on any other plugin.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板图标上方加一行可折叠的标题。点一下收起图标，再点一下展开，选择会记住。折叠是纯 CSS 做的，所以你以后新装的插件图标也会一起收进去。不依赖任何其它插件。

description.en: Clean and simple TUI.
description.zh: 干净简单的终端交互式界面。

description.en: A mid-run steer input for DeepSeek Harness Web: while the agent works, an input bar appears above the composer to inject modification requests into the next decision via agent.steer(), without stopping the conversation. Drafts persist per session, unread injected messages can be recalled from the bubble, and an optional guiding prefix is supported.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供运行中修改要求输入条：agent 工作时在 composer 上方弹出输入框，通过 agent.steer() 将修改要求注入下一步决策而无需停止对话；输入草稿按会话持久化，消息气泡旁可撤回未被读取的注入，支持可选注入引导前缀。

description.en: Adds a resizable workspace file tree beside the native preview, with directory expansion, filtering of loaded files, and refresh.
description.zh: 在原生预览旁添加可调整宽度的工作区文件树，支持目录展开、已加载文件筛选和刷新。

plugins.name: dsh-mini

description.en: Windows only (needs the Edge WebView2 Runtime): pop the current session into an always-on-top WebView2 mini window with a self-drawn title bar, free resizing and a jump back to the main window; adds full-screen and region screenshots that paste straight into the composer, a "ask about selection" pill for text selected in any application, global hotkeys and a settings section.
description.zh: 仅 Windows（需要 Edge WebView2 运行时）：把当前会话一键弹出为常驻置顶的 WebView2 小窗（自绘标题栏、可自由缩放、可跳回主窗），并附整屏与框选截图直插输入框、任意程序划词后的「问大肥鱼」快捷按钮、全局快捷键与设置页。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.microsoft.com

description.en: Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器：自动发现已安装皮肤，在独立设置页一键互斥切换，热载入无需重启。

description.en: Header chip for the DSH web GUI that shows whether the current Beijing time is inside DeepSeek's API peak window, with a live clock and countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 会话头部高峰指示灯，实时显示当前北京时间是否处于 DeepSeek API 高峰时段，附实时时钟与下一转折倒计时。

plugins.name: dsh-showreel

description.en: Turns the latest completed DSH session turn into a shareable vertical recap video: editable five-scene storyboard, host-side privacy redaction, optional AI polish and TTS narration, MP4/WebM export with PNG cover.
description.zh: 把最近一次已完成的 DSH 任务生成为可分享的竖屏战报视频：五幕可编辑故事板、Host 侧脱敏、可选 AI 润色与配音，导出 MP4/WebM 和 PNG 封面。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds an enhancement chip to the composer input action row, left of the model selector: it rewrites the draft in place using the model already selected in the session, in five styles, with one-click undo and an /enhance slash command.
description.zh: 在输入框动作行的模型选择器左侧加一颗增强芯片：用当前会话已选的模型就地改写草稿，五种风格，可一键撤销，另有 /enhance 斜杠命令。

description.en: Live multi-way tree of the current session's agents in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view and right sidebar, with status, plan progress, tokens, cost (requires dsh-cost-meter), and runtime on every card.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的对话页和右侧边栏中以多叉树展示当前会话的智能体工作流，每个卡片显示状态、计划进度、Token、费用（需挂载 dsh-cost-meter）和运行时间。

description.en: Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.
description.zh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

description.en: Adds a prompt enhancement button to the composer toolbar that rewrites the draft through a model call, keeps @file references verbatim, and offers one-click undo.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏添加增强提示词按钮，调用模型改写草稿，逐字保留 @文件引用，并可一键撤回。

plugins.name: DSH Canvas

description.en: An AI-native multimodal canvas for DSH: preview images, video, audio, 3D models, PDFs, documents, and code; connect ideas and collaborate with agents in a persistent local workspace.
description.zh: AI 原生多模态画布，支持图片、视频、音频、3D 模型、PDF、文档与代码等文件展示与预览；通过节点连线组织素材，与 Agent 共享上下文、协作编辑，内容持久保存在本机。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Developer tools panel for the DSH web UI: file browser with preview, edit, and path-only file mentions; multi-tab terminals with quick commands; Git panel with commit, push, pull, and branch switching; and background job management. UI ported from pi-web-ui.
description.zh: dsh Web UI 开发者工具面板：文件浏览/预览/编辑与路径式文件提及、多终端（快捷命令）、Git 面板（提交/推送/拉取/分支）与后台任务管理。UI 移植自 pi-web-ui。

description.en: Adds Open workspace entries to the sidebar session-row menu and the session header actions slot, opening the session workspace folder in the system file manager.
description.zh: 在工作区侧边栏会话行菜单和会话顶部标题栏提供「打开工作区」入口，用系统文件管理器打开当前会话所属工作区文件夹。

description.en: Re-applies Chinese UI labels to the DSH client modules on every start, so translations survive upgrades.
description.zh: 每次启动自动将 DSH 界面英文工具与状态标签修补为中文，升级 DSH 后自动恢复，无需手动改文件。

description.en: Adds a switch between DeepSeek web chat and the Harness workspace in DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版中提供 DeepSeek 网页聊天与 Harness 工作区之间的切换。

description.en: Editable quick-action buttons beside the DSH composer: send preset text or insert it into the draft, then reorder, move, or resize the buttons. Text-only: runs no host commands and never overwrites an existing draft.
description.zh: DSH 输入框旁的可编辑快捷按钮：发送预设文字，或只填入草稿；可排序、换位置、调大小。纯文字动作，不执行宿主命令；有草稿时不覆盖。

description.en: Better Session Topbar: replaces the session topbar title with a workspace and session breadcrumb, switching workspaces, sessions and subagents from topbar dropdowns; adding a workspace hands off to the host's own directory picker, which is the OS folder dialog on desktop.
description.zh: 更好的会话顶栏：把会话顶栏标题换成工作区与会话面包屑，可在顶栏下拉里切换工作区、会话与子智能体；添加工作区直接交给宿主的目录选择，桌面版就是系统文件夹对话框。

description.en: Collapses the sidebar global-panel rows to a few visible entries and adds a picker for choosing which ones stay, so a long panel list stops squeezing the workspace and session area; rows are hidden only, never unregistered.
description.zh: 把侧边栏的全局面板条目折叠成少量可见行，并提供勾选面板决定留哪几个，条目一多时不再挤压工作区与会话区；只隐藏显示，不注销条目。

description.en: Always-on-top lamp board for macOS: one lamp per agent, one row per session, collapsing to one lamp per running task; a lamp turns blue and blinks while an approval or a question is waiting on you, and the root agent finishing raises a system notification.
description.zh: macOS 系统级置顶灯板：每个 Agent 一盏灯、一个会话一行，收起时一个任务一盏灯；有审批或提问等你处理时该灯转蓝闪烁，根 Agent 结束时发系统通知。

description.en: Keeps the question you are currently on pinned above the composer, with a dropdown of every earlier question that scrolls the conversation back to that turn; questions folded into process groups are expanded first, and Escape, scrolling or clicking outside collapses the panel.
description.zh: 在输入框上方常驻当前提问，另有按时间排列的历次提问下拉，点任意一条把对话视图回退到那一轮；被折进「过程」分组的提问会先自动展开，Esc、滚动或点击面板外即收起。

description.en: Copper-to-oil ratio dashboard for the Shanghai Composite: lag-weighted forecast band and drill-down charts.
description.zh: 铜油比与上证指数看板：滞后加权预测区间与可缩放的联动图表。

description.en: Adds a ✦ button below the DSH composer that rewrites the current draft into a more complete prompt with a single call to the configured default model, keeping the original intent and language, and replaces the draft in place without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框下方加一个 ✦ 按钮，用当前配置的默认模型把草稿改写成更完整的提示词（保持原意与语言），原地替换草稿、不发送。

description.en: Drag-reorders the dsh sidebar panel entries and the conversation view tabs, and moves an entry between the sidebar and the tab strip as a real tab; order and moves are saved locally and survive restarts.
description.zh: 拖拽重排 dsh 左侧栏的插件面板条目与会话顶部标签，并能把条目在侧栏与标签区之间搬移（搬过去是真实标签）；顺序与搬移状态存本机，重启后保留。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop-style selection quoting: select text in a conversation to reply to that passage from a popover, or fork the session into a side chat in the right sidebar with the selection quoted. Quotes sit above the composer as removable cards, are sent as plain Markdown blockquotes in the same format as Claude Code Desktop, and render as clamped quote blocks in sent messages.
description.zh: Claude Code Desktop 风格的选区引用：在对话里选中文字，可在弹窗里针对这段话回复，或把当前会话 fork 成右侧栏的侧边对话并带上引用。引用以可移除的卡片放在输入框上方，按与 Claude Code Desktop 相同的格式作为纯 Markdown 引用块发送，已发送消息里显示为可折叠的引用块。

plugins.name: dsh-gpt-niang-widget

description.en: A GPT/ChatGPT-persona desktop pet pinned to the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI — shows balance, today's usage, peak/off-peak pricing and per-turn cost, with editable bubbles (text, balance, usage, pricing, images, random lines and weighted choices), per-line styles and fonts, a floating quick editor, sound effects, custom character art/animation/audio, and snapping/flipping. 54 GPT-flavored lines across five groups. Its routes, bundle id and data files are namespaced so it can run alongside the whale and Xiaoke widgets. A derivative of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (MIT).
description.zh: 右下角的 GPT / ChatGPT 拟人桌宠「GPT娘」：显示余额、今日已用、峰谷定价与每轮消耗，泡泡内容可编辑（文本、余额、今日、峰谷、图片、随机语句与并列加权选择），支持逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效、自定义角色图/动图/音效与吸附翻转，台词 54 条、分五组；路由、bundle id 与数据文件均与其它桌宠隔离，可与小鲸鱼、小克同时运行。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（MIT）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: DSH审批汉化 — approval dialogs translated to Chinese before they render: DeepSeek-powered, host-side, nothing for React to revert.
description.zh: DSH审批汉化 — 审批弹窗在渲染前自动翻译成中文：DeepSeek 驱动、宿主侧完成，React 重渲染也无法还原。

description.en: Rewrites the draft in the DSH composer into a clearer, more executable prompt through the harness's own LLM routes, showing an original/optimized comparison before you adopt it.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的草稿通过 harness 自身的 LLM 路由改写成更清晰、更可执行的提示词，采纳前先显示原文与优化后的对比。

description.en: Visual goal lifecycle for the DSH web UI: a composer dock to create, multiline-edit, pause, resume, complete and clear session goals with live round progress, plus a phase-dot composer entry and a settings-page goal overview.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供可视化的会话目标生命周期：composer 上方的目标栏支持创建、多行编辑、暂停、恢复、完成与清除并实时显示轮次进度，工具行入口带阶段色点，设置页提供目标总览。

description.en: Native side-by-side chat beside the main conversation: an independent archived DSH session with full native UI, on-demand parent-context retrieval, selection quoting, and a keep-or-delete lifecycle.
description.zh: 在主对话旁边打开原生并排侧聊：独立归档的真实 DSH 会话、按需读取父会话上下文、选文引用与保留或删除的生命周期。

description.en: Shows every session theme in the DSH Web left sidebar immediately on page load by warming the session projection cache at startup; no need to click into a conversation first.
description.zh: 打开页面时左侧边栏直接显示每个会话的主题，无需点进会话。启动时预热会话投影缓存，让冷会话也能显示真实标题。

plugins.name: dsh-xmlans

description.en: Desktop pet for DSH: 兰酱, an angel-winged maid in a transparent always-on-top window who reacts to session states (thinking, working, waiting, done, error), shows task progress and DeepSeek balance, and responds to drags, head pats, pokes and wing touches.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠兰酱：透明置顶窗口里的天使翅膀女仆，随会话状态（思考、工作、等待、完成、出错）做出动作，显示任务进度和 DeepSeek 余额，可以拖动、摸头、戳一下、碰翅膀。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Better Right-Click: right-click menu on file references in the DSH transcript. Copies the absolute path, reveals the file selected in Explorer by reusing and focusing an existing window, and lists every app registered for that file type so you can open it with the one you want. Menu labels follow the DSH display language (Chinese and English). Windows only (Explorer reveal and the registered-apps list use PowerShell).
description.zh: 给正文里的文件引用加右键菜单：复制绝对路径、在资源管理器中定位并选中文件（复用已打开的窗口并置前）、以及列出本机所有能打开该类型文件的程序让你自己选。菜单文案跟随 DSH 界面语言（中文/英文自动切换）。仅 Windows（资源管理器定位与程序列表依赖 PowerShell）。

plugins.name: dsh-pi-tui

description.en: Third-party TUI mode for DeepSeek Harness (dsh --profile pi-tui), built on a vendored pi-tui fork: covers the main session loop plus approvals, commands, session switching and full-text search, as well as presets, skills, model/settings menus and slash commands.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 TUI 模式（dsh --profile pi-tui），基于内置 pi-tui fork 构建：覆盖主会话循环（审批、命令、会话切换与全文搜索），以及预设、技能、模型/设置菜单与斜杠命令。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to dsh-pi-tui-remote.in-process

description.en: Host performance monitor in the right Sidebar: CPU, memory and swap gauges, a GPU clock and VRAM bar, CPU / GPU / motherboard / drive temperatures, and a process table sortable by CPU, memory or name.
description.zh: 右侧栏主机性能监控：CPU、内存、交换内存仪表盘，显卡频率与显存条，CPU / 显卡 / 主板 / 硬盘温度，以及可按 CPU、内存、进程名排序的进程列表。

description.en: Enhanced right-sidebar files panel: rename, create, upload, download (a directory is zipped on the fly), copy the full path and delete from the tree; an editable document renderer for 128 text extensions with Ctrl/Cmd+S save and conflict detection; plus an independent bottom terminal panel with tabs and a quick-command library persisted under the DSH home.
description.zh: 侧边栏文件树增强：重命名、新建、上传、下载（目录当场打包为 zip）、复制完整路径与删除；128 种文本扩展名的可编辑文档渲染器，支持 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存与版本冲突检测；另有一个独立的下侧终端面板，带标签页与持久化在 DSH home 里的快捷命令库。

description.en: Installer entry for the dsh-xswt-tauriapp desktop shell, a Tauri desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness: on the first dsh start after installation it downloads this platform's installer from the release, checks it against the release SHA256SUMS before writing it, and opens it with the system installer. It installs nothing itself and adds no UI to dsh.
description.zh: 桌面外壳 dsh-xswt-tauriapp（一个 Tauri 写的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面壳）的安装引导：安装后首次启动 dsh 时，从发布页下载本平台安装包，先比对 SHA256SUMS、校验通过才落盘，再交给系统安装器打开；插件自己不安装任何东西，也不给 dsh 加界面。

description.en: Inline user message editor: adds a pencil edit button next to Copy below sent user bubbles, switches the bubble in-place into a rounded editor card, and resends via session branch fork or in-session follow-up.
description.zh: 用户消息原位编辑与重发插件：在已发送消息气泡下方复制按钮旁提供铅笔编辑图标，点击原位展开圆角内联编辑框，支持从上一轮末尾分叉回退重发或在当前会话直接追发。

description.en: Cursor and GitHub PR Review style selection toolbar: quote selected text to chat (Cmd+L), write inline comments (Shift+Cmd+L), and batch-insert from a composer dock.
description.zh: Cursor 与 GitHub PR Review 风格划词引用与批注插件：支持划词一键引用到对话（⌘L）、行内展开写批注（⇧⌘L）及输入框上方批注汇总栏一键插入。

description.en: Chinese metaphysics (xuanxue) divination panel and agent tool with nineteen systems: eight chart systems (BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, LiuYao, MeiHua, Da Liu Ren, Qi Men Dun Jia, compatibility charts, Tarot) plus eleven quick references (almanac, solar–lunar conversion, date selection, bone-weight fortune, Xiao Liu Ren, horoscope, numerology, life-curve, feng shui, name analysis, an MBTI-style 16-type questionnaire), with ask-driven, report-style interpretation. BaZi adds exact dayun handover dates, annual suiyun hints, "passing-through" (通关), three-book classical cross-reference, four-mausoleum (杂气) month pattern selection and daily "human element" (人元司权); Zi Wei adds 34 patterns, nine switchable school variants, chained flying transformations and three-way-four-corner composite flights; LiuYao adds yongshen strength, whole-hexagram per-line strength, hidden-spirit release conditions and response-time clues (应期); feng shui covers eight-mansion and Xuan Kong flying stars; name analysis ships a 391-character library with five-grid (五格) numerology and phonetics checks. The DSH panel and the offline page share the same grouped first screen (ask / read a person / pick a date) with recent-used entries and narrow-width folding. All computed locally; networking is off by default. The npm package also ships an offline single-file page (命理排盘.html): double-click to open, every tab included, no server and no network needed.
description.zh: 玄学命理排盘：十九套体系——八套排盘（八字、紫微斗数、六爻、梅花易数、大六壬、奇门遁甲、合盘、塔罗）加十一套速查（黄历、农历互转、择日、称骨、小六壬、星座、生命数字、人生K线、风水、起名、十六型人格问卷），并可按所问之事生成可读报告；八字含交运日、岁运并临/伏吟反吟、通关、三书对照与杂气月取格/人元司权，紫微含 34 格局、九类流派开关、飞星串连与三方四正复合飞化，六爻含用神旺衰、全卦逐爻旺衰、伏神出伏与应期线索，风水含八宅与玄空飞星，起名含 391 字库、五格剖象与音韵检查；宿主面板与离线页共用同一套分组首屏（问一件事/看一个人/查日子），带最近用过与窄屏收纳；纯本地计算，默认不联网。npm 包内另附离线单文件页（命理排盘.html）：双击即开，十九个 tab 齐全，不用起服务、不用联网。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-stock-x

description.en: Financial quantitative workbench and stock ticker: floating ball and drawer panel, real-time A/HK/US/global market quotes, multi-period K-lines and 5-day intraday charts, depth order book, capital flow, sector heat map, and AI investment research.
description.zh: 全景金融量化工作台与股票盯盘：悬浮球与抽屉面板、A/港/美/全球指数实时行情、多周期K线与5日分时、五档盘口、资金流向、板块热点榜与AI投研诊断。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to qt.gtimg.cn

description.en: Full-screen video boot splash — play an mp4 at startup, skip with a click, import your own clip, and non-playable codecs are transcoded to H.264 automatically.
description.zh: 视频开机片头：启动时全屏播放 mp4，点击或 Esc 跳过，可导入自己的视频，浏览器解不了的编码自动转成 H.264。

description.en: Turn your recurring one-liners into capsules above the composer. They reorder themselves by how often you use them, and ask you to fill in {{placeholder}} values before the snippet lands in the draft. Clicking appends rather than replaces, so a half-written draft survives. A drawer adds search, grouping and editing, and everything lives in a Host-side JSON file you can edit by hand.
description.zh: 把每次都得重打的那几句话做成输入框上方的胶囊。它们按使用次数自动重排，带 {{占位符}} 的会先弹框让你填，填完才插入草稿。点击是追加而不是替换，写到一半的草稿不会被冲掉。抽屉里可以搜索、分组、编辑，数据存在 Host 侧 JSON 文件里，可以直接手改。

description.en: Session change-review for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls and renders VS Code-style side-by-side diffs via diff2html, auto-following the theme, with subagent aggregation and one-click revert.
description.zh: DSH 会话修改审查：追踪 write/edit 工具调用，集成 diff2html 实现 VS Code 风格 side-by-side diff，自动跟随主题，支持子代理聚合与一键撤回。

description.en: Keeps the images you pasted or attached in the composer, per session: they are mirrored locally in the browser and handed back through the official draft channel when you return to the conversation or the composer remounts, and dropped as soon as the message is sent or you remove them.
description.zh: 按会话保住输入框里的图片草稿：在浏览器本地留一份镜像，切回该对话或输入框重新挂载时经官方草稿通道放回去；消息一旦发出或你手动移除，就不再见它回来。

description.en: Pasted screenshots become numbered references: each Ctrl+V image is stored in the attachment library under a stable number, listed in a composer-dock thumbnail panel with an image source in the @ menu, and inserted as a reference chip at the caret — automatically after paste when the auto-insert switch is on.
description.zh: 粘贴即编号引用：Ctrl+V 的截图入库后拿到固定编号「图片N」，在输入框旁面板里以缩略图列出，可经 @图片 菜单插入引用；开着「自动插入」时粘贴后直接落到光标处。

description.en: Select text in a conversation to attach a numbered highlight with a colour stored per note, keep every mark in an outline panel that jumps back to its quote, and let a corner self-check badge report style, selector and saved-key problems without opening dev tools.
description.zh: 在对话里划词加批注：编号高亮、每条各记自己的颜色，大纲面板列出全部标记并点一条跳回原文；右下角自检角标不开开发者工具就报出样式、越界选择器与本地存档键的问题。

description.en: Adds a capability panel to the DSH web GUI: browse, install (upload, zip, host path or URL), enable, edit and export skills, and add or edit Claude Code-compatible MCP servers, at global and per-project scope — with project copies, per-project shadow stubs, live mount status and a zero-side-effect connection probe. A session view toggles capabilities for the current conversation only, and a TypeSafe Jev tab scores skills and MCP servers for the session from the input draft. Requires the dsh web shell 0.2.0-rc.2 or later. Forked from chengdb/dsh-plugin-capability-panel; it shares a patch id with that plugin and with pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel, so do not install them together.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中加入能力面板：浏览、安装（上传 / zip / 宿主路径 / URL）、启停、编辑与导出技能，新增与编辑 Claude Code 兼容的 MCP 服务器，覆盖全局与项目双作用域（项目副本、屏蔽占位、默认关闭声明），显示实时挂载状态并提供零副作用连通性探测；会话视图只对当前对话开关能力；「Jev 模型」Tab 用 TypeSafe Jev 按输入草稿为本会话技能与 MCP 打分。需 dsh Web 外壳 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上。fork 自 chengdb/dsh-plugin-capability-panel；与其及 pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel 使用同一 patch id，勿同装。

description.en: /cmd <command> in the composer runs that shell command in the session working directory, sends the command and its output to the model as a user message, and renders the input as a terminal card with exit status, expandable output and copy buttons; a bare /cmd opens an interactive terminal whose transcript is sent to the model with Ctrl+Enter. Runs with its own terminal permissions (danger-full-access) by default; set useSessionPolicy: true to use the session sandbox.
description.zh: 在输入框用 /cmd <命令> 执行当前会话工作目录里的 shell 命令，把命令与输出作为一条 user 消息交给模型，并把这次输入渲染成带退出状态、可展开输出与复制按钮的终端卡片；裸 /cmd 则打开交互终端，Ctrl+Enter 把整段终端内容发给模型。默认以终端自身权限（danger-full-access）执行，设 `useSessionPolicy: true` 改用会话沙箱。

description.en: Agent-team task Gantt chart for the DSH sidebar - one swimlane per teammate, real session-log time on the x-axis, and every shared task drawn with its title and summary. Requires dsh-better-sidebar 0.4.0 or later (the tab has nowhere to register without it).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的 agent team 任务甘特图：每个 teammate 一条泳道，横轴取自真实会话日志时间，条内显示共享任务的标题与简介。需先安装 dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.4.0（没有它，标签页无处注册）。

description.en: Read-only terminal view tab in the conversation header: aggregates bash output, background jobs and persistent terminal sessions from the current session, subagents and Agent Team teammates into one filterable panel, with type and session-scope filters, command/output search, auto-collapse, follow-scroll and a maximize dialog; foreground bash shows final output only. Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 or later (0.2.x).
description.zh: 会话头部只读的「终端」视图标签页：把当前会话、子代理与 Agent Team 队友的 bash 输出、后台任务和持久终端会话聚合为一个可筛选面板，支持类型与会话范围筛选、命令与输出搜索、自动收起、跟随滚动与最大化只读弹窗；前台 bash 仅显示终态输出。需 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 及以上（0.2.x）。

description.en: Snipaste-style screenshot for DeepSeek Harness: press F1 (a real Windows global hotkey) to freeze and dim the whole screen, drag a region, then draw red boxes and click-to-type text annotations with wheel-resizable font; the annotated PNG drops into the composer at native resolution. Esc exits. Windows 10/11.
description.zh: Snipaste 式截图标注：F1 全局热键把整块屏幕定格压暗，鼠标框选后用红色方框与文字标注（点位置输入、滚轮调字号），确认后按原分辨率把标注图放进输入框；Esc 退出。仅 Windows 10/11。

description.en: Adds a four-pointed-star button left of the composer's model selector that rewrites the unsent draft in place — grammar, wording, punctuation and execution order — preserving code, commands, paths, identifiers, numbers and URLs byte-for-byte, answering nothing and never overwriting text typed while it runs. A pencil under every user message reopens that message for editing without touching the draft; because the Harness session log is append-only, an edit forks the conversation before that message rather than rewriting it. A circular restart icon under every reply asks that one question again in a fresh conversation that carries none of the earlier turns. Both are refused while a turn is still answering, and disabled when the reply used a tool that can leave a trace or when the files the message named have since changed. A right-sidebar memory tree draws the conversation as turns, showing what was actually asked and answered, every answer to one question on its own line labelled original, edited or memory-free, newest first, with arrows that re-read an answer in place; right-clicking jumps to a branch or removes it from the plugin's own history.
description.zh: 在输入框模型选择器左侧加一个四角星按钮，发送前就地改写尚未发出的草稿——语法、用词、标点与制作顺序——并逐字节保留代码、命令、路径、标识符、数字与 URL；它不回答请求，也不会覆盖改写期间新输入的文本。每条用户消息下的铅笔可在不碰草稿的前提下重新打开该消息编辑；因为 Harness 的会话日志只追加，编辑是在该消息之前派生分支，而不是改写原消息。每条回复下的圆形重启图标会在一个不含此前任何轮次的全新会话里重新问同一个问题。一轮还在作答时两者都不允许；当这条回复用过会留下痕迹的工具，或该消息提到的文件此后被改过时，两者也会被禁用。右侧栏的记忆树把对话按轮次画出来，显示真正被问和被答的内容，同一个问题的每个回答各占一行并标注为原始、编辑所得或无记忆重问，最新的在最上方，箭头在原处换读该回答；右键可跳转到某个分支，或把它从插件自己的历史中移除。

description.en: Imports SillyTavern AI presets as switchable, editable prompt layers: preserves the raw JSON, edits prompt order and sampler parameters, previews the injected System Prompt, exports back to SillyTavern-compatible JSON, and archives or permanently deletes presets with confirmation. Applies temperature and maximum output tokens to Harness requests; other sampler fields are preserved and exported but not applied.
description.zh: 把 SillyTavern 的 AI 预设导入为可切换、可编辑的提示词层：保留原始 JSON，编辑提示词顺序与采样参数，预览最终注入的 System Prompt，导出为 SillyTavern 兼容 JSON，并支持归档或经二次确认永久删除。仅把 temperature 与最大输出 token 应用到 Harness 请求；其余采样字段只保留并随导出保存。

description.en: A stock market panel for DeepSeek Harness, forked from dsh-xueqiu: A-share/HK/US quotes, K-line and intraday charts, hot lists, search and 7x24 news, plus local holdings with live-computed P&L, host-side price alerts, and a hide switch that unmounts the panel and stops market polling while alerts still fire. Replaces dsh-xueqiu; do not install both.
description.zh: 行情面板（dsh-xueqiu 的衍生版本）：免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、K线/分时、热榜、搜索与 7×24 快讯，并支持本地持仓与按行情现算的盈亏、宿主侧价格提醒，以及一键「行情隐身」——面板卸载、行情请求停发，提醒照常。替代 dsh-xueqiu，请勿与它同时安装。

description.en: Adds a composer button that optimizes the current prompt or designs the next one from the current session and project context.
description.zh: 在输入栏添加按钮，可优化当前提示词，或结合会话与项目上下文设计下一步提示词。

description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: add, edit, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers from Settings → MCP 管理, with JSON export/import, four mcp_manager_* model tools and an HTTP API; install via npx, npm or cross-platform scripts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务管理器：在「设置 → MCP 管理」中新增/编辑/启停/重启/删除 MCP 服务，支持 JSON 导入导出、4 个 mcp_manager_* 模型工具与 HTTP API，可通过 npx、npm 或跨平台脚本安装。

description.en: A live conversation map for DeepSeek Harness web: real-time session tree with subagent lineage, running state, and one-click navigation.
description.zh: DSH 对话地图：当前工作区全部会话的实时树状图，子代理谱系、运行状态一目了然，双击即跳转。

description.en: Shows an elapsed/budget progress bar with a moving head picture under blocking tool calls in the DSH Web conversation flow, and adds a graphical settings page for its style and tool list.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话流的阻塞型工具调用下方显示「已等待/预算」进度条与随进度移动的图片（可换成动图），并提供图形化设置页调整样式与工具列表。

description.en: Edge-style tab groups for the DSH sidebar on Web and Desktop, with nested groups up to three levels, workspace tree, single-list view, recursive sorting, RGB colors, collapsed status summaries, subagent expansion with status, and an approval-gated agent tool for organizing groups.
description.zh: 仿 Edge 标签页分组的 DSH 侧栏会话分组插件，支持 DSH Web / Desktop；提供最多三层的组内分组、工作区树、单列表、递归排序、RGB 自定义颜色、折叠状态汇总、子代理展开与状态联动，以及需要用户审核的 AI 会话整理工具。

description.en: Adds an optimize button beside the composer that analyzes and rewrites the prompt draft with SSE streaming, conversation-context awareness (template vs intent-polish strategies), an edit-continuity memory chain, undo, and model routing with fallback and a connectivity test.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加「优化」按钮：流式分析并改写提示词草稿，支持会话上下文感知（模板/润色双策略）、跨编辑记忆链与撤回，模型路由带 fallback 与连通性测试。

description.en: Groups the sidebar's panel rows: two stay pinned, the rest fold under a collapsible Tools row, and rows can be dragged between the two groups.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板分组：两行常驻，其余收进可折叠的「工具」组，支持拖动互相搬运。

description.en: Third-party menu manager for the DSH Web UI: collects new menu entries added by other plugins into one place, with fold/collapse and pinned menu items.
description.zh: 第三方菜单管理器：统一收纳第三方插件的新增菜单入口，提供常规折叠与固定菜单项。

description.en: Prompt scene picker for DSH: choose a scene from a dropdown and it opens a new session with the prompt already filled in (with {variable} placeholders), so you only tweak and send.
description.zh: 提示词场景选择器：下拉选场景即自动开新会话并填充提示词（支持 {变量}），微调即可发送。

description.en: Erii (Sakura) themed boot splash animation — falling sakura petals, a mint monster mascot with a blossom on its head, and a soft pink progress bar; fades out after ~3 seconds without blocking input.
description.zh: 绘梨衣（Sakura）主题启动加载动画——樱花瓣飘落、头戴樱花的小怪兽、粉色进度条，约 3 秒自动淡出且不阻挡操作。

description.en: Zoom only DSH chat messages and input (80%–200%) using Ctrl shortcuts or settings, with local memory and no sidebar scaling.
description.zh: 仅缩放 DSH 聊天消息和输入区（80%–200%），支持 Ctrl 快捷键、设置调节与本地记忆，不缩放侧栏。

description.en: VS Code-style code editor: sidebar file tree over the workspace, Monaco editing, file read/write, Git status and diff, search, and Markdown preview.
description.zh: VS Code 风格代码编辑器：侧边栏文件树浏览工作区，Monaco 编辑，文件读写，Git 状态与差异，搜索与 Markdown 预览。

description.en: Right-click any session row in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar to color-tag it with a default red, ten palette colors or a custom picker, persisted locally.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话行加右键标色：默认红色、十色色板与自定义取色，颜色本地持久化。

description.en: Moves and resizes the DeepSeek Harness settings panel; its position and size are remembered per browser.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的设置面板可以自由拖动与缩放，位置与尺寸按浏览器记忆。

description.en: Removes the inherited ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE variable from the environment the open-in-app package hands to launched editors, so the desktop host's "Open in ..." launches stop failing with HTTP 502 launch-failed; app.asar is untouched.
description.zh: 修复vscode无法启动，从 open-in-app 包交给被启动编辑器的环境里去掉继承来的 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 变量，桌面端「用其它应用打开」不再以 HTTP 502 launch-failed 失败；不改动 app.asar。

description.en: Per-row display switches for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar's panel entries: a hidden row is still reachable from the More menu, and the choice is kept in localStorage across reloads and restarts.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏的面板入口行加显示开关：隐藏的入口仍可从「更多」菜单打开，选择存在 localStorage 里，刷新和重启都保留。

description.en: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段 550C 全屏开机片头：简易档 4 秒、完整档 16 秒覆写流程，点击或按 Esc 跳过，四套磷光配色。首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸；桌面窗口右上角那条原生按钮条带在片头期间透明化，按钮像浮在动画上。

description.en: About section for the DeepSeek Harness settings: version info, npm latest/next update check with one-click install and auto-restart, and GitHub release history.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中心增加「关于」分区：版本信息、npm 检查更新与一键安装（自动重启）、GitHub 版本更新记录。

description.en: Prompt enhancement for the composer: an "✨ Enhance" button rewrites your draft prompt into a clearer, more structured version with first-principles thinking, grounded in session context, memory and recent conversation; asks clarifying questions in a card when key info is missing, then previews the result before applying it to the input.
description.zh: 输入框提示词增强：✨ 增强按钮用第一性原理、结合会话上下文/记忆/最近对话，把草稿扩写为更清晰、更结构化的提示词；关键信息缺失时以提问卡片澄清，预览确认后再应用到输入框。

description.en: Returns the caret to the session composer on Ctrl+I; the key is rebindable in Settings and works from any region of the desktop window.
description.zh: 按 Ctrl+I 把光标送回会话输入框；可在设置里改键，桌面端窗口内任意区域都生效。

description.en: Read-only goal-tree status strip above the composer: planners see the full node tree, workers see their claimed node, and worker reports call back to the planner session.
description.zh: 输入框上方的只读 goal-tree 状态条：规划者看全树，Worker 只看认领节点，Worker 回报可唤醒规划者会话。

description.en: Tree-style questioning for DSH: click "Ask in tree" on a selection to add a node to the right-sidebar tree and ask inline under it; clicking another node makes it the current parent, so later selections nest there, Alt+click opens a root node, Ctrl+click appends another passage to the same node, double-click jumps back to the quoted text, a red/green dot marks each node as understood or not, and the panel switches between a list view and a horizontal branch graph. "Add to composer" instead puts the quote into the input box as a reference chip, without creating a node. Nodes live in localStorage and nothing is injected into the prompt.
description.zh: 对话里划取文字后点「树形提问」，右栏问题树就多一个节点，问题直接写在节点下；单击别的节点就把它设为当前节点，之后再划取默认挂在它下面，「Alt + 树形提问」新开根节点，「Ctrl + 树形提问」把新段落追加进同一节点；双击节点跳回原文，点左侧圆点标记「懂了」；右上角可在列表与横向分支图之间切换。划取后点「添加到对话」则把引用以 chip 形式插进输入框，不建节点。节点只存在 localStorage，不进提示词。
