description.en: Replaces the DSH sidebar with a fixed 2×4 board of eight standing agent seats; each seat shows its own status, latest tool call, reasoning and result, and a settings switch restores the stock sidebar at any time.
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏换成固定的 2×4 八席看板，每席显示自己的状态、最近一次工具调用、思考与结果；设置里的开关可随时切回原生侧栏。

description.en: Results-only conversation toggle for the Web GUI: hides thinking and tool-call process rows, keeps one live status line while the agent works, restores working animations under prefers-reduced-motion, zh-CN/en localized. Works in the stock composer and inside dsh-split-screen panes; verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 对话「只看结果」开关：隐藏思考与工具调用过程，运行中仅保留一条实时状态行，reduced-motion 环境下恢复活动光影，中英双语。原生输入框与 dsh-split-screen 分屏面板内均可用；已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Split-screen workspace for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - chat with several agents side by side in panes that look and behave exactly like the stock conversation: drag-to-split, live sessions with queued messages and in-pane ask_user/approval cards, per-pane view tabs (Chat/Trajectory/plugin views), a compact TUI composer mode (Alt+T) and pane-focus shortcuts. Requires DSH 0.1.5+.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端分屏工作区 - 多个会话并排聊天，面板观感与原生对话完全一致：拖拽分屏、实时会话（排队消息、面板内 ask_user/审批卡片）、面板内视图标签（Chat/Trajectory/插件视图）、Alt+T 紧凑 TUI 输入模式与面板焦点快捷键。需要 DSH 0.1.5+。

description.en: Expands the assistant reasoning block while it streams and folds it back when done, animated in both directions; the sidebar switch only controls whether that happens automatically.
description.zh: 思考时自动展开、结束时自动折叠，展开与收起都带高度与透明度过渡；侧边栏开关只控制是否自动，动画始终生效。

description.en: Draggable floating card that follows background jobs: a progress bar and percentage parsed from wget/curl/apt/pip output, elapsed time, ETA when present, and the latest output line.
description.zh: 可拖动的后台任务浮动卡片：从 wget/curl/apt/pip 等输出解析进度条与百分比，显示耗时、剩余时间（有则显示）和最新一行输出。

description.en: Keeps the current chat in a movable, resizable floating window when the right file or browser panel enters full view, with a compact input bar, a whale restore button and a return to the original split layout.
description.zh: 右侧文件或浏览器面板进入完整视图时，将原会话保留为可移动、缩放的聊天小窗，支持紧凑输入条、鲸鱼球恢复入口和返回原来的分栏布局。

description.en: Opens the recent sessions in a sheet that floats over the sidebar workspace list, from one row above Settings: rows sorted by last activity with their run state, a draggable height, and a list that settles onto whole rows after stopping. The sheet paints no surface of its own, so it reads as part of the sidebar.
description.zh: 在侧栏「设置」上方加一行入口，展开后最近会话以浮层压在工作区列表上方：按最后活动时间排序、每行带运行状态、高度可拖、滚动停下后自动对齐到整行。浮层不画自己的底色，展开后仍像侧栏的一部分。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面划词，小窗流式给出翻译，并结合这段文字所在的会话上下文解释它在这里的具体含义；面板带可回放的历史记录，也能一键升格为正式会话。

description.en: Chain-of-thought panel for the DSH Web right sidebar: folds the live reasoning stream of each session into turn → step groups carrying the reasoning text and the tool calls made in that step. Only the newest turn is expanded by default and earlier turns collapse to one line; steps are grouped into activity phases by a local rule, the step waiting on a tool is marked, tool failures show their reason, full reasoning text is fetched per step on demand, an all-turn directory searches turn titles, user text and turn numbers locally, and a whole turn can be summarised into a Chinese title with one model call.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧栏的思维链面板：把每个会话的实时思考折成 turn → step 分组，每一步带该步的思考原文与工具调用。默认只展开最新一轮，更早的轮次收成一行；步骤按本地规则合并成阶段块，正在等工具的那一步单独标出，工具失败显示原因，思考原文按步按需取回，全轮目录在本地搜索轮次标题、用户原话与轮号，整轮可用一次模型调用生成中文标题。

description.en: Full-screen ice-and-fire boot intro for DSH: a frost-to-ember boot sequence with typed bilingual logs and a hairline progress line, then Ygritte's five-step identity authorization. Esc skips, Enter or click fast-forwards, and a settings page switches it off/quick/full or replays it; the host half paints the opening frame while the document parses, so the built-in loading card never shows.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一段「冰与火」全屏开机片头：冰霜→余烬的启动动画、双语打字机日志与发丝进度线，随后是 Ygritte 的五步身份授权。Esc 跳过，Enter/点击快进，设置页可切换关闭/简易/完整或随时重播；首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段就注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸。

description.en: Chat quotes for DSH: select text in any message to quote or comment; the quote waits in a Chat quotes chip on the composer (never inside the draft), expands on hover into selected text and your comment, and folds into the message only when you send.
description.zh: 聊天引用：选中消息文字即可引用或评论；引用收在输入卡顶部的「聊天引用 N」芯片里，悬停展开所选文本与用户评论，发送瞬间才进入消息正文。

description.en: Prompt market beside the composer: browse and search three built-in online prompt sources, bookmark or write your own, and insert into the input box.
description.zh: 对话框旁的提示词市场：浏览并搜索三个内置在线提示词源，可收藏或自建，选中即插入输入框。

description.en: Replaces the reasoning-effort dropdown with a draggable snapping slider, and draws 13 canvas effects across five style families (thrust, fluid, fantasy, tech, texture) with three tiers that unlock as the effort level rises. Custom mode combines 10 particle forms with 8 flow trajectories; 9 accent presets and a hex picker recolor every effect, and optional key sounds cover two voice clips, a synthesized duck squeak, a mechanical click and a local audio file.
description.zh: 把推理强度下拉菜单换成可拖拽吸附的滑块，并提供 13 款 Canvas 动效，分属推进、流体、幻境、科技、质感五个家族；动效随推理档位分三阶递进解锁。客制动效可自由组合 10 种粒子形态与 8 种流动轨迹；9 款预设主题色与 Hex 拾色器让全部动效跟随变色，档位吸附音效支持两段语音、合成鸭子叫、机械微触感与本地音频文件。

description.en: Fold the sidebar plugin-panel list to three entries, drag them to reorder, and keep every other panel one click away in a More menu — order and pins persist in localStorage.
description.zh: 侧栏插件面板入口压缩：默认只留三个，按住鼠标拖动排序，其余全部收进「更多」菜单（点名字直接打开，✓/＋ 决定去留），选择和顺序记在 localStorage。

plugins.name: md2chat-dsh-share

description.en: Adds a Share to chat action under each reply: converts the answer to WeChat or WeCom text, ordered segments or a long image, editable-table email HTML, or a downloadable Word document.
description.zh: 在每条回复下加「分享到聊天」：把回答转成微信/企微可直接粘贴的文本、分段或长图、可编辑表格的邮件 HTML，或直接下载 Word 文档。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Takes over the edit/write rows in the chat stream with the official native row shell and collapse behavior; expanding shows per-file code cards with file-type icon, add/delete stats, per-block collapse, highlight/plus-minus toggle, syntax-highlighted unified diff with real file line numbers, and a configurable context margin. Also ships a patch tool (beta, off by default) that applies multi-spot multi-file patches atomically via the *** Begin Patch envelope. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
description.zh: 接管对话流的 edit/write 行：外壳与折叠沿用官方原生行，展开后每个文件一张代码卡片——文件类型图标、增删统计、块级折叠、高亮/±差异切换、语法高亮统一 diff（行号为文件真实行号），改动两侧多显示可调的上下文行。另带 patch 工具（测试版，默认关）：一次调用把多处零散修改/多文件补丁原子化应用（*** Begin Patch 信封，全有或全无）。已归档并冻结在固定版本：作者不再为它适配新版 DSH。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI on narrow screens: reveal drawer with the chat layer on top, drag gestures, bottom-sheet settings panel, composer and header fixes, zero desktop impact.
description.zh: DSH Web 移动端适配：窄屏下聊天页在上/侧栏在下的 reveal 抽屉、拖动手势、设置面板底部卡片上滑、composer 与头部修复，桌面端零影响。

description.en: Three-pane workspace layout with file-tree browsing, file editing, a non-linear conversation mindmap view, and mobile mode support.
description.zh: 三栏工作区布局，提供文件树浏览、编辑文件、非线性会话导图视图，并且支持手机模式。

description.en: Copying rendered math from the chat puts the formula's LaTeX source on the clipboard instead of KaTeX's visual glyph text.
description.zh: 在对话中复制渲染后的数学公式时，剪贴板里得到的是公式的 LaTeX 源码，而不是 KaTeX 的字形文本。

description.en: Select text in the chat to quote it into the composer as an annotation, or to ask about it in a throwaway side panel that leaves no record.
description.zh: 在对话里划词引用进输入框（显示为「N 条注释」小框），或在侧栏一次性小窗里就这段内容提问（不留任何记录）。

description.en: Pins passages selected in a conversation into a per-conversation right-sidebar panel, marks them in the transcript, jumps back to the source passage on click, and quotes a pinned passage into the composer from the selection toolbar or by typing @; the panel tags, searches, filters and exports the pins as a Markdown outline.
description.zh: 把对话中划选的段落固定到按对话隔离的右侧栏面板，在正文里留下持久标记并可点击跳回原文；可从划选浮条或输入框 @ 把已固定的段落引用进消息，片段支持标签，面板可搜索、筛选并导出 Markdown 提纲。

description.en: Improves conversation drafts with optional conversation, memory and project context, side-by-side previews, a dedicated model and one-step restore; never sends messages automatically.
description.zh: 按需结合对话、记忆和项目片段增强草稿，支持对照预览、专用模型与恢复原文，不会自动发送消息。

description.en: Counts keywords inside thinking rows and highlights them once a row is expanded, with a count chip per keyword on the title line that doubles as an on/off switch for that word, per-keyword tint, text colour and text size (10-22px, the same range the host body-text setting uses), typeface, bold / italic / underline and whole-word matching, plus a dedicated settings section.
description.zh: 统计思考行里的关键词并在展开后按词标红；标题行上每个词一个计数徽章，点徽章即单独开关这个词；每个词可设底色、文字颜色、字号（10-22px，与宿主正文尺寸同一区间）、字体、加粗/斜体/下划线与「完整词」匹配；插件有独立的设置分区。

description.en: Adds a tier bar to the DSH composer with three thinking tiers (normal, strict, max), an exclusive loop mode whose three levels run 3, 5 or 8 self-review rounds, and a counter-review toggle that stacks on either; the model reads the current tier through the clarify_tier and forge_level tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里加一条档位条：思考三档（常规 / 严格 / 极致）、互斥的循环模式三档（3 / 5 / 8 轮）、可叠加的对抗审查开关；模型通过 clarify_tier 与 forge_level 两个工具读取当前档位。

description.en: Classic 25/5/15 pomodoro timer for DSH that ties each run to the current session task or a manual project name, with a stats panel, a 365-day heatmap, a draggable floating timer and a corner pill, local JSON storage, and CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 番茄钟：经典 25/5/15 计时，可将每次专注关联当前会话任务或手动输入项目名，内置统计面板与全年热力图，配可拖动悬浮计时卡与角落迷你药丸，数据本地持久化并支持导出 CSV。

description.en: Adds buttons to open the current DSH workspace root in the host file manager.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题和工作区菜单中添加按钮，用系统文件管理器打开当前 Workspace 根目录。

description.en: A six-stop reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness, with a pixel-texture Ultracode mode that sweeps in from right to left and adapts to light and dark themes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的六档推理强度滑条，第六档 Ultracode 会在轨道上铺开一层向左流动的像素纹理，浮层与纹理跟随界面明暗自动切换。

description.en: Groups the composer model picker into customizable official, plugin and relay sources, with hierarchical navigation, an Our Free Model four-category view, and a dedicated settings page. The Our Free Model view needs dsh-our-free-model installed.
description.zh: 将输入框模型选择器按可自定义的官方、插件和中转来源分组，提供分层导航、Our Free Model 四类型目录及独立设置页。Our Free Model 目录需另装 dsh-our-free-model。

plugins.name: dsh-artifact-center

description.en: Artifact center: search, preview and open files produced by DSH conversations.
description.zh: 产物中心：跨工作区检索、预览并打开对话产出的文件。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

description.en: Delivery panel in the DSH sidebar: indexes every image and file sent to the harness (content-addressed attachments plus @-mentioned local paths), rebuilds Taildrop send history per target device from tailscale file cp calls in the session logs, lists incoming files (the Tailscale inbox plus unmarked files in ~/Downloads), and sends new files to a device from the panel with online status and upload progress.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的投送面板：索引所有发给 Harness 的图片与文件（内容寻址附件 + @ 引用过的本机路径），从会话日志里的 tailscale file cp 调用按目标设备还原 Taildrop 投送历史，列出收到的文件（Tailscale 收件箱 + ~/Downloads 里没有下载标记的文件），并能在面板里直接选设备发文件（显示在线状态与上传进度）。

description.en: Native desktop pet for DSH that follows agent activity, supports Codex pet packages, and imports approved pets directly from Petdex without its CLI.
description.zh: 跟随 agent 状态的 DSH 原生桌宠，兼容 Codex 桌宠包，并可在插件内直接从 Petdex 导入已审核桌宠，无需 Petdex CLI。

description.en: Display read_image results in DSH Web and Desktop: complete previews, grouped multi-image galleries, transparency checkerboards, keyboard and touch zoom, and session-authorized loading. Verified with DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 和桌面版展示 read_image 结果：完整预览、多图画廊、透明棋盘格、键盘与触控缩放，使用会话授权加载。已验证 DSH Desktop 0.11.1 / Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

plugins.name: dsh-free-models-hub

description.en: A drawer panel for the DSH web UI with a paginated list of free LLMs; one-click or batch writes each as a custom model provider into Settings, plus a local multi-key rotation proxy.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 右侧的免费模型抽屉面板，分页浏览免费模型，可一键或整页批量把模型写入自定义提供方，并附带本地多 Key 轮换代理。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to blog.4wc.cn

description.en: Decision split view for DSH web UI: a decision summary card in the main window plus the full plan in an independently scrollable side panel, so you can review the whole plan while writing decisions and send them back to the agent with one click.
description.zh: 决策分屏视图：主窗口显示决策摘要卡片，右侧详情栏独立滚动展示完整方案，边看全文边写决策，一键回传 agent。

description.en: Sidebar button that opens a semi-transparent popup for browsing, previewing, downloading and deleting generated images and videos, with a settings page for the media, record and download directories.
description.zh: 侧边栏按钮打开半透明弹窗，浏览、预览、下载和删除生成的图片与视频；设置页可改图片目录、记录目录与下载目录。

description.en: System-audio visualizer for the turn navigator rail: the rail reacts in real time to whatever the default playback device is rendering, with four motion modes (spectrum, pulse, sway, travelling wave), a 16-band logarithmic spectrum from a 2048-point FFT on the host, and live sensitivity, strength, bass-punch and wave-speed controls. Audio is captured host-side through WASAPI loopback, so there is no permission prompt, no microphone and no screen capture. The browser half adds one attribute, one stylesheet, some CSS variables and a sidebar control row, and never patches the official component; switching it off removes the attribute, the stylesheet and the variables, returning the rail to its default styling. Windows only.
description.zh: 轮次导航导轨的系统声音可视化：导轨实时跟随默认播放设备正在渲染的声音律动，提供频谱 / 脉动 / 摆动 / 行波四种运动方式，宿主端用 2048 点 FFT 切出 16 段对数频谱，灵敏度、强度、低频冲击与波速均可实时调节。音频走宿主端 WASAPI 回环采集，因此没有授权弹窗、不用麦克风、不录屏。浏览器半只添加一个属性、一张样式表、若干 CSS 变量和侧栏一行控件，绝不 patch 官方组件；关闭时移除属性、样式表与变量，导轨完全恢复默认样式。仅 Windows。

description.en: Phone-first drawer shell for DSH Web. Collapses the session list into a tap-to-open drawer, keeps header plugin actions, and turns Settings into a full-width sheet.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 做成真正的手机壳：会话列表收成抽屉，点会话自动收起且不弹键盘，设置页改为全宽 sheet。

description.en: Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat.
description.zh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

description.en: Codex-style auto-hiding right-edge turn rail: edge-peek show/hide, per-turn tooltip, in-rail search, and a scrolling 30-turn window for long sessions.
description.zh: Codex 风格自动隐藏右缘轮次导航：靠边浮现、单轮 tooltip、会话内搜索、长会话 30 轮滚动窗口。

description.en: Adds a display-only session group section to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: user-defined multi-level nested groups, drag sessions into groups, and a panel height you can adjust. Host workspace membership and session ownership are not modified.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏新增一个纯展示的会话分组分区：支持自定义多层嵌套分组、把会话拖进分组、调整分区高度；不修改 Host 的工作区归属与会话所有权。

description.en: Renders a ui-blocks file named by a ::dsh-ui <name> \[res=WxH]:: line in a sandboxed canvas, and turns an element token into a composer chip that serializes back to the token verbatim.
description.zh: 把 ::dsh-ui <name> \[res=WxH]:: 指向的 ui-blocks 文件渲染到沙箱画布，并把元素标记变成输入框 chip，回写时原样还原为标记。

description.en: Requires the ui-ux-pro-max design skill to be installed; this plugin only gates it. Adds a switch to the DSH sidebar footer that enables or disables the ui-ux-pro-max design skill at runtime; the choice is stored in the profile settings.
description.zh: 需先安装 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，本插件只做门控。在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个开关，一键启用/停用 ui-ux-pro-max 设计技能，选择保存在 profile 设置里。

description.en: Split-screen panel for the Web UI: draggable panes, each rendering one Session's real conversation, with unread dots and a layout saved per browser.
description.zh: 网页端分屏面板：可拖拽的窗格，每个窗格渲染一个会话的完整对话；窗格标题带未读点，布局按浏览器保存。

description.en: Composer prompt polisher: a button in the input tool row rewrites the current draft through the session model (workflow engine, enabled automatically) or an OpenAI-compatible standalone API with host-side key storage, backfills the rewritten text with a replace/give-up dialog when the draft changed mid-run, and ships concise/structured style presets, custom templates with a {draft} placeholder, one-click restore from the status dock and reference-chip protection.
description.zh: 输入框提示词优化：一键把当前草稿交给会话模型（自动启用 workflow 引擎）或 OpenAI 兼容独立 API（密钥只存宿主侧）改写并回填，草稿中途变更时弹出替换/放弃确认；提供 concise/structured 风格预设、自定义模板（{draft} 占位符）、状态条一键还原与引用记号保护。

description.en: Adds an edit action to finalized assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness, letting you rewrite the reply text or reasoning chain; the edit is saved as a surface replacement.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 已完成的助手回复增加编辑入口，可改写正文或思维链，改动以 surface replacement 形式保存。

description.en: Turns each produced-file chip into a per-file menu: open the file, copy its path, reveal it in the native file browser, or open a terminal cd-ed into its directory.
description.zh: 把每个产物文件卡片变成按文件操作的下拉菜单：打开文件、拷贝路径、在系统文件浏览器中定位，或打开终端并进入其目录。

description.en: A tiny always-on floating tree of the DSH workspaces, conversations and subagents that are running, waiting on you or on a schedule — live running state, who is waiting for your call, per-row model, scheduled-run countdowns, other local dsh instances with their ports, and local claude/codex CLI processes with their codex subagent threads.
description.zh: 一张常驻角落的迷你 agent 树：按 workspace → 对话 → subagent 实时展示谁在跑，等你拍板的会话琥珀色置顶，行内显示模型与定时任务倒计时；同时接上本机其它端口的 dsh 实例（会话数 / subagent 数可展开），并列出本机 claude/codex 进程及其子对话。

description.en: A floating whale-girl pet in the DSH web GUI: every hour it takes one article from a bundled 33-essay corpus of Mao Zedong's selected works and puts a cited line with its source link, one of six business angles (customer, project, organisation, cash flow, decision, self-discipline) and a one-line nudge for a founder into a bubble capped at 200 characters. Ships the maoxuan-pet preset and a maoxuan-vademecum skill over the same corpus, four poses, quiet hours and a daily cap.
description.zh: DSH 网页右下角的鲸鱼娘桌宠「小毛」：每小时从内置的 33 篇毛选语料里挑一篇，把一句带来源链接的原文、六个落点之一（客户 / 项目 / 组织 / 现金流 / 决策 / 自律）和一句说给你听的具体督促放进不超过 200 字的气泡；另带 maoxuan-pet preset 与 maoxuan-vademecum skill，可以顺着同一份语料问「这一步该怎么走」，四帧立绘，支持免打扰时段与每日上限。

description.en: Collects every DSH plugin sidebar entry into one collapsible floating dock at the corner of the Web GUI, with a switch that hides the original icon column and a deep-linked list of installed plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧栏里所有插件的入口收进一张可折叠的浮动小卡片：顶部开关决定是否收起原侧栏图标列，点一行直达对应面板，另有全部已安装插件的深链列表。

description.en: A row of quick-phrase buttons in the DSH composer: one click sends "please continue" or any saved phrase, so a stalled agent keeps working without touching your draft.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框底栏放一排可自定义的快捷语按钮：点一下发送「请继续」等快捷语，把卡住的 agent 一键叫醒，且不覆盖你写了一半的草稿。

description.en: Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for you - auto-maximize (keeps the window buttons) or true fullscreen on launch, then maximize / restore / minimize / always-on-top anytime. It quits only after a native confirmation dialog - Esc, double Esc, or Ctrl+Q; in fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen first. The window channel installs itself, so no script or Python is needed; the first install takes effect after two DSH restarts.
description.zh: 如果你嫌每次打开 Harness 都要手动全屏，这个插件可以帮你自动铺满：启动时自动最大化（保留右上角窗口按钮）或真全屏；随时可最大化／还原／最小化／窗口置顶；退出前弹原生确认框，快捷键可选 Esc、双击 Esc 或 Ctrl+Q，且全屏下 Esc 先退出全屏。窗口通道由插件自己安装，无需脚本或 Python，首次安装需重启两次 DSH 生效。

description.en: Sets the DSH web client conversation column to a percentage of its own width (40-100, default 100 = full width) instead of the built-in 680-920px reading measure, edited from a collapsible card under Settings > Plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 客户端对话列宽度设为其自身宽度的百分比（40–100，默认 100 即铺满整列），取代内置的 680–920px 阅读宽度，并在「设置 > 插件」中提供可折叠的调整卡片。

description.en: A Codex-style right side panel for the DSH Web UI — session artifacts browser (live file tree, scan include, preview, reveal) plus a side chat that forks the current session with a model picker, human-pacing scheduled runs and smart send-to-bottom scrolling.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 Codex 式右侧面板——会话产物浏览（文件树、扫描收录、预览、访达定位）+ 继承当前会话上下文的侧聊，支持模型选择器、拟人化定时调用、发送吸顶与智能滚动。

description.en: SoulFusion-style personalization: 9 response styles, custom instructions, persona cards, per-session switching, long-term memory with audit trails.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个性化设置：9 种回复风格、自定义指令、人设卡、会话级切换、带审计的长期记忆。

description.en: Learning Mode toggle in the input toolbar: injects a teaching prompt into the current session so the assistant introduces a topic, teaches it, tests it, and corrects mistakes, rendering graded quizzes through GenUI. Requires the GenUI plugin (@changfenhuang/dsh-genui); without it the teaching text still works but quizzes, sliders and charts degrade to plain text.
description.zh: 输入框工具栏的学习模式开关：为当前会话注入教学提示词，按「引入知识点—学习—测试—反馈纠错」引导，并用 GenUI 生成可判分的互动测验。需先安装 GenUI 插件（@changfenhuang/dsh-genui）；未安装时教学文字仍生效，但测验、滑块与图表会退化为纯文本。

description.en: A port of the T3 Code model picker into the composer: a provider rail, search results grouped under provider headings, favorites kept in the browser, unavailable-provider badges, and Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 jump shortcuts for the first nine rows of the visible list.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的模型选择器移植到 DSH 输入框：提供方侧栏、按提供方分组的搜索结果、浏览器本地收藏、不可用提供方标记，以及用 Cmd/Ctrl+1..9 直接选中可见列表的前九行。

description.en: A T3 Code-style New Session screen for the composer: a "What should we build in <project>?" headline whose project name opens a workspace menu, a reasoning-effort picker in the composer tool row, and a git branch strip under the card that searches local and remote refs and switches with git checkout.
description.zh: 把 T3 Code 的新会话界面移植到 DSH 输入框：标题「What should we build in <project>?」里的项目名可点开工作区菜单，工具栏里新增推理强度选择器，卡片下方新增 git 分支条，可搜索本地与远程引用并用 git checkout 切换。

description.en: Session-context surfaces ported from T3 Code: a session-row hover card showing machine, git branch, model, agent preset, approval policy and token usage, a status pill covering pending approval, awaiting input, working, error and subagent work, a provider and model chip, a per-session header strip, a lineage breadcrumb, row-menu actions that copy the context or run DSH compaction, and a preference row in DSH Settings for choosing which facts appear. Nothing is added to the composer.
description.zh: 移植 T3 Code 的会话上下文界面：会话行悬浮卡显示机器、Git 分支、模型、代理预设、审批策略与 token 用量，状态标签覆盖待审批、等待输入、运行中、错误与子代理工作，另有提供方与模型标记、会话头部信息条、血缘面包屑、可复制上下文或执行 DSH 压缩的行菜单操作，以及位于 DSH 设置中用于选择显示哪些事实的偏好行。输入框区域不新增任何元素。

description.en: Adds a Custom CSS section to Settings for adjusting dialog dimensions, font sizes, full-window wallpapers, and inspecting stable selectors.
description.zh: 在设置界面中调节弹窗尺寸、字号、全屏背景图与选择器速查，热注入自定义 CSS。

description.en: Adds a configurable bubble behind assistant replies, with an optional liquid-glass material and matching chrome for process, tool-call and reasoning rows.
description.zh: 给助手回复加一层可调节的气泡底，可选液态玻璃材质，并让过程、工具调用与思考等周边行同步。

description.en: Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings.
description.zh: 动态心情图标：favicon、侧栏字标与首页标题随会话状态切换 bloub 表情动画（执行中 / 等输入 / 完成 / 空闲），8 种形状、12 种颜色与自定义文字均可在设置页配置。

description.en: Renders the seven-layer SQLite store of meow-memory as a live 3D star map, with draggable nodes, layer rings and a click-through detail panel. Requires the meow-memory plugin and Node 22.5+.
description.zh: 把 meow-memory 的七层记忆库实时画成 3D 星图，光点可拖拽、可按层筛选，点开可看全文与元数据；需先安装 meow-memory 插件，并要求 Node 22.5+。

description.en: Plan / Build mode switcher for DeepSeek Harness: an always-visible dropdown in the composer beside the permission control that switches the current session both ways through the shipped /plan and /plan off commands, plus a Default mode row in Settings → General that decides the starting mode for newly created sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Plan / Build 模式切换：在输入框「完全权限」旁常驻一个下拉框，经内置的 /plan 与 /plan off 命令双向切换当前会话；设置 → 通用里另有一行「默认模式」，决定新建会话的起始模式。

description.en: Adds drag-to-split conversation panes and horizontal draggable tabs to DSH, preserving each tab’s reading position and restoring the layout after refresh or restart.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供拖拽分屏和横向会话标签，保留每个标签的阅读位置，并在刷新或重启后恢复布局。

description.en: Floating workspace file-tree browser for the Web GUI with line-numbered syntax highlighting and Markdown preview.
description.zh: 悬浮工作区文件树浏览器：带行号的代码语法高亮与 Markdown 富文本预览。

plugins.name: dsh-QiuYaTools

description.en: AI animated themes, computer control, standalone windows, attachment previews, Git management, session pop-outs and annotations, cross-app file drag-and-drop, and AI prompt suggestions. Computer control is enabled from the settings; on macOS it needs Screen Recording, Accessibility and Input Monitoring permission, Windows standalone windows need the Edge WebView2 runtime, and prompt suggestions and AI themes consume extra model usage.
description.zh: AI 智能动效主题、电脑操控、独立窗口、附件预览、Git 管理、会话分窗与批注、跨应用文件拖拽、AI 提示词。电脑操控需在设置里开启；macOS 上需授予屏幕录制、辅助功能与输入监控权限，Windows 独立窗口需 Edge WebView2 运行时；提示词建议与 AI 主题会额外消耗模型用量。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Preset workbench for editing per-agent personas, system prompt sections and tool descriptions, selecting tools and skills, previewing request context, and importing or exporting JSON/YAML configurations.
description.zh: 预设工作台：逐方案编辑人设、系统提示词段和工具描述，选择工具与技能，预览请求组成，并通过 JSON / YAML 导入导出配置。

description.en: Codex-style /side side conversations for DeepSeek Harness: a temporary fork of the current chat in a floating panel, inheriting context without interrupting the main task.
description.zh: Codex 风格 /side 侧边对话插件：在当前对话旁开一个浮动分叉面板，继承上下文、不打断主任务。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI: sprite-sheet animation, agent state linkage, drag, alarm (daily/one-shot) and pomodoro widgets, skin picker with preview.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物：精灵图动画、agent 状态联动、拖拽、闹钟（每天/一次）与番茄钟，皮肤下拉选择 + 预览。

description.en: Adds a sidebar entry that opens a full-screen 3D gallery of four procedural landmark models — the Eiffel Tower, the Great Wall, the Forbidden City and the Taj Mahal — plus a second entry with five quiet rooms.
description.zh: 左侧边栏加一个全屏 3D 展厅，看四座程序化建模的地标——埃菲尔铁塔、长城、紫禁城、泰姬陵——另带一个「五间安静的屋子」入口。

description.en: Fold the DSH left sidebar's plugin entries into a single 「插件列表」 row with grouping and custom ordering, giving vertical space back to the workspace and session list; expanding restores the full entry list.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧那排插件入口折成一行「插件列表」，支持按组归类与自定义顺序，把纵向空间还给工作区与会话列表；展开即恢复完整入口。

description.en: Annotate quoted answer text in the transcript: each selection keeps its quote plus a note of your own, notes pile up as chips in the composer and travel with the message, and two or more also get a chip above the input to jump back or clear them. The chips need dsh-paste-chip installed; without it each note is a plain text line in the draft.
description.zh: 划选回答文字就地加注释：保留原文引用加自己写的备注，每条在草稿里变成一枚胶囊，多条一起随消息发出；两条以上时输入框上方会多一个胶囊用来跳回原文或全部清除。胶囊需另装 dsh-paste-chip，否则每条注释在草稿里是一行纯文本。

description.en: Reasoning-effort slider for the DeepSeek Harness composer: drag through the thinking levels the current model declares and release to write the chosen level into the session. An auto band escalates one level after a tool error and another after two or more, and optional model routing picks a provider/model per task type.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框里的推理强度滑杆：按当前模型声明的思考档位拖动，松手把档位写入本会话；可选「自动区间」在工具报错后逐档上调，另有可选模型路由按任务类型挑 provider/model。

description.en: Collapses long pasted text into an expandable chip in the composer: hover shows the body and where it came from, sending expands it back in place, and long text written by other plugins is taken over the same way.
description.zh: 长文本粘贴自动折叠成可展开的胶囊：悬停看正文与出处，发送时按原位展开；其他插件写入的长文本同样接管。

description.en: Lets the DSH web UI attach files of any type as pathless @-mentions: pick a workspace file from the @ menu or drop one into the composer, and the agent reads it directly.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页以无路径 @提及 附加任意类型文件：可从 @ 菜单挑选工作区文件，或拖入输入区，Agent 直接读取。

description.en: Extends the DSH web chat drag-and-drop to accept every file type: non-image files are saved into the active session workspace so the agent can read and use them.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页聊天支持拖拽任意类型文件：非图片文件保存到当前会话工作区，供 Agent 读取使用。

description.en: Enables or disables MCP servers from Settings → MCP Servers: stops or starts each @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client connection immediately and persists the change across restarts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置 → MCP 服务器中直接启用或停用 MCP：即时停止或启动每个 MCP 客户端连接，并持久化，重启后依旧生效。

plugins.name: dsh-inline-comments

description.en: Annotate on selection, persist through refresh; send the notes with your message and the model answers each one.
description.zh: 选中即批注，刷新亦留存；随消息发送，模型逐条回应。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Render OpenUI Lang answers as interactive cards or reading articles in DSH chat, with maps, charts, forms, PNG export and standalone interactive HTML export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中把 OpenUI Lang 答案渲染成交互卡片或阅读式文章，支持地图、图表、表单、PNG 图片导出和独立交互 HTML 导出。

description.en: Web chat entry for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar button opening chat.deepseek.com in a dedicated desktop window under dsh-desktop, with in-webview fallback for plain web environments.
description.zh: 网页对话入口插件：侧边栏一键打开 chat.deepseek.com 独立窗口（dsh-desktop 桥接），纯网页环境自动回退内嵌打开。

description.en: A dsh web plugin that wraps the running Harness in a native Windows desktop window: it bundles a Wails v3 desktop client (so installing the plugin is enough), probes the web port and writes the ~/.dsh/dsh-web-port.json protocol file for the client, registers a system tray, desktop/Start Menu shortcuts and a startup autostart toggle, and the client can start dsh itself if it is not running.
description.zh: 把 dsh web 界面封装成原生 Windows 桌面窗口，内置桌面客户端，带系统托盘、开机自启与协议文件分发。

description.en: Type Markdown, see it rendered live — Open-WebUI-style composer for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web, with syntax-highlighted code blocks, task lists, format toolbars and smart paste.
description.zh: 打 Markdown，边打边渲染——给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 输入框带来 Open WebUI 风格的实时编辑体验，代码块语法高亮、任务列表、格式工具栏、智能粘贴。

description.en: Play a local video behind the DeepSeek Harness chat UI, with play/pause, opacity, scrim and fit controls.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面背后循环播放本地视频，支持播放/暂停、不透明度、遮罩与填充调节。

description.en: Manages CSS and JS snippets for the DSH web GUI, injecting enabled CSS as style elements and running enabled JS in the page, with a sidebar-footer quick toggle, its own page in the Settings navigation, and optional folder or Gist sync.
description.zh: 管理 DSH Web 界面的 CSS 与 JS 代码片段：启用的 CSS 注入为 style 元素，启用的 JS 在页面内执行；提供侧栏底部快捷开关，并在设置导航里有自己的页面，并可选本地文件夹监听与 Gist 同步。

description.en: Shows the linked COROS watch model and cumulative activity days in the Web UI, expanding to a one-line review and suggestion when clicked.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中常驻显示已绑定的高驰手表型号与累计运动天数，点击展开一句话点评与建议。

plugins.name: dsh-pricing-badge

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API peak and off-peak hours, the current model's output price and the account balance in the Web UI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中显示 DeepSeek API 高峰/空闲时段、当前模型的输出价格与账户余额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A Settings page for the memo plugin suite: edits the AI route, the archived-session summary language, length and copy, and the GitHub repository URL through DSH Web's own Settings surface, with per-field reset and a save that reaches the running memo service without a restart.
description.zh: 备忘插件套件的设置页：在 DSH Web 自带的 Settings 界面里修改 AI 路由、归档会话总结的语言、长度与文案，以及 GitHub 仓库地址，支持逐字段恢复默认，保存后无需重启即作用于运行中的备忘服务。

description.en: Aipx toolkit: skills plus a Hub Console that fronts every MCP server with ~4 meta tools — server pool health, per-tool enable/disable, a tool catalog, and a search playground showing exactly what mcp_search hands the model.
description.zh: aipx 工具包：技能之外还有 Hub Console 控制台——用约 4 个元工具代理全部 MCP 服务器，含服务器池健康、工具级启停、工具目录，以及直观展示 mcp_search 返回结果的搜索试验场。

description.en: Renders mermaid code blocks in the chat as diagrams in place (flowchart, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, pie), with zoom, source toggle, copy PNG and SVG download.
description.zh: 将聊天中的 mermaid 代码块原位渲染为图表（流程图/时序图/类图/状态图/ER图/甘特图/饼图），支持放大、源码切换、复制 PNG 与下载 SVG。

description.en: Provider logos and model IDs in the DSH model picker, registered as a label decorator on the official conversation.input.model.label slot; providers match by token, display name, model ID and explicit override, falling back to a letter monogram when unknown.
description.zh: 在 DSH 模型选择器中显示各提供商的 logo 与模型 ID：通过官方 conversation.input.model.label 插槽注册标签装饰器；按 token、显示名、模型 ID 与显式覆盖四级匹配，未知提供商回退为字母 monogram。

description.en: Selection quoting and anchored annotations across DSH chats and document previews: numbered quote blocks stay visible in the composer and in sent messages and click back to the source, notes from docx / PDF / Markdown / code / Excel-range previews collect into one batched send, and each note can be dictated by voice.
description.zh: DSH 会话与文档预览里的划词批注：带编号的引用块在输入框和已发送消息里始终可见、点一下跳回原文；docx / PDF / Markdown / 代码与 Excel 选区批注可攒起来一次性发送；批注框支持语音输入。

description.en: A2UI-inspired agent-authored application cards with a persistent machine directory, SSH probes, and reviewed monitoring and control actions. SSH probes require OpenSSH (ssh, ssh-keyscan, ssh-keygen).
description.zh: 受 A2UI 启发的模型生成应用卡片，提供持久机器目录、SSH 探测及经审阅授权的监控与控制操作。SSH 探测需 OpenSSH（ssh、ssh-keyscan、ssh-keygen）。

description.en: Prompt optimizer for the composer: a button in the tool row rewrites your draft through a model channel you already configured, streaming into a panel that floats above the composer without taking up layout. Your draft changes only when you click Accept — and Accept is refused while the answer is still streaming, so a half-finished reply can never be written back. It asks first when the draft carries @ references or attachments, which a whole-draft replace would flatten into plain text. No global keyboard shortcuts, and no API key ever reaches the browser: the host half makes the call.
description.zh: 输入框提示词优化：工具行一个按钮，用你已配置的模型渠道改写草稿，结果流式输出到贴着输入框上沿、不占布局的面板里。只有点「采纳」才会替换草稿，且生成中拒绝采纳——半截答案不会被写回；草稿含 @引用或附件时先确认一次，因为整段替换会把它们降级成纯文本。没有任何全局快捷键，密钥也不会进浏览器（模型调用在宿主半边完成）。

description.en: TRAE-style conversation rollback rebuilt for DSH 0.1.7-rc.2: per-turn file checkpoints restore touched files and truncate the model context in place under the same session id. Adds a /rollback doctor framework-contract self-check, an affected-file diff preview computed against the current on-disk state so it stays correct after a restart, a one-click undo-last action with a Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcut, a setting for whether rolled-back messages stay hidden, and English UI text.
description.zh: TRAE 式「回退到本轮对话发起前」：按轮次建立文件检查点，回滚工作区文件并在同一 session id 下原位截断模型上下文，已适配 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2。新增 /rollback doctor 契约自检、按当前磁盘状态实时计算的受影响文件 diff 预览（重启后依然准确）、一键「回退最近一轮」（快捷键 Ctrl+Shift+Z）、「回退后隐藏已回退消息」开关，以及英文界面文案。

description.en: Windows only, needs the NetEase Cloud Music client installed. NetEase Cloud Music player for the DSH Web UI: a mini bar that expands into a liquid-glass card with search, synced lyrics and volume, a click-to-open spinning vinyl view, and it signs in with the local NetEase client account (cookie decrypted on this machine only) so VIP tracks play and the client current song can be pulled in.
description.zh: 仅 Windows，需本机装有网易云音乐客户端。DSH Web 的网易云音乐播放器：收起是迷你播放条，点开是液态玻璃卡片（搜索 / 歌词 / 音量），点封面区切换成旋转黑胶视图；自动使用本机网易云客户端账号登录（cookie 仅在本机解密），VIP 曲目可播，并可把客户端正在播放的歌一键拉进来。

description.en: Declutter the DSH settings nav: fold third-party plugin entries under collapsible group rows, with bookmark-style custom groups, a fold toggle, and auto classification (market tags → name rules → your AI model).
description.zh: 设置面板导航整理：第三方插件入口折叠为可展开的分组行，支持书签式自定义分组、折叠开关与自动分类（市场标签 → 名称规则 → AI 模型三级兜底）。

description.en: Adds prompt optimization, cancellation, and undo controls to the DeepSeek Harness composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话输入框提供提示词优化：优化过程中可取消，完成后可一键撤回。

description.en: Set the DSH Harness conversation flow's font, font size and line spacing, plus the padding between the conversation text and the window edges.
description.zh: 设置DSH Harness对话流字体、字号行间距，以及对话文字到窗口边缘的留白。

description.en: Codex-style session archiving: hovering a sidebar conversation row reveals an Archive icon at the far right; one click archives the session via the official workspace archive API.
description.zh: Codex 风格会话归档：鼠标悬浮侧边栏会话行时，最右侧浮现 Archive 图标，一键归档会话。

description.en: Draws circles, arrows, boxes and text on the DSH image preview, keeps every mark selectable so it can be dragged, scaled or re-edited later, and attaches the flattened PNG to the composer at the original image resolution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的图片预览上圈选、画箭头、方框与文字，每一笔都能再选中拖动、缩放或改字，并把原分辨率的标注图作为附件放进输入框。

description.en: Upload files and folders straight into the conversation — images attach as real message blocks, text content is written into the composer draft, folders land by directory structure.
description.zh: 把文件与文件夹直接传进对话——图片以真实图片块加入消息，文本内容写入输入框草稿，文件夹按目录结构落盘。

description.en: Whale tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a Windows system-tray app and a macOS menu-bar app that start/stop the dsh service, summon the Web UI, restart and top up — running independently of the dsh process, like a Steam launcher for dsh.
description.zh: 大肥鱼 —— DeepSeek Harness 的托盘 / 菜单栏启动器：Windows 右下角托盘 + macOS 右上角菜单栏，一键开关 dsh 服务、唤起 Web、重启、充值，独立于 dsh 进程运行，类似 Steam 之于游戏。

description.en: Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar multi-column kanban whose cards run in real DSH agent sessions and can also be scheduled with cron expressions, executed host-side even with the browser closed.
description.zh: 侧边栏多列任务看板：卡片交给真实 DSH 智能体会话执行，支持 cron 定时（Host 侧到点执行，关浏览器也生效）。

description.en: Plugin and skin collection for the DSH Web UI: task board, Git graph, right-side panel, remote mobile UI, pet, live token stats, and a skin center.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件与皮肤合集：任务看板、git 图、右侧面板、远程移动端 UI、桌宠、实时 token 统计与皮肤中心。

description.en: Right-sidebar file-preview enhancement built on `dsh-better-sidebar` (required — without it the plugin stays inert): a floating find bar for any text file (Ctrl+F, literal or regex, case-sensitive, match counter, next/previous) plus a collapsible Structure panel that lists classes, methods and file-level variables for Java, JavaScript, TypeScript and Python and an element outline for HTML (including .vue/.svelte), with click-to-line jumps. Read-only, no separate tab.
description.zh: 基于 `dsh-better-sidebar` 的右栏文件预览增强（必须先装它，否则插件静默不生效）：为任意文本文件提供漂浮查找条（Ctrl+F，字面量或正则、区分大小写、命中计数、上一个/下一个），并在代码右侧提供可折叠的「结构」面板——Java、JavaScript、TypeScript、Python 列出类/方法/文件级变量，HTML（含 .vue/.svelte）给元素大纲，点条目跳到对应行。只读，不注册独立页签。

description.en: Floating GPU monitor for the DSH Web UI: a compact, draggable strip with one row per discrete GPU (exact name, utilization, VRAM, temperature, power draw) from nvidia-smi, stays visible over side panels and side cards, with a top-VRAM-process list when the driver reports it; degrades to an n/a pill on machines without an NVIDIA driver.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面内置的悬浮 GPU 监控：紧凑可拖动的条带，每张独立 GPU 一行（精确名称、利用率、显存、温度、功耗），数据来自 nvidia-smi；侧边面板或侧边卡片打开时保持在最上层；驱动支持时还列出显存占用最高的进程；无 NVIDIA 驱动的机器会退化为 n/a 胶囊。

description.en: Pixel-art reasoning-effort slider for DSH Web with continuous 0–100 dragging, 16ms throttled writes, snap-to-level commits, and a WebGL ember fire that ignites as the slider moves.
description.zh: 炭灰余烬风格的 DSH Web 像素推理强度滑块：以近黑木炭、暗红裂纹和橙红高温核心呈现 4px 像素化 WebGL 火焰，拖动时逐档点燃；支持 0–100 无极拖动、16ms 节流写入与松手吸附。

description.en: Lists every entry that can appear in the left sidebar and gives each panel entry its own hide/show switch from a section in Settings.
description.zh: 列出所有可以出现在左侧菜单里的功能，并在设置中逐个隐藏或显示面板入口。

description.en: CET-4/CET-6 vocabulary trainer in a draggable, minimizable floating window, so you can study while the model is thinking: 5,805 words bundled from ECDICT; flip cards graded known, fuzzy or unknown, plus multiple-choice quizzes whose distractors are easily confused words; Ebbinghaus-style spaced repetition with due reviews and extra practice; a configurable daily quota of new words; US and UK pronunciation streamed from an online dictionary, falling back to local text-to-speech while offline; and an optional setting that opens the window automatically while a session is running. Progress and window geometry are kept in the browser profile.
description.zh: 四六级背单词悬浮窗，模型思考时随手背：窗口可拖动、可最小化并记住位置；内嵌 ECDICT 提取的 5805 词；翻卡三键评分（认识/模糊/不认识）与形近词干扰的选择题两种模式；艾宾浩斯间隔复习，配到期复习与加练；每日新词数可调；发音取在线词典的真人美式与英式录音，断网时回落本地文字转语音；可开启「会话运行时自动弹出」。进度与窗口位置保存在浏览器配置里。

description.en: One-click thumbs up/down feedback UI that injects rating summaries into model context.
description.zh: 一键点赞/点踩反馈 UI，评分摘要自动注入模型上下文。

description.en: WYSIWYG Markdown notes editor in the DSH right sidebar, with tabbed documents, table editing, chat integration, assistant read/write tools, and local file export.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的所见即所得 Markdown 笔记编辑器，支持多标签、表格编辑、对话联动、模型读写与保存到本地文件。

description.en: Browser and mini-program element annotations with collapsible composer notes and source locations.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供网页与小程序元素注释、折叠注释附件及源码定位。

description.en: Rewrites drafts with one model call or predicts the next reply when empty; independent tasks, safe draft replacement, result previews, and original-text recovery.
description.zh: 输入框有内容时单次调用优化草稿，空白时预测下一句；两类任务独立，支持草稿保护、结果预览和原文恢复。

description.en: All-in-one bundle for DSH: the native Windows desktop window (WebView2), DeepEye vision (GLM-4V-Flash), and voice input (mic button) in a single install.
description.zh: DSH 三件套全家桶：Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）+ DeepEye 视觉（GLM-4V-Flash）+ 语音输入（麦克风按钮），一条命令装齐。

description.en: Native Windows desktop window (WebView2) for DSH: one-command install, auto-fetches the app zip from GitHub Releases, creates a desktop shortcut, and adds a desktop_launch tool to start it from chat.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）：一键安装，自动从 GitHub Releases 下载应用 zip、创建桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

description.en: Single/multi-line composer toggle for the DSH Web GUI: an editable shortcut (registered through the harness shortcut service) — Cmd/Ctrl+E on desktop builds and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E in the browser, with Linux browsers unbound until you pick one — switches the composer between its native single-line shape and a four-line-plus draft area; a small tab on the composer shoulder always shows the current shortcut and target mode; while multi-line, Enter inserts a newline and Shift+Enter sends, and the mode is remembered per device.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框单行/多行切换：通过官方快捷键服务注册的可编辑快捷键（桌面版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+E，浏览器版默认 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+E，Linux 浏览器默认未绑定） 在原生单行输入框与至少四行的多行输入框之间切换；输入框上沿的小 tab 常驻显示当前快捷键与目标模式；多行时 Enter 换行、Shift+Enter 发送，模式按设备记忆。

description.en: Replaces the composer model picker with a compact panel for provider-to-model navigation and an adaptive reasoning-effort slider, with a Default stop and no slider for models without adjustable efforts.
description.zh: 将输入框的模型选择器替换为紧凑面板，支持来源到模型的逐级选择和自适应思考强度滑块，保留 Default 档位，不支持调节的模型隐藏滑块。

description.en: A client-side panel for DeepSeek Harness: it stacks the epic cards of a dsh-taskboard project in their epic:children order, shows the position, code, name and version of every module along the arc, and marks the start, middle and end modules. The order can be changed by drag or by buttons, and the new order is written back through the the taskboard own public update API, so it persists and is shared by everyone viewing the project. Requires the cloader/dsh-taskboard plugin.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的客户端面板：把 dsh-taskboard 项目里的总任务卡按 epic:children 顺序堆叠展示，标出每个模块在弧线上的位置、代号、名称与版本，并区分起点/中间/终点模块。顺序可拖拽或用按钮调整，新顺序通过 taskboard 自身的公开更新 API 写回，因此会持久化并对该项目的所有查看者共享。需要先安装 cloader/dsh-taskboard 插件。

description.en: Adds edit mode to the DSH settings nav for drag-reordering, per-section show/hide and named collapsible drawer grouping saved in the plugin's own settings namespace, plus pinning up to five sections to the main sidebar for one-click access.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置页导航加编辑模式：拖拽排序、逐个显隐、用命名可折叠抽屉分组，排版存在插件自己的设置命名空间；还能把最多 5 个分区钉到主界面侧栏，一键直达。

description.en: Lets you choose which items appear in the DeepSeek Harness settings left nav.
description.zh: 让你选择 DeepSeek Harness 设置页左侧导航要显示哪些栏目。

description.en: Visualize the plugin and model call flow as a 3D office with six fixed workstations, thought bubbles and a delivery sheet.
description.zh: 把插件与模型的调用过程可视化成 3D 办公室：六个固定工位、思维流气泡与交付纸。

description.en: Composer key remap for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: bind Enter, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, Shift+Enter or any custom chord to the Send, Newline or Interrupt actions, with cross-action migration, durable persistence and native behavior preserved by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 输入框键位自定义：把 Enter、Ctrl/Cmd+Enter、Shift+Enter 或任意组合键分配给发送、换行、打断三个动作，支持跨动作互斥迁移与持久化保存，默认保持 DSH 原生行为。

description.en: Adds a Web composer switch between the native DSH agent and Grok Build, proxying Grok Build sessions and slash commands through ACP.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框中切换原生 DSH Agent 与 Grok Build，并通过 ACP 代理 Grok Build 会话及斜杠命令。

description.en: DSH Web GUI paperclip button: a 📎 button in the composer opens a file picker (drag & drop supported) and inserts file contents into the textarea.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 输入框添加回形针按钮：点击选择文件（支持拖拽），文件内容自动插入输入框。

description.en: Quick sticky notes with colored labels, pin, timed reminders, and password protection for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 泡泡猫的即时便签 — 支持彩色标签、置顶、定时提醒与密码保护。

description.en: Command deck for DeepSeek Harness: a live session rail and team roster, a task board with approvals and write actions, an activity stream, and a desktop HUD capsule that follows the working conversation. The HUD capsule is Windows-only.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 指挥台：会话栏与编队看板、带审批与写操作的任务板、实时流，以及跟随运行中对话的桌面 HUD 胶囊（仅 Windows）。

description.en: Startup video intro with per-clip playback parameters (segment, speed, brightness, fit, blurred cinema fill, hold ratio and fade duration) and light/dark clip variants selected by the app theme.
description.zh: 启动时播放视频开场，每段素材可独立调节播放片段、速度、亮度、画面适配、影院模糊填充、展示比例与淡出时长，并按应用浅色/深色外观自动选择对应版本。

description.en: Fork of dsh-effort-slider that splits the composer model seat into two buttons: the model name opens the model list, the effort label opens the Claude-style slider with WebGL fire.
description.zh: dsh-effort-slider 的修改版：把输入框的模型座位拆成两个按钮——点模型名打开模型列表，点推理等级打开带 WebGL 火焰的滑块面板。

description.en: Prompt-box screenshot shortcut button. Drag a box, shot taken immediately. DSH hides automatically; multi-monitor supported. Ctrl+Alt+1--hides the window then shoots; shift+click--does not hide. Hold Ctrl+Alt and click 1 to shoot repeatedly. ! One copy is saved by default, named by content hash, in the DSH attachment library; each session writes an index recording which shots belong to it (can be changed to keep an extra copy in the session folder). Images are part of the context, so deleting them breaks the session — use the "Delete Conversation" plugin to remove images together with the conversation. Windows only.
description.zh: 方便大家直接截屏的提示词框快捷按钮。拉完范围框后直接截屏。自动隐藏dsh，支持多屏幕。Ctrl+Alt+1--隐藏窗口截屏；shift+点击按钮--不隐藏窗口；按住Ctrl+Alt后点击1，反复截屏。！默认以哈希值名称保存1份在DSH附件库，各会话生成索引记录图片归属（可修改为多备份一份至会话文件夹）。图片属于上下文，删除会导致会话错误，须用“删除会话”插件让图片与会话一并删除。仅 Windows。

description.en: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin.
description.zh: OpenPencil 设计预览与编辑插件。

description.en: Replaces the composer model control with an inline Provider/Model trigger — clicking it opens a two-column card with providers on the left and the hovered provider's models on the right — and moves the reasoning effort into its own trigger beside it, unlike single-button model pickers.
description.zh: 顶替输入框里的模型控件：一个内联的「供应商/模型」钮，点开是两栏卡片，左栏供应商、右栏列出鼠标所指供应商的模型；推理强度单独成一个钮放在旁边（与只有一个钮的模型选择器不同）。

description.en: Folds long composer drafts into a compact summary card once a character threshold is reached, without changing message submission.
description.zh: 输入草稿超过阈值后自动折叠为摘要卡，不改变消息提交路径。

description.en: Highlights parts of speech (nouns green, verbs red, adjectives/adverbs purple) in rendered DSH Web Markdown, with light/dark palettes, toggles, and stream-aware updates.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 已渲染的 Markdown 中做词性高亮：名词绿、动词红、形容/副词紫，支持深/浅色板、词性开关与流式防抖。

description.en: Collapses the DSH sidebar panel list into a single group row, and its gear opens an edit mode to show, hide and drag-reorder two groups: sidebar extension entries and conversation view tabs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 左侧的面板列表折叠成一行分组头；点齿轮进入编辑态，对两组内容分别勾选显示/隐藏、拖动排序——侧栏扩展入口与会话顶部视图标签。

description.en: Forked from j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager (MIT) at its 0.5.6 baseline and substantially reworked since; it registers the same plugin id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original. Adds lossless cordis.patch.yml writes (JS expression values preserved), save-gated per-tool filters, skills governance over the DSH roots plus 10 external agent directories with per-skill/per-source switches enforced through the agent-scope skills provider (disabling actually hides a skill from the model), categories and a restorable trash, GitHub-repository install/update/rollback, zip and SKILL.md import, skills.sh/ClawHub market, workspace view, sidebar panel, dark/light contrast fixes, and update checks against the published npm package (same source as market installs; npm publication carries OIDC provenance).
description.zh: 本插件在 j62268781-alt/dsh-skills-mcp-manager（MIT）的 0.5.6 基线之上分叉并做了大幅重构；两者注册同一个插件 id，不能同时安装。相对基线新增：cordis.patch.yml 的无损写回（保留 JS 表达式值）、保存闸门式逐工具过滤、覆盖 DSH 原生根与 10 个外部 Agent 目录的技能治理与逐技能/逐来源启停（通过 agent-scope skills provider 真正让模型看不到被停用的技能）、分类与可恢复回收站、GitHub 仓库安装/更新/回滚、zip 与 SKILL.md 导入、skills.sh/ClawHub 市场、工作区视图、侧栏面板、亮/暗主题对比度修复，以及读取 npm 发布版本的更新检查（与市场安装源一致；npm 发布带 OIDC provenance）。

description.en: Hides the sidebar's global panel navigation (Plugins / Market / Schedules / More) and gives the vertical space back to the session list; three modes, switchable in Settings → Sidebar.
description.zh: 隐藏侧栏顶部的全局导航（插件 / 插件市场 / 自动化任务 / 更多），把垂直空间还给会话列表；三档模式，在 设置 → 侧栏 里切换。

description.en: Show or hide sidebar panel entries and add shortcuts to Settings sections.
description.zh: 控制侧边栏功能菜单的显示，并为设置页面添加快捷入口。

description.en: Highlight DSH Web replies while reading and save them with their user questions.
description.zh: 阅读 DSH Web 回复时划线，并连同对应的用户问题一起收藏。

description.en: Replaces the chat input model picker with a provider-grouped, collapsible list: groups models by provider, folds vision-bridge mirror providers back into their upstream, and carries the reasoning-effort options each model declares in settings. Tested on DSH Desktop only; the DSH web build is untested.
description.zh: 把聊天输入框的模型选择器换成按渠道商分组、可折叠的列表：按渠道商归组，把视觉桥镜像渠道商折叠回上游，并逐模型带上设置里声明的思考强度选项。仅在 DSH 桌面版实测，Web 版未测试。

description.en: Task details sidebar for DeepSeek Harness: a "View task details" button under every finished turn opens a resizable right-sidebar panel showing that task's input files, intermediate artifacts, output files, tools and skills used, inferred languages, a step-by-step flow timeline, and the model provider with token usage and cache hit rate.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务详情侧边栏：每个已结束任务的最下方显示「查看任务详情」，点开后从右侧边栏打开可拖拽调宽的面板，列出该任务的输入文件、中间产物、输出文件、所用工具与 skill、推断出的语言、按步骤组织的流程时间线，以及模型提供方与 Token 用量、缓存命中率。

description.en: Select any text in a DSH chat reply to get a floating Follow-up/Copy pill: one click quotes the selection into the composer so you can type your own follow-up question, or copies it.
description.zh: 选中聊天回复中的任意文字，浮出「追问/复制」气泡：一键把选中内容作为引用填入输入框（问题由你输入），或一键复制。另附安装与实现文档。

description.en: Adds a sparkle button left of the model selector in the composer: it rewrites the draft into a clearer, more complete task brief, replaces it in place with one-click undo, offers five rewrite styles, and greys out while the draft carries file/command chips.
description.zh: 在输入框的模型选择器左侧加一个星标按钮：把草稿改写成目标明确、细节完整的任务说明并就地替换，可一键撤销；提供五种改写风格，草稿含文件引用 / 命令芯片时自动置灰。

plugins.name: dsh-fudan-status-wallpaper

description.en: Fudan · Desktop: DeepSeek quota and campus-weather status bar, six curated campus wallpapers, and a fully local 知行台 schedule/knowledge workspace with a Fudan editorial UI and week-by-week review.
description.zh: 复旦 · 桌面：DeepSeek 额度与校园天气状态栏、六张精选校园壁纸，以及带复旦编辑感界面、支持按周回顾的本地知行台日程 / 知识工作台。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: ybkkasi

description.en: Asset governance console for self-hosted AI infrastructure. Registers MCP servers, skills, agents, AI apps, model channels, SaaS connectors and NAS storage in one ledger with a lifecycle state machine, per-tool RBAC permission points, department x agent x skill cost attribution, dependency topology and an append-only audit trail. Self-hosted, MIT, no hosted tier and no cloud contract.
description.zh: 自托管 AI 基础设施的资产治理控制台。把 MCP 服务 / Skill / Agent / AI 应用 / 模型渠道 / SaaS 连接器 / NAS 存储登记进同一台账，带生命周期状态机、逐工具 RBAC 权限点、部门 x Agent x Skill 三维成本归因、依赖拓扑与只追加审计日志。完全自托管，MIT，无托管版无云端合约。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to open-connector:3000

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API account balance in the composer dock with manual or custom-interval auto-refresh.
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额，支持手动刷新与自定义间隔自动刷新。

description.en: Finds wasted GitHub Actions runner time and proposes small, reviewable workflow patches, with explicit approval before any edit and a DSH settings page for analysis rules, history limits, storage, and cost estimation.
description.zh: 找出被浪费的 GitHub Actions 运行时间，并提出小而可审查的工作流补丁；任何修改都需要明确批准，并提供用于分析规则、历史上限、存储和成本估算的 DSH 设置页面。

description.en: Usage and cost view for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates real token usage from existing session logs, locks each cost at the price of its event time, and shows month and today spend against a budget from a sidebar card or an input-bar pill.
description.zh: dsh 用量与费用视图：从既有会话日志聚合真实 token 用量，按事件发生时刻的价格写时锁定费用；侧栏卡片或输入框胶囊展示本月/今日花费与预算进度，设置页另有概览、趋势、明细三页。

description.en: Live usage gauge injected into the system prompt every turn: session tokens and estimated spend, a next-turn estimate, and two predictions the model can act on — which step fills the context window and which step burns the budget. /qm panels, zero-config by default, optional price table, and it publishes a summary.json budget contract sibling plugins read.
description.zh: 实时用量仪表：每回合向系统提示注入一行 token/花费仪表，含下一步预估，以及模型可以自刹的两条预测——第几步撑满上下文、第几步烧穿预算。/qm 面板自查，零配置即用，价格表可选，并向家族发布 summary.json 预算契约供兄弟插件读取。

plugins.name: dsh-api-dashboard

description.en: Multi-platform API balance and usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI: balances for DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Kimi, StepFun, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Novita and xAI under the composer, estimated per-session and per-subagent cost with DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, automatic discovery of relays configured in DSH settings, and an optional draggable whale widget.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的多平台 API 余额与用量看板：在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek、智谱 GLM、Kimi、阶跃星辰、硅基流动、MiniMax、OpenRouter、Novita、xAI 的余额，估算本会话与子代理消耗并按 DeepSeek 峰谷计价，自动发现 DSH 设置里已配置的中转站，另有一个可拖拽的大肥鱼挂件。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Team cost captain: meters every model call (subagents included), attributes each call to a member by workspace rules, prices it with the built-in DeepSeek 2026-09 catalog (peak/off-peak, CNY/USD) or user overrides, and appends it to a local JSONL ledger. Adds hot-reloadable member budgets, 80%/100% webhook alerts, optional over-budget enforcement, a team_cost_report tool with CSV export, and a settings-page team dashboard served over a Typert RPC service.
description.zh: 团队成本管家：按成员/工作空间计量每次模型调用的 token 与费用（含子代理），内置 DeepSeek 2026-09 价目表与自定义价格覆盖，成员预算热更新、阈值 Webhook 告警、可选超支拦截，提供成本报表工具与 CSV 导出，并在设置页提供团队成本看板。

description.en: Tokenrhythm (基元律动) finance dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: account balance & expiring credits, category-filtered model price cards (with discounted prices), service status and platform key management; login via platform account or session cookie — credentials stay on the local host.
description.zh: 基元律动费用中心：账户余额与限时额度、按分类筛选的模型价格卡（含折扣价）、服务状态与平台密钥管理，支持平台账号或 Cookie 登录，凭据存本机 host。

description.en: Read-only clinic for DSH session logs: 22 named diagnostics (token waste, retry and failure loops, context bloat, cross-session amnesia, idle MCP servers and skills), each reported with a replayable evidence locator such as session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L110, and each finding turned into an executable prescription — a profile-patch YAML snippet or a command with current to suggested values, risk, verification and source — plus a feedback command that retires a prescription you reject, after which the report states it was removed by your feedback. Zero dependencies, default zero egress, session files are never written.
description.zh: DSH 会话日志的只读体检诊所：22 项具名诊断（token 浪费、重试与失败循环、上下文膨胀、跨会话失忆、闲置的 MCP 服务器与 skill 等），每条都附可复核的证据定位符（如 session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L110）；每个问题给一条可执行处方（profile patch 片段或命令，含当前值到建议值、风险与验证方式），并支持标记「已拒绝」让该处方不再出现（报告会写明是你撤掉的）。零依赖、默认零外发、会话文件只读。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-dashboard-plus

description.en: Shows DeepSeek balance and estimated daily spend, merges external vision-call JSONL records, and adds a per-session dashboard with model statistics, TTFT, cache rate, call logs, cost estimates, filters, and CSV export.
description.zh: 显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日花费估算，合并外部视觉调用 JSONL 记录，并提供含模型统计、TTFT、缓存率、调用日志、费用估算、筛选与 CSV 导出的会话看板。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Real-time token billing for DSH web: official DeepSeek CNY pricing with automatic peak/off-peak switching, hourly price sync from the official site, visual custom model prices, and multi-currency fallback.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时 token 计费插件：官网人民币价直接计费、高峰/错峰自动切换、价格实时跟随官网、可视化自定义模型价格、多币种兜底。

description.en: Activity heatmap in the DSH Web sidebar: GitHub-style grid of daily commits, token usage, and estimated spend, with a today stats line for all-session token totals, cache hit rate, and per-model auto-priced cost.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧边栏活动热力图：GitHub 风格网格展示每日提交、Token 用量与估算花费，今日统计行显示全会话 Token 总量、缓存命中率与按模型自动计价的花费。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-usage

description.en: Adds an OpenCode Go usage page to dsh Settings with per-model 5-hour, weekly, and monthly spend and remaining allowance.
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置里新增 OpenCode Go 用量页，按模型显示 5 小时、本周、本月花费与剩余额度。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Windows-only. Counts the dsh-auth-* login cookies the DSH desktop shell has accumulated, shows how much of the 16 KiB request-header budget they eat and how many launches are left before the shell stops opening with "desktop welcome: Web authentication failed". The web UI gets a draggable floating card that re-checks every 10 minutes, keeps one snapshot per local date and can refresh on demand; a standalone Windows checker ships in desktop/.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows。数出 DSH 桌面外壳已累积的 dsh-auth-* 登录 cookie 条数，显示它们占掉 16 KiB 请求头预算的多少，以及还差几次启动就会打不开并报 "desktop welcome: Web authentication failed"。网页里有一张可拖动的浮窗卡片，每 10 分钟自检、每个本地日期保留一条快照，也能手动刷新；另附 desktop/ 下的独立 Windows 自查工具。

description.en: Visualizes prompt-cache hit rates and model request activity in DSH Web, with request details, comparison, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中可视化提示词缓存命中率与模型请求活动，支持请求详情、请求对比和对话定位。

description.en: Local-first personal usage insights in Settings, with 1/7/30-day token heatmaps and a 30-day calendar, token composition, model mix, and skill-call status.
description.zh: 在设置页提供本机个人用量分析：1/7/30 天 Token 热力图与 30 天日历视图、Token 构成、模型分布和技能调用状态。

description.en: Inline Command Code plan usage badge in the DSH composer toolbar beside the model selector: 5h and weekly window usage plus remaining credits, clicking the badge opens an upward detail popover with reset countdowns; reuses the commandcode/report remote from @mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入栏（模型选择器旁）内联显示 Command Code 套餐用量：5 小时与周窗口已用百分比及剩余 credits，点击徽章弹出向上的详情浮层并含重置倒计时；复用 @mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider 的 commandcode/report 远端数据。

description.en: Cross-session token dashboard for DSH: daily spend as bars, trend or cumulative views plus a GitHub-style annual activity calendar, model and workspace splits, cross-filtering between day, model and workspace, and a per-turn timeline that also covers web-search and auxiliary model calls.
description.zh: 跨会话 token 消耗看板：每日消耗支持柱状、趋势、累积三种视图与 GitHub 风格年度活跃日历，模型与工作区分布，日／模型／工作区之间的交叉筛选联动，以及逐轮时间线——并计入联网搜索等辅助模型调用。

description.en: A price-aware task runner for DeepSeek: during an off-peak pricing window a batch of prompts goes straight to deepseek-flash; near peak it queues the batch behind a self-held timer and runs it at the start of the next off-peak window. Exposes `peak_run`, `peak_schedule` and `peak_cancel`, with configurable peak windows and a lead time.
description.zh: DeepSeek 峰谷价感知的任务执行器：平价时段把一批 prompt 直接交给 deepseek-flash；临近峰价时排队并用自持定时器在下一个平价时段开始执行。提供 peak_run / peak_schedule / peak_cancel 三个工具，峰谷时段与提前量可配置。

plugins.name: chicheng-stats

description.en: Configurable DSH usage statistics: a sidebar text/card widget plus a detail dialog with per-provider and per-model breakdowns, cache-hit rates, token trends, and latency details (TTFT and duration).
description.zh: 高度可配置的 DSH 用量统计插件：侧边栏文字/卡片组件加统计弹窗，提供按提供方与按模型的请求/Token 统计、缓存命中率、趋势图与首字节/总耗时明细。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Peak-hour reminder: while DeepSeek charges peak rates it shows a banner at the top of the DSH Web UI every N minutes (default 5, range 1-120), adds one at each peak/valley switch, stays silent during valley hours, and keeps a sidebar row with the current state and a countdown to the next switch. Peak rules (Beijing time Mon-Fri 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00; weekends, Chinese public holidays and 调休 weekends are valley all day) are evaluated in the host and served over two no-auth routes, /plugins/dsh-peak-reminder/state and /config; settings live in settings.section and are stored in ~/.dsh/peak-reminder.json.
description.zh: 峰时提醒：DeepSeek 走高峰计价时，每隔 N 分钟（默认 5，可设 1–120）在 DSH Web 界面顶部提醒一次「现在是峰时」，峰↔谷切换各提醒一条，谷时完全不打扰；侧边栏底部常驻一行显示当前峰/谷状态与下次切换倒计时。峰谷规则（北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00；周末、法定节假日与调休周末全天谷价）由宿主判定，经 /plugins/dsh-peak-reminder/state 与 /config 两个免鉴权路由供界面读取；开关与间隔在设置页一节里改，存到 ~/.dsh/peak-reminder.json。

description.en: See what a conversation actually costs: how many model requests, how big the system prompt and tool table are, cumulative tokens, estimated spend, and how far you are from automatic context compaction. Reads the local session log only; never calls a model, never adds a word to the system prompt. Token and spend figures are estimates from character counts, not provider usage.
description.zh: 看清一场对话到底烧了多少：模型请求次数、system prompt 与工具表各占多少、累计 token、估算花费、离上下文自动压缩还有多远。只读本地会话日志，不调模型，不往 system prompt 加一个字。token 与花费均按字符数估算，不是 provider 用量。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-billing

description.en: Usage and cost statistics with peak/off-peak pricing after the 2026-08-17 rate change, a floating summary panel, per-session breakdowns, and a day/week/month/year/all usage heatmap.
description.zh: 用量与消费统计：8/17 调价前后峰谷计费，主界面汇总面板、按会话明细与日/周/月/年/累计用量热力图。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-session-stats-panel

description.en: A right-side session stats panel showing average cache-hit rate, session cost, runtime, request count, cumulative tokens and account balance.
description.zh: 右侧会话统计面板，展示平均缓存命中率、会话成本、运行时长、请求数、累计 token 与账户余额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API peak/off-peak status, a countdown to the next switch and a mini timeline next to the DSH desktop avatar, with a 24-hour Beijing-time timeline on click; holiday calendars update automatically from holiday-cn, and an optional reminder fires 5 minutes before each peak period.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端头像旁显示 DeepSeek API 峰谷时段、切换倒计时与迷你时间轴，点击查看北京时间 24 小时时间轴；节假日日历从 holiday-cn 自动更新，可选在峰时段开始前 5 分钟提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-usage-sidebar

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (5-hour, weekly and monthly) in the DSH sidebar footer, with a countdown to the 5-hour reset. Requires an OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY credential (Settings → Models, or a refs entry in ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml); without it the card stays hidden.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏底部显示 OpenCode Go 订阅的 5 小时、本周、本月用量，并倒计时到 5 小时窗口重置。需先在「设置 → 模型」或 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 的 refs 中配置 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY，否则卡片不显示。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Real DeepSeek account balance and official spend tracker in the session header, with peak/off-peak badge, monetary alert with auto-stop, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: 会话头部的真实 DeepSeek 余额与官方消费统计：高峰/空闲标签、按金额提醒与自动停止、一键充值。

description.en: Local-only, read-only DSH token dashboard: provider-reported usage across all backends, all-time totals, a 365-day heatmap, input+output and cache read/write details, turn/step counts, average tok/s, and durable history after sessions are archived.
description.zh: 仅本地、只读、不上传的 DSH Token 面板：按 provider 实际 usage 统计，所有后端统一汇总；含历史总量、365 天热力图、输入+输出与缓存读写明细、轮次/步骤、平均 tok/s，归档后仍保留历史。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-badge

description.en: Sidebar row with today's tokens and estimated spend for DeepSeek Harness; the dialog adds 24h, 7-day, 30-day, 12-month and per-year charts, a contributions heatmap, per-request peak/off-peak pricing from the official DeepSeek price list and the Chinese statutory holiday calendar, and optional WebDAV sync that merges usage across machines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏用量徽标：显示当天 token 总量与估算费用；弹窗里有 24 小时 / 近 7 日 / 近 30 日 / 近 12 个月与按年图表、活跃度热力图，按 DeepSeek 官方定价与中国法定节假日逐请求计算峰谷价，并可选 WebDAV 云同步合并多台机器的用量。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to nas:19347

description.en: Reads the local Codex CLI ChatGPT-plan quota (5-hour and weekly windows), defaults to gpt-6.1-sol at high reasoning, falls back to gpt-5.6-sol when a window has 10% or less left, and delegates tasks through codex exec with an explicit opt-in for the expensive gpt-6-astra model. Requires a signed-in Codex CLI (`codex login`).
description.zh: 读取本机 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 计划额度（5 小时与每周窗口），默认统一使用 gpt-6.1-sol + high 推理强度，任一窗口剩余不超过 10% 时回退 gpt-5.6-sol，并通过 codex exec 外派任务；昂贵的 gpt-6-astra 需要显式开启。需已登录的 Codex CLI（`codex login`）。

plugins.name: model-usage-plugin

description.en: Per-model token usage and cost estimation with DeepSeek account balance, shown in a Settings panel tab.
description.zh: 按模型统计 token 消耗并估算费用，同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，展示于设置面板「模型消耗」页签。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-balance-chip

description.en: Live DeepSeek API balance in the sidebar footer plus an always-visible bottom-right pill: status dot and amount, refreshed every 60 seconds, the API key is read from the local credential store and never embedded.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部与右下角常驻胶囊实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额：状态点加金额，每 60 秒自动刷新，密钥从本机凭证库读取。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-llm-balance-siderbar

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for querying LLM service provider usage: reads DeepSeek and Moonshot balances plus Kimi For Coding and OpenCode Go quota windows on the host and shows them in an always-visible card with three view modes, edge docking and a collapsed letter bubble.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 服务提供商用量查询插件：在宿主侧读取 DeepSeek、Moonshot 余额与 Kimi For Coding、OpenCode Go 的配额窗口，在常驻卡片中展示，支持三种视图、边缘磁吸与收起为字母气泡。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Token usage statistics panel for DeepSeek Harness: usage trends, model breakdown and activity heatmap, hand-written SVG, zero chart libraries.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量统计面板：用量趋势、模型用量与活跃热力图，手写 SVG，零图表库依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-balance

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DSH sidebar, showing the active model provider balance for DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, and MiniMax, plus DeepSeek peak/off-peak status.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的账户余额胶囊，跟随当前模型的服务商显示余额，支持 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、Zhipu/GLM 与 MiniMax，并显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-balance

description.en: A floating credit/quota widget for the DeepSeek Harness Web: shows DeepSeek / OpenCode Go balances and usage, and tracks DSH session token usage and estimated cost by day, month, and model.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 LLM 额度/用量悬浮窗：显示 DeepSeek / OpenCode Go 余额与套餐用量，并按日、月、模型统计 DSH 会话 token 用量与费用估算。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Shows MiniMax Token Plan usage in the Settings page through webServer routes and reads either subscription key name from environment or credentials file.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 MiniMax Token Plan 用量，走 webServer 路由，兼容环境变量或凭据文件中的两种订阅 key 名称。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-tracker

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness LLM token usage and cost (CNY, peak/off-peak pricing) with a settings dashboard, agent tools, HTTP API and persistent storage.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM Token 用量与花费（人民币、峰谷计价），提供设置面板、Agent 工具、HTTP 接口与持久化存储。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Cumulative token usage tracking for DeepSeek Harness, with per-model and per-day breakdowns, a settings-page dashboard and an online-changeable data directory.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 累计 token 用量并按模型/日期区分，附设置页用量看板，数据保存目录可在线更改。

description.en: Per-model capability profiling for DSH: turns local session history into per-model dashboards of session counts, tool usage, error rates, and top error signatures, with time-range filters and multi-model comparison.
description.zh: DSH 按模型的能力画像:把本地会话历史变成逐模型的会话数、工具使用、错误率与 Top 错误签名看板,支持时间范围过滤与多模型对比。

plugins.name: dsh-cost

description.en: Account balance and cost statistics pill for DeepSeek Harness. It adds a pill at the right-hand end of the official stats row below the session composer, combining the billing period (peak/off-peak, colour-coded), the account balance and the current session cost; clicking it expands a per-session breakdown with cache-hit input, cache-miss input and output amounts, plus cost per model. The rate table is refreshed with plugin releases to follow official pricing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的账户余额及费用统计胶囊。它在会话输入框下方的官方统计行右侧新增一枚胶囊，集成计费时段（高峰/低谷，用颜色区分）、账户余额与会话费用；点击展开可查看本次会话的详细费用统计，包括缓存命中输入、缓存未命中输入、输出三项金额，以及按模型拆分的花费。费率表随插件版本更新，以跟随官方调价。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Floating overlay in the Harness Web UI with OpenCode Go usage: 5-hour rolling, weekly and monthly percentages, reset countdowns and the renewal date, with device-code sign-in and silent token refresh.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 上悬浮显示 OpenCode Go 用量：5 小时滚动、每周与每月百分比、重置倒计时与续订日期，支持设备码登录与静默刷新。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage

description.en: OpenCode GO quota widget pinned to the sidebar, with rolling/weekly/monthly usage bars, an elapsed-versus-remaining time bar under each, a same-origin usage proxy, an /opencode-go command, and the runtime x-opencode-session fix for GO gateway chat requests. Fork of yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage.
description.zh: 常驻侧边栏的 OpenCode GO 套餐额度组件：滚动/周/月三条用量条、每条下方一条已流逝与剩余时间条、同源用量代理、/opencode-go 命令，以及针对 GO 网关聊天请求的运行时 x-opencode-session 修复。fork 自 yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a cost-and-balance chip to the composer stats row beside the shipped token-usage pill — the session's estimated DeepSeek cost, a peak/off-peak light and the signed-in account's remaining balance, with each billing item priced in the breakdown; it activates only when a DeepSeek official route is present.
description.zh: 在输入栏统计行、官方 token 用量条旁加一枚费用与余额胶囊：本次会话的 DeepSeek 估算费用、峰谷时段指示灯与已登录账号的剩余额度，明细里按计费项列出各自金额；仅在检测到 DeepSeek 官方渠道时激活。

plugins.name: dsh-zhipu-plan

description.en: Zhipu coding-plan sign-in, quota, usage and reset panel for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中登录智谱编程套餐，查看额度与用量并执行额度重置。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A Usage page in DSH settings that folds every model call into a local ledger and reports requests, tokens, and estimated cost by day, route, and model, with editable unit prices and CSV export.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里加一页「用量查询」：把每次模型调用记进本地账本，按天、接口、模型汇总请求数、Token 与费用估算，支持单价修改与 CSV 导出。

description.en: Session-header balance readout for DeepSeek Harness: shows the spendable account total (recharge and bonus wallets combined) in the conversation header, refreshed every two minutes, and renders nothing when the account is signed out or the query fails.
description.zh: DSH 会话标题栏右上角的账户余额读数：显示可用总额（充值余额与赠金余额合并），每两分钟刷新一次；未登录或查询失败时不显示任何内容。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go quota usage in the web sidebar's bottom-left corner — rolling/weekly/monthly progress with a hover card, plus a Beijing-time DeepSeek peak-hour timeline.
description.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏左下角显示 OpenCode Go 用量——滚动/本周/本月配额进度与悬停明细卡片，并附按北京时间标记的 DeepSeek 高峰时段进度条。

description.en: Context lens: visualizes token usage of every request (context composition, KV cache hit rate) and enforces per-turn / per-session budgets with warning and blocking (npm: `dsh-my-context`).
description.zh: 上下文透镜：可视化每次请求的 token 用量（上下文构成、KV 缓存命中率），并提供每轮 / 每会话预算控制（超限提醒与拦截）（npm: `dsh-my-context`）。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness. A dedicated settings page shows cumulative input / output / cache-read / cache-write token totals, a green GitHub-style daily heatmap colored by usage, and a pie / bar chart toggle for per-model (provider/model) usage shares — all read from local session logs, no upstream API calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量看板。在设置页单开一页：累计输入 / 输出 / 缓存读 / 缓存写四大桶总量、按天绿色热力网格（颜色随用量加深），以及饼图 / 柱状图一键切换展示各模型（provider/model）的用量占比；数据全部来自本地会话日志，不调上游 API。

plugins.name: dsh-opencodego-usage

description.en: OpenCodeGo quota monitor for the DSH Web GUI: a breathing indicator at the input's bottom-right (green/yellow/red by remaining share), a liquid-glass panel with rolling/weekly/monthly usage windows and reset times, auto-refreshing every 30 s; API key read from DSH credentials.
description.zh: OpenCodeGo 剩余额度监视器：输入框右下角呼吸指示灯（按剩余额度绿/黄/红），液态玻璃面板显示滚动/周/月用量窗口与重置时间，每 30 秒自动刷新，API Key 自动读取 DSH 凭据。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Usage statistics: a usage and reference-cost panel for DeepSeek Harness with today, 7-day, 30-day, all-time and custom ranges aggregated by hour or day; a model filter and a per-model breakdown of requests, input and output tokens, cache, reference cost and share; a model-share card showing the top four models by total tokens with the rest grouped as others; a reference price list generated from opencode Zen and DeepSeek's published rates, with DeepSeek models billed by Beijing weekday peak/off-peak windows and Chinese public holidays; a pricing-match dialog to point an unmatched model at a reference model or type per-million rates by hand; reference cost switchable between ¥ and $ at a fixed 1 USD = 7 CNY; and a yearly heatmap drawn only with theme variables, with no third-party chart library.
description.zh: 用量统计：DeepSeek Harness 的用量与参考成本面板，含今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部 / 自定义范围并按小时或天聚合；模型筛选与按模型明细（请求数、输入/输出 Token、缓存、参考成本、占比）；按总 Token 显示前 4 个模型、其余归入「其它」的模型占比卡；参考价目由 opencode Zen 与 DeepSeek 官方定价生成，DeepSeek 型号按北京时间工作日高峰/空闲与法定节假日分档计价；未匹配的模型可在「定价匹配」里指定参考模型或手填单价；参考成本可在 ¥ / $ 间按固定汇率 1 USD = 7 CNY 切换；年度热力图只用主题变量绘制，不引第三方图表库。

description.en: Per-call cache billing inside the context-meter popover: current step, round and session totals with hit/miss/output tokens and amounts, automatic Beijing working-hour peak/off-peak pricing, per-model rates, and third-party relays billed too.
description.zh: 在上下文圆环弹层里实时算账：当前步、当前轮、会话累计三块明细，缓存命中/未命中/输出各带 token 与金额，官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定，第三方中转照常记账。

description.en: Live token stats under the DSH Web composer: streamed tokens/s, output token and first-byte latency, plus per-step estimate-vs-actual reconciliation using the official BPE tokenizer, to tell a slow stream from a stalled one.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时渲染 token 状态带：基于 DeepSeek 官方 BPE 分词表显示流式 token/s、输出 token 与首字延迟，并对比每次 step 的估算与实际偏差，用于判断生成是慢还是卡住。

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target provider; off-peak traffic flows to official as usual.
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-wave

description.en: Balance, remaining tokens and token/money usage waves for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar footer card plus a panel docked in the empty gutter left of the conversation, with 1h/6h/24h/7d stacked token-or-currency waveforms, a live tok/s strip and a per-command cost breakdown.
description.zh: 余额、剩余 tok 与用量面板：侧栏底部一张余额/剩余 token 卡片，点开是贴在对话栏左侧空白处的用量面板 —— 1h/6h/24h/7d 的 token/金额堆叠波形、实时 tok/s 曲线、逐指令消耗与花费；按最近 24h 实付均价折算「余额还能跑多少 tok」。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-balance-tasks

description.en: Floating card showing DeepSeek balance, peak/off-peak tier countdown, and remaining tasks estimated from historical per-task token usage and the current context.
description.zh: 右下角悬浮卡显示 DeepSeek 余额与峰谷档位倒计时，并基于历史平均单任务 Token 消耗与当前上下文估算剩余任务数。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Live prompt-cache telemetry for the current session in the DSH right sidebar, drawn as a register bank and a reactor-core history board.
description.zh: 以寄存器阵列与反应堆芯历史盘面的形式，在 DSH 右侧栏实时显示当前会话的提示词缓存遥测。
