description.en: Forensic analysis of past model-routing decisions. Replays each session, classifies every turn's task complexity from its request shape (deterministic, no LLM), and reports two kinds of waste: an expensive model on cheap work (the difference is measurable), and a cheap model on expensive work that failed on its own merits — where every retry re-sends the whole context, so the downgrade cost more than the upgrade. Distinguishes provider-capacity retries (RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT) from model failures so it does not cry wolf. Derives routing rules from the evidence, priced against a built-in per-million table.
description.zh: 模型路由浪费取证：回放每个会话，按请求形状确定性判定每轮任务复杂度（不调 LLM），报两类浪费——贵模型干 便宜活（差额可计算），以及便宜模型干贵活且因自身能力失败（每次重试重发整个上下文，比直接升级更贵）。会 区分服务商容量限制（RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT）与模型能力失败，所以不会天天喊狼来了。并从证据推导路由 规则，按内置每百万 token 价目表估算金额。

description.en: Quantify what switching projects costs. Measures each workspace's cold-start overhead (AGENTS.md + skill catalog + tool schemas + runtime context), its steady state, and how many turns it takes to reach it — then compares workspaces and attributes the difference. Attribution requires at least three workspaces and says so instead of inventing a correlation from two points; a factor with no spread across workspaces is reported as a property of the profile, not of the project. Recommends which workspaces to keep warm, which to archive, by entry cost times visit frequency. Deterministic.
description.zh: 工作区切换成本量化：量每个工作区的冷启动开销（AGENTS.md + 技能目录 + 工具 schema + 运行时上下文）、稳态值、 几轮到达稳态，然后横向对比并归因。归因需要至少三个工作区，不到就明说数据不够而不是拿两个点编一个相关性； 在所有工作区之间没有差异的因素被标注为 profile 的属性而非项目的属性。按"进入成本 × 访问频率"给出常驻/ 归档建议。纯确定性。

description.en: Token usage meter in the DSH sidebar footer that runs both data sources at once rather than picking one: the DeepSeek platform account's usage and cost endpoints, which cover every device on the account but only the official channel, and local session logs, which cover this machine in real time across every provider but carry no cost. The two are merged per day — the official channel takes the larger figure, since one call is recorded by both, and providers the platform cannot see are added on top. History is backfilled month by month from the platform, providers are classified by channel rather than model name, days follow the platform's UTC boundary, and no token has to be pasted because the platform figures reuse the DSH account you are already signed in to. Totals appear as all-time, current-project, today, week, month, last-7 and last-30 in a compact bar, an expand panel and a detail modal with calendar, chart, model, provider, year, month and day tabs.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏页脚的 Token 用量组件，同时跑两路数据源而不是二选一：DeepSeek 平台账号的用量/金额接口（账号全部设备、仅官方通道），本机会话日志（仅本机、含所有供应商、实时、无金额）。两路逐日合并——官方通道取较大值（同一次调用两路都会记），平台看不到的供应商再叠加；历史月份从平台回补，供应商按通道而非模型名判定，日桶跟随平台口径（UTC）；平台数字默认复用 DSH 已登录账号，不用粘贴 token。数字出现在紧凑条、展开面板，以及含日历/图表/模型/供应商/年/月/当月按天页签的详细数据弹窗，口径为总消耗/当前项目/今日/当周/当月/近 7 天/近 30 天。

Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.

description.en: Peak/off-peak and balance pill for the DSH composer, forked from xiangrikuibaize/dsh-tide-badge. Unlike the original, the conversation cost is priced from that session's token usage (uncached input, cache-read, cache-write and output tokens) against the official price table, so other conversations and API keys on the same account are not charged to it. It keeps the upstream package name, so it replaces the npm version — install one or the other, not both.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的峰谷计费与余额药丸，基于 xiangrikuibaize/dsh-tide-badge 修改。与原版不同的是：本次对话花费按本会话的 token 用量（未命中 / 缓存命中 / 缓存写入 / 输出）乘官方价目表计算，而不是余额差值，因此同账号的其他对话与 API Key 消耗不会被算进来。它与上游同包名，装上会替换 npm 上的上游版本，两者不能同时安装。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance badge in the sidebar footer beside Settings — reads the key DSH already stores, shows granted/topped-up breakdown on hover, flags a balance under ¥2, and refreshes every 60 seconds or on click.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部「设置」旁常驻显示 DeepSeek API 余额——读取 DSH 已保存的密钥，悬停查看赠送/充值明细，余额低于 ¥2 变红告警，每 60 秒自动刷新或点击刷新。

description.en: Local token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: four-segment token breakdown (miss/cache-hit/cache-write/output), cache savings estimate against the miss/hit price gap, per-session drill-down with context-growth curves and anomaly flags, global filters with shareable URLs, monthly budget progress with month-end projection, and day/month aggregate fast-path queries (O(days)) with incremental rescan.
description.zh: DSH 本地 Token 用量与成本统计仪表盘：四段 Token 构成（未命中/缓存命中/缓存写入/输出）、按未命中与命中的价差估算缓存省钱、会话下钻（上下文增长曲线与异常激增标记）、全局筛选可分享 URL、月度预算环形进度与月底外推、日/月聚合快路径查询（O(天数)）+ 增量扫描。

plugins.name: dsh-volcengine-usage

description.en: A draggable Volcengine Coding Plan usage card for DeepSeek Harness Web using a local console session.
description.zh: 一个使用本地控制台登录态、可拖动的 DeepSeek Harness Web 火山引擎 Coding Plan 用量卡片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-balance-card

description.en: A draggable balance and usage card for the web UI. Clicking the character button slides the card out from the left side of the image and clicking it again retracts the card; it shows the official DeepSeek account balance split into granted credit and top-up, and token usage folded from local session logs for today, the last 7 days and the month, priced per call with the official peak/off-peak rates (cache hits, cache misses and output are priced separately).
description.zh: 可拖动的余额与用量浮层卡片：点一下角色图片，卡片从图片左侧滑出，再点一下缩回；显示官方 DeepSeek 余额（赠金 / 充值拆分），并按缓存命中、未命中、输出三段计价，汇总本地会话日志的今日 / 近 7 天 / 本月 token 用量与人民币估算花费（按官方峰谷时段逐次计价）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Live CNY cost of the current session under the composer, priced per assistant message by the model that produced it and the peak or off-peak window of its own timestamp, with a Settings page that edits the six prices of every model and marks a model with no rate card with a leading tilde because it is costed from the Flash rates.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示当前会话的人民币费用，每条消息按其自身时间戳与该条所用模型的峰谷单价计价；设置页可编辑每个模型的六项单价，未定价的模型按 Flash 单价估算并以 ~ 标注。

description.en: Peak/valley pricing and spend dashboard for DeepSeek Harness, with a sidebar pill showing today's spend and tokens plus a details page with hourly, 14-day and per-model breakdowns.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量峰谷仪表盘：侧栏胶囊常显峰谷、今日花费与 tokens，详情页提供 24 小时、近 14 天与按模型的用量拆分。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-wallet

description.en: Shows the live DeepSeek account balance in the composer toolbar and prices each completed turn in CNY beside its token usage, using the official peak/off-peak table: peak on Beijing-time weekday mornings and afternoons, valley on weekends and statutory holidays. The balance needs a DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential; accounts signed in through DeepSeek OAuth show no chip.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在每轮完成对话的 token 用量旁显示按官方峰谷价计费的人民币金额：北京时间工作日上下午为高峰价，周末与法定节假日为空闲价。余额需要 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 凭据，仅通过 DeepSeek OAuth 登录的账号不显示余额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Keeps a pricing-period badge in the sidebar footer of the Web UI. It shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently in an off-peak or peak period, plus how long until the next switch. Click it to open the rules, the price table currently in force, and the balance of the signed-in DeepSeek account.
description.zh: 在 Web 界面侧栏底部常驻一个价格时段标记，显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于 空闲时段还是高峰时段、距下次切换还有多久；点开是规则说明、当前生效的价目表，以及已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额。

description.en: See the quota of every AI account connected to your local Magpie gateway at a glance, with usage breakdowns by day/week/month.
description.zh: 一键查看本机 Magpie 网关下全部 AI 账号的额度，并支持按天/周/月查看用量明细。

description.en: Local-first token usage heatmap inside DSH settings: GitHub-style week/month/quarter/year grids, hourly usage per day, per-model and per-provider Top 5, and persisted history that survives session deletion. Zero network, zero billing.
description.zh: DSH 设置内的本地 Token 用量热图：GitHub 风格周/月/季度/年视图、每日小时级展开、模型与供应商 Top 5，历史持久化，删除会话不丢数据。零联网、零计费。

description.en: GLM Coding Plan usage quota ring in the composer dock - 5-hour and weekly credit windows with level, auto-refresh and one-click retry. Requires a GLM Coding Plan subscription and key, plus your BigModel organization and project IDs (the team quota API returns empty without them).
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示 GLM Coding Plan 额度环 - 5 小时与每周额度窗口、等级、自动刷新与一键重试。需 GLM Coding Plan 订阅与 key，并配置 BigModel 的 organization 与 project ID（团队额度接口缺了它们会返回空）。

description.en: Agent billing and usage observability for dsh web: session-log direct-scan recording (zstd, per-event timestamps, watermark + lastSeq double dedup), multi-account rate profiles per provider and model, per-window live badge reading the window session id via React fiber, full glassmorphism dashboard with 14-day sparkline, budget alerts, relay-station balance queries and a 332-model official price library.
description.zh: dsh web 的 Agent 计费与用量可观测：会话日志直扫记账（zstd 解压、逐事件时间戳入账、水位+lastSeq 双防双计）、多账号按 provider/模型费率档案、per-window 实时徽标（React fiber 读窗口会话 id，切会话即切账单）、玻璃拟态面板（14 天趋势/预算告警/中转站余额/332 模型官方价库）。

plugins.name: dsh-client-ui-balance

description.en: DeepSeek account balance capsule in the conversation session header. A same-origin route registered by the package's own host half resolves the API key from the credential service and calls api.deepseek.com/user/balance, so the key never reaches the page; the capsule polls every 60 seconds and expands into a panel with per-currency totals, granted and topped-up amounts, last-updated time and a manual refresh. Read-only UI: it never touches prompts, tool results or model traffic.
description.zh: 会话标题栏里的 DeepSeek 账户余额胶囊。由本包自带的 host 半注册同源路由，从凭据服务解析 API Key 后查询 api.deepseek.com/user/balance，Key 始终不进页面；胶囊每 60 秒轮询，可展开明细面板，显示分币种总额、赠送与充值部分、更新时间与手动刷新。纯只读 UI：不接触提示词、工具结果与模型流量。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Settings section that reports token usage: totals for input, output, cache read, cache write, reasoning and call count, with breakdowns by model, day, month and project plus a per-day trend chart for the last 30 days; history is rebuilt once on a worker thread and then kept current from live session events.
description.zh: 设置中的 Token 用量面板：总量（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写/推理/调用次数），按模型、按天、按月、按项目的明细，以及最近 30 天的按日趋势折线图；历史在 Worker 线程上一次性重建，之后由会话事件实时累加。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-tide

description.en: DeepSeek account balance and session cost under the composer, with a live peak/off-peak pricing badge (Beijing time), a countdown to the next pricing switch, hover price tables, and usage advice.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本会话花费，余额前带峰/谷价格徽章（北京时间）与距切换倒计时，悬停看两档单价明细与使用建议。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replay the compressed version on every later request, and report each session's cost and savings. Disabled by default: select one rewrite backend first. derive needs no install and works on packaged DSH; in-place needs 14 source patches and a rebuild (recommended for source checkouts); message-edit needs a third-party plugin and is experimental only.
description.zh: 把过长的模型思考压缩成有用核心，之后每次请求重放压缩版，并给出每个会话的开销与节省报告。默认关闭：必须先选择一个改写后端。derive 无需安装、打包版也能用；in-place 需给 DSH 源码打 14 处补丁并重建（源码构建首选）；message-edit 需装第三方插件，仅实验性，不推荐。

description.en: Looks up English words in chat replies by click or selection, showing part of speech, Chinese meaning and exam tags; selecting a pure-English sentence translates it. Ships an offline dictionary: 20,499 entries, 8,960 with bilingual examples, 6,374 with root analysis.
description.zh: 点选或划选聊天回复里的英文单词，显示词性、中文释义与考纲标签；划选纯英文句子翻译成中文。词库离线内置：20,499 词条，8,960 个带双语例句，6,374 个带词根分析。

description.en: Usage panel on the blank-session hero: sessions, messages, total tokens, active days, peak hour, favourite model and a contribution heatmap, over all time, 30 days or 7 days.
description.zh: 空白会话首页的用量面板：会话数、消息数、总 token、活跃天数、高峰时段、常用模型与热力图，范围可选全部、30 天或 7 天。

description.en: Registers /daily, which sends the model to read the newest bili-scroll report and say what it understood instead of repeating the text; a sidebar panel runs the same command. Needs the dsh-bili-scroll plugin to have written reports into ~/.dsh/bili-duty/out, otherwise /daily finds none.
description.zh: 日报一键读：敲 /daily 就把「去读最新那篇刷B站日报」塞进当前会话——只给路径不给正文，让它自己读原文；侧栏面板发的是同一条命令。需 dsh-bili-scroll 已把日报写进 ~/.dsh/bili-duty/out，否则 /daily 找不到日报。

description.en: Sets a CNY spending cap for each DeepSeek Harness turn (¥5 by default) and stops the run before the next model request once the cap is reached; the switch and amount sit at the right end of the composer dock.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 每一轮对话设人民币花费上限（默认 5 元），到上限就在下一个模型请求发出前停下；开关与金额在输入框下方最右侧。

plugins.name: dsh-go-balance

description.en: OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover detail and warn/danger coloring.
description.zh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Provider-reported quota snapshots for GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot in DSH: a draggable floating capsule with detail panels for quota windows, reset times, per-model usage and Copilot credits, plus an optional sidebar card hidden by default; credentials are resolved by the DSH host and no quota history is stored.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中查看 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 的服务商额度快照：可拖动悬浮胶囊与详情面板展示额度窗口、重置时间、分模型用量与 Copilot 额度，附默认隐藏的可选侧边栏卡片；凭据由 DSH 宿主解析，不保存额度历史。

description.en: Permanent composer-dock balance card: real-time DeepSeek API account balance with 5-minute auto-refresh, a manual refresh button, and low-balance color warnings.
description.zh: 输入框下方常驻余额卡片：实时显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额，每 5 分钟自动刷新，支持手动刷新，余额过低自动变色提醒。

description.en: Sidebar card that prices this session's tokens in RMB at official peak/off-peak rates and splits context share by source, with per-turn pricing and a Markdown/CSV history report.
description.zh: 侧栏常驻卡片：按 DeepSeek 官方价目（含峰谷与缓存差价）把本会话 token 折算成人民币，并按来源拆开上下文占比；逐轮计价，另附 Markdown/CSV 历史报告。

description.en: Live token cost for every chat in the DSH Web UI: the chat, its subagents and the whole session tree, priced from a bundled models.dev snapshot of seven providers and 139 priced models, with cache read and write rates wherever the provider publishes them and DeepSeek from its own peak and off-peak table. Every finished answer carries its own price in the transcript, and a chat that is not currently open is priced from the log instead of disappearing. Spend is costed per interval from an append-only JSONL ledger in the project folder, so logged work keeps the tariff it was billed at. On top of it: budget-aware work plans packed against a money limit, routing scenarios that show which models are worth connecting, a generated plan document in English, Chinese or Russian, and a warning when spend belongs to no plan unit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 的每个对话实时计算 token 费用：本对话、其子代理与整棵会话树，价格来自内置的 models.dev 快照：七家供应商、139 个有价模型，缓存读写费率按供应商实际公布的取值，DeepSeek 则使用其官方峰谷价格表。每个完成的回答都会在对话中显示自身费用，未打开的对话则按日志计价而不是整行消失。费用按区间计价，依据写入项目目录的只追加 JSONL 账本，因此已记录的工作保留当时的费率。此外还提供：按金额预算排布的工作计划、展示值得接入哪些模型的路由方案比较、以英语/中文/俄语生成的计划文档，以及当费用未归入任何计划单元时的提醒。

description.en: Watchdog for quota exhaustion: on a 429 or quota error it creates a recurring schedule that re-sends a continue-the-task prompt until a turn closes normally, so a long task resumes without manual restarts; /keep-running list and /keep-running cancel <id> manage those schedules. Requires @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule to be mounted first (it registers the schedules).
description.zh: 配额看门狗：遇到 429 或配额错误时建立循环调度，持续重发「继续任务」提示直到某一轮正常结束，长任务不必手动重开；/keep-running list 与 /keep-running cancel <id> 用于查看和取消。需先挂载 @deepseek-ai/dsh-schedule（调度由它注册）。

description.en: Composer token pill for the current session: total tokens plus uncached input, cache read, cache write and output, with the cache-hit share. A pure client consumer of the session tokenUsage projection — no host service, no file access, no network requests.
description.zh: 输入框里的当前会话 Token 胶囊：总量与未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出四个分桶，并显示缓存命中率；纯客户端消费会话 tokenUsage 投影，不注册宿主服务、不读写文件、不联网。

description.en: All-session token usage dashboard in the sidebar: total and peak tokens, usage streaks, a 53-week activity heatmap, 7/30-day trend, per-model usage and a session ranking. Folded locally from the profile session projection cache, so sessions written by older session formats are counted too; no network access, and the read-only summary route refuses non-loopback peers.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的全量会话 Token 用量仪表盘：累计/峰值 Token、连续使用天数、53 周活动热力图、7/30 天趋势、按模型用量与会话排行；在本地从 profile 的会话投影缓存汇总（旧会话格式的会话也能统计），不联网，只读汇总路由拒绝非本机请求。

plugins.name: dsh-model-surplus

description.en: Shows the active model's usage and remaining balance in the session header: OpenCode Go plan usage (rolling, weekly, monthly) with the selected model's monthly cap, Command Code 5-hour and weekly window usage with remaining credits, and DeepSeek account balance.
description.zh: 在会话标题右侧显示当前模型的用量与余量：OpenCode Go 套餐用量、选中模型所对应的月上限、Command Code 的 5 小时与周窗口用量及剩余额度，以及 DeepSeek 账户余额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Per-model API price table with Peak and Off-Peak rates in USD or CNY, the DeepSeek account balance and live session spend under the composer, an all-time total, a collapsible source URL and check date per model, and optional per-model Peak schedules.
description.zh: 按模型设置高峰/低谷价格（USD 或 CNY），在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本次会话花费，累计总花费，每条价格可记录来源链接与核对日期，并支持为单个模型覆盖高峰时段。

description.en: Slims oversized MCP tool JSON Schemas per agent without changing dispatch, and reports token usage, cache hits and context composition on a settings page.
description.zh: 按 agent 收敛过大的 MCP 工具 JSON Schema（调度不变），并在设置页展示 token 用量、缓存命中与上下文构成。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-usage-dashboard

description.en: DeepSeek API usage dashboard for DSH Web: daily cache-hit/miss and output token statistics from session logs, per-model cost estimates, account balance, 7-day trends, and a composer usage summary.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek API 用量仪表盘：基于会话日志统计每日缓存命中/未命中输入与输出 Token，并展示分模型费用估算、账户余额、7 日趋势和 composer 用量摘要。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-model-balance

description.en: Auto-detect the current model vendor (7 built-in) and show its balance or quota in the composer input row, with custom endpoints for unsupported vendors.
description.zh: 自动识别当前模型厂商（内置 7 家），在输入框内显示余额或配额，未内置厂商可配置自定义接口。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: DSH workspace hub: organize workspaces into color-coded folders in the sidebar (three-level drag reorder for folders/workspaces/sessions, inline edit, one-click expand/collapse, dual-channel search) with per-workspace and per-session token usage and cost stats from real session logs (official DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing for any deepseek model, three spend calibers, hover detail cards, overview panel) plus OpenCode Go plan usage; data persists to host disk and refreshes live every 30 s.
description.zh: DSH 工作区中枢：侧边栏将工作区按彩色分组管理（分组/工作区/会话三级拖拽排序、内联编辑、一键展开折叠、标题+消息双通道搜索），基于真实会话日志统计每工作区与每会话的 Token 与花费（任意 deepseek 模型自动按官方峰谷价计费、三种时段口径、悬停明细卡、总览面板），另含 OpenCode Go 额度；分组与结果持久化到本机磁盘，30 秒实时刷新。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-limits

description.en: Shows how much of your Claude and Codex plan limits you have used: a line above the prompt in dst with 5-hour and weekly windows, percent used and time to reset, and a ring meter beside the context meter in dsh web that opens a panel listing every window.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中显示 OpenAI 与 Codex 的用量配额：Web 端用环形表与面板展示 5 小时 / 7 天窗口，dst 端在状态行显示同样的窗口。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Shows the current DeepSeek API peak or off-peak pricing period and a countdown to the next transition.
description.zh: 显示当前 DeepSeek API 高峰或非高峰计费时段，以及距离下一次切换的倒计时。

plugins.name: dsh-bill

description.en: Cost tracking priced from an online catalogue (models.dev + OpenRouter, 8000+ models, each call priced at its own instant): a per-turn cost line, a Cost tab attributing spend to tool output / model output / system prompt / commands, budget, monthly forecast, ~166 live-rate currencies, and a bill_stats agent tool.
description.zh: 按在线价格目录计价的费用统计（models.dev + OpenRouter，8000+ 模型，每次调用按自身时刻定价）：每轮成本行、把花费归因到工具输出 / 模型输出 / 系统提示词 / 终端命令的「费用」标签页、预算、月度预测、约 166 种实时汇率货币，以及 bill_stats agent 工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Intelligent token optimization via Jev System One triage, dynamic tool pruning, and subagent routing.
description.zh: 基于 Jev System One 分流、动态工具裁剪与子代理路由的智能 Token 优化插件。

description.en: Live token spend for the current DSH session beside the composer, pricing the four server-reported token buckets with the profile's own table and showing both the peak and off-peak rate.
description.zh: 在输入框旁实时显示当前会话的 token 花费：用服务端上报的四个 token 分桶乘以本 profile 的价格表，并同时列出高峰与空闲价格。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-quota-bar

description.en: Draggable transparent balance card with a blood-bar of remaining balance vs month-opening, today/month spend (official when the platform token is configured), and session cost.
description.zh: 可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条、今日/本月用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据）、当前对话费用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-opencode-usage

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling, weekly and monthly used and remaining percentage with reset times) in a floating panel anchored to the bottom-left of the session window.
description.zh: 在会话窗口左下角的悬浮面板中显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动/每周/每月的已用与剩余百分比及重置时间）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Floating DSH desktop pet with 12 authored state animations for requests, tools, compaction, archive and prompt enhancement; live context occupancy; a persistent cross-session Lifetime Ledger; per-provider/model totals, hourly trends and 7/30-day views; dark/light theme switching; optional cost estimates (off by default) with a visual price editor and monthly budget alert; client-side skin ZIP import; JSON/CSV usage export; snapshot-only panel reads with background incremental indexing; and opt-in prompt enhancement with editable preview and DSH composer submission.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮桌面用量小宠物：用 12 个正式状态动作反馈请求、工具、上下文压缩、归档和提示词增强，展示实时上下文占用、跨会话终身用量账本、服务商/模型统计、小时趋势与近 7/30 日视图；支持深色/浅色主题切换；可选成本估算（默认关闭）与可视化价格表、月预算告警；客户端皮肤 ZIP 导入；JSON/CSV 用量导出；通过纯快照面板读取和后台增量索引避免打开面板时扫描历史，并提供用户主动触发、可编辑预览和直接发送的提示词增强。

description.en: Per-step context ledger for dsh with opt-in gates: hides heavy tool groups from the tool table, externalizes long tool results to disk, and answers duplicate reads with a pointer instead of re-sending. In the author's A/B test the tool-table gate cut 16,110 first-step prompt tokens (-49.7%), and about -23% of per-step context on long sessions.
description.zh: 每步上下文账本：可选开启精简工具表、长结果外置、重复读回指针三个闸门。 作者 A/B 实测，开启工具表闸门后首步 prompt 少 16,110 token（-49.7%），长会话每步上下文约降 23%。

description.en: Shows where every session's tokens go: lifetime totals, cache hit rate, peak/off-peak cost, a calendar heatmap, a trend chart, per-model and per-workspace breakdowns, and a session tree revealing subagent sessions, with CSV/JSON export. Also ships context clear/compact actions and a prompt optimization button.
description.zh: 看清每个会话的 token 去向：累计总量、缓存命中率、峰谷分时成本、日历热力图、趋势曲线、模型与工作区分布，以及展开展示子代理的会话树，支持 CSV / JSON 导出。另带上下文清理 / 压缩按钮与提示词优化按钮。

description.en: DeepSeek-styled cross-session token usage, request count, and tiered cost analytics dashboard.
description.zh: 仿 DeepSeek 官方 Token 统计，跨会话 Token 消耗、请求次数与峰谷分时费用统计看板。

description.zh: 会话头部显示 DeepSeek 余额与本会话 Token 用量：三级余额预警、自定义阈值、一键充值入口、分段 Token 条与缓存命中率，并采用可见时才轮询的省流策略。

description.zh: Token 用量热力图：日/周/累计视图，12 个月窗口，支持深浅色主题。

description.zh: 侧边栏计费仪表盘：从会话日志聚合真实用量（按模型/按日统计调用、Token、缓存），按最新多厂商官方价格估算人民币费用，订阅套餐（coding/token/agent）通道豁免计费，并带各厂商健康状态圆点。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-opencode-go-usage

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription usage beside the composer: the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows each as a small ring with the used percentage (amber at 70%, red at 90%). Clicking the meter opens a detail card with per-window progress bars, reset countdowns and a refresh button, and when it is not clicked nothing floats over the conversation. The API key stays in the Host process and never reaches the browser.
description.zh: 在输入框旁边常驻显示 OpenCode Go 套餐用量：5 小时滚动、每周、每月三个窗口各一个圆环与已用百分比（70% 变黄、90% 变红）；点击整条弹出详情卡，含每个窗口的额度进度条、重置倒计时与刷新按钮，不点击时不会在对话上悬浮任何东西。API Key 只留在 Host 进程里，不进入浏览器。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Title-bar balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: account balance, today's cost, session tokens, and peak/off-peak pricing awareness (Beijing-time weekday windows) with flat-rate support for custom providers like TokenBom.
description.zh: 标题栏余额徽章：余额、今日花费、本会话 tokens 一目了然，官方按峰谷时段计价展示，TokenBom 等自定义服务商按平价展示。

description.zh: 用量统计设置页：全部基于本地会话日志计算（近 30 天条形图 / 模型表 / 会话表），按服务商感知计价（官方峰谷、内置 TokenBom 平价表），并跳过子代理会话继承的历史事件避免重复计费。

plugins.name: dsh-session-cost

description.en: Session cost estimate in a status bar at the bottom of the conversation (per-model token pricing, CNY) plus the live DeepSeek account balance via the official balance API.
description.zh: 对话底部的会话费用状态栏：按模型逐条计价估算 Token 费用（CNY），并实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（官方余额接口）。

description.en: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month / all-time totals.
description.zh: 新建会话页的 GitHub 风格每日 Token 用量热力图：可选日历年度视图、绿/蓝配色与显示开关，并附今日/本月/累计总量。

description.en: Sync cc-switch provider balances and track token usage & cost by day/month/total with relay-aware currency settings.
description.zh: 同步 cc-switch 各 provider 余额，按日/月/总量统计 token 用量与花费，支持中转站币种与汇率设置。

description.zh: 按厂商（订阅/官方API）统计用量看板：按供应商/模型拆分 Token、缓存、输出等 KPI，53 周热力图，趋势折线图（今天按小时），模型钻取，费用估算，CSV 导出，以及健康度卡片（TTFT、生成速度、峰值 Context、错误率）。

description.en: Prompt-cache diagnostics dashboard showing provider-reported token usage, adjacent logical-input changes, and Call TTFT.
description.zh: 提示词缓存诊断页，展示 Provider 回传的 Token 用量、相邻逻辑输入变化与 Call TTFT。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-quota#dsh-balance

description.en: Provider balance and quota status bar for DSH Web, with model capability settings, external JSON health monitoring, visual field binding, and per-model status details.
description.zh: DSH Web 的供应商余额与额度状态栏，支持模型能力设置、外部 JSON 健康监测、可视化字段绑定和逐模型状态详情。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-subusage

description.en: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁显示 28 条提供商入口的订阅额度与账户余额，附统一设置页和只读额度查询工具。

description.en: Global token totals across every local DSH conversation, de-duplicated by message id, with custom date ranges and per-provider monthly quota tracking.
description.zh: 统计本机全部 DSH 会话的历史 token 消耗，按 message.id 去重，支持自定义日期区间与按接入方的月度额度剩余。

description.en: Per-turn session cost chip in the composer stats row: each turn's spend with the model it used, the conversation total split into cache-hit and cache-miss (CNY), priced from an official price table that refreshes on demand.
description.zh: 输入框下方统计栏里的会话费用胶囊：逐轮列出每轮花费与所用模型，并把总额拆成缓存命中与未命中两笔（CNY）；价目表按需从官方定价页刷新。

description.en: Cost display for AiSpot (sapi) relays: crawls the provider's group list from its public pricing endpoints instead of hardcoding it, lets you pick the active group from a dropdown in the conversation header, and shows a per-turn cost at the end of each turn plus a session total that recurses through every subagent subtree. Switching groups re-prices all history instantly, because the host publishes token buckets only and the browser applies the live rates.
description.zh: AiSpot（sapi）中转站的费用显示插件：从供应商的公开价格端点动态爬取分组列表而非硬编码，在会话标题栏的下拉框里选择当前分组，在每轮对话结束处显示本轮费用，并在标题栏显示递归合计所有子代理子树的会话总额。切换分组会即时重算全部历史金额，因为宿主只发布 token 桶、由浏览器按实时价目表计价。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-monitor

description.en: GitHub-style contribution grid in the Web sidebar showing how many prompts you sent each day, with a switch to count conversations, total tokens or output tokens instead. Counts only messages you sent yourself; injected context is excluded.
description.zh: Web 侧边栏的 GitHub 风格日历网格，按天展示你发出的对话条数，可切换为会话数、Token 总量或输出 Token。只统计你亲手发送的消息，注入的上下文不计入。

description.en: White kitten accountant on the window sill: shows the tokens and money for each answer and for the whole session, the money the prompt cache saved, the context size against the model window, the next peak/off-peak price change and the live DeepSeek balance; it purrs when stroked, reacts while the agent works and synthesizes all of its sounds.
description.zh: 窗台上的白猫记账助手：显示每条回答与会话的 token 和花费、提示缓存省下的钱、上下文占模型窗口的比例、下一次峰谷换价时间与实时 DeepSeek 余额；可摸头打呼噜，随 agent 工作状态做出反应，所有音效均为合成。

plugins.name: dsh-simple-cost

description.en: DeepSeek account balance above the sidebar account area, the running cost of the open conversation, the cost of each turn beside its token count, and a one-click AI breakdown for any turn above a token threshold.
description.zh: 在侧边栏账户区上方显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、当前会话累计花费与逐轮费用，并对超出 token 阈值的单轮提供一键 AI 分析。

description.zh: 会话头部余量徽标 + 用量监控页签：实时展示各供应商余额/额度余量与重置倒计时，按会话/供应商/模型/客户端统计请求量、Token（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写）、缓存命中率、预估费用与平均时延，本地 SQLite 留存历史，支持跨设备导入导出。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Reorder configured models in the composer model picker, set cache-hit, cache-miss and output prices per million tokens, and estimate per-turn and session costs with built-in DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在输入框右下角的模型选择器中自定义模型顺序，按每百万 tokens 设置缓存命中、缓存未命中与输出三档价格，并结合内置的 DeepSeek 峰谷价估算逐轮和本会话费用。

description.en: Adds a /dshpp slash command that reports session and token usage, cache-hit rate, and estimated cost from harness session logs; the repo also ships a CLI and local web console for lifecycle, provider, session, and plugin-security management.
description.zh: 新增 /dshpp 斜杠命令，从 Harness 会话日志汇总会话数与 token 用量、缓存命中率与估算成本；同仓库还附带用于生命周期、Provider、会话与插件安全管理的 CLI 与本地 Web 控制台。

description.en: One-click update for the self-built Linux dsh-desktop: check fork releases, download the deb, swap the app and restart.
description.zh: 桌面端 Linux 自建版一键更新：检查 fork release、下载 deb、替换应用目录并自动重启。

description.en: Shows your DeepSeek balance and what the current session has cost in a corner overlay, with budget alerts, peak-hour warnings and opt-in official price sync.
description.zh: 在右下角浮层显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与本会话花费，支持预算告警、峰时提醒，以及可选开启的官方价格同步。

plugins.name: dsh-peak-hours

description.en: A composer switch between running always and running only in off-peak hours, set per session: a task is judged by the session that owns it, so changing one session no longer changes the others, and a session without its own choice follows a default. In off-peak mode every task, including one already running, is held at its next agent step or tool dispatch when a Beijing peak window starts (Monday to Friday 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00, statutory holidays excluded), and one timer releases it at the boundary; weekends and holidays are idle all day. The holiday calendar lists every statutory day off in 2025 and 2026 from the State Council notices, and a year with no data is reported as unknown rather than assumed to be a workday.
description.zh: 在「全天运行」与「仅空闲时段运行」之间切换，且按会话独立：任务按所属会话判定，改一个会话不再影响其他会话，没有单独设置的会话跟随默认值。选择空闲模式后，任务（含正在运行的）在进入北京高峰时段（周一至周五 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，法定节假日除外）时，会在下一个 agent 步进或工具分发边界被扣住，并由一个定时器在边界时刻精确放行；周末与法定节假日全天为空闲。内置 2025、2026 年国务院办公厅公布的逐日放假数据，无数据的年份如实标为未知，而不是默认按工作日处理。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to www.news.cn

plugins.name: dsh-turn-price

description.en: Shows what each completed turn cost in CNY on its own row under the turn, with a click-to-open breakdown naming the tokens per category, the unit rate, the matched price rule and the billing instant; per-model rates are edited on a settings page inside DSH — four token categories plus weekly recurring peak/valley rules with arbitrary multipliers and absolute time-window promo prices that override them. 0.2.3 adds account awareness: it reads the balance or remaining quota of 14 providers (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Zhipu GLM, Moonshot, MiniMax, Kimi Coding, OpenAI-compatible relays and more) and shows today / this month / this session spend next to it; spend is accumulated in a local ledger (atomic writes, one book per API key, 1-24 month retention, JSON export), and a monthly calendar lets any day be corrected by hand - including days with no balance observation - with an optional note. Usage and rates are computed locally from what the provider reported; balance is read straight from the provider API with your own key, and nothing is sent to a third party.
description.zh: 在每个已完成回合的下方单独一行显示这一轮的花费金额（人民币），点击展开明细，列出各 token 类别的数量、单价、命中的价格规则与计费时刻；单价可在 DSH 设置页里按模型维护，含四类 token 单价、每周循环的峰谷规则（系数自定）与绝对时间区间的限时优惠价。0.2.3 起还能看账户：读取 14 家 provider 的余额或剩余额度（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、智谱 GLM、月之暗面、MiniMax、Kimi Coding、OpenAI 兼容中转站等），在旁边显示今日 / 本月 / 本会话花费；花费记在本机日账里（原子写、按 API key 分本、保留 1-24 个月、可导出 JSON），另有一张按月日历，任何一天都能手动更正（包括没有余额观测的日子）并可加备注。用量与单价都在本机计算，余额用你自己的密钥直接向 provider 接口查询，不经过第三方。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Estimates what is filling the context window — per instruction file, per skill and per tool result — with a bloat verdict and actionable suggestions.

description.en: Shows today's, this month's and cumulative spend in the sidebar footer, under the message box and in the session header. Spend is metered by the plugin itself from session usage events using official DeepSeek unit prices (peak/off-peak, weekends and holidays treated as off-peak), with local-day aggregation and currency conversion. Also adds a cost_today tool and a /cost command.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部、输入框下方与会话头部显示今日、本月与累计花费；金额由插件自记 —— 从会话用量事件按 DeepSeek 官方单价逐次累计（含 UTC 峰谷，周末与节假日按平时价），并按本地日汇总、换算币种。另提供 cost_today 工具与 /cost 命令。

description.en: Sidebar token gauge for DeepSeek Harness: live output-speed dial, current-session and today token totals, estimated spend from DeepSeek list prices with half price off-peak, and a 70-100% cache-hit dial, with single- and dual-gauge layouts and four skins.
description.zh: 侧边栏 Token 仪表盘：实时输出速度表、当前会话与今日 Token 用量、按 DeepSeek 列表价（峰谷半价）估算的费用，以及 70–100% 缓存命中率表盘，支持单表/双表两种布局与四种皮肤。

description.en: Appends the current turn's estimated token cost in CNY to the assistant action row, right after the usage/time indicator. Prices come from a built-in DeepSeek peak/off-peak CNY table (Beijing time, Monday-Friday 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) and can be overridden from the profile's cordis.patch.yml; a model without a configured price shows a dash instead of a made-up amount. Follows the shipped Performance & usage - Compact setting and hides together with the usage pill. Token cost only, per turn only.
description.zh: 在本轮对话的操作行「用量 / 时间」右侧追加该轮 token 费用估算（人民币）。单价来自内置的 DeepSeek 峰谷价目（北京时间，周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00），可在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里整表覆盖；没有配置单价的模型显示「¥—」，不套用其它价格。跟随官方「性能与用量 = 简洁」设置一起隐藏。只算 token 费用、只显示本轮。

description.en: Per-answer timing breakdown: splits each reply into model, tool and other time, with first-token, decode and per-tool totals, and keeps a local JSONL ledger. Needs Node 24 or newer in the DSH runtime.
description.zh: 逐次回答耗时拆解：把每次回复分成模型、工具与其它三段，给出首字、生成与各工具耗时，并在本地落一份 JSONL 账本。需要 DSH 运行时为 Node 24 或更新版本。

description.en: Pauses peak-hour requests that target official or listed models and lets everything else run, with editable peak windows, a per-model interception list and per-session free-run in the badge panel.
description.zh: 高峰时段只暂停指向官方或拦截列表内模型的请求，其余照常放行；峰谷时段、按模型的拦截列表与会话「畅跑」都能在徽标面板里编辑。

description.en: Real-time cost tracking for the current DSH conversation: a composer-dock line showing the running token usage and DeepSeek official price estimate (base and peak/valley pricing).
description.zh: 当前对话实时费用统计：输入框下方一行显示运行中的 token 用量与 DeepSeek 官方价格估算（基础价与峰谷价）。

description.en: Bailian Token Plan quota panel using the official CLI login: 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, add-on credits, reset countdowns and subscription status.
description.zh: 基于官方 CLI 登录的百炼 Token 套餐用量面板：5 小时、每周、每月窗口，加购积分、重置倒计时与订阅状态。

description.en: DSH port of TokenEconomizer with cross-session project knowledge, opt-in tool pruning, failure-loop redirection, and token usage records.
description.zh: TokenEconomizer 的 DSH 移植版，提供跨会话项目知识、需主动应用的工具裁剪、失败循环引导与 token 用量记录。

plugins.name: dsh-balance

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance readout in the session header: host /api/balance route resolves the API key through the credentials seam (never sent to the browser), 60-second auto-poll plus manual refresh.
description.zh: 会话标题栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额：host 端 /api/balance 路由经凭据 seam 解析 API key（密钥绝不下发浏览器），60 秒自动轮询并支持手动刷新。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-balance-widget

description.en: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的余额与成本小部件：侧边栏底部卡片显示账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费；点击展开四层级成本明细（最近提问 / 本会话 / 今日·本项目 / 今日·全部），带名词解释与一键充值入口。零依赖，兼容 Node 24。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-hub-oauth-gateway

description.en: DSH Web Usage Center with local SQLite history, HUD and dashboard, Hub account/quota snapshots, custom pricing and fee ledger, and CSV/JSON export, plus coding-plan OAuth and an optional loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway.
description.zh: DSH Web 用量中心：本地 SQLite 历史、HUD 与仪表盘、Hub 账户与额度快照、自定义定价与订阅费用账本、CSV/JSON 导出，并含 coding 计划 OAuth 与可选回环 OpenAI/Anthropic 网关。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 100.64.0.0 for network access

description.en: A per-turn token usage strip in each reply's icon row: a grey/yellow/green segmented bar plus a legend giving that turn's uncached-input, cache-read and output split and each one's share.
description.zh: 在每条回复的图标行里画一条单轮用量条：灰/黄/绿分段条配百分比图例，显示该轮未缓存输入、缓存读取与输出的拆分与各自占比。

description.en: Reports Codex reset probabilities and schedules in the DSH composer, with opt-in system notifications for completed resets and a read-only status and history tool.
description.zh: 在 DSH composer 中报道 Codex 重置概率与排期，支持已完成重置的可选系统通知，并提供只读状态与历史记录工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that trims tool output (head/tail plus grep folding), adds optional prompt shaping (Caveman and Ponytail), instant local responses, RTK command-output compaction, context-pressure handling, optional LLM-summary compaction, stable prompt-cache layout, a Web settings UI, and persisted savings telemetry.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，可裁剪工具输出并折叠 grep 结果，提供可选的 Caveman 和 Ponytail 提示词精简、本地即时响应、RTK 命令输出压缩、上下文压力处理、可选的 LLM 摘要压缩、稳定的提示缓存布局、Web 设置界面及持久化节省统计。

description.en: Adds a /context slash command to DeepSeek Harness: shows how much of the session context window is used, how much is free, and a per-category breakdown (system prompt, memory files, skills, messages, tool results). Read-only, local, no model calls.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个 /context 命令：显示当前会话上下文窗口的占用、剩余空间，以及提示词各部分的占比（系统提示 / 记忆文件 / 技能 / 消息 / 工具结果）。只读、纯本地、不触发模型调用。

description.en: A personal usage profile page in the DSH sidebar. Five headline numbers (cumulative tokens, today's tokens, longest task, longest and current active-day streaks), a 12-month activity heatmap with daily / weekly / cumulative scopes, a Cache Lens that splits every token into cache hits, uncached input and output as a segmented bar (with a zoom into the uncached split), a stacked bar chart of tokens over time grouped by model family (version plus tier, so vendor-specific ids and unversioned aliases collapse correctly), and a per-provider split for today or all time. A page-level range (all / today / 7 days / 30 days) drives the token figures. Everything is folded from this machine's own session logs through ctx.sessionQuery. The only outbound request is a six-hourly read of this package's own version from the npm registry, used by the in-panel update button — no telemetry, no credentials, nothing uploaded.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的个人用量主页：五个核心数字（累计 Token、今日 Token、最长任务用时、最长/当前连续活跃天数）、近 12 个月活动热力图（每天/每周/累计总量三档）、把每个 Token 拆成「缓存命中 / 未缓存输入 / 输出」的分段占比条 Cache Lens（可放大查看未缓存内部构成）、按模型家族（版本 + 档位，自动归并不同供应商写法与无版本别名）堆叠的时间柱状图，以及按供应商的今日/累计分类。页面级时间范围（全部/今日/7 天/30 天）驱动上述用量数字。全部由本机会话日志经 ctx.sessionQuery 折叠而来；唯一的外发请求是每 6 小时读一次本包自己在 npm 上的版本号（供面板内的更新按钮使用），不上报数据、不碰凭据。

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness with a session drawer and today / last-3-day / last-7-day panels, plus configurable charts and metrics.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量：会话抽屉与今日 / 近 3 天 / 近 7 天面板，图表与指标可配置。

plugins.name: dsh-wallet-pill

description.en: A composer-dock wallet pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows the account balance behind DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and opens a panel with the peak/off-peak billing window, a live switch countdown, and per-model token prices.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的余额胶囊：在输入框下方显示 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 对应账户的余额，点开可查看峰谷计费时段、切换倒计时与各模型价目表。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: DeepSeek wallet balance at the sidebar foot: a credit-card icon with the amount tinted by remaining balance (green over ¥2, amber ¥0–2, red below), refreshed on mount, per turn-end, and on click; a signed delta floats up and fades on each balance change.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 钱包余额：信用卡图标配余额数字，按剩余额度着色（≥ ¥2 绿色、¥0–2 黄色、≤ ¥0 红色），挂载时、每轮对话结束和点击时刷新；余额变动时带符号差额上飘淡出。

description.en: Shows per-turn and session costs, provider/model breakdowns, subscription usage and the signed-in DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar.
description.zh: 展示每轮及会话费用、渠道/模型明细和套餐用量，并在侧栏显示已登录的 DeepSeek 账号余额。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness activity as a GitHub-style contribution graph: an account-menu row opens a centred dialog with your avatar and name, a year of daily activity in five shades, a year picker and a tooltip on every day.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的日常活动画成 GitHub 风格的贡献热力图：账号菜单里的入口打开居中弹窗，含头像与用户名、按五档配色的一年活动、年份选择器与逐格 tooltip。

description.en: Daily cost card for your local LLM gateway: /usage reads gateway_usage.jsonl and itemizes spend per model and per hour, covering official direct, OpenRouter relay, and in-plan metered pools.
description.zh: 本地 LLM 网关当日花费价目卡：/usage 读取 gateway_usage.jsonl，按模型×分小时列出消费，覆盖官方直连、OpenRouter 中转与套餐内计费池。

description.en: Records DeepSeek Harness token usage into CC Switch, one row per model call, sharing the dedup ledger its own DSH importer uses so the two never double count. Also backfills existing session logs on first run.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 每次模型调用的 token 用量写进 CC Switch 的用量统计，让 DSH 与 Claude Code、Codex 等 CLI 并列展示在同一个面板里。首启时会回填已有会话日志，并与 CC Switch 自带的 DSH 导入器共用去重台账，两者不会重复计数。

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance and the current peak / off-peak phase in the sidebar, and estimates per-session and per-turn cost using the official peak and off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前峰谷时段，并按官方高峰/空闲价估算每个会话与每一轮的花费。

description.en: Model visibility manager for DeepSeek Harness: hide or show any model in the conversation model selector from a dedicated settings page. Per-model switches, search, provider-level batch actions, reset-all. Zero intrusion - writes only its own hidden list, never the provider config; hiding a model in use never interrupts a running session.
description.zh: DSH 模型可见性管理：在独立的设置分区页里按渠道/模型隐藏或显示模型选择菜单中的条目。逐模型开关、实时搜索、渠道级批量隐藏/显示、一键恢复全部。零侵入——只写插件自己的隐藏列表，不改 Provider 配置，隐藏正在使用的模型不会中断会话。

plugins.name: dsh-session-cost

description.en: Composer cost chip: prices the current session DeepSeek API spend message-by-message with the official pricing table (incl. the 2026-08-17 peak/off-peak policy); hover for the breakdown, today (DSH) total and account balance. DeepSeek models only.
description.zh: 输入框右侧会话成本芯片：按官方价表（含 2026-08-17 峰谷价）逐消息计价当前会话的 DeepSeek API 花费，悬停查看计价明细、今日(DSH) 消耗与账户余额；仅 DeepSeek 模型计价，其他模型不计价不显示。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.zh: 在配额、速率限制或身份验证失败后轮换已配置的 LLM API 密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-stats

description.en: GitHub-style usage heatmap dashboard: per-workspace turn counts and token spend (with cache-hit rate), DeepSeek account balance, and workspace aliases.
description.zh: GitHub 风格用量热力图看板：按工作区统计使用次数与 Token 花费（含缓存命中率）、DeepSeek 账户余额查询、工作区别名管理。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Proxy provider that reshapes each outbound payload through a per-category op chain before forwarding upstream, keeping the prompt prefix monotonic between turns so unchanged history is not re-paid at full price; op names are transports (exec / http / inline) and accept user-defined algorithms.
description.zh: 代理 provider：每次出网前按类别跑 op 链重塑 payload 再转交上游，使 prompt 前缀在回合之间保持单调、未变的历史不必按全价重付；op 名只表示传输方式（exec / http / inline），可接入用户自定义算法。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-chart

description.en: Token, cost, and balance dashboard under the composer: live indicator plus zero-dependency SVG charts for per-turn usage, estimated cost, and DeepSeek account balance.
description.zh: 输入框下方的用量/成本/余额仪表盘：实时指标指示器 + 零依赖 SVG 用量图表，按轮次统计用量、估算成本并实时查询 DeepSeek 账户余额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates model input/output/cache tokens across all local sessions, prices them with a builtin table (including DeepSeek peak/off-peak), and shows daily trends plus per-model and per-session tables.
description.zh: 费用看板：汇总本机全部会话的模型输入/输出/缓存 token，按内置价格表计费（含 DeepSeek 峰谷），展示每日趋势与按模型/会话明细。

Days are bucketed by hour behind a date picker, next to a trailing window with per-model breakdowns, request and web-search counts; no cost or pricing model.

description.en: DeepSeek API pricing reminder with a game HUD: Beijing-time countdowns to peak/off-peak windows, a draggable HP capsule with day/moonlight themes, and a nine-realm cultivation system with breakthrough animations.
description.zh: 按北京时间提醒 DeepSeek API 定价高峰/空闲时段的游戏化插件：可拖动血条胶囊、日夜主题、隐藏彩蛋与修仙突破动画。

description.en: Context fullness bands, the per-session compaction threshold derived from the model window, per-step cost computed from cache read and cache write rates, cache-hit, DeepSeek balance with the peak/off-peak tariff, and a one-click handoff. It never calls a model and spends no tokens.
description.zh: 上下文占用档位、按模型窗口推算的每会话压缩阈值、按缓存读取/写入费率计算的单步费用、缓存命中率、DeepSeek 余额与高峰/低谷费率，以及一键交接。它从不调用模型，也不消耗 token。

description.en: Browse Claude Code, DSH and Codex session logs by working directory, with per-turn context composition, token usage, compaction markers and cost estimates.

plugins.name: dsh-api-balance

description.en: Windows-only guard against the desktop shell locking itself out: it counts the dsh-auth-* launch cookies the shell has accumulated, reports how much of the 16 KiB request-header budget they consume, and once the count passes 40 it backs up the whole Cookies database and lets DSH rebuild it, so every cookie in that profile is cleared. Install is one command: on load the plugin registers its own weekly scheduled task pointing at the scripts inside the package, and uninstalling it removes that task — nothing to copy into your home directory and no schtasks line to run by hand. The check itself runs while the app is closed (it waits up to 3 hours for the shell to exit). It does not raise the header budget or keep a floating panel; scripts/ can also be run standalone without the app installed.

plugins.name: dsh-all-usage

description.en: Analyze usage across models, providers, workspaces, and time ranges — including custom start/end dates over the full retained history — with live cache-hit visibility and separate model and provider breakdowns. Includes hourly single-day trends, daily cross-day trends, a 53-week GitHub-style heatmap, usage streaks, model and workspace Token-share donut charts with Token, cost, and percentage details, independent combinable filters, cache-efficiency trends, DeepSeek account balance, workspace aliases, CSV export, and a durable ledger that preserves successfully flushed usage after session deletion — and after a workspace is deleted, where its recorded usage is summed into one Deleted row — and rebuilds incrementally — on restart, unchanged sessions are applied from the ledger without re-reading their logs (a per-session log revision is the change signal), and only changed/new events are folded. The workspace registry is kept fresh automatically through the DSH domain/changed probe: only added/removed workspaces are reprocessed incrementally, unchanged workspaces reuse their computed aggregates and ledger with zero rescan, and usage is strictly limited to DSH-registered workspaces (unregistered cwds are ignored). After a scan, lightweight revision status fetches full history only when the Host/data state changes and exposes non-sensitive sync health (revision reuse, rereads, ledger recovery, and failures). Token accounting is explicit: input is fresh (cache read/write and reasoning are separate buckets) and zero-usage replays never overwrite recorded usage. Chinese uses local time, English uses UTC; API access is loopback-only.
description.zh: 支持跨多个模型、供应商、工作区与时间范围进行统一分析，并可在全部保留历史中自定义起止日期；实时呈现缓存命中率，并可分别查看模型和供应商的分类数据；单日趋势按小时、跨日趋势按日，提供 53 周 GitHub 风格热力图、连续使用、模型与工作区 Token 占比环图及 Token、成本、占比明细，以及可独立自由组合的筛选；支持查询 DeepSeek 账户余额、管理工作区别名及导出 CSV 数据；独立账本在会话删除前持久化用量，工作区被删除时同样保留并把用量汇总为一行「已删除」，增量重建只处理新增事件；重启时未变化会话不回读日志、直接复用账本（以每会话日志 revision 为变更信号）；工作区注册表通过 DSH 的 domain/changed 事件自动探针同步——只对新增/删除的工作区增量重扫，未变化的已有工作区直接复用已计算账本、零全量重扫，统计严格限定已注册工作区（未登记目录一律忽略），扫描完成后通过轻量 revision 状态判断，只有 Host/统计状态变化才获取完整历史，并显示 revision 复用、实际读取、账本恢复和失败等非敏感同步健康信息；全 0 用量的重放不会覆盖已记录的真实用量，Token 口径显式声明（输入不含缓存命中，缓存读写与推理独立成桶）。中文使用本地时区，英文统一使用 UTC；API 仅限本机访问。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness's own fast mode: the same model on the same reasoning effort, fewer output tokens, all prompt-side. Only the output-discipline switch is on by default (late mode, active from step 4); every other switch is off and can be enabled on its own; turn on the tool-output trim switch when tool output is long. Measured on one machine, not a leaderboard: 30 task pairs with long output at the trim switch 0.756x wall clock and 21% fewer output tokens; 24 pairs on 6 real pallets/click PRs 0.805x and 23% fewer. On official SWE-bench Lite instance definitions with a self-built harness it does not show a gain (8 instances, three independent runs pooled to 72 pairs: 0.933x wall, 0.903x tokens, wall still crosses 1; single runs of the same configuration differ by 30%), and stacking switches on top of the trim switch is worse than the trim switch alone. Numbers and repro in the repo.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自己的 fast mode：同一个模型、同样的思考强度，只花更少的输出 token，全程提示词侧。默认只开「精简输出」（late 模式，第 4 步后生效），其余开关默认关、可单独打开；工具输出很长时再开「截短工具输出」那个。本机实测、非榜单成绩：输出偏长的 30 对任务，只开截短开关时 0.756× 耗时、输出 token −21%；6 个真实 `pallets/click` PR 共 24 对，0.805× 耗时、token −23%。在官方 SWE-bench Lite 题目定义上用自建 harness 量不出收益（8 题、三次独立跑合池 72 对：墙钟 0.933×、token 0.903×，墙钟仍跨 1；同一配置单跑之间就差三成），往截短上再叠别的开关反而更差。数字与复现见仓库。

plugins.name: display-api-balance

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API-key balance as one ambient stat in the Harness composer row, refreshed every 60 seconds. Click the balance to set a local low-balance threshold; the amount turns red below it. The API key stays in the host and is only sent to api.deepseek.com/user/balance.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的统计行里显示 DeepSeek API 余额，每 60 秒自动刷新；点击余额可设置本地低余额阈值，低于阈值时金额变红。API Key 只留在本机 Host，仅用于请求 api.deepseek.com/user/balance。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Per-call token meter for the DSH composer: a colour-coded pill under the input and a dashboard above it showing every model call (total versus billable input+output), sub-agent spend, tool overhead and cache-versus-fresh input, read only from local session logs.
description.zh: 输入框下方的彩色 token 胶囊与上方展开面板：逐次调用的双图（总消耗 / 可计费）、子代理开销、工具归因与缓存拆分，只读本机会话日志。

plugins.name: dsh-stats

description.en: Project-level usage hub for DSH: per-project token, time and cost, with half-hour swimlanes, 26-week activity heatmaps and provider balance alerts; unpriceable usage is flagged rather than estimated.
description.zh: DSH 项目级全局用量中心：按项目统计 Token、工时与费用，支持半小时节奏泳道、26 周全局热力图与多 Provider 余额预警；无法确认计价的部分会标注而非估算。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Sidebar footer badge that shows whether DeepSeek is inside a peak-pricing window right now: a state dot, the current multiplier (x2 during peak, 5 zhe / half price off-peak), a countdown to the next switch, and a 24-hour schedule bar whose white line marks the current time. Peak windows are 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time; weekends and Chinese public holidays count as off-peak. The holiday table currently covers 2026 only. Client-only, no network requests.
description.zh: 侧栏底部角标，标注当前是否处于 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段：状态圆点、当前倍率（高峰 ×2、空闲 5 折）、距下次切换的倒计时，以及一条用白色竖线标出当前时刻的 24 小时日程条。高峰为北京时间 9:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日按空闲计费。节假日表目前只覆盖 2026 年。纯客户端插件，不发任何网络请求。

plugins.name: dsh-key-manager

description.en: Manage multiple API keys per provider in Settings → API 密钥: keep a pool of keys with notes, switch the active key with one click, and the switch really takes effect on the next model call.
description.zh: 在设置 → API 密钥中为每个提供商管理多个 API 密钥：密钥池加备注、一键切换当前使用密钥，切换后下一次模型调用立即生效。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Optional read-only bridge plugin that publishes live dsh session and token statistics as one JSON snapshot for the standalone dsh-minato toolkit to read.
description.zh: 可选的只读桥接插件：把 dsh 的会话与 token 实时统计写成一份 JSON 快照，供独立的 dsh-minato 工具箱读取.

description.en: Shows per-turn, per-session and per-workspace conversation costs in CNY, priced by DeepSeek's official tiers with peak/off-peak hours and per-request Search/Fetch billing.
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 官方价目显示每轮、每会话与每工作区的对话费用人民币金额，支持峰谷分时与 Search/Fetch 按次计费。

plugins.name: DeepSeek-Usage

description.en: DeepSeek balance and token usage panel for DSH, with official platform billing, a daily usage calendar, and local session-log estimates for all providers using editable per-model pricing.
description.zh: DSH 里的 DeepSeek 用量面板：官方账户余额与账单、每日用量日历，以及按可编辑的逐模型费率估算全部 Provider 的本地会话日志用量。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: DeepTrace — deterministic agent reports from session logs (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly/custom): cost & token breakdown, 8 insight rules, collaboration review, live provider balance, PDF/PNG/HTML export; read-only, never rewrites history.
description.zh: 深迹 DeepTrace — 从会话日志生成日报/周报/月报/年报/自定义区间报告：成本与 Token 拆解、8 条确定性洞察、协作复盘、实时模型余额、PDF/PNG/HTML 导出；只读，绝不改写历史。

plugins.name: dsh-abacus

description.en: Buckets every model call by local date, provider and model, then shows the totals in a sidebar card, a per-chat pill under the composer and a settings page, alongside each provider's account balance and subscription windows.
description.zh: 把每次模型调用按本地日期、供应商与模型记账，在侧栏卡片、输入框下方的单会话胶囊和设置页里展示用量合计，并同列展示各供应商的账户余额与套餐窗口。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: ds-api-usage

description.en: DeepSeek API balance and 24-hour usage dashboard in Settings, with estimated spend, token counts, request counts, and an hourly timeline.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 DeepSeek API 余额与最近 24 小时用量，包括估算消费、Token、请求次数和按小时时间线。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Composer pill with the DeepSeek account balance, the live peak/off-peak pricing phase, and this session's spend priced request by request at the rate in effect when each request was sent. Subagent sessions' costs are aggregated into the parent session; Search and Fetch fees are charged only for DeepSeek's search engine, while third-party engines (Tavily, Bing, Exa, …) are counted but free. The balance refresh interval is configurable.
description.zh: 输入框下方的余额胶囊：显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、实时峰谷时段，以及本会话花费——每条请求都按发出时刻生效的峰谷单价计价，子智能体会话的花费汇总进父会话；Search 与 Fetch 只对 DeepSeek 搜索引擎计费，Tavily、Bing、Exa 等第三方引擎只计数不计费；余额刷新间隔可在插件设置页调整。

description.en: Token usage dashboard for the whole harness: billed tokens from every session are rolled up per session and turn (uncached input, cache read, cache write and output) with a peak/off-peak CNY cost estimate, and a "Token 用量" entry above Settings in the sidebar opens the dashboard at /token-stats, in a new tab on the web and in an in-app popup on the Desktop. The page recollects and repaints every 60 seconds while the tab is visible. Usage is read from the same session event stream dsh-token-meter consumes, accepting 0.1.x assistant/chunk and 0.2.x assistant/message and assistant/attempt, and counting an attempt repeated after an llm retry as its own billed call; cold history is seeded once from a persisted rollup file and afterwards only logs whose mtime or size changed are re-parsed. Host half and client half ship in the one package.
description.zh: 整个 Harness 的 Token 用量看板：把全部会话的计费 token（未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出）按会话与轮次汇总，并给出高峰/低谷的人民币预估费用；侧边栏「Token 用量」入口（在设置上方）打开 /token-stats 看板，Web 端新标签页、桌面端应用内弹窗。标签页可见时每 60 秒自动重新采集并重绘。用量读取的是 dsh-token-meter 消费的同一条会话事件流，兼容 0.1.x 的 assistant/chunk 与 0.2.x 的 assistant/message、assistant/attempt；llm 重试后的再次采样按一次新的计费计入；冷历史只从持久化 rollup 文件播种一次，之后仅对 mtime/size 变化的日志做增量重解析。宿主半与客户端半在同一个包里。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that aggressively saves tokens without affecting task quality: lossless head/tail truncation of tool results (default), grep-result folding, pressure-triggered dsh-compaction-basic delegation, and an LLM-summary CompactionEngine subclass for the aggressive mode. Saves 97.6% of input tokens on an 8-scenario synthetic suite, with all reductions routed through dsh event flow so model-visible = logged stays intact.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 设计的 token 节省插件：不损失任务效果。默认 conservative 档对工具结果做无损头尾裁剪与 grep 折叠；balanced 档在压力阈值委托 dsh-compaction-basic；aggressive 档以 LLM-summary 引擎子类化替换官方压缩。8 个合成场景累计节省 97.6% 输入 tokens，所有削减走 dsh 事件流，model-visible = logged 不变式仍成立。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-monitor

description.en: Shows selectable DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, and TeamoRouter balances in the DSH Web sidebar, with per-provider details, usage data, and refresh controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧边栏展示可选的 DeepSeek、Kimi、智谱 GLM 和 TeamoRouter 余额，并提供渠道详情、用量数据与刷新控制。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-ofm-balance

description.en: Per-channel credit balances for the Our Free Model gateway in the DSH sidebar: one always-on card covering the channels the gateway supports (unconfigured channels stay hidden), collapsed to the channel the current conversation uses, expanded to one row per channel with a bar and remaining amount, with per-channel visibility toggles on the plugin detail page.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏显示 Our Free Model 网关各渠道的剩余额度：一张常驻卡片覆盖网关支持的渠道（未配置的默认隐藏），折叠时显示当前对话所用渠道及其剩余百分比，展开后每个渠道一行含进度条与余量，并可在插件详情页按渠道开关显示。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Read-only dashboard for token usage, cost, request speed, and first-token latency across local DSH sessions.
description.zh: 只读看板，汇总本机 DSH 会话的 Token 用量、费用、请求速度与首字耗时。

description.en: Usage tiers and shareable stats cards: 🐟→🐳 ranks by monthly token burn with a locally-computed estimated percentile, precise pricing for 46 models across 6 vendors (including size-tiered Chinese pricing), backfill of pre-install sessions, and old-vs-new comparison across the 2026-08-17 rate change. Local-only, no telemetry.
description.zh: 用量段位与战绩卡片：按本月 token 消耗评 🐟→🐳 五档段位，分位本地估算（零上报）；6 家厂商 46 个模型精准计价，支持国内厂商按输入长度分档；自动回填安装前的历史会话；8·17 调价前后同一份用量的新旧价对比。数据全在本机，无遥测。

description.en: Account-level DeepSeek platform usage inside the DSH settings page — 52-week token heatmap, per-API-key and per-model breakdown, live balance.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页查看 DeepSeek 开放平台的账号级用量：52 周热力图、按 API Key 与模型的拆分、实时余额。

description.en: Writes the session's estimated cost into the composer token-usage pill, and adds a per-bucket amount plus an estimated total to the usage dialogs, using DeepSeek's official peak and off-peak rates in yuan.
description.zh: 把本次会话的估算费用直接写进输入框上方的 Token 用量胶囊，并在用量弹窗里为每个分项补上金额与预估合计，按 DeepSeek 官方高峰与空闲时段价（人民币）计算。

description.en: A lightweight plugin that adds model thinking token statistics to the bottom Dock.
description.zh: 在底部 Dock 添加模型思考 token 统计信息的轻量化插件。

description.en: Cross-session usage rollup that resolves opaque route keys to real model names, with a per-request log, an editable four-bucket price table that leaves unknown models unpriced instead of guessing, and a calendar-day-filled bar trend whose values appear only on hover or keyboard focus.
description.zh: 本机跨会话用量汇总：把 qfmodel 这类不透明路由键解析为真实模型名，含逐请求明细表与可编辑的四桶价格表（无公开单价的模型标为未计价而非猜测），趋势柱状图按日历日补齐、数值仅在悬浮或键盘聚焦时显示。

description.en: Cross-agent token usage dashboard: aggregates local conversation logs from Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor IDE, DSH, OpenClaw, CodeWhale, Hermes and more into a persistent ledger that survives log deletion, with cache-hit rate, cost estimation, period comparison and day drill-down analytics in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 跨 Agent 的 token 用量看板:聚合 Claude Code、OpenCode、Cursor、DSH、OpenClaw、CodeWhale、Hermes 等本地对话日志,台账持久化(删除聊天记录后历史仍留存),提供缓存命中率、成本估算、环比对比与当日下钻分析的侧边栏面板。

description.en: Scheduled daily credit check-in for Trae CN, WorkBuddy, Qoder and MiniMax Code with per-platform toggles and history. Currently verified on macOS with DSH Desktop 0.12.1.
description.zh: 每天定时为 Trae CN、WorkBuddy、Qoder、MiniMax Code 领取每日积分，支持平台开关与签到记录。目前在 macOS 的 DSH Desktop 0.12.1 上验证。

description.en: Trims the GenUI card component prompt per global, workspace, or session scope; the built-in presets cut 24% to 61% of the prompt.
description.zh: 按全局、工作区、会话三级裁剪 GenUI 卡片组件提示词；内置预设削减 24% 到 61% 的提示词。

plugins.name: dsh-liquid-glass-balance-card

description.en: Draggable 3D liquid-glass floating card for the DSH web GUI: DeepSeek API balance, cumulative spend/token stats (today/yesterday/7d/30d/all), adjustable glass/3D/color controls, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: DSH 网页右上角可拖动 3D 液态玻璃余额卡片：显示 DeepSeek API 余额、累计消费与 Token 统计（今天/昨天/近7天/近30天/全部），玻璃参数/3D 厚度/颜色均可调，内置官方充值入口。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Shows per-answer and conversation cost estimates from recorded token usage, with automatic model pricing updates and detailed price-source breakdowns.
description.zh: 根据已记录的 Token 用量估算每轮回答和会话费用，支持自动更新模型价格及查看价格来源明细。

description.en: Displays token usage statistics, daily and weekly heatmaps, activity insights, and model rankings from DSH session logs, with locally persisted aggregates.
description.zh: 根据 DSH 会话日志展示 Token 用量统计、每日与每周热力图、活跃情况和模型排名，并在本地持久保存汇总数据。

description.en: Saves tokens in DeepSeek Harness sessions by reading any file by line range or symbol mention instead of whole, and by bounding oversized tool results while keeping a recovery path. Pruning happens at the source, not after content reaches the context. Measured 43.9% fewer prompt tokens in a modelled 30-step session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话节省 token：按行号或符号定位读取文件而不是整份读，并对过大的工具结果设上限且保留取回路径。修剪发生在源头，而不是内容进入上下文之后。在建模的 30 步会话上实测 prompt tokens 减少 43.9%。

plugins.name: dsh-token-dash

description.en: Token dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: per-provider monthly budgets, subscription quotas (GLM / Kimi Coding), account balances, and time-range cost and real-Token breakdowns — plus local JSON export and import for backup.
description.zh: DSH Token 看板：按供应商的月度预算、订阅配额（GLM / Kimi Coding）、账户余额，支持当天 / 7 天 / 30 天 / 全部范围查看费用与真实 Tokens，并可本地导出 / 导入备份。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A configurable 17-segment session status bar for the dsh composer dock with live TPS, per-model cost estimation, and a usage & cost dialog.
description.zh: 输入栏下可配置的 17 段会话状态栏，提供实时 TPS、按模型分别计价的费用估算，以及用量与费用弹窗。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-plugin

description.en: DeepSeek balance and token usage in the web sidebar, with a today/all-time toggle and provider filtering.
description.zh: dsh 网页侧边栏的 DeepSeek 余额与 token 用量监控：今日/累计切换，并按 provider 过滤其他厂商。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Session cost in rubles in the composer dock — the tariff in effect with its countdown, the API cost at that tariff, the CBR rate, the total including subagents, cache savings, and DeepSeek Platform balances.
description.zh: 在输入框坞区显示以卢布计的当前会话费用：当前时段与倒计时、该时段的 API 费用、央行汇率、含 subagent 的合计、缓存节省与 DeepSeek 平台余额。

description.en: DeepSeek API balance + per-call cost tracker: durable per-call cost ledger from real usage chunks with official Beijing peak/off-peak (x2) pricing, 60 s balance polling, and a sidebar footer action showing balance and today's spend.
description.zh: DeepSeek 余额与逐次调用成本追踪：基于真实 usage 的持久化成本账本，支持官方高峰/低谷定价（北京时间 ×2），60 秒余额轮询，侧栏底部显示余额与今日消耗。

description.en: Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.
description.zh: Web UI 美元成本徽标：头部显示会话总成本、每条回复结尾显示该轮成本，悬停看分项。

description.en: DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer plus spend per session, today, this month and all time, priced by a configurable time-of-day price table per currency (DeepSeek CNY/USD defaults included). Two read-only remote methods, no host routes, key read through the host credentials seam on every call, egress only to the configured provider origin.
description.zh: 侧栏脚注显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并按会话/今日/本月/累计统计花费，按可配置的分时价格表（按币种分表，内置 DeepSeek 人民币/美元默认表）计价。两个只读远程方法，无宿主路由，密钥每次经宿主凭据缝读取，只向配置的供应商域名出网。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-panel

description.en: Provider quota and balance status widget for the DSH web UI, showing remaining quota, usage and rate-limit windows in a dock at the bottom of the composer. Local fork of wenzetan/dsh-quota-panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 端的供应商额度与余额状态小组件，在输入框底部的停靠区展示剩余额度、用量与限流窗口。wenzetan/dsh-quota-panel 的本地分叉。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Prompt enhancer for the DSH web UI with basic/standard/expert modes: standard/expert modes rewrite drafts with project context and recent session history, retry gracefully when gateways reject reasoning-effort settings, and show a before/after review with undo.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面提示词增强插件：基础/标准/专家三档模式，标准/专家模式结合项目上下文与最近会话历史重写草稿；网关拒绝推理档位参数时自动去参重试；增强结果支持对比确认与撤回。

description.en: DeepSeek account wallet balance and the current peak or off-peak billing period, in a fixed status region at the sidebar foot, with a manual refresh and an official top-up link.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部固定状态区：DeepSeek 账号钱包余额、当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）、手动刷新与官方充值入口。

plugins.name: dsh-coding-plan-quota

description.en: Quota ring beside the DSH model selector that reads OpenCode Go and 14 other coding-plan quotas or balances, cycles the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, and colours itself by urgency.
description.zh: DSH 模型选择器旁的额度圆环，读取 OpenCode Go 等 15 个 coding plan 的用量或余额，点击循环 5 小时、每周、每月窗口，按紧急程度着色。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Counts the subagent sessions a conversation spawned and shows their token usage and CNY cost in the composer dock, grouped by parent turn.
description.zh: 在输入框工具条上统计本会话派出的子智能体 token 用量与人民币花费，按 turn 分组。

plugins.name: Balance & Quota · 余额与额度

description.en: Shows the current provider's account balance or coding-plan quota above the composer, with usage percentages and reset countdowns.
description.zh: 在输入框上方查看当前模型供应商的账户余额或套餐额度，显示已用比例和重置倒计时。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Floating usage window for DSH Web showing Claude and Codex subscription windows with reset countdowns, plus DeepSeek API spend and balance; display-only companion to dsh-cost-meter.
description.zh: DSH Web 悬浮用量小窗，显示 Claude、Codex 订阅用量窗口与重置倒计时，以及 DeepSeek API 今日花费与余额；只展示，是 dsh-cost-meter 的伴侣。

plugins.name: dsh-offpeak

description.en: Holds DeepSeek model calls for the rest of each peak-hour window you configure instead of sending them, so they are billed at off-peak rates; also pauses active goals while it waits and shows the account balance with an 8-hour spend chart.
description.zh: 在你配置的高峰时段内不发送 DeepSeek 模型调用，直到该时段结束再发出，从而按低谷价格计费；等待期间暂停进行中的目标，并显示账户余额与 8 小时消费图表。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance as a row in the sidebar footer with a refresh button, and opens a popover with the balance card, daily token and estimated-cost charts over a 7/30-day window, a per-model table, and a link to the platform usage page. The balance comes from the official /user/balance endpoint; usage is aggregated from local DSH session logs and priced with the published peak/off-peak rate card in CNY, so it is labelled an estimate and its scope is stated on the panel.
description.zh: 在侧边栏脚部显示一行 DeepSeek 账户余额（带刷新按钮），点击打开弹层：余额卡、7/30 天每日 Token 与估算费用图表、按模型明细表，以及平台用量页外链。余额取自官方 /user/balance 接口；用量由本机 DSH 会话日志聚合，按官方峰谷单价以人民币估算，因此界面明确标注为估算值并写明统计范围。

plugins.name: dsh-musage

description.en: Shows coding-plan usage and balance for 5 AI providers (MiniMax, DeepSeek, Kimi, OpenRouter, Zhipu) beside the composer input, switching with the selected model and reusing API keys configured in DSH model settings.
description.zh: 在 composer 输入框旁显示 5 家 AI 套餐用量与余额（MiniMax、DeepSeek、Kimi、OpenRouter、智谱），跟随当前模型自动切换，复用 DSH 模型设置里已配的 API Key。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-wallet-patched

description.en: Maintained fork of feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center, which has not been updated since 2026-09-09. Pricing follows the official model pool instead of a hardcoded model prefix, so DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (`deepseek-flash`) is billed and shows its peak/off-peak clock, and the official price page is parsed structurally so a renamed or retired model no longer stops price sync. Adds an English interface beside the original Chinese. Otherwise the same plugin: balance, per-session cost and token breakdown, a 24-hour peak/off-peak clock, Z.ai plan quota, and a local usage ledger, following the host light/dark theme.
description.zh: feibi-mochi/deepseek-harness-control-center 的维护分支，上游自 2026-09-09 起未再更新。计价改为跟随官方模型池、而非硬编码模型前缀，因此 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash（`deepseek-flash`）能正常计价并显示峰谷时钟；官方价格页改为结构化解析，模型改名或下架不再中断价格同步。界面在原有中文之外增加英文。其余与原插件一致：余额、本会话花费与 token 拆分、24 小时峰谷时钟、Z.ai 套餐额度与本机用量账本，并跟随宿主明暗主题。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Live tokens-per-second readout for the current session, docked to the sidebar or draggable as a floating card, with the placement chosen at the card's top-right corner.
description.zh: 当前会话的实时 tokens/s 读数卡片，可停靠左侧栏或作为悬浮卡片拖动，形态在卡片右上角切换。

description.en: Exports the agent loop to GreptimeDB as OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, with seven Grafana dashboards covering token usage, cost, session outcomes and per-turn latency.
description.zh: 把 agent loop 以 OpenTelemetry traces、metrics、logs 导出到 GreptimeDB，附七个 Grafana dashboard，覆盖 token 用量、成本、会话结果和每轮耗时。

plugins.name: dsh-grok-xai

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for SuperGrok and X Premium subscriptions: device-code sign-in, the xai provider, account-visible chat models with context and per-million-token prices, reasoning efforts read from model capabilities, and subscription usage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SuperGrok / X Premium 订阅插件：设备码登录、xai 提供商、账号可见对话模型与上下文/百万 token 价格、按模型能力读取的推理强度，以及订阅用量。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: One-click upgrade to Deepseek Harness, with version number displayed in the sidebar.
description.zh: 一键升级Deepseek Harness, 支持侧边栏显示版本号.

description.en: Settings-page usage dashboard: per-provider/model token summary across all sessions, with today/7-day/30-day CSS-bar trends and a cache-hit rate.
description.zh: 设置页用量仪表盘：按服务商/模型汇总全部会话 token 用量，含今日/近 7 天/近 30 天趋势柱状图与缓存命中率。

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly windows with reset countdowns) in the composer dock, with a built-in credential editor.
description.zh: 在输入框上方 dock 显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（5h 滚动/每周/每月窗口与重置倒计时），内置凭据编辑器。

plugins.name: dsh-toolkit#dsh-api-balance

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API balance and per-turn conversation cost directly in the session UI.
description.zh: 在会话界面里直接显示 DeepSeek API 余额与每轮对话花费。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-glm-balance

description.en: Composer status bar for GLM Coding Plan quota: 5-hour and weekly limits with reset times, MCP tool usage, and today's model usage, plus a glm_balance query tool.
description.zh: 在输入框下方常驻显示智谱 GLM Coding Plan 余量，含 5 小时/每周额度、重置时间、MCP 调用量与今日用量，并附 glm_balance 查询工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Live estimated session spend in the composer dock, pricing each assistant step at DeepSeek's peak or off-peak rate for its own timestamp.
description.zh: 在输入框底栏显示当前会话的预估花费，每一步都按其自身时间戳采用 DeepSeek 的峰时或非峰时单价计价。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage

description.en: Floating pill for DeepSeek Harness that shows OpenCode Go usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows as three rings, works out the remaining model quota automatically and can show the DeepSeek account balance alongside; a minimal mode nests the rings and lets you choose which of the 5-hour / weekly / monthly figures each outer / middle / inner ring shows, with a live preview.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮窗：三环显示 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月用量，支持自动计算模型配额剩余，可选同时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额；极简模式把三环嵌套显示并支持自定义外 / 中 / 内环数据与实时预览。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Agent-tree token budget management.
description.zh: agent 树 token 预算管理。

description.en: OpenCode Go plan usage display for the DSH web GUI: a persistent badge under the composer shows rolling/weekly/monthly usage percents with reset countdowns; click to expand a card; agents can query the balance via the `opencode_go_usage` tool.
description.zh: OpenCode Go 套餐用量显示：输入框下方常驻徽章显示滚动 / 每周 / 每月用量百分比与重置倒计时，点击展开进度卡片；Agent 可经 `opencode_go_usage` 工具随时查询余额。

description.en: Refines the built-in cache-hit percentage to three decimals in place across the composer stats row and the token-usage dialog.
description.zh: 把内置缓存命中率在 composer 统计行与 Token 用量弹窗中原位精化为三位小数。

description.en: Floating one-line widget showing how much Alibaba Cloud credit is left (voucher balance + account balance), with voucher face value, used amount and earliest expiry on hover. Read-only BSS queries, no spend tracking.
description.zh: 界面悬浮一行显示「还能花的钱」= 阿里云代金券余额 + 账户余额；悬停看券面值、已用与最早失效时间。只读 BSS 存量，不做消费统计。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage

description.en: Plan-usage pet for the DSH web GUI: a floating skeletal-animated character reports quota in a speech bubble, auto-matching the configured provider (OpenCode Go, Command Code, DeepSeek) to show a plan percentage or an account balance, and falling back to local token stats when the provider API is unavailable; draggable, wheel-scalable (90-260px), synthesized click sounds, loopback-only routes.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的桌宠用量小窗：悬浮的骨骼动画角色用气泡报出套餐用量，按 DSH 里配置的 provider 自动匹配（OpenCode Go / Command Code / DeepSeek 官方），套餐制显示百分比、按量计费显示余额，取不到官方数字时降级为本地 token 统计；可拖动、滚轮缩放（90–260px），音效现场合成，HTTP 路由只开 loopback。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Real-time token estimates for the DSH conversation composer, combining the current context baseline with the draft and showing exact or heuristic counts.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话输入框实时估算 token 数，将当前上下文基线与草稿合并计算，并区分精确计数与启发式估算。

plugins.name: dsh-composer-balance

description.en: One chip in the composer dock: the account balance plus what the current chat has cost, priced per turn at the tariff in force when each turn ran. Clicking it opens a 264px card in the panel style of the host, with refresh and settings buttons.
description.zh: 输入框下方一枚芯片：显示账户余额与当前对话花费，花费按每轮发生时刻的峰谷档位逐段计价。点击展开 264px 卡片，沿用宿主自带面板的样式，带刷新与设置两个按钮。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-quota-panel

description.en: Bottom-right quota capsule that auto-discovers every configured provider (DeepSeek, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, GLM, one-api/new-api, coding plans) and shows balance or rolling 5-hour and weekly usage, with per-provider visibility, alert thresholds and proxy support; also queries Volcengine Ark Agent Plan / Coding Plan usage via AK/SK-signed OpenAPI, and ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription usage via in-plugin device-code login or the Codex CLI auth file.
description.zh: 右下角额度胶囊：自动发现所有已配置 Key 的供应商（DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow、GLM、one-api/new-api、各类 Coding 套餐），显示余额或 5 小时/周滚动用量，支持按供应商设置可见性、告警阈值与代理；另支持火山方舟 Agent Plan / Coding Plan 用量查询（AK/SK 签名 OpenAPI）与 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 订阅用量（插件内设备码登录，或读取 Codex CLI 登录态）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Per-request cost ledger covering retries and subagents, holiday-aware peak/off-peak pricing, shared pricing/usage/balance/budget services, and DeepSeek bill reconciliation.
description.zh: 按请求记录费用，涵盖重试与子代理，支持节假日峰谷计价、共享计价/用量/余额/预算服务和 DeepSeek 账单对账。

description.en: Cost readouts for the composer, turns and sessions, a usage dashboard, daily/monthly budgets and settings, with DeepSeek balance from dsh-tally-balance-deepseek.
description.zh: 提供输入框费用条、每轮与会话费用详情、用量看板、日/月预算和设置，并通过 dsh-tally-balance-deepseek 显示 DeepSeek 余额。

description.en: Per-turn and per-session estimated cost in the DSH Web UI, computed from provider-reported token usage in four buckets with the built-in official DeepSeek CNY peak/off-peak card — peak hours are Monday-Friday 9:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time, weekends and Chinese statutory holidays are off-peak all day. An optional local JSON rate table overlays prices for other or self-hosted models, and models without a price show tokens only.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面显示每轮与整个会话的预估费用：按 provider 上报的 token 用量（四桶）与内置官方 DeepSeek 人民币峰谷价目计价，高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日全天按空闲价；可用本机费率表叠加其它或自部署模型的单价，没有单价的模型只显示 token。

description.en: Cost pill at the right end of the composer stats row, showing the estimated cost of the current turn and the session total; clicking it opens a two-column panel with input, cache and output spend for the turn and the session, dialogue turns, today's and lifetime spend, and this session's cache-hit rate and cache saving. Rates follow the official DeepSeek price table including peak pricing (double on weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, statutory holidays excluded), each message is priced at the time it settled, and prices.json reloads without a restart.
