description.zh: 位于输入框统计行右端的成本胶囊，显示估算的本轮费用与会话总费用；点开后是双栏面板，列出本轮与本会话的输入、缓存、输出支出，对话轮数，今日与总计支出，以及本会话缓存命中率和缓存节省。价格取自 DeepSeek 官方价目表并含峰时计价（北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 加倍，法定节假日除外），每条消息按结算时刻取价，prices.json 改动后无需重启即可生效。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-quota

description.en: OpenCode Go quota in the sidebar foot under the workspace list: one cell for the most constrained window plus a hover popover with the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly percents, each with a usage bar, an elapsed-time marker, the remaining share and a reset countdown, refreshed every 60 seconds from OpenCode's official usage API using the key already in the DSH credential store.
description.zh: 在侧边栏「工作区」列表下方显示 OpenCode Go 的滚动 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月额度百分比与重置倒计时，每档带用量条与时间进度标记，60 秒从 OpenCode 官方用量接口刷新，密钥复用 DSH 凭据库。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Multi-provider usage stats framework (v2 adapter contract): persistent capsule plus detail panel; DeepSeek official (interval-bookkeeping daily usage derivation with a peak/valley countdown badge, working even without an official usage endpoint) and OpenCode Go built in; any other data source joins by dropping in a single mjs adapter file, hot-swappable from the settings page, with API keys kept on the host.
description.zh: 多 provider 用量统计框架（v2 适配器契约）：常驻胶囊 + 详情面板；内置 DeepSeek 官方（区间记账法推算每日用量 + 峰谷倒计时徽标，官方无用量接口也能算）与 OpenCode Go；其他数据源只需放入一个 mjs 适配器文件即可接入，设置页热插拔，密钥只留在宿主端。

description.en: Adds an AIignore tab to the right sidebar: scores the open conversation and its folder across five dimensions, blocks reads of build output, lockfiles and logs before they reach the model, and writes the .aiignore rules for them one button at a time.
description.zh: 在右侧栏新增 AIignore 标签页：按五个维度给当前对话和所在目录打分，在构建产物、锁文件、日志被读进模型之前把它们拦下，并能一键把这些规则写进 .aiignore。

description.en: Local-first usage analytics for DSH: subscribes to session events and aggregates tool calls, turns, errors, latency and capability usage into daily tables, shown in a sidebar panel (6 KPIs, 14-day trend, top tools, capability breakdown) and served over a fenced local HTTP API with 18 JSON-RPC methods. Zero runtime dependencies, local mode makes no outbound requests, and no message bodies are collected.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 用量分析：订阅会话事件，把工具调用、回合、错误、耗时与能力使用聚合为日表，在侧栏面板展示（6 个 KPI、14 日趋势、Top 工具、能力分布），并通过受围栏保护的本地 HTTP 接口暴露 18 个 JSON-RPC 方法。运行时零依赖，local 模式零出站，不采集任何消息正文。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-gauge

description.en: Peak/off-peak billing cost dial for the DSH Web GUI: session token usage billed at the official DeepSeek peak and off-peak rates, a rate dial with a model-colored needle and switch countdown, a balance ring with a low-balance alarm, drag-to-resize, and a minimized status-lamp mode.
description.zh: 峰谷计费表盘：DSH Web 浮动窗按 DeepSeek 官方峰谷（高峰/空闲）费率对会话花费（token 费用）实时计费，指针配费率切换倒计时，余额环带低余额报警，支持拖拽缩放与最小化状态灯。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: CLIProxyAPI quota for DeepSeek Harness: a ring beside the model picker plus a settings panel listing every account quota windows with plans and reset times.
description.zh: 模型选择器旁的 CLIProxyAPI 额度圆环，设置面板仿 CPA 管理页列出全部账号的额度窗口、套餐与刷新时间。

description.en: Live token usage and estimated cost in the sidebar: the current task plus every session combined, an as-of clock for those totals, per-session time detail (elapsed, turns/steps, first-token, model vs tool time, decode speed), and a per-turn breakdown with each turn cost on hover.
description.zh: 侧栏里实时显示 token 用量与估算费用：当前任务与全部会话合计、这份账目的截至时刻、逐会话时间明细（运行时长/轮步/首token/模型与工具耗时/解码速度），鼠标悬停某个对话还能看到逐轮用量与每轮费用。

description.en: Composer readouts for the DeepSeek Harness: CJK-weighted draft token count, session spend at official peak/idle rates, context occupancy, and what the same usage would have cost on the costliest other model; client-only, with no host half and no credential access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 输入框下方的实时草稿 token 数、按官方高峰/空闲费率计算的会话花费、上下文占用，以及同样的用量在最贵的另一个模型上会花多少；纯客户端，没有 host 半，不接触凭据。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-dashboard

description.en: DeepSeek Harness usage analytics dock on the composer: Beijing-time peak/valley pricing with all-day weekend valley rate, live balance, cross-session history, by-date drill-down and charts.
description.zh: DSH 用量分析坞：输入框峰谷计费坞（周末全天谷时）、实时余额、跨会话历史、按日期下钻与图表。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek token usage, per-call and session costs, and account balance with cache-aware charge animations in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面追踪 DeepSeek Token 用量、单次与会话费用及账户余额，并显示缓存感知的扣费动画。

plugins.name: dsh-od-quota

description.en: OpenDesign subscription quota: a sidebar page for the 5-hour and 7-day allowance, with an adaptive quota meter in the session header.
description.zh: OpenDesign 订阅额度：左栏额度页看 5 小时 / 7 天剩余额度，顶栏自适应额度条一眼可见。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-billing-compass

description.en: Composer-dock billing panel: DeepSeek account balance, official per-model usage and spend with cost per 100M tokens, plus cost estimates for this run and the whole conversation. Clicking opens a popover that matches the composer's width and position; balance comes from /user/balance, usage and spend from platform's usage endpoints, and the whole-conversation total is folded read-only from the local session log. Zero dependencies (node:https + node:zlib), writes nothing to disk.
description.zh: 输入框下方的计费面板：DeepSeek 账户余额、官网各模型用量与消费（含每亿 token 单价）、本次运行与整段对话的费用估算。点击弹出面板，面板与输入框同宽同位；余额走官方 /user/balance，用量与消费走 platform 的 usage 接口，整段用量由本地会话日志只读汇总。零依赖（node:https + node:zlib），不写任何文件。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-api-balance

description.en: Live DeepSeek API balance and this session's token usage in the conversation header, with a detail panel for the topped-up / granted balance split, request count, input, output and cache-hit tokens, and context pressure. The API key is read on every query and is never cached, written to disk or returned to the browser.
description.zh: 在对话标题栏实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额与本会话 token 用量，详情面板展开余额拆分（充值／赠送）、请求次数、输入／输出／缓存命中 tokens 与上下文占用；API Key 每次查询现取，不缓存、不落盘、不返回浏览器。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A floating balance widget for the Web UI: live DeepSeek account balance with manual refresh and a Y/N-confirmed graceful exit.
description.zh: Web UI 右上角悬浮窗：实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，支持手动刷新与一键优雅退出（Y/N 快捷键确认）。

description.en: Token usage statistics plugin for DeepSeek Harness - today's token consumption by model, cache hit rate, 7-day trend chart, optional header badge, persistent storage with auto cleanup.
description.zh: DSH Token 用量统计插件 - 今日 Token 用量按模型分桶、缓存命中率、7 日趋势图、可选顶栏徽标、持久化存储自动清理。

description.en: Tracks this turn cost under the input box, today tokens and spend in the sidebar with peak and idle pricing, and pins the latest question to the top of the conversation.
description.zh: 输入框下方显示本轮花费；侧栏显示今日 token、消费与高峰/空闲时段；对话区顶部钉住最新提问，点击可跳回。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-stats

description.en: Token usage statistics by model, session and date in a sidebar panel, plus OpenCode Go quota, DeepSeek balance and Z.ai quota monitoring.
description.zh: 在侧边栏按模型、会话与日期统计 token 用量，并监控 OpenCode Go 额度、DeepSeek 余额与 Z.ai 额度。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Local Token usage dashboard in DSH Settings with hourly activity, daily heatmaps, custom date ranges, model breakdowns, local/API filters, and native cache-hit accounting, without cost estimates or composer overrides. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中统计本地 Token 用量，支持小时活动图、日历热力图、自定义日期、模型用量分布、本地/API 筛选和原生缓存命中口径，不估算费用，不替换输入框状态栏。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高兼容版本。

description.en: Billing-period and balance pill under the DSH composer: it shows the account balance and the current conversation cost alongside the peak/off-peak state and a countdown to the next switch. The peak/off-peak rules cover China statutory holidays and weekends, and the conversation cost is measured as the decrease in account balance between the plugin's 60-second idle balance refreshes.
description.zh: DSH 输入框下方的计费时段与余额药丸：常显账户余额与本次对话花费，并显示峰价/谷价档位与距下次切换的倒计时。峰谷判定含中国法定节假日与周末；本次对话花费按余额差值记账，采样点是插件自带的「对话停止满一分钟后刷新余额」。

description.en: K-ON! themed tea-table widget: click it to see the DeepSeek balance, today's spend and peak-hour state; each finished turn pops a cost bubble; double-click shows zh/ja character lines.
description.zh: 《轻音少女》部费挂件：茶桌加五人，点一下看余额、今天花费与峰谷状态；每轮对话结束弹消耗气泡，双击出中日对照角色台词。

description.en: Holds every final answer before delivery, has one independent minimal-context model call re-derive and check it, and releases only the verified text; the draft is never shown. Reviewed answers cost one extra model request and appear a few seconds later.
description.zh: 在最终回答送达前先扣住，交给一次独立、最小上下文的模型调用重新推导并校验，只放出校验后的文本，用户看不到草稿。被复核的回答多一次模型请求，文字出现前会多几秒。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-usage

description.en: Floating widget showing real-time OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) for every API key, with rate-limit alerts and automatic key-pool discovery.
description.zh: 悬浮组件实时显示 OpenCode Go 各 key 用量（滚动/每周/每月），限流预警，自动发现 key 池。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Proactive per-provider token-bucket rate limiting that queues over-limit requests before they are sent, preventing upstream 429 errors.
description.zh: 按 provider 令牌桶主动限速，超限请求在发出前延迟排队而非失败，避免触发上游 429。

description.en: Persistent token-usage ledger and Web Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 token 用量账本和 Web Usage 仪表盘。

plugins.name: dsh-token-plan-quota

description.en: Balance badge that follows the active model provider: official readings for DeepSeek, Qwen Token Plan and Aliyun BSS, plus Moonshot and OpenRouter endpoints not yet key-verified.
description.zh: 跟随当前模型供应商的额度徽标：DeepSeek、千问 Token Plan、阿里云费用中心取官方真值，Moonshot / OpenRouter 已接官方端点但字段未用真 Key 核对；其余只报本实例实测。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Routes dsh requests by conversation scenario and retries with fallback models when requests fail.
description.zh: 根据对话场景选择模型，并在请求失败时按候选链进行回退。

plugins.name: dsh-cpa-status

description.en: CPA account-pool status panel: sidebar health light, quota bars, success-rate ticks, and gateway key endings.
description.zh: CPA 账号池状态面板：侧栏健康灯、配额进度、成功率刻度与网关密钥末四位一览。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-service-monitor

description.en: Monitor the account balance for 3rd-party services those AI agents often use, such as Tavily, SerpAPI, Firecrawl, Bocha, Tinyfish, etc. Optionally you can select to inject the account balance into the system prompt, so the agent can use the services accordingly.
description.zh: 监控 AI Agents 常用的第三方服务余额，如 Tavily、SerpAPI、Firecrawl、博查、Tinyfish 等。可选支持将服务的余额注入 System Prompt，以便 Agent 合理使用相关服务。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-cost-live

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API balance (official endpoint) and today-spend estimate (this DSH instance session-log usage x per-model price table) for the DSH web: composer dock strip, always-on floating badge, full settings dashboard (7-day trend, per-model cost, editable price table and polling, history rescan). The API key never leaves the host.
description.zh: DSH Web 实时显示 DeepSeek API 官方余额与今日花费(本机会话日志用量 x 分模型价格表的本地估算):输入框下方统计小条 + 右下角常驻悬浮徽标 + 设置页完整面板(近 7 日趋势、分模型花费、可编辑价格表/轮询、历史重扫)。API Key 不出宿主进程。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Agent-structured prompt optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: rewrites composer drafts into role/task/context/constraint/format with normal, slim, and expand modes, a confirm modal with score, continue-optimize, and local, hybrid, DSH, or cloud-API engines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 结构化提示词优化：将输入栏草稿改写为角色/任务/上下文/约束/格式，支持普通/精简/扩写，弹窗含评分与继续优化，引擎可选本地、hybrid、DSH 或云端 API。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-balance

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek API account balance and live round-trip latency to the configured inference provider in one sidebar widget, with a configurable low-balance alert threshold. The balance needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY configured in DSH credentials, otherwise the widget shows a missing-key notice.
description.zh: 一个侧边栏挂件同时显示 DeepSeek API 账户余额与当前推理服务商的实时往返延迟，并可自定义余额告警阈值。读取余额需要在 DSH 凭据中配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，未配置时挂件会提示缺少密钥。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Cuts session input tokens three ways, each with its own switch in a panel under the composer: lossless structure-aware compression of tool results on `tools/post-execute`, then a per-tool head/tail elision that always names a recovery path through the shared spill store; tool-catalogue visibility per agent on `agent/created`; and a per-workspace memory document that recall matches against each new message and injects through `agent.inject`, so the transcript is not re-read. Measured 41.76% fewer prompt tokens over 149 recorded requests, with a bundled script that re-measures any profile.
description.zh: 三条路径削减会话输入 tokens，每条都在输入框下方的面板里带独立开关：在 `tools/post-execute` 处对工具结果做无损结构化压缩，再对超预算结果做按工具的头尾裁剪，且每次都通过共享 spill store 给出恢复路径；在 `agent/created` 处按 agent 管理工具目录可见性；并为每个工作区维护会话记忆文档，recall 用每条新消息匹配它并通过 `agent.inject` 注入，避免重读上下文。在 149 次真实请求上实测 prompt tokens 减少 41.76%，并附带可复测任意 profile 的测量脚本。

description.en: Floating cost crystal for the Web UI: balance card, real-time tok/s, peak/off-peak billing countdown, last-24h spend, and a 🔮 next-message cost forecast, all timezone-aware.
description.zh: Web UI 成本水晶球:余额卡片、实时 tok/s 速率、波峰/低峰计费倒计时、近 24h 消耗,以及 🔮 下一条消息消耗预测,全部时区感知。

description.en: Persistent local token-usage accounting for DSH Web with automatic history discovery and compact provider/model details.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供自动发现历史记录的本地持久化 Token 用量统计与紧凑的供应商/模型明细。

description.en: Per-session cost & usage report cards: tokens, cache hits, duration.
description.zh: 会话成本与耗时报表：tokens / 缓存命中 / 耗时。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud / Qwen balance card above the Settings row in the DSH web sidebar: account available and cash balance, coupon balances with expiry dates (student vouchers included) read through the BSS OpenAPI, and OpenAI-compatible relay quota. An official DashScope sk- key has no balance endpoint at all, so real money and coupons require an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey with bss:DescribeCoupons + bss:DescribeAcccount (AliyunBSSReadOnlyAccess is enough); secrets stay in the host process, the browser only sees a masked AccessKey ID, and /api/dsh-qwen-balance/* is loopback-only.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏「设置」行上方的阿里云 / Qwen 余额卡片：经 BSS OpenAPI 显示账户可用额度与现金余额、代金券余额与到期日（含学生 300 元券），以及 OpenAI 兼容中转站额度。官方百炼 / DashScope 的 sk- key 没有任何余额接口，想看真金白银与代金券必须用带 bss:DescribeCoupons + bss:DescribeAcccount（建议只挂 AliyunBSSReadOnlyAccess）的阿里云 AccessKey；密钥只留在宿主进程，浏览器只拿到掩码后的 AccessKey ID，/api/dsh-qwen-balance/* 仅允许环回访问。

plugins.name: dsh-usage-stats

description.en: Multi-provider usage dashboard with provider/model token breakdowns, calendar drill-downs, account balances, and OpenCode Go / Z.ai subscription quota tracking.
description.zh: 多供应商用量看板：按供应商/模型统计 Token 与日期下钻，统一展示账户余额，并追踪 OpenCode Go / Z.ai 订阅额度。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-subscribe-meter

description.en: Session cost meter forked from dsh-cost-meter, retargeted at Command Code GOAT: per-session and per-day cost, built-in 90+ model price catalog with automatic matching, GOAT subscription quotas (5-hour / weekly / monthly pool) as used/total bars, Coding Plan quotas, custom provider balances, peak/off-peak pricing notices, bilingual UI. It provides service:cost-meter like Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter and the other dsh-subscribe-meter variants, so install only one cost meter: it replaces dsh-cost-meter rather than running alongside it.
description.zh: dsh-cost-meter 的 Command Code GOAT 定制版：本会话与当日费用、内置 90+ 模型价格目录与自动匹配、GOAT 订阅额度（5 小时 / 周 / 月度池，已用/全部 进度条）、Coding Plan 额度、自定义 Provider 余额、峰谷计价提醒，界面中英双语。 它与 Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter 及同仓库其它变体提供同一个 service:cost-meter，只能装一个费用统计插件：本条目替代 dsh-cost-meter 安装，不能与上游同装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-subscribe-meter#dsh-newapi-meter

description.en: Session cost meter forked from dsh-cost-meter, retargeted at a self-hosted gateway: per-session and per-day cost, a 90+ model price catalog with automatic matching, gateway quota (one-api / new-api / sub2api, auto-detected) shown as used/total bars for the provider configured in DSH settings, Coding Plan quotas, provider balances, peak/off-peak pricing notices, bilingual UI. It provides service:cost-meter like Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter and the other dsh-subscribe-meter variants, so install only one cost meter: it replaces dsh-cost-meter rather than running alongside it.
description.zh: dsh-cost-meter 的 new-api 定制版：本会话与当日费用、内置 90+ 模型价格目录与自动匹配、网关额度（自动识别 one-api / new-api / sub2api，取 DSH「模型」设置里的 provider）以已用/全部进度条显示、Coding Plan 额度、自定义 Provider 余额、峰谷计价提醒，界面中英双语。 它与 Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter 及同仓库其它变体提供同一个 service:cost-meter，只能装一个费用统计插件：本条目替代 dsh-cost-meter 安装，不能与上游同装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-subscribe-meter#dsh-opencode-go-meter

description.en: Session cost meter forked from dsh-cost-meter, retargeted at OpenCode Go: per-session and per-day cost, a 90+ model price catalog with automatic matching, OpenCode Go subscription usage as rolling 5-hour / weekly / monthly percentages with progress bars, Coding Plan quotas, provider balances, peak/off-peak pricing notices, bilingual UI. It provides service:cost-meter like Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter and the other dsh-subscribe-meter variants, so install only one cost meter: it replaces dsh-cost-meter rather than running alongside it.
description.zh: dsh-cost-meter 的 OpenCode Go 定制版：本会话与当日费用、内置 90+ 模型价格目录与自动匹配、OpenCode Go 订阅用量（滚动 5 小时 / 本周 / 本月百分比 + 进度条）、Coding Plan 额度、自定义 Provider 余额、峰谷计价提醒，界面中英双语。 它与 Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter 及同仓库其它变体提供同一个 service:cost-meter，只能装一个费用统计插件：本条目替代 dsh-cost-meter 安装，不能与上游同装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-subscribe-meter#dsh-opendesign-go-meter

description.en: Session cost meter forked from dsh-cost-meter, retargeted at OpenDesign Cloud: per-session and per-day cost, a 39-model OpenDesign price catalog, OpenDesign Cloud quotas as rolling 5-hour and 7-day used/total bars read from the official funding-check endpoint, Coding Plan quotas, provider balances, peak/off-peak notices, bilingual UI. The quota card needs an OpenDesign Cloud account (the plugin has a built-in login), and it provides service:cost-meter like Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter and the other dsh-subscribe-meter variants, so install only one cost meter: it replaces dsh-cost-meter rather than running alongside it.
description.zh: dsh-cost-meter 的 OpenDesign Cloud 定制版：本会话与当日费用、39 个 OpenDesign 模型价格目录、OpenDesign Cloud 额度（联动官方 funding-check 接口，5 小时 / 7 天两档已用/全部进度条）、Coding Plan 额度、自定义 Provider 余额、峰谷计价提醒，界面中英双语。 额度卡需要 OpenDesign Cloud 账号（插件内置登录），且它与 Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter 及同仓库其它变体提供同一个 service:cost-meter，只能装一个费用统计插件：本条目替代 dsh-cost-meter 安装，不能与上游同装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-usage-wallet

description.en: Unofficial fork of dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage (baseline v0.16.0): sidebar balance and quota card for the active model provider, covering DeepSeek, Moonshot, Z.ai, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiniMax and OpenCode, plus Alibaba Cloud voucher balance for qwen-token-plan (BSS OpenAPI with AccessKey) and Xiaomi MiMo console balance with token-plan usage (console cookie). Ships a provider query-status page and per-token unit prices. Do not install it alongside upstream dsh-deepseek-usage: both render the same sidebar card.
description.zh: dougen/dsh-deepseek-usage 的非官方分支（基线 v0.16.0）：侧边栏余额与配额卡片，显示当前模型提供商的账户读数：DeepSeek、Moonshot、Z.ai、OpenRouter、Kimi、MiniMax、OpenCode；并为 qwen-token-plan 读取阿里云代金券余额（BSS OpenAPI + AccessKey），为小米 MiMo 读取控制台余额与套餐用量（控制台 Cookie）。另提供各提供商查询状态页与每 token 单价。不要与上游 dsh-deepseek-usage 同装：两者会渲染同一张侧边栏卡片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Per-model token cost tracking with configurable cache-hit/miss, output and peak-window pricing, a live session cost bar, and unconfigured-model flags.
description.zh: 按模型追踪 token 成本：可配置缓存命中/未命中、输出与高峰时段单价，实时会话花费条，并标记未配置价格的模型。

description.en: Free Egg credits panel for the DSH sidebar: WorkBuddy / Qoder account balances, daily budget, check-in state and per-turn spend (WorkBuddy credits priced per input / cache / output token type where rates are known), with one-click switching of the platform whose credits are spent first when new-api is configured. Requires a local WorkBuddy2API or Qoder gateway.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏看 WorkBuddy / Qoder 账号积分、今日额度、签到状态与每轮消耗（WorkBuddy 已知单价时按输入 / 缓存 / 输出分类型折算）；配置 new-api 后可一键切换优先消耗平台。需本机运行 WorkBuddy2API 或 Qoder 网关。

description.en: Auto-expand reasoning and tool cards, tune code-block font size and line spacing, and choose the model output language (auto, Chinese or English).
description.zh: 自动展开思考与工具卡片，调整代码块字号与行距，并可选择模型输出语言（自动、中文或 English）。

description.en: Unified token quota and usage statistics for dsh: multi-vendor rolling/payg quota with sidebar cards and provider ops, plus session-log token aggregation with trends, heatmap, and per-model breakdown. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
description.zh: DSH 额度与用量统计统一视图：多供应商滚动/按量额度（侧边栏卡片 + 供应商运维），外加会话日志 token 聚合（趋势、热力图、按模型拆分）。已归档并冻结在固定版本：作者不再为它适配新版 DSH。

plugins.name: dsh-float

description.en: Floating DeepSeek API balance capsule for the DSH Web GUI: a corner pill shows the remaining balance, clicking expands the total, granted and topped-up breakdown, double-clicking refreshes at once and the balance polls every 5 seconds; the host half proxies /user/balance so the key never reaches the browser.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 DeepSeek API 余额浮窗：角落胶囊显示余额，点击展开总额、赠金与充值明细，双击立即刷新且每 5 秒轮询一次；宿主侧代理 /user/balance，密钥不下发到浏览器。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: DSH-Balance-display

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek account balance badge in the sidebar footer with odometer roll animation, multi-currency support, balance trend chart, per-key usage statistics with historical backfill, and GitHub version auto-check.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额徽章：数字滚轮动画、多币种支持、余额趋势图、按 Key 用量统计（含安装前历史回填），并支持 GitHub 版本自动检查。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Usage statistics dashboard for the DSH Web UI: info cards, a 280-day GitHub-style activity heatmap, daily token trend, and model-usage donut chart.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 用量统计面板：信息卡、280 天活跃热力图、按天 Token 趋势与模型用量双环饼图。

description.en: Token attention management panel for DeepSeek Harness: per-task/day/week/month token usage and cost tracking (input hit/miss, output, reasoning), DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, task-type recognition, and advice on when to switch sessions, write a hand-off, or compact context.
description.zh: Token 注意力管理面板：按任务/日/周/月记录 token 消耗与费用（命中/未命中/输出/推理四桶），支持 DeepSeek 峰谷计价与任务类型识别，并给出换对话、写 hand-off、压缩上下文的建议。

description.en: Web search insights for the agent: it keeps a local log of what was looked up and which pages came back, and counts searches, returned pages, citations and pages opened per turn and across the session, with the numbers shown in a small entry under the answer and a right-sidebar panel.
description.zh: 联网搜索的「搜索洞察」：记下 Agent 查了什么、搜回哪些网页，并统计每轮与整个会话的搜索次数、返回网页数、被引用数与被打开读过的页数；这些数字在回答下方的引用入口和右侧栏面板里随时能回看。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-usage

description.en: Keeps DeepSeek usage and account balance in a bar at the bottom of the window.
description.zh: 在窗口底部常驻显示 DeepSeek 用量与账号余额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Floating Token Burn Dock for DSH that aggregates provider usage across every session: the collapsed capsule shows the live tokens/sec rate with an inline 60-second sparkline and today's total, while the expanded panel adds a large live-rate hero, per-model and per-hour breakdowns on a real left axis, and a 30-day commit-style heatmap. The sequence-frame flame burns only while tokens are actually flowing and goes out at rate 0; day and hour buckets follow the browser's UTC offset instead of the host process timezone, and the 31-day record store is written atomically after history load so a restart no longer wipes the numbers.
description.zh: DSH 的悬浮 Token 燃烧指数 Dock：汇总全部 session 的 provider usage。收起时是一枚胶囊，显示实时燃烧速率（含 token/s 单位）、内嵌近 60 秒速率曲线和今日总 Token；展开后是完整面板，含大号实时速率 Hero、按模型 / 按小时两种粒度、带真实左侧纵轴的柱状图，以及按真实星期对齐的近 30 天热力图。火焰是 16 帧程序生成的序列帧动画，只在真的有 Token 在烧时播放、速率为 0 时熄灭；日 / 小时分桶按浏览器时区（客户端把 UTC 偏移传给 Host），31 天记录先加载再原子落盘，重启不会再把历史覆盖清空。

description.en: The missing receipt for DeepSeek prefix caching: replays local DSH sessions, prices every call at official peak/off-peak rates, and produces an HTML receipt plus a shareable card.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 前缀缓存省下的钱逐笔算清：回放本地 DSH 会话、按官方峰谷价计费，生成 HTML 账单与可分享卡片。

description.en: Composer-dock badge that shows whether DeepSeek peak pricing is active: red during peak hours, yellow in the 30 minutes before they start, green off-peak, hidden for non-DeepSeek providers.
description.zh: 输入框下方的徽标：显示 DeepSeek 是否处于高峰计费时段——高峰时为红色，高峰开始前 30 分钟内为黄色，空闲为绿色；非 DeepSeek 来源时隐藏。

description.en: Real-time DeepSeek API usage: account balance with low-balance alerts (browser notification on threshold crossing), token & request stats (total/today/last-60s windows, per-model and per-session), estimated cost — a composer dock plus a settings-page usage panel.
description.zh: 实时 DeepSeek API 用量：账户余额与低余额告警（跨阈值浏览器通知）、请求/token 统计（全部/今日/近 60s，按模型与会话下钻）、估算花费——输入框下方统计条 + 设置页用量面板。

plugins.name: dsh-billing-balance

description.en: Shows DeepSeek API account balance and Volcengine Ark Coding/Agent Plan quota windows (5h/weekly/monthly with reset countdowns) in the settings panel, composer dock, and a draggable floating refresh button.
description.zh: 在设置页、输入框下方读数条与可拖动悬浮按钮三处显示 DeepSeek 官方 API 余额与火山方舟 Coding/Agent Plan 套餐额度（5小时/周/月窗口及重置倒计时）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Real-time session token usage and estimated cost in the composer stats row, with pricing fetched from DeepSeek official pricing page.
description.zh: 在输入框下方统计行实时显示当前会话累计 token 消耗与估算费用（人民币），价格从 DeepSeek 官方价格页动态获取。

description.en: Token usage and cost dashboard: requests, tokens, RPM/TPM over the last 60 minutes, cache hit rate, per-model and per-provider breakdown, a 12-month activity heatmap, and cost estimated from OpenRouter prices. Data stays in a local ledger; no telemetry.
description.zh: Token 用量与成本看板：请求数、Token、最近 60 分钟 RPM/TPM、缓存命中率、按模型与供应商拆分、12 个月活动热力图，成本按 OpenRouter 公开价目估算。数据只落在本地账本，无遥测。

plugins.name: dsh-balance-plain

description.en: DeepSeek balance, today's spend, peak/off-peak countdown and per-turn cost rendered as one text line embedded in the DSH sidebar footer, plus a low-balance alert. A text-only derivative of dsh-whale-widget (MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget); do not install both - they register the same /dsh-whale/* routes and share the same ledger files.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 余额、今日已用、峰谷倒计时与每轮消耗做成 DSH 侧栏 footer 里的一行纯文本，并在余额低于阈值时提醒。这是 dsh-whale-widget（MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget）的纯文本衍生版，不能与上游同装：两者注册相同的 /dsh-whale/* 路由并共用同一份账本文件。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Token usage dashboard in the DSH settings page: nine metric cards (total, today, yesterday, peak day, longest session, active-day streak, active days, sessions, subagent tokens), a GitHub-style daily/weekly/cumulative heatmap, and an activity insight list, aggregated locally from session logs and projection caches, keeping token history after a session is deleted.
description.zh: DSH 设置页的 Token 用量看板：九宫指标卡（累计/今日/昨日/峰值日/最长会话/连续活跃/活跃天数/会话/子代理 Token）、GitHub 风格每日/每周/累计热力图与活动洞察，全部从本地会话日志与投影缓存聚合，会话被删后历史 token 仍然保留。

description.en: Shows the remaining quota of the current Our Free Model (OFM) channel beside the DSH composer, with a panel listing every signed-in channel; exhausted channels are flagged and switching models switches the channel shown. Requires dsh-our-free-model with at least one channel signed in.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁显示 Our Free Model（OFM）当前渠道的剩余额度，点开可看全部已登录渠道；余额用尽时红底标注，切换模型会跟着切渠道。需先安装 dsh-our-free-model 并登录至少一个渠道。

description.en: Adds a colored status line under the DSH conversation stats showing live DeepSeek API cost, usage and account balance, with on/off-peak pricing indicators.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话统计行下方新增彩色状态行，实时显示 DeepSeek API 费用、用量与账户余额，并带高峰/错峰计费指示。

description.en: Shows real-time token and cost savings from the Headroom compression proxy in the DSH web UI: a Settings dashboard plus a persistent stats line under the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内实时展示 Headroom 压缩代理的 token 与费用节省：设置页仪表盘 + 输入区常驻统计行。

description.en: Live llmtrim savings dashboard in the DSH web UI: Settings page with paid, would-have-cost, saved-today and saved-this-week cards plus per-model breakdown, and a configurable rotating or static stats strip under the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内实时展示 llmtrim 节省统计：设置页金额卡片（已支付、未压缩应付、今日与本周节省）与按模型明细，输入区可配置轮播或静态统计条。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-quota

description.en: Bottom-right 余额 badge for the DSH Web UI: on expand it fetches the currently-selected provider's OpenCode Go plan limits or DeepSeek prepaid balance, plus local token usage and pricing-based spend estimates.
description.zh: DSH Web 右下角「余额」徽标：展开时读取当前所选提供方，显示 OpenCode Go 计划限额或 DeepSeek 预充值余额，并附本机 token 用量与按定价表估算的消费金额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Sidebar usage panel that attributes tokens to the relay site that served each request, read from your existing provider config: today/month/all-time totals, per-site and per-model breakdowns, a year activity heatmap, and New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek balances.
description.zh: 侧边栏用量面板：把 Token 归属到实际服务该请求的中转站，站点从已有的 provider 配置中读出，无需额外配置；含今日/本月/累计三窗口、按站点与模型下钻、一年活跃度热力图，以及 New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek 余额。

plugins.name: dsh-stats-panel

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness. Per-channel usage with balances and plan quotas for mainstream providers, CNY cost estimates, and daily charts — a settings-sidebar section.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Token 用量统计。按渠道区分统计，官方渠道自动显示余额，套餐渠道显示 5 小时/7 天/30 天用量余量，人民币计费估算，含每日图表与模型分布，集成在设置页侧边菜单。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Token usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: daily totals per model, with a trend chart, a calendar heatmap and a table view.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量面板：按模型统计每日消耗，含趋势图、日历热力图与表格视图。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-plus

description.en: See your real ChatGPT / Codex subscription quota inside DSH. Reads /wham/usage: 5-hour and weekly windows, reset countdown, extra-usage balance, additional limit groups and the code-review limit; lists and redeems server-issued reset credits with a stable, retry-safe idempotency key; switches between multiple accounts; reads /codex/models to show the account's real model catalog, showing empty rather than a built-in list when unavailable. One-click sign-in from Settings (browser authorization or device code, with a paste-the-callback fallback); credentials stay in DSH's credential service. Model calls reuse DSH's built-in llm-pi-ai Codex route instead of claiming a provider route — it degrades to a pure quota console when another plugin owns it. A remaining-quota chip sits beside the composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里查看 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅的真实额度。读账号后端 /wham/usage：短周期（5h）与每周窗口、重置倒计时、额外用量余额、独立额度分组与代码审查额度；列出并使用服务端发放的额度重置卡（幂等键由 credit id 稳定派生，重试只结算一次）；支持多账号切换；读 /codex/models 显示账号真实可用模型，拿不到就显示为空而不是内置列表。设置页内一键登录（浏览器授权或设备码，回调被拦截时可粘贴地址），凭据只存 DSH 凭据服务。模型调用复用 DSH 自带的 llm-pi-ai Codex 路由，不抢占其他插件的 provider 路由——被占用时自动退化为纯额度控制台。输入框右侧常驻剩余额度徽标。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Cross-session usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on usage ring plus a draggable panel that aggregates token usage, cache-hit rate, cost and balance from local session logs, with per-tool cost attribution, iOS-style tile layout editing and an optional animated companion face.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话用量面板：常驻用量圆环 + 可拖动面板，从本地会话日志聚合 token 用量、缓存命中率、成本与余额，支持工具级成本归因、iOS 式磁贴布局编辑与可选表情伴侣；数据只在本机读取，不联网。

description.en: Token cost monitoring, call-efficiency analysis and reversible tool-output caching for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 成本监控、调用效率分析与可逆工具输出缓存。

plugins.name: token-usage-statistic

description.en: Tracks token usage and estimated costs for every model call, with daily charts, session and workspace names, provider balances, budgets, and secret-free CSV/JSON exports.
description.zh: 统计本机每次模型调用的 token 用量与预估费用，提供每日图表、会话/工作区名称、账户余额、预算与无凭据 CSV/JSON 导出。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Local token totals, per-model usage and a 12-week heatmap in a Chinese sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在中文侧栏面板中展示本地 Token 总量、模型用量与 12 周热力图。

plugins.name: dsh-sidebar-balance

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the DeepSeek API account balance and OpenCode Go plan usage (consumption ring, hover details) in the sidebar footer, with adaptive polling and zh/en locale support.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件:在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek API 余额与 OpenCode Go 套餐用量(消耗圆环、悬浮详情),自适应轮询,支持中英文。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: GitHub-style activity heatmap in the sidebar, one cell per day over 30/90/365-day ranges, with token usage and estimated cost per model and editable per-model prices.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的活动热力图，一格一天，支持近 30、90、365 天，统计 token 用量与按模型估算的费用，单价可自行修改。

plugins.name: dsh-save-money#plugin

description.en: Pause and resume tasks automatically during user-defined time windows to avoid peak-hour API costs; includes account balance display and 10-minute granularity spend bar chart.
description.zh: 自定义时间窗口自动暂停/恢复任务，高峰时段节省 API 费用；含账户余额显示和 10 分钟粒度的消费柱状图。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Reads the API balance or subscription quota behind the current DSH route — including OpenDesign (AMR) wallet and Design Plan windows via the control plane — and never guesses a figure: a miss reports its cause (the raw response is echoed only when parsing fails). OpenDesign needs `vela login` or a desktop `controlKey` in `~/.amr/config.json`.
description.zh: 读取当前 DSH 路由背后的 API 余额或订阅余量——包括经控制面读取 OpenDesign（AMR）的钱包与 Design Plan 窗口——绝不猜数字：查不到时如实说明原因（仅解析失败时附原始响应）；OpenDesign 需先 `vela login` 或在桌面端写入 `~/.amr/config.json` 的 controlKey。

description.en: Token usage dashboard in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: daily totals from session logs with a 12-month heatmap, per-provider breakdown over today/7d/30d/all (hourly for today) including each route's average output speed, and a per-session ranking that includes archived and deleted sessions and folds subagent usage into its parent.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的 Token 用量看板：从本机会话日志统计每日消耗并给出近 12 个月热力图；按供应商渠道查看今天/近 7 天/近 30 天/全部的用量（今天按小时展开）及各渠道平均输出速度；按会话排行，包含已归档与已删除会话，子代理消耗并入父会话。

description.en: Token usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: a bar above the composer opens billing token totals, trend charts, per-model and per-project breakdowns and a custom date range, read from local session logs of DSH, Codex, Claude Code, Trae and WorkBuddy. With a self-hosted portal URL and an app key it also reports usage events to that portal; with neither configured it collects nothing. It exposes token_usage tools plus a ctx.tokenReport service, and never collects conversation content.
description.zh: DSH 的 token 用量面板：输入框上方一条用量条，点开是计费总量、趋势图、按模型/项目/来源的分组明细与自定义日期范围，数据来自本机 DSH / Codex / Claude Code / Trae / WorkBuddy 的会话日志；填了自建服务端地址与 appKey 后，用量事件会实时上报到那个服务端，两者都没配时一个字节都不采集；另提供 token_usage 工具与 ctx.tokenReport 服务。不采集对话内容。

description.en: Extreme LLM-call compression for DeepSeek Harness: title short-circuit, in-flight dedup, 24h replay cache, and batch-merging N parallel requests into 1 upstream call via a `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` delimiter protocol - fewer API calls, less spend, same answers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的极端 LLM 调用压缩：标题生成短路、飞行中请求去重、24 小时回放缓存，并用 `[[TASK n]]`/`[[ANSWER n]]` 分隔协议把 N 个并行请求批量合并为 1 次上游调用——更少 API 调用、更低开销、相同答案。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-usage-dashboard

description.en: OpenCode usage dashboard: a sidebar panel for quota and usage in DeepSeek Harness, with Go subscription windows, Console spend, trends, forecasts and model breakdown, multiple accounts, service-account filtering and English/Chinese UI.
description.zh: OpenCode 用量看板：在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏查看额度与用量，支持 Go 订阅窗口、Console 花费、趋势、预测和模型拆分，以及多账户、服务账号筛选和中英界面。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Session budget gate for DeepSeek Harness: prices every turn against the official price table, warns at 80%, stops the task at 100%, and writes a handoff snapshot so the next session can continue the work.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话设预算上限：按官方价目表实时算账，80% 预警、100% 拦停任务，并落盘一份交接快照，让下一个会话接着干。

plugins.name: dsh-token-optimizer

description.en: Token optimization for DeepSeek Harness with searchable MCP tool discovery and lazy loading, configurable compaction controls and status reporting, tool-output reduction, long-text vision summarization, and opt-in conversation archiving with paginated retrieval.
description.zh: Token 优化：支持可搜索的 MCP 工具发现与懒加载、可配置的压缩控制与状态查看、工具输出精简、长文本视觉摘要，以及可选的对话原文归档与分页回查。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: CommandCode usage & balance panel for DeepSeek Harness: API usage, credit balance, 5-hour/weekly windows from the sidebar footer.
description.zh: DSH 的 CommandCode 用量与余额面板：在侧边栏底部显示 API 用量、信用额度、5小时/每周窗口。

description.en: Sidebar account-balance quick view for DeepSeek Harness: balance, bonus credit, current model and the official peak/off-peak pricing period, with ruby/amber/jade/gold tiers and a low-balance warning.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏账户余额快捷查看：显示余额、赠送额度、当前模型和官方高峰 / 空闲计费时段，按余额分四档显示质感，余额过低时提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-quota-settings

description.en: Shows OpenCode GO plan quota (rolling 5-hour, weekly, monthly) on a DSH Settings page, reading the official usage API through a same-origin proxy; registers no sidebar widget. A rework of Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage (itself a fork of yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage) — remove that plugin first; both register their own OpenCode GO Settings section, so they cannot be installed together.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页显示 OpenCode GO 套餐额度（5 小时滚动、每周、每月），通过同源代理读取官方用量接口；不注册侧栏组件。本插件是 Astervolans/dsh-opencode-go-usage（上游为 yumusb/dsh-opencode-go-usage 的 fork）的改造分支，安装前请先卸载上游插件——两者会各自注册一份 OpenCode GO 设置页，不能同装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Local-first research toolkit for DSH: registers kb_grep, kb_list, and kb_save model tools. kb_grep searches the markdown knowledge base with ripgrep when present and falls back to grep, while kb_list and kb_save go through the scoped ctx.fs filesystem service; the KB defaults to ~/dsh-kb. The repo also ships two skills (local-first-research and session-memory) that must be copied into a DSH skills directory yourself; they are not installed by the plugin bundle. The plugin is pure Node ESM with no npm runtime dependencies and ships a framework-free node test harness. Installable via plugin_manager install_bundle; no client UI is bundled.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地优先研究工具包：注册 kb_grep / kb_list / kb_save 三个模型工具。kb_grep 用 ripgrep（没有时回退 grep）搜索 markdown 知识库，kb_list / kb_save 则经由作用域化的 ctx.fs 文件系统服务读写，知识库默认 ~/dsh-kb；仓库另附两个 skill（local-first-research 与 session-memory），需自行复制到 DSH 的 skills 目录，插件包不会安装它们。插件为纯 Node ESM、无 npm 运行时依赖，附无框架的 node 测试。通过 plugin_manager 的 install_bundle 安装；不含前端 UI。

description.en: Neo-brutalism skin with two switchable schemes (Blue Command / Aged Newspaper), hard shadows, sharp corners, and light/dark theme support.
description.zh: 新粗野主义换肤皮肤：双方案（蓝统治 / 做旧报纸）随时切换，硬阴影 + 直角 + 2px 边框结构层，浅色/深色自适应。

description.en: Post-build patch for the maid-atelier skin, mounted as a bundle: the window backdrop walks six time-of-day bands on the local clock with continuously interpolated sky and interior light, and the figure moves on its own (breath, weight shift, float, blinks, optional hem and hair displacement); applied to an already-installed skin and reverted from client.js.orig when the plugin is removed.
description.zh: 以 bundle 形式挂载的女仆工坊皮肤补丁：窗景按本机时间在破晓、黎明、早中、傍晚、晚上、深夜六档连续插值，立绘自带呼吸、重心移动、浮动与眨眼，可选裙摆与长发位移场；对已安装的皮肤生效，卸载即从 client.js.orig 还原。

description.en: Spice and Wolf theme for DeepSeek Harness: parchment palette, closable 12-second intro, six switchable right-rail standby clips, draggable wordmark and peeker, sidebar wheat layer, and one-click Holo role import for dsh-whale-widget.
description.zh: 《狼与辛香料》赫萝主题：暖纸色配色、可关闭的 12 秒开场动画、右栏六段可切换待机动画、可拖动的浮动字标与探头、侧栏麦田图层，以及为 dsh-whale-widget 一键导入赫萝角色。

description.en: ChatGPT-like conversation layout for the DeepSeek Harness Web client: a 768px centered column, right-aligned neutral bubbles for user turns, full-width assistant text at 16/28, and rounded code blocks with their own copy banner. Adds semantic inline markup (`==confirmed==`, `!!risk!!`, `++key word++`, with bare 4xx/5xx codes highlighted automatically) and line-start check/warn/tip callouts; a fast/thinking chip in the composer that switches the model reasoning effort through ctx.modelDirectories; and sidebar contrast, where the selected session gets a tinted row with an accent bar and workspace folder icons are colored.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 的对话排版改成 ChatGPT 风格：768px 居中版心、用户消息右侧中性灰气泡、助手消息全宽 16/28 正文、带独立复制条的圆角代码块；另有行内语义标记（==已确认==、!!风险!!、++重点词++，裸的 4xx/5xx 自动命中）、行首 ✅/⚠️/💡 整行卡片、发送框旁「快速 / 思考」胶囊（经 ctx.modelDirectories 切换推理强度），以及左侧工作区高亮：选中会话带底色与左侧色条、工作区文件夹图标上色。

description.en: Adds a Matrix-inspired digital-rain startup animation for DeepSeek Harness, a rectangular light portal that opens to both sides, optional replay when the desktop window reopens, and a green UI theme with adjustable hue.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加黑客帝国风格的数字雨开屏动画、向两侧展开的矩形光门、可选的窗口恢复重播，以及可调色相的绿色界面主题。

description.en: Plays a full-screen video while DeepSeek Harness starts and reveals the UI only after it ends. Esc skips it.
description.zh: 打开 DeepSeek Harness 时全屏播放一段开机视频，播完才露出界面，按 Esc 可跳过。

description.en: Honor of Kings inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness: the Jing · Blazing Sunlight key art is inlined and painted into the window backdrop and both main panels, over an ink night sky with a molten gold sun, frosted mirror shards, drifting embers and a three-level motion switch (full / calm / off). Colours come from overridden design tokens, so panels, bubbles, menus and code blocks follow the theme.
description.zh: 王者荣耀「镜 · 炽阳神光」主题：主视觉内联进插件，同时作为整窗底图与两个主面板的肌理；底子仍是墨色夜空、熔金日轮与光冕、磨砂镜片与飘浮金烬，左下角「镜」徽记可在 神光 / 静谧 / 关闭 三档动效间切换。配色通过覆写设计令牌实现，面板、气泡、菜单与代码块一并跟随。

description.en: Adds an appearance settings page to DeepSeek Harness: five eye-comfort light themes, each with its own accent and link colours, plus controls for the accent and background colours, UI and code fonts and sizes, font styles, content width, contrast and reduced motion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加外观设置页：五套护眼浅色主题，每套主题自带匹配的强调色与链接色；另可调整强调色与背景色、界面与代码的字体和字号、字体样式、内容宽度、对比度与减少动态效果。

description.en: Imports wallpapers newly downloaded by the Hao Wallpaper app into the DSH wallpaper engine on startup, incrementally and idempotently. Requires the Hao Wallpaper app, Python 3.8+ and the dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine plugin (elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine) installed first. Supports macOS and Windows.
description.zh: DSH 启动时把 Hao Wallpaper 新下载的壁纸增量导入 DSH 壁纸引擎（幂等）。需要先装好 Hao Wallpaper 应用、Python 3.8+，以及 dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine 插件（elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine）。支持 macOS 与 Windows。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DSH Web UI, adapted to DSH v0.2.x and desktop v0.22.3+: the header, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view become frosted glass panes over a live WebGL fluid board or an image/video wallpaper, with mica and compatibility layouts, adjustable blur, frost, hue and brightness, marine decorations (particle whale, fish, mesh, cursor glow), a one-click reset-to-defaults button, and a master switch whose off state restores the stock UI exactly; adapted from WYH66666666's original (0.1.x) and du-u-uck's 0.1.1-rc.2 port.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃质感主题（适配 DSH v0.2.x 与桌面端 v0.22.3+）：顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图悬浮在 WebGL 流体板或图片/视频壁纸上的磨砂玻璃片，云母/兼容双布局，模糊、磨砂、色调、亮度可调，海洋装饰（粒子鲸鱼、小鱼、网状交互、鼠标辉光），一键恢复默认，总开关关闭即完全还原原生界面；承 WYH66666666 原作（0.1.x）与 du-u-uck 的 0.1.1-rc.2 适配。

description.en: Theme that pairs Windows XP-era scenery wallpapers with a modern frosted-glass interface: a fixed background layer behind the DeepSeek Harness web UI, panel styling applied through theme tokens, a wallpaper picker with custom image import, and a light/dark toggle. Works on desktop and mobile web surfaces.
description.zh: 让 XP 时代的风景壁纸与现代磨砂玻璃界面同框的主题：DeepSeek Harness Web 界面 之下的固定壁纸底板、经主题 token 应用的面板玻璃样式、支持导入自定义图片的 壁纸选择器与明暗切换按钮——桌面与移动端均可使用。

description.en: A configurable Liquid Glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with translucent surfaces, wallpaper, desktop transparency, window blur, custom cursors, click ripples, and per-side conversation contrast controls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的液态玻璃主题，包含半透明界面、壁纸、桌面透出、窗口模糊、自定义光标、点击涟漪和消息辨识选项。

description.en: Particle-network background overlay for the DSH Web shell: full-screen, click-through, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供粒子网络动态背景：全屏覆盖、点击穿透、零运行时依赖。

description.en: IKUN fandom skin for the DSH Web UI: star-blue and black-gold palettes in the system theme list, full-screen photo wallpaper rotation, a music box, and a send-button voice line.
description.zh: ikun 主题皮肤：星蓝昼/夜与背带裤黑金三套配色接入系统主题列表，全屏照片壁纸轮播、音乐盒与发送音效。

description.en: Real Madrid dual-mode skin: Bernabeu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.
description.zh: 皇家马德里双模式皮肤：暗色为夜场伯纳乌全景，亮色为纯白主场暗纹，队徽与 1902 背号作为背景层（非官方球迷作品）。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, forked from upstream and repaired to load on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃质感主题（上游分支，修复以适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1）：云母/兼容双模式、可调模糊与磨砂、流体/壁纸背景、背景亮度，以及一键还原原生界面的总开关。

description.en: CGSS idol theme with multi-character Web colors and card artwork, immersive reading, and an optional Windows desktop companion.
description.zh: CGSS 偶像主题，提供多角色 Web 配色与卡面、沉浸阅读和可选的 Windows 桌宠。

description.en: Hello Kitty-styled task-completion and question alerts for DSH Web, bundled with an optional light/dark pink Skin Center v2 theme and local install scripts.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Hello Kitty 风格任务完成与待回答提醒插件，附带可选的粉色明暗双主题 Skin Center v2 皮肤及本地安装脚本。

description.en: Neutral warm Chobits Chii picture-book skin for the DSH web UI, with light and dark token sets, a polaroid photo wall, and a built-in Live2D Chii mascot with gaze following.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的小叽绘本风皮肤：明暗双 token、拍立得照片墙，以及内置 Live2D 小叽桌宠（视线跟随）。

description.en: Per-wallpaper offset for dsh-dream-skin - nudge the current wallpaper along X and Y in pixels from Settings, remembered separately for each image, URL or gradient.
description.zh: dsh-dream-skin 的壁纸位移插件：在设置里按像素微调当前壁纸的 X 与 Y 偏移，图片、URL、渐变三类壁纸各自记忆。

description.en: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的非官方明日方舟 P.R.T.S. 风格界面主题，提供外观预设、辅助功能与会话导航。

description.en: H.D.D skin for the DSH Web UI: a voiced full-screen boot animation, an animated eye core (idle / thinking / done) you can drag or hide, a brand swap on the new-chat hero, a time-of-day greeting, a usage bubble with balance, today spend and the peak/off-peak countdown, the Fairy-mode agent preset, and optional local GPT-SoVITS voice.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 H.D.D 皮肤：带音效的整屏开机动画、可拖动或隐藏的动态眼徽（待机/思考/完成）、新建对话页换标、按时段问候、显示余额与今日花费并带峰谷倒计时的用量气泡、Fairy 模式预设，以及可选的本地 GPT-SoVITS 朗读。

description.en: Theme studio for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: eight switchable preset styles, accent and panel-translucency fine-tuning, host-side wallpapers painted on the first frame, and a one-click fix when the wallpaper-engine glass tint greys out light styles.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工坊：可切换预设风格、强调色与面板透明度微调、宿主壁纸首帧绘制；wallpaper-engine 玻璃色把浅色主题洗灰时一键改为白色玻璃。

description.en: A Witch on the Holy Night (Mahoutsukai no Yoru) visual-novel theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with original-style menus, three characters with personas, day and night playlists, and an ending sequence. The repo ships no assets of its own; the 380 files / 263 MiB it drives (136 sprites, 208 UI parts, 13 backgrounds, 23 audio) must be recovered from your own copy of the original game, and the screen stays largely empty until then. The 23 audio files are a header strip away from working OGG; the 357 images use proprietary .mzp/.cbg formats, so the per-file mapping guide offers two routes and one of them expects you to supply your own decoder.
description.zh: 《魔法使之夜》(Witch on the Holy Night) 风格的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 整屏皮肤：原作式菜单、三角色与人格 skill、昼夜两套曲单、片尾演出。仓库自身不含素材——驱动它需要 380 个文件、263 MiB（立绘 136、UI 构件 208、背景 13、音频 23），须从你自己拥有的原著副本中还原，在此之前界面基本是空的。其中 23 个音频文件切掉 64 字节头就是合法 OGG；357 张图像是私有 .mzp/.cbg 格式，仓库附逐文件映射指南，给出两条路线，其中一条要你自备解码器。

plugins.name: dsh-glass-theme

description.en: Apple Liquid Glass skin that re-keys the harness design tokens, then adds its own settings page, a grouped model picker with peak and off-peak rate badges, and a merged usage panel.
description.zh: Apple Liquid Glass 皮肤：重写 Harness 的整套设计 token，并自带设置页面、带峰谷时段标记的分组模型选择器和合并后的用量面板。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Full-screen dynamic wallpaper from local videos and images, with live effect controls, wallpaper switching and Wallpaper Engine workshop import; settings persist automatically.
description.zh: 把本地视频/图片变成全屏动态壁纸，支持实时效果调节、壁纸切换与 Wallpaper Engine 工坊导入，设置自动保存永久生效。

description.en: Leafy green skin for the DSH Web GUI that overrides the --dsw-* palette in light and dark themes, plus a CSS layer for corners, shadows and motion that can be switched off.
description.zh: 叶绿色皮肤：把 DSH Web GUI 的 --dsw-* 调色板覆盖成浅色 / 深色两套叶绿配色，另有一层可关闭的样式层处理圆角、阴影与动效。

description.en: Customizable brand area for the Web UI: replace the whale logo and DeepSeek wordmark with local images, and edit the HARNESS badge text (double-click to change, right-click to reset).
description.zh: Web UI 品牌区自定义：鲸鱼 logo 与 DeepSeek 文字可换成本地图片，HARNESS 徽章文字可双击编辑（双击修改，右键恢复）。

description.en: Ye Xueqing (Justice Online) theme skin: two switchable artwork variants (wisteria courtyard / snowy river) rendered as a mask-edged band behind all UI text, bundled LXGW WenKai GB interface font with a toggle, and an exclusive mode that disables other skin plugins while it is on.
description.zh: 逆水寒·叶雪青主题皮肤：两个可切换的立绘变体（春庭藤影／雪霁寒江），画面经四边带遮罩置于全部界面文字之下，随包附带霞鹜文楷GB 字体开关，开启独占时自动停用其他皮肤插件。

description.en: A token-based DeepSeek Harness theme plugin with ten presets, custom colors, and system font pickers.
description.zh: 基于原生令牌的 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件，提供十套预设、自定义配色与系统字体选择。

description.en: MDSM (Male DeepSeek Mascot) appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: wears the bundled mascot character as the GUI background (surface-token fade with opacity, blur, scrim and position controls), seats the matching square avatar as the sidebar and conversation brand mark, and edits it all from a Settings section; the host serves the artwork and config locally under /api/MDSM, and the config lives at $DSH_HOME/MDSM.json.
description.zh: MDSM(DeepSeek 男性吉祥物)美化插件：把内置角色形象铺成界面背景（表面令牌淡出，配合不透明度、模糊、遮罩与位置调节），将方形头像换到侧栏与会话标题的品牌标识位，并在设置页统一配置；素材与配置由宿主在 /api/MDSM 下本地提供，配置文件位于 $DSH_HOME/MDSM.json。

description.en: Nai milk-frog mascot appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: wears the bundled milk-frog artwork as the GUI background (surface-token fade with opacity, blur, scrim and position controls), seats the matching square avatar as the sidebar and conversation brand mark, and edits it all from a Settings section; the host serves the artwork and config locally under /api/nai, and the config lives at $DSH_HOME/nai.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端的奶蛙美化形象插件：把内置奶蛙素材铺成界面背景（表面令牌淡出，配合不透明度、模糊、遮罩与位置调节），将方形头像换到侧栏与会话标题的品牌标识位，并在设置页统一配置；素材与配置由宿主在 /api/nai 下本地提供，配置文件位于 $DSH_HOME/nai.json。

description.en: TangSan mascot appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: wears a generated TangSan portrait as the GUI background (surface-token fade with opacity, blur, scrim and position controls), seats the matching square avatar as the sidebar and conversation brand mark, and edits it all from a Settings section; the host serves the artwork and config locally under /api/tangsan, and the config lives at $DSH_HOME/tangsan.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端的唐三美化形象插件：把生成的唐三插画铺成界面背景（表面令牌淡出，配合不透明度、模糊、遮罩与位置调节），将同系列方形头像换到侧栏与会话标题的品牌标识位，并在设置页统一配置；素材与配置由宿主在 /api/tangsan 下本地提供，配置文件位于 $DSH_HOME/tangsan.json。

description.en: Theme studio for the DSH Web GUI: five built-in presets plus fully customizable light/dark palettes (accent, background, foreground, UI and code fonts, translucent sidebar, contrast), hot-swapped instantly and persisted in localStorage.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 主题工作室：5 套内置预设 + 完全可自定义的浅/深配色（强调色、背景、前景、UI 与代码字体、半透明侧栏、对比度），即时热切换并持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Pink-and-white frosted-glass skin for the DSH Web GUI, themed after Cyrene from Honkai Star Rail. Also rewrites the agent persona (editable from the sidebar), adds Cyrene reaction stickers, replaces the new-session hero with her, and adds a full-page background picker with enable / pick / rotate / fade. Unofficial non-commercial fan project; Cyrene and related art are (c) miHoYo / HoYoverse, not affiliated or endorsed.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 换成昔涟（《崩坏：星穹铁道》）的粉白渐变毛玻璃主题，附带侧边栏可编辑的人格设定、昔涟表情包、新会话欢迎页形象，以及可开关 / 选图 / 轮换 / 调淡的整页背景图。非官方非商业同人作品；昔涟及相关美术素材版权归米哈游（miHoYo / HoYoverse）所有，与官方无隶属或背书关系。

description.en: Windows XP Luna skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a blue taskbar sidebar, Luna title bars, translucent conversation and plugin windows with adjustable opacity and blur, and a settings page for importing a wallpaper. Light mode only: the skin removes itself when the host switches to dark.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Windows XP Luna 皮肤：蓝色任务栏侧栏、Luna 标题栏、可调节不透明度与模糊的半透明对话及插件窗口，以及可导入壁纸的设置页。仅浅色模式：宿主切到深色时皮肤自动移除。

description.en: One install for a whale-girl boot animation, a cyber code-eye video background and a holographic dark theme. The skin and background video (CC BY-NC-SA) are downloaded from the upstream repo on first launch; the boot animation is only installed when @ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation is already present.
description.zh: 一次装好鲸鱼娘开机动画、赛博代码眼动态视频背景与全息暗色主题。皮肤与背景视频（CC BY-NC-SA）在首次启动时从上游仓库下载；开机动画仅在本机已装 @ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation 时才生效。

description.en: A Madara pixel theme with dark crimson colors, Chinese pixel fonts, and a skippable Sharingan startup animation.
description.zh: 宇智波斑像素主题：暗红配色、中文像素字体和可跳过的写轮眼启动动画。

description.en: Reveals the real wallpaper and windows behind the main chat area in Anywhere Labs DSH Desktop on macOS, using native glass with adjustable background and panel opacity.
description.zh: 在 macOS 的 Anywhere Labs DSH Desktop 中让主聊天区透出真实壁纸和后方窗口，复用原生玻璃材质并支持调整背景与面板不透明度。

description.en: Skin plugin for the DSH Web UI: 4 built-in skins plus custom image skins with the photo as a full-interface background and the palette following its dominant hue.
description.zh: DSH Web 换肤插件：4 套内置皮肤 + 自定义图片皮肤，图片作为全界面背景，配色自动跟随图片主色调。

description.en: Low-contrast dark theme that remaps DSH's alias tokens and adds its own chat bubble, code block banner and markdown heading colours.
description.zh: 低对比度深色主题，重映射 DSH 的 alias token，并自带聊天气泡、代码块语言条与 markdown 标题配色。

description.en: Restyles the DeepSeek Harness welcome area and composer, with workspace, mode, and skill shortcuts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 欢迎区和输入栏换肤，并提供工作区、模式与技能快捷入口。

description.en: Adds an animated ASCII whale ocean behind empty chats, with neutral frosted-glass input, visual color selection, light/dark support, and configurable whales, fish, grid and wakes.
description.zh: 在空白聊天背景中呈现 ASCII 鲸群与游鱼，提供中性毛玻璃输入框、可视化选色器、深浅色适配，以及鲸鱼、鱼群、栅格和尾迹参数设置。

description.en: Homepage-style chat background skin for DeepSeek Harness, ported line by line from deepseek.com/harness: WebGL fluid background (5-colour noise field, flow-field brush, light, bloom, vignette, grain), white 90px dot-line grid with mouse perturbation and spring return, and a digital point-cloud whale that assembles from particles, breathes, swims, is pushed radially by the cursor and brightened by a light beam. Dark theme only; disabled automatically under reduced-motion.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 首页风格聊天背景皮肤，对照 deepseek.com/harness 首页逐行移植：WebGL 流体背景（5 色噪声场、流场笔刷、光源、辉光、暗角、颗粒）、白色 90px 点线网格（鼠标扰动 + 弹簧回弹）、数字点云鲸鱼（粒子聚形、呼吸游动、鼠标径向推开、光标光束提亮）。仅深色主题生效，系统开启减少动态效果时自动停用。

description.en: Retro CRT phosphor theme: pure-black Matrix green, 40K amber-green or TFEL amber screens with bold glowing text, a code-rain boot animation and a BIOS-style control panel.
description.zh: 复古 CRT 磷光主题：纯黑底黑客帝国绿 / 40K 黄绿 / TFEL 琥珀三种屏种，粗胖发光字，附代码雨开机动画与 BIOS 风控制面板。

description.en: Adds a Theme row to Settings → General between Appearance and Font size — 8 builtin palettes plus Default, hover previews without writing, click applies and is persisted by the host; imports/exports custom dsh-theme.json files, with an optional Theme Creator skill behind /dsh-theme-creator.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」的官方「外观」与「字号」之间注入「主题」行：8 套内置配色 + 默认项，悬停预览不写盘、点击应用并由 Host 持久化；支持导入/导出自定义 dsh-theme.json 主题文件，另有可选的 Theme Creator skill（/dsh-theme-creator）。

description.en: A Blue Glass ocean-fantasy skin for DeepSeek Harness Web: crisp ocean backdrop, glass bubbles, an ocean sidebar with a gold-gradient HARNESS wordmark and a bottom cartoon character, a whale settings button, and gradient model text.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的海洋幻想玻璃皮肤：清澈海洋背景、玻璃气泡、海洋侧边栏（金色渐变「HARNESS」字标 + 底部卡通角色）、鲸鱼设置按钮、渐变模型文字。

description.en: Full-interface whale skin pack for the DSH Web UI — layered wallpaper, metallic trim, lace and bows, a corner mascot that reacts to agent state, ambient particles, plus an installable third-party skin-pack format.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面全屏鲸鱼皮肤包：多层壁纸、金/银描边、蕾丝蝴蝶结、随 Agent 状态反应的角落立绘与环境粒子，并支持可安装的第三方皮肤包格式。

description.en: Umbrella Corporation theme for DeepSeek Harness with dark and light schemes, a spinning umbrella watermark and a HUD frame.
description.zh: 生化危机保护伞公司主题，提供明暗双外观、自转保护伞水印与 HUD 装饰。

description.en: Paper-and-ink theme with warm surfaces, hairline strokes, near-square corners and a living ASCII koi pond behind the shell; the theme sets no font family, so the shell's own stacks (or your Settings choice) apply.
description.zh: 纸墨主题，提供暖色纸面、细描边和近方形圆角，并在整个界面后方绘制动态 ASCII 锦鲤池；主题不指定字体，沿用 DSH 自带字体栈（或设置中选择的字体）。

description.en: Wallpaper Engine integration for the dsh web GUI: scan the local WE library (Steam workshop 431960 + local projects) and use its wallpapers as the page background — image/video/web rendered natively, scene wallpapers as softened static previews — with a 壁纸设计 panel (opacity, scope, fill, blur, vignette, fps, parallax, carousel, theme linkage) and agent tools wallpaper_scan/list/set/config.
description.zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸联动：把本机下载的 WE 壁纸（创意工坊 431960 + 本地 projects）设为 DSH Web GUI 页面背景（图片/视频/网页原样渲染，场景壁纸柔化为静态预览），侧边栏「壁纸设计」面板可调不透明度、作用范围、填充、模糊、暗角、帧率、视差、轮播与主题联动，附 wallpaper_scan/list/set/config 四个 agent 工具。

description.en: Theme plugin — supports dark/light appearance switching, ships 34 preset themes, and supports creating, sharing, and importing custom themes.
description.zh: 主题插件 —— 支持深色/浅色外观切换，提供 34 款预设主题，支持创建/分享/导入自定义主题。

description.en: Genshin Impact Yoimiya theme: two hand-tuned palettes, a procedural fireworks particle layer, and a local music player that reads your own files — songs and covers are never uploaded. Warm syntax colors and a hand-drawn goldfish brand mark; apart from the wallpaper every pixel is CSS gradients and hand-written SVG.
description.zh: 《原神》宵宫主题：严格核算过对比度的明暗双色板、程序化生成的烟花粒子层，以及一个读取你自己本地文件的播放器——歌曲与封面不上传到任何地方。语法高亮为暖色，标识为自绘金鱼；除壁纸外所有画面都由 CSS 渐变与手写 SVG 生成。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme: ten OKLCH Chinese-traditional-colour palettes that adapt to light and dark, plus an optional wallpaper behind frosted glass panels; tailored for the DS Bot (bot team) interface; the palette and wallpaper persist locally.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 主题：十套 OKLCH 中国传统色配色、明暗自适应；可选一张壁纸铺满窗口、界面以磨砂玻璃叠上去；已适配 DS Bot（Bot 团队）界面；配色与壁纸都本地持久化。

description.en: WeChat-style skin for the Harness web UI: grey chat list, green outgoing bubbles, white incoming bubbles, a green send button, and a 已归档 tag on archived sessions.
description.zh: 把 Harness 界面换成微信风格：灰白配色、绿色气泡、绿色发送键、微信字体，已归档会话带「已归档」标签。

description.en: An eye-friendly green skin that reskins the whole DeepSeek Harness Web UI to a low-blue-light green palette, with complete light and dark mode coverage.
description.zh: 鎶ょ溂缁匡紙璞嗘矙缁匡級鐨偆涓婚锛氭暣浣撹鍐?DeepSeek Harness Web 鐣岄潰鐨勮璁?token锛屾祬鑹蹭笌娣辫壊涓ゅ閮芥崲鎴愪綆钃濆厜銆佹煍鍜岀殑鎶ょ溂缁块厤鑹层€?

description.en: Realtime WebGPU ocean skin with quick controls for waves, daylight, glass opacity, and an automatic day cycle.
description.zh: 实时 WebGPU 海洋皮肤，可快捷调节波浪、日光、玻璃不透明度与自动昼夜循环。

description.en: Ports CSDN blog article typography into the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — heading hierarchy, quote blocks, solid-grid tables, inline code and Atom One syntax highlighting, in matching light and dark palettes.
description.zh: 把 CSDN 博文的配色与正文排版搬进 DeepSeek Harness 网页端：标题层级、引用块、实线网格表格、行内代码与 Atom One 语法高亮，浅色深色各一套。

description.en: macOS-style skin with a swimming whale aquarium background and a dot-matrix whale send button for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的 macOS 风格皮肤：水中鲸鱼动态背景与点阵鲸鱼发送按钮，明暗双主题。

description.en: Fan-made wallpaper plugin themed on the streamer Zhang Shunfei: full-screen high-definition rotating colorful pegasus GIF wallpaper with theme blending and prominence control, plus a Bilibili music player (add songs by pasting a link, delete, volume, seek, single/list/shuffle loop, and a sidebar mini player).
description.zh: 以网络主播张顺飞为主题的粉丝同人二创壁纸插件：彩色飞马高清旋转动图全屏壁纸，支持主题融合与突出度调节；附带 B站音乐播放器，可粘贴链接添加歌曲、删除、调音量、拖进度条、切换单曲/列表/随机循环，并有侧栏迷你播放器。

description.en: Persistent wallpaper skin for the dsh web profile: static image or muted looping video as the app background, with translucent panels and a floating picker panel.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的持久化壁纸皮肤：静态图片或静音循环视频作为应用背景，面板半透明化，右下角悬浮面板一键换壁纸。

description.en: Twelve curated palettes, eight accent colours, a contrast slider and font/scale overrides for the DSH web UI, with an inlined first-paint script that prevents theme flash.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 12 套精选配色、8 种强调色、对比度滑块与字体/缩放覆盖，并内联首帧脚本防止主题闪烁。

description.en: Claude-style dark and light skin for the DeepSeek panel of dsh-webchat: warm neutral palette, terracotta accents and Claude brand marks, applied as injected CSS with no guest DOM edits and no network requests.
description.zh: 为 dsh-webchat 的 DeepSeek 面板提供 Claude 风格深/浅色皮肤：暖中性色板、赤陶强调色与 Claude 品牌标识，以注入 CSS 实现，不修改访客页 DOM、不发网络请求。

description.en: Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: champagne-gold glass panes, a fluid or wallpaper backdrop, and a one-switch toggle that restores the stock look exactly.
description.zh: Mineradio 玻璃拟态 DSH 网页主题：香槟金玻璃面板、流体或壁纸背景，一键开关即可还原原生界面。

description.en: Gemini-styled skin restyling the conversation ground, sidebar rows, hero greeting and composer through one stylesheet over the --dsw-* tokens, with light and dark both covered.
description.zh: Gemini 风格皮肤，用一张叠在 --dsw-* 令牌之上的样式表重塑对话区底色、侧栏胶囊行、首屏问候语与输入框，明暗主题都覆盖。

description.en: Bayern Munich skin for the dsh web GUI: home-red/away-white canvases, real match-photo backdrops for 19 first-team players plus drawn shirt, squad-wall, Allianz-Arena and plain backdrops, switchable player and accent colour.
description.zh: 拜仁慕尼黑主题的 dsh Web 皮肤：主场红/客场白双配色画布，19 名一线队球员的真实赛场照背景，外加球员球衣、阵容号码墙、安联球场、纯色四种程序绘制背景，可切换球员与强调色。

description.en: A port of DeepSeek-Refined for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), which injects "Obsidian Border"-style Markdown styling and multi-theme color schemes into the DSH frontend.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Refined 的 DSH 移植版：为 DSH 前端注入 Obsidian Border 等 5 个风格的 Markdown 美化与 5 套主题配色，并提供调色板按钮。

description.en: Arknights-inspired fan skin for the DSH Web UI featuring Pramanix and Eyjafjalla in a day/night celestial garden.
description.zh: DSH Web 明日方舟同人皮肤“初雪和小羊”，包含昼夜星海庭园背景与双角色布局。

description.en: A Dracula dark theme for DeepSeek Harness covering the sidebar, chat, settings, and code highlighting, with first-paint styling and synchronized switches across windows.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Dracula 深色主题，覆盖侧栏、对话区、设置与代码高亮，支持启动时应用主题和跨窗口开关同步。

description.en: 22 light-only palettes (Pantone / Chinese traditional / Morandi) and 14 composable surface effects for DeepSeek Harness, with twelve-shichen clock rotation, manual picks that lead until the next boundary, workspace binding, per-session colour marks and a nickname/avatar row whose editor lives in the settings page.
description.zh: 22 套仅浅色配色（Pantone / 中国传统 / 莫兰迪）与 14 种可叠加的表面效果，含十二时辰轮换、手动选色优先到时段边界、工作区绑定、会话颜色标记，以及设置页内的昵称与内联头像编辑。

description.en: A GrokBot-style animated avatar with a synchronized typewriter status line — right in front of the "Deep diving..." indicator.
description.zh: 在「Deep diving...」状态提示前，放一只动态小伙伴——GrokBot 风格动画头像，状态文字还会同步打字机变换。

description.en: Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, particle-whale accent, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃质感主题：云母/兼容双模式、可调模糊与磨砂、流体/壁纸背景、背景亮度、粒子鲸鱼点缀，一键关闭即还原原生界面。

description.en: Vietnamese UI language for the DSH web client (all 2,615 core strings), three Vietnamese palettes in light and dark, and a rotating Vietnam-landscape backdrop from Wikimedia Commons with per-photo attribution.
description.zh: DSH 网页客户端的越南语界面（全部 2,615 条核心文案）、浅色与深色各三套越南风配色，以及来自 Wikimedia Commons 的越南风景轮播背景（逐张标注作者与许可）。

description.en: Aqua glass theme adapted for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, with floating glass sidebars and fixes for Windows sidebar and titlebar controls.
description.zh: 适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的 Aqua 玻璃主题，提供悬浮玻璃侧栏，并修复 Windows 侧栏和标题栏控件布局。

description.en: Media-scape theme for the DSH web UI: standing/character-art and video wallpapers (mp4/webm, local + online) with boot animation, base color schemes (single-source JSON + presets + picker), capsule host-element styling, ambient particles, background music player (covers/playlists/random), typing sound effects, and a draggable dock toolbar with a unified upload entry — wallpapers and music uploaded together (suffix-classified), mid-upload no-disk buffering, pause→.part snapshots with offset resume, filename+size dedup with "skipped" notices, and true-delete removal with list refreshes.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 媒体景观主题：立绘/视频壁纸（mp4/webm，本地+在线）+ 开屏动画 + 基底配色（单真源 JSON + 预设包 + 取色器 + 胶囊宿主元素样式）+ 氛围粒子 + 背景音乐播放器（封面/歌单/随机）+ 打字音效 + 可拖动 dock 工具条；dock「传」统一上传壁纸与音乐（按文件后缀识别）——上传中途不落盘、暂停落 .part 快照可续传、文件名+大小去重预检「已跳过」、移除真实删除并前后刷新列表。

description.en: Prism Theme Studio adds 24 paired light/dark themes and a live theme studio to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: Prism 主题工作室为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 带来 24 套明暗双生主题和实时主题工作室。

description.en: Wishing House theme skin with warm amber glow, live moon phases, meteors, typing sparks, procedural chime audio, and daily fortune slips.
description.zh: 许愿屋古风主题皮肤：暖灯琥珀色调、今日真实月相与轨迹、字落生辉打字萤火、纯原生风铃音效与每日许愿签。

description.en: Requires DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+ (DSH Desktop >= 2.0.7) and dsh-better-sidebar >= 0.19.0 - update both before installing or updating this plugin. Plays local Wallpaper Engine Video/Web wallpapers behind the chat, renders Scene wallpapers as extracted static frames, and adds content-rating/type filters, custom uploads and an iOS-style liquid-glass settings window.
description.zh: 前置要求：DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+（DSH Desktop ≥ 2.0.7）且 dsh-better-sidebar ≥ 0.19.0，安装或更新本插件前请先更新两者。把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 Video/Web 壁纸实时播放到聊天界面后方，Scene 壁纸由内置渲染器输出完整场景帧，支持内容分级/类型过滤、自定义壁纸上传与 iOS 液态玻璃设置窗口。

description.en: Low-contrast graphite dark theme with a frosted-glass sidebar, composer and panels for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 低对比度石墨灰深色主题，侧边栏、输入区与弹层使用可调强度的毛玻璃。

description.en: Dracula (VS Code) dark theme for the DSH Web GUI: the vampire palette mapped onto the product colour tokens, plus a denser type scale, a 1080px reading column and code blocks that scroll instead of re-wrapping. Dark mode only.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Dracula（VS Code 吸血鬼）深色主题：把产品自身的配色令牌映射到德古拉调色板，并附更紧的字号阶梯、1080px 正文列宽与不折行的代码块。仅深色模式。

description.en: Four palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — solid, glass, volume and neon — each with light and dark halves. Neon adds a scene light field with a 46px circuit grid, a laser scan that sweeps the conversation column only while a turn is running, HUD-style workspace labels in the sidebar, embedded MiSans Latin chrome type, and a 125% sidebar type scale that stays fixed while the conversation area zooms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的四套配色：实心 / 玻璃 / 体积 / 霓虹，各含明暗两半。霓虹版在整窗场景光场上叠 46px 电路网格，并在模型运行时让一条激光扫描线扫过对话列（停止即消失）；侧栏工作区名为青色 HUD 标牌，界面拉丁字体内置 MiSans，侧栏字号固定 125% 且不随对话区缩放。

description.en: Three retrofuturist skins for the DSH Web GUI — a dusk train, neon rain and a sunset coast — with an in-page switcher and locally saved selection.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供黄昏列车、霓虹雨夜和落日海岸三套复古未来主义皮肤，支持页内切换并在本地保存选择。

description.en: A paper-and-ink client-side theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: Balanced preserves semantic status colors, and Immersive maps supported surfaces to monochrome.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 纸墨风客户端主题，提供保留语义状态色的平衡模式和黑白沉浸模式。

description.en: Liquid-glass theme for DeepSeek Harness with SVG edge refraction on the composer, bubbles, queue dock, menus and sidebar, translucent token overrides driven by live sliders for tint, opacity, blur and refraction, custom or built-in animated wallpapers, and desktop chrome extras such as a session bar merged into the system title bar and a fullscreen button.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的液态玻璃主题：输入卡片、气泡、队列坞、菜单与侧边栏带 SVG 边缘折射；半透明 token 覆盖，色调、不透明度、模糊与折射强度都有实时滑块；壁纸可自定义或使用内置动态壁纸；桌面版另把会话顶栏并入系统标题栏，并补了全屏按钮。

description.en: 🌹 Port all 38 opencode themes into DeepSeek Harness, light and dark alike: quiet Tokyo Night, soft Catppuccin, easy on the eyes Zenburn. Plus 25 IP theme capsules: Genshin, Kuromi, Doraemon, Hello Kitty, Harry Potter, Cyberpunk 2077, Dragon Ball, Naruto, One Piece, Pokémon, Sailor Moon, Star Wars, Transformers, Ultraman, Zelda, Super Mario, Evangelion, LEGO, Marvel, DC, Disney, four of them in a second light/dark take, each with its own soul. And every theme is fully editable, so you can craft one that is entirely your own.
description.zh: 🌹将opencode的38款主题搬进DSH，明暗兼收：东京之夜沉静、卡布奇诺轻柔、禅燃护眼；另备25款主题胶囊，原神、原神·夜航、库洛米、哆啦A梦、HelloKitty、哈利波特、赛博朋克2077、龙珠、火影忍者、火影忍者·暗部、海贼王、宝可梦、美少女战士、星球大战、变形金刚、奥特曼、塞尔达传说、超级马里奥、超级马里奥·夜行、新世纪福音战士、新世纪福音战士·晴空、乐高、漫威、DC、迪士尼，各有其魂；每款主题都可逐色细改，打造属于您的专属主题。

description.en: Color presets and a custom paper-color picker for the built-in DSH sidebar PDF, converted Office, and spreadsheet previews, with dark-mode brightness control and locally saved preferences; changes only the display, not the files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置侧边栏的 PDF、转为 PDF 的 Office 文档及表格预览提供配色预设与自定义纸张底色，支持深色模式亮度调节和本地保存偏好；只改变显示，不修改文件。

description.en: Animated and video live wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — GIF, animated WebP/APNG and static PNG/JPEG images, plus MP4/WebM video backgrounds, with auto format detection, a dim slider, and UI chrome tone matching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面动态壁纸插件：支持 GIF / 动图 WebP / APNG 与静态 PNG/JPG 图片，以及 MP4 / WebM 视频背景，格式自动识别，自带压暗与亮度调节，可让界面色调跟随背景。

description.en: Classic Macintosh (System 7) pixel theme: desktop pattern canvas, Finder sidebar, monochrome buttons and dialogs, light/dark support.
description.zh: 经典麦金塔 System 7 像素风主题：桌面网点画布、Finder 侧栏、黑白按钮与弹窗，深浅色随官方外观切换。

description.en: Photo wallpaper for the DSH Web UI, with local image uploads and live mask, blur, saturation and panel translucency controls.
description.zh: DSH Web 图片壁纸插件：本地上传图片，实时调节遮罩、模糊、饱和度与面板透明度。

description.en: An Everforest colour theme for DeepSeek Harness, for both web and desktop. Forest tones, with six dark and light palettes. Chat content (headings, code, links, tables and more) is restyled with independent colours, and every tone and saturation level is tuned individually for a warm, gentle, easy-on-the-eyes experience.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Everforest 配色主题，同时支持网页和桌面端。以森林为色调，深色与浅色共 6 档配色。对聊天内容（标题、代码、链接、表格等）样式优化，独立着色，所有色调及饱和度都已逐一调校，提供温暖柔和的护眼体验。

description.en: An F1 Race Control theme for DSH Web with four switchable team skins, broadcast-photo backgrounds, light and dark modes, and native appearance controls.
description.zh: 一款适用于 DSH Web 的 F1 赛事控制中心主题，提供四支车队皮肤、赛事摄影背景、浅色与深色模式及原生外观设置。

description.en: Inkstone is a monochrome theme inspired by Obsidian Minimal E-ink, with inverted sidebar interactions, colored Markdown headings and locally installed LXGW WenKai font fallbacks; it preserves native font and appearance preferences and targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 墨白：参考 Obsidian Minimal E-ink 的黑白主题，提供侧栏黑白反色、彩色 Markdown 标题及本机霞鹜文楷字体回退，保留原生字体与外观设置，适用于 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Adds an Appearance switch to the DSH sidebar with a three-second time-stop transition, synchronized sound, and light/dark theme switching.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加入“外观”开关，切换明暗主题时播放三秒时停转场与同步音效。

description.en: Rhine Lab-inspired Pioneer terminal theme with cream and graphite modes, a 16% animated central watermark, and themed titlebars and settings for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供莱茵生命 Pioneer 终端主题，包含奶油白与石墨黑配色、16% 中央动态水印，以及标题栏和设置页样式。

description.en: Region-by-region UI customizer for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: background, border and text styles for every interface area, element picker, highest-priority overrides.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端界面主题自定义：按界面区域配置背景、边框与文本样式，支持元素拾取器，优先级覆盖其他主题插件。

description.en: Non-commercial day/night whale-girl skin for official Harness rc.7: current no-viewport-frame layout, paired crystal-workshop and moon-tide scenes, chibi companions, translucent ornaments, and lightweight ambience.
description.zh: 面向官方 Harness rc.7 的非商业鲸鱼娘昼夜皮肤：当前无整屏边框布局、白昼水晶工坊与夜晚月潮观测室双场景、Q 版侧栏伙伴、透明花边与轻量氛围。

description.en: Light and dark theme editor with 14 exposed color controls, typography settings, named presets, and JSON import/export.
description.zh: 明暗主题编辑器，提供 14 项公开颜色编辑、字体字号设置、命名主题保存与 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Local images and videos as the DSH desktop window background: timed rotation with 0.7s cross-fades, first-frame-ready before fading in, automatic light/dark ink for readability, adjustable blur and panel/sidebar opacity, video thumbnails, and a probe endpoint reporting load, layer and selector health. Reads only the local files you point it at.
description.zh: 把本机图片/视频（含 Dynamic Wallpaper.app 素材）用作 DSH 桌面客户端背景：定时轮换与 0.7 秒交叉淡化、等首帧就绪再淡入、按壁纸明暗自动切换深/浅字色、模糊与面板/侧栏透明度可调、视频缩略图，探针接口上报加载、图层与界面选择器的健康状态。只读取本机文件，不联网。

description.en: 30 classic open-source theme palettes (Catppuccin, Nord, Tokyo Night, Gruvbox, Solarized, etc.) mapped to official ThemeService tokens for DeepSeek Harness, with a Style Settings panel for live color/font/radius tweaks and JSON export/import for sharing config packs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 30 套经典开源主题配色（Catppuccin、Nord、Tokyo Night、Gruvbox、Solarized 等），映射官方 ThemeService token；带 Style Settings 面板，可实时调整颜色/字体/圆角，并支持 JSON 导出/导入分享配置。

description.en: Themes, color palettes, backgrounds and appearance customization for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供主题、配色、背景与外观设置。

description.en: SAO (Sword Art Online) theme for DeepSeek Harness: a Link Start startup animation rendered ahead of the app shell, with Kirito/Asuna voice lines, plus theme and surface colours, liquid or frosted glass, per-component transparency, nine built-in or uploaded wallpapers, and a model-intensity slider.
description.zh: 仿刀剑神域主题：在应用外壳之前独立渲染的 Link Start 启动动画，配桐人／亚丝娜语音；另有主题色与界面底色、液态／磨砂玻璃、各组件透明度、九张内置壁纸或自传壁纸，以及输入区的模型强度滑条。

description.en: Turns an image folder into a frosted-glass global wallpaper for the DSH web UI, keeping the official palette.
description.zh: 把文件夹里的图片设为 DSH 网页端全局磨砂壁纸，配色沿用官方原版。

description.en: Adds a muted looping video behind the Harness workspace and makes the composer translucent after the boot splash finishes.
description.zh: 在 Harness 工作区后播放静音循环视频，并在开屏动画结束后将输入区域显示为半透明。

description.en: Moonrise dark theme for the DSH Web UI, with deep indigo surfaces and warm amber accents.
description.zh: 月升暗色主题——深蓝夜色打底、琥珀月光点缀。

description.en: Custom background image for the DSH Web UI: upload a picture or paste an image URL behind the whole app surface, with opacity, theme-aware scrim, panel transparency, frosted-glass and wallpaper blur, live preview and persisted settings, plus an optional DeepSeek-style timeline rail with per-question bookmarks for long conversations.
description.zh: DSH Web 自定义背景插件：上传本地图片或粘贴图片链接作为全界面背景，可调不透明度、明暗自适应遮罩、面板透明度、毛玻璃与壁纸模糊，实时预览、设置持久化；另附可选的 DeepSeek 官网风格会话时间线导航轨，支持重点书签与快速跳转。

description.en: Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.
description.zh: 按模型切换 DSH Web 界面外观：有序规则列表按当前会话的模型名匹配，每条规则自带壁纸、主题色、布局模式、取景与背景透明度、模糊；另有主背景、左侧栏、右侧栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页的分区透明度与毛玻璃模糊。

description.en: One-shot entrance animation when the workspace opens: the logo is written onto the canvas, then an inverted color bar sweeps across on exit; mirrors light/dark themes automatically.
description.zh: 打开工作台时的一次性入场动画：标识逐字擦出，退场时反色色块扫过全屏，深浅主题自动镜像。

description.en: Adeptus Mechanicus amber CRT skin for DeepSeek Harness, themed on Warhammer 40,000: a gear-and-skull emblem replaces the brand mark, the new-session slogan is written as a machine-cult verse, 14 theme tokens and 23 static palette entries are overridden, a monospace font stack covers the UI outside KaTeX math, scanlines and a screen vignette are added, and the agent-preset selector is 10% wider.
description.zh: 以《战锤 40,000》机械神教为灵感的琥珀 CRT 风格皮肤：以齿轮骷髅圣徽替代默认品牌标记，新会话口号改写为机械神教偈语，覆写 14 枚主题令牌与 23 枚静态调色板色值，在 KaTeX 公式之外统一全站等宽字体，叠加扫描线与屏幕暗角，并把模式选择器加长 10%。

description.en: A Herta theme for DeepSeek Harness: an ASCII boot opening ported from the upstream Herta project, a violet palette of design tokens, swappable wallpapers (four bundled, plus image URL, local import, solid colour or off) and a "Herta Appearance" page in DSH settings. Doubles as the theme that dsh-herta ships with.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的黑塔主题：移植自上游 Herta 项目的开机 ASCII 开场、一整套紫罗兰设计令牌、可替换的壁纸（自带四张，也支持图片网址 / 本机导入 / 纯色 / 关掉），以及 DSH 设置里的「黑塔外观」页。它同时就是 dsh-herta 自带的那套主题。
