description.en: Live dot-matrix whale wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: ~1,750 breathing WebGL2 particles with pointer liquid vortices, light/dark themes, and a Canvas2D fallback.
description.zh: DSH Web 动态点阵鲸鱼壁纸：约 1,750 个呼吸的 WebGL2 粒子，指针液态涡流交互，明暗双主题，带 Canvas2D 回退。

description.en: Dynamic backgrounds and interface skins for DeepSeek Harness. Native customizable animated skins, plus beautiful live wallpapers to download from the marketplace. Built on Open Sea Skin (d-dev0101/open-sea-skin) - do not install both.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 动态背景与界面皮肤。原生个性化动态背景皮肤，以及市场下载精美的动态壁纸。沿用 Open Sea Skin（d-dev0101/open-sea-skin）的上游实现，请勿与上游同时安装。

description.en: A liquid-glass skin built on your current desktop wallpaper: the wallpaper is blurred and veiled into the window canvas, panels stay translucent, and every surface that carries text (composer, code blocks, preview pane, menus) gets its own frost level so nothing is washed out. Apple-style liquid-glass controls. On Windows the canvas reads the current wallpaper from APPDATA; other platforms fall back to a painted gradient.
description.zh: 以当前桌面壁纸为基础做模糊处理的液态玻璃换肤：壁纸被模糊并蒙一层白纱作为整窗画布，侧栏与聊天面板保持半透明；输入框、代码块、预览面板、菜单等承载文字的表面按可读性分档加磨砂，控件为 Apple 液态玻璃质感。Windows 上读取当前桌面壁纸作为画布，其他平台回退到自绘渐变。

description.en: A deep-sea dive startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: a depth gauge with a submersible probe, a character reveal video that then loops, and a seafloor with coral, bubbles and slow drifting particles. The depth reached decides which sea creatures appear.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的深海下潜式启动开屏：深度尺与探测器、角色出场视频接无缝循环、海底珊瑚与气泡与缓慢漂浮的微光粒子；下潜到哪一层，就出现哪一层的海洋生物。

description.en: Anime theme for DeepSeek Harness: full-screen wallpaper, glassmorphism panels, six color themes, video wallpaper, particle effects, and a random corner sticker.
description.zh: 二次元主题：全屏动漫壁纸、玻璃拟态面板、六套全局配色主题、动态壁纸、粒子效果与右下角随机动图挂件。

description.en: Adds animated ASCII sharks to new and existing chats with adjustable counts and named style presets.
description.zh: 在新会话和聊天正文中显示游动的 ASCII 鲨鱼，支持调整数量和保存命名样式。

description.en: DSH Web plugin that injects an SVG (feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap) refraction filter and applies it through backdrop-filter to panels, bubbles and the input card, and bundles the orca-scene skin with theme tokens plus light and dark backgrounds.
description.zh: DSH 网页端插件：注入 SVG（feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap）折射滤镜，并用 backdrop-filter 作用到面板、气泡与输入卡上；同时附带 orca-scene 皮肤（主题 token 与明暗两套背景）。

description.en: Claude Design System theme for DeepSeek Harness: warm-grey surfaces and a clay accent, refined composer, sidebar, code blocks and Markdown, localized edit/write cards with workspace-relative paths, and an ASCII ocean on the blank-session page with three whale colour modes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude 设计系统主题：暖灰表面与陶土强调色，细化输入框、侧栏、代码块和 Markdown，编辑与写入卡片显示本地化状态及工作区相对路径，空白会话首页带三种鲸鱼配色的 ASCII 海洋。

description.en: Hot-switchable brand skins for the DSH Web UI: an OpenBMC skin, a UEFI skin and an unofficial fan-made skin based on A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, each with light/dark schemes, plus a personal wallpaper gallery, per-skin tagline and transparency controls, and a one-click path back to the official look.
description.zh: DSH Web 多品牌皮肤热切换：OpenBMC、UEFI 与《凡人修仙传》非官方同人画作三套皮肤，各带明暗双态配色，附个人壁纸图库、双语标语与通透度调节，随时一键回到官方界面。

description.en: ASCII sharks and schooling fish swim behind the DSH Web interface, with a settings page for veil opacity, shark count, size, fish density, swim speed and grid strength.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面背景中游动的 ASCII 鲨鱼与鱼群，设置页可调遮罩浓度、鲨鱼数量与体型、鱼群密度、游速和网格浓度。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness window into frosted acrylic glass so the desktop shows through, stacking on top of the active theme instead of replacing it. Desktop show-through on Windows 11 also needs the bundled installer (npx github:InkStain258/dsh-glass-skin), which makes a backed-up edit to the DSH Desktop app.asar.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 窗口换成磨砂亚克力玻璃，可透视桌面；叠加在当前主题之上而非替换主题。Windows 11 上透出桌面还需另跑仓库自带安装器（npx github:InkStain258/dsh-glass-skin，会带备份地修改 DSH Desktop 的 app.asar）。

description.en: Native Acrylic and fully transparent window backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness on Windows 11, with a mode selector and live Wallpaper Engine backdrop; requires a one-time manual desktop adapter installation. Node 20+.
description.zh: 为 Windows 11 版 DeepSeek Harness 提供可切换的原生毛玻璃与完全透明背景，实时显示 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸；需先手动安装一次桌面原生适配；需 Node 20+。

description.en: Anthropic Sans, Serif, and Mono fonts for the DSH Web UI, with Source Han fallback for CJK.
description.zh: Anthropic Sans/Serif/Mono 字体：界面 Sans、对话 Serif、代码 Mono，中文回退思源字体。

description.en: Refractive liquid-glass skin: custom wallpapers, several tunable refracting glass surfaces, wallpapers that rotate by time of day, four theme colours, a water-drop highlight lens on the selected item, and per-control parameters tuned from the bottom-right panel.
description.zh: 可折射的液态玻璃皮肤 UI：可自定义壁纸、多个可调折射液态玻璃面、随时段轮换的壁纸、四档主题色、选中项带水滴状高亮飞镜、右下可自定义每个控件参数。

description.en: Wandering Earth 550C control-room palette for the DSH Web UI, with dim 2px frames and amber selection states.
description.zh: 流浪地球 550C 控制台配色的 DSH 界面皮肤，含暗色 2px 边框与琥珀选中态。

description.en: A black hole theme plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）Web UI 的黑洞主题插件。

description.en: Ink-and-paper Apple-inspired theme for the DSH web client with a handwritten jimmy sidebar brand.
description.zh: 墨水纸质感的苹果风 DSH 网页主题，侧栏使用手写 jimmy 字标与小狗头像。

description.en: Neo-brutalist theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with paper and ink palettes, 4px hard rules, 8px offset shadows, zero radius, hazard stripes, and an in-settings theme row that restores the factory appearance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的新粗野主义主题：白纸 / 黑板双配色，4px 硬边、8px 偏移硬阴影、零圆角、警示斜纹，设置页内置主题行，可一键切回出厂外观。

description.en: Stripe Style theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a 40px purple grid, layered soft shadows, 12px cards, an 8px control scale, and an in-settings theme row with Daylight Violet and Midnight Navy palettes plus one-click factory restore.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Stripe 风格主题：40px 紫色网格、多级柔和阴影、12px 卡片与 8px 控件圆角，设置页内可直接切换「白昼紫 / 午夜蓝」双版本，并可一键恢复出厂外观。

description.en: A fully customizable theming framework for DSH UI, with Xiao from Genshin Impact as the default theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH UI 提供完全自定义的主题框架，默认主题为原神魈。

description.en: Warm pixel theme for the DSH Web UI: cream-paper and arcade-phosphor palettes, hard-edged pixel chrome with bundled pixel fonts, CRT motion on streaming and state changes, three intensity tiers, and a pixel loading bar while a turn runs.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的暖调像素主题：亮色暖米白纸面、暗色街机磷光；方角硬描边与偏移投影的像素控件、随包发布的像素字体，流式输出与状态变化带方块光标、扫描线与硬切闪帧；强度（轻/标准/浓）、动效、扫描线、像素字体四组档位在「设置 → 通用」里切换，输出时输入框上沿有一条像素加载条。

description.en: Six material skins for the DSH Web GUI — Ink Jade, Terracotta, Aurora, Abyss, Sakura Mist and Paper — painted with CSS only: one engine derives the 119 --dsw-* alias tokens from six colour inputs per appearance, Alt+K cycles skins, and the choice is remembered in localStorage. No images, no host route.
description.zh: 六套材质皮肤：墨玉、赤陶、极光、深海、樱雾、素笺。纯 CSS 绘制，一套引擎由六个输入色推导全部 119 个 --dsw-* 别名 token，Alt+K 轮换，选择记在浏览器本地；不含图片，不注册宿主路由。

description.en: Three photograph skins for the DSH Web GUI — River Night (三江夜), Lingyun Dusk (凌云晚照) and Emei Mist (峨眉夜雾). Each paints its Leshan photograph across the window and the conversation column under an appearance-keyed scrim; one engine derives the other 119 --dsw-* alias tokens from six colour inputs per appearance, Alt+K switches skins, and the choice is remembered in localStorage.
description.zh: 三套乐山照片皮肤：三江夜、凌云晚照、峨眉夜雾。照片同时铺在窗口和对话画布上，按明暗外观压罩层；每套皮肤由 6 个输入色推导全部 119 个 --dsw-* 别名 token，Alt+K 轮换皮肤，选择记在浏览器本地。

description.en: A web theme recreating the DeepSeek Harness homepage with a fluid background, an elastic pointer grid, animated fish, and adjustable effects.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Harness 首页视觉的 Web 主题，提供流体背景、鼠标弹性网格、动态小鱼与可调节效果。

description.en: Animated ocean waves with a whale swimming behind the page, plus translucent surfaces.
description.zh: 整个应用背景铺设动态海浪特效，一条鲸鱼在页面后面游泳，界面各层变为半透明。

description.en: Rotates images and videos from a media folder as the DSH UI background, with panel controls for the rotation interval and UI opacity.
description.zh: 把媒体目录中的图片与视频自动轮换为 DSH 界面背景，面板可调轮播间隔与界面透明度。

description.en: Acid-graphics theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: six complete palettes (acid, neon orange, electric cyan, violet, rose, warm orange-light) registered as switchable themes, plus an optional WebGL wireframe crystal backdrop driven by pointer and scroll, local wallpapers with a dimming mask and background lettering, a crystal startup animation with optional local video, and a Settings section that holds every control.
description.zh: dsh 酸性科技风主题：六套完整配色（酸性 / 霓虹橙 / 电弧青 / 紫罗兰 / 玫红 / 暖橙白）注册为可选主题；另附可选的 WebGL 线框晶体背景（随鼠标与滚动形变）、本地壁纸与遮罩、背景大字、晶体开机动画（可选本地视频），控制项集中在「设置 → Acid Core」。

description.en: Overhead conversation background with five whale species formed from custom text or ASCII, shaded cells, frosted content cards, input-box avoidance, independent dives, spouts, ripples, wind, and cloud shadows.
description.zh: 海面正上方俯视的对话背景，支持用自定义文字或 ASCII 组成五种鲸类，含彩色字格、内容框毛玻璃、输入框避让、独立下潜、喷水、尾拍涟漪、风纹与云影。

description.en: DSH Web skin manager for mainstream DSH skin packages: import local paths or GitHub collections, scan installed skins from the web profile, preview/use/disable/refresh/delete, with host-side persistence.
description.zh: DSH Web 皮肤管理器：支持主流 DSH 皮肤包本地/GitHub 导入、扫描已安装皮肤、预览/使用/禁用/刷新/删除，宿主持久化。

description.en: Minecraft-styled theme for the DSH web GUI: blocky pixel components, a photo wallpaper library with auto-rotation and local uploads, Minecraft UI sound samples, and a BGM player with a local track library.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面用的 Minecraft 风格主题：方块化像素组件、可自动轮换与本地导入的照片壁纸库、Minecraft 界面音效，以及可导入本地曲目的 BGM 播放器。

description.en: Firefly "Spring Missive" theme skin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Overrides 74 --dsw-alias-* design tokens in matched light and dark sets, draws a spring-window backdrop with drifting petals and fireflies, places one character illustration on each side of the layout, and keeps the centre column legible with a radial spotlight scrim. Registers a Settings section with switches for the skin and for the artwork; both choices persist in localStorage.
description.zh: 流萤「春日手信」主题皮肤。覆盖 74 个 --dsw-alias-* 官方设计令牌（明暗两套），绘制春日橱窗背景与飘落花瓣、萤火；布局两侧各放一张人物立绘，中央用径向聚光遮罩保证文字对比度；在设置里注册分区，提供皮肤与立绘两个开关，选择存在 localStorage。

description.en: Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: presets, image URL or upload, and an opacity slider that fades the interface to reveal the wallpaper.
description.zh: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：预设 / 图片 URL / 本地上传，透明度滑块让整面界面透出壁纸。

description.en: Visual-novel theme with responsive characters, task-state expressions, role skills and a music player, including an original demo pack and optional local game imports.
description.zh: 视觉小说主题，提供响应式人物、任务状态表情、角色表达技能与音乐播放器，附原创演示资源并支持可选的本机游戏导入。

description.en: A customized fork of TQSY114514/dsh-ui-appearance for theme palettes, wallpapers, and glassmorphism, with a layout fix for duplicate blank space alongside better-sidebar 0.18.0.
description.zh: 基于 TQSY114514/dsh-ui-appearance 的定制 fork，提供主题调色、壁纸与毛玻璃，并修复与 better-sidebar 0.18.0 共用时的重复留白。

description.en: Codex-style skin switcher plus a custom wallpaper layer with opacity and blur controls.
description.zh: Codex 风格皮肤切换器 + 自定义壁纸层，可调透明度与模糊。

description.en: CRT terminal skin with a phosphor-green palette, scanlines and monospace type for DeepSeek Harness. Also adds a sidebar dashboard with output speed, CPU/memory and DeepSeek balance; the key stays in the host process.
description.zh: 深色磷光绿 CRT 终端皮肤，带扫描线和等宽字体，用于 DeepSeek Harness。另在侧栏加仪表盘：输出速度、CPU/内存与 DeepSeek 余额；密钥只留在宿主进程。

description.en: Adaptive reasoning slider skin that maps each model's available reasoning efforts onto a 0–30 visual intensity scale, with synchronized portraits, background, and interface colors.
description.zh: 自适应推理等级滑块皮肤，将当前模型可用档位映射到 0–30 视觉强度，并同步人物、背景和界面配色。

description.en: DeepSeek official-site-inspired skin for DSH: dark aurora, particle whale and constellation backdrop, plus a light blue glass theme that follows the host color scheme. DSH Web only: verified on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5; the Desktop app is not yet verified.
description.zh: 灵感来源于 DeepSeek 官网的 DSH 皮肤：深色模式提供流体极光、粒子鲸鱼与星座背景，浅色模式采用蓝色玻璃质感，并跟随宿主深浅色设置切换。仅支持 DSH Web（DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 实测通过）；桌面版尚未验证。

description.en: Animated whale background for the DSH Web UI: a particle field sampled from the whale silhouette plus a dot-grid layer, both full-screen click-through canvases mounted in the shell.overlay seat; the particles gather on load, breathe when idle and are pushed away from the pointer, the grid dots swell near it, and the palette follows the page light/dark theme.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面加的一层动态鲸鱼背景：由鲸鱼剪影采样出的粒子场，加上一层点阵网格，两者都是挂在 shell.overlay 上的全屏点击穿透 canvas；粒子加载时聚合、空闲时呼吸、指针靠近时被推开，网格点靠近指针会放大，配色跟随页面明暗主题。

description.en: Applies the Naihuangxin appearance preset with settings backup and restore. A preset for elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine 1.4.0; that plugin and the local Naihuangxin wallpaper (Workshop 3808236079) are required.
description.zh: 应用奶皇新外观预设，支持设置备份与恢复。它是 elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine 1.4.0 的预设，需先装该插件并备好奶皇新壁纸（工坊 3808236079）。

description.en: DSH Web background settings: upload a local image or pick a preset ambiance, with live preview and persistent settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 设置背景：上传本地图片或选择预设氛围，实时预览且设置持久化。

description.en: QQ 2007-inspired DSH Web skin: 72 native theme tokens, scoped three-pane chrome, original offline art and pixel buddy, an optional synthesized send chime, responsive/accessibility fallbacks, and reversible Settings switches.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 QQ 2007 风格皮肤：72 个原生主题 token、作用域三栏窗框、原创离线素材与像素伙伴、可选合成发送提示音、响应式/无障碍回退和可恢复设置开关。

description.en: Local semantic-token theme editor with palette extraction, WCAG auditing, preview, and export.
description.zh: 本地语义令牌主题编辑器，支持色板提取、WCAG 审计、预览和导出。

description.en: Kimetsu no Yaiba (Demon Slayer) skin for the DSH Web UI: a night-forest palette applied through the stable token layer, nine rotating wallpapers served by the plugin host, a flame band, and a two-button dock to toggle the skin and change the picture.
description.zh: 《鬼灭之刃》DSH Web 皮肤：通过稳定令牌层应用鬼杀队配色，插件宿主提供的 9 张轮换壁纸、顶部火焰带，右下角两颗按钮分别负责开关皮肤与换壁纸。

description.en: Startup animation and chat wallpaper plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a two-act boot animation with custom animation import and three configurable transitions (first-act entry, act join, second-act exit), plus static-image and muted loop-video chat backgrounds (Wallpaper Engine project folders, custom video directories, random rotation, per-video delete).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 开机动画 + 聊天壁纸插件：两幕冷启动动画，支持导入自定义动画与三段自定义转场（第一幕入场、两幕衔接、第二幕退场）；聊天背景支持静态底图与静音循环视频（识别壁纸引擎项目文件夹、自定义视频目录、随机轮换、单个删除）。

description.en: Violet-gold acrylic DSH Web theme with light and dark stage art, framed chat, workspace mascot, and an optional Raiden agent preset.
description.zh: 紫金亚克力 DSH Web 主题，含浅色与深色舞台背景、描边对话框、工作区吉祥物与可选 Raiden Agent 预设。

description.en: Candy-pink acrylic DSH Web theme with light conservatory and dark stage art, gold-pink chat frame, Taffy character overlays, and an optional agent preset.
description.zh: 粉金亚克力 DSH Web 主题，含浅色花房与深色舞台背景、粉金对话框、塔菲立绘装饰与可选 Agent 预设。

description.en: Animated ASCII orca-ocean wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness that follows local time, with native plugin settings for brightness, saturation and composition.
description.zh: 随系统时间变化的 ASCII 虎鲸海洋动态壁纸，可在 DSH 原生插件设置中调节亮度、饱和度与构图。

description.en: Firefly-themed wallpaper background for the DSH Web GUI: four hand-picked wallpapers behind the chat, a canvas firefly field on top, and sliders for veil, blur, particle count and panel transparency.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Web 界面挂一张流萤壁纸，再撒一层萤火虫：四张壁纸可选，遮罩浓度、模糊、萤火虫数量、面板通透度、缓慢漂移都能在设置里调，深色和浅色主题各有一套参数。

description.en: Neumorphic DSH Web theme with light and dark palettes, ambient lighting, material shadows, grain texture, frosted-glass surfaces, and micro-interactions.
description.zh: DSH Web 轻拟物主题：提供浅色与深色配色、环境光影、材质阴影、纹理、磨砂玻璃表面与微交互。

description.en: Rotates the DSH app background wallpaper from a folder on a timer with cross-fade transitions; falls back to four bundled SVG gradients when no folder is set, and adds background-opacity, wallpaper-dimming, blur and text-shadow controls so panels and text stay readable.
description.zh: 按设定间隔从指定文件夹轮换 DSH 应用背景壁纸（带交叉淡化）；未配置文件夹时使用随插件分发的 4 张 SVG 渐变壁纸，并提供背景不透明度、壁纸压暗、毛玻璃模糊与文字阴影四个可读性调节，让面板与文字在花哨的图上仍然看得清。

description.en: DeepSeek homepage-style theme skin for the dsh web GUI: fluid particle background, glass sidebar and composer, running-subagent progress panel, and DSTT peak-hour color modes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 复刻 DeepSeek 官网风格的主题皮肤：流体粒子背景、玻璃拟态侧边栏与输入框、运行中子代理面板与 DSTT 高峰时段配色。

description.en: An enhanced fork of dsh-any-background. Its own work, from v0.4.0 onward, adds a dual-lane wallpaper: the same picture down each side of the window, split at the exact centre so the wallpaper stays visible beside the conversation column. Each lane can also read its own folder (one directory per side) while sharing a single rotation cadence and mode, and both lanes take identical edge feathering.
description.zh: dsh-any-background 的增强分支。v0.4.0 起的改动为本 fork 自作，新增左右双图轮播：同一轮播在窗口两侧各推进一步，以绝对中心为分界，壁纸不再被会话区完全挡住。两条车道还可各读一个文件夹（左右各一），共用同一轮播频率与模式，左右边缘淡化效果完全一致。

description.en: Windows 2000 desktop skin for the DSH Web GUI: metric-accurate grey chrome, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, square corners, 16px scrollbars, and the pixel font it renders with served by its own host route.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 换上 Windows 2000 桌面外观：按度量表还原的灰色控件、双色渐变标题栏、1px 立体边框、直角、16px 滚动条，以及由插件自身路由提供的点阵字体。

description.en: Stock market skin + real-time ticker plugin for DSH Web GUI: candlestick (K-line) popup with day/week/month periods, watchlist with pinyin fuzzy search, portfolio P&L tracker, trading session indicators, support for A-share/HK/US/crypto/forex.
description.zh: 股市行情皮肤与功能插件：全局交易终端皮肤 + 跑马灯 + 个股 K 线弹窗（日K/周K/月K 切换）、自选拼音首字母模糊搜索、持仓盈亏管理、交易时段指示，支持 A股 / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币 / 外汇。

description.en: ExHentai.org-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness. DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai. Charcoal background, light-gray text, gray borders. The session list reads like a gallery index; the composer reads like a search bar. Live Demo: https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/
description.zh: ExHentai 皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness。DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai，深炭底、浅灰文字、灰色边框；会话列表像画廊索引，发送框像搜索栏。预览Demo：https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/

description.en: A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness: light and dark share one QQ NT language — clean restrained light mode (brand blue #12B7F5, light-blue bubbles) and a calm blue-gray dark mode (#101822) — applied as reversible token and layout layers that never touch your Light/Dark preference.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 QQ NT 皮肤：浅色与深色共用一套 QQ NT 语言——浅色干净克制（品牌蓝 #12B7F5、浅蓝气泡），深色为沉稳蓝灰（#101822）——以可逆的 token 与布局两层实现，不改变你的浅色/深色偏好。

description.en: Chat wallpaper for the DSH desktop UI: paint one image from a local folder across the app, tune the left sidebar, main window and right sidebar scrims separately, rotate through a group with fade effects, and add a bar under the composer, a task progress bar and an all-session token total.
description.zh: 聊天背景：把本地图片文件夹里的一张图铺满 DSH 桌面界面；左侧栏、主窗口、右侧栏遮罩可分别调节，支持背景轮换与分组、淡入淡出特效，并提供输入栏背景条、任务进度条与全会话 Token 总用量。

description.en: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme with wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.
description.zh: 崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。

description.en: iOS 26 liquid-glass skin: one white-grey-blue fog field behind the whole window, a single 40px frost on top of it, a floating glass sidebar and reply bubbles. Light and dark palettes, no photo wallpaper, no dependencies (33 KB).
description.zh: iOS 26 液态玻璃皮肤：整窗共用一层白→灰→淡蓝的静态雾场，雾上只磨一次（blur 40px），左侧栏是悬浮玻璃卡，回复是一条气泡；浅深两套配色，不用照片壁纸，零依赖（33 KB）。

description.en: Unofficial Golden Spatula fan theme for the DSH Web GUI: an original hextech arena backdrop with a golden spatula crest (a parchment chart in light mode), four accent palettes (gold, cyan, violet, blue), a hex-board lattice, an optional aurora-and-gold-dust ambience, soft or sharp corners, a three-choice augment draft with a local 12-card codex, and a floating hex-core panel that can turn the theme off without uninstalling.
description.zh: 金铲铲同人风格的 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面主题：原创海克斯竞技场背景与金色铲影（浅色为羊皮纸棋盘地图），金/青/紫/蓝四套强化配色与令牌覆盖，界面底层铺六边形棋盘网格，另有可开关的极光与金色浮尘氛围、圆润/锐利棱角切换，以及三选一的海克斯强化草案和 12 张本地图鉴；右下角「海克斯核心」面板可一键关闭、即时还原原生界面；不含游戏素材。

description.en: Windows XP (Luna) skin for the DSH web GUI: beige Luna panels, gradient buttons, #7F9DB9 input fields, rounded blue scrollbars and a CSS-drawn Bliss-style desktop, plus a chime when a turn finishes and a different cue when the agent stops for approval.
description.zh: 把 DSH 换成 Windows XP：Luna 蓝皮肤（米色面板、渐变按钮、#7F9DB9 输入框、圆角蓝色滚动条、纯 CSS 绘制的 Bliss 风格桌面），外加一轮跑完时的提示音，以及智能体停下来等你批准时的另一种提示音。

description.en: Neon-green deep-space skin with dual character art, a 9-slice composer frame and a black-and-neon palette.
description.zh: 荧光绿的深空主题：双角色立绘、九宫格对话框外壳，黑底配荧光绿描边。

description.en: Bing daily wallpaper as the app background: auto-refresh every day, pin any of the last 30 days.
description.zh: 必应每日壁纸作为界面背景：每天自动更换，可在最近 30 天中任选一天固定。

description.en: Pixel Dynamic Starfield theme: five palettes, four layered text schemes, five pixel fonts including a simplified-Chinese face, square or rounded corners, a rotating pixel starfield with meteors, and a header pixel clock — configured from its own settings tab.
description.zh: 像素动态星空主题：五套配色、四套分层文字方案、五款像素字体（含简体中文像素字体）、方角与圆角可选、旋转像素星空与流星、顶栏像素时钟，均在插件设置页配置。

description.en: Arknights: Endfield theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: charcoal and hazard-yellow industrial HUD, a boot splash injected ahead of the shell, a conversation backdrop, and a re-cut Windows title bar. Restyles the sidebar brand to 终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES, which a URL flag reverts.
description.zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》主题：炭黑与警戒黄的工业 HUD、在外壳渲染前注入的开屏动画、对话区背景，以及重新配色的 Windows 标题栏。侧栏品牌会改为「终末地工业 / ENDFIELD INDUSTRIES」，可用 URL 参数还原。

description.en: A CSS skin that restyles the reasoning-tier control drawn by hytime/dsh-thinking-effort into a blue-to-violet pill with a starfield and a sheen sweep, with matching light and dark palettes. Requires that plugin to be installed; it adds no UI of its own.
description.zh: 给 hytime/dsh-thinking-effort 已经画出来的推理等级控件换一层 CSS 皮肤：蓝紫渐变胶囊、 星点与流光，浅色与深色主题各一套配色。需先安装该插件，自身不新增任何界面。

description.en: Light/dark colour theme for the DSH web UI with an APTX capsule logo, browser tab title and icon branding, and optional Ai Haibara (Detective Conan) artwork panels, configured under Settings → General → Appearance with a no-decoration mode.
description.zh: DSH Web 明暗配色主题：APTX 胶囊标志、浏览器标签标题与图标、可选的灰原哀（名侦探柯南）展示素材，在「设置 → 通用 → 外观」中配置，可选无装饰模式。

description.en: Deep-sea whale-blue reskin for the DSH Web GUI: 14 theme tokens in light and dark, five whale-tail-maid placements, a clock and weather card, and a collapsible hardware readout (CPU, memory, GPU, per-drive temperatures via HWiNFO). No backdrop image is bundled; drop your own in. MIT code, MIT character art.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 的深海鲸蓝换肤：亮/暗两套共 14 个主题 token、5 处鲸尾女仆角色元素、时钟与天气卡片，以及可上下伸缩的硬件状态悬浮窗（CPU / 内存 / GPU / 硬盘温度，温度需 HWiNFO 提供）。包内不含背景图，放一张你自己的即可。源码与角色素材均为 MIT。

description.en: Hello Kitty pink theme skin for the DSH Web UI: overrides the --dsw-alias-* semantic tokens in light and dark mode and paints a custom wallpaper on the app frame. Installs as a static profile plugin, so the theme restores automatically on every Harness start.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Hello Kitty 粉色主题皮肤：覆盖 --dsw-alias-* 语义 token（浅色/深色），并给主框架铺上自定义壁纸；作为静态 profile 插件安装，Harness 每次启动自动恢复。

description.en: Picks a random installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch and enables exactly that skin, with an on/off switch and a shuffle action inside the Skins settings page. Skins the running host would refuse to load are excluded, and a manual switch still applies until the next launch.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时随机启用一个已安装皮肤，并在「设置 → 皮肤」页内提供开关与「立即随机换一个」按钮。宿主会拒绝加载的皮肤自动排除；手动切换的皮肤一直有效到下次启动。

description.en: A lightweight font and theme plugin for the DSH client: Latin/Chinese/code font pickers that list only installed families, and five official palettes (One Dark Pro, Dracula, Nord, GitHub, Catppuccin) applied through the official theme tokens, including code-block syntax colors. No bundled fonts, no dependencies, no build step. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer.
description.zh: 轻量的 DSH 字体与主题插件：中英文与代码字体选择器（只列本机已安装的字体），以及 One Dark Pro、Dracula、Nord、GitHub、Catppuccin 五套官方色板预设，全部走官方主题 token（含代码块语法高亮），不打包字体、零依赖、零构建。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新。

description.en: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

description.en: Minecraft-styled skin for the DSH Web client: MC GUI palette and pixel bevels, a pixel logo, on/off switch art, two persistent toggles in Settings, and an optional 16 MB Minecraft AE pixel font served on demand by the host half.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 客户端用的 Minecraft 风格皮肤：MC 调色板与像素立体边框、像素标志图、开关图案、设置里两个可持久化的开关，以及由 Host 半边按需发货的 16 MB Minecraft AE 像素字体。

description.en: Anime skin pack for the DSH Web UI: five AI-generated HD themes (Ninja, Sakura, Bamboo, Ronin, Ryujin) with per-theme accent palettes, a top-right shirt-icon switcher, and an adjustable transparency slider.
description.zh: 动漫皮肤包：忍者、樱花、竹林、落日、苍龙五套 AI 生成高清主题，各配专属点缀色，右上角衣服图标一键切换，透明度可调。

description.en: Look & theme plugin for the DSH Web UI: built-in palettes, light/dark/follow-system appearance modes, Open VSX theme search & install, and VS Code theme import with a persisted theme library.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 外观与主题插件：内置调色板、明 / 暗 / 跟随系统外观模式、Open VSX 主题搜索导入与 VS Code 主题导入，主题库持久化。

description.en: Image-background skin with four shipped wallpapers, a user wallpaper directory, custom image URLs, and live dim/blur controls in Settings.
description.zh: 图片背景皮肤：内置四张壁纸，支持用户壁纸目录与自定义图片链接，设置页实时调节压暗与模糊。

description.en: Markdown conversation theme plugin — 4 built-in themes with light and dark variants, user-editable CSS themes, system-aware auto-switching, an in-browser editor with syntax highlighting and save-time validation, and a theme selection that persists across reloads and tabs. Also ships a version-history panel. Windows and DSH Desktop supported.
description.zh: 对话 Markdown 主题插件——4 套内置主题（浅/深双档）、可自行编辑的 CSS 用户主题、跟随系统自动切换、内置编辑器（语法高亮 + 保存校验）、选中主题在刷新与新标签页后保持，并附带版本台账面板；支持 Windows 与 DSH Desktop。

description.en: Adds Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, One Dark, Gruvbox, Solarized, GitHub, Everforest, Kanagawa and Rosé Pine presets to the DSH Web GUI theme picker, layered over the built-in light/dark/system appearance.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 的主题选择中加入 Nord、Dracula、Catppuccin、Tokyo Night、One Dark、Gruvbox、Solarized、GitHub、Everforest、Kanagawa、Rosé Pine 十一套配色预设，与内置的浅色/深色/跟随系统正交叠加。

description.en: Appearance suite for DeepSeek Harness: deep-space starfield background, Cyberpunk 2077 HUD theme, startup authentication sequence, and a sidebar toggle for borderless windows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观套件：深空动态天体背景、赛博朋克 2077 HUD 主题、开机认证序列，以及无边框窗口下的侧栏折叠按钮。

description.en: Tianlight skin for DeepSeek Harness: 4K video/image wallpapers, local upload and auto-rotation, optional WebWallGL scenes, liquid glass, and a Mint cat companion. Alt+W opens the wallpaper panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「遐蝶·天光」皮肤：4K 视频/图片壁纸、本地上传与自动轮播、可选 WebWallGL 场景、液态玻璃与薄荷猫桌宠；Alt+W 打开壁纸面板。

description.en: A Genshin Impact Hu Tao (Wangsheng Funeral Parlor) skin for the dsh web GUI - a 14-token ink-black, crimson and amber palette, falling plum petals and spirit butterflies, a plum-blossom brand mark, and a floating petal toggle that tracks the sidebar.
description.zh: 原神胡桃（往生堂）主题皮肤：14 个主题令牌的墨黑、绯红与琥珀金配色，飘落梅花瓣与流光蝴蝶，梅花徽记，以及会跟随侧栏收放的浮动开关。

description.en: Dark theme plugin for dsh web (port of Obsidian things-soft-colorful-headings): warm-gray dimmed text via --dsw-alias-label-* token overrides plus soft colorful h1-h6 headings, zero dependencies.
description.zh: dsh web 暗色主题插件（移植自 Obsidian things-soft-colorful-headings）：通过 --dsw-alias-label-* token 覆盖实现暖灰调暗文本，配合柔和的彩色 h1-h6 标题，零依赖。

description.en: Switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH web UI — 14 panels become frosted glass over a fluid backdrop, with material sliders and hover elasticity.
description.zh: 可切换的 DSH 网页端液态玻璃主题——14 个面板在流体背景上变成磨砂玻璃，材质参数有滑杆，悬停时玻璃与面板内容一起倾斜。

description.en: A dark, glassy Scaramouche theme for DeepSeek Harness with static and video wallpapers, opening video, ambient music, particles, and a draggable dock.
description.zh: 墨黑玻璃质感的原神「散兵」主题：静态/视频壁纸、开屏视频、环境音乐、粒子与可拖动控制条。

description.en: Hand-drawn mountain-lake pastoral theme with continuous local-time day/night scenes and a farmer who works while the displayed conversation is running. Architecture reference: xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme.
description.zh: 手绘山湖田园主题：按本地时间连续呈现晨昏昼夜，并让农人随当前展示对话的任务运行状态进出田间。插件架构参考 xikan0/dsh-outerwilds-theme。

description.en: A NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with sand-and-charcoal palettes, square geometry, and interface-wide styling.
description.zh: 一款面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 风格工业终端主题，提供沙色与炭黑配色、直角几何和全界面样式。

description.en: A lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness: custom wallpaper, glass-like panel transparency, and an accent color; server-side settings shared across devices, native light/dark mode left untouched.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 轻量级外观皮肤：自定义壁纸、玻璃质感面板与重点色；服务端持久化、多设备一致，不接管原生深浅色。

description.en: Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设置 → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。

description.en: United Nations theme for the DSH Web GUI: UN blue over paper white, the official emblem, a slow rotation of credited UN peacekeeping photographs behind the conversation, Charter and UN-facts ribbons, and a 7,030-language picker (127 languages with a complete skin translation) that leaves every existing control untouched. Browser-side only; installers for Linux, macOS and Windows.
description.zh: 联合国主题皮肤：白底联合国蓝、官方徽记、对话背景缓慢轮播带署名的联合国维和照片、宪章与联合国知识丝带，以及收录 7,030 种语言（127 种已完整翻译）的语言选择器，不改动任何原有按钮。纯浏览器侧实现，附 Linux/macOS/Windows 一键安装脚本。

description.en: Arknights PRTS Originium Protocol theme featuring interactive 3D crystal, tactical HUD, memory fragments, and boot sequence.
description.zh: 明日方舟 PRTS 源石协议主题：可交互旋转 3D 源石晶簇、工业指令面板、普瑞赛斯记忆残片与启动序列。

description.en: Dark-only starry-sky theme for the Web UI: both Light and Dark resolve to one deep-space night palette with a twinkling click-through starfield and four constellation figures, and the appearance preference is pinned to Dark while the plugin is enabled.
description.zh: 深色星空主题：浅色与深色外观统一为同一套深空配色，带闪烁星点和四组星座连线；插件启用时外观固定在深色。

description.en: Adds a city-local sky theme with a moving sun, day and night colors, drifting clouds, time previews, and an immersive sky view to the DSH web workspace.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页工作区添加按城市当地时间变化的天空主题，支持太阳移动、日夜配色、浮云、时间预览与沉浸天空。

description.en: Saber (Fate) theme for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web with light/dark palettes, 30 on-demand chat wallpapers rotating every five minutes, and a task attention tray below the right-side turn index, compatible with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版和 Web 的 Saber（Fate）主题，提供冰蓝浅色、深色配色、每五分钟随机切换的 30 张按需加载聊天背景，以及右侧对话索引下方的任务关注浮层，兼容 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 和 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Kimi no Na wa (Your Name) theme: cinematic wallpaper, comet-blue glassmorphism, movie logo swap and unified scrollbars for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 《你的名字。》主题：电影壁纸、彗星蓝玻璃拟态、电影 Logo 替换与统一滚动条。

description.en: Standalone wallpaper background for the DSH Web UI and desktop app: built-in wallpapers, local image/video uploads stored in IndexedDB, and a read-only local Wallpaper Engine library served by the bundled wallpaper-engine-api service in the repository; renders images, video and scene workshop previews, with light-fog/dark-overlay, blur, brightness and safe-zoom controls plus a read-only follow-desktop-wallpaper mode.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面与桌面端的独立壁纸背景：内置壁纸、本地图片/视频上传（存 IndexedDB）、只读接入本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库（需仓库自带的 wallpaper-engine-api 服务）；支持图片、视频与场景工坊预览渲染，可调浅色雾层/深色遮罩、模糊、亮度与安全放大，并可只读跟随桌面壁纸。

description.en: Strinova theme: light/dark modes, a Cielle character illustration on the new-session screen, a corner character randomly picked on each page load with a matching composer placeholder line, and floating particles.
description.zh: 卡拉彼丘主题：日夜双模式；新会话页展示汐的角色立绘，右下角角色与输入栏台词按页面加载随机轮换，并点缀漂浮粒子。

description.en: Catppuccin themes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web GUI: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice, and adjustable frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Catppuccin 主题插件：Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套主题接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择；另附可开关的玻璃质感皮肤，顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图的磨砂玻璃效果可自由调节。

plugins.name: dsh-claude-style

description.en: Claude Code Desktop look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — ivory/warm-black dual canvas, clay accent, three-font typography, permission segmented control and brand switcher, via CSS overrides and client DOM overrides.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的视觉与交互——象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙强调色、三字体排版、权限分段控件与品牌切换，以 CSS 覆盖与客户端 DOM override 实现。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Dracula theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: the classic dark palette and the Soft variant registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的德古拉主题插件：经典暗色配色与 Soft 变体接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择。

description.en: Claude-style skin with a warm-black canvas, clay accent, and serif UI that follows the native light and dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格皮肤：暖黑画布、陶橙点缀、衬线 UI，跟随原生亮/暗主题。

description.en: eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI themed as an XRY/B1 medical HUD: ECG heartbeat waveform and a rotating radar scan disc on the right bar, power-gen energy-cell meters on the left bar, a DATA TIMELINE scan-log table on the bottom, all in a cyan-on-near-black CRT skin around the original UI.
description.zh: 以 XRY/B1 医疗 HUD 为主题色的 eDEX-UI 风格 DSH 外壳：右侧 ECG 心电波形与旋转雷达扫描盘、左侧能量条仪表、底部 DATA TIMELINE 扫描日志表，青蓝近黑 CRT 皮肤包裹原始界面。

description.en: iOS 26 style liquid glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: a fully transparent workspace, layered glass panels, a built-in wallpaper gallery, and a control center for workspaces and plugins.
description.zh: DSH 的液态玻璃主题：工作区全透明、分层玻璃面板、内置壁纸库，外加一个管工作区与插件的控制中心。

description.en: Deep-sea skin for the DSH Web UI: an 80-token light/dark theme layer, a two-layer background, a gradient sidebar with a whale sticker, a wordmark that doubles as the skin switch, and a rotating turn-status line.
description.zh: DSH Web 深海皮肤：80 条明暗双值令牌、背景两层、渐变侧栏与鲸鱼娘贴纸；左上角大字标就是皮肤开关，运行中的状态文案每 6 秒轮播。

description.en: WeChat-style light theme with a dark icon rail, grey conversation list and green chat bubbles.
description.zh: 微信风格浅色主题，包含深色图标栏、灰色会话列表和绿色聊天气泡。

description.en: Sky: Children of the Light skin for the dsh web UI - light children on a glowing star map, candlelight gold and starry night.
description.zh: 光遇·遇境主题皮肤：星盘之上的光之子，烛火暖金与深蓝星空双主题，为 dsh WebUI 定制。

description.en: Kami-inspired editorial skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with a warm parchment canvas, ink-blue accent, serif typography and hairline borders in light and dark palettes.
description.zh: 基于 Kami 视觉风格的 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 皮肤；暖羊皮纸画布、墨蓝强调色、衬线字形与发丝线边框，提供浅色与深色两套配色。

description.en: Glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: frosted translucent surfaces with adjustable opacity, blur radius and saturation, ambient lighting and accent palettes, plus a custom background image with cover, contain, stretch, tile or center fit and crop, all persisted from a settings page.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的毛玻璃主题：磨砂半透明表面，可调不透明度、模糊半径与饱和度，支持氛围光与配色方案，并可设置自定义背景图片（填充、适应、拉伸、平铺、居中与裁剪），全部参数保存在设置页中。

description.en: Opening animation, three bundled wallpapers, up to nine uploaded wallpapers with random rotation, and live panel and sidebar opacity.
description.zh: 开场动画、三张内置壁纸、最多九张上传壁纸与随机轮换，以及实时生效的面板与侧边栏透明度。

description.en: Dark navy glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with a cyber-city background and holographic-cube cyan accents.
description.zh: 深海军蓝半透明面板承载赛博城市夜景背景、全息立方体青色辉光作为点缀的暗色主题。

description.en: Persona 3 Reload style skin: midnight-blue palette, cyan hairlines, skewed blue selection slabs, game-style-like dialogue boxes.
description.zh: Persona 3 Reload 风格皮肤：午夜蓝配色、青色细线、斜切蓝色选中板、类游戏式对话框。

description.en: One-command skin plugin: 8 original themes, translucent wallpaper with opacity/blur, per-user accent, and shareable theme-pack import/export, favorites and surprise-me — purely native on DSH's token system.
description.zh: 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊）、强调色、主题包导入/导出+分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统接入。

description.en: Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: image background with opacity, mask and blur controls.
description.zh: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：图片背景，可调透明度、压暗遮罩与模糊。

description.en: Codex-style appearance for the DSH Web interface: window edge hairlines and shadows, sidebar colours and row alignment, a model picker with a reasoning-effort power rail, composer and right-panel geometry, a full-page settings-modal pass, a Trajectory view exit, and a settings card for theme, accent, background, foreground, fonts, sidebar translucency and contrast.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面复刻 Codex 外观：窗口边缘发丝线与阴影、侧栏配色与行对齐、带推理强度功率轨的模型选择器、输入区与右栏几何、设置模态框全页改造、轨迹视图退出出口，以及可调主题、强调色、背景、前景、字体、侧栏半透明与对比度的设置卡。

description.en: Opt-in pixel-neon arcade skin with Fusion Pixel fonts, animated whale-girl icons, custom crosshair and draggable detail windows; preserves light/dark/system themes. v0.3.2 includes local display-name controls, mobile menu improvements and an optional source patch for the arcade home screen, transitions and telemetry HUD.
description.zh: 可选的像素霓虹街机皮肤：Fusion Pixel 字体、鲸鱼娘像素图标、十字准星与可拖动详情窗口，保留浅色/深色/跟随系统。v0.3.2 支持本地自定义称呼并完善手机菜单；完整街机首页、转场与数值 HUD 另附可选源码集成补丁。

description.en: Colour engine for the chat UI: ships the Mariana palette as the default preset, exposes 18 colour slots and 9 Markdown prose roles, lets you save up to 12 presets, and colours LaTeX blocks by running Sublime's own LaTeX syntax.
description.zh: 对话界面配色引擎：内置 Mariana 配色作为默认预设，提供 18 个颜色槽位与 9 个 Markdown 正文角色色，最多可保存 12 套预设；LaTeX 代码块通过移植 Sublime 自身的语法来上色。

description.en: Wallpaper backgrounds for the DSH web GUI. Windows: reads your Wallpaper Engine (Steam) library and plays video/web wallpapers behind the chat. macOS: scans the WaifuX download folder and loose media folders automatically — anything saved in WaifuX becomes a DSH background with zero setup. Liquid-glass blur, dim and border sliders.
description.zh: DSH Web 聊天背景壁纸。Windows：直接读取你的 Wallpaper Engine（Steam）库，把视频/网页壁纸渲染到聊天界面背后。macOS：自动扫描 WaifuX 下载目录和媒体文件夹——在 WaifuX 里保存的壁纸零配置即可成为 DSH 背景，支持视频与图片。带毛玻璃模糊、压暗、边框调节滑块。

description.en: Two-level theme manager for the DSH Web UI: pick a culture / scene, a national flag, a developer palette, or a high-contrast pairing first, then a concrete style (58 built-in palettes, light and dark).
description.zh: DSH Web 两级主题管理器：先选文化 / 场景、国旗、开发者配色或强烈对比配色，再选具体风格，内置 58 套浅色 / 深色配色。

description.en: A soft, simple pink theme for DeepSeek Harness with a hand-drawn kitty-print wallpaper, light and dark palettes, and two kitty mascots; no configuration or extra panels.
description.zh: 粉嫩、简洁的 DeepSeek Harness 主题：手绘小猫印花壁纸、浅色与深色配色，以及两只小猫装饰；没有复杂配置和额外面板。

description.en: Use wallpapers downloaded in Wallpaper Engine as the DeepSeek Harness web background: video wallpapers play in place, image wallpapers use the highest-resolution standalone artwork, with cover/contain fit modes and a 0-100 panel dimmer.
description.zh: 将 Wallpaper Engine 中已下载的壁纸用作 DeepSeek Harness 的背景：视频壁纸原位播放，图片壁纸优先使用最高分辨率原图，支持铺满/完整显示适配与 0–100 面板暗化。

description.en: Windows XP Luna desktop for the DSH Web UI: a floating window manager with taskbar and desktop icons, plus the era-accurate Luna skin.
description.zh: Windows XP Luna 桌面化主题：浮动窗口管理器（任务栏、桌面图标）加上还原度很高的 Luna 皮肤。

plugins.name: dsh-xingkong-theme

description.en: Deep-space theme for the Harness Web GUI: two fully designed light and dark palettes over a seamless cross-dissolve nebula wallpaper, plus a model probe that reports which configured models actually answer and their real context window.
description.zh: 深空观测站主题：浅色与深色两套完整设计，衬在无痕交叉溶解的星云动态壁纸之上；附带模型检验面板，告诉你哪些模型真的可用、真实上下文窗口有多大。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: An Aether Gazer Verdandi-inspired DSH Web UI skin with light and dark backgrounds, wedding-themed chrome, responsive character art, and themed conversation and sidebar surfaces.
description.zh: 一款以《深空之眼》薇儿丹蒂为主题的 DSH Web UI 皮肤，包含昼夜背景、誓约婚礼装饰、响应式角色立绘，以及主题化的会话区与侧边栏。

description.en: Upload an image as a full-window frosted-glass theme: sidebar/conversation/details share one frost layer, Save/Delete, official Light/Dark/System stay in charge.
description.zh: 上传图片作为整窗磨砂玻璃主题：侧栏/会话/详情同一层磨砂，保存/删除，官方浅色/深色/跟随系统仍有效。

description.en: Windows only. With Wallpaper Engine installed it follows the active wallpaper or a pinned pick from the Workshop library; without it the plugin ships four starter wallpapers in a drop folder. Translucent panels, per-block blur and wallpaper-matched text contrast.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。装了 Wallpaper Engine 就跟随当前壁纸，或从创意工坊库里固定一张；没装也能用，投放文件夹里自带四张起始壁纸。面板半透明、分块模糊、字色自动跟随壁纸。

description.en: Add a theme-adjustment panel under Appearance to customize accent, background, foreground, contrast and gradient, applied live through theme token overrides.
description.zh: 在「外观」下增加一个主题调节面板，可自定义强调色/背景色/前景色/对比度/渐变度，并实时生效。

description.en: Interactive Chinese glyph ink-wash backgrounds for DSH conversations, with six scenes: Lotus pond, Misty hills, Qingming handscroll, 24 solar terms, Northern sea and Big fat whale.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供可交互的汉字水墨背景，包含莲池、山水、清明上河、二十四节气、北冥和大肥鲸六个场景。

description.en: Two switchable design languages for the DSH GUI — liquid glass with inner-lit surfaces and pointer specular, and Soviet constructivism with cream/ink/red poster geometry — plus a personalization panel, drop-in CSS skin packs, and a seven-expression whale-girl pet.
description.zh: 给 DSH 界面的两套可切换设计语言：内部发光的液态玻璃，与米色/血红/墨黑的苏联构成主义海报；附带个性化面板、投放式 CSS 皮肤包与 7 种表情的鲸鱼娘桌宠。

description.en: Imports .vsix theme files made for Visual Studio Code and applies them to the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 导入为 Visual Studio Code 设计的 .vsix 主题文件并应用到 DSH Web UI。

description.en: Signature escook theme ported from VS Code: 4 classic aesthetic color schemes (Dark, Dark Soft, Light, Light Soft) with high-contrast syntax highlighting for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 移植自 VS Code 经典的彬哥主题：包含 4 款经典美学配色（经典暗黑、柔和暗黑、紫韵浅色、柔和浅色）与高对比度语法高亮。

description.en: Adds selectable animated skins to the "Deep diving..." status row, with configurable size and optional status-text replacement.
description.zh: 为“Deep diving...”状态行添加可选动态皮肤，并支持调整尺寸和可选状态文案替换。

description.en: Browser-local wallpaper and translucent-panel controls for DSH Web, with multiple images, fit and position choices, shading, blur, and panel opacity.
description.zh: DSH Web 的浏览器本地壁纸与半透明面板插件，支持多图切换、填充与位置选择、遮罩、模糊和面板透明度调节。

description.en: Whale-girl skin series for the DSH Web UI (maid-atelier).
description.zh: DSH Web 鲸鱼娘皮肤系列（深海女仆工坊 maid-atelier）。

description.en: Adds two switchable themes, built-in and local-folder background slideshows, and per-session token usage details to DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 与桌面端提供两套可切换主题、内置及本地文件夹背景轮播和逐会话 Token 用量明细。

description.en: Skin author workbench: official token browser (169 --dsw-* variables with Chinese descriptions and module-usage tags), live try-on, durable skin save, theme freeze, seven spectrum presets with SVG backdrops and custom backdrop upload.
description.zh: 皮肤作者工作台：官方 token 浏览器（169 个 --dsw-* 变量，带中文描述与模块标签）、实时试穿、皮肤持久保存、主题固化、7 套光谱预设与 SVG 背景图，以及自定义背景上传。

description.en: Theme presets, a DIY palette editor with per-mode accents, bold borders, fonts, and interface text size for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供主题预设、DIY 调色与各模式强调色、加粗边框、字体与界面字号。

description.en: Uses a looping silent clip as the chat background with adjustable opacity, and plays a startup animation with sound. On first launch under a light theme it switches once to dark, with an undo prompt.
description.zh: 把一段循环短片铺成聊天背景（可调透明度），启动时再播放一段有声片头动画。首次启动若为浅色主题，会一次性切到深色（附撤销提示）。

description.en: EVA armor HUD theme skin for DSH, with startup animation and sequential UI entrance animation.
description.zh: EVA真希波装甲HUD风格DSH皮肤，自带开场动画、组件顺序入场动效，毛玻璃UI

description.en: Six switchable background palettes, a custom image, or any solid color for DeepSeek Harness, with adjustable opacity and a dedicated Background settings page.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供六套可切换背景、自定义图片或任意纯色，可调节不透明度，并注册为独立的「背景」设置页。

description.en: Red-phosphor CRT terminal theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: black background, phosphor-red text, animated data rain and scanlines, and four department presets (Party Affairs, State Council, Central Military Commission, State Security), each with its own emblem, palette and background pattern.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换成黑底红字的磷光终端主题：红色数据雨与 CRT 扫描线，外加党务 / 国家政务 / 中央军委 / 国家安全四套部门预设，每套自带徽记、配色与背景纹样。

description.en: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
description.zh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

description.en: Local image and MP4 video backgrounds for DSH Web and Desktop, plus Codex, Cursor, Doubao and WorkBuddy: a sidebar Background panel, saved named themes, a sound switch, restore-last-background, a background-only "slack" mode, and /bg, /bg-theme, /bg-clear commands.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 与 Desktop 设置本地图片与 MP4 视频背景（也支持 Codex、Cursor、豆包、WorkBuddy）：侧栏「背景」面板、可保存命名主题、声音开关、恢复上次背景、只留背景的摸鱼模式，以及 /bg、/bg-theme、/bg-clear 命令。

description.en: An ink-wash theme for DeepSeek Harness inspired by Luzhou Moon, a guofeng song by the Chinese singer Vae. Built on dsh-theme-customizer, it repaints the app background, sidebar, composer, new-session button, settings panel, Cordis panel and floating panel with generated ink-landscape artwork, adds gold filigree frames and a full-screen rain effect, and rotates vertical lyrics drawn from 24 of his Chinese-style songs.
description.zh: 以许嵩国风作品《庐州月》为题的 DSH 水墨主题。基于 dsh-theme-customizer，为界面背景、侧边栏、输入区、新会话按钮、设置面板、Cordis 面板与浮窗面板换上程序生成的水墨画面，配金丝边框与全屏雨幕，并竖排轮播其 24 首国风作品的歌词。

description.en: Genshin Impact white-and-gold skin for the DSH web GUI: a random in-game landscape wallpaper on every page load, the Genshin UI font site-wide, a Paimon-style menu and a running-status element ring, and a switchable Paimon/Phanes assistant persona. The repository ships 262 wallpapers across eight regions at 1920x1080.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成原神白金风格：每次打开随机一张游戏内风景壁纸，全站使用原神界面字体，带派蒙风格菜单与运行状态元素环，可在派蒙/法涅斯两种人格间一键切换；仓库内置 262 张 1920x1080 壁纸，覆盖八个地区。

description.en: Orihime golden-hour skin for DeepSeek Harness: a two-layer illustrated backdrop with a sidebar workshop for composition and sharpness, amber message bubbles and a cream letter-paper composer.
description.zh: 井上织姬主题的暖金皮肤：两层插画背景、可调构图与清晰度的侧栏工作台、琥珀色消息气泡与奶油信纸输入框。

description.en: Kaze Tachinu (The Wind Rises) skin for the DSH Web GUI: a full-screen film wallpaper behind glassmorphism surfaces, sky-blue interaction tokens, redrawn vector logos for the sidebar and home hero, a restyled composer card with themed placeholder text, and a bottom fade on the message list.
description.zh: 宫崎骏《起风了》主题皮肤：全屏电影壁纸配毛玻璃界面，交互色统一为天蓝，侧边栏与首页改用自绘矢量徽标，输入卡重绘为主题化占位文案的云海蓝胶囊，并为消息列加 40px 底部渐隐。

description.en: Compact ASCII / terminal skin for DeepSeek Harness: 19 palettes with a picker in the status line, 3 UI densities, a vim-style status line, ascii.rest art on empty sessions and a retro boot intro with custom logo text.
description.zh: 紧凑的 ASCII / 终端风格皮肤：19 套配色（可在状态栏切换）、3 档界面密度、vim 风格状态栏、空会话中的 ascii.rest 字符画，以及可自定义 Logo 文字的复古开机动画。

description.en: Claude-style warm-editorial skin for the DSH web GUI — ivory/warm-black canvas, a clay ember accent, serif display + sans UI + mono labels, hairline borders and pill CTAs, light/dark themes.
description.zh: Claude 风格暖调编辑 DSH Web 皮肤：象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙点睛、衬线标题+无衬线界面+等宽标签、发丝线与胶囊 CTA，亮暗双主题跟随系统。

description.en: Furina (Genshin Impact) theme with three palettes, switchable wallpapers and an in-Settings theme page.
description.zh: 《原神》芙宁娜主题，三套配色、可切换壁纸，并在设置页内管理。

description.en: Qingxiao (Wuthering Waves) themed skin for the DSH web GUI, with ice-blue/jade/moon-white palette, sword-light motes and user-swappable backgrounds.
description.zh: 以《鸣潮》清宵为主题的 DSH Web 界面皮肤，冰蓝·青碧·月白配色，含剑气流光与可更换背景。

description.en: Presents DSH Web as a playable, full-screen first-person Minecraft-style voxel interface—not a color-only skin: users walk through a persistent Three.js block world and access native workspaces, sessions, conversations, tools, model selection, permissions, context information, and the composer through in-world facilities and a workbench.
description.zh: 将 DSH Web 直接呈现为可游玩的全屏第一人称 Minecraft 风格体素界面，而非只更换颜色的皮肤：用户可以在可持久化的 Three.js 方块世界中移动，并通过游戏内设施和工作台使用原生工作区、会话、对话、工具、模型选择、权限、上下文信息与输入框。

description.en: Arknights theme for the DSH Web GUI: twelve full-screen wallpapers whose edge blur, feathering and glass opacity are computed per image; ink solved in OKLCH to hold WCAG AA; Rhodes Island iconography throughout; and approval and question cards signed with operator autographs.
description.zh: 明日方舟主题：12 张整屏壁纸，边缘虚化、羽化与玻璃浓度按每张图分别计算；文字色以 OKLCH 求解并守住 WCAG AA 下限；界面图标换成罗德岛素材；授权卡与选项卡带干员签名。

description.en: Skin manager for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a draggable whale button that restores the default look on left-click and switches between installed skins on right-click.
description.zh: DSH 网页皮肤管理器：可拖动的鲸鱼按钮，左键恢复默认界面，右键列出并切换所有已安装皮肤。

description.en: Fixed deep-blue gradient sidebar for the DSH Web UI plus three light-mode content backdrops (native white, a flowing blue WebGL shader ported from the deepseek.com homepage, or a muted blue), and brand-blue token overrides.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的固定深蓝渐变侧边栏（不跟随浅色/深色），外加浅色模式下的三档内容区底色（原生白 / 移植自 deepseek.com 首页的 WebGL 流动蓝 / 雾蓝），并覆盖品牌蓝 token。

description.en: A neon pixel theme for DeepSeek Harness desktop with playable air-battle, pig-sling and fruit-slicing backgrounds, mouse controls and a day/night switch for the sling game.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面端霓虹像素主题，提供可参与的像素空战、愤怒的小猪和霓虹切水果背景，支持鼠标操作及小猪游戏昼夜切换。

description.en: Main UI skin that extends the dsh-startup-screen archive layout to the whole workspace, picking up from the boot animation when it hands off.
description.zh: 主界面皮肤：把 dsh-startup-screen 开机动画的技术档案版式延伸到整个工作台，揭幕时接住开机动画的常驻件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness appearance toolkit. Independently tune opacity + frosted-glass blur across 8 surfaces (main background, sidebar, cards & panels, inputs & controls, settings, conversation frame, trajectory view, produced/highlights — 9 with dsh-better-sidebar). Use any image or video as wallpaper with a drag-to-pan, scroll-to-zoom position editor and 5 layout modes (Fit/Fill/Stretch/Tile/Center); videos loop muted, survive refresh, and capture a live frame for preview, color extraction and framing. Rotate a pool of images (shuffle/order, every refresh/daily/weekly). Also: PS-style color wheel, one-click wallpaper color extraction, 6 presets + saved profiles, day/night auto switch, and full theme export/import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观一体化工具。对 8 个界面区域分别调节透明度与毛玻璃模糊（主背景、侧边栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页、产出物/高亮内容；安装 dsh-better-sidebar 后为 9 个）。用任意图片或视频做壁纸，配有拖动平移、滚轮缩放的位置编辑器与 5 种布局模式（适应/填充/拉伸/平铺/居中）；视频静音循环播放、刷新不丢失，并自动截取一帧用于预览、取色与构图。把多张图片加入轮换池（随机/顺序，每次刷新/每天/每周）自动更换。还包含 PS 风格色轮、一键从壁纸提取主题色、6 套预设 + 命名配置、昼夜自动切换与主题一键导出导入。

description.en: Cyberpunk 2077 / Night City theme: NC yellow and neon cyan identity, CRT scanlines, Kiroshi hover lock-on, combat-state HUD, synthesized typewriter and message SFX, and hidden easter eggs (relic / johnny).
description.zh: Cyberpunk 2077 / 夜之城主题：NC 黄 × 霓虹青配色、CRT 扫描线、Kiroshi 悬停锁定、战斗状态 HUD、合成打字机与消息音效，以及隐藏彩蛋（relic / johnny）。

description.en: Turns the DSH web UI into the H.D.D Hollow Deep Dive terminal from Zenless Zone Zero: the sidebar and composer are reskinned. Ships a small read-only host half plus the web skin; switch it off and DSH returns to its native light UI.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成《绝区零》H.D.D 空洞深潜系统的深蓝终端：侧栏与输入框整体换装。插件含一个只读的宿主半边与前端皮肤；关掉即回 DSH 原生白底。

description.en: Two-suit VTuber theme for Joi: Flowers and Library are separate token systems for light and dark, with a standing portrait and a whale girl napping on the headline of the new-session page, two chibi companions above the composer that follow the turn state, a duo sidebar mark, and a context meter shaped as a ripening mandarin; a third card returns the stock DeepSeek look with the plugin still installed.
description.zh: 轴伊 Joi 双衣装主题：Flowers 与 Library 是各自成套的明暗令牌体系，新会话页有立绘与趴在标题上的鲸鱼娘，输入框上方两只 Q 版角色随本回合状态换表情，侧栏字标换成二人合影，上下文占用由一颗渐熟的橘子表示；第三张卡可在保持插件安装的前提下切回 DeepSeek 原生外观。

description.en: Appearance customization for the DeepSeek Harness WebUI: theme palette, wallpaper and video backgrounds, translucency and glassmorphism.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观自定义:主题调色、壁纸与视频背景、半透明与毛玻璃。

description.en: Skin switcher for the dsh web UI: one-click theme switching with auto-discovery of community skins.
description.zh: 皮肤切换器：右上角一键切换主题，自动发现社区皮肤。

description.en: Interface and code typography, three-color themes, and named presets for DeepSeek Harness, tested on Windows Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供界面和代码字体、三色主题及命名外观方案；已在 Windows 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.5 验证。

description.en: Original CSS gold and purple glass theme with local avatar upload, crop controls, assistant naming and reading styles; no bundled game media. The package was renamed from dsh-glass-theme to dsh-glass-aurum because another author publishes an unrelated package under the old name; stop the old package before installing this one.
description.zh: 原创 CSS 金紫主题，支持本地头像上传与裁切、助手命名和阅读排版，不附带游戏素材。包名已从 dsh-glass-theme 改为 dsh-glass-aurum——旧名被另一位作者的无关插件占用；安装前请先停用旧包。

description.en: Client theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: a fluid background, frosted glass panels and quantised shader effects, with 100 adjustable parameters persisted to a JSON file.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 客户端主题插件：流体背景、毛玻璃面板与量子化着色器效果，100 项参数可调并持久化到 JSON 文件。

description.en: Whale-girl wallpaper background with a frosted semi-transparent app surface; customize image, opacity, and contain/cover from the Web settings, with remote image preflight and no-referrer loading.
description.zh: Web UI 鲸鱼娘壁纸背景，应用表面半透明磨砂；支持在设置页自定义图片、透明度与 contain/cover 铺放方式，远程图片自动预检并 no-referrer 加载。

description.en: One toggle makes the whole DeepSeek Harness shell translucent, with an opacity slider and a custom full-page background.
description.zh: 一键让整个 DeepSeek Harness 界面通透起来：透明度滑块随心调，背景图自由换。

description.en: Matrix-style binary (0/1) digital rain for the Harness interface: columns spawn only while a task is running, fall off screen when it stops, and leave a blank canvas; frosted-glass token layer with adjustable digit and panel opacity.
description.zh: 黑客帝国式二进制数字雨（字形只有 0 与 1）：仅任务运行时生成数字，任务停止后停止生成并让已有数字落出屏幕、画面归空；配磨砂玻璃 token 层，数字与面板透明度均可调。

description.en: Adds Amadeus-inspired light and dark colors and interface decorations.
description.zh: 添加 Amadeus 风格的浅色与深色配色及界面装饰。

description.en: Customize the interface font, size, weight, color and layout from the settings page, Word-style and WYSIWYG, auto-saved. Ships two bundled open-source fonts (STIX2Text, Latin Modern Mono Light) plus an author-recommended typography, and stores settings under ~/.dsh.
description.zh: 在设置页里像 Word 一样改界面字体、字号、加粗、颜色与版式，所见即所得、自动保存。自带两套开源字体（STIX2Text、Latin Modern Mono Light）与一套作者推荐排版，设置存在 ~/.dsh（换桌面外壳不丢）。

description.en: Sakura theme, companion notifications (approval/job/answer), message read-aloud, and voice settings for the DSH web GUI.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的樱花主题与陪伴功能：审批/任务/回答提醒、消息朗读、语音设置。

description.en: Taojian (陶笺): Claude-inspired DSH theme with warm paper, clay accent, Noto Serif SC, and Cascadia Mono.
description.zh: 陶笺：奶油纸浅色主题，陶橙强调色，界面思源宋，代码 Cascadia Mono。非官方，与 Anthropic、DeepSeek 无关。

description.en: Font switcher for the DSH Web GUI: 99 UI fonts and 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing stacks, instant apply and localStorage persistence.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 字体切换器：99 个界面字体与 31 个代码字体，中西文自动搭配，即选即生效，localStorage 持久化。

description.en: Capy-style ambient background for DSH with wallpaper, bottom black gradient, and composer aura.
description.zh: DSH 氛围背景插件，支持壁纸、底部深色渐变与输入框光晕。

description.en: Bloom Morandi theme: fifteen variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple, sage, stone, lapis, amber, aurora, lavender, mint, tangerine, silverrose, dawn, osmanthus) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even; twelve are featured in the top-bar switcher, grouped by color family, and all 30 foreground/background pairs are measured at WCAG AA or better.
description.zh: Bloom 莫兰迪主题：十五款变体（黛蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、桃夭 petal、天青 ripple、竹青 sage、赭石 stone、青金 lapis、琥珀 amber、落霞 aurora、青莲 lavender、草色 mint、橙黄 tangerine、银红 silverrose、粉霞 dawn、轻黄 osmanthus）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变；顶栏切换器精选 12 套并按色系相邻排列，每套配色右侧标出处诗句，30 组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。

description.en: Genshin Nicole PV wallpaper skin for the DSH web GUI — 14 subtitle-free frames rotate on a timed crossfade queue with pause and manual switching.
description.zh: 原神·尼可 PV 背景皮肤：14 张去字幕画面定时轮播淡入淡出，支持暂停与上一张/下一张切换。

description.en: Turns the local Wallpaper Engine library into the DSH GUI's live background — video and web wallpapers play for real behind the interface, while scene/application packages the browser cannot run are filtered out. A legibility veil samples wallpaper brightness and strengthens itself to keep text readable on any wallpaper; menus, dialogs and popups render as frosted glass while a wallpaper is active; manual zoom/pan/rotate framing, rotation lists, a resource monitor and a bilingual settings section round it out.
description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库变成 DSH 界面背后的动态背景——视频与网页壁纸真实播放,浏览器无法执行的场景/应用包被过滤。可读性遮罩采样壁纸亮度并自动加强,保证任意壁纸上文字可读;壁纸激活时菜单、弹窗与设置弹窗呈磨砂玻璃;支持缩放/平移/旋转取景、轮播列表、资源监控与中英双语设置分区。

description.en: A Neon Genesis Evangelion-inspired skin for DeepSeek Harness: Title Card (light) and Central Dogma (dark) modes over one removable override layer, 55 measured color tokens, a wallpaper paint layer whose two surface alphas are solved against a WCAG contrast budget, a boot mask and a brand mark. It also rewrites the sidebar identity line, replaces the new-session heading, hides six official entries, and reshapes the composer control row. Unofficial fan work, non-commercial: the background pictures are fetched from third-party URLs at paint time, not shipped in the repository.
description.zh: 基于《新世纪福音战士》的 DeepSeek Harness 皮肤：Title Card（亮色）与 Central Dogma（暗色）两套完整模式叠在一层可移除的覆盖层上，55 个实测色值，壁纸绘制层的两个表面 alpha 按 WCAG 对比度预算求解，另有开机遮罩与品牌标记。它还改写侧栏身份行、替换新会话页的标题、隐藏六处官方入口，并重排会话框控件行。非官方同人作品、非商业用途：背景图在绘制时从第三方 URL 拉取，不随仓库分发。

description.en: Animated wallpaper plugin with 8 canvas backgrounds (particles, meteors, starfield, waves, rain, bubbles, matrix, aurora) plus custom video import, and speed/density/opacity/blur sliders with localStorage persistence.
description.zh: 动态壁纸插件：8 种内置 Canvas 壁纸（粒子、流星雨、星际穿梭、波光、雨幕、气泡、字符雨、极光）加自定义视频背景，支持速度/密度/遮罩/模糊调节，配置持久化。

description.en: Animated background themes for the DSH desktop — 10 scene renderers (milky way, glow horizon, layered mountains, cloud dome, aurora ionosphere, black hole, cloud train, particle image, pixel sculpt, blinking squares), a wallpaper and video library, per-zone UI surface transparency, and a replica of the Appearance settings panel.
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面版换上动态背景——10 种场景渲染器（银河、辉光地平线、层峦、云穹、极光电离层、黑洞、云列车、粒子成像、像素雕塑、闪烁方块）、壁纸与视频素材库、UI 表面分区透明，外加逐像素复刻的 Appearance 设置面板。

description.en: Wallpaper skin for DeepSeek Harness: static images, video and generative gradients with five fit modes, blur/dim/contrast/saturation sliders, rotation and six transition styles. A spread mode carries the same artwork into the sidebar, panels, menus and window chrome instead of only the conversation canvas. It also samples the artwork on a 12x8 grid to derive WCAG-checked text colours and surface opacity, and annotates replies with colour only, never boxes.
description.zh: DSH 壁纸皮肤：静态图/视频/生成式渐变，五种适配方式，模糊暗化对比度饱和度滑条，自动轮播与六种切换过场；「全窗铺开」把同一张壁纸推进侧栏、面板、菜单与窗口标题栏，而不只是对话画布。另对壁纸做 12×8 网格采样，据 WCAG 推导文字颜色与底板透明度，标注只写颜色不产生方框。

description.en: Fifteen curated theme families and nine complete dsh-web-ui skin replicas in one plugin behind a single settings entry, with CSS-only custom theme JSON, controlled custom skin-pack import via folder picker, preview, apply, delete and restore-default. Ships on npm as `dsh-appearance-gallery`.
description.zh: 15 个精选主题家族 + 9 个完整 dsh-web-ui 皮肤复刻合并为单一插件、设置页单一入口，支持 CSS-only 自定义主题 JSON、受控自定义皮肤包导入（可直接选文件夹）、试穿、应用、删除与恢复默认。npm 包名 `dsh-appearance-gallery`。

description.en: Meteor-night wallpaper skin for DeepSeek Harness: a sharp full-window meteor picture, transparent sidebar and night-only ink.
description.zh: 流星夜色：整窗流星夜空壁纸、透明侧栏、夜间配色，桌面端与 dsh web 通用。

description.en: A switchable WebGPU black-hole theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI that retains the built-in Dark palette and animates only the new-session background.
description.zh: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的可切换 WebGPU 黑洞主题：沿用内置深色配色，仅在新会话页面显示动态背景。

plugins.name: dsh-Kinich-theme

description.en: Kinich and Ajaw theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with three visual styles, session-state feedback, companion interactions, and configurable ambient effects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Kinich 与 Ajaw 主题，提供三种视觉风格、会话状态反馈、伙伴交互和可配置的动态环境效果。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-Xiao-theme

description.en: Xiao character theme for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with light and dark palettes, selectable illustrations, a draggable companion, session-state feedback, and optional official DeepSeek balance display.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 与 Desktop 的魈角色主题，提供明暗配色、可切换立绘、可拖动伙伴、会话状态反馈及可选的官方 DeepSeek 余额展示。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Three switchable low-glare themes (Warm Paper, Sage Green, Warm Grey) for the DeepSeek Harness GUI, each a full alias-token layer with a light and a dark face.
description.zh: 三套可切换的低刺激护眼配色（暖纸、豆绿、暖灰），每套都是完整的别名 token 层，含浅色与深色两副面貌。

description.en: API key rotation pool for your LLM providers: auto-discovers providers from settings, per-provider multi-key round-robin, failover on 401/403/429, and cooldown recovery.
description.zh: 对话模型 API Key 轮换池：自动检测 settings 中的厂商，每个厂商下多 Key 轮询，401/403/429 自动切换，冷却恢复。

description.en: Outer Wilds theme with a static starfield, campfire effects, appearance settings, and bundled Jost and Source Han Sans fonts.
description.zh: 以《星际拓荒》为主题，提供静态星空、篝火动效、外观设置和内置 Jost 与思源黑体。

description.en: Wallpaper plus optional Liquid Glass islands for the DSH Web UI: Ice/Deepwater presets, import, wallpaper opacity, and per-island blur on official light/dark/system.
description.zh: DSH Web 液态玻璃皮肤：冰原/深水壁纸、可导入、壁纸透明度，以及叠在官方浅色/深色/跟随系统上的分岛模糊。

description.en: Codex-style dark interface for DSH on Windows, with navigation, project and conversation sidebars, and model and reasoning controls.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 Codex 风格深色界面，包含导航、项目与会话侧栏、模型和思考强度控件。

description.en: Twenty-one fruit themes with original palettes and pixel fruit sprites for the DeepSeek Harness web client, including a settings gallery and an in-session style switcher.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端提供 21 套水果主题（原创配色与像素水果），含设置页画廊与会话内换肤入口。

description.en: Seaglass is a highly customizable glassmorphism theme.
description.zh: Seaglass是一个高自由度的玻璃质感主题。

description.en: UI theme customizer, acrylic frosted glass, and panoramic live video/wallpapers for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 专为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 UI 个性化配色、毛玻璃拟态与全景壁纸/动态视频外观定制插件。

description.en: 2005-era instant-messenger skin for the DeepSeek Harness client: right-angle 1px window chrome, a blue-gradient title bar, SimSun for the Chinese UI, a buddy-group sidebar with an avatar card and editable signature, per-message name/time headers, and three switchable intensities. All artwork is original SVG; the reskinned toolbar also carries a cross-session notepad, a running-session panel, and an 8-ball game, minesweeper, a token garden and heads-up poker that a built-in focus mode silences.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 客户端的 2005 年代即时通讯皮肤：直角 1px 窗框、蓝色渐变标题条、中文界面统一宋体、好友分组式侧栏（含头像档案卡与可编辑签名）、每条消息带名字与时间抬头，皮肤档位三档可实时切换。美术全部为原创 SVG；重绘后的工具条另带跨会话备注框、后台任务面板，以及美式八球、扫雷、Token 农场和德州扑克——插件内置的专注模式会把它们静音。

description.en: Song-dynasty-inspired theme for the DSH web UI: a light "rice paper" and a dark "night ink" variant, Ru celadon carrying interactive states while kiln copper is reserved for blockquotes, plus a 4pt spacing scale and a 46-glyph mask icon set.
description.zh: 宋律 Songgrid —— 宋代美学主题，宣纸（浅）与夜墨（深）双变体；汝窑天青承担交互态、窑铜只用于引用块；另附 4pt 间距阶与 46 个 mask 图标。

description.en: Path to Nowhere MBCC dossier theme for DSH, with dark and light palettes, a boot splash, a balance capsule and a settings panel.
description.zh: 无期迷途 MBCC 档案风 DSH 主题：深浅两套色板、开屏动画、余额胶囊与设置面板。

description.en: Chat wallpaper: use a local image, a local video or one of six preset gradients as the chat background, with clarity, opacity, zoom, position, dark veil, fit mode, motion and glass panels; files stay in IndexedDB and nothing is uploaded.
description.zh: 聊天壁纸：用本地图片、本地视频或六套预设渐变做聊天背景，可调清晰度、透明度、缩放、位置、暗色遮罩、显示方式、动效与玻璃面板；文件只存在浏览器 IndexedDB，不上传。

description.en: Generative aurora wallpaper for the Harness web UI: 13 palettes, adjustable breathing and motion, and a local photo or video as the backdrop.
description.zh: 给 Harness 网页界面加一层生成式极光壁纸：13 套配色、呼吸与流动可调，也能用本地图片或视频当壁纸。

description.en: Local-folder wallpaper for the DSH Web UI: it defaults to your Pictures library (C:\Users\<you>\Pictures) and the host serves those images over same-origin HTTP, rotating one every N minutes (0-1440, default 5) in a shuffled pass with no repeats; the settings page under Plugins picks a different folder through the native system dialog, and tunes image opacity (100%), darkening scrim (25%) and panel opacity (15%) with changes applied live. Dialogs, modals and menus keep the default opaque background so text stays readable. Reads .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif .avif .bmp straight from disk, and keeps per-user settings under $DSH_HOME so upgrades never ship your folder path.
description.zh: 用本地文件夹当 DSH Web 壁纸：默认就用当前用户的「图片」库（C:\Users\<用户名>\Pictures），宿主通过同源 HTTP 提供其中的图片，每 N 分钟轮换一张（0-1440，默认 5），洗牌后一轮内不重复；「插件」页的设置界面可用系统原生文件夹对话框换目录，并可调节背景图不透明度（100%）、压暗遮罩（25%）与面板不透明度（15%），改动即时生效。弹窗、对话框与菜单保持默认不透明底色，字更清楚。直接读取 .jpg .jpeg .png .webp .gif .avif .bmp，用户配置写入 $DSH_HOME，升级不会带上你的目录路径。

description.en: Web appearance suite with a 7-theme gallery (each a full 122-token --dsw-* mapping) plus one-click switching persisted in settings, Material You wallpaper color extraction that generates a whole dynamic palette, and a global corner-radius control. Themes ride on the official look system as override layers instead of fighting it, so the official light/dark/auto row stays valid. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
description.zh: Web 外观定制套件：7 套主题画廊（每套 122 个 --dsw-* token 全量映射）+ 设置页一键切换并持久化，Material You 壁纸取色一键生成整套动态配色（可导出 MD3 令牌），另带全局圆角三档。主题以官方 overrideTokens 覆盖层叠加在官方亮/暗之上，官方外观行永远合法可用。已归档并冻结在固定版本：作者不再为它适配新版 DSH。

plugins.name: dsh-theme-endfield

description.en: Arknights: Endfield industrial-editorial theme for the DSH Web UI: cream paper, ink text, zero border radius, two switchable accent palettes (signal yellow / teal-cyan), plus optional marching-squares contour background, ENDFIELD watermark and boot progress plate.
description.zh: 《明日方舟：终末地》工业编辑风主题：奶油纸底、墨黑文字、全局直角，两套强调色配色（谷地黄信号黄 / 武陵青青碧色）可在设置切换，另有可选的等高线地形背景、ENDFIELD 水印与启动加载屏。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Unofficial Asuka-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness with dual character illustrations, day and night city-dome backdrops, and five appearance settings covering mode, backdrop, character position, backdrop intensity, and character size.
description.zh: 非官方明日香主题皮肤：双人物精绘立绘、城市穹顶日夜背景，含表现方式、穹顶背景开关、立绘位置、背景强度和人物大小五项设置。

description.en: Syncs the wallpaper currently applied in Wallpaper Engine to the DSH Web UI background through a local bridge: preview/capture/full render modes, monitor lock, a wallpaper library panel for local and market content, focus lens with eye tracking, immersive mode, and a Windows app launcher that installs software from direct links or a cloud-drive share link and starts it with one click.
description.zh: 把 Wallpaper Engine 当前应用的壁纸经本地桥接同步为 DSH Web 界面背景：预览/捕获/完整三档渲染、显示器锁定、本地与市场壁纸库面板、专注透镜与眼动追踪、沉浸模式，以及支持直链与网盘分享链接安装、一键启动的 Windows 应用启动器。

description.en: Five warm, low blue-light color themes that retint the whole DSH interface, including the sidebar, popups and shadows, without touching layout.
description.zh: 五套低蓝光暖色配色，整体重着色 DSH 界面（含侧栏、浮层与阴影），零布局改动，卸载即还原。

description.en: Ocean-blue theme for the DSH web interface: swimming fish, rising bubbles, a daily-quote ticker above the input box, and a replacement brand area; Settings → Marine Theme exposes 7 groups and 32 options (brand text and size, badge, primary color, watermark, fish, quotes, overall scale) that apply instantly without a reload, plus a two-step reset to defaults.
description.zh: 海洋蓝主题：游动鱼群、上升气泡、输入框上方的「每日鱼语」，以及左上角品牌区替换；「设置 → 海洋主题」提供 7 组 32 项可调（品牌文字与字号、徽章、主色、水印、鱼群、语录、整体缩放），改动即时生效无需刷新，并带二次确认的一键恢复默认。

description.en: Transparent acrylic window material and layered frosted panels for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: the window reveals the desktop wallpaper (Windows Acrylic supplies the blur), the composer is a pane of frosted glass, and chat text is hard-clipped at the composer's top edge. Note: the page styling installs with the plugin, but making the window itself transparent needs a one-time app.asar patch (the patch bundle in this repo's Releases; double-click enable-transparency.cmd). The patch takes effect after a restart and must be re-applied after every DSH update. The plugin works without it — the window simply stays opaque.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版提供透明亚克力窗口材质与分层雾面面板：窗口透出桌面壁纸（模糊由 Windows Acrylic 负责），输入栏是一块毛玻璃，聊天文字在输入栏上沿硬裁切。注意：页面样式随插件安装，但「窗口透出壁纸」需要额外运行一次 app.asar 补丁脚本（仓库 Releases 里的补丁包，双击 enable-transparency.cmd），补丁重启后生效，DSH 更新后需重打。只装插件也能用，只是窗口保持不透明。

description.en: Renders Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers in real time in the browser (three.js player plus a Rust/WASM CPU particle simulation) and plays video and web wallpapers, falling back to the preview image, with no Wallpaper Engine runtime required. Scans the local Steam workshop library (431960) by auto-detection or a manual path, and offers a settings panel for wallpaper selection, library and engine directories, glow, pause and quality.
description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸放到 dsh Web 界面背后：scene 壁纸在浏览器内实时渲染（three.js 播放器 + Rust/WASM CPU 粒子模拟），视频与 web 壁纸原样播放，其余回退 preview 图，不需要安装 Wallpaper Engine 运行时。壁纸库从 Steam 创意工坊目录（431960）自动探测或手动指定，设置面板可选壁纸、配壁纸库与引擎目录、调光晕与暂停/画质。

description.en: (UI enhancement) Frosted-glass background for the whole app: one slider blends from a genuinely blurred, milky frost to a fully transparent page, and every region, control and expanded page moves as a single sheet painted on body::before; the settings page has its own independent slider, and an optional whale particle overlay reacts to the pointer. In a browser the plugin paints its own dark backdrop behind the frost. On the desktop the effect is painted on the app window itself: the dsh Windows window has never been transparent (only macOS gets a vibrancy window), so on Windows the page shows the window background instead of your wallpaper, while macOS keeps the native transparent window. Works on every dsh version (checked up to 0.2.2-alpha.3).
description.zh: （UI 增强）整页磨砂背景：一条滑杆从真实模糊的磨砂过渡到完全透明，所有区域、组件与展开面板作为画在 body::before 上的同一张纸一起变化；设置页有独立滑杆，另有可选的鲸鱼粒子图层，随鼠标推开与拖动。浏览器里插件会自绘一层深色背景垫在磨砂之下。桌面端的效果直接画在应用窗口上：dsh 的 Windows 主窗口历来不透明（只有 macOS 才有 vibrancy 透明窗口），所以 Windows 上看到的是窗口自身的底色而不是你的壁纸，macOS 则仍是原生透明窗口。适用于所有 dsh 版本（已核对到 0.2.2-alpha.3）。

description.en: Whale-maid theme for DSH desktop and Web UI with light and dark palettes, ocean illustrations, hand-drawn frames, and a native Windows companion.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端与 Web UI 鲸鱼女仆主题，提供亮暗配色、海洋插画、手绘边框和 Windows 原生桌宠。

description.en: Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 设置和侧边栏自动分配并支持自定义的 Fluent 风格图标，离线内置 SVG，默认保留插件原图标。

description.en: Sakura-afternoon pastel skin for the DSH Web UI: light and dark sakura token palettes, a click-through falling-petal overlay with a soft vignette, a header petal toggle and a General-settings master switch.
description.zh: 樱色午后主题皮肤：浅色/深色各配一套柔和的樱色令牌配色，全屏飘落樱瓣与柔光晕（点击穿透），会话头部的樱瓣开关与「通用设置」里的皮肤总开关。

description.en: Character skins with an editable decoration board — Yukino warm daily and occult editorial themes, each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor, custom asset upload, and shareable diorama packs (assets + layout bundled).
description.zh: 角色皮肤舞台：雪乃·暖阳日常与隐秘年代志双主题，各带双角色立绘与表情贴纸；可视化装饰看板支持拖动/缩放/旋转/坐标精调/锚定切换/上传素材，装饰包（素材+布局）可导出分享、导入后自动打开看板继续调整。

description.en: ShaderToy backgrounds for DeepSeek Harness: a WebGL2 player with a background library and five bundled presets, adjustable opacity, brightness, resolution and frame rate, playback options, and an in-app editor for the running shader.
description.zh: 把 ShaderToy 作品作为 DeepSeek Harness 背景：WebGL2 播放器 + 背景库（含 5 个预设），可调界面不透明度、亮度、分辨率与帧率，支持画面循环与音乐播放设置，并能在设置页直接编辑当前着色器代码。

description.en: Deep-sea tidal-blue theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web client with a single accent color and matte (non-glass) surfaces in light and dark modes. Same-token UI additions: a single-line dock HUD reading real session projections (context usage vs. window, TPS, cache-hit rate, elapsed time), per-turn subagent delegation cards showing token usage and an optional cost estimate from OpenRouter public prices, sidebar pagination with pinned sections and type-to-filter, and model / reasoning-effort / permission controls under the composer. Each addition can be toggled in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 的深海潮汐蓝主题：单一强调色、磨砂（非玻璃）材质，明暗双态一致。同套令牌下的界面增强：单行底栏 HUD（读取真实会话投影的上下文占用与上限、TPS、缓存命中率、耗时）、按回合绘制的子代理委派卡片（显示 token 用量，并可附上按 OpenRouter 公开单价估算的金额）、侧栏分页与置顶小节加实时筛选、输入框下方的模型/思考等级/权限控件，每项均可在插件设置中单独开关。

description.en: Reskins the whole app from a sidebar panel with five skins — pixel arcade, midnight terminal, neon cyber, paper study and aurora glass — changing the palette, type and texture, with one click to restore the default look.
description.zh: 从侧边栏面板用五套皮肤换掉整个应用的配色、字体与质感——像素街机、午夜终端、霓虹赛博、纸感书房、极光玻璃——一键恢复默认外观。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme (component-override edition): an official-mechanism client theme that stacks a cream-paper alias-token layer, stitched pixel font and valley wallpaper over the intact official React UI. npm: dsh-theme-stardew-valley.
description.zh: 星露谷物语主题·组件替换版：走 dsh 官方客户端主题机制，在完整保留的官方 React UI 上叠加奶油纸面 alias token 层、缝合像素字体与山谷壁纸。npm 包名 dsh-theme-stardew-valley。

description.en: Stardew Valley theme (full-skin edition) for the dsh web UI only: replaces the served web frontend with a self-contained pixel-farm interface — Junimo dialog, farm-select presets, quest journal HUD, session-as-day valley calendar, chiptune SFX and desktop pets. Not available in the desktop window and not compatible with other UI-changing plugins.
description.zh: 星露谷物语主题·整皮版，仅适用于 dsh Web 界面：把 Web 前端整体换成自包含的像素农场界面——祝尼魔对话、农场选预设、任务日志 HUD、会话即游戏日的山谷日历、8-bit 音效与桌宠。不支持桌面原生窗口，请勿与其他会改变 UI 的插件同时启用。

description.en: Four-palette pixel-art skin for DSH Web (wood, parchment, warm, terminal green) with a bundled CJK pixel font served by the plugin's own host route, and a flat, shadow-free look.
description.zh: 四套配色的像素风 DSH Web 皮肤（木屋/羊皮纸/暖阳/终端绿）；中文像素字体由插件自身的 host 路由发货；完全平面、无阴影。

description.en: 🐱 Catppuccin theme plugin: the lively, relaxing official 26-color pastel palette — 🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha — with one-click switching; the whole UI is tinted from the palette and hover interactions glow in the theme accent.
description.zh: 🐱 Catppuccin 主题插件：充满活力、令人放松的柔和彩色主题。遵循官方 26 色粉彩盘，🌻 Latte / 🪴 Frappé / 🌺 Macchiato / 🌿 Mocha 四档一键切换，全界面按色盘上色，鼠标滑过交互变主题色。

description.en: Font system plugin: OFL webfont presets served offline from the plugin, user-imported custom woff2 fonts, and a ctx.fonts registry other plugins can extend.
description.zh: 字体系统插件：随插件离线分发的 OFL 开源字体预设、自定义 woff2 字体导入，以及供其他插件扩展的 ctx.fonts 注册表。

description.en: Solarized theme plugin: the classic low-contrast, eye-friendly dual palette system — Ethan Schoonover's Solarized plus Selenized (its refined take), dark and light each, built for long sessions with canonical syntax colors.
description.zh: Solarized 主题插件：经典低对比护眼配色双体系——Ethan Schoonover 的 Solarized 与 Selenized（改良版）深浅各一套，专为长时间使用设计，遵循经典语法色。

description.en: A coastal theme for official macOS DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2, with animated clouds, local waves, swaying foreground plants and Chinese settings.
description.zh: 适用于官方 macOS DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的海边主题，提供动态云层、局部海浪、前景花草摆动和中文设置。

description.en: Whale Girl light theme for the DSH Web UI, ported from a DreamSkin skin package: a full native --dsw-* token remap, the artwork as an ambient wallpaper behind a single light paper layer, and live controls for glass strength, conversation-only paper, wallpaper veil/focus/zoom and the composer focus glow, with a bilingual settings form on the installed-package page. Visual identity: 溟月 by 上善无形 → DeepSeek maid ver. by ZipZipPipe; artwork CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, code MIT.
description.zh: 移植自 DreamSkin 皮肤包的 DSH Web UI 鲸鱼娘亮色主题：完整重映射原生 --dsw-* 令牌，插画作为环境壁纸衬在单层轻纸面之后，玻璃强度、对话区独立纸面、壁纸遮罩/焦点/缩放与输入框聚焦光晕均可实时调节，设置表单以中英双语呈现在已安装插件详情页。视觉定型：溟月（上善无形）→ DeepSeek 女仆装（ZipZipPipe）；插画 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，代码 MIT。

description.en: Aqua glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: adjustable blur and frost, a fluid or image/video wallpaper, unified corners and motion, and font family, size and colour controls — switching it off restores the stock UI. Continues the Aqua theme by WYH66666666 (DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin v1.3.0); do not install alongside the upstream.
description.zh: Aqua 玻璃主题：可调模糊与磨砂、流体或图片/视频壁纸、统一圆角与动效、字体字号与文字配色，关掉即还原原生界面。承接 WYH66666666 的 Aqua 主题（DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin v1.3.0），请勿与上游同装。

description.en: Pokémon-style skin for DSH Web with GBA frames, HP-bar status, effort level panel, and customizable color palettes.
description.zh: 宝可梦风格 DSH Web 皮肤，含 GBA 双边框、HP 条状态、推理等级面板与可自定义配色。

plugins.name: dsh-oh-my-theme

description.en: Web theme and file workspace plugin with global typography controls, @file mentions, a project file tree, Markdown preview, and a resizable side panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 主题与文件工作台：全局字体设置、@ 文件引用、项目文件树、Markdown 预览和可拖拽侧边面板。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Warm light and dark theme for DSH Web with responsive layout, bilingual settings, safe Markdown preview, per-block copy controls, and no telemetry.
