description.zh: DSH Web 暖中性色明暗主题，支持响应式布局、双语设置、安全 Markdown 预览、内容块复制与无遥测运行。

plugins.name: dsh-claude-desktop-theme

description.en: Claude Code Desktop-style theme for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with compact sidebar and chat layouts, light and dark themes, model and reasoning-effort controls, and an interactive pixel whale with spout, hop and tail-wag reactions on new sessions.
description.zh: 面向 macOS 与 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的 Claude Code Desktop 风格主题，提供紧凑侧栏与会话布局、浅色与深色主题、模型与推理强度控件，以及支持随机喷水、轻弹和摆尾互动的新会话页像素小鲸鱼。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Fantasy glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web UI: a moonlit nether-forest scene with drifting teal clouds, red spider lilies spreading from the lower-left and a sleeping cat in the corner, drawn over a WebGL2 fluid background with its own wallpaper and video backgrounds. Ships two switchable variants (pale / saturated blue), plus cat-paw, fish, bubble and starlight decorations. One switch restores the stock interface exactly.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面打造的奇幻玻璃拟态皮肤：月光冥界森林，青绿流云缓缓翻涌、绯红彼岸花自左下蔓延、角落里趴着一只睡猫，底层是 WebGL2 流体；另有自定义壁纸与视频背景。内置两套可一键切换的风格（淡雅 / 蓝色），并有猫爪、小鱼、泡泡、星光装饰。一个开关即可完全还原原生界面。

description.en: Five palettes for DeepSeek Harness — mono, warm sand, indigo, moss and a custom three-colour palette — each rebuilt in OKLCH for light and dark, with text and surface contrast solved per palette. Includes config export/import codes and a high-contrast mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的五套配色（黑白、暖砂、靛蓝、苔绿、自定义三色），明暗两模式各自用 OKLCH 重算整条色阶，并按配色求解文字与承载面的对比度；附配置导入导出短码与高对比档。

description.en: Browse, search, install, and apply VS Code color themes to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: bundles 14 curated themes with live color-swatch previews, searches the official VS Code Marketplace for more, and one-click installs map any theme's palette onto the DSW design tokens with live switching and persisted selection.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中浏览、搜索、安装并应用 VS Code 配色主题：内置 14 款精选主题并带实时色卡预览，可搜索官方 VS Code 插件市场安装更多主题，一键安装会把任意主题的调色板映射到 DSW 设计令牌，支持实时切换与选择持久化。

description.en: Coastal light and dark palette for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, built as a token-only ThemeRuntime overlay covering all 107 official alias tokens.
description.zh: 海岸线明暗双色主题，只通过 ThemeRuntime 的 token 层叠加，覆盖全部 107 个官方 alias token。

description.en: Declares per-model reasoning-effort ladders for third-party providers in the llm-pi-ai settings section, so DSH's stock thinking-intensity selector works on models the pi-ai catalog does not describe.
description.zh: 在 llm-pi-ai 设置节为第三方模型提供商补齐推理档位（reasoning effort）声明，让 DSH 自带的思考强度选择器对 pi-ai 目录之外的模型真正可用。

description.en: Fills missing context window, max tokens, thinking levels, and image input on custom DSH models from models.dev, and lists unmatched models for manual edits.
description.zh: 按模型名从 models.dev 补全自定义模型缺失的上下文、输出上限、思考档位和图片能力，并列出未匹配模型供手改。

description.en: Registers local Qoder, QoderCN, OpenCode, Pi and CodeBuddy CLIs as DSH subagent backends, with ordered model fallback, live progress, per-run credit display, a settings page, and slash commands. Requires the corresponding CLI installed and logged in.
description.zh: 把本机 Qoder、QoderCN、OpenCode、Pi、CodeBuddy 等 CLI 注册为 DSH 子代理后端，支持模型故障转移链、实时进度、单次额度显示、设置页与斜杠指令。需先安装并登录对应 CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-adapter

description.en: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness with no API key, tracking Zen gateway changes.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key，并跟踪网关兼容性。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to ip-api.com

description.en: Huawei Cloud CodeArts provider for DeepSeek Harness with OAuth2 PKCE/DPoP sign-in, multi-account rotation, model discovery, and credits and usage views. A derivative of elegant01/dsh-codearts (MIT) with added account and image features; do not install it alongside the upstream - both register the same `codearts` provider.
description.zh: 华为云 CodeArts 的 DeepSeek Harness 接入插件：内置 OAuth2（PKCE + DPoP）登录、多账号轮转、模型发现，以及积分与用量查看。本项目是 elegant01/dsh-codearts（MIT）的衍生版，补充了账号与图片相关能力；请勿与上游同时安装——两者注册同一个 `codearts` provider。

description.en: Registers the models bundled with the Xunfei Loomy desktop app as a `loomy` provider in DSH, reading the app's local sign-in session instead of an API key. Fork of gdrpzym/dsh-loomy-connect adapted to DSH 0.2.1, adding a per-model enable/disable switch. Requires the Loomy desktop app installed and signed in; it cannot be installed alongside gdrpzym/dsh-loomy-connect because both register the same `loomy` provider.
description.zh: 把讯飞 Loomy 桌面端内置的模型注册为 DSH 的 `loomy` 供应商，读取该应用的本地登录态而不使用 API Key。是 gdrpzym/dsh-loomy-connect 适配 DSH 0.2.1 的派生版本，新增逐模型启用/禁用开关。需本机安装并登录讯飞 Loomy 桌面端；与 gdrpzym/dsh-loomy-connect 注册同一个 `loomy` 供应商，不能同装。

description.en: Registers the Xunfei Loomy cloud channel as an OpenAI-compatible supplier in dsh-router, adding model listing and streaming chat completions.
description.zh: 把讯飞 Loomy 云端通道作为 OpenAI 兼容供应商接入 dsh-router，提供模型列表与流式对话补全。

description.en: Pools every WorkBuddy account signed in on this machine into one auto-failing-over provider, serving OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages from the same pool, with model aliases, usage statistics and scheduled credit automation.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号汇成一个自动故障转移的模型池，同一池子对外提供 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 三种协议，并支持模型别名、用量统计与积分自动化。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek models in dsh through an OpenCode Go subscription and falls back to the DeepSeek account per model when that model's allowance runs out; a plan-wide fallback covers bad credentials.
description.zh: 让 dsh 里的 DeepSeek 模型优先走 OpenCode Go 套餐额度，额度耗尽时只把该模型切回 DeepSeek 账户，其它模型继续用套餐；凭证异常等整体失败时整体回退。

description.en: Retry failed model requests automatically: intercepts every request error and replays the same step after a 2s / 5s / 10s / 20s backoff ladder, so gateway blips and rate limits no longer end the turn.
description.zh: 模型请求失败自动重试：拦截每一次请求错误，按 2/5/10/20 秒的阶梯退避后重放同一个 step，中转站抖动与限流不再中断整轮对话。

description.en: Derivative of dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model (do not install both): routes subagent delegations by role with candidate pools, cross-provider failover and fork window slicing; shows running subagents in a header panel with duration and token counts; supports mid-run and batch model switching and exposes routing tools the model can call.
description.zh: 基于 dingminhua/dsh-subagent-default-model 的衍生作品（不要与上游同装）：按角色为子代理派发选路由，带候补池、跨供应商故障转移与 fork 活跃窗口切片；标题栏显示正在运行的子代理及其时长与 token；支持运行中与批量换模型，并给模型提供可调用的路由工具。

description.en: Model channel auto-enricher for DeepSeek Harness: eliminates manually configuring contextWindow, maxTokens, \[text, image] multimodal input, and {low, high, max} reasoning effort tiers model by model after adding a provider channel, with live auto-enrichment on save, a Settings UI page, and timestamped backups.
description.zh: DSH 模型补齐助手：解决添加新渠道后还要把几十个模型一个个手动点开调百万上下文、调最大输出、勾多模态发图（\[text, image]）、配思考强度档位（{low, high, max}）的繁琐痛点，支持设置页添加模型保存后自动补齐与可视化一键补齐。

plugins.name: dsh-teleagent-pool

description.en: Registers two LLM account pools as model providers: TeleAgent (China Telecom TeleAI; paste a token once) with a daily 09:00 UTC+8 full-pool check-in — currently check-in, balances and model listing only, since its chat is blocked by the client signing key — and AutoClaw (Zhipu desktop, Windows), whose tokens are decrypted from the local DPAPI-protected credential store and whose chat streams through the desktop bridge. Both pools report credit balances and model catalogs; quota-triggered failover across local desktop instances is automatic, while switching the AutoClaw account is an opt-in setting (off by default). Panels ship in settings and the left sidebar.
description.zh: 把两个 LLM 账号池注册为模型提供方：TeleAgent（中国电信天翼 AI 星辰超级智能体，需手工粘贴一次 token）支持每天 09:00（UTC+8）全量自动签到，目前提供签到、余额与模型目录，对话仍被客户端签名密钥挡住；AutoClaw（智谱桌面端，Windows）的 token 由本机 DPAPI 保护的凭据解出，对话经桌面端桥接流式返回。两个号池都能查询积分余额与模型目录；额度耗尽时会自动在本地桌面端实例之间转移，切换 AutoClaw 账号则需在设置中开启（默认关闭）。设置页与左侧边栏均有面板。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds six AI coding platforms to DSH — OpenCode, Qoder, Qoder CN, TRAE, WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy International — each as its own group in the native model picker, and manages their accounts from one settings page, with daily check-in where the platform has one, credit balance lookups, and retry on another account of the same platform when one is rate-limited. Models carry their credit multiplier where the platform declares one. OpenCode's anonymous free tier works with no credential, and TRAE stays hidden by default until it is enabled in the settings.
description.zh: 把六个 AI 编程平台接进 DSH——OpenCode、Qoder、Qoder CN、TRAE、WorkBuddy 与国际版——每个平台在原生模型选择器里各自成组；在一个设置页里统一管理账号，平台有签到接口就每日签到、可查积分余额，账号被限流时自动改用同平台其它账号。平台声明了积分倍率的模型会标注倍率。OpenCode 匿名免费层无需任何凭证；TRAE 默认隐藏，在设置里启用后才出现。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-opencode-go

description.en: OpenCode Go in the DeepSeek Harness model list, providing subscription quota display, model discovery, session affinity, and more.
description.zh: 把OpenCode Go接入DSH的模型列表，提供订阅额度显示、模型发现、会话亲和等功能。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Multi-model deliberation pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: independent proposals, blind peer review, program-executed evidence verification, immutable revision and independent acceptance on a fresh context.
description.zh: DSH 多模型协作研讨插件：独立提案、互审、证据核验、完整稿修订与新上下文验收。

description.en: OpenCode Console (Zen) models for DeepSeek Harness: paste a Console API key under Settings → Plugins and the Console's chat models become selectable, with the catalog synced automatically, each model routed to the endpoint the official docs assign, and free *-free models hidden by default because they only run inside the OpenCode client.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console (Zen) 模型：在「设置 → 插件」填入 Console API Key 后即可选用 Console 的对话模型，模型目录自动同步，每个模型按官方文档路由到对应端点，免费 *-free 模型默认不列出（它们只能在 OpenCode 客户端内运行）。

description.en: Mirrors cc-switch providers and models into DeepSeek Harness the moment they are saved, and shows each provider's plan windows, account balance, or custom usage script in the composer and the settings card.
description.zh: 把 cc-switch 的供应商与模型在保存的瞬间镜像进 DSH，并在输入框和设置卡片里显示各供应商的套餐窗口、账户余额或自定义用量脚本的结果。

description.en: Unofficial Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth integration with isolated account storage; carries account-ban risk.
description.zh: 提供独立账户存储的非官方 Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth 接入，存在封号风险。

description.en: Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes.
description.zh: 提供由 Lead 规划与审查、Sidekick 执行代码修改的组合模型线路。

description.en: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.
description.zh: 通过 Pi 适配器接入订阅 OAuth 和厂商 Plan API Key 登录，使用独立的 DSH 凭据存储。

plugins.name: dsh-openai-oauth

description.en: Connect a ChatGPT account to Codex models in DeepSeek Harness through browser PKCE or device-code OAuth, with automatic token refresh and Web or headless login.
description.zh: 通过浏览器 PKCE 或设备码 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 账户接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 模型，并支持自动刷新令牌以及 Web 或无头登录。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-models-dev-reasoning

description.en: Adds models.dev reasoning levels to unconfigured third-party DeepSeek Harness models.
description.zh: 为未配置的第三方 DeepSeek Harness 模型添加 models.dev 推理级别支持。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: One-click free-model setup for DSH web, built for coding beginners: one-click installer for Windows (install.bat) and macOS/Linux (install.sh, v1.7.0+); four permanently free channels — Zhipu GLM (text + image), SiliconFlow (Qwen3-8B plus 15+ sub-9B models), iFlytek Spark Lite and the OpenRouter free pool, which routes through openrouter/auto and picks from a pool that changes over time; bottom-left setup hint hides once any free model is connected; real-time DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reminder; bundled beginner help center.
description.zh: DSH Web 小白零门槛零费用套件：一键安装支持 Windows（install.bat）和 macOS/Linux（install.sh，v1.7.0 起）；一键接入四款永久免费渠道——智谱 GLM（文本+图片）、硅基流动（Qwen3-8B 及 15+ 款 9B 以下小模型）、讯飞星火 Lite，以及 OpenRouter 免费池（一个 Key，经 openrouter/auto 自动挑选，池内模型随时变化）；接入任一免费模型后左下角配置提示自动隐藏；含 DeepSeek 计价时段提醒、内置新手帮助中心。

description.en: Provider-first model picker for the composer. Every provider is listed in the left rail and its models in the right pane. Providers, models within a provider, and pins reorder by drag or Alt+Arrow; providers take a local display alias; one provider can be the panel default; a model's reasoning levels expand inline; search matches model names, provider names and aliases. Switching goes through the shipped model directory service, so the /model popup and this panel always agree.
description.zh: 输入框里的供应商优先模型选择器：左栏列出全部供应商，右栏列出选中供应商的模型。供应商、组内模型与收藏都可用拖拽或 Alt+方向键排序；可给供应商起本地显示别名、可指定面板默认供应商；推理档位内联展开；搜索同时匹配模型名、供应商名与别名。切换走官方模型目录服务，/model 弹窗与面板始终一致。

plugins.name: dsh-model

description.en: One authenticated OpenAI-compatible endpoint (built on CLIProxyAPI) for dsh and other tools: gathers WorkBuddy, OpenCode Zen, local Ollama / LM Studio and CLI subscriptions such as Codex and Kimi, signs in from the dsh page without installing their CLIs, and syncs the picked models into dsh grouped by source. The settings page has a switch per source with free / paid tags, plan usage, API keys with 24-hour stats, per-source model picking, and update / uninstall. Runs on macOS, Linux (including next to dsh-vps) and Windows.
description.zh: 为 dsh 和其他软件提供一个带鉴权的 OpenAI 兼容地址（基于 CLIProxyAPI）：汇集 WorkBuddy、OpenCode Zen、本机 Ollama / LM Studio，以及 Codex、Kimi 等 CLI 订阅；在 dsh 页面上登录，不用装各家 CLI；挑选的模型按来源分组同步进 dsh。设置页提供每个来源的开关和免费 / 付费标签、套餐用量、带 24 小时统计的 API key、按来源挑选模型，以及更新和卸载。支持 macOS、Linux（含与 dsh-vps 同机部署）和 Windows。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 1.1.1.1 for network access

description.en: Drop-in successor to the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect, keeping its package name, config row id and provider ids so an existing install upgrades in place. Also fixes the 400/11128 channel check by neutralising the DSH identity sentences and scrubbing the product name from system messages, and reads the real Windows client and bundled CLI versions instead of a compiled constant, unlike the functy and community forks. Verified 2026-10-21 on Windows, WorkBuddy 5.8.3, DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 已 404 的 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect 的原地接管版，沿用原来的包名、配置行 id 与 provider id，已装用户可直接升级。同时修复 400/11128 渠道校验（归一化 DSH 身份句并清除 system 消息中的产品名），并改为读取真实的 Windows 客户端与内置 CLI 版本，不再使用编译常量，这一点与 functy、community 两个分叉不同。验证环境（2026-10-21）：Windows、WorkBuddy 5.8.3、DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

plugins.name: dockyard-dsh

description.en: Native account-pool and provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness on macOS: official browser OAuth plus provider-native transports for those plus WorkBuddy and Command Code, with live model catalogs, Antigravity browser OAuth needs your own DOCKYARD_ANTIGRAVITY_CLIENT_ID and DOCKYARD_ANTIGRAVITY_CLIENT_SECRET, plan and quota windows, and manual, sticky-session, round-robin or failover account selection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 原生账号池与 Provider 插件：Codex、Antigravity、Grok、Claude 与 Cursor 支持官方浏览器 OAuth，这些 Provider 与 WorkBuddy、Command Code 均走原生请求链路；读取实时模型目录、套餐与额度窗口，并支持手动、sticky session、轮询与 failover 账号选择。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-ark-coding-provider

description.en: Unofficial Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider: registers an `ark-coding` route with 12 models (capacity facts measured per model), multi-account with automatic rotation, a bundled pinned arkcli for the official model catalog and live plan quota, plus a settings wizard and a sidebar usage card.
description.zh: 非官方火山方舟 Coding Plan 模型接入插件：注册 `ark-coding` 路由，12 个模型的容量事实逐项实测，多账户自动轮换，内置钉版 arkcli 拉官方模型目录与真实套餐额度，含设置向导与侧边栏用量卡片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Uses Z.ai / ZCode Start Plan quota inside DeepSeek Harness as a GLM model provider (GLM-5.3-Flash, GLM-5.3) with tool calling and reasoning levels; the settings page shows quota bars, gifted-plan claiming, refresh opportunities and a redacted request log. Requires the ZCode desktop app installed and signed in at least once (the plugin reads its local credential store) and an account with an active Z.ai / Start Plan entitlement.
description.zh: 把 Z.ai / ZCode Start Plan 额度接进 DeepSeek Harness，作为 GLM 模型提供方（GLM-5.3-Flash、GLM-5.3），支持工具调用与推理等级；设置页提供额度进度条、领取赠送计划、刷新机会与脱敏请求日志。需要安装并至少登录过一次 ZCode 桌面客户端（插件读取其本机凭据库），且账号持有生效中的 Z.ai / Start Plan 权益。

plugins.name: dsh-model-router

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness work across configured model APIs and supported vendor CLIs with dependency-aware packages and cost previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 规划有依赖的工作包，将其分配给已配置的模型 API 或支持的厂商 CLI，并提供费用预览。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Google Antigravity model provider based on LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity, with a multi-account pool added. Do not install it in the same profile as LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity: both register the same bundle id (dsh-antigravity) and the same npm package name.
description.zh: Google Antigravity 模型提供商插件，基于 LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity，增加了账号池。请勿与上游 LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity 同装：两者注册同一个 bundle id（dsh-antigravity）和同一个 npm 包名。

plugins.name: dsh-harness-switch

description.en: Adds Kimi models to native DSH sessions with per-model selection of the embedded Kimi core or DSH native execution.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生会话中接入 Kimi 模型，并按模型选择嵌入式 Kimi 核心或 DSH 原生执行方式。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 100.64.0.0 for network access

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
description.zh: 将 Google Antigravity (agy CLI) 接入 DSH：无 API Key 使用 Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS 订阅模型，支持流式对话、原生工具卡片、思考轮次注记及 Web 界面 Google OAuth 扫码登录。

description.en: Control panel for local LLM inference servers in the DSH web view: service registry with health checks and stop controls, named parameter profiles for llama.cpp, SGLang and vLLM with pre-save KV/VRAM validation, GPU detection, and tok/s benchmarks.
description.zh: DSH Web 视图中的本地 LLM 推理服务控制面板:服务注册表与健康检查/停止控制、llama.cpp / SGLang / vLLM 命名参数 profile(保存前做 KV/显存校验)、GPU 探测与 tok/s 测速。

description.en: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness with a Claude Pro/Max membership (no API key), downscale Anthropic request images to a 2000px long edge, slim /compact summarizer payloads, and show 5-hour/weekly plan usage plus DSH message counts.
description.zh: 用 Claude Pro/Max 会员登录 DeepSeek Harness（无需 API key），将 Anthropic 请求图片长边压到 2000px，精简 /compact 摘要请求，并显示 5 小时/每周套餐用量百分比与 DSH 消息数。

description.en: Signs in to Huawei Cloud CodeArts and registers CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, LobsterAI, Qoder (global and China), TRAE, Cline, Loomy, Raccoon Work, MiniMax Code, TeleAgent, ZCode, Step Code and Antigravity as LLM providers, with per-provider account pools; several of them also show quota balance and daily check-in in the same panel.
description.zh: 华为云 CodeArts 浏览器登录，并把 CodeBuddy、WorkBuddy、LobsterAI、Qoder（国际版与中国版）、TRAE、Cline、Loomy、Raccoon Work、MiniMax Code、TeleAgent、ZCode、Step Code、Antigravity 注册为 LLM 提供商；各 provider 独立账号池，其中多家在同一面板内提供额度余额与每日签到。

plugins.name: dsh-claude-subscription

description.en: Use Claude models in DeepSeek Harness through Claude subscription accounts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中以 OAuth 登录的 Claude 订阅账号运行 Claude 模型，每个账号一条独立 provider 路由与一份可编辑的模型列表，提供 /claude-login、/claude-account、/claude-usage、/claude-logout 命令，并在输入框显示配额用量。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Routes outbound model traffic per provider host or per model ID through chosen proxies, loopback or direct, configured from a Plugins settings page.
description.zh: 按提供商主机或模型 ID 将模型出站流量分流到指定代理、直连或继承进程策略，可在 Plugins 设置页配置。

description.en: Model channel manager: several provider/model candidates share one virtual route (roundrobin/<group>) with failover, retry, timeout and cooldown; a settings tab edits providers and groups, runs per-model speed tests and real single-model request tests, and a seven-day health panel aggregates latency, failures and upstream token usage (input, output, cache and reasoning).
description.zh: 模型渠道管理：多个供应商/模型候选共享一条虚拟路由（roundrobin/组），带失败转移、重试、超时与冷却；设置页签可编辑供应商与轮询组、跑测速与单模型真实请求测试，健康面板聚合七天延迟、失败与上游 token 用量（输入、输出、缓存、推理）。

description.en: Adds the Liquid Inference auction exchange as a model route, with liquid.auto and its ranking variants, and four tools that read offers, markets, routers and job receipts. Requires a Liquid Inference API key (LIQUID_API_KEY, spend scope).
description.zh: 将 Liquid Inference 拍卖式推理交易所接入为模型路由，提供 liquid.auto 及其排序变体，并附带四个工具，用于读取报价、市场、路由器与任务收据。需 Liquid Inference API Key（LIQUID_API_KEY，spend 权限）。

description.en: Adds the models available in a signed-in WorkBuddy desktop app to DeepSeek Harness as a model provider, with the CN and international apps as separate groups. It is a rebuilt derivative of the npm package dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9 (originally corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect); it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 中的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，国内版与国际版各自成组。它基于 npm 包 dsh-workbuddy-connect@0.7.9（原 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect）的构建产物改出，注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

plugins.name: dsh-ollama-cloud

description.en: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness: adds the chat route on install, publishes each model's own thinking levels for the composer effort control, keeps the model list current from the endpoint (/api/tags and /api/show, cached for offline boots), shows the account allowance with an API-key field in the Models page and sidebar, and offers Ollama's web search and fetch as selectable DSH web providers.
description.zh: Ollama Cloud 供应商：安装即配好聊天路由，按 Ollama 模型自身元数据公布每个模型的思维链档位（供 composer 的推理强度选择），模型清单可由端点自动刷新（/api/tags 与 /api/show，并带离线缓存），在 Models 页与侧栏显示账号额度并提供 API Key 输入，还把 Ollama 的 web_search / web_fetch 作为可选的 DSH 网页能力提供方。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Edit reasoning effort levels and thinking formats for models that declare none.
description.zh: 为未声明思考档位的模型编辑推理强度档位与思考格式。

description.en: Official-style model + reasoning-effort control for the composer. Reuses the official picker and always offers Off/Low/High/Max — exactly like the official DeepSeek control — even when a gateway model declares no reasoning effort, with a small hint at the panel bottom when upstream does not natively support it.
description.zh: 输入框里的官方同款「模型 / 推理等级」控制。直接复用官方组件，即使网关模型（如 deepseek-v4.1-flash）未声明思考强度，也始终提供与官方一致的 Off/Low/High/Max 四档；上游未原生支持时，在面板底部显示一行小字提示。

description.en: Fork of dsh-reasoning-effort with a two-level model picker in the composer: a provider list, a model pane that slides out beside it, search, and compact rows, alongside the reasoning-effort slider and its max-level effects.
description.zh: dsh-reasoning-effort 的分支：输入框里的两级模型选择器（Provider 列表 + 右侧滑出的模型栏）、搜索与紧凑行，并保留推理强度滑块与最高档特效。

description.en: Declares image input on relay routes whose endpoint omits modality metadata, so models that can see photos stop being rejected as text-only. This also overrides routes that are explicitly declared text-only.
description.zh: 为端点不返回模态元数据的中转路由补上图片输入声明，让本来就能看图的模型不再被当成纯文本拒收；声明为纯文本的路由同样会被覆盖。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness sidebar for LiteLLM models, MCP servers, skills, and spend.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏面板，用于 LiteLLM 虚拟钥匙、动态模型注入、MCP 转发与花费统计。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-harness

description.en: Codex-shaped coding tools and agent presets for GPT models on DeepSeek Harness: exec_command, write_stdin, apply_patch and view_image, plus OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses API routes, bridged to DSH-native plan, ask, approval and compaction. Long-running commands become DSH background jobs with bounded head/tail output readable through job_output, and each subagent type can be pinned to its own preset, provider, model and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 上 GPT 模型的 Codex 风格编码工具与 agent 预设：exec_command、write_stdin、apply_patch、view_image，以及 OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Responses API 两条路由，并桥接 DSH 原生的计划、提问、审批与压缩。长命令注册为 DSH 后台作业，输出首尾有界，可用 job_output 读取；每种子代理类型可独立指定 Preset、Provider、Model 与 Reasoning effort。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Pools several OpenCode Go API keys and hot-switches each request to the least-used one, with official usage and balance lookup plus a graphical settings page.
description.zh: 聚合多个 OpenCode Go API key，把每次请求热切换到用量最低的一个，并提供官方用量/余额查询与设置页图形化管理。

description.en: Adds native Codex OAuth sign-in, main-Agent default model selection, and direct or local-proxy settings for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 提供原生 Codex OAuth 登录、主 Agent 默认模型选择及直连或本地代理设置。

description.en: Multi-model orchestrator: the main brain decomposes complex tasks and dispatches subtasks to GLM / Kimi / Qwen sub-agents by each model's strengths, with per-model token usage.
description.zh: 多模型主脑编排器：主模型将复杂任务拆解，按各模型优劣分派给 GLM / Kimi / Qwen 子代理执行，并按模型统计 token 用量。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-gpt

description.en: OpenAI OAuth login for ChatGPT Codex that adds ChatGPT as a selectable LLM provider (streaming, Off/Low/High/Max reasoning effort, image input) and a codex tool for per-session DeepSeek escalation, with optional light-task delegation to DeepSeek and subscription usage and reset-credit management.
description.zh: 通过 OpenAI OAuth 登录 ChatGPT Codex，把 ChatGPT 加为可选 LLM provider（流式、Off/Low/High/Max 思考强度、图片输入），并提供按会话授权的 codex 工具供 DeepSeek 升级调用，支持把轻任务委派回 DeepSeek，附带订阅用量与重置卡管理。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Proactive multi-model scheduling plugin: multi-source signal intake with dedup and urgency ranking, a four-way execute/defer/dismiss/ask-user decision engine, DAG plan generation with parallel model execution, quality reflection with automatic retry and model switch, long-term memory for task patterns and lessons, and strategy evolution via genetic algorithms with sandboxed evaluation and canary rollout.
description.zh: 主动式多模型协同调度插件：多源信号接入（去重与紧急度排序），execute/defer/dismiss/ask-user 四级决策引擎，DAG 计划生成与多模型并行执行，质量反思自动重试与切换模型，任务模式与经验教训长期记忆，以及遗传算法策略进化（沙盒评估、金丝雀发布）。

description.en: Rule-based multi-provider model routing for DeepSeek Harness with pre-first-token failover, cooldown circuit-breaking, usage accounting, and a status API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多供应商模型路由插件：规则路由 + 首 token 前无感故障切换 + cooldown 熔断 + 用量记账 + 状态接口。

description.en: Magpie gateway provider for DSH: syncs gateway models into the picker with visibility control, image input and thinking levels.
description.zh: 把 Magpie 网关的模型接入 DSH 选择器，支持模型显隐管理、图片输入与思考档位。

description.en: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage auditing.
description.zh: 早期开发中的团队管理插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 接入独立部署的自托管 OwnDsh 服务端，提供团队身份、模型授权、配额与用量审计。

plugins.name: dsh-openrouter-live

description.en: OpenRouter provider that reads the live /models list, so new models appear without a harness release: models sorted by name with input/output prices, per-model reasoning levels, image input, reasoning_details replay, Anthropic prompt caching, and actual spend per session including subagents from OpenRouter usage.cost, shown under the Web UI composer and by /cost.
description.zh: 读取 OpenRouter 实时 /models 列表的模型提供商，新模型无需等待 harness 发版即可出现：模型按名称排序并显示输入/输出价格，按模型提供思考档位、图片输入、reasoning_details 回放、Anthropic 提示缓存，并按 OpenRouter usage.cost 统计本会话（含子代理）的实际花费，显示在 Web 输入框下方并可用 /cost 查看。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Two-tier model routing: a strong tier plans, advises and reviews while a cheap tier implements, with plan-mode-aware auto routing, a high-impact escalation guard, failure auto-escalation, and subagent tiering.
description.zh: 双档模型路由：强档负责规划/咨询/评审、弱档负责实现；含计划模式自动路由、高危操作守卫、失败自动升级与子代理分层。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy free/paid models (domestic + international) into DSH without the desktop app, published as @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate. This package is a maintained fork of Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy (whose upstream entry is already listed in this catalogue); do NOT co-install both, as they register the same provider id "workbuddy-ai" and will collide. v1.2.7 relocates over-long system prompts past the domestic gateway channel-risk classifier, rewrites the DSH brand string, and adds a debug dump; supports dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1 (incl. prereleases).
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 国内版和国际版的免费/付费模型接进 DSH，无需桌面端；以 @bushizhanghan/dsh-workmate 发布。本包是 Faide-cyber/dsh-workbuddy 的维护分支（上游条目已在目录内）；请勿与上游同装，二者共用 provider id「workbuddy-ai」会冲突。v1.2.7：跨国内网关风控——长系统提示自动搬迁、出站体改写 DSH 字样、调试落盘；支持 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 至 0.2.1（含预发布）。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-oauth

description.en: Adds a Codex sign-in page to DSH settings, driving the built-in llm-pi-ai OAuth flow for browser or device-code login and showing masked account status without a separate provider or credential store.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页添加 Codex 登录入口，调用 llm-pi-ai 内置 OAuth 流程完成浏览器或设备码登录并展示脱敏账号状态，不另建模型适配器或凭证库。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://localhost:3080/v1.
description.zh: 以 DSH 插件形式运行的 AI 路由网关。侧边栏新增「路由系统」面板管理供应商、账号池、回退组合与 API 密钥，并在 http://localhost:3080/v1 提供 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: CodeBuddy supplier plugin for dsh-router. Handles one account at a time with polling OAuth login and token refresh, leaving account selection, cooldown and check-in to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 CodeBuddy 供应商插件。单账号负责轮询式 OAuth 登录与令牌刷新，选号、冷却与签到交由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: Qoder supplier plugin for dsh-router, covering both the CN and international regions. Uses a personal access token for authentication, signs requests to the Qoder cosy gateway and converts upstream SSE to OpenAI SSE; the model list reports the upstream display name alongside the key, while account selection and cooldown stay in dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 Qoder 供应商插件，同时覆盖国内版与国际版。以个人访问令牌认证、对 Qoder 的 cosy 网关签名请求，并把上游 SSE 转成 OpenAI SSE；模型列表同时上报上游显示名与 key，选号与冷却仍由 dsh-router 核心处理。

description.en: TRAE SOLO supplier plugin for dsh-router, ported from traework2api. Provides the traework supplier, a free SOLO chat channel, and reports single-account status to dsh-router core.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 TRAE SOLO 供应商插件，移植自 traework2api。提供 traework 供应商这一免费 SOLO 聊天通道，并向 dsh-router 核心上报单账号状态。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-grok-online

description.en: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible relay that forwards DSH chat requests to grok.online, exposing its two chat models in the model picker without an API key.
description.zh: 在本机跑一个 OpenAI 兼容反代，把 DSH 的对话请求转给 grok.online，无需 API key 即可在模型选择器里用它的两个对话模型。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to 1.1.1.1:8000
uses literal IP 3.3.3.3 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-grok3ai

description.en: Talks to the two public Hugging Face Spaces (MiniMax-VL-01 and Llama-2-7B-Chat) that grok3ai.org only embeds in an iframe, presenting them as OpenAI-compatible models.
description.zh: 直连 grok3ai.org 仅用 iframe 嵌进去的两个公开 Hugging Face Space（MiniMax-VL-01 与 Llama-2-7B-Chat），当作 OpenAI 兼容模型使用。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to 1.1.1.1:8000
uses literal IP 1.1.1.1 for network access

description.en: Signs in to LightVela by WeChat QR code, reads the model gateway key from your own instance and writes the gateway into llm-pi-ai so its models appear in the picker.
description.zh: 微信扫码登录 LightVela，从你自己的实例里读出模型网关凭据并写进 llm-pi-ai，让套餐里的模型出现在模型选择器中。

description.en: Time-based model routing: a settings panel defines weekday peak and off-peak windows and the provider/model each one uses, the choices are read from the harness registry (API keys and subscription logins alike), and a global switch decides whether that policy sets the model and reasoning effort of every request. The switch is independent per session, each session row carries a light showing its own state, and the settings panel names the model in force right now and why. A day no window matches — every weekend and holiday — uses the primary model of the first plan; the advanced thinking model is a separate axis, used only when a session itself asks for max reasoning.
description.zh: 按时间做模型路由：在设置页定义工作日峰谷时段与各时段使用的 Provider/模型（候选来自 harness 已注册的 API 与订阅账号），打开开关后由该策略决定每次请求的模型与思考档。开关按会话独立，会话列表每行带指示灯显示各自状态，设置页顶部写明此刻生效的模型与原因。无任何时段命中的日子（周末、假期）使用第一个方案的主力模型；高级思考模型是另一根轴，只在会话自身要求 max 思考时使用。

description.en: Adds configurable reasoning levels for third-party models and a model-strength picker in the composer.
description.zh: 为第三方模型配置推理强度档位，并在输入栏提供模型与强度选择器。

description.en: Manage API providers and enabled models, with provider-grouped model switching and keyword search in the native model menu.
description.zh: 管理API供应商与启用模型，在原生模型菜单中按供应商分组切换并搜索模型。

description.en: Named subagent presets bound to model-route allowlists, where an out-of-list child model is refused before a delegation starts and each child conversation shows the model its last request actually used.
description.zh: 为官方子智能体工具提供具名预设与模型路由白名单：越界的子模型在派发前被拒绝，子会话标题栏显示最近一次请求实际使用的模型。

description.en: Bring the WorkBuddy accounts signed in on this machine into DSH, managing CN and international accounts separately. Supports automatic failover between accounts, one-click refresh of model catalogs and credits, the CN daily check-in, and a togglable OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 多账号接入 DSH，国内版与国际版分开管理。支持账号故障自动切换、一键刷新模型目录与积分、国内版每日签到，以及可开关的 OpenAI 兼容端点。

plugins.name: dsh-newapi-video

description.en: Call a new-api (one-api style) relay station's video model from the conversation with @-referenced image/video materials, supporting Seedance 2.0 and Happyhorse text-to-video and image-to-video across four relay protocols.
description.zh: 在对话中用 @ 引用素材调用 new-api 中转站的视频大模型生成视频，支持 Seedance 2.0 与快乐马的文生视频和图生视频，覆盖四种中转协议。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: One DSH plugin that aggregates the models of WorkBuddy (personal multi-account, enterprise and the WorkBuddy AI international edition), Qoder CN and Trae CN into a single model picker with a shared conversation history, live credit multipliers, per-model reasoning effort, the largest context window the international edition declares, and daily check-in where the channel offers one.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件把 WorkBuddy（个人多账号、企业版与国际版 WorkBuddy AI）、Qoder CN、Trae CN 的模型聚合进同一个模型选择器，共用一套对话历史，支持积分倍率、逐模型思考档位、国际版上游声明的最大上下文窗口，并在渠道有签到活动时自动领取。

description.en: Brings the WorkBuddy, Trae and Qoder desktop logins on this machine into DeepSeek Harness as OpenAI-compatible local endpoints, with an account pool, automatic account switching when WorkBuddy is rate limited, and a settings panel.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder 的桌面登录接进 DeepSeek Harness，每家一个 OpenAI 兼容的本地端点，带账号池、限流自动换号与设置面板。

description.en: Remembers the reasoning effort you explicitly chose for each provider and model and restores it when you switch back, without replacing DSH's own model picker.
description.zh: 按 Provider + Model 记住你最后一次明确选择的推理档位，切回该模型时用同一次原生选择调用恢复，不替换 DSH 原生模型选择器。

description.en: Ranks the models a DeepSeek Harness install already discovered by measured connectivity and speed, and switches to the next candidate inside the same turn when the one in use fails without producing any output. Ships a settings page with a grouped model list, per-model and per-channel switches, and a quota-aware cooldown that rests an exhausted model until the next day.
description.zh: 把本机已发现的 DSH 模型按实测连通性与速度排序，当前模型无输出失败时在同一回合内切到下一个候选。附带设置页：按渠道分组的模型列表、逐模型与逐渠道开关，以及额度耗尽后休息到次日的冷却策略。

description.en: Turns the composer's model menu into a two-level list (provider first, then that provider's models), shows the current model together with its provider name, asks for a reasoning effort after a model is picked, and adds settings switches that hide whole providers or single models from the picker.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型菜单改成「先选厂商、再选模型」的两级列表，当前模型位同时显示厂商名，点模型后再选推理等级；设置里可按厂商或单个模型把条目从选择器中隐藏。

description.en: Signs in to a ChatGPT account over OAuth and serves that plan's models as a DeepSeek Harness provider route, calling api.openai.com/v1/responses with the account's plan scope rather than the Codex backend.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 ChatGPT 账号，把该套餐的模型作为 DeepSeek Harness 的 provider 路由提供；调用 api.openai.com/v1/responses 并使用账号的套餐授权范围，而非 Codex 后端。

description.en: Signs in to ChatGPT by driving DSH's bundled pi-ai Codex OAuth flow from a settings page, revokes the session at OpenAI on sign-out, shows the signed-in account's five-hour and weekly quota, and limits the Codex route to seven GPT models with low, medium, high and xhigh reasoning (default low).
description.zh: 在设置页驱动 DSH 自带 pi-ai 的 Codex OAuth 登录 ChatGPT，退出时在 OpenAI 撤销会话，显示所登录账号的 5 小时与每周额度，并把 Codex 路由限定为 7 个 GPT 模型，统一 low、medium、high、xhigh 四档推理（默认 low）。

description.en: Per provider/model generation concurrency, with a settings card: a cap on how many sessions may stream at once, enforced at the stream and again at subagent spawn, where a fan-out past the cap waits in a FIFO queue instead of failing.
description.zh: 按提供方/模型限制并发生成，并附带设置卡片：限定同时进行流式生成的会话数，在流式调用与子代理派生两处强制执行；超出上限的扇出会进入 FIFO 队列等待，而不是直接失败。

description.en: A thinking level stored per provider and model, so reasoning effort outlives the session it was set in and also reaches subagents, which dsh never asks. The in-session picker still wins, and a model with no row keeps its provider default.
description.zh: 按提供方与模型保存思考等级：推理强度不再只属于设置它的那次会话，还会应用到 dsh 从不询问的子代理。会话内的手动选择依然优先，没有配置的模型保持提供方默认值。

description.en: Declare whether a configured third-party model accepts image (multimodal) input; writes the modality into the owning provider settings and verifies it through runtime model resolution.
description.zh: 声明第三方模型是否支持图像（多模态）输入，写入所属提供方设置并通过运行时模型解析校验。

plugins.name: dsh_gearbox

description.en: Reasoning-effort gear presets for third-party models: 16 vendor/model presets with per-mode custom wire values, written into dsh-llm-pi-ai with pre-write validation and per-rule rejection; per-model switching between OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages with automatic route regrouping; plus a composer Optimize button and a settings section that rewrite the input text with a model you pick.
description.zh: 第三方模型的思考档位预设：内置 16 组按「厂家 → 模型」组织的官方档位，支持自定义档位与逐模式传输值，校验后直写 llm-pi-ai 配置；支持按模型在 OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 三种协议间切换并自动重新分组路由；输入框提供「优化提示词」按钮，用设置中指定的大模型改写当前内容。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.
description.zh: DIT.ai 的 DeepSeek Harness 模型接入 bundle：使用一个 DIT_API_KEY 安装 29 个 OpenAI Chat Completions 模型和 10 个 Anthropic Messages 模型，并按协议配置 thinking。

description.en: Adds a deepseek-web provider that uses chat.deepseek.com web models in DSH, with browser login capture, PoW request signing, SSE streaming, and prompting-based tool calls.
description.zh: 新增 deepseek-web provider，把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端模型接入 DSH：浏览器登录抓取、PoW 请求签名、SSE 流式传输与基于提示词的工具调用。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages local inference engines.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于管理本地推理引擎。

description.en: A simplified version of the Plan/Act feature in the RooCode and Cline VS Code extensions, binding one provider, model and reasoning effort to plan mode and another to act mode, with per-workspace overrides.
description.zh: 简化RooCode和Cline在VSCode插件上的功能，为 Plan 与 Act 两种模式各绑定一套 provider、模型与思考复杂度，支持按工作区覆盖。

description.en: Automatically and intelligently routes each delegated task to the best configured model using aliases, capability tags, and usage guidance—keeping routine work fast and affordable while sending complex work to stronger specialists. Configure your model team in the Web UI or guided setup, run specialists in parallel with reliable result joining, and see the chosen model at a glance in subagent views and inline in Better Sidebar's Tasks tree.
description.zh: 借助别名、能力标签和使用说明，将每项委派任务自动智能路由到最合适的已配置模型——常规工作更快、更省，复杂任务则交给更强的专用模型。可通过 Web 设置页或引导流程组建模型团队，让多个专家并行工作并可靠汇总结果；所选模型会显示在子代理视图中，并以内联标签无缝融入 Better Sidebar 的 Tasks 任务树。

plugins.name: dsh-factory-provider

description.en: Factory (Droid) subscription quota as native DSH model providers, with three protocol routes, your own API key through a loopback gateway, and a settings page for connection status, quota, per-model token statistics and key switching.
description.zh: 把 Factory (Droid) 订阅额度接入 DSH 的原生模型 provider：三条协议路由、用你自己的 API key 经本机回环网关认证，并提供设置页查看连接状态、订阅额度、按模型的 token 统计与切换 key。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: DSH model provider for the locally authenticated AGY CLI: Gemini/Claude model discovery, independent reasoning effort, DSH-owned tools, bounded context and tool-result handling, and Windows-safe streaming. Report problems in GitHub Issues: https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues.
description.zh: 将本机已登录的 AGY CLI 接入 DSH 作为模型 Provider：支持 Gemini/Claude 模型发现、独立推理强度、DSH-owned 工具、受限上下文与工具结果管理、Windows 安全流式传输；如遇问题，请在 GitHub 提交 Issue：https://github.com/darkings/dsh-agy-provider/issues。

description.en: Kiro model provider with Builder ID, Identity Center, Google, GitHub and credential-import sign-in, automatic token and profile refresh, account usage, live model discovery, selectable reasoning efforts, streaming tool calls, provider stop-reason and context-overflow handling, and token accounting that uses Kiro's exact counters when it sends them and otherwise scales the context-usage percentage it does send by the model's advertised window.
description.zh: Kiro 模型提供商，支持 Builder ID、Identity Center、Google、GitHub 与凭据导入登录、token 和 profile 自动刷新、账户用量、实时模型发现、推理档位选择、流式工具调用、上游结束原因与上下文溢出处理；token 统计在 Kiro 提供精确计数时直接采用，否则用它确实会发送的上下文占用百分比乘以模型公布的窗口换算。

description.en: Adds Claude, Gemini, and a local Ollama model to DSH's native model picker, using your existing Claude Code / Antigravity CLI logins instead of a metered API key, with a working reasoning-effort selector for Claude.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器里加入 Claude、Gemini 与本地 Ollama 模型，复用你已有的 Claude Code / Antigravity CLI 登录态而不是按量计费的 API Key，并为 Claude 提供可用的推理强度选择。

description.en: Global Chinese mode: a compact pill switch beside the composer that injects a language requirement into any preset's system prompt (complete personas excepted); reply, thinking and tool output each toggle between Chinese and English, and anchored presets are supported.
description.zh: 全局中文模式：输入框旁的紧凑胶囊开关，开启后向任意预设（完整 persona 除外）的系统提示注入语言要求；回复、思考、工具区域可分别切换中英文，并兼容锚定预设。

description.en: Per-model enable/disable and renaming for every provider in DeepSeek Harness: a panel at the bottom of Settings - Models with a search box, status chips with counts, a provider filter, collapsible provider groups with group-level switches, and batch actions scoped to the current view. Disabled models leave the model picker and custom names replace the built-in ones. Preferences persist in the profile and apply immediately, without reloading the page or restarting DSH.
description.zh: DSH 全体模型管理：在「设置 → 模型」页底部加一块面板，管理所有 provider 的每一个模型——逐条启用/停用与改名。带搜索框、状态筛选（含计数）、提供商下拉、可折叠的 provider 分组与组级开关，批量操作只作用于当前筛选视图。停用的模型从模型选择器里消失，自定义名直接替换显示名；偏好持久化在 profile，改完立即生效，不用刷新页面、不用重启 DSH。

description.en: Adds a one-click switch to every provider row in Settings - Models: turn a provider off and it leaves the model picker, turn it back on and it returns. It works by wrapping the model catalog call, so it affects the catalog and the picker only, never routing, keys or provider config; existing sessions that already use such a model keep working.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 模型」每个提供商行的「编辑」左边加一个一键开关：关掉哪个提供商，它就从主界面模型选择栏里消失，打开即恢复。做法是包一层模型目录调用，因此只影响目录与选择器，不动路由、密钥与 provider 配置；已经选着该模型的旧会话照常工作。

description.en: Adds the models of your own GPU Hugging Face Space to the model selector, starts the Space when you send a message, shows its start progress, and pauses it when idle or at a time limit. Requires a Hugging Face account with a GPU Space serving an OpenAI-compatible API, a Hugging Face token stored in the DSH vault as HF_TOKEN, and a paid plan for GPU hardware; Hugging Face bills the GPU time.
description.zh: 将你自己的 Hugging Face GPU Space 中的模型加入模型选择器，发送消息时启动该 Space，显示启动进度，并在空闲或达到时限时将其暂停。需要 Hugging Face 账号、一个提供 OpenAI 兼容 API 的 GPU Space、在 DSH 凭据库中以 HF_TOKEN 保存的 Hugging Face token，以及 GPU 硬件所需的付费计划；GPU 机时由 Hugging Face 计费。

description.en: Two-level model routing: pick the best model group first, then the best channel within that model; a failure switches channel before switching model. Preference mode pins one model across its channels, a status bar under the composer shows the live model, channel health and the day's token usage, and a speed/intelligence report can be imported as the routing prior. Exposes a model_orchestrator tool and a /route command.
description.zh: 两级模型调度：先在模型层选最优模型组，再在该模型的渠道层选最佳渠道；失败时先换同模型的其它渠道，整个模型不可用才换模型。偏好模式把单个模型锁在它的各条渠道上，输入框下方的状态条实时显示当前模型、渠道健康与今日 token 用量，并可从测速/智力报告导入路由先验；另提供 model_orchestrator 工具与 /route 命令。

description.en: Connects Qoder (Lingma CN / international) models to DSH through their PATs, with a per-region multi-account pool, daily check-in, automatic failover, and read-only credit visibility.
description.zh: 通过 PAT 将 Qoder（通义灵码国内版 / 国际版）模型接入 DSH，支持按区域的多账号池、每日签到、自动换号与只读积分展示。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in Trae CN models to DSH, supports DSH-executed tool calls, account switching, and Work/general credit visibility.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 Trae 中国区模型接入 DSH，支持由 DSH 执行工具调用、账号切换，以及 Work/通用积分展示。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models, CN and international alike, to DSH, reading each model's credit multiplier from the upstream catalog on every refresh, with per-model image input toggles, account switching backed by an auto-failing-over pool, manual daily check-in, and read-only credit overviews shown as compact pills on the card and in the composer.
description.zh: 将本机登录的 WorkBuddy 模型（国内版与国际版）接入 DSH，每次刷新按上游目录读取每个模型的积分倍率，支持逐模型图片输入开关、带自动换号的账号池、手动每日签到，以及卡片与输入框里的只读积分胶囊读数。

description.en: Configurable default model for subagent delegations via settings.yaml, with single-model and multi-model round-robin or random strategies.
description.zh: 通过 settings.yaml 为子代理派发配置默认模型，支持单模型与多模型轮换/随机分配策略。

description.en: Connect OpenCode Zen free-tier models into DeepSeek Harness. Real-time model discovery, per-model toggle in settings, one-click provider write. No API key required.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，实时模型发现、设置页逐个启停、一键写入 provider，免 key。

description.en: Aggregates all local Trae accounts into one auto-failover model provider, with manual and automated daily check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, and a model selection settings card.
description.zh: 把本机多个 Trae 账号聚合成一个自动容错换号的模型供应商，附带手动与自动签到、积分与到期监控，以及模型配置设置卡片。

description.en: Aggregates every WorkBuddy account already signed in on this machine into one model pool, with manual and scheduled check-in, credits and expiry monitoring, per-model credit multipliers, and account switching with remaining credits right below the composer.
description.zh: 把本机所有登录过的 WorkBuddy 账号聚合成一个模型池，带手动与自动签到、积分与到期监控、模型倍率，并可在输入框下方切换账号、查看剩余总积分。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-openai-completions

description.en: OpenAI-completions-compatible adapter for custom gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted proxies): always role:"system", thinking driven by the model config, Qwen-style response split, and vision-model image input (single / multiple).
description.zh: 面向自定义网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管代理）的 OpenAI-completions 兼容适配器：始终 role:"system"、按模型配置驱动思考、Qwen 式 response 切分，并支持视觉模型图片输入（单图 / 多图）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Per-round thinking-level (reasoning_effort) control for DeepSeek Harness: pick Auto and it schedules low/high/max from the recent tool-call history, or fix a wire level (off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max) manually, with custom wire mapping, a model-aware capability guard, and context-window presets (64K–1M); its per-model capability card pairs with a separate plugin, [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions) (installable from dsh-market), so custom OpenAI-compatible gateways (vLLM / LM Studio / self-hosted) can try reasoning — the card writes llm-pi-ai capabilities, the adapter drives the wire (compat.thinkingFormat), and this plugin auto-maintains the takeover list.
description.zh: DSH 逐轮思考级别（reasoning_effort）控制：选择 Auto 即按近期工具调用历史自动调度 low/high/max，或手动固定线路档位（off/on/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max），支持自定义线路映射、模型能力护栏与上下文窗口预设（64K–1M）；其逐模型能力卡片与另一独立插件 [dsh-llm-openai-completions](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-llm-openai-completions)（可在 dsh-market 安装）联动，让自定义 OpenAI 兼容网关（vLLM / LM Studio / 自托管）也能试用推理——卡片写入 llm-pi-ai 能力，适配器接管线路（compat.thinkingFormat），本插件自动维护接管列表。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness: the China and international builds each appear as their own group in the model picker, with the reasoning tiers the upstream declares, per-reply credit cost and remaining balance, per-account model visibility, and image input where supported.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接进 DSH 模型选择器：国内版与国际版各自成组，带上游声明的推理档位、每条回复的积分消耗与剩余积分、按账号分别保存的模型显隐，以及在支持的模型上的图片输入。

plugins.name: OneKey-Models

description.en: One-click TokenDance gateway access for DeepSeek Harness: OAuth sign-in stores the API key, a live model catalog with per-model visibility, and agent tools for chat, image generation, video generation and typed decisions.
description.zh: 一键接入 TokenDance 模型网关：OAuth 登录保存 API Key，实时模型目录可逐模型控制显隐，并提供对话、生图、生视频与类型化判断的 agent 工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to tokendance-plugin.com

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go

description.en: OpenCode Go provider with live gateway model discovery, online models.dev capability metadata, session routing, and Web settings with subscription usage.
description.zh: OpenCode Go 模型提供方，支持网关实时模型发现、models.dev 在线能力配置、会话路由，以及含订阅用量显示的 Web 设置页。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to 169.254.169.254
uses literal IP 169.254.169.254 for network access

description.en: Adaptive model routing: per-request complexity classification with automatic provider routing.
description.zh: 自适应模型路由：请求级复杂度分类，按配置链自动选择后端 provider。

description.en: Local model plugin for DeepSeek Harness: manage GGUF models in settings, auto-launch llama.cpp on first message, and auto-unload after 5 minutes of idle time to free VRAM.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地模型插件：在设置里管理 GGUF 模型，首条对话自动拉起 llama.cpp，空闲 5 分钟自动卸载释放显存。

description.en: English-only fork of dsh-model-router. Routes each agent step across a configurable model pool and adjusts reasoning effort based on task complexity, tool failures, and cost.
description.zh: dsh-model-router 的纯英文分支。把每个 agent 步骤路由到可配置的模型池，并按任务复杂度、工具失败与成本调整推理强度。

plugins.name: dsh-our-free-model

description.en: Adds free model lanes to DeepSeek Harness — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Kimi K3 and others — with no login, sign-up or API key, plus a local OpenAI-compatible gateway, fallback routing and a usage dashboard.
description.zh: 为 dsh 接入免费模型车道（含 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 等），无需登录、注册或填写 API Key，并提供本地 OpenAI 兼容网关、降级路由与用量看板。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to opencode.ai:443

plugins.name: dsh-oauth-adapter

description.en: Provides an OAuth account page for DSH Web, currently supporting OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Anthropic, Kimi For Coding, OpenRouter, and xAI.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 OAuth 账号页面，目前支持 OpenAI Codex、GitHub Copilot、Anthropic、Kimi For Coding、OpenRouter 与 xAI。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-connect-agnes-token-plan

description.en: One-tap connect Agnes language, image and video models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. After signing in to the Agnes console (re-login uses AGNES_PASSWORD), you can see the quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, video), account-wide cumulative usage, and a usage pill beside the input box. AgnesCode desktop models can be connected too (Windows only), re-reading the desktop app login when the token expires, with rate-limit hits backing off on their own.
description.zh: 一键接入 Agnes 的语言、生图、视频模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与思考强度；登录 Agnes 控制台后（重登需 AGNES_PASSWORD），可看额度窗口（5 小时请求、每周请求、每日图片、视频）、账号累计用量，以及输入框旁的用量胶囊；也支持接入 AgnesCode 桌面端模型（仅 Windows），令牌到期时重新读取桌面端登录态，撞限额自动退避重试。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: One-tap connect ModelScope language and image-generation models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and context window filled in automatically. You can also see the free Magicube balance, jump to a model's info page, and record local call counts, trends and rate-limit events, with a usage pill beside the input box showing the balance and today's local count. All of it needs only an API key, with no account sign-in.
description.zh: 一键接入魔搭社区的语言、生图模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与上下文窗口；还可查看免费魔粒余额、跳转到模型信息页，记录本地调用计数、趋势、限流事件，输入框旁另有用量胶囊显示余额与今日本地调用次数。上述功能仅需填入 API key，不需要登录账号。

plugins.name: dsh-connect-qoder

description.en: Registers Qoder CN and international language models into DSH, fetching each model's rate automatically as it shifts with off-peak hours. It also provides a daily check-in, a usage pill and a credit lookup. Needs the Qoder login state on this machine, or one browser login.
description.zh: 注册 Qoder 中国版与国际版的语言模型到 DSH，自动获取每个模型的费率，随错峰时段变化。并提供每天签到、用量胶囊与积分查询功能。需要本机Qoder的登录态，或浏览器登录一次。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan

description.en: One-tap connect SenseNova Token Plan language and image models into DSH (off by default), with image recognition and thinking level filled in automatically. On a rate limit it backs off and retries on its own instead of misreading it as an exhausted quota. After signing in to the SenseNova console you can see the usage pill, credit pools and per-model consumption. Xiaohuanxiong can also be signed in by QR code, bringing in its models and their consumption multipliers, and taking over DSH web search.
description.zh: 一键接入商汤 Token Plan的语言、生图模型到 DSH（默认关），自动填入图片识别与思考强度；限频时自动退避重试，不会误判为额度耗尽；登录商汤控制台后，可查看用量胶囊、积分池、每模型消耗。也支持扫码登录小浣熊，接入其模型，查看模型消耗倍率，使用联网搜索。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts to DeepSeek Harness with built-in OAuth2 sign-in (PKCE + DPoP) or a pasted token, after which CodeArts models are available in the DSH conversation window. Reads per-account credit balance, expiring credits and daily check-in from the CodeArts credit API, counts requests and tokens locally, and shows a per-account credits popover under the chat input box; the credits line and the upstream queue hint can each be turned off in settings.
description.zh: 把华为云 CodeArts 接入 DeepSeek Harness：内置华为云 OAuth2 登录（PKCE + DPoP），也支持粘贴 token；登录后即可在 DSH 对话窗口使用 CodeArts 提供的模型。积分余额、即将过期额度与每日签到读 CodeArts 自己的积分接口，请求数与 token 用量按账号在本机统计；对话输入框下方那行积分可点开看逐号明细，积分与上游排队位置都能在设置里单独关掉。

plugins.name: dsh-opendesign-go

description.en: OpenDesign Go provider: 12 subscription models over Chat Completions, the real 5-hour and 7-day quota read from the local OpenDesign app, per-model parameters and switches, and multi-account failover.
description.zh: OpenDesign Go 模型提供方：以 Chat Completions 协议接入 12 个订阅模型，从本机 OpenDesign 客户端读取真实的 5 小时 / 7 天额度，支持每模型参数与开关、多账号失败切换。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Wraps globalThis.fetch to route DeepSeek Harness model-API requests through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy by target domain, leaving all other requests on the direct connection, without modifying Harness source.
description.zh: 把 globalThis.fetch 包一层，按目标域名让 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 API 请求走 HTTP/SOCKS 代理、其它请求保持直连，全程不改 Harness 源码。

description.en: Requires DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0. Declare any number of LLM providers, each with its own endpoint, credential and per-model parameters (reasoning-effort vocabulary, image input, retry policy), across the OpenAI Chat, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Google Gemini wire formats, configured from a settings page.
description.zh: 需要 DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.2 < 0.3.0。在设置页配置任意数量的模型供应商：各自独立设置接口地址、密钥与逐模型参数（思考强度、图片输入、重试策略），支持 OpenAI Chat、OpenAI Responses、Anthropic Messages 与 Google Gemini 四种协议。

description.en: Runs a local OpenAI-compatible gateway so DSH can use the model quota of a logged-in Tencent CodeBuddy (WorkBuddy) account: one-shot installer with SHA256 verification, logon scheduled task with duplicate-launch guard, manage.ps1 for status/start/stop/restart/logs/update/uninstall, and an agent skill that drives setup and troubleshooting.
description.zh: 在本机运行 OpenAI 兼容网关，让 DSH 使用已登录的腾讯 CodeBuddy（WorkBuddy）账号额度：一键安装脚本（含 SHA256 校验）、登录自启计划任务（带防重复启动）、manage.ps1 统一管理（status/start/stop/restart/logs/update/uninstall），并内置指导安装与排障的 Agent 技能。

description.en: Use your ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions in DSH, with image generation and web search support.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用你的 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，并支持图像生成和 Web 搜索。

description.en: Bring WorkBuddy's free and paid models (domestic and international) into DSH — no WorkBuddy desktop app required.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 国内版和国际版的免费/付费模型接进 DSH —— 无需下载 WorkBuddy 桌面端。

description.en: A gold switch beside the composer that raises every model request to the strongest reasoning effort the current model declares and to its default max output tokens, and adds a system-prompt section asking for exhaustive, self-checked work.
description.zh: 输入框旁一枚金色开关：把每次模型请求的推理强度提到当前模型声明的最高档、输出上限提到其 defaultMaxTokens，并在系统提示里追加一段要求穷尽检索、逐条自检的工作纪律。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-longcat

description.en: LongCat-2.0 LLM adapter: 1M context, binary thinking mode, tool calling, and streaming over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: LongCat-2.0 模型适配器：100 万上下文、二元思考模式、工具调用，基于 OpenAI 兼容接口的流式输出。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: macOS Keychain credential provider that replaces the local-file provider and uses a signed, notarized universal helper.
description.zh: macOS Keychain 凭据提供器：替换本地文件提供器，并使用已签名、公证的通用二进制辅助程序。

description.en: Anthropic provider using the native Messages API for language models in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 使用原生 Messages API 为 DSH 提供语言模型能力的 Anthropic 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Cohere provider for language models, embeddings, and reranking through Cohere's native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 通过 Cohere 原生 API 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入和重排序能力的 Cohere 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Alibaba Cloud DashScope provider for Qwen language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation through native APIs in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 通过阿里云 DashScope 原生 API 为 DSH 提供通义千问语言模型、嵌入、重排、语音和图像生成能力。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Jina provider for embeddings and reranking in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供嵌入和重排序能力的 Jina 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: LocalAI provider for language models, embeddings, reranking, speech, and image generation with LocalAI-specific controls in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入、重排序、语音和图像生成能力及 LocalAI 专用控制项的 LocalAI 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Ollama provider for language models and embeddings, with model discovery, loading, and unloading in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入以及模型发现、加载和卸载功能的 Ollama 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: OpenAI provider for language models, embeddings, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and image generation in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供语言模型、嵌入、文本转语音、语音转文本和图像生成能力的 OpenAI 提供商。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: AI provider runtime and configuration UI for shared credentials and embedding, reranking, speech, and image generation services in DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供共享凭据以及嵌入、重排序、语音和图像生成服务的 AI 提供商运行时与配置界面。

description.en: TypeSafe AI Jev decision provider for typed probabilistic choices and scores in DSH. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 TypeSafe AI Jev 决策能力，用于带类型的概率选择和评分。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-ai-providers#runtime。

description.en: Exposes OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness, with no API key.
description.zh: 将 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需 API Key。

description.en: Adds Token Market as an OpenAI-compatible model provider with DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3, and GLM-5.3.
description.zh: 将 Token Market 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，并提供 DeepSeek V4 Pro、Kimi K3 和 GLM-5.3。

description.en: Registers external ACP (Agent Client Protocol) agents such as Codex, Claude Code and Gemini CLI as DSH model providers: maps each agent's thought_level options to the reasoning-effort selector, forwards images when the agent advertises promptCapabilities.image, and routes permission requests to DSH's approval dialog; ships an ACP Agents settings page that imports Zed agent_servers JSON and discovers models.
description.zh: 把 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等外部 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）Agent 注册为 DSH 模型提供方：Agent 的 thought_level 选项映射为推理等级菜单，Agent 声明 promptCapabilities.image 时转发图片，权限请求走 DSH 原生审批框；附带 ACP Agents 设置页，可导入 Zed 的 agent_servers JSON 并发现模型。

description.en: Connects Trae enterprise models to DeepSeek Harness from a personal access token alone, calling llm_raw_chat directly with no trae2api or traecli process; fetches the model catalog from upstream on startup and shows remaining quota for personal packs and enterprise seats.
description.zh: 仅凭一个个人访问令牌（PAT）把 Trae 企业版模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，直连 llm_raw_chat，不需要 trae2api 或 traecli 进程；启动时从上游拉取模型目录，并显示个人额度包与企业席位的剩余额度。

description.en: Tiers free-channel models into three 1M fallback chains plus a custom chain; orders them by measured throughput, drops models below throughput or error-rate thresholds, and rotates accounts. Requires an OpenAI-compatible gateway (default :8326).
description.zh: 把白嫖渠道模型按倍率分成三条 1M 降级链，另加自定义链；按实测吞吐排序，低于吞吐线或错误率过高的模型不进链，账号到期优先并轮流。需 OpenAI 兼容网关（默认 :8326）。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-connect

description.en: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Pick the model your subagents run on — with a reasoning-effort ceiling and an output-token cap — enforced in code on every child DSH starts, whichever tool starts it.
description.zh: 自己选定子代理运行的模型——附带推理力度上限和输出 token 上限——在代码层面对 DSH 启动的每一个子代理强制执行，无论它由哪个工具启动。

description.en: Reuses the CodeBuddy CLI sign-in to bring its models into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card showing account, token expiry, and remaining credit.
description.zh: 复用 CodeBuddy CLI 的登录态，把 CodeBuddy 包含的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，设置卡片可查看账号、令牌有效期与剩余积分。

description.en: Hosts the WorkBuddy2API gateway in DSH with a native panel, a separately updatable kernel, and outbound fingerprint alignment with WorkBuddy Desktop 5.9.2.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy2API 网关托管进 DSH，提供原生面板、可独立更新的内核，以及对齐 WorkBuddy Desktop 5.9.2 的出站指纹。

plugins.name: Trae2api-dsh

description.en: Use TRAE account model quota in dsh, with multi-account management, daily check-in, rotation, usage statistics, reasoning levels and model visibility. Requires Python 3.10+; the first run downloads Python dependencies.
description.zh: 将 TRAE 账号的模型额度接入 dsh，支持多账号管理、自动签到、账号轮询、用量统计、思考强度选择和模型显示管理。 需要 Python 3.10+，首次使用需联网安装 Python 依赖。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-model-think-level

description.en: Thinking levels, image input and image generation for third-party models in the official Models page; multiple keys per provider routed by model, automatic failover between keys on failure, per-route custom request headers, and balance display.
description.zh: 在官方「模型」页为第三方模型补上思考等级、图片输入与生图；一个供应商可配多把密钥，按模型分流、失败自动换密钥重试，并可配置按路由的请求头、查看余额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Syncs DSH model providers and models across computers through any WebDAV server: the backup is sealed with a passphrase before it leaves this machine, so a new machine opens with the same model list.
description.zh: 通过任意 WebDAV 服务在多台电脑之间同步 DSH 的模型供应商与模型：备份离开本机之前先用口令封好，新机器打开就是同一份模型清单。

description.en: Set the provider, model and reasoning effort delegated subagents run with, from one chip beside the composer: a per-conversation override and a profile-wide default share the same two controls, and the chip always shows the effective route. Applied on the agent/request hook to every in-process child; no settings page, no preset edits, no model-facing tool parameters.
description.zh: 在输入框旁的「子代理」胶囊里统一设置委派子代理使用的 provider、模型与思考强度：卡片的「本对话 / 全局默认」两个范围共用同一组控件，胶囊上始终显示当前生效的路由；经 agent/request 钩子对每个进程内子代理生效，不注册设置页、不改 agent preset、不给工具加模型参数。

description.en: Windows-only model provider for Google Antigravity CLI, continuing Darkings/dsh-agy-provider (install as dsh-agy-cli; do not install alongside the original). It reads the Antigravity token from the Windows Credential Manager and sends it only to the Google Cloud Code endpoints, lets DSH own the harness tool policy, streams the tail without rollback, and tracks the real quota windows.
description.zh: Windows 专用的 Google Antigravity CLI 模型提供方，接续自 Darkings/dsh-agy-provider（包名 dsh-agy-cli，请勿与原版同装）。从 Windows 凭据管理器读取 Antigravity 令牌并只发往 Google Cloud Code 端点；Harness 工具策略由 DSH 全权负责，尾流式输出防回滚，并跟踪真实配额窗口。

description.en: Runs the locally installed ZCode CLI as a `zcode` model route in DSH: all traffic is signed by the official binary, the plugin never sends its own request, forges client requests or sends credentials off the machine (the plan token is decrypted in memory only to hand back to the official CLI), no API key is needed, and both a paid one-shot and a free app-server channel are supported. Since v0.3.0 it ships an HTTP MCP bridge so tool calls run through the DSH approval surface. Backed by a contract document and a node --test gate.
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 ZCode CLI 接成 DSH 的 `zcode` 模型路由：流量全部由官方二进制签名，插件自身不发请求、不伪造客户端请求、不把凭据传出本机（plan token 只在内存中解密并交还官方 CLI），不需要 API Key，付费一次性与免费 app-server 两条通道并存；v0.3.0 起内建 HTTP MCP 工具桥，工具调用走 DSH 的审批面；有契约文档与 node --test 测试门禁背书。

description.en: Hand a DSH web session to the locally installed Claude Code CLI: a per-session engine selector (DSH | Claude Code), Claude models and reasoning effort in the model seat, Claude permission modes in place of the access-mode selector, and permission requests, AskUserQuestion and ExitPlanMode routed to the native DSH approval, question and plan-review cards. The stream is written as native DSH session events, so the built-in transcript, tool cards and nested subagents render it; Claude slash commands merge into the command palette; the CLI is held by a detached broker, so plugin updates and DSH restarts do not interrupt a running turn.
description.zh: 把一个 dsh web 会话交给本机 Claude Code CLI 驱动：输入框内的引擎选择器（DSH | Claude Code）按会话切换，模型座换成 Claude 的模型与 reasoning effort，访问模式换成 Claude 权限档；权限请求、AskUserQuestion、ExitPlanMode 分别接到 dsh 原生的审批卡、提问卡与计划审核卡。Claude 的流写成 dsh 原生会话事件，由内建转录、工具卡片与嵌套子 agent 渲染；斜杠命令并入命令面板；CLI 由独立 broker 持有，插件更新与 dsh 重启都不中断进行中的轮次。

description.en: Connects CANNBOT gateway models to DSH by reusing the sign-in CANNWork already establishes for opencode: the JWT and virtual key are read from disk on every request, so no separate OAuth flow or extra key is needed, and the account's visible models are registered in the model picker.
description.zh: 把 CANNBOT 网关的模型接入 DSH：复用 CANNWork 已为 opencode 建立的登录态，每个请求从磁盘现读 JWT 与虚拟密钥，不需要另起 OAuth 流程或额外填 key，账号可见的模型会注册进模型选择器。

description.en: Per-Session OpenRouter routing: a loopback relay writes `service_tier`, `provider.sort` and the `:floor` variant into each request from one of nine presets picked on the composer chip, with a pinned base URL per preset for route-level defaults.
description.zh: 按会话切换 OpenRouter 路由：本地回环中继把 `service_tier`、`provider.sort` 与 `:floor` 变体写进每个请求，九个预设从输入框的按钮里选，每个预设另有固定的基址供整条路由使用。

plugins.name: dsh-sub2api

description.en: Connect a sub2api gateway to DeepSeek Harness: OpenAI-compatible multi-provider routes (OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini) behind one base URL, with per-key model discovery, usage lookup, and global vision/image tools.
description.zh: 将 sub2api 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness：用一个 base URL 统一管理 OpenAI / Claude / Grok / Gemini 等多供应商路由，支持按 key 发现模型、用量查询与全局视觉/图像生成工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Automatically retries model failures (drops, timeouts, rate limits, 5xx) in-turn. Retry count, delays, backoff, fallback and more are configurable. Rate-limit backoff is capped and jittered, server retry hints are honored, and optional retry-until-success keeps going within a time ceiling. Every option is editable from the plugin config or the sidebar panel: retry count, initial and max delay, backoff factor and jitter, rate-limit delay window, retry-until-success ceiling, fallback trigger and switch cap, dead-route blacklist TTL, log file. When a route keeps failing it can switch to a pinned, allowlist-filtered, or catalog-picked alternate model route, with a 30-minute dead-route blacklist (auth failure, subscription expired, billing) and a stale-assembly guard that keeps retried requests on the switched route. Ships a right-sidebar panel with live retry state, route labels and incident counters, Chinese and English locale, and memory-only logging by default.
description.zh: 自动重试断连类模型失败（传输中断、超时、限流、5xx、流中断），在同一次智能体回合内接管重试而不是让任务直接断掉。所有选项都能在插件配置或右侧栏面板里调整：重试次数、初始与最大延迟、退避系数与抖动、限流延迟窗口、一直重试的时间上限、换路线的触发条件与次数上限、死路黑名单时长、日志文件。限流按指数退避等待并尊重服务端重试提示，开启后可在时间上限内一直重试直到成功。路线持续失败时可自动切换到备选模型路线（可手工固定、白名单过滤或从模型目录挑选），死路（鉴权失败、订阅过期、欠费）拉黑 30 分钟，并有旧装配守卫保证重试请求确实走在新路线上。附右侧栏状态面板（重试状态、路线标签、事故计数），中英双语，默认仅内存日志、可选设置文件。

plugins.name: dsh-clinebot

description.en: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClineBot/ClinePass 集成：专属设置页、实时配额仪表板、界面内密钥保存、精选与自定义模型选择，以及 /cline 命令。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to api.cline.bot

description.en: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
description.zh: 为每个提供方维护 API Key 池并自动创建克隆路由，在配额或限流错误时切换到下一个 Key，主动探测冷却中的 Key 以便恢复，并在设置中提供 Key 池、冷却时间与切换状态码的编辑界面。

plugins.name: dsh-model-sync

description.en: Synchronizes the model catalog of API-key providers from the provider itself instead of maintaining the model list by hand.
description.zh: 自动从服务商同步 API Key 提供方的模型列表，无需手动维护。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-ollama-cloud-provider

description.en: Ollama Cloud provider for DeepSeek Harness with native and OpenAI-compatible transports.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Ollama Cloud 模型接入，支持原生及 OpenAI 兼容传输。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-provider

description.en: OpenCode Console and OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Console 与 OpenCode Go 两个 provider。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-subscriptions

description.en: Registers ChatGPT Codex, Claude, Grok and Antigravity subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers through OAuth, so no API key is needed for them.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT Codex、Claude、Grok 与 Antigravity 订阅注册为 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方，无需为其配置 API Key。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Harness-owned lifecycle for the dario proxy — starts it with your harness, readiness-gates it, and stops it when the harness stops, so subscription-backed (Claude/ChatGPT) model routes just work.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动并管理 dario 代理（把 Claude/ChatGPT 订阅当 API 用），就绪门控、随停随止，订阅模型路由开箱即用。

description.en: Connects a locally-signed-in Cursor desktop app to dsh as a native LlmAdapter — reads the Cursor login token from state.vscdb or auth.json, drives the private agent.v1.AgentService/Run HTTP/2 bidi stream, and translates InteractionUpdate deltas into dsh StreamChunks. No loopback proxy. macOS, Windows and Linux.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 Cursor 桌面应用接入 dsh，原生 LlmAdapter 直连：从 state.vscdb 或 auth.json 读登录态，驱动 agent.v1.AgentService/Run 的 HTTP/2 双向流，把 InteractionUpdate 增量翻成 dsh StreamChunk，不走 loopback 代理。支持 macOS / Windows / Linux。

description.en: Only the domains you list go through a proxy: add a model host that needs the proxy to be reachable, and web search plus every other request stays on the normal network. Multiple named proxies can serve different domains, with a never-proxy list on top; saved settings apply on the next request without a restart.
description.zh: 某个模型的 API 要代理才连得上？把它的域名填进来就行——只有你列出的域名走代理，网页搜索等其它请求照旧直连，互不打扰。可以配多个代理分给不同域名，也能指定某些域名永远不走代理；保存后下一次请求就生效，不用重启。

description.en: Reuses stored Responses IDs for continuation, with retry and branch isolation and verified history replay.
description.zh: 复用 Responses 存储 ID 续传，隔离重试与分支，并核对历史回放。

description.en: OpenCode Zen free-tier models for DeepSeek Harness with anonymous no-key access, a loopback OpenAI-compatible shim, and real bash/read gate tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenCode Zen 免费模型：默认免 key 走公共额度，内置回环 OpenAI 兼容 shim，并把网关要求的 bash/read 注册为真实可执行工具。

plugins.name: dsh-better-reasoning-effort

description.en: Per-model reasoning-effort and input-modality configuration for third-party providers: suggestions fused from a model knowledge base and raw /models endpoint evidence with confidence labels, edited inside the official Models page card.
description.zh: 为第三方供应商模型按模型配置思考强度与输入模态：知识库与原始 /models 端点取证融合建议并标注置信度，在官方「模型」页卡片内直接编辑。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-clinepass

description.en: ClinePass provider for DeepSeek Harness: 15 bundled subscription and free models, a settings page with per-model capacity overrides, subscription usage for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, and multi-account failover to a backup account.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClinePass 模型提供方：内置 15 个订阅与免费模型，提供设置页与按模型容量覆盖、5 小时／每周／每月订阅用量，以及多账号与备用账号自动切换。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-go-plus

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription models as a DeepSeek Harness provider: re-resolves the live gateway catalog every few minutes, auto-adapts models the built-in table has not seen, and covers streaming, tool calls, image input and subscription usage. A maintained fork of dsh-opencode-go: a clash with the upstream package over the llm-opencode-go settings namespace makes it withdraw quietly instead of failing the whole plugin tree, and an already-claimed opencode-go route makes it serve on opencode-go-plus.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Go 订阅模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：每隔几分钟重新解析网关实时目录，内置表里没有的模型按同族自动适配，支持流式输出、工具调用、图片输入与订阅额度显示。这是 dsh-opencode-go 的维护分支：与上游包争用 llm-opencode-go 设置命名空间时安静退场，而不是让整棵插件树加载失败；opencode-go 路由已被占用时改用 opencode-go-plus 路由继续服务。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.
description.zh: 限流或配额耗尽时自动切换模型提供方：可按提供方配置模型，带冷却机制与永久最终兜底。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-moe4all

description.en: Runs MoE4All models locally in DSH with automatic engine installation, model discovery and downloads, inference settings, and live speed monitoring, or connects to an existing service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中运行 MoE4All 本地模型，支持引擎自动安装、模型发现与下载、推理参数配置和实时速度监控，也可连接已有服务。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds Standard Compute as an OpenAI-compatible model provider through the built-in pi-ai adapter, with its standardcompute router model and two direct model pins; configuration only, no code.
description.zh: 通过内置 pi-ai 适配器将 Standard Compute 添加为 OpenAI 兼容模型供应商，包含 standardcompute 路由模型和两个直连模型；仅配置，无代码。

description.en: Per-model reasoning effort (off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh) for GPT, Codex, Gemini and OpenAI-compatible models. Installs a helper, not a runtime adapter: run enable-capabilities.ps1 once per profile (Windows) and restart — it declares the levels in ~/.dsh/settings.yaml, with a disable script and a backup to revert.
description.zh: 为 GPT、Codex、Gemini 与 OpenAI-compatible 模型提供按模型的推理等级（off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh）。装的是 helper 而不是运行时适配器：需按 profile 手动跑一次 enable-capabilities.ps1（Windows）并重启——它把等级声明写进 ~/.dsh/settings.yaml，附带还原脚本与备份。

description.en: Choose API hostnames from configured providers or add them manually to route matching DSH backend Fetch/Undici requests through an existing local HTTP(S) proxy, leaving other routes unchanged; optional in-memory records show actual dispatch paths, first-content wait, token throughput and usage without storing prompts, responses or API keys.
description.zh: 从已配置的 Provider 选择 API 域名或手动添加，让命中的 DSH 后端 Fetch/Undici 请求通过已有本机 HTTP(S) 代理，其他请求沿用原有路线；可选开启内存调用记录，查看实际分发路线、首内容等待、token 速度与用量，不保存提示词、回答或 API Key。

description.en: Displays CodexRadar model capability benchmarks in a Settings page and shows the selected session model's DeepSWE score beside the composer.
description.zh: 在设置页展示 CodexRadar 模型能力评测，并在输入框旁显示当前会话所选模型的 DeepSWE 分数。

plugins.name: dsh-workbuddy2api-hub

description.en: Registers the models of a local workbuddy2api-hub gateway into DSH as one OpenAI-compatible provider per gateway API key, each key keeping its own model selection, and shows the main key's credit balance plus today's and this week's tokens, credits and API-equivalent cost in a sidebar badge. Requires workbuddy2api-hub running locally.
description.zh: 把本地 workbuddy2api-hub 网关的模型接进 DSH：网关里有几条 API Key 就同步成几条 provider，每条 key 的模型勾选各自独立；侧边栏徽标显示主 key 的积分余额和今日、本周的 tokens、积分与 API 等价花费。需本机运行 workbuddy2api-hub。
