capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Replaces the official Models settings page with provider lifecycle management, per-model reasoning effort tiers, retry overrides, drag reorder and upstream model sync.
description.zh: 替代官方「模型」设置页：提供方生命周期管理、每模型思考档位、重试覆盖、拖动排序与上游模型同步。

description.en: Per-model input type and thinking level declarations on the 模型 settings page — 输入类型 checkboxes on every provider card, and a 思考等级 field in the provider 编辑 dialog. Writes the official pi-ai input and reasoningEfforts fields.
description.zh: 在「模型」设置页面按模型声明输入类型与思考等级——每个渠道卡片上的「输入类型」勾选框，以及渠道「编辑」对话框里的「思考等级」。写入 pi-ai 官方的 input 与 reasoningEfforts 字段。

description.en: Exposes the accounts in a local CC Switch database to DeepSeek Harness: every account (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Build) becomes a model category in the picker, and the SQLite database is re-read on every model listing and request, so switching accounts in CC Switch needs no DSH restart. Requires CC Switch and the DSH desktop app.
description.zh: 把本地 CC Switch 数据库里的账号接进 DeepSeek Harness：Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Grok Build 的每个账号在模型选择器里各成一类，列模型与发请求时都会重读 SQLite 数据库，在 CC Switch 里换账号不必重启 DSH。需 CC Switch 与 DSH 桌面端。

description.en: Bridge DSH to OpenCode-compatible models via the local OpenCode CLI: native LlmAdapter passthrough, persistent OC sessions with cross-turn tool results, tool mirroring, and a CLI environment check panel. Requires the OpenCode CLI installed locally.
description.zh: 经本机 OpenCode CLI 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode 兼容模型：原生 LlmAdapter 透传、OC 会话持久续接（工具结果跨轮可见）、工具镜像回传、CLI 环境检测面板。需本机已安装 OpenCode CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-model-context-catalog

description.en: Match context windows for configured DSH models in one click, show capacity sources, and support selective bulk configuration, manual editing, and continuous synchronization.
description.zh: 一键匹配 DSH 已配置模型的上下文窗口，展示容量来源，支持勾选批量配置、手动编辑和持续同步。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Model settings panel for DeepSeek Harness: set the default model for new sessions, plus separate provider/model/reasoning-effort overrides for subagents and goal rounds, with live reload.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 模型设置面板：设置新会话的默认模型，并为子代理与 goal 回合分别配置 provider、模型和推理强度，保存后热更新。

description.en: GLM Mode agent preset for zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash: PTC/Code Mode tool presentation, a reasoning loop guard and a tool spin guard (live-incident driven), and GLM-specific auto-compaction at 75%/22%.
description.zh: 为 zhipuai/glm-5.3-flash 调优的「GLM 模式」Agent 预设：PTC 程序化工具调用、思考死循环守卫与工具空转守卫双层防护（源自活体事故复盘）、GLM 专属自动压缩（75%/22%）。

description.en: Configures forward proxies per enabled provider in Settings (HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5), keeping unconfigured providers and other traffic direct.
description.zh: 在设置里为每个已启用的 provider 单独配置正向代理（HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5），未配置的 provider 与其它流量保持直连。

description.en: Brings the models of the SCNet (超算互联网) Computing Service desktop client into DSH by reusing the API key that client already wrote, with a 30-model catalog and a per-model default thinking level.
description.zh: 复用超算互联网（SCNet）计算服务客户端已写入的 API key，把它的模型接入 DSH，带 30 个模型的目录与逐模型默认思考档位。

description.en: Model failover and turn keep-alive for DeepSeek Harness: a request that fails with a model error before any visible output falls through the models of the configured provider groups (then the next provider) until one streams; transient failures retry with backoff under a liveness watchdog, a dead turn self-resumes with templated 「继续」 wake-ups, and an optional full-auto mode auto-answers permission, question and plan approvals with every decision appended to an AUTO-MODE.md audit log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 模型故障自动回退与轮次保活：请求在产出任何可见内容前因模型错误失败时，沿所选供应商分组的模型（再到下一个供应商）逐个切换直到流式成功；瞬态失败按指数退避自动重试并有活性看门狗防假死，整轮任务失败后自动发送模板化「继续」唤醒续跑；可选全自动模式自动应答权限审批、确认提问与方案评审，每次自动决策追加到 AUTO-MODE.md 审计日志。

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

description.en: Keeps the shared default model pinned, so switching the model inside a chat no longer rewrites the global default and no longer lowers that default's reasoning effort.
description.zh: 锁定共享的默认模型：在聊天里切换模型不再改写全局默认值，也不会再被那次切换连带降档推理强度。

plugins.name: workbuddy-to-dsh#dsh-plugin

description.en: Registers a local OpenAI-compatible bridge as a native dsh model provider: reuses the models already signed in on the desktop app on this machine, manages the bridge and its local dashboard process, and adds five tools, a /workbuddy command and a nine-tab settings panel. Requires the desktop app to be installed and signed in on the same machine; the bridge binds 127.0.0.1 only.
description.zh: 把本机的本地 OpenAI 兼容桥注册成 dsh 原生模型 provider：复用这台机器桌面端已登录的模型，管理桥与其本地控制台进程，并附带 5 个工具、/workbuddy 命令与 9 个标签页的设置面板。需同机已安装并登录该桌面端；桥只监听 127.0.0.1。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a web device-code sign-in and sign-out entry for the built-in GitHub Copilot provider in DSH, presets an out-of-the-box Copilot provider route, keeps credentials in the built-in credential store, and manages the model catalog as a first-login fallback that never overwrites customized model entries.
description.zh: 为 DSH 内置的 GitHub Copilot 通道补充网页设备码登录与注销入口，预置开箱即用的 Copilot 提供方路由，凭据存入内置凭据库，模型目录仅在首次登录兜底填充一次、永不覆盖已定制的模型条目。

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: provider-scoped PDF and image input, with Responses API streaming support.
description.zh: 火山方舟 Coding Plan 的 DeepSeek Harness LLM provider：provider 级 PDF 与图片输入，支持 Responses API 流式。

description.en: Signs in and manages accounts for 16 AI coding providers, plus a cross-provider rotation channel: multi-account pools, automatic credential refresh, credit claiming where the provider offers it, and a local OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 登录并管理 16 个 AI 编程服务商的账号，另含一个跨渠道轮换渠道：多账号池、凭据自动续期、服务商支持时的积分领取，以及本地 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description.en: Pool AI provider accounts per platform and route them through a local loopback proxy that bridges the OpenAI, OpenAI-Responses, Anthropic and Gemini protocols, then write the proxy into Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Grok, OpenCode, OpenClaw and Hermes config files with snapshot-and-rollback safe writes; registers no agent tools.
description.zh: 按平台把 AI 供应商账号组成算力池，经本地回环代理路由并在 OpenAI、OpenAI-Responses、Anthropic、Gemini 四种协议间桥接，再用带快照回滚的安全直写把代理写进 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini CLI、Grok、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Hermes 的配置文件；不注册任何 agent 工具。

description.en: Adds a browserless deepseek-web provider that drives chat.deepseek.com, with an account pool (rotation, cooldown, auto-failover), in-panel login (browser, or email + password with MFA) and token usage stats.
description.zh: 把 chat.deepseek.com 网页版接成 deepseek-web provider：纯 HTTP 无浏览器，多账号轮换/冷却/自动切换，插件内登录（浏览器，或邮箱+密码+验证码），带 token 用量统计。

description.en: Declares the OpenCode Go and Command Code route wire protocol and endpoint (so the API address never has to be typed), adds the DeepSeek V4.1 models to the OpenCode Go route and puts them first, completes the Command Code model list from its public catalog, and attaches a per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode requests (fixes 400 MissingSessionID).
description.zh: 为 opencode-go 与 Command Code 路由声明 wire 协议和 API 地址（不用手填地址）；把 DeepSeek V4.1 模型补进 opencode-go 路由并排到最前；从公开目录补齐 Command Code 的模型清单；并为发往 OpenCode 的请求附加按会话的 x-opencode-session 头（修 400 MissingSessionID）。

plugins.name: dsh-openrouter-free-models

description.en: Discovers OpenRouter's free models, measures their real speed and context size, and writes them into the DeepSeek Harness model list fastest-first, with speed and context in each display name, plus a Settings section to configure and run it.
description.zh: 自动筛选 OpenRouter 免费模型，实测真实速度与上下文大小，并按速度从快到慢写入 DeepSeek Harness 模型列表，模型名中带上速度与上下文，同时在设置中新增「免费模型」配置页。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-speed

description.en: Adds a Speed setting (Standard, Fast, Ultrafast) for OpenAI and Codex models on a patched dsh build: the pinned dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 web client needs the Model / Effort child-slot patch, the host pi-ai must be 0.87.1 or 1.1.0 (other versions refuse to load), and the terminal controls need a patched dsh-TUI. Then it appears in the Model / Effort menu; in dst /speed opens a picker or sets the speed directly, and the current speed shows in the bottom bar. The choice is kept per session, provider and model and is sent as the request service tier.
description.zh: 为 OpenAI 与 Codex 模型增加 Speed 设置（Standard／Fast／Ultrafast），但需要打过补丁的 dsh 构建：钉住的 dsh 0.2.1-alpha.2 Web 客户端要加上 Model / Effort 子槽补丁，宿主 pi-ai 必须是 0.87.1 或 1.1.0（其他版本会拒绝加载），终端控制还需打过补丁的 dsh-TUI。满足条件后它会出现在 Model / Effort 菜单；在 dst 里 /speed 可打开选择器或直接设置，底栏显示当前档位。选择按会话、供应商和模型分别保存，并作为请求的 service tier 发送。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-tool-antigravity

description.en: Connect Google Antigravity OAuth accounts to DeepSeek Harness with smart multi-account quota rotation, multi-model LLM routing, and Nano Banana 2 image generation.
description.zh: 接入 Google Antigravity OAuth 账号，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能多账号池额度自愈轮换、全系多模型流式路由及 Nano Banana 2 图像生成。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Connects the MiniMax Code models to DSH - reusing the desktop app's sign-in or signing in on its own - with Anthropic-compatible model access, a live model catalog, the daily check-in that grants the free credits, and a credit balance that follows the model you selected.
description.zh: 将 MiniMax Code 的模型接入 DSH：复用桌面 App 登录态或用设备码自行登录，提供 Anthropic 兼容接入、动态模型目录、每日签到领取免费额度，以及跟随所选模型显示的积分余额与到期提示。

plugins.name: dsh-model-palette

description.en: Global Alt+M model command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web: fuzzy search over models and providers, favorites and recents, per-model reasoning effort, provider and model configuration, request retries, capacity presets, and optional OpenRouter image/video generation tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的全局 Alt+M 模型命令面板：模型与提供商的模糊搜索、收藏与最近使用、每模型思考档位、提供商与模型配置、请求重试、容量预设，以及可选的 OpenRouter 图片/视频生成工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Captures and compares single-token behavioral fingerprints of configured DSH model routes using the One Token Is Enough protocol.
description.zh: 使用《One Token Is Enough》论文协议，对 DSH 已配置的模型路由采集并比较单 token 行为指纹。

plugins.name: dsh-workbuddy2api-panel

description.en: Reads a running workbuddy2api-panel over its HTTP API and syncs its models into the DSH model picker with credit multipliers, CN/international realm labels and per-model reasoning-effort levels; also shows remaining credits and usage in a settings page and a sidebar badge.
description.zh: 读取运行中的 workbuddy2api-panel 的 HTTP 接口，把面板模型连同倍率、国内/国际分区与逐模型思考档位同步进 DSH 的模型选择器，并在设置页与侧边栏徽标中显示剩余额度与用量。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: The model switch for DSH: point it at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with curated free/cheap DeepSeek provider presets and automatic fallback when a free tier rate-limits you.
description.zh: DSH 的模型切换器：指向任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，内置精选免费/低价 DeepSeek 服务商预设，免费额度限流时自动回退。

description.en: Declarative provider/model fallback chains for the model picker: an ordered root chain plus named pools, failure-code triggered switching, per-model cooldowns, time-slot presets, and subagent role routing. A fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks 0.6.5; do not install it alongside that plugin (both use the "llm-fallbacks" profile row id).
description.zh: 模型选择器用的可配置降级链：有序主链加命名池，按失败码自动切换，支持按模型冷却、分时段预设与子代理角色路由。omdsh-dev/dsh-llm-fallbacks 0.6.5 的 fork；不要与上游同时安装（两边的 profile 行 id 都是 "llm-fallbacks"）。

plugins.name: dsh-model-sync

description.en: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
description.zh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Weak-network adaptor: transparent long-backoff model-stream retries (10-min cap), local response replay cache, heartbeat auto-reconnect, and degraded-mode token economy, with a bilingual (zh/en) settings page.
description.zh: 弱网适配器：模型流式请求的长退避透明重试（上限 10 分钟）、本地响应重放缓存、心跳自动重连、降级模式 token 节流，并提供中英双语设置页。

description.en: Model switching and reasoning-effort control for DeepSeek Harness: set_model and list_models agent tools let the agent autonomously change its provider, model or thinking depth (reasoning effort) mid-task with a mandatory reason, a provider whitelist and a context-window token-pressure guard, the active model is injected into the runtime context, and Plan Mode auto-transition switches to a configured planning model on entering plan mode and restores the previous execution model on exit.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供动态模型切换与思考深度调节：set_model / list_models 两个 Agent 工具让模型按任务难度自主切换 provider、model 与 reasoningEffort（思考深度），强制附带切换理由，带 Provider 白名单与上下文窗口 Token 水位护栏，活跃模型注入运行时上下文；进入 Plan 规划模式自动切换到配置的规划模型，退出自动恢复日常执行模型。

description.en: Compliantly use your own Antigravity quota in dsh: bridges your local logged-in official Antigravity CLI (agy) session as the chat and subagent model provider.
description.zh: 合规地在 dsh 中使用你自己的 Antigravity 额度：将本机已登录的官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）会话桥接为主对话与子代理模型提供方。

plugins.name: dsh-spark-scope

description.en: Shows a Spark Scope card at the bottom of the dsh sidebar: model server decode and prefill rates with sparklines, running and queued requests, KV cache, TTFT and TPOT p95, and GPU temperature, power, load and memory for each DGX Spark node. Read-only; needs a running Spark Scope server. Works in dsh web and the desktop app.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧边栏底部显示 Spark Scope 卡片：模型服务的 decode 与 prefill 速率及走势图、运行中与排队请求、KV 缓存、TTFT 与 TPOT p95，以及每个 DGX Spark 节点的 GPU 温度、功耗、负载和显存。只读，需要已运行的 Spark Scope 服务。dsh web 与桌面应用均可使用。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to spark-scope.local:8787

description.en: Planner/executor delegation with named roles: a strong planner steers, disposable executor sub-agents (per-role routes and prompts) implement. Default role plus per-delegation override, a global reasoning-effort knob in the composer chip, and a settings page for role management.
description.zh: 规划者/执行者委派调度：高阶模型（Planner）定方向，一次性低阶执行子代理（按角色的路由与提示词）干具体活；默认角色 + 单次委派覆盖，输入框芯片快速切换角色与全局思考等级，设置页管理执行角色。

description.en: Rate-limits LLM requests per provider and per model using a reservation-based token bucket, with queue or reject modes, plus gateway identity rules that rewrite user-agent and inject custom headers.
description.zh: 按供应商与模型粒度限速 LLM 请求，预约式令牌桶支持排队或拒绝两种模式，附带网关身份规则（改写 User-Agent、注入自定义请求头）。

description.en: Adds a settings page for declaring per-model reasoning efforts and vision support on pi-ai provider routes.
description.zh: 在设置里新增「模型能力」一页，为每个模型声明思考档位与视觉能力。

description.en: Import local Codex, Grok, Claude, OpenCode, and CC Switch logins into DSH; pick sources and enable models in Settings.
description.zh: 把本机 Codex / Grok / Claude / OpenCode / CC Switch 登录态导入 DSH，在设置里自选来源并启用模型。

description.en: Registers the workbuddy model provider by mounting dsh-llm-workbuddy and supervises the local wb2api gateway, then bundles two protocol bridges onto that same gateway: Responses for OpenAI Codex CLI, and Anthropic Messages for Claude Code and Claude Desktop, which see the gateway models under generated claude-wb-… ids. Skips work that is already running or already registered, and reports each part through a status tool. Requires a local wb2api gateway and a WorkBuddy account.
description.zh: 通过挂载 dsh-llm-workbuddy 注册 workbuddy 模型 provider，托管本地 wb2api 网关，并在同一网关前内置两条协议桥：给 OpenAI Codex CLI 的 Responses，以及给 Claude Code 与 Claude 桌面端的 Anthropic Messages——后两者以生成的 claude-wb-… id 看到网关模型。已在运行或已注册的部分会跳过，并通过状态工具汇报各环节状况。需本机有 wb2api 网关并有 WorkBuddy 账号。

description.en: Three independent language channels for model output — tool-call descriptions (every tool-call card title, including run_code in PTC-style presets), thinking, and replies — each set to follow the web GUI language, force a specific language, or turn off (default: only descriptions, following the GUI). One global runtime-context prompt directive on the host; the client half reports the GUI language; a Settings plugin card switches the modes.
description.zh: 模型产出文本的三个语言通道——工具调用描述（所有工具调用卡片标题，含 PTC 类预设的 run_code）、思考与回复——各自可跟随网页界面语言、强制指定语言或关闭（默认仅描述通道跟随界面语言）。host 侧注入一条全局 runtime-context 提示指示，client 半上报界面语言，设置里的插件卡片负责切换。

description.en: LLM provider that runs the locally installed Claude Code CLI as the model backend, so requests go through an existing Claude subscription instead of a metered API key; native tool calls are bridged over MCP.
description.zh: LLM 供应商：把本机已安装的 Claude Code CLI 作为模型后端，请求走已订阅的 Claude 账号，无需按量计费的 API key；原生工具调用经 MCP 桥接。

description.en: Turn a logged-in DeepSeek web account into an OpenAI and Anthropic compatible endpoint, with tool calling, image input, an account pool and a local admin console. First use needs a one-time `node scripts/fetch-assets.mjs` in the installed plugin directory to download DeepSeek's PoW runtime from the vendor CDN; without it the proxy starts but every upstream request fails.
description.zh: 把已登录的 DeepSeek 网页账号包装成 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容接口，支持工具调用、图片输入、账号池与本地管理台。首次使用需在插件目录手动运行一次 `node scripts/fetch-assets.mjs`，从 DeepSeek 官方 CDN 拉取 PoW 运行时；未拉取时反代能启动，但所有上游请求都会失败。

description.en: Shows Provider/Model in the DSH Web composer model selector trigger; the dropdown list and its search are unchanged.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话框模型选择器的触发器显示「供应商/模型」；下拉列表与其搜索均不变。

plugins.name: dsh-bailian-catalog

description.en: Bailian (DashScope / Model Studio) model catalog in the DSH settings page: lists every model the configured API key can reach, groups them by model family, probes whether a model is actually callable (an unopened model answers 403, which DSH reports as an invalid key), refuses to add models that fail the probe, and shows the active session's context window and remaining budget. An sk- key has no balance endpoint, so quota here means context quota.
description.zh: DSH 设置页里的百炼（DashScope / Model Studio）模型目录：列出当前 API Key 可用的全部模型、按模型家族分组，可探测某模型是否真的可调用（未开通会返回 403，而 DSH 会把它显示成密钥无效），探测不通过的模型拒绝加入配置，并显示当前会话的上下文窗口与剩余额度。百炼 sk- Key 没有余额接口，因此这里的额度指上下文额度。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Codex-style model selector for the composer listing every provider/model in the profile, with four reasoning-effort levels and per-session persistence; disabling of the native selector ships inside the package.
description.zh: 输入框内的 Codex 风格模型选择器：列出 profile 全部 provider/model，四档推理力度，选择按会话记忆；原生选择器的禁用补丁随包内置。

description.en: Use third-party subscription accounts in DeepSeek Harness: chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing with the models your subscription covers, with available models and reasoning levels synced from your account; currently supports OpenAI/ChatGPT subscriptions, more providers planned.
description.zh: 用第三方订阅账户在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用订阅覆盖的模型：文字对话、图片理解、图片生成与图片编辑，可用模型与推理等级随账户自动同步；当前支持 OpenAI / ChatGPT 订阅，更多订阅服务规划中。

description.en: Switch OpenAI models between Codex-style Responses WebSocket transport and SSE from the composer, inheriting DSH provider settings with an optional priority-tier toggle.
description.zh: 继承 DSH 渠道配置，在输入框旁切换 OpenAI 模型的 Codex 风格 Responses WebSocket 与 SSE 传输，并可开启优先处理模式。

description.en: Antigravity provider for DeepSeek Harness: resolves the OAuth client from the locally installed official desktop app and supports multiple accounts with quota-based automatic switching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Antigravity 模型供應商：從本機安裝的官方桌面應用程式解析 OAuth client，支援多帳號管理與額度自動切換。

plugins.name: dsh-image-bridge

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image for a model that cannot draw, through any OpenAI-compatible image API, with multiple providers and an automatic fallback model.
description.zh: 让没有生图/修图能力的模型接入任意 OpenAI 兼容生图接口：支持文生图与图生图，可添加多个服务商，并为生图与修图各选主用与备用模型，主模型连不上时自动切换到备用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds the KnyazevAI API provider and its DeepSeek, GLM, and MiniMax model catalog to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 KnyazevAI API 提供方及 DeepSeek、GLM 和 MiniMax 模型目录。

plugins.name: dsh-rustvy

description.en: Vendor marks in the model picker plus a model list kept in step with the provider: mirrors the public catalog and logos to loopback, and regenerates the pi-ai route's models from that route's own endpoint, showing the drift before anything is written.
description.zh: 在模型选择器中显示厂商标志，并让模型列表与提供方保持同步：把公开目录与标志镜像到本地回环地址，再依据路由自身的接口重新生成 pi-ai 路由的模型列表，写入之前先显示差异。

description.en: Adds the official Google Antigravity ACP agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, with tool execution and approval kept in DSH, Node 22.19+ and a signed-in Antigravity account required, a per-model quota pill and a settings page.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity ACP agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供商，工具执行与审批仍由 DSH 负责，附按模型切换的额度药丸和设置页；需 Node 22.19+ 并登录 Antigravity 账号。

description.en: Relays the ZCode CLI (the client-bundled coding agent) into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider: a resident app-server session injects the Start Plan account and signs each request with the OAuth plan token, so model requests burn ZCode Start Plan / Coding Plan quota directly — real streaming, image input, per-session resume, no API key.
description.zh: 把 ZCode CLI（客户端自带 agent）接入 DeepSeek Harness 的模型反代：常驻 app-server 会话 + Start Plan 账户注入 + 每请求 OAuth 鉴权，直接消耗 ZCode Start Plan / Coding Plan 额度，真流式、图片输入、会话续接，无需 API Key。

description.en: Runs your logged-in Claude Code CLI as a dsh model provider: live model list, session resume, approval relay, rewind, memory panel and remote SSH workspaces.
description.zh: 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 作为 dsh 的模型提供方：实时模型列表、按会话恢复、审批中转、回退、记忆面板，以及远程 SSH 主机上的工作区。

description.en: Exposes the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness through an OpenAI-compatible gateway, so other local projects can call them with any standard OpenAI client. Multiple provider candidates share one named group with ordered, balanced or random dispatch; upstream failures before any output switch to the next candidate transparently, and rate-limited requests are retried after the provider's backoff. Per-candidate call statistics (attempts, answers, failures, token/TTFT totals) appear as badges in the settings page, and daily aggregates persist to a local file with a 30-day heatmap and trend view. Until you create a key in the UI, the endpoint accepts calls from anyone who can reach it; keys (stored as SHA-256 hashes) then turn authentication on, and the endpoint stays locked even after the last key is revoked. Exposing the optional LAN listener without a key leaves the port open to the whole network. Runs on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 through 0.1.7-alpha.1 and later.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置好的模型通过 OpenAI 兼容网关中转出去，其他本地项目 用标准 OpenAI 客户端即可调用。多个供应商候选共享一个具名分组，支持顺序、均衡、 随机三种调度；上游在产出任何内容前失败时自动切换下一候选，客户端无感，被限流的 请求按供应商指示的退避时间自动重试。每条候选的调用统计（尝试、应答、失败、 token/TTFT 累计）以徽章形式显示在设置页，按天聚合的数据落盘为本地文件，附 30 天 热力图与趋势视图。在界面创建密钥之前，接口对任何能访问到它的人开放；创建密钥 （仅存 SHA-256 哈希）后开启校验，且删掉最后一个密钥仍保持锁定，需显式关闭鉴权 才会重新开放。若启用可选的局域网监听而未配密钥，该端口对整个局域网开放。支持 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 至 0.1.7-alpha.1 及以后。

description.en: One-step local model onboarding plus a light harness for DSH. On load it probes loopback and private-network inference endpoints (llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio), reads each model's context window and output budget from the backend, and registers the provider through settings, so a local model becomes selectable without hand-writing config. It then trims only that provider: masks the tool list through tools.restrict, drops named system-prompt sections and memory contexts, swaps the injected instruction block for a short one while preserving its first 80 and last 96 characters, and truncates tool-schema descriptions without touching structure or required fields. Cloud providers are returned as the same assembly object, untouched. The injected block is re-read from disk on every assembly, so editing the file takes effect on the next request with no reload. The panel in the plugin detail page is a live operations view: it shows whether the takeover is active and by which hook, how many characters the last assembly was trimmed from and to, and which providers are online (probed concurrently, with a real one-shot completion reporting latency and reply text per provider). If a local backend is not running, the panel offers a one-click launch: it probes the port first (never starting a duplicate), then starts the matching server (ollama serve, or a custom command you supply) detached and polls until the endpoint answers, clamping the wait to 3-600 seconds, reaping the child it just spawned if it never answers, and naming the paths it searched when it cannot find the binary. A stop button kills backends this plugin started (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL) and refuses to touch a server somebody else launched. When a model has just been downloaded and no backend exists yet, the panel can also scan the machine for .gguf files with hard caps (300 models, 20000 directory entries, Downloads only one level deep), start llama-server on the chosen one (skipping the .mmproj. vision projection and reusing a server that already answers), register the provider under the model id the backend reports, and run one real completion to prove it works. Before spawning anything it does a fit check that counts only the part of the file the GPU cannot hold: hostBytes = fileSize - VRAM, compared against max(total RAM - 2GB, free RAM). A file far larger than RAM is refused outright; a heavy host-side remainder is refused unless you confirm; the same remainder under mmap is only a warning, because the weights land in reclaimable page cache. A load-mode selector (auto / mmap / none / mlock / mmap+mlock) maps to llama.cpp --load-mode, and the default is whatever the engine picks. From 0.4.2 everything above is derived from the platform instead of assumed: home and data directories come from os.homedir() and the OS conventions (LOCALAPPDATA on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support on macOS, XDG_DATA_HOME elsewhere); backend binaries are looked up in the official install locations of each OS and can be pinned with OLLAMA_BIN, LLAMA_SERVER_BIN, VLLM_BIN or LMSTUDIO_BIN; model discovery walks DSH_LOCAL_MODELS_DIR, ~/models, ~/llama.cpp/models, ~/.cache/llama.cpp and the LM Studio data directory, with the WorkBuddy layout demoted to one candidate among them. VRAM is asked from nvidia-smi, then rocm-smi, then sysctl hw.memsize on Apple Silicon (flagged unified, so the same bytes are not charged twice), and any flip to a unified-memory budget is handled explicitly. Before building a command line the plugin runs llama-server --help once and keeps only the flags that build actually has, so older engines get --n-gpu-layers 99 and no KV quantization while newer ones get auto plus q8_0; anything it cannot probe is passed through rather than dropped. LM Studio is started with lms server start --port N rather than being lumped in with the engines that need a model argument, and vLLM gets its own --model example instead of llama.cpp syntax. Windows, macOS and Linux are all exercised in CI, including a windows-latest and a macos-latest job, because a cross-platform claim that has only ever run on one OS is not a claim. Two of those suites exist specifically to catch this machine's blind spots: one replays the whole suite with process.platform rewritten to each OS, and one deletes every advantage this development box has — no nvidia-smi, no rocm-smi, no sysctl, an empty PATH, a home directory with no models — and requires graceful degradation rather than a crash. That last one caught a real class of bug: several assertions hardcoded 'lms.exe', which cannot pass where the executable has no suffix. Measured on the reference machine: a 16.9GB 27.2B MoE with 14.5GB of VRAM holds a 285-691MB working set and sustains 76 tok/s after a 1000-2000 token warm-up, so file size alone is not a fit signal. From 0.4.3 the scanned models are shown as a table rather than a dropdown (one row per gguf, with its size and any fit warning), so you can see what is on disk before choosing. From 0.4.4 the delete button on the provider table removes the provider entry, not the weights file on disk. That distinction matters: what people actually want to clear out is the dead entry - one pointing at a port that never answered, one registered twice for the same port, one whose model file was deleted long ago - not a 15.8GB gguf. Deleting a config is undone by importing again; deleting a gguf is not. The removal goes through settings.mutate with an unset op on \['providers', id], because update merges layers: writing null there leaves a null provider key that the loader reads as a broken config rather than an absent entry, and only mutate/unset is implemented as Reflect.deleteProperty. The result is read back afterwards, because unset on a key that comes from a lower layer (the profile cordis.patch.yml or a home patch) does not delete it - it restores the inherited value, so the call succeeds while the entry stays. When the entry is still there the panel says so and points at the file to edit instead of reporting success, and a DSH whose settings service predates mutate() is told plainly rather than silently ignored. Deleting takes two clicks and clearing the confirmation is as easy as clicking another row; on success the online and baseURL caches are cleared and the tool surface is recomputed, since the provider list changed. The gguf itself is never touched by this plugin - the scanned-model table is display and selection only.VRAM reporting is driver-dependent. From 0.4.5 model discovery also reads Ollama's own storage: its blobs are named sha256-… with no extension, so extension matching could never list them. Weights are now accepted by extension OR by GGUF magic header (only dot-free files of at least 8MB, capped at 600 header reads per scan; obviously-not-weights extensions like .json/.md/.safetensors/.part are never opened). Ollama models are resolved from their manifests: the model layer is picked by mediaType application/vnd.ollama.image.model (never adapter/mmproj layers), the human-readable name is restored from the manifest path (…/qwen3/8b becomes qwen3:8b, …/latest stays bare), tags sharing one blob merge into a single row, and the metadata kv supplies name, quantization and context length. Adopting an Ollama model does not start a duplicate llama-server over the same weights: it confirms ollama serve answers on 11434 (launching it if not) and registers the provider under the tag the endpoint itself reports — the blob's sha256 name would never match anything, since 11434 lists qwen3:14b, not sha256-a8cc…. Two real-machine-only traps fixed on the way: existsSync('<file>/') returns true on Windows, so manifest-vs-directory branching now goes by parseable content instead of trailing-slash semantics; and the quantization label table had been copied from a stale ggml enum generation, labelling ggml_type 15 as Q5_K_S while ollama show reports Q4_K_M. Same-blob dedup is by (dev,ino), keeping whichever entry has a name. Verified on the reference machine: the scan goes from 1 row to 4 — qwen3:14b (8.64G) and qwen3:8b (4.87G) now appear with Q4_K_M badges — in 4ms; npm run verify exits 0 (launcher 57, portable 35, panel-host green including the linux/darwin simulated-platform runs); the new panel-host suite builds a real miniature Ollama store in tmpdir and points OLLAMA_MODELS at it, so results no longer depend on whether the test machine happens to have Ollama installed. From 0.4.6 the panel shows each model its real name instead of its file name, because some download tooling stores every weight under one generic file name, leaving the real name only inside the GGUF header. The scan now reads each file GGUF KV section - not a fixed-size head buffer, because tokenizer.ggml.tokens (hundreds of thousands of strings on a large MoE model) and the chat template push general.file_type past any window; and GGUF string arrays are interleaved (u64 length plus payload per element), so treating them as a length table walks the cursor off the rails and produces astronomically large reads. Reading and skipping are accounted separately: key names and types are always read, string values over 256KB and string arrays are only walked past without copying, non-string arrays over 64 elements are skipped outright, and a cursor past the file size stops the read, because an out-of-range position means the cursor is wrong rather than that a limit should be raised. The displayed name goes Ollama tag, then general.basename plus size_label, then general.name, then the file name, with the full string kept for the hover text since it usually carries internal build numbers; mmproj files are now identified by general.type as well as by name. A short read (truncated file) no longer feeds half a value into the parser. On the reference machine, reading one file header parses 44 keys in about 16ms, and a whole scan takes about 31ms. From 0.4.7 the smoke test no longer fails the first time and passes the second. The old code gave both request attempts one shared AbortController and one shared 30-second timer, so the total budget covered both rounds: a cold load of a large model burned it in round one, the abort left the signal permanently aborted, and the second round (the Ollama-style reasoning_effort: none retry) could not even be sent - which is exactly why the first click returned This operation was aborted and the second succeeded. Now each attempt gets its own controller and timer, a timeout retries once automatically (retryOnTimeout, on by default) because a first-request timeout almost always means the weights are still being read from disk, and non-timeout errors (refused connection, HTTP error) are not retried at all. Timeouts report themselves: the message says the wait exceeded smokeTimeout, whether a retry already happened, and points at the new smokeTimeout setting (seconds, default 60, clamped to 5-600) - port responding is not the same as tokens coming out, so it is a separate knob from launchTimeout. Unrelated: an example naming one specific model was dropped from the panel copy, since not every machine has that model downloaded, and the explanation now describes the mechanism instead.
description.zh: 给小本地模型的一步到位接入 + 轻量 harness。装载时自动探测回环与私有网段上的推理端点（llama.cpp、Ollama、vLLM、LM Studio），从后端读出每个模型的窗口与输出预算，再经 settings 注册 provider —— 不用手写配置就能在模型选择器里选到本地模型。随后只对这一个 provider 裁剪：用 tools.restrict 收缩工具面、按段名丢弃系统提示词段落与记忆 context、把注入的指令块换成一页纸同时保留其首 80 与末 96 字符、截断工具 schema 的 description 而不动结构与 required。云端 provider 原样返回同一个 assembly 对象，不做任何改动。注入正文每次装配都重新读盘，改文件下一次请求就生效，不用重载。插件详情页的面板是一块实时运行视图：显示接管是否生效、走的是哪个钩子，最近一次装配的字符进→出与省下的比例，以及各 provider 的在线灯（多路并发点灯，每个本地 provider 还能发一次真实的最小请求，把延迟与回复原文报出来）。本地后端没起来时，面板能一键拉起：先探测端口（已在应答就不重复启动），再按端口拉起对应后端（ollama serve，或你自己填的启动命令），进程独立于宿主存活，随后轮询到端口应答为止，等待上限夹在 3–600 秒，超时会把刚起的那个进程回收掉不留孤儿，找不到可执行文件时会把搜过的路径写清楚。面板上还有停止按钮，只肯停本插件自己起的后端（先 SIGTERM，1.5 秒不退再 SIGKILL），别人的服务一概不动。模型刚下好、后端还不存在时，面板能扫描本机 .gguf（跳过 .mmproj. 视觉投影、按大小降序，并带 300 个模型 / 20000 个目录项 / Downloads 只扫一层这三道上限），选一个就用它拉起 llama-server（端口上已有服务就复用），按后端自报的模型 id 注册 provider，再发一条真实请求证明能用。真正起之前会做一次装得下算账：只算显存装不下的那部分（hostBytes = 文件体积 − 显存），拿它比 max(总内存 − 2GB, 空闲内存)。文件比「显存 + 内存」还大直接拦；落到宿主的内存太多时先不替你起，要你确认；同样的情况若走 mmap 只给警告，因为权重落在可回收的页缓存里。加载方式下拉（auto / mmap / none / mlock / mmap+mlock）对应 llama.cpp 的 --load-mode，默认交给引擎自己决定。0.4.2 起上面每一条都改成按平台推导，而不是假设本机长什么样：家目录与数据目录走 os.homedir() 和各系统惯例（Windows 用 LOCALAPPDATA，macOS 用 ~/Library/Application Support，其它用 XDG_DATA_HOME）；后端二进制按各系统官方安装位置找，也可以用 OLLAMA_BIN / LLAMA_SERVER_BIN / VLLM_BIN / LMSTUDIO_BIN 钉死；找模型依次走 DSH_LOCAL_MODELS_DIR、~/models、~/llama.cpp/models、~/.cache/llama.cpp 与 LM Studio 数据目录，WorkBuddy 的布局降级成其中一个候选。显存先问 nvidia-smi，再问 rocm-smi，Apple Silicon 上问 sysctl hw.memsize 并标成统一内存（同一块字节不重复扣两次）。拼命令行之前会跑一次 llama-server --help，只保留这个 build 真有的参数 —— 老引擎给 --n-gpu-layers 99 且不下发 KV 量化，新引擎给 auto 加 q8_0；探测不出来的参数一律照传，不因为探不到就丢掉。LM Studio 用 lms server start --port N 起，不再和「必须先给模型参数」的引擎混在一起；vLLM 单独给 --model 的示例，不再套 llama.cpp 的写法。Windows、macOS、Linux 三套都在 CI 里跑，另加 windows-latest 与 macos-latest 两个 job —— 只在一个系统上跑过的「跨平台」不算跨平台。其中两套专门用来抓这台开发机的盲区：一套把 process.platform 改掉、整套测试按各系统重跑；另一套把开发机的所有有利条件全删掉（没有 nvidia-smi、没有 rocm-smi、没有 sysctl、PATH 是空的、家目录里没有模型），要求优雅退化而不是崩。后一套抓到过真实的一类 bug：好几处断言写死了 lms.exe，在可执行文件不带后缀的系统上根本不可能过。参考机实测：16.9GB 的 27.2B MoE 配 14.5GB 显存，进程工作集只有 285–691MB，预热 1000–2000 token 后稳定 76 tok/s —— 光看文件大小判断装不装得下是错的。0.4.3 起扫出来的模型是一张表而不是下拉框（每个 gguf 一行，带体积和偏大提示），选之前能看清磁盘上到底有什么。0.4.4 起 provider 表上的删除键删的是这条 provider 配置，不是磁盘上的权重文件。这个区别很重要：真正想清掉的是那种僵尸条目 —— 指向一个从没应答过的端口、同一个端口注册了两遍、或者模型文件早就删了还留着的那几条，而不是一个 15.8GB 的 gguf。删配置随时可以重新导入，删 gguf 不行。删除走settings.mutate 的 unset，路径是 \['providers', id]：不能用 update，因为 update 是合并层，往那儿写null 只会留下一个 null 的 provider 键，loader 会当成配置坏了而不是「没有这一条」；只有 mutate 的unset 内部是 Reflect.deleteProperty。删完会回读一次，因为对「来自下层（profile 的 cordis.patch.yml或 home patch）的键」做 unset 不是删除而是恢复继承值 —— 调用成功但条目还在。条目还在时面板会直说，并把该改哪个文件指出来，不谎报成功；settings 服务太老没有 mutate() 的版本也会明说，而不是默默忽略。删除要点两次，点别的行就撤回确认；删成功会清掉在线缓存与 baseURL 缓存并重算工具面，因为 provider列表变了。gguf 本身插件一个字节都不动 —— 扫描出来的那张表只用来展示和选中。且显存能不能读到取决于驱动。0.4.5 起模型扫描也读 Ollama 自己的存储：它的 blob 叫 sha256-… 、没有后缀，光按扩展名永远列不出来。现在认权重看后缀或文件头 GGUF 魔数（只开「无点号且 ≥8MB」的文件，一趟最多读 600 次魔数；.json/.md/.safetensors/.part 这类明显不是权重的后缀一次都不开）。Ollama 的模型从 manifest 还原：只取 mediaType 为 application/vnd.ollama.image.model 的层（mmproj/adapter 层不算主模型），人话名从 manifest 路径还原（…/qwen3/8b → qwen3:8b，latest 不加冒号），同一份 blob 被多个 tag 引用时合并成一行，metadata 的 kv 给出名称、量化和 context 上限。对 Ollama 的模型点「一键配置」不会再拿同一份权重重复起一份 llama-server：它确认 11434 上的 ollama 在应答（不在就 ollama serve），并按端点自己报的 tag 注册 provider —— 11434 上报的是 qwen3:14b，拿 blob 的 sha256 名永远匹配不上。顺带修掉两个只有真机才暴露的坑：Windows 上 existsSync('<文件>/') 返回 true，manifest 与目录的分岔改成按内容判定，不再依赖尾斜杠语义；量化标签表照搬了旧一代 ggml 枚举，把 ggml_type 15 标成 Q5_K_S，而 ollama show 实测报 Q4_K_M，整表按真实序号重写。同一份文件的去重按 (dev,ino)，谁有名字留谁。参考机实测：扫描从 1 行变 4 行 —— qwen3:14b（8.64G）与 qwen3:8b（4.87G）带着 Q4_K_M 徽标出现 —— 耗时 4ms；npm run verify 退出码 0（launcher 57 项、portable 35 项、panel-host 含 linux/darwin 模拟平台两套全绿）；panel-host 新增的用法在 tmpdir 里现造一份迷你 Ollama 存储再把 OLLAMA_MODELS 指过去，测试结果不再取决于跑测试的机器装没装 ollama。0.4.6 起面板显示的是模型自己的真名，不再是文件名：有些下载工具会把任何权重都落成同一个通用文件名，真名只写在 GGUF 头部里。扫描会读每个文件的 GGUF KV 区 —— 不是先读一段固定大小的头部，因为 tokenizer.ggml.tokens（大 MoE 模型动辄几十万条字符串）和 chat_template 会把 general.file_type 挤出任何窗口；而且 GGUF 的字符串数组是交错存储（每条 u64 长度加载荷），把它当长度表读会让游标跑偏、算出天文数字的读取量。读与走位分开记账：键名与类型必读，超过 256KB 的字符串值和字符串数组只走位不复制，非字符串数组超过 64 个元素直接跳过，游标越过文件末尾立刻停 —— 越界说明游标错了，不是该把上限调大。显示名依次取 Ollama 的 tag、general.basename 加 size_label、general.name、文件名，整串留在悬停里因为常带内部编号；视觉投影文件现在也靠 general.type 认，不只看文件名。短读（文件被截断）不再把半截字节喂给解析器。参考机实测：读一个文件的头部解析出 44 个键耗时约 16ms，整趟扫描约 31ms。0.4.7 起「试跑」不再出现「第一次失败、第二次成功」。老代码让两轮请求共用一个 AbortController 和一个 30 秒定时器，也就是两轮加起来只有 30 秒：大模型的冷加载第一轮就烧完它，abort 之后 signal 永久处于已中止状态，第二轮（换成 Ollama 认的 reasoning_effort: none 再试一次）连请求都发不出去 —— 这正是第一次点报 This operation was aborted、第二次却能成功的原因。现在每轮各自一个 controller 和定时器；超时自动再来一轮（retryOnTimeout 默认开），因为第一次请求超时几乎总是「权重还在读盘」；非超时错误（连不上、HTTP 报错）完全不重试。超时也会自己说清楚：文案里写明超过了多少秒、是否已自动重试，并指向新增的「试跑超时（秒）」配置项（默认 60，可设 5-600）—— 端口通了不等于能出字，它和「拉起后等端口（秒）」是两个不同的旋钮。顺带：面板提示里那句绑定某一个具体模型的举例去掉了，不是每台机器都下了那个模型，说明改成讲机制。

description.en: Unofficial Zhipu Qingyan (chatglm.cn) web provider — run DeepSeek Harness on web-app credits with a login token, streaming and prompt-bridged tool calls included.
description.zh: 非官方的智谱清言（chatglm.cn）网页版 provider——用网页版登录态与积分驱动 DSH，支持流式输出与提示词桥工具调用。

description.en: Changes and pins the shared default model — new conversations, restarts and switching models inside a chat no longer rewrite it.
description.zh: 修改并固定共享的默认模型：新建对话、重启、以及在对话里切换模型都不会再改写它。

description.en: LLM request retry plugin for DeepSeek Harness: when a model request fails with a configured HTTP status code, machine code, or provider field=value match, it sleeps for the per-rule delay and re-issues the request automatically, so subscription quota and rate-limit errors (429 / insufficient_quota) do not interrupt a run.
description.zh: 大模型请求重试插件：命中配置的 HTTP 状态码、机器码或 provider 返回字段=值时，按该条规则独立配置的时长休眠后自动重新请求，让订阅套餐的限额、限流报错（429 / insufficient_quota）不打断运行。

plugins.name: model-failover-manager

description.en: Model picker dialog with routing groups: a model that keeps failing hands the turn to the next usable model in its group, and the dialog also carries a metrics dashboard and a free-channel tab. That tab installs six channel plugins — Our Free Model (the only one that needs no login or API key), CodeArts, WorkBuddy, Trae, Qoder and Providers Hub — whose providers cover 23 platforms: Huawei Cloud CodeArts, Tencent CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, Youdao LobsterAI, Qoder, TRAE, Cline, iFlytek Loomy, SenseTime Raccoon, MiniMax, Zhipu ZCode, Gemini Code Assist, Alibaba Accio, iFlytek AStudio, OpenCode, OfficeAce, AutoClaw, ModelScope, Qiniu, Codely, MonkeyCode, Baizhi Cloud and MagiCrew.
description.zh: 模型选择弹窗＋路由分组：模型失败后自动换到组内下一个可用模型并继续本轮；另含数据看板与免费渠道页签。页签一键安装六个渠道插件 —— Our Free Model（唯一不登录、不填 API Key 也能用的）、CodeArts、WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder、Providers Hub，覆盖 23 个平台：华为云 CodeArts、腾讯 CodeBuddy、WorkBuddy、有道 LobsterAI、Qoder、TRAE、Cline、讯飞 Loomy、商汤 Raccoon、MiniMax、智谱 ZCode、Gemini Code Assist、阿里 Accio、讯飞 AStudio、OpenCode、OfficeAce、AutoClaw、魔搭 ModelScope、七牛云 Qiniu、Codely、MonkeyCode、百智云、超级麦吉 MagiCrew 等平台。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Use your DSH models in [Libre WebUI](https://github.com/libre-webui/libre-webui) for chat, sandboxed Work and usage tracking, with provider credentials kept in DSH. Requires Libre WebUI 0.37.0 or later.
description.zh: 在 [Libre WebUI](https://github.com/libre-webui/libre-webui) 中使用 DSH 模型进行聊天、沙箱 Work 任务和用量统计，提供商凭据保留在 DSH 中。需要 Libre WebUI 0.37.0 或更高版本。

description.en: Brings the providers you already configured in cc-switch into DeepSeek Harness: reads the cc-switch database, converts Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi entries into llm-pi-ai routes with their API keys, and adds a health check that measures time-to-first-byte and whether each stream completes.
description.zh: 把 cc-switch 里配好的模型供应商接进 DeepSeek Harness：读取 cc-switch 数据库，将 Claude / Codex / OpenClaw / MCode / Pi 等条目转成 llm-pi-ai 路由并写入 API Key，还提供实测首字节耗时与流能否正常收尾的体检。

plugins.name: dsh-proxy-routes

description.en: Per-provider (account) proxy routing for DSH. SOCKS5/HTTP proxy pool with account-level routing based on API keys. Supports forced direct connections and hot-swapping built-in web tools proxies. Managed via a graphical settings page in DSH.
description.zh: 按提供商（账号）分流的 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理池。基于 API 密钥识别账号实现精准分流，支持绝对直连（无视 DSH 全局代理）与内置联网工具代理热装。配置在 DSH 设置页图形化管理，保存即热生效。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Connects Tencent CodeBuddy CLI to DeepSeek Harness through ACP, with native CLI tool execution, multi-account management, and a standalone codebuddy_ask tool.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 将腾讯 CodeBuddy CLI 接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持 CLI 原生工具执行、多账户管理和 codebuddy_ask 独立问答。

description.en: Connects Qoder models to DeepSeek Harness through the official Qoder CLI over native ACP stdio (no reverse-engineered model API), with qoderclicn (China) having a verified real ACP tool loop; qodercli (international) is selectable but its real inference path is not yet verified. Requires Node.js 22.18+ and the chosen Qoder CLI installed and logged in on the same machine; the plugin does not install or manage accounts.
description.zh: 通过官方 Qoder CLI 以原生 ACP stdio 接入 Qoder 模型（无需逆向模型 API）；qoderclicn 中国版已通过真实 ACP 工具链路验证，qodercli 国际版可选但真实推理路径尚未验证。需 Node.js 22.18+，并在同一台机器上安装并登录所选 Qoder CLI；插件不安装 CLI、不管理账户。

description.en: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider with quota management and model selector.
description.zh: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist 模型提供商插件，支持配额查看与模型选择管理。

plugins.name: dsh-framework-doctor

description.en: Configure model providers by probing their endpoint, check DeepSeek Harness health, and repair what can be fixed.
description.zh: 给一个调用网址就自动配好模型，体检框架健康度，并修复可自动修复的问题。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: oh-my-dsh

description.en: Tiered model routing for DeepSeek Harness: think/build model tiers, vision delegation (the vision model only describes images; the working model acts), image generation, and a high-impact guard.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分级模型路由：think/build 模型分级、视觉委派（视觉模型只负责描述图片，工作模型负责执行操作）、图片生成，以及高影响操作守卫。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-coding-subscription-oauth

description.en: Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence.
description.zh: 编码订阅 OAuth，支持 SuperGrok / Grok Build、ChatGPT Plus Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code，并提供可选 loopback OpenAI/Anthropic 网关：本地登录无需粘贴 token，支持 AUTH 刷新重试、grok-4.6 xhigh，并可与 API-key 路由共存。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 100.64.0.0 for network access

description.en: Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live catalog is served from the host over a fenced route.
description.zh: 为模型选择器（每一行）与 composer 工具行显示峰谷倍率，按每个 provider 自己的时区与时段规则判定；实时目录由 host 经带信任围栏的路由下发。

plugins.name: dsh-claude-subscription

description.en: Adds a Claude Pro/Max OAuth provider with multiple accounts, optional account failover, cached quota reporting, live model catalogs, and quota UI in settings and conversations. Uses the Claude Code client identity; quota reporting uses an experimental endpoint.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 接入 Claude Pro/Max 订阅，支持多账号、可选故障切换、额度缓存、在线模型目录，以及设置页和会话额度入口。请求使用 Claude Code 客户端身份，额度查询使用实验性接口。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Models+ settings page for the DSH web UI: per-model reasoning-effort tables, input modalities and compat flags saved through the official settings pipeline, with models.dev metadata prefill and API key management.
description.zh: 模型+ 设置页:按模型声明推理挡位、输入模态与兼容参数(走官方 settings 管线保存),支持 models.dev 元数据预填与 API 密钥管理。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-web-free

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-web` provider that drives your own signed-in chat.deepseek.com account as an extra model in DSH, and also embeds the DeepSeek web app inside the DSH window: a right-sidebar tab, plus a draggable and resizable whale floating window whose position and size are remembered across restarts (the window follows the ball while you drag it). Sign-in is one-time and synchronized in both directions - signing in or out in the settings page or inside the panel updates the other side, so a restart does not ask again. The provider side needs no Open Platform API key: the sidebar footer lists your Web conversations, Fork to Workspace opens an independent Harness session that never writes back to the original conversation, native search stays on for the `default` model, and `/clean` is a session toggle that sends only the human text. Fork of y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web, kept working on current DSH 0.2.x (widened peer ranges, `ctx.settings.configure()` plus `.volatile()` config fields, renamed client icons, SSE errors surfaced as real errors instead of poisoning the session history). Installing it alongside the upstream dsh-deepseek-web is not supported: both register the same deepseek-web provider. Use only for personal convenience: reusing a web login from a third-party client may violate DeepSeek's terms of service and carries account risk (rate limiting, suspension, ban); the authors accept no responsibility for any consequences.
description.zh: 把你已登录的 chat.deepseek.com 账号当作额外模型接入 DSH，同时把 DeepSeek 网页端直接嵌进 DSH 窗口：右侧栏标签页，以及一颗可拖动、可拉伸的鲸鱼悬浮球窗口（位置与尺寸跨重启记忆，拖球时窗口跟随）。登录只需一次且双向同步——在设置页或面板内登录/退出都会同步到另一边，重启后无需重登。Provider 侧无需 Open Platform API key：侧边栏底部列出你的网页端会话，「Fork to Workspace」会开一个独立的 Harness 会话、不回写原对话，`default` 模型保持网页端原生搜索，`/clean` 是只发送人类文本的会话开关。本包是 y-wi/dsh-deepseek-web 的 fork，适配当前 DSH 0.2.x（放宽 peer 范围、用 `ctx.settings.configure()` 与 `.volatile()` 配置字段、更新改名的客户端图标、SSE 错误直接报错而不再污染会话历史）。不能与上游 dsh-deepseek-web 同装：两者注册同一个 deepseek-web provider。仅供个人方便使用：把网页端登录态用于第三方客户端可能违反 DeepSeek 服务条款，存在账号风险（限流 / 冻结 / 封禁），作者不承担任何责任。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Groups the DSH model picker by provider: the menu lists sources with their model counts, and hovering a source slides that provider's models out in a side panel (default); in panel mode a click opens the same panel, and double-clicking a source title cycles hover -> panel -> inline (expand below the title). The active model stays visible at a glance. Pure DOM enhancement with zero intrusion - the panel is plugin-owned DOM mounted on body and selection happens by programmatically clicking the real menu buttons, so no React-managed node is moved or removed, keeping the host rendering intact and coexisting with other UI plugins. Styling follows the host by reusing the official --dsw-* theme tokens, with an enforced opaque background, sufficient contrast, and one shared set of sizing and colour tokens for both menu levels. No network access and no telemetry. Built for DSH kernel 2.0.15-next.
description.zh: 把 DSH 模型选择器按来源（provider）分组：菜单只列来源与其模型数，悬停来源即在右侧滑出该来源的模型子面板（默认）；切换为面板模式后改为单击来源滑出，或改为在列表内就地展开，双击来源标题即可在 悬浮 -> 面板 -> 列表 三者间循环切换；当前使用的模型一眼可见。纯 DOM 增强、零侵入——面板是插件自建 DOM 并挂载到 body，选择通过程序化点击原菜单真实按钮完成，不移动也不删除任何 React 管理的节点，因此不影响原组件渲染，并能与其他 UI 插件共存。配色与排版跟随宿主：复用官方 --dsw-* 主题变量，背景保证不透明、对比度充足，来源清单与子集清单共用同一套尺寸与色值令牌。不联网、无遥测。适配 DSH 内核 2.0.15-next。

description.en: Configure thinking toggles and reasoning efforts per model for llm-pi-ai and official DeepSeek, and specify input modalities (input or inputModalities) in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板为 llm-pi-ai 与官方 DeepSeek 提供方按模型配置思考开关与思考等级，并为各模型配置多模态输入类型。

description.en: Caps every image sent to a model at a per-side pixel limit (default 2000 px) by wrapping attachments.readImageRequest, which fixes Anthropic many-image request errors without touching stored images.
description.zh: 把发给模型的每张图片按单边像素上限（默认 2000 px）压缩：通过包装 attachments.readImageRequest 实现，修复 Anthropic 多图请求报错，且不改动已存储的图片。

description.en: Fills in a cheaper sibling route for subagent calls that name no provider, model or effort (for example Opus to Sonnet 5.5 at medium, Qwen max to Qwen flash); explicit choices and subagent_fork are left alone. Requires the subagent-model-selection policy to be enabled with the target route in its allowedModels - without it the plugin does nothing.
description.zh: 为未指定 provider/model/effort 的 subagent 调用补上更便宜的同类路由（例如 Opus → Sonnet 5.5 @ medium、Qwen max → Qwen flash）；显式指定的选择与 subagent_fork 保持不动。需在设置里启用 subagent-model-selection 且目标路由在其 allowedModels 中，否则插件不产生任何效果。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-github-copilot

description.en: GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o), and two wire protocols (Chat Completions and Responses API) with automatic endpoint routing per model.
description.zh: GitHub Copilot LLM 适配器：OAuth 设备码登录、从 Copilot API 动态发现模型、视觉模型图片输入支持（gpt-4.1、gpt-4o），以及 Chat Completions 与 Responses 双协议，按模型自动路由。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Unofficial Grok integration for eligible X Subscription, SuperGrok, or X Premium accounts: shared Grok CLI OAuth, chat with optional main-loop web/X search, and experimental image generation, image editing, and video generation (all media features disabled by default).
description.zh: 面向符合资格的 X Subscription、SuperGrok 或 X Premium 账号的非官方 Grok 集成：共用 Grok CLI OAuth 登录，支持对话及可选的主循环网页/X 搜索；实验性的图片生成、图生图编辑和视频生成均默认关闭，需主动开启。

plugins.name: dsh-commandcode-provider

description.en: Unofficial Command Code LLM provider: registers a `commandcode` route with a live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
description.zh: 非官方 Command Code 模型接入插件：注册 `commandcode` 路由，带实时模型目录与推理强度支持。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Connects Qoder CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with zero user interaction: decrypts local OSCrypt credentials, signs requests with the COSY scheme against the CN gateway, and lists 14 models with free-tier badges.
description.zh: 将 Qoder CN 桌面版的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，零用户交互：解密本地 OSCrypt 凭据，以 COSY 签名对接国内网关，14 个模型含免费额度标注。

description.en: Connects Trae CN desktop app models to DeepSeek Harness with no OAuth flow: reuses the desktop sign-in, exposes 17 models (including deepseek-v4.1-flash) with consumption-rate badges and reasoning-effort mapping.
description.zh: 将 Trae CN 桌面版的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，无需单独 OAuth：复用桌面端登录，17 个模型（含 deepseek-v4.1-flash）带倍率标注与思考强度映射。

description.en: Connects Qoder (China and Global) subscriptions to DSH through personal access tokens, keeping each variant on its own credentials and catalog, with saved-token switching, sidebar quota cards, per-model toggles, a context-window preference and a daily check-in.
description.zh: 通过个人访问令牌将 Qoder（国内版与国际版）接入 DSH，两版各自独立的凭证与模型目录，支持多令牌切换、侧栏额度卡、按模型开关、上下文窗口偏好与每日自动签到。

description.en: Reorder your own models: drag inside a provider card on the Models settings page, or use the Model order section when another plugin already occupies that card. The order is written through the host settings service with a revision check, so the settings page and the model picker stay in sync. The settings left nav can be reordered by drag as well.
description.zh: 模型顺序：在「设置 → 模型」的提供方卡片里拖动调整；卡片格被别的插件占用时，入口在设置左导航的「模型顺序」分区。顺序通过宿主 settings 服务带版本校验写回，设置页与模型选择器保持同步；设置左导航本身也可拖拽排序。

description.en: Adds an "Add model" entry to the model menu for third-party providers, plus a management dialog that switches the model of the current conversation, edits or removes entries, and highlights the one in use.
description.zh: 在模型菜单底部增加「添加模型」与「管理已添加模型」：接入第三方服务商并写入 DSH 模型配置，可编辑 / 删除条目，并一键切换当前对话的模型、高亮正在使用的那一行。

description.en: Brings the Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro) subscription already signed in on this machine into DSH. It (1) shows the 5-hour and weekly windows with their reset times and the remaining reset credits in a sidebar panel, with one-click reset that consumes a credit; (2) registers the subscription route in llm-pi-ai (openai-codex) when the quota is read, so the Codex models appear in the model picker; (3) refreshes the OAuth access token before expiry and writes it back atomically, so no key has to be replaced by hand; and (4) adds a codex tool that delegates a task to the local Codex agent. No API key has to be entered.
description.zh: 本机已登录的 Codex（ChatGPT Plus/Pro）订阅接入 DSH。用途：①在侧边栏展示 5 小时窗口与一周窗口的剩余额度、重置时间与剩余重置券数量，并支持一键消耗一张重置券重置额度；②读取额度时自动把订阅线路注册进 llm-pi-ai（openai-codex 路由），使 Codex 模型出现在模型选择器中；③access token 到期前自动续期并原子写回，无需手动更换密钥；④提供 codex 工具把任务委派给本机 Codex agent。无需填写任何 API key。

description.en: Rates how hard the current message is and shows the cheapest model and reasoning effort that still fits, above the composer, before you send.
description.zh: 发送前判断问题难度，在输入框上方提示够用的模型与推理等级，避免用错档位多花钱。

description.en: Adds a thinking-depth slider mapped to declared model levels, configuration guidance, and optional inline model settings.
description.zh: 按模型声明的能力提供思考深度滑块、配置指引与可选模型行设置。

plugins.name: dsh-provider-qoder

description.en: Connects Qoder subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness, supporting Global and China regions, multimodal input, and tool calls.
description.zh: 将 Qoder 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持国际版与中国区、多模态与工具调用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-modellix

description.en: Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.
description.zh: 将 Modellix 接入 DSH：使用一个 API Key 在分栏 Design 工作区中提供基于 Schema 的图片、视频与音频生成、实时 LLM 模型目录，以及原生网页搜索与抓取 Provider。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Per-model system prompt injector for DeepSeek Harness: append custom prompt text to the END of the system prompt for locally configured models, matched by exact provider/model route or a provider-wide provider/* rule (both stack in order). A Settings page lists every configured provider and its models for per-route editing with instant effect, and rules persist to DSH_HOME so they survive restarts. Applies to main sessions, subagents, and workflow children alike.
description.zh: DSH 按模型注入系统提示词：为本地已配置的模型把自定义提示词追加到系统提示词末尾，支持 provider/model 精确匹配与 provider/* 服务商级通配（两者按序叠加）。设置页自动列出每个已配置服务商及其模型，逐行编辑、即时生效；规则持久化保存、重启不丢；对主会话、subagent 与 workflow 子代理同样生效。

plugins.name: dsh-openrouter-providers

description.en: Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.
description.zh: 配置 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商列表与量化位数上限，注入 provider.only/order（allow_fallbacks）与 provider.quantizations 路由参数。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A row of model preset buttons above the composer: left-click switches the session to that preset's provider, model and reasoning effort, right-click opens an editor for it, and each preset can carry a custom name instead of the model id. The editor reads the session's live model catalog, and presets are stored locally.
description.zh: 输入框上方的一排模型预设按钮：左键点击把当前会话切换到该预设的提供方、模型与思考强度，右键点击打开该预设的编辑弹窗，每个预设还可以自定义备注名称而不必使用模型名。编辑弹窗读取当前会话真实的模型目录，预设保存在本地。

description.en: Reuses the local model proxy of a logged-in XiaoyiWork desktop app (Windows only) so its models appear in DeepSeek Harness without a separate API key.
description.zh: 复用已登录的小艺Work 桌面端本地模型代理（仅限 Windows），其模型直接出现在 DeepSeek Harness 中，无需单独 API Key。

description.en: Configures provider and model reasoning-effort mappings for DeepSeek Harness, with a grouped model picker and composer slider.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置 Provider 与模型的推理强度映射，并提供按 Provider 分组的模型选择器和输入框滑块。

description.en: Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings → Models, with atomic settings writes.
description.zh: 为自定义 API 模型提供推理强度分级管理与跨会话偏好记忆：在「设置 → 模型」中内联切换 low/medium/high/max，配置写入为原子操作。

description.en: Session-affinity routing for LLM gateways: injects the session ID into every request sent to NewApi-style gateways so the gateway can pin requests per session and raise prompt-cache hits; takes over the official pi-ai routing on install and restores it on uninstall.
description.zh: LLM 网关会话粘性路由：把会话 sessionId 注入发往 NewApi 类网关的每个请求，供网关做请求亲和以提升 prompt cache 命中，装上即接管官方 pi-ai 路由，卸载即还原。

description.en: Model selector for the DSH composer that keeps the native button and menu and takes over only when the small dropdown would open: search across providers, probe any model with a real streaming request to measure TTFT and TPS, and browse a leaderboard of up to 100 rows built from OpenRouter's catalogue, where clicking a row searches local channels of that name.
description.zh: DSH 输入框的模型选择器：保留原生按钮与菜单，只在小下拉列表即将弹出时接管；跨渠道搜索、对任意模型发起真实流式请求测出 TTFT 与 TPS，并可浏览由 OpenRouter 目录构建的最多 100 行榜单，点一行即搜索本机同名渠道。

description.en: Keeps a pool of models and routes every agent step to one of them with its reasoning effort set — configured by clicking in the composer, no JSON needed. The router takes over the composer's model cell, so one control shows the session's model and reasoning effort alongside the router's own settings. Three authorization scopes (model / effort / full) where a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it, and in effort scope the router is bound to the one model you choose. Task presets with per-model weights, vision routing for image steps, session signals (active todo, context pressure, token budget, subagent depth), and an optional semantic task classifier. Thinking stays on, because DeepSeek rejects a thinking-enabled request whose history contains a tool call made with thinking off.
description.zh: 维护一个模型池，把每个 agent 步骤路由到池内模型并设置其思考等级——全部在输入栏点选配置，不需要写 JSON。路由面板接管输入栏的模型位置，同一个控件里既有本会话的模型与思考等级，也有路由自身的设置。三种授权范围（模型 / 思考 / 全部）：手动选择只在所属范围内生效；「思考」范围下路由只作用于你选定的那一个模型。另有按任务类型给模型加权的预设、带图任务的视觉分流、会话信号（当前 todo / 上下文压力 / token 预算 / 子 agent 深度），以及可选的语义任务分类。思考等级保持常开，因为 DeepSeek 会拒绝思考关闭时产生的工具调用。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#qwen-token-plan-cn-responses

description.en: Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools, text/reasoning/tool-call multi-turn history, persisted image attachments, and a per-release official model catalog snapshot.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-grok-byapi

description.en: Grok model provider for DeepSeek Harness with model discovery, image and video generation, text-to-speech tools, and durable local media tasks over an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 Grok：模型发现、图片与视频生成、文字转语音工具，以及可重启恢复的本地媒体任务。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping session affinity and prompt-cache routing intact.
description.zh: 为 OpenCode / OpenCode Go 提供商请求自动附加每个会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 错误，同时保持会话亲和与提示缓存路由。

description.en: ChatGPT Codex subscription chat: official OAuth, a Sol/Terra/Luna catalog with Fast rows, live usage limits, and optional search and view_image tools.
description.zh: ChatGPT Codex 订阅聊天：官方 OAuth 登录，Sol/Terra/Luna 目录含 Fast 行，实时额度，以及可选的搜索与 view_image 工具。

description.en: Command Code Provider API chat for DSH with a Host-held API key, discovered model catalog, effort defaults, an optional zero-data-retention header, quota meters, and per-model OpenAI or Anthropic protocol selection.
description.zh: DSH 的 Command Code Provider API 聊天：Host 持有 API key，支持模型发现、effort 默认值、可选零数据保留请求头、额度仪表，以及按模型选择 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 协议。

description.en: Unofficial Cursor subscription chat: Host-owned CLI session login, a displayed model catalog, and subscription usage rails. Cursor staff treat this class of private-client usage as against ToS.
description.zh: 非官方 Cursor 订阅聊天：Host 持有 CLI 会话登录，可编辑展示用模型目录，并显示订阅额度。Cursor 员工认定此类私有客户端用法违反 ToS。

description.en: xAI Grok subscription chat: SuperGrok or X Premium+ OAuth, a displayed model subset, Responses through the Grok CLI proxy, and always-on server-side web_search and x_search.
description.zh: xAI Grok 订阅聊天：用 SuperGrok 或 X Premium+ 的 OAuth 登录，选择要显示的模型子集，经 Grok CLI 代理走 Responses，并始终开启服务端 web_search 与 x_search。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-ollama

description.en: Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: direct NDJSON translation of the Ollama /api/chat wire format, model discovery with context windows and capabilities, and web search/fetch providers under the ollama-cloud id, plus a Web settings card.
description.zh: Ollama Cloud 原生聊天适配器：直连 NDJSON 翻译 Ollama /api/chat 协议，模型发现带上下文窗口与能力信息，并注册 web 搜索/抓取 provider，附 Web 设置卡片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: OpenCode Go subscription chat for DSH with per-model Completions, Responses, or Anthropic protocol selection, model discovery, context, vision and thinking metadata, effort defaults, and usage meters.
description.zh: DSH 的 OpenCode Go 订阅聊天：按模型选择 Completions、Responses 或 Anthropic 协议，支持模型发现、上下文、视觉与思考元数据、effort 默认值和用量仪表。

description.en: Explicit model routing for Main, Subagents, web_search, and image generation, plus a catalog-driven Composer and Plan Review picker with Model, Effort, Context, Fast, and Thinking variants.
description.zh: 显式路由 Main、Subagent、web_search 与图像生成，并提供由模型目录驱动的 Composer/Plan Review Picker，支持 Model、Effort、Context、Fast 与 Thinking 变体。

description.en: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
description.zh: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

description.en: Qwen multi-modal plugin support.
description.zh: Qwen 多模态插件支持。

description.en: Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the denylist.
description.zh: 提供模型粒度的启用禁用机制：从 DSH 模型目录隐藏被禁用的模型，以协议内错误块拦截直接分发请求，并提供UI设置界面。

description.en: Simulates a Codex environment for selected model routes to improve GPT-family model tool-call success.
description.zh: 为选定的模型路由模拟 Codex 环境，以提升 GPT 系列模型的工具调用成功率。

description.en: Registers Kimi, Grok, Codex, and MiniMax as DeepSeek Harness model routes, vendor subagent recipes, and kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch tools.
description.zh: 把 Kimi、Grok、Codex、MiniMax 注册成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型路由、各家子代理配方，以及 kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch 工具。

description.en: Use local Ollama in DSH with Ollama native API and params support.
description.zh: 在DSH中使用带有原生API和参数设置的Ollama。

description.en: Fetches Tsinghua MadModel API tokens and renews them from the saved SSO session on a 20-minute timer in a windowless browser, writes the token into the DSH credential MADMODEL_API_KEY and creates or reuses the madmodel model provider; one manual Get captures that session through the campus login window.
description.zh: 获取清华 MadModel 的 API token，按每 20 分钟在无窗口浏览器里用已保存的 SSO 会话续期，写入 DSH 凭据 MADMODEL_API_KEY 并创建或复用 madmodel 模型 Provider；手动点一次 Get 就通过校内登录窗口捕获该会话。

plugins.name: dsh-model-health

description.en: Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.
description.zh: 设置页「模型健康」面板：列出 settings.yaml 配置的全部模型，一键批量测试可用性与延迟。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
description.zh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

description.en: Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用做 Flash/Pro 自动分派：轻任务自动用便宜模型、重任务留在强模型，支持手动覆盖与 /delegate 会话模式。

description.en: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.
description.zh: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

description.en: Ollama provider for DeepSeek Harness with model management, health checks, rule-based local routing, and cloud fallback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ollama 接入：模型管理、健康检查、基于规则的本地路由与云端回退。

description.en: Fills missing model parameters from models.dev, imports models from configured providers, and writes per-field overrides for built-in models, with prices in USD or native CNY set as manual rates or a reference price times a multiplier.
description.zh: 从 models.dev 补全缺失的模型参数，从已配置供应商导入模型，并按字段覆盖内置模型；价格可按美元或原生人民币设为手动单价，或按参考价乘自定义倍率。

description.en: DSH plugin: matches a model you declared on a custom gateway to the capability metadata it should have — context window, output cap, reasoning levels and image support — by looking the bare model name up at runtime; the plugin never writes your settings document.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按模型名在运行时查一次目录，把你在自定义网关上声明的模型该有的能力元数据补上——上下文长度、输出上限、推理等级、能否看图；插件自己不写你的设置文档。

plugins.name: dsh-sensenova-pool

description.en: Brings SenseNova (日日新) models into dsh with a per-key rotation pool: paste any number of API keys and requests rotate across them, a 429 rate-limit immediately retries on the next key with per-key exponential-backoff cooldown, local RPM pre-throttling avoids the limit instead of reacting to it, and an exhausted pool answers 503 with Retry-After so a 429 never reaches the caller. Ships a built-in model catalogue that works offline and refreshes from /v1/models, plus a settings card with masked keys, per-key probing and removal.
description.zh: 把商汤日日新（SenseNova）模型接入 dsh，并提供按 Key 轮换的 Key 池：粘贴任意多把 API Key，请求在多把 Key 之间轮转；遇 429 限流立即换下一把 Key 重试，每把 Key 独立指数退避冷却；本地 RPM 预限流从源头避开限流，池子耗尽时回报 503 与 Retry-After，使 429 不会传到调用方。内置可离线使用的模型目录并从 /v1/models 刷新，设置卡片提供脱敏 Key 列表、单把探活与删除。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Exposes every model of every provider configured in DeepSeek Harness through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a fixed loopback port, with a sidebar page for the base URL, key, port and model ids.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置的全部 provider 与模型暴露成一个固定端口的 OpenAI 兼容接口，并在侧边栏提供地址、密钥、端口与模型 ID 的复制页面。

plugins.name: dsh-commandcode

description.en: Command Code for DSH connects Go / GOAT / Pro / Max subscriptions through llm-pi-ai provider profiles, with model sync previews, favorites and hidden models, per-model reasoning presets, explicit request diagnostics, usage alerts, configuration import/export and web search.
description.zh: Command Code for DSH｜订阅接入：通过 llm-pi-ai 供应商配置接入 Go / GOAT / Pro / Max 订阅，支持模型同步预览、收藏与隐藏、逐模型推理预设、主动调用诊断、用量提醒、配置导入导出和联网搜索。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Use Jev to adjust main-chat reasoning effort without switching its model, independently select and apply fresh sub-agent capability and effort, and inspect decisions with per-reply allocation feedback.
description.zh: 通过 Jev 调整主会话推理投入而不换模型，为 fresh 子任务独立选择并应用能力与投入，展示决策分布并收集逐回复资源分配反馈。

plugins.name: dsh-magpie-connector

description.en: Connect a self-hosted Magpie gateway with one provider route per upstream owner, so the stock model picker shows Magpie (Claude), Magpie (Codex) and other groups, plus automatic multi-line failover, read-only usage cards, per-model default effort, a per-session fast switch for priority-tier models, and optional Cloudflare Access.
description.zh: 把自托管 Magpie 网关按上游归属接入为多个 provider route，原版模型选择器即显示 Magpie (Claude)、Magpie (Codex) 等分组；支持多线路自动切换、只读用量卡片、逐模型默认 effort、priority 档模型的会话级快速切换和可选 Cloudflare Access。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Keeps a local TinyTitan model server reachable from the harness: refreshes the llm-pi-ai route from the installed models and mounts a compaction backend that does not think.
description.zh: 把本机 TinyTitan 模型服务接入 Harness：按已安装模型刷新 llm-pi-ai 路由，并挂载一个不做思考的压缩后端。

plugins.name: dsh-openai-oauth

description.en: Use ChatGPT subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness Desktop via official Sign in with ChatGPT, with dynamic Agent registration and native model and reasoning selection.
description.zh: 通过官方 Sign in with ChatGPT 授权在 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 使用 ChatGPT 订阅，支持动态 Agent 注册及原生模型和推理强度选择。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Model failover for DeepSeek Harness: pick one or more providers and the pool becomes every model inside them; when a request fails (rate limit, quota, timeout, server or transport error) the next untried model in the pool retries automatically, and the original error surfaces once the pool is exhausted. Configure from a seat beside the composer model picker or the model_failover tool, with no restart needed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的模型故障自动转移：可选一个或多个供应商，池=所选供应商内的全部模型；请求失败（限流、配额、超时、服务端或传输错误）时自动用池中下一个未试过的模型重试，整池试尽则交还原错误。在输入框右下角模型选择器旁的「故障转移」面板或 model_failover 工具里配置，无需重启。

plugins.name: dsh-jev-mode

description.en: Optional JEV decision mode with deterministic project reads, bounded semantic selection, native authorization checks and desktop credential settings.
description.zh: 可选 JEV 决策模式，提供代码优先项目读取、有限语义选择、原生授权检查与桌面密钥设置。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Multi-account Google Gemini provider: picks the account with the most remaining quota, fails over on 429 with exponential cooldown, probes disabled accounts in the background, and ships a Chinese/English settings page.
description.zh: 多账号 Google Gemini 提供商：按剩余额度挑选账号，遇 429 指数退避切换，后台探活已禁用账号，附中英双语设置页。

description.en: Bridges the third-party providers saved in a local cc-switch app into DeepSeek Harness: Anthropic-format tool groups become adapter routes, Codex groups are handed to the built-in pi-ai adapter, and a settings page picks which groups to import and in which order.
description.zh: 把本机 cc-switch 里保存的第三方供应商接入 DeepSeek Harness：Anthropic 格式的工具分组注册为适配器路由，Codex 分组交给内置 pi-ai 适配器，并在设置页选择导入哪些分组以及它们的顺序。

plugins.name: dsh-chatgpt-subscription

description.en: Connect ChatGPT subscription models to DSH via OAuth, preserving local tool-call identity across conversation replay.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 订阅模型接入 DSH，并在会话回放中保留本地工具调用身份。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-thinking-api

description.en: One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.
description.zh: 一键接入 OpenAI 兼容 API（CodeBuddy、vLLM、各类代理）并开启思考模式，绕开第三方端点以 content_filter 拒绝 developer 角色的问题。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Model switching, model capability configuration, fixed compaction models, subagent routing, and input history enhancement.
description.zh: 模型切换、模型能力配置、固定摘要模型、子 agent 角色路由与输入历史增强。

description.en: Sub-agent matrix swarm that routes heterogeneous tasks to the most suitable model from an OpenRouter-like gateway plus cfgpu.com/llm/square, dispatches each via in-process subagents or direct LLM calls, and tracks per-model token consumption with a feedback-driven ranking.
description.zh: 子智能体矩阵蜂群：把异质任务路由到最合适的模型（OpenRouter 类网关 + cfgpu.com/llm/square），通过进程内子智能体或直接 LLM 调用下放，并按模型统计 token 消耗、用真实反馈驱动排名。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-zen

description.en: Bring OpenCode Zen free models to DSH: 8 live-discovered providers with zero config, no API key; includes persistent quota tracker with rate-limit detection and reset countdown.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DSH：8 个实时发现的免费模型，零配置无需 API key；内置持久化额度检测器，自动追踪 429 限流并显示重置倒计时。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: OAuth sign-in for 9 subscription LLM providers (Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, OpenRouter, Agnes AI, Qwen, Spark, ERNIE) with zero-config login and usage dashboards.
description.zh: 支持 Claude、Codex、Grok、Antigravity、OpenRouter、Agnes AI、Qwen、星火、文心一言共 9 个订阅账号的 OAuth 登录，零配置直连，内置用量看板。

description.en: Gives pi-ai routed models a reasoning-effort ladder without manual settings: falls back declared to models.dev to a 7-tier default, and replaces the composer model chip with a Codex-style vertical picker.
description.zh: 让 pi-ai 路由的模型无需手写 settings 即可调节思考等级：按 已声明 → models.dev → 7 档兜底 的顺序回退，并把 composer 模型按钮换成 Codex 式竖向选择器。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness model API requests through a system, custom or SOCKS proxy; requests outside the configured domains stay direct.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 API 请求送进系统代理、自定义代理或 SOCKS 代理，清单之外的请求一律直连。

plugins.name: dsh-zed-provider

description.en: Use Zed AI hosted models in DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Zed AI 托管模型。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A GUI subagent-model selector beside the main model seat: pick a model and reasoning effort per session, applied to every in-process subagent.
description.zh: 主模型选择器旁的子代理模型选择器：按会话选择模型与思考程度，应用到所有进程内子代理。

description.en: Use local MLX-LM or MLX-VLM models in DeepSeek Harness through a loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, with optional DSH-owned server startup.
description.zh: 通过回环 OpenAI-compatible 提供方在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用本机 MLX-LM 或 MLX-VLM 模型，并可选由 DSH 托管模型服务进程。

description.en: Grouped provider and manufacturer model selector for DeepSeek Harness, preserving provider/model routes and reasoning levels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的平台与厂家折叠模型选择器，保留 provider/model 路由与思考等级。

description.en: Adds per-member model and reasoning-effort routing to DeepSeek Desktop Agent Teams, plus leader-initiated release of a teammate subagent run instance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Desktop 的 Agent Teams 提供成员级模型与思考强度路由，并允许主理人释放（删除）团队成员的子智能体运行实例。

description.en: Brings the free models of a locally installed OpenCode CLI into DSH: starts or reuses a local opencode serve, discovers the live catalog and refreshes it every five minutes, and bridges the session event stream to OpenAI-compatible SSE through a loopback-only shim that validates Host and Origin.
description.zh: 把本机已安装的 OpenCode CLI 免费模型接入 DSH：自动拉起或复用本地 opencode serve，读取实时模型目录并每五分钟刷新，再通过仅绑定回环、校验 Host 与 Origin 的 shim 把会话事件流转换为 OpenAI 兼容 SSE。

description.en: Expose every model already configured in your local DeepSeek Harness to the LAN over OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, with API keys, per-key rate limits, a circuit breaker, model filters and usage reports.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness 已配置的全部模型，以 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容接口开放给同一局域网；自带 API Key、按 Key 限流、熔断、模型过滤与用量报告。

description.en: Add missing reasoning-effort declarations to custom pi-ai models through DSH settings, enabling the native effort picker and handling models added later.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 设置为自定义 pi-ai 模型补充缺失的推理强度声明，启用原生强度选择器，并自动处理后续添加的模型。

plugins.name: dsh-model-smart-config

description.en: Recognizes a model ID in the DeepSeek Harness model catalog and fills that row's context window, input modalities and reasoning levels as editable suggestions, from a bundled offline rule table covering 33 vendors.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型目录里识别模型 ID，用内置的离线规则表（覆盖 33 家厂商）把该行的上下文窗口、输入模态与思考等级填成可修改的建议。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Registers OpenCode Zen free models as a native provider: the catalog is discovered live from opencode.ai intersected with models.dev pricing, and a detail page can re-fetch it or test which models answer. Declares no dependencies, so the host's pi-ai stays the only one.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型注册为原生 provider：目录由 opencode.ai 与 models.dev 价格实时取交集得出，详情页可重新拉取目录或逐个探测哪些模型能调通。不声明任何依赖，宿主自带的那份 pi-ai 始终是唯一一份。

description.en: Settings-UI editor that assigns per-teammate model and reasoning-effort rules for DSH native agent teams, resolved at spawn time by wrapping SubagentRuntime.startContinuable. No official files are modified.
description.zh: 为 DSH 原生 Team 编队队员可视化配置专属模型与推理档位，运行时包装注入，不改官方任何文件。

description.en: Adds OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT) as a selectable DSH provider via the local Codex App Server.
description.zh: 通过本机 Codex App Server，将 OpenAI Codex（ChatGPT）作为可选 DSH Provider。

description.en: Expose every free model from a local opencode serve catalog — all providers, including your own custom ones — to DeepSeek Harness's model picker, with OpenCode's native tools denied so execution stays in DSH.
description.zh: 把本机 opencode serve 目录里的全部免费模型（覆盖所有 provider，含你自定义的 provider）接入 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器，并禁用 OpenCode 原生工具，执行权留在 DSH。

description.en: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
description.zh: 子代理 LLM 供应商/模型选择，支持角色模板。

plugins.name: dsh-model-management

description.en: Manages the default DSH model, provider and model visibility, and optional OpenAI Responses web search.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 默认模型、Provider 与模型可见性，并支持可选的 OpenAI Responses 联网搜索。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
