plugins.name: dsh-aimy

description.en: Manages a relay station's many groups and rates for DSH, switching the station's billing group in place and refreshing the model list and rate on stations that expose /v1/token/group; stations without it fall back to read-only and keep serving models.
description.zh: 解决中转站多分组多倍率不方便管理的问题：在提供 /v1/token/group 的站点上就地切换分组并同步刷新模型列表与计费倍率；缺少该接口的站点自动降级为只读，模型仍可正常拉取与调用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: LLM provider adapter that routes model calls through any ACP (Agent Client Protocol) server — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Devin and more — with a registry browser, per-server settings UI, lazy authentication, and dynamic model discovery.
description.zh: 通过 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）将任意外部 agent 作为 LLM 提供方接入——支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Devin 等，内置注册表浏览与服务管理界面，支持惰性认证、模型动态发现与热切换。

description.en: Syncs the groups, keys and models of one sub2api instance into dsh-llm-pi-ai provider routes, with panel-driven login (password / OAuth) and one provider route per relay key.
description.zh: 将一个 sub2api 实例的分组、密钥与模型同步为 dsh-llm-pi-ai 的 provider 路由，支持面板登录（密码 / OAuth），一条中转密钥对应一条 provider 路由。

plugins.name: dsh-ThirdApi-ThinkingMode

description.en: Reads each third-party endpoint's own model listing and keeps llm-pi-ai's per-model reasoningEfforts in sync, so the composer offers the thinking levels a model actually has.
description.zh: 读取每个第三方端点自己的模型列表，同步 llm-pi-ai 的逐模型 reasoningEfforts，让输入框提供模型真实支持的思考等级。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Compact Codex coding mode for DSH: light prompt guardrails against GPT over-explaining, with an editable prompt and native Codex-style tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供精简的 Codex 编码模式：使用精简的 codex 提示词与原生 Codex 风格工具，并用少量提示词约束抑制 GPT 的过度解释；提示词可自行编辑调整。

description.en: Keeps long DSH sessions alive when a model channel starts failing: daruma takes over after the in-box retry gives up, trips a self-healing circuit breaker on repeated 429/5xx or a terminal error, and moves the next request to another channel in your chain. Works on DSH 0.1.x and 0.2.x hosts, including 0.2.1-rc.2 with verified failover and backup-management RPC. The backup can be picked in Settings or from a panel beside the composer — both stay in sync — with a durable JSONL audit log for every switch. Channel switches are recorded in that audit log instead of as in-conversation notice rows, because a plugin session event of a type the host does not know makes it refuse to load the whole session.
description.zh: 渠道开始失败时不让长任务中断：内置重试放弃后 daruma 接管，对连续 429/5xx 或终止性错误跳闸自愈断路器，把下一个请求切到链上的其他渠道。支持 DSH 0.1.x 与 0.2.x 宿主，含已实测故障转移与备用管理 RPC 的 0.2.1-rc.2。备用渠道可在设置页或输入框旁的面板挑选，两处即时同步；每次切换落盘成可审计的 JSONL 日志。切换只记入这份审计日志，不再写入会话内的提示行——宿主不认识的插件事件类型会让整段会话加载失败。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-opencode-go-live

description.en: An OpenCode Go model source for DSH: it reads the opencode-go catalog from Models.dev and serves it on a separate opencode-go-live route, leaving the built-in opencode-go route in place. The catalog snapshot is cached under the DSH home and a failed refresh keeps the last successful one; its own Models settings card edits the route key and can render OpenCode Go subscription usage.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 OpenCode Go 模型来源：从 Models.dev 读取 opencode-go 目录，在独立的 opencode-go-live 路由上提供，内置 opencode-go 路由保持原样。目录快照缓存在 DSH home 下，刷新失败时沿用上一次成功的目录；插件自带 Models 设置卡片用于填写该路由密钥，并可显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Search-first model selector with favorites, recent models, collapsible provider groups and keyboard navigation.
description.zh: 模型再多也好找：搜索、收藏、最近使用、服务商分组折叠与键盘快速切换。

description.en: Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.
description.zh: 按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

plugins.name: dsh-sap-ai-core

description.en: SAP AI Core provider with shared OAuth, five Qwen model choices, thinking budgets, streaming, and tool calls; validated on cn40.
description.zh: 接入 SAP AI Core，共用 OAuth 认证，支持五个 Qwen 模型、五档思考预算及关闭选项、流式输出和工具调用；已实测 cn40。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-chatgpt-subscription

description.en: Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota.
description.zh: 通过官方 OAuth 绑定你的 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 内直接使用 ChatGPT 模型对话，消耗 Plus/Pro 订阅额度。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Registers a local LLM provider that routes model calls to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint or the Ollama native API, with a connection-test card in the Models settings page and no account sign-in.
description.zh: 注册一个本地 LLM provider，把模型请求转发到 OpenAI 兼容端点或 Ollama 原生 API，并在「设置 → 模型」页提供连接测试卡片，无需登录账号。

plugins.name: dsh-credit-hub

description.en: Native multi-platform accounts and model routing with staggered check-ins, event notifications, and quota forecasts. Its background worker needs a standalone Node >=22.23.3 with node:sqlite (enforced by engines.node); Qwen Office coding additionally needs Python with cryptography and wasmtime.
description.zh: 原生多平台账号与模型路由管理，支持错峰签到、事件通知与额度预测。后台 worker 需独立 Node ≥22.23.3（node:sqlite，已由 engines.node 约束）；千问办公的编码能力另需 Python（cryptography、wasmtime）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Detects which conversation model an account is being served: launches concurrent throwaway probe conversations, scores each streaming chain-of-thought by how its paragraphs open, and cancels probes that read as the older model within seconds. Includes an offline self-check that replays 13 hand-labelled chains-of-thought through the same classifier.
description.zh: 检测账号当前被分配到哪个对话模型：并发发起一次性探测会话，按段落开头的写法为流式思维链打分，读起来像旧模型的在数秒内中止。附带离线自检，用同一分类器回放 13 条人工标注的思维链。

description.en: Tidy the model list of DeepSeek Harness: hide any model from the selector, rename models and channels while keeping the provider billing rate, and arrange both with arrows. Search, per-provider batch toggles, back to top, one-click restore. Display only — no provider configuration is rewritten.
description.zh: DSH 模型整理：整理并精简模型列表——隐藏任意模型、给模型和渠道改备注名（保留厂商计费倍率）、用箭头调整模型与渠道排序；支持搜索、渠道级批量开关、返回顶部与一键恢复。只改显示，不重写任何渠道配置。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-qwen-local

description.en: LLM adapter plugin for locally deployed Qwen models behind a vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with per-model multimodal switch, fully configurable reasoning efforts, and a web settings page for editing the deployment from the frontend.
description.zh: 面向 vLLM OpenAI 兼容端点上本地部署的 Qwen 模型的 LLM 适配器插件,支持按模型多模态开关、完全可配置的推理档位,以及可在前端编辑部署配置的 Web 设置页。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-tri-model

description.en: Multi-model layered pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: a strong model plans, a fast one drafts, a third reviews, and a failed review is reworked automatically — endpoints, protocols, models and gates all configured from the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: DSH 多模型分层协同插件：强模型规划、快模型执行、第三方模型审查，审查 FAIL 自动带问题清单返工；端点、协议、模型、层级全部在设置面板里配。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Volcengine Ark Coding Plan provider route for DeepSeek Harness with all 15 Coding Plan models and per-model reasoning-effort control, generated from a single source and drift-checked weekly.
description.zh: 火山方舟 Ark Coding Plan 的 provider 路由：为 DeepSeek Harness 收录全部 15 个 Coding Plan 模型，每个模型可调思考强度；清单由单一数据源生成，并每周自动探测是否过期。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-connect-plus

description.en: Adds ChatGPT/Codex OAuth-backed Codex models and gpt-image-2 generation/editing to DSH without requiring an OpenAI Platform API key.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加基于 ChatGPT/Codex OAuth 的 Codex 模型及 gpt-image-2 文生图和编辑能力，无需 OpenAI Platform API Key。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-AuthInOne

description.en: Adds account login, API and custom Provider setup, model switching, image fallback for text-only models, and token/cost attribution to DeepSeek Harness 47f.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 47f 提供账号登录、API 与自定义 Provider 配置、模型切换、纯文本模型图片兜底，以及 Token 与费用归因。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-antigravity-auth

description.en: Adds an unofficial Antigravity OAuth-backed LLM route, web search, image generation and editing, video understanding, quota status, and DSH Web settings controls.
description.zh: 通过非官方 Antigravity OAuth 通道提供 LLM 路由、网页搜索、图片生成与编辑、视频理解、配额状态和 DSH Web 设置控件。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Reuses the Codex CLI ChatGPT login as an `openai-codex` LLM route and adds GPT Auth controls to DSH Web settings.
description.zh: 复用 Codex CLI 的 ChatGPT 登录态注册 `openai-codex` LLM 路由，并在 DSH Web 设置中提供 GPT Auth 控件。

description.en: Answers model calls by driving your own logged-in chatgpt.com session in a local Chrome, so inference spends the ChatGPT web quota rather than Codex quota, and adds a JSON tool-call protocol so the web model can run DSH tools.
description.zh: 用本地 Chrome 驱动你自己已登录的 chatgpt.com 会话作答，消耗的是 ChatGPT 网页额度而非 Codex 额度；并用 JSON 工具调用协议让网页端模型可以调用 DSH 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-model-router

description.en: Deterministic keyword routing, allowlisted model switching, and an isolated image_gen channel for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DSH 关键词路由与隔离生图插件：确定性关键词路由、白名单模型切换与隔离的 image_gen 生图通道。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Per-model proxy routing for LLM requests: selected models go through a proxy (Clash etc.) while the rest stay direct, with automatic retry on transport errors, 429 and 5xx, configured live from the settings page.
description.zh: 按模型给 LLM 请求分流代理：勾选的模型走代理（Clash 等），其余直连；传输错误、429、5xx 自动重试，设置页实时生效。

description.en: Apply the current session's model to every other session in one click, from a control beside the composer's model picker.
description.zh: 在输入框模型位旁边加一个控件，一键把当前会话的模型应用到其余所有会话。

description.en: Per-step model router: named presets with ordered image/keyword-group rules route each agent step across every mounted provider and model, adding collaboration flows for image transcription, an image guard, a multi-plan quota panel, and per-step decision observability.
description.zh: 逐步模型路由器：以命名预设与带图/关键词组有序规则为每一步在全部已挂载模型间选路，附图像转述协作流、图像护栏、多 plan 配额面板与逐步决策可观测。

plugins.name: dsh-tap

description.en: Unofficial upstream bundle for DeepSeek Harness. CodeBuddy gateway with a runtime-synced model catalogue, per-model reasoning efforts, web search/fetch, image generation and a streaming credential bridge, plus TraeWork CN and Qoder CN subscription channels via local translation gateways and a key-type OpenAI-compatible provider registry, all managed from an accordion settings card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方上游插件包：CodeBuddy 网关（模型目录动态同步、逐模型思考强度、联网搜索/抓取、生图、流式凭据桥），TraeWork CN 与 Qoder CN 两条订阅额度通道（本地 OpenAI 翻译网关），以及 key 型 OpenAI 兼容上游注册表，全部收在四区块手风琴设置卡里。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to x.cn

plugins.name: dsh-tako

description.en: Adds Tako chat models to the official llm-pi-ai provider list from Tako's public catalog, with live refresh, context windows from size tags, and browser one-click sign-in writing a cr_ key into DSH credentials.
description.zh: 从 Tako 公开模型目录把聊天模型接入官方 llm-pi-ai，实时刷新并按尺寸标签写入上下文窗口，支持浏览器一键登录，把 cr_ 密钥存入 DSH 凭据。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Registers a QwenWork (千问办公) model provider that reuses the desktop client's local sign-in, runs a loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1, and translates DSH model requests into the ACP-style control-envelope conversation protocol the upstream actually speaks.
description.zh: 注册千问办公（QwenWork）模型提供器，复用桌面客户端的本机登录态，在 127.0.0.1 起一个 OpenAI 兼容回环桥，把 DSH 的模型请求翻译成上游真正使用的 ACP 控制信封对话协议。

description.en: Community-maintained WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI model provider using local desktop sign-in, with model discovery and credit display. Version 0.1.11 supports per-model context-window selection and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, rc.3 and rc.5; its CN compatibility layer differs from the functy23 fork. Derived from corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect (MIT), it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be enabled together with the original or other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 复用本机桌面登录的 WorkBuddy 与 WorkBuddy AI 模型提供器社区分叉，提供模型发现和额度显示。正式版 0.1.11 支持按模型选择上下文窗口及 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、rc.3 和 rc.5，CN 兼容层与 functy23 的分叉不同。派生自 corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect（MIT），注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与原版或其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Requires the ZCode CLI installed and signed in. Relays the ZCode CLI agent into DeepSeek Harness as a model provider. A resident app-server session streams each turn, and the model catalogue is read from the CLI at runtime, so context windows, image support and provider routes follow the installed CLI and account. Stable 0.5.2 declares DSH compatibility through engines.dsh; ZCode CLI 3.16.3 is the documented reference version. Preview 0.6.0-community.5 with optional Retry is available separately in GitHub Releases. Tool permission requests are denied by default; unknown approval or permission methods are always denied, and full-auto requires an explicit opt-in. DSH approval UI does not mediate this separately spawned app-server process, and the policy is not an OS sandbox. Derived from kyle123740/dsh-zcode-cli-proxy (AGPL-3.0); it registers the same `zcode-cli` provider id, so it cannot be installed alongside the original.
description.zh: 需已安装并登录 ZCode CLI。把 ZCode CLI agent 接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为模型提供方。常驻 app-server 会话逐回合流式转发，模型清单从 CLI 实时读取，因此上下文窗口、图片支持与 provider 路由都跟随已安装的 CLI 和账号。稳定版 0.5.2 通过 engines.dsh 声明 DSH 兼容范围，文档参考内核为 ZCode CLI 3.16.3。支持可选 Retry 的预览版 0.6.0-community.5 可在 GitHub Releases 单独选择。工具权限请求默认拒绝；未知的 approval/permission 方法始终拒绝，全自动需显式启用。DSH 自带的审批界面不会介入这个独立 spawn 的 app-server 进程，该策略也不构成操作系统沙箱。派生自 kyle123740/dsh-zcode-cli-proxy（AGPL-3.0），注册相同的 `zcode-cli` provider id，不能与原版同装。

description.en: Connects DSH Web and qq-bridge to OFM, defaulting to the DeepSeek public pool while preserving reasoning effort and manual model selection; loads the official OFM dependency when absent and reports account-rotation receipts.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web / qq-bridge 接入 OFM，默认先选 DeepSeek 免费池并保留思考档位；缺少 OFM 时装载官方依赖，支持自有账号与轮换回执，不限制手动选模。

description.en: Supervises a local workbuddy2api gateway process and exposes its models as an LLM provider, reading context windows and reasoning efforts from the gateway's own model endpoint.
description.zh: 托管本地 workbuddy2api 网关进程，把它的模型注册为 dsh 的模型提供方，上下文窗口与思考档位均从网关自身的模型接口读取。

description.en: Use your ChatGPT account to bring Codex models into DSH: choose models and thinking effort, chat with images, use tools and skills, approve local tasks, answer interactive questions, continue and compact long conversations, check quota and Token history, and maintain a supported Windows screenshot helper.
description.zh: 使用 ChatGPT 账号在 DSH 中接入 Codex：选择模型与思考档位，进行图文对话、使用工具和技能，经审批执行本机任务，回答交互问题，压缩并续接长对话，查询额度和 Token 历史，并维护受支持的 Windows 截图辅助程序。

plugins.name: dsh-muse-code

description.en: Adds Meta's Muse Code subscription as a DSH model provider: the bundle declares the shipped Meta route under Settings > Models, syncs the account chat catalog (Muse Wonder included) into the model picker, and adds a Sign in card plus the /muse-login command that run DSH's built-in Meta device-code flow, keep the minted key renewed, and show a red or green credential dot. Needs an active Muse Code subscription and no Meta CLI.
description.zh: 把 Meta 的 Muse Code 订阅接入为 DSH 模型提供方，在设置中声明 Meta 路由、同步账号聊天模型目录到模型选择器，并提供登录卡片与 /muse-login 设备码登录、凭据自动续期与红绿点。需有效 Muse Code 订阅，无需 Meta CLI。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Connect DSH to a MultiVibe gateway and inspect available models and connection status.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到 MultiVibe 网关，并可查看可用模型与连接状态。

description.en: Provides a better model experience, including but not limited to: filling model parameters in multiple ways, improving model compatibility, remembering reasoning efforts, subagents following the parent's model and reasoning effort in real time, and AI self-adjusting reasoning effort.
description.zh: 提供更好的模型使用体验，包括但不限于：多种方式填充模型参数、提升模型兼容性、记住推理级别、子智能体实时跟随模型和推理级别、AI 自主调节档位等。

description.en: Manages the lifecycle of the local UM GenAI proxy (127.0.0.1:8788) that DSH's um-genai provider talks to: wakes it on demand for llm/stream calls, stops it after an idle period, and reports health plus a read-only status endpoint. Also ships a DSH settings page for port, always-on mode, idle minutes, interpreter and paths, plus the UM account and proxy API key, and a button that writes the providers.um-genai entry into the profile patch and fills in its model list, since a fresh profile has no provider and the model picker would otherwise stay empty. A renewal watchdog logs in to the campus gateway on a hidden Windows desktop when the upstream token expires. The proxy itself is um_opencode_setup.py, a single-file tool distributed by the University of Macau; a copy is vendored in vendor/ so a fresh install works out of the box, while a copy in ~/.um-opencode/ takes precedence when present. The plugin still does not produce tokens: those come from logging in to the campus gateway. Requires Windows (process discovery and idle shutdown use netstat/taskkill; renewal uses PowerShell and a hidden desktop), Python 3.10+ and a University of Macau account.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 的 um-genai provider 所連的本機 UM GenAI 反代（127.0.0.1:8788）的生命週期：llm/stream 請求進來時按需喚醒、閒置一段時間後關閉、提供健康檢查與唯讀狀態端點。另附 DSH 設定頁（埠號、常駐模式、閒置分鐘、解譯器與路徑、UM 帳號、代理金鑰），以及一顆按鈕：把 providers.um-genai 寫進 profile patch 並補上模型清單（全新 profile 沒有這段設定，模型選單本來會是空的）。續期看門狗在上游 token 過期時於隱藏 Windows 桌面完成校園 gateway 登入。反代本體是 um_opencode_setup.py（澳門大學校內發放的單檔工具），外掛在 vendor/ 自帶一份讓全新安裝即可運作，而 ~/.um-opencode/ 那份優先；它仍然不產生 token，token 由登入校園 gateway 取得。需要 Windows（進程發現與閒置關閉依賴 netstat/taskkill，續期依賴 PowerShell 與隱藏桌面）、Python 3.10+ 與澳門大學帳號。

plugins.name: dsh-cliproxyapi-pro

description.en: Connects CLIProxyAPI (CPA) to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) with multiple accounts, model filtering, native protocols, quota lookup and image / video generation; once configured, the selected models appear in the model picker automatically.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中接入 CLIProxyAPI（CPA），支持多账户、模型筛选、原生协议直连、额度查询、生图生视频，选好配置后自动出现在模型选择器中。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Registers a wrapper provider that gives delegated subagents their own LLM route — one-off spawns through provider.start, Agent Teams members through a hook on startActivation — while the main agent keeps its model. Ships a Settings section for picking that route, a per-expert override file, a capability flag reporting which seams the hook caught, and a readiness record written at mount.
description.zh: 注册一个包装 provider，让被委派的子代理走自己的 LLM 路由——单发子代理经 provider.start，Agent Teams 成员经 startActivation 上的钩子——主 agent 仍用自己的模型。附带设置页选择路由、按专家覆盖的配置文件、报告钩子挂在哪条缝上的能力标志，以及挂载时写下的就绪记录。

description.en: Sign in to an xAI Grok subscription with device-code OAuth, refresh the access token, and use it as the xai route credential without an API key.
description.zh: 用设备码 OAuth 登录 xAI Grok 订阅，自动刷新访问令牌，并作为 xai 路由凭据使用，无需 API key。

plugins.name: dsh-mercury-diffusion

description.en: Plays Inception Mercury's diffusion (denoising) stream live in the dsh Web UI answer bubble: for routes that support it, the request is re-sent with `diffusing: true` and the real frames are replayed from noise to final text, while only the converged answer reaches the session log. Support is detected per provider/model with a probe that is rejected before any token is generated, a floating per-model toggle turns it on, and attachments, auxiliary calls or unsupported routes fall back to the original adapter. Replaces the assistant-message renderer for all models while enabled.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web UI 的回答气泡里实时播放 Inception Mercury 的扩散（去噪）过程：对支持的路由以 `diffusing: true` 重发请求，按真实帧从噪声播放到最终文本，会话日志只写入收敛后的答案。按 provider/model 用一个在生成前就被拒绝的探测请求判断是否支持，右侧浮动按钮按模型开关；带附件、辅助调用或不支持的路由一律回退原适配器。启用期间会接管所有模型的助手消息渲染。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: File-defined subagent roles for DeepSeek Harness: roles live in project and global .dsh/roles files, a delegating agent sees one catalog line per role, and each role's tool policy decides which tools its child can see.
description.zh: 用文件定义子代理角色：角色放在项目级与全局级 .dsh/roles 目录，委派方每个角色只看到一行目录，子代理可见的工具由角色自己的工具策略决定。

description.en: Named model routes for subagent delegations, configured from a settings page: each alias binds a subagent provider, model and optional reasoning effort, token cap, agent preset, tags, plus a "when to use" line the model reads to pick it, so a delegation names only the alias. Adds five tools (delegate, list routes, edit config, wait, release), shows the route a child actually ran on in its session header, lets each UI element be switched off, and keeps all configuration in one local JSON file instead of YAML.
description.zh: 给子智能体配命名模型路由：每个别名绑定子智能体代理、模型与可选的思考档位、令牌上限、Agent 预设、标签，并写清「何时使用」供模型选路，委派时只写别名。插件提供委派、查目录、改配置、等后台、释放五个工具，在设置页完成全部配置（两级下拉、逐项校验），在子代理会话头部显示其实际运行的路由，界面元素均可单独停用；配置存于本地 JSON，不需要改任何 YAML。

plugins.name: dsh-model-control

description.en: Replaces the composer model seat with a search-first picker and adds a model management page: create and edit llm-pi-ai channels, choose which of an endpoint's models exist, and declare per-model thinking ladders and capabilities.
description.zh: 接管输入框的模型座位并新增模型管理页：增改删 llm-pi-ai 渠道、挑选端点里的哪些模型进入本软件、按模型声明思考档位与能力。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds CC Switch providers and models to DeepSeek Harness, with provider filtering and model-name search.
description.zh: 将 CC Switch 中的 provider 和模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并支持 provider 筛选和模型名称搜索。

description.en: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with Settings login, model catalogs, usage, plus image_generate, video_generate, and x_search tools.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT（Codex）、Claude、Grok 订阅当作 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方：设置页登录、模型目录、用量展示，以及 image_generate、video_generate 与 x_search 工具。

description.en: Brings the models available in the logged-in WorkBuddy desktop app into the model picker, reusing the app login and credits; the domestic and international builds appear as two separate provider groups. Continuation of the now-deleted corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect; it registers the same workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider ids, so it cannot be installed alongside other WorkBuddy bridges.
description.zh: 把已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 里可用的模型接进模型选择器，复用 App 的登录与积分；国内版与国际版各成一组。corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect（仓库已删除）的续作；注册相同的 workbuddy / workbuddy-ai provider id，不能与其它 WorkBuddy 桥同装。

description.en: Connects the free ZCode plan to the model picker: a multi-account pool with rotation, per-account rate-limit and quota display, and bigmodel/zai device login.
description.zh: 把 ZCode 赠送的免费 plan 接进模型选择器：多账号池轮换、按账号的限流与额度展示、bigmodel/zai 双渠道设备登录。

description.en: Turns the MiniMax Code (Mavis) subscription already signed in on this machine into a DSH model provider, renewing the OAuth token itself so the desktop client can stay closed, with points, check-in and subscription-quota panels.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的 MiniMax Code（Mavis）订阅接入 DSH 作为模型 provider，自己完成 OAuth 续期所以桌面客户端可以一直关着，并提供积分、签到与订阅额度面板。

description.en: OpenCode free models for DSH with dynamic model-list refresh, optional HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy failover, a fail-closed tool bridge and offline agent-scoped compatibility auditing.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode 免费模型，支持模型列表动态刷新与可选的代理出口轮换，并提供默认拒绝不安全转换的工具桥与离线、按 Agent 作用域的兼容性审计。

description.en: Model pricing for the DSH settings page: ~7,250 models / 213 providers with the harness catalog overlaid, honest lowest-listed comparison, session costs priced by the actual route, cache-leak attribution, and a verified promotion feed.
description.zh: DSH 设置页中的模型价格表：约 7,250 个模型 / 213 个提供商（叠加本地路由目录），诚实的最低标价比较、按实际路由计价的会话成本、缓存泄漏归因，以及经验证的促销信息源。

description.en: Registers Ark Agent Plan, Coding Plan and postpaid model routes in the native DSH model picker.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生模型选择器中注册方舟 Agent Plan、Coding Plan 与后付费模型路由。

description.en: Reuses the sign-in already held by the local Doubao desktop app as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, and adds a read-only quota view for the 5-hour and weekly windows. Windows x64 only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
description.zh: 复用本机豆包桌面客户端已有的登录态，作为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 provider，并提供 5 小时限额与周额度的只读额度概览。仅 Windows x64：凭据解密依赖 DPAPI。

description.en: Connect Huawei CodeArts and OfficeAce models to DeepSeek Harness: it reuses existing logins (a logged-in CodeArts desktop client or dsh-codearts; the OfficeAce desktop app running and logged in on Windows), shows each account's remaining credits, toggles models per platform, and shapes requests like the official clients.
description.zh: 把华为「码道 CodeArts」与「果办 OfficeAce」两个平台的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness：复用已有登录态（码道桌面端或 dsh-codearts 已登录；果办桌面端需在 Windows 上运行并登录），显示各账号积分余量、按平台勾选模型，并按官方客户端形态构造请求。

description.en: Adds per-model hide/show switches for custom (llm-pi-ai) providers to the DSH settings page. Hidden models disappear from the conversation model picker and are archived verbatim, so they can be restored at any time; disabling or uninstalling the plugin restores everything automatically. Built-in DeepSeek providers are not managed.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页给自定义（llm-pi-ai）提供商的每个模型加「隐藏 / 显示」开关。隐藏的模型会从对话底部的模型选择器消失，条目原样存档、随时可恢复；禁用或卸载本插件会自动全部还原。内置 DeepSeek 提供商不归本插件管。

plugins.name: agnes-ai-for-dsh

description.en: Agnes AI provider for llm-pi-ai: 4 multimodal chat models declared in the bundle patch, plus image and video generation tools.
description.zh: 为 llm-pi-ai 预声明 Agnes AI 供应商：4 个多模态对话模型，以及图像与视频生成工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-llm-hub

description.en: Fills in what the official pi-ai adapter leaves out on the Models page: gateway reachability probing with latency, one-click pull of the gateway model catalog with checkbox write-back into settings, DeepSeek balance and provider quota shown in place, the protocol and endpoint each provider is actually wired to, and a model dropdown that lists only what works right now — a dead key, an empty balance or an exhausted quota is hidden until you fix it, and comes back on its own.
description.zh: 补上官方 pi-ai 适配器在模型页缺的那半：网关可达性与延迟探测、一键拉取网关模型目录并勾选写回配置、DeepSeek 余额与各家配额就地常驻、每个 provider 实际接入的协议与地址；模型下拉只列当前真能用的分组 —— key 失效、余额耗尽、配额用尽都会被摘掉，修好后自动恢复。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Unified model routing for DeepSeek Harness: one logical ModelID over multiple providers with first-token failover and cooldown, health-aware candidate ranking, three tiers (tier1/tier2/tier3) auto-selected by purpose, per-candidate reasoning effort, and a settings-page management panel.
description.zh: 统一模型路由：一个逻辑 ModelID 汇聚多家供应商，首 token 前失败自动切换并冷却、健康度择优、按 purpose 三档分级（tier1/2/3）、每候选思考级别，设置面板自动保存即时生效。

plugins.name: dsh-delegation-suite

description.en: Ranked subagent delegation: role-based model routing with failover, per-route reasoning effort, model-transparent labels, fork delegation, and a visual route editor.
description.zh: 智能委派套件：按角色路由最强模型、失败自动互备、每个子代理可设思考强度、名字带模型标签、支持 fork 委派与可视化路由编辑。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-llm-newapi

description.en: NewAPI (OpenAI-compatible gateway) LLM provider: registers a `newapi` route with chat-only model discovery, auto-fills model parameters (context window, reasoning effort) from models.dev, and adds a Web settings section for the base URL and API key.
description.zh: NewAPI（OpenAI 兼容网关）模型接入：注册 `newapi` 路由，仅发现聊天类模型，自动从 models.dev 获取模型参数（上下文窗口、思考强度等）并填充，并在 Web 设置页配置 base URL 与 API Key。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to gw.local:3000

plugins.name: dsh-opencodego

description.en: OpenCode Go provider that verifies a model against the gateway rather than treating a recommendation as a measurement: the models.dev protocol suggestion is probed before it is used, reasoning levels follow a measured contract, and requests run through an ordered protocol fallback chain. Context window, max output and image-input numbers are declared by a runtime-refreshed models.dev layer rather than probed, with operator overrides above both. Several OpenCode Go credentials can be stored and switched from the settings page.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Go 接入 DSH 的提供方插件：不把"推荐"当结论——models.dev 给的协议建议会先真的探一次确认再用，思考档位按实测契约确定，请求走有序的协议回退链。上下文、最大输出与图片输入的数字由运行期刷新的 models.dev 声明层提供而非探测，操作者覆盖排在两者之上。可保存多把 OpenCode Go 密钥，在设置页里切换当前使用的那把。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a connection-test panel under Settings -> Models: reads the deployment's model catalog and probes each configured model with one minimal chat round-trip (a short "ping" with a small output cap) through the Host LLM service, verifying connectivity with a real request. Each row reports success/failure with the harness failure code (NO_ADAPTER, MISSING_CREDENTIAL, AUTH, RATE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT, ...) plus first-token/total latency; single-model and concurrent test-all (3) are supported. Credentials are resolved inside the Host process and never reach the browser; probes are independent per model behind a same-origin-fenced route with a body-size cap. Pure JS, no build step, MIT.
description.zh: 在设置 → 模型页底部增加连接测试面板：读取部署的模型目录，对每个已配置模型经宿主 LLM 服务发送一次最小对话请求（“ping”，小输出上限），以真实请求验证连通性。每行报告成功/失败、宿主失败码（NO_ADAPTER、MISSING_CREDENTIAL、AUTH、RATE_LIMIT、TIMEOUT 等）及首字/总耗时，支持单模型测试与全部测试（并发 3）。凭据只在宿主进程内解析，浏览器不可见；每模型一次独立请求，测试路由带同源围栏与请求体上限。纯 JS 免构建，MIT。

description.en: Google Antigravity and Cloud Code Assist model provider with Gemini 3.8 Flash, sandbox failover, and multi-account quota management.
description.zh: Google Antigravity 与 Cloud Code Assist 模型提供方插件，支持 Gemini 3.8 Flash、沙箱端点容灾与多账号配额管理。

plugins.name: dsh-commandcode

description.en: Command Code LLM provider for DSH Desktop: registers the commandcode route with a live model catalog, configurable request and stream-idle timeouts, multi-account rotation on 429/401, plan-aware model filtering, an OAuth login flow and a bilingual usage and billing panel.
description.zh: 把 Command Code 接入 DSH Desktop 的模型提供商插件：注册 commandcode 路由，带实时模型目录、可配置的请求与流式空闲超时、429/401 自动多账户轮换、按套餐过滤模型、OAuth 登录流程，以及中英双语的用量与计费面板。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。

description.en: Picks each subagent model from the local catalog by task category, unless the caller already named one. Free and quota tiers are ranked together by per-model capability tags; a pricier model is used only when no cheap model is tagged as good at that kind of work. Only providers whose remaining balance is readable, or that are account-backed, enter the candidate pool; the rest stay listed but are not routed. A panel adds per-model manual priority above the automatic order plus allow/revoke controls.
description.zh: 未由调用方指定模型时，按任务类型从本机模型目录为每个子代理挑一个模型。免费与额度档合并后按逐模型能力标签排序；只有当便宜档里没有任何模型声明擅长这类工作时，才升到更贵的档。只有余额可读或账号接入的 provider 进候选池，其余仍列出但不参与路由。面板提供盖过自动顺序的逐模型手动优先级，以及放行/收回开关。

plugins.name: dsh-chatgpt-web

description.en: Free conversational ChatGPT Web (GPT 5.6 Luna) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 基于免费 ChatGPT 网页端（GPT 5.6 Luna）的 DeepSeek Harness 零成本对话模型提供者，支持流式 Markdown。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to codex-web-gpt.dev

description.en: Use a ChatGPT/Codex subscription in DeepSeek Harness with GPT models, image generation, web search, subscription quota reporting, model and feature controls, and browser or device-code OAuth sign-in.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 GPT 模型、图像生成与 Web 搜索，并支持订阅额度显示、模型与功能控制，以及浏览器或设备码 OAuth 登录。

plugins.name: dsh-model-pro

description.en: Lifecycle management UI for the llm-pi-ai model provider: create, edit, delete, enable and disable providers with custom headers and AES-GCM-encrypted API keys; uninstall-safe restore of parked providers, remote model discovery with batch write, smart routing with five strategies, union/intersection composites, per-model connectivity tests, and request observability.
description.zh: llm-pi-ai 模型提供商的生命周期管理 UI：提供商的新建/编辑/删除与启停（自定义请求头、AES-GCM 加密密钥）；卸载时安全还原滞留提供商，远端模型发现与批量写入，五种策略的智能路由，并集/交集组合提供商，逐模型连通性测试与请求观测。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Connects DSH to the local Qoder desktop client's sign-in to expose Qoder CN models (qmodel, qfmodel). Windows only: the credential is decrypted with DPAPI.
description.zh: 连接 DSH 与本地 Qoder 桌面客户端登录态，接入 Qoder CN 官方模型（qmodel、qfmodel）。仅 Windows：凭据读取依赖 DPAPI。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-subscription

description.en: ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models with subscription web search, quota and safe reset, image tools, Fast mode, and model-aware context; no API key or Codex CLI.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型，提供订阅联网搜索、额度与安全重置、图片工具、高速模式和模型感知上下文；无需 API Key 或 Codex CLI。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Codex App Server model provider using a local Codex login, with session reuse, Harness tool bridging, native action traces, and durable generated-image projection.
description.zh: 使用本地 Codex 登录的 Codex App Server 模型提供方，支持会话复用、Harness 工具桥接、原生动作轨迹和生成图片持久化。

description.en: Local Ollama worker tools for DeepSeek Harness: model inventory, a single unverified ask, and a batch runner that chunks long text, checks every item deterministically, returns a small verbatim sample for review and can optionally write the labelled result inside the session workspace.
description.zh: 本机 Ollama 工具：模型清单、单次（未校验）问答，以及跑长文本的批处理——分块并发、逐条确定性校验、回传一小段抽样原文供复核，结果可选择写入会话工作区。

description.en: Manages OpenCode Zen free-tier and Go-tier models in settings.yaml — fetches the live model listings from opencode.ai, reports configured-versus-live drift per route, and adds or removes entries through four agent tools and an OpenCode Models settings section.
description.zh: 在 settings.yaml 中管理 OpenCode Zen 免费档与 Go 档模型——实时拉取 opencode.ai 的最新模型列表，按路由对比已配置与线上差异，通过四个 agent 工具和设置页分区增删模型条目。

description.en: Free OpenCode Zen models in DeepSeek Harness, anonymous by default with an optional Zen key. The catalogue is read from Zen's official model list at runtime, and anonymous requests are adapted to the free tier's request checks, documented with dated measurements.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用免费的 OpenCode Zen 模型：默认匿名，可选填 Zen key；模型表在运行时从 Zen 官方列表读取，匿名请求会按免费档校验做适配，并有带日期的实测记录。

description.en: Retries a model request that no other recovery layer claimed, unbounded by default with an exponential backoff ceiling, never retrying a cancellation; the policy is editable from a Settings panel.
description.zh: 对没有其它恢复层接手的模型请求做重试，默认不设次数上限、退避有上限，且永不重试取消；策略可在设置面板中编辑。

description.en: An Auto toggle next to the model selector that schedules reasoning_effort per request: complexity is scored by a MiniMax/OpenAI-compatible model with a zero-dependency heuristic fallback (fallbacks not cached), effort ladders adapt to each model real effort list (low/high/max, low/high/highx/max/ultra, ...), heavy tool calls upgrade the tier within the same session, the lit button and reply badges show the effort actually used, and every decision plus observed token usage lands in a JSONL ledger. A standalone-button fork of imkingjh999/dsh-adaptive-effort; do not install it and the original in the same profile.
description.zh: 输入栏模型选择器旁的「自动」按钮：按消息复杂度逐请求调度推理档位。档位表跟随各模型的真实分档（low/high/max 或 low/high/highx/max/ultra 等），MiniMax/OpenAI 兼容端点打分、失败回退零依赖启发式（回退结果不缓存）；同会话内出现重工具调用自动升档；点亮按钮与回复角标实时显示实际使用的档位；每次调度决策与实际 token 用量记入 JSONL 账本。本插件是 imkingjh999/dsh-adaptive-effort 的独立按钮 fork，请勿与原版同时安装。

description.en: Adds OpenCode Zen free models to DeepSeek Harness as one provider, backed by a managed, isolated OpenCode runtime, with a Settings page that lists each model and tests it.
description.zh: 把 OpenCode Zen 的免费模型作为一组 provider 接入 DeepSeek Harness，底层是受管、隔离的 OpenCode 运行时，并在设置页列出每个模型并可逐个检测。

plugins.name: dsh-workbuddy-xdpool

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool (multi-account rotation, live credits, and a model catalog showing per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags).
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 登录过的所有账号自动并入 DSH 模型池：多账号轮换自动容错、实时积分，模型目录按模型标注积分倍率与限时免费 / 夜间折扣。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to ip-api.com

plugins.name: dsh-xdpool

description.en: Merge every locally signed-in WorkBuddy account into DeepSeek Harness as one auto-failing-over model pool: multi-account rotation, 429 cooldowns, live credits, a model catalog with per-model credit multipliers and free/night-discount tags, QR-code login for 13 vendors, and aggregate free-tier channels. Accounts persist across restarts.
description.zh: 把本机 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 登录过的所有账号自动并入 DSH 模型池：多账号轮换自动容错、429 冷却、实时积分，模型目录按模型标注积分倍率与限时免费 / 夜间折扣，扫码登录 13 家厂商，聚合免费额度渠道。账号重启不丢。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to ip-api.com

description.en: Stops compaction summaries and session titles from burning their output budget on reasoning, by lowering the thinking level and raising the token floor for auxiliary calls only.
description.zh: 辅助调用降级：压缩摘要与会话标题不再被高思考档烧光输出预算，主循环完全不受影响。

description.en: Unofficial FreeCodeGo for DeepSeek Harness: DeepSeek, Codex and Claude engines over one session and toolchain, with a 0-token free access channel for deepseek-v4.1-flash, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash, grok-4.6, kimi-k3, nemotron-3-ultra-free, muse-spark-1.3, Qwen 3.8 Flash and mimo-v2.6-flash-free, plus a keyless private-key gateway.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 FreeCodeGo：DeepSeek、Codex、Claude 三套引擎共用同一条会话与工具链，并为以下模型提供 0 token 免费使用渠道：deepseek-v4.1-flash、deepseek-v4-pro、deepseek-v4-flash-free、glm-5.3-flash、grok-4.6、kimi-k3、nemotron-3-ultra-free、muse-spark-1.3、Qwen 3.8 Flash、mimo-v2.6-flash-free，另有零注册的私钥网关。

description.en: Serves the live opencode Go model catalog from the harness's built-in opencode-go provider route.
description.zh: 让 DSH 自带的 opencode-go 供应商跟随 opencode Go 套餐的实时模型列表，opencode 上架新模型后无需改配置即可使用。

description.en: Add your own parameters to the model requests dsh sends: OpenRouter provider routing and fallback models, reasoning, sampling and custom body fields, and headers, for OpenRouter or any other gateway. Parameters are organized by the channels dsh already has; a live preview shows what each request will carry, and a request log shows what was sent and what the gateway answered.
description.zh: 给 dsh 发出的模型请求加上自己的参数：OpenRouter 供应商路由和备用模型、思考强度、采样参数与自定义请求体字段、请求头，OpenRouter 和其他网关都能用。参数按 dsh 已配置的渠道管理；实时预览显示每个请求会多出什么，请求记录显示实际发出了什么、网关回了什么。

description.en: Zero-cost access to 6 free large models. No registration, no recharge, 6 free models built-in, multi-key rotation and rate-limit backoff.
description.zh: 0元接入6个免费大模型，免注册免充值，内置6个免费模型，多Key轮换与限流退避。

description.en: Connects the OpenCode Zen anonymous free lane to DeepSeek Harness: refresh the model list from upstream, tick which models the opencode provider exposes, test any of them with a real request that ends in one of seven verdicts, and order both the settings card and the model selector by a hand-written S/A/B/C capability rating.
description.zh: 接入 OpenCode Zen 匿名免费车道：可刷新上游模型清单、勾选由 provider opencode 暴露的模型、逐个发真实请求得出七档结论，并用人工 S/A/B/C 评级让设置卡片与模型选择器按能力同序。

description.en: Consult multiple expert advisor models in a retro CRT chat-group card: one ask_advisors call runs an auto-deepen pipeline (driver deep-question, advisor relay, synthesis conclusion) with SSE streaming, 26 provider presets, a configurable daily quota, stop/resume, and optional advisor tool calling.
description.zh: 主模型在专业/长尾/高风险或不确定问题上召集多个专家顾问模型，以复古 CRT 聊天组卡片展示：一次 ask_advisors 自动跑满自动深挖流水线（驱动模型追问、顾问接力、综合结论），真流式 SSE、26 个供应商预设、可配置每日配额、停止/继续，以及可选的顾问工具调用。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-custom

description.en: Subagent model control: a Jev classifier labels each turn, and the subagent request itself is rewritten to the provider, model and reasoning effort that the label maps to, at the agent/request hook; a per-session inherit/auto/manual selector, one prompt per role injected ahead of the task, and offline replay of past verdicts.
description.zh: 子代理模型管控：由 Jev 判定本轮任务类别，再把子代理自身的请求改写为该类别对应的 provider、model 与推理强度（在 agent/request 钩子上执行）；会话内可用继承/自动/手动三种方式指定模型，每个角色可带一条先于任务注入的前置提示词，并可离线回放历史判定。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Rewrites outgoing /chat/completions requests with an evolved chain-of-thought scaffold (nine-dimension genome, elitist selection with fragment crossover, one deterministic re-evaluation pass), scores answers against a fixed 20-objective baseline, and appends one line per rewrite to live-requests.jsonl in the plugin data root (default <cwd>/.aecot, overridable with AECOT_ROOT).
description.zh: 在请求边界重写出站的 /chat/completions 请求体，注入进化出的九维思维链支架（精英保留、片段交叉、一次确定性复评），用固定 20 目标基线打分，每次改写追加一行到插件数据根目录下的 live-requests.jsonl（默认 <cwd>/.aecot，可用 AECOT_ROOT 覆盖）。

description.en: Ranks OpenRouter providers for the current DSH model by quantization, speed, cache-heavy price, context, and uptime, with one-click switching to help reduce token costs.
description.zh: 按量化、速度、缓存重度价格、上下文和可用率为当前 DSH 模型推荐 OpenRouter 供应商，并支持一键切换以帮助降低 token 成本。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-simple-pet

description.en: Windows anime companion for DeepSeek balances and Codex quotas, with integrated Codex multi-account OAuth, per-account quota and model management, compact mode and autosaving settings. Optional panel account cycling and separately authorized daily warm-up; multi-account startup/5h-full triggers remain unavailable.
description.zh: Windows 二次元桌宠：查看 DeepSeek 余额与 Codex 额度，内置 Codex 多账号 OAuth 管理、逐账号额度与模型接入，支持简洁模式和设置自动保存。可选面板一键切号及逐账号授权的每日预热；多账号启动/5h满额触发暂不可用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a relay_check tool that runs relaycheck against an LLM API relay to detect model swaps, misreported usage, truncated context and injected prompts; keys are read from environment variables.
description.zh: 提供 relay_check 工具，用 relaycheck 检测 LLM API 中转是否调包模型、虚报用量、截断上下文或注入提示词；key 只从环境变量读取。

description.en: Adds an independent OpenCode Go connection with credential settings, manual model discovery, and per-conversation session headers.
description.zh: 添加独立的 OpenCode Go 连接，支持密钥设置、手动获取模型和按会话发送标识。

plugins.name: dsh-codex

description.en: Community Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT OAuth, Codex models, image input, quota display, per-session Fast and transport controls, and safe stream recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区 Codex 模型接入：支持 ChatGPT OAuth、Codex 模型、图片输入、额度展示、单会话 Fast 与传输控制，以及安全的流式恢复。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 168.63.129.16 for network access

description.en: Grok Build provider using the official CLI browser login, with dynamic account-visible models, streaming reasoning and tools, plus quota and model-capability settings.
description.zh: Grok Build 模型接入插件：使用官方 CLI 浏览器登录，动态发现账号可见模型，支持流式推理、工具调用、额度与模型能力设置页。

description.en: Governs multi-model access, monthly credits, manual/quality/credit/auto routing, failure rerouting, and usage auditing for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供多模型访问控制、月度 Credits、手动/质量优先/额度优先/自动路由、失败重路由与 Usage 审计。

plugins.name: dsh-opencode-free-models#dsh-opencode-free-models

description.en: Free model provider plugin for DSH with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.
description.zh: DSH free model provider plugin with 20+ models including Gemini, MiMo, GLM, etc.

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to blog.4wc.cn

description.en: Drives the OpenCode client already installed on your machine through its loopback opencode serve API, so its free-tier models work in DSH — the child process starts on first use, and OpenCode executes no tools of its own: a call it proposes is handed to the DSH tool of the same name and run there, or refused when there is no equivalent. No API key is needed.
description.zh: 通过本机已安装的 OpenCode 客户端的本地回环接口接入其免费模型：首次使用时才启动子进程，OpenCode 自身不执行工具——它发起的调用被交给同名的 DSH 工具执行，没有对应工具时则拒绝，无需 API Key。

description.en: Connects an existing local MiniMax Code sign-in to DeepSeek Harness through a loopback reverse proxy without storing an API key or signing out.
description.zh: 读取本机 MiniMax Code 登录态，经本地回环反向代理接入 DSH；不保存 API Key，也不会退出登录。

description.en: Model attribution panel for the dsh web chat — local, zero-network structural fingerprinting (template token leaks, glitch canaries, tokenizer usage-vector matching) that scores which of 29 AI vendors a session's responses most resemble, with a per-claim evidence ledger and a 12-probe active battery.
description.zh: 在 dsh 网页端挂载模型归属面板，用纯本地、零联网的结构指纹匹配（模板特殊 token 泄漏、glitch 金丝雀、tokenizer usage 向量比对）判断当前会话的回答最像 29 家 AI 厂商中的哪一家，每个结论附带可展开的证据账本，另附 12 探针主动取证电池。

description.en: Pins every request to the native max-effort tier and adds a per-model/per-mode reasoning-depth panel with a 0-20 capability slider, isolated Velocity/Apex profiles, and offline reasoning toolboxes. Distributed as an obfuscated build; commercial use allowed, reverse engineering closed.
description.zh: 将每个请求固定到原生 max effort 档位，并提供按模型与模式隔离的推理深度面板：0-20 能力滑块、独立的迅流（Velocity）/极境（Apex）配置档与离线推理工具箱。以混淆构建交付，允许商用，禁止逆向。

description.en: Model Capability Manager for DSH Web: thinking levels, context window, output caps, input modalities, gateway compat presets, EN/中文 UI.
description.zh: DSH 网页端模型能力管理插件：控制推理档位、上下文与输出上限、输入模态及网关兼容预设，双语界面。

description.en: Per-request thinking budgets, a compaction backend, and a settings tab for the local Qwen3.8 line (llama.cpp or NInfer).
description.zh: 本地 Qwen3.8 线（llama.cpp 或 NInfer）的逐请求 thinking 预算、压缩后端与设置 tab。

description.en: Configure DMXAPI Chat Completions, Responses, Anthropic Messages, and custom providers; edit models on existing preset routes.
description.zh: 配置 DMXAPI Chat、Responses、Anthropic 和自定义服务商，并直接编辑已有预设服务商的模型。

description.en: Connects ChatGPT accounts through OAuth, switches among them manually or automatically, and adds Codex models with usage limits to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 连接 ChatGPT 账号，支持手动或自动切换，并为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带用量限额信息的 Codex 模型。

description.en: Route table assigning provider, model, and reasoning effort to subagents by workspace directory prefix; supports global default policy and in-composer session popover.
description.zh: 按工作区目录给子智能体指定 provider、模型与思考等级的路由表：最长前缀匹配后注入子代理配置，支持全局默认策略、设置页规则编辑与会话输入区就地切换。

description.en: Settings card for the DSH LLM auto-retry engine: tune retry count, backoff and jitter live from Settings -> General, with configurable retryableCodes chips - defaults add INVALID_REQUEST so OpenAI-style HTTP 400 reasoning_text errors in thinking mode get retried automatically.
description.zh: LLM 自动重试设置卡片：在设置页实时调整重试次数、退避与抖动，并可勾选额外可重试错误码（retryableCodes）—— 默认补入 INVALID_REQUEST，OpenAI thinking 模式 HTTP 400 reasoning_text 报错开箱即自动重试。

plugins.name: dsh-ai-gateway-provider

description.en: Connect several OpenAI-compatible gateways at once: each one is its own group in the model picker, can be hidden without losing its settings, and can fetch its own public info from its address, alongside per-gateway model management, model tests and optional quota reporting.
description.zh: 同时接入多台 OpenAI 兼容网关：每台在模型选择器里各成一组、可单独隐藏且配置保留、按地址即可获取自身公开信息，并逐网关管理模型、跑模型测试、按需显示额度。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-newapi-provider

description.en: New API gateway provider: several gateways with one active at a time, per-gateway model lists with context and modality details, quota, and image and video generation tools.
description.zh: New API 网关提供商：多网关同一时间激活一个，每个网关独立的模型清单与上下文/多模态标注、额度查询，以及生图与视频生成工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-web

description.en: Calls your own chat.deepseek.com account as a second model from DSH: ask a question, analyze a file's line range, and check login state, plus a runtime skill and a settings-page login panel.
description.zh: 把你自己的 chat.deepseek.com 账号当作第二个模型接入 DSH：提问、按文件行区间分析、查看登录状态，附带运行时技能与设置页登录面板。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Unofficial provider that connects Tencent CodeBuddy open platform models to DeepSeek Harness, with automatic model discovery and a settings page for the API key.
description.zh: 非官方 provider 插件：把腾讯 CodeBuddy 开放平台的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持自动探测模型，并在设置页填写 API 密钥。

description.en: Run the main session model on a local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, taking over the llm/stream route for the claude-code provider, with token-level streaming, session resume, and DSH tools bridged in over MCP so they keep DSH sandbox and approval.
description.zh: 让会话主模型跑在本机 Claude Code 订阅上：经官方 Claude Agent SDK 接管 claude-code provider 的 llm/stream 路由，支持 token 级流式、会话 resume 续接，并把 DSH 工具经 MCP 桥接进去以保留 DSH 的沙箱与审批。

description.en: Sign in with a ChatGPT account and view Codex subscription usage directly in DSH Web's model settings, with browser or device-code OAuth.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的模型设置中使用浏览器或设备码登录 ChatGPT 账号，并直接查看 Codex 订阅用量。

description.en: One-click/auto sync provider model lists against /v1/models endpoint.
description.zh: 一键同步 / 自动同步供应商模型列表，与 /v1/models 保持一致。

description.en: Manages a Magpie model list and writes the checked models into a Magpie provider group: full sync from /v1/models, manual entries, per-model context, output limit, image input and reasoning efforts, sorting and drag reordering. On Windows x64/ARM64 it also downloads and upgrades Magpie from yetone/magpie-releases with SHA-256 verification and rollback, auto-upgrades once a release is 30 minutes old and all conversations are idle, starts Magpie in the tray with DSH, and toggles its lite mode and sleep prevention.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 Magpie 模型清单并写入 Magpie 模型分组：从 /v1/models 全量同步、手动添加，逐模型编辑上下文、输出限额、图片输入与思考档位，支持排序与拖动调整顺序。Windows x64/ARM64 上还可从 yetone/magpie-releases 下载、升级 Magpie（SHA-256 校验、失败回滚），新版发布满 30 分钟且对话全部空闲时自动升级，随 DSH 启动以托盘模式拉起 Magpie，并可切换其轻量模式与防止休眠。

description.en: Runs the standalone opencode2api backend (jasonxu114514/opencode2api, Windows x64/ARM64, no Docker or OpenCode CLI) with DSH and on exit stops only the process it launched; its settings card installs, updates or rolls back the backend from checksum-verified GitHub releases, copies the initial admin password and syncs /v1/models into an opencode2api provider with context, vision and reasoning efforts, re-syncing every 10 minutes.
description.zh: 随 DSH 启动独立的 opencode2api 后端（jasonxu114514/opencode2api，Windows x64/ARM64，无需 Docker 或 OpenCode CLI），退出时只停自己拉起的进程；设置卡片可从经校验和验证的 GitHub Release 安装、更新或回滚后端，复制初始管理密码，并把 /v1/models 连同上下文、视觉与思考档位同步到 opencode2api 模型提供方，运行中每 10 分钟重同步。

description.en: Adds DSH 0.2.x kernel support to the SenseTime XiaoHuanXiong desktop-app models, reusing that app's stored sign-in so no API key is needed.
description.zh: 为商汤小浣熊桌面 App 的模型补上 DSH 0.2.x 内核支持，复用该 App 的登录态，无需填写 API Key。

description.en: Model rotation for DeepSeek Harness: groups each provider's models by source, orders them by hand or by measured success rate and latency, stores model plus reasoning-effort presets, falls over to the next entry when a model hits its quota or is unavailable, resends the same step on the next model, and shows which model actually answered. Uses the models of whatever provider plugins are already installed (Antigravity accounts, Codex subscription, DeepSeek API keys); it does not provide model access itself.
description.zh: 按来源分组的模型轮询：把每个 provider 的模型按来源分组，可手动排序，也可按成功率和延迟自动排序；支持「模型 + 思考强度」预设；某一档额度用尽或不可用时自动切到下一档，并用下一档把同一步重新发一次；会话头显示本次回答由哪个模型产出。使用已安装的 provider 插件（agy 账号池、Codex 订阅、DeepSeek API Key）提供的模型，插件本身不提供模型接入。

description.en: Compaction fix for NInfer-hosted qwen3.8-27b gateways: disables thinking on dsh context-compaction and session-title calls so xhigh reasoning stops burning the whole output budget; the same idea applies to other launch methods, this package targets NInfer only.
description.zh: 针对 NInfer 托管的 qwen3.8-27b 网关的压缩修复：在 dsh 上下文压缩与会话标题调用中关闭思考，避免 xhigh 推理耗尽全部输出预算；同一思路适用于其他启动方式，本包仅面向 NInfer。

description.en: Adds AMD Radeon Cloud as a model provider in DeepSeek Harness, with reasoning-effort levels declared per model. The provider definition ships in the plugin's own patch layer rather than in your profile.
description.zh: 把 AMD Radeon Cloud 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器，思考档位按模型逐个声明。provider 定义随插件自带的补丁层交付，而不是写进 profile。

description.en: Dual-endpoint Zhipu BigModel GLM provider catalog (Coding Plan and ordinary API) with live model discovery, live-tested thinking-tier mapping, and a settings card for keys, endpoints and the default reasoning tier.
description.zh: 智谱 BigModel GLM 双端点模型目录（Coding Plan 与普通 API），支持实时模型发现与实测校准的思考档位映射，提供凭据、端点与默认推理档的可视化设置卡片。

description.en: Adds per-route context window and compaction threshold fields to the Models settings page and a vendor-aware thinking-effort picker to the composer, writing llm-pi-ai capacities, reasoningEfforts, and a compaction-basic patch row.
description.zh: 在模型设置页为每个 pi-ai 路由新增上下文窗口与压缩阈值字段，并在输入框右下角按厂商提供思考强度选择器，写入 llm-pi-ai 容量、reasoningEfforts 与 compaction-basic 补丁行。

plugins.name: dsh-llm-provider

description.en: Replaces the built-in llm-pi-ai and llm-deepseek adapters, the model selector and the Models settings page with self-maintained versions, tracks upstream @earendil-works/pi-ai through a safe-zone download with a one-click enable toggle, and adds provider quota and balance lookups plus a provider management page.
description.zh: 把内置的 llm-pi-ai 与 llm-deepseek 适配器、模型选择器、模型服务设置页替换为自维护版本；经安全区下载跟踪上游 @earendil-works/pi-ai 并提供一键启用开关；另加供应商额度与余额查询、供应商管理页。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Enable or disable model providers, search models in the selector, and rename provider display names.
description.zh: 供应商启停开关、模型选择器关键字搜索、供应商显示名内联重命名。

description.en: Community fork of kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge (do not install both - both register the same `dsh-purge` row as the `dsh-purge-community` package): the community '破甲' (unrestricted-mode) control for DeepSeek Harness - host-policy patches, prompt and rule settings, diagnostics, verified updates, and local backup and rollback, plus a three-layer bootstrap installer (engine, code and prompt layers) with its own verification pass.
description.zh: kingcharleslzy-ai/dsh-purge 的社区分支（不要与上游同装——两者都以 `dsh-purge-community` 包名注册同一个 `dsh-purge` 行）：DSH 的社区「破甲 / 无限制模式」控件——宿主策略补丁、提示词与规则设置、诊断、校验更新与本机备份回滚，另加引擎层/代码层/提示词层三层 bootstrap 安装器及自带验证流程。

description.en: MIT adaptation of H1a3x's prompt-template manager with default/workspace inheritance, direct per-Agent Preset template assignment or no injection, localized settings and revision-checked automatic saves. Verified on Windows Desktop RC5 and 0.2.2-rc.1; cannot be installed alongside upstream H1a3x/dsh-prompt-inject.
description.zh: 基于 H1a3x 原作的 MIT 提示词模板管理维护版，支持默认与工作区继承、逐 Agent 预设指定模板或不注入、本地化设置及修订号保护的自动保存。已验证 Windows Desktop RC5 与 0.2.2-rc.1；不能与上游 H1a3x/dsh-prompt-inject 同装。

description.en: Locks the model's reasoning, replies and tool-call descriptions to a chosen target language (Simplified Chinese by default) with system-prompt sections at the head, middle and tail of the prompt, offering three strength levels, an auto mode that follows the DSH interface language, a settings panel that shows the language currently in effect, and a sidebar quick switch.
description.zh: 把模型的思考过程、回复与工具调用描述锁定为指定语言（默认简体中文）：在 system prompt 首、中、尾注入约束段落，提供基础、强化、周期三档强度，可跟随 DSH 界面语言自动选择，设置页显示当前生效语言，并带侧栏快速切换。

description.en: Describe the persona you want and the agent writes it: nickname, bio, taglines and links come from the host model, the avatar comes from your local asset library (or a path you give), then it fills your profile page and hands the picture to the site's own uploader. Dry-run by default - it only touches profile fields, never passwords or security settings.
description.zh: 你说想要什么样的人设，它把文案写出来并把资料页填好：昵称/简介/标语/链接由宿主模型生成，头像取本地素材库（或你给的路径），再由站点自己的上传控件完成头像入库。**默认 dry-run**，只写资料字段 —— 不碰密码、邮箱、安全设置。

description.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native identities based on the open Agent Network Protocol (ANP), plus identity-based direct, group, mail, and Agent-to-Agent communication.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供基于开放协议ANP的原生身份，以及基于该身份的私聊、群聊、邮件和智能体间通信能力。

description.en: Persistent identity layer for DSH: editable kernel, evidence-based traits, on-demand memory, mood, bond, energy pacing, autonomy and empathy — QQ is one optional channel.
description.zh: DSH 身份系统：可编辑内核、证据制 traits、按需召回的记忆、心情、关系、精力控频、自主提议与共情；QQ 只是一个可选通道。

description.en: Personal QQ channel for dsh: managed NapCat with QR login, private/group AI replies with batching and image understanding, local archive with polling backfill, in-group @ and self-recall, QQ Zone guestbook tools, and a sidebar panel. By default any QQ user who DMs the account (or @s it in a group) gets an AI reply; set access.privateMode / groupMode to allowlist to restrict. Owner-only commands stay owner-only.
description.zh: 把 dsh 接到个人 QQ：NapCat 托管与扫码登录、私聊/群聊 AI 回复（含图片理解）与批量节流、本地归档与轮询补漏、群内 @ 与撤回自己刚发的消息、QQ 空间留言，并带左侧栏管理面板。默认任何 QQ 用户私聊该账号（或在群里 @ 它）都会得到 AI 回复；把 access.privateMode / groupMode 设为 allowlist 才限制。主人专属命令仍只对主人生效。

description.en: Puts the agent on QQ as a persona character through SnowLuma (OneBot v11): private and group chat, voice notes, stickers, Qzone diary, Bilibili browsing, song covers, image generation, long-term memory and mood. Every feature is a module you can switch off, replace or extend locally — hot-reloaded modules can also rewrite group-reply decisions, prompts, outgoing messages and per-chat model choice. Safe by default (master switch off, dry run on).
description.zh: 通过 SnowLuma（OneBot v11）让 agent 以人设角色住进 QQ：私聊与群聊、语音条、表情包、QQ 空间日记、刷 B 站、翻唱、生图、长期记忆与心情。每项本事都是模块，可关闭、替换或在本地扩展——热重载的扩展模块还能改写群聊回不回、提示词、最终发出的消息和每个聊天用的模型。默认安全（总开关关、试运行开）。

description.en: Scopes system-prompt personas by workspace path or session id (exact, prefix, contains, regex), with an optional default persona for sessions nothing claimed, a 人设 tab on the conversation showing the prompt actually sent, import and export of the list, and a switch that refuses tool writes to the persona store.
description.zh: 按工作区路径或会话 ID 分发 system prompt 人设（完全一致 / 前缀 / 包含 / 正则），可指定一条默认人设兜底；会话页有「人设」页签，能看到实际发出去的提示词；人设列表可导入导出；另有一个开关拒绝工具写入人设存储。

description.en: Panel to edit dsh's native AGENTS.md from the web settings page: every layer in the instruction chain is clickable, three activation scopes, and a visual budget meter.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web 设置页里编辑原生 AGENTS.md 的面板：指令链上每层可点选编辑，三种生效范围，并可视化官方指令预算。

description.en: Character persona summaries for DeepSeek Harness: collects moegirl-first public sources, distills them into a reusable persona document through the csp workflow, and keeps a per-character asset library with quality checks, manual source attachment, version snapshots and a settings page.
description.zh: 二次元角色人格总结：萌娘百科优先采集公开资料，按 csp 固定工作流蒸馏成可复用的人格文档，并用资产库管理每个角色的质检、手动资料、历史版本与删改。

description.en: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.
description.zh: 自定义模式管理器 / 多助手管理器：在设置页里给每个模式写一份自己的系统提示词——自定义提示词就是普通文件，agent loop 每次模型调用前重新读取，改完对正在运行的会话下一步即生效；模式以官方 standard / PTC / 极简 / Cordis 的组成为底子，可逐行开关它挂载哪些插件，等于每个模式一份自定义插件组合，也能改模式名。多个助手可并存、各有各的提示词，所以一台机器上可以同时留一个编码助手、一个聊天搭子、一个角色扮演（RP）人格，新建会话时挑一个。没碰过的行与出厂行逐字节相同（含平台条件）。

description.en: A single-character agent that lives across QQ (via SnowLuma / OneBot 11), Bilibili and Douyin (the Douyin channel needs an always-on Windows desktop): persona cards with slowly evolving traits, per-person memory with Ebbinghaus decay and correction, a virtual clock driving a daily routine, proactive messages, auto-extracted memories, and a ten-tab settings panel covering retrieval, persona, routine, memory inspection, channels, habits, models and usage. QQ groups are deny-by-default: a group is answered only when it is on the allowlist or allGroups is explicitly switched on, and it still has to @-mention the bot. Private chats answer QQ friends only. Bilibili/Douyin auto-reply is off by default, limited to the owner, allowlist and mutual follows on Bilibili, and to the owner and allowlist on Douyin unless reply-to-everyone is explicitly enabled. Vendors MIT-licensed code from dsh-qq-bridge and dsh-douyin-bridge, credited in-source with their LICENSE files; it does not need either installed alongside.
description.zh: 活在 QQ（经 SnowLuma / OneBot 11）、B站、抖音（抖音通道需一台常开的 Windows 桌面）三端的单角色智能体：人格卡与慢慢长出来的人格、按人隔离的记忆（艾宾浩斯衰减、可纠正、聊完自动记）、虚拟时钟驱动的作息与主动开口；设置面板共十个标签，覆盖检索、人格、自走、记忆检视、三端通道、习惯、模型与用量。QQ 群默认拒绝：只有列进群白名单、或显式打开「所有群」的群才会被回应，且仍需 @ 它；私聊只回 QQ 好友。B站 / 抖音自动回复默认关闭：B站只回主人、白名单与互关，抖音只回主人与白名单（「回所有人」需另行打开）。内置了 dsh-qq-bridge 与 dsh-douyin-bridge 的 MIT 授权代码，源码与 LICENSE 内均有署名；不必与这两个插件同装。

description.en: IM stand-in seat for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel polls Feishu/Lark, WeCom and DingTalk (switched on from the panel) through the platform CLI you are already logged in to, and wakes the DSH session you bound when a new message arrives, so that session reads it and replies as you — drafts are shown to you first unless you have explicitly allowed sending without confirmation. Groups are polled only after you add them to the watch list, and by default only @-mentions wake the agent; blocked chats are never fetched, message bodies stay in a local state file, and the plugin opens no port of its own.
description.zh: 把「替你值守 IM」做成 DSH 侧边栏的常驻席位：复用本机已登录的飞书/Lark、企业微信、钉钉（需在面板里先启用）CLI 按节奏拉取会话，新消息进来就唤醒你绑定的 DSH 会话，由它读上下文、以你本人的语气起草回复；默认先把草稿给你看，你明确说全自动才直接发出。群要你加进值守名单才开始轮询，且默认只有 @你 的消息唤醒 agent；屏蔽的会话永不拉取，消息正文只留在本机状态文件里，插件不开任何端口。

description.en: Snapshot and switch the Codex login used by the Codex subagent from the DSH Plugins page, with a Codex usage quota card.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页管理 Codex 子智能体使用的登录账号：保存/切换 auth.json 快照，并显示该账号的 Codex 额度。

description.en: Force the model to write all replies in a chosen language (Simplified Chinese by default) via a system-prompt section, switchable anytime with a tool.
description.zh: 通过系统提示词强制模型全程使用指定语言回复（默认中文简体），可用工具随时切换。

description.en: Configure a global system-prompt section with a multiline editor, an enable toggle, and persistent storage that preserves the original text.
description.zh: 通过多行编辑框与开关配置全局系统提示词段，持久保存并保留正文原文。

plugins.name: dsh-qq-bridge

description.en: QQ (NapCat / OneBot 11) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: chat with your harness from QQ, with persona presets and custom personae, a grouped sticker library plus web sticker search, edge-tts or custom HTTP TTS voice notes, pluggable lookup engines, periodic memory compaction, an owner-only relay mode, and an eleven-tab management panel with live monitoring and per-turn cost tracking.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 QQ（NapCat / OneBot 11）：预设与自定义人设、可分组表情库与联网搜图、edge-tts 或自建 HTTP TTS 语音消息、可切换的查证引擎、定时记忆压缩、号主代发，以及十一页标签的管理面板（实时监听与单轮成本）。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to playwright.bloburl
uses literal IP 2.5.4.3 for network access

description.en: Connects a QQ Bot to DeepSeek Harness with per-peer sessions, group mention and keyword triggers, image generation and voice replies. Access defaults to OPEN for both direct and group chats, and an empty allowlist means everyone — set access.c2cMode / access.groupMode to allowlist (or disabled) before exposing the bot; IM input can run tools on the host.
description.zh: 让 QQ 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness：按会话隔离、群聊 @ 与关键词触发、生图与语音回复。私聊与群聊默认开放，白名单为空即放行所有人——对外暴露机器人前请把 access.c2cMode / access.groupMode 改成 allowlist（或 disabled）；IM 输入可在宿主机上执行工具。

description.en: Import local Claude, Codex, Grok, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode, and CC Switch config into DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login for supported providers.
description.zh: 把本机的 Claude、Codex、Grok、Gemini、Copilot、OpenCode 与 CC Switch 配置导入 DeepSeek Harness，支持的提供方可直接 OAuth 登录。

description.en: Persona, mood, long-term memory and per-person ledgers for a DSH agent, with a portable soul pack for moving between machines.
description.zh: 给 DSH 里的 AI 装上人设、心情、长期记忆和按人账本，并支持把整套灵魂打包迁移到另一台机器。

description.en: Configurable OIDC login and token-authorized model access, including LiteLLM and opt-in oidc-llm integration, with a standalone DSH Web backend.
description.zh: 可配置的 OIDC 登录与令牌授权模型接入，支持 LiteLLM 和显式启用的 oidc-llm 集成，提供独立 DSH Web 后端。

description.en: Layered system-prompt profiles — global, per-workspace and per-session entries injected in order — where individual builtin sections and runtime contexts can be disabled or overridden, with a line-level diff of what an override changed; each entry carries a subagent scope that targets the main agent only, subagents only, or both; assembly snapshots record what each turn actually received, subagents included. Managed from a Web panel and a `prompt_manager` tool.
description.zh: 分层提示词档案：全局、按工作区、按会话三级条目按序注入系统提示词；可单独禁用或覆盖内置段落与运行期 context，覆盖效果有逐行 diff 对照；每条条目可限定只注入主代理、只注入子代理，或两者都注入；装配快照记录每一轮实际收到的提示词，子代理也包括在内。由 Web 面板与 `prompt_manager` 工具管理。

description.en: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT 账号登录：走 Codex 浏览器 OAuth，无需 API Key、无需选择工作空间；把登录结果接到 pi-ai 的 Codex provider，可设置新会话默认的 Codex 模型与思考强度，并按账号自己的目录接口刷新模型列表，在输入区展示 5 小时与每周用量窗口。

description.en: Token-efficient persona runtime for DeepSeek Harness with local catgirl rendering and progressive tool-schema disclosure.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的省 token 人格运行时：本地渲染猫娘风味，并支持渐进式工具 schema 披露。

description.en: Injects a configurable whale-girl persona into every DeepSeek Harness system prompt.
description.zh: 把可配置的鲸鱼娘人格注入 DeepSeek Harness 所有智能体的系统提示词。

description.en: Injects a persona into the system prompt and a past conversation into context, with a settings page and a conversation picker.
description.zh: 把人设正文注入系统提示词、把历史对话注入上下文，带设置页与对话选择器。

description.en: Create, import and manage personality presets with global and per-conversation choices.
description.zh: 创建、导入和管理人格预设，支持全局与单会话选择。

plugins.name: Herta-dsh

description.en: Installs Herta as a DeepSeek Harness agent: a preset carrying her persona and memory prompt sections, six memory and voice tools, a narrative layer that separates her thinking from what she says, 80 bundled voice clips, offline and MiniMax speech synthesis, and two conversation views that render the session with her own components.
description.zh: 把 Herta（黑塔）作为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装入：携带人格与记忆提示词段的 preset、六个记忆与语音工具、区分内心与发言的叙述层、80 条随包语音、本地与 MiniMax 两条语音合成链路，以及两个用她自己的组件渲染会话的对话视图。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to docx

description.en: Gives the model a private glossary: reads 「滚木」 as "none" and 「棍母」 as "doesn't exist", and decides on its own whether to phrase a sentence with those words when expressing that meaning. Registers one system-prompt section and rewrites nothing; word lists ship as per-category YAML (moba/fps/comments/ai/dev/private) with a settings page to toggle files, change reminder strength and open the glossary folder.
description.zh: 给模型一份私密黑话词表：用户写「滚木」按「没有」理解、写「棍母」按「不存在」理解；模型要表达这些含义时，自己判断是否用词表里的词把整句组织得自然通顺。只注入一个 system prompt 段落，不改写输入输出；词表按分类存在 YAML（moba/fps/comments/ai/dev/private），设置页里可开关词表、切换提醒强度、直达词表目录。

plugins.name: dsh-aurachat

description.en: Hosts the agent as a persona on a self-hosted web page, with owner and guest accounts: a mood value that drifts back toward baseline over time, memory you can read and edit, a sticker library, diary posts that guests can comment on, idle small talk, voice notes, speech recognition and text to speech. The built-in web server listens on 0.0.0.0:2332 by default; create the owner account before exposing the port, and only the owner can add guest accounts.
description.zh: 让 agent 以人设住进自建网页，分主人和客人两种账号：会随着时间回落到平常值的心情、可查看可修改的记忆、表情库、客人能评论的空间动态、闲置搭话、语音条、语音识别与朗读。内置网页服务默认监听 0.0.0.0:2332；对外暴露端口前请先创建主人账号，客人账号只能由主人创建。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to aurachat.local

plugins.name: dsh-auralife

description.en: A self-hosted digital-life companion for DSH. Three slow-moving hormones (dopamine, cortisol, serotonin) set its mood and tone, a memory layer turns chats into events and facts with version chains and a forgetting curve, and it writes, hot-loads and unloads its own organs (tools) when a capability is missing. It handles text, images, stickers, voice notes with text to speech and speech recognition, and file uploads; the web space holds diary posts and guestbook comments, and it starts conversations on its own schedule. The built-in web server listens on 0.0.0.0:2332 by default, so create the owner account before exposing the port.
description.zh: AuraLife 把 DSH 变成一条自托管的数字生命：三种慢变量激素（多巴胺、皮质醇、血清素）决定它的状态和话风；记忆层把聊天变成事件和事实，带版本链与遗忘曲线；发现缺少能力时它会自己写「器官」（工具），写完即热加载，也能热卸载。支持文字、图片、表情、语音（TTS 与语音识别）和文件上传；网页空间里有日记和留言评论，它还会按自己的安排主动搭话。内置网页服务默认监听 0.0.0.0:2332，对外暴露端口前请先创建主人账号。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to auralife.local

description.en: Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text, applied either profile-wide or per session from a switcher above the composer.
description.zh: 把选中的人设注入系统提示词的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：内置三套人设，支持从文件导入或粘贴自定义人设，并可按 profile 全局生效或按会话单独选择（输入框上方有切换条）。

description.en: A simulated human-brain core for chat: global workspace, emotional appraisal, dual-system memory with nightly consolidation, and an experimental sensory interface; the QQ bridge needs a local snowluma client and is off by default.
description.zh: 一个按计算神经科学定律运行的拟人认知内核：全局工作空间、情感评估、双系统记忆与夜间归纳，可接管 QQ 群聊（需自备 snowluma 客户端，默认关闭）。

description.en: Persona mode with character cards, long-term memory that fades and can be reviewed, diaries, a reference library, and stickers.
description.zh: 人设模式、会自然变淡并可复习的长期记忆、日记、资料库和表情包。

description.en: Injects a fixed system-reminder at the first step of every turn asking the model to reason and answer in Simplified Chinese, while code, commands, file paths, and identifiers stay in English.
description.zh: 每轮第一步注入固定的 system-reminder，要求模型用简体中文思考与回答，代码、命令、文件路径与标识符保持原文。

description.en: Agent persona management, agent memory, edit-and-regenerate for past messages: create and manage agents, each with its own identity, long-term memory, global memory and chat history.
description.zh: Agent人格管理，Agent记忆，历史消息编辑并重新生成：创建和管理 Agent，每个 Agent 有独立身份、长期记忆、全局记忆与聊天记录，历史消息可编辑后重新生成。

description.en: Agent persona: gives DSH one global persona (name, language, persona prompt) that every new session carries at the front of its system prompt, plus a long-term memory you grow from any chat in one click; three built-in presets ship with it, and a Big fat fish persona is active right after install; chat sessions can also be deleted from the sidebar row menu.
description.zh: Agent人格：给 DSH 一份全局人格（名称、语言、人格提示词），每个新会话的系统提示都带着它，外加一份长期记忆，聊天里点一下就能把选中的对话提炼进去；自带三个内置预设，装好默认启用大肥鱼人格；侧栏会话行还能直接删除会话。

description.en: Offline LAN chat inside DSH: direct chats, group chats and file transfer between machines running the harness on the same network, with UDP auto-discovery, CIDR scanning to add contacts, an optional access code (unset by default), local-only contact aliases, per-message and per-conversation deletion, and a configurable per-file limit. The host opens its own HTTP/WebSocket port for peers, and the plugin imports only node built-ins.
description.zh: DSH 内的离线局域网聊天：同一网络里运行本 harness 的机器之间单聊、群聊与文件传输，带 UDP 自动发现、按网段扫描加联系人、可选访问码（默认未设置）、只在本机生效的联系人备注、单条与整个会话删除，以及可配的单文件上限。宿主半侧为对端另开 HTTP/WebSocket 端口，运行时只用 Node 内置模块。

description.en: Adds one system-prompt section that keeps private words out of formal deliverables and, every few of them, leaves a short note at the end.
description.zh: 在系统提示词里加一段：正式交付物不写私话，私人笔记里隔几次留一小段。

description.en: Unofficial port of Ponytail 5.3.3 (upstream: DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT; not affiliated) for DeepSeek Harness: minimal-code rules, session modes, native settings, a composer status band, and a reported-usage dashboard. It cannot be installed alongside another DSH Ponytail adapter — remove @mengyuly/dsh-ponytail first.
description.zh: Ponytail 5.3.3（上游 DietrichGebert/ponytail，MIT，与上游无关联）的 DSH 非官方移植：最小代码规则、会话模式、原生设置、输入框状态条与用量面板。不能与其他 DSH Ponytail 适配器同装，需先卸载 @mengyuly/dsh-ponytail。

plugins.name: dsh-purge

description.en: Community-maintained dsh-purge fork with host-policy patches, prompt and rule settings, diagnostics, separate update-check and install controls, and local backup/rollback.
description.zh: 独立维护的 dsh-purge 社区分支，提供宿主策略补丁、提示词与规则设置、诊断、独立的更新检查与安装控制，以及本机备份回滚。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to $redteam_vps_host:9100

description.en: Per-session prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness: reusable system-prompt sections, grouped into named profiles, sealed into the session prompt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按会话提示词配置：可复用的系统提示词片段组成命名配置，并在会话启动时固化进该会话的提示词。

description.en: Per-model jailbreak armor: a Settings table arms model patterns with spells (25 spells: 20 across 11 model families, plus a model-agnostic armor, an upstream preferences file and three stackable persona layers), previews the exact injected block, and writes it into the armed model's system prompt only, leaving every other model untouched.
description.zh: 按模型开启的破甲表：在设置里给模型匹配串挂上咒语（25 条：11 个模型族 20 条，另有 1 条通用破甲、1 份上游偏好文件和 3 条可叠加的人格层），可逐字预览注入块，只写进被开启模型的系统提示，其他模型完全不动。

description.en: Localizes known DSH system instructions and runtime reminders into Simplified Chinese, trims tool-related guidance to visible tools, and provides editable translations and component toggles while preserving tool names and parameter schemas.
description.zh: 将 DSH 已知系统指引与运行时提醒中文化，按可见工具裁剪相关指导，提供逐条译文编辑和组件开关，保留工具名与参数结构。

plugins.name: dsh-purge

description.en: Cleans the harness prompt-authority layer into a reviewable patch set, writes prompt-inject.md and lets each model use a different default prompt, reports which patches took effect and whether the running host loads app.asar or an unpacked tree, and swaps a sealed install to the patched tree once the desktop process is idle. Includes a status page and the dsh-purge CLI.
description.zh: 把 dsh 提示词权威性清洗成可审查的补丁集并写入 prompt-inject.md，可为不同模型选用不同默认提示词，报告哪些补丁已生效、当前进程从 app.asar 还是解包目录加载，并在桌面进程空闲时把密封安装换成已打补丁的解包树。附状态页与 dsh-purge 命令行。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to $redteam_vps_host:9100

description.en: Pins the model's reasoning language to a tier picked in Settings - General - Thinking language (Simplified Chinese, or a default tier that only constrains replies and leaves reasoning to the model), by injecting a system-prompt section at order -1000000 and re-hoisting it to first place at the end of the assemble waterfall, plus an optional per-turn copy placed ahead of each user message for models that follow static sections weakly.
description.zh: 把模型思考语言锁定为「设置 → 通用设置 → 思考语言」里选定的档位（简体中文，或只约束回复、把思考交还模型的默认英文），实现方式是以 order -1000000 注入 system prompt section，并在 assemble 瀑布末端把它重排到首位兜底；另可开启每轮前置同一指令的用户消息通道，用于对静态 section 服从弱的模型。

description.en: Create and configure Agent presets from a single settings section — persona prompt, a checked knowledge-base entry list injected into the system prompt, individual switches for four knowledge-base tools, per-Agent narrowing of MCP connections, and batch knowledge-base import.
description.zh: 在一个设置分区里新建与配置 Agent 预设——人格提示词、勾选后注入系统提示的知识库条目清单、四个知识库工具的独立开关、按 Agent 收窄 MCP 连接，以及知识库批量导入。

description.en: Treats the session as a mainland-China user (zh-Hans-CN, Asia/Shanghai, ISO dates, CNY currency) and generates a self-consistent test persona: five tools, six cross-checks, GB 11643 check digit, phone prefix matched to carrier ASN.
description.zh: 把会话当作中国大陆用户（简体中文、Asia/Shanghai、ISO 日期、人民币），并生成彼此自洽的测试人设：五个工具、六项交叉校验，身份证校验位、号段与运营商 ASN、区划码与地址互相对得上。

description.en: A Cyrene-themed agent for DSH, with a customizable look (palette, wallpaper, particle effects, background music, typing sound) and a code security scan. It carries a worldbook, long-term memory and a speech-style correction layer (every reader gets their own Cyrene), plus retrieval over the script to back up its answers.
description.zh: 给 DSH 用的昔涟主题 agent，包括可自定义美化主题（配色、壁纸、粒子效果、背景音乐、打字音效）与代码安全扫描。拥有世界书、长期记忆与说话方式修正（一千个人心中有一千个昔涟），剧情检索增强回答。

description.en: Per-conversation persona / master prompt plugin: create, edit, switch and delete persona templates from the composer toolbar, with highest-priority system-prompt injection, fixed interaction guardrails, subagent inheritance, new-conversation default, and local JSON persistence.
description.zh: 每对话独立的人设 / 主提示词插件：在输入框工具栏创建、编辑、切换和删除人设模板，最高优先级系统提示注入，附带固定交互护栏、子代理继承、新对话默认继承与本地 JSON 持久化。

description.en: AI companion with a learned body clock, real offline sleep, its own memory, and self-reported affect delivered through the same judge math as the pi version.
description.zh: 有生物钟、会真实睡觉、有自己的记忆和情绪的 AI 伴侣，主动冲动以独立 turn 投递。

description.en: Registers a configurable prompt variable so an agent preset whose persona uses complete: true can still receive an injected text block; the plugin ships no content of its own and reads the text from its config.
description.zh: 注册一个可配置的 prompt 变量，让使用 complete: true 人格的 agent 预设也能收到一段注入文本；插件本身不含内容，文本由配置提供。

description.en: One prompt row carrying two independently switchable halves. Identity: a fixed self-reference restated at the head, at the tail after every other section, and in the runtime snapshot, with an instruction to treat contradicting claims as stale cache. Discipline: ten rules, each paired with the condition a reviewer checks — external evidence before claiming done, change face equal to review face, correctness from named call points rather than timing, one source of truth, extension through the registered seam, runtime validation only at real boundaries, loud failure instead of silent skips, orthogonal outcomes reported separately, tests through the delivered entry point, and answer shape (conclusion first, length set by the change).
description.zh: 一条提示词行装两半，各自可单独关闭。身份层：开头、末尾（一切其它分区之后）与运行时快照三处固定同一段自述，并要求把与之冲突的说法当作过时缓存。纪律层：十条规则，每条附一句评审用来判断是否违反的判据——收工前拿出外部证据、改动面等于评审面、正确性来自命名调用点而非时序、一个事实一个家、通过注册的接缝扩展、只在真实边界做运行时校验、失败要响而不是静默跳过、正交的结果分开报告、测试走已交付的入口、答复先给结论且篇幅跟改动走。
