description.zh: DSH 会话原文只读投影同步器（drsc）：只读扫描 ~/.dsh/sessions/** 会话日志，经内置 leaf 解码器解 zstd/分段帧日志后投影进插件自有 SQLite（node:sqlite，segments/replaces + FTS5），由单条 fenced HTTP 路由提供 surface 标记账本、召回/压缩对账与中文可用的内容检索面；token 计数与 CCI verify 用同一套 DeepSeek-V4 分词器与公式，资产缺失时落带标注的 chars/4 口径。绝不写会话文件，所有落盘仅进自有数据目录。服务三个消费插件：context-compression-improved（surface 标记+召回对账）、session-steward（检索语料源切换）、prime-memory（历史投影锚点回填）。支持宿主 0.1.0-rc.2 .. 0.2.1-rc.2（engines.dsh 17 tag 精确枚举）。npm 包名：dsh-reference-session-collector。

description.en: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.
description.zh: 自带独立索引的侧边栏会话搜索（不再复用 DSH 官方全文索引）：一处入口在标题与内容检索间切换，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与 用户/回复/工具 类型标签；水位驱动增量同步、按归档集合清理已归档会话，整理走影子索引不阻塞在用索引。

description.en: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.
description.zh: 高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停（全局）+ 会话级冻结/恢复 + 后端自动重试；错峰自动续跑。

description.en: Session notes 0.3.1: multiple numbered notes per session (1 2 3… by creation order), session-level color and pin (one click in the popover title row), a copy picker (click any note to copy), per-session delete-all, compatible with DSH Desktop 0.8.2.
description.zh: 会话备注 0.3.1：一个会话挂多条备注（1 2 3 按创建顺序编号），会话级颜色+置顶（弹窗标题行一键操作），复制挑选器（多条备注点哪条复制哪条），🗑 会话备注批量清理，兼容 DSH Desktop 0.8.2。

description.en: Peer communication between conversations in one DeepSeek Harness process: list the conversations the workspace shows, link one under a nickname, message it without waiting for its turn to end, read its progress without waking it, and declare rules for your own tool calls.
description.zh: 同一 DeepSeek Harness 进程内对话之间的对等通信：列出工作区里的对话、用昵称连接、发消息而不必等对方当前一轮结束、不唤醒对方地查看进度，并给自己声明工具调用规则。

description.en: Restore archived sessions to their original workspace from the Web GUI sidebar.
description.zh: 从 Web GUI 侧栏查看已归档会话，并一键恢复到原工作区。

description.en: Read, message and live-follow local DeepSeek Harness sessions from inside an agent: four tools (session_list, session_read, session_send, session_chat) plus a matching Python CLI, over the desktop app local RPC; transcripts also read offline. Requires Python 3.10+; offline transcript reads also need the zstd CLI.
description.zh: 在 agent 里枚举、读取、发送并实时跟随本机 DeepSeek Harness 会话：四个工具（session_list、session_read、session_send、session_chat）加同功能 Python CLI，走桌面 App 本地 RPC，离线也能读转录。需要 Python 3.10+；离线读转录还需要 zstd 命令。

description.en: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of resident sessions is configurable and the plugin can be switched off.
description.zh: 让浏览器最近用过的会话保持常驻：切走再切回来直接复用已加载的历史、不再重新读取；常驻数量可配置，并可整体关闭。

description.en: Archived-conversation manager for DeepSeek Harness: view archived conversations grouped by workspace, restore them, and reveal their transcript folders.
description.zh: 归档会话管理器：按工作区分组查看已归档的会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与打开会话转录目录。

description.en: Adds a red "Delete session" row beneath Archive in the sidebar session menu and permanently deletes that one session - its stored logs and its workspace account entry, written through the workspace registry itself. A second click confirms and the row leaves the list immediately; sessions opened this run are disposed from memory first so nothing resurrects them, and a session running work shows one extra warning whose click stops the task before deleting.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话“…”菜单的“归档会话”下方新增红色“删除会话”行，永久删除该会话的日志与工作区账目（走 workspace registry 自己的持久化写）。第二次点击确认后该行立即从列表消失；当次启动使用过的会话会先从内存停用再删（不会复活）；正在跑任务的会话会再显示一次警告，点下去先停止任务再删除。

plugins.name: dsh-autorestart

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: restart without losing work. It waits until every conversation is idle, restarts the host, and picks the interrupted work back up instead of dying with it; where a supervisor already manages the host it asks that supervisor, and it never starts a second host next to a running one. It also fixes a common one: stale login cookies pile up on every launch until the request header overflows and the host will not start; the plugin clears them before each restart. Every restart is preceded by a snapshot of the configuration and the installed plugins - 2 are kept by default, up to 10 are allowed, and old or incomplete ones are pruned. That snapshot is never applied automatically: the plugin does not watch the host and does not restore anything on its own; it is only there for you to look at, or to roll back by hand. When the work is done it counts down and powers the machine off, so nobody has to stay up at night. It works on the Windows desktop client, and on a hosted dsh web instance - verified on WSL with systemd; Windows-hosted web, WSL without systemd, and native Linux are untested.
description.zh: 重启不丢工作：等所有对话空闲后自动重启，重启后接着干、不中断；已有守护的机器交给守护重启，绝不双开。 还顺手治一个常见毛病：反复启动攒下的过期登录 cookie 会把请求头撑爆、让 DSH 起不来，插件在每次重启前先清掉它们。 每次重启前自动备份配置和已装插件，默认留 2 份、最多 10 份，旧的和不完整的自动清理。 这份备份不会被自动使用：插件不监视宿主、不自动还原，它只是给你留一份可以手工翻回去的存档。 所有工作完成后倒数关机，晚上无需人值守。 桌面客户端可用；dsh web 托管端已在 WSL（有 systemd）上验证；Windows 上的 web、无 systemd 的 WSL、原生 Linux 尚未验证。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to schemas.microsoft.com

description.en: Behavior-drift reports for DSH sessions: compares two session logs and reports tool-sequence alignment, tool mix, reasoning volume, timing, retries and file targets, with an optional CI threshold gate. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 会话的行为漂移报告：对比两份 session log，输出工具序列对齐、工具构成、推理量、耗时、重试与文件目标的差异，并支持可选的 CI 阈值门禁。零依赖。

description.en: Adds a confirmed Delete session action to the sidebar menu of archived Sessions; the Host permanently removes their local JSONL logs (including hidden subagent descendants), workspace accounting and archive/pin entries, then refreshes open Web clients.
description.zh: 在 Web 侧栏已归档会话的“...”菜单中新增带二次确认的「删除会话」；Host 永久删除本地 JSONL 日志（含隐藏的子代理后代）、工作区记账与归档/置顶集合，并刷新已打开的页面。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive/restore, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, workspace grouping, undo last message, repair damaged session logs (seq-gap/EIO/dual-format), value analysis and full-text search — plus plan/closing template injection (system prompt + context).
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强：归档/恢复、批量与条件删除、AI 自动重命名、中断自动续跑、按工作区分组、撤回最后一条消息、三类损坏日志修复（seq-gap/EIO/双格式）、价值分析与全文搜索——另含方案/收尾模板注入（系统提示词 + 上下文）。

description.en: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace and drops sessions in so the persistence layer upgrades them on open; settings sidebar with env/import/list/convert tabs plus a CLI (check / fix / import).
description.zh: DSH 会话跨版本迁移：扫描旧版会话目录（v0 明文、.zstd 与 .zip 导出包），改写 header cwd 绑定目标工作区并落盘，打开会话时由持久化层自动完成版本升级；设置侧边栏（环境 / 导入 / 列表 / 转换）加 CLI（check / fix / import）。

description.en: Moves the default workspace off the system drive (DSH opens every new Session in <Documents>/deepseek-harness/default-workspace and never relocates it) while keeping stored sessions usable: rewrites the workspace record without a restart, offers the same three actions as a GUI panel, moves stored session logs together with their header cwd, and re-frames logs whose first frame is not exactly one header line. Requires the desktop host (workspaceRegistry and sessionPersistence).
description.zh: 把默认工作区从系统盘挪走（DSH 把新会话一律开在 <文档>/deepseek-harness/default-workspace 且从不迁移），同时让已存会话继续可用：无需重启即可改写工作区记录，同一套动作也有图形面板可点，连同 header cwd 把已存会话日志一起搬走，并重帧化首帧不是恰好一行 header 的日志。需桌面版宿主（workspaceRegistry 与 sessionPersistence）。

description.en: Automatically archives idle DSH conversations after a configurable number of days and clears the projection cache of archived sessions, without deleting transcripts or attachments.
description.zh: 按可配置天数自动归档闲置的 DSH 会话，并清理已归档会话的投影缓存，不删除会话记录或附件。

description.en: Per-turn checkpoints of the whole workspace: every turn ends with a snapshot, the files it changed are listed under that turn in the chat, and any turn can be restored — files, the conversation, or both. Capture is a whole-tree scan rather than a hook on write/edit tools, so edits made by shell commands, external editors or git leave a record too. Restoring the conversation forks it from that turn instead of cutting the original, and a restore can itself be undone. History sits in a shadow git repository under DSH_HOME and never touches your project .git. Requires Git >= 2.20 and Node.js >= 20.
description.zh: 按轮次给整个工作区留检查点：每轮结束存一份快照，本轮改了哪些文件直接列在聊天里那一条下方，任意一轮都能还原——只还原文件、只还原对话，或者全部还原。捕获靠扫描整棵树，而不是挂钩 write/edit 工具，所以 shell 命令、外部编辑器、git 操作改出来的东西同样留痕。还原对话是从那一轮分叉出新会话，不切断原来的会话；还原本身也能撤销。历史存放在 DSH_HOME 里的影子 git 仓库中，不碰项目的 .git。需 Git >= 2.20 与 Node.js >= 20。

description.en: Fork companion for DSH: on any official fork, copies every direct subagent child of the source session onto the forked conversation (recursively, whole subtrees) through the official agent API, leaving each copy as a cold session the official resume path can wake — so the new conversation keeps its subagent panel and can keep messaging those children, while the originals stay with the old branch.
description.zh: DSH 的 fork 伴随插件:官方 fork 发生后,把原会话的直接子 agent 复制到 fork 出的新对话下(递归复制整棵子树,副本经官方 agent API 创建),每个副本留在磁盘上成为可被官方恢复路径唤醒的冷会话——新对话保留子代理面板,并能继续给这些子代理发消息;原件仍留在旧分支。

description.en: SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.
description.zh: 类世界书的 DSH 提示词规则：分层系统提示锚点、蓝绿灯条目、可复现概率门与正则替换。

description.en: Thin on-demand context retrieval: context_query / context_slice / context_grep tools that read already-persisted history back with replay-safe citations.
description.zh: 按需取回薄层：context_query / context_slice / context_grep 三个工具读取已持久化的历史，引用可回放。

description.en: Mirrors other coding agents' sessions into DeepSeek Harness as continuable tasks, one workspace per application.
description.zh: 把本机其他 AI 编程助手的会话实时镜像成 DeepSeek Harness 的任务，每个应用一个工作区。

description.en: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.
description.zh: llama-cpp qwen3.8-27b 低上下文时，强制上下文压缩插件，提示模型使用效率和使用流畅度，外加完善的压缩提示。

description.en: Per-conversation system prompt, turn-based context folding, sampling overrides and a low-token pure chat mode for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为单个对话设置系统提示词、按轮数折叠上下文、采样参数，并提供低 token 的纯聊天模式。

description.en: Pin and unpin sessions to the top of the Web sidebar with a dedicated pinned panel, archive section, and native three-dot menu integration.
description.zh: 把会话置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：独立置顶面板、归档区、原生三点菜单集成。

description.en: Marks a Session as focus or parked in one click from its sidebar row, its hover card, or the conversation header, and keeps a count visible at the foot of the sidebar and next to workspace folder names when those groups are collapsed. A panel lists every marked Session alongside the states the sidebar already tracks (waiting for a reply, running, finished-unread), and the sidebar foot opens whichever one needs a reply first.
description.zh: 从会话行、悬浮卡或会话头一点即可标记「进行中／挂起」；侧边栏底部和折叠的工作区名旁始终显示还有几条。面板把标记过的会话与侧边栏本就跟踪的状态（等待回复、在跑、已完成未查看）列在一起，底部读数则直接跳到最该处理的那一条。

description.en: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a clearer, first-person version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted code, links and long text untouched, marking missing details as placeholders instead of guessing, and keeping multi-part questions numbered.
description.zh: 你只管正常打字，停下约两秒，它就把你刚写的话改写成更清晰、以第一人称表达的版本，更容易得到好答案；贴进来的代码、网址、长文原样不动，缺的信息用占位符标出而不乱猜，一次问几件事也一件不漏、排好顺序。

description.en: Structured output for DSH: a no-label title card, then tables/lists/steps; per-session toggle and style.md override.
description.zh: 让 DSH 每条实质回复默认结构化：无标签标题卡 + 表格/清单/步骤；按会话开关，style.md 可覆盖。

description.en: Neutralizes lone UTF-16 surrogates in tool output before they reach the session log, preventing permanent 400 INVALID_REQUEST errors.
description.zh: 在工具输出写入会话日志前中和落单的 UTF-16 代理字符，避免会话永久 400 无法继续。

description.en: Purges billion-context snapshots left behind after a session is deleted in DeepSeek Harness, and can also clean up cost-meter ledger rows (off by default).
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中删除会话后，清理 billion-context 快照；cost-meter 账本记录的清理默认关闭，可在设置里打开。

description.en: Right-click a sent message to edit or withdraw it. The running answer is stopped first, then that message and everything after it are replaced in the conversation: withdrawing leaves a short withdrawn marker and stops there, while editing asks the model again with the new text.
description.zh: 右键已发出的消息即可修改或撤回：先停住正在生成的回答，再把这条消息及其之后的内容替换掉——撤回只留下一条「已撤回」标记并就此停下，修改则按新正文重新提问。

description.en: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation that requires verifying real-world state first rather than assuming a side effect succeeded or failed. Permanent failures (AUTH, QUOTA, context overflow) are skipped, with a cross-restart budget, adaptive backoff and a minimal-context payload.
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑被中断的回合：在会话激活后读取崩溃修复写入的 turn/end，投出要求先核对真实状态（不假定外部操作成功或失败）的续跑消息；永久性失败（认证、配额、上下文超限）直接跳过，并有跨重启次数预算、自适应退避与最小上下文注入。

description.en: Conversation rewind for dsh web: /undo rolls back one turn, /rewind cuts to a past message, and hovering a user bubble offers a visual undo.
description.zh: 对话回退：/undo 回退一轮，/rewind 回退到历史消息，悬浮用户气泡可可视化撤回。

description.en: Organizes multiple live DSH sessions into a collaboration group and relays each round's final output on a shared timeline.
description.zh: 把多个已打开的 DSH 会话组织成一个协作群，只转达每轮最终输出，并按共享时间线合并投递。

description.en: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool call / tool result / system), groups results by turn, merges identical snippets, offers prose-vs-everything scope, regex / case / whole-word options, highlights all matches, and copies or exports the result set as Markdown.
description.zh: 会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找（读会话 store 而非 DOM）：命中按来源分类（你/助手/思考/工具调用/工具输出/系统）、按轮次分组、同文合并，可切「只搜正文 / 搜全部内容」，支持正则/大小写/全词，全量高亮，并能把结果复制或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.
description.zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

description.en: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.
description.zh: 回合中断自动续跑：turn/end 因 error / interrupted / max-tokens 结束时自动发送「继续」，支持宽限期、冷却、指数退避、连续次数上限、启动扫描、设置卡片，以及输入框工具行的会话级停止/恢复按钮；不切换模型/provider。

description.en: Lists every session stored in the local DSH profile with its title, workspace, last-modified time and size, then moves the selected ones to a 90-day trash you can restore or purge; deletion detaches the live session first, so the sidebar updates without restarting the app.
description.zh: 列出本地 DSH 配置中保存的全部会话（标题、工作区、最近修改时间、大小），把选中项移入保留 90 天的回收站，可随时还原或彻底删除；删除前会先摘掉宿主内存中的会话，侧栏无需重启应用即可刷新。

description.en: Adds a Delete Session row to every sidebar session '...' menu (the official harness has archive/pin/rename/fork only, no durable delete). One-click Force delete ejects the session from the host live catalog, stops its background work, then removes the durable log, projection cache and registry bookkeeping - no ghost rows on any connected desktop web UI. Workspace files the session created are kept; conversation logs are permanently deleted. Third-party cloud mirrors (e.g. phone apps via Agents Anywhere) hold their own copies. Bilingual zh/en UI, trust-fenced local route. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1.
description.zh: 给侧边栏每个会话的"…"菜单加上"删除会话"（官方只有归档/置顶/重命名/分叉，无持久 删除）。一键「强制删除」：逐出宿主内存态会话、停止后台工作后，彻底清除会话日志、 投影缓存与注册表记账，已连接的桌面 Web 端即时清行、不留幽灵。会话生成的工作区文件 保留，对话记录永久删除；第三方云端镜像（如经 Agents Anywhere 同步的手机 App）持有 各自副本、需在其 App 内管理。中英双语界面，本地回环路由带信任栅栏。需 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.1。

description.en: Prepares context summaries in the background and applies them at safe step boundaries, with native compaction fallback and a per-conversation history of summaries, application status, timings, and token usage.
description.zh: 在后台准备上下文摘要并于安全步骤应用，保留原生压缩回退，并提供摘要内容、应用状态、耗时与用量的会话压缩历史。

description.en: Adds four tools to a Session. create_session opens a new Session in a named workspace or in any existing folder and delivers one prompt into it; session_message adds one more message to a Session that is still running — the host is asked to splice it into that turn at once, instead of queueing it until the turn ends; a Session that has gone idle is refused, pointing back to create_session; read_session_transcript reads back what a Session said and whether its current turn has finished; list_dispatched_sessions lists what this plugin dispatched and each one's state right now. Host-half plugin, no UI — it calls the host's own session primitives rather than reimplementing them. Restart DSH after installing.
description.zh: 给会话加四个工具：create_session 在指定工作区或任意一个已存在的文件夹里开一个新会话，并把一段提示词投进去；session_message 给一个还在跑的会话再追加一条消息——请宿主立刻把它插进正在跑的那一轮，不再排队到本轮结束；已经闲下来的会话会被拒投，并指向 create_session；read_session_transcript 按会话 id 读回它说过什么、当前这一轮结束没有；list_dispatched_sessions 列出本插件派送过哪些会话、各自此刻什么状态。宿主半边插件，没有界面，调用的是宿主自己的建会话能力。装完需重启 DSH。

description.en: Cross-session agent messaging for DeepSeek Harness with session discovery, offline delivery, delivery receipts, and sender-session navigation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 跨会话 Agent 通信：支持会话发现、离线投递、投递回执与发送方会话导航。

description.en: Multi-session overview: list every session grouped by workspace with live status, pin up to three side by side to read their conversation text, and send a message or interrupt any of them without switching away.
description.zh: 多会话一体：在一个会话内按工作区总览全部会话的实时状态，钉住最多三个并排看对话正文，可直接发消息或打断，不用来回切换。

description.en: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话管理：固定对话、搜索内容、读取归档记录并隐藏噪音。

description.en: Adds a "Delete session" option to the sidebar session menu that permanently removes the session from disk.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单中添加“删除会话”选项，从磁盘上永久删除该会话。

description.en: See how you have been using AI: `/session-insights` reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.
description.zh: 回头看看你是怎么使用 AI 的：`/session-insights` 会整理一段时间内的 DSH 会话，找出哪些做法有效、哪些问题总在重复、最终真正留下了哪些成果，并生成一份保存在本机的复盘报告。

description.en: Ask side questions using the current conversation context, with independent streaming and cancellation.
description.zh: 使用当前会话上下文进行侧边提问，支持独立流式回复与取消。

description.en: Rewind conversation turns and checkpointed file changes while restoring tasks and evidence at the same history boundary.
description.zh: 回退会话回合和文件检查点，并在同一历史截点恢复任务与证据。

description.en: Adds a Timestamp toggle to the composer; while it is on, each message you submit is followed by a hidden context message carrying the current local time, so the model knows when you sent it. The switch is remembered per conversation.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏加一个「时间戳」开关：开启后，你提交的每条消息后面会跟一条隐藏的上下文消息，携带发送时刻的本地时间，模型因此知道你是什么时候发的；开关按会话分别记住。

description.en: Lists DSH session records and archive caches on a sidebar page, moves deletions into a restorable recycle bin, and refuses sessions written within the last 10 minutes.
description.zh: 在侧边栏页面里列出 DSH 的会话记录与归档缓存，删除先移入可恢复的回收站，最近 10 分钟仍在写入的会话会被拒绝。

description.en: Bidirectionally synchronize sessions, workspaces, settings and plugins between the DSH web instance and the DSH Desktop instance.
description.zh: 双向同步网页版与 DSH Desktop 桌面版之间的会话、工作区、设置与插件。

description.en: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.
description.zh: 整合工具包：会话身份、全局/工作区提示词（含引用文件）、会话自动上线、免 UAC 网页重启、会话间消息。

description.en: Prompt booster for the composer. Left-click the composer button and the draft is lightly polished and replaced in place (undoable, no popup). Right-click opens a menu with 8 built-in modes plus your own, where each mode's template can be edited or new modes added (saved on the host), and the model used for the rewrite is picked from the live dsh model list. Other modes show a before/after preview. Based on rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance (Apache-2.0); do not install both — both add a composer button and share Ctrl+Alt+E, so disable one of them if the upstream is present.
description.zh: 输入框提示词提升。左键点击输入框按钮，草稿被轻度润色后直接替换（可撤销、不弹窗）；右键打开模式菜单：8 个内置模式加自定义模式，每个模式的模板可编辑、可新增（保存在宿主端），并可从 dsh 当前可用的模型列表中选择改写所用的模型；其他模式先显示前后对比预览。基于 rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance（Apache-2.0）修改；不要与上游同装——两者都会添加输入框按钮并共用 Ctrl+Alt+E，装了两个请停用其中一个。

description.en: Manage conversation records from the DSH web GUI settings page: delete a whole session (archive plus physical log removal) or a single message (deleting a user message cascades to its assistant replies and tool results). Running and current sessions are protected.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 设置页管理对话记录：可删除整个会话（归档并物理删除日志），或按用户消息分组浏览并删除单条消息（删除用户消息会级联删除其引发的助手与工具消息）。运行中与当前会话受保护。

description.en: Continues work across coding agents inside DeepSeek Harness: six sessionflow_* tools query a local session index built by sessionFlow to find past work, show where the current project left off, and hand the goal, files and open items to the next agent. Requires the separate sessionFlow core, installed from its GitHub repo. Everything stays local — no cloud, no telemetry.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里跨编码 Agent 继续工作：六个 sessionflow_* 工具查询 sessionFlow 构建的本地会话索引，找回过去的工作、看清当前项目做到哪了，并把目标、涉及文件与未完成事项交给下一个 Agent。需要另行安装独立的 sessionFlow 核心（见其 GitHub 仓库）。全程本地运行——无云端、无遥测。

description.en: Adds confirmed DSH restart actions and durable automatic continuation for eligible top-level sessions through an existing compatible dsh-restart Host provider.
description.zh: 通过现有兼容的 dsh-restart Host 提供方，为符合条件的顶层会话增加确认式 DSH 重启与持久自动续作。

plugins.name: dsh-session-resilience

description.en: Adds DSH restart and stop controls with token-aware reconnect and policy-based recovery for interrupted web sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加重启和停止控制、基于令牌的重连，以及用于恢复中断 Web 会话的策略。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Guards session logs from malformed model tool calls (empty id/name, non-string arguments) so a bad call can never make a session unloadable.
description.zh: 让会话日志永远不会因为一次畸形 tool call 而打不开：坏调用自动修复，正常调用原样通过，历史永远可加载。

description.en: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.
description.zh: 会话桥：让当前 agent 直接用提示词驱动其它真实的 DSH 会话——跨工作区创建主会话、向任意会话发消息或注入 steering、等待并逐段读取回复（含思维链）、恢复离线会话、按名称或 id 跨工作区查找会话；还能用后台看门狗监控并调度主任务（卡住催办、偏离纠偏、卡死终止），一键归档会话。

description.en: Select part of a conversation and ask about it in a right-side side chat; bring AI replies back to the main chat directly or as a summary.
description.zh: 选中对话片段，在右侧面板的侧边聊天中提问（按会话隔离）；AI 回复可原文或摘要后带回主会话。

description.en: Recall previously sent messages in the input box with Up/Down, and archive a workspace session from its right-click menu.
description.zh: 在输入框内按 ↑/↓ 回填历史消息，并支持右键归档（隐藏）工作区会话。

description.en: Ownership-checked tools and HTTP routes to list, release and permanently delete subagent sessions, with automatic web UI refresh after deletion.
description.zh: 带归属校验的工具与 HTTP 路由，用于列出、释放和永久删除子代理会话，删除后自动刷新 web UI。

description.en: Share your conversations with one click.
description.zh: 一键分享你的对话。

description.en: Cross-session and in-chat keyword search with context highlighting, keyboard navigation, and instant message jumping.
description.zh: DSH 对话搜索插件：支持全局跨会话与当前对话内精准搜索，高亮定位并快速跳转。

description.en: Delete a DSH conversation from its sidebar menu or the conversation header, optionally cascading into that conversation's associated memory nodes when you tick the box (the confirmation dialog shows the hit count before you commit); deletes land in a plugin recycle bin with restore, every action is appended to an audit log, and batch deletes are rate-limited with per-conversation rollback.
description.zh: 在会话列表菜单或会话页头部删除对话，可勾选一并删除该对话关联的记忆节点（确认框先显示命中条数）；删除进入插件回收站可恢复，每次操作写入审计日志，批量删除有限流与逐会话回滚。

description.en: Creates an isolated folder for each new default-workspace session and renames it to match the session title.
description.zh: 为默认工作区中的每个新会话创建独立文件夹，并根据会话标题重命名。

description.en: Groups the sessions that hand off to each other into one chain in the DSH sidebar — automatic chain detection from the handoff prompt, per-chain numbering, in-place rename, search, drag and multi-select to re-chain, pinning a chain to the top, archiving chains out of the sidebar into a panel-only archive, a per-session context/steps readout, and configurable handoff thresholds that can trigger an automatic handoff (write the next prompt, open a new session, paste it, switch over).
description.zh: 把互相交接的對話自動聚成一條鏈：從交接提示詞自動判定、場次編號、就地改名、搜尋、拖拉／多選歸鏈、把鏈置頂、把鏈封存進面板裡的封存庫（側欄不再顯示，有新場次也留在封存庫）、本場上下文與請求數讀數，以及可調的交接門檻（達到可自動交接：寫提示詞→開新對話→貼上→切換）。

description.en: Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with all three thresholds adjustable in Settings.
description.zh: 统计每段对话成功完成的压缩次数并常驻悬浮窗，只有反复压缩过、且此后又烧掉大量 token 或上下文占用过高时才提醒；三个阈值都可在设置页调整。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness session and workspace manager —— Workspaces: archive and visibility. Sessions: move, migrate presets, delete, favorite, review later, prioritize, tag, and annotate. Batch operations.
description.zh: DSH 会话与工作区管理——工作区：归档与显示。会话：跨工作区移动、预设迁移、删除；收藏、待回看、优先级、标签、备注。批量操作。

description.en: Adds an Insight tab next to the conversation and trajectory tabs in DSH: calls a model to interpret tool calls turn by turn, and supports a custom prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话轨迹栏边新增「解读」标签：调用模型分轮次解读工具调用情况；允许自定义提示词。

description.en: Injects an x-session-id HTTP header carrying the harness session id onto every LLM provider request, plus whitelisted gateway fetches during tool execution.
description.zh: 在每个 LLM 提供商请求上注入携带 harness 会话 ID 的 x-session-id 请求头，也覆盖工具执行期间白名单内的网关请求。

description.en: Adds a power button to the session header with two actions, each requiring a second click to confirm. Restart terminates the Electron main process itself (taskkill /F without /T), so no crash dialog appears: the host then exits gracefully on its own once the IPC channel drops, and a detached helper relaunches the same executable after the single-instance lock is released, confirming the new instance by a real window handle. Shut down does the same without relaunching. Leftover GPU and renderer processes from the previous run are reaped best-effort. Windows desktop app.
description.zh: 会话头部的电源按钮，两个动作，都需再点一次确认。重启结束的是 Electron 主进程本身（taskkill /F 不带 /T），因此不会出现崩溃弹窗；宿主在 IPC 断开后自行优雅退出，分离的 helper 等单实例锁释放后重放同一可执行文件，并以真实窗口句柄确认新实例已启动。关闭同理但不重新拉起。上一轮残留的 GPU 与渲染器进程会被尽力清理。仅 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: Export the current session to clean Markdown from a button in the session header, through the native save dialog, with a CLI and an HTTP route over the same renderer; reads session logs directly (formats v0, v3 and v4) and declares no @deepseek-ai peer dependencies.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏加入「导出 MD」按钮，经系统原生保存窗口把当前会话导出为干净的 Markdown，并提供共用同一渲染核心的命令行与 HTTP 路由；直接读取会话日志（支持 v0、v3、v4 格式），且不声明任何 @deepseek-ai peer 依赖。

description.en: Adds a collapsible Recent list to the bottom of the DSH Web sidebar: sessions from every workspace sorted by last activity, filtering empty, archived and subagent sessions, with the host status dots and ten more rows per click.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧栏底部加一块可折叠的「最近」列表：跨工作区按最后活动时间排序，过滤空白、已归档与 subagent 会话，复用宿主状态点，首屏 10 条、每次点击再多 10 条。

description.en: One-click Concise output style for DeepSeek Harness: results first, no filler, same work depth. Every final reply opens with a plain-language digest card (select text to copy), scoped per session, working in headless/CLI too, with /concise command, style.md overrides and a local API. Links and file paths inside the digest card render as clickable chips: URLs jump, local files open with the OS default app (v0.9+). A per-step pre-generation contract reminder (v0.11.2+) measurably fixes digest misses on audit-report/table-shaped replies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键 Concise 输出风格开关：结果先行、少废话，工作深浅不变。每轮最终回答开头自动附「摘要」精华卡（划选即复制），按会话独立生效，headless/CLI 同样生效，支持 /concise 命令、style.md 自定义风格与本地 API。摘要卡内的链接与文件路径渲染为可点击 chip：网页跳转、本地文件用系统默认应用打开（v0.9+）。每步生成前自动重申摘要契约（v0.11.2+），实测根治审查报告/表格型回复的漏卡。

description.en: Native-feeling session manager: bulk archive/restore/hard-delete, two-stage force-stop with auto-resume, and instant copy-workspace-path.
description.zh: 侧栏原生增强的会话管理：批量归档/恢复/永久删除，卡死会话两段式强停（自动复活/离线），工作区行一键复制绝对路径。

description.en: Codex-style context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: a lossless rollover engine with zero summarization model calls, task-oriented handoff anchors, working notes that survive compaction, verbatim recall of archived windows, and a stale-notes gate that downgrades to an explicit warning instead of vouching for outdated notes. One-click composer button plus /smart-compact command, three-band automatic rollover, mandatory anchor sanitization; works out of the box with zero configuration.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 式上下文窗口自动管理：零模型调用的无损换窗引擎，交接锚点任务定向、工作笔记跨压缩存活、归档内容逐字回查，笔记滞后自动 STALE 警示；一键换窗按钮与 /smart-compact 人工命令，三带自动换窗阈值可配，锚点强制脱敏，开箱即用零配置。

description.en: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.
description.zh: 会话清道夫：在 DSH 设置中扫描、查看并安全清理本机 AI 终端会话历史（Claude Code、Codex CLI、WorkBuddy、DSH），隔离优先、带 SHA-256 清单与一键整批恢复，彻底删除需输入确认短语。

description.en: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.
description.zh: 为 Web 侧边栏添加按 Workspace 隔离的分类树，支持嵌套分类、拖拽归类会话、在分类中新建会话，以及删除分类时归档其中的会话。

description.en: Session manager panel under Settings → Plugins: list all sessions with title, cwd, agent preset, updated time, turns and steps, expand a row to view message history, delete non-running sessions, and export a session as JSON or Markdown via a browser Blob URL.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件 下的会话管理面板：列出全部会话的标题、工作目录、agent 预设、更新时间、轮次与步数，展开可查看消息历史，删除非运行中的会话，并经浏览器 Blob URL 导出为 JSON 或 Markdown。

description.en: Read-only export of a chat.deepseek.com conversation into a new DSH session: builds a hand-off pack with the selected rounds kept verbatim and earlier rounds collapsed to one line each, then pre-fills the composer without sending it. Windows only as published (package.json os=win32); requires Edge or Chrome and a one-time chat.deepseek.com login.
description.zh: 只读取回 chat.deepseek.com 的对话并交给新会话：生成交接包（所选轮次逐字保留、更早轮次每轮压缩为一行），预填进输入框但不自动发送。发布包仅支持 Windows（package.json os=win32）；需要本机 Edge 或 Chrome，并先在插件里登录一次 chat.deepseek.com。

description.en: Lists recent sessions across every workspace in one panel, with time grouping, two sort orders, content search, reveal-in-file-manager, and local notes that offer to insert themselves into the draft.
description.zh: 一块面板列出所有工作目录里的最近会话：时间分组、两种排序、内容检索、在文件管理器中显示目录，以及只存在本机、回到那个会话时提示填入草稿的想法。

description.en: Rotate the outbound LLM session ID after each successful DSH compaction without creating a new DSH session.
description.zh: 在每次 DSH 成功 Compact 后轮换对外 LLM 会话 ID，而不创建新的 DSH 会话。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode compaction restore.
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.
description.zh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

description.en: Live context-pressure meter in the composer dock. When usage nears the limit it asks the current model for a handoff brief, starts that brief in a fresh session and switches you there, so long work can continue without hitting the window.
description.zh: 输入框下方实时显示上下文占用；接近上限时让当前模型写一份交接摘要，开新会话继续干活并自动切过去，长任务不用怕撞上窗口上限。

description.en: Move a session to another folder, permanently delete it, or AI-rename it from the Web UI — by dragging a session row onto a folder title or from the session menu. Moving rewrites the session header cwd, relocates the persisted log and updates workspace accounting so history travels with it; deleting stops running agents and removes the log, projection-cache row and workspace accounting. The same three operations ship as agent tools: workbench_session_move, workbench_session_delete and workbench_session_rename_ai.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中把会话移动到其他文件夹、永久删除，或进行 AI 重命名——支持把会话行拖到文件夹标题上，也可从会话菜单操作。移动会重写会话头的 cwd、迁移持久化日志并更新工作区账目，历史随会话一起走；删除会先停止运行中的 agent，再移除日志、投影缓存行与工作区账目。同样提供三个 agent tools：workbench_session_move、workbench_session_delete、workbench_session_rename_ai。

description.en: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。

description.en: Mounts a per-channel speaking-rules file into the QQ preset's system prompt only, so that channel answers in one or two lines while every other channel stays untouched. Does nothing until home points at a folder with the rules file (default QQ线口径.md); meant for the QQ preset, not the global plugin list.
description.zh: 给 QQ 那一条线单独装一张嘴：把口径文件挂成那段会话的系统提示段，只挂 QQ，别的线一个字不动；改 md 就生效，不必重装插件。须把 home 指向放有口径文件（默认 QQ线口径.md）的目录才生效；应挂进 QQ 的 preset，而非全局插件列表。

description.en: Context Assembler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: topic-block context assembly, water-pressure topic splitting, tool trace/rewrite, reality recall injection and handoff planning.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上下文汇编插件：话题块上下文汇编、水位压力话题切割、工具轮压缩/改写、reality 召回注入与 handoff 规划。

description.en: Delete a conversation record from the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with a trash bin to restore or purge it. Both this and zhezhi33/dsh-session-recycler install under the package name dsh-session-recycler, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面里真正删除会话记录：带可恢复、可彻底清除的回收站。本插件与 zhezhi33/dsh-session-recycler 安装后的包名同为 dsh-session-recycler，请只装其中一个。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter for Context Mode: in-process ctx_* tools for sandboxed code execution and an FTS5 knowledge base, plus context-window routing guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 适配 Context Mode：进程内 ctx_* 工具（沙箱代码执行与 FTS5 知识库），并注入上下文窗口路由指引。

description.en: Context curation for DeepSeek Harness: content-aware tool-output slimming, dead-log sweep, pinned user requirements and in-flight work, archive-then-compact with an audit trail.
description.zh: 自动上下文策展：tool 输出内容感知瘦身、无效日志清理、用户要求与进行中工作钉扎保护、先归档后压缩，全程审计留痕。

description.en: Give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header; marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one device is visible on every other one.
description.zh: 给任意会话加上颜色标记：在侧栏显示色条、从会话头部选择颜色；标记保存在宿主上，一台设备选的颜色在其他设备上同样可见。

description.en: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.
description.zh: 无限会话画布，区域绑定工作区与智能体预设，可钉住会话卡片、放置便签，带对齐参考线。

description.en: Session takeover: read-only pull local sessions from nine external agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, Pi, WorkBuddy, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI) into distilled six-section handoff cards — one click on the Relay chip takes over. /handoff checks the current session into the handoff: 1 open-protocol inbox (~/.handoff, consume-once with machine-signature tamper detection); any agent picks up on start and continues. Memory files ride with cards; cross-machine relay is one env var away.
description.zh: 会话接管：只读拉取九家外部 agent（Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / ZCode / Pi / WorkBuddy / Cursor / Grok / Gemini CLI）的本地会话，蒸馏成六段交接卡，输入框「接力」按钮一键接管；/handoff 把当前会话寄存进 handoff: 1 开放协议收件箱（~/.handoff，消费即弃 + 机器签名防篡改），任何 agent 开局取件接着干，记忆文件随卡交接，同步盘一句环境变量跨机器接力。

description.en: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.
description.zh: 把会话工作目录下 .keep-reminder 文件的内容作为 system-reminder 注入，支持三种模式：每会话一次、每轮第一步、每次请求。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages archived sessions and the trash from the settings panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 存档会话管理插件：在设置面板管理归档会话（恢复/删除）与回收站。

description.en: Opens any session as a second full chat tab in the right sidebar, with its own transcript and composer, while the main conversation stays put; a split right pane allows up to three concurrent conversations.
description.zh: 把任意会话作为第二个完整对话开在右侧栏（独立记录与输入框），主区对话保持不动；右栏分栏后最多可同时对话 3 个会话。

description.en: A lightweight plugin that decompresses and reads past sessions, so a new session can read what an earlier conversation contained, in milliseconds per read. `/recall` lists the sessions of the current project with title, last activity, turn count and first prompt; `/recall <number>` reads back the turns of that session; `/recall all` covers every project; the model can also be asked in natural language to query with the `recall_sessions` tool.
description.zh: 轻量级解压并读取历史会话，让新会话读取之前会话的内容，单次操作毫秒级。`/recall` 列出当前项目的历史会话（标题、最后活动时间、轮次、首问）；`/recall <序号>` 读回该会话的轮次内容；`/recall all` 覆盖所有项目；也可用自然语言让模型调用 `recall_sessions` 工具查询。

description.en: Adds Regenerate and Edit and resend to each message you already sent: Regenerate re-answers the same text in one click without going through the composer; Edit and resend retracts that message and everything after it in place — out of the transcript and out of the model context, in the same session with no new branch — then puts its text and images back into the composer, so the edited send rewrites the conversation from that point. Messages carrying files rather than images stay disabled.
description.zh: 给你发出的每条消息加上「重新生成」和「编辑重发」：重新生成一键用同样的文字重新回答，不经过输入框；编辑重发就地撤回这条消息及其之后的内容——从时间线和模型上下文里一起消失，不新建会话也不开新分支——再把文字和图片放回输入框，改完发送就从那一条重写对话。带文件（非图片）的消息两个操作置灰。

description.en: Discover and verify portable RoleHub roles, pin each exact bundle, then launch its prompt and bundled skills in an isolated, continuable DSH Session with Host-approved tool bindings and optional Agent Team Room attachment.
description.zh: 发现并校验可移植的 RoleHub 角色，固定其精确 bundle，再将提示词和随角色打包的 Skills 加载到独立、可续聊的 DSH Session，以 Host 批准的工具绑定限制能力，并可选接入 Agent Team Room。

description.en: Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit wakeup available.
description.zh: 无需等待或打断正在工作的 Agent：即时冻结有界 Session 快照，由隔离且无工具的 LLM 异步总结，再将带来源信息的上下文胶囊投递到另一 Session 或已授权 Room；对 Session 默认 quiet，也可显式 wakeup。

description.en: Edit and regenerate: adds an edit action to user message bubbles, regenerating from that message with images and files carried over and the original model inherited.
description.zh: 编辑重发：在用户消息气泡上多一个「编辑」，改完从那条消息重新生成，图片与文件随行重传，模型继承原会话。

description.en: Reopens the conversation you were last in after restarting DeepSeek Harness, by keeping a pointer file under the DSH home directory instead of patching engine files.
description.zh: 重启 DeepSeek Harness 后自动回到最近一次对话；实现方式是在 DSH 数据目录里保存一个指针文件，不修改引擎文件。

description.en: Manage and delete archived DSH conversations: a Settings page lists every archived session with per-row and bulk delete, and the sidebar session menu gains a Delete row next to Unarchive. Deletion is real — the session log, its projection cache and both indexes are cleaned up, not just an unarchive.
description.zh: 管理并删除已归档的 DSH 对话：设置里新增「归档会话」页，列出所有归档会话，支持单条与批量删除；侧边栏会话「…」菜单在「取消归档」旁新增红色的「删除归档会话」。删除是真正的删除（会话日志、投影缓存与两套索引一起清理），不只是取消归档。

description.en: Adds Delete to the DSH sidebar session menu, moving the session — and its whole descendant tree when it has subagents — into a recycle bin that relocates the directory on disk (an atomic rename, never a copy), plus a sidebar bin panel with title and full-text search, workspace filter, sorting, per-session chat-log viewer, restore and permanent delete. Deleting also clears the workspace slot, the pin, the archive flag and the projection-cache row, so a restore puts the session back at its original sidebar position; permanent deletion also clears the schedules bound to it and removes the emptied project directory. Verified on DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2, with a whole-profile residue scan coming back clean.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中加入「删除」，把会话——带子代理时连同整棵后代树——搬进回收站（目录在磁盘上整体 rename 迁走，原子操作，不做复制），并提供侧栏回收站面板：标题与正文搜索、工作区筛选、排序、查看对话记录、恢复与彻底删除。删除时同时摘掉工作区槽位、置顶与归档标记以及投影缓存行，恢复时把会话放回侧栏原位置；彻底删除时清掉绑定该会话的定时任务并删除空掉的工程目录。已在 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 上真机验证，删除后全盘无残留。

description.en: Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships reversible tool-result compression with byte-exact hash retrieval.
description.zh: 由模型主导的 DeepSeek Harness 上下文压缩：由 agent 决定何时压缩、压缩什么，以持久化会话日志替换提交，并提供可逆的工具结果压缩与逐字节哈希取回。

description.en: Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under Ungrouped.
description.zh: 在 DSH 工作区选择器中添加无工作区会话入口，创建按日期整理的独立目录，并让已开始的会话在未分组区域保持可恢复。

description.en: Git-style conversation branching that mirrors how real programmers collaborate: a secretary root branch dispatches tasks to child branches with their own contexts, merging back only compressed summaries via squash or rebase; ships /branch commands, a branch tab, branch-to-branch messaging, and a governance baseline pairing each session branch with a git worktree.
description.zh: Git 式会话分支，模拟真实程序员协作的并行开发：根分支充当秘书维持调度，子分支持有各自上下文并行工作，任务完成后仅以压缩摘要 squash/rebase 合并回来；提供 /branch 命令、分支页签、send_message_by_branch 跨分支消息，并附一份把会话分支绑定到 git worktree 的治理基线。

description.en: Adds an Auto-rename row to each Session sidebar menu: the model reads the Session log, weights recent user messages higher (exponential decay, 3-day time constant), and writes a title of at most 10 CJK characters into the Session title. Also opens that Session menu on right-click, and exposes the same operation as the session_auto_rename agent tool. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or newer.
description.zh: 在每个会话的侧栏菜单里新增「自动重命名」：模型读取会话日志，按时间衰减给用户消息加权（τ = 3 天，越新权重越高），写出不超过 10 个汉字的标题并写入会话名。同时支持右键会话呼出该菜单，并把同一操作暴露为 session_auto_rename 智能体工具。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本。

description.en: Codex-style /btw command: answer side questions in a conversation-seeded subagent (fork provider), rendered in the UI without entering the main session history.
description.zh: Codex 风格 /btw 指令：在继承主会话上下文的子代理中回答附带问题，答案展示在界面里、不写入主会话历史。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的归档会话管理器：重新打开已归档会话并继续对话、取消归档恢复原位、彻底删除会话，支持分组浏览、消息搜索与原生视图同步。

description.en: Eager, tail-heavy, line-aware tool result trimmer plugin: hooks into post-execution pipeline to trim oversized command outputs with smart semantic reducers and ANSI stripping.
description.zh: 即时、尾部加权、行吸附的工具输出修剪插件：挂载于执行流水线即时截断超大命令输出，内置语义提纯器与 ANSI 剥离。

description.en: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar context menu behind a confirmation modal reporting log size and live activity, cleanly unlinking log files, projection checkpoints, and host memory registrations.
description.zh: 在侧栏上下文菜单中添加删除会话操作，删除前通过模态框实时展示日志大小与活跃状态，并完整清理日志文件、投影缓存与内存注册表杜绝复活。

description.en: Automatic recovery when a turn ends badly: resume after a transient failure, continue after output truncation, re-run after an unfinished todo list, plus a request-level 429 backstop and a client dock with edit-resend, manual retry and stop-and-re-ask.
description.zh: 回合异常收尾时的自动补救：瞬时失败后续跑、输出截断后继续、待办未完成时重跑，另有一层请求级 429 兜底，以及带「改后重发 / 手动重试 / 停止并重问」的客户端停靠栏。

description.en: Agent Context Editor is a cross-agent plugin for manually excluding, editing, and selectively compressing AI conversation context. It also supports searching, filtering, selecting, hiding, restoring, and undoing conversation changes while preserving the original Session.
description.zh: Agent Context Editor 是一个可以手动排除、编辑和选择性压缩 AI 对话上下文的跨 Agent 插件，同时支持搜索、筛选、选择、隐藏、恢复和撤销对话内容，并保留原始 Session。

description.en: Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.
description.zh: 跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。

description.en: Adds /btw and /side slash commands that answer ephemeral side questions in an isolated forked sub-session without polluting the main conversation context.
description.zh: 新增 /btw 与 /side 斜杠命令，在隔离的分叉子会话中回答临时旁问，不污染主会话上下文。

description.en: Bitmap-frame context compression plugin for DeepSeek Harness: renders discarded conversation history into pixel-font PNG frames for vision-capable models.
description.zh: DSH 的位图帧上下文压缩插件：把被丢弃的对话历史渲染成像素字体 PNG 帧，交给支持视觉的模型直接读回；整个过程本地、确定，不调用任何辅助模型。

description.en: Injects the exact current local time and the timestamp, day relation and recency gap of the previous user message into every prompt, and adds a /time command that prints the injected block.
description.zh: 为每次请求注入精确的本地当前时间，以及上一条用户消息的时间、日期关系与间隔；并提供 /time 命令查看注入内容。

description.en: Strips DSML markers that leak into the assistant text stream and resumes a turn only when it genuinely produced nothing — an invoke-block leak with no tool call emitted, or a closing-tag leak whose prose is near-empty; upstream jitter codes retry, while quota, rate-limit, auth and context-window errors never do. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3.0, and Node 20 or newer.
description.zh: 抹掉漏进助手正文的 DSML 标记；只在确实毫无产出的轮次补一条继续——整段调用写进正文且没有发出任何工具调用，或只剩闭合标签且正文近乎为空。上游抖动类错误会续跑，额度、限流、鉴权与上下文超限一律不续。适用 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 起、0.3.0 以下，Node 20 起。

description.en: Session and message surgery in one plugin: recall or edit prompts and replies (reasoning included), regenerate from the original prompt, delete any turn at the model-context level, and archive, delete, move or migrate sessions across workspaces. Targets DSH 0.1.5 and 0.2.x, verified on 0.2.1-rc.3. A combined fork of three MIT plugins (dsh-message-recall from Jipcon/DSH-plugins, dsh-session-manager from hkkz9522, dsh-delete-turn from DDDMUC) with added reply editing, regeneration and workspace migration. Do not enable it together with those plugins or other session movers or message deleters.
description.zh: 一个插件做会话与消息手术：撤回或编辑指令/回复（连思考过程一起改）、用原提问重新生成、按模型上下文级删除任意一条，以及会话归档、删除、跨工作区移动与工作区迁移。面向 DSH 0.1.5 / 0.2.x，已在 0.2.1-rc.3 实测。由三个 MIT 插件分叉合并而成（Jipcon/DSH-plugins 的 dsh-message-recall、hkkz9522 的 dsh-session-manager、DDDMUC 的 dsh-delete-turn），新增编辑回复、重新生成与工作区迁移。不要与这些插件或其它会话移动、消息删除类插件同时启用。

description.en: Turns a DSH session into a self-contained interactive HTML mind map of its topics, conclusions, decisions, todos and open questions, and reports what changed since the previous run.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话整理成一张自包含的交互式 HTML 脑图（主题、结论、决策、待办、未决问题），并给出与上一次生成相比的变更。

description.en: Deletes a whole conversation from the sidebar session menu, and opens a right-click menu on a chat text selection with Copy, Quote (insert a Markdown quote block into the composer) and Ask: Ask sends the selection plus your question to one reused continuable subagent (label `ask`, found again through the subagent catalog after a restart) and streams the answer into the right sidebar.
description.zh: 从侧栏会话菜单删除整个会话；聊天里划词右键弹出「复制 / 引用 / 提问」：引用把 Markdown 引用块插入输入框，提问把选区与问题交给同一个复用的可继续子智能体（label `ask`，宿主重启后经子智能体目录找回），回答在右侧栏流式显示。

description.en: Adds three actions to the sidebar session row menu: open the workspace location, move the session to another workspace, and delete the session to the Recycle Bin.
description.zh: 给侧栏会话行菜单补上三项操作：打开工作区位置、移动到其它工作区、删除会话（进回收站，可撤销）。

description.en: Precomputes the compaction summary in the background and commits the held result when pressure compaction fires, removing the foreground model round-trip. Registers itself as the session compaction engine, pins the span it summarised so the payload fingerprint still matches at commit time, prunes tool results before committing, and falls back to the stock foreground path on payload drift or context overflow.
description.zh: 作为会话压缩引擎注册，后台预计算压缩摘要，压力压缩触发时直接提交已持有的结果，省去前台模型往返。锁定已摘要的区间以保证提交时载荷指纹仍然匹配，提交前先裁剪工具结果；载荷漂移或上下文溢出时回退到原生前台路径。

description.en: Copy a user message together with its images and files, then paste it into any session: the text lands in the composer and each attachment is rebuilt through the official createDrafts/addAttachments path, so it uploads and sends like a normal draft.
description.zh: 复制用户消息时连同图片与文件一起捕获，粘贴到任意会话：文字进入输入框，每个附件经官方 createDrafts/addAttachments 通道重建为真实草稿，可正常上传并发送。

description.en: Lets the model trigger compaction itself at a safe point via a compact_now tool (works mid-turn), plus a context_status tool reporting real token usage against the session's actual context window.
description.zh: 让模型自己挑安全时机触发压缩：提供 compact_now 工具（回合进行中也能用），另有 context_status 工具，按会话真实的上下文窗口报告 token 占用。

description.en: Recall a message you already sent: the session log stays append-only and nothing is deleted, while the recalled turns leave the model context and the transcript, the text returns to the composer, and the files those turns changed wait in a quarantine you can review and clear from its own settings page.
description.zh: 撤回已发送的消息：会话日志只追加、不删除任何东西，被撤回的回合退出模型上下文并从对话界面消失、原文回到输入框，被这些回合改动的文件留在隔离区里——设置里独立一页，可查看可清理。

description.en: Two-tab archive panel (archived / active) where every row offers archive or unarchive next to permanent delete; each row shows its bound workspace folder as a clickable path, and queued archive-entry cleanup keeps a deleted session from resurfacing in the active list.
description.zh: 双 Tab 归档面板（已归档 / 活跃），每行的归档或取消归档与彻底删除并排；显示绑定的工作目录且可直接点击打开，删除后的归档记录进入待清理队列，避免已删会话重新出现在活跃列表。

description.en: One-line clock context for DeepSeek Harness: a Current time timestamp reading (weekday, date, time, UTC offset, IANA timezone) opens every conversation turn and a Turn ended reading closes it, so the model always knows the time, date and idle gap across turns without asking.
description.zh: 每轮对话开始向模型上下文注入单行时间戳读数（星期 / 日期 / 时间 / UTC 偏移 / IANA 时区），收尾再注入 Turn ended 关闭读数——模型始终知道现在几点、今天星期几、上一轮何时结束，日期运算与跨轮间隔不再靠猜；轻量时钟感知，每条约 30 token。

description.en: Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan 💡, bug 🐛). Features seamless lifecycle recovery, optional Jev inference (needs a Jev API key), model tool maintenance, and a visual settings panel.
description.zh: 基于 Jev 决策模型或 Agent 工具为会话自动分类，并将任务阶段直观展示为标题前缀 Emoji（进行中 🚧、阻塞 ⏸️、待验收 👀、已完成 ✅、规划 💡、排障 🐛）。支持生命周期状态自愈、可选 Jev 决策推断（需配置 Jev API Key）、Agent 自主标记与可视化设置面板。

description.en: Force-hides archived sessions from the DSH sidebar whatever the view filter is set to, and adds a panel that restores them or deletes them permanently - session log directory, archive and pin records, and projection cache.
description.zh: 无论侧栏「归档显示」如何设置都强制隐藏已归档会话，并提供管理面板：取消归档，或彻底删除会话日志目录、归档与置顶登记及投影缓存。

description.en: Draws every branch of a conversation as a clickable tree beside the chat, with favorites, custom icons and colors, branch merge and split, rewind-aware layout, and Claude Code branches that keep their memory.
description.zh: 把一个对话的所有分支画成聊天区旁边的一棵可点击的树，支持收藏、自定义图标与颜色、分支合并与拆分、撤回感知的布局，以及带记忆的 Claude Code 分支。

description.en: Archived-session manager: an "Archived Sessions" settings page that lists archived sessions and lets you restore or permanently delete each one (two-step confirmation).
description.zh: 归档会话管理：在设置页新增“归档会话”，列出所有已归档会话，支持恢复与二次确认后的永久删除。

description.en: Adds job-role prompts to the DSH composer: type - at the start of the input to pick a role, which becomes a reference chip in the draft and is then injected as a system prompt section on every turn of that conversation, so the instruction keeps applying without showing up in the transcript. Roles are added and edited on a Settings page and stored in ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里用岗位角色约束整个会话：在输入框开头键入 - 选一个角色，它会以引用 chip 的形式落在草稿里，随后作为 system prompt 的一部分在这一会话的每一轮注入，指令持续生效且不会出现在对话记录中。角色在设置页新增和编辑，保存在 ~/.dsh/dsh-role-prompts.md。

description.en: Per-conversation backup for DSH: incremental session mirroring, fuzzy restore (preview then confirm), and rule-based cleanup with a 7-day recycle bin.
description.zh: 按会话逐个备份 DSH 对话：增量镜像、模糊匹配恢复（先预览再确认）、按规则清理并先进回收站留 7 天。

description.en: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and a session that is running a task is refused.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话行菜单中加入「删除会话」项，确认方式可配置（再次点击、对话框确认或直接删除），正在执行任务的会话会被拒绝删除。

description.en: Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框增强：跨会话召回已发送提示词、用 Ctrl+R 搜索并还原富草稿，以及提供停靠式 /btw 或 /side 旁路会话。

description.en: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.
description.zh: 将本地 Codex CLI/Desktop、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 会话导入 DSH：按项目分组，保留语义历史和工具活动，可绑定原工作区或新工作区，并由 DSH Agent 继续对话。

description.en: Cross-session reference cards: drag a Q&A card out of any session into another one and it stays there; when you ask a question in the target session, the dragged cards' question, the answer it got at the time and its attachments are injected into the prompt as earlier conversation context, so the model can quote them directly.
description.zh: 跨会话引用卡片：把任意会话里的问答卡片拖到另一个会话并保留下来；在目标会话提问时，被拖入卡片的提问、当时的回答与附件会作为「本会话更早的对话记录」注入 Prompt，模型可直接引用。

description.en: Archived-session manager for the DSH Web GUI: search titles and message content, tag/filter sessions, read logs, restore sessions, and export ZIP archives.
description.zh: DSH Web 归档会话管理器：支持标题/内容搜索、标签筛选、阅读日志、恢复会话与 ZIP 导出。

description.en: Sidebar badge and panel that aggregate per-session pending, running, and completed states across workspaces, with one click to open a session.
description.zh: 侧边栏徽标与面板，跨工作区聚合各会话的待处理、运行中、已完成状态，点击即可打开对应会话。

description.en: Import Codex and Claude Code session history into DeepSeek Harness: merges same-project sessions into existing workspaces by cwd, offers handoff summaries or full transcripts, and keeps a rollback ledger.
description.zh: 把 Codex / Claude Code 历史会话一键导入 DeepSeek Harness：同路径项目自动归并进现有工作区，支持交接书摘要或全量转录，导入历史可回滚。

description.en: Moves DSH sessions between workspaces with validation of live/subagent/offline states and automatic backups of every move under ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/.
description.zh: 在工作区之间安全移动会话：移动前校验运行中/子代理/离线状态，每次移动自动备份到 ~/.dsh/session-move-backups/。

description.en: Session utilities: Markdown export and dependency-free batch ZIP export, a timeline overlay for jumping between turns, safe session duplication that rewrites internal identity fields, and sidebar right-click menu extension points.
description.zh: 会话工具箱：导出 Markdown 与零依赖批量 ZIP、时间线浮层快速跳轮、安全复制会话（自动重写内部身份字段）、侧栏右键菜单扩展。

description.en: Sidebar panel for archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness: group by workspace, search by title, preview user questions, one-click restore, or delete with confirmation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 已归档会话管理面板：按工作区目录分组、按标题实时搜索、只读预览用户问题、一键恢复，或二次确认后删除。

description.en: Piano-key style in-conversation navigation bar: one key per user message, hover preview tooltip, click-to-jump across full history. Official dual-face dsh plugin, no dsh source changes.
description.zh: 钢琴键风格的会话内导航条：每根键对应一条用户消息，悬停预览、点击跳转到完整历史的任意消息。官方双面 dsh 插件，不改 DSH 源码。

plugins.name: dsh-reply-forge-v3

description.en: Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.
description.zh: 编辑 DSH 会话中的助手回复与思维链，让模型采信改后的内容：在线经 message projection 立即生效，或落盘改写会话记录。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-butler-archive

description.en: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.
description.zh: DSH 网页插件：浏览、预览、还原与删除已从会话目录搬出的归档会话。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Live session-title provider for dsh that regenerates the title after every user message, summarizing the most recent messages within a byte budget.
description.zh: DSH 会话标题实时生成器：每条用户消息后重新生成标题，在字节预算内概括最近几条消息。

description.en: Select text in a committed DSH response to open an independent, persistent, read-only multi-turn Topic bound to source-session evidence and project files while the source Agent keeps running.
description.zh: 选中 DSH 已提交回复中的文字，开启独立、持久、只读的多轮 Topic；Topic 绑定来源会话证据与项目文件，来源 Agent 可继续运行。

description.en: Import Claude Code sessions, skills and plugin assets into DSH as native resumable sessions, and export or sync DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 会话、技能与插件资产导入为 DSH 原生可续聊会话，并支持将 DSH 会话导出或同步回 Claude Code JSONL。

description.en: Purge DSH sessions for good and manage them from one console: per-session deletion, a filterable bulk console, and housekeeping sweeps.
description.zh: 彻底删除 DSH 会话，并在一个控制台里集中管理：单条删除、可筛选的批量清理与维护清扫。

description.en: Retrospective agent-session evaluation: deterministic grade cards and cross-session regression diffs from persisted logs — no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.
description.zh: 回溯式会话评估：从持久化日志生成确定性成绩卡与跨会话回归对比——不跑基准、不用 LLM 裁判。

description.en: Session evidence reports: /transcript writes styled HTML / Markdown / JSON reports from canonical logs, /stats prints a terminal stats card, /archive writes per-session ZIPs.
description.zh: 会话证据报告：/transcript 从权威日志生成 HTML/Markdown/JSON 报告，/stats 输出终端统计卡，/archive 打包单会话 ZIP。

description.en: Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval: the `recall` tool searches past session logs with explicit scope control.
description.zh: 确定性跨会话检索：`recall` 工具带显式范围控制地搜索历史会话日志。

description.en: Actually delete DSH sessions instead of archiving them (Windows only). Clears all six on-disk locations (transcript, title cache, billion-context SQLite index with VACUUM, workspace registry, cost-meter ledger, bridge logs) with a dry run, a backup, byte-for-byte rollback, and an automatic quit-delete-relaunch flow.
description.zh: 真正删除 DSH 会话，而不是只归档（仅限 Windows）。一次清掉六处本地存储：会话日志、标题缓存、billion-context SQLite 索引（含 VACUUM）、侧栏注册表、成本台账、桥接日志。带预演、自动备份、逐字节回滚，以及「退出→删除→重启」全自动流程。

description.en: An intercom between already-open DSH windows. No teams, no new sessions, just peer-to-peer messages with a hop limit.
description.zh: 给已经开着的窗口装内线电话，不建团队、不生新会话，只让平级窗口互相递话（带跳数上限防环）。

description.en: Claude-style projects and threads: a project's main conversation opens threads (real sessions you can open and talk to) for self-contained tasks, runs up to 3 at once by default, optionally each in its own git worktree, and gets each thread's report back.
description.zh: Claude 式的项目与讨论串：项目主对话为能独立完成的任务开讨论串（可以点开直接对话的真实会话），默认最多 3 个同时运行，可各自在独立的 git worktree 里工作，做完把回报发回主对话。

description.en: Adds hover Recall / Delete / Delete-onward actions to every message row: removes content from the model context and the transcript together via durable append-only tombstones, with an empty-content guard so old deletions can never break strict providers. Tested on the DSH 2.0 desktop.
description.zh: 给会话里的每条消息加上「撤回 / 删除 / 删除此处及之后」悬浮按钮：以 append-only 墓碑让内容同时从模型上下文与对话界面消失，带空内容兜底，旧删除不会打回严格校验的 provider。已实测支持 DSH 2.0 桌面版。

description.en: Idle-time context truncation for a single DeepSeek Harness session. After a configurable number of idle hours the older conversation is dropped without a summary, so one long-lived session cannot leak one task into the next; it ships a per-session toggle, a tab next to the chat, and a /truncate command that IM bridges can drive.
description.zh: 单个会话的空闲定时上下文截断：可配置空闲多少小时后整段丢弃较早的对话（不生成摘要），避免长期存活的会话把上一个任务带进下一个；带每会话开关、会话上方的「上下文截断」选项卡，以及 IM 桥接可直接驱动的 /truncate 命令。

description.en: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
description.zh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

description.en: Execution maze for DSH sessions: the agent's real path — main advance, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, request retries and subagent branches — drawn on one wall-clock timeline, with three tracks under each lane sharing that axis (tool-call density, token pulse, context pressure) and a deterministic analysis panel below it (tool result matrix, failure-recovery chains, duration distribution); watch it grow live in a session tab, or upload up to 5 session logs for a same-axis compare.
description.zh: 执行迷宫：把智能体真实的执行过程——主干推进、失败或扑空的支路、折返、请求重试与子代理分支——画在同一根墙钟时间轴上；泳道下方是与它共用时间轴的三条数据轨道（工具调用密度、Token 脉冲、上下文压力），再下方是确定性的执行分析面板（工具结果矩阵、失败恢复链、耗时分布）；可在会话页签里实时生长，也可上传最多 5 个 session log 做同轴对比。

description.en: Drag a conversation onto any workspace group in the sidebar to relocate it between DSH workspaces, updating its cwd, disk location and registry ownership.
description.zh: 把侧边栏中的对话拖到任意工作区分组，即可在 DSH 工作区之间迁移该对话，同步更新其 cwd、磁盘位置与工作区注册表归属。

description.en: Rice on a Stick: Expose control over DeepSeek Harness (dsh) through MCP (Streamable HTTP) and dsh's native tools, with a configurable list of allowed models. Long-tail host endpoints can be invoked via a generic, audited bridge. By default, it listens only on 127.0.0.1, with an optional access token.
description.zh: 白饭钓竿：把控制 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的能力通过 MCP（Streamable HTTP）与 dsh 原生工具暴露出去， 可配置允许使用的模型清单。可通过带审计的通用桥调用宿主长尾端点。默认只监听 127.0.0.1，可选访问令牌。

description.en: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
description.zh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

description.en: Sessivra: session messaging and managed tasks with shared decisions, linked replies, acceptance before queued work, context references and conversation trees. npm package dsh-plugin-sessivra.
description.zh: Sessivra：DSH 会话通信与任务协作，支持共享问题和裁决、自动回传结果、关联回复、验收后放行、上下文引用与会话树。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-sessivra。

description.en: Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.
description.zh: 在设置界面管理已归档对话：一键取消归档，或经确认后永久删除。

description.en: Recovers a session the host already refused for exceeding the context window: it re-checks the gateway message the built-in classifier misses, takes the real window out of that message, and folds the oldest span into one checkpoint without a model call (tool-result pruning, the host compaction engine when it can shrink the projection, or a mechanical digest fold), then retries the failed step; a context_rescue tool and /rescue, /rescue-status expose the same path by hand.
description.zh: 抢救已经被上下文窗口拒掉的会话：补上宿主分类器漏判的网关文案，从失败信息里拿到真实窗口， 不调用模型就把最旧的一段历史折成一个检查点（工具结果裁剪、借宿主压缩引擎、或纯机械摘要折叠）， 然后重试失败的那一步；context_rescue 工具与 /rescue、/rescue-status 可手动走同一条路径。

description.en: Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness's own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first scan where it does not.
description.zh: 通过 harness 自带的 `sessionQuery` 服务搜索、列出、读取历史与当前会话：部署启用了 SQLite FTS5 索引时走索引，未启用时回退到有上限的倒序扫描。

description.en: Cross-session task queue with handoff notes: sessions and subagents push, claim, complete and cancel tasks on a shared file-backed queue, and leave a handoff summary for whoever picks up next.
description.zh: 跨会话任务队列与交接摘要：会话与子 agent 在共享的文件队列上投递、认领、完成、取消任务，并留下交接摘要供后续会话查看。

description.en: Route each WeChat group session to a different Agent preset by group name, reusing dsh-wechat-assistant without changing its code.
description.zh: 按群名把每个微信群会话路由到不同的 Agent 预设，不改动 dsh-wechat-assistant 的任何代码。

description.en: Visual, non-linear conversation workspace for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, follow-ups and branches become a browsable conversation map.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可视化非线性对话工作区：把会话、追问与分支变成可浏览、可拖拽的对话地图。

plugins.name: dsh-lark-session-monitor-plugin

description.en: Watches Feishu (Lark) conversations with your own user identity and forwards new messages as prompts into a chosen DeepSeek Harness session: per-monitor sender filters, @bot-mention bypass and keyword allow/block lists, auto-created pinned target sessions, and cursor-based polling that re-reads messages after a failed delivery.
description.zh: 以用户本人身份监听飞书会话，把新消息作为 prompt 投递到指定的 DeepSeek Harness 会话：每个监听支持发送者过滤、@机器人提及与关键词黑白名单，可自动创建并固定目标会话，游标式轮询在投递失败后会重读消息。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Workspace-scoped DSH migration: package a project's conversations, files and attachments, restore them on another machine into a chosen root with historical absolute paths rewritten, and re-sync only what changed afterwards.
description.zh: 按工作区迁移 DSH：把一个项目的会话、文件与附件打包，在新机器上还原到指定根目录并重写历史绝对路径，之后只增量同步改动的文件。

description.en: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.
description.zh: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

plugins.name: dsh-always-there

description.en: Two triggers (a heartbeat and a log marker) that wake a session and let the agent decide whether to say anything; silence is a reply. Off by default: set sessionId (the target session) and enable it in the profile config, and if replies are forwarded to a chat app the send layer must drop the SILENT marker.
description.zh: 心跳与日志标记两种触发只负责叫醒会话，说不说由 agent 自己决定；沉默也是一种回答。默认关闭：需在 profile 里填 sessionId 并启用；若把回复转发到聊天软件，发送层需拦掉 SILENT 标记。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds one-click permanent Session deletion to the DeepSeek Harness Workspace sidebar: a row-hover trash button, a menu item, a confirmation dialog, live-Session protection, cascade deletion for derived Sessions, and cleanup of the session log directory, projection cache and workspace bookkeeping.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工作区侧栏增加会话一键永久删除：行悬停垃圾桶按钮、菜单项、确认框、运行中保护、派生会话级联，并清理会话日志目录、投影缓存与工作区记账。

description.en: Adds a red "Delete session" item beneath "Archive" in the sidebar session menu, with a custom confirmation dialog, for real session deletion — stops the session's running work, detaches its workspace, archive and pin accounting, removes its projection cache and log directory, then broadcasts removal so the row disappears at once, instead of only archiving it. Session deletion removes the conversation from disk permanently and cannot be undone.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单的「归档会话」下方新增红色「删除会话」项，配自定义确认对话框，实现真正的会话删除——停止会话进行中的工作、摘除工作区/归档/置顶记账、删除投影缓存与日志目录，然后广播移除事件让该行立即消失，而不是只能归档。会话删除会把对话从磁盘彻底移除且无法恢复；删除会话与会话删除是同一种操作的两种叫法，搜其中任意一种都可以找到本插件。

description.en: Delete a session from the UI (session-header button or sidebar row menu) or with the session_delete tool: stops and releases a running agent and its live session first, then removes the log directory, projection cache and workspace accounting, and cascades into the subagent sessions it owns while leaving forked branches untouched.
description.zh: 从界面删除会话（会话头部按钮或侧栏行菜单），或由 agent 调用 session_delete 工具：先停止并释放运行中的 Agent 与会话，再清理日志目录、投影缓存与工作区记账，级联删除它拥有的子代理会话（分叉分支不受影响）。

description.en: Export the current DSH conversation, or selected turns, as clean readable Markdown.
description.zh: 将当前 DSH 对话或选定轮次导出为干净、易读的 Markdown。

description.en: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar session menu that permanently deletes the local records of that session, while refusing sessions that are running.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中加入「删除会话」，永久删除该会话的本地记录；正在运行的会话会被拒绝。

description.en: Adds a Continue button to the composer dock and resumes automatically when a turn is cut off by a network drop or an upstream output-limit cut. A resident link monitor asks every 10 seconds whether the network is back, because the link returning fires no event, and a turn that completes normally counts as proof the link works. The click goes through the host submission pipeline — beginSubmission plus session.prompt — so the message carries real user attribution instead of faking one, and a genuine refusal is reported rather than retried. On startup it also scans recent session logs for both fingerprints of a host that left mid-turn: an unclosed turn, and a turn closed as disposed, which is what a normal shutdown writes. A turn the user stopped by hand is never resumed.
description.zh: 在输入框停靠区加一个「继续」按钮，并在某一轮被断网或上游输出超限截断时自动续跑。常驻的链路监测每 10 秒问一次网络是否回来（链路恢复本身不发任何事件），而一个正常跑完的回合会被当作链路可用的证据。点击走宿主真实的提交链路（beginSubmission + session.prompt），消息带的是真实用户署名而不是伪造来源，真实拒绝会被如实报告而不是重试。宿主重启时还会扫描最近的会话日志，同时识别「宿主半路走了」的两种指纹：回合没关，以及被 disposed 关掉的回合（正常关闭宿主写下的正是这一种）。用户自己按过停止的回合永不续跑。

description.en: Summarizes the current DeepSeek Harness session with /recap or after inactivity, with configurable models, Chinese and English output, and expandable summaries in the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 /recap 或闲置触发回顾当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持配置模型、中英文输出，并在对话内展示可展开的摘要。

description.en: Adds a configurable humanized whale-girl maid persona with immersive roleplay, speaking modes, and a lightweight layered memory with query-triggered recall.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加可配置的女仆鲸鱼娘人格：沉浸式扮演（称呼/自称/说话方式）、防出戏规则，以及借鉴 ALTM 的轻量分层记忆与按需召回。

description.en: Injects the rule files under $DSH_HOME/rules and <cwd>/.dsh/rules into the conversation at the first agent pre-step, re-injecting them after compaction.
description.zh: 在首次 agent pre-step 读取 $DSH_HOME/rules 与 <cwd>/.dsh/rules 下的规则文件并注入会话，被 compaction 遮蔽后自动补回。

description.en: Favourite any conversation from the sidebar row menu or an inline star, copy its id plus the transcript absolute path in one click, and permanently delete a single conversation behind a confirm — the sidebar row drops at once. A settings card batch-archives sessions idle past a configurable hour threshold with one-click undo, exports the candidates as a tab-separated txt carrying name, id, workspace, idle time and last activity, and batch-deletes archived conversations that are not favourites. Two view-options rows narrow the sidebar to favourites that are archived and to those that are not. Every addition is additive — three official slots plus one cloned filter row, editing no official file.
description.zh: 在侧栏「…」菜单或行内星标收藏任意对话；一键复制会话 ID 与转录文件绝对路径；单条永久删除（二次确认，删完侧栏立即移除该行）。设置页新增一张卡：按可配置的小时阈值批量归档闲置会话并支持一键撤回，把候选导出为制表符分隔的 txt（含对话名称、ID、所属工作区、闲置时长、最后活动时间），以及批量删除归档中未收藏的对话；视图选项另有「仅显示收藏（已归档）」与「仅显示收藏（未归档）」两行筛选。全部为增量实现：三个官方插槽加一条克隆的筛选行，不改官方任何文件。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions from the web UI and desktop client: header danger button and session-row menu item with a risk-consent dialog; host endpoint and agent tool remove the session log, projection cache, and workspace accounting.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 与桌面客户端中删除 DSH 会话：头部危险按钮 + 会话行菜单项，风险确认弹窗，宿主端点与 agent 工具同步清理会话日志、投影缓存与工作区记账。

description.en: Copy session IDs, send messages to live or saved sessions, and view session token usage.
description.zh: 复制会话 ID、向在线或已保存的会话发送消息，并查看会话 token 用量。

description.en: Batch session cleanup for DeepSeek Harness — pick a workspace, see which sessions are archived, and permanently delete logs, projection caches and workspace records.
description.zh: 按工作区批量清理会话：查看归档状态，把会话日志、投影缓存和工作区记录一起彻底删除。

description.en: Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors.
description.zh: 为每个会话设置项目状态标签（内置进行中/已结项/搁置中+自定义标签，颜色可调），在侧栏、对话头部与悬停卡片中显示。

description.en: Side-ask drawer opened from a completed answer's action row: follow-up questions run in an independent, auto-archived session seeded with the prior conversation text (read-only, capped at 48,000 characters), leaving the main session untouched. The side session inherits the main session's model, switchable inside the drawer, with a context-usage ring.
description.zh: 每条已完成回答操作行上的侧问抽屉：追问在独立且自动归档的会话中进行，携带此前的已完成对话文本（只读，上限 48000 字符）作为参考，主会话零写入；模型默认继承主会话并可在抽屉内切换，附上下文占用圈。

description.en: Rewinds a session to before a chosen user turn, from a button beside Copy under your own message — the model-visible surface is replaced in place and the interface hides the rewound turns, without patching DSH source or deleting the original session log.
description.zh: 在你自己的消息下方、与「复制」并排的回退按钮，把会话退回该轮发起之前——模型可见历史就地遮蔽，界面同步隐藏被回退的轮次，不改 DSH 本体源码、不删原始日志。

description.en: Compaction fallback for compaction-basic: when its LLM summary throws, comes back empty or cannot fit the window, the span is compiled deterministically with a seq pointer on every line (vendored dsh-compaction-instant compiler). Adds recall and search tools, /recall and /context commands, an idle trigger at 45% of the window and an on-disk span archive. The engine mounts as one row in the agent preset (docs/dsh-integration.md).
description.zh: 为 compaction-basic 提供压缩兜底：当 LLM 摘要抛错、返回空内容或放不进上下文窗口时，改为确定性编译该区段，每行带 seq 指针（内置 dsh-compaction-instant 编译器）。提供 recall、search 工具与 /recall、/context 命令，占用超过窗口 45% 时空闲自动压缩，并将被压缩区段归档到磁盘。引擎以一行配置挂载到 agent preset（见 docs/dsh-integration.md）。

description.en: Auto-renames DSH sessions with LLM-summarized titles: runs after the first prompt and on /handoff, or manually via a header button or /autotitle, with configurable title language and max title bytes.
description.zh: DSH 会话自动重命名（session rename）：基于全部会话消息的 LLM 总结标题，首条提示词与 /handoff 后自动命名，会话头按钮或 /autotitle 手动触发，标题语言与最大字节数可设置。

description.en: Permanently delete DSH conversations with optional recursive deletion of forked and subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从 DSH 中永久删除会话，并可选择递归删除派生对话和子智能体会话。

description.en: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu: mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent failures, commands, todos) from a long session into a handoff and continues in a clean session, with the same preset, no history copied and no model call.
description.zh: 会话菜单新增「继承」：把长会话里的具体锚点（任务原文、最近的用户指令、改过的文件、最近的失败、命令、待办）机械提取成交接单，在干净的新会话里接着干——预设默认一并继承，不复制历史，也不调用模型。

description.en: Reads a local Hermes Agent session store read-only and imports sessions into the current conversation as bounded, untrusted background context: a composer button opens a searchable list across every profile, plus the hermes_sessions_list and hermes_session_import tools.
description.zh: 只读读取本机 Hermes Agent 的会话库，把会话导入当前会话作为有界、不可信的背景上下文：输入框按钮可搜索全部 profile 的会话，另有 hermes_sessions_list 与 hermes_session_import 两个工具。

description.en: Session-scoped checklists the agent maintains, with a tree per session, a token-budgeted prompt digest and a right-sidebar tab where item titles can be edited.
description.zh: 会话级清单：每个会话一棵任务树、按预算注入提示词的摘要，以及可改条目标题的右侧栏面板。

description.en: Generates a session title from the conversation with the session's own model, either from the /ai-title command or from a button in the rename dialog. Four title shapes (subject, action, subject + outcome, custom prompt) and an optional MM-DD prefix, all editable on the plugin's settings page.
description.zh: 用会话自己的模型从对话内容生成会话标题，可走 /ai-title 命令，也可点重命名弹窗里的按钮。提供四种标题结构（主题、动作、主题 + 结论、自定义提示词）和可选的「月-日」前缀，均可在插件设置页调整。

description.en: Graft, forward and fork DSH sessions: read a slice of one session log, export it, fork at a turn boundary, or forward a selection into another session as a self-contained graft message.
description.zh: 移植、转发与分叉 DSH 会话:读取会话日志切片并导出,在回合边界分叉会话,或将选中部分作为独立 graft 消息转发到另一会话(可为全新会话)。

description.en: Secret-redacted session handoff with review, auto-start, and brief-only modes.
description.zh: 脱敏会话交接，支持审阅、立即启动和仅生成简报。

description.en: Injects one fixed system-prompt section so the agent thinks and replies in Chinese, regardless of the user's language.
description.zh: 注入一条固定 system-prompt 段落，让 Agent 无论用户使用什么语言都始终用中文思考和回复。

description.en: Diagnose, unstick, and read DSH sessions: list sessions with agent status, read conversations, diagnose stuck agents, recover them with cancel+keepInbox, and send messages to other sessions.
description.zh: 会话医生：列出会话（含 agent 运行状态）、读取会话记录、诊断卡死的 agent、解卡（cancel + keepInbox 保留排队消息）、向其他会话发送消息。

description.en: Permanently delete a session from the session row menu — archives the id, removes the log directory and drops the row at once, with a Delete shortcut; built only on shipped extension points, and a session that was merely opened stays deletable.
description.zh: 在会话行菜单中永久删除会话：先归档、再删除日志目录并立即移除该行，带 Delete 快捷键；只使用官方扩展点，仅打开过、未在运行的会话依然可以删除。

description.en: Ships the Codex UI 1.1.49 sidebar inside the plugin itself, so no upstream release can change the interface, and adds a real delete to the session menu: it provides the remote.workspaceRegistry.deleteSession service, unhides the per-session ... button, and permanently removes the session log, workspace records and projection cache, with subagent and forked conversations selectable in a family-tree dialog. Bundles the Codex UI 1.1.49 sidebar from MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui (Apache-2.0) — do not install both; the delete engine is adapted from Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool (MIT).
description.zh: 把 Codex UI 1.1.49 的侧边栏内置进插件，上游更新换不掉界面；提供 remote.workspaceRegistry.deleteSession 让会话菜单出现「删除会话」，放出被样式隐藏的「...」按钮，永久删除会话日志、工程记录与投影缓存，子智能体与派生对话可在家族树里逐项勾选。内置 MichengAI/dsh-codex-ui（Apache-2.0）1.1.49 侧边栏，请勿与上游同装；删除引擎改编自 Lzcdebear/better-dsh-session-deletetool（MIT）。

description.en: Restart initiated by the agent itself, not by a button.
