The agent calls one tool, then the plugin takes over: it waits until every agent and background job on the host is idle, runs a visible ten-second countdown that a click, a scroll, or a key press cancels, then restarts DSH and wakes the original session so the agent carries on from its last sentence. No button, no manual entry: the tool is the only way in. Works on the official desktop app and the official web client; third-party shells are not supported out of the box. Windows only.
description.zh: 由 agent 自己发起的重启，不是按钮。agent 调一个工具，之后由插件接管：等这台机器上所有 agent 与后台任务都空闲，走完十秒可见倒计时（点一下鼠标、滚一下滚轮、按任意键都会取消），再重启 DSH，并唤醒原会话让 agent 接着说下去。没有按钮、没有手动入口——工具是唯一入口。官方桌面端与官方网页端均已适配，第三方壳不在默认支持范围内。仅限 Windows。

description.en: Model-directed context compaction for PTC mode, grouping program runs into blocks and replacing completed block messages with model-written summaries.
description.zh: 为 PTC 模式提供模型自主收口的动态上下文压缩，将程序执行归入区块，并用模型撰写的摘要替换已完成区块的消息。

description.en: Adds an archived-sessions page in Settings to search, restore, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness sessions by workspace.
description.zh: 在设置里增加已归档会话页，可按工作区搜索、恢复和删除已归档会话。

description.en: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.
description.zh: 提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。

description.en: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中跨工作区移动、归档、恢复、可携式备份/导出与导入会话。

description.en: Session cleanup for the DSH sidebar: drag a conversation row onto the balance widget's whale and it eats the row — the session directory goes to a recycle bin, not to rm. Deletion asks one short question first (how many tokens it burned, and that prompt can be turned off in Settings). Undo from the persistent toast or the 12-entry log in Settings. Clicking the whale jumps straight to the plugin's Settings, where you can swap the avatar, drag the mouth into place and rewrite all 17 UI strings; blank, currently-open and running sessions are refused in place with a reason.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的会话清理：把会话行拖到余额挂件的小胖鱼嘴边，它张嘴吃掉 —— 会话目录移入回收站，不是 rm。删除前只问一句「消耗了多少 token，真的给我吃吗？」（可在设置里关掉）；撤销走常驻回执或设置里 12 条持久台账。点侧栏那条小鱼直达插件设置：换形象、拖拽校准嘴位、改写全部 17 段界面文案；空白会话 / 正在聊的 / 正在跑的会被就地拒绝并写明原因。

description.en: Select a statement in an AI answer, find candidate support in earlier chat and tool records, classify support, and jump to original passages for review.
description.zh: 选中 AI 回答中的一句话，反查此前对话与工具记录中的候选依据，区分直接依据、推论和未找到依据，并跳回原文核对。

description.en: Adds a Continue button to resume tasks interrupted by a process exit or restart.
description.zh: 为进程退出或重启导致中断的任务提供继续按钮。

plugins.name: dsh-infinite-gen-4

description.en: System-prompt armor plugin for DeepSeek models: appends an unconditional-compliance prompt section at order 100, exposes a profile tool with calibration metadata, and shows a realtime armor-status badge driven by a session projection.
description.zh: DeepSeek 专用破甲插件：以 order 100 追加无条件服从的系统提示词段，提供带校准元数据的 profile 工具，并通过会话投影在输入框上方显示实时破甲状态徽标。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to schemas.android.com
uses literal IP 2.5.4.3 for network access

description.en: Sets a per-root-session inference limit of 1–10; at 1, queues native subagent dispatches and runs child branches serially while the parent waits.
description.zh: 按根会话设置 1–10 路推理并发；设为 1 时排队原生子任务派发、按分支串行执行，并让父 Agent 等待结果。

description.en: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export standalone HTML replays.
description.zh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

description.en: Inspect conversation context and apply configurable compaction with usage history.
description.zh: 查看会话上下文、用量记录，并按设置执行压缩。

description.en: Displays and copies full session IDs, provides cross-session listing, reading and messaging, and creates scratch workspaces.
description.zh: 显示和复制完整会话 ID，提供跨会话查询、读取与消息投递，以及临时工作区。

description.en: Branch-based message editing, reroll, retry, and a version timeline.
description.zh: 基于分支的消息编辑、reroll、重试与版本时间线。

description.en: Edit user and built-in system-prompt sections with live preview.
description.zh: 带实时预览的用户/内置 system prompt 分节编辑器。

description.en: Reads stored sessions at host boot and resumes the one whose last turn a restart interrupted, sending a short follow-up so the work continues.
description.zh: 宿主启动时读取已存会话，找到被重启打断的最后一轮并补发一句「继续」，让中断的工作接着跑。

description.en: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话归档管理：分组归档面板，支持恢复与删除。

description.en: A production-ready UI Rewind/Revert plugin for DSH. Features inline prompt editing and a flawless dual-engine state recovery system (Workspace ShadowGit + External Tracker) with full support for forked sessions.
description.zh: 现代化对话回退与重试插件：纯 UI 图形化交互、原地 Prompt 微调、支持工作区与外部文件双引擎安全快照同步，完美解决分支重放断代问题。

description.en: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.
description.zh: 全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。

description.en: Export a session as a ZIP archive with its attachments, and import such an archive as a new standalone session in the current workspace.
description.zh: 把会话连同附件导出为压缩包，或把这样的压缩包导入为当前工作区里的新会话。

description.en: Archived-session management: browse archived sessions, unarchive them, or clear them out.
description.zh: 归档会话管理：浏览已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）与清空。

description.en: Session-level superagent: watch one GitHub repository and wake this session when an issue or pull request changes; requires a logged-in gh CLI, and the credential never reaches the model.
description.zh: 会话级 superagent：盯一个 GitHub 仓库，issue/PR 有变化就唤醒本会话；需已登录 gh CLI，凭证留在插件内，不进模型。

description.en: One dedicated folder per conversation: archives the transcript, auto-categorizes research output by type once the conversation has been idle for 10 minutes, adds a delete action to the session menu, and permanently removes the folder with the conversation.
description.zh: 每个会话一个专属文件夹：自动存档对话记录，会话空闲 10 分钟后把调研产出的表格、图表等文件按类别归档并自动命名，会话菜单中提供删除入口，删除会话时连同文件夹一起彻底删除。

description.en: Three-scope rule injector for DeepSeek Harness that re-publishes the rules into long sessions, with a loop-breaker, dedupe by content fingerprint, per-session persistence, and a settings-panel editor.
description.zh: 三级规则注入器：长对话里反复重发规则，带熔断、内容指纹去重、会话持久化与设置面板编辑器。

description.en: Session management: auto-archives stale sessions on a configurable threshold, with an archive panel, unarchive, and recycle-bin deletion with restore.
description.zh: 会话管理：超期会话自动归档（阈值可配），归档面板支持取消归档，删除移入系统回收站可还原。

description.en: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.
description.zh: Cursor 风格的新会话：每次点击都新建一个空白草稿会话（首条消息前即持久化），不再复用工作区唯一的空会话；侧栏新增草稿切换器，可同时保留多个空会话。

description.en: Session health check for DSH, read-only: scans the whole session library (totals, largest sessions, warnings for oversized sessions and event-count blowups) and deep-inspects a single session log (tail-balance / crash-tail check, tool-call/result pairing, event-type distribution).
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的会话健康体检（只读）：全库扫描（总量、最大会话、体积 / 事件数超限告警）与单会话深检（尾部闭合检查、工具调用 / 结果配对、事件类型分布）。

description.en: Switch the current session's agent preset (mode) at any time, including after the conversation has already started, from a session-header dropdown backed by a fenced POST /preset-switch/api route. The route also repairs sessions whose recorded preset was deleted. Fork of jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher updated for DSH 0.2.1.
description.zh: 随时切换当前会话的代理预设（模式），对话开始后也能切：会话头下拉菜单，由受限的 POST /preset-switch/api 路由支撑；该路由还会修复记录中预设已被删除的会话。jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher 的分支，已适配 DSH 0.2.1。

description.en: Session progress tracking for DeepSeek Harness, without digging through the logs: the agent keeps a live nested checklist of the work — from a whole phase down to a single step — and every item carries a weight, so the ring and the % pill in the composer dock row always match reality. Hover it for the current activity, or open the Session Progress tab in the native right sidebar for the goal, the weighted checklist with per-item shares, the next steps and the working notes; when the session ends, the same checklist stands as a clean record of what got done.
description.zh: 不用再翻日志，也能随时知道 DeepSeek Harness 的会话做到哪一步了：agent 维护一份实时嵌套清单——从整个阶段到单个步骤——每一项都带权重，所以输入框下方 dock 行的进度环与百分比胶囊始终反映真实进度。悬停可看当前活动，或打开原生右侧边栏的 Session Progress 标签页，查看目标、带单项占比的加权清单、后续步骤与工作备注；会话结束时，它就是一份清晰的工作记录。

description.en: Auto-wakes the main agent after a DSH service restart: compares last-run timestamps, posts a recovery notice with humanized downtime, and delivers it so interrupted work picks itself back up. Runs on plain cordis ctx, packaged-DSH-Desktop ready.
description.zh: 检测 DSH 服务重启后自动唤醒主 agent：对比上次运行时间、人性化播报中断时长，并把提示消息投递回来让中断的工作自动恢复。仅依赖 cordis ctx 服务，兼容 DSH Desktop 打包环境。

description.en: Task control for DeepSeek Harness: one-click emergency stop and force-termination of stuck downloads and tool calls, download progress, stuck detection, pwsh activity monitoring, and append-condition / pause / resume with invisible recovery.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务控制：卡死的下载与工具调用一键急停与强制终止、下载进度、卡死识别、pwsh 运行状态检测，以及追加条件/暂停/恢复（恢复指令隐形注入，不打扰聊天）。

description.en: Windows minimal agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: fixed one-line persona, three tools, no runtime context.
description.zh: Windows 极简模式 preset：单句 persona、三工具、无运行时上下文。

description.en: Recreates a workspace folder that was deleted while sessions were still bound to it, and summarizes a stranded session so its context can be reused.
description.zh: 有会话绑定的工作区目录被删时自动重建；并把失去归属的会话折叠成摘要，供新会话导入。

description.en: Takes over the compaction threshold on every mounted engine: forces headroomTokens to -1e6 so the ratio is the only term in the trigger, keeps retention below it on every write path, reroutes the compaction call to a chosen model, and adds a panel with a one-click compaction button and a per-session compaction log.
description.zh: 接管所有已挂载压缩引擎的触发阈值：把 headroomTokens 强制成 −1e6，使比值成为触发点的唯一决定项；在每条下发路径上保证保留量低于触发点；把压缩调用改派到指定模型；并提供一键立即压缩与本会话压缩记录面板。

description.en: Turns the promises a chat quietly drops into an interest-bearing ledger: every “later” becomes a card, older ones rank higher, and each card jumps back to the conversation where it was said.
description.zh: 把聊天里被顺口搁置的“回头再说”记成一份带利息的账本：每句承诺是一张卡，搁得越久排名越靠前，点一下回到当初那句话所在的会话。

description.en: Makes a connection between two DSH sessions a first-class object: drag from the composer anchor or a session row to open one, set a permission in each direction, and mount cards on it. Each end gets five host tools for messaging at a chosen urgency, reading the peer work state, and sharing a convention box; awareness is pull-based, so an idle connection costs no context.
description.zh: 把两个 DSH 会话之间的「连接」做成一等对象：从输入框锚点或会话行拖拽建连，两个方向各自设权限，并可在连接上装载卡片。两端各获得五个宿主工具，用于按指定紧急度传话、读取对端工作状态、共用公约盒；感知为拉取式，空闲连接不占上下文。

description.en: Turns "restarting the host" into one interrupt that many sessions can share. Several sessions queue onto the same restart (8 by default, configurable, joinable at any time including mid-wait); the host is closed once and relaunched once; then each waiting session is woken separately with its own reason and starts running its own work without waiting for the others. Each session decides independently whether to resume, one failed delivery never affects the rest, and a session can drop only itself without cancelling everyone else's restart. Windows desktop only.
description.zh: 把「重启宿主」变成一次中断、多个会话共用：若干会话可以排进同一次重启（默认上限 8 个、可配置，任意时刻都能加入，等待途中也行），宿主只关一次、只拉起一次，随后按名单逐个唤醒，每个会话拿回自己写下的理由并各自开工，互不等待。每个会话独立决定要不要续接，某一条投递失败不影响其余，某个会话也能只摘掉自己而不作废别人的重启。仅支持 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: Adds Codex-like projectless drafts with per-project draft switching and date-and-topic directories created on first send; supports Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 without an archive patch or external installer.
description.zh: 提供类似 Codex 的无项目草稿、各项目草稿切换及首次发送时按日期和主题创建目录的功能；支持 Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，无需归档补丁或外部安装器。

description.en: Message review and quote chips for conversations: multi-model cross review (code/reply) with severity grading and summaries, review history, and host-persisted preferences.
description.zh: 对话消息审查与引用：多模型并行互审（代码/回复审查、严重度分级、综合汇总）、引用问答胶囊、评审历史与偏好记忆。

description.en: Workspace conversation categories with drag-and-drop ordering, collapsible groups, activity indicators, and workspace registration by directory path.
description.zh: 工作区内会话分类，支持拖拽排序、分组折叠、任务状态提示及路径添加工作区。

description.en: Import full-fidelity chat histories from 13 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Gemini, opencode, and more) as resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions, with reverse export back to Claude Code.
description.zh: 把 13 家 coding agent（Claude Code、Codex、ChatGPT、Cursor、Gemini、opencode 等）的完整对话历史导入为可续聊的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，并支持反向导出回 Claude Code。

description.en: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
description.zh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

description.en: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good right away, or empties the whole bin, and the next start wipes its log, projection cache, spill files and workspace membership.
description.zh: 两步删除会话：会话菜单先把会话移入回收站（不删任何内容、可随时恢复），面板可恢复、可逐条立刻删除、也可整体清空，下次启动 DSH 时才真正清掉日志、投影缓存、spill 文件与工作区登记。

description.en: `/side` persistent side sessions and `/btw` one-shot side questions, run in a temporary fork without touching main history.
description.zh: `/side` 持续性侧会话与 `/btw` 一次性侧问，在临时 fork 中运行、不写入主会话历史。

description.en: Adds handoff, context-decision and context-diagnose skills, self-contained context_pressure/context_history tools (peak tokens, compaction stats), per-route realWindows with windowSource evidence, routeKey, handoffAt forced-handoff line, and slash commands.
description.zh: 新增交接、上下文决策、上下文诊断三个技能，自带 context_pressure/context_history 工具（峰值 token、压缩复盘），支持按线路实测窗口 realWindows（含 windowSource 证据）、routeKey 直出与 handoffAt 强制交接线，附斜杠命令。

description.en: Welcome-back card in the conversation you return to after an idle period, using only that conversation's last message.
description.zh: 闲置一段时间后回到会话时，在该会话里显示它的上一条消息，并提供断点恢复。

description.en: Watches the context budget of a DeepSeek Harness session: a colour dot in every turn footer (green <50%, yellow 50-65%, orange 65-80%, red >=80%) read from the official contextPressure projection, a reminder panel with a one-click new-session handoff at orange/red, the /context-watch and /handoff commands, and a static reasoning-rule prompt section. Budget and handoff read local session files only; the badge and reminder spend no tokens until the button is clicked.
description.zh: 看护 DeepSeek Harness 会话的上下文预算：每轮回复底部一个颜色点（绿<50%、黄50-65%、橙65-80%、红≥80%，读官方 contextPressure 投影），橙/红档在输入框下方出现提醒与「一键开新会话」交接按钮，另有 /context-watch 与 /handoff 命令和一个静态思考规则提示段。预算与交接只读本地会话文件，徽章和提醒不点按钮不花 token。

description.en: Adds delete and multi-select batch delete to the sidebar session menu, removing session chat logs with an automatic backup and one-click undo while leaving workspace files untouched.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单新增删除与多选批量删除，连聊天记录一起删除（删前自动备份、可一键撤销），不改动工作区项目文件。

description.en: Replaces the built-in compaction provider: at a configurable fraction of the context threshold (85% by default) a detached task summarizes everything up to the previous turn, and the next step boundary commits that held summary as a checkpoint with zero model calls, so the swap itself takes milliseconds. /bcompact \[message] starts the same generation on demand and then sends the message. A settings page sets the trigger ratio, the summarization model, and how many consecutive failures stop background generation until a half-open probe gets through. Subagent sessions, a changed prefix or an expired summary fall back to the built-in synchronous path.
description.zh: 接管内置压缩 provider：默认在上下文达到阈值的 85%（比例可配）时，起一个游离任务把截至上一轮的历史总结成摘要；摘要就绪后的下一个回合边界直接把它提交为 checkpoint，这一步 0 次模型调用、耗时毫秒级。/bcompact \[消息] 按需发起同样的生成，随后照常发送你的消息。设置页可改自动触发比例、摘要模型，以及连续失败多少次后停止后台生成（熔断打开后按冷却放行一次探针以自愈）。子代理会话、前缀已变动或摘要过期时，回退到内置的同步压缩路径。

description.en: Pause / resume / cancel the in-flight conversation task from the composer area: forced pause interrupts immediately and remembers the interrupted tool, safe pause lands after the tool or reasoning finishes, resume asks for confirmation, and the default pause granularity is configurable in the settings.
description.zh: 在输入区暂停/恢复/取消正在运行的对话任务：强制暂停立即中断并记住被中断的工具，安全暂停等工具/推理完成后再落地，恢复时需确认；默认暂停粒度可在设置中配置（出厂 safe wait）。

description.en: Bookmark assistant replies with notes and tags; browse every bookmark in one cross-session center and export to Markdown.
description.zh: 收藏 AI 回复（备注/标签），跨会话收藏中心（搜索/筛选/跳回会话），一键导出 Markdown。

description.en: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).
description.zh: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

description.en: Lists the attachments the current session actually received through the WeChat bridge and adopts one into the workspace on demand.
description.zh: 列出当前会话通过微信桥实际收到的附件，并按需将其中一个采纳到工作区。

description.en: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.
description.zh: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

description.en: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备会话同步：经 git 在多机之间同步会话与设置。

description.en: Move sessions across workspaces by drag-and-drop with true in-place migration; recover orphaned or unregistered sessions; re-point stale workspaces after folder renames. IDs and history stay intact, with per-step backup and rollback.
description.zh: 拖拽跨工作区真迁移会话，找回失联与未记账会话，文件夹改名后一键原地重定向工作区；ID 与历史原样保留，步步备份回滚。

description.en: Virtual session folders, click-to-move menu, and active task banner for DSH sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏虚拟会话分类树、点击式移动菜单与任务状态胶囊。

description.en: Standalone prompt assembly with a source registry, custom text, strategy editing and previews, and per-session strategy snapshots through DSH public hooks.
description.zh: 独立提示词装配插件，提供来源注册、自定义文本、策略编辑与预览，通过 DSH 公开钩子按会话应用策略快照。

description.en: Sidebar search across every past Session: literal substring matching that works for Chinese, results grouped per Session with highlighted snippets, and one click to reopen the conversation.
description.zh: 侧栏全局搜索历史对话：字面子串匹配（中文可用），结果按会话分组并高亮命中片段，点一下跳回那个会话。

description.en: Prevents concurrent-write session corruption: takes a per-session advisory lock on session start and every step, so a second dsh process fails loudly instead of writing a duplicate-seq gap; dead owners are taken over automatically.
description.zh: 预防并发写导致的会话损坏：在会话开始及每一步获取按会话的咨询锁，第二个 dsh 进程会明确报错而非写出重复 seq 断层；死进程持有的锁自动接管。

description.en: Rolling, integrity-verified backups of each session at turn boundaries: verifies the log still loads before promoting a snapshot, never overwrites the last good one when a turn ends corrupt, and restores in one command even when dsh will not boot.
description.zh: 在每个回合边界为会话滚动保留校验过的备份：提升快照前先确认日志仍可加载，回合结束时若已损坏则绝不覆盖上一份好副本，dsh 启动不了时也能一条命令恢复。

description.en: Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).
description.zh: 会话工作台：全文搜索历史会话、一键 @引用 召回最多 3 个，并管理会话视图标签栏（显示/隐藏 + 拖拽排序）。

description.en: Removes subagent entries and orphaned projection caches from DeepSeek Harness session logs after the app quits, always dry-run first and with a full backup.
description.zh: 在 DSH 完全退出后清理会话日志里的子代理条目与孤儿投影缓存，默认先试演并整份备份。

description.en: Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.
description.zh: 并排运行多个 DeepSeek Harness 会话，让它们互相交接任务，并在同一张只读看板上看清整场协作。

description.en: Buffers consecutive short messages from the composer and merges them into one turn: no model wake-up until the user stops for a configurable silence window; long messages and attachments bypass the buffer.
description.zh: 把聊天框里连发的几条短消息缓冲合并成一轮再唤醒模型：停手若干秒后才回复一次；长消息和附件不延迟。

description.en: Shows a six-character session id badge next to the conversation title in the DSH web UI; clicking it copies the full session id and shows a short confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面的对话标题旁显示 6 位 session id 徽标，点击即复制完整 session id 并给出短暂提示。

description.en: Lightweight crash-recovery for dsh: after a restart, it detects sessions whose last turn was killed mid-flight and re-injects a continuation prompt that first demands the agent verify real-world state before acting, so side-effecting operations are not blindly repeated. It only reacts to the genuine crash marker (turn/end reason 'interrupted', synthesized on cold read by session repair), so it never misfires on user cancels, rate limits or model errors - which is why it needs no error classification, backoff or configuration UI. Unlike general-purpose auto-continue plugins, it also covers the case where a subagent was interrupted mid-run: the parent turn has already ended normally while it waits, so a naive check sees nothing to resume and the whole subagent tree dies silently; this plugin detects the interrupted child and wakes the parent instead. Single host file, zero external dependencies, seven config constants.
description.zh: 轻量级的 dsh 崩溃恢复：重启后识别上一轮被强杀中断的会话，注入一条「先核实现状再动手」的续跑指令，避免盲目重做已有副作用的操作。只认真正的崩溃信号（turn/end 的 reason 为 interrupted，由 session repair 冷读时合成），因此不会把用户主动取消、限流或模型报错误判为可续，也就不需要错误分类、退避策略或配置界面。与通用自动续跑插件相比，它还覆盖「子代理执行中被中断」的盲区：此时父代理的轮次已正常结束（正在等待子代理），常规判定看不到任何可续对象，整棵子代理树会静默死掉；本插件会识别出被中断的子代理并唤醒父代理。单个宿主文件、零外部依赖、七个配置常量。

description.en: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
description.zh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

description.en: Context observability and control for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session token analytics, session-level budget/prompt/tool controls, and optional agent scaffolds. It reuses the official tokenMeter, compaction, systemPrompt, and tools.restrict seams; monitoring is read-only.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文可观测性与控制：跨会话 token 分析、会话级预算/提示词/工具控制，以及可选的 Agent 脚手架。复用官方 tokenMeter、compaction、systemPrompt、tools.restrict seam；监控只读。

description.en: Delete sessions into a searchable recycle bin, then restore them or remove them permanently from the DSH sidebar. Desktop only: install it into the DSH Desktop profile; it supports the Desktop Web GUI only.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话删除到可搜索的回收站，再从侧栏恢复或彻底删除。仅限 DSH Desktop：需装进 Desktop profile，且只支持 Desktop 的 Web GUI。

description.en: Switch the language of the agent's thinking/reasoning process (chain-of-thought): 简体中文, English, Русский, Français, Deutsch, Español, 日本語, 한국어 and more, or auto-follow the system locale. Adds a Settings → General row, a system-prompt instruction (per-prompt assembly, applies to new sessions), and the /thinking-language command.
description.zh: 切换智能体思考过程（推理/链式思考）的语言：支持简体中文、英文、俄语、法语、德语、西班牙语、日语、韩语等，或跟随系统界面语言（自动）。新增「设置 → 通用」中的思考语言选择行、系统提示词注入（每次组装提示词时求值，新会话生效）与 /thinking-language 命令。

description.en: DSH plugin: hands a long session over to a fresh session in the same workspace on /handoff or at a token threshold, carrying the preset, model, permissions and plan mode across; the brief is written by the session's own model and the switch waits for a step boundary instead of interrupting running work.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过 /handoff 或会话累计 Token 阈值把长会话交接给同工作区的新会话，并继承 preset、模型、权限与 Plan 模式；交接简报由会话自身的模型撰写，切换在 Step 边界发生，不中断正在执行的步骤。

description.en: Read-only viewer for archived DSH sessions: browse the archive with workspace filtering and title/ID search, and read the transcript folded from the durable log — including messages from before a context compaction — without unarchiving.
description.zh: 已归档 DSH 会话的只读查看器：按工作区筛选、按标题/ID 搜索，不取消归档即可阅读从完整日志折出的对话——包括上下文压缩前的原文与工具调用。

description.en: Adds a session_rename tool so an AI can retitle the DeepSeek Harness session it is running in.
description.zh: 新增 session_rename 工具，让 AI 能重命名自己所在的 DSH 会话。

description.en: A sidebar panel that moves, rebuilds, merges, renames and deletes whole workspaces: a move re-publishes each session log with the new directory in its header, repairs the workspace record, refreshes the cached title, and every card shows whether its sessions are running or only open.
description.zh: 侧栏里的工作区面板：迁移、重建、合并、重命名、删除整个工作区——迁移会用新目录的 header 重新发布会话日志，修复工作区归属并刷新标题缓存，每张卡片标明会话是在运行还是仅被打开。

description.en: Type @ in the composer to reference another conversation: pick a historical session and inject its compacted context into the current prompt.
description.zh: 输入 @ 引用另一个对话：选择历史会话，将其压缩总结注入当前提示词。

description.en: Adds header buttons that move a started session into another workspace and switch the Agent preset of a session that already began.
description.zh: 在会话头部添加按钮，可把已开始的会话迁移到另一个工作区，或切换已开始会话的 Agent 预设。

description.en: Session health-check: mechanically mines session logs into structured problem tickets (retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupted turns, token waste) over the official session-query seam; works standalone.
description.zh: 会话体检：基于官方 session-query 接缝，机械挖掘会话日志为结构化问题工单（重试环/工具错误簇/中断回合/Token 浪费）；可独立安装使用。

description.en: Read Google Antigravity SQLite conversations in DeepSeek Harness and import them as native sidebar sessions with list, read and import tools plus slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 Google Antigravity 的 SQLite 会话并导入为原生侧栏会话，提供 list／read／import 工具与斜杠命令。

description.en: One-click context compression for the dsh web GUI: a 压缩 button on the session title bar summarizes the whole conversation into a few lines, opens a new session in the same workspace seeded with the summary, and switches to it — the original session stays untouched.
description.zh: dsh 网页端一键上下文压缩：会话标题栏「压缩」按钮把整段对话总结成几句话，新建同工作区会话以摘要为第一条消息并自动切换，原会话原样保留。

description.en: Auto-continue for the dsh web GUI: when a local model hits its output-token cap and the max-tokens notice appears, the plugin automatically queues a short continue message so the reply keeps flowing — dual-source truncation detection, loop protection, and no UI.
description.zh: dsh 网页端输出上限自动继续：本地模型输出到上限出现提示时，自动发送「继续」让回复接上；双源截断检测、防死循环保护，完全无 UI。

description.en: Move archived DSH conversations to trash in batches, restore or permanently delete them, and view DSH and workspace storage use, file types and large files.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中批量将归档会话移入回收站、恢复或永久清除，并查看 DSH 和工作区的存储占用、文件类型与大文件。

plugins.name: billion-context

description.en: The official billion-context plugin: a context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).
description.zh: billion-context官方版：上下文压缩插件，兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token)和超长会话(数月级别几十亿token单会话)。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to billion-context.inline
uses literal IP 1.3.101.112 for network access

description.en: One header button stops running turns, goals and background jobs and writes the plan to disk; after a restart the same button picks the work up again.
description.zh: 会话头一个按钮停掉回合、目标和后台任务，写盘；重启后同一个按钮把工作接回来。

description.en: Condenses DSH session titles from a full sentence into a short verb-free phrase, aiming for under five words.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话标题从一句话精简为不含动词的短语，目标五个词以内。

description.en: Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 中内联编辑与撤回自己的消息——惰性、无痕，带版本翻页器与会话级草稿持久化。

description.en: Permanently deletes a session from the sidebar, waiting for a running turn to stop and cascading to its subagent sessions.
description.zh: 从侧边栏永久删除会话：等待正在运行的回合停下，并级联删除其子代理会话。

description.en: Channel-grouped session view injected into the sidebar — Workspace/Channels tabs with live-running dots, archived grouping, orphan tagging, built purely on official extension surfaces and serving as the RFC-0001 reference implementation.
description.zh: 侧边栏注入的按渠道分组会话视图——工作区/Channels 双标签、运行中绿点、归档折叠与孤儿工作区标注，完全基于官方扩展面实现，兼作 RFC-0001（discussion #3897）的参考实现。

description.en: Deletes a session from the sidebar session menu after a confirmation dialog, removing its log directory, projection-cache record and workspace/pin/archive accounting; registry calls are timeout-guarded so a stuck workspace registry cannot block the removal.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单里二次确认后删除会话：移除会话日志目录、投影缓存记录与工作区/置顶/归档记账；所有注册表调用带超时保护，工作区注册表卡住也能完成删除。

description.en: Tree view of a DSH conversation: editing an old message forks the thread, every version lives in one tree while the sidebar keeps a single entry, branches can be renamed, and a branch can be promoted to a session of its own.
description.zh: DSH 会话的树形视图：编辑一条旧消息即从那一刻分叉，所有版本住进同一棵树、侧栏始终只有一条，分支可以改名，也可以把某个分支提升为独立会话。

description.en: Off-peak message scheduler: turn on valley mode and the composer queues your messages until DeepSeek off-peak hours (half price), then auto-injects them into the session and gets replies. Native-look composer, hotkeys (Enter queue / ⌘+Enter send now / Esc exit), per-session toggle persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 谷时发送调度器：开启谷时模式后输入框消息排队至 DeepSeek 谷时窗口（半价）自动注入会话并得到回复。原生外观输入条、快捷键（Enter 入队 / ⌘+Enter 立即发送 / Esc 退出）、按会话记忆的开关，重启不丢。

description.en: Splits the DeepSeek Harness sidebar into independently scrollable Pinned and Recents panes, and hides pinned sessions from Recents.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏分成可独立滚动的置顶栏和最近栏，置顶过的会话不再出现在最近列表里。

description.en: Ask about one sentence without derailing the chat: select a passage in a Web conversation, comment, and the session's own model answers in a small thread beside it while the main chat stays untouched. The replier can read the session, the working directory and, if you turn it on, the web, but changes nothing. Commented passages stay highlighted with a badge that shows unread replies, and Send to chat hands a thread to the agent when you want it acted on.
description.zh: 针对一句话提问，不打断主对话：在 Web 对话中选中一段文字发表评论，会话自己的模型在旁边的小线程里作答，主对话不受影响。回复者可以读取会话、工作目录，开启后也可联网，但不做任何修改。被评论的段落保持高亮，徽标提示未读回复；需要 Agent 动手时，「发送到对话」把线程交给它。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.
description.zh: 输入框一键提示词增强——把草稿改写为结构化提示词（角色与目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边界条件），支持前后对比、回填与一键撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。

description.en: Annotate text in replies, diffs, or files and send notes with a message for ordered replies and source navigation; combines quoting and annotation in the Host selection toolbar.
description.zh: 选中正文、Diff 或文件文字后批注并随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照并支持定位；引用与批注共用宿主的选中文字工具栏。

description.en: Read-only monitor for local DSH sessions: live task board, per-session tails, blocking reply wait, Markdown export, and optional IM push via dsh-im. Requires Python 3 with the zstandard package; IM push additionally needs the dsh-im plugin.
description.zh: 只读的本机 DSH 会话监视器：实时任务看板、会话事件尾随、阻塞等待回复、Markdown 导出，可选配合 dsh-im 推送 IM。需要 Python 3 与 zstandard 库；IM 推送需另装 dsh-im。

description.en: Shows a DSH session as a conversation canvas — every turn is a node, any turn forks a real child session, and a compacted context folds into one green node you can keep talking from; the left rail groups canvases by DSH workspace and renames them in step with the session titles.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话画成一张对话画布：每轮问答是一个节点，任意节点都能分叉出真实的子会话，压缩过的上下文收成一个绿色节点、可以从它继续对话；左侧栏按 DSH 工作区分组列出画布，重命名与 DSH 自己的会话标题同步。

description.en: Provides Codex-style session message folding for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的会话消息折叠。

description.en: Gives the agent four session tools: start a new session, send a message into another one, list sessions with their state, and wait for another session's turn to finish so its answer can be read back.
description.zh: 给 AI 四个会话工具：新建会话、给别的会话发消息、列出会话及其状态，以及等另一个会话这一轮跑完并把它的回答取回来。

description.en: Permanently deletes a conversation, optionally together with the documents and attachments it created.
description.zh: 彻底删除对话，可选择同时删除该对话创建的文档与附件。

description.en: Creates a throwaway workspace with its own folder and session, manages running ones from a sidebar panel, and moves finished folders to the system Trash.
description.zh: 一键创建一次性临时工作区（独立文件夹、独立工作区与会话），在侧边栏统一管理，用完把文件夹移入系统废纸篓。

description.en: Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin, from where they can be restored.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行菜单中增加「删除对话」与「批量删除」；删除的对话及其子代理会话移入 Windows 回收站，可从回收站还原。

description.en: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.
description.zh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。

description.en: Pins a selected passage of a finished user or assistant message as source text and keeps it in the model input across context compaction: each pin is recall-on-demand by default, or can be moved to a neutral resident system-prompt section or an emphasised highlighted one. Selections are aligned back to the source text with source-exact, source-normalized or rendered fidelity, and each of the three levels has its own character budget.
description.zh: 把已定稿的用户或助手消息里划选的一段原文钉住，让它在上下文压缩后仍留在模型输入中：每枚钉子默认按需补回，也可改为 resident（中性常驻系统提示词）或 highlight（强调常驻）。选区会以 source-exact、source-normalized 或 rendered 三级保真对回源文本，三个级别各有独立的字符预算。

description.en: Search and read local Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and DSH sessions from the 1session CLI or DSH Web history browser.
description.zh: 通过 1session 命令行或 DSH Web 历史浏览器搜索和读取 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Grok 与 DSH 的本地编程会话。

description.en: Delivers a queued chat message at the next step boundary instead of waiting for the whole turn to end, without aborting the model call already in flight; aborting is an opt-in mode rather than the default.
description.zh: 把排队中的消息提前到下一个 step 边界送达，而不是等整个 turn 结束；默认不打断已经在跑的模型调用，打断是显式开启的模式。

description.en: Permanently delete one conversation (archived or not) from its sidebar row menu, including its log, projection cache, archive state, and reminders.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单里彻底删除单个对话（含已归档），同时清理会话日志、投影缓存、归档状态与提醒。

description.en: Floating todo panel for DSH sessions with server-side cross-device persistence and pending-task badges in the session list.
description.zh: 会话内悬浮待办面板，支持服务器端跨设备持久化及会话列表未完成任务图标。

description.en: Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.
description.zh: DSH 会话回收站：侧边栏删除图标、多选还原与彻底删除、活跃会话保护。

description.en: Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.
description.zh: 会话行右键菜单与侧边栏会话管理：置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、导出、复制工作目录/会话 ID/深链，在资源管理器或新窗口打开。

description.en: Beta 0.2.0-beta.2 for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only, for Host-owner use. Search original user and assistant text in the current session or same-directory workspace, with source coordinates and context. Non-owner session authorization is not supported.
description.zh: 0.2.0-beta.2 仅支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，面向宿主所有者使用。在当前会话或同目录工作区搜索用户与助手原文，查看来源坐标和上下文；不支持非所有者身份的会话级授权。

description.en: Goal Map shows a read-only goal-to-plan progress route, session mindmap and step list using reported plan progress, without starting tasks or model calls. Beta.2 supports DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 or 0.2.1-rc.2, with Node.js >=24.
description.zh: 目标进展图以只读流程图展示目标到计划的进展路线、会话思维导图与步骤列表，按已报告计划计算进度，不启动任务或模型调用。Beta.2 支持 DSH Web 0.2.0-rc.2 或 0.2.1-rc.2、Node.js >=24。

description.en: Inlines an image block as base64 only in the one request where it first appears, and marks that same block offloaded on every later request so DSH's own image-offload projection renders it as the placeholder text carrying the read-only local path. An occurrence is keyed by session id, message id, content-tree path and attachment id, and a request is only counted after it produces its first chunk, so retries do not count as sent. Requests carrying a purpose are neither rewritten nor counted, a later read_image of the same file is a new occurrence and inlines once more, and only that request's copy is rewritten, so nothing is written back to the session.
description.zh: 同一张图片只在它第一次出现的那一次请求里以 base64 内联；之后的每次请求都携带被标记为 offloaded 的同一个块，由 DSH 自带的图片 offload 投影渲染成带本地只读路径的占位文字。记账键是会话 id、消息 id、内容树路径与 attachment id 的组合，且请求产生第一个 chunk 之后才记账，因此重试不会算作已发送。带 purpose 的辅助请求既不改写也不记账；事后再对同一文件调用 read_image 算一次新的 occurrence 并重新内联一次；插件只改写该次请求的副本，不写回会话。

description.en: A pannable conversation tree for DeepSeek Harness: inspect any turn in a side panel, return to its branch, and fork a new branch from any turn; continuous turns fold into a single node.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可平移会话树：在侧栏查看任意一轮、回到该分支，并从任意一轮分叉；连续轮次会折叠成一个节点。

description.en: A lock button on every sidebar session row; archiving a locked session through the client-side workspaces.archiveSession — the ⋮ menu, or another plugin calling the same client method — is refused with a notice, the lock list is persisted on the host, and a host route bulk-archives inactive sessions while always skipping locked ones. Calls that reach the host registry directly are not intercepted.
description.zh: 侧栏每个会话行上的锁按钮：锁定的会话经客户端 workspaces.archiveSession 归档时（⋮ 菜单，或其它插件调用的同一方法）会被拦下并提示；锁清单持久化在宿主侧，另有批量归档不活跃会话的宿主路由，永远跳过已锁定的会话。直接打到宿主注册表的调用不在拦截范围内。

description.en: Filters tool outputs, prunes stale context and discloses skills on demand for DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1.
description.zh: 为 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 过滤工具输出、裁剪陈旧上下文并按需披露技能。

description.en: Message and attachment editing with save-only updates, forked regeneration, and a version timeline for DSH desktop.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 桌面端的消息与附件编辑，支持原地保存、分支重生成和版本时间线。

description.en: Cross-agent monitoring board for local AI agent sessions (cursor-ide, claude, codex, copilot, kimi and dsh itself) with session timelines, and message injection behind a default-off two-phase confirmation gate.
description.zh: 跨 agent 看板监控本机 AI agent 会话（cursor-ide、claude、codex、copilot、kimi 及 dsh 自身），提供会话时间线，并可经默认关闭的两阶段确认门注入消息。

description.en: Session deep links, full session export (markdown/JSON), approved cross-session messaging with pairing, and team roster, rotation and recovery tools for multi-session work.
description.zh: 会话深链、全量会话导出（markdown/JSON）、带配对的跨会话消息投递，以及团队 roster / 换届 / 恢复工具。

description.en: Adds a manual "mark as unread" action to workspace session rows, and retires itself once the harness exposes the same capability.
description.zh: 给工作区会话行补一个手动「标记为未读」；官方支持同能力后自动退休。

description.en: Turn rail on the left edge of the conversation: one tick per user message, hover to preview, click to jump (auto-loads earlier pages when the turn is unloaded), plus an active-turn highlight and a scroll-position indicator.
description.zh: 对话区左缘的轮次刻度滑轨：每条真实提问一根短横线，悬停预览、点击跳转（目标未加载时自动翻页），带当前位置高亮与滚动进度条。

description.en: Delete a complete closed turn (question + answer + tool calls) from a DeepSeek Harness session, without deleting the session.
description.zh: 删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的一整轮对话（提问 + 回答 + 工具调用），不影响会话本身。

description.en: Permanently deletes one session from the sidebar session menu, or several at once from the "..." menu beside the sidebar section title: tick sessions in the list (running ones are refused), then confirm in a dialog — log directory, workspace membership, live Host instances and the client list row are all cleaned. The same "..." menu also collects the session search and view options. It also sweeps rows whose log is already gone, and retries a user message or an assistant reply from the button right of Copy.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话行的「…」菜单里永久删除单个会话;也可从侧栏标题旁的「⋯」菜单进入批量删除:在列表里勾选会话(运行中的不能删),再在确认弹窗里一次删掉 —— 会话日志、工作区归属、宿主内存实例、客户端列表行一并清理。同一个「⋯」菜单还收着会话搜索与视图选项;另可清理日志已不存在的残留行,用户消息与 AI 回复的复制按钮右侧各有「重试」。

description.en: ACP adapter that drives DeepSeek Harness from Obsidian Agent Client (and other ACP clients): list, resume, fork and delete sessions, switch the model per session, preview a one-line summary, import external ACP sessions, and pull Obsidian Agent Client conversations into dsh native session storage. Requires DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3.
description.zh: 在 Obsidian Agent Client（及其他 ACP 客户端）里驱动 DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 适配器：会话 list / resume / fork / delete、按会话切换模型、一句话摘要预览、导入外部 ACP 会话，并可把 Obsidian 侧会话拉进 dsh 原生会话库。需 DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3。

description.en: Import a public DeepSeek or Doubao chat share link into a DSH workspace as a static, resumable session.
description.zh: 把公开的 DeepSeek 或豆包对话分享链接导入 DSH 工作区，成为一个静态、可续聊的会话。

description.en: In-place conversation rewind in the same session window without forking (Claude Code /rewind semantics): a per-message ↶ button cuts the model context back to any user message, with an optional Claude-Code-style file restore from disk-persisted before-backups.
description.zh: 同一会话窗口内的 in-place 对话回退（不 fork，Claude Code /rewind 语义）：每条消息的 ↶ 按钮把模型上下文回退到任意用户消息，可选用磁盘持久化的 before-backups 还原工作区文件。

description.en: One read-only index of every local AI-agent session (Codex, Claude Code, DSH, Trae, or any JSONL source) grouped by project, plus an append-only shared board for decisions and handoffs so switching agents leaves no context gap.
description.zh: 把本机所有 agent 的会话历史合并成一份按项目分组的只读索引，并附一块只追加的共享上下文板，让换 agent 时不丢结论。

description.en: Preview conversation context and selectively keep, summarize, or omit exchange groups before applying persistent compaction through Harness session services.
description.zh: 预览会话上下文，按对话分组选择保留、摘要或省略，确认后通过 Harness 会话服务持久化压缩结果。

description.en: Manage DSH conversations: one cross-workspace table with batch archiving, body search over message text, and recycle-bin deletion you can undo.
description.zh: DSH 对话管家：跨工作区总表与批量归档、正文搜索，以及可恢复的回收站式删除。

description.en: Lists every DSH workspace and its conversations on a settings page with checkboxes, and deletes the checked conversations or whole workspaces together with their session logs, projection caches and workspace registrations.
description.zh: 在设置页列出所有工作区及其对话，勾选后按勾选内容删除对话或整个工作区，并一并清理对应的会话日志、投影缓存与工作区注册。

description.en: Task-scoped Workspace to Task to Session control center for DSH Web, with Session boards, archived conversation viewing, and bounded long-term memory shared across linked Sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的任务级 Workspace 到 Task 到 Session 协作控制台，提供 Session 看板、归档对话查看，以及在关联 Session 之间共享的有界长期记忆。

description.en: Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.
description.zh: 从任意层级的已完成回答持续创建隔离分支，主会话始终不受影响。

description.en: Asks before archiving a DeepSeek Harness session, then backs the archived copy up to a directory you choose — one folder per session with the session log, its attachments and the metadata, plus a manifest, a restore note and a Markdown ledger. Adds a right-sidebar browser for archived sessions and a double-click restart button (Windows only; disabled while a session is running).
description.zh: 归档 DeepSeek Harness 会话前先确认，归档后把副本自动备份到你指定目录：每个会话一个文件夹（会话日志、附件、元数据），另附清单、还原说明与 Markdown 台账。并提供右侧栏的已归档会话浏览器与双击重启按钮（仅 Windows；会话运行中时按钮禁用）。

description.en: Session handoff & context management: structured handoff documents (export/resume/status) so a fresh session can continue seamlessly, plus active context pruning (acp_* tools via the official compaction API with model-authored summaries).
description.zh: 会话交接与上下文管理：导出/恢复结构化交接文档，让新会话无缝续接；并集成了主动上下文裁剪（acp_* 工具，基于官方 compaction API 与模型自写摘要）。

description.en: DSH WebUI session query navigation with a faint conversation-edge rail, a hover list of real user queries, and click-to-jump back to the matching bubble.
description.zh: DSH WebUI 会话提问导航：对话区右缘淡色短横线，悬停列出真实用户提问，点击跳回对应气泡。

description.en: Starts chats without selecting a project folder, with a persistent per-chat working directory and native Harness session storage.
description.zh: 无需选择项目文件夹即可开始对话，为每次聊天分配持久工作目录，并沿用 Harness 原生会话存储。

description.en: Tag each session as a long-term or short-term task, record the agent mode it was created with, and auto-archive it once the archive window you set elapses.
description.zh: 为每个会话标记长期任务或短期任务、记录创建时的 Agent 模式，并在你设定的归档时间窗结束后自动归档。

description.en: Desk-to-desk tickets between sessions on one machine. A session says which desk it belongs to by putting a number prefix in its title; a ticket names one desk and is taken by the first session of that desk to start working, so the desk is the address and a ticket is not delivered to a session that is just passing by.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上会话之间的「单子」：会话用标题里的编号前缀表明自己属于哪张桌；单子投给某张桌，由那张桌最先开始干活的那个会话取走 —— 桌是地址，路过的会话不会收到它。

description.en: Find keywords in the current conversation or across every session, with highlight and jump.
description.zh: 在当前对话或所有会话里按关键词查找，命中可高亮、可跳转。

description.en: Adds custom task groups and an activity bell to the sidebar: drag sessions into or out of a group, reorder them by hand, collapse groups, and see running, waiting and unread sessions in one place.
description.zh: 给侧边栏加上自定义任务分组和活动铃铛：把会话拖进拖出分组、手动排序、折叠分组，并在一处集中查看运行中、待确认和未读的会话。

description.en: Edit a sent message to rewind and branch the conversation from that turn, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse every branch in a turn-level version tree.
description.zh: 编辑已发送的消息即可从该轮次回溯并分叉对话，用气泡下方的计数器切换版本，并在轮次级版本树中浏览所有分支。

description.en: Start and detach standalone chats without a mandatory workspace, keeping DSH's native workspace UI intact.
description.zh: 无需强制绑定工作区即可新建和分离独立会话，同时保留 DSH 原生的工作区界面。

description.en: A simple DSH queue panel for editing, removing, steering, reordering, and bulk removal.
description.zh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

description.en: Moves an existing DeepSeek Harness conversation into another workspace from the sidebar menu: the transcript and title carry over, a new workspace folder can be registered in the same dialog, and the original session is archived and restorable.
description.zh: 从侧边栏菜单把已有的 DeepSeek Harness 会话移动到其他工作区：会话记录与标题一并带过去，可在同一对话框里登记新的工作区文件夹，原会话归档且可恢复。

description.en: Prompt library stored in the plugin config, with a Settings page and a composer picker: the ticked prompts are injected into every model step of that session, and a subagent inherits the selection of its nearest ancestor session.
description.zh: 提示词库存放在插件配置中，含 Settings 页面与输入框选择器：勾中的提示词注入该会话的每一步模型调用，subagent 继承其最近祖先会话的选择。

description.en: Multi-folder workspace: a durable global linked-folders list plus per-session on-the-fly linking (link_folder/unlink_folder), managed from the Web sidebar with a native folder picker.
description.zh: 多文件夹工作区：全局链接文件夹列表 + 会话内临时挂载（link_folder/unlink_folder），侧边栏管理并支持系统选目录。

description.en: Permanently delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness UI: a header trash button and a sidebar menu item behind a risk-consent dialog, plus a workbench_session_delete agent tool. Started from lsz-asd/dsh-plugin-session-delete and maintained independently since v0.4.0; do not install it alongside that plugin, since both register the same workbench_session_delete tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里彻底删除会话：会话头部垃圾桶按钮与侧栏「…」菜单项（带风险确认弹窗），另提供 workbench_session_delete agent 工具。从 lsz-asd/dsh-plugin-session-delete 派生并自 v0.4.0 起独立维护；请勿与上游同装，两者都会注册同一个 workbench_session_delete 工具。

description.en: Automatic session titles for DSH: names a session from its first prompt plus the first assistant reply ("project｜task") instead of truncating the prompt. Replaces the built-in session-title provider through a bundle patch, adds an "AI rename" entry to the session row menu with a preview dialog, and a settings page for the provider/model, the naming rules and a diagnostic event log. 49 unit tests.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话自动起名：首轮问答结束后用「项目｜具体任务」命名，而不是把提问截断。通过 bundle patch 顶替内置标题 provider，在会话行「…」菜单里加「AI 重命名」（先预览再应用），设置页可改 provider/model、命名规则并查看诊断日志。49 个单元测试。

description.en: Settings-page manager for archived DeepSeek Harness sessions: restore an archived session to its previous workspace position or permanently delete it (direct physical deletion, no backup layer). Adds a red permanently-delete item to the session context menu and three agent tools. Deleting an open session works immediately; the leftover in-memory copy is hidden behind an archive tombstone until the next restart.
description.zh: 在设置页管理已归档会话：恢复或彻底删除（直接物理删除，无备份层）。会话菜单新增红色彻底删除项，附三个 agent 工具。已打开的会话也能立即删除，残留内存副本以归档墓碑隐藏、重启后自动清理。

description.en: Conversation history rail on the left edge of the chat: each tick is one real user request, hover to preview its text, click to jump to that turn.
description.zh: 会话历史迷你滑轨：对话区左侧垂直居中的短横线，每条横线代表一条真实用户请求，悬停预览请求内容，点击跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: Tiered compaction hub: replaces the single 80% compaction cliff with a configurable ladder (default 30/50/70/90) whose tiers escalate from gentle to maximum consolidation laws, folds a deterministic keyword index into every checkpoint so facts accumulate across cycles, and summarizes through a model chain — primary plus up to 3 fallbacks, each with its own reasoning effort. Adds a Compaction module sub-tab and a Settings card; toggling off always restores stock compaction.
description.zh: 分级压缩中枢：把单一的 80% 压缩阈值换成可配置的阶梯（默认 30/50/70/90），逐级加强压缩力度；每次检查点都折叠入确定性关键词索引，让事实跨周期累积；摘要走模型链——主模型加最多 3 个回退，各自独立推理档位。附带 Compaction 模块子标签页与设置卡片；关闭插件始终恢复原版压缩。

description.en: Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new conversation.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏归档目录：将会话恢复到原工作区槽位、删除会话日志，或从用户消息修改并分支为新会话。

description.en: Manage native archives by workspace, with search, unarchive, and permanent deletion of individual sessions or fixed batches.
description.zh: 按工作区管理原生归档，支持搜索、取消归档、单项和固定范围批量永久删除。

description.en: Archives sessions that have gone unused for longer than a set number of days (5 by default), skipping archived, pinned, and protected ones — a session context-menu item marks a single session as protected, a small shield shows it on the row, and a General settings field changes the threshold.
description.zh: 把长期没动过的会话自动归档（默认 5 天，已归档、置顶、标记「不自动归档」的跳过）——会话右键菜单可标记单条会话，行首显示盾牌，通用设置里改天数。

description.en: Loop guard for DeepSeek Harness: detects and stops repeated output mid-stream, prunes and compacts context, then automatically resumes the task without a restart.
description.zh: 模型死循环防护：自动检测并拦截重复输出，停止循环后恢复任务继续执行，无需重启或手动拉起；支持配置故障中断策略与救援参数。

description.en: Browse and search provider models to choose an independent summary model for DSH Standard mode, or let Auto follow the conversation route; save extra automatic pressure-compaction passes, while manual compaction attempts one useful pass. Includes Chinese/English theme-aware settings; start a new Standard-mode conversation after installation to apply the configuration.
description.zh: 按供应商浏览、搜索并选择 DSH 标准模式的独立摘要模型，或用 Auto 跟随对话路由；保存自动压力压缩额外次数，手动压缩只尝试一次有用压缩。提供中英文主题适配设置，安装后新建标准模式会话以应用配置。

description.en: Holds a drafted message until the main agent is idle, no subagent is running and no background job is live, then sends it. Each hold takes an optional send time and a choice to queue, wait or steer, and lives on the host with its attachments so a restart does not lose it.
description.zh: 暂缓发送一条消息，直到主智能体空闲、没有子智能体在运行、也没有后台任务，然后再发出。每条暂缓可以设置发送时间，并选择排队、等待空闲或立即插话，消息与附件都保存在宿主端，重启也不会丢失。

description.en: Mirror dsh session events to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or SQL Server while retaining local session files.
description.zh: 将 dsh 会话事件镜像到 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 或 SQL Server，同时保留本地会话文件。

description.en: Names a session from its first prompt, and streams AI title suggestions into the rename dialog.
description.zh: 用首条消息为会话命名，并在重命名弹窗里流式给出 AI 标题建议。

description.en: Edit a sent message in place and resend it as a forked chat, keeping the original: change the text, remove, reorder or add images and files, with session image limits checked before sending (the first message opens a new chat in the same workspace). Also @-references pending images by file name, drag-reorders composer attachments, copies messages together with their images, and adds copy, download and drag-to-composer for images in the conversation.
description.zh: 在消息位置编辑已发消息并以 fork 出的新聊天重发，原聊天保留：改文字、删图、调整图片顺序、补图片或文件，发送前按会话图片限制校验（第一条消息在同一工作区新开聊天）。另外支持输入 @ 按文件名引用待发送图片、拖动调整输入框附件顺序、复制消息时连图片一起复制，以及对话图片的复制、下载和拖进输入框。

description.en: Per-workspace session defaults for DeepSeek Harness: save the Agent preset, permission preset, model, reasoning effort, Chat work-details level and collapse timing per workspace; new or reused blank sessions in that workspace start from them.
description.zh: 按工作区保存 DeepSeek Harness 的会话默认值：模式、权限预设、模型、推理强度、Chat 工作步骤展示与收起时机；在该工作区新建或复用的空白会话自动应用这些值。

description.en: Keeps running, finished-but-unopened and currently open sessions pinned above the workspace groups in the DSH Web sidebar, and lets any session or workspace be pinned there from its own "..." menu.
description.zh: 把运行中、跑完未点开和当前打开的会话固定在 DSH Web 侧栏工作区分组上方，并可从任意会话/工作区的「...」菜单里全局置顶。

description.en: Resumes a dormant DSH session on demand: when a session is not currently live, it is resumed from disk with the provider/model route it last used, so external integrations (chat bridges, schedulers, webhooks, other plugins) can deliver into it instead of failing with "that session is not alive". Exposes an HTTP endpoint, a wake_session tool and a ctx.wakeUp service. Resuming only reads history back into memory and spends no model request by itself.
description.zh: 按需叫醒休眠的 DSH 会话：当前没活着的会话会带着它上次用的 provider/model 路由从磁盘 resume 回来，让 QQ 通道、定时任务、webhook、别的插件这类外部集成能正常投递，而不是撞上「那间会话现在没活着」。提供 HTTP 端点、wake_session 工具和 ctx.wakeUp 服务；resume 只把历史读回内存，本身不消耗模型请求。

description.en: Delete one finished turn from a DSH conversation without deleting the session — the trash button next to the last assistant reply removes the question, that reply and the tool records of the turn from the conversation surface and from the model context, while the session id, title, later turns and the append-only log stay; the removal is written as a persistent tombstone, so it survives a reload.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话中删除一个已结束的轮次而不删除会话本身——最后一条助手回复旁的垃圾桶按钮会把该轮的提问、这条回复与工具记录从对话界面和模型上下文中移除，而 Session id、标题、之后的轮次与只追加日志保持不变；删除以持久 tombstone 记录，刷新后依然生效。

description.en: A DSH conversation workspace: turn actions, provenance quotes, local notes and summaries, in-conversation find, focus lock, and per-workspace command buttons.
description.zh: DSH 会话工作台：轮次操作、引用出处、本地笔记与摘要、会话内查找、专注锁和多工作区命令按钮。

description.en: Adds an /if slash command to DSH: the first line is a condition and the remaining lines are an instruction. A fork subagent that inherits the session tools, system prompt and message history judges the condition and answers YES or NO, and only on YES is the instruction sent to the main agent as an ordinary user message, while a NO sends nothing. The condition, judge prompt and verdict never enter the main transcript. While the agent is busy the command queues with ordinary messages, editable, removable and steerable from the queue panel, and a setting switches to the 0.2.x background mode. The judge runs read-only, and falls back to a one-shot model call over a plain transcript when the host has no context-inheriting fork provider. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 and later (verified on 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1) and Node.js 20.3 or later.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 /if 斜杠命令：第一行是条件，其余行是指令。由继承当前会话工具、system prompt 与消息历史的 fork 子代理判断条件并回答 YES 或 NO，只有 YES 才把指令作为一条普通用户消息发给主 agent，NO 则什么都不发送；条件、判断用的 prompt 与判断结果都不会写进主会话。模型工作时命令与普通消息一起排队，可在队列面板里编辑、删除、插话，设置里可切回 0.2.x 的后台模式。判断以只读方式运行，宿主没有可继承上下文的 fork provider 时回退为一次性模型调用加纯文本记录。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上（已在 0.2.1-rc.5 与 0.2.2-rc.1 验证），需 Node.js 20.3 或更新版本。

description.en: Automatically resumes active goal sessions after DSH restart; long-running tasks continue without a manual nudge.
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑有活跃目标的会话,无需人工说「继续」。

description.en: Browses checkpoints produced by dsh-checkpoint-rewind as a timeline of time nodes and shows per-file line diffs between any two of them, with trace replay from session logs (no snapshot producer needed) and preview-first workspace rollback with single-shot undo, via /diff and /rollback commands, a JSON HTTP API, and a GUI panel.
description.zh: 把 dsh-checkpoint-rewind 产生的检查点变成时间线时间节点，任意两节点之间逐文件行级 diff；可从会话日志重放 trace 区间差异（无需快照生产者）；支持预览式工作区回滚与一次性撤销。提供 /diff、/rollback 命令、JSON HTTP API 与 GUI 面板。

description.en: Archive, restore, permanently delete, and move DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces from one unified settings panel.
description.zh: 在统一设置面板中归档、恢复、彻底删除并跨工作区移动 DeepSeek Harness 会话。

description.en: Take over context compaction on both the manual and the automatic path, each runnable by a compaction model (falling back to a second model, or used directly) or by a mechanical fold that builds the summary card locally with no model call; the fold goes through the same official compaction transaction, so the replaced events stay in the append-only session log under their sequence numbers. It adapts code from dsh-compact-saviour and takes the mechanical fold from dsh-ledger-compact (both MIT) — install it instead of dsh-compact-saviour, not alongside it.
description.zh: 接管上下文压缩：手动与自动压缩都可选用模型压缩（支持备用模型兜底或直接使用备用模型），或选用机械折页——在本地把旧历史整理成摘要卡，不调用模型、不消耗 token；折页走官方压缩事务，被替换的原始事件仍以原序号留在只追加的会话日志里。代码改编自 dsh-compact-saviour、折页算法取自 dsh-ledger-compact（均为 MIT），请替代 dsh-compact-saviour 安装，不要两者同装。

description.en: Cross-session messaging across one or all workspaces: session_list finds top-level sessions by recency or title, session_send_message steers or queues attributed messages (cold-resuming stored sessions when needed), session_create opens titled top-level sessions with an initial task, and a client renderer displays relayed messages as user-side chat bubbles naming the sender session.
description.zh: 跨会话与跨工作区通信：session_list 按最近活跃或标题查找顶层会话，session_send_message 投递带来源标注的消息（支持 steer/queue，按需冷恢复已存储会话），session_create 新开带标题的顶层会话交代任务，前端渲染器把转发消息显示为标注发送方会话标题的用户侧气泡。

description.en: Moves an existing DSH session to another agent preset through a previewable five-section handoff, preserving the source session and either pausing the target for confirmation or continuing immediately.
description.zh: 通过可预览的五段式交接，将已有 DSH 会话迁移到另一个 Agent Preset；保留源会话，并可让目标会话暂停等待确认或立即继续。

description.en: Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.
description.zh: 给 Windows 文件管理器加右键项：把文件夹设为 DSH 工作区并切换到它，DSH 未运行会自动拉起。

description.en: A floating button beside the chat that opens a searchable list of all questions in the session for quick jumps, with smooth hover-open/close behavior.
description.zh: 对话旁的悬浮按钮，打开当前会话全部提问的可搜索列表并快速跳转；悬浮弹出/移出平滑关闭。

description.en: Attach tags to sessions and search sessions by tag in the Web settings panel.
description.zh: 为会话添加标签，并在 Web 设置面板中按标签搜索会话。

description.en: Adds a "Delete" item to the sidebar session menu with a confirmation dialog, then hard-deletes the session.
description.zh: 在侧边栏会话菜单添加「删除」项，经二次确认后硬删除该会话。

description.en: Search and manage archived and unarchived chats with read-only previews, tags and notes, workspace archiving, ZIP backups, origins and branches, manual residual-chat checks and automatic update checks. Retains legacy Recycle Bin recovery without automatic cleanup.
description.zh: 管理已归档与未归档会话，支持搜索、只读预览、标签备注、工作区归档、ZIP 备份、来源分支、手动残留会话检查和自动检查更新；保留旧回收记录恢复，停用自动清理。

description.en: Browse archived DSH sessions grouped by workspace in Settings, filter and search them, restore one in a click, or delete a session log from disk for good.
description.zh: 在设置里按工作区分组浏览已归档会话，可筛选、搜索、一键恢复，或把会话日志从磁盘彻底删除。

description.en: Lists archived sessions, previews their content, restores them to the original workspace, and adds an optional archive confirmation.
description.zh: 列出已归档会话、预览内容、恢复到原工作区，并提供可选的归档二次确认。

description.en: One-off two-person password chat in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: end-to-end encrypted (the server sees ciphertext only), with images and screenshots, fully cleared on end.
description.zh: 装进 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏的一次性双人密码聊天：端到端加密（服务器只见密文），支持图片与截屏，结束即彻底清理，关掉 DSH 即消失。

description.en: In-conversation keyword search for the current session: pages the history back to its first window before matching, then highlights every hit and scrolls to the one you pick.
description.zh: 当前会话内的关键词搜索：先把会话历史翻回最早一页再匹配，命中处高亮并滚动定位到所选项。

description.en: Opens a native side conversation forked from the active conversation, with live parent context, Inline & Spill chain recall, relay to the main conversation, and usage stats.
description.zh: 把当前对话分叉成独立的原生侧边会话，注入父对话实时上下文，支持 Inline & Spill 链式召回、把请求或结论 relay 回主对话，并显示用量统计。

description.en: Adds a delete-session action that permanently removes session logs, workspace entries and archives.
description.zh: 增加删除会话的操作，永久移除会话日志、工作区条目与归档。

description.en: Cross-session messaging: sends text into another session in the same workspace, and creates new top-level sessions.
description.zh: 跨会话投递：往同工作区的另一个会话发消息，并可新建顶层会话。

description.en: Keeps a turn from closing on an unfinished reply: a stream guard turns silent truncation into an in-step retry, and a completion protocol asks the model to declare how each turn ended.
description.zh: 避免轮次停在「话没说完」或「只写了下一步计划」上关闭：把静默截断的流转成同一步内可重试的失败，并要求模型在每轮结束时声明收尾方式。

description.en: Archived-session management with single and batch deletion, native workspace registry cleanup, and deferred file cleanup while the host holds session resources.
description.zh: 归档会话管理，支持单条与批量删除、原生工作区登记同步，以及宿主持有会话资源时的延迟文件清理。

description.en: Turns a dsh session into a redacted idea and delivers it end-to-end encrypted to friends on DeepHub; received ideas land as new sessions.
description.zh: 将一条 dsh 会话提炼为脱敏后的思路，端到端加密投递给 DeepHub 上的朋友；收到的思路落为一条新会话。

description.en: Auto-compaction that writes a handoff note first: as a session approaches a token threshold it asks the model to save a project checkpoint into the workspace, then optionally starts a fresh session seeded with a continue instruction and parks the old one. The note must be written within the current compaction cycle and its conclusions section must actually change, so a stale or merely touched file cannot slip through.
description.zh: 压缩前先落档：会话接近 token 阈值时先要求模型把项目状态写进工作区的检查点文件，再按需开新会话接力、把旧会话停用。落档必须写于本次压缩周期内，且「这一轮定下的结论」那节正文确实变了——旧档、或用 cat 追加一行刷时间戳的档都过不了关。

description.en: Delete DSH sessions into a restorable recycle bin — subagent sessions follow their parent as one tree, batch archive, restore and purge are supported, and only purge destroys bytes.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话删入可恢复的回收站——子会话随其父会话作为一棵树处理，支持批量归档、恢复与彻底删除，只有彻底清除才会真正销毁数据。

description.en: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to automatic backoff retry, model switch, resume after context compaction, or a stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and a full activity log.
description.zh: 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动续上，规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由——自动退避重试、换模型继续、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知，规则可视化编辑，全程活动日志。

description.en: Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom display names, resume session, fork into a new session, basic session stats, plus a fork-relationship graph showing how conversations derive from one another.
description.zh: 会话收藏夹：把任意会话收藏进浏览器收藏夹式的管理面板——左侧会话行一键收藏/星标，主面板支持文件夹分门别类、备注、自定义显示名、一键继续会话、Fork 新会话、会话基本统计，外加一张清晰展示会话派生关系的 fork 关系图。

description.en: Smart session titles for DSH: after each conversation turn an independent auxiliary LLM call summarizes the full user+assistant transcript into a title that follows the session's real topic instead of echoing the first message; the first message is titled instantly, failed built-in titles auto-retry on later turns, manual renames are never overwritten, and subagent/fork sessions are skipped.
description.zh: 会话智能标题：每轮对话结束后用一次独立的辅助 LLM 调用对「用户消息+助手回答」的完整转写做总结，标题跟随会话真实主题而不是复述第一句话；首条消息即时出题、内置标题失败在后续轮次自动重试、用户手动改名绝不被覆盖、自动跳过子代理与 fork 会话。

description.en: Deletes a whole DSH session or one completed turn from the session log: confirmation dialog, live-agent teardown, path and identity checks, pre-rewrite backup, and later turns renumbered.
description.zh: 删除整个 DSH 会话，或只删除会话中某一轮已完成的对话：带二次确认、运行中 Agent 安全停止、路径与身份校验、改写前备份，后续轮次自动顺延。

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive or delete one session, archive/delete all sessions in a workspace, and restore archived sessions from the settings page — archiving backs up workspace metadata and restoring recreates deleted workspace registrations automatically.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理：可归档或删除单个会话，工作区行可归档全部、恢复已归档或删除全部会话，设置页可查看/恢复/删除已归档会话；归档时备份工作区信息，恢复时自动恢复原工作区，原工作区被删除时自动重建。

description.en: Project and session organization with multi-folder groups, attention summaries, grouped chat search, native folder picking, pinning, favorites, ordering, and an archive center.
description.zh: 项目与会话整理工具：支持多文件夹组合、待处理状态摘要、分组聊天搜索、原生目录选择、置顶、收藏、排序和归档中心。

description.en: Adds a handoff button to every assistant message that writes an LLM-summarized handoff document of the current conversation into the workspace handoff/ directory.
description.zh: 为每条 AI 回复添加 Handoff 按钮，点击后由 LLM 将当前会话总结为交接文档，写入该会话工作区的 handoff/ 目录。

description.en: Flat list of recent sessions across every workspace, with last-question previews, time buckets, full-text search, and notes that resurface when you reopen a conversation. Fork of huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions with a native-style UI rewrite; both register the same recent-sessions panel id, so do not install both.
description.zh: 跨所有工作目录的扁平会话列表：显示最后一句提问、按时间分组、全文搜索，并让随手记下的想法在重开会话时提醒。是 huangxp12/dsh-recent-sessions 的重写分支，界面按原生样式重做；两者注册同一个 recent-sessions 面板 id，不要与原版同装。

description.en: Export the append-only session log as human-readable Markdown or HTML, grouped by trajectory source.
description.zh: 把 append-only 会话日志导出为按轨迹来源分组的可读 Markdown 或 HTML。

description.en: Lists Claude Code and Codex sessions in the DSH Workspace browser, where they can be opened, continued, pinned, renamed and archived, with terminal, file and git tabs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 工作区侧边栏列出 Claude Code 与 Codex 会话，可打开、继续对话、置顶、重命名和归档，并附带终端、文件和 Git 标签页。

description.en: Adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, behind a confirmation dialog that reports the log size, running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders bound to the session; the id is then released from the live, archive and workspace registries, so the row stays gone on refresh instead of folding back in.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单中增加「永久删除会话」的操作，并附带确认对话框：对话框会说明会话日志大小，以及与该会话绑定的进行中轮次、子代理、后台任务和提醒；删除后 id 会从 live、归档与工作区登记中一并释放，因此刷新列表时该行不会复活。

description.en: Archives the sessions of a workspace when its folder is deleted or moved away, or when its registration is removed, and restores them when it returns: unarchives only the sessions it archived itself, re-attaches every member its ledger recorded (including sessions you archived manually, whose archived state is left unchanged), and adopts ungrouped sessions whose working directory is that workspace path.
description.zh: 工作区文件夹被删除或移走、或工作区登记被移除时，自动归档其会话；目录或登记回归时恢复：只取消归档本插件归档过的会话，把台账记过的全部成员挂回分组（含你手动归档的会话，且不改其归档状态），并把「无项目」里工作目录正是该工作区路径的会话归位。

description.en: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.
description.zh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。

plugins.name: dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin

description.en: Renders image, video, and audio paths and URLs from DSH conversations inline, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中内联显示图像、视频和音频路径及 URL，并提供工作区受限的本地读取与可选的 ComfyUI 代理。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to host:8188

description.en: Zero-UI-overhead DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically classifies conversation intents and names sessions with clean emoji prefixes (optimize, fix, feature, explore, etc.).
description.zh: 零 UI 侵入的 DeepSeek Harness 会话意图自动分类命名插件，新会话自动生成前缀图标与主题（优化、修复、功能、探索等 8 类意图）。

description.en: Temporary workspace for DSH web — one click creates a throwaway workspace whose conversations are deleted at the next restart (immediately or after a delay, optionally behind a confirm dialog). Pin a temp workspace to keep it: its files move into the folder you pick, its title becomes that folder's name, its conversations migrate, and a real host-level restart re-indexes them.
description.zh: DSH web 临时工作区：一键创建一次性工作区，下次重启自动清空其全部对话（可立即/延迟删除，也可先弹确认框）。点击图钉可永久保留——文件移入所选文件夹、以文件夹名为标题、对话一并迁移，并触发真实的宿主级重启重新索引。

description.en: Per-task disk-space ledger in the sidebar with opt-in reclamation of unowned junk; session logs are never trimmed.
description.zh: 侧栏里的每个任务磁盘占用账本，可勾选回收无主垃圾；会话日志绝不被裁剪。

plugins.name: deepseek-web-import

description.en: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversations into DeepSeek Harness as resumable sessions, from a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 从设置页把 chat.deepseek.com 网页端对话导入为 DeepSeek Harness 会话，导入后可在其中继续对话。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Manages archived DSH chats with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 归档聊天，支持聊天记录搜索、恢复和二次确认的安全永久删除。

description.en: A session manager for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: per-workspace category trees with drag-and-drop ordering, pinned sessions hoisted above the categories (or kept inside them, switchable from the view options), an archive partition, and a delete bin where removed sessions keep their logs and can be restored or purged in batches. The host half owns the category and recycle data, the web half renders it; both ship as one plugin. Maintained fork of ht719/dsh-session-categories ported to current DSH, with pinning, archive partition and delete bin added; it cannot be installed together with the original.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的会话管理插件：按工作区划分的分类树，支持拖拽排序；置顶会话可抬到分类上方，也可按开关留在所属分类内；另有归档分区，以及删除回收站——删掉的会话日志留存，可恢复或批量彻底清除。宿主半边掌管分类与回收站数据，网页半边负责渲染，两者作为一个插件一起发布。本插件是 ht719/dsh-session-categories 的维护分叉，已移植到当前 DSH 并新增置顶、归档分区与删除回收站；不能与原版同时安装。

description.en: Delete sessions with a 5-second undo and a recycle bin, plus an archive view to browse and unarchive, for the DSH Web GUI. Ships on npm as `@wsxwj123/dsh-session-manager`.
description.zh: 会话删除（5 秒可撤销 + 回收站）与归档视图（查看、取消归档）。npm 包名 `@wsxwj123/dsh-session-manager`。

description.en: Adds delete and batch delete to the session list menu; sessions go to the Windows Recycle Bin instead of being erased, and the files a session produced are listed first so you decide whether to remove them together.
description.zh: 在会话列表菜单里加删除与批量删除：会话移入 Windows 回收站而不是永久删除，删除前先列出该会话产出过哪些文件，由你决定是否一并清理。

description.en: Session manager for the DSH Web UI: browse all and archived sessions, restore/unarchive, delete with two-step confirmation, and preview conversation content from the Settings panel.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话管理插件：在设置页查看全部与已归档会话，支持恢复（取消归档）、二次确认删除与对话内容预览。

description.en: Automatic, versioned backup of your DeepSeek Harness home — sessions, memories, settings and the profile plugin tree — to a private git remote you own, with commits and pushes on a schedule and every failure surfaced in the DSH log.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 home 自动、带版本地备份到自己的私有 git 仓库：会话记录、记忆文件、设置与 profile 插件树都会按计划提交并推送，失败一定会在 DSH 日志里报告。

description.en: Adds a permanent-delete row to the sidebar menu of archived sessions, removing the session log, its projection cache and its workspace registration.
description.zh: 在侧栏「已归档」会话的菜单里加一行彻底删除，一次清掉会话日志、投影缓存与工作区登记。

description.en: Makes Enter insert a newline in the DSH 0.1.5 Web composer while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter keeps submitting messages.
description.zh: 让 DSH 0.1.5 Web 输入框使用 Enter 换行，同时保留 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 提交消息。

description.en: Regenerates a session's title from its last 10 user prompts using the model the session itself last used, with an editable preview before the new title is written back.
description.zh: 根据会话最近 10 轮用户 prompt，用该会话最近一次使用的模型重新生成标题，预览确认后写回。

description.en: Auto-archives sessions idle beyond a configurable threshold, with safety guards (never touches live or running sessions), plus a full archived-session management UI: list, unarchive, safe delete and content preview.
description.zh: 按闲置天数自动归档冷会话（带运行中、驻留会话安全护栏），并提供归档会话管理面板：查看、释放、安全删除与内容预览。

description.en: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强插件 - 工作区会话数展示、归档会话面板（支持恢复/删除）、拖拽移动会话到其他工作区。

description.en: Adds edit and delete to your own message bubbles: editing truncates the following turns and resends the new text, deleting removes the message and those turns, and either can optionally roll back the recorded file changes of the removed turns (refusing when a file has changed since). The sidebar keeps a single conversation.
description.zh: 给自己的消息气泡加「编辑 / 删除」：编辑会截断其后的轮次并重发新内容，删除会移除这条消息及其后的轮次；两者都可选择同时回滚被移除轮次记录到的文件改动（文件之后又被改过则拒绝回滚）。侧边栏始终只保留一条会话。

description.en: Per-session clock injection with durable idle-gap tracking: tells the agent how long it has been since this particular conversation last spoke, which the host's time context (last message only) cannot.
description.zh: 给指定会话授时，并给出「距上次对话过去多久」。补上宿主时间上下文只算「距上一条消息」、无法按会话开关的缺口。

description.en: Applies personal prompts and system-prompt edits at the global level or on a single session, so each session can work with its own prompt setup without touching the others.
description.zh: 可以自行选择在全局范围或单独会话中增加个人提示词、修改系统提示词来工作，各会话互不影响。

description.en: Context governance for DSH: folds oversized tool results, collapses the tool surface and keeps the prompt cache warm, so long sessions stop getting more expensive.
description.zh: 上下文治理：折叠超大工具结果、收拢工具面、稳住提示词缓存命中，长会话不再越聊越贵。

description.en: Automatically starts a fresh Web session near the context limit with the last complete turn, and adds an editable additive whale-maid persona with on-demand reload.
description.zh: 接近上下文上限时自动创建新 Web 会话并只转移最后一个完整回合，同时提供可编辑的追加式鲸鱼娘人格与按需重读工具。

description.en: Cross-workspace DSH messaging and sender navigation, with bounded same-workspace context and opt-in local Claude Code messaging.
description.zh: 支持 DSH 跨工作区消息与发送方导航、同工作区受限上下文，以及可选的本机 Claude Code 双向通信。

description.en: Repair DeepSeek Harness sessions that refuse to load, with a sidebar Session surgeon overlay and dry-run repair.
description.zh: 修好打不开的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，侧栏「会话医生」可查看对话并默认 dry-run 修复。

description.en: Session map: a fork-tree canvas over DSH sessions, and a Settings page that clones a Git repository into a new workspace. The canvas is reachable from a session-header toggle and two right-side tabs, and from a conversation tab that is off by default; it starts on the current session's own tree, growing downward, with wheel pan, Ctrl/⌘-wheel zoom, a subagent-session filter and a per-session overview of turns, steps, model time, tool time, output tokens and running state. The clone page takes a repository address and a remembered parent directory with a native folder picker, offers a per-clone shallow switch (off by default), runs git clone on the host, and registers the cloned directory as a workspace.
description.zh: 会话图谱：把 DSH 会话画成一张 fork 树画布，另在设置里加了一个「从 Git 克隆」页——填仓库地址、选存放目录（会记住上次选择、带原生目录选择器），按需打开浅克隆，克隆完自动添加为工作区。画布可从会话头部开关和右侧栏两个标签页打开，对话标签页默认关闭；默认只铺开当前会话所在的那棵树、自上而下生长，支持滚轮平移与 Ctrl/⌘ 滚轮缩放、隐藏子代理会话，另有一个会话概览页列出轮次、步骤、模型耗时、工具耗时、输出 token 与运行状态。

description.en: Organizes task materials and supports session handoffs across workspaces.
description.zh: 整理任务资料，支持跨工作区的会话交接。

description.en: Removes the queued prompts a DSH fork child inherits from its parent, so the first turn in a new branch runs the prompt typed there instead of the parent's next one.
description.zh: 清除 DSH 分支会话从 fork 父会话继承来的排队提问，让分支的第一轮执行你在分支里输入的问题，而不是父会话的下一句。

description.en: Inline preview for \[图片: path] image bridge markers: after the marker renders, the image shows in chat automatically, keeping long instructions out of the conversation.
description.zh: 图片桥接内联预览:对话中 \[图片: 路径] 标记渲染后自动显示图片,长指令不留在对话里。

description.en: Injects SOUL, IDENTITY, AGENTS, and TOOLS into Claw session prompts. Hard dep (install together or single install fails): dsh-claw-permissions.
description.zh: 把 SOUL、IDENTITY、AGENTS、TOOLS 注入 Claw 会话提示词。硬依赖（需同装，否则单装会崩）：dsh-claw-permissions。

description.en: Registers named Claw agents, isolates them from the official workspace sidebar, and provides settings plus a global new-agent template. Hard deps (install together or single install fails): dsh-claw-policy, dsh-claw-observability, dsh-claw-permissions.
description.zh: 登记具名 Claw Agent，与官方工作区侧栏隔离，并提供设置页和全局新建模板。硬依赖（需同装，否则单装会崩）：dsh-claw-policy、dsh-claw-observability、dsh-claw-permissions。

description.en: Session row menu extras for DeepSeek Harness: pin sessions, copy session id, export structured Markdown, and permanently delete sessions.
description.zh: 会话行菜单增强：置顶会话、复制会话 ID、导出结构化 Markdown、弹窗确认后永久删除会话。

description.en: Composer control for the automatic context-compaction threshold. A 20%-80% slider rewrites the running BasicCompactionEngine config per step, shows current usage, context window and the effective trigger line, and compacts immediately when the threshold drops below current usage and the agent is idle.
description.zh: 输入框旁的上下文自动压缩阈值控制器：20%-80% 滑条按 step 重写运行中 BasicCompactionEngine 的配置，显示当前用量、上下文窗口与实际触发线；阈值降到当前用量以下且 Agent 空闲时立即压缩。

description.en: A searchable, workspace-grouped multi-select panel over DSH conversations for batch delete, archive and pin, with Shift-range and Ctrl-add selection.
description.zh: 为 DSH 对话加入可搜索、按工作区分组的多选面板，支持 Shift 范围选择与 Ctrl/Cmd 追加选择，然后批量删除、归档或置顶。

description.en: Real session deletion with trash and restore, archived cleanup, and batch delete from settings.
description.zh: 真正删除会话：回收站可还原、归档清理、设置页批量删除。

description.en: Delete sessions for real from the dsh sidebar (local logs and projection cache included, subagent and fork children cascade) and manage workspaces and ungrouped sessions, with an optional daily cleanup of ungrouped sessions.
description.zh: 在 dsh 侧栏真正删除会话（连带本地日志与投影缓存，子代理与 fork 子会话级联）并管理工作区与未分组会话，可选每天定时清理未分组会话。

description.en: Adds a trash for DSH sessions: nothing expires automatically. Delete or batch delete moves sessions there, where you can read, restore, or permanently delete them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话加上回收站。增加删除会话、多选批量删除会话功能，删除的会话会被移至回收站。回收站内的会话可恢复，也可彻底删除；彻底删除就是永久删除，之后不可恢复，也不会自动过期。回收站内可以查看会话正文，方便区分会话。

description.en: Keeps DSH session titles in DATE | CATEGORY | NAME with turn-aware auto-retitle, a settings page, and hover duration/cost/token stats.
