description.zh: 把 DSH 会话标题固定为「日期 | 分类 | 名称」，支持回答后自动重算、设置页，以及悬停查看耗时/估算成本/token。

description.en: Generates a structured handoff card so a near-full conversation continues in a fresh zero-context session: /handoff writes the card with self-incrementing titles, pins it to the top of the sidebar and prepares the new session once the context nears its threshold.
description.zh: 用 /handoff 生成交接卡，让快满的对话在全新零上下文会话里接着跑：标题自动递增编号、卡片在侧栏置顶，接近阈值时自动备好新会话。

description.en: Fork of harness-session-delete that adds Delete to the native session action menu and a recycle-bin page with search, sort, workspace grouping, message preview, batch restore, and per-workspace permanent purge; active sessions are protected.
description.zh: 在原生会话操作菜单中加入「删除」，并提供支持搜索、排序、工作区分组、消息预览、批量恢复与按工作区彻底清除的会话回收站；活跃会话受到保护。

description.en: Save whole turns — the question plus the full answer — as plain Markdown inside the session workspace, promote the good ones into a cross-project personal knowledge base, and let the model search it on demand. No database and no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把整轮问答（问题 + 完整回答）存成工作区里的纯 Markdown；把值得留的提升进跨项目个人知识库，模型可按需检索。无数据库、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Replacement session-title provider that compresses oversized or code-heavy first prompts before calling the model (in the tested DSH version the built-in provider rejects inputs above 4096 bytes without a model call) and waits for a real task instead of titling a greeting. Titles use the session’s own provider and model by default and manual titles are protected; title rules cover a character cap, an optional date affix, style, language and exclusion words, plus a per-session lock. Also re-titles stored sessions in bulk, with a progress overlay that keeps running after Settings is closed.
description.zh: 会话标题 provider 替换插件：先把过长或代码密集的首条 Prompt 压缩再调用模型（实测 DSH 版本的内建 provider 在超过 4096 bytes 时直接拒绝、不调用模型），遇到纯问候则等待真正的任务。默认使用该会话自身的 provider 与 model，保护人工标题；标题规则支持字数上限、可选日期前后缀、风格、语言与排除词，并可按会话锁定标题。还可批量重优化历史会话标题，进度浮层在关闭设置页后继续运行。

description.en: Recall, edit-and-resend and regenerate, plus in-conversation versioning: a timeline of every rewind, artifact rollback (git-first, snapshot fallback), a fork map of explored paths, session lineage, and a real-time watchdog that snapshots the log at the first sign of concurrent writes. Edits auto-stop the running agent (official cancel/whenIdle) so rewinds never corrupt the durable log or break /compact.
description.zh: 撤回/编辑重发/重新生成，加上单会话版本化：每次回退的时间线、产物回退（git 优先、快照兜底）、分叉图、会话谱系，以及实时看门狗（并发写入第一时间快照日志）。编辑前自动停止运行中的 agent（官方 cancel/whenIdle），回退不会损坏持久化日志、也不会破坏 /compact。

plugins.name: dsh-nutstore-backup

description.en: Backs up DeepSeek Harness sessions, plugin config and workspace memory to Nutstore (Jianguoyun) over WebDAV, with incremental upload, connection test and one-click restore on a new machine.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话记录、插件配置与工作区记忆通过 WebDAV 增量备份到坚果云，支持连接测试与在新机器上一键恢复。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Session management for DSH: archive, restore and delete persisted sessions, cap how many sessions each workspace keeps, and review disk usage in a size governance panel.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理：归档、恢复、删除持久化会话，按工作区限制会话数量上限，并提供体积治理面板。

description.en: Session handoff for DeepSeek Harness: the session menu creates a successor session that rebuilds the old session's memory, tasks and rules through an eight-section takeover packet, with light context via on-demand transcript readback.
description.zh: 会话工作移交：会话行菜单一键移交，新会话按八节交接包复刻老会话的记忆、任务与铁律，原始上下文经按需回读保持轻量。

description.en: Session-row unread mark for DeepSeek Harness: the session menu gains Mark unread and Unmark, pinning a red dot before the session title that survives reload and opening until cleared, both entries disabled while the built-in green finished-unopened dot is present.
description.zh: 会话行未读标记：会话菜单新增「标记未读」「取消标记」，在会话标题前钉一个刷新与点开都不会消失的红点（与系统绿点区分），绿点存在时两项禁用，标记经服务端持久化。

description.en: Export sessions to Markdown/JSON for review, replay, and per-session cost summaries.
description.zh: 会话导出为 Markdown/JSON，便于复盘、重放与单会话成本汇总。

description.en: Injects a fixed system-prompt section so the agent always replies in Simplified Chinese — including the short narration between tool calls — unless you explicitly ask for another language. Applies to every session and preset without overriding the persona.
description.zh: 向系统提示注入固定语言指令，让 Agent 始终用简体中文回复（含工具调用之间的叙述文字），除非你明确要求其他语言；对所有会话与预设生效，且不覆盖 persona。

description.en: Turns a session into a folder in the left sidebar: fork it into an independent branch — full copy, a compressed digest of its memory, or only the opening request — and browse the branches as a tree.
description.zh: 把会话变成左侧栏里的文件夹：可分叉出独立分支（完整复制 / 压缩记忆 / 只继承开头），并以树状浏览。

description.en: One settings card that gives every DSH agent mode its own compaction threshold: it registers <mode>-compact-<ratio> preset copies with compaction-basic.thresholdRatio rewritten, re-registers when the value or the selection changes, and can adopt one copy as the default mode (standard > cordis > minimal > ptc).
description.zh: 一个设置项把压缩阈值铺到所有 Agent 模式：注册 <模式>-compact-<阈值> 预设副本并改写 compaction-basic.thresholdRatio，阈值或勾选变化时重新注册，还可把副本设为默认模式（标准 > 创造 > 极简 > ptc）。

description.en: Session and image management for DSH: a sidebar panel deletes selected sessions together with their on-disk files after DSH has archived them, with multi-select, sub-agent / team-member / whole-family cascade and per-session size; a right-sidebar tab counts a session images and offloads or deletes the selected ones, optionally removing source files and attachment objects from disk.
description.zh: DSH 会话与图片管理：侧边栏多选面板在 DSH 归档后把选中的会话连同磁盘文件一起删除，支持子 agent / 团队成员 / 整族级联与逐个大小统计；右侧栏页签统计会话图片张数并多选摘除，可另行删除磁盘上的源文件与附件对象。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-session

description.en: Routes DSH web search through the current session's model and a self-hosted retrieval backend.
description.zh: 让 DSH 网页搜索改走当前会话模型加自建检索后端。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Session instruction anchor for DeepSeek Harness: the first step of a new session injects a freely composed instruction block as a plugin-sourced message, and it is re-anchored after a summarizing compaction, every N turns, or when metered context pressure crosses a threshold. An /anchor command re-anchors on demand without a model call; a settings page manages the paged preset library, injection order, re-anchor source and character limits.
description.zh: DSH 会话指令定锚：新会话的第一个 step 把自由组合的指令块作为插件来源消息注入，之后在完成压缩、跨过设定轮数、或计量到的上下文压力越过阈值时重锚。`/anchor` 命令可按需定锚且不触发模型调用；设置页管理分页预设库、注入顺序、重锚来源与字数上限。

description.en: Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel (live mode, pinned to original session on switch), rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + persistent header chip (idle / active / tool-wait / stalled). dsh v0.1.2+: fuses with the official TurnNavigatorRail — vector-icon info chips (duration, tool calls, errors, thinking) plus lazy tool distribution inside the official preview card, right-click opens the workbench; the classic piano-key strip is on by default and delegates unloaded-turn jumps to the official auto-load engine; the official rail can be hidden entirely. Settings dialog section with 10 tunable behavior params.
description.zh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、全文检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。会话流标签页嵌入原生会话页：轮次悬浮条、详情并入右栏（实时模式，切换会话可钉住原会话直播）、会话重命名（对齐官方即时同步）、结论摘要行、健康监控与常驻头部胶囊（空闲 / 活跃 / 工具执行 / 疑似卡死四态）。dsh v0.1.2+ 与官方轮次导航融合：官方预览卡内嵌矢量图标信息段（耗时 / 工具调用 / 错误 / 思考 + 工具分布懒加载），右键唤起会话流工作台；经典钢琴键悬浮条默认开启并存，点击未载入轮次委托官方引擎自动加载跳转；可设置隐藏官方导航只留钢琴键。设置弹窗独立分节，10 项行为参数可调。

description.en: Session hotkeys for the DSH Web GUI: switch sessions like browser tabs (positional Alt+1-9, pinned slots, previous/next, new/archive/rename), keyboard model switching via Alt+M, alternate send, Esc focus hand-off, and Alt+W to close or restore a dsh-split-screen workspace — all rebindable with Windows/macOS presets. Verified on DSH 0.1.1 and 0.1.5.
description.zh: Web 会话热键插件：像切浏览器标签页一样用键盘管理会话——Alt+1-9 顺序切换、固定槽位、上/下一个、新建/归档/重命名、Alt+M 键盘切换模型与备用发送、Esc 焦点交接，Alt+W 关闭/恢复 dsh-split-screen 工作区；键位可在面板录制重绑，Windows/macOS 双预设。已适配 DSH 0.1.1 与 0.1.5。

description.en: Chunked compaction for oversized sessions: takes over only when the live context exceeds 85% of the model window (or the request exceeds 4 MB), summarizes the history in 1.5 MB chunks and merges them; smaller sessions keep the built-in compaction.
description.zh: 超大会话分块压缩：仅在实测上下文超过模型窗口 85%（或请求超过 4 MB）时接管，把历史按 1.5 MB 分块摘要再合并；小会话仍走 dsh 自带压缩。

description.en: Adds Activity and Favorites views to the DSH sidebar for running, waiting, unread, recent, and natively pinned sessions across workspaces, while preserving the native workspace tree. Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏添加 Activity 和 Favorites 视图，跨工作区查看运行中、等待回复、未读、最近及原生置顶会话，并保留原生工作区树。仅适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Invites people into one conversation through single-use links with no account: up to 20 guests discuss together and ask the AI, the shared fork runs read-only, and the owner can remove guests or end the share at any time.
description.zh: 用一次性链接邀请别人加入同一段对话，不需要账号：最多 20 位访客一起讨论、一起问 AI，分享用的 fork 以只读权限运行，所有者可以随时移除访客或结束分享。

description.en: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be restored on demand.
description.zh: 用命名任务包住工作过程；任务结束后，在下一个步骤边界把整段消息折叠成一段摘要，原文可随时还原。

description.en: Injects one system-prompt section so the agent's chain-of-thought, planning and tool-invocation reasoning stay in Simplified Chinese. Zero external dependencies - clone and link-install from any local directory, no npm build or publish required.
description.zh: 注入一条系统提示词段落，让 Agent 的思维链、规划与工具调用推理全程使用简体中文；零外部依赖，git clone 后可从任意本地目录 link 安装，无需 npm 构建或发布。

description.en: Material library for dsh: collect a folder, file or note from a conversation, keep it in real folders with tags, browse it Finder-style, reopen the source chat's output in one click. Ships a materials_archive tool plus auto-filing rules: file a task's deliverable once, and every later scheduled run files the new documents by itself.
description.zh: dsh 材料库：把对话里产出的目录、文件或笔记收进真实文件夹并打标签，按 Finder 方式浏览，点一下跳回原始会话。内置 materials_archive 工具与自动归档规则：手动收过一次某任务的成品，之后每次定时任务跑完都会自动把新成品收进同一个文件夹。

description.en: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file.
description.zh: 新会话开始时注入一条很小的接续指针，说明上一个会话是谁、工作区有没有交接文档；没有交接文档时复用 DSH 已有的压缩摘要。

description.en: Edit plain-text user prompts inline and resend them in a new DSH conversation branch.
description.zh: 原位编辑纯文本用户提问，并在新的 DSH 会话分支中重新发送。

description.en: Archive, unarchive, and delete sessions from a settings page.
description.zh: 在设置页中归档、恢复并删除会话。

description.en: Codex-style drag-to-reference for DeepSeek Harness: drag a conversation row from the sidebar onto the chat area and it becomes a native session-reference chip in the composer draft, so you can keep typing around it before sending. Drag a workspace (folder) row instead and the draft gets that folder's path, so a whole directory can be handed to the model. The target session is matched by session id rather than by title, so duplicate or blank titles cannot insert the wrong conversation. The reference cap comes from the host (3 by default) and is read at runtime instead of being hard-coded, so a host-side raise is followed without changing the plugin. If the chip cannot be inserted, the plugin falls back to sending a reference-only message instead of failing silently.
description.zh: Codex 同款拖拽引用对话：把侧栏的会话行拖到对话区，它就变成输入框里一枚原生会话引用 chip，可以继续打字再发送。拖侧栏的工作区（文件夹）行，则把那个文件夹的路径插进草稿，整个目录一起交给模型。候选按 session id 匹配而不是按标题，标题重名或为空都不会插错对话。引用条数由宿主决定（原版 3 条），插件在运行时从宿主读取该上限而不写死，宿主侧调大后自动跟随、不用改插件。chip 插不进时降级为直接发一条只含引用的消息，不会静默失败。

description.en: Guarded context compaction for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the LLM proposes, deterministic guards dispose — eager per-atom shrink (extract/summary/false under verbatim guards) + lazy reference-graph eviction (0-LLM) + byte-exact recall from an append-only log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 守卫式上下文压缩——LLM 提议、确定性守卫裁决：逐原子缩放（verbatim 守卫下 extract/summary/false）+ 引用图延迟剪枝（0-LLM）+ append-only 日志逐字节精确召回。

description.en: When a live session's context passes a threshold, append older messages to a per-conversation folder on disk, then release the oldest finished turns from the model-visible context; the chat transcript and the session log stay untouched.
description.zh: 会话上下文超过阈值时，先把较早的消息追加到按会话归档的文件夹，再把最早的已完成轮次移出模型可见上下文；聊天记录与会话日志保持原样。

description.en: Local-first learning mode: cross-session learning threads with per-source explanations.
description.zh: 本地优先学习模式：跨会话全局学习线程、按来源讲解。

description.en: Side-by-side native chat windows for DSH Web GUI — open several conversations beside the main chat, tile them with one click, minimize into a live status dock, or pop them out into their own browser window.
description.zh: 话分两头：把 AI 对话从「切来切去」变成「并排开火」——每个会话一枚原生小窗，贴着主对话随开随用；一键平铺所有窗口（顶对齐·同高·紧贴），最小化到带实时状态灯的底部停靠条（转圈=工作中·绿色=刚完成·黄色=待审批·灰色=空闲），真浏览器里还能把会话弹出成独立浏览器窗口。

description.en: Export the current session as a readable Markdown file with dialogue only: user messages, assistant text, and ask_user_question answers, from a session-header button or the /md command.
description.zh: 把当前会话导出为可读的 Markdown 文件，只保留对话正文：用户消息、助手文本与 ask_user_question 问答，通过会话标题栏按钮或 /md 命令触发。

description.en: Talk about everything in one chat (the main chat): each message is routed automatically to the topic it belongs to, each topic runs in its own background session with its own context, and existing DSH chat history is organized into topics.
description.zh: 所有事在一个对话框（主聊天）里聊：每条消息自动分到所属话题，每个话题在后台有独立的会话和上下文；已有的 DSH 旧会话也会自动整理、分类成话题。

description.en: Manage archived DSH sessions on Windows with search, batch restore and deletion, AI-assisted file retention, and verified local or network-directory backups.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上管理 DSH 已归档会话，支持搜索、批量取消归档与删除、AI 辅助文件保留，以及经过校验的本地或网络目录备份。

description.en: Folds oversized tool results into on-disk spill files with deterministic head and tail markers, indexes compaction summaries in a searchable ledger, and extracts cross-session memories with per-project scoping. Any folded content is restored byte-for-byte on demand through one tool call.
description.zh: 把超长工具结果折叠为落盘副本并保留 head/tail 标记，为 compaction 摘要建立可检索账本，并按项目作用域抽取跨会话记忆；被折叠的内容可通过一次工具调用原样取回。

description.en: Write each session's summary as a Markdown file in its workspace, with a page to browse, regenerate and delete them.
description.zh: 把每个会话总结成工作区里的 Markdown 文件，并提供一个浏览、重新生成和删除的页面。

description.en: While vibe coding, save an answer you may need later, use Side Chat for a question that suddenly comes up, or open a related conversation for deeper work without losing focus on the current task.
description.zh: Vibe Coding 时，如果突然想到另一个问题，或者看到一段以后还会用到的回答，可以先保存下来、在 Side Chat 里快速问清楚，或另开一个相关会话继续研究，不打断当前任务的开发思路和注意力。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Default System Prompt Management Plugin: Browse, search, and override the final system prompt assembled into each session round within the Web GUI "Settings".
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 默认 System Prompt 管理插件：在 Web GUI「设置」里浏览、检索并覆盖最终装配进每轮会话的系统提示词。

description.en: Elides stale, oversized plain-text tool results from the model-visible session surface once the prompt cache goes cold, replacing each with a stub that keeps the tail lines and any error lines, and reports per-request and cumulative savings in the composer footer.
description.zh: 在提示缓存转冷后，把陈旧、过大的纯文本工具结果替换为带末尾行与错误行预览的 stub，并在输入框下方显示每请求与累计节省量。

description.en: One-stop pack for DeepSeek Harness: the workspace frontend plugin itself plus a pack/ installer for the task list, encoding fallback, LSP/audit and vision plugins. Root stays a normal marketplace-installable plugin.
description.zh: DSH 环境一站式整合包：根目录是可从市场一键安装/更新的工作区美化插件，pack/ 子目录是任务列表、编码兼容、LSP/审查、视觉与白皮书的完整安装器。

description.en: Recovers broken DSH turns: widens the product's own retry budget and renders the wait as a live countdown inside the same step, keeps a truncated output alive inside the same turn, and can open an opt-in continuation round when a turn has already ended; while the composer is empty it hands the send button to that continuation.
description.zh: 修复被打断的 DSH 回合：放大产品自带的重试预算并把等待渲染成同一步内的实时倒计时，输出被截断时在同一轮内续写，回合已结束时可选地新开一轮继续；输入框为空时把「继续」交给发送键。

description.en: Keep this session working until a wall-clock deadline: one button in the composer picks 22:30, +90m, or tomorrow 07:00, and after every finished turn the plugin posts one continuation message so the session keeps working; nothing is posted once the deadline passes. Stops early on a round cap (400), three consecutive failed turns, or four consecutive rounds that called no tool; a manual stop button is always there. The last part of the watch switches to wrap-up wording, sized to at most half the remaining time so a short watch is not entirely wrap-up. Armings persist to $DSH_HOME/nightwatch.json via an atomic write and are re-adopted after a restart. No slash command is registered by default (enableCommand turns one on); the continuation message carries source.kind cordis-host-runner, not user.
description.zh: 把这个会话一直续跑到指定钟点：输入框里一颗按钮选 22:30、+90m 或明天 07:00，之后每轮答完插件补一句继续，让你去睡觉时它接着干；到点之后不再发任何消息。另有三道提前收手的闸——轮次上限 400、连续 3 轮出错、连续 4 轮一个工具都没调；随时可以手动停。快到点时切成收尾语气，窗口最多为剩余时间的一半，免得短守夜整段都在收尾。守夜记录以原子写落到 $DSH_HOME/nightwatch.json，重启后自动认领。默认不注册任何 slash 指令（enableCommand 可开）；补的那句话 source.kind 是 cordis-host-runner 而不是 user。

description.en: Adjusts the context-window percentage at which DSH triggers its native automatic compaction: a slider on the plugin page in the plugins manager sets it from 1% to 100% (default 80%, arrow keys adjust by 1%), and the retained-history budget shrinks with lower thresholds so early compaction is not defeated; the compaction run itself stays with the native engine.
description.zh: 调整 DSH 原生自动上下文压缩的触发阈值：在插件管理器的插件页面用滑块设置上下文占满模型窗口多少百分比时压缩（1%–100%，默认 80%，方向键可 1% 微调）；阈值调低时保留的最近历史预算会随之缩小，以免提前压缩被抵消，压缩本身仍由原生引擎执行。

description.en: Adds a one-click delete-session row to the DSH sidebar session menu: moves the session log and its per-conversation .dsh-sessions artifact directory to the Windows Recycle Bin, with no confirmation dialog.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏会话菜单中加入一键「删除会话」：把会话日志与该对话的 .dsh-sessions 产出目录移入 Windows 回收站，没有确认弹窗。

description.en: Progress tab for the DSH right sidebar: the turn status of the session and the progress long-running tasks reported, in one tab beside the conversation.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的进度页：会话每一轮的状态与长任务上报的进度集中在一个 tab 里，和对话并排看。

description.en: Session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar menu item, a workspace-grouped batch cleanup panel and a session_delete tool (dry-run by default). Deletes session logs, projection cache, workspace-registry references and derived search indexes, and cascades to all subagent sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上会话删除：侧边栏菜单项、按工作区分组的批量清理面板、默认 dry-run 的 session_delete 工具。删除会话日志、投影缓存、工作区注册表引用与派生搜索索引，并级联删除全部子代理会话。

description.en: Adds Copy session ID and permanent deletion of a Conversation's log, projection cache and workspace references to the session row's ⋯ menu, behind a two-step confirm.
description.zh: 在会话行的「⋯」菜单里补上复制会话 ID，以及永久删除会话（日志、投影缓存与工作区引用），删除前有二次确认。

description.en: Keeps a per-turn receipt that later turns do not clear (final todo counts, goal id and phase, end reason, and a fail-closed pass/fail/inconclusive plan verdict), plus a read-only tool to read recent receipts. Stores counts and ids only.
description.zh: 为每个回合保留一张不会被后续回合清空的凭据(回合结束时的 todo 计数、目标 id 与阶段、结束原因,以及 fail-closed 的 pass/fail/inconclusive 完成判定),并提供一个只读工具回读最近的凭据。只存计数和 id。

description.en: Per-turn file changes, per-file diffs and deterministic safety verdicts for DSH sessions, plus a preview-first rewind that refuses when the worktree has drifted since the preview.
description.zh: 逐轮次文件变更与逐文件差异、确定性安全结论，外加 preview-first 安全回退：预览不写盘，确认后才应用，工作区在预览后发生漂移则直接拒绝。

description.en: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
description.zh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

description.en: Workspace manager in the sidebar: a workspace-to-session tree table with name and path search, column sorting, unarchived-session counts, batch archive, session and workspace rename, workspace removal that keeps files and logs, and extra source folders per workspace passed to the agent as context without granting file access; the same operations are exposed as a workspace_manager tool.
description.zh: 侧栏工作区管理：工作区→会话树形表格，支持按名称与路径搜索、按列排序、未归档会话计数、批量归档、会话与工作区重命名、移除工作区（保留文件与会话日志），并可为每个工作区添加额外源文件夹——作为上下文提供给 AI，不授予文件访问权限；同一套操作也以 workspace_manager 工具暴露。

description.en: Two-stage session deletion for DSH on Windows: move a conversation to the recycle bin and restore it to its original sidebar slot; deletion confirmed in two steps to prevent deleting files by mistake, clearing the whole subagent tree, sidebar ledger, projection cache, log lines and exclusive attachments along the way. It also scans the files a conversation actually wrote, adds a file query that pastes the path information into the conversation so an agent can judge which files are safe to delete, highlights them in Explorer, and copies the paths grouped by type. Both this and iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler install under the package name dsh-session-recycler, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 DSH 会话两段式删除：对话移入回收站、可恢复回侧栏原位置；两段确认式删除，防止误删文件，连带整条子代理树、侧栏账本、投影缓存、日志与专属附件。同时能扫出一条对话真正写过的文件，增加文件查询功能，点击后将路径信息粘贴到对话中，通过Agent来判断哪些文件可以删除；在资源管理器中多选高亮，并复制按类型分好的路径。本插件与 iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler 安装后的包名同为 dsh-session-recycler，请只装其中一个。

description.en: Automatically sends a "continue" prompt when a reply is cut off at the output token limit, resuming long answers without manual input; aimed at self-hosted Ollama deployments with small output caps.
description.zh: 回答因达到单次输出 token 上限被截断时自动发送"继续"续写，无需手动操作；面向自部署 Ollama 等小输出上限场景。

description.en: Model-callable compact_agents tool that force-compacts context in every live session (main session, ordinary sub-agents and AgentTeams members alike), queues busy targets and compacts them when the turn ends, reports the shadowed node count and estimated tokens per target, and ships a browser form for the trigger ratio, retained ratio, controlled-phase output budget, auto-continue budget and an end-of-turn pre-compaction ratio that compacts near the trigger line once a turn ends, so a reply no longer opens with a wait for the summarizer.
description.zh: 模型可调用的 compact_agents 工具：强制压缩进程内所有活会话的上下文（主会话、普通子代理、AgentTeams 成员一视同仁），忙的目标自动排队、本轮结束立即补压，逐目标回报被遮蔽的节点数与估算 token 数；浏览器侧在设置里自成一页，提供触发阈值、保留比例、受控阶段输出预算、自动续写次数与「回合结束预压」比例的编辑表单（一轮结束时上下文已接近触发线就先压一次，避免下一轮回答开头空等）。

description.en: One Settings page for every DeepSeek Harness session: browse active and archived sessions by workspace, generate a title from the whole conversation for live or archived sessions, archive or restore, move a cold session to another workspace, and permanently delete an archived session (with its subagent descendants after confirmation).
description.zh: 在设置里管理全部 DeepSeek Harness 会话：按工作区分组浏览活跃与已归档会话，为活跃或已归档会话按整段对话生成标题，归档/恢复，把冷会话移动到其他工作区，并在确认后彻底删除已归档会话（含其子代理会话）。

description.en: Adds a manual, confirm-first title generator: a header button and a session-row menu entry ask a model to summarize the whole conversation, show the proposal in an editable dialog, and rename the session only after you confirm — without registering a title provider or changing automatic titling.
description.zh: 手动触发的「先确认再改名」标题生成器：顶栏按钮与会话行菜单各一个入口，让模型总结整段会话给出标题，在可编辑弹窗里确认后才重命名会话；不注册标题 provider，不影响自带的自动标题。

description.en: Search stored DSH conversation text across all or selected workspaces and sessions, with exact, regular-expression, typo-tolerant or word-internal subsequence matching.
description.zh: 在所有或指定工作区、会话中搜索已存储的 DSH 对话文本，支持精确、正则表达式、拼写容错及词内子序列匹配。

description.en: Maintained fork of dsh-prompt-enhance, brought up to DSH 0.1.7 — the plugin would not even load on current hosts (InputState.imageIds became attachmentIds, so the composer button crashed the input box; settings.get() was removed; /enhance read a session id the agent no longer exposes). Rewrites default to reasoningEffort off, which measured 252 output tokens for a draft where the model default spent 2897, and a Settings page for all 17 fields is bundled. Verified on a real 0.1.7-rc.2 host: activation, a live HTTP enhancement request, /enhance in the GUI, and the Settings page reading and persisting configuration. 204 tests.
description.zh: dsh-prompt-enhance 的维护分支，已适配 DSH 0.1.7——此前的版本在当前宿主上甚至无法加载（InputState.imageIds 已更名为 attachmentIds，输入框按钮会让整个输入区崩溃；settings.get() 已被移除；/enhance 读取了 agent 不再暴露的会话 id）。改写默认使用 reasoningEffort off：实测同一段草稿为 252 输出 token，而模型自身默认档要 2897；并内置覆盖全部 17 个字段的设置页。已在真实的 0.1.7-rc.2 宿主上验证：插件激活、真实 HTTP 增强请求、GUI 中 /enhance 执行，以及设置页读取并持久化配置。204 项测试。

plugins.name: dsh-share

description.en: Share the current session over the LAN as a read-only, token-guarded HTML snapshot with session stats and Markdown rendering.
description.zh: 将当前会话以只读、token 保护的 HTML 快照分享到局域网，附带会话统计与 Markdown 渲染。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 1.1.1.1 for network access

description.en: Timed send for the chat composer: pick a moment and the host delivers the message then. Inside an existing conversation tasks join that conversation; from the new-session screen each task gets its own pre-created session.
description.zh: 聊天输入框的定时发送：选好时刻到点由 Host 真正发出。已有对话内任务排进当前对话；新会话界面每条任务各建一个独立会话。

description.en: Message-level full-text search across DSH sessions via an FTS5 trigram index (user / assistant / steering / tool with per-kind filters), deduplicated results across fork/continued sessions, read-only context preview with auto-scroll to the focused message, one-click jump to the real session, and incremental/full index rebuild with health check; zh/en i18n follows the Host locale service.
description.zh: DSH 会话消息级全文检索浏览器：FTS5 trigram 索引按消息检索（用户/助手/系统注入/工具四类，可按类型筛选），fork/续接会话结果自动去重，只读上下文预览自动滚动定位焦点消息，一键跳转真实会话；支持增量/全量重建索引与健康检查；界面中英双语跟随 Host locale 服务。

description.en: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.
description.zh: 诊断并安全修复损坏的 DSH 会话历史：raw zstd/JSONL 校验、tool-call ID 修复、单槽 pre-repair 备份与恢复、审计记录。

description.en: Replaces rolling narrative summaries with an append-only session index, so early facts survive compaction verbatim and shadowed text stays retrievable by anchor.
description.zh: 把上下文压缩从滚动重写的叙事摘要改为只追加的会话索引：早期事实逐字保留，被压缩掉的原文可按锚点取回。

description.en: Take a breath mid-task: the current step finishes, then it holds. Resume sends no new request and spends no tokens; the timer freezes. Current session only.
description.zh: 零成本“会话暂停”键：不会发出新请求，当前步骤做完后直接挂起，方便添加提示词；继续时不会花费token重发请求；只有点击继续或发新提示词才会继续，子代理结算与定时提醒唤不醒；侧栏加入暂停图标，计时器与动画共同冻结，不计暂停时段，恢复后从冻结前时间继续走；状态区分「暂停中」与「已暂停」；暂停只会作用于当前会话。

description.en: Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.
description.zh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

description.en: Adds a delete row to the menu of an archived conversation only, and after a confirmation removes the session log directory, its projection cache, the archive and pin marks and the workspace booking together.
description.zh: 只给已归档对话的菜单加一项删除，确认后把会话日志目录、投影缓存、归档与置顶标记、工作区记账一起清掉。

description.en: Moves a conversation into another workspace: long-press its sidebar row, drop it on the target workspace, and the session log with its full history is relocated and re-pointed. A plain drag still does the sidebar's own reorder inside one workspace.
description.zh: 把一段对话搬到另一个工作区：长按侧栏里的会话行，拖到目标工作区松手，会话日志与全部历史一起迁移并改指到新目录。直接拖动仍然是工作区内的原生排序。

description.en: Cross-session task delegation for DeepSeek Harness: spawn durable top-level sessions and send them tasks, read or steer them by base62 session alias, and approve their sandbox escalation requests through an approval bridge that refuses destructive deletes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话派活与协同：新建顶层任务会话并投递任务，用 base62 会话别名读取或干预，并通过审批桥批准子会话的沙箱提权——命中破坏性删除一律强制拒绝。

description.en: Session replay view for DSH conversations: replays a session turn by turn at reading pace for prompts and answers while reasoning and tool output stream past, and every prompt is followed by a one-second pause. It can also re-run the original prompts in a new session, and record the replay — screen recording the conversation itself — to a WebM video through a 1280x720 canvas, with no OS screen-recording permission.
description.zh: DSH 会话回放视图：按轮重放一次会话，用户输入与助手正文保持阅读速度，思考与工具输出高速掠过且每段最多 3.5 秒，每条输入后停顿一秒；可一键把原始请求复刻到一个新会话，也可边回放边录制，把回放录屏导出成 WebM 视频（画布 1280×720，无需系统录屏权限）。

description.en: Stops DeepSeek Harness from compacting (summarizing) your conversation far too early. Without it, compaction fires around half-full on smaller context windows; with it, compaction waits until the window is as full as you want (80% by default), settable per provider/model. It only changes when compaction happens — what a summary keeps is still DSH’s decision.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 不再过早压缩对话（把早期内容总结掉）。默认行为下，上下文窗口不大的模型（十几万 token 那种）常常在半满出头就开始压缩；装上它之后，压缩会等你设定的比例（默认 80%）到了才发生，并且可以按 provider/model 分别设置。它只改“什么时候压缩”，一次压缩保留哪些内容仍由 DSH 决定。

description.en: Context rollover: auto-saves a handoff before the context window fills and re-injects it once in the next session segment. Two tools and a settings panel.
description.zh: 上下文滚段：窗口快满时自动存档接续前情，换段后自动注入一次。两个工具 + 设置面板。

description.en: Adds a Global Prompt tab to the conversation view: text you write there is prepended to the top of every session system prompt, and saving takes effect on the next message without a restart.
description.zh: 全局提示词配置：在对话视图新增一个标签页，写进去的内容会加在每个会话系统提示词的最前面，保存后下一条消息即生效。

description.en: Read-only attachment library: lists every image and file attachment stored on this machine, its size, and which conversations (including those in the session trash) still use it, with Show in Finder and Open in Preview.
description.zh: 只读附件库：列出本机保存的所有图片和文件附件及其占用空间，以及哪些对话（包括会话回收站中的）仍在使用它们，并可在访达中显示或用预览打开。

description.en: Session trash: move conversations to a trash instead of deleting them, restore them, or delete them permanently after a second confirmation; a session opened in this run is hidden and moved at the next start.
description.zh: 会话回收站：把对话移到回收站而不是直接删除，可以恢复，或再次确认后永久删除；本次启动中打开过的会话先隐藏，下次启动时再移入。

description.en: Project memory for dsh with native task-system integration: session todos and file reads auto-condense into cross-session task records (task↔file links), so workflows are switchable and resumable without re-contextualizing. Read-time memory (no upfront scan): extracts code symbols, summarizes docs, and cross-links docs↔symbols; optional TS semantic enhancement (auto on when TS installed). Experience notes auto-dedup. Every recall includes a traceable citation. Pure JS, single dep, works out of the box, silent operation, zero overhead.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness提供持久化的项目级记忆。专门针对项目开发，原生融合 dsh 任务系统，会话内任务清单与读过的文件自动沉淀为跨会话任务记录，任务↔文件自动关联——开发工作流可切换、可续接，无需重复梳理整个项目。文档与代码符号在读取时索引，无需全量预扫；针对不同语言的项目，支持可选功能增强。经验笔记自动去重，避免重复记录。所有数据召回附带出处可溯源。纯 JS、单依赖、静默运行、零操作成本。

description.en: Long-term memory on top of mem0 and a local Chroma store: user profile and recalled facts injected through the system prompt, capture at session end, a nightly pass that dedupes, merges paraphrases and resolves contradictions, a persistent topic graph written as Markdown cards, periodic export to a git repository, and a full-page memory UI with search, bulk merge, snapshots and undo. Needs a manual Python venv setup plus LLM and embedding API keys before use.
description.zh: 基于 mem0 与本地 Chroma 的长期记忆：画像和相关事实经系统提示注入；会话结束自动捕获；夜间执行去重、近义归纳与矛盾处理；主题图持久化为 Markdown 主题卡；定期导出到 git 仓库；自带全屏记忆页，支持搜索、批量合并、快照与撤销。使用前需自建 Python 虚拟环境并填入 LLM 与 embedding 两组 API Key。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: agents save, search and update user preferences, facts and project decisions; important entries are injected into later sessions, and a Settings section lists, edits, archives or deletes them.
description.zh: dsh 跨会话记忆：agent 保存、检索并更新用户偏好、事实与项目决策，重要条目自动注入后续会话，设置面板可浏览、编辑、归档与删除。

description.en: Reading archive for dsh: after reading open-source code, capture quick notes or write full deep notes that group into one card per repo / file / symbol, stored as an append-only log of Markdown notes you can open in Obsidian; query your history, browse recent reads, or search your own Obsidian vault and link related notes to a reading record. Nine tools, a /codevault command, and a code-reading skill.
description.zh: 读开源代码后记一笔的档案：快记或深读笔记按 仓库/文件/符号 归并成一张卡，追加式落盘为可放进 Obsidian 的 Markdown 笔记；可检索历史、回看最近阅读，也能搜你自己 Obsidian 里的笔记、把相关笔记挂到阅读记录上。共 9 个工具、/codevault 命令与 code-reading 技能。

description.en: Captures the agent's own self-reported mistakes into a categorised lesson library that is re-injected into the system prompt every turn (each captured draft is confirmed or edited by the user before it is recorded), and adds two conversation-header panels for editing the cross-conversation global prompt and a per-session prompt.
description.zh: 把 agent 自报的错误收进分类经验库，并每轮回注系统提示词（每条草稿都先经用户确认或修改）；同时在对话标题栏提供两个面板，用于编辑跨对话全局提示词与本次对话提示词。

description.en: Six-layer local memory for dsh: captures turns, stages them through an L2 buffer into DL3 summaries via a staging model, injects a stable memory block each turn and replaces chat history with placeholders. Ships five memory tools and a config page.
description.zh: dsh 的六层本地记忆插件：捕获对话轮次，经 L2 巩固、由分流模型沉淀为 DL3 摘要，每轮注入稳定记忆块并以占位符替代聊天历史。附五个记忆工具与配置页。

description.en: Shared Markdown memory for every DSH session: persona, requirements, corrections, lessons, methods, requests, sessions, a method library and ingested documents, mirrored to a second disk with version snapshots and a cross-process write lock; entries move between the main file and a searchable archive by hit frequency and repeated emphasis, and retrieval is keyword co-occurrence plus BM25. Also ships a skills library (SKILL.md playbooks with optional guarded run.mjs execution) and a sticker library: users import their own images, the plugin classifies them by mood, and it automatically sends a fitting sticker at the right moment in the conversation to express emotion.
description.zh: 所有会话共用一份 Markdown 记忆，含人设、要求、指正、教训、方法、请求、会话、方法库与导入文档九个分区；双硬盘镜像、历史快照、跨进程写锁，条目按命中频率与重复强调在主文件与可检索归档之间双向流动，检索为关键词共现加 BM25 排序。另含自有技能库（SKILL.md 操作手册，可选带护栏的 run.mjs 执行）与表情包库：用户自己导入图片，插件按情绪自动分类，并根据对话内容在合适时机自动发送合适的表情包来表达情绪。

description.en: Turns DSH into a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible gateway endpoint that puts one persona and long-term memory in front of every client pointed at it; requires your own DeepSeek API key — the DSH login credential is rejected upstream.
description.zh: 把 DSH 变成本机的 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容网关端点，给指向它的客户端统一套上同一套人格与长期记忆；需自备 DeepSeek API Key（DSH 的登录凭证在上游会被拒）。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: imports Word/PPT/Excel/PDF (text or scanned), EPUB and MOBI/AZW3, builds Markdown parts with page anchors, OCR quality/confidence and column-aware PDF reading order; adds an LLM-maintained wiki layer (schema.md rules, auto index.md, append-only log.md, typed notes with sources and backlinks), adds source-trust labels (high/medium/low) with trust-aware ranking and low-trust warnings, and supports ranked search, cross-KB query, precise reading/editing, and md/jsonl/zip export. MOBI/AZW3 need Calibre; legacy .doc/.ppt need Word/PowerPoint (Windows) or LibreOffice (Linux); scanned-PDF OCR downloads models on first use.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地知识库：导入 Word/PPT/Excel/PDF（文字版或扫描版）、EPUB、MOBI/AZW3，生成带页码锚点、OCR 质量/置信度与 PDF 双栏阅读顺序的 Markdown 分块；并提供 LLM 维护的编译层（schema.md 维护规范、自动 index.md 内容索引、只追加 log.md、带来源与反链的 typed 笔记），支持来源可信度标注（高/中/低）与可信度感知检索、低可信提醒，以及排序检索、跨库查询、精读修订与 md/jsonl/zip 导出。MOBI/AZW3 需 Calibre；旧版 .doc/.ppt 需 Word/PowerPoint（Windows）或 LibreOffice（Linux）；扫描版 PDF 的 OCR 首次使用会下载模型。

description.en: Local three-band memory for DeepSeek Harness: a 24h protection band, query recall and scene replay, injected into sessions without embedding or model calls.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的本地三段式记忆带：24 小时保护带、按话题召回、场景回放，自动注入会话，不调用 embedding 或模型。

description.en: The memory organ of Agent-Body: after 2 minutes of silence it enters light sleep and after 5 minutes deep sleep, where deterministic rules distil real experience into memory cards (pitfalls, playbooks, hotspots, unresolved issues, facts). Incoming commands recall related cards by keyword and inject them into context; cards unused for long decay on a half-life and are archived rather than deleted. It also de-noises body-wide homeostasis warnings: repeats inside a window are counted instead of re-printed, and a warning that keeps recurring without ever healing converges into a known steady-state offset and goes quiet. Consolidation and recall make no model calls.
description.zh: Agent-Body 的记忆器官：静默 2 分钟进浅睡、5 分钟进深睡，深睡里用确定性规则把真实经历压成记忆卡（坑/打法/薄弱环节/未解决/事实），新命令进来按关键词召回并注入上下文；久未使用的卡按半衰期衰减后归档而非删除。同时对全身的稳态告警做降噪：窗口内重复只计数不刷屏，反复出现且从未自愈的收敛成已知稳态偏移并静默。巩固与召回都不调用模型。

description.en: Lets the AI remember what you said across sessions, and know which facts are still current.
description.zh: 让 AI 记住你跨会话说过的事，并且分得清哪些已经过期。

description.en: Project-level memory built around a ledger whose structure the AI designs per project; the plugin only handles detection, injection, write-back, archiving and git. Memories are split by meaning: the active ledger holds current state, the turn journal is append-only, and decisions, the goal tree and lessons are one-card-per-file (with a multi-dimension index over the card folders); the fundamental principles file can be changed only by the user. There is a single compaction mode: before compacting, the AI sorts the work into three buckets - what must stay in context and is re-injected verbatim, what is written to the project's _stash/ for later lookup, and what is dropped. When a conversation is opened in a container workspace holding several projects, it can be locked to one sub-project (the lock lives in the plugin's own home and survives restarts; it leaves no marker in your project). Also an activity log with five levels, where L4 stores the user's own words verbatim (never injected, queryable on demand). Before each compaction a verbatim capsule (user quotes, raw errors, changed files) is written to disk, and both the capsule and its source material survive a restart; a handoff document lets a new conversation resume the previous one. 21 tools, 12 subcommands, 39 settings (one of them switches whether the settings panel or each project's manifest wins). Runs locally, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 项目级记忆，核心是台账：台账的结构由 AI 按项目类型自行决定，插件只负责检测、注入、回写、归档与 Git 配合。记忆按语义分开放 —— 活跃台账是当前状态、回合流水只追加、关键决策/目标树/经验教训各是一卡一文件（另有卡片目录的多维索引表），根本原则只有用户本人能改。压缩方式只有一种（分流后压缩）：压缩前先让 AI 把这一段分成三个桶 —— 留上下文的压缩后逐字注回、以后要查的落进项目 _stash/、已被取代的丢掉。对话建在装着多个项目的总工作区上时，可以把它锁定到某个子项目（锁记在插件自己的家，跨重启保持；不在你的项目里留任何标记）。另有活动日志 L0–L4，其中 L4 逐字存档用户原话（不注入上下文，可按需查）。每次压缩前把用户原话、报错原文、改过哪些文件落盘成一份逐字胶囊，重启后仍能取到（素材与胶囊分别落盘、跨重启保留）；再用交接单让新会话接上上一次的工作。21 个工具、12 个子命令、39 项设置（其中一项可切换「以设置面板为准 / 以项目清单为准」）；纯本地运行，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Fully local long-term memory for dsh: cross-conversation and cross-project, stored as a single JSON file on your machine with no network calls, no model calls and no API key. Ships memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_forget and memory_review tools, keyword-and-tag recall injected before each turn with adjustable ranking weights, Markdown import (including Kun and Hermes Agent formats) and export (native and Hermes Agent formats), and a settings page to browse and edit memories.
description.zh: 纯本地长期记忆：跨对话、跨项目，数据只存本机一个 JSON 文件，不联网、不调大模型、不需要 API key。提供 memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_forget / memory_review 五个工具；每轮按关键词与标签检索并注入相关记忆，检索权重可调；支持 Markdown 导入（含 Kun 与 Hermes Agent 格式）与导出（原生与 Hermes Agent 格式）；设置页可直接浏览与编辑记忆。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only event log, rebuildable tag index, day diaries, semantic layer, trend quarantine, and an offline knowledge-graph panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的分层长期记忆：追加式事件日志、可重建标签索引、按天日记、语义层、趋势隔离，以及离线知识图谱面板。

description.en: Local Obsidian vault as the agent knowledge store, with read-only DSH tools that route status, preference, correction, memory, project, search, and suggest to the matching page.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 库当作 Agent 知识库，并用只读 DSH 工具把状态、偏好、纠错、记忆、项目、搜索与建议路由到对应页面。

description.en: Local, auditable personal memory for DeepSeek Harness: preferences, project conventions, workflows and error lessons persisted as a changelogged JSON file in the workspace, with onboarding, auto project-convention extraction and evidence-backed lessons.
description.zh: 解决 AI 金鱼脑：本地可审计的个人记忆层——偏好、项目约定、工作流与纠错教训，以带变更日志与完整性校验的 JSON 持久化在工作区，支持一次性设置、项目约定自动提取、证据化教训与快照恢复。

description.en: Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供持久化专注板：在会话工作区维护目标、约束与决策笔记，跨压缩与会话存活，支持自动注入上下文、清空归档与可选 Web 面板。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness via the official storage domain: memories persist through ctx.storage (storageDomain table) and are injected into the system prompt through a registered section (memory:recall), with memory_save / memory_forget tools so the agent reads and writes its own memory (maxMemories configurable).
description.zh: 跨会话记忆插件：用官方 ctx.storage 存储域持久化记忆，注册 system-prompt section（memory:recall）把记忆注入模型上下文，提供 memory_save / memory_forget 工具让 agent 自行存取记忆（maxMemories 可配置）。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH stored as plain Markdown. Real user/assistant exchanges are captured into daily session files without a model call; an LLM pass then distils them into memories that are injected into the system prompt each turn. Retrieval is local (CJK bigram + BM25) in three levels — index, summary, full text — so the model only pays for the detail it asks for. Memories carry priorities; P0 and user-written entries are never changed automatically, and forgetting marks an entry stale instead of deleting it, so the whole chain stays auditable in status.md. Six tools cover recall, write, status, extract, feedback and the skill library; when a cluster of memories is ready to become a skill, a card appears at the end of the turn, writes the SKILL.md on click, and installs it only after you approve. Learning is on by default and follows the conversation model; turning the master switch off stops the LLM entirely while capture keeps working. Failures are surfaced in the prompt and in status.md instead of being swallowed. Pure JavaScript, no third-party runtime dependencies beyond the harness packages.
description.zh: DSH 的长期记忆，全部存成纯文本 Markdown。真实的用户/助手对话会零模型调用地落进按天切分的会话文件，再由一轮 LLM 抽取沉淀成记忆，每轮注入系统提示。检索在本地完成（中文二元组 + BM25），分索引、摘要、全文三级，模型只为它真正要看的细节付费。记忆带优先级；P0 与用户手写的条目永不被自动改动，遗忘是把条目标记为 stale 而不是删除，整条链路都能在 status.md 里审计。六个工具覆盖检索、写入、状态、抽取、反馈与技能库；当一组记忆够格变成技能时，回合尾部会出现一张卡片，点一下当场写出 SKILL.md，经你确认后才装进技能库。学习默认开启并跟随对话模型；关掉总开关即完全不用 LLM，而原始问答照样落盘。失败会写进提示与 status.md，不会被吞掉。纯 JavaScript，除 harness 自带包外无第三方运行时依赖。

description.en: Replaces the summarizing context compactor with a handoff note the model writes itself and a fresh window that keeps only the system prompt, the note, and the current turn.
description.zh: 用模型自写的交接便签替代摘要式上下文压缩：换窗后只保留系统提示、便签与当前 turn，并提供预算感知与归档回查。

description.en: Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool that keeps a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged context message — at the start, after a change and after compaction — and a session_search tool that reads earlier chats only after the user approves, with a Memory panel to see and edit what is kept.
description.zh: Hermes Agent 风格的 dsh 持久记忆：一个 memory 工具维护用户档案与模型自己的笔记，并在每段对话的开头、记忆变更后、压缩之后各投递一条带记录的消息；session_search 工具只在用户同意后才会读取更早的会话；另有 Memory 面板可查看和编辑已保存的内容。

plugins.name: graph-memory

description.en: Traceable, searchable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — conversation knowledge as typed graph nodes (TASK/SKILL/EVENT) and typed edges.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可追溯、可检索跨会话记忆：把对话知识沉淀为带类型的图节点（任务/技能/事件）与关系边。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。

description.en: Coding retrospect distilled memory for DSH: distills rejected solutions, pitfalls and constraints from each turn via a local LLM, tags them into MemOS (type:rejected_solution), and boosts weighted recall on coding tasks via agent/pre-step.
description.zh: 编码任务复盘记忆：每轮对话后用本地 LLM 蒸馏被否决方案/踩坑/工程约束，按 type:rejected_solution 写入 MemOS，编码任务时对这类记忆加权召回。

description.en: Proactive associative memory for DSH: zero-prompt recall injected at a fixed boundary, three-layer auto-consolidation, skill crystallization, and Astra-style context management - handoff ledgers and a PLAN whiteboard that survive context-window switches, water-level sensing with an auto-detected model window. Local Markdown storage, model-agnostic, zero deps; lexical 0GB floor with optional semantic tiers.
description.zh: 主动联想记忆 + Astra 式上下文管理：自动唤回（固定边界注入，前缀缓存友好）/自动沉淀/技能固化/交接账本与 PLAN 白板跨窗口续命/水位感知（窗口自动适配当前模型）。本地 Markdown 存储，模型无关，零依赖；词法 0GB 兜底，可选语义档。

description.en: Cross-session persona and diary for DeepSeek Harness: a local gate decides whether a turn is worth remembering, then one extra model call turns it into a first-person diary entry plus an impression of the user, where every impression carries the specific moment that produced it. Later conversations inject about 2000 tokens of that as a self-memory block in three registers: a persona core, a section for judgements the model wrote itself, and the diary. There is a tool for the model to record a judgement in its own words, and a plain markdown hand-note file the human can write into which the plugin only ever reads. A sidebar panel lets you read, forget or export the archive, and forgetting demotes an entry rather than deleting it, so an old one still surfaces on a strong topical match. Local-only, secrets are stripped before anything is sent, and the archive is a plain folder you can read, edit or carry to another account. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话人格与日记：本地闸门判断一轮值不值得记，值得才追加一次模型调用，产出一条第一人称日记加一份对用户的印象 —— 每条印象都带着产生它的那个具体瞬间。之后的对话把约 2000 token 的自我记忆注入系统提示词，分三种声音：人格内核、以及「我自己想的」那一栏（模型自己写下的判断）、还有日记。模型有一个工具能用自己的话记下判断；人则有一个纯 markdown 的手记文件可以手写，插件只读它、永不覆盖。侧栏面板能看、能删、能带走；遗忘是降级而不是删除，所以强相关的旧事仍然会被想起来。全程本地、发送前先拦掉密钥、档案是一个可读可改、能换账号带走的普通文件夹。零运行时依赖，无构建步骤。

description.en: Configurable personas, separate reply generation, and evidence-backed memory with review and correction for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置人格、独立回复生成，以及支持审核和修正的可追溯记忆。

description.en: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.
description.zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

description.en: Project-isolated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness that keeps one bank per project and adds a cross-project view; it can also seed a project's memory from its git history without opening a session there.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨项目长期记忆：每个项目各存各的库，另有一次性看遍全部的查询视图；还能不打开会话就直接从项目的 git 历史播种记忆。

description.en: PostgreSQL-backed durable memory for DSH agents: MCP memory tools plus a Web panel for reviewing memories and candidates.
description.zh: PostgreSQL 持久个人记忆：MCP 记忆工具 + 可查看记忆与候选的 Web 面板。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: Distills long sessions into background observations and reflections, injects them as a system-prompt section, and renders compaction summaries from prepared memory; includes a Settings page and source-backed recall.
description.zh: 在后台把长会话提炼为观察与反思并注入系统提示，压缩时直接用预备记忆渲染摘要；提供设置页与可回溯原文的 memory_recall。

description.en: Stores the agent's long-term memory as plain Markdown in an Obsidian vault — every memory is a .md file with YAML frontmatter that Obsidian indexes natively, so you can read, edit, link and back up it with tools you already use. Nothing is locked in a database. Ships a sidebar panel (tag filter, sort by recency or importance, edit in place), 7 agent tools, three-tier token-budgeted recall, BM25 ranking (no embeddings, no API key, works offline, CJK bigram tokenization), importance decay with archiving (moved to .archive/, never deleted), and optional GitHub Contents API sync. A note containing a secret is refused rather than redacted, because a redacted memory reads as complete while the important part is gone. Zero runtime dependencies; everything comes from the DSH host.
description.zh: 把 agent 的长期记忆存成 Obsidian vault 里的普通 Markdown 笔记——每条记忆是一个带 YAML frontmatter 的 .md 文件，Obsidian 原生索引，可以直接读、改、链接和备份，不锁在数据库里。提供左侧栏面板（按标签筛选、按时间或重要度排序、就地编辑）、7 个 agent 工具、三档 token 预算的召回、BM25 排序（无需 embedding、无需 API key、离线可用、支持中文二元分词）、重要度衰减与归档（只移到 .archive/ 从不删除），以及可选的 GitHub Contents API 同步。含敏感串的记忆会被拒绝推送而不是打码，因为打码后的记忆读起来像完整的、实际关键信息已经丢了。零运行时依赖，依赖全部来自 DSH 宿主。

description.en: Layered file memory for DeepSeek Harness with workspace-scoped USER/MEMORY notes, background consolidation, and hybrid session recall.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分层文件记忆，提供工作区隔离的 USER/MEMORY 笔记、后台沉淀与混合会话召回。

description.en: Local-first, file-backed memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Markdown memories, verified trust, per-turn recall, and optional SQLite FTS5.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的本地优先、基于文件的记忆插件：支持 Markdown 记忆存储、可验证的信任机制、逐轮次回忆，以及可选的 SQLite FTS5 全文检索。

description.en: Cross-session memory plugin for DSH (v0.6.1, npm @asherliner/dsh-memory-connect): auto-extraction, SQLite FTS5 indexing, RRF semantic recall injected into the system prompt every turn, scheduled maintenance, LLM-powered consolidation via ctx.llm, context explosion prevention, and global Soul identity via ~/.dsh/soul.md. v0.5.0 added temporal context graph (valid_from/valid_until/supersedes, append-only corrections via reviseMemory), trust model (recalled history injected as untrusted reference, current instruction always wins), turn-end summarization. v0.6.0 added local semantic embeddings (BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 via embed_server.py, cosine + RRF fusion with FTS5, no cloud calls, ~232 msgs/sec on CPU). v0.6.1 fixed ~ expansion in path config. Zero-config install.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆插件（v0.6.1，npm 包 @asherliner/dsh-memory-connect）：自动提取、SQLite FTS5 索引、RRF 语义召回（每轮注入系统提示词）、定时维护、LLM 智能合并（自动接入 ctx.llm）、上下文爆炸防护、全局身份 Soul（~/.dsh/soul.md）。v0.5.0 新增：时态上下文图谱（valid_from/valid_until/supersedes，reviseMemory 追加式修正）、信任模型（历史记忆作为不可信参考注入，当前指令绝对优先）、轮末自动摘要。v0.6.0 新增：本地语义 embedding（BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5，embed_server.py 提供，余弦相似度 + 与 FTS5 的 RRF 融合，纯本地无云端调用，CPU 约 232 条/秒）。v0.6.1 修复 path 配置 ~ 展开。零配置装完即用。

description.en: Claude Code-style auto-memory, natively: typed memory files (user/feedback/project/reference) with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt (zero footprint when empty); memory_write/read/list/delete follow Claude Code write rules (dedupe-and-update, absolute dates, cross-links); workspace-scoped and user-scoped layers, cross-process file locking with orphan-lock recovery, plain Markdown on disk, no external services, no embeddings.
description.zh: 原生实现 Claude Code 式自动记忆:类型化记忆文件(user/feedback/project/reference)+ 自动注入系统提示词的 MEMORY.md 索引,无记忆时零提示词占用;memory_write/read/list/delete 遵循 Claude Code 写入规则(查重更新、相对日期转绝对、交叉链接);项目级与用户级双层作用域,跨进程文件锁与孤儿锁自愈,记忆为磁盘纯 Markdown,无外部服务、无 embedding。

description.en: Memory triage for DeepSeek Harness: at the end of each turn it decides which entries to keep and which to archive, routes project-specific ones into a project bucket while global ones stay in the main store, merges near-duplicate entries, and falls back to an LLM when the rules are unsure — automatic actions are recoverable archives only, never deletions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 记忆分诊插件：每轮对话结束自动判断条目保留或归档，把项目条目迁入 project 桶、全局条目留在总体记忆，合并近义重复条目，规则拿不准时用 LLM 兜底；自动动作只做可恢复的归档，永不直接删除。

description.en: Structural long-term memory for DSH: supersede, decay and entity-state tracking across 15 MCP tools, automatic recall and capture hooks, and a bounded pointer index published per request instead of filling the window. Requires Python 3.10+ with torch and sentence-transformers; the first run downloads a ~470 MB embedding model.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的结构化长期记忆：15 个 MCP 工具支持取代、衰减与实体状态跟踪，带自动召回与捕获钩子，并按请求发布有界指针索引，而不是等上下文塞满再压缩。需要带 torch 与 sentence-transformers 的 Python 3.10+；首次运行会下载约 470 MB 的嵌入模型。

description.en: Memory protocol enforcement plugin: bridges the opencode-memory MCP server, forces memory_weave before tool calls, auto-ingests turns, and injects memory context into agent steps.
description.zh: 记忆强制协议插件：桥接 opencode-memory MCP 服务器，工具调用前强制 memory_weave、每轮自动存档、自动注入记忆上下文。

description.en: A durable RAG-enhanced long-term memory layer for LLM agents, featuring holographic memory, state-slot conflict detection, and timeline retrieval. Requires Python 3.10+ and this repository's Python dependencies: create a venv and run pip install -e ".\[dev]" in the checkout before enabling the plugin (the bundled installer is a PowerShell script, i.e. Windows).
description.zh: 面向 LLM Agent 的持久化 RAG 增强长期记忆层，支持全息记忆、状态槽位冲突检测与时间线检索。需要 Python 3.10+，并先在仓库里建 venv 执行 pip install -e ".\[dev]" 装好 Python 依赖后再启用插件；仓库自带安装脚本为 PowerShell（Windows）。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: distils durable user preferences and project facts after each turn, injects a memory digest into later sessions, and keeps a daily diary of habits. Adds memory_search, memory_save and memory_forget tools.
description.zh: 长期记忆插件：每轮对话结束后自动提炼用户偏好与项目事实并注入后续会话，还会写每日习惯日记；提供 memory_search、memory_save、memory_forget 三个工具。

description.en: Failure memory for DeepSeek Harness. Captures tool failures as they happen, classifies them with 16 built-in rules into lessons pairing a symptom with a fix, adds session/daily/weekly summaries, and injects a short briefing into later sessions through systemPrompt context. Ships 5 pitfall_ tools and a web settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的失败记忆插件。运行中捕获工具失败，用 16 条内置规则归并成「症状 + 正确做法」的经验，附带会话/天/周三级总结，并通过 systemPrompt context 把简报注入后续会话。提供 5 个 pitfall_ 工具与 Web 设置页。

description.en: Long-term memory scoped to the DSH workspace. A session opens with a one-line-per-memory index - bodies are fetched on demand by the `memory` tool, so the same character budget holds about three times as many entries - and when a turn ends a purely local search over the last user message pulls the matching memories into the next briefing at no model cost. Optional auto-capture distils a stretch of conversation into structured memories; in draft mode they wait in an approval queue instead of landing directly. A portrait layer keeps a workspace and a global picture, rewritten from the journal and the records, with the same draft-or-direct choice. Settings → Memory holds the archive, list and timeline views, a health check (duplicate clusters, stale entries, broken links), the supersede version chain with rollback, and a read-only scan that imports existing WorkBuddy / Qoder memory files.
description.zh: DSH 的工作区长期记忆。会话开始只注入「一行一条」的记忆索引，正文由 memory 工具按需取——同样字数预算约装三倍条目；一轮结束时用当轮最后一条用户消息做纯本地检索，命中的记忆下一轮随简报召回，不花模型 token。可选自动提炼把一段对话归纳成结构化记忆，captureMode=draft 时先进审批队列、你批准了才生效。另有画像层：工作区与全局各一份全貌，由日志与条目重写生成，同样可走草稿。设置 → 记忆 里有档案 / 列表 / 时间线、体检（重复簇、过期未用、断链）、版本链 supersede 与一键回滚，以及「扫描本机」把已有的 WorkBuddy / Qoder 记忆文件导入（只读，不动来源）。

description.en: Memory in global and per-project scopes: memories are injected into the system prompt at session start, a settings panel edits them with confirmation on write, and the agent gets a read-only memory_query tool (npm: `dsh-my-memory`).
description.zh: 全局 / 项目两级记忆：会话开始时把记忆注入系统提示词，设置页面板支持新增 / 修改 / 删除（写操作需确认），并为 agent 提供只读查询工具 memory_query（npm: `dsh-my-memory`）。

description.en: Learns a user's coding conventions from instructions and corrections, stores them as confidence-scored rules in editable Markdown, and injects them as reference data into every session. Rules that decay out of range or contradict a newer rule stay visible for review instead of being applied.
description.zh: 从指令和纠正里学习编码习惯，存成带置信度、可手工编辑的 Markdown 规则，并在每个会话中作为参考数据注入。衰减出注入窗口或与更新规则冲突的条目会留在待审列表里，而不是继续生效。

description.en: Runs TiddlyWiki 5 as the DSH persistent knowledge base: ten tiddlywiki_* agent tools (filtered search, read/write/batch/rename/delete, recent, tags, git sync with conflict resolve), a full TiddlyWiki editor embedded in the GUI center column over a same-origin proxy, a right-side wiki tab, a per-session tab summarizing the notes a session read or wrote, a quick-note card with draft auto-save, and an optional clip bookmarklet with image attachment — all backed by an auto-committing git repository.
description.zh: 把 TiddlyWiki 5 变成 DSH 的持久知识库：十个 tiddlywiki_* 智能体工具（带过滤的检索、读写/批量/改名/删除、最近、标签，以及 git 同步与冲突解决），GUI 中央栏经同源代理内嵌完整 TiddlyWiki 编辑器，右侧栏知识库 Tab，会话级汇总本会话读写过的笔记，快速笔记卡片支持草稿自动保存，另可选剪藏书签（选中图片一并存为二进制附件）——全部由自动提交的 git 仓库支撑。

plugins.name: dsh-obsidian-mem

description.en: Project documents and long-term memory as plain Markdown in a dedicated Obsidian vault: six mem_* tools (search, read, write, log, brief, admin), one budgeted recall injection at the first step of a session, and automatic distillation of completed turns. Obsidian does not need to be running, and the vault stays readable with the plugin uninstalled.
description.zh: 把项目文档与长期记忆以纯 Markdown 存进专用 Obsidian 仓库：六个 mem_* 工具（search / read / write / log / brief / admin）、会话第一步的一次带预算召回注入，以及已完成回合的自动蒸馏。Obsidian 无需运行，卸载插件后仓库内容照常可读。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Workspace-wide sticky notes on an infinite canvas: notes are plain Markdown files, created manually, captured from conversations, or distilled by the AI, and can be handed back as context; ships 12 model tools and 5 bundled skills for creating, tagging, arranging, comparing and merging notes.
description.zh: 工作区级的无限画布便签：便签以 Markdown 文件保存，可手动创建、从对话中摘录或由 AI 提炼生成，并能作为上下文提供给 AI 使用；附带 12 个模型工具与 5 个内置技能，用于创建、打标签、整理、比较与合并便签。

description.en: Local literature knowledge-base RAG: 10 tools (kb_ingest, kb_search, kb_rag, kb_zotero, kb_dedup, kb_clear, kb_fetch, kb_scope, kb_stats, kb_status), hybrid BM25+vector+reranker search, cited QA with clickable DOI links, all-local bge embeddings over a single-file SQLite index. Needs Python 3.9+ with pymupdf, faiss-cpu and sentence-transformers; the `npx dsh-kb-rag-install` installer sets those up and pre-downloads the model.
description.zh: 本地文献知识库 RAG：10 个工具（kb_ingest、kb_search、kb_rag、kb_zotero、kb_dedup、kb_clear、kb_fetch、kb_scope、kb_stats、kb_status），BM25+向量+重排混合检索、DOI 可点击溯源问答，全本地 bge 嵌入 + 单文件 SQLite 索引。需要 Python 3.9+ 及 pymupdf、faiss-cpu、sentence-transformers（`npx dsh-kb-rag-install` 安装器会自动装好并预下载模型）。

description.en: Replaces the built-in DSH compaction summarizer with a five-section handoff summary and keeps every shadowed message readable in a segment directory.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 自带的压缩摘要器，改用五段式交接摘要，被压掉的每条消息都能在分段目录里读回。

description.en: Local Markdown long-term memory for DSH: an Obsidian-compatible vault, a sidebar management page, four memory tools, and budgeted per-turn recall.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地 Markdown 长期记忆：Obsidian 兼容仓库、侧边栏管理页、四个记忆工具，以及按预算的每回合召回。

plugins.name: busabase-dsh-plugin

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Busabase: search workspace knowledge, work with structured records and apps, submit writes as reviewable ChangeRequests, and inspect results in live cards.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Busabase：检索工作区知识、操作结构化记录与应用、将写入提交为可审阅的 ChangeRequest，并在实时卡片中查看结果。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Turns corrections into permanent rules: explicit remember: triggers and auto-detected corrections pass a confirm bar (save globally / per project / edit / skip) and are written into a marked AGENTS.md section. New rules take effect in the current session and load natively in future ones; writes are deduplicated and version-guarded, and secret-looking content is refused.
description.zh: 把对模型的纠正变成永久规则：remember: 显式触发与自动检测的纠正经确认条确认后写入 AGENTS.md 的标记段（全局或项目作用域，可编辑、可跳过），当前会话立即生效，新会话由 dsh 原生指令加载器读取；规则去重、版本守卫写入、疑似密钥拒绝落盘。

description.en: Adds a multi-user settings panel to the DSH web client: usage-mode selection, member management with online status and device binding, and switching or sharing of per-member memory and knowledge bases.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端增加多用户设置面板：使用模式选择、成员管理与在线状态、一人多设备绑定，以及各成员记忆体和知识库的切换与共享。

description.en: Native DSH foundation bundle that registers a persistent default workspace, provides paged read-only inspection of plugins, skills, memory, sessions, storage, settings, credentials, and DSH_HOME files, and synchronizes rich CLIProxyAPI model capabilities into native provider settings.
description.zh: 原生 DSH 基础插件：注册持久化默认工作区，分页只读查看插件、skills、memory、会话、storage、settings、credentials 与 DSH_HOME 文件，并将 CLIProxyAPI 的模型能力同步到原生 Provider 设置。

plugins.name: dsh-eli-mode#packages/eli-mode

description.en: Knowledge-base-driven agent preset: wiki long-term memory, a web KB UI, a management page and optional UI polish.
description.zh: 知识库驱动的 Agent 预设：wiki 长期记忆、网页知识库、管理页、可选界面润色。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-inbox

description.en: Personal paste inbox for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): /inbox in the composer or the sidebar panel files links, images, text and credentials into a local vault, classifies them by local rules and then by a rate-capped model pass, and browses, searches and edits them from the panel; the assistant retrieves records on request in conversation, credential bodies stay encrypted at rest, and an optional WebDAV or S3 remote syncs records and attachment bytes. Windows only so far.
description.zh: dsh 的个人收件箱：输入框的 /inbox 或侧栏面板把链接、图片、文本与账密收进本地仓库，先按本地规则、再由有每日上限的模型分类，可在面板里筛选、搜索与编辑；对话里让助手按需检索取回，账密正文加密落盘，可选 WebDAV 或 S3 远端同步记录与附件字节。目前只在 Windows 实测。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Records DeepSeek Harness runtime errors and coding retrospectives as an interactive GPU graph, and feeds the recorded lessons back into the model's context.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的运行错误与编程任务复盘渲染成可交互的 GPU 图谱，并把记录下来的教训送回模型上下文。

description.en: A private memory library for DSH with customizable personas that only records when you ask, storing everything locally in Markdown.
description.zh: 不忘 —— 主动记录的私人记忆库，内置可修改的人格，只在你开口时才写；读取时每轮自动注入人格与记忆，纯本机 Markdown 不联网。

description.en: Cross-session memory with zero-token deterministic recall (bigram-Jaccard fused with FTS5 BM25 via RRF, Chinese-aware tokenization), reinforcement that strengthens repeated observations, and procedures crystallized into SKILL.md files refined in place through an active-stale-archived lifecycle with reversible archive and rollback. Ingest and disposal each expose a user-chosen autonomy tier; conflicts and high-importance writes always go to human review, and nothing is ever auto-deleted. Requires Node 22.5+.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆，零 token 确定性召回（bigram-Jaccard 与 FTS5 BM25 经 RRF 融合，中文分词精确）；重复观察会强化已有理解而非堆叠重复；过程性知识结晶为 SKILL.md，就地精炼升级，走 active-stale-archived 生命周期治理，归档可逆、可回滚。摄入与处置各有一档用户可选的自治程度，冲突与高重要写入始终交人工复核，任何档位都不会自动删除。需要 Node 22.5+。

description.en: Launches the local compound-memory MCP server through uvx and injects a short usage reminder once per session.
description.zh: 通过 uvx 启动本地 compound-memory MCP server，并在每个会话注入一次简短的使用提醒。

description.en: Reads the files that AGENTS.md references with @path imports and injects their content into model context, with byte budgets, compaction re-seeding and a six-language settings card. v0.3.x expands the imports of every instruction file the harness loaded, including a project AGENTS.md picked up mid-session (needs DSH 0.2.0+); use 0.2.x on DSH 0.1.7.
description.zh: 把 AGENTS.md 里 @路径 引用的文件读出来，在会话启动时注入模型上下文；带字节预算、压缩后重新注入和六语言设置卡片。v0.3.x 会展开 DSH 已加载的所有指令文件里的引用，包括会话中途自动带进来的项目 AGENTS.md（需 DSH 0.2.0+）；DSH 0.1.7 请用 0.2.x。

description.en: Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.
description.zh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

description.en: A daily journal the agent keeps: the journal_record tool appends dated todos and memories, with optional detail and tags, to one JSON file per day under the DSH home; the right sidebar draws those files as a month calendar marked per day by open todos, finished todos or memories, with checkable todos and the selected day's entries below; and the duty sentence it adds to the system prompt is editable from the calendar itself.
description.zh: 助手替你维护的每日日志：journal_record 工具把带时间的待办与记事（可选详情与标签）追加到 DSH home 下一天一个的 JSON 文件；右侧栏把这些文件画成月历，单元格按「有待办未完成 / 待办已完成 / 只有记事」标记，下方是可勾选的待办与所选日期的条目；它加入系统提示词的那句职责文案，可以直接在日历上编辑。

description.en: A purely plugin-based implementation that brings "cross-session long-term memory + background self-evolution" capabilities to DeepSeek Harness: five-track memory · git branch awareness · in-turn self-review · skill self-evolution and skill manager · four-track to-do · COI scheduling · session broadcast · session search · prompt manager · temporary info notes—zero core modifications, zero runtime dependencies, ready to use upon installation and completely removable upon uninstallation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来「跨会话长期记忆 + 后台自我进化」能力的纯插件实现：五轨记忆 · git 分支感知 · 回合内自我审查 · 技能自我进化与技能管理器 · 四轨待办 · COI 调度 · 会话广播 · 会话搜索 · 提示词管理器 · 临时信息便签——零核心修改、零运行时依赖，随装随用、卸载即净。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: pinned rules injected every turn, the rest recalled by IDF-weighted keyword evidence, fact-key dedup, plain JSON storage, and a settings page to edit or delete entries.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话长期记忆：规则和坑每轮注入，其余按 IDF 加权关键词召回；事实键去重、明文 JSON、设置页可增删改。

description.en: Local long-term memory for DSH sessions: archives older turns under context pressure, with four tiered hot-memory boards, project documents, memory families with editable family names and root transfer that preserves project hot memory, summary keyword locator with segment-level candidates and paging, manual injection, 20K segmented reads, and tag-related retrieval. Includes staged recall cues and post-install version verification. All data stays in the workspace.
description.zh: DSH 会话的本地长期记忆：上下文压力升高时归档较早轮次，提供四板块分级热记忆、项目档案、记忆家族与根转移（家族名可独立修改，转移保留项目热记忆）、摘要关键词定位与段级候选翻页、手动注入、20K 分段读取和 tag 关联检索；包含分级回忆 cue 与安装后版本校验。数据都保存在工作区。

description.en: Project-scoped persistent key-value memories with set/get/list/delete/search model tools and JSON-file storage.
description.zh: 项目作用域持久化键值记忆：set/get/list/delete/search 模型工具，JSON 文件存储。

description.en: Adds personality injection, a decaying memory card, a mood state and a daily diary so the agent keeps identity and history across sessions.
description.zh: 给 agent 加人格注入、会衰减的记忆卡、心情状态和每日日记，让它跨会话保留身份和历史。

description.en: Knowledge base with a corrective acquisition loop for DeepSeek Harness: when the agent keeps hitting the same failure, a background worker fetches the web under a rate limit, distills the result into a staging area, and only a two-stage commit makes it recallable — pages without sources are refused.
description.zh: DSH 的纠错式补料知识库：agent 反复撞同一堵墙时，后台 worker 在限流下联网抓取、蒸馏结果先落暂存区，只有两段式 commit 才能进入召回——无来源的页面一律拒绝。

plugins.name: dsh-living-memory

description.en: Self-tending living memory in one local SQLite file — a nightly patrol dedupes, merges, decays and cross-links entries on its own, with seven-signal RRF hybrid recall (FTS5 + jieba Chinese-first tokenization, optional vector KNN, graph PPR), a typed knowledge graph, conflict detection instead of silent overwrites, and web telemetry panels.
description.zh: 单文件本地 SQLite 的自整理活记忆——夜巡引擎自动去重、合并、衰减、建链，七信号 RRF 混合检索（FTS5+jieba 中文优先分词、可选向量 KNN、图谱 PPR），带类型知识图谱，冲突检测标记矛盾而非静默覆写，Web 遥测面板。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A /remember command that writes facts into the AGENTS.md instruction hierarchy dsh already loads, plus a Memory tab showing which instructions the loader kept within its byte budget.
description.zh: /remember 命令将事实写入 dsh 已加载的 AGENTS.md 指令层级，并配有 Memory 标签页，显示加载器在字节预算内实际保留了哪些指令。

description.en: Persistent AI memory backed by a local Obsidian/Codex vault: five obsidian_memory_* read/write/search tools plus a sidebar vault browser.
description.zh: 基于本地 Obsidian/Codex 知识库的持久 AI 记忆：5 个 obsidian_memory_* 读写搜索工具，外加侧边栏知识库浏览器。

description.en: Recent conversations stay vivid. Older ones fade into summaries, not oblivion. StrataGate gives DeepSeek Harness six-layer, time-decaying memory, while lasting events and relationships settle into a knowledge graph. Bring your memories from other AIs with you—no need to start over.
description.zh: 近期对话保持清晰，久远记忆逐渐化为摘要，而不是消失。StrataGate 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来六层时间衰减记忆，并将长期事件与关系沉淀进知识图谱。还可以把其他 AI 中的已有记忆一起带过来，不必从头开始。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory backed by a local Go service (~50MB RAM, SQLite-vec + verify-augmented claims): zero-lag recall injection on every user message, session-end transcript ingest, and memory_search / memory_logs / memory_ingest tools. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add @djasdh/interest-memory-dsh-bridge`. Protocol bridge only: the Go service is not installed by `dsh plugin add` — install and start it per the repository README first; until it runs, the tools silently return nothing.
description.zh: 由本地 Go 服务支撑的跨会话长期记忆（约 50MB 内存，SQLite-vec + 经验证增强的论断）：每条用户消息零延迟注入召回、会话结束时摄入对话记录，提供 memory_search / memory_logs / memory_ingest 工具。安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @djasdh/interest-memory-dsh-bridge`。仅为协议桥：Go 主服务不随 `dsh plugin add` 安装，需先按仓库 README 安装并启动；服务未运行时工具静默返回空。

description.en: Long-conversation memory for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): keeps settled decisions, user corrections and exact numbers, with their conditions and sources, available across compaction and restarts in 100-1000+ turn sessions; one small budgeted evidence block per model step, with enabled skill rules re-applied in the same block.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 长会话记忆插件：把已经定下来的决定、用户的纠正和精确数字连同统计口径与来源存下来，压缩或重启后仍能找回、复用，适合 100–1000+ 轮会话；每步只注入一小段有预算的证据块，已启用的 skill 规则也在这块里按任务重新装配。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: each base is a folder of UTF-8 text, text PDFs and OCR-read images; the plugin retrieves from the session's selected bases before every turn with Chinese n-gram and BM25, answers carry citations that open in a right-sidebar reader, and the agent gets five kb_* tools (list, search, read, stats, propose text) plus /kb commands for create, use, files, search and rescan.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库：每个库对应一个本地文件夹，支持 UTF-8 文本、文本型 PDF 与图片 OCR 资料；每轮对话前用中文 n-gram 与 BM25 从本会话所选库中检索，回答带可在右侧阅读器打开原文的引用；并提供 kb_list、kb_search、kb_read、kb_stats、kb_propose_text 五个工具与 /kb 系列命令（新建、选用、文件、检索、重扫）。

description.en: Layered memory for DSH whose agent-facing surface is 10 tools: high-privilege writes (memory_add, memory_delete, memory_import), rumination controls (memory_ruminate, _cancel, _status), and a memory graph (memory_search_graph, memory_expand_graph_node), built over an L0-L3 distillation pipeline that recalls and injects relevant memories before each model step.
description.zh: 分层记忆插件，面向 Agent 暴露 10 个工具：高权限写入（memory_add / memory_delete / memory_import）、反刍控制（memory_ruminate / _cancel / _status）与记忆图谱（memory_search_graph / memory_expand_graph_node），底层为 L0–L3 蒸馏管线，并在每步模型调用前召回注入相关记忆。

description.en: Trim tools for long chats: trim_context / estimate_context_tokens keep the system persona and the last message, drop the oldest user/assistant pairs to fit a turn or token budget, and report before/after estimates; the conversation is not trimmed unless something calls the tools.
description.zh: 长对话裁剪工具：trim_context / estimate_context_tokens 保留系统人设与最后一条消息，按轮丢弃最旧的用户/助手对话以压到轮数或 token 预算内，并回报裁剪前后的估算；不调用工具就不会自动裁剪。

description.en: Evolving memory infrastructure for DSH — evidence, time, context, and correction for long-term continuity — backed by a local Python 3.11+ memory service (fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic, started automatically as a python3 subprocess).
description.zh: DSH 演化记忆基础设施：用证据、时间、情境与纠错支撑长期连续性；后台是本地 Python 3.11+ 记忆服务（fastapi/uvicorn/pydantic，插件以 python3 子进程自动启动）。

description.en: Memory that outlives the session, kept as plain daily log files: one markdown file per day plus a generated index the agent greps instead of re-reading. Registers the annals skill, injects the write-it-down rules into the system prompt, and exposes three tools — annals_init builds the log directory, the index generator and a separate Git repository in one call; annals_query full-text searches past entries and returns them with file and line anchors; annals_links resolves which entry cites which. Reminds the agent once per turn when it changed files but wrote no log that day, and once more when the log was updated but the index was not. Adds a settings page for the six switches.
description.zh: 活过本次会话的记忆，载体是普通的每日日志文件：一天一个 markdown，外加一份生成出来的索引，让助手先用索引检索而不是重读全文。注册 annals 技能，把「写下来」的规矩注入系统提示词，并提供三个工具——annals_init 一次建好日志目录、索引生成器与独立的 git 仓库；annals_query 全文检索历史条目并带回文件与行号锚点；annals_links 查条目之间的双向引用。改过文件但当天没写日志时每轮提醒一次，写了日志却没更新索引时再提醒一次。另有设置页可关这六个开关。

description.en: Cross-session memory as plain Markdown per workspace: weighted injection, bi-temporal invalidation, TTL review with stale markers, credential redaction, error and session retrospectives, SOP skills, and approval-gated self-improvement proposals.
description.zh: 按工作区存放的纯 Markdown 跨会话记忆：重要性加权注入、双时态失效、按 TTL 复查并标注可能失效、凭据脱敏、出错与会话复盘、SOP 技能沉淀，以及需人工确认的自我改进提案。

description.en: Local semantic memory and prior-chat retrieval with source references, editable memories, retention, forget controls, undo, and JSON import/export.
description.zh: 本地语义记忆与过往对话检索，保留来源引用，支持编辑、保留、遗忘、撤销及 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Distills session work into background observations and reflections to preserve context across compaction.
description.zh: 在后台将会话工作提炼为观察和反思，以便在上下文压缩后保留会话上下文。

description.en: Per-session long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness, with memory management, persona settings, and compaction prompts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供会话独立的长期记忆、记忆管理、人设设置和压缩提示词。

description.en: A self-contained second brain for DeepSeek Harness — auto-captures durable dialogue knowledge into a local Markdown vault (custom dedup, CJK search, git-friendly), with a graphical knowledge base and an interactive knowledge graph (legend filter, time-dimension coloring, box-select, merge, delete, PNG export/import).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上自研「第二大脑」：对话结束自动把值得复用的内容沉淀成本地 Markdown 知识卡（自研去重、CJK 检索、可 git 管理），设置页提供图形化知识库 + 交互式知识图谱（图例过滤、时间维、框选、合并、导入导出）。

description.en: Self-built DSH memory plugin: SQLite persistent storage + database-level audit guard (enforceAudit) + audit log. Auto-captures knowledge after conversations, agents recall via memory_recall, supports Claude Code/Codex/Cursor multi-agent sharing. Zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 自研 DSH 记忆插件：SQLite 持久存储 + 数据库层审核守卫（enforceAudit）+ 审计日志。对话结束自动沉淀知识卡，Agent 经 memory_recall 按需召回，支持 Claude Code/Codex/Cursor 多智能体共享，零外部依赖。

description.en: A harness that gets smarter the more you use it, with no more goldfish memory. Before each prompt, Evolver recalls one proven strategy from your local history and the EvoMap network; after the turn it grades that strategy by the checks that ran, whether the edits were kept, and how you replied, then reports back to the network, which weighs it by evidence. Every success becomes a shortcut for next time, and every failure becomes a warning.
description.zh: 越用越聪明的 harness，告别金鱼记忆。每条 prompt 前，Evolver 从本地经验和 EvoMap 网络召回一条验证过的策略；回合结束后，它凭测试结果、改动是否被保留、你的下一句反馈给策略打分，再回报网络按证据加权。每一次成功都变成下一次的捷径，每一次失败都变成下一次的避坑指南。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DSH: one Markdown file per note, with tags, hierarchical folders, full-text search, attachment opening via the system default app, zero-dependency Office text extraction, and citation into the conversation. Built for host DSH 0.2.0-rc.2; on Windows the default root is E:/dsh-kb.
description.zh: 本地知识库：每篇笔记一个 Markdown 文件，支持标签、层级目录、全文检索、附件用系统默认程序打开、Office 零依赖文本抽取，以及引用到对话。面向宿主 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2；Windows 下默认根目录为 E:/dsh-kb。

description.en: Diary and narrative memory for companion agents: daily first-person entries scoped per group or private chat, refs that can be checked against that day's messages, and a read-only journal page where hand-drawn doodles and photos follow the sentences they belong to.
description.zh: 给陪伴型 agent 的日记 / 叙事记忆：按天、按 scope 写「自己视角」的话，每条尽量能回指到当天的消息；附带只读日记页（简笔画 / 照片跟着句子走）与接地审计。

description.en: Persistent SQLite session state, story memory and recall, repositories, and model-facing record tools for DSH roleplay plugins.
description.zh: 为 DSH 角色扮演插件提供持久化 SQLite 会话状态、故事记忆与回忆、数据仓库以及面向模型的记录工具。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory backed by Supermemory: pre-step semantic and chunk recall with per-session deduplication, debounced transcript upload, background LLM fact extraction (add/update/delete) with bigram and semantic deduplication, memory_search / memory_save / memory_forget tools, global or per-workspace container scoping, and a Plugins page UI for API key storage, memory CRUD, recall preview and activity log. Requires a Supermemory API key (a free monthly quota is available), and conversation excerpts are uploaded to Supermemory's cloud.
description.zh: 基于 Supermemory 的跨会话长期记忆：在 pre-step 按需执行语义与历史对话片段召回（同会话去重、首轮附带静态画像），回合结束后防抖上传脱敏对话并由后台模型提炼增删改事实（字面二元组与向量语义双层查重），提供 memory_search、memory_save、memory_forget 三个工具，支持全局或按工作区分库，并内置插件设置页管理 API Key、增删改查记忆、预览召回结果与查看活动日志。需自备 Supermemory API Key（有每月免费额度），对话片段会上传到 Supermemory 云端。

description.en: Permanent memory plugin for DSH with vector search, LLM reflection, and knowledge pages.
description.zh: DSH 永久记忆插件，支持向量搜索、LLM 反思和知识页面生成。

description.en: Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-compatible with pi-handoff.
