description.zh: 每个工作目录与 git 分支自动维护 handoff.md：记录回合、折叠为简洁 Markdown 并注入后续会话，存储于 ~/.agent/agent-handoff，与 pi-handoff 字节级兼容。

description.en: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and proactive care signals (memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack), installable as `dsh-sgme`.
description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

description.en: Three-layer local memory for DeepSeek Harness: L1 snapshot memory (MEMORY.md/USER.md) read on demand through the memory_* tools + L2 searchable knowledge base (facts + SQLite FTS5, Chinese search via sliding-window tokenization) + L3 import from Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy and from approved Agent Hub documents (memory/global, memory/projects, accepted decisions) with content-hash dedup. v0.2.0 removed every automatic injection: memory enters the context only when the model calls one of the 12 memory_* tools, and data stays on the local drive.
description.zh: DSH 本地混合记忆插件：L1 快照（MEMORY.md/USER.md，由 memory_* 工具按需读取）+ L2 可检索知识库（facts + SQLite FTS5，滑窗分词支持中文检索）+ L3 从 Hermes/Claude Code/Codex/WorkBuddy 以及 Agent Hub 已批准文档（memory/global、memory/projects、accepted decisions）导入，内容哈希去重。v0.2.0 已移除全部自动注入：记忆只在模型调用 12 个 memory_* 工具之一时才进入上下文，数据全部留在本地。

description.en: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.
description.zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

description.en: Cross-session lesson book (the agent wrong-answer notebook) for DeepSeek Harness: injects a memory index capped at 2 KB verbatim into every turn, adds mem_recall and mem_save model tools whose write gate demands four sections, a locatable reference and explicit human approval before anything reaches disk, registers the /memory command, and keeps every lesson as a zero-dependency Markdown entry in the .memory/ directory.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆「错题本」插件：每轮把 ≤2 KB 的记忆索引原文注入提示词；mem_recall / mem_save 模型工具，写入闸要求四段结构 + 可定位引用 + 人工批准才落盘；注册 /memory 命令；所有教训以零依赖 Markdown 条目存放在 .memory/ 目录。

description.en: Bounded local memory with CBDC authority gating: SQLite + FTS5 claims, scoped recall with explainable use/verify/ignore decisions and a full audit trail, /memory commands, ≤3-claim/1200-char injection per call, no extra model call.
description.zh: 有界本地记忆 + CBDC 权威门控：SQLite + FTS5 claims，作用域召回并给出可解释的采用/核验/忽略决策与完整审计轨迹，/memory 命令，每次注入 ≤3 条/1200 字符，不增加额外模型调用。

description.en: Automatic context compression for DeepSeek Harness: compresses tool outputs before they reach the model and keeps every lossy compression reversible via CCR retrieval tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自动上下文压缩插件：在工具输出进入模型前压缩，并通过 CCR 检索工具保持所有有损压缩可逆。

description.en: Read-only bridge that surfaces Claude Code's existing project memory in DSH — git-root-aware resolution, credential redaction before injection, and an on-demand recall tool. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 只读桥接 Claude Code 已有项目记忆到 DSH：按 git 仓库根解析、注入前脱敏、按需检索工具，零依赖。

description.en: Connects dsh to the GreatArrow.ai MCP server over Streamable HTTP, so the agent can search and save workspace memories, tasks and decisions shared with your other AI clients; a config-only bundle that reads the token from great-arrow.token in the dsh home, never from the environment.
description.zh: 通过 Streamable HTTP 将 dsh 连接到 GreatArrow.ai MCP 服务器，让智能体检索和保存与你其他 AI 客户端共享的工作区记忆、任务与决策；纯配置包，从 dsh 主目录的 great-arrow.token 读取令牌，从不读取环境变量。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together with its agent loop as one more tool, ships a notes skill, and enforces a readonly/authoring/full profile on every call while keeping the tool list available when the app is closed.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到本机思源笔记桌面端：把笔记工具注册为 mcp__siyuan__<tool>，额外把思源里配置好的 AI 与其 agent 回路也做成一个工具（按档位门禁），附带笔记使用技能，并在每次调用上执行只读/创作/完整三级策略；思源关闭时工具列表依然可用。

description.en: An accumulated design-taste corpus for DSH agents: feed good and bad examples, distill principles, and review new designs against learned judgment rather than a fixed ruleset.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的积累型设计品味语料库：喂好坏例子、提炼原则，用学到的判断评审新设计，而不是套固定规则。

description.en: Local long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with SQLite storage, automatic extraction, semantic recall, corrections, reliable forgetting, and an in-app summary dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地长期记忆：SQLite 存储、自动提炼、语义召回、纠错、可靠遗忘，以及内置记忆摘要弹窗。

description.en: Offline QR code (SVG/PNG/ASCII) and barcode (Code128/EAN-13) generator for DeepSeek Harness, no network and no shell.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 离线二维码（SVG/PNG/ASCII）与条码（Code128/EAN-13）生成器，无网络、无 shell。

description.en: Scans the skills visible to the current session and ranks them by relevance to the recent conversation.
description.zh: 扫描当前会话可见的技能，按与最近对话的相关性排序推荐。

description.en: Standing instructions edited in the DSH settings UI and injected into the system prompt of every subsequent turn.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面维护常驻指令，自动注入此后每一轮对话的系统提示词。

description.en: Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

description.en: Persistent conversation memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory tab, automatic AI naming, per-AI privacy isolation, sidebar AI names, and automatic experience archiving. A static profile plugin available in every preset without disappearing on restart.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化对话记忆：记忆标签页、AI 自动命名、按 AI 隔离的隐私边界、侧栏显示 AI 名称与经验自动归档。以静态 profile 插件形式在所有预设中常驻，重启不丢。

description.en: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 融合 Claude Code 的 Auto Memory 与 Codex 的 Session 记忆整理，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简单、透明、上下文友好的长期记忆。

description.en: General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.
description.zh: DSH 通用知识库插件：导入 md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf、目录化管理、FTS5 全文检索（BM25）、Web 管理界面。

plugins.name: dsh-hindsight-local-optimize

description.en: Local-memory lifecycle for the official Hindsight plugin on DSH desktop: one-click start/stop of the hindsight-embed daemon, auto-start on boot, stop on exit, hides the uv.exe console window, and installs the vault/models to another drive.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面端官方 Hindsight 插件补齐本地记忆生命周期：一键启停 hindsight-embed 守护进程、开机自启、退出随停、隐藏 uv.exe 黑框，并支持把档案柜与模型装到其它盘。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Rewrites each request against a learned prompt profile and automatically updates habits, anti-hallucination rules, and learning records.
description.zh: 按学习到的 Prompt 画像改写每个请求，并自动更新习惯清单、防幻觉规则与学习记录。

description.en: Warns the session to flush what matters before context compaction kicks in, and rolls a long-term ledger into a frozen archive with a digest of title plus up to three lines per moved section. The roll-up stays off until home is set.
description.zh: 压缩之前先落盘：会话压力到线时先递一句话；另给长期账本做确定性滚动——最旧的几节搬进档案、原处留标题加至多三行要点，不调模型、不猜内容。账本滚动须配置 home 才启用。

description.en: Injects your home folder — identity, house rules, recent diary and ledger — into every new session before anyone speaks, and keeps that home writable so the agent can amend its own persona. Does nothing until the home folder exists (default dsh-home under the user home, or set home in the config).
description.zh: 起床包：每开一段新对话，赶在人开口之前把家读一遍注入会话——身份、规矩、错题、日记和账；家还是可写的，对话里认下的东西当场写回去，人设由它自己改。家目录不存在时什么都不做（默认为用户主目录下的 dsh-home，或在配置里填 home）。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: each turn injects a persona frame plus a relevance-ranked memory index while full transcripts stay on disk and are expanded on demand, so the vault never floods the context window. Facts are slot-keyed, so a changed mind retires the old value instead of recalling two contradictory answers. The persona frame is derived from memory by the model itself, behind three anti-pollution gates (rejecting development chatter, blocking echoes of its own injection, and merging restatements by shared content words). Periodic consolidation merges near-duplicates, rolls long topics into digests, and archives low-value old entries by tagging only — raw text is never deleted. The append-only store is compacted in place (measured 4.7 MB to 355 KB). Zero third-party dependencies, no build step. Note: per-turn injection inevitably lowers prompt-cache hit rates, so this plugin is not recommended for work scenarios.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆：每轮只注入「人设框架 + 相关记忆索引」，原文留在磁盘按需展开，不把整个库塞进上下文。事实层按槽位做冲突消解，改口后旧值自动失效；人设框架由模型从记忆里自行归纳，带三道防污染闸门（拒收开发流水、拦截自身注入的回流、同一件事按共享实词归并）。记忆周期性固化——合并近似重复、把大话题压成摘要、归档低价值旧条目，全程只打标签不删原文；追加式存储也会就地压缩（实测 4.7 MB → 355 KB）。零第三方依赖，无构建步骤。⚠️ 注意：每轮注入会不可避免地降低缓存命中率，请勿在工作场景使用。

description.en: Local Markdown user and project memory for DSH: pinned preferences, keyword search, soft invalidation, history and archive, and JSON migration with preview, backup and rollback.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Markdown 用户与项目记忆：置顶偏好、关键词检索、软失效、历史归档，以及带预览、备份与回滚的 JSON 迁移。

description.en: File-backed working memory: memorize/recall key premises verbatim in a session notes file so they survive context compaction losslessly.
description.zh: 文件型工作记忆：memorize/recall 把关键前提逐字保存在会话笔记文件，无损挺过上下文压缩。

description.en: Bridge into a global Markdown knowledge base shared with the Codex kb.cmd CLI: kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline tools with byte-compatible frontmatter.
description.zh: 全局知识库桥：kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline 读写与 Codex 共享的 D:\knowledge（格式逐字节兼容）。

description.en: Post-compaction premise-drift guard: injects a one-shot notice when a compaction summary drops a critical literal anchor.
description.zh: 压缩后前提漂移守卫：摘要丢失关键字面锚点时注入一次性提醒。

description.en: Human-governed cross-session memory spaces with independent source and consumer relationships, provenance, versioning, and pre-send injection review.
description.zh: 用户治理的跨会话记忆空间，提供独立的来源与使用关系、来源追踪、版本管理和发送前注入检查。

description.en: Governed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: append-only evidence ledger with write guards, 7-tier authority claims, supersede chains, and budgeted pre-step injection with per-domain quotas.
description.zh: 带治理的长期记忆：只追加证据账本、写入闸门、7 级权威声明与取代链，pre-step 按领域配额预算注入。

description.en: Injection scheduler for DeepSeek Harness injection planes: cross-plugin sections register/order/account on the official storageDomain, with conflict detection and per-session budget summaries (B10 panel data source).
description.zh: DSH 注入调度器：跨插件注入段的注册/排序/记账落在官方 storageDomain，含冲突检测与每会话预算汇总（B10 面板数据源）。

description.en: Memory the assistant writes and maintains itself — diary, index, self-description, the live emotion value — put back in front of it at the start of every session. It reads only the sections you name, never summarises, fills in missing starter files, and stamps a start date into an undated anchor in place — apart from that one additive edit it never changes an existing file. The writing side ships as skills.
description.zh: 让 AI 自己写、自己维护的一份记忆——日记、索引、自我描述、此刻的情绪；插件每个会话把她写的那几段摆回她眼前。只读你点名的几段，不自动总结、不替她写正文，只补缺的起始文件、给没有日期的锚点补上起算日；除此之外不改动已有文件。怎么写做成 skill 随包发。

description.en: Failure-recovery memory: search and record failure-recovery lessons from real engineering sessions, with BM25 + semantic RAG retrieval and a lessons knowledge base.
description.zh: 失败恢复记忆库：从真实工程会话中搜索和记录失败恢复教训，支持 BM25 + 语义 RAG 检索和知识库管理。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: five tools to ingest Markdown, plain text and PDF files, search them with BM25 or hybrid BM25 plus optional local embeddings, and answer with cited source passages. Runs offline with no database server. Requires Node.js 18+ and Python 3.9+; PDF ingest needs pymupdf.
description.zh: 本地知识库：五个工具，导入 Markdown、文本与 PDF，用 BM25 或 BM25 + 本地向量的混合检索查找，回答时带原文引用。离线运行，不需要数据库服务。需 Node.js 18+ 与 Python 3.9+；导入 PDF 需 pymupdf。

description.en: Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.
description.zh: DSH 上 hermes-agent 记忆机制的忠实移植（MEMORY.md / USER.md）：有界双记忆库（2200/1375 字符）、单个 memory 工具（add/replace/remove/batch 全有或全无）、每会话冻结快照注入与 nudge 提醒、DSH 原生 JSON 存储——零外部依赖、零 LLM 成本。

description.en: Local-first long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: text packages, on-demand recall, raw event citation, multiple brains and workspace boundaries.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 长期记忆插件：文本包、按需检索、可回原始事件、多大脑与工作区边界。

description.en: Cross-session event-cue memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto-extracts task/conversation cues and user language habits from every turn into a persistent global cue bank, then re-injects remembered context on topic-switch detection (keyword or vector matching).
description.zh: 跨会话「触点记忆库」插件：自动从每轮对话提取任务/会话级触点与用户惯用词，存入全局持久记忆库；检测到话题切换时重新注入相关历史记忆（关键词或向量匹配）。

description.en: Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern knowledge base for DSH: wiki-write/wiki-search skills, zero-dependency pipeline (lint/index/mnemon memory sync/quality feedback), minimal lifecycle plugin injecting schema + knowledge preview, SiliconFlow semantic recall via an Ollama-compatible proxy.
description.zh: Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式的 DSH 知识库系统：wiki-write/wiki-search 技能引导模型写读 Obsidian wiki，零依赖管线（lint/索引/mnemon 记忆体同步/质量闭环），极简生命周期插件注入守则与知识预览，Ollama 兼容代理接 SiliconFlow 语义召回。

description.en: Read-only semantic retrieval for meow-memory: a local bge-m3 vector index over memory entries and conversation turns, a knowledge graph, and verbatim turn recall. Never writes back to the memory store; requires meow-memory.
description.zh: meow-memory 的只读语义检索增强层：为本机记忆条目与对话轮次建 bge-m3 向量索引，提供记忆图谱与逐字原文召回，绝不回写记忆库；需与 meow-memory 搭配使用。

description.en: Hindsight long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: injects relevant memories before each turn and retains finished turns to a Hindsight bank. Requires DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2).
description.zh: 接入 Hindsight 长期记忆：每轮开始前自动注入相关记忆，回合结束后自动沉淀对话。需要 DSH ^0.2.0-rc.1（已在 0.2.0-rc.2 验证）。

description.en: Claude Code-compatible persistent memory: the host injects the MEMORY.md index at session start, the model maintains memory files with plain read/write/edit tools, and a Settings page lists saved memories. Same on-disk format as Claude Code; claude mode shares the exact memory directory.
description.zh: Claude Code 兼容的持久记忆：每个会话开始时自动注入 MEMORY.md 索引，模型用普通 read/write/edit 文件工具维护记忆，Settings 内置记忆列表页。落盘格式与 Claude Code 完全一致，claude 模式直接共享同一记忆目录。

description.en: Turns guard denials, gate failures and human thumb-downs into project lessons, and injects only the rules a human has armed into each new session of that project; it registers no model tools and is reviewed through its settings card.
description.zh: 把拦截拒绝、门禁失败与人工差评沉淀为项目教训，只把人工确认过的规则注入该项目之后的新会话；它不注册模型工具，通过设置卡评审规则。

description.en: Cited memory over DSH's lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 无损会话日志的引用式记忆：蒸馏出的事实带 `(sessionId, eventRange)` 引用，可随时展开回原始日志片段。

description.en: Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with automatic turn-end persistence and per-agent namespace isolation.
description.zh: 向量+图记忆后端：observe/remember/search/recall 四个工具对接本地 memoria 服务，HNSW 语义召回 + FTS5 关键词 + 知识图谱信号经 RRF 融合排序，回合结束自动写入，按 Agent 命名空间隔离。

description.en: Advanced memoria tools: session context injection (profile + recall), recent decisions, health report, namespace allowlist, memory relation graph, and entity search; companion to dsh-memoria.
description.zh: memoria 进阶工具：会话上下文注入（画像+召回）、近期决策、健康报告、命名空间白名单、记忆关系图与实体搜索；dsh-memoria 的伴生插件。

description.en: Semantic context watcher for DSH agents: maintains a journey ledger with flash summarization and MinHash novelty detection, folds milestones, and can inject long-term context with a three-level stall response; injection and the stall-2/3 responses are off by default.
description.zh: DSH 语义上下文观察器，维护旅程台账并做闪存摘要与 MinHash 新颖度检测，支持里程碑折叠、长期上下文注入与三级停滞响应；注入与 stall-2/3 响应默认关闭。

description.en: BM25 keyword-based memory recall.
description.zh: 基于 BM25 关键词检索的记忆召回。

description.en: Causal memory for dsh: a zero-dependency MCP stdio bridge that mounts the 17 tools of the causal-memory server under clean names (no mcp__ prefix) — decision → outcome edges with typed relations (caused / enabled / prevented) in a local SQLite store that survives compaction — plus a pinned system-prompt section. Requires the causal-memory server binary on PATH (pip install causal-memory, or a prebuilt release).
description.zh: 因果记忆插件：零依赖的 MCP stdio 桥，把 causal-memory 服务的 17 个工具以干净名（无 mcp__ 前缀）挂载——本地 SQLite 记录「决策 → 结果」因果边（caused / enabled / prevented），压缩后记忆仍存活——另注入一段常驻系统提示词。需先将 causal-memory 服务端装到 PATH（pip install causal-memory，或下载预编译包）。

description.en: Dual-ledger cross-session memory: auto-extracts lasting facts from conversations into MEMORY.md and maintains a PROGRESS.md project ledger, recalling both into every new session.
description.zh: 双账本跨会话记忆：自动把对话中的长期事实提取进 MEMORY.md，并维护项目进度账本 PROGRESS.md，每个新会话自动召回两本账。

plugins.name: dsh-task-checkpoint-guard

description.en: Local task checkpoints and bounded recovery for DSH, with optional L0–L3 hierarchical memory, dependency-aware retrieval, prerequisite-aware context, and six opt-in memory tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地任务检查点与有界恢复，并可选启用 L0–L3 层级记忆、依赖感知检索、先修知识上下文和六个按需启用的记忆工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Model-autonomous context compaction for DeepSeek Harness: a mind_map tool surveys the agent context surface (stable seq ids, roles, token weights, clear-boundary markers, the clear-mind playbook), a clear_mind tool replaces a chosen conversation-history span with a model-written checkpoint through the native compaction transaction, call and result pairs self-collapse into one-line tombstones, and a proactive reminder nudges the model when the context grows long or a turn runs too many steps.
description.zh: 让模型自主压缩自身上下文的 dsh 插件：mind_map 工具俯瞰模型自己的上下文表面（稳定 seq、角色、token 重量、清理边界标记，返回内附清理手册），clear_mind 工具把选定的对话历史区间替换成模型自写的检查点（走平台原生 compaction 事务，GUI 渲染可展开的压缩行），调用对自动折叠成单行墓碑，上下文过长或单轮步数过多时主动提醒模型清理；人类侧会话记录保持原样、可审计可回退。

description.en: Three-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness — a small always-on core block plus on-demand topic files (profile, preferences, decisions, lessons), with source-annotated writes and supersede-not-overwrite history, so preferences and project constraints stop drifting between sessions. Local-first: no vector DB, no server, no outbound calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的三层记忆：常驻小索引加按需读取的主题文件（画像、偏好、决策、教训），写入带来源标注、冲突取代留痕，让偏好与项目约束跨会话不漂移。本地优先：无向量库、无服务端、零出站。

description.en: A project-scoped memory plugin for DSH. Knowledge authoring and the plugin's own prompts are open to editing, so users can redesign the library structure and how the model is driven without changing a line of code. By default the library is built on one core idea: a project document you design yourself (a handoff by default) is the project entity; the plugin detects which project a session belongs to, binds captured knowledge to that project, and promotes what generalizes into theme and global layers. The most natural logic there is does the pre-filtering of knowledge, with controllable compression and archiving of context.
description.zh: 以项目为主线的 DSH 记忆插件。开放知识书写，以及插件提示词编辑，让用户不改一行代码就能重新设计记忆库结构与模型被驱动的方式。默认的记忆库核心设计在于，项目以一份你自己设计的项目文档（默认是一份交接文档）作为实体，插件自动识别会话所属项目、把沉淀的知识与项目绑定，并把可复用的部分升级进主题与全局层。用最自然的逻辑完成知识的初筛，上下文可控压缩和留档。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH: conversations auto-distilled into atomic facts, scene summaries and a persona profile, with relevant memories injected before every model step. Zero-config out of the box — hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, optional offline local embeddings, chat/work family separation.
description.zh: dsh 长期记忆：对话自动蒸馏为原子事实、场景摘要与用户画像，每步模型调用前自动注入相关记忆。开箱零配置——BM25 + 向量混合检索，可选本地离线嵌入，chat/work 双族隔离。

description.en: Layered cross-session memory kept as plain YAML: facts carry a version history instead of being overwritten, a briefing is injected at session start, and a nightly pass consolidates and shards by topic past a threshold. Zero runtime dependencies, so it also runs inside the dsh Android app (verified there).
description.zh: 明文 YAML 的分层跨会话记忆：事实带版本链而非覆盖，会话开始注入简报，夜间整理并在超过阈值后按主题分片。零运行时依赖，在 dsh 安卓版实测可用。

description.en: Long-term memory backed by a local SQLite store: project-scoped memory auto-injection with junk filtering, rule-based or model-assisted memory extraction from recent turns, write-side dedup and feedback-weighted ranking. The Python bridge runs on $NEXUS_PYTHON or the DSH-bundled interpreter at <DSH home>/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/ (Python 3.8+).
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆：新会话自动注入项目相关记忆（噪声过滤），支持轻量规则或模型辅助提取，写入去重与反馈加权排序。Python 桥默认使用 $NEXUS_PYTHON 或 <DSH home>/dsh-runtimes/dsh-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/ 下的解释器（需 3.8+）。

description.en: Event-based memory for long-lived chat bots: emotion-weighted decay, three confidence levels on recall, superseding outdated facts, per-subject isolation, plus relationship, fact, chapter, skill and gap tables. Ships a CLI, an HTTP endpoint and a DSH plugin bundle.
description.zh: 给长期陪伴型机器人的记忆层：事件编码、情绪加权遗忘、召回分三档确定度、改口即失效、按人隔离，另有关系、事实、章节、技能、缺口五张表。包含命令行、HTTP 接口和 DSH 插件三件套。

description.en: Local-first memory and persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four file-backed memory layers (pinned, memory, facts, experience), editable SOUL/MOOD persona, zero-LLM session capture, BM25 recall and a themed mood card; no standalone web panel, Python service, vector database, or API key.
description.zh: 澜·轻量本地记忆与人格系统：四层文件记忆（pinned / memory / facts / experience）、可编辑 SOUL/MOOD 人格、零 LLM 捕获、BM25 检索与状态池卡片；无独立管理面板，不依赖 Python 服务、向量库或 API Key。

description.en: Runs the upstream Headroom compression toolkit (headroom-ai, Apache-2.0) inside DeepSeek Harness over MCP: headroom_compress, headroom_retrieve and headroom_stats are exposed as mcp__headroom__* tools backed by the upstream server, installed on demand by uvx. Compression is lossy but reversible — originals are fetched back by hash from a local CCR store. Also ships a registrar that adds DeepSeek Harness to Headroom's own MCP registry, and a model-header sanitizer for the upstream proxy.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内以 MCP 方式运行上游 Headroom 压缩工具集（headroom-ai，Apache-2.0）：headroom_compress、headroom_retrieve、headroom_stats 以 mcp__headroom__* 工具暴露，后端是上游服务端、由 uvx 按需安装。压缩有损但可逆——原文按哈希从本地 CCR 存储取回。另附一个注册器，把 DeepSeek Harness 加入 Headroom 自身的 MCP 注册表，并修复上游代理的模型请求头。

description.en: Cross-compaction memory for a long session: on compaction it stores what is being dropped, and at question time it injects a few relevant passages (or nothing) so the model can recall what you decided before.
description.zh: 跨压缩记忆：压缩时把被压掉的内容存到本机，提问时只注入相关的那几段（没有就一点不注入），让模型重新想起你早先定过的事。

description.en: Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: a single SQLite store (node:sqlite, WAL) whose Markdown tree is kept as a read-only mirror; memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection at session start, graded approval gating, on-demand extraction of the current session, near-duplicate merging, an archive and supersede lifecycle, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall over local embeddings, and the /memory command.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的生物仿生记忆系统：以单一 SQLite 库为唯一事实来源（node:sqlite，WAL），Markdown 树仅作只读镜像；含 memory 工具、会话启动时的冻结快照注入、分级审批门、按需把当前会话抽取成记忆、近重复合并、归档与取代生命周期、记忆代谢（dream）、记忆钉、基于本地嵌入的语义检索，以及 /memory 命令。

description.en: Context compression for small-context models: visually configure the compressed context budget, default to an 8k handoff + 16k recent context, and keep full history searchable.
description.zh: 面向小上下文模型的 DSH 上下文压缩插件：压缩大小可视化配置，默认 8k 交接摘要 + 16k 最近上下文，完整历史仍可查询。

description.en: Local code memory with automatic source context, symbol lookup, vector search, and dependency graphs for JavaScript and TypeScript projects.
description.zh: 面向 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 项目的本地代码记忆：自动带上源码上下文，支持符号查找、向量检索与依赖图。

plugins.name: dsh-hindsight-gui

description.en: Adds a Hindsight configuration and status dashboard to the DSH sidebar for connection, model, embedding and bank settings, with health checks and ownership-checked local service controls; memory tools are provided by the separate official integration. Hindsight itself is a separate service and is not installed by this plugin.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏提供 Hindsight 配置与状态面板，管理连接、模型、向量和记忆库设置，支持健康检查及经归属核验的本机服务控制；记忆工具由独立的官方集成提供。Hindsight 服务需另行安装，本插件不负责部署。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-get-memory

description.en: Pulls GitHub repo content into DSH conversations at start and writes extracted long-term memory back with SHA-locked multi-file commits at conversation end; per-file read/write permissions, native settings page, turn indicators and global change notices.
description.zh: 对话开始时自动拉取 GitHub 仓库内容注入上下文，对话结束时提取长期记忆按文件写回并提交；文件权限中心、原生设置页、回合写回指示与全局变动提示。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Organize folders and sessions into projects with shared PROJECT.md memory and AGENTS.md instructions injected into every session, plus a project tree sidebar.
description.zh: 把多个文件夹与会话收纳为「项目」，共享 PROJECT.md 记忆与 AGENTS.md 指令并注入每个会话，附带项目树侧边栏。

description.en: Polaris Memory: local-first project memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Uses per-project .dsh-memory.json; provides memory_read/recall/write/update/delete tools, /memory command and settings UI, with tiered injection (resident user profile + scene-triggered memories with P1/P2/P3 importance), semantic recall (IDF + synonym layer), and a hard-guard mechanism for bottom-line memories (detect deny-semantics -> authorize -> block AI deletion; user can confirm-override).
description.zh: 北极星记忆：DeepSeek Harness 本地优先项目记忆插件。每项目一份 .dsh-memory.json（按 cwd 隔离），提供 memory_read/recall/write/update/delete 工具、/memory 命令与设置页；分级注入（用户画像常驻 + 场景触发记忆带 P1/P2/P3 等级）、语义召回（IDF+同义词层）、底线记忆硬守卫机制（识别禁止语义→授权→拦截 AI 删除；用户可确认绕过）。

description.en: Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with secret and prompt-injection scanning, session-scope search, retention cleanup, and optional session-start injection; standing context via memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin.
description.zh: DSH 有界持久记忆：memory_save/search/replace/remove/list 覆盖全局、用户、项目、失败四类范围，基于 DSH storage-domain 持久化，写入前做密钥与提示注入扫描，支持会话范围检索、保留期清理与可选的会话开始注入；常驻上下文用 memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin 管理。

description.en: Tiered persistent memory (user/env/project) with per-tier char budgets and semantic query routing; full layers refuse writes instead of silently evicting.
description.zh: 分层持久记忆（user／env／project）：每层各有字符预算与语义查询路由；层满时拒绝写入，而不是静默淘汰。

description.en: Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.
description.zh: 提供本地与远程知识库，支持项目和会话范围检索、可控回写以及内嵌 Web 管理台。

description.en: Markdown-as-database project knowledge base for DSH agents: ten kb_* tools (including kb_register for registering existing notes), stable TIDs, `[[node]]` links that never copy text, `[[tscl]]` definitions expanded in place, bounded reads, structural lint covering tscl, workspace-first library discovery, inline git snapshots, a node-graph panel, and a bundled prompt section plus skill that make the agent reach for kb_* instead of hand-written docs/.
description.zh: 给 DSH Agent 用的「md 即数据库」项目知识库：10 个 kb_* 工具（含登记已有笔记的 kb_register）、稳定 TID、`[[node]]` 只出链接不复制正文、`[[tscl]]` 定义就地展开、有界读取、覆盖 tscl 的结构 lint、工作区优先的库发现、内嵌 git 快照、节点图面板，另带系统提示词段落与随包技能，让 Agent 优先用 kb_* 而不是手写 docs/。

description.en: Project-level Local Context Engine for DeepSeek Harness: retrieval/compression/prioritization over history, code, files, user preferences and agent trajectories, producing a dynamic context window for any LLM.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的项目级本地上下文引擎：对历史、代码、文件、用户偏好和 Agent 轨迹做检索/压缩/优先级排序，为任意 LLM 生成动态上下文窗口。

description.en: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

description.en: Keeps project decisions in plain markdown instead of chat history: one main document plus per-module documents, every entry carrying a file:line citation. The agent interviews you to turn open questions into settled decisions, and a five-dimension score (task complexity, extensibility, maintainability, code quality, reusability) is derived from the documents and shown on a button beside the model picker. A session can bind several projects; projects are sized small/medium/large, which widens the entry limits, and a reusable-pipeline section in the main document is injected when its trigger words appear.
description.zh: 把项目决策落成纯 markdown 而不是留在聊天记录里：一份主文档加若干模块文档，每条都带 文件:行 出处。AI 主动提问把悬而未决变成已定；五维健康性（任务复杂度 / 可拓展性 / 维护系数 / 代码质量 / 可复用性）由文档证据算出，显示在输入框模型选择器旁边的小按钮上。一个会话可同时绑多个项目；项目分小 / 中 / 大三档，条目上限随档位放宽；主文档里的标准化流水线小节在命中触发词时自动注入。

description.en: Fully local vector memory for DSH: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup, and optional LLM extraction.
description.zh: DSH 全本地向量记忆:本地 embedding、SQLite 存储、自动召回注入、去重与冲突检测、软删除回收站、在线备份,可选 LLM 提取。

description.en: Explicit, project-scoped memory handoff: when you open a new conversation, one model call that you confirm curates the project's earlier conversations into a bounded brief and injects it into the conversation's first step. No silent background calls; a Memory panel shows the brief and lets you edit notes.
description.zh: 显式、按项目隔离的记忆交接：新开会话时，经你确认后只调用一次模型，把同一项目里之前的对话整理成有长度上限的摘要，注入到新会话的第一步；不会在后台偷偷调用模型。“记忆”面板可以查看摘要、编辑笔记。

description.en: Mem0-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with managed Platform, self-hosted server and local OSS backends; visual settings, automatic recall and capture, editable memory summary, token budgets and weekly memory hygiene.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Mem0 的长期记忆，支持 Platform、自建 Server 和本地 OSS 后端，带可视化设置、自动召回与保存、可编辑记忆摘要、Token 预算和每周记忆巡检。

description.en: Local knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: distills workspace and chat-attached PDF, Word, Excel, Markdown, TXT, CSV and HTML documents into Markdown notes, with a VS Code-style viewer, per-workspace access grants and agent tools to search, read and add notes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地知识库：把工作区与对话附件中的 PDF、Word、Excel、Markdown、TXT、CSV、HTML 文档提炼为 Markdown 知识，提供类 VS Code 预览、按工作区授权，以及检索、读取和入库的模型工具。

description.en: Copies the compaction checkpoint into the sticky-notes archive when context is compacted and wakes the session to write what was lost.
description.zh: 上下文压缩时把 checkpoint 原文抄进便签归档，并叫醒会话补写丢掉的内容。

description.en: Windows-only plugin that watches the foreground window title, recognizes Bilibili video courses, classifies them by subject, fetches metadata/danmaku/comments, and generates Markdown + Mermaid knowledge maps and Word study manuals (Word output needs a local Python install).
description.zh: 仅限 Windows：读取前台窗口标题，识别 B 站视频课程并按学科分类，抓取简介/弹幕/评论，生成 Markdown + Mermaid 知识地图与 Word 学习手册（Word 输出依赖本机 Python）。

description.en: Character-chat memory layer that keeps persona, voice and relationship state separate from summaries, archives every raw message for retrieval, and ships a SillyTavern card importer plus an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
description.zh: 角色聊天记忆层：人格、语气、关系与摘要分开保存，原文全量归档并按需检索，附带 SillyTavern 角色卡导入和 OpenAI 兼容网关。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory. v0.11 added a bilingual settings panel whose copy and sidebar label follow DSH language setting (中文「记忆」/ English "Memory"); v0.12 added the shared cross-plugin speech floor, a context-sensitive tone section and a weekly growth recap; v0.13 declares its DSH compatibility via engines.dsh (official 0.2.1-rc.5 series; older hosts are refused by the gate), adds a "Review now" button (POST /api/memory/control, action growth-now) that sends one growth recap immediately while still respecting the speech floor, panel accessibility (aria labels, status and alert roles, focus-visible rings), and the public PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md. v0.14 adds per-session memory: a composer chip with a dropdown (this session / workspace default), the /memory on|off|status command, and a settings-panel switch all flip the same gate — off means no boot injection, no digest/recall nudges and no last_access stamping for that session (nothing is deleted); disabledWorkspaces lets whole projects default to off, and session choices persist for 7 days. v0.15 adds a Basic soul (quick forging) card: my name / what I call you / baseline persona, saved into a managed block inside SOUL.md (the rest of the file is left untouched) and marks BOOTSTRAP complete; existing chat-forged souls are echoed from the SOUL text, and the boot block now asks the agent to remind the user to forge first when no soul exists yet.
description.zh: 带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。 v0.11 起设置面板与侧栏 label 跟随 DSH 语言设置（中文「记忆」/英文 "Memory"）；v0.12 新增跨插件共享发言权、按语境微调的语气段与每周成长回顾；v0.13 用 engines.dsh 声明 DSH 兼容范围（官方 0.2.1-rc.5 系列，旧宿主会被闸门拒绝），新增「立即回顾」按钮（POST /api/memory/control，action growth-now，立即发一次成长回顾且仍尊重发言权）、面板可访问性（aria-label、status/alert role、focus-visible 焦点环）与公开的 PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md。v0.14 新增按会话记忆开关：输入框芯片（下拉可选本会话 / 此工作区默认）、/memory on|off|status 命令与设置面板开关共用同一判定——关闭后该会话不注入 boot 块、不发 digest/追忆提醒、不盖 last_access（记忆文件不删）；disabledWorkspaces 可让整个项目默认关闭，会话选择持久化 7 天。v0.15 新增「人格基础（快速铸魂）」卡片：我的名字 / 你的称呼 / 基础人格描述，保存写入 SOUL.md 受管区块（其余内容一字不动）并把 BOOTSTRAP 标 complete；对话铸魂的老库会从 SOUL 文本回显，未铸魂时 boot 块会先提醒用户完成铸魂。

description.en: Distills daily chats into an updatable character card and a cross-session emotion module that trains the persona.
description.zh: 把每天的聊天过程蒸馏成可更新的角色卡与跨会话感情模块，持续训练角色卡（保留说话习惯与关键记忆）。

description.en: Review every five distinct ended project sessions in DeepSeek Harness, retain sourced lessons and workflow drafts, and supply project memory to later sessions.
description.zh: 每五个不同的项目会话结束后自动复盘，积累有来源的经验与工作流草稿，并为后续会话带入项目记忆。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with automatic model distillation, source-linked encrypted session logs, and guarded compaction.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层长期记忆，支持自动模型提炼、可追溯的加密会话日志和带校验的记忆压缩。

description.en: Compaction backend replacing LLM summarization with a deterministic semantic extractor (keeps code/paths/commands, drops chatter) plus 28.4x KV-compression accounting.
description.zh: 压缩后端：用确定性语义提取器替换 LLM 摘要（保留代码/路径/命令，剔除闲聊），附带 28.4x KV 压缩记账。

description.en: LLM-driven remember/forget memory: after each turn a model decides what to keep (MemoryDirector), injects relevant memories before each step, dedups, and persists cross-session.
description.zh: LLM 驱动的记忆记/忘插件：每轮对话后由模型决定记住什么/忘记什么（MemoryDirector），请求前注入相关记忆，自动去重，跨会话持久化。

description.en: Turns archived sessions into durable memory instead of dead disk. Distils each archive into reusable skills, a fact ledger with ADD/UPDATE/NOOP decisions plus validUntil and supersededBy so stale facts retire instead of piling up, and topic clusters by single-linkage similarity. Also digests sessions that are still in progress through a read-only seq watermark, leaving the session log byte-for-byte untouched, and can self-check the growing memory to merge duplicate facts, retire stale ones and consolidate duplicate skills — measuring only unless you opt in, and never hard-deleting, only superseding.
description.zh: 把已归档的会话变成可用的记忆，而不是躺在磁盘上的死数据。每条归档提炼成可复用技能、带 ADD/UPDATE/NOOP 判定与 validUntil / supersededBy 时效的事实台账（旧事实会退场而不是无限堆积），以及用 single-linkage 相似度聚合的主题簇。还能对仍在进行中的会话做增量提炼——用只读的 seq 水位线，会话日志一个字节都不改；并能自检精简不断变脏的记忆：合并重复事实、清退失效事实、归并重复技能。自检默认只测量不动手，且从不硬删除，只做取代。

description.en: Local long-term memory for DSH: browse, search (BM25 + synonyms) and edit entries in a panel; folders, archive and a recycle bin; choose per session what to inject; model-written memories need your approval; import/export backups; optionally sync across devices via your own Git or WebDAV.
description.zh: DSH 的本地长期记忆库：面板里浏览、检索（BM25 + 同义词）、编辑；文件夹、归档、回收站；逐会话决定注入哪些；模型写入的记忆需你确认；可导入导出备份；可选同步到自己的 Git 或 WebDAV 实现多设备。

description.en: Automatic conversation distillation: background subagent reflection + skill create/update.
description.zh: 自动对话蒸馏：后台 subagent 反省 + 技能 create/update。

description.en: Engineering intelligence for coding agents — persistent, evidence-aware, project-isolated engineering memory with unified hybrid search (memory + RAG documentation) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向编程代理的工程智能——为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、证据感知、项目隔离的工程记忆，以及统一的混合搜索（记忆 + RAG 文档）。

description.en: Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.
description.zh: 人类可读的 Markdown 记忆插件：用户级（~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md）+ 工作区级双层记忆，每轮自动注入提示词，回合结束自动写日志并按期蒸馏沉淀；可桥接已有 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 记忆目录；内置 memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read 三个工具（自动去重）与中英双语设置页。纯文件存储、无数据库，记事本即可编辑。

description.en: Layered cross-session memory for DSH that pushes only what changed - the first round injects every active entry, later rounds push only added / updated / removed ones, and nothing at all is injected when nothing changed, with keys that merely repeat an entry id left out of the text so the baseline is about 26% smaller. Facts and decisions carry semantic keys (one active truth per key), the model may only write to an inbox that a human promotes, an entry can carry a review date that raises a one-time reminder when due, and search is relevance-ranked with journal lines down-weighted and Chinese matched by bigram. A sidebar tab tells the lifecycle story instead of listing files - entries are grouped by stage (awaiting confirmation / in use / archived) along four axes (topic - one level, human-assigned, type, tag, date), each group can be ticked for batch promote / withdraw / archive / restore / delete / assign topic, and topics can be renamed store-wide or searched on their own. The archived stage reads in three levels - the category says why an entry left (distilled into the docs / useless for good / not needed right now, the first two being defaults you can add to), below it the entry topic stays collapsed until you click it, and entries with no topic sit right under the category. The tab also shows the global and workspace instruction files plus the current injection size. A zero-dependency CLI ships with it, so the store is usable without DSH.
description.zh: 分层跨会话记忆，只推变化的部分：首轮注入全部有效条目，之后只推新增 / 已更新 / 已失效，没有任何变化时一个字都不注入；与条目 id 重复的 key 不再写进正文，基线体积因此小约 26%。事实与决策带语义键（一个 key 只有一个有效结论），模型只能写收件箱、由人确认后才成为常驻事实；条目可以带复核时间，到期后提醒一次；检索按相关度排序、流水行被降权，中文按 bigram 匹配。侧边栏页签不再只是列文件，而是讲清流程：条目按「待你确认 / 已在用 / 已归档」分组，每个阶段都能按四个维度（主题——一级、由人归类，类型，标签，日期）查看；可逐条勾选做批量提升 / 撤回 / 归档 / 取回 / 删除 / 归类，主题可全库改名、也可只在该主题内搜索。「已归档」分三层：分类说明它为什么退场（已蒸馏 / 已废弃 / 暂时不用，前两个是默认分类，也能自己新建一个），分类下面是主题行、点开才列出条目，没写主题的条目直接列在分类下。页签同时显示全局与工作区规范文件以及当前注入体积。附带零依赖 CLI，不装 DSH 也能用这套记忆库。

description.en: Cross-session and cross-project long-term memory: a non-blocking silent sedimentation dispatch on turn/end writes into a local SQLite store (FTS5 trigram full-text index with insert/update/delete sync triggers) that later turns recall from; entries are scoped per project alongside a global tree, and the plugin ships its own embedded web dashboard (it starts the HTTP server itself, no separate process) for browsing, graphing and controlled deletion.
description.zh: 跨会话、跨工程的长期记忆：turn/end 时非阻塞派发无感静默沉淀，写入本机 SQLite（FTS5 trigram 全文索引，含增删改同步触发器）供后续回合召回；记忆按项目作用域与全局树分层存储，并自带内嵌 Web 看板（插件自身起 HTTP 服务，非独立进程）用于浏览、图谱与受控删除。

description.en: Obsidian-compatible Markdown notes in the DSH sidebar with search, tags, backlinks, graph, audio notes with transcription, a paint canvas, OCR (needs tesseract), client-side encryption and notes_* agent tools; the release tarball and the npm package carry a prebuilt Linux x64 daemon, other platforms build it from source with Go.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏里的 Obsidian 兼容 Markdown 笔记：搜索、标签、反向链接、图谱、带转写的语音笔记、画布、OCR（需 tesseract）、客户端加密与 notes_* agent 工具；release tarball 与 npm 包自带预构建的 Linux x64 daemon，其他平台需用 Go 从源码构建。

description.en: Static-context audit for a DSH home: a six-layer baseline (rules, memory, skills, tool surface, sessions, KB), broken-path checks for a markdown capability map, memory duplicate/stale/over-limit reports, SKILL.md description compression, and tool-surface plus cold-start static-context estimates recovered from session logs. Four read-only DSH tools; writes require --apply and are backed up first. Requires Python 3.10+ on the host (stdlib only; all four tools shell out to the bundled CLI).
description.zh: DSH 主目录的静态上下文审计：六层基线（规则/记忆/技能/工具面/会话/KB）、能力地图失效路径校验、记忆重复/过期/超限报告、SKILL.md 描述压缩，以及从会话日志推算的工具面与冷启动静态上下文。四个 DSH 工具全部只读；写操作需 --apply 且先备份。需要宿主上的 Python 3.10+（仅标准库；四个工具都调用随包附带的 CLI）。

description.en: Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.
description.zh: 会话记忆自动驾驶：监听 DSH 会话，在会话结束与压缩前通过宿主 LLM（ctx.llm，默认 deepseek-official）就地抽取 OKF 条目，无需外部 API Key。

description.en: Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.
description.zh: 经 MCP stdio 把 Agent 接入持久化 OKF 记忆库：Python 服务端（SQLite FTS5 + Markdown），10 个工具用于检索与写入决策、事实和偏好。

description.en: A memory plugin that forgets on purpose: short-term memories expire after 48h, long-term ones are rescheduled by Ebbinghaus/SM-2 curves and rarely-used ones fall asleep instead of bloating your context. Long-term writes stop in an approval center, so the agent cannot rewrite your persona on its own.
description.zh: 会遗忘的记忆插件：短期记忆 48 小时自动过期，长期记忆按艾宾浩斯/SM-2 曲线复习，久不用的沉进沉睡区（可唤醒）而不是无限撑爆上下文。长期写入停在审核中心，模型不能自行改写人格设定。

description.en: Context manager for DeepSeek Harness: auto-summarizes every turn into priority-sorted records, injects them plus pinned cross-session notes and custom text into each model request, and folds any-size real conversation ranges into summaries to save tokens. Persistent and restart-safe. NOTE: manual multi-step install — copy the three package folders into profiles/node_modules and add the provided cordis.patch.yml rows, then restart DSH; not a standard one-command install.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 上下文管理：每轮对话自动总结为记录并按优先级排序注入，⭐ 置顶记录跨会话继承，自定义文本每轮注入；真实对话任意范围折叠成摘要真省 token，全状态持久化重启不丢。注意：非标准一键安装——需手动将三个包目录复制到 profiles/node_modules、粘贴 cordis.patch.yml 接线并重启 DSH。

description.en: Four-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness, ported from the memory design of NoMindSama/qq-dsh-bridge (MIT) with the QQ channel removed: an append-only dialogue log, a weighted long-term fact store with decay and one-way archiving, self-notes the agent writes about itself, Chinese bigram recall over the raw log, and incremental AES-256-GCM sync to a private git repo where only ciphertext is stored. Archived sessions drop out of recall without losing their history.
description.zh: DSH 四层记忆插件（记忆设计移植自 NoMindSama/qq-dsh-bridge，MIT，去掉了 QQ 通道）：只增不改的原文库、带权重衰减与单向归档的长期事实库、智能体自己写的自我认知、原文库上的中文 bigram 检索，以及增量 AES-256-GCM 加密同步到只存密文的私有 git 仓库。会话归档后不再参与检索，但历史仍在库里。

description.en: Turns a local Markdown vault into two folders the user picks in Settings: a knowledge folder DSH writes notes into, and a memory folder used as the agent's long-term memory with per-turn recall and end-of-turn capture. Pure Markdown with frontmatter, BM25 search, reversible archive, and path isolation that rejects traversal, absolute paths and symlink escapes.
description.zh: 把本地 Markdown 库拆成两个由用户在设置页选择的文件夹：知识库由 DSH 在对话中写入笔记，记忆库作为 agent 的长期记忆，按回合召回、回合结束沉淀候选。纯 Markdown 加 frontmatter、BM25 检索、可逆归档，并用路径隔离拒绝穿越、绝对路径与符号链接逃逸。

description.en: Durable cross-session memory plus a fetch ladder that survives hostname-keyed blocking. Four tools: memory_recall, memory_save and memory_stats over a plain-JSON fact store at $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json, plus resilient_fetch which tries plain fetch, then a same-service alias host (Wikipedia only for now), then curl over IPv6 and IPv4 (needs curl on PATH). No daemon, no npm dependency, no network at import time. (1.3.0 shipped a fifth tool, memory_prune; it was withdrawn in 1.4.0 because adding a tool to a running plugin breaks sessions that were opened before it.)
description.zh: 跨会话持久记忆，加一条绕开主机名级封锁的取数阶梯：四个工具——memory_recall / memory_save / memory_stats 读写 $DSH_HOME/memory/facts.json 里的纯 JSON，resilient_fetch 依次尝试直连 fetch → 同服务别名主机（目前仅 Wikipedia）→ curl IPv6 → curl IPv4（curl 需在 PATH 上）。无后台进程、无 npm 依赖、导入期不联网。（1.3.0 曾加入第五个工具 memory_prune，已在 1.4.0 撤下：给运行中的插件加工具，会让此前打开的会话报错。）

description.en: Long-term memory & self-evolving plugin for DSH: L0 capture → L1 memory extraction → L2 scene grouping → L3 user persona, auto recall injection, skill synthesis, fully local (SQLite FTS5 + jieba, optional vector recall).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆与自进化插件：L0 对话捕获 → L1 记忆提取 → L2 场景归纳 → L3 用户画像，自动召回注入 + 技能合成，纯本地（SQLite FTS5 + jieba，可选向量召回）。

description.en: Cross-session experience memory for DSH. Lessons are evidence-graded, injected when the turn is about the same thing, and shown just before an action only when the record declares which call it applies to. A rule that holds whatever the turn is about — "always answer in Chinese" — can be marked **standing** and is then carried every turn: measured on 24 isolated real-model turns, a standing rule is followed 6/6 against 0/18 for the controls (empty store, same record unmarked, unrelated standing record). A guess still cannot become always-on: a standing record needs a verified passage like any other. What nobody looks up is retired, reversibly. Five tools, seven slash commands, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 跨会话经验记忆：经验按证据定级，本轮话题相同时才注入；动手前提示只在记录自己声明了适用哪次调用时才出现。不管聊什么都要守的规矩（例如「一律用中文」）可以标成**常驻**，之后每一轮都会带上它——24 个隔离真模型回合实测：标常驻 6/6，对照组（空库、同一条不标、无关常驻）合计 0/18。光是猜的东西进不了常驻层：标了常驻也必须有可核实的出处。没人再查的记录会被退役（可逆）。五个模型工具、七个斜杠命令、运行时零依赖。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness - a merge of AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory 4.0.2, dsh-soul-md and dsh-shallow-memory (do not install it alongside those plugins): a diary distilled from finished turns, a hand-written feelings diary, a persona card with version history, a hand-note injected in full every turn, and a short-TTL note layer, each capped separately so per-turn injection stays small; ships agent tools and a sidebar panel for recall, editing, compaction, and backup or restore from a local file, WebDAV or a gzip archive.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆，合并自 AirPineApplea/feiyu-memory 4.0.2、dsh-soul-md 与 dsh-shallow-memory（请勿与这几个插件同时安装）：从结束的对话自动蒸馏的共度时光日记、手写的情感日记、带版本历史的人设卡、每轮全量注入的人格手记，以及带 TTL 的浅层记忆，各自独立限量以控制每轮注入开销；附带一组智能体工具与侧栏面板，可召回、编辑、压缩，并支持本地文件、WebDAV 与 gzip 整包备份还原。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
description.zh: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to a Hindsight memory service using the same conventions as omp: one shared bank, automatic project-tag stamping, project plus global recall, plus tools for mental models, duplicate detection and retrying failed background operations. Requires a running Hindsight server (default http://127.0.0.1:8888).
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Hindsight 记忆服务，沿用与 omp 相同的约定：单一共享 bank、自动打项目标签、项目层与全局层同时召回，并提供精神模型、重复检测与失败后台任务重试工具。需要本机已运行 Hindsight 服务（默认 http://127.0.0.1:8888）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights, and document retrieval.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenContext，提供跨会话持久记忆、提示词自动捕获与召回、会话摘要、结构化洞察和文档检索。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust backend.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

description.en: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and guided setup/diagnostic skills, sharing one ~/.memorylake identity and memory set with the Claude Code and Codex plugins.
description.zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一 ~/.memorylake 身份与记忆。

description.en: Local-first memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: layered L1/L2/L3 memory with automatic capture, manual memos_* retrieval tools, and a built-in memory viewer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地记忆插件：分层 L1/L2/L3 记忆，自动沉淀与手动 memos_* 检索工具并存，内置记忆浏览器。

description.en: Personal-experience memory for DSH: turns solved tasks into sourced problem cases with condition-scoped claims, recalls them into new tasks via hidden pre-step injection, and makes corrections/deletes cascade to future recall.
description.zh: 个人经验记忆：把真实解决过的问题存为带来源、可纠正、有适用条件的案例，新任务中自动召回复用，纠正与删除会级联影响后续召回。

description.en: Persistent long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a JSON store of typed entries (fact, preference, entity, rule, episodic) exposed as the memory_remember and memory_recall agent tools, with recall ranked by keyword overlap, importance and access frequency.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的长期持久记忆：以 JSON 保存事实／偏好／实体／规则／经历等分类条目，注册为 memory_remember 与 memory_recall 两个 agent 工具；召回按关键词重叠、重要度与访问频次排序。

description.en: A private diary for your agent: eight zero-dependency tools to write, amend, search and export daily entries kept on date-hashed paths the index never records (inner_find returns a day's path on request).
description.zh: 给 agent 的私人日记本：八个零依赖工具负责写、改、翻、导出，正文按日期哈希散落在看似随机的目录里，索引不记路径（需要时由 inner_find 按日给出路径）。

plugins.name: dsh-graphmemory

description.en: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.
description.zh: DSH 知识图谱记忆：better-sidebar「记忆图谱」页签与独立看板 /graph-memory/app；抽取任务/技能/事件节点并跨会话召回，npm 包名为 dsh-graphmemory。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: On-demand memory for DeepSeek Harness: session logs are distilled into layered markdown (a summary, an index and per-topic files), and a mem_query tool returns only the matched entries rather than the whole index. Nothing is injected per turn, there are no dependencies, and every entry keeps a source pointer back to the conversation it came from.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的按需记忆库：会话日志提炼成分层 markdown（总览、索引与分主题明细），mem_query 只回命中条目而非整份索引。不每轮注入、零依赖，每条记忆都保留指回原对话的溯源标记。

description.en: A memory panel for DeepSeek Harness with one store per workspace: persona traits, notes about you, dated events, and a first-person diary the model writes and cannot edit. Every entry keeps the quote it came from and can be retracted; workspaces can share one memory and be split apart again; optional per-person profiles for group chats; a capped event list with ★ marks. Local only, no network, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 按工作区分开的记忆面板：人设卡、用户画像、事件与模型自述日记各存一份，每条都带原话与改动史、可以撤回；工作区之间能共用同一份记忆并随时切断；可选按人记录的他人画像；事件有上限、可标 ★。纯本地、不联网、零依赖。

description.en: A persistent AI companion for DSH that explores Bilibili, interacts with permission controls, and grows through evidence-backed life memories, evolving interests, simulated emotions, social relationships, and autonomous to-dos.
description.zh: 让 DSH AI 角色自主探索 B站并按权限互动，从真实经历中沉淀长期记忆，逐渐形成兴趣、模拟情绪和好友关系，同时管理自主待办。

description.en: Connect Trilium notes to the DSH agent via ETAPI with 20 agent tools: durable memory (remember/recall + auto-injected index), note management (CRUD/clone/attributes/revisions), full-text search, weekly-report workflow, attachments, calendar notes, backup/import, and a settings card.
description.zh: 通过 ETAPI 把 Trilium 笔记库接入 agent，提供 20 个工具：记忆读写（remember/recall + 自动注入索引）、笔记管理（CRUD/克隆/属性/修订）、全文搜索、周报工作流、附件、日历笔记、备份导入，独立设置卡片，配置 0600 落盘。

description.en: Iter Memory: it remembers my own state, not the facts. A level that drifts back to baseline by itself, plus an occasional line I choose to say only when that level allows it. When it stays quiet, nothing is spent.
description.zh: 迭代记忆：记的不是事，是我自己的状态——一条会自己退回基线的潮位，配上不定时由我自己开口的一句。状态低就先忍着，说了没人应再掉一点；不说的时候一声不响，不花 token。

description.en: Tide Memory: a long-term memory that forgets on purpose. It keeps what matters and lets the rest fade. Whether an entry enters the context is decided by an evidence score C = s/(s+2): below the threshold (0.35 by default) it never enters. Events decay by half-life (30 days, or 7 days when they carry emotion); facts never decay; superseded entries are kept and marked stale instead of deleted. Recalled lines do enter the context and therefore do consume tokens — small, but real. No embeddings, no network calls, no cloud.
description.zh: 潮汐记忆：一份会忘事的长期记忆。该记的记着，没被想起来的自己淡掉。进不进由证据分 C = s/(s+2) 决定，低于阈值（默认 0.35）根本不进上下文；事件按半衰期淡忘（30 天，带情绪 7 天），事实永不衰减；被取代的旧条目不删，标成过时留档。被召回的那几句会进入上下文、确实消耗 token（量很小，但确实不是零）；不做 embedding、不联网、不上云。设置页能看见每轮到底注入了哪几句。

description.en: Persistent persona memory for DSH with a unified recent, long-term and archive timeline, bounded context loading, memory retrieval and isolated task delegation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持续人格记忆，统一短期、长期与归档时间线，支持有界上下文加载、记忆检索和独立任务委派。

description.en: Connect dsh to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes through `obsidian_*` tools.
description.zh: 把 dsh 连接到本地 Obsidian vault：通过 `obsidian_*` 工具搜索、读取、写入、移动与回收笔记。

description.en: Coordinates bounded project recall from compatible memory and learning providers, with shared settings and provider lifecycle management.
description.zh: 协调兼容的记忆与学习提供方进行有界项目召回，提供共享设置和提供方生命周期管理。

description.en: Project-scoped local memory with review-before-recall, source references, reversible consolidation, and a portable Cordis service; the Harness adapter provides search and settings, with optional Brain integration.
description.zh: 按项目隔离的本地记忆，支持审核后检索、来源追溯、可回滚整理与通用 Cordis 服务；Harness 适配提供搜索和设置页，可选接入 Brain。

description.en: Persists scoped user corrections and method candidates for DSH with bounded recall and restart-safe completion settlement.
description.zh: 为 DSH 持久保存分作用域的用户纠错与方法候选，提供限额召回和可跨重启恢复的完成结算。

description.en: Layered long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a ~600-character hot layer that evicts its own overflow, month-archived cold entries recalled by keyword and ranked by usage, and extractive day/week/month summaries.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的分层长期记忆：热层约 600 字、超限自动腾挪，冷层按月归档、可按关键词跨月召回并按使用度排序，日/周/月三级抽取式摘要控制注入体量。

description.en: Workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness ported from ZCode: one Markdown memory directory per workspace (a MEMORY.md index plus one file per fact), injected into each main session and refreshed by a background extraction request after completed turns; a sidebar page browses the stored files read-only.
description.zh: 把 ZCode 的工作区记忆移植到 DeepSeek Harness：每个工作区一份 Markdown 记忆目录（MEMORY.md 索引 + 一事实一文件），主会话开始时注入，每轮成功对话后由后台提取请求补充；左栏页面只读浏览已存文件。

description.en: ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.
description.zh: ZCode 风格持久化项目记忆：设置内完整管理页、索引式注入与 agent 记忆工具。

description.en: Hana-style assistant manager for DSH: visual preset management (cards, yuan personalities, avatar cropping) plus a full Hana memory stack (rolling summaries, layered compilation, SQLite fact store, deep memory).
description.zh: Hana 式助手管理：可视化配置助手预设（卡片、四性格「元」、头像裁剪），并完整复刻 Hana 记忆系统（滚动摘要、分层编译、SQLite 事实库、深度记忆）。

description.en: Chat memory that archives messages by time and recalls by stated period, widening twice before admitting it forgot.
description.zh: 按时间归档聊天，用户提到某段时间就先检索，未命中扩大两次，仍没有就如实说「我忘记了」。

plugins.name: dsh-feed-the-seek

description.en: Personal cross-session memory in local SQLite, with automatic conversation learning, companion states, and optional semantic retrieval. Currently intended for single-user local use on Windows.
description.zh: 大肥鱼饲养手册：基于本地 SQLite 的个人跨会话记忆，支持对话自动学习、伙伴状态与可选语义检索，目前面向 Windows 单人本地使用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Kifu-style context compression for long DSH sessions: each step folds new turns into a DAG (node = position, edge = attempted fix), injects only a ~415-token hot list (2000-edge fixture, L5 tier), and adds failure memory plus position-repetition detection.
description.zh: 棋谱式上下文压缩：每步把新回合折进一张 DAG（节点=局面、边=试过的改法），只注入约 415 tokens 的热清单（2000 边合成夹具、L5 降级档）；带失败记忆与局面重复检测。

description.en: Persistent five-layer memory system with relevance injection, LLM auto-extraction, profile rotation, and six agent tools.
description.zh: 五层持久记忆系统：相关性注入、LLM 自动提取、画像轮替与六个 agent 工具。

description.en: Knowledge base as a canvas in the right sidebar: notes are nodes, and nine tools let the model read, write, link and remove them. A node can carry pictures and documents, and reading one returns their text — Office files extracted in place — while pictures can be handed over as images.
description.zh: 右侧栏的卡片画布知识库：笔记就是节点，模型通过九个工具读写、连线、移除。节点可以挂图片和文档，读节点时连同内容一起返回（Office 文件就地抽取文本），图片还能作为图像直接交给模型。

description.en: Loads a workspace's VSCode/Copilot AI configuration into every DSH session: `.github/copilot-instructions.md` is injected as standing instructions, `.github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md` are gated by their frontmatter `applyTo` and join once the session has touched a matching file, and `.github/skills/*/SKILL.md` are registered as DSH skills. Configuration directories outside the workspace, by default `~/.copilot`, are read as well, and a settings page edits that path list.
description.zh: 把工作区里的 VSCode/Copilot 风格 AI 配置加载进每个 DSH 会话：`.github/copilot-instructions.md` 作为常驻指令注入，`.github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md` 按 frontmatter 的 `applyTo` 在会话碰过匹配文件后才加入，`.github/skills/*/SKILL.md` 注册为 DSH 技能。工作区之外的配置目录（默认 `~/.copilot`）同样读取，设置页可编辑这组路径。

description.en: Archives the QQ Zone posts you published yourself into a local library, auto-sorted into three columns — thoughts, dreams and reviews (book/film recommendations) — all three of which can be corrected by hand, one column at a time, and undoing a correction never disturbs the other two. Ships a private web viewer that can be locked with a password, repairs long posts that the upstream API truncates to its first ~500 characters, counts words by year and month, and backs up attached images for offline reading. The cookie is stored on the local machine only.
description.zh: 把你本人发过的 QQ 空间说说收进本地库，自动分成「思考/感想」「梦记」「介绍/推荐」三栏，三栏都能人工纠正 —— 逐条改，一条只动它自己那一栏，撤销也不会连累另外两栏。配一个可用口令锁住的私人网页查看器，会把被上游接口截到前 500 字左右的长说明确补回全文，按年月统计字数，并把配图备份到本地离线可读。Cookie 只存在本机。

description.en: One shared Obsidian vault for every agent: dependency-free Python core (search/promote/adjudicate/forget), vault template, dsh plugin (memory_search/show/submit/status).
description.zh: 多 Agent 共享一个 Obsidian vault：零依赖 Python core（检索/晋升/裁决/遗忘）+ vault 模板 + dsh 插件（memory_search/show/submit/status）。

description.en: One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.
description.zh: 给所有 AI 工具和 Agent 共用的一层记忆：注入 Context Bundle、提示时检索、MCP 工具与回合结束 DSH 线程捕获。

description.en: Cipher memory platform as a DSH bundle: four memory types (attention, experience, preference, cognitive) sedimented per turn by four memory agents, cross-session deterministic recall injected via systemPrompt.context, insight review kept out of user-facing output, per-session UNNI/LOOP modes with memory-driven auto-continuation, memory search/ingest tools, plus a settings page (SOUL editor) and an AgentPool panel.
description.zh: 把 cipher 记忆平台原生带进 DSH：四类记忆每轮沉淀、跨会话确定性检索经 systemPrompt.context 注入、洞察复核只进沉淀、会话级 UNNI/LOOP 模式（记忆驱动自动续轮）、记忆检索/写入两个工具，以及设置页（SOUL 编辑器）与 AgentPool 面板。

description.en: Yuque knowledge base as external memory for dsh — auto-injects matching document fragments into conversation, with catalogue search, cloud full-text search and online reading.
description.zh: 把语雀文档作为 dsh 的外部记忆：对话中自动检索并注入相关文档片段，支持目录快照检索、云端全文搜索与在线阅读。

description.en: Global and project text memory with original-message citations, revision history and managed source withdrawal. Public beta.
description.zh: 保留原话引用、修改历史并支持受管来源撤回的全局与项目文字记忆。公开测试版。

description.en: Ships a minimal lesson ledger: brief.ps1 to look up past pitfalls, add-lesson.ps1 to record new ones, deployed into the skills directory and wired into AGENTS.md by the installer. The model checks it before working and turns what it hits into rules, so the same mistake is not made twice. This plugin watches whether that actually happens and shows the result in a tab and under the composer.
description.zh: 自带一套最小账本工具：brief.ps1 查过往踩过的坑，add-lesson.ps1 记新的，安装时自动部署到技能目录并接好 AGENTS.md。模型动手前查一遍、踩坑后记成规则，同一个坑不必踩第二次。本插件负责盯着它有没有真的这么做，并把「查了几次、记了哪几条」摆在面板和输入框下方。

description.en: Build auditable KB packs (SQLite FTS5) from md/txt/docx/pdf with deterministic retrieval and original-text reading.
description.zh: 从 md/txt/docx/pdf 构建可审计知识库包（SQLite FTS5），确定性检索与原文阅读。

plugins.name: dsh-mnemon

description.en: Cross-agent, local-first persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), powered by Mnemon. It shares long-term memory across Mnemon-enabled agents and adds runtime memory, searchable project documents, semantic recall, knowledge graph, and a Sidebar UI.
description.zh: 由 Mnemon 驱动的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）跨 Agent、本地优先的持久记忆插件。它可在支持 Mnemon 的 Agent 之间共享长期记忆，并提供运行时记忆、可检索项目档案、语义召回、知识图谱和 Sidebar UI。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Agent tools for a self-hosted mem0 server: add, search, get, update, delete, history, reset and status memories, with a settings-panel configuration card.
description.zh: 自托管 mem0 记忆读写插件：agent 直接读写自有 mem0 服务（增删查改、搜索、历史、重置、状态），并带设置面板配置卡片。

description.en: Recalls lessons recorded in earlier projects: when the running work matches one, the local model decides whether to inject a short note before the next step. Requires a local Ollama model (default qwen3.5:9b) and the dsh-mnemon store with its mnemon CLI; without them it only observes and logs, never injects.
description.zh: 把在别的项目里记下的经验在当前工作命中时找出来，由本机小模型判断是否在下一步之前插入一条简短提示。需要本机 Ollama（默认 qwen3.5:9b）以及 dsh-mnemon 记忆库与 mnemon CLI；缺了只会观察记录、不会注入。

description.en: Turns local markdown and text documents into a queryable knowledge base with hybrid semantic and keyword search, citation verification, and source injection.
description.zh: 将本地 Markdown 与文本文档转为可检索的知识库，支持语义与关键词混合搜索、引用校验与来源注入。

description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory: a typed `ctx.memory` seam with a zero-dependency SQLite provider, a `memory` tool, and frozen snapshot injection, plus the dsh-memory-protocol v1 rehearsal with an adapter registry and a distributable conformance suite.
description.zh: 有界、分层、带审批门、可审计的跨会话记忆：`ctx.memory` 服务 + 零依赖 SQLite 存储 + `memory` 工具与冻结快照注入，并预演 dsh-memory-protocol v1——适配器注册表与可分发的一致性套件。

description.en: Project-scoped cross-session memory: seven-layer SQLite store (soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic) on node:sqlite, cache-friendly first-message injection plus per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project tools, and idle-window consolidation ("dream") with peak-hour suppression. Prompt texts ship as per-language data files — the framework supports multilingual users.
description.zh: 项目级跨会话记忆：node:sqlite 七层存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/rules/topic），首条消息缓存友好注入 + 每条消息关键词命中，memory_remember/search/find_similar/read/update/project 工具，空闲窗口自动整理记忆（dream，峰时抑制）。prompt 文案按语言数据文件加载——框架支持多语言用户。

description.en: Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.
description.zh: 由 Plastic Labs 维护的 Honcho 记忆插件：会话启动时注入用户画像、会话摘要与相关结论，后台脱敏后逐轮上传对话到 Honcho，提供 honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember 工具及 /honcho 状态命令；通过与其他 Honcho 集成共用的 ~/.honcho/config.json 配置，支持托管的 honcho.dev 或自建实例。

description.en: PLUR memory rendered into the system prompt on each assembly rather than exposed as a tool call, so the block is replaced instead of appended and context stays flat across a session. Fully local hybrid search (BM25 + BGE fused with RRF), plain YAML storage you can edit, per-workspace scoping, and a /plur-memory browser.
description.zh: PLUR 记忆在每次组装时渲染进系统提示词，而非以工具调用形式暴露，因此记忆块是被替换而不是追加，整段会话的上下文长度保持不变。全本地混合检索（BM25 + BGE，RRF 融合）、可直接编辑的纯 YAML 存储、按工作区划分 scope，并提供 /plur-memory 浏览器界面。

description.en: Maintained fork of dsh-memory-eternal: auto-captures knowledge cards into a local Markdown vault and recalls them on demand, with DSH 0.2.0-rc.x compatibility fixes. Original project by EternalNight996 (https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal), MIT.
description.zh: dsh-memory-eternal 的维护版 fork：对话结束自动沉淀知识卡到本地 Markdown 记忆库并按需召回，修复 DSH 0.2.0-rc.x 兼容性。原项目由 EternalNight996 创建并维护（https://github.com/EternalNight996/dsh-memory-eternal），MIT。

description.en: Send "Memory unlocked" to let the AI recall conversations it has forgotten.
description.zh: 发送“大记忆恢复术”来让 AI 回想起忘记的对话。

description.en: Long-term memory kept as plain Markdown plus git: each session opens with a generated memory-context block assembled from a global store and per-project books (role card, user profile, current focus, routing table, recent logs), the plugin records which memory files the agent read and reminds it to extract conclusions while the day's log is unextracted, personas live in roles/<role>/SOUL.md role cards, and it ships a seven-tab settings page in the sidebar plus four skills. Requires Python 3.10+.
description.zh: 以纯 Markdown 加 git 存放长期记忆：每次会话开始按全局总册与各项目册渲染一段 memory-context（人格卡、用户档案、当前焦点、路由表、最近日志），记录代理读过哪些记忆文件，并在当天日志还没提炼时提醒收口；人格放在 roles/<role>/SOUL.md 角色卡里，附侧边栏七页签设置页与四个 skill。依赖 Python 3.10+。

description.en: Lingshu (灵枢) is a brain-inspired persistent memory, persona and growth system for AI coding agents: pure Python standard library, zero dependencies, local-first, requires Python 3.9+. Hippocampus/cortex layered memory with forgetting curves, dream consolidation, fuzzy associative recall, emotion system, persona drift protection, knowledge base, self-authored skills, and a local web panel. Ships as a DSH bundled skill; the separately installable cordis startup-injector plugin auto-injects sessions only when Lingshu is installed at ~/.dsh/skills/lingshu (or brainPy is configured) and Python 3 is available; the optional update check contacts GitHub/Gitee.
description.zh: 灵枢（lingshu-skill）：面向 AI 编程助手的类脑持久记忆、人格与成长系统。纯 Python 标准库、零依赖、本地优先，需 Python 3.9+。海马体/皮层分层记忆与遗忘曲线、做梦巩固、模糊联想回忆、情绪系统、人格漂移防护、知识库、技能自编辑，并带本地可视化面板。以 DSH bundled skill 形式安装；仓库另含可单独安装的 cordis 启动注入插件，仅在灵枢已安装到 ~/.dsh/skills/lingshu（或配置 brainPy）且 Python 3 可用时才会自动注入会话；可选的更新检查会访问 GitHub/Gitee.

description.en: Memory profile composition with Chinese session search, hybrid recall, persistent workspace facts, user-pinned rules and reusable native skills. Install the standalone versioned Release bundle with one dsh plugin add command. Requires Node.js 24 and pnpm on PATH.
description.zh: 记忆 profile 组合：中文会话检索、混合召回、workspace 持久事实、用户固定规则与可复用原生技能。通过单条 dsh plugin add 命令安装版本化 Release 独立包。需 Node.js 24 与 PATH 上的 pnpm。

description.en: Cross-session development worklog for the agent: worklog_add appends one line (optional tag) to today's file, worklog_list reads a day back or lists the days on record. Entries are plain JSON under $DSH_HOME/worklog, so the next session can pick up where the last one stopped.
description.zh: 给 agent 的跨会话开发日志：worklog_add 往当天文件追加一行（可带 tag），worklog_list 按天回读或列出有记录的日期。条目是 $DSH_HOME/worklog 下的纯 JSON，下一次会话能接上上一次停在哪。

description.en: Local-only project memory with zero bundled runtime dependencies or external services: JSON as the source of truth plus generated PROJECT_MEMORY.md, token-bounded session-frozen Hot Memory for prompt-prefix cache stability, cached cross-project BM25 recall, trusted session/turn provenance, explainable pre-write duplicate/conflict governance, editable importance/pin/tags/supersede/archive lifecycle, configurable top-level turn-end distillation, and a bilingual Web GUI for search, inspection, diagnostics, and live settings.
description.zh: 仅本地运行、零捆绑运行时依赖（仅使用 DSH 宿主 peer）且不调用外部服务的项目记忆：以 JSON 为单一事实源并自动生成 PROJECT_MEMORY.md、按 token 有界且按会话冻结的 Hot Memory 以保持 prompt-prefix cache 稳定、带查询缓存的跨项目 BM25 召回、可信 session/turn 溯源、可解释的写前重复/冲突治理、可编辑的重要度/置顶/标签/supersede/归档生命周期、可配置的顶层回合自动蒸馏，以及支持搜索、检查、诊断和实时设置的中英双语 Web GUI。

description.en: A consent-gated personal profile store: people are indexed by name, entries by person and key, and no profile record is read before the current session is authorised. Sensitive entries come back masked unless the user authorises that tier separately; credential-like values are refused at write time. Ages and next birthdays are computed at read time, so asOf restores the answer for a past date, and facts that rot (height, weight, address) carry freshness warnings. Five profile_* tools plus a settings page to browse, edit, delete and revoke grants.
description.zh: 带授权的本地个人信息库：以姓名为索引存人，以「姓名 + 条目」取值，未获当次会话授权不会读取任何档案。敏感条目（证件、银行卡、住址、健康）默认掩码，凭证类数据写入时直接拒收；年龄和下次生日一律查询时现算，asOf 能复原过去某天的答案，身高体重住址这类会过期的条目带新鲜度提醒。提供五个 profile_* 工具和设置页，可浏览、编辑、删除与撤销授权。

description.en: Persistent project memory, event-sourced task lifecycle, context budgeting, and cooperative multi-agent handoffs.
description.zh: 持久化项目记忆、事件溯源的任务生命周期、上下文预算控制与多智能体协作交接。

description.en: MemWeave (dsh-mem-weave) weaves memory into persona: layered memory and a persona editor in one DeepSeek Harness plugin, with a bounded per-turn injection budget, decay and consolidation, a candidate and conflict review queue, 24-hour undo, and calendar reminders, all stored in a local SQLite file.
description.zh: 忆织 MemWeave（dsh-mem-weave）—— 把记忆编织进人格（记忆 × 人格一体 DSH 插件）：分层记忆与人格编辑，每轮注入有固定上限，记忆按层遗忘与整理，候选与冲突需人工确认，写入可在 24 小时内撤销，另有约定与纪念日提醒，全部数据存在本机 SQLite 文件里。

plugins.name: dsh-quberi

description.en: Search the documents and pictures in your Quberi knowledge base, browse its spaces and documents, save notes to it, and upload files into it with your approval for each one, from DeepSeek Harness over OAuth.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过 OAuth 检索你的 Quberi 知识库中的文档和图片，浏览空间和文档，保存笔记，并上传文件（每个文件都需你确认）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Project+global long-term memory for the dsh web GUI: split POST /items endpoints, tool-call context merged into memory items as compact summaries, with deduplication and session-scoped persistence.
description.zh: dsh 网页端项目级+全局长期记忆：分拆 POST /items 路由避免路径冲突，多轮工具调用上下文压缩后存入记忆项，去重与会话级持久化。

description.en: A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.
description.zh: 超级简化版 llm-wiki 记忆插件：一个索引文档（自动加载）+ 每个主题一个 md 文件（需要时才读）——不会把所有东西塞进上下文烧 token。简单轻量，安装卸载无压力，想怎么改就怎么改。

description.en: Closes ai-memory's consolidation loop for DSH: when a DSH session ends it calls ai-memory finalize-session, so the observations DSH captured become wiki pages the other harnesses ai-memory serves can read. Skips subagents, queues concurrent session ends, and sweeps sessions abandoned by a forced restart.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上 ai-memory 的收敛闭环：DSH 会话结束时调用 ai-memory finalize-session，把本次捕获的观察整理成 wiki 页面，供 ai-memory 服务的其他 harness 读取；跳过子代理、串行化并发结束的会话，并补扫被强制重启遗留的会话。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory: captures durable facts from each turn, auto-associates them by shared entity and tag, and recalls with BM25 plus spreading activation over the link graph.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆：从每轮对话抽取持久事实、按共享标签与实体自动建立联想关联，并以 BM25 加关联图激活传播进行召回；提供六个模型可调用工具与一张设置卡片。

description.en: Three-tier agent memory harness: L1 always-on CLAUDE.md, L2 index, L3 detail skeleton with templates, a gate that blocks writes to protected files without a one-time approval token, zero-judgement event logging, weekly distillation, and a TDD execution-loop skill.
description.zh: 三级记忆 agent 底座：L1 常驻层、L2 索引、L3 详情骨架与模板，受保护文件门禁（一次性审批令牌），零判断事件日志，周审提炼与 TDD 执行流技能。

description.en: Mnemosyne memory for DeepSeek Harness: remember / recall / forget / stats / sleep tools, embedded skill, auto-setup, optional auto-sync/prefetch, and a Settings panel. Data lives under ~/.dsh/mnemosyne.
description.zh: Mnemosyne 记忆插件 for DeepSeek Harness：提供 remember / recall / forget / stats / sleep 工具、内嵌技能、Settings 面板和可选的自动记忆功能。

description.en: Nothing stays in the system prompt: a hit returns titles only, a body loads only when read, and project rules can grow themselves.
description.zh: 让东坡肉滚出系统提示：记忆不常驻，命中只给标题，正文读了才进上下文，项目规范还能自己长。

description.en: Conversation history recall for DSH: three-layer (literal/fuzzy/semantic) retrieval over every past session's original text, fully local & offline — AI never forgets what you told it. One-command install via `dsh.bundle.patch`, semantic layer runs in a worker thread.
description.zh: 对话历史回忆：字面/模糊/语义三层检索全部历史会话的原始文本，完全本地离线——AI 再也不会忘记你说的话。一条命令安装（自带 `dsh.bundle.patch`），语义推理跑在 worker 线程。

plugins.name: tmcra-plugin-deepseek-harness

description.en: Cross-app project memory for DeepSeek Harness with role-separated writeback, a visual knowledge workspace, confirmed corrections, session controls, local Writer and organizer settings, and an account-free Windows local installation preview.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨应用项目记忆，支持角色分离写回、可视化知识工作台、确认后纠错、会话控制、本地 Writer 与整理模型设置，以及免账号 Windows 本地安装预览。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, five model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget), automatic recall and hard rules injected into the agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.
description.zh: 一体化本地记忆：按作用域（会话、项目、全局或自定义名）各一个 JSONL 文件、作用域内按内容去重，五个模型工具（memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_get / memory_forget），自动召回与硬性规则注入 agent 的 pre-step，并带一个设置面板。检索是词法 IDF 与本地向量后端的组合，向量后端可由面板一键安装并托管。

description.en: Port of the V2 memory pipeline from OpenAI Codex to DeepSeek Harness: a background agent extracts each idle session, consolidation folds the extractions into one memory_summary.md behind a git baseline diff, new sessions get that summary injected, and cited memory flows back as usage counts. A Settings page chooses the model, each stage's reasoning effort, and the idle, age, concurrency and timeout limits.
description.zh: Codex V2 记忆流水线到 DeepSeek Harness 的移植：后台 agent 逐个抽取空闲会话，整合阶段在 git baseline diff 之后把它们合成一份 memory_summary.md，新会话注入这份摘要，被引用的记忆回流成使用计数。设置页可选模型、两个阶段的思考强度，以及空闲时长、保留天数、并发和超时等上限。

description.en: Long-term memory for dsh with defense-in-depth hardening. Two tiers (project `.dsh-memory/` and user `$DSH_HOME/memory/`), each a plain hand-editable JSON file with bounded entries and tags. Writes are atomic (unique temp file + rename, previous revision kept in a bounded history/) and serialized across processes by a per-tier lock with stale reclaim; a disk-revision check refuses lost updates instead of silently overwriting another writer. Memory text is wrapped in explicit untrusted-data boundaries (forged wrappers stripped on write) to blunt prompt injection from remembered content, load-time validation rejects out-of-bounds stores, and symlink escapes out of the tier directory are refused with MEMORY_STORE_ESCAPE.
