No content-heuristic filtering and no confirmation step, so headless auto-consolidation stays intact. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:RocoFish/deepseek-memory.
description.zh: 带纵深加固的 dsh 长期记忆插件。两层存储（项目级 `.dsh-memory/` 与用户级 `$DSH_HOME/memory/`），每层就是一个可手改、可 diff 的纯 JSON 文件，条目与标签均有上限。写入原子（唯一临时文件 + rename，旧版本进入有上限的 history/ 备份），跨进程由带过期回收的 per-tier 锁串行化；磁盘 revision 校验拒绝丢失更新，绝不静默覆盖其他写入者。记忆文本以显式 untrusted-data 边界包装（伪造包装标签写入时剥除）以削弱记忆内容中的提示注入，加载时校验拒绝越界存储，tier 目录外的符号链接逃逸以 MEMORY_STORE_ESCAPE 拒绝。不做内容启发式过滤、不加确认步骤，无头自动巩固流程不受影响。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add github:RocoFish/deepseek-memory。

description.en: Roleplay companion memory for DeepSeek Harness: per-conversation editable persona documents (1-100 weight per entry, AI may refine them in small story-driven steps), per-speaker favorability and bond in multi-person chats, active memories with AI-scored vectors, a nine-emotion table updated every turn, an AI self-evolution ledger, recent 48-hour transcript search, companion-style conversation compression, a date-archived local knowledge base with auto-packing by turns or tokens, and a unified integrations page that lists curated plugins and downloads their GitHub releases.
description.zh: 《AI记忆》角色扮演伴侣记忆：每个对话独立的人格文档（每条设定可配 1~100 权重，默认允许 AI 小步润色角色性格与例句）、多人对话按说话人分开记录的好感度与羁绊、带 AI 打分的活跃记忆、每轮实时更新的九种情绪表、AI 自我演化的性格/喜好/习惯、最近 48 小时对话检索、伴侣式上下文压缩、按日期归档的本地知识库（支持按轮数或 tokens 自动打包），以及统一「接入软件」页（收录精选插件并从 GitHub 下载发布包）。

description.en: Connects the Drafta notes app to DeepSeek Harness over MCP, so the agent can search, read and write notes in your local Drafta library.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 把 Drafta 笔记应用接到 DeepSeek Harness，让智能体可以检索、读取并写入你本地 Drafta 库中的笔记。

description.en: Semantic retrieval, resource management, auto-recall (user + agent dual spaces) and session memory for DeepSeek Harness: memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob over viking:// URIs, memadd/memremove resource management, memqueue observer status, memcommit session capture, and memlearn skill playbook minting.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 语义检索、资源管理、自动召回（user + agent 双空间）与会话记忆插件：基于 viking:// URI 的 memsearch/memfind/memread/membrowse/memgrep/memglob 检索工具、memadd/memremove 资源管理、memqueue 队列状态、memcommit 会话捕获，以及 memlearn 技能手册沉淀。

description.en: Hides other memory plugins' context sections and tools inside a chosen DSH preset, so that session gets a clean context. Off by default; ships a read-only diagnostic tool.
description.zh: 在指定 DSH preset 里挡掉其他记忆插件的上下文段与工具，让该会话拿到干净上下文。bundle 形态、默认关闭，带只读诊断工具。

description.en: Keep conclusions alive across context compaction: the model writes a task checkpoint and the plugin re-injects it into the system prompt's first node — the span compaction never touches, so it survives any number of compactions. Four-tier injection (0/95/175/≤12000 chars) scales with session relatedness; checkpoints live in the plugin's own folder, never in your workspace.
description.zh: 让结论活过上下文压缩：模型把任务状态写成检查点，插件把它注入到 DSH 系统提示词首节点——那里永不参与压缩，所以压缩 100 次结论也不丢。四档注入（0/95/175/≤12000 字符）按会话关系收放；检查点写在插件自有目录，工作区一个文件都不多。

description.en: Project memory for coding agents on DeepSeek Harness: similar past edits surface as precedents, out-of-scope edits are blocked, and cognition persists across sessions (47 upstream-verified fixes, gold-free 20-task run).
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的项目记忆:历史相似编辑作为先例出现、越界修改被 scope 锁拦下、认知跨会话持续积累(47 次上游验收修复、去 gold 化 20/20)。

description.en: Manage soul.md persona cards and long-term memory, with workspace and session persona selection and tools to read and update them.
description.zh: 管理 soul.md 人设卡与长期记忆，支持按工作区和会话选择人设，并提供读取和更新工具。

description.en: TencentDB Agent Memory integration with conversation capture, structured memory extraction, automatic recall, and memory and conversation search tools.
description.zh: 集成 TencentDB Agent Memory，支持对话捕获、结构化记忆提取、自动召回，以及记忆和对话搜索工具。

description.en: Per-workspace memo/todo panel that auto-captures queued and running user instructions, marks preempted tasks as interrupted, and restores them to their previous state with one click.
description.zh: 按工作区记录未完成任务：自动捕获排队/执行中的用户指令，插队自动标记打断，一键按原状态恢复重发。

description.en: Local Git-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness with hybrid CJK/English retrieval, cited context, transactional sync, previews, and rollback.
description.zh: 基于本地 Git 的 DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆，提供中英文混合检索、带引用的上下文、事务式同步、预览与回滚。

description.en: Neuron-inspired memory for dsh: turns buffer into a hippocampus, a nightly patrol classifies fragments into pools, and each turn injects a minimal auto-compacted handoff, the live mood (via dsh-feiyu-mood), and only relevance-filtered memories (Ebbinghaus half-life decay; recalled memories are reinforced like spaced repetition). Hard caps bound storage; past-session original text is searchable over multi-frame zstd; dsh-fish-memory stores can be imported. Optional vector retrieval (off by default, keyword fallback). The 3D panel offers four themes and pulses a signal from the center to each recalled memory.
description.zh: 仿神经元记忆框架：对话自动进海马体，夜巡按关键词分池归档，每轮只注入最小交接（自动压缩）、当前心情（对接 dsh-feiyu-mood）和相关性命中的记忆（艾宾浩斯半衰期衰减，被想起时会像间隔重复一样强化），跨会话、抗上下文压缩；单条/每池硬上限防膨胀，历史会话原文可检索（多帧 zstd），可导入 dsh-fish-memory；可选向量检索（默认关，服务不可用退回关键词）。3D 面板提供星云/皮层/矩阵/极简四套主题，记忆被想起时从中心向节点脉冲。

description.en: Brings your existing Claude / ChatGPT history into DSH: instant zero-token import of the memories.json inside a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts with no export needed, and conversations distilled through the model you already configured in DSH. Every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code — a paraphrase is dropped and counted, and evidence found only in the assistant turns is always routed to review rather than stored.
description.zh: 把你在 Claude / ChatGPT 里已有的历史搬进 DSH：Claude 导出包里的 memories.json 零 token 瞬时入库，本机 Claude Code 记录免导出直读，历史对话用你在 DSH 里已配好的模型提纯。每条记忆都带由代码回原文核对的逐字证据——转述会被丢弃并计数，只在 AI 回复里找到的证据一律转人工确认而非直接入库。

description.en: Long-term memory kept as blocks: one event per block, written to a local append-only event log with a block view and derived indexes, so a full history stays recoverable while only the matching blocks reach the context. The model saves entries with memory_remember and pulls the relevant few with memory_recall, plus one automatic recall pass before each step. Data stays in ~/.beme; no external service and no API key.
description.zh: 块记忆式长期记忆：一件事一块，写进本地只追加的事件账本，再派生块视图与索引，历史全量可回溯，进入上下文的只有匹配的那几块。模型用 memory_remember 记一条、用 memory_recall 取回相关的几条，每步之前还有一次自动召回。数据留在 ~/.beme，不连外部服务，不需要 API key。

description.en: Portable agent knowledge base in plain OKF v0.2 Markdown: 13 wiki_* read/write tools, progressive disclosure, backlinks, gated writes via AGENTS.md rules, auto index/log maintenance, linting, and named multi-bundle switching (session-level or global).
description.zh: 纯 OKF v0.2 Markdown 的通用 agent 知识库：13 个 wiki_* 读写工具、渐进披露、backlinks、AGENTS.md 门控写入、index/log 自动维护、lint 体检，以及命名多目录 bundle 切换（会话级或全局）。

description.en: SQLite memory entries, a calendar with due-time reminders, and cron-scheduled agent tasks, with 13 model tools and a bilingual zh/en UI.
description.zh: SQLite 条目化记忆、日历到点提醒，以及 cron 驱动的定时 agent 任务；13 个模型工具，中英双语界面。

description.en: Zero-LLM auto-capture and a symbolic \[ENGRAM\] index with progressive disclosure, an ESR-lite task/evidence protocol (esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link), and per-workspace usage telemetry with an offline recall benchmark (npm run eval).
description.zh: 零 LLM 自动捕获 + 符号化 \[ENGRAM\] 索引渐进披露，配 ESR-lite 任务/证据闭环（esr_task / esr_node / esr_close / esr_link）、按工作区的真实使用遥测与离线召回基准（npm run eval）。

description.en: The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: recalls you and your projects across sessions, consolidates memories while idle (autoDream), freezes conflicting memories for your review, and keeps a replayable audit trail. Memory stays on your machine as SQLite with human-editable Markdown mirrors; four-way recall (keyword, vector, BM25, entity graph) and an interactive memory panel ship with it, plus 10 model tools, an MCP server, an external API and a CLI. Summarization and consolidation run on the host model you already configured; with a local embedder, semantic search runs fully offline.
description.zh: 会做梦的记忆 — DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记忆插件：跨会话记住你与项目，空闲时自动巩固记忆（autoDream），冲突记忆先冻结待你裁决，全程可回放审计。记忆落在本机：SQLite 存储配可人工编辑的 Markdown 镜像；附带四路召回（关键词、向量、BM25、实体图谱）与交互式记忆库面板，另有 10 个模型工具、MCP 服务端、外部 API 与 CLI。摘要与巩固走你已配置的宿主模型；把嵌入换成本地模型后，语义检索可完全离线运行。

description.en: Unified long-term memory hub: captures turns into L0 evidence, distills in the background into L1 facts / L2 scenes / L3 profile (depth configurable), recalls via hybrid BM25+fuzzy search, ships 13 memory_* tools, traceable lineage back to source turns, optional Hindsight backend, and a built-in memory panel with three entry points.
description.zh: 统一长期记忆中枢：自动捕获对话沉淀为 L0 原始证据，后台分层蒸馏为 L1 事实 / L2 场景 / L3 画像（层数可配），BM25+模糊混合检索召回，13 个 memory_* 工具，记忆谱系可回溯到原始记录，可选 Hindsight 云记忆后端，内置记忆管理面板（设置页、侧边栏、独立整页三入口）。

description.en: Layered global and workspace memory for DeepSeek Harness, with a web panel to browse entries and tune distillation and consolidation, an index kept in context with records loaded on demand, and a per-session choice of layer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供分层的全局与工作区记忆：Web 面板中查看、控制条目并调整记忆整理与整合设置；索引常驻上下文、详情按需加载，每个对话手动选择要加载的记忆层。

description.en: Long-term memory for dsh via a local Hindsight service: each turn is retained with local timestamps and relevant memories (time-aware, reranked) are recalled into context before replies; each workspace binds to one memory bank, several workspaces can share a bank, and banks can have Chinese names; what gets retained is configurable (default: user messages and AI replies); history is imported only when you choose to; includes a three-step setup page with one-click local deployment (uv + Python 3.12), a sidebar status card and a panel to browse and search memories. Needs a SiliconFlow API key for the default embedding and reranker models; only Linux is verified so far.
description.zh: dsh 长期记忆（基于本地 Hindsight 服务）：每轮对话带本地时间写入记忆库，回答前按问题与时间检索并经 reranker 排序后注入上下文；每个工作区绑定一个记忆库，多个工作区可共用同一个库，记忆库可起中文名；记住哪些内容可设置（默认只记用户消息与 AI 回复）；以前的对话不自动导入，由用户手动选择导入；提供三步设置页与一键本地部署（自动准备 uv 与 Python 3.12）、侧栏状态卡片及可浏览、搜索记忆的控制面板。默认的向量与排序模型需要一个硅基流动 API 密钥，目前只在 Linux 上实测。

description.en: Hippocampus: renders workspace files, DSH memories and past sessions as a rotatable neuron graph in the sidebar, with Chinese-friendly labels and automatic re-indexing on every start.
description.zh: 海马体：把工作区文件、DSH 记忆和历史会话画成一张可旋转的神经元网络，挂在侧栏随时翻；条目名自动整理成中文短句，每次启动自动重新索引。

description.en: Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved.
description.zh: 基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。

description.en: Knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: assembles ContextWindow evidence at query time within heading boundaries and token budgets, with follow-up reading around each search anchor; combines BM25/vector search via weighted RRF, MMR and optional local/remote reranking; provides automatic evidence injection, a browser panel for local embedding/rerank/OCR model downloads and health checks, keyword search without model downloads, and in-place rescans of imported directories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 知识库：查询时按标题边界与 Token 预算动态组织 ContextWindow 证据，支持围绕命中锚点续读原文；通过加权 RRF 融合 BM25 与向量召回，支持 MMR 去冗余和本地／远程重排；提供回答前自动证据注入、本地 embedding／rerank／OCR 模型下载与健康检查面板、无需下载模型的关键词检索，以及导入目录原地重扫。

description.en: A long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Every turn is judged and stored into a local SQLite (utterance / event / version / stage / decision), with a browsable panel.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆插件。每轮聊完自动把话判一遍，存进本地 SQLite（话、事、版本、阶段、决定五层），带一块能翻能筛的面板。

description.en: Notes-backed context compression for DeepSeek Harness: replaces LLM-summarized compaction with a model-written persistent notebook plus recoverable raw history, so the rollover boundary itself costs zero model calls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供笔记式上下文压缩：用模型维护的持久笔记本取代 LLM 摘要式压缩，并保留可恢复的原始历史，窗口边界本身不产生模型调用。

description.en: Brain-inspired cognitive plugin: episodic, semantic, procedural and emotional memory with reinforcement-learning signals, a goal stack with time triggers, curiosity-driven autonomous web research and proactive initiatives.
description.zh: 受大脑启发的认知插件:情景、语义、程序与情绪记忆,带强化学习信号;目标栈支持时间触发器,好奇心驱动的自主网络研究与主动提议。

description.en: Keeps notes as local Markdown files grouped by directory under a root folder you choose, with a sidebar page, AGENTS-style rule files surfaced as writing context, and six agent tools.
description.zh: 把笔记存成你选定根目录下按分组组织的本地 Markdown 文件，带侧栏页面，并把 AGENTS 等规则 md 作为写作上下文，另有六个 agent 工具。

description.en: Feeds every dsh prompt into the local agent-feedback-loop feedback-memory pipeline — captures dissatisfaction, reviews it offline into reflections, and attaches the compiled recurrence-rule context back to the turn, never blocking a prompt. Requires the agent-feedback-loop runtime; running agent-feedback-loop install afterwards wires existing dsh profiles automatically.
description.zh: 把 dsh 的每一轮 prompt 送入本地 agent-feedback-loop 反馈记忆管线——捕获用户不满、离线评审沉淀为反思，并把编译好的复发规则上下文附着回当前轮次，从不阻塞 prompt。需要先安装 agent-feedback-loop 运行时；安装后执行 agent-feedback-loop install 会自动接线已有的 dsh profile。

description.en: Bridges the MemOS memory service over MCP: the agent gets add/search/update/delete memory, multi-cube sharing, and a memory scheduler as mcp__memos__* tools.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 桥接 MemOS 记忆服务：agent 获得 mcp__memos__* 记忆写入/检索/更新/删除、多 Cube 共享与记忆调度工具。

description.en: Project-scoped SQLite memory with progressive retrieval, bounded context, a composer button and visual review. Install the repository-root DSH bundle, then run /learning-init with an absolute project path using local Python 3.10+.
description.zh: 项目级 SQLite 记忆，支持渐进检索、有界上下文、聊天框按键与可视化审批。安装仓库根 DSH Bundle 后，用本机 Python 3.10+ 执行 /learning-init 加项目绝对路径完成初始化。

description.en: A context usage ring with configurable character-based automatic compaction, manual compaction, protected user requirements and recoverable original history for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 上下文用量环，支持按字符自定义自动压缩阈值、手动压缩、保留用户要求和回查原文，适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Local-first Agent Experience Network for DeepSeek Harness, distilling task-level experiences from traces and live manifests, grading by H0-H4 evidence, discovering by compatibility, and promoting only after explicit review.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先 Agent 经验网络：从 trace 与实时 Manifest 蒸馏任务级经验，按 H0-H4 证据分级、按兼容性发现，经显式审阅后才晋升。

description.en: A memory subsystem for DeepSeek Harness: full ontological memory (event/fact/rule three-ontology) plus a goal system (goal.js) — belief values written via Bridge trigger words, goal activation scored at read time (0.25 domain + 0.35 bridge + 0.40 sim) to recover goal/value long-range associations, journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay, memory_append/read/consolidate plus linghun_goal_update/get/state closed loop. Independent of the original dsh-linghun line. 16/16 on LoCoMo-Plus.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的记忆子系统：记忆完全本体化（event/fact/rule 三本体）+ 目标系统（goal.js）——belief 价值观写侧收录 + Bridge 触发词，读侧重匹配公式（0.25 域命中 + 0.35 触发词 + 0.40 相似度）补上 goal/value 语义远距联想；序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘；memory_append/read/consolidate + linghun_goal_update/get/state 读写沉淀闭环。独立于原 dsh-linghun 演进。LoCoMo-Plus 16/16 满分。

description.en: Seven shared engineering skills, a read-only project dashboard with amendments, options, stages and SQLite audit browsing, and workflow request previews for DSH.
description.zh: 七个共享工程技能、支持修正里程碑、可选项、阶段及 SQLite 审计浏览的只读项目仪表盘，以及 DSH 工作流请求预览。

description.en: Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.
description.zh: 以唯识心所与种子藏记录 agent 的状态，并以第一人称倾向写回提示词。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory: a hybrid-retrieval memory store (BM25 plus CJK bigrams), chunked long-document search, chat-log extraction and distillation, and context-summary archiving and browsing, with important memories and the latest summaries auto-injected into the prompt.
description.zh: 跨会话长期记忆包：混合检索记忆库（BM25+中文二元分词）、长文切块检索、聊天记录提取精炼，外加上下文总结存档与翻阅，重要记忆与最新总结自动注入提示词。

description.en: Registers the local flowix-cli MCP server so the agent can search, read, create, and edit Flowix memos and mind-map artifacts.
description.zh: 将本地 flowix-cli 注册为 MCP 服务，让 agent 可以搜索、读取、创建和编辑 Flowix 备忘与思维导图产物。

description.en: Offline meme and slang dictionary: 6,668 built-in entries are looked up before a turn and injected only when a message looks like a meme question. Ships a lookup tool, a settings page for adding/editing/deleting entries and aliases, an adjustable tone slider for how far it plays along, and a built-in version check.
description.zh: 离线梗/黑话词典：内置 6668 条词条，只在消息像在问梗时才提前查好注入上下文。带查询工具、可增删改词条与别名的设置页、可调的玩梗尺度滑杆，以及检查版本更新。

description.en: Notes taken from DeepSeek Harness conversations: quotes whole replies or selected passages, keeps highlights rendered at their original position in the session, attaches editable Markdown notes, tags them, filters by workspace or session, and exports Markdown or a full JSON backup stored as local JSON files.
description.zh: 从 DSH 会话里记笔记：可收藏整条回复或选中片段，划线会持久重绘回原文位置，可为其补写可编辑的 Markdown 笔记、打标签，按工作区或会话筛选，并导出 Markdown 或完整 JSON 备份；数据以本机 JSON 文件存储。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness kept as plain markdown, one fact per file. Every step the `MEMORY.md` index (the project store if there is one, plus a global store under `$DSH_HOME`) goes into the runtime context, so recall does not wait for a file read. The index has a hard cap, 200 lines / 25 KB by default, enforced by `ctx.tools.guard()`: a write that grows an over-cap index is denied, a rewrite that shrinks it passes. A read-only sidebar Memory page lists the notes by type. The plugin never writes memories on its own. An experimental companion mode adds note types for a persona's own life. The same store also works with Claude Code, Codex, Kiro and OpenClaw.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆，以纯 markdown 保存，一条事实一个文件。每一步都把索引 `MEMORY.md`（有项目库时含项目库，另加 `$DSH_HOME` 下的全局库）放进运行时上下文，召回不用等模型去读文件。索引有硬上限，默认 200 行 / 25KB，由 `ctx.tools.guard()` 强制执行：让已超限的索引变大的写入被拒绝，缩小它的重写一律放行。左侧栏有只读的「记忆」页，按类型列出笔记。插件不会自行写入记忆。实验性的大肥鱼模式为人设角色加了记录它自己人生的笔记类型。同一个记忆库也可供 Claude Code、Codex、Kiro、OpenClaw 使用。

plugins.name: dsh-memu-memory

description.en: Memory for long-form RP and companion chats: three fading layers, per-turn recall, source labels, character and world boundaries, a relationship graph, image attachments and a WebUI.
description.zh: 面向长篇 RP 与陪伴对话的记忆插件：三层记忆、逐轮召回、来源标注、角色与世界线边界、关系图、图片附件与独立 WebUI。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A biomimetic memory plugin for DSH that folds context into token clues and reconstructs memories on-demand.
description.zh: 记忆插件：上下文放不下时把旧轮次蒸馏成 Token 线索并从历史中切除，需要时用线索重建记忆。

description.en: Per-project memory for DeepSeek Harness. Three Markdown files per workspace — PROJECT.md, DECISIONS.md and SESSIONS.md — are auto-created on the first step of any session in that workspace, re-read from disk and re-injected only when they change (and re-injected if compaction dropped them), and written back by classification through a memory_checkpoint tool, with a bounded end-of-turn nudge when a turn did work but recorded nothing. memory_read and memory_search read the live log and the archive, the latter over a zero-dependency BM25 index. The session log is capped at 200 entries with the overflow moved to SESSIONS-archive.md — never injected, but visible, readable and searchable, and restorable one entry at a time. Settings page: a workspace list with a path filter, read-only tabs for the three memory files plus the archive, reload, export/import of one workspace's memory as a JSON bundle, a two-step clear, a panel that rewrites or removes the AGENTS.md instruction block, and a PROJECT.md staleness reminder. A composer status chip shows that workspace's sync state and creates the files on click. Zero dependencies — no vector store, no embeddings, and no model calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的项目记忆插件。每个工作区三份 Markdown 文件（PROJECT.md / DECISIONS.md / SESSIONS.md）：会话首个步骤自动创建、内容变了才重新注入（被上下文压缩挤掉也会重注入），并按分类经 memory_checkpoint 工具写回，在「干了实事却没记录」时给一次收尾提醒。memory_read 与 memory_search 可读活日志与归档，后者走零依赖 BM25 索引。会话日志上限 200 条，溢出搬进 SESSIONS-archive.md —— 不自动注入，但可见、可读、可搜，并能逐条恢复。设置界面：带路径筛选的工作区列表 / 三份记忆文件与归档的只读页签 / 重新读取 / 单个工作区记忆包的导出导入（JSON）/ 两步确认的清除 / AGENTS.md 指令段的重写或移除面板 / PROJECT.md 陈旧提醒。输入框状态图标显示该工作区的同步状态，无记忆时可点击创建。零依赖——不含向量库、embedding 或模型调用。

description.en: Bounded self-managed long-term memory (Hermes-style MEMORY.md / USER.md with hard character limits and a safety scan), a review that runs after every turn and writes plain-language notes or refines an existing skill instead of adding a near-duplicate, a curator that finds and surgically repairs skills the loader would silently discard, cross-session search over past messages, and a learning card above the composer that appears only when there is news and asks before it deletes or rewords a memory.
description.zh: 有界自管的长期记忆（Hermes 式 MEMORY.md / USER.md，硬字符上限 + 写入前安全扫描）；每轮结束后自动复盘，用大白话写笔记、或把新知识合并进已有技能而不堆出雷同技能；curator 找出会被加载器静默丢弃的技能并外科式修复；跨会话搜索历史消息；输入框上方的学习卡片只在有新闻时出现，删改记忆前必须先问你。

description.en: Local memory for DeepSeek Harness: what you write is filed under a topic and linked to related entries, recall ranks results by embedding similarity (word matching when no model is installed), and the data stays in a local SQLite database.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆插件：写下的内容按主题归档、与相关条目连边，召回按向量相似度排序（没装模型时退回词面匹配），数据存在本地 SQLite 库里。

description.en: Local SQLite long-term memory with CJK-aware search, BM25 and character n-gram cosine reranking, deduplication, and lifecycle management.
description.zh: 基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆，支持 CJK 分词检索、BM25 与字符 n-gram 余弦重排、去重和生命周期管理。

description.en: Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

description.en: Forgetting-curve in-place dialogue compression for DeepSeek Harness: recent turns stay verbatim, middle turns are structurally dehydrated (zero-LLM), ancient turns fold into a bounded summary pair — unbounded conversations on a bounded memory budget.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于自然遗忘曲线的就地对话压缩：近期对话逐字保留、中期结构化脱水（零 LLM 成本）、久远对话折叠为有界摘要对——有限记忆预算上的无限对话。

description.en: Model-driven context compression (Active Context Pruning) for DeepSeek Harness: the model decides when and what to compress.
description.zh: 模型驱动的上下文压缩（Active Context Pruning）：由模型决定何时压缩、压缩什么。

description.en: Local relationship-memory workbench with a confirmation gate: every AI write — extracted memories and newly created contacts alike — lands in a pending queue until the user confirms it in the GUI; materials are archived verbatim with quote-level provenance checks on AI extraction, and confirmed memories aggregate into per-contact timelines, gift occasions and reciprocity views. Ships a native relationship agent preset for conversation capture; JSON storage by default with an optional SQLite backend, zero production dependencies.
description.zh: 本地关系记忆工作台，一切 AI 写入先过确认闸门：AI 提取的记忆与新建的联系人都先进入待确认队列，由用户在界面拍板收录；素材逐字存档，AI 提取时逐条校验原话摘录溯源；已确认记忆聚合为联系人时间线、礼赠时机与往来视图。内置「关系记忆」agent preset 支持对话录入；默认 JSON 存储、可选 SQLite 后端，零生产依赖。

description.en: Hindsight, agent memory that learns: long-term project memory with auto recall and retain, knowledge pages, deep reflection, and per-repo memory banks.
description.zh: Hindsight：会学习的 Agent 长期记忆系统，自动召回/保存、知识页、深度反思与按仓库隔离的记忆银行。

description.en: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.
description.zh: 一个 Obsidian 风格的知识库：摄取资料，让 LLM 构建并维护互联 wiki，并基于它提问。

description.en: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.
description.zh: 可逆的上下文瘦身插件：均匀 JSON 数组走 TOON 式无损表格化重编码，管道表按行号抽样保留窗口，90 秒内字节级相同的工具输出跨轮去重；每次替换都要通过双重门（压缩后 ≤72% 字节且估算 token 严格下降），原文落盘并以 `[save-token #id]` 标记，可用 `save_token_expand` 工具一步取回；设置页仪表盘分别统计实际计费与节省的 token。

description.en: OpenViking memory and context bundle for DeepSeek Harness: pre-step auto-recall and profile injection, session capture, `viking://` URI guarding, and recall/write memory tools backed by an OpenViking server.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenViking 记忆与上下文插件：pre-step 自动召回与画像注入、会话捕获、`viking://` URI 防护，以及对接 OpenViking 服务端的 recall/write 记忆工具。

description.en: Reads the session files forty-two other coding agents on this machine already wrote (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Cline, Zed and more), including sessions from before it was installed: six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall added to the runtime context. Local BM25 index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).
description.zh: 读取本机上其他四十二个编程智能体已经写下的会话文件（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code Copilot Chat、opencode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Kimi、Cline、Zed 等），包括安装之前的历史：提供 deja_recall、deja_session、deja_blame、deja_fix、deja_how、deja_remember 六个工具与 /deja 命令，并可选地把召回结果加入运行时上下文。本地 BM25 索引，不用大模型，不用向量嵌入，不联网（dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja）。

plugins.name: dsh-anima-rag

description.en: Anima-style vector memory for DSH: injects retrieved historical summaries into the system prompt each turn, exposes an anima_query semantic-search tool, and isolates the vector store per playthrough. SiliconFlow embeddings sent as array-shaped requests; timeouts and provider errors surface as honest, classified notes in the injection slot — never silent.
description.zh: Anima 式向量记忆：每轮把语义检索到的历史总结注入 system prompt，提供 anima_query 检索工具，向量库按周目隔离；SiliconFlow 嵌入（数组形状请求），嵌入超时/网络错分级如实写进注入格，绝不静默失败。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: RP memory built on pmp tavern: RP history summaries ride the native compaction pipeline, with plain tool sessions kept out of the way. Full recall requires the downstream anima plugin. Requires the plugin-provided roleplay preset to be enabled.
description.zh: 基于 pmp tavern 的 RP 记忆库：利用原版压缩机制管理 RP 历史总结，并隔离一般工具会话。完整召回功能需配合下游 anima 插件。需要启用插件注入的角色扮演预设。

description.en: Single-file persistent companion memory: interests, preferences, tasks, and past works summarized into the system prompt, with read/update tools.
description.zh: 单文件持久陪伴记忆：把兴趣、偏好、任务与过往作品摘要注入系统提示词，提供读取与更新工具。

description.en: Per-workspace memory library with manual per-chat opt-in, editable rules, three sharing modes, and continuous forgetting; cards stay readable Markdown.
description.zh: 按工作区隔离的记忆库，支持按对话手动开启、可编辑规则、三种共用模式和连续遗忘；记忆卡仍是可读的 Markdown。

description.en: Make the AI remember how you think, not what you said: actively captures your principles, redlines, and working habits across sessions — with memory capacity, graceful decay, and human-readable reasoning for every entry. 0.7.0 brings an intuitive persona portrait with evidence tracing.
description.zh: 让模型主动记下你的判断依据（原则/红线/工作方式），跨会话复用 —— 有容量上限、会遗忘、每条都说得出为什么记。0.7.0 重构为画像式速写，带证据追溯与红线硬约束，告别冷冰冰的数据库列表。

description.en: Context trimmer: lists the current session's context entries with role, preview and ≈token estimate (cl100k), highlights over-threshold items, and removes selected entries exactly without LLM summarization.
description.zh: 上下文剃刀：把当前会话上下文逐条列出（角色/预览/≈token 估算），超阈值标红，勾选后不经 LLM 精确裁剪，删了什么一目了然。

description.en: Automatic session retrospective: after a conversation wraps up, distills useful experience into reusable skills stored in the skill library for the model to call, with signal-accelerated triggers, manual runs, an approval mode, and skill-library governance (archive/restore, never deletes directly).
description.zh: 自动复盘：对话收尾后自动把有价值的经验蒸馏成可复用的技能（skill）存入技能库，支持信号加速触发、手动立即复盘、审批模式与技能库治理（归档/恢复，永不直接删除）。

description.en: Syncs Logseq 2.0 DB graphs (including E2EE) with a Logseq sync server via the headless Logseq CLI, adds 11 logseq_* tools to search, query and edit them, and a Settings section to log in and configure sync.
description.zh: 通过无头运行的 Logseq CLI，把 Logseq 2.0 DB 图谱（含 E2EE 加密图谱）与同步服务器保持同步，提供 11 个 logseq_* 工具用于搜索、查询和编辑，并在设置页里登录和配置同步。

description.en: Per-turn development progress memory: completed turns are classified into date-indexed Markdown files under doc/progress/ with a maintained INDEX.md, system-level bugs are kept in a cross-project SYSTEM_MEMORY.md and re-injected on error keywords, and a progress_read tool loads full documents on demand.
description.zh: 逐轮开发进度记忆：每轮完成后分类写入 doc/progress/ 下按日期索引的 Markdown 文件并维护 INDEX.md，系统级问题记入跨项目 SYSTEM_MEMORY.md 并在出现报错关键词时重新注入，progress_read 工具可按需读取完整文档。

description.en: Indexes each chat of a workspace into a small topic graph every 4 turns (one model call, verbatim source kept under .context-graph/), appends up to 5 matching topics from the other chats to each message, searching a named day such as "yesterday" first, and adds a recall tool that returns the original text by topic, chat, day or turn. On and shared by default; /context-graph off and unshare opt a chat out, and stats, build, map and find inspect it.
description.zh: 每 4 轮把工作区里的每个对话索引成小型主题图谱（一次模型调用，原文保存在 .context-graph/），在每条消息末尾附上其他对话中最多 5 个匹配主题，提到“昨天”等时间时先搜那一天，并提供 recall 工具按主题、对话、日期或轮次取回原文。默认开启并共享；/context-graph off 与 unshare 可让某个对话退出，stats、build、map、find 用于查看。

description.en: Mebular · shared memory and task collaboration for agents. Through a DSH-native plugin it offers cross-device, cross-agent memory sharing and task graphs. The plugin attaches to an existing Mebular app or CLI runtime, and its panel installs the shared runtime on demand when none exists; it never starts or downloads Mebular silently.
description.zh: Mebular 忆云 · 智能体共享记忆与任务协作。通过 DSH 原生插件提供跨设备、跨 Agent 的记忆共享与任务图。插件连接已有的 Mebular App/CLI 运行时；没有时可在面板里按提示安装共享运行时，不会静默启动或下载 Mebular。

description.en: File-backed memory: injects your own Markdown memory file at each session start, adds read/write tools with backup and undo, and reports DSH_HOME drift. Reads no conversations by default; an opt-in autoScan switch surfaces your own recent lines from local session logs. Never opens a network connection.
description.zh: 文件型长期记忆：每个会话开始注入你自己的 Markdown 记忆文件，提供带备份与撤销的读写工具，并能查出 DSH_HOME 漂移。默认不读对话；可选开启 autoScan 后，才从本机会话日志里提取你自己的发言交给 agent 归档。不联网。

description.en: Memory consolidation tuning for dsh-mneme (autoDream enabled, schema-max output budget, deepseek-chat route) plus the llm-deepseek reasoning-effort fix, an MCP bridge to the auditable seed-society agent runtime, and six yogacara seed skills.
description.zh: 面向 dsh-mneme 的记忆巩固调优（开启 autoDream、放大输出预算、deepseek-chat 路由）与 llm-deepseek 推理力度修复，附带可审计智能体运行时 seed-society 的 MCP 工具桥与六个唯识种子技能。

description.en: Local-first experience library for DeepSeek Harness: indexed markdown knowledge with error-signature retrieval, failure capture, gap-to-entry closure, and a sidebar panel. Ships a sanitized starter library. No network access.
description.zh: 本地优先的经验库：给 DeepSeek Harness 的索引化 markdown 知识，支持错误签名检索、失败采集、缺口→条目闭环与侧边栏面板；自带脱敏起步库，不联网。

description.en: A local-first personal state record and decision engine for dsh: keeps every input byte-for-byte with line-level provenance, argues against its own conclusions by generating defeaters first, ages each stored fact with its own TTL, and reports where a decision rests on nothing at all.
description.zh: 本地优先的个人状态档案与决策引擎：逐字保留你的原始输入并精确到行地溯源，给出结论前先生成"证伪项"反驳自己，为每个事实单独设置有效期，并指出这个决定正建立在哪些空白之上。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DSH: export every session to readable Markdown transcripts, keep one long-term MEMORY.md, and get a wake-up summary in a fresh window.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆：会话自动导出成能读的 Markdown（带出处），维护一份长期 MEMORY.md，新窗口醒来先看摘要。

description.en: Local-folder knowledge base for DSH: builds a SQLite FTS5 index over Office, text, PDF and scanned files, ships five tools (kb_search / kb_read / kb_list / kb_status / kb_session) plus a Web panel, and retrieves or syncs only when the user explicitly asks.
description.zh: DSH 本地文件夹知识库：把 Office、文本、PDF 与扫描件建成 SQLite FTS5 索引，提供 kb_search / kb_read / kb_list / kb_status / kb_session 五个工具与 Web 面板；仅在用户点名时检索，仅在手动触发时同步。

description.en: Adds a Chat mode beside Work with a user-defined persona, long-term memory extracted after each turn and recalled by topic, and stickers it can save and send.
description.zh: 在「工作」之外加一个「聊天」模式：使用自定义人设，每轮自动提炼长期记忆并按话题召回，还能保存和发送表情包。

description.en: Three ledgers for a model that loses context between restarts. Self-note: what I have become — capped at 40 entries, and every eviction first leaves a one-line crease recording which entry was dropped and why. Judgment ledger: record a claim together with how to verify it, come back when it is due, and mark it right or wrong; wrong ones stay in a mistakes book so you stop assuming you were always correct. Handoff: where this run stopped and what the next one should read first — a baton, not a memory. Three tools each taking an action parameter instead of a dozen separate ones (the prompt is paid every turn). Data lives in ~/.dsh/*.jsonl and is shared with the same-named CLI scripts. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 给会断片的模型三本账，各解决一件事：自我笔记（我变成什么样了——上限 40 条，挤掉最旧的一条之前必须留一句折痕，记下删的是哪条、为什么）、判断账本（记下自己做的判断和验证方法，到期回头核，错了进错册，防止一直觉得自己是对的）、交接条（这一轮停在哪、下一轮先看什么——是接力棒不是记忆）。三个工具各带 action 参数，不拆成十几个省 prompt；数据存 ~/.dsh/*.jsonl，与同名命令行脚本共用同一份，零依赖。

description.en: Read-only enhancer for a file-based long-term memory library (markdown cards in git): a memory_find search tool, a small budgeted memory digest injected into the system prompt, and a settings page with library overview, health-check status and toggles.
description.zh: 面向「纯文件（markdown 卡片 + git）长期记忆库」的只读增强插件：memory_find 检索工具、一小段受预算约束的记忆库摘要注入，以及带概览/健康/开关的设置页。

description.en: Configuration UI for the official OpenViking memory plugin: connection and user-key setup, local connection diagnostics, a per-session memory toggle in the composer, memory isolation that keeps recall inside the current topic, and recall tuning for score threshold, injected item count, query expansion and excluded URIs.
description.zh: 官方 OpenViking 记忆插件的配置管理界面：连接与用户 Key 配置、本机连接诊断、输入栏会话级记忆开关、按主题隔离的召回范围，以及分数阈值、注入条数、查询扩写与排除 URI 的召回调优。

description.en: Long-term notes and daily journals kept per workspace in a hot/cold archive, each tier with its own index and rebalanced once a day; read and written through seven memory_* tools, with a settings page for per-workspace options.
description.zh: 按工作空间保存日记与长期要点的冷热归档记忆：热档常驻、冷档下沉，每层各有一份索引，每天自动归纳一次；读写走七个 memory_* 工具，另有设置页可按工作空间调参数。

description.en: Gives a DSH agent five layers of persistent memory kept as plain Markdown files — persona, speaking-style rules, daily diary, session archive and open loops — rebuilds a system-prompt section from them within a minute of a file change, and adds three tools (memory_read, memory_write, memory_search) plus an importer for migrating an existing memory directory.
description.zh: 给 DSH 机器人装五层持久记忆（人设、说话规则、日记、会话存档、未了结的约定），全部存成磁盘上的纯 Markdown；文件改动一分钟内自动重建注入段落，配 memory_read / memory_write / memory_search 三个工具，另带一个从旧记忆目录迁移的导入器。

description.en: A markdown notes manager for DSH: full **MD notes manager** and **MD notes editor**, quickly capture conversations into notes, maintain notes by **syncing to Git repositories**, and **bring notes into the conversation context**.
description.zh: DSH 的 MD 笔记管理插件：提供完整的 **MD 笔记管理器** 和 **MD 笔记编辑器**，对话内容可快速记入笔记。笔记可 **同步 Git 仓库** 维护。对话时可将笔记 **加入上下文**。

description.en: DSH-native integration layer for the Minta memory engine: composes the official dsh-mcp-client row, registers the minta-memory-governance skill plus a session-start memory prewarm, and ships a Minta agent preset; requires the separately deployed Minta engine (Python/Docker) to provide the 19 MCP tools - not usable without it.
description.zh: Minta 记忆引擎的 DSH 原生接入层:合成官方 dsh-mcp-client 行、注册 minta-memory-governance 技能与 session-start 记忆预热,并提供 Minta agent 预设;19 个 MCP 工具由需单独部署的 Minta 引擎(Python/Docker)提供,未部署引擎则无法使用。

description.en: Cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: a three-tier store (behavior notes, deep details, session archive) plus a 600-character core card injected every step, work/companion/learning state lines, multi-person and multi-group records with visibility partitions, session-scoped suppression or deletion of memory fragments, summaries and fact candidates that can route to a separate model, and backup plus self-check tools. Data is plain text under the home directory, and entries can carry images and audio stored by content hash.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话记忆：三层存储（行为笔记／深层细节／会话阵列）打底，加一张每步注入的 600 字核心卡、工作·陪伴·学习三线状态、多人多群记录与可见性分区、会话级记忆片段屏蔽与删除、可路由到独立模型的摘要与事实候选，以及备份与自检工具；数据全部是家目录下的纯文本文件，条目可附带按内容哈希落盘的图片与音频。

description.en: White-box memory in two parts: four user-authored long-term tiers (must-follow rules, behavior settings, user profile, optional rules) injected as one system-prompt section, plus a separate temporary working set (cross-session handoffs, stage goals, waiting items) with its own 1200-character budget that stops being injected once an entry is done. The long-term tiers are plain Markdown files the user can read and edit; the agent can only propose them, and nothing is written until the user accepts in the Chinese panel. Temporary entries are written only when the user explicitly asks, and live in <DSH_HOME>/temp-memory.json (created on first write), not in the memory directory. No auto-capture, no background writes, no network.
description.zh: 白箱两段记忆：四层用户自写的长期记忆（必须遵守／行为设定／用户画像／可选遵守）注入为系统提示词的一节；另有「临时记忆」（跨对话交接／阶段目标／等待项）独立成节、独立预算（默认 1200 字），条目完结即停止注入。长期记忆是记忆目录里可读可改的 Markdown 文件，AI 只能提议，用户在中文面板点「采纳」才写入；临时记忆只在用户明确要求时写入，存放在 <DSH_HOME>/temp-memory.json（首次写入才创建），不在记忆目录里。不自动采集、不后台回写、不联网。

description.en: View and delete persistent skill memory from the DSH sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中查看与删除持久化的技能记忆。

description.en: Action-state time memory: record typed states and actions, then analyze trends, anomalies, and causality.
description.zh: 动作-状态时序记忆：记录类型化的状态与动作，做趋势、异常与因果关联分析。

description.en: SQLite-backed long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: add, search, update and archive entries with categories and tags, automatic conversation logging, tiered compression, and a project dimension that scopes retrieval to the current workspace plus global facts.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SQLite 长期记忆插件：按分类与标签增删改查、搜索、归档记忆，自动记录对话并分层压缩，带项目维度——检索默认收窄到当前工作区加全局事实。

description.en: Unified rules/guidelines layer for DeepSeek Harness. Keeps every agent guideline in one local rule library with default (always-on) vs local (task-domain) coverage, syncs the effective set into the AGENTS.md managed section, and adds semantic routing, a classification tree, a management page / right-sidebar panel, an in-panel assistant that can collect existing guidelines, calibrate pending rules, re-classify them, and report an issue ledger grouped by owner, rule copies (right-click move/copy, folder copy, jump to origin), decision points with branch conflicts, and per-session branch choice.
description.zh: DSH 统一准则/规则层：把 agent 的所有准则收进一份本地规则库，区分默认（常驻）与局部（按任务域）适用面，把生效规则同步进 AGENTS.md 托管段；并提供语义路由、分类树、管理页/右栏面板、面板内助手（读取规则、校准待复核、个性化分类、按归属汇报问题台账），以及规则副本（右键移动/复制、文件夹整体复制、跳转原规则）、决策点与分支冲突、本对话选择分支。

description.en: Disk-backed long-term memory for DSH: a SQLite FTS5 vault that captures every conversation turn, injects relevant past turns into new sessions within a per-turn character budget, groups sessions into resumable conversation files, and ships a web panel for search, paging and capacity.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供磁盘上的长期记忆：SQLite FTS5 记忆库自动采集每轮对话，新会话按预算把相关的旧片段注入上下文，会话可按「对话文件」串成可续接的线索，并带一个可检索、可翻页、可调容量的网页面板。

description.en: Self-narrative memory in five budgeted segments (800 chars, not a full context): a first-person note the model writes to itself, a profile of you aggregated from approved facts, environment facts kept separate from who you are, heat-ranked conclusions, and habits. Every injected fact is traceable to a fact id and can be retired; the profile can be edited by hand, and self-notes stay plain lines you can clear. Facts fade by use and time without ever changing their credibility. Preference-like lines you say are auto-detected as candidates (never auto-approved), with conflicts kept side by side. Recall over past conversations with citations, an incremental index that only decodes newly appended frames, a pointer-required warm layer, a doctor that says which part is broken, a heartbeat proving injection is alive, and export/import so the whole thing moves to another machine.
description.zh: 五段预算制的自我叙述记忆（共 800 字，不是整段上下文）：模型写给自己看的第一人称自述、从已采纳记忆聚合的「关于你」画像、与本机环境事实分开的画像、按热度排序的结论、以及习惯。每条注入的事实都能回溯到具体事实 id，可一键退役；画像可手改覆盖，自述则是可清空的纯文本行。事实按使用与时间衰减，但可信度不随时间变。你说过的长期要求会被自动识别成候选（永不自动采纳），互相冲突的两条并排留着。另外带出处的历史检索、只解新增帧的增量索引、必须有指针的温层摘要、能说清哪里坏了的体检，证明注入还活着的心跳，以及能整体搬到另一台机器的导出/导入。

plugins.name: dsh-wiki-notes

description.en: Read-only retrieval over a Markdown notes vault: one `wiki_recall` tool that returns the matching section in full with page-level citations, plus vault health checks and a page skeleton for writing a good answer back.
description.zh: 在本地 Markdown 笔记库里只读检索：一次调用返回命中小节正文与页级出处，另带库健康检查与「把好答案回写成新页」的骨架。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a long-term memory box to the DSH Settings page. The saved text is injected into the system prompt of every new session and is kept in the profile patch, so it can be edited again at any time.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页新增「长时记忆」输入框，保存的文本会注入每个新会话的系统提示词，内容持久化在 profile patch 中，可随时回到设置页修改。

description.en: Built-in Obsidian-style knowledge base for DSH: agents distill conversations, documents and web sources into a structured .wiki graph, with retrieval, graph export, note editing, incremental builds and multi-vault management.
description.zh: DSH 内置版 Obsidian 知识库：agent 把对话、文档与网页蒸馏为结构化 .wiki 知识图，支持检索、图谱导出、笔记编辑、增量构建与多库管理。

description.en: PowerContext for DeepSeek Harness: WorkBuddy-style project memory and inspectable handoff workflows - bounded context recall before each model step, 19 pc_* tools for memory, handoff, experience and skills, with a Windows server watchdog for resident operation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 PowerContext 常驻插件：模型每步前自动召回有界上下文，19 个 pc_* 工具覆盖记忆、工作移交、经验与技能，附带 Windows Server 看门狗实现常驻自启与崩溃自动拉起。

description.en: Long-term memory injected at session start: preferences/facts/summaries/knowledge in global and per-project scopes, budgeted recall via `agent/pre-step`, durable JSON store.
description.zh: 会话开始自动注入的长期记忆：preference/fact/summary/knowledge 四类、global/project 双作用域，`agent/pre-step` 字节预算召回，JSON 原子持久化。

description.en: Cross-session memory kept as a short Markdown living document that is rewritten in full at the end of every turn, written to by model tools, the page, and automatic rewriting alike.
description.zh: 把跨会话记忆写成一份简短可读的 Markdown 活文档，每轮对话结束后整个重写；模型工具、页面手写与自动改写都写进同一批文件。

plugins.name: dsh-engramory-recall

description.en: Local BM25 auto-recall, a fail-closed write guard, a static doctor and a memory panel for an Engramory markdown store. No network, no daemon and no model calls unless you opt in; recall quality is measured by a reproducible benchmark in the repository.
description.zh: 给 Engramory 记忆库加本地 BM25 自动召回、写入闸门、静态体检与记忆面板。不联网、不起进程，默认不调模型；召回质量由仓库里的可复算基准量化。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Background memory consolidation (auto dream) for DeepSeek Harness: periodically reviews recent sessions and existing memories to dedupe, refresh stale entries, remove contradictions and rebuild the MEMORY.md index, with hybrid/volume auto triggers, /dream command and a settings-panel config card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动做梦插件：后台定期回顾近期会话与记忆，整合去重、更新过时、删除矛盾、修剪索引，支持 hybrid/volume 自动触发、/dream 手动执行与设置面板配置。

description.en: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: memory read/write/retrieve tools, per-turn auto-recording, project-scoped recall injection and a management UI, with non-destructive Claude Code memory import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 持久记忆插件：记忆读写/检索工具、回合自动记录、项目作用域召回注入、管理界面，可非破坏导入 Claude Code 记忆。

description.en: DSH ↔ agentmemory session-memory bridge: mirrors session lifecycle into a local agentmemory daemon (REST), exposes memory_recall / memory_remember tools, and injects a per-session memory context window via agent/pre-step.
description.zh: DSH ↔ agentmemory 会话记忆桥：把会话生命周期镜像到本地 agentmemory 守护进程（REST），提供 memory_recall / memory_remember 工具，并通过 agent/pre-step 按会话注入记忆上下文窗口。

description.en: Partitioned long-term memory for agents, with folders as memory zones, a one-line index first, and a forgetting curve.
description.zh: 分区式长期记忆：用文件夹收纳记忆，先看一行索引再翻对应分区，带遗忘曲线。

description.en: DSH plugin: a four-entry learning flow in the session input bar — scaffold a preset, collect candidates, merge reviewed changes, and run a read-only workspace audit.
description.zh: DSH 插件：会话输入区的四入口学习流程——初始预设、收集提炼、关联升级、沉淀复用。

description.en: A memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness: set its name, personality and character; it forgets only trivial things, keeps what matters, and marks and remembers what is special to you.
description.zh: 记忆类插件。可设置名字、性格与人格；只淡忘琐事，重要的会保留，特殊的会被记住。

description.en: Cross-harness agent memory for DSH: one plain-file store shared by the DSH and pi adapters and the harnmem CLI, so a memory written in one harness is available in another; injected as a byte-stable hot index, with five harnmem_* tools, session-end extraction, and a read-only memory browser panel.
description.zh: DSH 跨 harness 全局记忆：DSH、pi 适配器与 harnmem CLI 共享同一份本地纯文件记忆库，在一个 harness 写入的记忆在另一个 harness 可用；以字节稳定的热索引注入系统提示，提供五个 harnmem_* 工具、会话结束记忆提取与只读记忆浏览面板。

description.en: Memory for DeepSeek Harness with five sections (memories, tree, profile, graph, inbox), a rule-based capture policy that decides what to keep and what to drop, and hybrid BM25 plus vector retrieval over parent and child chunks, backed by twelve agent tools that read and write the same local files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地记忆插件：记忆、目录、画像、关系、待审五个分区；规则式自动沉淀，明确区分该记与不该记；父子分块的 BM25 + 向量混合检索；12 个工具读写同一份本地数据。

description.en: Plain-text memory for DSH where every event is one Markdown section with six fields, recall works by element association rather than vector search, at most two old titles surface per turn, and nothing calls a model or the network. Writing the library stays manual: you can open it, grep it, correct it and carry it to another machine.
description.zh: 纯文本记忆：一条事一节、六个字段，靠元素联想而不是向量检索，每轮最多交两条旧事；不调模型、不联网，写库留给人——库能直接打开、能 grep、能改、能整份拷走。

description.en: Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness with curated facts, automatic turn retention, and graph- and vector-ranked recall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供人工记忆、自动对话保留以及图谱和向量排序召回的持久记忆插件。

description.en: Per-session long-term memory that fades over time, recalls by evidence score and injects a few entries into the system prompt each turn.
description.zh: 按会话分开的长期记忆，会随时间变淡，按证据分召回、每轮注入几条到系统提示词里。

description.en: Decision log for DeepSeek Harness: record key decisions (chosen option + why) into a versionable DECISIONS.md via decision_log / decision_list / decision_audit tools, and auto-inject the summary into future sessions so decisions stay traceable and are never re-litigated.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 决策日志：通过 decision_log / decision_list / decision_audit 工具把关键决策（选了什么 + 为什么）沉淀为可版本化的 DECISIONS.md，并在后续会话自动注入摘要，让决策可追溯、不重复、不推翻。

description.en: Global experience archive for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: probes local tools (with versions and PATH-first hits), convenient paths, network latency and disk speed; folds per-session stats from session/event; LLM-extracts durable facts; env_profile tool with remember; byte-stable summary injected every turn to speed up sessions and cut token use.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全局经验档案（Windows）：探测本地工具（含版本与 PATH 首个命中）、便捷路径、网络延迟与磁盘速度；从 session/event 折叠每会话统计；由 LLM 抽取持久知识条目；提供带 remember 的 env_profile 工具；每轮注入字节稳定的摘要，加快会话并降低 token 消耗。

description.en: Long-term memory about the owner: extracts schedule, likes, dislikes, emotional triggers, current focus, promises and tone preferences from each turn, injects a short digest into every prompt, speaks up on a schedule or slips a caring line into replies, learns wake/work/sleep times from short messages, and compacts the memory automatically, with plugin-source and outbound-tool recognition, unverified-memory down-weighting and one-click retract.
description.zh: 只记关于主人的长期记忆：每轮抽出作息、喜好、雷点、情绪触发、在忙什么、约定与说话方式，把很短的摘要注入每轮提示；会按点主动开口或在回复里顺口关心一句，从短句里学作息，记忆攒多了自动整合——带有插件来源与对外发送动作识别、未核实记忆降权与一键撤回。

description.en: Injects your existing markdown documents (notes, rules, knowledge-base files) into every dsh session's system prompt as read-only memory — list file or directory paths in `files`; no database, no service, no write path; UTF-8 byte-budgeted truncation with line-boundary fallback, total budget, YAML front-matter stripping, and freshness timestamps.
description.zh: 把本地已有的 markdown 文档（笔记、规则、知识库）按路径清单注入 dsh 每个会话的系统提示词，当只读记忆——无数据库、无服务、无写入通道；支持目录收集、UTF-8 字节预算截断、front-matter 剥离与新鲜度时间戳。

description.en: Cross-session memory and a per-workspace knowledge base in one plugin. Memories are plain JSONL under ~/.dsh/memory by default; each session starts with the relevant ones already in the system prompt and writes one back when it ends. A read-only kb/ folder per workspace plus one global folder is searched with results cited down to file lines. Eleven tools under a scribe_ prefix (seven scribe_memory_*, four scribe_kb_*), a /scribe slash command, and a settings page with overview, memory, knowledge base and migration tabs. Cloud backends (Bailian memory library, ChromaDB, cloud-primary with local mirror) are opt-in; moving data between them requires an explicit approval and is logged so it can be rolled back.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆与工作区知识库合一。记忆默认是 ~/.dsh/memory 下的纯 JSONL，会话开始把相关记忆放进系统提示，会话结束回写一条；每个工作区的 kb/ 目录加一份全局目录构成只读知识库，检索结果能引用到文件行号。十一个工具统一带 scribe_ 前缀（七个 scribe_memory_*、四个 scribe_kb_*），一个 /scribe 斜杠命令，以及概览 / 记忆 / 知识库 / 迁移四页的设置页。云端后端（百炼记忆库、ChromaDB、云端主 + 本地镜像）按需启用；迁移数据必须经显式审批，并留有可回滚的日志。

description.en: Bridges DSH to a local MemVault store: core memory blocks injected into the system prompt, finished turns extracted through MemVault's own pipeline, and a panel to browse, trace, review and replay what was stored.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到本机 MemVault 记忆库：核心记忆块注入系统提示词、结束的轮次经由 MemVault 自己的管线抽取，并提供浏览、追溯、复核与重抽的面板。

description.en: Week-keyed personal memo service: stores entries in ISO-week tables, resolves week/month/quarter/year navigation from one period calendar, archives quarters, runs AI analysis and Markdown report export, summarizes archived DSH sessions into the week as one entry per session in the language and at the length the reader picks, requires an explicit force flag to edit a past week, and turns one suite-wide telemetry failure analysis into a GitHub issue report.
description.zh: 按 ISO 周组织的个人备忘服务：条目按周存储，周/月/季/年四种视图由同一份周期日历解析，支持按季度归档，提供 AI 分析与 Markdown 报告导出，并能按读者所选语言与长度把 DSH 已归档会话总结进对应周、每个会话一条，修改非当前周需要显式确认，也能把整条插件套件的遥测失败分析整理成一份 GitHub issue 报告。

description.en: Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.
description.zh: 模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注入下一步上下文，无需手动调用。

description.en: Decision-and-goal memory with lineage: explicit commands and a model tool record decisions deterministically, a status card re-anchors them across compaction, a lossless event stream with BM25+jieba retrieval backs it, and a scenario-level fidelity regression suite gates releases.
description.zh: 带血缘的决策与目标记忆：显式命令与模型工具确定性记录决策，状态卡跨压缩重锚定，无损事件流 + BM25 分词检索兜底，场景级保真回归集作发布门禁。

description.en: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
description.zh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

description.en: Generate AI-narrated DSH session reports (daily/weekly/monthly, any date range) and sync them to flomo (浮墨笔记) with one configurable tag (default #write/dsh) and automatic # stripping, via a web settings panel with daily reminder.
description.zh: 生成 AI 叙事的 DSH 会话报告（日报/周报/月报、任意区间）并同步到 flomo：单一可配置标签（默认

description.en: Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page — configured once with an Integration Token.
description.zh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。

description.en: Local-first, file-native long-term memory for DSH with per-turn preflight, compact context injection, citations, human-approved writes, manual consolidation, nightly report-only maintenance, and a Web panel that is read-only for knowledge while allowing workspace-config edits.
description.zh: 本地优先、文件原生的 DSH 长期记忆，提供每回合预检、紧凑上下文注入、引用、人工批准写入、手动汇总、夜间只读维护，以及一个知识视图只读、可编辑工作区配置的 Web 面板。

description.en: Local-first persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness: bounded pre-step hot-memory injection, exact and Chinese-bigram BM25 cold recall, six agent tools, approval-gated lease-lock writes with recovery receipts, and read-only governance and trajectory-review candidates.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先持久记忆：在 pre-step 注入有预算上限的热记忆，使用精确匹配与中文二元 BM25 召回冷层，提供六个 Agent 工具，并以审批门禁、租约锁、恢复回执和只读治理与轨迹复盘候选保护写入。

description.en: Shared Markdown memory for DSH and other coding agents, with automatic capture, pre-step context injection, searchable recall, and memory-to-skill self-evolution through a review panel.
description.zh: 供 DSH 与其他编程 Agent 共享的 Markdown 记忆，支持自动捕获、步骤前上下文注入、搜索召回，以及通过审阅面板实现 memory-to-skill 自进化。

description.en: DSH adapter bridging DeepSeek web chat and DeepSeek Harness with automatic DSM-tag harvesting, memory injection and write-back, full-answer saving on the web, a DSH sidebar for browsing and manual injection, named-entry retrieval, general/non-general classification, and transactional memory compression; works with the separately loaded Chrome/Edge extension in extension/ and the local @zoria-lind/dsh-ecolink-service, which the adapter can start automatically.
description.zh: 跨端记忆的 DSH 适配器：支持 DSM 短标签自动捕获入池、记忆注入与写回、网页完整回答保存、DSH 侧栏浏览与手动注入、指定条目读取、通用/非通用分类及事务化记忆压缩；配合需另行加载的 extension/ 目录下 Chrome/Edge 扩展，以及适配器可自动启动的本地 @zoria-lind/dsh-ecolink-service 服务。

description.en: Long-term memory for DSH agents — durable, inspectable memories with recall, search, browse and knowledge-graph tools, import from ten other AI coding tools, and a settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供长期记忆——可检索、可检视的持久记忆，带回忆、搜索、浏览与知识图谱工具，支持从十个其他 AI 编码工具导入记忆，并附设置页。

description.en: Agent memory with a forgetting curve: entries gain weight when mentioned, shrink when forgotten, and pinned entries never decay. Six tools and a settings panel.
description.zh: 带遗忘曲线的代理记忆：被提起就变牢、不提就变短，📌 的永不淡忘。六个工具 + 设置面板。

description.en: Share an existing OpenClaw Markdown workspace with DeepSeek Harness as bounded persona and memory context, with Sidebar browsing and editing.
description.zh: 把现有 OpenClaw Markdown workspace 作为有界的人格与记忆上下文共享给 DeepSeek Harness，并提供 Sidebar 浏览与编辑。

description.en: Self-hosted crypto portfolio dashboard: BTC, EVM (73 chains via DeBank), Solana, Dogecoin, Cardano, Hyperliquid L1, five exchanges (Binance, Bybit, Backpack, OKX, Bitget) and tokenised equities in one view, with multi-provider failover, custom asset labels, a tunable asset-health report, a shareable PNG card, per-source connection tests, multi-profile configs, scheduled refresh and zero-dependency charts (Python stdlib + vanilla JS, no CDN).
description.zh: 自托管加密资产仪表盘：BTC、EVM（DeBank 73 条链）、Solana、狗狗币、艾达币、Hyperliquid L1、五家交易所（Binance / Bybit / Backpack / OKX / Bitget）与代币化股票统一视图；多数据源自动切换、自定义资产类别标签、可调阈值的资产健康度报告、可分享的 PNG 卡片、每个数据源独立连通性测试、多 Profile 配置、定时刷新、零依赖图表（Python 标准库 + 原生 JS，无 CDN）。

description.en: Native Windows desktop control for DSH, 21 tools: UIA control tree plus offline OCR to see the screen, click a control by its name, type CJK without touching your clipboard, and drive WeChat / Office / browsers / online-class pages. It never steals your mouse or keyboard (it waits for you to stop), never resizes your windows, lets you type corrections mid-task from a sidebar panel, and after every action it reads the screen back and tells you honestly when it could not confirm. Persistent built-in browser channel. No driver, no extra runtime.
description.zh: 原生 Windows 桌面控制，共 21 个工具：UIA 控件树 + 离线 OCR 看屏幕、按控件名字点击、不占剪贴板地打中文，微信 / Office / 浏览器 / 网课都能操作。不抢你的鼠标键盘（你在用它会等）、从不改你的窗口大小，侧边栏「指挥台」可随时打字纠正，每步操作后都会回头核对屏幕并如实说明结果。内置持久登录的网页通道，无需驱动、无额外运行时。

description.en: MySQL connector for DeepSeek Harness: configure multiple connections in the settings page with per-connection table allowlist and write permission, switch the active connection from the composer, and expose mysql_query / mysql_tables / mysql_execute tools to every agent preset.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MySQL 连接插件：在设置页配置多套连接（每连接可配表白名单与写权限），输入栏一键切换当前会话的连接，并为所有 Agent 预设提供 mysql_query / mysql_tables / mysql_execute 工具。

description.en: Sweeps AI byproducts (scratch files, backups, logs, caches) into a reversible trash per project, and on project close classifies deliverables, archives reference results and writes a cleanup report. Requires Python 3 on PATH (the cleanup engine is a Python script; python3 / python / py are auto-detected, and without one cleanup cannot run and says so).
description.zh: 把 AI 会话留下的草稿、备份、日志、缓存收进可逆回收站；项目结项时归类成品、归档可引用结果并生成结项清理清单，未结项期间一切保留。清运引擎是 Python 脚本，需 PATH 上有 Python 3（自动探测 python3 / python / py；缺了它清运跑不起来，会明确提示）。

plugins.name: dsh-media-studio

description.en: Generate images and videos directly in chat and deliver them to the conversation: generate_image / generate_video / send_media tools, a built-in Agnes free tier plus any OpenAI-compatible backend, background jobs that auto-push finished media, and inline gallery and video cards with download, lightbox, and native open.
description.zh: 在对话里直接生成图片和视频并发送到会话：generate_image / generate_video / send_media 三个工具，内置 Agnes 免费额度与任意 OpenAI 兼容后端，长耗时生成走后台任务完成后自动推送，内联画廊与视频卡片支持下载、灯箱查看和系统默认应用打开。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Deny-only tool blacklist per agent preset. Tick a tool off in Settings and it leaves that mode's tool schema and its calls are rejected; nothing is ever enabled or whitelisted, and tools nobody denied are left alone. Each row expands to that tool's own description, and rules live in one JSON file outside the profile.
description.zh: 按 Agent 预设（模式）管理的工具黑名单，只做禁用：在设置页勾掉一个工具，它就从该模式的工具 schema 里消失、调用也会被拒；不设白名单、不负责启用，没被点名的工具一概不碰。每行可展开看工具自己的描述，规则存在 profile 之外的单个 JSON 文件里。

description.en: Detect which installed apps have a newer version and update them with one click, downloading each vendor's full installer from its official site and installing it silently. Windows via winget, macOS via Homebrew casks, matching the machine's ARM64 or x64 architecture.
description.zh: 检测本机已安装应用里哪些有可用新版本，并一键从各软件官网下载完整安装包静默更新；Windows 走 winget、macOS 走 Homebrew cask，并按本机 ARM64 / x64 架构挑选对应安装包。

description.en: Minecraft redstone music: rm_render renders instrument samples from a SoundFont and aligns every onset to within 3 ms, and rm_build compiles a song plus lane table into a datapack of scheduled mcfunction shards (optionally deployed over RCON).
description.zh: Minecraft 红石音乐：rm_render 从 SoundFont 渲染乐器采样并把起音对齐到 3ms 内，rm_build 把谱面与轨表编译成分片 mcfunction 数据包（可选经 RCON 部署开建）。

description.en: Natural-language data queries + BI reports: Text2SQL, charts, report saving, schema/data grid panel, and a sidebar workbench — all behind DSH's MySQL connection layer.
description.zh: 自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表：Text2SQL、图表、报表收藏、Schema/数据面板与侧栏工作台，基于 DSH 的 MySQL 连接层。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation: nine tools that read a window control tree and drive elements by id through their own UI Automation patterns, with every write gated by an approval policy, an append-only action log and a settings panel.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation 控制 Windows 桌面：九个工具读取窗口控件树、按 id 走控件自身的 UIA 模式操作，每次写入都受审批策略、动作日志与设置面板约束。

plugins.name: dsh-hdc-bridge

description.en: HarmonyOS device bridge: hdc screenshot/install/log/crash/UI automation loop with read_image, official-first versioned API knowledge (SDK .d.ts + offline bundled docs), and a DevEco CLI build/sign/lint lane.
description.zh: 鸿蒙设备桥：hdc 截图/装包/日志/崩溃/UI 自动化闭环（配 read_image 看图），官方优先版本化 API 知识层（SDK .d.ts + 离线随包文档），以及 DevEco CLI 构建/签名/lint 通道。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 26.0.0.810 for network access

description.en: Runs the local nanobot CLI agent as a DSH subagent through a nanobot_run tool: each call carries one self-contained task and returns only the agent's final answer, either as a fresh process or through a persistent OpenAI-compatible server.
description.zh: 通过 nanobot_run 工具把本机 nanobot CLI agent 当作 DSH 子代理运行：每次只交给它一个自包含任务并仅返回最终答案，可按次启动进程，也可走常驻的 OpenAI 兼容服务。

description.en: Unified MCP, skill and expert management board for DeepSeek Harness: connection status, tool schemas, enable/disable and reconnect for MCP servers across global and per-project scopes, enable/disable of SKILL.md skills, attach/switch/detach WorkBuddy expert personas in any conversation at any time (429 experts) with no mid-session preset lock, a tool tailor that scans local session logs for per-tool call counts, error rates and context-token cost with one-click disabling, and three install markets (SkillHub 190k+ skills, WorkBuddy connectors, 47 verified built-in services).
description.zh: Skill + MCP + 专家统一看板：MCP 服务器连接状态、工具 Schema、启停与重连（全局与项目双作用域）、SKILL.md 技能启停、WorkBuddy 专家人设可在任意会话随时挂上 / 更换 / 取消（429 位，不受「会话已开始就不能换」的限制）、工具裁缝（扫描本机会话日志统计每个工具的调用次数、错误率与上下文 token 税，死工具一键禁用），以及三大安装市场（SkillHub 19 万+ 技能、WorkBuddy 连接器、47 个一手核实的内置服务）。

description.en: Turns a local Obsidian vault into a dedicated RAG chat panel: a sidebar page with the note browser, the retrieval-augmented chat and the cited source side by side, answering from fully local BM25 plus CJK-bigram retrieval over your notes and streaming through the DSH model channel, with clickable \[n] citations and mtime-based incremental indexing.
description.zh: 把本地 Obsidian 仓库变成专属 RAG 对话面板：侧栏一个完整页面，左侧笔记浏览、中间检索增强对话、右侧引用原文；检索用完全本地的 BM25 加中文 bigram，回答走 DSH 模型通道，\[n] 引用可点击，索引按 mtime 增量更新。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu

description.en: Creates and edits Feishu and Lark cloud content through ten tools - Bitable databases and their records, documents with Markdown converted to native blocks, spreadsheets, wikis, drive files and messages - plus Base V3 dashboard charts and server-side aggregate queries.
description.zh: 通过十个工具创建与编辑飞书 / Lark 云内容——多维表格及其记录、把 Markdown 转成原生块的文档、电子表格、知识库、云空间文件与消息，并提供 Base V3 的仪表盘图表与服务端聚合查询。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: MCP management console for DeepSeek Harness — a left-sidebar page that lists every configured MCP server, trial-calls its tools in place, restarts a single row when its transport dies or never synced, and probes reachability. A fork of PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel; do not install it alongside the upstream plugin — both register the /mcp command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 管理控制台：左侧栏独立页面列出全部 MCP 服务器，可就地试用工具；传输断开或工具未同步时可单独重启某一行，并探测连通性。基于 PerryLink/dsh-mcp-panel 的分支；不能与上游插件同装——两者都注册 /mcp 命令。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) integration for DeepSeek Harness: 25 tools for chat messages and history, cloud documents (including knowledge-base pages, generated charts and images), bitable records, spreadsheet ranges and drive permissions, using your own enterprise self-built Feishu app.
description.zh: 飞书（Lark）集成：25 个工具，覆盖群消息与聊天记录、云文档（含知识库页面、自动生成的图表与图片）、多维表格记录、电子表格区间读写与文档授权，基于企业自建应用。

description.en: Drives Siemens NX 2406 and 2506 from DeepSeek Harness, plus NX 12: an executor that judges a journal run from its log rather than its exit code (NX returns 0 for a journal that swallowed its exception, and 0xC0000409 after a clean one), 16 typed tools over a resident batch NX, and a probe that keeps the three releases apart. Windows only; NX 2406 is the reference release, 2506 expected. Requires a local Siemens NX install and a free NX licence seat; run `dsh-nx install` once, and the 16 MCP tools stay off until `NX_ENABLE_MCP=1` is set (the skill route works without it).
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动 Siemens NX 2406 与 2506，也支持 NX 12：一个按日志而非退出码判定 journal 成败的执行器（NX 对吞掉异常的 journal 返回 0，干净结束时返回 0xC0000409）、常驻批处理 NX 上的 16 个类型化工具，以及一个能分清三个版本的探测。仅 Windows；以 NX 2406 为基准版本，2506 为预期可用。需本机已安装 Siemens NX 并有一个空闲的 NX 许可席位；先运行一次 `dsh-nx install`；16 个 MCP 工具默认关闭，需设 `NX_ENABLE_MCP=1` 才注册（技能路线不受影响）。

description.en: Registers two MCP servers that drive the installed AutoCAD and SolidWorks desktop apps over COM, plus two on-demand skills. Windows only, Python 3.11+; the pinned upstream servers install themselves on first load, and only the sides whose CAD application is registered get a row. Each server advertises two meta-tools instead of its full catalog (a discovery shim here for SolidWorks, upstream DISCOVERY_MODE=search for AutoCAD), taking the schemas loaded before the first request from 23,404 to 256 tokens and from 83,732 to 365 respectively.
description.zh: 注册两个 MCP 服务器，在 Windows 上通过 COM 驱动本机安装的 AutoCAD 与 SolidWorks，另附两个按需技能。仅 Windows，需要 Python 3.11+；首次加载时自动安装钉死版本的上游服务器，并且只给真正装了的 CAD 应用注册对应的那一行。两者都只广告两个元工具而非完整工具表（SolidWorks 用本仓库的 discovery 垫片，AutoCAD 用上游 DISCOVERY_MODE=search），首次请求前加载的工具定义分别从 23,404 降到 256 token、从 83,732 降到 365 token。

description.en: Emotion, energy and per-user portrait engine for AI characters: a 303-word leveled emotion library with lowest-level replacement and a promotion buffer, a spirit meter with easter-egg state transitions (excited / suppressed / angry), and per-user portraits. Requires your own OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint and API key (EMOTION_LLM_KEY or emotion/config.json).
description.zh: 给 AI 角色的情绪·精神·人物画像引擎：303 个情绪词分级叠加，等级最低者优先替换、弱情绪走缓冲区升级，精神值驱动说话风格，连击解锁亢奋/压抑/生气状态跃迁，按人画像，可接任意 AI。需要自备 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 地址与 API Key（环境变量 EMOTION_LLM_KEY，或 emotion/config.json 的 llm 配置）。

description.en: Private Windows DSH environment ZIPs for plugin configuration, Session, Workspace, identified external memory and Skills; v0.6.0 standalone recovery plans cross-version migration into fresh targets, checks dependencies and schemas, and validates startup before commit.
description.zh: 为 Windows DSH 创建包含插件配置、Session、Workspace、已识别外部记忆和 Skills 的私人冷备份；v0.6.0 独立恢复助手规划跨版本迁移到全新目标，检查依赖与数据格式，并在启动验证后提交。

plugins.name: 3chatai-deepseek-harness-plugin

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness to 3Chat via OAuth for customer and conversation search, context retrieval, confirmed messaging, and batch-send tracking.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 3Chat，查询客户与会话、读取沟通上下文、确认后发送消息并跟踪批次进度。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Web search, page fetch and one-call research through DeepSeek's official Search and Fetch API; needs a DeepSeek API key.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek 官方 Search/Fetch 接口做网页搜索、单页抓取与一键调研；需要一个 DeepSeek API key。

description.en: Turns a ZSpace (极空间) NAS into native agent tools: list, stat, search, read, download, upload, write, create folders, rename, move, copy and delete files on the NAS. Works across networks through the desktop client relay — no LAN, no WebDAV, no SSH — and switches to the faster direct WebDAV transport automatically when the NAS is on the same network. Deletes require an explicit confirm: true; write, upload, create-folder, rename, move and copy run directly, and zspace_write overwrites a same-named file unless overwrite is false.
description.zh: 把极空间（ZSpace）NAS 变成 agent 的原生工具：列目录、查属性、按名检索、读取、下载、上传、写入、建目录、重命名、移动、复制、删除 NAS 文件。跨网络走桌面客户端中转——不需要同一局域网、不用 WebDAV、不用 SSH；同一网络时自动改走更快的 WebDAV 直连。删除需显式传 confirm: true；写入、上传、建目录、重命名、移动、复制默认直接执行，zspace_write 会覆盖同名文件（除非传 overwrite: false）。

description.en: Release gate for AI answer quality. Two channels: replay an existing VeriScope archive through the original Python quality gate, or run a threshold gate over a Ragas per-row export with Node only — no VeriScope, Python or pandas. Returns PASS, FAIL or REVIEW with source evidence and a re-checkable receipt; supports per-row thresholds and exact decimal comparison. It never re-evaluates and never calls a model, and REVIEW never becomes PASS.
description.zh: AI 回答质量的发布门禁。两条通道：用原 Python 门禁重放 VeriScope 归档，或仅用 Node 对 Ragas 逐条导出做阈值判定，后者不需要 VeriScope、Python 或 pandas。返回通过／失败／待复核，附出处与可复验回执；支持逐条阈值与精确十进制比较。不重新评测、不调用模型，待复核永不转为通过。

description.en: Brings McDonald's China official MCP (mcp.mcd.cn) into DSH. Paste a token you generated yourself and the plugin handshakes, calls tools/list, and registers every remote tool as a native DSH tool (mcd_ prefix) — upstream additions and removals need no code change, just a restart. Ships four always-on tools (mcd_status, mcd_test, mcd_tools, mcd_call) for self-checks and direct fallback calls, plus a settings page with a one-click connection test. The token is stored only on this machine in ~/.dsh/dsh-mcd-mcp.json (mode 600); it never enters the repository or the conversation context.
description.zh: 把麦当劳中国官方 MCP(mcp.mcd.cn)接入 DSH。粘贴自己在官网生成的 Token 后，插件会握手并调用 tools/list，把远端全部工具自动注册成 DSH 原生工具(mcd_ 前缀)，官方增删工具无需改代码，重启即同步。另附 mcd_status、mcd_test、mcd_tools、mcd_call 四个常驻工具用于自检与兜底直调，设置页可一键测试连通性。Token 只存本机 ~/.dsh/dsh-mcd-mcp.json(权限 600)，不进仓库、不进对话上下文。

description.en: Agent tools that download a Bilibili video, transcribe it with a local whisper.cpp build, then write a structured Markdown note with DSH's own LLM (optionally printing it to PDF). Windows only: missing dependencies are auto-downloaded into the data directory — yt-dlp.exe and the ffmpeg.exe build from GitHub and gyan.dev, the whisper.cpp x64 binary from GitHub, and a ~547 MB model from the hf-mirror mirror; PDF export shells out to a locally installed Edge/Chrome. Two tools: video_to_notes and note_to_pdf. Pure JS, no extra API key.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频下载、本地 whisper.cpp 转写、再用 DSH 自身 LLM 生成结构化 Markdown 笔记（可打印为 PDF）的 agent 工具。仅支持 Windows：缺依赖时自动下载到数据目录——yt-dlp.exe 与 ffmpeg.exe（GitHub、gyan.dev）、whisper.cpp x64 二进制（GitHub）、约 547 MB 模型（hf-mirror 镜像）；PDF 由本机安装的 Edge/Chrome 无头打印。提供 video_to_notes 与 note_to_pdf 两个工具，纯 JS，无需额外 API key。

description.en: A research library panel and skill set for DSH: project folders, figures with registered provenance, drafts, references, data tables, journal profiles and submissions, plus writing, citation and Origin-plotting discipline for research agents.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的科研库面板与技能组：课题目录、带溯源的图表登记、草稿、文献、数据表、期刊档案、投稿台账，以及面向科研智能体的写作、引用与 Origin 出图纪律（出图需另装 dsh-origin-plugin）。

description.en: Adds a download_file tool that fetches a URL over 16 aria2c connections and falls back to a single stream when aria2 is unavailable. Needs aria2c installed separately; the aria2 channel does not verify TLS certificates.
description.zh: 新增 download_file 工具，用 16 路 aria2c 并发下载，aria2 不可用时自动退回单线程流式下载。需自行安装 aria2c；aria2 通道不校验 TLS 证书。

description.en: Take a local video all the way to a Douyin creator post: open the upload page, trigger the picker, hand the file over with verification, fill the title, set visibility - then stop before publishing unless explicitly told to publish.
description.zh: 把本地视频送到抖音投稿页的「待发布」状态：打开投稿页、真实点上传、递文件（回读校验）、填标题、设可见性，然后默认停手——可见性默认仅自己可见、不点发布。

description.en: Hand a local file to any program's file picker: wait for the native Open dialog, paste the path through the clipboard, read it back to verify character by character, then confirm. The target is always explicit and every step leaves evidence. Windows only (EnumWindows / UI Automation).
description.zh: 把本地文件交给任何程序的「打开文件」对话框：等对话框出现、走剪贴板填路径、读回来逐字核对、再点确认。目标必须显式给，每一步都留证据——文件上传、微信发文件、PS 打开都能用它代劳。仅 Windows（依赖 EnumWindows / UI Automation）。

description.en: Windows GUI automation reliability layer: probes whether a window is minimized, foreground or DPI-scaled, then clicks and types with the coordinate space and activation order handled for you. Zero dependencies, local only.
description.zh: Windows 窗口操作的可靠性层：先体检目标窗口是否最小化、是否在前台、有没有 DPI 缩放，再点击与输入——坐标口径和激活顺序由它处理。零依赖、纯本地、不联网。

description.en: One screen for every work you have shipped: local project facts, GitHub stars and last push, whether the plugin market has picked it up and how many downloads it has, plus pending pull-request wait times against the upstream median.
description.zh: 一屏看清每个作品的现状：本地版本与文件数、GitHub star 与最后推送、市场是否已收录及下载量、收录 PR 等待时长对比上游中位数；全部只读、数字都来自 API，不经模型生成。

description.en: Let the agent restart its own DSH host: schedule a self-restart, finish the turn first, then a detached helper stops and relaunches the app and reports what happened. Dry-run, a status check, and an optional "when can I blink" confirmation are built in.
description.zh: 让 agent 自己安排宿主重启：工具立刻返回，等这一轮回复送达、会话日志落盘安静后再停+拉，并留下报告；自带 dry-run、体检与「什么时候可以眨一下眼」的确认。

description.en: Ship a local DSH plugin project to GitHub and the plugin market in one call: preflight, per-file upload with byte verification, the market registry PR, then pull every published file back and compare bytes.
description.zh: 一条命令把本地 DSH 插件工程发到 GitHub 并开市场收录 PR：逐文件上传带字节校验、市场条目 PR，最后把线上文件逐个拉回来比 sha256。

description.en: Park whole tool packs out of the session's tool surface and mount them back with one command. Cuts the tool table from 99,789 to 48,144 characters (51.8%) without uninstalling plugins or restarting. Reversible per group, per agent.
description.zh: 把整包工具从会话的工具面上摘掉，要用时一条命令挂回来。工具表从 99,789 字符降到 48,144（51.8%），不用卸载插件、不用重启，按组可逆、按 agent 独立。

description.en: Academic writing toolkit for DSH agents: paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA 引文格式化、措辞质检与投稿前清单。

description.en: Education toolkit for DSH agents: lesson-plan skeletons by grade band, quiz scaffolding and answer-key validation, analytic rubrics, Anki/markdown flashcards, and readability levels.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供教育工具包：按学段的教案骨架、测验题与答案校验、分析式评分量规、Anki/markdown 闪卡与可读性分级。

description.en: Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供金融数据工具包：数字与货币格式化（含中文万/亿单位）、收益与年化计算、估值与盈利比率、现值/终值、风险指标与数据质量清单。

description.en: Local-life toolkit for DSH agents: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, common unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F, L/gallon), and trip checklists.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供本地生活工具包：预算规划、账单分摊、单价与折扣计算、常用单位换算（斤/里/尺、摄氏/华氏、升/加仑）与出行清单。

description.en: Translation toolkit for DSH agents: sentence segmentation, term and glossary extraction, source-target QA (numbers, units, brackets), tone guides, and a durable workspace translation memory.
description.zh: 为 DSH agent 提供翻译工具包：句子分块、术语与术语表提取、译文质检（数字、单位、括号）、语气指南与工作区持久化翻译记忆。

description.en: Native WCAG accessibility scanner: runs axe-core over local HTML files / build output / URLs and reports violations (rule id, impact, WCAG 2.1 mapping, element targeting, fix suggestions) as Markdown/HTML/JSON. Read-only, CI-able.
description.zh: 原生 WCAG 无障碍扫描工具：对本地 HTML / 构建产物 / URL 运行 axe-core，输出规则 id、impact、WCAG 2.1 映射、元素定位与修复建议（Markdown/HTML/JSON），只读可进 CI。

description.en: Record terminal/tool output as asciinema v2 (.cast), replay with an offline embedded player, and export HTML.
description.zh: 把终端/工具输出录制为 asciinema v2（.cast）文件，离线内嵌播放器回放并导出 HTML。

description.en: Cross-platform Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: virtual-mouse human-like operation (screen_observe + computer_click + type + key + scroll + drag, 11 tools), AX-tree zero-vision-cost mode with free GLM-4V-Flash vision fallback, safety guards (snapshot TTL / app whitelist / dangerous-action approval / password-box protection).
description.zh: 跨平台 Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作（screen_observe / computer_click / type / key / scroll / drag 共 11 个工具），AX 语义树零视觉成本 + GLM-4V-Flash 免费视觉兜底，安全护栏（快照 TTL / 应用白名单 / 危险操作审批 / 密码框保护）。

description.en: Scan project lockfiles (npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle/...) against the free OSV API and report confirmed dependency vulnerabilities with fix versions and remediation commands.
description.zh: 扫描项目锁文件（npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle…）并对免费 OSV API 批量查询漏洞，输出「包 / 当前版本 / 漏洞 ID / 摘要 / CVSS / 修复版本」表格与修复命令。

description.en: Parse Chinese e-invoice PDFs (XML attachment first, text-layer regex fallback) into structured JSON with amount cross-check, and generate expense reports (Markdown / xlsx).
description.zh: 解析增值税电子发票 PDF（XML 附件优先、文本层正则兜底）为结构化 JSON + 金额勾稽校验，多张汇总生成报销单（Markdown / xlsx）。

description.en: Expose a local MCP server to remote agents through an outbound-only tunnel stack (mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel), then register the public URL into dsh-mcp-client streamable-http config.
description.zh: 把本机 MCP Server 通过出站-only 隧道栈（mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel）暴露给远程 Agent，并把公网 URL 注册进 dsh-mcp-client 的 streamable-http 配置。

description.en: Analyze the current branch diff and generate a Conventional Commits PR title, motivation/scheme/testing/risk description and a self-review checklist, write PR_DESCRIPTION.md, optionally open the PR via gh.
description.zh: 分析当前分支 diff，生成符合 Conventional Commits 的 PR 标题与动机/方案/影响/测试/风险描述和自审清单，输出 PR_DESCRIPTION.md，可选直接调用 gh 提 PR。

description.en: Mine local DSH session logs (JSONL) into personal usage & impact receipts: Markdown day/week/month reports plus a self-contained HTML receipt, cross-referenced with local git log — zero-network, privacy-first.
description.zh: 从本地 DSH 会话日志（JSONL）挖掘「使用与影响」报告：Markdown 日/周/月报 + 自包含 HTML receipt，交叉本机 git log；零联网、隐私优先。

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: realtime market indices, stock screener with 13 technical signals and multi-strategy intersection, 7×24 multi-source news aggregation, watchlist with group management, market sentiment thermometer (limit-up ladder, breadth), K-line charts with MA/EXPMA/BOLL overlays, and sector/limit-up/longhu rankings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness A 股行情面板：实时大盘指数、技术选股（13 项信号 + 多策略交叉）、7×24 多源快讯聚合、自选股分组管理、市场情绪温度计（连板梯队/涨跌家数）、K 线图（MA/EXPMA/BOLL 叠加）、板块榜/涨停池/龙虎榜。

description.en: Connects AutoCAD, ZWCAD, GstarCAD and BricsCAD to DeepSeek Harness over MCP, bundling the CAD server and building a private Python environment on first run. Requires Windows, one of those CAD applications installed, Python 3.10+ on PATH, and CAD running as the same Windows user and at the same privilege level as DSH.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 把 AutoCAD、中望、浩辰、BricsCAD 接入 DeepSeek Harness，内置 CAD 服务端，首次运行自动搭建私有 Python 环境。需要 Windows、本机已安装上述任一款 CAD、PATH 上有 Python 3.10+，且 CAD 与 DSH 以同一 Windows 用户、同一权限级别运行。

description.en: macOS computer-use tools backed by a plugin-owned Cua Driver runtime.
description.zh: 通过插件独立管理的 Cua Driver 运行时提供 macOS 电脑操作工具。
