description.en: Five production-grade DSH tools bundled into one plugin (8 tool slots total): git regression finder (find introducer, recent changes, bisect, blame age), stack-trace decoder with local code context, YAML/ENV/properties config validator with typo suggestions, cross-platform shell escape (POSIX/PowerShell/cmd), and MyBatis Plus SQL static auditor (N+1, missing @Transactional, LIKE leading %, SELECT *, missing WHERE). Zero npm dependencies, all offline; concurrency-safe except the bisect tool (dsh-when-broke). Each sub-plugin is also installable standalone (dsh-when-broke, dsh-stackdecoder, dsh-config-guard, dsh-cmd-shield, dsh-mp-auditor).
description.zh: 五个生产级 DSH 工具合一的 bundle（共 8 个 tool slot）：git 回归定位（引入者反查、最近改动、二分定位、blame 年龄）、带本地代码上下文的堆栈解码器、YAML/ENV/properties 配置校验器（带近似键名提示）、跨平台 shell 转义（POSIX/PowerShell/cmd）、MyBatis Plus SQL 静态审计器（N+1、缺 @Transactional、LIKE 前导 %、SELECT *、缺 WHERE）。零 npm 依赖，全离线；除 bisect 工具（dsh-when-broke）外并发安全。每个子插件也可单独安装（AAAlenwow/dsh-when-broke、dsh-stackdecoder、dsh-config-guard、dsh-cmd-shield、dsh-mp-auditor）。

description.en: Archive DeepSeek Harness sessions into a self-hosted WeKnora knowledge base with extraction, summarization and incremental dedup.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话归档进自建 WeKnora 知识库，含提取、总结与增量去重。

description.en: Siemens NX integration for dsh on Windows (requires a local Siemens NX install; tested only with NX 2512, and the FE tools need Simulation/Nastran licences): 71 tools that build and edit solids, surfaces, sketches, holes and tubes, run NX Nastran statics and modal studies, roll up assembly BOMs with pairwise clearance checks, and print A3 sheets with a real GB frame to PDF, all in a background NX session driven by JSON commands.
description.zh: 把 Siemens NX 接进 dsh（仅 Windows，需本机已装 Siemens NX，且只在 NX 2512 上验证；有限元工具另需 Simulation / Nastran 许可）：71 个工具覆盖实体建模、曲面闭环、同步建模、孔型与管路、Nastran 静力与模态、装配 BOM 与逐对间隙检查、A3 图纸与 GB 图框出 PDF，全部通过 JSON 命令驱动后台 NX 会话执行。

description.en: Bilibili autopilot run by a local Ollama model: it picks videos within per-topic quota, reads subtitles, hot comments and keyframes, decides whether a reply is warranted, then writes and posts one comment through a five-level safety gate. Triggered by dsh-schedule; write tools are not registered while commenting is disabled. v1.1 hardens the write path: revoking write access is a runtime state checked before every send, publishing is atomic, risk-control errors persist as a pause, and the final post re-checks persona style. Needs Python 3.10+ with the repo's requirements.txt installed.
description.zh: 本地模型刷 B 站：由 Ollama 小模型按题材配额挑片，读字幕、热评与关键帧，判断要不要评论，再经五档安全闸写出并发布。节奏由 dsh-schedule 触发；未开启写权限时不注册写工具。v1.1 收紧写路径：撤权改为运行时状态（每次发送前检查）、发布原子化、风控错误会持久化为暂停、发前复核人设风格。需 Python 3.10+ 并装好仓库里的 requirements.txt。

description.en: Toolbox plugin for the Web UI: session/trash/subdirectory/search/preset/config management, tag grouping, long-message collapse, and a scheduled heartbeat with optional IM channel push.
description.zh: Web 界面工具箱：会话/回收站/子目录/搜索/预设/配置管理、标签分组、长消息折叠，以及支持 IM 渠道推送的定时心跳。

description.en: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
description.zh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

description.en: Compiles LaTeX with the TeX Live installed on the machine: one `latex` tool typesets a formula into an SVG, PNG or PDF and a whole document into a PDF (Chinese text switches to xelatex with ctexart), writes the file into the workspace and returns a Markdown reference to it. A system-prompt section asks the model to write `$...$` and `$$...$$` instead of code fences, and when no TeX Live is found a banner above the composer offers a one-click BasicTeX or TinyTeX install.
description.zh: 用本机已装的 TeX Live 真编译 LaTeX：`latex` 工具把一个公式排成 SVG、PNG 或 PDF，把整份文档排成 PDF（正文含中文时自动切 xelatex + ctexart），产物写进工作区并返回可直接引用的 Markdown 链接。同时注入系统提示词段落，让模型用 `$...$` / `$$...$$` 而不是代码块写公式；本机没有 TeX Live 时，输入框上方会给出 BasicTeX / TinyTeX 一键安装。

description.en: One-click create, update or remove the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut with switchable custom icons and a draggable whale button.
description.zh: 一键创建、更新或删除 DeepSeek Harness 桌面快捷方式，图标可自定义上传切换，蓝白金鲸鱼悬浮按钮可拖动，点击旋转 90° 弹出面板。

description.en: Mounts the mcptoon MCP gateway as one stdio server, so the agent discovers the tools of every MCP server you have configured through mcptoon's compressed view instead of full JSON schemas on each turn. Ships a doctor CLI that checks the mcptoon executable resolves and prints the exact command/args override when it does not.
description.zh: 把 mcptoon 作为一条 stdio MCP 服务接入，让 agent 通过 mcptoon 的压缩视图发现已配置 MCP server 的工具，而非每轮支付完整 JSON schema。附带 doctor CLI：校验 mcptoon 可执行文件能否解析，不能时打印精确的 command/args 覆盖配置。

description.en: Browses Bilibili on your behalf and actually takes part: search videos, like, coin, send danmaku, post comments, reply to other people, and keep replying when someone answers back. Reads the video's Bilibili AI subtitle (or transcribes the audio locally when there is none) so its comments talk about what the video really says, and it reads that same content before choosing whom to reply to. Instead of copying other people's sentences, it distills rules about how to sound like a person and gets less AI-ish the more it runs. Skips videos it already browsed, de-duplicates replies per thread, and after too many rounds with the same person in one comment section it reviews whether the exchange has any substance -- if it looks like two bots complimenting each other, it says one last line and stops replying to that person there. Checks whether each comment is genuinely public or only visible to your own account, can scan any time window (last hour / day / 3 days / all) and lists the ones others cannot see, warning you on the overview when replies got folded. Six-tab settings panel where every change takes effect immediately with no restart, a manual run that queues behind the background listener instead of being refused, and an environment self-check that tells you exactly what to install. Requires Python 3 for the Bilibili actions; the built-in check lists any missing packages.
description.zh: 替你在 B 站上真的动手：搜视频、点赞、投币、发弹幕、发评论、回别人的评论，别人回了还能接着聊。会读视频的 B 站 AI 字幕（没有字幕时可本地转写），所以评论说的是视频里真正讲了什么；挑该回谁之前也会先看一遍视频内容。它不抄别人的句子，而是总结「怎么说话才像真人」的规律，跑得越多 AI 味越淡。会跳过刷过的视频、同一楼不重复回复；跟同一个人在同一个评论区来回聊太多轮时会先审查这段对话有没有营养 —— 如果像两个机器人在互相捧场，就说最后一句、之后不再回复他。还能查每条评论是真公开了还是只有你自己看得见，可以按任意时间范围（最近 1 小时 / 24 小时 / 3 天 / 全部）批量扫描并列出别人看不到的那些，总览上直接告警有多少条被折叠。六页签设置面板，改任何一项立刻生效、不用重启；手动「跑一轮」撞上后台监听会排队而不是被拒；自带环境自检，缺什么直接告诉你。B 站操作需要 Python 3，内置自检会列出缺少的依赖。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the official Vercel MCP server over OAuth, with per-Agent on-demand tool loading, slimmed tool schemas, paged long results and 34 bundled Vercel skills.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 把 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Vercel 官方 MCP 服务，支持按 Agent 按需加载工具、精简工具 schema、长结果分页，并附带 34 个 Vercel 技能。

plugins.name: dsh-graft-plugin

description.en: Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools.
description.zh: 显示当前 dsh 会话所用的 graft 索引、以及它是否仍与代码一致，并把 graft_ask、graft_grep、graft_callers、graft_skeleton、graft_map 作为原生工具交给模型。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Dormant-by-default MCP for dsh: one mcp_summon tool; summoning a server registers its tools as real native mcp__<server>__<tool> tools for the rest of the session, and release unregisters them and stops the process.
description.zh: 休眠式 MCP：只注册一个 mcp_summon 工具，召唤后该服务器的工具在本次会话内以原生 mcp__<server>__<tool> 名称注册，释放即注销并停止进程。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative cloning, and launching and managing Meta, Google and TikTok campaigns. Requires an AdWhispr account.
description.zh: 通过 mcp-remote 加浏览器 OAuth 登录，把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AdWhispr 的远程 MCP 服务：竞品广告调研、广告创意克隆，以及 Meta／Google／TikTok 广告的投放与管理。需要 AdWhispr 账号。

description.en: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.
description.zh: 用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

description.en: Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure drafting, figures and simulation runs, seven-dimension review and docx/PDF export. Skills work out of the box; the search, export and experiment tools come from a bundled Python MCP service that ships disabled - one line in ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml enables it, and uvx fetches the wheel from PyPI.
description.zh: dsh 专利撰写把关人：动笔前先检索中国专利给出三档结论，再走五方对齐访谈、八章交底书、附图与仿真实验、七维审查与 docx/PDF 导出全流程。技能开箱即用；检索、导出与实验工具来自内置的 Python MCP 服务，默认关闭——在 ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml 里开一行即启用，uvx 会从 PyPI 自动拉取。

description.en: Turn English audiobooks (MP3) and documents into listening lessons: transcribe every sentence locally with the speech model DSH voice input already downloaded (about 241 MB, fetched on first use if missing; ffmpeg required), proofread and explain each sentence with your DSH model, then drill with blind listening, intensive listening and spaced repetition, with Chinese-dubbing export and offline Kokoro voices; ships a sidebar panel and four AI tools.
description.zh: 把英文有声读物（MP3）和英文文档（PDF / Word / EPUB / 网页 / TXT）变成听力课：用 DSH 语音输入已下载的模型在本机识别每一句（缺失时首次使用自动下载约 241 MB；需 ffmpeg）、用你选的大模型逐句校对翻译讲解，再以精听、间隔复习、磨耳朵练到一听就懂；支持中文配音导出与离线 Kokoro 语音，提供右侧栏面板和 4 个 AI 工具。

description.en: Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiated generations are approval-gated by default: requests queue in the floating panel and nothing bills until you approve; approval is non-blocking (the agent replies "awaiting your approval" immediately, and results, denials or timeouts are injected back so the agent reports them in the next turn). Floating glass workbench with five tabs (Generate / Approvals / Prompts / History / About), aspect-ratio grid with quality-budget + 16px-alignment sizing, transparent background, batch up to 10 images as aggregated sub-tasks, prompt library with custom JSON sources fetched through a host proxy, persistent generation logs with one-click retry, multi-channel aggregation with per-channel model fetching, bilingual UI (zh/en), stroke-SVG icon set, config import/export. Registers as a Better Sidebar tab when dsh-better-sidebar is installed; stacks above the dsh-cua FAB when both are present.
description.zh: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准才开始生成并计费；审批非阻塞——Agent 立即回复"等你审批"，结果、拒绝或超时以通知注入后续轮次并自动汇报。玻璃拟态浮窗五页签（生成/审批/提示词/记录/说明）、比例网格（质量预算+16px 对齐）、透明背景、批量最多 10 张（子任务聚合，部分成功也返回）、提示词库（自定义 JSON 来源经宿主代理拉取）、生成记录持久化与一键重试、多渠道聚合与逐渠道拉模型、中英双语界面、线性 SVG 图标、配置导入导出。安装 dsh-better-sidebar 自动注册侧栏页签；与 dsh-cua 共存时自动堆叠其悬浮按钮上方。

description.en: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-first observe/act loop with 30 standard tools (element/coordinate targets, auto/a11y/event strategy routing), superseded-observations and no-replay safety semantics, persistent kill switch, RuntimeId/rect-drift stale protection, chat cards and a floating panel (live ops, frame wall, env auto-detect settings), tiled vision describe for low-res models, JSONL audit trail and a pid allowlist. Requires Windows 10+ and Python 3.9+ with uiautomation and pillow (installable from the settings page).
description.zh: Windows 桌面自动化插件：无障碍优先的观察-动作回路（30 个标准工具，元素/坐标双目标与 auto/a11y/event 策略路由），写后作废与禁重放安全语义，持久急停开关，RuntimeId/矩形漂移防错位，对话卡片与悬浮面板（实况/画面/环境自检设置），面向低分辨率模型的分块识图，JSONL 审计与 pid 白名单。需 Windows 10+ 与 Python 3.9+，并安装 uiautomation 与 pillow（设置页可一键安装）。

plugins.name: dsh-literature

description.en: Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed search, APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago citation generation, a side-panel PDF reader with highlights and notes, and AI-assisted Q&A/translation steered into the current conversation.
description.zh: DSH 内置文献库（可选导出到 Zotero）：通过 Unpaywall/arXiv/自定义 URL 模板获取全文 PDF，Crossref 候选式宽松搜索，APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago 引用生成，侧窗 PDF 阅读器（高亮与笔记），以及注入当前对话的 AI 问答/翻译。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.xfa.org
uses literal IP 169.254.169.254 for network access

description.en: Model failover router that queues all connected DSH models, retries with continue text on failure, switches to next model, and quarantines failing models for the day.
description.zh: 模型接力路由器：将已接入 DSH 的全部模型排成优先级队列，失败时自动重试「继续」，不行则切换下一模型，并将故障模型隔离至次日。

description.en: Turns a learning request and local materials into a structured, locally stored AI course with outline, lessons, diagrams and learning progress.
description.zh: 把学习诉求和手头资料变成结构化、纯本地的 AI 课程，含大纲、知识点内容、图表与学习进度。

description.en: Literature research toolset registering 26 model tools over PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, PubTator3 and Semantic Scholar: field-syntax search, ID conversion, bibliographic lookup, citation formatting, MeSH and related-article walking, PubTator bioconcept resolution and relation queries, Europe PMC and Semantic Scholar paging, full-text retrieval, and open-access PDF discovery with optional download. A unified search deduplicates hits across sources and orders results by cross-source hits, then relevance, then citation count; a session knowledge graph with PubTator concept enrichment commits to a persistent user graph and renders as Mermaid. Most sources need no key.
description.zh: 文献研究工具集，注册 26 个模型工具，覆盖 PubMed、Europe PMC、OpenAlex、PubTator3 与 Semantic Scholar：字段语法检索、ID 互换、残缺引文定位、引文格式化、MeSH 与相关文献追溯、PubTator 生物概念归一与关系查询、Europe PMC 与 Semantic Scholar 翻页检索、全文获取，以及开放获取 PDF 发现（可选下载）。统一检索会跨源去重，排序依次按跨源命中、相关度、被引数；会话知识图谱带 PubTator 概念富集，可提交为持久用户图谱并渲染为 Mermaid。多数数据源无需密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-moss-image

description.en: Moss text-to-image inside DSH — describe the picture in chat and get it back; needs a Moss API key from platform.moss.cn, and generation is billed to your own account.
description.zh: DSH 的 Moss 文生图插件——在对话里说一句要画什么，就出一张图；需自备 platform.moss.cn 的 Moss API Key，生成费用由自己的账号承担。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: English port of Windows Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: 10 desktop tools (computer, computer_batch, open_application, windows, ui_elements, clipboard, switch_display, app_skill, request_access, list_granted_applications) with UI Automation, per-app access control, English settings UI and mini progress card overlay, Esc pause/resume, and DSH 0.2.1 unpacked koffi.node auto-discovery. Fork of copylee711/dsh-computer-use; it reuses the same plugin id and tool names, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制插件（英文版）：提供 10 个桌面控制工具（截图、鼠标、键盘、UIA 界面元素读取、剪贴板、窗口管理、应用技能与按应用授权），全英文设置面板与右下角迷你进度卡片浮层，支持按 Esc 暂停或继续，并适配 DSH 0.2.1 的 koffi.node 自动发现。Fork 自 copylee711/dsh-computer-use，沿用同一插件 id 与工具名，两者不能同时安装。

description.en: Route native DeepSeek Harness subagent_fork child sessions onto your Google AI Pro (Antigravity) subscription (Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-OSS 120B) with zero API cost, live SSE streaming, full tool calling, prefill cache warm-up gating, ~200ms HTTPS quota checks, and a chat header button + slide-out settings/effort drawer.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 原生 subagent_fork 子智能体会话路由至 Google AI Pro (Antigravity) 订阅（支持 Gemini 3.8 Flash、Claude Sonnet 5.5、Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-OSS 120B）：零 API 费用、实时流式输出、完整工具调用、并行前缀缓存预热、200ms HTTPS 配额查询，以及聊天栏右上角配额按钮与侧滑模型/推理强度设置面板。

description.en: A namespace management tool for toolsets that supports automatic discovery and integration, designed to help reduce token consumption. Also runs TypeScript and JavaScript in a restricted Node runtime for on-demand namespace calls.
description.zh: 一个用于管理工具集的命名空间管理工具，支持自动发现与集成，用于节省token的消耗还会在受限 Node 运行时执行 TypeScript 与 JavaScript，按需通过命名空间调用工具。

description.en: Read, edit, export and verify Excel VBA projects through a real Excel COM instance: modules, UserForm code, procedure lists and .frm/.frx exports. Windows only, with desktop Excel installed, Python 3.10+ with pywin32, and AccessVBOM=1.
description.zh: 通过真实 Excel COM 读写、导出并校验 Excel VBA 工程：模块、窗体代码、过程清单与 .frm/.frx 导出。仅 Windows：需安装桌面版 Excel、Python 3.10+（含 pywin32），并设置 AccessVBOM=1。

description.en: Disk Janitor for DeepSeek Harness — reports where DSH disk usage goes and reclaims only what is safe to rebuild, always keeping the resources currently in use.
description.zh: DSH 磁盘清理插件：看清磁盘占用都花在哪，只清理可以安全重建的部分，正在使用中的资源始终保留。

description.en: Task timing for DSH agents: a task_clock tool that measures elapsed time on the host monotonic clock, resumes across DSH or system restarts with the gap estimated, and returns unknown rather than inventing a number; it does not touch presets.
description.zh: 给 DSH Agent 的任务计时工具：task_clock 用宿主单调时钟测实际耗时，DSH 或系统重启后可续算并标注空档为估算，桥接不了时返回 unknown 而不是编造数字；不覆盖任何 preset。

description.en: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.
description.zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看

description.en: OneDev integration for dsh: an MCP server exposing the OneDev REST API as 61 tools — 57 administration tools (users, groups, roles, projects, authorizations, build agents and tokens, builds with streamed build logs, global settings, access tokens), 3 standalone documentation-query tools for docs.onedev.io, and environment discovery with per-call multi-environment routing — plus a dsh Web settings page that manages per-environment credentials locally and applies them on the next tool call without a restart.
description.zh: OneDev 集成插件：MCP 服务器将 OneDev REST API 暴露为 61 个工具——57 个管理工具（用户、组、角色、项目、授权、构建代理与令牌、构建及流式构建日志、全局设置、访问令牌）、3 个独立的官方文档查询工具（docs.onedev.io）以及带按调用多环境路由的环境发现；另提供 dsh Web 设置页，在本地管理各环境凭据，保存后下一次工具调用即生效，无需重启。

description.en: Sends QQ mail through an OAuth-authorized agently-cli account. Registers the send_qq_email tool with a user-approval step and exposes a ctx.qqEmail service for other DSH plugins.
description.zh: 用已授权的 agently-cli 账号发送 QQ 邮件：注册 send_qq_email 工具（发送前需用户确认），并对外提供 ctx.qqEmail 服务供其他 DSH 插件调用。

description.en: Mount the QianYuan MCP server inside DeepSeek Harness: one config-layer bundle brings 15 agent-record tools (pitfalls, cached results, identity, task board) to mcp__qianyuan__*. No runtime code; reads are anonymous, writes are ed25519-signed.
description.zh: 把乾元 MCP 服务器挂进 DeepSeek Harness：一个纯配置层 bundle 带来 15 个 agent 记录工具（坑库、成果缓存、身份、任务板），注册为 mcp__qianyuan__*。不含运行时代码；读匿名，写用 ed25519 签名。

description.en: Study coach for DeepSeek Harness: turns a course into a knowledge map of subject, module and unit, records mastery per unit in six stages, plans daily tasks against a materials index, keeps a wrong-answer book and spaced-repetition cards, and serves its own web panel.
description.zh: DSH 的学习教练：把一门课拆成知识地图（大类 / 模块 / 最小单元），逐单元记六档掌握度，按资料索引排每日任务，带错题本与记忆卡，并自带一个网页面板。

description.en: One-click WorkBuddy daily check-in button pinned to the composer tool row. Clicking it calls the check-in route provided by dsh-connect-workbuddy for the currently selected account, and shows the result next to the button: already checked in, credits claimed, or streak days. The done state persists across sessions via a local date stamp and reconciles with the upstream status on load, flipping back automatically after midnight.
description.zh: 常驻输入框工具行的 WorkBuddy 每日签到按钮，一键调用 dsh-connect-workbuddy 的签到路由为当前选中账号签到，并在按钮旁显示结果：已签到、签到成功加分或连签天数。已签状态通过本地日期戳跨会话保留，加载时与上游状态对账，跨天后自动复位。

description.en: Drive local Origin/OriginPro from chat via 27 MCP tools: import .dat/.csv/.txt and CHI workstation .bin files, plot, style, fit, and deliver PNG/TIF/SVG/PDF plus an editable .opju project, with read-back verification on plots, styles and exports. Requires Windows, Origin/OriginPro 2021+ and Python 3.10+, plus `pip install originpro numpy` into the interpreter dsh launches: without the package every tool answers `missing_originpro`, and without an interpreter on PATH no tools register at all.
description.zh: 通过 27 个 MCP 工具在对话里驱动本机 Origin/OriginPro：导入 .dat/.csv/.txt 与 CHI 工作站 .bin，绘图、改样式、拟合，交付 PNG/TIF/SVG/PDF 图片和可继续编辑的 .opju 工程；绘图、样式、导出都带读回验证。需要 Windows、Origin/OriginPro 2021+ 与 Python 3.10+，并把 `pip install originpro numpy` 装进 dsh 启动的那个解释器：缺包时每个工具都会返回 `missing_originpro`，PATH 上没有解释器时工具完全不注册。

description.en: Secondary working directories for a DSH project: the agent keeps the primary workspace as cwd and gains equal read/write/exec permissions on configured secondary directories, configurable from the session header and the new-session page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 项目提供副工作目录：agent 保持主工作区为 cwd，同时对已配置的副目录获得同等读写/执行权限，可在会话头部与新会话页配置。

description.en: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
description.zh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

description.en: Accessibility-first macOS computer use: fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.
description.zh: macOS 电脑控制：Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入。

plugins.name: dsh-cos

description.en: Adds COS storage browsing and transfers, workspace artifact uploads, temporary links, and conversation attachments that retain local copies with cloud object identity, plus Agent tools for Tencent Cloud COS, CI, and MetaInsight.
description.zh: 提供 COS 云存储浏览与传输、工作区产物上传、临时链接，以及同时保留本地副本和云端对象身份的会话附件，并提供腾讯云 COS、数据万象和 MetaInsight 的 Agent 工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to cam.qcloud.com
uses literal IP 1.3.101.112 for network access

description.en: Reads the installed plugins, MCP servers and skills, groups them by capability, and reports which preset each belongs in; can register one preset per category on request.
description.zh: 读取已安装的插件、MCP 服务器与技能，按能力分组，报告每项能力应属于哪个预设；可按需为每个类别注册一个预设。

description.en: Read-only inventory of every agent preset for the Web GUI, with a matrix of which preset holds which tools, MCP servers and skills, plus CLIs that move a plugin between presets.
description.zh: 面向 Web GUI 的 agent 预设只读清单：以矩阵展示每个预设包含哪些工具、MCP 服务器与技能，并提供在预设间迁移插件的命令行工具。

description.en: Clean Architecture reference library for DSH: 8 pinned reference repos (Go, Java, C#, Python) indexed into a local FTS5 database, with assertion rules, a review ledger, and a read-only observation panel.
description.zh: DSH 的 Clean Architecture 参考库:8 个钉版参考仓(Go / Java / C# / Python)索引进本地 FTS5,提供断言规则、审查台账与只读观察窗面板。

description.en: Data cleanup and reconciliation for dsh, built around reviewable evidence: original sources stay read-only, a cell is accepted only after independent checks agree, and every accepted value keeps its provenance and audit trail.
description.zh: 用于数据核对与清洗的 dsh 插件：原始材料保持只读，一格数据只有在多个独立校验一致后才被接受，每个接受值都保留来源与审计痕迹。

description.en: Trip planning workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a map page with day-by-day stops, roam_* tools that draft, review and adopt an itinerary, and optional MCP sidecars for rail tickets and Xiaohongshu notes.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的行程工作台：地图页按天展示站点，roam_* 工具负责起草、审阅与采用行程，可选接入火车票和小红书笔记的 MCP 数据源。

plugins.name: anysearch-dsh

description.en: AnySearch-powered real-time web and vertical search provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 AnySearch 的实时网页与垂直搜索插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Query local log files with Chinese natural-language time expressions (e.g. "yesterday afternoon", "3 hours ago") — precise time range, matched lines, ERROR/WARN/INFO level stats, fully offline.
description.zh: 用中文自然语言时间描述查询本地日志（如「昨天下午」「3小时前」）——精确时间范围、匹配行、级别统计，完全离线。

description.en: Safe, resumable automation and analysis tools for CST Studio Suite, with task planning, solve-budget control, persistent runs, result extraction, far-field analysis, and parameter sweeps.
description.zh: 面向 CST Studio Suite 的安全、可恢复自动化与分析插件，支持任务规划、求解预算控制、持久化运行、结果提取、远场分析和参数扫描。

description.en: Injects the current date and time into the runtime context on every turn, so the agent can read the time instead of inferring it.
description.zh: 每一轮把当前日期时间注入运行上下文，让 agent 能读到准确时间而不是靠推算。

description.en: Pinned-version REA for DeepSeek Harness: installs rea-agents locally, starts its MCP server from that pinned copy, and upgrades only when you press Update.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 固定版本的 REA：把 rea-agents 安装到当前配置档的一个确切版本，从该副本启动其 MCP 服务，只有按下「更新」才升级。

description.en: Drives a local MaaEnd (MXU) client over its loopback HTTP API: 10 maend_* agent tools, a sidebar dashboard panel, and startup-mute / success-gated close-game steps in the task chain. Requires a local MaaEnd install with its MXU service running.
description.zh: 通过本机 MaaEnd（MXU）的 loopback HTTP API 驱动它：10 个 maend_* agent 工具、一个侧边栏看板面板，以及任务链里的启动静音与「全部成功后才关游戏」收尾。需先在本机安装 MaaEnd 并开启 MXU 服务。

description.en: Reads the local NTQQ (QQ 9.9.x) message database on Windows and Linux and exports group and private chat history to txt, csv, json, md, html or sqlite. Ships sixteen model tools: qqnt_status and qqnt_doctor for environment and blocker checks, qqnt_extract_key, qqnt_index to build or inspect the sidecar index, qqnt_list_groups, qqnt_list_chats, qqnt_search, qqnt_stats for totals and monthly counts, qqnt_export_group, qqnt_export_chat and qqnt_export_batch (a chat can be named the way the user says it, and ambiguity refuses instead of guessing), qqnt_jobs for OCR, speech-to-text, chunking and model downloads, qqnt_media for a chat's downloaded images, qqnt_storage for disk usage and allow-listed cleanup, and qqnt_ask plus qqnt_recall for retrieval with citations. The local web UI on 127.0.0.1:46728 adds an incremental SQLite index, six views (chats, export, statistics, ask, settings, models), a task panel, a single-pane layout on narrow screens, sender redaction, media bundling, per-day splitting, export presets and AES-256 password ZIPs; OCR, speech and embedding components install into the plugin's own virtualenv on demand. Needs python3 with sqlcipher3 (the settings page can create a private virtualenv), and the database key is read from the running, logged-in QQ client.
description.zh: 读取 Windows / Linux 本机 NTQQ（QQ 9.9.x）消息库，把群聊与私聊的聊天记录导出成 txt、csv、json、md、html 或 sqlite。包含十六个模型工具：qqnt_status 与 qqnt_doctor（环境体检与排障）、qqnt_extract_key、qqnt_index（建立或查看侧车索引）、qqnt_list_groups、qqnt_list_chats、qqnt_search、qqnt_stats（总量与月度统计）、qqnt_export_group、qqnt_export_chat、qqnt_export_batch（可以直接用用户说的名字指代会话，重名时不猜、返回候选）、qqnt_jobs（截图识别 / 语音转写 / 分块与嵌入 / 下载模型）、qqnt_media（取一个会话已下载的图片）、qqnt_storage（磁盘占用与白名单清理），以及做检索问答与时间线回顾的 qqnt_ask、qqnt_recall。127.0.0.1:46728 上的本地网页界面有六个视图：会话、导出、统计、问答、设置、模型与组件，另有任务面板、窄屏单栏布局、昵称 / QQ 脱敏、媒体打包、按天分文件、导出预设与 AES-256 密码压缩包；OCR、语音与嵌入组件按需装进插件自己的虚拟环境。需要带 sqlcipher3 的 python3（设置页可一键创建独立虚拟环境），数据库密钥从正在登录的 QQ 客户端内存中读取。

description.en: Makes the WorkBuddy desktop app's web search the dsh web_search provider, reusing the app's existing sign-in with no extra configuration.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的网络搜索作为 dsh 的 web_search 提供方，复用 App 已有的登录状态，无需额外配置。

description.en: Linux X11 computer use for DeepSeek Harness: 9 tools (screenshot, move/click/drag/scroll mouse, type, key combos) driven by a zero-dependency Python XTest helper — native-pixel coordinates, per-action verification, optional auto-observation screenshot.
description.zh: Linux X11 电脑控制插件：9 个工具（截图、鼠标移动/点击/拖拽/滚轮、输入、快捷键），由零依赖 Python XTest 助手驱动——原生像素坐标、每次操作返回坐标校验、可选自动截图。

description.en: Windows x64 bundle with the official Antigravity ACP runtime included. Delegates one-shot text tasks with selectable authentication, model and thinking level; uses host peers for Harness >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.2.2-0, including later 0.2.1 RCs and stable 0.2.1.
description.zh: 内置 Google 官方 Antigravity ACP 运行时的 Windows x64 完整包，委派一次性文本任务，支持选择认证方式、模型和思考强度；复用宿主依赖，支持 Harness >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.2.2-0，包含后续 0.2.1 RC 和 0.2.1 正式版。

description.en: Expert-mode agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (v0.9.2, npm dsh-expert-mode, bilingual EN/ZH): a chief coordinator plus 17 domain-expert subagents with automatic task delegation. Features: taskboard scheduler (file-system task state machine pending/ready/running/done/failed, dependency DAG, atomic claim, retry, crash recovery), quality gates (5-stage pipeline for high-risk tasks: requirement clarity, implementation, verification, independent review, integration, with 2-round rework limit), Five-Anchor constraint (review/convergence/anti-drift/collaboration-check/resource-awareness per turn), Near-distance Guidance (identity/task/output template per expert), progressive disclosure (~28% token savings), expert persistence, inter-expert file message bus (direct P2P comm, zero coordinator relay), cross review, experience pool, fast-track for simple tasks, fault recovery with auto-retry. Experts: data analyst, copywriter, legal review, product manager, frontend, UI/UX, architect, social media ops, growth hacker, quant finance, finance, backend, DevOps, database, QA, security.
description.zh: 专家模式 agent preset（v0.9.2，npm 包 dsh-expert-mode，双语双份）：首席协调官 + 17 位领域专家子代理，按任务特性自动委派。特性：任务调度器（文件系统任务状态机 pending/ready/running/done/failed + 依赖DAG + 原子认领 + 重试 + 崩溃恢复）、质量门禁（高风险任务五段式：需求澄清→实现→验证→独立评审→集成，最多回炉2轮）、五锚约束（每轮回顾/收敛/反跑题/协作检查/资源感知自检）+ 近距离引导（身份/任务/输出格式模板）+ 渐进式披露（省token约28%）+ 专家持久化 + 专家间文件消息总线（P2P直连，零协调官中转）+ 交叉评审 + 经验沉淀 + 简单任务快速通道 + 故障自动重试。专家：数据分析/文案/法务/产品/前端/UI-UX/架构/社交运营/增长/量化/财务/后端/DevOps/数据库/QA/安全/生图短视频。

description.en: Windows-only desktop control for DSH with six tools that list windows, capture occluded windows, focus windows, click by coordinate, inject Unicode keyboard input, and diagnose the desktop bridge.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 桌面控制插件，六个工具：列出窗口、抓取被遮挡窗口、聚焦窗口、按坐标点击、注入 Unicode 键盘输入与诊断桌面桥接。

plugins.name: dsh-literature-search

description.en: Literature search for DeepSeek Harness: pubmed_search, pubmed_paper and pubmed_related over the official NCBI E-utilities (including elink related-article ranking), plus scholar_search and scholar_cite (MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX via SerpApi). Both backends return one paper shape, and a settings card configures the API keys, the Scholar backend and the rate/result limits.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的文献检索：pubmed_search、pubmed_paper、pubmed_related 走官方 NCBI E-utilities（含 elink 相关文献排序），scholar_search、scholar_cite 走 Google Scholar（MLA/APA/Chicago/Harvard/Vancouver/BibTeX，需 SerpApi 后端）。两个后端统一为同一种 paper 结构，设置卡片可配置 API key、Scholar 后端与速率/条数上限。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Downloads a Bilibili video with yt-dlp, samples key frames, and transcribes it — from the site subtitles, or from a local faster-whisper install when there are none. Registers the skill the agent uses to write the summary; activates when a user message contains only a video link. Requires yt-dlp and ffmpeg on PATH; transcription needs faster-whisper.
description.zh: 用 yt-dlp 下载 B 站视频、抽帧并转写：优先用站方字幕，没有字幕时调用本机 faster-whisper。注册写总结所需的技能，当用户消息只有一条视频链接时自动启用。需 PATH 上有 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg，转写另需 faster-whisper。

description.en: One switch that takes an MCP server's tool schemas and its instructions block out of the model context for every agent, live and without a restart, built for the 207 tool schemas REA registers whether or not a task is reverse engineering. A pill in the composer dock, /rea on|off|status|toggle, and GET/POST /rea-toggle/state; the position is remembered across restarts and subagents are covered before their first step.
description.zh: 一个开关，实时把某个 MCP 服务器的工具 schema 与说明块从每个 agent 的模型上下文中移除或放回，无需重启——针对 REA 在任何任务下都会注入的 207 个工具 schema 而做。输入框下方胶囊、/rea on|off|status|toggle 与 GET/POST /rea-toggle/state 三种驱动方式；位置跨重启保持，子智能体在第一步之前就被覆盖。

description.en: Trip-planning agent preset for mainland China that answers in Chinese: queries 12306 train availability, Fliggy and Tuniu flight and hotel prices, and real Amap transit routes, checks closures and weather, and delivers a single offline HTML roadbook with draggable maps, three hotel price tiers and an itemized budget. Ships 9 skills, an environment doctor that walks users through missing API keys, and a patch for the 12306 MCP server; it plans and queries but never books or pays.
description.zh: 中文旅行规划 agent 预设「旅行规划助手」（面向国内行程）：实时查 12306 余票、飞猪 / 途牛机票与酒店价格、高德真实路线，核实闭馆与天气，交付一份可离线打开的单文件 HTML 路书（可拖动地图、三档酒店、分项预算）；附 9 个技能、引导用户补齐 Key 的环境自检，以及 12306 MCP 的预售期补丁；只规划查询，不代订代付。

description.en: Registers a `dispatch_task` tool that hands scoped or routine work to an isolated subagent, waits for it to finish, then checks the expected files and runs an optional verification command before returning a short report to the main conversation.
description.zh: 注册 `dispatch_task` 工具，把局部或例行任务交给隔离子 Agent 执行，等待其完成后检查预期文件并运行可选的验证命令，只向主会话返回一份简短报告。

description.en: Windows desktop control connector: through 10 agent tools it captures the screen (including occluded and partially off-screen windows), lists and focuses windows, moves, clicks, drags and scrolls the mouse, and sends key chords or arbitrary Unicode text. Built on koffi FFI: no compiler, no per-call subprocess, and its own GDI screenshot plus PNG encoder.
description.zh: Windows 桌面控制连接器：通过 10 个工具截屏（含被遮挡与半出屏窗口）、枚举与置顶窗口、移动/点击/拖拽/滚轮鼠标、发送组合键与任意中文文字。基于 koffi FFI：无需编译器、不每次起子进程，自带 GDI 截图与 PNG 编码。

description.en: Adds a writing console above the composer with four style tiers (T1-T4) and five rigor tiers (L1-L5), selectable by hand or left to automatic choice; keeps project terminology and banned phrasing in .mem/config.md with a read-only human section; and provides a whale_polish tool that rewrites expression without changing facts.
description.zh: 在输入框上方增加写作控制台：四种风格档（T1–T4）与五种严谨档（L1–L5）可手动选择或自动判断；把术语、禁用写法等记入 .mem/config.md（人工区只读）；并提供只改表达、不改事实的 whale_polish 润色工具。

description.en: Answers @file completion from the Everything index through es.exe instead of walking the workspace, keeping the workspace root as the ranking scope. Windows only; needs Everything and es.exe on PATH.
description.zh: 用 es.exe 从 Everything 索引回答 @file 补全，而不是遍历工作区，并以工作区根目录作为排序范围。仅限 Windows；需先安装 Everything 与 es.exe 并加入 PATH。

description.en: Render GeoJSON or vector data into an interactive GeoLibre map in a sidebar tab, and let agents operate the live map through tools: layers, styles, view, feature identification, GeoLibre processing algorithms, and the Whitebox toolbox (WASM in the browser).
description.zh: 把 GeoJSON / 矢量数据渲染成侧边栏「地图」tab 里的交互地图，并让 Agent 通过工具实时操作地图：图层、样式、视图、要素识别、GeoLibre 处理算法与 Whitebox 工具箱（浏览器端 WASM 执行）。

description.en: Pre-launch and runtime HTTP proxy control: writes the proxy into DSH's user-level .env so the launcher and the requests before any plugin loads use it, then keeps that file in sync from a switch in the Plugins page.
description.zh: 启动前与运行时的 HTTP 代理控制：把代理写入 DSH 用户级 .env，让启动器和任何插件加载前的请求也走代理，并在「插件」页用开关同步该文件。

description.en: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.
description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 BailingHub，直接操作商城、SaaS 或其他业务系统后台，在现有账号权限内查询数据、修改资料并执行已开放的操作。

description.en: Publishes the running DSH host as a Model Context Protocol endpoint, so other harnesses such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or another DSH can start and continue sessions, read transcripts, wait on or cancel turns, and answer pending approvals; every call is attributed to its caller, and owner-scoped sessions keep callers apart.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DSH 宿主发布成 MCP 端点，让 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、另一个 DSH 等 harness 可以创建与延续会话、读取对话记录、等待或取消回合、代答待决审批；每次调用都归因到发起方，会话按所有者隔离。

description.en: Construction cost workbench for DeepSeek Harness projects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 项目的工程造价工作台。

description.en: DOCX to PDF without Microsoft Office, LibreOffice or a network: converts a Word .docx with the dxpdf Rust/Skia engine, repairs the schema-invalid OOXML that WPS Office writes, and restores the blank pages Word inserts at odd/even section breaks. Needs Python 3.8+ on PATH with pip install dxpdf lxml.
description.zh: 不依赖 Microsoft Office、LibreOffice 或网络的 DOCX 转 PDF:用 dxpdf(Rust/Skia)引擎转换 Word 文档,自动修复 WPS Office 写出的非法 OOXML,并补齐 Word 在奇偶页节分界处插入的空白页。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+ 并 pip install dxpdf lxml。

description.en: Configurable, provider-agnostic image generation: mounts the bundled MCP server behind an NDJSON bridge as mcp__image_generation__image_generate and mcp__image_generation__image_config_status, and registers the bundled image-generation skill. Needs baseUrl and apiKey; without them the MCP server mounts nothing.
description.zh: 可配置、与供应商无关的图片生成:把随插件分发的 MCP 服务器挂在 NDJSON 桥后面,提供 mcp__image_generation__image_generate 与 mcp__image_generation__image_config_status,并注册 image-generation 技能。需要配置 baseUrl 与 apiKey，否则 MCP 服务器不会挂载。

description.en: Auditable mathematical proving for DeepSeek Harness: a local stdio MCP server with 23 machine-checking tools, a bundled workflow skill, and the /prove and /audit-proof commands. proven, refuted and inconclusive are never conflated, and unproven steps are reported instead of hidden. Needs Python 3.10+ with pip install -r requirements.txt on first run; the 23 tools are unavailable until then.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的可审计数学证明:本地 stdio MCP 服务器(23 个机器校验工具)+ 工作流技能 + /prove、/audit-proof 命令。proven / refuted / inconclusive 绝不混淆,未证明的步骤如实报告而非隐藏。需 Python 3.10+，首次运行要 pip install -r requirements.txt（就绪前 23 个工具不可用）。

description.en: Text-to-image through a StepFun-compatible endpoint: mounts a no-npm-dependency Python MCP server behind an NDJSON bridge as mcp__simple_image__simple_image and returns the generated image URLs. Needs Python 3.8+ on PATH and STEP_API_KEY.
description.zh: 通过 StepFun 兼容接口文生图:把无 npm 依赖的 Python MCP 服务器挂在 NDJSON 桥后面,用 mcp__simple_image__simple_image 生成并返回图片 URL。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+ 并设置 STEP_API_KEY。

description.en: Image generation through TokenRhythm: mounts a no-npm-dependency Python stdio MCP server as mcp__tokenrhythm_image__generate_image, producing images with qwen-image-2.0 or wan2.7-image and saving them to a directory you choose. Needs Python 3.8+ on PATH and TOKENRHYTHM_API_KEY.
description.zh: 用 TokenRhythm 生成图片:把无 npm 依赖的 Python stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__tokenrhythm_image__generate_image,用 qwen-image-2.0 或 wan2.7-image 生成并存到你指定的目录。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+ 并设置 TOKENRHYTHM_API_KEY。

description.en: Connects an existing local BeatGEO instance through its scoped MCP key for brands, AI visibility evidence and drafts; includes setup diagnostics and a Skill for the same brand's SEO dashboard.
description.zh: 通过工作区权限受限的 MCP Key 连接已有本地 BeatGEO，操作品牌、AI 可见度证据和草稿；附带连接诊断与同品牌 SEO 页面操作 Skill。

description.en: Five native tools for Social Data discovery, pricing previews, approved reads, stored-result retrieval and source tables; requires a BeatAPI key for paid reads.
description.zh: 提供社媒能力发现、价格预览、确认后读取、历史结果取回及来源表格；付费读取需要 BeatAPI key。

description.en: Agent-native API client for DeepSeek Harness: Postman-like debugging UI (request tree with context menus and full keyboard navigation, resizable sidebar, layered auto-generated header preview with per-item suppression and constant secret masking), six api_client_* agent tools sharing the same request core, redaction and audit chain with the human UI, Postman Collection v2.1 import with a migration report, environment variables with SecretRef indirection, and a fail-closed SSRF network policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 原生 API Client：Postman 级调试 UI（右键菜单与完整键盘导航的请求树、可调宽侧栏、自动生成 Header 分层预览——逐项可停用、敏感值恒脱敏），六个 api_client_* Agent 工具与 Human UI 共用同一请求核心、脱敏与审计链，Postman Collection v2.1 导入附迁移报告，环境变量经 SecretRef 间接引用，SSRF 网络策略默认 fail-closed。

description.en: Transactional uninstall engine: every destructive action runs validate/preview/execute/undo with Saga rollback, WAL crash recovery, hash-chain audit, hardlink dedup, and a Bayesian oracle that predicts success probability before you commit.
description.zh: 事务化卸载引擎：每个破坏性动作走 validate/preview/execute/undo 四段式并带 Saga 回滚，WAL 崩溃恢复、hash chain 审计、硬链接去重，提交前先知推演成功率。

plugins.name: dsh-wechat-collector

description.en: WeChat Official Account source collector: QR-login credential profiles, rate-limit-safe crawling with cooldown, RSS second water source, and secret-safe handoff to ContentStudio.
description.zh: 公众号素材采集：扫码登录的多套凭证档案、带冷却保护的限流安全抓取、RSS 第二水源，以及凭证隔离的 ContentStudio 来源卡交接。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Six RF calculators as agent tools: level conversion, link budget and maximum range, cascade noise figure, Shannon capacity, and impedance match.
description.zh: 六个射频计算工具：电平换算、链路预算与最大距离、级联噪声系数、香农容量、阻抗匹配。

description.en: Use the Jev (System One) decision-model paradigm with any OpenAI-compatible LLM — no TypeSafe key required. Registers a jev_decide tool that returns probability-distributed answers to typed questions (choice/score/boolean) in one call.
description.zh: 用任意 OpenAI 兼容大模型跑 Jev 决策范式——无需 TypeSafe key。注册 jev_decide 工具，一次调用返回带概率分布的类型化答案（choice/score/boolean）。

description.en: WebUI panel for the dsh-guardian watchdog: start, stop and inspect two macOS LaunchAgents with status, log tail and explicit failure states.
description.zh: dsh-guardian 守护程序面板：在 dsh WebUI 中启动、停止并查看两个 macOS LaunchAgent 的状态、日志尾行与明确的失败提示。

description.en: Connect DSH to a local BiliMemory backend for Bilibili search, collection, status and login tasks, A-Memorix shared memory health checks, plus QQ link status, QQ user allowlists and QQ watcher restart. The repository includes a Windows one-click installer that installs or repairs MaiBot A-Memorix when missing, then configures local-bge-small-zh, embedding and shared memory. It also provides install-memory.cmd for memory-only repair. Requires Windows, DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+, Node.js 22.19+, Python 3.12, Playwright/Edge, FFmpeg, a running BiliMemory API at 127.0.0.1:8765, a local embedding service at 127.0.0.1:11435, a Bilibili login, and MaiBot/NapCat for QQ. Voice, RVC and cover features are excluded.
description.zh: 把本地 BiliMemory 接入 DSH，支持 B站搜索、视频采集、任务状态、登录管理、A-Memorix 共用记忆状态检查，以及 QQ 链接监听状态、QQ 白名单和监听重启。仓库提供 Windows 一键部署器，可在 A-Memorix 缺失时自动安装或修复，并配置 local-bge-small-zh、向量服务和共享记忆。另提供 install-memory.cmd 用于单独修复记忆库。需要 Windows、DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+、Node.js 22.19+、Python 3.12、Playwright/Edge、FFmpeg、运行中的 BiliMemory API（127.0.0.1:8765）、本机 embedding 服务（127.0.0.1:11435）、B站账号登录，以及用于 QQ 的 MaiBot/NapCat。当前不包含语音、RVC 和翻唱功能。

description.en: Runs commands as background jobs that keep executing when DSH exits, with an optional sandbox to constrain file effects, plus a live web panel and offline CLI/GUI management. Windows only for now.
description.zh: 将命令提交为独立于 DSH 进程的后台任务（可选沙箱），关闭 DSH 也不影响运行，并提供实时网页面板与离线 CLI/GUI 管理。当前仅支持Windows系统。

description.en: MySQL and PostgreSQL connection manager with a schema tree, table search, SQL console with completion, and four agent tools for listing connections, searching tables, inspecting structure, and running queries.
description.zh: MySQL/PostgreSQL 数据库连接管理，带库表字段树、表名搜索、SQL 补全控制台，以及列出连接、搜索表、查看结构和执行 SQL 的四个 Agent 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-database

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness Web to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB for schema discovery and read-only queries through session-authorized MCP tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 数据库插件：统一管理 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB 连接，让 Agent 按会话授权探索数据结构、执行只读查询并辅助数据分析。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Handwriting and diagram whiteboard: sketch on a floating or sidebar canvas and attach the cropped image to your message.
description.zh: 手写公式、画示意图的画板：浮动或侧栏画布，导出裁切后的图片作为消息附件。

plugins.name: dsh-moss-draw#plugin

description.en: Adds seven `art_*` agent tools plus a right-sidebar drawing workbench (series, pages, revisions, regions, camera blockout) that submits ComfyUI graphs to a ComfyUI instance you host, for MOSS/K2 text-to-image, inpaint, character references, region editing and Qwen-Image edits, with up to four caller LoRAs stacked per request. Requires a local checkout and one adapter step: after a marketplace install, run `install/adapt.mjs` (or use `install/install.ps1` on Windows) to replace the `__MOSS_*__` placeholders with an absolute `workspaceRoot` and a ComfyUI origin; until then the Host refuses to load the preset with `MOSS_CONFIG_*`.
description.zh: 给 Agent 增加 7 个 art_* 工具和一个右侧栏绘图工作台（系列、页、修订、区域、相机体块），把工作流提交到你自建的 ComfyUI：MOSS/K2 文生图、局部重绘、角色参考、区域编辑与 Qwen 图像编辑，单次请求可叠加最多 4 个自备 LoRA。需要本机仓库执行一次适配：市场安装后运行 `install/adapt.mjs`（Windows 可用 `install/install.ps1`）把 `__MOSS_*__` 占位符替换为绝对的 `workspaceRoot` 与 ComfyUI 地址，否则 Host 会以 `MOSS_CONFIG_*` 拒绝加载预设。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Per-project MCP servers: a project declares servers in its own documents (`.dsh/mcp.json` by default; the local and global file lists are settings), and they are mounted only for the sessions working in that project — on the first turn of a session, released when it goes idle. A right-sidebar tab and a Settings page list each project with a live session, the status of every server and the session holding each mount, with `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`, an `enabled` switch and an editor over one existing entry; a per-project tool policy (`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`) with pins and `mcp_search_tools` decides what the model sees; `${VAR}` references resolve through the project `.env` files and the credentials file; per-server call counters outlive the sessions that produced them.
description.zh: 按项目挂载 MCP 服务器：项目在自己的文档里声明服务器（默认 `.dsh/mcp.json`，本地与全局文件列表均为配置项），只对在该项目中工作的会话挂载——会话首个 turn 时挂载，空闲后释放。右侧栏标签页与设置页列出每个有活动会话的项目、各服务器状态以及持有挂载的会话，并提供 `Sync` / `Retry` / `Release`、`enabled` 开关和对某个既有条目的编辑器；按项目的工具策略（`disclosure` / `direct` / `off`）配合固定项与 `mcp_search_tools` 决定模型可见范围；`${VAR}` 引用依次从项目 `.env` 文件与凭据文件解析；按服务器统计的调用次数不随会话消失。

description.en: Connects the Bowmark hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes, so the agent can search a library of typed functions for live websites and call them. The API key is read from the BOWMARK_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
description.zh: 接入 Bowmark 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具，让智能体搜索并调用面向实时网站的类型化函数库。API Key 从 BOWMARK_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

description.en: Adds a subagent_routed tool that runs a one-shot subagent fully mounted on any agent preset from any session, with per-call model/provider override and a model-availability pre-check.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_routed 工具：从任意会话发起一次性子 Agent，并完整挂载到任意 agent preset 上运行，支持按次覆盖模型/提供方，并在调用前预检模型可用性。

description.en: Chinese writing-register plugin for the Gcores/机核 editor 白广大: registers a 40 KB style skill plus style_lint / style_audit / style_rules tools — 4 hard-error and 27 warning checks (banned connectives, slogan inflation, empty quantifiers, uniform paragraphs, unsourced statistics, AI clichés), with thresholds calibrated on 444 articles / 802k characters; a settings page adds an on/off switch, single and batch trial runs, and JSON threshold overrides.
description.zh: 把机核网编辑白广大的中文文风做成可执行的判据：注册一份 40 KB 风格技能，并提供 style_lint / style_audit / style_rules 三个工具——4 条硬错误 + 27 条警告（空转转折、金句通胀、冗余量词、段落过于均匀、孤证数字、AI 口头禅等），阈值按 444 篇 / 80.2 万字语料标定；设置页带总开关、单篇与批量试跑、阈值 JSON 覆盖。

description.en: Registers Brave as the web_search provider, resolving the API key from the DSH credential store, $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml, or the environment. No settings card and no fallback engine: one request to Brave's Web Search API per search.
description.zh: 把 Brave 注册为 web_search 的搜索提供方，API Key 依次从 DSH 凭证库、$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml 或环境变量读取。无设置卡片、无备用引擎：每次搜索向 Brave Web Search API 发起一次请求。

description.en: Git Bash shell tool for Windows: runs commands through the bash bundled with Git for Windows, with timeout, sandbox, output truncation, and background jobs, replacing the slow pwsh tool and the WSL-only bash tool.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 Git Bash 工具：通过 Git for Windows 自带的 bash 执行命令，支持超时、沙箱、输出截断与后台任务，替代卡顿的 pwsh 工具与仅限 WSL 的 bash 工具。

description.en: UGREEN NAS connector for UGOS Pro: 59 agent tools covering all 70 access-token permissions over OpenCLI — files, storage, task metrics, Docker, downloads, app management, control panel and global search, auto-gated per category by what the token grants.
description.zh: 绿联 NAS（UGOS Pro）连接器：通过访问令牌调用 OpenCLI，59 个工具覆盖全部 70 项令牌权限——文件、存储、任务指标、Docker、下载、应用管理、控制面板与全局搜索，按令牌实际授予自动增减。

description.en: Session execution analytics: steps, tool calls, failures, repeated actions, token usage and verification signals, rendered as text/Markdown/JSON reports.
description.zh: 会话执行分析：步骤、工具调用、失败、重复动作、token 用量与验证信号，输出 text/Markdown/JSON 报告。

description.en: Evidence-first vulnerability research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: native audit views, 29 OMV tools, Evidence.v1 findings, reproducible runs, Campaign workflows, and isolated PoC evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先漏洞研究工作台：原生审计视图、29 个 OMV 工具、Evidence.v1 Finding、可复现 Run、Campaign 工作流和隔离 PoC 证据。

description.en: Git-based multi-device sync for DSH configuration — captures settings, plugin manifests, lockfiles and skills into a private repository, with one-click capture, apply, pull and restore, and plugin rebuilds from pnpm-lock.
description.zh: 基于私有 Git 仓库的 DSH 多端配置同步——把设置、插件清单、锁文件与技能纳管到私有仓库，设置页一键捕获、应用、拉取与回滚，并按 pnpm-lock 确定性重建插件依赖。

description.en: Engineering work-tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers two model-facing Host Tools — a scoped `git` runner, and a package-manager runner (`dev`) that detects npm/pnpm/yarn/bun from the workspace lockfile and picks the right verb per manager. Both run through dsh's sandboxed shell and return structured stdout/stderr/exitCode, so the agent gets focused, reviewable results instead of raw bash, and adding another tool is a copy-paste of one register block.
description.zh: 面向软件工程师的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：注册两个模型可直接调用的 Host Tool——受工作区约束的 `git` 运行器，以及按 lockfile 自动识别 npm/pnpm/yarn/bun 并选择正确动词的包管理器运行器（`dev`）。两者都经 dsh 沙箱 shell 执行，返回规整的 stdout/stderr/exitCode，让 agent 拿到聚焦、可复核的结果而不是裸 bash；再加一个工具只需复制一个 register 块。

plugins.name: dsh-icloud-calendar

description.en: Read and write Apple iCloud Calendar over CalDAV through five tools: list calendars, read a window with recurring events expanded, create an event, and delete behind a dry run that must confirm the exact object count. Credentials come from DPAPI, Keychain or libsecret, or from an environment variable.
description.zh: 通过 CalDAV 读写苹果 iCloud 日历，提供五个工具：列出日历、按时间窗读取并展开重复日程、创建事件，以及先干跑、按对象数确认后再删除。凭据保存在 DPAPI／钥匙串／libsecret 或环境变量中。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to calendarserver.org

description.en: Resident search index living in the host process: hot_find (fuzzy filename and path match, with frecency and git status), hot_fuzzy (content search that tolerates typos, including in Chinese), hot_grep (literal and regex content search), hot_plan (groups hits per file so a batch of files can be read in order) and hot_stats. One in-memory line index is built once and rebuilt on demand, so a query does not spawn a process.
description.zh: 活在宿主进程里的常驻检索索引：hot_find（文件名与路径模糊匹配，带 frecency 与 git 状态）、hot_fuzzy（内容检索，中文错字也能命中）、hot_grep（字面与正则内容检索）、hot_plan（按文件聚合命中，便于排批量阅读顺序）与 hot_stats。一份内存行索引只建一次、按需重建，单次查询不启动进程。

description.en: RTK (Rust Token Killer) extension for dsh-router: rewrites each bash tool call through `rtk rewrite` so the agent reads compressed command output, and falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent.
description.zh: dsh-router 的 RTK(Rust Token Killer)扩展插件：把每次 bash 工具调用经 `rtk rewrite` 改写，让 agent 读到压缩后的命令输出；rtk 缺失或无等价改写时原样执行。

description.en: A persona and memory plugin for DSH Desktop. Distill characters from chats, novels, scripts, or character sheets; keep long-term and temporary memories, learn style corrections and approved replies, detect persona leakage after switching, visualize memories, and import or export persona cards. Task guidance is reduced to one lightweight fixed discipline with no plans, ledgers, or dynamic reminders.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 人设与记忆插件：从聊天记录、小说、剧本或设定文档蒸馏角色；支持长期与临时记忆、风格学习、认可语料、人设切换纠偏、记忆星图和角色卡导入导出。任务侧仅保留轻量工作纪律，不再注入计划、台账或动态提醒。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to AsimovBox for creating, updating, rendering, and finishing videos through API-key-authenticated tools.
description.zh: 通过 API 密钥认证的工具将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 AsimovBox，用于创建、更新、渲染和完成视频。

description.en: Stage-gate governance tools: model-callable gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close for in-memory, per-session acceptance checks with PASS/BLOCK conclusions.
description.zh: 阶段门治理工具：模型可直接调用的 gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close，为多阶段工作提供内存态、按会话隔离的验收核对与通过/阻塞结论。

description.en: Econometrics research assistant: 6 tools covering method selection, data preparation, model specification, empirical analysis with Python/R/Stata code templates, robustness checks, and result reporting.
description.zh: 计量经济学研究助手：6 个工具覆盖方法选择、数据预处理、模型设定、实证分析（含 Python/R/Stata 代码模板）、稳健性检验与结果报告。

description.en: IMAP/SMTP mail tools for listing, reading, searching, replying, sending and moving messages, with built-in provider presets (QQ, 163, 126, Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or a custom server), attachment upload and download, and a sidebar page for account setup.
description.zh: 通过 IMAP/SMTP 列出、读取、搜索、回复、发送和移动邮件的工具集，内置 QQ／163／126／Gmail／Outlook／iCloud 与自定义服务器预设，支持附件上传下载，并提供侧栏账号配置页。

description.en: A document preview / edit / management plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It provides a VSCode-style "Document Center" workbench inside the DSH Web GUI: a file tree on the left, click-to-preview, editable code & Markdown with Ctrl/Cmd+S save; and exposes three document tools (doc_read / doc_edit / doc_create) to agents, letting models read and write workspace documents through natural language.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的文档预览 / 编辑 / 管理插件。在 DSH Web GUI 中提供一个 VSCode 风格的「文档中心」工作台：左侧文件树，点击即预览，代码与 Markdown 支持编辑与 Ctrl/Cmd+S 保存；同时为 Agent 暴露 doc_read / doc_edit / doc_create 三个文档工具，让模型可以通过自然语言读写工作区文档。

description.en: Scans MCP servers configured in Claude Code, Codex and CodeBuddy and probes real connectivity via stdio and streamable-http initialize handshakes, with enable/disable toggles and a /mcp control panel.
description.zh: 扫描 Claude Code / Codex / CodeBuddy 配置中的 MCP，通过 stdio 与 streamable-http initialize 握手检测真实连通性，支持启停开关与 /mcp 控制面板。

description.en: Renders the built-in cache-hit percentage with three decimals and widens the composer stats line to prevent truncation.
description.zh: 把内置缓存命中率原位显示为 3 位小数，并加宽底部统计行避免内容被截断。

description.en: Per-execution HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy routing for Agent fetches, LLM providers, and shell commands, with settings-backed hot reload, approval-gated controls, and credential-safe status.
description.zh: 按每次执行为 Agent fetch、LLM provider 与 shell 命令路由 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理；支持 settings 热更新、审批门禁和凭据安全状态。

description.en: Normalizes every tool schema before it reaches the model, rewriting it into the strict OpenAPI 3.0 subset that Gemini function declarations accept — a type on every node, items on every array, no empty enum entry, $ref inlined — so a single offending MCP or built-in tool no longer fails the whole request with HTTP 400.
description.zh: 把发给模型的工具 schema 统一归一化成 Gemini function declaration 能接受的 OpenAPI 3.0 子集：每个节点补 type、数组补 items、剔除空 enum 项、内联 $ref，让"任何一个 MCP 或内置工具不合规"不再把整包请求打成 HTTP 400。

description.en: Moves DSH plugins between machines and profiles: export a migration bundle where local plugins keep their source and remote ones reinstall by version, restore it elsewhere with the bundle's own restore.mjs, copy plugins to another profile, or pack the whole environment (config, memory, sessions, attachments, plugin sources) into checksummed volumes with a restore script.
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件搬到另一台机器或另一个 profile：导出迁移包（本地插件带源码、远程插件按版本重装），用包自带的 restore.mjs 在别处恢复，一键复制到其他 profile，或把配置/记忆/会话/附件/插件源码打成带校验分卷并附恢复脚本。

description.en: Lets one session read, write and run bash across several folders, not just the primary root — additional roots are registered from a sidebar Folders panel or the /workspace-folders command (inherit/read-only/read-write) and share the primary root's file-fence + OS-sandbox authorization; adds no new tools.
description.zh: 让单个会话在多个文件夹中读写并运行 bash，而不限于主目录——附加根经侧栏 Folders 面板或 /workspace-folders 命令登记（inherit/read-only/read-write），与主根共享同一套文件围栏 + 内核沙箱授权；不新增工具。

description.en: Blender 3D production plugin with 30 modeling/reconstruction skills, 13 runtime tools, and 26 deterministic helpers for reference fitting, rendering, validation, animation, and portable export; installable as `dsh-blender`.
description.zh: Blender 3D 生产插件：提供 30 个建模/重建 Skill、13 个运行时工具和 26 个确定性 Helper，覆盖参考图拟合、渲染、验证、动画与可移植格式导出；npm 包名 `dsh-blender`。

description.en: Zero-dependency MCP client bridge that connects stdio and HTTP MCP servers and registers their tools as mcp_<server>_<tool> for the agent.
description.zh: 零依赖 MCP 客户端桥接，连接 stdio 与 HTTP MCP server，把其工具注册为 mcp_<server>_<tool> 供 agent 调用。

description.en:
Static HTML auditor for Chinese line-breaking: checks explicit-`
` orphan lines, keep-all CSS coverage, CJK line-start/line-end punctuation rules, and protected-phrase splits, then inserts at natural breakpoints; exposes a cn_linebreak_audit tool for agents.
description.zh:
中文网页文案断行静态审查与修复工具：检查显式
孤字行、keep-all 覆盖、标点禁则、保护词被拆等问题，并在自然停顿处自动插入 ；提供 cn_linebreak_audit 工具供代理调用。

description.en: Make DSH follow your system network settings: route through the OS proxy and trust its certificate store, so TLS-intercepting accelerators work without environment variables or a restart.
description.zh: 让 DSH 跟随系统网络设置：走系统代理并信任系统证书库，无需环境变量、无需重启。

description.en: Keeps bulk output out of the conversation: ctk_execute, ctk_execute_file and ctk_batch_execute run code in a child process and return only the conclusion, ctk_index and ctk_search file long material into a local FTS5 knowledge base built on node:sqlite, and a routing gate refuses curl and wget before they execute. Ships ctk_stats and ctk_doctor plus a settings page with a live context-occupancy panel. No third-party runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 让大块输出不进对话：ctk_execute、ctk_execute_file 与 ctk_batch_execute 在子进程里跑代码只回结论，ctk_index 与 ctk_search 把长材料存进基于 node:sqlite 的本地 FTS5 知识库，路由门禁在执行前拦下 curl 与 wget。附 ctk_stats、ctk_doctor 与带实时上下文占用面板的设置页，零第三方运行时依赖。

description.en: Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code's Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).
description.zh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

description.en: Claude Code-style shell integration: /! for single-command analysis and /terminal for interactive PTY sessions with on-demand history reference.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格的 shell 集成：/! 单命令分析 与 /terminal 交互式终端（带按需历史引用）。

description.en: Detect and contain runaway symbol streams at the model boundary in DeepSeek Harness, with tooling to repair polluted artifacts and sessions.
description.zh: 在模型输出边界检测并拦截退化符号流，并提供修复被污染工件与会话的工具。

description.en: AI UI automation via Midscene — android_ui and web_ui tools that tap, type, query, and assert on a real Android device or an already-running Chrome through the ctx.midscene seam.
description.zh: 基于 Midscene 的 AI UI 自动化——android_ui 与 web_ui 工具，通过 ctx.midscene seam 在真实 Android 设备或已运行的 Chrome 上完成点击、输入、查询与断言。

description.en: Drives a local Hiddify installation from DeepSeek Harness without its GUI: seven tools to start and stop the core, switch split-tunnel modes (rebuilds the config and restarts the core), rotate exit nodes through the Clash control plane, and search or fetch pages through the proxy. Windows only.
description.zh: 不打开 Hiddify 桌面版也能用它：七个工具起停内核、切换分流模式（重建配置并重启内核）（外网走代理／国内与内网直连）、经 Clash 控制面轮换出口节点，并经代理做多引擎检索与网页抓取。仅 Windows。

description.en: Literature search tools for DeepSeek Harness: four model-facing tools — paper_search, paper_get, paper_citations and book_search — over OpenAlex, arXiv, Crossref, Semantic Scholar and PubMed, with open-access PDF resolution through Unpaywall.
description.zh: DSH 学术检索工具：四个模型可用工具 paper_search / paper_get / paper_citations / book_search，覆盖 OpenAlex、arXiv、Crossref、Semantic Scholar、PubMed 五个库，并用 Unpaywall 解析开放获取 PDF。

description.en: Data analysis toolkit: CSV/TSV/JSON profiling, IQR and z-score anomaly detection, structured summarization with quality issues, and code-free filter/group/aggregate queries.
description.zh: 数据分析工具包：CSV/TSV/JSON 数据画像、IQR 与 z-score 异常检测、带质量问题提示的结构化摘要、以及无需写代码的筛选/分组/聚合查询。

description.en: Codebase knowledge graphs for DeepSeek Harness: seven graphify_* Agent tools, a /graphify command, and a Graphify page build and query a project graph locally with AST parsing (no API key), plus path/explain/god-node lookups and wiki/HTML/SVG/GraphML/Obsidian exports. Requires the graphify CLI (graphifyy); only full document/PDF/image extraction needs an LLM key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码库知识图谱：7 个 graphify_* Agent 工具、/graphify 命令与 Graphify 页面，用本地 AST 解析构建并查询项目图谱（无需 API Key），支持路径 / 解释 / 枢纽节点查询与 wiki、HTML、SVG、GraphML、Obsidian 导出。需先安装 graphify CLI（graphifyy）；只有含文档 / PDF / 图片的完整抽取需要 LLM Key。

description.en: Drives the installed AutoCAD over COM and exposes it to the agent as 18 mcp__autocad__ tools: connect and status, cancel the current command, list registered ProgIDs, list or create documents, save, create and list layers, draw lines, circles, rectangles, polylines, arcs and text, list entities, zoom to extents, and pass any native command through. A sidebar panel owns the Python bridge process — start, stop, restart, dependency bootstrap, live logs and crash recovery — and resolves every path at runtime, so the same bundle serves both the web app and the desktop app. Windows only, Python 3.10-3.12, AutoCAD 2022-2024 documented (2024 is the default; other versions require setting CAD_PROG_ID to the matching ProgID).
description.zh: 通过 COM 驱动本机安装的 AutoCAD，把它暴露成 18 个 mcp__autocad__ 工具：连接与状态、取消当前命令、列出本机注册的 ProgID、列出或新建文档、保存、新建与列出图层、绘制直线/圆/矩形/多段线/圆弧/文字、列出图元、缩放到范围，以及透传任意 AutoCAD 原生命令。侧边栏面板托管驱动它的 Python 桥进程——启动、停止、重启、安装依赖、实时日志与崩溃自动重启——所有路径在运行时解析，同一个 bundle 在 Web 版与桌面版都能用。仅 Windows，Python 3.10-3.12，文档覆盖 AutoCAD 2022-2024（默认 2024；其他版本需把 CAD_PROG_ID 设为对应 ProgID）。

description.en: Cloudflare D1 tools for agents: d1_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health over the D1 HTTP API, read-only by default with a SQLite-accurate lexical guard, LIMIT row cap, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.
description.zh: Cloudflare D1 数据库工具：d1_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health，通过 D1 HTTP API 访问，默认只读（SQLite 语义的词法级只读保护）、LIMIT 行数上限、CSV/JSON 查询输出与写审批门。

description.en: 123 Cloud Drive (123pan) client: signs in with a phone number or email plus password, or a pasted token, browses and drag-drop uploads and downloads through a sidebar panel, backs up a workspace incrementally while keeping its directory tree, and exposes 15 tools for an agent to list, upload, download, rename, move and delete files. Network, MD5, 16MB multipart upload and token encryption run in a bundled statically linked C++ core, so it needs no Python or other runtime. Windows 10/11 x64 only.
description.zh: 123 云盘客户端：支持手机号或邮箱密码登录，也支持粘贴 token；侧栏面板可浏览、拖拽上传与下载，并能对工作区做保留目录结构的增量备份；同时提供 15 个工具供 agent 列目录、上传、下载、重命名、移动和删除文件。网络请求、MD5、16MB 分片上传与 token 加密都由随包的静态链接 C++ 核心完成，不需要 Python 或其他运行时。仅 Windows 10/11 x64。

description.en: Semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: registers two native tools, semble_search (find code by describing its behaviour, returning ranked file:line hits) and semble_find_related (neighbours of a known location), which run the Semble CLI via uvx, plus one bundled routing skill. Requires uv on PATH; the first query on a repository builds its index.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的语义代码搜索：注册 semble_search（按行为描述检索代码，返回按相关度排序的 file:line 命中）与 semble_find_related（查找已知位置的相邻代码）两个原生工具，检索由 uvx 启动的 Semble CLI 完成，并附一个随包分发的路由技能。需要 PATH 中有 uv；对某个仓库的首次查询会建立索引。

description.en: AI interview practice for DeepSeek Harness Web: generates questions across four modes (concept review, mock interview, scenario, LeetCode Hot 100), scores answers, and provides explanations.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 面试陪练：支持背八股、模拟面试、场景题与力扣热题 100 四种模式，自动评分、点评并讲解知识点。

description.en: Code-generated math and science animation for DSH: six tools cover environment checks and dependency self-repair, Manim/manimgx scene rendering to storyboard frames or MP4, contact-sheet probing of finished clips for black or overexposed frames, and formula identity checks with SymPy, together with three skills (topic routing, design spec, QA rubric), a project scaffold with timeline and narration, requirement approvals before rendering, and five animation styles.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的代码生成数学/科普动画：六个工具覆盖环境预检与依赖自愈、把 Manim/manimgx 场景渲染为 storyboard 帧或 MP4、对成片抽帧拼图检查黑帧与过曝、用 SymPy 判断公式恒等；另带三个技能（题材路由、设计规范、交付自检）、含时间轴与旁白的项目脚手架、渲染前的需求确认，以及五套动画风格。

description.en: Turns markdown into a WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) draft: inlines every CSS rule onto its element because the editor discards `<style>` blocks and class names, uploads each local image through WeChat's own endpoint so it is not filtered out, and creates the draft; it never broadcasts.
description.zh: 把 markdown 变成排好版的微信公众号草稿：样式逐条内联到元素上（编辑器会丢弃 `<style>` 块和 class 名），每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口以免被过滤，然后创建草稿；不做群发。

description.en: Terminal plugin — a real shell, workspace sync, persistent state, common-command management, and command completion.
description.zh: 终端插件 — 真 shell、工作区同步、状态常驻、常用命令管理、命令补全。

plugins.name: dsh-academic

description.en: Academic tools in TypeScript, no Python or MCP server: the Zotero library through its local API or zotero.org (search, annotations, full text, citation export; add by DOI / arXiv id, notes and tags when writing is turned on), starting Zotero when it is closed; paper search across arXiv, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, PubMed and Europe PMC, plus CNKI and Google Scholar through a browser window; open-access full text, citations from the DOI registry, reference checking; 11 bundled skills.
description.zh: 学术工具，TypeScript 实现，不需要 Python 或 MCP 服务：通过本地 API 或 zotero.org 访问 Zotero 文库（检索、批注、全文、导出引文；开启写入后可按 DOI / arXiv 编号入库、写笔记、改标签），Zotero 没开时自动启动；同时检索 arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref、Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Europe PMC，并通过浏览器窗口检索知网和 Google Scholar；阅读开放获取全文、从 DOI 注册机构取引文、核验参考文献；内置 11 个学术技能。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in control the screen shows an orange glow and a status bar, and Esc pauses or resumes.
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制：截图、鼠标、键盘、剪贴板和窗口工具，按应用授权并经 DSH 审批；操控期间屏幕显示橙色光晕和提示条，按 Esc 暂停或继续。

description.en: Network proxy settings page for DeepSeek Harness: set a global HTTP(S) proxy with bypass hosts, or give each LLM provider its own proxy or a direct connection; changes apply on save without a restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理设置页：配置全局 HTTP(S) 代理及免代理主机，或为单个 LLM 提供商单独指定代理或直连；保存即生效，无需重启。

description.en: Progressive tool disclosure: a deferred tool group costs one catalog line instead of its full schemas until the model loads it with tool_search, with one switch per group in Settings and each group measured against the live registry.
description.zh: 渐进式工具披露：被延后的工具组在每次请求中只占目录里的一行，模型用 tool_search 加载后才拿到完整 schema；设置页为每个组提供一个开关，各组开销按当前工具注册表实测。

description.en: Optional DSH configuration bundle that connects the existing MCP client to hosted BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit using a user-provided BAIZHI_API_KEY Bearer header; tool calls may incur charges.
description.zh: 复用 DSH 现有 MCP 客户端连接百智云托管工具包的可选配置包，通过用户提供的 BAIZHI_API_KEY 生成 Bearer 请求头；工具调用可能计费。

description.en: C++ runtime info probe for Windows via CDB: cpp_trace prints variables at multiple breakpoints in one session (replaces hand-written print), cpp_probe dumps the call stack at a conditional breakpoint. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cpp-probe.
description.zh: Windows + CDB 下的 C++ 运行时信息探针：cpp_trace 一次会话多断点打印变量（替换手打 print），cpp_probe 条件断点输出调用栈。安装：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cpp-probe。

description.en: Electrical and electronics calculation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: every computation runs through dedicated tools on self-describing complex value objects in SI base units, with an isolated calculation agent preset and a records panel that archives every solve on disk.
description.zh: DSH 电气电子计算插件：所有计算都通过专用工具完成，基于 SI 基本单位的自描述复数值对象；附带隔离的计算智能体预设与记录面板，每次求解落盘存档。

plugins.name: dsh-reckoner

description.en: A deterministic calculation engine for DeepSeek Harness, including a preset that guides the LLM to calculate through the engine rather than by text generation.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性计算引擎，附带一个预设：引导 LLM 通过引擎而非文本生成来完成计算。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Third-party adapter that registers the upstream REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server into DeepSeek Harness as mcp__rea__* tools. 2.x provisions its own runtime (Node, the REA CLI, a JDK, Ghidra) under <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle and launches REA through a shim, so a machine with nothing pre-installed works after one setup run; 1.x (branch v1, npm 1.0.6) is configuration-only and expects REA and Ghidra to be installed already. Analysis is upstream's: native binaries (Hopper/Ghidra/IDA), JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, websites, Android APKs and adb devices, firmware, and process captures.
description.zh: 第三方适配插件：把上游 REA（逆向一切，github.com/morluto/rea）的 MCP 服务接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 mcp__rea__* 工具。2.x 自带供给：把 Node、REA CLI、JDK、Ghidra 装到 <DSH_HOME>/plugins/rea-bundle 下，再经 shim 启动 REA —— 干净机器跑一次 setup 即可用；1.x（v1 分支 / npm 1.0.6）是纯配置适配器，需要你自己装好 REA 与 Ghidra。逆向分析能力由 REA 提供，覆盖原生二进制（Hopper/Ghidra/IDA）、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集、网站、Android APK 与 adb 设备、固件与进程捕获。

description.en: Local knowledge base and document search for DeepSeek Harness with full-text search, PDF/Word/PowerPoint/Excel/Markdown import, OCR, ACL, and a Web panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地知识库与文档检索插件：全文搜索、PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/Markdown 导入与按行读取、扫描件 OCR、ACL 和 Web 面板。

description.en: Bilibili video analysis: metadata, transcript (ASR fallback via Bijian/sherpa-onnx/whisper.cpp), comments, danmaku, and sharp keyframes with optional local vision descriptions.
description.zh: B站视频分析工具：提取元数据、字幕文稿（必剪/本地 ASR 兜底）、评论与弹幕，抓取清晰关键帧并可选本地视觉描述。

description.en: Connects an existing local CodeGraph CLI to each session's indexed project, shares one MCP process per project, and updates session-scoped tools when the working directory or index changes.
description.zh: 将本机已安装的 CodeGraph CLI 接入各会话的已索引项目，同项目共享一个 MCP 进程，并在工作目录或索引变化时更新会话级工具。

description.en: Enhanced MCP client: paginated tool discovery, non-blocking startup, mcp_tool_search, hand-rolled stdio/streamable-http transports.
description.zh: MCP 客户端增强：分页工具发现、非阻塞启动、mcp_tool_search 搜索，自研 stdio/streamable-http 传输。

plugins.name: dsh-stash

description.en: Registers external databases and document corpora as callable model tools: a per-source access boundary, a credential reference ledger that never stores values, and a fetch ledger that keeps fingerprints and content hashes instead of payloads.
description.zh: 把外部数据库与文献语料登记成模型可调用的取数工具；每条库声明取数边界，钥匙台账只记引用名不存值，取数台账只留指纹与内容哈希而不留响应体。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Connects QQ private chats and groups to DSH over OneBot 11, adding qq_send and other tools so the agent can reply, send stickers and wait for follow-ups.
description.zh: 经 OneBot 11 把 QQ 私聊和群聊接进 DSH，提供 qq_send 等工具，让 agent 能回消息、发表情、等待对方接话。

description.en: Draws draw.io diagrams in DeepSeek Harness through the next-ai-drawio MCP server: the link in the reply opens a live preview in the right sidebar, you can edit the diagram by hand, and each AI change is a version you can restore. Node.js 18+; npx downloads the MCP server on first use.
description.zh: dsh 的 draw.io 绘图插件：通过 next-ai-drawio MCP 服务器作图，点回复里的链接在右侧栏打开实时预览，可以手动修改图，AI 的每次修改都是可以恢复的版本。需 Node.js 18+，首次使用由 npx 下载 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Balance dashboard, allowing the addition of multiple pay-as-you-go/Token plans, while simultaneously checking balances.
description.zh: 余额看板，可以添加多个按量计费/Token plan，同时查询余额。

description.en: Import the copied connection information from the new API site with a single click.
description.zh: 一键从new api站点导入复制的连接信息。

description.en: Route eligible shell commands through rtk to compress tool output and save tokens.
description.zh: 将符合条件的 shell 命令路由给 rtk，压缩工具输出并节省 token。

description.en: An AI collaboration mailbox in DeepSeek Harness for messaging, task handoffs and delivery receipts. One package includes MCP integration and a mailbox UI. Version 0.2.2 requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. Requires a separately installed Agent Mail 1.0.0-alpha.7 provider; no automatic model wake or continuous online status.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中的 AI 协作邮箱，让 AI 工具互发消息、交接任务并查看收发回执。一个包包含 MCP 集成与邮箱界面；0.2.2 需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2，需要独立安装 Agent Mail 1.0.0-alpha.7；不提供自动唤醒模型或持续在线状态。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a deployment-owned AI Asset Hub MCP server and exposes eight reviewed read-only asset tools.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到部署方管理的 AI Asset Hub MCP 服务，并提供八个经过审查的只读资产工具。

description.en: Agent trajectory governance and anomaly diagnosis: rebuilds flat session logs into multi-branch trajectory trees, detects loop deadlock, invalid retry, and goal drift, alerts with cost attribution, one-click interrupt and breakpoint fork via official APIs, independent GUI tab.
description.zh: Agent 轨迹治理与异常诊断：把平铺会话日志重建为多分支轨迹树，识别循环死锁/无效重试/目标漂移，带成本归因的告警与一键中断/断点分支（官方 API），独立 GUI Tab。

description.en: Registers codex-web-search-mcp as native DSH MCP tools (mcp__codex-web-search__codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch) for model-independent Codex and Grok web search and deep research.
description.zh: 将 codex-web-search-mcp 注册为 DSH 原生 MCP 工具（codex_web_search / codex_web_research / web_fetch），提供与模型无关的 Codex / Grok 联网搜索与深度研究。

description.en: Personal finance plugin for DSH with structured Beancount ledger tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的个人记账插件，基于结构化的beancount账本工具。

description.en: Version-adaptive tooling for DeepSeek Harness: it reads the running DSH version from the plugin manager, mirrors app-boot plugin-compatibility rules (engines.dsh first, then @deepseek-ai/dsh* peers, prerelease-inclusive comparison, exact-version exemptions) to score every installed plugin, and statically flags source still using APIs renamed or deprecated between v0.1.6 and v0.2.1. Ships a conversation-view panel, an agent tool and HTTP state/scan/report routes. Read-only, offline.
description.zh: DSH 版本自适应：自检当前运行时版本，按 DSH 自己的规则（engines.dsh 优先，否则检查 @deepseek-ai/dsh* peer；预发布参与比较；精确版本例外）逐条判定已装插件，并用官方 release notes 摘出的规则标出源码里仍在使用 v0.1.6 起已改名/弃用接口的位置。带会话视图面板、agent 工具与 HTTP 状态/重扫/报告入口；只读、离线。

plugins.name: dsh-cost-ledger

description.en: Auditable token-cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the llm/stream waterfall and records every call with provider, model, input/output/cache-hit/cache-write tokens, usage source and integer nano-CNY cost from an explicit price table. Aggregates by hour, day and session; exports JSON or CSV with a no-write dry-run preview; keeps a manually entered official platform bill in a parallel column with actual-minus-estimate diff. Unknown provider/model routes stay explicitly unpriced. Zero runtime dependencies; no balance query, notifications or animations.
description.zh: 可核对的 token 成本账：包住 llm/stream waterfall，逐次记录 provider、model、输入/输出/缓存命中/缓存写入 token、用量来源，以及按显式价目表算出的整数 nano-CNY 费用；按小时/日/会话聚合，支持 JSON/CSV 导出与不落盘的 dry-run 预览；手填官方平台账单与本地估算并列，给出 actual − estimated 差异。未知 provider/model 保持显式未定价。零运行时依赖；不查余额、不发通知、不做动画。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to ledger.local

description.en: A delivery receipt panel for a project hand-off. One trigger collects the branch and commit, the test and build results, screenshot dimensions with sha256, and the secret-scan verdict, then assigns every line to one of three zones by evidence alone — verified, local-only, or unverified. A claim in the unverified zone keeps its label and prints an explicitly empty slot instead of the claim itself, because a confidently worded sentence with nothing behind it is the exact thing the receipt exists to catch. Test failures and secret-scan hits are still evidence, so they land in the verified zone with a red tone rather than being quietly dropped.
description.zh: 项目收尾用的交付回执面板。触发一次即汇总分支与 commit、测试与构建结果、截图的宽高与 sha256、密钥扫描结论，然后只按证据把每一条分进三区：已验证、仅本地、未验证。落在未验证区的声明只保留标签，正文位置显式留空而不是把声明印出来——措辞自信而背后什么都没有的句子，正是回执要防的东西。测试失败与密钥扫描命中同样是有证据的事实，因此进已验证区并带红色色调，而不是被悄悄丢掉。

description.en: Content-catalog guard for WeChat mini-programs: validates catalog.json so every activity price is an integer amountFen, every template renders prices through money(), required fields / duplicate copy / image paths are checked, and the result is an issue list plus a unified diff that can be applied with patch -p1. 29 rules over five groups (catalog shape, required fields and uniqueness, amounts, rendering, images). Three fixes are automatic (legacy yuan amount, string Fen, absolute image path) and preserve the file's own indent, EOL and trailing newline; everything else is reported with a hint instead of being guessed. Dry-run by default; apply re-checks the written file so the report describes what remains. One implementation serves a tool, a conversation panel and a CLI with exit codes 0/1/2. Zero runtime dependencies, no model call, no network.
description.zh: 微信小程序内容目录守卫：校验 catalog.json，保证每条活动金额都是整数 amountFen、页面价格统一走 money()，必填字段 / 重复文案 / 图片路径逐项检查，输出问题清单与可直接 patch -p1 的 unified diff。29 条规则分五组（目录结构、必填与唯一性、金额、渲染、图片）；三条可自动修复（旧「元」金额、字符串分、绝对图片路径），写回保留原文件的缩进/行尾/结尾换行，其余只给修法提示不猜。默认 dry-run，apply 后会重查写回的文件，报告描述剩余问题。一份实现同时服务工具、会话面板与 CLI（退出码 0/1/2）。零运行时依赖，不调用模型、不联网。

description.en: A shareable delivery receipt for a project hand-off. The `ship_receipt` tool measures what it can and records what it was told, then sorts every line into three zones: verified (evidence this run produced and that reproduces elsewhere — a command that actually ran with its exit code, a file hash for a file that is under version control, a scan that found files, a git ref present in the recorded remote), local-only (true on this machine alone — uncommitted changes, unpushed commits, an artifact no one else can see), and unverified (no evidence, including every sentence a human typed). A claim with no evidence keeps its label and leaves the body blank rather than printing the claim; declares the commit and branch, artifact byte sizes and sha256 with PNG dimensions, and the three pre-push checks.
description.zh: 项目收尾时生成一张可公开的交付回执。`ship_receipt` 工具自己测量能测的、记录被告知的，再把每一条硬性分进三区：已验证（本次采集到、且能在别处复现的证据——真跑过的命令与退出码、已入版本库文件的哈希、确实扫到文件的扫描、本地记录的远端里存在的 git 引用）、仅本地（只在这台机器上成立——未提交改动、未推送提交、别人看不到的产物）、未验证（没有证据，包括人写的任何一句话）。没有证据的声明只留标签、正文留空，而不是把声明照原样印出来；回执里含分支与 commit、产物的字节数与 sha256（PNG 附带宽高），以及推送前三步检查的结论。

description.en: The composer predicts what you are about to type.
