Inline ghost text sits on the caret, measured against the editor's own font and line box, and Tab turns it into real text (Esc ignores it). The prediction is one short call through the session's own model router, seeded with your draft and the last few turns of the conversation, so an empty composer also gets a next-prompt guess written in the user's voice; suggestions that merely restate the assistant are dropped. Host side is one HTTP route with sub-path endpoints (loopback-only, 64 KB body cap, 2-minute result cache, 20-second miss cache, one in-flight call per session); client side is one 0-height overlay registered on conversation.input.overlay, with insertion guarded by the composer's draftRev CAS and a setDraft fallback. IME composition and slash commands are skipped. 16 node:test cases, zero runtime dependencies, real screenshots in docs/.
description.zh: 输入框会预测你接下来要打的字：幽灵文本贴在你的光标后面，字体、行高、字间距都照抄编辑器，按 Tab 变成真正的文字，按 Esc 忽略。预测是走当前会话自己的模型路由的一次短调用，喂进你的草稿和最近几轮对话，所以空输入框时还会预测你的「下一句」，用用户自己的口吻；只是复述助手原话的建议会被丢弃。宿主半边是一条带若干子路径的 HTTP 路由（只收 loopback、64KB 体积上限、结果缓存 2 分钟、空结果缓存 20 秒、每会话同时只有一个在飞请求）；客户端半边是挂在 conversation.input.overlay 上的 0 高度覆盖层，落字带 draftRev 的 CAS 校验，失败退回 setDraft。输入法组字期间与 / 命令不预测。16 个 node:test 用例，零运行时依赖，docs/ 里有真实运行截图。

description.en: Two DeepSeek Harness tools for the local tempguard watchdog: read temperatures and alertd health, and send alerts through alertd; it does not start or stop the watchdog. Needs the separate tempguard Python watchdog and its alertd service running locally, with projectDir and alertdToken set in the profile patch; there is no npm package, so install from a local clone of the repository subfolder.
description.zh: 为本地 tempguard 温度守护提供两个 DSH 工具：读取温度与 alertd 健康状态，以及通过 alertd 发送告警。需另行在本机运行 tempguard Python 看门狗及其 alertd 服务，并在 profile patch 里配置 projectDir 与 alertdToken；暂无 npm 包，需克隆仓库后从子目录本地安装。

description.en: Drives the Claude desktop app from DSH over its claude:// deep links: open a Claude Code session with a prompt and folders, a Cowork task with files, or push a CLI session id back into the app. Also presses Ctrl+Enter for you (SendKeys) and reads the reply back from the local Claude Code transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/<cwd-slug>/<session>.jsonl — seven tools: desktop_send, desktop_continue, desktop_open, desktop_sessions, desktop_read, desktop_wait, desktop_probe.
description.zh: 用桌面端自己的 claude:// 深链把活派过去：开新 Claude Code 会话（带 prompt、目录）、带文件开 Cowork 任务、把 CLI 会话 id 交回应用；再代按 Ctrl+Enter 发送，并从本机 Claude Code 的 transcript（~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session>.jsonl）把回答读回来。七个工具：desktop_send / desktop_continue / desktop_open / desktop_sessions / desktop_read / desktop_wait / desktop_probe。

description.en: Runs the local Claude Code CLI from DSH as three tools (claude_run, claude_resume, claude_probe) that parse --output-format json and return the session id for follow-ups, plus a standalone loopback bridge.
description.zh: 把本机 Claude Code CLI 接成 DSH 的三个工具（claude_run / claude_resume / claude_probe），解析 --output-format json 并返回可续接的 session id，另带独立回环桥。

description.en: Runs the local Codex CLI from DSH as four tools (codex_run, codex_resume, codex_queue, codex_probe), and ships a standalone loopback bridge with an HTTP API and a file mailbox.
description.zh: 把本机 Codex CLI 接成 DSH 的四个工具（codex_run / codex_resume / codex_queue / codex_probe），另带独立的回环桥：HTTP 接口 + 文件信箱。

description.en: Frontend aesthetics engine as 17 native tools — a 118-palette evidence library matched by register, cross-register whole-page design directions, four mechanical gates (WCAG contrast, color-blind simulation, AI-slop detection, scorecard) with digest-bound verdicts, plus semantic design tokens, existing-page audit, CVD-checked chart palettes, CJK type scale, render-vs-tokens reconciliation and measured-numbers rationale. Fully local, zero network. Requires Python 3.8+.
description.zh: 前端美学引擎的 17 个原生工具：118 块实证色板按语域选板、跨语域整页方向对比、四道机械检查（对比度、色盲、AI 味、评分）带指纹绑定，另有设计令牌表、页面审计、图表色板、中文字阶、渲染对账与量化叙事。全部本地运行，零联网。需 Python 3.8+。

description.en: Reorganizes a DeepSeek Harness session transcript into a structured Markdown document with an outline and a table of contents instead of exporting the chat in chronological order. Exposed three ways: a model tool session_to_doc, a composer button, and a loopback-only Web endpoint.
description.zh: 把 DSH 当前会话的对话记录重组成带大纲、章节层级和目录的结构化 Markdown 文档，而不是按时间顺序原样导出。三种入口：模型工具 session_to_doc、输入框按钮、仅回环的 Web 接口。

description.en: AOCI binding toolkit for DSH hosts: discover workspaces that have an AOCI index, diagnose and repair their MCP bindings, initialize unbound repos, and expose status and doctor tools.
description.zh: DSH Host 侧 AOCI 接入工具：发现带 AOCI 索引的工作区、诊断与修复 MCP 绑定、初始化未接入仓库，并提供状态与体检工具。

description.en: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上支持 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2 四种后端，外加交互式 PTY 终端；MSYS2 后端以 bash.exe -lc 启动，让 /etc/profile 把 /usr/bin 与 /mingw64/bin 带进 PATH，并为 PTY 环境注入 MSYSTEM=MINGW64。TypeScript 编写，面向 DSH 0.1.2+。

description.en: The cyber-elixir of youth for the desktop client: fixes the `desktop welcome: Web authentication failed` (HTTP 431) launch failure — an Electron random-port launch lets `dsh-auth-*` login cookies pile up per port (70+ of them, ~229 B each), the startup request headers blow past Node's default 16 KB cap, and the client can no longer launch. Two fixes in one: a scriptable cleaner that removes leftover login cookies from the cookie database (Chromium SQLite) — explicit, offline, keeps a `.bak` copy, `--expired-only` narrows the scope — and a `patch` feature on the settings panel that fixes the launch port through the profile `cordis.patch.yml`, so the client always starts from a single port and cookies stop accumulating across different ones (rewrite `port` as a `!!js` expression to keep the `--port` flag in charge; a per-profile snapshot makes one click revert it). Read the README for usage. Interface, CLI output and market metadata in 9 languages. The purge runs from the bundled CLI (`dsh-cookie-cleaner --clean`) only while the client is fully closed; the in-app half is read-only. npm: `dsh-cookie-cleaner`.
description.zh: 桌面客户端的赛博端粒不老药：解决启动报 `desktop welcome: Web authentication failed`（HTTP 431）的现象——Electron 随机端口启动，`dsh-auth-*` 登录 cookie 随端口越积越多（70 余条、单条约 229 B），启动请求头撑爆 Node 默认 16 KB 上限，客户端直接起不来。两味药：脚本化清理器——报告并清理 cookie 库（Chromium SQLite）里残留的登录凭据，显式、离线、保留 `.bak` 副本，`--expired-only` 可收窄范围；设置面 patch 功能——经由 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 把启动端口固定化，保证客户端始终从单一端口启动，cookie 不再随不同端口累计（`port` 改写成 `!!js` 表达式可让 `--port` 旗标继续优先，按 profile 留快照、点一次即可回滚）。用法详见 README。界面、CLI 输出与市场元数据覆盖 9 语。清理需在客户端完全退出后运行包内 CLI（`dsh-cookie-cleaner --clean`），插件本体只读。npm 包名：`dsh-cookie-cleaner`。

description.en: Patch-style file editing: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), applying every change all-or-nothing after a full read-only verification pass, with sandbox-aware delete and move and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 补丁风格文件编辑：单个 apply_patch 工具，接受 git/unified diff（默认）与 Codex apply_patch 语法（可选开启），在完整只读校验后全量原子应用；删除与移动走沙箱感知路径，并提供 dry-run 模式。

description.en: Adobe Lightroom Classic as native dsh tools through the lightroom-py MCP server: read the catalog, apply develop settings and presets, export JPEG/TIFF/PSD/DNG, and write ratings, labels, keywords and IPTC — 15 tools driving the Lightroom Classic installed on the local machine, no cloud round-trip; the Python package is on PyPI and the Lightroom plugin installs with one command.
description.zh: 通过 lightroom-py MCP 服务器把 Adobe Lightroom Classic 接入为 dsh 原生工具：读取目录、应用 develop 设置与预设、导出 JPEG/TIFF/PSD/DNG、写入星级/色标/关键词/IPTC——15 个工具，直接驱动本机安装的 Lightroom Classic，不经云端；Python 包在 PyPI 上，Lightroom 插件一条命令安装。

plugins.name: dsh-ds-balance

description.en: Shows the DeepSeek account balance at the bottom of the sidebar, with a configuration card on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，并在插件页提供配置卡。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Three Zhihu tools for DSH — in-site search, Zhihu's global web index with domain and date filters, and Zhida answers — with a native settings card and source-cited results.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加三个知乎工具——站内问答与文章检索、知乎全网索引检索（可按域名与时间过滤）、直答——自带原生设置卡片，结果附来源可引用。

plugins.name: dsh-auxiliary

description.en: Dedicated model routes, tools, and system guidance for vision, compaction, reviews, subagents, titles, and image generation.
description.zh: 为视觉理解、上下文压缩、审批审查、子代理、会话标题与图片生成提供独立的模型路由、工具与系统提示。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Exposes Windows display geometry and the foreground window rect in physical pixels.
description.zh: 提供 Windows 显示器几何与前台窗口的物理像素坐标。

description.en: Data cleaning and data enrichment for CSV/XLSX/JSON enterprise lists in DeepSeek Harness, including spreadsheet cleaning, deduplication, profiling, optional Qichacha MCP and exports.
description.zh: 数据清洗补全智能体：面向 Excel/CSV/JSON 企业名单，提供数据清洗、表格清洗、清洗补全、去重、企业数据补全与字段补全，支持企查查 MCP 和结果导出。

description.en: AI form filling and spreadsheet autofill for XLSX in DeepSeek Harness, using authorized Qichacha MCP facts with cell previews, user confirmation and export to a new copy.
description.zh: AI填表智能体：支持自动填表、表格填充、表格补全、Excel填表与 Excel回填；使用企查查 MCP 填写 XLSX 空白字段，预览确认后导出新副本。

description.en: MCP Connector for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP manager with one panel to connect servers, configure authorization, search tools across connections, and troubleshoot failures. Browse a continuously updated catalog of over one hundred connectors; filter by connection/server/status, inspect readable parameters and the last successful cache time, and rediscover tools. Supports OAuth 2.0 PKCE, API keys, stdio/HTTP, and mcpServers JSON import. Maintained by Qichacha/QCC.
description.zh: MCP连接器：DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 管理面板；通过持续更新的超百个 MCP连接器目录接入 MCP Server，统一连接管理与授权配置、跨连接搜索工具并完成连接排障；可按连接/服务/发现状态筛选，查看易读参数、最后成功缓存时间和诊断，并逐连接重新发现工具；支持 OAuth 2.0 PKCE、API Key、stdio/HTTP 和 mcpServers JSON 导入；由企查查/QCC 团队维护。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) legal-data MCP services — regulation search and case search — with dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查法律产品——法律数据 MCP 服务（法规检索、案例检索）：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖法规与案例服务。

description.en: One-click OAuth (PKCE) connect to Qichacha (qcc.com) MCP services in DeepSeek Harness: dynamic client registration, token auto-refresh, and dynamic mcp-client configuration.
description.zh: 一键 OAuth（PKCE）授权接入企查查 MCP 服务：动态注册客户端、token 自动刷新、动态配置 mcp-client 条目，一次授权覆盖全部企查查数据服务。

description.en: Read, create and edit Figma designs through natural language in DSH, including batch layer edits, components, variables, screenshots and asset exports. Local mode does not use the official Figma MCP call quota.
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言读取、创建和修改 Figma 设计，支持批量调整图层、组件与变量、截图及素材导出。本地模式不消耗官方 Figma MCP 调用额度。

description.en: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: a persistent PowerShell UIA backend behind 16 merged MCP entries (read/click/type/observe/verify), a hardened policy layer (red lines, approvals, observation binding, point-ownership and focus guards) and a performance pass (prewarm, caching, pixel-hash stability probe). Fork of dsh-computer-use-win.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的 Windows 计算机操作插件：常驻 PowerShell UIA 后端，对外只有 16 个合并入口（读取/点击/输入/观测/验证）；带加固的策略层（红线拒绝、显式审批、观测绑定、落点归属与前台焦点守卫）与一轮性能优化（后端预热、缓存、像素哈希稳定探测）。fork 自 dsh-computer-use-win。

plugins.name: dsh-qboson-ising-solver

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes QBoson Kaiwu Ising solving as an agent-callable solve_ising tool.
description.zh: 将 QBoson Kaiwu 的 Ising 矩阵求解能力作为 solve_ising Agent Tool 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Visibility layer for the built-in Cua Driver computer-control channel: a top banner names the controlling session and its goal, and Esc truly stops the agent.
description.zh: 给官方内置 Cua Driver 电脑控制通道加一层可见提示：顶部横幅显示是哪个会话、基于什么目标在控制电脑，按 Esc 真正停止。

description.en: One panel for MCP servers, skills and Claude Code plugins across global/profile/project scopes: live status, import/export, trash & backups, and the official claude-plugins-official market (install/update/uninstall).
description.zh: 一个面板统一管理全局 / Profile / 项目三个作用域的 MCP 服务与技能：实时状态与工具数、导入导出、回收站与备份，并可安装/更新/卸载 Anthropic 官方 claude-plugins-official 市场的 Claude Code 插件。

description.en: DBLP and arXiv literature search, BibTeX retrieval and full-text acquisition with session-owned background jobs; an EduWork-maintained fork of SihanLv/dsh-literature.
description.zh: 检索 DBLP 与 arXiv 文献、获取 BibTeX 和全文，支持归属当前会话的后台任务；由 EduWork 接续维护的 SihanLv/dsh-literature 分支。

description.en: Read-only IMAP search and attachments, plus SMTP sending under DSH permissions, with separate reading and sending switches and a credential-backed settings page.
description.zh: 通过只读 IMAP 检索邮件与获取附件，按 DSH 权限发送 SMTP 邮件，提供独立收发开关和接入凭据存储的设置页。

description.en: MCP server installer and verifier for DeepSeek Harness: interactive init writes real patch entries into a profile, list and validate inspect them, and a CI-enforced verifier connects to every curated server.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器安装与验证工具：交互式 init 会把真实 patch 条目写进 profile，list 与 validate 检查配置，CI 强制的验证器逐个连接精选服务器。

description.en: Network and proxy doctor for DSH: checks system proxy settings, probes local proxy ports, detects TUN adapters, tests GitHub, TCP and HTTP reachability, scans hosts conflicts and prints concrete suggestions for what to change.
description.zh: DSH 的网络与代理诊断工具：检查系统代理设置、探测本地代理端口、识别 TUN 适配器、测试 GitHub/TCP/HTTP 连通性、扫描 hosts 冲突，并给出具体的修改建议。

description.en: Bridge plugin for the [Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome extension: exposes HTTP handshake and session-filtered SSE event streams over the web server, enabling browser-extension UI integrations with DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: [Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome 扩展桥接插件：在 webServer 上提供 HTTP 握手与会话过滤的 SSE 事件流，实现浏览器扩展 UI 与 DeepSeek Harness 的集成。

description.en: Use the free AtomGit quota already signed in on this machine to have AtomCode run an independent code review: the model calls the atomcode_ask tool on its own, and you can also use the /atomcode-review command to review uncommitted changes, a branch or a PR in one click. The plugin reads no API key; a usage pill below the input box shows the CodingPlan quota.
description.zh: 用你本机已登录的 AtomGit 免费额度，请 AtomCode 给代码做一次独立代码审查：模型通过`atomcode_ask` 工具自主调用审查；你也可以使用`/atomcode-review`命令，一键评审未提交改动 / 分支 / PR。本插件不读取 API key；输入框下方有用量胶囊显示 CodingPlan 额度。

description.en: A working Remotion prototype that turns a DSH plugin repository into a 16:9 promo video and a 3:4 promo image locally; its DSH bundle is scaffolded but has not yet been loaded into a real DSH profile. Requires Node.js 22+ and Chrome or Chromium for rendering.
description.zh: 本地用 Remotion 从 DSH 插件仓库生成 16:9 宣传片与 3:4 宣传图的可用原型；DSH bundle 仍是脚手架，尚未在真实 DSH profile 中加载验证。需 Node.js 22+ 与 Chrome/Chromium 渲染。

description.en: Per-round reasoning_effort optimizer for dsh — auto-downgrades reasoning for simple tool calls and lifts back for heavy work, cutting thinking time between tool calls.
description.zh: dsh 每轮推理强度优化器——简单工具调用自动降档、重任务回升，削减工具调用间的思考时间。

plugins.name: hermes-dsh-bridge

description.en: Embedded MCP server letting external agents (Hermes, Claude Code, etc.) drive DeepSeek Harness over StreamableHTTP: sync/async task execution, a three-tier file sandbox, a Web-backed approval bridge, session management and search, and path-jailed file tools.
description.zh: 内嵌 MCP server，让外部 Agent（Hermes、Claude Code 等）通过 StreamableHTTP 驱动 DeepSeek Harness：同步/异步任务执行、三档文件沙箱、Web 审批桥、会话管理与搜索、路径隔离的文件工具。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)
uses literal IP 169.254.169.254 for network access

description.en: Per-project runtime environments for DeepSeek Harness: auto-adopt or create a project-local Python venv (.venv_local/python) and wire in the toolchains and env vars for the runtimes each project uses (python venv / node / go) — python & pip always resolve to the project, never silently to system Python.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 工作区/项目提供独立的运行时环境：自动接管或创建项目本地 Python venv（.venv_local/python），并自动识别项目所用运行时（python venv / node / go）接入其工具链与环境变量——python / pip 永远走项目环境，绝不静默落到系统 Python。一个有则接管、无则自动建的零配置插件。

description.en: Adds configurable HTTP header profiles that can be selected per model.
description.zh: 添加可配置的 HTTP 请求头配置档，并支持按模型选择。

description.en: Translates user prompts before sending and translates model reasoning and replies back into the user's language via translation APIs or configured DSH models, with independent content toggles and a composer menu.
description.zh: 通过翻译 API 或 DSH 已配置的模型，在发送前翻译用户提示词，并将模型思考文本和回答译回用户语言，提供独立内容开关和输入框快捷菜单。

plugins.name: dsh-web-studyhub

description.en: Study workspace for DeepSeek Harness: imports your own PDF, DOCX, PPTX and Markdown materials plus lecture recordings, turns them into source-cited flashcards, quizzes and open questions, and schedules spaced review with FSRS-6 in a built-in web panel. Imported recordings are transcribed with your own SiliconFlow, Groq or Gemini key; live classes can instead use an on-device SenseVoice engine that needs no key (about 239 MB on first install); requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or later but below 0.3.
description.zh: DSH 的学习工作台：导入自己的 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、Markdown 资料与课堂录音，生成带出处引用的卡片、测验与开放题，按 FSRS-6 安排间隔复习，自带网页面板。导入的录音需用自备的 SiliconFlow、Groq 或 Gemini 密钥转写；课堂实录可改用本机 SenseVoice 引擎，无需密钥（首次约下载 239 MB）；需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 及以上、0.3 以下。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Codegraph CLI as eight code-intelligence tools for DSH — symbol search, callers/callees, impact analysis, codebase exploration, symbol/file reading, index status and sync.
description.zh: 将 Codegraph CLI 封装为 DSH 的八个代码智能工具：符号搜索、调用者/被调用者、影响分析、代码库探索、符号/文件读取、索引状态与同步。

description.en: Lets the agent inject one turn into a chosen session on its own when the host has been idle. Daily cap, active hours, weighted action lottery, per-activity budget, and a policy file re-read on every check. Disabled by default; sends no network requests.
description.zh: 宿主空闲时由 Agent 自己决定要不要往指定会话注入一轮：每日上限、活跃时段、按权重抽动作、单次预算，策略文件每次判定现读。默认关闭，不发任何网络请求。

description.en: Local IMAP invoice download, OCR, archive, and Excel reimbursement summaries for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地 IMAP 发票下载、OCR 识别、归档与 Excel 报销汇总。

description.en: Cache-stable progressive tool discovery: a fixed tool_search and tool_dispatch surface on every request, in-memory catalog search, nested dispatch through the Harness pipeline, and a byte-stable native tool list across discovery.
description.zh: 缓存稳定的渐进式工具发现：每次请求使用固定的 tool_search 与 tool_dispatch 工具面，从内存目录搜索后经 Harness 管线分发，发现过程中原生工具列表保持字节稳定。

description.en: Connect multiple decision providers and models through one interface: Jev via TypeSafe, Clef via Cloudflare, Drex via Nace, Decider via meraGPT, self-hosted Laya, and compatible custom providers. Agents and plugins can classify content, filter candidates, score against criteria, or locate objects in images, then use structured results in their workflows.
description.zh: 用同一接口接入多种决策提供商与模型：在线可选 TypeSafe 提供的 Jev、Cloudflare 提供的 Clef、Nace 提供的 Drex、meraGPT 提供的 Decider 1；本地可连接 Laya，也支持兼容的自定义 provider。Agent 和插件可用它进行内容分类、候选筛选、按标准评分或图片定位，再用结构化结果继续自己的流程。

description.en: Adds local PDF reading, a durable paper library, traceable evidence records, and cross-paper comparison and synthesis tools.
description.zh: 提供本地 PDF 阅读、持久论文库、可追溯证据记录，以及跨论文比较与综合工具。

description.en: Deterministic context compression for dsh — zero LLM calls, rule-based pruning that preserves paths, commands, error traces, and open todos verbatim. Compresses ~80k tokens to a few hundred.
description.zh: dsh 的确定性上下文压缩后端：零 LLM 摘要调用，基于规则剪枝，逐字保留路径/命令/报错原文/未完成 todo，约 8 万 token 压到几百。

plugins.name: dsh-subagent-registry

description.en: Register locally-defined custom agents as callable subagents in dsh: the main conversation invokes any agent by name via use_agent, each running as a real dsh subagent with its own persona. Supports breakpoint resume for interrupted runs.
description.zh: 把本地定义的自定义 agent 注册成 dsh 可调用的 subagent：主模型通过 use_agent 工具按名字派活，每个 agent 以独立人格运行，支持断点续跑。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Keyless web search with one web_tools entry and eight actions for multi-query search, date windows, packages, papers, repositories, platforms, page reading, cited research, cache search and engine health; fuses eight engines and ships a stdio MCP server for other agents.
description.zh: 免密钥网页搜索：一个 web_tools 入口、八个 action，覆盖多查询、日期窗口、包、论文、仓库、平台、正文读取、引用研究、缓存检索与引擎健康；融合八个引擎，并提供给其他 Agent 使用的 stdio MCP server。

description.en: Drive OriginLab Origin scientific plotting from AI chat via MCP: 62 tools. Modal-dialog watchdog, LabTalk safety gate, release/reconnect, fit with initial/fixed/weighted params, fine-grained plot and sheet edits, matrix tools, FigureSpec declarative YAML (diff-able and replayable), MCP Resources read-only snapshot, matplotlib-figure bridge, PowerPoint assembly with panel labels, Graph Gallery template search, EPS export, file-access whitelist, visual regression baseline, and editable OPJU delivery with deterministic readback verification.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 AI 对话里驱动 OriginLab Origin 科学绘图与分析：62 个工具。模态对话框看门狗、LabTalk 破坏命令门禁、释放/重连、拟合初值/固定参数/加权、细粒度图与工作表编辑、矩阵工具、FigureSpec 声明式 YAML（可 diff 可重放）、MCP Resources 只读会话快照、matplotlib 图桥接、PowerPoint 组图、Graph Gallery 模板搜索、EPS 导出、文件访问白名单、视觉基准回归，以及带确定性反读验证的可编辑 OPJU 交付。

description.en: Weather care for DeepSeek Harness: turns a forecast into one sentence you can send — clothing and umbrella advice from feels-like temperature, humidity and air quality, adjusted for how cold-sensitive the user is and how they commute. Also a switchable daily care push, extreme-weather alerts and reminders, evaluated when the agent wakes (a host such as qq-bridge can wake it on schedule). Preferences stay on the local machine.
description.zh: 天气关心：把预报变成一句能直接发出去的话——按体感温度、湿度、空气质量给穿衣与带伞建议，并照顾对方怕冷怕热、骑车还是开车。另有每日主动关心（可开关）、极端天气预警与提醒，在 agent 醒来时评估，可由 qq-bridge 这类宿主定时唤醒；偏好只存本机。

description.en: Polymarket toolkit for DeepSeek Harness and Claude Code: market-data tools for Gamma/CLOB/Data-API (31 model tools in DSH; read-only subset exposed over MCP), opt-in authenticated trading tools, WebSocket stream service, and an embedded Polymarket knowhow skill.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 与 Claude Code 的 Polymarket 工具包：Gamma/CLOB/Data-API 行情工具（DSH 内 31 个模型工具，MCP 只暴露只读子集）、需显式开启的带鉴权交易工具、WebSocket 推流服务，以及内置的 Polymarket 知识技能。

description.en: Enter-plan-mode tool: gives the model a callable `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode` that switches the current session into plan mode, pairing with the built-in `exit_plan_mode` for a plan-then-review loop.
description.zh: 进入计划模式工具：给模型一个可调用的 `dsh_enter_plan_mode_enter_plan_mode`，把当前会话切进计划模式，与内置的 `exit_plan_mode` 配对，形成“先规划、后评审”的闭环。

description.en: GIS/CAD analysis toolkit for dsh: read DXF, convert DWG to DXF, query layers/entities, export styled analysis maps (SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF, plus PSD on Windows x64), and run GIS summary/buffer/overlay on SHP/GeoJSON/KML — pure-JS parsing, no GDAL.
description.zh: 面向规划/测绘的 GIS/CAD 分析工具：读 DXF、DWG 转 DXF、按图层/文字查实体、出带版式的分析图（SVG/PNG/JPG/PDF，PSD 仅 Windows x64），并对 SHP/GeoJSON/KML 做按类汇总、缓冲与叠加——解析用纯 JS，不依赖 GDAL。

description.en: Mojibake guard bundle for DSH: feature-based garbled-text detection before writes with review-then-release (an identical retry passes), plus pre-execution pwsh encoding audit (ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/Default), Windows and Chinese first.
description.zh: DSH 乱码拦截器 bundle：写入前特征值/编码回环检测乱码并复查放行（原样重试即通过），pwsh 写入编码执行前审计（ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/默认编码），Windows 与中文场景优先。

description.en: LeisureTimeQueue is a local leisure-time task queue plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: LeisureTimeQueue 是一个基于 DeepSeek Harness 的本地闲时任务队列插件。

description.en: Windows desktop UI context picker for Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and MCP clients: select windows, UI elements, or screen regions with hover highlighting, UI Automation, screenshots, and local OCR, then review and approve Markdown/JSON context before output.
description.zh: 面向 Codex、DeepSeek Harness 和 MCP 客户端的 Windows 桌面 UI 上下文取景器：选择窗口、UI 元素或屏幕区域，使用悬停高亮、UI Automation、截图和本机 OCR，并在输出前确认 Markdown/JSON 上下文。

description.en: Bridges the Cua Driver MCP server into DSH: installs the cua-driver executable when it is missing, starts it over stdio through the in-box MCP client, and registers its 60 accessibility-first window, input, menu, and browser tools with a bundled workflow skill and one-time macOS permission guidance.
description.zh: 把 Cua Driver 的 MCP 服务器接入 DSH：缺失时自动安装 cua-driver，经内置 MCP 客户端以 stdio 启动，注册其 60 个无障碍优先的窗口、输入、菜单与浏览器工具，并附带工作流技能与一次性的 macOS 权限引导。

description.en: Windows file search + document full-text search: names via Everything (es.exe), text inside PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/EPUB via Anytxt; both installed separately.
description.zh: 本机文件搜索与文档全文搜索（全文检索）：文件名走 Everything（es.exe），磁盘上的 PDF / DOCX / XLSX / PPTX / EPUB 正文走 Anytxt，五个只读工具；两个引擎需另装，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Runs DSH's stock bash tool on Git Bash for Windows, so commands go straight to bash -c instead of being re-parsed by the pwsh tool.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上把 DSH 原版 bash 工具挂到 Git Bash 上运行，命令直达 bash -c，不再经 pwsh 工具二次解析。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement (5 modes, memory chain, multi-model fallback) plus voice recognition (cloud Qwen3-ASR / offline SenseVoice, auto-stop on silence) for the composer, with one-click DSH service restart.
description.zh: 一键提示词增强（5 模式·记忆链·模型链）+ 语音识别（云端 Qwen3-ASR / 本地 SenseVoice 离线，说完自动停），附服务异常一键重启。

description.en: Turn a script into a narrated explainer video: text-card slides by default (fast and exact for tutorials) or AI-generated footage per segment (needs AGNES_API_KEY); 14 online neural Chinese voices plus 3 offline Windows voices, with a one-command sample pack for picking a voice by ear. Requires ffmpeg, and the bundled video-remix skill copied to <workspace>/.dsh/skills/video-remix with npm install run there for the online voices.
description.zh: 把文案变成带配音的讲解视频：默认用文字卡片（快且准确，适合教程），也可逐段调用 AI 生成真实画面（需 AGNES_API_KEY）；内置 14 个在线中文神经音色和 3 个离线 Windows 音色，一条命令即可生成全部音色的试听包。前置需要 ffmpeg，并把仓库内的 video-remix skill 放到 <工作区>/.dsh/skills/video-remix 后在该目录执行 npm install（在线音色所需）。

description.en: Academic literature search and citation tools for DeepSeek Harness: paper search via Crossref and OpenAlex with no API key, related-works discovery, and citation formatting in GB/T 7714, APA and BibTeX.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的学术文献检索与引用工具：基于 Crossref 与 OpenAlex 检索论文（无需 API key），支持相关工作发现，并可按 GB/T 7714、APA 与 BibTeX 格式生成引用。

description.en: Chooses which skills and MCP servers each workspace may use, from a "Skills & MCP" item in the workspace row's "..." menu; unchecked skills leave the session catalog, the `skill` tool and `/name`, and unchecked servers have their `mcp__<server>__*` tools denied for that workspace's sessions, running ones included from the next turn.
description.zh: 在侧栏工作区行的「…」菜单中新增「技能与 MCP」，按工作区勾选可用的技能与 MCP 服务器；取消勾选的技能从会话技能目录、`skill` 工具和 `/技能名` 中消失，取消勾选的服务器其 `mcp__<服务器>__*` 工具对该工作区的会话禁用，已在运行的会话从下一轮起生效。

description.en: Adds extra working directories to a workspace, each read-write or read-only, from a folder button next to the composer or the `/add-dir`, `/remove-dir` and `/dirs` commands; the model sees them in its runtime context, and `write` and `edit` calls into read-write directories skip the sandbox escalation prompt by default while shell commands still ask.
description.zh: 为工作区添加额外的工作目录，可设为读写或只读，可通过输入框旁的文件夹按钮或 `/add-dir`、`/remove-dir`、`/dirs` 命令管理；模型可在运行时上下文中看到这些目录，对读写目录的 `write` 与 `edit` 调用默认免去沙箱提权确认，终端命令仍会询问。

description.en: Windows-only game crash diagnosis from Event Log, WER reports and crash dumps, with a diagnose_game_crash tool and an optional background notifier.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows：从事件日志、WER 报告和崩溃转储诊断游戏崩溃，提供 diagnose_game_crash 工具和可选的后台通知。

description.en: Windows serial-port monitor for DeepSeek Harness — port parameters, live text/hex receive and data sending.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 串口调试面板：串口参数设置、文本/十六进制实时接收显示与数据发送。

description.en: Multi-machine remote workspace: manage many SSH hosts, pick a local or remote workspace in the native Add-workspace flow (system folder chooser / local path / remote dir browse), mirror a remote workspace to a real local folder, and operate it with rw_* tools. The picker is a centered modal that opens on the local tab and auto-fills `/` for remote paths, live-completing each directory level.
description.zh: 多机远程工作区：管理多台 SSH 主机，在原生「添加工作区」流程里选本机系统文件夹或远程目录，把远程工作区镜像成真实本地文件夹并用 rw_* 工具操作。选择器是居中弹窗，默认落在本机页签，远程路径自动预填 `/` 并逐级自动补全目录。

description.en: DSH settings section for managing a local Sirchmunk knowledge backend: graph inspection, cluster management, audit history, runtime metrics, and privacy controls.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理本地 Sirchmunk 知识库：图谱导出、聚类管理、审计历史、运行指标与隐私控制。

description.en: Multi-source web search and fetch failover for DeepSeek Harness sessions: takes over the session searchProvider and fetchProvider seams and tries configured sources in a chosen order — TinyFish, Tavily and the official search as a fallback that always participates and can be repositioned but not removed. Multiple API keys per platform are spread round-robin, usage snapshots drive pre-flight exclusion of exhausted accounts, and per-request timeouts plus same-platform retry control failover granularity. Web fetching runs local HTTP first, then falls back to TinyFish Fetch server-side rendering and Tavily Extract, so pages still load when local egress is blocked by proxy or DNS policies. A per-platform panel shows key usage and plan limits. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-failover-search`.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供多来源网页搜索与抓取故障转移：接管会话的 searchProvider 与 fetchProvider 接缝，按可配置顺序尝试已配置来源——TinyFish、Tavily 与官方搜索，官方固定参与兜底、位置可调但不可移除。每平台可配多个 key 轮转分摊，基于用量快照做请求前账号排除，单请求超时与同平台重试控制转移粒度。网页抓取本地 HTTP 优先，失败后依次兜底 TinyFish Fetch 服务端渲染与 Tavily Extract，本机网络受限时代理或 DNS 拦不住页面抓取。插件页按平台展示各账号用量与套餐额度。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-failover-search`。

description.en: Runs Midscene on the models already configured in DeepSeek Harness instead of separate third-party API keys: hosts an OpenAI-compatible bridge on 127.0.0.1 (default port 8787, automatically skipping occupied ports) that proxies chat completions, streaming and non-streaming, to the DSH host model layer, so DeepSeek official routing, CodeBuddy, Codex and custom OpenAI/Anthropic endpoints all become available to Midscene agents while credentials stay inside the provider plugins and the bridge never touches them. A `/v1/midscene-env` endpoint generates the four MIDSCENE_MODEL_* environment lines with the model family inferred, and seven built-in skills — browser, desktop, Android, iOS and HarmonyOS automation plus a Vitest E2E skill and a Midscene knowledge reference — appear in the session skill catalog without `npx skills add`. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-midscene`.
description.zh: 让 Midscene 直接用 DeepSeek Harness 里已配置的模型，不再需要第三方模型 API Key：在 127.0.0.1 托管一个 OpenAI 兼容桥接服务（默认端口 8787，被占用时自动跳号），把流式与非流式的对话补全代理到 DSH 宿主模型层，DeepSeek 官方路由、CodeBuddy、Codex 与自定义 OpenAI/Anthropic 端点对 Midscene 全部可用；凭据留在各提供方插件内，桥不接触。`/v1/midscene-env` 端点直接生成四行 MIDSCENE_MODEL_* 环境变量并自动推断模型家族；浏览器、桌面、Android、iOS、鸿蒙自动化加 Vitest E2E 与 Midscene 知识参考共 7 个内置技能随装随用，无需 `npx skills add`。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-midscene`。

description.en: Foggy Java data-analysis integration for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Runtime, CLI, Launcher, onboarding Skills, and semantic-layer workflows.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理 Foggy Java 数据分析 Runtime、CLI、Launcher 与 onboarding/语义查询 Skill，支持数据库接入和语义层建模。

description.en: AI research toolkit for DSH: a model release radar, a per-model benchmark and community report from 13 structured leaderboards plus Chinese and English community discussion, and an AI news radar over 46 feeds and 22 official X accounts; registers four tools and three skills and renders every report to Markdown with a generated table of contents.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 研究工具箱：模型发布雷达、单模型跑分与口碑体检（13 路结构化榜单 + 中英文社区讨论）、覆盖 46 个 Feed 与 22 个官方 X 账号的 AI 新闻雷达；注册 4 个工具 + 3 个技能，报告统一渲染为带目录的 Markdown。

description.en: Multi-source image search and download (14 engines + 7 aliases covering Baidu, Bing, 360, Duitang, Huaban, Iconify, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, Openverse, Wikimedia, Pixiv, Wallhaven, Konachan and Safebooru) that saves the picked images into the session workspace with a per-file meta.json and renders them inline in the conversation; ships a standalone CLI as well.
description.zh: 多图源搜图并下载（14 个图源 + 7 个别名，覆盖百度/必应/360/堆糖/花瓣/Iconify/DuckDuckGo/Yandex/Openverse/维基共享/Pixiv/Wallhaven/Konachan/Safebooru），落盘进会话工作区并逐张写 meta.json，图片直接在对话里显示；另附独立 CLI。

description.en: An editable diagram canvas in the DSH sidebar plus two agent tools (diagram_read, diagram_apply) that read and edit the workspace in place, using native .drawio files: the canvas opens and saves them losslessly — cells it does not understand are preserved byte-for-byte — and a file-fingerprint revision powers optimistic locking against concurrent edits.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的可编辑画布，加两个模型工具（diagram_read、diagram_apply），直接读写工作区、载体是原生 .drawio 文件：无损写回让画布读不懂的单元逐字节保留，文件指纹 revision 支撑起对并发编辑的乐观锁。

description.en: Imports the MCP servers Codex and Claude Code already declare as dsh mcp-client tools, links the skills of 22 known agent skill directories into ~/.dsh/skills as symlinks instead of copying them, and adds a Settings page that lists what was mounted, toggles each skill, and changes the source on a name conflict.
description.zh: 把 Codex 与 Claude Code 已声明的 MCP 服务器接入 dsh 的 mcp-client，把 22 个已知 Agent 技能目录的技能以符号链接（不复制文件）导入 ~/.dsh/skills，并提供设置页：列出本次实际挂载的服务器与技能、逐项启停技能、重名时改选来源。

description.en: Restores the Windows desktop after a restart or power loss: snapshots open apps, documents, folders and window positions, and reopens them on demand. Windows 10+ only; automatic capture before shutdown needs two scheduled tasks registered once with collector/install-tasks.ps1.
description.zh: 重启或断电后恢复 Windows 桌面：快照已打开的程序、文档、文件夹与窗口位置，可一键重开。仅支持 Windows 10 及以上；关机前自动抓取需先用 collector/install-tasks.ps1 注册两个计划任务。

description.en: Windows desktop organizer for DeepSeek Harness: it registers 1 agent tool (desktop_organize).
description.zh: Windows 桌面整理：归类桌面快捷方式、发现未建快捷方式的程序、检测失效链接（1 个模型工具 desktop_organize）。

description.en: Interactive K-line analysis for DeepSeek Harness with multi-market quotes, technical indicators, news, and fundamentals.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的交互式 K 线分析，支持多市场行情、技术指标、新闻和基本面信息。

description.en: Local document library for DSH Desktop (Windows only, installed with the bundled PowerShell script): upload files once, then every conversation can search and read them through four tools (library_list / library_search / library_read / library_save); upload, download and batch download live in the Settings panel. Files stay on the machine unless you enable the optional vision model, which sends images to the endpoint you configure.
description.zh: 本地资料库（仅 Windows，需用随包的 PowerShell 脚本安装）：文件传一次，之后每个对话都能用四个工具（library_list / library_search / library_read / library_save）检索、读取；上传、下载与打包下载在设置页完成。文件只保存在本机——除非你启用可选的视觉模型，它会把图片发到你配置的接口。

description.en: Nine consolidated tools that give agents full access to the stool ops CLI: server management, database query/redis, log search/tail, CI/CD deploy and history, MFA codes, git operations, notes, todos, and misc utilities (accounting, weekly reports, audit, project listing, nginx presets).
description.zh: 将 stool 运维 CLI 的全部能力整合为 9 个合并工具，Agent 可直接调用：服务器管理、数据库查询与 Redis、日志搜索与尾部查看、CI/CD 部署与历史、MFA 动态码、Git 仓库操作、笔记管理、待办任务，以及记账、周报、审计、项目列表、Nginx 预设等杂项工具。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills from a panel in the DSH sidebar: edit rows in the profile or global cordis.patch.yml, toggle them, check whether an HTTP server answers, scan Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini configs and import the servers they declare, and browse, create, edit, enable or delete skills by rewriting the user-invocable policy in SKILL.md.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的面板里管理 MCP 服务器与技能：编辑 profile 或全局 cordis.patch.yml 中的行、启用停用、探测 HTTP 服务器是否响应、扫描 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini 的配置并导入其中声明的服务器，以及浏览、新建、编辑、启停与删除技能（直接重写 SKILL.md 的 user-invocable 策略位）。

description.en: Read-only GitHub research tools for the agent - repository search, repo health check (stars, license, last push, size, archived), dependency manifests, and single-file reads over the raw channel - plus an oss-reuse skill that makes the agent search GitHub and check real dependencies before writing code, so features are assembled from existing open-source projects instead of rewritten; nothing is cloned and no disk space is used.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 调研工具——仓库检索、候选体检（star、许可证、最近推送、体积、是否归档）、依赖清单读取、经 raw 通道读单个文件——并附一个 oss-reuse 技能，让 agent 先检索 GitHub、核对真实依赖，再用现成开源项目拼装功能而不是从零重写；全程不克隆、不占磁盘。

description.en: Wayland desktop control for GNOME/Mutter sessions: screenshot, OCR with screen coordinates, click by text, and batch input actions. Needs a Python 3 backend with python3-gi and GStreamer; OCR needs Tesseract.
description.zh: GNOME/Mutter 下的 Wayland 桌面控制：截图、带坐标的 OCR、按文字点击，以及批量输入动作。后端为 Python 进程，需 python3-gi 与 GStreamer；OCR 需 Tesseract。

description.en: Connect any ACP-capable agent to DSH and use DSH as a single entry point for all conversations and tasks. Models, thinking levels and permission modes come from the agent itself; tool calls appear in the main chat, diffs are collected on a dedicated NTR page, and approval requests appear in the composer. Requires an ACP-capable agent CLI installed locally.
description.zh: 把任意支持 ACP 的 Agent 接进 DSH，用 DSH 一个入口管理所有会话和任务。模型、思考等级和权限模式由 Agent 自己提供；工具调用显示在主聊天区，diff 汇总到独立的 NTR 页，权限询问出现在输入框。使用前需在本机安装支持 ACP 的 Agent 命令行工具。

description.en: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.
description.zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

description.en: Windows desktop control exposed as native DSH tools - whole-screen and single-window capture (the window one goes through PrintWindow, so a covered window still captures), click, drag, typing, keyboard shortcuts, scrolling, window management, pixel and window polling, and UIA queries that can invoke a control or read its value instead of clicking coordinates. 13 tools over a PowerShell 7 child process; no MCP server, no resident process, no API key.
description.zh: 以 DSH 原生工具形式提供的 Windows 桌面控制——整屏与单窗口截图（单窗口走 PrintWindow，窗口被遮住也能抓）、点击、拖动、打字、按键、滚动、窗口管理、像素与窗口轮询，以及可直接 invoke 控件或读取控件值的 UIA 查询（不必点坐标）。13 个工具，跑在 PowerShell 7 子进程上；不需要 MCP 服务器、无常驻进程、无 API key。

description.en: Localizes the prompts DeepSeek Harness sends to the model — system prompt sections, runtime context, tool descriptions and parameter docs — into Simplified Chinese. Its Cordis API dictionary is derived from zjl1989-li/dsh-harness-zh-cn (MIT), which translates the same prompt layers at runtime; do not enable both at once.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 发给模型的提示词——系统提示词各段、运行时上下文、工具描述与参数说明——翻译成简体中文。Cordis API 词典派生自 zjl1989-li/dsh-harness-zh-cn（MIT），后者同样在运行时翻译同一批提示词层；不要同时启用两者。

description.en: Paper trading in DSH: A-shares and commodity futures, local ledger, built-in FTShare data and K-line, and daily-close practice without buying an API key.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中进行模拟交易，支持 A 股和商品期货，本地账本，内置 FTShare 数据源与 K 线，无需购买 API Key 也可使用日K收盘价练习

description.en: NURBS BRep solid modeling studio with natural-language input, live 3D viewport (measure/wireframe/fit), STEP export, and agent tools driving NVIDIA usd-brep through a managed CPython venv. Needs CPython 3.12; usd-brep wheels cover 64-bit Windows and Linux only.
description.zh: NURBS BRep 实体建模工作台：自然语言输入、实时 3D 视口（测量/线框/适合）、STEP 导出，并通过托管 CPython venv 驱动 NVIDIA usd-brep 的 agent 工具。需要 CPython 3.12；usd-brep 仅有 64 位 Windows 与 Linux wheel。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible image generation in DSH Desktop chat: generate inline, edit reference images or chain-edit previous results directly (image-to-image) without re-uploading, with storage cleanup.
description.zh: 对话内联生图插件：模型在对话框直接出图，可基于参考图或上次生成结果连续图生图修改，附存储清理。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Postiz over MCP: list connected social media channels, fetch per-platform posting rules, and schedule, draft, or publish posts to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, Slack, Telegram and more; adds a postiz workflow skill.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Postiz：列出已连接的社交媒体渠道、获取各平台发帖规则，并向 X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook、Threads、TikTok、YouTube、Reddit、Bluesky、Mastodon、Discord、Slack、Telegram 等平台排期、存草稿或发布帖子；附带 postiz 工作流技能。

description.en: Adds generation_fork and generation_run to copy an agent preset and run a task on a new session.
description.zh: 提供 generation_fork 与 generation_run，用于拷贝 Agent preset 并在新会话上跑任务。

description.en: Multi-agent frugality defense plugin: read-ledger dedup metrics, compaction-immune rules, completion gate, cheap-model review lane.
description.zh: 多智能体防内耗防御插件：读取台账去重度量、免疫压缩规则区、完成机械门禁、低成本审查 lane。

description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
description.zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

description.en: AST-based context compression, test log filtering, and token budget guard for DeepSeek Harness: strips redundant syntax, prunes noisy log lines, and enforces a token ceiling so the context window never overflows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 AST 上下文压缩、测试日志过滤与 Token 预算守卫：剔除冗余语法、精简日志噪声，并强制执行 Token 上限以防止上下文窗口溢出。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session provider quota.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

plugins.name: dsh-image-gen

description.en: Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接入 FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，并在对话中内联显示结果。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 169.254.169.254 for network access

description.en: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click inspector, side-by-side visual diff, a responsive device matrix and one-click Vite ZIP export.
description.zh: 在隔离的 iframe 沙箱中实时渲染 Agent 生成的 HTML、React (JSX/TSX)、Vue、SVG、Mermaid 和 Markdown，支持 SSE 热重载，并提供 DOM 点击检查器、并排视觉对比、响应式设备矩阵和一键 Vite ZIP 导出。

description.en: Mixture-of-Agents plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a /moa slash command fans a prompt out to multiple models in parallel, merges their responses in a file workspace, and integrates with Live Canvas for visual output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的混合智能体（MoA）插件：/moa 斜杠命令将提示词并发分发给多个模型，在文件工作区合并响应，并与 Live Canvas 集成以呈现可视化输出。

plugins.name: dsh-markdownize

description.en: Convert PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, HTML, CSV, JSON and ZIP files to Markdown for the model, using a bundled JavaScript engine or Microsoft MarkItDown.
description.zh: 将 PDF、Word、PowerPoint、Excel、HTML、CSV、JSON、ZIP 等文档转换为 Markdown 供模型读取，内置 JavaScript 引擎，也可使用 Microsoft MarkItDown。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Helps keeping tracked updates from plugins added from github with a simple usability UI.
description.zh: 通过简单的可用性 UI 帮助跟踪从 github 添加的插件的更新。

description.en: Provides the see_image tool for DSH: send an image file to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision model and relay its description back to a text-only model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 see_image 工具：将图片文件发送到可配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，并把其描述回传给纯文本模型。

plugins.name: dsh-grafana

description.en: Conversational Grafana operations: inspect live dashboard data across named sources, then make safe, reviewable dashboard changes with approval and version checks.
description.zh: 对话式 Grafana 运维：跨多个命名源站查看实时大盘数据，再通过审批与版本校验安全、可审阅地修改大盘。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Folder time machine for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot any folder, browse its timeline, roll back with one click — Git-like history without needing Git, for folders that never had a repo (game saves, app config dirs, loose documents). Snapshots are content-addressed and deduplicated, and unchanged files are not re-hashed. Automatic snapshots come in two modes: realtime (fs.watch — one version ~8s after the last change, so a save-all or a build counts once) and timed (checks every N minutes, stores only when something actually changed; identical content never adds an empty version). Empty folders are recorded and recreated on restore. Every restore takes a safety snapshot first, so a rollback is itself undoable, and exact-mode cleanup only removes files and empty folders — a non-empty folder is never deleted. Ships a folder_timemachine model tool (status/history/diff need no approval; writes ask first) plus a floating panel with the timeline, one-click restore and mode switching. Pure JS, zero runtime dependencies, 110 tests included.
description.zh: 给任意文件夹留下历史时间点并一键回到过去：像 Git 一样有版本历史，但不需要懂 Git，任何文件夹都能用（游戏存档、软件配置目录、散落文档都行）。快照按内容寻址去重，只存真正变化的文件，未变文件不重算哈希；自动存档分两档——实时（fs.watch，最后一次改动静默约 8 秒后存一版，编辑器一次保存或一次构建算一版）与定时（每 N 分钟检查，有变化才存，内容没变不产生空版本）。空文件夹也会被记录，恢复时一并重建（mod 加载器、存档扫描器常要求某个空夹存在）。每次恢复前自动存一个安全还原点，因此恢复本身可撤销；exact 模式只删多余文件与空目录，非空目录一律不动。附带模型工具 folder_timemachine（status/history/diff 免审批，写操作走审批）与左下角浮窗面板（时间线、一键恢复、实时/定时切换）。纯 JS、零运行时依赖、自带 110 项测试。

plugins.name: xander-zaozao-xiaban

description.en: Xander Amazon seller-operations toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: 33 native xander_* tools and 7 skills for competitor research, keywords, listings, ads, replenishment and profit, with exact proposals, explicit approval and read-back verification for Amazon changes.
description.zh: Xander 早早下班亚马逊运营工具包：提供 33 个原生 xander_* 工具和 7 个技能，涵盖竞品、关键词、Listing、广告、补货与利润；亚马逊改动须准备精确提案、取得明确批准并回读核验。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Daily game automation on Windows for Genshin Impact, Honkai Impact 3, Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero: a scheduled task per game drives BetterGI, the game-daily skill family, March7thAssistant or ZenlessZoneZero-OneDragon, with per-game switches, a foreground guard, in-run supervision that only steps in on trouble, and one report session per game that later results are appended to. Requires the DSH desktop app and the matching external engine installed.
description.zh: Windows 上的原神 / 崩坏3 / 崩坏：星穹铁道 / 绝区零日常自动化：每个游戏一个计划任务，分别驱动 BetterGI、game-daily 技能族、三月七助手或绝区零「一条龙」；带逐游戏开关、前台守护、只在出问题时介入的运行期值守，以及每游戏固定一个汇报会话、后续结果追加进去。需要 DSH 桌面端，并预先安装对应外部引擎。

description.en: Douyin operator for DSH: drives your own Chrome to read the feed, comments and DMs, reply in-thread, and upload a local video through the creator center - every write passes a policy gate and publishing always needs your click.
description.zh: 抖音运营插件：用本机真实 Chrome 看推荐、读评论、回私信，把本地视频传进创作者中心；写动作过权限闸，发布永远要你点头。

description.en: Bridge to the UnrealAgentLink editor plugin: the Unreal Engine editor dials this WebSocket bridge on 127.0.0.1:17860 and the agent drives it through 12 tools covering all 170 cataloged commands (actors, levels, blueprints, materials, PCG, screenshots, logs, undo).
description.zh: UnrealAgentLink 编辑器插件的桥接端：Unreal 编辑器拨入 127.0.0.1:17860 的 WebSocket 桥，agent 由此用 12 个工具驱动全部 170 个已编目命令（Actor、关卡、蓝图、材质、PCG、截图、日志、撤销）。

description.en: Loads only the basic DSH tools by default and activates the rest on demand, with a per-tool switch list in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 默认只加载基础工具，其余工具按需激活，并在插件设置页以逐工具开关管理。

description.en: 3D director desk sidebar plugin for DSH: stage characters, set camera moves and record timeline previews; AI agents drive the scene in real time via MCP tools.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 3D 导演台插件：摆角色、运镜、时间轴预演与导出，AI Agent 经 MCP 工具实时编排场景。

description.en: Infinite canvas workspace in the DSH sidebar — arrange text, image, video and audio nodes, generate media with AI, and let agents drive every canvas operation through MCP tools. Ships a local bridge service, ready to use offline after install.
description.zh: 无限画布右侧栏插件——在画布上编排文本、图片、视频、音频节点，用 AI 生成媒体内容，Agent 经 MCP 工具直接操作画布；自带本地桥服务，安装后离线可用。

description.en: Let a DSH model inspect and operate Windows applications through an installed Codex Computer Use runtime, with per-session app approval.
description.zh: 让 DSH 当前模型通过已安装的 Codex Computer Use 运行时读取和操作 Windows 应用，并保留每个会话的应用授权。

description.en: Connects the CallAI SEO MCP server: 10 SEO data tools plus a generic DataForSEO request tool for Google/Bing SERP (with AI Overview sources), keyword volume and difficulty, long-tail ideas, competitor keyword gaps, backlinks and page audits. Includes a callai-seo skill. Requires a CallAI API key; pay as you go.
description.zh: 连接 CallAI SEO MCP 服务，提供 10 个 SEO 数据工具和 1 个 DataForSEO 通用请求工具：Google/Bing 搜索结果（含 AI Overview 引用来源）、关键词搜索量与难度、长尾词、竞品关键词差距、外链和页面审计。附带 callai-seo 技能。需要 CallAI API Key，按量付费。

description.en: Content workshop tools for DSH — topic, title, post and content-calendar generation through the built-in LLM.
description.zh: 内容工坊——选题、标题、文案与排期生成工具，直接调用内置 LLM。

description.en: Scientific figures as code: agents create a versioned figure IR, patch it incrementally (one node at a time — untouched objects never move), and export publication-ready, true-vector SVG / PDF / PPTX. Seven papercanvas_* tools (create, get, patch, layout, lint, render, inspect) over a deterministic engine with FC001-FC008 quality lint and CJK-aware font resolution. Verified on DSH 0.1.5-rc.3 through 0.2.2-alpha.2. By the author of dsh-sessionflow. Requires the PaperCanvas engine installed separately: Python 3.11+ and the papercanvas CLI (not yet on PyPI — install it from this repository, put it on PATH or set papercanvasBin); the plugin is a thin adapter and ships no engine.
description.zh: 论文图即代码：Agent 创建版本化 Figure IR，经语义化 Patch 增量修改（单节点粒度——未指定的对象绝不动），确定性导出可编辑的 SVG / PDF / PPTX 真矢量图。七个 papercanvas_* 工具覆盖创建、读取、修改、布局、Lint（FC001–FC008 质量检查）、渲染与检视；中文标签自动使用系统 CJK 字体度量与嵌入。已验证 DSH 0.1.5-rc.3 至 0.2.2-alpha.2 各渠道。dsh-sessionflow 同作者作品。需另装 PaperCanvas 引擎：Python 3.11+ 与 papercanvas CLI（PyPI 尚未发布，当前需从本仓库安装，并放到 PATH 或配置 papercanvasBin）；插件只是薄适配层，不自带引擎。

description.en: Folds REA's 207 reverse-engineering tools (Ghidra / Hopper / IDA backends) into 3 commands plus 6 read-only domain entries: about 5 KB of resident tool text instead of 757 KB. Ships no engines; rea-agents, Ghidra 12.1.x and JDK 21 are installed separately.
description.zh: 把 REA 的 207 个逆向工具（Ghidra / Hopper / IDA 后端）折叠成 3 条命令加 6 个只读域入口，常驻约 5 KB。不代装引擎，需自行安装 rea-agents、Ghidra 12.1.x 与 JDK 21。

description.en: Discovers Codex and Claude project directories and registers them as shared DeepSeek Harness workspaces.
description.zh: 发现 Codex 和 Claude 使用过的项目目录，并将其注册为共享的 DeepSeek Harness 工作区。

description.en: Bridge local projects into Obsidian: bounded manifest scanning, deterministic dependency/tech/topic edges, and wiki-linked notes written into a managed graph/ vault namespace via the Local REST API or the vault filesystem.
description.zh: 把本机项目接入 Obsidian：有界的 manifest 扫描、确定性的依赖/技术栈/主题边，通过 Local REST API 或 vault 文件系统把带 wiki 链接的笔记写入托管的 graph/ 命名空间。

description.en: Talk to Excel in DeepSeek Harness: create, edit, repair, and verify spreadsheets by conversation, with automatic formula health checks after every edit.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里对话完成 Excel 工作：建表、编辑、修复公式、图表校验，每次编辑后自动体检公式。

description.en: Language-pack framework that rewrites model replies: A is an independent LLM rewrite, B injects FTS5 terminology retrieval into that rewrite, C applies local dictionary and regex rules, and composite runs a pipeline such as B then A then C. Ships a GitHub pack marketplace, a ZIP installer with path, size and file-type checks, and a mandatory risk disclaimer gate.
description.zh: 改写模型回复的语言包框架：A 为独立 LLM 改写，B 将 FTS5 术语检索注入改写请求，C 执行本地字典与正则规则，composite 按 B→A→C 等管线组合。附 GitHub 语言包市场、带路径/体积/文件类型校验的 ZIP 安装器，以及强制风险免责闸门。

description.en: Give the agent a priority-ranked, coverage-honest map of any codebase before it edits.
description.zh: 让 agent 在动一个陌生仓库之前，先拿到一份按优先级排序、覆盖率老实的仓库地图。

description.en: Hacker News tools for feeds, discussion threads, search, and user profiles.
description.zh: 用于获取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索和用户资料的工具。

description.en: SSH/SFTP remote sites and workspaces: manage connections and remote directories like local workspaces.
description.zh: SSH/SFTP 远程站点与远程工作区：像本地工作区一样管理远程连接与目录。

description.en: DSH tools for operating a self-hosted Talebook library: search, download, upload and manage books and audiobooks, manage Legado book sources, and admin operations, with approval-gated writes.
description.zh: 在自托管 Talebook 书库上搜索、下载、上传和管理书籍与有声书，管理 Legado 书源及管理员操作；写入操作需经批准。

description.en: Searches a database of past motor-repair cases by fault description, motor rating and brand, and lets new diagnoses be saved back for future retrieval.
description.zh: 按故障描述、功率与品牌检索历史电机维修案例，支持将新诊断沉淀回写供后续检索。

description.en: Combines historical supplier quotes and service rates into onsite-repair, factory-overhaul, green-remanufacture and replacement options for a motor, then recommends one by total cost of ownership.
description.zh: 组合历史供应商报价与工时，生成现场抢修/返厂大修/绿色再制造/整机更换等维修方案，并按综合持有成本给出决策建议。

description.en: Summarises the case evidence, diagnosis, repair procedure, parts list and cost-option comparison for a motor into a Markdown repair recommendation report with data provenance.
description.zh: 将案例依据、诊断结论、维修工序、配件清单与方案对比汇总为带数据溯源的 Markdown 维修建议书。

description.en: Combines fault knowledge-base symptom-to-cause rules with similar past cases to rank candidate motor diagnoses with evidence terms and suggested extra tests.
description.zh: 结合故障知识库症状-原因规则与相似历史案例，输出电机候选诊断排序、证据词与建议补测项。

description.en: Builds a motor-repair replacement-parts BOM from the fault and motor rating, listing stock, lead time and domestic or imported alternatives.
description.zh: 按故障类型与电机功率生成替换配件 BOM，输出库存、交期与国产/进口替代选项。

description.en: Governed literature library: import papers, extract text, keep one index row per entry, and verify quotes verbatim.
description.zh: 可治理的文献库：导入论文、抽取全文，每条文献只保留一行索引，并逐字核验摘录能在原文中查到。

description.en: Chinese writing de-AI plugin (AI-isms / AI writing / humanize): say "去掉AI味" to rewrite text, "写的不错" to auto-learn new AI words into the avoid list. Free from the Zhihu "去AI味写作技巧" community.
description.zh: 中文写作去 AI 味技能插件（AI-isms / AI writing / humanize）：说"去掉AI味"即重写，说"写的不错"自动把新 AI 词汇记入规避表。由知乎圈子"去AI味写作技巧"社区免费提供。

description.en: Bridges the CursorTouch/Windows-MCP desktop automation server into DSH through the official MCP client bridge, registering its screenshot, UI tree snapshot, mouse and keyboard input, clipboard, process and registry tools as mcp__windows__* tools for the model, and adds a windows_mcp_doctor diagnostic tool. Computer Use is off by default and is switched on from the plugin panel.
description.zh: 通过官方 MCP 客户端桥接层把 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP 桌面自动化服务器接入 DSH，把截屏、UI 树快照、鼠标键盘输入、剪贴板、进程与注册表等工具注册成 mcp__windows__* 供模型调用，并附带 windows_mcp_doctor 诊断工具；Computer Use 默认关闭，需在插件面板里打开。

description.en: Shopping assistant for e-commerce: search, compare, pick and recommend products when buying things online, with price comparison, sales, service tags, product images and promotion links from the official Pinduoduo open-platform API, right inside the DSH conversation.
description.zh: 购物助手：在 DSH 对话里搜索、对比、挑选并推荐商品，支持比价与选购建议，覆盖电商购物场景，数据来自拼多多开放平台官方 API，含价格、销量、服务标签、商品图与推广链接。

description.en: Reads only the Microsoft OneNote notebooks you allow, with device-code sign-in, a per-notebook allow-list in Settings, and four read-only tools for status, page listing, search and page content.
description.zh: 只读取你允许的 Microsoft OneNote 笔记本：设备码登录、设置页的笔记本白名单，以及状态、页面列表、搜索、页面内容四个只读工具。

description.en: AI video creation and editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with conversation-driven revisions, multitrack timelines, audio waveforms, and MP4 export. Requires Node 22, FFmpeg and Chrome; audio generation calls a Qianwen MaaS endpoint only after you add an API key.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内通过对话生成与续改视频，支持多轨剪辑、音频波形和 MP4 导出。需要 Node 22、FFmpeg 与 Chrome；音频生成只有在你填入 API key 后才会调用千问 MaaS 接口。

description.en: Headless Claude Code consultations with advisor, reviewer, and designer roles, returned as reference answers.
description.zh: 以 advisor / reviewer / designer 角色无头调用 Claude Code，回复作为参考答案。

description.en: Gives DSH its own per-extension "open with" map: delivery cards, the sidebar preview and change review launch the app you pick, while macOS keeps its own default for Finder double-click. Rules are edited in a Settings tab and stored in ~/.dsh/open-with.json; "show file location" still reveals in Finder.
description.zh: 讓 DSH 擁有自己的「副檔名 → 開啟 app」規則：卡片、側邊預覽與變更審查用你指定的 app 開啟， 而 macOS 的 Finder 雙擊預設不受影響。規則在設定頁編輯、存於 ~/.dsh/open-with.json； 「顯示文件位置」仍走 Finder。

description.en: Zotero library tools via the local API (no API key, Zotero 7+): search items and collections, read metadata, abstracts and PDF full text (on-the-fly parsing when the cache misses), download attachments, and manage notes; API endpoint, target library and limits are configurable.
description.zh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API（无需 API Key，Zotero 7+）操作文献库：检索条目与分类、读元数据/摘要/PDF 全文（缓存未命中时现场解析）、下载附件、管理笔记；API 地址、目标文献库与限额均可配置。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns Jev judgments into three automatic actions — pruning oversized tool output to the segments relevant to the request, screening fetched pages for instructions aimed at the model, and picking which skill fits the next step — plus the jev_ask and jev_gate tools, a judgment ledger that survives restarts, and a /jev-status report. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it is inert and sends nothing.
description.zh: 把 Jev 判定变成三件自动动作的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：精简超长工具输出、筛查抓取页面里针对模型的指令、挑选下一步该用的 skill；另有 jev_ask 与 jev_gate 两个工具、可跨重启的判定账本，以及 /jev-status 报告。需要 TypeSafe API key，没有时完全惰性，不发任何请求。

description.en: Map and routing tools: driving/transit/walking/bicycling route planning, geocoding and POI search via free OSM/OSRM data by default, with an optional Amap (高德) key for better China coverage.
description.zh: 地图与路径规划工具：驾车/公交/步行/骑行路线、地理编码与 POI 搜索。默认零 key 使用 OSM/OSRM 免费数据，可选配置高德 key 获得更优的国内覆盖。

plugins.name: dsh-claude-codex-mode

description.en: Keeps discussion read-only and hands every repository code edit to the Codex CLI through a bundled MCP server; switches between the DSH model and the Claude Code CLI in the plugin form, with preflight checks and a write guard that blocks structured edits to repo files.
description.zh: 讨论阶段只读，改仓库代码一律交给 Codex CLI（插件自带 MCP server）；在插件表单里可在 DSH 主模型与 Claude Code CLI 之间切换，带前置检查，并用写文件 guard 拦截对仓库文件的结构化写入。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Built for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (engines.dsh pins it exactly). Technical support for Dragonfly 3D World using 2027.1 help documents and read-only searches of a detected local installation, with an explicit help-only fallback.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2（engines.dsh 精确钉版）。基于 Dragonfly 3D World 2027.1 帮助文档和本机安装源码的只读检索提供技术支持，未发现安装时明确提示仅帮助文档模式。

description.en: Live Android device pane next to your DSH conversation: scrcpy H.264 streaming, agent taps verified by screenshots and a UI tree, and screenshots / recordings / debug evidence saved into one host directory. Debug sessions keep segmented video, full logcat and per-action frames. Emulators and USB phones, human+agent co-operation, loopback-only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话旁打开 Android 设备实时画面：scrcpy H.264 串流，agent 可点按操作并用截图与控件树自证，截图 / 录屏 / 调试证据统一存进你指定的电脑目录；调试会话自带分段视频、全量 logcat 与逐动作前后帧。模拟器与 USB 真机通吃，人机共屏，仅限本机回环。

description.en: Drives Proteus 8/9 interactive simulation from the agent through eleven proteus_* tools: connect, simulation start/stop/status, probe readings, a project save that checks the file hash and mtime actually changed, and layout suggestions computed locally; on machines that register the Labcenter.InteractiveSimulation COM server it also places devices from a whitelist and queries and connects pins, while without COM it falls back to a keyboard-driven UI transport covering the simulation lifecycle and saving. Requires Windows with a local Proteus 8/9 installation.
description.zh: 让 Agent 通过 11 个 proteus_* 工具控制 Proteus 8/9 交互仿真：连接、仿真启停与状态、探针读数、会校验文件哈希与 mtime 确已变化的工程保存、纯本地计算的布局建议；本机注册了 Labcenter.InteractiveSimulation COM 服务器时还可按白名单放置器件、查询引脚并连线，没有 COM 则降级到只覆盖仿真生命周期与保存的键盘驱动 UI 传输。需要 Windows 与本地安装的 Proteus 8/9。

description.en: Persistent model tool-call trace recorder: every tool call is durably written to a JSONL file that survives restarts, queryable via a structured call_trace tool and a callTraceHistory service, with size rotation and an optional floating canvas UI add-on.
description.zh: 持久化模型工具调用轨迹记录器：每次工具调用落盘为 JSONL（重启不丢），提供结构化 call_trace 查询工具与 callTraceHistory 服务，支持文件大小轮转，附可选浮层画布 UI。

description.en: Send files or folders over the local network via the LocalSend v2 protocol, or generate a temporary browser download link that the receiver opens with no software installed.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中通过 LocalSend v2 协议把文件/文件夹发到局域网内其它机器，或生成一次性浏览器下载链接（接收方无需安装任何软件）。零配置开箱即用，兼容 dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 与 0.1.3-alpha.1。

description.en: Windows desktop observation and control: accessibility tree, screenshots, OCR fallback, mouse and keyboard, with session-scoped approvals and an ESC halt gate. Computer use and desktop automation for DSH, including GUI automation fallbacks.
description.zh: Windows 桌面观察与操作：无障碍树、截图、OCR 兜底、鼠标键盘，带会话级授权与 ESC 急停；适用于电脑操作、桌面自动化与 GUI 自动化场景。

description.en: Computer cleanup for Mac and Windows: disk cleanup, storage cleanup, caches, leftovers, similar photos; scans read-only and moves files to the Trash on macOS or a quarantine folder on Windows, with undo.
description.zh: 电脑清理工具：磁盘清理、空间清理、Mac清理、Windows清理；缓存、残留与相似照片，扫描只读，清理先移入废纸篓或隔离区并可撤销。

description.en: OAuth2-capable IMAP email reader for accounts where password authentication is disabled. Microsoft disabled Basic Auth for personal Outlook IMAP in 2024, so this plugin authenticates via refresh-token OAuth2 (XOAUTH2) with automatic token refresh, plus app-password login for Gmail through an optional local HTTP/SOCKS proxy. Registers list/read/search as ol_email_* so it can coexist with the market dsh-email plugin without tool-name clashes.
description.zh: 面向密码认证被禁用邮箱的 OAuth2 IMAP 读取插件：微软 2024 年起停用个人 Outlook 的 IMAP 基本认证，本插件改用 refresh-token OAuth2（XOAUTH2）自动续期，Gmail 走应用密码并可选本地 HTTP/SOCKS 代理；工具注册为 ol_email_*，可与市场版 dsh-email 共存不撞名。

description.en: SMS forwarding webhook for DeepSeek Harness. Phone apps (SMS Forwarder, Tasker, or any HTTP POST) push messages to a local HTTP endpoint; the plugin stores them as JSONL and exposes sms_recent / sms_search tools so the agent can read SMS verification codes during tasks. Auto-extracts the first 4-8 digit OTP from each message, supports keyword filtering, and works over LAN or Tailscale.
description.zh: DSH 短信转发 webhook：手机端转发 App（短信转发器/Tasker 等）把短信 POST 到本地 HTTP 端点，插件落盘 JSONL 并暴露 sms_recent / sms_search 工具，让 agent 在任务中直接读取短信验证码；自动提取 4–8 位 OTP，支持关键词过滤，可走局域网或 Tailscale。

description.en: Read-only CNKI bibliographic search for DSH: four MCP tools (search, detail, export, status) drive your own Edge/Chrome through a native-messaging bridge, with no PDF downloads, a 3-second minimum interval and a 300-action daily cap. Requires pip install wensu plus wensu setup and loading the browser extension before the four tools appear.
description.zh: 只读的知网题录检索：四个 MCP 工具（search / detail / export / status）通过原生消息桥驱动你自己的 Edge/Chrome，不下载全文，最小间隔 3 秒，每日上限 300 次。需要先 pip install wensu，运行 wensu setup 并在浏览器加载扩展，四个工具才会出现。

description.en: Git Bash as the default shell on Windows. Resolves bash.exe from git --exec-path (never the WSL stub), exposes a run_shell tool, and degrades visibly instead of disappearing when Git Bash is missing.
description.zh: Windows 上的 Git Bash 默认 shell。从 git --exec-path 定位 bash.exe（不用 WSL 的 bash），提供 run_shell 工具；找不到 Git Bash 时明确降级，而不是让插件消失。

description.en: MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness settings: add streamable-http or stdio servers, paste Postman-style headers, test connectivity, and toggle each tool so disabled ones never reach the model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 工具管理器：在设置里添加 streamable-http/stdio 服务器、Postman 式请求头、连通性测试，并按工具开关——停用的工具不会进入模型。

description.en: Monitors IEEE Xplore journal Early Access through Crossref, has an LLM screen every new paper against your keywords, and emails a Markdown weekly digest.
description.zh: 按关键词盯 IEEE 期刊 Early Access：Crossref 抓新收录，逐篇交给大模型研判，生成 Markdown 周报并发到邮箱。

description.en: Hash-anchored file tools for DeepSeek Harness: the read, edit, write and grep tools are replaced by versions where every line is addressed by a variable-length content anchor instead of a line number, and the plugin also registers delete, rename, undo_last_edit, ast_grep, ast_edit, lsp and format. Edits answer with a unified diff; a stale or ambiguous anchor is rejected and a fresh one served back; undo survives restarts; structural search and rewrite run on tree-sitter and semantic work through a language server; a bundled web card plugin renders read, diff, grep and LSP cards from the tools' own structured metadata.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的文件工具换成哈希锚定版本：read、edit、write、grep 被替换为按变长内容锚点定位每一行（而不是行号）的实现，插件同时注册 delete、rename、undo_last_edit、ast_grep、ast_edit、lsp 与 format 七个工具。编辑以统一 diff 返回；失效或歧义的锚点被拒绝并重新下发新鲜锚点；undo 跨重启保留；结构化查找与改写走 tree-sitter，语义能力走语言服务器；随包的 web 卡片插件按各工具自带的结构化元数据渲染 read、diff、grep 与 LSP 卡片。

description.en: Code-graph integration for the DSH Web GUI: a "Codegraph" card in Settings → Plugins with index status, symbol search, callers / callees / impact views, and one-click sync / index; hosts the codegraph MCP server and injects a CodeGraph usage guideline into the system prompt. Requires the codegraph CLI.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Codegraph 集成：设置 → 插件 中的「Codegraph」卡片提供索引状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact 查看与一键 sync/index；托管 codegraph MCP 服务器，并向 system prompt 注入 Codegraph 使用指引。需安装 codegraph CLI。

description.en: Docker container panel for the DSH Web GUI: containers (optionally including stopped), docker inspect details, logs, stats snapshots, image list and one-shot exec on the local machine or SSH hosts — read-only by default (mutations and exec are permission-gated), with a per-container terminal drawer embedded via the tty plugin.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Docker 容器面板：本机或 SSH 主机上的容器列表（可选含已停止）、docker inspect 详情、日志、stats 快照、镜像列表与一次性 exec——默认只读（启停删与 exec 均需显式开启权限），可经 tty 插件在面板底部就地打开容器终端。

description.en: Log query card for the DSH Web GUI over Elasticsearch / OpenSearch: one query surface with per-dialect query strings and clickable examples, field-name completion, filter chips, a time histogram whose bars zoom into that window, field facets that turn a bucket into a filter, and a result list with level colors, stack-continuation rows, columns and paging; Docker container logs are a collection source that reuses the docker plugin. Ships five read-only loglens_* tools (sources / search / fields / facets / context) sharing the same execution layer as the panel. Outbound requests only reach configured sources, judged on the resolved IP, without following redirects and with size and timeout caps.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的日志查询卡片（Elasticsearch / OpenSearch）：一个查询面——按来源方言给查询串与可点例子、字段名补全、筛选芯片、可点柱缩放时间窗的时间分布、把分组的桶点成筛选、带级别染色与堆栈续行标记的结果列表（可选列、可翻页）；Docker 容器日志作为采集来源复用 docker 插件。agent 侧五个只读 loglens_* 工具（sources / search / fields / facets / context）与面板共用同一执行层。出站只打到已配置的来源，按解析后的 IP 判定，不跟随重定向，并有体积与超时上限。

description.en: MCP server configuration card for the DSH Web GUI: add / edit / enable / disable MCP servers over stdio (local subprocess) or streamable-http (remote), with js: prefixed expressions for env / header values, status badges, and hot-reload on save.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器配置卡片：增删改查与启用/停用 MCP 服务器（stdio 本地子进程 / streamable-http 远程两种传输），env / headers 值支持 js: 前缀表达式，带状态徽标，保存即热生效。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-kit#rss

description.en: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.
description.zh: DSH 的 RSS/新闻聚合插件：内置渠道库 + awesome-rsshub-routes 精选订阅源目录 + 自定义源（保存时真实抓取校验），每天自动汇总成「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt；带 Web 设置卡片与侧边栏阅读弹窗。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.ruanyifeng.com

description.en: Read-only preview of SQLite files and MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server connections in the right sidebar, with tables, paged rows, columns, indexes and draggable column widths, never writing to the database.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏只读预览 SQLite 文件与 MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL / SQL Server 连接：表、分页数据、列、索引，列宽可拖动，从不写库。

description.en: Sends photos from a phone into a DeepSeek Harness conversation through a simple LAN service.
description.zh: 通过一个简单的局域网服务，把手机中的照片发送到 DeepSeek Harness 的对话中。

description.en: Hard stop for runaway turns: blocks repeated identical tool calls and ends the turn when per-turn step or time budgets are exceeded.
description.zh: 失控回合硬止损：拦截同一工具+同一参数的重复调用，单轮步数或时长超预算即结束本轮。

description.en: Appends actionable hints to failed tool results, such as the nearest existing directory when a path does not exist.
description.zh: 给失败的工具结果追加可执行提示（如路径不存在时给出最近的已存在目录）。

description.en: Low-cost video understanding tool: a video_understand tool turns a Bilibili link / BV / local video into an AVIS info layer (ASR + scene structure + object tracks + YOLO labels) and returns summary + Q&A. Question-driven dynamic routing across layers (L0 ASR / L1 object tracks / L2 key-frame VLM), semantic-layer reuse for repeat questions, per-question budget cap. Python engine: core layer needs faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp (~200-300MB); the optional semantic layer adds ~2GB of torch / transformers / ultralytics. A bundled doctor --fix sets up the venv and installs both.
description.zh: 低成本视频理解工具：video_understand 把 B站链接/BV号/本地视频转成 AVIS 信息层（ASR+场景结构+对象轨迹+YOLO 标签）并输出摘要+问答。问题驱动动态路由分层（L0 ASR / L1 对象轨迹 / L2 关键帧 VLM）、语义层复用（重复提问直接查层）、单次问题预算上限。Python 引擎：核心层需 faster-whisper / opencv / yt-dlp（约 200-300MB）；可选语义层另需约 2GB 的 torch / transformers / ultralytics。内置 doctor --fix 一键建 venv 并装齐两者。

description.en: Exposes a stdio MCP server as native DeepSeek Harness tools. Ships with the official Microsoft Playwright MCP preset, so the agent browses through the Edge or Chrome you already have open, with your logins intact; any other stdio MCP command can be configured instead. Host-only, no client bundle, no npm dependencies. To drive your own browser, start Edge/Chrome with remote debugging and allow npx to fetch @playwright/mcp.
description.zh: 把 stdio MCP 服务器变成 DeepSeek Harness 原生工具。默认接微软官方 Playwright MCP，agent 直接操作你已打开、已登录的 Edge 或 Chrome；也可换成任意 stdio MCP 命令。宿主侧插件，不带客户端包，无 npm 依赖。要接管你自己的浏览器，需以远程调试模式启动 Edge/Chrome，并允许 npx 拉取 @playwright/mcp。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-subscription

description.en: Use ChatGPT and Codex subscriptions in DeepSeek Harness with OAuth, quota runway forecast, safe resets, web search, image generation, and Fast mode.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅：OAuth 免密、额度续航预测、安全重置、联网搜索、生图与高速模式。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Floating panel for the DSH web UI managing MCP servers and skills: per-server deferred tool loading (ToolSearch, off by default) keeps a server's tools out of every turn's context — the prompt lists tool names only, and a tool's full schema enters the list once the model finds it with the built-in tool_search, so a turn stops paying for schemas it never calls. MCP servers live in a global scope or a project's own .dsh/mcp.json, with per-server enable/disable, a 47-service market and import from ten other clients; skills are auto-discovered across their real scopes with shadowing, and model auto-invocation versus manual-only is a switch per skill.
description.zh: DSH 网页的悬浮面板，管 MCP 也管技能：逐服务器开启工具延迟加载（ToolSearch，默认关闭）——该服务器的工具不再每轮常驻上下文，提示词里只列工具名，模型用内置 tool_search 搜到哪个，哪个的完整参数 schema 才进工具列表，每一轮不再为没调用的 schema 付上下文。MCP 分全局与项目两级（项目写在它自己的 .dsh/mcp.json，只该项目会话可见），逐台启停，另有 47 个服务的市场与从 10 种其他客户端导入配置；技能由宿主自动发现，面板按真实作用域与同名遮蔽逐条列出，每个技能「模型自动调用 / 仅你手动调用」就地可拨。

description.en: Five tools that build, test and run the Inimerse engine, and drive its Verse layers over the server's line protocol. Needs a local Inimerse checkout built with CMake; point the bundle's repoRoot at it (the shipped default is the author's path).
description.zh: 五个工具，用于构建、测试与运行 Inimerse 引擎，并通过服务端行协议驱动其 Verse 层。需要本机有 Inimerse 源码检出并用 CMake 构建；在 bundle 配置中把 repoRoot 指向它（默认值是作者本机路径）。

description.en: DSH tools for reproducing and validating the ml-quant-trading protocol v1 CPU benchmark, then drafting an issue-ready report. Requires a local clone of initial-d/ml-quant-trading (set as the workspace or repoPath) plus Python and PyTorch; this plugin does not fetch the repository or install its dependencies.
description.zh: 用于复现并校验 ml-quant-trading protocol v1 CPU 基准测试，并生成可提交 issue 报告的 DSH 工具。需要本地 clone initial-d/ml-quant-trading，并将其设为 workspace 或 repoPath，同时自行准备 Python 和 PyTorch；本插件不会获取仓库或安装依赖。

description.en: A workbench for engineering and math problems, with nine tools for reading images, solving, plotting and verifying answers, plus four bundled skills. Needs Python with numpy and Pillow. Image reading, figure checking and formula typesetting rely on a vision provider you have configured a key for, so those images are sent to it, and without a key they fail while the other tools still work.
description.zh: 工科与数学题解工作台：九个工具覆盖读题、求解、出图与校核，另附四个随包技能。需要带 numpy 与 Pillow 的 Python。读图、图形校核与公式排版依赖你已配置密钥的视觉模型提供商，图片会发给它；未配置密钥时这些功能报失败，其余工具照常可用。

plugins.name: dsh-ai-library

description.en: Local library panel for DSH: indexes files and artifacts into a searchable card tree with PDF, Office and image preview, plus paper search across arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref and others, web-page archiving to markdown snapshots, a plugin-market tab, and one-click switching for resources found in installed plugins (personas, meme packs, whale widget assets). Ships 18 tools and 22 host routes.
description.zh: DSH 的本地资料馆：把本机文件与产物索引成可搜索的卡片树，支持 PDF / Office / 图片预览，另带论文检索（arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref 等）、把网页存成 markdown 快照、插件市场标签页，以及已装插件资源的同步与一键切换（人设、表情包图集、鲸鱼挂件素材）。包含 18 个工具与 22 条宿主路由。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to export.arxiv.org

description.en: Adds a structured TextIn xParse tool and document parsing skill to DeepSeek Harness, supporting document parsing, cached-content navigation and durable multi-document tasks, with AppKey or Device OAuth authentication, paid-operation approval and bundled cross-platform CLI binaries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化的 TextIn xParse 工具与文档解析 Skill，支持文档解析、缓存内容导航和持久化多文档任务，并集成 AppKey 或 Device OAuth 认证、付费操作审批及跨平台内嵌 CLI。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness rate-limiting plugin that prevents API 429 errors during long-running tasks, with task retrospectives.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 限流插件：长程任务自动控速避免 429，支持任务复盘。

description.en: Blocks a tool call whose arguments lost their boundary, keeps a closing turn open when a step silently never ran so the model can re-issue it, and replaces damaged output on the model-visible surface after a fork. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 拦截参数边界损坏的工具调用；某一步静默失败、turn 即将关闭时保持其打开，让模型重新发起调用；fork 之后把模型可见面上损坏的输出替换为说明。零依赖。

description.en: Slash-command console for dsh: /web start|stop|restart|status, /tunnel SSH forward management, one-shot /ask, and a console TUI launcher.
description.zh: dsh 控制台命令：/web 启动/停止/重启/状态、/tunnel SSH 隧道管理、/ask 一次性问答、/console 启动控制台 TUI。

description.en: Finishes 头歌 (EduCoder) homework over the platform JSON API, with no browser automation. educoder_sweep scans every course for homeworks that still have unfinished challenges — complete homeworks are skipped without reading a single challenge, so a full-account scan costs no model tokens — and can finish them; multiple-choice challenges also cost no model tokens, because the platform returns the answer key in any submission response, while code challenges are generated by the model, uploaded with evaluate:0 and graded once per challenge, then retried using the error report the platform returns. Three tools: educoder_sweep, educoder_homework, educoder_account.
description.zh: 走头歌（EduCoder）平台 JSON API 完成作业，无浏览器自动化。educoder_sweep 扫描所有课程中仍有未通过关卡的作业——已完成的作业直接跳过、一个关卡都不读，因此全量扫描不消耗模型 token——并可一次做完；选择题同样零 token，因为平台会在任意一次提交的响应里回吐标准答案；代码题由模型生成，以 evaluate:0 上传后每关只触发一次评测，再按平台返回的报错重试。三个工具：educoder_sweep、educoder_homework、educoder_account。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness plugin for IsingQ: guided QUBO modeling and validation on-device, then user-confirmed remote solving.
description.zh: IsingQ 原生插件：引导式 QUBO 建模与本地校验，用户确认后提交远端求解。

description.en: Persistent C/C++, Python, and TypeScript definition navigation with a standalone workspace UI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的 C/C++、Python 和 TypeScript 定义跳转及独立工作区界面。

description.en: Prompt enhancement: click the star button in the composer to have the current model rewrite the draft more clearly, with one click back to the original; the template is editable.
description.zh: 增强提示词：点击发送框的星形按钮，用当前模型把草稿改写得更清晰，可一键切回原文；模板可编辑。

description.en: MCP server manager for DSH: add, edit, enable and disable Model Context Protocol servers from a panel, with stdio and streamable-HTTP transports, per-server tool-call timeouts, live connection and tool-count status, and persistence to a project- or home-level mcp.json. Maintained fork of @wingsky-1/dsh-mcp-manager.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 MCP 服务器管理器：在面板中增删改、启用或停用 Model Context Protocol 服务器，支持 stdio 与 streamable-HTTP 两种传输、按服务器设置工具调用超时、实时查看连接状态与工具数量，并持久化到项目级或主目录的 mcp.json。@wingsky-1/dsh-mcp-manager 的维护分支。

description.en: Lets sandboxed agents reach the web through your local proxy: net_fetch fetches pages, net_proxy_status reports proxy status.
description.zh: 让沙箱里的 agent 通过你的本地代理联网：net_fetch 抓取网页，net_proxy_status 查看代理状态。

plugins.name: beav-deepseek-harness

description.en: Connects DSH to local Beav for Xiaohongshu (RED/RedNote) and social-media AI operations: topic research, knowledge, copywriting, image, audio, and short-video workflows with approval and artifact tracking.
description.zh: 将 DSH 连接到本机 Beav，面向小红书（RED/RedNote）、社交媒体运营和自媒体 AI 创作，覆盖选题研究、知识库、文案、图片、音频与短视频工作流，并保留审批和产物追踪。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Registers the MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP server into a dsh profile, so agent sessions get mcp__matlab__* tools for running MATLAB code and reading, editing and testing Simulink models.
