description.zh: 把 MathWorks MATLAB/Simulink MCP 服务器注册进 dsh profile，让会话获得 mcp__matlab__* 工具，用于运行 MATLAB 代码以及读取、编辑与测试 Simulink 模型。

description.en: AST-based structural code search and syntax outline tool powered by ast-grep.
description.zh: 基于 ast-grep 的语法级 AST 代码结构检索与大纲提取工具。

description.en: LSP action surface for DeepSeek Harness providing diagnostics, formatting, rename, code actions, and symbols over real language servers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的通用 LSP 工具面，提供语言服务器诊断、格式化、重命名、代码动作与符号导航。

description.en: Semantic workspace search: three model tools (`zg_search`, `zg_index`, `zg_status`) drive the `zg` CLI for hybrid BM25 + vector + RRF retrieval, with a search-first guard that makes `grep`/`rg` require a prior successful search in an indexed workspace.
description.zh: 工作区语义检索：三个模型工具（`zg_search` / `zg_index` / `zg_status`）驱动 `zg` CLI 做 BM25 + 向量 + RRF 混合检索，并带一层 search-first 守卫——已建索引的工作区里，`grep`/`rg` 需要先成功调用一次检索。

description.en: Turns a Xiaohongshu, Douyin, TikTok, YouTube or X link into text: transcript with timecodes, on-screen text, a description and OCR of every image, caption and metadata. Mounts the hosted MCP server over streamable HTTP.
description.zh: 把小红书、抖音、TikTok、YouTube 或 X 链接转成文本：带时间戳的转写、屏幕文字、逐图描述与 OCR、正文与元数据。通过 streamable HTTP 挂载托管的 MCP 服务。

description.en: Local toolbox for the DSH web GUI: 35 pure-client tools (text, encoding, hashing, extraction, conversion, reference tables) in a sidebar view, plus the /toolbox command and config-driven agent tool exposure.
description.zh: DSH 本地工具箱：侧边栏独立页面内置 35 个纯本地小工具（文本、编码、哈希、提取、转换、速查表），另有 /toolbox 命令与配置驱动的 agent 工具注册。

description.en: AI-driven drawio: four agent tools (validate, render to SVG/PNG, edit, template) plus a sidebar live board — zero-dependency mxfile-to-SVG preview, embedded diagrams.net editor with save bridge, and auto-open whenever the agent draws.
description.zh: AI 驱动 drawio：四个画图工具（校验 / 渲染 SVG/PNG / 编辑 / 模板）+ 侧栏实时画板——零依赖 mxfile→SVG 预览、内嵌 diagrams.net 官方编辑器、AI 画图时自动弹出跟随。

description.en: Bilibili companion for DSH (MIT fork of Alterssss/dsh-bili-whale; do not install alongside the upstream — both register the same `/dsh-bili/` settings routes and share `~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json`): wakes on a schedule, reads videos through subtitles, danmaku, hot comments and covers, writes two diaries, and shares at most one pick per wake by commenting on the video and @-mentioning the owner (daily quota 3; DM when `share.via=dm`). Inbound DMs, commenter names, summary requests and live danmaku are normalized and scanned for injected instructions before they reach the model; only the owner DM channel can carry an authorization prefix.
description.zh: DSH 的 B 站养鱼插件（Alterssss/dsh-bili-whale 的 MIT 分叉；不要与上游 dsh-bili-whale 同装——两者注册同一套 `/dsh-bili/` 设置路由并共用 `~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json`）：按作息自己醒来，靠字幕、弹幕、热评与封面读懂视频，写两本日记，每次醒来最多以评论区 @ 主人的方式分享一条（每日额度 3；`share.via=dm` 时走私信）。私信正文、来信人、总结请求与直播弹幕在进模型前会归一化并扫描可疑指令；只有主人私信通道能携带授权前缀。

description.en: Full upstream REA 6.4.0 integration over the official DSH MCP bridge: all 170 tools, the version-matched reverse-engineering skill, and the six original MCP prompts with argument completions reachable from the composer / menu, all sharing one REA process and complete structured Evidence. External analysis engines are bring-your-own.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 官方 MCP 桥接接入原版 REA 6.4.0：完整 170 个工具、同版本原版逆向 Skill，以及输入框 / 菜单里的六个原版 MCP prompts 与参数补全，共用同一个 REA 进程并保留完整结构化 Evidence。外部分析引擎需自行配置。

description.en: Windows computer-use plugin for AI agents with reusable window targets, UI Automation, window-bound screenshots, background-first verified input, isolated Chromium automation, MCP, CLI, and installable skills.
description.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的 Windows 电脑操控与 computer use 插件，支持可复用窗口目标、UIA 无障碍定位、窗口绑定截图、后台优先的验证输入、隔离 Chromium 自动化、MCP、CLI 和可安装 Skill。

plugins.name: agent-web-search

description.en: Aggregated multi-upstream web search for DeepSeek Harness: replaces native web_search with model-native grounding and agent search APIs, source attribution, and rich citation cards.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 聚合多上游联网搜索插件：无缝替换原生 web_search，支持模型原生检索、免 Key 上游与富文本引用卡片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Typed, guarded container control: ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop and compose up/down with JSON output, project-aware targeting, and approval-gated destructive ops.
description.zh: 类型安全、带护栏的容器控制：ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop 与 compose up/down，JSON 输出、项目感知定位、破坏性操作需审批。

description.en: Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.
description.zh: 把已有的 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）技能库带进 DSH：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录、注入渐进式索引，按需加载技能正文。

description.en: Daily check-in for Nanjing Forestry University's ACM AI Hub plus seat booking for its library — both site addresses are hardcoded — with a settings page and a progress badge; built for DeepSeek Harness Mobile (DSHM) on Android.
description.zh: 南京林业大学 ACM AI Hub 每日签到与该校图书馆座位预约（两个站点地址写死），带设置页与完成度角标；面向 Android 上的 DeepSeek Harness Mobile。

description.en: DSH bundle that registers 13 native codegraph_* tools wrapping the codegraph CLI, so agents bootstrap, maintain, and query a pre-indexed code knowledge graph (symbol query, explore, node trail, callers/callees, impact, affected tests) instead of grepping files.
description.zh: DSH 插件，注册 13 个原生 codegraph_* 工具包装 codegraph CLI，让代理初始化、维护并查询预索引的代码知识图谱（符号查询、区域探索、节点轨迹、callers/callees、影响分析、受影响测试），无需 grep 文件。

description.en: Code knowledge graph bridge for codebase-memory-mcp: semantic symbol search (BM25), source snippets, architecture overview with Leiden communities, call/data-flow/cross-service traces, graph-augmented grep.
description.zh: codebase-memory-mcp 的代码知识图谱桥：语义符号搜索（BM25）、源码片段、Leiden 社区架构总览、调用/数据流/跨服务追踪、图增强 grep。

description.en: Desktop and browser automation bridge (36 tools): window/screen/mouse/keyboard control with PaddleOCR element perception, Chrome CDP browsing with accessibility snapshots.
description.zh: 桌面 + 浏览器自动化桥（36 个工具）：窗口/屏幕/鼠标/键盘控制配 PaddleOCR 元素感知，Chrome CDP 浏览配无障碍快照。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills in DeepSeek Harness, and hide tool groups from the next prompt with token-cost estimates.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器与 Skill，并可把工具组从下一轮 prompt 中隐藏，附 token 成本估算。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills in DeepSeek Harness, and control which tools enter the next prompt.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器与 Skill，并控制下一轮 prompt 带入哪些工具。

description.en: Adds a markitdown tool that converts PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, CSV, EPUB and URLs to Markdown, using a real Microsoft MarkItDown installation when one is reachable and a bundled dependency-free converter otherwise.
description.zh: 提供 markitdown 工具，把 PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、HTML、CSV、EPUB 与网址转成 Markdown：能找到真实的 Microsoft MarkItDown 时驱动它，否则使用内置的零依赖转换器。

description.en: This plugin locates the root cause of a failed DeepSeek Harness agent session and produces a shareable diagnostic report.
description.zh: 此插件定位DeepSeek Harness代理会话失败的根本原因，并生成可共享的诊断报告。

description.en: Xcode AI integration for DSH: 26 Xcode MCP tools (mcpbridge) + Apple platform skills + Xcode Intelligence-style persona (agent preset or global bundle).
description.zh: DSH 的 Xcode AI 集成：26 个 Xcode MCP 工具（mcpbridge）+ Apple 平台技能 + Xcode Intelligence 风格 persona（agent preset 或全局 bundle）。

description.en: Windows-only computer use for DeepSeek Harness: captures the virtual screen and drives mouse & keyboard through 9 tools built on PowerShell and Win32 SendInput; pairs with picturereader so text-only models can complete the screenshot-analyze-act-verify loop fully locally.
description.zh: 仅 Windows 的 DSH 电脑操作插件：以 PowerShell + Win32 SendInput 实现 9 个工具，截取虚拟屏幕并驱动鼠标键盘；配合 picturereader 让纯文本模型在本地完成「截图-分析-操作-验证」闭环。

description.en: Project/task dual-mode workspaces for DSH: a task skips the workspace picker and gets a fresh scratch directory (D:\dsh_working\<name>-<timestamp>) per conversation, Codex-style; no-workspace sessions are grouped under a persistent Tasks section in the sidebar with empty states, and the new-session workspace picker gains a "no workspace (task)" option.
description.zh: DSH 项目/任务双模式工作区：任务不绑定工作区，每次新对话在 D:\dsh_working\<名称>-<时间戳> 自动创建独立临时目录（类 Codex）；侧边栏"任务"分组常驻显示所有无工作区会话并带空状态提示，新建会话的工作区选择器增加"无工作区（任务）"选项。

description.en: Real-compute verification gates: math simplification, logic proofs, regex validation, E-prover FOL, state-machine checks, and code repair, backed by Go-compiled binaries with prebuilt Windows executables.
description.zh: 真实计算验证门：数学化简、逻辑证明、正则校验、E-prover 一阶逻辑、状态机检查与代码修复，由 Go 编译的二进制支撑（附 Windows 预编译产物）。

description.en: Traditional Chinese Medicine toolkit: eight-axes diagnosis and herb-pair lookup.
description.zh: 中医工具集：八纲辨证与药对查询。

description.en: One-click ✨ polish button for the composer: rewrites prompts and drafts with WorkBuddy humanizer-style rules (kills AI-flavored phrasing, varies rhythm, mode-aware for instructions/questions/prose) via free Zhipu GLM-4.5-Flash or any OpenAI-compatible API, falling back to offline local rules.
description.zh: 输入框 ✨ 一键润色按钮：参考 WorkBuddy 润色（humanizer-zh）规则改写提示词与草稿（去除 AI 写作痕迹、调整句式节奏，按指令/提问/普通文本分类处理），默认使用免费的智谱 GLM-4.5-Flash，也支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 API，断网时回退到本地规则引擎。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness automatically opens browser plugins and includes a built-in WebView2 program to achieve a lightweight desktop experience.
description.zh: deepseek harness自动打开浏览器插件，内置WebView2程序实现轻量级桌面化。

description.en: The dsh security mode plugin achieves a zero third-party plugin startup by constructing a blank profile.
description.zh: dsh安全模式插件，通过构建空白profile实现零第三方插件启动。

description.en: Hot-swap the outbound proxy in dsh between direct, system, and saved proxies without restarting.
description.zh: 在 dsh 运行过程中热切换出站代理（直连/系统/自定义），无需重启即可生效

description.en: Scan installed Windows apps and launch them from a sidebar launcher above the settings icon.
description.zh: 扫描本机已安装的 Windows 应用，在侧边栏设置图标上方提供一键启动。

description.en: Rejects foreground waiting in DSH agents: waiting commands (sleep, wait, tail -f, watch, ping without -c, infinite loops), blocking wait tools (wait_agent, job_output with wait: true), progress polling (the same check command repeated within a window) and commands that need human input/confirmation (sudo without -n, ssh without BatchMode, login flows, interactive editors, docker -it) are refused with an actionable retry to run in the background or end the turn. Configurable budget and polling window, message language follows the system (zh/en), zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 禁止 Agent 前台等待：sleep / wait / tail -f / watch / ping 等等待型命令、wait_agent 与 job_output(wait) 等阻塞等待工具，用反复 check 代替等待的轮询（同一条命令在窗口内重复出现），以及需要人输入/确认的命令（sudo 不加 -n、ssh 不开 BatchMode、登录流程、交互式编辑器、docker -it）都会被拒绝，并给出改用后台作业或结束本轮等唤醒的可执行指令；等待预算与轮询窗口可配、文案跟随系统语言（中/英）、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Windows multi-drive dashboard that labels cleanable, caution, and system space in green, yellow, and red, audits download folders, and suggests how to split data across drives.
description.zh: Windows 多盘磁盘分工面板：用绿/黄/红标出可清理、需确认、系统占用，核对下载目录，并给出多盘分工与迁移建议。

description.en: Input-box floating translation widget for DSH: translate drafts via session model, Zhipu GLM, or custom endpoints, with preview/replace/append, connectivity testing, and recent history.
description.zh: DSH 输入框悬浮快捷翻译挂件：支持当前会话模型、智谱 GLM 与自定义端点，提供预览/替换/追加、连通性测试及最近历史找回。

plugins.name: qiaomu-rss-dsh

description.en: Read RSS feeds, retrieve podcast transcripts, collect web links for rewrites, and discuss articles in native Harness conversations.
description.zh: 阅读 RSS、获取播客原文、收录网页并生成改写，在 Harness 原生对话中伴读。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to feeds.feedburner.com

description.en: Registers six native DeepSeek Harness tools for deterministic fixture-based or read-only Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle database analysis, planning, preview, and readback.
description.zh: KaleidoSphere 数据库分析插件：六个原生工具（状态/发现/分析/计划/预览/回读），针对只读的 Microsoft SQL Server 与 Oracle，默认走内置确定性 fixture，运行时随包分发、无需外部服务。

description.en: In-session cd for DeepSeek Harness: re-base relative paths on the fly (the file tools and the bash/pwsh default workdir follow) or move the session to another workspace for real — a `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` call the user has agreed to, or the user's own `/cd <directory>` command, relocates the session's stored log, sandbox root, AGENTS.md and skill discovery and sidebar grouping. Per-session, persisted across restarts, without moving the session for a plain re-base.
description.zh: 会话内 cd：即时切换相对路径基准（文件工具与 bash / pwsh 默认工作目录跟随），或把会话真正搬到另一个工作区——经用户同意的 `cd {"workspace": true, "confirmed": true}` 或用户自己的 `/cd <目录>` 命令，会迁移会话日志存储位置、沙箱根、AGENTS.md 与 skills 发现根以及侧边栏分组；按会话隔离、跨重启恢复，单纯换基准时不动会话身份。

description.en: Active wait for background subagents in DeepSeek Harness: registers a wait_subagent model tool that blocks until a named background continuable subagent settles, then returns its stop reason and closing message — optional timeout, membership gate rejects unknown ids, event-driven with zero polling. Closes the gap between run_in_background fire-and-return and the async settlement notice; wait for a background subagent without polling list_agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供后台子代理的主动等待：注册 wait_subagent 模型工具，阻塞等待指定的后台 continuable（可续会话）子代理收尾（settlement），返回停止原因与收尾消息——可选超时、成员资格门控拒绝未知 id、事件驱动零轮询。补齐 run_in_background 发后不管与异步收尾通知之间的缺口：等待后台子代理（subagent wait）不再轮询 list_agents、不再靠猜。

description.en: A lightweight, general-purpose attachment Dock for DSH: paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, documents, archives, code, and other files, review and manage them before sending, then pass them to the Agent as local paths. It gives non-image files a consistent attachment entry point.
description.zh: 一个轻量、通用的 DSH 附件 Dock：支持粘贴、拖入或选择图片、PDF、文档、压缩包、代码等文件，发送前统一查看和管理，再以本地路径交给 Agent；解决非图片文件缺少统一附件入口的问题。

description.en: Applies structured unified diffs (git format) to the real filesystem: multi-file/hunk parsing, fuzzy hunk location with line-offset correction, all-or-nothing application with typed conflict reports, reverse-patch undo journal and dry-run - four patch_* dsh tools plus a CLI.
description.zh: 将结构化 unified diff（git 格式）应用到真实文件系统：多文件/多 hunk 解析、带行号偏移修正的模糊定位、全有或全无的应用与类型化冲突报告、反向补丁撤销日记及 dry-run——4 个 patch_* dsh 工具外加一个 CLI。

description.en: Conversational bookkeeping bundle for dsh: record expenses/income by chat with strict amount validation and natural-language dates, then query, report, export CSV/HTML, and track monthly budgets against a local SQLite ledger.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式记账插件:聊天即可记账(严格金额校验、自然语言日期、自动分类),并支持查询、报表、CSV/HTML 导出和月度预算,数据存于本地 SQLite 账本。

description.en: CalDAV + iCalendar + RRULE calendar integration bundle for dsh with Chinese-bias support (lunar calendar / holidays), conflict detection and reminder tools.
description.zh: dsh 的日历集成 bundle：CalDAV + iCalendar + RRULE 日程管理，内置农历/节假日等中文场景支持、冲突检测与提醒工具。

description.en: Local code knowledge graph for agents: parse a codebase (Python/JS/TS/Go/Java/Rust) into a SQLite index and answer callers, callees, deps, dependents, impact and full-text questions over it.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的本地代码知识图谱：把代码库（Python/JS/TS/Go/Java/Rust）解析进 SQLite 索引，回答调用者、被调用者、依赖、反向依赖、影响面与全文检索问题。

description.en: Desktop (native) control for dsh as a stdio JSON-RPC bridge over a Python core: capture the screen, inject pointer/keyboard input, drive accessibility-tree actions, and gate high-risk operations behind required confirmations.
description.zh: 桌面(native)控制:dsh 经 stdio JSON-RPC 桥接 Python 核心;支持截屏、指针/键盘注入、无障碍树语义操作,并以强制确认为高风险操作把关。

description.en: Safe, audited SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL access for dsh agents: schema introspection, enforced read-only queries, a write approval gate, and a durable JSONL SQL audit trail.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供安全且可审计的 SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL 访问：schema 内省、强制只读查询、写审批门与持久化 JSONL SQL 审计追踪。

description.en: Local semantic index over workspace documents (MD/PDF/DOCX/TXT): FTS5 BM25 + local embedding hybrid retrieval, hit citations with line numbers, and incremental updates.
description.zh: 工作区文档的本地语义索引（MD/PDF/DOCX/TXT）：FTS5 BM25 与本地嵌入混合检索、带行号命中引用、增量更新。

description.en: Financial market monitor bundle for dsh: real-time quotes, a local watchlist, threshold alerts with cooldowns, periodic polling, and in-chat ASCII/mermaid charts for A-share stocks/indices and crypto (Tencent + CoinGecko).
description.zh: dsh 的金融行情监控插件:实时报价、本地自选列表、带冷却的阈值提醒、定时轮询,以及在会话内用 ASCII/mermaid 渲染 A 股与加密货币图表(数据源腾讯 + CoinGecko)。

description.en: Auto-discovers model listings, pricing and capabilities from OpenAI-compatible API hosts, normalizes them, and emits ready-to-use model configs for dsh.
description.zh: 从 OpenAI 兼容 API 主机自动发现模型列表、定价与能力，归一化后生成 dsh 可直接使用的模型配置。

description.en: HTTP network debugging toolset for DeepSeek Harness: a general-purpose HTTP client with SSRF/private-network protection, per-session request history with replay, response inspection and HAR export - three dsh tools plus a zero-dependency CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的网络调试工具集：带 SSRF/私网防护的通用 HTTP 客户端、会话内请求历史与重放、响应检查与 HAR 导出——三个 dsh 工具外加零依赖 CLI。

description.en: RSS/Atom digest bundle for dsh: subscribe to feeds, fetch on a schedule, dedupe exact and near-duplicate stories, and get LLM-summarized daily Markdown briefings delivered into conversations and/or files (with a standalone CLI).
description.zh: dsh 的 RSS/Atom 摘要插件:订阅源管理、定时抓取、精确与近似去重,并由 LLM 生成每日 Markdown 简报投递到会话和/或文件(同时提供独立 CLI)。

plugins.name: semantic-search

description.en: Local semantic code search for DeepSeek Harness: fragment-level symbol-aware indexing, offline lexical embeddings or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and hybrid vector + BM25 retrieval fused with RRF - three dsh tools plus a sema CLI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地语义代码搜索：片段级符号感知索引、离线词法 embedding（或 OpenAI 兼容端点）、向量+BM25 混合检索并以 RRF 融合——三个 dsh 工具外加 sema CLI。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: API contract studio for DeepSeek Harness: decide the seven things that must be locked before coding, author and review OpenAPI, classify breaking changes by how they actually break clients, and settle error shapes, versioning and deprecation — six playbooks plus a router.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 API 契约工作室：开工前先定七件事、写/审 OpenAPI、按「客户端具体坏在哪」分类破坏性变更，再定错误结构、版本与弃用——六本手册加一个路由。

description.en: Run Blender headless from DeepSeek Harness: execute bpy scripts, render scenes and export glTF assets, with modeling cookbook, 5.x pitfall list and asset-pipeline playbooks bundled as skills so the agent self-checks geometry before handing assets back.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里以 headless 方式跑 Blender：执行 bpy 脚本、渲染场景、导出 glTF 资产，并附带建模技法库、5.x 踩坑清单与资产管线手册（技能包），让 agent 在交付前自检几何。

description.en: Production pack for ComfyUI inside DeepSeek Harness: submit API-format workflows to a local or remote server, batch-generate and fetch outputs, and diagnose bad images with measured parameter ranges and a failure-mode decision tree (black frames, duplicated subjects, color fringes, OOM).
description.zh: ComfyUI 在 DeepSeek Harness 里的生产包：向本地或远程服务提交 API 格式工作流、批量出图并取回产物，附实测参数区间与崩图排查决策树（黑图、主体重复、彩边、显存不足）。

plugins.name: dsh-jenkins

description.en: Manages multiple Jenkins servers and triggers jobs from a Settings page, model tools, or a per-workspace "Run Jenkins Job" entry, with a bilingual host + browser UI.
description.zh: 管理多台 Jenkins 服务器，支持从设置页、模型工具或工作区级「执行 Jenkins Job」入口触发构建，宿主 + 浏览器双端、界面中英双语。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to jenkins-tx.whale-plus.com:8080

description.en: A plugin for dsh: monitor the resource utilization of dsh system processes, and report the results to the user in the form of charts.
description.zh: 监控dsh进程及其派生子进程的资源占用,并以面板图表报告整机与各会话的CPU与内存占用

description.en: A plugin for dsh: quantify every dsh Agent interaction as a visualized performance metric and automatically sync it to WakaTime, using data to showcase your productivity with Agent.
description.zh: 将DSH的每一次Agent交互量化为可视化表现指标并自动同步至WakaTime,用数据展示你与Agent协作的生产力

description.en: Per-conversation tool kits for DeepSeek Harness: pick one kit and only its tools reach the model, with three bases (All, built-in only, or a saved kit), add-ons for one-off combinations, and a token ledger estimating what the kit saves.
description.zh: 给每个对话选一套工具（套装），只把用得上的工具投给模型：三档底座（全部 / 仅内置 / 我的套装）、一次性加挂、token 账本估算省下的开销，并可在设置里指定新对话的默认套装。

plugins.name: dsh-read-book

description.en: Search four free libraries from one window: Project Gutenberg through its OPDS catalog, Shuge through its WordPress search plus the s.shuge.org short links on each book page, and NCPSSD through its Solr-backed endpoint. The Chinese Text Project is deliberately link-only, because its terms forbid automated access. Two tools: readbook_search and readbook_open; the second returns real download URLs for Gutenberg and Shuge, and only a page link for NCPSSD.
description.zh: 一个窗口同时搜四家免费图书馆：Project Gutenberg 走 OPDS 目录，书格走 WordPress 检索再取每本书页面上的 s.shuge.org 下载短链，国家哲学社会科学文献中心走它的 Solr 检索接口。中国哲学书电子化计划刻意只给链接——它明令禁止程序化抓取。两个工具：readbook_search 与 readbook_open，后者给 Gutenberg 和书格的真实下载地址，NCPSSD 只给页面链接。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to opds-spec.org

description.en: Indexes public AI-company job boards (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workable, SmartRecruiters), scores postings for AI relevance, extracts the requirements from each job description, and produces a scheduled daily Markdown digest.
description.zh: 索引海外 AI 公司的公开招聘看板（Greenhouse、Ashby、Lever、Workable、SmartRecruiters），按 AI 相关性给岗位打分，从职位描述里提取招聘要求，并按计划每天生成 Markdown 摘要。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Baidu Netdisk's official MCP service for file search, file metadata, and storage quota. Requires Baidu account authorization after installation.
description.zh: 百度网盘 MCP 插件，支持在 DeepSeek Harness 中搜索网盘文件、查看文件信息和查询容量。安装后需授权百度账号。

description.en: Connects the agent to JuzPost, a social media scheduler, over MCP: lists connected accounts, checks per-platform limits, uploads media, and drafts, schedules or publishes posts to YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Bluesky, Threads, Tumblr and WordPress. Registers the JuzPost tools as mcp__juzpost__* plus a workflow skill that confirms with the user before anything is published. Needs a JuzPost API key in JUZPOST_API_KEY; JuzPost issues API keys on paid plans.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 将智能体连接到 JuzPost（社交媒体排程工具）：列出已连接账号、检查各平台限制、上传媒体，并向 YouTube、Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、X、LinkedIn、Pinterest、Bluesky、Threads、Tumblr 和 WordPress 起草、排程或发布帖子。注册 mcp__juzpost__* 工具及一个发布前先向用户确认的工作流技能。需要在 JUZPOST_API_KEY 中提供 JuzPost API 密钥；JuzPost 的 API 密钥需付费方案才能创建。

description.en: Jira and Confluence for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Atlassian remote MCP server, a result card for issues and pages, and an issue panel.
description.zh: 把 Jira 与 Confluence 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Atlassian 远程 MCP 服务器的工具、问题与页面的结果卡片，以及问题面板。

description.en: A WebSearchProvider that falls back across backends instead of relying on one: Exa, then Bing HTML, then DuckDuckGo HTML, and only then the quota-limited SerpAPI, so the free tiers carry routine searching.
description.zh: 多后端自动降级的 WebSearchProvider：依次尝试 Exa、Bing HTML、DuckDuckGo HTML，都失败后才动用有额度的 SerpAPI，日常搜索由免费档承担。

description.en: Semantic-layer analytics tool that uses curated table, column and metric metadata with Qdrant and Elasticsearch recall to generate, validate and execute MySQL analytical queries through the Xiwen service.
description.zh: 基于人工维护的表、字段和指标语义元数据，结合 Qdrant 与 Elasticsearch 召回，通过析问服务生成、校验并执行 MySQL 分析查询。

description.en: Custom script manager for DSH: turn verified operations into reusable scripts that run directly via /script or register as agent tools, with parameterized scripts, declared expected outcomes, and execution history.
description.zh: DSH 自定义操作脚本管理器，将验证过的操作流程固化为可复用的脚本，用 /script 直接运行或注册为 Agent 工具，支持参数化脚本、执行预期声明、执行历史记录。

description.en: Search AIGC Radar's curated GitHub AI project library (500-star admission, bilingual zh/en tags, star-growth snapshots) over its MCP endpoint with native result cards; an agent/pre-step listener proactively suggests a reuse check before the agent writes code.
description.zh: 检索 AIGC Radar 精选 GitHub AI 项目库（500 Stars 准入、中英双语标签、星标增长快照），经其 MCP 端点调用并以原生结果卡片展示；agent/pre-step 监听器在 agent 动手写代码前主动建议复用检查。

description.en: Redirects DSH downloads, artifacts, caches and temp files to user-specified drives (auto-picks the largest non-C drive), injects a path-discipline prompt into every session, and ships a disk_guard tool for status and cleanup — keeps the C: drive from filling up.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的下载、产物、缓存与临时文件重定向到用户指定目录（自动挑剩余空间最大的非 C 盘），向每个会话注入路径纪律提示词，并自带 disk_guard 工具做状态查看与清理——防止 C 盘被撑爆。

description.en: Connects DSH to timestamped video reading, shared queues/history and Scroll personal Bilibili workflows through an existing Video Reader installation. Windows x64 only: install the core and set VIDEO_READER_ROOT before starting DSH; the bundle does not install Python, FFmpeg, models or Bilibili credentials.
description.zh: 复用现有的 Video Reader 本地安装，为 DSH 接入带时间戳的视频阅读、通用队列/历史与 Scroll 的个人 B 站工作流。仅支持 Windows x64：需先安装核心并设置 VIDEO_READER_ROOT 再启动 DSH；本包不安装 Python、FFmpeg、模型或 B 站凭据。

description.en: Windows plugin that swaps the host shell executor for Git for Windows bash across every agent mode, materializes Git Bash variants of the standard, minimal, PTC and Cordis presets (per-file sha256-marked, user edits preserved), and exposes a gitBash capability so companion presets pick Git Bash automatically; when dsh-better-sidebar is installed it also adopts that sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through its official settings seam.
description.zh: Windows 插件：将宿主 shell 执行器换成 Git for Windows bash（全部 Agent 模式生效），并物化标准/极简/PTC/创造四个 Git Bash 预设变体（逐文件 sha256 标记、用户修改保留）；发布 gitBash 能力服务，让配套预设自动选用 Git Bash；若装有 dsh-better-sidebar，还会通过对方官方设置补丁口把其终端（UI 标签与模型 terminal_* 工具）一并切到 Git Bash。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that layers the self-referential Cordis toolset (dynamic plugins, runtime inspection) and preset-authoring skills onto the PTC Code-Mode preset; materialized files carry per-file sha256 markers, so user-edited presets are never overwritten on upgrade or uninstall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 Agent 预设：在 PTC 编码模式之上叠加自引用 Cordis 工具集（动态插件、运行时检视）与预设编写技能；物化文件带逐文件 sha256 标记，用户改过的预设升级与卸载时都不会被覆盖。

description.en: Linear tools for DeepSeek Harness: 26 model-facing tools over the Linear GraphQL API (issues, comments, relations, teams, states, labels, projects, cycles, users) plus a linear_graphql escape hatch. Requires a Linear personal API token.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Linear 工具：26 个基于 Linear GraphQL API 的模型工具（议题、评论、关联、团队、状态、标签、项目、周期、用户），外加 linear_graphql 逃生口。需自备 Linear 个人 API token。

description.en: Douyin assistant plugin: picks a daily round of videos, reads comments, writes a dated report, can like and comment with an @ mention (both off by default), and publishes clips rendered by your own ComfyUI. Windows only; needs Python 3 and a system Chrome, and the first run needs the install-main-dependencies step plus a QR-code login.
description.zh: 抖音助手插件：每天刷一轮视频、读评论、写带日期的日报，可点赞、评论并 @ 你（默认均关闭），还能发布你自己 ComfyUI 出的片子。仅限 Windows；需 Python 3 与系统 Chrome，首次使用要先点「装主依赖」并扫码登录。

description.en: QQ Zone poster for DeepSeek Harness: scan a QQ login once, then let the model publish posts with mood-matched sticker images, with a daily cap and a silent headless Chrome session.
description.zh: QQ 空间发说说插件：手机 QQ 扫一次码登录，之后由模型按心情挑表情包发说说，支持每天条数上限，静默 Chrome 不占屏。

description.en: Resident Rust sidecar for Windows that folds shell-heavy tool calls into one warm worker: 11 tools (10 rust_* tools plus a native_help entry point; 5 resident, 6 activated on demand) for command execution, sha256-guarded file reads and writes, code indexing and search, session-log projection and resource sampling, served by a lane pool with soft RSS and CPU limits over 8 HTTP routes.
description.zh: Windows 上的常驻 Rust 伴生进程，把散落的 shell 调用收进一个暖 worker：11 个工具（10 个 rust_* 工具外加 native_help 入口；5 个常驻、6 个按需激活）覆盖命令执行、带 sha256 校验的文件读写、代码索引与搜索、会话日志投影与资源采样，由带通道池和 RSS/CPU 软限额的 worker 提供，并暴露 8 条 HTTP 路由。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-zai

description.en: Web search for DeepSeek Harness through Z.ai or Zhipu, with Coding Plan MCP quota and REST API billing modes, a native bilingual settings card, and support for reusing an existing ZAI_API_KEY.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Z.ai / 智谱网页搜索插件，支持 Coding Plan MCP 套餐额度和 REST API 余额两种计费模式，提供原生中英文设置卡片，可复用现有 ZAI_API_KEY。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A-share and US stock trading toolkit for DSH agents: realtime quotes, OHLCV klines, ADX three-state regime signals and simple backtest previews via EastMoney. Read-only, never places orders.
description.zh: DSH agent 的 A股/美股交易工具箱：实时行情、OHLCV K线、ADX 三状态市场分类信号与简易回测预览，数据源东方财富。只读设计，永不下单。

description.en: Agent tools for a local Gopeed downloader: create, inspect, pause, resume and remove downloads, diagnose or launch the Gopeed process, and receive download-complete events through a DSH background job that wakes an idle agent. Process diagnostics and launching are Windows-only; the download tools work wherever Gopeed runs.
description.zh: 把本机 Gopeed 下载器接进 DSH 的 agent 工具：新建、查看、暂停、继续、删除下载任务，诊断或启动 Gopeed 进程，并通过 DSH 后台任务接收下载完成事件（空闲的 agent 会被唤醒）。进程诊断与启动仅支持 Windows，下载相关工具跨平台可用。

description.en: Insurance actuary — runs real actuarial calculations (life & P&C reserve valuation under C-ROSS II BEL+RM, profit testing NBV/VNB/IRR, embedded value EV, pricing & loss-triangle reserving), not just explanations.
description.zh: 保险精算师（insurance-actuary）——真跑精算测算：寿险/财险准备金评估（偿二代二期 BEL+RM）、利润测试（NBV/VNB/IRR）、内含价值(EV)、产品定价与损失三角准备金，而非仅讲解。

description.en: Insurance company financial & operating analyst — solvency, financials, investment, distribution channels and peer comparison with real calculations.
description.zh: 保险公司财务经营分析专家，真跑偿付能力、财务报表、投资、渠道与同业对标测算。

description.en: Insurance company operations analyst — runs real solvency, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance calculations, not just text explanations.
description.zh: 保险公司经营分析专家（盈安），真跑偿付能力、盈利能力、内含价值(EV)、投资风险与监管合规五维测算。

description.en: Insurance product comparison & proposal expert — clause analysis, cost-effectiveness, coverage planning, generates verifiable client-facing PDF proposals.
description.zh: 保险产品对比与建议书专家（险析君），条款拆解、性价比测算、保障规划，生成可自核 PDF 建议书。

description.en: HarmonyOS device workbench for DSH NEXT Desktop on Windows x64 (tested with DSH NEXT 2.0.21-next and Better Sidebar 0.28.2); the floating mirror reuses DSH's Electron or downloads one (~140 MB) on first use.
description.zh: 面向 Windows x64 上的 DSH NEXT 桌面版（在 DSH NEXT 2.0.21-next + Better Sidebar 0.28.2 上验证）的鸿蒙设备工作台；悬浮投屏复用 DSH 的 Electron，没有时首次打开会下载约 140 MB 的 Electron。

description.en: Zhihu (知乎) dashboard: hot list with trend arrows, follow feed (favorites/creations/followees), post tracking (question/keyword/person) with auto-briefs, and five agent tools (zhihu_search/hot/answer/global_search/followees).
description.zh: 知乎面板：热榜（带趋势标记）、关注动态（收藏/创作/关注的人）、帖子追踪（问题/关键词/关注的人，支持自动创意简报），并提供 5 个对话工具（zhihu_search / hot / answer / global_search / followees）。

plugins.name: dsh-fengniao-company-search

description.en: Look up Chinese companies inside the conversation: name a company and get its business registration, shareholders, executives, outbound investments and registration changes, plus judicial and operating-risk records such as enforcement, dishonest judgment debtor, consumption restriction, abnormal operation, serious illegality and administrative penalties (11 dimension groups). Results render as conversation cards with fields and the raw payload on expand, and the API key is saved from the plugin page into the Harness credential store.
description.zh: 在对话里直接查中国企业：说出公司名就能拿到工商基本信息、股东、高管、对外投资、工商变更，以及被执行、失信、限制高消费、经营异常、严重违法、行政处罚等司法与经营风险（共 11 类维度）；结果以对话卡片呈现，展开可看字段与原始数据，API Key 在插件页保存到 Harness 凭据库。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Whole-disk file search on Windows: ask for files or folders by name, path, extension, size or modified date and get matches from the local voidtools Everything index in milliseconds, with full paths, sizes and modified times. A second card reports whether Everything is reachable and how many items it indexes. Ships the official Everything SDK, so no es.exe or HTTP server is needed; Everything 1.4+ must be installed and running (the plugin can start it).
description.zh: Windows 全盘文件搜索：按文件名、路径、扩展名、大小或修改时间检索，毫秒级从本机 voidtools Everything 索引返回匹配的文件与文件夹（完整路径、大小、修改时间）；另一张卡片显示 Everything 是否可达与索引条目数。内置官方 Everything SDK，不需要 es.exe 或 HTTP 服务；需安装并运行 Everything 1.4 以上（插件可自动拉起）。

description.en: Adds a line-based copy tool for replacing or inserting file sections, with indentation control and diff previews.
description.zh: 提供按行复制工具，可替换或插入文件片段，并支持缩进控制和 diff 预览。

description.en: Genspark tools for DeepSeek Harness - web search, crawl, image/video/audio generation, media analysis, X/Instagram/Reddit search and model listing through @genspark/cli, with 17 typed tools and 18 /genspark-* commands. Requires @genspark/cli installed and logged in (gsk login), or GSK_API_KEY set.
description.zh: 将 Genspark 能力接入 DeepSeek Harness：网页搜索、抓取、图片/视频/音频生成、媒体理解、X/Instagram/Reddit 搜索与模型列表，提供 17 个工具和 18 个 /genspark-* 命令。需安装并登录 @genspark/cli（gsk login），或设置 GSK_API_KEY。

description.en: Answers the built-in web_search from a self-hosted RustXNG metasearch instance, downloading and starting that binary on demand and stopping it after an idle timeout; an optional fetch provider also decodes pages whose charset is declared only in <meta>.
description.zh: 用自托管的 RustXNG 元搜索引擎接管内置 web_search，按需下载并启动该二进制、空闲超时后停止；可选的抓取层还能解码仅在 <meta> 中声明编码的页面。

description.en: User-defined agents with automatic routing, model failover, and squad orchestration: six model tools (agent_dispatch / agent_followup / agent_list / agent_squad / agent_import_skill / agent_upsert), no built-in agents, a native right-tab panel (Overview / Agents / Squads / History), and a floating action ball.
description.zh: 自定义 Agent + 自动路由 + 小队编排：六个模型工具（agent_dispatch / agent_followup / agent_list / agent_squad / agent_import_skill / agent_upsert），无内置 Agent，原生右 tab 主面板（总览 / Agent / 小队 / 历史）与悬浮活动球。

description.en: Pi-compatible tool suite recreated inside DeepSeek Harness: installs lower-case read/write/edit/bash/find/grep/ls core tools while retaining DSH-backed web, task, plan, todo, think, and slash extensions.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中复刻 Pi 工具组：安装小写 read/write/edit/bash/find/grep/ls 核心工具，并保留 DSH-backed 网页、任务、计划、todo、think 与 slash 扩展。

description.en: Model-driven tool-result archiving for DeepSeek Harness. Results above a configurable size carry a short inline id (\[#a1b2c3d4]); the model archives the ones it no longer needs into the session's own archives/ folder and the context keeps a small recoverable stub with the file path. Originals stay in the append-only session log, so nothing is lost. Ships a settings panel with per-size-bucket recovery stats, thresholds that apply without restart, and a conditional reminder when results are waiting to be archived. Requires dsh-better-sidebar for the statistics panel.
description.zh: 模型驱动的工具结果归档插件。超过阈值的结果会带一个短内联编号（\[#a1b2c3d4]），模型把不再需要的 结果归档进会话自己的 archives/ 目录，上下文里只留一个可回捞的小存根（含文件路径）。原文同时保留在 只增的会话日志中，不会丢失。附带设置面板：按大小分桶的回收统计、改完立即生效的阈值、以及有待归档 结果时的条件提醒。统计面板需 dsh-better-sidebar。

plugins.name: dsh-figma-plugin

description.en: Figma design context for the agent: reads a frame's node tree, auto-layout, paints and typography, resolves the variables it is bound to, and renders a screenshot to compare code against — plus four bundled design-to-code skills. Connect with one button against Figma's own consent page; the plugin ships its own OAuth app, refreshes tokens automatically, and never asks for or displays a token.
description.zh: 给 agent 用的 Figma 设计上下文：读取画板的节点树、自动布局、填充与字体，解析节点绑定的设计变量，并渲染截图用于对照代码 —— 另附四个设计转代码技能。点一个按钮即跳转 Figma 官方授权页完成连接；插件自带 OAuth 应用、自动续期令牌，全程不索取也不展示任何 Token。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: macOS cross-application desktop tools for DSH using CuaDriver, with a hidden agent cursor, background window selection and post-action observations.
description.zh: 基于 CuaDriver 的 macOS 跨应用桌面工具，默认隐藏虚拟光标，支持后台窗口选择和操作后界面回读。

description.en: Mounts the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server through two gateway tools instead of registering its 200+ tool schemas on every request: rea_list searches the catalog or returns one tool's input schema, and rea_call invokes that tool, each call spawning a short-lived rea mcp process, so the tool definitions sent per step drop from about 780 KB (207 tools as measured in REA 6.5.0) to about 1-2 KB. When no rea entry point is found it installs rea-agents into a plugin-private directory with the pnpm bundled in DSH (dependency build scripts skipped) and links the reverse-engineer-anything and rea-gateway skills into the skills directory without overwriting existing ones.
description.zh: 把 REA（逆向一切）的 MCP 服务收成两个网关工具，而不是每次请求都注册它的 200 多个工具 schema：rea_list 按名字/描述搜索工具目录、或取单个工具的完整 input schema，rea_call 按原始工具名调用，每次调用启动一个短命 rea mcp 子进程，每步请求的工具定义由约 780 KB（REA 6.5.0 实测 207 个工具）降到约 1-2 KB。找不到 rea 入口时，用 DSH 自带的 pnpm 把 rea-agents 装进插件私有目录（跳过依赖构建脚本），并把 reverse-engineer-anything 与 rea-gateway 两个技能链接进技能目录，已存在的同名技能不会被覆盖。

description.en: Region screenshot for DSH without a hotkey (Windows only; capture runs through PowerShell + GDI). Hold the left mouse button for 550 ms, the page dims into a crosshair, drag a box, release: the crop is saved to ~/.dsh/longpress-shots and copied to the clipboard, and a preview card can send the same bytes into the composer (button, Ctrl+V, or drag) instead of hunting for a file dialog.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加区域截图，不用记快捷键（仅 Windows；截图走 PowerShell + GDI）。按住左键 550 毫秒，页面变暗进入十字框选，拖出范围松手即得 PNG，落到 ~/.dsh/longpress-shots 并同时写进剪贴板；预览卡可以把同一份字节直接送进输入框（按钮 / Ctrl+V / 拖拽三条路），不用再翻文件对话框。

description.en: Search-first capability workflow for DSH agents (v1.0.0): reuse local tools or review exact-source plugins before installation, adapt or create capabilities in managed source work, and use receipts that distinguish installed, loaded, activated, and verified states; version tools cover rollback, adoption, and upstream updates.
description.zh: AutoEvo v1.0.0 为 DSH Agent 提供 Search-first 能力工作流：优先复用本地工具或审查精确来源插件后再安装；可在受管源码中改造或新建能力；回执区分 installed、loaded、activated、verified，版本工具支持回滚、领养与上游更新。

description.en: Agent config packer for DeepSeek Harness: pack local agent assets (skills/sessions/profiles/settings/memory) into a zip for migration or sharing, with privacy scanning, diff-based restore, pack management, and a settings UI; memory ships as a read-only Markdown mirror, not the live database.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Agent 配置打包器：把本地 Agent 资产（Skills/会话/Profile/全局设置/记忆）打包成 zip，用于迁移或分享；带隐私安全扫描、差异恢复、包管理与设置 UI；记忆以只读 Markdown 镜像入包，不含运行时数据库。

description.en: Keeps heavy tool groups out of every request, and can scope tools per session or per role: the role key comes from the host's own session label, subagent marker or preset, so an orchestrator's child agents each see only their own group allow-list. Also auto-groups new tool families by name prefix, lets the agent classify ungrouped tools once, brings a hidden tool back when it is actually called, and exposes a health snapshot of what each session can really see.
description.zh: 把重工具组从每一轮请求里收起来，并且能按会话/按角色裁剪工具面：角色键来自宿主自己的会话 label、subagent 标记或 preset，编排器的子代理各看各的组白名单。另有按名前缀自动分组、让 AI 分一次没归组的工具、调用被收工具时自动放回，以及每个会话实际可见性的 health 快照。

description.en: Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent) server for dsh: expose this dsh as a callable agent over HTTP with JSON-RPC tasks.
description.zh: dsh 原生 A2A 服务：通过 HTTP JSON-RPC 将本 dsh 暴露为可调用的代理。

description.en: Security and governance for dsh: rule-based tool denial, full tool-call audit trail, and governance reports.
description.zh: dsh 安全治理：规则化工具拦截、完整工具调用审计轨迹与治理报告。

description.en: Token usage and cost metering for dsh: per-session and aggregate statistics with configurable pricing and reports.
description.zh: dsh 用量计量：会话级与汇总 token 统计、可配置计价与报告。

description.en: Progressive tool discovery through tool_list, tool_search and tool_load, exposing tool schemas on demand while preserving host execution permissions.
description.zh: 通过 tool_list、tool_search 和 tool_load 渐进式发现工具，按需披露工具 schema，保留宿主执行权限约束。

description.en: Scans 20+ AI agents on this machine (Codex, Claude Code, cc-switch, Hermes, opencode, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, CodeBuddy, Trae, OpenClaw, Qoder, WorkBuddy, Zcode, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, Qwen Code, ...) and one-click syncs, manages and adds their MCP servers and skills into DSH — global or per-workspace.
description.zh: 扫描本机 20+ 种 AI agent 的 MCP 服务器与 Skills（Codex、Claude Code、cc-switch、Hermes、opencode、Gemini、Grok、Kimi、CodeBuddy、Trae、OpenClaw、Qoder、WorkBuddy、Zcode、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline、Roo Code、Qwen Code 等），一键同步、管理并添加进 DSH（全局或按工作区）。

description.en: Team shared knowledge base: one member runs a zero-dependency Hub, everyone else installs this plugin and joins with one invite code. Uploads are filed into ten categories with a summary, confidence and points; 15 agent tools let members upload, search, recall, comment and read them. Important items are pinned with a hand-written recommendation until the member has read them, and each account also gets a private local library, collections, a weekly digest and version diffs.
description.zh: 团队共享知识库：一个人在自己电脑跑零依赖 Hub，其他人装插件后粘一个邀请码即可加入。上传素材按十类归档，带摘要、置信度与要点；15 个 agent 工具支持上传、检索、聚合回顾、评论与阅读。标为重要的资料必须手写推荐语，并置顶到每位成员读过为止；每个账号还各有本地私有库、收藏夹、每周简报与版本对比。

description.en: Android GUI Agent with ADB screenshots, compact UI hierarchy grounding, verified iterative actions, approvals, and a Mobile Web view.
description.zh: Android GUI Agent：ADB 截图、压缩 UI hierarchy 定位、逐步动作验证、审批和 Mobile Web 视图。

description.en: Translate text-based PDFs via DeepSeek or OpenAI-compatible APIs while preserving layout, fonts, images and links, with editable output.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 或兼容 API 翻译文本型 PDF，保留版式、字体、图片与链接，输出可编辑 PDF。

description.en: Turns declared health readings — source, criterion, verdict — into one read-only verdict; an unreadable source is reported as `unknown`, never as healthy.
description.zh: 把声明式的健康读数（来源、判据、结论）合成为一个只读的总判定；读不到的来源报 `unknown`，绝不报成健康。

description.en: Adds selection annotations, in-place translation, sidebar subagent questions and default-browser link opening to DSH. The selected text rides along with your next message, the source keeps its highlight and ordinal mark for jumping back, the menu opens on selection or from the right-click menu, and the translation model can be picked separately.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加划词批注、引用、划词翻译、侧边子代理提问，链接用默认浏览器打开。选中的原文连同评论随下一条消息交给模型，正文保留高亮与序号角标、可跳回原文；菜单可划词浮出或从右键打开，翻译可单独指定模型。

description.en: Views and builds CAD models (STL, OBJ, STEP, IGES, DXF, SVG) via cad_view/cad_info and OCCT parametric modeling tools, with an interactive viewer card and a resident CAD panel in the Web UI.
description.zh: 通过 cad_view/cad_info 与 OCCT 参数化建模工具查看和构建 CAD 模型（STL、OBJ、STEP、IGES、DXF、SVG），并在 Web UI 中提供交互式查看卡片与常驻 CAD 面板。

description.en: Union workspaces: merge multiple directories into one session, manage unions from a settings panel, and read/write member files via uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move tools.
description.zh: 联合工作区：将多个目录合并到一个会话中，通过设置面板管理联合工作区，使用 uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move 工具读写成员目录文件。

description.en: Lazy-loading router for MCP servers: auto-discovers compatible MCPs and keeps only a shared router in the tool catalog, revealing a server's schemas when a turn needs them and hiding them again at turn end, so many installed MCPs stop costing context on every request. Falls open to normal visibility on any uncertainty, and the original MCP keeps ownership of execution, permissions and process lifecycle. Also supports explicit lazy connections with warm reuse, bounded reconnection, stdio and Streamable HTTP.
description.zh: MCP 懒加载路由：自动发现可接管的 MCP，冷态只在工具目录里留一个共享路由，某轮需要哪个服务器才展开它的工具 Schema、轮次结束再收起，让装了很多 MCP 不再每次请求都吃上下文。命名异常、重名或状态不确定的 MCP 不接管；出现任何不确定即恢复原工具可见性，执行、权限与进程生命周期仍归原 MCP。也支持显式的连接层懒加载，含连接保温、有限重连、stdio 与 Streamable HTTP。

description.en: Bounded, privacy-safe local scanner for Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, and CodeBuddy metadata: atomically aggregates keyed evidence and deterministically advises built-in DSH presets and optional capabilities—without content retention, network access, or preset mutation.
description.zh: 有界、隐私安全的本地扫描器：汇总 Codex、Claude Code、WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 元数据，原子保存密钥化聚合证据，并确定性推荐 DSH 内置 preset 与可选能力；不保留正文、不联网、不修改 preset。

description.en: Cone crusher selection and crushing-plant design for MACKORN NH/NS single-cylinder hydraulic cone crushers: requirement-form intake, equipment selection, plant configuration, proposal generation, product-size simulation and field-data calibration. 21 tools, 6 skills, an MCP server, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: MACKORN NH/NS 单缸液压圆锥破碎机的选型与破碎筛分生产线设计：需求表录入、设备选型、整线配置、方案书生成、产品粒度仿真与实测标定。21 个工具、6 个技能、一个 MCP 服务器，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Multi-threaded downloader plugin for DeepSeek Harness with bundled aria2: probes the target for Range support, then picks aria2 (4 or 8 connections by file size) or falls back to curl.
description.zh: DSH 多线程下载插件，内置 aria2：先探测目标是否支持 Range，再按文件大小选择 aria2（4 或 8 连接）或回退 curl 单线程下载。

description.en: Local code intelligence for DSH: Impact X-Ray visualizes potential change impact with inspectable source evidence and uncertainty; also provides symbol navigation, bounded Context Packs and ArkTS support.
description.zh: DSH 本地代码智能插件：Impact X-Ray 可视化展示潜在变更影响、源码证据与不确定性，并提供符号导航、有界 Context Pack 和 ArkTS 支持。

description.en: Real-time LSP diagnostics loop: lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover tools over headless stdio language servers (TypeScript/JavaScript + Python), plus an auto-injected post-edit diagnostics delta wired to the harness fs/observed event — Cursor-style edit → diagnostics → fix for dsh agents.
description.zh: 实时 LSP 诊断闭环：通过无头 stdio 语言服务器（TypeScript/JavaScript + Python）提供 lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover 工具，并订阅 harness 的 fs/observed 事件自动注入「本次编辑引入的诊断增量」——为 dsh Agent 带来 Cursor 式的编辑→诊断→修复体验。

description.en: Dual-model auto-routing plugin: low-cost direct / high-cost upgrade with an escape-learning closed loop (wrong direct answers auto-learn fingerprints, force-upgrading the same fingerprint next time), persisted and interoperable with the Python ModelRouter.
description.zh: 双模型 Auto 路由插件：低成本模型直返 / 高成本模型升级 + 逃逸学习闭环（直返答错自动学习指纹，同指纹下次强制升级），状态持久化并与 Python ModelRouter 互通。

plugins.name: dsh-proxy-router

description.en: Imports a proxy subscription, supervises a local mihomo core (proxy-provider plus a url-test group), and fetches direct-first with automatic proxy fallback and per-host routing memory; exposes one proxy_router tool (status, start, stop, test, fetch, routes, forget).
description.zh: 导入代理订阅并监督本地 mihomo 内核（proxy-provider + url-test 组），取回时直连优先、失败自动切代理并按主机记忆路由；对外只有一个 proxy_router 工具（status/start/stop/test/fetch/routes/forget）。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to cp.cloudflare.com

description.en: Hermes-style tool search & slimming: progressive disclosure, semantic search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand while core tools stay eager.
description.zh: Hermes 风格工具搜索与瘦身：渐进式披露，语义搜索/查看/调用长尾工具，核心工具保持直通。

description.en: Publishes and reads QQ Zone posts through SnowLuma's OneBot qzone_* actions (SnowLuma 2.2+ signed in to QQ), and lets the agent understand images with a local vision model (OpenAI-compatible gateway) or Windows OCR.
description.zh: 通过 SnowLuma 的 OneBot qzone_* 动作发/看/删/赞/评论 QQ 空间说说（需 SnowLuma 2.2+ 且已登录 QQ），并让机器人用本地视觉模型（OpenAI 兼容网关）或 Windows OCR 看懂图片。

description.en: Windows desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: update checker, server start/stop, system tray, graphical console, and one-click installer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面伴侣：更新检查、服务器启停、系统托盘、图形控制台与一键安装。

description.en: Per-workspace activation control: a dialog opened from the workspace row menu switches individual plugins, MCP servers, and skills on or off, and the host applies the choice in that workspace's own agent scope — a disabled skill leaves the model catalog, an MCP server has its mcp__<server>__ tools denied, and a plugin has the tool names its entry declares denied.
description.zh: 按工作区开关插件、MCP 服务器与 Skills：工作区行菜单里的弹窗写入选择，宿主机在该工作区自己的 Agent 作用域内应用——关闭的 Skill 从模型目录中消失，MCP 服务器被拒绝其 mcp__<server>__ 工具，插件被拒绝其条目声明的工具名。

description.en: A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.
description.zh: Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

description.en: Adds session, project, and global controls in the DSH WebUI for skills, MCP servers, tools, prompt injections, approval escalation, and safety guards; enforcement is scoped to the current agent.
description.zh: 在 DSH WebUI 中为技能、MCP 服务器、工具、提示词注入、审批升权和安全守卫提供会话、项目与全局三级控制，并在当前 agent 作用域内强制执行。

description.en: Add MiniMax image understanding, image generation, speech synthesis, and transcription tools to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 MiniMax 识图、文生图、语音合成和语音转写工具。

plugins.name: dsh-intent-recognition

description.en: Five-layer intent recognition pipeline (rules, pgvector retrieval, Jev scoring, fine-tuned arbitration, LLM fallback) with scenario management UI, PostgreSQL storage and distributable API services.
description.zh: 五层意图识别流水线（规则、pgvector 向量检索、Jev 概率精判、微调仲裁、LLM 兜底），带场景管理界面、PostgreSQL 存储与可分发 API 服务。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org
uses literal IP 1.3.101.110 for network access

description.en: Reads your past DSH conversations and surfaces recurring prompt gaps — missing paths or versions, an unstated output format, missing preconditions that break tool calls — each with a paste-ready rewrite. Adds a one-click rewrite next to the composer that applies those constraints to the draft in a shorter form.
description.zh: 读你的历史会话，找出反复踩的提问坑（缺路径与版本、没定输出格式、漏说前置条件导致工具失败），每条给一段可直接粘贴的改写；输入框右侧一键把草稿改成更短的带约束版本。

description.en: Views, creates and edits AGENTS.md and other AI rule files from the DSH settings page: the project directory chain from project root to cwd, both DSH global roots (~/.dsh and ~/.agents), and user-level rule files of 25 third-party AI tools. Markdown preview is rendered with .mdc frontmatter stripped, edits save in place with conflict detection, files whose content is identical across tools are flagged, and tools outside the built-in list are discovered heuristically. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页查看、创建与编辑 AGENTS.md 等 AI 规则文件：项目级跟随工作区从项目根到 cwd 的目录链，全局级覆盖 ~/.dsh 与 ~/.agents，另含 25 个第三方 AI 工具的用户级规则文件。预览以渲染态展示并自动剥离 .mdc 的 frontmatter，就地编辑并带冲突检测，内容完全相同的跨工具文件会互相标注，内置清单之外的工具按目录特征自动发现。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Native tools for an Obsidian wiki vault: wiki_query, wiki_write, wiki_rename, wiki_scaffold, wiki_archive, and wiki_lint cover BM25 search with link-graph context, bookkeeping writes with sha256 source tracking, vault-wide renames, mode scaffolds, source archiving, and health checks — with cross-process locks and optional git auto-commit.
description.zh: Obsidian wiki vault 原生工具：wiki_query、wiki_write、wiki_rename、wiki_scaffold、wiki_archive、wiki_lint 覆盖 BM25 链接图检索、带 sha256 源追踪的簿记式写入、全库改名、模式化脚手架、源归档与健康检查，并内置跨进程锁与可选 git 自动提交。

description.en: Injects live time, weather, location, battery, and device context into the DSH system prompt, with a bilingual settings page.
description.zh: 将实时的时间、天气、地点、电量和设备信息注入 DSH 系统提示，并提供双语设置页面。

description.en: Scores each assistant answer on five dimensions plus topic coverage, shows evidence, and turns the weakest dimension into copy-ready prompt advice. Observational only; local by default, with optional Jev review.
description.zh: 为每条回答给出五维质量分与话题覆盖度，附证据，并把最弱的一项转成可直接复制的提示词改写。只观测不改写；默认本地评分，可选 Jev 精评。

description.en: Cross-session artifact center: agent tools that register deliverable files (PDF, Excel, PPT, code, JSON) into one shared directory, plus a sidebar panel that filters them by category, extension or keyword.
description.zh: 跨会话产物中心：agent 产出重要文件时用工具登记（默认复制一份到统一目录），侧边栏面板按分类、后缀或关键词即时筛选。

description.en: Audits JLCEDA (EasyEDA) .enet netlists for broken net labels, dangling nets, power-rail orphans, conflicting pin polarity, and full-differential-amplifier feedback wiring.
description.zh: 校对嘉立创 EDA 导出的 .enet 网表，检查断链式网络标签、单脚悬空网络、电源轨孤立、引脚名与所连网络极性矛盾、全差分运放反馈接法。

description.en: Gowin (高云) 1.9 FPGA toolchain control for dsh: 15 tools covering environment and license probe, .gprj/.cst project and constraint auditing against a real GW1N board pinout, gw_sh batch synthesis and place-and-route, pnr resource and timing report parsing, programmer_cli JTAG scan and flash, arbitrary gw_sh Tcl, and the GAO on-line logic analyzer capture chain — plus a bundled gowin-fpga skill and three field-note references. Pure JS, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把高云 Gowin 1.9 FPGA 工具链交给 dsh：15 个工具覆盖环境与 License 探针、.gprj/.cst 工程与约束审计（对着真实 GW1N 板引脚表）、gw_sh 批量综合与布局布线、pnr 资源与时序报告解析、programmer_cli 扫描与烧录、任意 gw_sh Tcl 执行，以及 GAO 在线逻辑分析采集链路；另附内置 gowin-fpga 技能与三份实测手册。纯 JS，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Deterministic Reasoning Engine (DRE) for dsh: dre__* tools for knowledge verification (three-stage discrimination), deterministic cognition loops, constraint solving, mental models and synapse memory - strengthens information certainty.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供确定性推理引擎（DRE）：dre__* 工具覆盖知识验证（三段甄别）、确定性认知闭环、约束求解、心智模型与突触记忆，强化信息确定能力。

description.en: Knowledge base (Vault memory + knowledge graph) for dsh: kb__* tools for deterministic memory search/write, knowledge-graph nodes/edges/subgraph/traversal, document-to-graph ingestion and unified cross-store query (KAL) - no web-search tools.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供知识库（Vault 记忆 + 知识图谱）：kb__* 工具覆盖确定性记忆检索/写入、知识图谱节点/边/子图/遍历、文档入图谱与跨存储统一查询（KAL），不含联网检索工具。

plugins.name: dsh-ai4scholar

description.en: AI4Scholar academic search: 38 tools over Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, and DOI resolution (search, citation graph, authors, recommendations, PDF full text in slices, auto-cite, scientific figures), a unified cross-platform search with de-duplication, an API-key card in Settings, and per-call credit accounting with an `/ai4scholar` balance card.
description.zh: AI4Scholar 学术检索：覆盖 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv、bioRxiv/medRxiv 与 DOI 解析的 38 个工具（搜索、引用图谱、作者、推荐、PDF 全文分片、自动引用、科研绘图），跨平台去重统一搜索，设置页 API Key 卡片，按次积分统计与 `/ai4scholar` 余额卡。

description.en: Agnes AI image and video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Agnes AI 生图生视频插件。

description.en: Chemical safety intelligence through the hosted MSDS Chain MCP endpoint: 23 tools for compatibility and mixing order, GHS hazards, PPE, storage, waste disposal, exposure limits, transport classification, multi-region regulatory compliance, SDS lookup and version diffs, and signed audit reports, each answer citing the supplier SDS and revision date it is grounded in.
description.zh: 通过托管的 MSDS Chain MCP 端点接入化学品安全数据：23 个工具覆盖相容性与投料顺序、GHS 危害、PPE、储存、废弃处置、职业接触限值、运输分类、多法域合规、SDS 查询与版本比对、签名审计报告；每条回答都标注其依据的供应商 SDS 与版本日期。

plugins.name: fitmeet-dsh-plugin

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to FitMeet through per-user OAuth with 17 tools for people search, gatherings, notifications, personal items, connection feedback, Hall publishing, and direct messages, with preview-and-confirm guards for write actions.
description.zh: 通过每位用户独立的 OAuth 授权将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 FitMeet，提供找人、组局查询、提醒、个人事项、连接反馈、大厅发布与私聊的 17 个工具，写入操作保留预览与确认步骤。

description.en: AI dataset quality inspector for annotation consistency, class distribution bias and data leakage detection.
description.zh: AI数据集质量巡检工具，自动检测数据集中的标注一致性、类别分布偏差与数据泄露风险。

description.en: City data AI classification plugin — auto-recommends data classification based on GB/T 47949, supports structured/semi-structured/unstructured data.
description.zh: 城市数据AI分类插件 — 基于GB/T 47949自动推荐数据分类，支持结构化/半结构化/非结构化

description.en: Construction data asset inventory plugin — inventories BIM/IFC classification, asset encoding, outputs asset catalog.
description.zh: 建筑工程数据资产盘点插件 — 盘点BIM/IFC分类、资产编码，输出资产清单

description.en: Data asset attestation plugin that generates certification-level data quality reports with evidence chains.
description.zh: 数据资产认证报告插件 — 生成带证据链的认证级数据质量报告

description.en: Data asset compliance check plugin — checks source compliance, processing compliance, usage compliance.
description.zh: 数据资产合规检查插件 — 检查来源合规性、处理合规性、使用合规性

description.en: Data asset inventory scan plugin — deep metadata scan + triple-condition check, outputs asset catalog.
description.zh: 数据资产盘点扫描插件 — 深度元数据扫描 + 资产三条件初筛（权属线索标注），输出资产清单

description.en: Data asset orchestration engine that chains suite tools into preset pipelines (masking, cleaning, inventory, packaging, attestation, AI dataset health check, government inspection, circulation assessment), with incremental and scheduled processing.
description.zh: 数据资产编排引擎，把套件内工具串成预置流水线（脱敏→清洗→盘点→封装、鉴证、AI数据集体检、政务巡检、可流通性评估），支持增量与定时处理

description.en: Quantitative data quality scoring based on GB/T 36344-2018, providing auditable quality reports for data asset capitalization.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 36344-2018 国家标准，从规范性、完整性等六个维度对数据质量进行量化评分，为企业数据资产入表提供可审计的底稿。

description.en: Data asset registration helper: runs a disallowed-scenario and ownership-dispute pre-check, matches a registration agency by data type and region, and returns a registration checklist with the triple-audit standard and seven-step flow.
description.zh: 数据资产登记助手：做禁用场景与权属纠纷预检，按数据类型和地区匹配登记机构，并给出含三审标准与七步流程的登记清单。

description.en: Data asset valuation plugin with cost-based (replacement cost) and income-based valuation.
description.zh: 数据资产估值插件 — 成本法（重置成本）+收益法两轨估值

description.en: Data-circulation assessor: scores how readily a dataset can circulate, covering trusted-data-space access readiness and transaction-compliance pre-checks, with improvement recommendations.
description.zh: 数据流通评估插件：给数据集的可流通性打分，覆盖可信数据空间接入就绪度与交易合规预判，并给出改进建议。

description.en: Data cleaning plugin for deduplication, format standardization and anomaly detection.
description.zh: 数据清洗插件 — 去重+格式标准化+异常值检测

description.en: Data inventory plugin — directory scan + value assessment + classification annotation.
description.zh: 数据目录盘点插件 — 目录扫描+价值评估+分类标注

description.en: Data lineage tracking tool, mapping the full lifecycle of data to meet source legality requirements.
description.zh: 数据血缘追踪工具，梳理数据从产生到流转的全链路，满足数据产权登记中的来源合法性审查要求。

description.en: Automated data masking tool based on national standards, automatically identifying sensitive fields like ID cards and phone numbers.
description.zh: 基于国家标准的自动化数据脱敏工具，自动识别身份证、手机号等敏感字段，支持完全匿名化与假名化分级策略，生成合规审计日志。

description.en: Data packaging plugin for product manual generation and compliance attachments.
description.zh: 数据封装插件 — 产品说明书生成+合规附件

description.en: Data quality scoring plugin — multi-dimensional scoring (completeness/accuracy/consistency/timeliness).
description.zh: 数据质量打分插件 — 多维度评分（完整性/准确性/一致性/时效性）

description.en: Data sensitivity classification plugin that auto-identifies sensitive fields and classifies them into high/medium/low/public levels.
description.zh: 数据敏感度分类插件 — 自动识别敏感字段+分级（高/中/低/公开）

description.en: Data visualization plugin that generates self-contained HTML reports with five chart types (bar/comparison/pie/radar/flowchart) and two-column layout.
description.zh: 数据可视化插件 — 生成自包含HTML报告，支持五种图表(bar/comparison/pie/radar/flowchart)与两列布局

description.en: Financial AML compliance checker: detects large/suspicious transaction thresholds, exemptions and timeliness, outputs auditable AML compliance reports across banking, insurance and securities.
description.zh: 金融反洗钱合规检查插件，自动检测大额与可疑交易阈值、豁免规则与时效性，输出可审计的反洗钱合规报告，覆盖银行、保险、证券多业态。

description.en: Registration document generation plugin - generates the three registration materials: data description, source legality statement, and ownership explanation (three-rights separation).
description.zh: 登记文档生成插件 - 生成三份登记材料：数据描述、来源合法性声明与产权归属说明（三权分置）。

description.en: Geospatial data quality inspector: checks elevation accuracy, topology consistency and coordinate system compliance, outputs weighted quality scoring reports per GB/T 24356-2023.
description.zh: 地理空间数据质量检查插件，检测高程精度、拓扑一致性与坐标系统合规性，输出加权质量评分报告，满足GB/T 24356-2023国家标准。

description.en: Zhejiang provincial government data inspection config pack with runtime config loading and validation.
description.zh: 浙江省政务数据巡检配置包 — 含浙政办/浙委改等浙江省地方政策依据与标准词表，提供配置加载与校验运行时

description.en: Government data inspector covering completeness, accuracy and timeliness metrics.
description.zh: 政务数据巡检工具，覆盖数据完整率、准确率、时效率等核心指标。

description.en: Registration agency matching plugin — recommends data exchange/registration agency based on data type.
description.zh: 登记机构匹配插件 — 基于数据类型推荐数据交易所/登记机构

description.en: Registration precheck plugin — checks a data asset against the national data-property registration rules: national-security sensitivity, source legality, ownership disputes, and the material-authenticity commitment, then outputs a precheck report.
description.zh: 登记预检插件 — 按国家数据产权登记规则做四项检查（国家安全、来源合规、权属纠纷、材料真实性承诺），并输出《登记预检报告》。

description.en: Research data provenance auditor: audits lineage integrity, reproducibility and FAIR principles compliance, outputs provenance audit reports for research integrity and open science.
description.zh: 科研数据溯源审计插件，审计血缘完整性、可复现性与FAIR原则合规性，输出溯源审计报告，支撑科研诚信与开放科学。

description.en: Manage Postman cloud collections from dsh with 9 tools — list, browse, add one or many requests, edit and delete them, and export or overwrite a whole collection.
description.zh: 用 9 个工具在 dsh 里管理 Postman 云端集合——列出、浏览、新增（单个或批量）、修改、删除接口，导出或整体覆盖集合。

description.en: Generate and edit images, generate video, and cut video locally through a GenBox server, with a zero-key test bench.
description.zh: 通过本地 GenBox 服务生图、改图、生视频，并用 ffmpeg 本地剪辑；自带零成本测试台。

description.en: Adds parametric CAD modeling, geometry validation, previews, design history, and STEP/STL export to DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加参数化 CAD 建模、几何验证、预览、设计历史和 STEP/STL 导出能力。

description.en: Mounts the tsm-core-dlr semantic service (LanceDB vectors + graph) as MCP tools and ships the scenario-independent DLR/TSM modeling skill, a service-status overlay and the agent rules; the service is a hard dependency and must be running before the bundle activates.
description.zh: 把 tsm-core-dlr 语义服务（LanceDB 向量 + 图）挂为 MCP 工具，并携带与场景无关的 DLR/TSM 建模技能、服务状态浮层与 agent 规则；该服务是硬依赖，须先运行、bundle 才能激活。

description.en: Video editing toolset for DSH: probe, trim, concat, audio handling, subtitle burn-in, transform, transcode and frame grabbing, powered by ffmpeg downloaded on first use.
description.zh: DSH 视频剪辑工具集：探测、裁剪、拼接、音轨处理、字幕烧录、变速、转码与抽帧，引擎为首次使用时自动下载的 ffmpeg。

description.en: Semantic tool routing, skill discovery, and typed System One decisions for DeepSeek Harness powered by TypeSafe Jev.
description.zh: 基于 TypeSafe Jev 的 DeepSeek Harness 语义工具路由、技能发现与类型化 System One 决策插件。

plugins.name: DLT

description.en: Six independently togglable modules in one DSH plugin: per-turn CNY cost, DeepSeek account balance, PDF/Word/Excel/CSV read-write tools with right-sidebar preview, a compiler/runtime environment registry, and run/build tools that execute a program or an MSBuild project by environment id. Toolchain paths are resolved at run time (Visual Studio install-root scan, %ProgramFiles%, PATH) and can be overridden per environment through plugin config, so nothing is pinned to the author's machine.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件里的六个可独立开关的模块：每轮对话的人民币成本、DeepSeek 账户余额、PDF/Word/Excel/CSV 直接读写工具与右栏预览、编译/运行环境表，以及按环境名执行程序或编译 MSBuild 工程的 run/build 工具。工具链路径在运行时解析（扫描 Visual Studio 安装根、%ProgramFiles%、PATH），并可在插件配置里逐个环境覆盖，没有写死在作者机器上的路径。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Drive the NI Multisim 14.3 install on a Windows machine through nine msim_* tools: open and save .ms14 designs, read and edit component values and circuit parameters, run DC operating point, AC sweep, single-frequency AC and transient analyses, export schematics, BOM and netlists. A Win32 channel drives the visible window to run the Analyses dialog and capture Multisim's own schematic view and waveform plot; a SPICE command-file engine handles designs that expose no probes; an offline reader unpacks the .ms14 container without starting Multisim at all. Requires Windows, NI Multisim 14.3, and a 32-bit Python 3.11-3.13 with pywin32.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上把本机的 NI Multisim 14.3 变成可编程对象：九个 msim_* 工具可开关 .ms14 设计、读写元件值与电路参数、跑直流工作点/交流扫频/单频交流/瞬态分析、导出原理图与 BOM/网表；Win32 通道驱动可见窗口操作分析对话框并截取 Multisim 自己的电路视图与波形图；SPICE 命令文件引擎处理没有探针的设计；离线解析器完全不启动 Multisim 就能读出 .ms14 内容。需要 Windows、NI Multisim 14.3，以及装好 pywin32 的 32 位 Python 3.11-3.13。

description.en: Master Duel utility panel for DSH: card lookup with banlist filters and AI-assisted effect search, related cards, rarity badges, favorites, a deck builder with drag-and-drop and a collapsible favorites panel, engine-tested opening hands and hand_odds opening probabilities, deck-type rankings, and deck checking. Card images and text are fetched from third-party sources at runtime; the plugin bundles no card data and requires the separate master-duel-ai-advisor MCP server.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Master Duel 工具面板：带禁限筛选和 AI 智能查卡的查卡、相关卡片、稀有度徽章、收藏与构建拖放、可收放收藏栏、规则引擎先手实测与 hand_odds 起手概率、卡组类型排行、卡组检查。卡图与卡文在运行时从第三方来源获取，插件不打包卡牌数据；需要单独安装 master-duel-ai-advisor MCP。

description.en: Runs OpenCode as a DSH subagent over ACP and shows each task live in the right sidebar — its agent and model, tool calls, and the subagents OpenCode spawns itself; permission requests become DSH question cards with allow once, allow always or reject.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 把 OpenCode 作为 DSH 子智能体运行，并在右侧边栏实时展示它的 agent 与模型、工具调用和它自己派生的子 agent；权限请求会变成 DSH 问题卡片，可选允许一次、始终允许或拒绝。

description.en: Personal toolbox for the dsh web profile with per-feature toggles: task-done desktop notifications, one-click restart, session deletion, plugin enable/disable, update checks, and UI utilities.
description.zh: 面向 dsh web profile 的个人工具箱，各功能可单独开关：任务完成桌面通知、一键重启、会话删除、插件启停、更新检查，以及若干界面小工具。

description.zh: 用 Tree-sitter 建立工作区符号索引，提供词法或可选 embedding 辅助的代码检索。

description.zh: 9router 网页搜索与网页抓取 provider，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索和抓取能力。

description.en: China hard-tech supply chain intelligence: 33-signal board, H1 earnings tracker, hit-rate track record and Q&A, via a remote MCP (mcp__cn_intel__*).
description.zh: 中国硬科技供应链情报：33 条信号看板、中报验证追踪、命中率记录与问答，通过远程 MCP 接入（mcp__cn_intel__*）。

description.en: Correct-encoding command runner and mojibake recovery: encoding_run spawns a child process and decodes its raw output bytes (UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK auto-detected or forced), and encoding_decode recovers garbled text back to correct Unicode.
description.zh: 编码正确的命令执行与乱码还原：encoding_run 自动识别 UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK 并正确解码子进程输出，encoding_decode 把乱码文本还原为正确 Unicode。

description.en: Reads .mcp.json from the .dsh home and from the agent workspace, mounts every mcpServers entry into DSH, and adds an MCP tab in the Web UI for listing, adding and unloading servers.
description.zh: 读取 .dsh 根目录与 agent 工作区里的 .mcp.json，把其中的 MCP server 挂载进 DSH；Web 界面增加「MCP」标签页，可查看、添加与卸载服务。

description.en: Codebase Memory MCP bridge for DeepSeek Harness: six knowledge-graph code tools, auto-started background daemon with visualization Web UI, and bundled agent skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Codebase Memory MCP 桥接插件：提供六个原生代码知识图谱工具、自动启动后台守护进程及可视化 Web 界面，并内置专属代理技能。

description.en: Mirrors a USB-connected Android phone in the DSH sidebar and drives it over scrcpy's control protocol: 12 agent tools for tap/swipe/type/keys, multi-frame scroll-and-stitch long screenshots, and agent-first control that hands over the moment a human touches the phone. Ships its own adb and scrcpy-server. Windows 10/11 only; the live sidebar mirror additionally requires dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏实时显示 USB 连接的安卓手机，并通过 scrcpy 控制协议直接操作手机：12 个 agent 工具（点按/滑动/输入/按键）、多帧滚动拼接的长截图，以及「默认交给 agent、人一碰手机就立刻交出控制权」的控制权模型。自带 adb 与 scrcpy-server。仅 Windows 10/11；侧栏实时镜像还需 dsh-better-sidebar。

plugins.name: dsh-molbio-tools

description.en: A bundle of molbio tools for molecular biology work:sequence analysis, primer and probe design (qPCR, TaqMan), in-silico PCR,cloning simulation,plasmid maps,sequencing validation,protein and CRISPR analysis,qPCR statistics,literature and lab records;installed as a preset-scoped bundle.
description.zh: 一组molbio分子生物学工具，包含序列分析、引物和探针设计、电子 PCR、克隆模拟、质粒图谱，测序验证，蛋白与CRISPR分析，qPCR统计，文献与实验记录；随 bundle 以预设模式安装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Monitors Windows console windows and hides or closes empty ones — consoles whose interpreter process has no business child process left besides conhost or openconsole and stays idle at about zero CPU. Recognizes both classic console windows and Windows Terminal CASCADIA tabs that only host a bare cmd, powershell, pwsh or python prompt. Hard-protects Fluent, MPI and solver processes, the DSH host, Explorer and the foreground window, so running solvers are never touched. Also provides a taskbar window cleanup action named close other windows, plus a persistent exemption whitelist of process names and title keywords stored in ~/.dsh/console-sentinel/whitelist.json. A settings panel under Settings then Console Sentinel shows live window status, one click hide of empty consoles, a taskbar cleanup preview and run button, and whitelist editing. Windows only.
description.zh: 监控 Windows 控制台窗口，自动隐藏或关闭「空壳」控制台——解释器进程除 conhost / openconsole 外没有任何业务子进程、且长期 CPU 接近 0 的窗口。同时识别传统控制台与 Windows Terminal（CASCADIA）中只挂着裸 cmd / powershell / pwsh / python 提示符的标签页。对 Fluent、MPI、求解器进程、DSH 宿主、资源管理器与前台窗口做硬保护，绝不误伤正在计算的控制台。另提供「一键关闭其他窗口」的任务栏清理动作，以及持久化豁免白名单（进程名 + 标题关键字，落盘 ~/.dsh/console-sentinel/whitelist.json）。设置页「控制台哨兵」可查看实时窗口状态、一键隐藏空壳、预演并执行任务栏清理、编辑白名单。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Fetch academic papers by DOI or keyword: Crossref and OpenAlex search, batch PDF download through eight Sci-Hub mirrors with an Unpaywall open-access fallback, PDF magic-byte validation, bounded concurrency, and a clickable batch-access HTML manifest for papers that could not be downloaded.
description.zh: 按 DOI 或关键词获取学术文献：Crossref 与 OpenAlex 检索，经 8 个 Sci-Hub 镜像批量下载 PDF 并以 Unpaywall 开放获取兜底，含 PDF 魔数校验与并发控制，并为未下载到的文献生成可点击的批量获取清单 HTML。

description.en: Lab/project progress management for DeepSeek Harness: 16 progress_* agent tools (item CRUD, day-board pages, daily records, global search, overview, gantt, comments, import/export) plus a 「进度」sidebar tab in better-sidebar hosting the original web UI; data lives in the session project's .progress/progress.json.
description.zh: 「进度」实验/项目进度管理：16 个 progress_* agent 工具（安排增删改查、画板页、每日记录、全局搜索、概览、甘特、留言、导入导出），并在 better-sidebar 注册「进度」侧边栏 tab 托管原版界面；数据存会话项目 .progress/progress.json，随项目目录走。

description.en: Read-only Windows device information tools: one agent tool per Win32 device category (time, system, cpu, memory, disk, gpu, network, battery, processes, usb, audio, printers) via WMI/CIM and Node os collectors.
description.zh: 只读的 Windows 设备信息工具：每个 Win32 设备类别一个 agent 工具（时间、系统、CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU、网络、电池、进程、USB、音频、打印机），基于 WMI/CIM 与 Node os 采集。

description.en: Low-token web search that returns only {title, url, snippet} per hit — vendor extras such as answer, score and raw_content never enter the context. Five interchangeable backends (Tavily, Brave, SearXNG, Google CSE, Exa) with automatic failover to the next usable one in fallback / chain order when the primary fails, deduplicating repeated providers. Returned URLs and snippets are sanitized of tracking parameters.
description.zh: 低 Token 联网搜索：只把结果裁成 {title, url, snippet} 三个字段返回，厂商附带的 answer / score / raw_content 等一律不进上下文。后端可在 Tavily、Brave、SearXNG、Google CSE、Exa 五种之间配置，主后端失败时按 fallback / chain 顺序自动切换到下一个可用后端（同一后端去重）。返回的 URL 与摘要经清洗，除去跟踪参数。

description.en: Windows Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness with screenshots, UI Automation, 18 desktop tools, per-Agent activation, human-input handoff, approval prompts and prebuilt native workers.
description.zh: Windows 桌面操控：让 DeepSeek 看屏幕、点鼠标、敲键盘。提供截图、UIA 定位、18 个桌面工具、按 Agent 激活、人机共用和操作审批，原生组件随包提供。

description.en: One-click Figma MCP connector for DSH (DeepSeek Harness).
description.zh: DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件。

description.en: Local file upload: paperclip button and drag-and-drop, per-session storage under .dsh-uploads, and a read_document tool that pages text and OCRs images.
description.zh: 本地文件上传：回形针按钮与拖拽上传、按会话隔离存储到 .dsh-uploads，并提供 read_document 工具分页读文本、对图片 OCR。

description.en: After an agent's own bash or shell command, re-observes the files that session had observed, so FS_STALE_VERSION no longer fires on self-inflicted writes but still fires on writes by others.
description.zh: 在 agent 自己的 bash/shell 命令结束后，重新观察该会话此前观察过的文件：自己改文件不再触发 FS_STALE_VERSION，但其他人写入仍会触发。

description.en: Mail for DSH: IMAP, POP3, SMTP and OAuth2 accounts with a reading tab, API senders, scheduled and CSV bulk sends with unsubscribe handling, and mail_* agent tools. The Mail tab appears inside dsh-better-sidebar; the agent tools work without it.
description.zh: DSH 的邮件客户端：接入 IMAP、POP3、SMTP 与 OAuth2 账号，提供侧栏阅读标签页、API 发信、定时与 CSV 批量发信（含退订处理），以及 mail_* agent 工具。阅读标签页需配合 dsh-better-sidebar，未装时 agent 工具仍可用。

description.en: A Phone tab in dsh-better-sidebar: SMS and calls over Twilio and SIP lines bridged through Asterisk, call audio through your server, Live, Voicemail and Do not disturb modes with live voicemail transcripts, a Telegram account with chats, voice messages and calls, and phone_* and telegram_* agent tools. Requires dsh-better-sidebar, Node 22.5+, a Twilio account with a voice and SMS number, a public HTTPS host for provider webhooks, and the bundled Go daemons built from a checkout (Telegram also needs your own api_id/api_hash).
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 里的 Phone 标签页：通过 Twilio 与经 Asterisk 桥接的 SIP 线路收发短信和通话，通话音频走你的服务器，提供 Live、Voicemail、勿扰模式与实时语音信箱转写，并可挂一个 Telegram 账号（聊天、语音消息、通话），以及 phone_* / telegram_* agent 工具。需要 dsh-better-sidebar、Node 22.5+、带语音与短信号码的 Twilio 账号、可供服务商 webhook 访问的公网 HTTPS 地址，以及从 checkout 构建的 Go daemon（Telegram 还需自备 api_id/api_hash）。

description.en: Notify-only update checker for the plugins in a DSH profile: classifies each dependency by its specifier and offers only releases the running DSH core can load, in a plugin_updates tool and an Updates sidebar tab (the tab needs dsh-better-sidebar; the tool and settings work without it).
description.zh: 面向 DSH profile 内插件的只提醒更新检查器：按依赖写法（specifier）分类，只列出当前 DSH 内核能加载的版本；提供 plugin_updates 工具和 Updates 侧栏页（侧栏页需装 dsh-better-sidebar，不装时工具与设置仍可用）。

description.en: Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom address with one persistent toggle, an editable settings card, and agent-visible proxy status.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全局代理插件：通过 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址统一代理模型请求与工具流量，主界面常驻开关，且 Agent 在对话中实时感知代理状态。

plugins.name: sanmu-skills

description.en: Research Agent skills, literature search with citation tracking, document-to-markdown knowledge base builder, and in-depth reading with browser workbench for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 三木科研 Agent Skills 合集：多源学术检索与原位引文追溯、LaTeX/KaTeX 高精度文档解析转 Obsidian 知识库、证据链精读与完整科研工作台。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to arxiv.org

description.en: Registers the minas-webdav MCP server as one stdio row, giving the agent 14 tools for a Xiaomi Smart Storage (MINAS) NAS without mounting it: list, stat, tree, find, du, df, cat, upload, download, mkdir, move, copy, delete and a capability probe. The Python package behind it is installed separately with pipx.
description.zh: 把 minas-webdav MCP server 注册成一行 stdio 配置，给 agent 14 个工具，不挂盘直接操作小米智能存储（MINAS）：列目录、stat、tree、find、du、df、cat、上传下载、mkdir、移动复制删除，另带能力探测。Python 包需另行 pipx 安装。

description.en: A read_graph tool backed by a codebase knowledge graph (CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL relations).
description.zh: 基于代码库知识图谱的 read_graph 工具（CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL 关系）。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that interviews the user about a project, generates a project timeline / Gantt chart, and exports it as Word or Excel.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过与用户进行项目需求访谈，生成项目时间线 / 甘特图，并导出为 Word 或 Excel 格式。

description.en: Fronts stdio MCP servers with three router tools (list_capabilities, describe_tool, call_tool) so schemas load on demand instead of riding every request; shapes every tool result through a deterministic output ladder that archives the original first (retrieve_spill reads it back); prices tool groups in tokens and can hide built-in groups per agent. Bridges to a standard-library Python router, so Python 3.9+ is required.
description.zh: 用三个路由工具（list_capabilities、describe_tool、call_tool）代理 stdio MCP 服务器，schema 按需加载，不再随每次请求发送；所有工具结果经过确定性输出阶梯压缩，有损处理前先归档原文（retrieve_spill 可读回）；按 token 为工具分组标价，并可按 agent 隐藏内置分组。桥接到纯标准库的 Python 路由器，需要 Python 3.9+。

plugins.name: dsh-jev-plugin

description.en: Integrates TypeSafe Jev for skill and file selection, task supervision, shared-finding corrections, tool-output filtering, approval assistance, and recorded-stage navigation in DeepSeek Harness; all features are disabled by default.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中集成 TypeSafe Jev，用于技能与文件选择、任务监督、共享结论纠错、工具输出过滤、审批辅助和历史步骤阶段导航；所有功能默认禁用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: HTTP/API debugging toolset: full-control HTTP requests (method/headers/body/auth), curl command parsing and one-step execution, in-session request history with side-by-side response comparison, pagination-aware Link headers, and DeepSeek-branded UI cards (optional dsh-http-tools-ui).
description.zh: HTTP/API 调试工具集：全参数 HTTP 请求（method/headers/body/auth）、curl 命令解析与一步执行、会话内请求历史与响应并排对比、分页 Link 头透出；配合可选 dsh-http-tools-ui 提供 DeepSeek 风格工具卡片。

description.en: Enhances data visualization in DeepSeek Harness by automatically selecting chart types from user input and generating images for trends, comparisons, proportions, relationships, and flows.
description.zh: 增强 DeepSeek Harness 数据可视化能力，根据用户输入自动选择图表类型并生成图片，支持趋势、比较、占比、关系和流程等可视化场景。

description.en: A novel-writing workspace: one folder per book, YAML/Markdown sections, an auto-wired relationship graph, consistency checks, four LLM tasks and four export formats.
description.zh: 小说创作工作区：一本书一个文件夹、YAML/Markdown 分区、关系图自动连边、一致性校验、四个 AI 任务与四种导出格式。

description.en: Writing tools that remove AI-sounding patterns and match your personal voice. 8 deterministic tools scan text, build a style fingerprint from your samples, and return rewrite briefs.
description.zh: 写作工具：去除 AI 腔并贴合个人文风。8 个确定性工具扫描文本、从样本提取文风指纹，并返回改写 brief。

description.en: Adds a balance-checking tool, injects a per-turn DeepSeek account balance snapshot with a low/critical power-saving and stop policy, and provides a settings page for thresholds and FX-linked currency conversion. Requires a signed-in DeepSeek account for balance reads; API-key-only profiles return an unreadable result.
description.zh: 新增余额查询工具，在每轮对话中注入 DeepSeek 账户余额快照与低余额省电/严重不足停机策略，并提供阈值和汇率联动换算设置页。需要已登录的 DeepSeek 账号才能读取余额，仅配置 API key 的 profile 会返回无法读取。

description.en: Drive CADCraft from the agent: draw lines, arcs and splines, manage layers, add dimensions, hatches and blocks, then export DXF, DWG, SVG, PNG or PDF. Exposes both CADCraft's command ids and its own MCP server, so a drawing can be created and read back. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 CADCraft：绘制直线、圆弧与样条，管理图层，添加标注、填充与图块，并导出 DXF、DWG、SVG、PNG 或 PDF。同时暴露 CADCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server，可创建并读回图纸。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。
