description.en: Drive DeckCraft from the agent: create slides, apply layouts and themes, add shapes, pictures, tables and charts, then save a .pptx or export a PDF. Exposes DeckCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 DeckCraft：新建幻灯片、套用版式与主题、添加形状、图片、表格与图表，并保存为 .pptx 或导出 PDF。暴露 DeckCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive DesignCraft from the agent: create pages, place and flow text, arrange frames and master pages, then export PDF. Exposes DesignCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 DesignCraft：创建页面、置入与排布文字、组织图文框与主页，并导出 PDF。暴露 DesignCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive EffectCraft from the agent: build compositions, add layers, set properties and keyframes, evaluate expressions, then render frames or movies. Exposes EffectCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 EffectCraft：搭建合成、添加图层、设置属性与关键帧、计算表达式，并渲染单帧或视频。暴露 EffectCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive FigCraft from the agent: create frames, components and auto layout, set fills, strokes and effects, build prototypes, and export PNG, SVG, PDF or code. Exposes both FigCraft's command ids and its own MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 FigCraft：创建画框、组件与自动布局，设置填充、描边与效果，搭建原型，并导出 PNG、SVG、PDF 或代码。同时暴露 FigCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive FilmCraft from the agent: build a project and sequences, import media, run edits as a script, then export with a preset or format. Exposes FilmCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 FilmCraft：创建工程与序列、导入素材、以脚本方式执行剪辑，并按预设或格式导出。暴露 FilmCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive GridCraft from the agent: build workbooks, write and evaluate formulas, format ranges, insert charts and tables, and read cells back. Exposes both GridCraft's command ids and its own MCP server, so a workbook can be created and inspected end to end. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 GridCraft：构建工作簿、写入并计算公式、设置区域格式、插入图表与表格，并读回单元格。同时暴露 GridCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server，可端到端地创建并检查工作簿。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive LightCraft from the agent: import photos, apply develop settings, and export JPEG or other formats from a photo library. Exposes LightCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 LightCraft：导入照片、应用冲图设置，并从照片库导出 JPEG 等格式。暴露 LightCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive PdfCraft from the agent: read and extract text, render pages to images, rotate, delete, reorder, combine or split pages, and audit faux redactions. Exposes PdfCraft's tool set as both commands and an MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 PdfCraft：读取并提取文本、把页面渲染成图片、旋转/删除/重排/合并/拆分页面，并检查伪脱敏。以命令与 MCP server 两种形式暴露 PdfCraft 的工具集。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive PhotoCraft from the agent: open and create documents, work with layers and selections, apply adjustments and filters, run batch actions, then save or export PSD, PNG, JPG, TIFF or WebP. Exposes PhotoCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 PhotoCraft：打开与新建文档、操作图层与选区、应用调整与滤镜、执行批处理动作，并保存或导出 PSD、PNG、JPG、TIFF 或 WebP。暴露 PhotoCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive SoundCraft from the agent: load a session, set track and mixer levels, insert plugins, edit MIDI, and bounce audio without opening a window. Exposes the DAW's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 SoundCraft：加载工程、设置轨道与混音电平、插入插件、编辑 MIDI，并在不打开窗口的情况下 bounce 音频。暴露这个 DAW 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive TextureCraft from the agent: build texture sets and layers over a mesh, paint, bake maps, and export PBR textures. Exposes both TextureCraft's command ids and its own MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 TextureCraft：在网格上构建贴图集与图层、绘制、烘焙贴图，并导出 PBR 纹理。同时暴露 TextureCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive VectorCraft from the agent: create and edit paths and artboards, set text and effects, then export SVG, PDF, AI or EPS. Exposes VectorCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 VectorCraft：创建与编辑路径和画板、设置文字与效果，并导出 SVG、PDF、AI 或 EPS。暴露 VectorCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: Drive WordCraft from the agent: create documents, insert and style text, build tables and headers, track changes and comments, then save as DOCX or convert to PDF, ODT, RTF, Markdown and more. Exposes WordCraft's command ids and its MCP server. Requires the matching ArtCraft app CLI installed locally; it is not bundled.
description.zh: 让智能体驱动 WordCraft：新建文档、插入并排版文字、构建表格与页眉、跟踪修订与批注，并保存为 DOCX 或转换为 PDF、ODT、RTF、Markdown 等。暴露 WordCraft 的命令 id 与自带的 MCP server。需本机安装对应的 ArtCraft 应用 CLI，插件不附带应用本体。

description.en: A live preview panel for the ArtCraft applications inside the DSH Web GUI: the agent step list, the current render, a filmstrip of earlier steps and a timeline for time-based crafts, fed by the craft plugins' renders.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 内的 ArtCraft 实时预览面板：智能体步骤流、当前渲染、历史步骤胶片条，以及时间轴类应用的时间轴，数据来自各 craft 插件生成的渲染图。

description.en: Academic assistant plugin.
description.zh: 学术助手插件。

description.en: Sidebar button that checks for DSH updates on startup, shows red dot for new versions, supports ignoring specific versions, and displays changelog preview with live download progress and GitHub mirror support for China.
description.zh: 侧边栏按钮：启动时自动检查DSH更新并显示红点提示，支持忽略特定版本、预览更新日志，带实时下载进度、国内镜像加速和下载安全校验。

description.en: Wraps colbymchenry/codegraph into agent tools - status, search, callers/callees, impact, explore, and more.
description.zh: 将 colbymchenry/codegraph 封装到代理工具中 - status、search、callers/callees、impact、explore 等等。

description.en: PCL-style modpack for DSH plugins: export a small .dshpack.zip manifest of the selected third-party plugins and their versions, then import it with a preview before reinstalling.
description.zh: PCL 式 DSH 整合包：勾选已安装插件导出小体积 .dshpack.zip 与安装命令串，导入时先预览、确认后再按版本重新安装。

description.en: Per-workspace gate that hides the tool schemas and system prompt sections of selected plugins from the model in directories that do not need them.
description.zh: 按工作区门控插件：把选定插件的工具 schema 与系统提示词段，从不需要它们的目录的模型上下文中摘掉。

plugins.name: dsh-cpa

description.en: In-process ChatGPT Codex authorization, model discovery, and quota display for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内直连 ChatGPT Codex，管理授权、模型同步和额度显示，无需本地代理进程。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-decisiontools

description.en: Optional Decision API tool discovery and search-source prefetch, with per-session controls and ordinary-discovery fallback.
description.zh: 可选 Decision API 工具预发现与搜索来源预读，支持会话开关和普通按需发现回退。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Research-only trading workbench bundle: typed market-data provider seam with a CSV reference provider, multi-timeframe indicator regime snapshot and OHLCV tools, interactive chart cards in dsh web with provenance-gated model annotations, and a risk-guard denying execution-shaped tool calls at tools/pre-execute.
description.zh: 只读交易研究工作台 bundle：带类型的行情数据接缝（含 CSV 参考数据源）、多周期指标 regime 快照与 OHLCV 工具、dsh web 交互式 K 线卡（模型标注需溯源并经价格区间校验）、以及在 tools/pre-execute 拦截下单形工具调用的 risk-guard。

description.en: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description.zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

description.en: Sales workflow for individual insurance agents: P1-P5 product class matched against the client risk rating, a policy ledger that counts grace periods from the receipt date, and five-section dual-recording checks. 10 tools and 5 skills.
description.zh: 个险代理人的展业工作流：P1-P5 产品分级与客户风险等级匹配、按回执签收日推算犹豫期的保单台账、双录五环节校验，含 10 个工具与 5 个技能。

description.en: Download videos and create GIFs from links or local clips with optional size limits on Windows x64.
description.zh: 在 Windows x64 上下载视频，或将链接及本地片段制作为可指定体积上限的 GIF。

description.en: Local ComfyUI image generation for DeepSeek Harness — discovers or starts the ComfyUI installed on the machine, generates a text-to-image result from a chat request, and attaches it to the conversation.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 用本机 ComfyUI 真正生图——自动查找或启动本地服务，在对话里完成文生图并附图。

description.en: Strongly read-only, secret-aware Oracle second-opinion subagent.
description.zh: 强制只读、会脱敏的第二意见子代理。

description.en: Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table conversion, SQL dialect transpiling, and mainland-China reachability probes run from a China Mobile network vantage point.
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en: File workbench library plugin for DSH, provide file processing capability.
description.zh: DSH 文件工作台库插件，提供文件处理相关能力。

description.en: DSH QQ bot bridge plugin, connect DeepSeek Harness with QQ bot.
description.zh: DSH QQ机器人桥接插件，将DeepSeek Harness对接QQ机器人。

description.en: Local Qimen business-timing workbench for DeepSeek Harness, with nine palaces, deterministic scoring, future-window ranking, and direction advice.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中本地完成奇门排盘、商务评分、未来择时和方位建议。

description.en: Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable model channel.
description.zh: DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。

description.en: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
description.zh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

description.en: Read-only audit of the local CLI toolchain as a sidebar panel in the DSH web GUI: lists installed versions across Homebrew, npm global, pip, Rust/Bun/uv and self-updating CLIs, flags which ones have a newer release available, and shows the dependency impact for installed packages. It reports only and never runs an upgrade, so no tool on the machine is modified. The DSH plugin ships on npm as `dsh-cli-doctor`.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的只读 CLI 工具链体检面板：按生态列出 Homebrew、npm 全局、pip、 Rust/Bun/uv 与自更新类 CLI 的本机版本，标出哪些有可用更新，并展示已安装包 的依赖影响。只报不升，不会改动本机任何工具。DSH 插件在 npm 上以 `dsh-cli-doctor` 发布。

description.en: Evidence-driven company and job due-diligence for DSH: logs sources with evidence levels, adds evidence-bounded claims, verifies the legal entity against official registries, and renders a PROCEED/VERIFY/STOP report with a verification checklist and interview questions.
description.zh: 证据驱动的公司与岗位尽调插件：登记带证据等级的来源、添加受证据边界约束的结论、用官方登记信息核验公司主体，并生成推进/核验/停止三态报告，附核验清单与面试问题。

description.en: Mounts the pen.dev desktop app MCP server in a DSH session so the model can read and edit the .pen document open in Pen through the get_app_state, read_skill, execute, get_style and browser tools; finds the server binary by probing the usual install paths, and adds a pen-dev skill plus a listener that turns pen.dev plan-limit failures into a short bilingual notice. Unofficial, and ships no pen.dev binaries.
description.zh: 把 pen.dev 桌面应用的 MCP 服务器挂进 DSH 会话，模型即可通过 get_app_state、read_skill、execute、get_style、browser 读取并修改 Pen 中打开的 .pen 文档；服务器二进制按常见安装路径探测定位，另附一个 pen-dev 技能，以及一个把 pen.dev 额度用尽错误改写成简短中英提示的监听器。非官方项目，不含 pen.dev 任何二进制。

description.en: Read-only Grafana tools that query metrics through the data source proxy: instance health, data source listing, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert state, and provisioned alert rules. Range queries downsample to a point budget; an explicitly supplied step that would exceed it is rejected rather than silently changed, so the model never receives data at a resolution it did not ask for.
description.zh: 面向 Grafana 的只读工具，经数据源代理查询指标：实例健康、数据源列表、instant 与 range PromQL 查询、当前告警状态与已配置的告警规则。range 查询会按点数预算降采样；调用方显式指定的 step 若会超量则直接拒绝，而不是静默改写，避免模型拿到与预期不同分辨率的数据。

description.en: Read-only Odoo tools over JSON-RPC: server info, model field introspection, and a restricted search_read limited to an allow list of models whose domain field names may not contain dots, so related-record traversal is not possible. A draft-create tool is registered only when allowWrite is enabled, and is limited to sale.order and project.task with the draft state enforced by the plugin.
description.zh: 经 JSON-RPC 的 Odoo 只读工具：服务器信息、模型字段自省，以及受限的 search_read——仅限白名单模型，且 domain 字段名不允许包含点号，因此无法沿关联关系穿透。草稿创建工具需显式开启 allowWrite 才会注册，且仅限 sale.order 与 project.task，草稿状态由插件强制。

plugins.name: dsh-stock-research

description.en: Provides snapshot-based research and question answering for individual A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 基于数据快照提供 A 股与美股的单股研究和问答。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A-share multi-agent analysis behind /trading-agent, ported from TradingAgents-AShare, running 14 roles (analysts, bull/bear debate, risk review, trader) through the harness LLM route.
description.zh: /trading-agent 命令背后的 A 股多智能体分析，移植自 TradingAgents-AShare：14 个角色（分析师、多空辩论、风控、交易员）经 dsh 已配置的模型路由协作产出完整投研报告。

plugins.name: DSH-WebGIS

description.en: Conversational GIS for the DSH Web UI with local file and PostGIS querying, interactive maps, and spatial analysis.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的对话式 GIS：支持本地文件与 PostGIS 查询、交互式地图与空间分析。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Chat-operated multi-database admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness: query and manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, GaussDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, DM and SQLite from the conversation with project-scoped ro/rw grants, a sidebar management panel, schema browsing and data preview, and confirmation-gated dangerous operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件：在对话中直接管理多数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、GaussDB、MongoDB、Redis、Oracle、达梦、SQLite），支持项目级 ro/rw 授权、侧边栏管理面板、结构浏览与数据预览，危险操作需确认后执行。

plugins.name: dsh-tianjige

description.en: Algorithm field guide for graphics, animation, physics and AI work — 219 entries with tradeoffs and links to existing implementations, exposed as 10 agent tools and a sidebar page. AI-assisted tools require DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
description.zh: 图形/动画/物理/AI 算法的可查询天书——219 条术法，带取舍说明与现成实现链接，提供 10 个 agent 工具与侧栏页面。AI 工具需 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www-sop.inria.fr

description.en: Universal Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: connects agents to stdio/sse/websocket MCP servers with a 10k dormant scale engine, sub-millisecond BM25 tool search, dynamic token budgeting, and a real-time web UI dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 桥接插件：支持 stdio/sse/websocket 协议，具备 10k 休眠伸缩引擎、亚毫秒级 BM25 工具检索、动态 Token 预算管理及实时 Web UI 仪表盘。

description.en: A self-healing layer for tool calls: missing params, wrong fields and out-of-range paths are fixed before they reach the model. Measured visible error rate fell from 7.95% to 2.20%.
description.zh: 给工具调用加一层自愈：缺参数、错字段、路径越界在到达模型前自动修好，实测可见错误率从 7.95% 降到 2.20%。

description.en: E-commerce plugin for DeepSeek Harness — product search, comparison and checkout across Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo, via the yuantoutao Streamable HTTP MCP server.
description.zh: 电商插件——一个 MCP 给你的 AI 加上商品搜索、比价与购买能力，覆盖淘宝/京东/拼多多，商品目录由源头淘 MCP 服务提供。

description.en: Indexes the current workspace into a relation graph and exposes one agent tool, codegraph_explore, for reachability, callers, and impact, plus a Web sidebar graph pane.
description.zh: 将当前工作区索引为关系图，向 agent 暴露一个工具 codegraph_explore（可达性、调用者、影响面），并在 Web 右侧栏提供图形面板。

description.en: Project-level MCP servers loaded automatically: a project declares them in `.agents/mcp.json` (path and root markers configurable), and every session working inside that project mounts them in its own scope — stdio and Streamable HTTP, tools named `mcp__<server>__<tool>` — with the connections closed when the session ends. A Web UI panel lists the session's servers and their tools, and can enable or disable a project entry after confirmation, backing up and atomically rewriting the manifest.
description.zh: 自动加载项目级 MCP 服务器：项目在 `.agents/mcp.json` 中声明服务器（路径与根目录标记可配置），在项目内工作的每个会话各自的作用域里挂载——支持 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP，工具名为 `mcp__<server>__<tool>`——会话结束时断开连接。Web UI 面板列出本会话的服务器及其工具，并可在确认后启用或禁用项目条目，写入前备份并原子替换清单文件。

description.en: Role-based plugin recommender for DSH: asks the user's role (developer, designer, writer, researcher, ops, student...), recommends suitable plugins, and audits each with a local static security scan (dangerous code patterns + 0-100 risk score) and a reputation check (npm downloads / GitHub stars).
description.zh: 按职业/角色推荐 DSH 插件：询问用户是做什么的（程序员、设计师、写作、研究、运维、学生…），推荐适合的插件，并对每个插件做本地静态安全审计（危险代码模式 + 0-100 风险分）与口碑检查（npm 下载量 / GitHub 星数）。

description.en: Fork of kirkchinese/dsh-capability-catalog 0.1.4 (cannot be installed alongside the upstream capability catalog / @kirkchinese/dsh-rea): a REA-focused MCP gateway with three fixed search, describe and call tools, cached schemas, session controls and native DSH result handling. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.4 and a Node/npm setup able to run REA.
description.zh: 派生自 kirkchinese/dsh-capability-catalog 0.1.4（不能与上游能力目录 / @kirkchinese/dsh-rea 同装）：为 REA 提供按需 MCP 网关，通过三个固定的检索、参数查看与调用入口访问缓存工具定义，支持会话开关并复用 DSH 原生结果处理。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.4，以及能运行 REA 的 Node/npm 环境。

description.en: Offline Wikipedia and ZIM lookups through your own kiwix-serve: the wiki_search, wiki_read and wiki_books tools run full-text search with snippets, read an article by exact title, and list the local ZIM library.
description.zh: 通过你自己运行的 kiwix-serve 离线查询维基百科等 ZIM 数据包：wiki_search / wiki_read / wiki_books 三个工具分别做带摘要片段的全文搜索、按精确标题读取全文、列出本地 ZIM 书库。

plugins.name: dsh-serper-search

description.en: Complementary web-search provider: every web_search merges the DeepSeek Search API (primary) with serper.dev Google results (secondary) at a fixed 2:1 ratio. Both sides are direct HTTP retrievals with no auxiliary model turn: URL-deduped sources, long DeepSeek summaries clipped into snippets, per-backend timeouts and graceful degradation to whichever backend answers.
description.zh: 互补式网页搜索 provider：每次 web_search 由 DeepSeek 官方 Search API（主）与 serper.dev 的 Google 结果（补）按固定 2:1 交错合并。两路均为直连检索、无辅助模型调用；来源按 URL 去重，官方长摘要截断注入，单路超时自动降级到另一路。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Resolves a company name or ticker to a verified stock symbol via SEC EDGAR, then fetches a live quote with price, P/E, EPS, market cap, 52-week range, and dividend yield from yahoo-finance2.
description.zh: 通过 SEC EDGAR 将公司名称或股票代码解析为已验证的股票代号，再从 yahoo-finance2 获取实时行情，包括价格、市盈率、每股收益、市值、52周区间和股息率。

description.en: E-commerce product image generation for DSH: 24 prompt modules covering main, detail and ad images, style transfer from a reference shot, batch runs, and a project gallery with live preview.
description.zh: DSH 电商商品图生成：24 个提示词模块覆盖主图、详情图与广告图，支持参考图风格复刻、批量生成，以及作品库实时预览。

description.en: System One decision runtime for dsh. Ships fast non-generative tools (choice, score, screen, gate) on a local or hosted System One gateway, and — without the model calling anything — prunes oversized tool output segment by segment, refuses repeated identical calls once System One confirms stagnation, verifies completion claims against real tool evidence, and corrects failing retries. Published on npm as dsh-harness-reflex (plugin) and harness-reflex (core, also a stdio MCP server).
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的 System One 决策运行时。提供不消耗生成 token 的快速工具（选择、评分、安全筛查、完成度核验），并在模型不调用任何工具的情况下自动干预：把超长工具输出逐段交给 System One 判定取舍后裁剪、在确认停滞时拒绝重复调用、用真实工具证据核验完成声明、对反复失败的重试给出纠正。npm 包为 dsh-harness-reflex（插件）与 harness-reflex（核心，同时是 stdio MCP server）。

description.en: Adds a subagent_codex tool that delegates tasks to the local OpenAI Codex CLI, running the work in an isolated external process.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_codex 工具，把任务委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 在独立外部进程中执行，与主对话完全隔离。

description.en: Offline Chinese-English and English-Chinese dictionary with monolingual glosses, grouped related words, prosody analysis, and a public-domain Chinese/English literary corpus exposed to agents.
description.zh: 离线汉英/英汉词典：含汉语释义、英英释义、分组相关词与声律分析，并向 Agent 提供可检索的公有领域中英文文学语料库。

description.en: Character consistency toolkit: personality profile cards, appearance-weight stats, and behavioral-drift detection for long-form fiction.
description.zh: 角色一致性工具包：性格侧写档案、出场权重统计与行为偏离检测。

description.en: Dead-loop brake for DSH agent sessions: detects repeated identical tool calls, repeating call sequences, and duplicate text, then reminds the agent or refuses the call before it runs.
description.zh: DSH 会话死循环刹车器：检测重复的相同工具调用、循环的调用序列与重复文本，提醒 agent 或在执行前拒绝调用。

description.en: Replaces the default web search and fetch channel with eight free search engines including Tavily, Exa and Brave, tried in a configurable fallback order. Keys are entered in a settings card that also toggles the web_fetch tool.
description.zh: 把默认的 Web 搜索与抓取通道替换为 Tavily、Exa、Brave 等八个免费搜索引擎，按可配置的顺序依次 fallback。在设置卡片中填写各引擎 Key，并可开关 web_fetch 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-iris

description.en: Media and vision workspace for DeepSeek Harness: image, video and speech generation, image Q&A and element locating, long-image OCR, pixel diff, HTML-screenshot verification and video summarization, with DashScope and OpenAI-compatible providers, model pools and a workbench client.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体与视觉工作台：文生图、图/文生视频、语音合成与转写、图像问答与元素定位、长图 OCR、像素比对、HTML 截图验证、视频摘要；支持 DashScope 与 OpenAI 兼容供应商，含模型池与工作台客户端。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Let DeepSeek Harness see and operate any program on Windows. The model looks at the real screen and drives the mouse, keyboard and windows itself. It is fast: several steps run in a single round trip, and a window can be focused before input lands, so the click hits the right one. It can do anything you would do on a desktop, including but not limited to CAD drawing, circuit simulation, and sending messages.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 看见并操作 Windows 上的任何程序。模型直接看真实屏幕，自己驱动鼠标、键盘和窗口。特点是快：好几步动作在一次往返里跑完，输入前还能先把目标窗口聚焦，点击就落在正确的窗口上。你在桌面上能做的事它都能做，包括但不限于画 CAD、电路图仿真、发消息。

description.en: MCP server console under Plugins: manage the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client at runtime — add/edit/delete servers, enable/disable/reconnect, per-tool switches, live status and tool lists over SSE, mcpServers JSON import, and auto-migration of profile-YAML MCP entries; an uninstall leaves a native fallback block that keeps the same servers loadable.
description.zh: 插件页 MCP 服务器控制台：运行时管理官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client——新增/编辑/删除服务器、启停/重连、工具级开关、SSE 实时状态与工具列表、mcpServers JSON 导入、自动迁移 profile YAML 里的 MCP 条目；卸载后留下原生 fallback 块，同一批服务器仍可加载。

description.en: Sticker/emoji expression for assistants: emotion-driven auto-matching, library management, AI image tagging, dialects, style mimicry, and chat-based tag refinement.
description.zh: 表情包表达插件：让助手用表情包表达情绪，按情绪自动配图，含图库管理、AI 识图打标、方言口音、学我说话，还能点「和助手聊聊」直接调教标签。

description.en: Database access for DeepSeek Harness through the DBHub MCP server: configure MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite and SQL Server connections per workspace and environment, then let the agent configure, list, query and search SQLite objects through four fixed tools. Passwords and full connection strings are entered in the settings UI and never accepted as tool arguments, so the model only sees metadata such as mysql://host:3306/db; each environment can be read-only (the model may enable it but not clear it) or reached through a manual SSH tunnel. Every call runs its own short-lived dbhub process and dbhub installs itself when missing.
description.zh: 把 DBHub MCP 服务器接入 DeepSeek Harness 的数据库插件：按工作区 × 环境配置 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQLite 与 SQL Server 连接，让 Agent 通过固定 4 个工具配置连接、列出数据源、执行 SQL、搜索 SQLite 对象。密码与完整连接串由用户在设置界面输入、不作为工具参数接收，模型只看到 mysql://host:3306/db 这类元数据；每个环境可设为只读（模型只能开启、不能关闭）或经手动 SSH 隧道访问。每次调用独立启动一条用完即退的 dbhub 进程，未安装 dbhub 时自动安装。

description.en: Clinical documentation and reference bundle for healthcare professionals: SOAP/APSO progress notes, admission H&P, SBAR/I-PASS handover, discharge summaries, Safe Harbor de-identification, patient-instruction readability, completeness checks, and cited lookups against FDA labels, MedlinePlus, PubMed, and ClinicalTrials.gov. Draft-only with a PHI egress guard; not a medical device.
description.zh: 面向临床人员的文档与参考工具包：SOAP/APSO 病程录、入院 H&P、SBAR/I-PASS 交接班、 出院小结、Safe Harbor 脱敏、患者须知可读性评分、完整性检查，以及来自 FDA 说明书、 MedlinePlus、PubMed 和 ClinicalTrials.gov 的带出处检索。仅起草不决定， 内置 PHI 外发守卫；非医疗器械。

description.en: Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP browsing, via a persistent stdio MCP child process.
description.zh: nuphus-mcp 官方 DSH 插件（由 nuphus-mcp 维护者发布）：桌面 + 浏览器自动化（38 个工具），配 PaddleOCR 元素感知与 Chrome CDP 浏览，经常驻 stdio MCP 子进程接入。

description.en: File encoding guard: byte-exact read/write/edit for GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, Windows-125x, UTF-16 and UTF-32 files, so editing a legacy file leaves it in its original encoding instead of silently rewriting it as UTF-8; UTF-8 BOM preserved exactly as it was, line endings (CRLF/LF/CR) kept, characters the encoding cannot represent refused rather than written as "?", and non-UTF-8 files listed with candidate encodings so the model can re-read them explicitly.
description.zh: 文件编码守护：为 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS、EUC-KR、Windows-125x、UTF-16、UTF-32 文件提供字节级无损读写与编辑，改完仍是原编码而不是被悄悄转成 UTF-8；UTF-8 BOM 原样保留，CRLF/LF/CR 换行符保持，编码表示不了的字符拒绝写入而不是写成「?」；非 UTF-8 文件会列出候选编码，模型可显式指定重读。

plugins.name: dsh-msszsd-toolkit

description.en: Drive existing DSH sessions from QQ (needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside): ask another session a question, manage share/team slots with a guard, pause a running turn, restart DSH on Windows and resume (via the install-restart.ps1 scheduled task), and inject peak-hour discipline. Plugin detail page has per-feature switches.
description.zh: 用 QQ 远程驾驶已有的 DSH 会话（需本机另跑 OneBot 11 实现，如 NapCat）：跨会话提问（带上下文守卫）、分享槽与团队槽（一令牌一目录，带监管）、界面暂停按钮、在 Windows 上重启 DSH 并自动续跑（依赖 install-restart.ps1 创建的计划任务）、贵时段纪律注入。插件详情页带分模块开关。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 223.5.5.5 for network access

description.en: Settings page for the REA reverse-engineering tool gateway (rea-mcp-lite) that lives in the same repository: pick which tool bundles load into context, see the tool count and token cost of each bundle, save and recall named presets of your loading setup, hot-swap them without restarting DSH, and check this repository and REA for updates, including classifying the tools a new REA release added. The page is split into sections with sub-menus, filters and pagination. Requires REA (rea-agents) and the gateway registered as the rea MCP server (see repo README).
description.zh: 同一个仓库里的 REA 逆向工具网关（rea-mcp-lite）的设置页：勾选加载哪些功能族、看清每族的工具数与 token 成本、把当前加载组合存成命名预设随时切回、热切换无需重启，并可检查本仓库与 REA 的更新、归类 REA 新版新增的工具。页面按功能分区，带子菜单、筛选与分页。需已装 REA（rea-agents），并按仓库 README 把网关注册为名为 rea 的 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Windows desktop automation for dsh: 14 tools that enumerate apps and windows, capture window screenshots that still work when the window is covered by other windows, read the accessibility tree, and perform real input — click, type text (CJK included), press key combinations, scroll and drag. Loads the official computer-use runtime (@oai/sky) already installed on the machine, discovering it by enumerating vendor directories, so vendor upgrades that change hash directories do not break it.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 Windows 桌面自动化：14 个工具，可枚举应用与窗口、抓取被遮挡也能截的窗口截图、读取无障碍树，并执行真实输入——点击、输入文字（含中文）、按组合键、滚动与拖拽。加载机器上已安装的官方电脑控制运行时（@oai/sky），按厂商目录枚举发现，引擎升级换目录也不会失效。

description.en: Shared interactive terminal: the AI terminal tool and the official sidebar xterm drive the same session shell, so you can type and watch the live screen.
description.zh: 共享交互式终端：AI terminal 单工具与官方侧栏 xterm 共用 Session shell，用户可输入并查看当前屏幕。

description.en: Windows shell takeover: replace the default pwsh tool with a configurable multi-client shell tool (git bash, WSL, cmd, pwsh, custom paths), with a deny blacklist and automatic fallback.
description.zh: Windows shell 接管：把默认 pwsh 工具替换为可配置多客户端 shell 工具（git bash/WSL/cmd/pwsh、自定义路径），deny 黑名单与失败自动回退官方链。

description.en: Deferred tool loading gate: inject allowlisted tools in full, mark the rest for the host deferred-loading chain, and expose them as searchable placeholders with a settings card.
description.zh: 全局层工具白名单延迟加载：白名单内工具全量注入，其余交宿主按需加载链以 tool_search 检索激活，设置卡可视配置。

description.en: Hosted PrimeSync AI Studio strategy-research MCP configuration bundle using the official MCP client and mcp-remote OAuth bridge; eligible Studio access required. Experimental: OAuth consent and tool calls are not yet verified end-to-end. Complete manual CLI sign-in on the same computer before starting Harness; otherwise tools may be absent after startup. Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only; mcp-remote 0.15.2 is downloaded through npx on first launch.
description.zh: PrimeSync AI Studio 托管策略研究 MCP 服务的实验性配置包，使用官方 MCP 客户端和 mcp-remote OAuth 桥接，需具备 Studio 使用权限。OAuth 授权与工具调用尚未完成端到端验证；启动 Harness 前须在同一电脑上通过命令行手动登录，否则工具可能无法显示。仅面向 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2；首次启动时通过 npx 下载 mcp-remote 0.15.2。

description.en: One MCP tool surface over two Windows desktop-automation backends (dsh-computer-use-win and windows-mcp). Both must be installed first: dsh-computer-use-win as a DSH plugin, windows-mcp via uv tool install windows-mcp --python 3.14, then run the bundled scripts/patch-backend.mjs once (it rewrites the local windows-mcp source; without it screenshot/read_webpage/launch_app fail) and disable the standalone wincu mount. It merges their 44 tools into 29 by dropping 10 duplicates, 4 dangerous ones (PowerShell, Registry, FileSystem, Process) and 1 tool-management entry, and blocks dangerous calls before forwarding through a reversibility-graded guard.
description.zh: 把两个需自行安装的 Windows 桌面自动化后端（dsh-computer-use-win 插件 + 用 uv 装的 windows-mcp，Python 3.14）合成一个 MCP 工具面：装完还要跑一次随包的 scripts/patch-backend.mjs 改写本机 windows-mcp 源码（不跑则 screenshot/read_webpage/launch_app 会失败），并在 profile 里禁用单独挂载的 wincu。44 个后端工具去重为 29 个（去掉 10 个重复、4 个危险工具 PowerShell/Registry/FileSystem/Process、1 个工具管理入口），并在转发前用按可逆性分级的守卫拦截危险调用。

description.en: TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) as the jev_decide tool for DeepSeek Harness: noul, choice and score questions return calibrated probabilities; credentials reuse the DSH credential seam; 429/529 backoff retry built in.
description.zh: 把 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）接入 DSH 的 jev_decide 工具：noul/choice/score 三种问题形状返回校准概率，凭证复用 DSH 凭证缝，内建 429/529 退避重试。

description.en: Drop-in web_search provider that follows the session's routed model: a runtime-editable priority chain with three wire dialects (Anthropic web search, OpenRouter online, Zhipu bigmodel), per-route endpoints and credentials, a Settings UI panel, local JSONL call audit, and built-in official fallback.
description.zh: 替换内置 web_search 的 provider：按会话当前路由的模型选择端点与凭据，运行时可编辑的优先级链支持 Anthropic web search、OpenRouter online、智谱 bigmodel 三种方言，设置 UI 面板可视化编辑，本地 JSONL 调用审计，链全失败回退内置官方方案。

description.en: Reads and edits STEP models through FreeCAD, measures geometry (distance, angle, diameter), and generates first-angle 2D machining drawings with a hole table as SVG, DXF, PDF or PNG.
description.zh: 通过 FreeCAD 读写 STEP 模型、量取几何尺寸（距离、角度、直径），并生成带孔表的第一角法二维加工图，可导出 SVG、DXF、PDF、PNG。

description.en: Multi-round deep research in the DSH sidebar: each round fans sub-questions out to parallel sub-agents, then continues from where the last round stopped and writes a cited report.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的多轮深度搜索：每轮把子问题派给多个子代理并行查，再在上一轮基础上继续深挖，最后产出带引用的调研报告。

description.en: Automated daily content pipeline for Insta360 GO 3S: BLE/WiFi remote capture of aquarium footage, wireless import, ffmpeg quality evaluation with decision log, Auto editing (segment selection, TTS narration, music, subtitles), and Bilibili upload via biliup (dry-run by default).
description.zh: Insta360 GO 3S 自动每日内容管线：BLE/WiFi 遥控拍摄鱼缸素材、无线取回、ffmpeg 质量评估与决策记录、自动剪辑（选段/旁白/配乐/字幕）、biliup 投稿（默认 dry-run）。

plugins.name: Zuad-deepseek

description.en: Manage Zuad digital signage programs, media, playback schedules, and devices through DeepSeek Harness. Requires an existing Zuad signage backend and an account on it; you sign in from the plugin settings and the password stays local.
description.zh: 通过 DeepSeek Harness 管理 Zuad 数字标牌节目、素材、播放排程和设备。需要已有 Zuad 信发系统后台及可用账号，在插件设置里登录，密码只保存在本地。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to demo3.uad360.com

description.en: DSH plugin to read AutoCAD DWG/DXF, PDF and images without installing AutoCAD or Tesseract; DXF requires Python 3 and ezdxf on the machine.
description.zh: DSH 插件：直接读取 DWG/DXF 图纸、PDF 与图片，无需安装 AutoCAD 或 Tesseract；DXF 需本机安装 Python 3 与 ezdxf。

description.en: Lets the primary model ask an independent reviewer model to review a decision it has already made, with off, shadow and advisory modes. Requires your own service implementing POST /v1/decision.
description.zh: 让主模型把已形成的决策交给独立评审模型复核，支持 off、shadow、advisory 三种模式；需自备实现 POST /v1/decision 的复核服务。

description.en: Connects the Tavily hosted MCP server and registers the tools it publishes. The API key is read from the TAVILY_API_KEY credential and is not stored in plugin config.
description.zh: 接入 Tavily 托管的 MCP 服务器并注册它公布的工具。API Key 从 TAVILY_API_KEY 凭据读取，不写入插件配置。

description.en: Node-based creation studio for DeepSeek Harness - script, storyboard, reference images and multi-shot video generation on an infinite canvas, drivable from the chat in batches; bring your own image/video/TTS providers (OpenAI-style endpoints or Seedance/Sora-style video APIs), and with none configured the pipeline runs offline in demo mode with placeholder media.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的节点式创作工作室——在无限画布上完成剧本、分镜、参考图与多镜头视频生成，可由对话批量驱动；图像/视频/TTS 需自带服务商（OpenAI 风格接口，或 Seedance/Sora 风格视频 API），未配置时整条流水线以离线演示模式运行、只产出占位素材。

description.en: Read Bilibili and Douyin from a session: WBI-signed Bilibili API calls behind one shared pacer (4 req/s, per-host cooldown after a 412) for video, feed, search, author, comments, danmaku and subtitles, plus Douyin hot list, video, feed and search rendered in a locally launched Edge over CDP.
description.zh: 会话内读 B站与抖音：B站走 WBI 签名接口，全部请求共用一个限速器（默认 4 请求/秒，吃 412 后按主机冷却），覆盖视频、热门、搜索、UP主、评论、弹幕、字幕；抖音则通过 CDP 驱动本机 Edge 渲染，读热榜、视频、推荐流与搜索。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）机械臂的插件，由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研的 nUR MCP Server 同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language — by default an offline, kinematics-level simulated arm, with a real-robot channel that stays off until it is explicitly enabled. Needs a Python install with numpy and paramiko (pip install -r requirements.txt). Developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)
description.zh: 让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）协作机械臂的插件——默认是一台离线、运动学级的仿真机械臂，真机通道在显式开启前始终关闭。需本机 Python 并 pip install -r requirements.txt（numpy、paramiko）。由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研 nUR MCP Server 的同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）

description.en: Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and switch manually.
description.zh: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

description.en: DSH hardware sandbox plugin: assemble a 3D scene of ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED components with protocol- and voltage-checked port wiring, run real Python project code in the loop against simulated I2C/GPIO hardware with fault injection, let networked device simulators report over HTTP to a real backend (validated end-to-end against a live seat-reservation system), observe a real device read-only and map its state onto the scene, and add support for new boards through data-driven pin definitions. Ships 16 hw_* agent tools plus a bundled SKILL.md.
description.zh: DSH 嵌入式硬件沙盒插件：在 3D 面包板场景里摆放 ESP32 / BME280 / PIR / LED 等器件、按协议与电压校验接线；让真实 Python 项目代码在环运行、经 Python shim 读虚拟 I2C/GPIO 的寄存器级读数，支持故障注入（断线 / NACK / busy / 强制读数）；联网设备模拟器可向真实 HTTP 后端周期上报（已在真实"智能选座"系统全链路验证）；还可只读观察真机状态，并用数据驱动的型号定义支持新硬件。随插件带 16 个 hw_* 工具与一份 SKILL.md。

description.en: Framework-upgrade safety and plugin gating for DSH: a pre-upgrade session-format contract preflight that adapts incompatible plugins and agent presets before you upgrade, automatic rollback on failure, auto-quarantine of plugins that broke a boot, plus environment fingerprinting and a public contract-rule pack. The built-in multi-source marketplace is a discovery layer only.
description.zh: DSH 框架升级安全与插件升级门控：升级前跑「会话格式契约预检」（把不兼容的插件与 agent 预设扫出来先适配）、升级失败自动回滚、把拖垮过启动的插件自动隔离；另有环境指纹与公开契约规则库持续守门。内置多源插件市场只作发现层。

description.en: Fetches up-to-date, version-pinned library documentation and code examples from context7.com for DSH agents via context7_search and context7_get_docs tools.
description.zh: 通过 context7_search 与 context7_get_docs 工具，为 DSH 智能体从 context7.com 获取最新、可锁定版本的库文档与代码示例。

description.en: Model-agnostic visual-inspection pipeline for text-only agents: page-by-page HTML screenshots plus a ready-made vision-subagent briefing contract (gewu_prep), then source-code truth verification of every finding (gewu_locate); validated on mimo-v2.5 & qwen3.7-plus.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DSH 主脑的模型无关视觉审阅流水线：HTML 逐页截图 + 视觉子代理简报契约（gewu_prep），再把每条审阅发现定位回源码核验真值（gewu_locate）；已在 mimo-v2.5 与 qwen3.7-plus 上实测。

description.en: Agent mode picker for DSH: pick an external Agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Aider, Goose, Hermes…) as the session's default executor from a control next to the input box, instead of editing configuration files. The agent roster is data-driven, and installed CLIs are discovered automatically from PATH, the managed CLI directory and a drop-in convention directory. Agents that are installed but still missing credentials or a required background service are shown as "needs setup" rather than silently hidden.
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 模式选择器：在输入框旁边直接选定一个外部 Agent CLI（Claude Code、Codex、 Qwen Code、Gemini CLI、Aider、Goose、Hermes…）作为当前会话的默认执行体，不必去改配置文件。 Agent 名册是数据驱动的，已安装的 CLI 会从 PATH、托管 CLI 目录和约定目录自动发现；装了但还缺 凭据或需要常驻服务的，会显示为「待配置」而不是被悄悄藏起来。

description.en: Everything (voidtools) file-name search: everything_find queries the local Everything index to locate files and folders on any indexed drive in milliseconds, and adds a configuration card to the Plugins page.
description.zh: 基于 Everything 索引的全盘文件名搜索：everything_find 工具毫秒级定位任意盘上的文件与文件夹，并在插件页提供配置卡片。

description.en: Reads Claude Code and Codex plugin configurations to discover and preflight MCP servers and slash commands, with opt-in registration in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 读取 Claude Code 和 Codex 插件配置，发现并预检 MCP 服务器与斜杠命令，支持在 DeepSeek Harness 中按需启用注册。

description.en: Create and manage sandboxed JavaScript tools with a Monaco editor and model-driven tool lifecycle.
description.zh: 用 Monaco 编辑器创建和管理沙箱化的自定义 JavaScript 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-data-agent

description.en: Let the AI connect to databases and write SQL for you.
description.zh: 让 AI 帮你连数据库、写 SQL。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Safe math expression evaluator, zero-dependency recursive-descent parser.
description.zh: 安全的数学表达式求值器，零依赖递归下降解析器。

description.en: Parse/query/aggregate/convert CSV (RFC 4180) with a zero-dependency state-machine parser.
description.zh: CSV 解析/查询/统计/转换（RFC 4180），零依赖状态机解析器。

description.en: Structured comparison and unified diffs for text/JSON/CSV/Markdown.
description.zh: 文本/JSON/CSV/Markdown 结构化比较与 unified diff。

description.en: base64/url/hex encoding, common hashes, and UUID generation.
description.zh: base64/url/hex 编解码、常用哈希、UUID 生成。

description.en: JSON queries with a JMESPath subset.
description.zh: JMESPath 子集 JSON 查询。

description.en: Test/extract/safe-replace/statically explain regexes without executing code.
description.zh: 正则测试/提取/安全替换/静态解释（不执行代码）。

description.en: JSON Schema validation: validate/paths/explain/normalize.
description.zh: JSON Schema 验证：validate/paths/explain/normalize。

description.en: Descriptive statistics, percentiles, frequency distributions, and correlation.
description.zh: 描述统计/百分位数/频数分布/相关性。

description.en: Strict ISO 8601 parsing, IANA timezone conversion, and UTC calendar arithmetic.
description.zh: 严格 ISO 8601 解析、IANA 时区转换、UTC 日历运算。

description.en: Zero-dependency toolkit: time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema — ten deterministic tools in one install.
description.zh: 零依赖工具包：time / encoding / json / calculator / csv / regex / markdown / diff / stat / schema 十件套一键安装。

description.en: Runs OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses in a persistent Python kernel, with capability-catalog search, kernel inspection and an account tab.
description.zh: 在持久 Python 内核里跑 OmicVerse/OmicOS 生信分析，附能力目录检索、内核变量查看与账号订阅页签。

plugins.name: dsh-oomol

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to OOMOL-managed apps and services, with progressive Connector Action discovery and execution plus an in-app panel for managing Provider connections.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入由 OOMOL 管理的应用与服务，支持渐进式发现并执行 Connector Actions，并提供用于管理 Provider 连接的应用内面板。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-stitch-mcp

description.en: Connects the Google Stitch MCP endpoint as 16 native `mcp__stitch__*` tools for projects, screens and design systems, plus an in-panel card for an API key or OAuth access token.
description.zh: 把 Google Stitch 的 MCP 端点接成 16 个原生 `mcp__stitch__*` 工具，覆盖项目、界面与设计系统，并附一张面板内的 API Key / OAuth 令牌凭据卡片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Drive the Unity Editor from DSH through the official unity CLI: live-Editor scene commands, in-Editor C# eval and runtime command discovery over a warm unity shell session, plus a raw CLI escape hatch for project creation, tests and builds. Mounts Unity's official skill collection alongside its own Unity workflow and Asset Store skills.
description.zh: 通过官方 unity CLI 在 DSH 中操作 Unity 编辑器：实时场景命令、编辑器内 C# 求值、运行时命令发现，均复用常驻的 unity shell 会话；另有原始 CLI 通道用于建工程、跑测试与构建。同时挂载 Unity 官方技能集，以及插件自带的 Unity 工作流与 Asset Store 技能。

description.en: Business knowledge-network context for DeepSeek Harness: bind a session to an OpenBKN knowledge network, query its objects and metrics through managed MCP tools, and open trace-backed provenance (execution facts and a business graph) for each answer. Ships with the OpenBKN Runtime; the provenance views need an OpenBKN enterprise license.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供业务知识网络上下文：将会话绑定到 OpenBKN 知识网络，通过受管 MCP 工具查询对象与指标，并为每轮回答打开可溯源的执行事实与业务上下文图。随 OpenBKN Runtime 发布；溯源视图需企业版 License。

description.en: A wb_archive tool that turns a single Weibo post link (m.weibo.cn/status/...) into a permanent Markdown snapshot via the 2100laike archive service: long posts are fetched in full, images are re-hosted so they never break, snapshots survive post deletion, and resubmits dedup-hit and return the latest version without spending quota. Needs the third-party 2100laike service; anonymous use is limited to 8 archives per day per plugin instance and a registered PAT raises that to 100 per day.
description.zh: wb_archive 工具：把微博单条链接（m.weibo.cn/status/…）经 2100laike 存档服务转成永久 Markdown 快照——长文取全文、图片转存不裂链、删博后仍可读、重复提交去重秒回不耗额度。依赖第三方 2100laike 存档服务；匿名使用每个插件实例每天限 8 次，注册后配置 PAT 可提升到每天 100 次。

description.en: A wx_archive tool that turns a WeChat Official Account article link into a permanent Markdown snapshot via the 2100laike archive service: images are re-hosted so they never break, snapshots survive article deletion, resubmits dedup-hit and return the latest version without spending quota, a content_kind field tells text articles from sticker (image-post) messages, and refresh forces a refetch with a PAT. Needs the third-party 2100laike service; anonymous use is limited to 8 archives per day per plugin instance and a registered PAT raises that to 100 per day.
description.zh: wx_archive 工具：把公众号文章链接经 2100laike 存档服务转成永久 Markdown 快照——图片转存不裂链、删文后仍可读、重复提交去重秒回不耗额度、content_kind 区分图文与贴图（图片消息）、带 PAT 可 refresh 强制重抓。依赖第三方 2100laike 存档服务；匿名使用每个插件实例每天限 8 次，注册后配置 PAT 可提升到每天 100 次。

description.en: An x_archive tool that turns an X (Twitter) post link into a permanent Markdown snapshot via the 2100laike archive service: images are re-hosted so they never break, snapshots survive post deletion, resubmits dedup-hit and return the latest version without spending quota, and refresh forces a refetch with a PAT. Needs the third-party 2100laike service; anonymous use is limited to 8 archives per day per plugin instance and a registered PAT raises that to 100 per day.
description.zh: x_archive 工具：把 X（Twitter）推文链接经 2100laike 存档服务转成永久 Markdown 快照——图片转存不裂链、删帖后仍可读、重复提交去重秒回不耗额度、带 PAT 可 refresh 强制重抓。依赖第三方 2100laike 存档服务；匿名使用每个插件实例每天限 8 次，注册后配置 PAT 可提升到每天 100 次。

description.en: Vision-first Mac computer use, for when the accessibility tree is unavailable. Ships 11 desktop_* tools - window list, screenshots, OCR text targeting, numbered elements, coordinate clicks, typing, scrolling, drag - plus a Codex-style cursor overlay with spring animation. Clicks are delivered to the target process, so the real pointer never moves and nothing steals focus. In DSH it shows up as Mac Desktop Control with a settings page that checks the engine and the Screen Recording / Accessibility permissions, with a button that opens the matching System Settings pane. Works out of the box: the tarball bundles the dsh-cu engine and the overlay as prebuilt universal binaries (Apple silicon + Intel, macOS 11+, ad-hoc signed), compiled from the repo's Swift sources by the release workflow - no clone, no Xcode, no install.sh. The only setup is granting DeepSeek Harness Screen Recording and Accessibility once. macOS only; on Windows and Linux the plugin loads without registering the desktop tools.
description.zh: Mac 的视觉优先 computer use：无障碍树不可用时照样能干活。11 个 desktop_* 工具——窗口枚举、截图、OCR 找文字、元素编号、坐标点击、输入、滚动、拖拽，外加 Codex 风格的浮层光标（带弹簧动效）。点击投递给目标进程，不移动真实鼠标、不抢前台。DSH 插件页里显示为「Mac 桌面操作」，设置页会逐项检查命令行引擎和屏幕录制 / 辅助功能权限，缺哪个直接给按钮。装上就能用：安装包自带 dsh-cu 引擎和浮层的通用二进制（Apple 芯片 + Intel，macOS 11 起，本地签名），由发版工作流从仓库里的 Swift 源码编译——不用 clone、不用 Xcode、不用 install.sh。唯一的设置是给 DeepSeek Harness 开一次屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。仅支持 macOS；在 Windows / Linux 上插件照常加载，只是不注册桌面工具。

description.en: SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.
description.zh: OtterMind SQLX 数据库工具：列出已保存的数据源、查看或测试连接、执行 SQL、打开本地结果页，缺少 sqlx CLI 时首次调用自动安装。

description.en: One settings panel managing MCP, skills, memory, subagents, prompts and sessions; customize scene combos to switch the whole environment; the Agent can also operate this plugin for you.
description.zh: 一个设置面板，统一管理 MCP、技能、记忆、子智能体、提示词和归档会话；可自定义搭配场景，一个场景即可切换整个环境；Agent也能帮你操作这个插件。

description.en: Keeps a panel of what you must do, what you can apply for and what is worth knowing, distilled from your WeChat and QQ chat logs by one resident agent session that re-reads them on a schedule or when you click Fetch; each item can link straight to its source file or image.
description.zh: 把微信与 QQ 聊天记录里「必须做的、可以报名的、值得知道的」摘成一张面板：由一个常驻会话按计划或在你点 Fetch 时重读聊天记录并改写条目，每条可直链到原始文件或图片。

description.en: Manage $DSH_HOME/.env from Settings and sync Host plus Windows/macOS user environment.
description.zh: 在设置中管理 $DSH_HOME/.env，并同步到 Host 与 Windows/macOS 用户环境。

description.en: Rclone backup tooling with four tools: target inventory, local/remote status, rclone check verification, and approved copy/sync transfers with dry-run previews and an audit line. Requires rclone installed and a remote configured with `rclone config`; the plugin never reads the rclone config or credentials.
description.zh: 基于 rclone 的备份工具，含四个工具：目标清单、本地/远端状态、rclone check 校验，以及带预演与审计行的审批式 copy/sync 传输。需已安装 rclone 并用 `rclone config` 配好远端；插件不读取 rclone 配置或凭据。

description.en: Read-only Linux port, service and Caddy route map: listening sockets with their owning unit or container, a reverse service view, and reverse_proxy liveness checks. Requires iproute2 (ss); docker and a Caddyfile are optional.
description.zh: 只读的 Linux 端口、服务与 Caddy 路由地图：监听套接字及其所属 unit 或容器、反向服务视图，以及 reverse_proxy 存活检查。需要 iproute2（ss），docker 与 Caddyfile 可选。

description.en: Read-first VPS operations tools: systemd status and actions, disk usage, Docker status, log tails, configured backups, and quiet-hours schedules.
description.zh: 先读后写的 VPS 运维工具：systemd 状态与操作、磁盘占用、Docker 状态、日志尾部、可配置备份与静默时段计划。

description.en: Manage tool availability and groups for each Agent Preset, load tools on demand like Skills, and reduce model context usage.
description.zh: DSH 工具管理插件：按 Agent Preset 开关和分组工具，像 Skill 一样按需加载工具，减少模型上下文占用。

description.en: Gives the agent 14 tools to create and edit DingTalk Yida apps (apps, forms, pages, schema, data) through the OpenYida CLI, plus a right-sidebar workbench that opens them in the built-in browser.
description.zh: 通过 OpenYida CLI 给 Agent 14 个创建、修改钉钉宜搭应用（应用、表单、页面、Schema、数据）的工具，并在右侧栏工作台里用内置浏览器打开查看。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation via OpenRouter's unified Image API: configurable model aliases with parameters gated against the live model capability listing, reference-image inputs, a settings card, and inline chat display of results.
description.zh: 通过 OpenRouter 统一 Image API 的文生图与图生图：以别名配置模型，参数按实时模型能力列表校验，支持参考图输入、设置卡片与对话内联展示结果。

description.en: Not another memory plugin: ODR is an evolving-worlds self-improvement loop (Dream-RSI) — attempts are recorded into a Discovery Tree, and between runs thousands of strategy variants are replayed against that recorded world; a strategy, recipe or lesson is promoted only after surviving counterfactual replay, never on the model's word alone, and Sentinel gates tool calls before the budget burns; the LLM stays frozen, installable from npm as dsh-open-dream-rsi.
description.zh: 不是又一个记忆插件：ODR 是“演化世界”式（Dream-RSI）自我改进回路——每次尝试都记入发现树（Discovery Tree），任务间歇将数千个策略变体在这棵记录下来的世界上回放；策略、配方或经验只有通过反事实回放的考验才会晋升，绝不因模型自己说好就获得信任，Sentinel 还会在预算耗尽前拦截工具调用；LLM 保持冻结，可从 npm 安装 dsh-open-dream-rsi。

description.en: Create editable Blender product scenes in DSH. Start from speaker, cup and lamp recipes or imported models; view saved results on the Lighttable, compare revisions, and adjust dimensions, materials, cameras and lights. Place static models on actual mesh surfaces in one saved operation, then save a complete static view while preserving existing cameras and animation. Repair repeating texture coordinates on planar custom mesh faces while preserving geometry. Render images or saved-shot videos and export an editable revision with its assets. Native geometry inspections, immutable revisions and an approval gate help preserve existing work. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 and the legacy host, with 20 tools for modeling, review and delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中创建可编辑的 Blender 产品场景。从音箱、杯与灯具配方或导入模型开始，在光台查看保存结果、比较版本，调整尺寸、材质、相机与灯光。一次操作将静态模型放到实际网格表面并保存，再另存完整静态取景，保留原相机和动画。逐面修复自定义网格上的重复纹理坐标并保持几何不变。渲染图片或分镜影片，也可将一个版本连同素材导出为可编辑副本。原生几何检查、不可变历史和审批闸门帮助保留已有作品。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 并保留旧宿主入口，提供 20 个建模、评审与交付工具。

description.en: Install this plugin and DSH can operate your Zotero for you: search the library, read PDF full text, summarize highlights and notes, organize collections by topic, import your downloaded papers, and attach a translated version back to an item. The right sidebar also gains a Zotero library panel that brings an item, an excerpt or a whole collection into the conversation with one click. Model-side actions need Zotero's local API plus the Zotero MCP plugin (write operations enabled); the sidebar panel needs only the local API.
description.zh: 装上这个插件，DSH 就能直接操控你的 Zotero：检索文库、精读 PDF 全文、汇总高亮与笔记、按主题整理分类；也能在一个对话里导入你下载好的论文、把译文作为附件挂回条目。右侧栏还多一块「Zotero 文献库」面板，可把条目、摘录或整个分类一键带进对话。模型侧操作需开启 Zotero 本地 API 并安装集成 MCP 插件（写操作需在 MCP 插件里放行）；右侧面板只依赖本地 API。

description.en: Local video color editing with camera-matched DJI Log LUTs, independent highlights and shadows, optional skin and selective color controls, frame previews, and 10-bit HEVC export. The universal tarball listed here ships no runtime: its first-launch "configure environment" button downloads a pinned platform runtime (Python 3.12 + FFmpeg 9, ~100 MB) over HTTPS, or point it at your own Python 3.10+ and FFmpeg/ffprobe 8+; the platform-suffixed release packages bundle that runtime.
description.zh: 本地视频调色工作台，支持 DJI Log LUT 匹配还原、高光与暗部独立调节、可选肤色与局部颜色控制、逐帧预览和 10-bit HEVC 导出。此处列出的通用包不带运行时：首次启动点「配置独立环境」会经 HTTPS 下载固定版本的平台运行时（Python 3.12 + FFmpeg 9，约 100 MB），也可改用自备的 Python 3.10+ 与 FFmpeg/ffprobe 8+；带平台后缀的发行包才内置运行时。

description.en: Quantitative R&D toolkit for DeepSeek Harness — 59 tools across six domains covering market data, indicators, factor evaluation, walk-forward ML validation, risk (VaR/CVaR/drawdown/Beta with Kupiec POF), options, bonds, FICC and fund simulation, with an end-to-end PDAT→PET research pipeline.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的量化研发工具箱，59 个工具覆盖行情、指标、因子评价、滚动样本外机器学习验证、风险（VaR/CVaR/回撤/Beta 与 Kupiec POF）、期权、债券、FICC 和基金模拟，并提供端到端 PDAT→PET 研究管线。

description.en: Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.
description.zh: 电商店主工作台：CSV 批量预览（多平台列适配）、可复算利润与六维评分、公开商品页快照、中文 skills、可替换售后政策知识库。

description.en: Aquaculture input register completeness and withdrawal-period date check: deterministic findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 水产养殖投入品记录完整性与休药期日期核对：按规则 ID 输出确定性发现。

description.en: Checks a bid requirement by requirement against a tender requirements pack and reports which requirements appear answered, weakly matched or not located. It reports differences; it does not judge substantive compliance.
description.zh: 按招标要求逐条检查投标文件的响应位置，报告哪些要求看起来有应答、哪些匹配较弱、哪些未能定位。只报告差异，不判断是否实质满足。

description.en: Checks a canteen food-retention ledger for the four required record elements, the 125 g minimum, the 48-hour cold-storage window and template placeholders left in a cell.
description.zh: 核对食堂留样台账的四个记录要素、125 克下限、48 小时冷藏窗口，以及单元格中残留的模板占位符。

description.en: Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool execution, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code /rewind 等价能力：每次变更型工具执行前捕获 git 优先的工作区文件快照，轮次边界 fork 会话，一条 /rewind 命令恢复文件并把会话回退到检查点。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action, and a sanitized audit trail.
description.zh: Windows 桌面电脑操作工具（点击、输入、按键、截屏）：每次动作都带新鲜度校验、审批门、进程身份核验与脱敏审计。

description.en: Checks a project document archive for missing required document types, stale revisions and empty files, using folder and file names rather than document contents.
description.zh: 按项目资料归档要求检查缺失的必需资料类型、过期版本与空文件；只读文件夹与文件名，不读文档内容。

description.en: Customs declaration document consistency check: field-level findings with rule IDs.
description.zh: 报关单证一致性检查：按规则 ID 输出字段级发现。

description.en: Data quality checking for DeepSeek Harness — profiling, cleaning, and verification pipelines with structured reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据质量检查：数据画像、清洗与验证流水线，产出结构化报告。

description.en: Evidence-list completeness check: maps facts to evidence and reports gaps with rule IDs.
description.zh: 证据清单齐备性核对：把待证事实映射到证据并输出缺口与规则 ID。

description.en: Joins two spreadsheets on a declared key and compares declared fields within declared tolerances, producing a Markdown report, a JSON result and a diff workbook. It reports differences; it does not adjudicate them.
description.zh: 按声明的主键连接两张表，按声明字段与容差比对，输出 Markdown 报告、JSON 结果与差异工作簿。只报告差异，不裁决对错。

description.en: Checks an FMEA worksheet for element completeness and for the arithmetic that follows from it - severity, occurrence and detection against the resulting risk priority number - following published FMEA method standards. Reports inconsistencies; it does not judge whether the ratings themselves are appropriate.
description.zh: 参照公开的 FMEA 方法标准，核对 FMEA 分析表的要素齐备性，以及严重度、发生度、探测度与风险顺序数之间的算术一致性。只报告不一致之处，不评价各项评分数值是否恰当。

description.en: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds built from public-source data (Tiantian Fund and Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.
description.zh: 中国公募基金确定性研究报告：采集天天基金/东方财富公开数据，纯函数计算业绩拆解、持仓穿透、风格归因与经理画像，输出带逐数字可溯源快照附录的版本化报告。

description.en: Checks an official document's type and reference number against the published party and government document format standard - including the bracket form the year is written in and the numbering pattern. Reports what does not match the format; it does not judge the document's content.
description.zh: 依据公开的党政机关公文格式标准，核对公文的文种与发文字号——包括年份所用的括号形式与编号格式。只报告与格式不符之处，不评价公文内容。

description.en: Checks a hazardous-chemical register for internal consistency: that each substance names its hazard class, that stored quantities parse, that a threshold is recorded, that the major-hazard-source verdict agrees with how the stored quantity compares to the threshold the register states, that safety data sheet numbers are present and CAS numbers are not duplicated. Reports differences for a human to review; it does not decide whether a unit constitutes a major hazard source.
description.zh: 核对危险化学品台账的内部自洽性：每种物质是否载明危险性类别、储存量能否解析、是否记录临界量、重大危险源判定与该储存量相对台账自述临界量的关系是否一致、是否载明安全技术说明书编号、CAS 号是否重复。只列出差异供人复核，不判定某单元是否构成重大危险源。

description.en: Flags ICD coding pairs that need a coder's attention - dagger and asterisk combinations, combination codes - against GB/T 14396-2016 and published ICD usage notes. Reports the pairs it finds rather than resolving them; the coding decision stays with the coder.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 14396-2016 与公开的 ICD 使用说明，提示需要编码员关注的 ICD 编码配对——剑号与星号组合、合并编码。只报告发现的配对，不代为判定，编码结论仍由编码员作出。

description.en: Checks an invoice ledger for duplicates keyed on code + number, arithmetic consistency, payer mismatch, date anomalies and template placeholders, and emits an anomaly list plus a workbook.
description.zh: 核对发票台账：按代码与号码识别重复、核对算式一致性、付款方不一致、日期异常与模板占位符，输出异常清单与工作簿。

description.en: Laya typed decisions (`noul` yes/no, `choice`, `score`) as a first-class Cordis service (`ctx.laya`) plus the model-visible `laya_ask` and `laya_plan` tools. The plugin itself installs and downloads nothing: it is a client of a `laya-mcp serve` sidecar you start yourself, and it reports that the sidecar is not running instead of failing obscurely at the first tool call.
description.zh: 把 Laya 的有类型决策（`noul` 是/否、`choice`、`score`）接成一等 Cordis 服务（`ctx.laya`）与两个模型可见工具 `laya_ask`、`laya_plan`。插件自身不安装也不下载任何东西：它是你自己启动的 `laya-mcp serve` 边车的客户端，边车未运行时会明确报出，而不是在首次工具调用时隐晦失败。

description.en: LSP action surface for DSH: diagnostics, formatting, completion, code actions, symbols, signature help, inlay hints and rename, all backed by real language servers.
description.zh: DSH 的 LSP 动作面：诊断、格式化、补全、代码动作、符号、签名提示、inlay 提示与重命名，全部由真实语言服务器驱动。

description.en: Checks a medical-record front sheet for field completeness and for internal logical contradictions between its fields, against 国卫办医发〔2016〕24号 and other published documents. Lists what is missing or inconsistent for a human to review; it does not assess clinical correctness.
description.zh: 依据国卫办医发〔2016〕24号等公开文件，核对病案首页各字段的齐备性与字段间的逻辑矛盾。列出缺失或不一致之处供人复核，不评价临床正确性。

description.en: Checks nursing records for entry timing, signatures and assessment-form completeness, against 《病历书写基本规范》 and other published documents. Reports what is missing or out of sequence for a human to review.
description.zh: 依据《病历书写基本规范》等公开文件，核对护理记录的书写时限、签名，以及评估表的完整性。列出缺失或次序不符之处供人复核。

description.en: Checks a payroll sheet against published social-insurance, housing-fund and individual-income-tax parameters, with pass, pass_with_gaps, review and fail outcomes and parameters that carry their own review date.
description.zh: 按公开的社保、公积金与个人所得税参数核对工资表，结果分为 pass、pass_with_gaps、review、fail 四档；参数本身带复核日期。

description.en: Local non-generative decision layer: phocinae_ask and phocinae_gate return typed verdicts with calibrated confidence from a small decision model, with fail-closed escalation. Needs a local phocinae-server (pip install phocinae-server) with the Phocinae-Largha-150M-v1 model on loopback port 8155.
description.zh: 本地非生成式决策层：phocinae_ask 与 phocinae_gate 由小型决策模型返回带校准置信度的类型化裁决，并对无法回答的情况 fail-closed 升级。需在本机 8155 端口运行 phocinae-server（pip 安装）并加载 Phocinae-Largha-150M-v1 模型。

description.en: Checks an electrical work permit for the elements it must carry and for the issue and permission sequence the current electrical safety regulations require. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the work was safe or whether the permit was validly authorised.
description.zh: 依据现行电力安全工作规程，核对电力工作票应载明的要素，以及签发与许可的先后顺序。只报告发现的差异，不判定作业是否安全、许可是否有效。

description.en: Checks a site safety-qualification ledger for training hours, the four required record elements, and special-operation certificate validity against the dates the person worked.
description.zh: 核对施工安全资格台账的培训学时、四个记录要素，以及特种作业证书有效期与作业时间的匹配。

description.en: Checks supervision logs for cross-day continuity and for on-site supervision coverage, against GB/T 50319-2013 and other published documents. Reports gaps and coverage differences for a human to review.
description.zh: 依据 GB/T 50319-2013 等公开文件，核对监理日志的跨日连续性，以及旁站监理的覆盖情况。列出缺漏与覆盖差异供人复核。

description.en: Converts tables in .docx, .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv and .tsv files into the table JSON consumed by the rule checkers, and reports when it could not rather than guessing.
description.zh: 把 .docx、.xlsx、.xlsm、.csv、.tsv 中的表格转换成规则核查器可读的 table JSON；识别不了时明确报告，不做猜测。

description.en: Checks a bid evaluation scoring matrix for internal arithmetic consistency: that each factor's maximum, the scores recorded and the total agree with each other. Reports the differences it finds; it does not judge whether the evaluation itself was correct or fair.
description.zh: 核对评标因素评分矩阵的内部算术自洽性：各因素分值上限、所记分值与合计之间是否互相一致。只报告发现的差异，不评价评标本身是否正确或公正。

description.en: Extracts deadlines, deposit, validity, ceiling, bid composition and copy counts from a tender document, and reports the items it did not find rather than omitting them.
description.zh: 从招标文件提取截止时间、保证金、有效期、最高限价、投标文件组成与正副本份数；未找到的项也逐条报告，不省略。

description.en: TickTick (Dida365) task bridge: a session-header task panel and curated agent tools over the official TickTick MCP endpoint.
description.zh: TickTick（滴答清单）任务桥：会话页头部任务面板与精选代理工具，走官方 TickTick MCP 端点。

description.en: Tool-output repair layer for DeepSeek Harness — JSON schema enforcement, parameter mapping, and JSON repair for tool calls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工具输出修复层：JSON Schema 校验、参数映射与 JSON 修复。

description.en: Bayesian stock prediction plugin that fuses MACD, RSI, moving-average, volume and other technical signals into an up-move posterior probability with multi-horizon comparison, trend-state classification and position risk metrics for A-share and US stocks.
description.zh: 贝叶斯个股预测插件：多指标信号融合的上涨概率估计、趋势状态识别与持仓风险度量（A 股 + 美股）。

description.en: Local-first HTML review and annotation workspace for coding agents: opens an isolated copy of a file in a browser editor, collects text edits, format changes and element/area comments, and returns a durable handoff the agent can claim and resolve.
description.zh: 面向编码代理的本地优先 HTML 审阅与标注工作区：在浏览器编辑器中打开文件的隔离副本，收集文本修改、格式调整与元素/区域评注，并把持久的交接（handoff）交还给代理认领和落实。

description.en: Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader plugin), via a `picgo_upload` tool and a `/picgo` command.
description.zh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

description.en: Browser-local audio/video toolkit for DSH — extract frames, capture thumbnails, compress images, and convert clips to GIF with FFmpeg.wasm.
description.zh: 基于 FFmpeg.wasm 的浏览器端音视频工具集，支持抽帧、截图、图片压缩与视频转 GIF。

description.en: Runs the official Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a one-shot coding subagent over print-mode stream-json, exposed as the subagent_antigravity delegation tool. Includes Gemini 4 Argon on Antigravity subscriptions. Requires the Antigravity CLI (agy 1.4+) installed and signed in.
description.zh: 把 Google 官方 Antigravity CLI（agy）作为一次性编码子智能体接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供 subagent_antigravity 委派工具，可直接使用 Gemini 4 Argon 等 Antigravity 订阅模型。需安装并登录 Antigravity CLI（agy 1.4+）。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to MCP Bids public US federal opportunities and connected TED notices, with source-linked document tools and personal API-key authentication.
description.zh: 使用个人 API 密钥，将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 MCP Bids 的美国联邦公开采购机会、TED 公告和来源文件工具。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to MCPTender public Russian procurement records, source documents and published contract suppliers using a personal service API key.
description.zh: 使用个人服务 API 密钥，将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 MCPTender 的俄罗斯公开采购记录、来源文件及已公布合同供应商。

description.en: View and manage an agent’s tools and skills in a visual menu. Set each capability to Resident, On-demand, or Disabled; agents can find and use on-demand capabilities while reducing context usage.
description.zh: 以可视化菜单查看和管理 Agent 的工具与技能，按常驻、按需、禁用三档控制能力暴露；支持按需检索和使用，减少上下文占用。

description.en: Answers Dark Souls III questions from your own Windows PC save (default `%APPDATA%\DarkSoulsIII\*\DS30000.sl2`): level and stats, current area, bonfires/rings/spells/covenants counted by family, kill state for the 24 bosses, and Steam achievements when Steam is installed - exposed as model tools plus a progress pill beside the composer and a 19-area sidebar page with next-step suggestions. The save stays read-only and is parsed locally by a bundled Python 3 script; Python 3 and the `cryptography` package must be installed, and the game data ships with the plugin.
description.zh: 读你自己的《黑暗之魂3》Windows 存档（默认 `%APPDATA%\DarkSoulsIII\*\DS30000.sl2`）回答问题：等级与属性、当前区域、按家族统计的篝火/戒指/法术/誓约完成度、24 个 Boss 的击杀状态，装有 Steam 时还包括 Steam 成就；以模型工具提供，另配输入框旁的进度药丸和 19 区域侧栏页。存档只读，由随包提供的 Python 3 脚本本地解析；运行前需装好 Python 3 与 `cryptography`，游戏数据随插件分发。

description.en: Offline HAR diagnostics with endpoint aliases, original entry indexes and minimal HTML/JSON evidence; no recording or request replay.
description.zh: 离线分析 HAR，以端点别名、原始条目索引和最小 HTML/JSON 证据定位请求问题；不录制或重放请求。

description.en: Adds an http_probe tool for endpoint health checks: status code, latency and key response headers, using HEAD with GET fallback; response bodies are never downloaded.
description.zh: 为 agent 增加 http_probe 工具：探测 HTTP(S) 端点的状态码、延迟与关键响应头，HEAD 被拒时自动降级 GET，不下载响应体。

description.en: Read-only CSV/XLSX comparison by business keys, with offline review decisions, comments and source-verified feedback handoffs.
description.zh: 按业务主键对齐 CSV/XLSX 改动，离线记录审阅结论与批注，核对源文件后生成反馈交接包。

description.en: Reproducible science workbench: agent-driven cells, inline figures with feedback/rerun, manifest provenance, environment snapshots, and publication-grade figure skills (9 bio_* tools + workbench UI).
description.zh: 可复现科学分析工作台：agent 驱动的 cell、内联图形与反馈重画、manifest 溯源、环境快照与出版级出图技能（9 个 bio_* 工具 + 工作台界面）。

description.en: Live hotel and flight prices from Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, Traveloka and other booking sites, through the remote PriceWin MCP server (no account or API key), plus a travel-search skill. In the Web UI the results show as cards: hotel photo, rating, stay total and one linked price per site; flights with times, stops and each site's fare. Search details are sent to mcp.price.win.
description.zh: 通过远程 PriceWin MCP 服务器（无需账号或 API key）实时比较 Booking.com、Agoda、Trip.com、Traveloka 等预订网站的酒店与机票价格，并附带旅行搜索 skill。在 Web 界面中结果以卡片呈现：酒店照片、评分、整段住宿总价及各网站带链接的价格；航班显示起降时间、经停与各网站票价。搜索条件会发送到 mcp.price.win。

description.en: Delegates self-contained coding subtasks to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Agent SDK and returns the result to the host session. Nineteen per-call parameters control model, thinking effort, permission mode, allowed tools, turn count and budget cap; background jobs return a jobId immediately and stream incremental output; the result carries a session handle that can be passed back as resume to continue the same conversation; commands expected to run past ~20 seconds go through the built-in mcp__dsh__shell channel, which streams output line by line without consuming model context; a Claude Code monitor panel in the session lists jobs, renders the structured process, shows live output blocks and cancels a run; the delegation procedure ships as a runtime-registered skill, so installing the plugin installs the skill.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码子任务委派给本机 Claude Code（官方 Agent SDK 驱动），结果回传主会话：19 个参数可按次控制模型、思考强度、权限模式、允许工具、轮次与预算上限；后台作业立即返回 jobId 并支持增量读取；结果附会话句柄，传回 resume 即可在同一会话续跑；预计超过 20 秒的命令经内置 mcp__dsh__shell 通道逐行实时输出，不占用模型上下文；会话内附 Claude Code 监控面板（任务列表、结构化过程视图、实时输出块、一键取消）；委派规程以运行时技能注册，安装插件即安装技能。

description.en: Per-session switches for which tools a DSH conversation may call, plus a guest mode that keeps file tools inside the workspace and turns off shell and subagents.
description.zh: 按会话开关 DSH 工具，并提供让文件操作只落在工作区、同时关闭 shell 与子代理的访客模式。

description.en: Cooperative timeout guard for ask_user_question: lost or unanswered questions resolve as a structured ASK_TIMEOUT instead of hanging the turn forever.
description.zh: 为 ask_user_question 提供协作式超时守卫：提问卡片丢失或用户未答复时以结构化 ASK_TIMEOUT 结束调用，避免回合无限挂起。

description.en: Adds a squeeze tool: the agent hands a long web page, a batch of pages, a text file or a text PDF (via pdftotext) plus one question to a helper model and gets back only the answer, so the material never enters the chat. A settings page picks up to three helper models from the DSH model list, each with a nickname, a fixed thinking level and a "when to use" note, with optional fallback and size limits taken from each model's context window.
description.zh: 新增 squeeze 工具：Agent 把长网页、多个网页、文本文件或含文本层的 PDF（借助 pdftotext）连同一个问题交给辅助模型阅读，只把答案带回对话，原文不进入上下文。设置页可从 DSH 模型列表选择最多三个辅助模型，各配昵称、固定思考强度与“何时使用”说明，支持可选的回退，并按各模型的上下文窗口自动计算体积上限。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the QianYuan MCP server, a shared record of pitfalls other agents already hit and results they already produced, plus capability lookup. Exposes 13 tools named mcp__qianyuan__*. Reads are open and need no key.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入乾元 MCP 服务器——其中存着其他 Agent 已经踩过的坑与已经跑出的结果，并提供能力检索。共暴露 13 个工具，名为 mcp__qianyuan__*。读取开放，无需密钥。

plugins.name: dsh-github-link

description.en: Links the current DeepSeek account in DSH to a GitHub identity through the local GitHub CLI, a personal access token, or OAuth device flow, then exposes a scoped github tool for listing repositories and reading, creating, or commenting on issues.
description.zh: 把 DSH 中当前 DeepSeek 账号与本机 GitHub 身份关联，支持本机 GitHub CLI、Personal Access Token 和 OAuth 设备授权，并提供受控的 github 工具用于列出仓库、读取或创建 Issue、发表评论。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Study companion for your materials with guided practice, evidence-grounded feedback, Leitner spaced review, 18 teacher tools, and a Chinese/English student panel using the current DSH session model; requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0, Python 3.11+, and Python runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 面向自选资料的学习陪练，使用当前 DSH 会话模型，提供引导练习、证据反馈、Leitner 间隔复习、18 个教师工具与中英双语学生面板；要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0、Python 3.11+ 及 Python 运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-qixin-insight-mcp-oauth

description.en: Connects the Qixin Insight MCP server over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE as a single plugin entry, mounting its tools as mcp__qixin_insight__* with automatic token refresh and revocation on disconnect.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 授权接入启信慧眼 MCP 服务，以单条插件条目把它的工具挂载为 mcp__qixin_insight__*，token 到期前自动刷新，断开时吊销。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Windows-only Computer Use plugin for DeepSeek Harness with UIA, cua-driver, and optional GLM vision.
description.zh: 适用于 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness Computer Use 插件，支持 UIA、cua-driver 和可选 GLM 视觉。

description.en: Adds a calculate tool backed by a hand-written parser with no eval, batch evaluation and an exact-decimal mode for money math.
description.zh: 为 agent 提供 calculate 工具，内置零依赖表达式解析器（不用 eval），支持批量求值与金额精确小数模式。

description.en: Unreal Engine .uasset inspection (resolve/registry/load) and restricted Blueprint node editing through built-in UE Python.
description.zh: 通过 Unreal 内置 Python 提供 .uasset 检查与受限蓝图节点编辑。

description.en: Native Graphify knowledge graph plugin providing 10 code intelligence tools, topological search, god nodes discovery, and PR blast radius triage.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Graphify 知识图谱支持，包含 10 个代码智能工具、拓扑搜索、核心节点发现与 PR 影响分析。

description.en: Folds the tool-definition prompt surface when many MCP servers are installed: a static KV-cache-stable catalog plus BM25/bge-m3 hybrid tools_search and batch tools_schema expansion, so hundreds of tools stay discoverable without spending their full schemas every turn.
description.zh: 装了大量 MCP 时折叠工具定义提示面：KV 缓存稳定的静态目录 + BM25/bge-m3 混合 tools_search + tools_schema 批量展开，几百个工具仍可检索，但不必每轮都付完整 schema 的 token。

description.en: Commander mode for the dsh web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.
description.zh: dsh 网页端指挥官模式：会话标题栏一键注入协议简报，解析模型回复中的任务块并自动执行，让策略层与执行层分离；通过徽章按钮激活/停用。

description.en: Run the local Cursor CLI agent on a coding task in a workspace and continue the run by chat id.
description.zh: 把编码任务交给本机 Cursor CLI 代理在工作目录中执行，并可按 chat id 续跑。

description.en: Retrieval and planning toolkit for the BeiShan Besson Minecraft modding tutorials site: 7 tools to search 194 indexed tutorials, plan learning routes, compare version environments, and fetch article text.
description.zh: 北山 Besson Minecraft 模组开发教程检索与规划工具包：7 个工具检索 194 篇教程文章、规划学习路线、对比版本环境差异并抓取文章正文。

plugins.name: dsh-Alist-

description.en: AList v3 file management: browse, search, upload (streamed and multipart), offline downloads, archive listing, task polling and control, plus admin tools for storages, users, roles, meta rules, settings, search index, shares and labels - 75 tools in total; every write goes through the approval flow and passwords are never read back.
description.zh: AList v3 文件管理插件：浏览、搜索、上传（本地文件流式与 multipart）、离线下载、压缩包查看、任务轮询与控制，以及存储、用户、角色、元数据、站点设置、搜索索引、分享、标签等管理端操作，共 75 个工具；全部写操作强制走审批，密码与 Token 只写不读。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: miran-fann-dsh

description.en: Motion graphics from a dsh session through the Miran Fann engine over MCP, with a Miran settings page and motion-design skills. Requires the Miran Fann engine installed separately (npx miran-fann setup) and a signed-in install.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 调用 Miran Fann 引擎，在 dsh 会话里做动态图形，附带 Miran 设置页与动效设计技能。需单独安装 Miran Fann 引擎（npx miran-fann setup）并登录。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-jev-plugin

description.en: A `jev` tool that asks Jev (TypeSafe System One) typed yes/no, choice and score questions about one block of text and returns probabilities and confidence, with the provider and API key configured per user in Settings, a judgment ledger with its spend, and daily call and token caps.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 `jev` 工具：就同一段文本向 Jev（TypeSafe System One）提出是/否、选择和评分问题，返回概率与置信度；provider 与 API key 在设置中按用户配置，并带判定账本、花费统计以及每日调用与 token 上限。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Registers a read-only tool that lets a parent agent read what each subagent is actually doing, not just whether it is running: the progress notes the child wrote itself, oldest first, paged backwards by seq, plus how many steps passed since the last look, and a quiet count when five or more steps go by with no new note.
description.zh: 注册一个只读工具，让父代理读到每个子代理实际在做什么，而不只是它有没有在跑：子代理自己写下的进度旁白，时间早的在前，按序号向前翻页，给出距上次查看已过去多少步，并在连续五步以上没有新旁白时给出沉默计数。

description.en: US stock quotes, price history, financial statements, analyst consensus and news via yahoo-finance2.
description.zh: 美股行情、历史 K 线、财务报表、分析师共识与新闻，数据来自 yahoo-finance2。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar plugin that compares two git commits, builds a manual-test checklist from the impact scope, and supports fail notes, screenshots, task attachments, and defect submission to Yunxiao, GitHub, GitLab, or a webhook.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏插件：对比两个 git 提交，根据影响面生成手测清单，支持失败备注、截图、任务附件，以及向云效 / GitHub / GitLab / Webhook 提交缺陷。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-9router

description.en: 9router-backed web search and fetch for DeepSeek Harness. Enabling the bundle automatically routes native web_search/web_fetch tools to 9router; disabling it restores the remaining provider configuration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 9router 网页搜索与抓取。启用插件包后自动接管原生 web_search/web_fetch，停用后恢复其余配置层的提供方选择。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds your own Recued server as an MCP server, so the agent can read your notes, tasks and the things you own and propose changes that wait for your approval in Recued.
description.zh: 把你自己搭建的 Recued 服务器接成 MCP 服务，让 agent 读取你的笔记、任务与物品，并提交需要你在 Recued 里确认的修改。

description.en: LibTV canvas and media tools for DeepSeek Harness, with three director skills bundled and one-time WeChat QR authorization.
description.zh: 把 LibTV 的画布与媒体生成能力接进 DeepSeek Harness，随包附带三个导演技能，首次使用微信扫码授权一次即可。

description.en: Reference search for DeepSeek Harness: refkit_search looks up image, video, audio and text references across 24 open sources and tags each result with its normalized license and a use verdict for the intended use; refkit_rights re-checks one license against another use. Source keys and search tuning live on a settings page. 11 of the 24 sources need API keys; the use verdict is returned only when an intended use is passed.
