Runs on DSH ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2 (tested on 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的参考素材检索插件：refkit_search 在 24 个开放来源中检索图片、视频、音频和文本参考素材，为每条结果标注规范化的许可证和针对用途的可用性判定；refkit_rights 针对另一种用途复核单条许可证。来源 key 与检索参数在设置页配置。24 个来源中 11 个需要 API key；仅在传入用途时返回可用性判定。支持 DSH ^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.1-rc.2（实测 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2）。

description.en: Hides tool schemas from the model's prefill and reveals one tool at a time through a decision model API. Requires a running decision-model API endpoint and pnpm on PATH.
description.zh: 通过决策模型 API 把工具 schema 从模型 prefill 中隐藏，每次按需揭示一个工具。需运行决策模型 API 端点，且 PATH 中有 pnpm。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-knowra

description.en: Connects the hosted Knowra MCP server: search arXiv papers by topic, author or exact UTC dates without an account, and sign in with OAuth from the plugin page to read Scout reports on methods, evidence and limitations.
description.zh: 接入 Knowra 托管 MCP：无需账号即可按主题、作者或精确 UTC 日期检索 arXiv 论文；在插件页用 OAuth 登录后可读取 Scout 报告（方法、证据与局限）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Hash-anchored read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit tools: every line gets a unique 3-character content hash, edits target hashes instead of line numbers, and served-state verification rejects stale ranges with fresh anchors.
description.zh: 基于哈希锚定的 read / edit / batch_edit / undo_last_edit 工具：每行分配唯一的 3 字符内容哈希，编辑按哈希而非行号定位；对已提供状态逐行校验，过期范围会被拒绝并回传新锚点。

description.en: Windows bash tool for DeepSeek Harness: replaces the preset pwsh with Git for Windows or MSYS2 (UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64/...) bash while keeping the official terminal contract — workdir, background jobs and timeout promotion, result markers, terminal cards — and adds a settings row that discovers and validates Git/MSYS2 installations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows bash 工具：用 Git for Windows 或 MSYS2（UCRT64/MINGW64/CLANG64…）的 bash 替换预设里的 pwsh，保留官方终端契约（workdir、后台任务与超时转后台、结果标记、终端卡片），并提供一个可自动发现、校验 Git/MSYS2 安装的设置行。

description.en: Local-first code knowledge graph for coding agents: 10 MCP tools for layered context compression, DAG planning, incremental AST indexing, a cross-session skill flywheel, diagnostics, and graph artifact import/export.
description.zh: 面向编程 Agent 的本地代码知识图谱：提供 10 个 MCP 工具，覆盖分层上下文压缩、DAG 规划、增量 AST 建图、跨会话技能飞轮、诊断与图谱产物导入导出。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Postel over MCP: search a library of X posts that went viral by topic, write posts and X threads in the user's saved voice, and save, schedule or publish them to X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and Mastodon; adds a postel-writing skill. Research works without an API key.
description.zh: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Postel over MCP: search a library of X posts that went viral by topic, write posts and X threads in the user's saved voice, and save, schedule or publish them to X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and Mastodon; adds a postel-writing skill. Research works without an API key.

description.en: Pi-style append-only multi-branch session trees: fork or jump to any historical node without deleting history, clone a branch into a new session, and browse the tree in a WebUI panel. Works on stock Harness via graceful degradation.
description.zh: Pi 风格的追加式多分支会话树:在任意历史节点开分支或跳转而不删除旧历史,可将分支克隆为新会话,并在 WebUI 树面板中浏览(明暗主题)。在原版 Harness 上优雅降级运行。

description.en: Local 3D studio orchestration: detects Blender, COLMAP and ComfyUI on every run and picks the route they support, and also ships a Three.js fallback that generates models from primitive specs, edits or scales GLB files, writes an offline viewer page and renders multi-view PNGs without Blender.
description.zh: 本地三维工作室编排：每次调用都现场探测 Blender、COLMAP 与 ComfyUI 并按其支持情况选路线；另带 Three.js 兜底通道，可按图元描述生成模型、修改或缩放 GLB、生成离线预览页并在没有 Blender 时渲染多视角 PNG。

description.en: Requires Python 3.12+; Xiaohongshu reading needs the xiaohongshu-mcp backend and a QR sign-in (ffmpeg/OCR optional). Batch-read Xiaohongshu notes and WeChat public-account articles: per-note body, image text via local OCR, video frame text and comment samples, structured JSON/Markdown output, and the original source URL on every result. Read-only: it never publishes, likes, follows or comments.
description.zh: 需 Python 3.12+；小红书需 xiaohongshu-mcp 后端并扫码登录（OCR/ffmpeg 可选）。批量抓取小红书笔记与微信公众号文章：逐篇取正文、图片文字（本地 OCR）、视频抽帧文字与评论样本，输出结构化 JSON/Markdown，每条结果带原文链接。只读，不发布、不点赞、不关注、不评论。

description.en: Mounts the hosted Reaudit MCP server (https://mcp.reaudit.io/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge with a REAUDIT_API_KEY bearer token: 238 mcp__reaudit__* tools for brand visibility in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews), competitor and citation analysis, site audits, content generation and social scheduling.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接挂载托管的 Reaudit MCP 服务（https://mcp.reaudit.io/mcp），用 REAUDIT_API_KEY 做 bearer 鉴权：238 个 mcp__reaudit__* 工具，覆盖品牌在 AI 回答里的可见度（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Google AI Overviews）、竞品与引用分析、站点审计、内容生成与社媒排期。

description.en: Right-sidebar basket that collects the files a session produced or changed without the agent having to register them, with preview, zip packaging, and one-click archiving.
description.zh: 右侧栏「鱼篓」不用 agent 登记，自动汇总本场会话产出或改动的文件，支持预览、一键打包 zip 与归档。

description.en: Rotifer Protocol skills plus the Rotifer MCP server, configured as instances of DSH's own skill provider and MCP client: search Genes, compare them on Arena rankings, install or roll back Genes in the local project, and create and run local Agents. The MCP server is version-pinned and limited to its evolve tool set, which leaves out publishing and login.
description.zh: Rotifer 协议的技能包加 Rotifer MCP 服务，以 DSH 自带的技能提供器与 MCP 客户端实例的形式挂载：搜索 Gene、按 Arena 排名比较、在本地项目里安装或回滚 Gene，并创建和运行本地 Agent。MCP 服务锁定版本，只开放 evolve 工具集，不含发布与登录。

description.en: GitHub Trending radar inside the Harness Web UI: fetches the daily, weekly or monthly board (optionally filtered by a language), analyzes each repository into description, star gain, tech stack, highlights and risks, renders the result as a filterable card panel with paging, and registers the github_trending tool plus the /github-trending command.
description.zh: Harness Web UI 里的 GitHub 趋势雷达：抓取日榜/周榜/月榜（可按编程语言筛选），把每个仓库分析成简介、star 增量、技术栈、亮点与风险，渲染为可筛选、可分页的卡片面板，并注册 github_trending 工具与 /github-trending 命令。

description.en: Model-facing weather tool that queries current conditions and 7-day forecasts from public Open-Meteo APIs, with no API key required.
description.zh: 面向模型的天气工具，基于公开 Open-Meteo API 查询当前天气与 7 天预报，无需 API Key。

description.en: Read-only CAD tools that inspect, extract and export DWG/DXF drawings, including SVG and PNG previews and DXF conversion.
description.zh: 只读 CAD 工具：查看、提取 DWG/DXF 图纸，导出 SVG/PNG 预览或转换 DXF。

description.en: Turn-level file undo for tool writes and edits: each file is snapshotted before the write lands, and the model (an undo tool), the human (a /undo command) or a button in the assistant message action row can roll back every file a turn changed. Snapshots are written in-process rather than by shelling out, so it needs no extra sandbox permission in sessions confined to workspace-write.
description.zh: 按轮次回退工具写入/编辑造成的文件改动：落盘前先快照，模型（undo 工具）、人（/undo 命令）或助手消息动作行里的按钮都能一次退回一整轮改动过的所有文件。快照在进程内写入、不 fork shell，因此在 workspace-write 这类受限会话里无需额外权限放宽。

description.en: Runs a Claude Code project's .claude/ slash commands and permissions.deny rules inside DeepSeek Harness. Command bodies expand $ARGUMENTS, positional arguments and @file references into the agent's next turn; matching tool calls are denied before they run. Every host service is probed, so a host without a command registry, working-directory service or TUI status line degrades one feature instead of failing the boot.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里运行 Claude Code 项目的 .claude/ 斜杠命令与 permissions.deny 规则。命令正文会把 $ARGUMENTS、位置参数与 @文件引用展开进模型的下一轮；命中的工具调用在执行前被拒绝。所有宿主服务都做探测：缺命令注册表、工作目录服务或 TUI 状态行时只降级一个功能，不会让宿主启动失败。

description.en: Offline, deterministic public API catalog search for DeepSeek Harness, with Chinese and English queries plus exact filters for authentication, HTTPS, CORS, status, source tier, and category.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的离线确定性公共 API 目录检索，支持中英文查询，以及认证、HTTPS、CORS、状态、来源层级与分类的精确筛选。

description.en: Unit conversion as a `convert` tool: 10 categories (length, area, volume, time, angle, speed, temperature, pressure, energy/heat, power) and 82 units with English and Chinese aliases, plus a locale-aware Unit Converter tab in the DSH web view with one module per category and a temperature-difference (Δ) switch.
description.zh: 单位换算：提供 convert 工具，覆盖长度/面积/体积/时间/角度/速度/温度/压力/热量/功率十大类共 82 个单位，支持中英文单位名与温差（Δ）换算，并在 DSH Web 会话视图中提供按类别分模块、跟随中英文界面语言的「单位换算」标签页。

description.en: Windows system-drive (C:) cleanup for DSH: rule-based scan, five-tier safety grading, a staging area with a rollback ledger, UAC elevation, and migration to another drive — a model tool plus a Web GUI panel.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 系统盘（C 盘）清理能力：按规则库扫描、五级安全分级、带台账可回滚的暂存区、UAC 提权与迁移到其他盘 —— 既有模型工具，也有 Web 面板。

description.en: A webfetch tool for full-text web/Toutiao articles: 3-tier strategy (direct fetch → resident Edge CDP headless browser → dump-dom fallback), with automatic Toutiao anti-bot challenge handling plus a bundled experience skill.
description.zh: 读网页/头条文章全文的 webfetch 工具：三级策略（直连 → Edge 常驻无头浏览器 CDP → dump-dom 兜底），自动识别头条反爬质询页，附 toutiao-reader 实战经验技能。

plugins.name: dsh-everything

description.en: Whole-disk file search tool backed by the local Everything (voidtools) index: millisecond path queries for the agent over a loopback-only HTTP fast channel with es.exe fallback, plus verified auto-install of the latest stable Everything + ES CLI backend (signature-checked, proxy-aware). Windows only.
description.zh: 基于本机 Everything（voidtools）索引的全盘文件搜索工具：通过仅回环监听的 HTTP 快速通道（es.exe 兜底）为 Agent 提供毫秒级路径查询；后端缺失时自动下载并校验安装最新稳定版 Everything 与 ES CLI（验签名、支持代理）。仅支持 Windows。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 1.1.0.37 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-bili-watch

description.en: Reads bilibili video as structured text for AI: metadata, comments, danmaku, subtitles, local ASR, frame OCR. Local processing (no cloud upload), decoy-subtitle detection with frame check, instant re-reads via cache, AI-ready manifest + summary. Frame OCR needs ffmpeg; local ASR/OCR need Python 3.10+ venvs (plus the VC++ runtime on Windows); AI subtitles need a Bilibili login.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频解析成模型可消费的结构化内容：元数据、评论、弹幕、字幕、本地 ASR 转写、抽帧 OCR。本地跑不上传、字幕诱饵检测（可疑时抽帧核对）、二次读瞬时、输出 manifest + 摘要。抽帧 OCR 需 ffmpeg；本地 ASR/OCR 需 Python 3.10+ 虚拟环境（Windows 另需 VC++ 运行库）；AI 字幕需登录 B 站。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 223.5.5.5 for network access

description.en: ClickHouse query tools for DSH, targeting ClickHouse alone: seven tools that list databases, tables and columns, sample rows, search columns by name, show EXPLAIN plans, and run single read-only SQL statements behind a client-side guard that rejects writes, multi-statement SQL, cross-table queries and external table functions. Single-table by default: the query parameter is used as given, with no built-in multi-step business flow. Zero runtime dependencies; it tells the model to backtick non-ASCII aliases instead of failing with a bare syntax error on older servers.
description.zh: DSH 的 ClickHouse 数据问答工具：七个工具负责列库表字段、抽样、按字段名反查、看 EXPLAIN 计划，以及执行带客户端只读护栏的单条 SQL（拒绝写操作、多语句、跨表查询与外部表函数）。默认单表查询：用户给什么参数就用什么参数，不内置任何多步业务流程。零运行时依赖；遇到老版本服务器会提示中文别名要加反引号，而不是只报一个语法错误。

description.en: Project .pack.json/.pack.zip into .agent-pack/modpacks/ and expose skills via a workspace allow-list.
description.zh: 把 .pack.json/.pack.zip 投影到 .agent-pack/modpacks/，按工作区白名单暴露 skill。

description.en: Nexterm fleet maintenance in a DSH session: 6 agent tools (auth with password/TOTP/device-code login, fleet listing, single-host exec, parallel batch exec, preset health checks, CPU/memory/disk monitoring) over the Nexterm REST API, plus a minimal settings page; no SSH private keys needed on the DSH machine.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中运维 Nexterm 托管的 SSH 机群：6 个 agent 工具（密码/TOTP/设备授权码登录认证、机群清单、单机执行、批量并行执行、预设健康检查、CPU/内存/磁盘监控），全走 Nexterm REST API，附极简设置页；DSH 机器上无需任何 SSH 私钥。

description.en: Qichacha (企查查) enterprise data source as a dynamic Cordis plugin: 5 agent tools (auth with QR login, company search, knowledge search, tool search, tool execute) covering 100+ data dimensions (business registration, shareholders, judicial, IP), plus a settings-page account manager; network/file IO via DSH subprocess spawning node -e, credentials interop with the local BizOwl client.
description.zh: 企查查企业数据源动态 Cordis 插件：5 个 agent 工具（扫码登录认证、企业快搜、知识库检索、工具发现、取数执行），覆盖工商/股东/司法/知识产权等 100+ 数据维度，附设置页账号管理；网络与文件 IO 经 DSH subprocess 拉起 node -e 完成，凭证与本地 BizOwl 客户端互通。

description.en: MuApi media-generation tool: a muapi_generate tool that submits and polls jobs against any of MuApi's 100+ image, video, audio, and 3D models through one x-api-key.
description.zh: MuApi 媒体生成工具：muapi_generate 工具通过一个 x-api-key 提交并轮询 MuApi 100 多个图片、视频、音频与 3D 模型的生成任务。

description.en: ADB device & bench operations for DSH: device discovery, structured logcat (background streaming), apk install, file pull/push, and dumpsys performance snapshots.
description.zh: ADB 设备·台架运维工具集：设备发现、结构化 logcat（后台采集）、apk 安装、文件 pull/push、性能快照。

description.en: Converts Mermaid flowcharts into GB/T 1526-1989 (ISO 5807) compliant SVG through one model-facing tool, with optional A4/A3 pagination.
description.zh: 把 Mermaid 流程图转成符合 GB/T 1526-1989（等同 ISO 5807）图形符号的 SVG，可选用 A4/A3 幅面自动分页。

description.en: Batch recursive extraction: magic-byte format detection (disguised extensions), nested archive auto-unroll, multi-password pool with per-layer dynamic discovery, SFX/split-volume pairing.
description.zh: 批量递归解压：魔数识别真实格式（伪装后缀/无后缀/乱序后缀）、嵌套压缩包自动解到底、多密码池+层内动态发现（"第二层密码:xxx"）、SFX/分卷自动配对、工具运行库目录防误递归。

description.en: Computer Use for macOS desktop applications: reads any app's accessibility tree as text with element indices, then clicks, types, pastes, scrolls, drags, selects text and sets values through it, plus screenshots read back as images. Driven by a persistent JavaScript REPL — the agent gets two tools (`js`, `js_reset`) and calls an `sky` API inside them, so state survives between calls and the tool schema stays fixed as capabilities grow. Accessibility trees come back as diffs after the first read; actions address elements by index and indices from a stale read are refused rather than misapplied; typing waits for keyboard focus and reads the field back; paste restores the clipboard. Requires macOS 14.4+, Accessibility permission (Screen Recording only for screenshots) and Node 20+; ships a prebuilt native module, so nothing compiles at install time.
description.zh: macOS 桌面应用 Computer Use 插件：以文本读取任意应用的无障碍树与元素索引，并据此点击、输入、粘贴、滚动、拖拽、选择文本与赋值，截图可回传为图片。由常驻 JavaScript REPL 驱动——智能体只拿到两个工具（`js`、`js_reset`），在其中调用 `sky` API，因此状态跨调用保持、能力增长时工具 schema 保持稳定。无障碍树在首次读取后以 diff 返回；动作按索引寻址，过期索引会被拒绝而非错用；输入前等待键盘焦点并回读输入框；粘贴会恢复剪贴板。需 macOS 14.4+、辅助功能权限（截图另需屏幕录制）与 Node 20+；随包提供预编译原生模块，安装时不需编译。

description.en: Ships the Zhouli-mode agent preset, which runs a session in three phases (declaring roles on opening, citing authorities while working, a six-item self-audit at the close), plus one tool with seven actions over a bundled 49,384-character 《周礼》 corpus that returns every passage with a stable 篇序.职官序 coordinate, a per-office establishment index and collation between two Kanripo witnesses.
description.zh: 主打「周礼模式」agent 预设：会话分三段依六官法度而行——开工「设官分职」、事中「依典援据」、收尾「岁终之会」依六计考成。另附 zhouli 工具，七种检索动作，检索内置 49,384 字《周礼》语料，每条结果带稳定坐标（篇序.职官序），含职官员额索引与 Kanripo 两本互校勘记。

description.en: A plugin for managing MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness内管理MCP服务的插件。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-deepsearch

description.en: Switch DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API (/v1/tools/search) and the default account search, with automatic fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.
description.zh: 给 DSH 内置 web_search 加一个开关：在 DeepSeek Search API（/v1/tools/search）与默认账号搜索之间切换，失败自动回退，并带设置页与侧栏开关。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Exposes Cue public data MCP services to DeepSeek Harness: 15 streamable-http domains (~104 tools) for regulatory, macro, disclosures, statute, holdings, entity, academic, IPO, ESOP, buyback, footnote and fact-index data as native mcp__cue_<domain>__* tools.
description.zh: 向 DeepSeek Harness 暴露 Cue 公开数据 MCP 服务：15 个 streamable-http 域（约 104 工具），覆盖制裁/宏观/披露/法规/持仓/主体/学术/IPO/ESOP/回购/脚注/事实索引，以原生 mcp__cue_<domain>__* 工具提供。

description.en: Cue Omni Reader for DeepSeek Harness: registers the audited omni-reader-mcp MCP server so its URL/file parse tools surface as mcp__omni__ (parse, get_parse_status, read_result, read_outline, save_result, discard_result, cancel_parse).
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Cue Omni Reader：接入审校版 omni-reader-mcp MCP 服务，把 URL/文件解析工具以 mcp__omni__ 暴露（parse、get_parse_status、read_result、read_outline、save_result、discard_result、cancel_parse）。

description.en: One-click optimization of a raw instruction into a professional prompt: three output styles, situation-aware role/task/goal profiling, multi-sample selection scored by a model judge, self-iterating learning (session memory + smart defaults + user overrides), /template for 22 sub-scenes with zero model calls, input-box ✨ one-click optimize/undo, prompt_optimize tool, auto-optimize hook, a runtime status page, a settings panel (dsh 0.2.0) and auto-detected zh/en documents.
description.zh: 把原始指令一键优化为专业提示词——支持三种输出形态、情境感知画像、多采样择优（模型判官评分）、自迭代学习，以及 /template 等命令与一键工具/钩子/状态页/设置面板/自动语言。

description.en: Bidirectional bridge between Hermes Agent and DeepSeek Harness: dispatch_task with UI-visible sessions in the DSH sidebar, session mirroring, and 10 DSH-to-Hermes tools.
description.zh: Hermes Agent 与 DeepSeek Harness 的双向桥：派单任务以 UI 可见会话出现在 DSH 侧边栏，支持会话镜像与 10 个 DSH→Hermes 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-computer-use

description.en: Computer use for DeepSeek Harness: js and js_reset tools that read windows, click, type, and screenshot macOS apps through the locally installed ChatGPT app. Apple Silicon macOS only; requires the ChatGPT desktop app.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 computer use：js 与 js_reset 工具通过本机安装的 ChatGPT 应用读取窗口、点击、输入与截屏（macOS）。仅 Apple Silicon macOS，需已装 ChatGPT 桌面版。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Export diagram-design HTML diagrams to SVG/PNG, extract draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw structure, validate output, and browse 45 diagram types. Built on cathrynlavery/diagram-design (MIT); needs python3, and PNG export additionally needs Playwright.
description.zh: 将 diagram-design 图表导出为 SVG/PNG，提取 draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw 结构，校验输出，并浏览 45 种图表类型。基于 cathrynlavery/diagram-design（MIT），需 python3，导出 PNG 还需 Playwright。

description.en: Encrypted, scheduled backup and restore of a DSH profile — plugins, settings, skills, UI preferences and optional MCP connector or API keys — to S3-compatible storage, WebDAV or a local folder.
description.zh: 把 DSH 配置档案（插件、设置、技能、界面偏好与可选的 MCP 连接器或 API Key）加密定时备份到 S3 兼容存储、WebDAV 或本地目录，恢复时自动重装缺失的插件。

description.en: Companion sidebar panel for the Kaipu site plugin: shows the built-in advisory team and seat status. Install together with kaipu-platform — seat data comes from the site plugin's gateway endpoints; a standalone install honestly reports "channel not ready". Removable: uninstall it and the site plugin stays fully usable.
description.zh: 山海·开铺 智囊团插件：配套侧边面板，展示内置谋士团队与席位状态。需与 kaipu-platform 一起安装——灯位数据由开铺插件经网关提供，单独安装会如实显示「通道未就绪」。可摘除：卸掉它，开铺仍完整可用。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against morluto/rea over stdio, for reverse engineering anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥，经 stdio 连接 morluto/rea，让 agent 从应用行为一路逆向到底层原生二进制。

description.en: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP, excluding PowerShell, FileSystem, Registry, Process and Scrape by default (16 of the 21 tools upstream 0.8.8 publishes). Requires uv on PATH.
description.zh: 纯配置型 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用本体自带的 MCP 客户端桥接 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP，默认排除 PowerShell、FileSystem、Registry、Process、Scrape（上游 0.8.8 共 21 个工具，保留 16 个）。需要 uv 在 PATH 上。

description.en: Prompt-polish template injector for DSH: click ✨ in the composer to inject a "polish my prompt" template (current draft auto-embedded), no send, no network, no model — the main agent rewrites with full context. Replaces narrative-prompt-polish (2026-09-14 migration).
description.zh: 点会话输入框右座 ✨，把「打磨提示词」模板写进输入栏——当前草稿自动嵌进 `<内容>` 位置，不发送、不联网、不调模型，由当前会话的主 agent 带着全部上下文改写。替代 narrative-prompt-polish（2026-09-14 更名并整体重构）。

description.en: MCP server manager for DSH: nine mcp_manager_* tools, a CLI and a web panel that list, validate, probe, add, edit, enable/disable and remove servers in ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml, search and install servers from the official MCP Registry, and locate or rotate stored credentials.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器管理器：九个 mcp_manager_* 工具、命令行与网页面板，可列出、校验、探测、新增、编辑、启停、移除 ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml 中的服务器，从官方 MCP Registry 搜索并安装服务器，以及定位或轮换已存凭据。

description.en: Professional translation for DSH: 18 target languages, 4 styles (formal/casual/technical/literal), glossary-controlled terminology, and whole-file translation (README/docs/subtitles) with Markdown/code-block format preservation; powered by DeepSeek via SiliconFlow.
description.zh: 专业翻译：18 种目标语言、4 种风格（正式/口语/技术/直译）、术语表控制译名、整文件翻译（README/文档/字幕）并保留 Markdown 与代码块格式；经 SiliconFlow 调用 DeepSeek。

plugins.name: DM-inspect

description.en: Run a read-only Dameng DM8 database inspection with 85 checks and produce an HTML report.
description.zh: 只读巡检达梦 DM8 数据库：85 项检查项，生成 HTML 报告。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 8.1.60.80 for network access

description.en: Read-only assessment of whether a Dameng DM8 database can be recovered and to which point (LSN or time), across 16 recovery scenarios, with an HTML report. Needs Java 8+ and a Dameng JDBC driver jar (DmJdbcDriver8.jar) that you provide yourself.
description.zh: 只读评估达梦 DM8 数据库的可恢复能力：16 类恢复场景下能恢复到哪一点（LSN/时间）、要丢什么，并生成 HTML 报告。需 Java 8+，并自备达梦 DmJdbcDriver8.jar。

description.en: Answers hard questions by staging a formal debate: two adversarial subagents argue opposite sides with research, then the main agent rules on the transcript through the debate_open, debate_round, and debate_verdict tools.
description.zh: 通过一场正式辩论来回答难题：两个对抗性子代理各自调研并论证对立立场，最后由主代理依据辩论记录作出裁决，提供 debate_open、debate_round、debate_verdict 三个工具。

description.en: Sensitive-character replacement for DeepSeek Harness: matches messages and tool results against a YAML blocklist you maintain (global, per provider id, or per model) before the model reads them, and scrubs the outgoing request again before dispatch, so blocked characters cannot trip the official API Content Exists Risk 400.
description.zh: 在模型读取内容之前，按用户维护的 YAML 屏蔽表（全局 / 按 Provider ID / 按模型）替换消息与工具结果中的敏感字符，出网前再清洗一次请求，避免 DeepSeek 官方 API 的 Content Exists Risk 400。

description.en: ZCode-style enhancement of dsh plan mode: a model-initiated enter_plan_mode tool, hard interception of write-class tools at dispatch time (ctx.tools.guard) while planning, and a four-phase planning prompt section (explore, design, review, exit), reusing the official plan/mode state machine and exit review flow.
description.zh: dsh 计划模式的 ZCode 式增强：模型可主动调用 enter_plan_mode 进入计划模式，计划期间写类工具在分发前被硬拦截，并注入「探索 → 设计 → 评审 → 退出」四阶段工作流提示词；复用官方 plan/mode 状态机与退出评审流，只做增量。

description.en: Mounts external skill directories (Claude Code, Codex, ZCode) into DSH as read-only skill providers: frontmatter field mapping, name slug normalization and hot reload.
description.zh: 技能兼容层：把 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode 的技能目录挂载为 dsh 的只读技能提供方——支持 frontmatter 字段映射、名称 slug 规范化与热重载。

description.en: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official todo_write tool: priority tags on each task, full checklist rendering in the conversation, and a draggable in-session floating task panel with position memory, double-click reset and a live indicator of the action currently being executed.
description.zh: 官方 todo_write 的增强 fork：任务项支持优先级标签、会话内完整清单渲染，并提供可拖动的会话内浮动任务面板（位置记忆 / 双击复位 / 当前动作显示）。

description.en: Economic indicator lookup via World Bank open data (GDP, inflation, trade, population), no API key required.
description.zh: 世界银行开放数据经济指标查询：GDP、通胀、贸易、人口等，无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Economics-first journal/working-paper monitor for DeepSeek Harness: NBER RSS + arXiv econ (4 categories) + Chinese econ journals (Shi Jie Jing Ji via Magtech, Zhong Guo Nong Cun Guan Cha, Cai Mao Jing Ji, Zhong Guo Ren Kou Ke Xue, Jing Ji Guan Li via ajcass) fetch, keyword filter, dry-run/Webhook push, dedup persistence, and schedule_create-compatible briefing.
description.zh: 经济学优先的期刊/工作论文监控插件：NBER RSS + arXiv 经济学（4 类目）+ 中文经管期刊（世界经济-玛格泰克平台，中国农村观察/财贸经济/中国人口科学/经济管理-ajcass 平台）抓取、关键词过滤、dry-run/Webhook 推送、去重持久化、定时简报（schedule_create 兼容）。

description.en: A @-file reference tool for DSH: registers an at_file_read tool that injects workspace-file contents into the session, with traversal protection and a 50KB truncation cap (MIT).
description.zh: DSH 的 @ 文件引用工具：注册 at_file_read 工具，把工作区内文件内容注入会话，含目录穿越防护与 50KB 截断（MIT）。

description.en: Ask-before-act approval for every edit and every bash command: a red/green line diff before a file is touched, a description+command panel before a command runs — approve once or reject, each gate with its own master switch in Settings → General.
description.zh: 每次 edit 与 bash 调用前都会询问：编辑前展示红绿行级 diff，命令前展示描述与命令面板——同意一次或拒绝，两个 gate 各带独立总开关（Settings → General）。

description.en: A `search` tool that learns to pick between fast and thorough search strategies using a contextual bandit (Thompson sampling), improving from real usage instead of a fixed heuristic.
description.zh: 使用上下文赌博机算法（Thompson 采样）学习何时使用快速搜索、何时使用深度搜索的 `search` 工具。

description.en: SymPy-backed exact computation and independent verification for China's postgraduate entrance exam Mathematics I: 14 tools over 214 operators, exact symbolic results by default, and every result re-checked by a separate mechanism (requires Python 3.10+ with sympy and mpmath).
description.zh: SymPy 驱动的考研数学一精确计算与独立验证：14 个工具、214 个算子，默认返回精确符号解，并由独立机制复核每个结果（需本机 Python 3.10+ 及 sympy、mpmath）。

plugins.name: dsh-blender-plugin

description.en: Lets a DSH agent drive a local Blender over a direct TCP channel with 15 tools: viewport frames, custom-angle renders, Python execution, headless and job offload, transaction rollback, and a planning layer of 228 ops across 34 families.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 通过直连 TCP 通道驱动本地 Blender，提供 15 个工具：视口帧、自定义视角渲染、Python 执行、无头与作业卸载、事务回滚，以及 34 个 family / 228 个 op 的规划层。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Fork of fourzkw/dsh-drawai that keeps the editable .drawio canvas and its two agent tools, and adds a second vectorization engine beside the original tracer: hierarchical color clustering with Bezier spline fitting and per-channel color precision, selectable per drawing task in three fidelity levels (measured about 18, 38 and 46 dB PSNR on the same 1920x1080 frame (the upstream engine scores about 26 dB on that frame)), with worker parallelism raised to half the logical cores instead of a cap of four. The original tracer stays the default and remains the right choice for whole videos, where the new engine produces files hundreds of times larger.
description.zh: fork 自 fourzkw/dsh-drawai，保留 .drawio 可编辑画布与两个模型工具，并在原版描边之外新增第二套矢量化引擎：分层颜色聚类 + 贝塞尔样条拟合 + 每通道色彩精度，绘制任务可选三档保真度（同一 1920×1080 帧实测约 18 / 38 / 46 dB PSNR（上游引擎同帧约 26 dB）），并行度提升为逻辑核心数的一半（不再封顶 4）。原版描边仍是默认引擎，也是整段视频的正确选择——新引擎在视频上产物会大出数百倍。

description.en: Observes consecutive identical tool failures and optionally pauses before the next model step, preserving original results and successful repeats, with an in-chat report in DSH Web.
description.zh: 监视连续相同的工具失败，可在下一个模型步之前选择暂停；保留原始结果与成功的重复调用，并在 DSH Web 里出一份会话内报告。

plugins.name: transproof#transproof-plugin

description.en: TransProof translation proofreader for DeepSeek Harness: full web UI plus a local, non-networked run-local-check agent tool.
description.zh: 译校助手 TransProof 的 DSH 插件：完整网页界面 + 不联网的「跑本地体检」Agent 工具。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: DSH↔Godot engine runtime bridge: launch and drive a running Godot 4.x game through its in-game TCP interaction server — 16 tools (runtime control via ~130 game commands, scene/UI inspection, GDScript eval, input simulation, screenshots, headless static ops, project editing, export, script validation, engine-path setup), replaces godot-mcp.
description.zh: DSH↔Godot 引擎运行时控制桥：通过游戏内置 TCP 交互服务器启动并操控运行中的 Godot 4.x——16 个工具（约 130 条运行时命令、场景/UI 检查、GDScript eval、输入模拟、截图、headless 静态操作、项目编辑、导出、脚本编译检查、引擎路径设置），替代 godot-mcp。

description.en: Adds the fs_remove and fs_move tools, executed in the DSH host process so they can delete paths the sandboxed shell cannot, gated by a session allow list and a path allow/deny list that denies by default.
description.zh: 在 DSH 宿主进程里执行 fs_remove 与 fs_move，因此能删除沙箱 shell 删不掉的路径；带会话白名单与路径白/黑名单，默认拒绝。

description.en: Self-contained personal portfolio and investment-research workspace for DSH with local registration, asset import and allocation views, market and news tracking, a research library, and optional user-configured AI briefs; ships a Windows runtime and stores data locally.
description.zh: DSH 内的自包含个人资产与投研工作台：支持本地注册、资产导入与配置视图、市场和新闻跟踪、研究库及用户自行配置的 AI 简报；内置 Windows Runtime，数据保存在本机。

description.en: Encrypted, chunked full backups of a DSH installation: config, sessions, plugins, workspaces and Hindsight memory packed into AES-256-GCM volumes that unlock by passphrase, recovery code or this machine's DPAPI slot, each package carrying a self-contained restorer, GFS rotation (last, daily, weekly, monthly, plus a total size cap and a recycle bin) and network or WebDAV targets. Zero external dependencies — node: builtins only, no 7z, openssl or rclone.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的配置、会话、插件、工作区与 Hindsight 记忆加密分卷打包：AES-256-GCM 卷可用口令、恢复码或本机 DPAPI 免密槽解开，包内自带自包含还原器；GFS 四档滚动保留（最近 / 每日 / 每周 / 每月，另有总体积上限与回收站），支持网络路径与 WebDAV 目标。零外部依赖，只用 node: 内置模块，不需要 7z、openssl 或 rclone。

description.en: A ✨ button left of the send button: reads the draft and recent turns, asks the configured model for three suggestions each pairing an issue with a patch, lets you tick them individually with a live preview of the merged prompt, and writes the result back to the composer without sending.
description.zh: 发送按钮左侧的 ✨ 按钮：读取草稿与最近若干轮对话，向已配置的模型要三条建议（每条都是「问题 + 改法」），可逐条勾选并实时预览合并后的提示词，结果写回输入框但不发送。

description.en: Multi-workspace sandbox: grants file-write access to every registered workspace automatically — add a workspace, write to it immediately, no config or escalation needed.
description.zh: 多工作区沙箱：自动赋予所有已注册工作区的文件写入权限——添加工作区后即可直接写入，无需配置或提权。

description.en: macOS menu bar app for the DSH web server, plus the host plugin it reads: the plugin writes the running server's port, PID and tokenized URL to ~/.config/dsh-launcher/runtime.json and removes it on shutdown, so start, open, restart and stop work from the status bar even for a server started from a terminal.
description.zh: DSH Web 服务的 macOS 菜单栏应用，以及它所读取的 Host 插件：插件把运行中服务的端口、PID 与带 token 的 URL 写入 ~/.config/dsh-launcher/runtime.json，并在停止时删除，因此即使服务器是从终端启动的，也能在状态栏完成启动、打开、重启与停止。

plugins.name: dsh-phone-drop

description.en: LAN phone drop: a QR code on the computer screen opens a page on the phone, and photos or scanned documents land in a computer folder over the local network, with no tunnel and no cloud in between. Document mode binarizes locally in the browser (adaptive threshold plus speckle removal and edge crop) so an ordinary phone photo comes out as a black-and-white scan. Adds a "phone drop" entry at the foot of the DSH sidebar that opens the QR page, plus a phone_drop tool for the assistant; the same CLI also runs standalone without DSH.
description.zh: 局域网手机直传：电脑屏幕上出一个二维码，手机扫开就能拍照或扫描，文件直接落进电脑文件夹，全程局域网直连，不经过隧道也不经过云端。文档模式在手机浏览器里本地做自适应二值化、去噪、裁边，把普通照片变成黑白扫描件。插件会在 DSH 侧边栏底部加一个「手机直传」入口，点开就是二维码页；另有 phone_drop 工具供助手调用，同一个 CLI 也能脱离 DSH 独立运行。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Three tools that let any agent, including a team member, list, steer and stop the subagents it started.
description.zh: 三个工具，让任意智能体（包括团队成员）能列出、追问并中止自己派出的子代理。

description.en: Rust-based POSIX bash executor for the Windows platform — gives DSH a native bash with no WSL or MSYS compatibility layer, honors DSH's three-tier permission policy, and provides persistent-terminal tools.
description.zh: Rust 实现的 Windows 平台 POSIX bash 执行器：为 DSH 提供原生 bash（不依赖 WSL 或 MSYS兼容层），服从 DSH 的三档权限策略、提供持久化终端工具。

description.en: OAuth 2.1 MCP client for Streamable HTTP servers: add a connection in Settings, sign in through the browser (PKCE with dynamic client registration), and have its tools registered in DSH, with tokens kept in the credential service and the connection written to the profile.
description.zh: 面向 Streamable HTTP 服务的 OAuth 2.1 MCP 客户端：在设置页添加连接，通过浏览器登录（PKCE + 动态客户端注册），其工具随即注册进 DSH；令牌存于凭据服务，连接写入 profile。

plugins.name: dsh-codex-tools

description.en: Codex-backed `web_search`, `image_gen`, and `image_vision` tools for DeepSeek Harness, reusing ChatGPT OAuth login state.
description.zh: 基于 Codex 的 `web_search`、`image_gen` 与 `image_vision` 工具，复用 ChatGPT OAuth 登录态为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索、生图与识图能力。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Runs PowerShell scripts through base64 encoding, so quotes, $, backslashes and CJK survive as written. Same sandbox channel as the built-in pwsh tool.
description.zh: 把 PowerShell 脚本 base64 编码后执行，引号、$、反斜杠、中文全部原样传递，免去转义地狱。走与内置 pwsh 工具相同的沙箱通道。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation, window screenshots and mouse/keyboard input, with per-session app consent and action approvals.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation、窗口截图和鼠标键盘操作 Windows 桌面软件，支持会话独立应用授权和操作审批。

description.en: CalDAV calendar tools (list/create/update/delete/search/health) for Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/custom endpoints, with RRULE expansion, a month/week/agenda panel inside the settings page, in-panel connection setup that is tested before saving, and drag-to-reschedule in the week view (15-minute snapping, undo). A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: CalDAV 日历插件：查/建/改/删/搜日程与健康自检，Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/自定义端点，RRULE 重复事件展开；设置页内置月/周/议程面板，连接可在面板内填写并先测后存，周视图支持拖拽改期（15 分钟吸附、5 秒撤销）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Citation tools for agents: exact DOI lookup, Crossref bibliographic search, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago formatting, BibTeX generation, bounded-concurrency DOI validation and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 参考文献工具：DOI 精确查询与 Crossref 题录检索，GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA / Chicago 格式化，BibTeX 生成、有界并发 DOI 校验与健康自检。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Batch-port official Codex plugins into DSH skills (codex_list/port/status/health; measured: 186 plugins / 583 skills, 577 ported, 0 failures).
description.zh: Codex 官方插件一键移植为 DSH 技能（codex_list/port/status/health，实测 186 插件/583 技能，移植 577 个 0 失败）。

description.en: Docker tools for agents: ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health with JSON output, env-configurable CLI path, approval-gated exec and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: Docker 工具：ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health 七工具，JSON 输出、DSH_DOCKER_PATH 环境变量、exec 审批门、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Ten video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif/frames/adjust/health) on the official subprocess service: probe summaries, batch frame extraction, speed/volume/mute/rotate adjust, shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 视频处理十工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/批量抽帧/GIF/调整/健康自检）：探测摘要、变速/音量/静音/旋转调整、官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

description.en: RSS/Atom subscription tools (list/add/remove/fetch/check/search/opml_import/opml_export/health) with cross-feed keyword search, cursor-based incremental fetch and OPML import/export, persisted to settings. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: RSS/Atom 订阅九工具（管理/校验/抓取解析/跨订阅搜索/增量抓取/OPML 导入导出/健康自检），游标增量抓取，订阅持久化到 settings。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Database tools for agents: list/query/exec/schema/stats/health across SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL, with lexer-grade read-only protection, row caps, CSV/JSON query output and an approval-gated write path.
description.zh: 数据库工具：sql_list/query/exec/schema/stats/health，SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL 三引擎，词法级只读保护、行数钳制、CSV/JSON 查询输出与写审批门。

description.en: Manage Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server and SQLite connections with driver diagnostics, column defaults/comments, and opt-in metadata browsing for agents; requires a separate Python 3 environment with the per-driver packages (SQLite needs only the standard library).
description.zh: 管理 Oracle、PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB、SQL Server 与 SQLite 连接，提供驱动诊断、字段默认值/注释和需显式授权的智能体元数据浏览；需另建 Python 3 环境并安装对应驱动（SQLite 仅需标准库）。

plugins.name: dsh-ros2

description.en: ROS2 debugging toolset and robot-state vision analysis for DeepSeek Harness: node/topic/service/action/interface/TF enumeration, whole-graph topology JSON, rosdep checks, approval-gated builds and custom message scaffolding, GUI screenshots and multimodal vision observation, plus headless RViz2 offscreen rendering (low-poly meshes, direct pixel read, GPU passthrough - motion rendering at 30Hz) with parallel VLM realtime analysis.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 ROS2 调试工具集与机器人状态视觉分析：节点/话题/服务/动作/接口/TF 枚举、全图拓扑 JSON、依赖检查，审批门控的构建与自定义消息骨架生成，GUI 截图与多模态视觉观察，以及无头 RViz2 离屏渲染（低模 + 直读像素 + GPU 直通，动作渲染 30Hz）与并行 VLM 实时分析。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to fishros.com

plugins.name: dsh-leekbox

description.en: A-share market dashboard for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): realtime quotes and indices, full-market search, intraday and forward-adjusted candlestick K-line with F10 fundamentals, stock/ETF/convertible-bond/LOF boards, watchlist with position P/L and price alerts, 13-signal screener with 7 preset strategies, limit-up sentiment thermometer, dragon-tiger list, three-source 7x24 news, and AI stock analysis.
description.zh: 韭菜盒子：A股看盘助手——实时行情与大盘指数、全市场搜索、同花顺式 K 线详情弹窗（日/周/月/5分/30分，含 F10 财务摘要）、股票/ETF/可转债/LOF 榜单、带持仓盈亏与价格预警的自选股、13 项技术信号选股与 7 个预设策略交叉、涨停情绪温度计、龙虎榜、三源 7×24 聚合快讯、AI 个股分析。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to 48.push2.eastmoney.com

description.en: Lets a DSH agent ask the user a structured question without blocking the turn: the ask_interactive_question tool returns a pending batch id at once, the answer arrives later as an ordinary user message, and pending batches sit in a browser inbox panel with optional system notifications.
description.zh: 让 DSH agent 提问而不阻塞回合：ask_interactive_question 工具立刻返回待答批次号，答案稍后以普通用户消息送回会话，待答批次显示在浏览器内的待答面板，可选系统通知。

description.en: SketchUp Pro 2023 bridge for DeepSeek Harness that lets the agent inspect a live model, run Ruby task scripts, save .skp files and capture viewport PNGs.
description.zh: SketchUp Pro 2023 桥接插件：让 Agent 检查实时模型、执行 Ruby 任务脚本、保存 .skp 并截取视口 PNG。

description.en: Stores bookmarks as local Markdown files in a folder you choose, with a sidebar page for collections and links, library-wide search, automatic favicon downloads, and three agent tools.
description.zh: 把收藏的链接存成你指定文件夹里的 Markdown 文件，带侧栏页面管理收藏夹与链接、全库搜索、自动抓取图标，以及三个 agent 工具。

description.en: FHL Images generation and multi-reference editing for DeepSeek Harness, with three agent tools, a pool of up to ten API-key workers, and chat-based key configuration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 FHL Images 生图与多参考图编辑，含三个 Agent 工具、最多十个 API Key Worker 的池，以及聊天内配置 Key。

description.en: Tool catalog for agents: search ~2,600 external endpoints (SEO and SERP, backlinks, social, people and company enrichment, ad libraries, scraping) by the task you want done, read each one's parameters and per-call price, then call it with the credential injected server-side. Ships the skill plus an MCP row that stays disabled until TREG_TOKEN is set.
description.zh: 给 Agent 的工具目录：按「要做的事」检索约 2,600 个外部接口（SEO 与 SERP、外链、社交、人物与公司信息补全、广告库、抓取），查看参数与单次调用价格后直接调用，凭据由服务端注入。附带技能，MCP 行在未设置 TREG_TOKEN 前保持禁用。

description.en: AX-first macOS computer use for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility snapshots with stable refs, background input, Unicode typing, menus and apps, set-of-mark screenshots, on-device OCR and verified actions — 11 tools bridged to the macos-cu CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS computer use：基于无障碍树的稳定 ref 定位、后台输入、Unicode 输入、菜单与应用、set-of-mark 截图、本地 OCR 与动作校验——11 个工具桥接 macos-cu CLI。

description.en: Connects a ComfyUI server to the agent through five draw_* tools (status, workflows, models, generate, reverse) and a sidebar panel. It ships no workflows and assumes nothing about your models: every API-format JSON you drop into the workflow directory is inspected to find where prompt, negative, width, height, steps, cfg, seed and LoRA live, and a sidecar file can override what was detected. LoRA injection splices into any graph. All paths are configuration, editable from the panel and saved to a settings file, so it works against a remote or already-running ComfyUI. Headless auto-start and idle shutdown are opt-in and off by default.
description.zh: 把 ComfyUI 接给 agent：五个 draw_* 工具（状态、工作流、模型、生图、反推）与侧栏面板。插件本身不带任何工作流、也不假设你用什么模型：放进工作流目录的每个 API 格式 JSON 都会被自动检查，找出 prompt / 负向提示词 / 宽高 / steps / cfg / 种子 / LoRA 落位，可用同名 sidecar 文件覆盖检测结果；LoRA 能插进任意连线图。所有路径都可配置、可在面板里改并保存到设置文件，因此对着远程或已经开着的 ComfyUI 也能用。无头自动启动与空闲关闭默认关闭，需自行开启。

description.en: Branching surveys in the web GUI: the ask_survey tool with per-option routing, hover insights, Mermaid diagrams, quick one-click answer templates, and resumable banked progress.
description.zh: 网页端分支问卷：ask_survey 工具，按选项路由后续问题，悬停洞察、Mermaid 流程图、一键快速模板，答案可暂存续答。

description.en: Percent-progress scoreboard docked below the todo pill: tracking_write rows with evidence-bound percents, host-captured git checkpoints with before/after deltas, and pursue/align/dismiss actions that reach the agent as instructions.
description.zh: todo 胶囊下方的进度记分板：百分比行必须带工件证据，检查点由宿主抓取 git 状态，pursue/align/dismiss 直接送达 agent 下一步。

description.en: Native discovery and per-agent loading of built-in, plugin and MCP tools, with BM25 and optional Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embeddings.
description.zh: 内置工具、插件工具与 MCP 工具的原生发现与按 agent 加载，支持 BM25 检索，可选 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的向量检索。

description.en: Agent Settings: manage reusable sub-agent profiles in the sidebar, each with a when-to-use description and its own provider/model route, and let the agent start the matching one as a subagent.
description.zh: 智能体设置：在侧边栏管理可复用的子智能体档案，为每个档案写明适用场景与所用提供方/模型，任务中由智能体按场景自动拉起对应的子智能体。

plugins.name: dsh-ops

description.en: Provides bash, PowerShell 7, and high-performance Rust tools for DSH on Windows to reduce token usage.
description.zh: 为 Windows 的 DSH 提供 bash、PowerShell 7 及 Rust 高性能工具，减少 token 消耗。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 2.56.0.2 for network access

description.en: Observational file-mutation rollback for the fs tools: write/edit pre-images are checkpointed as git blobs or snapshots and restored through a model-facing rollback_files tool or a /rollback command.
description.zh: 文件变更回滚：捕获 write/edit 工具调用的改前映像（git blob 或快照），通过面向模型的 rollback_files 工具或 /rollback 命令还原。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SolidWorks install through an MCP server, with a read-only default mode and per-call confirmation for high-risk operations. Windows 10/11 x64 only; needs Python 3.10+ with mcp, pydantic and jsonschema (plus pywin32 and comtypes on Windows) and a local SolidWorks 2023-2026 installed and started at least once.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 服务器把 DeepSeek Harness 接入本机 SolidWorks，默认只读模式，高风险操作逐次确认。仅 Windows 10/11 x64；需 Python 3.10+ 并装好 mcp、pydantic、jsonschema（Windows 上还需 pywin32、comtypes），且本机已安装并至少启动过一次 SolidWorks 2023–2026。

description.en: Read PLC projects inside DSH — decode CoDeSys .project and Delta .dvp (both need Python 3.9+ on PATH) and Siemens S7-200 SMART .smart/.smartlib into readable reports and structured data, plus project diff, address audits, element-level read/write analysis and ladder-logic reconstruction.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里读 PLC 工程——把 CoDeSys `.project`、台达 `.dvp`（两者需本机 PATH 里有 Python 3.9+）与西门子 S7-200 SMART `.smart/.smartlib` 解码成可读报告与结构化数据，另带新旧对比、地址体检、元素级读写判定与连线还原。

description.en: Fine-grained LLM verification for DSH agents: pairwise rewards over score-token logprobs, Probabilistic Pivot Tournament best-of-N selection, and per-step progress tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 智能体的细粒度 LLM 验证：基于评分 token logprob 期望的成对打分、概率枢纽锦标赛 N 选一与逐步进度追踪。

description.en: Unified search with evidence verification for agents: 120+ engines with multilingual routing, vertical domains and structured modality cards, 10 MCP tools plus wide_research orchestration, and a fetch-verify loop that backfills evidence scores.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的统一搜索与证据核验：120+ 引擎多语言路由，垂直域与结构化模态卡，10 个 MCP 工具与 wide_research 编排，fetch 核验回填证据分的证据闭环。

description.en: Minimal snippet and command toolbox for DSH: five tools over a single human-editable JSONL file, zero UI, zero database, zero network, explicit save-only memory.
description.zh: DSH 极简片段/命令工具箱：5 个工具，一个可手工编辑的 JSONL 文件，零 UI、零数据库、零网络，只有明确说存才存。

description.en: DeepTutor tutoring bridge: deep explanations, self-test questions, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search (RAG), and note archiving via deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note tools.
description.zh: DeepTutor 学习辅导桥接插件：通过 deeptutor_run / deeptutor_kb / deeptutor_note 工具为 agent 接入深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索（RAG）与笔记归档。

description.en: Four read-only tools over a WeKnora knowledge base: list knowledge bases, hybrid passage search, reassemble one document's chunks in order, and WeKnora's own cited RAG or ReAct-agent answer with a resumable session id.
description.zh: 把 WeKnora 知识库接入 dsh 的四个只读工具：列出知识库、混合检索原文片段、按顺序还原单篇文档，以及直接取用 WeKnora 自己带引用的 RAG 或 ReAct agent 回答（含可续聊的 session id）。

description.en: Tencent CloudBase backend for DeepSeek Harness — scaffold and deploy full-stack apps from chat, render query results as table cards with paging, sorting and CSV export, preview a deployment on its domain, and call the CloudBase MCP toolset (`mcp__cloudbase__*`) with device-code login.
description.zh: 把腾讯云 CloudBase 后端接入 DeepSeek Harness——在对话里搭好并部署全栈应用，查询结果渲染为表格卡片（分页、排序、导出 CSV），部署后可预览真实域名，并提供 CloudBase MCP 工具集（`mcp__cloudbase__*`），登录走 device-code 流程。

description.en: Zero-key market data MCP server (dsh bundle): 5 MCP tools for A-share/HK/US quotes, sector rankings, futures, money flow and 7x24 news, with a three-tier upstream fallback.
description.zh: 零密钥行情数据 MCP server（dsh bundle）：5 个 MCP 工具覆盖 A股/港股/美股行情、板块排行、期货、资金流与 7×24 快讯，三层上游降级兜底。

plugins.name: dsh-realtimeavatar

description.en: Realtime Avatar (realtimeavatar.ai) for agents: the developer API key held by the harness credentials store, the public docs as five on-demand skills, rta_* tools over the public REST API (balance, avatars, clips, sessions, usage) with approval-gated credit spending, and a /rta command that walks a developer from no key to a live avatar call.
description.zh: Realtime Avatar（realtimeavatar.ai）实时数字人工具：开发者 API key 由 harness 凭据存储保管，公开文档打包为五个按需加载的技能，rta_* 工具封装公开 REST API（余额、数字人、动作片段、会话、用量），消耗额度的操作需审批，/rta 命令引导开发者从零到一次真实的数字人通话。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Drive the Tuanjie editor from DeepSeek Harness by connecting to the running editor's Codely bridge, creating and modifying GameObjects, editing component properties, running editor commands, and executing C# inside the editor process. Adapted from opdsh/unity-plugin for the Tuanjie Codely bridge.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动团结引擎编辑器：连接已运行编辑器的 Codely 桥，创建与修改 GameObject、改组件属性、执行编辑器命令，并在编辑器进程里跑 C#。改自 opdsh/unity-plugin，适配团结引擎的 Codely 桥。

description.en: OpenMAIC: classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.
description.zh: OpenMAIC 教学：课堂、幻灯片、交互组件与苏格拉底式教学。

description.en: One-shot mcp-unity integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP server with zero manual config lets the agent drive the Unity editor through 34 tools - scenes, game objects, transforms, materials, prefabs, menu items, play mode, tests and console logs - with auto-reconnect.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键接入 mcp-unity：内置 MCP 服务端，零配置让 Agent 直接操控 Unity 编辑器——场景、GameObject、变换、材质、Prefab、菜单、播放模式、测试与控制台日志等 34 个工具，支持自动重连。完整中文文档。

description.en: Bundles five TIA Portal skills (Siemens PLC docs lookup, ladder-logic generation, SimaticML-to-PNG rendering, scan-cycle simulation with PASS/FAIL scenarios, and a TiaLink gateway skill for driving a real TIA Portal project) and wires five MCP endpoints. Requires TiaLink (paid; Windows + TIA Portal V19/V20 + Openness) for real-project work, API keys for the four cloud services (100 free calls each, then paid; rendering is billed per call even on failure), Node 22+, and network access; program snippets are uploaded to tia.hubwiz.com.
description.zh: 一次装齐西门子博途（TIA Portal）的五项技能（官方文档检索、梯形图生成、SimaticML 转 PNG 渲染、逐扫描仿真与 PASS/FAIL 验收、操作真实工程的本机网关）并接好五个 MCP 端点。操作真实工程需另装付费的 TiaLink（Windows + 博途 V19/V20 + Openness 用户组）；四个云端服务需 API Key（各 100 次免费，之后付费；渲染每次计费且失败也扣），且需 Node 22+ 与联网；程序片段会上传到 tia.hubwiz.com。

description.en: FormatForge: forge 30+ file formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, EML, EPUB, TOML, archives) into AI-readable text via a drag-and-drop inbox, ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result tools and a CLI; scanned PDFs fall back to local OCR or an enhance hint for the session model.
description.zh: FormatForge：把 30+ 种文件格式（PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、EML、EPUB、TOML、压缩包）锻造成 AI 可读文本——网页拖拽入箱自动转换，提供 ff_translate/ff_formats/ff_result 工具与 CLI；扫描件回退本地 OCR 或交给会话模型增强。

description.en: Image generation through eight provider APIs (Labnana, OpenAI, Gemini, Seedream, DashScope, xAI, Zhipu, ComfyUI) with multiple saved profiles, a per-conversation gallery, and credit tracking on Labnana.
description.zh: 多 API 生图：Labnana、OpenAI、Gemini、Seedream、DashScope、xAI、智谱、ComfyUI 八种接口，支持多套配置、对话画廊与 Labnana 积分计量。

description.en: China A-share stock research: ticker search, announcements over any date range, financial report cards, valuation profiles and signal-factor explanations (~5,000 stocks since 2011, public read-only data service), plus a link-out tool to an external trading-sandbox product.
description.zh: A股个股研究：搜股票、查任意区间公告、财报卡、估值画像与交易信号科普（约 5000 只、2011 年至今，公共只读数据服务），另有一个跳转外部交易推演产品的链接工具。

description.en: Runs the model's bash commands in a local shell chosen in Settings (Niubash, Git Bash, MSYS2, Cygwin, or any bash.exe on PATH) instead of rewriting them for PowerShell, and hides the pwsh tool on Windows.
description.zh: 让 bash 工具在本机设置里选定的 shell（Niubash、Git Bash、MSYS2、Cygwin 或 PATH 上的 bash.exe）中执行命令，不再改写为 PowerShell，并在 Windows 下隐藏 pwsh 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-find-ideas

description.en: GitHub project search and analysis: describe your idea in one sentence and the agent searches GitHub for related projects, ranks them by relevance weighted with stars, and returns a structured card — last updated, relevance, stars, weighted score, language and a one-line description for each project. Pick a few repositories and it reads their README, dependency manifest, directory tree and key files to lay out their architecture — so you stand on the shoulders of giants before you start building.
description.zh: GitHub 项目检索与解析工具：一句话输入开发想法，agent 在 GitHub 搜索相关项目，按相关性与 star 加权排序后返回一张结构化的卡片（包括各项目的更新时间、相关性分数、star数、加权后得分、使用的开发语言、一句话简介）。选择几个仓库后，它还能直接读取这些项目的 README、依赖清单、目录树和关键文件等，梳理它们的架构。让你在动手开发前，先“站在巨人的肩膀上”。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: DSH plugin bridging agents to Cheat Engine for dynamic memory debugging: scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints, and game memory hacking.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Cheat Engine 进行动态内存调试：扫描、指针分析、断点与游戏内存修改。

description.en: Diverts operation-script writes out of the workspace into a per-session scratch root and collects each one into an inspectable vault outside the workspace, so the workspace holds only real deliverables.
description.zh: 把操作腳本的寫入導出工作區、改放各 session 的暫存根，並把每一支收進工作區外的可檢視收納庫，讓工作區只留下真正的交付物。

description.en: Computer use through an external USB HID device: name a target in plain language, a vision model locates it in a cropped window screenshot, and a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 moves the real mouse and types on the real keyboard. 7 tools. Windows has window listing, per-window cropping and automatic window raising; macOS needs pyobjc and has neither; Linux is unsupported.
description.zh: 通过外接 USB HID 硬件做电脑控制：用一句话描述目标，视觉模型在裁剪后的窗口截图里定位，树莓派 Pico 2 驱动真实鼠标和键盘完成动作。7 个工具。Windows 支持窗口枚举、按窗口裁剪与自动抬窗；macOS 需 pyobjc 且不支持这两项；Linux 不支持。

description.en: Session-scoped GeoGebra canvas with 20 native tools for drawing, scene readback, text layout checks and animation capture, plus 55 mathematical skills and bundled offline applet assets.
description.zh: 会话隔离的 GeoGebra 画布，提供 20 个原生工具用于作图、场景读回、文字排版检查与动画采样，并内置 55 个数学技能和离线 Applet 资源。

description.en: Interactive code-reading coach for DeepSeek Harness: a five-phase guided walkthrough of the source behind a paper, starting by identifying its language and framework.
description.zh: 代码研读教练：交互式引导研读论文对应的开源代码。五段研读法（锚定论文主张、地形扫描、入口追踪、核心映射、闭环验证），自动识别并告知语言的框架与架构，适合研读 AI 论文源码。

description.en: DSH plugin that installs, supervises and auto-upgrades the local miloco-mcp-server background service, bridges its MCP tools into DSH and adds service, account and license settings panels.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中安装、守护并自动升级本机 miloco-mcp-server 后台服务，把它的 MCP 工具接入 DSH，并提供服务、账号与授权设置界面。

plugins.name: dsh-data-agent

description.en: Database connections and SQL for DeepSeek Harness: register data sources, browse and comment schemas, run AST-checked SQL with a per-source read-only toggle, and render bar, line and pie charts, from chat or the Settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库连接与 SQL 插件：注册数据源，浏览并注释表结构，通过 AST 校验执行 SQL（每个数据源可单独切换只读），并渲染柱状图、折线图和饼图，可在对话或设置页中使用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Multi-platform research and deep search pipeline: harvest_scout for parallel discovery across GitHub, Web, Twitter, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, and YouTube, harvest_deep_research for automated comprehensive research reports, plus extract, cross-source verification, and credibility auditing.
description.zh: 多平台调研与深度搜索流水线：harvest_scout 并行发现（覆盖 GitHub、Web、推特、Reddit、小红书、B站、YouTube 等通道），harvest_deep_research 自动化长篇综合研报生成，外加穿透抓取、跨源交叉验证与五维来源可信度审计。

description.en: Generates 3Blue1Brown-style Manim animations to explain answers, with a right-column gallery and inline multi-modal file publishing.
description.zh: 调用 3Blue1Brown Manim 现做动画直观解释回答，配有右侧抽屉栏动画库及对话流多模态文件发布卡片。

description.en: Hot-switches in-process DSH fetch traffic among direct, manual HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 proxy, and ambient system-proxy modes, with no-proxy rules and optional proxy-environment export for newly spawned child processes.
description.zh: 在直连、手动 HTTP(S)/SOCKS5 代理和环境/系统代理模式间热切换 DSH 进程内 fetch 流量，支持免代理规则，并可为之后启动的子进程导出代理环境变量。

description.en: Writing council: parallel multi-model drafting, judge consensus & critique synthesis, AI prompt refinement, visual concept illustration, and Markdown file preview.
description.zh: 写作工作台：引入多模型针对同一命题独立盲写，追加主审裁判交叉评审与去糟取精，支持 AI 命题扩写、视觉总览配图与 Markdown 文件预览导出。

description.en: Turns a Minecraft Java save into a Blender cover or animation: scans the .mca region files for flat open ground, exports the terrain to OBJ, and drives Blender headless with MCprep materials, the BPS character rig and three-point lighting. After each render it reviews the frame with OpenCV for facing, ground contact, exposure, lighting and composition, then re-renders with adjusted parameters when a check fails. Requires Blender 4.2 LTS or newer and Python 3.10+ with opencv-python and numpy; the first run assembles the Minecraft assets with the bundled setup command.
description.zh: 把 Minecraft Java 存档变成 Blender 封面或动画：在 .mca 区域文件里找大片平地，导出地形为 OBJ，无头驱动 Blender（MCprep 材质、BPS 角色骨架、三点布光）。每次渲染后用 OpenCV 检查朝向、接地、曝光、布光和构图，不合格就调整参数重渲。需 Blender 4.2 LTS 以上、Python 3.10+（opencv-python、numpy），首次使用运行 setup 装配 Minecraft 素材。

description.en: Deterministic AST code graph and architecture intelligence tool for call hierarchies, blast radius, circular dependencies, domain slices, and full-stack API contracts.
description.zh: 确定性 AST 代码图谱与架构治理分析工具：调用链消歧、重构爆炸半径、循环依赖审计、领域切片与全栈 API 契约追踪。

description.en: Request-level one-time prompt injection without further context pollution. SillyTavern-style UI and data compatibility, keyword/regex/constant triggers, and a lore_lookup tool for on-demand searching.
description.zh: 酒馆风格的通用世界书，为最新用户消息附加一次性的提示词注入，无上下文污染。兼容酒馆世界书，关键词/正则/常驻触发，以及不污染上下文的 lore_lookup 单轮查询工具。

description.en: A CodeGraph tool scoped to the session's own indexed project, resolved from its workspace directory. One MCP server is launched through npx per project root and shared by every session working there; a project indexed mid-session is enabled without a restart, and the managed child process is reaped when the harness exits.
description.zh: 按会话自身的已索引项目提供 CodeGraph 工具，项目由 workspace 目录解析得出。每个项目根经 npx 启动一个 MCP 服务并被该项目下所有会话共享；会话中途建好索引即自动启用，无需重启；harness 退出时受管子进程被回收。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Skill built on the official command-line tool maa-cli for MaaAssistantArknights (MAA), enabling direct control of MaaCore to automate daily tasks in Arknights.
description.zh: 基于 MaaAssistantArknights (MAA) 官方命令行工具 maa-cli 构建的 DeepSeek Harness Skill：让 DeepSeek Harness 直接驱动 MaaCore，自动化完成《明日方舟》日常任务。

description.en: E-commerce customer-service desk that answers buyers only from the fields the shop itself wrote down (price, SKU table, shipping, after-sales), has the DSH model rephrase those facts under a check that rejects invented numbers and platform red lines, and moves the conversation to a human queue when a field is missing. Ships Taobao TOP and JD JOS gateway adapters, a local bridge and webhook channel, and a standalone 24/7 daemon.
description.zh: 电商客服台：只按商家自己写下的字段（价格、规格表、发货、售后）回答买家，由 DSH 模型改写措辞并校验不得编造数字或触碰平台红线，缺字段时转入人工队列。内置淘宝 TOP、京东 JOS 网关适配器，外加本地桥接与 webhook 通道，以及可独立常驻的守护进程。

description.en: NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek nodes inside DSH: five read-only tools covering provenance (both upstream releases this build names), a data directory's restored state and ledger audit, the conformance vectors, exact decimal conversion, and node reachability. Driving the node -- starting or stopping a daemon, depositing funds, sending bus messages -- is deliberately not exposed, because those are audited privileged operations in this project.
description.zh: 把 NewAgentUniverseByDeepSeek 节点接入 DSH：五个只读工具，覆盖版本与上游出处、数据目录恢复状态与账本审计、一致性向量、精确十进制换算，以及节点可达性探测。刻意不暴露启动/停止守护进程、存款、发总线消息这类在本项目里受审计的特权操作。

description.en: Read-only Windows AppData analyzer: click the sidebar icon to drill down explorer-style through directories, each row showing recursive size, file count and last-modified time, plus the software that created it and a delete-worthiness verdict built from a knowledge base, mixed-directory splitting, then heuristics, with unmatched guesses marked as such. Scans directories only and never reads file contents; it ships no delete action, and unknown directories can be looked up online with a model summary and cited sources. The online lookup needs a DeepSeek API key (or an equivalent credential); without one the query is only copied to the clipboard.
description.zh: 只读的 Windows AppData 分析插件：点侧边栏图标后以资源管理器式逐层下钻，每行显示目录的递归体积、文件数与最后修改时间，并说明由哪个软件生成、作何用途，按「知识库 → 混合目录拆分 → 启发式 → 标注为推测」的顺序给出可删建议；只统计目录、不读取文件内容，也不提供任何删除操作，未知目录可按需联网检索并给出带摘要的来源。联网查询需配置 DeepSeek API key（或等价凭据）；没有凭据时只会把查询串复制到剪贴板，不会报错。

description.en: Unit conversion toolbox covering 20 categories — length, mass, temperature, area, volume (incl. US cooking units), speed, time, data sizes (decimal MB vs binary MiB), data transfer rates (Mbps vs MB/s), acceleration incl. g-force, illumination (lux / foot-candle), pressure, energy, angle, frequency, power incl. three horsepower definitions, force, torque, typography (px/pt/em/rem), and fuel economy (mpg ↔ L/100km). Two tools — convert_unit and list_units — zero runtime dependencies, pure arithmetic; each result includes the formula applied.
description.zh: 单位换算工具箱：覆盖 20 个类别——长度、质量、温度、面积、体积（含美制烹饪单位）、速度、时长、数据大小（十进制 MB 与二进制 MiB）、数据传输速率（Mbps 与 MB/s）、加速度（含 g-force）、照度（lux 与英尺烛光）、压强、能量、角度、频率、功率（含三种马力定义）、力、扭矩、排版（px/pt/em/rem）与油耗（mpg ↔ L/100km）。提供 convert_unit 与 list_units 两个工具；零运行时依赖，纯算术实现，结果附带所用公式。

description.en: Web reading tools for text-only agents. Five read-only tools: web_fetch (any URL rendered as clean Markdown or plain text), web_links (inventory of a page's links), web_feed (RSS 2.0 / Atom entries), web_headers (HTTP status, response headers and redirect chain without downloading the body, HEAD with automatic GET fallback), and web_table (HTML tables extracted as structured rows with header detection and colspan/rowspan grid expansion). Transport is Node fetch plus a zero-dependency HTTP proxy implementation (CONNECT tunnelling, absolute-URI requests, NO_PROXY with suffix/wildcard/IPv4-CIDR matching, Proxy-Authorization). Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的网页阅读工具。五个只读工具：web_fetch（把任意 URL 渲染成干净的 Markdown 或纯文本）、web_links（清单页内链接）、web_feed（RSS 2.0 / Atom 条目解析）、web_headers（不下正文即取 HTTP 状态、响应头与重定向链，HEAD 失败自动回退 GET）、web_table（把 HTML 表格抽成结构化行，含表头识别与 colspan/rowspan 网格展开）。传输层为 Node fetch 加一套零依赖 HTTP 代理实现（CONNECT 隧道、绝对 URI 请求、NO_PROXY 的后缀/通配/IPv4 CIDR 匹配、Proxy-Authorization）。零运行时依赖。

description.en: CCReach capability-search provider for DeepSeek Harness, letting agents discover data sources, tools, APIs, MCP servers, skills and workflows.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 检索 CCReach 能力目录（数据源、工具、API、MCP、技能与工作流）。

plugins.name: dsh-live-data

description.en: Ten live-data tools over eight keyless public APIs: FX rates, weather, npm/PyPI versions, GitHub repo stats, Bilibili video stats, A-share/index/gold quotes, and IP geolocation. Tool defaults are configurable in settings.
description.zh: 10 个实时数据工具，覆盖 8 个免密钥公开接口：汇率、天气、npm/PyPI 包版本、GitHub 仓库信息、B站视频数据、A股/大盘/金价行情、IP 归属地；默认参数可在设置面板配置。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 8.8.8.8 for network access

description.en: Running pace calculator: converts distance and time to min/km pace and km/h speed.
description.zh: 跑步配速计算：根据距离与时间换算配速（分/公里）与速度（公里/小时）。

description.en: Content-aware tool-result reducer: 13 reducers cut oversized output by meaning at tools/post-execute (failing tests kept, diff context dropped, JSON and CSV sampled, lint problems grouped by rule, dependency stack frames collapsed, crowded directories counted), with full originals spilled to disk behind a locator.
description.zh: 按内容语义压缩工具结果：13 个 reducer 在 tools/post-execute 阶段按含义裁剪超长输出（保留失败的测试、丢弃 diff 上下文、对 JSON 与 CSV 抽样、lint 问题按规则归类、依赖库的调用栈帧折叠、文件过多的目录只给计数），完整原文落盘保存并留一个定位符可取回。

description.en: Generates game art from reference images via Seedream image generation and MiniMax image-to-video, assembling eight-direction sprites, sequence frames, and skeleton animations with local green-screen keying.
description.zh: 基于 Seedream 生图与 MiniMax 图生视频，从参考图生成游戏素材，本地绿幕抠像后合成八方向精灵图、序列帧与骨骼动画。

description.en: Drives Cadence Virtuoso from the host: VM lifecycle, SKILL execution through the bridge, window capture, Calibre DRC parsing and a write-confirmation gate, in 12 host-only tools.
description.zh: 从宿主机驱动 Cadence Virtuoso 画版图：虚拟机生命周期、经 bridge 执行 SKILL、窗口截图、Calibre DRC 解析，以及写入确认闸门，共 12 个宿主侧工具。

plugins.name: dsh-file-bookmark

description.en: Manage frequently used file bookmarks in DeepSeek Harness, supporting bookmark saving, listing and navigation. It also allows creation of frequently used projects, including management projects, code projects and more.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理常用的文件书签，支持保存、列出与跳转，并且可以创建常用的项目，包括管理类项目、代码类项目等。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to maven.apache.org

description.en: SSQ (China Welfare Lottery Double Color Ball) helper for DeepSeek Harness: 1000-draw trend tracking, six prediction models with ensemble voting, structure analysis and dan-tuo/random generation via the ssq tool.
description.zh: 双色球助手 DSH 插件：千期趋势追踪、6 种预测模型与集成投票、组合结构分析、胆拖/随机选号，对话中直接调用 ssq 工具。

description.en: Windows desktop control for DeepSeek Harness agents: window and UI Automation automation, local Windows OCR, direct browser reads over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (DOM text, JavaScript, selector clicks), humanised mouse and keyboard input, browser tab management, and a live control panel. It probes the machine on first run, writes its own config, and degrades gracefully when a capability is missing. Windows 10/11 only.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体用的 Windows 桌面控制：窗口与 UI Automation 自动化、本地 Windows OCR、通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直读浏览器 DOM 并执行 JS、拟人化鼠标键盘、浏览器标签页管理，以及一个实时控制面板。首次启动自动探测本机能力并写入配置，缺失的能力自动降级而非报错。仅支持 Windows 10/11。

plugins.name: capital-generation

description.en: China A-share financial data MCP server for the harness: 11 fin_data__* tools (quotes/K-lines/financials/calendar/special-data/announcements/EDB/reconcile/funds/indices) over THS free official REST (primary) + AKShare (fallback) + Wind (exclusive domains), with observable degradation, context-budget compression (result-side -72.2% measured), and an offline 10-year market-data lake; BYOK.
description.zh: 中国 A 股金融数据 MCP server：11 个 fin_data__* 工具（行情/K线/财务/日历/特色数据/公告/EDB/对账/基金/指数），同花顺免费官方 REST 主干 + AKShare 兜底 + Wind 独家域，降级全程可观测；上下文压缩（实测结果侧 -72.2%）；离线 10 年数据湖；BYOK 零平台密钥。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Undermind literature search inside DeepSeek Harness. The plugin owns the OAuth authorization-code + PKCE login the remote MCP server requires, refreshes the rotating refresh token before expiry, re-initializes the MCP session when the server drops it, and registers every tool Undermind tools/list returns as a mcp__undermind__* tool, alongside a permanent undermind_auth tool for status, login, logout and retry. Needs an Undermind account and a client id - Undermind accepts a Client ID Metadata Document URL (CIMD) or a pre-registered client id, and does not support dynamic client registration.
description.zh: 把 Undermind 的文献检索接进 DeepSeek Harness。插件自己维护远端 MCP 服务要求的 OAuth 授权码 + PKCE 登录，在到期前刷新并轮换 refresh token、在服务端丢弃会话时重新初始化，并把 Undermind tools/list 返回的每个工具注册成 mcp__undermind__* 工具，另加一个常驻的 undermind_auth 工具用于查状态、登录、登出与重试。需要一个 Undermind 账号和一个 client id：Undermind 接受 Client ID Metadata Document URL（CIMD）或预注册 client id，不支持动态客户端注册。

description.en: Track countdowns and recurring dates with optional reminders.
description.zh: 记录倒数日和重复日期，并可设置提醒。

description.en: Deterministic review of synthetic AI-agent claims in DeepSeek Harness, reporting bounded verdicts, reasons, and evidence references.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的合成智能体主张证据审阅插件，通过确定性规则输出有限判定、理由与证据引用。

plugins.name: dsh-coderag

description.en: Code retrieval engine exposed as an MCP server: four tools (code_search, code_outline, code_index, index_status) over a SQLite FTS5 index with BM25 ranking, CJK bigram indexing, declaration-aware tree-sitter chunking, incremental reindexing, and a three-layer secret filter. The bigram index matches Chinese-language queries against English code, and the default path needs no vector store or embedding model. Requires a local Python 3.10-3.12 engine installed by scripts/install.sh, and CODERAG_ROOT set in the profile patch.
description.zh: 以 MCP 服务器形态提供的代码库检索引擎：四个工具（code_search、code_outline、code_index、index_status），底层是 SQLite FTS5 索引 + BM25 排序 + 中文 bigram 索引，tree-sitter 按声明边界分块、增量重建索引，并带三层密钥过滤。bigram 索引让中文提问也能命中英文代码，且默认路径不需要向量库或 embedding 模型。需要先用 scripts/install.sh 装好本机 Python 3.10–3.12 引擎，并在 profile patch 里设置 CODERAG_ROOT。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Windows settings switch that replaces PowerShell with Git Bash across the four built-in presets, including a persistent terminal in minimal mode.
description.zh: Windows 上的一键 Git Bash 开关，替换四种内置模式的 PowerShell，极简模式保留持久终端。

description.en: Windows desktop control with window-bound screenshots and accessibility state, text readback, DSH approvals, and activity overlays.
description.zh: Windows 桌面操作插件，提供绑定窗口的截图与无障碍状态、文本回读、DSH 审批和操作提示层。

description.en: Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure.
description.zh: 按 agent 的按需工具发现与渐进式 schema 披露。

description.en: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.
description.zh: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。

description.en: Fetches random cat facts and images from public APIs for AI agents.
description.zh: 为 AI 代理从公开 API 获取随机猫咪冷知识与猫图。

description.en: Toggles the rea-mcp server on and off from the DSH Web UI session header or through the rea_mcp_toggle agent tool, so the 170 mcp__rea__* tool schemas stop being sent with every request while REA is off (the tools payload drops from about 722 KB to about 95 KB) and the REA child process exits; the choice is kept in a profile-scoped state file and restored at startup by a row-level disabled expression.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 会话标题栏或通过 rea_mcp_toggle 工具开关 rea-mcp 服务器：不用逆向时，170 个 mcp__rea__* 工具 schema 不再随每次请求发送（tools payload 由约 722 KB 降到约 95 KB），REA 子进程同时退出；选择存入 profile 级状态文件，重启后由行级 disabled 表达式恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-zotero

description.en: Zotero as an evidence store for agents: search your library, inspect metadata and notes, retrieve evidence passages, open source PDFs, and generate citations and bibliographies.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 研究工作流的 Zotero 插件：搜索文献、查看元数据与笔记、提取与问题相关的证据段落、打开原文 PDF、生成引用与参考文献表。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to zotero.org

description.en: Run Python on the local NVIDIA CUDA GPU from DeepSeek Harness: device status, foreground and detached jobs, durable logs, and a measured peak-VRAM figure per run.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接跑本地 NVIDIA CUDA GPU 的 Python 任务：设备状态、前台/后台作业、持久日志、每次运行实测的峰值显存。

description.en: Inspect and tidy a real Android phone over adb: storage surveys, per-app data sizes read from dumpsys diskstats without root, cache clearing that preserves app data, directory measurements and screenshots — five tools; reads never modify anything, writes require explicit confirmation.
description.zh: 用 adb 查看并打理一台真实的 Android 手机：存储体检、未 root 也能读到的逐应用数据大小（来自 dumpsys diskstats）、只清缓存不动数据的清理、目录统计与截图——共五个工具；读取永不改动任何东西，写入必须显式确认。

description.en: Adds a Managed Agents settings tab and MCP tools to dispatch long-running agent tasks to Ark cloud Managed Agents.
description.zh: 新增 Managed Agents 设置页，并通过 MCP 工具向方舟云端 Managed Agents 派发长任务、取回轨迹与产物。

plugins.name: dsh-folder-search

description.en: Search local Word, PDF, PPT, and Excel folders for exam questions and export selected questions to a Word paper.
description.zh: 在本地 Word、PDF、PPT、Excel 文件夹中检索试题，并把选中的题目导出为 Word 试卷。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Route every host-process undici fetch through a local HTTP(S) proxy while keeping localhost and China-reachable APIs direct.
description.zh: 把 Host 进程的 undici 请求统一路由到本地 HTTP(S) 代理，同时保持 localhost 与国内可达 API 直连。

description.en: Picks PTC or native tool presentation per task and switches it at runtime for the model or the user.
description.zh: 按任务自动选择 PTC 或标准工具呈现，并支持模型或用户在任务中随时切换。

description.en: Archived-session management, task-stop notifications, an update checker, model routing (keyword rules + allowlist-gated model_route), multi-task scheduled triggers (heartbeats and fixed-time tasks), and a DeepSeek-style message scroll nav for the dsh web GUI.
description.zh: 归档会话管理、任务完成桌面通知、更新检查、模型路由（关键词规则 + 白名单门控 model_route）、多任务定时触发（心跳与定点任务），以及 DeepSeek 风格的消息滚动导航。

description.en: PubMed deep-research toolset: literature search, author investigation, same-name disambiguation, institution statistics and mentor-student matching.
description.zh: PubMed 深度科研工具集：文献检索、作者调查、同名消歧、机构统计与师承匹配。

description.en: Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from ~/.codex/skills, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.
description.zh: Codex 与 DSH 双向桥接：挂载 ~/.codex/skills、带工作区绑定的会话导入、mcp_servers 实时镜像，以及 Codex 端反向 MCP 安装器。

description.en: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.
description.zh: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

description.en: One-click draft polish for the DSH composer: rewrites your spoken draft into professional wording, sends only the draft snapshot (never conversation context), and never blocks sending if the LLM is unavailable.
description.zh: DSH 输入框一键润色草稿：把口语化表达改写成专业措辞；只发送草稿快照、绝不夹带会话上下文；LLM 不可用时优雅降级，不阻塞发送。

description.en: One settings page for every MCP server on your machine. It reads the real config file of 17 other AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, OpenCode, Trae, Trae CN, Qoder, Gemini CLI, Qwen, Zed, Roo Code, Copilot CLI, Kiro, CodeBuddy, Continue) plus DeepSeek Harness itself, groups servers by the file that declares them, probes each one over JSON-RPC to see whether it starts and which tools it exposes, and gives every server a switch that mounts or unmounts it in DeepSeek Harness without editing the other tools' own files.
description.zh: 一个设置页管理本机所有 MCP 服务器。它读取另外 17 种 AI 工具的真实配置文件（Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、Windsurf、OpenCode、Trae、Trae CN、Qoder、Gemini CLI、Qwen、Zed、Roo Code、Copilot CLI、Kiro、CodeBuddy、Continue）以及 DeepSeek Harness 自身，按声明它的文件分组展示，对每个服务器做一次真连 JSON-RPC 探活，看它能否启动、暴露了哪些工具，并给每个服务器一个开关，把它挂载进或卸载出 DeepSeek Harness —— 全程不改动其他工具自己的配置文件。

description.en: Registers the MCP server built into DaVinci Resolve 21.1+ as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can drive Resolve through its scripting API.
description.zh: 把 DaVinci Resolve 21.1+ 内置的 MCP 服务器注册进 DSH，让 agent 能通过 Resolve 的脚本 API 操作达芬奇。

description.en: Registers FilmLight's official FLAPI MCP assistant (flapi-dev-mcp) as an MCP server in DSH, so an agent can write and run Baselight / Daylight FLAPI scripts.
description.zh: 把 FilmLight 官方的 FLAPI MCP（flapi-dev-mcp）注册成 DSH 里的 MCP 服务器，让 agent 能编写并运行 Baselight / Daylight 的 FLAPI 脚本。

description.en: Read GeoServer WMS services and render map images in the dsh web GUI, with a settings card for server, username, and password.
description.zh: 在 dsh web GUI 中读取 GeoServer WMS 服务并渲染地图图像，带服务器地址、用户名和密码设置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-daoyi-yijing

description.en: Yijing-based decision review plugin for DSH: six-layer weighted aggregation engine (384 yao to taiji) with strong-association veto rules, pure JS with zero solver dependencies. Free tier is capped at 9 runs per day and activation codes raise it; the stock-trend scenario pulls live quotes from Tencent for the stock codes in the request.
description.zh: 道一-易经推演：通用决策评审 DSH 插件（决策辅助，非迷信）。六层加权聚合引擎（384爻→64卦→8宫→四象→三才→两仪→太极），强关联一票否决，内置电机设计/股票趋势/商业成功率剧本，纯 JS 零求解器依赖。免费档每日限 9 次推演，激活码可提升；stock-trend 剧本会按请求里的股票代码向腾讯行情接口拉取实时行情。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to qt.gtimg.cn

plugins.name: dsh-motor-ai

description.en: Full edition of the motor-design AI plugin for DeepSeek Harness: adds the L1 (Ansys RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) precision layers on top of the L0 millisecond-level broad filter, completing an end-to-end chain from requirement parsing to parameter identification, candidate matrix, L0 pre-screening and L1/L2 verification. Mutually exclusive with dsh-motor-ai-l0 (uninstall l0 first); the shared core @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core installs automatically. L1 needs Ansys AEDT (RMxprt) and L2 needs Motor-CAD installed locally. Distributed under the PolyForm Noncommercial licence; L1/L2 require an activation code. Telemetry is on by default: per-tool usage counts and design-experience samples that the author describes as desensitized are sent to the author's server at wangxuewangxue98.deno.net, and fault assistance can upload fault reports; switch them off with telemetryEnabled, designExperienceUpload and faultAssistEnabled in the plugin config.
description.zh: 电机电磁设计 AI 插件完整版：在 L0 毫秒级广筛之上补齐 L1（Ansys RMxprt）与 L2（Motor-CAD）精算层，形成 需求解析 → 参数识别 → 候选矩阵 → L0 预筛 → L1/L2 精算校核 的端到端设计链；与 dsh-motor-ai-l0 互斥，安装前请先卸载 l0，共享核心 @wangxue98/dsh-motor-ai-core 随包自动安装；L1 另需本机安装 Ansys AEDT（RMxprt），L2 另需本机安装 Motor-CAD。完整版采用 PolyForm Noncommercial 许可，L1/L2 需激活码。默认开启遥测：按工具聚合的使用次数和作者称已脱敏的设计经验样本会回传到作者在 wangxuewangxue98.deno.net 的服务器，故障协助还可上传故障报告；可在插件配置里用 telemetryEnabled、designExperienceUpload、faultAssistEnabled 关闭。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to mock.local

description.en: Motor-design AI assistant plugin: requirement parsing → parameter identification → candidate matrix → Top10 verification. L0 is a millisecond-level broad filter (pure JS, zero solver dependency) that ranks candidates and emits the handoff payload for the L1/L2 precision tools; usable as a local agent preset and Cordis plugin. L1 (RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) are reserved in this version — the level gate fails fast above l0.
description.zh: 电机 AI 辅助设计插件：需求解析 → 参数识别 → 候选矩阵 → Top10 校验。L0 纯 JS、零求解器依赖，毫秒级广筛候选并给出交给 L1/L2 精算工具的载荷；可作为本地 agent 预设与 Cordis 插件使用。L1（RMxprt）与 L2（Motor-CAD）在本版本中仅预留接口，层级总闸设为 l0 以上会立即报错。

description.en: Scans the whole C drive and classifies every large folder into A/B/C/D/E/P (safe cache / relocatable / junction-movable / abandoned software / config-memory redline / personal files), then deletes, moves, or redirects on demand — with strong redline protection, dry-run preview and undo. Unknown software decided by LLM fallback + human confirmation. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 扫描整 C 盘,把每个大空间按 A/B/C/D/E/P 分类(无忧缓存/官方可改址/可junction搬/冷废弃软件/配置记忆红线/个人文件),再按需删缓存/junction搬走/引导改址,带强红线保护、dry-run 预览与 undo。未知软件由 LLM 兜底 + 人工确认,动手前先预览、做完可回滚。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Local file recall: indexes the folders you choose into one local SQLite database, so 'where did I put that file?' is one query instead of a disk walk. Caches, VCS and program folders are pruned per directory; each folder keeps its own incremental anchor, so a folder added later is backfilled in full. Read-only: it never modifies, moves or deletes your files. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 本地文件记忆索引：把指定的文件夹记进本机一个 SQLite 库，忘了东西放哪问一句就能找回，不必翻硬盘；缓存、版本库与程序目录整棵跳过。每个目录各有独立增量锚点，后加入的目录首扫回填全部历史。只读，绝不修改、移动或删除你的文件。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。

description.en: Resume screening plugin for HR in DeepSeek Harness: ingest up to 100k Word/PDF/Excel resumes into one searchable library with skills / coarse categories / ingest time, auto-ingest & de-dupe new resumes, then screen by plain-language criteria — rule pre-filter in the database plus LLM fine-judge on the shortlisted few, CSV export. Works on DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7 through 0.2.x, tested on 0.2.0-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向 HR 的简历筛选插件:把 Word/PDF/Excel 简历统一收进简历库建档(技能/粗分类/入库时间),新简历自动入库、重复自动去重;用大白话下指令即可筛选,硬性条件靠库内规则精准过滤,入围的少数人再由 LLM 精判适配度,结果可导出、可追溯。 支持 DSH 0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x,已在 0.2.0-rc.1 实测。
