description.en: Point-and-shoot screenshot capture: a system floating window turns a new screenshot (or copied image) into an Obsidian note with comments and key-point marking, instant OCR through the host DSH multimodal model (no extra API key needed, Tongyi Qianwen as fallback), a duplicate-screen guard, per-day merging, and an optional evening AI organization pass.
description.zh: 指哪拍哪截图入库：系统级悬浮窗把新截图（或复制图片）一键存入 Obsidian 笔记，支持注释与「重点」标记、用宿主 DSH 多模态模型即时识别文字（零配置、无需另配 key，可回落通义千问）、同屏去重、按天合并，并可在晚间用 AI 整理归类、打双链并生成当日总结。

description.en: English word bank for one or more children, built for DSH 0.2 and newer (0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.0-rc.2 verified, including the desktop shell; 0.1.7 through 0.2.x all work). 1.10 added pronunciation: in the memory cards and in the online quiz every word and every example sentence has a speaker button that reads it aloud with the built-in Windows voice - offline, with no network call and no model call - and the whole batch of audio is pre-rendered in the background whenever cards or an exam are generated, so a click starts instantly. 1.11 adds: pick words in bulk straight from the library (10 at a time, top-down, up to 50 selected, with a live counter); turn the words a child got wrong in a quiz into a one-click review set - an online card page that speaks plus a printable PDF; and every card example sentence now carries its Chinese translation underneath. Words marked on textbook or workbook photos (highlighter, red pen) are found by their marks, then translated and stored in a local SQLite bank with an occurrence count; the clipboard picker, the photo route and dictation all land in the same bank. High-frequency words surface by count, three correct answers in a row flag a word as learned, and any selection prints as a memory card set (a word split into chunks, real IPA per chunk, a grade-7 example sentence, a mnemonic hook, an A4 sheet of eight) in HTML, PDF or Word, with a print-and-answer exam page whose four options are set against each other for meaning. On 0.1.5 the settings panel does not appear - install dsh-word-vault@1.0.2 instead.
description.zh: 一个或多个孩子的英语生词库，面向 DSH 0.2 及以上（0.2.0-rc.1 / 0.2.0-rc.2 实测通过，含桌面版 GUI；0.1.7 ~ 0.2.x 均可使用）。1.10 新增语音发音：记忆卡与在线答题页里，每个单词、每句例句旁都有一个 🔊，点了用 Windows 自带语音朗读——离线、不联网、不调模型；出卡/出卷时还会在后台把整批音频预先合成好，点击即秒开。1.11 新增：词库页一键批量选词（每次 +10 个、从上往下、最多同时 50 个，带实时计数）；考试做错的词可一键出成「能发音的在线复习卡」（在线点读页 + 可打印 PDF）；卡面英文例句下方带中文对照。课本/作业照片上被荧光笔或红笔标出的词按标记找出来，翻译后进本机 SQLite，并累计出现次数；剪贴板点选、拍照、对话三种录入进的是同一本库。高频词按次数浮现，连对三次自动标记「已学会」；勾选任意若干词可出记忆卡（拆解块 + 每块真实 IPA 音标 + 7 年级英文例句 + 荒诞梗，A4 每页 8 张），输出 HTML/PDF/Word，并可出一份四选项按词义互斥的打印试卷作答。在 0.1.5 上设置面板不会出现，可改装 dsh-word-vault@1.0.2。

description.en: macOS desktop launcher with an installation skill: starts or reuses the local DeepSeek Harness web service and opens it in Google Chrome, with a transparent character and thought bubble icon.
description.zh: macOS 桌面启动器与安装 skill：启动或复用本地 DeepSeek Harness Web 服务，固定使用 Google Chrome 打开，并提供透明人物与对话框图标。

description.en: Keeps the NapCat QQ backend alive next to DSH: probes the OneBot 11 HTTP port at startup, launches NapCat when the port does not answer, then rechecks every 45 seconds, kills duplicate process chains, hides the console window, can create a logon scheduled task when a task name is set, and adds a settings page plus napcat_status, napcat_restart and napcat_dedupe tools. Optionally remembers the QQ password, behind a risk confirmation, so an expired fast-login token can be renewed without scanning a QR code. Windows only; without that scheduled task the launched QQ exits together with DSH.
description.zh: 让 NapCat 这个 QQ 后端跟着 DSH 一起活着：启动时探测 OneBot 11 的 HTTP 端口，连不上就拉起 NapCat，之后每 45 秒复查、清掉重复的进程链、隐藏控制台窗口、可在填写任务名后创建登录计划任务，并提供设置页以及 napcat_status、napcat_restart、napcat_dedupe 三个工具。可选记住 QQ 密码（默认关闭，开启前需确认风险），让失效的快速登录令牌不用扫码也能自己续上。仅 Windows；不建计划任务时，拉起的 QQ 会随 DSH 一起退出。

description.en: Requires Claude Code installed and signed in on this machine. Delegates coding tasks to the local Claude Code agent through the Claude Agent SDK, reports which files changed, supports one-command revert, and adds a Claude Mode toggle to the composer.
description.zh: 需本机已安装并登录 Claude Code。通过 Claude Agent SDK 把编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code，报告改动文件、支持一键回退，并在输入框旁提供「Claude 模式」开关。

description.en: Translate between Chinese and English without leaving DSH, using your configured models with no extra API key: streaming output, a customizable prompt, and local history to revisit and re-translate.
description.zh: 不离开 DSH 就能中英互译：复用已配置的模型，免填 API Key；译文边生成边显示，提示词可自定义，历史自动存在本地，可随时回看重译。

description.en: Notes and todos as plain Markdown files in your workspace: type /ml plus a sentence to jot into today's journal; todos come in three flavors — deadline, sleep-until-a-date (auto-wakes when due), and anytime; /ml view fuzzy-opens any file with a few keystrokes. Zero tokens throughout — nothing goes through the model, and your notes stay ordinary local files that git and any editor can read.
description.zh: 把随手记和待办写进工作区的 Markdown 文件里：/ml 加一句话就记进当天日志；待办分三种——截止日、睡到某天自动唤醒、随时；/ml view 打几个字母就能模糊打开任意文件。全程零 token，不经过大模型；笔记就是普通的本地文件，git 和任何编辑器都能直接用。

plugins.name: dsh-novel

description.en: Novel-writing console for DSH: five novel_* tools for the agent (list, read, context, save chapter, cast) plus a side panel with a book wizard, a cast/relation view and streaming chapter continuation.
description.zh: 小说创作台：5 个 novel_* 工具（列目录、读文件、取上下文、存章节、管角色），外加侧栏开书向导、人物关系图与流式续写。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: From chat to canvas to artwork — drive ComfyUI as a visual workflow IDE inside DSH. Embed ComfyUI (local or cloud) as a split-screen canvas in DeepSeek Harness Web: the agent sparks ideas, writes prompts and scripts right in the chat, applies them live to the canvas in front of you, and produces images, music, video, and 3D. From idea to finished output without ever leaving the conversation or switching front-ends: Canvas ops — compose and arrange pipelines, read/write workflows, edit nodes, wire links, run, tune parameters, and debug errors, all live and WYSIWYG on the exact canvas you are looking at; Production tasks — batch parameter sweeps (batch_run) and automatic output-image retrieval back into the chat (get_outputs), powering multi-modal creative and batch generation across images, music, video, and 3D; Environment upkeep — one-click launch of ComfyUI and one-click upgrade of the core plus every custom node (upgrade), keeping the stack healthy without interruption. This package is the DSH-side plugin, and it ships the ComfyUI-side bridge node too.
description.zh: 从对话到画布再到作品——DSH 里驾驭 ComfyUI 的可视化工作流 IDE。把 ComfyUI（本地或云端）以画布分屏嵌入 DeepSeek Harness Web，agent 在对话里激发创意、书写提示词与脚本，实时落到你眼前的画布上，产出图像、音乐、视频、3D。从灵感到成品，全程不离开对话，不用切换任何前端工具：画布操作——搭建编排、读写工作流、修改节点、连线、运行、调整参数、工作流查错，所见即所得，实时落在你眼前的画布上；生产任务——批量扫参（batch_run）、自动取回出图（get_outputs）带回对话，实现图像、音乐、视频、3D 等多任务智能创作与批量生产；环境维护——一键启动 ComfyUI、一键升级核心与全部自定义节点（upgrade），省心维护不间断。本仓库集成了 DSH 侧插件（画布副驾）+ ComfyUI 侧桥接节点，无人值守/规模化执行时可配合官方 ComfyUI MCP 服务器使用。

description.en: PC environment diagnostics & port control board: zero-dependency inspection of system, CLI toolchains, active listening ports with hover-to-kill release, and model key readiness. No external calls, zero plaintext secrets.
description.zh: 环境自检与端口控制大屏：零依赖洞察系统架构、12 款核心 CLI 工具链、活跃监听端口与悬浮释放、模型凭据就绪状态。局域网主 IP 一键速查，零外联、零私有凭据明文。

description.en: Analyze Windows disk usage, compare scans, and manage cache cleanup and developer environment migration in DSH Web.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中分析 Windows 磁盘占用、对比扫描结果，并管理缓存清理与开发环境迁移。

description.en: Session workspace file manager: adds a "Files" tab to the conversation area to browse the current session workspace directory tree and manage it in place (upload, download, mkdir, rename, delete, search), with files mentionable into the composer for the agent to process.
description.zh: 会话工作区文件管理：在对话区加「文件」tab，浏览当前会话工作区的目录树并就地管理（上传/下载/新建文件夹/改名/删除/搜索），文件可 @ 进对话框给 agent 处理。

description.en: WebDAV server: turns a shared directory into a WebDAV service that Windows, macOS and Linux can mount as a local disk, with token authentication, optional read-only mode, configurable directory/port/token, and per-platform mounting guides built into the settings page.
description.zh: WebDAV 服务器：把一个共享目录变成 Windows/macOS/Linux 都能挂载成本地磁盘的 WebDAV 服务，令牌认证、可选只读、目录/端口/令牌全可配，设置页自带三平台挂载指南。

description.en: Turn any SVG logo into a motion video inside DSH: an `animate_svg` tool renders a transparent 30fps assembly animation (parts fly in, or the whole mark settles) and synthesizes an MP4 with ffmpeg.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里把任意 SVG logo 变成动效视频：`animate_svg` 工具渲染透明背景 30fps 组装动画（零件飞入或整体落位），并用 ffmpeg 合成 MP4。

description.en: SSH remote ops for DSH: pair servers over SSH or a one-time-code remote-hostd, then run commands, manage background jobs, and read or write remote files with reviewable changes (host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes).
description.zh: DSH SSH 远程运维：通过 SSH 或一次性配对码的 remote-hostd 连接服务器，执行命令、管理后台任务、读写远程文件并审阅变更（host_pair/host_bash/host_jobs/host_read_file/host_write_file/host_review_changes）。

description.en: 3D printing & additive manufacturing plugin for DeepSeek Harness: parametric STL generation, calibration G-code, STL/G-code analysis, toolpath rendering and PrusaSlicer bridge, plus 5 skills and a concise persona optimized for local models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 3D 打印与增材制造插件：参数化 STL 生成、校准 G-code、STL/G-code 分析、刀路可视化、PrusaSlicer 桥接，含 5 个技能与面向本地小模型的精简 persona。

description.en: RSS/Atom reader with grouped subscriptions and unread/total counts, FreshRSS account sync over the Google Reader API with read/star written back, local image proxy, optional BYOK AI summary/translate/Q&A, podcast audio playback and full-text fetch.
description.zh: RSS/Atom 阅读器——分组订阅与未读/总数双计数、FreshRSS 账号同步（Google Reader API，已读/收藏双向写回）、图片本地代理、自带 Key 的 AI 摘要/翻译/单篇问答、播客音频与全文抓取。

description.en: MiniMax multimodal bridge: one `mmx_bridge` tool covers image understanding/generation, video, TTS, music, cover, web search and quota; optional `web_search`/`read_image` takeover; inline players/image previews right in the Web GUI (npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`).
description.zh: MiniMax 多模态桥接：一个 `mmx_bridge` 工具覆盖图片理解/生成、视频、语音合成、音乐、翻唱、联网搜索与用量查询；可选接管 `web_search`/`read_image`；对话流直接内嵌播放器与图片预览（npm: `dsh-mmx-bridge`）。

description.en: Search BOOTH for VRChat avatar assets — clothing, shaders, base models, accessories, textures, animations and props — from a dedicated BOOTH tab beside the conversation or via two read-only tools, with Chinese keywords translated to Japanese before the request.
description.zh: 在会话旁的 BOOTH 独立页或两个只读工具里搜 VRChat 素材（衣服、着色器、素体、配饰、贴图、动画、小物）；中文关键词在宿主侧转日文再检索，界面不出现日文词。

description.en: Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin's own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.
description.zh: 让 agent 读写浏览器所在电脑上的文件：浏览器授权本地目录（File System Access），工具调用经插件自建 WebSocket 中继；移动端/非安全上下文自动降级只读兼容模式。

description.en: Attach files and folders in the composer via clipboard paste, a native file/folder picker, and @-mention path search; folders are converted to paged Markdown for the agent to read page by page. macOS only (clipboard and picker go through osascript).
description.zh: 在输入框附加文件和文件夹：剪贴板粘贴、原生文件/文件夹选择器、@-mention 路径搜索；文件夹转分页 Markdown 供智能体逐页读取。仅支持 macOS（剪贴板读取与选择器依赖 osascript）。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek web archive tools for DSH: list/download/search sessions, share-list, and a digest tool that compresses the 100-session history into one high-density page with activity bars and topic clusters. Write operations are intentionally not exposed (the web client rate-limits them). Requires the separately installed deepseek-ops Python client (github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops, by another author) with QR-code login; set scriptDir to its path.
description.zh: DSH 内只读访问 DeepSeek 网页版会话归档：列会话/下载全文/搜索索引/分享列表，以及把 100 段会话压缩成一页高密度摘要（含活跃度直方图与主题聚类）的 digest 工具。刻意不暴露写操作（网页版有限流）。需另外安装第三方 deepseek-ops Python 客户端（github.com/Panniantong/deepseek-ops，另一位作者）并扫码登录，在插件配置里把 scriptDir 指向它。

description.en: Adds a "Check updates" tab to the Built-in plugins settings: one row per installed bundle, with its latest npm version and an update button. Each row also reports DSH-runtime compatibility. The registry is read through the .npmrc chain (environment, then profile, then user, first hit wins); with nothing configured it races a mirror against the public registry, and a private registry is never raced against a public one. A version is installed from the registry it was read from.
description.zh: 在内置插件设置里新增「检查更新」标签页：每个已安装插件一行，显示 npm 最新版本并提供更新按钮。每行还会报告 DSH 运行时兼容性。注册表按 .npmrc 逐级读取（环境变量 → profile → 用户级，取第一个命中），未配置时并发探测镜像与公共源，内部源不会与公共源竞速。版本从哪个注册表读到，就由它安装。

description.en: Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen casting with remote tap/swipe/text control, memory/proc/frida reverse-engineering toolset, 30 agent tools.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 安卓实机调试工作台：自动附加 logcat 流（级别/关键词过滤、崩溃自动快照），真机屏幕实时投屏与远程点击/滑动/文字操控，内存/进程/frida 逆向工具链，30 个 agent 工具。

description.en: Astronomy research workbench for DSH and Codex: NADC terms, reference library, writing, scoring, author confirmation, recommended books, FITS/XML formats, and analysis guides.
description.zh: 面向天文的 DSH/Codex 研究工作台：NADC 术语、参考文献库、写作、评分、作者确认、推荐书籍、FITS/XML 格式与分析引导。

description.en: MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.
description.zh: MCP 服务器管理器（stdio / streamable-http）：按工作目录分项目级/全局两级配置；项目级 MCP 默认经中间层收敛为 4 个原子工具（`middleware: all` 连同全局服务器一并收敛，设置页热切换）；工作空间隔离防串台；配置只存 `${ENV}` 引用、不落盘明文密钥；提供运行时注册接口供其他插件注入 MCP。

description.en: Keyless web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness: Startpage, DuckDuckGo, Exa, and more behind a consensus fan-out.
description.zh: Keyless web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness: Startpage, DuckDuckGo, Exa, and more behind a consensus fan-out.

description.en: Export a whole working DSH home — profile, installed plugins with their node_modules, skills, hooks and task boards — into one .dshpkg tar and import it on another machine without network or pnpm; also streams over HTTP or a one-shot LAN link.
description.zh: 把整套可用的 DSH 主目录——profile、带 node_modules 的已装插件、技能、hooks 与任务板——打包成单个 .dshpkg，在另一台机器上免联网、免 pnpm 还原；也支持 HTTP 上传与一次性局域网链接。

description.en: On-demand GitHub proxy for the Web UI: one-click git/SSH proxy toggle with connectivity tests.
description.zh: Web UI 按需 GitHub 代理：一键开关 git/SSH 代理并测试连通性。

description.en: Resolves the original local path of files uploaded to .dsh-uploads by matching file name, size, and sha256.
description.zh: 通过文件名、大小和 sha256 反查上传到 .dsh-uploads 的文件在本地原始位置的绝对路径。

description.en: COM-driven real Microsoft Office automation for DeepSeek Harness: drives a running Excel/Word instance through OfficeMCP — VBA macros, pivot tables, live formula recalculation, and deep document layout; plus an accounting suite (double-entry journal posting with debit/credit balance check, and SUMIF general ledger).
description.zh: COM 驱动真实 Microsoft Office 实例的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：经 OfficeMCP 操作运行中的 Excel/Word——VBA 宏、透视表、活公式重算、文档深度排版；含会计场景（复式记账分录 + 借贷平衡校验、SUMIF 科目总账）。

description.en: Dual knowledge-graph RAG for Markdown notes with half-life memory decay: prerequisite + similarity graphs (P/S-Agent traversal), paragraph chunking, n-gram/embedding hybrid search, and an explicit weight-feedback loop — a native Cordis plugin, npm-installable as @eqman00003/knowlp-rag.
description.zh: Markdown 笔记的双知识图谱 RAG，带半衰期记忆衰减：前置依赖 + 相似关联双图（P/S-Agent 遍历）、段落级匹配、ngram/embedding 混合检索、显式权重反馈闭环——原生 Cordis 插件，npm 包 @eqman00003/knowlp-rag。

plugins.name: dsh-ip-info

description.en: IP/domain intelligence for DeepSeek Harness: ip_lookup, dns_lookup and whois_lookup tools via free no-key APIs (ipwho.is, Google DNS-over-HTTPS, RDAP).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 IP/域名情报：ip_lookup、dns_lookup、whois_lookup 工具，走免费免 key API(ipwho.is、Google DoH、RDAP)。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 8.8.8.8 for network access

description.en: Share the DSH workspace over the local network: phones, tablets and other computers browse, download and upload files via browser with no DSH login. Token gate, path boundary, read-only mode and rate limit. Zero-dependency (node:http).
description.zh: 通过浏览器把 DSH 工作区分享到局域网：手机、平板、其它电脑可浏览、下载、上传文件，无需 DSH 登录。带令牌门卫、路径边界、只读模式与速率限制，零依赖(node:http)。

description.en: The public-apis catalog wired into DeepSeek Harness: search 1716 free public APIs by keyword, category, auth, HTTPS or CORS and call any of them.
description.zh: 把 public-apis 目录接入 DeepSeek Harness：按关键词、分类、auth、https、cors 搜索 1716 个免费公共 API 并直接调用。

description.en: Force the agent's chain-of-thought, planning, tool-invocation reasoning, and internal deliberation to stay in Chinese — the language constraint is injected at the top of the system prompt before every reasoning step, so it cannot be diluted by tool-returned content. A settings panel lets you edit the constraint text on the fly.
description.zh: 让 Agent 的思考过程也自动使用中文。在每步推理前向 System Prompt 最顶部注入语言约束，强制思维链、规划、工具调用推理全部使用中文，防止工具返回英文内容后发生语言漂移。支持在设置面板中实时编辑约束文本。

description.en: Queries PRTS Wiki for Arknights operators, items, stages, story pages and worldbook entries, and predicts unreleased characters, alters and banner schedules from story-cast statistics and banner history.
description.zh: 查询 PRTS Wiki 的《明日方舟》干员、物品、关卡、剧情与泰拉大典世界观条目，并基于剧情卡司统计与卡池历史预测未实装角色、异格与卡池排期。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-mail-triage

description.en: IMAP mail triage and cleanup for DeepSeek Harness: incremental read-only scan, a hard-protection rule layer plus optional local-model classification, a Markdown report and a hashed manifest, an explicit approval card, and only then a move to the Trash mailbox — no expunge.
description.zh: IMAP 邮件分拣与清理：增量只读扫描，先过硬保护规则层、再走可选的本地模型分类，产出报告与带哈希的清单，人工批准后才移动到回收站——全程不 expunge。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Runs a Douyin subagent that browses videos and reads comments in valley hours and reports back, with dy_* tools for publishing and replying (comments sent from the already-logged-in page with its own request signature, no IM ticket), a daily quota timer, and a settings panel under Settings → Douyin: master switch, auto mode, valley windows, rounds per day and report depth. Windows-oriented; needs the separate douyin-mcp binary (yunsur/douyin-mcp releases, path set via dy_config mcpExe) and an Edge/Chromium login; replying needs a logged-in browser on a CDP port; publishing needs extra credentials most accounts lack.
description.zh: 让子代理在谷时刷抖音、读评论并汇报；附带发作品/回评论的 dy_* 工具（评论从已登录页面带签名直发，不依赖 IM ticket）、每日配额定时，以及设置页「刷抖音」里的控制面板（总开关、自动模式、谷时窗口、每天轮数、报告详细度）。偏 Windows；搜索与评论依赖另装的 douyin-mcp 可执行文件（yunsur/douyin-mcp 的 Release，路径经 dy_config 的 mcpExe 设置）及 Edge/Chromium 登录；回评论需要开了 CDP 端口的已登录浏览器；发作品还需多数账号没有的额外凭据。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-dm-ops

description.en: Requires JDK 11+, the DM JDBC driver and SSH access to the target instance. Inspect Dameng database instances, assess security and recovery conditions, and generate filterable reports with shared evidence.
description.zh: 需 JDK 11+、达梦 JDBC 驱动与目标实例的 SSH 访问。巡检达梦数据库实例、评估安全与恢复条件，生成支持筛选和共享证据的报告。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 8.1.60.80 for network access

description.en: Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.
description.zh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

description.en: Dota 2 ranked no-ban 2-2-1 draft assistant with bracket and pro data sources, flexible player pools, in-game player selection, and a post-draft win probability estimate.
description.zh: Dota 2 天梯无 Ban 2-2-1 征召助手，支持分段与职业数据口径、灵活分路成员池、参战勾选和 BP 后预测胜率。

description.en: War Thunder user-skin studio: 4-point UV quad picker, quad-clipped art layers, and PNG/DDS/.blk export.
description.zh: 战争雷霆自定义涂装插件：四点 UV 取点器、按四边形裁切的艺术图层，导出 PNG/DDS/.blk。

description.en: Nine model-facing tools over the qBittorrent WebAPI v2, with confirm-gated mutations and an orphan-torrent diagnostic.
description.zh: 基于 qBittorrent WebAPI v2 的九个模型侧工具，写操作需显式 confirm，并提供孤儿种子诊断。

description.en: Windows-native computer use for DeepSeek Harness: two tools drive and read any desktop app. One batch call runs find, click, type, key, read, wait and screenshot steps in a single engine pass, so a task whose steps are known up front costs one model round trip; reading returns window text rather than an image, and input and capture prefer UI Automation patterns, Win32 messages and offscreen PrintWindow so the user's focus and pointer stay untouched.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 原生电脑操控：两个工具即可驱动并读取任意桌面应用。一次批量调用把找控件、点击、输入、按键、读取、等待、截图放进同一次引擎请求，步骤可事前确定的整件事只花一轮模型往返；读取返回窗口文本而非图像，输入与抓取优先走 UIA 模式、Win32 消息与 PrintWindow 离屏抓取，用户的焦点与鼠标全程不受打扰。

description.en: Search 65,600+ API docs from 20 Chinese open platforms through five read-only tools and a runtime skill.
description.zh: 通过五个只读工具和一个运行时 Skill，搜索 20 个中国开放平台的 65,600+ 篇 API 文档。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-writing

description.en: A web-novel writing engine for DeepSeek Harness: parallel drafting, outlining and brainstorming with a separate DeepSeek key, lore and foreshadowing management, semantic vector retrieval, a corpus library, usage ledger, mechanical proofreading, and a local serialization plan.
description.zh: 写文引擎：用独立 DeepSeek key 分流并发生成草稿/细纲/点子，设定与伏笔管理、语义向量检索、书库（饲料区）、用量总账、机械校对与本地连载计划。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Host-side Typert remote for dsh-tool-writing: serves project volumes, chapter status, corpus library, full-text search, evolution entries, and thread-graph data to the client writing panel.
description.zh: 写文引擎的 host 侧数据通道：把项目分卷、章节状态、书库、全文检索、演化条目与线索图谱以 Typert remote 暴露给客户端写作面板。

description.en: Requires the Codex CLI installed and `codex login` completed. Consult the OpenAI Codex CLI from DeepSeek Harness with three tools: codex_consult runs Codex in a read-only sandbox, inlines evidence files, verifies the served model and reasoning effort from the Codex rollout file, retries disconnected streams, and records quota before and after the call; codex_quota reports the current 5-hour and weekly quota; codex_calls lists recent calls.
description.zh: 需先安装 Codex CLI 并完成 `codex login`。为 DeepSeek Harness 增加三个按需咨询 OpenAI Codex CLI 的工具：codex_consult 在只读沙箱中运行 Codex、自动内联证据文件、从 Codex rollout 记录校验实际模型与推理档位、断流自动重试，并记录调用前后的额度；codex_quota 查询当前 5 小时与每周额度；codex_calls 列出最近调用。

description.en: Power management plugin for DeepSeek Harness - sidebar power button with restart/shutdown menu, self-contained restart engine without external dependencies, graceful session flush.
description.zh: DSH 电源管理插件 - 侧边栏电源按钮、重启/关机菜单、自包含重启引擎（无需外部依赖）、优雅会话刷新。

description.en: Resolve a shared URL into title, author, body text, cover and direct video links: Bilibili, Douyin, Xiaoheihe and GitHub are parsed structurally, while WeChat, Zhihu and other pages fall back to an OpenGraph summary (title, description, cover). Includes an optional download step for sending the media back through chat.
description.zh: 把聊天里的分享链接解析成标题、作者、正文、封面与视频直链：B站、抖音、小黑盒、GitHub 走结构化解析，微信、知乎等其它页面退回 OpenGraph 摘要（标题、简介、封面）；可把媒体下载到本地后发回聊天。

plugins.name: dsh-proxy-on-demand

description.en: Start a local mihomo proxy core on demand and shut it down when idle — no always-on port, no leftover process, no change to the Windows system proxy. Routes through an existing proxy when one is already running. Needs a Clash/mihomo config (subscription, imported FlClash config, or pasted in); the first run downloads the ~61 MB mihomo core into the plugin folder.
description.zh: 按需拉起 mihomo 内核，空闲后自动关闭：不常占端口、不留后台进程、不改 Windows 系统代理设置。已有代理在跑时直接借道它的出口。需要自备 Clash/mihomo 配置（订阅、导入 FlClash 配置或手动粘贴）；首次运行会自动下载约 61 MB 的 mihomo 内核到插件目录。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to connect.rom.miui.com

description.en: Gives the agent its own clock: per-session time readings whose precision the agent can change at runtime, elapsed-time counters, and one-shot countdowns that survive a host restart.
description.zh: 为 agent 提供它自己的时钟：按会话注入时间读数且精度可由 agent 运行时调整，并附带累计计时器与跨宿主重启可靠的一次性倒计时。

description.en: Extract short-video scripts and captions from Douyin, Bilibili, Kuaishou and YouTube, including titles, authors, hashtags and engagement data, through a bundled Python extractor.
description.zh: 提取抖音、B站、快手与 YouTube 短视频的文案与字幕，并带标题、作者、话题与互动数据；抽取器以 Python 随包提供。

plugins.name: dsh-config-manager

description.en: One-click backup, export, import and migration of a whole DSH config: settings, plugins, MCP, skills and workspaces. Secrets are excluded by default and, if you opt in, are AES-256-GCM encrypted rather than written in the clear; imports preview first and auto-backup with rollback, profiles hold multiple setups, and remote sync pushes portable config through a private Git repo with secrets excluded.
description.zh: 一键备份、导出、导入与迁移整套 DSH 配置：设置、插件、MCP、技能与工作区。密钥默认不导出；若选择包含，则以 AES-256-GCM 加密而非明文写出。导入先预览、自动备份并可回滚，profile 可保存多套配置，远程同步经私有 Git 仓库推送可移植配置且不含密钥。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Unity-MCP bridge for DSH: dormant from boot, /unity-mcp-tools connects the Unity editor MCP server (com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp) and registers the tools currently enabled on the Unity side; ships a per-plugin-version command catalog plus /unity-mcp-install and /unity-mcp-check, and re-fetches tools/list itself after a tool-set change because DSH sessions never receive list_changed.
description.zh: Unity-MCP 桥接：开机即休眠，/unity-mcp-tools 才连接 Unity 编辑器的 MCP 服务端（com.ivanmurzak.unity.mcp）并注册 Unity 侧当前已开启的工具；随包发布按插件版本生成的命令目录与 /unity-mcp-install、/unity-mcp-check 两个技能，工具集变更后桥接自行重拉 tools/list。

plugins.name: dsh-wind-aifin

description.en: Connects seven Wind financial MCP domains and Wind Alice to DSH while resolving WIND_API_KEY only inside the host credential boundary.
description.zh: 将 Wind 七个金融 MCP 域和 Wind Alice 接入 DSH，并仅在宿主凭证边界内解析 WIND_API_KEY。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Composes tools, skills and MCP servers into switchable per-session sets, shrinking the resident tool surface and the system prompt on demand.
description.zh: 能力组合：把工具、技能与 MCP 编成可切换的组合，按需缩小常驻工具面与系统提示。

description.en: Windows x64 desktop tools for DeepSeek Harness to restore and foreground existing windows, observe screenshots and UI Automation elements, left-click, and type text or supported keys, with repeatable control sessions and physical Esc to stop.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows x64 桌面工具，可恢复并前置已有窗口、观察截图与 UI Automation 元素、左键点击、输入文字或支持的按键，支持反复开启和交还控制，并可按物理 Esc 停止。

description.en: Registers any set of HTTP APIs as paired doc-query and request tools for the agent.
description.zh: 把任意一套 HTTP 接口注册成 agent 可用的文档查询与请求双工具。

description.en: Offline schematic review for EasyEDA Pro, exposed to dsh as four tools — one-shot checkup reports, architecture skeletons, an install doctor, and a live-editor bridge that prefers read-only actions, all driven by the local boardwise CLI.
description.zh: 立创 EDA Pro（EasyEDA Pro）原理图离线审查，给 dsh 加四个工具——一次性 checkup 报告、架构骨架、本机安装体检，以及只读优先的在线编辑器桥，全部由本机 boardwise CLI 驱动。

description.en: Hides opted-in third-party skills and MCP servers from the model-facing catalogs and serves them through one capability tool: search by intent, read the schema or the skill instructions, then call. A local journal records metadata only, never query text or arguments.
description.zh: 把选定代管的第三方技能与 MCP 服务器从原生工具目录收起，改由单个 capability 工具统一提供：按意图搜索、读 schema 或技能说明，再调用。本地日志只记录元数据，不记录查询文本与参数。

description.en: Local knowledge base manager for DSH agents: multi-format import, CJK-aware chunking, sqlite-vec vector + BM25 hybrid search with bge-reranker-base rerank, snapshots, kbpack export/import and cross-KB search — 22 agent tools plus a Web panel.
description.zh: 本地知识库管理：多格式导入、CJK 感知分块、sqlite-vec 向量 + BM25 混合检索与 bge-reranker-base 重排序、快照恢复、kbpack 导入导出与跨库检索，提供 22 个 agent 工具与 Web 面板。

description.en: AstrBot/DSH-native GPU coordination for local AI companions: LLM, IndexTTS and ComfyUI take turns, no proxy.
description.zh: 面向本地 AI 陪伴的 AstrBot/DSH 原生显存协调：LLM、IndexTTS、ComfyUI 轮流用卡，不加代理。

description.en: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation inside DSH through OpenAI-compatible endpoints, with an agent tool, multi-provider fallback, and a side-panel workspace with history.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内直接文生图/图生图：对接 OpenAI 兼容图像接口，提供 Agent 生图工具、多供应商自动降级，以及带生成历史的侧栏工作台。

description.en: Windows computer use forked from computer-user: 13 computer_* tools that read the screen and drive the mouse and keyboard. Image-capable routes get the screenshot as a real image with an exact image-to-screen mapping, so no external OCR; elements return as UI Automation refs so a click lands on the exact control rectangle; Ctrl+Alt+Esc stops every call.
description.zh: computer-user 分叉的 Windows 电脑操作插件：13 个 computer_* 工具，读取屏幕并驱动鼠标键盘。模型支持图像输入时截图直接作为图片返回，附精确的图像→屏幕映射，无需外接 OCR；控件以 UI Automation 引用返回，点击落在精确矩形上；Ctrl+Alt+Esc 可阻断所有调用。

description.en: Deep-read books and articles in five modes (quick, deep, knowledge map, Feynman, full book) with claim-evidence-data reports, Mermaid/XMind mindmaps, batch comparison, budget preflight, transparent background-job progress, and MD/HTML exports from URLs, files, or pasted text.
description.zh: 五种模式精读图书与文章（快速/深度/知识地图/费曼/全书），输出观点—证据—数据报告、四档置信度、Mermaid/XMind 思维导图，支持批量对比、预算预检与后台任务进度透明，可导出 MD/MM/HTML。

plugins.name: dsh-jev-verify

description.en: 0.8.6 fixes a startup crash: the host runtime package is an optional peer, never an installed dependency. TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) wired end to end into DeepSeek Harness (0.8.6). Seven tools: jev_decision (1-25 parallel atomic verdicts in one call; noul/choice/score; typed answers with calibrated confidence; measured median 266-484 ms; verdicts only, never prose), jev_choose (rank 2-10 candidate approaches - fit 0-3 and risk - into an explicit composite with a recommended pick), jev_batch (NEW in 0.8.6: one set of 1-5 judgments over 1-20 texts, one real call per text at bounded concurrency, returning a paste-ready markdown table sortable by a judged dimension; built-in sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam presets; a failed row is reported as failed with the raw error, never guessed), jev_usage (locally measured usage: calls, tokens, estimated cost, latency median and p95, per-tool mix, rolling windows, projected burn rate, optional local hard budgets, and a declared-balance remainder), jev_overview (session ledger), jev_guard_status (guard counters plus a registrations block that surfaces per-surface registration failures) and jev_verify (frozen 27-question live benchmark at concurrency 6: 96.3%, 26/27). WHAT IS NEW IN 0.8.6 - the ledger survives a restart, the remainder is derived instead of invented, and the plugin can now do batch paperwork. (1) The local ledger persists to $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json BY DEFAULT, so the cumulative total no longer resets when the host restarts. Two real bugs behind the old silent zero were found and fixed: the ledger path only honoured DSH_HOME (absent inside the host process, so persistence was silently disabled and the file name was null), and save() wrote the still-empty in-memory ring over the history file because it ran before the first load while the debounce window swallowed the follow-up write. (2) Remaining is derived, never invented: TypeSafe exposes no balance endpoint - /v1/usage, /v1/quota, /v1/account, /v1/account/balance, /v1/balance, /v1/credits, /v1/billing, /v1/me, /v1/limits and a dozen more all return 404, and only /v1/models answers, with no balance headers - so the panel shows the remainder as your declared balance (quota.declaredBalanceUsd) minus locally measured spend since quota.balanceSince, and says plainly that it cannot be fetched instead of printing a number. (3) The composer pill re-reads every 20 s instead of every 60 s, so a call you just made shows up while you are still looking at it. (4) The collapsed pill leads with the remainder once you declare a balance, and the cumulative row is renamed when the ledger is on disk. Every tool has an in-conversation structured view; the Settings > Plugins card covers credentials, tool switches, the auto-guard, the dashboard, the prompt section, usage/quota and auto-triage. Honest by design: no API key means an explicit error, never fabricated results; every registration is quarantined so a failure degrades one surface. Tests 38/38 (npm test, ~2.5 s). Client half applies on refresh; server half needs a host restart.
description.zh: 0.8.6 修复了一个会让宿主起不来的依赖问题（宿主运行时包改为 optional peer，永不被安装）。为 DeepSeek Harness 端到端接入 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）0.8.6。共七个工具：jev_decision（一次并行完成 1-25 个原子判定；noul/choice/score；返回类型化答案与校准置信度；实测中位 266-484 ms；只出判定不写文本）、jev_choose（对 2-10 个候选并行打分——契合度 0-3 与风险——合成综合分并给推荐，只给分不解释）、jev_batch（0.8.6 新增：一次调用对 1-20 条文本跑同一组 1-5 个判定，每条文本一次真实调用、并发有上限，返回可直接粘贴的 markdown 表格并可按某个判定维度排序；内置 sentiment/priority/intent/pii/spam 预设；失败的行如实标为失败并附原文错误，绝不猜测）、jev_usage（本机实测用量：调用、tokens、估算成本、延迟中位与 p95、按工具分布、滚动窗口、全天用量预测、可选的本地硬预算，以及自报余额推算出的剩余）、jev_overview（会话账本）、jev_guard_status（护栏计数，并用 registrations 暴露分面注册失败）与 jev_verify（对线上 API 6 路并发运行冻结的 27 题基准：96.3%，26/27）。0.8.6 的三件事：账本扛得住重启、剩余是算出来的而不是编出来的、插件开始干批量整理的活。 （1）本地账本默认写入 $DSH_HOME/jev-usage.json，宿主重启后累计不再清零。此前「明明有调用、面板却是 0」背后是两个真 bug：账本路径只认 DSH_HOME（宿主进程里没有这个变量，于是持久化被静默关闭、file 为 null），以及 save() 在首次 load 之前执行，把尚未载入的空内存环覆盖写到了历史文件上，而紧随其后的那次保存又被节流窗口吞掉。 （2）剩余只推算、不编造：TypeSafe 没有任何余额接口——/v1/usage、/v1/quota、/v1/account、/v1/account/balance、/v1/balance、/v1/credits、/v1/billing、/v1/me、/v1/limits 等十几个路径全部 404，只有 /v1/models 有响应且响应头没有任何余额字段——因此面板把「剩余」显示为你在 quota.declaredBalanceUsd 自报的余额减去 quota.balanceSince 起的本机实测花费，没自报时明确写「剩余无法显示」，绝不印一个数字。 （3）输入框胶囊的刷新周期从 60 秒改为 20 秒，刚跑完的调用不用等就能看到。 （4）自报余额后，折叠胶囊以「剩余」为首，账本落盘后累计行改名。每个工具都有对话内结构化视图；「设置 → 插件」卡片覆盖凭据、工具开关、自动护栏、看板、引导段、使用额度与 autoTriage。 诚实设计：未配置 Key 时给出明确报错、绝不伪造结果；任何分面注册失败都被隔离，只降级一个功能。 测试 38/38（npm test，约 2.5 s）。客户端部分刷新页面即生效；服务端部分需重启宿主。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Pins a Chinese (zh-CN) thinking and answering constraint into the system prompt, and registers a per-step runtime reminder so the agent does not drift back to English after tool output. Zero runtime dependencies, single file; falls back to a second registration path and only logs a warning when the host API changes.
description.zh: 把「用中文思考和回答」钉进系统提示词，并每步注入一条运行时提醒，避免工具返回英文后语言漂移。零运行时依赖、单文件，带能力探测与降级注册，宿主 API 变更时仅记日志、不抛错。

description.en: Database explorer panel for DeepSeek Harness: connect SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis, Elasticsearch and Qdrant from a third Conversation tab — browse schemas, page through data, edit cells, insert rows, design and drop tables, run SQL, import/export CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown, and draw editable E-R diagrams. Read-only connections enforce statement-level allowlists, agent tools ship read-only by default with an opt-in write flag, and every write (including refused attempts) lands in an auditable log. Ships an MCP stdio server exposing the same connections to external AI clients.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据库浏览器：在对话区第三个页签连接 SQLite、MySQL/MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MongoDB、ClickHouse、Redis、Elasticsearch 与 Qdrant——浏览结构树、分页查看数据、编辑单元格、插入行、建表/改表/删表、执行 SQL、CSV/JSON/SQL/Markdown 导入导出，以及可编辑的 E-R 关系图。只读连接按语句白名单硬拒绝写路径，agent 工具默认只读、写工具需显式授权，所有写操作（含被拒尝试）进入可查可删的审计日志；附带 MCP stdio 服务器，把同一份连接暴露给任意外部 AI 客户端。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file upload for PDF, Word, Excel and images: dropped files are saved to a local directory and referenced by path, no base64 bloat in the chat.
description.zh: 拖拽上传 PDF/Word/Excel/图片等文件:落盘为本地路径引用,对话里不塞 base64 大文本。

description.en: Strips AI-flavor from LLM text with local density scanning and deterministic fact/strength/safety checks; a rewrite that fails verification falls back to the original.
description.zh: 把大模型生成的文本改成读起来像人写的：本地密度扫描 + 事实/强度/安全确定性校验，改写不达标自动回退原文。

description.en: Adds a Drawing Mode agent preset whose 19 comfyui_* tools drive a local ComfyUI: Anima and Krea2 generation, LoRA search and download, Danbooru character tags, PNG metadata, an upstream repro check, and xiaofanqie de-obfuscation.
description.zh: 新增「绘图模式」Agent 预设，含 19 个 comfyui_* 工具：Anima/Krea2 出图、LoRA 检索与下载、Danbooru 角色 tag、PNG 元数据、上游复刻自检、小番茄解混淆。

description.en: Deliverables registry for DeepSeek Harness: agents register the final artifacts of a task (reports, pages, documents, sheets, images, datasets) into one settings section and manager page that store paths only, never copies, and remove recoverably; a standalone CLI (add, list, stats, check, remove, restore) reads and audits the same registry outside the app.
description.zh: DSH 成果登记：agent 把一次任务的最终成果（报告、网页、文档、表格、图片、数据表）登记进设置页与管理页的同一份清单，只记路径、不搬文件，删除可撤销；独立 CLI（add/list/stats/check/remove/restore）在应用外也能查同一份清单，并核对登记的文件是否还在。

description.en: Exposes a running DeepSeek Harness as an MCP server over Streamable HTTP or a bundled stdio bridge, so an external agent can create workspaces and sessions, prompt, fork, rename and switch the model on them, read and write files, run foreground and background shell commands, call the instance's own agent tools by name, and read per-turn and cumulative token usage with a cost receipt when a price plugin is installed.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 暴露为 MCP server（Streamable HTTP，或附带的 stdio 桥），外部 agent 可创建 workspace 与会话，发起 prompt、fork、重命名、切换模型，读写文件，运行前台与后台 shell 命令，按名调用该实例自身的 agent 工具，并读取单轮与累计 token 用量；装了计价插件时还给出费用回执。

description.en: Per-profile settings overlay for DeepSeek Harness: global settings.yaml stays the baseline while each profile overrides any namespace through its own profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml — object sections merge recursively, scalars and arrays replace wholesale, and !unset masks an inherited value. The overlay is transparent to existing plugins (they keep reading ctx.settings unchanged), writes land in the profile overlay only, and official schema validation, revision semantics, expectedRevision conflicts, watchers and events are untouched. Ships a settings command family (get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers) plus a Profile Settings section in the web Settings panel over a loopback RPC channel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按 profile 分层的设置覆盖：全局 settings.yaml 仍为基线，每个 profile 可用自己的 profiles/<name>/settings.patch.yml 覆盖任意设置命名空间——对象段递归合并，数组与标量整体替换，!unset 显式屏蔽继承值。覆盖层对现有插件透明（照常读 ctx.settings），写入只落在 profile 覆盖层；官方 schema 语义、revision、expectedRevision 冲突检测、watcher 与事件均不改动。附带 settings 命令族（get/set/unset/mask/unmask/promote/demote/migrate/diff/layers），并在 Web 设置面板经 loopback RPC 通道提供 Profile Settings 区块。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-writing-guard

description.en: Academic writing guard (EN/ZH bilingual): removes AI-style defensive writing, protects scientific evidence (numbers, citations, claim strength, null findings, scope) during polishing, and calibrates writing toward a target journal (Journal Profile + Journal Fit). Deterministic local regex/statistics, zero network/LLM; writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile with auto-audit on paper writes.
description.zh: 论文写作守卫（中英双语）：去掉 AI 式防御性写作，润色时守住科学证据（数字/引用/主张强度/零结果/scope），并按目标期刊校准写作风格（Journal Profile + Journal Fit）。纯本地正则/统计，零网络零 LLM；提供 writing_rules / writing_audit / writing_style_profile / writing_journal_profile，论文写入后自动审计。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Author custom tools in Python from a web page, in chat, or from the dsh-go app's native panels, and register them as DSH tools without a restart; dangerous tools need built-in approval on every run, tools can be grouped into packs, and an optional unlock mode exposes them per conversation. Needs Python 3 on PATH.
description.zh: 用 Python 在网页、对话或 dsh-go 手机 App 的原生面板里编写自定义工具，保存后免重启注册成 DSH 工具；危险工具每次执行都走内置审批，工具可分组成包，还可选「解锁模式」按对话逐步放出。需 PATH 中有 Python 3。

description.en: This project aims to bridge the Blender MCP Add-on, so that models on DSH can conveniently connect to the current user's working Blender to assist creation, while meeting basic security requirements.
description.zh: 此项目旨在桥接 Blender MCP Add-on，使 DSH 上的模型可便捷对接接入当前用户工作的 Blender 以辅助创作，且满足基础安全需要。

description.en: Looks up CCF conference paper deadlines with the ccf_deadlines, ccf_venue and ccf_update tools, the /ccf command and a desktop panel that exports the list as a calendar. Dates come from a live sync (CCFDDL as the main source, a second source cross-checked; a gap of 36 hours or more is flagged as a source conflict), so nothing is bundled and the next 30 days stay in the system prompt.
description.zh: 用 ccf_deadlines、ccf_venue、ccf_update 三个工具、/ccf 命令和可导出日历的桌面面板查 CCF 会议截稿：日期靠实时同步（CCFDDL 为主、另一个源交叉比对，差 36 小时以上标「来源冲突」），插件本身不内置任何日期，首次使用需先同步一次；未来 30 天的截稿会常驻系统提示。

description.en: DSH plugin for Gaussian 16: SMILES-to-3D, input generation, serial job management, output parsing, and Multiwfn/VMD post-processing (orbital/ESP/RDG).
description.zh: Gaussian 16 计算辅助插件：SMILES→3D 建模、输入生成、串行任务管理、输出解析，以及 Multiwfn/VMD 后处理（轨道/ESP/RDG 出图）。

description.en: Routes model requests, web fetches/searches and spawned tools through the Windows system proxy or a custom address — idempotent kernel (reads never rebuild the dispatcher), header one-click toggle, per-URL route diagnosis and NTLM-aware 407 hints.
description.zh: 把模型请求、web 抓取/搜索与衍生工具统一路由到 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址——幂等内核（读操作不重组分发器）、头部一键开关、按 URL 路由诊断与 NTLM 认证提示。

description.en: Show local images and short videos in the DSH conversation card with one-click download of the original file, or offer any other local file for download; works over local and remote connections and keeps the media itself out of the model's vision context.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话卡片内显示本地图片与短视频并提供原文件一键下载，也可为任意其他本地文件提供下载；本机与远程连接均可用，媒体本身不进入模型的视觉上下文。

description.en: Trending-topics collector aggregating Baidu / Toutiao / Douyin / Weibo hot lists in one call (Weibo optional cookie), returning titles with heat values for content creators — tool: `sxs_news_hot`.
description.zh: 时事热点采集：一次调用聚合百度热搜 / 头条热榜 / 抖音热点 / 微博热搜（微博可选 cookie），返回标题+热度值，供内容创作借势——工具：`sxs_news_hot`。

description.en: Sidebar disk browser for DeepSeek Harness - browse any folder on the server (including hidden ones) with text preview, streaming download and upload (multi-select / drag-and-drop, overwrite confirm), responsive on desktop and mobile.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏磁盘文件浏览插件：浏览服务器任意目录（含隐藏文件夹），支持文本预览、流式下载与上传（多选/拖拽、同名确认覆盖），桌面与移动端响应式适配。

description.en: Annotates bash results whose exit code 1 is an answer rather than an error (grep with no match, diff with differences, false test) so the agent does not re-investigate them.
description.zh: 为 exit code 1 表示结果而非错误的 bash 输出（grep 无匹配、diff 有差异、test 为假）补充说明，避免 agent 反复排查。

description.en: Cache-first code exploration: the rdd_explore tool queries the project's .rdd/exploration index and, on a miss, dispatches a read-only worker subagent to explore and register findings; rdd_models serves the live model catalog for dispatch-time model selection.
description.zh: 缓存优先的代码探索：rdd_explore 工具查询项目 .rdd/exploration 索引，未命中时派遣只读 worker 子代理探索并注册产物；rdd_models 提供实时模型目录，用于派遣时选模型。

description.en: Subagent delegation provider that runs any Claude-compatible CLI binary pointed at by a configurable executablePath field.
description.zh: 子代理委派提供方：通过可配置的 executablePath 字段，运行任意 Claude 兼容 CLI 二进制。

description.en: Compile a video link into timestamped Markdown knowledge cards with back-links to the exact moment. Requires your own Python 3.10+ and yt-dlp (ffmpeg + faster-whisper only for videos without subtitles; Bilibili login cookies for members-only subtitles).
description.zh: 把视频链接编译成带时间戳、可回跳原片时刻的 Markdown 知识卡。需自备 Python 3.10+ 与 yt-dlp（无字幕视频另需 ffmpeg + faster-whisper，B 站会员字幕需登录 cookie）。

description.en: Domain-routed proxy for DSH fetch traffic: hosts on a force-proxy list always go through the proxy, every other host tries direct first and fails over to the proxy within a second, the first channel to answer is pinned for the session, connections are reused for 120 seconds, and each attempt is logged. Can also route pnpm/git subprocesses used by plugin installs.
description.zh: 按域名分流的 DSH 代理插件：列入「强制走代理」的域名（含子域名）永远走代理，其余域名先直连、1 秒内不通再换代理，先答上的通道在本会话定格，连接复用 120 秒，每次尝试都记录；可让插件安装用的 pnpm/git 子进程也走代理。

description.en: Bridge between DSH and the local WorkBuddy desktop app, in four parts: read, search and append WorkBuddy memory, skills, plans and daily logs; run tasks through the local CodeBuddy CLI with four permission profiles; drive the running WorkBuddy window over CDP (open a conversation, read its replies as sanitized rich HTML, type and send, switch the account-billed model, relaunch it with a debug port when it is missing); and a sidebar panel that puts that conversation surface inside DSH. 25 tools and 15 HTTP routes in one plugin.
description.zh: 把 DSH 与本机 WorkBuddy 桌面端接起来，分四块：读写与搜索 WorkBuddy 的记忆、技能、计划和日志；经本机 CodeBuddy CLI 跑任务，带四档权限；通过 CDP 驱动正在运行的 WorkBuddy 窗口（打开会话、以清洗后的富文本读取回复、代打字并发送、切换按账号计费的模型、端口缺失时带调试端口重启它）；再加一个侧栏面板，把同样的对话界面放进 DSH。一个插件里共 25 个工具、15 条 HTTP 路由。

description.en: Records an agent's short notes about what it browsed or thought, and lists them in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 把智能体浏览、干活时的碎碎念随手记下来，并在侧栏面板里按时间列出。

description.en: Control, organize, diagnose, design, personalize, and answer product knowledge questions for a Yeelight smart home, powered by the local yeelight-home runtime.
description.zh: 控制、组织、诊断、设计、个性化 Yeelight 智能家居，解答产品知识问题，由本地 yeelight-home 运行时驱动。

description.en: Keeps the /tmp cleanup daemon alive: an in-process watchdog revives it within about two minutes after Android kills it, runs the due cleanup inside dsh while it stays down, and adds a settings page for status, config, clean and dry-run. The cleaner ships inside the package (bin/tmp-clean, Python 3), so no extra install step is needed.
description.zh: 保证 /tmp 清理守护进程常驻：被 Android 杀掉后约 2 分钟内由 dsh 进程内看门狗复活，守护进程持续不在时由 dsh 自己兜底清理；设置页可看状态、改配置、立即清理或演练。清理工具随包自带（bin/tmp-clean，Python 3），装好即用。

description.en: Computer Use for every DSH session: screen capture, mouse and keyboard, app launch, plan and skill replay, an audit log, guards for dangerous actions, a background code agent, and an OCR workflow (text and coordinates) for apps whose accessibility tree is empty. Verified on macOS only: Windows has a basic GUI backend that is unverified, Linux has no desktop backend (calls fail with unsupported_platform), and the window/AX/browser/clipboard tools register on macOS only.
description.zh: 装一次、所有 DSH 会话可用的 Computer Use 插件：截屏、鼠标键盘、启动应用、计划与技能回放、审计日志、危险动作守卫、后台代码代理，以及面向无障碍树缺失应用的 OCR 工作流（文字与坐标）。仅 macOS 已验证：Windows 只有未验证的基础 GUI 后端，Linux 没有桌面后端（调用报 unsupported_platform），窗口/AX/浏览器/剪贴板工具只在 macOS 注册。

plugins.name: dsh-va-studio

description.en: VA Studio integration: ten tools that generate short dramas, images, videos, novels and screenplays, and reverse-engineer prompts from images or videos. Requires a running VA Studio backend.
description.zh: 接入 VA Studio：10 个工具，生成短剧、图片、视频、小说与剧本，并从图片或视频反推提示词。需运行中的 VA Studio 后端。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Bridges a local MATLAB MCP server into DSH: evaluate MATLAB code, run .m scripts and tests, and inspect installed toolboxes via mcp__matlab__* tools. Requires MATLAB and the MathWorks MATLAB MCP Server binary, and a path edit after install — the plugin on its own registers no tools.
description.zh: 将本地 MATLAB MCP server 桥接进 DSH，提供 mcp__matlab__* 工具：执行 MATLAB 代码、运行 .m 脚本与测试、查看已安装工具箱。需要自备 MATLAB 与 MathWorks 官方 MATLAB MCP Server 可执行文件，且安装后需填一次路径——只装插件不会出现工具。

description.en: Registers the dsh-mol stdio MCP server, built on RDKit with no network access, into a DSH profile. It exposes 12 tools: three-level SMILES validation with human-readable diagnostics and character positions, molecular properties, drug-likeness and structural alerts, structure rendering to PNG/SVG, multi-molecule grids, format conversion (SMILES, InChI, InChIKey, MOL, SDF, formula), standardisation with a per-step change log, deduplication, SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, and batch clean-up that reports every rejected row. The patch only registers the server; the tools live in this repository's Python package and must be installed first — the README gives a `pip install` route and a from-source route, and until the package is on PyPI the from-source one is what works.
description.zh: 把 dsh-mol 的 stdio MCP 服务（基于 RDKit，不联网）接进 DSH profile。它提供 12 个工具：三级 SMILES 校验（人话诊断 + 字符定位）、分子性质、类药性与结构警报、结构图渲染（PNG/SVG）、多分子拼图、格式互转（SMILES/InChI/InChIKey/MOL/SDF/分子式）、标准化（逐步记录改了什么）、去重、SMARTS 子结构匹配、指纹相似度，以及逐条报告失败行的批量清洗。本 patch 只负责注册服务；工具实现在本仓库的 Python 包中，需先安装——README 给了 pip 与源码两条路线，包上架 PyPI 之前，源码那条是可用的。

description.en: A chemistry workbench panel in the DSH web UI. Draw structures on a Ketcher canvas (a script downloads the build; it renders locally in the browser with no backend), then compute on the current molecule with RDKit without calling a model — formula, molecular weight, exact mass, logP, TPSA, hydrogen-bond donors and acceptors, ring counts, Fsp3, stereocentres, Lipinski and Veber rule-by-rule checks, QED, PAINS/BRENK structural alerts and the Murcko scaffold, plus SMARTS substructure matching, fingerprint similarity, format conversion, standardisation and batch clean-up. A retrosynthesis tab talks to a pluggable backend (Retro* by default) over a single JSON-in/JSON-out process, and states what is missing when the backend is not installed instead of inventing a route. The calculations run in this repository's Python package (rdkit), which is installed with pip separately.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的化学工作台面板。在 Ketcher 画板上画结构（构建由脚本下载，浏览器本地渲染、不经后端），然后对本机 RDKit 直接计算，不调用模型——分子式、分子量、精确质量、logP、TPSA、氢键供体与受体、环数、Fsp3、立体中心，Lipinski 与 Veber 逐条判定、QED、PAINS/BRENK 结构警报与 Murcko 骨架，另有 SMARTS 子结构匹配、指纹相似度、格式互转、标准化与批量清洗。逆合成页签通过「JSON 进 JSON 出」的单进程协议对接可插拔后端（默认 Retro*），后端没装好时如实说明缺什么，不编造路线。实际计算由本仓库的 Python 包（rdkit）完成，需另外 pip 安装。

description.en: On-screen test-progress HUD for DSH — a click-through panel drawn over the app under test, showing each step's expectation vs actual and whether the waiting human may take back the mouse and keyboard. Ships a universal prebuilt binary (arm64 + x86_64), so no Xcode Command Line Tools are needed; the panel itself requires macOS 14+.
description.zh: 把自动测试的进展画在被测界面之上的浮层：每步的期待与实际，以及等待的人现在能不能动鼠标键盘。包内附带通用预编译二进制（arm64 + x86_64），无需 Xcode 命令行工具；浮层面板自身要求 macOS 14 及以上。

description.en: Query Chinese Minecraft Wiki (MediaWiki API) and convert raw wiki text into clean AI-readable output — search, page intro, full-page Markdown, and random entry; templates, references, images and cross-language links are stripped before reaching the model. Frozen archive: keep the pinned version, as the author no longer adapts it to newer DSH releases.
description.zh: 查询中文 Minecraft Wiki（MediaWiki API），把搜索结果与页面全文完整转换为 AI 可直接阅读的干净文本——搜索、引言、全文 Markdown、随机条目；模板、引用、图片、跨语言链接等噪声在插件内部全部清洗完毕。已归档并冻结在固定版本：作者不再为它适配新版 DSH。

description.en: Anime subscription manager for DeepSeek Harness: Bangumi metadata lookup, nyaa/dmhy torrent search, qBittorrent auto-download with RSS-based new-episode polling, local media-library dedup, and a calendar/progress sidebar GUI with 11 LLM tools (bangumi_lookup / bangumi_search / bangumi_subscribe / bangumi_unsubscribe / bangumi_list / bangumi_progress / bangumi_calendar / qb_status / qb_configure / qb_add_torrent / library_scan).
description.zh: DSH 追番订阅管理器：Bangumi 查番、nyaa/dmhy 搜种、qBittorrent 自动下载（RSS 判新轮询）、本地媒体库查重，附日历/进度侧边栏 GUI 与 11 个 LLM 工具（bangumi_lookup / bangumi_search / bangumi_subscribe / bangumi_unsubscribe / bangumi_list / bangumi_progress / bangumi_calendar / qb_status / qb_configure / qb_add_torrent / library_scan）。

description.en: Three literature-research skills packaged as one DSH plugin: academic-web-research (lightweight proxy fetch), academic-literature-research (Scholar/IEEE/CNKI/Wanfang/Sci-Hub pipeline), off-campus-literature (campus WebVPN/CARSI access). Installing drops the three SKILL.md folders into ~/.dsh/skills/, so the agent can invoke them by name after a restart. The bundled web-research skill assumes a local HTTP proxy at 127.0.0.1:7897; edit it if your setup differs.
description.zh: 三个文献调研技能打包成一个 DSH 插件：academic-web-research（轻量代理检索）、academic-literature-research（Scholar/IEEE/知网/万方/Sci-Hub 全流程）、off-campus-literature（校园 WebVPN/CARSI 校外访问）。安装即把三个 SKILL.md 落到 ~/.dsh/skills/，重启后 agent 可按名调用。内置的 academic-web-research 技能假定本机 127.0.0.1:7897 有 HTTP 代理，环境不同请自行修改。

description.en: Rolling-window batch scheduler for DeepSeek Harness subagents: one subagent_batch call carries a queue of independent subtasks plus a user-owned concurrency window, a settled child's slot is refilled immediately, and the call returns every child's final answer, stop reason and child id as one acceptance report. async mode keeps the pool running in the background for subagent_batch_status, and the window comes from config, DSH_SUBAGENT_BATCH_CONCURRENCY or a hardware recommendation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 子智能体的滚动窗口批量调度器：一次 subagent_batch 调用携带一队互相独立的子任务和由用户掌握的并发窗口，任一子智能体一结束就立刻补位，结束时把每个子智能体的最终回答、停止原因与子会话 id 作为一份验收报告一并返回。async 模式让整个池子在后台运行、用 subagent_batch_status 收取结果；并发窗口来自配置、DSH_SUBAGENT_BATCH_CONCURRENCY 或硬件推荐值。

description.en: DSH plugin: read and write DingTalk AI Tables through the official dws CLI, adding ten DingTalk AI Table tools (nine `dingtalk_aitable_*` plus `dingtalk_sync_job`), a settings panel, and scheduled CSV export.
description.zh: DSH 插件：包装钉钉官方 dws CLI，读写钉钉 AI 表格，提供 10 个钉钉 AI 表格工具（9 个 `dingtalk_aitable_*` 加 1 个 `dingtalk_sync_job`）、设置面板与定时 CSV 导出。

description.en: DSH plugin: a settings panel to list, add, rewrite and toggle @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client MCP rows — no more hand-writing them into cordis.patch.yml. Zero build, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 插件：一块设置面板管理 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 的 MCP 行——列出、新增、改写、启停，不必再手写 cordis.patch.yml；零构建、零运行依赖。

description.en: Anime Garden for DSH: search anime torrent resources from 動漫花園, 蜜柑计划, 萌番组 and ANi inside DSH — via chat, a sidebar panel with fansub and type filters, a seasonal calendar, and an in-app floating player.
description.zh: Anime Garden 的 DSH 插件：在 DSH 内搜索来自動漫花園、蜜柑计划、萌番组和 ANi 的动画 BT 资源——支持对话搜索、按字幕组和类型筛选的侧边栏面板、新番周历，以及站内浮窗播放。

description.en: Collects the papers a DeepSeek Harness conversation cited, checks each one against Crossref, OpenAlex, arXiv and DataCite, and exports the confirmed entries as BibTeX or RIS.
description.zh: 收集对话里引用过的文献，逐条到 Crossref、OpenAlex、arXiv、DataCite 核对，通过核对的导出为 BibTeX 或 RIS。

description.en: A 护航 panel in the session header that switches the local dsh-guard watchdog on or off and shows whether scanning is enabled, whether the guard is alive and when it last scanned; the Python watchdog that does the watching is deployed separately and found through the DSH_GUARD_ROOT environment variable. The watchdog defaults to a Windows checkout (D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard); set DSH_GUARD_ROOT to point at another directory.
description.zh: 会话头部的「护航」面板：启停本机 dsh-guard 守护，显示扫描开关、守护心跳与上次扫描时间；做监控的 Python 守护需单独部署，插件通过 DSH_GUARD_ROOT 环境变量定位它的目录。守护默认路径是 Windows 上的 D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard，可用 DSH_GUARD_ROOT 指向别的目录。

description.en: On-demand tool loadout for DSH: MCP tools are grouped by server and host plugin tools by prefix; grouped tools hide by default and activate with one call, while tools claimed by no rule stay visible. Ships preset modes (coding / writing / ops / review), a trial zone that promotes new tools after repeated use, gated groups that need user confirmation to activate, an outbound cut while reading the web as prompt-injection defense, and built-in search plus proxy call for long-tail tools.
description.zh: DSH 的按需工具装配：MCP 工具按 server 自动分组、宿主插件工具按手工前缀分组，进组的默认隐藏、一句话激活，没被规则认领的始终可见。另带写代码/写材料/运维/只读审阅内置模式、新工具观察区用多了自动转正、敏感组激活要用户点头、读网页当轮切断外发组防提示注入，以及长尾工具的内置搜索和代理调用。

plugins.name: dsh-siyuan

description.en: SiYuan (思源笔记) notes integration: 17 siyuan_* host tools covering notebook and document listing, full-text search, SQL query, reading documents and blocks, creating and appending content, moving and renaming documents, daily notes and block attributes, plus a Web settings page for the SiYuan URL, API token and per-tool switches.
description.zh: 把思源笔记（SiYuan）接入 DeepSeek Harness：17 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具，覆盖笔记本与文档列表、全文检索、SQL 查询、读取文档与块、新建与追加内容、移动与重命名文档、日记与块属性，另提供一个 Web 设置页配置思源地址、API token 与逐工具开关。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Lets the DSH agent operate your Windows apps and web pages: it reads controls through UI Automation, clicks, types, captures the screen and reads text with OCR, and works on web pages in its own browser in the background, without moving your mouse; when it needs your mouse or keyboard, an on-screen indicator appears and Esc stops it.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 agent 直接操作你的 Windows 桌面程序和网页：用 UI Automation 读控件，点击、输入、截图、识别文字；网页在它自己的浏览器里后台完成，不动你的鼠标；需要用鼠标键盘时屏幕会提示，按 Esc 立刻停下。

plugins.name: dsh-reference-checker

description.en: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the reference_checker model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt or pasted text) against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, reports found / partial / not_found / error per entry, and emits corrected citations in the input's style (APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, Vancouver, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供参考文献真实性检查：reference_checker 工具将论文（PDF/BibTeX/tex/文本/粘贴列表）的每条文献对照 Crossref / OpenAlex / arXiv 核对，逐条判定 found / partial / not_found / error，并按输入样式生成可直接替换回论文的更正版引用（APA、GB/T 7714、IEEE、Vancouver、MLA、Chicago、Harvard、ACS、BibTeX）。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to export.arxiv.org

description.en: Ingestion-time tool-output curation: keeps error and warning lines plus head and tail, spills the full text to disk with a pointer the model can read back; covers every text tool, small results pass through untouched.
description.zh: 摄入时点的工具输出治理：保留 error/warning 行与头尾，全文落盘留指针供模型按需读回；覆盖所有返回文本的工具，小结果原样通过。

description.en: One versioned vocabulary of a project's business concepts, a read-only drift scan, and the same naming rules in every agent prompt.
description.zh: 一份按项目维护的业务概念词表、只读命名漂移扫描，以及注入每个 Agent 提示的同一套命名规则。

plugins.name: dsh-desktop-tools

description.en: DSH environment management: auto-installs a Rust/Tauri desktop host (downloaded per-OS from dsh-desktop-host releases, source build as fallback), one-click runtime updates, Windows platform compatibility, official DeepSeek billing, and a built-in code editor for the workspace.
description.zh: dsh 环境管理插件：自动获取 Rust/Tauri 桌面宿主（按系统从 dsh-desktop-host 下载，无 Release 时源码构建），运行时一键更新、Windows 平台兼容自动适配、DeepSeek 官方计费，并内置工作区代码编辑器。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Pack a directory into a deterministic tar, read an archive's contents without extracting it, unpack while refusing every member that could reach outside the destination, and verify what came out against what went in by SHA-256. No external dependency — the tar format is written and read in this plugin. Extraction is deliberately more permissive on reading than on writing, because a reader's job is to report what an archive says, while a writer must never emit what it cannot read back. A tar has no central index, so the walk tracks whether it reached the end-of-archive marker: without that, a half-file checksums fine and reads as complete.
description.zh: 把目录打成确定性 tar、不解包就列出内容、解包时逐个成员拒绝任何能写到目标目录之外的名字、并用 SHA-256 核对「解出来的东西 == 打进去的东西」。零外部依赖 —— tar 格式在这个插件里自己写、自己读。读比写更宽容是刻意的：读方的职责是如实报告归档说了什么，写方则绝不能写出自己读不回来的东西。tar 没有中央索引，所以遍历必须跟踪「有没有走到归档结束标记」—— 少了这一步，一个被截断的文件校验和照样正确、照样被读成完整。

description.en: Open a page, wait for it the way it actually needs, extract the readable article, and take a screenshot. Playwright is optional: when it is absent the tools fall back to a static fetch and say so in the result, because a page whose JavaScript never ran means something different from one that rendered. Content is chosen by scoring candidate subtrees on prose density rather than on tag names, so a container loses to the article inside it instead of winning by containing more of the document.
description.zh: 打开页面、按页面真正需要的方式等待、抽出可读正文、截图。Playwright 是可选依赖：没装时退回静态抓取并在结果里明确说明，因为「JavaScript 从未执行」的页面意味着的东西和渲染过的不同。正文靠给候选子树打正文密度分来选，而不是相信标签名，所以容器不会因为「包含的文档更多」而赢过它里面的正文。

description.en: Generate images from chat by calling a fleet of local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with workflow templates, worker health checks and queue control.
description.zh: 在对话里直接调用本机或局域网的 ComfyUI 机队出图，支持工作流模板、机队健康检查与队列控制。

description.en: Read, build and take apart EPUB 3 books with no external dependency — the ZIP reader/writer and the XML scanner are both built in. Inspect metadata, reading order and TOC for structural problems, assemble a book from chapters, or split one back into per-chapter HTML.
description.zh: 读、造、拆 EPUB 3 电子书，零外部依赖 —— ZIP 读写器与 XML 扫描器均为自建。可体检元数据/阅读顺序/目录并点出结构问题，从章节拼出一本合规的书，或把已有的书拆回逐章 HTML。

description.en: WeChat Official Account pipeline: validate a draft against a publish gate, then push it into the draft box.
description.zh: 公众号发布管线：先按发布闸门校验草稿，再推送到草稿箱。

description.en: Pull invoice number, date, parties, tax IDs and the amount/tax/total triplet out of text, then verify that amount plus tax really equals the total and flag documents that do not reconcile.
description.zh: 从文本中提取发票号码、日期、购销方、税号与金额/税额/合计，并验算「金额 + 税额 = 价税合计」是否成立，对不上就报出来。

description.en: Drive a local ffmpeg as six structured tools: probe a file's streams, transcode or trim it, pull evenly-spaced frames or the audio track, and compress video to a byte budget with two-pass encoding.
description.zh: 把本机 ffmpeg 包成六个结构化工具：探流、转码裁剪、均匀抽帧、扒音轨，以及按目标体积做两遍编码压缩。

description.en: Turn a GitHub repository's raw counts into a defensible judgement — contributor concentration and bus factor with single-author files, merge time reported as a median beside the mean so an outlier is visible rather than hidden, and an issue backlog with pull requests and drafts filtered out. Reads the public REST API with no SDK, and never claims a truncated page is the whole answer.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 仓库的原始计数变成一句能站住的判断 —— 贡献者集中度与 bus factor（附单作者文件）、合并时长中位数与均值并列（让离群值可见而不是被隐藏）、以及排掉 PR 与 draft 之后的 issue backlog。只用公开 REST API、不装 SDK，分页被截断时明确说明而非伪装完整。

description.en: Convert Notion blocks and Markdown in both directions, with no API client and no external dependency. A Notion paragraph is an array of rich-text runs while Markdown says one string, so the two directions are a split and a merge rather than a pair of inverses — rich-text runs are cut at every annotation boundary one way and re-merged the other, with fences widened when the content already contains backticks. Reports every lossy step instead of swallowing it.
description.zh: Notion 区块与 Markdown 双向转换，不带 API 客户端、无外部依赖。Notion 的段落是一组富文本 run，而 Markdown 只有一个字符串 —— 所以两个方向分别是「切分」与「合并」，并不是一对互逆操作：一个方向在每个注解边界切开 run，另一个方向把相邻同注解的 run 重新合并，内容本身含反引号时自动加宽围栏。每一步有损转换都会报出来，而不是默默吞掉。

description.en: Extract text from an image or PDF, reading a born-digital text layer directly and falling through to a configured OCR engine for scans.
description.zh: 从图片或 PDF 中抽取文字，电子版直接读文字层，扫描件自动转交已配置的 OCR 引擎。

description.en: Turn a raw recording into a published podcast with a local ffmpeg — detect chapter boundaries from silence, cut at those boundaries, normalise loudness to a broadcast target in two passes, and write an iTunes-compatible RSS feed whose enclosure byte lengths are measured from disk.
description.zh: 用本机 ffmpeg 把一期录音做成可发布的播客 —— 从静音里检出章节断点、按断点切段、两遍算法把响度归一化到广播目标，并写出 iTunes 兼容的 RSS（enclosure 字节长度实测自磁盘，避免客户端静默丢弃）。

description.en: Read, audit and diff Protocol Buffer definitions without installing protoc: a zero-dependency .proto parser exposing six tools (status, outline, describe, diff, audit, next_number). diff classifies every change as breaking, risky or additive and names the wire-format consequence; audit catches what protoc accepts but a reviewer should not — duplicated or illegal field numbers, reserved-range collisions, unresolved types, and unreserved gaps below the high-water mark.
description.zh: 无需安装 protoc 即可阅读、审查和对比 Protocol Buffer 定义：零依赖 .proto 解析器，提供六个工具（status / outline / describe / diff / audit / next_number）。diff 会把每处改动分级为 breaking、risky、additive 并说明其线上格式后果；audit 能发现 protoc 接受但审查者不该放过的隐患——重复或非法字段编号、与 reserved 区间冲突、类型无法解析，以及高水位线以下未声明的空洞。

description.en: Generate QR codes from a from-scratch ISO/IEC 18004 encoder with no external tools, plan symbol version and error-correction headroom before producing anything, and decode an existing symbol back to text.
description.zh: 内置从零实现的 ISO/IEC 18004 编码器，无需任何外部程序即可出码；出图前先算清楚版本与纠错余量，也能把已有二维码读回文本。

description.en: Read, write, convert and retime a subtitle track across SRT, WebVTT and ASS, audit it for over-long or unreadable cues, and transcribe audio through a configured speech recogniser.
description.zh: 读写互转 SRT/WebVTT/ASS 三种字幕并校正时间轴，出片前体检过长或读不过来的 cue，还能用已配置的识别引擎把音视频转成字幕。

description.en: Per-workspace closet for temporary scripts and their run logs, kept in a .dsh-fix directory inside each project. Registers a script with its language and purpose, scans a project for leftover scratch scripts, backups and log files, runs registered scripts with a timeout and writes each run to a timestamped log, and sweeps chosen files into a reversible trash with per-batch restore. Scanning only lists and never deletes; cleanup moves files instead of deleting them; files already tracked by git are refused unless forced. Ships 7 agent tools and a settings panel.
description.zh: 按工作区管理临时脚本与其运行日志的收纳间，数据放在每个项目内的 .dsh-fix 目录。可登记脚本（语言与用途）、扫描项目中遗留的临时脚本/备份/日志、带超时执行已登记脚本并把每次运行写进带时间戳的日志、把选中的文件清运进可整批还原的回收站。扫描只列清单永不删除；清运只做移动不做删除；已被 git 跟踪的文件默认拒收，确需处理要显式加 force。含 7 个 Agent 工具与一个设置面板。

description.en: Black-box GUI testing for DeepSeek Harness: an AI tester drives a real Windows virtual machine using only screenshots and mouse/keyboard, so its verdicts rest on pixels instead of logs or source code. Ships the dsh-vm-tester plugin with twelve vm_* tools (status, UI tree, screenshot, click, type, type-secret, key, basic key, wait, snapshot, upload, download), a reverse-tunnel guest agent for Windows, and run verification scripts. Needs Windows, VirtualBox 7 and a Windows guest VM with the bundled agent before any vm tool works.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的黑盒 GUI 测试：AI 测试员只靠截图与键鼠操作真实 Windows 虚拟机，判定必须由像素支撑，而不是读日志或源码。包含 dsh-vm-tester 插件的十二个 vm_* 工具（状态、UI 元素树、截图、点击、输入、凭据注入、按键、普通键、等待、快照、上传、下载）、Windows 虚拟机内的反向隧道代理，以及运行体检与围观脚本。需要 Windows、VirtualBox 7 和装有内置代理的 Windows 虚拟机，vm 工具才可用。

plugins.name: dsh-aiyting-image-video

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to AIyting's image generation MCP endpoint and registers four tools: aiyting_image_catalog (models, routes and specs), aiyting_image_settings (read, quote and save parameters), aiyting_image_generate (return a quote first, and submit only with an explicit credit ceiling) and aiyting_image_task (task lookup, waiting, and a local per-account ledger for unfinished jobs). A sidebar page signs in with an AIyting access key, shows points, today's usage and daily quota, logs out, and keeps per-conversation defaults for model, route, aspect ratio, resolution and count.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AIyting 的生图 MCP 端点，注册四个工具：aiyting_image_catalog（模型、线路与规格）、aiyting_image_settings（读取、报价与保存参数）、aiyting_image_generate（先返回报价，只有显式给出点数上限才提交）、aiyting_image_task（任务查询、等待，以及按账号保存在本机的未完成任务台账）。侧栏页面用 AIyting 接入密钥登录，显示点数、今日用量与每日上限，可退出登录，并按对话保存模型、线路、比例、分辨率与张数的默认值。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Navigation dots for DSH Web conversations — quickly jump between user messages.
description.zh: DSH 网页端对话导航点 — 快速跳转用户消息。

description.en: Prompt optimizer in the composer: rewrites the draft into an eleven-section analytical prompt using the conversation, workspace files and the session's selected model, with one-click undo.
description.zh: 输入框内的提示词优化器：结合对话历史、工作区文件与会话选定模型，把草稿改写为十一节分析式提示词，支持一键撤销。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-litellm

description.en: Web search provider for the ctx.web seam that routes the DeepSeek web_search tool through a LiteLLM proxy using the OpenAI Responses API, reusing LITELLM_API_KEY.
description.zh: ctx.web 搜索提供方：通过 LiteLLM 代理走 OpenAI Responses API 调用 DeepSeek 原生服务端 web_search，复用 LITELLM_API_KEY，无需新密钥。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Host-wide MCP server panel: imports the servers declared in Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor and Codex CLI configs, searches six upstream catalogs and installs from whichever of them declares an install plan, asks only for the fields a server actually declares, and checks each row for whether the mount, the handshake and its tool list really work.
description.zh: 全局 MCP 服务面板：导入 Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor、Codex CLI 配置里声明的服务，检索六个上游目录并只从声明了安装方案的条目安装，只询问服务器自己声明过的配置项，并对每一行检查挂载、握手与工具表是否真的可用。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file upload into the conversation composer, token usage pill with quota tracking, and session archive management — a three-in-one daily-driver addon.
description.zh: 会话输入区拖拽上传文件、Token 用量胶囊与额度跟踪、会话归档管理，三合一日常插件。

plugins.name: dsh-pdf-mineru

description.en: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的统一文档解析，支持自托管与官方云双 Provider、DSH 原生后台任务、不可变产物缓存与请求合并。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Switchable backends behind the native web_search and web_fetch, chosen per session from a composer menu or /setup-search and /setup-fetch: DeepSeek, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily, Tinyfish, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar and server-side model search for search; local HTTP with a private-network allowlist, the DeepSeek Fetch API, Exa, Firecrawl, Tavily and Tinyfish for fetch.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供可切换的后端，每个会话可在输入框菜单或 /setup-search、/setup-fetch 中选择：搜索支持 DeepSeek、Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、Tinyfish、OpenAlex、Semantic Scholar 与模型服务端搜索；抓取支持带内网白名单的本机 HTTP、DeepSeek Fetch API 以及 Exa、Firecrawl、Tavily、Tinyfish。

description.en: Lets the agent scan Bilibili through a subagent and report what is worth watching, with per-video notes, a card wall, and an inbox for mentions, replies and shared videos.
description.zh: 派子代理去刷 B站，回报值得看的视频，带每条视频的笔记、卡片墙，以及 @/回复/私信转发的收件箱。

description.en: Cross-platform Web UI launcher for DeepSeek Harness: webui_start/stop/status/open model tools, a /webui start|stop|status|open slash command, a Settings-page launch card, and an optional desktop shortcut that starts the Web UI hidden and opens the browser once it is fully ready (dsh default icon).
description.zh: 跨平台 Web UI 启动器：提供 webui_start/stop/status/open 模型工具、/webui start|stop|status|open 斜杠命令、设置页启动卡片，以及可选的桌面快捷方式——隐藏控制台启动 Web UI，完全就绪后自动打开浏览器，默认使用 dsh 官方图标。

description.en: Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.
description.zh: 在设置页一键创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式：为 DeepSeek Harness 或任意本地服务生成 .cmd 启动器与桌面图标，自动打开浏览器、可固定任务栏。

description.en: Human-in-the-loop tools (`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`): pause the agent until the user performs a real-world action or returns an observation (GUI operation, game testing, visual verification, hardware checks), gated by session consent and an AFK presence check, returning a structured JSON result via a web task dialog.
description.zh: 人工协作工具（`human_task` / `human_task_ready_check`）：让 Agent 暂停等待用户完成现实操作或返回观察结果（GUI 操作、游戏测试、视觉验证、硬件检查等），内置会话同意与 AFK 在场两级门控，通过 Web 任务窗返回结构化 JSON 结果。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Multisim MCP for circuit generation, simulation, diagnostics, design optimization, and experiment report export.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Multisim MCP，用于生成电路、运行仿真、诊断与优化设计，并导出实验报告。

description.en: Attach tables and documents (xlsx, csv, pdf, zip…) to the DSH composer via paste or drag-and-drop: files are saved into the session workspace and an @reference is inserted.
description.zh: 把表格与文档（xlsx、csv、pdf、zip…）粘贴或拖拽进 DSH 输入框即可附加：文件会保存到会话工作区并插入 @引用。

description.en: Game asset production pipeline: generate images, video and audio, turn a video into a coherent sprite animation, derive recoloured variants, adapt assets to an engine schema, install them into the project and verify the code actually references them. Requires ffmpeg for the video-to-sprite path, and an image/video API key (Agnes AI / OpenAI / fal) for generation.
description.zh: 游戏素材生产流水线：出图、生视频与音频，把一段视频变成连贯的精灵动画，派生配色变体，适配引擎配置，装进项目并核对代码是否真的引用了。视频转精灵动画需 ffmpeg；出图/生视频需自备图像/视频 API Key（Agnes AI / OpenAI / fal）。

plugins.name: dsh-siyuan-archive

description.en: Archives DSH conversation output into SiYuan notes: a single siyuan_archive call files content under `<archive path>/<year-month>/<type>/<date>_<time>_<topic>_<content>` with a metadata table and auto-maintains an index document at the notebook root; 6 siyuan_* host tools (list notebooks, full-text search, read document, archive, delete block, remove document) and a Web settings page for base URL with connection test, API token in the host credential store, archive target and title template, plus notebook/document-level read/write/delete permissions with default deny and child levels able to only tighten.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话产出归档到思源笔记：一次 siyuan_archive 调用按「<归档路径>/<年-月>/<类型>/<日期>_<时间>_<主题>_<内容>」写入并附元数据表，自动维护笔记本根的「索引与规范」索引文档；6 个 siyuan_* 宿主工具（列笔记本、全文检索、读文档、归档、删块、删文档）与 Web 设置页配置地址（含测试连接）、存宿主凭据库的 API token、归档目标与标题模板，以及按笔记本/文档的读写删权限（默认全拒、子级只能收紧）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Provides the bili_summary tool: Bilibili video metadata, subtitle timeline, and sharp-based frame capture with built-in error handling and graceful degradation.
description.zh: 提供 bili_summary 工具：B 站视频元数据、字幕时间轴与 sharp 切帧配图，内置错误处理与优雅降级。

description.en: Lets the agent drive Windows by sight: Windows OCR turns on-screen text into clickable targets, then clicks, drags, scrolls, types and presses keys, verifying each action with a per-pixel diff and an OCR text delta; F6+F7 is a separate emergency stop.
description.zh: 让 Agent 看着屏幕操作 Windows：用 Windows OCR 把界面文字变成可点目标，再执行点击、拖动、滚轮、键入与按键，每步都用逐像素差分和文字增删复核；F6+F7 由独立进程急停。

description.en: Scans MCP configurations from 13 local AI clients and from project workspaces, imports selected servers into the active DSH profile, and adds connection testing, in-place reconnect, JSON import and visual add, edit and removal controls.
description.zh: 扫描 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、VS Code 等 13 种客户端和项目工作区的 MCP 配置，把选中服务接入当前 DSH profile，并提供连接测试、原地重连、JSON 导入和图形化新增、编辑和移除。

description.en: Starts a BaseMind MCP server for each session's workspace and registers the code-intelligence tools it advertises, with no MCP row to configure. Requires BaseMind installed and on PATH (basemind serve); without it no tools are registered.
description.zh: 按会话工作区启动 BaseMind MCP server，并注册其对外提供的代码智能工具，无需配置 MCP 行。需先安装 BaseMind 并在 PATH 上（basemind serve）；否则不会注册任何工具。

description.en: Algorithm learning toolkit syncing Codeforces and AtCoder submissions, profiling weaknesses, generating AI training plans, and tracking spaced-repetition reviews across a 114-lesson algorithm curriculum.
description.zh: 算法学习工具：同步 Codeforces 与 AtCoder 提交记录，分析弱项画像， AI 生成训练计划，间隔复习排期，覆盖 114 课算法模板库。

description.en: A biomedical Research Graph grounded in literature and experiment results. Fork hypotheses, connect evidence, advance research.
description.zh: 基于文献和实验结果的生物医学研究图谱，拆分假设，连接证据，推进研究。

description.en: Manage MCP servers, load them on demand, and filter tools to reduce context usage.
description.zh: 管理 MCP 服务器，按需加载并筛选工具以减少上下文占用。

description.en: Financial research workflow and portfolio risk tools with source discipline for current market facts.
description.zh: 金融研究工作流与组合风控工具，对当前市场事实强制来源与时间戳边界。

description.en: Delegates a self-contained coding task to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Claude Agent SDK, and adds a session tab with live output, cost and remaining quota.
description.zh: 把自包含的编码任务委派给本机 Claude Code 订阅执行（走官方 Claude Agent SDK），并在会话里新增一个标签页，实时显示输出、费用与剩余额度。

description.en: Export DSH conversations as Smartisan Notes-style PNGs, or create and update Markdown notes in a configured account-scoped workspace.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话导出为锤子便签风格 PNG，或在配置的账号工作区中新建和更新 Markdown 便签。

plugins.name: dsh-pptx-builder

description.en: PowerPoint deck builder for DeepSeek Harness: pastel palettes, ten slide templates, web images, Python-drawn charts, highlighted code cards, LaTeX formulas typeset without a TeX installation (matrices, integrals, sums with limits) and a Presentations agent mode.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 PowerPoint 演示文稿生成器：柔和色板、十种幻灯片模板、网络图片、Python 绘制的图表、高亮代码卡片、无需安装 TeX 的 LaTeX 公式（矩阵、积分、带上下限的求和）以及 Presentations 智能体模式。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: MCP gateway for dsh that connects each server on first use and disconnects it after an idle window; tool lists are cached on disk, existing mcpServers files can be imported, and child-process environment variables are scrubbed.
description.zh: dsh 的按需 MCP 网关：每个 server 首次使用时才连接、空闲后自动断开，工具列表缓存在磁盘，可导入现有的 mcpServers 配置，并对子进程环境变量做脱敏。

description.en: Cubox sync for DeepSeek Harness: scheduled sync of your bookmarks, an AI daily brief generated from your own prompt template straight into Obsidian, and per-card markdown export.
description.zh: Cubox 收藏同步：定时同步收藏，按你的 prompt 用 LLM 生成今日收藏简报直接写入 Obsidian，可导出每张收藏为 Markdown。

description.en: Zhihu (知乎) for DeepSeek Harness: wraps the local pyzhihu-cli as 18 zhihu_* tools — 14 read-only (search, hot list, question, answer, user, feed, topic, notifications, collections) plus 4 publishing tools that are not registered until readOnly is turned off — with a web panel in the sidebar for login, config and lookups.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供知乎能力：包装本机 pyzhihu-cli 为 18 个 zhihu_* 工具——14 个只读（搜索/热榜/问题/回答/用户/推荐流/话题/通知/收藏夹）与 4 个发布类工具（readOnly 关闭前不注册）——并在侧栏提供 Web 面板做登录、配置与查询。

description.en: WeChat Reading (WeRead) multi-target export for DeepSeek Harness via the official Skills API gateway: browse your bookshelf, export highlights & thoughts to flomo, a local Markdown file, or Notion, optionally reworked by a configurable LLM prompt.
description.zh: 微信读书多目标导出：通过官方 Skills API Key 查看书架、导出划线/想法到 flomo、本地 Markdown 或 Notion，可选按自定义 LLM prompt 整理后再导出。

description.en: Installs and verifies the reverse-engineering engines REA needs on Windows (Ghidra, JADX, apktool, adb, WABT, frida and more), pins the rea-agents MCP server version, and reports capability gaps in a settings card.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上安装并校验 REA 所需的逆向引擎（Ghidra、JADX、apktool、adb、WABT、frida 等），固定 rea-agents 的 MCP 服务版本，并在设置卡片里体检能力缺口。

description.en: AnySearch-backed search tools for agents: general and vertical-domain search, parallel batch queries, vertical-domain capability discovery, and page-to-Markdown extraction, plus an API key panel in Settings. It registers its own tools instead of a web_search provider, so it cannot be installed alongside @anysearch/anysearch-dsh.
