description.zh: 给 agent 用的 AnySearch 搜索工具：通用与垂直域搜索、并行批量查询、垂直域目录发现、网页转 Markdown，并在设置中提供 API Key 面板。它注册独立工具而非 web_search provider，不能与 @anysearch/anysearch-dsh 同时安装。

description.en: Search offline AI events around Wudaokou and Tsinghua, retrieve source pages, and keep local search history.
description.zh: 搜索五道口、清华附近的 AI 线下活动，读取来源页面并保存本地检索历史。

description.en: Adds an agnes_image tool that calls the Agnes Image Flash models (2.5, 2.1, 2.0) for text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition, and ships a settings-page console for the active model, default size and aspect ratio, output folder, API key and generation history.
description.zh: 提供 agnes_image 工具，调用 Agnes Image Flash 系列模型（2.5 / 2.1 / 2.0）完成文生图、图生图与多图合成，并带一个设置页控制台管理当前模型、默认档位与画幅、输出目录、API Key 与生成历史。

description.en: A settings-panel skin manager that auto-discovers installed Web UI skins, switches between them in one click, and maintains the profile patch automatically.
description.zh: 设置面板皮肤管理器：自动扫描已安装的 Web UI 皮肤并一键切换，profile 补丁自动维护。

description.en: Go (weiqi) review coach: parses SGF records, backfills winrate and score analysis with a bundled KataGo engine, explains the costly moves in the chat, and writes the commentary back into an SGF copy; a web panel shows the board with problem moves, AI choices and variations.
description.zh: 围棋复盘教练：解析 SGF 棋谱，用自带 KataGo 引擎补算胜率与目差，在对话里逐手讲解问题手，并把讲解写回 SGF 副本；Web 面板用棋盘展示问题手、AI 首选与变化图。

description.en: Manages the MCP servers of a DeepSeek Harness profile: lists each server with its connection state and the tools it registers, preflights a configuration before saving it (a missing executable, an npm package name used as a command, an unexpanded variable that would reach the child literally, a URL with no path), and adds servers by pasting a dsh patch fragment or a Claude Code mcpServers block, converted to the dsh shape.
description.zh: 管理 DeepSeek Harness profile 的 MCP 服务：列出每个服务的连接状态与它注册的工具；保存前预检配置（可执行文件缺失、把包名当命令、变量未展开、URL 缺少路径）；粘贴 dsh 配置片段或 Claude Code 的 mcpServers 块即可新增，并自动转换为 dsh 格式。

description.en: Read-only Molio knowledge base tools: list vaults, browse the file tree, full-text search and read documents, served over the local Molio daemon HTTP API, which must be running. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-molio.
description.zh: Molio 本地知识库只读工具集：列知识库、浏览文件树、全文搜索、读取原文，经本机 Molio daemon HTTP API 取数（需 daemon 常驻运行）。npm 包名 dsh-plugin-molio，dsh plugin add 即装。

description.en: Windows NapCat deployment guide and read-only loopback port checks for DSH, with a user-initiated administrator launcher.
description.zh: Windows NapCat部署指南与本机端口只读检查，附用户手动运行的管理员启动入口。

description.en: Auto-switch DeepSeek models: routes every request to the vision model when images are present, to the pro model for complex tasks, and to the fast model otherwise; includes a switch_model tool for manual overrides.
description.zh: 自动切换 DeepSeek 模型：含图片时走视觉模型，复杂任务走 pro，常规任务走 fast；提供 switch_model 工具手动固定。

description.en: DeepSeek API billing-period chip in the composer dock: shows whether the current time is peak or off-peak with a countdown to the next rate switch, opens the peak/off-peak window rules on click, and during peak hours intercepts sending to ask for confirmation first.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek API 当前计费时段（高峰/空闲）与距下次切换的倒计时，点击可展开高峰/空闲时段规则；高峰时段发送消息前会先拦截并弹出确认。

description.en: Keeps the DSH host awake during active tasks using native power assertions and releases them when tasks finish.
description.zh: 在任务运行期间通过原生电源断言保持 DSH 主机亮屏与唤醒，并在任务结束后释放。

plugins.name: dsh-milvus

description.en: Read-only DSH Web plugin for inspecting and searching Milvus or Zilliz Cloud collections from chat, including scalar, BM25, dense, and hybrid queries.
description.zh: 只读 DSH Web 插件，可在对话中检查和搜索 Milvus 或 Zilliz Cloud Collection，支持标量、BM25、稠密向量与混合查询。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Query 64 Chinese exams (高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…) with rule-aware date math (2nd-Saturday, 1st-Sunday) and countdowns.
description.zh: 查询 64 场中国考试（高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…）的规则日期（第二个周六、第一个周日）与倒计时。

description.en: Compile SVG paths and keyframe specs into self-contained Lottie JSON animation files.
description.zh: 将 SVG 路径与关键帧参数编译成自包含的 Lottie JSON 动画文件。

description.en: Recurring-habit scheduling from pure date math: next occurrence, range schedules, and overdue advice.
description.zh: 基于纯日期数学的周期习惯排程：下次发生日、区间排程与逾期提醒。

description.en: Registers one `context_extract` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it compresses a long raw document (financial report, contract, ledger) into dense structured Markdown plus JSON — key metrics, tables, numbered clauses, entities and cross-check alerts — so a downstream pipeline can work from the compressed form instead of re-reading the raw document. Financial statements, legal contracts and business ledgers are detected and handled differently; balance-sheet and cash tie-outs are run and mismatches are flagged as alerts rather than silently fixed. Read-only; never modifies the source file. Requires Python with openpyxl and python-docx.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `context_extract` 工具：把长篇原始文件（财报底稿、合同、台账）压成高密度结构化 Markdown + JSON——关键指标、表格、条款切分、实体与勾稽 alert，让下游流程直接基于压缩结果工作，而不是重读原文。财报 / 合同 / 台账分别走不同解析路径；资产负债表与现金勾稽不平只报 alert，不静默修正。只读，不改原文件。需 Python 并安装 openpyxl 与 python-docx。

description.en: Registers one `office_audit` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it recalculates formulas with the bundled LibreOffice Kit and then audits the recalculated values — formula errors, broken sheet references, formula-consistency, hardcoded constants, number-format and unit mismatches, balance-sheet balance, retained-earnings roll-forward, cash tie-out, cash-flow subtotals, ratio-table conventions and data-cleaning issues. Findings are severity-ranked with the offending cell, and an optional findings sheet can be written into a copy. The source workbook is never modified. Requires Python with openpyxl and the bundled LibreOffice Kit.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `office_audit` 工具：用内置 LibreOffice Kit 重算公式后审计计算结果——公式错误、断链引用、公式一致性、硬编码、数字格式与单位不符、三表勾稽、留存收益滚动、现金 tie-out、现金流量表加总、比率表口径与数据清洗问题。问题按严重度分级并给出具体单元格位置，可选把「模型审计」页写进副本。原工作簿永不被修改。需 Python 与 openpyxl，并使用随包的 LibreOffice Kit。

description.en: Registers one `principles_audit` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it reviews a principle library for principle_id collisions and legacy ids, missing causal statements, boundaries, counter-examples or evidence, duplicate and near-duplicate principles, status-versus-confidence inconsistencies, long-stale entries and dimension-coverage gaps. Findings are severity-ranked and a hard gate turns them into pass, warn or fail, where every critical finding must be covered by a valid, unexpired exemption. The library is only read.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `principles_audit` 工具：审查原则库的 ID 冲突与旧版 ID、因果句/适用边界/反例/证据缺失、同名与近重复原则、状态与置信度不一致、长期未复核与维度覆盖缺口。问题按严重度分级，并用硬门禁给出 pass / warn / fail——严重项必须被有效且未过期的豁免覆盖。原则库只读不改。

description.en: Registers one `valuation_service` tool that reads a workpaper tree of 01/02/04 JSON and returns one unified schema: six ratio groups, forecast ratios, DCF input slots with explicit missing markers, comparable PS/PE and IRR. Deterministic and local: missing WACC, growth, capex, D&A or working-capital inputs stay blank instead of being guessed, and assumption differences are flagged for review.
description.zh: 注册一个 `valuation_service` 工具：读取 01/02/04 JSON 底稿树，输出统一 schema——六大类比率、预测比率、带 missing 标记的 DCF 输入槽、可比 PS/PE 与 IRR。确定性、本机运行：缺 WACC/增长率/资本开支/折旧摊销/营运资本时留空而不猜测，假设差异逐项标出交人工复核。

description.en: Registers one `workpaper_gate` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it audits a workpaper set for completeness, covering both the target design or template itself and the instance-versus-template structure, with the rule list, template list and core-table list all configurable in one spec file. Findings come back as blocker, warning and info, and the workpapers are only read, never modified. Requires Python with openpyxl.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `workpaper_gate` 工具：审核底稿完整性，既审目标（设计层/模板）自身，也审底稿实例与模板的结构一致性；规则清单、模板清单与核心表清单全部配置化在同一个 spec 文件里。结果按 blocker / warning / info 分级，底稿只读不改。需 Python 与 openpyxl。

description.en: Structured math problem bank with multi-solution support, layered knowledge graph and six-dimensional difficulty for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化数学题库：多解法、分层知识图谱、六维难度与技巧驱动的变式出题。

description.en: Panel for MCP servers registered by @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client: toggle each server on or off with live effect, see the registered tool count and estimated context-token cost of each server, and persist the choice to the home cordis.patch.yml with a timestamped backup before every write. The panel itself can sit either as a page inside Settings or as an icon row in the left sidebar, one seat at a time, with the switcher on the plugin page in Settings. Maintained fork of dsh-mcp-toggle.
description.zh: 面向 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 注册的 MCP 服务器的面板：逐个开关服务器（即时生效），显示各服务器的已注册工具数与预估上下文 token 开销，并将选择持久化到主目录 cordis.patch.yml，每次写入前保留带时间戳的备份。面板本身可以放在设置里作为一节，也可以放在左侧边栏作为一行图标，任一时刻只保留一个入口，切换器在「设置 → 插件」的插件页里。dsh-mcp-toggle 的维护分支。

description.en: Law paper writing corpus for DeepSeek Harness: 850 bibliographic records from four CLSCI journals (2024-2026) with title, authors, abstract, keywords and outline, supporting BM25 search, framework cards, journal profiling, submission self-check and export.
description.zh: 法学论文框架语料库：内置 2024–2026 四本 CLSCI 期刊 850 篇题录（标题、作者、摘要、关键词、目录骨架），支持 BM25 检索、框架卡、期刊画像、投稿对标自查与导出。

description.en: Chinese localization for DeepSeek Harness: translates all system prompts, tool descriptions, and runtime contexts into Chinese at runtime via the system-prompt/assemble waterfall (1788 entries, zero source modification, uninstall restores English).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 中文汉化插件：通过 system-prompt/assemble 瀑布钩子在运行时把全部系统提示词、工具描述与运行时上下文翻译成中文（1788 条译文，零源码修改，卸载即还原英文）。

description.en: Resident-index grep for DeepSeek Harness that shadows the built-in grep/glob tools under the same names: repeated content searches hit an in-memory index ranked by access/modification frecency, and glob serves the built-in ripgrep semantics when available, falling back to the index otherwise.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻索引 grep，以同名遮蔽内置 grep/glob 工具：重复内容检索命中按访问/修改 frecency 排序的内存索引，glob 在可用时对齐内置 ripgrep 语义、不可用时回退索引。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-multi

description.en: Selectable SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Gemini Search Grounding, or Wikipedia backend for the native web_search tool, with Web settings and no implicit fallback.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 工具提供可选的 SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Gemini 搜索溯源或 Wikipedia 后端，支持 Web 设置且不进行隐式回退。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Render Markdown + JSON into self-contained HTML documents, cards, dashboards, and galleries (CLI + artifact_render tool).
description.zh: 把 Markdown + JSON 渲染成自包含 HTML 文档/卡片/仪表盘/画廊（CLI + 内置 artifact_render 工具）。

description.en: Browser Use cloud bridge for dsh: run real web tasks — open pages, click, type, fill forms, and extract data — through the Browser Use API.
description.zh: Browser Use 云端桥接：通过 Browser Use API 让 dsh agent 执行真实网页任务，包括打开页面、点击、输入、填表和提取数据。

description.en: Scrape URLs to LLM-ready Markdown and search the web via the Firecrawl Cloud API.
description.zh: 通过 Firecrawl Cloud API 把 URL 抓成 LLM 可用 Markdown，或搜索网页并返回结果内容。

description.en: Tool-call discipline for DeepSeek Harness with behavior prompts, failure-driven concurrency reduction and retry guidance, post-write checks with backup rollback, high-risk command gates, change summaries and verification reminders, advisory project-memory checks, configurable project-discipline reminders after compaction or at intervals, and compliance statistics.
description.zh: 工具调用纪律：提供行为提示、失败后降低并行度与重试提醒、写后检查及备份回滚、高风险命令闸门、变更摘要与验证提醒、项目记忆建议性检查、可配置的项目纪律周期重述与压缩后补充，以及遵守度统计。

description.en: Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.
description.zh: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 `dsh-plugin` 话题生态，公开评分模型，提供 rank/search/recommend 工具与设置页榜单。

description.en: Text-first computer use for DSH: background Chromium control via Playwright/CDP plus accessibility-first macOS control; actions stay pinned to the right process and window without taking the user's pointer, ships a Developer ID signed, notarized Universal 2 DMG.
description.zh: DSH 电脑控制：Playwright/CDP 后台操作 Chromium，Accessibility 优先控制 macOS；动作锁定到正确进程与窗口，不抢前台、不移动鼠标，提供已签名公证的 Universal 2 DMG 安装包。

plugins.name: dsh-agnes-tools

description.en: Agnes AI image and video generation tools for DeepSeek Harness, where long video jobs can be resumed in a later call. Requires an Agnes API key (AGNES_API_KEY).
description.zh: 把 Agnes AI 的生图 / 生视频接成 DSH 原生工具，长视频任务可稍后续查。需设置 Agnes API Key（AGNES_API_KEY）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds supplemental request retries, turn auto-continue and a no-response watchdog on top of built-in dsh retries, with a live countdown banner, toast notifications and a usage dashboard.
description.zh: 在 dsh 内置重试之上追加重试、回合自动继续与无响应看门狗，提供实时倒计时横幅、通知弹窗与统计看板。

description.en: Windows only. Bilibili video summarizer: downloads the audio track, transcribes it locally with faster-whisper (Python + faster-whisper, about 725 MB of models on first run), then writes the analysis markdown and renders a one-page infographic PNG.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。B 站视频一键总结：下载音轨并用 faster-whisper 本地转写（需 Python 与 faster-whisper，首次运行下载约 725 MB 模型），随后生成解析 md 与一页「一图读懂」PNG。

description.en: Audits Chinese copy for AI-sounding phrasing: a 0-100 score over six dimensions, sentence-level flags with rewrite hints, and per-genre weights adjustable in conversation.
description.zh: 中文文案去 AI 味审计：0–100 六维评分、逐句打标并给出改法，文体权重可在对话里查看和修改。

description.en: Local image, PDF, data, audio/video and Office file conversion through agent tools and a drag-and-drop interface; v1.0.x targets DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5, with external tools required for some conversions.
description.zh: 通过 Agent 工具和拖拽界面在本地转换图片、PDF、数据、音视频及 Office 文件；v1.0.x 适配 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5，部分转换需要外部工具。

description.en: Desktop computer-use for DSH: captures the Windows screen into the agent vision channel and drives mouse/keyboard through a Codex-style overlay with Esc abort; auto-detects Windows native or WSL hosts.
description.zh: DSH 桌面操作插件：把 Windows 屏幕送进 Agent 视觉通道，并通过 Codex 风格覆盖层驱动鼠标/键盘，支持 Esc 中止；自动识别 Windows 原生或 WSL 宿主。

description.en: Generic Companion-protocol bridge from DeepSeek Harness to phones/IoT/legacy agents (includes Termux companion example).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用 Companion 桥：手机 / IoT / 旧世界薄 Agent（含 Termux 样例）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness to macOS companion daemon (notify / Shortcuts / clipboard read-write).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对接 macOS Companion（通知 / Shortcuts / 剪贴板读写）。

description.en: Allowlisted SSH into Unix/AIX/macOS from DeepSeek Harness (no shell; read-only by default), with remote_ssh_probe OS-aware suite.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 白名单 SSH 接入 Unix/AIX/macOS（不走 shell；默认只读），含 remote_ssh_probe 按系统探测套装。

description.en: Opens http(s) URLs from WSL in the Windows default browser.
description.zh: 在 Windows 默认浏览器中打开来自 WSL 的 http(s) 链接。

description.en: Read-only khal calendar list.
description.zh: 日历只读：khal list / today。

description.en: Reads and writes the Windows clipboard from WSL.
description.zh: 从 WSL 读写 Windows 剪贴板。

description.en: Detects WSL2 clock skew versus Windows that can break TLS and tokens.
description.zh: 检测相对 Windows 的 WSL2 时钟偏差，避免 TLS 与 token 异常。

description.en: Docker Compose ps/logs with richer status; up/down double-gated.
description.zh: Docker Compose：ps/logs 与更丰 status；up/down 需双重确认。

description.en: Safe Git Credential Manager hints for WSL without exposing secrets.
description.zh: 提供 WSL 下 Git Credential Manager 的安全指引，不回传密钥。

description.en: Read-only psql + redis-cli probes.
description.zh: psql / redis-cli 只读探针。

description.en: Windows security posture from WSL: Defender real-time state and signature age, recent detections, exclusions, and firewall profiles.
description.zh: Windows 安全态势：Defender 实时状态与特征库年龄、近期检出、排除项与防火墙配置。

description.en: Reports the current WSL distro and warns about multi-distro setups.
description.zh: 报告当前 WSL 发行版，并提醒多发行版混用风险。

description.en: Compares WSL versus Windows DNS resolution for common endpoints.
description.zh: 对比 WSL 与 Windows 对常用域名的 DNS 解析结果。

description.en: Reports Docker CLI, context, and daemon reachability in WSL, plus vLLM :8000 /v1/models health and GPU runtime hints.
description.zh: 报告 WSL 内 Docker CLI、context 与 daemon 是否可达，并探测 vLLM :8000 的 /v1/models 健康与 GPU runtime。

description.en: Lists or copies files from the Windows Downloads folder into the WSL workspace.
description.zh: 列出或复制 Windows「下载」文件夹中的文件到 WSL 工作区。

description.en: Opens a WSL Linux path in Windows Cursor, VS Code, or Notepad (optional line/column; win_editor_status).
description.zh: 用 Windows 的 Cursor、VS Code 或 Notepad 打开 WSL 路径（可选行列；含 win_editor_status）。

description.en: Reports PowerShell, cmd, and LANG encoding for UTF-8 versus code-page issues.
description.zh: 报告 PowerShell、cmd 与 LANG 编码，便于排查 UTF-8 与代码页问题。

description.en: Injects WSL distro, Linux path mapping, /mnt/c CRLF and git caveats, and NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY into the system prompt.
description.zh: 向 system prompt 注入 WSL 发行版、Linux 路径映射、/mnt/c 的 CRLF 与 git 注意点，以及 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY。

description.en: Read recent Windows event log entries from WSL, filtered by log name, level, provider and time window.
description.zh: Windows 事件日志：按日志名、级别、来源与时间窗读取近期条目。

description.en: Advises or applies allowlisted Windows portproxy for a WSL listen port, preferring the kit :3081 relay and launch token for local dsh UI.
description.zh: 为 WSL 监听端口提供白名单 Windows portproxy 建议或应用；本机 dsh UI 优先用 kit 的 :3081 中继与 launch token。

description.en: Registers a wsl-proxy ctx.web fetch provider so official web_fetch uses undici ProxyAgent through HTTP(S)_PROXY instead of connecting from WSL to a DNS-pinned public IP (the official path that produces TypeError: fetch failed behind a Windows proxy).
description.zh: 在 ctx.web 注册 wsl-proxy 抓取后端，让官方 web_fetch 经 HTTP(S)_PROXY 用 undici ProxyAgent 出网，避免官方实现在 WSL 里 DNS 钉死后直连公网 IP，从而在 Windows 代理后出现 TypeError: fetch failed。

description.en: Capped Git status / diff --stat / log --oneline (no full patches).
description.zh: 截断版 Git status / diff --stat / log --oneline。

description.en: Uses a GitHub App to report open PRs and the latest Actions run for the current repo without returning secrets.
description.zh: 通过 GitHub App 查询当前仓库未关闭 PR 与最近一次 Actions，不回传密钥。

description.en: Read-only glab MR / issue / ci status.
description.zh: glab 只读：MR / issue / ci。

description.en: Probes nvidia-smi and GPU visibility inside WSL.
description.zh: 探测 WSL 内的 nvidia-smi 与 GPU 可见性。

description.en: Read-only Helm list / status / history.
description.zh: Helm 只读：list / status / history。

description.en: Probes Windows-host Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, and llama-server from WSL, compares ctx, and reports /v1/models apiReady versus TCP.
description.zh: 从 WSL 探测 Windows 上的 Ollama、LM Studio、vLLM 与 llama-server，比对 ctx，并报告 /v1/models 的 apiReady 与 TCP 是否打通。

description.en: Bridges Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Slack, Discord, Telegram and Mattermost into dsh agents (outbound WS/Stream/Gateway/long-poll/webhook), with im_status, optional local Whisper ASR, plain-text outbound for QQ/DingTalk/Telegram/Mattermost, and env CSV allowlists (DSH_IM_*_ALLOWED_USER_IDS). Empty allowedUserIds means EVERYONE can drive your agent — set a whitelist before exposing a bot.
description.zh: 把飞书、企微、钉钉、QQ、Slack、Discord、Telegram、Mattermost 桥进 dsh agent（出站长连接/长轮询/Webhook），提供 im_status、可选本机 Whisper ASR、QQ/钉钉/TG/MM 纯文本出站，以及环境变量白名单（DSH_IM_*_ALLOWED_USER_IDS）。allowedUserIds 为空即任何人都能驱动 agent——对外暴露前请先设白名单。

description.en: Call TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One for noul, choice, and score (jev_ask / jev_check / jev_rank).
description.zh: 对接 TypeSafe Jev / OpenRouter System One：jev_ask / jev_check / jev_rank。

description.en: Read-only kubectl get / describe / logs / contexts for dsh on WSL (configurable log tail).
description.zh: kubectl 只读：get / describe / logs / contexts（可配置 logs 行数帽）。

description.en: Launches allowlisted Windows apps such as VS Code, Explorer, and browsers from WSL.
description.zh: 从 WSL 白名单启动 Windows 应用（如 VS Code、资源管理器、浏览器）。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible client for llama.cpp / Unsloth Desktop (default :8080).
description.zh: 对接 llama.cpp / Unsloth 的 OpenAI 兼容接口（默认 :8080）。

description.en: Mail list/search via himalaya / notmuch (no send).
description.zh: 邮件只读：himalaya / notmuch（不发送）。

description.en: Local media/doc pipeline: ffprobe, extract, thumbnail, PDF, ASR, pandoc, OCR, exif (allowRoots include IM inbox).
description.zh: 本地媒体/文档管线：ffprobe、抽音轨、缩略图、PDF、ASR、pandoc、OCR、exif（allowRoots 含 IM inbox）。

description.en: Warns when the workspace path sits on slow /mnt/c.
description.zh: 当工作区路径落在缓慢的 /mnt/c 上时发出告警。

description.en: Adds a net_doctor tool that reports proxy environment, NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY, and reachability of the DeepSeek API and the npm registry, and sets NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY on bash and npm child processes.
description.zh: 提供 net_doctor 工具，报告代理环境、NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY，以及 DeepSeek API 与 npm registry 的连通性，并为 bash 和 npm 子进程设置 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY。

description.en: Shows a short Windows MessageBox or toast (BalloonTip) from WSL when a long task finishes.
description.zh: 长任务结束后从 WSL 弹出 Windows MessageBox 或 toast（气球提示）。

description.en: Optional Obscura headless-browser tools from WSL (obscura_status / obscura_fetch / obscura_mcp_hint). Not the same as dsh-wsl-browser win_open_url (Windows GUI browser), and not a replacement for dsh-wsl-fetch web_fetch.
description.zh: 可选：在 WSL 中驱动 Obscura 无头浏览器（obscura_status / obscura_fetch / obscura_mcp_hint）。不同于 dsh-wsl-browser 的 win_open_url（打开 Windows 图形浏览器），也不替代 dsh-wsl-fetch 的 web_fetch。

description.en: Bridges a WSL dsh agent to a Windows Obsidian vault on NTFS: status/list/search/read/write/append, wikilink resolve, write/append require confirm=true, plus obsidian:// open. Keep the vault under /mnt/<drive>/; Linux-disk vaults via \\wsl$ are unreliable.
description.zh: 把 WSL 里的 dsh agent 接到 Windows NTFS 上的 Obsidian vault：status/list/search/read/write/append、wikilink 解析、写操作需 confirm=true，并用 obsidian:// 打开。vault 请放在 /mnt/<盘符>/；Linux 盘经 \\wsl$ 不可靠。

description.en: Local Ollama status / list / chat / embed for dsh on WSL (unreachable status includes Windows/WSL gateway hints).
description.zh: 本机 Ollama：status / list / chat / embed（不可达时给出 Windows/WSL 网关提示）。

description.en: Opens WSL Linux paths from DeepSeek Harness chat in the Windows default app or Explorer.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 聊天里的 WSL Linux 路径在 Windows 默认程序或资源管理器中打开。

description.en: Converts Linux and Windows paths with /mnt/c caveats for WSL.
description.zh: 在 WSL 下转换 Linux 与 Windows 路径，并说明 /mnt/c 注意点。

description.en: Windows host performance from WSL: CPU, memory, disk and top processes.
description.zh: Windows 宿主性能：CPU、内存、磁盘与占用最高的进程。

description.en: Browse WSL directories under / and /mnt for workspace picking (start/filter; im-workspace shortcuts).
description.zh: 浏览 WSL 的 / 与 /mnt 目录以便挑选工作区（start/filter；含 im-workspace 快捷入口）。

description.en: Dependency tree summaries: npm / pip / cargo.
description.zh: 依赖树摘要：npm / pip / cargo。

description.en: Headless Playwright fetch (title + body text) in WSL.
description.zh: WSL 无头 Playwright 抓取标题与正文。

description.en: Diagnoses WSL port listening and Windows localhost forwarding, with a 3080/3081 uiPlaybook for the dsh web relay and launch token.
description.zh: 诊断 WSL 端口监听与 Windows localhost 转发，并对 dsh web 中继的 3080/3081 给出含 launch token 的 uiPlaybook。

description.en: Windows power state from WSL: active power plan, all schemes, battery, sleep timeout and hibernation availability.
description.zh: Windows 电源：当前方案、全部方案、电池、休眠超时与是否支持休眠。

description.en: Read-only rclone listremotes / lsf / about.
description.zh: rclone 只读：listremotes / lsf / about。

description.en: Read-only Windows registry access from WSL, restricted to an allowlist of key prefixes; list a key's values or its child keys.
description.zh: Windows 注册表只读：限定在允许的键前缀内，可列值或列子键。

description.en: Sandboxed ripgrep / fd / ast-grep under allowRoots (defaults include ~/.dsh/im-workspace).
description.zh: 沙箱 ripgrep / fd / ast-grep（默认 allowRoots 含 ~/.dsh/im-workspace）。

description.en: Read-only pass / age secrets with allowPrefixes; reveal defaults to false.
description.zh: 只读 pass / age 密钥（需 allowPrefixes）；默认不明文回显。

description.en: Read Windows service state from WSL: list services, or inspect one by name with its dependencies, logon account and binary path.
description.zh: Windows 服务：列服务，或按名查单个服务的依赖、登录账户与可执行路径。

description.en: Saves a Windows clipboard image into a WSL file (clear ok:false + hint when clipboard has no image).
description.zh: 将 Windows 剪贴板图片存为 WSL 文件（无图时返回明确 ok:false 与 hint）。

description.en: Hints how to forward the Windows OpenSSH agent into WSL without dumping keys.
description.zh: 提示如何把 Windows OpenSSH agent 转发进 WSL，且不输出密钥。

description.en: Sandboxed jq / yq / read-only sqlite3.
description.zh: 沙箱化 jq / yq / sqlite3（只读 SELECT）。

description.en: Read-only systemd --user list / show / journal.
description.zh: systemd --user 只读：list / show / journal。

description.en: Terraform/OpenTofu plan summary + state list (never apply).
description.zh: Terraform/OpenTofu：plan 摘要 + state list（永不 apply）。

description.en: Read-only tmux list + capture-pane.
description.zh: 只读查看 tmux 会话与 pane 输出。

description.en: Writes a Windows shortcut and tray launcher to start dsh web in WSL, with Health/Restart and the :3081 launch-token URL.
description.zh: 生成 Windows 快捷方式与托盘启动器，在 WSL 中启动 dsh web，并提供 Health/Restart 与 :3081 launch token 地址。

description.en: Windows UI Automation from WSL: enumerate top-level windows, read a bounded element tree, and wait for or trace the path to a named element.
description.zh: Windows UI Automation：枚举顶层窗口、读取有界元素树，并按名等待元素或取祖先链。

description.en: Tiny local vector memory via Ollama embeddings and ~/.dsh/vecmem (workspace namespaces; optional IM crumb via vecmemOnReply).
description.zh: 本地向量小记：Ollama embedding + ~/.dsh/vecmem（workspace 命名空间；可选 IM 回合摘要写入）。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible vLLM client (default :8000).
description.zh: 对接 vLLM 的 OpenAI 兼容服务（默认 :8000）。

description.en: Enumerate and control Windows top-level windows from WSL: activate, minimize, maximize, restore, move, resize, set always-on-top, close.
description.zh: Windows 窗口控制：激活、最小化、最大化、还原、移动、改尺寸、置顶、关闭。

description.en: Targeted Windows input from WSL: invoke a UI Automation element by name, or send keys, clicks and mouse wheel to a chosen window.
description.zh: Windows 定向输入：按名调用 UI 元素，或向指定窗口发送按键、点击与滚轮。

description.en: Capture a Windows window to a WSL file, whole or cropped to a region or to a named UI element.
description.zh: 截取 Windows 窗口到 WSL 文件：整窗、按区域裁剪，或裁剪到指定 UI 元素。

description.en: Lists WSL distros and validates a Linux workspace path for DSH.
description.zh: 列出 WSL 发行版并校验可用于 DSH 的 Linux 工作区路径。

description.en: Gives read-only advice for Windows .wslconfig memory and mirrored networking.
description.zh: 只读查看 Windows .wslconfig，并给出内存与 mirrored 网络建议。

plugins.name: dsh-wsl-workspace

description.en: Add a WSL workspace from the web GUI without needing to install dsh or related tools again inside WSL. Bash commands and file read/write operations run within the local WSL distribution on the host machine, while Windows files remain accessible.
description.zh: 从 Web GUI 添加 WSL 工作区，无需在 WSL 之中再次安装 dsh 以及相关工具，bash 命令与文件读写运行在本机 WSL 发行版内，Windows 文件仍可访问。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Windows-native tools for DSH agents: clipboard read and write, system notifications, hosts file inspection and network diagnostics, each returning structured data with UI cards from injection-safe PowerShell.
description.zh: 面向 DSH agent 的 Windows 原生工具：剪贴板读写、系统通知、hosts 文件查看与网络诊断，均返回结构化数据（带 UI 卡片），底层为防注入的 PowerShell。

description.en: Use Windows and native Linux DSH sessions in one Windows window, with WSL environment switching and bidirectional system tools.
description.zh: 在同一个 Windows 窗口中使用 Windows 与原生 Linux DSH 会话，支持 WSL 环境切换和双向系统操作。

description.en: Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports.
description.zh: 从 WSL2 走 IPv6/IPv4 经反向代理（Lucky）把 DSH Web GUI 暴露到公网：/wan up 一键建立 socat 中继、Windows portproxy、防火墙与 trusted-host 白名单；域名与端口可在设置卡片或命令中配置。

description.en: Adds /dev/dxg and /proc read-write grants to the DSH Landlock sandbox on WSL2, so CUDA is available inside a confined agent bash session.
description.zh: 为 WSL2 上的 DSH Landlock 沙箱追加 /dev/dxg 与 /proc 的读写授权，使受限的 agent bash 会话中也能使用 CUDA。

description.en: Fixes the Windows workspace-open action: the shipped opener spawns explorer.exe with windowsHide, so the File Explorer window is created invisible and the click reports success without appearing.
description.zh: 修正 Windows 上「打开工作目录」：上游启动 explorer.exe 时带了 windowsHide，导致文件资源管理器窗口被创建为不可见，点击看似成功却什么都没出现。

description.en: Windows only (binds user32.dll via koffi; inert on macOS/Linux). Remembers the DeepSeek Harness main window's size AND position: restores both on every launch (re-asserted during a grace period to beat the default layout), saves stable manual moves/resizes as the new lock, never records minimized/maximized/fullscreen states, never adopts the default rect DSH itself places the window at (so the app's own layout resets can never poison the lock), and stays on-screen when monitors change. Compatible with DSH 0.2.1-rc.3+.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows（用 koffi 绑定 user32.dll，macOS/Linux 上不生效）。记住 DeepSeek Harness 主窗口的尺寸与位置：启动时恢复上次的位置和大小，并在宽限期内反复断言以压过默认布局；手动移动或调整窗口后自动保存为新锁定；最小化/最大化/全屏状态不会被记录；DSH 自行放置的默认矩形永远不会被采纳，应用自身的布局重置无法污染锁定；更换显示器时自动防屏外。兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3+。

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut and system-tray launcher for DSH running in WSL, with fully hidden startup, tray open/restart/exit menu, and a plugin-configuration card to manage the shortcut.
description.zh: 为运行在 WSL 的 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面快捷方式和系统托盘启动器：完全隐藏启动，托盘菜单支持打开/重启/退出，插件配置页可管理快捷方式。

description.en: Injects native-Windows (non-WSL) PowerShell, encoding, filesystem, and cross-platform-build gotchas into the system prompt.
description.zh: 向系统提示注入原生 Windows（非 WSL）环境下 PowerShell、字符编码、文件系统与跨平台构建的常见坑点。

description.en: Add a WSL directory as a DSH workspace from the sidebar's Add workspace button: pick a distribution, browse the Linux tree, and the directory is registered as a \\wsl.localhost workspace whose sidebar terminals open inside the distribution and whose files the agent can write. Requires Windows 10/11 with WSL installed.
description.zh: 在侧栏的「添加工作区」按钮里把 WSL 目录加成 DSH 工作区：选发行版、浏览目录后以 \\wsl.localhost 路径注册；该工作区的侧栏终端开在发行版里，agent 也能正常写入其中的文件。需 Windows 10/11 并已安装 WSL。

description.en: Adds a logon autostart switch for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. It manages a single shortcut in the user Startup folder: no registry writes, no admin rights, no extra background process.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版加一个登录自启开关：只管理用户启动文件夹里的一个快捷方式，不写注册表、不需要管理员权限、不额外常驻进程。

description.en: Choose which shell backs the Windows terminal tool: PowerShell, the local Git Bash, or cmd.exe.
description.zh: 选择 Windows 终端工具背后的 shell：PowerShell、本地 Git Bash 或 cmd.exe。

description.en: Runs persistent bash and Linux-path file and search tools inside the current WSL distribution. A new conversation that selects WSL mode asks which of that distribution's folders to use as the workspace, and nothing is installed inside the distribution.
description.zh: 在当前 WSL 发行版里运行持久 bash 以及 Linux 路径的文件与搜索工具。新建对话选中 WSL 后，从该发行版的文件夹里指定工作区，且不会在发行版内安装任何东西。

description.en: WSL console for the harness — manage distributions, edit .wslconfig and wsl.conf in a typed form, and run commands, file edits and long-running processes inside any distribution with its own wslx-* tools.
description.zh: 用于 Harness 的 WSL 控制台：管理发行版、以表单编辑 .wslconfig 与 wsl.conf，并用自带的 wslx-* 工具在任意发行版内执行命令、读写文件、运行长驻进程。

description.en: Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.
description.zh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。

description.en: Extends the working range of DSH into WSL. Files in the distribution can be read, written, edited and searched by DSH directly. Depending on the task, the AI chooses for itself: run a one-off command, or open its own terminal and run several commands there to finish the job. Typing `dsh` in a WSL terminal calls DSH (type `dsh help` there for details), fusing WSL and DSH deeply. Every terminal you open can collaborate visually with the AI.
description.zh: 将 DSH 的工作范围扩展到 WSL。插件支持了发行版中的文件直接被 DSH 读取、写入、编辑与搜索。面对不同任务需求，AI可根据任务需求自行选择执行一次性命令/自建终端执行多条命令以完成任务。支持在 WSL 终端中键入 dsh 命令调用 DSH(详情在 WSL 终端键入dsh help)，深度融合了 WSL 与 DSH。用户新建的所有终端支持与AI可视化协作。

description.en: Publishes an ordered system prompt section that names wsl as the command executor to reach for first, so the agent prefers WSL over PowerShell on Windows. Registers no tools, and only advertises executors the agent can actually call.
description.zh: 发布一段带顺序的系统提示词段，指定 wsl 为执行命令时优先选用的执行器，让模型在 Windows 上优先走 WSL 而不是 PowerShell。不注册任何工具，且只宣传模型真实可调用的执行器。

description.en: Keeps the DSH browser from accumulating tabs: once a configurable limit is exceeded it closes blank, error, duplicate and oldest pages, while leaving the page in use, newly opened tabs and keep-pattern URLs alone. Includes a settings panel with preview and manual cleanup.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器标签页管家：超过可配置上限时，按空白页、报错页、重复地址、最老页面的顺序关闭，正在用、刚打开和命中保留规则的页面不动；带设置页，可预演和手动清理。

description.en: Fetches any http/https page and returns title, description, main text, heading outline and links, with stats (char/word counts, reading time, language) and top keywords; can download content images to the session workspace for vision analysis and dispatch them to registered analyzers via the scrape.imageAnalyzer service.
description.zh: 抓取任意 http/https 网页，提取标题、描述、正文、标题结构与链接，输出字符/词数、阅读时长、语言等统计与高频关键词；支持下载内容图片到会话工作区供视觉分析，并通过 scrape.imageAnalyzer 服务分发给已注册的识图分析器。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-tavily

description.en: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
description.zh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量与时间窗口的设置卡片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Installs the codex-cua skill so DeepSeek Harness can use Codex computer use: drives Chrome and native macOS apps through the runtime bundled with the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app, ships a persistent session client and a doctor self-check. Requires the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app with its Chrome extension, Python 3.9+, and macOS.
description.zh: 安装 codex-cua 技能，让 DeepSeek Harness 使用 Codex computer use：通过 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面端自带的运行时操作 Chrome 与 macOS 原生应用，自带常驻会话客户端与 doctor 自检。需已装 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面端及 Chrome 扩展、Python 3.9+，仅 macOS。

plugins.name: dsh-websearch

description.en: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.
description.zh: 聚合网络搜索插件：一次查询并发分发到 11 个引擎（Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Serper、Mojeek、DeepSeek、Anthropic、OpenAI），URL 去重后合并结果。设置面板卡片可开关后端、将 API Key 存入凭证库，并调整并发与超时。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Independent browser acceptance testing for agent deliverables: JSON spec in, real-Chromium verdict out.
description.zh: Agent 交付物的独立浏览器验收测试：JSON 规格进，真实 Chromium 结论出。

description.en: Read any page as clean main content: charset auto-detect (GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5), noise stripping, compact text/Markdown, offset continuation, optional SPA rendering, batch reads and site crawling.
description.zh: 读取网页返回干净正文：中文编码自动识别（GBK/GB2312/UTF-8/Big5）、噪音过滤、紧凑文本/Markdown、offset 续读、可选 SPA 渲染、批量读取与整站爬取。

description.en: Drives a locally installed Moli headless browser from DeepSeek Harness: rendered fetch, JavaScript evaluation, Markdown, semantic trees, screenshots and PDFs. A CSS selector returns one container rather than the whole page (measured 40-80x fewer tokens on listing pages) and scroll triggers lazy loading. Installs Moli when it is missing; verified with a real engine on Windows, Linux and macOS.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动本机安装的 Moli 无头浏览器：渲染抓取、JavaScript 求值、Markdown、语义树、截图与 PDF。用 CSS 选择器只取某个容器而不是整页（列表页实测省 40–80 倍 token），并支持滚动触发懒加载。Moli 缺失时自动安装；已在 Windows、Linux 与 macOS 上用真实引擎验证。

description.en: A persistent translate button lives in every page the browser opens: click it and every visible text node is replaced in place, click again to restore. Hold to drag, drop it near an edge and it tucks into a small handle; it is re-injected automatically after navigation. The host LLM service does the translation — the plugin holds no API key.
description.zh: 给内置浏览器的每一张页面常驻一个「🈯 译」按钮：点一下，页面上每个可见文本节点原地换成译文；再点一下回到原文。长按可拖动，拖到左右边缘自动吸成贴边小把手；页面导航后自动重装。翻译走宿主模型服务 —— 插件不持有任何 API key。

plugins.name: dsh-web-tools

description.en: Unified multi-provider web search and fetch: BYOK key pools, health monitoring, and deterministic fallback.
description.zh: 统一的多供应商网络搜索与抓取：多 Key 轮询容灾、用量与健康监控、原生设置面板及搜索模式。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a Firecrawl search provider with multi-account API-key settings.
description.zh: 提供 Firecrawl 搜索服务及多账户 API Key 设置。

description.en: In-app browser for DSH: a dedicated Chromium rooted at a persistent profile so a Feishu or SSO login survives restarts, driven over CDP, exposing seven agent tools (status, open, eval, read, feishu, screenshot, tabs) and mirroring the page live in a right-sidebar panel that tool calls open by themselves. Also converts Feishu documents to Markdown by sweeping their virtual scroll. Requires a locally installed Chrome, Edge, Chromium, or a Playwright Chromium build (it never downloads one); set DSH_IAB_CHROME to point at a specific binary.
description.zh: DSH 内置浏览器：独立 Chromium 配合持久化 profile，飞书或 SSO 登录一次跨重启有效，经 CDP 驱动，提供七个 Agent 工具（status、open、eval、read、feishu、screenshot、tabs），并把页面实时镜像到右侧栏面板——工具调用时面板会自动打开。另可按虚拟滚动回扫把飞书文档转成 Markdown。需本机已装 Chrome / Edge / Chromium 或 Playwright 的 Chromium 构建（不会自动下载）；可用 DSH_IAB_CHROME 指定可执行文件。

description.en: Shared browser panel for DeepSeek Harness via Better Sidebar, with local Chromium, human and agent mouse and keyboard control, page snapshots, screenshots, and per-chat persistent profiles.
description.zh: 通过 Better Sidebar 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供共享浏览器面板，支持本地 Chromium、人和 AI 的鼠标键盘操作、页面快照、截图及按聊天持久保存的浏览器资料。

description.en: Controls your real Chrome from DSH over a local WebSocket bridge: tab management, navigation, DOM snapshots, page JS evaluation, clicks, typing, screenshots, waits and dialog handling behind a Settings toggle.
description.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 桥接让 DSH 操控你的真实 Chrome：标签页管理、导航、DOM 快照、页面 JS 求值、点击输入、截图、等待与弹窗处理，默认关闭需在设置中开启。

description.en: Generic browser automation with six tools (browser_open, browser_click, browser_type, browser_extract, browser_screenshot, browser_eval), @e element references, and dual Playwright-headless / CDP (connect to your own Chrome) backends.
description.zh: 通用浏览器自动化：browser_open、browser_click、browser_type、browser_extract、browser_screenshot、browser_eval 六个工具，@e 元素引用，Playwright 无头与 CDP（连接本机 Chrome）双后端。

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9 interactive browser tools.
description.zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-pro

description.en: Persistent enhanced web search: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU cache, userscript-style extraction, Playwright rendering.
description.zh: 增强型、可持久化的网页搜索：多引擎路由（DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/B站/YouTube/V2EX/小红书/Twitter/Reddit/RSS）、SQLite+LRU 缓存、userscript 风格抽取、Playwright 渲染。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to export.arxiv.org

plugins.name: dsh-tavily-web

description.en: Tavily search and page fetch: tavily_search queries with a rotating pool of up to eight API keys that backs off per key on 401/403/429 so one exhausted account does not take the tool down, and web_fetch retrieves a single page through curl, returning its HTTP status with de-tagged text.
description.zh: Tavily 检索与网页抓取：tavily_search 带最多八把 API key 的轮询池，按 key 对 401/403/429 退避，单个账号额度耗尽不再等于工具失效；web_fetch 经 curl 抓取单页，返回 HTTP 状态与去标签正文。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Two native tools for key-free Chinese/English search via 360, Bing RSS and DuckDuckGo, and static webpage text extraction, without a browser, Python or MCP subprocess.
description.zh: 两个原生工具，提供基于 360、Bing RSS 和 DuckDuckGo 的免 API Key 中英文搜索与静态网页正文读取，无需浏览器、Python 或 MCP 子进程。

description.en: Browser automation connector: drives the local Edge or Chrome over the DevTools Protocol with zero runtime dependencies — launch a headless throwaway-profile browser or attach to one started with --remote-debugging-port, then navigate, read page text and interactive elements, click, type, and screenshot through 11 agent tools.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化连接器：用 DevTools 协议直接驱动本机 Edge/Chrome，零运行时依赖——可启动无头的一次性 profile 浏览器，也可接管用 --remote-debugging-port 启动的浏览器；通过 11 个工具完成打开页面、读取正文与可交互元素、点击、填表与截图。

description.en: Embeds external AI chat sites in a DSH side panel through the same-origin reverse proxy with per-site DOM adapters, and adds a composer button that either rewrites the draft with the host model or runs a two-round loop: compress the conversation, optimize, send to the embedded site, capture the reply, then finalize it into the composer.
description.zh: 通过同源反向代理把外部 AI 对话站点嵌进 DSH 右侧面板（DOM 适配器写在配置里，站点改版无需改代码），并在输入框旁加一个按钮：要么用宿主模型改写草稿，要么跑一轮闭环——压缩对话、优化、发送到嵌入站点、捕获回复、整理成终稿写回输入框。

plugins.name: dsh-webscout

description.en: Tavily-backed web search and page fetch for DeepSeek Harness: a Search provider, a Fetch provider with Tavily Extract, Firecrawl and direct HTTP modes, and a settings card. Needs a Tavily API key; Firecrawl is optional.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Tavily 网页搜索与页面抓取：包含 Search provider、支持 Tavily Extract/Firecrawl/本地 HTTP 的 Fetch provider，以及设置卡片。需要 Tavily API key，Firecrawl 可选。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Connects Harness to the published BeatBrowser runtime with namespaced MCP tools and a TaskSpace Skill; requires the Chrome extension and preserves manual takeover.
description.zh: 通过带命名空间的 MCP 工具和任务空间 Skill 接入已发布的 BeatBrowser；需要 Chrome 扩展，保留人工接管规则。

description.en: Opens the dsh web GUI in a dedicated Edge/Chrome app-mode window on its own browser profile and gracefully stops the server when that window is closed.
description.zh: 在独立浏览器 profile 的 Edge/Chrome 应用模式窗口中打开 dsh web 界面，关闭窗口即优雅停止服务。

description.en: Adds CodePen, Pinterest, Z-Library, and GitHub data cards to the native @ reference menu, with Pinterest pagination and Z-Library sorting.
description.zh: 在原生 @ 引用菜单中提供 CodePen、Pinterest、Z-Library 与 GitHub 数据卡片，并支持 Pinterest 分页和 Z-Library 排序。

description.en: Exact-profile control of your real logged-in Chrome browser: an MCP server plus MV3 extension and authenticated localhost bridge for tabs, locators, file injection, media export, and durable scroll capture, with no debug profile or remote-debugging port.
description.zh: 按精确 Profile 名控制你真实已登录的 Chrome 浏览器：MCP 服务器 + MV3 扩展 + 认证本地桥接，提供标签页、定位器、文件注入、媒体导出与持久滚动采集，不使用调试 Profile 或远程调试端口。

description.en: Select browser elements directly during Vibe Coding and send structured visual feedback to the DeepSeek Harness Agent.
description.zh: 面向 Vibe Coding 的浏览器元素标注插件：直接选取页面元素，并将结构化视觉反馈发送给 DeepSeek Harness Agent。

plugins.name: web-search-advanced

description.en: Switchable web-search provider for DSH: native DeepSeek web search or an OpenAI-compatible custom backend. Installation automatically routes DSH web searches to the plugin; only provider, API key and model are required. Published on npm as @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3.
description.zh: 安装后自动将 DSH 网页搜索路由到本插件；只需配置服务商、API Key 和模型即可使用。支持 DeepSeek 原生搜索与 OpenAI 兼容自定义后端，已发布为 npm 包 @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real browser through the local bridge.
description.zh: 自动安装并启动 kimi-webbridge 桥接守护进程（含 SHA-256 校验），注册一套 25 个动作的技能，通过本地桥接驱动用户的真实浏览器。

plugins.name: dsh-search-proxy

description.en: SearXNG web search with a managed local runtime, external instance support, Web settings, and an optional DSH process proxy.
description.zh: 提供 SearXNG 网页搜索，支持托管本地运行环境、连接已有实例、Web 设置及可选的 DSH 进程代理。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for the built-in web_fetch tool: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify) and returns markdown.
description.zh: 为内置 web_fetch 工具提供 Playwright/CDP 后端：用真实浏览器渲染网页，经 Readability + DOMPurify 降噪后返回 Markdown。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-aggregation

description.en: Aggregated web-search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one prioritized queue over nine providers (AnySearch, TinyFish, Tavily, Brave, Exa, Firecrawl, Jina, SerpApi, Serper), with multi-key rotation per provider, ordered fallback on failed attempts, and a live settings card.
description.zh: 聚合式网页搜索提供方：为内置 web_search 工具提供一条按优先级排序的搜索队列，覆盖 AnySearch、TinyFish、Tavily、Brave、Exa、Firecrawl、Jina、SerpApi、Serper 九家服务，每家支持多把 API Key 轮换，失败时逐级回退，并附带实时生效的设置卡片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-search-account

description.en: DeepSeek account-backed web search and page fetching for DeepSeek Harness sessions whose chat model runs through a third-party subscription or gateway (for example OpenCode Go): registers deepseek-account-search and deepseek-account-fetch providers that call the official Search and Fetch APIs with the signed-in DeepSeek account token, so the built-in web_search and web_fetch keep working without a DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.
description.zh: 为聊天模型走第三方订阅或网关（例如 OpenCode Go）的 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供基于已登录 DeepSeek 账号的网页搜索与抓取：注册 deepseek-account-search 和 deepseek-account-fetch 两个提供方，用账号 token 调用官方 Search / Fetch API，无需 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 也能让内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 继续可用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A real Chrome or Edge for the agent to work in, mirrored in the sidebar so you can watch and take over: every conversation gets its own browser process, with its own profile and its own CDP port, so sign-ins never leak between conversations. It drives the Chrome or Edge already on the machine, downloads no browser, needs no companion app or extension, and another Playwright or DevTools can attach to the same CDP port while the sidebar is live.
description.zh: 让 agent 在一台真实 Chrome 或 Edge 里干活，侧栏同步镜像，你能看着，也能随时接手：每个对话一台独立的浏览器进程，各自的 profile 与 CDP 端口，登录态不会在对话之间串。它驱动机器上已有的 Chrome 或 Edge，不下载浏览器，不需要配套应用或扩展；侧栏镜像开着时，另一个 Playwright 或 DevTools 也能附加到同一个 CDP 端口。

plugins.name: dsh-free-search

description.en: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.
description.zh: 可切换引擎的联网搜索 provider，其中多个引擎无需 API key（Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等），可设置回退顺序；另提供 multi_search、platform_search、带对话内图片墙的 image_search、page_images 和 save_images，以及配置引擎、密钥和按引擎代理的设置页。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#web-fetch

description.en: A guarded local fetch provider for the ctx.web seam — the backend dsh does not ship for its own web_fetch tool. Every redirect hop is re-resolved and checked against the non-routable ranges, with a streamed size cap and a content-type allowlist.
description.zh: ctx.web 接口的本地受控抓取提供方——dsh 自带完整的 web_fetch 工具，却没有随附后端。每一跳重定向都会重新解析并对照非公网地址段校验，另有流式大小上限与内容类型白名单。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 100.64.0.0 for network access

description.en: Points web_search at a self-hosted SearXNG instance instead of the native route: pages until maxResults is satisfied, and reports degraded coverage when engines fail so a thin result set is not read as a thin web.
description.zh: 把 web_search 指向自建的 SearXNG 实例而非原生搜索路由：自动翻页直到满足 maxResults，并在引擎失败时报告覆盖不全，避免把稀少的结果误读成网上本就没有内容。

description.en: Annotate pages inside the existing Harness Browser: click or drag to select, comment or ask, then send marked screenshots or DOM location details to the current session. While enabled it replaces the official Browser, Chat and Layout providers; targets Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2.
description.zh: 在 Harness 原有 Browser 内批注网页：点选或框选后就地评论、提问，可把标记截图或 DOM 定位资料发给当前会话；启用期间替换官方 Browser、Chat 与 Layout 提供方，精确支持 Harness 0.2.1-alpha.2。

description.en: Browser tools for DSH that POST to the local OpenCLI daemon instead of spawning the opencli CLI per command, avoiding its cold start: oc_status, oc_exec, oc_navigate, oc_snapshot and oc_tabs, with one persistent automation tab per session.
description.zh: 把本机 OpenCLI daemon 当常驻服务直连的 DSH 浏览器工具，替代「每条命令起一次 opencli CLI」的冷启动：oc_status、oc_exec、oc_navigate、oc_snapshot、oc_tabs 五个工具，每个 session 一个常驻自动化标签页。需要本机运行 OpenCLI daemon，并让浏览器里的 OpenCLI 扩展保持连接。

plugins.name: dsh-douyin-agent

description.en: Autonomous Douyin watching in a dedicated Edge browser on Windows (requires Node.js 22.13+): sampling decisions, frame storyboards, danmaku-aware comments, persona memory and a watch diary, all under daily viewing limits. Fork of LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent — uninstall the upstream plugin before installing this one.
description.zh: 在 Windows 的专用 Edge 浏览器里自主刷抖音（需 Node.js 22.13+）：采样决策、抽帧拼故事板、带时间的高赞弹幕、人格与兴趣记忆、观看日报，全程受每日时段与额度限制。改自 LockyBee/dsh-douyin-agent，不能与上游同装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 141.0.0.0 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-free-search

description.en: Free, keyless web search for DSH: 7 engines (DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG free + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), auto-failover, settings-page UI with API key inputs and official links, web_fetch, and an engine test tool.
description.zh: DSH 免费搜索插件：7 个引擎（DuckDuckGo/Bing/SearXNG 免费 + Exa/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、设置页 UI（API key 输入 + 官网链接）、web_fetch、引擎测试工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Decodo Web Data API as the fetch provider behind the built-in web_fetch tool: returns Markdown by default, pins fetchProvider to decodo, and enforces a configurable per-process fetch cap. Requires a Decodo API key; web_search is unchanged.
description.zh: 把内置 web_fetch 工具的抓取后端换成 Decodo Web Data API：默认返回 Markdown，并把 fetchProvider 固定为 decodo，可配置单进程抓取上限；需要 Decodo API Key，web_search 不受影响。

description.en: Free web search with 10 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch free + Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek paid), automatic fallback chain, time-filtered advanced search, platform search (GitHub/Reddit), web page fetching, LRU caching, and a settings UI. No API keys required for basic use.
description.zh: 免费网页搜索，支持 10 个引擎（Bing/DuckDuckGo/SearXNG/AnySearch 免费，Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Perplexity/DeepSeek 付费）、自动回退、按时间筛选的高级搜索、平台搜索（GitHub/Reddit）、网页内容抓取、LRU 缓存和设置界面。基本使用无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Real browser tools for DeepSeek Harness: browse and extract web content, fill forms, manage multiple tabs, and execute multi-step tasks, with incremental DOM, session isolation, screenshots, action-result checks, and archived evidence recall.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供真实浏览器操作能力：网页浏览与信息提取、表单填写、多标签页协作和多步骤任务执行；支持增量 DOM、会话隔离、截图、操作结果检查与证据归档回读。

description.en: Attaches the current Chrome tab to a DSH draft: one pick screenshots the page (falling back to a macOS window shot) and writes its title and URL into the composer as one line.
description.zh: 把当前 Chrome 标签页附到 DSH 草稿：一次点击截图（失败时降级为 macOS 窗口截图），同时把页面标题与地址写成一行放进输入框。

description.en: Open the extension side panel and it takes over the page you are browsing right now. On top of upstream it adds: hover, coordinate clicks, drag, batched action chains, whole-page screenshots, local file upload, image listing, and switching between several connected browsers. Pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list; actions wait for your approval and sensitive fields stay masked. Ships as the bridge plugin, with the extension in the same release. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser
description.zh: 打开浏览器扩展侧边栏，就能原地接管你当前正在浏览的网页。在上游基础上补齐了：悬停、坐标点击、拖拽、批量动作链、整页截图、本地文件上传、图片地址列举，并可在多个已连接的浏览器之间切换。页面以带编号的结构化文本交给模型；动作默认需要你批准，敏感字段以掩码呈现。发布的是桥接插件，配套扩展在同一 Release 里。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 的 fork，原仓库：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

description.en: Drives a Chromium browser you are already running — Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Chromium, Arc or Thorium — over one long-lived CDP connection, so the remote-debugging approval is asked once instead of per command. Commands for tabs, navigation, JS evaluation, DOM snapshots, clicks, typing, screenshots and CSS/DOM/pixel assertions go over a loopback HTTP route that the agent calls with the shell tool it already has, so no new tools are registered, and the plugin registers its own usage skill with no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 通过一条常驻 CDP 连接驱动本机已在运行的 Chromium 内核浏览器——Chrome、Edge、Brave、Vivaldi、Opera、Chromium、Arc、Thorium，远程调试授权只需点一次，而不是每条命令都点。标签页、导航、执行 JS、DOM 快照、点击、输入、截图以及 CSS/DOM/像素断言都走本机回环 HTTP 路由，agent 用已有的 shell 工具发命令，因此不注册新工具；插件自带使用说明 skill，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-browser-cdp

description.en: Visible agent browser over CDP: 30+ bcdp_* automation tools, realtime SSE watch panel with direct click/scroll/IME input, element picking quoted into the composer as balanced @"picks/*.json" references, and human-verification notices.
description.zh: 看得见的 Agent 浏览器（CDP 接入）：30+ bcdp_* 工具，实时观察窗支持直接点击/滚动/中文输入，点选元素以 @"picks/*.json" 引用投进输入框，人机验证提醒；DSH 0.1.5/0.1.7/0.2.0 宿主各有一条对应版本线。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-union-search

description.en: Union web search for DSH (consolidated successor of DDDMUC/dsh-free-search, which it credits): 28 engines across three tiers — keyless free (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG multi-instance union, plus Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless modes), paid-with-key (Zhihu/Perplexity/Serply/DeepSeek official/You.com/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao/Zhipu/Bocha/Metaso), and model built-in search (OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok, explicit opt-in only) — with auto smart routing, per-engine enable/disable & fallback priority, parallel top-3 merge, multi_search, failure-aware fallback, a toggle to block the system built-in search, time filtering, platform search, web_fetch and a web settings UI. Experimental free advance_fetch: whole-page GFM-Markdown or CSS-selector/fields structured extraction with no API key and no per-call billing; fetch identity configurable (custom User-Agent, Referer, per-domain cookies attached only on domain match, never leaked across cross-domain redirects). Hosts 0.1.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1-rc.2 (17-tag exact engines.dsh enum; the rc.2 search-provider takeover goes through volatile config pinning after capability probing, never version branches). Paid engines need your own API keys (optional; free engines work keyless). npm: @drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search and bare dsh-union-search.
description.zh: DSH 的联合联网搜索（DDDMUC/dsh-free-search 的整合后继，README 有致谢）：28 个引擎分三档——免 key 免费（Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG 多实例联合，Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel 免 key 模式）、凭 key 付费（知乎/Perplexity/Serply/DeepSeek 官方/You.com/百度/Kimi/阿里云/豆包/智谱/博查/Metaso）、模型内置搜索（OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Grok，仅显式勾选）——配自动智能路由、逐引擎开关与回退优先级、并行 top-3 融合、multi_search 跨源工具、失败感知回退、屏蔽系统内置搜索开关、时间过滤、平台搜索、web_fetch 与网页设置界面。实验性·免费 advance_fetch：整页 GFM-Markdown 或 CSS 选择器/字段结构化抽取，零 key 零按次计费；抓取身份可配（自定义 UA、Referer、按域 cookie——仅在域名匹配时附带、跨域重定向绝不外流）。宿主 0.1.0-rc.2→0.2.1-rc.2 共 17 个 rc 精确枚举（rc.2 的搜索接管经能力探测后走 volatile 配置钉选，禁版本号分支）。付费引擎需自备 API key（可选，免费引擎开箱即用）。npm：@drscrewdriver/dsh-union-search 与裸名 dsh-union-search 双发。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Microsoft Web IQ search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, endpoint, language, region, passage length and SafeSearch.
description.zh: 基于 Microsoft Web IQ 的网页搜索提供方，接入内置 web_search 工具，并提供 API Key、端点、语言、地区、摘要长度与 SafeSearch 的设置卡片。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-firecrawl

description.en: Firecrawl-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key and result limits.
description.zh: 基于 Firecrawl 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量等字段的设置卡片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Drive a real Chrome/Chromium browser from DeepSeek Harness with 35 structured tools for navigation, snapshots, clicks, forms, JavaScript/CDP, screenshots, downloads and tabs; a live sidebar mirrors the page and accepts mouse and keyboard input. It ships a managed CDP runtime, keeps login state across calls, and can import cookies from your everyday Chrome through a companion extension.
description.zh: 用 35 个结构化工具从 DeepSeek Harness 驱动真实 Chrome/Chromium：导航、语义快照、点击、表单、JavaScript/CDP、截图、下载与标签页管理；右侧边栏实时镜像页面，并支持鼠标键盘直接接管。插件自带受管 CDP 运行时，跨调用保留登录状态，并可通过配套 Chrome 扩展从日常浏览器导入 cookie。

description.en: Annotates pages inside the built-in browser: click an element, write a comment, and send the batch to the conversation as one message, with a cropped screenshot per note where the element can be located.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器里给网页元素写批注，整批发进对话；每条批注附一张能定位到元素的裁剪截图。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-ext

description.en: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free anonymous access.
description.zh: 面向内置 web_search 工具的多后端搜索提供方（Exa + Firecrawl）：自动故障切换、按后端 429 冷却、无密钥匿名可用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: qp-exa-dynamic

description.en: Exa-backed web search provider for the ctx.web seam, with Exa Dynamic Highlights on by default and the Exa-Beta header that setting requires; exposes all eight Exa retrieval types, adds an /exa command to change highlights, search type and result count at runtime, and registers an exa_search tool that takes its own result count.
description.zh: 基于 Exa 的网页搜索提供方：默认开启 Exa Dynamic Highlights（并带上该设置必需的 Exa-Beta 请求头），开放全部 8 种 Exa 检索类型，提供 /exa 命令在运行时改高亮、检索类型与返回条数，并注册一个可自行指定条数的 exa_search 工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeps searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint, result count and result language configurable; targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.7+).
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源：优先解析 Bing 的 RSS 输出，以 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页作为兜底，无需 API Key，国内可直连，搜索不再消耗模型自带的搜索额度。端点、结果数量与结果语言可配置；适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.7+ 亦可用）。

plugins.name: dsh-exa

description.en: Exa web search and fetch provider for DSH: replaces built-in web search and exposes multi-source research capabilities.
description.zh: 基于 Exa 的 DSH 网页搜索与抓取插件：完全接管内置网络检索，并提供多源深度调研工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Side-panel Chrome and Firefox extension that lets DSH drive the tab you are on: pages reach the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing and navigation wait for your approval. Beyond upstream it adds viewport screenshots, opening a URL in a new window, scrolling inside nested scroll containers (chat transcripts, side panes, modal bodies), permission-mode, model and slash-command controls in the composer, and an opt-in developer-tools group (elements and CSS, page JavaScript, network requests) that is off by default and approved per call. The install is two halves: the bridge plugin comes from the prebuilt release tarball, and the companion extension ships as a tgz in the same release and is loaded unpacked, which is the only way Chrome accepts it. This project is a fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser
description.zh: 侧栏 Chrome/Firefox 扩展，让 DSH 直接操控你当前所在的标签页：页面以带编号的结构化文本交给模型，点击、输入与导航都要你批准后才执行。在上游基础上补了视口截图、在新窗口打开网址、滚动页面内的滚动容器（聊天记录、侧栏列表、弹窗正文等）、输入区的权限模式/模型/斜杠命令控件，以及默认关闭、每次调用单独审批的开发者工具组（元素与 CSS、页面 JavaScript、网络请求）。安装分两半：桥插件直接用 Release 里的预构建 tarball 装，配套的浏览器扩展是同一次 Release 里的 tgz，解压后在浏览器里以已解压扩展加载——Chrome 只接受这种装法。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 的 fork，原仓库：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser

description.en: Ultra-lightweight Moli (Rust headless browser) web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders complex SPAs, micro-frontends, and dynamic pages with ~60MB memory.
description.zh: 基于超轻量 Rust 无头浏览器 Moli 的 web_fetch 提供方：专为微前端与复杂 SPA 渲染设计，内存占用仅约 60MB。

description.en: Browser and desktop application control with live previews, annotations and native Hyprland support.
description.zh: 浏览器与桌面应用控制，支持实时预览、标注和 Hyprland 原生操作。

description.en: Zero-dependency browser control: drive a real headless Edge/Chrome over CDP with 8 `pilot_*` tools (navigate/click/type/keys/eval/screenshot) plus a live draggable cockpit panel in the Web GUI - text-first snapshots for text-only models, no Playwright, no API key.
description.zh: 零依赖浏览器操控：agent 通过 CDP 驾驶真实 headless Edge/Chrome（导航/点击/输入/按键/JS/截图，8 个 `pilot_*` 工具），Web GUI 内可拖拽驾驶舱面板实时围观——文本优先快照适配纯文本模型，无需 Playwright、无需 API key。

description.en: Learn an ERP through the browser into private local knowledge, with a desktop Adapt ERP workspace (multi-site sessions, chat in the middle and the official Browser on the right, approvals before writes).
description.zh: 通过浏览器学习 ERP 并沉淀为私有本地知识；桌面端提供「ERP 助手」工作区（多站点会话、中对话+右浏览器、写入前审批）。

description.en: 19 browser_* tools that let agents drive DeepSeek Harness's built-in sidebar browser over a loopback bridge: accessibility-tree reads with stable refs, real CDP clicks and keys, screenshots, network interception, device emulation, a cookie vault, document-start script injection, multiple browser instances, and raw CDP passthrough. Requires DSH launched with --remote-debugging-port=9222.
description.zh: 19 个 browser_* 工具，让 agent 通过回环桥驱动 DSH 内置的侧边栏浏览器：带稳定 ref 的无障碍树读取、CDP 真实点击与按键、截图、网络拦截、设备模拟、Cookie 保险库、document-start 脚本注入、多浏览器实例，以及任意 CDP 命令透传。需以 --remote-debugging-port=9222 启动 DSH。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-openai

description.en: OpenAI-compatible web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: one baseURL/apiKey/model config powers Qwen Token Plan, OpenAI and any Responses API gateway.
description.zh: 基于 OpenAI 兼容 Responses API 的通用联网搜索插件：配置 baseURL / API Key / 模型即可让内置 web_search 工具对接 Qwen Token Plan、OpenAI 等任意网关。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Annotate elements, blank positions or dragged regions in the DSH right-Sidebar Browser tab; each batch is saved as screenshots plus report files and attached to the next message as text. Does not replace the official Browser, Chat or Layout providers.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏 Browser 中批注元素、空白位置或框选区域；每批保存截图与报告文件，并以文本形式附加到下一条消息。不替换官方 Browser、Chat 或 Layout 提供方。

description.en: Logged-in browser automation with 170+ site adapters as deterministic one-shot commands (requires the OpenCLI CLI, npm i -g @jackwener/opencli, and its BrowserBridge browser extension) — action-evidence verification (no silent failures), site knowledge & health cards, watch monitoring, trace replay, provenance reports, and a write-approval gate.
description.zh: 登录态真实浏览器自动化:170+ 站点结构化命令一步到位（需安装 OpenCLI CLI：npm i -g @jackwener/opencli，及其 BrowserBridge 浏览器扩展）;执行真实性判定(失败说真话)、站点知识卡+健康度、watch 监控、轨迹回放、带出处报告导出;写命令带审批门。

description.en: Built-in browser: gives the agent a real headed Chromium it can open, click, type and scroll in, keeping page state across calls.
description.zh: 内置浏览器：给 Agent 一个真实的有头 Chromium，可打开网页并点击、输入、滚动，页面状态在多次调用之间保持。

description.en: Chrome side-panel browser agent for DeepSeek Harness with tools to inspect pages, navigate, click, type, scroll, and capture screenshots through a local bridge.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Chrome 侧边栏浏览代理，通过本地桥接提供页面读取、导航、点击、输入、滚动和截图工具。

description.en: Embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a DSH Desktop main panel through an Electron webview guest, with a back/forward/reload toolbar and a local snapshot of login-related localStorage restored on the next open.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版主面板里通过 Electron webview 嵌入 DeepSeek 网页版聊天（chat.deepseek.com），带后退/前进/刷新工具栏，并把登录相关的 localStorage 快照存在本地、下次打开时回填。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-exa

description.en: Exa search provider for the dsh-web seam: the web_search tool sends queries to Exa's /search API and returns the results as sources, in dsh web, dsh-TUI and headless runs. Needs an Exa API key (EXA_API_KEY, the credential store or a key file read on every search). web_fetch is unchanged and there is no UI.
description.zh: dsh-web 接缝的 Exa 搜索提供方：web_search 工具把查询发送到 Exa 的 /search API，并把结果作为来源返回，适用于 dsh web、dsh-TUI 和 headless 运行。需要 Exa API key（EXA_API_KEY、凭据存储，或每次搜索时读取的 key 文件）。web_fetch 不变，没有界面。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Opens the official DeepSeek web app (chat.deepseek.com) inside DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar entry renders the real page in the center column through the desktop shell's native browser guest, and keeps you signed in across restarts. The official client keeps its model picker, deep think, smart search, history and attachments. Falls back to opening a window where no guest bridge exists.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页版：点侧边栏入口，真实页面通过桌面端的原生浏览器访客渲染在中栏，并且重启后保持登录。模型选择、深度思考、智能搜索、历史记录、附件上传仍是官方那一套；宿主没有该访客桥接时降级为打开窗口。

plugins.name: dsh-scrapling

description.en: Wraps the Scrapling Python library in up to nineteen model tools, registered by probed capability: real-browser rendering for JavaScript-only pages, CSS/XPath extraction that returns data instead of Markdown, self-healing selectors, reusable login-state sessions, XHR capture, page screenshots, gated browser actions and a domain-scoped crawler with content/sitemap/feed/Shopify modes on the official job backend. It can also replace the built-in web_fetch / web_search, and serve the same tool table over MCP. Requires Python 3.14+ with Scrapling installed; the browser tools also need a Chromium engine for patchright, which an optional CLI installs on macOS arm64 only.
description.zh: 把 Scrapling Python 库包成最多十九个模型工具，按探测到的能力注册：为纯 JavaScript 页面上真实浏览器渲染、用 CSS/XPath 取出结构化数据而不是 Markdown、选择器自愈、可复用的登录态会话、XHR 抓取、页面截图、受部署门禁的浏览器动作，以及在官方作业后端上跑的限定域爬虫（content/sitemap/feed/Shopify 四种模式）。它还能顶替内置的 web_fetch / web_search，并把同一份工具表通过 MCP 端出。需要 Python 3.14+ 且装好 Scrapling；浏览器工具还需要 patchright 的 Chromium 引擎，可选的 CLI 只在 macOS arm64 上装得起来。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 198.18.0.0 for network access

description.en: A visible Chrome window per DSH session: 16 chrome_* tools (open/status/close/navigate/tabs/snapshot/screenshot/click/click_at/fill/type/press_key/hover/scroll/evaluate/wait), a Chrome tab in the Web GUI with a live screencast view (screenshot-heartbeat fallback for idle pages), tab management, window controls and a screenshot history.
description.zh: 每个 DSH 会话一个可见的 Chrome 窗口：16 个 chrome_* 工具（打开/状态/关闭/导航/标签/快照/截图/点击/坐标点击/填写/输入/按键/悬停/滚动/执行脚本/等待），Web GUI 的 Chrome 标签页提供实时画面流（静止页截图心跳兜底）、标签页管理、窗口控制与截图历史。

description.en: Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Jiey 浏览器：导航、快照、操作、读取、截图与标签页管理，使用真实 Chromium 环境。

description.en: Real-browser automation for dsh via an MCP server (Playwright core): navigate, click, fill, type, screenshot, and act on accessibility snapshots with numbered references - all 22 web_* tools re-exposed to the harness over stdio.
description.zh: dsh 的真实浏览器自动化:基于 Playwright 的 MCP 服务,提供导航、点击、填写、输入、截图与带编号引用的无障碍快照操作,22 个 web_* 工具经 stdio 接入 Agent。

description.en: Records real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic in a user-guided browser session for DSH, then generates a Markdown timeline report (report.md + events.jsonl) to build API-level skills.
description.zh: 网页操作录制器：录制用户引导会话中的真实点击、输入、导航与网络请求，生成 Markdown 操作时间线报告（report.md + events.jsonl），用于沉淀接口级 skill。

description.en: A fake-ip-aware ctx.web fetch provider that takes over the stock http provider id: a hostname is accepted when every DNS answer is a placeholder inside the proxy's fake-ip block (198.18.0.0/15 by default), so web_fetch works under mihomo/Clash TUN mode without disabling fake-ip or setting proxy environment variables. IP literals and private, loopback and reserved destinations stay blocked.
description.zh: ctx.web 的 fake-ip 感知抓取后端，接管官方 http provider id：当某主机名的每一条 DNS 应答都是代理 fake-ip 段（默认 198.18.0.0/15）内的占位地址时予以接受，从而在 mihomo/Clash TUN 模式下无需关闭 fake-ip、也无需设置代理环境变量即可使用 web_fetch；IP 字面量与私有、回环、保留地址仍被拒绝。

description.en: Controlled browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: the agent_browser tool and BrowserAutomationService drive a real Chromium or Chrome page (or an explicit CDP endpoint) through the agent-browser CLI, with allowedDomains containment and per-call output limits.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的受控浏览器自动化：agent_browser 工具与 BrowserAutomationService 通过 agent-browser CLI 驱动真实 Chromium / Chrome 页面（或指定 CDP 端点），支持 allowedDomains 域名收敛与单次调用输出上限。

description.en: Keenable web search and page fetch for the built-in web_search and web_fetch tools, working with any model and no API key.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 与 web_fetch 工具提供 Keenable 网页搜索与网页读取，适用于任意模型，无需 API Key。

plugins.name: dsh-web-kimi

description.en: Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kimi Coding 的网页搜索与网页抓取双提供方——一把 coding 计划密钥同时接入 ctx.web 的两条链路（/v1/search 与 /v1/fetch），设置卡片经凭据服务保存密钥，并回退读取 Kimi CLI 配置，安装即用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-doubao

description.en: Doubao Search (Volcengine 豆包搜索) web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness — swaps the active web_search backend to the standalone Doubao Search API with its own key and billing (500 free searches per month), and ships a dedicated settings card that stores the key via the credentials service.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供豆包搜索（火山引擎）网络搜索提供方——把 web_search 的后端切换为独立的豆包搜索 API，密钥与计费独立（每月 500 次免费），并内置专用设置卡片，经凭据服务保存密钥。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Browser bridge for DeepSeek Harness: captures page markup (DOM with boxes and computed styles, selector candidates checked for uniqueness) and the site's own xhr/fetch calls with headers and bodies, redacting credential-shaped values on ingest, into workspace files — then drives the page with trusted CDP input to verify what was captured. Ships 11 tools and an MV3 extension that works in the browser's own session. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+; the extension is loaded manually and paired with a local token.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供浏览器桥接：把页面结构（带盒子与计算样式的 DOM、经过唯一性校验的选择器候选）与站点自身的 xhr/fetch（含请求头与请求体，凭据形态的值在写入时脱敏）抓取为工作区文件，再用可信 CDP 输入驱动页面验证抓取结果。包含 11 个工具与使用浏览器自身会话的 MV3 扩展。需 Chrome/Edge 125+，扩展需手动加载并用本机 token 配对。

plugins.name: dsh-websift

description.en: Token-efficient web reading for DeepSeek Harness: one call fetches several pages through a real Chrome/Edge over CDP, gates them by relevance and returns a single digest, cutting context tokens by 80-98%. Real search URLs, login flow, screenshots, three proxy modes.
description.zh: 省 token 的网页阅读：底层是真 Chrome/Edge（CDP），一次调用读完多个页面、按相关性筛掉不相关的，只回一段带账本的摘要（实测省 80–98% 上下文）。真实搜索链接、登录态、截图、三档代理。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.gstatic.com

description.en: Playwright MCP browser control for AI agents: drive a real, visible Chrome (navigate/click/type/snapshot + ~80 browser_* tools), with a live screenshot panel embedded in the GUI that refreshes after every action.
description.zh: 基于 Playwright MCP 的 AI 浏览器控制：驱动真实可见的 Chrome（导航/点击/输入/快照，约 80 个 browser_* 工具），并在 GUI 内嵌实时截图面板，每次操作后自动刷新。

description.en: Browser takeover for sign-in-gated sites: keeps a list of addresses that need a login (URL and date only, no credentials), answers before a visit whether an address is already on it, reports whether the debug browser is signed in there from the session-cookie names of that site (certain, likely, or not signed in — anonymous cookies such as _gh_sess never count), and opens saved addresses in that browser by navigating and clicking one element by its visible text, searching every iframe. One click per call, no crawling.
description.zh: 浏览器网址接管：维护一份「要登录的网址」清单（只存网址与添加时间，不存账号密码），访问前先回答这条地址在不在清单里；按该站点的会话 cookie 名字判断调试浏览器此刻是否已登录（确定／可能／未登录，_gh_sess 这类匿名 cookie 不计），在带调试端口的浏览器里打开清单中的地址，并按可见文字点击一个元素（会搜索所有 iframe）。一次调用最多点一个元素，不做批量爬取。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search

description.en: Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置联网搜索，支持 SearXNG、Wikipedia、Tavily、Brave 与 Gemini，并支持客户端引擎选择和受控重试。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-proxy-switch

description.en: Fixes web_fetch failing with "non-public IP address" while Clash, Surge or v2rayN runs in TUN/fake-IP mode: finds your local HTTP proxy by itself, sends web_fetch through it while the proxy is on and directly when it is off, and adds an Auto/Proxy/Direct switch to the sidebar. Model calls are left alone by default.
description.zh: 修复开着 Clash / Surge / v2rayN（TUN、fake-IP）时 web_fetch 报 non-public IP address 的问题：自动找到本机 HTTP 代理，代理开着走代理、关了直连；侧栏可一键切换「自动 / 走代理 / 直连」。默认只接管 web_fetch，不影响模型调用。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to 8.8.8.8
uses literal IP 100.64.0.0 for network access

description.en: Records browser bugs, freezes expected results, and verifies fixes against a fresh original-code control.
description.zh: 录制浏览器问题、固定预期，并通过独立原代码对照复核修复。

description.en: Mobile-viewport preview tab for the right sidebar, with nine preset sizes covering phones, tablets and a laptop plus a custom width/height, one-click URL copy, and the page URL inserted into the composer through an @ button or the /url command.
description.zh: 右侧边栏的移动端视口预览标签页：九种预设尺寸（手机、平板、笔记本）及自定义宽高，一键复制当前地址，并可通过 @ 按钮或 /url 指令把页面地址插入输入框。

description.en: Browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: agent-driven real-browser control (managed Chrome with an isolated persistent profile, or attach to your daily Chrome over CDP) with snapshot, click, fill and page-reading tools; records manual operation flows and replays them with variable slots to create test data on demand; ships 27 browser_* tools plus a Settings panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 真实浏览器自动化：agent 可直接驱动真实 Chrome（独立托管档案，或附加日常 Chrome/CDP），提供页面快照、点击、填表、读表与控制台/网络诊断工具；可将手动操作录制成流程并把输入标记为变量槽，按参数自动重放来批量造测试数据；附带 27 个 browser_* 工具与设置页控制面板。

description.en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).
description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。

plugins.name: dsh-douyin-agent

description.en: Browses Douyin in a dedicated browser with daily viewing limits, shared local persona and interests, native settings, diagnostics, usage tracking, and reports. Replies and shares use selected conversations; group replies require a mention or configured name. Public comments require separate opt-in.
description.zh: 在专用浏览器中按每日时段和额度观看抖音，共享本地人格与兴趣，提供原生设置、自检、用量和观看日报。回复与分享限定所选好友和群聊，群聊仅在被 @ 或叫到设定昵称时回复；公开评论需单独开启。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-native-browser

description.en: Browser plugin for DSH (浏览器): Codex-style native browser control in your signed-in Chrome, with smooth virtual-cursor feedback, semantic page reads, form filling, screenshots and handoff; setup from the Browser sidebar. Requires macOS + Google Chrome (Chrome 125+) and a one-time unpacked load of the bundled MV3 extension; Edge, Windows and complete Linux installation are experimental.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器插件（Browser）：以 Codex 浏览器操作为体验参考，直接使用已登录的 Chrome 浏览器，平滑虚拟鼠标，支持页面读取、填表、截图与控制交还；安装后从侧栏「浏览器」完成配置。需要 macOS + Google Chrome（125+），并一次性以解压加载方式安装随包的 MV3 扩展；Edge、Windows 与完整的 Linux 安装仍属实验。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to *

description.en: Web search and fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness and Pi: anonymous-first routing across Exa, Tavily, Parallel, Firecrawl and TinyFish, with opt-in billing, quota preflight and bounded cancellation.
description.zh: 同时兼容 DSH 与 Pi 的搜索与抓取提供方：Exa、Tavily、Parallel、Firecrawl、TinyFish 匿名优先路由，计费需显式授权，带额度预检与有界取消。

description.en: Type /tabs to pick a browser tab (via chrome-devtools-mcp) and auto-fill its URL into the composer.
description.zh: 输入 /tabs 弹出浏览器标签页选择器，点选后链接自动填入输入框。

description.en: Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_* tools, a Skill and /chrome commands.
description.zh: 通过 MV3 扩展和本地 loopback Bridge 驱动用户已登录的真实 Chrome/Edge Profile、标签页与 Cookie，为 DSH 提供 browser_* 工具、Skill 和 /chrome 命令。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
