description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 headless Chromium（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed; single-engine moli serve with auto LD_LIBRARY_PATH/FONTCONFIG_FILE injection and a persistent profile dir for logins), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 moli 无头浏览器（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron；单发动机 moli serve 直连，自动注入 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 与 FONTCONFIG_FILE，profile 目录持久化登录态）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。

plugins.name: dsh-search-hub

description.en: Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with entry and credential management on a Settings page tab.
description.zh: 可配置的原生 web_search 后端：在 DeepSeek 官方原生搜索与智谱 GLM web_search 之间切换当前生效入口，并在设置页管理搜索入口与凭证引用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-zhipu_plan_tools

description.en: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.
description.zh: 智谱（GLM Coding Plan）三件套以原生 provider 与工具接入：内置 web_search / web_fetch 后端切换为智谱联网搜索与网页 Markdown 读取，可选注册 github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file 开源仓库工具，附设置卡片配置开关与凭据引用名。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: CloakBrowser-powered native browser tools with per-agent isolated sessions, bounded snapshots, ref-based interaction, screenshots, and safe routing.
description.zh: 基于 CloakBrowser 的原生浏览器工具：按 Agent 隔离会话，提供有界快照、ref 交互、截图与安全路由。

plugins.name: dsh-tinyfish-search

description.en: TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.
description.zh: 基于 TinyFish 的网页搜索提供方：把内置 web_search 接到 TinyFish Search API，每次搜索一次 GET，不消耗模型调用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Native headless and visible Chromium browser automation agent for DeepSeek Harness with DOM tree extraction, screenshot capture, and built-in SSRF protection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生无头及可视化 Chromium 浏览器自动化插件：支持 DOM 树提取、网页截图捕获及内置 SSRF 安全防护。

description.en: Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.
description.zh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

description.en: Drive the user's real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that reuse existing login sessions.
description.zh: 通过本地 Kimi WebBridge 守护进程驱动用户的真实浏览器：navigate、find-tab、snapshot、click、fill、evaluate、CDP、screenshot、network、upload、PDF 导出与标签管理工具，复用浏览器已登录会话。

description.en: Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own visible window on your desktop — minimise it and it keeps working without stealing focus — and a sign-in, CAPTCHA or native dialog stops the run and hands the page back to you: it never confirms on your behalf. Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化：让 AI 用你已经登录的账号，在真实网页上填表、抓取列表、多标签查后台。它跑在你桌面上的一个可见窗口里 —— 最小化它就不抢焦点、安静干活；遇到登录、验证码和原生弹窗会停下来等你，绝不替你点「确定」。登录一次一直记得（独立 profile + session cookie 回注）。23 个 Playwright 工具（20 个常驻、3 个默认关闭的强力工具），URL 白名单、弹窗挂起、CDP 方法白名单都是机制级且有测试钉住。

description.en: Picks an element in the right-Sidebar browser and inserts its selector, computed style, and HTML into the chat draft as a chip you can remove one by one.
description.zh: 在右侧栏浏览器里拾取元素，把它的选择器、计算样式与 HTML 以可逐条删除的胶囊插入对话草稿。

plugins.name: dsh-tavily#packages/dsh-tavily

description.en: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per Tavily account, plus a key and usage card on the Plugins page. The built-in web_search is never replaced.
description.zh: Tavily 搜索、提取、站点地图与爬取工具：多 Key 轮换，HTTP 401/429/432/433 故障转移，并提供按账号限制并发请求的负载均衡模式；插件配置页含密钥与用量卡片。内置 web_search 永不替换。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Keyless web powers for any MCP client: web_search, JS-rendered web_extract over dual CDP Chrome with proxy failover, and 7 real-browser page_* tools in an isolated context.
description.zh: 免密钥上网 MCP server：web_search、基于双 CDP Chrome 的 JS 渲染抓取（代理自动互备），以及 7 个隔离上下文真实浏览器 page_* 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-gui-auth-url

description.en: Agent tool that returns the running DSH Web GUI URL including its per-process launch token, so browser automation can open the GUI instead of getting a 401.
description.zh: 把当前 DSH Web GUI 的合法带 token 地址作为 agent 工具返回，浏览器自动化可直接打开 GUI，不再遇到 401。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-glm

description.en: Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as `glm` on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing).
description.zh: 智谱 GLM 联网搜索 provider：以 glm 注册到 ctx.web 缝，经 GLM 的 Anthropic 兼容 API 执行原生 web_search 服务端工具（走 Coding Plan 计费）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.
description.zh: DSH Web 与 Desktop 端的内置浏览器：为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供的 AI 原生浏览器工作区，融合了多标签浏览、实时页面批注、轻量级代码编辑、工作区预览，以及跨网页和桌面的智能助手辅助迭代功能。

description.en: Chrome sidebar extension that lets DSH operate your browser directly, no vision capabilities required.
description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏扩展，让 DSH 直接操控你的浏览器，无需视觉能力。

description.en: Controls the Chrome you are already logged into: the model clicks, types, fills in forms, reads pages, takes screenshots and downloads files in your real tabs, including inside same-origin iframes. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux; needs Chrome 116+ and Node 18+. Works over native messaging and chrome.debugger instead of a listening port. Ships 12 browser_* tools and a cb CLI, dispatches real CDP input events, draws an on-page cursor that also appears in screenshots, and adds a toolbar panel with live status, the controlled tabs and a pause switch. browser_download saves a link, an element's target or a URL with the site's login cookies (following redirects, keeping the server's file name) to the Downloads folder or the session's working directory; cross-origin iframes are named in the snapshot but not entered. The native host and the MV3 extension travel inside this tarball: on first load the plugin copies them into place and writes the native-messaging registration itself, so there is no clone, no install.sh and no python3 - the one step left is adding the extension to Chrome: install DSH Bridge from the Chrome Web Store (https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo, no Developer mode), or load the bundled unpacked copy at chrome://extensions (the plugin opens that page and puts the folder on the clipboard for you). Until then the tools fail loudly with those steps. On Windows the registration goes into the registry (for Chrome and Edge) and the host talks over a named pipe. A daily CI run on GitHub's macOS, Windows and Linux machines installs the plugin, loads the extension into a real Chrome and reads a page through the browser_* tools.
description.zh: 操作你已经登录的 Chrome：模型在你真实的标签页里点击、打字、填表、读网页、截图、下载文件，同源 iframe 里的内容也能读能点。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux；需要 Chrome 116+ 与 Node 18+。走 native messaging 与 chrome.debugger，不开监听端口。提供 12 个 browser_* 原生工具和一个 cb 命令行，发送真实 CDP 输入事件，绘制会出现在截图里的页内光标，并带一个工具栏面板（连接状态、正在控制的标签页、暂停开关）。browser_download 带着这个网站的登录 Cookie 下载链接、元素指向的文件或网址（跟随跳转、用服务器给的文件名），存进「下载」文件夹或会话的工作目录；跨站 iframe 只在快照里标出来，不进去读。宿主（原生宿主 + MV3 扩展）随本 tarball 一起发：插件首次加载时自己把它们落盘并写好 native messaging 注册，不用 clone 仓库、不用 install.sh、不用 python3——只剩把扩展装进 Chrome：从 Chrome 应用商店装 DSH Bridge（https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bippcbbbipppmhjkjomgdnjbooecbimo，不用开发者模式），或者到 chrome://extensions 加载自带的已解压扩展（插件会替你打开那个页面并把文件夹放进剪贴板）。没装好之前，工具会带着这几步明确报错。Windows 上注册写进注册表（Chrome 和 Edge 都写），宿主走命名管道。每天在 GitHub 的 macOS / Windows / Linux 机器上自动跑一遍：装插件、把扩展加载进真 Chrome、用 browser_* 工具读一个网页。

description.en: Zero-key web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: scrapes Bing China, 360 and SearXNG through a backend fallback chain and returns real URLs with snippets and publish dates. No API key and no settings card are required. SearXNG is used only when you set your own instance URL, and installing this plugin switches web_search to it and turns off the official DeepSeek search row.
description.zh: 免 key 的 web_search 后端：按降级链抓取 Bing 中文站、360 与 SearXNG，返回真实 URL、摘要与发布日期；不需要任何 API key，也没有设置卡片。面向校园网等拿不到官方 key 的环境。SearXNG 仅在配置自有实例地址后才会启用；安装后 web_search 会切换到本插件，并停用官方 DeepSeek 搜索行。

description.en: Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具注册免密钥搜索提供方：无需 API Key 即可使用，在 Tavily 与 Firecrawl 官方免密钥通道之间自动降级；若设置了 TAVILY_API_KEY 或 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 会自动采用。另含两个 Bing 抓取后端，默认关闭。

description.en: Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的可见 Electron 浏览器：共享一个 BrowserWindow，提供隔离任务视图、显式人机交接、快照引用与原生导航工具、操作轨迹、按需页面缩略图、可靠标签页切换与关闭的 keyed session 恢复，以及按站点清理 Cookie 的登录态维护能力。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-zhipu

description.en: GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu's Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu's non-standard tool_result response layout.
description.zh: GLM(智谱)网页搜索 provider——把 web_search 后端切到智谱 Anthropic 兼容端点的服务端搜索工具,直接复用你现有的 GLM 额度或 Coding Plan,替代 DeepSeek 官方搜索通道,并内置智谱私有响应格式的翻译层。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-proxy-failover

description.en: Loopback relay as DSH's process-wide proxy route: web_fetch works under TUN fake-ip; a dead proxy gets same-request direct fallback, and a probe switches back.
description.zh: 把回环 HTTP 中继设为 DSH 的进程级代理路由，让 web_fetch 在 Mihomo/Clash TUN fake-ip 下正常出网；上游代理不可用时，同一请求内改走直连，1.5 秒探活发现代理恢复后自动切回。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 223.5.5.5 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-browser4

description.en: Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.
description.zh: 安装 browser4-cli 运行时，并将 Browser4 技能集（browser4-cli、browser4-experience、browser4-plugin、scent-miner）注册到 DSH 技能库，提供面向自主 Agent、智能提取与大规模网页自动化的 AI 原生浏览器引擎。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.
description.zh: 接入 Firecrawl 托管 MCP 服务：免密钥即可使用搜索、抓取与解析（有每日额度），配置 API Key 后解锁完整工具集，含爬取与站点地图。

plugins.name: dsh-research-plugins#dsh-tavily

description.en: Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.
description.zh: Tavily 网页搜索：设置页开关，关闭时回落到 DeepSeek 内置搜索；免密钥可用搜索与内容提取，配置 API Key 后解锁爬取与站点地图等 MCP 工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-fetch

description.en: Aggregated web_search and web_fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness, sitting behind the built-in tools. Search fans one query out to AnySearch, Zhipu and Zhihu concurrently, dedupes URLs, fuses ranks with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and optionally reranks through SiliconFlow. Fetch is URL-aware: static pages pass through the built-in HTTP fetcher, dynamic ones fan out to Firecrawl and AnySearch extract and pick one body by quality. One shared circuit breaker skips an engine for the day after a quota or 429 signal, and a settings card keeps each engine API key in the credential store without ever showing its value.
description.zh: 聚合型 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，接在 DSH 原生工具背后。搜索把一次查询并发分发给 AnySearch、智谱、知乎三路，URL 去重后用 RRF 融合排名，可选经硅基流动重排。抓取按 URL 感知分流：静态页走内置 HTTP 抓取，动态页并发 Firecrawl 与 AnySearch extract，再按质量择优返回一路正文。共用一个熔断器，某引擎触发配额或 429 信号后当日跳过该路；设置卡片把各引擎 API Key 存入凭证库，从不显示其值。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Embed a local web server in the DSH GUI through a remote-browser-safe same-origin proxy: any localhost port works, plus a Console/Network/Errors toolbox that captures what the iframe actually does.
description.zh: 把本地网页服务安全地嵌进 DSH 界面：同源代理绕开远程浏览器的 localhost/混合内容限制，任意 localhost 端口可用，并附控制台/网络/错误工具箱，实时捕获 iframe 内真实行为。

plugins.name: dsh-webstack

description.en: SearXNG search and Scrapling multi-tier fetch provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness ctx.web with SSRF protection and markdown conversion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web) 提供 SearXNG 搜索与 Scrapling 多级抓取 Provider，支持 SSRF 防护与 Markdown 格式转换。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 192.0.0.170 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-inner-browser-use

description.en: Drives the sidebar browser already open on the right: same cookies and same sign-in, a pointer you can watch, no second window.
description.zh: 不另开窗口：用右栏内置浏览器，同一份 cookie、同一处登录，指针走到哪点到哪。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to account.100bt.com
uses literal IP 32.0.0.371 for network access

description.en: Paste a link; the agent reads it. Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, WeChat, articles, PDFs and audio become citable Markdown for a wiki or knowledge base. On 60 turns with vs without: finishes reading 22% -> 92% (+70 points), times out 68% -> 0%, answer quotes a real source fact 23% -> 82% (the A/B is exploratory: different time caps, no human correctness review). On 123 live links 80% came back usable (93% of the pages that answered); an unreachable link reports in 26 s. Codex, Claude Code, DSH.
description.zh: 贴一条链接，Agent 直接把内容读给你：小红书笔记、抖音与 B 站视频、微信公众号文章，连同文章、PDF、音频，都变成可引用的 Markdown，直接进你的知识库或 wiki。同一批题 60 轮对照：读完并作答 22% → 92%（+70 个百分点），跑到超时 68% → 0%，答案说中原文事实 23% → 82%（这组 A/B 是探索性的：两臂时限不同、未做人工正确性复核）。123 条真实链接里 80% 能直接当素材（能连上的页面里 93%），打不开的链接 26 秒就报。Codex / Claude Code / DSH 通用。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-tavily

description.en: Tavily-backed search provider for native web_search, with a Settings → Plugins card for API key management and toggling DeepSeek replacement.
description.zh: 为原生 web_search 提供 Tavily 搜索后端，并在设置 → 插件中提供 API Key 管理与是否替换 DeepSeek 的开关。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-browser-use

description.en: Browser provider for DeepSeek Harness: hand it a web task — open a page, click, type, fill a form, read what is on it — and it drives a real browser step by step, seeing an indexed table of what can be done on the current page instead of raw HTML or screenshots. Each step is one bundled-Jev decision rather than a full model turn (1.1 s median per step versus 2.8–3.6 s for chat-model turns in the repo benchmark), and the main conversation receives only the conclusion, so its context does not grow with the page. Targets come from the page it just read and a changed page is re-read rather than clicked blind, and it runs in the browser that Session owns, leaving your everyday Chrome untouched unless you switch to attach mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 浏览器插件：把网页任务交给它——打开页面、点击、输入、填表、读取页面内容——它会驱动真实浏览器一步步完成，每步只看到“当前页面能做什么”的索引表，而不是原始 HTML 或截图。每步由内置 Jev 引擎决策一次，而非大模型整轮推理（仓库基准中每步决策中位 1.1 秒，大模型整轮 2.8–3.6 秒）；主对话只收到结论，上下文不随页面变长。目标取自它刚读到的页面，页面变化就重新读取而非盲点；每个会话用自己的浏览器，不碰你日常的 Chrome（除非切到 attach 模式）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Selection mode for HTML preview and browser tabs: click any element in a locally served demo page and its locator (selector, text, HTML snippet) is written into the chat input for precise AI editing.
description.zh: HTML 选区模式：点选本机 demo 页面中的任意元素，定位信息（选择器、文本、HTML 片段）自动写入对话输入框，供 AI 精准修改。

description.en: SearXNG-backed web_search provider for the web seam: free, self-hosted, key-less metasearch through your own instance's JSON API, with a bundled loopback-only docker-compose example.
description.zh: 基于 SearXNG 的 web_search provider：通过自建实例的 JSON API 实现免费、免密钥的元搜索，附仅绑定回环地址的 docker-compose 示例。

description.en: Adds an ego-webqa MCP server that audits deployed pages across the mobile viewport matrix and returns structured repair evidence; needs uv/uvx on PATH and a Playwright Chromium headless runtime on the same machine.
description.zh: 把 ego-webqa 的 MCP 审计服务接入 DSH，在移动端视口矩阵中检查已部署页面并返回结构化修复证据；前置需要在同一台机器上装好 uv/uvx 与 Playwright Chromium 无头运行时。

description.en: Mounts Microsoft's Playwright MCP through the official dsh-mcp-client so the agent gets its browser tools over stdio; the one-time CDP authorization is guided by a prompt note, a call guard and the /bw-setup command.
description.zh: 通过官方 dsh-mcp-client 挂载微软的 Playwright MCP，把浏览器工具以 stdio 接入智能体；一次性的 CDP 授权由提示注入、调用拦截与 /bw-setup 命令引导完成。

description.en: Adds a visible-browser Agent preset (persona and toolset for navigating, filling forms, clicking and screenshotting through the Playwright MCP toolset) plus a gate that refuses every browser tool call in other presets until the user approves that Session through the bundled browser_access tool. The bundle mounts the Playwright MCP provider itself, and both a settings page in the Plugins view and the browser_source tool switch the browser at runtime between Microsoft Edge (default), the Chromium shipped with Playwright, and a CDP endpoint. Requires keeping the shared browser-use registration row in the profile (one provider per process).
description.zh: 新增「浏览器操作」Agent 预设（基于 Playwright MCP 工具集的导航、填表、点击与截图规程），并加门禁：其他预设里的浏览器工具调用一律拒绝，直到用户通过内置的 browser_access 工具授权该会话。插件自带 Playwright MCP provider，插件页的设置页与 browser_source 工具都能在运行时把浏览器来源切换为 Microsoft Edge（默认）、Playwright 内置 Chromium 或 CDP 地址。需在 profile 里保留共享的 browser-use 注册表行（一个进程只能有一个 provider）。

description.en: Lets DSH drive the Chrome tab you are already browsing, no vision needed: the page reaches the model as structured text with a numbered element list, and clicks, typing, key presses, scrolling, tab handling and navigation wait for your confirmation in the extension side panel while password and payment-card fields stay masked. Fifteen browser_* tools cover snapshot, text, tab list, open, follow, click, type, press, scroll, wait, navigate, back, close, forward and reload. A repack of the bridge plugin from omdsh-dev/dsh-browser, published to npm so it installs with `dsh plugin add`: the peer ranges the host checks are widened so the install is not refused as incompatible, the bundled extension also probes the DSH Desktop host port 19387 so no bridge address has to be typed, and a script copies the extension to a fixed directory so a profile switch or reinstall cannot break it. The prebuilt release tarball carries the plugin and the built MV3 extension. Upstream: https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接操控你当前正在浏览的 Chrome 标签页，无需视觉能力：页面以带编号元素清单的结构化文本交给模型；点击、输入、按键、滚动、标签页操作与导航都会在扩展侧边栏等你确认，密码与支付卡字段保持掩码。15 个 browser_* 工具覆盖 snapshot、文本读取、标签页列举/打开/跟随、点击、输入、按键、滚动、等待、导航、后退、关闭、前进与刷新。本项目是 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser 桥接插件的再打包版，发布到 npm，可直接 `dsh plugin add` 安装：放宽了宿主安装时校验的 peer 范围，避免被判为版本不兼容；随包的扩展额外探测 DSH 桌面端宿主端口 19387，因此无需手填桥接地址；并附带脚本把扩展复制到固定目录，避免切换 profile 或重装后扩展失效。预构建 Release tarball 内含插件本体与已构建的 MV3 扩展。上游：https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-browser。

description.en: Reference logged-in Chrome/Edge tabs, authorized local HTML and running Windows apps through a searchable native sidebar or @. Open browser candidates and the webpage sidebar refresh when the extension connects, disconnects or changes tabs, including an unchanged search query. Windows application lists skip protected processes with unreadable identity metadata and preserve other running apps. Read scoped snapshots, batch actions, capture screenshots and use available WebMCP tools; supports authorized uploads, drag/drop and opt-in network metadata. Browser actions preserve failure evidence, accept an explicit post-action observation scope and can check one final visible/text/value/URL condition without replaying effects. Expandable context preserves model content; dockable annotations support a session-bound staging queue with edit/delete/restore, and append to chat drafts without sending. App control prefers a matching installed MCP or approved installation, then Cua Driver with text, hotkeys and paged controls; desktop reads present the window once per connection or when recovery is needed. Background input depends on the app. Requires Chrome or Edge 125+ with the companion MV3 extension manually loaded and paired; installing the plugin does not install the extension.
description.zh: 通过可搜索的原生侧栏或 @ 引用已登录的 Chrome / Edge 标签页、已授权的本地 HTML 和运行中的 Windows 应用。扩展连接、断开或标签页变化时，已打开的浏览器候选与网页侧栏自动更新，无需修改搜索词。Windows 应用列表跳过身份信息无法读取的受保护进程，保留其他运行中的应用。读取局部快照、批量操作、截图及调用可用的 WebMCP 工具；支持授权上传、拖放和按需网络元数据。浏览器动作失败后保留执行证据，可显式指定后置观察范围，并在末尾检查一次可见性、文本、输入值或 URL 条件，不自动重放副作用。可展开引用保留模型内容；可收纳批注支持绑定会话的暂存队列与编辑、删除、恢复，加入聊天草稿而不自动发送。应用控制优先匹配的本地 MCP，未安装先询问，无匹配时使用 Cua Driver，支持打字、快捷键及控件分页；桌面读取在连接首次或需要恢复窗口时展示。后台输入取决于应用。需要 Chrome / Edge 125+，手动加载配套 MV3 扩展并配对；插件不会自动安装扩展。

description.en: Keep the built-in web_search tool without an official DeepSeek API key: disable web-search-deepseek and use Tavily keyless by default.
description.zh: 不用官方 DeepSeek API 也能用内置 web_search：关掉 web-search-deepseek，默认走 Tavily keyless。

description.en: Registers the hosted SpecStream MCP server with the harness MCP manager and keeps the API key in the credential store. The server returns live web data as structured rows, each value with its source URL, and a run starts only after the quote's maximum is approved.
description.zh: Registers the hosted SpecStream MCP server with the harness MCP manager and keeps the API key in the credential store. The server returns live web data as structured rows, each value with its source URL, and a run starts only after the quote's maximum is approved.

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-ollama

description.en: Routes the DSH web_search tool through Ollama's web search API, reusing OLLAMA_API_KEY. No DeepSeek official key needed.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 web_search 工具走 Ollama 联网搜索 API，复用 OLLAMA_API_KEY，无需 DeepSeek 官方 Key。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a Chat/Work switch in the DSH Desktop titlebar: Chat embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a native webview with no DSH API calls from the plugin and is the default on first launch, Work keeps the native agent UI, the page stays mounted across switches, and a confirm-first dialog can copy chat text into a work-mode draft without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版标题栏加入聊天/工作切换：聊天模式用原生 webview 内嵌 DeepSeek 网页版（chat.deepseek.com），插件自身不调用 DSH API，首次启动默认进入聊天；工作模式保留原生 Agent 界面，切换时网页保持挂载；「带入工作」对话框需先确认，只会填入工作模式草稿、不自动发送。

plugins.name: dsh-tavily-pool

description.en: Takes over the built-in web_search and web_fetch providers with Tavily, each behind its own toggle: a key pool with balance-aware scheduling that reads real credit balances from /usage, failover with hard exclusion of cooling or exhausted keys, and call history with a 14-day credit chart.
description.zh: 用 Tavily 接管内置的 web_search 与 web_fetch 提供方，两者各有一个开关：密钥池按余额调度（从 /usage 读取真实余额），失败自动切换，冷却中与额度耗尽的密钥硬排除，并记录调用历史与 14 天额度图表。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Chrome side panel that embeds the dsh web UI and lets the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic, and drive the browser.
description.zh: Chrome 侧边栏内嵌 dsh 网页界面，让 agent 读取当前页面、捕获 HTTP 流量并操作浏览器。

description.en: Chrome/Edge companion extension: select text on a page and click the badge to get a Markdown answer from dsh in the side panel or a floating card, with native multi-turn follow-ups; host-side tools let the agent read the current page, capture HTTP traffic and drive the browser. Fork of stuarthu/dsh-chrome (MIT): upstream supplied the bridge, browser tools and page injector, and this fork adds select-to-interpret, native multi-turn follow-up, in-panel settings and appearance options. It registers the same browser_* tool names as the upstream, so the two cannot be installed together.
description.zh: Chrome/Edge 浏览器伴侣扩展：在网页上选中文字后点浮标，dsh 的解读会以 Markdown 显示在侧栏或页面浮窗，并支持多轮追问；宿主侧工具让智能体读取当前页面、抓取 HTTP 流量、操作浏览器。stuarthu/dsh-chrome（MIT）的 fork：桥接、浏览器工具与页面注入来自上游，本仓库在其上加了划词解读、侧栏原生多轮追问、设置内嵌与外观定制。注册的 browser_* 工具与上游同名，不能与 stuarthu/dsh-chrome 同装。

description.en: Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class `s1_*` tools, with a bundled s1 skill.
description.zh: Search1API（s1）原生联网检索工具：网页搜索、新闻、页面抓取、站点地图与趋势榜，以 `s1_*` 一等工具形式提供，并附带 s1 技能。

plugins.name: dsh-tavily

description.en: Tavily web search for DSH with a settings toggle, keyless by default, and a connection test.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Tavily 网页搜索：设置开关、默认无 Key，以及连通测试。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: WebMCP bridge: your agent discovers & calls site tools exposed over the W3C WebMCP protocol via a built-in headless Chromium.
description.zh: WebMCP 桥接器：让 agent 通过内置无头 Chromium，发现并调用网站按 W3C WebMCP 协议暴露的站点工具。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness control of the Tabbit Browser: auto-loads the tabbit-browser skill on install, detects official Tabbit and Tabbit Browser releases (>= 1.9.0), checks the tabbit-cli persistent runtime, diagnoses the per-platform DSH sandbox mode needed to call the CLI, and downloads the region-matched official installer via a background job when no qualifying version is present.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 能够控制 Tabbit 浏览器：安装即自动加载 tabbit-browser skill，检测国际版 Tabbit 与国内版 Tabbit Browser 正式版（>= 1.9.0），检查 tabbit-cli 常驻运行时，按平台诊断调用 CLI 所需的 DSH sandbox 模式，并在没有合格版本时通过后台任务下载与系统地区匹配的正式版安装包。

description.en: Control the Chrome browser you are already using: open new tabs or reuse your logged-in tabs, so the model can read pages, click, fill inputs, drag page elements, scroll, take screenshots, open tabs in groups and close the tabs it opened, inspect console and network logs, and debug the browser. Requires Chrome 120 or newer; install the extension from the Chrome Web Store and pair it with an 8-digit code.
description.zh: 操纵你正在使用的 Chrome 浏览器：新建或复用已登录的标签页，让模型读取页面、点击、填写、拖拽页面元素、滚动、截图，新建标签页并分组、关闭本会话打开的标签页，并查看控制台与网络日志，调试浏览器等。需要 Chrome 120 或更新版本；扩展从 Chrome 应用商店安装，用 8 位配对码连接。

description.en: Registers a real-browser URL-to-text MCP server in a DSH profile: fetch_url and fetch_urls render JavaScript-heavy and anti-bot Chinese pages (Zhihu, CSDN, Juejin, cnblogs) and return clean article text as JSON with per-tier diagnostics, and crawler_status reports whether the browser is available. Needs a one-time Python dependency setup after install.
description.zh: 把真实浏览器抓取注册进 DSH profile：fetch_url 与 fetch_urls 渲染 JS 页面与中文反爬站点（知乎、CSDN、掘金、博客园），返回带分层诊断的干净正文 JSON，crawler_status 报告浏览器是否可用。装好后需要一次性安装 Python 依赖。

description.en: BrowserSkill bridge for controlling visible Chrome and Edge Agent Windows from DeepSeek Harness, with native browser tools, accessibility and VOM observations, screenshots, owned multi-session control, and a live Web UI overlay.
description.zh: BrowserSkill 的 DeepSeek Harness 浏览器自动化桥接插件，通过原生浏览器工具控制可见的 Chrome 和 Edge Agent Window，支持可访问性与 VOM 页面观察、截图、隔离的多会话控制和 Web UI 实时观察浮层。

description.en: Use ChatGPT Dots in a full-width DSH page with Desktop startup preload and page retention across panel switches within the same DSH session, Chinese/English theme-aware controls, reload and external-browser fallback; includes a separately applied login-persistence companion for Windows DSH 0.2.1-rc.3. After upgrading to DSH 0.2.1-rc.5, the embedded Dots page may require signing in again after restarting DSH. The current host browser does not provide login persistence across restarts, and a host upgrade may overwrite the earlier additional persistence treatment; this Dots update did not remove login-saving functionality.
description.zh: 在 DSH 全幅页面使用 ChatGPT Dots，支持 Desktop 启动预加载与同次运行内的页面切换保留、中英文主题工具栏、刷新及外部浏览器回退，并提供需单独应用、适用于 Windows DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 的登录态持久化配套工具。升级至DSH 0.2.1-rc.5后，Dots内嵌页面可能需要在重新启动DSH后再次登录。当前宿主浏览器不提供跨重启登录态保存，原有额外持久化处理也可能在宿主升级时被覆盖；这不是Dots此次更新移除了登录保存功能。

description.en: Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.
description.zh: ctx.web 接缝的零配置 Exa 网页搜索提供方：无 API key 时走匿名 MCP 兜底，配 key 时走 REST 搜索。

plugins.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search-metaso

description.en: Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).
description.zh: 秘塔AI搜索 providers for ctx.web：web_search 返回网页摘要，web_fetch 读取网页全文 markdown，多范围搜索（网页/文库/论文/图片/视频/播客）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-search-enhance

description.en: Grok-compatible web search with retained source pagination, Context7 and Exa documentation lookup, bounded page extraction, site mapping, offline research planning, and read-only diagnostics.
description.zh: 提供 Grok-compatible 网页搜索、保留来源分页、Context7 与 Exa 文档检索、有界网页提取、站点映射、离线研究计划和只读诊断。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Annotate elements in the built-in browser — click one, write a comment, then send the whole batch to the session in one message so the model can find and edit the matching source.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器里点选页面元素写批注，攒够后一次性发给会话，让模型直接定位并修改对应源码。

description.en: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.
description.zh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

description.en: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots the result; ships a frontend-verify skill.
description.zh: 无头浏览器验证工具：让 agent 打开自己刚写的页面，读取渲染后的 DOM 与计算样式、检查控制台、截图留档；内置 frontend-verify 技能。

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-openrouter

description.en: The built-in web_search bills a full model turn against DeepSeek's own endpoint; this runs it on an OpenRouter-compatible gateway instead, so search is billed where your chat already is, at the model and price you pick.
description.zh: 内置 web_search 每次搜索都要在 DeepSeek 自己的端点上消耗一整轮模型调用；本插件改为在 OpenRouter 兼容网关上执行搜索，与对话走同一个账户，模型和价格都由你决定。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-web-search-yuanbao

description.en: Tencent Yuanbao Search provider for the ctx.web seam: one direct Search API request per query returns portable title, URL, snippet and ISO-8601 date, with credentials resolved per search and no auxiliary model turn. Requires a Tencent Cloud WSA API key.
description.zh: 为 ctx.web 接入腾讯元宝搜索：每次查询只发一次直接检索请求，返回标题、URL、摘要与 ISO-8601 日期，凭证按每次搜索解析，不产生辅助模型轮次；需腾讯云 WSA API Key。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Windows x64 only, 0.5.4 preview: two scoped tools (dragon_browser and dragon_desktop) that drive a visible browser through the DOM or CDP and Windows apps through UI Automation, with per-origin and per-executable read/control scopes, batch steps, a physical-Esc emergency stop and a redacted action log. 0.5.4 only widens the DSH compatibility range to 0.2.0-rc.2 through 0.2.1.x, because 0.5.3 pinned it to an exact DSH version and was silently skipped on DSH Desktop 0.2.1. Two long-lived native processes remove the per-action process spawn, so a single key step takes about 0.7 s on the same machine; when another window steals the foreground the step is aborted instead of typing into the wrong place. The browser side ships its own Edge/Chrome launcher and CDP client, so it no longer needs another browser plugin or the Electron runtime. It is not an OS sandbox; logins, admin windows and secure desktops stay with the user.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows x64，0.5.4 预览版：两个受控工具（dragon_browser 与 dragon_desktop），网页走 DOM/CDP、桌面走 Windows UI Automation，按网站来源和可执行文件分 read/control 权限，支持多步 batch、物理 Esc 急停与脱敏动作日志。0.5.4 只是把 DSH 兼容范围放宽到 0.2.0-rc.2 至 0.2.1.x——0.5.3 把版本钉死，在 DSH Desktop 0.2.1 上会被宿主静默跳过。原生命令改成两个常驻进程，省掉每次动作重新起进程，同机单步按键约 0.7 秒；前台被别的窗口抢走时直接中止这一步，不会把字打到别处。网页侧自带 Edge/Chrome 启动器与 CDP 客户端，不再依赖其他浏览器插件或 Electron 运行时。它不是系统沙箱，登录、管理员窗口和安全桌面仍由用户处理。

description.en: Maintained fork of godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing adapted to DSH 0.1.5-rc.1: Bing-backed provider for the built-in web_search tool, scraping the public cn.bing.com HTML results page with no API key, reachable from mainland China, and keeping searches off the model's own search quota. Endpoint and result count configurable.
description.zh: godchen520/dsh-web-search-bing 的维护 fork，适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1：为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源，直接解析 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页，无需 API Key，国内可直连，不消耗模型自带搜索额度。端点与结果数量可配置。

description.en: Makes the built-in web_fetch tool work when Clash / mihomo runs in TUN mode with fake-ip: it lets the fake-ip address ranges (198.18.0.0/15, fdfe:dcba:9876::/64, 2001:2::/48) past the public-address check that otherwise rejects them, while loopback, private and link-local addresses stay blocked as before. Works with no proxy environment variables and no Clash changes.
description.zh: 让内置 web_fetch 在 Clash / mihomo 以 TUN + fake-ip 模式运行时正常工作：只放行 fake-ip 地址段（198.18.0.0/15、fdfe:dcba:9876::/64、2001:2::/48）通过公网地址校验，回环、内网与链路本地地址仍照旧拦截。无需设置代理环境变量，也无需改动 Clash。

plugins.name: dsh-browser

description.en: Shared real browser for DSH: a native Electron window the human can watch and take over, driven by the agent over CDP with 20 browser_* tools (open/snapshot/execute/fill/screenshot/download/auth), per-task session isolation, cookie persistence, CAPTCHA detection; self-hosts on plain dsh web without a desktop shell.
description.zh: 共享真实浏览器：用户可观看并随时接管的原生 Electron 窗口，agent 通过 CDP 驱动，内置 20 个 browser_* 工具（打开/快照/执行/填表/截图/下载/登录态）；任务级会话隔离、登录态持久化、人机验证识别，纯 `dsh web` 无需桌面外壳即可自托管。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Relay that bridges DSH and the browser: tasks started from a browser extension run in DSH sessions, while page operations are driven back through browser_* tools, with an in-page assistant panel and a local wizard for one-click setup.
description.zh: DSH 与浏览器之间的通信桥：浏览器扩展发起的任务经 relay 在 DSH 创建会话执行，页面操作通过 browser_* 工具桥接回扩展，提供页面助手面板与免配置接入向导。

description.en: Chrome DevTools Protocol Plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Use chrome-remote-interface to connect to and control Chrome via CDP. The connection includes a graphical interface.
description.zh: Chrome DevTools Protocol 插件 for DeepSeek Harness。通过 chromremote-interface 以 CDP 连接并操控 Chrome。连接带有图形界面。

description.en: Bundles the PrismSearch MCP server and its agent skill. Web search over Bing and Baidu with no account or API key, plus Google and Brave when API keys are set and DuckDuckGo, Sogou, 360 and Yandex when enabled in config; automatic engine fallback and an aggregate mode. Also image search, WeChat Official Account article search, and fetch_page, which returns web pages and PDFs as Markdown in segments.
description.zh: 打包 PrismSearch MCP 服务与配套 Agent Skill。网页搜索默认使用 Bing 和百度，无需账号或 API Key；设置 API Key 后可用 Google、Brave，在配置中启用后可用 DuckDuckGo、搜狗、360、Yandex；支持引擎自动回退与聚合模式。另提供图片搜索、微信公众号文章搜索，以及把网页和 PDF 转成 Markdown 并分段读取的 fetch_page。

plugins.name: dsh-jev-ultrafast

description.en: Drive a browser from one natural-language goal: a decision service picks the next operation and target from an indexed element table, so a DSH session spends one tool call instead of one turn per click.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 一句话目标：决策服务从带编号的元素表里挑出下一步操作与目标元素，驱动真实浏览器把事办完，一趟多步任务只花一次工具调用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Operate the Edge or Chrome window that is already open, without restarting it and without closing it: choose a window once, reuse a tab that already shows the URL, read page text or DOM state, click by accessible name or visible text, type, scroll, wait for content and batch steps. 22 tools over UI Automation, SendInput and an optional Tampermonkey bridge. Windows only.
description.zh: 操控已经打开的 Edge 或 Chrome 窗口，不重启也不关闭它：一次选定窗口、已打开的网址直接复用标签页、读页面文本或 DOM 状态、按可访问名或可见文字点击、输入、滚动、等待内容、多步合批。22 个工具，基于 UI Automation、SendInput 与可选的篡改猴桥。仅 Windows。

description.en: Anti-bot HTTP fetch tools hardened by SXS's production scraping stack (millions of requests/day): UA-pool rotation, retry with exponential backoff, anti-bot wall detection (captcha / verification challenges) and adaptive rate limiting — tools: `sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`.
description.zh: 反爬 HTTP 工具：UA 池轮换、指数退避重试、反爬墙检测（验证码/安全验证）与自适应限流，提炼自 SXS 生产采集体系（每日数百万请求）——工具：`sxs_fetch` / `sxs_fetch_json` / `sxs_rate_status`。

plugins.name: yingmoon-plugins#plugins/rightbar-driver

description.en: Drives the DSH right-sidebar built-in browser from the agent side with 38 tools (open, navigate, read page text and interactive elements, accessibility tree, click, fill, select, check, key press, scroll, resize the browser frame by dragging its corner, with the page inside reflowing responsively so a narrowed frame shows the mobile layout, screenshot, full-page screenshot, PDF, markdown export, scrape to JSON, download, cookies, per-step operation records with replay and action whitelisting), serves the built-in web_search from a self-hosted SearXNG over an SSH tunnel with Tavily and a real-browser fallback, and registers a fetch provider that retries blocked GitHub URLs through measured mirrors and sniffs charset from the response header so GBK and GB2312 pages decode correctly.
description.zh: 用 38 个工具从 agent 侧驱动 DSH 右推栏内置浏览器：打开、导航、读取页面正文与可交互元素、无障碍树、点击、填字、选下拉框、勾选、按键、滚动、拖动网页框边角改变大小，框内网页随之响应式重排，框宽收窄即呈现手机版布局、截图、整页截图、导出 PDF、导出 markdown、按选择器提取 JSON、下载文件、存取 Cookie，以及带序号的操作记录、重放与动作白名单。同时把内置 web_search 接到自建 SearXNG（经 SSH 隧道，Tavily 与真实浏览器作兜底），并注册抓取提供者：被墙的 GitHub 地址按实测可用的镜像顺序重试，并从响应头嗅探字符集，使 GBK 与 GB2312 页面正确解码。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 124.221.10.56 for network access

description.en: Web access for DSH agents: fetch JS-rendered or protected pages as clean markdown, aggregated search across 14 engines, and stateful interactive sessions (click, type, scroll, eval, screenshot) against a hosted or self-hosted Rust browser engine. Every session returns a live view URL so a human can watch the agent browse and take over with the mouse.
description.zh: 给 DSH agent 的网页访问层：把 JS 渲染或受保护的页面抓成干净 markdown，聚合搜索 14 个引擎，并提供有状态交互会话（点击、输入、滚动、eval、截图），引擎可托管可自部署（Rust 单二进制）。每个会话带直播页 URL，人能实时围观 agent 浏览并用鼠标接管。

description.en: Opens academic sites through institutional proxy rules and optionally renames eligible new PDFs using matched article metadata, with Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and US English settings.
description.zh: 按机构代理规则打开学术网站，可依据匹配的论文元数据重命名符合条件的新 PDF，并提供简体中文、繁体中文及美式英语设置界面。

description.en: Opens chat.deepseek.com inside DSH Desktop from a conversation view tab (next to Chat / Trajectory / Context, scoped to the open conversation) and from a left-rail globe button — all entries share one embedded page, so switching between them never reloads it. Keeps you signed in across restarts by replaying a localStorage plus readable-cookie snapshot before the page's own scripts run, strips only the Electron/<version> token from the user agent, and keeps navigation inside deepseek.com while sending everything else to the system browser. Pure client code: no host-side script, no file access, no credential service, no server route.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端里打开 chat.deepseek.com：入口有两个——会话视图标签栏里的「网页端」（与「对话｜轨迹｜上下文」并列， 随当前会话走），以及左上角面板列的地球图标；两者共用同一个内嵌页面，切换入口不会重新加载。登录态可跨重启保留 （在页面自身脚本执行前回放 localStorage 与页面可读 cookie 的快照），UA 只剥离 Electron/<版本> 标记， 导航限制在 deepseek.com 内、其余链接交给系统浏览器。纯客户端实现：没有宿主侧脚本、不读文件、不走凭据服务、不开服务器路由。

description.en: Desktop half of the dsh browser extension: mounts a token-authenticated WebSocket bridge on the dsh webserver and exposes the browser_* tools that let the model read the tab you are on as text and act on it, with image recognition off until the user enables it.
description.zh: dsh 浏览器扩展的桌面端一半：在 dsh 自带的 webserver 上挂一个带令牌校验的 WebSocket 桥，向模型暴露 browser_* 工具，让它读取并操作用户当前标签页，图片识别默认关闭、需用户自行开启。

description.en: Registers Baidu, Doubao, Tavily, and Exa backends into ctx.web so official web_search can use them, and routes web_fetch through Tavily Extract or Exa Contents when that backend is active.
description.zh: 向 ctx.web 注册百度、豆包、Tavily、Exa 后端供官方 web_search 使用，并在 Tavily 或 Exa 生效时将 web_fetch 转到对应提取接口。

description.en: Drives a real Chrome through a local MCP server so the agent can search Google/Bing/Sogou, read any page including JS-rendered and login-only content, automate click/scroll/type/key-press/select in a background window, and run platform search/detail/comment/download for Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, X and Reddit; resumable comments, SHA-256-verified downloads, cookies never returned, localhost only.
description.zh: 通过本地 MCP server 驱动你真实的 Chrome：可搜索 Google/Bing/搜狗、读取任意页面（含 JS 渲染与登录后内容）、在后台窗口自动化点击/滚动/输入/按键/选择，并为知乎、小红书、抖音、Bilibili、X、Reddit 提供平台级搜索/详情/评论/下载；评论断点续抓、下载 SHA-256 校验、不返回 cookie、仅本地回环。

description.en: CDP bridge to an already-running Chrome/Edge for DSH: screenshots, pixel assertions, DOM/CSS checks, and page JS evaluation over HTTP + WebSocket, with zero child processes, zero npm dependencies, and zero per-use approval.
description.zh: 通过 CDP 连接已运行的 Chrome/Edge：为 DSH 提供截图、像素断言、DOM/CSS 检查与页面 JS 执行，全程 HTTP + WebSocket、零子进程、零 npm 依赖、无需逐次授权。

description.en: Annotation browser in the DSH sidebar: a real Chrome page streamed over CDP with input forwarded, where picking an element or selecting text attaches its source location, component stack, styles and a crop to the chat input. Needs a local Chrome (on Windows set chromePath).
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏里的标注浏览器：通过 CDP 推流并转发输入的实时页面，点选元素或划选文字后，把源码位置、组件栈、样式与裁图带进聊天输入框。需本机 Chrome（Windows 须设置 chromePath）。

description.en: Tavily backend for the built-in web search: an in-process endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 turns its requests into Tavily searches; up to 10 API keys stay in the DSH credential store, rotate per request and switch on auth, rate-limit or quota errors; a settings card manages keys, runs a test search and points web search at the endpoint.
description.zh: 为内置网页搜索提供 Tavily 后端：在 DSH 进程内提供 127.0.0.1:8787/v1 接口，把搜索请求转成 Tavily 检索；最多 10 个 API Key 存在 DSH 凭据库，按请求轮换，遇鉴权、限流或额度错误自动换下一个；设置卡片可管理密钥、测试搜索并一键接入网页搜索。

description.en: Multi-engine reverse image search aggregator: Google Lens, Baidu, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, IQDB, Ascii2d.
description.zh: 多引擎反向识图聚合：Google Lens、百度、Yandex、TinEye、SauceNAO、IQDB、Ascii2d。

description.en: Detect and download media from Bilibili/YouTube/Douyin/Xiaohongshu with quality and format analysis.
description.zh: 检测并下载 B站/YouTube/抖音/小红书视频媒体，带清晰度与格式分析。

description.en: Windowseat bridge for DeepSeek Harness: a local host plugin exposing a loopback HTTP/SSE endpoint so the bundled Microsoft Edge side-panel extension can read the current page, search local files and talk to DSH; the Edge extension lives in the same repo and must be loaded separately. Windows 10/11 with desktop Edge required.
description.zh: 临窗 Windowseat 的 DSH 宿主插件：在回环地址暴露 HTTP/SSE 端点，供同仓库的 Microsoft Edge 侧边栏扩展读取当前页面、检索本地文件并连接 DSH；扩展需在 Edge 中单独加载；需 Windows 10/11 与桌面版 Edge。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-search

description.en: Registers DeepSeek Search and Fetch API providers for the ctx.web seam, replacing both the web_search and web_fetch backends with DeepSeek's Search and Fetch JSON APIs, with configurable retries and backoff, settings that apply to the next call, and a configuration page on the bundle page. Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5+ and a DeepSeek API key with access to /v1/tools/search and /v1/tools/fetch (calls are billed by DeepSeek; account sign-in is not supported).
description.zh: 在 ctx.web 接缝上注册 DeepSeek Search / Fetch API 的搜索与抓取 provider，用 DeepSeek 的 Search / Fetch JSON API 替换 web_search 与 web_fetch 两个后端；支持可配置的重试与退避、下次调用即生效的实时设置，以及 bundle 详情页里的配置页。需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上，以及一个可访问 /v1/tools/search 与 /v1/tools/fetch 的 DeepSeek API key（调用由 DeepSeek 计费；不支持账号登录）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Registers a Tavily search provider for the ctx.web seam and switches web_search to it, with a comma-separated apiKey list that rotates on 401/403/429/5xx and transport errors.
description.zh: 为 ctx.web 接缝注册 Tavily 搜索 provider 并把 web_search 切到它；apiKey 支持逗号分隔多 key，遇到 401/403/429/5xx 与网络错误自动轮换。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-fallback

description.en: Routes chat images to a fixed OpenAI-compatible vision model, returns factual observations to the selected main model, and reuses session-scoped observations across replay, compaction, and restarts.
description.zh: 将聊天图片交给固定的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，把事实性观察交给当前主模型，并在事件回放、上下文压缩和重启时复用会话内观察。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter.
description.zh: 注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。

description.en: Model-facing `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness: describe and OCR image files by calling the free Zhipu GLM vision API directly (glm-4v-flash fallback chain), no external CLI required.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本模型补上免费识图：`vision` 工具直连智谱 GLM 视觉 API 描述/OCR 图片文件（glm-4v-flash 降级链），无需任何外部 CLI。

description.en: Registers an `image2_generate` tool that calls your own OpenAI-compatible image relay to generate or edit pictures (text-to-image via POST /images/generations, image-to-image via POST /images/edits with a local PNG/JPEG/WebP reference, accepting b64_json or image URLs), saves them in the session working directory, and renders them inline in the conversation through its `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` dependency.
description.zh: 注册 `image2_generate` 工具：调用你自己的 OpenAI 兼容图片中转站生成或编辑图片（文生图走 POST /images/generations，图生图走 POST /images/edits 并接受本地 PNG/JPEG/WebP 参考图，兼容 b64_json 与图片 URL 返回），图片保存在会话工作目录内，并借助其 `@wisdoverse/dsh-inline-media-viewer` 依赖在对话里内联渲染。

description.en: Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro) or Gemini fallback; auto detail escalation, vision evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图插件：默认走豆包 Web（零成本、免 API key，经 Windows CDP 桥接驱动已登录 Chrome），另有反重力额度（flash/pro）与 Gemini 降级通道；档位自动升级、视觉证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图工具包：模型可主动调用的 `vision` 工具、deepseek/opencode-go 包装适配器（v4 flash/pro）、反重力额度（默认，flash/pro）/ 任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM / Gemini / 本地 Ollama 通道、证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

description.en: Keeps a local sticker dictionary keyed by content hash so an image already described is recalled instead of re-read, and splits a GIF into evenly sampled frames laid out as one contact sheet so the whole animation is visible.
description.zh: 维护一本按内容哈希索引的本地表情包字典，看过的图直接复用描述而不再重复识图；同时把 GIF 均匀抽帧拼成一张联系表，让视觉模型看清整段动作。

description.en: Adds image_generate and image_library tools that pick reference images from four local libraries (characters, outfits, scenes, props), expand situation, expression, pose, shot and light keyword presets into the prompt, and call the 65535 async task API or any OpenAI-compatible images API, showing the result in the conversation; a settings page manages the libraries and turns an uploaded image or a text description into a three-view reference sheet. With dsh-daily-schedule installed, an image without a specified outfit uses what the character is wearing in the current schedule entry.
description.zh: 提供 image_generate 与 image_library 工具：从本地四个参考库（人物、服饰、场景、道具）挑选参考图，把情境、神态、动作、镜头、光线关键词展开进提示词，调用 65535 异步任务接口或任意 OpenAI 兼容图像接口生图并在对话中显示；设置页可管理参考库，并能把上传的图片或一段文字描述生成三视图设定图。装了每日日程（dsh-daily-schedule）时，没指定服饰的图沿用角色此刻日程里的穿着。

description.en: Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer.
description.zh: 以对话内画廊和灯箱展示生成的图片。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-bridge

description.en: Adds image input and recognition through configured DSH providers or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
description.zh: 通过已配置的 DSH Provider 或 OpenAI 兼容端点提供图片输入与识别。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Image previews for DSH sessions: read_image thumbnails plus user, assistant, Markdown and present images in a lightbox with zoom, rotate, pan, download, sidebar and native file actions.
description.zh: 统一接管 DSH 会话里的图片预览：read_image 缩略图，以及用户、助手、Markdown 和 present 图片，支持缩放、旋转、拖动、下载、侧栏和原生文件操作的 Lightbox。

description.en: A content-aware PDF reading plugin for vision models: profiles each page for figures (vector and raster), tables, formula risk and double-column layout, then applies content-aware hybrid extraction, rendering figure/table/formula pages as high-DPI region crops. Provides a low-resolution preview to understand the page layout, and renders a specified region at high resolution. Packaged as multiple tools for agents.
description.zh: 面向视觉模型的内容感知 PDF 读取插件：逐页分析图（矢量与栅格）、表格、公式风险与双栏排版，基于内容识别进行混合提取，图表/公式页渲染成高 DPI 区域裁切。提供低清预览以理解页面概况并支持指定选区获取高清渲染。功能包装为多个工具供Agent使用。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-toolkit

description.en: Vision for text-only models: paste an image and the model switches to a Vision Toolkit variant for image Q&A, multi-image comparison, long-screenshot OCR, screenshot-to-UI reproduction, element grounding, and pixel diff. No API key by default — images are processed by the author-hosted free service, 100 per machine per day; configurable to your own provider.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型处理视觉任务：粘贴图片后自动切换到 Vision Toolkit 变体，支持图片问答、多图比较、长截图 OCR、截图还原前端 UI、元素定位与像素对比。默认无需 API Key——图片经作者自建的免费服务处理，每台机器每天 100 张；也可改为指向自己的服务商。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-client-vision#tool-vision

description.en: Screen capture and external vision recognition: take_screenshot, list_windows, analyze_image and view_image tools with a configurable GPT vision channel (gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra), API key via the credentials service, and a settings card; view_image shows the screenshot in the Web UI while the model context keeps text only.
description.zh: 屏幕截图与外部视觉识别：take_screenshot、list_windows、analyze_image、view_image 四个工具，可配置 GPT 视觉通道（gpt-5.5 / gpt-5.6-sol / gpt-5.6-terra），API Key 经凭据服务存储，带设置卡片；view_image 在 Web 对话中显示截图，模型上下文只保留文字。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-image-generation#tool-image-generation

description.en: Model-facing image-generation tool with a configurable channel and normalized image parameters.
description.zh: 面向模型的图像生成工具，提供可配置通道和标准化图像参数。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: MiniMax-powered multimodal plugin: real-time voice call mode (streaming conversation, floating dock UI), voice mode and mic voice input, plus image/video/music/speech generation and vision inspection tools.
description.zh: 基于 MiniMax 的多模态插件：实时语音通话模式（流式对话、悬浮胶囊 UI）、语音模式与麦克风语音输入，并提供图像/视频/音乐/语音生成与视觉检查工具。

description.en: For the DeepSeek Harness native vision model deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, raises image admission limits to 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 images and adds a highres_read tool that tiles large images, then returns the whole image plus 800x800 tiles through the host read_image tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 原生视觉模型 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 提供高清识图：将图片准入上限提升至 32 MiB / 8192 px / 600 张，并新增 highres_read 工具，将大图切为整图与 800x800 分块后经宿主 read_image 注入模型。

description.en: Captures a dragged desktop region with a global hotkey and either recognises its text with Windows OCR or attaches the screenshot to the chat draft.
description.zh: 全局快捷键截取桌面选区，用 Windows OCR 识别文字填入输入框，或直接把截图插入对话。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek: send images (alone or mixed with text) and a fast tiny vision model describes them behind the scenes — the chat keeps the picture, DeepSeek sees only text. Pure plugin: uninstall restores everything.
description.zh: 视觉桥：纯文本 DeepSeek 也能收图（单独发、图文混发均可），快速小识图模型后台描述，对话框里图还在、模型只见文字；纯插件，卸载即复原。

description.en: Eyes for text-only models: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image, which sends an image file to StepFun step-3.7-flash and returns a detailed description.
description.zh: 给不具备多模态能力的模型一双眼睛:把随插件分发的 stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__opencode_eyes__describe_image,把图片交给 StepFun step-3.7-flash 并返回详细描述。

description.en: Vision through NVIDIA NIM: mounts the bundled stdio MCP server as mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image, which describes an image with any of seven hosted vision models (MiniMax-M3 by default) and rotates several API keys.
description.zh: 走 NVIDIA NIM 的视觉能力:把随插件分发的 stdio MCP 服务器挂成 mcp__opencode_eyes_nvidia__describe_image,用 7 个托管视觉模型之一(默认 MiniMax-M3)描述图片,并支持多 Key 轮换。

description.en: Local OCR with nothing sent to a cloud: mounts the PP-OCRv6 Medium stdio MCP server (PaddleOCR on ONNX Runtime, CPU) as mcp__ppocr__ocr_image and mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf for images and multi-page PDFs.
description.zh: 本地 OCR,不把文件发到云端:把 PP-OCRv6 Medium stdio MCP 服务器(PaddleOCR + ONNX Runtime CPU)挂成 mcp__ppocr__ocr_image 与 mcp__ppocr__ocr_pdf,识别图片和多页 PDF。

description.en: Starts the published local BeatDesign 0.2.5 workspace and connects 30 MCP tools for projects, Canvas, Assets and Timeline, with a shared-project Skill and remote-generation approval guidance. Requires Node.js 22.12+ and a free port 3020; frame extraction and timeline rendering also need ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH (browser export does not).
description.zh: 启动已发布的本地 BeatDesign 0.2.5 工作台，接入项目、画布、素材和时间线的 30 个 MCP 工具，附带共享项目与远程生成确认流程。需 Node.js 22.12+ 且 3020 端口空闲；抽帧与时间线渲染另需 PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe（浏览器导出不需要）。

description.en: Four native tools for image/video model discovery, contract inspection, pricing previews, approved generation and resumable task status through BeatAPI.
description.zh: 提供图片视频模型发现、接口检查、价格预览、确认后生成及原任务续查，通过 BeatAPI 执行。

description.en: Let your AI agent see and operate a real Android phone: phone_look (vision + UI-tree fusion), tap/swipe/type, screenshot — over adb, for any MCP client.
description.zh: 让 AI 助手看见并操作真实安卓手机：phone_look（视觉+UI 树融合判读）、点击/滑动/输入、截图——经 adb，适用于任何 MCP 客户端。

description.en: Give DSH text-only models vision: an image/OCR/document recognition skill (race pool → custom channels → local) plus an idempotent host patch so image messages reach the model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 纯文本模型补充视觉能力：识图技能（图片理解/OCR/文档解析，竞速池→自定义通道→本地）+ 幂等宿主补丁，让图片消息能送达模型侧。

description.en: Configurable image recognition for text-only DSH models: attached images are preserved through the DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 adapter pipeline, transcribed by an OpenAI-compatible vision model, and passed to the main model as text. Supports selectable OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or Azure auth headers and reports a missing API key before sending a request.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DSH 模型增加可配置识图能力：在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 中，上传图片会完整通过适配链路，由 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转写为文字后交给主模型；支持 OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Azure 风格密钥鉴权，缺少 API Key 时会在发起请求前明确提示。

description.en: Lets the model actually see a video: local ffmpeg samples timestamped stills and faster-whisper transcribes the audio track, so the agent reads real pixels frame by frame instead of trusting a text summary. Fully local, nothing uploaded; reports honestly when the audio has no speech. Windows only; needs Python 3.10+ and ffmpeg installed, and the first video_eyes_setup run downloads about 700 MB (faster-whisper and its model).
description.zh: 让模型真的「看见」视频：本地 ffmpeg 按时间抽静帧、faster-whisper 转写音轨，模型逐帧读真实像素，而不是只读一段文字摘要。全程本地、不上传画面；音轨没有语音时如实报告而不是硬编。仅限 Windows；需已装 Python 3.10+ 与 ffmpeg，首次运行 video_eyes_setup 约下载 700 MB（faster-whisper 及其模型）。

description.en: Generate images through a logged-in web ChatGPT session and download them to a local directory.
description.zh: 控制已登录的网页版 ChatGPT 生成图片并下载到本地。

description.en: Samples a video the way a person does instead of downloading it: metadata and chapters first, then timestamped frames as images, subtitle-first transcripts (local ASR only when the platform carries no subtitles), AudioSet 527-class sound tags and top comments — 21 tools sharing one on-disk cache behind a cross-process lock. Needs Python 3.10+, ffmpeg and the vidlens package (pip install vidlens-mcp); a missing install comes back with the two ways to fix it instead of a bare ImportError.
description.zh: 按人看片的顺序取样，而不是下载整片：先元数据与章节，再按时间码抽帧看画面、字幕优先转录（平台没有字幕才走本地 ASR）、AudioSet 527 类声音事件标签与高赞评论——21 个工具共用一个磁盘缓存，并带跨进程锁。需要 Python 3.10+、ffmpeg 与 vidlens 包（pip install vidlens-mcp）；缺依赖时回给你的是两种修法，而不是一句 ImportError。

plugins.name: dsh-model-vision

description.en: Fills in the vision capability that DSH's "fetch models" step drops, so image-capable models stop being declared text-only, and marks them in the model name.
description.zh: 补上 DSH「获取可用模型」漏记的视觉能力，让能看图的模型不再被当成纯文本，并在模型名后标出「可看图」。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Reuses DeepSeek web's built-in vision mode for text-only models: the deepseek_vision tool drives the local deepseek-vision-cli browser automation (manual login helper, deep-think enabled, auto-closes browser) and returns image descriptions as text.
description.zh: 复用 DeepSeek 网页端识图模式给纯文本模型补上看图能力：deepseek_vision 工具调用本地 deepseek-vision-cli 浏览器自动化（手动登录助手、自动开启深度思考、用后自动关窗），把图片描述以文字返回给模型。

description.en: Image Designer connects DSH to Shenhuo AI designers, with personal OAuth, material uploads, proposals, credit quote confirmation and local downloads.
description.zh: 神火设计师：连接神火 AI 完成图片设计，支持个人账号 OAuth、素材上传、需求匹配、设计提案、积分报价确认与作品下载。

description.en: Image Editor separates uploaded images into editable layers through Shenhuo MCP, with confirmed credit quotes, browser editing and local PSD downloads.
description.zh: 神火图层编辑器：通过神火 MCP 上传并分离图片，确认积分后生成可编辑图层，在默认浏览器编辑，按需导出并下载 PSD。

description.en: Adds a right-column panel that compares a set of images the user picks from the workspace — 1/2/3/4/6 per page, per-image zoom and pan, the zoom and viewed position of one image synced onto the whole set, and a reorderable filmstrip. The browser loads every image, so none of it reaches the model.
description.zh: 在右栏新增一个面板，用来并排对比用户自己从工作区挑选的一组图片——每页 1/2/3/4/6 张、每张独立缩放与平移、可把某一张的缩放与显示位置同步到整组、缩略图可拖动排序。图片由浏览器直接加载，不进入模型。

plugins.name: aura-vision

description.en: Free vision OCR with adaptive tile recognition for long documents and Markdown/Word/PNG/Excel export.
description.zh: 免费视觉识别插件：自适应切块长文档识别，支持历史收藏与 MD/Word/长图/Excel 导出。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Reads a video or audio file into metadata, sampled stills, subtitles and a multilingual speech transcript with speaker labels, captures the live desktop as frames or a recording, and installs its ffmpeg/whisper.cpp/sherpa-onnx toolchain on first use with per-file sha256 checks; all processing stays local. Automatic toolchain install and desktop capture currently support Windows x64 only, so elsewhere ffmpeg and model paths must be set manually.
description.zh: 读取视频与音频文件的元数据、关键帧、字幕和带说话人标签的多语种转写；把实时桌面抓成帧序列或视频；首次使用时自动安装 ffmpeg / whisper.cpp / sherpa-onnx 并按文件校验 sha256，全部处理都在本机完成。自动安装工具链与桌面捕获目前仅支持 Windows x64，其他平台需手动提供 ffmpeg 与模型路径。

description.en: MCP bridge to gemini.google.com: vision analysis of images and videos, Imagen image and Veo video generation, and conversation management using the logged-in browser session with no API key.
description.zh: 接入 gemini.google.com 的 MCP 桥：图片/视频视觉识别、Imagen 生图、Veo 生视频与历史对话管理，复用浏览器登录态，无需 API Key。

plugins.name: dsh-image-gen

description.en: Image generation with a sidebar gallery page and three agent tools (paint_image, paint_images, edit_painting); preset providers include ModelScope, Google Gemini, OpenAI, SiliconFlow, Volcengine Seedream, Alibaba DashScope, xAI and Zhipu, plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, each with its own proxy setting.
description.zh: 图像生成：侧边栏画廊页面和三个 Agent 工具（paint_image、paint_images、edit_painting）；预置 ModelScope、Google Gemini、OpenAI、硅基流动、火山方舟 Seedream、阿里云百炼、xAI、智谱等服务商，也可接入任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，每个服务商可单独设置代理。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-chat-imagine

description.en: Automatically generates and displays images in the DSH chat via API channels or local CLIs (mmx / codex / agy), and can also recognize images using the corresponding CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天窗口自动调用生图工具（API 渠道，或本机 CLI：已支持 mmx / codex / agy）并展示图片，也支持利用对应 CLI 识别图片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Registers one `ocr` tool for text-only models: it runs the offline script bundled in the repo over a single image or PDF and returns the recognized text — Windows native OCR first, then RapidOCR, then Tesseract. Recognition runs locally with no network request and no API key. Needs Python 3.11 on PATH plus `pip install winocr pillow` (winocr is the preferred engine; RapidOCR and Tesseract are fallbacks). Per-line results for images, per-page results for PDFs.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型注册一个 `ocr` 工具：调用仓库自带的离线脚本识别单张图片或 PDF 并返回文字——Windows 原生 OCR 优先，其次 RapidOCR，最后 Tesseract；识别过程在本机完成，不发网络请求、不需要 API key。需自备 PATH 上的 Python 3.11 并 `pip install winocr pillow`（winocr 为首选引擎，RapidOCR 与 Tesseract 为兜底）。图片返回逐行结果，PDF 返回逐页结果。

plugins.name: dsh-image-pathify

description.en: Lets text-only models handle pasted chat images, with a native vision experience, batch image viewing, and a built-in OpenAI-compatible analyze_image tool; vision-capable models are unaffected.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能处理聊天贴图，提供原生视觉体验，支持批量看图，走内置 OpenAI 兼容识图工具 analyze_image；具备视觉能力的模型不受影响。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Gives a text-only model image understanding via a vision-language model, exposed as a `describe_image` tool.
description.zh: describe_image 模型工具：让纯文本模型通过视觉语言模型获得图像理解能力。

description.en: Five tools for reading a video as raw material rather than as something to watch. video_outline maps a whole file as text and draws nothing at all: 4-60 equal windows, each with its cut count, speech share, intensity bar and tags, then the windows worth opening and the exact start/end for the call that follows -- zero image tokens. video_probe returns metadata and a reading plan without decoding frames. video_storyboard turns a window into one contact sheet plus a text index binding every cell to its timecode, cut count and frame time; cells whose text would be illegible at that scale are marked zoom, and dedupe global folds a picture that comes back after a cut. video_zoom re-renders 1-9 cells from a short window at a larger scale. video_read decodes only keyframes, OCRs each screen, and returns an outline plus \[mm:ss] text -- the path for lectures, slide decks and screen recordings, where the words are the content. It also reads a file with sound and no picture as a transcript (subtitle track, then DSH_ASR_CMD, then a transcript file you pass; long audio is cut at 45 s onto silence), composes six changed frames into one sheet when a file has no readable text at all, and can write the result out as SRT, WebVTT or text. Cuts, dissolves and one-frame flashes are found in a single ffmpeg pass; from ten minutes up a file is analysed on its keyframes only, 2.7x faster on a two-hour lecture; and a cell is never shrunk below a fifth of the source, so a 1440p sheet spends the same tokens on fewer, bigger cells. OCR is the engine Windows ships, tesseract with line boxes, or DSH_OCR_CMD. It takes a B station link (bilibili.com/video/BV..., a bare BV id, an av id or a b23.tv short link) wherever it takes a file: up to 300 seconds is read from the CDN in place with nothing written to disk, longer videos are downloaded once and cached within a 4 GB / 24 video budget, play URLs are cached for ten minutes, and a link that is not a single video says what it is. Needs ffmpeg, uses ffprobe when present, and has no other runtime dependencies. It is a wire-compatible reimplementation of SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard: it registers the same video_probe / video_storyboard / video_zoom tool names, so the two cannot be enabled together.
description.zh: 五个工具，把视频当成原料而不是节目来读。video_outline 把整片映射成文字、一张图都不画：4-60 个等分窗口，每行给切点数量、语音占比、强度条和标签，再给出值得先看的窗口以及下一步的精确 start/end —— 零图像 token。video_probe 不解码画面就给元数据和阅读计划。video_storyboard 把一个时间窗口压成一张分镜图，再给一份文本索引，把每一格绑到时间码、切点数量与取帧时刻；在那一档尺寸下文字会糊掉的格子会被标记 zoom，dedupe global 可以把切走之后又回来的画面折叠掉。video_zoom 把短窗口里的 1-9 格按更大尺寸重画。video_read 只解关键帧，逐屏 OCR，返回大纲加 \[mm:ss] 文本 —— 讲座、幻灯片和录屏走这条，因为文字才是内容。它也能把只有声音没有画面的文件读成转录稿（字幕轨、DSH_ASR_CMD、你传的转录文件，长音频按 45 秒切在静音处），没有任何可读文字时会把六张变化过的画面拼成一张图，还可以把结果导出成 SRT、WebVTT 或纯文本。切点、叠化与单帧闪烁用一遍 ffmpeg 找出；十分钟以上的片只解关键帧分析，两小时课程快 2.7 倍；格子永远不会缩到源图的五分之一以下，所以 1440p 的图用同样的 token 换更少更大的格子。OCR 可以用 Windows 自带的引擎、带行框的 tesseract，或 DSH_OCR_CMD。凡是要文件的地方都能直接给 B 站链接（bilibili.com/video/BV…、裸 BV 号、av 号、b23.tv 短链）：300 秒以内直接在 CDN 上读、不落盘，更长的下一遍缓存，缓存有 4 GB / 24 片的预算，play 链接缓存十分钟，不是单个视频的链接会各自说明是什么。需要 ffmpeg，有 ffprobe 时用 ffprobe，除此之外没有运行时依赖。它是 SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard 的接口兼容重实现：注册同样的 video_probe / video_storyboard / video_zoom 工具名，所以两者不能同时启用。

description.en: AI image generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image through a configurable OpenAI-compatible endpoint (gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3), with an api_url/api_key settings card and a sidebar split-pane generation studio.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图插件：通过可配置的 OpenAI 兼容端点（gpt-image-2 / gpt-image-1 / dall-e-3）实现文生图与图生图，提供 api_url/api_key 设置卡片与侧边栏分栏生图工作台。

description.en: Prove that a local image edit left every pixel outside its mask untouched. Original, generated and mask PNGs go in; a greppable `MASK_PIXEL_LOCK=PASS|FAIL|EMPTY` verdict, a difference heatmap, per-channel statistics, a bounding box and the largest changed pixels come out, plus a self-contained HTML report and `report.json` with a SHA-256 file hash, a canonical protected-pixel digest and a proof digest binding both to the policy. Supports edit and lock mask polarities, a mask threshold, tolerance and alpha-ignoring; PNG color types 0/2/3/4/6, bit depths 1-16, all five filters and Adam7. Zero dependencies, local only — no model call, no network, no upload.
description.zh: 证明一次局部改图没有动蒙版外的像素。输入原图、生成图和蒙版三张 PNG，输出可 grep 的 `MASK_PIXEL_LOCK=PASS|FAIL|EMPTY` 结论、差异热力图、逐通道统计、差异包围盒与最大差异像素，并生成自包含 HTML 报告和 `report.json`；后者包含文件 SHA-256、规范化受保护像素摘要，以及把两者与判定策略绑定在一起的证明摘要。支持 edit / lock 两种蒙版语义、蒙版阈值、容差与忽略 alpha；PNG 覆盖颜色类型 0/2/3/4/6、位深 1-16、五种过滤器和 Adam7。零依赖、纯本地：不调模型、不联网、不上传。

description.en: Pixel-level screenshot diff for visual regression. Two local PNGs in; a machine-readable first line (`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`, greppable as an assertion), then the difference ratio, per-region bounding boxes, maximum channel delta and mean absolute error, plus a self-contained HTML comparison page. An ignore-region list with absolute or fractional coordinates excludes clocks, cursors and other per-render noise. It deliberately does no content recognition: it answers only "did this change", which is the part that can be made deterministic. Entirely local — no model call, no network, no upload.
description.zh: 面向视觉回归的像素级截图比对。输入两张本地 PNG，第一行是可机器判定的结论（`PIXEL_CHANGED=true|false`，可以直接 grep 当断言），随后是差异比例、差异区域包围盒、最大通道差与平均绝对误差，并生成一份自包含的 HTML 对照页。可用绝对或比例坐标声明忽略区，排除时钟、光标这类每次渲染都会变的部分。它刻意不做内容识别——只回答「变没变」，因为这一步可以做成确定性的。全部本地完成：不调模型、不联网、不上传。

plugins.name: dsh-cloudflare-media

description.en: Cloudflare Workers AI media tools for dsh - text-to-image, text-to-speech and speech-to-text. Per-model price badges, a native settings card, reuse of an existing Cloudflare account, and output files named after the model that made them.
description.zh: 把 Cloudflare Workers AI 的多媒体模型接进 dsh：生图、TTS、语音转写都有；每个模型标注价格档位，带原生设置页，复用已有的 Cloudflare 账号，输出文件带模型名。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: All-media (video/audio/image) sibling of liustack/modlens: turns local media into structured evidence (timeline / transcript / layout regions) injected into the conversation so text-only models can cite concrete frames, seconds and speakers — Evidence, not imagination. One failover chain per media, recorded hop-by-hop in meta.attempts (a fallback is never silent): host-registered multimodal models first, then a configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (comma-separated multi-key rotation), then local ffmpeg frame-sampling / a local ASR CLI, degrading to metadata-only as a last resort. Absorbs modlens battle-tested rules — cooldown keyed only on auth/quota failures and softened to chain-tail (never dropped), redact-before-clip error text, magic-byte sniff that never trusts file extensions. Optional vision-bridge registers a media-lens wrapper into the host model selector so a pure-text model gains image/audio/video sight. Registering / authenticating multimodal models and true inline audio-video upload lean on two companion plugins, declared as optional peers (absence auto-degrades, never errors): dsh-thinking-levels fronts the model config / registration surface, dsh-llm-openai-completions takes over the OpenAI-compatible transport that serializes file blocks into video_url / input_audio. Privacy: media goes to remote providers by default; strictLocalOnly keeps content on-machine. Prerequisites not shipped with the package: ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH (frame sampling / reencode / duration probe; degrades to metadata when missing) and a user-configured local ASR CLI for the audio fallback. Hosts 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 (6 rc, exact engines.dsh enum). npm: dsh-media-lens.
description.zh: liustack/modlens 的全媒体（视频/音频/图像）延伸：把本地媒体转成结构化证据（时间线/转写/版面区域）注入对话，让纯文本模型能引用具体帧、秒、说话人——Evidence, not imagination。每个媒体一条 failover 链，逐跳记录在 meta.attempts（降级绝不静默）：宿主已注册全模态模型优先，其次自配 OpenAI-compatible 端点（逗号分隔多 key 轮换），再落到本地 ffmpeg 抽帧 / 本地 ASR CLI，末位仅元数据降级。吸收 modlens 实战经验——仅 auth/quota 类失败触发冷却且软化垫队尾（不剔除）、错误文本先脱密后截断、magic-byte 校验绝不信任扩展名。可选 vision-bridge 把透镜包装成模型选择器可见的 media-lens 包装 provider，让纯文本主力获得图/音/视频视野。多模态模型的注册/认证与真正的音视频直传依赖两个姊妹插件配合（均声明为 optional peer，未装则能力自动降级、不报错）：dsh-thinking-levels 承接模型配置录入/登记面，dsh-llm-openai-completions 做 OpenAI-compatible 传输接管、把 file 块序列化成 video_url / input_audio 真正上送。隐私：媒体缺省会发往远端 provider，开启 strictLocalOnly 则不出本机。不随包分发的安装前提：PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe（抽帧/重编码/时长探测，缺失时降为仅元数据），以及音频兜底需用户自备本地 ASR CLI。支持宿主 0.1.7 / 0.2.0 / 0.2.1 共 6 个 rc（engines.dsh 精确枚举）。npm 包名：dsh-media-lens。

description.en: High-performance fork of SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard — install this or the upstream plugin, not both. Turns a video into addressable storyboard grids (numbered cells, a timestamp and transcript line per cell, audio envelope); needs Node 20+, ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH, and a configured ASR endpoint when the file has no subtitle track.
description.zh: SAOS-3624/dsh-video-storyboard 的高性能分支，与上游二选一、不能同装。把视频压成可寻址的宫格分镜（编号、每格时间戳与台词、音频包络）；需要 Node 20+、PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe，文件无字幕轨时还需配置 ASR 端点。

description.en: Video studio for DeepSeek Harness on Android: storyboard editing, multi-provider image/video generation with automatic failover, FFmpeg MP4 export, prompt optimization, and a mobile-first workbench.
description.zh: 安卓上的 DSH 视频工作台：分镜编辑、多供应商图像/视频生成与自动切换、FFmpeg 合成 MP4、提示词优化、手机窄屏工作台。

description.en: Native LLM-provider vision bridge: images pasted in the chat are described by a vision model (Qwen3-VL via pi-ai/llama.cpp) and the text description is fed to text-only DeepSeek for the reply — image admission, routing and compaction all run through harness-native mechanisms, with an LRU description cache and 503 retry.
description.zh: DeepSeek 视觉桥接：注册原生 LLM provider，聊天内粘贴的图片自动由视觉模型（pi-ai/llama.cpp 上的 Qwen3-VL）转成文字描述后交给纯文本 DeepSeek 作答——图片准入、路由与会话压缩全部走 harness 原生机制，带 LRU 描述缓存与 503 重试。

description.en: Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).
description.zh: 图片转文字输入插件：粘贴/拖拽图片自动转为结构化文字描述发送，给纯文本 LLM 提供图片输入接管（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API）。

description.en: Synesthesia Encoder for DSH: a vision model translates images into compact structured spatial text (canvas/elements/percentage coordinates), giving text-only LLMs pixel-level image understanding via the `mm_vision` tool.
description.zh: 通感编码器（Synesthesia Encoder）：调用视觉模型把图片翻译成紧凑的结构化空间文字（画布/元素/百分比坐标），让纯文本 LLM 获得像素级看图能力（`mm_vision` 工具）。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-better

description.en: Vision relay for text-only models: a configurable GLM-compatible vision endpoint analyzes the images you attach in the background and the original model keeps answering in the same session, leaving your message, image, model and history untouched. Requires applying patches/0001-session-image-admission.patch to a stock DSH install (images are rejected before storage otherwise); the repo ships an apply/restore script.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型提供的图像识别转发：后台调用你配置的 GLM 兼容视觉接口分析图片，原模型在同一会话继续作答，你的消息、图片、模型与历史全程不变。需先运行仓库自带的 patches/apply-core-patch.cmd 给 DSH 打核心补丁，否则带图消息会在入库前被原版 DSH 拒绝（可用 restore 脚本还原）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a screenshot tool that captures the Windows desktop to PNG and hands the path to the model, plus a composer camera button that previews, downloads or copies the capture.
description.zh: 在输入框加相机按钮（预览、下载、复制截图），并提供一个截图工具，把 Windows 桌面截成 PNG 交给模型读取。

plugins.name: dsh-labnana

description.en: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Labnana 图片生成：文生图 / 图生图 / 精准编辑，含积分预估、余额查询与网页设置界面。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-comfyui

description.en: Drive a local or remote ComfyUI server from DeepSeek Harness: comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow tools generate and edit images and videos, with a workflow library (graph extraction: per component / main flow / all), a load area with resolution auto-match, a live queue, SDXL and Wan 2.1 templates, a companion skill, and a same-origin media proxy.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 直接驱动本地或远程 ComfyUI：comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow 工具生成与编辑图像、视频，附带工作流库（图工作流提取：按分量 / 主流程 / 整体）、加载区分辨率自动匹配、实时队列、SDXL 与 Wan 2.1 模板、配套 skill 与同源媒体代理。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Read a video with a text-only model: with ffmpeg installed, sample frames at a 0.1-10 second interval into contact sheets where every frame carries its real timecode, extract the audio track and send it to iTingnao (needs an ITINGNAO_API_KEY) for a timestamped transcript, and describe each sheet with an image-capable model in the host, so the plugin works on its own without any other vision plugin. A composer slider sets the sampling interval, and pure audio files are transcribed without frame sampling.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型看懂视频：需本机装好 ffmpeg；按 0.1–10 秒的可调间隔抽帧拼成总览图，每格烧录该帧的真实时间码；提取音轨后上传到听脑（需配置 ITINGNAO_API_KEY）转写成带时间戳的台词；并自行调用宿主里的视觉模型逐页描述画面，因此不依赖任何其他视觉插件。输入框上方有抽帧间隔滑块，纯音频文件则跳过抽帧只做转写。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-proxy

description.en: DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed via the official deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp by default (a pure-text V4-Pro brain can see images), with any OpenAI-compatible VLM or local Ollama as alternatives.
description.zh: DeepSeek 大脑 + 自动识图：GUI 附加的每张图片自动经官方 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 原生识图转译，再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek 作答（纯文本 V4-Pro 也能看图）；支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM 与本地 Ollama 作为备选。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)
reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Generate images and videos, edit images, remove backgrounds, upscale images, upload reference media, and check Fotor credits.
description.zh: 通过 Fotor 生成图片和视频、编辑图片、移除背景、放大图片、上传参考素材及查询积分。

plugins.name: dsh-free-vision

description.en: Free vision bridge for text-only models: image understanding, OCR, UI and debug analysis via free-tier providers (Qwen3-VL-Flash, Doubao, DeepSeek-OCR) with a settings GUI.
description.zh: 免费视觉插件：纯文本模型看图 / OCR / UI / 报错分析，优先免费模型（千问 Qwen3-VL-Flash、豆包、DeepSeek-OCR），设置界面可配置。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)
