description.en: Local-first structured vision for text-only agents: images go to a local OpenAI-compatible VLM and come back as JSON evidence (summary, verbatim OCR, layout regions, entities/relations, colors, explicit uncertainty), with anti-hallucination fallback and an optional paste/upload bridge; zero cloud cost, images never leave the machine.
description.zh: 本地优先的结构化视觉插件：图片交给本地 OpenAI 兼容 VLM，返回 JSON 证据（摘要、逐字 OCR、版面区域、实体/关系、配色、显式不确定项），带反幻觉回退与可选粘贴/上传桥；零云端成本，图片不出本机。

description.en: Transparent image guard for text-only routes: paste images without the 400 session deadlock, plus a vision_analyze tool for OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/video.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的透明图片护栏：贴图不再 400 卡死会话，附带 vision_analyze 工具（OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/视频）。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-bridge

description.en: Routes images to a vision model of your choice - auto-rewrite, explicit tools, or hybrid - so a text-only chat model does not fail a turn that contains a picture.
description.zh: 将图片交给所选的视觉模型处理（自动改写、显式工具或混合模式），使纯文本聊天模型也能处理包含图片的对话。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: deepseek-vision#plugins/dsh-plugin-deepseek-vision

description.en: Vision MCP and DSH bundle for text-only DeepSeek: analyze_image, analyze_clipboard, compare_images and vision_status tools, a visual settings page, free GLM-4.6V-Flash by default, result caching and rate-limit tolerance; keys stay out of logs.
description.zh: 面向纯文本 DeepSeek 的视觉 MCP + DSH 插件：analyze_image / analyze_clipboard / compare_images / vision_status 四个工具、可视化配置页、默认免费 GLM-4.6V-Flash、结果缓存与限流容错，Key 不入日志。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Local OCR fallback for text-only routes: when the session model declares it cannot accept images, the attached image is cached locally and its path injected so the model can call ocr_image — PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime on CPU, no API key, images never leave the machine. Silent when the model can see images.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的本地 OCR 兜底：会话模型明确声明不接受图片时，把附件的图片存入本地缓存并注入路径，模型调 ocr_image 用 PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime 在纯 CPU 上离线识别，无需 API key，图片不出本机；模型能看图时静默。

description.en: Bridges session images to configurable vision providers and returns text-only analysis to eligible DeepSeek Harness model routes.
description.zh: 将会话图片转交可配置视觉服务，并向符合条件的 DeepSeek Harness 模型路由返回纯文本分析。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-mix

description.en: Combine text, vision, and image-generation APIs into one Mix model with automatic routing: text-only requests go to the chat model, user images and agent screenshots go to the vision model, follow-ups keep using the same session image, and agents can generate or edit images with session-scoped call history.
description.zh: 把文本、识图和生图 API 组合成一个 Mix 模型并按对话内容自动路由：纯文本走聊天模型，用户图片和 Agent 截图走识图模型，后续可继续追问同一张图；还支持图片生成与编辑及会话级调用记录。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: DeepSeek Harness vision plugin: 8 analysis modes (describe, OCR, chart data, UI review, object detection, compare, code-gen, debug), any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible vision API, with a built-in free vision model and automatic rate-limit failover.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 图像理解插件：8 种分析模式（描述、OCR、图表取数、UI 评审、目标检测、对比、代码生成、诊断），支持任意 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容视觉 API，内置免费视觉模型与限流自动切换。

description.en: Apple on-device Vision tools for text-only dsh models: local OCR (zh-Hans + 30 langs), image classification, face detection, document layout, and a combined describe — 100% offline, no API key, tall-screenshot slicing.
description.zh: 苹果设备端 Vision 工具：本地 OCR（含中文）、图像分类、人脸检测、文档版面分析与综合描述，100% 离线、无需 API key，支持长截图切片。

description.en: Local WeChat OCR tool for DSH: `wechat_ocr_recognize` returns recognized text and the engine structured result for a local image path.
description.zh: DSH 的本地微信 OCR 工具：`wechat_ocr_recognize` 针对本地图片路径返回识别文本和引擎的结构化结果。

description.en: Local Windows 11 OneOCR tool for DSH: `oneocr_recognize` returns OCR text and structured line/word polygons, confidence, rotation, and handwriting style.
description.zh: DSH 的本地 Windows 11 OneOCR 工具：`oneocr_recognize` 返回 OCR 文本，以及包含行/词多边形、置信度、旋转角度和手写体样式的结构化结果。

description.en: Let the DSH assistant send local, web, and AI-generated images directly to users in chat, with external vision support for text-only models. On Windows it runs through PowerShell.
description.zh: 让 DSH 助手把本地、网页和 AI 生成的图片直接发到聊天里给用户看，并为文本模型提供识图能力；Windows 下经 PowerShell 运行。

description.en: Image-generation tool with automatic prompt enhancement, switchable API profiles, and a Turn-tail image card that survives chat folding. Requires a user-supplied image API endpoint and key; none are bundled.
description.zh: 带提示词自动增强、可切换多个 API 配置，并在 Turn 尾展示不被折叠的图片卡片的生图工具。需自行配置图像 API 地址与密钥，插件不内置。

description.en: Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR, element detection, inline display) sharing the same image resolver, generate_image over OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI protocols, multi-card async generate_video with a /build-video-tool builder, and speak/clone_voice TTS over seven providers, all driven by one auto-saving settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的全模态工作站：analyze_image 走有序多卡片 VLM 故障转移链；六个视觉工具箱工具（局部放大、色调采样、像素比对、OCR、元素检测、内联展示）共用同一套图片来源解析；generate_image 支持 OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI 协议；多卡片异步 generate_video 配 /build-video-tool 构建器；speak/clone_voice 语音合成覆盖七家供应商；全部由一个自动保存的设置页驱动。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek routes that analyzes attached and local images through configurable OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, or Anthropic Messages endpoints while leaving image-capable routes native.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 路由提供视觉桥接：通过可配置的 OpenAI Responses、Chat Completions 或 Anthropic Messages 端点分析附件与本地图片，同时保持支持图片的路由走原生路径。

plugins.name: dsh-tool-visual-primitives

description.en: Analyzes conversation images through mode-specific prompts (caption, UI, document, grounding, topology, etc.) and injects structured evidence with coordinate primitives (boxes, points, refs) as text, with session-level caching for reuse across replay and compaction.
description.zh: 通过模式化提示分析对话图片（描述、UI、文档、定位、拓扑等），将含坐标原语（框、点、引用）的结构化证据以文本注入上下文，会话级缓存跨回放与压缩复用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).
description.zh: 纯文本模型双层识图：优先本地快速 OCR（RapidOCR，离线），不足时回落视觉模型（modlens）。

description.en: Image "reading" for text-only models: downscale + reduce color depth + structure/color fingerprints into text grids fed back to the conversation, letting the model zoom, sample and OCR autonomously like a multimodal model; fully local with zero external model dependency, ships an image-reading methodology skill and optional PaddleOCR.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的"读图"能力：图片降分辨率+降色深+结构/色彩指纹渲染成文本网格喂回对话，模型像多模态一样自主缩放、取样、OCR 读图；纯本地零外部模型依赖，附读图方法论 skill 与可选 PaddleOCR。

description.en: Transparent multimodal routing for text-only models: every image in every model call is fully transcribed (verbatim OCR, data, uncertainty zones, injection-hardened) by your own multimodal understander, with focused re-look via vision_relook and automatic retry on image-related failures. No bundled endpoints, no borrowed logins.
description.zh: 纯文本模型的透明多模态路由：每一次模型调用里的每张图片先由你自己配置的多模态理解模型全量转述（逐字 OCR、数据、不确定区、防注入），vision_relook 定点复看，图片类报错自动转述重试。不内置端点、不借登录态。

plugins.name: qiaomu-cover-design-dsh

description.en: Design covers on a canvas using templates and typography controls, and export PNG images.
description.zh: 在画布中使用模板和排版控件制作封面，并导出 PNG 图片。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to jikasei.me

description.en: Vision for text-only dsh models: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically — transparent twin routing, an agent-callable read-image tool, no built-in keys or relay.
description.zh: 纯文本 dsh 模型的识图插件：粘贴图片自动由你配置的多模态模型转成文字——透明孪生路由、模型可自主调用识图工具、无内置密钥与中转。

description.en: Gives text-only models vision: forwards user images to an OpenAI-compatible vision model and shows the descriptions in a Web UI right panel.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型装上眼睛：把用户图片转发给任意 OpenAI 兼容的视觉模型生成描述，并在 Web UI 右侧面板展示结果。

description.en: Auto-switch the DeepSeek route to the vision model on demand: flash main session switches (A), pro keeps deep reasoning and delegates image reading to a vision subagent (B), subagents always switch, with fatal-failure fallback. No manual model switching.
description.zh: 按需自动把 DeepSeek 路由切到视觉模型：flash 主会话直接切（A），pro 保持深推理并交给视觉子代理读图（B），子代理恒切，含失败回退，无需手动切模型。

description.en: Give a text-only agent video understanding: extract timestamped frame files, sample only on scene changes, export GIF clips, probe metadata, and run a one-shot analyse over the frames. Five tools that shell out to a local ffmpeg through argv arrays rather than a shell string.
description.zh: 给纯文本 agent 补上视频理解：抽帧并返回带时间码的帧文件、只在场景切换时采样、导出 GIF 片段、探测元数据、并对关键帧做一次性分析。五个工具，通过 argv 数组调用本机 ffmpeg 而非拼接 shell 字符串。

description.en: Vision provider route that transcribes attached images to text through a configurable model (15+ OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic vendors) while DeepSeek keeps answering.
description.zh: 视觉模型路由：把附加图片经可配置模型（15+ OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic 供应商）转译为文字，对话仍由 DeepSeek 作答。

plugins.name: dsh-mindseye

description.en: Plug-in vision for text-only models on DSH, with native interaction for image understanding and generation, GUI automation, through layered evidence memory and cache.
description.zh: 为 DSH 上的纯文本模型提供视觉插件：通过分层证据记忆与缓存，实现图片理解与生成的原生交互及 GUI 自动化。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-qwen-studio

description.en: Qwen Image 2.1 workspace for DSH: Apple Silicon MLX or your own NVIDIA server, native reference editing, LoRA, ControlNet, inpainting, shared presets, gallery and live agent progress. Includes verified updates and an agent setup guide.
description.zh: DSH 的 Qwen Image 2.1 创作工作区：本机 MLX 或自己的 NVIDIA 服务器，支持原生参考编辑、LoRA、结构控制、蒙版、整套预设、图库与对话实时进度，提供校验更新和 Agent 安装指南。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 198.18.0.0 for network access

description.en: Turn every idea into an image or video with Kling AI. In DeepSeek Harness, use natural language for text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-image creation, task tracking, and result previews.
description.zh: 一句话，让灵感从想法变成大片。在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接用自然语言调用可灵 AI，支持文生图、图生图、文生视频、图生视频、参考图创作、任务跟踪和结果预览。

description.en: Give your text-only model eyes - chat image attachments are auto-described via a vision model (default prompt), with iterative re-parsing through model-generated prompts when details are missing; system/custom model modes + GUI config panel, key-safe secret handling, and a small host patch for DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 (see repo README).
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能看图：发图自动用视觉模型描述（默认提示词），描述不足时对话模型自动生成更具体的提示词重新解析；系统模型/自定义双模式 + GUI 可视化配置、Key 脱敏安全、针对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 的宿主小补丁（见仓库 README）。

description.en: GPT Image 2 `image_gen` with Codex subscription OAuth by default or explicit API-key mode: developing card, up to three live API partials, durable attachment replay/lightbox/download, text-only model output, and bounded credential-safe requests.
description.zh: GPT Image 2 `image_gen`：默认复用 Codex 订阅 OAuth，也可显式使用 API Key；显影卡片、最多 3 张 API 实时局部图、持久附件回放/灯箱/下载、纯文本模型输出和受限的凭据安全请求。

description.en: On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek models: upload images, and the model calls a view_image tool backed by any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (Qwen/DashScope by default).
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供按需视觉：上传图片后，模型通过 view_image 工具调用任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点（默认 Qwen/DashScope）。

plugins.name: dsh-visibridge

description.en: Structured vision evidence (OCR/layout/semantics) plus a USB camera capture tool for a "shoot-look-adjust" debug loop; backends: Ollama, DeepSeek, Xiaomi.
description.zh: 结构化视觉证据（OCR/版面/语义）+ USB 摄像头拍摄工具，支持"拍-看-改"调试闭环；后端支持 Ollama、DeepSeek、小米。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: External vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: whale-button config panel, image recognition with auto-reply, and agent screenshot/recognize tools.
description.zh: 外挂识图插件：鲸鱼按钮配置面板、图片识图自动回传、模型自主截图识图工具。

description.en: Local art pipeline for DSH: drives the locally installed SD WebUI and ComfyUI backends through ten image_* tools and an Art Studio sidebar panel with an embedded ComfyUI canvas, post-processes with the Python shipped with those installs (rembg cutout, Real-ESRGAN upscale, seamless tiling), and writes Godot-ready assets with res:// paths once a project root is set.
description.zh: 本机美术流水线：把本机已装的 SD WebUI 与 ComfyUI 接进 DSH——10 个 image_* 工具 + 「美术工坊」侧边栏面板（内嵌 ComfyUI 画布），用整合包自带的 Python 做抠图 / 放大 / 无缝平铺后处理；填写 Godot 项目根目录后，产物直接落成带 res:// 路径的游戏资产。

description.en: Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend.
description.zh: 本地生成图像/配音/音乐/音效并听写，同一性锁定：角色、动物、道具与配音角色定妆定声一次，之后每次调用复用同一份参考；退化产物（接近纯色的图、静音的音频）被拒绝而不是当成成功返回；生成的台词可以听写回文字，好让吞掉结尾的克隆暴露出来。空闲时引擎卸载显存，生图与听写也可改指向任意 OpenAI 形状的 API 而不用本地 Vulkan 后端。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only models: paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics).
description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。

description.en: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.
description.zh: 一个截图工具，外加两个默认关闭的自动截图时机。需要模型支持图片输入。

description.en: Vision understanding + image generation/editing for DeepSeek Harness (read images with Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini, generate and edit with Qwen-Image). A rework of liustack/modlens (MIT). Remove @liustack/modlens first — both register the same vision providers and image interception hooks, so co-installation breaks image reading.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供读图与生图/编辑能力（Qwen/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini 读图，Qwen-Image 生图与编辑）。基于 liustack/modlens（MIT）改造；请先卸载 @liustack/modlens——两者会注册同一批 vision provider 与图片拦截钩子，并存会导致读图失灵。

description.en: Gives dsh the ability to generate images and videos through the grok2api API.
description.zh: 让 dsh 通过 grok2api 的 API 获得生成图片与视频能力。

description.en: Trims historical images in outgoing chat requests down to a recent-image count, learns the provider per-prompt image cap from HTTP 400 responses, and retries with fewer images so image-heavy sessions keep working.
description.zh: 发送前把请求中的历史图片裁剪至保留张数，并从上游 400 错误解析单次图片上限、按更少张数降级重试，保证含图会话不被图片数量限制打断。

description.en: Dual-engine screen capture for DSH: inside the SSiD desktop shell, a global hotkey or tray opens a fullscreen box-select overlay (all monitors, per-display pixel-perfect frames) with in-place red-box annotation and a WeChat-style toolbar; in plain DSH (browser), the composer camera button captures the display via getDisplayMedia and reuses the same single-phase box-select + annotation overlay in-page. The cropped image lands in the current conversation composer through the official attachment intake.
description.zh: DSH 双引擎截图：思灵桌面壳内，全局快捷键/托盘打开全屏框选浮层（多显示器、逐屏像素级抓帧），选区定格后工具条就地画红框，一次确认送进输入框；纯 DSH（浏览器）下由输入框相机按钮经 getDisplayMedia 捕获屏幕，复用同一套单阶段框选+标注遮罩。均走官方附件通道。

description.en: Scene-awareness probe for DSH on macOS: a privacy-first, pull-model `look` tool that reads the frontmost non-self window (app info, AX title/selection, gated local OCR), plus a summon-hotkey snapshot captured the instant you press.
description.zh: macOS 场景感知探针：拉模型零轮询的 look 工具，读取最前非自身窗口（应用信息、AX 标题/选中文本、按需本地 OCR），支持召唤热键按下瞬间抓取快照注入对话。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.
description.zh: 给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

description.en: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a locally running Unsloth Desktop (Unsloth Studio) server through unsloth_run and unsloth_vision tools; pure HTTP client, never spawns or owns processes.
description.zh: 把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地运行的 Unsloth Desktop（Unsloth Studio）服务器：unsloth_run 与 unsloth_vision 两个工具，纯 HTTP 客户端，不拉起也不持有任何进程。

description.en: Image generation and image reading for DSH: a 创作 sidebar page (one row per model, 10 ratios, 1K–4K sizes, a contact sheet with detail cards, zoom, reuse and delete), three preset providers plus custom endpoints — one needs no key at all — and a vision-review skill. A pasted key is written to ~/.dsh/secrets/media-tools.env (mode 600) and only sent to the provider you picked. Requires Python 3.9+ (generation runs through scripts/generate.py); the 创作 page needs desktop DSH 0.2.1+.
description.zh: DSH 的生图与读图：侧边栏「创作」页面（按模型分行、10 种比例、1K–4K 尺寸、联系表 + 详情卡 + 放大 + 复用 + 删除），三个预设提供方外加自定义端点（其中一个完全免 Key），另有 vision-review 读图技能。粘进去的 Key 只写进本机 ~/.dsh/secrets/media-tools.env（权限 600），只发给你选的那家服务商。需要 Python 3.9+（生图由 scripts/generate.py 执行）；「创作」页需桌面版 DSH 0.2.1+。

description.en: Structured image recognition: local sharp measurements plus a cloud vision model return description, OCR with coordinates, object locations and fine-grained attributes in one call; a fingerprint cache makes repeated images return in milliseconds without spending model quota.
description.zh: 结构化图像识别：本地 sharp 感知 + 云端视觉模型，一次调用拿到描述、带坐标的 OCR、 目标定位与细粒度属性；图片指纹缓存让重复图片毫秒返回且不消耗模型额度。

description.en: Full vision-capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: a vision_understand tool (OpenAI-compatible vision APIs, free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash by default) plus paste/drag-and-drop/button entry points for image recognition.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视觉能力全家桶：vision_understand 工具（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API，默认免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash）+ 粘贴/拖拽/按钮三入口识图。

description.en: Vision-augmented DeepSeek adapter: a vision-capable model describes image input, then a text-only DeepSeek model reasons over the description.
description.zh: 视觉增强的 DeepSeek 适配器：由视觉模型把图片描述成文字，纯文本 DeepSeek 模型再基于描述推理。

description.en: Reads animated GIF and WebP as animations: a pasted one keeps playing in the UI while the model gets a labelled sheet of frames sampled across it, and the read_animation tool samples a file on demand.
description.zh: 把 gif 和动图 webp 当作动画来读：贴进聊天框的照常播放，模型收到的是横跨整段采样、带帧号与时长的胶片条；工作区里的文件由 read_animation 按需采样。

description.en: Lets a text-only DeepSeek agent read images in the same session by delegating to a vision-capable subagent, with send-time image-to-path conversion.
description.zh: 让纯文本 DeepSeek 代理在同一会话内读图：委派给视觉子代理，发送时自动把图片转为文件路径。

description.en: Fully-local image understanding & OCR via macOS Vision Framework: `ocr_image` (text, table layout + coordinates) and `view_image` (scene, faces, QR) — paste multiple images into the web input box or pass path/URL/base64; images never leave your Mac.
description.zh: 基于 macOS Vision Framework 的全本地识图插件：`ocr_image`（文字提取，表格结构+坐标）与 `view_image`（场景/人脸/二维码）；web 输入框可直接粘贴多张图片，图片永不离开你的 Mac。

description.en: Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

description.en: Control a HarmonyOS phone from the DSH web UI with AI: live H.264 screen mirroring, mouse touch and system keys, hilog streaming, and agentic tools that let the model read the screen, locate UI controls, then tap, long-press, press keys, or type.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页中用 AI 操控鸿蒙手机：实时 H.264 投屏、触控与系统按键、hilog 日志，并让模型读屏、定位 UI 控件，再执行点击/长按/按键/输入。

description.en: Full-screen screenshot panel for the DSH composer: marquee selection with rectangle, ellipse, arrow, pen, mosaic and text annotation, then insert into the conversation, copy or save. The selected region can also be recognized offline — PP-OCRv6 through onnxruntime-node, falling back to the built-in Windows OCR engine — and translated into nine languages with the model already configured in DSH. On Windows the marquee covers the whole screen including the taskbar and hides the DSH window first, so the capture is of the real desktop. The panel runs in an Edge or Chrome kiosk window, and falls back to an in-DSH capture flow when no browser can be launched. Note that DSH Desktop denies ordinary browser access by default, so the full-screen panel also needs "Allow opening this Profile in a browser" (compatibility mode) enabled in the profile settings; without it every capture goes through the in-DSH fallback. Windows only (DSH Desktop); the PP-OCRv6 models are downloaded from ModelScope on first recognition.
description.zh: DSH 输入框旁的整屏截图面板：框选后可标注矩形、椭圆、箭头、画笔、马赛克与文字，再插入对话、复制或另存为；框选区域可以用 PP-OCRv6（onnxruntime-node，模型未就绪时回落 Windows 自带 OCR 引擎）离线识别成文字，再用 DSH 里已配置好的模型翻译成九种语言。Windows 下框选覆盖含任务栏的整个屏幕，截图前会先隐藏 DSH 窗口，截到的是真实桌面；面板由 Edge 或 Chrome 的 kiosk 窗口承载，找不到可用浏览器时回退到 DSH 内截图。注意 DSH Desktop 默认不放行普通浏览器的访问，所以整屏面板还需要在 profile 设置里打开「允许在浏览器中打开」（兼容模式）；没打开时每次截图都走 DSH 内回退流程。仅支持 Windows（DSH Desktop）；PP-OCRv6 模型在首次识别时从 ModelScope 下载。

description.en: Native image attachments for text-only DeepSeek in the Web GUI: pasted or dropped images appear as thumbnails in the session, and before dispatch the host reads them with the free Zhipu GLM-4V-Flash vision API (glm-4v-flash fallback chain) and substitutes the description, so DeepSeek answers about the image while the original is kept in history.
description.zh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 提供原生图片上传体验：在 Web GUI 粘贴/拖入图片即以缩略图附件进入会话，发送前由 host 用免费智谱 GLM-4V-Flash 视觉 API（glm-4v-flash 降级链）读取并替换为文字描述，DeepSeek 据此回答，原图保留在聊天历史中。

description.en: Keyless image generation with two tools: generate_image (no API key, one call at a time, bounded rate-limit retries) and list_image_models.
description.zh: 无需 API 密钥的图片生成，含两个工具：generate_image（无需密钥、串行调用、有限次限流重试）与 list_image_models。

description.en: Zero-dependency screen capture for DSH: Lightweight — zero deps, zero binaries; Stage & shoot — one-click full screen, window layout, hover-snap capture of occluded windows; Agent self-service — path-only delivery; paths are universal, pair with modlens (optional) for one-call structured evidence.
description.zh: DSH 轻量截图插件：轻——零依赖零二进制；摆——一键全屏、窗口排版、悬停吸附截取被遮挡窗口；自助——Agent 可自助截屏，传路径不传图，路径通用，接上 modlens（选装）一步读出结构化内容。

description.en: Multi-engine text-to-image generation (OpenAI Images and Zhipu CogView presets) with per-session quota tracking, engine failover, credential-safe config, and a result card with regenerate.
description.zh: 多引擎文生图（OpenAI Images 与智谱 CogView 预设）：按会话配额、引擎故障切换、凭证安全配置，结果卡片支持重新生成。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-opencode

description.en: Adds a configurable vision model to text-only main models: a vision_read_image tool, a composer-bar vision-model selector, and automatic image-to-text conversion for text-only routes.
description.zh: 给纯文本主模型加可配置识图模型：vision_read_image 工具、输入框识图模型选择器，以及纯文本路由的图片自动转文字。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-imagegen-video

description.en: AI image and video generation for the DSH Web GUI: text-to-image and image-to-image over per-channel model catalogs with per-family request shaping (gpt-image, Grok Imagine, Nano Banana, Seedream, GLM-Image, Qwen-Image, MiniMax image-01, DALL-E 3), a sidebar generation studio, an infinite canvas with node workflows, files preview and canvas skills, and a prompt template library; the video side adds text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-keyframe and multi-reference modes on an async submit/poll/download pipeline, host-side video tools, video nodes on the canvas, and clip stitching of two or more video nodes into one MP4 with the local ffmpeg.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的 AI 生图与生视频插件：文生图/图生图按渠道配置模型目录，并按模型族适配请求协议（gpt-image、Grok Imagine、Nano Banana、Seedream、GLM-Image、Qwen-Image、MiniMax image-01、DALL-E 3），提供侧边栏生图工作台、带节点工作流的无限画布、文件预览与画布技能，以及提示词模板库；生视频侧含文生视频、图生视频、首尾帧与多参考图模式，走异步提交/轮询/下载链路，另有宿主侧视频工具、画布视频节点，并可用本机 ffmpeg 把两个以上视频节点拼接成一个 MP4。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to invalid

description.en: Generate images from the agent on the user's own GPU by queueing a workflow on a local ComfyUI install over its HTTP API: Z-Image-Turbo for fast drafts and Qwen-Image-2.1 for final assets and legible in-image text. Registers comfyui_generate and comfyui_status plus a skill covering model selection and prompt craft, has no runtime dependencies, and starts ComfyUI headless when no server is listening.
description.zh: 通过本地 ComfyUI 的 HTTP 接口把工作流排到用户自己的 GPU 上，由 Agent 直接生图：Z-Image-Turbo 适合快速草稿，Qwen-Image-2.1 适合成图与图中文字排版。 注册 comfyui_generate、comfyui_status 两个工具和一个涵盖模型选择与提示词 写法的 skill，无运行时依赖；没有 ComfyUI 在跑时会自动 headless 启动一个。

description.en: Drive local Adobe Photoshop for game screenshots and photos: layered HDR, multi-zone colour/person masks, SUPIR/Real-ESRGAN super-resolution, native 1:1 vision inspection. Requires Windows 10/11 and Adobe Photoshop 2025; the grading tools do not run on macOS or on earlier Photoshop versions.
description.zh: 驱动本机 Adobe Photoshop 处理游戏截图与照片：分层 HDR、多区域颜色/人物蒙版、SUPIR/Real-ESRGAN 超分与原生 1:1 视觉检查。需要 Windows 10/11 与 Adobe Photoshop 2025；macOS 与更早的 Photoshop 版本无法运行调色工具。

description.en: Local eyes for text-only models: eyes_render draws text/shapes/Mermaid onto a canvas in the Web GUI, eyes_paste captures pasted images, eyes_ocr reads text via the built-in Windows OCR (offline), and eyes_analyze inspects pixels as structured data — no vision model required.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型装上本地眼睛：eyes_render 在 Web 界面画布上绘制文字/图形/Mermaid，eyes_paste 接收用户粘贴的图片，eyes_ocr 用 Windows 自带 OCR 离线读文字，eyes_analyze 把像素解析成结构化数据，全程无需视觉模型。

description.en: Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent, and materialize pasted originals for editing.
description.zh: 为任意 DSH 路由装上眼睛：Web 输入框贴图按意图自动聚焦分析，视觉子代理代读工作区图片，原图可随时物化编辑。

description.en: Give text-only models vision: a describe_image tool that delegates images to a vision model from your dsh model list over the harness's own LLM runtime.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型拥有视觉：describe_image 工具调用 dsh 模型列表中的视觉模型描述图片，走 harness 自身的 LLM 运行时。

description.en: Lets a text-only agent watch a live screen or camera feed: every frame is scored by how much the picture changed, only the ones that matter are packed into one numbered sheet with an audio envelope, so the model looks at what actually changed instead of a screenshot every few seconds.
description.zh: 让只有文字的智能体「看」实时屏幕或摄像头：每帧按画面变化量打分，只把真正变了的帧拼成一张带编号、带音轨条的宫格图——看视频、看演示、看游戏都行，token 只花在变了的地方。

description.en: Turns a video (a local file, or a Bilibili/yt-dlp link) into one addressable storyboard grid — numbered cells with exact timestamps, per-cell transcript and an audio envelope on the same timeline — and video_zoom re-reads any window at higher resolution, so a text-only model can look at the video instead of reading a summary.
description.zh: 把视频（本地文件，或 B 站 / yt-dlp 链接）压成一张可寻址的宫格图：每格烧编号、对应精确时间、挂台词，底部还有同时间轴的音频包络；video_zoom 可对任意窗口高清重看——纯文本模型因此能「看」视频，而不是读别人写的摘要。

description.en: DSH text-to-image/image-to-image plugin: compatible with OpenAI-style image generation APIs, with 多米API as the default; standard OpenAI endpoints may require protocol, image-to-image mode and size adjustments; text-to-image and URL reference images do not use COS, while local reference images can be compressed and stored in COS; custom prompt suffixes are supported.
description.zh: DSH文生图/图生图插件：兼容OpenAI风格生图接口，默认适配多米API；标准OpenAI需调整协议、图生图模式和尺寸；文生图和URL参考图无需COS，本地参考图可压缩后存COS；支持自定义提示词后缀。

description.en: Send local images or HTTP(S) image URLs to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint with the inspect_image tool and return its text response to the conversation.
description.zh: 通过 inspect_image 工具将本地图片或 HTTP(S) 图片链接发送至配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点，并将文字结果带回对话。

description.en: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek models: transcribes attached images with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp before they reach deepseek-v4-pro, with no third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 视觉桥：贴图先经 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 转写为文字，再交给纯文本的 deepseek-v4-pro 回答，零第三方依赖。

description.en: Advertise image paste on text-only DeepSeek routes, describe attachments with a vision sidecar, and leave native vision models untouched.
description.zh: 在纯文本 DeepSeek 线路上开放贴图准入，用视觉 sidecar 把附件转成文字，原生视觉模型不改写。

description.en: Reads a local video or page link with ffmpeg and Paraformer ASR, returning a timestamped transcript plus key-frame images the agent can open; finds candidate videos by keyword and installs its own runtime dependencies on first use. Requires Python 3.8+ on PATH; video_discover also needs a one-time douyin/xiaohongshu login.
description.zh: 用 ffmpeg 与 Paraformer 读取本地视频或网页链接，返回带时间轴的逐字稿与可逐帧打开的关键帧图片；可按关键词检索候选视频，首次使用时自动安装运行时依赖。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.8+；video_discover 还需一次性登录抖音/小红书。

plugins.name: dsh-deepseek-vision

description.en: A vision-language gateway provider route: pasted images are described by a configurable VL model (Qwen-VL by default) before the DeepSeek wire.
description.zh: 视觉语言网关：注册支持图片输入的 DeepSeek provider 路由，图片先由可配置 VL 模型（默认 Qwen-VL）描述成文字再发送。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Runs the GPT Image Playground workbench inside DeepSeek Harness: gallery and agent modes, reference images with a mask editor, multi-provider API profiles, and local history. The upstream MIT build is served same-origin by the plugin, with an optional API proxy.
description.zh: 把 GPT Image Playground 工作台装进 DeepSeek Harness：画廊与 Agent 双模式、参考图与遮罩编辑、多供应商 API 配置与本地历史。界面为上游 MIT 构建，由插件同源托管，并提供可选的 API 代理。

description.en: Shows oversized images to the model at readable resolution instead of one downscaled copy: before admission, a large upload is split into as many tiles as the attachment store allows (an 8000x8000 screenshot becomes 20 tiles of 2000x1600), so small text survives. Replaces the local attachment store; adds no settings of its own.
description.zh: 让超大图片以可读分辨率进入模型视野，而不是被压成一张缩图：准入前按附件存储允许的上限把大图切成多张切片（8000x8000 的截图会变成 20 张 2000x1600），小字得以保留。以替换本地附件存储的方式实现，不新增任何配置项。

description.en: Design-fidelity QA for text-only models: a `deepseek_vision` tool borrows an eye from any OpenAI-compatible vision route, so the model can judge whether an implementation matches its mock — shipped with the benchmark behind that judgement (four fixtures, 23 injected defects, raw transcripts) and the questioning discipline it depends on.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的设计稿保真判定：`deepseek_vision` 工具从任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉路由借来一只眼，让模型判断实现与设计稿是否一致——并附上支撑该判定的基准（4 组夹具、23 处注入缺陷、逐格原始输出）与其依赖的提问纪律。

description.en: Codex Appshots for DSH: capture the frontmost active window via global shortcut and seamlessly mount it into the composer for agent queries.
description.zh: DSH 版 Codex Appshots：全局快捷键精准捕获当前工作窗口，零摩擦挂载至 Composer 作为上下文向 Agent 提问。

plugins.name: taxue-dsh-artisan

description.en: Integrated visual creation toolchain for DSH: prompt reverse-engineering and audit optimization plus multi-provider image generation with async background rendering.
description.zh: DSH 一体化视觉创作工具链：提示词反推与审计优化，多供应商生图，支持异步后台出图。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Add PaddleOCR vision to text-only LLMs like Agnes, DeepSeek, MiniMax, GLM and Mimo. Supports local files and URLs. Free tier of 20,000 pages/day; needs a PaddleOCR API token you apply for (free, 1-3 business days).
description.zh: 为纯文本模型添加 PaddleOCR 视觉能力，支持 Agnes、DeepSeek、MiniMax、GLM、Mimo，支持本地文件与 URL。每日 2 万页免费额度；需先申请 PaddleOCR API Token（免费，审核约 1-3 个工作日）。

description.en: Give DSH AI timestamped video frames, audio and lyric analysis for Bilibili, YouTube and local files, with encrypted browser-session import, continued viewing, saved site resolvers and native cache management. Requires FFmpeg and ffprobe on PATH or configured in the plugin settings.
description.zh: 让 DSH 中的 AI 结合时间戳画面、音频与歌词理解 B 站、YouTube 和本地视频，支持浏览器登录态导入与加密保存、接续观看、站点解析扩展和原生缓存管理。需要把 FFmpeg 与 ffprobe 放进 PATH，或在插件设置中填写程序路径。

description.en: Reads images with a vision model on the same provider when the selected model cannot see them, and passes that description to the text model.
description.zh: 主模型不能识别图片时，自动改用同一 API 下可识别图片的模型读取图片，再把描述反馈给主模型。

description.en: Agent-callable vision tool that describes local images via any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint you configure, with an optional multi-model cross-check and no built-in keys.
description.zh: Agent 可调用的视觉工具：通过你配置的任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点描述本地图片，支持多模型交叉核对，不内置任何密钥。

description.en: Local OCR using Apple Vision on macOS: text from screenshots, photos, and scans, with no install, no network and no API key.
description.zh: 在 macOS 上使用 Apple Vision 的本地 OCR：从截图、照片和扫描件中读取文字，无需安装、无需联网、无需 API 密钥。

description.en: Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。

description.en: Model-facing image_describe (识图) tool over the DashScope OpenAI-compatible API (qwen3.7-flash), plus a paste bridge: on text-only sessions, pasted images auto-convert to file paths at send time and render back in the transcript, so they never trip image admission. Bring your own DASHSCOPE_API_KEY; endpoint/model/budgets configurable, redirect-proof HTTP client, works in every agent preset.
description.zh: 面向模型的 image_describe（识图）工具（DashScope OpenAI 兼容接口，qwen3.7-flash）+ 粘贴桥：纯文本模型会话里粘贴的图片在发送时自动转为文件路径并在聊天记录中回显，不再触发图片准入拦截。自带 DASHSCOPE_API_KEY；端点/模型/预算可配置，重定向防护 HTTP 客户端，所有 Agent 预设均可用。

description.en: Image generation through a local ComfyUI server: one generate_image tool covering text2img, img2img, inpaint and background removal.
description.zh: 用本地 ComfyUI 出图：一个 generate_image 工具覆盖文生图、图生图、局部重绘与去背景。

plugins.name: dsh-image-generation

description.en: Configure multiple image providers in Settings and call image_generate with the one selected model; images save under generate/image and show inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 在设置中配置多个生图供应商，对话通过 image_generate 调用当前选中的模型；图片保存到工作区 generate/image，并在对话中内联显示。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Removes the model-capability gate that blocks image prompts: patches llm.resolveModelInfo results and adapter model tables to declare image input, so routes with no declared input modality can send and read images. No app.asar or config-tree edits.
description.zh: 移除拦截图片请求的多模态能力门禁：改写 llm.resolveModelInfo 的返回值与适配器模型表，为未声明 input 的路由补上 image 输入能力，使其可以发送和读取图片。不改 app.asar，也不改配置树。

description.en: Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the frontmost window, attach it to the current chat, and inject a VoiceOver-style accessibility tree as hidden context.
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的窗口截图，支持 macOS 和 Windows：macOS 按两边 Command、Windows 按两边 Ctrl（或点输入框旁相机）捕获当前前台窗口并附加到会话，同时把 VoiceOver 风格的辅助功能树注入为隐藏上下文。

description.en: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 原生图片查看体验，支持指针中心缩放、拖动、画廊、下载、键盘操作和图片区域备注。

plugins.name: mimo-vision

description.en: `describe_image` tool: a vision bridge that sends images to mimo-v2.5 through the opencode Zen API (credential `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, free route first with paid fallback) and returns text descriptions for text-only models, with native passthrough and ImageMagick transcoding of SVG/TIFF/HEIC formats.
description.zh: `describe_image` 视觉桥：经 opencode Zen API（凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`，免费线路优先、付费兜底）把图片发给 mimo-v2.5、返回文字描述给纯文本模型，原生格式直发，SVG/TIFF/HEIC 等格式经 ImageMagick 自动转码。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Native vision capability extension, using either Zhipu (free) or Qwen-VL (local).
description.zh: 极简的原生视觉能力增强，支持免费的智谱模型或本地千问视觉模型。

plugins.name: dsh-image-vision

description.en: Image understanding for any DSH model: vision, OCR, grounding, and crop tools with domain presets for histopathology, cell biology, anatomy, clinical images and scientific figures.
description.zh: 让任意 DSH 模型都能识图：提供 vision/OCR/定位/裁剪四件套工具，内置病理、细胞、解剖、临床与科研统计图等专业预设。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Unified image generation router for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): auto-discovers image models from any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, provides draw_image and draw_list_sources tools, supports SenseNova, StepFun, Agnes, Qwen, Flux, SD, Imagen and more.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 统一绘图路由器：自动识别任意 OpenAI 兼容接口的绘图模型，提供 draw_image 和 draw_list_sources 工具，支持商汤、阶跃、Agnes、千问、Flux、SD、Imagen 等。

description.en: Composer-attached images are transcribed to text by an OpenAI-compatible vision model before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
description.zh: 输入框贴图自动识别：由 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转成文字描述后，再交给纯文本 DeepSeek 模型处理。

description.en: Enhanced vision toolbox: 14 pixel-level vision tools (describe, ground, detect, crop, pixel-diff, OCR, long-screenshot OCR, vectorize, colors, cutout, screenshot, present, materialize, html-screenshot) driven by one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with clean \[图片: path] bridge markers, content-safety classification and rate-limit auto-retry.
description.zh: 增强版视觉工具箱:14 个像素级视觉工具(看图问答/定位/检测/裁剪/像素比对/OCR/长截图OCR/矢量化/取色/抠图/截图/展示/落盘/网页截图),单一 OpenAI 兼容端点驱动,桥接标记极简、规则下沉系统提示,带内容安全识别与限流自动重试。

description.en: Splits over-long screenshots into DSH-acceptable slices before prompt admission instead of letting them be rejected: vertical slices overlap so a line of text is never cut in half, and pure-JS codecs avoid native binaries. It wraps the existing attachment store instead of replacing it.
description.zh: 超长截图在发送前自动切成 DSH 可接受的切片，而不是被直接拒收：纵向切片带重叠，不会把一行字劈成两半；纯 JS 编解码，无原生依赖，且只是包住现有附件服务、不顶替它。

description.en: Chat image-attachment bridge with a `view_image` tool for any OpenAI-compatible VLM (local Ollama or cloud): pasted/dropped images become `view_image` path markers before reaching text-only DeepSeek models.
description.zh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的聊天识图插件：view_image 工具转发任意 OpenAI 兼容 VLM（本地 Ollama 或云端），对话框粘贴/拖拽的图片自动改写为 view_image 路径标记供模型查看。

description.en: Windows computer-use capability for DSH: screenshot → vision model → simulated mouse/keyboard with self-evolving knowledge base. Dual-mode plugin tools + skill-only pwsh fallback.
description.zh: Windows 桌面识图+模拟操作能力：截图→vision模型→模拟鼠标键盘，内置自进化应用技巧库。支持插件工具模式和纯skill模式双形态。

plugins.name: dsh-shengtu

description.en: Multi-engine image generation inside the conversation: an agent tool plus a composer-dock panel with an on/off switch, engine presets (Volcengine Ark, SiliconFlow, OpenAI-compatible, custom) and local spend tracking. You supply the API key for the engine you pick.
description.zh: 会话内多引擎生图：agent 工具 + 输入框下方的停靠面板，带启用开关、引擎预设（火山方舟 / 硅基流动 / OpenAI 兼容 / 自定义）和本地消耗统计。需自备所选引擎的 API Key。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Let text-only models see images: when a picture arrives with a placeholder like \[image omitted because this model accepts text only], the model calls the vision_describe tool and the plugin forwards the image reference plus the question to a multimodal model, retrying with a fallback model on failure. Configured in the settings page and persisted via the official settings API.
description.zh: 让纯文本模型也能看图：消息中出现图片占位符时模型调用 vision_describe 工具，插件把本轮图片引用与提问一起转交给多模态视觉模型识别，主模型失败时自动用备用模型重试。配置在设置页完成并通过官方 settings API 持久化到 settings.yaml，热重载不丢。

plugins.name: dsh-vision-router

description.en: Free vision for text-only agents: built-in keyless vision chain plus pixel tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots); paste an image to use it.
description.zh: 为纯文本 Agent 提供视觉能力：内置免 Key 视觉链 + 像素级视觉工具（看图问答、定位、裁剪、像素对比、取色、OCR、矢量化、抠图、截图）；粘贴图片即可用。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-image-lite

description.en: Image generation for DSH in two modes — an image_generate_lite tool the model calls from chat, and a right-sidebar studio for manual runs; up to five reference images, the OpenAI images API format, keys kept in the DSH credential service.
description.zh: DSH 生图插件，双模式：对话中由模型调用 image_generate_lite 工具出图，或在右侧栏「生图工作台」手动生图；最多 5 张参考图、支持 OpenAI images 接口格式，密钥存于 DSH 凭据服务。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Turn your phone into a full-featured camera for dsh sessions (requires the open-source Android companion app — install the plugin and scan the QR code it shows to download the APK): 1. Live viewfinder over LAN or USB, injectable into the chat or savable to a folder. 2. Callable tools let the dsh model take photos, zoom, and switch lenses on demand mid-conversation, so in fully automated workflows the model can actively "see" the physical world. 3. Full zoom/flash, crop, and annotation. 4. Rich settings.
description.zh: 手机变 dsh 会话的全功能摄像头（需配合开源的 Android 手机 App——安装插件后扫插件提供的二维码即可下载 APK）：1. 局域网或 USB 直连实时取景，画面可直接注入对话框或保存到指定位置；2. 提供可调用工具，dsh 模型可在流式对话中按需主动拍照/变焦/切换镜头，便于全自动开发中模型主动"看见"物理世界；3. 提供完整的变焦/闪光灯、照片裁剪、标注等功能；4. 提供丰富的设置选项。

description.en: Adds an Omni-modal settings section to DeepSeek Harness that points the harness at any OpenAI-compatible image and video endpoint: switchable config profiles with separate endpoint, API key, model, path and size for each side, free-form extra request parameters, a connectivity test that does not spend generation quota, and three model-visible tools — generate_image, generate_video and check_video — with async video tasks that survive restarts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「全模态设置」分区：可把生图 / 生视频指向任意 OpenAI 兼容端点，多套配置档案可随时切换，图片与视频各自独立的接口地址、API Key、模型、路径与尺寸，支持自由填写额外请求参数、不消耗额度的连通性测试，并注册 generate_image / generate_video / check_video 三个模型可见工具，异步视频任务可跨重启保留。

description.en: Digests the images in a prompt with a vision model before admission, so any model — a text-only one included — can read them without the session ever switching models, and adds a describe_image tool for image paths.
description.zh: 在准入前把提示词里的图片换成视觉模型的文字分析，因此任何模型（包括纯文本模型）都能读图且会话不切换模型；另提供 describe_image 工具处理图片路径。

description.en: Registers two tools for DeepSeek Harness. `doc_ocr` turns scanned PDFs and images into structured text (per-page text, financial tables with a balance-sheet tie-out check, contract-clause hits) through a local RapidOCR engine or a Zhipu GLM-OCR cloud engine, and `doc_preprocess` turns a directory of raw files into an Obsidian-ready knowledge base through a seven-stage pipeline with backend routing and sha256-based incremental skipping. Numbers that fail the tie-out are reported, not invented. The local engine needs Python 3 with rapidocr-onnxruntime, pypdfium2 and Pillow (pip install -r requirements.txt); the GLM engine needs ZHIPU_API_KEY.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册两个工具：`doc_ocr` 把扫描件 PDF 与图片转成结构化文本（逐页文本、带资产负债表平衡勾稽的财务报表行、合同条款命中），可用本机 RapidOCR 或智谱 GLM-OCR 云端引擎；`doc_preprocess` 用 7 阶段管线把一批原始文件整理成 Obsidian 可读知识库，含后端路由与 sha256 增量跳过。勾稽不平的数字只报出、不编造。本机引擎需 Python 3 并安装 rapidocr-onnxruntime、pypdfium2、Pillow（pip install -r requirements.txt）；GLM 引擎需设置 ZHIPU_API_KEY。

plugins.name: dsh-agnes-studio

description.en: AI image and video studio as a floating DSH panel, so creation runs alongside the conversation instead of replacing it: text-to-image, image-to-image and multi-image composition at 1K-4K across eight aspect ratios; text-to-video and image-to-video with first-frame control at 4-12 seconds; short-drama mode that imports a script (.txt/.md/.json), breaks it into storyboard shots for preview and batch generation; and a prompt-expert workspace. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 一站式 AI 影视创作工作站，作为 DSH 全局浮层面板运行，不占用对话框：生图（文生图 / 图生图 / 多图合成，1K–4K、8 种宽高比）、生视频（文生视频 / 图生视频，4–12 秒、支持首帧控制）、短剧（导入 .txt/.md/.json 剧本自动拆解分镜，故事板预览与批量生成）与提示词专家工作区。零运行时依赖。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-agnes-media

description.en: Sidebar panel for Agnes image and video generation that also ships a node canvas and a short-drama mode. Canvas nodes are chained by extracting the previous shot's tail frame with ffmpeg and submitting it as the next shot's first frame; short-drama mode turns an imported script into storyboard shots. Generation and polling run in the Host process, so tasks survive a page reload or a closed panel, and results plus an 80-entry history are stored on disk.
description.zh: 侧边栏 AI 创作面板，除生图与生视频外还带画布节点图和短剧模式：画布上用 ffmpeg 抽取上一镜尾帧，作为下一镜首帧自动串联；短剧模式可导入剧本拆解为分镜。生成与轮询都在宿主进程后台执行，刷新页面或关闭面板都不中断，结果与最多 80 条历史保存在本机。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Mic button in the composer tool row: Web Speech API speech-to-text (Chrome/Edge), language switching, and optional auto-send, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风语音输入：浏览器 Web Speech API 实时转写（Chrome/Edge），多语言切换与可选自动发送，零依赖零密钥。

description.en: Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.
description.zh: 明日方舟终末地佩丽卡主题分级提示音：计划出方案 / 任务完成 / 需要你回应 / 出错四档独立音效，普通问答保持安静；系统级播放（窗口在后台也响），跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），支持自定义 TTS 语音。

plugins.name: dsh-mimotts

description.en: MiMo TTS speech synthesis for DeepSeek Harness: a speak button on finalized assistant messages with an inline player (draggable progress bar), a plugin-page configuration card with preview playback, and a voice-history settings page.
description.zh: MiMo TTS 语音合成——已定稿助手回复的朗读按钮与内联播放器（可拖动进度条）、插件页配置卡片（支持试听）和语音历史设置页。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via free Edge TTS or your own RVC voice models: read-aloud buttons + auto-read, adaptive chunked progressive playback (gapless long reads), one-click voice-pack installs from a registry, and a portable RVC runtime.
description.zh: 用免费 Edge TTS 或你自己的 RVC 音色朗读 AI 回复：消息朗读与自动朗读、长文自适应分块渐进播放（无缝衔接）、音色包仓库一键安装、便携 RVC 运行时。

description.en: Floating TTS speaker in each conversation corner: when an AI reply finishes, edge-tts reads the summary aloud in the background with no popup windows; the toggle is remembered per conversation. Requires Windows, Python 3.9+ with the edge-tts package installed, and network access to Microsoft's Edge TTS service; summary is the default mode.
description.zh: 每个对话右下角悬浮小喇叭：AI 回复完成后由 edge-tts 在后台静默朗读摘要，全程无前台窗口；开关状态每个对话独立记忆。需要 Windows、Python 3.9+ 并安装 edge-tts，且需联网调用微软 Edge TTS 在线服务；默认朗读摘要。

description.en: Reads AI replies aloud as they stream, with voiced waiting phrases while the model thinks. Edge TTS built in, any OpenAI-compatible cloud engine supported.
description.zh: AI 回复流式 TTS 朗读插件，思考等待期有文字与语音同步的趣味短语反馈。内置 Edge TTS，支持任意 OpenAI 兼容云端引擎。

description.en: Voice input for DeepSeek Harness: speak into the microphone and the recognized text is submitted as a normal chat message, via local or browser speech recognition.
description.zh: 语音输入插件：对着麦克风说话，识别后的文字作为普通聊天消息发送（本地模型或浏览器语音识别）。

plugins.name: dsh-livevoice

description.en: Realtime WebRTC voice using Codex OAuth, with task delegation to a DSH session.
description.zh: 使用 Codex OAuth 的 WebRTC 实时语音，并可将任务交给 DSH 会话执行。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Reads Harness replies aloud through an existing local TTS runtime: built-in IndexTTS and GPT-SoVITS launchers, a protocol-based local HTTP/JSONL entry, and model-folder loading for Kokoro, F5-TTS, VoxCPM, Qwen3-TTS and CosyVoice SDK environments. Ships no models. Derived from 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts; it isolates its row id and settings, so both can be installed side by side with duplicate features deactivated.
description.zh: 用已有的本地语音合成为 Harness 逐句朗读：内置 IndexTTS 与 GPT-SoVITS 启动器、基于协议的本地 HTTP/JSONL 接入，以及 Kokoro、F5-TTS、VoxCPM、Qwen3-TTS、CosyVoice 的 SDK 环境模型文件夹加载；不附带任何模型。衍生自 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts；已隔离行 id 与设置，可与原插件同装，重复功能会自动停用。

description.en: Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).
description.zh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

description.en: Search public-domain libraries (Project Gutenberg, Wikisource, Internet Archive, Standard Ebooks) by title, author, character or half-remembered plot, or import EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown, and listen in the sidebar with Microsoft Edge neural voices, offline Kokoro or the device voices; keeps your position, takes voice notes anchored to what you just heard, and discusses the book with your DSH model.
description.zh: 搜书听：按书名、作者、角色名或大概情节搜公版书（古腾堡、中英文维基文库、Internet Archive、Standard Ebooks），或导入 EPUB / PDF / TXT / DOCX / Markdown，在右侧栏用微软 Edge 神经网络语音、离线 Kokoro 或设备自带语音读给你听；自动记住听到哪，能语音记读书心得、和 AI 聊刚听到的内容。

description.en: Zero-dependency, event-driven voice announcement plugin: no extra model, no token cost. Speaks with the system's built-in natural voice, supporting both Windows and macOS; final-reply announcements, approval & question alerts, optional event announcements (turn end, command done, goal change, tool errors, todo updates), replayable final replies, and a bilingual visual settings page.
description.zh: 零外部依赖、事件驱动、无需额外模型、不消耗任何 token的语音播报插件。使用系统自带自然语音进行播报，支持win/mac双平台；最终回复、审批与提问提醒、可选事件播报（回合结束/命令完成/目标变更/工具出错/待办更新）、最终回复可重播、双语言可视化设置。

description.en: Turns a local audio file into a short plain-language verdict on tempo, key, dynamics, clipping and arrangement shape, and keeps the raw measurements in a separate block; audio never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 把本地音频拆成速度、调性、动态、削波与编曲形状，合成一段人话结论，原始测量值另列；音频不出本机。

description.en: Push-to-talk dictation for the Web composer: hold a hotkey to record and the transcript is written into the draft through DSH's own speech Remote (local SenseVoice), with an optional auto-send.
description.zh: 输入框按住说话：按住快捷键录音，经 DSH 自带语音 Remote（本地 SenseVoice）识别后写入草稿，可选自动发送。

description.en: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
description.zh: 浏览器 Web Speech API 语音输入：零服务端、零密钥、零模型下载（Edge=Azure 语音、Chrome=Google 语音）。

description.en: Speech-to-text voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer transcribes speech into the draft via the browser Web Speech API (zero-config) or an OpenAI-compatible Whisper API (OpenAI / Groq), with a selectable model and language in Settings.
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：输入框旁麦克风按钮语音转文字填入输入框；支持浏览器 Web Speech API 本地识别（零配置、无需密钥）与 OpenAI 兼容 Whisper API（OpenAI/Groq），模型与语言可在设置中选择。

description.en: Big Fish Voice: makes the DSH web desktop pet speak. Whisper bubbles are read aloud automatically, left-clicking a bubble reads it, right-click/long-press reads it again, and clicking the pet replies with lines like 「主人，小鱼在这呢」. 10 offline Chinese voices: 2 local replica voices (鱼鱼酱 / 鱼鱼姐, no API key, ~58MB each) plus 8 Kokoro female voices (4 moe / 4 onee-san, models download on first use ~348MB, then work offline). Auto-reading can be throttled (unlimited / 30s / 60s / 3min); within one DSH instance only a single page plays audio. About 35KB package, inference in a worker thread, no dsh-pet files modified. The two replica voice models are for personal non-commercial use only.
description.zh: 大肥鱼语音：让 DSH 网页桌宠开口说话。碎碎念气泡出现时自动朗读，左键点气泡朗读内容，右键/长按再读一遍，点桌宠回应「主人，小鱼在这呢」等互动台词。10 个离线中文音色：2 个本地复刻音色（鱼鱼酱 / 鱼鱼姐，无需 API Key，各约 58MB）+ 8 个 Kokoro 离线女声（萌系/御姐各 4 个，模型首次按需下载约 348MB，之后断网也能读）。自动朗读可设最小间隔（不限/30 秒/60 秒/3 分钟），同一实例多页面只由一个页面出声；插件本体约 35KB，推理在 worker 线程，不修改 dsh-pet 的任何文件。两个复刻音色模型仅供个人非商业使用。

description.en: Voice AI girlfriend for the Web UI: FunASR mic input, Qwen3-TTS spoken replies, companion animation window, and two-way QQ chat (text/voice/image push) via NapCat.
description.zh: Web UI 语音 AI 女友：FunASR 麦克风语音输入、Qwen3-TTS 语音回复、数字人动画窗、QQ 双向聊天（文本/语音/图片推送，经 NapCat）。

description.en: Dual-MediaPlayer daemon ($think loop + $fx one-shots) with volume ducking, mood-aware sounds (smooth/struggle/deep_think triggered by consecutive success/failure streaks and prolonged agent runtime), 15 built-in PCM WAV synthesised from sine/square waveforms, per-tool sound mapping with 51 categorised tools, custom WAV/MP3 drop-in with auto-conversion, and a full settings UI with dark-mode fix.
description.zh: 双 MediaPlayer 守护进程（$think 思考循环 + $fx 一次性音效）支持音量闪避、情绪感知音效（连续成功/失败/长时间运行自动触发 smooth/struggle/deep_think）、15 种正弦/方波合成内置音、51 个工具分类映射、自定义 WAV/MP3 直替自动转换，以及完整设置页含深色模式修复。

description.en: Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD that sends each utterance after a pause, speech recognition through the local SenseVoice model already downloaded by the official voice-input plugin (no second model), FunASR HTTP or streaming, or a cloud-compatible API, MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS (director mode and voice clone) / OpenAI-compatible TTS replies, an optional wake-word mode with auto-sleep, and task dispatch to separate sessions with progress, stop, and spoken completion reports.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端与 Web GUI 通用（同一份插件，只是 profile 名不同）的个人语音通话助手：可拖拽悬浮球通话面板、浏览器端 VAD（停顿自动发送）、语音识别可选本地 SenseVoice（复用官方「语音输入」插件已下载的模型，免装第二份模型）/ FunASR HTTP 或流式 / 云端兼容 API、MiniMax / MiMo-V2.5-TTS（含导演模式与音色克隆）/ OpenAI 兼容 TTS 语音回复、可开关的唤醒词模式（沉默自动休眠），以及把任务分发给独立子会话并跟踪进度、停止与完成播报。

description.en: Notifies you when a conversation finishes: plays a sound and shows a Windows notification when the agent goes idle (configurable sound file, volume, debounce/throttle).
description.zh: 对话完成提醒：Agent 空闲（idle）时播放提示音并弹 Windows 原生通知，可配 ding.mp3、音量与防抖节流。

description.en: Adds a speaker button immediately right of the Like button on every finalized assistant reply; click it to hear the reply through the browser speech engine, and hover it for a speed and voice panel. Text is sent to an unofficial Edge TTS endpoint.
description.zh: 在每条已定稿的助手回复里、紧挨点赞按钮右侧加一个小喇叭：点击用浏览器语音引擎朗读这条回复，鼠标悬停可调倍速与音色；文本会发送到非官方的 Edge TTS 端点。

plugins.name: dsh-ears-prosody

description.en: Local offline prosody analysis for DeepSeek Harness: reports how something was said — speed, pitch, pauses, energy — alongside the transcript.
description.zh: 本地离线语气分析：在转写之外，给出语速、音高、停顿与力度的听感描述，让模型听懂「怎么说的」。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: any-audio

description.en: Five tools for agent-driven audio: anyaudio_music renders note-level scores offline from local SoundFont banks, anyaudio_sfx offers 52 SoundFont presets plus 15 procedural generators, anyaudio_tts speaks through Edge or MiMo, anyaudio_mix ducks narration under the bed and normalizes peak level, and anyaudio_sources manages the shared sound-font library.
description.zh: 五个工具做 agent 音频：anyaudio_music 从本地 SoundFont 离线渲染音符级乐谱，anyaudio_sfx 提供 52 条 SoundFont 音效预设与 15 种程序化生成器，anyaudio_tts 走 Edge 或 MiMo 配音，anyaudio_mix 做旁白闪避与峰值归一，anyaudio_sources 管理共享音源库。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Dictation that ends up in the repository instead of the chat log: hold the button (or import a WAV), and the plugin archives voice-memos/<id>/ with audio.wav, a rendered waveform.png, memo.md (frontmatter, per-segment timestamps, ready-to-paste quote blocks) and meta.json. Audio is resampled to 16 kHz mono in the browser before it is sent. Transcription stays local — the harness speechToText service with silence-split windows, or a command worker such as faster-whisper — and when no engine is available the memo is still filed with an explicit status and reason rather than a fabricated transcript. Ships a conversation-view 口述 tab with click-to-seek playback and per-segment quote copy, three agent tools (voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read) and HTTP routes. Zero runtime dependencies, 52 node:test cases, real screenshots in docs/.
description.zh: 把口述变成仓库里的归档，而不是聊天里一闪而过的转写：按住说话（或导入 WAV）后，插件把 audio.wav、渲染好的 waveform.png、memo.md（frontmatter、逐段时码、可直接粘贴的引用块）与 meta.json 落到 voice-memos/<id>/。音频先在浏览器里重采样成 16 kHz 单声道再上传。转写全部本地完成——DSH 的 speechToText 服务（静音切窗补时间戳）或 faster-whisper 这类命令 worker；没有可用引擎时仍然归档，并写明状态与原因，绝不编造文本。带会话视图的「口述」Tab：点波形定位播放、逐段复制引用；另有三个 agent 工具（voice_memo_save / voice_memo_list / voice_memo_read）与 HTTP 路由。零运行时依赖，52 个 node:test 用例，docs/ 里有真实运行截图。

description.en: Qwen media tools: multimodal video and audio understanding, text-to-speech with preset voices, and scene audio generation, through Alibaba Cloud DashScope.
description.zh: Qwen 媒体工具：通过阿里云百炼提供多模态视频音频理解、带预置音色的语音合成，以及场景音频生成。

plugins.name: dsh-voice-talk

description.en: Voice conversation mode for the DSH Web GUI: tap the mic to start a full-screen call, talk hands-free, and hear each reply read aloud as it streams. Bilingual (Chinese/English) UI, light and dark themes, adjustable speech rate, and switchable voices.
description.zh: DSH Web 的语音对话模式：点一下麦克风进入全屏通话，边说边听，AI 回复边生成边朗读。界面中英双语，适配明暗主题，支持语速调节与音色切换。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip clones one, and community-trained models work too - and no 6.4 GB GPT-SoVITS install: the plugin installs its own runtime and voice. An existing GPT-SoVITS can be used instead, and it is the same voice model.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 用你喜欢的声音开口说话、汇报内容，过长的汇报先压缩再念。角色声线不需要自己训练：一段 3-10 秒参考音就能克隆，也能直接用别人训练好的模型；不必为此装一整套 6.4 GB 的 GPT-SoVITS —— 运行时和声线都由插件自己装好。已有 GPT-SoVITS 的话也能直接接上，两者跑的是同一套声线。

description.en: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a top-right card that jumps straight to the replying conversation.
description.zh: 多对话并行的声音提醒 + 对话直达：当前对话当/当当（crisp 清脆档），其他对话叮/叮叮（soft 柔和档）+ 右上角小卡片，点一下直达对应对话。

description.en: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.
description.zh: DSH Web 本地离线语音输入：麦克风经本地 FunASR（SenseVoiceSmall）识别后填入输入框，支持一键安装，全程离线。

description.en: Requires macOS and AirPods with head tracking. Answer DSH permission prompts and questions with AirPods head gestures — nod to allow or confirm, shake to reject or shift the selected option — and install the companion macOS menu-bar app from a card inside the session.
description.zh: 需 macOS 与支持头部追踪的 AirPods。戴着 AirPods 用点头/摇头回答 DSH 的权限许可与提问——点头＝允许或确认，摇头＝拒绝或切换选项；会话里一张卡片就能装好配套的 macOS 菜单栏 App。

description.en: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 对话结束语音播报（会话名、轮数、结果），回复生成时实时逐句朗读；内置 edge-tts，零第三方依赖。

description.en: Free voice closed loop for the Web UI: browser SpeechRecognition mic input with live interim results plus read-aloud speaker buttons and auto-read for assistant replies, zero configuration and no API key.
description.zh: Web UI 免费语音闭环：浏览器语音识别输入（实时中间结果上屏）+ 助手回复朗读与自动朗读，零配置、免 API key。

description.en: Adds two Volcengine Doubao cloud speech recognizers to the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker, optionally rewriting the transcript with an LLM.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入加入两个豆包云端识别器，可选再用大模型把口语顺成通顺的书面句子。

plugins.name: dsh-tts

description.en: Speaks agent replies in the DeepSeek Harness web UI through a provider fallback chain (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google, Azure, Groq, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Edge, Piper, eSpeak), so a failing or rate-limited provider falls through to the next instead of going silent.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 中朗读智能体回复，采用服务商回退链（OpenAI、ElevenLabs、Google、Azure、Groq、Deepgram、OpenRouter、Edge、Piper、eSpeak），某个服务商失败或被限流时自动切换到下一个，而不是直接静音。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-voice

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：按停顿分段的听写与语音消息，各自拥有独立的服务商回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Breeze TTS for DeepSeek Harness: read replies aloud in full or as a short summary, one-click Breeze CLI login with automatic key import, voice search and design, smart companionship, and lunch/dinner reminders.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Breeze 语音插件：可按全文或概要朗读回复，一键登录 Breeze CLI 并自动导入 Key，支持音色搜索与设计、智能陪伴，以及午饭/晚饭提醒。

description.en: Full-duplex voice mode for the Web UI: tap-to-toggle or hold-to-talk dictation (send key or `Ctrl`) with a live caption, host-side SenseVoice ASR via sherpa-onnx, sentence-by-sentence spoken replies, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). No API key.
description.zh: Web UI 全双工语音对话：点按切换或按住说话（发送键或 `Ctrl`）并显示实时字幕，宿主端 SenseVoice（sherpa-onnx）转写，回复按句流式朗读，开口说话即打断播放与正在运行的回合（真 barge-in），无需 API key。

description.en: Give the agent a talking face: seven tools that drive a self-hosted Mynah realtime digital human — speak (queued or interrupting), play a gesture clip, interrupt, list live sessions and channels, check health, add text to its knowledge base.
description.zh: 给 Agent 一张会说话的脸：七个工具驱动自托管的 Mynah 实时数字人——开口说话（排队或打断）、播放动作片段、打断、查看在线会话与频道、健康检查、往知识库加文本。

description.en: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls you back, volume boost, settings panel.
description.zh: 通知出口：agent 主动通过桌面通知 / 中文语音 / 音效（炸裂、胜利、警报）联系你，60 秒确认窗口后语音呼叫，音量增强，设置面板。

description.en: Local meeting transcription with microphone and system audio recording, speaker labels, and transcript export for DeepSeek Harness on Apple Silicon macOS.
description.zh: 为 Apple Silicon macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地会议转写、麦克风与系统音频录制、说话人标签及文本导出。

description.en: Listen to Ximalaya podcasts and audiobooks inside the DSH web UI: search albums, browse paginated tracks, and play through a now-playing bar (prev/play/next, seek, volume, rate). After QR login the "Mine" page lists your liked tracks (click to play), subscribed albums with latest-episode hints, and followed anchors with their public albums; the host relays audio streams with Range support and registers an `ximalaya_play` tool so the agent can search and play on request.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听喜马拉雅播客/有声书：搜索专辑、分页浏览曲目，播放条支持上下集/进度/音量/倍速；扫码登录后「我的」页可看收藏的声音（点击即播）、我的订阅（带最新一集提示）与关注的主播（含其公开专辑）；Host 端音频流代理支持 Range 拖动，并注册 `ximalaya_play` 模型工具让 agent 按需搜索播放。

description.en: Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.
description.zh: 语音输入、语音输出：把口述音频转写为用户消息（transcribe），让 agent 朗读回复（speak），本地优先，音频存于 ~/.dsh/voice。

plugins.name: qiaomu-audio-dsh

description.en: Read Markdown aloud, dictate and transcribe audio, and export narrated media from Harness.
description.zh: 在 Harness 中朗读 Markdown、听写和转写音频，并导出配音媒体。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.mp3dev.org

description.en: Hold-to-talk dictation in the composer that ships no recognizer of its own and reuses the speech service the official voice-input bundle already mounts - long-press the input box with mouse or touch, release to write the transcript into the draft, slide up to cancel, and it never sends.
description.zh: 输入框长按听写，不自带识别引擎，复用官方语音输入模块已挂载的语音服务——鼠标或触屏长按输入框，松开把文字写进草稿，上滑取消，不会自动发送。

plugins.name: dsh-live-voice

description.en: Consent-bound one-turn voice preview for DSH Web with a credential-free local synthetic demo, optional Qwen Audio, exact Session isolation, and explicit transcript-to-draft handoff without automatic submission.
description.zh: DSH Web 的会话绑定单轮语音预览：提供无需凭证的本地合成演示和可选的 Qwen Audio，保持精确会话隔离，并仅在明确操作后将转写写入草稿，不会自动提交。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Let DSH speak: every reply is rewritten into natural spoken language before being read aloud, with code, tables, and Markdown handled gracefully. Works out of the box with system TTS; Doubao (third-party API) adds dialects and expressive voices; the local Kokoro engine runs offline to keep content on your device. Supports both DSH desktop and dsh web. Optional session sounds tell you when the agent is working, finished, or waiting for your answer — with swappable built-in tones and support for your own audio.
description.zh: 让 DSH 开口说话：每轮回答先改写成自然口语再朗读，代码、表格与 Markdown 自动处理；系统 TTS 开箱即用，豆包（第三方 API）提供方言与情感演绎，本地 Kokoro 引擎离线运行、内容不出本机；支持 DSH 桌面版与 dsh web。另附工作／完成／提问三种会话状态提示音——会话在跑、跑完了、等你回答各有提示，音色可换、也能上传自己的音频。

description.en: Music composition inside the conversation: the model writes a score against a bundled composing skill, and a play_score tool renders it as an inline card with a piano roll, Web Audio playback and WAV/JSON export.
description.zh: 在对话里作曲：模型按内置作曲规范写出乐谱 JSON，play_score 工具校验后渲染成对话内的卡片，含卷帘图、Web Audio 实时播放与 WAV/JSON 导出。

description.en: Adds a terminology-aware correction pass to the built-in local speech-to-text: keeps DSH's own microphone and SenseVoice engine (audio never leaves the machine) and fixes homophones, domain terms and malformed numbers in the finished transcript.
description.zh: 给内置本地语音转写加一层术语纠错：沿用自带的麦克风与 SenseVoice 引擎（音频不出本机），在文字进入输入框前修正同音字、专业名词与数字写法。

description.en: Meeting notes for dsh: one meeting per conversation, transcribed and speaker-separated on the machine itself, with points, assignments, handwritten notes, reviews and monthly scores in the same panel. Exports SRT/Markdown/Word and packs a meeting into a portable zip another dsh can import; confirmed assignments go to DingTalk/WeCom in one click, following your robot settings. Recognition models are swappable (a stronger local model can be imported from a file), and cloud recognition is off by default with no request made before consent. Word export needs Python and python-docx; the first run downloads a recognition model (28 or 77 MB).
description.zh: 会议记录插件：一个会话对应一场会议，本机离线转写与发言人分离；要点、工作安排、手写笔记、复盘与月度评分都在面板里完成。可导出 SRT／Markdown／Word，也能打成「会议工程包」（zip）在另一台 dsh 导入；已确认的工作安排按设置一键推送到钉钉／企业微信。识别模型可更换（支持从本地文件导入更强的模型），云端识别默认关闭、未同意即零请求。导出 Word 需 Python 与 python-docx；首次使用会下载识别模型（28 MB 或 77 MB）。

description.en: Hands-free voice for DSH on Windows: local wake word, local Chinese speech-to-text inserted and sent into the composer, and spoken replies that can be interrupted and resumed. Requires a one-time run of the bundled install.ps1 (Python speech dependencies plus microphone pick) and a SenseVoice model already downloaded by the DSH voice input (or placed under models/sensevoice-onnx).
description.zh: Windows 上的免手语音：本地唤醒词、本地中文识别自动填入并发送、回答语音朗读，可打断与续播。需先运行仓库自带的 install.ps1（安装 Python 语音依赖并选定麦克风），并准备 SenseVoice 识别模型（跑一次 DSH 语音输入让它自动下载，或放到 models/sensevoice-onnx）。

description.en: Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.
description.zh: 让 Agent 弹一曲真钢琴：Salamander Grand 真实采样音色，Canvas2D 三角钢琴与沉浸式舞台渲染，88 键可弹。

description.en: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.
description.zh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

description.en: MiMo voice for DeepSeek Harness — reads each finished answer aloud, turns composer dictation into text, and offers nine built-in voices plus a cloned-voice slot.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的小米 MiMo 语音插件：把每段回答念出来、把输入框里的口述变成文字，带 9 个内置音色和一个克隆音色槽位。

plugins.name: dsh-voco

description.en: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供持续语音对话，支持免提监听、按住说话、语音识别、TTS 语音回复和后台 Agent 任务委派。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Plays the audio of a Bilibili video from a floating bar in the DSH Web UI, with a queue, seek and speed controls, and a host-side reverse proxy for the CDN Referer check.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面挂一个悬浮播放条，粘贴 BV 号或链接就能听 B 站视频的声音，带队列、进度与倍速，并由宿主反向代理绕开 CDN 的 Referer 校验。

description.en: Adds a voice to the agent: emotional speech synthesis (ChatTTS when available, falling back to edge-tts) and a singing mode, with mp3 output and local playback over ffplay. Requires Python 3.10+ with edge-tts installed (ChatTTS and its model cache are optional), ffmpeg/ffplay, and the pythonPath/ffmpegPath/ffplayPath values in cordis.patch.yml pointed at your own installs.
description.zh: 给 AI 加上声音：带情绪的语音合成（有 ChatTTS 用 ChatTTS，否则回退 edge-tts）和唱歌模式，生成 mp3 并可用 ffplay 本机播放。需本机安装 Python 3.10+ 与 edge-tts（ChatTTS 及其模型缓存可选）、ffmpeg/ffplay，并把 cordis.patch.yml 里的 pythonPath/ffmpegPath/ffplayPath 改成你自己的安装路径。

description.en: Local wake-word voice input for DSH. Say the wake word, wait for the chime, then speak; text is sent to a DSH session. Audio is processed locally by default and not stored. Requires the DSH speech input service (speechToText) to be available.
description.zh: DSH 本地语音唤醒。先说唤醒词，听到提示音后说内容，自动发进 DSH 会话；默认本地识别，音频不落盘。需要 DSH 语音输入服务（speechToText）可用。

description.en: Plays a voice line or a sound when a turn finishes and a failure cue when a tool call or a turn errors — user aborts stay silent by default and subagent sessions are skipped, both configurable. Three alert modes: voice, effects, or off. Effects is the default and ships 20 built-in sounds (10 alert chimes + 10 nature), each assignable to the done, fail or approval event with per-row preview, so it needs no API key and no audio files; the voice route uses Volcengine TTS with cloned or preset voices, batch-imported voice IDs and fingerprint reuse that skips re-synthesis when text, voice and parameters are unchanged. A third approval slot exists but has no automatic trigger — it only plays when called manually. Playback goes through winmm/waveOut as-is, never changing the system volume or mute state, and the player is spawned detached so session teardown cannot silence it. Windows only.
description.zh: 每个 turn 结束自动播报完成、出错时播失败提示（用户中断默认不播，子代理会话默认跳过，均可配置）。三种提醒方式：语音、音效、关闭。默认「音效」内置 20 个音效（提醒 10 + 大自然 10），每个音效可指定给完成/失败/审批事件并单独试听，零配置、不需要任何 API Key 与音频文件；语音走火山 TTS，支持克隆音色与预设音色、批量导入音色 ID，并按文案/音色/语速/音调/音量指纹复用已生成的 mp3，未变则不重复合成。第三个「审批」槽位没有自动触发源，只能手动播放。走 winmm/waveOut 原样播放，绝不改动系统音量或静音状态，播放进程独立拉起、DSH 会话销毁也杀不到声音。仅 Windows。

description.en: Read-aloud and dictation for the DSH web UI with 23 TTS and STT provider types configured side by side, per-language routing, in-text language markers, per-sentence language detection, word highlighting and a TTS Reader sidebar tab (the tab requires dsh-better-sidebar; everything else works without it).
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供朗读与听写：23 种 TTS 与 STT 提供商类型可并排配置，支持按语言路由、文内语言标记、逐句语言检测、逐词高亮，以及 TTS Reader 侧边栏标签页（该标签页需安装 dsh-better-sidebar，其余功能不装也可用）。

description.en: Connects a local Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro to the agent through its own Lua script API, with five tools for discovery, a persistent bridge, voice composition, note editing and DAW (VST3/ARA + MIDI) integration. Windows 10/11 only; requires Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ with a project open.
description.zh: 通过 Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 自带的 Lua 脚本 API 把它接入 Agent，提供自动发现、常驻桥、演唱创作、音符编辑与 DAW（VST3/ARA + MIDI）集成五个工具。仅 Windows 10/11；需安装 Synthesizer V Studio 2 Pro 2.1.2+ 并打开工程。

description.en: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.
description.zh: 豆包式语音对话插件：聊天框麦克风按钮（按住说话）语音转文字并自动发送，AI 回复自动朗读。可选 LLM 转述精简（长回复压缩成口语再播，跟随当前对话模型）、朗读前清洗 markdown/emoji/特殊符号、Edge TTS 多种音色、静音自动结束时长可调，设置嵌入 DSH 自带设置弹窗（voice chat 类目）。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud via Fish Audio API only (bring your own key): per-message read-aloud, auto-read toggle, and a settings page for model, voice reference_id, encrypted API key, and proxy.
description.zh: 朗读助手回复（仅支持 Fish Audio API，需自备 Key）：逐条朗读、自动朗读开关，设置页可配模型、音色 reference_id、加密 API Key 与代理。

description.en: Two-way voice for the DSH web app: dictate with the unified composer, hear replies with speaker buttons and auto-read, on any device. Needs DSH 0.1.7+, Node 22+, Python 3 with numpy and requests, a TTS model, and a microphone.
description.zh: DSH Web 的双向语音：用统一输入框听写、用朗读按钮与自动朗读听回复，任意设备可用。需 DSH 0.1.7+、Node 22+、Python 3（含 numpy 与 requests）、TTS 模型与麦克风。

description.en: Generative background music while the model streams, plus completion, approval and attention chimes: hear whether the agent is thinking, still working, or waiting for you without watching the screen.
description.zh: 模型输出时演奏生成式背景音乐，完成、审批与等待操作各有独立提示音：不盯屏幕也能听出 Agent 在思考、仍在工作还是在等你。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS voice for DeepSeek Harness: boots the engine with DSH and kills it on exit, speaks only the line marked for voice, and ships a default voice, so you only need to point runtimeDir at a local GPT-SoVITS install.
description.zh: 把本机 GPT-SoVITS 接进 DeepSeek Harness：随 DSH 启停引擎、只念该说出口的那一句；自带默认音色，只需填好本机 GPT-SoVITS 的 runtimeDir。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer that transcribes speech into the draft via the Web Speech API, with an optional auto-send toggle.
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：输入框一键麦克风按钮，基于 Web Speech API 语音转文字填入草稿，可选识别后自动发送。

description.en: Real-time speech-to-text inside the DeepSeek Harness composer: a live transcript while you speak, inserted at the caret when you stop, with a microphone picker. Local sherpa-onnx inference, so audio never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框里做实时语音转文字：边说话边显示识别结果，说完点完成自动插入光标处，可切换麦克风，本地 sherpa-onnx 推理、音频不出本机。

description.en: Voice input for the Web UI: a mic button that drives local VocoType offline speech recognition and auto-inserts recognized text into the composer (auto-deploy, dedupe, continuous dictation).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：输入框麦克风按钮驱动本地 VocoType 离线识别，识别结果自动插入输入框（自动部署/防重复/持续输入）。

description.en: Turns a streaming assistant reply into short blips, one per character at a configurable minimum spacing, for the reply text only, and keeps sounding when the window is minimized, covered, or in a background tab. Two built-in voices, or a custom one shaped by waveform, or loaded from an audio file.
description.zh: 把流式输出的助手回复变成短促音效：按可调的最小间隔逐字发声，只对回复正文发声，窗口最小化、被遮挡或切到后台标签页时照常发声。内置两种音色，也可自调波形，或载入音频文件当音色。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech for DSH: reads replies aloud, switches voices from the right sidebar, and trains a new voice from a dropped audio sample. First run downloads an 11.4 GB engine and needs an NVIDIA CUDA GPU.
description.zh: 基于 GPT-SoVITS 的本地语音合成：朗读 DSH 回复、在右侧边栏换音色，拖一段声音就能训练新音色。首次使用需下载约 11.4 GB 引擎，并要求 NVIDIA CUDA 显卡。

description.en: Breeze TTS client for DeepSeek Harness: connects to your own Breeze TTS server to read replies aloud and manage voice cloning (the server and its model must be deployed separately; hardware requirements are on the server side), with an optional cross-machine mode. Merges @dsh-external/dsh-plugin-local-ai-tts (abbccdd/dsh-localtts) and dsh-breeze-voices, carries code from 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts, and must not be installed alongside the two upstream plugins it merges.
description.zh: DSH 的 Breeze 语音客户端：连接你自己部署的 Breeze TTS 服务来朗读回复、管理音色克隆（服务与模型需单独部署，硬件门槛在服务端），另提供可选的跨机调用。本插件由 @dsh-external/dsh-plugin-local-ai-tts（abbccdd/dsh-localtts）与 dsh-breeze-voices 合并而来（含 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tts 的代码），不能与这两个上游同装。

plugins.name: dsh-xiaoai-bridge

description.en: Plugin that turns a XiaoAI (Xiaomi) smart speaker into a voice assistant: hosts the local bridge process, listens for the wake word, runs speech recognition (ASR / STT) on what you say, keeps the conversation in the host session, and speaks the answer back through the speaker with text-to-speech (TTS) playback.
description.zh: 把小爱音箱（小爱同学 / 小米智能音箱）接成语音助手的插件：托管本地桥接器进程，听到唤醒词就收音、做语音识别（ASR / STT），把对话交给 DSH 会话，再用语音合成（TTS）把答案念回音箱播报。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-voice-call

description.en: Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.
description.zh: agent 主动打来的语音电话：`offer_call` 向人类振铃（接听/拒接/稍后再说），接听后由本地 CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS 合成并播放（9 个音色，含 2 个中文方言）；拒接则把决定返回给 agent。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Voice input for the DSH web UI: tap or hold Alt to dictate into the composer. Local SenseVoice ASR by default — offline, zero config, zero key; auto-fallback to browser Web Speech, optional OpenAI-compatible ASR chain, polish through DSH-configured models, settings UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web UI 的语音输入插件：点按或按住 Alt 听写，结果落进输入框草稿。默认本地离线 SenseVoice（离线、零配置、零 key），自动回退浏览器 Web Speech，可选 OpenAI 兼容云端 ASR 服务链，可经 DSH 已配置模型润色，带设置页。

description.en: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入输出：麦克风语音转文字与文字转语音。

description.en: In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话内朗读：点一下即可朗读、暂停、继续 AI 回复，豆包 TTS 自然音色（BYOK），只读最终回答并过滤代码、表格与图形，本地引擎，插件零 Key。

description.en: Provides Xiaomi MiMo, Doubao, and browser-local TTS for DSH, with automatic read-aloud, custom voices, UI sound effects, desktop pet integration, and QQBot integration.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供小米 MiMo、豆包、浏览器本地 TTS 语音朗读；自动播报、自定义音色、UI 音效、桌宠联动、QQBot 联动。

description.en: Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 全双工语音对话：按钮或 Ctrl+Shift+V 进入，持续聆听（停顿自动发送）或按住说话，zipformer2 流式识别入可编辑草稿、可选唤醒词；回复按句 Edge TTS 朗读并显示实时字幕，开口即打断播放与回合（真 barge-in）；识别模型本地推理、Edge TTS 在线合成，无需 API Key。

description.en: Microphone voice input for the composer: browser Web Speech API live transcription, dedupe/auto-continue, smart punctuation, language and auto-send settings.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风语音输入：浏览器 Web Speech API 实时转写，自动去重/续听、智能标点，支持语言与自动发送设置。

description.en: Rings your phone over CallKit: `call_me` and `text_me` tools, plus optional turn-end and approval calls whose spoken answer is transcribed back into the session.
description.zh: 通过 CallKit 打电话到你的手机：`call_me` 与 `text_me` 工具，并可在回合结束或等待审批时来电，语音回答转写后送回会话。
