description.en: Bilibili music player for the DSH composer dock: import your Bilibili login cookie and a listening-profile JSON for profile-based recommendation with like/skip/dislike feedback and 192k playback; without a profile it falls back to genre-based online search and progressive playback.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框上方点播 B 站音乐：导入 B 站登录态与听歌画像 JSON 后按画像推荐，支持喜欢/跳过/不喜欢软反馈；没有画像时退回按风格词在线搜索，播放为边下边播。

description.en: The DSH app also doubles as a desktop pet: wake it with your voice, talk out loud, and give orders by speaking. Reach the DeepSeek Harness running on your own computer over LAN, your own domain, or a relay server — and chat with the little whale working in your project to put it to work. Travelling without your laptop is no longer a problem.
description.zh: DSH 的 App 端还融合了桌宠玩法：语音唤醒、随口说话、语音指挥。远程操作电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 有三种连法——局域网、自建域名、服务器中转；也能直接和工作在项目里的小鲸鱼聊天，一句话指挥它干活。出门在外，再也不用担心没带电脑。

description.en: Audio tools for DSH: inspect audio/video files, transcode or extract the audio track from a video, trim and normalize, and transcribe speech with local whisper.cpp or an OpenAI-compatible API. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH (not bundled); local transcription also needs a whisper-cli binary and a ggml model.
description.zh: DSH 音频工具：查看音频/视频信息、转码、从视频提取音轨、裁剪与响度归一化，并用本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口把语音转成文字和字幕。需要本机已装 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe（插件不自带）；本地转写还需 whisper-cli 与 ggml 模型。

description.en: Transcribe local audio and video files offline with a composer panel, a CLI, and an agent skill, powered by SenseVoice int8.
description.zh: 在输入框面板、命令行与 agent 技能里离线转写本地音视频文件，引擎为 SenseVoice int8。

description.en: Watch a video together with a text-only agent: with ffmpeg and the bundled browser extension reporting your real playback position (not a timer), it hands over one segment at a time just before that segment ends. It ships no TTS engine — it emits timed speech events, and speaking them aloud needs your own voice/TTS setup.
description.zh: 和只有文字的智能体一起看视频：需要 ffmpeg 和浏览器扩展上报真实播放位置（不是定时器），在每段结束前把画面和台词交到它手上。插件不带 TTS 引擎，只按时间轴发台词事件，要出声需自行配置语音/TTS。

description.en: Local English-to-Chinese simultaneous interpretation: on-device Qwen3-ASR bilingual captions with automatic language detection, crash-safe meeting records with minutes, and Obsidian export.
description.zh: 本机英译中同声传译：用 Qwen3-ASR 在本地识别中英文并生成双语字幕，同时存档会议记录、生成纪要与导出 Obsidian。

description.en: China-ready voice input for the composer. Requires a local Python bridge (pip install dashscope websockets, run bridge/voice-bridge.py) — the plugin alone does not work. Browser mic streams 16 kHz PCM to the bridge, which runs Alibaba Cloud DashScope ASR (paraformer-realtime-v2); interim text fills the draft at the cursor, silence auto-stop, optional auto-send.
description.zh: 国内可用的输入框语音输入。需要先启动本地 Python bridge（pip install dashscope websockets，运行 bridge/voice-bridge.py）——只装插件不可用。浏览器麦克风采集 16kHz PCM 流式转发给 bridge，由阿里云 DashScope ASR（paraformer-realtime-v2）识别；识别文字在光标处实时填入草稿，静音自动停止，可选识别后自动发送。

description.en: AI audio generation for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI — multi-vendor TTS, music, sound effects and voice design with a sidebar panel, model comparison, resource library and Agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 AI 音频插件 —— 多厂商 TTS、音乐、音效与音色设计，含侧边栏面板、模型对比、资源库与 Agent 工具。

description.en: Voice tools: free edge-tts neural speech synthesis, OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription, voice list, batch voice preview and health self-check.
description.zh: 语音五工具：edge-tts 免费微软神经语音合成、OpenAI 兼容 ASR 转写、音色清单、批量音色试听与健康自检。

description.en: Voice control for the DSH web composer: push-to-talk speech-to-text into the input box (with optional auto-send), spoken playback of assistant replies via the Web Speech API, right-click settings popover, and a global Ctrl+M hotkey.
description.zh: DSH 网页端语音控制：按住说话将语音转文字输入发送框（可自动发送），用浏览器语音合成朗读助手回复；右键麦克风打开设置面板，支持 Ctrl+M 全局快捷键。

description.en: Voice assistant for dsh web: say the wake phrase (e.g. "小鲸") to activate hands-free dictation — what you say is transcribed and typed into the chat box automatically. Supports spoken edit commands (send, clear, new line, stop reading) and reads assistant replies aloud in Chinese. Speech recognition runs locally in-browser via sherpa-onnx WASM, so it works offline without an API key.
description.zh: dsh web 语音助手：说出唤醒词（如「小鲸」）即可免手听写，说话内容自动转成文字填入输入框；支持口述编辑指令（发送、清空、换行、停止朗读），并可用中文朗读 AI 回复。语音识别基于 sherpa-onnx WASM 在浏览器本地运行，离线可用、无需 API Key。

description.en: Real-time duplex voice over Volcengine streaming ASR/TTS: agent reply narration, barge-in, wake word, live captions, 30 Chinese voices and a reply-first acknowledgment; builds in the DSH monorepo.
description.zh: 基于火山流式 ASR/TTS 的实时双工语音：回复朗读、打断、唤醒词、实时字幕、30 个中文音色与先响应后思考；在 DSH monorepo 内构建。

description.en: Real-time local TTS for DeepSeek Harness: voice presets, auto-read, engine setup assistant, a read-aloud button, and a settings panel for the GSV-TTS-Lite engine.
description.zh: 将本地高性能 TTS 引擎 GSV-TTS-Lite 实时接入 DeepSeek Harness：语音预设、自动朗读、引擎配置助手、朗读按钮与设置面板。

description.en: Click the chibi mascot and it reads the assistant reply aloud through your local IndexTTS 2.5 install. One character = one reference clip; a missing portrait just shows a placeholder. Ships no voices or artwork — the library lives on the user's own machine. Requires a local IndexTTS 2.5 install.
description.zh: 点一下 Q 版立绘挂件，就用本机 IndexTTS 2.5 把助手回复念出来。一个角色 = 一段参考音频，谁的声音都能当角色；没有立绘也能用，挂件会提示「本角色暂无图片，请添加」。不含任何音色与立绘，角色库在用户自己机器上。需要本地已装 IndexTTS 2.5。

description.en: Connects the Xiaozhi voice assistant to DSH Web over MCP: DSH is the tool provider, weaving 35 DSH Web endpoints into 16 voice-friendly tools for workspaces, sessions, chat, models, settings and files — outbound WebSocket to the Xiaozhi MCP access point by default (no public IP or port forwarding needed), several devices bound at once, plus a DSH settings page with live status.
description.zh: 把小智语音助手接入 DSH Web：DSH 作为 MCP 工具提供方，把 35 个 DSH Web 接口封装成 16 个语音友好工具，覆盖工作区、会话、对话、模型、设置与文件；默认出站 WebSocket 连到小智 MCP 接入点（无需公网 IP 和端口转发），可同时绑定多台设备，并自带实时刷新状态的 DSH 设置页。

description.en: Speaker button left of the model selector in the composer tool row — one click scrolls to the start of your newest question, marks it with a blinking caret and reads from there through the newest agent reply (dsh-tts, browser voice as fallback); press-and-hold the icon and then click anywhere on the page to pick another reading start position; press-and-drag-up opens a vertical mixer for in-page media volume and system output volume.
description.zh: 输入框工具行里、模型选择框左边的扬声器按钮——单击翻到「你最新提问的开头」并闪烁光标，从那里读到最新回复结尾（走 dsh-tts，回退浏览器语音）；按住图标后在页面上单击即可挑选任意朗读起点；按住上滑调出竖式混音台，分别控制页内媒体音量与系统输出音量。

description.en: One-handed, keyboard-free input for the composer: press and hold the mouse on the input box, speak, release — the text lands in the draft, and sliding up cancels without leaving a half sentence behind. No mic button to aim at and no shortcut to remember; the hand never has to leave the input area, which is the point when the other hand is busy. Recognition runs fully offline (SenseVoice via sherpa-onnx, no API key, audio never leaves the machine).
description.zh: 输入框上的单手、免键盘输入：鼠标在输入框按住、说话、松手，文字直接进草稿；上滑取消，不留半句。不用去瞄麦克风按钮，也不用记快捷键，手始终不用离开输入区——另一只手正忙的时候，这一点才是关键。识别完全在本机完成（SenseVoice + sherpa-onnx），无需 API key，音频不出本机。

description.en: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous results reported by voice.
description.zh: dsh 的对话式语音前端 Agent：通过 ByteDance Duplex 自然对话，把语音请求委派给后台任务，并用语音回报异步结果。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition backends, optional polish through dsh own LLM routes, and a native settings page.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的语音输入插件：输入框的麦克风按钮把语音转成草稿文本，支持多种语音识别后端，可选经 dsh 自有 LLM 路由润色，并带原生设置页。

description.en: Turn-end notification sound for DSH: built-in internet meme voices (ni gan ma ai yo, ji ni tai mei, shen ying ge, etc.), Settings panel with preview/switch/random, custom audio folder support.
description.zh: DSH 对话结束提示音：内置网络热梗原声（你干嘛哎呦、鸡你太美、神鹰哥等），设置面板可试听/切换/随机，支持自定义音频目录。

description.en: Per-reply read-aloud with a multi-provider settings page — MiniMax or any OpenAI-compatible /audio/speech endpoint, with voice, emotion, speed and model selection plus an auto-read toggle.
description.zh: 每条回复旁的朗读按钮与输入框自动朗读开关，设置页可选服务商与音色：MiniMax 或任意 OpenAI 兼容的 /audio/speech 端点，可调音色、情绪、语速与模型。

plugins.name: dsh-breeze-tts

description.en: BreezeBlue text-to-speech for DSH: three agent tools, a header toggle that reads assistant replies aloud (markdown and code blocks stripped), and local HTTP endpoints for audio playback, synthesis and long-poll delivery. Requires a BreezeBlue API key (BREEZE_API_KEY); synthesis is billed per character.
description.zh: 把 BreezeBlue 语音接入 DSH：三个工具、会话头开关自动朗读助手回复（自动剥离 Markdown 与代码块），并提供音频播放、合成与长轮询的本地 HTTP 接口。需配置 BreezeBlue API Key（BREEZE_API_KEY），合成按字符计费。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Semantic UI sound effects powered by uisfx: task start/success/failure and per-button cues, settings UI with instant preview, 12 sound packs, Host-persisted preferences, and `ctx.uisfx` service for other plugins.
description.zh: 基于 uisfx 的语义化 UI 音效：任务开始/成功/失败、不同按钮情景 cue，设置页即时试听，12 种音色包，Host 持久化，并提供 `ctx.uisfx` 服务给其他插件。

description.en: Local GPT-SoVITS text-to-speech that reads DeepSeek Harness assistant replies aloud, with a draggable mascot toggle and a one-click installer. Requires Python 3.10–3.12 preinstalled (the installer only locates it, it does not install Python); about 5 GB of disk and a GPU are recommended.
description.zh: 用本地 GPT-SoVITS 把 DeepSeek Harness 的助手回复读出来，带可拖动的挂件开关与一键部署。需预装 Python 3.10–3.12（安装器只负责定位，不负责安装）；建议约 5 GB 磁盘与 GPU。

description.en: Free lip-sync video generation plugin for DSH with 3000+ voices and 500+ languages.
description.zh: DSH 免费对口型口语视频生成插件，支持 3000+ 声音和 500+ 语言。

description.en: Full-duplex Chinese voice interaction for DSH Web: dictate and edit tasks, submit requests, manage sessions, answer DSH questions, and hear concise task-completion announcements.
description.zh: 基于全双工语音模型的 DSH 网页端中文语音交互：边听边说、随时插话，用语音输入和修改任务、提交请求、管理会话、回答 DSH 的问题，并简短播报任务完成结果。

description.en: Reads DSH conversations aloud using the DeepSeek web page's built-in read-aloud, driven by a small browser extension.
description.zh: 用 DeepSeek 网页端自带的朗读，把 DSH 里的对话念出来，靠一个小浏览器扩展驱动。

description.en: Subtitle-first video transcription with SRT export, cancellable job controls, and a faster-whisper large-v3 fallback when subtitles are unavailable.
description.zh: 字幕优先的视频转录，支持 SRT 导出与可取消任务控制；字幕不可用时回退到 faster-whisper `large-v3`。

description.en: Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop.
description.zh: 输入框麦克风：点击持续监控、按住对话；浏览器语音识别逐字上屏，回复由 host Edge TTS 边生成边朗读，朗读时暂停识别防回声，点击可停止。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices and highlights the sentence being spoken, so you can follow along while listening. The highlight is yours to style: background colour, text colour and opacity are each adjustable in settings. Also adds a sound-wave play button to every reply, pause plus previous and next sentence, adjustable speed, and an auto-read toggle.
description.zh: 用微软 Edge 神经音色朗读助手回复，并高亮当前正在朗读的那一句，可以边听边看。高亮样式完全自定义：底色、文字颜色、浓淡三样都能在设置里调。另外每条回复下方有音浪播放键、暂停与上句/下句跳转、语速调节和自动朗读开关。

description.en: GPT-SoVITS voice output for DSH: a speak tool and /voice command, a read-aloud speaker button under each reply, and a settings tab to switch voices, tune synthesis, manage the local service and one-click install a voice pack. Windows only; needs a local GPT-SoVITS checkout with trained weights and its Python environment.
description.zh: 把本机 GPT-SoVITS 音色接进 DSH：voice_speak 工具与 /voice 命令朗读，每条助手回复下方有喇叭按钮，设置页可切音色、调合成参数、管本地推理服务，并支持一键安装音色包。仅 Windows；需本机已有 GPT-SoVITS 仓库、训练好的权重与它的 Python 环境。

description.en: CapMap docs visualization with Obsidian-style semantic graph and capability panel.
description.zh: CapMap 文档体系可视化：Obsidian 风格语义图谱与能力面板。

description.en: Markdown sidebar preview and source editor for dsh-better-sidebar, with block- and text-range annotations that can be sent to the conversation as structured revision requests.
description.zh: 面向 dsh-better-sidebar 扩展的 Markdown 侧边栏预览与源码编辑器，支持块级和文本选区批注，并可将批注作为结构化修改请求发送到对话框。

plugins.name: qiaodoc-dsh

description.en: Derived from joeseesun/qiaomu-reader-dsh (not an official successor; do not install both - both use the qiaomu-reader plugin id): read documents beside native DSH chats, explain or translate selected passages, and return through document history. Development preview verified only on Windows with DSH 0.2.1-rc.5.
description.zh: 基于 joeseesun/qiaomu-reader-dsh 二次开发（并非上游官方后续版本；两者都用 qiaomu-reader 插件 id，不要同装）：在 DSH 原生对话旁阅读文档、解释翻译选段，并通过文档历史返回原会话。当前为开发试用版，仅验证 Windows + DSH 0.2.1-rc.5。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.ibm.com

description.en: Converts half-width punctuation in AI replies to full-width Chinese punctuation, so copied answers stay publication-ready.
description.zh: 将 AI 回答中的半角标点转换为中文全角标点，让复制的回答可直接用于公文材料。

description.en: Cite Lens for dsh: select text in a PDF in the Files tab to quote or ask about it in the current chat, and turn the model's \[main.pdf p.7 "exact words"] citations into links that open the PDF and highlight the passage; /cite-links makes a chat cite every claim.
description.zh: dsh 的 PDF 阅读：在文件选项卡里选中 PDF 中的文字，就能引用到当前对话或就它提问；把模型的引用变成链接，点开 PDF 并高亮被引用的那几句话；/cite-links 让一段对话为每条论断都附上引用。

description.en: Distills daily AI conversations (Doubao, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Kimi) into structured Markdown notes in your Obsidian vault.
description.zh: 把每天和各种 AI 的对话提炼成结构化 Markdown 笔记，写入你的 Obsidian 库。

description.en: Render Mermaid code fences in DSH Web chat messages as lazy-loaded SVG diagrams with strict sanitization and light/dark theme follow.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 会话消息中的 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为惰性加载的 SVG 图表，严格消毒并跟随明暗主题。

description.en: Translates PDFs with BabelDOC through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint while keeping the original layout, and returns both a bilingual and a translated-only PDF. Requires a one-time runtime setup and an OpenAI-compatible API key.
description.zh: 通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用 BabelDOC 翻译 PDF，保留原排版，输出双语对照版与纯译文版。需先运行一次运行时安装脚本，并配置 OpenAI 兼容接口的 API Key。

description.en: Preview Mermaid diagrams as images via local rendering in DSH Web when the chat message contains a Mermaid fenced code block, and also allow integration with external rendering servers.
description.zh: 当 DSH Web 中的消息包含 Mermaid 语法时，通过本地渲染以图像形式预览 Mermaid Diagrams，并允许接入外部渲染服务器。

description.en: PDF translation for DeepSeek Harness through a yiyide.cc connector account: 12 tools covering authorization, upload with page-level pre-flight, a three-page preview, quote, a confirmation that freezes translation points, job polling, quality confirmation, and download of the translated or bilingual PDF to the local machine.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里通过一译得连接器账号翻译 PDF：12 个工具覆盖授权、上传与页级预检、三页预览、报价、确认（冻结译点）、任务轮询、质量确认，以及把纯译文或双语对照 PDF 下载到本机。

description.en: Conversation rendering: every fenced block is rendered by the plugin itself (markdown for text fences, language-banner code blocks with highlight.js for others), mermaid fences become zoomable diagram cards, plus context-body rendering, whole-content copy and a MarkdownView export (npm: `dsh-md-render`).
description.zh: 对话渲染：围栏块由插件自身渲染（text 家族按 markdown，其余为真实语言名 banner + highlight.js 高亮的代码块），mermaid 块渲染为可缩放图表卡片，另支持上下文注入块渲染、整段复制与 MarkdownView 导出（npm: `dsh-md-render`）。

description.en: Typocket reads, edits and organizes local documents in DSH and previews workspace Markdown.
description.zh: Typocket 在 DSH 中阅读、编辑和整理本机文档，并预览工作区 Markdown。

plugins.name: dsh-101

description.en: Document reading mode for DSH.
description.zh: DSH 文档阅读模式。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Native right-sidebar Markdown preview with Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, GFM tables and syntax highlighting — rendering engine bundled, fully offline.
description.zh: 在 DSH 原生右侧文件预览中渲染 Mermaid 图表、KaTeX 公式、GFM 表格与代码高亮，渲染引擎随包内置，完全离线。

description.en: Obsidian-style Markdown workbench for DSH: browse, edit, preview, create, move, and delete notes inside the selected local vault.
description.zh: DSH 内的 Obsidian 风格 Markdown 工作台：浏览、编辑、预览、创建、移动和删除所选本地仓库中的笔记。

description.en: Consistency guard for long-form writing: scans conversation prose for character, timeline and numeric setting conflicts across chapters, then jumps straight to the conflicting message.
description.zh: 长文创作一致性守卫：扫描会话正文，发现人物年龄、等级、境界、年份等设定跨章节矛盾，点击直接跳转到冲突原文位置。

description.en: Document review workbench: select text in a Markdown file, leave comments saved as MRSF sidecar files next to it, and let the agent read them with doc_review_* tools and propose edits you accept or reject.
description.zh: 文档批注台：在 Markdown 文档上划词写批注，批注按 MRSF 侧车文件存在文档旁，Agent 用 doc_review_* 工具读取并登记改动提案，你在批注页逐条接受或拒绝。

description.en: Serve any local file in DSH web sessions - /ws/<absolute-path> maps disk files to same-origin http URLs that session markdown can render. Any drive, no staging directory.
description.zh: 让会话 markdown 直接渲染本地任意位置的图片与文件：/ws/<本地绝对路径> 同源路由，跨盘符、中文路径、深层嵌套与 UNC 均可，无需先复制到特定目录。

description.en: Compiles a repository into a source-grounded code map: structured pages where every claim carries a verifiable path:line citation, an interactive dependency graph, knowledge cards, four model tools and the /codemap command. Deterministic, no model calls, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 把代码仓库编译成带 path:line 源码引用的代码地图：结构化页面、可拖拽依赖图谱、知识卡片、四个模型工具与 /codemap 命令。确定性生成、不调用模型、零第三方依赖。

description.en: Write, check, and publish a Chinese Quarto Book: nine-step chapter writing, structure/link/figure checks, a consistent theme, and render acceptance. Loads only in type: book repositories; requires Quarto CLI and Python 3.
description.zh: 把一份 Quarto Book 写成可读、可查、可发布的中文技术书：九步章节写作、结构/链接/图表检查、统一主题与渲染验收。仅在 type: book 仓库加载；需 Quarto CLI 与 Python 3。

description.en: Turns Zhejiang University classroom replays (classroom.zju.edu.cn) into Markdown study notes plus a matching PDF typeset locally with Typst. Transcripts are public; slide capture is opt-in and needs a ZJU login. Scraping core: nzw806/zju-lecture-summerizer-. Optional fill-in notes use the MIT-licensed scholia Typst template.
description.zh: 把浙大智云课堂（classroom.zju.edu.cn）回放整理成 Markdown 复习讲义，并在本地用 Typst 排成同名 PDF。字幕公开免登录；投影截图需在插件设置中开启，且需浙大登录态。抓取内核来自 nzw806/zju-lecture-summerizer-；可选填空笔记用 MIT 授权的 scholia 模板。

description.en: Turn DeepSeek Harness sessions into daily, weekly, handoff and article reports, with a verifiable HTML export and a receipt that re-checks the saved file.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话整理成日报、周报、交接与文章稿件，支持可核验的 HTML 导出与复核收据。

plugins.name: PTT-Studio

description.en: Design-first PowerPoint builder: six pptx_* tools turn a deck.json design draft into an editable .pptx with AI backgrounds, cutout illustrations and decoration pieces, run layout and contrast checks, render slide previews, and review pages with a configurable vision model; chat cards and a settings page in the Web UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+ (pptx_render uses its bundled LibreOffice Kit) and an Agnes or ModelScope API key for image generation.
description.zh: 设计型 PPT 生成：六个 pptx_* 工具把逐页设计稿（deck.json）组装成可编辑 .pptx，配合 AI 背景、去底插画与装饰件，做版式与对比度检查、渲染页面预览，并可用可配置的视觉模型逐页评审；Web 端提供聊天卡片与设置页。需 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2+（pptx_render 使用其内置 LibreOffice Kit），AI 背景需 Agnes 或 ModelScope API Key。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：Agent 通过办公软件的自动化接口，直接在你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint（微软 Office 或 WPS Office）窗口里改文档，改动实时出现，你可以同时编辑；可读取结构、批量修改、把页面渲染成图片核对排版、保存或导出 PDF。

description.en: Windows PDF translator for DeepSeek Harness: a vision model locates and translates text, tables, figures and formulas; output is a Chinese PDF and a LaTeX source zip. Requires a vision-capable OpenAI-compatible API.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows PDF 翻译插件：由视觉模型识别并翻译正文、表格、图表和公式，输出中文 PDF 与 LaTeX 源码压缩包。需要自备支持图片输入的 OpenAI 兼容 API。

plugins.name: dsh-openwiki

description.en: Brings the codebase knowledge-base capability of langchain-ai/openwiki into DSH — one-click generate/read/update of the repository Wiki, Grounded Claims (source-traced knowledge cards) and a project knowledge base built from uploaded local files, reusing the model DSH already has configured, with no second API key.
description.zh: 把 langchain-ai/openwiki 的代码库知识库能力搬进 dsh —— 一键生成 / 阅读 / 更新仓库 Wiki 与 Grounded Claims（溯源知识卡片）与项目知识库（上传本地文件），直接复用 DSH 已配置的模型，无需二次填 Key。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Document intake for agents: doc_route sniffs a file's real format by magic bytes and measures a PDF's text layer and page column layout before any conversion, and pdf_markdown converts PDFs to Markdown in column reading order with PyMuPDF. The PDF path needs a Python 3 interpreter with PyMuPDF.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的文档入口：doc_route 先按魔数嗅探真实格式，并测量 PDF 的文本层与分栏版面，再给出该走的提取管线；pdf_markdown 用 PyMuPDF 按分栏阅读顺序把 PDF 转成 Markdown。PDF 路径需要带 PyMuPDF 的 Python 3 解释器。

description.en: Create, read, and edit PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, and PDF via the local zagens-office CLI as office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read tools.
description.zh: 通过本机 zagens-office CLI 读写编辑 PPTX / DOCX / XLSX / PDF，注册为 office_schema / office_write / office_edit / office_read。

description.en: Generates release material from what a local repository can actually support: a hero image, a feature grid and bilingual copy rendered as SVG and HTML from `README.md`, `package.json` and optional screenshots. Facts are quoted from those files — name, version, license, summary, features, install snippet — and a field that is missing is left unrendered rather than filled with placeholder text. Every feature carries a source citation such as `README.md#L42`, and a claim the repository cannot substantiate is linted out before anything is written, with the reasoning left in `lint-report.json`. `manifest.json` records a sha256 for each input and output, and `--now` or `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` makes a run byte-identical. Also ships a GUI panel that regenerates from inside a session.
description.zh: 从本地仓库真实支持的产物生成发布素材：hero 图、特性网格与中英双语文案，由 `README.md`、`package.json` 和可选截图渲染成 SVG 与 HTML。事实全部从这些文件引用——项目名、版本、license、一句话简介、特性列表、安装片段——缺失的字段直接不渲染，不补占位文案。每条特性带 `README.md#L42` 这样的来源标注；无法被本仓库证实的说法在写出之前就被 lint 掉，理由留在 `lint-report.json`。`manifest.json` 记录每个输入与输出文件的 sha256，`--now` 或 `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH` 可让整次输出字节一致。另含一个可以在会话里重新生成的 GUI 面板。

description.en: Turns a plugin repository's existing screenshots into a 6-second silent looping hero reel: a VP9 webm that keeps real alpha, a matted gif, and a cover frame, plus a manifest with per-scene holds and sha256s. The timeline is exact by construction (integer holds plus transitions sum to durationMs, and the last scene transitions back into the first so t=0 equals t=duration). Zero runtime dependencies: PNG decode/encode on node:zlib, an SDF card compositor, and ffmpeg as the only external binary, discovered at runtime. Ships a conversation-view panel (pick, reorder, generate, copy the README markdown) and a CLI with a storyboard.json contract.
description.zh: 把插件仓库里已有的截图排成一条 6 秒无声循环首屏短片：VP9 webm（保留真 alpha）、压平垫底的 gif、封面帧，外加记录每幕停留与 sha256 的清单。时间轴按构造即精确（整数停留 + 转场之和等于 durationMs，最后一幕转场回第一幕，t=0 与 t=结束同一帧）。零运行时依赖：PNG 编解码基于 node:zlib，自写 SDF 卡片合成器，唯一外部程序是运行时发现的 ffmpeg。带对话视图面板（选图、排序、生成、复制 README Markdown）与一条接受 storyboard.json 的 CLI。

description.en: Structure-level watermark removal for PDF and Word: finds full-page Form XObject overlays drawn on every page and text blocks matching a watermark vocabulary, lists them by confidence, then excises only the drawing operators or runs — the text layer, embedded images and their resolution are not re-rendered or altered.
description.zh: 面向 PDF 与 Word 的结构级去水印：识别每页都会绘制的整页 Form XObject 图层水印，以及命中水印词表的文字块，按置信度列出候选后仅摘除对应的绘制指令或 run——正文文字层、内嵌图片与其分辨率均不重绘、不改动。

description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness a real office environment. Univer Office Plugin brings spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvases, relational tables, and more into one runtime — with connected data, validation, versioned changes, and isolated worktrees for multi-agent collaboration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造一个真正的办公环境。Univer Office 插件将电子表格、文档、幻灯片、画布、多维表格等汇聚到同一个运行时——数据互联、修改经过校验、变更按版本管理，并以隔离工作树支持多 Agent 协作。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .docx files: headings from the style map, paragraphs, lists, real table cells, inline pictures and header notes. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and rendered blocks keep a document from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .docx 阅读视图：按样式表识别标题，还原段落、列表、真实表格单元格、内嵌图片与页眉注释。归档体积、单部件解压字节与渲染块数均有上限，文档不会卡死标签页。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reader for CSV/TSV/PSV files and xlsx/xlsm workbooks: a sortable, filterable table with sheet tabs. Ceilings on rows, columns and cells, plus two zip-container gates, keep an input from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的表格读取视图：读取 CSV/TSV/PSV 与 xlsx/xlsm 工作簿，表头可点击排序、可按子串筛选，多工作表以标签切换。行数、列数与单元格数均有上限，另有两道 zip 容器闸门，任何输入都不会卡死标签页。

plugins.name: dsh-pptx-sidebar

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar reading view for .pptx decks: slides in deck order, bullet levels, speaker notes and inline pictures. Ceilings on archive size, per-part inflated bytes and slide count keep a deck from freezing the tab.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 的 .pptx 阅读视图：按演示顺序列出幻灯片，还原项目符号层级、演讲者备注与内嵌图片。归档体积、单部件解压字节与幻灯片数量均有上限，演示文稿不会卡死标签页。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Analyze a codebase and generate architecture documentation: module responsibilities, dependencies, entry points and run methods.
description.zh: 分析代码库并生成架构文档：模块职责、依赖关系、入口点与运行方式。

description.en: Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.
description.zh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Notes workspace in the right sidebar: a notes tree beside a live-preview Markdown editor with tabs, split panes, outline and trash, over plain .md files and a thin per-workspace index. Agents organize it through one `knowledge` tool; `embed` fences render an interactive HTML page in a sandboxed iframe (scripts run, no network).
description.zh: 右侧栏的笔记工作区：笔记树 + 实时预览的 Markdown 编辑器（标签 / 分屏 / 大纲 / 回收站），笔记是普通 .md 文件，索引是按工作区的薄映射，Agent 侧只用一个 `knowledge` 工具整理；`embed` 围栏把可交互网页演示嵌进笔记（沙箱 iframe，脚本可跑、断网、拿不到宿主）。

description.en: A workspace-based Studio for source-grounded reports, slides, tables, mind maps, quizzes, flashcards, audio and video, using DSH models and shared artifact services. Office generation requires Python 3.12+ with its dependencies and DSH_OFFICE_PYTHON configured; media rendering requires Chromium, and local ASR additionally requires whisper.cpp and a model.
description.zh: 基于工作区资料的 Studio，复用 DSH 模型与共享成果服务，制作报告、演示文稿、表格、思维导图、测验、闪卡及音视频。Office 生成需 Python 3.12+ 及相关依赖，并配置 DSH_OFFICE_PYTHON；媒体渲染需 Chromium；本地语音转写另需 whisper.cpp 和模型。

description.en: Document workspace that turns equipment manuals and past reports into proposals, research reports and bid files, then exports Markdown, Word, HTML, PDF and PPTX. Word/PPTX export and document parsing need Python 3 with pypdf, python-docx and python-pptx (installed from Settings), and PDF export needs Chrome or Edge at the standard Windows paths.
description.zh: 文档工坊：把设备说明书与历史报告变成技术方案、调研报告和投标文件，支持导出 Markdown / Word / HTML / PDF / PPTX。Word / PPTX 导出与文档解析需要 Python 3 及 pypdf、python-docx、python-pptx（在设置页初始化），PDF 导出需要标准 Windows 路径下的 Chrome 或 Edge。

description.en: Lets the agent see the compiled page: renders any page to an image, resolves a PDF point or a text anchor to the exact source line through SyncTeX (and says when a rule is drawn by a package rather than by the body, which is where naive locating is wrong), diffs a page against the previous build so an edit is visible, audits every page for holes the edit introduced, and checks that numbered labels still read in order.
description.zh: 让 Agent 真正看见编译后的页面：把任意一页渲染成图片，用 SyncTeX 把页面坐标或文字锚点解析成源码 file:line（并指出某条横线是宏包画的而不是正文画的——这正是朴素定位最容易出错的地方），把这一页与上一次构建做像素对比，逐页审计本次修改新引入的空洞，并检查图表编号是否仍然顺序正确。

description.en: LaTeX and BibTeX guardrails for DeepSeek Harness: compile checks with automatic xelatex/lualatex detection, BibTeX entry deduplication and field filling from Crossref, and \cite key audits against the .bib file.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 LaTeX 与 BibTeX 检查工具：编译检查（自动识别 xelatex/lualatex），基于 Crossref 的 BibTeX 条目去重与字段补全，以及 \cite 键与 .bib 文件的一致性审计。

description.en: Connect multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP for browsing, analysis, and Git-based file updates.
description.zh: 通过 OverleafMCP 将多个 Overleaf 项目接入 DSH，支持浏览、分析和通过 Git 写回 LaTeX 文件。

description.en: Renders a conversation's context as a layered architecture map of goals, decisions, actions, artifacts, risks and open questions, exported as SVG, interactive HTML and Mermaid Markdown.
description.zh: 把对话上下文分层渲染成信息架构图：目标、决策、动作、产物、风险与待确认一次成图，可导出 SVG、交互式 HTML 与 Mermaid Markdown。

description.en: Mermaid diagram renderer for the Web UI conversation: renders mermaid code blocks into interactive cards (zoom, fit-width, fullscreen viewer, preview/code toggle) with official UI primitives, and keeps the original code block with an inline error banner when rendering fails.
description.zh: Web UI 对话 mermaid 渲染插件：将消息中的 mermaid 代码块渲染为可交互图表卡片（缩放 / 适应宽度 / 全屏查看 / 预览代码切换），复用官方组件原语，渲染失败时保留原代码块并内联展示错误。

description.en: Paper reading workbench: library + PDF reader + tutor-style companion. Answers cite clickable page numbers that jump back and flash the exact passage; select-to-ask without leaving the paper; bundled strict-tutor preset (reading plan, section coaching, graded quizzes tracked across sessions). With MinerU configured (self-hosted, no signup / mineru.net cloud token): scanned PDFs become readable, formulas become click-citable (one click sends the LaTeX source into the chat) and searchable (QK^T hits directly), plus a per-page formula panel; optional embeddings endpoint adds semantic recall for plain-language questions. Rename/delete topics and papers — deletes go to a recoverable .trash with a batch-clear flow for non-empty topics; reader with scroll/single-page modes, rightbar-fullscreen safe, one-click path copy and translated-PDF export; in-place original ↔ Chinese toggle (babeldoc, zero preinstall). Transcription and search run locally by default — documents never leave your machine; only when cloud MinerU, an embeddings endpoint, or a translation endpoint is enabled does the corresponding text go to the service you configure.
description.zh: 论文伴读工作台：文献库 + PDF 阅读器 + 教练式伴读。回答必带页码，点页码跳回 PDF 并高亮闪烁对应原文；选中即问不打断阅读；自带「严格师傅」preset——定阅读计划、逐节带读、出题批改，成绩跨会话累积；配置 MinerU（本地自建免注册 / mineru.net 云端 token 二选一）后：扫描版 PDF 可读可伴读、公式可点引用（点一下即得 LaTeX 源码进对话）、公式可检索（QK^T 直接命中），∑ 面板按页浏览全文公式；可选嵌入端点语义召回，大白话提问命中术语段落。文献库专题/论文改名删除——删除走 .trash 回收站可恢复、非空专题批量清空一次确认；阅读器滚动 ↔ 单页翻页双模式、右栏全屏可用、PDF 路径一键复制、译文 PDF 一键导出；原文 ↔ 纯中文原地切换（babeldoc 零预装）。默认本地转录检索，文档不出本机；仅当启用云端 MinerU、嵌入端点或翻译端点时，对应文本才会发往你配置的服务。

description.en: Renders mermaid fences in dsh web chat as SVG diagrams by default, with cursor-anchored smooth zoom and pan, a per-fence diagram/code toggle persisted in localStorage, dark-mode follow, and a bundled offline engine.
description.zh: 将 dsh Web 对话中的 mermaid 代码围栏默认渲染为 SVG 图表，支持以指针为锚点的丝滑缩放拖拽、按围栏记忆的图/文案切换（localStorage 持久化）、明暗主题跟随，以及完全本地打包的离线渲染引擎。

description.en: In-chat preview for produced files: click a produced-file chip to render Markdown (server-side markdown-it + highlight.js), images, or plain text right in the conversation; system-app open and reveal-in-folder stay one click away.
description.zh: 产物文件聊天内预览：点击产物 chip 直接在对话中渲染 Markdown（宿主侧 markdown-it + highlight.js 代码高亮）、图片或纯文本，系统应用打开与在文件夹中显示仍一键可达。

plugins.name: dsh-overleaf

description.en: Embeds an Overleaf site (overleaf.com or a self-hosted instance) into a conversation tab through a same-origin reverse proxy, with cookie or popup login, selection quoting, caret insertion, compile-log driven fixes, outline navigation, and .bib / .tex synchronization.
description.zh: 把 Overleaf 站点（公有云或自托管实例）经同源反向代理嵌入会话页标签，支持 Cookie 或弹窗登录、选区引用、光标处插入、编译日志驱动的修复、文档大纲跳转与 .bib / .tex 双向同步。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-office-kit

description.en: Creates, reads, and edits DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX through `/documents`, `/pdf`, `/presentations`, and `/spreadsheets`; renders pages to check layout, and turns selections in the sidebar preview into edit requests for the session. Python 3.10-3.13 required.
description.zh: 通过 `/documents`、`/pdf`、`/presentations`、`/spreadsheets` 创建、读取与编辑 DOCX、PDF、PPTX、XLSX，把页面渲染出来核对排版，并将侧边栏预览中的选区变成发给会话的修改要求。需 Python 3.10–3.13。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

plugins.name: dsh-diagram

description.en: Turns an article in the DSH conversation into an Excalidraw canvas in a session tab: the Agent drafts the structure with diagram_create, you edit labels, nodes and layout with autosave, export PNG, SVG or .excalidraw, and the Agent reads your edited canvas back with diagram_read. 0.6 adds an editable classification overview plus a complete detail index for large three-level trees.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话中的文章整理成会话内的 Excalidraw 画布：Agent 用 diagram_create 起草结构，你在画布中修改文字、节点和布局并自动保存，可导出 PNG、SVG 或 .excalidraw，Agent 再用 diagram_read 读回你改过的画布。0.6 新增大型三层分类树的可编辑总览与完整明细索引。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to docs.excalidraw.com

description.en: Turns up to 30 uploaded PDF papers into prompt-driven literature reviews, key findings, research ideas and study designs, exported as page-cited reports (DOCX/PDF) or slide decks (PPTX/PDF).
description.zh: 把最多 30 篇上传的 PDF 文献变成提示词驱动的文献综述、关键信息提取、研究思路与研究设计，并导出带页码引用的报告（DOCX/PDF）或演示文稿（PPTX/PDF）。

description.en: Bundles a deep-read paper library and the paper-deepread-html skill: a sidebar panel to browse interactive reading reports, upload PDFs into a managed library, deep-read them with an agent (or through an optional site auto-read worker), and manage or rebuild the library; ships the paper_deepread, paper_deepread_uploads and paper_deepread_reports model tools. Deep-read/ingest and report builds require Python 3 (the bundled skill prepares a PyMuPDF venv on first use; index rebuild falls back to plain python3).
description.zh: 把文献精读库与 paper-deepread-html 精读技能打包成 dsh 插件：侧边栏浏览交互式报告、上传 PDF 到托管书库、由 Agent 或可选接入的站点自动精读 worker 精读、管理或重建书库；提供 paper_deepread、paper_deepread_uploads、paper_deepread_reports 三个模型工具。精读摄取与成稿需要 Python 3（内置技能首次会准备 PyMuPDF 解释器；重建索引会退化为纯 python3）。

description.en: Overlay reader for agent output files: Markdown rendering, in-panel PDF, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX text preview and reply-end file chips, with search, outline and position memory.
description.zh: agent 产出文件的浮层阅读器：Markdown 渲染、PDF 面板预览、DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 文本提取与回复末尾文件 chips，支持搜索、大纲与位置记忆。

description.en: Search, read and write an Outline knowledge base from conversations, with whitelist-guarded approval for every document write.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中搜索、读取并安全读写用户自己的 Outline 知识库文档，写操作受白名单保护与审批约束。

plugins.name: blog-manage

description.en: Manage a GitHub Pages blog from a DSH panel — browse the Markdown articles grouped by tag, edit them in a split editor with a front-matter form, and publish the changes as one commit over the GitHub REST API.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里管理 GitHub Pages 博客：按标签分组浏览 Markdown 文章，用表单填 front matter 并在分屏编辑器里修改，再通过 GitHub REST API 把改动作为一次 commit 发布。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-mineru

description.en: Expose MineRU document parsing tools to the model.
description.zh: 向模型暴露 MineRU 文档解析工具。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to your-mineru-host:18000

plugins.name: dsh-ima

description.en: Browse Tencent ima knowledge bases in a DSH sidebar panel, preview PDF, Office, note and media files inline, and let the agent search and read them through five tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏浏览腾讯 ima 的知识库与文件，内置常见格式预览，并让 agent 用 5 个工具按名称或正文检索、读取库内资料。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to docs.oasis-open.org

description.en: Provides a structured, per-session resume editor for DeepSeek Harness with shared chat and sidebar edits, A4 preview, and PDF export.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化简历编辑器；每个会话独立保存草稿，对话与侧栏共用内容，并提供 A4 预览和 PDF 导出。

description.en: AI-native text editor for DeepSeek Harness: tabs, encoding-safe saves, selection/document AI with diff review, Markdown preview, and Windows file associations.
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 原生文本编辑器：多标签、编码保留、选区/全文 AI 与 Diff 审阅、Markdown 预览及 Windows 文件关联。

description.en: Publish an HTML document as a shareable link that opens in one tap and previews as a card in chat apps; publish, update, and export to PNG/PDF/Word.
description.zh: 把 HTML 文档变成一键打开、在聊天里显示预览卡的分享链接;支持发布、更新,以及导出 PNG/PDF/Word。

description.en: Bounded, cell-addressed `doc_read`/`doc_write` for xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb, plus an MCP server and CLI.
description.zh: doc_read/doc_write：以有界、单元格寻址的方式读写 xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb，另附 MCP 服务器与 CLI。

description.en: Bridge to the local doc2md (markdown_monitor) CLI — one doc2md tool with convert, read, scan and status actions over docx, doc, xls, xlsx, pdf and image files.
description.zh: 桥接本机 doc2md（markdown_monitor）命令行——一个 doc2md 工具，提供 convert / read / scan / status 四个动作，支持 docx、doc、xls、xlsx、pdf 与图片。

description.en: Tools over the local jetformat CLI: convert DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX to PDF, extract text, validate files, and inspect, merge, extract pages from, or render PDFs. Requires the jetformat CLI.
description.zh: 基于本地 jetformat CLI 的工具：将 DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 转为 PDF，提取文本，校验文件，以及查看、合并、抽页或渲染 PDF。需要安装 jetformat CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-code-server-app

description.en: Package and install code-server (the web version of VSCode) as a plugin within dsh to quickly achieve professional file editing.
description.zh: 将code-server（VSCode网页版）打包安装到dsh内的插件，快速实现专业的文件编辑。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Format Markdown with publishing themes, preview the result, and export HTML or long images.
description.zh: 使用发布主题排版 Markdown，预览效果并导出 HTML 或长图。

plugins.name: qiaomu-reader-dsh

description.en: Read EPUB, PDF, TXT, Markdown, and HTML with reading notes, a vocabulary list, and native Harness AI companion reading.
description.zh: 在 Harness 中阅读 EPUB、PDF、TXT、Markdown 和 HTML，整理阅读笔记与生词，并使用原生 AI 伴读。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.ibm.com

description.en: Browse UI design references and interaction examples, take design quizzes, and export learning notes as Markdown.
description.zh: 浏览界面设计参考和交互标本，练习设计测验，并导出 Markdown 学习笔记。

description.en: PDF electronic signing: generate a handwritten-style signature image, stamp images and typed blocks onto PDF pages, and apply a PKCS#7/CMS digital signature with a PKCS#12 certificate you supply. Stamping first keys an opaque background out to transparency - un-compositing each pixel so the ink keeps its original colour - and trims to the ink, so a seal stamped over a signature does not erase it.
description.zh: PDF 电子签名：生成手写风格签名图、在 PDF 页面盖章（图片与文字块）、并用自备的 PKCS#12 证书施加 PKCS#7/CMS 数字签名。盖章前会先把不透明签名图/印章图的底色转为透明（通过反合成保留墨色）并裁掉留白，因此印章盖在签名上不会把签名擦掉。

description.en: Builds a per-project code wiki: README summary, docs tree, tech stack, git activity and language composition, cached locally and exportable as Markdown.
description.zh: 项目 Wiki 生成器：聚合 README 摘要、docs 树、技术栈、git 活跃度与语言构成，本地缓存并可导出 Markdown。

description.en: Read official DSH docs in the Plugins page; Creator mode searches docs and checks plugin npm metadata with native tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页阅读官方文档；创造模式用原生工具检索文档、查询插件 npm 元数据。

description.en: Makes the AI default to Mermaid diagrams in development conversations — system prompt guidance, a mermaid_validate syntax-check tool with real-parser validation, and an output gate that auto-fixes or removes broken diagrams. Rendering via dsh-mermaid.
description.zh: 让 AI 在开发交流中默认用 Mermaid 图表达——系统提示引导、mermaid_validate 真解析语法校验工具，以及自动修复或摘除坏图的输出闸。渲染交给 dsh-mermaid。

description.en: Workspace-safe Office tools for agents: create/read Word, create/read/update Excel, and create/read PowerPoint decks with PNG/JPG/GIF image placement.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的工作区安全 Office 工具集：创建/读取 Word、创建/读取/更新 Excel、创建/读取 PowerPoint，并支持 PNG/JPG/GIF 图片排版。

plugins.name: dsh-mineru

description.en: Parse PDFs and documents into structured Markdown with MinerU. Uploads files to the MinerU cloud; no offline mode.
description.zh: 用 MinerU 把 PDF 与文档解析为结构化 Markdown。文件会上传到 MinerU 云端，无离线模式。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds right-sidebar document previews for STL, OBJ, PLY, glTF and GLB models, zip/tar/gzip archives, audio and video, fonts, subtitles, TOML, Intel HEX, JCAMP-DX spectra, VCD waveforms, KiCad schematics and boards, and DFU firmware images.
description.zh: 在右侧栏文档预览中打开 STL、OBJ、PLY、glTF 与 GLB 模型，zip/tar/gzip 压缩包，音视频、字体、字幕，以及 TOML、Intel HEX、JCAMP-DX 谱图、VCD 波形、KiCad 原理图和电路板、DFU 固件。

description.en: Render Markdown to a standalone, self-contained HTML page: an `md_html_render` tool that works in a headless profile, plus a web drawer to browse, preview, edit and export local `.md` files; both share one renderer, with no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把 Markdown 渲染为自包含的独立 HTML 页面：提供在 headless 配置下同样可用的 `md_html_render` 工具，以及在网页端浏览、预览、编辑并导出本地 `.md` 文件的抽屉；两个入口共用同一个渲染器，无运行时依赖。

description.en: Read-only JSONL and NDJSON viewer with a byte index, record navigation, and streaming previews for large records. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 使用字节索引逐条浏览 JSONL 与 NDJSON，支持物理行跳转和超长记录流式预览的只读查看器。要求 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Artifacts-like documents in the sidebar: the agent writes a self-contained HTML document, you comment on any part, send the comments back for the next version, or edit text and formatting yourself. Every change is a new version; local only. A local-only fork of tdoc (https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc), rewritten as a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 Artifacts 式文档：AI 生成独立的 HTML 文档，你可以对任意位置批注、一键交给 AI 改出新版本，也可以自己直接修改文字和格式。每次修改都是新版本，内容只存在本地。基于 tdoc（https://github.com/tornado-doc/tdoc）改造的本地化 DSH 插件。

description.en: Typst live preview as a native right-Sidebar tab: clicking a .typ file opens a tab whose toolbar switches between the tinymist-rendered page and the highlighted source, with the preview page and its WebSocket served through the app's own origin.
description.zh: 原生右侧边栏里的 Typst 实时预览：点开 .typ 文件即得一个 tab，工具栏在 tinymist 渲染的页面与高亮源码之间切换；预览页面与其 WebSocket 都经应用自身 origin 提供。

plugins.name: dsh-attachment-formats

description.en: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin — PDF text-layer and scanned-PDF OCR, Office docx/xlsx/pptx to Markdown, TIFF/epub and long-document index cards.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件——PDF 文字层与扫描件 OCR、Office 文档转 Markdown、TIFF/epub 与长文档索引卡。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

plugins.name: dsh-course-assistant

description.en: Turns course files (PPTX, PDF, DOCX, Markdown) into an outline, per-chapter key points with quoted evidence, Bilibili video picks, syllabus coverage, and Anki/JSON exports.
description.zh: 把课程文件（PPTX、PDF、DOCX、Markdown）解析成目录、带原文引证的分章要点、B 站网课推荐与考纲覆盖检查，并可导出 Anki 卡片和 JSON。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Turn code flows into source-linked Mermaid diagrams and interactive CodeWalkthrough explainers.
description.zh: 把代码流程变成可跳转源码的 Mermaid 图和交互式 CodeWalkthrough 讲解页。

description.en: Prose review for human-facing writes. The write and edit tools require a human_facing flag; the plugin reviews the text against layered PROSE.md rules in the background, stages annotations, reconciles them against the full file, and merges them through /humanize, /humanize-loop or post-compaction while the main session keeps working. /humanize-review runs a batch over git-tracked files on demand.
description.zh: 面向人类写入内容的行文审查。write 和 edit 调用需声明 human_facing，插件在后台按分层 PROSE.md 规则审查文本并暂存批注，再按全文核对已有批注，主会话照常推进；用 /humanize、/humanize-loop 或压缩后自动合并批注，/humanize-review 按需批量审查 git 管理的文件。

description.en: Typora-style Markdown editor for the DSH right sidebar: live math and Mermaid rendering, click right of an image to keep writing on the next line, Ctrl/Cmd+S with version-guarded saves that also work outside the session workspace, and selections inserted into chat with their absolute file path.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 Typora 式 Markdown 编辑器：公式与 Mermaid 即时渲染，点图片右侧直接在下一行继续写，Ctrl/Cmd+S 版本守卫保存（不受会话工作区限制），选中文段带绝对路径插入对话。

description.en: Turns a repository and a software name into Chinese software copyright registration material - the 60-page source code excerpt (50 lines per page, auto-paginated), the software manual with screenshots, and the derived application-form fields (line count, language, completion date, function summary). Requires Python 3 with python-docx, and Google Chrome for screenshots.
description.zh: 把代码仓库和软件名变成软件著作权登记材料：60 页源程序鉴别材料（每页 50 行自动分页）、带截图的软件说明书、以及申请表信息推导（源程序量、语言、完成日期、功能简介）。需 Python 3 与 python-docx，截图需 Google Chrome。

description.en: Turns a repository and a running system into acceptance material - database design, design specs, a user manual with screenshots, and test / go-live / acceptance reports. Sections follow GB/T 8567-88; anything it cannot verify is left blank instead of invented. Requires Python 3 with python-docx for .docx output, and Google Chrome for automatic screenshots.
description.zh: 把代码仓库与运行中的系统变成验收材料：数据库设计、概要设计、详细设计、带截图的使用说明书，以及测试报告、上线报告、验收报告。章节按 GB/T 8567-88 组织，无法核实的字段与结论一律留空，不编造。需 Python 3 与 python-docx 生成 .docx，自动截图需 Google Chrome。

description.en: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
description.zh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

description.en: Two-way sync between a local LaTeX folder and an Overleaf project over the Overleaf Socket.IO + OT channel instead of a Git bridge: pull with automatic git init, dry-run-first push, three-way diff, background watch, and conflict copies that never overwrite.
description.zh: 不走 Git 桥接，而是通过 Overleaf 自身的 Socket.IO + OT 通道在本地 LaTeX 文件夹与 Overleaf 项目之间双向同步：拉取后自动 git init、推送默认 dry-run、三方 diff、后台 watch，冲突永不覆盖而是另存副本。

description.en: Render Mermaid code fences as SVG diagrams with streaming support, diagram/code switching, fullscreen zoom and pan, SVG export, and a bundled same-origin runtime.
description.zh: 将 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为 SVG 图表，支持流式输出、图形/代码切换、全屏缩放与拖拽、SVG 导出，以及内置的同源运行时。

description.en: Makes identifiers inside inline code in chat clickable; resolves a definition, then a wrapper, then the next occurrence, and opens the file at that line in the sidebar preview.
description.zh: 让聊天里行内代码中的标识符可点击：按定义、包装函数、顺序出现三级回退解析，在右侧预览打开文件并定位到对应行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness tools and a Skill for md-report/1: validate and render Markdown plus declared SQLite/CSV datasets into one offline interactive HTML report or dashboard, with AntV G2 charts (ECharts fallback) and chart/table data and source-SQL views.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 md-report/1 报告的校验与渲染工具：把 Markdown 与声明的 SQLite/CSV 数据集生成单个离线可交互 HTML 报告或仪表盘，图表默认用 AntV G2、复杂图表回退 ECharts，并提供图表/数据/SQL 与数据表/数据/SQL 视图。

description.en: HTML↔Markdown conversion, GFM table normalization, and TOC generation.
description.zh: HTML↔Markdown 转换、GFM 表格规范化、目录生成。

description.en: WeChat Official Account typesetting workbench: renders Markdown into inline-styled HTML you paste straight into the WeChat editor, with a sidebar panel, 11 themes and five model tools for block-level revision.
description.zh: 微信公众号排版工作台：把 Markdown 渲染成带内联样式的 HTML，粘进公众号编辑器即成排版；配右侧栏面板、11 套主题与五个模型工具做块级改稿。

plugins.name: dsh-ppt-maker

description.en: PPT workbench: eleven ppt_* tools create, edit, reverse-engineer, QA-check and export slides from a plain-text PPTD project; five design-system families, themes, animations, posters and infographics.
description.zh: PPT 制作插件：十一个 ppt_* 工具创建、编辑、逆向、质检与导出演示文稿，内置五族设计系统与主题模板，支持幻灯片动画、海报与信息图。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

plugins.name: dsh-gh-pages-artifacts

description.en: Publishes HTML pages and Markdown documents written by the agent to GitHub Pages as shareable links, with tools to update them in place, list, read back, and delete them; adds an Artifacts sidebar panel and a bundled page-design skill.
description.zh: 把 Agent 生成的 HTML 页面和 Markdown 文档发布到 GitHub Pages 并返回可分享链接，提供原地更新、列出、读回和删除的工具；附带侧边栏 Artifacts 面板和内置的页面设计技能。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-reading-companion

description.en: An AI reading buddy: it sits next to you while you read, and only knows the pages you have already reached — so it cannot spoil the rest, and it never summarizes the whole book for you. Highlight a sentence and ask about it, or just ask about what you finished; it usually restates what you seem to mean and asks one concrete question back. What you work out can be saved as a takeaway and later becomes a review card that jumps back to the sentence. EPUB, MOBI, FB2, TXT, Markdown, HTML, CBZ.
description.zh: 读书时旁边坐一个 AI 同读的人：它只知道你读到的位置，所以不会剧透，也不会替你把整本书总结掉。觉得哪句有分量就划出来问它，或者直接问刚读完的内容——它多半先复述你的意思，再反问一个具体的问题。想明白的东西可以存成「收获」，之后变成复习卡片，点一下跳回原句。支持 EPUB、MOBI、FB2、TXT、Markdown、HTML、CBZ。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.idpf.org

description.en: Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.
description.zh: 以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能内置 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档离线镜像：站点中英 168 页 + 仓库补充文档 52 篇，带主题导航与全文检索，编写插件时随时查阅。

description.en: Builds presentations by driving the LibreOffice installed on the machine over UNO instead of writing OOXML in JavaScript: `lo_build` opens a real Impress document from structured slides and lets LibreOffice export editable PPTX/ODP plus PDF and per-slide PNG, `lo_render` re-renders an existing PPTX/PPT/ODP, `lo_convert` converts between Office formats, `lo_probe` reports the detected soffice path, version and UNO bridge, and `lo_config` edits the stored settings. Needs a local LibreOffice (verified on 26.8.1.1); it uses the bundled Python, so no system Python is needed, and it keeps one warm soffice process between calls. Fully verified on Windows only; on Linux it falls back to the system python3, which needs python3-uno.
description.zh: 通过 UNO 驱动本机安装的 LibreOffice 做 PPT，而不是用 JavaScript 写 OOXML：`lo_build` 用结构化幻灯片真开一份 Impress 文档，再由 LibreOffice 导出可编辑的 PPTX/ODP、PDF 与逐页 PNG；`lo_render` 重新渲染已有的 PPTX/PPT/ODP；`lo_convert` 做 Office 格式互转；`lo_probe` 报告探测到的 soffice 路径、版本与 UNO 桥状态；`lo_config` 修改已保存的配置。需要本机安装 LibreOffice（已在 26.8.1.1 验证），使用其自带 Python，无需系统 Python，并会在两次调用之间保留一个 soffice 热进程。仅在 Windows 上做过完整验证；Linux 上会退回系统 python3，需要 python3-uno。

description.en: Deterministic industry research reports for DeepSeek Harness — company and industry research flows produce structured, verifiable reports from staged evidence.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性行业研究报告：公司与行业研究流程基于分阶段证据产出结构化、可核验的报告。

description.en: Paper reading workbench: a paper library, the PDF beside Markdown notes and one dedicated AI session per paper. Highlights and region screenshots go straight into notes; select-to-ask sends the passage with its page; notes are editable in place with autosave; sessions can be combined into a Summary.
description.zh: 论文阅读工作台：论文库、PDF 与 Markdown 笔记并排、每篇论文一个专属 AI 会话。高亮与框选截图自动写入笔记；划词 Ask AI 附带页码与选段；笔记可原地编辑、自动保存；多个会话可汇总成 Summary。

description.en: Windows x64 translator with a dedicated sidebar entry and Workbench / Chat interface, side-by-side text and document translation, screen-region translation, recent history, and host model selection, voice input and preview. CPU OCR without NVIDIA dependencies. Do not enable the CPU and CUDA packages at the same time.
description.zh: 翻译 CPU：Windows x64 专属翻译界面，侧栏独立入口，支持工作台／聊天切换、原文与译文双栏、尽量保留原格式的文档翻译、屏幕框选翻译及最近记录，复用宿主模型、语音输入与预览。使用 CPU OCR，无需 NVIDIA 运行库。不要同时启用 CPU 与 CUDA 两个版本。

description.en: Windows x64 translator with a dedicated sidebar entry and Workbench / Chat interface, side-by-side text and document translation, screen-region translation, recent history, and host model selection, voice input and preview. CUDA document OCR with CPU fallback; screen OCR uses CPU. Do not enable the CPU and CUDA packages at the same time.
description.zh: 翻译 CUDA：Windows x64 专属翻译界面，侧栏独立入口，支持工作台／聊天切换、原文与译文双栏、尽量保留原格式的文档翻译、屏幕框选翻译及最近记录，复用宿主模型、语音输入与预览。文档 OCR 支持 CUDA 加速，无兼容 GPU 时回退 CPU；屏幕 OCR 使用 CPU。不要同时启用 CPU 与 CUDA 两个版本。

description.en: Translate installed plugins' documentation into Simplified Chinese: README sections are translated with a persistent section-level cache, and an opt-in metaSidecars mode (off by default) writes a locale/zh.json sidecar for each Plugins list row so the list can render Chinese natively.
description.zh: 把已安装插件的文档翻译成简体中文：README 按章节翻译并持久缓存；另有默认关闭的可选 metaSidecars 模式，会为每条插件列表行写入 locale/zh.json 侧文件，让列表原生渲染中文。

description.en: Dockable Markdown preview for the DSH Web UI: side-by-side with the conversation, a per-session recently-read .md list, local relative-path images render in place, and clicking an in-chat .md reference previews it instead of launching the system editor; follows the shell light/dark theme.
description.zh: DSH Web 端可停靠的 Markdown 预览面板：与对话并排展示，会话级「最近打开 .md」列表，本地相对路径图片可直接渲染；点击对话中的 .md 引用改为并排预览而非唤起系统编辑器；跟随 shell 深浅色主题。

description.en: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.
description.zh: 把会话工作区里已有的 Markdown 文档、源码、图片与视频列进 DSH 侧边栏，按与当前对话的相关性排序。默认的词法模式用最近几条消息在本地与标题、摘要、正文做带 IDF 加权的匹配（BM25）—— 不调用模型、没有网络出口，内容不出本机。列表来自工作区扫描，而不是「最近打开记录」，所以重启 DSH 或新开会话都不会变空。排序结果组织成主要 / 辅助 / 相关三层的阅读顺序，每一条都写明可核验的理由（命中了哪个字段、被哪一篇引用），点一行即可就地预览：Markdown 按渲染后的样子显示、相对路径图片真实渲染、源码走宿主自带的语法高亮、视频走 HTTP Range 流式播放。同一份 Context Pack 也作为 knit_docs 工具交给 agent。后续版本陆续补上读取证据与生命周期（归因在读那一刻冻结）、固定 / 排除（排除先于检索生效，且可恢复）、关系证据（引用 / 导入 / 测试，带行号）与增量索引（重启后复用）。v0.23 起还多一条可选的混合检索：默认关闭，只有你自己配好 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的 embedding 服务才会生效。它生效时，发出去的是你这句查询原话加上每篇候选文件的标题与摘要 —— Markdown 的摘要取自正文首段（不超过 60 字），代码的摘要是它所在的工作区相对目录，图片 / 视频贡献的是文件名；完整正文与绝对路径都不发送，指向本机服务（loopback）时内容不出这台机器。v0.24 起还能做变更关联：用一条只读的 git status（固定 argv、不走 shell、子进程环境白名单），配合同一套引用 / 导入 / 测试 / 提及证据，指出这次改动大概率该一起看哪些文件 —— 默认关闭。语义检索的收益仍待真 provider 实测，因此不承诺召回提升。

description.en: Context7 MCP bridge: gives the model up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples through the Context7 MCP server, keyless by default.
description.zh: 接入 Context7 托管 MCP 服务，为 agent 提供随版本更新的库文档查询；默认免密钥可用。

description.en: Drag documents into the dsh web chat; the agent reads them directly from the local filesystem and the right sidebar lists the outputs and file paths.
description.zh: 拖拽文档进 dsh Web 对话框，Agent 直读本地文件处理，右侧侧栏展示产出与文件路径。

description.en: Edit xlsx/xls/csv/tsv/docx/pptx files in the DSH sidebar on Windows DSH Desktop through a locally installed ONLYOFFICE Document Server; saved edits are written back to the original file on disk.
description.zh: 在 Windows 版 DSH Desktop 的侧边栏用本机安装的 ONLYOFFICE Document Server 编辑 xlsx/xls/csv/tsv/docx/pptx，保存直接写回磁盘上的原文件。

description.en: Read PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and text documents as agent tools, and OCR scanned PDFs or images locally with tesseract.js. Exposes doc_read, pdf_read, xlsx_read, doc_meta and doc_ocr.
description.zh: 把 PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 和文本文件读取为智能体工具，并用 tesseract.js 在本地对扫描版 PDF 或图片做 OCR。提供 doc_read、pdf_read、xlsx_read、doc_meta、doc_ocr 五个工具。

plugins.name: reviso-dsh

description.en: Publish agent output to Reviso for human review, browse published documents from the sidebar, and find them again from the session that produced them. OAuth is host-mediated: Reviso tokens stay in DSH credentials and the browser only receives short-lived embed sessions. Requires a Reviso account or a compatible self-hosted Reviso server.
description.zh: 把 Agent 产出发布到 Reviso 供人工评审，在侧边栏浏览已发布文档，并在产生这些文档的同一个 DSH 会话中再次找到它们。OAuth 由宿主中转：Reviso token 只保存在 DSH credentials 里，浏览器仅获得短时效的 embed 会话。需要 Reviso 账号或兼容的自建 Reviso 服务。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: WYSIWYG Markdown editor in the DSH right sidebar, built on MarkText's muya engine: open a .md file, edit it as a rendered document, and save back through ctx.fs with a version guard.
description.zh: 基于 MarkText 内核 muya 的右侧栏所见即所得 Markdown 编辑器：打开 .md 按渲染结果编辑，保存走 ctx.fs 并带版本守卫。

description.en: Normalizes every generated .docx to one Chinese official-document layout: XiaoBiaoSong title, FangSong body at a fixed 29pt leading with zero paragraph spacing, character-unit 2-character first-line indent, fully centered table cells with repeating header rows, and a centered footer page number. Long attachment entries are split into real paragraphs at the wrap point measured by Word, producing a 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 character indent ladder. It applies the layout only when the request mentions 公文 (official document) and writes no signature block unless asked.
description.zh: 把生成的 .docx 统一到一套中文公文版式：方正小标宋标题、仿宋正文 29 磅固定行距、段前段后 0、字符单位首行缩进 2 字符，表格每个单元格都水平居中并带重复表头，页脚居中「— 1 —」页码。附件长条目按 2 / 6 / 5 / 6 字符缩进阶梯自动分段，折行点由 Word 实测得到。只有请求里提到「公文」时才套用版式，用户没有明确要求时默认不写落款。

description.en: Whole-PDF paper translation for DSH on top of a BabelDOC installation you provide (Python CLI, with an OpenAI-compatible API key in its config.toml): bilingual dual-page output, a token cost estimate before running, a per-domain glossary reused across papers, and the server-side thinking overhead disabled for translation.
description.zh: DSH 的整篇 PDF 文献翻译：BabelDOC（Python CLI 及其 config.toml 里的 OpenAI 兼容 API Key）需自行安装配置；输出双语对照 PDF，跑之前先给 token 成本预估，按领域跨论文复用术语表，并关掉翻译环节服务端默认开启的 thinking 推理开销。

description.en: Renders workspace Markdown files in a standalone full-screen reader with GFM, KaTeX, Mermaid, outline navigation, live file reload, and browser printing/PDF export.
description.zh: 在独立全屏阅读器中渲染工作区 Markdown 文件，支持 GFM、KaTeX、Mermaid、目录导航、文件更新同步以及浏览器打印和 PDF 导出。

description.en: Syntax-highlighted code for reports via one highlight_code tool: 68 languages, 15 themes, 11 output formats (inline HTML, Word-ready SVG/PNG, LaTeX), incl. the classic SyntaxHighlighter themes. PNG output needs Python 3 with Pillow; other formats need no external runtime.
description.zh: 报告代码高亮：一个 highlight_code 工具，68 种语言、15 套主题、11 种输出（内联 HTML、Word 可插 SVG/PNG、LaTeX 等），含 codeinword.com 同款 SyntaxHighlighter 经典主题。PNG 输出需 Python 3 与 Pillow，其他格式无额外依赖。

description.en: A local-first sidebar knowledge base for a DSH workspace: indexes projects, documents and plugins, classifies entries automatically, and provides search, file previews and editable notes. Data stays in the workspace.
description.zh: 本地优先的 DSH 工作区侧边栏知识库：索引项目、文档和插件，自动归类，支持搜索、文件预览和可编辑笔记；数据保存在工作区。

description.en: End-of-chat visual storyboard: a storyboard tool renders a self-contained HTML card (inline SVG diagram, numbered flow, facts grid, timeline) from a JSON spec, writes it under ~/.dsh/storyboard/<session>/ and opens it in the sidebar; a system-prompt section and a /storyboard command trigger generation. Server-only, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 对话收尾可视化故事板：storyboard 工具把 JSON 规范渲染为自包含 HTML 卡片（内嵌 SVG 流程图、编号步骤、事实网格、时间线），写入 ~/.dsh/storyboard/<session>/ 并在侧边栏打开；系统提示词段落与 /storyboard 命令触发生成。纯服务端、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Read and search local PDFs with page citations, render pages as images, and use optional Tesseract OCR for scanned or mixed pages; requires Poppler.
description.zh: 读取和搜索本地 PDF 并提供页码引用，将页面渲染为图片，可用 Tesseract 对扫描页或混合页面进行 OCR；需要 Poppler。

description.en: Pipeline for scanned textbooks: OCR at roughly 5x the ONNXRuntime speed (requires Python 3.10+ with pymupdf, rapidocr, openvino and numpy), then a structure report and a per-chapter reading plan before you open the PDF.
description.zh: 扫描版教材流水线：在本机 Python 3.10+ 环境（需 pymupdf、rapidocr、openvino、numpy）下，OCR 提速约 5 倍，先出骨架地图，再按章阅读。

plugins.name: dsh-ppt

description.en: Presentation skill and tools: one sentence or one document to an HTML slideshow plus editable PPTX, seven layouts (incl. quote and native PPTX tables), speaker notes (HTML S-key panel and native notes slides), five built-in themes, default theme/language config and bilingual support. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 演示文稿技能与工具：一句话或一篇文档生成 HTML 放映与可编辑 PPTX，7 种页型（含金句与原生 PPTX 表格），演讲者备注（HTML 按 S 呼出 + PPTX 原生备注页），内置 5 套主题，可配置默认主题/语言，中英双语。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

plugins.name: DSH Notebook · 私人笔记管理

description.en: Save conversations, manage notes with images, export files, and sync across devices through your own private GitHub repository.
description.zh: 保存会话、管理图文笔记、导出文件，通过自己的 GitHub 私有仓库跨设备同步。

plugins.name: dsh-shareone-plugin

description.en: Publish TXT, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word, and PowerPoint files as ShareOne links with passwords, watermarks, text-page updates, and TXT/Markdown/HTML comments.
description.zh: 将 TXT、Markdown、HTML、PDF、Word 和 PowerPoint 文件发布为 ShareOne 分享链接，支持访问密码、水印、文本页面更新和 TXT/Markdown/HTML 评论。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-workbuddy-ppt

description.en: Generates editable PPTX decks in DSH with a bundled authoring Skill, deterministic PPTD scene checks, native PowerPoint objects, and local PPTD source-project delivery.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用包内编排 Skill、确定性 PPTD 场景检查和原生 PowerPoint 对象生成可编辑 PPTX，并在本地交付 PPTD 源项目。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Review AI-generated Word, PowerPoint, PDF and HTML in the official preview: box problems, edit the text in place, and hand the notes to the agent. PDF and images are annotate-only; editing relies on the Harness bundled LibreOffice kit and Python.
description.zh: 在官方预览里审阅 Word、PowerPoint、PDF 与 HTML：框选问题、就地改字，再把批注交给 AI。PDF 与图片仅可批注；改字依赖 Harness 自带的 LibreOffice 与 Python。

description.en: Two PDF tools for the DSH sidebar in one install — jump to any page and browse the whole document with locally rendered pages and thumbnails, or open a PDF with DSH's native preview. Ships a /pdf command too.
description.zh: 一个包装两个 PDF 工具：按页码跳页、用本地渲染的页面和缩略图整本浏览，也可用 DSH 原生预览直接打开；另带一个 /pdf 命令。

description.en: Renders Excalidraw architecture scenes inside DSH — import a local .excalidraw/.json file or an inline document with no account, or refresh from Excalidraw+ over MCP (refresh needs an Excalidraw+ MCP bearer token in mcpToken or EXCALIDRAW_MCP_TOKEN); pan, zoom, select and export SVG/PNG.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里渲染 Excalidraw 架构图：可无账号导入本地 .excalidraw/.json 或内联文档，也可通过 MCP 从 Excalidraw+ 刷新（刷新需在 mcpToken 或 EXCALIDRAW_MCP_TOKEN 里配置 Excalidraw+ 的 MCP 令牌）；支持平移、缩放、选中与 SVG/PNG 导出。

description.en: Generate validated, self-contained interactive architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from repositories or system descriptions.
description.zh: 从仓库或系统描述生成经过校验的自包含交互式架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图和生命周期图。

description.en: A WYSIWYG Typst editor for papers, reports, exams, resumes, charts, posters, sheet music, and slides exported as PPTX.
description.zh: Typst 文档编辑工具：WYSIWYG 编辑排版论文、报告、试卷、简历、图表、海报、乐谱和可导出为 PPTX 的 Slides。

description.en: Knowledge-point notebook for DeepSeek Harness: turns a Markdown notes folder into a card canvas — folder = chapter, file = section, body = knowledge points — with masked-answer questions for self-testing, KaTeX formulas, Mermaid flowcharts, a mind map view and in-panel editing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 知识点笔记插件：把 Markdown 笔记目录变成卡片式学习画布，目录 = 章节、文件 = 小节、正文 = 知识点；题目可遮挡答案自测，支持 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 流程图、思维导图与面板内编辑。

plugins.name: dsh-qingagent

description.en: Writing bridge to the open-source QingAgent client: the agent drafts and revises documents through qing_ prefixed host tools, typeset on a rice-paper panel with mermaid, drawio, tables and KaTeX; edits stage as reviewable diffs and land only on commit, and it requires the QingAgent desktop app on the same machine.
description.zh: 青简写作桥：agent 通过 qing_ 前缀工具起草改稿，右侧宣纸面板排版呈现（mermaid、drawio、表格、公式）；每处修改先摆在纸上供审阅，提交才落稿。需本机运行开源的青简桌面客户端。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.jgraph.com

description.en: Tree-shaped Markdown knowledge base for DSH agents: kb_list/kb_read/kb_write tools, tree/node HTTP routes, and a browser panel companion.
description.zh: 树状 Markdown 知识库：为 DSH Agent 提供 kb_list/kb_read/kb_write 工具、目录/正文 HTTP 接口，并配套浏览器面板。

description.en: Adds a global document-routing prompt so PDFs, images, and Office files are read with the right tool.
description.zh: 加入全局文档路由提示，让 PDF、图片和 Office 文件自动走正确的读取工具。

plugins.name: dsh-markdown-notes

description.en: Write and read Markdown notes: switch between reading, editing and side-by-side preview, with an outline, three preview themes, math and Mermaid, nested folders, and autosave to local .md files.
description.zh: 随手记、随时读：阅读、编辑、并排预览一键切换，附大纲与三套排版主题，支持公式与 Mermaid，多级文件夹管理，自动存为本地 .md 文件。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

description.en: Saves opt-in conversations as structured Markdown study notes with topic folders and a maintained index.
description.zh: 按对话开启学习笔记，自动整理问答，按分类保存并维护 Markdown 索引。

plugins.name: dsh-docchain

description.en: DocChain knowledge base, document conversion and knowledge-graph toolkit — filename, content and metadata search, locate-by-doc_id/name with content reading, topic listing, bulk document upload, document-to-Markdown conversion, image-similarity search, per-document image descriptions saved to a sidecar markdown (flowcharts and architecture diagrams are turned into PlantUML sketches, other images into text descriptions; the original image is replaced by a clickable link), a deep-research workflow, and a knowledge-graph layer (ontology inspection, read-only Cypher, ontology/entity/relation writes). Every script-backed capability also ships as a native DSH tool executed in-process: doc search, content search, filename search, topic info, metadata search, upload, image search, image describe, doc2markdown, plus kg schema / kg cypher / kg upsert node / kg upsert relation / kg delete node / kg delete relation. All graph operations go through the DocChain API, so no Neo4j password is needed. The configuration page keeps several docchain environments (each with its own address and credential), switches between them in one click, and pre-selects topics per environment. Needs a docchain service URL and API key (except doc2markdown); image descriptions additionally need an OpenAI-compatible multimodal endpoint (defaults to an internal gateway model, configurable).
description.zh: 知识库、文档转换与知识图谱插件：文档文件名、内容与元数据检索，按 doc_id/文档名称定位并读取正文，主题查询，文档批量上传，文档转 Markdown，图搜图，文档图片转文字（流程图/架构图这类结构图自动转成 PlantUML 草图，其它图写成文字描述，并写入旁路描述 md，主 md 不动；原图改为可点链接），深度研究工作流，以及知识图谱能力（查本体结构、执行只读 Cypher、本体/实体/关系的增删改，全部走 DocChain API，无需 Neo4j 密码）。所有带脚本的能力同时提供原生 DSH 工具，由宿主进程内直接执行：文档定位、内容搜索、文件名搜索、主题查询、元数据查询、批量上传、图搜图、文档图片转文字、文档转 Markdown，以及知识图谱的本体查询 / Cypher / 节点与关系的增改删。配置页可保存多个 docchain 环境（各带独立地址与凭据）并一键切换，还可按环境预选主题。除 doc2markdown 外需配置 docchain 服务地址与 API key；图片转文字另需一个 OpenAI 兼容的多模态模型端点（默认走内网网关模型，可配置更换）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to host:7100

plugins.name: dsh-docdesk

description.en: An add-only Markdown library for DeepSeek Harness with a workspace file picker, fixed non-overlapping icon grid, marquee selection, virtual folders, full-screen tabs, GFM tables, and local Mermaid/chart rendering.
description.zh: 只收主动加入的 Markdown 文档，支持工作区挑选、固定网格对齐、右键框选、虚拟文件夹、全屏标签页、GFM 表格和 Mermaid/代码块图表本地渲染。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

description.en: Team knowledge base for offline knowledge sharing (FDE box scenario): browse, full-text search and refinement entry points; raw material is queued automatically and distilled into wiki pages by a serial bot session (Karpathy LLM Wiki pattern: immutable raw, two-step refinement, log stream, monthly lint).
description.zh: 团队知识库：离线知识共享（FDE 盒子场景），浏览/全文检索/加工入口；raw 入料自动入队、bot 会话串行蒸馏成文（Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式：raw 不可变 / 两步加工 / log 流水 / 月度 lint）。

description.en: PDF document editing plugin for precise text editing in PDF files.
description.zh: 面向 PDF 文档的编辑插件,精确编辑PDF文字

description.en: Renders Jupyter notebooks in the document preview, with syntax-highlighted code, offline KaTeX for inline and display math, and a zoomable figure viewer.
description.zh: 在文档预览中渲染 Jupyter 笔记本，支持代码语法高亮、离线 KaTeX 行内与块级公式，以及可缩放的图像查看器。

description.en: Browse, preview, edit, and save files under the current project's openspec/ directory from a Web UI header panel that follows the session workspace.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 会话标题栏打开当前项目的 openspec/ 目录，浏览、预览、编辑并保存其中的文件，自动跟随会话工作区。

description.en: Forces ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English on every reply and every document. Commands: /asd100 on, /asd100 off, /asd100.
description.zh: 强制所有回复和文档按 ASD-STE100 简化技术英语输出。命令：/asd100 on、/asd100 off、/asd100。

description.en: Adds a diagram button under every finished reply in the DSH Web UI: the configured model writes a single-file HTML page with inline SVG and the right sidebar renders it in a sandboxed iframe, with diagram, source and original-text views, a per-session replay history that is served from a disk cache instead of calling the model again, redraw, and save to a .html file.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面每条定稿回复下加一个「图解」按钮：模型产出单文件 HTML（内联 SVG），右侧栏以沙箱 iframe 渲染；带图解／源码／原文三个视图、命中磁盘缓存即回放（不再调用模型）的会话内历史列表、重画与另存 .html。

description.en: Prepares files before read, read_image and the vision tools open them: downscales images over 2048 px or 8 MB (one retry at 1280 px within the same turn), converts BMP/TIFF to PNG, relabels mislabeled uploads by sniffing their bytes, and turns docx/xlsx/pptx, text-layer PDF, csv/tsv and html into Markdown with no external programs.
description.zh: 在 read、read_image 与 vision_* 打开文件之前先处理：长边超 2048 像素或体积超 8 MB 的图降采样（同一轮可降到 1280 再试一次），BMP/TIFF 转 PNG，按字节纠正标错的上传类型，并把 docx/xlsx/pptx、有文字层的 PDF、csv/tsv 与 html 转成 Markdown，不依赖任何外部程序。

description.en: Reads and writes WPS 365 cloud documents (smart documents and .docx/.xlsx/.pptx) through the locally installed wps365-cli, with conflict checks before writing; requires a WPS 365 enterprise account.
description.zh: 通过本机安装的 wps365-cli 读写 WPS 365 云文档（智能文档与 .docx/.xlsx/.pptx），写入前先做并发冲突比对；需要 WPS 365 企业版账号。

description.en: Kill AI Slop for DSH — score a received document on three weighted axes (expression, execution, decision), audit work-slop with a delivery-obligation ledger, and machine-verify every quote against the source. Reads docx, pptx, xlsx, pdf, txt, md, csv, json and html. Zero runtime dependencies, zero network, fully local.
description.zh: AI垃圾过滤（Kill AI Slop）：给收到的文件打一个可回溯的体检得分（表达／执行／决策三维加权），用交付承接台账审查工作空转，每条引文回原文机器复核；支持 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf/txt/md/csv/json/html。零运行依赖、零联网、纯本地计算。

description.en: End-to-end PowerPoint assistant preset for DeepSeek Harness with editable deck generation, template-preserving edits, rendering and structural quality checks. Needs Python 3.10+ with requirements.txt installed; rendering also needs LibreOffice and pdftoppm, and OCR of scanned documents needs Tesseract.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的一条龙 PowerPoint 助手预设，支持可编辑演示文稿生成、保留模板的修改、渲染和结构质量检查。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装 requirements.txt；渲染另需 LibreOffice 与 pdftoppm，扫描件 OCR 需 Tesseract。

description.en: Chat-driven image-deck workbench for DSH: intent to storyboard script, per-page prompts and AI image generation with page-level revisions, nine design-style presets, and PDF/PPTX export (one full-page image per slide).
description.zh: DSH 的 image deck 工作台：从意图到故事线脚本、逐页 prompt 与 AI 出图、按页版本留存、9 套预设设计风格，导出 PDF/PPTX（每页一张整页图）。

plugins.name: dsh-pptx-editor

description.en: Preview and edit attached PowerPoint presentations in the DSH sidebar through conversation or manual controls, with shared undo/redo and PPTX download.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏预览附件中的 PowerPoint 演示文稿，通过对话或手动操作编辑，共享撤销与重做历史，并下载编辑后的 PPTX。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Converts Office and PDF files in the DSH workspace to Markdown locally — no network, no API quota — before the model reads them. Writes each .md next to its source so only a file path enters the context, and returns byte size, line count, token estimate and a heading outline, for a single file or a whole directory.
description.zh: 在模型读取之前，把工作区里的 Office / PDF 文件在本机转成 Markdown（不联网、不消耗 API 额度），.md 写在源文件旁边，因此进入上下文的只是一个文件路径，并返回字节数、行数、token 估算与标题结构索引，支持单个文件或整个目录。

description.en: Renders mermaid fenced code blocks in the conversation as real diagrams, with the source one click away.
description.zh: 把会话里的 mermaid 代码块直接渲染成图表，源码一键可查。

description.en: Technical documentation agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: template-driven writing with a self-learning template library, AI-flavor removal for tech docs, and a quality-assurance toolkit (document audit, cross-document consistency, numbering resequencing, version sync, PDF and Word export, screenshot automation).
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的技术文档撰写 Agent 模式：模板驱动写作与自学习模板库、技术文档去 AI 味，以及文档质量保障工具集（量化体检、多文档口径一致性校验、图/表编号重排、版本同步检查、Word/PDF 导出与界面截图自动化）。

description.en: Previews a workspace OpenWiki in the DSH Web right Sidebar: detects the wiki directory, serves it with the official `openwiki visualize` reader on a loopback port, and embeds it in its own tab, reporting the installed openwiki and DSH versions against configurable floors and checking the registry for its own updates.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏预览工作区的 OpenWiki：识别 wiki 目录，用官方 `openwiki visualize` 阅读器在本地回环端口提供服务并嵌入自有标签页，同时对照可配置的版本下限报告 openwiki 与 DSH 版本，并向 registry 检查自身更新。

description.en: PDF parsing tools for DSH: pdf_info, pdf_extract_text, and pdf_render_page with dual pdfjs and built-in rendering engines, including system-font rendering for PDFs with non-embedded CJK fonts.
description.zh: DSH 的 PDF 解析工具：pdf_info、pdf_extract_text、pdf_render_page 三件套，pdfjs 与自研渲染器双引擎，未内嵌 CJK 字体的 PDF 也能用系统字体渲染出图。

description.en: Registers the Inspiration Deck Workshop skill for DSH: local static HTML presentation decks (6 deck templates, 25+ layouts, 23 themes & motion showroom) with a validate + PNG/PDF export CLI and smoke tests, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册灵感演示工坊技能：本地静态 HTML 演示文稿（6 套 deck 模板、25+ 布局、23 套主题与动效展示馆），带 validate 校验与 PNG/PDF 导出 CLI 和 smoke 测试，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Registers the remove-pdf-background-gray skill for DSH: whitens gray/off-white scan backgrounds in image-based PDFs while preserving resolution, page geometry, and anti-aliased text edges (lossless Flate write-back), via a single Python script (pypdf + Pillow + numpy).
description.zh: 注册 remove-pdf-background-gray 技能：去除扫描 PDF 的灰色/米白底色，保持分辨率、页面几何与抗锯齿文字边缘（无损 Flate 写回），核心为单文件 Python 脚本（pypdf + Pillow + numpy）。

description.en: Host plugin that adds the /dsh-book-deconstruct command and the dsh-book-deconstruct tool to any session for a full book walkthrough plus one deep insight.
description.zh: Host 插件：任意会话可用 /dsh-book-deconstruct 命令与 dsh-book-deconstruct 工具，输入书名与作者后讲透全书并给出一段深度思想。

description.en: Injects PowerPoint entrance animations and slide transitions into existing .pptx files by writing the OOXML timing tree (p:timing), which python-pptx does not implement. Requires Python 3 with python-pptx installed (the plugin auto-detects python / python3 / py).
description.zh: 给已生成的 .pptx 批量写入 PowerPoint 进入动画与幻灯片切换——直接构造 python-pptx 未实现的 OOXML timing 树，并附带结构校验器。需本机 Python 3 且已安装 python-pptx（插件会自动探测 python / python3 / py）。

description.en: Notes and folder reader in the main panel: a file tree with pinned files, closeable tabs, Markdown split edit/preview with synced scrolling, plain-text editing, manual save, and drag-to-move. Deleting a file moves it to the system trash where one exists (macOS, Linux), falling back to an in-folder dsh-notes-trash directory; Windows has no delete entry.
description.zh: 主面板内的笔记与目录阅读器：文件树与置顶、可关闭的标签页、Markdown 左编右渲与同步滚动、纯文本编辑、手动保存、拖拽移动文件。删除时移入系统回收站（macOS、Linux），系统回收站不可用时移入目录内的 dsh-notes-trash 目录；Windows 不提供删除入口。

description.en: Prepares a repository README before pushing: scans repo facts, renders banner and process-diagram images (needs Pillow and the Microsoft YaHei font), lints layout and section numbering, then commits and pushes with retry.
description.zh: 上传 GitHub 前优化仓库 README：扫描仓库事实、渲染首图与过程图（需 Pillow 与微软雅黑字体）、校验排版和编号，最后带重试提交推送。

description.en: Prose-editing skill for academic and professional writing. The composer offers three modes: Check — review and suggest without editing, with a verdict when readiness is asked; Polish — improve the wording while keeping the meaning, facts and citations; Draft — draft from the supplied material without adding facts.
description.zh: 学术与专业写作润色技能，输入框三选一：检查——只检查并给建议；询问能否提交时补充结论，不改原文。润色——改善表达，保留原意、事实和引用。起草——根据现有材料起草，不补充材料外的事实。
