description.en: Skill bundle that installs the codex-collab skill for driving the local OpenAI Codex CLI as a vendor instead of a consultant: every delegation carries acceptance criteria and a self-test script, the result is verified by running those tests locally, and a failure is handed back with its original error output; batch delegation runs sequentially (parallel subprocesses are not usable locally) and multi-turn continuation stays inside one session. Requires the local Codex CLI and PowerShell 7+; the helper scripts are Windows-native and only partially work on macOS/Linux.
description.zh: 把 codex-collab 技能装进 DSH 的技能包：把本地 OpenAI Codex CLI 当供应商而非顾问来派活——每次派活附验收标准与自测脚本，本地跑测试验收，失败把原始报错原样丢回去；支持批量派活（本机子进程并行不可用，按顺序执行）与单会话多轮续接。需已安装本地 Codex CLI 与 PowerShell 7+；辅助脚本为 Windows 原生，macOS/Linux 只能部分运行。

description.en: Browses the awesome-claude-video-skills catalog (373 entries) inside DSH settings and installs a chosen skill into ~/.claude/skills and/or ~/.dsh/skills: it downloads the GitHub archive of that repository and copies the skill directory, and executes no code from the repository. Installs run as background jobs with live progress (bytes downloaded, files copied) and can be cancelled; skills installed by the plugin can be uninstalled, while directories without its marker are left untouched. Rows show an approximate repository size reported by GitHub. The same actions are exposed to the agent as the video_skill_search, video_skill_install and video_skill_uninstall tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里浏览 awesome-claude-video-skills 目录（373 条），把选中的技能装进 ~/.claude/skills 和/或 ~/.dsh/skills：下载该仓库的 GitHub 归档并复制技能目录，不执行仓库里的任何代码。安装以后台任务运行、显示实时进度（已下载字节与已复制文件数）并可取消；本插件装上的技能可以卸载，没有本插件标记的目录保持不动。列表显示 GitHub 报告的仓库体积近似值。同样的能力也以 video_skill_search、video_skill_install、video_skill_uninstall 三个工具暴露给智能体。

description.en: Provides a skill for the LinShang LS125 UV irradiance meter and its UVALED-X3 probe: the reverse-engineered 9600 8N1 link (28-byte frames, CRC-16/MODBUS, poll and clear commands), a capture and decode toolchain, and a verified STM32F103 host firmware that reads the probe without the original meter. All code and documentation written by an AI agent (DeepSeek Harness).
description.zh: 为林上 LS125 紫外辐照计与 UVALED-X3 探头提供技能：逆向出的 9600 8N1 链路（28 字节帧、CRC-16/MODBUS、轮询与清零命令）、抓取解码工具链，以及已验证的 STM32F103 主机固件，可在脱离原装表的情况下读取探头。全部代码与文档均由 AI agent（DeepSeek Harness）编写。

description.en: Bundles 19 short-video production skills (1 entry point, 1 orchestration, 17 atomic) into the agent skill catalog: Chinese TTS pronunciation fixes, text-to-image and text-to-video, image panning, composition, covers, media verification, data review and four-platform publishing. Ships skills and scripts only, so a runnable pipeline still needs ffmpeg, Python 3 + Pillow, Node.js and playwright installed locally, your own Bilibili biliup credential and WeChat Channels / Douyin / Xiaohongshu login states, and the placeholder values under skills/*/scripts/ filled in with your own. An installer's own skill of the same name keeps precedence.
description.zh: 把一条短视频生产流水线的 19 个 skill（1 总入口 + 1 编排 + 17 原子）内置进 agent 技能目录：中文配音读音校正、文生图与文生视频、图片运镜、成片合成、封面、成片核验、数据复盘、四平台发布。本包只提供 skill 与脚本，不安装任何工具：要真跑通流水线，还得本机装好 ffmpeg、Python 3 + Pillow、Node.js 与 playwright，自备 B 站 biliup 凭据和视频号 / 抖音 / 小红书登录态，并把 skills/*/scripts/ 里的占位符改成自己的值。使用者自己的同名 skill 优先级更高。

description.en: Invoke user-accessible Skills with @name tokens and show matching Skill suggestions in the conversation composer.
description.zh: 通过 @名称 标记调用用户可用的 Skill，并在对话输入框中显示匹配的 Skill 候选项。

description.en: Template-driven code review skill: five-step review flow, critical/medium/minor severity grading, four-dimension scoring (quality, security, performance, maintainability), dual text and HTML report output, and an on-demand reference knowledge base.
description.zh: 模板驱动的代码审查技能：五步审查流程、严重/中等/轻微三级分级、四维评分（质量、安全、性能、可维护性），同时输出文本与 HTML 报告，内置按需加载的参考知识库。

description.en: Skill that fact-checks a claim against the open web rather than model memory: it splits the claim into independently checkable fact points, routes each point to the primary-source ladder for its domain (policy, academic, medical, financial, disaster and accidents, food safety, science, education, sports, entertainment, judicial, and more), searches domestic and international ecosystems in parallel, fetches primary pages, grades sources by type, re-searches with debunking keywords, and reports conclusion-first with a full URL and citation position behind every statement, keeping unverified and undecidable points separate from confirmed ones. Three factual judgements can be routed to a TypeSafe Jev (System One) decision model when a key is configured, falling back to the skill's deterministic rules when it is not; a model verdict can only lower a confidence tier.
description.zh: 事实核查技能：不依赖模型记忆，去公开互联网核实——把论断拆成可独立验证的事实点，先按事实范畴（政策、学术、医疗、金融、灾害事故、食品安全、科学常识、教育考试、体育、娱乐名人、司法案件等）选定该范畴的一手来源阶梯，国内外信息生态并行搜索，抓取一手页面并按来源类型分级，再用质疑关键词反查一轮，最后结论先行地输出报告，每条论断都带完整 URL 与引用位置，「未证实」「无法裁定」与「已证实」分档呈现。三类事实判断在配置了密钥时可交给 TypeSafe Jev（System One）决策模型，未配置则回退到内置的确定性规则；模型的判断只能降档、不能升档。

description.en: Beginner starter pack for DeepSeek Harness: welcome flow, 0→1 learning path, scenario-based plugin recommendations and a self-check checklist, paired with the dsh-handbook-zh Chinese tutorial repo.
description.zh: DSH 新手入门包：欢迎语、从 0 到 1 学习路径、按场景推荐插件与新手自查清单，联动 dsh-handbook-zh 中文教程仓库。

description.en: Competition math (IMO/Putnam/USAMO/AIME) solved with a pure-reasoning pass, an adversarial verifier in a fresh subagent context, and calibrated confidence output (high / medium / honest "no confident solution"); optional LaTeX-to-PDF rendering.
description.zh: 竞赛数学解题（IMO/Putnam/USAMO/AIME）：纯推理求解 + 新鲜上下文 subagent 对抗验证 + 校准信心输出（high / medium / 诚实「无把握解」）；可选 LaTeX 编译 PDF。

description.en: Legacy code modernization workflow (preflight -> assess -> map -> transform) with a Cordis mount plugin, offline Python scripts and smoke tests.
description.zh: 遗留代码现代化工作流（preflight → assess → map → transform），含 Cordis 挂载插件、离线 Python 脚本与冒烟测试。

description.en: One-shot DSH skill (SKILL.md) generator: capture intent, draft, validate, package and distribute skills from inside a DeepSeek Harness session (skill_new / skill_validate / skill_package / skill_improve_description).
description.zh: 一键生成 DSH 技能（SKILL.md）的 Cordis 插件：在会话内捕获意图、起草、校验、打包分发并优化技能描述（skill_new / skill_validate / skill_package / skill_improve_description）。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skill bundle for Hearts of Iron IV 1.19.3 modding: scaffold a mod, focus trees, events, decisions, ideas, characters, technologies, MIO, special projects, GUI, localisation, DDS, static verifier, installer and error.log triage. Bundled Python tools; no game assets.
description.zh: 面向《钢铁雄心 IV》1.19.3 模组开发的 DSH 技能包：搭模组骨架、国策树、事件、决议、理念、人物、科技、MIO、特殊项目、界面、本地化、DDS、静态校验、安装器与 error.log 排查。随包提供 Python 工具，不含游戏素材。

description.en: Browses and manages user skills already on disk in DSH and supported agent home directories.
description.zh: 浏览和管理 DSH 及受支持 Agent 主目录中已有的用户技能。

description.en: Spring Boot admin toolkit: EasyExcel batch import/export code generation and Thymeleaf + LayUI template safety guard.
description.zh: Spring Boot 后台开发套件：EasyExcel 批量导入导出代码生成与 Thymeleaf + LayUI 模板安全守卫。

description.en: Tag-based skill filtering: attach tags to DSH skills, then hand each workspace or conversation only the subset its boolean tag expression selects (for example `pdf + docx` or `aegis * plugin`). Excluded skills are deny-shadowed out of the model catalog rather than merely hidden in the settings UI; skills outside the expression can still be added by hand or force-disabled, and the bundled `tagging-skills` teaches the agent to derive a tag set from the machine it is running on.
description.zh: 按标签筛选技能：给 DSH 技能打标签，再用布尔表达式为每个工作区或对话选出下发给模型的子集（例如 `pdf + docx` 或 `aegis * plugin`）。命中以外的技能会被 deny-shadow 真正从模型目录里移走，而不只是在设置页隐藏；表达式之外的技能可手动添加或强制禁用，另附带 `tagging-skills` 教 agent 从本机技能清单自建标签体系。

description.en: Skill pack plugin: the 25 promoted skills from mattpocock/skills (engineering and productivity), translated to Chinese, registered as a bundled DSH skill provider.
description.zh: 技能包插件：把 mattpocock/skills 的 25 个 promoted 技能（工程与效率）全文汉化，注册为 DSH 捆绑技能 provider，经技能系统发现与调用。

description.en: Action Hub for DSH: a standard Agent Skill library whose SKILL.md files can run as model-visible Skills or user-only Commands, with groups, project scopes, import/export and a native Alt+A palette.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的标准 Agent Skill 库：同一份 SKILL.md 可作为模型可见的 Skill 或仅由用户调用的 Command，支持分组、项目范围、导入导出和原生 Alt+A 面板。

description.en: Expert center: browse and import WorkBuddy experts, create experts with AI, edit role.md and skills, and switch experts per session.
description.zh: 专家中心：浏览并导入 WorkBuddy 专家，用 AI 创建专家、编辑 role.md 与技能，并按会话切换专家。

description.en: A skills button at the bottom-right of the input box: one click opens every installed skill with search, categories and favourites, and the skill you pick is inserted into the box. Each answer also lists the skills that turn actually used.
description.zh: 输入框右下方有一个「技能」按钮，点开就能搜技能、按分类浏览、收藏常用的，选中后直接插进输入框；回答下方还会列出这一轮真正调用过的技能。

description.en: Embedded C/C++ firmware development toolbox: agents and skills covering FreeRTOS, interrupts, NVM storage, Keil MDK, ARMCLANG, HardFault triage, state machines, architecture, and LVGL patterns.
description.zh: 嵌入式 C/C++ 固件开发工具箱：代理与技能覆盖 FreeRTOS、中断、NVM 存储、Keil MDK、ARMCLANG、HardFault 分析、状态机、架构原则与 LVGL 陷阱。

description.en: Claim-verification skill that checks design documents and plans against codebase facts, escalating behavioral claims to executable logic-primitive verification for state machines and data models, with before/after regression, domain constraints, and concurrency risk mining.
description.zh: 声称核查技能：将设计文档与计划中的每条声称对照代码库事实核验，行为类声称升级为状态机/数据模型逻辑原语验证，支持前后回归、领域约束与并发风险挖掘。

description.en: Multi-agent workflow for math-modeling contests: the "UltraMath" preset runs a problem from reading through framework, derivation, coding, verification, paper and review, plus 4 single-stage role presets (mathematician, engineer, writer, reviewer) and 33 model-library skill docs.
description.zh: 数学建模竞赛多 Agent 求解工作流：「UltraMath」主控预设一个预设跑通 读题→框架→推导→编码→验算→论文→审稿 全流程，另有 数学家/工程师/作家/审稿人 4 个单阶段角色预设与 33 篇模型库技能文档。

description.en: Manage DSH skills and commands from Settings: list, enable/disable, edit, delete and add skills across global and project scopes, and save reusable prompts as slash commands.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理技能与命令：跨全局与项目作用域查看、启用/停用、编辑、删除与添加技能，并把常用提示词保存为斜杠命令。

description.en: Modular AI research/engineering skill pack, installable via dsh plugin add — registers 27 skills (security audit, paper reading/writing, figure drawing, dev workflow, storage analysis) on ctx.skills.

description.en: Adds a Vivado session preset to dsh with an FPGA engineering-discipline persona (global serialization, pure-ASCII paths, evidence-first conclusions, detached long builds) and mounts eight bundled AMD/FPGA skills from the package itself; installing the preset needs no Vivado or vivado-mcp installation.

Requires Python 3.10+; platform/AI subtitles need a Bilibili SESSDATA cookie; OCR/ASR/PDF need ffmpeg, faster-whisper and LibreOffice or reportlab.
description.zh: 从 Bilibili 视频或本地视频提取字幕，输出 Markdown、Word、PDF、TXT、SRT 或 JSON，支持时间戳、双语对齐和质量报告。需 Python 3.10+；平台/AI 字幕需 Bilibili SESSDATA Cookie；OCR/ASR/PDF 需 ffmpeg、faster-whisper，以及 LibreOffice 或 reportlab。

description.en: Windows PowerShell 5.1 skill for downloading large GitHub release assets: it first read-only probes the host (listening local proxy ports, system proxy and env vars, an installed Clash Verge core and its config, curl version), measures KB/s of four routes in parallel (existing proxy, headless-spawned core, public mirrors, direct), runs a short time-boxed concurrency ladder on the winner, then downloads the asset in parallel curl byte ranges and verifies the byte count plus SHA256 against the release digest. Skips the ladder when the asset is under 100 MB or a single connection already reaches 3 MB/s, because concurrency only pays off when a single connection is throttled: measured 6.3x on a throttled node (1,234 to 7,759 KB/s) but 0.72x on a fast one (5,829 vs 4,175 KB/s). Needs no aria2 or 7z, never changes the system proxy, never asks the user for ports or concurrency, reports ASSET_NOT_FOUND with the real candidate names instead of silently picking a different file, and degrades to a size-only check with DOWNLOAD_SIZE_OK_NO_DIGEST when a release predates digests.
description.zh: 在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 上下载 GitHub Release 大资产的技能：先只读自检宿主环境（在监听的本地代理端口、系统代理与环境变量、已安装的 Clash Verge 内核及其配置、curl 版本），四条路线（现有代理 / 无头拉起内核 / 公共镜像 / 直连）并行实测 KB/s，在胜出路线上做限时并发阶梯，再用 curl 多段 range 并发下载，并按 release 的 digest 校验字节数与 SHA256。资产小于 100 MB 或单连接已到 3 MB/s 时直接跳过阶梯——并发只在「单连接被限速」时才有收益：实测限速节点 6.3×（1,234 → 7,759 KB/s），节点不限速时反而是 0.72×（单流 5,829 vs 16 段 4,175 KB/s）。不要求预装 aria2/7z，不改系统代理，不向用户索要端口或并发数；资产名对不上会报 ASSET_NOT_FOUND 并列出真实候选，绝不静默换文件；老 release 没有 digest 时降级为 DOWNLOAD_SIZE_OK_NO_DIGEST。

description.en: Registers the domestic-China trip-planning skill: hour-level daily timelines, 12306 and Trip.com booking deep links, offline KML, and seven HTML themes. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH (the bundled scripts are standard-library only).
description.zh: 把境内旅行规划技能注册进 DSH 技能目录：逐小时每日时间线、12306 与携程/去哪儿预订深链、离线 KML 与七套 HTML 主题。需 PATH 上有 Python 3.9+（内置脚本仅依赖标准库）。

description.en: In-GUI skill hub for DeepSeek Harness: browse, search, toggle, inspect, diagnose and scaffold local skills from the official ctx.skills registry, plus a skill market with tracked source sync and one-click update-all.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 技能中枢：基于官方 ctx.skills 注册表浏览、搜索、启停、查看、诊断并新建本地技能，附技能市场：来源快照跟踪、一键全量更新。

description.en: C++ audit skill: detects the target project's actual C++ standard before making any recommendation, then reports findings across RAII and ownership, move semantics, exception safety, performance and memory, containers and algorithms, concurrency, templates and compile-time, standard boundary, and type safety, ABI and interface design, each with a checkpoint, a reason, a bad-to-good example and the minimum standard.
description.zh: C++ 审查技能：先探测目标工程真实的 C++ 标准再给建议，随后按 RAII 与所有权、移动语义、异常安全、性能与内存、容器与算法、并发、模板与编译期、标准边界、类型安全、ABI 与接口设计逐条给出结论，每条含检查点、原因、反例→正例与适用标准。

description.en: Barrage-meme skill distilled from 22,771 real messages in the 6657 live room: wanjiqi-style banter, CS and DOTA cross-memes, player roasting and casting commentary.
description.zh: 玩机器（6657 直播间）烂梗技能包：22771 条真实弹幕蒸馏而成，涵盖玩机器式弹幕烂梗、CS×DOTA 双料梗、选手锐评与解说吐槽。

description.en: A gated math-modeling skill suite for DeepSeek Harness: a five-stage pipeline with stage gates, award-paper writing patterns, sensitivity analysis, statistical diagnosis, and a contest preset.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的门控式数学建模 skill 套件：五阶段流水线、阶段门、国奖写作范式、灵敏度分析、统计诊断与竞赛预设。

description.en: Skills for building websites on the Creght platform: CLI pull/push sync, page and component conventions, CMS, forms, auth, SEO, publishing and version rollback.
description.zh: Creght 平台建站技能包：CLI 拉取/推送同步、页面与组件规范、CMS、表单、Auth、SEO、发布与版本回滚。

description.en: Invoke DSH skills with a $name gesture instead of /name, with a composer picker and the same blue text-reference decoration as /name.
description.zh: 用 $name 手势调用 DSH skill（与 / 命令不冲突），带输入框候选菜单，并让 $name 获得与 /name 相同的蓝色文本引用高亮。

description.en: Manage installed DeepSeek Harness skills from settings: list, search, view rendered docs, copy content, open the folder, soft-delete to a recoverable trash, and try a skill out.
description.zh: 在设置中管理 DSH 已安装技能：列表、搜索、查看渲染后的文档、复制内容、打开文件夹、软删除到可恢复的回收站、立即试用。

description.en: Adds SKILL.md bundles from nested subfolders of the standard DSH skill roots to the catalog, with settings for depth, watching, and extra roots.
description.zh: 把标准 DSH 技能根目录下嵌套子文件夹中的 SKILL.md 技能包加入目录，并可在设置中调整深度、监听和额外根目录。

description.en: Installs the coaligne-workflow skill for CoAligne team collaboration; requires CoAligne Desktop (signed in) to provide the MCP connection - not usable without Desktop.
description.zh: 安装 CoAligne 团队协作的 coaligne-workflow skill；MCP 连接由登录后的 CoAligne Desktop 提供，不安装 Desktop 则无法使用。

description.en: Skill provider that installs the whole @dennisrongo/skills catalog as one npm dependency, so skills install and update without cloning or linking directories.
description.zh: 技能提供者：将整个 @dennisrongo/skills 目录作为一个 npm 依赖安装，无需克隆仓库或链接目录即可完成技能的安装与更新。

description.en: Serves the obra/superpowers skill catalog to the harness and injects its using-superpowers bootstrap as a persistent, compaction-safe system-prompt section.
description.zh: 向 dsh 提供 obra/superpowers 技能目录，并将其 using-superpowers 引导作为持久、压缩安全的系统提示区块注入。

description.en: Complete chinese-traditional-wisdom (玄枢 / XuanShu) skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: bazi, ziwei-doushu, liuyao, meihua, qimen, daliuren, taiyi, wuyun-liuqi, constitution and fengshui calculation, with a local deterministic engine and a visualization dashboard.
description.zh: 完整中华传统智慧（玄枢 / XuanShu）技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness Cordis 插件：八字、紫微斗数、六爻、梅花易数、奇门遁甲、大六壬、太乙、五运六气、中医体质与风水推算，内置本地确定性引擎与可视化 Dashboard。

description.en: Complete reverse-skill pack (85 SKILL.md) as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: reverse engineering, authorized pentesting and security-research skill router.
description.zh: 完整 reverse-skill（85 个 SKILL.md）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包。

description.en: Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi calculation, clinical pattern differentiation, and pathogenesis reasoning.
description.zh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

description.en: Registers the imagegen skill on the skill registry, so generating and editing raster images needs no hand-copied files under $DSH_HOME/skills. The agent drives a bundled image_gen.py CLI against any OpenAI-compatible GPT Image endpoint for text-to-image, reference-image editing, and transparent-background cutouts.
description.zh: 把 imagegen skill 注册进 skill 注册表，无需往 $DSH_HOME/skills 手工拷贝文件，每个会话都能生成或编辑图片：agent 调用随包附带的 image_gen.py CLI，对接任意 OpenAI 兼容的 GPT Image 端点，支持文生图、参考图编辑与透明背景抠图。

description.en: Windows only (desktop Word + full MathType 7 + Python 3.10+). Convert LaTeX placeholders in a Word .docx into real MathType OLE equations (Equation.DSMT4), preserving equation numbers, SEQ fields and cross-references.
description.zh: 仅 Windows（需桌面版 Word、完整版 MathType 7 与 Python 3.10+）。把 Word 文档中的 LaTeX 占位符转换为真正的 MathType OLE 公式（Equation.DSMT4），保留公式编号、SEQ 域与交叉引用。

description.en: Eight academic skills bundled for one-command install — publication-ready academic figures designed from real data with visual review, AI-text humanization, paper polishing and rewriting, PubMed citation verification (DOI/PMID reconciliation), Chinese citation and medical-book reference checks, and WeChat medical article structuring. Three skills run fully local, five call external services only when used (NCBI E-utilities, DOI resolvers, publishing platforms), declared per skill. Zero telemetry, no install-time scripts. Skills run local Python 3.8+; the academic-figures skill also needs its pip dependencies installed.
description.zh: 八个学术技能一次装齐——学术图表（按真实数据设计+视觉审核）、去 AI 味改写、论文润色与改写、PubMed 引文核验（DOI/PMID 逐条对账）、中文著作引用核验、公众号医学文章结构化。三项纯本地运行，五项按功能访问外部服务（NCBI、DOI 解析、发布平台）并逐技能如实声明；零遥测、无安装期脚本。技能经本机 Python 3.8+ 运行；academic-figures 另需安装其 pip 依赖。

description.en: Shows which skills each turn invoked and installs, updates or removes skills inside the app.
description.zh: 显示每轮对话实际调用了哪些技能，并可在应用内安装、更新与删除技能。

description.en: Generates complete AI songs (vocals plus full arrangement) from a theme or from provided lyrics, and instrumental BGM, through a bundled xiapan-music skill and a xiapan_music DSH tool; also queries the Xiapan API balance. Uses a user-supplied Xiapan API key (BYOK), and saves the generated mp3 files on the DSH host.
description.zh: 通过内置的 xiapan-music 技能与 xiapan_music 工具，按主题或已有歌词生成完整 AI 歌曲（人声与完整编曲） 以及纯音乐 BGM，并可查询虾盘云 API 余额；使用用户自带的虾盘云 Key（BYOK），生成的 mp3 保存在 DSH 主机上。

description.en: Registers a web-design skill and a compact system-prompt rule set for a three-layer shadcn/ui, Canvas UI and ThreeUI workflow, with Radix UI Colors and strict interface rules.
description.zh: 注册一个网页设计技能和一组系统提示规则，按 shadcn/ui、Canvas UI、ThreeUI 三层体系执行，并强制 Radix UI Colors 与界面细节规范。

description.en: Lighten the load on your agent: one-click toggles for skills and MCP, so the context holds only what this turn actually needs. Skills and MCP servers you switch off are no longer injected into the model context — cleaner, and lighter on tokens.
description.zh: 给你的 Agent 减负：Skill 与 MCP 一键启停，让上下文只装这一轮真正要用的能力。关掉的 skill / MCP 不再进入模型上下文，更干净，更省 token。

description.en: Searches the installed skill catalog on a trigger word, requires a use-or-skip decision for every candidate, and blocks other tools until all selected skills are loaded.
description.zh: 触发词命中后先检索本机已安装的 skill，要求对每个候选登记使用或弃用的理由，并拦住其它工具直到选定的 skill 全部加载。

description.en: DSH project scaffold preset: strict 5-phase init runbook, engineering standards and six runnable starter templates (node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo).
description.zh: DSH 项目初始化脚手架预设：严格 5 阶段初始化流程 + 工程规范 + 六套可运行模板（node-ts / react-vite / python / go / spring-boot / monorepo）。

description.en: Trusted office suite for government/enterprise work by Beijing Caizhi Technology (深知可信智能): three skills — trusted consulting (policy/regulation Q&A with citation markers + provenance HTML), trusted search (authoritative policy/standard retrieval with traceable HTML + clean Markdown), and official-document writing (draft/rewrite/Word/red-head delivery); all interfaces go through the dknowc trusted workbench MCP (Bearer auth), products land in the session workspace, one-time key setup persists for later sessions; ships on npm as dknowc-dsh.
description.zh: 彩智科技深知可信智能出品的可信办公全家桶 dsh 插件：包含深知可信咨询（政策/法规/办事问答，带真实来源角标 + 可点击溯源 HTML）、深知可信搜索（权威政策/标准检索与深度研究，溯源 HTML + 干净 Markdown）、深知公文写作（正式公文起草/改写/Word/红头交付）三个 Skill；接口统一经深知可信工作台 MCP 转接（Bearer 认证），产物写入会话工作区，API Key 一次配置长期免注册；已发布 npm 包 dknowc-dsh。

description.en: Zotero skill for DeepSeek Harness: page-anchored Q&A, full-text translation and close reading, native highlights and Chinese notes, bilingual PDF and paragraph Markdown, evidence comparison tables, and reviews with citation tracking; finds papers on OpenAlex or Crossref, imports Chinese CNKI export files, classifies the library into research-direction folders, surfaces research gaps, and runs a ranked daily digest of new papers. Python-based (basic library management uses the standard library; the reading workflow downloads its PDF/OCR components on first use); writes need a one-time Zotero authorization, and daily scheduling is Windows-only. Adapted from the OpenAI MIT Zotero plugin.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Zotero 文献技能：原文定位问答、全文翻译与精读、原生高亮和中文批注、双语 PDF 与逐段 Markdown、论文证据对比表、综述与引用追踪；支持 OpenAlex / Crossref / 知网导出文件三种来源，按研究方向建文件夹分类、提炼脉络、发现空白，并可每日自动收录新论文。基于 Python（基础文献管理用标准库，阅读流程首次使用时下载 PDF/OCR 组件）；写入需一次性 Zotero 授权，每日定时收录仅支持 Windows。改编自 OpenAI 的 MIT Zotero 插件。

description.en: Website cloning methodology skill: a real-source-first decision tree covering static sites, React/Vue/Next content sites and WebGL/Canvas-heavy fronts, mandatory verification of executable code quoted from second-hand AI analyses, and 13 zero-dependency Node scripts for CDP browser recon, asset/font harvesting, route crawling, sourcemap hunting and pixel-diff auditing.
description.zh: 网站复刻方法论 skill：以「真源码至上」决策树覆盖静态站、React/Vue/Next 内容站与 WebGL/Canvas 重前端站，强制核对二手 AI 分析里的可执行代码，内置 13 个零依赖 Node 脚本（CDP 浏览器侦察、素材/字体抓取、路由爬取、source map 挖掘、像素 diff 审计）。

description.en: Skill usage scoreboard for DSH: counts both per-session deduplicated and per-load usage, scores `skill` tool calls and direct `read` of skill files, and shows the tally in a three-tab settings page (skill ranking, session board, management) with paging and JSON import/export.
description.zh: DSH 的 Skill 使用记分板：同时记录按会话去重与每次加载两种次数，统计 skill 工具调用与直接 read skill 文件两种记分来源，设置页三选项卡（Skill 排行 / 会话榜 / 管理）展示，支持分页与记分 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: Bundled Pixiv skill backed by a Python CLI: search illustrations, manga and novels, browse daily/weekly/monthly/rookie/original/AI/R-18 rankings, look up works, novel series and artists, and download originals, with multi-page works merged into PDF, ugoira converted to GIF and novel series merged into TXT; requires Python 3.9+ with requests, img2pdf and Pillow installed (pip install -r requirements.txt), and R-18 content needs your own Pixiv cookie.
description.zh: 内置 Pixiv 技能，由 Python 命令行脚本实现：搜索插画、漫画、小说，查看日榜/周榜/月榜/新人榜/原创榜/AI 榜/R-18 榜，查询作品、小说系列和画师详情，下载原图，多页作品合成 PDF、动图转 GIF、小说系列合并成 TXT；需要 Python 3.9 以上并装好 requests / img2pdf / Pillow（pip install -r requirements.txt），R-18 内容需要自己的 Pixiv Cookie。

description.en: Registers the eight official GSAP AI skills in DeepSeek Harness; the skill bodies ship inside the plugin, so it works after installing and restarting with no configuration, account or API key.
description.zh: 把 GSAP 官方的 8 个 AI 技能注册进 DeepSeek Harness；技能正文随包分发，装完重启即可使用，无需配置、账号或密钥。

description.en: dsh port of the shared handoff kit: handoff and task-id-bootstrap skills plus host-side automation — baseline state injection, per-turn snapshots with an Auto Log trail, task=<id> routing, continuation re-injection, a compaction guard with clear-required alerts, and read-only subagent handling — all writing the same .agents/state/ as the Codex, Claude, and pi editions for one-repo multi-agent handoff.
description.zh: 共享交接套件的 dsh 版:handoff 与 task-id-bootstrap 技能 + host 侧自动化——基线状态注入、每轮快照与 Auto Log 轨迹、task=<id> 路由、续接关键词重注入、达阈值报警的压缩守护、子代理只读保护;与 Codex、Claude、pi 版写同一份 .agents/state/,一个仓库多代理共享交接。

description.en: Skill panel: browse skills by source, group them into colored folders, preview files, export a skill as zip, copy one into the project, rename it on disk, and insert /skill calls from a composer menu.
description.zh: 技能面板：按来源浏览 skill，用彩色分类文件夹归类，预览文件，导出 zip、复制到项目、在磁盘上重命名，并在输入区菜单里插入 /skill 调用。

description.en: Doxygen comment workflow for C/C++ (including Qt) sources: file headers, functions, module groups, trailing and short comments, plus a scan that flags comments whose signature fingerprint went stale. Requires Python 3.10+ with `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`.
description.zh: 为 C/C++（含 Qt）源码生成与维护 Doxygen 注释的工作流：文件头、函数、模块分组、行尾与简短注释，并扫描出签名指纹已过期、需要更新的注释。运行时需要 Python 3.10+ 并 `pip install tree-sitter tree-sitter-cpp`。

description.en: Type /私 and complete 私家大厨 — Chinese skill names, zero renaming. Patches DSH skill discovery, the / gesture and the skill tool so any Unicode SKILL.md name (私家大厨, 卡路里, 作息管家…) works: slash completion, direct /私家大厨 invocation, model skill({name}) loading. Zero config; runtime changes revert on uninstall, but the regex patch written into three DSH packages on disk stays until the next DSH upgrade replaces those files.
description.zh: 中文技能名零改造直用：输入 /私 自动补全 私家大厨。为 DSH 打上技能发现、斜杠手势与 skill 工具补丁，Unicode 技能名（私家大厨/卡路里/作息管家…）补全、直达、加载全可用；不改 SKILL.md、零配置；运行时改动随卸载恢复，但写进 DSH 三个依赖包磁盘文件里的正则补丁会保留到下次 DSH 升级覆盖为止。

description.en: 🌹 Installs with 27 engineering and productivity skills bundled (mattpocock/skills v1.3.1), no manual skill installation needed. Built with 40 billion tokens. This plugin delivers 10x development efficiency on top of the original skills and helps newcomers get started with the skill suite faster. GitHub issues are fully supported; Markdown is a preview; GitLab is not supported yet. Thank you for using and supporting us.
description.zh: 🌹安装即自带mattpocock/skills v1.3.1的27个工程与效率技能，无需手动装技能。400亿token打造本插件，在原始技能之上提供10倍的开发效率，也能帮助新手更快上手该技能套件。全力支持GitHub issue；Markdown为预览版；GitLab暂不支持。感谢您的使用和支持💗

description.en: Decides whether Python code is original or a derivative work: reports the longest identical expression span against an upstream tree, an exemption rationale per finding, and a risk list. Pure stdlib `ast` analysis — offline, no model calls.
description.zh: 判定 Python 代码是原创还是演绎作品：给出与上游最长相同表达片段、逐条豁免依据和风险清单。纯标准库 `ast` 分析——离线运行，不调用模型。

description.en: Makes 1080x1920 vertical promo videos from a storyboard JSON with 7 tools (doctor, setup, catalog, guide, validate, render, verify), rendered locally with Remotion.
description.zh: 从分镜 JSON 生成 1080×1920 竖版宣传片，含 7 个工具（doctor、setup、catalog、guide、validate、render、verify），用 Remotion 本地渲染。

description.en: QA pipeline as 10 agent skills: requirement analysis, test strategy, case writing and review, E2E (Playwright) and API automation, exploratory, regression scope and bug analysis, backed by a shared knowledge base with format rules, risk model and schema validators.
description.zh: 软件测试全流程技能包：10 个技能覆盖需求分析、测试策略、用例编写与审查、E2E（Playwright）与 API 自动化、探索式测试、回归范围与 Bug 分析，共享知识库提供格式规范、风险模型与 Schema 校验脚本。

description.en: A fork of Microsoft's official .NET/C# skills for AI coding agents, additionally packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin — covering development, testing, diagnostics, migration, and AI integration.
description.zh: 微软官方 .NET/C# AI 编码智能体技能的 fork，额外打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件——覆盖开发、测试、诊断、迁移与 AI 集成。

description.en: Registers the fnOS CLI Skill and provides a matching CLI for fnOS device operations. For first sign-in, the user authorizes access in a browser and sends a one-time code back to the Agent; no interactive terminal is required.
description.zh: 注册 fnOS CLI Skill 并提供匹配版本的 CLI，用于管理 fnOS 设备；首次登录由用户在浏览器授权后，将一次性 code 回传 Agent，无需交互式终端。

description.en: Skill panel for the DSH Web GUI: lists every installed skill with Chinese annotations and eight category filters, runs pinyin and fuzzy search, ranks by pin and recency, and manages each skill in place (pin, disable, reveal, uninstall with undo). Ships its own maintenance skill.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的技能面板：列出全部已安装技能并附中文备注，提供八类分类筛选、拼音与模糊搜索、置顶与最近使用排序，可原地管理每个技能（置顶、关闭、定位、卸载并可撤回）。随包自带一个维护技能。

description.en: WeChat Official Account content studio: anti-homogenization rotation writing, low-creativity remediation playbook, blessing-image visual baseline, gpt-image pipeline with OCR acceptance, and the measured xiaolvshu draft web API.
description.zh: 微信公众号内容生产工作台：防低创作度结构轮换写作法、低创作度整改实战、祝福图视觉基线、gpt-image 配图管线与 OCR 验收、小绿书草稿网页接口实测参数。

description.en: Agent-managed procedural memory: a skill_manage tool that creates, patches, disables and deletes the agent's own skills in user or project scope, with delete guards (agent-created marker, pin, path confinement) and a trigger-discipline prompt.
description.zh: 代理自管的程序性记忆：skill_manage 工具可创建、修补、禁用、删除 agent 自己的技能（用户级/项目级双作用域），带删除守卫（agent 创建标记、pin、路径限制）与触发纪律提示。

description.en: Software-engineering method pack for coding agents, with skills for baseline-first planning, systematic debugging, prompt hygiene, verification before completion, and repair/retirement tracking.
description.zh: 面向编码 Agent 的软件工程方法包，提供基线优先规划、系统化调试、提示词卫生、完成前验证，以及修复/退役双轨跟踪技能。

description.en: Ships a skill that documents how to build, debug and publish DSH plugins - host and client package skeleton, developing a forked plugin inside a throwaway profile, publishing to GitHub and npm, and the pitfalls found while shipping them. Installing the plugin registers the skill.
description.zh: 携带一份技能，讲怎么开发、调试、发布 DSH 插件——host/client 双半包骨架、把 fork 挂进丢弃式 profile 开发、发布到 GitHub 与 npm，以及发布过程中实际踩到的坑。安装插件即注册该技能。

description.en: Ships a skill about writing DSH skills - SKILL.md frontmatter and root precedence, how to phrase a description so it actually triggers, length and splitting rules, and an A/B check that the finished skill changes agent behaviour. The package also carries the checker the skill uses to validate a skill directory.
description.zh: 携带一份讲怎么写 DSH 技能的技能——SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 与技能根优先级、description 怎么写才会被触发、篇幅与拆分标准，以及「写完后怎么证明它真管用」的 A/B 验证。包里还带着供这份技能校验技能目录的检查脚本。

description.en: Daoist Canon (DaoZang) retrieval skill: keyword or semantic search over 285,117 scripture chunks with exact original-text extraction (line numbers, hit markers), and one-command workspace setup from the Godners/DaoZang dataset.
description.zh: 道藏知识库离线检索与原文提取：对 28.5 万段经文进行关键词或语义检索，精确提取原文（带行号与命中标记），可从 Godners/DaoZang 数据集一键搭建工作区。

description.en: Scans the skills DSH can load into one browsable catalog organized as collection, category and command, with a sidebar panel, click-to-insert into the composer, and custom categories and per-command notes saved outside the plugin directory.
description.zh: 把 DSH 能加载的技能扫成一份可浏览目录，按集合、分类、命令三级组织，提供侧边栏面板与点击插入输入框，自定义分类与命令说明保存在插件目录之外。

description.en: 273 ECC skills (95.8% of the 227k-star operator system) ported to DSH in four batches.
description.zh: ECC（227k⭐ 操作员系统）273 个技能（95.8%）分四批移植到 DSH。

description.en: Ponytail lazy senior dev mode: 6 skills adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail.
description.zh: Ponytail 最懒资深工程师模式：6 个技能，改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail。

description.en: Matt Pocock full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code review, wayfinder, ask-matt router) ported to DSH.
description.zh: Matt Pocock 完整发布技能集（25 个 SKILL.md）的 DSH 移植。

description.en: Matt Pocock's 25 skills fully translated to Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses).
description.zh: Matt Pocock 25 个技能正文全译中文（技术术语保留英文并附注释）。

description.en: Goal mode and autonomous execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a sticky top banner keeps the current goal visible across turns while the agent works toward it autonomously.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的目标模式与自主执行插件：顶部吸附横幅在每轮对话中保持当前目标可见，同时 Agent 自主推进完成目标。

description.en: Runs Superpowers as an agent preset and gives each skill its own subagent model from a Settings table, so TDD, debugging and verification no longer all inherit the parent model.
description.zh: 把 Superpowers 作为 Agent 预设运行，并在设置表里为每个技能单独指定子代理模型，测试、系统调试与收尾验证不再全部沿用父会话的模型。

description.en: Registers the RainSkills bootstrap skill in DeepSeek Harness for deploying, troubleshooting, and verifying applications on Rainbond.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 RainSkills 引导技能，用于通过 Rainbond 部署、排障和验证应用。

description.en: Manage skills, MCP servers, instruction files, custom commands and hooks.
description.zh: 管理 Skill、MCP 服务器、指令文件、自定义命令和 Hooks。

description.en: Douyin patent and trademark complaint workflow for DeepSeek Harness with a left-sidebar task panel: checks user-supplied links, materials and organization identity in a dedicated browser, records each submission state, queries platform history read-only, and shows local task counts in the sidebar; never discovers targets or submits without explicit authorization.
description.zh: 抖音专利/商标侵权举报插件：左侧栏任务面板 + 专用浏览器核对本次链接、证明材料与组织身份，记录提交状态，只读查询平台历史回执；不自动发现举报对象，未明确授权不提交。

description.en: Skill for packaging DeepSeek Harness into a Tauri 2 desktop app (macOS + Windows): dual-platform install playbook, China mirror bootstrap with a subagent timeout sentinel, admin-free Windows toolchain recipe (no VS Build Tools), and three-path acceptance checklists.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows）的技能包：双平台安装、国内镜像加速（含 subagent 超时哨兵）、无管理员 Windows 工具链方案、三路径验收清单。

description.en: Registers the fight-scene-director skill for designing AI-video fight scenes, ported from the Codex skill of the same name. Emits structured Chinese prompts for Seedance 2.0/2.5 and MiniMax H3, plus trajectory-map and initial-position image prompts.
description.zh: 把 fight-scene-director 打戏设计技能注册进 DSH，移植自同名 Codex 技能。输出适配 Seedance 2.0/2.5 与 MiniMax H3 的结构化中文提示词，并支持轨迹图与初始站位图生图提示词。

description.en: OMX-style workflow skills for DeepSeek Harness: deep-interview, ralplan, ralph, autopilot, team, code-review, visual-ralph, canslim-trader and 17 more, with autopilot defaulting to agent-team collaboration (Agent Teams), rewritten on native DSH tools including vision-backed UI matching.
description.zh: OMX 风格工作流技能集：deep-interview、ralplan、ralph、autopilot、team、code-review、visual-ralph、canslim-trader 等 25 个技能，autopilot 默认组队（Agent Teams），基于 DSH 原生工具重写，含视觉支持（参考图/基线 UI 对齐）。

description.en: Smart Charts skill: turns CSV/TSV/TXT/XLSX/XLS/JSON data files into standalone interactive ECharts HTML - 32 chart types including offline maps, 3 themes, no CDN. A --profile data profile (per-column dtype, cardinality, missingness, samples, statistics, entity grain, insight signals) lets the agent read the data and pick the chart itself; each chart embeds a fact sheet (plot_stats + data_preview) whose numbers are the only quotable values. LLM transform code runs in a restricted sandbox (blacklist + AST whitelist + safe builtins); --doctor self-checks the Python environment. Fully offline, ECharts bundled.
description.zh: 智能图表 skill：把 CSV/TSV/TXT/XLSX/XLS/JSON 数据文件转为独立交互式 ECharts HTML——32 种图表（含离线地图）、3 套主题、无需 CDN。--profile 数据画像（每列 dtype/基数/缺失/样本/统计、实体粒度、洞察信号）让 agent 自己读懂数据并决定选型；每张图内置事实卡（plot_stats + data_preview），其数值是解读时唯一可引用的数字。LLM 转换代码在受限沙箱（黑名单 + AST 白名单 + 安全 builtins）中执行；--doctor 自检 Python 环境。ECharts 离线打包，完全无需联网。

description.en: Skill center: browse and manage local Agent Skills, and search, preview and install skills from the ClawHub, ModelScope and QwenPaw marketplaces in one merged view with source and category filters; ships a `skill_hub` tool so the agent can install skills itself.
description.zh: 技能中心：浏览与管理本地 Agent Skills，并在同一视图中搜索、预览、安装 ClawHub、ModelScope、QwenPaw 三个市场的技能，支持来源与分类筛选；同时提供 skill_hub 工具，让 agent 也能自助安装技能。

description.en: Ponytail lazy-senior-dev ruleset for DeepSeek Harness: a 7-rung minimal-code ladder (YAGNI, reuse, stdlib, native, installed deps, one line, minimum), six skills (main rules, over-engineering review, repo audit, debt ledger, gain scoreboard, help), a /ponytail session command for lite/full/ultra/off levels, and optional always-on ruleset injection via config. Vendored verbatim from upstream ponytail (MIT), zero tools registered, clean uninstall.
description.zh: 把「最懒资深工程师」规则集 ponytail 装进 DeepSeek Harness：7 级最小代码阶梯（YAGNI、复用、标准库、平台原生、已装依赖、一行、最小实现），六个技能（主规则、过度工程 review、全仓 audit、debt 欠账台账、gain 计分板、help 速查），/ponytail 会话级调档命令（lite/full/ultra/off），以及可选的每轮常驻规则注入。上游内容 MIT 原样打包，零工具注册，卸载零残留。

description.en: Skill cockpit page in the DSH app-level nav (sidebar.panellist seat): lists every skill this machine actually exposes across all six skill-root kinds, explains why a skill is invisible (dropped reason, missing root, or disabled), and toggles one skill by renaming only its entry file (SKILL.md and SKILL.md.disabled); project-level skill roots stay read-only.
description.zh: DSH 应用级导航里的「技能中心」页（sidebar.panellist 席位）：列出本机实际暴露的全部技能（覆盖六类技能根），说明某技能为何不可见（被丢弃的原因、根目录缺失、已停用），只改入口文件名（SKILL.md 与 SKILL.md.disabled）即可单独启停；项目级技能根保持只读。

description.en: Provides six code quality skills for code review, architecture audits, technical debt, test quality, health dashboards, and remediation.
description.zh: 提供六个代码质量技能，涵盖代码审查、架构审计、技术债、测试质量、健康看板与修复。

description.en: Registers fifteen slash commands (/idea, /review, /poster, ...) that inject the matching research skill's SKILL.md as a user message, so installed skills run without a marketplace. The skills are not bundled and must already be under ~/.dsh/skills or ~/.agents/skills, otherwise commands report skill not found.
description.zh: 把装好的研究技能变成斜杠命令：/idea、/novelty、/review、/poster……一共十五条，敲一下就把对应的 SKILL.md 塞进对话，照着跑那个技能。技能不随包提供，须已装在 ~/.dsh/skills 或 ~/.agents/skills 下，否则命令只提示找不到技能。

description.en: Bundles the 14 obra/superpowers skills for dsh from a recorded upstream tag (v6.3.0), re-syncable with drift reporting; the skills trigger automatically.
description.zh: 把 obra/superpowers 的 14 个技能按已记录的上游 tag（v6.3.0）打包进 dsh，并可用带差异报告的命令重新同步；任务匹配时自动触发。

description.en: AI-for-Science research workflow skill for DeepSeek Harness, aimed at researchers and grad students using agentic AI: multi-angle literature review with per-angle files, experiment design with a caveat list, figures and paper reading; each job returns files plus a cross-verification brief for a second model. Zero deps, MIT.
description.zh: AI4S 科研工作流技能包，面向 AI for Science 与研究生/科研 Agent 用户：多角度文献调研（每角度落盘）、实验方案（含漏洞清单）、作图与精读；每单交付文件，附交叉验证任务书。零依赖，MIT。

description.en: Replaces the full skill catalog with keyword-based discovery, per-skill enable/disable switches, and system-prompt section controls. Disabled skills are refused by the skill tool, and their slash-command invocations are blocked at pre-step.
description.zh: 用关键词匹配替代完整技能目录，支持逐个技能的启停开关与系统提示词段落开关。被停用的技能会被 skill 工具拒绝，其斜杠调用也会在请求前被拦截。

description.en: Browse and search a SkillHub registry and manage local skill installation, updates, and removal inside DeepSeek Harness. Targets DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.2; not yet compatible with 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、搜索 SkillHub 技能，并管理本地技能的安装、更新和卸载。适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 与 0.2.1-rc.2，暂不兼容 0.2.1-rc.3。

description.en: Agent skills: browse, toggle and edit skills in the management page, and let the agent write new ones itself.
description.zh: Agent技能：在管理页里浏览、开关、编辑技能，也能让 Agent 自己写新技能。

description.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting / NeRF / computer-graphics research skills — 18 AI skills (paper reader, method compare, experiment planner, code reviewer, training debugger, visualizer, MCP renderer…) over a curated 1011-method catalog, plus a stdio MCP server for agent-driven 3DGS rendering.
description.zh: 3D 高斯泼溅 / NeRF / 图形学科研技能包——18 个 AI 技能（论文精读、方法对比、实验设计、代码审查、训练调试、可视化、MCP 渲染器…）覆盖 1011 个方法的精选目录，并带一个 stdio MCP 服务供 Agent 驱动 3DGS 渲染。

description.en: Turns a YouTube link into study notes: pulls the captions the video already publishes, optionally reads on-screen content with a vision model, then asks for your own notes and merges everything into one document. Requires python3, ffmpeg and yt-dlp on PATH (the skill stops with an install hint when they are missing).
description.zh: 把 YouTube 链接变成学习笔记：先取视频自带字幕，可选让视觉模型读画面，再问你自己的笔记，最后合并成一份文档。需 PATH 上有 python3、ffmpeg 与 yt-dlp（缺失时技能会停下来并给出安装提示）。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills covering planning, TDD, debugging, and code review.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能，覆盖规划、TDD、调试与代码评审。

description.en: Skill dossier + work report for DSH: browse, search and archive each skill (direction, scope, boundaries, scenarios), review or delete it, and roll daily briefs into daily, weekly and monthly reports.
description.zh: DSH 技能档案与工作汇报：浏览、搜索并为每个技能建档（方向/使用范围/能力边界/应用场景），复审与删除技能，并把每日简报汇成日报/周报/月报。

description.en: 11 shareable workflow skills (handoff, triage, to-spec, to-tickets, wayfinder, teach, wait-what, dsh-mode-routing, ask-matt, overnight-execution, full-throttle) as an installable skill pack.
description.zh: 11 个可分享的工作流 skills（handoff、triage、to-spec、to-tickets、wayfinder、teach、wait-what、dsh-mode-routing、ask-matt、overnight-execution、full-throttle），打包为可安装 bundle。

description.en: Coding agent preset plus an embedded coding-discipline skill for DeepSeek Harness: verify-first edits, minimal diffs, real test runs and evidence-based reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Coding 纪律强化插件：提供 Coding agent 预设与内嵌 coding-discipline 技能，强调先复现再修改、最小改动、真实跑测试与证据式汇报。

description.en: Deck-generation skill for the National College Student Career Planning Competition. It takes a contestant's profile, materials and photographs, drafts a page-by-page outline for confirmation, then renders a 15-20 page reading-type PPTX (under 15 pages is flagged as a page-count error) using 17 page types, three built-in themes or a user-supplied template; the build audits the estimated layout (text overflow, per-page word count, missing evaluation dimensions, material gaps) and the rendered PDF is checked again for out-of-bounds and overlapping text. Requires Python 3.9+ with python-pptx, python-docx and Pillow; LibreOffice (soffice) and pdftotext are optional for the PDF layout re-check.
description.zh: 职规赛（全国大学生职业规划大赛）展示 PPT 生成技能：给出选手信息、材料与照片后先出逐页大纲待确认，再渲染成 15–20 页的阅读型 PPTX（少于 15 页会被判为页数错误）（17 种页型、3 套主题，可套学校模板）；生成时审计估算版面（文字溢出、每页字数、评分维度覆盖、素材缺口），导出 PDF 后再复核一遍越界与压字。依赖 Python 3.9+ 及 python-pptx、python-docx、Pillow；PDF 版面复核可选依赖 LibreOffice（soffice）与 pdftotext。

description.en: Spec-driven development discipline for dsh: five keel skills (anchor/spec/probe/build/audit), three review tools and six spec templates enforce specs-before-code, assumption verification and scope control.
description.zh: 规格驱动开发纪律技能包（keel）：五个技能（锚定/立规/探针/建造/审计）、三个审查工具与六个规格模板，强制先规格后代码、假设先行验证并约束范围蔓延。

description.en: DSH bundle porting Matt Pocock's 25 promoted engineering and productivity agent skills (grilling, TDD, code review, domain modeling, etc.).
description.zh: 将 Matt Pocock 的 25 个精选工程与效率 Agent 技能（grilling、TDD、代码审查、领域建模等）移植为 DeepSeek Harness 插件包。

description.en: Injects a per-turn skill-selection preface chosen by the local JEV model of the jev-decision-kit workspace, so the agent loads exactly those skills instead of browsing. Requires a separately set-up jev-decision-kit workspace (Python .venv, host/preface_worker.py, models/jev/head.json); without it the plugin injects nothing.
description.zh: 每轮对话前用本机 JEV 模型选好技能，把一行选择结果作为前言注入，让智能体只加载该加载的技能。需另行准备好 jev-decision-kit 工作区（Python .venv、host/preface_worker.py、models/jev/head.json）；没有它插件不会注入任何内容。

description.en: AIEO (GEO/AEO) delivery method as one isolated skill provider: AI-visibility diagnosis on a 0-9 score, positioning, search-term mining restricted to whitelisted platform exports, periodic monitoring and an HTML monitoring dashboard, chained by one shared question library, plus a landing-page cloner.
description.zh: AIEO（GEO/AEO）交付方法论，挂载为一个独立的 skill provider：0-9 分制的 AI 可见性诊断、产品定位、仅限白名单平台导出数据的搜索热词挖掘、周期性效果监控与 HTML 监控面板，由同一份共享问题库串联，另附一个落地页复刻 skill。

description.en: Network Engineer Assistant preset plus a 12-vendor, 96-document switch/router/firewall command knowledge base skill (Huawei, H3C, Ruijie, DPtech, Cisco IOS/IOS-XE, Cisco NX-OS, Juniper Junos, Arista EOS, Fortinet FortiOS, ZTE ZXR10, VyOS, MikroTik RouterOS) with KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI screenshot reading, cited online manual lookup, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only. A community continuation of sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer (see NOTICE.md); it cannot be installed alongside that upstream plugin because both register the network-command-kb skill and a 网络工程师助手 preset.
description.zh: 网络工程师助手预设 + 12 厂商 96 篇交换机/路由器/防火墙命令知识库技能（华为/新华三/锐捷/迪普/思科 IOS·NX-OS/Junos/Arista EOS/FortiOS/中兴/VyOS/MikroTik），支持知识库优先检索、跨厂商命令对照、拓扑与 CLI 截图识图、带引用的联网查手册，并对高危命令强制 ⚠️ 风险标注；仅回答网络工程主题。是 sososilencing/dsh-network-engineer 的社区延续版（见 NOTICE.md）；两者注册同一个 network-command-kb 技能和同一个「网络工程师助手」预设，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Project-based learning coach: a subject-agnostic teaching engine plus swappable domain packs (Unity/C# included), shipped both as a DSH skill and as an installable bundle. The skill protocol enforces attempt-first teaching and graded hints; a zero-dependency validator rejects ability claims their evidence does not support and blocks stage acceptance while blockers are open.
description.zh: 项目制教学教练：学科无关的教学引擎 + 可替换领域包（随包提供 Unity/C#），同时以 DSH 技能与可安装组合包分发。技能协议强制"先做后教"与分级提示；零依赖校验器会拒绝证据不支撑的能力结论，并在存在未解决阻塞项时阻止阶段通过。

description.en: Sorts every loaded skill into one or more user-owned workspaces in a right-sidebar tab: each workspace is its own category list plus where every skill sits, categories are created, renamed, reordered and deleted in place, and skills are dragged or picked between them. A first run can let the profile model build the first classification, or place skills into categories the user built first; clicking a row copies its /skill-name and hovering unfolds the description the skill ships.
description.zh: 在右侧栏用一个或多个「工作区」给已加载的 skill 分类：每个工作区有自己的分类表和每个 skill 的归属，分类可就地新建、改名、排序、删除，skill 可拖动或用选择器改归位；首次使用可以让这个 profile 的模型从零分一版，也可以先自己建分类再让模型按分类分配。点击行复制 /skill-name，悬停展开 skill 自带的描述。

description.en: AI fortune-telling skill for DeepSeek Harness: feng shui, face reading, BaZi, zodiac, daily divination and Chinese almanac.
description.zh: AI玄学助手技能：风水、面相、八字、星座、每日一卦与老黄历。

description.en: A-share stock analysis and screening skill: real-time quotes, technical timing scores, buy/sell signals and a managed watchlist.
description.zh: A股智能选股技能：实时行情、技术面择时分、买卖信号与动态股票池。

description.en: Fishing assistant skill: spot analysis, fish activity and bait/lure recommendations from water photos and weather data.
description.zh: AI钓鱼助手技能：水面照片分析鱼情，结合天气气压推荐鱼种、钓法与饵料。

description.en: Tracking assistant skill: monitor product prices, celebrity news and custom metrics with change alerts and scheduled pushes.
description.zh: 追踪管家技能：追踪商品价格、明星动态与自定义指标，变动自动汇报，支持定时推送。

description.en: Fridge manager skill: recognize ingredient photos and recommend recipes, with inventory and shopping reminders.
description.zh: AI冰箱管家技能：食材图片识别并推荐菜谱，支持库存管理与采购提醒。

description.en: B2B lead generation skill: search target companies by industry/product/region, cross-validate and extract contacts.
description.zh: 精准客户线索挖掘技能：按行业/产品/地区搜索目标公司，多渠道验证并提取联系方式。

description.en: Product research skill: analyze market, technology and supply chain, then output three-tier product spec proposals.
description.zh: AI产品调研技能：分析市场、技术与供应链，输出高中低三套产品规格方案。

description.en: Life-story skill: capture moments and fragments, build a user profile and generate novels, scripts or autobiographies.
description.zh: 闪念记录与人生拼图技能：捕捉生活点滴，构建画像并生成小说、剧本或自传。

description.en: Scheduled tasks and message push manager: cron scheduling with auto push to Feishu and multi-channel, dual-env (OpenClaw/DSH).
description.zh: 定时任务与消息推送管家：统一管理 cron 调度，自动推送飞书/多端，兼容 OpenClaw 与 DSH 双环境。

description.en: Global news monitoring skill: track world events and analyze impact across industries, currencies and commodities.
description.zh: 全球热点监控技能：追踪全球事件，按行业、汇率与大宗商品链路分析影响。

description.en: Fruit price tracking skill: collect and query global wholesale fruit prices with RMB/kg conversion.
description.zh: 全球水果价格追踪技能：采集与查询国内外水果批发价，支持人民币/公斤换算。

description.en: Smart form skill: structured record-keeping for bills, ledgers and logs with auto-categorization and periodic reports.
description.zh: 智能表单技能：支出账单、台账与日志的结构化记录，自动归类并生成周期报表。

description.en: DSH composer UI for searching current-session user-invocable skills and inserting the verified slash command into the draft without sending.
description.zh: DSH composer 界面：搜索当前会话可手动调用的 Skill，并将宿主可识别的斜杠命令写入草稿，不自动发送。

description.en: Self-learning loop for dsh: record lessons, draft and promote skills, periodic curator review that corrects, consolidates, and retires skills.
description.zh: dsh 自我学习闭环：记录经验、生成并发布技能，定期审查修正、合并与退役技能。

description.en: Skill routing for DeepSeek Harness: embeds skills and each user task with a local model, keeps the clearly-relevant skills with a gap-based selection rule, and auto-injects their full bodies into the prompt.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 skill 路由插件：用本地模型为 skill 和用户任务生成向量，按基于分差的规则保留明确相关的 skill，并自动把它们的完整正文注入提示词。

description.en: Superpowers for DeepSeek Harness: TDD, debugging, planning, and collaboration skills adapted from obra/superpowers, installed as a Cordis plugin registering 14 skills with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版 Superpowers 技能包：移植自 obra/superpowers 的 TDD、调试、规划与协作技能，以 Cordis 插件安装并注册 14 个技能（零运行时依赖）。

description.en: Repackages the MedXpert skill collection (zhaoxinghua09-cell/medxpert-skills, Apache-2.0): twenty-one medical-device regulatory skills for NMPA, FDA, EU MDR, and PMDA workflows. Do not install the same skills twice (do not also copy them into ~/.dsh/skills).
description.zh: 把 MedXpert 技能集合（zhaoxinghua09-cell/medxpert-skills，Apache-2.0）打包为 21 个医疗器械法规技能，覆盖 NMPA、FDA、EU MDR 与 PMDA；请勿重复安装同一套技能。

description.en: Rolecard-engineering toolkit for SillyTavern: 23 bundled skills, a host front door, a selectable agent preset and a browser panel in one DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 面向 SillyTavern 角色卡工程的工具包：23 个技能、Host Front Door、可选 agent 预设和浏览器面板，打包成一个 DSH 插件。

description.en: Experience validation layer for DSH: zero-token collection of tool-failure/retry/search signals, AI refinement into verified skill books (three-layer verification), looked up at task start. Ships 10 trial skills and benchmark data (complex-task success 100% vs 60% bare).
description.zh: DSH 经验验证固化层：零 token 采集工具失败/重试/搜索信号，加工轮提炼成经三层检验的技能书，任务开局翻书复用。内置 10 本试验经验 + benchmark 数据（复杂任务成功率 100% vs 裸环境 60%）。

description.en: HarmonyOS NEXT skill bundle for DeepSeek Harness with offline API references and DevEco, HDC, and emulator automation guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 HarmonyOS NEXT 技能包、离线 API 参考及 DevEco、HDC 与模拟器自动化指南。

description.en: Chinese government document processing toolkit: GB/T 9704 format check, auto-fix, content revision (red annotation + strikethrough), template generation, Markdown-to-docx, and document header/footer/page-number injection for 24 official document types.
description.zh: 中文公文全流程处理工具：GB/T 9704 格式检查、自动修复、内容修订（红色标注+删除线）、模板生成、Markdown 转公文、版头/版记/页码注入，覆盖通知/请示/报告/函/会议纪要等 24 类公文。

description.en: Adds a writing-plans skill that generates a structured implementation plan document before coding, then executes simple tasks inline or offers an execution choice for complex work.
description.zh: 添加 writing-plans 技能，在写代码前生成结构化实现计划文档，简单任务直接执行，复杂任务提供执行方式选择。

description.en: RigorQuant preset + skill pack: unattended walled multi-agent research for empirical and computational mathematics (economics, finance, portfolio), with a four-part pre-implementation check battery and a jacobian/Lean escalation lane.
description.zh: RigorQuant 预设与技能包：面向实证与计算数学（经济学、金融、组合）的无人值守隔离多智能体研究，内置四重实现前校验与 jacobian/Lean 升级通道。

description.en: Gives agents the DSH (Cordis) plugin authoring contract and the dsh plugin market submission process, from the bundle manifest and entry module to the pull request.
description.zh: 给 agent 一套 DSH（Cordis）插件编写规范与 dsh 插件市场收录流程，从 bundle manifest、入口模块一直讲到提交 PR。

description.en: Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills — brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven development, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel agent dispatch, git worktrees, code review, verification before completion and skill authoring — served through the DSH skills registry with their scripts, references and cross-links intact (frontmatter folded into a manifest, prefixes realigned to DSH skill names). Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): the /superpowers slash command declares the producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能——头脑风暴、写计划、计划执行、subagent 驱动开发、TDD、系统化调试、并行派发、git worktree、代码评审、完成前验证、技能编写——经 DSH 技能注册表提供，脚本、参考资料与交叉引用原样保留（frontmatter 收进 manifest、前缀对齐 DSH 技能名）。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：/superpowers 斜杠命令使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers。

description.en: Measures one university department's research output: matches author affiliation strings against a college's known name variants (detecting same-named departments at other universities), backfills papers that only name the university by faculty author IDs, classifies each paper by journal tier (CAS partition with Top flag, JCR quartile, CCF, Chinese core via a CNKI export merger), splits staff from student first authors, and writes a workbook with a dashboard sheet, a filterable paper list, a teacher-by-direction matrix and per-teacher statistics. Student authorship is inferred from affiliation and staff lists, not verified against enrolment records. Requires Python 3.9+ with pandas and openpyxl (pip install -r requirements.txt); papers come from the OpenAlex API, whose free per-IP quota is limited, and Chinese-journal coverage needs a manual CNKI export.
description.zh: 统计某一所大学某个学院（二级单位）的科研产出：按作者单位串匹配学院的各种英文写法（并检测其他高校的同名院系），对只写到校名一级的论文用教师作者 ID 反查补全，再按期刊层级分类（中科院分区含 Top 标记、JCR 分区、CCF、经知网导出合并的中文核心），区分教师与学生一作，输出含看板页、可筛选论文清单、教师-方向矩阵和教师个人统计的工作簿。学生身份由单位与教师名单推定，未与学籍核对。需 Python 3.9+ 与 pandas、openpyxl（pip install -r requirements.txt）；题录走 OpenAlex 接口（按 IP 计的免费额度有限），中文期刊需人工从知网导出后合并。

description.en: Registers Epic's Unreal Engine skills (unreal-mcp, create-toolset, unreal-skill), injects Unreal project context, and connects the editor's ModelContextProtocol server with a port form on the Plugins page.
description.zh: 注册 Epic 的 Unreal Engine 三个技能（unreal-mcp、create-toolset、unreal-skill），注入 UE 工程上下文，接通编辑器的 ModelContextProtocol 服务器，并支持在插件页修改端口。

description.en: Takes the user's own .pptx template plus a course outline (lesson plan / document / plain text) and produces a courseware .pptx that adopts the template's background, color scheme, fonts, and page skeleton. Pure plugin package, no built-in API keys; the image backend must be configured by the user.
description.zh: 拿用户自己的 .pptx 模板 + 一份课程大纲（教案/文档/纯文本），产出套用该模板背景、配色、字体、页面骨架的课件 .pptx。纯插件包，无内置密钥，图片后端需用户自行配置。

description.en: Product-thinking companion for DeepSeek Harness: clarifies negative boundaries first, separates facts from assumptions, routes through seven product lenses, and persists confirmed decisions to project memory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的产品思考助手：先明确负向边界，拆开事实与假设，经七套产品视角讨论取舍，并将确认的决策沉淀到项目记忆中。

description.en: Turn a feature that actually runs into a trustworthy delivery demo video, or a defect into a traceable feedback video: real screen recordings, edge-tts narration with word-clock subtitles, a self-contained ffmpeg pipeline, and a deterministic quality gate (spec, audio, loudness, black/freeze/silence scans) that refuses to pass a fake or broken demo. Feedback episodes add severity/phase chips, a repro-steps overlay and a ticket-ready report bound to the artifact SHA256. Preflight and artifact verification included. Requires Python 3.9+, ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH, and `pip install edge-tts Pillow`; narration calls the public edge-tts endpoint.
description.zh: 把真实运行的功能做成可信交付演示视频，或把缺陷做成可追溯的问题反馈视频：真实录屏、edge-tts 旁白与逐字对齐字幕、自包含 ffmpeg 管线，配一道拒绝放过造假或残次演示的确定性质量闸（规格、音轨、响度、黑帧/冻结/静音扫描），含渲染前预检与成片证据核验。反馈模式带严重级别/阶段徽标、复现步骤浮层，以及按成片 SHA256 绑定的工单级问题报告。需 Python 3.9+、PATH 上的 ffmpeg/ffprobe，以及 `pip install edge-tts Pillow`；旁白会调用 edge-tts 公共接口。

description.en: Skill shell that installs, runs and troubleshoots React-Monitor-Agent, a human-agent operation board built on review replay and checkpoints: the agent writes its work as a structured replay timeline of screen-recording, screenshot, diff and text nodes, and the human decides at plan, progress, risk and delivery checkpoints, with verdicts branching the timeline and rejected branches kept greyed-out for audit. The skill guides cloning the source repo and starting a zero-dependency Node event service on 127.0.0.1:8790 plus a React board on localhost:5173 that ships an offline FIXTURE demo mode. The bundle embeds the skill only; product source stays in the repo.
description.zh: 安装壳技能：安装、跑起并排障 React-Monitor-Agent 人机协作操作板——agent 把工作过程写成由录屏、截图、diff、文本节点组成的结构化回放时间线，人在方案/阶段/风险/完工四类检查点上拍板，决策改变时间线走向，被否定/改向的旧分支灰掉保留以供审计。技能引导克隆主仓，启动零依赖 Node 事件服务（127.0.0.1:8790）与 React 操作板（localhost:5173），操作板内置离线 FIXTURE 演示模式。bundle 只内嵌技能，产品源码以主仓为准。

description.en: Fully local push-to-talk voice input for macOS: hold a global hotkey, speak, release — transcription is pasted at your cursor. Local-first STT (Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 4bit on MLX/Metal by default, SenseVoice and mlx-whisper fallbacks), zero external APIs, launchd self-healing service and an 8-point diagnose script. The bundled skill lets the agent install, configure (Karabiner hotkey wiring, launchd, engine switching) and troubleshoot the whole toolchain for you.
description.zh: macOS 本地按住说话语音输入：按住全局热键说话、松开即转写粘贴到光标处。纯本地 STT（默认 Qwen3-ASR 0.6B 4bit 走 MLX/Metal，SenseVoice / mlx-whisper 双 fallback），零外部 API，launchd 自愈常驻 + 8 项自检。内置技能让 agent 代你完成安装、Karabiner 热键接线、launchd 配置、引擎切换与全链排障。

description.en: SHOPLINE AI Toolkit: bridges the official SHOPLINE Developer MCP server and ships seven SHOPLINE agent skills (Admin REST, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, Sline) — the SHOPLINE counterpart of the Shopify AI Toolkit.
description.zh: SHOPLINE AI 工具包：接入 SHOPLINE 官方开发者 MCP 服务器，内置七个 SHOPLINE 平台技能（Admin REST、GraphQL、OAuth、Webhook、Sline），是 Shopify AI Toolkit 的 SHOPLINE 对应版。

description.en: DSH bundle that vendors the full mattpocock/skills tree, preserves upstream invocation policies, and applies an exact-match DSH semantic overlay checked during automatic upstream synchronization.
description.zh: 将完整 mattpocock/skills 技能树打包为 DSH 插件，保留上游调用策略，并在自动同步上游时校验和应用精确匹配的 DSH 语义适配层。

description.en: Bundles the kb-curator skill, which keeps a local three-layer knowledge base and refuses to index anything the user has not approved. The L2 retrieval layer needs @kenz1117/dsh-engram installed separately, and the engine runs on Windows only.
description.zh: 捆绑 kb-curator 技能，用本地三层知识库保存资料，未获用户批准前不写入索引。L2 检索层需另装 @kenz1117/dsh-engram，且引擎目前仅支持 Windows。

description.en: DSH Prompt Library plugin: prompt CRUD, tags & categories, import/export, AI polish, one-click clip selected text, sidebar and assistant bubble reminders.
description.zh: DSH提示词库插件：支持提示词增删改查、分类标签、导入导出、AI智能优化、选中文本一键剪藏，附带侧边栏与词库助手气泡提醒。

description.en: Searches medical and life-science literature by topic, keyword or DOI through Europe PMC, PubMed, OpenAlex and Crossref; decides open-access status through Unpaywall/OpenAlex/Europe PMC; downloads the PDF when an OA route exists (verified by magic bytes and page count) and otherwise writes a decision card with the exact failure reason plus four manual fallback channels: AbleSci assistance, Sci-Hub, SciDown and X-MOL. The bundled Python tool uses only the standard library.
description.zh: 按领域、检索词或 DOI 检索医学与生命科学文献（Europe PMC / PubMed / OpenAlex / Crossref），用 Unpaywall 等源判定开放获取状态，能拿到 OA 全文时自动下载并通过文件头与页数校验；拿不到时生成决策卡，写清自动下载失败的具体原因，并给出科研通互助、Sci-Hub、SciDown、X-MOL 四条人工通道的直达链接，人工取回后用一条命令登记入库。随包 Python 工具仅依赖标准库。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle of the 25 promoted mattpocock/skills with a native agent preset, an invocation-aware skill provider, and a light grilling-to-implement bootstrap.
description.zh: 将 mattpocock/skills 的 25 个正式技能打包为 DeepSeek Harness bundle，附原生 Agent 预设、区分人触发与模型调用的技能 provider，以及轻量 grilling 到 implement 引导。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle of 14 obra/superpowers engineering skills with a native agent preset, automatic session bootstrap, and Windows sandbox compatibility.
description.zh: 将 obra/superpowers 的 14 个工程技能打包为 DeepSeek Harness bundle，附原生 Agent 预设、自动会话引导和 Windows 沙箱兼容。

description.en: Adds a summonable domain-expert roster that runs as subagents while the parent session keeps the task and final answer.
description.zh: 增加可召唤的领域专家名单，专家以子代理运行，主会话保留任务和最终答复。

description.en: Windows WeChat 4.x chat export toolchain shipped as a skill: discovers SQLCipher shards, decrypts, exports and merges them; conversion, stats, AI relationship analysis and HTML reporting delegate to the locally installed she-love-me skill. Requires Python 3.9+ for the analysis stages.
description.zh: Windows 微信 4.x 聊天导出工具链技能：自动发现、解密、导出并合并 SQLCipher 分片；转换、统计、AI 关系分析与 HTML 报告委托给本机已装的 she-love-me 技能。分析阶段需要 Python 3.9+。

description.en: Task-to-skill pairing meta-skill with a laziness ladder for minimal loading, a user-editable routing table, and a quarantine, SkillSpector scan, human-approval install flow.
description.zh: 任务到技能配对元技能：懒人阶梯最小化加载、可编辑路由表、隔离-SkillSpector 扫描-人工确认的安装流程。

description.en: Migrates skills from other agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more) into DSH: scans 14 agent platforms plus the shared ~/.agents skills layer, detects duplicate names across sources, lets you pick the best source per skill, copies them into the DSH skills directory, and rolls back previously migrated skills.
description.zh: 把其他 Agent（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等）的技能一键搬进 DeepSeek Harness：扫描 14 个平台外加共享的 ~/.agents 技能层，识别不同来源的同名技能，可挑选每个技能的最佳来源，复制到 DSH 技能目录，支持回滚移除已迁移的技能。

description.en: Answers real-life decisions from a 765-entry Chinese life guide: looks up entries first, ranks by cost and benefit, and cites section and item.
description.zh: 按《高性价比人生指南》765 条正文回答人生决策：先查条目，按成本与收益排序，每条注明第几节第几条。

description.en: Port of pstack to DeepSeek Harness: 58 agent-workflow skills plus a deterministic router that picks each subagent model from the models you checked for subagents.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 pstack：58 个 agent 工作流技能，外加确定性路由器，按任务意图从你勾选的子 agent 模型池里选型。

description.en: Browse, search and install skills from the public SkillHub catalogue, then enable, disable, update or remove them without leaving Harness. Category chips carry the upstream total for each category; the details drawer has tabs for the file tree, version history, permissions, third-party security-scan results and upstream metrics. An installed skill is written into the harness skill root as an ordinary local skill, and disabling one moves its directory out of that root rather than flagging it.
description.zh: 浏览、搜索并安装公开的 SkillHub 技能库,启用、停用、更新或卸载都不必离开 Harness。分类按钮带该分类的上游总数;详情抽屉提供文件树、版本历史、权限、第三方安全扫描结论与上游指标等页签。装好的技能会作为一个普通本地技能写入 harness 的技能根目录,而「停用」是把它的目录移出该根目录,不是打标记。

description.en: Lists the skills in the shared skills directory with their source and version, installs and updates them from a GitHub repo, removes them to a recycle bin kept for 7 days, and controls which agents can see each skill and whether the model may invoke it.
description.zh: 汇总共享技能目录里的技能并标注来源与版本，可从 GitHub 仓库安装与更新，删除时先进保留 7 天的回收站，并控制每个技能对各 Agent 的可见性与模型可调用性。

description.en: Skill browser and switchboard for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar entry lists skills from configurable source directories as cards, clicking a card opens the full SKILL.md, and the per-card switch writes disable-model-invocation and registers or removes that skill in the agent skill catalog, so the model can load exactly the skills that are switched on. It also recognises WorkBuddy expert-team folders and shows avatar, tags, quick prompts and members, registering its lead prompt as a skill when switched on. Source directories are editable in the panel.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的技能中心：侧栏入口把可配置来源目录里的技能铺成卡片，点击卡片查看完整 SKILL.md；卡片上的开关会写入 disable-model-invocation，并同步把该技能注册进或移出模型可用的技能表，让「模型能加载的技能」与开关一致。同时识别 WorkBuddy 专家团目录（带 agents 的 .codebuddy-plugin/plugin.json），以头像、描述、标签、快捷提示与团队成员的形式展示，打开开关即把它的 lead 提示词注册为技能（不写这些文件）。卡片还支持在文件管理器中定位、复制路径，来源目录本身也可在面板里编辑。

description.en: Per-project skill roots for DeepSeek Harness, with multi-level category discovery.
description.zh: 按项目分配技能根目录，支持多级分类发现。

description.en: Resolves unique kebab-case skill substrings in slash tokens, so /oneshot can load game-package-oneshot.
description.zh: 用唯一 kebab 片段解析斜杠 skill，例如 /oneshot 可加载 game-package-oneshot。

description.en: Bundles the official Scrapling agent skill into a DeepSeek Harness profile: anti-bot bypass, stealth browsing, the spiders framework, adaptive parsing and JavaScript rendering, discovered through the host skill catalog.
description.zh: 把官方 Scrapling 技能包进 DeepSeek Harness profile：反反爬绕过、隐身浏览、spiders 框架、自适应解析与 JS 渲染，通过宿主技能目录发现。

description.en: Geological 3D modeling and 3D seismic processing workflow skill: SEG-Y volume parsing, CGCS2000 coordinate unification, fault representative line and exploration boundary shapefile output, and multi-mine 3D geology platform building.
description.zh: 地质三维建模与三维地震资料处理全流程技能：SEG-Y 数据体解析、CGCS2000 坐标统一（带带号）、断层代表线与勘探范围 shp 输出、多矿区三维地质平台建设。

description.en: Builds a Markdown knowledge base from your course materials, then drills you until every knowledge point reaches your target accuracy; each answer must include your reasoning.
description.zh: 从课程材料建一份 Markdown 知识库，然后出题刷到每个知识点都达到目标正确率；每题都必须写出思维链。

description.en: Live skill provider that adds skills from 60+ other agents' directories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot), Claude Code plugin marketplaces, and any git repository of skills to the dsh catalog without copying or symlinking; deduplicates, repairs frontmatter, renames name collisions, and ships a CLI (list, add, sync, doctor).
description.zh: 实时技能提供器：把 60+ 个其他 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot）的技能目录、Claude Code 插件市场以及任意 git 技能仓库中的技能接入 dsh 目录，零拷贝零软链接；自动去重、修复 frontmatter、处理同名冲突，并附带 CLI（list、add、sync、doctor）。

description.en: Ported from the ARS Claude Code plugin (44k+ stars on GitHub): academic research skills for DeepSeek Harness — a deep-research agent team, a paper-writing pipeline, a multi-perspective peer-review panel, and an end-to-end orchestrator, plus sixteen /ars-* commands.
description.zh: 移植自 ARS Claude Code 插件（GitHub 44k+ stars）：面向 DeepSeek Harness 的学术研究技能套件——深度调研 agent 团队、论文写作流水线、多视角同行评审小组与端到端编排器，外加十六个 /ars-* 命令。

description.en: Team Skill Hub: browse shared public or private team skills from a Skill Base server and install them in DSH Web.
description.zh: 团队 Skill 中心：连接 Skill Base，浏览团队共享的公开或私有技能，并一键安装到 DSH Web。

description.en: Bundles five skills — web slide decks, social card images, typeset web pages, Chinese de-AI editing (humanizer-zh) and a writing-voice profile — with the first three sharing one design system (magazine and Swiss themes, contrast-checked brand colours). Adds a sidebar page that lists your works with thumbnails, opens a new session with a draft that reuses a work's theme and layout, offers six content workflows, and collects the messages you sent in local dsh sessions as study material for the voice profile.
description.zh: 打包五个 skill：网页 PPT、图文卡片、网页排版、中文去 AI 味（humanizer-zh）和语气档案，前三个共用一套设计系统（杂志风与瑞士风主题、按对比度校验的品牌色）。侧栏页面列出你做过的作品和缩略图，「做同款」会在新会话里按这份作品的主题和版式填好草稿；提供六个内容生产工作流；把你在本机 dsh 会话里发过的消息整理成语气档案的学习素材。

plugins.name: dsh-skill-experts

description.en: Manage skill experts in the sidebar and summon them from the composer or @ menu.
description.zh: 在侧栏管理技能专家，并通过输入栏或 @ 召唤他们协助完成任务。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.skillexperts_expertspanel_w3.skillexperts_expertspanel_org

description.en: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

description.en: Plugin-author upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness: one package carrying a corridor index, which detects the caller peer band and routes to the closed corridor card that matches it (0.1.3-alpha.1 -> 0.1.5-rc.1 as legs A+B, 0.1.5-rc.2 -> 0.1.6-alpha.2 as leg C), plus a zero-dependency seam scanner shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件作者的升级技能：一个包只放一份走廊索引，自动识别调用方的 peer 区间并路由到对应已封版的升级卡片（0.1.3-alpha.1 至 0.1.5-rc.1 为 A+B 两条腿，0.1.5-rc.2 至 0.1.6-alpha.2 为 C 腿），并附带以 bundle 技能与 npx CLI 两种形态提供的零依赖接缝扫描器。

description.en: Merged, version-locked plugin upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness (0.1.3-alpha.1 to 0.1.5-rc.1 as two closed legs): an evidence-bound version card plus a zero-dependency 20-seam scanner, shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.
description.zh: 合并后的版本锁定插件升级技能（0.1.3-alpha.1 → 0.1.5-rc.1，两条闭环腿）：证据绑定版本卡 + 零依赖 20 接缝扫描器，以 bundle 技能 + npx CLI 两种形态发布。

description.en: AI-driven presentation workflow packaged as a dsh skill: generates editable PPTX decks and SVG snapshots from PDF, DOCX, URLs or Markdown, fills native PPTX templates, and enhances finished presentations.
description.zh: AI 驱动的演示文稿工作流：从 PDF、DOCX、网址或 Markdown 生成可编辑 PPTX 与 SVG 快照，支持原生 PPTX 模板填充与成品演示文稿增强。

description.en: Read-only Skill inspector for DeepSeek Harness. It shows which Skills a conversation actually loaded — from observed loading evidence only — and which Skills the current environment can discover, and gives each Skill a detail page whose left column switches between the framework, the evidence, validation, evaluation, step evidence, run logic, the before/after of a modification when there is one, the definition facts and the raw SKILL.md. Declaration and run stay apart: the body is split into structure, declared workflow and progressive disclosure, the run logic is read from local receipts, and every declared step carries its own evidence — no observed evidence is reported as exactly that, not as executed or not executed, and the run's instruction hash sits beside the current definition as match, mismatch or unavailable. The evidence view gives each subject one of three states (declared, observed, unavailable), walks definition → load → use → outcome, names what each stage cannot reach, declines to attribute an outcome to the Skill, and can copy the snapshot out as byte-stable JSON. Validation checks the Agent Skills open standard and the platform profiles separately, each finding on a rule id and labelled standard compliance or platform compatibility. Evaluation keeps repeatable cases with the conditions each run was recorded under and the four stages of runtime evidence, comparing two runs of one case item by item without scoring them. The trigger boundary keeps should-trigger and should-not-trigger prompts, has you run them in a real new session, then records what was observed — whether a load record appeared and whether it was model-invoked or user-explicit; a typed /name is not a natural trigger, and an absent load record is reported as not observed, not as not triggered. The same projections are exposed to the agent as a read-only skill_review tool, which returns a structured review packet and says what it omitted when the packet will not fit whole. The inspector, the evidence chain and these reviews are computed on this machine from the definition and the session receipts; the Chinese reading version sends the body through the host's model when you ask for it, keeping code fences, paths and frontmatter verbatim and storing the result on this machine. A Skill can also be cloned into a local copy. It does not write back to the source Skill and does not run its scripts.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的只读 Skill 检视器。它显示一次对话实际加载过哪些 Skill（只凭观测到的加载证据）、当前环境又能发现哪些 Skill，并为每个 Skill 提供一页详情：左列在框架、证据、验收、评测、步骤证据、本次运行逻辑、有修改事务时的本次修改前后对比、定义事实与 `SKILL.md` 原文之间切换。声明与运行始终分开：正文按结构、声明流程与渐进披露拆开，运行逻辑只从本机收据读，每个声明步骤都带自己的证据——没有观测到证据就照实这么写，而不是「已执行」或「未执行」；本次运行收到的指令哈希与当前定义并列给出 match、mismatch 或 unavailable。证据视图给每一类对象三态之一（声明 / 已观察 / 无法取得），沿定义 → 加载 → 使用 → 结果走一遍，逐段写明它够不着什么，不把结果归因给这个 Skill，并能把快照按逐字节稳定的 JSON 复制出去。验收把 Agent Skills 开放标准与各平台 Profile 分开判，每条发现落在规则 id 上并标注「标准合规」或「平台兼容」。评测用可重复的用例记录每次运行的条件与四段运行时证据，只在同一个用例内逐项对照两次运行，不给分。触发边界维护「应触发 / 不应触发」的提示词，由你在真实新会话里跑一遍再记录观察到的结果——加载记录出现过没有、`model-invoked` 还是 `user-explicit`；手打 `/name` 不算自然触发，没有加载记录只写成「未观察到」，不写成「没有触发」。同一批投影也作为只读工具 `skill_review` 交给 Agent，它返回结构化审查包，包太大时会说明省略了什么。检视器、证据链与上面这些审查都在本机按定义与会话收据算；中文阅读版在你需要时把正文交给宿主模型翻译，代码围栏、路径与 frontmatter 逐字保留，译文只存本机。另外可以把一份 Skill 复刻成本机副本。它不改写源 Skill，也不执行源里的脚本。

description.en: Codex-compatible Skill Studio with a left-sidebar page for browsing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, and invoking SKILL.md skills; bridges ~/.codex/skills and project .codex/skills into DSH and supports $skill-name invocation in chat.
description.zh: 带左侧栏页面的 Codex 兼容技能工作室：浏览、创建、编辑、启停并调用 SKILL.md 技能；把 ~/.codex/skills 与项目 .codex/skills 接入 DSH，并支持在对话中用 $技能名 调用。

description.en: Ponytail port: a DeepSeek Harness agent preset that makes the model finish tasks with the least tokens, with lite / full / ultra levels.
description.zh: Ponytail 移植：让模型消耗最少的 token 完成任务，解决浪费，支持 lite / full / ultra 三档强度。deep seek harness 可用

description.en: Answers a question with a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled `am` CLI builds the page, with flow, sequence, tree, timeline and ER diagrams, tables and callouts.
description.zh: 把回答做成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的 `am` 命令行生成页面，支持流程图、时序图、树、时间线、ER 图、表格和提示框。

description.en: Pavement design methods as a judgement manual: 76 cards over 9 chapters on method selection, indicator assignment, parameter calibers, axle-load conversion and climate zoning, with the airport chapter recovered by re-OCR of the intact PDF.
description.zh: 路面设计方法判据手册：9 章 76 张卡，覆盖方法选型、指标指派、参数口径、轴载换算与气候分区；第九章机场道面曾整章丢失，已由原 PDF 重扫恢复。

description.en: Asphalt pavement skid resistance: 76 cards over 12 chapters on friction calibers, water film and hydroplaning, texture parameters, tire-road contact and maintenance decisions, each capability carrying its own when-not-to-use bound.
description.zh: 沥青路面抗滑：12 章 76 张卡，覆盖摩擦口径、水膜与滑水、纹理参数、胎路接触与养护决策，每条能力都带「什么时候别用」。

description.en: Pavement structural dynamics as a judgement manual: 59 cards over 8 chapters flagging which chapter name oversells its contents, which formulas break when copied, and which numbers cannot be cross-quoted.
description.zh: 路面结构动力学判据手册：8 章 59 张卡，指明哪章名不副实、哪些式子抄走就错、哪些数不能互引。

description.en: Turns PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files into Markdown or plain text with heading levels preserved where the source allows it, and refuses scanned PDFs that have no text layer instead of writing an empty file, naming the OCR alternative instead. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements.
description.zh: 把 PDF、Word、PPT、Excel 转成保留标题层级的 Markdown 或纯文本；遇到没有文字层的扫描件会主动拒绝（退出码 2），不会写一个空文件骗过下游，并指明可改用 OCR（dsh-scan2md）。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements。

description.en: Road building materials as a caliber manual: 60 cards over 12 chapters on aggregates, asphalt and the PG system, mix volumetrics, cement, concrete, stabilized mixtures, steel, polymers and 35 test procedures.
description.zh: 道路建筑材料口径手册：12 章 60 张卡，覆盖集料、沥青与 PG 体系、混合料体积参数、水泥、混凝土、无机结合料、钢材、聚合物与 35 个试验方法。

description.en: OCR for scanned, image-only PDFs into Markdown, built around the fact that a book takes about an hour: every page is checkpointed so an interrupted run resumes, a progress log reports live status, and a quality report names empty pages and low-confidence lines. Requires Python 3.10+ and pip install -r requirements; the first run downloads the OCR model.
description.zh: 把扫描版 PDF（影印书、拍照件）OCR 成 Markdown，并按“一本书要跑约一小时”来设计：逐页写检查点，中断可续跑；进度日志随时可查；质量报告点名空白页和低置信行。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装仓库 requirements；首次运行会下载 OCR 模型。

description.en: Engineering checklists distilled from Gillespie's Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics: 164 cards over the book's ten chapters, one skill entry with two-level routing. Each card gives the inputs a computation needs, the procedure, the boundary conditions where the method stops being valid, and a page reference — the explanation itself stays in the book. No passage of the book's prose is reproduced; 44 defects in the source (misprints, OCR damage, internal contradictions) are documented in the cards, each carrying a review-list ID. A study aid, not a substitute for the book.
description.zh: 把 Gillespie《车辆动力学基础》整本书做成工程检查单：十章 164 张卡，单一入口两级路由。每张卡给出所需输入、执行步骤、方法失效的边界条件，以及回查用的页码——原理讲解仍在原书里。不复制原书任何连续段落；卡内记录了 44 条原文缺陷（错印、OCR 损坏、前后矛盾），每条带审查清单编号。本包是学习辅助，不能替代原书。

description.en: Turns explicit DSH session experience into reviewable native Skill drafts that are saved only after user approval.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话中明确表达的经验整理为可审核的原生 Skill 草稿，并仅在用户确认后保存。

description.en: Five skills for a reviewable engineering incident journal: record an event only when a counterfactual can be written, quiz yourself from the existing entries, audit the journal for decay, ingest outside material together with its provenance, and rename a layout directory while rewriting every reference to it.
description.zh: 五个技能维护一本可复习的工程事故日志：写不出反事实就不记，从已有条目出题自测，体检条目腐化，按出处收外部资料，并能在改目录名的同时改掉全库引用。

description.en: Folds the DSH skill catalog prompt surface with KV-cache-stable rendering, BM25/bge-m3 hybrid skill search, and optional auto route hints.
description.zh: 折叠 DSH 技能目录提示面：KV 缓存稳定渲染 + BM25/bge-m3 混合技能检索 + 可选自动路由提示。

description.en: 100+ multi platform social-media data skills, plus 40 native MCP tools covering data APIs, AI search and AI generation — all installable with one command.
description.zh: 100+ 多平台社媒数据技能 + 40 个原生 MCP 工具（数据 API、AI 搜索、AI 生成），一键安装。

description.en: Generate and format Chinese Word (.docx) documents from a simple markup file, using built-in heading styles, SimSun and Times New Roman fonts, and per-chapter figure and table captions.
description.zh: 用简单标记稿生成并排版中文 Word（.docx）文档，使用内置标题样式、宋体与 Times New Roman 字体，图表题注按章自动编号。
