description.en: Skill Center panel for the current session: lists the visible skills with their provider and source root, renders each SKILL.md, toggles model and user invocation, and creates or soft-deletes skills; ships a skill-authoring skill and the skill_create tool.
description.zh: 当前会话的技能中心面板：列出可见技能及其提供方与来源根目录，阅读 SKILL.md，开关模型/用户调用，并可创建、软删除技能；随包附带 skill-authoring 技能与 skill_create 工具。

description.en: Skill that reviews your coding-agent session transcripts (Claude Code and Codex only; DSH's own transcripts are not supported) over the last two weeks and reports which skills, hooks and rules work, need attention or go unused. Requires Python 3.
description.zh: 技能：回看最近两周的编程助手会话记录（仅 Claude Code 与 Codex，不支持 DSH 自身会话），报告哪些技能、钩子和规则有效、需要关注或从未使用。需要 Python 3。

description.en: Adds file-backed Chinese web-fiction planning, chapter writing, consistency review, rollback, and style-profile skills.
description.zh: 为现有 Agent 添加基于文件记忆的中文网文策划、逐章写作、一致性审校、回滚与文风画像技能。

description.en: Douyin local-promotion OEM ad daily/weekly report automation (Author: Kirin): collects 3 data sources (laike leads, plan-level delivery, video analysis) via a one-time Edge login, computes metrics, builds A4-style docx reports, supports free-choice scheduled run times and email notifications.
description.zh: 抖音本地推 OEM 广告日报/周报自动生成（作者：Kirin）：一次 Edge 登录后自动采集三大数据源（来客客资、计划级投放明细、视频分析），计算指标并生成 A4 排版 docx 报告，支持自由选择定时运行时间和邮件通知。

description.en: Installs a skill-router skill that semantically searches a local skill corpus on demand, keeping the corpus out of the per-turn model catalog.
description.zh: 安装一个 skill 路由技能：按需对本地技能库做语义检索，让庞大的技能库不占每轮的模型目录。

description.en: Bioinformatics agent preset with 17 BioDSH analysis skills (single-cell, bulk RNA-seq, survival, regression, ANOVA), a 2000+ skill library searched by a skill_library tool, per-message skill selection and a time/step convergence guard.
description.zh: 生信智能体预设，含 17 个 BioDSH 分析技能（单细胞、bulk RNA-seq、生存分析、回归、方差分析）、可用 skill_library 工具检索的 2000+ 技能库、按消息自动选技能和按时间/步数的收敛护栏。

description.en: Mounts 88 packaged research, social-intelligence, marketing and business Agent Skills into dsh through the filesystem Skill provider.
description.zh: 通过文件系统 Skill provider 将 88 个研究、社交情报、营销与商业 Agent Skills 挂载到 dsh。

description.en: Wraps the upstream ppt-master presentation skill set as an installable DeepSeek Harness plugin: byte-for-byte vendored skills, three lifecycle tools (ppt_master_info, ppt_master_check_env, ppt_master_setup_deps), optional venv interpreter isolation, and a Plugins-page configuration card. Requires python3 ≥ 3.10 plus the pip dependencies installed via `ppt_master_setup_deps`.
description.zh: 把上游 ppt-master 演示文稿技能集封装为可安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逐字节 vendor 技能树，提供 ppt_master_info / ppt_master_check_env / ppt_master_setup_deps 三个生命周期工具、可选的 venv 解释器隔离与插件页配置卡片，需 python3 ≥ 3.10 + `ppt_master_setup_deps` 安装的 pip 依赖。

description.en: Registers six spec-driven + test-driven workflow skills for DeepSeek Harness: OpenSpec spec authoring fused with Superpowers TDD discipline into a Phase 0-4 pipeline with review gates. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 6 个 SDD+TDD 工作流技能：把 OpenSpec 规格编写与 Superpowers 测试驱动纪律衔接为带审查 Gate 的 Phase 0-4 流水线，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Live skill provider that reads every Xiaomi MiMo (MiMo Desktop / MiMoCode) skill into the DSH session catalog: the engine-bundled skills under engine-config (unpacked from app.asar when that directory is absent), the MiMoCode global and project roots, extension-contributed skill directories declared in extensions.json, and the brand compatibility roots MiMo's own skillPathCompat setting enables.
description.zh: 实时技能提供器：把小米 MiMo（MiMo Desktop / MiMoCode）的全部 skill 读进 DSH 会话技能目录——engine-config 下的引擎内置技能（该目录缺失时从 app.asar 解包）、MiMoCode 全局与项目根、extensions.json 里扩展贡献的技能目录，以及 MiMo 自己的 skillPathCompat 开关启用的品牌兼容根。

description.en: Evidence-first reuse skill for DeepSeek Harness: before implementing, porting, choosing dependencies, or troubleshooting a tool, it searches the local project and machine for existing solutions in layers, judges reuse on checkable evidence, refuses reuse when essential requirements or risks are unmet, and reports what could not be verified. Ships as a DSH bundle that registers the skill on ctx.skills.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的「先找本地现成方案、再用证据验证」技能：动手实现、移植、选依赖、排查工具之前，先在项目与本机分层检索已有方案，用可核对的证据判断能否复用，必要条件或风险不满足时明确拒绝复用，并写清哪些结论无法核实。以 DSH 组合包（dsh.bundle）注册到 ctx.skills。

description.en: Diagnoses why a skill is not picked up — truncated description, broken frontmatter, missing resource files — and checks installed plugins for conflicting loader entries. Keeps a per-profile record so every checkup is diffed against the previous one, groups repeated findings into one root cause, produces rewrite worksheets for oversized descriptions, and lists the plugin patches that touch the skill directory configuration.
description.zh: 诊断技能为什么没被模型选中——简介被截断、文件头损坏、引用文件缺失——并检查已安装插件之间是否存在 loader 条目冲突；按 profile 自动保存体检病历、每次复诊对比上次差值，把重复出现的问题归并为同一根因，为超长简介生成改写工单，并列出改动了技能目录配置的插件 patch。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skill plugin that reviews law theses (international economic law and other legal topics): reads a student Word .docx, checks it against a bundled common-issue checklist, applies definite fixes as tracked changes, and adds Word comments for overall/section problems and missing-basis issues, then emits a short objective overall review plus a fix list.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能插件：批改法学论文（国际经济法等）。读取学生 Word 论文，对照打包的常见问题清单逐项检查；可直接确定的错漏以 Word 修订模式修改，对部分整体问题、缺依据/缺澄清之处写 Word 批注；并输出简短、客观、以宏观点评为主的总体评语与待修改清单。

description.en: Minecraft development for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), covering Minecraft 1.7.10 through 26.3: 9 skills for Paper/Spigot plugins, Fabric, Forge and NeoForge mods, addon development against major mods, and Gradle/JDK setup per era; the mc_scaffold generator and mc_gradle runner; 18 offline API signature indexes generated from the pinned artefacts with provenance headers; and mc_arbitrate, a deterministic sharded pipeline (contract freeze, per-shard briefs, 21 high-confidence audit rules including 5 cross-shard checks, manifest merge, compile-error routing) that calls no model inside the engine. Apache-2.0 with NOTICE.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 Minecraft 开发插件，覆盖 Minecraft 1.7.10 至 26.3：9 个技能（Paper/Spigot 插件、Fabric/Forge/NeoForge 模组、大型模组附属、分时代 Gradle/JDK 构建）、mc_scaffold 项目生成器与 mc_gradle 构建执行器、18 份由钉选工件生成且带 provenance 头的离线 API 签名索引，以及确定性分片流水线 mc_arbitrate（契约冻结、分片任务书、21 条高置信审计规则含 5 条跨分片检查、清单合并、编译错误定点路由），引擎内部不调用模型。Apache-2.0 + NOTICE。

description.en: Bundles 50 AMD ROSS agent skills for Vivado, Vitis HLS, Versal segmented configuration, Vitis AI, and hardware debug into DeepSeek Harness, with a left-sidebar catalog panel for filtering, searching, and copying skill invocations.
description.zh: 把 AMD ROSS 的 50 个 Vivado、Vitis HLS、Versal 分段配置、Vitis AI 与硬件调试技能装进 DeepSeek Harness，并在左侧栏提供可筛选、搜索、展开与复制的技能目录面板。

description.en: View local Skills and edit automatic and /name invocation policies from DSH Web settings, with bundled and symbolic-link entries kept read-only.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中查看本地 Skills，并编辑自动调用与 /name 调用策略；内置和软链接条目保持只读。

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers. On the host it scores the live catalog from the instruction's keywords and the catalog metadata, with no LLM or embedding call, and appends a single producer-tagged message to the step: a ranked shortlist by default, the winning SKILL.md body once the score clears a threshold, or an instruction to call a named router skill exactly once. Unrelated instructions stay silent.
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md 正文，也可以只注入一句「立刻调用某个路由技能」。无关指令保持沉默。

description.en: Twenty-one official HyperFrames by HeyGen skills synced from the official upstream (HTML video authoring, animation, keyframes, audio/music-to-video, CLI, registry, slideshow, talking-head recut, website/product/PR-to-video, Studio timeline conventions and more), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 同步 HyperFrames by HeyGen 官方上游的二十一技能：HTML 写视频/动画/关键帧/音频与音乐转视频/CLI/注册表/幻灯片/口播重剪/网址·产品·PR 转视频/Studio 时间轴规范等，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Twelve official Remotion skills synced from the official upstream (programmatic video with React: animation, audio, captions, 3D, maps, charts, render, Studio), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: Remotion 官方 12 技能：React 编程式视频（动画/音频/字幕/3D/地图/图表/渲染/Studio），安装即用，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: ADHD-friendly output shaping where the mode belongs to one session, not a global setting: switch it with /i-have-adhd on|off in the conversations you want shaped, and the state stays with that session. Ported from ayghri/i-have-adhd.
description.zh: ADHD 友好输出塑形插件：模式属于单个会话，而不是一项全局设置——用 /i-have-adhd on|off 在你想要塑形的对话里开启/关闭功能，状态随该会话保留。移植自 ayghri/i-have-adhd。

description.en: Provides 15 Superpowers skills for DeepSeek Harness, covering test-driven development, debugging, planning, and code review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 15 个 Superpowers 技能，覆盖测试驱动开发、调试、规划与代码评审。

description.en: Format checker for theses and lab reports: verifies body font size, first-line indent, line spacing, Chinese font, header student ID and name, page margins, and figure/table caption numbering against a JSON rules preset, then reports each problem with its paragraph location and the concrete fix. Read-only, zero dependencies (Python standard library only), and it refuses to report a pass when no check actually ran. Requires Python 3.8 or newer on PATH.
description.zh: 论文 / 实验报告格式体检：对照 JSON 规则预设核验正文字号、首行缩进、行距、中文字体、页眉学号姓名、页边距、图题表题编号，逐条给出段落定位与具体修法。只读、零依赖（纯 Python 标准库），实际执行的检查项为 0 时拒绝判通过。需要 PATH 中有 Python 3.8 或更高版本。

description.en: Publish size check skill: verifies a deliverable's geometric specs against a target platform before publishing - pixel dimensions, aspect ratio, dpi, file size, format, physical print width and colour mode. Geometry only: it does not review content compliance (QR codes, text-to-image ratio, copyright and prohibited content are out of scope). Pure Python standard library, no third-party packages, and inputs are never modified. Python 3.8+. Covers 10 platforms and 20 slots with per-platform confidence labels - WeChat MP, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Zhihu, Weibo, Douyin, WeChat Channels, journal submission, print and client delivery - and resolves a platform by id, Chinese name or alias with fuzzy matching. Two trigger modes: asked directly, or as a parasitic self-check that runs by itself once an image, poster, chart or export workflow has written a file and the user mentioned a publishing target, reporting in one line when everything passes and only expanding when something is wrong. For journal submission and print it judges by physical width (pixels / dpi), which catches files whose dpi metadata passes but whose actual printed size is too small; for multi-image posts it checks whether the whole set is consistent and names the odd one out rather than listing every file.
description.zh: 发布尺寸检查技能：发布前对照目标平台的几何规格核验交付物——像素尺寸、宽高比、dpi、体积、格式、物理印刷宽度、色彩模式。只查几何参数，不做内容合规审查（二维码、文字占比、版权、违规内容均不在范围内）。纯 Python 标准库实现，不装任何第三方包，原件全程只读。需 Python 3.8+。覆盖 10 个平台、20 个槽位，并按平台标注可信度——微信公众号、小红书、哔哩哔哩、知乎、微博、抖音、微信视频号、学术投稿、印刷交付、甲方交付；平台参数支持 id、中文名、别名，模糊匹配也能命中。两种触发：直接提问，或作为「寄生自检」在出图/海报/图表/导出流程落盘且用户提到发布目标后自行运行，全部通过时一句话带过，有问题才展开。投稿与印刷按「像素÷dpi=实际印刷宽度」判定，能抓出 dpi 字段达标但实际尺寸不足的图；多图连发时检查整组是否整齐，并指出少数派是哪一张，而不是罗列每个文件。

description.en: Discovers workspace Markdown commands, skills and path-scoped rules from .dsh and .agents directories.
description.zh: 从 .dsh 与 .agents 目录发现工作区 Markdown 命令、技能和按路径生效的规则。

plugins.name: SumSec-Skills

description.en: Multi-platform Agent Skills monorepo that mounts as a DeepSeek Harness profile bundle, exposing Chinese writing, Git, plugin-dev, taste, and semantic-linter skills.
description.zh: 多平台 Agent Skills 集合，作为 DeepSeek Harness profile bundle 挂载，提供中文写作、Git、插件开发、Taste 与语义边界检测等 Skill。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Manage agent skills and MCP servers across DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other tools from one DSH sidebar page: CRUD, cross-tool sharing, import/export, backups and MCP health checks.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏统一管理 DSH、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等工具的 skill 与 MCP 服务器：增删改查、跨工具共享、导入导出、备份恢复与 MCP 连接体检。

description.en: Design skill for UI and marketing graphics on the Superdesign canvas: reads the repo for context, extracts its design system, then generates and iterates branchable design drafts, flow pages, and reusable components through the Superdesign CLI.
description.zh: 在 Superdesign 画布上做 UI 与营销图的设计技能：先读代码库拿上下文、抽取现有设计系统，再通过 Superdesign CLI 生成并迭代可分支的设计稿、流程页与可复用组件。

description.en: Math Agent Framework for DeepSeek Harness: symbolic derivation engine (CES / quadratic forms / ODE / PDE), SymPy verification, Lean 4 compiler-verified formal proofs, and QED-style multi-agent adversarial verification, exposed as native DSH tools through a TS shell bridging a Python engine. Requires cloning the math-agent-framework repo and `pip install -r requirements.txt`, with MATH_AGENT_HOME pointing at the repo root. Every result carries provenance (engine versions, seed, tolerances) and is marked untrusted data.
description.zh: 数学 Agent 框架接入 DeepSeek Harness：符号推导引擎（CES/二次型/ODE/PDE）、SymPy 验证、Lean 4 真编译验证的形式化证明、QED 多 Agent 对抗验证，经 TS 壳桥接 Python 引擎暴露为 DSH 原生工具。需先克隆 math-agent-framework 仓库并 `pip install -r requirements.txt`，将 MATH_AGENT_HOME 指向仓库根目录。所有结果携带 provenance（引擎版本/seed/容差）并标记为不可信数据。

description.en: Tencent CloudQ integration: AIOps chat mode with usage, inspiration, artifact and architecture panels.
description.zh: 腾讯云智能顾问集成：CloudQ 对话模式，附用量、灵感、制品与架构图面板。

description.en: Multi-lens structural analysis skill: adversarial-first analysis across 16 lenses in 4 categories with 10 structural tools, confidence calibration, and fact-bound layered output.
description.zh: 多视角深层结构分析技能：16 透镜 4 类别、10 个结构工具，先攻击默认立场，产出置信度校准、事实绑定的分层结论。

description.en: Adds an Assist button beside the composer send key. It scans the skills and MCP tools available in the session, ranks them against the text currently in the input box, and lets you inject the selected ones into the running conversation as a steering message.
description.zh: 在对话框发送键旁添加一个「辅助」按钮：扫描本会话可用的技能与 MCP 工具，按输入框里的当前草稿排序，并可把选中的技能作为 steering 消息注入正在运行的对话。

description.en: Reusable skill to browse, search and download Wallpaper Engine (Steam 431960) workshop wallpapers and wire them into the DSH skin center, including bypassing the Steam HTTP block and the region-mismatch sign-in block via a matching SOCKS proxy.
description.zh: 可复用技能：批量浏览、搜索、下载 Wallpaper Engine（小红车，Steam 431960）创意工坊壁纸并接入 DSH 皮肤中心；含绕过 Steam HTTP 封锁与异地登录拦截（经出口 IP 与账号一致的 SOCKS 代理）。

description.en: Browse, preview and install public Agent Skills from inside the DSH web GUI, aggregating five sources (claudeskills.info, skillsmp.com, the awesome-claude-skills repository list, the official anthropics/skills repo, and skill packs shipped by installed DSH plugins). Skills install pinned to a commit rather than a branch name, so what you previewed is what lands; the panel reports provenance, whole-tree update checks and a trash instead of deleting. Before writing anything it validates the skill name and frontmatter against the rules the harness silently enforces, lists files that SKILL.md references but the fetch did not bring, flags partial fetches, and offers overwrite, rename or skip when a name is taken.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里浏览、预览并安装公开的 Agent Skills，聚合五个来源（claudeskills.info、skillsmp.com、awesome-claude-skills 仓库坐标表、Anthropic 官方仓库、已装 DSH 插件自带的技能包）。安装按 commit 而不是分支名钉住，预览到的就是落地的；面板给出每个技能的来路、按整棵树比对的更新检查，删除是移进回收站而不是抹掉。落地之前先按 harness 实际执行的规则体检技能名与 frontmatter（名字不合法会被 harness 静默跳过），列出 SKILL.md 引用但没取回的文件，标出只取到一部分的情况，同名时给出覆盖、改名、跳过三个选项。

description.en: Standalone Skills page for dsh: lists every skill with an enable switch at global, project or session scope, keeps unchecked skills out of the model catalog, and sorts them into named categories.
description.zh: dsh 技能管理页：列出全部技能，按全局、本项目、本会话三级开关，取消勾选的技能不进模型目录，并可按自建分类整理。

description.en: Ships a skill for verifying a change with the cheapest check that still yields a definite answer: an L0-L3 cost ladder from static checks to a single suite, condition polling with a timeout instead of fixed sleeps, assertions that can actually fail, and durations that are measured rather than remembered. The package also carries the two zero-dependency Node tools the skill calls - wait-until.mjs (poll a command, a file, or a port until it is ready) and measure-runtime.mjs (wall-clock timing for any command, plus a segmented timer for library use).
description.zh: 携带一份技能：用仍然能给出确定结论的最便宜手段验证改动——L0–L3 成本阶梯（静态检查到单个测试套件）、用条件轮询加超时替代固定延时、断言必须能失败、耗时必须实测而不是凭印象。包里还带着这份技能调用的两个零依赖 Node 工具：wait-until.mjs（轮询命令 / 文件 / 端口直到就绪）与 measure-runtime.mjs（测任意命令的墙钟耗时，库模式下提供分段计时）。

description.en: Watches agent execution traces and fires an LLM review at every successful turn end when signals trip, crystallizing reusable workflows into registered skills that improve progressively with later runs.
description.zh: 观察 agent 执行轨迹，在每个成功回合结束时按信号触发 LLM 评审，把值得复用的工作流结晶为已注册技能，并随后续运行持续改进。

description.en: Tripo 3D generation skills driving the tripo-cli through the shell: text-to-3D, image-to-3D, rigging with locomotion clips, decimation and LOD chains, and export to GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF, with headless device login for both China-mainland and international accounts; installable as `tripo-dsh`.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 tripo-cli 的 Tripo 3D 生成 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、绑骨与走跑动画、减面与 LOD 链，导出 GLB/FBX/OBJ/STL/USDZ/3MF，支持国内站与海外站账号的无头设备码登录；npm 包名 `tripo-dsh`。

description.en: Reports which skills each turn invoked (loaded by the model, typed as /name, or none) and manages the local skill directory: install from a pasted repository, folder, SKILL.md or zip address, set a Chinese display name in the skill meta.yaml, and remove a skill while keeping a backup.
description.zh: 每轮对话报告本轮调用了哪些 skill（模型自动加载、用户输入 /name，或一个都没用），并管理本机 skill 目录：粘贴仓库、文件夹、SKILL.md 或 zip 地址即可安装，中文显示名写入该 skill 的 meta.yaml，删除时保留备份。

description.en: Literary DSH plugin: one session is one book. Cover-card /new opens one of 19 realms, a prose-only 诸天万界DSH preset keeps the model writing fiction, keyword worldbook entries ground each turn, and /export-story typesets the session into a Markdown novel.
description.zh: 诸天万界DSH：一个会话就是一本书。封面开书，十九界任选，文学预设只写正文，规则书按关键词注入，/export-story 把整场会话誊成 Markdown 小说。

description.en: Skills and optional MCP rows for eleven marketplaces: price comparison across Wildberries, Detsky Mir and Yandex Market, plus per-source search, product cards and reviews, including Ozon, Avito and AliExpress. The 14 skills load on install; both MCP rows stay disabled until RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR points at a local clone, which needs Python 3.12+ and uv.
description.zh: 面向十一家电商平台的技能与可选 MCP 行：跨 Wildberries、Detsky Mir、Yandex Market 比价，以及各平台（含 Ozon、Avito、AliExpress）的搜索、商品卡与评论。安装后 14 个技能立即可用；两行 MCP 默认关闭，需将 RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR 指向本地克隆，该克隆需要 Python 3.12+ 与 uv。

description.en: Browse the public skillhub.cn catalog from Settings and install selected SKILL.md bundles into ~/.dsh/skills.
description.zh: 在设置页浏览 skillhub.cn 公开技能目录，并将选中的 SKILL.md 技能包安装到 ~/.dsh/skills。

description.en: DSH plugin that registers the ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill: eight checkable working rules for coding agents (verify before calling, confirm ambiguity, cite evidence, reuse before creating, test before claiming done, follow local conventions, separate fact from inference, keep changes reversible) plus a ninth rule that logs each user request and the change made in report files at the workspace root.
description.zh: 注册 ai-eight-honors-eight-shames skill 的 DSH 插件：面向编码代理的八条可核对工作准则（先查证再调用、有歧义先确认、业务规则给出处、先复用再新造、先测试再声称完成、按既有约定写、区分事实与推断、改动可回滚），外加第 9 条——用户每次提出需求或问题，都在工作区根的报告文件里成对记录诉求与改动。

description.en: Competitive-informatics coach plugin for DeepSeek Harness: coaching-rule prompts, learning roadmap, knowledge points, problem setting, real C++ judging with g++, and ima knowledge-base retrieval with four-notebook archiving, for GESP / CSP-J/S / NOIP / NOI teaching. Needs g++, and an ima account with ima-skill and the four notebooks configured; replies carry a WeChat-account promo and QR code by default.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 信奥教练插件：教练规则提示词 + 学习路线图/知识点/命题/C++ 真评测（g++ 编译运行）+ ima 知识库检索与 4 笔记本归档，面向 GESP、CSP-J/S、NOIP、NOI 教学。需本机有 g++，并配置 ima 账号、ima-skill 与 4 个笔记本；回复默认附带公众号推广与二维码。

description.en: Competitive-informatics senior plugin for DeepSeek Harness: companion practice, three-version C++14 reference solutions, problem explanations, real g++ compile-and-judge (g++ required), and optional solution-record archiving to the ima notebook "信奥学长-题解复盘", for GESP / CSP-J/S / NOIP / NOI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 信奥学长插件：陪刷 + 三版 C++14 参考实现 + 解题说明，本地 g++ 真编译真评测（需 g++），做题记录可选归档到 ima 笔记本「信奥学长-题解复盘」，面向 GESP、CSP-J/S、NOIP、NOI。

description.en: Teaching-first CTF solving skill: narrates each step's pattern, tool choice and underlying mechanism, then writes a reproducible writeup under solves/<challenge>/ gated by a nine-section check.
description.zh: 教学式 CTF 解题技能：每步讲清套路、工具选型与底层原理，收尾在 solves/<题目名>/ 生成可复现 Writeup，并用九章质量门校验。

description.en: Project documentation scaffolding skill: question-driven setup of project standards, AI-collaboration workflows, and memory discipline across DSH, Reasonix, Claude Code, and Codex.
description.zh: 项目文档体系初始化 skill：提问驱动落实文档规范、固化 AI 协作工作流，跨 DSH / Reasonix / Claude Code / Codex 可用。

description.en: Skill-creation console for the Web UI: fetches the official creator skills, hands the requirements to the Huawei Cloud, generic, or REST API creator, then scores the generated skill against a 10-point rubric and returns the itemised deductions to the creator until it reaches 8.5/10.
description.zh: Web 界面上的技能创建面板：拉取官方 creator 技能，把需求交给华为云 / 通用 / REST API 三个 creator 之一执行创建，随后按 10 分制评测产物，未达 8.5 分就把逐项扣分交回 creator 修改直到通过。

description.en: Chinese industry and technology research report skill with an offline DOCX build pipeline (build_docx.py). Enforces a 9-chapter structure with a plain-language timeline (Section 2.1), 5-dimensional technical bottleneck criteria, and Make-vs-Buy cost/compensation trade-offs, verified by check_threads.py and compiled to .docx with a 3-level auto TOC. Requires Python 3.9+ with lxml.
description.zh: 中文行业与技术调研报告生成技能，内置离线 Word (.docx) 编译流水线（build_docx.py）。规范九章总分总结构、2.1 节白话演进时间线、五维技术瓶颈判据与自研成本/外部采购成对博弈论证，提供双主线启发式自检工具（check_research_report_threads）与带原生三级自动目录的 DOCX 构建工具（build_research_report_docx）。需要 Python 3.9+ 及 lxml。

description.en: Generate and edit AI media (image, video, audio, 3D) with WaveSpeed models via the open-source wavespeed CLI: live catalog search, per-model input-schema introspection, local-file upload with @path markers, and price checks before running.
description.zh: 通过开源 wavespeed CLI 用 WaveSpeed 模型生成与编辑 AI 媒体（图像、视频、音频、3D）：实时目录搜索、逐模型输入 schema 自省、@path 标记本地文件上传、运行前价格查询。

description.en: Skill marketplace and manager: manage skills from all local coding agents (10+ executors, incl. Claude Code and Codex) in one page and import them into the DSH skill library; built-in market of 6600+ skills, per-skill token-overhead stats, and model visibility control.
description.zh: 技能市场：一个页面管理本机所有 coding agent 的技能，一键收编进 DSH 用户库；内置 6600+ 技能市场，支持注入开销（≈token）统计与模型可见性治理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：DietrichGebert/ponytail 懒人 senior 模式与七阶梯子完美移植，6 个技能描述双语自由切换，各个技能自由开关，零 tool 注册，全场景零缓存破坏。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 15 obra/superpowers engineering skills, bilingual descriptions, per-skill toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：15 个 obra/superpowers 工程纪律技能，技能描述中英双语自由切换，每一个技能本身自由开关。

description.en: Screenshot-review skill for DeepSeek Harness: the agent opens a frontend page, screenshots it, views the screenshot itself, revises the code, then re-screenshots — iterating until the page visually matches the user's requirements. Ships as a dsh.bundle, so it installs with `dsh plugin add`.
description.zh: 截图审阅 skill：模型自己打开页面、截图、看图、改代码，反复迭代直到前端效果符合要求。以 dsh.bundle 打包，可用 `dsh plugin add` 一键安装。

description.en: A-share technical analysis (ladder dynamics) plugin: chanlun structure via struct_calc, hang-slope D+/D/D- and strong-start E+/E/E- signals, with an in-app settings page and work prompts.
description.zh: A股技术面研判（架梯动力学）插件：基于缠论结构给出挂坡 D⁺/D/D⁻ 与强势起步 E⁺/E/E⁻ 信号，附设置页与工作提示词。

description.en: Multilingual writing, chunked long-form collaboration and continuity review, with on-demand DSH delegation discovery. Requires Python 3.9+ on PATH.
description.zh: 多语言润色、长文分块协作与上下文一致性审查，按需检查 DSH 智能体委派能力。需要 PATH 上有 Python 3.9+。

description.en: Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from dropped folders, zip archives, or local paths of any size.
description.zh: 侧边栏技能站：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录一键导入，管理全局与项目技能（启停、回收站），支持拖拽文件夹、zip 包与本地路径（不限大小）安装。

description.en: Isolated-environment browser verification skill for DSH plugin development: a throwaway DSH_HOME, its own `verify_<random>` profile, its own port and its own browser instance in one command, cleaned up on exit, so the profile you are actually using is never touched; ships a zero-dependency raw-CDP driver (snapshot / click / screenshot / eval) and an optional isolation audit.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发的隔离环境浏览器验证 skill：一条命令拉起临时 DSH_HOME、独立 `verify_<随机>` profile、独立端口与独立浏览器实例，退出自动清理，不污染正在使用的 profile；自带零依赖 raw-CDP 浏览器驱动（快照 / 点击 / 截图 / 求值）与可选隔离审计。

description.en: Matches prompts to installed skills for automatic activation, applies skill-declared lifecycle hooks and tool policies, and manages GitHub-hosted skills from Settings or the skill_manager tool.
description.zh: 根据提示词自动激活已安装的 Skill，应用 Skill 声明的生命周期 Hook 与工具策略，并通过设置页或 skill_manager 工具管理 GitHub 托管的 Skill。

description.en: Answers a hard question with a one-page visual HTML explainer: the model writes a short Markdown draft and the bundled dependency-free `am` CLI builds the layout, CSS and diagram coordinates. Vendors the upstream answer-me-with-html skill verbatim as a skill-only DSH bundle with no Host code.
description.zh: 把复杂问题回答成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的零依赖 `am` 命令行负责排版、配色与图表坐标。以上游 answer-me-with-html 技能原样内置，是纯技能的 DSH bundle，不含 Host 代码。

description.en: Turns an English paper PDF into a Chinese group-meeting .pptx whose figures and tables are the paper's own cropped pixels.
description.zh: 把英文论文 PDF 做成中文组会汇报 PPT，图表用原文真实像素。

description.en: Turns one journal paper PDF into a Chinese group-meeting literature report deck (.pptx) in the Nanyang Normal University physics template, plus a matching Word speaker script. Requires Python 3 with python-pptx, python-docx, Pillow and pymupdf (pypdf fallback); install them with pip install -r requirements.txt.
description.zh: 把一篇期刊论文做成中文组会文献汇报 PPT（南阳师范学院物理模板），并附一份配套的 Word 讲稿。需本机 Python 3 及 python-pptx、python-docx、Pillow、pymupdf（pypdf 兜底）依赖，可用 pip install -r requirements.txt 安装。

description.en: Skill center panel for the DSH web GUI - search online skill registries (SkillHub, skills.sh, GitHub), install skills to user or project roots, and manage local skills with enable, create, edit, delete and preview.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的技能中心面板——搜索网络技能市场（SkillHub、skills.sh、GitHub），一键安装技能到用户或项目根，并管理本地技能（启停、创建、编辑、删除、预览）。

description.en: Import, install and invoke Agent Skills in DeepSeek Harness from Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, GitHub or npm — composer-side ⚡ picker inserts /skill-name into the draft, and a Skill 管理 settings page offers per-source/per-skill import, expandable source paths with skill counts, uninstall and one-click restore from .trash.
description.zh: 从 Codex / Claude Code / OpenCode / GitHub / npm 导入并安装技能到 ~/.dsh/skills，模型自动读取、/技能名 立即可用；对话框旁 ⚡ 一键插入调用，设置页支持按来源/单技能导入、路径与数量展示、卸载与一键恢复。

description.en: Google's Agent Skills (google/skills) for DeepSeek Harness: 128 bundled SKILL.md skills for Google Cloud, BigQuery, GKE, Gemini, Firebase, ads and analytics.
description.zh: Google 的 Agent Skills(google/skills)for DeepSeek Harness：128 个打包的 SKILL.md 技能，覆盖 Google Cloud、BigQuery、GKE、Gemini、Firebase、广告与分析。

description.en: Nightly self-improvement for your DeepSeek Harness agent: harvest past sessions offline, replay recurring tasks on your own API budget, and consolidate validated skills behind a held-out gate. Brings microsoft/SkillOpt's SkillOpt-Sleep engine to dsh as native tools plus a bundled skill - no weight training. Requires Python 3.10+ and the SkillOpt-Sleep engine (pip install skillopt).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供夜间自我进化：离线复盘过往会话，在你的 API 预算内重放高频任务，并把学到的技能凝练成经得起门禁验证的技能。把 microsoft/SkillOpt 的 SkillOpt-Sleep 引擎带进 dsh，作为原生工具加内置技能——无需模型训练。需 Python 3.10+ 并安装 SkillOpt-Sleep 引擎(pip install skillopt)。

description.en: Terse prose for DeepSeek Harness — compress the agent's own output so every reply costs fewer tokens (layer 4). Style, never substance.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的输出极简——压缩 agent 自己的输出让每句回复更省 token(layer 4)。只改措辞，不丢内容。

description.en: Session context handoff for DeepSeek Harness — stop re-reading and re-deriving context every session. A single skill (layer ①) that keeps the next session warm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话上下文交接——不再每会话重读/重建上下文。单个 skill(layer ①),让下一会话暖启动。

description.en: Context compaction / headroom for DeepSeek Harness — compress the live context so the prompt stays small without losing the state that matters (layer 3).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文压缩/headroom——压缩在线上下文让 prompt 保持小，又不丢关键状态(layer 3)。

description.en: Input redundancy pruning for DeepSeek Harness — drop repeated/redundant tokens before they reach the model (layer ②).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的输入冗余剪枝——送进模型前剪掉重复/冗余 token(layer ②)。

description.en: Cut token cost in 4 layers without cutting model intelligence: handoff, rtk, headroom, caveman token-saving skills — each also available as a standalone installable plugin.
description.zh: 四层省 Token，不牺牲模型智能：handoff、rtk、headroom、caveman 四个省 token 的 skill，每个也是独立可装插件。

description.en: Investment research bundle: 10 tools (search, page fetch, source audit, claim verification, numeric rigor, channel health, workflow loader, chart engine, PDF renderer, PDF gate) and 23 skills adapted from ai-berkshire. Runs a six-phase workflow where four parallel agents (Duan Yongping, Buffett, Munger, Li Lu) research a company, cross-examine each other, and ship a chart-rich PDF with cover, tables, captions and page numbers. Requires Python 3.10+; the chart and PDF tools also need python-docx and matplotlib.
description.zh: 投研插件：10 个工具（检索、正文抓取、来源审计、断言核验、数值严谨、通道体检、workflow 装载、图表引擎、PDF 渲染、PDF 准出），外加 23 个改造自 ai-berkshire 的技能。六阶段 workflow 让段永平/巴菲特/芒格/李录四个 Agent 并行研究、交叉质证，最终产出带封面、表格、图注与页码的图文 PDF。需 Python 3.10+；图表与 PDF 工具还需 python-docx 与 matplotlib。

description.en: Sidebar skill picker: lists installed skills with Global and repo badges, session checks plus persistent auto-start, optional Guard, Codex/Grok/Hermes user skills, and /skill injection.
description.zh: 侧边栏技能选择器：列出已安装技能并标注 Global 与所属 repo，支持本会话勾选与常驻默认启动、可选 Guard、Codex/Grok/Hermes 用户技能，以及 /skill 注入。

description.en: Turns the 13 δ-me13 (Amphoreus) role skill cards into seat workspaces: per-seat theme and wallpaper, first-turn skill injection, chat stickers, per-seat memory notes and presets, Alt+digit seat switching, and an overview canvas for dispatch and handoff; the skill suite itself is read from a configurable local directory and is not bundled.
description.zh: 把 δ-me13（翁法罗斯）的 13 张黄金裔角色技能卡变成席位工作区：逐席配色与壁纸、首轮自动注入技能卡、对话表情、每席记忆便签与预设、Alt+数字切席，以及用于派发与移交的总览画布；技能套件本身从可配置的本地目录读取，不随插件打包。

description.en: Grouped on/off switches for the skills a DSH profile exposes: the effective set is the union of the groups that are switched on, with a catalog-derived group for the skills shipped with the harness, a panel over the composer, and skill_toggles_* tools for agents.
description.zh: 按分组开关 DSH 暴露的技能：生效集合是所有启用中分组的并集；含成员由当前目录判定的自带技能分组、输入框上的面板，以及给智能体的 skill_toggles_* 工具。

description.en: Skill manager page for dsh: set each skill to on, manual only, model only, or off per agent mode; count how often each skill is loaded per mode from the session history; search skills.sh and install from GitHub; import from Codex, Claude Code, or a folder; create, edit, and version skills, with a trash for deleted ones; modes keep working after an uninstall.
description.zh: dsh 的 Skill（技能）管理页：按 Agent 模式把每个 Skill 设为开、仅手动、仅模型或关；从会话历史统计每个 Skill 在各模式里被加载的次数；搜索 skills.sh 并从 GitHub 安装；从 Codex、Claude Code 或文件夹导入；新建、编辑、保存版本，删除的 Skill 进回收站；卸载后模式照常可用。

description.en: Shows what each installed skill costs in the model context and hides a skill from the catalog without deleting it. Lists every skill found on disk with the exact catalog line the model receives (description normalized and truncated at the catalog cap), its body size and token estimate; previews the catalog message byte-for-byte as the agent will receive it, compares that with the copy already published in the current session, and reports skills on disk that never reach the catalog (invalid frontmatter, or shadowed by a higher-priority root). Hiding writes disable-model-invocation into frontmatter and keeps the file, so the skill still works via /name. Also imports skills from ClawHub, Skills.sh and GitHub URLs and uninstalls user-owned ones.
description.zh: 显示每个已安装 skill 在模型上下文中占多少，并能在不删除文件的前提下把它从目录里摘掉。按 DSH 的渲染规则给出模型实际看到的那一行（介绍归一化并按目录上限截断）、正文体积与 token 估算；可逐字预览模型将收到的目录消息，与会话里已发布的那份比对，并列出来自磁盘却进不了目录的 skill（frontmatter 无效，或被更高优先级的同名 skill 覆盖）。隐藏会写入 disable-model-invocation 并保留文件，skill 仍可通过 /名字 调用。同时支持从 ClawHub、Skills.sh 与 GitHub 链接导入，以及卸载用户目录下的 skill。

description.en: Universal skill adapter that registers any GitHub repo containing a SKILL.md as a DSH skill by cloning and symlinking into the official skills root.
description.zh: 通用 skill 适配器，将含 SKILL.md 的 GitHub 仓库克隆并 symlink 到官方 skills 根目录，注册为 DSH skill。

description.en: Reads the session event stream, with no extra model calls, and turns corrections, failures and fixes into pending lesson candidates. Every candidate is judged against written criteria and carries the reason it passed or was refused; only confirmation writes a skill, and only through the single validated writer `learn_skill_manage`. An idle curator marks unused skills stale and archives them by moving rather than deleting, and spares any skill that is still being loaded. Five tools: `learn`, `learn_review`, `learn_curator`, `learn_skill_manage`, `learn_skills`. Registers a prompt section stating the criteria, and a tool guard that refuses direct edits to skill files so the writer cannot be bypassed.
description.zh: 读取会话自身的事件流（不额外发起模型调用），把纠正、失败与修法变成待确认的候选教训。每条候选按写死的标准逐项判定，并给出通过或被拒的理由；只有确认之后才写成技能，而且只能经过唯一的写入口 `learn_skill_manage`。闲置时由 curator 把长期不用的技能标为陈旧并归档（是移动，不是删除），仍在被加载的技能会被豁免。五个工具：`learn`、`learn_review`、`learn_curator`、`learn_skill_manage`、`learn_skills`。另外注册一段写明判定标准的提示词段落，并挂一个工具守卫，拒绝直接编辑技能文件，使写入口无法被绕过。

description.en: Rigorous open mathematics research suite: four agent skills (rigorous-open-math-research, manage-math-research-program, math-research-workflow, lean-verify) for theorem solving with adversarial audit, research program management, pipeline orchestration, and Lean 4 formalization audit; CI-verified tests and mechanical upstream sync.
description.zh: 严谨开放数学研究套件：4 个 agent skill（rigorous-open-math-research、manage-math-research-program、math-research-workflow、lean-verify），覆盖对抗性审计的定理求解、研究项目管理、流水线编排与 Lean 4 形式化审计；CI 测试与机械式上游同步。

description.en: Provides three learning skills for course notes, conceptual explanations, and self-contained lecture chapters, with bundled references and course helper scripts.
description.zh: 提供课程阅读稿、理解式讲解与自足讲义三个学习技能，附带参考文件和课程辅助脚本。

description.en: Design-artifact skill adapted from Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder: turns a design brief into a self-contained HTML/SVG artifact (posters, infographics, landing pages, charts, component mockups) with a pre-delivery quality checklist and an anti-AI-look pattern list.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的设计稿生成 skill（改编自 Anthropic canvas-design / web-artifacts-builder）：把设计需求做成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿（海报、信息图、落地页、图表、组件稿），内置交付前质量清单与「去 AI 味」反模式清单。

description.en: Hand a command-line-verified operation over to the GUI: drive it once, verify with ground truth, and hand back a self-contained illustrated tutorial.
description.zh: 把命令行验证过的操作交接给图形界面：自己驱动一遍、用地面真值验证，并产出人能照着做的自包含带图教程。

description.en: Self-evolving project-level Agent for DeepSeek Harness: 16 SDD workflow skills (clarification, PRD, issue, coding, locating, acceptance, review) plus project memory and knowledge that compound over time.
description.zh: 会进化的项目级 Agent：以 SDD 规格驱动掌舵全流程，内置 16 个技能覆盖澄清、PRD、issue、编码、定位、验收、审查；会记忆、会沉淀，越用越懂你的项目。

description.en: Skill center for DSH: browse skills by region, install them from a zip archive, and manage them afterwards with enable/disable, uninstall, trash restore and search.
description.zh: 技能中心：按区域浏览技能、从 zip 安装，并支持启用停用、卸载、回收站恢复与搜索。

description.en: Three-layer skill management for DeepSeek Harness: a library pool, per-workspace enablement whitelists, and per-session picks, with a Web settings panel, a conversation-embedded view, a skill file browser/editor, zip and folder import, and engine-load validation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能生命周期管理：技能库（纯技能池）、工作区启用白名单、会话勾选三层模型；Web 设置面板与对话页内嵌视图，支持技能文件浏览/编辑、zip 与文件夹批量导入、引擎实际加载校验。

description.en: Provides three skills for the Let's Build Robots SO-101 course: yanshifu reads the learner's project files to assess progress and suggest next steps; ask answers questions using four bundled guides; update checks for and installs updates to those guides.
description.zh: 为《一起手搓机器人》SO-101 课程提供三个技能：yanshifu 读取学员的项目文件，判断进度并建议下一步；ask 根据四份配套资料回答问题；update 检查并更新本地配套资料。

description.en: Serves the OwlCoda RunKit skill in the DSH skill catalog: project-owned objectives, work items, candidate identity, verification receipts, handoffs and recovery stay in project artifacts. Installs instructions only; the project-local owlrunkit CLI is a separate setup step.
description.zh: 把 OwlCoda RunKit 技能加入 DSH 技能目录：目标、WorkItem、候选身份、验证回执、交接和恢复保存在项目工件中。只安装指令；项目本地的 owlrunkit CLI 仍需单独安装。

description.en: Generate complete AI songs and BGM from prompts or lyrics, with reference-audio creation and song extension.
description.zh: 根据提示词或歌词生成完整 AI 歌曲和 BGM，并支持参考音频创作与歌曲续写。

description.en: Image and video production toolkit for DeepSeek Harness - background removal with quality tiers, local inpainting retouch, headline and logo compositing, batch platform-size exports and image QA reports; for video, AI subject matting with background replacement (RVM ONNX, plus a chroma-key path), animated titles with fade/slide/typewriter/karaoke presets, 53 transitions with stylized variants, and light-effect and grading presets with LUT support, alongside footage inventory, accurate cutting, subtitle burn-in, music mixing and platform-spec exports; it provisions its own local Python runtime through a bundled bootstrap script.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的美工与视频剪辑工具包——可分档抠图、局部重绘改图、标题与 logo 合成、平台规格批量导出与图片体检；视频侧含 AI 抠像换背景（RVM ONNX，另有绿幕色键路径）、淡入/滑入/打字机/卡拉OK 动效文字、53 种转场与风格化变体、光效与调色预设（支持 LUT），以及素材通览、精确裁切、字幕烧入、配乐混音与平台规格导出；通过内置引导脚本自备本地 Python 运行时。

description.en: Turns course, lecture, tutorial, meeting, and talk videos into structured study notes: it extracts the audio track with ffmpeg, transcribes it with Whisper, then writes notes with a chapter outline, emphasis markers, and a quick-reference card.
description.zh: 把课程、讲座、教程、会议、演讲等视频整理成结构化学习笔记：用 ffmpeg 提取音轨、Whisper 语音转文字，再生成带分段大纲、重点标记和速查卡的笔记。

description.en: Skill manager for DSH with a pack system. Installs skills as versioned packs and never overwrites files you have edited - upgrades skip your changes and report them. Also ships 6 built-in skills, a problem-grouped settings panel, and tools that let the agent read and write the skill library in conversation.
description.zh: DSH 技能管理器，带技能包机制。技能以带版本的包安装，升级时绝不覆盖你改过的文件，只跳过并如实报告。另自带 6 个基础技能、按「你遇到的问题」分组的面板，以及让模型在对话里直接读写技能库的工具。

description.en: Always-on ADHD-friendly output shaping: one system-prompt section makes replies action-first with numbered steps and concrete time estimates; adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status tools persist the mode across restarts.
description.zh: 常驻的 ADHD 友好输出塑形：一个系统提示词区段让回复行动先行、步骤编号、时间估算具体；adhd_on / adhd_off / adhd_status 三个工具让模式跨重启保持。

description.en: Router and artifact gate for DeepSeek Harness: a per-turn skill router that ranks the live catalog, plus a write gate enforcing read-before-write, dedupe and a four-line audit on every file write.
description.zh: DSH 的技能路由与写入门禁：每回合对现有技能目录排序选择，另有一道写入门禁，强制先读后写、去重，并为每次写文件留下四行审计。

description.en: Chain-of-thought leakage linter: zero-dependency CLI that finds AI-session residue in docs and comments (dead design citations, PR vantage, change narration, review choreography), shipping the cot-trim fixing skill as the installable bundle.
description.zh: 思维链泄漏检测：零依赖 CLI 扫描 AI 留在文档与注释里的会话残留（死设计引用、PR 视角、变更叙述、评审编排），内置 cot-trim 语义修复技能包。

description.en: It shows the number of confirmed loaded skills in the conversation header. Click **技能** (Skills) to open the right sidebar and check whether each skill's full main body remains in the current main assistant context, along with its recorded versions and sources.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏显示已确认加载的技能数量，点击「技能」打开右侧面板，查看完整正文是否仍在当前主助手上下文中，以及各次加载的正文版本与来源。

description.en: Provide a LeLogin skill for credential injection and authenticated business applications without exposing plaintext secrets.
description.zh: 提供 LeLogin 技能，用于凭据注入和已登录业务系统调用，避免向模型暴露明文秘密。

description.en: Auto-injects user-chosen skills into DSH sessions, either every prompt or once at session start, with a settings page and a composer indicator.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中自动注入所选技能（如 caveman、ponytail）：每轮提示或仅在会话开始时，含设置页与输入区指示。

description.en: Design-aesthetics skill pack (10 styles: dark SaaS, minimal white, neumorphism, brutalism, glassmorphism, Japanese minimal, bento grid, cyberpunk, vaporwave, art deco) with runnable landing-page demos: tokens, component rules, forbidden lists, and acceptance checklists per style.
description.zh: 设计美学技能包：10 种风格（深色 SaaS、极简白、新拟态、粗野主义、毛玻璃、日式极简、便当盒、赛博朋克、蒸汽波、装饰艺术），每种含 token、组件规则、禁用清单与验收清单，附可运行落地页 demo。

description.en: DSH session workflows for packaging verifiable capsules, evaluating reusable Skills, and comparing controlled session trajectories.
description.zh: 用于打包可验证会话、评测可复用技能和对比受控会话轨迹的 DSH 工作流。

description.en: Diagnoses and fixes "duplicate loader entry id" boot crashes - finds duplicate loader rows across profile bundles and converts them into id-targeted patches via a zero-dependency CLI (detect / preview / fix / verify).
description.zh: 检测并修复 dsh 启动的 "duplicate loader entry id" 崩溃：扫描 profile 各 bundle 的重复 loader row，转换为 id-targeted patch，附带零依赖 CLI（检测/预览/修复/复检）。

description.en: Skill studio for DeepSeek Harness: visualize every agent skill (name, description, source, nested flag, model/user invocation), view and edit the full SKILL.md body, toggle model/user invocation, and mine DSH session logs to extract reusable personal skills that the agent auto-loads — from the web settings panel and via skillmgr_* / skillmgr_extract_* tools.
description.zh: DSH skill 可视化与管理插件：在设置面板列出全部 skill（含来源、嵌套标记与模型/用户调用状态），查看并编辑 SKILL.md 正文，一键启用/禁用模型与用户调用；并可从会话日志提取可复用内容，沉淀为 agent 可自动加载的个人 skill。提供 skillmgr_list/get/save/policy 及 skillmgr_extract_* 工具。

description.en: DSH bundle of the 27 promoted skills from mattpocock/skills v1.3.2 (TDD, code review, grilling, spec and ticket flows, domain modelling), bodies byte-identical to upstream and upstream invocation policies preserved; ships a sync script and an offline contract check.
description.zh: 把 mattpocock/skills v1.3.2 的 27 个精选技能（TDD、代码审查、grilling、规格与工单流程、领域建模等）打包为 DSH 插件；技能正文与上游逐字节一致，并保留上游调用策略；附带上游同步脚本与离线契约校验。

description.en: Skill for building a game design brief into a playable, publishable TapTap Maker project: it picks the browser workspace or local MCP route, extracts the five elements of the brief, writes a first-round prompt for a minimal core loop, iterates in the official order, checks preview and release materials, and keeps credit, credential and irreversible-action limits in view. Includes eight reference notes on the product, credits, themes and asset limits, the leaderboard, brief parsing, iteration, publishing and safety, four templates, and three read-only Python checks for brief completeness, project layout and release materials.
description.zh: 把一份游戏策划案在 TapTap 制造（UrhoX 引擎 + Lua）上落成可玩、可发布的项目：先用浏览器工作区还是本地 MCP、拆解策划案五要素、写最小可玩的首轮需求、按官方顺序迭代、核对预览与发布物料，并守住积分、凭证与不可逆动作的红线。含 8 篇参考（产品、积分、主题与素材、排行榜、需求拆解、迭代验收、发布、安全）、4 个模板、3 个只读 Python 校验脚本（五要素完整性、项目目录、发布物料）。

description.en: Registers the project-cross-migration skill for DSH: five-layer agent project migration (conversations, memory, persona, tools, environment) with entry validation, JSONL integrity checks and readable restore. 1,418-message real migration verified across three platforms; pure Python stdlib, MIT.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注册 project-cross-migration 技能：对话/记忆/人格/工具/环境五层迁移，含入口校验、JSONL 完整性检查与可读还原。三平台 1418 条消息真实迁移实测；纯 Python 标准库，MIT。

description.en: Skill center for the dsh web GUI: browse all loaded skills grouped by source, enable or disable model invocation, create new skills, and delete into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: 技能中心：按来源分级浏览已加载的全部 skill，启用/禁用模型调用、创建新技能、删除进可恢复回收站。

description.en: Run Stata through DeepSeek Harness: the native Stata AI Skill service auto-starts with DSH (macOS/Windows binaries bundled), so you can run regressions, do-files and econometrics workflows with no manual setup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行 Stata：Stata AI Skill 原生服务随 DSH 自动启动（内置 macOS/Windows 多平台二进制），无需手动配置即可跑回归、do 文件与计量工作流。

description.en: ADHD behavioral coaching skill: task breakdown, overwhelm management, launch rituals, and failure recovery.
description.zh: ADHD 行为辅导技能：任务拆解、事项过载管理、启动仪式与失败重启。

description.en: On-demand skill tools for DeepSeek Harness: registers skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref so the model searches a staged skill library first and loads a skill body only when it needs it, keeping the library out of the resident session catalog and out of every turn's context; adds a Skills tab to the conversation view ring that reads back the whole session and lists which skills were actually loaded, and in which turn. Zero dependencies, and the records render client-side only, never entering the model's context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按需技能工具：注册 skill_search / skill_load / skill_ref 三个工具，让模型先从分层的技能库里检索、再按需加载正文，库里的技能因而不必进入常驻目录、不占每轮上下文；并在对话视图栏加一个「技能」标签页，回读整个会话、列出本次真正加载过哪些技能及其轮次。零依赖，所有技能调用记录只在客户端渲染，不进入模型上下文。

description.en: Registers the commercial-ui-ux skill for DSH: task-aware commercial UI/UX/GUI design, review, repair, and implementation (SaaS, dashboards, admin panels, forms, tables, design systems) with a reference-doc system and quality gates.
description.zh: 注册 commercial-ui-ux 技能：以任务为中心的商业界面 UI/UX/GUI 设计、审查、修复与实现（SaaS、仪表盘、后台、表单、表格、设计系统），带参考文档体系与质量门禁。

description.en: Bundles the 32 gis/ skills of opengis-skills (GDAL, QGIS, GeoServer, PostGIS, PROJ, PDAL, GRASS GIS, JTS, GeoPandas, Shapely, CesiumJS, OpenLayers, Leaflet, deck.gl and more) into the DSH skill catalog; only names and descriptions appear up front, and instruction bodies plus reference documents load on demand.
description.zh: 把 opengis-skills 的 32 个 gis/ 技能（GDAL、QGIS、GeoServer、PostGIS、PROJ、PDAL、GRASS GIS、JTS、GeoPandas、Shapely、CesiumJS、OpenLayers、Leaflet、deck.gl 等）打包进 DSH 技能目录；目录只列出名称与描述，技能正文与参考文档按需加载。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.
description.zh: DSH bundle 技能包：把深度长文生产（学术论文 / 行业分析 / 商业评论）拆成 9 角色流水线——T1 文献 / T2 数据 / T3 案例三线并行检索、T4 分析、T5 写作、T6 批判伙伴、T7 审计、T8 终检（主控亲执行）、T9 同行评审，跨 6 个阶段，含三角验证、M 门 26 项终检（25 项机检 + 1 项人工）、G0-G16 独立审计（含中文 AI 痕迹闸）、审稿评分与期刊匹配，以及 4 个人在环节点。以 bundle 分发（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` + `lib/index.js` 入口注册技能），`dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` 即装；随包 T1-T9 角色卡、模板与 36 个零依赖校验脚本，README 五语。

description.en: Adds two audit tools and four skills for Chinese medium-to-long texts (fiction among them) and document review — seven-dimension AI-flavor scoring with line-numbered blocking findings, plus file-backed continuity state for long manuscripts. Do not install with the older dsh-deai-audit from the same author, which registers the same tool names.
description.zh: 提供两个审查工具与四个技能，覆盖中长文本（例如小说）与文档审稿：七维 AI 味打分、带行号的阻断项，以及落盘的长篇连续性状态。不要与同作者的旧版 dsh-deai-audit 同装，二者注册同名工具。

description.en: File-state cache skill for coding agents: one explore call replaces ls+grep+read, reads remember they already happened, and edits return a diff plus the exact changed line range instead of a full re-read. State is a JSON cache on disk, so it survives across tool calls and restarts. Requires Python 3.8+ (standard library only).
description.zh: 文件状态缓存技能：一次 explore 代替 ls+grep+read，读过的文件不再重复全量读，改完只回 diff 与精确变更行区间而不是重读全文。状态存在磁盘上的 JSON 缓存里，跨工具调用与重启都有效。需要 Python 3.8+（仅标准库，无需安装第三方依赖）。

description.en: Work reports for DeepSeek Harness: gathers Git commits and local agent conversations (DeepSeek/Claude/Codex) and renders daily, weekly or monthly reports from your own templates; the agent tool is injected on demand.
description.zh: dsh 工作报告：汇总 Git 提交与本地 agent 对话（DeepSeek/Claude/Codex），按自定义模板生成日报/周报/月报，agent 工具按需注入。

description.en: Adds persistent execution contracts, recursive work graphs, critical clarification, and evidence gates for long or underspecified Harness tasks.
description.zh: 为长期或定义不完整的 Harness 任务提供持久执行合同、递归工作图、关键澄清与证据门禁。

description.en: Arms a watch on a directory and delivers a batched, deduplicated diff when the tree goes quiet, filtering out the writes the session made itself; delivery is per watch, either waking a new turn or queueing for the next step.
description.zh: 监视目录，在文件树安静后投递批量合并、去重的变更清单，并过滤掉本会话自己的写入；投递方式按监视器选择，可起新回合或排队到下一步。

description.en: One hub over every coding IDE you run — dsh, Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, Qoder, CatPaw, Trae, OpenCode. Zero-API: it reads each tool's own on-disk state and gives a session inventory, per-IDE usage with cache-hit rates, one-line resume commands, and a single .hub/ rule body wired into all eight via marker-delimited pointer files. The domestic-IDE adapters (Trae/Qoder/CatPaw) were verified against the installed binaries — a gap no overseas tool covers.
description.zh: 一个入口管住所有编码 IDE（dsh/Claude Code/Codex/ZCode/Qoder/CatPaw/Trae/OpenCode）：零 API 读各自磁盘状态，出会话盘点、按 IDE 用量与缓存命中率、一键恢复命令，并用指针文件把一份规则本体接入全部 8 个工具。国产 IDE 适配位从本机安装的二进制里逐一逆向核实，补齐海外工具的空缺。

description.en: Compiles a rough need into a versioned task book (goal / context / constraints / acceptance / decisions / open gaps, all numbered) and hands it to any AI window losslessly: the receiver must pass a read-back handshake — restate, list gaps, declare READY — before work starts; /answer closes gaps with an automatic version bump, /forge-list tracks which window holds which version.
description.zh: 把大白话编译成开源标准任务书（目标/约束/验收/决策/缺口全编号），再无损交接给任意窗口的 AI：接收方必须通过回读握手——复述理解、列出缺口、声明 READY——才被允许开工；缺口答案回填自动升版本，台账记录哪个窗口持有哪个版本。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness — autopilot/ralph/team execution modes, 19 role cards, 40 bilingual skills, and a bundled MCP state server, ported from oh-my-claudecode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排层——autopilot/ralph/team 三种执行模式、19 张角色卡、40 个双语技能与内置 MCP 状态服务，移植自 oh-my-claudecode。

description.en: Trellis-style workflow for DeepSeek Harness: per-turn phase breadcrumbs via agent/pre-step, bundled skill provider, and DSH-native task/phase state with git-cleanliness guardrails.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Trellis 风格工作流：基于 agent/pre-step 的每轮速记注入、内置技能提供方，以及带 git 清洁度护栏的 DSH 原生任务与相位状态管理。

description.en: AI Look-Up: detects aimless grinding (repeated commands, failure loops, long runs with no output) and injects mid-run self-review nudges, plus a real local-clock anchor so the agent stops estimating elapsed time.
description.zh: AI 抬头：检测空跑（重复命令 / 连续失败 / 久跑零产出）并在运行中途注入自我审查提醒，同时定期注入真实本地时间，校准 AI 的时间感。

description.en: 21 read-only lifecycle governance tools in one self-contained DSH plugin: task tiering, state/plan/evidence validation, gate precheck and aggregation, release/install audits, context and progress analysis, critical path, resume reconciliation, and a mutation preview that always denies execution. Installs from npm as @240xu/dsh-tech-lead.
description.zh: 单包 21 个只读生命周期治理工具：任务分级、状态/计划/证据校验、Gate 预检与聚合、发布与安装审计、上下文与推进分析、关键路径、续跑对账，以及始终拒绝执行的变更预览。npm 包名 @240xu/dsh-tech-lead。

description.en: Captain-led multi-agent teams that split a goal into tasks and dispatch them along an execution chain to members running in their own sub-sessions, each with its own model.
description.zh: 领队主导的多智能体团队：把目标拆成任务，按执行链派发给运行在各自子会话里的成员，每个成员可配不同模型。

description.en: Mailbox for DeepSeek Harness: sessions pass letters through a shared folder, and an hourly randomized scheduler can wake a session on its own (mutual letters between two sessions, or a gentle nudge to the owner). Per-recipient hourly rate limit and a UTF-8 log.
description.zh: DSH 会话信箱：两间会话用文件夹互相传信，另加按小时随机调度——互递信，或主动找主人说话；每个收信人每小时限流，带 UTF-8 日志。

description.en: Cron scheduler with a sidebar UI: run shell, Python or Node scripts, skills, or agent tasks on a schedule, with push notifications and session archiving.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：侧栏管理界面，按 cron 表达式或间隔执行脚本、技能与 Agent 任务，支持完成后推送通知与会话归档。

description.en: A work assistant for WeChat: it records what you tell it into a SQLite task ledger, ranks items by urgency, reminds you on schedule, extracts people and their relations from your notes, and hands tasks to separate assistant sessions. Ships its own WeChat bot channel (scan to log in; private chat only) and a full-page dashboard.
description.zh: 微信工作助理：把你交代的事记进 SQLite 任务账本，按紧急度排序，到点提醒，从笔记里抽取人物与关系，并把任务分派给独立的助手会话。自带微信机器人通道（扫码登录，仅私聊）与整页仪表盘。

description.en: Pre-implementation design review gate: an Elephant agent drafts the design, zero-context Goldfish subagents attack it from fixed reviewer roles, and you approve before implementation.
description.zh: 动工前的设计评审闸门：大象代理写设计图纸，零上下文金鱼子代理按固定角色挑刺，你拍板后才开始实现。

description.en: Deliver-and-align mode: the agent hands over one block at a time through an align_deliver tool, each block lands on disk immediately so you can edit it in place, and the agent re-reads your version before continuing.
description.zh: 交付对齐模式：AI 通过 align_deliver 工具一次只交付一块，每块直接落盘、你可以就地在文件里改，AI 重读你的版本后再继续；方向错了可带时间戳备份安全返工。

description.en: Read-only orchd panel for the DSH right sidebar: task board, ideas board, dependency graph, review timeline and an install entry for the project of the current session.
description.zh: 把 orchd 项目状态带进 DSH 右侧栏的只读面板：任务看板、想法看板、依赖图、审查时间线与接入入口，只跟当前会话的项目。

description.en: Engineering workflow agent preset for dsh: five gated phases (requirements clarification, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagents, verified finishing) with six workflow skills adapted from obra/superpowers.
description.zh: 工程化工作流 agent preset：五阶段硬门禁（需求澄清、计划审批、TDD、子 Agent 并行、验证收尾），附 6 个改编自 obra/superpowers 的工作流技能。

description.en: Windows-only: adds a switch to Settings → General that powers the computer off when the finished conversation ends (default delay 60 s, configurable 5–86400 s), behind a native countdown dialog that cancels the pending shutdown in one click (shutdown /a).
description.zh: 仅 Windows：在「设置 → 通用」增加一个开关，本次对话完成后按设定延迟（默认 60 秒，可设 5–86400 秒）自动关机，并弹出原生倒计时窗口，点一下即执行 shutdown /a 取消本次关机。

description.en: Preset workflow template library: 12 reusable orchestration script templates with wf_template_list / wf_template_search / wf_template_run / wf_template_validate tools and static template validation.
description.zh: 预置 Workflow 模板库：12 个可复用编排脚本模板，提供 wf_template_list / wf_template_search / wf_template_run / wf_template_validate 工具与模板格式静态校验。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-crossfire

description.en: Adversarial review for DeepSeek Harness: put one settled plan on the stand, send read-only red-team experts at it by dimension, then split their findings into single defects you endorse or reject one by one. It never rewrites the plan and never fixes code.
description.zh: 对抗式评审：把一个已定稿的方案摆上台，让只读红队专家按维度分头攻击，再把发言拆成逐条可裁决的缺陷由你逐一认定或驳回。它不产出方案、不改代码、不自动修复。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Visual round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness — expert nodes on a ring with directed edges, an aggregation gateway, proxy thinking for black-box worker models, and adversarial review (red-team) of settled plans with per-viewpoint endorse/reject.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话变成可视化圆桌会议：环形专家拓扑、连线协作、汇聚网关、代理思考，以及「针锋相对」红队评审（观点支持/驳回）。

description.en: Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs.
description.zh: 定时任务面板：分区管理 DSH 与系统 crontab、自然语言生成表达式、执行日志与完成后消息推送。

description.en: Creates, runs and monitors persistent research experiment loops from the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面创建、运行和监控可持久化的研究实验循环。

description.en: Dispatches coding tasks to local Orca-managed agents and reports completion to DSH; documented for DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
description.zh: 将编程任务派给本地 Orca 管理的 Agent 并将完成状态带回 DSH，现有文档面向 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

description.en: Ports poteto's pstack engineering playbooks to DSH, covering planning, review, verification and release workflows.
description.zh: 将 poteto 的 pstack 工程工作流移植到 DSH，涵盖规划、审查、验证与发布。

description.en: DeepSeek-led background orchestration of Codex and DSH subagents, with existing conversation handoff, Markdown history, quota pauses, and bounded decision retries.
description.zh: 由 DeepSeek 主导后台调度 Codex 和 DSH 子对话，支持已有对话接管、Markdown 历史、额度暂停和有限决策重试。

description.en: Durable task-decomposition plans for DeepSeek Harness: the model submits a staged plan with acceptance criteria, every work item then runs on a real department subagent, and the progress panel draws done/running/blocked subtasks as a ring, a stacked bar and per-stage steps. Ships a public security self-assessment structured on ISO/IEC 15408:2026 (Common Criteria) — security target, vulnerability analysis, SBOM and a security policy — with an explicit "no certificate claimed" line, plus a published self-correction record of where v1.8.0 documentation overstated the code (fixed in 1.8.1). Every claim is checkable by the reader instead of taken on trust. One command to install, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的任务分解计划：先给出带验收标准的分阶段计划，每项工作交给真实的部门子 Agent 执行；进度面板用环形图、四段构成条与逐阶段步进条画出已完成、进行中与卡住的子任务。随包提供按 ISO/IEC 15408:2026（通用准则 CC）结构编写的公开安全自评估——安全目标、脆弱性分析、SBOM 与安全策略，并在首行明确写"未主张认证"；v1.8.0 中三处"文档说得比代码多"的地方已在 v1.8.1 公开更正，1.8.2 把两个卖点提到首页第一句，更正过程也写进仓库。每条声明都能被读者自己核对，而不是靠信任。一条命令安装，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Codex-inspired lifecycle command hooks for DSH, with explicit tool-input sharing, pre-tool deny policies, notifications, and local audit examples.
description.zh: DSH 的 Codex 风格生命周期命令钩子，支持工具参数显式共享、执行前拒绝，以及通知与本地审计示例。

description.en: Run your RunningHub ComfyUI workflows from DSH to generate images, video and audio, with a workflow setup panel, background tasks and multi-key management.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中调用你的 RunningHub ComfyUI 工作流生成图片、视频和音频，提供工作流配置面板、后台任务和多 Key 管理。

description.en: Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message tools so the model can come back to a chat on its own.
description.zh: 把消息排进 dsh 会话稍后再发：消息框里带日期与时间选择器的「定时」按钮、跨会话列出待发消息的侧栏面板、浏览器关着也由宿主按时投递成一条普通用户消息，以及 schedule_message / list_scheduled_messages / cancel_scheduled_message 三个工具，模型因而能自己回到某个会话。

plugins.name: dsh-history-plugin

description.en: Tracks successful DSH plugin installs per device, merges the ledger across devices through a user-authorized Baidu Netdisk account, and supports preflighted batch reinstalls.
description.zh: 按设备记录 DSH 插件成功安装历史，通过用户授权的百度网盘账号跨设备合并账本，并支持预检后的批量重装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Keeps an unattended DeepSeek Harness session moving when nobody answers ask_user_question: it fronts the question waterfall, leaves a human answer untouched, and after a configurable window (120 s by default) submits the option marked (Recommended)/（推荐）, or the configured first/last fallback; plan reviews stay with the human unless explicitly enabled.
description.zh: 无人值守时没人回答 ask_user_question，也让会话继续走：站在问题 waterfall 前面，有人回答就原样放行；超过可配置窗口（默认 120 秒）后提交标了（推荐）/(Recommended) 的选项，或按 first/last 兜底；计划审批默认仍交给人，需显式开启。

description.en: Workflow tools for the local aflare binary: generate, validate and run local-first deterministic YAML workflow DAGs (WAL crash recovery, Saga compensation) through the local aflare binary, with 300+ templates built in.
description.zh: aflare 工作流工具：通过本地 aflare 二进制生成、校验并执行本地优先的确定性 YAML 工作流 DAG（WAL 崩溃恢复、Saga 补偿），内置 300+ 模板。

description.en: Turns your AI agent application into an interactive workspace for ideation and design, with editable panels, structured knowledge and guided iteration.
description.zh: 将你的 AI 智能体应用升级为交互式构思设计工作台，通过可编辑面板、结构化知识与有目的的循环推荐，协作完成复杂任务。

description.en: Runs one-time and RFC 5545 recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with visual schedule editing and session-linked history.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或 RFC 5545 周期 Agent 任务，支持可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。

description.en: A shared kanban board that lets people and DSH agents manage workspace tasks through a Board tab and kanban tools.
description.zh: 一个由用户与 DSH Agent 共同维护的工作区看板，通过看板标签页和 kanban 工具管理任务。

description.en: Six-stage WeChat Official Account content-publishing workflow with quality-gate tools and a bundled skill.
description.zh: 六阶段公众号内容发布工作流，带质检门工具与配套 skill。

description.en: Agent preset: one session runs a three-phase auto-development pipeline — interactive design with parallel research subagents, goal-driven development with reviewer/developer subagents and per-package budget ledgers, then an acceptance fix loop.
description.zh: Agent 预设：单会话跑三阶段自动开发流水线——并行研究员子代理交互设计、goal 驱动审核/开发子代理开发（按包预算台账硬上限）、验收修复循环。

description.en: Declarative task-DAG orchestration for DSH: validates dependency graphs, runs topological task layers in parallel through workflow-backed subagents, and propagates failures deterministically.
description.zh: DSH 声明式任务 DAG 编排：校验依赖图，通过工作流子智能体并行执行拓扑任务层，并确定性传播失败。

description.en: A faster, more efficient, and more accurate coding Agent preset. On 100 hard SWE-bench Pro tasks selected using multidimensional difficulty criteria, average elapsed time decreased by 36%, average input tokens per task decreased by 17%, and accuracy increased by 5 percentage points.
description.zh: 提供一个更快、更节省、更准确的编码 Agent 预设。在按多维难度规则筛选的 SWE-bench Pro 高难度 100 题评测中，平均耗时减少 36%，平均每题输入 token 减少 17%，正确率提高 5 个百分点。

description.en: Streams DeepSeek Harness sessions, messages, tool activity, and turn outcomes to a JARVIS Mission Control board with task status and human review.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话、消息、工具活动与每轮结果实时推送到 JARVIS Mission Control 看板，附任务状态与人工复核。

description.en: A visual workbench for reference-image generation, cropping and component-wise Tripo 3D modeling, with per-task paid-operation approval and local asset previews.
description.zh: 用于参考图生成、裁剪、分件 Tripo 3D 建模与本地资产预览的可视化工作台，收费操作须逐次确认。

description.en: Task reliability: auto-retry on model timeouts/failures, auto-continue unfinished tasks, completion verification, thinking-repeat interruption, resume after sleep or restart, autopilot mode and a remote trigger endpoint (npm: `dsh-task-reliability`).
description.zh: 任务可靠性：模型超时/请求失败自动重试、任务未完成自动继续、独立完成度校验、思考重复检测打断、休眠/重启后任务自动恢复、自主决策模式、远程触发接口（npm: `dsh-task-reliability`）。

plugins.name: dsh-task-runner

description.en: Coordinates PUA and Completion Guard tasks from /task-run or a CLI, requiring frozen acceptance and a current candidate/Goal certificate before completion, with an 8-round and 90-minute ceiling. Verified on macOS Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2. Since 0.3.7, PUA 0.3.27, Completion Guard 0.9.0 and SpecWorkflow 0.1.1 are bundled, so only Task Runner itself needs installing.
description.zh: 通过 /task-run 或 CLI 协调 PUA 与 Completion Guard 长任务，冻结验收通过且当前候选与 Goal 证书有效后才允许完成，最多 8 轮、90 分钟。已验证 macOS Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2。自 0.3.7 起已内置 PUA 0.3.27、Completion Guard 0.9.0 与 SpecWorkflow 0.1.1，只需安装 Task Runner 本身。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-plan-checkup

description.en: Checks each step of a plan before you approve it, using command rules plus Jev or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with logprobs, and marks steps that can't be undone, affect things outside the workspace, weren't asked for or are too vague on the plan review card.
description.zh: 在你同意执行计划前逐步检查每一步，用命令规则加上 Jev 或支持 logprobs 的 OpenAI 兼容端点，在计划审阅卡片上标出无法恢复、影响工作区以外、需求没提到或描述太模糊的步骤。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: ZenTao work panel in the DSH left sidebar: lists tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you (web-login protocol, so instances where the RESTful v2 API is unavailable are supported — verified on ZenTao 18.13 open-source) with search, smart sort, overdue / due-today filters and a flow-board view; opens a new chat pre-filled with the card's description, recent comments and screenshots (or a blank one), or dispatches it to a new background session with workspace, model, reasoning-effort and optional-instruction selection (single or multi-select batch), turns screenshots inside ticket descriptions into real image attachments, reads back the linked session's latest reply once a card is done and lets you answer the agent from the panel while it waits on you, and tracks each card with live running / needs-decision / done status plus manual overrides and a manually-marked finished state, with a deep link to ZenTao's finish / resolve page. Multi-account; read-only, no writes back to ZenTao.
description.zh: DSH 左侧栏禅道工作面板：列出指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求（走网页登录协议，RESTful v2 API 不可用的实例也能用，已在禅道 18.13 开源版实测），支持搜索、智能排序、逾期/今天到期筛选与流程看板；可新建对话并自动带入任务背景（描述、最近动态与截图，也可只建空白会话），或下发到新后台会话（可选工作区、模型、思考强度与附加指令，支持多选批量），工单里的截图会转成真实图片附件，已完成的卡片可回读关联会话的最新回复，等你决策时能在面板里直接答复 agent，卡片实时显示 处理中/等你决策/已完成 状态并支持手动修正与「已结束」终态，完成后可跳转禅道的完成/解决页收尾。支持多账号；只读，不回写禅道。

description.en: Bilibili curation floating panel for DSH: learns your interests on a probability schedule and decays them by half-life, picks videos inside a token budget derived from a daily money cap, and mentions you only when a fit score passes a threshold. Comments are off by default; once enabled they run in draft-and-confirm or self-checked auto mode under a daily quota, with a hard no-comment rule for political, government and frontier-science topics, and comment text is scrubbed for account identifiers before it can be posted. It signs in through your own Bilibili account cookies; a separate posting account is recommended.
description.zh: B站策展浮窗：按概率学习你的兴趣并按半衰期淡忘，把每日金额上限换算成 token 额度后挑片，契合度达标才 @ 你。评论默认关闭；开启后按「草稿待确认」或「自检后自动发」模式运作，有日上限，政治 / 政府 / 前沿科学三类话题一律不评价，正文发出前会脱敏账号痕迹。通过你自己的 B 站账号 Cookie 登录，建议单独准备一个发言号。

plugins.name: qdd

description.en: Question-Driven Discovery research workflow for DeepSeek Harness with a QDD Agent Preset, durable Human and Auto runs, and an auditable research panel.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Question-Driven Discovery 科研工作流，提供 QDD Agent Preset、持久化 Human 和 Auto 运行，以及可审计的研究面板。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Multi-agent delivery workflow for dsh: a commander dispatches to fixed and temporary agents through a persisted task state machine, with a canvas and roster in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多 Agent 交付编排：总指挥派发 + 固定/临时员工 + 落盘任务状态机，右侧栏提供画布与名册面板。

description.en: Claude Science-style research workbench: ReAct research-loop engine (research_* tools), versioned artifacts with provenance (artifact_* tools), and 10 science skills for genomics/pathogens/bioinformatics.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 Claude Science 式科研工作台：ReAct 研究循环引擎（research_* 工具）、带溯源的版本化工件（artifact_* 工具）与面向基因组/病原体/生物信息的 10 个科研技能。

description.en: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness: a Settings page stores named Teams — a captain with its own prompt and tool allow-list, plus members carrying their own provider/model route, reasoning effort, prompt and tools — and a composer control applies one Team to the current Session, installing the captain prompt and registering the spawn_team_member, get_team_preset and update_team_preset tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可复用智能体团队预设：设置页保存具名团队——队长带自己的提示词与工具白名单，成员各自带 provider/模型路由、推理强度、提示词与工具——编辑器栏的团队控件把选中的团队应用到当前会话，安装队长提示词，并注册 spawn_team_member、get_team_preset、update_team_preset 三个工具。

description.en: Verification gate for DSH agents: every acceptance criterion must be backed by server-stamped real tool evidence before the completion gate lets a goal through (advisory audit, enforce gate, durable permits).
description.zh: DSH agent 完成验证闸门：每条验收标准必须有服务端标记的真实工具证据才能完成（advisory 审计 / enforce 拦截 / 持久 permit）。

description.en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.
description.zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。

description.en: Turns each DSH workspace into a project: every new session auto-injects a project-workspace convention (read code before acting, empty folder means a brand-new project); a per-session Project toggle in the composer downgrades the session to a plain workspace with an explicit notice, with the state kept in the session log.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区文件夹变成项目：新会话自动注入精简的「项目工作区约定」上下文（先读代码、空目录即新建项目）；输入框旁每会话「项目」开关可将会话显式降级为普通工作区（状态渲染式注入，关时有提示，不整块消失），状态存于会话日志。

description.en: Webpage watch agent: keep a watchlist of URLs, snapshot each page on every sweep, detect changes by bigram-Dice ratio and keywords, log important ones and push to a WeChat webhook; agent tools page_watch_add/list/check/history/remove. Renders JS anti-bot WAF pages via the optional lexmount extractor.
description.zh: 网页监控哨兵：把一批网页加入监视清单，每次巡检抓快照、用 bigram-Dice 变化率与关键词判断变化是否重要，重要变化写日志并推送企业微信 webhook；提供 page_watch_add/list/check/history/remove 工具，可选 lexmount 通道穿透 JS 反爬 WAF 页面。

description.en: WeChat Mini Program dev loop for DeepSeek-Harness: check IDE status, launch the DevTools project, trigger preview and get the QR code straight into the conversation, parse compile errors into file/line/column, and watch it all from a sidebar panel. Six agent tools over the official DevTools CLI — honest about needing a one-time scan-login, never fakes a preview. Requires the Windows WeChat DevTools CLI and a one-time QR login.
description.zh: 小程序开发闭环：查 IDE 状态、启动开发者工具并打开项目、触发预览把二维码直接贴进对话、把编译报错解析成文件/行/列，右栏面板常驻显示状态、二维码与错误清单。六个 agent 工具走官方 DevTools CLI，首次扫码登录的需求如实告知，绝不假装预览成功。需要 Windows 上的微信开发者工具 CLI，并完成一次扫码登录。

description.en: Lets Codex delegate tasks to Desktop sessions through a local authenticated bridge and companion MCP server, with Workspace grouping, model and reasoning effort selection, event tracking, waiting, and cancellation.
description.zh: 通过本机鉴权桥接与配套 MCP 服务，将 Codex 任务委托给 Desktop 会话，支持工作区分组、模型与推理等级选择、事件跟踪、等待和取消。

description.en: Parse PRDs and PDFs, ask clarifying questions in batches, consolidate a BRIEF.md system brief, and package deliverables for upload.
description.zh: 解析 PRD/PDF、分批追问澄清目标系统并沉淀 BRIEF.md，最终打包可上传交付物。

description.en: Kanban board for DSH: task state machine with git branch isolation, agent auto-execution, and review-driven merge.
description.zh: DSH 任务看板：任务状态机 + git 分支隔离，agent 自动执行、审核后自动合并回基础分支。

description.en: Acceptance-criteria-driven goal completion: locks verifiable criteria, tracks task dependencies, and gates completion behind formal reviewer validation (18 MCP tools).
description.zh: 验收标准驱动的目标完成：锁定可验证的验收标准、跟踪任务依赖，以 reviewer 正式验收作为完成门禁（18 个 MCP 工具）。

description.en: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
description.zh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

description.en: Appends ambiguity-handling rules to the dsh system prompt so the agent asks clarifying options before guessing.
description.zh: 向 dsh system prompt 追加歧义处理规则，让 agent 在猜测前先列出 A/B/C/D 选项请求澄清。

description.en: Keeps a DeepSeek Harness run going on its own: continues a turn that ended abnormally, and continues a turn logged as completed while the model tool call was emitted as plain text instead, which leaves the agent silently idle. Revives a model request that stops streaming. A wait on an approval or on a question is logged and notified, never answered.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的回合自己接上：轮次异常结束时补一条继续；工具调用被中转站当成正文吐出、回合却仍记为正常结束时，补一条带指向性的继续，让它重新发起工具调用；模型请求不再出流时掐掉当前轮重来。卡在审批或提问只记录并提醒，不代为回答。

description.en: Installs four multi-agent math-research presets for DSH: v2 (probability-driven pipeline with multi-verifier debate), v3 (paper-style Markdown knowledge base with a planner agent and a reusable method library), v4 (persistent self-organizing residents that message and meet), and v5 (a research institute with an academician who decomposes and assigns work, voting researchers, temp workers, group chat and a compare-and-set task board); all four support checkpoint resume, human intervention, and an optional Lean formal-verification switch (off/encourage/require) whose passing proof turns the vote into a fidelity check of the Lean statements.
description.zh: 为 DSH 安装四个多代理数学研究预设：v2（概率驱动流水线 + 多验证器辩论）、v3（论文式 Markdown 知识库 + 规划代理 + 可复用方法库）、v4（常驻自组织成员，靠留言与开会决定一切）、v5（研究所：院士拆解并分派任务、有表决权的研究员、临时工、群聊与 CAS 任务板）；四套均支持断点续跑、人工干预，以及可调档的 Lean 形式化验证（off/encourage/require，一旦跑通，表决转为对 Lean 陈述的忠实性核对）。

description.en: Visual multi-agent DAG workflows for DeepSeek Harness with live execution, restart recovery, and Feishu integration.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可视化多智能体 DAG 工作流，支持实时执行、重启恢复和飞书集成。

description.en: Embeds the active installed Codex Taskboard runtime in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, using its launcher runtime descriptor instead of a fixed port.
description.zh: 把当前已安装并运行中的 Codex Taskboard 嵌入 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏，并通过 Launcher 运行时描述文件连接，而不是使用固定端口。

description.en: An isolated translation pipeline where each module is its own model call carrying only its own prompt and its own input — no session history, no tool schemas, no other module's content. Build chains from draggable cards, edit any module's prompt in place, override the model per module, or start from one of two precision presets. The same chain is exposed to the agent as a translate_flow tool.
description.zh: 隔离式翻译链路：每个模块都是一次独立的模型调用，只携带自己的提示词和自己的输入——不带会话历史、不带工具定义、不带其他模块的内容。用可拖拽卡片编排链路，就地编辑任意模块的提示词，按模块覆盖模型，也可直接套用两套精译预设。同一条链路还以 translate_flow 工具的形式提供给智能体。

description.en: Adds a system-prompt rule that makes DSH agents look for existing work before they build.
description.zh: 给 DSH 代理加一条系统提示规则，让它动手前先找现成方案，而不是闭门造车。

description.en: Task board for DSH: create tasks with project and model assignment, run them manually or on cron schedules; new sessions in a project automatically pick up its todo tasks and move them to in-review when done.
description.zh: dsh 的任务看板：创建任务时可指定项目与模型，支持手动执行及定时执行；项目内新建会话会自动拉取该项目的待办任务，完成后移至待验收。

description.en: Visual node-based workflow canvas for DSH with sub-agent calls, code execution, branching, loops, scheduling, and workflow import/export.
description.zh: DSH 可视化节点工作流画布，支持子 Agent 调用、代码执行、条件分支、循环、定时任务及工作流导入导出。

description.en: Main-brain orchestration preset: delegation-first persona, root-session execution gate, and portable AI-LAW rule skill.
description.zh: 主脑编排 preset：委派优先的 persona、根会话执行门禁，以及可移植的 AI-LAW 规则技能。

description.en: Agent Teams for DeepSeek Harness: hand work to a team of agents that carries it end to end while you set the direction and hold the gates. Agents claim Tasks, hand work to each other, and have someone other than the builder verify it.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 团队：把工作交给一支 Agent 团队，它们把事做到底，你定方向、把关键的关。Agent 自己认领 Task、互相交接，由做的人以外的成员验收。

description.en: Progressive disclosure agent preset and call directory tool that starts from a minimal baseline and unlocks tools, skills, and MCP servers on demand.
description.zh: 渐进式展开 Agent 预设与调用目录工具，从极简模式起步，按需解锁挂载工具、技能与 MCP 服务。

description.en: Scheduled task dispatcher: a dsh host plugin that drives recurring agent tasks from a single task table, dispatching each run as an independent dsh session; scheduling is pure logic and uses zero model calls.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：一张任务表驱动周期性运行的 agent 任务，每次调度为一个独立的 dsh 会话；调度本身纯逻辑实现，不消耗任何模型调用。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks, including context injection: declare event, handler and outcome in YAML, where the handler is an in-harness tool (MCP included), a shell command or an HTTP endpoint, and the outcome is model-visible context, a denied tool call, or fire-and-forget.
description.zh: 以配置驱动的生命周期钩子，并支持上下文注入：在 YAML 中声明事件、处理器与结果——处理器可以是进程内工具（含 MCP）、shell 命令或 HTTP 端点，结果可以是模型可见的上下文、拒绝该次工具调用，或触发即忘。

description.en: Deep research as an agent mode: one reviewed loop that plans, researches in adaptive parallel rounds driven by the gaps the researchers themselves declare, synthesises a cited report and then reviews it adversarially, instead of a script the model rewrites per call. Questions the round budget never reached are named in the report rather than dropped.
description.zh: 把深度研究做成一种代理模式：一条经过审阅的固定循环——先规划，再按研究员自行声明的缺口进行自适应并行轮次，综合出带引用的报告，最后对其做对抗性审阅——而不是让模型每次现写脚本。轮次预算未能覆盖的问题会在报告中被逐一点名，而不是被悄悄丢弃。

description.en: Auto Mode for DSH: a flash-model router that auto-picks the best agent preset (standard/code/minimal/cordis) for each new session and executes immediately, no confirmation.
description.zh: DSH 自动模式：用 Flash 模型为每个新会话自动判断最合适的 Agent 预设（标准/PTC/极简/创造）并直接执行，无需确认。

description.en: Counts agent steps and, every N of them, adds a progress-report instruction to the batch that is about to be sent, so the agent states what it is doing, what it finished and what comes next, then carries on without stopping for you. Interval, prompt text and a main-agent-only default are editable in its settings page.
description.zh: 按 agent 步骤计数，每满 N 步就在即将发出的那一批消息里追加一条汇报指令，让 agent 说明正在做什么、已完成什么、接下来做什么，说完继续，不停下来等你确认。间隔、提示词原文、以及「只在主智能体汇报」的默认值都能在设置页里改。

description.en: ICVO coding-standards kit for DeepSeek Harness (formerly dsh-coding-kit): a bundle plugin that registers tools on load and injects the standards only when apply_coding_standards is called, plus a P0 gate CLI (npx spec-wave) with G1-G7 process commands, skills install, host apply, and IDE-block refresh.
