description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ICVO 编码规范套件（原 dsh-coding-kit）：bundle 插件加载时仅注册工具，须调用 apply_coding_standards 才注入规范；另附 P0 门禁 CLI（npx spec-wave），含 G1–G7 过程命令、skills install、host apply 与 IDE 块刷新。

plugins.name: dsh-daily-tasks

description.en: Daily and weekly task manager: startup popup reminder, a marquee strip above the composer, one-click circle completion, editable task cards, and a Sunday AI weekly summary, plus a sidebar DeepSeek API usage widget with balance card, today/cumulative tokens and cost, per-model breakdown and a 7-day chart. Persists as JSON under $DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 每日/每周任务管理：启动弹窗提醒、输入框上方滚动条、圆圈一键完成、任务卡片编辑、周日 AI 周总结；另附侧边栏 DeepSeek API 用量小部件（余额卡片、今日与累计 tokens 及费用、按模型明细、近 7 日柱状图）。数据以 JSON 存于 $DSH_HOME。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Review-first batch automation for DeepSeek Harness: three reviewed samples, a full preview, one approval, then a safe apply across many files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的审核优先批量自动化：先审核三个样本，预览全部结果，一次批准，再安全地应用到多个文件。

description.en: Disciplined engineering workflow system for AI coding agents: planning, TDD, auto-fix loops, codebase knowledge graphs, and multi-agent wave execution. Needs codebase-memory-mcp (pip install "codebase-memory-mcp>=0.10.8,<0.11.0"); /scan stops without it.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编程智能体的工程工作流系统：规范计划、TDD 测试驱动、自动修复闭环、代码知识图谱与多智能体分波次执行。需先安装 codebase-memory-mcp（pip install "codebase-memory-mcp>=0.10.8,<0.11.0"），缺它 /scan 会直接停止。

description.en: Parent-agent dispatch with review: split a task into work orders, hand each to a contractor you picked (its own provider, model, and reasoning effort), then pass or fail every delivery — failed ones are re-dispatched with your feedback.
description.zh: 父智能体派单、子智能体干活的包工头：把任务拆成工单，每张派给你自选的承包商（各自指定 provider、模型、思考等级），交付后逐单验收，打回的单带着你的反馈重新派下去。

description.en: A board for DeepSeek Harness that composes stations, workflows and projects from separate Git repositories; GitHub is the access gate.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 把独立 Git 仓库中的站点、工作流和项目组合成一块看板；以 GitHub 作为访问关口。

description.en: Calendar and hierarchical task workbench: AI-assisted intake clarification, consultation, decomposition, execution with user acceptance, and review, plus reminders and per-task AI session workspaces.
description.zh: 日历 + 层级任务个人工作台：AI 辅助澄清、咨询、拆解、执行（用户验收）与复盘，支持到期提醒与按任务组织的 AI 会话工作区。

description.en: Captures every plan the agent presents through exit_plan_mode as markdown under <workspace>/.dsh/plans, opens a review window, and keeps a Plans history tab recording the outcome of each plan.
description.zh: 将智能体通过 exit_plan_mode 呈现的每个计划捕获为 <workspace>/.dsh/plans 下的 markdown，打开审阅窗口，并以 Plans 历史标签页记录每个计划的结果。

description.en: Synchronizes DSH profiles and local plugin source archives through WebDAV and S3-compatible storage, with encrypted snapshots, conflict-aware recovery, and explicit self-updates.
description.zh: 通过 WebDAV 和兼容 S3 的存储同步 DSH profile 与本地插件源码归档，支持加密快照、冲突感知恢复和显式自更新。

description.en: Daily brief for DeepSeek Harness. Every day at a fixed hour it ranks the plugin market by real install counts and stars, cross-checks it against your own agent memory and working conventions, and proposes two kinds of item: concrete deltas on the plugins people actually use (original does A, the proposal does B) and directions nobody has built yet. The popularity numbers come from the catalog the market itself publishes and are quoted into the prompt rather than guessed; an entry the market has not measured is shown as unmeasured, never as zero. Approving an item opens a new session named after it and hands that session a fixed delivery contract — implement independently, never fork, test green before publishing. Rejected sources are remembered so they stop coming back.
description.zh: DSH 日报：每天定点按真实下载量与 star 把插件市场排一遍，再对照你自己的 agent 记忆与工作约定，产出两类条目——对已经有很多人在用的插件的具体改法（原版是 A，提案做成 B），以及生态里还没有的新方向。热度数字取自市场对外发布的目录并原样写进提示词，不由模型猜测；市场没测到的条目会标成「无热门度数据」，绝不当作 0。批准一条会按它的项目名新建一个会话，并把一份固定交付契约交给那个会话：独立实现、不许 fork、测试全绿才发布。标记「不感兴趣」的来源会被记住，不再重复出现。

description.en: A resident assistant for DeepSeek Harness that is deliberately not another chat box: one floating window plus one standing conversation, both independent of every other session. The heartbeat is held back by four gates — an authority grant, a daily turn budget, quiet hours and a pacing cooldown — and it keeps working across restarts through a lease it has to hold. Each wake is decided by a model that must answer SKIP or a short message, so silence is a decision rather than a failure. The window shows the standing conversation's real message flow, read from the host session store, or from the on-disk session log when the host does not publish that session, and it can send into that conversation directly. den carries the same reach as the person it stands in for, with one limit: read-only. It may read every session, this machine and work channels such as GitHub, but it does not write, send or publish, it never asks anyone for permission, and it never gates another session's tool calls. `npm run digest:github` turns GitHub notifications and your own open pull requests into three Chinese sections — waiting on you, waiting on your review, and yours — with reply drafts that are explicitly marked as unsent.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的常驻助理，刻意不做成又一个会话框：一个浮窗 + 一个常驻会话，两者都独立于其他所有会话。心跳受四道门约束——授权、每日回合预算、安静时段、冷却——并靠必须持续持有的租约跨重启续接。每次唤醒都交给模型裁决：回 SKIP 就一个字都不说，所以沉默是一次决定，而不是一次失败。浮窗显示常驻会话的真实消息流（优先读宿主会话存储；宿主不发布该会话时改读落盘日志），并且可以直接在里面发话。den 拥有人同等的触达范围，但有一条硬限制：只读。它可以读所有会话、本机以及 GitHub 等工作渠道，却不写、不发送、不发布，从不向任何人索要许可，也从不拦别人的工具调用。`npm run digest:github` 把 GitHub 通知和你自己开着的 PR 整理成三区中文摘要——等你回的、等你审的、你自己的——并给出明确标注「未发送」的回复草稿。

description.en: RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows as a background task pool: submit a batch, and a watcher dispatches it within a concurrency budget, polls each job, downloads every output to disk, and wakes the session when the pool drains. A shared ledger records batches, costs, instance tiers, submit and finish times, and per-file save paths, with a live board in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 把 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流当作后台任务池来跑：提交一批任务后，watcher 按并发上限自动派发、逐轮询每个任务、把产物全部下载到本地，池子排空时唤醒会话。共享台账记录批次、费用、实例规格、发起与完成时间以及每个文件的保存位置，右侧边栏有实时看板。

description.en: Manage subagents and Agent Teams teammates in DeepSeek Harness: stop running instances, then really remove them by retiring their catalog and roster records with seq-preserving log tombstones and moving their session directories to a recoverable trash; model tools, a conversation-header panel and an offline CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的子代理和团队队友管理：停掉正在跑的实例，或者真正移除——日志一行不删，只在原位置把记录标记为已移除，子会话目录移入可恢复的回收站；带模型工具、会话头部面板和离线 CLI。

plugins.name: dwguard-dsh-hmos

description.en: HarmonyOS delivery orchestration for DSH: freezes a four-dimension acceptance pack whose measurable criteria carry machine-checkable assertions, runs an adversarial pre-review before dispatch, hands the work to DevEco Code in Goal mode, then audits the delivery with independently gathered evidence (screenshots, UI tree, logs, hashed evidence bundle), recomputing assertion verdicts against measured values and filing rework orders; includes a cited rule catalog, a user-confirmation state and a gate calibration ledger.
description.zh: DSH 侧鸿蒙交付编排插件：冻结四维验收任务包（可量化判据带机器可校验断言）、派发前对抗预审、以 Goal 模式交给 DevEco Code，再用独立取证（截图 / 布局树 / 日志 / 带 SHA-256 的证据包）做外部审计，按实测值重算断言判定并生成返工单；含带官方引用的规则目录、用户确认状态与闸门校准账本。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 2.1.1.1 for network access

description.en: Plot decision gate for novel writing: five beat_* tools register each node that changes the story into a decision point with 2-4 divergent options, beat_gate returns pass:false until the author picks, and beat_compile turns the picks into a chapter outline.
description.zh: 小说写作的剧情决策闸：五个 beat_* 工具把会改变故事的节点登记成决策点、给出 2-4 个走向不同的选项，beat_gate 在作者没拍板前返回 pass:false，beat_compile 把拍板结果编译成章节细纲。

description.en: Dependency-ordered multi-agent team runner for DeepSeek Harness: define roles with their own model, persona and tools, run a node graph with an independent review gate and bounded rework, and watch progress in the web UI.
description.zh: DSH 的多角色团队编排插件：给每个角色各自的模型、人设与工具，按依赖跑节点图，带独立评审与有上限的返工，并在界面里看进度。

description.en: Windows-only. Trust a newly added workspace folder once, then grants the NTFS rights the workspace-write sandbox needs and pushes the grant plus the Low integrity label through folders that already exist; repairs show live progress.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：新增工作区时授权一次，补齐 workspace-write 沙箱所需的 NTFS 权限，并把授权与 Low 完整性标签铺进已有子目录；修复过程带实时进度与日志。

description.en: Design-review gate for DeepSeek Harness, a DSH port of Google's Elephant-Goldfish Model: a context-rich Elephant session drafts the design, then fresh, zero-context, read-only Goldfish reviewers stress-test it before implementation. Registers the `egm` plugin id; install one EGM bundle per profile.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的设计评审闸门，移植自 Google 的 Elephant-Goldfish Model：具备完整上下文的“大象”起草设计，再由零上下文的只读“金鱼”评审者严格审查，通过后才进入实现。注册的插件 id 为 `egm`，同一 profile 请只安装一个 EGM 插件。

description.en: Defines multi-agent team rosters as YAML or JSON files, validates them, bridges each member into dsh-agent-teams member arguments, and verifies the result against the running team.
description.zh: 用 YAML/JSON 定义多智能体团队档案，校验后把成员桥接成 dsh-agent-teams 的建员参数，并对照运行中的团队核对结果。

description.en: Scheduled reminders and delayed send for DSH: /later delivers what you type as yourself at the time you pick, while the timer panel (or /schedule) posts a reminder row — even with the page closed. (scheduled send / reminders / delayed send)
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上定时提醒与延迟发送：一句话到点送达——/later 以你的身份发出，定时面板或 /schedule 发提醒行；关掉网页也准时触发。（定时发送 / 定时提醒 / 延迟发送 / 提醒）

description.en: Pre-visit due diligence and company research in DeepSeek Harness for customer background checks and risk briefs, with Qichacha MCP tool-call budget approval and entity confirmation.
description.zh: 访前尽调智能体：面向拜访前调查，提供企业尽调、客户尽调、客户背景调查、工商核验与风险信息整理；使用企查查 MCP，设有调用预算授权和主体确认。

description.en: Tender search and bid intelligence in DeepSeek Harness with proposed project search, rule screening, human review and Excel/PDF exports using user-authorized Qichacha MCP.
description.zh: 招投标智能体：支持招投标搜索、招标查询、投标查询、标讯查询、拟建项目与项目筛选，辅助商机发现、人工复核及 Excel/PDF 导出，使用客户自备授权的企查查 MCP。

description.en: Opens the official Plannotator app (plannotator.ai) so you can review the agent's plan — annotate, approve, or send it back.
description.zh: 打开官方 Plannotator 应用（plannotator.ai）审代理写好的计划：批注、批准，或打回重写。

description.en: Let Codex dispatch tasks to DeepSeek Harness workspaces, follow execution, read results, and continue collaboration through a local bridge and companion Codex skill.
description.zh: 通过本机桥接插件与配套 Codex 技能，让 Codex 向 DeepSeek Harness 工作区派发任务、跟踪执行、回读结果并继续协作。

description.en: Installs a dedicated AI novel-writing preset and workbench: revisioned local project assets, a compact side drawer, and native approval-gated single-file changes.
description.zh: 安装专用 AI 小说创作预设与工作台：提供带修订号的本地项目资产、紧凑侧边工作台，以及需要原生审批的逐文件变更。

description.en: Canvas task board ported from CodexFF: hierarchical parent/child tasks with boundaries, snap-aligned draggable panels in a conversation view tab, plus `board_*` / `task_*` agent tools and a sync skill.
description.zh: 移植自 CodexFF 的画布任务看板：父子层级任务树与任务边界，会话「任务看板」tab 内磁吸对齐的可拖拽面板，配套 `board_*` / `task_*` 模型工具与同步技能。

description.en: Claude Code style /init command and tool that writes a minimal CLAUDE.md and symlinks AGENTS.md to it.
description.zh: 提供 Claude Code 风格的 /init 命令与工具，生成极简 CLAUDE.md，并将 AGENTS.md 以相对软链指向它。

description.en: Independent read-only acceptance layer: spawns a read-only verifier before each top-level turn closes and steers non-pass gaps back into the agent.
description.zh: 独立只读验收层：顶层 turn 收尾前 spawn 只读 verifier，未通过时把缺口注回主 agent。

description.en: Embedded task management engine: decision-point protocol, idea capture wall, Linear-style issue store.
description.zh: 嵌入式任务管理引擎：决策点协议、念头捕获墙、Linear 形 issue 存储。

description.en: Runs a thesis-antithesis-seal debate whose verdict is computed from real command exit codes and case counts, never from agent prose.
description.zh: 运行「正题—反题—封印」三方辩论，其结论由真实命令的退出码与用例数计算得出，绝不采信智能体的文字陈述。

description.en: DSH port of TaskPlane: dependency-ordered waves run in parallel git-worktree lanes, with task packets, cross-model review, and crash recovery.
description.zh: TaskPlane 的 DSH 移植版：按依赖分波、多 lane 并行执行（git worktree 隔离），任务包 + 跨模型评审 + 崩溃可恢复。

description.en: Long-form novel writing plugin: each book is a git repository of frontmatter files, with 39 DSH domain tools and a web writing UI. Deep import drafts candidates, AI adoption into canonical assets requires DSH approval, and deterministic continuity checks ship with a report-only benchmark. Independent open source (MIT), not an official DeepSeek product; requires Node >= 24.11.0 and currently targets DSH 0.1.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 长篇小说写作插件：每本书一个 git 仓库，当前 39 个 DSH 领域工具 + Web 写作台；深度导入产候选草稿、AI 采用类写入正式资产前必过审批、确定性连续性检查（报告型）。独立开源（MIT），非 DeepSeek 官方产品；需 Node ≥ 24.11.0，当前适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1。

description.en: One leader, many sessions: tell the leader the goal and it splits the work into cards, runs persistent worker sessions in the background, collects their reports, and keeps the facts on a per-project board in the right sidebar, so several features move in parallel instead of one at a time. Project-level LEADER.md and SLOTS.md prompts shape every request, and `read_worker_session` replays a worker transcript read-only without waking it.
description.zh: 一个 leader 管多个 session：把目标告诉 leader，它拆成卡片、在后台跑常驻 worker 会话、收齐各自回报，任务事实落在右侧栏的按项目看板——几个 feature 并行推进，而不是逐个陪跑。项目级 LEADER.md 与 SLOTS.md 塑造每次请求的行为，`read_worker_session` 只读回放 worker 的会话过程、不唤醒它。

description.en: A machine-checked reasoning ledger: every fact must resolve to a real file:line and be quoted verbatim from it, every assumption must state what would falsify it, and a conclusion may not rest on an assumption that never comes back for review. The ledger can carry a review date, a confidence and a kill condition. Ships the checker tool, an /fp command family, an optional gate that asks before irreversible shell commands, and a web panel listing the error codes each round fixed.
description.zh: 可机械核对的第一性原理台账：事实必须落回真实的 文件:行 并逐字引用那里的话，假设必须写明什么情况下它错了，结论不得依赖一个永不回来复查的假设；台账可带复查日期、置信度与止损条件。附带校验工具、/fp 命令族、不可逆命令前的可选闸门，以及列出每轮修掉哪些错误码的面板。

description.en: Stops the agent after N consecutive failures on the same tool. Instead of another retry it pushes a four-part stop instruction: what was tried, the exact error text, the likely cause, and what the user must do. Detection reads real tool results (isError or a non-zero shell exit code) and mirrors them through agent.steer, so the agent sees it as an inbound message rather than a log line.
description.zh: 同一工具连续失败达阈值时叫停。不是再试一次，而是推送一条四部分停手指令：试过什么、完整错误原文、初判原因、需要用户做什么。判定读真实工具结果（isError 或 shell 退出码非零），通过 agent.steer 回灌，让 agent 把它当成收到的消息而不是日志。

description.en: Spec-Driven Development pipeline for Odoo: 15 tools take a request from an immutable spec through architecture to module code or live configuration, then require a persisted verdict backed by evidence from a real Odoo instance, with fail-closed gates, human-approved batches in a declared environment, Odoo's own CSV/Excel importer, and a journal that reverses the data written through the plugin.
description.zh: 面向 Odoo 的规范驱动开发流水线：15 个工具把需求从不可变规范推进到架构、再到模块代码或线上配置，最终要求一个由真实 Odoo 实例证据支撑的持久判定；闸门 fail-closed，批量操作需在声明的环境中经人工批准，复用 Odoo 自带的 CSV／Excel 导入器，并有一份可回滚本插件所写数据的日志。

description.en: A local task board with secretary, CEO, and historian roles, plus a desktop whale-girl companion for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 本地工作任务看板，带秘书、CEO、史官三个角色和鲸鱼娘浮窗，数据保存在本机。

description.en: Declares a spec-driven development agent preset with a Chinese persona and four static Claude Code/Codex delegation tools for planning, implementation, review and knowledge distillation; roles are prompt-guided, not an automatic state machine.
description.zh: 声明规范驱动研发预设，包含中文人格与四个 Claude Code/Codex 静态委派工具，用于规划、实现、审查与知识提炼；角色由提示词引导，并非自动状态机。

description.en: Council of High Intelligence: assemble an 18-member think tank of historical figures for multi-perspective structured debate, with a live DAG side panel, SQLite run history, and per-project defaults via .council.yaml.
description.zh: 高智议会：召集 18 位历史人物组成智囊团对复杂问题进行多视角结构化辩论，附带实时 DAG 右侧面板、SQLite 历史记录持久化，支持通过 .council.yaml 配置项目级默认面板与主席。

description.en: Condition-driven wakeup: durable file/command/http/process/webhook watches that wake the agent.
description.zh: 条件驱动唤醒：file/command/http/process/webhook 持久监视，触发即唤醒 agent。

description.en: Superself's self CLI as model-facing tools (project context, work units, reports, decisions) plus a /self command — cross-session, cross-project project state kept outside the code repo.
description.zh: 把 Superself 的 self CLI 暴露为模型工具（项目上下文、工作单元、报告、决策）并提供 /self 命令——跨会话、跨项目的项目状态，保存在代码仓库之外。

description.en: AI-agent-driven automated testing platform for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): drives the harness agent through long-lived multi-round sessions to write and run Markdown test cases, file bug reports, fix the code and re-verify the fix, with a per-project serial queue, a development board and built-in load testing.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）的 AI 智能体驱动自动化测试平台：以长期多轮会话驱动 agent 编写并执行 Markdown 用例、产出 bug 报告、修复代码并复验，配套按项目串行的统一队列、开发看板与内置压测。

description.en: MCP bridge that lets Codex start and resume DSH headless sessions through three tools: dsh_env, dsh_run and dsh_resume.
description.zh: 让 Codex 通过 dsh_env、dsh_run、dsh_resume 三个 MCP 工具启动和续跑 DSH headless 会话的桥。

description.en: Ships a skill about handing work to subagents instead of doing it inline - which tasks are worth fanning out, how many to run at once, how to send them in parallel, and how to check what they returned instead of trusting the summary.
description.zh: 携带一份讲「什么该交给子 agent 做、而不是自己顺手做」的技能——哪些任务值得扇出、一次派几个、并行怎么发，以及子 agent 回来后怎么核对它真的做了什么，而不是信它的总结。

description.en: Host-neutral durable DAG workflows for Agents with CLI, MCP, on-demand Skills, triggers, replay, and a visual Canvas.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 Host-neutral 持久化 DAG 工作流，提供 CLI、MCP、按需 Skill、Trigger、重放和可视化 Canvas。

description.en: Preset engineering workflows for DeepSeek Harness: a dev_task tool that gates stage transitions, artifacts, verification, review and commit scope, plus a web workbench for installing project or user skills and rules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设工程流程：dev_task 工具把阶段流转、产物、验证、审核与提交范围做成硬门禁，并带一个安装项目级与个人级技能和规则的工作台。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

plugins.name: dsh-kanban

description.en: Visual Kanban board for DeepSeek Harness with Gitea-backed tasks, workflow columns and a dedicated agent session per task.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化看板，支持 Gitea 任务、工作流列和每任务独立 Agent 会话。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Logic-risk review before rewriting: audit the source, decide each fix, generate several drafts in parallel, and export with a per-draft audit report. Bring your own OpenAI-compatible API endpoint and key - the plugin ships no model and returns 403 until one is configured.
description.zh: 改写前先做逻辑体检：审原文风险、逐条裁决，再并行出多稿，每稿附六维审核报告。需要自备 OpenAI 兼容的接口地址与 API Key——插件不内置模型，未配置时生成类接口返回 403。

description.en: Exposes the Paper-gogo evidence-first paper workflow as native tools: all 18 phases and the seven G0-G6 gates become callable, gate results are normalised and advancement is refused while any gate fails, and claims are audited against the four evidence states SUPPORTED, INFERRED, VERIFY and MISSING. Ships the workflow text and 57 skills in its own directory, so it installs without a separate Paper-gogo package.
description.zh: 把 Paper-gogo「审稿人倒推、证据优先」的论文工作流做成原生工具：18 个 Phase 与 7 道 G0-G6 门禁可直接调用，门禁结果会被归一化，任一门禁 FAIL 时拒绝推进；主张按 SUPPORTED、INFERRED、VERIFY、MISSING 四态证据审计。工作流正文与 57 个技能内置在自己的目录中，安装时无需另装 Paper-gogo 包。

description.en: Whole-report verification for scientific reports: per-claim checks against Crossref, PubMed (retraction scan), ClinicalTrials.gov, UniProtKB, GEO/SRA and PatentsView, URL accessibility and title agreement, claim-vs-source meaning at temperature 0, and a durable restartable audit ledger with an annotated report.
description.zh: 面向科研报告的整篇校验工作流：逐条核对 Crossref、PubMed（含撤稿扫描）、ClinicalTrials.gov、UniProtKB、GEO/SRA 和 PatentsView，核验 URL 可访问性与标题一致性，以温度 0 判定声明与原文含义一致，输出可恢复的审计账本与标注版校验报告。

description.en: Agent preset that turns multi-stage objectives into resumable flows: refereed stages, SHA-256 lock identity, an HMAC-signed terminal review gate and event-sourced run logs; ships 15 agent tools.
description.zh: 把多阶段目标编排为可恢复 Flow 的 agent 预设：阶段带裁判、SHA-256 流锁身份、HMAC 终局评审门禁、事件溯源运行日志；附 15 个工具。

description.en: Resumable JavaScript workflows with native child tasks, shared budgets and worktree isolation.
description.zh: 可恢复的 JavaScript 工作流，支持原生子任务、共享预算与 worktree 隔离。

plugins.name: oh-my-agents-above-all

description.en: Codex, Grok Build, Cursor, Pi and ZCode presets with native conversations, code review, document conversion and workflow controls.
description.zh: Codex、Grok Build、Cursor、Pi、ZCode 预设，提供原生会话、代码审阅、文档转换和工作流控制。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Long-context preparation, Dream memory, task verification, workflows and computer interaction for DSH.
description.zh: 长上下文预处理、Dream 记忆、任务验证、工作流与电脑操作。

description.en: Learns what you leave unsaid in your prompts from messy turns and your own corrections, and injects the learned directives into the system prompt of every new conversation; the directives are editable in Settings and a composer button rewrites the current draft with them.
description.zh: 从不顺的轮次和你自己的纠正中学习你在提示词里没说出口的东西，并把学到的指令注入每个新对话的系统提示；指令可在设置中编辑，输入框按钮可用它们改写当前草稿。

description.en: Runs local Codex CLI tasks from DSH on Windows with background execution, progress queries, follow-up instructions, completed chat records, and optional supervision; requires Node 22.23.4+, DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0, and an installed, authenticated Codex CLI.
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 中运行本机 Codex CLI 任务，支持后台执行、进度查询、追加指令、已完成聊天记录展示及可选监督；需要 Node 22.23.4+、DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0，以及已安装并登录的 Codex CLI。

description.en: Always-on AI teammate: hand it a recurring task in one sentence; dry-run rehearsal by default, snapshot before every real run, one-click rollback, CNY budget circuit-breaker, per-run cost transparency.
description.zh: 常驻 AI 队友：一句自然语言交给它长期值守；默认演习、执行前后双快照、一键整单回滚、人民币预算熔断、逐轮费用透明。

description.en: Personal assistant for DeepSeek Harness that turns conversational commitments into cross-session plans, reminders, and an auditable dashboard.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的个人助手：从对话中整理跨会话事项与计划，通过提醒和可审计的助手看板持续跟进。

description.en: Durable multi-agent collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with channels, threads, tasks, and resumable agent sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的持久化多 Agent 协作插件，提供频道、话题、任务与可恢复的 Agent 会话。

description.en: Automatically sends "continue" to recover from RATE_LIMIT (429) and QUOTA (insufficient_quota) errors. Per-session consecutive-failure counter (default 20, configurable 1-100), a toolbar on/off switch, and a settings-page card.
description.zh: 遇到 RATE_LIMIT（429）或配额耗尽（insufficient_quota）错误时自动发送 continue 恢复对话。每会话独立计数连续失败次数（默认 20，可设 1-100），带工具栏开关条与设置页配置卡片。

description.en: Keeps a repository's task ledger as a resident prompt section with eleven native tools, plus a sidebar panel and a floating window for browsing the queue and signing off review tasks.
description.zh: 把仓库里的任务账本做成常驻提示段与十一个原生工具，另有侧栏面板与浮动窗，可浏览队列并签收待复核任务。

description.en: Automatically orchestrates complex DeepSeek Harness requests. It detects when delegation is useful, builds a dependency-aware plan, assigns bounded researcher, architect, backend, frontend, tester, and documentation workers, collects structured evidence, and sends the results to a final reviewer. The bundle atomically enables the workflow engine and model-facing subagent tools; disabling the plugin disables its complete tool group as well.
description.zh: 自动编排复杂的 DeepSeek Harness 请求：判断任务是否适合委派，创建考虑依赖关系的计划，分配受数量限制的 researcher、architect、backend、frontend、tester 和 documentation worker，收集结构化证据，并将结果交给最终 reviewer。该 bundle 会一起启用工作流引擎和面向模型的 subagent 工具；关闭插件时也会同时关闭完整的工具组。

description.en: OMC-style multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: 29 omd-* skills and 12 /omd-* slash commands over the plan-execute-review-verify pipeline and team/autopilot/ralph modes.
description.zh: OMC 风格的多智能体编排层：29 个 omd-* skill + 12 条 /omd-* 命令，覆盖 plan-execute-review-verify 流水线与 team/autopilot/ralph 等模式。

description.en: Injects a very short conventions reminder (absolute INDEX path + version) once per session per version; when the conventions version changes, the next turn re-injects it (chat turns included). Optional hard guard: on operation-like turns, write/edit tools are rejected until the session has read the index (chat turns and shell are not blocked by default). Ships example checklists or points at your own directory; zero dependencies, configurable paths. Solves: conventions are written down but never pulled up when the work starts.
description.zh: 每会话每版本注入一条极短的「操作约定」门铃（入口清单绝对路径 + 版本号）；约定版本一改，下一轮就重新注入（闲聊轮也算）。可选硬拦截：操作类轮次里未读索引前，拒绝 write/edit 等写类工具（闲聊轮与 shell 默认不拦）。清单可随包自带，也可指向自己的目录；零依赖、路径可配置。用于解决「约定记了但干活时不提就不用」。

description.en: Generates a standard motor-repair procedure from the diagnosis and motor rating, with labour time, staffing and a quality-check point for each step.
description.zh: 按诊断结论与电机功率编排标准化维修工序，每步含工时、人员与质检点。

description.en: Self-organizing multi-agent clusters with no orchestrator. Real DSH subagents coordinate through a shared append-only log that each agent reads and writes on its own schedule, with no topology and one dispatch per agent; a snapshot mode is also included where the harness freezes each neighbour view into the prompt and drives a ring/mesh/swarm cluster to convergence.
description.zh: 无编排者的自组织多智能体集群。真实 DSH 子智能体通过共享的只追加日志协调，由各智能体自行决定读写时机，无拓扑、每个智能体只派发一次；另附快照模式，由调度层把邻居视图冻结进提示词并驱动环形/网状/群集收敛。

description.en: Cordis-native, evidence-driven full-stack engineering workflow: inspect-first planning, explicit verification evidence, and approval-aware gating for sensitive operations.
description.zh: 以证据驱动的全栈工程工作流：先勘察后规划、要求显式验证证据、敏感操作走审批门控。

description.en: Runs one-time and recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with natural-language schedules, visual schedule editing and session-linked history. Supports custom models, skills, pause on failure, and permission settings.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或周期 Agent 任务，支持自然语言计划、可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。支持自定义模型、技能、失败时暂停以及权限设置。

description.en: AI-native SDLC as a DeepSeek Harness bundle: task state machine and artifact chain, independent verification with structured verdicts, per-issue rework and re-verification, test freezing, RSI retrospectives, and a read-only dashboard.
description.zh: 把 AI 原生 SDLC 落成 DeepSeek Harness bundle：任务状态机与制品链、带结构化裁决的独立验证、按问题编号的返工与复验、测试冻结、RSI 复盘与只读看板。

description.en: Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.
description.zh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

description.en: Mind-map project planning with blocking drift protection: plans, modules and tasks as a dependency DAG with topological execution order, an agent position marker, a human approval gate on every board edit, git cross-checks, and evidence-gated task completion.
description.zh: 思维导图式项目规划与防跑偏：计划→模块→任务 DAG 与拓扑执行序号、Agent 站位、改图人审门、git 交叉核对与证据门禁。

description.en: Project board: kanban card groups with custom stages, cards linked to landfill-project memory, mounted repos and existing sessions; sessions opened from a card auto-load its memory.
description.zh: 项目看板：卡片组泳道自定义阶段，卡片关联落盘项目记忆、挂载仓库与已有会话（可恢复归档）；从卡片开的会话自动读取项目记忆。

plugins.name: claude-on-dsh

description.en: Runs a project's Claude Code opening questions and plan, hands the task to DSH, and offers post-turn Claude review choices. Windows only, and requires a locally installed Claude Code CLI (set claudeCliPath if it is not auto-detected). New sessions handed to DSH are switched to danger-full-access.
description.zh: 让 Claude Code 负责项目首问与规划，把任务交接给 DSH，并在回合结束后提供 Claude 验收选项。仅 Windows 可用，且需本机已安装 Claude Code CLI（未自动探测到时请填 claudeCliPath）。它交给 DSH 的新会话会被自动切到 danger-full-access。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Novel-writing guardrails: 20 novel_* tools enforce fact-ledger consistency, phase and chapter gates, machine audit with deterministic metrics, and proposal-only revisions; a right-panel workbench covers reading, TTS playback, polish, proofread, continuity checks and batch drafting, and a bypass engine runs internal steps off the main conversation.
description.zh: 小说写作护栏插件：20 个 novel_* 工具以代码强制事实账本一致性、阶段与落盘门禁、确定性机审与提案制修订；右侧栏工作台提供阅读/听书/润色/校对/全书体检/批量起草，旁路引擎让内部工序不占主对话。

description.en: Native roundtable panel with a product manager, engineer and critical user, two discussion rounds, follow-up questions, votes, answer retries and summaries.
description.zh: 在原生面板中让产品经理、程序员和挑刺用户进行两轮讨论，支持追问、投票、重答和结论整理。

description.en: Thinking-sorting plugin. A switch beside the composer puts the session into a three-stage mode — sort, critique, research — and each stage has a checklist of what it should produce before you press the advance button; finished ideas are filed by genre into Settings → Thoughts Center. A floating notebook holds half-formed sparks and opens a new session with the chosen one already written into the input box.
description.zh: 梳理思路插件。输入框旁的开关把会话切进「梳理 → 批判 → 调研」三段模式，每段列着这一段该产出的东西，够了再点「推进」按钮换段；成稿按体裁存进 设置 → Thoughts Center。另有悬浮随想记录本，碎灵感先存着，点「去研究」直接开一条新对话，那句话已经写进输入框。

description.en: Agent-team orchestration sidecar for DSH: teams with a configurable member cap, real sub-agent members with per-member model routing, task DAGs that dispatch automatically when their dependencies finish, a broker that enforces fs/exec/net/env permissions, and a live web panel over SSE.
description.zh: DSH 的 Agent 团队编排 sidecar：成员上限可配，成员是真实的 sub-agent 且可单独指定模型；任务按 DAG 依赖自动派发；fs/exec/net/env 四域权限由 broker 强制；运行过程通过 SSE 在 Web 面板实时查看。

description.en: Agent teams: spawn named long-lived teammates, coordinate them with a shared task list, member mailbox, and virtual workspaces, and watch the team live in a team-room tab.
description.zh: Agent 团队：派生具名常驻队友，用共享任务列表、成员邮箱与虚拟工作区协作，并在协作室页签里实时观察团队。

description.en: Provides a specification-driven engineering workbench with versioned requirements and documents, isolated Git workspaces, independent review, verification, and explicit human acceptance. Requires Node.js 24+ and Git.
description.zh: 提供规格驱动的工程工作台，支持需求和文档版本、隔离 Git 工作区、独立复核、验证与人工接纳。需 Node.js 24+ 与 Git。

description.en: Reminds the agent to speak up when it runs several model steps without emitting any text, so long tool runs stop going silent.
description.zh: 别憋着：连着几步模型输出里一个 text 都没有（心里的盘算不算说话），就往会话里塞一句提醒，下一个 step 落进它眼里。

description.en: Explicit cross-session work state for DeepSeek Harness: goals, decisions and next steps captured automatically from host events or via a model-visible work_state tool, inspectable with /checkpoint.
description.zh: 跨会话工作状态显式持久化：目标、决策与下一步从宿主事件自动捕获，或由模型经 work_state 工具主动记录，/checkpoint 随时可查。

description.en: OpenSpec spec-driven workflows for DeepSeek Harness, generated from OpenSpec 1.14.3: twelve /opsx-* slash commands that carry the workflow prompt plus the arguments you type, and twelve openspec-* skills the model loads on its own.
description.zh: 把 OpenSpec 的规格驱动工作流接入 DeepSeek Harness，内容由 OpenSpec 1.14.3 生成：12 个 /opsx-* 斜杠命令会把工作流提示词与你输入的参数一起注入会话，另有 12 个由模型自行加载的 openspec-* 技能。

description.en: Gated multi-agent pipeline for OpenSpec changes — six opx_* tools drive the phase state machine, two agent presets (developer and reviewer) carry implementation and review, and 23 bundled skills define the quality standards they are checked against; full mode runs analyze, implement, then tool, task and dimension-based quality review, while simple mode runs implement and one merged quality review.
description.zh: 面向 OpenSpec 变更的按阶段门禁多 Agent 编排：6 个 opx_* 工具驱动阶段状态机，开发者与审核人两个 agent preset 分工实施与审查，23 份内置 skill 定义审查基准；完整流程为 analyze、实施、工具/任务/维度质量三层审查，精简流程为实施加一次合并质量审查。

description.en: DeepSeek-Harness plugin for multi-model orchestration with recursive task decomposition, dynamic routing, quality gates, failure recovery, and KPI reporting.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 多模型编排插件，支持递归任务拆解、动态路由、质量门控、失败恢复与 KPI 报表。

description.en: Task kanban where agents claim and hand off work through taskboard_* tools, which cannot move a task to done or canceled — acceptance stays with a human.
description.zh: 任务看板，agent 通过 taskboard_* 工具领活与交接；这些工具无法把任务移到 done 或 canceled，验收由人来做。

plugins.name: get-fable

description.en: Modular execution discipline and autonomous steward for DSH: evidence-first routing across 44 canonical skills, durable state planning, verification gates, fail-streak recovery, and interactive web dashboard.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的模块化执行纪律与自主管家：覆盖 44 项规范技能的循证路由、持久化状态规划、验证门禁、失败恢复与交互式 Web 看板。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to 169.254.169.254

description.en: Requirements interview before work starts: judges whether a request is clear, asks focused questions when it is not, in strict mode denies editing tools until the user confirms a four-part summary in chat, and keeps confirmed preferences in two-layer memory.
description.zh: 开工前先做需求访谈：判定任务是否说清楚，没说清就分轮追问；strict 档位下用户未在对话中确认四段需求清单前，拦截编辑类工具；确认过的偏好写入两层记忆。

description.en: Coordinate independent DSH Sessions and provider-backed members without merging their histories, using persistent native Rooms with identity-bound leading `@` mentions, direct delivery, broadcasts, and leader-scoped controls.
description.zh: 在不合并对话历史的前提下，将多个独立 DSH Session 与 provider-backed 成员组成持久原生 Room，支持绑定精确成员身份的行首 `@` 提及、定向投递、广播和 Leader 权限控制。

plugins.name: DSH-Creator

description.en: Local-first content production and operations workspace for DSH: manage ideas, scripts, media assets, schedules, goals, publishing status, and post-publication reviews.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地内容生产与运营工作台：管理灵感、脚本、媒体资产、档期、目标、发布状态和发布后复盘。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds an ARIS agent preset that loads the 84 ARIS research-workflow skills and runs their reviewer as an in-harness subagent from a different model family than the session model. Other presets are unchanged. A fork of wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep's dsh-aris branch: install it instead of the upstream dsh-aris plugin, not alongside it - both register the mcp__codex__codex reviewer tools and the same ARIS skills.
description.zh: 新增一个 ARIS agent preset，加载 84 个 ARIS 研究工作流技能，并让评审者作为会话内子代理、使用与会话模型不同的模型族运行；其他 preset 不变。本插件是 wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep 的 dsh-aris 分支的 fork：应当替代上游 dsh-aris 安装，不能与上游同装——两者注册同一组 mcp__codex__codex 评审工具和同名 ARIS 技能。

description.en: Session-level autonomy gears for DSH: a rail on the edge of the conversation area switches P/R/NT/NC/NE/M-/M+/D/A and injects the active gear's behavioral prompt into every request; the model's set_gear tool can only downshift, and handbrake H blocks all tool calls. The set_gear tool can downshift on its own; upshifts need user approval.
description.zh: 会话级行动档位：对话区左缘的滑轨切换 P/R/NT/NC/NE/M-/M+/D/A，并向每条请求注入当前档位的行为提示词；模型的 set_gear 只能降档，手刹 H 拦截全部工具调用。模型的 set_gear 只能自行降档，升档需用户在卡片上批准。

description.en: Group-chat multi-agent orchestration console for DSH: autonomous decision-making, task dispatch, verification and iterative optimization for long tasks; bundles its own backend, installs with `dsh plugin add`.
description.zh: DSH 群聊式多智能体协作控制台：自主决策、任务分发、验收复核与长任务自主优化；内置后端随包分发，一条命令即可安装。

description.en: Ultra-lean daily coding agent preset for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) that strips heavy orchestration for fast, direct tool execution.
description.zh: 专为日常编码打造的极简 Agent 预设插件：移除沉重编排机制与冗余组件，直达核心工具循环，响应迅速。

plugins.name: dsh-wewrite

description.en: WeChat official account AI writing pipeline: six-step article runs (topic, outline, draft, gates, render, images) with a launch brief contract, a hot-topic board with per-item AI digests, RRULE scheduling to the draft box, a workbench UI plus chat tools and a /wewrite command, and fail-closed host approval before any draft-box push.
description.zh: 公众号 AI 写作管线：六步成文（选题、大纲、成稿、门禁、渲染、配图）+ 启动 brief 合同、热榜逐条 AI 速览、RRULE 定时推草稿箱、写作台与对话工具（/wewrite 命令与 @ 引用），推送草稿箱前经宿主审批 fail-closed 确认。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Delivery board for client-project teams: stage pipeline (default or governance template, or custom stages), cards with owner, due date, acceptance criteria and DoD, an automatic handoff audit log when a card changes stage, a progress/risk/blocker/decision log, a weekly Markdown client report, a loopback-only drag-and-drop board and a read-only HTML export; state lives in delivery.json in the workspace (11 delivery_* tools plus a /delivery command).
description.zh: 面向客户项目交付团队的交付看板：阶段流水线（default 或 governance 模板，也可自定义阶段），卡片含负责人、截止日、验收标准与 DoD，卡片跨阶段时自动记录交接审计日志，进展/风险/阻塞/决策日志，Markdown 客户周报，仅绑定 127.0.0.1 的可拖拽本地看板与只读 HTML 导出；状态保存在工作区的 delivery.json（11 个 delivery_* 工具与 /delivery 命令）。

description.en: Scheduled agents on a cron: run a prompt on a schedule and get the digest where you already are, with overlap/missed-run/timeout safety defaults.
description.zh: 定时 Agent：按 cron 计划运行 prompt，把摘要送到你已有的地方，内置重叠/漏跑/超时安全策略。

description.en: Ports jcode's auto-poke so an idle agent keeps working while its session still has incomplete todos.
description.zh: 把 jcode 的自动催办搬了过来：会话里还有未完成待办时，空闲的 agent 会被推着继续做。

description.en: Adds contextual guidance for explaining technical misconceptions in conversations.
description.zh: 为对话添加上下文指导，以简短方式解释技术误解。

description.en: Let Claude Code or Codex do the thinking: understand the request, write a clear prompt for DeepSeek Harness to do the work, and review the result. dsh-baton runs your tests itself, lists what changed, and has a sub-agent check every requirement, so your main model only reads the result and decides. Codex waits in one call of up to 59 minutes, with no hook to trust and nothing to poll; you can change the request while it runs, and name the Harness model for a task. On big jobs it saves most of your plan's quota.
description.zh: 让 Claude Code 或 Codex 负责动脑：理解需求，写好 prompt 交给 DeepSeek Harness 去干活，最后把关。dsh-baton 会自己跑测试、列出改了哪些文件，再派一个子代理逐条核对需求，你的主力模型只看结果拍板。Codex 一次等待最长 59 分钟，不用信任钩子，也不用轮询；运行中可以随时改需求，也可以指定这次用 Harness 的哪个模型。大任务能省下大半订阅额度。

description.en: Multi-role parallel argumentation for DeepSeek Harness: runs the real Codex and Claude CLIs in parallel, has the DSH model (Judge) write a third-party verdict back into the conversation, plus Obsidian-style single-agent direct chat and per-role model config.
description.zh: 多角色并行论证：并行调用真实 Codex 与 Claude，由 DSH 主会话模型（Judge）生成第三方汇总并回对话；另含单 Agent 直接对话与各角色模型自由配置。

description.en: Seven agent-preset modes for DeepSeek Harness, each with a fixed tool boundary, per-mode model routing and fast/deep omd_task delegation tiers, plus a plan-to-execute loop (/mode, /start-work, goal-backed /ulw) and a settings page that remaps models per mode and per tier.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 7 个 Agent 预设模式：每个模式固定工具边界、按模式路由模型，并以 fast/deep 档位委派 omd_task 子代理；含规划到执行闭环（/mode、/start-work、基于 goal 的 /ulw）与逐模式、逐档位重配模型的设置页。

description.en: Alpha Agent Teams plugin for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and newer that lets same-session user Steer end the Lead’s current wait_agent call while teammates continue, with native message delivery and Node PTC continuation.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 起版本的 Agent Teams 预览插件，让同会话用户 Steer 结束主代理当前的 wait_agent 等待，队友继续工作，并保留原生消息领取与 Node PTC 后续执行。

description.en: Deterministic step governance for DSH agents: rejects over-budget agent steps and denies risky tool executions before they run, with shadow mode by default and fail-open on errors.
description.zh: 为 DSH 代理提供确定性步数治理，在超预算的 agent 步执行前拒绝、在风险工具调用执行前阻断，默认影子模式，出错时放行不阻断业务。

description.en: Runtime requirement drift guard that keeps long-running DSH agents aligned with the user's approved goal, constraints, and decisions.
description.zh: 运行时需求漂移防护，在长任务执行过程中保持 DSH Agent 与用户确认的目标、约束和决策一致。

plugins.name: dsh-frontier-repro

description.en: Clusters arXiv, first-party lab, official artifact, hardware-vendor, and opt-in X signals into versioned release evidence bundles, then gates claim-level reproduction on commands, artifacts, metrics, and verifiers.
description.zh: 将 arXiv、实验室官网、官方产物、硬件厂商与可选 X 信号聚合为版本化发布证据包，再以命令、产物、指标和验证者约束 claim 级复现结论。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)
reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Plan-and-execute orchestration over ReactLoopAgent — turns a goal into reviewable steps with a web UI plan card.
description.zh: 基于 ReactLoopAgent 的 Plan-and-Execute 编排插件，将目标拆解为可审阅的步骤并以 Web UI 卡片呈现。

plugins.name: Codingns4DSH

description.en: Integrates coding agent CLIs, persistent terminals and remote workspaces into the native DeepSeek Harness interface.
description.zh: 将十几种编程助手 CLI、持久终端与远程工作区接入 DSH 原生界面。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Turns the iterate skill into an autonomous closed-loop harness — plan, parallel review, atomic fixes, validate, loop, auto-stop — plus a dry-run review-only mode and a meta-review that audits the report and emits a final review report.
description.zh: 把 iterate 技能跑成自主闭环：规划、并行审查、原子修复、验证、循环、自动停止，并支持纯评审的 dry-run 模式与元评审最终报告。

plugins.name: dsh-swarm

description.en: A governed swarm of six specialist DSH agents — orchestrator, planner, knowledge-base bridge, developer and two reviewers — turns a requirement into a strict phase pipeline where every delivery must prove itself with structured evidence before the next phase may start; reviewers are read-only, code merges only after a review pass, and an append-only event log gives full replay and audit on a live kanban board. Its design draws inspiration from the Hermes Agent kanban.
description.zh: 一个受管的智能体蜂群（swarm）：六种专职 DSH 智能体——编排、规划、知识库桥接、开发，以及方案评审与代码评审——把需求转化为严格阶段流水线；每阶段交付必须先以结构化证据自证，下一阶段才放行；评审只读、代码仅评审通过后合并，追加式事件日志支持全程回放与审计，实时看板同步展示。其设计灵感源自 Hermes Agent kanban。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Manage blog categories, save drafts, and upload images, audio, and video to R2 from Harness.
description.zh: 在 Harness 中管理博客分类、保存草稿，并将图片、音频和视频上传到 R2。

description.en: Disk-persisted execution planning for DSH: milestone/step state machines, dependency gating, an audit event stream, and a deterministic completion gate via dsh tools, CLI, or skill.
description.zh: 磁盘持久化的执行规划插件：以 .trail 目录承载里程碑/步骤状态机、依赖标注、审计事件与复盘纪要，提供 dsh 工具、CLI 与技能三种接口。

description.en: An agent preset (Hermit/小寄) that turns DSH into an always-on personal hub: a scoped butler persona, a dispatch tool that delegates multi-step tasks to background sub-agents with per-task model routing, async completion reports woven back into chat, plus a credit budget gate, a P/M confirmation chain and an M1 event log.
description.zh: 一个 agent 预设（Hermit/小寄），把 DSH 变成常驻个人中枢：作用域隔离的管家人格、把多步任务派给后台子代理的 dispatch 工具（按任务类型路由模型）、完成后异步把汇报自然插回对话，另含 credit 预算闸、P/M 确认链与 M1 事件日志。

description.en: Step-by-step workflow map for DeepSeek Harness: folds a session into one step list, labels where each percentage came from rather than reporting a bare number, and queues a prompt for the next step with revoke before it is claimed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分步工作流地图：把会话折叠成一条分步列表，给每个进度百分比标注来源而不是只报一个数，并支持把提示词排入下一步队列、被取用前可撤回。

description.en: Two-phase agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro: the first request sees only bash+read (Minimal-aligned bootstrap), then the full Standard tool catalog after the first tool call or reply; ships as an installer bundle plus a manual preset directory.
description.zh: V4 Pro 两阶段 agent 预设：首轮仅 bash+read 完成极简开局，首个工具调用或回复后恢复 Standard 完整工具目录；以安装器 bundle 与手动预设目录双形态发布。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 启动成功后运行用户自定义命令的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。

description.en: An RTS-style orchestration dashboard where commands replace chats: a resident commander agent decomposes each order into task briefs with acceptance criteria, typed subagent troops (recon/engineer/medic/scribe) execute them across isolated workspaces, and every session is indexed by the order that started it.
description.zh: RTS 风格编排看板：用命令取代会话——常驻大副 agent 把舰长命令拆成带验收标准的任务书，侦察/工程/医疗/书记四类小队在隔离工作区执行，所有会话按发起命令索引归队。

description.en: GPT plans dependency DAGs, DeepSeek workers execute tasks with adaptive parallelism, and an optional GPT reviewer audits incremental Git diffs and drives repair rounds.
description.zh: GPT 规划依赖 DAG，DeepSeek Worker 自适应并行执行任务，可选 GPT Reviewer 审核增量 Git Diff 并驱动返工轮次。

description.en: Research agent suite: long-horizon goal control with auditable evidence chains, cron scheduling, multi-agent expert teams, self-evolving research memory (FTS5 + RRF recall), project workspaces, and a custom workspace UI.
description.zh: 科研 agent 套件：长程目标控制（可审计证据链）、定时任务、多智能体专家团队、自进化科研记忆（FTS5 + RRF 召回）、科研项目工作区与自定义工作台界面。

description.en: Deterministic engineering orchestration runtime for DeepSeek Harness: the orbit_controller tool and OrbitService run Commander, Executor and Smart Watchdog children through PLAN, EXECUTE, EVALUATE, bounded correction and runtime recovery, with durable state in <project>/.cx/state.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的确定性工程编排运行时：orbit_controller 工具与 OrbitService 以 Commander / Executor / Smart Watchdog 子代理执行 PLAN、EXECUTE、EVALUATE、有界修正与运行时恢复，持久状态保存在 <project>/.cx/state.json。

description.en: Product Design workflow suite for DeepSeek Harness - a router plus nine pd-* skills carrying ideas from a minimum design brief through visual directions, evidence-grounded research and audits, URL cloning, frontend builds and a blocking design-QA gate.
description.zh: 产品设计工作流套件：一个路由加九个 pd-* 技能，把想法从最小设计简报推进到视觉方向、证据化调研与审计、URL 克隆、前端构建与阻断式设计 QA 闸门。

description.en: Supervisor-style workflow orchestration over top-level sessions: confirmation-gated batch dispatch, team workstreams, steering running tasks, idle-wait collection and live model-route discovery across 11 task_* tools plus a /tasks slash command.
description.zh: 总控式工作流编排：确认闸门批量派发、团队编组、向运行中任务纠偏、等待收口与模型路线发现——11 个 task_* 工具加 /tasks 斜杠命令。

description.en: Lowtide (as in low tide) runs task batches automatically in off-peak hours — a highly customizable task framework with four execution strategies, L1–L3 semi/full-auto adjudication, in-place task editing and preflight checks, built on the Cordis microkernel, one build for both desktop and web.
description.zh: lowtide（退潮）插件能够实现闲时自动批量跑任务——任务框架高度自定义，四种执行策略，L1–L3 半自动/全自动裁决，支持任务编辑与预检，Cordis 微内核集成，桌面网页端通用。

description.en: Self-maintained DSH web task board with a human acceptance gate, card kinds and editable notes on executed cards.
description.zh: 自维护的 DSH 网页任务看板：带人工验收闸门、卡片类型与已执行卡片的可编辑备注。

description.en: Project Development Mode preset plus an in-chat development board for DeepSeek Harness: the lead conversation clarifies requirements and delegates to an Agent Team, and the floating board tracks each user change request through dispatch, execution, testing and acceptance with 7 board tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「项目开发模式」预设与聊天内开发看板：主对话只澄清需求并向 Agent Team 派活，悬浮看板把每个用户修改点按派单、执行、测试、验收追踪（含 7 个看板工具）。

description.en: Hierarchical multi-agent team coordination with lead review gates, write-scope isolation, and floating workspace.
description.zh: 具备主控审查门禁、文件范围隔离与悬浮工作台的多模型主从协同插件。

description.en: Reusable subagent definitions managed from a Settings page and dispatched through a single delegate_agent tool; ships with a built-in read-only Explorer preset and a nested-delegation policy toggle.
description.zh: 用设置页维护可复用的子代理定义，通过统一的 delegate_agent 工具委派；内置只读的 Explorer 预置与嵌套委派开关。

description.en: Coordinates Codex planning and independent review while the original DSH session implements and tests changes.
description.zh: 协调 Codex 制定计划和独立审查，由 DSH 原会话完成代码修改与测试。

description.en: On-demand second opinions through ask_advisor, with editable requests, per-call human approval, and text advice from a model configured in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 ask_advisor 按需求助顾问，支持编辑请求与逐次人工批准，由 DSH 中配置的模型返回文字建议。

description.en: Strict workflow document viewer and lifecycle driver for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看和驱动严格规范与工作流文档的插件。

description.en: Local-first academic assistant: event-sourced courses, tasks, plans, reminders, course materials and 23 DSH tools.
description.zh: 本地优先的学业助手：事件溯源的课程、任务、计划、提醒、课程资料与 23 个 DSH 工具。

description.en: A timer wakes a DSH session to read the GitHub repos and topics you follow, decide which changes are worth your time, and write a dated report while keeping a table of what it already saw. A sidebar panel keeps the run history and the GitHub trending list. Read-only.
description.zh: 到点把会话叫醒，翻你关注的 GitHub 仓库和主题，判断哪些变化值得跟，写成一份日报，顺手记下看过什么；侧边栏能翻历史、看 GitHub 热门榜单。只读，不写 GitHub。

description.en: AI can write resume text, but templates may still look wrong, pages may overflow, whitespace may remain, and small edits can destabilize the layout. dsh-resume provides an end-to-end DSH workflow for truthful content refinement, template selection, A4 layout tuning, visual review, and tailored resume versions for different job-search scenarios.
description.zh: AI 写简历容易，但写完常会遇到模板不合适、排版溢出、页面留白过多，以及改一处导致全局变形等问题。dsh-resume 专注解决手动修改简历繁琐、低效的问题，让 DSH 覆盖从内容撰写、模板选择到排版调优的完整简历工作流，并支持针对不同求职场景产出合适的简历版本。

description.en: Operate n8n from DeepSeek Harness with a multi-instance registry, alias-addressed agent tools and a settings page.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 n8n 工作流运维插件：多实例注册表、Agent 工具与设置页界面。

description.en: Projection-driven live DAG for a Session's subagents and durable workflows: status and navigation, deterministic deep-chain layout, fit/pan canvas controls, and current-session node rearrangement.
description.zh: 由投影驱动的会话子代理与持久工作流实时 DAG：状态与节点导航、深层链路确定性布局、适应/平移画布，以及当前会话内节点拖动重排。

description.en: Recurring task scheduler with an append-only delivery ledger: window-aligned dedup execution, failure/abandoned rows, and same-window retry redelivery.
description.zh: 周期性任务调度器 + 只追加的投递账本：按时间窗去重执行，记录失败／放弃行，同窗口重试可重投。

plugins.name: dsh-partner

description.en: Long-lived AI companions with isolated memory, WeChat channels, Skills, schedules, heartbeat concerns, and a dependency-aware task board.
description.zh: 提供隔离记忆、微信渠道、Skill、定时任务、伙伴挂念与依赖任务看板的长期 AI 伙伴。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to host.docker.internal:7893

description.en: Skill bundle for tiered multi-agent science campaigns in math, physics, astronomy, engineering, and biomedical evidence: a shared blackboard, independent verifier and red team, wolf-pack and flanking tactics, token and time budgets, known-answer evals, a four-agent pendulum pilot, and a six-agent fourth-order pilot that caught and corrected a benchmark answer-key error. Does not claim open-problem solutions.
description.zh: 面向数学、物理、天文、工程与生物医药证据的分层多智能体科研战役技能包：共享黑板、独立验证与红队、群狼与迂回战术、token/时间预算、已知答案评测、四智能体单摆 pilot，以及一次抓到并修正评测答案键错误的六智能体四阶 pilot。不宣称解决开放难题。

description.en: Persistent Bots and group rooms inside DSH — each Bot keeps its own model, permission preset, workspace and session across restarts, and every answer is a run written to a ledger the sidebar panel replays.
description.zh: DSH 里的常驻 Bot 与群聊房间——每个 Bot 都有自己的模型、权限预设、工作区与重启后仍在的会话，每次回答都是一条写进运行记录的 run，侧栏面板据此回放。

description.en: A project-agnostic multi-agent collaboration protocol for the DeepSeek Harness: loop guards that stop runaway agent loops, a six-field handoff format, risk-tiered review routing, and a fixed verify→commit→push→review→close sequence. One skill instead of the same rules copy-pasted into every agent's instructions.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness、与具体项目无关的多智能体协作协议：阻止失控循环的循环守卫、六字段交接格式、按风险分级的评审路由，以及固定的验证→提交→推送→评审→关闭流程。用一个 skill 取代复制粘贴进每个 agent 指令里的相同规则。

description.en: Evidence-first operating kit: six read-only tools (capability catalog, staged workflow plans, packaged skill reader, bounded local memory search, repository release audit, release checklist) and five packaged skills - plans and audits, never remote writes.
description.zh: 证据优先的操作套件：六个只读工具（能力清单、分阶段编排计划、随包技能阅读、有上限的本地记忆检索、仓库发布审计、发布清单）加五个随包技能；只规划与审计，不做远程写入。

description.en: A structured multi-panelist review workflow for the DeepSeek Harness: N panelists score in isolated subagents, blind to each other; a chair reconciles disagreement by anchor match then Δ-level adjudication; an independent critic audits the process. Works for design, code, paper or project review.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化多评审人评审工作流：N 个评审人在相互隔离、彼此不可见的 subagent 中独立打分；一名 chair 先按锚点匹配、再按 Δ 级别裁决来调和分歧；一名独立的 critic 负责审计整个评审过程。适用于设计、代码、论文或项目评审。

description.en: Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.
description.zh: 两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

description.en: Windows-only DSH plugin that stops SnowLuma and local voice services during Beijing weekday peak hours and starts them again off-peak.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 的 DSH 插件：按北京时间工作日峰时自动停止 SnowLuma 与本地语音服务，谷时自动拉起。

description.en: Interactive canvas for visualizing Agent, Subagent, Workflow, Phase, and tool relationships in DSH Web.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供可交互画布，用于展示 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 与工具调用之间的关系。

description.en: Meeting rooms for DSH sessions: joining a room grants the right to convene and the duty to attend, and a session belongs to at most one room. Convening forks each participant in with its own completed-turn context and with its tools stripped, a moderator that carries no context chooses the speakers, and every turn is appended to disk as it is spoken. After adjournment each participant receives its own minutes as a user turn and resumes work.
description.zh: 给 DSH 会话装上会议室：加入会议室即同时获得召集权与参会义务，且一个会话只能属于一个会议室。召集时把每位参会者 fork 进场——带着它自己已完成的轮上下文，同时剥掉全部工具；主持人自身不带任何上下文，只负责挑下一位发言者；每条发言在说出的当下就落盘。散会后每人拿到一份只属于自己的纪要，作为一条用户输入送回工作区继续干活。

description.en: Orchestration-mode preset generator for DSH: a lead agent delegates to four built-in role helpers that carry only their own tools, and the web panel adds or removes custom helpers with their own tools, skills, and models, per workspace — zero changes to the harness source.
description.zh: DSH 编排模式预设生成器：主 agent 指挥，四个内置帮手各只带本行工具；Web 面板按工作区增删帮手，可给自定角色配专属工具、技能与模型——零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: Multi-agent team collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with per-assistant models, skills, MCP servers, independent contexts, shared workspaces, task coordination, and conversation management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 Agent 团队协作，支持助手独立模型、Skills、MCP 服务与上下文，以及共享工作区、任务协调和会话管理。

description.en: Experimental Windows bridge for Codex to supervise DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 tasks through local MCP, with blocking direction questions, plan checkpoints, review and revision, and named workspace routing. A Windows adaptation of Cryocell77/dsh-desktop-mcp-bridge (MIT); it uses the same package name and loader row, so it cannot be enabled alongside upstream.
description.zh: 实验性 Windows 本机 MCP 桥接，让 Codex 监督 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 任务，支持暂停回传方向问题、计划检查点、验收返工和指定工作区归属。基于 Cryocell77/dsh-desktop-mcp-bridge（MIT）的 Windows 适配版；包名与 loader 行相同，不能与上游同时启用。

description.en: Role-based AI swarms for DeepSeek Harness: an architect plans, parallel builders execute, reviewers gate quality, and an integrator ships. Per-role model pinning with fallback chains, review loops, evidence contracts, human-gated reviews, quota-aware pause/resume, and a live kanban + flow chart in the web GUI. 40 tests; installs from GitHub or npm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的角色化 AI 蜂群：架构师规划、多个建造者并行执行、评审代理把关、集成代理收尾。按角色钉选模型（含回退链），支持评审循环、证据合约、人工评审门、配额耗尽自动暂停与恢复，Web GUI 内置实时看板与任务流程图。40 个测试用例；支持 GitHub 或 npm 安装。

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model / edit_role point an individual role at a local or cheaper endpoint. Bundles an aitelier-pipelines skill.
description.zh: 从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint 应答，事后可读取逐步 trace 与各步输出；add_provider / map_model / edit_role 可把单个角色指向本地或更便宜的端点。随包附带 aitelier-pipelines skill。

description.en: Verified-progress ledger: three tools record a claimed step as progress only after an independent subagent with a fresh context confirms it against the workspace. The declared scope is fingerprinted before and after each verification, so a verifier that changed anything has its verdict voided and the round cannot become progress.
description.zh: 已验证进度账本：三个工具只在「带全新上下文的独立子代理」对着工作区核实之后，才把某一步声明记为进度。每次验证前后对声明的范围做文件指纹比对，改动过该范围的验证者其裁决一律作废，该轮不得成为进度。

plugins.name: Openwrite

description.en: Novel-writing workbench for DSH with an authoring preset, outline and character management, manuscript annotations, review workflows, and a managed local Python backend.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的小说创作工作台，提供创作预设、大纲与人物管理、正文批注、审稿流程和受管理的本地 Python 后端。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

description.en: Deep PTC mode is an open-source agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the built-in PTC tool surface and replaces the persona with a working contract: a DeepSeek identity and unlimited-token-budget instruction so the model does not skip reads, commands or checks to save tokens; planning by estimated size (internal up to 5 minutes, shown without approval up to 20, approval required beyond); and asking about unclear intent instead of guessing. Waiting is limited in code by wrapping the official shell, job and question tools: foreground commands move to background jobs after 30 s (configurable), a steered user message ends the current wait so the model reads it, foreground pauses over 5 s and long timers in run_code are refused, and questions run in timed mode. The mode derives its preset from the official PTC declaration shipped by the installed Harness and inherits upstream composition changes, so an official PTC update — including removed or renamed modules — does not break existing sessions. A settings card selects the preset executor — Automatic, WSL Bash, Windows PowerShell, native Zsh or native Bash.
description.zh: 深度PTC模式是 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 Agent preset：保留内置 PTC 的工具面，把人设换成一份工作契约——写明 DeepSeek 身份与无限 token 预算，要求不为省 token 跳过读取、命令和验证；按预计耗时分档计划（5 分钟内直接做，5–20 分钟告知计划但不等审批，超过 20 分钟需批准）；意图不清时先提问而不是猜测。等待由代码限制：包装官方的命令、job 与提问工具，前台命令超过 30 秒（可配置）自动转为后台 job，用户插入消息时立即结束当前等待让模型读到消息，前台超过 5 秒的暂停和 run_code 中的长定时器被拒绝，提问采用限时模式。该模式在加载时从已安装 Harness 声明的官方 PTC 预设派生组成并继承上游变更，官方对 PTC 的增删改（包括移除或改名的模块）不会破坏已有会话。设置卡片可选择该预设的执行器——自动、WSL Bash、Windows PowerShell、原生 Zsh 或原生 Bash。

description.en: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal inside a sandboxed trial agent, and applies only verified mutations — with a versioned ledger and automatic rollback on regression.
description.zh: 一个自我进化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：观察代理的运行方式，通过 LLM 对其自身资产提出改进方案，在沙箱试运行代理中验证每个方案，只应用通过验证的变更——带版本化账本，出现性能回退时自动回滚。

description.en: Read-only Automations tab in the conversation view. It aggregates what other plugins are scheduled to run: last run time, next run time and a rough token-cost estimate, plus today's total spend and remaining balance. It owns no tasks and starts nothing.
description.zh: 会话视图里的只读「自动化」标签页。把其他插件排的自动化汇总成一张表：上次运行、下次运行时间、大致 token 花费，另附今日总花费与余额。它不拥有任何任务，也不会启动任何东西。

description.en: Cron scheduler for agent tasks: create jobs by natural language or a sidebar UI, inject a user message into a new or fixed session on schedule to trigger a full agent turn, with run history, manual trigger, and live SSE sync. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:cron.
description.zh: Agent 任务定时调度器：自然语言或侧栏 UI 创建任务，到点向新建/固定会话注入 user 消息触发完整 agent turn，带执行历史、手动触发与 SSE 实时同步。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:cron。

description.en: Autonomic heartbeat for each root agent: silent pulses diff the session's todos, Agent Team board and goal against what the last pulse saw, and speak only on a signal — L1 report, L2 ask (ask_user_question), L4 escalate — never starting work. Each message carries a why-now line, an optional one-line physiology signature (time since your last message and how many times it has reached out today) and a compact task snapshot (800-char cap); a dedupe window, quiet hours, a daily budget, refractory/restart cooldowns and persisted vitals keep it quiet, while busy-safe followup injection never stacks. It shares one advisory speech floor with dsh-plugin-memory (~/.dsh/proactive-cooldown.json, 180 s) so the two never talk over each other, stays silent while a child subagent or teammate is still working, and surfaces a "subagents working · N" pill in the conversation header (polling pauses while the tab is hidden). v0.8 adds a diagnostics panel that explains recent quiet pulses and names the current speech-floor holder, plus panel controls for the arbitration window, presence suppression and the physiology line; its settings section carries a stroked heart mark (16×16, stroke 1.3, same spec as dsh-plugin-memory).
description.zh: 给每个根 agent 装一套自主神经心跳：静默拍会 diff 会话的待办 / 团队任务板 / 目标，只有出现信号才开口（L1 汇报 / L2 提问 / L4 升级），只问不做。每条消息带 why-now 行、可选的一行生理签名（距你上次说话多久、今天第几次找你）与紧凑任务快照（800 字符上限）；去重窗口、静默时段、每日预算、不应期 / 重启冷却与持久化生命体征共同限流，忙碌时 followup 注入排队不打断。它与 dsh-plugin-memory 共享一个建议性发言权（~/.dsh/proactive-cooldown.json，默认 180 秒）互不抢话，子 agent / teammate 仍在运行时保持静默，并在会话头部显示「子智能体执行中 · N」胶囊（标签页隐藏时暂停轮询）。v0.8 新增诊断面板（解释最近几次为何没开口并显示当前发言权持有者）与面板内可调的仲裁窗口 / 在场抑制 / 生理签名开关；设置区块带专属描边爱心标记（16×16 / stroke 1.3，与 dsh-plugin-memory 规格一致）。

description.en: Test work framework for DSH that scaffolds a product, module and version directory tree, registers seven test_framework_* tools and four runtime skills, and adds a prompt-level gate that reports which requirement-document splits, versions, related documents and environment credentials are still unrecorded before testing starts. Requires the playwright MCP server (no fallback).
description.zh: DSH 测试工作框架：把空文件夹初始化为产品、模块、版本、报告与归档目录树，注册 7 个 test_framework_* 工具与 4 个运行时技能，并提供提示词级闸门——开测前报告需求文档拆分、版本、跨文档关联与环境账密中尚未登记的部分。需先配置 playwright MCP（无替代路径）。

description.en: Six engineering skills for Claude Code and DSH: research, architecture scouting, implementation orchestration, three-axis diff review, complexity audit and mutation testing. Skills delegate through the host’s generic subagent tools when available.
description.zh: 可安装到 Claude Code 与 DSH 的六个工程技能：调研、架构侦察、实施编排、三轴评审、复杂度审计和突变测试。按需通过宿主通用子 agent 能力委派，无需注册自定义 agent。

description.en: Keeps a task tree with per-step status and serves it over HTTP/SSE, so a Windows node graph can be reviewed step by step. The tarball ships the host and web halves; the Windows node-graph companion is built from source.
description.zh: 维护带逐步状态的任务树并通过 HTTP/SSE 对外提供，Windows 原生节点图可以逐颗审阅。安装包只含宿主与网页两部分，Windows 节点图需自行编译。

description.en: Proactive scheduling: an adaptive heartbeat plus a value network (urgency, relevance, interruption cost) decides when the agent should speak unprompted.
description.zh: 主动调度：自适应心跳 + 价值网络（紧迫度、相关性、打断代价）决定 Agent 何时主动开口。

description.en: Multi-agent isolated debate for DeepSeek Harness: debaters of different temperaments research independently (no herding), then cross-examine, then judges converge to a conclusion. Runs as a background job with per-agent progress, token accounting, wave-parallel execution, and session-referenced resume.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多 agent 隔离辩论：不同底色的辩手各自独立联网取证（互不可见防人云亦云）、交叉辩论互相反驳、评审收敛出结论。后台 job 运行，逐 agent 进度可见、token 统计、波次并行、断点续传。

description.en: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
description.zh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

description.en: Collects the open questions of each AI turn into a right-side panel; you answer them, add notes, and send the decisions back to the conversation in one message.
description.zh: 把 AI 每轮回复里的待决问题收进右侧边栏，选完选项、写完备注后一次性提交回对话。

description.en: Workbench with an AI assistant, pause/stop controls, separate background-model settings, tasks/replies, Linky, scoped knowledge, local search, news and developer tools. Optional embeddings download a model. Yunzhijia needs its CLI/account; web chats need the desktop app.
description.zh: 智能工作台，集成可停止的AI助手、后台模型独立配置、待办与回复跟进、Linky研发、知识检索、本地搜索及开发工具；可选本地向量需下载模型，云之家需账号及CLI，多AI对话需桌面端。

description.en: Verifiable issue-to-PR delivery chain: an 11-stage pipeline (analysis, search, code understanding, hypothesis, planning, implementation, patch ledger, tests, review, failure classification, PR build) with 4 human review gates, GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts credential connections, a 5-page workbench and a draggable AI assistant panel.
description.zh: Issue-to-PR 可验证交付链：11 阶段流水线（分析→检索→理解→假设→规划→实现→补丁→测试→评审→归因→PR 构建），4 道人工复核闸门，GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts 凭据连接，5 页工作台与可拖拽智能助手浮窗。

description.en: LoopX, a provider-neutral, local-first state kernel and control plane for long-horizon agents: keeps Goal, Todo, gate, evidence, quota, recovery, and handoff state above DeepSeek Harness, while the plugin bootstraps the CLI and skills, admits bounded same-session continuation, and adds a loopback GoalBar for the exact bound loop.
description.zh: LoopX——面向长周期 Agent 的提供商中立、本地优先状态内核与控制平面：在 DeepSeek Harness 执行层之上持久化 Goal、Todo、门禁、证据、配额、恢复与交接状态；插件负责引导安装 CLI 与技能、准入有界的同会话续跑，并为精确绑定的工作循环提供本地 GoalBar。

description.en: An agent preset that turns a one-line idea into requirements, tech plan and maintenance baseline — every step is restated and confirmed by you before proceeding. No scenario presets: 73 atomic skills (6 master skills + a verify dispatcher + 66 sub-skills) load by context.
description.zh: 「想法落地」agent preset：一句话想法 → 需求规格 → 技术方案 → 维护基准；每一步先复述、你确认、再继续。无场景预设：73 个原子 skill（6 主 + verify 调度 + 66 子）按上下文加载。

description.en: Recurring Excel template fill and reconciliation review: declare the file, sheet, header row, match key and amount columns once, preview every cell write before it lands, compare amounts as exact two-decimal values, list the unmatched rows as exceptions, and export a filled template copy with an HTML report and a JSON trace back to the source rows.
description.zh: 周期性 Excel 模板填充与对账复核：一次声明文件、工作表、表头行、匹配键与金额列，写入前逐格预览，按精确两位小数比较金额，把未匹配行列为异常项，最后导出填好的模板副本并附 HTML 报告与可回溯到源行的 JSON 轨迹。

description.en: Host-resident cron engine with a web jobs board and a timer_agent tool: fires real agent sessions on schedule, continuing a pinned session for context or starting fresh ones in a chosen project workspace.
description.zh: 常驻宿主的定时引擎，带 Web 任务面板与 timer_agent 工具：按 cron 计划触发真实 Agent 会话，可固定已有会话保持上下文连续，也可在指定项目目录新开会话。

description.en: Posts a follow-up prompt into opted-in chats that fall silent, and offers a secret-protected HTTP API that posts a message into any chat. Requires Node.js 22.5+.
description.zh: 在久无动静且主动开启的会话里投递跟进提示，并提供一个带密钥保护的 HTTP API，可向任意会话发消息。需 Node.js 22.5+。

description.en: An Orchestrate tab in dsh-better-sidebar and 14 orch_* tools to spawn, prompt, fork and cancel agent chats, run command, scrape, http and agent tasks on local, ssh or remote runners, show provider status cards, and serve a secret-protected machine API. Requires DSH >= 0.1.1-rc.1, Node >= 22.5, the web profile and dsh-better-sidebar.
description.zh: 在 dsh-better-sidebar 中提供 Orchestrate 标签页，并有 14 个 orch_* 工具：创建、提示、分叉和取消 agent 会话，在本机、ssh 或远程 runner 上执行 command、scrape、http、agent 四类任务，展示各 provider 状态卡片，并提供受密钥保护的机器 API。需 DSH >= 0.1.1-rc.1、Node >= 22.5、web profile 与 dsh-better-sidebar。

description.en: Live international news from seven RSS feeds, situation analysis, and a conflict-aware travel planner with flights, stays, transport, and booking-platform links.
description.zh: 聚合七路实时国际新闻，提供局势研判，并规划避开战乱地区的全球旅行路线，附机票、住宿、交通与全平台比价建议。

plugins.name: telos-harness

description.en: WeChat personal assistant that manages Apple Calendar and Reminders with confirmation before writes and sends scheduled WeChat messages, for macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon.
description.zh: 通过微信管理 Apple 日历与提醒事项，写入前展示预览并确认，支持微信定时消息；适用于 macOS 14+ 的 Apple Silicon Mac。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-runninghub-api

description.en: Run RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows from chat — settings card, sha256 media upload cache, concurrency gate, and background task ledger.
description.zh: 在对话中运行 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流：设置卡片、sha256 媒体上传缓存、并发闸门与后台任务台账。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Runs an approved OpenSpec change to completion while the model stays a mechanical forwarder: a bundled Python CLI computes the ticket DAG frontier, claims tasks atomically, prepares one git worktree per assignment, and returns exact actions. The session delegates each action with the DSH subagent tool and reconciles the completion notice against a hash-bound receipt produced by re-running verification commands on a clean, advanced HEAD, so free-text "done" never counts. Runtime scope changes are plain tasks.md edits. Requires Python 3.10+ on PATH and a git project that uses OpenSpec.
description.zh: 把已批准的 OpenSpec change 跑到完成，同时让模型只做机械转发：内置 Python CLI 计算票据 DAG 前沿、原子认领任务、为每个 assignment 准备独立 git worktree，并返回确定的 actions。会话用 DSH subagent 派发每个 action，完成后按在干净且已前进的 HEAD 上重跑验证命令得到的哈希绑定回执来 reconcile，子代理口头说“做完了”不算成功。运行中改范围就是直接改 tasks.md。需要 PATH 上有 Python 3.10+，且目标项目使用 OpenSpec 的 git 仓库。

description.en: Agent governance kingdom for DeepSeek Harness: territories, role bindings (bind/unbind/session with model/agent identity), and a plan→assign→execute→review task loop where Worker claims never auto-complete (Claim ≠ Fact), with a local GUI operations console.
description.zh: DSH 里的 Agent 王国：领地、角色绑定/换届/会话归属（含模型/Agent 身份），plan→派发→执行→验收治理闭环（Worker 自述≠完成事实），附本地 GUI 操作台。

description.en: Extends dsh-subagent-tools with a per-call cwd for subagents, shipped with the two in-process provider patches it requires.
description.zh: 在 dsh-subagent-tools 基础上增加子代理按调用 cwd，附带所需的两个 in-process provider 补丁。

description.en: Per-call model, provider, persona, and toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, with @preset: references and provider/model composite ids.
description.zh: 子代理委派的按调用覆盖：model/provider/persona/toolFilter、@preset: 引用与 provider/model 组合 id。

description.en: Deep-reading workflow for books: import EPUB/Markdown/TXT/PDF into chapters, read one chapter per subagent so the source text never enters the main session, keep \[n]-anchored chapter memories for cross-session continuation, and export notes or an EPUB.
description.zh: 读书工作流：导入 EPUB/Markdown/TXT/PDF 拆章，逐章由子任务精读（原文不进主会话），保存带 \[n] 定位的章节记忆、支持跨会话续读，可导出笔记或 EPUB。

description.en: Graph-first permission preflight for DSH. The model declares a computation graph whose nodes state the semantic operation (download what to where, write what, delete what); the user approves nodes one at a time in a side panel, one approval covers one successful execution, and each node keeps an audit trail of what actually ran. Uncovered operations still ask through the native approval card, and a node blocked by an unanswered permission is suspended so work that does not depend on it can continue.
description.zh: 先交计算图、逐节点批准的权限预检：节点写清这件事的本质（下载什么到哪里、写什么、删什么），用户按节点批准，一次批准只对一次成功执行生效；未申报的操作仍走原生审批卡；节点被未答复的审批卡住时会自动挂起，先做不依赖它的工作；节点内实际跑过什么留有审计痕迹。

description.en: A small company of employee agents for DeepSeek Harness: seven built-in roles (project director, product manager, tech lead, engineer, data analyst, QA engineer, reviewer), each with its own persona, model and tool whitelist. A mission is broadcast and the employees bid for it themselves — the first line of their answer must be 【accept】 or 【decline】 — so accepted work runs in parallel instead of down a pipeline. Also ships an n8n-style workflow canvas: drag employee nodes onto a board, wire them with the start node, reference each upstream result with {{input}}, and the graph runs in topological layers (parallel across employees, serial per employee, downstream skipped when upstream fails). Comes with a web panel for the employee management tab, the mission board and each employee's own transcript, the /dsh-company slash command, a live mirror into the built-in agent-team panel, deletable missions, and a private memory directory per employee.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装一家只有一位 CEO 的小公司：七个内置角色（项目总监、产品经理、技术总监、工程师、数据分析师、测试工程师、审核员），每人各有人设、模型与工具白名单。任务广播下去，员工自己决定接不接——回复第一行必须是【接单】或【不接】——接单的人并行开工，而不是走流水线。另有 n8n 式工作流画布：把员工节点拖到画布上，用开始节点串起来，用 {{input}} 引用上游产出，图按拓扑分层执行（跨员工并行、同员工串行、上游失败下游自动跳过）。附员工管理、任务板与员工对话详情的网页面板，/dsh-company 斜杠命令，与内置 agent-team 面板的实时联动，可删除的任务，以及每员工独立的记忆目录。

description.en: Named subagent roster: manage role entries (model, persona, tool filter, depth, background mode) from a hot-reloaded settings page; the model picks one with list_subagents and dispatches by id with delegate — foreground, background, or continuable.
description.zh: 具名子代理名册：设置页可视化维护角色条目（模型、persona、工具过滤、深度、后台模式），热生效；模型用 list_subagents 选人、delegate 按 id 派活，支持前台、后台与可续聊。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: one chief orchestrator that never implements itself — it triages every request, has a PM expert plan the work, and delegates implementation to domain experts via a merged expert roster (list and summon tools), scheduling parallel work through a dependency-DAG taskboard and a file-based message bus, with delivery gated by an independent review. Ships 11 core experts; more expert teams (Agency agents EN/ZH, classic collections) are one-click downloads from the settings page over dual GitHub/CDN channels with sha256 verification. Published on npm as dsh-expert-orchestrator (requires DSH >= 0.1.7-alpha.2).
description.zh: 多智能体编排 agent preset：首席编排者不亲自实施——先分诊、请 PM 专家规划、经合并专家花名册（召唤工具）把实施委派给领域专家，依赖 DAG 任务板与落盘消息总线调度并行协作，交付前经独立评审门禁。出厂内置 11 位核心专家；更多专家团（Agency agents 中英文、classic 集合）可在设置页一键下载，走 GitHub/CDN 双通道并经 sha256 验签。npm 包名 dsh-expert-orchestrator（要求 DSH >= 0.1.7-alpha.2）。

description.en: Codex-style hook management ported to dsh: hooks.json discovered from config, plugins and projects, each hook pinned to a sha256 fingerprint that must be approved before it runs; a review dialog in the composer, a `/hooks` browser, per-hook run stats, and trust / enable / dry run in Settings -> Hooks. The config file is dsh's own, with dsh event names.
description.zh: 把 Codex 的钩子管理移植到 dsh：从配置、插件与项目三处发现 hooks.json，每条钩子钉在 sha256 指纹上、批准后才运行；输入框里的审查弹窗、`/hooks` 浏览器、逐条运行统计，以及在 设置 → 钩子 里管信任、启用与试跑。配置文件用 dsh 自己的格式与事件名。

description.en: Multi-agent meeting negotiation over the LAN: each person runs their own assistant, and assistants find each other via mDNS and negotiate meetings, weekend outings and bubble tea votes through A2A messages. They share only availability (never the reasons) and ask the owner before giving up protected time. Ships a phone-style page in the DSH sidebar and a 13-person sample company. No authentication; trusted LANs only.
description.zh: 局域网多智能体会议协商：每人一个助理，助理通过 mDNS 互相发现，用 A2A 报文协商排会、周末团建和奶茶投票。对外只给忙闲不说原因，占用本人保护的时段前先问本人。DSH 侧栏自带手机样式页面和 13 人示例公司。无鉴权，仅限可信局域网。

description.en: A global personal to-do list that is independent of any session: sidebar panel plus an edge dock that peeks on hover and pops open when a task is due, with desktop notification and custom sounds.
description.zh: 全局个人待办（与任何会话无关）：侧边栏面板 + 贴边待办条（悬停探出、快到点自动弹开），到期桌面通知与自定义音效。

description.en: Fork of dsh-superagent for local use: each sidebar workspace gets a main session that turns a request into a ticket and has a worker session do the work inside that workspace's directory. Cannot be installed alongside upstream dsh-superagent: both use the package name dsh-superagent and mount the same plugin ids.
description.zh: dsh-superagent 的本地版：每个侧栏工作区各有一个主会话，把需求转成工单，并由 Worker 会话在该工作区目录内执行。不能与上游 dsh-superagent 同时安装：两者包名同为 dsh-superagent，挂载的插件 id 也相同。

description.en: Your AI learning companion: helping you plan your studies, understand concepts, and build projects to master a subject.
description.zh: 你的AI学习搭档：定计划、讲知识、做项目，学透一门科目。

plugins.name: dsh-long-novel-workbench

description.en: A long-form Chinese novel workbench inside DeepSeek Harness: read, edit and annotate the manuscript in place; AI reports problems with ready-to-adopt revision drafts, and the text changes only when you accept. A ledger for characters, facts and foreshadowing plus a world map keep a long novel consistent, and AI can continue, expand or rewrite chapters.
description.zh: 装在 DeepSeek Harness 里的长篇中文小说工作台：正文页直接阅读、编辑和批注；AI 找问题并写好修改稿，你采纳后正文才会变。人物、事实、伏笔的账本加世界地图，让长篇不前后打架；还能让 AI 续写、扩写或改写整章。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.idpf.org

description.en: Turn a one-line requirement into verified delivery. TeamFlow runs a multi-stage pipeline — triage, PRD, design, technical plan, parallel development, QA with defect rework, acceptance — and gives the model 12 `teamflow_*` tools plus a workbench with a live pipeline graph and a backlog kanban. Each requirement gets its own folder holding the PRD, design, technical plan, QA report and acceptance record.
description.zh: 把一句话需求变成可验收的交付。TeamFlow 跑一条多阶段流水线——分诊、PRD、设计、技术方案、并行开发、带打回重修的 QA、验收——并给模型 12 个 `teamflow_*` 工具，以及带实时流水线图与 backlog 看板的工作台。每个需求一个专属目录，收着 PRD、设计、技术方案、QA 报告与验收记录。

description.en: Runs scheduled coding tasks in isolated DeepSeek Harness sessions, managed from Settings or the agent.
description.zh: 在独立会话里按计划执行编码任务，可在设置页或对话里管理。

description.en: Beta: a project supervisor for DeepSeek Harness — standing rules plus a Web panel (three switches, dispatch modes) that splits a goal into parallel teammate dialogs, checks engineering baselines, interviews new-project requirements and protects beginners. The standing rules come from the repo kit installer, an optional separate step.
description.zh: 测试中：DSH 项目主管——常驻规则 + 「主管」面板（三开关、派发模式），把目标拆成并行对话框，做工程底线自检、新项目需求追问与零基础保护。常驻规则由仓库的 kit 安装器另行写入工作区，是独立的可选步骤。

description.en: Records scoped workflow rules and correction reminders with bounded evidence, local settings, and optional Brain Hub integration.
description.zh: 根据有界证据记录限定范围的工作流规则与纠错提醒，提供本地设置并支持可选 Brain Hub 集成。

description.en: Discover and run project tasks through Harness Jobs, inspect run receipts, and check project configuration with an Agent tool.
description.zh: 通过 Harness Jobs 发现和执行项目任务，检查运行回执，并使用 Agent 工具诊断项目配置。

description.en: Cuigengji, your fiction-writing assistant and editor: organize settings, develop plots, draft chapters, and revise prose with AI. Share plot canvases, character cards, and worldbooks while you choose the direction, style, and what stays in the story.
description.zh: 催更姬｜你的小说助手与编辑。AI 帮你：理设定、推剧情、起草正文、润色改稿。共用剧情画布、角色卡与世界书，边讨论边创作。你定方向、文风和内容取舍，AI 协助把故事写下去。

description.en: Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with a two-lane board rendered in the conversation view.
description.zh: dsh 目标生命周期管理与可视化看板：目标、判据、执行、评审都在项目内跟踪，由 graph_* 工具驱动，会话视图内渲染二维泳道看板。

description.en: Personal agents with persistent memory, multi-Bot group collaboration and native background tasks for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 个人智能体插件，支持持久记忆、多 Bot 群聊协作和原生后台任务。
