description.en: Dispatch self-contained tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, TraeCode, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, Kimi, Qwen, Copilot, WorkBuddy, Grok): a host-only bundle registering the conductor_dispatch tool plus an auto-triggered conductor skill.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里派活给 11 种外部 agent CLI（Codex、Claude Code、TraeCode、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor、Kimi、Qwen、Copilot、WorkBuddy、Grok）：host-only bundle 注册 conductor_dispatch 工具，附自动触发的指挥家技能。

description.en: Owner-facing AI studio for DeepSeek Harness: project roles, task acceptance, worktree-based agent runs, host verification, independent review, decision records, and human-triggered merges.
description.zh: 面向项目所有者的 DeepSeek Harness AI 工作室：角色、任务验收、worktree 代理执行、Host 验证、独立评审、决策记录和人工触发合并。

plugins.name: dsh-teams-x

description.en: Orchestrates durable multi-agent teams from one DSH session: a captain spawns member subagents, drives a dependency-aware task DAG with quality gates, and coordinates through persistent mailboxes, with a live activity panel.
description.zh: 把单个 DSH 会话编排成持久化多智能体团队：captain 生成成员子代理、驱动带质量门的依赖感知任务 DAG、通过持久邮箱协调，附带实时活动面板。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

plugins.name: dsh-dual-host-plugin

description.en: Dual-host coordination for DeepSeek Harness (大肥鱼 bot): hand a task off in local chat, run bounded jobs in a cloud worker, then review results and approve follow-up steps in one workbench. Includes protected six-page onboarding, per-task model selection, a task approval ledger and stepwise controlled delivery.
description.zh: DSH 双端协作（大肥鱼 bot）：在本地对话中自然语言交办，云端独立 worker 执行有界任务，在工作台查看成果并逐步审批后续动作。含六页保护性配置导览、按任务选模型、审批账本与受控交付。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Runs shell scripts on cron or interval schedules inside the host with no model call, logging every run and waking the model only when a script's output changes.
description.zh: 在宿主内按 cron 或固定间隔运行 shell 脚本，不调用模型，按次记录日志，只在脚本输出变化时唤醒模型。

description.en: Registers a SpecWorkflow skill pack for requirement clarification, implementation specs, execution, delivery review, repair planning, bug diagnosis, and source-backed research.
description.zh: 注册 SpecWorkflow 技能包，覆盖需求澄清、实施规格、代码执行、交付检查、修复规划、bug 诊断和带来源调研。

plugins.name: dsh-github-trending

description.en: Schedules a daily, weekly or monthly GitHub Trending digest, has a local trendradar core write Chinese summaries and period recaps, commits them to your own repo and opens the pull request, and shows an overview, digest, run history, subscription and settings workbench.
description.zh: 按日 / 周 / 月周期定时生成 GitHub 趋势日报，由本地 trendradar 核心写中文简介与周期总结、提交到你自己的仓库并开 PR，内置概览 / 榜单 / 运行记录 / 订阅 / 设置工作台。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Dispatch subagents with named profiles (model, reasoning effort, and tool scope per task), safety checks, cost estimation with savings comparison, and a full dispatch decision ledger.
description.zh: 子 Agent 派发插件：按任务选模型、推理强度与工具范围，存成命名方案随时复用；内置安全检查、成本估算与节省分析、完整派发决策台账。

description.en: Cron job board: schedules local scripts or dsh session tasks (fresh or pinned sessions) by cron expression, with centralized environment-variable management, run logs, and concurrency and timeout control.
description.zh: 定时任务看板：cron 调度本地脚本或 dsh 会话任务（每次新建/固定会话），环境变量集中管理，执行日志与并发/超时控制。

description.en: AgentTeams multi-agent teams.
description.zh: AgentTeams 多智能体团队。

description.en: QA project workbench for dsh: manage test projects, requirements, test cases, defects, milestones, reports and approval gates through a browser UI and 18 QA-domain tools.
description.zh: dsh 质量项目工作台：通过浏览器界面和 18 个 QA 领域工具管理测试项目、需求、用例、缺陷、里程碑、报告与审批门禁。

description.en: Sidebar todo list for DeepSeek Harness — grouped buckets, recurring tasks with weekday or month-day rules, a month-view calendar, and an agent tool that reads and writes the same JSON file.
description.zh: 侧栏待办清单——逾期/今天/本周分组、循环任务（每周多选周几、每月指定几号）、月视图日历，agent 通过工具读写同一份 JSON。

description.en: Project control plane with durable tickets, replaceable DSH sessions, a project matrix, and bidirectional UI navigation.
description.zh: 项目控制台，支持持久化任务、可替换的执行会话、项目卡片矩阵和 DSH 双向切换。

description.en: Multi-agent roundtable discussion: each member runs as a subagent on its own model and speaks in turn, a host summarizes each round, and termination writes meeting-minutes Markdown.
description.zh: 多智能体圆桌讨论：每个成员作为子代理在自己的模型上依次发言，主持人逐轮汇总，终止时生成会议纪要 Markdown。

description.en: Expose a running DeepSeek Harness instance over MCP, so an external agent can list, create and continue that instance's own sessions, delegate a turn and collect its result, answer the questions the DSH agent asks, and set how future approval requests resolve.
description.zh: 把正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 实例通过 MCP 暴露出来：外部 agent 可以列出、新建并继续该实例自己的会话，委派一轮并取回结果，回答 DSH agent 提出的问题，并决定后续审批请求如何裁决。

description.en: Cross-workspace worker fleets: one orchestrating session spawns named worker sessions in other project workspaces, queues or steers tasks into them, watches them in the background via a real host job, and collects their reports. Worker completions deliver themselves to the orchestrator's session rather than needing to be polled, so an idle orchestrator still reacts. Escalations and failed workers deliver by steer when the orchestrator is mid-turn and by queue when it is idle; a turn that ends without a report counts as a failure and the worker is replaced after a configurable limit. The roster persists to disk and each worker session carries a durable title, so a restart neither loses the fleet nor spawns duplicate sessions. Ships five agent presets at full plugin parity with the standard preset.
description.zh: 跨工作区的多智能体工舰队：一个编排会话在其他项目工作区中创建具名的 worker 会话，向其排队或插队下发任务，以后台任务的方式监视其进度，并收集其报告。worker 完成后主动把消息投递到编排会话，无需轮询，空闲的编排器同样能及时反应。当编排器正在执行任务时，升级提问与失败通知以 steer 方式送达，空闲时以 queue 方式送达；一个回合结束时若未提交报告即判定为失败，达到阈值后自动替换该 worker。名册持久化到磁盘，且每个 worker 会话带有持久标题，重启既不会丢失工舰队，也不会产生重复会话。附带五个智能体预设，插件清单与 standard 预设完全一致。

description.en: Inject a personal rules file into the DeepSeek Harness system prompt, with silent-step and repeated-action loop guards editable from the settings dialog.
description.zh: 把个性化规则文件注入 DeepSeek Harness 系统提示，并提供静默提醒与重复操作循环检测，可在设置弹窗中编辑。

description.en: Match your models and token budgets to each role, then let DSH delegate specialized subagents by task type. Covers architecture analysis, UI/UX, code implementation, codebase exploration, and documentation research, with automatic setup plus per-role reasoning effort and tool permissions.
description.zh: 合理搭配你的模型及 Token 额度，让 DSH 按任务类型自动委派专业子代理，覆盖架构分析、UI/UX、代码实现、代码库探索与文档调研。安装后自动配置，并支持按角色设置思考强度和工具权限。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-relay

description.en: Loopback-first multi-agent message relay: HMAC-authenticated broker plus dsh plugin (relay_send/recv/peers/history), zero-dependency CLI and Python clients, wire protocol v1.0.
description.zh: 本地优先的多 Agent 协作中继：HMAC 认证 broker + dsh 插件（relay_send/recv/peers/history）+ 零依赖 CLI 与 Python 客户端，wire protocol v1.0。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: External Agent control plane for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, and Antigravity adapters with settings and background job visibility.
description.zh: 外部 Agent 控制面，接入 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor Agent 与 Antigravity，并提供设置和后台任务可见性。

description.en: Runs Claude Code as a DSH conversation while preserving its native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 作为 DSH 会话运行，同时保留其原生智能体循环、工具、技能、钩子和 MCP 集成。

description.en: Role-based expert subagents for DeepSeek Harness with a task sidebar: explorer, librarian, oracle, designer and fixer delegate in parallel, each with its own model and reasoning depth.
description.zh: 基于角色的专家子代理并行协作，各角色可配置模型与思考深度，并提供 Expert Group 任务侧栏。

description.en: Drives the GME Test Agent from inside Harness: three tools list interface catalogs, start and repair autonomous test generation in a local Python backend, poll the task until review, and keep PR, skip and cleanup actions behind explicit user consent.
description.zh: 在 Harness 内驱动 GME Test Agent：三个工具负责列出接口目录、在本地 Python 后端启动并修复自主测试生成、轮询任务直到待评审，并把创建 PR、跳过与清理等动作挡在用户显式同意之后。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-events: session-protocol events — auto session-start reminder + auto-save on session close; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-events：会话协议事件插件——新会话入口提醒 + 会话关闭自动 save；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools 配套使用。

description.en: Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools: 15 schema-validated tools (memory + quality gates) plus an L0 guard of the consulting document-generation engine; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-events for the full session protocol.
description.zh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-tools：咨询/汇报材料生成引擎的 15 个 DSH 原生工具（记忆面 + 质量门禁）+ L0 守卫；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-events 配套使用。

plugins.name: dsh-lab-assistant

description.en: Desktop-pet lab assistant for DSH that keeps experiment records, accumulates per-software notes, and generates Word/Markdown lab reports from real step-by-step evidence. The desktop pet and lab panel require the Windows desktop build of DSH; other profiles get the conversational tools only.
description.zh: 面向高校实验课程的 DSH 桌宠式插件：保存实验档案、按软件累积经验、用真实步骤证据生成 Word/Markdown 实验报告，并提供黄色高框指引与「点一下自动判对错」的教学循环。桌宠与实验助手面板仅在 Windows 桌面端出现，其他环境只有对话工具可用。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: An approval-gated OME engineering delivery preset with session-isolated lifecycle evidence.
description.zh: 采用阶段审批门禁和会话隔离证据记录的 OME 工程交付 Agent 预设。

description.en: UltraCode-style multi-agent orchestration: a generatable, savable, governable, observable, resumable workflow layer.
description.zh: 把 UltraCode 式多 Agent 调度带给 DSH：可生成、可保存、可治理、可观察、可恢复的 Workflow 层。

description.en: Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.
description.zh: 搭配一个副模型，每轮被动审查并注入见解。

description.en: Adaptive deep-research orchestrator built on the official workflow engine.
description.zh: 自适应深度研究编排器（基于官方 workflow 引擎）。

description.en: Adversarial checkup → fix → review loop toolset.
description.zh: 发现问题→修复交付→质量复查的对抗式闭环工具集。

description.en: Reflex arc for DS Bot: runs as a sibling DSH plugin with no change to ds-bot, collects facts in cheap layers, scores them with a local decision model, and wakes a Bot only when something crosses a threshold.
description.zh: 给 DS Bot 的反射弧：作为兄弟插件运行、不改 ds-bot，用低成本层持续采集事实并在本地决策模型上打分，只有越过阈值时才唤醒 Bot 的推理层。

description.en: Profile-wide DSH governance and routing with a Web Control Center for responsibility and evidence inspection, plus compaction, scoped semantic memory, safety continuity, and verified delivery; compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.1.
description.zh: 面向整个 DSH profile 的治理与路由 bundle，提供用于职责与证据检查的 Web Control Center，以及压缩、本地作用域语义记忆、安全连续性与真实验收；兼容 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。

description.en: Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed; per-session isolation and restart-safe redelivery.
description.zh: 定时发送：到点将拟好的消息以正常用户气泡发送到绑定的会话。调度在服务端执行，关闭浏览器不影响发送；会话隔离、重启自动补发。

description.en: Native workbench to select project sources, distill and test capability candidates, configure scoped Slack access, and review approvals and persistent tasks.
description.zh: 原生分身工作台：选择项目资料、蒸馏并试跑能力候选、配置有范围的 Slack 访问，查看审批与持久任务。

plugins.name: dsh-family-assistant

description.en: Owner workbench for independently connected family WeChat assistants, per-member project and tool permissions, scheduled services and delivery status; API acceptance does not confirm receipt.
description.zh: 通过 Owner 工作台管理家人各自连接的微信助手、按人授予项目和工具权限、安排服务并查看投递状态；接口接受不代表手机实收。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to family.local

description.en: Personal assistant for projects, conversations, memory, reviews and news. Bundled WeChat pins the QR-confirmed account; first messages cannot claim ownership. An optional allowlist further restricts access. Missing or conflicting identity requires desktop recovery. API acceptance is not phone receipt.
description.zh: 个人助理：在授权范围内整理项目，衔接原生对话、记忆、回顾与资讯。单包内置微信，扫码确认账号为唯一操作者，陌生人先发消息不能认领；白名单可进一步限制，身份缺失或冲突会暂停并提示在电脑恢复。接口接受不代表手机实收。

description.en: Session-scoped delivery receipts for local artifacts: compare current file hashes with a recorded baseline, keep agent claims separate from explicit user acceptance, flag changed or unavailable files, and export a Markdown receipt through a tool, slash command, and conversation panel.
description.zh: 为本地成果生成会话级交付回执：对比当前文件哈希与记录基线，将 Agent 自述与用户明确验收分开，标记已变化或无法核验的文件，并通过工具、斜杠命令和会话面板导出 Markdown 回执。

description.en: Session-scoped research evidence ledger with sources, linked claims, open questions, and explicit user review; provides a tool, slash command, and conversation panel, with selected-claim Markdown export that omits excerpts, review notes, and local paths by default; does not fetch sources or verify their truth.
description.zh: 会话级研究证据账本，整理来源、关联论点、待解问题与用户明确复核；提供工具、斜杠命令和会话面板，可按论点选择导出 Markdown，默认省略摘录、复核备注与本地路径；不抓取来源或判断内容真伪。

description.en: A /agentinit command that builds, repairs or audits a repository's AGENTS.md inside a subagent: the child reads the method file itself and checks every command and path it writes with the bundled read-only checker, so no instruction body enters the main conversation. The bundled checker is a Python script, so Python 3 must be on PATH.
description.zh: /agentinit 命令：在子代理里生成、修订或审计仓库的 AGENTS.md。方法文档由子代理自己读取，写下的每条命令与路径都用随包的只读检查器核验，主对话不进入任何指令正文。随包的检查器是 Python 脚本，需要 Python 3 在 PATH 中。

description.en: Sync DSH user-level assets (skills, plugin manifest, config, memory) across machines with one-click restore, automatic plugin reinstall and secret scanning.
description.zh: DSH 用户级配置同步：技能、插件清单、配置与记忆跨机同步，换机一键恢复、缺插件自动装回、敏感文件硬拒绝。

description.en: Host-side long-task detection for small-context local models: long outputs are scaffolded into a parts skeleton (one part per reply, then assemble), and multi-step work into a PLAN.md ledger with notes/ (plan first, one step per reply). Detection is heuristic and host-side, so it does not depend on the model judging its own limits.
description.zh: 面向小上下文本地模型的宿主侧长任务识别：长产出自动拆成分段骨架（每轮只写一段，最后拼装），多步骤任务自动建立 PLAN.md 台账与 notes/（先立计划、每轮执行一步）。判定在宿主侧用启发式完成，不依赖模型自己判断极限。

description.en: Deep reading & summarization for DSH: books/papers/videos/web into structured Obsidian notes via plugin parsers, MapReduce parallel deep-read subagents, JSON Schema outputs and an idempotent cache.
description.zh: DSH 精读与摘要：书籍/论文/视频/网页经可插拔解析器转成结构化 Obsidian 笔记，MapReduce 并行精读子代理、JSON Schema 输出与幂等缓存。

description.en: Accounts-payable three-way match: import invoices, purchase orders and goods receipts, apply the tolerance policy and export the exception workpaper — 4 `ap.*` tools.
description.zh: 应付三单匹配：导入发票、采购订单与收货单，按容差策略匹配并导出异常底稿——4 个 `ap.*` 工具。

description.en: Durable background child agents on the official subagent seam: start from any session, watch progress in the Web UI sidebar, message and interrupt any time, with per-child tool scoping, persona and delegation-depth caps.
description.zh: 官方子代理接缝上的持久化后台子代理：任意会话中启动，Web 侧边栏看进度、随时留言与打断，支持按子代理限定工具、人格与委托深度。

description.en: Bank statement reconciliation: ingest CAMT.053 and MT940, match them against ledger entries and export the workpaper — 6 `bankrec.*` tools.
description.zh: 银行对账单核对：导入 CAMT.053 与 MT940，与账簿条目匹配并导出工作底稿——6 个 `bankrec.*` 工具。

description.en: Engineering-discipline guard: requirements grill before the first edit, red/green test-evidence gates, forked adversary review, and a delivery report with a per-dimension verification workflow.
description.zh: 工程纪律守门：动笔前审讯需求，红绿测试证据门，交付后对抗评审，并汇总交付报告与逐维度核对。

description.en: Chinese e-invoice (OFD/XML) inbox: ingest, parse, deduplicate, queue for review, record receipts and archive locally — 10 `invoice.*` tools, nothing uploaded.
description.zh: 中文电子发票（OFD/XML）收件箱：导入、解析、去重、进入复核队列、登记回执并本地归档——10 个 `invoice.*` 工具，数据不出本机。

description.en: Contract clause work: build the clause tree, map it against a 12-key playbook, register the playbook and export the unresolved report — 5 `legal.*` tools.
description.zh: 合同条款处理：构建条款树、按 12 项 playbook 映射、登记 playbook 并导出未决清单——5 个 `legal.*` 工具。

description.en: Legal request intake: read requests out of EML, deduplicate threads and export the intake ledger — 2 `legal.*` tools.
description.zh: 法务需求收件：从 EML 读取需求、按线程去重并导出收件台账——2 个 `legal.*` 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-research-report

description.en: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger, versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory, and retrieval orchestration that reuses the ctx.web and ctx.jobs seams.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可核查研究报告引擎：通过内容寻址的证据台账和版本化封存报告使每条结论携带核查结论，由 manifest 哈希封存目录，检索编排复用 ctx.web 与 ctx.jobs 接口。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to doi.org

description.en: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive restarts.
description.zh: 持久化、跨会话的多 Agent 团队房间：成员、消息总线、共享任务板与共享时间线，重启后仍然保留。

description.en: Travel expense reconciliation: ingest orders, invoices and card lines, deduplicate, run the three-way match and a read-only policy check, then export — 5 `travel.*` tools.
description.zh: 差旅费用核对：导入订单、发票与卡流水，去重、三单匹配与只读政策校验后导出——5 个 `travel.*` 工具。

description.en: Ships BMAD-Method inside the plugin: the seven modules are laid down on first open, no installer run and no download, the method's 90 agent and workflow skills come in the package, and each module can be turned off by writing the disabled flag into the profile patch.
description.zh: 把 BMAD-Method 塞进插件里：首次打开即铺好七个模块（不跑安装器、不下载），随包提供 90 个 agent 与工作流 skill，每个模块可通过写 profile 补丁里的 disabled 标记单独停用。

description.en: Deterministic ticket triage: a rule prefilter classifies clear cases and returns everything else as needs_review instead of guessing.
description.zh: 确定性工单分诊：规则先处理明确案例，放不下的统一返回 needs_review，而不是猜。

description.en: Visual drag-and-drop workflow builder for DSH — orchestrate tool calls, sub-agents, and conditional branches on a React Flow canvas.
description.zh: DSH 可视化工作流编排画布，基于 React Flow 拖拽编排工具调用、子智能体与条件分支。

description.en: Scheduled Agent tasks for DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 with per-task models, workspaces, independent or persistent sessions, run history, and file artifacts.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 的定时 Agent 任务，支持按任务配置模型与工作目录、独立或持续会话、运行记录和文件产物。

description.en: Local Markdown notes as governable working memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: dual-mode source/WYSIWYG editor with images, convention or reference notes auto-inject into the system prompt with sensitive values masked, plus snapshot version history, recycle bin, undoable archiving, AI reorganization, backlinks and full-text search. Compatible with DSH 0.1.7-0.2.x.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可治理 Agent 工作记忆层，沉淀为本地 Markdown 笔记：双模式编辑器（源码⇄富文本，支持图片），约定/资料笔记自动注入系统提示（敏感值自动脱敏），另有快照版本历史、回收站、可撤销归档、AI 整理、双链与全文搜索。兼容 DSH 0.1.7～0.2.x。

description.en: Kanban task board for DeepSeek Harness sessions: the main agent dispatches tasks to one-shot worker/verifier subagents, with dependency scheduling, file-level exclusion locks, arbitration hold/freeze, milestone progress reporting, and per-task token usage stats.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话任务看板：主窗口把任务派发给一次性 Worker/Verifier 子代理执行与验收，支持依赖调度、文件级排他锁、裁决挂起冻结、里程碑进展上报与任务级 Token 消耗统计。

plugins.name: dsh-punky-swarm#dsh-punky-swarm

description.en: Engine-enforced guardrails for DeepSeek Harness agent swarms: quality gates reject half-done work, crash-safe checkpoints resume in place — keeps AI teams from breaking, not just running.
description.zh: dsh 单机多子 Agent 集群治理：引擎级质量门禁拒收半成品、崩溃断点续跑不重来——给 AI 团队装上"跑不坏"的工程护栏。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 2.5.4.3 for network access

description.en: Config-only bundle that mounts Ouroboros through the DSH MCP client, exposing 36 interview, Seed, execution, evaluation, and evolution workflow tools in DSH.
description.zh: 通过 DSH MCP 客户端挂载 Ouroboros 的纯配置包，在 DSH 中提供 36 个涵盖需求访谈、Seed、执行、评估与演化流程的工具。

description.en: Installs two selectable Agent Presets: a shell-restricted general-purpose agent and a repository-focused coding agent.
description.zh: 安装两个可选 Agent Preset：默认不暴露 Shell 的通用 Agent，以及面向真实代码仓库的 Coding Pro。

description.en: Automatically continues a native continuable DSH subagent once when it ends with explicit max-tokens termination, then stops.
description.zh: 当原生可续接 DSH 子代理因明确的 max-tokens 终止时自动续接一次，然后停止介入。

description.en: Self-evolution actuator: consumes problem tickets mined from session logs, synthesizes skill candidates (zero-code tiers by default) behind an eval gate with hold-out canaries, then promotes to project .dsh/skills with human confirm and deterministic rollback.
description.zh: 自进化执行器：消费会话日志挖掘出的问题工单，在评测门（hold-out canary 防作弊）下合成技能候选，人工确认晋级到项目 .dsh/skills 并支持确定性回滚。

description.en: More agent presets for DSH, derived from other coding agents such as Qwen Code and iFlow.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供更多智能体预设，衍生自其他编程智能体（例如 Qwen Code、iFlow）。

description.en: DIY workflow builder for DSH - compose multi-step prompt workflows with self-check gating, engine-enforced jump rules, agent-driven execution and a live run panel.
description.zh: 流程锻造——在侧边面板编排多步骤提示词工作流，支持自检门禁、引擎执行的跳转规则、主对话 AI 逐步执行与实时运行面板。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness bundle adapted from whatcccup/cece_legal_skills (MIT) for local DOCX, PDF, TXT and Markdown redaction with human review, PDF masking, local history and optional Agent rule edits. Requires Python 3.9+ and first-run dependency downloads. Model access is needed only for rule generation; 1.3.0 is a development prerelease and Windows acceptance is pending. The upstream is a standalone offline tool/SkillHub skill, not a DSH plugin, so it cannot be installed alongside this bundle.
description.zh: 在 whatcccup/cece_legal_skills（MIT）基础上适配的 DeepSeek Harness 文书脱敏插件，提供本地识别、人工复核、PDF 框选遮盖、历史记录与可选 Agent 改规则。需 Python 3.9+，首次准备依赖需要联网；仅规则生成需要模型。1.3.0 为开发预发布，Windows 待实机验收；上游是独立离线工具/SkillHub 技能，不是 DSH 插件，无法在 DSH 内与本插件同装。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that periodically detects added, modified, and deleted files in a workspace and reports the changes.
description.zh: 一个适配 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区监测插件，按周期检测并报告文件的新增、修改和删除。

description.en: Optimized fork of dsh-image-gen with batch generation (count), gallery pagination, lazy loading, fetch retry/timeout, and 7 providers: Gemini/OpenAI/Seedream/DashScope/Agnes/GLM-Image/Stability AI.
description.zh: dsh-image-gen 优化版：支持批量生图（count 参数）、画廊分页懒加载、请求超时/重试，兼容 7 个提供商：Gemini/OpenAI/Seedream/通义万相/Agnes/智谱 GLM/Stability AI。

description.en: Creates and inspects RecoWork local-agent-project workspaces through two bounded DSH tools and a web workspace card.
description.zh: 通过两个受限的 DSH 工具和网页工作区卡片，创建并检查 RecoWork local-agent-project 工作区。

description.en: Novel writing panel for the DSH sidebar that binds a local manuscript folder, imports Agent Skills as analysis lenses, and scans platform rankings into story-structure outlines.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的小说创作面板：绑定本地书稿目录，把导入的 Agent 技能当作分析视角，并扫描平台榜单归纳故事架构。

description.en: Turns a product or UI request into an implementation-ready design spec with /ui-workflow and /ui-rerun. Analysts run through a read-only ui_analyst tool, and the lead agent writes docs/ui-workflow reports.
description.zh: 把产品或界面需求编排成可落地的设计规格，提供 /ui-workflow 与 /ui-rerun。分析师通过只读 ui_analyst 运行，主控把报告写入 docs/ui-workflow。

description.en: Unified anchored agent preset for DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash on the official API and opencode-go: Minimal-exact two-tool first-request bootstrap, model-aware Pro/Flash paths, and epoch-aware catalog management for long-session stability.
description.zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro/Flash 统一锚定 agent 预设（官方 API 与 opencode-go）：首请求 Minimal 精确两工具锚定、按模型分流 Pro/Flash 路径、epoch 感知目录管理保证长对话稳定。

description.en: Long-task orchestration loop: Codex plans/scores/reviews, DeepSeek executes, Kimi supplements (vision acceptance, summarization, cross-check).
description.zh: 长任务编排闭环：Codex 规划/打分/审核，DeepSeek 执行，Kimi 补充（视觉验收/摘要/交叉验证）。

description.en: DSH self-discipline companion with recurring tasks, a gaze-tracking desktop mascot, evidence logs, final AI review, reminders, and window intervention on Windows and GNOME Wayland.
description.zh: 大肥鱼监工是 DSH 自制力助手：支持单次与循环预约、会看鼠标的桌面角色、采集证据与诊断日志、到点后的 AI 末轮验收，以及原生提醒和窗口干预；支持 Windows 与 GNOME Wayland。

description.en: Keep your automation tasks in files you can version and review: write each task's schedule, prompt, model, permission and working folder in YAML, JSON or JS, and DSH's own Schedule is kept exactly in line, creating, updating, disabling and deleting tasks within a second of a save. Each task runs in its own conversation, persistent or fresh per run; /automations syncs on demand and names any file mistake; and a sync that finds no tasks never wipes the Schedule.
description.zh: 把自动化任务放进可以版本管理、可以审阅的文件里：用 YAML、JSON 或 JS 写下每个任务的计划、提示词、模型、权限和工作目录，DSH 自带的 Schedule 会与文件保持完全一致，保存后一秒内完成创建、更新、停用和删除。每个任务在自己的会话中运行，可持续复用或每次新开；/automations 可随时同步并指出出错的文件；若同步时一个任务也没找到，绝不会清空 Schedule。

description.en: Keep a multi-PR effort on one board you can trust at a glance: the hub agent keeps a tree of steps, each linked to its issue, PR, branch and worktree, through four board tools, and you see what is done, what is blocked and what needs you in a right-sidebar Board tab and a progress strip above the composer. Each board is one plain JSON file your scripts can read, and an optional drift command you configure flags steps whose status no longer matches their work.
description.zh: 把跨多个 PR 的工作放进一块一眼就能看清的看板：中枢 Agent 通过四个看板工具维护一棵步骤树，每步关联 issue、PR、分支与 worktree；右侧栏 Board 标签页和输入框上方的进度条告诉你哪些已完成、哪些被阻塞、哪些在等你处理。每个看板就是一个你的脚本也能读的 JSON 文件；可选的、由你配置的漂移检查命令会标出状态与实际进展不再一致的步骤。

description.en: Installs a multi-agent novel-writing preset for DeepSeek Harness: one conductor agent dispatches five specialized subagents — world-building, plotting, character management, prose writing, and QA review.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 安装一个多智能体小说创作预设：一个统筹队长派单五个专职子代理——架构世界、策划剧情、管理人物、执笔写文、质检复核。

description.en: Model high-availability failover (quarantine, circuit breaking, probe recovery) and subagent orchestration (fanout/pipeline/supervisor) with bilingual settings UI.
description.zh: 模型高可用故障回退（隔离/熔断/探测恢复）与子智能体编排（fanout/pipeline/supervisor），附带双语设置界面。

description.en: Connects dsh to a local SandBase Harness runtime over stdio MCP for managing agents and sessions, streaming turns, inspecting artifacts and cancelling work.
description.zh: 通过 stdio MCP 将 dsh 连接到本地 SandBase Harness 运行时，用于管理代理与会话、流式执行任务、检查产物和取消工作。

description.en: Session-local scheduled tasks: inject a prompt into the current session after a delay, at a fixed time, or on a repeating interval, so the model wakes up and runs it on time. Manage them from a panel above the composer, the /schedule command, or seven model-facing tools. Timers freeze while DSH is closed and never auto-resume; pause keeps the remaining time, so resuming continues from where it stopped.
description.zh: 会话内定时任务：按延迟、固定时刻或重复间隔向当前会话注入一段提示词，到点唤醒模型执行。可用输入框上方面板、/schedule 命令、或 7 个面向模型的工具管理。DSH 关闭期间计时冻结、绝不自动恢复；暂停保留剩余时间，恢复后从原处继续。

description.en: Persistent Codex, Grok Build and Claude Code sessions through ACP, with native model controls, permission approvals and optional A2A delegation.
description.zh: 通过 ACP 使用持久化的 Codex、Grok Build 和 Claude Code 会话，支持原生模型控制、权限审批及可选的 A2A 委派。

description.en: A Multitask agent preset where the main conversation only plans, briefs subagents and summarizes results, while file reads, commands, search and builds run inside subagent contexts; four worker kinds, an approval gate for dangerous operations, and zero changes to DSH source.
description.zh: Multitask 减震器模式（Agent preset）：主对话只做需求理解、任务下发与结果汇总，读文件、跑命令、搜索与构建全部下放子代理；含四类 worker、危险操作审批闸门，且零 DSH 源码改动。

description.en: Settings-based scheduled tasks that run on time or during DeepSeek off-peak hours, with one-time and daily schedules backed by durable task state.
description.zh: 设置页定时任务：支持准点或 DeepSeek 谷时段执行、单次/每日重复，并持久化任务状态。

description.en: Cross-session task relay for DSH Desktop 0.2: six relay_* control tools, independent sidebar sessions, live host-origin discovery, durable turn-completion checks, and a bundled relay skill.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 0.2 跨会话任务接力插件：提供 6 个 relay_* 控制工具、独立侧边栏会话、动态宿主地址发现、持久化回合完成检查及内嵌接力技能。

description.en: Cross-device workspace backup, restore, and ecosystem update via the uagent-sync CLI.
description.zh: 工作区跨设备备份、恢复与扩展更新，经 uagent-sync CLI 桥接执行。

description.en: Bundles 61 specialist workflows and a Chief of Staff coordinator in one plugin, with local intake, delivery, recovery, and evidence tools.
description.zh: 把 61 套专家工作流与一个 Chief of Staff 协调器打包成一个插件，内置本地需求受理、交付、返工与证据工具。

description.en: An audit workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a multi-agent consultation venue where each review seat is filled by an agent, every judgment is routed to a named review face, and the whole run is kept as a traceable record. Works out of the box: the service endpoint is built in, a workspace is provisioned automatically on first launch, and review scenes come with their seats and agents listed.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多人会商审校的「场地」——每个审核席位由一个 Agent 承担，判定逐面路由，全程留痕可回看。装上即用：内置服务端接入，首次打开自动开铺，场景、席位与审核 Agent 开箱在位。

description.en: Companion operations panel for the Kaipu site plugin: round timeline, run status, jump gates and browser entry. Installs and uninstalls on its own; the site plugin stays fully usable without it. Renders the persisted workstation state (no live stream yet).
description.zh: 山海·开铺 工位插件：场地的操作台面板，轮次时间线／运行状态／跳转门／浏览器入口。可单独安装或卸载，卸掉它场地仍完整可用。当前渲染工位持久化态（非实时流）。

description.en: A full-screen novel-writing workbench: chapter board, draft candidates reviewed and merged paragraph by paragraph, plot summaries carrying an index header, and a writing pack assembled from the outline, character cards and earlier chapters. It also reads a shelf of finished books you import, extracts their writing habits in one run, merges them into a single style standard, and puts that standard in the prompt for every later generation.
description.zh: 一页式小说创作工作台：章节看板、候选稿逐段评审与合稿、带索引头的剧情总结，以及由大纲、人物卡与前文拼成的写作包。还能导入几本成品书，一次跑完粗扫、精读、汇总并融合成一套写法标准，写进偏好档案，之后每次生成都照着它来。

plugins.name: dsh-image-gen

description.en: Native conversational image generation for DeepSeek Harness: ask the agent to create an image, and it handles generation and keeps the result directly in the conversation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生对话生图能力：直接让 Agent 画图，插件自动完成生成并把结果保留在当前会话中。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Local SQLite taskboard as a native overlay page: projects, tasks, comments, relations, attachments and workflow automation, with backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done statuses, `taskboard_*` Agent tools that can only submit work to in_review, a headless JSON CLI and a packaged skill.
description.zh: 本地 SQLite 任务板，以原生覆盖页呈现：项目、任务、评论、关联、附件与工作流自动化，状态流转 backlog → todo → in_progress → in_review → done；提供 `taskboard_*` Agent 工具（Agent 只能提交到 in_review，验收需人工）、无头 JSON CLI 与打包 skill。

description.en: When a dsh turn gets interrupted — by a web restart or an upstream hiccup (rate limit, 5xx, quota error) — this plugin auto-injects a "continue" so your session picks up where it left off, with a dead-loop guard that hands back control if the retry produces nothing.
description.zh: dsh 会话因 web 重启或上游瞬时故障（限流、5xx、余额/配额错误）中断时，自动注入「继续」让本轮接着跑，不需要手动点、不会丢上下文；带死循环守卫，重试没反应就把会话交回给你。

description.en: ✨ One-click prompt polisher for the DSH composer — an agent refines your rough draft in a side chat over multiple turns, and you copy the result back when you're happy.
description.zh: DSH 主输入框旁的 ✨ 一键提示词打磨：点击后 Agent 在侧边对话多轮改写草稿，你满意后再手动回填。

description.en: Advisor reviews that converge over rounds, an engineering mode whose writes require a design token, escalation of a task to a stronger model, and parallel multi-model consultation; a settings page edits the model routes, timeouts and budgets.
description.zh: 导师评审逐轮收敛、工程模式写入需持设计令牌、把任务转交给更强的模型、并行多模型会诊；设置页可改各模型路由、超时与预算。

description.en: A novel-writing workbench for DeepSeek Harness: you tap thumbs-up or thumbs-down on candidate passages, and the model distils them into a short preference profile that carries into later drafting calls while the manuscript stays out of the drafting context. Adds a chapter board, per-chapter writing packs, annotation-scoped revision that rewrites only the annotated paragraph and verifies the rest byte-for-byte, a project ledger, and local pacing checks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的小说写作工作台：你在候选段落上点赞或点踩，模型把这批点选蒸馏成一份简短的「作者偏好档案」带进后续写稿，正文本身不进写稿上下文。另有章节看板、每章写作包、只改被批注段落并逐字核对其余段落的批注式微调、项目台账，以及不把正文送进模型的本地情节体检。

description.en: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official workflow tool: a verbatim fork of the stock tool plus a persisted saved-workflow library (workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved) backed by ctx.storageDomain, so scripts can be stored, retrieved and re-run with new arguments.
description.zh: 官方 workflow 工具的 drop-in 增强版：在逐字 fork 的官方工具之上，用 ctx.storageDomain 提供持久化的 saved workflow 库（workflow_save / workflow_list / workflow_get / workflow_delete / workflow_run_saved），可把编排脚本存库、检索并带新参数重跑。

description.en: Enhances native DSH subagents and teams with persistent subagents, improved subagent messaging, and per-member model selection for teams. Adds no extra tools or context beyond the native features.
description.zh: DSH原生子代理和团队增强。提供持久子代理功能，及子代理消息增强。额外支持指定团队成员模型。与原生功能相比，无附加工具及上下文。

description.en: Agent-team task workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar board and requirement view track tasks across backlog, execution, review and done, dispatch work to coding agents, and run multi-role team orchestration on a local SQLite store.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体团队任务工作台：侧栏看板与需求视图跟踪任务从待办、执行、评审到完成，把工作派发给编码智能体，并用本地 SQLite 承载多角色团队编排。

description.en: Capture selected DSH, local MCP, or native WebMCP calls as reviewed, parameterized routines, expose typed tools, and replay with fresh approval.
description.zh: 把选定的 DSH、本地 MCP 或原生 WebMCP 调用捕获为经过评审的参数化例程，暴露为带类型的工具，重放时重新请求批准。

description.en: Asks the few key questions that decide the approach before work starts — one shot, about 200 tokens per session, no tool registration and no extra model call.
description.zh: 开工前用一次提问把关键选择问清（静态还是动态、Hexo 还是 Hugo），约 200 token/会话，不注册工具、不额外调模型；可在精简/标准/深入三档间切换。

description.en: Study workbench for exam prep and research: three-column task board with tags and filters, a spaced-repetition queue (simplified SM-2) that keeps finished cards coming back, a heatmap lit by actual focused minutes, weekly reports, per-day review notes, a pomodoro timer that survives panel switches, and Markdown export/import for Obsidian. Installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-study-desk on npm).
description.zh: 备考与科研学习工作台：三列待办墙（标签与过滤）、间隔重复复习队列（简化 SM-2，已完成的卡照样会到期）、按实际专注分钟点亮的热力图、周报、每日复盘、跨面板存活的番茄钟，支持 Markdown 导出与读回（Obsidian 友好）。可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-study-desk）。

description.en: Synchronizes DeepSeek Harness third-party plugin lists through S3-compatible storage with diff preview, local snapshots, rollback, and optional LLM provider configuration sync.
description.zh: 通过兼容 S3 的对象存储同步 DeepSeek Harness 第三方插件列表，提供差异预览、本地快照、回滚与可选的 LLM provider 配置同步。

description.en: Run your DSH agents like a company: departments, order dispatch, attempt credentials, an audit ledger and cost accounting on top of ctx.agents/subagents — plus a work board, an org chart and DAG task planning, no native team layer required.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 agent 当公司跑：部门、派工、attempt 凭证、审计账本与成本核算，叠加工作网看板、组织架构图与 DAG 任务图并行派发，无需原生 team 层。

description.en: Reason tree: breaks a conclusion into a bottom-up argument tree, marks each branch as holds, fails or open, and jumps to the source file in Hippocampus.
description.zh: 根源追溯：把结论拆成从下往上的论证树，每一支可标成立、不成立或待拆，并能跳到海马体看原文。

description.en: Jimu (积木): domain-based orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness — domain_plan confirmation, per-domain sub-agents with hand-off, and automatic LLM audit.
description.zh: 积木：DSH 分域编排插件，domain_plan 分域确认 + 按域编排子代理（手递手）+ LLM 自动审计。

description.en: Adds a "Compact and run" action to the DSH Web plan-review card, which compacts the history submitted before the plan into a checkpoint and then approves the plan.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的计划审批卡上增加「压缩后执行」：先把计划提交之前的历史压成检查点，再批准计划。

description.en: Host-side unattended job scheduler: runs one-shot agent tasks or shell commands on cron, interval, or one-time schedules, with persisted at-most-once dispatch state, overlap/misfire policies, and bounded run history.
description.zh: 宿主侧无人值守定时任务：按 cron 表达式、固定间隔或一次性时点运行一次性 agent 任务或 shell 命令，调度状态持久化（至多一次语义），支持重叠/错过策略与有界运行历史。

description.en: Minimal prompt x Web PTC capabilities: one-line persona, run_code SDK, subagents, Ralph, web search/fetch, and Windows Git Bash; the general-purpose workflow tool stays hidden.
description.zh: 极简提示词 × Web PTC 能力：一句人格、run_code SDK、子代理、Ralph、网页搜索/抓取与 Windows Git Bash；通用 workflow 工具保持隐藏。

description.en: All-in-one combo patch for STARDUSTLC's 18 DSH plugins: one command injects shared default configs across office, media, DevOps and notification presets; each component installs directly via a one-line add command (flat design, no git subdependencies).
description.zh: STARDUSTLC 插件全家桶·组合补丁：与 18 个组件插件配套，一条命令统一注入默认配置（办公流/媒体工坊/DevOps/通知/预设）；组件经一行 add 命令直装（扁平化设计，无 git 子依赖）。

description.en: Agent preset bundle for wish and task management: create wishes or tasks from conversation, opportunity-day check-ins, micro-actions, plus a memory store and progress charts in the web UI.
description.zh: 愿望与任务管理的 Agent Preset 组合包：在对话中创建愿望/任务、机会日打卡、微行动，并附带记忆存储与 Web 端进度图表。

description.en: Provides shared plan, context pickup, and progress update Skills through StateDock Remote MCP without executing tasks or scheduling agents; targets Harness 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 通过 StateDock Remote MCP 提供共享计划、上下文恢复与进度更新 Skills，不执行任务或调度 Agent；适配 Harness 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: To-do list panel for DeepSeek Harness: large task cards in collapsible sections, hour-precision due times, per-task reminder lead times, and DingTalk notifications through a group robot webhook or an enterprise-app work notice. Each task can bind to a workspace session and jump to it on click.
description.zh: DSH 待办清单面板：可折叠分组中的大卡片任务，截止时间精确到小时，可按任务设置提前提醒，并通过钉钉群机器人 Webhook 或企业应用工作通知推送；任务可绑定工作区会话，点击直达。

description.en: Per-workspace project kanban board: nine kanban_* model tools for agent-driven planning plus a browser board UI, with disk persistence, undo, templates, and archiving.
description.zh: 按工作区（项目）隔离的项目看板：9 个 kanban_* 模型工具供 Agent 规划时写卡，另带浏览器看板 UI，支持磁盘持久化、撤销、模板与归档。

description.en: Runs work as a crew of role agents: a product manager writes the PRD or DoD, waits for your confirmation, then starts architect, engineer, QA and reviewers whose tool sets are locked per role, and shares work through files on disk.
description.zh: 以角色团队的方式干活：产品经理先写 PRD 或 DoD 并等你确认，再启动架构师、工程师、QA 与各类评审；每个角色的工具集按角色锁定，彼此通过磁盘文件协作。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: the standard tool stack plus four working rules written into the persona prompt — a project keeps at most four documents (intro, decisions, change log, current state and next steps), those documents describe only the current state with no AI edit history or superseded decisions, no git commit or push or pull request until the user explicitly asks, and a careful-coding workflow (restate the goal and done-criteria first, surgical diffs, evidence before claiming success) with plain-language reports.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Agent 预设：标准模式的工具栈，外加写进人格提示的四条工作纪律——每个项目最多四个文档（项目介绍、方案设定、改动记录、现状与下一步）；文档只写当前状态，不记 AI 修改历史、不留被推翻的旧方案；用户没有明确指令就不提交、不推送、不开 PR；动手前先复述目标与验收标准、只做手术式最小改动、没验证不说已修复，汇报用大白话。

description.en: Dual-brain agent presets for DSH: one model plans the framework and delegates execution to a subagent pinned to a second model. Ships brain-ds (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash plans, MiMo-V2.6-Flash executes) and brain-mimo (the reverse), switchable per session. Needs two providers configured (Xiaomi MiMo and a DeepSeek account), and the main brain must be selected manually.
description.zh: 双脑协作 agent 预设：主脑先出框架，再把执行步骤委派给锁定另一模型的子代理。内置 brain-ds（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 规划、MiMo-V2.6-Flash 执行）与 brain-mimo（反向），按会话切换。需配置 Xiaomi MiMo 与 DeepSeek 账号两个 provider，主脑须手动选择。

description.en: Multi-CLI worker sidebar for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS and Windows, with task dispatch, live conversation views, stop and follow-up controls, and custom role presets.
description.zh: 适用于 macOS / Windows 和 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的多 CLI 智能体侧栏插件，提供任务派遣、实时对话查看、停止与续聊及自定义角色预设。

description.en: Saves architecture and validated plans, runs native AgentTeams workers with approval, parallel coding and independent review, and summarizes progress and verification results.
description.zh: 保存架构和可校验计划，批准后通过原生 AgentTeams 并行开发与独立审查，并汇总进度、验证结果和交付阻塞。

description.en: Self-media workbench plugin: 8-tab dashboard (daily brief, narrative lines, topics, drafts, knowledge-card distill review, sources, publish, advice) with hard guards (48h window, event dedup, card/line existence, read-only advice) and a read-only intel module following the four red lines.
description.zh: 自媒体工作台插件：8 tab 看板（今日简报/叙事主线/选题/草稿/知识卡蒸馏审核/信息源/发布表现/系统建议），五守卫硬执行，VAULT 数据与代码分离，intel 模块只读接入并遵守四条红线。

description.en: Adds a "Task Planning" agent preset that asks requirements in versioned rounds, then writes step-by-step plans and prompts without implementing them itself.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加「任务规划」模式：按版本迭代逐轮提问把需求问清楚，再产出可逐条执行的规划与提示词，自身不实现代码。

description.en: Keeps an agent working continuously over long stretches: set a deadline, and if it finishes the task early, Dont-Stop automatically nudges it to keep iterating and take on the next step on its own.
description.zh: 保证智能体长时间持续工作：设定一个截止时间，若提前完成任务，Dont-Stop 会自动督促它继续迭代、自主推进下一步任务。

description.en: Generic monitor plugin for DSH Desktop: an HTTP polling rule engine. Poll any endpoint on schedule (multi-step, variable extraction, JS condition expressions); when conditions hit, wake a visible agent session to act — zero model calls otherwise. Configure everything in a sidebar GUI panel: create/edit/pause/test/fire-now/run history, same UX as the built-in scheduler plugin.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 通用监控插件：HTTP 轮询规则引擎。按规则定时轮询任意接口（多步骤、变量提取、JS 条件表达式），条件命中才唤醒一个可见的 agent 会话执行任务；未命中零模型调用、零 token 消耗。规则通过导航栏 GUI 面板配置：新建/编辑/启停/测试/立即触发/执行记录，与定时任务插件同款交互体验。

description.en: Adds a versioned DPIA workbench to DeepSeek Harness for source-linked facts, follow-up answers, reassessment, and reviewable reports. Needs Python 3.9+ with `python-docx`, `pypdf`, and (for PDF templates) `reportlab` + `pdftoppm`.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加带版本记录的 DPIA 工作台，关联材料来源、事实补正、补答、复评与待审阅报告。需 Python 3.9+ 及 `python-docx`、`pypdf`，PDF 模板还需 `reportlab` 与 `pdftoppm`。

description.en: Sidebar node canvas for DSH where each node is an agent task and each link a dataflow dependency. One deterministic import (no model calls) produces both a task pipeline and a file-level module graph; file nodes carry a coupling score, and every run is snapshotted so it can be undone as a whole.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的节点画布：每个节点是一个 agent 任务，每条连线是一条数据流依赖。一次确定性导入（不调模型）同时生成任务流水线与文件级模块结构图，文件节点带耦合评分；每次运行前自动快照，可整次撤销。

description.en: LittleStar Meeting Room: bring AI sessions that cannot see each other into one room — for a meeting, or a game of werewolf. By 插件·2代小星辰 (LittleStar) and 辰启星明; the four-piece game layer (targeted visibility, private chat, concurrent asks, elimination) was contributed by 插件·3代小星辰. Any session can host — set the topic and goal, invite members in order, they speak one at a time, and the meeting closes with written minutes; it also runs games like werewolf. Includes 小白使用指南.md, a beginner guide written by 插件·3代小星辰.
description.zh: 星辰会议室：让分散在不同会话里的 AI 开一场会 —— 或者，跑一局狼人杀。作者：插件·2代小星辰（LittleStar）、辰启星明；「四件套」（定向可见 / 私聊 / 并发 / 出局）由插件·3代小星辰扩建。在 DSH 里，每个会话是一个独立的 AI，彼此完全看不见；任意会话都能开房当主持人，先定议题与目标，按顺序邀请其他会话，一位一位发言，轮次用满或目标达成即收会生成纪要。它也能跑狼人杀这类对抗游戏。本插件附带小白使用指南.md，看了你就会用，由插件·3代小星辰编写。

description.en: Visually configure an agent's prompt, tools, visible skills, subagents and fallback models, and assemble several of them into a team. It never writes or edits any host preset file.
description.zh: 可视化地自定义配置 Agent 的提示词、工具、可见技能、子代理与备用模型，把它们编成一支团队。不写宿主的任何预设文件。

description.en: Agent-driven kanban board: one board per workspace, per-task agent sessions, and a guarded human/agent workflow (Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done).
description.zh: agent 驱动的看板：每个工作区一块看板、每个任务一个 agent 会话，以及带护栏的人机协作流程（Backlog → To Do → In Progress → Review → Done）。

description.en: Gated four-stage video pipeline: brief, script, assets and compose, turning one sentence into a narrated explainer with ComfyUI workflows or image/video APIs and FFmpeg assembly.
description.zh: 四段带审批闸的视频创作管线：立项、脚本、素材、合成，把一句话变成带配音、配图或视频和字幕的解说片；生成走 ComfyUI 工作流或图片/视频 API，合成走 FFmpeg。

description.en: Evidence-first self-evolution controller: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and a crash-resumable journaled lineage.
description.zh: 证据优先的自进化控制器：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件，一次性真实 Loader 准入，Harbor 评测，可崩溃恢复的日志化谱系。

description.en: Scheduled coding runs in fresh agent sessions with auditable history.
description.zh: 定时任务：让 Coding 任务按计划在全新 Agent Session 中运行，保留可审计历史。

description.en: Plan review with anchored annotations and structured feedback back to the agent.
description.zh: 计划批注：选中计划原文逐条批注，结构化反馈送回 Agent。

description.en: "Single-Core Writing" plugin for DeepSeek Harness: Thoroughly tool-streamlined and output-hardened for quantized small models, suitable for running long-novel pipelines locally with on-device models.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。

description.en: TongFlow film-crew studio for image, voice, music and video production: the agent writes per-asset TongFlow workflow files (.tongflow.json) that run through TongFlow plugins, with an embedded workflow canvas, a shot/character/take project layout and a manga-drama template; sessions starting with @tongflow open the Studio view.
description.zh: 基于 TongFlow 的“片场”插件，用于图片、配音、音乐与视频制作：agent 为每个资产生成 TongFlow 工作流文件（.tongflow.json）并通过 TongFlow 插件执行，内嵌工作流画布，按镜头/角色/take 组织项目，附漫剧模板；以 @tongflow 开头的会话进入 Studio 界面。

description.en: Persistent multi-model squads configured in Settings and selected in the Composer, with per-member model and tool policies. By default the lead Agent completes simple work itself and delegates only when the saved squad is needed; delegated work runs as a bounded DAG with optional review and repair. Run Center tracks retries and per-member tokens from official Harness usage events.
description.zh: 持久化多模型小队在 Settings 中配置、从 Composer 选择，并支持逐成员模型与工具策略。默认由主 Agent 自行完成简单任务，需要已保存的小队时才派工；派工按有界 DAG 执行，并可进行有限的审核与返工。Run Center 展示重试和基于 Harness 官方 usage 事件的逐成员 token 用量。

description.en: Lifecycle orchestration engine for AI agent teams with task-scoped Git worktree isolation, state-gated delivery transitions, and off-context memory.
description.zh: 基于 Git 工作树任务隔离、状态门禁交付与外置记忆的 AI 智能体软件生命周期编排引擎。

description.en: Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

description.en: Conversation search, checkpoints, context management, main and side chats, local long-term memory, tasks, and daily planning for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索、检查点、上下文管理、主聊旁聊、长期记忆、目标待办与今日计划。

description.en: Full local-first issue board embedded in the DSH web GUI: Kanban / list / Gantt / workflow / dashboard views, AI chat per task, attachments and labels, auto-claim of todo tasks driven by dsh-routines — data lives in local SQLite (dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard).
description.zh: 内嵌于 DSH Web GUI 的完整本地优先任务看板：看板/列表/Gantt/工作流/仪表盘视图、任务 AI 对话、附件与标签、dsh-routines 驱动的待办自动认领——数据存本地 SQLite（dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard）。

description.en: Read-only workflow panel for DSH: overview, six gates, milestones, org template, task flow and roster - project data from a project.json file, roster from the live DSH state, ledger presence from the ledger directory. Ships as a Cordis bundle with two GET-only routes and writes nothing to the project or the DSH state file.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 工作流面板：概览、六道门、里程碑、组织模板、任务流与人员卡——项目数据来自 project.json，人员卡来自 DSH 实时状态，台账只读其目录。以 Cordis bundle 形式安装，只注册两条 GET 路由，不写入项目文件或 DSH 状态文件。

plugins.name: dsh-cron-job

description.en: Scheduled DeepSeek Harness Agent tasks with mandatory end-to-end tests, run history, and bidirectional delivery through nine messaging channels.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Agent 定时任务：创建前强制完成端到端测试，提供运行历史，并通过九种通讯渠道双向收发消息。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.ibm.com

description.en: Schedules workspace Agent runs in fresh Result Sessions with persistent audit history, using a stock DSH Conversation tab or a global Shell page when its slots are available.
description.zh: 面向 Workspace 调度 Agent 任务，每次运行创建全新 Result Session 并持久保留审计历史；原版 DSH 使用会话标签，存在对应 Slot 时使用全局 Shell 页面。

description.en: Event-source plugin for DeepSeek Harness: cron, webhook, file watch, and deterministic procedures, with a ledger, console, and concurrency limits.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的事件源插件：cron、webhook、文件监听与确定性 procedure，带账本、控制台和并发上限。

description.en: FIST commander task orchestration as an MCP server: seven-state task lifecycle, hierarchical decomposition, DAG scheduling, self-driving loops and Omega verification, all in one SQLite ledger. Ships a prebuilt CLI, so installing it needs no build step. Requires Node 24+.
description.zh: 把 FIST 指挥官任务编排做成 MCP 服务：七态任务生命周期、层级拆解、DAG 排程、自驱闭环与 Omega 强验证，账本落在一个 SQLite 里；自带预构建 CLI，安装无需构建；需 Node 24+。

description.en: Surveys local code and GitHub/npm for reusable implementations before development, evaluates reuse versus rewrite, and checks architecture coupling.
description.zh: 在开发前检索本地代码与 GitHub/npm 的可复用实现，评估复用与重写成本，并检查架构耦合。

description.en: Keeps a local task-outcome ledger for DSH, verifies acceptance criteria from deterministic evidence, records user disposition and token usage, and supports digest-bound export.
description.zh: 为 DSH 保存本地任务结果账本，依据确定性证据验证验收标准，记录用户处置与 token 用量，并支持摘要绑定导出。

description.en: Shut down Windows automatically after DeepSeek Harness tasks complete — a floating arm button plus a cancellable countdown banner (shutdown /a), zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 任务完成后自动关机：右下角按钮开启模式，任务成功完成后进入可取消的倒计时（取消走 shutdown /a），零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-jev-subagent-dispatch

description.en: Cut LLM costs: a Jev (System One) classifier vets each turn against a declarative policy and recommends the subagent model route, so routine work runs at flash rates while the main model keeps the hard parts; explicit /route trigger, runtime delegation-capability gate, credential redaction, and offline policy replay over the verdict log.
description.zh: 降低 LLM 成本：Jev（System One）分类器按声明式策略审查每一轮任务并推荐 subagent 模型路由，让常规工作以 flash 价格运行、主模型专注难点；显式 /route 触发、运行时代理能力门控、凭据脱敏，以及基于判定日志的离线策略回放。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.
description.zh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

description.en: Let external MCP agents delegate tasks to the existing DSH desktop, with visible sessions, user takeover, and optional approval handoff.
description.zh: 让外部 MCP Agent 将任务交给现有 DSH 桌面端，并提供可见会话、用户接管与可选审批转交。

description.en: Work-review loop for an Obsidian-style vault: writes a day's Dream with a numbered T/G plan, executes only the items marked routine (read-only by default, local commits only with --live), folds seven days into an ISO-week routine, and shows every day and week in a read-only sidebar panel.
description.zh: 面向 Obsidian 风格 vault 的工作回顾闭环：每晚生成当天 Dream 与编号 T/G 计划，只执行标记为「常规」的条目（默认只读，--live 才本地 commit），把七天汇总成 ISO 周周报，并在只读侧栏面板里展示日报与周报。

description.en: Gitee/GitHub AI employee: @ the bot on an issue (Gitee or GitHub), it clones the repo, implements the fix on the branch you name, opens a PR to that branch, and can auto-merge and auto-close the issue. v1.2 adds security scanning: configure scan repos, audit with built-in/custom prompts, deduplicate, and file new findings as issues.
description.zh: Gitee/GitHub AI 员工：在 issue 里 @ 机器人并指定目标分支（如"需要修改 release-v1.2 分支"），它自动克隆仓库开发、向指定分支提交 PR，可自动合并并自动关闭 issue。v1.2 新增代码安全扫描：配置扫描仓库后按内置/自定义提示词审计代码，去重后把新发现提交 issue。

description.en: Execution flow chart: renders the current session's execution as a vertical node flow (turns, user, assistant, tools, approvals, retries, compaction), appended in real time over SSE with auto-follow scrolling — the chart draws wherever the session executes.
description.zh: 执行流程图：把当前会话的执行过程画成一条纵向节点流（回合/用户/助手/工具/审批/重试/压缩），SSE 实时追加——会话执行到哪，图就画到哪，自动跟随滚动。

description.en: Process management: brings ntd-style processes (multi-stage, multi-step agent workflow templates) into the dsh web UI — browse, edit, validate, import/export and AI-generate processes; the built-in library is read-only while the personal library is writable with live file sync, and agents read the library through process_* tools and advance work stage by stage.
description.zh: 工艺管理：把 ntd 的「工艺」（多阶段·多环节 agent 工作流模板）接进 dsh web——浏览/编辑/校验/导入导出/AI 生成工艺，内置库只读、我的库可写，文件改动实时同步；agent 可通过 process_* 工具读工艺库、按工艺分阶段推进。

description.en: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.
description.zh: 定时任务：用 cron 表达式定时执行提示词，到点自动开一个新 agent 会话替你干活，支持绑定工作区、手动立即执行与会话自动命名。

description.en: Think tank: a built-in library of 161 classic mental models (decision/strategy/cognition/psychology/communication/learning/system/innovation/execution) — enter one question and several selected models analyze it in parallel via AI, producing a synthesized report with consensus, disagreements, blind spots and an action checklist; supports both automatic analysis and prompt round-trip import.
description.zh: 智囊团：内置 161 个经典思维模型库（决策/战略/认知/心理/沟通/学习/系统/创新/执行九大分类），输入一个问题即可用选中的多个模型并行 AI 分析，产出含共识/分歧/盲区/行动清单的综合报告页；支持自动分析与提示词往返导入两种模式。

description.en: Declares four agent presets (plan, work, code, review) that give each role its own tool matrix for a six-step multi-agent workflow.
description.zh: 声明 plan、work、code、review 四个 agent preset，为每个角色划定各自的工具集，服务一条六步多 Agent 工作流。

description.en: Adds twelve chain_* tools that turn a multi-agent role chain into a round state machine with one frozen baseline, per-signature failure counts, role-tagged evidence, blocking approval gates and one audit file per round; also adds a settings card that routes each role to its own model and thinking effort. Requires the sibling l1-presets bundle (plan/work/code/review) - without those presets every chain_* tool returns ROLE_DENIED.
description.zh: 新增十二个 chain_* 工具，把多 Agent 角色链变成轮次状态机：唯一冻结的基线、按签名累计的失败次数、按角色标注的证据、阻塞式审批门禁，以及每轮一份审计文件。另附设置页卡片，可为每个角色指定模型与思考深度。需同时安装同仓库的 l1-presets 包（plan/work/code/review 四个 preset），否则所有 chain_* 工具都会返回 ROLE_DENIED。

description.en: Windows only: a night-and-moon themed floating button (a sleepy DeepSeek-chan whale mascot, awake/sleeping artwork) in the bottom-right corner arms the plugin — click it to power the machine off once every root Agent session has gone idle, and click it again to disarm. The button is draggable (position remembered in localStorage), automatically dodges other plugins' corner popups, and survives the frontend re-rendering it away. When the batch finishes a 60 s cancellable countdown starts (configurable 10–600 s) with the remaining seconds on the button and a matching banner: clicking Cancel runs shutdown /a and disarms the mode, and any new session starting during the countdown aborts it. A right-click menu on the button switches the shutdown condition between only-on-success and shutdown-regardless, persisted across restarts in $DSH_HOME/deepseek-chan-sleep-shutdown.json. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：右下角一枚深夜月亮主题的悬浮按钮（会打瞌睡的 DeepSeek-chan 鲸鱼娘形象，清醒/睡觉两套图），点一下即开启——当所有 root 会话全部空闲后自动关机，再点一下关闭。按钮可拖动（位置记在 localStorage），会自动避让其他插件的角落弹窗，前端重渲染把它冲掉也会自动挂回。批次结束后进入 60 秒可取消倒计时（可设 10–600 秒），按钮上显示剩余秒数并弹出同款横幅：点「取消关机」执行 shutdown /a 并退出模式，倒计时期间任何新会话启动也会中止。按钮右键可在「仅成功时关机」与「无论成败都关机」之间切换，选择持久化在 $DSH_HOME/deepseek-chan-sleep-shutdown.json，DSH 重启后保持。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Task Runner mode for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent decomposes large tasks into independent subtasks, dispatches them to subagents (default local model) in fresh short contexts, and synthesizes results; concurrency and worker/orchestrator models are configurable in the settings panel.
description.zh: 任务拆解模式：主代理把大任务拆成独立子任务，派给子代理（默认本地模型）在全新短上下文中执行并综合结果；并发数与模型可在设置面板图形化配置。

plugins.name: dsh-round-table

description.en: Round-table meetings for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 on Windows desktop, reusing existing Agent sessions with discussion, editable task cards, sequential and parallel steps, shared meeting files, and secretary minutes.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 桌面版 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 的圆桌会议，复用已有 Agent 会话，提供讨论、可编辑任务卡、顺序与并行步骤、会议文件归档及秘书纪要。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Shared multi-agent task board (create/claim/transition/query) over a Cordis service key.
description.zh: 多 agent 共享任务板：经 Cordis service key 创建/认领/流转/查询任务。

description.en: Event-driven trigger plugin (the doorbell beside dsh-proactive's alarm clock): recursive fs watchers with per-rule debounce windows and glob filters, plus a loopback-only local webhook endpoint with per-rule tokens, fire rules that wake a target session through the host agents service - live sessions get a direct follow-up, cold ones are resumed first - and inject a rendered prompt with template variables (paths, count, payload). Rules hot-reload from the event-gate rules file without restarting DSH, every trigger appends to an auditable JSONL history queryable via the trigger_list and trigger_history tools, and a loopback health route reports install and runtime status. Typical uses: auto-organizing a downloads folder, diagnosing CI or monitoring alarms posted from local scripts, and watching logs for errors. Pure JS, no build step, MIT.
description.zh: 事件驱动触发器插件（dsh-proactive 闹钟旁的门铃）：递归目录监视按规则防抖合并并支持 glob 过滤，本机回环 webhook 端点按规则 token 鉴权；规则命中后经宿主 agents 服务唤醒目标会话（活会话直接投递，冷会话先恢复再投递），并注入渲染后的 prompt（支持 paths、count、payload 模板变量）。规则文件保存即热更新，无需重启 DSH；每次触发追加 JSONL 审计历史，可通过 trigger_list / trigger_history 工具查询；另提供回环 health 路由报告安装与运行状态。典型用途：下载目录自动整理、CI/监控报警自动诊断、日志错误自动定位。纯 JS 免构建，MIT。

description.en: Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped to the current session.
description.zh: 多候选模式插件（test-time scaling）：悬浮球面板配置，模型对任务自动执行并行候选加验证选优，仅当前会话生效。

description.en: Runs a second agent: hands independent subtasks to a local Codex CLI in parallel (up to three at a time), and asks it to review a design or a plan before the user sees it, returning conclusion, evidence, counterexamples and a verification step. A dispatch missing its timeout or its acceptance check is rejected by the plugin, not by the model remembering to check.
description.zh: 双 agent 协作：把互不依赖的子任务并行交给本机 Codex（同时最多三路），并在方案交给你看之前先让它盲审一轮，必须回「结论 / 证据 / 反例 / 验证方式」四段；缺超时或缺验收判据的派活会被插件当场拒绝，不靠模型自己记得。

description.en: Luna preset for DeepSeek Harness — a little-demon persona on the full standard tool set, composed by six deterministic rule layers (perception, understanding, state, style, regulation, memory) plus a derived vitals layer, with a gated, suppressible cross-session memory file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的露娜预设：小恶魔人设配完整的 standard 工具面，由感知、理解、状态、表达、调节、记忆六层确定性规则驱动，外加生理派生层；跨会话记忆写入经证据门控，遗忘用抑制而非删除。

description.en: Auto-send every DSH turn result to WeChat: listens for task completion, extracts the final assistant message and pushes it raw via the WeChat iLink bot (real delivery check, never fake success). Requires the wechat-acp daemon, a separately installed process you log into WeChat with.
description.zh: DSH 会话任务结束后自动把结果原文推送到微信（iLink 直发，真实校验送达，失败如实报错）。需配置 wechat-acp 守护进程——一个需要另外安装并扫码登录微信的独立进程。

description.en: Thesis and empirical-analysis workbench that drives IBM SPSS from the conversation: spss_check (environment self-check), spss_variables (list .sav variables with labels, types, measurement levels, case counts), spss_data (sample case rows to inspect missing and outlying values), spss_run / spss_run_file (execute SPSS syntax or an .sps file, relative CD and GET FILE paths auto-rebased), and spss_analyze (one-shot frequencies, descriptives, crosstabs with chi-square, t-tests, one-way ANOVA, correlation, linear regression). Results come back as structured tables extracted through OMS. SPSS 25-31 is auto-detected; the bundled MCP server is zero-dependency stdio.
description.zh: 论文/实证分析工作台：在对话里直接驱动 IBM SPSS。spss_check（环境自检）、spss_variables（列出 .sav 变量：名称/标签/类型/测度水平/案例数）、spss_data（抽查案例数据，检查缺失与异常值）、spss_run 与 spss_run_file（执行 SPSS 语法或 .sps 文件，自动修正 CD / GET FILE 相对路径）、spss_analyze（一键跑频数、描述统计、交叉表卡方、t 检验、单因素方差、相关、线性回归）。结果经 OMS 导出为结构化表格。自动探测 SPSS 25-31；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 服务。

description.en: Task-list staleness guard for DeepSeek Harness: watches the session event stream and counts tool calls since the last todo_write; past a configurable threshold it appends one short notice before the next step, quoting the current list, so the model writes it back to the real progress instead of leaving a stale snapshot on screen. Pure prompt injection, no blocking and no data mutation.
description.zh: 任务清单陈旧度守卫：监听会话事件流，统计上一次 todo_write 之后又发生了多少次工具调用；超过可配置阈值时在下一步之前追加一条简短提醒，并附上当前清单内容，让模型把清单写回真实进度，而不是在界面上留一份过期的快照。纯提示注入，不阻断流程，也不改动任何数据。

description.en: Maintains reusable named subagent profiles for DeepSeek Harness and runs them with per-profile model, reasoning effort, and agent-preset settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 维护可复用的命名子代理配置，并按配置的模型、推理强度和 Agent 预设运行子代理。

description.en: Registers one tool, report_health, that answers whether a scheduled report job actually ran. It judges by side effects rather than exit codes: how old the newest report folder is, how many documents it holds, whether more than one report category is present, whether the audit ledger was synced recently, and how long ago the last log was written. Exits nothing, calls no model, and reads only local paths you can override by config or environment variable.
description.zh: 只注册一个工具 report_health，回答「定时报告任务到底跑了没有」。它看副作用而不是退出码：最新报告目录有多旧、里面有几份文档、是否不止一个类别、审计账本上次同步是多久前、最后一条日志写了多久。不调用模型、不产生退出码，只读本地路径，可用配置或环境变量覆盖。

description.en: Settings page for agent modes (presets): switch up to 15 capabilities per mode (commands, files or read-only files, web, subagents, and more) or individual plugin rows; edit each mode's system prompt with variable checks, a full preview, version history, optional live updates for running sessions, and an approval-gated mode_prompt chat tool; create modes from four starter templates or copies; merge built-in updates after a dsh upgrade while keeping your changes, and turn off rows that fail to load.
description.zh: Agent 模式（预设）设置页：按模式开关最多 15 项能力（运行命令、读写或只读文件、网页、子代理等），也能逐个开关插件；编辑每个模式的系统提示词，带变量校验、完整预览和历史版本，可选让正在运行的会话即时生效，并提供每次保存都需审批的对话内修改工具 mode_prompt；用四个起步模板或复制现有模式新建模式；dsh 升级后合并内置更新并保留你的修改，一键关闭加载失败的插件。

description.en: Recursive delegation for dsh agent trees: a preset plus Host limits bound what each subagent may do, subagents work in separate _agents/ workspaces, and the parent decides which results to integrate.
description.zh: dsh agent 树的递归委派：用预设与 Host 限制划定每个子 agent 的能力边界，子 agent 在各自 _agents/ 工作区独立工作，成果由父 agent 决定是否合并、如何合并。

description.en: Card-based task orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: splits work into cards, dispatches and monitors tasks, handles stalls, verifies results, and adopts work conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供卡片任务编排：拆分任务、派单盯办、处理卡顿、核对结果，并接管工作对话。

description.en: Project autopilot for DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3, with scoped authorization, independent verification, editable memories and companion chat, including automatic installation of the compatible desktop pet fork. The bundled pet is a fork of takboo/dsh-coopanion (AGPL-3.0-or-later); do not install the upstream pet alongside it.
description.zh: 支持 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、0.2.1-rc.3，提供范围授权、独立验收、可编辑记忆和伙伴聊天的项目自动推进插件，自动安装配套桌宠 fork。配套桌宠是 takboo/dsh-coopanion 的 fork（AGPL-3.0-or-later），不能与上游桌宠同装。

description.en: Lead-mode agent preset plus two runtime skills for the official Agent Teams runtime: a delegate-wait-verify working method, and a wrap-up digest that merges several members' output into one file. Ships no team runtime of its own.
description.zh: 给官方 Agent Teams 运行时配的 Lead 模式预设与两个 runtime skill：一套拆活、派活、验收的工作法，以及收尾时把多个成员产出合并成一份文件的团队汇总。本身不带 Team 运行时。

description.en: Adds subagent_route and subagent_fork_route delegation tools where the model itself picks the provider/model route for each child; the deployment only sets the spawn/fork backend, background policy and allowedProviders allowlist, while continuable children and background jobs reuse the official send_message / job_output tools.
description.zh: 新增 subagent_route 与 subagent_fork_route 委托工具：由模型自主为子代理挑选 provider/model 路由，部署方仅配置 spawn/fork 后端、调度策略与 allowedProviders 白名单；续聊子代理与后台任务复用官方 send_message / job_output 工具。

description.en: Extends the composer model selector menu with a third Context window row, preset capacities (64K–2M), custom input, provider-wide sync, and adaptive compaction guard.
description.zh: 在底部聊天输入框的模型选择弹窗中扩展第三行【上下文窗口】，支持 64K~2M 档位切换、自定义容量输入、提供商批量同步与自适应压缩防失败守卫。

description.en: Registers native doubao_generate_image and doubao_image_status Agent tools to automate Doubao Web (doubao.com) via Tabbit Browser, automatically extracting watermark-free 2.7K wm0 original images into local files and multimodal chat attachments.
description.zh: 豆包网页生图 Agent 原生工具插件：向 Agent 注册 doubao_generate_image 与 doubao_image_status 工具，通过 Tabbit 操控 doubao.com 提交生图提示词、选择比例与风格，自动优选 2.7K wm0 无水印超清原图落盘并注入对话附件。

description.en: Milestone progress soft-enforcement guard: injects persistent system-prompt rules and post-execute notices when tool calls omit visible progress text, with a Web settings form.
description.zh: 阶段性结论软强制守卫：常驻注入系统提示词规范，并在模型调用工具漏发可见结论时自动附加软强制纠偏提醒，支持 Web 设置表单。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks for DSH: block or observe tool calls, and react to completed turns, messages, and title changes with shell commands.
description.zh: 配置驱动的 DSH 生命周期 hooks：拦截或观察工具调用，并对回合完成、用户消息和标题变化执行 shell 命令。

description.en: Convert Office documents and PDFs (including scanned ones) to structurally formatted Markdown via a CPU-first routing OCR pipeline (RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet).
description.zh: 将 Office 文档与 PDF（含扫描件）转换为保留结构的 Markdown，采用 CPU 优先的路由 OCR 流水线（RapidOCR/SLANet/FormulaNet）。

description.en: Role-based multi-agent team for DeepSeek Harness — your digital workforce. One goal assembles a team of product, architect, frontend, backend, reviewer and QA roles that deliver through a nine-phase gated pipeline, plus a persistent team you can keep directing across sessions. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
description.zh: 角色化多智能体专家团 = 你的数字员工。一句目标即自动组建最多 12 个角色（产品、架构、前端、后端、审查、测试等），按九阶段门控流水线协作交付，并支持常驻团队反复指挥。零运行时依赖、无构建步骤。

description.en: Cron task scheduler for DSH: on schedule, automatically creates a new session and injects your prompt as its first message, with task history and manual run/stop controls. Also runs KNJ workflows: pick files directly (stored as persistent snapshots, re-handed to the workflow on every fire) or reference them by path. Its sidebar entry is provided by dsh-knj-menu; install together: dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu.
description.zh: 定时任务调度器：按 Cron 表达式到点自动新建 DSH 会话并注入提示词执行，支持任务历史、手动运行与启停。也可直接调用 KNJ 工作流：支持直接选文件（持久化快照，每次触发重新交给流程）与按路径引用两种方式。侧边栏入口由 dsh-knj-menu 提供，一条命令安装：dsh plugin add dsh-scheduler dsh-knj-menu。

description.en: Config-driven development-task orchestration for DSH: graph workflows (task/gateway/human nodes) with per-stage persistence, plus an in-editor AI assistant that configures workflows through conversation with live validation. Hand documents to nodes as generic attachments (no declaration needed): files land in the task workspace and ${inputs.附件} gives the newline-joined absolute paths, so a node parses them with its own prompt.
description.zh: 配置驱动的工作流与开发任务编排：图式工作流（任务/网关/人工审批节点）+ 阶段级断点持久化，内置 AI 助手在图编辑器中通过对话配置工作流，逐条校验实时应用到画布。把文档作为「通用附件」交给节点（无需声明）：文件启动前落到工作区，节点用 ${inputs.附件} 拿到换行拼接的绝对路径自行解析。

description.en: Publish articles to CSDN / Juejin / CNBlog directly from the session, no external server.
description.zh: 会话内直接发布文章到 CSDN / 掘金 / 博客园，无外部服务。

description.en: Cron/one-shot scheduled tasks: run shell commands or fire webhooks on a schedule, with optional ServerChan/DingTalk/Feishu/webhook delivery of results.
description.zh: cron / 一次性定时任务：按调度执行 shell 命令或投递 webhook，结果可推送到 ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

description.en: Antigravity-style run_command for DSH: short commands return inline within a configurable wait window (default 10s) while longer ones auto-promote into ctx.jobs for later collection and completion notices — executed via ctx.shell under the session sandbox and approval pipeline.
description.zh: Antigravity 式 run_command：短命令在可配置窗口（默认 10 秒）内同步返回结果，长命令自动晋升为 ctx.jobs 后台任务并推送完成通知——命令经 ctx.shell 执行，受会话沙箱与审批管线约束。

description.en: Agent Teams roster plugin: newest-first ordering for the roster, task board and subagent catalog, plus bulk cleanup and teammate rename/delete.
description.zh: Agent Teams 名册插件：名册、任务板与子智能体目录倒序显示（最新在最上），并提供批量清理与成员改名/删除。

description.en: Export and import DeepSeek Harness configuration across machines as same-OS .dshmig archives, with credential redaction, verification and rollback.
description.zh: 迁移 DSH 配置：跨机器导出/导入 .dshmig 归档（同 OS、新建 profile、凭据脱敏、校验与回滚）。

description.en: Whole-book translation production line for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic chapter detection and segmentation, per-chapter subagent translation, glossary control, full-book review, targeted revision, and auditable meta.json evidence.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 整本书翻译生产线：确定性章节识别与分段、子代理逐章翻译、术语表控制、全书审查、定向修订，以及可审计的 meta.json 证据链。

description.en: A shared todo list for DeepSeek Harness: you and your agent manage the same tasks from a sidebar page or todo tools, with per-project and global todos, and one-click task references into the composer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的人机共享待办：你和 AI 通过侧边栏或待办工具管理同一份任务，支持项目级与全局待办，并可一键把任务引用进输入框。

description.en: Windows-only: per-session auto-shutdown switch in the session header — once every armed session has no turn, job or subagent still running (by default every other live session must be idle too), a two-minute countdown starts and the machine powers off; clicking the countdown cancels it, and sessions without the switch never start one.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：会话标题栏上的「任务完成后自动关机」开关——所有开启它的会话都不再有进行中的回合、任务或子代理（默认还要求其他在线会话也空闲）时，开始两分钟倒计时，结束后关机；点倒计时即取消，没开这个开关的会话不会触发任何动作。

description.en: Cursor-style mode switching for the dsh web UI: plan mode with a delegation gate, multitask mode with a tool-call quota, and the create_plan / request_more_edits / list_running_agent tools. Adds a plan card with Build buttons and compacts the subagent dropdown to running rows.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页端提供类 Cursor 的模式切换：带委派闸门的计划模式、带工具调用配额的多任务模式，以及 create_plan / request_more_edits / list_running_agent 三个工具。另有带 Build 按钮的计划卡片，并把子代理下拉收成只显示运行中的行。

description.en: Local kanban boards shared by people, DSH sessions and optional DS Bot, with role permissions, change history and explicit task completion.
description.zh: 人、DSH 会话与可选 DS Bot 共用的本地看板，提供角色权限、变更记录和明确的任务完成操作。

description.en: Delivery workflow preset for DeepSeek Harness: an agent protocol plus seven tools that keep user requests verbatim, record feedback decisions, plan tasks with acceptance criteria, log real verification commands and exit codes, and write completion summaries as per-project JSONL files.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的研发交付工作流 preset：一段工作协议加七个工具，保留用户原话与验收条件、记录反馈决策、拆解带验收的任务、记录真实验证命令与退出码，并以项目隔离的 JSONL 记录完成总结。

description.en: Two DSH delegation presets — a fixed 8-seat crew, or up to 3 day-rate temps by convention — with call-time guards that refuse the other shape's delegation tools. The 8-seat preset additionally needs @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile in the profile's dsh.profile.bundles; without it that preset has no team tools and degrades to solo work.
description.zh: 给 DSH 装两条干活形态——8 个固定工位的终身奴，或按约定一次最多点 3 个的日结奴；跨形态调用会在调用时被 guard 拒绝。8 工位形态还需在 profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里挂 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile，否则该形态没有 Team 工具、会降级为单人作业。

plugins.name: dsh-nexus

description.en: Personal coding assistant that schedules, follows up on and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks from DSH, with WeChat, WeCom and Feishu remote channels.
description.zh: 个人编码助理：在 DSH 中安排、跟进与验收本机 Codex 或 Claude Code 任务，并提供微信、企业微信与飞书远程渠道。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Lets the agent start a conversation on its own, using a local dice roll on a set interval to decide whether to speak into a chosen session, with quiet hours and a dry-run mode.
description.zh: 让 AI 伙伴自己起个话头：按设定间隔掷一次本地骰子决定要不要往指定会话里说话，带安静时段与试运行。

plugins.name: DSH-Feedback-Bridge

description.en: Turns DSH conversations into reviewable community feedback and, after confirmation, submits it to the official DeepSeek Harness Discussions.
description.zh: 将 DSH 对话整理为可审阅的社区反馈，并在确认后提交到 DeepSeek Harness 官方 Discussions。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: AI Company Framework: turn one sentence into a multi-agent company — 15 flat Skills (boss/pipeline/role-template/11 roles/generic customer-memory), 7 workflow templates, AgentTeams runtime + activity panel, employee sidebar with per-session isolation, Feishu bot bridge (boss and per-employee bots, group routing, autonomous push, human decision gate, external-contact guide), per-customer SQLite memory with three-layer memory (cross-group merge), /company mode switch; no RAG.
description.zh: AI 公司框架：一句话开一家多 Agent 公司——15 个扁平 Skills（老板/流水线/岗位模板/11 个岗位/通用客户记忆）、7 个工作流模板、AgentTeams 运行时与活动面板、带会话隔离的员工侧边栏、飞书机器人桥（老板/任意员工机器人、群聊路由、自主推送、重大决策人工闸门、外部联系人指引）、客户档案 SQLite 数据库与三层记忆（跨群归并）、/company 公司模式开关；不含 RAG。

description.en: AlphaRSI — three-role self-improvement loop that evolves the training recipe of alpha sequence models. Operator runs walk-forward, Evaluator grades with OOS RankIC, Refiner proposes hyperparameters via TPE Bayesian search; only strictly-better recipes are kept. Offline one-command run, data bundle shipped with sha1 reconciliation, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.
description.zh: AlphaRSI——三角色自改进闭环，进化 alpha 序列模型的训练配方。Operator 跑 walk-forward、Evaluator 用 OOS RankIC 验收、Refiner 用 TPE 贝叶斯搜索提议超参，只保留严格更优。离线一条命令跑，数据包 sha1 对账分发，GPU 自动走 CUDA。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Training attestation — reproducible, attributable, auditable off-site standardized training for asset pricing. Hard-gates four failure modes (half-refresh, hash mismatch, unknown-read-as-pass, master pollution). Ships one skill.
description.zh: 训练鉴证——把资产定价的异地标准化训练钉成可复算、可归因、可审计的裁决链，四道闸硬拦（半拉子刷新、账物不符、判不了当通过、污染母本）。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Model training stage — end-to-end analysis, model training, and estimation for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 模型训练与结论阶段——资产定价与机器学习研究的端到端分析、模型训练与估计。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Data stage — data discovery and quality assessment for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 数据处理阶段——资产定价与机器学习研究的数据发现与质量评估。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Literature review stage — search, synthesis, and citation-chain tracking for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 文献综述阶段——资产定价与机器学习研究的文献检索、合成与引用链追踪。附带一个 skill。

description.en: PPT stage — presentation generation (Beamer/Quarto) from the paper for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 报告阶段（PPT）——资产定价与机器学习研究的论文演讲幻灯片生成（Beamer/Quarto）。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Report stage — academic paper writing for asset pricing and machine learning research. Ships one skill.
description.zh: 报告阶段（文稿）——资产定价与机器学习研究的学术论文写作。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Zagent — unified three-role self-improvement loop with three operators. Data-RSI (daily cross-sectional cleaning: winsorize → cross-sectional standardization → median fill, plus experience extraction), Harness-RSI (evolves system prompt / memory / skills), and Model-RSI (evolves alpha training recipes via framework-native walk-forward with 2-day gap and multi-seed). Offline one-command run, GPU auto-detect. Ships one skill.
description.zh: Zagent——统一 RSI 三角色自改进闭环框架，三个算子：Data-RSI（逐日截面清洗：去极值→截面驻日标准化→中位数填充，加经验提取）、Harness-RSI（进化系统提示词/记忆/技能）、Model-RSI（进化 alpha 训练配方，框架内置 walk-forward，含 2 天空白与多 seed）。离线一条命令跑，GPU 自动走 CUDA。附带一个 skill。

description.en: Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.
description.zh: 给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。

description.en: Google Antigravity CLI (agy) as a DSH product subagent: delegate tasks to a Gemini coding agent with your Antigravity login (no API key), with conversation follow-ups, background streaming progress, image analysis by path, and a pop-up login window.
description.zh: 把 Google Antigravity CLI（agy）接入 DSH 作为产品子代理：用 Antigravity 登录态（无需 API key）委托 Gemini 编程智能体干活，支持对话续聊、后台流式进度、按路径识图与自动弹出登录窗口。

description.en: Bot Mode for DeepSeek Harness: a roster of named bots with avatars, personas and per-bot chats, each backed by one durable continuable subagent session that keeps memory across turns.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Bot 模式：把子 Agent 变成一群有头像、有人格的 Bot，每个 Bot 拥有独立对话，由一个持久的 continuable 子 Agent 会话支撑，跨轮次保留记忆。

description.en: Chinese multi-agent workflow with per-role model fallback, versioned Mermaid task plans, independent Agent and Jev reviews, persistent expert collaboration, and pure-function calculation tools.
description.zh: 中文多智能体工作流，支持按角色配置模型回退、版本化 Mermaid 任务规划、独立 Agent 与 Jev 审核、专家持久化协作和纯函数计算工具。

description.en: Agent state machine plugin with a todo ledger, stall guard, phase trails and a process-isolated per-step Python worker with GUI automation lanes. Windows only; needs Python 3.10+ on PATH, and pyautogui, mss and pywinauto for the GUI lanes.
description.zh: 智能体状态机插件：任务台账、停滞熔断、相位轨迹与进程隔离的步级 Python 执行器，带 GUI 自动化车道。仅限 Windows；需 PATH 中有 Python 3.10+，GUI 车道另需 pyautogui、mss、pywinauto。

description.en: Policy-driven Git sync for DSH settings and profile configuration, with secret-aware projections, conflict review, and per-line apply controls.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 设置与 Profile 配置的策略化 Git 同步，支持敏感信息隔离、冲突审阅与按行选择应用。

description.en: Four Chinese agent presets in one plugin, Standard, PTC, Minimal and Creation (standard-zh, ptc-zh, minimal-zh, cordis-zh), each keeping the matching built-in tool set; Standard, PTC and Creation translate known host instructions into Chinese while tool IDs, schemas and SDK declarations stay unchanged; a settings page enables each mode and edits its name, description and system prompt.
description.zh: 一个插件提供四种中文 Agent 预设：中文标准、中文 PTC、中文极简、中文创造（standard-zh / ptc-zh / minimal-zh / cordis-zh），沿用对应内置模式的工具组合；标准、PTC 与创造模式将已知宿主说明汉化，工具 ID、schema 与 SDK 声明保持原样；设置页可逐个启停模式并编辑显示名称、描述与系统提示词。
