description.en: Programming Mode agent preset bundle: the standard coding agent with its persona mandating the Superpowers discipline (skills first, brainstorming before building, plans before code, TDD, systematic debugging, verification before completion) plus an always-on Ponytail code-volume discipline (7-rung minimal-code ladder, default full); ships all twenty skills bundled (14 superpowers + 6 ponytail) and mechanically injects the full using-superpowers skill into every new session's first request.
description.zh: 编程模式 agent preset 组合包：标准编码 Agent 强制执行 Superpowers 工程纪律（技能优先、先头脑风暴、先计划后编码、TDD、系统化调试、完成前验证），并常驻 Ponytail 代码量纪律（7 级最小化阶梯，默认 full）；内置全部 20 个技能（14 superpowers + 6 ponytail），并在每个新会话的第一条请求前自动注入 using-superpowers 技能全文。

description.en: Task workspace convention: one folder per session, one PROGRESS.md per task overwritten on each update, and per-task git once the task runs long.
description.zh: 任务工作区约定：一个会话只用一个文件夹，一个任务一个 PROGRESS.md（每次修改整体覆盖更新），任务过长就在任务目录里建 git 仓库。

description.en: Turns a stated rule into a checkable intake card and writes it into the right AGENTS.md, and keeps project plans, a rule ledger, project records, handoffs, a change log and a timeline.
description.zh: 把一句话的要求做成可核对的规则卡并写进对应的 AGENTS.md，同时统管项目档案、计划、交接、改动账本与时间线。

description.en: Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code or Codex: native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge for vision and image generation.
description.zh: 从 Claude Code / Codex 派发任务给 DSH Agent：原生子代理进度、按能力分层预设的宿主内工作会话，以及为纯文本 Harness 提供视觉与图像生成的多模态桥。

description.en: Persistent personal todos shared across DeepSeek Harness sessions and projects: SQLite storage, Agent tools, a native sidebar and turn-tail cards, with user-managed workflows or optional dispatch of individual todos to Agent sessions.
description.zh: 跨 DeepSeek Harness 会话与项目共享的持久个人待办：使用 SQLite 存储，提供 Agent 工具、原生侧栏与对话尾部卡片，既可由用户自行管理，也可按需将单条待办交给 Agent 会话执行。

description.en: Per-target scheduled wake-ups for a DSH workspace: interval, quiet hours, daily cap and a prompt per target; each wake-up waits for the turn it started and records the outcome, and a turn that never finished is not counted as done.
description.zh: 给 DSH 工作区按目标定时唤醒：每个目标可设间隔、安静时段、每日上限和提示词；每次唤醒会等它自己那一轮结束并记下结果，没跑完的那一轮不会算作完成。

description.en: Task planning with experience muscle-memory: condition-reflex recall of past solutions, LLM capability matching, and auto-persisted lessons.
description.zh: 带经验肌肉记忆的任务规划：条件反射检索历史方案 + LLM 能力匹配 + 经验自动沉淀。

description.en: In-conversation workflow run timeline for DSH Web: a horizontal rail with phase stations, agent pills, loop arcs and parallel bands replaces the stock workflow tool card and workflow-run chat node. Planned stations render before the run starts via client-side script scanning; status dots and icons follow DSH official primitives.
description.zh: 对话内工作流运行时间线：横向轨道 + 阶段站 + 子代理药丸 + 循环弧线 + 并行带，替换官方 workflow 工具卡与 workflow-run 聊天节点。客户端脚本扫描让计划站在开跑前全部渲染；状态点与图标对齐 DSH 官方 primitives。

description.en: System-1 decision guard for DeepSeek Harness, 4 questions asked before tool calling (risk reversible, relevance, injection suspension) and allow/ask/reject action. Needs an API key for a system-one compatible provider; decision requests are sent there.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 System-1 决策守卫：在每次工具调用前问模型四个问题 （风险、可逆性、任务相关性、注入嫌疑），据此放行、询问或拦截。

description.en: By default, blocks marking a team task complete without a passed independent verification record whose commit matches the worktree HEAD, and adds a dependency DAG board and a settings page.
description.zh: 默认拦截缺少「验收通过」独立记录、或验收提交与 worktree HEAD 不一致的团队任务完成操作，并提供依赖 DAG 看板与设置页。

description.en: Peer-to-peer colleague-agent consultation for DSH: ask one or several configured peers, queue asynchronous questions, discover peers through signed friend cards, and review inbound requests in the Web UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的点对点同事 Agent 咨询：可向单个或多个已配置 Peer 提问、异步排队问题、通过签名 Friend Card 推荐发现 Peer，并在 Web UI 审批入站请求。

description.en: Floating commit panel for the DSH web UI: it appears when the current session workspace has unstaged or untracked changes, takes a hand-written or AI-drafted commit message (AI drafts follow Conventional Commit), and commits or commits and pushes. Works in the DSH web UI and CLI only; the desktop app cannot install it.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的悬浮提交面板：当前对话所在工作区出现未暂存或未跟踪改动时浮出，提交信息可手写或由 AI 起草（AI 起草按 Conventional Commit 生成），支持提交与提交并推送。仅支持 DSH Web / CLI，桌面版无法安装。

description.en: Checks git commit messages against the 7DGroup convention (Chinese type tags, length and punctuation rules) before committing, as a client-side guard before GitLab pre-receive hooks.
description.zh: 提交前按 7DGroup 规范校验 git commit message（中文类型标签、长度与标点规则），作为 GitLab pre-receive 钩子的客户端前置校验。

description.en: Pending-change review for DeepSeek Harness: every `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` change is collected automatically into the file list, where a single change block, the blocks within a selection, or the whole file can be kept or reverted, and undo/redo is supported. It imports the workspace's version-control changes, shows the diff in a single-column or side-by-side view, and provides a Markdown preview in which changes can also be kept or reverted, in-file search, block jumping and copyable line references; the diff data is stored persistently, so the review continues after a restart.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的待处理改动审查：每次 edit/write/str_replace_editor 改动都会自动汇总到文件列表，可对单个差异块、选区内的多块或整个文件执行保留/回退，支持撤销重做。还能导入工作区的版本控制改动，以单栏或左右对照视图展示差异，并提供亦能保留/回退差异的 Markdown 预览、文件内搜索、差异块跳转与可复制的行号引用；差异数据持久化存储，重启后可继续审查。

plugins.name: harness-github

description.en: DSH GitHub connector: review PRs, triage issues, debug CI, prepare changes (18 tools, gh-first + REST fallback, approval-gated writes).
description.zh: DSH GitHub 连接器:检查 PR、分诊 issue、调试 CI、准备代码变更(18 个工具,gh 优先 + REST 回退,写操作人工审批)。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection.
description.zh: Git 侧边栏面板：提交图谱、超前/落后跟踪、分支操作及改动 Diff 一键带入对话。

description.en: Right-sidebar page for DSH that draws the current session's repository as a VS Code-style commit graph - colored branch/merge lanes, ref chips and per-commit details - with a working-tree Changes area above it (staged/unstaged sections with inline diffs) for every working tree of the repository; read-only, works with or without dsh-better-sidebar, and follows the session's worktree label when dsh-session-worktree is installed.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏页：把当前会话的仓库画成 VS Code 风格的分支/合并提交图谱（彩色泳道、ref 徽章、提交详情），上方带工作区 Changes 区（staged/unstaged 分节、行内 diff），覆盖仓库的每个工作树；只读，装不装 dsh-better-sidebar 都能用，装了 dsh-session-worktree 时跟随会话的 worktree 标签。

description.en: Pre-submit pull-request hygiene checks inside DeepSeek Harness: scans the current diff for TODO leftovers, hardcoded secrets, and non-conventional commit subjects.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内做提交前的 Pull Request 卫生检查：扫描当前改动中的 TODO 残留、硬编码密钥与非规范提交信息。

description.en: Git panel in the right sidebar plus fifteen agent tools: editor-style diffs, a commit graph across every branch, staging and committing, branch, stash and remote operations, and model-assisted commit messages, pre-commit review and commit splitting.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 Git 面板与十五个 Agent 工具：编辑器式的差异、覆盖全部分支的提交图、暂存与提交、分支与贮藏与远程操作，以及由模型协助的提交说明、提交前审阅和拆分提交方案。

description.en: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
description.zh: 极简 worktree 管理方案，只有一个按钮和一个弹窗。

description.en: GitHub account management plus a local Git workflow for the web GUI with clone, fast-forward pull, status, commit, push, and host-side push guards.
description.zh: Web GUI 的 GitHub 账号与本地 Git 工作流插件，支持 clone、快进 pull、status、commit、push，推送默认关闭并有宿主侧开关保护。

plugins.name: dsh-github-router

description.en: Read-only GitHub access for agents, wrapping several tools. Inside the tool it automatically probes and selects whichever GitHub access method works locally, and tries network proxies on its own. That cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitHub, and the overhead of it repeatedly trying different approaches.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的只读 GitHub 访问，封装多个工具。在工具内部自动探测与选择本地可用的 GitHub 访问设施，并自动尝试网络代理。减少 Agent 在访问 GitHub 时可能遇到的网络问题或解析问题，减少 Agent 频繁尝试不同方案的开销。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A code review workflow that reviews uncommitted changes, changes against a base branch, a single commit, a GitHub pull request, or a file.
description.zh: 一种代码审查工作流，用于审查未提交的更改、相对于基础分支的更改、单个提交、GitHub Pull Request 或某个文件。

description.en: Review code with Open Code Review: deterministic scope and rule resolution, judged by your own DSH model, no API key.
description.zh: 用 Open Code Review 评审代码：确定性的范围与规则解析，由你自己的 DSH 模型判断，无需 API Key。

description.en: A Git graph plugin for DSH: repository tree and SVG lane history (curves, merge diamonds, ref badges, terminus notches, export) in a dsh-better-sidebar tab, plus conventions that reach the model - seven built-in frameworks (or your own templates, hidden built-ins), injected into every model step and checked against the last 20 commits. Shares the /git prefix with the upstream plugin, so pick one.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 图谱插件：better-sidebar 里看多仓库提交图（泳道、合并菱形、短槽、导出），七套内置规范（可自建、可隐藏）注入每个模型步骤并体检最近 20 条提交。与上游同占 /git 前缀，二选一。

description.en: Fork and delete buttons on each workspace row of the Harness sidebar, plus a /fork-worktree command: fork creates a git worktree and registers it as a new workspace, delete removes the workspace folder through git worktree remove (asking again before discarding uncommitted work) and drops the registration.
description.zh: 在 Harness 侧边栏的每个工作区行加 fork 与删除按钮，并提供 /fork-worktree 命令：fork 创建 git worktree 并注册为新工作区，删除通过 git worktree remove 移除工作区文件夹（丢弃未提交内容前会再确认一次）并移除工作区登记。

description.en: Codex-style review of session file changes: per-turn cards (optionally taking over the shell edited cards) whose totals are the turn net diff, a review tab with syntax-highlighted diffs that never wrap, real line numbers, open-at-line and a draggable split, a hover preview of the whole file with three lines of context around each change, one-click per-turn revert, and the on-disk record size with a clear button in the review toolbar. Records are sharded per session, with content-addressed snapshot blobs that dedupe and are garbage collected. Light/dark presets follow the DSH theme, typography follows DSH and installed skins (or any font on the machine, with a px stepper), and a settings switch injects a think-in-Simplified-Chinese rule into the global AGENTS.md.
description.zh: Codex 风格的会话文件修改审查：每轮变更卡片（可接管 shell 的 edited 卡片），统计口径为本轮净差异；审查 tab 的 diff 不自动换行、真实行号、按行打开、可拖拽分栏；悬停预览显示整文件差异（每处改动前后 3 行上下文）；按轮一键撤回；工具条显示记录占用并可一键清空。记录按会话分片存储，快照用内容寻址 blob 去重并自动 GC。深浅两套配色跟随 DSH 主题，字体跟随 DSH 与已装皮肤（也可选机器上的任意字体并微调字号）；设置里可把「用简体中文思考」规则注入全局 AGENTS.md。

description.en: Sidebar Git panel for the DSH web GUI: Local Changes and All Commits views, branch, tag and stash management with fetch, pull and push dialogs, merge with conflict handling, and a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar.
description.zh: DSH 网页端的侧栏 Git 面板：Local Changes 与 All Commits 视图，分支、标签与 Stash 管理，fetch、pull、push 弹窗，带冲突处理的合并，以及输入框上的 zsh 风格分支标记。

description.en: Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生交互式 Git diff 审查，支持结构化批注并回传当前 Agent 会话。

description.en: GitLab panel in the DSH right sidebar: commit graph, branches, changes, merge requests (inline diffs, review submission, pipelines), issues, and agent tools with an approval queue for triage and batch actions. GitLab data needs a personal access token or a logged-in `glab`; local git data works without either.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 GitLab 面板：提交图、分支、变更、合并请求（行内 diff、提交评审、流水线）、议题，以及带审批队列的 Agent 工具用于分诊与批量操作。GitLab 数据需要 Personal Access Token 或已登录的 `glab`；本地 git 数据无需凭据。

description.en: Git tab in the DSH web UI right sidebar for the current session repository — switches branches from a dropdown of local and remote branches (with ahead/behind counts), stages files in staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted groups, commits, fetches, pulls and pushes with automatic upstream setup, drafts a Conventional Commits message from the staged diff with the default model and falls back to a plain chore message when none is available, and renders git log --graph with per-branch colors plus a word-level highlighted diff.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧边栏的 Git tab，跟随当前会话的仓库：下拉切换本地/远程分支（带 ahead/behind），按 staged/unstaged/untracked/conflicted 分组暂存，提交、fetch、pull、push（无 upstream 时自动建跟踪分支），用默认模型按已暂存 diff 起草约定式提交信息（模型不可用时降级为普通 chore 文案），并以每条分支一种颜色的形式渲染 git log --graph 和词级高亮的 diff。

description.en: Adds a Worktree view to DSH Web UI that groups Sessions by Git worktree while keeping DSH as the source of truth.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 增加按 Git Worktree 组织 Session 的视角，同时继续由 DSH 管理原始 Project 和 Session 数据。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-git

description.en: Git service plus right-sidebar UI — a Changes tab (stage/unstage, per-file diffs, commit/amend, push and rebase-then-push sync, confirmed discard), a paged canvas commit-graph tab, a Worktrees tab to list, enter and create checkouts, a composer branch selector, and opt-in LLM commit-message generation.
description.zh: Git 服务 + 右侧边栏 UI：Changes 页（暂存/取消暂存、逐文件 diff、提交/修补、推送与 rebase 同步、二次确认的丢弃）、分页 canvas 提交图谱页、Worktrees 页（列出/进入/新建工作树）、输入框旁分支选择器，以及可选的 LLM 提交信息生成。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Session change-review plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tracks write/edit tool calls per session and renders line-level diffs with customizable colors, with session isolation, subagent aggregation, and SSE live updates.
description.zh: 会话修改审查插件：追踪会话内 write/edit 工具调用并展示 diff 对比；会话隔离、子代理聚合、SSE 实时推送、角标与颜色自定义。

description.en: Gitee Enterprise work-item workbench in the Harness sidebar: browse projects and tasks, requirements, and bugs; inspect details, child tasks, comments, and Markdown; create or edit work items; and reference them with @.
description.zh: 在 Harness 侧栏提供 Gitee 企业版工作台：浏览项目及任务、需求、缺陷，查看详情、子任务、评论与 Markdown，支持新建或编辑工作项，并可通过 @ 引用。

description.en: Git plugin — adds Git management to the session tab bar, covering the basics: commit | pull | push | branch | diff.
description.zh: Git 插件 —— 会话 Tab 栏添加 Git 管理功能，支持 commit | pull | push | branch | diff 等基础功能。

description.en: Branch panel for the composer: creates rule-checked branches from production6, validates commit messages against a type(scope) convention, and commits, pushes, or merges into stage in one click.
description.zh: 输入框内的分支面板：按规范从 production6 切分支，按 type(scope) 约定校验提交信息，一键提交、推送并合并到 stage。

description.en: Git panel with commit graphs, file diffs, branch and worktree management, and AI-assisted commit message previews.
description.zh: Git 面板，支持提交图、文件差异、分支与工作树管理，以及 AI 辅助生成提交说明预览。

description.en: Git branch selector and Git graph in the conversation header of the dsh web GUI.
description.zh: dsh web GUI 会话头部栏的 Git 分支选择器与提交图。

description.en: A GitHub-connected visual git manager for DeepSeek Harness: guided GitHub-Flow steps, commit graph with PR/CI badges, one-click GitHub login, PR and issue management, and structured git tools for the agent. Renamed from gitcompass in 2.0.0.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 GitHub 联动的可视化 Git 管理：引导式 GitHub Flow 步骤、带 PR/CI 徽章的提交图谱、一键 GitHub 登录、PR 与 issue 管理，以及面向 Agent 的结构化 Git 工具。2.0.0 起由 gitcompass 改名而来。

description.en: Codex-style Git workbench: workspace-scoped changes, diff, stage, commit, guarded branch operations, graph history, fetch, fast-forward pull, and upstream push through official plugin APIs.
description.zh: Codex 风格 Git 工作台：工作区级更改、diff、暂存、提交、受守卫的分支操作、提交图谱、fetch、pull --ff-only 与经官方插件 API 的上游推送。

description.en: Maintainer and developer PR board for the DSH sidebar: a five-state review queue (waiting on me / waiting on author / ready to merge / merged / inbox), a three-column issue board, and a global view of the PRs you authored (my move / waiting on others / merged), with CI rollup badges, an inactivity filter, and one click per card to open or start the matching review conversation.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的维护者 + 开发者 PR 看板：五状态评审队列（等我 / 等作者 / 可合并 / 已合并 / 待分诊）、三列 issue 看板、跨仓库跟踪自己 PR 的 mine 视图（我的回合 / 等别人 / 已合并），附 CI 汇总徽章与不活跃过滤，点卡片一键打开或新建对应的评审会话。

description.en: Git Changes tab for the DSH web GUI: staging, diffing, AI-drafted commit messages, branch/merge/stash/worktree operations and sync, with live updates via fs.watch plus a changeToken poll.
description.zh: Git 更改标签页：暂存、对比、AI 起草提交信息、分支/合并/储藏/工作树操作与同步，通过 fs.watch 加 changeToken 轮询实现实时更新。

description.en: Finds potential UX issues in your project: automatically reviews React/TypeScript code, pinpoints each problem, and gives concrete suggestions.
description.zh: 帮你发现项目中可能存在的用户体验问题：自动走查 React/TypeScript 源码，定位问题并给出具体优化建议。

description.en: Turns real git history into two Chinese changelog drafts (short for users, long for developers); every entry carries its commit SHA and an evidence-backed verified/unverified mark, and commit subjects are never translated.
description.zh: 从真实 git 历史生成两份中文变更日志（面向用户短版、面向开发者长版）；每条都带 commit SHA 与「已验证／未验证」标记，只有能引用到验证证据时才标「已验证」，提交主题不翻译。

description.en: Merged commit timeline for the Git repositories in a DSH workspace, with per-repository dirty and ahead/behind state, fetch, and right-sidebar file diffs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区内各 Git 仓库的提交合并在一条时间线中查看，并显示各仓库改动与领先／落后状态、支持拉取和右侧文件差异。

description.en: Git commit-and-push automation for DSH with pre-push auditing, rule-based quality scoring, SSH key generation, and a three-tab settings sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 的 git 提交推送自动化：提交前审计、规则质量评分、SSH 密钥生成与三选项卡设置侧边栏。

description.en: Git view for DeepSeek Harness: status, commit graph, branches and tags in one picker, diff, staging/commit, push/pull and blame.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 视图：状态、提交图、分支与标签（合并为同一个下拉框，可切换分支或检出标签）、差异、暂存提交、推送拉取与逐行溯源。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

plugins.name: dsh-vcs

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN change review inside DeepSeek Harness, with repository browsing and side-by-side diffs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to subversion.tigris.org

description.en: Branch-role guard for AI coding agents: configurable integration/preview/production/archive roles, blocking direct push, force-push and delete on protected branches and agent merges into production/archive.
description.zh: AI 编码智能体分支角色守卫：可配置集成/预览/生产/归档角色，拦截对受保护分支的直接推送、强推与删除，以及智能体对生产/归档分支的合并。

description.en: GitHub search, discovery and audit scripts wrapped as a SKILL.md pack around the gh CLI: repo search, multi-axis explore, trending, repo summaries, similar projects, code search, issue/PR search and org audits; ships as a dsh bundle (and on npm).
description.zh: 基于 gh CLI 的 GitHub 搜索/发现/审计技能包（SKILL.md 打包）：仓库搜索、多轴探索、趋势、仓库概览、相似项目、代码搜索、issue/PR 搜索与组织审计；以 dsh bundle 形式安装（并已发布 npm）。

description.en: The session page has an extra "Git" page; on the left is a preview of the non-staged/staged changes, and on the right is a diff preview with a row-level action bar (staged/discarded).
description.zh: 会话页里多出一个 Git 页；左侧是未暂存 / 已暂存的改动，右侧是带行级操作条（暂存 / 丢弃）的 diff 预览。

description.en: One-step GitHub uploader: initializes git, auto-creates or improves README, sets repository topics, and pushes a local project to GitHub.
description.zh: 一键上传项目到 GitHub：自动初始化 git、生成或完善 README、设置仓库 topics，并推送本地项目。

description.en: Session-header environment and branch chips: Local git-switches the checkout; Worktree creates an isolated git worktree under .agents/worktrees, registers it as a workspace, and offers merge, squash, delete, and auto-cleanup.
description.zh: 在空白会话加入环境与分支 chip：本机切换当前检出，Worktree 在 .agents/worktrees 下创建隔离 git worktree 并注册为工作区，会话头部提供合并、压缩提交、删除与自动清理。

description.en: Branch and worktree management for DeepSeek Harness: the workspace toolbar shows the current branch with in-place switching, plus an IDEA-style branch selector, remote branch checkout, context menus (create, rename, delete, copy), push and update, and branch isolation into standalone worktrees with managed creation and deletion.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 git 分支与 worktree 管理：工作区工具栏显示当前分支并可原地切换；支持 IDEA 风格分支选择器、远程分支检出、右键操作菜单（新建/重命名/删除/复制）、推送与更新当前分支，以及把分支隔离到独立 worktree 工作区并管理其创建与删除。

description.en: Manages Git worktrees in DeepSeek Harness with branch deletion controls and scoped workspace management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 Git Worktree，提供分支删除控制和指定工作区管理。

plugins.name: dsh-gitea

description.en: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Gitea 与 Forgejo，提供 issue、拉取请求和 worktree 工具及 Git 状态芯片。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: IDEA-style Git tool window for DSH: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/branch/author/date/path filters, staged and unstaged changes with a commit box, commit details with per-file line diff, stash and worktree management, a git console log, and AI commit-message drafting. Fork of KannaKuron/dsh-ide-git (MIT), reworked to register native DSH entries instead of depending on dsh-better-sidebar and extended with worktree management, undo for branch, stash and discard actions, a git console log and AI commit-message drafting. Its plugin, route and sidebar-tab ids differ from the upstream, so both can be installed, but you get two Git tool windows.
description.zh: DSH 里的 IDEA 风格 Git 工具窗口：带 ahead/behind 角标的分支树、可按文本/分支/作者/日期/路径筛选的提交图谱、已暂存与未暂存变更和提交框、提交详情与逐文件行级 diff、贮藏与工作树管理、git 控制台日志，以及 AI 撰写提交信息。KannaKuron/dsh-ide-git（MIT）的 fork：改用 DSH 原生入口注册（不再依赖 dsh-better-sidebar），并新增工作树管理、分支/贮藏/丢弃的撤销、git 控制台日志与 AI 撰写提交信息。插件、路由与侧栏 tab 的 id 均与上游不同，两者可同装，但会出现两个 Git 工具窗口。

description.en: VSCode-style uncommitted-changes sidebar docked to the right of the DSH web conversation page: staged / unstaged / untracked file groups, status badges, per-file +/− line counts, click-to-expand diff, rename as old → new, untracked content preview, and open with the system default application.
description.zh: 停靠在 DSH Web 对话页右侧的 VSCode 风格未提交改动侧边栏：已暂存/更改/未跟踪三组文件、状态徽标与每文件 +/− 行数，点击展开单文件 diff，支持重命名显示、未跟踪文件内容预览及调用系统默认应用打开文件。

description.en: Reports the semantic blast radius of agent code edits: which symbols changed, who calls them, and which of those callers have no covering test.
description.zh: 报告 agent 代码修改的语义波及面：哪些符号变了、谁在调用它们、其中哪些调用方没有测试覆盖。

description.en: Review tab for DeepSeek Harness sessions: workspace changes versus HEAD or any two refs as a filterable file tree with side-by-side diffs, a lane commit graph with blame and file history, three-scope search, line comments back to the composer, and guarded stage/commit/branch/tag/stash/conflict operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话审查标签页：工作区相对 HEAD 或任意两 ref 的变更，以可过滤文件树加双列差异呈现；泳道提交图带逐行追溯与单文件历史；三范围搜索；行内评论回写对话输入框；暂存、提交、分支、标签、贮藏与冲突操作全部设防。

description.en: Git workbench in the DSH session header and overlay: view changes, commit, fetch, pull, push, and browse branches and history in existing local repositories.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话标题栏与浮层工作台中管理已有本地仓库，支持查看改动、提交、获取、拉取、推送以及浏览分支和历史。

description.en: Authored pull request feedback inbox with paginated GitHub collection, priority favorites, and version-bound local progress shared by the DSH panel and CLI.
description.zh: 聚合本人创建的 PR 反馈，分页采集 GitHub 评论与审查，支持重点标记和 DSH 面板、CLI 共用的版本化本地处理进度。

description.en: Score a GitHub repo's contribution-friendliness from live merge and maintainer evidence.
description.zh: 用活的合并与维护者证据，给一个 GitHub 仓库的对外贡献友好度打分。

description.en: Git worktree panel for DSH Web: replaces the workspace sidebar with project → main/linked worktree → session groups, creates and removes worktrees, switches the main branch, and migrates configurable project-local or global storage with dirty-tree and active-session safeguards.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Git worktree 面板：将工作区侧栏替换为项目 → 主/关联 worktree → 会话分组，支持创建和删除 worktree、切换主分支，并在脏工作树与活跃会话保护下迁移可配置的项目内或全局存储位置。

description.en: A right-sidebar Git tab for DeepSeek Harness that lists working-tree changes with inline diffs and the commit graph, commits (locally or with a push), fast-forward pulls, and switches branches while the working tree is clean.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 页签：列出工作区改动并内联显示差异、浏览提交树，支持一键提交（仅本地或提交并推送）、快进拉取，并在工作区干净时切换分支。

description.en: Gitee Enterprise project management inside the conversation: issues, pull requests, kanban and the Gitee MCP toolchain.
description.zh: 在对话里管理 Gitee 企业版项目：issue、Pull Request、看板与 Gitee MCP 工具链。

description.en: Connects a GitHub account to DSH from the composer button (OAuth device flow or a personal access token) and exposes one github_api tool for REST calls — create repositories, write files, read pull requests and workflow runs — with a read-only switch and an in-panel call log. A rewritten fork of Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect (MIT): device-flow Client IDs are no longer rejected, paths may carry query strings and non-ASCII characters, undici is no longer a hard dependency, and the panel has four tabs. Registers the same github_api tool name and the same credential namespace, so it cannot be installed alongside that plugin.
description.zh: 在对话框左下角连接你的 GitHub 账号（设备流或 Personal Access Token），提供一个 github_api 工具直接调 REST 接口——建仓库、写文件、读 PR 与 Actions，带只读开关和调用记录。改自 Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect（MIT）：不再拒收设备流 Client ID，路径可带查询串与非 ASCII 字符，不再硬依赖 undici，面板改成四页签。工具名 github_api 与凭据命名空间都与原插件相同，两者不能同时安装。

description.en: Branch chip in the composer tool row that switches, creates, and refreshes workspace branches, commits a checked subset of changed files with a message the session's own model writes from the diff, and pushes the current branch.
description.zh: 位于 composer 工具栏的分支标记：切换、新建、刷新工作区分支；提交时可勾选部分改动文件，提交信息由当前 Session 的模型根据 diff 生成；并可推送当前分支。

description.en: Browse the GitHub issues and pull requests of a workspace's origin remote, filter and comment, close or reopen, and file one as a task on dsh-plugin-taskboard for an agent to claim.
description.zh: 浏览工作区 origin 远端对应的 GitHub issue 与 pull request，筛选、评论、关闭或重开，并可转成任务写到 dsh-plugin-taskboard 的看板上等 agent 领取。

description.en: Wraps the local GitHub CLI (gh) in agent tools for pull requests, issues, Actions runs, repository search and raw API calls, plus /gh status and /gh help slash commands and two web panels (a global repository cockpit and a per-session workspace panel).
description.zh: 把本机 GitHub CLI (gh) 包装成 Agent 工具集（PR、Issue、Actions 运行、仓库检索与原始 API 调用），另提供 /gh status 与 /gh help 两个斜杠命令，以及全局仓库驾驶舱和会话工作区两个 Web 面板。

description.en: Qoder-style workspace mode and branch chips on the session row; picking a branch arms it, and the first message creates a dedicated git worktree and moves the session into it. Windows only: the write grant runs PowerShell Set-Acl; elsewhere Worktree mode reports an error and stays in the main checkout.
description.zh: Qoder 风格的工作区模式与分支 chip，选择分支即挂起意图，发送第一条消息时自动创建独立 git worktree 并把会话迁入其中。仅 Windows：放行写入依赖 PowerShell Set-Acl，其他平台进 Worktree 会报错并留在主检出。

description.en: Registers a /code-review slash command with five parallel review lenses and per-finding confidence scoring, for both pull requests and local code.
description.zh: 注册 /code-review 斜杠命令，五个并行审查视角、逐发现置信度打分，同时支持拉取请求与本地代码审查。

description.en: Wraps the external `ocr` (open-code-review) CLI in five model tools — one-shot review, whole-tree scan, deterministic scope/rule scaffolding and session lookup — and reports what OCR found separately from whether the run actually covered the selected files.
description.zh: 把外部 `ocr`（open-code-review）CLI 包成五个模型工具——单次评审、全树扫描、确定性的范围与规则脚手架、会话查询——并把「OCR 发现了什么」与「这次跑有没有覆盖完选中的文件」分成两套口径回报。

description.en: Git and GitHub panel for the DSH web profile: stage/unstage/discard/diff, branches, commit, push/pull/sync, log, file browser, workflow board, and GitHub OAuth with PR creation.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 Git 与 GitHub 面板：暂存/撤销/丢弃/差异、分支、提交、推送/拉取/同步、日志、文件浏览、工作流看板，以及带 PR 创建的 GitHub OAuth。

description.en: Local AI code-review gate: review a workspace/branch/commit diff via the managed ocr.js, returning structured findings with token stats; gate mode fails on findings.
description.zh: 本地 AI 代码评审门禁：对工作区/分支/commit diff 跑评审（托管 ocr.js），返回结构化 findings 与 token 统计；门禁模式发现问题即失败。

description.en: Adversarial multi-lens code review: parallel correctness/security/maintainability lenses attack a diff, with deterministic severity grading, suppression rules and incremental review history.
description.zh: 对抗式多视角代码审查：正确性/安全性/可维护性透镜并行攻击 diff，确定性严重度定级、抑制规则与增量审查历史。

description.en: Per-task isolated git worktrees with a full create/sync/finish lifecycle: task names auto-derive branches, merge targets are double-checked, and batch cleanup is built in — zero manual git operations.
description.zh: 按任务隔离的 git worktree 工作区，覆盖创建/同步/收尾全生命周期：任务名自动派生分支、合并目标双重校验、内置批量清理——全程零手工 git 操作。

description.en: Git workflow studio for DeepSeek Harness: pick a branch model, enforce Conventional Commits, review PRs by defect density, rewrite history safely, rescue lost commits with reflog, and version releases by actual behavior change.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作流工作室：定分支模型、统一提交规范、按缺陷密度评 PR、安全改写历史、用 reflog 救援丢失的提交，并按真实行为变化定版本号。

description.en: Merge requests, review threads and pipeline job logs for GitLab over its REST API with a personal access token, in a side panel, with comment, reply, resolve and approve actions that wait for confirmation. Reads need the read_api scope, writes need api.
description.zh: 在侧栏面板里通过 GitLab REST API 与个人访问令牌查看合并请求、评审讨论串与流水线作业日志，并可评论、回复、解决讨论与批准；写操作均需二次确认（读需 read_api，写需 api）。

description.en: Git development workbench for DeepSeek Harness: captures branch, status, worktrees, stashes and recent commits, with commands, tools and a settings UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Git 开发工作台：采集分支、状态、worktree、stash 和最近提交，并通过命令、工具与设置界面管理 Git 工作区。

description.en: Worktree Space: puts a workspace task that spans one or more Git repositories in its own task space directory - each repository in it gets its own worktree on one shared task branch; the space is registered as a DSH Workspace so sessions start right there, and multiple tasks run side by side without interfering. Finishing a task can merge the work back into each repository's target branch, remove the worktrees, and file whatever Git does not track in an archive directory you choose.
description.zh: Worktree Space：将一个可包含多个 Git 仓库的工作区任务放进独立的任务空间目录——参与的每个仓库使用同一个任务分支各开一个 worktree；空间自动注册为 DSH 工作区，会话直接在其中开工，多个任务并行推进、互不干扰。收尾时可合并回各仓库目标分支、移除 worktree，并把 Git 未跟踪的文件归档到指定目录；结束任务时可选把未提交的变更和合并冲突交给 agent 处理。

description.en: JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工具窗口：带 ahead/behind 角标的分支树、可按文本/作者/日期/路径筛选的提交图谱、逐文件行级 diff、变更列表与提交框，以及分支、标签、贮藏操作和合并、变基、优选、重置、抓取/拉取/推送。

description.en: GitHub Device Flow connect plus an in-conversation PR workflow: a status bar above the composer for create / AI-review / merge, and github_* tools for search, issue and PR read and write.
description.zh: GitHub Device Flow 授权与对话内 PR 工作流：输入框上方的状态条支持创建 / AI 审查 / 合并 PR，另有 github_* 工具用于搜索、Issue 与 PR 读写。

plugins.name: dsh-workspace-git-badge#dsh-git-badge

description.en: Git status badges for DSH: sidebar workspace-row badges and an input-row chip showing the current conversation's workspace git state, with event-driven freshness over SSE.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 状态徽章：侧边栏工作区行徽章与输入行徽章，显示当前会话工作区的 git 状态，通过 SSE 事件驱动保持实时。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: A Git Graph tab for DSH Web: a faithful port of vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 that registers a native tab in the dsh-better-sidebar right rail (prerequisite), auto-binds to the session workspace, runs the full git operations (checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash) directly on the host, and opens file diffs in the built-in DiffTab.
description.zh: DSH Web 的 vscode-git-graph 1.30.0 忠实移植：入驻 dsh-better-sidebar 右侧栏的原生 Git Graph 提交图 tab（前置依赖），自动绑定会话工作区，host 直跑全套 git 操作（checkout/merge/rebase/push/tag/stash），文件 diff 复用内置 DiffTab 打开。

description.en: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.
description.zh: 在 Web 输入框切换分支、以真实工作区方式创建隔离的 git worktree。

description.en: PiUI-style diff viewer replacing the stock DiffBlock for write/edit tool calls.
description.zh: PiUI 风格 diff 查看器，替换 write/edit 工具调用的默认 DiffBlock。

description.en: VSCode-style editing experience for DeepSeek Harness: a Monaco-based central file editor (tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, status bar) and interactive diff review of agent edit/write results with per-change Keep/Undo, rollback and archiving, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 VSCode 编码体验：基于 Monaco 的中央文件编辑器（文件页签、Ctrl+P 快速打开、状态栏），并对 Agent 的 edit/write 结果进行交互式差异审查（逐处采纳/拒绝、回滚、归档），状态跨重启持久化。

description.en: Task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: durable per-repo manifest, worktree mode injects a creation instruction with your first message under an automatic worktree/ branch prefix, header badge instead of workspace clutter, and bring-back or force-remove cleanup.
description.zh: 任务级 git worktree：per-repo manifest 持久保存；Worktree 模式在首条消息注入创建指引并统一 worktree/ 分支前缀，头部徽标替代工作区注册，支持带回主目录或强制删除收尾。

description.en: Codex-style Git panel for DeepSeek Harness: a header button opens a menu with commit, push, branch switching and creation, and repository initialization; shows the current branch and the total additions and deletions of uncommitted files.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Codex 风格的 Git 面板：会话头部按钮打开菜单，提供提交、推送、切换分支、创建并切换与初始化仓库；显示当前分支与未提交文件的总增减。

description.en: Local Git plus the four GitHub remote tabs in the official DSH right sidebar: Changes (per-file staging, line diffs, and commit messages written by the model already configured in DSH), History, then Code, Issues, Pull requests and Actions proxied by the host half. The token stays in the host half through ctx.credentials and /dsh-git/* accepts loopback requests only.
description.zh: DSH 官方右侧栏里的本地 Git 与四个 GitHub 远端页签：Changes（按文件暂存、逐行 diff、提交信息由 DSH 里已配好的模型生成）、History，以及由 host 半代理的 Code / Issues / Pull requests / Actions。令牌只存在 host 半（ctx.credentials），/dsh-git/* 只接受 loopback 请求。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-github

description.en: Agent-facing GitHub repository tools: binds an account through a first-run prompt, then clones into the workspace and reads, exact-replaces, commits and pushes files, with writes off by default.
description.zh: 面向 Agent 的 GitHub 仓库工具：首次调用弹窗绑定账号，之后把仓库克隆到工作区并读写文件、精确替换、提交与推送，写远端默认关闭。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Two halves with one account store: a left-panel GitHub repositories viewer that is read-only by construction (three GET endpoints, every non-GET refused with 405 before routing, request body never read, tokens never leave the host), and a github-manager skill exposing exactly two tools — github_accounts and github_api — so the agent does the writing. Sign-in is GitHub Device Flow, and the store self-invalidates on mtime so a token added later is picked up without a restart.
description.zh: 同一个账户库的两半：左侧「GitHub 仓库」面板是结构性只读（只有三个 GET 端点，任何非 GET 在路由前直接 405，请求体从不读取，令牌不出宿主），以及一个 github-manager 技能，只暴露两个工具 —— github_accounts 与 github_api —— 写入动作交给 Agent。登录走 GitHub Device Flow，账户库按 mtime 自动失效，后加进来的令牌无需重启即可生效。

description.en: Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
description.zh: 增加需要审批的 Git 状态、diff、日志、提交、分支和可选检查点工具。

description.en: Pin Git commits to the environment's own author identity; env-var injection overrides all `git config` settings.
description.zh: git 提交固定使用环境自身作者身份，环境变量注入压过一切 `git config` 设置。

description.en: Injects allowlisted GitHub Actions and GitLab CI run metadata into agent context without reading logs, credentials, or provider APIs.
description.zh: 将白名单内的 GitHub Actions 与 GitLab CI 运行元数据注入 Agent 上下文，不读取日志、凭据或服务商 API。

description.en: Code smell radar: statically scans TODO/FIXME debt, stub implementations, long lines, oversized files and duplicated blocks, with severity-sorted read-only fix suggestions.
description.zh: 代码气味雷达：静态扫描 TODO/FIXME 债务、未实现桩、超长行、大文件与重复代码块，按严重度输出修复建议，全程只读。

description.en: Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).
description.zh: Git 卫生巡检：只读扫描已合并/过期分支、大文件、未跟踪文件与未提交修改，输出体检报告与清理建议，不自动删除任何东西。

description.en: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one severity-grouped report from /review or a code_review tool call.
description.zh: 通过 /review 命令或 code_review 工具并行派出只读评审员子代理小队（安全、正确性、测试、风格，各自可指定不同模型），并汇总为按严重度分组的结构化评审报告。

plugins.name: dsh-ma-plugins#dsh-librarian

description.en: Evidence-first GitHub research subagent with bounded tools and in-memory request caching.
description.zh: 带行号证据和内存缓存的 GitHub 只读调研子代理。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: DSH Source Control tab in dsh-better-sidebar that mirrors VS Code Git workflows.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 中的 DSH 源代码管理面板，尽量对齐 VS Code 的 Git 工作流。

description.en: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs and changed files, and Actions runs, jobs and job logs. Tool metadata is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.
description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。

description.en: Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count, opens a branch switcher on hover and an IDEA-style VCS panel on click (branch tree, commit graph, changes and staging, commit detail, file diff), plus a settings page for commit identity, the git binary and the network flags. Registers no model tools with DSH.
description.zh: 照着 IDEA 的 VCS 做的 Git 集成，装进 DSH 会话：输入框「权限模式」旁边的 Git 图标显示当前分支与未提交改动数，悬停可切分支，点击弹出 IDEA 风格的面板（分支树、提交图、变更与暂存、提交详情、文件差异），另有一个设置页管提交身份、git 位置和网络参数。不向 DSH 注册任何模型工具。

description.en: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
description.zh: /backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。

description.en: Git status badge in the composer tool row: a 14px branch glyph left of the model selector, with branch name, changed-file count and +added/-deleted lines on hover. Counts staged, unstaged and untracked files; nothing renders outside a git work tree.
description.zh: 输入框工具行的 git 状态角标：模型选择器左侧一枚 14px 分支图标，悬停显示分支名、变更文件数与增删行数。统计含未跟踪文件；非 git 工作区不显示。

description.en: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。

description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.
description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。

description.en: Shows the repository, branch, working-tree change count and short commit SHA on the composer row, with a searchable branch switcher and a per-file diff pane in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 在输入框那一行显示仓库、分支、改动数与短 SHA；点分支可搜索、切换或新建分支，点改动数在右侧边栏打开逐文件 diff 面板。

description.en: Alibaba Open Code Review for DSH: host-model delegation with native preview/rule tools and a review skill, plus optional OCR-managed reviews.
description.zh: 将阿里 Open Code Review 接入 DSH：通过原生文件筛选、规则工具和审查技能复用当前会话模型，并提供可选的 OCR 独立审查模式。

description.en: Connects your GitHub account to DSH agents from the composer GitHub button (OAuth device flow or personal access token) and lets them call the GitHub API through the github_api tool.
description.zh: 在对话框左下角一键连接你的 GitHub 账号（OAuth 设备流或 Personal Access Token），之后 AI 可通过 github_api 工具读取和操作你的 GitHub。

description.en: Git workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness: a repo-gated composer button opens a settings-style panel for diff/commit, branch, conflict, and worktree management, plus a commit history with branch-graph lines.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作区管理：输入框「模式」选择器旁的仓库感知入口，打开与设置同规格的面板，覆盖 diff/commit、分支、冲突、worktree 管理与带分支线的提交历史。

plugins.name: gitnexus-plus

description.en: Reads a GitNexus index in the DSH sidebar, reports skipped files, index freshness and language coverage, searches symbols, and reviews recent Git activity.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏读取 GitNexus 索引，报告被跳过的文件、索引新鲜度与语言覆盖，支持符号搜索和最近的 Git 活动审查。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: GitHub REST API tools + browser sidebar panel: repos, search, issues, PRs, comments, account binding (credential-store), and one-click clone-as-workspace.
description.zh: GitHub REST API 工具 + 浏览器侧边栏面板：仓库/搜索/Issue/PR/评论、账号绑定（凭据库）与一键克隆为工作区。

description.en: Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness — isolate parallel work in its own directory and branch. Ships Fast mode (快速模式).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 管理 git worktree —— 让并行工作各自隔离在自己的目录与分支里。自带快速模式（Fast mode）。

description.en: Git-first file-tree sidebar for the DSH web GUI: VS Code-style indent guides, M/A/U/D/R git decorations, HEAD-vs-worktree diff preview, media preview, and drag-to-reference (files/folders/selected code with line numbers) — pure plugin.
description.zh: Git 优先的文件树侧栏：VS Code 风格层级线、M/A/U/D/R git 状态装饰、HEAD 与工作区对照预览、媒体预览、拖拽引用（文件/文件夹/选中代码带行号）—— 纯插件。

description.en: Visual GitHub login without a terminal: in-window device flow, token synced into the gh CLI, and host status/launch endpoints.
description.zh: 零终端的 GitHub 可视化登录插件：窗口内完成设备码授权，令牌同步进 gh CLI，附宿主端状态与唤起接口。

description.en: Project-scoped Git credentials: forge accounts (GitHub, Gitea, GitLab, Bitbucket or a custom host) live in the right-sidebar "Git Forge" tab, are granted per project, and reach the agent as an HTTPS credential helper so the token never enters the conversation. Pushes to a host the project has not granted are rejected.
description.zh: 项目级 Git 凭据：forge 账号（GitHub、Gitea、GitLab、Bitbucket 或自定义域名）在右侧栏「Git 凭据」标签页里管理并可按项目授权，再由生成的凭据 helper 交给 agent 走 HTTPS 推送，token 不进对话；未授权 host 的推送会被拦截器直接拒绝。

description.en: Syncs the DSH home directory and Mnemon memory data through a git remote: pull, push, sync on an interval, cross-device migration, initialization backups, and conflict detection that stops before pushing and keeps local commits. A panel lists up to 100 recent operations with their backup paths.
description.zh: 通过一个 git 远端同步 DSH 主目录与 Mnemon 记忆数据：拉取、推送、按间隔自动同步、跨设备迁移、初始化备份，遇冲突在推送前停下并保留本地提交；面板记录最近 100 次操作各自的备份路径。

description.en: Right-sidebar Git review panel for DSH: staged and unstaged change tree, inline and side-by-side diffs, stage/unstage/discard, commit and push, AI-generated commit messages, and line blame. A fork of sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1; install either this or the upstream panel, not both.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 审查面板：暂存 / 未暂存改动树、内联与左右并排 diff、暂存 / 取消暂存 / 放弃更改、提交与推送、AI 生成提交信息、行级 Blame。本条目是 sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1 的 fork，与上游面板不能同时安装。

description.en: Human-operated Git worktree task board for DeepSeek Harness with validation-bound merge delivery.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的人工 Git worktree 任务工作台，将验证结果绑定到合并交付。

plugins.name: dsh-github

description.en: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
description.zh: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action.yml、轮询 PR 评审机器人（幂等行内评论 + status-check 门禁）以及 PR/issue 工具，所有写入走人工审批门。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Compact Git status line for DSH Web: the current branch, staged and unstaged line changes, ahead/behind commit counts against upstream, and a clean-worktree marker — placeable in the sidebar footer, the session header, or above/below the composer, with the position switched on the settings page.
description.zh: DSH Web 的紧凑 Git 状态行：显示当前分支、已暂存与未暂存的行数改动、相对 upstream 的领先/落后提交数以及工作区干净标记；可放在侧边栏底部、会话标题栏或输入框上方/下方，位置在设置页切换。

description.en: Codex-style location, worktree and branch switchers on the New Session screen of DSH; all git work runs in the host half.
description.zh: 在 DSH 新建会话页提供 Codex 风格的工作位置、worktree 与分支切换器，git 操作全部由 Host 半执行。

description.en: DSH slash command /commit: stages all changes, summarizes the staged diff with the session model, and commits; no browser UI required, with a local fallback when the model call fails.
description.zh: DSH 斜杠命令 /commit：暂存全部更改，用会话当前模型总结暂存区 diff 后提交；不依赖浏览器界面，模型调用失败时回退到本地规则生成提交信息。

description.en: Source Control panel in the DSH Web left rail: search, switch and create branches with ahead/behind counts, a topo-order commit graph, and a click-to-expand preview of any commit showing its files (A/M/D), insertions and deletions, message, author and timestamp. An always-on footer dock above Settings carries the branch dropdown and recent commits and follows the open session; fetch and fast-forward pull are one button, and a git_worktree agent tool creates, lists and removes worktrees.
description.zh: DSH Web 左侧栏的源代码管理面板：搜索、切换与创建分支并显示领先/落后提交数，拓扑序提交图，点击任意提交可展开查看其文件（A/M/D）、增删行数、提交信息、作者与时间。设置上方常驻一个底部停靠区，包含分支下拉与最近提交并跟随当前会话；fetch 与快进 pull 合并为一个按钮；另有 git_worktree 工具供智能体创建、列出与移除 worktree。

description.en: Redundant branch cleaner: finds branches whose work already landed in the mainline — merged, squash-merged, patch-equivalent after rebase or cherry-pick, upstream-gone, or PR-merged — and deletes them when asked. It only reports by default, never switches branches or rebases, and backs every deleted local branch up under refs/backup/branch-cleaner/ (deleting remote branches has no backup).
description.zh: 冗余分支清理：找出已经落地到主线的分支（普通合并 / squash 合并 / rebase 或 cherry-pick 落地 / 上游已删除 / PR 已合并），确认后再删除。默认只报告，不切换分支、不 rebase，删除前把每个本地分支备份到 refs/backup/branch-cleaner/（删除远端分支不备份）。

description.en: Git and source-control plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness: local git operations plus GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps and Gitea adapters, with self-evolving memory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 与源码管理插件套件：本地 git 操作，外加 GitHub、GitLab、Bitbucket、Azure DevOps 与 Gitea 适配器，并带自演进记忆。

description.en: Git worktree management for dsh — group workspaces by repository, create and switch worktrees, and browse their changes, commit history and file diffs.
description.zh: dsh 的 Git worktree 管理——按仓库聚合工作区，创建与切换 worktree，并查看变更、提交历史与文件差异。

description.en: Git tab in the DeepSeek Harness conversation view: reviews every repository in the session working directory and commits each on its own, with change groups, whole-file / changes-only / side-by-side diffs, in-panel editing, and a push button that lists every commit it would publish.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 对话页里的 Git 标签页：列出会话工作目录下的每个仓库并各自独立提交，变更分组，整个文件 / 只看变动 / 并排三种差异看法，面板内直接编辑保存，以及推送前逐一列出将要发布的提交。

description.en: Four dependency-free local git tools (status, diff, log, commit) for DeepSeek Harness operating on the session workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供四个零依赖本地 git 工具（status、diff、log、commit），作用于会话工作区。

description.en: Back up, restore and two-way sync DSH plugins and configuration through your own Git repository, with conflict handling, snapshots and six agent tools.
description.zh: 用你自己的 Git 仓库备份、恢复并双向同步 DSH 插件与配置，支持冲突处理、快照与 6 个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Snapshot-bound multi-agent Git review with independent verification, majority voting, resolution tracking and an AI review gate.
description.zh: 绑定代码快照的多智能体 Git 审阅，支持独立复核、多数投票、问题处置追踪和 AI 审阅门禁。

description.en: Four GitHub workflow skills for PR triage, review feedback, GitHub Actions diagnosis, and safe draft-PR publishing, reusing existing DSH capabilities with gh/git fallbacks.
description.zh: 四个面向 GitHub 工程工作流的 DSH Skill：PR 分诊、review 反馈、GitHub Actions 诊断和安全的 draft PR 发布；优先复用现有 DSH 能力，必要时回退到 gh/git。

description.en: A strip above the composer listing files modified in the current session (collapsed by default), with a Review button opening a per-session change panel showing before/after hunks from the session's own edit/write tool results, no git required.
description.zh: 输入框上方的条带列出当前会话修改过的文件（默认折叠），Review 按钮打开会话变更面板，基于会话自身的 edit/write 工具结果展示前后差异块，无需 git。

plugins.name: dsh-git-connector

description.en: Git repository connector for DeepSeek Harness: saved repo profiles addressed by name, work-copy operations (clone/fetch/pull/push/commit), Gitea/Forgejo/GitHub API tools, keys in the DSH credential center, and per-repo safety flags (TLS bypass, overwrite, force push).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 仓库连接：按档案名操作仓库（clone/fetch/pull/push/commit）、Gitea/Forgejo/GitHub API、密钥存 DSH 凭据中心，并按仓库单独授权忽略证书/允许覆盖/force push 等危险开关。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: GitHub CI co-pilot for DeepSeek Harness: PR review, CI failure fixing, issue triage and release notes.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness Agent 化身 GitHub 副驾：PR 审查、CI 失败修复、Issue 分类与自动发版说明。

description.en: A right-sidebar Git panel in the IDEA style — local changes with per-file checkbox commits, a commit tree with per-commit details, branch, remote and stash management, push with a credential fallback, all driven by the plain git CLI.
description.zh: 右侧栏的 IDEA 风格 Git 面板：本地变更与按文件勾选提交、提交树与提交详情、分支 / 远程 / 贮藏管理、带凭据兜底的推送，以及 git 命令流水，全部通过原生 git CLI 执行。

description.en: Records every agent write, edit and shell `rm` into a shadow git repository, then reviews them hunk by hunk in VS Code — accept or revert each one. Needs the companion dsh-review-vscode extension; the panel only appears inside VS Code's webview.
description.zh: 把 agent 的每次写入、编辑和 shell `rm` 删除记录进一个 shadow git 仓库，然后在 VS Code 里逐 hunk 接受或撤回。需要配合 dsh-review-vscode 扩展；面板只出现在 VS Code 的 webview 里，独立浏览器中的对话界面不变。

description.en: First-class Git tools for the model: status / diff / log / commit / branch with validated messages and paths - no bare-shell git calls.
description.zh: 一等公民的 Git 工具：status / diff / log / commit / branch，参数与路径校验、零 shell 调用，杜绝注入。

description.en: Reports bounded, repository-relative Git status as structured data without staging, committing, or changing branches.
description.zh: 以结构化数据返回有界、相对仓库根的 Git 状态，不暂存、不提交，也不切换分支。

description.en: 33 github_* tools covering REST reads, issue writes, Git data writes, private repo creation, and clone; in-process permission gate and cost-discipline companion skill; no gh CLI required.
description.zh: 33 个 github_* 工具，覆盖 REST 读取、Issue 写入、Git 数据写入、私有仓库创建与克隆；附带进程内权限门与成本纪律伴生 skill，无需 gh CLI。

description.en: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to independent verifiers tasked with refuting it, and one refutation drops it.
description.zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

description.en: A /review command that hands the current change set to a reviewer subagent pinned to the model you choose, with one continuing reviewer session per chat.
description.zh: 一条 /review 命令，把当前改动集交给固定到你选定模型的评审子代理，并且每个对话只保留一个持续复用的评审会话。

description.en: Runs 3 or 5 coding-agent candidates in detached Git worktrees, validates their patches with project commands, ranks only passing candidates, and requires separate approval before applying the winner.
description.zh: 在独立 Git worktree 中运行 3 或 5 个编码智能体候选，用项目命令验证补丁，只对通过者排序，并在应用获胜补丁前要求再次批准。

description.en: Git server: embeds ts-gogs (a TypeScript reimplementation of Gogs) and serves a full Git service on its own port — HTTP clone/push, web UI, issues/PRs/wiki — reusing user-management credentials, start/stop from the settings page.
description.zh: Git 服务器：内嵌 ts-gogs（Gogs 的 TypeScript 平替），独立端口跑完整 Git 服务（HTTP clone/push、网页端、issue/PR/wiki），可复用 user-management 的用户名密码，设置页一键启停。

description.en: Read-only Git Graph in the native DSH Web sidebar, with commit history, branch and tag refs, file diffs, two-commit comparison, and full historical source.
description.zh: DSH Web 原生右侧栏的只读 Git Graph，支持提交历史、分支与标签、文件 Diff、两提交比较和完整历史原文。

description.en: Sidebar tab that lists a session's file changes by turn, expands line-level diffs and undoes them, with a matching review card at the end of each chat turn. Needs dsh-better-sidebar installed separately. DSH 0.2.x port of Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab; do not install both.
description.zh: 侧边栏「文件审查」标签页：按轮次列出本会话改动文件、展开行级 diff 并支持撤销，对话尾部同步显示同款审查卡片。需另装 dsh-better-sidebar。是 Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab 的 DSH 0.2.x 移植版，不要与原版同装。

description.en: Git worktree Session Targets with isolated task sessions, Ready for Review, reversible Local Preview, human-confirmed delivery, environment retention and recovery, and same-session iteration.
description.zh: Git Worktree Session Target：任务在隔离 Session 中运行，支持 Ready for Review、可撤回的 Local Preview、人工确认交付、环境保留与恢复，以及同一 Session 连续迭代。

description.en: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.
description.zh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。

description.en: Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.
description.zh: 增量代码审查插件：批准一批改动后只审查检查点之后的新改动，提供 Web 审查面板与 `/review` 命令，并把审查意见注入回 agent。

description.en: Jujutsu (jj) version-control panel in the DSH web GUI: a Jujutsu tab renders the jj log change graph with change details, changed files and file diffs, a revset input, and jj-native history edits (drag-to-rebase, split by file, describe, squash, abandon, undo, push); it reads jj directly rather than through git, and every command runs as an argv array through a whitelisted host service with confirmations, timeouts and output caps.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 里的 Jujutsu（jj）版本控制面板：「Jujutsu」标签页把 jj log 渲染成 change 图，含 change 详情、改动文件与文件差异、revset 输入框，以及 jj 原生历史改写（拖拽 rebase、按文件拆分、修改描述、压缩、放弃、撤销、推送）；直接读 jj 而不经过 git 转译，所有命令以 argv 数组经白名单化的宿主服务执行，带确认、超时与输出上限。

description.en: Adds a one-click Worktree switch beside the composer that moves an empty session into a new git worktree, and removes worktrees idle for three days.
description.zh: 在输入框分支标记旁提供一键 Worktree 开关，让空会话进入新的 git worktree；三天无活动的 worktree 自动清理。

description.en: Bidirectional GitHub repository sync for DSH: git sync with conflict rollback and pre-push checks, Actions/CI monitoring with per-step run detail, repository add/remove/rename, a web panel with local and remote file browsers, scheduled automation, and six agent tools.
description.zh: DSH 的 GitHub 仓库同步插件：带冲突回滚与推送前检查的双向 git 同步、可下钻到每一步的 Actions/CI 监控、仓库添加/移除/改名、含本地与远端文件浏览的 Web 面板、定时自动化流水线，以及六个 Agent 工具。

plugins.name: dsh-git-panel

description.en: IDE-style Git panel in the DSH Web GUI: a resident tab with a three-column overview (branch/tag list, searchable commit-history graph, commit detail with changed-file tree and message) and a changes page (stats bar, uncommitted list with per-file stage/unstage/discard, commit box with amend); side-by-side diffs carry lazy highlight.js syntax highlighting, on-demand between-hunk context expansion and word-level intra-line emphasis, with image files shown as before/after panes; plus a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar. Every git command runs as an argv array through the host subprocess service, cwd locked to the repo root.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 里的 IDE 风格 Git 面板：常驻标签页含三栏总览（分支/标签列表、可搜索的提交历史图、含变更文件树与提交信息的提交详情）与变更记录页（统计条、带逐文件暂存/取消/丢弃的未提交列表、含 amend 的提交框）；并排差异带懒加载 highlight.js 语法高亮、块间上下文按需展开与词级行内高亮，图片文件以变更前/后双图对照；另在输入框提供 zsh 风格分支标记。所有 git 命令以 argv 数组经宿主 subprocess 执行、cwd 锁定仓库根。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.eclipse.org

description.en: DSH Web GUI right sidebar: VS Code-style file explorer plus source control (git status, stage/unstage/discard, commit, diff, commit graph, fetch/pull/push sync, branch and remote management, git init, multi-repo switch, color-coded file status, file-type icons), an editor view that opens every file reached from the chat, the file tree or source control (Markdown/HTML/PDF/image previews, 15-language syntax highlighting, hunk-level diff editing, Ctrl+S save), file operations (new/move/copy/delete, reveal in file explorer), a collapsible icon rail, a multi-tab bottom terminal (ConPTY), and commit messages generated from the staged diff by a host-configured model.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 右侧边栏：VS Code 风格文件浏览器加源代码管理（git 状态、暂存/取消暂存/放弃变更、提交、差异、提交图形、抓取/拉取/推送同步、分支与远程管理、Git 初始化、多仓库切换、文件状态着色、文件类型图标），并提供打开会话/文件树/源代码管理里任一文件的编辑器视图（Markdown/HTML/PDF/图片预览、15 种语言语法高亮、逐块差异编辑、Ctrl+S 保存）、文件操作（新建/移动/复制/删除、在文件管理器中显示）、可折叠图标窄条、多标签底部终端（ConPTY），以及由宿主已配置模型基于暂存差异生成提交信息。

description.en: AtomGit plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: six built-in AtomGit skills (plan issues, implement issues, review PRs, merge PRs, publish CLI releases, mirror to GitHub) plus ag CLI integration and platform-hosted MCP tools for repos, branches, issues, PRs, and search.
description.zh: AtomGit 插件包：内置六个 AtomGit 技能（Issue 规划、Issue 实现、PR 审查、PR 合并、CLI 版本发布、GitHub 镜像），并集成 ag CLI 与平台托管的 MCP 工具（仓库/分支/Issue/PR/搜索）。

description.en: VSCode-style Source Control page in the DSH Web right sidebar: a paged commit lane graph with ref markers and per-commit diffs, grouped working-tree changes with stage/discard/unstage, a commit box with amend and AI-generated messages, a side-by-side and unified diff page, GitHub repository and pull request creation through the gh CLI, and bidirectional HTTPS/SSH remote switching.
description.zh: DSH Web 右侧 Sidebar 中的类 VSCode 源代码管理页：带引用标记与分页的泳道提交图与逐提交差异、分组的工作区变更与暂存/丢弃/取消暂存，支持修补上一次提交与 AI 生成信息的提交框、并排与统一差异视图、通过 gh CLI 新建仓库与创建 Pull Request，以及 HTTPS 与 SSH 远程地址双向切换。

description.en: Visual Git graph, interactive branch management, and commit diff inspector in DeepSeek Harness right sidebar.
description.zh: 嵌入 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏的可视化 Git 提交图谱、交互式分支管理与代码差异比对工具。

description.en: Version-control workbench for the DSH Web sidebar: local changes grouped by type, per-file and multi-file staging, preview-confirmed commit / update / push, and a failure dialog that shows the raw Git output instead of a four-second toast.
description.zh: DSH Web 侧栏的版本控制工作台：改动按类型分组，支持单文件与多文件暂存，提交/拉取/推送均先预览再确认，失败时弹窗展示 Git 原始输出。

description.en: Runs git in the Host process so push, pull and fetch work inside the agent sandbox; exposes 8 agent tools (status, diff, log, stage, commit, push, fetch, pull) and 11 slash commands including /git-status, /git-commit, /git-tag and /git-name-set.
description.zh: 在宿主进程中执行 git，使 push、pull、fetch 在 agent 沙箱内可用；提供 8 个 agent 工具（status、diff、log、stage、commit、push、fetch、pull）与 11 个斜杠命令，包括 /git-status、/git-commit、/git-tag 与 /git-name-set。

description.en: Conventional-commit enforcement, changelog generation, PR summaries and branch pushes through the plain git CLI.
description.zh: 规范提交（Conventional Commits）、自动 changelog、PR 描述生成与分支推送，纯 git CLI 实现。

description.en: One-click standalone two-column code review page for Git diffs in the conversation: line numbers, add/delete coloring, character-level highlight, hunk-aware per-file sections, a file nav sidebar and a stats bar; line comments submit back to the DSH composer, and the UI follows the DSH locale.
description.zh: 把对话里的 git diff 一键打开为独立标签页的双列代码评审页：行号、增删配色、字符级高亮、hunk 感知的多文件分段、文件导航侧栏与统计条，行内评论可提交回 DSH 对话框，界面跟随 DSH 语言（中英）。

description.en: JetBrains-style Git workbench for DSH: hunk and line-level staging, side-by-side diff with word-level highlighting, commit graph and branch operations, three-way conflict merge, and commit messages drafted with the host model.
description.zh: DSH 的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工作台：按块与按行暂存、带词级高亮的并排 diff、提交图与分支操作、三方冲突合并，还能用宿主模型起草提交信息。

description.en: Local Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: branch search and switching, hunk-level staging, commit graph, file history and blame, stash and worktree management, conflict resolution, and eight git tools for the agent.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 Git 工作台：分支搜索与切换、hunk 级暂存、提交图谱、文件历史与 blame、储藏与工作树管理、冲突处理，以及 8 个供 agent 使用的 Git 工具。

description.en: Turn-level workspace undo for Git worktrees: every agent turn gets a private snapshot, /undo previews a red/green diff card that is confirmed in place, files changed after the turn are refused with a conflict diff unless --force or --skip-conflicts is passed, and HEAD, index, stash and commit history of the user repository are never written.
description.zh: Git worktree 的 turn 级工作区撤销：每个 turn 建私有快照，/undo 先出红绿 diff 预览卡、卡内确认；turn 之后被改过的文件拒绝用冲突 diff 覆盖，只有显式 --force 或 --skip-conflicts 才继续；不写用户仓库的 HEAD、index、stash 与提交历史。

description.en: Zero-config per-turn git checkpoints: after every completed agent turn in a git workspace, stages all changes into one tagged \[turnsnap] commit (serialized queue, sandbox-policy aware), so any turn is a rollback point.
description.zh: 零配置的逐轮 git 检查点：在 git 工作区的每个 agent 轮结束后，把全部变更暂存为一条带 \[turnsnap] 标记的提交（串行队列、感知沙箱策略），每一轮都是回滚点。

description.en: Runs a diff past several reviewers at once — a CLI coding agent such as codex or claude, or a DSH subagent — and merges their separate sections into one report; reviewers and named review modes are configured in the settings UI.
description.zh: 把同一个 diff 同时交给多个评审者——已安装的 CLI 编程智能体（codex、claude 等）或 DSH 子智能体——各自成节，合并为一份报告；评审者与命名评审模式在设置界面里配置。

plugins.name: dsh-svn-tools

description.en: SVN (Subversion) toolset for DeepSeek Harness: 33 agent tools (status, diff, log, blame, commit, merge, props, lock, changelist...) plus a sidebar panel with side-by-side BASE/working-copy diff, conflict resolution and AI commit logs.
description.zh: SVN（Subversion）工具集：33 个 agent 工具（status/diff/log/blame/commit/merge/props/lock/changelist 等），以及带 BASE/工作副本左右对比、冲突解决与 AI 提交日志的侧边栏面板。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to host

description.en: Turns GitHub, GitLab and Gitee URLs in the transcript into hover cards with cached repository metadata, and opens them in the DSH sidebar browser on click; plain URLs and GenUI blocks are covered without patching GenUI itself.
description.zh: 把对话里的 GitHub / GitLab / Gitee 链接变成带缓存元数据的悬停卡片，点击在 DSH 右侧栏浏览器中打开；裸 URL 与 GenUI 块都覆盖，且不修改 GenUI 本体。

description.en: Trimmed fork of ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow: a floating panel plus a right-column review pane for the pull requests raised in a session, showing CI state, review comments and merge status. It also registers the github_* agent tools (PR merge and review, secrets, raw API), so do not install both.
description.zh: fork 自 ItQianChen/dsh-github-flow 并裁剪：本会话 PR 的浮窗与右列审阅面板，显示 CI 状态、评审意见与合并状态；同时注册 github_* 工具（含合并/评审 PR、密钥、原始 API），勿与原版同装。

description.en: IDEA-style Git workbench for the Web UI: commit graph with lanes and ref labels, log filters, commit details, split and unified diffs with per-hunk staging, a fine-grained zero-context mode, local changes with amend and sign-off, rename-following file history, per-line annotate, stash, branch operations, compare, tags, an interactive rebase planner and conflict resolution. Records which model produced a commit by stamping an Assisted-by trailer from the live session, and renders any existing commit trailers as chips, so AI-authored history stays traceable.
description.zh: IDEA 风格的 Git 工作台：提交图（泳道与引用标签）、日志筛选、提交详情、并排与统一差异、按 hunk 暂存、零上下文的细粒度模式、本地更改（含修补与 sign-off）、跟随重命名的文件历史、逐行注解、Stash、分支操作、比较、标签、交互式变基与冲突解决。按活跃会话盖上 Assisted-by trailer 记录提交由哪个模型产生，并把已有的 trailer 渲染成标签，让 AI 参与的历史可追溯。

description.en: Runs git init in each newly registered DSH workspace, with an empty initial commit by default, so git-aware plugins have a repository to attach to; directories already inside a work tree are skipped.
description.zh: 在 DSH 每次注册新工作区时自动 git init 并补一个空提交；已在工作树内的目录会被跳过。

description.en: Git branch selector and Git graph for the dsh web GUI: switch branches and explore branch-lane and commit history from the conversation header.
description.zh: 输入框上方提供 Git 分支选择器，并把分支泳道与提交历史画成图谱，沿着时间线找到任意变更。

description.en: One-click update for the local DeepSeek Harness checkout — compare versions, pull and rebuild, then restart, and roll back to any past release, all from a sidebar panel with live progress.
description.zh: 一键更新本地 DeepSeek Harness：侧边栏按钮对比版本、拉取重建并自动重启，还可选择回退到任一历史版本，全程实时进度。

description.en: Code management panel for the DSH web UI that handles everyday Git in five steps: ① env check auto-detects git/gh/ssh and one-click installs missing tools (gh mirror download sources speed up installs, Windows included) with check-update; ② SSH ed25519 key generation / connection tests plus one-click 443 config to bypass blocked port 22, with the Gitee personal token configured here; ③ repo status, side-by-side diffs, stage/commit, branch switching, history with revert/cherry-pick, one-click repo creation and push, auto-ignoring >100MB files; ④ lists all repos of your account for one-click clone; ⑤ five-step npm publish wizard. GitHub / Gitee dual-platform, with the UI switching between 中文 and English live.
description.zh: DSH 网页界面的代码管理面板，五步搞定 Git 日常：① 环境检查自动检测 git/gh/ssh，缺工具一键安装（gh 支持镜像下载源加速，Windows 也可用）并带检查更新；② SSH ed25519 密钥生成/连接测试 + 一键写 443 配置绕过 22 端口封锁，Gitee 私人令牌在此配置；③ 查看仓库状态、并排 diff、暂存提交、切换分支、查看/回滚历史，一键新建仓库并推送，自动忽略超 100MB 文件；④ 列出账号名下所有远程仓库一键克隆；⑤ 五步发布 npm 包。支持 GitHub / Gitee 双平台，界面中英文跟随 DSH 设置实时切换。

description.en: Connects GitHub's official remote MCP server as a DSH plugin: stores the PAT in DSH's credential center (.credentials.yaml) via github_set_token, and exposes GitHub tools as mcp__github__*.
description.zh: 把 GitHub 官方远程 MCP server 封装为 DSH 插件：PAT 存入 DSH 凭据中心（.credentials.yaml），提供 github_set_token / github_token_status 模型工具，GitHub 工具以 mcp__github__* 形式可用。

description.en: GitHub MCP helper panel: shows copyable example prompts at Settings → Plugins → GitHub MCP (random 4 from a 30-example pool), visualizes a public user's repo star/fork/language, and adds the gh_repo_stats and gh_current_user model tools.
description.zh: GitHub MCP 辅助面板：在「设置 → 插件 → GitHub MCP」展示可复制的示例提示（30 条示例池随机 4 条）、可视化公开仓库的星/fork/语言，并提供 gh_repo_stats / gh_current_user 模型工具。

description.en: Adds a Git chip beside the composer that opens a centered workbench (changes, history, files, tags, stash) plus a Git section in settings. Supports multi-account OAuth device flow and PAT with per-repository permissions (full, read, none), gates writes behind a global switch and reads behind an allowed-directory list, and refuses a push whose target remote belongs to no writable account. Diffs preview in place with line numbers, four layouts, word-level emphasis, syntax highlighting and Ctrl/⌘+F find; Markdown and images render inline, commit messages are searchable, and commit messages can be generated from the staged diff through the host LLM service. Ships 8 Agent tools, 51 local HTTP endpoints and 8 languages, with tokens encrypted at rest by AES-256-GCM.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个 Git chip，点开是居中工作台（改动、历史、文件、标签、贮藏），设置页另有一个 Git 分节。支持多账号的 OAuth 设备码流程与 PAT，按仓库设三档权限（完整、只读、无权限），写操作受全局开关控制、读操作受允许目录白名单控制，推送目标远端不属于有写权限的账号时会被拒绝。差异就地预览，带行号、四档布局、词级强调、语法高亮与 Ctrl/⌘+F 查找；Markdown 与图片可内联渲染，提交信息可搜索，也能调用宿主 LLM 服务从暂存差异生成提交信息。提供 8 个 Agent 工具、51 个本地 HTTP 接口与 8 种语言，令牌以 AES-256-GCM 加密落盘。

description.en: PR evaluation and improvement consultant: assesses PR success probability based on historical anti-patterns and success patterns, with one-click scoring and actionable suggestions.
description.zh: PR 评估和改进顾问：基于历史反模式和成功模式评估 PR 成功率，一键评分并提供可操作的改进建议。

description.en: Push vague or rich, user-configurable DSH interaction states to the local Discord client as Rich Presence — real-time, content-free, with a user-editable status list and an optional rich-mode toggle in Settings.
description.zh: 将模糊或丰富的 DSH 交互状态实时推送到本地 Discord 客户端作为 Rich Presence——不携带任何工作区内容，状态消息列表可自由编辑，并可在设置中切换丰富模式。

description.en: QQ channel for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11 / NapCat: keeps one fixed persona across sessions with long-term memory, answers in group and private chats, sends stickers and voice replies, and ships a local web console that shows what the bot is doing. Persona and memory files are yours to write — the repository only ships examples.
description.zh: 基于 OneBot 11 / NapCat 的 QQ 通道：跨会话保持同一人设并带长期记忆，在群聊和私聊里接话，会发表情包、会发语音，另附一个本地 Web 控制台，能看见她此刻在做什么。人设与记忆文件由你自己写，仓库只提供样例。

description.en: Multi-channel push for DeepSeek Harness: Server酱, PushPlus, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Feishu, ntfy, custom webhooks and more, configurable from the settings panel and callable by other plugins via the pushNotifier service.
description.zh: DSH 多渠道消息推送插件：支持 Server酱、PushPlus、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram、飞书、ntfy、自定义 Webhook 等，可在设置面板配置多个渠道，并通过 pushNotifier 服务供其他插件调用。

plugins.name: dsh-messaging#messaging-core

description.en: Unified messaging gateway for DeepSeek Harness: 27 IM platforms (Telegram, QQ, WeChat, Discord, WhatsApp, Feishu and more) in one plugin, with QR scan-to-authorize, per-platform workspaces, slash commands, and a web setup dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一消息网关：一个插件接入 27 个 IM 平台（Telegram、QQ、微信、Discord、WhatsApp、飞书等），支持扫码授权、每平台独立工作区、斜杠命令与 Web 配置弹窗。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to homeassistant.local:8123

plugins.name: dsh-im-qq

description.en: QQ official bot (q.qq.com) integration for DeepSeek Harness: chat with the full agent from private chats, groups and channels — WS long connection (heartbeat / reconnect / RESUME), per-chat session isolation, standard agent preset, approval inline buttons with /revoke, slash commands, whitelist fail-closed, credentials via the credentials domain.
description.zh: 接入 QQ 官方机器人（q.qq.com）：私聊 / 群聊 / 频道 @ 与完整 agent 对话——WS 长连接（心跳 / 重连 / RESUME）、每会话隔离、标准 agent preset、审批内联按钮 + /revoke、斜杠命令、白名单 fail-closed、凭据走凭据域。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Sends Windows system notifications when DSH session turns end, with session titles, elapsed time when observed, optional foreground suppression and subagent filtering. Click a notification to focus the DSH window.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话本轮运行结束时发送 Windows 系统通知，显示会话标题及可观测的运行耗时，支持前台免打扰与子代理过滤。点击通知可将 DSH 窗口拉回前台。

description.en: Multi-channel notifications for DeepSeek Harness: registers a send_notification tool and a settings page fanning out to NotifyX, WeCom app webhook, WeCom group robot, email (Resend), SMTP, DingTalk, Feishu robot; plus browser notifications and automatic notification on task completion and blocking events.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多渠道通知插件：注册 send_notification 工具与设置页，向 NotifyX、企业微信应用通知、企业微信机器人、邮件（Resend/SMTP）、钉钉机器人、飞书机器人发送通知；支持浏览器通知、运行结束/阻塞/目标完成事件自动推送。

description.en: Multi-platform message gateway and WeCom AI bot bridge with session context compression and smartsheet creation.
description.zh: 多平台消息网关与企微智能机器人桥接：会话自动压缩持久化与智能表格一键创建。

description.en: Smart calendar and checklist assistant with lunar dates, macOS/Windows native notifications, and WeCom push.
description.zh: 智能日程与待办助手：农历节气、macOS/Windows 原生桌面弹窗、企微多平台推送与拖拽改期。

description.en: A desktop dynamic island window for DSH (tested on Windows) that shows whether the agent is thinking, replying, running tools or waiting for approval; expanded, it shows plan progress, context and token usage, and lets you stop the task, approve permission requests and answer the agent's questions, with a separate usage window that estimates cost from DeepSeek's official prices. The island window needs an existing Electron runtime — reused from the dsh-orb plugin's downloaded runtime or pointed to by DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON — and DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5 on Windows; the package neither bundles nor downloads Electron.
description.zh: DSH 桌面灵动岛悬浮窗（Windows 验证）：实时显示 Agent 正在思考、回答、执行工具或等待确认；展开后可查看计划进度、上下文与用量，停止任务、批准权限请求、回答 Agent 的提问；另有用量统计窗口，按 DeepSeek 官方价格估算费用。灵动岛窗口需复用本机已有的 Electron 运行时（沿用悬浮球插件 dsh-orb 下载的运行时，或用 DSH_ISLAND_ELECTRON 指定路径），并要求 Windows 版 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5；安装包不含、也不会自动下载 Electron。

description.en: Connects a DSH Host to Slack and Feishu using your own bot applications.
description.zh: 使用自建机器人应用，将一个 DSH Host 接入 Slack 和飞书。

description.en: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。

description.en: Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.
description.zh: DSH Notch 的配套助手，同步 Desktop、Web 与 Notch 之间的会话跳转和已读状态。

description.en: Host-side Feishu board for DeepSeek Harness: pushes a session's ask_user_question to Feishu DM as plain text and sends a quoted reply back to the exact session that asked, archiving unmatched replies instead of guessing. Its lark-cli wrapper also suppresses an identical notification resent within three minutes.
description.zh: 宿主侧飞书公告板：把会话的 ask_user_question 以纯文本推到飞书私聊，引用回复只投回提问的那个会话，匹配不上的回复存档不猜；lark-cli 发送包装会拦下三分钟内重复的同一通知。

description.en: Turn timer for DSH: reports how long the current turn has been running, injects wrap-up prompts on a /set-time schedule so the agent starts finishing instead of running on, and shows run-time cards above the composer.
description.zh: DSH 本轮计时看门狗：读取本轮已运行时长，按 /set-time 排程向模型注入收尾提示词，并在输入框上方显示运行时长卡片。

description.en: IM channel bridge: WeChat (ilinkai) / QQ / Feishu with proactive push — wake the channel bot from scheduled tasks and deliver AI replies to your phone.
description.zh: IM 渠道桥：微信（ilinkai）/ QQ / 飞书接入，支持主动推送——定时任务可唤醒渠道 bot 并把 AI 回复推送到手机。

description.en: macOS notifications with the standard Glass alert when a reply finishes or DSH needs your input.
description.zh: 回复完成或需要用户介入时，用 macOS 系统通知 + Glass 提示音提醒，点通知回到对应会话。

description.en: Discord adapter that installs into a dsh web or desktop profile: @mentions and threads bind to sessions with streaming replies and live tool-activity rows, nine slash commands cover workspace binding, permission presets and model selection, and tool approvals and user questions are claimed by whichever of Discord or the web UI answers first, behind a deny-first guild allowlist.
description.zh: 装进 dsh web / desktop profile 的 Discord 适配器：@提及与线程绑定会话，回复流式渲染并带实时工具活动行；九条斜杠命令覆盖工作区绑定、权限预设和模型选择；工具审批与提问在 Discord 与 web 端谁先答谁生效；guild 白名单默认拒绝。

description.en: Turn-end reminders for DSH 0.2.x — the host folds each session's last completed turn into a projection and the desktop shell shows it as a real Windows toast, with per-outcome filters, background-only gating and a settings page. The Windows desktop shell must register its AUMID once before toasts appear.
description.zh: DSH 0.2.x 的完成提醒——宿主把每个会话最后一次 turn/end 折成投影，桌面端再发成真正的 Windows toast；带按结束原因过滤、仅后台提醒和设置页；Windows 桌面壳需先注册一次 AUMID，toast 才能弹出。

description.en: QQ channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot v11/SnowLuma, with pairing-based access approval, long-term memory, a knowledge base, proactive events and an admin panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 渠道插件（OneBot v11 / SnowLuma）：默认配对审批（陌生人先待主人批准）、长期记忆、知识库、主动行为与管理后台。

description.en: Sounds and notifications when a task completes or waits for your approval or answer; notification sounds are configurable in the settings page (synth styles or your own audio file), with built-in cat hachimi sounds, just for fun. An optional Windows patch adds a taskbar digit, flashing and native toasts.
description.zh: 任务完成或等待批准、回答时播放提示音并发送通知；提示音可在设置页更换（合成音色或自选音频文件），内置猫咪 hachimi 音效，just for fun。可选的 Windows 补丁额外提供任务栏数字角标、闪烁与原生通知。

plugins.name: dsh-gotify-notify

description.en: Push a Gotify notification when each conversation turn ends, with configurable templates, priority and per-cause titles.
description.zh: 每轮会话结束时向 Gotify 服务器推送通知，支持模板、优先级与按结束原因区分标题。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: DSH secretary: triages your unread GitHub notifications by their real state every 15 minutes (closing what is already resolved), remembers dated things you tell it (bills, renewals, document expiries, birthdays) and reminds you when due, and watches your inbox read-only; secrets live in the system keychain only.
description.zh: DSH 小秘书：每 15 分钟按当前状态分诊 GitHub 未读通知（已解决的替你关掉），记住你交代的到期事项（账单、续费、证件、生日）到时提醒，只读盯着邮箱收件箱；密码只进系统钥匙串。

description.en: Sends a macOS Notification Center alert when a session finishes or the agent is blocked on an answer, an approval, or an error. The banner carries the last reply and plays your system alert sound, and clicking it returns you to the DSH page.
description.zh: 会话结束、或 Agent 卡在等你回答／批准／排错时，发一条 macOS 系统通知；横幅带上最后一条回复并播放你的系统提示音，点击即可回到 DSH 页面。

description.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QR one-click auth, card-based commands and intent-confirmation cards, at-least-once zero-loss outbox, media in/out, /doctor session-log ZIP, and a reusable DSH Web GUI that lands sessions in the right workspace.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的高可靠飞书/Lark 桥接：扫码一键认证、卡片化命令与意图确认、at-least-once 零丢失出站队列、多媒体出入站、/doctor 会话日志 ZIP，并复用 DSH Web GUI 把会话归入正确工作区。

description.en: Connects a Feishu self-built app over WebSocket, routes each chat to an independent DSH agent session, and streams replies through a Card JSON 2.0 card with plain-text fallback.
description.zh: 接入飞书自建应用，把每个飞书会话映射到独立的 DSH Agent，经卡片 JSON 2.0 流式回复，不可用时回退纯文本。

description.en: Conversation-completion notifications for DeepSeek Harness: Windows toast + sound on turn done / error / goal, plus ask & approval alerts - background-only, with a volume-adjustable bell in the conversation header.
description.zh: 对话完成通知：回合完成/出错/目标完成/提问/审批时弹出 Windows toast 与提示音，仅后台提醒，会话头部铃铛即控制中心。

description.en: Routes eight DSH lifecycle events through dedup, quiet hours and digest batching into seven channels. Severity maps to the fields Bark, ntfy, Telegram and webhooks actually support; failed deliveries retry with jittered backoff and survive a restart; per-channel circuit breakers stop hammering a dead endpoint; and a self-check reports a degraded relay instead of going silent.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的八类生命周期事件过去重、免打扰、摘要合批三道关后外发到七个通道。严重度映射到 Bark、ntfy、Telegram 和 webhook 真正支持的字段；失败投递带抖动退避重试并可跨重启恢复；单通道熔断避免反复敲一个已死的地址；自检发现中继降级时主动报告而不是静默。

description.en: Native Windows question and completion notifications with customizable titles and icons, foreground suppression, acknowledgement, and activation of an existing DSH browser tab; requires one-time local setup.
description.zh: Windows 原生提问与完成通知，支持自定义标题和图标、聚焦免打扰、确认收到及切回已有 DSH 标签页，首次使用需本机初始化。
