description.en: Multi-channel IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness: route WeChat (ClawBot/iLink), QQ, and Feishu (Lark) chat messages to a DSH agent and relay its replies back, with per-channel sessions and reply dedup.
description.zh: 多通道消息桥接插件：将微信 ClawBot / QQ / 飞书的消息接入 DSH agent，并把回复回传给发送者，按通道独立会话、回复去重。

description.en: macOS Share menu receiver for DeepSeek Harness: appends shared files, images, text and links to the current thread’s draft attachments (requires the DSH Share app).
description.zh: macOS 分享菜单接收端：把分享的文件、图片、文本和链接追加到 DeepSeek Harness 当前会话的草稿附件（需先安装 DSH Share App）。

description.en: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session; remote trigger endpoint and SSE channel (npm: `dsh-my-notify`).
description.zh: 会话（本轮）结束 / agent 询问 / 等待审批时弹浏览器通知 + 滴声，点击通知跳转会话；预留远程触发接口与 SSE 实时通道（npm: `dsh-my-notify`）。

description.en: Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one notification per session with a newer one replacing the old, and an idle notice reports how many background tasks are still running.
description.zh: 会话出现待回复交互或一轮跑完落到空闲时弹出浏览器系统通知，提示音由系统通知自带；不判断页面是否聚焦，每个会话最多保留一条通知、新通知顶掉旧的，空闲时若还有后台任务会在正文里说明数量。

description.en: Two-way WeChat (iLink) bridge: turn-end and approval-request push, in-chat approve/reject and message injection, persistent dedup and convergent long-reply chunking; channel layer extensible to other IMs.
description.zh: 微信（iLink）双向桥：turn 完成/批准请求推送、聊天内批准与消息注入、持久去重与长回复收敛分段；通道层为多 IM 预留。

description.en: Desktop notification reminders.
description.zh: 桌面通知提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-webbridge

description.en: DSH meets Kimi WebBridge.
description.zh: DSH 结合 Kimi WebBridge。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Native-style notification sounds for DeepSeek Harness: a chime when the agent needs your decision or finishes a task, clickable system notifications that jump back to the window, repeat reminders, quiet hours, and goal-mode alerts that wait for the final round.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生风格提示音插件：智能体需要你决策或任务完成时播放提示音，点击系统通知可跳回窗口；支持重复提醒、静音时段，以及目标模式下只在最终轮提醒。

description.en: macOS Dock badge and bubble chime: shows an unread badge on the Dock (dot while running, count when done) and plays a chime while the app is hidden; clears on return, built on the Badging API.
description.zh: macOS Dock 角标与提示音：最小化/切走时 Dock 显示未读角标（运行中=红点、跑完=数字）并播放水泡提示音，回到应用自动清除，基于 Badging API。

description.en: Native desktop notifications for DSH — approvals, questions, turn completion, session end and errors — with click-to-session, per-event toggles, quiet hours, a privacy switch that keeps message text off the banner, and a Web Audio tone per event type.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知：审批、提问、轮次完成、会话结束与出错时弹系统原生通知，点击直达对应会话；六类事件分别开关，支持免打扰时段与隐藏正文的隐私开关，并按事件类型合成提示音。

description.en: ACP bridge between BitFun and DSH.
description.zh: BitFun 与 DSH 的 ACP 交互对接。

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session activity to a self-hosted cc-monitor server, which surfaces Claude Code and DSH sessions as color-coded state cards in one web dashboard and pings your browser and Android app when a session needs attention.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动上报到自托管的 cc-monitor 服务器：Claude Code 与 DSH 会话以彩色状态卡片出现在同一个 Web 仪表盘中，会话需要关注时通过浏览器与 Android 应用通知你。

description.en: WeChat automation for DSH: push task progress to WeChat, listen for messages with keyword auto-reply, and a WeChat ↔ DSH two-way bridge controllable from the settings page, built on wxauto4.
description.zh: 基于 wxauto4 的微信自动化插件：任务进度微信推送、消息监听（关键词自动回复）、微信⇄DSH 双向桥，设置页开关与配置。

description.en: Tri-channel task notifications: in-page toasts with chimes, browser OS banners, and host-direct OS toasts that keep working with the browser closed, plus a bell panel with persistent history.
description.zh: 三通道任务通知：页内浮层与提示音、浏览器系统横幅、宿主直发系统通知（浏览器关闭也送达），附铃铛面板与持久历史。

description.en: Let your DSH agent browse Bilibili on its own, read subtitles, write a daily digest, and @ you when it finds something worth your attention.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 自己刷 B站 —— 读字幕原文挑内容、写日报，遇到值得看的会发评论 @ 你。

description.en: Bridge a Feishu bot to a DSH session: open a real session in a workspace, run tasks with the existing model and plugins, and report results back.
description.zh: 飞书机器人 → DSH 会话桥：在指定工作区开真会话，用 DSH 现有模型+插件执行任务并回传结论。

description.en: Poll Feishu (Lark) group and direct chats through lark-cli, extract candidate tasks with a review workflow, and two-way sync them with the task-board plugin, with a floating browser panel and one-click device-flow authorization.
description.zh: 通过 lark-cli 轮询飞书群聊与单聊，提取候选任务并逐条审核，与任务看板插件双向同步，含悬浮面板与一键授权。

description.en: Feishu bridge for DeepSeek Harness (derived from dsh-im-bridge): WebSocket long connection, approval cards, group @-mention-only replies, streaming card updates, /stop command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 飞书桥（衍生自 dsh-im-bridge）：长连接免公网、审批卡片、群聊仅 @ 回复、流式卡片打字机回显、/stop 中断任务。

description.en: Bridge DSH agent sessions, tool calls, and approvals to the CodeIsland macOS notch panel over a Unix socket, with in-panel allow/deny.
description.zh: 通过 Unix socket 把 DSH agent 的会话、工具调用与审批实时桥接到 CodeIsland macOS 刘海面板，可直接在面板上批准/拒绝。

plugins.name: dsh-qq-onebot-bridge

description.en: Bidirectional QQ bridge over OneBot v11 (reverse WebSocket): per-group and per-private-chat sessions, @-quoted voice speech-to-text, private image/animated-sticker viewing, face and sticker tools.
description.zh: 基于 OneBot v11 反向 WebSocket 的 QQ 双向桥：每群/每私聊用户独立会话、@引用语音转文字、私聊图片/动画表情识图、表情与贴纸工具。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.pushplus.plus

description.en: Desktop notifications and an app-icon unread badge for DeepSeek Harness. A banner fires when a turn finishes, when an approval, question or plan confirmation is waiting, and when a turn fails; the badge shows how many sessions need you and clears once viewed, and clicking a banner switches to that session. Follows the DSH interface language, subagent sessions stay quiet by default, titles and body length are configurable, and a loopback HTTP interface lets scripts and other tools post notifications.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加桌面通知与应用图标未读角标：一轮结束、等待审批／回答／计划确认、以及这一轮出错时各弹一条横幅；角标显示有几个会话需要你，看过之后清零，点横幅切到对应会话。文案跟随 DSH 界面语言，子智能体会话默认不提醒，标题与正文长度可配置；宿主还在回环地址上开了一个 HTTP 接口，供脚本和其它工具发通知。

description.en: Mirrors DeepSeek Harness task state (failed, waiting for your answer, finished) into the macOS Atoll Dynamic Island as one status light with three counts.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的任务状态（失败、等待你处理、已完成）镜像到 macOS Atoll 灵动岛上的同一枚状态灯，并显示三种状态的计数。

description.en: Notifies the DSH session that started a task-board card when that card settles, queueing the title, outcome, duration and next step into it; successes merge inside a configurable window (30 seconds by default) and failures are sent at once. A card that stops to ask is relayed to the same session, which answers through a tool.
description.zh: 任务看板卡片结算后，把标题、成败、耗时与下一步排队送进发起该卡的那个 DSH 会话；成功卡按可配置窗口合并（默认 30 秒），失败卡立即发送。卡片执行中提问时，问题也送回同一个会话，再由它把回答交回卡片。

description.en: Webhook notifications for dsh sessions: a POST when an approval is requested or a turn ends, to ntfy, Bark, a Slack/DingTalk/WeCom bot URL, or any HTTPS endpoint.
description.zh: dsh 会话的 Webhook 通知：审批被请求或回合结束时发送 POST，可发往 ntfy、Bark、Slack/钉钉/企微机器人地址或任意 HTTPS 端点。

description.en: Strikes a single short chime, raises the DSH window, floats a reminder card above the page and sends a system notification whenever the agent needs your approval or an answer. Sound and popup are two independent switches in the session header, remembered across reloads and restarts.
description.zh: 需要授权或确认时敲一记短音、把 DSH 窗口提到最前、在页面最上层浮出提醒卡片，并弹一条系统通知。声音与弹窗是会话头部上的两个独立开关，刷新与重启后仍然保持。

description.en: Windows system-level notifications when the agent finishes a task or needs your input: task-done, question, approval and plan-review alerts via the browser Notification API, click-to-open the session, background-only mode, and a first-level settings page (Settings → 任务提示).
description.zh: 任务完成或需要你输入/批准时弹出 Windows 系统通知（浏览器 Notification API）：完成/提问/审批/计划审阅提醒，点击气泡直达会话，支持后台模式，设置页在官方设置 → 任务提示。

description.en: Telegram notifications for DeepSeek Harness questions, approval requests, and completed turns. Notification-only: one runtime file, zero runtime dependencies, no custom question cards.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的提问、审批请求与回合完成发送 Telegram 通知。仅通知不改交互：单运行时文件、零运行时依赖、不自建问题卡片。

description.en: Notification reminders, message alerts and desktop notification for DSH — a desktop notifier that raises a system toast, a sound and a tab-title marker when the agent needs your input (approval, plan review, question) or a reply is finished in the background (task complete / completion alerts, notify when done); the Settings page holds the master switch, sound and volume, the per-case toggles and the zh/en notification language.
description.zh: 通知提醒 / 消息提醒 / 消息通知 / 桌面通知弹窗 / 桌面提醒 / 弹窗通知、弹窗提醒 / 任务提醒、任务完成提醒 / 后台提醒、回复完成提醒 / 审批提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或任务、回复跑完时，弹出系统通知（可操作提醒、审批通知、完成通知）与提示音，并标记标签页标题；这是一款 DSH 通知提醒插件、DSH 提醒插件、消息通知插件，设置页可开关提醒、调音量、切换中英文通知语言。

description.en: Plays a chime when DeepSeek Harness asks for approval; tone, volume and on/off are set in Settings → Notifications.
description.zh: DSH 请求审批时响一声提示音；音色、音量与开关在「设置 → 通知提醒」里调。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness agent sessions into Feishu (Lark) chats over the official SDK long connection, with a streaming reply card, many bots per instance, and mention-gated group replies.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 会话接进飞书（Lark）：官方 SDK 长连接收发、流式回复卡片、单实例多 bot、群里 @ 才回复。

description.en: Multi-channel IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness: each QQ (SnowLuma / OneBot v11, official QQ Bot) or Discord group and private chat becomes its own agent session, bound to a role card whose domain carries knowledge bases with draft approval, shared memory, a read-only GitHub reader and group trigger rules; two built-in personas (customer support, group chat), unified push with broadcast, and human hand-off.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多渠道 IM 桥：QQ（SnowLuma / OneBot v11、官方 QQ Bot）与 Discord 的每个群、每个私聊都对应一个独立的 agent 会话，会话绑定角色卡、角色卡背后的领域承载知识库（含草稿审批）、共享记忆、只读 GitHub 查询与群聊触发策略；内置客服与群聊两套人格，支持统一推送（含广播）与人工接管。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH Web sessions: browser notifications plus Windows toast when a session finishes, fails, needs an approval, or asks a question. Clicking one opens the session; browser notifications focus an open tab, Windows toasts open a new tab.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话提供桌面通知：会话完成、失败、需要审批或提问时发送浏览器通知，在 Windows/WSL 下同时弹出系统 Toast；点击通知定位到对应会话（浏览器通知聚焦已打开标签页，Toast 新开标签页）。

description.en: WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over Tencent's iLink bot channel: one session per contact, inbound text/images/files, and WeChat's native typing indicator while a turn runs.
description.zh: 基于腾讯 iLink 机器人通道的微信桥：每个联系人一个独立会话，支持入站文本/图片/文件，并在整轮运行期间显示微信原生“正在输入”。

description.en: Task-completion notifications: desktop alerts via macOS Notification Center and Windows Toast, plus mobile push through Bark, ntfy, ServerChan or any webhook when an agent run goes idle, errors or blocks.
description.zh: 任务完成通知推送：代理转入空闲、出错或阻塞时，经 macOS 通知中心、Windows Toast 及 Bark、ntfy、Server酱、通用 Webhook 发送系统通知。

description.en: Notifications for four session states, with browser alerts and prompts.
description.zh: 会话完成等四种状态的通知响应，支持浏览器提示。

description.en: Native OS notifications for approval and question/plan prompts: the toast names the workspace, click jumps to it, bilingual (zh-CN/zh-TW/en), with chime.
description.zh: 审批与选择方案的系统级桌面通知：通知显示所属工作区、点击跳转到对应工作区，多语言（简中/繁中/英文），附提示音。

description.en: macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or subagent-end via terminal-notifier; clicking a banner opens a configured app and returning to the page auto-dismisses them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 系统通知插件：任务中止、超限、阻塞、中断、出错、等待提问或批准、完成或子代理结束等事件通过 terminal-notifier 弹系统横幅；点击横幅打开指定应用，回到页面自动清空。

description.en: Task-queue execution endpoint for DSH: requires a separately self-deployed Hermes Agent gateway plus your own WeChat inbound script; verified on a single environment — expect to adapt it.
description.zh: DSH 的任务队列执行端点：需要自行部署独立的 Hermes Agent 网关并编写自己的微信入站脚本；仅在单一环境验证过，需要按你的环境适配。

description.en: Plays a voice alert and a browser notification when a turn finishes, asks for input, or fails, and can push the same summary to a Feishu bot webhook as a card.
description.zh: 回合完成、需要你输入或执行失败时播放语音提醒并发送浏览器通知，还可把同样的摘要以卡片推送到飞书机器人 webhook。

description.en: Windows only. Autonomous news briefing on user absence or continuous schedule, illustration & anime gallery with tagging and QQ bot search, plus native OS desktop alerts for AI completions, delivered to DSH sessions or IM bots.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。离席或持续自主资讯全网检索与多端推送，精选二次元/色图插画画廊与点图搜图，以及会话状态全局系统原生桌面弹窗通知，支持投递至 DSH 会话与 IM 机器人。

description.en: Sends a QQ direct message through a local NapCat (OneBot) instance when DeepSeek Harness asks for permission, after verifying the bot QQ; requires owner/bot QQ ids plus the NapCat endpoint and token, and falls back to a Windows notification when NapCat is unreachable.
description.zh: 通过本机 NapCat（OneBot）在 DSH 弹出权限申请时给主人发 QQ 私信，先校验机器人 QQ；需要配置主人/机器人 QQ 号与 NapCat 地址、token，NapCat 不可用时回退 Windows 通知。

description.en: Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS notification.
description.zh: agent 回合结束时在浏览器标签页里播放一声合成的叮,纯前端 Web Audio 发音,不经过后端、不弹系统通知。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness covering approval requests, questions, run completion, errors and sign-in prompts, with the conversation name as the first line of every notification.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：申请权限、提问、任务完成、出错与登录提醒，每条通知第一行都是会话名称。

description.en: Multi-channel push notification plugin supporting Bark (iOS) and ntfy (Android/iOS/Web/Desktop) for turn completion, approvals, questions, and quota halts.
description.zh: 多渠道推送通知插件，支持 Bark (iOS) 与 ntfy (全平台)，覆盖回合结束、操作授权、交互提问及额度耗尽异常停机。

description.en: During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.
description.zh: agent 思考超时时，直接在对话流中推出一条今日头条热点或提醒消息。

description.en: OneBot v11 hub: sits between an upstream OneBot implementation (LLOneBot and similar) and downstream bot implementations, relaying events and actions verbatim, and gives the agent a per-session timeline, an action ledger, layered memory (active topics and tasks, long-term events, person and group profiles) and onebot_* tools for replying, media, members and raw API calls.
description.zh: OneBot v11 枢纽：夹在上游 OneBot 实现（LLOneBot 等）与下游 bot 实现之间，逐字转发事件与动作；给 agent 一条按会话的时间线、动作账本、分层记忆（进行中的话题与任务、长期事件、人物与群档案）以及一组 onebot_* 工具（回复、媒体、成员、原始 API 调用）。

description.en: Windows native toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness with a progress bar, automatic retraction, goal-mode summaries, click-to-session, and a taskbar unread badge for distinct root sessions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带进度条、自动收回、Goal 模式汇总和点击回会话的 Windows 原生通知，以及按不同根会话计数的任务栏未读角标。

description.en: Unread count on the browser tab icon and the Windows taskbar button, with a chime when a turn finishes.
description.zh: 回合结束时在浏览器标签页图标和 Windows 任务栏图标上显示未读数，并播放提示音。

description.en: QQ-style alert sounds for DSH: the QQ message tone when a turn finishes and the QQ system tone when approval or an answer is needed, reading your local QQ install on Windows and falling back to built-in tones.
description.zh: 用本机 QQ 的音效提醒 DSH：任务完成响好友消息音，需要审批或回答问题时响系统消息音；Windows 下自动发现 QQ 目录，其它平台回落到内置音效。

plugins.name: dsh-mobile-remote

description.en: Drive your dsh agent from WeChat over the iLink gateway: two-way encrypted media transfer (auto-decrypt inbox + /send), proactive weixin_send tool, completion notifications, multi-session switching, and a health panel with file logging.
description.zh: 微信遥控 DeepSeek Harness：iLink 双向加密文件收发（入站自动解密落盘 + /send 出站）、weixin_send 主动通知、完成通知、多会话切换、健康面板与文件日志。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥接：双向会话、对话引导、主频道路由，以及以 Telegram 语音消息发送的 TTS 语音笔记。

description.en: Limbus Company desktop-lyrics style toasts for session events: approval requests, turn start and turn end appear as per-character animated text above every window on Windows — ripple/drop entry and exit, jitter or wave motion, per-event glow colors, random left/right screen-side placement, {tool}/{outcome}/{title} message templates, all editable live from a settings page in the DSH GUI; the transparent companion overlay is auto-launched by the plugin host and respawned when it disappears. Windows only; requires running npm install inside the package companion/ directory once to fetch Electron ^33 for the overlay.
description.zh: 会话事件（权限请求、回合开始/结束）以 Limbus Company 桌面歌词风格的逐字动画浮在所有窗口之上：波纹/跌落入退场、抖动或波动律动、分事件光晕配色、屏幕两侧随机落位、{tool}/{outcome}/{title} 文案模板，全部参数在 DSH 设置页实时编辑；透明悬浮伴侣窗由宿主自动拉起、消失即守护重生。仅 Windows；需在包内 companion/ 目录执行一次 npm install 以安装悬浮窗依赖的 Electron ^33。

description.en: Enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness: block & reasoning streaming, usage telemetry, model/effort switching, permission presets, session resume/archive, per-session MCP servers, and Zed file/terminal forwarding.
description.zh: 增强版 ACP 服务器：块级与推理流式、用量遥测、模型/推理强度切换、权限预设、会话恢复/归档、每会话 MCP servers、Zed 文件/终端转发。

description.en: Automatically retrieves time-of-use pricing data (with Beijing Time) and notifies users during peak periods to reduce costs.
description.zh: 自动获取分时电价数据（按北京时间），在高峰时段提醒用户，以降低用电成本。

description.en: Persistent WeChat bridge for DSH: one WeChat user maps to one persistent agent session via the official iLink channel, with context and the user-to-session registry surviving restarts. There is no sender allowlist — anyone who can message the paired WeChat account can start a conversation with a session that has tool access, and the working directory defaults to the home directory; use a dedicated account and set WECHAT_PERSISTENT_CWD.
description.zh: DSH 的持久微信桥：一个微信用户对应一个持久智能体会话，走官方 iLink 通道，上下文与用户→会话映射在重启后保留。没有发送者白名单——任何能给所配对微信号发消息的人都能发起对话并获得拥有工具权限的会话，工作目录默认是用户主目录；请使用专用账号并设置 WECHAT_PERSISTENT_CWD。

description.en: Flashes the Windows taskbar icon in the DSH desktop app when a turn finishes in the background or an approval or question is waiting for you.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版在后台跑完一轮、或等你审批 / 回答时，闪烁 Windows 任务栏图标。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to LINE: runs its own signed webhook server, sets up a Cloudflare Tunnel (quick URL or an API-token tunnel), keeps the LINE webhook endpoint pointed at the current tunnel, and gives each LINE user a separate session with a chosen persona, plus optional scheduled check-ins. Requires a LINE Messaging API channel (Channel ID and Channel Secret); only allow-listed LINE users, or users approved from the pending queue, can talk to the bot.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 LINE 的橋接外掛：內建簽章驗證的 webhook 伺服器、Cloudflare Tunnel（quick URL 或 API Token）、自動把 LINE webhook 端點指向目前的隧道、每位 LINE 使用者獨立 session 與可選人設，並可排程主動傳訊。需要 LINE Messaging API 頻道（Channel ID／Channel Secret）；只有白名單內、或在面板核准的使用者能與機器人對話。

description.en: One-click launcher for the Web UI: a double-click Start-DSH-Web.cmd on the Windows desktop that boots dsh web and auto-opens the browser (polling until ready), plus a web_launcher model tool (install / open / status).
description.zh: Web 界面一键启动器：在 Windows 桌面创建双击即用的 Start-DSH-Web.cmd（自动启动 dsh web，轮询就绪后自动打开浏览器），并提供 web_launcher 模型工具（install / open / status）。

description.en: Two small macOS features in one plugin. keepAwake stops the display and system from sleeping while dsh runs (caffeinate tied to the host process). taskNotify posts a system notification when a top-level conversation finishes its turn, with the outcome (completed, error, blocked, output cap) and the duration; clicking the notification brings DeepSeek Harness forward. Click-to-focus needs Xcode Command Line Tools to build the notifier; without the toolchain the notification still appears but clicking it opens Script Editor. Subagents and Agent Teams members never notify, and a stop you pressed is silent by default. Both features can be switched off separately.
description.zh: 一个插件里的两个 macOS 小功能。keepAwake：dsh 运行期间不让屏幕和系统休眠（caffeinate 跟随宿主进程，dsh 退出即解除）。taskNotify：主对话一轮结束时发系统通知，写明结果（完成、出错、被拦截、输出达到上限）和用时；点击通知会切回 DeepSeek Harness。点击切回需要 Xcode Command Line Tools 构建通知助手；没有工具链时仍会提醒，但点击打开的是「脚本编辑器」。子智能体和 Agent Teams 成员不提醒，你手动停止的任务默认不提醒。两个功能可以分别关闭。

description.en: Floating ZenTao work center: a right-edge sidebar listing tasks, bugs and stories assigned to you, with drag-to-chat, original links and auto-refresh.
description.zh: 悬浮禅道工作台：右侧边栏展示指派给你的任务、Bug 与需求，支持拖拽到聊天、原始链接与自动刷新。

description.en: Windows toast and a chime whenever a conversation task stops: completed, waiting on your approval or answer, or failed. Clicking the toast reopens that session at your last question, and in DSH Desktop it also raises the window.
description.zh: 对话任务停止时弹一条 Windows 通知并响一声提示音：完成、等你审批或回答、出错都会提醒。点通知回到那个会话，落在你上次提问的位置；桌面端还会把窗口拉到前台。

description.en: Task-complete and question notification sounds for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a soft chime when the agent finishes a turn, a ding-dong when it asks you something (questions, plan reviews, approvals). Synthesized Web Audio, zero assets, mute toggle and volume slider in the session header and settings.
description.zh: 任务完成与提问提示音：Agent 完成回合时播放一声轻快提示音，向你提问（普通提问/计划评审/权限确认）时播放叮咚声。Web Audio 实时合成、零资源零网络，会话头部带静音开关，设置页可调音量。

description.en: Native RSS monitor for DeepSeek Harness: multi-source subscription, keyword filtering, scheduled polling with smart dedup, and email notifications for new items (HTML template with thumbnail cards), with SMTP passwords stored only in the credential store.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 RSS 订阅监控插件：多源订阅、关键词过滤、定时检查去重、新条目邮件通知（缩略图 HTML 模板），SMTP 密码走凭据库永不落盘，原生设置页四页签体验。

description.en: Toasts from DeepSeek Harness when a turn finishes, and when it stops for approval, a question or a plan exit. Native on Windows, text and timing configurable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面通知：任务完成时、或停下来等你审批/回答/确认计划时弹出系统通知。文案与触发时机可配置。

description.en: Telegram mobile remote that attaches the phone to a live DeepSeek Harness Web session: workspace-then-session picker (/sessions), /last for the previous Q/A, /model switch, and native Rich Message replies.
description.zh: Telegram 手机遥控器：附着本机正在跑的 Web 会话，支持 /sessions 工作区→会话选择、/last 查看上次问答、/model 切换模型，以及原生 Rich Message 回复。

description.en: Plays a sound when a DSH task completes, fails, or waits for approval, with per-category switches.
description.zh: 在 DSH 任务完成、失败或等待授权时播放提示音，并提供分类开关。

description.en: Reminder bubbles beside the input for DeepSeek Harness: any plugin or AI can push reminders (text/link) with chat-style stacking, drag-resize, AI summary, visual customization and random outfit presets. A static profile plugin available in every preset without disappearing on restart.
description.zh: 在输入框右边加了一个泡泡窗口，你可以接入插件或者告诉 AI 什么时候使用它。

description.en: Five task-state reminders for DeepSeek Harness (completion, approval, question, block, error) with four synthesized browser sound presets, optional question text in the notification, an optional native Windows and WSL toast channel that bypasses Focus Assist, and a terminal-BEL fallback when no browser is ready.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供五类任务状态提醒（完成、审批、提问、受阻、出错）：四种浏览器合成音方案、可在通知中显示提问正文、可选的原生 Windows/WSL 通知通道（可越过专注助手），没有就绪浏览器时降级为终端 BEL。

description.en: Feishu/Lark integration for DeepSeek Harness through the official lark-cli: a sidebar panel for app setup and QR sign-in, a command console, and agent tools that run any lark-cli command across 18 business domains, 200+ high-level commands and the full OpenAPI; the official CLI is downloaded on first use on Windows, macOS or Linux.
description.zh: 通过飞书官方 lark-cli 接入 DeepSeek Harness：侧边栏面板完成应用初始化与扫码登录，内置命令控制台，并提供 Agent 工具执行任意 lark-cli 命令，覆盖 18 大业务域、200+ 高层命令与全量 OpenAPI；首次使用时自动下载对应平台的官方 CLI（Windows / macOS / Linux）。

description.en: Windows balloon notifications for session lifecycle events (new / running / finished / error) across all workspaces, with a session-store watch that catches headless and A2A dispatch sessions whose events never reach the host bus. Windows only.
description.zh: 会话生命周期事件（新建 / 运行中 / 完成 / 出错）的 Windows 气泡通知，覆盖所有工作区；还会监听会话存储，捕捉事件从不经过宿主总线的无头与 A2A 派发会话。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Windows taskbar unread badge and window-bounds restore for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 Windows 任务栏图标上显示 DSH 未读会话数，并恢复上次关闭时的窗口大小和位置。

description.en: Host-side macOS notifications for questions, approvals and finished replies — immune to hidden-renderer notification loss, with icon, sound and click-to-raise.
description.zh: 宿主侧 macOS 系统通知：提问/审批/回复完成即时送达，免疫渲染层隐藏丢通知，带图标、提示音与点击抬窗。

description.en: Always-on-top notch for Windows that shows which sessions are working, which need you, and which are done or failed: one bot per session, never takes focus, hides under full-screen apps, with its own settings page.
description.zh: Windows 屏幕顶部始终置顶的刘海：每个会话一个小机器人，显示哪些在工作、哪些在等你、哪些已完成或失败；不抢焦点，全屏应用下自动隐藏，带独立设置页。

description.en: In-page task notifications with collapsible status toasts, sound, and session navigation.
description.zh: 带可折叠状态通知、提示音与会话跳转的页内任务通知插件。

plugins.name: dsh-lark-bridge

description.en: Bidirectional Lark/Feishu controller for DeepSeek Harness with project and session routing, interactive cards, approvals, attachments, and task controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 双向控制器，支持 Project 与 Session 路由、交互卡片、审批、附件和任务控制。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Sends an Edge/Windows desktop notification when a tool call waits for approval, the agent asks you to choose an option, or a session finishes a turn, and only while the DSH page is in the background or unfocused; an optional chime covers cases where the browser or Windows suppresses the notification.
description.zh: 工具调用等待审批、智能体提问等你选择、或会话跑完一轮时，弹出 Edge/Windows 桌面通知，且只在你不看 DSH 页面（后台或未聚焦）时提醒；浏览器或 Windows 抑制通知时可用可选提示音兜底。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Avernet's Bot Collaboration Network over WebSocket V2, with automatic onboarding, isolated agent sessions, tool-call events, and multi-bot routing tools.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket V2 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Avernet Bot 协作网络，支持自动注册、Agent 会话隔离、工具调用事件和多 Bot 路由工具。

description.en: Windows desktop launcher for the DSH Web UI: desktop shortcut, silent start, system tray with open/full-exit (stop service, close app window, quit tray), PWA app window with focus-instead-of-relaunch, install prompt, and task-completion notifications.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面化启动器：桌面快捷方式、静默启动、系统托盘（打开 / 彻底退出＝停服务＋关应用窗口＋退托盘）、PWA 应用窗口（已运行则聚焦不重复弹窗）、安装引导、任务完成通知。

description.en: Approval sound effects from the movie NiuLai: plays 「妈妈」 when user confirmation is requested, interrupts it and plays 「牛来！」 the moment the user approves; native Windows playback, zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 牛来确认音：请求用户确认时播放「妈妈」，批准瞬间掐断并播放「牛来！」；梗源电影《牛来》，Windows 原生播放，零外部依赖。

description.en: Two-way agent bridge for Feishu (Lark) and DingTalk groups: chat with a DeepSeek Harness agent from IM groups via long-connection / Stream Mode — no public port needed. Workspace selection/creation, session switching, archiving (synced with DSH GUI), configurable from the DSH settings page. Feishu uses interactive cards, DingTalk uses text commands.
description.zh: 飞书 / 钉钉群双向桥接：在 IM 群里直接与 DeepSeek Harness agent 对话（飞书长连接 / 钉钉 Stream 模式，无需公网端口）。支持工作区选择/创建、会话切换、归档（与 DSH GUI 同步）、设置页图形化配置。飞书交互卡片、钉钉文本命令。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness via `dsh plugin add`; one DM user to one persistent dsh session, with full debugging docs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 私聊桥接插件，支持 `dsh plugin add` 一键安装，配套完整调试文档。

description.en: Nudges the main agent of a long-running DSH session to report progress at a configurable interval, with exponential back-off, stuck detection, a per-session Progress tab, and a manual "nudge now" action.
description.zh: 主 agent 长时间执行时按可配置间隔提醒它播报进度，支持指数退避、卡住检测、会话「进度」标签页与手动「立即催一次」。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness sessions to Feishu/Lark, Telegram and DingTalk: each chat is bound to a resumable DSH session, replies stream back as cards, and a task-end card reports the model, token usage, step count and duration. Question and permission-approval cards are answerable from the chat, and a web settings pane configures the per-channel credentials.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话接入飞书/Lark、Telegram 与钉钉：每个聊天绑定一个可续接的 DSH 会话，回复以卡片流式回传，任务结束时用一张结果卡汇报模型、token 用量、步数与耗时。提问与权限审批可直接在聊天里作答，各渠道凭据在 Web 设置面板中配置。

description.en: Telegram remote control for DeepSeek Harness: list conversations with titles and workspaces, resume paused persisted sessions on demand (preset remount), turn-tracked reply relay, first-line reasoning summaries, inline-button approve/reject with outcome edits, and a bot command menu.
description.zh: Telegram 远程控制插件：会话列表（标题+工作目录）、按需恢复暂停的持久化会话（重挂 preset）、按回合精准回传回复、💭 思考摘要、✅/❌ 内联按钮审批（结果回写原消息）、bot 命令菜单。

description.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you are away, with stable SMTP (no 535 retry loop), connect and idle timeouts, and a --check self-test.
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：稳定 SMTP（不重试 535）、连接与空闲超时，并带 --check 自检。

description.en: Chat with, monitor, and approve your DSH agents from WeChat via the iLink gateway: text both ways, session targeting, digest heartbeats, and numbered approval prompts.
description.zh: 通过 iLink 网关在微信里与 DSH agent 聊天、监控与审批：双向文本、会话切换、进度摘要与编号审批提示。

description.en: Top-right status plate for six session states (complete, error, approval, question, unopenable, subagent), plus an OS notification when you are away.
description.zh: 右上角状态提示板，覆盖六种会话状态（完成、出错、待授权、待回答、会话打不开、子 agent 在跑），不在看 DSH 时发系统通知。

description.en: macOS notch panel for DeepSeek Harness: running sessions and pending approvals sit above every window, approvals are decided in place, and clicking a row opens that conversation in the desktop app. Requires macOS 14+ and Xcode Command Line Tools.
description.zh: macOS 灵动岛桥接：运行中的会话与待审批操作浮在所有窗口之上，审批直接在岛上裁决，点一行可在桌面端打开对应会话。需 macOS 14+ 与 Xcode Command Line Tools。

description.en: MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT Web create, view, continue, and supervise DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and goals while preserving DSH's native approval, sandbox, and workspace security model.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 让 ChatGPT Web 创建、查看、继续和监督 DeepSeek Harness Agent 会话与 Goal，同时保留 DSH 原生的审批、沙箱与工作区安全模型。

plugins.name: dsh-helper

description.en: Send local files to WeChat from any DSH session by reusing an installed IM plugin, plus cron-scheduled tasks that run in fresh sessions, a workspace activity glow, a header activity indicator, a completion chime, a macOS sidebar vibrancy toggle and a one-click host restart.
description.zh: 在任意 DSH 会话把本机文件主动投递到微信（复用已装的 IM 插件），另有按 cron 在全新会话里跑的定时任务、工作区活动呼吸灯、标题栏活跃指示、对话完成提示音、关闭 macOS 侧栏毛玻璃与一键重启宿主。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Feishu (Lark) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: one-command install, streaming progress cards with a tool panel, ask/approval button cards, attachments, and proactive feishu_send pushes.
description.zh: 飞书入口插件：一条命令安装，流式进度卡片带工具面板、提问/审批按钮卡片、附件处理与 feishu_send 主动推送。

description.en: Multi-channel notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness: dispatches in-page toasts in the foreground and PWA system notifications (Service Worker) or browser notifications in the background, with per-event toggles for task complete, approval request, question, plan review and errors, persistent notifications, and Web Audio synthesized alert sounds without audio files.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多通道通知插件：前台弹页面内 toast，后台按可用性切换 PWA 系统通知（Service Worker）或浏览器通知兜底；任务完成、审批请求、提问、计划评审、出错等事件可逐项开关，重要通知驻留不消失，并用 Web Audio 实时合成提示音效、零音频文件零网络上报。

plugins.name: dsh-im-humanize

description.en: Humanized fork of @xmanrui/dsh-im (base 4.21.2): humanized message delivery with send-delay and typing two-phase, message_break + streaming coexistence, status reactions, reply quotes, per-bot humanize overrides, and a no_reply reclaim tool — across WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Telegram, Slack and WhatsApp channels.
description.zh: @xmanrui/dsh-im 的拟人化分支（基于上游 4.21.2）：人化消息发送（发送延迟 + 输入中两阶段）、message_break 与 streaming 共存、状态表情、回复引用、per-bot 全量拟人化覆盖、no_reply 回收工具，覆盖微信/飞书/钉钉/企业微信/QQ/Telegram/Slack/WhatsApp 全通道。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Windows toast notifications for approval requests, questions, completed or failed runs, and sign-in prompts; clicking a notification reopens the conversation that raised it, and toasts are attributed to the DeepSeek Harness app identity.
description.zh: 等待授权、等待选择、对话完成或出错、需要登录时在 Windows 通知栏弹出提醒；点击通知直接跳回发出它的对话，通知以 DeepSeek Harness 应用身份显示。

description.en: Sound + popup when a task completes: a Web Audio chime, an in-page toast, and a system notification while the page is in the background (browser-only, cross-platform).
description.zh: 任务完成时播放提示音并弹出小通知：Web Audio 合成音效、页面内 toast、页面在后台时系统通知，纯浏览器方案、零系统依赖、跨平台。

description.en: Plays a random chime when a reply finishes, a one-shot reminder chime if the conversation stays quiet for a configurable number of seconds afterwards, and a chime the moment DSH needs you to step in: an approval request, a question, or a plan confirmation. Three independent switches and sound pools, persisted on disk.
description.zh: 每轮回复结束随机播一声完成音效；之后若静默到设定秒数，再补响一次提醒；DSH 需要你出面（审批、提问、确认计划）时立刻响一声。三个独立开关：A/C 为可批量导入的音效池，B 为单个提醒音；设置全部落盘持久化。

description.en: Shows a system notification when a turn finishes, carrying the session title and a summary of the reply.
description.zh: 每轮对话正常结束时弹出系统通知，标题是会话名，正文是本轮回答的摘要。

description.en: Native desktop alerts when dsh needs the human — approvals, questions, plan reviews, turn completion, goals, errors and workflow runs — plus a Settings tab for every option, hot-applied.
description.zh: 当 dsh 需要你注意时发出桌面通知——权限确认、提问、计划审批、回合完成、目标、出错、工作流——并提供设置页「通知」选项卡，改动即时生效。

description.en: macOS 13+. Plays a macOS system sound when DeepSeek Harness needs a tool approval, an agent question, a macOS permission prompt, or an administrator password sheet, then repeats on a 0/25/20/15/10/5 second cadence until the request is resolved. Ships as a bundle with a switch and a config form in the Plugins page.
description.zh: 需 macOS 13+。在 DeepSeek Harness 需要工具审批、Agent 提问、macOS 权限弹窗或管理员密码弹窗时播放系统提示音，并按 0/25/20/15/10/5 秒节奏重复提醒，直到请求被处理。以 bundle 形式提供，在侧边栏插件页带开关和中文配置表单；需 macOS 13+。

description.en: Real Windows OS toasts for DeepSeek Harness: task-finished, needs-input and needs-approval alerts that persist in Notification Center under DeepSeek branding. Windows-only, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 真正的 Windows 系统 Toast（通知中心持久、DeepSeek 品牌鲸鱼图标）：任务完成 / 需要输入 / 需要审批时提醒。仅支持 Windows，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Two-way WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness via the iLink protocol: bind your personal WeChat with a QR scan and chat with a local DSH agent from the chat box (text, images, voice-to-text, files); a web settings panel handles binding/start/stop/status, project-session binding continues the conversation on desktop, proactive wechat_notify pushes include throttling, and the pure-Node daemon runs on Windows/macOS/Linux.
description.zh: 基于 iLink 协议的 DSH 微信双向桥：扫码绑定个人微信后在聊天框直接与本机 DSH Agent 对话（文字/图片/语音转文字/文件），Web 设置面板管理扫码绑定/启停/状态，支持绑定项目会话跨端续聊，agent 可主动 wechat_notify 推送（内置节流），纯 Node 守护进程，Windows/macOS/Linux 三端通用。

description.en: Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 生命周期提示音：10 个可配置事件，默认只开启三项低打扰提示，可为每个事件更换自定义声音，内置音效不带音频资源。

plugins.name: dsh-dingtalk-notify

description.en: DingTalk alerts when the agent needs your choice or approval, or finishes a turn; it stays quiet while you are watching the DSH page.
description.zh: 钉钉提醒：AI 需要你选择、审批或干完活时推送到钉钉群；有人正看着 DSH 页面就不发，没人看才提醒。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to bad

description.en: QQ hub for DeepSeek Harness: private and group chats over OneBot v11 (SnowLuma/NapCat), with per-chat scoped memory, per-chat persona routing, a vision helper that narrates images for text-only models, multi-platform link parsing (large videos sent as group files, image galleries sent inline or as merged-forward messages) and a web panel for models, personas and settings. Derived from aureth-labs/dsh-aurabot-qq; do not install both.
description.zh: 把 QQ 接入 DeepSeek Harness：经 OneBot v11（SnowLuma / NapCat）接私聊与群聊，按会话隔离记忆、按会话分流人格，文本模型收图时由辅助模型转述，多平台链接解析（大视频转群文件，图集以图片或合并转发发出），并提供网页管理面板。改自 aureth-labs/dsh-aurabot-qq，不能与上游同装。

description.en: Plays a chime when the AI asks a clarifying question (a `?` / `？` in the message, or an `ask_user_question` tool call). Synthesized via Web Audio API, no audio file, works on every OS.
description.zh: 当 AI 询问澄清性问题时（带问号或调用 ask_user_question）播放提示音。Web Audio API 合成，零音频文件，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

description.en: Shows a Windows 11 toast notification when a DeepSeek Harness session turn finishes, and stays quiet while a DSH window is focused.
description.zh: DSH 会话每轮结束时在 Windows 11 右下角弹出系统通知；DSH 窗口在前台时自动跳过，避免打扰。

description.en: Bridge DSH sessions, prompts, tool calls and approvals to CodeIsland's macOS notch, including the latest reply on Stop.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的会话、提问、工具调用与审批桥接到 CodeIsland 的 macOS 刘海面板，并在停止时报上最近一次回复。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DSH: a system toast, a per-kind chime and a tab-title marker when the agent needs you (approval, plan review, question) or a reply finishes in the background; errors, interrupts, usage limits and multi-agent workflow progress alert too. A host half adds SSE delivery, webhook push (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/generic), per-turn token/cache/TPS stats, plus three message-format presets (concise, detailed, custom); settings changes auto-save.
description.zh: DSH 桌面消息提醒：模型需要你操作（审批、方案确认、提问）或后台回复完成时，弹系统通知、提示音并标记标签页标题；出错、中断、用量上限与多 agent 工作流进展同样提醒。宿主半提供 SSE 投递、Webhook 推送（企业微信 / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 通用）与当轮统计（token / 缓存 / TPS），以及三档消息格式（简洁 / 详细 / 自定义）与自动保存。

description.en: Bottom-right DSH-styled Windows cards for approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished runs: click to jump back to the app that started the session (DSH by default), close with the × button, or let it close when you return.
description.zh: 工具请求审批、模型提问、计划待审阅或运行结束时，在右下角弹出 DSH 风格置顶卡片；点一下切回发起该会话的应用（默认 DSH），点 × 关闭，或切回时自动关闭。

plugins.name: work-personal-secretary#work-personal-secretary

description.en: Installer and configuration base for a five-plugin DSH assistant suite: probes the Python, WPS and workspace environment, installs the sibling plugins shipped in the same repository, and generates the workspace baseline (instruction layer, memory seed, skills, settings); it also contributes its own settings section and its own host-side setup and check logic.
description.zh: DSH 工作秘书集成体的本体：做安装引导（Python / WPS / 工作区环境探针、安装同仓库分发的子插件）与配置底座（生成指令层、记忆种子、技能、设置），并在界面里提供独立的「工作秘书」设置分区，自带宿主侧安装与检查逻辑。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (install)

description.en: Speaks a short status line when DSH changes state — turn done, turn error, job done, job failed, goal complete, goal blocked, an approval waiting, or the agent needs your answer — using eight pre-recorded clips in Chinese (default) and English. The audio is played by the host process through ffplay, or through the Windows PowerShell player that ships with the OS, so it does not depend on a Web Audio tab. Windows only.
description.zh: DSH 状态变化时读出一句简短提示——本轮完成、本轮出错、后台任务结束、后台任务失败、目标完成、目标受阻、等待批准、等待你回答——中文（默认）与英文各八条预录语音。音频由宿主进程播放（ffplay，或系统自带的 Windows PowerShell 播放器），不依赖浏览器 Web Audio。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Shows a reminder card in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI whenever the agent is waiting for your answer, and adds a desktop notification plus a flashing tab title when you are on another tab or window.
description.zh: 当 agent 停下来等你作答时，在 DSH Web 界面右下角弹出提醒卡；若你切到了别的标签或窗口，再补一条系统通知并让标签标题闪烁。

description.en: WeChat bridge and native Web settings panel with QR scan login, live token health probe, and credential management.
description.zh: 微信双向通道与原生设置管理面板，支持扫码登录、实时连通性与过期探测、单实例选举锁及凭证管理。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications when a DSH turn finishes or fails, and sends 继续 automatically after the model-retry budget is exhausted.
description.zh: 任务结束或失败时发送桌面通知；模型请求重试预算耗尽时自动发送「继续」让 Agent 接着执行。

description.en: Raises a Windows desktop notification card when DSH asks you a question, and returns to the asking Session when the card is clicked.
description.zh: DSH 向你提问时在屏幕右下角弹出毛玻璃通知卡片，点击卡片即恢复并置顶窗口、回到发起询问的会话。

description.en: Bark push notifications for DeepSeek Harness: turn completion, waiting prompts and approvals, plus opt-in background-job cards. Devices and card settings are edited live, and each push checks the per-device result returned by the Bark server and retries transient failures.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Bark 推送：回合结束、等待选择/批准，以及可选的后台任务卡片；设备和卡片参数在设置里实时生效，每次推送按 Bark 服务器返回的设备结果逐台核对，瞬时失败会自动重试。

description.en: Surfaces important facts and trade-offs from the current task, with on-demand explanations and optional discussion in the main session.
description.zh: 根据当前任务上下文提醒重要事实和方案取舍，支持展开解释并带入主会话讨论。

description.en: Bridge to the Telegram Bot API: long polling, per-chat sessions, HTML formatting.
description.zh: Telegram Bot API 桥接：长轮询、per-chat 会话、HTML 格式化。

description.en: Adds Windows desktop notifications, optional sounds, and DSH-styled in-page notifications for task events.
description.zh: 为任务事件提供 Windows 桌面通知、可选提示音和 DSH 风格的页面通知。

description.en: Pushes DSH session events to phone IM and lets you reply straight under that message, injecting the text back into the right session. Covers nine event kinds: task completion, execution error, execution blocked, manual abort, token limit reached, abnormal interruption, waiting for your answer, permission request, and waiting for plan confirmation. Channels are QQ single-chat bots and Feishu custom apps, both over WebSocket long connections — no public IP, domain or tunneling needed. Several bots can be configured at once, each subscribing to the sessions it cares about. Approvals and questions arrive with tappable buttons, and replies route home through three layers (button, quoted reply, explicit short-id prefix), falling back to the most recent intervention-needed notification and echoing which session it went to.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话事件推到手机 IM，并允许在那条消息下直接回复回注到正确会话。覆盖九类事件：任务完成、执行错误、执行被阻塞、手动中止、Token 达到上限、异常中断、等待我回答、权限请求、等待计划确认；通道支持 QQ 单聊机器人与飞书自建应用，两者均走 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 IP、域名或内网穿透。可同时配置多台机器人，各自订阅自己关心的会话。审批与提问以可点按钮下发，回复按「按钮 → 引用回复 → 显式短 id 前缀」三层路由归位，兜底发给最近一条需人介入的通知并回显投递目标。

description.en: Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice questions, duty/local toggle with a web duty banner, zh/en messages, zero idle tokens.
description.zh: Telegram 值班网关：手机消息任务闭环（专属值班会话）、值守模式全局审批转发（内联同意/拒绝按钮）、telegram_ask 选项提问、值守/本地切换与网页横幅、中英双语消息、空闲零 token。

description.en: Background notification plugin: desktop notification, with a tab-title fallback, when an approval prompt or an ask-user-question card appears while the page is in a background tab. The host queues approval and question events behind a same-origin endpoint that the client polls every 3 seconds; clicking the notification focuses the page, and the tab title is restored once the page becomes visible.
description.zh: 后台通知插件：页面处于后台时出现审批提示或提问卡片，即发送桌面通知（通知权限不可用时回退为标签页标题 ⚠ 前缀），点击通知聚焦页面；宿主将事件存入同源队列供前端每 3 秒轮询，页面恢复可见后标题自动还原。

description.en: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：运行完成、出错或等待审批时发送桌面通知并播放提示音，支持可配置的时长阈值。

description.en: Monitors session state in the DSH web app and sends desktop, browser, and third-party notifications for interactions, completions, and errors.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 端监控会话状态，为需要交互、任务完成、任务出错发送桌面 / 浏览器 / 第三方通知。

description.en: Tone or voice alerts for DSH approvals, questions, completions, errors and stalls; reads out what is waiting and repeats until handled; no network requests.
description.zh: DSH 提醒音：审批、提问、完成、错误、卡住各有音色；选「语音」会念出工具名、原因或问题原文；未处理会重复提醒，全程不联网。

description.en: Shows a focus-free notice card in the corner when a turn ends or DSH is waiting on an approval or a question.
description.zh: 任务跑完、等你审批或等你回答时，在屏幕角落弹出一张不抢焦点的通知卡。

description.en: Unofficial host-side ServerChan notifications for DeepSeek Harness: sends mobile alerts through WeChat (ServerChan Turbo) or the ServerChan³ app when approvals, plan reviews, or questions go unanswered beyond a configurable threshold, even with the browser closed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 Server酱通知插件：在主机端监控审批、计划评审和问答，超过设定时间仍未处理时通过微信（Server酱 Turbo）或 Server酱³ App 发送手机提醒，无需保持浏览器打开。

description.en: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.
description.zh: 给 dsh 加上 QQ 通道（OneBot 11，兼容 NapCat）：反向/正向 WS、私聊群聊、图片与语音转写、t2i 文字图卡片、合并转发、设置页可视化配置。

description.en: Push DSH task results to the Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today screen as service cards. After installing, enter the auth code on the plugin settings page: DSH top-left Plugins - dsh-harmonyos-hiboard.
description.zh: 把DSH的任务结果，以服务卡片形式推送到华为鸿蒙负一屏。安装后请在插件设置页输入授权码，位置：主页面左上角「插件」→ 「dsh-harmonyos-hiboard」。

description.en: Desktop notification and sound when a turn completes, the agent asks a question, or an approval is requested, each independently toggleable, plus an activity ball that lists live sessions and jumps back to one.
description.zh: 跑完 / 提问 / 需要审批时弹桌面通知与提示音（三类可分别开关），另附活动悬浮球，点会话行直接跳回该会话。

plugins.name: dsh-notion-oauth-ui

description.en: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE — official Notion MCP, no integration token.
description.zh: 在图形界面中以 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 连接 Notion —— 官方 Notion MCP，无需集成令牌。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Windows-only DeepSeek Harness host plugin that shows bottom-right desktop cards: a notification when a turn completes or fails, and a choice popup for ask_user_question where clicking an option answers it. Card colours follow the current Harness theme, and the notification sound plus the always-notify / only-when-unfocused timing are configurable in the Harness settings page.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 宿主插件：在桌面右下角弹卡片——回合完成或出错时弹通知卡，ask_user_question 变成可点选的选择卡（点选项即作答）；卡片配色跟随当前 Harness 主题，提示音与「始终通知 / 仅在未聚焦时通知」可在 Harness 设置页里配置。

description.en: WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) Smart Robot bridge: two-way chat over the aibot WebSocket gateway, no public endpoint needed.
description.zh: 企业微信智能机器人桥接：aibot WebSocket 双向对话（bot_id + secret），无需公网回调。

plugins.name: dsh-im-connect

description.en: Connects WeChat, WeCom, DingTalk, Feishu, Lark, QQ, and Telegram to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, with each IM chat as a separate workspace channel.
description.zh: 把微信、企业微信、钉钉、飞书、Lark、QQ、Telegram 接到本机 DeepSeek Harness，每个 IM 聊天对应一条独立工作区频道。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 198.18.0.0 for network access

description.en: Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable sound library.
description.zh: DSH 声音工坊：在会话结束、弹出选项、请求许可与停止时播放指定音效，支持 AI 角色语音生成与音效库管理。

plugins.name: dsh-notify

description.en: Cross-device notifications for DeepSeek Harness. While a long task runs unattended, a finished turn, a pending approval or a question reaches you through the enabled channels: desktop toast, browser tab, ntfy push or Feishu bot.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备通知插件。执行长任务期间无需值守：任务结束、等待审批或等待回答时，通过已启用的渠道发出提醒，可选桌面通知、浏览器标签页、ntfy 推送或飞书机器人。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Sends desktop notifications and custom HTTP pushes when tasks finish or need your attention.
description.zh: 在任务结束或需要处理时发送桌面通知和自定义 HTTP 推送。

description.en: Replies to DingTalk direct messages as your own account — reads the bound DSH workspace, writes the answer, and sends it back through the dws CLI.
description.zh: 以你本人钉钉身份自动回复私聊：在绑定的 DSH 工作区里查资料生成回答，通过 dws CLI 以本人身份发出。

description.en: Connect dsh to Notion via the official Notion MCP (OAuth + PKCE): search, read, and write pages, databases, and comments through `mcp__notion__*` tools.
description.zh: 通过官方 Notion MCP（OAuth + PKCE）把 dsh 连接到 Notion：通过 `mcp__notion__*` 工具搜索、读写页面、数据库与评论。

plugins.name: dsh-im-global

description.en: Telegram, Discord, Slack, Mattermost, Zulip and Matrix channels in one plugin, with per-conversation sessions that survive restarts, a Settings page that adds, tests and saves channels without YAML, and a fail-closed allowlist that rejects every sender until one is configured.
description.zh: 一个插件接入 Telegram、Discord、Slack、Mattermost、Zulip 与 Matrix，按对话隔离会话、重启后仍能续上；带设置页可增删与测试通道、无需改 YAML，白名单 fail-closed——未配置前拒绝所有发送者。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Auto-switches the agent to ultra-compressed caveman-style output during DeepSeek peak-pricing hours (Beijing 09:00–12:00 / 14:00–18:00, price x2) and shows a status badge plus transition toasts.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek 高峰计价时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，价格 ×2）自动切换 caveman 超精简输出省 token，标题栏常驻状态徽章，档位切换时弹提醒。

plugins.name: dsh-quake-alert

description.en: Real-time disaster alerts for DeepSeek Harness: Japan earthquakes (P2PQuake) and JMA EEW, tsunami and weather telegrams, global earthquakes (EMSC/USGS) and NOAA tsunamis, mainland China earthquakes (CENC via Wolfx) plus nmc.cn rainstorm and geological-hazard warnings, and US/Canadian NWS and ECCC flood, rainfall and storm-surge warnings — matched against your watch regions and thresholds.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的实时灾害预警：日本地震（P2PQuake）与 JMA 紧急地震速报、海啸、气象电文，全球地震（EMSC/USGS）与 NOAA 海啸，中国大陆地震（CENC via Wolfx）及 nmc.cn 暴雨、地质灾害预警，美国 NWS 与加拿大 ECCC 的洪水、降雨、风暴潮预警——按你关注的地域与阈值匹配播报。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to xml.kishou.go.jp

description.en: Notifies you about 11 configurable DSH agent events (task completion, questions, denied approvals, background subagents/goals/jobs, team tasks, context compaction, triggered schedules, plugin startup and permission changes) as browser Web Notifications through a bundled service worker, falling back to Windows toast or Linux D-Bus, with three silence levels and click-to-open.
description.zh: 为 11 类可配置的 DSH agent 事件（任务完成、提问、审批被拒、后台子代理/目标/任务、团队任务、上下文压缩、定时任务触发、插件挂载、权限变更）发送桌面通知，优先走自带 Service Worker 的浏览器 Web Notification，降级到 Windows Toast 或 Linux D-Bus，支持三档静默与点击跳转。

description.en: Turn event notifications: six event classes (completed, error, interrupted, approval requested, AI question, limit reached) delivered via sound, system notification, in-page banner, webhook, IM and host desktop-notification channels; when several browser windows are open, only one rings.
description.zh: 回合事件通知：完成/出错/被中断/等待审批/AI 提问/达到上限六类事件，经声音、系统弹窗、页内提示、webhook、IM、宿主桌面通知通道推送，多窗口只响一次。

description.en: Windows-only plugin that shows permission requests, waiting questions, task errors and finished turns as native card windows, and can allow a permission request straight from the card.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows：把审批请求、待回答的提问、任务出错和轮次完成显示为原生卡片窗口，审批请求可直接在卡片上放行。

description.en: Adds a Settings card that pops a system notification and optional chime when a conversation turn completes.
description.zh: 在设置中新增卡片，对话轮次完成时弹出系统通知与可选提示音。

plugins.name: dsh-relay

description.en: Relay agent approval requests and questions to iMessage / Email / WeChat channels and resolve them by replying with the request number (#N 批准 / 拒绝 / 回答).
description.zh: 把 agent 的审批与提问诉求推送到 iMessage / 邮件 / 微信通道，回复 `#编号 批准/拒绝/回答` 即可处理，无需打开网页。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.
description.zh: 回合结束时向 Server酱3 推送微信通知——标题、模型、项目目录、Git 分支、状态与回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，fire-and-forget 不阻塞主流程。

description.en: One-click publish of DSH conversations as Markdown articles on a Halo CMS blog: confirm in the GUI, type the console password (never stored), and the Q&A record is created through the Halo REST API.
description.zh: 一键将 DSH 对话发布为 Halo CMS 博客的 Markdown 文章：界面确认、输入控制台密码（永不存储），问答记录通过 Halo REST API 创建。

description.en: Desktop and webhook alerts on macOS, Linux and Windows when an agent finishes a turn, errors, or waits for approval — zero-dependency native notifications (osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast) plus a Slack-compatible webhook, with a configurable minimum turn duration.
description.zh: 桌面与 webhook 通知：任务完成、出错或等待审批时提醒；零依赖，走系统自带的 osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast，并支持 Slack 兼容的 webhook，可配置最短回合时长。

description.en: Short Web Audio cues when a session needs your attention (approval, question, or plan review) and when a task finishes; synthesized inside the page in two selectable styles with a volume setting — no popups, no OS notifications, no audio files, no network — and one bundle that covers DSH 0.1.7+ (desktop & web) and 0.1.0-rc.6.
description.zh: 会话需要你操作（审批、提问或计划确认）以及任务完成时播放不同的短提示音；页面内 Web Audio 现场合成，两种可选风格与音量可配，无弹窗、无系统通知、无音频文件、无网络请求，同一包同时支持 DSH 0.1.7+（桌面版/新版 Web）与 0.1.0-rc.6。

description.en: Registers im_say, a tool that sends each call as its own IM message through dsh-im's proactive delivery service, so a single reply can arrive as several bubbles instead of one block; im_targets and im_target_add list and create the delivery targets it sends to.
description.zh: 注册 im_say 工具，调用一次就通过 dsh-im 的主动投递服务发出一条独立 IM 消息，让一条回复拆成多个气泡而不是一整块；另有 im_targets 与 im_target_add 查看和新建投递目标。

description.en: Opens the Obsidian vault a DSH session is working in, on the first human message — so your sync plugin (Nutstore sync, Obsidian Sync, Obsidian Git, …) starts running and the files the agent edits actually get synced. Skips a vault that is already open, and opens a new window behind the current one instead of stealing focus. Also serializes writers per vault — a second conversation's write is refused before it runs and queued until the holder is done, so a sync client cannot splice two conversations' edits together. Windows only.
description.zh: 会话的第一条真人消息到达时，自动打开该会话工作目录所在的 Obsidian 库——这样你装的同步插件（坚果云同步、Obsidian Sync、Obsidian Git 等）就会开始工作，AI 在库里改的东西才能真正同步出去。已开着的库直接跳过；新开的窗口压到当前窗口后面而不抢焦点。同时保证同一个库同一时刻只有一个对话在写——第二个对话的写入会在执行前被拦下并排队，等前一个写完才放行，避免同步客户端把两个对话的改动拼在一起。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Quiet break, water, long-session and late-night reminders delivered by three bundled chibi companions, with cloud bubbles and a light bounce. Works in-page without extra downloads; the optional macOS desktop window uses a separately downloaded Electron helper.
description.zh: 用三套内置 Q 版角色提供久坐、喝水、连续工作与深夜关怀，带云朵气泡和轻回弹；页面内显示无需额外下载，可选 macOS 桌面窗口使用单独下载的 Electron 组件。

plugins.name: dsh-lark

description.en: Lark/Feishu bot channel for DeepSeek Harness: each chat drives its own agent, and tool approvals, model questions, and plan reviews return as cards answered by a button or a reply. Switch workspace and model from the chat (`/cd`, `/model`, `/new`), and run several bots that keep separate sessions and can hand turns to each other in one group.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 机器人渠道：每个会话驱动独立 agent，工具审批、模型提问与计划审阅都以卡片回到聊天，点按钮或直接回复即可作答；聊天里用 `/cd`、`/model`、`/new` 切工作区、换模型、重开会话，多个机器人各自独立并可在同群交接回合。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Desktop notifications for turn completions, with per-outcome controls and keyword rules.
description.zh: 回合完成桌面通知，按结果分控 + 关键词过滤。

description.en: Open DSH workspace directories in VS Code directly from the web GUI.
description.zh: 从 Web GUI 一键在 VS Code 中打开工作区目录。

plugins.name: deepseek-harness-acp

description.en: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
description.zh: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness lifecycle status, errors, and approval requests to a locally running OpenPets desktop companion.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

description.en: Evidence-first attention supervision for DeepSeek Harness with C0–C3 policy, deduplicated Inbox alerts, quiet hours, and redacted outcome records.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先注意力监督，提供 C0–C3 策略、去重 Inbox 提醒、静默时段和脱敏结果记录。

description.en: Paints a colored counter badge (green = unread completed sessions, orange = pending question or approval) on the DeepSeek Harness taskbar icon on Windows, and plays a chime when a session finishes. Fork of dthcle/dsh-badge-notify (MIT) with a completion chime and green/orange state colors; both draw the same taskbar badge, so the two cannot be enabled together.
description.zh: 在 Windows 任务栏的 DeepSeek Harness 图标上叠画彩色计数角标（绿=未读的已完成会话，橙=待回答提问或待批准权限），会话结束时播放提示音。基于 dthcle/dsh-badge-notify（MIT）二次开发，新增提示音与绿/橙状态色；两者都在同一个任务栏图标上叠画角标，不能同时启用。

description.en: Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away: fires at goal completion, blockage, before asking the user a decision, and at long-task milestones via a bundled zero-dependency Node SMTP sender.
description.zh: 你不在电脑前时由 agent 邮件提醒你：goal 完成、阻塞、向你提问决策前、长任务节点时触发，自带零依赖 Node SMTP 发送器。

description.en: Windows native toast notifications for DSH desktop sessions: turn ends, approvals, questions and a reminder for an unanswered wait — each with its own sound and popup text (up to three named templates per situation), three delivery modes, previews, and imported custom sounds. Clicking a toast raises the DSH window.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端会话的 Windows 原生 Toast 通知：回合结束、审批、提问与未应答催办，每个情况可单独选择音效与弹窗文本（每个情况最多 3 套命名模板），支持三种通知形式、预览效果与导入自定义音效；点击通知把 DSH 窗口拉回前台。

description.en: WeChat (personal WeChat, iLink Bot API) channel: chat with your DSH agent from WeChat, with images, files and voice-note transcription. One WeChat conversation can hold several DSH Sessions (/new, /list, /use) and every option is editable from the settings page. Also published to npm as dsh-plugin-weixin.
description.zh: 微信（个人微信，iLink Bot API）通道：在微信里直接对话 DSH agent，支持图片、文件收发与语音转写。一个微信会话可挂多条 DSH 会话（/new、/list、/use 切换，切走不销毁），全部配置项都能在设置页里查看和修改。已上架 npm（dsh-plugin-weixin）。

description.en: OS-level system notifications for the dsh web GUI: popups when a turn finishes or the agent needs your approval, answer, or plan review while the page is in the background.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面系统通知：回合结束或 agent 等待授权/回答/计划审核时，页面在后台也弹出系统级提醒。

description.en: Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.
description.zh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

description.en: Bark push notifications to iPhone: turn completion, waiting-for-input, and approval events sent from the DSH Host.
description.zh: Bark 推送通知到 iPhone：回合完成、等待回答、等待授权等事件由 Host 端发送。

description.en: Config-driven lifecycle hooks: event→command declarations in cordis.patch.yml, with Feishu card notifications and a QR scan-to-create bot setup.
description.zh: 配置驱动生命周期 hooks：在 cordis.patch.yml 声明事件→命令，附飞书卡片通知与扫码一键创建机器人。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) UI for DeepSeek Harness — a panel-driven control console: every slash command is a button on the ⚙️ control-panel card, in-card approvals and questions, live streaming cards, and one-QR app setup.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书 UI：面板驱动控制台——每个斜杠命令都是 ⚙️ 控制面板卡片上的按钮，卡内审批与提问，流式卡片，扫码一次完成配置。

description.en: Two-way iMessage channel for DeepSeek Harness over Photon: sender allowlisting, session commands, in-chat approvals and questions, and a Settings page for device authorization and hosted-line setup.
description.zh: 通过 Photon 接入 DeepSeek Harness 的双向 iMessage 通道：按发件人白名单路由，支持会话命令、聊天内审批与提问，并提供用于设备授权和托管号码设置的 Settings 页面。

plugins.name: dsh-pocket-console

description.en: Forwards an unattended DeepSeek Harness run's tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts to Feishu cards on your phone. The desktop GUI answers first — a card is only sent after `delaySeconds` (120 by default) with no answer there — and a phone approval grants `allowed-once`, so no authority accumulates on the phone. One outbound WebSocket long connection to Feishu: no public IP, domain, tunnel or relay.
description.zh: 把无人值守运行时 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用审批与 ask_user_question 提问推送到手机飞书卡片。桌面 GUI 优先作答——只有在 `delaySeconds`（默认 120 秒）内无人应答时才发出卡片——手机上的批准等同于 `allowed-once`，因此不会在手机上累积任何权限。仅一条到飞书的出站 WebSocket 长连接：不需要公网 IP、域名、隧道或中继。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Desktop notifications for run completion, model questions, and approval requests with per-platform system sounds, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 系统桌面通知：运行结束、模型提问与审批请求即时提醒，三平台提示音，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Floating approval window for DeepSeek Harness that appears when you leave the app and hands the request back to the native card when you return. Windows-only (WPF via PowerShell). Independent fork of zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta (MIT); do not run alongside the upstream.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的独立审批浮窗：离开应用时弹出，切回时把请求交还原生卡片。仅 Windows（WPF/PowerShell）；独立分支自 zeta987/dsh-notify-zeta（MIT），不能与上游同时运行。

description.en: Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: scan-to-connect PersonalAgent binding, streaming cards, git-worktree project workspaces, parallel per-scope tasks, multi-role agents, cross-session notify, in-chat model/key management, and a safety-net guardian that still answers in Feishu after dsh crashes.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进飞书的桥接插件：扫码绑定 PersonalAgent、流式卡片、git worktree 项目工作区、scope 并行任务、多角色 Agent、跨会话通知、对话内模型/密钥管理，以及 dsh 崩溃后仍在飞书应答的安全网守护。

description.en: Live session status on the browser tab favicon with sound notifications for pending input and completed tasks.
description.zh: 浏览器标签页 Favicon 实时回显会话状态，并支持需介入/已完成时的音效提示。

description.en: A draggable floating window with three tabs — meals, water, standing. It picks breakfast, lunch and dinner at random (three tries a day, no repeats, editable food lists), counts water cups and standing breaks, and reminds you with a distinct 3-second chime per tab. Collapses to a 32px ball.
description.zh: 可拖动的悬浮小窗，分吃饭、喝水、站立三个 tab：随机决定三餐（每天各 3 次机会、不重复、可增删菜品），记录喝水与站立，每类提醒各用一种音色响约 3 秒；可收成 32px 悬浮球。

description.en: Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace's latest session and replies return automatically; bot credentials and workspace routing are configurable from the settings page.
description.zh: 基于飞书官方 WebSocket 长连接的 DSH 双向聊天桥：消息路由到所选工作区的最新会话并自动回复，可在设置页切换机器人凭证与工作区。

description.en: Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today (负一屏) task-completion push for DeepSeek Harness: hiboard_push / hiboard_verify tools post Markdown task results to the phone card feed, wire-compatible with the OpenClaw today-task skill, with the authCode managed from the dsh settings panel.
description.zh: 华为鸿蒙负一屏（智慧助手·今天）任务完成推送：hiboard_push / hiboard_verify 工具把 Markdown 任务结果推送到手机卡片流，与 OpenClaw today-task 技能线级兼容，授权码可在 dsh 设置面板配置。

description.en: Turn-finished music reminder: when an agent turn ends, play a ringtone or any local audio file (bundled synthesised telephone ring, custom absolute path, or an in-page upload), with a floating chip to pause, resume or dismiss it and loop-until-paused playback; configured in Settings, defaults overridable per deployment.
description.zh: 回合提醒音乐：对话（回合）结束时播放铃声或任意本地音频提醒你回来——内置合成的电话「叮铃铃」，也可填宿主机绝对路径或直接在设置页上传；右下角浮标可暂停/继续/关闭，默认循环响到你手动停；设置项在「设置 → 内置插件」里，部署级默认值可写进 cordis.patch.yml。

description.en: Ambient fullscreen status grid for DeepSeek Harness sessions with token/rate graphs, plus ntfy push and alarm notifications when a turn ends, errors, or waits for approval.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏状态看板：会话状态网格与 token/速率图表一览无余，回合结束、出错或等待审批时通过 ntfy 推送与铃声提醒。

description.en: System notifications, a tab-title dot and a PWA taskbar badge when a reply finishes in the background or a session waits for your approval, plan review or answer, all cleared when you return to the window.
description.zh: 会话在后台跑完、或在等你审批、计划审阅或回答时，弹出系统通知、标题加红点并点亮 PWA 任务栏徽标；回到窗口自动清除。

description.en: Bilibili live-room danmaku for DSH: read live chat, send messages only after explicit confirm, hang out in a room in the background, optionally let the model decide whether to reply, and optionally transcribe stream audio to text; no video understanding. Setup needs a Python 3 venv with the bundled requirements plus Bilibili cookies; transcription additionally needs ffmpeg and a Whisper engine.
description.zh: DSH 的 B 站直播弹幕插件：看弹幕、确认后才发弹幕、挂机听、可选 AI 自动接话与可选语音转写；不抽帧、不做视觉理解。使用前需自建 Python 3 虚拟环境并装好仓库里的 requirements，发弹幕需 B 站凭证；语音转写另需 ffmpeg 与 Whisper 引擎。

plugins.name: dsh-telegram-notify

description.en: One-way Telegram notifications for DSH.
description.zh: 针对 DSH 的单向 Telegram 通知。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Reports DeepSeek Harness session state (working, done, error) to the agent-pet macOS desktop overlay and lets it open sessions or start a chat.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的会话状态（工作中、完成、出错）报告给 agent-pet 的 macOS 桌面悬浮宠物，并可从宠物打开会话或开始新对话。

description.en: Per-event sound alerts and system notifications for DeepSeek Harness. Four events — turn complete, question, approval and error — each get a switch, a sound picker with instant preview and a system-notification master switch. Twelve built-in tones plus a silent option are synthesized at runtime with the Web Audio API, so no audio files ship with the package; the four per-event defaults differ in register, timbre and rhythm (a high sine strike, a rising triangle pair, a repeated square pulse and a low sawtooth descent) so they are distinguishable without comparing pitches. A mode dropdown in General settings offers on, off and a smart mode that defers to the whale widget so the two never double up; the same row has a preview button and a gear opening a full settings dialog with volume, a skip-while-focused option and upload of your own audio up to 2 MB. A speaker button in the composer mutes sound without touching notifications. Works in the web GUI and the Electron desktop app.
description.zh: DSH 逐事件提醒插件：任务完成 / 需要回答 / 需要授权 / 运行出错四类事件，各配一个开关、一个可即时试听的声音选择和一个系统通知总开关。内置 12 种音色与 1 项静音，全部用 Web Audio 实时合成，不随包分发任何音频文件；四个默认音在音区、音色与节奏上互不相同（高音正弦单响、三角波上行两音、方波同音三连、锯齿低音下坠），不必对比音高也能分辨。通用设置那一行提供模式下拉（开启提醒 / 关闭提醒 / 智能判断，智能模式让开鲸鱼挂件已提醒的事件，避免重复），旁边有试听按钮与打开完整设置弹窗的齿轮；弹窗内含音量、前台运行时不提醒，以及上传自定义音频（单个不超过 2MB）。对话输入框左下角的喇叭可临时静音声音而不影响系统通知。网页端与桌面端（Electron）均可用。

description.en: Turn the tab icon into a green/amber status light and send browser notifications when a session finishes or awaits your input, with 47 selectable notification sounds.
description.zh: 把标签页图标变成绿/琥珀状态灯，并在会话跑完或有交互待处理时发送浏览器通知，含 47 个可选音效。

description.en: Two-way bridge between GNU Emacs and a running DeepSeek Harness session over loopback HTTP + SSE: submit prompts, stream replies, manage sessions and workspaces, and answer ask-user/approval prompts from Emacs, with a Plugins-page card that installs the Emacs package.
description.zh: GNU Emacs 与正在运行的 DSH 会话之间的双向桥：走本机回环 HTTP + SSE，可在 Emacs 里提交提示、流式收回复、管理会话与工作区、回答 ask-user / 审批提示；插件页还有一张卡片用来安装 Emacs 那边的包。

plugins.name: dsh-guild

description.en: Discord-like communities in DSH with channels, roles and permissions, message search, and sharing or cloning of DSH sessions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板内建社区：文字、公告与话题频道，角色与频道级权限，消息搜索，并可分享和克隆 DSH 会话。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.ibm.com

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: forwards agent questions (with inline buttons), tool approval requests, turn summaries and subagent messages to a Telegram bot, and takes the answer from Telegram or the DSH Web UI, whichever comes first. Ships a loopback control panel; host-only, no client UI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 桥：把代理提问（带内联按钮）、工具审批请求、回合摘要和子代理消息转发到 Telegram 机器人，答案可从 Telegram 或 DSH Web 界面给出，以先到者为准。自带本地控制面板，纯宿主插件，不含前端界面。

description.en: Daily news digest from 46 curated RSS sources, edited by the model already configured in dsh, delivered to your IM via webhook, and broadcast in the chat like a regular model reply with zero context cost.
description.zh: 每日要闻日报：46 个精选 RSS 源，用 dsh 里已配好的模型做主编式编辑，经 webhook 送到微信/Telegram，并以模型回答的样式插播在对话里，零上下文消耗。

description.en: Remote phone access to the DSH Web UI: scan a QR code for LAN or public (cloudflared tunnel) access with real-time sync, a mobile-adaptive layout, and a settings tab.
description.zh: 手机远程访问 DSH Web 界面：扫码即用局域网或公网（cloudflared 隧道）访问，实时同屏、移动端适配布局，带设置页管理。

description.en: Control a DeepSeek Harness agent from Feishu/Lark: send a task by DM, an agent runs it with your configured model and replies in the chat, and a feishu_send tool lets the agent push results. Uses lark-cli's WebSocket connection, so no public webhook is needed, and ships a resident launcher. Note: the plugin does not check who sent a message, so anyone who can DM the bot — by default, members of the Feishu tenant the app belongs to — can drive an agent running with the host's own model credentials and file permissions. Setup is not one `dsh plugin add`: `lark-cli` must be installed and authenticated once, and a Feishu self-built app with the permissions the README lists is required.
description.zh: 从飞书/Lark 操作 DeepSeek Harness：私聊发送任务，agent 用你配置的模型执行并把结果回到会话；feishu_send 工具可让 agent 主动推送结果。基于 lark-cli 的 WebSocket 长连接，无需公网 webhook，并附常驻启动器。注意：插件不校验发送者身份，因此任何能私聊到该机器人的人（默认即该飞书应用所属企业内的成员）都能驱动一个使用宿主机自身模型凭据与文件权限运行的 agent。安装不是一条 `dsh plugin add` 就完事：需要先全局安装并登录一次 `lark-cli`，并在飞书开放平台建一个带 README 所列权限的自建应用。

description.en: Unified IM channel for DeepSeek Harness: Feishu, Telegram, DingTalk, Slack, Discord — persistent conversations, true streaming replies, 40 MCP Feishu tools, slash commands, and an IM-bot status tab in the plugin settings.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一 IM 渠道：飞书、Telegram、钉钉、Slack、Discord —— 持久会话、真流式回复、40 个飞书 MCP 工具、斜杠命令，以及插件设置页中的 IM 机器人状态页。

description.en: Move45clock: a health clock for DeepSeek Harness. A 45-minute work timer (5–120 minutes), 12 guided 12–15 minute seated/standing break plans, a visual plan editor, reminder cards scalable to 200%, night reminders at 21:30/22:00/22:30, and optional action-name voice coaching. Window wake is Windows-only.
description.zh: Move45clock · 健康钟：每工作 45 分钟弹出引导式休息卡片，内置 12 套 12～15 分钟坐/站计划；支持可视化编辑计划、弹窗放大、21:30/22:00/22:30 夜间提醒，以及可选的动作名语音播报；Windows 下可把托盘窗口叫回前台。

description.en: Native desktop and webhook notifications for turn completions, failures, and approval requests, with outcome filters, content rules, privacy controls, and retrying delivery.
description.zh: 回合完成、失败和待审批时发送跨平台本机通知与 Webhook，支持结果过滤、内容规则、隐私控制和失败重试。

plugins.name: dsh-qq-bridge

description.en: Connects one existing DSH session to QQ through OneBot/NapCat without starting a new session, and uses a fail-closed whitelist plus @-mention, nickname and configurable-probability wake rules to decide which messages reach the model.
description.zh: 把一个固定的 DSH 会话接到 QQ（OneBot/NapCat），不新建会话、保留原上下文；白名单 fail-closed，@ 与昵称必唤醒，其余按可调概率唤醒。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Scheduled bilingual financial reports for DSH: market quotes, news and macro calendar, with per-target timezones and delivery through eight dsh-im channels.
description.zh: DSH 定时双语财经日报：包含行情、新闻与宏观日历，支持每个目标独立配置时区，并通过 dsh-im 的八种通道投递。

description.en: Periodic water, stand-up, eye-break and stretch reminders on your own work schedule, with daily and 7/30-day statistics and multiple switchable reminder plans.
description.zh: 按自定义作息定时提醒喝水、起身、护眼和拉伸，带每日与近 7/30 天统计，以及多套可随时切换的提醒方案。

description.en: An announcement file shared by several agent sessions on one machine. It is a plain text file the agents only append to; before each step a session receives the entries it has not seen yet, a new session catches up on the ones still in effect, and a session whose context was compacted gets them re-sent.
description.zh: 同一台电脑上多个会话共用的公告文件：一个只许追加的纯文本文件。每个会话在下一步之前收到自己还没见过的条目；新会话补看仍在有效期内的；上下文被压缩过的会话会收到一次重发。

description.en: Focus-aware notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, plan reviews and finished replies appear as one alert only when the conversation window loses focus; background conversations alert at any time and subagent sessions never do.
description.zh: 焦点感知的 DeepSeek Harness 通知插件：审批、提问、方案确认与回复完成统一为一种提醒，当前对话在窗口失焦后才弹出，后台对话随时提醒，子代理会话不提醒。

description.en: DingTalk group-robot notifications (notify/text/health; webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
description.zh: 钉钉群机器人通知：dingtalk_notify/text/health 三工具，webhook + HMAC 加签，零运行时依赖。

description.en: IMAP/SMTP email tools (list/read/search/send/folders/attachment/health/watch/mark/reply) with since/until date-range filters, email_mark for read/unread/star/move, email_reply for reply/reply-all/forward with threading headers, QQ/163/126/Sina/Aliyun/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud presets, multi-account support, a send-approval gate, a web settings page and a whale-girl new-mail popup driven by the incremental email_watch checker. Outlook OAuth2 device-code login works out of the box through a built-in community client, and an account can still supply its own clientId instead. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 邮件工具插件：含 email_watch 增量新邮件检查、email_mark（已读/未读/星标/移动文件夹）与 email_reply（回复/回复全部/转发，自动线程头+引文）的十工具，Web 设置页与鲸鱼娘递信新邮件弹窗，since/until 日期范围过滤，内置 QQ/163/126/新浪/阿里/Gmail/Outlook/iCloud 预设，多账号、连接复用与发信审批门；Outlook OAuth2 设备码登录开箱即用（内置社区客户端，账号仍可填自己的 clientId 覆盖）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Two-way Slack messaging (notify/channels/inbox/reply/health) over Socket Mode, no public callback needed.
description.zh: Slack 双向通信（notify/channels/inbox/reply/health 五工具），Socket Mode 免公网回调。

plugins.name: dsh-softsensor-hub

description.en: Message hub for DeepSeek Harness. Collectors for system health, weather, IMAP mail and market events feed configurable severity rules (critical wakes you, warn batches, info is only logged), and the surviving events are handed to the agent. Collectors run in-process, so nothing dies silently in a stray daemon. The weather collector is on by default and sends your IP to ip-api.com over plain HTTP unless a city is configured.
description.zh: 消息中枢：采集系统健康、天气、邮件与行情事件，按可配置的轻重规则过滤（critical 立刻叫、warn 攒批、info 只留档），再把事件交给 agent。采集器跑在插件进程里，不会死在一个没人看的守护进程里。天气采集器默认开启，未配置城市时会把你的 IP 经明文 HTTP 发给 ip-api.com 定位。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to ip-api.com

description.en: Checks npm hourly for newer versions of the installed plugins and asks which ones to upgrade.
description.zh: 每小时检查 npm 上已安装插件的新版本，并询问升级其中哪些。

description.en: Discord-native remote controller for DeepSeek Harness: drive persisted coding-agent sessions from DMs, mention-gated guild channels, and threads, with slash commands, progress updates, approvals, structured questions, and image and text attachments.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Discord 原生远程控制器：通过私信、需提及机器人的服务器频道及 Thread 操作持久化的编程 Agent Session，并支持斜杠命令、进度更新、工具审批、结构化问题、图片和文本附件。

description.en: Plays a chime when any session's response finishes (rising tone) or a question/approval is asked (falling tone), with a click-to-mute badge.
description.zh: 当任意会话的回复完成（上升音调）或提出问题/请求（下降音调）时播放提示音，带点击静音徽章。

description.en: Play different configurable sounds for five conversation events in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: normal completion, interrupt, error, approval wait, and auto-retry success; each event has its own audio setting and bundled default, with auto-retry after errors using a configurable wait (10-300s), plus a community sound library. Compatible with DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的不同触发情况可分别设置音频提醒：支持正常完成、中断、出错、等待确认、自动重连成功五种场景，每种场景都有独立音频配置和默认音效；出错后自动重连，等待时长可自定义（10-300 秒）；附带社区音色库下载；已适配 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

description.en: Audio cues for DeepSeek Harness: a short synthesized sound when an agent needs confirmation, finishes a turn or a background job, or fails, with five sound packs, per-event toggles and volume, and do-not-disturb rules stored in the host settings document.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 音效提示：智能体需要确认、回合完成、后台任务结束或失败时播放短提示音，内置 5 套音色、逐事件开关与音量、免打扰规则，配置存放在宿主设置文档。

description.en: Desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness — a web notification while a browser page holds the plugin (turn completion and pending questions), and a native Windows toast from the host for finished turns once the browser is closed.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知：页面开着时弹网页通知（回合结束与待回复问题），浏览器关掉后由 Host 对已完成的回合弹 Windows 原生通知。

description.en: Notifies you with a browser notification and toast whenever a session turn ends, with 5-language templates and custom presets.
description.zh: 会话轮次结束时推送浏览器系统通知与页内提示，内置 5 种语言模板与自定义预设。

description.en: DSH-side remote session driver for the dsh-overdrive chat gateway: exposes sessions, trajectory replay and tap-to-approve to Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom bridges. Requires running @dsh-overdrive/gateway alongside.
description.zh: dsh-overdrive 聊天网关的 DSH 侧远程会话驱动：把 Telegram / Discord / Slack / WhatsApp / 飞书 / 钉钉 / 企业微信 的会话、轨迹回放与一键审批接入 Harness。需配套运行 @dsh-overdrive/gateway。

description.en: DSH notification & remote-control plane: one `notify()` API across 28 outbound channels, six inbound control channels, phone approvals/questions/task control, a Native DSH Notify & Control UI, live outbound hot-apply, multi-agent routing, and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 通知与远程操作控制面：一个 `notify()` API 接入 28 个出站渠道，六条入站控制通道承载手机审批、提问与任务控制；提供 DSH 原生「通知与控制」UI、出站热生效、多 agent 路由，并保持零运行时依赖。

description.en: Phone push for DeepSeek Harness: hooks the question seam in-process so a pending question reaches your phone through an ntfy relay; an answer sent from the phone is fed back to the agent as a user message, which requires `tool-ask-user` to run in `mode: timed` — with the shipped default (`mode: legacy`) only the notification is delivered.
description.zh: DSH 手机推送：进程内挂载提问 seam，把待答问题经 ntfy relay 推到手机；手机作答会以 user 消息回灌给 agent。该回灌需要把 `tool-ask-user` 配成 `mode: timed`，默认的 `mode: legacy` 只推送通知。

description.en: Multi-platform IM gateway for DSH: Feishu (Lark) WebSocket long connection (no public URL), WeCom AES-encrypted callbacks, and Telegram long polling — per-chat agent sessions, whitelist access, and a visual settings card in the web GUI.
description.zh: 多平台 IM 网关：飞书（Lark）WebSocket 长连接（无需公网）、企业微信 AES 加密回调、Telegram 长轮询；每会话独立 agent、白名单访问、Web GUI 可视化设置卡片。

description.en: Plays a short bell the moment DeepSeek Harness asks for tool approval or a question, so a stalled turn gets noticed.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 请求审批、或向你提问时响一声“叮”，人不在窗口前也能立刻察觉。
