description.en: Task alerts for DSH: a system toast when a turn finishes, or when an approval, question or plan review is waiting; a chime rendered on the Windows communications endpoint so the system ducks other media by its own setting and restores it afterwards, without anyone's volume being written; and an optional copy mailed to your phone over SMTP (465 implicit TLS, or STARTTLS where credentials go out only after the upgrade). No runtime dependency: the sound helper is a PowerShell script, the mail client is plain Node.
description.zh: DSH 任务提醒：每轮对话结束、或出现待审批 / 待回答 / 待确认计划时弹系统通知；提示音走 Windows 通信播放端点，由系统按「通信活动」自动压低其他媒体并在结束后恢复，不写任何应用的音量；可选再用 SMTP 发一封邮件到手机（465 隐式 TLS，或 STARTTLS 且仅在升级后才发送凭据）。无运行时依赖：声音助手是 PowerShell 脚本，邮件客户端是纯 Node 实现。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-discord

description.en: Discord bridge loaded into the same Host as the desktop app or dsh web, with no separate process or profile — chat with sessions in any workspace from DMs or threads, attach to sessions open on the desktop, and answer tool approvals and model questions from whichever side responds first.
description.zh: 与桌面端或 dsh web 运行在同一个 Host 里的 Discord 桥接，无需单独进程或 profile：在私信或线程里与任意工作区的会话对话，接入桌面端正在用的会话，工具审批和模型提问在 Discord 与桌面端谁先答谁生效。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds an UpdateNotify tool and a live progress panel docked above the composer in the DSH Web UI, so the model can narrate what it just did, found, or is waiting on while a turn runs.
description.zh: 为模型提供 UpdateNotify 工具，并在 DSH Web UI 输入框上方停靠一个实时进度窗，让模型在一轮任务进行中随时播报刚做了什么、发现了什么、在等什么。

description.en: DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.
description.zh: 钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。

description.en: Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面通知，默认把回合结果读出来：Windows TTS 零下载即可用，另有 13 个 VOICEVOX 语音包可在设置页下载。完成提醒会等子代理与后台任务结束后再响；审批、提问、出错立即提醒。语音包从 GitHub 下载，下载前需确认使用条款。

description.en: Email notifications for DSH with an away-mode switch: mails you when a turn ends, a tool waits for approval, or the assistant asks a question. Title and body are editable templates.
description.zh: DSH 邮件通知插件，带一个「离开模式」开关：任务完成、工具等你授权、助手向你提问时发邮件给你；标题与正文都是可自定义的模板。

description.en: Fork of amlyczz/dsh-lark-link (MIT), maintained by Very12345. Per-conversation reasoning-effort controls, multi-app isolation, and streamed task-status cards.
description.zh: amlyczz/dsh-lark-link（MIT）的分叉，由 Very12345 维护；提供每会话推理强度控制、多应用隔离与任务状态流式卡片。

description.en: QQbot, QQ机器人 — watches chosen QQ groups over OneBot 11, batches messages by a count threshold, summarizes each batch with a model already configured in DSH, and sends the per-group report to chosen friends as a QQ private message. Messages can be filtered by keyword and by sender; ships a settings page, a local web console and a summary archive.
description.zh: QQ机器人、QQbot：通过 OneBot 11 监听指定 QQ 群，按消息数阈值分批，调用 DSH 已配置的模型总结每批消息，再按群私聊投递到指定好友；支持按关键词与成员过滤消息，带设置页、本地网页控制台与总结归档。

description.en: Sound alerts for the DSH web UI: a chime when an answer completes and a three-tone prompt when your approval or question is pending, with optional custom WAV stored only in the local browser (pure client-side, zero assets).
description.zh: DSH 网页端提示音：回答完成播放提示音，需要授权或向你提问时播放三连音；支持自定义 WAV（仅存本机浏览器），纯客户端零资源。

description.en: Talk to DeepSeek Harness from Feishu / Lark. A chat maps to a DSH session, messages become turns and answers are pushed back as cards; questions, permission requests, model switches and conversation switches are interactive cards, and inbound files and images are downloaded into the workspace.
description.zh: 在飞书里跟 DeepSeek Harness 对话。一个会话对应一段 DSH 会话，消息变成一轮对话、回答以卡片推回；提问、权限审批、切模型、切会话都是可点卡片，入站的文件与图片自动下载到工作区。

description.en: Sit-and-water reminder for DeepSeek Harness, with a cat that sits in the corner of the Web GUI. A focus cycle of 30-90 minutes ends in a centered overlay plus a triple chime that gets you up to walk and drink; the later button answers with one real sourced case about prolonged sitting and one about dehydration (built-in library of 17 entries, each with publisher, date and a link to the original); stopping produces a session report with worked time, completed rounds, successful interruptions, snoozes, suggested drinks and a good/mid/bad grade. The cat can be dragged anywhere with its position remembered and loops one animation per state. The timer and the ledger live in the host half, so a page refresh never loses a cycle; it only reminds while a DSH page is open. Cycle lengths, chime volume, cat opacity and grade thresholds are configurable on the plugin settings page.
description.zh: DSH 的久坐与喝水提醒：一只猫待在 Web GUI 角落帮你盯时间。专注周期 30-90 分钟结束后居中弹窗并连响三声，喊你起来走两步、喝口水；点「再等会」给出 1 条久坐的真实案例 + 1 条缺水的真实案例（内置 17 条，均带来源媒体、发布日期和原文链接）；点「结束」输出本次工作评价：工作时长、完成轮数、成功中断次数、推迟次数、建议喝水次数与好/中/差评分。猫可以拖到任意位置并记住位置，四个状态各一段循环动画。计时与账本在宿主侧，刷新页面不丢；只在 DSH 页面开着时提醒。周期时长、提示音音量、猫的不透明度、评价阈值都能在设置页调整。

description.en: WeChat (iLink) channel: chat with your DSH agent from the WeChat app, one persistent session per conversation, reusing DSH credentials.
description.zh: 微信（iLink）通道：用手机微信直接对话 DSH agent，每个对话一个持久会话，复用 DSH 凭据。

description.en: Turn-handoff reminders in the DSH Web UI with a modal or top banner, six browser-synthesized chimes, configurable auto-dismiss, and a sidebar speaker toggle with an unread session list.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的回合交接提醒：居中弹窗或顶部横幅、六种浏览器合成提示音、可配置自动消失，以及带未读会话列表的侧栏喇叭开关。

description.en: Plays a short chime when a conversation turn finishes, with three built-in tones or one custom upload, configured in Settings → Plugins.
description.zh: 会话回合结束时播放短提示音，内置三种音色或一条自定义上传，在设置 → 插件中配置。

description.en: IM webhook and local notifications on turn completion, errors, or approval (Feishu/WeCom/DingTalk/Slack/Discord/custom).
description.zh: 回合完成、错误或待审批时推送 IM webhook（飞书/企微/钉钉/Slack/Discord/自定义）与本地通知。

description.en: Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.
description.zh: 任务事件通知中心：6 类事件（提问 / 审批 / 完成 / 子代理完成 / 错误 / 轮次完成），双通道（浏览器通知 + 宿主系统 toast）外加 Bark/Webhook 推送频道（ntfy、Gotify、自建网关）；支持免打扰时段与紧急例外、审批超时二次提醒、完成风暴聚合、通知文本脱敏。

description.en: Personal WeChat and WeCom (企业微信) bridge: QR pairing, one DSH conversation per chat, two-way text/image/video/document/archive transfer, chat commands (/help, /status, /new, /stop, /friends) answered by the bridge itself without spending a model turn, a switch that restricts the bot to 1:1 chats (group messages are dropped silently and counted), remote approval by replying 1 or 2 in the chat, and a two-way WeCom intelligent robot over its long connection (no public URL needed) that also receives and sends images, files and videos.
description.zh: 个人微信 + 企业微信桥：扫码配对，每个会话各自一个独立 DSH 会话，文字/图片/视频/文档/压缩包双向传输，聊天里支持 /help、/status、/new、/stop、/friends 命令（由桥直接应答，不消耗模型回合），可切换「只处理好友私聊」（群消息静默忽略并计数），敏感操作可在聊天里回 1 或 2 远程审批，并支持双向的企业微信智能机器人长连接（无需公网地址），图片、文件、视频同样能收发。

description.en: Linux desktop notifications and a chime for DeepSeek Harness, sent by the host process so they still arrive with the browser page closed: turn completion, pending questions, tool approvals and turn errors, delivered through notify-send and paplay with a canberra-gtk-play fallback. A browser half adds an in-page toast, a Web Notification and a synthesized Web Audio chime as fallback; every switch lives in a Settings page or a JSON file.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Linux 桌面通知与提示音，由宿主进程发出，浏览器页面关闭后依然可达：回合结束、等待选择、工具批准与回合出错四类事件，走 notify-send 与 paplay（回退 canberra-gtk-play）。浏览器半身作为兜底提供页内浮层、Web Notification 与 Web Audio 合成提示音；所有开关都在设置页或 JSON 配置文件中。

description.en: Send QQ private-message notifications via a local NapCat bot: qq_send / qq_status / qq_napcat / qq_deploy native tools plus one-click deployment scripts.
description.zh: 通过本机 NapCat 机器人向主号 QQ 发送私聊通知：qq_send/qq_status/qq_napcat/qq_deploy 原生工具与一键部署脚本。

description.en: Bridge dsh session status to the cc-pet desktop pet bubble: thinking, tool calls, and completion in real time. Ships on npm as `dsh-pet-bridge`.
description.zh: dsh ↔ cc-pet 桌面宠物状态桥：把会话状态（思考中 / 读取文件 / 运行命令 / 完成）实时推送到桌面宠物气泡。npm 包名 `dsh-pet-bridge`。

description.en: Connects WeChat, QQ, DingTalk, Lark, and Telegram to DeepSeek Harness with unified configuration, private-chat and group access controls, and channel-side Agent chat and session commands.
description.zh: 将微信、QQ、钉钉、飞书和 Telegram 接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供统一配置、私聊与群聊访问范围管理，以及渠道内 Agent 对话和会话指令。

description.en: Emails you when a long turn finishes or errors, when a goal completes or blocks, and when an approval or a question has waited past a timeout; each new notification deletes the previous one from the inbox over IMAP, so the inbox holds at most one.
description.zh: 耗时较长或工具调用较多的任务结束时发邮件到手机，出错、目标完成或目标受阻也发；审批或提问挂起超过设定时间没人处理会另外提醒（正文带问题原文与候选项，提醒不依赖任务档位）。每封新通知会通过 IMAP 删掉收件箱里的上一封，收件箱里最多留一封；其它文件夹不扫描。

description.en: Fail-closed Feishu (Lark) channel bridge: chat with a bot, get dsh agent turns back — with opt-in human-in-the-loop tool approval (Allow/Deny cards before every bash call, fail-closed timeout). Official-Python-SDK-only integration (exact-pinned); deny-by-default allowlist, webhook signature/timestamp/replay verification, per-chat sticky sessions; daily latest-SDK compatibility canary; bilingual docs.
description.zh: Fail-closed 的飞书（Lark）channel 桥：和机器人聊天即驱动 dsh agent turn，可选人在环工具审批（每次 bash 调用前飞书弹 Allow/Deny 卡，超时默认拒绝）。仅经官方 Python SDK 集成（精确锁版）；白名单默认全拒、webhook 验签/时间窗/防重放、按 chat 粘性会话；每日最新 SDK 兼容金丝雀；中英双语文档。

plugins.name: dsh-auto-email

description.en: Daily AI digest by email: fetches ten sources (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Hugging Face, arXiv, Hacker News and others), clusters near-duplicate stories, scores them in code and with an LLM, then emails the top three on a daily schedule with a four-part reading (facts, why it matters, impact, open questions). Adds four conversation tools and a sidebar panel for previewing the digest, sending it now and changing the schedule.
description.zh: 每日 AI 三报：抓取 10 个信源（OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Hugging Face、arXiv、Hacker News 等），语义聚类去重，程序打分加 LLM 打分，每天定时把选出的三条发到邮箱，并附「事实／为什么重要／影响／存疑」四段解读；另提供 4 个对话工具与侧边栏面板，用于预览、立即发送和改配置。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to export.arxiv.org

description.en: Windows desktop notifications with selectable sounds: five bundled sound packs (45 clips) plus imported audio, one sound per event, and clicking a notification opens the matching session.
description.zh: Windows 桌面通知 + 可选音效：内置五组共 45 个音效并支持导入音频，可逐事件指定音效，点击通知直接跳到对应会话。

description.en: Web Audio agent-heartbeat cues for the DSH web GUI: a low working hum while an agent is busy, ticks on streaming output, and a chime when a session awaits input or work finishes, with per-voice volume, mute toggle, and optional local audio files.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面提供 Web Audio 智能体心跳提示：Agent 忙碌时低频心跳、流式输出时滴答声、会话等待输入或工作完成时提示音；支持分音色音量、静音开关与本地音频文件替换。

description.en: Browser notification plugin for DeepSeek Harness - system toasts when a task finishes, a run errors, or your input is needed (question / approval / plan review), click to open the session, per-type toggles, and no false 'done' while the main session waits on its subagents.
description.zh: DSH 浏览器通知插件 - 任务完成 / 运行出错 / 需要你回答、批准、审阅计划时弹系统级通知，点击气泡直达会话，三类通知独立开关，主会话等子代理期间不误报完成。

description.en: Connects dsh to Weixin, with arbitrary file sending support.
description.zh: 通过微信远程控制 DeepSeek Harness，支持任意文件传输。

description.en: Task-completion chime for DeepSeek Harness, playing the original opencode sounds for done, question, plan-review and error events with zero external dependencies.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 复刻 opencode 的任务完成提示音，完成、提问、计划待审、出错四种场景播放原始音效，零外部依赖。

description.en: Turns the MacBook keyboard Caps Lock light into an agent status light: on while the agent works, flashing when it waits for your approval or answer, off when idle.
description.zh: 把 MacBook 键盘的 Caps Lock 指示灯变成 agent 状态灯：干活时常亮，等你审批或回答时快闪，空闲时熄灭。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu

description.en: Connect a Feishu bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.
description.zh: 通过扫码把飞书机器人接入DeepSeek Harness。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-im

description.en: Connect IM bots to DeepSeek Harness via QR codes or bot credentials (9 channels: Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp).
description.zh: 通过二维码或机器人凭据将 IM 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness（支持飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord 和 WhatsApp 共 9 种渠道）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-weixin

description.en: Connect a Weixin bot to DeepSeek Harness by scanning a QR code.
description.zh: 通过微信扫码把微信机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Scheduled daily toast popups summarizing yesterday's conversations and managing two-tier pending TODOs.
description.zh: 每日定时弹窗推送昨日对话要点提炼与双轨待办事项管理。

description.en: Diving-Fish score lookup for MaimaiDX inside QQ, plus qq-bridge chat extensions. #查分 renders a B50 with song artwork from an OAuth authorisation that any member can use, and works without the bridge running; the extensions cover balance and auto-shutdown, reasoning tier switching by billing peak hours, holiday-table coverage, start/shutdown greetings, and an in-QQ feature toggle.
description.zh: 把水鱼（舞萌DX）查分接进 QQ：#查分 查 B50 并渲染带曲绘的成绩图，走 OAuth 授权、不限管理员、且不依赖桥接运行；另附 qq-bridge 聊天拓展——余额与自动关机、推理档位按计费峰谷切换、节假日表覆盖、开机/关机提示词、QQ 内功能开关。

description.en: Host-side session alerts for DSH Web on Linux: tones played through the server's audio device when a turn ends, fails, or waits for approval or an answer — no browser needed.
description.zh: Linux 上 DSH Web 的宿主侧会话提醒：回合结束、出错或等待审批/回答时，服务器音频设备直接发声，无需打开浏览器。

description.en: In-app local notification center for DSH: a sidebar Notifications entry with unread badge, full-screen center with level color coding (info/success/warn/error), time/source filters, sorting, title/content search, read/unread, delete, detail popup with one-click copy, and pagination; written by the notify_add agent tool or the dsh-localnotify CLI (with auto-cleanup retention), page refreshes live, UI follows dsh web language (zh/en).
description.zh: DSH 本地通知栏：侧边栏【通知】入口 + 未读徽标、全屏通知中心（级别视觉分级 info/success/warn/error、时间/来源筛选、排序、标题内容搜索、未读已读、删除、详情弹层一键复制、分页），notify_add agent 工具与 CLI 写入本地 JSON 文件（支持自动清理），页面实时刷新，界面跟随 dsh web 语言切换。

description.en: Task-completion notifications via ServerChan / DingTalk / Feishu / generic webhooks.
description.zh: 任务完成通知：ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

description.en: Pushes a notification when a long agent turn finishes, a turn fails, or an approval waits too long, via ntfy, Bark, Gotify, ServerChan, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram or a webhook. Port of @magpie-community/gateway-notify (MIT); the upstream is a magpie API-gateway plugin that does not install into DSH, so the two never coexist in one host.
description.zh: 长任务结束、回合失败或审批等待过久时推送通知，支持 ntfy、Bark、Gotify、Server酱、飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 与 webhook。移植自 @magpie-community/gateway-notify（MIT）；上游是 magpie API 网关插件，无法装进 DSH，两者不会同装。

description.en: Attention gate for DeepSeek Harness: sorts run events into blocked / terminal / progress and alerts only on the first two, holding everything non-blocking during a /focus block and delivering it when the block ends. Alerts flash the taskbar button only - no toast, no sound, no focus steal. Windows only.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的注意力闸门：把运行事件分成「卡住 / 终态 / 中间进展」三级，只对前两级提醒；专注块内的非阻塞事件一律攒着，块结束时一次性交付。提醒只闪任务栏按钮——不弹通知、不出声、不抢焦点。仅 Windows。

description.en: Windows-only tray monitor for DeepSeek Harness: deploys and manages the standalone DshTaskWatcher tray app - four-state tray icon (gray=disconnected, green=idle, amber=running, red=attention), a per-task panel with live duration/tps/tokens, and completion & outcome notifications. Start/stop switch in Settings > Plugins; the watcher is an independent process that survives DSH restarts.
description.zh: Windows 托盘任务监视器：部署并管理独立监视程序——四态托盘图标（灰=未连接、绿=空闲、橙=运行中、红=有待处理）、逐任务实时面板（时长/速度/token）、完成与结局通知。设置→插件内启停开关；监视器独立进程运行，DSH 重启不影响。

description.en: Feishu meeting reminder: a dsh-plugin which has only side effect: reminding you, mid-flow with AI, that you "have to go meet carbon-based lifeforms".
description.zh: 飞书会议提醒：一个只有副作用的 dsh-plugin，在你跟 AI 聊得神魂颠倒时提醒你「不得不去跟碳基生命开会了」。

description.en: Sends one system notification when a DSH turn ends: per-outcome switches for completed, error and interrupted, a minimum-duration threshold, silent subagents and unfocused-window-only delivery. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux, delivered through a connected page or a native fallback (PowerShell toast, osascript, notify-send; the Linux native fallback needs libnotify). Clicking the notification brings DSH back to the front on the page/Electron channel; PowerShell and notify-send notifications are not clickable.
description.zh: DSH 每轮任务结束时弹一条系统通知：完成 / 出错 / 中断分别开关，可设最短耗时、子任务静默、只在窗口不在前台时提示。Windows / macOS / Linux 通用，页面开着走页面通道，否则回退 PowerShell toast / osascript / notify-send（Linux 原生回退需装 libnotify）；页面 / Electron 通道的通知可点击把 DSH 拉回前台，PowerShell 与 notify-send 的通知点不动。

description.en: Windows system and custom desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness events: task completed, failed, running, awaiting approval, and awaiting answer. Click-to-jump to the session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness事件的Windows系统和自定义桌面通知：任务已完成、失败、正在运行、等待批准和等待答复。单击以跳转到会话。

description.en: Wire up Feishu/Lark from a four-step wizard that discovers your chats instead of asking for a 32-character id, creates the app by scan, and runs a nine-item live self-test that names the exact scope to enable when a check fails. It drives a companion MCP server of 25 tools, including ones that move local files into a chat and pull a message's attachments back to disk. The MCP server is a separate install: take dsh-feishu-mcp-<version>.mjs from the dsh-feishu Releases (or npx github:yinsang0910-star/dsh-feishu-mcp); until it is in place the self-test reports MCP as not mounted and no mcp__feishu__* tool exists.
description.zh: 用四步向导把飞书接上：会话自动发现、不用手抄 32 位 id，扫码创建应用，再跑九项实时自检——哪项不通过就直接给出该开通的 scope。它驱动一个 25 工具的 MCP server，其中包括把本地文件发进会话、把消息附件取回本地。MCP server 需另行安装：从 dsh-feishu 的 Releases 取 dsh-feishu-mcp-<版本>.mjs（或 npx github:yinsang0910-star/dsh-feishu-mcp）；装好之前自检会显示 MCP 未挂载，也没有任何 mcp__feishu__* 工具。

description.en: Connects QQ Bot private and group chats to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, with per-chat personas, interactive questions, and optional image understanding.
description.zh: 将 QQ 私聊和群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness Desktop，支持按会话切换人格、交互式提问和可选图片理解。

description.en: Let the Blue Big Fat Fish browse Bilibili for you: it comments on your behalf, DMs you interesting finds, writes a diary, and keeps a memory for long-term summaries. It filters videos to your taste, creates Markdown digests, and can watch comments and reply for you. In Circle Mode, it replies only inside threads explicitly invited by the video uploader in a top-level comment — ordinary viewer requests do not count, and it never starts a new top-level comment. Commenting, DMs, auto-run, and comment watch are off by default. Needs Node 22, DSH 0.1.7-rc.1+, a signed-in Bilibili account, a model route and Python.
description.zh: 让蓝色大肥鱼替你刷 B 站：帮你评论，把发现的有趣内容私信给你，还会写下日记；它也有记忆，能长期总结。视频按你的口味筛选并生成 Markdown 日报，也能守着评论区替你回话。开启「圈地自萌」后，它只回视频 UP 主本人主动邀请的楼中楼，普通观众喊话不算，绝不自己起新楼；评论、私信、自动运行和守护默认关闭。需 Node 22、DSH 0.1.7-rc.1+、已登录的 B 站账号、模型线路与 Python。

description.en: Sounds a chime and raises a desktop notification when the agent needs you — stage completion, approval requests, awaiting input, task completion, and errors, each with its own tone.
description.zh: Agent 需要你时响铃并弹出桌面通知：阶段完成、请求批准、等待输入、任务完成、出错，五种场景各配不同提示音。

description.en: Native Windows system notification (Notification Center toast) when a task completes: goal completion or agent turn end.
description.zh: 任务完成时弹出 Windows 原生系统通知（通知中心横幅）：目标完成或 Agent 结束一轮。

plugins.name: dsh-qq-bot

description.en: DSH plugin (fork of sj244/dsh-qq-bridge, MIT) that connects DSH sessions to QQ through OneBot/NapCat. Whitelist stays closed until filled in; @-mentions, nicknames and pokes always wake the model; other messages wake at a configurable probability. Cordis id remains qq-bridge. It keeps the upstream Cordis id (qq-bridge): uninstall sj244/dsh-qq-bridge before installing, the two cannot be installed together — and with an empty whitelist nothing wakes.
description.zh: 把 DSH 会话接到 QQ（OneBot/NapCat）的插件（fork 自 sj244/dsh-qq-bridge，MIT）。白名单默认全关；被 @、叫到昵称或被戳一定叫醒，其余消息按可调概率抽样。Cordis 插件 id 仍是 qq-bridge。它沿用上游的 Cordis id（qq-bridge）：安装前须先卸载 sj244/dsh-qq-bridge，两者不能同装；白名单为空时谁都不会被叫醒。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Plays a Windows system sound when the agent opens a question dialog, when a tool asks for permission, and when a conversation turn ends, plus a fish_beep tool to trigger a sound on demand. Custom audio folders are supported.
description.zh: 弹出选项卡提问时、请求工具权限时、一轮对话结束时，各播放一次提示音；支持自定义音频文件夹；另附 fish_beep 工具，可随时手动响一声。

description.en: Bridges a DSH session and QQ over NapCat HTTP, forwarding agent replies to QQ and feeding messages you send in QQ back into the session.
description.zh: 通过 NapCat HTTP 把 DSH 会话和 QQ 双向打通：AI 说完自动发到 QQ，你在 QQ 里说的话自动转进会话。

description.en: Flashes the DeepSeek Harness taskbar button on Windows when an approval, a question or a plan review is waiting, or when a turn finishes.
description.zh: Windows 上审批、提问或方案确认在等你、或一轮回复完成时，让 DeepSeek Harness 的任务栏按钮闪动。

description.en: System-native notifications when a task finishes or needs your confirmation: Windows toast, macOS osascript, and Linux notify-send.
description.zh: 任务完成或需要确认/输入时发送操作系统原生通知：Windows toast、macOS osascript、Linux notify-send。

description.en: Sidebar badge and desktop notification when a background session finishes while you are working in another project.
description.zh: 你在别的项目里工作时，后台会话跑完会在侧边栏显示角标并发出系统通知，点角标可直接跳到该会话。

plugins.name: dsh-qqbot

description.en: QQ official bot channel for DeepSeek Harness (feature-rich fork of tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot): group and private chat with the full agent, sticker library with auto-tagging and AI meme replies, group management (join approval and mute), botplay interactive card events with paginated catalogs, user extension registry (custom slash commands and QQ tools), scheduled wakeups, remote approvals over QQ, and a floating dock web UI.
description.zh: 接入 QQ 官方机器人的 DeepSeek Harness 通道(tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 功能增强 fork): 群/私聊与完整 agent 对话、表情包图库(自动打标+AI 斗图)、群管理(入群审批/禁言)、botplay 互动事件卡与翻页目录、用户扩展注册表(自定义斜杠命令与 QQ 工具)、定时唤醒、QQ 远程审批、悬浮球 dock Web UI。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Native macOS completion notifications and user approval alerts with Settings UI for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生任务完成通知与审批提醒插件，集成设置面板。

description.en: Host-layer Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: agent turn done, error or interruption, subagent done, and background job done, plus alerts when the model asks you a question or a tool approval is pending. The notification logic runs in the DSH host process, so toasts still arrive with the tab or the browser closed; a Win32 foreground probe suppresses them while you are looking at DSH. Windows only.
description.zh: DSH 宿主层 Windows 原生 Toast 通知：回合完成、出错或中断、子代理完成、后台任务完成，以及模型提问与工具审批待处理时的提醒。通知逻辑跑在 DSH 宿主进程里，标签页或浏览器关掉也照响；用 Win32 前台探测，正在看 DSH 时不打扰。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Speaks a cue for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: a configurable phrase when an agent turn completes normally, a second phrase when the agent needs you to choose — a question, a plan approval, or a permission request — and a time-of-day greeting when a new conversation starts. A small bubble in the lower-left corner mutes and unmutes every cue with one click, with its own toggle chime. Phrases are synthesized with a Microsoft Edge neural voice (skipping aborted and errored turns, subagent turns, and rounds that a goal is still driving), cached under the DSH home directory and replayed locally, with the desktop SAPI voice as the offline fallback.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness 语音提示：一轮对话正常结束时朗读一句可自定义的话（默认「已完成当前任务」），智能体需要你做选择时——提问、批准计划或权限确认——朗读第二句（默认「老大老大，等你做选择呢」），开始一个新对话时再按系统时间问候一句（默认「早上好／中午好／下午好／晚上好！有什么工作需要做吗？」）。页面左下角还有一个小悬浮泡，点一下就把所有播报静音或恢复（自带开关音效）。朗读用微软 Edge 神经语音合成（被中断或出错的回合、子代理回合、以及 goal 仍在续跑的回合不朗读），结果缓存在 DSH 主目录并本地播放，网络不可用时回退到系统 SAPI 桌面语音。

description.en: System-level desktop notifications: turn-completion and workflow-end banners, plus a modal alert when an approval is needed (macOS osascript / Linux notify-send).
description.zh: 系统级桌面通知：回合完成 / 工作流完成横幅，需要审批时弹出模态提醒（macOS osascript / Linux notify-send）。

plugins.name: dsh-task-dispatcher

description.en: TickTick (滴答清单) daily task dispatcher: an interval timer pulls due tasks from a chosen list into a Markdown task file and notifies only when the task set changes (WeChat via ClawBot / flomo / macOS); it can also auto-execute each task in its own headless DSH session under a configurable timeout, optionally gated to DeepSeek's off-peak hours so peak-time work queues to the next off-peak window instead of starting, plus a settings panel for the deferred write-back queue and dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report tools.
description.zh: 滴答清单任务派发器：按间隔从指定清单拉取到期任务写入今日任务文件，仅在任务集变化时通知（微信 ClawBot / flomo / macOS）；可为每个任务单独开一个 headless DSH 会话自动执行（worker 超时可配），并可选只在 DeepSeek 空闲（优惠）时段开跑——高峰期把任务排到下个空闲窗口而不是立刻执行；带 Web 设置面板（延迟回写队列、省钱模式时段与状态）与 dispatcher_status / dispatcher_config / dispatcher_run / dispatcher_report 工具。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.apple.com

description.en: Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Plays a chime and speaks a Chinese voice alert when an approval, question, or plan-review popup appears in the DSH web GUI, so you never miss a request.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 中出现审批、提问或计划审批弹窗时，播放提示音并中文语音播报，避免漏看待处理请求。

description.en: Task-tiered session notifications for DSH: marked main-line sessions alert as they finish, other sessions batch into one summary, plus balanced and silent modes; per-event sounds or uploaded audio, per-session mute, click-through notifications, and an option to wait for subagents.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的任务分级会话通知：标记的主线任务完成或失败时立即提醒，其余会话汇总为一声；另有逐条提醒的均衡模式与完全不响的静音模式（提问与权限请求仍提醒）。支持每类事件独立音效或自定义音频、按会话静音、点击通知直达会话，以及等待子代理结束再提醒。

description.en: Mobile push when a DSH task goes idle, over 10 channels: ntfy, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu, ServerChan, PushPlus, Telegram, Qmsg and generic webhooks. The message carries the session, workspace, elapsed time, turn number and a reply excerpt, and it runs host-side rather than in the browser page.
description.zh: DSH 任务停下来时把通知推送到手机，支持 10 个渠道：ntfy、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、飞书、Server酱、PushPlus、Telegram、Qmsg 与通用 webhook；消息里带会话、目录、耗时、回合号与回复摘要，运行在 Host 侧而不是浏览器页面里。

description.en: Windows toast notifications when a DeepSeek Harness task finishes: the session title, the outcome, and a summary of the final reply, sent once when the agent really stops rather than once per round of a running goal.
description.zh: DSH 任务完成时，在 Windows 通知栏弹出原生通知，带上会话标题、结果状态与最后一条回复的摘要；在 agent 真正停下来时才发一条，而不是每跑一个回合就响一次。

description.en: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approve or reject from the notification while DSH is in the background, with an in-app fallback; foreground only skips the current conversation, while other conversations still notify. Also reports turn completion and errors; subagent sessions stay silent.
description.zh: DSH 的 Windows 授权通知：后台时可直接在通知上点「允许一次 / 拒绝」，前台时当前对话走应用内审批框、其他对话照常提醒；另含完成 / 出错通知，子代理会话保持静默。

description.en: Capybara secretary for DSH: desktop pet notifications with ding sound, alert inbox API, session-aware alerts (turn done / approval needed / turn blocked), check scripts, and daily high-star plugin recommendations.
description.zh: 水豚秘书：桌面宠物气泡+叮咚通知、告警收件箱 API、会话智能提醒（任务完成/需要确认/阻塞）、磁盘/HTTP/进程巡检脚本，以及每日高口碑插件推荐，另附 API 冒烟测试。

description.en: Inventory every listening TCP endpoint and grade each holder as agent-spawned, workspace, dev-server, unattributed, system or protected; only the first two can be auto-selected, and a reap previews its descendant-closure plan unless confirmed.
description.zh: 枚举本机全部监听端口，按「会话派生的 / 工作区内的 / 开发服务器 / 无法归属 / 系统 / 受保护」六级定性持有者；只有前两级可被自动选中，回收前默认只预览后代闭包计划。

description.en: Command resolution forensics: which file a command actually runs, which PATH entry won, what it shadows, how many entries are duplicates or dead, and whether the copies behind one name report the same version.
description.zh: 命令解析取证：一条命令实际会跑哪个文件、PATH 哪一条胜出、遮蔽了谁、有多少重复与死条目，以及同名副本报的版本是否一致。

description.en: One-click restart button for the DSH Web UI: a sidebar footer button that restarts the dsh web process with a single click and persists across the restart it triggers.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面一键重启按钮：侧边栏底部按钮，单击即重启 dsh web 进程，且重启后按钮常驻。

description.en: The organ kernel of Agent-Body: plugins organized as one body. Each command is turned into a nerve impulse that deterministically innervates the organ which should handle it and names the capability to use; a heartbeat with a variable interval (faster on alerts, slower when idle) pumps operator directives, proprioception and homeostasis warnings system-wide; reflex arcs fire with zero model calls; failures go through deterministic attribution (missing tool / arguments / permission / timeout / network), a prescription, and a re-check loop, with argument errors never auto-retried. A missing organ is compensated by the one with the highest capability overlap, and tool schemas are gated by the current intent (84.7% measured reduction, reproducible in-repo). This entry is the kernel plugin package inside the agent-body repository.
description.zh: Agent-Body 的器官内核：把插件组织成一具身体。命令先被转成神经冲动、确定性地支配到该处理它的器官并指明用哪个能力；心跳按内环境变速（告警加快、静默放慢）把指令、本体状态与告警打包泵向全身；反射弧零模型调用、命中即执行；失败走确定性归因（缺工具/参数/权限/超时/网络）加处方与复检闭环，参数错误不自动重试。器官缺失时按能力重叠自动代偿，工具 schema 按当前意图显影（仓库内实测省 84.7%）。本条目是 agent-body 仓库中的内核插件本体。

description.en: Runtime-switchable outbound HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy for DSH with a web settings card.
description.zh: DSH 运行时可切换的出站 HTTP/SOCKS5 代理，带网页设置卡片。

description.en: Real-time stage, ETA & cost dashboard for headless dsh tasks: turns the black-box session event stream into a live multi-task grid (cordis plugin + standalone local dashboard, no API calls).
description.zh: headless dsh 任务的实时阶段、ETA 与成本看板：把黑盒会话事件流变成实时多任务网格（cordis 插件 + 本地独立看板，零 API 调用）。

description.en: Opt-in HTTP proxy service for DSH plugins, with native address and port settings. Exposes scopedHttpProxy for explicit callers, applies address changes to subsequent requests, and leaves system proxies, environment variables and global network dispatchers unchanged.
description.zh: 供 DSH 插件显式调用的独立 HTTP 代理服务，提供原生地址和端口设置。通过 scopedHttpProxy 服务接入，地址修改对后续请求生效，不修改系统代理、环境变量或全局网络连接器。

description.en: Enforces a check-fix-recheck loop when a task is wrapping up: it auto-runs your tests/lint/audit, blocks any round that still has unfixed problems, and only calls the task done after three consecutive clean full checks, then notifies the user.
description.zh: 收尾自检哨兵：任务收尾时强制「全面检查 → 修复 → 再全面检查」循环，自动跑测试/lint/audit，有未修复的问题就打回，直到连续三轮零问题才判定完成并通知用户。

description.en: Pre-flight plugin-library index for DSH agents: injects per-step trigger-table hints into the runtime context so suitable installed plugins get used predictably instead of opportunistically.
description.zh: DSH agent 的插件库起飞检查：向运行时上下文注入按步骤触发的提示，让合适的已装插件从「碰巧想起」变成「可预期使用」。

plugins.name: dsh-restart-dock

description.en: A small dock in the DSH Web UI: restart the host or reload the page in one click. Restart asks first (now / 30s / 60s / 2min / cancel); the dock drags to any edge only after a 320ms hold, and stays anchored when the window resizes. Refresh refuses to run unless the plugin bundle is verifiably loadable (timestamp baseline + real bundle fetch + syntax compile), so a reload can never brick the app. Restart is Windows-only (PowerShell 5.1); the UI and page refresh work on all platforms.
description.zh: DSH 界面上一小框：一键重启宿主、一键刷新页面。重启会先问「立即 / 30 秒 / 60 秒 / 2 分钟 / 取消」，倒计时可撤回；小框需长按 320ms 才能拖动（避免手一抖就粘住），拖到边缘自动吸附，窗口缩放时跟着走。刷新前会真正确认插件包能加载（文件时间戳 + 取回 bundle + 语法编译三重检查），任何一项拿不到就不刷——宁可多点一次，也不把应用刷成起不来的样子。重启仅 Windows（PowerShell 5.1）；界面与刷新功能全平台可用。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to dsh-restart-dock.local

description.en: Development tooling for Minecraft 26.3 mods: starts a real dedicated server and a real client from JSON instance registrations, drives both through an authenticated HTTP probe, and asserts on world, UI and log state across Fabric, Forge and NeoForge, writing per-run evidence and shipping no game or loader files. Requires JDK 25 and a Minecraft 26.3 instance.
description.zh: Minecraft 26.3 mod 开发工具：按 JSON 实例登记启动真实的专用服与客户端，通过带鉴权的 HTTP 探针驱动两端，并对世界、UI 与日志状态做断言，覆盖 Fabric / Forge / NeoForge；每轮运行留下取证目录，且不随包分发任何游戏或加载器文件。需 JDK 25 与 Minecraft 26.3 实例。

description.en: Verification toolkit for DSH agents: evidence-based claim checking against workspace files with line citations, config validation (JSON/YAML), and read-only URL/npm/GitHub submission-readiness probes.
description.zh: DSH 核验工具箱：在工作区文件中核查声明并返回带行号引用的证据，校验配置文件（JSON/YAML），以及只读的 URL / npm / GitHub 提交就绪度探测。

description.en: Ecosystem trend dashboard (行情面板): snapshot the dsh-plugin topic and the awesome list into local history, then report weekly trends — new plugins, star gainers, category heat, awesome coverage — plus a keyword radar for new plugins and star surges.
description.zh: 生态行情面板：把 dsh-plugin topic 与 awesome 收录列表快照成本地历史，产出周报（新增插件、star 增速、类别热度、收录覆盖率），并支持关键词雷达监控新品与 star 突增。

description.en: Installs a self-evolving development-constraints rule library, exposes it to the agent through a constraints tool and a once-per-session reminder, and audits AI token cost and context usage.
description.zh: 把一套会自我进化的开发约束规则库装进项目，通过 constraints 工具和「每会话一次」的提醒交给智能体，并可审计 AI 的 token 成本与上下文占用。

description.en: Records the files and folders an AI agent creates, modifies, deletes, renames or moves, shows them in a draggable floating panel with unread counts, and persists the records as per-workspace JSONL logs.
description.zh: 记录 AI 对文件与文件夹的新建、修改、删除、重命名与移动，在可拖拽悬浮窗中实时展示未读数，并按工作区持久化为 JSONL 日志。

description.en: C/C++ LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using clangd.
description.zh: 基于 clangd 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 C/C++ 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: C# LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using OmniSharp.
description.zh: 基于 OmniSharp 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 C# 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Go LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using gopls.
description.zh: 基于 gopls 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Go 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Java LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using the Eclipse JDT language server.
description.zh: 基于 Eclipse JDT 语言服务器为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Java 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Kotlin LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using kotlin-language-server.
description.zh: 基于 kotlin-language-server 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kotlin 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Lua LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using lua-language-server.
description.zh: 基于 lua-language-server 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Lua 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: PHP LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using Intelephense.
description.zh: 基于 Intelephense 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 PHP 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Python LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using Pyright.
description.zh: 基于 Pyright 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Python 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Ruby LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using ruby-lsp.
description.zh: 基于 ruby-lsp 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Ruby 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Rust LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using rust-analyzer.
description.zh: 基于 rust-analyzer 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Rust 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: Swift LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using sourcekit-lsp.
description.zh: 基于 sourcekit-lsp 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Swift 代码导航和语言服务配置。

description.en: TypeScript and JavaScript LSP configuration plugin for DeepSeek Harness using typescript-language-server.
description.zh: 基于 typescript-language-server 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 TypeScript 和 JavaScript 代码导航及语言服务配置。

description.en: Self-update for the harness launcher; checks npm for a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh, stages the tarball, and applies it on harness exit or via update-and-restart from the web panel.
description.zh: Harness 启动器自更新插件；检查 npm 上的 @deepseek-ai/dsh 新版本，暂存 tarball，并在退出或通过面板「更新并重启」时应用。

description.en: Automatic type-check diagnostics: after the model edits or creates TS files, runs `tsc --noEmit` in the background (debounced per project) and reports errors via the `code_check` tool — grouped by file with line/column, severity and TS error codes, closing the "edit → check → fix" loop.
description.zh: 自动类型检查诊断：模型编辑/创建 TS 文件后后台防抖运行 `tsc --noEmit`，经 `code_check` 工具按文件分组汇报错误（行列号 + 严重级别 + TS 错误码），形成「改 → 查 → 修」闭环。

description.en: In the DSH desktop file preview, click an HTML element (with its source line and column) or lasso part of an image for the vision model to identify, then send your change request to the current session; local HTML edits keep a history with before/after previews, line diffs and rollback.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端文件预览中点选 HTML 元素（附源码行列），或自由圈选图片区域由视觉模型识别目标，写下修改要求后发送到当前会话；本地 HTML 修改保留记录，支持前后预览、逐行对比与回滚。

description.en: Creates, activates, checks and removes external DSH plugins from a conversation through fixed tools; requires the external DSHX devkit.
description.zh: 通过对话中的固定工具创建、激活、检查和移除外部 DSH 插件，需要外部 DSHX 开发工具。

description.en: Local visual React and Tailwind designer with project-scoped file tools; documented for DSH 0.1.5-rc.2.
description.zh: 提供本地 React 与 Tailwind 可视化设计及限制在项目内的文件工具，现有文档面向 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。

description.en: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks blocked-versus-converted metrics.
description.zh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

description.en: Diagnoses current and saved DeepSeek Harness trajectories with AgentDebugX and opens structured reports in its dashboard.
description.zh: 使用 AgentDebugX 诊断当前及已保存的 DeepSeek Harness 轨迹，并在其仪表盘中打开结构化报告。

description.en: Update management for DeepSeek Harness and its plugins: semver-aware dual-source (npm/GitHub) checks for the main program and every installed plugin, a locale-aware banner (zh/en) listing updatable items, one-click updates (the main program is backed up, integrity-checked and rolled back on failure; plugins install via a temp directory without touching other packages), and a watchdog-guarded restart after updating. The settings page adds per-plugin version lamps, live update progress, and banner/notification toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 主程序与插件更新管理：对主程序与每个已装插件做 npm/GitHub Release 双源 semver 比对，GUI 横幅按系统语言（中/英）列出可更新项；一键更新——主程序自动备份、完整性校验、失败回滚，插件经临时目录安装不碰其它包；更新后看门狗自动重启服务。「检查更新」设置页提供逐插件版本状态灯、实时更新进度与横幅/通知开关。

description.en: Restarts the running DSH process from a model tool or a bottom-right GUI control, with launchd KeepAlive detection, a detached-supervisor fallback that aborts the exit when its handshake fails, a macOS desktop restart path, and JSONL restart records correlated by arm id, pid and profile so a restart stays distinguishable from unrelated log activity.
description.zh: 用模型工具或右下角 GUI 控件重启正在运行的 DSH 进程：探测 launchd KeepAlive，无托管时派 detached supervisor 兜底（握手失败即取消退出），桌面版走 macOS 应用重启路径，每次重启写入按 armId、pid 与 profile 关联的 JSONL 记录，使一次重启能与日志里的无关活动区分开。

description.en: Skill Manager page in the DSH settings panel: browse system / user / workspace / preset skills, expand a skill to its file tree, view and edit files, import skills from a zip, and export or delete them (system skills read-only).
description.zh: DSH 设置面板内的「技能管理」页面：按系统 / 用户 / 工作区 / 预设浏览技能，展开技能查看文件树、查看和编辑文件，支持从 zip 导入技能，以及导出、删除（系统技能只读）。

description.en: Local development facts for Harness: environment and runtime-health probes, git status/diff/log/commit, write-time snapshots with version-by-version restore, and project checks for Node, Python and Go.
description.zh: 本地开发事实层：环境探测与运行时健康检查、git 状态/差异/历史/提交、写入前快照与逐版回退，以及 Node / Python / Go 项目检查。

description.en: Quality suite: background tsc --noEmit diagnostics fed back after the agent edits TypeScript, plus a /code-review command running five parallel review lenses with confidence scoring; absorbs dsh-code-check and dsh-command-code-review.
description.zh: 质控套件：agent 编辑 TypeScript 后自动回喂 tsc --noEmit 诊断，另含 /code-review 命令（五镜头并行审查 + 置信度评分）；吸收合并 dsh-code-check 与 dsh-command-code-review。

description.en: Turns what a design, plan or document claims into a model and decides it: UML diagrams rendered, read and reviewed; state machines, protocols and data models checked as models; migrations tested for coverage and rollback symmetry; concurrency claims mined and routed to the checker that can decide them; dependency graphs audited; reports diffed.
description.zh: 把设计、计划或文档里的声称抽成模型再判定：UML 图渲染、读取与审查；状态机、协议与数据模型按模型判定；迁移检查覆盖与回滚对称；并发声称挖掘后分派给能判定它的工具；依赖图审查；报告对比。

description.en: Bridges the Codebase Memory MCP code knowledge graph into DSH and keeps indexed repositories fresh with a debounced filesystem watcher. Windows-only MCP bridge (the watcher half is cross-platform); auto-installs its npm CLI via npx on first start.
description.zh: 把 Codebase Memory MCP 代码知识图谱接入 DSH，并用防抖文件监视器自动保持索引新鲜。MCP 桥接部分仅支持 Windows（监视器跨平台）；首次启动会经 npx 自动安装所需 npm CLI。

plugins.name: dsh-devforge

description.en: Spec-driven service forge and integrated operations workspace for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的规范驱动服务工厂与本机智能体工作台。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A personal home page for DSH that gathers feature entry points and readings into a card wall: one-click DSH core updates, security review of a plugin before install, local Skill management, session status and more. The page is customizable, and any other plugin can add its own cards through the interface.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供一个集成功能入口与信息浏览的个人主页：以卡片墙的形式内置一键更新 DSH 核心版本、审核外部插件安全性、管理本地 Skill、浏览会话状态等功能与信息展示。页面支持高度自定义，并可自由通过接口增加新的卡片。

description.en: Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions.
description.zh: 封装了Python虚拟环境管理指令，减少Agent使用终端指令管理环境时遇到的网络问题和权限问题，兼容不同操作系统，工具内部设置自动网络与镜像路由。工具严格受给定读写权限限制。

description.en: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.
description.zh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

description.en: Code RAG semantic index panel and settings card: live index bar with start/rebuild/cancel, plus one-click detection and configuration.
description.zh: Code RAG 语义索引面板与设置卡片：输入框上方的实时索引条（开始/全量重建/取消），以及一键检测与配置（Qdrant/Ollama/预设/ignore）。

description.en: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
description.zh: DSH 重启插件：可配置的重启方式（Node 原生/旧 PowerShell 适配）、重启后自动继续的提示词、可选看门狗自动拉起。

description.en: Diagnose duplicate DSH loader entry IDs before startup, report version-locked repair status in a read-only settings card, and apply or revert audited loader repairs through an external CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动前诊断重复的 loader entry ID，通过只读设置卡片报告版本锁定的修复状态，并使用外部 CLI 应用或撤销经过审计的 loader 修复。

description.en: Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
description.zh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

description.en: Preflight checks for a DeepSeek Harness plugin before submitting it to the community list: verifies the dsh.bundle manifest, cordis.patch.yml wiring, client bundle shape, and peer ranges that silently exclude prerelease harness builds. CLI plus one read-only agent tool.
description.zh: 投稿社区精选列表前的插件自检：校验 dsh.bundle 清单、cordis.patch.yml 接线、客户端 bundle 形态，以及会静默排除预发布版 harness 的 peer 版本范围。提供 CLI 与一个只读的 agent 工具。

description.en: Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.
description.zh: 全模式调用工具失败自动实录：把原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用的失败错因去重计数后写入 skill，越用越少错。

description.en: Backup, restore and machine-migration for DSH: packs skills (which live outside ~/.dsh, in ~/.agents/skills), plugin manifests, core config, memories, todos and optionally sessions into a tar.gz with a sha256 sidecar, then imports it on another machine as a three-way merge against a baseline, listing per-file differences instead of overwriting changes made there. Credentials never enter an archive (filename deny-list of 27 names plus 7 private-key suffixes plus a content gate, enforced again on the import side), every import writes a pre-restore snapshot first, and an archive can be uploaded to any WebDAV server and pulled back on the new machine. Also includes scheduled backups, a read-only viewer for individual files, and an in-panel cloud card; no npm runtime dependencies (packing uses the system tar).
description.zh: DSH 的备份 / 恢复 / 换机迁移：把技能（技能目录在 ~/.dsh 之外的 ~/.agents/skills）、插件清单、核心配置、记忆、待办、以及可选的会话打成一个带 sha256 边车的 tar.gz，再在另一台机器上以「带基线的三方合并」导入 —— 逐文件列出差异，而不是直接覆盖对方改过的东西。凭据永不进包（27 个文件名 + 7 个私钥后缀的黑名单，外加内容特征闸，导入侧再过一遍），每次导入前先写一份可原样还原的快照；归档可以推到任意 WebDAV 服务（绿联 NAS / 群晖 / 坚果云 / Nextcloud）并在新机器上下载回来。另含定时备份、单文件只读查看、面板内的云端卡片；零 npm 运行时依赖（打包用系统 tar）。

description.en: Registers a `config_doctor` tool that checks the harness's own configuration for problems that boot silently: fields a patch dropped by whole-config replacement, patches targeting missing entry ids, and tool-name collisions. Read-only.
description.zh: 注册 `config_doctor` 工具，检查 harness 自身配置里那些会静默通过启动的问题：patch 整体替换 config 而丢失的字段、指向不存在 entry id 的 patch、工具重名冲突。只读。

description.en: Registers `list_profiles` and `export_profile`, so the agent can show what setups exist and hand back a whole profile — bundle order, plugin versions and patch — as one portable file to share. Read-only.
description.zh: 注册 `list_profiles` 与 `export_profile`：让 agent 列出本机有哪些配置，并把整套 profile（bundle 顺序、插件版本、patch）导出成一个可直接分享的文件。只读。

description.en: Read-only health clinic for the installed DSH plugin set: loader health, dependency integrity, version compatibility, install-script risk, duplicates and patch integrity, delivered as a model tool, a Settings dashboard and JSON reports.
description.zh: 已安装 DSH 插件集合的只读体检诊所：加载健康、依赖完整、版本兼容、安装脚本风险、重复与 patch 引用，交付模型工具、设置面板与 JSON 报告。

description.en: Rewrites pwsh and bash tool commands through `rtk rewrite` and executes the compact equivalent; falls back to the original command when rtk is missing or has no equivalent, and ships a checksum-verified `/rtk install` downloader.
description.zh: 把 pwsh / bash 工具命令经 `rtk rewrite` 改写后执行，让 rtk 的压缩输出进入上下文；rtk 缺失或无等价命令时原样执行，并提供带 SHA256 校验的 `/rtk install` 下载。

description.en: Edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md rules from the web settings panel, live on save.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则，保存后实时生效。

description.en: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
description.zh: 让 Windows 上可用的 bash 工具限制为 Git Bash,并禁用 PowerShell。

description.en: Scans the DSH loader tree at startup for plugin conflicts (duplicate mounts, failed or pending plugins, duplicate config row ids), auto-stops or restores the affected plugins, and shows a conflict report popup in the web UI.
description.zh: DSH 启动时扫描加载器中的插件冲突（重复挂载、启动失败、依赖缺失、配置行 id 重复），自动停用或恢复冲突插件，并在 Web 界面弹出冲突报告。

description.en: DSH sidebar file-activity tab: records file reads/creates/modifies by the agent and the sidebar (including file ops hidden inside bash commands), per-session isolation, survives restarts, click a file for a floating preview (npm: `dsh-file-activity`).
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏文件活动页签：记录 agent 与侧边栏的文件读取/新增/修改事件（含 bash 命令中隐含的文件操作），按会话隔离、重启后恢复，点击文件浮窗预览（npm: `dsh-file-activity`）。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits and pre-commit incremental diff review (npm: `dsh-my-observability`).
description.zh: 可观测性与 Git 工程工具：跨会话持久化的事件审计日志与查询 API、资源看门狗侧边栏面板、结构化 Conventional Commits 提交、提交前增量 diff 审查（npm: `dsh-my-observability`）。

description.en: Load Claude Code assets into DSH at runtime — skills, slash commands, rules, permission rules (deny/ask/allow), subagents and hooks from .claude/, plus Claude Code plugins (plugin.json / marketplace / skills / agents / MCP), via an in-memory IR that keeps .claude as the source of truth and writes back only when you opt in. Also surfaces Claude Code auto-memory in the system prompt, read-only by default, with a write-back switch in the /cc-memory panel. Eight packages: one bundle that installs the whole set, plus the loader and six adapters (skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp, memory).
description.zh: 运行时把 Claude Code 全家桶原样加载进 DSH：.claude/ 的技能、斜杠命令、规则、权限（deny/ask/allow）、子代理与 hooks，以及 Claude Code 插件（plugin.json / marketplace / 技能 / 代理 / MCP）——内存 IR 解析层，.claude 始终是唯一事实来源，只有主动开启才会写回。同时把 Claude Code 的 auto-memory 接入系统提示，默认只读，可在 /cc-memory 面板打开写回。八个包：一个可一键装齐的全家桶包、loader，以及 skills、permissions、agents、hooks、mcp、memory 六个适配包。

description.en: A floating VS Code-like workbench for DeepSeek Harness, with a Monaco editor, file explorer, Git panel, content search and an SSH terminal.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的浮动式 VS Code 风格工作台，包含 Monaco 编辑器、资源管理器、Git 面板、内容搜索与 SSH 终端。

description.en: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use edit instead, applied to all sessions.
description.zh: 纯 host 端守卫，让 write 工具只允许创建新文件：目标已存在时在执行前直接拒绝并提示改用 edit，全局所有会话生效。

description.en: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn pwsh propagation; default rule matches full-width parentheses.
description.zh: 在工具执行前拦截 edit/write 写入内容里匹配配置正则的字符，默认匹配全角圆括号，同一回合命中后连带拦截后续 pwsh，报错文案与正则均可配置。

description.en: Evaluation harness for DSH plugins: YAML cases drive real headless agent runs, assert on tool calls, args, results and token usage, with a baseline gate for CI regression.
description.zh: DSH 插件评测框架：YAML 用例驱动真实 headless agent，断言工具调用/参数/返回与 token 用量，baseline 门禁做 CI 回归。

description.en: Bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directories into DSH with zero migration: project and user-level skills, commands, rules (one system-reminder envelope), agent files, hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/ SessionStart/SessionEnd) and .mcp.json servers, plus Claude Code plugin marketplaces. Ships /cc-plugin for full plugin/marketplace management (claude CLI first, self-implemented fallback), /cc-resume to list and import Claude Code sessions into DSH as native event-sourced logs, and /cc-export to write DSH skills back as Claude Code skills. Two-way Claude Code <-> DSH bridge, versioned and released as dsh-claude-compat.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 .claude/ 目录零迁移桥接进 DSH：项目与用户级 skills、 斜杠命令、rules（单条 system-reminder 信封注入）、agent 文件、hooks （PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart/SessionEnd）、 .mcp.json 服务器，并支持 Claude Code 插件 marketplace。自带 /cc-plugin 插件与市场全管理（claude CLI 优先、自实现兜底）、/cc-resume 列出并把 Claude Code 会话导入为 DSH 原生事件日志、/cc-export 把 DSH skill 导出为 Claude Code skill。Claude Code 与 DSH 的双向桥。

description.en: Migrate Codex (OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop) MCP servers, skills, instructions, memory and session history into DeepSeek Harness with a visual panel or CLI, with dry-run previews and secrets migrated as-is.
description.zh: 把 Codex（OpenAI Codex CLI / Desktop）的 MCP 服务器、技能、全局指令、记忆与会话历史迁移进 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），支持可视化面板与命令行，带 dry-run 预览。

description.en: Contract regression harness for plugin authors: a scripted LLM adapter drives the real pipeline in isolated child processes with session-event assertions (load/contract/behavior/fault layers); zero API key, CI-ready.
description.zh: 插件作者的契约回归风洞：剧本适配器在隔离子进程中驱动真实管线，会话事件断言覆盖加载/契约/行为/故障四层；零 API key，可进 CI。

description.en: Manage development projects from the DSH web UI in a draggable floating window: add/remove, one-click start/stop/restart, hot-reload restart on file changes, and real-time persistent logs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面以悬浮窗口管理开发项目：添加/删除、一键启动/停止/重启、文件变更热重载自动重启、实时日志查看与持久化。

description.en: Reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with per-turn model selection, argument substitution, and state restoration.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 可复用 Markdown Prompt Profile，支持单轮模型选择、参数替换和状态恢复。

description.en: Automated unit-test generation: a /testgen command and generate_tests tool that scaffold, run, and fix tests until they pass (LLM + offline template generators; vitest/jest/mocha/node:test).
description.zh: 自动化单元测试生成：/testgen 命令与 generate_tests 工具，生成、运行并修复测试直至通过（LLM 与离线模板双生成器；支持 vitest/jest/mocha/node:test）。

description.en: Audit what context compaction actually lost. Reads the raw session event log and checks session-constraint survival (the standing instructions the user gave — do-not-X, must-Y, only-in-Z — and whether the summary still carries them; arXiv 2608.11242 measured ~17% survival across compactors), summary hallucination (paths, versions, ports and identifiers the summary invents that were never in the history it replaced), ghost references ("see above" pointing at removed text), token accounting (a summary nearly as large as what it claims to free), and unaccounted prunes. Four agent tools including a cross-session sweep that ranks conversations by how much compaction hurt them. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name.
description.zh: 压缩质量审计：审出上下文压缩到底丢了什么。读原始会话事件日志，检查会话约束幸存率（用户给的常驻指令—— 不要X、必须Y、只准Z——摘要是否还带着；arXiv 2608.11242 实测各压缩器平均只保留 17%）、摘要幻觉（摘要里 出现了历史中从不存在的路径/版本/端口/标识符）、幽灵引用（"如上所述"指向已不在上下文的内容）、token 记账（摘要几乎和它声称释放的一样大）、无据裁剪。四个 agent 工具，含跨会话扫描并按受损程度排序。纯 确定性，不调 LLM——答错就是规则有 bug，有名字可查。

description.en: Audit how each turn's context budget is spent. Breaks down what a turn pays for AGENTS.md, the skill catalog, tool schemas and runtime context; flags repeated injection of unchanged content as pure waste; ranks skill-catalog bloat (with 60+ skills installed, how many tokens of descriptions does the model read every turn) and tool-schema inflation per plugin. Deterministic — no LLM, so a wrong answer is a rule bug with a name. Four tools including a cross-session sweep.
description.zh: 每轮上下文预算审计：拆解一轮对话在 AGENTS.md、技能目录、工具 schema 与运行时上下文上各花了多少；把"内容 没变却每轮重发"标为纯浪费；排名技能目录膨胀（装 60+ 个技能时，模型每轮要读多少 token 的描述）与各插件的 工具 schema 占比。纯确定性，不调 LLM。四个工具，含跨会话扫描。

description.en: OpenFOAM case doctor for DeepSeek-Harness. Six agent tools: audit a case for 25 classes of silent failure (steadyState paired with timeStep writes, limiters set to 1 that let k/epsilon go negative, unbounded advection of transport scalars, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 0 on a skewed mesh, loose solver tolerances, blockMesh vertex/block mismatch, stray time directories, purgeWrite 0); read any dictionary as JSON; survey a sweep of cases; run checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun inside WSL with log parsing; parse logs into the metrics that matter (aspect ratio, non-orthogonality, skewness, residual floor, fatal errors). Deterministic text analysis — no LLM — validated against a real 82k-cell street-canyon snappy case.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 的 OpenFOAM 算例医生。六个 agent 工具：体检算例的 25 类静默错误（steadyState 配 timeStep 写出海量时间目录、限幅器设 1 导致 k/epsilon 变负、输运标量无界对流、斜网格上非正交修正为 0、求解容差过松、blockMesh 顶点/块不匹配、残留时间目录、purgeWrite 0）；把任意字典读成 JSON；扫描参数化扫描目录；在 WSL 里跑 checkMesh/blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/foamRun 并解析日志；把日志解成关键指标（长宽比、非正交度、扭曲度、残差地板、致命错误）。纯确定性文本分析，不调 LLM，已在一台真机的 8.2 万单元格街道峡谷 snappy 算例上验证。

description.en: Read-only DSH profile doctor: the seven config-tree checks (config-clobber, dead-patch, tool-collision, plugin-not-mounted, plugin-stale, entry diff, explain) plus eight ecosystem checks learned from real failures — pnpm store version conflicts that break `dsh plugin add`, patch insert names node_modules cannot resolve, broken junctions, duplicate-capability plugins, orphan backup dirs, GitHub-source deps, npm publish-scope hints, and the minimumReleaseAgeExclude gap. Four agent tools; every finding carries its fix.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH profile 医生：配置树七检（patch 丢字段、死 patch、工具重名、装了没挂载、停更、树 diff、组成解释）加八项生态检查——pnpm store 版本冲突（`dsh plugin add` 报 ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE 的根因）、patch insert 指向不存在的包、断裂的 junction、重复能力插件、孤儿 backup 目录、GitHub 源依赖、npm 发布权限提示、minimumReleaseAgeExclude 缺口。四个 agent 工具，每条 finding 都带修复文案。

description.en: For DSH plugin AUTHORS: run this after you finish writing a plugin and it audits the entire publish path, then hands you the exact GitHub + npm + market commands. Pre-publish gate for DSH plugins. Turns every silent failure in the publish path into a deterministic check: package.json completeness (missing exports\["."], files omitting lib/ so the tarball is empty, no "type": "module", client declared without a ./client export), UTF-8 BOM, JSON/YAML parse errors, cordis.patch.yml insert rows written at the wrong indent (the bug that makes a plugin install and never mount), insert name mismatches, missing entry exports, require() inside ESM, missing LICENSE or README install line, missing tests, unscoped npm names that return a 403 no granular token can diagnose, versions already on the registry, and missing GitHub repos. Six agent tools; every finding carries its fix. Read-only, no LLM.
description.zh: 给插件作者用：写完插件后跑一遍，自动体检整条发布链路，然后给出 GitHub + npm + 市场三步的可照抄命令。 DSH 插件的发布门禁。把发布链路上的每个静默坑变成确定性检查：package.json 完整性（缺 exports\["."]、files 漏了 lib/ 导致发空包、没写 "type": "module"、声明了 client 却没导出 ./client）、UTF-8 BOM、JSON/YAML 解析错误、cordis.patch.yml 的 insert 行缩进写错（正是让插件装上却永不挂载的那个 bug）、挂载名与 package.json 不一致、入口导出缺失、ESM 里调 require()、缺 LICENSE 或 README 安装行、缺测试、裸包名 （granular token 收到无法诊断的 403）、版本已被 registry 占用、GitHub 仓库不存在。六个 agent 工具， 每条 finding 都带修复文案。只读，不调 LLM。

description.en: Scaffold DSH local bundles in the dph format from any workspace and keep a pitfall experience library to steer later development.
description.zh: 在任意工作区按 dph 格式脚手架 DSH 本地插件，并维护踩坑经验库持续修正开发。

description.en: Bridges Multica to DeepSeek Harness through a versioned JSONL process protocol.
description.zh: 通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 Multica 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Zero-touch runtime telemetry for DSH: every session auto-writes task, model tier, tools, failures, duration, status into a human-readable journal with a stats section (pure observer — no tools, no LLM calls, no injection).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 零侵入运行事实遥测：每个会话自动把任务/模型档位/工具/失败/时长/状态写入人机共读观测卡并附统计区（纯观察者——零工具、零 LLM、零注入）。

description.en: Code graph from tree-sitter: codegraph finds declarations, callers, callees, impact and call paths; codegraph_index builds the index, 18 languages.
description.zh: tree-sitter 代码图谱：codegraph 查声明、调用者、被调用关系、变更影响与调用路径，codegraph_index 建索引，覆盖 18 种语言。

description.en: Governs the persistent information and project constraints an agent works with - project orientation and scope, information and document lifecycle, and persistent workspace mutation - through one additive system-prompt section plus deterministic runtime checks.
description.zh: 治理代理在项目中持续接触的持久信息与项目约束：项目定位与范围、信息与文档生命周期、持久工作区变更；通过一个附加的系统提示章节与确定性的运行时检查落地。

description.en: Unified LLM request/response inspector: reasoning-effort tuning, external-think export, traffic & bundle analysis.
description.zh: 统一 LLM 请求/响应检查器：调 reasoning effort、外部思考(think)导出、流量与包分析。

description.en: Escaped, theme-aware HTML code-block rendering service for DSH Web plugins, built on structured syntax-highlight tokens with source line-ending preservation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 插件的转义与主题响应 HTML 代码块渲染服务，基于结构化语法高亮 token，并保留源码换行符。

description.en: Bidirectional RPC between DSH Host and Client through the native Connection and Typert Gateway, with targeted peer calls, cancellation, and connection lifecycle handling.
description.zh: 通过原生 Connection 与 Typert Gateway 在 DSH Host 和 Client 之间提供双向 RPC，支持目标 Peer 调用、取消与连接生命周期处理。

description.en: macOS Desktop only: one-click restart of the DeepSeek Harness Electron app. Confirms before interrupting running turns, blocks during plugin install/update, and records restart phases/logs.
description.zh: 仅 macOS 桌面版：一键重启 DeepSeek Harness Electron 应用；重启前确认运行中的任务，插件安装/更新时拒绝，并记录重启阶段与日志。

description.en: Detects Minecraft mod and plugin projects (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Architectury, Paper) and runs their Gradle client or server task from the session header, with launch logs in a sidebar tab. One-shot tasks such as data generation and GameTest report a pass or fail verdict when they finish.
description.zh: 识别工作区里的 Minecraft 模组与插件工程（Fabric、Forge、NeoForge、Architectury、Paper），在会话标题栏运行 Gradle 的客户端或服务端任务，日志显示在侧栏标签；数据生成与 GameTest 这类会跑完的任务在结束时给出通过或失败的结论。

plugins.name: dsh-daemon

description.en: Registers the DeepSeek Harness web server (dsh web) as an auto-start, self-healing background service — LaunchAgent / systemd / cron plus a 30s health-check watchdog — with seven dsh_daemon_* tools (install/uninstall/reinstall/status/start/stop/update).
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的 web 服务（dsh web）注册为自启动、自愈的后台服务：LaunchAgent / systemd / cron 加 30 秒健康检查 watchdog，并提供 7 个 dsh_daemon_* 工具（安装/卸载/重装/状态/启动/停止/更新）。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.microsoft.com

description.en: Adds a Restart card to the harness settings: one click hands the restart to the DeepSeek Harness launcher (`Launch-DeepSeekHarness.ps1`), which replaces the running web process, and the page reconnects itself once the new instance answers. Windows only; without that launcher the button reports an error instead of restarting.
description.zh: 在设置页增加「重启」卡片：一键把重启交给 DeepSeek Harness 启动器（`Launch-DeepSeekHarness.ps1`）替换正在为页面提供服务的 web 进程，新实例就绪后页面自行重连。仅支持 Windows；缺少该启动器时按钮会报错，而不是完成重启。

description.en: Verifies that Cordis-managed runtime resources return to baseline after isolated plugin teardown, with deterministic cleanup receipts.
description.zh: 隔离插件卸载后验证 Cordis 管理的运行时资源是否回到基线，并生成确定性清理回执。

description.en: Stability audit for installed dsh plugins: static risk grading (hook surface, startup work, inject, entry, dep ranges) plus optional isolated install verification.
description.zh: 已安装 dsh 插件的稳定性审计：静态风险分级（钩子面/启动任务/inject/入口/依赖区间）加可选隔离安装验证。

plugins.name: dsh-tauri-launcher

description.en: Tauri 2 desktop application for Windows that detects (or installs) the global @deepseek-ai/dsh package, launches the DSH Web server and embeds it in its own window, with system tray management, login autostart, a global hotkey and desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 Tauri 2 桌面应用：检测或自动安装全局 @deepseek-ai/dsh 包，启动 DSH Web 并嵌入自身窗口，支持系统托盘管理、登录自启、全局快捷键与桌面快捷方式。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to tauri.localhost

description.en: Rebind running sessions onto a rebuilt agent-preset revision, so preset changes apply without restarting dsh.
description.zh: 把正在运行的会话重绑到重建后的预设 revision 上，让预设改动无需重启 dsh 即可生效。

description.en: Self-diagnosing, self-repairing watchdog for DSH plugins: 15s health patrol, version-switch repair with observe window and auto rollback, unknown symptoms escalated to human.
description.zh: DSH 插件自诊断自修复看门狗：15 秒巡检、带观察窗与自动回退的版本切换修复、未知病症上报人工。

description.en: Restarts the DSH desktop app on Windows and wakes the sessions listed for it afterwards. The agent-facing restart tool is off by default and refuses while the host is busy.
description.zh: 重启 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，并在重启后唤醒清单里指定的会话。面向 agent 的重启工具默认关闭，宿主繁忙时拒绝重启。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for rulemux: asks the local rulemux CLI for the rules rendered for this workspace (rulemux inject --agent dsh) and injects the output into the session at the first user turn, once per session. Nothing is written into the workspace for rules; skills are the only part that lands on disk.
description.zh: rulemux 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：通过 rulemux inject --agent dsh 取当前工作区渲染出的规则，在每次会话的首条用户消息时把输出注入一次。规则不往工作区写任何文件；只有技能会落盘。

description.en: Acceptance gate for DSH: freeze the acceptance criteria into an oracle ledger before work starts, then honor only real execution receipts — files changed after freezing are refused outright, and a failing hard gate overrides any human pass.
description.zh: DSH 验收闸门：动手前把验收判据冻结成 oracle 账本，之后只认真实执行回执——冻结后被改过的文件直接拒绝执行，硬门失败时人工放行也无效。

description.en: Adds a Restart button to the DeepSeek Harness title bar so newly installed plugins can take effect. The first click arms the button and the second one ends the current desktop instance and relaunches the executable. The restart runs in a PowerShell script created through WMI, outside the application job object and without a console window, and every step is written to $DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-restart-plugin.log. Windows desktop app only.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 标题栏加一个重启按钮，让新安装的插件生效：第一次点击进入确认态，第二次点击结束当前桌面实例并重新拉起可执行文件。重启由 WMI 创建的 PowerShell 脚本执行，处于应用的 job object 之外，且不弹出控制台窗口；每一步写入 $DSH_HOME/logs/dsh-restart-plugin.log。仅支持 Windows 桌面版。

description.en: Rewrites the blocked at-sign and four channel fingerprints in system messages at the fetch layer, so WorkBuddy's China gateway stops answering DSH requests with HTTP 400 code 11128; dry-run mode only observes and never modifies the request.
description.zh: 在 fetch 层改写 system 消息里被拦截的 at 符号与四处渠道指纹，让 WorkBuddy 国内网关不再对 DSH 的请求返回 HTTP 400 / code 11128；dry-run 模式只观察、不改动请求。

description.en: Read-only code-reading workspace with multi-repository projects, source-linked notes, code maps and Mermaid diagrams.
description.zh: 只读代码阅读工作台，支持多仓库项目、源码关联笔记、代码地图与 Mermaid 图表。

description.en: DSH plugin for bounded agent evaluation: compare an original with candidate prompt or supported configuration changes against user-supplied checks, record evidence and costs, and leave adoption to the user.
description.zh: DSH 有界智能体评测插件：针对提示词或受支持的配置改动，用用户提供的检查比较原版与候选，记录证据和成本，由用户决定是否采用。

description.en: Three things for DSH plugin development: reload the plugins whose files changed, restart the client when a reload cannot apply a change, and let the model trigger a reload itself. Reload uses DSH's own path, so untouched plugins keep running. Restart starts outside the client, so it completes even when the client is what gets replaced, and refuses while a session or job runs. Lightweight: no parameters, no added context, buttons off by default.
description.zh: 给 DSH 插件开发准备三件事：重载文件有改动的插件、重载办不到的改动就重启客户端、模型能自己触发热重载。重载走 DSH 自带的路径，没碰过的插件继续运行。重启从客户端外部发起，所以被替换的正是客户端也能完成，有会话或后台任务在跑时拒绝。轻量：不带参数、不添加上下文、按钮默认不出现。

description.en: Moves a DSH profile to another machine with its plugins, not only its files: packs the plugin bundle selection and the whole settings layer into one JSON file, then on restore writes the configuration back, restores local plugin sources and plugin-owned data, and installs the plugin bundles the backup recorded that the new machine is missing (plugin manager first, pnpm as a fallback).
description.zh: 换机迁移 DSH profile，连插件本身一起：把插件包选择与整个配置层打包成一个 JSON 文件，恢复时写回配置、还原本地插件源码与插件数据，并安装备份里记录、新机器缺失的插件包（优先插件管理器，失败回退 pnpm）。

description.en: Settings -> Plugins switchboard: every loaded plugin card shows its package description and runtime phase, with fuzzy search and start/stop toggles that never rewrite config files.
description.zh: 设置→插件开关面板：每个已加载插件的卡片显示简述与运行阶段，支持模糊搜索与运行时启动/关闭（不改写配置文件）。

description.en: System proxy detection (scutil/env/PAC) with a status tool and a proxy_export bash snippet tool.
description.zh: 系统代理检测（scutil/env/PAC）：状态工具 + proxy_export 导出 bash 代理片段。

description.en: Runs project check commands itself and records the real exit codes, pins the result to a git or file workspace fingerprint, expires the evidence when the tree changes, and reminds the agent to verify before claiming completion.
description.zh: 由插件自己执行项目检查命令并记录真实退出码，把结果绑定到 git 或文件级工作区指纹；代码一变旧证据自动过期，收尾时提醒 agent 先取证再宣称完成。

description.en: Runs the local Cursor CLI as a child coding agent from DSH - a `cursor_code` tool plus the native one-shot `cursor_subagent` tool, one mirrored DSH sub-session per run, per-task model choice, resumable conversations, a step timeline with real file diffs, and a usage, model and session panel.
description.zh: 把本机 Cursor CLI 当作子编码智能体：提供 `cursor_code` 工具与原生一次性 `cursor_subagent` 工具，每次运行镜像为一个真实的 DSH 子会话，可按任务选模型、会话可续聊，返回逐步工具时间线与真实文件 diff，并提供额度、模型和会话面板。

description.en: Dependency-topology guard: pre-install conflict prediction and post-install detection of duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-* copies, version drift, and vendored core services that cause Symbol-key crashes like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')".
description.zh: 依赖拓扑安全：装前预测 + 装后检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 多副本、版本漂移与插件私包，防 Symbol 键冲突崩溃（Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')）。

description.en: Replaces the headless startup to add --model provider/model, --resume <id|latest>, --continue and --session-info flags to dsh headless runs.
description.zh: 替换无界面启动流程，为 dsh headless 运行添加 --model provider/model、--resume <id|latest>、--continue 与 --session-info 标志。

description.en: Per-process tool-call statistics: a `tool_stats` tool reporting per-tool call counts, error counts, and average durations.
description.zh: 进程内工具调用统计：提供 `tool_stats` 工具，按工具汇报调用次数、失败次数与平均耗时。

description.en: Boot-time watchdog for DSH web: detects broken plugins, disables them persistently so the UI opens, with quarantine audit, automatic probe recovery, and one-click restore.
description.zh: dsh web 启动看门狗：检测并持久化禁用问题插件，让界面正常打开，并提供隔离账本、探针自动恢复与一键恢复。

description.en: Replaces the Windows pwsh executor row so the model-facing pwsh tool runs PowerShell 7, with a shell_router tool for status, diagnosis, and per-user portable installation.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上替换 pwsh 执行器行，让模型侧 pwsh 工具运行 PowerShell 7，并提供 shell_router 工具做状态、诊断与用户级便携安装。

description.en: A governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio and streamable-http): four-level fail-closed authorization, mcpServers JSON import that rejects malformed args, credential redaction at every output boundary, an agent bridge that returns an honest review verdict instead of a fake approval, and a /mcp-reg operator console plus a settings page.
description.zh: MCP 连接器（stdio / streamable-http）的受治理注册表：四级 fail-closed 授权、mcpServers JSON 导入对畸形 args 大声报错、输出边界全程脱敏、agent 桥接返回诚实 review 而非伪装放行，配 /mcp-reg 操作台与设置页。

description.en: Preset doctor for agent presets: scans home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` declarations and legacy `.agent-presets/` dirs across host lines 0.1.0→0.2.0, shows every detected preset as an official-style card (source/era badges, broken red border, per-finding details, current DSH version + era catalog), and syncs a preset to the current syntax per-card behind an explicit confirm dialog (.bak backup + atomic write; report-level findings are never written — startup scans are report-only). npm: `dsh-preset-doctor`.
description.zh: Agent 预设医生：跨宿主线（0.1.0→0.2.0）扫描 home/profile `cordis.patch.yml` 声明与遗留 `.agent-presets/` 目录，把检测到的每个预设以官方同款卡片展示（来源/代际徽章、失效红边、逐条修复项明细、当前 DSH 版本与代际目录）；卡内「同步到当前版本」走显式确认框（.bak 备份 + 原子写，需人工裁决项永不写盘，启动扫描恒只报告）。npm 包名：`dsh-preset-doctor`。

description.en: Runtime diagnostics for DSH plugins: live, restart, or hot reload.
description.zh: DSH 插件运行时诊断：区分实时生效、重启和热重载。

description.en: Change impact analysis plugin that lifts a code change into an evidence-backed impact and verification plan (CHANGE-IMPACT.md + change-impact.json): affected modules, entry points and public exports, risk levels with factors and confidence, and recommended verification commands (read-only, never runs repository commands). Only read-only git queries (rev-parse, diff, status) are run; suggested verification commands are never executed.
description.zh: 变更影响分析插件：把一次代码变更升级为有证据支撑的影响与验证计划（CHANGE-IMPACT.md + change-impact.json）：受影响模块、入口与公开导出、带因子与置信度的风险分级、建议验证命令（只读，不执行仓库命令）。只会执行 rev-parse、diff、status 等只读 git 查询，建议的验证命令不会被执行。

description.en: Turn codebase smells into an executable, priority-ordered refactoring plan: file-length / deep-nesting / function-length / god-object heuristics plus a staged runbook (read-only, no auto-rewrite).
description.zh: 重构入口诊断：把代码库坏味道（超长文件/深嵌套/超长函数/上帝对象）转成带定位、优先级与依赖顺序的重构计划（只读不自动改码）。

description.en: Read-only repository fact scanner kernel for DSH analysis plugins: deterministic probe / file index / modules / dependencies / entry points / symbols / graphs and git facts over a stable JSON schema (CLI + library + skill runbook).
description.zh: 只读仓库事实扫描内核：为分析型插件提供可复现的仓库探测、文件索引、模块、依赖、入口、符号与 Git 变更等硬事实（CLI + 库接口 + 技能 runbook）。

description.en: Test-insight plugin that turns repository facts and change risk into evidence-backed test plans and isolated, reviewable test drafts.
description.zh: 测试洞察插件：把仓库事实与变更风险转化为有证据支撑的测试计划与隔离、可人工审查的测试草稿。

description.en: Android Studio-style ADB logcat viewer with live filtering and level colors.
description.zh: Android Studio 风格 ADB logcat 查看器，支持实时过滤与等级配色。

description.en: Fixes plugins a DSH upgrade left behind: rehearse each rejected plugin in a throwaway home, grant a reversible exact-version exemption when it boots, and refuse when it does not. Also a multi-host compatibility matrix, a public table of every catalogued plugin, and a read-only plugin_health tool.
description.zh: 修复 DSH 升级后被落下的插件：每个被拒绝的插件先在一次性环境里试装试启动，能启动才写一条可撤销的精确版本豁免，不能启动就明确拒绝。另有：多宿主兼容矩阵、覆盖全部已收录插件的公开兼容表，以及只读的 plugin_health 工具。

description.en: Wakes the main agent after any DSH restart so interrupted work resumes automatically — adds a restart tool and an optional canary that validates the boot and aborts with an alert before a broken restart.
description.zh: DSH 重启后唤醒主 agent，让被打断的工作自动接着做；提供一个重启工具，以及可选的探针在启动异常时提前中止并告警。

description.en: Plugin development toolset: mark files read by shell commands, sync code into a profile, mock a plugin backend, preview a plugin frontend, verify plugin loading, spin up an isolated test instance, run named shell shortcuts, and list the plugin's tools.
description.zh: 插件开发工具箱：命令读过的文件自动算已读、代码同步到 profile、后端模拟与前端预览、插件装载验证、隔离测试实例、自定义快捷命令、工具清单。

description.en: Local AI-agent request-log panel: aggregates local logs from atomcode, codebuddy, workbuddy, claude, codex, codearts, gemini, cursor, kimi and dsh, and shows per-round latency, tokens, cache, context and tool calls.
description.zh: 本地 AI agent 请求日志面板：聚合 atomcode、codebuddy、workbuddy、claude、codex、codearts、gemini、cursor、kimi、dsh 等本地日志，查看每轮耗时、token、缓存、上下文与工具调用。

description.en: Windows commit-charge watchdog for DSH Desktop: samples committed memory every 5 seconds, attributes it to the DSH process tree and the largest consumers, blocks automatic restart when DSH is not the main committer, and adds read-only pagefile advice, a 7-day crash timeline and an event export; automatic restart and crash resume are both off by default.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 Windows 提交内存看门狗：每 5 秒采样提交内存，把它归因到 DSH 进程树与占用最高的进程，在 DSH 不是主要占用者时阻止自动重启，并给出只读的分页文件建议、7 天崩溃时间线与事件导出；自动重启与崩溃后自动续接默认都是关闭的。

description.en: Capability transform & assembly engine (Qian Xuesen cybernetics/systems framework): static resident layer manages the skill/MCP/plugin registries, auto-absorbs skills and tool metrics, and drives a negative-feedback evolution loop (scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select promote/reject → 30s rollback); includes a Web UI panel and a GitHub dsh-plugin store bridge.
description.zh: 能力转化与组装引擎（钱学森工程控制论/系统论框架）：静态常驻层管理 skill/MCP/插件三库、自动吸收技能与工具度量，驱动负反馈进化闭环（scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select 晋升/淘汰 → 30s 回滚）；含 Web UI 面板与 GitHub dsh-plugin 商店桥。

plugins.name: dsh-jenkins-plugin

description.en: Jenkins CI integration with a live build-progress panel in the right sidebar, a multi-instance settings page, five model-facing tools (list jobs, build status, console log, workspace, trigger build), and a failure wake that hands a failed followed build to the conversation that followed it.
description.zh: Jenkins CI 集成：右侧栏实时构建进度面板、多实例设置页、五个面向模型的工具（列 job、构建状态、控制台日志、工作区、触发构建），以及构建失败时唤醒当初关注该 job 的那个会话。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Network optimization for the DSH web UI: reduces transfer size with caching and compression to greatly speed up page loading, plus a connection-drop indicator and automatic reconnection. Ideal for users pursuing peak performance or using unstable networks.
description.zh: dsh网页端网络优化：通过缓存与压缩技术降低传输，从而大幅提升网页加载速度；同时提供网络断连指示与自动断网重连功能。非常适合追求极致性能或网络不稳定用户使用。

description.en: Inspects ONNX models (inputs/outputs, shapes, opset, operators, size) and benchmarks them with ONNX Runtime on the local machine or on a remote target over SSH, reporting average/P50/P95/P99 latency, FPS and the execution provider actually used, with PASS/FAIL gates for FPS, P95 latency and model size. Requires Python 3.10+ with numpy, onnx, onnxruntime, and psutil installed (pip install numpy onnx onnxruntime psutil); remote targets need python3, numpy, and onnxruntime.
description.zh: 检查 ONNX 模型（输入输出、形状、opset、算子、体积），并用 ONNX Runtime 在本机或通过 SSH 在远程设备上做基准测试，报告平均/P50/P95/P99 延迟、FPS 及实际使用的执行后端，可按 FPS、P95 延迟和模型体积设置 PASS/FAIL 部署门槛。本机运行需要 Python 3.10+ 并安装 numpy、onnx、onnxruntime 和 psutil（pip install numpy onnx onnxruntime psutil）；远程目标还需要 python3、numpy 和 onnxruntime。

description.en: Circuit breaker for idle agent turns: watches agent/assistant-stream and cancels a turn that produces only reasoning — no text and no tool call — after 45s, after 80000 reasoning characters, or on a degenerate repetition pattern (exact repeat unit, sentence-template repeat, sparse repeat, or 6-gram density). On trip it injects a continue instruction that requires the next action to be a tool call, and ships 11 regression cases plus per-gate tuning.
description.zh: 空转回合熔断器：监听 agent/assistant-stream，对只产出 reasoning、零文本零工具调用的回合实施三重熔断——45 秒无进展、单次思考超 80000 字符、或命中退化重复模式（精确重复单元/句模重复/稀疏复读/6-gram 密度）。熔断后注入继续指令，要求下一个动作必须是工具调用；附 11 个回归用例与逐档调参。

description.en: One-click health check for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 score, plain-language issue list, and safe reversible fixes via the profile's cordis.patch.yml.
