description.zh: 一键体检你的 DeepSeek Harness：0-100 健康评分、问题清单，以及写入 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 的安全可逆一键修复。

description.en: /repro exports a minimal, secret-scrubbed, replayable problem bundle: the session log, failed commands, and Git diff.
description.zh: /repro 导出最小可复现问题包：去 secret 的会话日志、失败命令与 git diff。

plugins.name: dsh-experimental-computer-use-linux-nde-mcp

description.en: DSH Cordis computer-use provider for the ZTE Nde desktop. npm install auto-fetches the musl binary built by computer-use-linux-zte-nde (v0.7.7-nde.3) into the package's own bin/ via postinstall; resolveCommand() resolves the cordis command path against import.meta.url so the mount works regardless of dsh web's cwd. Reserves the shared computer-use slot via ctx.computerUse.register and exposes MCP tools under mcp__computer-use-linux-nde-mcp__* (screenshot, list_windows, click, type_text, doctor, etc.). Two notable Nde fixes upstream of this provider: KWin caption+coords fallback for window targeting, and SnapshotCache that keeps AT-SPI single-wake per (app, pid) so Chrome is not repeatedly disturbed.
description.zh: 为中兴 Nde 桌面定制的 DSH Cordis computer-use provider。npm install 完成后由 postinstall 钩子从 computer-use-linux-zte-nde v0.7.7-nde.3 release 自动下载 musl 静态二进制到包内 bin/，SHA 校验后 chmod +x；cordis patch 里的 command 用相对路径，由 provider 内部 resolveCommand() 依据 import.meta.url 解析为绝对路径，不依赖 dsh web 的 cwd。占用 DSH 一等公民 ctx.computerUse slot，工具命名空间为 mcp__computer-use-linux-nde-mcp__*（screenshot、list_windows、click、type_text、doctor 等）。binary 本身携带两个 Nde 适配修复：KWin 窗口寻址的 caption+coords 兜底，以及 SnapshotCache——同一 (app, pid) 5 秒内的 AT-SPI 树结果复用、避免 Chrome 反复被唤醒。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Runs the agent's shell and file tools in disposable Podman containers, so its access is constrained to the workspace project by default, and adds container, image, volume and secret management with approval-gated control.
description.zh: 让 agent 的 shell 与文件工具在一次性 Podman 容器中运行，默认只能访问工作区项目；同时提供容器、镜像、卷与机密管理，部分操作需审批。

description.en: Restart recovery for DeepSeek Harness web: after a crash or restart, an interrupted agent turn continues automatically (host-side agent/created listener, no browser timing races).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness web 重启恢复：崩溃或重启后，被打断的 agent 回合自动继续（host 侧 agent/created 监听，无浏览器时序竞态）。

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for dsh web: console-free background start (VBS/powershell chain), a tray menu with open UI / logs / icon presets / launch-at-login / restart Harness, one-click install and update of the bundled dsh-plugin-usage-meter, and a dsh plugin half that starts the tray together with the harness.
description.zh: Windows 系统托盘启动器：无窗口后台启动 dsh web（VBS/powershell 链），托盘菜单支持打开界面、日志、图标预设、开机自启与重启 Harness，一键安装与更新内置的 dsh-plugin-usage-meter，并可作为 dsh 插件安装使托盘随 Harness 一起启动。

description.en: Runs project OMA checks before and after tool execution and when a turn tries to finish. Installs its OMA CLI dependency and initializes unconfigured projects on first use. Requires Node.js 22+; initial setup needs network access and project write access.
description.zh: 在工具执行前后以及尝试结束当前轮次时运行项目 OMA 检查。随插件安装 OMA CLI 依赖，并在首次使用时初始化未配置的项目。需要 Node.js 22+；首次初始化需要网络连接和项目目录写入权限。

description.en: Manages DSH skills and MCP servers from the web settings: skill cards with hot enable/disable, workspace scopes, groups, batch migration and drag-and-drop import, plus stdio/HTTP MCP CRUD with connection tests, secret redaction and the unified dsh-panel CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置中管理技能与 MCP 服务器：技能卡片热启停、工作区作用域、分组、批量迁移与拖拽导入，以及 stdio/HTTP MCP 增删改查、连接测试、密钥脱敏，并附带统一 dsh-panel 命令行。

description.en: A dockable IDE workbench for the DSH web UI: a GPU-accelerated terminal (restty renderer over a Rust PTY), a CodeMirror editor, a file explorer, notes, a sandboxed browser, and ripgrep content search.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的可停靠 IDE 工作台：GPU 加速终端（restty 渲染器 + Rust PTY）、CodeMirror 编辑器、文件浏览器、笔记、沙箱浏览器，以及基于 ripgrep 的内容搜索。

description.en: Langfuse observability for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-turn trace trees aggregated by session id, with prompt versioning and evaluation.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的 Langfuse 可观测性插件：会话轮次映射为 Langfuse trace 树（同会话经 session id 聚合），提供 Prompt 版本管理与评测能力。

description.en: fnOS 飞牛 NAS integration for DeepSeek Harness, working through the fnOS browser SDK when the Web UI runs inside an fnOS app frame: follows the NAS theme while DSH is set to system preference, lists and revokes authorized NAS directory grants in Settings, opens files and links in the matching fnOS app, and syncs the DSH page title to the fnOS app window. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进飞牛 fnOS：DSH 界面跑在 fnOS 应用框架里时通过 fnOS 浏览器 SDK 工作——DSH 设为跟随系统时读取并跟随 NAS 主题，在设置里列出和取消已授权的 NAS 目录，把文件与链接交给对应的 fnOS 应用打开，并把 DSH 页面标题同步到 fnOS 应用窗口。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`。

description.en: Component checklist for the shared Semi Design package used by tnnevol DSH plugins, opened from a `Semi UI` button in a conversation header: 35 components plus a multi-account case page, organised into seven sidebar groups from inputs, forms, selectors and trees to tables, cards, overlays and feedback, each rendered live with a one-line description and a page outline, with light, dark and follow-system preview. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-semi-ui-showcase`.
description.zh: tnnevol 系列 DSH 插件共用的 Semi Design 组件检查页，从会话头部的 `Semi UI` 按钮进入：35 个组件加一个多账号案例页，按七个侧边分组组织，涵盖输入、表单、选择器、树、表格、卡片、浮层与反馈，逐个实渲并配一句话说明与页内目录，可切换浅色、深色与跟随系统预览。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-semi-ui-showcase`。

description.en: A local workbench with model metrics, cost estimates, prompt presets, and optional request auditing for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供模型指标、费用估算、提示词库与可选请求审计的本地工作台。

description.en: Three-position toggle (off / this turn / always-on) for an "unlimited mode" that injects a "do not conserve tokens" instruction into the system prompt; the "this turn" mode reverts automatically on the kernel agent/status idle event.
description.zh: 三档切换的「无限大白饭模式」（关 / 本轮 / 常开），控制要不要给系统提示注入「别省 token」的指令；「本轮」靠内核 agent/status 的 idle 事件自动回落。

description.en: Runs the agent's filesystem, bash and PTY terminals inside a Docker container by providing the `ctx.fs` and `ctx.subprocess` seams, so cwd, environment and background processes survive a harness restart.
description.zh: 通过提供 `ctx.fs` 与 `ctx.subprocess` 接缝，把 agent 的文件系统、bash 与 PTY 终端跑在 Docker 容器里；工作目录、环境变量与后台进程可在 harness 重启后存活。

description.en: Concurrency guard and monitor for DeepSeek Harness: FIFO queue when concurrent model requests reach the limit, per-day persisted stats with error-kind classification, and interruption detection for abandoned streams.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 并发监控与门闩：模型请求达上限时 FIFO 排队防锁号，按天持久化统计并做异常分类，检测流被弃用的回合中断。

plugins.name: dsh-model-health-probe

description.en: Manual model probe for DeepSeek Harness: a session-view tab where you pick provider, API type, model and route, then send one real raw HTTP request over openai-completions, openai-responses or anthropic-messages — streaming or not — and read latency, TTFT, HTTP status, token usage and a three-layer diagnosis chain (API request / model response / strict check) on one screen, with errors in plain language.
description.zh: DSH 模型健康检查：会话视图页签内按「供应商 → API 类型 → 模型 → 路由」选定目标，手动发一条真实裸 HTTP 请求（支持 openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages 三协议，流式可切），一屏看清耗时、TTFT、HTTP 状态、token 用量与三层诊断链（API 请求 / 模型响应 / 严格校验），错误全部人话化。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Config snapshot and rollback for DSH: auto-captures before risky changes, ships a standalone restore script that works even when DSH won't boot. Windows only; the restore script is a .bat and needs Node.js.
description.zh: DSH 配置快照与回滚：危险操作前自动留痕，附带独立还原脚本，DSH 起不来时也能救回。仅 Windows；还原脚本为 .bat，需 Node.js。

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
description.zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

description.en: One-click restart for DeepSeek Harness via a sidebar button, a model tool, and a detached watchdog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 一键重启：侧边栏按钮、模型工具与独立守护进程。

description.en: Exposes the DSH dynamic-Cordis toolset to Claude Code over MCP (streamable HTTP on the existing web port, no new listener): ten tools to list, inspect, define, run, stop and permanently remove dynamic plugins in a live DSH session, with the same approval flow the GUI uses for packages that ship a client half. Bearer auth is mandatory — the token is configured on a DSH settings page, the endpoint answers 503 rather than serve without one, accepts loopback only and never emits CORS headers.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的动态 Cordis 工具集以 MCP（streamable HTTP，挂在现有 web 端口上，不新开监听）暴露给 Claude Code：10 个工具，可列出、查看、定义、运行、停止与永久删除某个活 DSH 会话里的动态插件；含 client half 的包仍走 GUI 那套审批流。强制 Bearer 认证——token 在 DSH 设置页配置，未配置时端点直接 503 而不是降级放行，只接受回环访问，且永不返回 CORS 头。

plugins.name: dsh-service

description.en: Self-hosted DSH Web operations panel for safe restart and upgrade, health diagnostics, model-usage statistics and provider quota lookup, backup and session management, task notifications, skill controls, subagent model routing, and Linux permission maintenance.
description.zh: 面向自托管 DSH Web 的运维面板：安全重启与升级、健康诊断、模型用量统计与供应商额度查询、备份和会话管理、任务通知、技能控制、子代理模型路由与 Linux 权限维护。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Ships a skill plus six Node scripts for a DSH install that will not come up - walking the boot stages before readiness, the plugin dependency bridges and junctions under a profile, dead or duplicated plugin rows, and the upgrade path. The scripts are diagnostics first; the rebuild helper only writes when it is given --fix.
description.zh: 携带一份技能加 6 个 Node 脚本，用来处理装完起不来的 DSH——沿 readiness 之前的引导阶段、profile 下的插件依赖桥与 junction、失效或重复的插件行、以及升级路径逐段排查。脚本默认只诊断，重建脚本只有显式加 --fix 才写盘。

description.en: Read-only static checks for DSH profiles, bundle resolution, version compatibility, patches and MCP name conflicts, with pre-install candidate checks.
description.zh: 只读检查 DSH profile、bundle 解析、版本兼容、patch 和 MCP 名称冲突，支持安装前候选检查。

description.en: Plugin development toolkit for DeepSeek Harness with scaffolding, contract checks, plugin vetting, impact analysis, and upstream compatibility tracking.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件开发工具集，提供骨架生成、契约检查、插件体检、影响面分析与上游兼容性追踪。

description.en: Auto-update plugin for DeepSeek Harness — checks and updates a git-checkout or npm-global dsh plus integration repos, with ff-only pulls, automatic rollback, cancel, and an optional idle-aware auto-apply mode.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动更新插件：检查并更新 git checkout 或 npm 全局形态的 dsh 本体与 integrations 仓，仅快进合并、失败自动回滚、可随时取消，可选空闲感知自动应用。

plugins.name: dsh-issue-reporter

description.en: Collects and redacts DSH runtime diagnostics before filing structured issues in GitHub or Gitea.
description.zh: 收集并脱敏 DSH 运行诊断信息，然后向 GitHub 或 Gitea 提交结构化问题报告。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Training Lens opens a local TensorBoard scalar dashboard with selectable metrics, explicit improvement direction, optional EMA smoothing and Chinese/English UI; requires an existing Python environment with TensorBoard.
description.zh: Training Lens · 训练视窗通过 DSH 工具打开本地 TensorBoard 标量监控页面，支持指标选择、改善方向、EMA 平滑和中英文界面；需要已有的 Python 与 TensorBoard 环境。

plugins.name: dsh-zterm

description.en: SSH and JumpServer terminal plugin: real-machine read tools, human-initiated read-write operations, and session management from inside DSH.
description.zh: SSH 与 JumpServer 终端插件：真实机器读工具、人工发起的读写操作，以及 DSH 内的会话管理。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)
reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Environment housekeeper for the agent: toolchain inventory (node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg/browsers), scratch/cache scan with whitelist-guarded one-click cleanup, and the machine rules file (AGENTS.md) editor - all in the Web GUI settings.
description.zh: agent 的环境管家：工具链台账（node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg/浏览器）、缓存与临时目录扫描 + 白名单安全一键清理、机器规则（AGENTS.md）编辑，全在 Web GUI 设置面板。

description.en: Evidence-first frontend release checks: real-browser content, accessibility, runtime, network, and baseline regression reports with screenshots.
description.zh: 证据优先的前端交付验收：用真实浏览器检查内容、无障碍、运行时错误、网络失败与结构基线，并保存截图报告。

description.en: Read-only insight panel for one profile: five views over the same data — config layers, plugin tree, services, tool names and models — each entry showing which layer inserted or disabled it and whether it is running.
description.zh: 只读的 profile 洞察面板：同一份数据的五个视图——配置层、插件树、服务、工具名、模型，每一条都给出被哪一层插入或禁用、此刻在不在跑。

description.en: Detect DSH plugin conflicts and loading failures, quarantine affected bundles and recover them, with offline startup rescue.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 插件冲突与加载故障，隔离和恢复受影响的插件，并在宿主无法启动时提供离线修复。

description.en: Control pnpm build-script approval across DSH profiles from Add Plugin, and repair same-Git-URL updates on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 在“添加插件”中统一控制各 DSH 配置的 pnpm 构建脚本审批，并修复 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 的同一 Git 地址更新问题。

description.en: Select elements, draw arrows or frame areas in DSH previews, send visual feedback to chat and compare before-and-after snapshots.
description.zh: 在 DSH 预览中点选元素、画箭头或框选区域，将修改意见加入对话，并查看更新前后的截图对比。

description.en: Builds, tests, archives and runs an Xcode project or workspace on iOS or macOS through xcodebuild — a live filterable build log, scheme and destination pickers read from the project, and log streaming for simulators and USB devices, including iOS 16 and earlier over libimobiledevice, whose app logs stay readable while the device is locked. macOS only.
description.zh: 在 harness 中通过 xcodebuild 编译、测试、归档并运行 iOS 或 macOS 工程——实时可过滤的构建日志、从工程自身读取的 scheme 与目标设备选择，以及模拟器与 USB 真机的日志流，包含经 libimobiledevice 支持的 iOS 16 及更早设备，其 app 日志在设备锁屏时依然可读。仅限 macOS。

description.en: Local-first control plane for managing multiple DSH runtimes, profiles, presets, sessions, plans, and knowledge references.
description.zh: 面向本地优先管理多个 DSH Runtime、Profile、Preset、Session、计划和知识引用的控制平面。

description.en: DSH-native uv environment manager: create, sync and run Python virtualenvs from the settings tab, with pip fallback, read-only conda visibility and a dry-run project sync preview.
description.zh: DSH 原生 uv 环境管理器：在设置面板创建、同步、运行 Python 虚拟环境，pip 回退、conda 只读可见，项目依赖同步带 dry-run 差异预览。

description.en: Unifies every DSH extensibility seam behind one declarative DSL: a runtime `fabric` service, `fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` tools, and a capability-graph settings page.
description.zh: 用一套声明式 DSL 统一 DSH 的所有可扩展接缝：提供 `fabric` 运行时服务、`fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` 工具，以及能力图谱设置页。

description.en: Plugin compiler with a blueprint registry (scaffold → validate → deploy) exposed as a runtime service, three model tools, and a blueprint-gallery settings page.
description.zh: 插件编译器：以运行时服务提供蓝图注册表（脚手架 → 校验 → 部署），配三个模型工具和一个蓝图画廊设置页。

description.en: Diagnose DSH home, leftover processes, ports, and oversized sessions, then write a paste-ready /doctor report.
description.zh: 诊断 DSH home、残留进程、端口与过大 session，并生成可粘贴的 /doctor 报告。

description.en: Sends a VS Code selection or file path into the open DSH conversation as an @path reference with its line range, inserted at the composer without sending it. Requires the companion VS Code extension shipped as a .vsix inside the bundle (one-click install from the composer, or install it by hand).
description.zh: 把 VS Code 的选区或文件路径以 @路径（含行号范围）插入当前 DSH 对话的输入框，不自动发送；需安装随包附带的 VS Code 扩展（.vsix，可在输入框一键安装或手动安装）。

description.en: Update copilot for DeepSeek Harness: one scan covers the DeepSeek Harness core and every profile plugin; explains what changed and how risky each update is, then updates only what you confirm.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的更新助手：一次扫描覆盖 DeepSeek Harness 本体和每个 profile 的插件，说清改了什么、风险多大，只更新你确认过的那些。

description.en: Aborts a DSH reasoning stream that starts repeating itself instead of letting the turn stall: five rules over the streamed reasoning text (periodic unit, repeated block, repeated line above a share floor, 64-gram density, and a long trailing run of punctuation or whitespace), plus a JSONL fire journal, a Web GUI log panel, and opt-in recovery that retries with a corrective message.
description.zh: 在推理流开始自我重复时提前中断本轮，避免长时间卡死：对推理文本做五条判据（周期单元、重复块、带占比下限的重复行、64-gram 密度、末尾超长标点或空白段），并附带 JSONL 触发日志、Web GUI 日志面板，以及可选的重试恢复（带纠正消息）。

description.en: Shows the installed DeepSeek Harness version in the sidebar, checks npm and GitHub Releases for updates, and provides manual or confirmed update commands.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 版本，检查 npm 与 GitHub Releases 更新，并提供手动或确认后执行的更新命令。

description.en: Self-healing plugin doctor: detects failed DeepSeek Harness plugin rows, disables them automatically after backing up the profile patch, and reports diagnostics via /doctor.
description.zh: 自愈插件医生：检测加载失败的 DSH 插件行，自动备份 profile patch 后禁用失败行，并通过 /doctor 汇报诊断。

description.en: Branch-aware code knowledge graph for DSH - callers, impact, trace and architecture over 158+ languages, freshness-gated, one dispatcher tool, zero MCP sessions.
description.zh: DSH 原生分支感知代码知识图谱：调用链/影响面/路径/架构覆盖 158+ 语言，保鲜门控，切分支索引自动跟随，单工具分发零 MCP 会话。

description.en: Move an entire dsh installation to another machine and check it item by item. Three layers go across: the declaration layer (settings, credentials, plugin declarations and vendored link: sources), the state layer (sessions, storages, skills, attachments) and, optionally, the workspace project code. Sessions are rewritten at the zstd header frame only, workspace paths are remapped through an explicit path mapping, and at the end 14 checks (I1–I13 plus I6b) report PASS / FAIL / WARN. A LAN route pairs two machines and pulls the bundle over directly; merge mode diffs a bundle against a machine that has already been in use and stops before writing anything while conflicts are undecided.
description.zh: 把整台机器的 dsh 搬到另一台并逐条核对。三层一起走：声明层（设置、凭据、插件声明与 link: 插件源码）、状态层（会话、storages、skills、附件），以及可选的工作区项目代码。会话只改写 zstd 首帧，工作区路径按显式映射改写，最后核对 14 项检查（I1–I13，另含 I6b）并给出 PASS / FAIL / WARN。另可局域网配对直传；merge 模式把 bundle 与「已经在用的机器」逐项比对，分歧未决议就停在写盘之前。

description.en: One-click start/stop button pinned to the window bottom-right corner: restarts DeepSeek Harness in place via a detached helper that relaunches the exact boot invocation (loopback same-origin guarded), with an optional stop-only action.
description.zh: 固定在窗口右下角的一键启停按钮：通过脱离终端的辅助进程按原始启动命令重启 DeepSeek Harness（仅本机同源可调），附「仅停止」小按钮。

plugins.name: huaweicloud-devkit

description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.
description.zh: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Update checker (npm edition): a settings page comparing local and latest versions of @deepseek-ai/dsh and every installed plugin, with a red-dot nav reminder and ready-made update commands.
description.zh: 更新检查器（npm 版）：设置页对比 @deepseek-ai/dsh 与已装插件的本地/最新版本，有更新时导航红点提醒，并直接给出更新命令。

description.en: Community distribution: TUI, desktop, and Web UI as one bundle with layered installation.
description.zh: 社区发行版：TUI、桌面端与 Web UI 统一体验，分层安装、一步到位。

description.en: Profile management card for the DSH Web GUI: view, create (base / web / headless templates), copy, rename and delete DSH profiles under ~/.dsh/profiles, with per-profile port configuration and a copyable launch command.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Profile 管理卡片：可视化查看、创建（base / web / headless 三种模板）、复制、重命名与删除 ~/.dsh/profiles 下的 profile，支持逐 profile 端口配置并复制带 --port 的启动命令。

description.en: Track the origin of local development ports on Windows and safely manage verified DSH services.
description.zh: Windows 本地开发端口来源追踪与安全处理工具。

description.en: Enforced pain-point gate: after two non-converged experiments it injects the three questions, denies non-investigative tool calls until answered, and blocks same-direction retries.
description.zh: 强制痛点检查：同一问题连续 2 个实验未收敛后注入三问、拦截非调查类工具调用直到答出、阻止同方向重试。

description.en: Restart button in the window caption band: one click closes the whole desktop app and relaunches it (the original v0.1.0 restart helper). The repository also ships a tool that patches the installed desktop shell so its tray menu carries a Restart item.
description.zh: 窗口标题栏的重启按钮：点一下关闭整个桌面应用再重新拉起（沿用最初的 v0.1.0 重启逻辑）。仓库另附一个工具，可为已安装的桌面壳打补丁，使其托盘菜单里出现「重启」一项。

description.en: Docker-isolated real-host lifecycle tests for DSH plugins across install, boot, tool registration, update, uninstall, reinstall, and recovery, with structured evidence.
description.zh: 在 Docker 隔离的真实宿主中测试 DSH 插件的安装、启动、工具注册、更新、卸载、重装与恢复生命周期，并输出结构化证据。

description.en: Per-conversation behavioral rule fence for DeepSeek Harness: rules live in one JSON file, are edited from a Settings page or the conversation panel, and every rule carries its own on/off switch so a single rule can be muted without deleting it (muted rules are skipped at injection and the remaining numbering stays contiguous); any number of conversations can also be excluded as a whole so they receive no fence at all, and picking conversations never touches the rules themselves; the enabled rules are injected as one runtime-context section at a fixed order so the system prompt prefix stays stable.
description.zh: 给每个对话加一道行为围栏：规则存在一个 JSON 文件里，可在设置页或对话面板里编辑，每条规则右侧都有独立开关，可以随时单独停用某一条而不用删掉它（停用项不参与注入、剩余条目编号仍然连续）；也可以多选若干对话整体排除在外，让它们完全不受围栏约束，勾选对话本身不会改动任何规则；启用中的规则作为一段固定顺序的运行时上下文注入，不重写系统提示词前缀。

description.en: Adds a restart_self tool and /restart command that replace the DSH host process with the same command line and port, then deliver a message into the calling session so the agent picks the work back up by itself.
description.zh: 新增 restart_self 工具与 /restart 命令：以相同命令行与端口替换 DSH 宿主进程，重启完成后向发起会话投递一条消息，让智能体接着自己跑。

description.en: Keeps plugins you have edited (third-party or built-in) as local git repos: deploys an exact commit only after it builds and passes checks, reverts a change that crashes dsh right after it is applied, merges origin updates (npm or git) into your edits, and can open an agent session that squashes your edits into one commit on top of the original release (backup branch first).
description.zh: 把你改过的插件（第三方或内置）保存为本地 git 仓库：只部署已构建并通过检查的指定提交，应用后导致 dsh 崩溃时自动回滚，把 npm 或 git 源的更新合并进你的修改，并可打开智能体会话，把你的修改压缩为原始发布版本之上的一个提交（先建备份分支）。

description.en: Metadata-first runtime profiler for DSH agents: turn/step traces, model and tool wall-time timelines, provider usage, retries, errors, and live or historical sessions.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的运行时分析器：查看 Turn/Step 轨迹、模型与工具耗时、Provider 用量、重试与错误，实时与历史会话都能看。

description.en: Back up your DSH profile configuration to a private GitHub Gist on a schedule, with merged restore.
description.zh: 定时把 DSH 配置备份到私有 GitHub Gist，支持合并恢复。

description.en: GitLab and Kubernetes monitoring for DSH: merge request and pipeline management, deployment and pod status with logs and events, webhook-triggered alerts, and a dashboard UI.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 GitLab 与 Kubernetes 监控：合并请求与流水线管理、部署与 Pod 状态（含日志与事件）、Webhook 告警，以及仪表盘界面。

description.en: Continual self-refinement loop: persistent memory, periodic review-and-refine, cross-session shared knowledge, and automatic rollback through a model-callable harness_refine tool.
description.zh: 持续自我优化闭环：持久记忆、周期评审与自动优化、跨会话共享知识、失败自动回滚，由模型可调用的 harness_refine 工具驱动。

description.en: Compare multiple skills on the same task and pick the winner.
description.zh: 同一任务并行试跑多个技能，对比结果选出最优。

description.en: Evidence-backed Skill self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: redacted trajectory learning, quarantined proposals, arena validation, canary monitoring, automatic rollback.
description.zh: 带证据的 Skill 自进化：脱敏轨迹学习、隔离提案、竞技场验证、金丝雀监控与自动回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-quality-gate

description.en: Turn-end quality gate: when the turn edited code or config it walks each file up to its project root, runs that root one check from a fixed whitelist (`pnpm check`, `cargo check`, `ruff check .`, `tsc --noEmit`) and, only if that check really ran and failed, opens a new turn carrying the failure output instead of letting the turn close.
description.zh: 回合收口质量门禁：本回合改过代码或配置时，把改过的文件逐个上溯到项目根，从固定白名单里为该根跑一条检查（`pnpm check` / `cargo check` / `ruff check .` / `tsc --noEmit`）；只有真跑过且失败才带着输出开新轮修复，而不是让回合直接收尾。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Collapsible right-docked web terminal (xterm.js) bridged to a host PTY over WebSocket: bash/zsh switching, resizable panel, and fold/unfold that keeps the session alive.
description.zh: 右侧停靠的可折叠 Web 终端（xterm.js），经 WebSocket 桥接宿主 PTY：支持 bash/zsh 切换、拖拽调宽，折叠时保留会话。

description.en: Take control of your tmux panes: list/send-keys/capture, run long jobs in a pane with watch mode, and approval-gated destructive commands.
description.zh: 掌控你的 tmux 面板：list/send-keys/capture、在面板中运行长任务并 watch，破坏性命令需审批。

description.en: LLM debug console for DeepSeek Harness: captures the full content of every model call at the llm/stream waterfall (options, stream chunks, usage, wire protocol) and shows it in a DevTools-style docked panel, with shared-prefix context diffing, wire-JSON reconstruction, JSON export and a runtime-tunable capture policy.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的 LLM 调试台：在 llm/stream 层完整捕获每次模型调用（请求参数、流式块、用量、真实 wire 协议），以 DevTools 风格停靠面板展示，支持上下文共享前缀折叠对比、wire JSON 重建、JSON 导出与运行时可调的抓取策略。

description.en: Per-turn tool-call step budget for Agent Teams teammates, shipped together with the team-dev and team-boot skills.
description.zh: 为 Agent Teams 的 teammate 提供按回合的工具调用步数预算，并随包提供 team-dev 与 team-boot 技能。

description.en: Keeps plugin inventories in sync across machines through a secret GitHub Gist, and updates installed plugins to their newest npm or GitHub release. Push shows a diff first: version conflicts default to the newer side, entries only the Gist has stay by default, and entries only the local machine has are pushed. Each update can pick the npm or the GitHub channel, and every install goes through the plugin manager with a live log.
description.zh: 通过私有 GitHub Gist 在多台机器间同步插件清单，并把已装插件更新到 npm 或 GitHub 上的最新发布版。推送前先展示差异：版本冲突默认取较新一方，仅线上有的条目默认保留，仅本机有的直接推送。每次更新可逐项选择 npm 或 GitHub 通道，安装全程走插件管理器并输出实时日志。

description.en: Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md.
description.zh: dsh 规则、命令与技能管理：/rules 斜杠命令、设置面板可视化编辑规则（增改禁用删除、自由区域支持）、带参数的自定义命令、技能管理、AGENTS.md 自动备份与一键恢复。

description.en: Evidence-first guard: warns the agent when it claims success without a matching tool-execution record in recent context.
description.zh: 证据铁律守卫：模型声称成功但上下文中没有对应工具执行记录时，自动注入警告。

description.en: MCP management panel for DeepSeek Harness — live connection status per server (green dot), one-click pip/npx upgrades for local stdio servers with Windows file-lock handling, pause/resume/delete, an add-server form writing cordis.patch.yml, real initialize-handshake probes, and beginner-friendly usage help.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 管理面板：每个服务器实时连接状态（绿点）、本地 stdio 服务器一键升级（pip/npx，自动处理 Windows 文件锁）、暂停/恢复/删除、添加表单直写 cordis.patch.yml、真实 initialize 握手探测与小白友好的使用说明。

description.en: Compares installed plugins against a downloaded DSH update and reports which interfaces they use that the update no longer exposes. Runs before you install, with a dry-run diagnose command for when it declines to act. Windows only, on the DSH desktop app, with Node.js 18+.
description.zh: 在安装 DSH 更新之前，把已装插件用到的接口与更新包里的实际接口逐项比对，指出新版本已经不再提供的那几个；附一个只读的 diagnose 命令，用来查看判定卡在哪一环。仅支持 Windows 上的 DSH 桌面端，需要 Node.js 18+。

description.en: Local development service console for DSH: lists every listening service on the machine and lets users inspect, safely stop, or restart services that were started during development.
description.zh: DSH 本地开发服务控制台：列出本机所有监听服务，并让用户查看、以安全方式停止或重启开发过程中启动的服务。

description.en: Adds a Restart dsh button above Settings that restarts dsh in place: through systemd when dsh runs as a systemd unit, otherwise via process.execve with the same PID (a thin wrapper parent on Windows or Node < 22.15), so whatever started dsh needs no supervisor config (verified on Linux; Docker, macOS and Windows not yet run for real); the page reloads once the new boot id answers.
description.zh: 在「设置」上方添加「重启 dsh」按钮，原地重启：以 systemd 单元运行时由 systemd 重启，否则通过 process.execve 保持同一 PID（Windows 或 Node < 22.15 时保留一个轻量父进程），启动 dsh 的守护进程或终端无需额外配置（已在 Linux 实测，Docker、macOS、Windows 尚未实机测试）；新 boot id 响应后页面自动刷新。

description.en: Structured machine-readable CI output for DeepSeek Harness: JSON/NDJSON session reports, JUnit XML, semantic exit codes, artifact collection and privacy redaction - a dsh profile bundle plus a standalone CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结构化、机器可读的 CI 输出：JSON/NDJSON 会话报告、JUnit XML、语义化退出码、工件收集与隐私脱敏——一个 dsh profile bundle 外加独立 CLI。

description.en: Reuses hooks declared in Claude Code, Codex and opencode configs on dsh, executing shell, webhook, oracle and proxy handlers with zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 把 Claude Code、Codex、opencode 配置里声明的 hooks 原样复用到 dsh，执行 shell、webhook、oracle、proxy 四类 handler，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Turns code review into a hard gate: deterministic severity rules, LLM-assisted findings, a team approval quorum and a durable compliance audit trail that must pass before a merge proceeds.
description.zh: 将代码评审变成一道硬性闸门：确定性严重级别规则、LLM 辅助发现、团队批准法定人数与合规审计追踪，未通过前禁止合并。

description.en: Session export and compliance archiving for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic redaction, Markdown/JSONL/PDF outputs, on-disk archive management, and a trend/audit view.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会话导出与合规归档：确定性脱敏、Markdown/JSONL/PDF 导出、磁盘归档管理与趋势/审计视图。

description.en: Self-healing runtime layer: a resource control loop with strategy switching and repair escalation, error-storm and fiber-failure insight, cross-session knowledge carry-over, a self-healing dashboard and 7 tools.
description.zh: 运行时自愈层：资源控制闭环（策略切换 + 修复升级链）、错误风暴与 fiber 失败洞察、跨会话知识传承，附自愈可视化面板与 7 个工具。

plugins.name: dsh-doctor

description.en: DSH environment diagnosis, graded repair with one-click rollback, and a runtime self-healing service.
description.zh: DSH 环境诊断、分级修复与一键回滚，附带运行时自愈服务。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Restart control for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. A session header button or a tray icon stops the app and its host process, waits for both to exit, clears a stale profile lock, and relaunches, so a newly installed plugin loads without quitting the app by hand.
description.zh: 仅支持 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端重启开关。会话头部按钮与系统托盘图标都会结束应用及其 Host 进程、等待完全退出、清理残留的 profile 锁，然后重新拉起应用，装好新插件后不必手动退出再进。

description.en: Reads IDEA run configurations and launches Java, Spring Boot and Vue projects inside DeepSeek Harness, with colored logs and a fast java -cp startup path.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 IDEA 运行配置，启动 Java / Spring Boot / Vue 项目并查看彩色日志，支持快速启动（java -cp 直启）。

description.en: Sentry for DeepSeek Harness: the tools of Sentry MCP server, a result card, and an issue panel with resolve, ignore and assign.
description.zh: 把 Sentry 接进 DeepSeek Harness：提供 Sentry MCP 服务器的工具、结果卡片，以及可解决、忽略与指派的问题面板。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-unified-panel

description.en: All-in-One MCP and skill manager with feature-based recognition and native OAuth 2.1 authentication.
description.zh: 一站式 MCP 与技能管理中心，支持特征识别与原生 OAuth 2.1 浏览器鉴权。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Visualize the DSH process network path on Windows or WSL with layered DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP probes, detect stale proxy configuration, and apply snapshot-guarded repairs.
description.zh: 可视化 DSH 进程在 Windows 或 WSL 上的网络链路（DNS/TCP/TLS/HTTP 分层探测），检测失效的代理配置，并提供带快照回滚的安全修复。

description.en: In-process crash guard: takes over the fatal-error handlers that would exit DSH, names the responsible plugin from the stack, and disables only that row in the home patch layer, leaving the profile and the provider config inside it untouched. The crash page offers retry, keep-disabled or uninstall, and opens a temporary safe-mode session when no culprit can be named (CLI and web launches only).
description.zh: 进程内崩溃兜底：接管本该让 DSH 退出的致命错误处理器，从栈里认出是哪个插件，只在 home 层停用那一行——profile 与里面的供应商配置一个字节都不写。崩溃页给出恢复、保持禁用、卸载三个选择；认不出是谁时，开一个临时的安全模式会话（仅命令行与 web 启动）。

description.en: Lets build commands run inside the DSH sandbox instead of asking for elevation on every invocation: redirects pure caches (GOCACHE, NPM_CONFIG_CACHE, BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR, PIP_CACHE_DIR) to a temp root, or grants the real cache directories write access in place so they stay shared with the terminal. Dependency stores (GOMODCACHE, CARGO_HOME) are never redirected, only granted. Adds optional user-directory grants (~/.config and friends, all off by default) and a command allowlist that matches exact strings or per-segment after splitting on &&, ||, ; and |, while rejecting redirects that write files (fd duplication like 2>&1 and /dev/null are allowed), command substitution and backgrounding outright. Settings are per-profile or per-session; file edits apply without a restart.
description.zh: 让构建命令直接在 DSH 沙箱内跑通，不再每次申请提权：把纯缓存（GOCACHE、NPM_CONFIG_CACHE、BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR、PIP_CACHE_DIR）重定向到临时目录，或原地授权真实缓存目录以与终端共用。依赖仓库（GOMODCACHE、CARGO_HOME）永不重定向，只做授权。另提供可选的用户目录授权（~/.config 等，默认全关）与命令白名单：支持逐字符匹配，或按 &&、||、;、| 拆段后逐段匹配，写文件的重定向（fd 复制如 2>&1 与 /dev/null 除外）、命令替换与后台执行一律拒绝。配置支持按 profile 或按会话生效，改配置文件无需重启。

description.en: A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.
description.zh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

description.en: Service control panel in DSH Web settings: live host info (PID, versions, uptime, memory/CPU trends, active sessions), npm update banner, and a confirm-guarded graceful stop that warns when tasks are running and can wait for them to finish.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置页的服务控制面板：实时宿主信息（PID、版本、运行时长、内存/CPU 趋势、活跃会话）、npm 更新提醒，以及带确认的优雅停止——任务运行时发出警告，也可等待任务结束后自动停止。

description.en: Read-only agent checkup with four probes (output repetition, error visibility, tool failure rate, context bloat) over recent local session logs, rendered as an HTML report.
description.zh: Agent 体检：对近期本地会话日志跑重复率/错误可见性/工具失败率/上下文膨胀四个只读探针，输出 HTML 报告。

description.en: Project progress panel that scans a configurable root for local projects, infers activity from anchors and git evidence, and exports a self-contained dark HTML report.
description.zh: 项目进度面板：扫描配置根目录下的本地项目，按锚点与 git 证据推断活跃度，支持筛选、锚点标记与自包含深色 HTML 报告导出。

description.en: Read-only panel reporting an instance's plugin bundles, patch inserts, skills, upgrade health and decoupling health.
description.zh: 只读生态面板：汇总实例的插件束、补丁插入、技能、升级健康与解耦健康。

description.en: Configuration vault for DeepSeek Harness: snapshot, diff and safely roll back profile patches, plugin manifests, skills and workspace lists, with credentials excluded by default.
description.zh: 配置保险箱：为 DSH 配置创建快照、对比差异并安全回滚设置补丁、插件清单、技能与规则、工作区列表，凭据默认排除。

description.en: Network proxy manager for DeepSeek Harness: switch between system, manual, and direct modes from a live settings UI, applied instantly.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网络代理管理器：在设置界面即时切换跟随系统 / 手动 / 直连三种模式，立即生效。

description.en: A starter template for dsh plugins covering config, tools, events, services, hooks, browser UI slots, and slash commands.
description.zh: dsh 插件开发模板，覆盖配置、工具、事件、服务、钩子、浏览器 UI 插槽与斜杠命令。

description.en: A web Settings "Loop engine" switch that swaps the agent loop driving every dsh session among five engines — the built-in in-process loop plus hosted Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and Kimi Code — with zero changes to the harness; each hosted engine keeps its thinking and tool calls in the durable session transcript, takes over commands, skills, and the agent preset, and runs sandboxed through the dsh subprocess seam.
description.zh: Web 设置页的「循环引擎」开关，在五套引擎间切换驱动每个 dsh 会话的 agent 循环——内置 in-process 加托管的 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、Kimi Code——无需改动 harness；每个托管引擎都把思考与工具调用写入持久会话记录，接管命令、技能与 agent 预设，并经 dsh 子进程接缝沙箱运行。

description.en: Progressive-disclosure MCP gateway that searches large remote catalogs through `mcp_search`, then invokes exact schemas through `mcp_call` with lazy connections and bounded caches.
description.zh: 渐进披露 MCP 网关：用 `mcp_search` 检索大型远程工具目录，再由 `mcp_call` 按精确 schema 调用，并采用惰性连接与有界缓存。

description.en: Automatically disables a failing plugin so the rest of DSH keeps booting — by patching DSH’s own installed kernel (mount-time quarantine + self-healing), not preflight smoke-tests. Includes status tools and a one-click restore panel.
description.zh: 自动隔离损坏插件、让 DSH 其余插件照常启动——通过补丁 DSH 自身已安装的内核实现（挂载期隔离 + 补丁自愈），而非 preflight 冒烟测试。附带状态工具与一键恢复面板。

description.en: Checks installed DSH plugins for version-declaration and API risks against the current host, with source locations when available, certainty, impact basis and coverage limits. Adds a compatibility settings panel, plugin-detail findings/badges, a compat_check agent tool and a skill provider.
description.zh: 检查已装 DSH 插件相对当前宿主的版本声明与 API 风险，报告可用源码位置、确定度、影响依据和覆盖限制。提供兼容性设置面板、插件详情发现与角标、compat_check 对话工具及 skill provider。

description.en: Generate Functions, MCP tools, workflow Skills, and offline test packages from user-authorized source code.
description.zh: 从用户授权的源码生成 Function、MCP 工具、工作流 Skill 与离线测试包。

description.en: Compares coding agents in isolated Git worktrees with deterministic validation, scoring, and explicit winner application.
description.zh: 在隔离的 Git 工作树中比较编码智能体，并提供确定性验证、评分和显式胜者应用。

plugins.name: dsh-ssh

description.en: SSH profiles, browser terminals, SFTP browsing, port forwarding, proxies, and session-scoped AI access for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 配置、浏览器终端、SFTP 浏览、端口转发、代理与会话级 AI 访问。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Explain supported DSH plugin failures with composition source paths and manual next steps: duplicate insertions, missing bundle patches and peer mismatches; standalone CLI and report viewer, read-only diagnosis offline by default, with unobserved runtime left unknown.
description.zh: 通过组合来源路径和人工下一步解释受支持的 DSH 插件故障：重复引入、bundle patch 缺失和 peer 不匹配；提供独立 CLI 与报告查看器，默认只读离线诊断，未观察的 runtime 保留 unknown。

description.en: dsh-lint-loop v0.7.0 adds bounded, read-only evidence checks for observable shell/bash/pwsh and file-tool changes; uncertain evidence remains incomplete. [Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop/releases/tag/v0.7.0).
description.zh: dsh-lint-loop v0.7.0 通过有界、只读检查点追踪 shell/bash/pwsh 与文件工具产生的可观察变更；证据归因不确定或不足时保留为 incomplete。[正式 Release](https://github.com/lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop/releases/tag/v0.7.0)。

description.en: DSH Desktop workbench for official MATLAB MCP experiments, verified PNG figures, MATLAB-computed metrics, and PID parameter sweep comparisons. Requires Windows, a MATLAB license and the separately installed official MATLAB MCP Server.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop 中通过官方 MATLAB MCP 执行实验，校验 PNG 图像及 MATLAB 计算指标，并比较 PID 参数扫描结果。需要 Windows、MATLAB 授权，以及另行安装的官方 MATLAB MCP Server。

description.en: Read-only semantic code navigation for DeepSeek Harness via local language servers: definitions, references, symbols, diagnostics, hover, and rename preview.
description.zh: 通过本地语言服务器为 DeepSeek Harness 提供只读语义代码导航：定义、引用、符号、诊断、悬停和重命名预览。

description.en: Runtime governor for DeepSeek Harness: zero-progress steering, generation-bound verification evidence, evidence-aware completion guarding, and task-profile tool restriction.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 运行时治理器：零进展回合引导、按代际绑定的验证证据、基于证据的完成守卫，以及按任务配置限制工具集。

description.en: WeChat Mini Program engineering tools: scan a project for pages missing from app.json, scaffold pages with automatic registration, fix orphan pages, manage subpackages, tabBar and components, and drive the WeChat DevTools CLI for preview QR codes and uploads.
description.zh: 微信小程序工程工具：体检扫出没写进 app.json 的页面，建页面时自动注册，一键修复孤儿页，管理分包、tabBar 与组件，并可调用微信开发者工具出预览二维码、上传体验版。

description.en: Diagnostic evaluation plugin for DeepSeek Harness: freezes the confirmed Harness configuration, runs a benchmark, keeps the full session trace, and attributes failures to model, Harness, benchmark or environment.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的诊断型评测插件：冻结已确认的 Harness 配置，跑一遍基准测试，保留完整会话轨迹，并把失败归因到模型、Harness、基准或环境。

description.en: Diagnoses third-party LLM API endpoints from the sidebar: a four-layer check (DNS/TCP/TLS, key and model, a real streaming conversation, then timed repeat runs) reporting time-to-first-token, output speed and success rate, with every failure attributed to the step it stalled at and the byte count that actually left the machine. 37 provider presets, no model names hardcoded.
description.zh: 侧边栏体检第三方 LLM 接口：四层检查（DNS/TCP/TLS、Key 与模型、真实流式对话、连测多轮），报出首字延迟、输出速度与成功率；失败时标明卡在第几步、实际写出多少字节。内置 37 个服务商预设，不硬编码任何模型名。

description.en: Exposes the DSH workspace as an HTTP API: browse, search and read files, and run natural-language agent tasks that answer with cited sources.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区暴露为 HTTP API：浏览/搜索/读取文件，并支持自然语言任务（agent 查阅文档后带出处回答）。

description.en: Compare two running Vite builds inside DSH conversations, choose blind, and review adoption against current project edits. Requires a root-level Vite project in a Git repository with at least one commit.
description.zh: 在 DSH 主对话中体验两版 Vite 应用、盲选，并结合项目当前改动审查采用结果。适用于 Git 仓库（至少一次提交）中的根目录 Vite 项目。

description.en: Exposes dsh's internal capabilities (language, workspace registry, agent-status and approval events) over HTTP under /dsh-api on the local loopback socket dsh already listens on, with SSE fan-out at /dsh-api/events.
description.zh: 把 dsh 内部能力（语言、工作区注册表、agent-status 与 approval 事件）以 HTTP 路由的形式暴露在 dsh 已监听的本地回环 socket 上，前缀 /dsh-api，并通过 /dsh-api/events 提供 SSE 事件推送。

plugins.name: dsh-mcp-skill-panel

description.en: MCP & Skill manager: enable/disable MCP servers and skills from a Settings panel to free context in real time; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call) calls disabled servers on demand, with state-based visibility filtering that keeps user-enabled servers visible.
description.zh: MCP 与技能管理面板：设置页面板实时启停 MCP 服务器与 Skill 释放上下文占用；可选 AI 中间层（mcp_search/mcp_call）按需调用停用服务器，按 server 状态过滤模型可见性（用户打开的保持可见）。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to root

description.en: Crash protection plugin that auto-isolates plugins causing startup crash or hang, with independent watchdog process for total hang recovery.
Makes the agent answer as soon as it has one: injects a deliver-first rule into the system prompt and escalates reminders when tool calls pile up without an answer.
description.zh: 让 agent 一拿到结果就交付：把"先交付、少查询"写进系统提示，并在工具调用持续堆积时逐级提醒它收尾。

description.en: Unified Godot asset and project-goal management for DSH: godot_* model tools, a /gap REST surface, and a better-sidebar UI with asset manager, scene-tree viewer, and Git panel.
description.zh: Godot 资产与项目目标统一管理：godot_* 模型工具 + /gap REST 路由 + better-sidebar 界面（资产管理器 / 场景树查看器 / Git 版本控制）。

description.en: Undo/redo & rollback system for DSH: every config change is auto-snapshotted; undo/redo/restore to any version from the WebUI or the offline CLI/GUI tools (works even when DSH fails to boot).
description.zh: DSH 撤销/回退系统：配置变更自动存档，一键撤销/恢复/回退到任意版本，支持 WebUI 与离线 CLI/GUI 工具（DSH 启动失败也能救）。

description.en: A developer toolkit for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web console: a real multi-tab PTY terminal docked under the composer plus an AI-output file browser sidebar with syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering and image preview.
description.zh: DSH 网页控制台的开发者工具包：一个真实的多标签 PTY 终端（停靠在输入框下方），外加 AI 输出文件浏览器侧栏，支持语法高亮、Markdown 渲染与图片预览。

description.en: Read-only trajectory review in a resizable conversation sidebar, with rule analysis, optional model explanations, evidence navigation, and same-range run comparison.
description.zh: 在可调宽的会话右侧栏中提供只读轨迹复盘、规则分析、可选模型解读、证据定位和同区间运行对比。

description.en: Manage and organize your agent skills by category, tags and collections in DeepSeek Harness, with a settings panel and a slash-command folder picker.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中按分类、标签和集合文件夹管理你的 agent 技能，自带设置面板与输入框文件夹技能挑选器。

description.en: Panel entry for the official client-plugin hot reload that tells you what actually changed first: it diffs each row rev against the last seen state and reloads only the plugin bundles that changed, keeps whole-graph reloads behind an explicit confirmation (a bare call is refused and reports the affected row count), and reports replay counters so a silent no-op cannot hide.
description.zh: 把官方客户端插件热重载做成面板入口，并且先告诉你「到底变了什么」：比对每行 rev 与上次所见后只重载 bundle 变化的那几个插件；整图重载必须显式二次确认（不带参数会被拒绝并回报受影响行数）；同时暴露重放计数，让「点了没反应」无法被静默掩盖。

description.en: Plugin compatibility vet for dsh that compares installed plugins peerDependencies against the running dsh version to flag which ones the startup preflight will refuse to load, prints copy-pasteable fix commands, and offers a top-of-page banner in dsh web to isolate, uninstall or upgrade them, with an automatic backup before the change and rollback if the re-check fails.
description.zh: dsh 插件兼容性体检：把已装插件的 peerDependencies 与当前 dsh 运行时比对，提前指出哪些会在下次启动被预检拒绝加载，并给出可直接执行的中文修复命令；dsh web 顶部横幅可按键隔离、卸载或升级，改动前自动备份、复检不过自动回滚。

description.en: YiHe pkg-dev knowledge packs for DeepSeek Harness: 52 domain packs and 90 RFB experience files for coding cognition.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 YiHe pkg-dev 知识包：52 个领域包与 90 个 RFB 经验文件，用于编程认知。

plugins.name: dsh-accelerator

description.en: Repairs domains blocked by SNI filtering on Windows from inside DSH, without any self-hosted server.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上从 DSH 内部修复被 SNI 阻断的域名，不依赖任何自建服务器。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to 127.0.0.2:8843
uses literal IP 2.5.4.3 for network access

description.en: Starts DSH at Windows logon by writing HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run, and removes exactly that value when the plugin is disabled or uninstalled. 84 lines, no daemon, no background process, no service — the entry is written through execFileSync so a spaced install path stays quoted and actually launches.
description.zh: 写 HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run 让 DSH 在 Windows 登录时启动，插件被关闭或卸载时精确移除那一条。84 行，没有守护进程、没有后台进程、不装服务；通过 execFileSync 写入，安装路径含空格时仍保留引号，登录时确实能拉起。

plugins.name: DSHEssentialTools

description.en: A permanent DSH plugin that bundles a developer workbench, an in-session conversation tree, and a plugin manager: build and run an LVAL project, browse its code, and keep per-program version snapshots with rollback; edit, retry, or branch any message in place, with message micro-versions; a feature manager plus a global-plugin library whose entries each carry an enable tier; cross-dialogue memory, one-shot temporary chats, and model collaboration; five network-permission tiers, mixed-model routing, a security audit, and browser control through a companion extension.
description.zh: DSH 永久插件工作台：LVAL 工程工具的编译/运行、代码查看与程序版本快照回退；会话内对话树（就地编辑 / 重新生成 / 分支）与消息小版本；DET 管理器，以及每条记录各带一档启停权限的全局插件库；跨对话记忆、一次性临时对话与模型合作；五档网络权限、混合模型路由、安全审计，以及经配套浏览器扩展的浏览器控制。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Hands standalone jobs to the Cursor CLI signed in on the same machine, with CLI readiness and proxy diagnostics, child-model settings, and a read-only connectivity test.
description.zh: 将独立任务交给同机已登录的 Cursor 命令行，并提供命令行就绪/代理诊断、子模型设置和只读连通性测试。

description.en: Source-aware prompt injection guard for DSH: tracks untrusted turn context, detects injection signals, scores sensitive sinks, and blocks high-risk tool calls with explainable audit logs.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的来源感知提示词注入防护：跟踪 Turn 中的不可信上下文，检测注入信号，评估敏感 Sink，并通过可解释审计日志阻断高风险工具调用。

description.en: Adds one row to Settings → General with a switch that writes or removes a Windows logon startup entry for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, and registers a dsh_autostart tool exposing the same status, enable and disable operations. Defaults to a single HKCU Run value, no admin rights; the startup-folder launcher mode adds an optional delay and launch arguments.
description.zh: 在 设置 → 通用 里加一行「开机自启」开关，用于设置 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版的开机自启：写入或删除它的 Windows 登录启动项，并注册 dsh_autostart 工具暴露同一组状态查询、开启与关闭操作。默认只写一条 HKCU Run 值，不需要管理员权限；启动文件夹模式额外支持延迟秒数与启动参数。

description.en: Converts session, agent-loop, LLM, and tool lifecycle events into OpenTelemetry GenAI traces and metrics, exported over standard OTLP/HTTP to any compatible backend, with content capture off by default.
description.zh: 将会话、Agent 循环、LLM 与工具生命周期事件转换为 OpenTelemetry GenAI 调用链与指标，通过标准 OTLP/HTTP 导出到任意兼容后端，正文采集默认关闭。

plugins.name: dsh-apirevise

description.en: API regression and acceptance workbench: snapshot the responses of the endpoints you register before the agent edits the backend, rerun them all after the edit, and review a structured field-level diff (status codes, added and removed fields, numeric old → new values with the delta) beside the captured source diff, accepting each endpoint one by one before exporting a Markdown or single-file HTML report.
description.zh: 接口回归验收台：登记端点后先快照响应基线，模型改完后端一键重跑，把结构化字段级差异（状态码、字段增删、数值新旧值与差值）与源码 diff 并排展示，逐项验收后再导出 Markdown / 单文件 HTML 报告。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Reload a plugin or skill you just installed without restarting DSH. reload_plugin clears that plugin's own module cache, unloads the old instance and re-imports it, restoring the previous module if the new code throws; reload_skill forces skill directories to be re-discovered. Ships both as tools and as the /reload-plugin and /reload-skill commands.
description.zh: 不用重启 DSH 就能重载刚装好的插件或技能。reload_plugin 清掉该插件自己的模块缓存、卸载旧实例再重新 import，新代码报错时自动换回旧模块；reload_skill 强制重新发现技能目录。工具与 /reload-plugin、/reload-skill 两个命令都有。

description.en: Self-editing desktop workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a full dsh web replica with an edit mode in which the agent modifies the workbench (patch layers, plugins, UI) with hot reload.
description.zh: 可自修改的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面工作台：完整 dsh web 副本 + 编辑模式，agent 在对话中实时修改工作台（补丁层、插件、UI）并热更新生效。

description.en: Agent Studio for DSH Web: configure models, prompts, per-plugin tool bindings and Skills; trial-run with editable tool results and run history; preserve session capability snapshots; export standalone presets; draft Agents with a guided creator preset.
description.zh: DSH Web Agent 工作室：配置模型、提示词、按插件绑定的工具与 Skills；支持编辑工具结果的试运行和运行历史，保留会话能力快照，导出独立 Preset，并通过引导式创建预设生成 Agent 草稿。

description.en: Document-code consistency guard: audits version headers / changelog tables / directory trees / module & test counts / cross-doc references for drift, with severity-sorted, read-only fix suggestions.
description.zh: 文档与代码一致性守护：版本号/更新记录表/结构树/模块清单/测试计数/交叉引用漂移审计与修复建议，全程只读。

description.en: Weekly digest generator: aggregates git commits, DSH session activity and daily memory entries into a Markdown weekly report, read-only.
description.zh: 周报生成器：聚合最近 N 天的 git 提交、会话活动与每日记忆，自动生成 Markdown 周报，全程只读。

description.en: Close and restart controls for DeepSeek Harness Desktop and Web on Windows, in Settings → General.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 与 Web 提供「关闭程序」和「重启程序」控制，位于「设置 → 通用设置」。

description.en: Packaging pipeline for uni-app x projects: reads the local HBuilderX version, recommends and one-click installs the matching iOS / Android / HarmonyOS offline SDK (panel card with official download links), then drives the HBuilderX CLI to build, sign and upload apps from per-project config files; the engine also ships as list / doctor / check / build tools for the agent.
description.zh: uni-app x 项目打包流水线：读取本机 HBuilderX 版本，按版本推荐并一键配置对应的 iOS / Android / HarmonyOS 离线 SDK（面板卡片附官方下载入口），再按项目配置调用 HBuilderX CLI 打出、签名并上传；引擎同时以 list / doctor / check / build 四个工具暴露给 agent。

description.en: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe and logs, plus shell completions and self-update.
description.zh: 通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。

description.en: One-click page refresh for the DSH Web UI: purges the rebuildable caches (Cache Storage, service workers, /plugins/** bundle bytes) and reloads the page, so a hot-injected client plugin appears without restarting the app.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的一键刷新：先清掉可重建的缓存（Cache Storage、Service Worker、/plugins/** 的 bundle 字节）再重载页面，热注入的客户端插件立刻生效，无需重启应用。

description.en: View and interact with the persistent terminal used by each DSH Agent.
description.zh: 查看并操作每个 DSH Agent 使用的持久终端。

description.en: Low-code project workspace for the DSH web UI. A multi-level file tree with a push-status ledger, in-panel source view and edit, pre-push static checks, and a scaffold for an empty workspace. Requires the MagicalCoder platform and a server profile (address + designer account) for push/pull.
description.zh: 把低代码工程目录搬进 DSH Web 侧栏：多级文件树与推送状态账本、面板内源码查看与编辑、推送前静态校验，以及空白工作区一键铺脚手架。推送/拉取需 MagicalCoder 平台与服务器配置（地址 + 设计师账号）。

description.en: Windows boot autostart and one-click restart for the DSH service, from inside DSH: a resident supervisor that outlives the host, so a failed restart cannot leave DSH down; DSH spawned attached to a hidden console the supervisor owns, so no console window appears; plus a restart button, the current tokenised access URL and an optional post-start hook.
description.zh: Windows 平台的 DSH 服务开机自启与一键重启（都在 DSH 设置页内）：由常驻看护进程启动 DSH，它活得比 DSH 久，因此重启失败不会让 DSH 停摆；DSH 依附在看护进程的隐藏控制台上，不再每条命令弹一个控制台窗口；另有设置页重启按钮、当前带 token 的访问地址与可选的服务启动后钩子。

description.en: Floating power dock for the DSH web GUI: one-click restart or graceful shutdown of the dsh host, loopback-guarded and dependency-free.
description.zh: DSH Web 悬浮电源坞:一键重启或优雅关机,仅限环回访问,零依赖。

description.en: Service farm for DSH: register, start, stop and restart long-running project services, with agent tools (farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register), farm.yaml declarations and an overview drawer UI with live log follow, search and export.
description.zh: DSH 服务农场：注册、启动、停止、重启长驻项目服务，提供 agent 工具（farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register）与 farm.yaml 声明式服务，总览抽屉支持按工作区分组、实时日志 follow、搜索与导出。

description.en: Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live per-session status in the sidebar.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

description.en: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace. Local variables, request headers and bodies, query strings, packages and secret-looking tags are removed before the event reaches the model, and oversized events degrade through source context, breadcrumbs and frames rather than failing.
description.zh: 面向 Sentry 的只读工具：项目列表、组织或项目范围的议题搜索、单个议题详情，以及最新或指定 event 的裁剪后堆栈。局部变量、请求头与请求体、查询字符串、依赖清单以及疑似机密的 tag 会在 event 交给模型前移除；超大 event 会依次降级源码上下文、面包屑与栈帧，而不是直接失败。

plugins.name: dsh-harmony

description.en: Modifies DSH plugin code at runtime, with ordered patches, inspection, and hot reload.
description.zh: 在运行时修改 DSH 插件代码，并提供 Patch 排序、检查和热重载。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Visual development studio for DSH WebUI plugins with isolated Git worktrees, live official-WebUI previews, source editing, patch inspection, builds, and validation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH WebUI 插件的可视化开发工作室，提供隔离的 Git worktree、真实官方 WebUI 预览、源码编辑、Patch 检查、构建与验证。

description.en: Replaces the web profile's pwsh shell executor with a subclass that rewrites every command through `rtk rewrite` before execution for token savings, running the original command unchanged on any rewrite failure (no equivalent, missing rtk, timeout) and keeping sandbox semantics intact.
description.zh: 将 web profile 的 pwsh shell 执行器替换为执行前经 `rtk rewrite` 透明改写的子类以节省 token，任何改写失败（无等价、rtk 缺失、超时）都原样执行且沙箱语义完整保留。

description.en: Model-driven /init command: the agent analyzes the current repo and generates/updates a high-signal AGENTS.md, with a persistent system-prompt reminder to keep it maintained.
description.zh: 模型驱动 /init 命令：让 agent 分析当前仓库并生成/更新高信号 AGENTS.md，并通过常驻 system prompt 提醒持续维护。

description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: Manages local DeepSeek Harness skills in Settings and shows shared Agent skills as read-only.
description.zh: 在设置里管理本地 DSH 技能，并只读查看公共 Agent 技能。

description.en: Browse, enable, disable, and manage Agent Skills from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, and custom directories in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中浏览、启用、停用和管理来自 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini 及自定义目录的 Agent Skills。

description.en: Registers system-prompt sections that make the model reason in Simplified or Traditional Chinese, with strict/prefer modes and an optional reply-language policy. Adds a /thinking-zh command for per-session switching. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 注册系统提示词段落，让模型的内部思考使用简体或繁体中文，支持严格/宽松两种强度，并可单独约束最终回复语言。提供 /thinking-zh 命令做会话级切换。零运行时依赖。

description.en: One-click health check for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar button runs the ops kit's check-health.ps1 through a plain HTTP route (independent of the tool registry) and renders a structured report card; colors follow the active theme, Windows/PowerShell.
description.zh: 一键健康检查：侧边栏按钮经纯 HTTP 路由（独立于工具注册表）调用 check-health.ps1 并渲染结构化报告卡片；配色跟随当前主题，Windows/PowerShell。

description.en: Forge quality gates for DeepSeek Harness: task gates, read-before-edit, bash hazard interception and quality scoring, enforced by the local forge CLI through DSH's typed interception points. Requires the forge CLI on PATH; without it the plugin fails open and says so with a best-effort notice at session start, and task gates also need forge init in the project.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Forge 质量门禁：任务门禁、改前必读、危险命令拦截与质量评分，经 DSH 类型化拦截点由本地 forge CLI 执行。需本机安装 forge CLI，缺失时插件 fail-open 并在会话开始时尽力提示；任务门禁还要求项目已执行 forge init。

description.en: Plugin-combination analysis for the DeepSeek Harness: dependency trees, conflict detection, risk scoring with prediction, visualization, and combination simulation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件组合分析工具：依赖树、冲突检测、风险评估（含预测）、可视化与组合模拟。

description.en: Minecraft server ops via RCON with static command blocking, pluggable local/Pterodactyl adapters, configurable community voting, and multi-layer process detection for Paper, Forge, Fabric, and vanilla servers. The QQ group surface requires the @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot plugin first; the local adapter runs through PowerShell 5.1 on Windows.
description.zh: 通过 RCON 进行 Minecraft 服务器运维，支持静态命令拦截、本地/Pterodactyl 可插拔适配器、可配置的群友投票，以及对 Paper、Forge、Fabric 和原版服务器的多层进程探测。QQ 群入口需先安装 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 插件；local 适配器在 Windows 上依赖 PowerShell 5.1。

description.en: Hot-reloads DSH plugin modules without restarting the app (module-cache purge, junction-path matching, bust fallback) and registers a refresh button in the session header so the browser page loads the new plugin bundles.
description.zh: DSH 插件免重启热重载：清模块缓存、按 junction 路径匹配、失败时带版本号重新导入， 并在会话标题栏注册一颗刷新按钮，让页面立刻加载新的插件 bundle。

description.en: Safe detached DSH restart: /restart and /dsh-restart slash commands with native candidate styling plus a dsh_restart agent tool; a detached worker restarts DSH after 3 seconds without freezing the session, and Windows/macOS use a native Node helper built on the official appExit service.
description.zh: 安全的分离式 DSH 重启：/restart 与 /dsh-restart 斜杠命令（原生候选样式）加 dsh_restart Agent 工具；分离的 worker 在 3 秒后重启 DSH 且会话不冻结，Windows/macOS 走基于官方 appExit 服务的原生 Node helper。

description.en: HarmonyOS development suite for DSH: a right-sidebar HiLog inspector (live stream with level/logger/text filters) and an ArkUI Inspector (screenshot pick, collapsible component tree, node properties with search, box model), two tree sources — the DevEco debug channel (declared padding/margin/border and custom component names) and the uitest accessibility tree — an .ets viewer with ArkTS syntax highlighting, DevEco Studio/CLT toolchain and device management, plus the harmony_ui_tree agent tool. 21 remote methods, 82 unit tests.
description.zh: HarmonyOS 全栈开发套件：右侧边栏提供 HiLog 检查器（实时流与级别/包名/关键词过滤）与 ArkUI Inspector（截图点选高亮、可折叠组件树、节点属性搜索、盒子模型），两种树源——DevEco 调试源（ark 调试链路，提供 padding/margin/border 声明值与自定义组件名）与 uitest 无障碍树；.ets 查看器提供 ArkTS 语法高亮；注册 harmony_ui_tree agent 工具供对话内取组件树；设置页管理 DevEco Studio/CLT 工具链与 USB/网络设备。21 个 Remote 方法，82 个单元测试。

description.en: Offline diagnostic for DSH: 19 checks across env, profile, and session state, with a settings "Doctor" panel and a read-only JSON API.
description.zh: 离线诊断工具：环境/Profile/会话共 19 项检查，带设置「诊断」面板与只读 JSON API。

description.en: Reports conflicting DeepSeek Harness plugin composition — duplicate loader names across bundles (install-shadow), one id given two names, enable/disable fights, and config keys silently overwritten by a later layer — then emits a patch with the final merged values. Ships a CLI that runs when DSH itself will not boot, plus a fusion_report tool that reads the live loader.
description.zh: 检查 DeepSeek Harness 插件装配层的冲突：跨 bundle 重复的 loader 名（install-shadow）、同一个 id 被写成两个 name、一层要开一层要关、以及被后一层静默覆盖的配置键，并把覆盖合成终值补丁。带一条 DSH 起不来时也能跑的 CLI，另有一个会读运行时 loader 的 fusion_report 工具。

description.en: Checkup for the whole plugin lifecycle: before install it verifies dsh.bundle, engine and peer compatibility, native build needs, platform limits and whether the new patch would mount a loader name that is already installed (install-shadow prediction); after install it groups every installed plugin by capability; before update it runs the same checks against the new version and reports only the problems the update introduces. Ships a CLI that runs even when DSH will not boot, plus three read-only tools.
description.zh: 管插件全生命周期的体检：装之前检查 dsh.bundle、引擎与 peer 兼容性、是否需要编译原生模块、平台限制，以及新插件的 patch 会不会挂出已存在的 loader 名（install-shadow 预判）；装之后把已装插件按能力分类；更新前对新版本跑同一套检查，只报这次更新引入的问题。带一条 DSH 起不来时也能跑的 CLI，和三个只读工具。

description.en: One-click restart for the DSH desktop client, from five entries you can toggle individually: a sidebar panel, the sidebar footer, the conversation header, a Settings → General row, or the /restart slash command. The app is closed gracefully (only the main process is signalled, so the host can flush session logs) and relaunched by a detached helper that survives the shutdown; optional guards wait for running tasks or an in-progress plugin install, results land in a receipt, requests are fenced to loopback same-origin, and every switch is persisted in the profile config file. Only the four UI entries can be switched off; the slash command is always available.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版一键重启，五个入口可逐项开关：侧栏面板、侧栏底部、会话标题栏、设置 → 通用行、斜杠命令 /restart。只给主进程发关闭信号让宿主优雅退出（会话日志得以下盘），再由脱离进程树的助手自动拉起；可选守卫会等待进行中的任务或插件安装结束，重启结果写成回执，动作请求仅限本机同源，所有开关落 profile 配置文件。四个界面入口可单独关闭，斜杠命令始终可用。

description.en: Re-encodes WebP attachment images to PNG so alpha-channel images load on LLM backends that cannot decode WebP (e.g. llama.cpp).
description.zh: 把 WebP 附件图片转码成 PNG，让带 alpha 通道的图能在无法解码 WebP 的 LLM 后端上加载（例如 llama.cpp）。

description.en: Multi-cluster Kubernetes management panel powered by local kubectl, with resource filtering, YAML editing, live Pod logs, interactive container terminals, workload restart/scaling, and DSH theme synchronization; accessible from the sidebar or session view. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.
description.zh: 基于本地 kubectl 的 Kubernetes 多集群管理面板：资源筛选、YAML 编辑、Pod 实时日志、交互式容器终端、工作负载重启与扩缩容，并同步 DSH 主题；支持侧栏入口和会话视图。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2。

description.en: Run the dsh runtime on Multica.
description.zh: 让 dsh 运行时跑在 Multica 上。

description.en: Connects DSH to local HTTP proxies automatically via a loopback relay. No TUN, no env vars, zero-restart switching, with sidebar/composer dock controls and live topology.
description.zh: DSH 自动代理：自动识别本机代理端口，固定本地入口无感热切换，免 TUN、免改环境变量、无需重启 DSH。支持侧栏、底栏工作台与输入框胶囊一键启停，内嵌链路拓扑图。

description.en: Discovers installed DSH plugins with tags, overlap and compatibility detection, one-click enable/disable, failure diagnosis, and update checking.
description.zh: 动态发现已装插件并打标分类，检测功能重叠与兼容冲突，一键启停切换、失效诊断与更新检测。

description.en: Session-bound persistent TypeScript REPL for DSH PTC mode: bindings and imports stay live across run_code calls, edit_run_code replaces one line without resending the block, module import/export syntax is adapted via AST rewriting, and durable bindings are restored from the session journal after a cold restart.
description.zh: 把 DSH PTC 模式的顶层 run_code 变成会话绑定的持久 TypeScript REPL：变量与导入在多次 run_code 调用间保持可用，edit_run_code 只替换一行而无需重发整段，import/export 模块语法经 AST 改写适配，持久绑定在冷重启后由会话日志恢复。

description.en: Adds a Restart button to the Windows titlebar of the desktop app: a click opens a confirmation dialog that says how many sessions a restart would interrupt, and confirming quits and reopens the app.
description.zh: 给桌面端 Windows 标题栏加一个「重启」按钮：点一下先弹出确认框（并说明有几个会话会被中断），确认后退出并重新打开应用。

description.en: Cadence SKILL (Virtuoso Lisp) assistant for EDA engineers: official-doc-anchored API lookup (3557 entries across 5 IC6.1.8 manuals, signature confidence levels, never invents APIs) plus zero-execution static analysis driven by a lexical depth coordinate system — iterator-safe deletion with position-sensitive copy() protection, printf placeholder/argument reconciliation, in-loop nth O(N^2) detection, deprecated APIs with page refs, dangerous-intent interception and CIW error-log triage. Host half has zero third-party dependencies.
description.zh: 面向 Cadence Virtuoso 版图工程师的 SKILL 脚本助手：官方文档锚定的 API 检索（5 本 IC6.1.8 手册 3557 条，签名带置信度，查不到绝不臆造）＋不执行代码的深度静态检查——词法深度坐标系可精确判定跨行循环体与同行闭合，覆盖迭代中删除（copy 位置敏感）、printf 占位符与实参对账、循环内 nth O(N^2)、废弃 API（带页码引用），另有危险需求拦截与 CIW 错误日志定位修复。宿主半区零第三方依赖。

description.en: Version and maintenance suite for DSH itself: detects new host releases from npm dist-tags, upgrades with one click, restarts safely, and the web page auto-recovers once the host is back.
description.zh: DSH 版本与运维一体化：自动发现新版本、一键升级、安全重启，重启后页面自动恢复。

plugins.name: dsh-home-hosted

description.en: Starts your dsh web and other servers at boot, sets up and manages services like Gitea and Jellyfin just by asking, and puts them all under one home-hosted panel.
description.zh: 让 dsh web 与其他服务器随开机自动启动；只需一句提示就能搭建和管理 Gitea、Jellyfin 等服务，并统一收纳到一个 home-hosted 面板中。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to schemas.microsoft.com

description.en: Discovers rule files from every convention OMP supports and injects them into the system prompt as an always-apply layer plus a rulebook index, then enforces them with time-traveling stream rules that abort violating output mid-turn, deny a matching tool call, fold a reminder into that call's result, or ask a judge model about the finished reply. The same tool lets the model write new rules, and an audit panel on the Plugins page says why each rule is in force.
description.zh: 从 OMP 支持的每一种约定中发现规则文件,以 always-apply 层加规则索引注入系统提示词,并用时间旅行流规则强制执行——在模型输出中途打断违规内容、拦下会违规的工具调用、把提醒折进该调用的结果,或在回复完成后交由裁判模型判断。同一个工具也让模型能写入新规则;Plugins 页的审计面板会说明每条规则为何生效。

description.en: Read-only work report rebuilt from local session logs: tools used and how often, commands run, files read and written, whether tests passed, failures and their causes, token usage, and whether the task finished.
description.zh: 从本机会话日志只读还原的工作报告：用了哪些工具、各调用多少次、执行了哪些命令、读写哪些文件、测试有没有通过、失败了几次及原因、消耗多少 Token，以及最后完成了没有。

description.en: Ren'Py galgame production workbench: a host-side project service (write gateway plus git snapshots, a dialogue/scene dialect parser, derived progress, human-only review stamps, pinned-SDK validation and playtest, local publish) behind one seam, driven by an embedded web panel and agent tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里制作 Ren'Py galgame 的工作台：宿主侧项目服务（写网关 + git 快照、方言子集解析器、推导进度、只由人盖的审读戳、钉版 SDK 校验与试玩、本地发布）收在一条接缝后面，由内置 Web 工作台面板与 agent 工具驱动。

description.en: Auto-approval agent for DSH permission requests: rule layer (denyAlways/allowlist) plus Hermes Pro semantic adjudication with quick-fail retries, fail-closed to human when Hermes is unavailable, rejection feedback returned to the requesting session, and approve tasks enqueued into the task queue with a shared busy mutex.
description.zh: DSH 权限请求自动审批代理：规则层（黑名单/白名单）+ Hermes Pro 语义裁决（快速失败重试），Hermes 不可用时 fail-closed 转人工；拒绝原因回传发起会话；审批任务入队并与消费端共用忙锁串行化。

description.en: Mandatory cross-review for design proposals and lessons-learned: auto-detects design doc writes and enqueues them (tier=review) into the task queue, delivers the external reviewer verdict back to the initiating session, and appends approved preventive measures to OPS-GUARDRAILS.md (append-only, conflict-checked).
description.zh: 设计方案与事故教训强制交叉评审：自动识别设计文档写入并入队（tier=review），外部评审结论投递回发起会话，approved 的防复发措施以 append-only + 冲突检测方式追加到守则文件。

description.en: Hands DSH reset requests to an external ops agent via a versioned JSON protocol: preflight snapshot, pre-restart maturity gate (no pending approvals, free disk, cooldown), restart, health check, and interrupted-work recovery, with the result delivered back to the requesting session.
description.zh: 把 DSH 重置请求经带版本的 JSON 协议交给外部运维 agent：预检快照、重启前成熟度门禁（无待审批、磁盘充足、冷却期）、重启、健康检查与业务恢复，结果投递回发起会话。

description.en: Tiered task queue as the single source of truth for DSH↔Hermes work (reset > approve > review): enqueue tools for all submission paths, lease/claim model with concurrency 1, priority aging against starvation, atomic busy mutex, and a Hermes-side consumer (cron */1 + monitor gating) that drains tasks, writes review-handoff requests with single-slot checks, and invokes the reset agent.
description.zh: DSH↔Hermes 协作的缓存梯队任务队列（reset > approve > review，queue.json 唯一真相源）：全部提审路径入队、租约/认领模型并发 1、优先级 aging 防饿死、原子忙锁；Hermes 侧消费端（cron */1 + monitor 门控）出队执行、单槽检查写审核请求、调用重置 agent。

description.en: Mirrors assistant streaming frames (deltas, blocks, commits, turn fences) to a configurable NDJSON sink for external consumers.
description.zh: 把助手流式输出帧（增量、块、提交、轮次栅栏）以 NDJSON 形式写入可配置的接收端，供外部进程消费。

description.en: Compiles a Windows .bat/.cmd launcher into a real .exe from inside DSH: renders an icon from a built-in bitmap font, emits a C# wrapper that runs the batch file next to it, compiles with csc.exe (or dotnet build), and can write Start Menu / Desktop shortcuts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内把 Windows .bat/.cmd 启动器编译成真正的 .exe：用内置位图字体生成图标，生成调用同目录批处理的 C# 薄壳，经 csc.exe（或 dotnet build）编译，并可选写入开始菜单/桌面快捷方式。

description.en: Scheduled update checks for DeepSeek Harness itself and installed plugins, applied only in idle windows — four schedule modes (daily, every N hours/days/minutes), bidirectional plugin whitelist, disk-verified installs, and a web settings panel with hot-reload config.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 定时自动更新插件：本体与已装插件一并检查，仅在空闲窗口执行。四种调度模式（每日/每N小时/每N天/每N分钟）、双向白名单、磁盘回读验证、内嵌设置面板热生效。

description.en: Bridges the harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP server into DSH: HarmonyOS device discovery, build/install/run/uninstall, UI automation (click/input/keys/swipe/screenshot), E2E UI-tree inspection, and log/crash analysis as 18 mcp__harmonyos__* tools.
description.zh: 把 harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP 服务桥接进 DSH：鸿蒙设备发现、构建/安装/运行/卸载、UI 自动化（点击/输入/按键/滑动/截图）、E2E 界面树检查、日志与崩溃分析，共 18 个 mcp__harmonyos__* 工具。

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web: start, stop, restart, open the Web UI, tail logs, live status icon, and a launch-at-login toggle.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Windows 托盘启动器：托盘图标一键启动、停止、重启服务，打开 Web UI、查看日志，实时状态图标，并支持开机自启开关。

description.en: Ship a project to Cloudflare and publish your plugin to npm — the first deploy needs no cloud account, and credentials never reach the model.
description.zh: 一句话把项目部署到 Cloudflare、把做好的插件发布到 npm：首次部署零账号，凭据模型看不到。

description.en: Records every session as one readable Markdown timeline inside the session workspace - the full request sent to the model (system prompt and plugin injections included), user input, replies, reasoning, tool calls and results, file reads and writes, web searches, skill loads, command runs and token usage - with a review page, a per-session tab and configurable capture scope.
description.zh: 把每次会话记录成会话工作区内一份可读的 Markdown 时间线——发往模型的完整请求（含系统提示词与插件注入）、用户输入、模型回复、推理过程、工具调用与结果、文件读写、联网搜索、技能加载、命令执行与 token 用量，并带审阅页、会话内标签页与可配置的采集范围。

description.en: Plugin health checks: manifest protocol / patch format / build traps, zero-dependency and read-only.
description.zh: 插件健康检查：扫描清单协议/patch 格式/构建陷阱，零依赖只读。

description.en: Frame-level scan diagnostics for session files (torn/corrupt/empty detection).
description.zh: 会话文件帧级扫描诊断（torn/损坏/空会话检测）。

description.en: Plugin template repo (based on the official turtle-ui repo).
description.zh: 插件模板仓库（基于 turtle-ui 官方仓库）。

description.en: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.
description.zh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。

description.en: Loads Claude-style plugins into DeepSeek Harness (dsh): discovers skills, commands and optional SessionStart hooks from Claude plugin directories, with hot command reload and uninstall cleanup.
description.zh: 把 Claude 风格的插件加载进 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）：扫描 Claude 插件目录，接入 skills、commands 与可选的 SessionStart hooks，支持命令热更新与卸载清理。

description.en: Freshness gate for the agent's test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.
description.zh: 为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。

description.en: Read-only MCP server over the DSH plugin-certification registry, exposing a plugin certification grade, its snapshot and the five-dimension evidence behind it.
description.zh: 基于 DSH 插件认证登记的只读 MCP 服务，对外提供插件的认证等级、其快照以及支撑它的五维证据。

description.en: Performance profiling and LLM cache diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness — context engineering, latency profiling, and cache behavior reports.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的性能剖析与 LLM 缓存诊断：上下文工程、延迟剖析与缓存行为报告。

description.en: Read-only runtime management panel for the official DSH MCP client: connection status, registered tools, errors, and reconnect counts through the /mcp command and a Settings tab, with sanitized display and enable/disable patch suggestions.
description.zh: 官方 MCP 客户端（dsh-mcp-client）的只读运行时管理面板：/mcp 命令与设置页 MCP 页签展示连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数，脱敏展示并提供启停 patch 建议。

description.en: Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.
description.zh: 将会话事件流导出为 OpenTelemetry OTLP 与 Langfuse 的脱敏、缓冲 traces 与指标，默认关闭。

description.en: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity, plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a /style command, per-session persistence, systemPrompt injection, six built-in styles, a web picker, and a renderer registry with per-session/per-tool rules and /export.
description.zh: 运行时切换模型输出风格（对标 Claude Code outputStyles），另加 output.render.* 呈现协议：/style 命令、按会话持久化、systemPrompt 注入、六个内置风格、Web 选择器，以及带按会话/按工具规则与 /export 的渲染器注册表。

description.en: Zero-dependency static and sandbox smoke detector for DSH plugins: package-structure gates, cordis contract scans, keyless headless smoke, and ecosystem-listing checks.
description.zh: 零依赖的 DSH 插件静态检查与沙箱冒烟检测器：包结构门禁、cordis 契约扫描、无密钥无头冒烟，以及生态收录校验。

description.en: Shared toolkit for authoring DeepSeek Harness plugins, published as @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit: a pluggable provider registry seam, fail-closed approval and session-event gates, shared sanitize/pricing/judge modules and a new-plugin skeleton.
description.zh: 编写 DeepSeek Harness 插件的共享工具包，发布为 @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit：可插拔的 Provider 注册表接缝、失败即拒绝的审批与会话事件门、共享的脱敏/计价/裁决模块，以及新插件骨架。

description.en: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins that scores a repo or npm package across install success, maintenance activity, documentation completeness, security scan, and protocol compliance using real CLI evidence, and produces a JSON or Markdown leaderboard report.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供多指标质量评分：基于真实的 CLI 证据对某个仓库或 npm 包在安装成功率、维护活跃度、文档完整度、安全扫描和协议合规五个维度打分，并生成 JSON 或 Markdown 排行榜报告。

description.en: Runs isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DSH plugins in throwaway profiles, returning structured pass/fail records and batch matrices without touching your real profile.
description.zh: 在一次性隔离配置中为 DSH 插件执行安装与冒烟测试，返回结构化的通过/失败记录与批量矩阵，不触碰真实配置。

description.en: Make your dsh ready for serious coding. (Tools x Schemas)^REPL. `skill://`, `ctx://`, `agent://`, `dvc://`, `dsh://`, IPython REPL, Context as Variables, cross compactions recallable, full context revive. `hash-edit`, `dvc://browser`, subagent as function, workflow as function.
description.zh: 能胜任严肃编程任务的 dsh。（Tools x Schemas）^REPL。`skill://`，`ctx://`，`agent://`，`dvc://`，`dsh://`，IPython REPL，Context as Variables，抗压缩可回溯、完整上下文重构。`hash-edit`、`dvc://browser`、subagent as function、workflow as function。

description.en: Session-level verdict on whether compaction would lose unlanded state; structurally refuses per-block screening.
description.zh: 会话级判定：compaction 是否会丢失未落地状态；结构上拒绝逐块筛选。

plugins.name: dsh-frostfin

description.en: Use Kimi Code as the DSH agent loop over ACP, with approvals, slash commands, and local/remote (ssh+tmux) session attach.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 agent loop 换成 Kimi Code（ACP 直连）：审批、斜杠命令、本地与远程（ssh+tmux）会话接入。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Backs up DSH profiles and mints a desktop "revival coin" that restores the harness after a failed boot or install: a boot guard runs a two-phase health check (HTTP 200 plus client render), marks good boots, isolates or rolls back bad ones, and keeps 3 rotating snapshots. Cross-platform.
description.zh: 备份 DSH 环境，启动或安装失败时通过桌面"复活币"一键恢复：内置启动守卫做两阶段健康检查（HTTP 200 + 客户端渲染），标记正常启动、隔离或回滚异常启动，并轮换保留 3 份快照。跨平台。

description.en: Check your DSH setup and fix supported problems after you approve.
description.zh: 给 DSH 做体检，告诉你哪里有问题；你确认后再备份和修复。

description.en: Audits a DSH profile for capabilities nothing consumes: inventories the declared composition rows, counts how often each registered tool and skill is actually called in the session logs, separates calls that were made from calls that returned a result, and reports the ones with no observed consumer. Ships a skill that fixes the evidence-chain format for completion claims.
description.zh: 审计 DSH profile 里没有消费者的能力：清点已声明的组成行，统计每个已注册工具与 skill 在会话日志里真正被调用的次数，把「发起过调用」与「返回了结果」分开，报告没有观察到消费者的那些；并附一份固定「完成声明」证据链格式的 skill。

description.en: Manage GitHub and npm from inside DeepSeek Harness: multi-account switching, repository management, workspace Git tree with one-click push, pre-push Agent review, and npm package browsing, packing, pre-publish review and publishing.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里统一管理 GitHub 与 npm：多账号切换、仓库管理、工作区 Git 版本树与一键推送、推送前 Agent 审查，以及 npm 包的浏览、打包、发布前审查与发布。
