description.en: Skills & MCP section in Settings: browse, create, edit and delete skills with live directory watching, toggle loading of any on-disk skill through frontmatter policy keys, register local folders or GitHub repos as extra skill scan roots, edit the MCP server rows in the profile patch, import MCP config from Claude Code or Codex, and install from a curated market of skill repos and MCP servers.
description.zh: 设置页的「技能与 MCP」分区：技能目录实时监听，可浏览、新建、编辑、删除技能，用 frontmatter 策略键开关任何落在磁盘上的技能；本地目录或 GitHub 仓库可注册为额外技能扫描根；profile 的 MCP 服务器行在页面上编辑，可从 Claude Code / Codex 配置导入；另带精选技能仓库与 MCP 服务器的市场。

description.en: Keeps DeepSeek Harness desktop dsh-auth-* session cookies bounded by deleting stale ones during the token exchange performed on every launch, so random-port accumulation cannot reach the 16 KiB request-header limit and cause an HTTP 431 startup failure.
description.zh: 在每次启动的令牌交换中删除多余的 dsh-auth-* 会话 cookie，让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的 cookie 数量保持在 3 条以内，避免随机端口累积达到 16 KiB 请求头上限而出现 HTTP 431 启动失败。

plugins.name: dsh-noname-kit

description.en: Noname (Sanguosha-like game) extension workshop. AI writes skill and card extensions behind confirmation gates, static validation and block-based safe writes.
description.zh: 无名杀扩展开发工坊。AI 在确认协议、校验门禁与区块化写入的保护下编写武将技能与卡牌扩展。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to fixture
uses literal IP 1.11.5.2 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-ide-database

description.en: JetBrains Database-style data source tree and SQL/Redis consoles with 15 agent tools for DeepSeek Harness. SQL needs Java 8+ installed, Redis does not.
description.zh: 仿 JetBrains Database 的数据源树与 SQL/Redis 控制台，附 15 个 agent 工具。SQL 需本机 Java 8+，Redis 不需要。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 8.1.3.140 for network access

description.en: List the LLM provider routes a running DSH process registered and run one real streamed call.
description.zh: 列出运行中 DSH 进程真实注册的 LLM 路由，并可跑一次真实流式调用。

description.en: Plugin diagnostics for the dsh web GUI: finds plugins that failed to load, bundle rows that never started and broken file links, then reports the findings. Read-only: it does not repair, journal or undo anything.
description.zh: dsh Web 界面的插件诊断：找出加载失败的插件、未启动的 bundle 行与失效的 file 链接，并报告扫描结果。只读：不修复、不写日志、不提供撤销。

description.en: Real AST-based scan of installed plugins for malicious-intent patterns (dynamic eval, cross-plugin writes, exfiltration-shaped network calls), with an optional periodic schedule and auto-quarantine on critical findings.
description.zh: 基于 AST 的已装插件恶意行为扫描：识别动态 eval、跨插件写入、外泄型网络调用等模式，并给出可复核的报告。

description.en: Prunes the tool schema to a whitelist and injects a structural preamble on a session's first turn only, then passes every later turn through untouched.
description.zh: 只在会话首轮把工具清单裁剪到白名单并注入一段结构化前言，之后每一轮原样放行。

description.en: Registers /wrapped, which reads the session's own stats and renders a shareable dark SVG summary card — tool vs. thinking time, decode speed, and a tool/thinking-ratio verdict.
description.zh: 注册 /wrapped 命令，读取会话自身的统计数据，渲染成一张可分享的深色 SVG 总结卡：工具耗时与思考耗时对比、解码速度，以及工具/思考占比的评语。

description.en: Configurable per-turn budgets for supported file mutations, limiting distinct files, mutation calls, and UTF-8 payload bytes before tool execution.
description.zh: 为受支持的文件修改设置可配置的逐回合额度，在工具执行前限制不同文件数、修改调用数与 UTF-8 载荷字节数。

description.en: PWA plugin for DSH — adds offline support, service worker caching, and install-as-app capability.
description.zh: DSH 的 PWA 插件：离线支持、Service Worker 缓存，并可作为应用安装。

description.en: Turns real DSH crash logs into a short hard-constraint list: static preflight before a plugin installs, conflict check afterwards, controlled self-heal when the harness will not start — plus handing a huge session over to a fresh one, the brief written by a model that reads the original transcript.
description.zh: 把 DSH 真实崩溃日志沉淀成精简硬约束：装插件前静态预检拦崩，装完体检冲突，起不来时受控自愈；大会话还能转世成新会话，交接单由模型读懂原会话后写。

description.en: The desktop app has its own refresh button. Edited a plugin but a run is still going? Refresh. Window sluggish after hours of use? Refresh. One button fixes both — running sessions, queued messages and drafts are untouched.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端自己的刷新按钮。开发插件要重启，可手里还有任务在跑？刷新一下！开久了页面越来越卡？刷新一下！一个按钮解决这些烦恼，正在进行的会话、排队消息和草稿都不受影响。

description.en: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
description.zh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

description.en: Local dev panel for the DSH web GUI: follow service logs, start/stop workspace programs, debug Java over JDWP, browse and edit workspace files, and search file names. Needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or later; starting or debugging Java programs needs a local JDK and Maven, and starting front-end programs needs Node.
description.zh: DSH 网页版的本机开发面板：跟随服务日志、启停工作区程序、JDWP 调试 Java、浏览编辑工作区文件与文件名搜索。需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 或更高版本；启动或调试 Java 程序需要本机 JDK 与 Maven，启动前端程序需要 Node。

description.en: Claude Code rules.md-style rule prompts: activate rule markdown files by glob-matching the files an agent reads or edits, with prompt injection and ordering support.
description.zh: 类 Claude Code rules.md 的规则提示词：按智能体读取或编辑文件的 glob 匹配自动激活规则文档，支持提示词注入与排序。

description.en: Records the version of the edit target as an observation when the agent inspected the file with bash instead of the read tool, so the filesystem observation policy stops rejecting edits with FS_NOT_OBSERVED. Applies to edits only; blind whole-file overwrites stay guarded.
description.zh: 当 agent 用 bash（sed/awk/cat）看过文件而非 read 工具时，为编辑目标补登记一次真实版本的观察记录，使文件系统观察策略不再以 FS_NOT_OBSERVED 拒绝编辑；只作用于编辑，整文件盲覆盖仍受保护。

description.en: Replaces the built-in bash executor so every command gets an environment resolved from its own working directory: configurable PATH prepends, Python venv activation and mise shims, with a dedicated section in the Web UI settings.
description.zh: 替换内置 bash 执行器，按每条命令的工作目录解析环境：可配置的 PATH 追加、Python venv 自动激活与 mise shims，并在 Web UI 设置中提供独立分区。

description.en: Minimal-anchored agent preset: request #1 keeps the real bash + str_replace_editor pair with auto-injected context stripped, then promotion unlocks the full Standard catalog and posts a one-shot background-jobs notice against sleep-polling habits.
description.zh: Minimal 锚定的 agent preset：request #1 仅保留真实 bash + str_replace_editor 工具对并剥离自动注入上下文，晋升后开放完整 Standard 工具目录，并注入一次性后台 job 提示纠正 sleep 前台轮询惯性。

description.en: MCP manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: a Settings page beside Plugins that lists the MCP servers the running loader tree actually holds, each with its config summary, endpoint and live state, and disables or restores any of them through a paired-marker block in the profile's cordis.patch.yml. Env values, header values and `!!js` sources reach the page only as key names or dot-paths.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 极简管理：与「插件」同级的一页设置，列出运行中 Loader 树里真实存在的 MCP 服务器及其配置摘要、端点与实时状态，并通过 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 成对标记块停用或恢复任一服务器；环境变量值、请求头值与 `!!js` 表达式只以键名或点路径的形式到达页面。

description.en: Plugin inventory manager for DeepSeek Harness Web: table view of installed plugins with status filters, enable/disable switches applied via HMR, config viewer/copy, uninstall and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 插件总览（逃咪）：以表格视图管理已安装插件，支持状态过滤、HMR 热生效的启停开关、配置查看/复制、卸载与 npm 更新提醒。

description.en: Skill manager page in the DSH Web Settings panel, at the same level as Plugins: lists every skill the installation serves with its own summary, source and disk footprint, and removes any of them into a recoverable trash.
description.zh: DSH Web 设置里的 skill 管理器页面，与「插件」同级：列出当前安装提供的全部 skill 及其自己的简介、来源与占用，并可逐个移除（移除是移入可恢复的回收站）。

description.en: Runs DeepSeek Harness bash commands inside the workspace's Nix dev shell whenever a flake.nix is present.
description.zh: 工作区存在 flake.nix 时，让 DeepSeek Harness 的 bash 命令在 nix develop 的 devShell 环境中执行。

description.en: Agent2Agent protocol v1.0 for DSH: run a standard A2A server to let other agents call this instance, connect to remote A2A agents as clients, and manage both from a visual settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH 实现 Agent2Agent 协议 v1.0：以标准 A2A server 接收其他 Agent 的调用，以 A2A client 连接远程 Agent，并在可视化设置页统一管理连接。

description.en: Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.
description.zh: 独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

description.en: Agent-facing plugin installer that resolves DSH-compatible versions, handles ambiguous names, and verifies the loader entry after install.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的插件安装器：解析 DSH 兼容版本、处理同名歧义，并在安装后校验 loader 入口。

description.en: Adds a Quick Restart entry to the DSH Desktop account menu that quits and relaunches the app in one click. Windows desktop app only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面端账号菜单中新增“快速重启”入口，一键退出并重新打开 DSH。仅 Windows 桌面端。

description.en: MATLAB in the sidebar: a VS Code-like .m editor backed by a persistent MATLAB session (first boot ~6–9 s, then 12–84 ms per run in the default session mode, where figures really open on the desktop), live workspace variables you can edit, .mlx preview, extra folder mounts, and an agent-facing matlab_run tool. Requires a local MATLAB installation.
description.zh: 侧栏里的 MATLAB IDE：类 VS Code 的 .m 编辑器，背后是常驻 MATLAB 会话（首次启动约 6–9 秒，默认 session 模式下单次运行 12–84 毫秒，figure 真的会弹窗），可查看并编辑的实时工作区变量、.mlx 预览、多文件夹挂载，以及给 agent 用的 matlab_run 工具。需要本机安装 MATLAB。

description.en: LLVM static-analysis plugin that builds whole-program bitcode for C/C++ projects and runs kernel-analyzer (KAMain) reachability analysis on it, providing kanalyzer_* tools to the agent and a ctx.kanalyzer service to other plugins.
description.zh: LLVM 静态分析插件，可为 C/C++ 项目构建整程序 LLVM bitcode，并在其上运行 kernel-analyzer（KAMain）可达性分析，向智能体提供 kanalyzer_* 工具，并向其他插件提供 ctx.kanalyzer 服务。

description.en: Adds a { } button under each assistant reply in the DSH Web GUI that opens the exact request sent to the model for that reply: model, call parameters, messages, tools, and provider-reported token usage.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 每条 assistant 回复下方加一个 { } 按钮，点开可查看产生这条回复的那次调用实际发给模型的完整请求：model、调用参数、messages、tools 与 provider 上报的 token 用量。

description.en: Category-based backup of DeepSeek Harness settings, skills, plugins, sessions and storages into verifiable, restorable and downloadable archives, with optional GitHub sync.
description.zh: 按分类备份 DSH 的设置、技能、插件、会话与存储，生成可校验、可恢复、可下载的归档，并支持 GitHub 同步。

description.en: Complement to official Creator mode: stage, validate, live-mount via ctx.plugin, score, and solidify or roll back in-memory tool-plugin trials.
description.zh: 补充官方创造模式：把内存里试过的小工具插件校验、经 ctx.plugin 热挂、打分后固化到盘上或回滚。

description.en: Launch and manage local Maven-based Spring Boot applications on Windows, with service controls and searchable logs in the DSH web interface.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上启动和管理本地 Maven Spring Boot 应用，并在 DSH Web 界面提供服务控制与日志搜索。

description.en: DSH updater + official docs sync in Settings: one-click npm update of @deepseek-ai/dsh with live progress (npm output stream, elapsed timer, monotonic bar), multi-copy protection that only touches the running instance, source-tree mode via git pull, one-click PowerShell 7 install on Windows, incremental sync of the official docs/ with progress, and the dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read model tools.
description.zh: 设置页内的 DSH 更新器 + 官方文档同步器：一键以 npm 全局更新 @deepseek-ai/dsh 并带实时进度（npm 输出流、已运行计时、单调进度条），多副本保护只更新当前运行实例，源码树模式走 git pull；Windows 缺 PowerShell 7 时可一键安装；官方 docs/ 增量同步（按 blob sha 跳过未变文件）带进度条，并提供 dsh_docs_search / dsh_docs_read 模型工具。

description.en: Imports Claude Code setup into DeepSeek Harness from a native settings screen or CLI, with dry-run previews for skills, commands, agents, hooks, permission rules, and MCP config. Codex and OpenCode remain supported as secondary origins, with collision-safe apply and post-move checks.
description.zh: 通过原生设置页或 CLI 将 Claude Code 配置迁入 DeepSeek Harness，可先预览技能、命令、代理、hooks、权限规则与 MCP 配置；Codex 和 OpenCode 作为次要来源继续支持，并提供目标冲突保护和迁移后检查。

description.en: Diagnoses and repairs DeepSeek Harness on native Windows around the official persistent PowerShell and Workspace Write stack, creates the desktop shortcut, and keeps earlier Git Bash and BusyBox presets behind an explicit legacy setup. No WSL.
description.zh: 围绕官方持久 PowerShell 与 Workspace Write 方案检查和修复原生 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness，创建桌面快捷方式，并仅通过明确的 legacy 安装保留早期 Git Bash 与 BusyBox 预设，无需 WSL。

description.en: Windows-only DSH sidebar preview and Dart hot reload for configured Starcompanion / Operit2-derived projects; requires the project preview scripts, a prebuilt debug APK, Android SDK, Flutter and scrcpy 3.3.3.
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 侧栏预览已配置的星伴 / Operit2 衍生工程，操作真实安卓画面并在保存 Dart 后热重载；需要工程预览脚本、预构建调试 APK、Android SDK、Flutter 和 scrcpy 3.3.3。

description.en: Exports selected DSH plugins as one pasteable share code, applies the delta on another machine, and reports which credentials still need configuring.
description.zh: 把勾选的 DSH 插件导出成一条可粘贴的分享码，在另一台机器上应用差量，并列出仍需补齐的凭据。

description.en: Parses DSH session logs to attribute AI-written files, overlays c8 coverage, and reports AI vs human code coverage with a trust score, plus a check/fix/verify tool loop for closing test gaps.
description.zh: 解析 DSH session 日志归因 AI 生成文件，叠加 c8 覆盖率，产出「AI vs 人工代码」覆盖率对比与信任分，并提供 check/fix/verify 三工具闭环补齐测试盲区。

description.en: Dependency graph inspector for DeepSeek Harness: snapshots the live Cordis plugin/service topology into a zoomable browser panel with graph-theory metrics, plus a graph.render tool for the model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件依赖图检查器：把运行中的 Cordis 插件/服务拓扑快照为可缩放的浏览器面板图，附带图论指标，以及面向模型的 graph.render 工具。

description.en: A TPS metrics plugin.
description.zh: TPS 指标插件。

description.en: Unity 2022.3 editor control for the agent: 20 tools that read the scene hierarchy, create and edit GameObjects, components and serialized properties, drive Play mode, capture screenshots, evaluate C# inside the editor and start player builds.
description.zh: 让 agent 直接操作 Unity 2022.3 编辑器：20 个工具可读写场景层级、增删改 GameObject 与组件及序列化属性、控制 Play 模式、截图、在编辑器内执行 C#、发起打包构建。

description.en: Bring a DSH plugin repository's build and release pipeline into the app: a sidebar panel listing each repository's latest workflow run, its releases, and how far the local checkout has drifted from the last release, with buttons to trigger a build, cut a release, publish a draft, re-run, cancel, or read the failed-step log. Drives the workflows through the machine's authenticated gh CLI, so the plugin stores no credential of its own, and which repositories are tracked lives in a config file rather than the package.
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布搬进应用：侧边栏面板逐仓库显示最近一次工作流运行、已发布与草稿 Release，以及本地检出相对上次发布的领先与未提交情况，并提供触发构建、发布、公开草稿、重跑、取消、查失败日志等按钮。通过本机已登录的 gh CLI 驱动工作流，插件自身不保存任何凭据，被监视的仓库列表放在配置文件里、不打进包。

description.en: Runs a fixed set of agent benchmark cases in isolated sandboxes, scores each case with deterministic assertions, and diffs two runs to show which cases regressed after a model, prompt or DSH upgrade.
description.zh: 在隔离沙箱里跑一组固定的 Agent 用例，用确定性断言判分，并对比两次运行，指出换模型、改提示词或升级 DSH 之后哪条用例退化了。

plugins.name: dsh-environment-tray

description.en: Manage environment variables, .env files, and credentials in DeepSeek Harness, including Windows user and system environment variables.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理环境变量、.env 文件和凭据，支持 Windows 用户级与系统级环境变量。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Requires mise installed on the host. A mise-backed toolchain manager for the host machine — a settings page listing the active, installed and available versions, with .mise.toml-driven install, use, uninstall and prune, mise shims prepended to the host PATH on load, and nine agent tools for the same work (status, versions, PATH scan, install, use, prune, uninstall, activate, progress).
description.zh: 需本机先安装 mise。用 mise 管理本机工具链 —— 设置页列出生效 / 已装 / 可用版本，按 .mise.toml 安装、切换、卸载与清理，加载时把 mise 的 shims 放进 Host PATH 最前，并给 agent 九个工具（状态、版本、PATH 扫描、安装、切换、清理、卸载、激活、进度）。

description.en: Keeps the PTC run_code deadline from firing while DSH waits for your answer, plan review or approval, so a question can stay open longer than the shipped 120 s budget.
description.zh: 把 PTC 模式 run_code 的执行预算在人机等待期间暂停，提问、计划审议或审批可以超过出厂的 120 秒而不被中断。

description.en: Adjust Agent Team's member count, task count, message size and teardown timeout.
description.zh: 调整 Agent Team 的人数、任务数、单条消息大小与清理超时。

description.en: Loopback-only ACP door for DeepSeek Harness: connect VS Code and other local clients to a running kernel over the local loopback address, sharing its models, tools, memory and sessions. Browse history, change permission modes and call capabilities registered by DSH plugins.
description.zh: 为正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 内核提供仅监听本机回环地址的 ACP 接入点，供 VS Code 等本机客户端连接，共用模型、工具、记忆和会话，并支持历史查看、权限切换及调用 DSH 插件已注册的能力。

description.en: Test-stability tools: repeatedly run vitest/jest/pytest/node:test suites, classify flaky cases, keep history, maintain a quarantine manifest and health self-check.
description.zh: 测试稳定性工具：重复运行 vitest/jest/pytest/node:test，识别 flaky 用例，历史留档、隔离清单与健康自检。

description.en: Evidence-backed inspector for DSH Web built-in capabilities: runtime/config provenance, compatibility and drift diagnostics, plus fail-closed controls for nine reviewed UI leaves.
description.zh: DSH Web 内置 capability 的 evidence-backed 检查器：展示运行/配置溯源、兼容性与漂移诊断，并仅为 9 个经过审阅的 UI leaf 提供 fail-closed 控制。

description.en: Provider-scoped HTTP/HTTPS forward proxy for DeepSeek Harness: configure independent proxy URLs and enable/disable switches per LLM provider, with environment-variable references for proxy credentials and model discovery routing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的按 Provider HTTP/HTTPS 代理：为每个 LLM Provider 独立配置代理地址和启停开关，支持通过环境变量引用代理凭据，并让模型发现请求使用对应 Provider 的代理。

description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.
description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash 提供者换成 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令作用于挂载的资源（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres）而非宿主磁盘，支持按挂载点设置读/写/执行模式、按命令选择沙箱（进程内 monty、pyodide、quickjs；远程 docker、e2b、daytona），并可在虚拟终端中安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws，或自行注册的程序树）作为命令头词。

description.en: Reloads an upgraded plugin inside the running dsh process instead of restarting it, and rolls back to the old version when a reload fails.
description.zh: 插件升级后在运行中的 dsh 内直接重载，无需重启；重载失败时回滚到旧版本并提示手动重启。

description.en: Version management for dsh: inspect the installed version against every npm channel or version line, install or downgrade in one click, stream the install log live (rollback-snapshot copy progress, npm extraction progress, elapsed time), roll back instantly from local snapshots, and automate the cycle with a policy engine (silent auto-update, execution windows, daily checks). Never stops npm mid-install — a wedged run is only stopped after an hour, and a half-committed global tree is detected and repaired from the pre-install snapshot automatically. Confirms before installing a found update, auto-restarts the host after install, and falls back to a mirror when the primary registry is unreachable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 版本管理：对照各 npm 通道或版本线查看已装版本，一键安装或降级，安装日志实时流出（回滚快照复制进度、npm 提取进度、已运行时长），从本地快照秒级回滚，用策略引擎（静默自动更新、执行时间窗、每日检查）托管整个流程。绝不在安装中途终止 npm——卡死的任务要等一小时才会停止，半提交的全局安装树会被自动检测并从安装前快照修复。检查到新版本时弹窗确认是否立即更新，安装后自动重启宿主，遇到 registry 不可达时自动回退到镜像。

description.en: Unreal Engine 4/5 (UE4, UE5) asset browser and exporter for Windows x64: browse, preview and export cooked assets from local PAK archives via CUE4Parse, with 3D mesh preview, animation playback and a searchable asset index. Oodle-compressed archives need Epic's oo2core DLL, which is not bundled but can be downloaded from the settings page.
description.zh: 虚幻引擎（Unreal Engine 4/5，UE4/UE5）资产浏览器与导出器，仅 Windows x64：通过 CUE4Parse 浏览、预览并导出本地 PAK 归档中的烘焙资产，支持模型 3D 预览、动画播放与可搜索的资产索引。Oodle 压缩的归档需要 Epic 的 oo2core DLL，包内不含，可在设置页一键下载。

description.en: Graph-based code context, impact analysis, review workflows, interactive graphs, and permission-controlled refactoring for DSH using the code-review-graph engine.
description.zh: 基于 code-review-graph 引擎，为 DSH 提供代码图谱上下文、影响分析、审查工作流、交互式图谱和权限控制的重构。

description.en: A Storage settings page for DeepSeek Harness: a donut of what dsh occupies on this machine (install, sessions, attachments, runtimes, plugins, temp), a drill-down that lists archived sessions and can delete them, and a clean action that only touches rebuildable caches. Deleting to the system Recycle Bin and Open folder are Windows-only; scanning works everywhere. Host routes accept loopback connections only and are CSRF-guarded; nothing leaves the machine.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「存储空间」设置页：环形图展示本机 dsh 占用（程序本体、会话、附件、运行时、插件、临时目录），可按工作区/类型下钻、列出已归档会话并删除，清理只动可再生缓存。系统回收站与打开目录仅 Windows，扫描与统计跨平台可用；宿主路由只接受本机回环连接并有 CSRF 防护，不联网。

description.en: Keeps what the agent builds at runtime: turns a `cordis_define` dynamic package into a real installed plugin that survives restart, writing the bundle and registering the profile layer with no pnpm, no network, and no build authorization.
description.zh: 把 agent 现场造出来的插件留下来：将 `cordis_define` 的动态包固化成能跨重启存活的正式插件，写包并注册 profile 层的全过程不用 pnpm、不联网、不需要构建授权。

description.en: TapTap Maker game-dev workbench with 150+ bundled skills, custom image lane, ChatGPT web with account rotation, CC0 SFX, web BGM, and a forced no-Maker-credit-burn policy.
description.zh: TapTap Maker 游戏开发工作台：内置 150+ 技能、自定义生图通道、ChatGPT 网页多账号轮换、CC0 音效库、网页 BGM，并强制"未经用户同意不花 Maker 额度"。

description.en: S3-compatible backend for the spill seam: oversized tool output goes to object storage (S3, MinIO, R2) with hashed session prefixes and unguessable keys, instead of the agent's local disk.
description.zh: spill seam 的 S3 兼容后端：超长工具输出写入对象存储（S3、MinIO、R2），会话前缀经哈希、键不可猜测，而不是落在 agent 的本地磁盘上。

description.en: Aborts startup when another live dsh instance holds the same DSH_HOME data directory, preventing the concurrent session-log writes that corrupt transcripts.
description.zh: 检测到其他存活的 dsh 实例占用同一 DSH_HOME 数据目录时中止启动，防止并发写会话日志导致的历史损坏。

description.en: TapTap Maker integration for DeepSeek Harness: bundled MCP tools, Maker workflow and feature skills, plus a packaged CLI path for project initialization and diagnostics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 TapTap Maker 集成：提供内置 MCP 工具、Maker 工作流与功能技能，以及用于项目初始化和诊断的随包 CLI 路径。

description.en: Grades free physical and commit memory and refuses heavy tools (shell, workflow, subagent) before the machine thrashes. Also shows in the composer how much of the machine dsh itself is using, including whole-machine CPU.
description.zh: 按可用物理内存与提交内存分级，到线就拦重活（shell、workflow、subagent）。并在输入框旁显示 DSH 自己占用了整机多少资源，含整机 CPU 占比。

description.en: Read-only DSH environment health check: disk, memory, latency, ~/.dsh bloat and outdated-plugin detection with graded reports and baseline trend comparison. Deletes nothing.
description.zh: DSH 环境只读体检：磁盘/内存/延迟/缓存膨胀/插件版本落后检测，分级报告并对比历史基线趋势。只读，不删任何东西。

description.en: Grouped run panel for DeepSeek Harness: one click starts a project's services in a real PTY, streams live colored output, and keeps every run's log on disk where the agent can read it.
description.zh: 分组运行面板：在真 PTY 里一键启动项目服务，实时彩色输出，每次运行的日志落盘，代理可直接读取。

description.en: Send dsh turn traces, LLM generations, tool spans, and subagent activity to Langfuse.
description.zh: 将 dsh 的会话轮次、LLM 调用、工具调用及子 agent 活动记录到 Langfuse。

description.en: Bidirectional Hermes ↔ DSH bridge: import Hermes sessions into DSH, consult Hermes, and receive Hermes-dispatched tasks as a single Cordis plugin.
description.zh: Hermes 与 DSH 的双向桥接插件：将 Hermes 会话导入 DSH、咨询 Hermes，并以单一 Cordis 插件接收 Hermes 下发的任务。

description.en: Runtime plugin loading for the Web UI: a watched hot directory installs/updates client-plugin bundles live on every open page, no restart. Includes a right-column subagent dashboard example.
description.zh: Web UI 运行时插件加载：监视热目录，运行中安装/更新客户端插件 bundle，所有页面即时生效，免重启。附子智能体看板示例。

description.en: Browse, search, delete, undo-delete, and update user skills from the Web settings panel; checks GitHub/Gitee Releases for newer skill versions.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中浏览、搜索、删除/撤回并更新用户技能，支持从 GitHub/Gitee Release 检查技能更新。

plugins.name: DSH-2Xray

description.en: Xray-core supervisor and router for DSH with VLESS import, global/China-direct/whitelist routing, a three-card live panel, and self-update.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Xray 受管内核与分流：VLESS 导入、全局/国内直连/白名单路由、三卡片实时面板与自更新。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to cp.cloudflare.com
uses literal IP 1.1.1.1 for network access

description.en: Conflict diagnosis and repair for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Builds a capability graph of the running Loader profile and of the on-disk cordis.patch.yml layers, comparing imports, peer ranges and config against the host that is ACTUALLY running rather than the profile's possibly-stale copies, and reports the conflicts that fail silently: a fiber stuck PENDING on a service no plugin provides, a browser half injecting a client module nothing provides, a tool id two plugins both register, duplicate Loader entry ids, a row disabled by one layer and re-inserted by another, an import of a host subpath the running host does not export, and a cycle among inject declarations. Every finding carries its evidence, a confidence grade for who owns a name, and a repair with a risk grade — verify it with a dry-run difference table, or take the individual .patch.yml files that --fix-out writes (never auto-loaded, so picking wrong breaks nothing).
description.zh: DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。把运行期能力图谱与磁盘上的 cordis.patch.yml 层对齐，并与真正在运行的宿主（而不是 profile 里可能过期的副本）比对导入、peer 范围与配置，检出那些不会自己报错的静默故障：卡在 PENDING 等待无人提供的服务、浏览器半区注入了无人提供的客户端模块、两个插件注册同一个 tool id、Loader entry id 重复、某层停用又被后一层重新插入的行、导入了运行宿主未通过 exports 暴露的子路径、以及 inject 声明之间成环。每条结论都带证据、归属置信度与带风险分级的修复：用 --dry-run 在内存里试修并看修改前后差异，或用 --fix-out 拿到独立的 .patch.yml 文件自己挑（这些文件不会被 DSH 加载，挑错也不影响运行）。

description.en: Telemetry backend exporting turns, model steps, and tool calls to yiTrace.
description.zh: 遥测后端：把 turns、model steps、tool calls 导出到 yiTrace。

description.en: Routes eligible bash commands through rtk (Rust Token Killer) so tool output is compressed before it reaches the model, by asking the installed rtk to rewrite each command and adopting what it prints; when rtk is absent the executor behaves exactly like the stock one.
description.zh: 把符合条件的 bash 命令交给 rtk（Rust Token Killer）执行，让工具输出在进入模型之前就被压缩：插件调用本机 rtk 重写命令并采纳其结果；rtk 未安装时，执行器行为与原生完全一致。

description.en: Folds degenerate reasoning loops out of the model-visible history so they are not replayed upstream on the next turn. Detects two shapes — one sentence hammered repeatedly, and short-sentence rotation — and replaces the matched span in place; a companion escape valve aborts a turn that will not stop on its own.
description.zh: 把退化的思考复读从模型可见历史里折叠掉，下一轮不再回传上游。能识别两种形态——同一句反复死磕、以及短句轮换——并对命中的那段做等价替换；配套的急停阀则对停不下来的回合当场中止。

description.en: Fullscreen business-app framework for DeepSeek Harness Web with a dark-sidebar workbench bundling a database connectivity tester and SQL query panel, a two-level knowledge base (bill and accounting) with local search and Word document ingestion, metadata environment comparison with alter-SQL generation, a data dictionary, agent log-search report demos, a system test-case runner, Evernote-style notes, developer utilities, and mini-games.
description.zh: 构建在 DeepSeek Harness Web 之上的全屏业务应用框架：深色侧边栏工作台，集成数据库连通测试与 SQL 查询、票据/会计二级知识库（本地检索与 Word 文档投喂）、元数据环境比对与变更 SQL 生成、数据字典、Agent 日志检索报告演示、系统测试用例执行、印象笔记风格记事本、常用开发工具与小游戏。

description.en: Lean and light? See DSH CPU, memory and UI stalls, broken down by plugin, terminal and MCP server, matched against stall times, and copy a diagnostic report. Windows x64 only.
description.zh: 小而美？看清 DSH 的 CPU、内存与卡顿：按插件、终端、MCP 拆分占用，对照卡顿时刻，复制诊断报告。仅限 Windows x64。

description.en: Moves a plugin set between DSH profiles (web to desktop by default): diff, pre-checks, an offline script for CLI-owned profiles, and a post-restart verification. It installs nothing itself.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的各 profile 之间迁移插件（默认 web → desktop）：算差异、预检、为 CLI 管的 profile 生成离线脚本、重启后核对。它自己不安装任何东西。

plugins.name: dsh-pve

description.en: Manage Proxmox VE through conversation: 116 read + 116 write tools covering VMs, containers, storage, nodes, clusters, backups and firewalls, with API-token or username/password (ticket) auth.
description.zh: 通过对话管理 Proxmox VE：116 个只读 + 116 个写工具，覆盖虚拟机、容器、存储、节点、集群、备份与防火墙，支持 API Token 或用户名密码（ticket）鉴权。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: FDE toolbox bundle: installing this one plugin pulls in a curated set of common dsh plugins (git server, WebDAV mount, knowledge base, scheduled tasks, auto-resume, UI tweaks, auto-retrospection, file manager, smart titles, task board, plugin market, context trimmer, IM bridge, sidebar enhancements), with a panel showing install status and one-click gap-filling.
description.zh: FDE 工具箱全家桶：安装一个插件带上一批常用 dsh 插件（代码仓库 / 挂载盘 / 知识库 / 定时任务 / 自动续跑 / 界面微调 / 自动复盘 / 文件管理 / 智能标题 / 任务看板 / 插件市场 / 上下文 / IM 接入 / 侧栏增强），面板看状态、一键补装。

description.en: Multi-machine sync: keeps multiple dsh replicas consistent through one private GitCode repository — skills, sessions, settings and plugin manifests each with an independent switch; changes go through branch, PR and merge, remote-only additions are pulled back before every push so nothing is deleted, and an AI smart-align step semantically merges files both sides changed (plus one-click conflict resolution); private repos enforced, pull never overwrites local edits.
description.zh: 多机同步：让多台机器上的 dsh 通过一个私有 GitCode 仓库保持一致——技能、会话、设置、插件清单四类内容各有独立开关；变更走分支 → PR → 合并，推送前自动回填远端新增防误删，支持 AI 智能对齐（语义合并双方改动）与一键解决冲突；强制私有仓库，pull 不覆盖本地改动。

plugins.name: pi2dsh

description.en: Pi Host ABI compatibility engine: after one install, unmodified Pi extensions from npm mount as native DSH plugins with `dsh plugin add <pi-package>`. Verified end to end on stock DSH with pi-mcp-adapter (full MCP manager: OAuth, resources, prompts, MCP Apps, elicitation, sampling), @tintinweb/pi-subagents, pi-code, pi-hermes-memory and pi-background-tasks; `pi2dsh inspect` reports a package's compatibility before installing.
description.zh: Pi Host ABI 兼容引擎：装一次之后，npm 上的 Pi 扩展原包经 `dsh plugin add <pi-package>` 直接作为 DSH 原生插件挂载。已在官方 DSH 上端到端验证 pi-mcp-adapter（完整 MCP 管理面：OAuth、resources、prompts、MCP Apps、elicitation、sampling）、@tintinweb/pi-subagents、pi-code、pi-hermes-memory、pi-background-tasks；`pi2dsh inspect` 在安装前报告一个包的兼容情况。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to 169.254.169.254
uses literal IP 169.254.169.254 for network access

description.en: Self-evolution: the agent hot-mounts/removes persistent plugins on itself mid-session.
description.zh: 自进化：agent 在会话内给自己热挂载/卸载持久化插件。

description.en: A settings page that edits the current project's CLAUDE.local.md, the private per-project instruction file DSH's built-in loader reads at the start of a session; the file stays out of git.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑当前项目的私有指令文件 CLAUDE.local.md——DSH 内置加载器会在会话开始时读取它，文件同时被排除在 git 之外。

description.en: Manage the DSH web service from a settings panel: status, version, restart, stop, and one-click updates.
description.zh: 在设置面板中管理 DSH Web 服务:状态、版本、重启、停止与一键更新。

description.en: A starter plugin to copy from: one right-sidebar tab with two languages, behaviour tests that mount the real bundle, and CI that runs the manifest preflight.
description.zh: 可直接照抄的入门插件：一个右侧栏标签页、中英两份文案、挂载真实 bundle 的行为测试，以及会跑清单预检的 CI。

description.en: Preflight for plugin authors: the checks the market runs — root export, dsh.client against exports\["./client"], whether npm pack ships the panel — on any folder or GitHub repo, from a panel or one command; plus release tooling and a Node testkit for client bundles.
description.zh: 给插件作者的安装前体检：把市场那套检查——根导出、dsh.client 与 exports\["./client"] 是否一致、npm pack 有没有带上面板——跑到任意文件夹或 GitHub 仓库上，面板里能点，命令行也能跑；另有发版工具，以及能在 Node 里挂起 client bundle 的 testkit。

description.en: macOS only: holds a PreventUserIdleSystemSleep assertion (caffeinate -i -w <host pid>) while any DSH session runs, and releases it when the last one stops, so a long turn is not cut off by idle sleep. The display may still turn off. It keeps holding through the maintenance phase, where Agent.status reports idle and a long manual /compact runs, via the compaction/start and compaction/end events. It reconciles against ctx.agents.list() every 60s, so a session already running when the plugin is hot-reloaded is picked up at once instead of at the next turn boundary. A failed hold retries with exponential backoff capped at 60s and never gives up; release escalates from SIGTERM to SIGKILL after 2s, and -w lets caffeinate exit by itself if the host dies. No browser half — configured through the profile patch. 51 tests, including two that read pmset -g assertions on real hardware.
description.zh: 仅 macOS：任意 DSH 会话运行期间持有 PreventUserIdleSystemSleep 断言（caffeinate -i -w <宿主 pid>），最后一个会话结束后释放，长时间回合不会因空闲休眠被切断；屏幕仍可正常息屏。它会一直持有跨过 maintenance 阶段——该阶段 Agent.status 报 idle 而手动 /compact 正在跑，靠 compaction/start 与 compaction/end 事件兜住。每 60 秒与 ctx.agents.list() 对账，插件热重载时已在运行的会话立即被接管，不必等到下一个回合边界。持有失败按指数退避重试、上限 60 秒且永不放弃；释放时先 SIGTERM，2 秒未退出升级 SIGKILL；带 -w，宿主崩溃时 caffeinate 自行退出。无前端半身，通过 profile patch 配置。共 51 个测试，其中 2 个在真机上直接读 pmset -g assertions。

description.en: Shows per-turn changes in cyclomatic complexity, cognitive complexity, and maximum nesting depth for TypeScript, Python, and Go in the Web UI, with expandable file and function summaries for code review.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 中展示每轮任务前后的圈复杂度、认知复杂度和最大嵌套深度变化，支持 TypeScript、Python 和 Go，可展开文件和函数查看详情，帮助确定代码审查重点。

description.en: Inject deployment-configured system-prompt sections and reference exchanges into every conversation request via stream interception, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 通过流拦截将部署级系统提示词段落与参考对话注入每次对话请求，附带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Azure resource management: query and show resources, deploy Bicep/ARM templates, and check the activity log.
description.zh: Azure 资源管理：查询/展示资源、部署 Bicep/ARM 模板、查看活动日志。

description.en: OpenAI Codex CLI wrapper: one-shot exec, repo review and session resume with a default read-only sandbox.
description.zh: OpenAI Codex CLI 封装：一次性任务、仓库审查与会话续接，默认只读沙箱。

description.en: Load testing with Grafana k6: smoke-test first, then run scripts and read percentiles from the JSON summary.
description.zh: Grafana k6 压测：先冒烟再跑脚本，从 JSON 汇总读百分位数。

description.en: Kubernetes ops for the agent: get resources with structured JSON output, describe, logs, exec, apply/delete (user-confirmed) and port-forward.
description.zh: Kubernetes 运维：JSON 结构化查资源、describe、日志、exec、apply/delete（需确认）与端口转发。

description.en: Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: validate, run, and scaffold declarative agents and workflows (YAML).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) 插件：验证、运行、搭建 declarative agents 与 workflows(YAML)。

description.en: Infrastructure as code: gated plan/apply, state and output inspection, and configuration validation via the terraform CLI.
description.zh: 基础设施即代码：plan/apply 门控、state/output 检查与配置校验。

description.en: Windows Package Manager: search, install, upgrade, uninstall, import/export and pin software through native tools.
description.zh: Windows 包管理器：搜索、安装、升级、卸载、导入导出与版本固定。

description.en: WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: run Linux commands, manage distros, convert paths, and copy across the Windows/Linux boundary.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 WSL(Windows Subsystem for Linux)桥接：跑 Linux 命令、管理发行版、路径转换与跨系统复制。

description.en: Windows only; the upgrade path needs DSH_AUTO_UPDATE_LAUNCH_CMD configured. Checks, installs and rolls back DeepSeek Harness CLI updates from the web settings page, switching the launcher pointer only after the new version passes a config-tree check and a health-checked restart, and reverting automatically when it does not boot.
description.zh: 仅 Windows；升级路径需配置 DSH_AUTO_UPDATE_LAUNCH_CMD。在 Web 设置页检查、安装、回滚 DeepSeek Harness CLI 更新：新版本装上后先过配置树检查与健康重启，通过才切换启动指针，起不来就自动退回旧版本。

description.en: Developer quick-reference toolbox for DSH: 12 themed categories (195 entries) plus zero-dependency tools — regex tester, JSON formatter, timestamp converter, Base64/URL codec, cron generator and line diff, in a searchable settings panel.
description.zh: 开发者速查工具箱：12 个主题 195 条速查 + 6 个零依赖工具（正则实时测试、JSON 格式化、时间戳转换、Base64/URL 编解码、Cron 生成、行 diff），设置页可搜索查阅。

description.en: Wire-level LLM inspector: captures the raw HTTP request and response bodies of model provider calls and attributes each capture to the session that caused it through the llm/stream waterfall. The request pane renders the body as a collapsible tree with per-node sizes — one measured request was 98.6% a single 973-entry array — and the response pane reassembles the OpenAI-style SSE chunk stream into reasoning, content, tool calls and usage. Shown in a Conversation View tab and a loopback viewer page.
description.zh: 线路层 LLM 检查器：抓取模型调用的原始 HTTP 请求与响应报文，经 llm/stream 瀑布把每次抓取归属到发起它的会话。请求面板把报文渲染成带每节点大小的可折叠树——实测一次请求有 98.6% 是单个 973 项的数组——响应面板则把 OpenAI 风格的 SSE chunk 流重新组装成推理、正文、工具调用与用量。在对话栏标签页与本地查看页展示。

description.en: Read-only diagnostic that reports which leg of the DSH → bridge → OneBot → QQ chain is broken — process, port, login, preset or recent wake failures — and prints the fix for each failed check. Runs as `node check.mjs` (read-only by default; the optional `--fix` only aligns the bridge baseUrl and starts a stopped bridge), or installs as a `chain_check` tool.
description.zh: 只读诊断：DSH → 桥接 → OneBot → QQ 这条链断在哪一段——进程、端口、登录、preset、最近的唤醒失败——每一项都给出修法。可以直接 `node check.mjs` 跑（默认只读；可选的 `--fix` 只把桥接 baseUrl 对齐到当前端口、拉起没在运行的桥接），也可以装成 `chain_check` 工具。

description.en: Automatic second-opinion review: a restricted child session re-reads the agent's recent work with read-only tools and delivers at most one evidence-backed note, or stays silent. Requires a model route in the config; the plugin stays disabled until one is set.
description.zh: 自动二审：受限子会话用只读工具复核 agent 最近的工作，最多投递一条有证据支撑的提醒，没有问题则保持沉默。

description.en: Staleness keeper for the Codebase Memory knowledge graph: it compares the graph Branch node head_sha with git rev-parse HEAD and reports an exact behindBy, rebuilds only the stale projects through the codebase-memory-mcp CLI so the MCP tool 60-second cap does not apply, watches each project for edits, and mirrors the same state into a settings card and a REST control surface.
description.zh: Codebase Memory 知識圖譜的保鮮插件：比對圖譜 Branch 節點的 head_sha 與 git rev-parse HEAD、給出精確的落後提交數，只重建落後的專案且走 codebase-memory-mcp CLI（不受 MCP 工具 60 秒上限約束），逐專案監看檔案變更，並把同一份狀態呈現在設定卡片與 REST 控制面。

description.en: Native DSH right-sidebar tab that lists the ports this machine is listening on together with the process behind each one, and offers per-port actions to open it, copy its address, reveal its working directory or end the process.
description.zh: dsh 原生右侧栏页签：列出本机监听的端口及占用它的进程，并可对每个端口执行打开、复制地址、定位工作目录或结束进程。

description.en: A development safety kit: rolling config snapshots, automatic rollback on plugin failures, boot-failure rescue, and an in-settings management panel.
description.zh: 开发配套守护：滚动快照、插件失败自动回退、启动失败救援、设置页管理面板。

description.en: A hands-off safety net: directories the agent deletes go to a trash folder first and symlinks are never followed, with zero approvals.
description.zh: 脱手模式安全网：agent 删除的目录先进回收站、链接绝不跟随，零审批。

description.en: Windows only. Prompts to restart DSH after a plugin install, update or uninstall, restarts it in one click without any console window, and shows a per-file diff of what changed.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。DSH 插件变动后提示重启，一键静默重启（全程无命令提示符窗口），并可展开本次改动的逐行差异。

description.en: Fail-fast tool batches for DeepSeek Harness: inside a step, concurrency-safe calls still overlap, but after the first failed call every remaining unstarted call is denied before dispatch and returned to the model as a synthesized `is_error` "not executed" result.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工具批次增加“失败即停”（fail-fast）机制：同一并行组内的只读调用仍可并发，一旦有调用失败，所有尚未开始的调用都会在派发前被拦截，并以合成的 is_error「未执行」结果返回给模型。

description.en: Reload a plugin's source the moment a file changes, without restarting the harness. Covers the third-party plugin case the built-in watcher misses because it skips node_modules.
description.zh: 改完插件源码即刻生效，无需重启 DSH。补上宿主内置热重载因排除 node_modules 而覆盖不到的第三方插件场景。

description.en: Prints every plugin in the DeepSeek Harness loader tree at boot, with the exception text for anything that failed, and checks dependency version drift, profile config validity, web port reachability and registered tools.
description.zh: 启动时打印 DeepSeek Harness 插件树中每一行的状态（失败的附异常内容），并检查依赖版本漂移、配置文件合法性、端口可达性与已注册工具。

description.en: One fixed button inside the DSH window that restarts DSH and reopens it automatically, with no console window; right-click it for a built-in self check that writes a single diagnostic report.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的一个固定按钮，点一下就把 DSH 关掉并自动重开，全程没有控制台窗口；右键它还有内置自检，能生成一份自包含的诊断报告。

description.en: IDE-style run configurations for DSH: save LLM prompts and shell commands as reusable run configs (global or per-workspace), run them from the session header or the new-session page, and manage them via the task_run_config tool with approval-gated writes.
description.zh: DSH 的 IDE 风格运行配置：把常用 LLM 提示词和 Shell 命令保存为可复用的运行配置（全局或按工作区），在会话头部或新会话页一键运行，大模型可通过 task_run_config 工具管理（写操作走审批）。

description.en: One-command backup, restore & migration for all DSH user data (~/.dsh) with a visual Settings panel: scheduled auto-backup with tiered retention, sha256 verification, hardened restore with auto-rollback and a result receipt, typed sub-backups (--types), credential redaction into a local vault, private-repo GitHub sync for moving to a new machine, and an out-of-process rescue console (zero-dependency rescue web UI in the backup dir) that works even when the host won't boot. /backup doctor checks and repairs corrupt session logs from a known-good backup and quarantines them before rotation; migrate-check statically predicts which sessions a host upgrade would break (frozen event-list rules, filename/generation mismatch, hardlink support, legacy credentials); the credential sentinel preserves pre-migration copies before the host rewrites them; smart backup snapshots before host upgrades; /backup check-update and /backup update report and install new releases (snapshotting first). Restore handles attachment hard links and arbitrarily large archives (streamed listing). Current npm version 0.13.4; spans DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 through 0.2.0-rc.1, including 0.2.0's install-time peer gate. macOS/Linux/Windows.
description.zh: 一条命令备份、恢复与迁移 DSH 全部用户数据（~/.dsh），附可视化设置面板：定时自动备份与每日/每周分级保留、sha256 校验、失败自动回滚并回执的加固恢复、分类型子集备份（--types）、凭据脱敏进本机 vault、GitHub 私有仓库同步跨机迁移、宿主起不来也能用的进程外救援通道（备份目录内置零依赖救援网页）。/backup doctor 从已知良好备份体检并定点修复损坏会话日志、轮换前先隔离；migrate-check 迁移预检在升级前静态扫描，预测哪些会话会被新宿主拒绝（冻结清单、文件名代际不匹配、硬链接、旧版凭据布局等）；凭据哨兵在宿主改写前自动存底；智能备份在宿主升级前快照；/backup check-update 与 /backup update 感知并一键更新（先留快照）。恢复链路支持含附件硬链接的归档与超大归档（清单走原始流逐行校验）。当前 npm 版本 0.13.4；覆盖 DSH 0.1.1-rc.2–0.2.0-rc.1，含 0.2.0 起的安装期 peer 闸门。macOS/Linux/Windows。

description.en: Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.
description.zh: 关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

description.en: Shared diagnostic log used by the Claw agent governance plugins (dsh-claw suite).
description.zh: Claw Agent 治理插件共用的诊断日志（dsh-claw 套件）。

description.en: DSH self-updater in the settings page: one-click check/pull (`git pull --ff-only`), auto background checks, version diff and changelog preview with a red-dot reminder.
description.zh: 设置页中的 DSH 自助更新器：一键检查/拉取（git pull --ff-only）、自动后台检查、版本对比与更新说明预览，带红点提醒。

description.en: Runtime observability and plugin operations panel for DeepSeek Harness: shows the profile plugin tree, real Loader fiber state, capabilities/dependencies/compatibility, current-session plugin activity and upstream source/version checks, with one-click enable/disable/update/uninstall plus a standalone startup-failure diagnostics page that works while DSH is not running.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的运行可观测与插件运维面板：展示 Profile 插件树、Loader 真实 fiber 状态、能力/依赖/兼容性、本轮会话插件活动与上游来源/版本核验，支持一键关闭/启用/更新/卸载，并提供 DSH 未运行时也能打开的独立启动失败诊断页。

description.en: Reports which PowerShell the DSH pwsh executor actually runs (enabled rows only; version-numbered Store paths are never recommended as pins), and installs a Store-managed PowerShell 7 through a scripted Store-page click or the manual Store path. Allows the pwsh tool only when the live executor resolves PowerShell 7+, and when dsh-ops is installed keeps the native pwsh beside ops_bash by enabling Compatibility and hiding duplicate official tools. Native status card and configuration switch in the Web UI; Windows only, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 报告 DSH 的 pwsh 执行器实际运行的 PowerShell（只认启用中的行，带版本号的商店路径不会被推荐为 pin），并通过脚本点击商店页面或手动商店路径安装由商店管理的 PowerShell 7。只有实际执行器解析到 PowerShell 7+ 时才放行 pwsh 工具；检测到 dsh-ops 时启用其 Compatibility 模式，保留原生 pwsh 与 ops_bash 并存，并隐藏重复的官方工具。Web 界面提供原生状态卡片和配置开关；仅 Windows，零运行时依赖。

description.en: Embedded closed-loop development cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: the agent builds, flashes, debug-verifies and monitors STM32 boards from one panel, while the user watches every step live - progress ladder, streaming logs, RAM/FLASH usage and decoded serial waveforms. Requires a host Python 3.10+ on PATH (the plugin cannot install it); the ARM toolchain is auto-downloaded on first use (~400 MB, Windows x64 only), and you need an STM32 board with a debug probe.
description.zh: 嵌入式闭环开发驾驶舱（DSH 插件）：agent 在面板里闭环开发 STM32——发现、编译、烧录、调试校验、串口监视，开发过程对用户全程可视化（阶梯进度、实时日志、RAM/FLASH 占用、串口波形解码）。需主机自带 PATH 上的 Python 3.10+（插件不能代装）；ARM 工具链首次使用时自动下载（约 400 MB，仅 Windows x64），并需自备 STM32 板与调试探针。

description.en: Context-window attribution for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that ranks the user messages, assistant turns, reasoning blocks and tool results of a session by the tokens each one occupies, so it is clear which entries hold the window. It also shows the share by entry type, the heaviest entries across the live sessions of the host, and, where the host provides them, provider usage and the estimated system/tools/messages composition. The panel is read-only: it does not estimate cost, modify a session, or trigger compaction.
description.zh: DSH Web 的上下文窗口归因插件：Mini Utility Dock 面板按各自占用的 token 给会话内的用户消息、助手回复、推理块和工具结果排序，一眼看出窗口被哪些条目占住。面板还显示各条目类型的占比、本机各 live session 里最重的条目，并在宿主提供时显示 provider usage 与 system/tools/messages 的估算构成。面板只读：不估算费用、不修改会话、不触发 compaction。

plugins.name: dsh-instance-manager

description.en: Instance manager for DSH Web: a Mini Utility Dock panel that lists every local dsh web instance the machine can see (port, PID, uptime, live session count, resident memory, version), starts a new instance on an automatically picked free port in 3080-3129 or on a port you name, opens a row in a new tab, and stops one or all of them through that instance’s own graceful shutdown (appExit). Rows also show what each instance is serving, and read-only instance logs and session summaries are one click away. Where a peer is configured, the same panel lists and queries instances on other machines over a bearer-authenticated link. Every route is loopback-guarded, and a browser-facing action must additionally pass the host’s own browser authentication.
description.zh: DSH Web 实例管理器：Mini Utility Dock 面板列出本机可见的全部 dsh web 实例（端口、PID、运行时长、会话数、常驻内存、版本），可在 3080–3129 自动选一个空闲端口或按指定端口启动新实例、把某一行在新标签页打开，并通过目标实例自身的优雅退出停掉单个或全部实例。行内还显示每个实例在跑什么，只读的实例日志与会话概要一点即达。配置了 peer 时，同一个面板会通过带 bearer 鉴权的链路列出并查询其他机器上的实例。所有路由都做回环校验，面向浏览器的操作还要额外通过宿主自身的鉴权。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Windows process-tree reconciler for the DSH host: samples the host process tree and the job ledger, attributes each process to the job that created it, flags unattributed and orphaned processes with a confidence level, and offers guarded termination of a whole tree. Termination is refused unless the target belongs to the DSH host tree, is re-sampled and re-checked immediately before the kill (creation time included), and contains no protected descendant, so an allowlisted PID cannot widen the kill scope.
description.zh: DSH 宿主的 Windows 进程树对账插件：采样宿主进程树与任务账本，把每个进程归属到创建它的任务，并按置信度标出未归属与孤儿进程，同时提供受保护的整树终止。终止必须满足：目标归属于 DSH 宿主树、在动手前重新采样复核（含创建时间）、目标树内不含受保护后代，因此白名单 PID 不会扩大可杀范围。

description.en: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.
description.zh: 导出有界的 DSH Session、Agent、LLM、Tool、Approval、Subagent 与 Job Prometheus 指标，附带 Grafana 仪表盘，Endpoint 默认仅监听回环地址。

description.en: Host-side DSH evaluation control plugin: injects one evaluation trial's variables, budget limits, session root and fork lineage into the agent process, routes its model calls through a host broker under a gateway lease, and writes a schema-versioned bundle descriptor for evidence attribution.
description.zh: 宿主侧 DSH 评测控制插件：把单次评测试次的变量、预算上限、会话根目录与 fork 血统一次性注入 agent 进程，模型调用经宿主 broker 走网关租约，并写出 schema 版本化的 bundle descriptor 做证据归属。

description.en: Client-side performance HUD and always-on recorder for DeepSeek Harness: FPS and worst frame, long tasks with four-leg attribution (React fiber / subtree / DOM writes / scheduler), per-plugin callback rate and sync time, DOM growth and writers, JS heap, host event loop and link RTT, plus a night-watch recorder that keeps the worst stalls and exports incident packs for replay.
description.zh: 纯客户端性能 HUD 与默认常开的记录器：帧率与最差帧、Long Task 四条腿归因（React fiber / 子树 / DOM 写入 / 调度点）、每插件回调速率与同步耗时、DOM 增长与写入者、JS 堆、宿主 event-loop 与链路 RTT；守夜层自动留存最差几次卡顿，可逐帧回放并导出事故包。

description.en: Restart button for the Harness desktop app: one sidebar entry that closes every Harness process and starts the application again, launched without a console window and without a close-confirmation dialog. Windows only.
description.zh: DSH 桌面应用重启按钮：侧栏一个入口，关闭全部 Harness 进程后重新启动应用；启动过程无控制台窗口、无关闭确认框。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Lists the Docker Compose projects of your DSH workspaces in the right sidebar, one group per project directory, with container status, project- and service-level up/stop/restart, and streamed per-service logs.
description.zh: 在右侧栏列出各 DSH 工作区中的 Docker Compose 项目，按项目目录分组，显示容器状态，支持项目级与服务级 up/stop/restart 以及单服务日志流。

description.en: Adds a restart row to Settings → General that relaunches dsh web with the same invocation through a detached helper, refuses under a detected systemd supervisor unless allowRestart is true, and tests whether the listening port is free by connecting to it rather than binding it.
description.zh: 在「设置 → 通用」增加一行重启按钮：用相同启动参数、经分离的 helper 重新拉起 dsh web；检测到 systemd 监管时默认拒绝（除非 allowRestart 为 true）；判断端口是否空闲用连接探测而非绑定。

description.en: One repository, three parts: a runtime injector for DSH plugin packages (inject, hot-reload, unload, promote a dev staging tool to the front, route self-heal, plus a settings-page plugin manager that lists, unloads and drags folders in to internalize), a task-aware reasoning-mode router agent preset (router-standard / router-spec / router-react), and a graded two-level task protocol whose six tools (commit_star, lock_stage, revise_do, edit_plan, mark_task, redteam_verdict) pin task state to disk. The injector implementation ships in-tree, so the install carries its own behaviour rather than a dependency list.
description.zh: 一个仓库三件套：DSH 插件包的运行时注入器（注入、热重载、卸载、开发侧挂区一键转正、路由自愈，外带设置页插件管理：列出、卸载、拖入文件夹内化）、任务感知的思维模式路由 agent 预设（router-standard / router-spec / router-react）、以及分级两级任务协议（commit_star / lock_stage / revise_do / edit_plan / mark_task / redteam_verdict 六个工具，任务状态落盘）。注入器实现直接在库内，安装的是它自己的行为而不是一份依赖清单。

description.en: Compares existing DSH sessions or runs controlled A/B trials between agent presets, showing aligned timelines, paired metric deltas, explicit success checks, and exportable reports.
description.zh: 对比已有 DSH 会话，或在两套 Agent Preset 之间运行受控 A/B 试验，展示对齐时间线、配对指标差值、显式验收结果与可导出的报告。

description.en: Version-token-validated in-process result cache for the DSH read tool: repeated reads of unchanged files skip file I/O and line rendering, with a readcache tool for stats and clearing.
description.zh: 为 DSH read 工具提供版本令牌校验的进程内结果缓存：未变更文件的重复读取跳过文件 I/O 与行渲染，附带 readcache 工具查看统计与清空。

description.en: Runs reproducible DSH profile and patch experiments with guided case authoring, assertions, Web comparison reports, recovery, and policy gates.
description.zh: 运行可复现的 DSH Profile 与 Patch 实验，并提供引导式用例构建、断言、Web 对比报告、恢复和策略门禁。

description.en: Skill pool manager in the Settings sidebar: enable/disable, folder batch import with rename-conflict prompts, state-driven one-click DSH-spec check & auto-fix, system/project scope labels.
description.zh: 设置侧边栏的 Skill 管理器：池与启用目录启停、文件夹批量导入（重名询问）、状态驱动一键规范检查与自动修复、系统级/项目级来源标识。

description.en: Drives a plugin page in the running DeepSeek Harness UI — opens the panel, reads real DOM and computed styles, clicks, types, waits for async effects, collects console errors, then returns to the original conversation.
description.zh: 在运行中的 DeepSeek Harness 界面里驱动插件页面做验收：打开面板、读取真实 DOM 与计算样式、点击、输入、等待异步生效、抓取控制台报错，结束后自动回到原对话。

description.en: One plugin brings the rtk token-saving setup from Claude Code to DeepSeek Harness: commands rtk can rewrite are rewritten, and builds, tests and logs that rewriting cannot reach are compressed too; common commands such as git, cargo, npm, pytest and docker are covered (rtk itself supports 100+ commands). After compression the model is told what was elided and how to recover it — when the sandbox cannot reach the rtk store, the original is saved separately and its path is given — and `/rtk stats` shows how much was saved. When a rewrite is unreliable the original command runs as usual: if rtk cannot run, or the command rtk returns would drop arguments, nothing breaks. The rtk binary ships with the package, so mainstream platforms need no separate rtk install, unlike most other rtk plugins.
description.zh: 一个插件把 Claude Code 里 rtk 的省 token 机制接进 DSH：能改写的命令交给 rtk 重写，改写够不着的构建、测试、日志也会被压缩；git、cargo、npm、pytest、docker 等常见命令都有覆盖（rtk 本身支持 100 多种）。压缩后会告诉模型省略了什么、怎么找回原文——沙箱里读不到 rtk 存储时，原文会另存一份并把路径给出来；省了多少可以用 `/rtk stats` 看。改写不可靠时原命令照常执行：rtk 跑不起来，或 rtk 给出的命令会丢掉参数，都不会让命令失败。rtk 二进制随包，主流平台不用像多数其他 rtk 插件那样先自行安装 rtk。

description.en: Conversation header badge showing the DeepSeek Harness version, checking npm for the latest release and prompting upgrades.
description.zh: 会话顶栏徽章：显示 DeepSeek Harness 当前版本，自动检查 npm 最新版本，有新版时提示升级。

description.en: Session-header button that previews and downloads the exact request frame DeepSeek Harness sends to the model: the full system prompt, the declared tools array, and the wire message array (system/user/assistant/tool-result) rebuilt from the session log via the same folds the agent loop reads.
description.zh: 会话头部按钮：预览并下载 DeepSeek Harness 真正发给模型的请求帧——完整 system prompt、声明的工具数组 tools 与 wire 消息数组（system/user/assistant/tool-result），按 agent loop 读取所用的同一会话折叠重建。

description.en: Skills & MCP manager in the DSH web settings: browse/enable/import/delete skills across project and user roots, and manage stdio/streamable-http MCP servers with a real connection (tools registered as mcp__<server>__<tool>, config in ~/.dsh/mcp.json).
description.zh: DSH Web 设置内的技能与 MCP 管理器：在项目级与用户级技能目录间浏览/启用/导入/删除技能，并管理 stdio/streamable-http 的 MCP 服务器（真实连接，工具注册为 mcp__<server>__<tool>，配置存 ~/.dsh/mcp.json）。

description.en: Read-only panel listing recent Codex CLI runs parsed from the local ~/.codex/sessions rollout files, showing status, duration, token usage and the last assistant message, with no bridge or extra daemon.
description.zh: 只读面板：直接解析本地 ~/.codex/sessions 的 rollout 文件，把最近 Codex CLI 运行的状态、耗时、token 用量和最后一条回复列在右上角，不需要桥接或额外守护进程。

description.en: Mirror an iOS Simulator or Android emulator into DSH as floating overlay windows, several at once, and tap, drag or type on the mirrored screen with the input forwarded back to the device.
description.zh: 把 iOS 模拟器或安卓模拟机投进 DSH 的浮窗，可同时开多个，并在投屏画面上点、拖、打字，输入回传到设备。

description.en: Enables or disables DSH plugins from Settings → Plugins: each toggle stops or starts the plugin immediately without a restart and the change persists across restarts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置 → 插件页直接启用或停用插件：切换开关即时停止或启动插件（无需重启），并持久化，重启后依旧生效。

description.en: Local-only memory guard for the DeepSeek Harness: host heap and session-log monitoring, oversized tool-argument interception, and dry-run by default session vacuum.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地内存守护插件：监控 host 堆与会话日志体积、拦截超大工具参数，并提供默认 dry-run 的会话瘦身命令。

description.en: GitHub issue service for DSH: turns a telemetry failure analysis into a uniform issue report, builds a pre-filled new-issue URL that is shortened when it would exceed a configured length budget, and rewrites a plain description into a structured issue with the deployment's model.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 GitHub issue 服务：把遥测失败分析整理成统一格式的 issue 报告，构造预填的新建 issue 链接并在超出配置长度时裁剪正文，再用部署配置的模型把一段自然语言描述改写为结构化 issue。

description.en: Local-only telemetry service for DSH plugins: records operation trails and error events into a storage-domain KV table, applies a configurable redaction rule set before the write and again when the analysis reads back a record stored before a rule existed, and groups one plugin's failures by feature-code anchor, reporting the window it read, the route each group ran on, and the attempts recorded after its last failure in write order.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件的本地遥测服务：把操作轨迹与错误事件写入 storage-domain KV 表，在写入前按可配置的规则集脱敏，并在分析读回早于规则存在的旧记录时再次按同一规则集脱敏，然后按功能码锚点聚合单个插件的失败事件，同时报告读取的时间窗口、每个失败组的模型路由，以及按写入顺序统计的最近一次失败之后的尝试次数。

description.en: Auto-adjust model reasoning effort per task (off/low/high/max): task classification, \[effort=...] markers, in-turn error escalation, DeepSeek peak-pricing-period capping with countdown notices, and manual-selection priority.
description.zh: 根据任务自动调整模型推理档位（off/low/high/max）：任务分类判定、\[effort=...] 显式标记、轮内出错升级、DeepSeek 高峰计价时段自动限档省钱并显示切换倒计时、GUI 手动选择优先。

description.en: In-app server monitor window for DSH that tunnels to a lightweight agent on your server: memory, swap, load, disk, per-container usage and QQ status, cache purge and container restarts, plus an embedded VNC desktop for manual QQ QR login and sign-out. The agent ships in the repository (server/monitor.py) and you deploy it yourself.
description.zh: 在 DSH 内直接打开服务器监控窗口，经 SSH 隧道读取内存、交换分区、负载、磁盘、各容器占用与 QQ 登录状态，并提供清理缓存与重启容器按钮，以及内嵌 VNC 的 QQ 客户端供手动扫码登录或退出账号。守护 agent 随仓库提供（server/monitor.py），需要你自己部署。

description.en: One-click start/stop launcher for DSH Web on macOS — start (foreground/daemon), stop, status, duplicate-launch guard, auto browser open, plus a Dock-able DSH.app built by script.
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH Web 的一键启停启动器：前台/后台启动、停止、状态、防重复启动、自动打开浏览器，并可用脚本构建程序坞版 DSH.app。

description.en: Track DeepSeek Harness's own releases and update in one click: reads the npm dist-tags and the GitHub changelog, shows every change between the running build and the target, grades the risk, then hands the install to a detached helper that backs the current install up with an atomic rename, runs npm, verifies what landed, relaunches, and rolls back when the new build does not come up.
description.zh: 跟踪 DSH 官方版本并一键更新：读取 npm dist-tags 与 GitHub 更新说明，列出当前版本到目标版本之间每一个版本的更新点，给出分级风险清单（预发布、破坏性变更措辞、本机多份安装与 PATH 不一致、插件 dsh.engines.dsh 兼容性、备份与回滚可用性），再把安装交给分离助手——用 rename 原子备份当前安装、执行 npm、校验落地结果、用原命令重启，新版本起不来就自动回滚。

description.en: Registers a janitor_scan tool that returns a deterministic, reviewable cleanup plan for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts) with per-file verdicts and evidence; scan-only, never deletes.
description.zh: 注册 janitor_scan 工具：对会话遗留物（计划文档、临时脚本）给出确定性、可审阅的清理计划，逐文件裁决附证据；只扫描，永不删除。

description.en: Context injection audit: token costs of instruction chains / skill catalogs / tool schemas, duplicate and conflict detection.
description.zh: 上下文注入审计：统计指令链/技能目录/工具 schema 的 token 成本，检测重复与冲突。

description.en: File-based environment registry for DSH: manage environments, services, deployments and operation-to-Skill bindings through a panel and model-facing tools.
description.zh: 基于文件的 DSH 环境注册表：通过面板和模型工具管理环境、服务、部署以及操作到 Skill 的绑定。

description.en: Audits the skills and plugins you already installed: routes a task description to the tool it needs, flags version drift against the npm registry and runtime faults from host logs, and reports which of a plugin's tools you never call. Registers 9 tools: can, find, status, recommend, check, scan, probe, run and suggest. Runs on Python 3.8+ with no third-party dependencies. Registered tool ids all carry the skill_audit_ prefix, for example skill_audit_can and skill_audit_find.
description.zh: 审计你已装的 skill 与插件：按任务描述路由到该调的工具，对比 npm registry 发现版本落后、读宿主日志发现运行时故障，并报告插件的哪些工具你从没调用过。注册 9 个工具：can、find、status、recommend、check、scan、probe、run、suggest。基于 Python 3.8+，无第三方依赖。注册工具名均带 skill_audit_ 前缀，例如 skill_audit_can。

description.en: Preview native WeChat Mini Programs in the DSH sidebar with a local runtime and WXML source locations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右边栏预览原生微信小程序，提供本地运行时与 WXML 源码定位。

plugins.name: dsh-android-emulator-helper

description.en: Android development toolchain inside DeepSeek Harness: 23 android_* tools that find the SDK, create and manage AVDs, start and stop emulators, scaffold a Kotlin/Compose project, build and run it with Gradle, then install, launch, screenshot, tail logcat and drive the UI. A settings page holds the SDK, emulator, API-level, build and output parameters.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里驱动 Android 开发工具链：23 个 android_* 工具负责探测 SDK、创建与管理 AVD、启停模拟器、生成 Kotlin/Compose 工程、用 Gradle 构建运行，并完成安装、启动、截图、logcat 与 UI 操作。设置页集中管理 SDK、模拟器、API 级别、构建与输出参数。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.android.com

description.en: The official ZCode ios-simulator plugin ported to native DSH tools: the original 20 ios_* tools keep their names and arguments, plus ios_shutdown_simulator, covering Xcode project discovery and scaffolding, simulator boot and shutdown, build, install, launch and terminate, screenshots, log reading, an in-app settings page and optional idb UI automation. macOS only.
description.zh: 把官方 ZCode ios-simulator 插件移植为 DSH 原生工具：原有 20 个 ios_* 工具的命名与参数保持不变，另加 ios_shutdown_simulator，覆盖 Xcode 工程发现与生成、模拟器启动与关闭、构建、安装、启动与结束进程、截图、日志读取，并提供应用内设置页与可选的 idb UI 自动化。仅支持 macOS。

description.en: Registers one `doc_ocr_sign_fix` tool for DeepSeek Harness: on macOS it diagnoses and repairs the condition where the bundled Python cannot load native extensions (onnxruntime, cv2, pypdfium2) because of the hardened runtime and library validation, by injecting the disable-library-validation entitlement and re-signing the interpreter, then verifying the imports. Operations are idempotent and the original binary is backed up first. It never touches the enclosing application bundle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `doc_ocr_sign_fix` 工具：在 macOS 上诊断并修复内置 Python 因 hardened runtime + Library Validation 拒绝加载 onnxruntime / cv2 / pypdfium2 原生扩展的问题——注入 disable-library-validation entitlement 并 ad-hoc 重签解释器，再验证导入。操作幂等，签名前先备份原二进制。绝不触碰外层 App。

description.en: Creates local, content-addressed workspace checkpoints with diff previews and two-phase restore confirmation.
description.zh: 创建本地内容寻址工作区存档，提供差异预览和两阶段确认恢复。

description.en: Continual self-evolution: versioned, auditable, rollback-safe harness state (prompts, memory, skills, subagent specs) refined from session trajectories, with review gates and hot-reloaded skills.
description.zh: 持续自进化：从会话轨迹沉淀版本化、可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态（提示词/记忆/技能/子代理规格），带审查门禁与技能热加载。

description.en: Crash protection for installed plugins: crash cards with one-click disable, static pre-flight inspection, black-box crash telemetry, and a safe-mode rescue profile for a broken UI.
description.zh: 已装插件的崩溃防护：崩溃卡片一键停用、静态预检、黑匣子遥测，以及救援损坏 UI 的安全模式 profile。

description.en: Plugin quality scorecard for DeepSeek Harness: 0-100 with grade, 6 components, fix suggestions per deduction, batch leaderboard - CLI plus an agent-callable quality_score tool.
description.zh: dsh 插件质量评分卡：0-100 分 + 等级 + 六项分项，逐项修复建议，支持批量榜单 - CLI + agent 可调用 quality_score 工具。

description.en: Plug/unplug any DeepSeek Harness plugin cleanly — list every mounted layer (bundles + patch rows), remove with full cleanup, disable/enable without deleting, and audit for orphaned/dangling state. CLI + agent-callable unplug tool. Read-only by default; destructive operations require explicit confirmation.
description.zh: 让 DSH 插件的安装和卸载干净利落——列出所有加载层（Bundle + 补丁行）、完整卸载（清理 Bundle 列表+补丁行+依赖）、临时禁用以调试而不真正删除、以及审计残留的孤立行或悬空引用。CLI 与 agent 均可调用，默认只读，破坏性操作需二次确认。

description.en: Stops a streaming model call when the same string repeats ten times in a row (threshold configurable), keeps the partial answer as a normal assistant message, and shows a stop notice with the workspace, session name and the repeated string. Repeat counts can vary by unit length through a piecewise table or a JavaScript module, and code regions (fenced, inline, indented) use a relaxed threshold.
description.zh: 同一字符串连续重复达到阈值（默认 10 次）时截停本次生成，已生成内容照常提交；截停后弹出通知，显示所属工作区、会话名称与重复的字符串。重复次数可按单元长度用分段表或 JS 模块决定，代码区域（围栏 / 行内 / 缩进）使用放宽的阈值。

description.en: Source-install updater for DeepSeek Harness: checks the official GitHub release and the npm record, builds the target tag in an isolated directory, smoke-starts it, then switches through a supervisor process with rollback, with scheduled checks and a daily idle-only install window. Source install only (macOS/Linux); requires Node.js 22.19+, pnpm and Git.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 源码安装的更新插件：核对官方 GitHub 发布与 npm 记录，在独立目录构建目标版本并试启动，再由监督进程切换、失败回滚，支持定时检查与每日空闲安装时段。仅支持源码安装（macOS/Linux）；需 Node.js 22.19+、pnpm 与 Git。

description.en: Java efficient development plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing deterministic auto-fix for .java files, token-saving template intents, and cross-platform JDK/Gradle/Android SDK/FFmpeg/LWJGL/IDEA discovery with persistent caching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Java 高效开发插件，提供 .java 文件的决定性自动修复、节省 token 的模板意图、以及跨平台的 JDK/Gradle/Android SDK/FFmpeg/LWJGL/IDEA 自动发现与持久化缓存。

description.en: Intercepts startup crashes, isolates broken frontend plugins, and recovers GUI cleanly with revision-bound quarantine.
description.zh: 拦截插件启动崩溃与前端白屏，按指纹静默隔离故障版本并在修复后自动恢复。

description.en: Audits installed plugin compatibility after a DeepSeek Harness upgrade, repairs or disables incompatible plugins, and keeps an out-of-host supervisor that rescues boot failures or rolls back to the previous host snapshot.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 升级后自动巡检已安装插件的兼容性，修复或禁用不兼容插件；宿主启动失败时由宿主外 supervisor 救援，必要时回滚到上一个宿主版本。

description.en: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
description.zh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

description.en: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
description.zh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

description.en: Appends local hash-chained JSONL receipts for tool results and session events without storing prompts, tool arguments, result text, or raw session IDs.
description.zh: 把工具结果与会话事件的 receipt 写入本地哈希链 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数、结果正文或原始会话 ID。

plugins.name: dsh-ui-auth

description.en: Authentication gateway for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the login gate covers pages, /api, /plugins and WebSocket upgrades; PBKDF2 password hashing with per-user salts, HttpOnly SameSite session cookies named per DSH_HOME and IP-based login lockout; invite-code registration; two-factor login with TOTP or passkeys (WebAuthn: several keys per account, phone enrolment by QR, username-less sign-in, and a step-up before any login factor is added or removed); a user-management settings panel (users edit their own profile and manage their own TOTP and passkeys, admins add or remove users, reset passwords, manage invites and clear the passkeys of a lost device); per-user model and API-key configuration whose private entries are encrypted with a key derived from the login password and stay unreadable by any admin, with admin sharing to selected users (usable, balance visible, key never shown, revocation immediate) and unconfigured users blocked rather than falling back to the deployment configuration; per-user isolation on the REST and list APIs and per-frame ownership filtering on the WebSocket mux; session persistence across restarts; a JSONL audit log; and a fail-closed gateway. Requires the DSH 0.2.0 line (the 0.1.1-rc.2 transport line was removed in 0.7.0); passkey login needs a localhost or HTTPS origin because browsers require a secure context.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 认证网关：登录门禁覆盖页面、/api、/plugins 与 WebSocket 升级；PBKDF2 口令哈希（每用户独立盐）、HttpOnly SameSite 会话 Cookie（名字按 DSH_HOME 唯一）、按源 IP 登录锁定；邀请码注册；两步验证可用 TOTP 动态码或通行密钥（WebAuthn：一个账号可绑定多个密钥，手机可扫码添加，支持免用户名登录，改动登录因子前必须二次验证）；设置面板内置用户管理（普通用户可修改本人资料与密码并管理自己的 TOTP 与通行密钥，管理员可新增/删除用户、重置密码、管理邀请码、清除丢失设备的通行密钥）；模型与 API Key 按用户隔离管理，私有配置用登录口令派生的密钥加密、任何管理员都无法读取，管理员可把自己的模型分享给指定用户（可用、可看余额、看不到 Key、撤销立即生效），未配置的用户被阻断而不是回退到部署级配置；REST/列表接口按用户隔离，WebSocket 主通道逐帧按归属过滤；会话重启后免登录恢复；JSONL 审计日志；存储故障时保持 fail-closed。仅支持 DSH 0.2.0 线（0.1.1-rc.2 传输线已在 0.7.0 移除）；因浏览器要求安全上下文，通行密钥需通过 localhost 或 HTTPS 访问。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Ask the executing AI — and the auto-review AI when DSH's auto-review plugin is installed and enabled — about a pending tool approval before you allow or reject it; the executing AI's answers are saved into the session.
description.zh: 审批等待期间，向执行 AI 提问，装了并启用 DSH 的自动审查插件时也可问自动审查 AI，问清风险与后果再决定；执行 AI 的回答会留在会话里。

description.en: Hard-stop consecutive identical tool calls after a configurable streak so the agent cannot spin in place.
description.zh: 在可配置次数后硬拦截连续相同的工具调用，避免 Agent 原地空转。

description.en: Hard-stops further tool calls after a configurable per-session budget is reached.
description.zh: 在达到可配置的会话级工具调用次数上限后，硬拦截后续工具调用。

description.en: Pre-publish credential audit: walks a directory tree and flags API keys, tokens, private keys, database connection strings and hard-coded passwords before you commit, publish or ship. Zero dependencies, fully offline, findings are redacted to the first six characters.
description.zh: 发布前凭据审计：在你提交、发布或打包外发之前，遍历目录找出里面的 API key、令牌、私钥、数据库连接串和硬编码密码。零依赖、纯本地、不联网，发现结果脱敏到前 6 个字符。

description.en: Pre-execution safety valve for DSH that judges with TypeSafe Jev: it hooks tools/pre-execute and decides every bash/pwsh call by first applying offline static rules, then by asking the Jev model — the System One model from TypeSafe, which returns a structured decision instead of prose — one yes-no question ("will this command irreversibly delete or overwrite real data?"), turning the answer into allow, revise, block or escalate; revise hands the model a safer rewrite, escalate offers a one-shot human token; exhausted credit or a missing API key degrades loudly instead of failing silent, and a missing key is requested in the conversation itself (`guard key set`, read from stdin); every verdict is appended to a shared audit log and the text people read is bilingual zh-CN/en.
description.zh: DSH 执行前安全阀门，用 TypeSafe Jev 模型做判定：挂载 tools/pre-execute，对每条 bash/pwsh 调用先过离线静态规则，再向 Jev 模型（TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，返回结构化判定而非散文）提一个是非问句——「这条命令会不可逆地删除或覆盖真实数据吗？」——把答案切成允许／修正／拦截／上报人工四态；修正给模型更安全的写法，上报提供一次性人工令牌；额度耗尽或没有可用密钥时大声降级而非静默失效，缺密钥时会直接在对话里要求录入（录入用 `guard key set`，只从标准输入读）；每条判定写入共享审计日志，面向人的文案中英双语。

description.en: Agent governance suite: policy-based tool gating (allow/deny/ask with wildcards and priorities), a structured JSONL audit trail, and per-agent token quotas against the host token meter, with state under $DSH_HOME/gov.
description.zh: Agent 治理套件：基于策略的工具门禁（allow/deny/ask，支持通配符与优先级）、结构化 JSONL 审计日志、基于宿主 token 计量的按 agent 配额，状态存于 $DSH_HOME/gov。

description.en: Installation safety gate for DSH plugins: antivirus-style scan of install scripts, permissions, secrets and network callbacks on local directories or npm tarballs, returning a BLOCK/WARN/PASS verdict before "dsh plugin add".
description.zh: DSH 插件的安装安全闸门：在 "dsh plugin add" 前对本地目录或 npm 包做"杀毒"式扫描（安装脚本、权限、密钥、网络回连），给出 BLOCK/WARN/PASS 判定。

description.en: Claude Code-style permission rules engine: hard/deny/ask/allow tiers with a hard tier above full access, workspace-scoped rules, wildcard path protection, and a visual staged editor; rules persist in settings.yaml.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格权限规则引擎：hard/deny/ask/allow 四级规则（hard 高于全访问、不可豁免）、workspace 作用域、通配符路径保护、可视化草稿式编辑器，规则持久化于 settings.yaml。

description.en: Auto-approval permission guard: a middle tier between workspace-write and danger-full-access — auto-allows safe operations inside trust directories, always asks a human for destructive ones, with 11 per-category switches and an audit trail.
description.zh: 自动审批权限守卫：介于 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间的中间档——信任目录内安全操作自动放行，危险操作一律人工确认；11 个分类开关可调，自带审计记录。

description.en: Adds Auto-review and Approve for me modes for DSH tool calls.
description.zh: 为 DSH 工具调用提供 Auto-review 和 Approve for me 模式。

description.en: LLM approval answerer for sandbox escalations beyond workspace-write: a deterministic regex filter first, then a clean-context reviewer model; humans are asked only when it is unsure. Requires the bundled core patches.
description.zh: 沙箱越权审批的 LLM 应答器：先过确定性正则过滤，再交给干净上下文的审核模型；拿不准才转人工。需要随附的核心补丁。

description.en: Named user credentials the model uses by reference: values are entered on a Settings → Credentials page and injected into each shell execution as DSH_CM_* variables instead of being printed into the transcript, with credential_read as the documented last resort.
description.zh: 具名凭据按引用使用：秘密值在「设置 → 凭据」页录入，按次注入 shell 执行环境的 DSH_CM_* 变量而不打印进对话，credential_read 是文档化的最后手段。

description.en: Security-analysis plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 33 tools spanning six security domains, evidence/reporting and toolbox, plus the case lifecycle, routing and tool ledger; a session-bound case workflow with an evidence chain, E-id validation and reproducible findings; 362 on-demand references; three hot-swappable persona profiles; and a four-tab workbench (armor / case / intercept / about) with case-state recovery after context compaction.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的安全分析插件：33 个工具覆盖六大安全域、证据/报告与工具集，并提供案件生命周期、路由和工具账本；按会话绑定的案件工作区支持证据链、E 编号校验与可复现结论（repro_cmd）；内置 362 篇按需参考、三档可热切换人设，以及带案件状态恢复的破甲 / Case / 拦截 / 关于四页工作台。

description.en: Applies per-workspace default Agent and permission presets to new root sessions automatically (Settings - Workspace defaults), using only official extension points.
description.zh: 按工作区规则为新建根会话自动应用 Agent 预设与权限预设（设置 - 工作区默认设置），仅使用官方扩展点。

description.en: Rewrites agent-issued delete commands (PowerShell `Remove-Item` and its aliases, Bash `rm`/`unlink`/`rmdir`, CMD `del`/`erase`/`rd`/`rmdir`) into system recycle-bin operations on Windows, Linux and macOS, best-effort checks scripts for the same operations before they run, and keeps no permanent-delete fallback.
description.zh: 把 Agent 提交的删除命令（PowerShell `Remove-Item` 及别名、Bash `rm`/`unlink`/`rmdir`、CMD `del`/`erase`/`rd`/`rmdir`）改写为 Windows、Linux、macOS 的系统回收站操作，执行脚本前尽力检查其中的同类删除操作，且不提供永久删除兜底。

description.en: Uses an isolated LLM review to approve or reject DSH sandbox permission requests.
description.zh: 使用隔离的 LLM 审查来批准或拒绝 DSH 沙箱权限请求。

description.en: One-click Approve & escalate on the approval card: answers the pending request and switches the live session to a permission preset.
description.zh: 审批卡片上的「批准并升级」一键操作：既应答当前待批请求，又把当前会话切换到指定的权限预设。

description.en: Permission mode between workspace-write and full access: shell commands are checked by deterministic rules and a subagent review; irreversible or system-level actions require explicit approval.
description.zh: 介于 workspace-write 与 Full access 之间的权限模式：命令先经规则与子代理审查，不可逆或系统级操作需人工批准。

plugins.name: dsh-privacy-guard

description.en: Control panel for a local credential-redaction gateway in DeepSeek Harness: gateway and model health, audit metrics, a dry-run leak tester, an exemption whitelist, encrypted key management, credential-protected model entries and deployment controls.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 本地凭据脱敏网关的控制面板：网关与小模型健康状态、审计指标、泄密探测沙箱、豁免白名单、加密密钥管理、凭据保护模型入口与部署控制。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to 100.114.93.90:8317

description.en: Read-only audit of whether a DSH plugin's HTTP routes are actually fenced, discovering the registered routes by reading plugin code and probing loopback only.
description.zh: 只读审计 DSH 插件的 HTTP 路由是否真的做了鉴权栅栏：读插件代码找出真正注册的路由，仅对回环地址发起探测。

description.en: Codex-style auto-review permission mode: adds an auto-review preset that auto-approves safe sandbox escalations, asks on risky or ambiguous ones, and rejects critical unconfirmed operations.
description.zh: Codex 风格自动审查权限模式：新增 auto-review 权限档，自动放行安全沙箱提权，危险或模糊操作转人工确认，未确认的致命操作直接拒绝。

description.en: Keeps a redundant sandbox-escalation argument from failing a tool call. Escalating tools (pwsh, bash, write, edit) advertise the full sandbox_permissions enum, but DSH only accepts a level strictly wider than the one already in effect — a check its own source calls 'deliberately not a schema constraint'. A model that reflexively passes the argument therefore picks the level it is already at and the call dies before running with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode', costing some models a whole turn of retries. This plugin registers one tools/execute waterfall listener and, only on that documented rejection and only when the arguments really carried an escalation field, re-issues the identical call once without it. Safe by DSH's own documentation: the rejection precedes any execution ('nothing has run'), and the corrected call cannot match again, so the retry is loop-free. Reproduced and verified end to end — before: isError true, the command never ran; after: the command's real output, isError false, one tool/call and one tool/result. Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 让「同级或更窄的 sandbox_permissions」不再让工具调用直接失败。会升级的工具（pwsh、bash、write、edit）都广告完整的 sandbox_permissions 枚举，但 DSH 只接受严格更宽于当前生效级别的请求——其源码自称这是「deliberately not a schema constraint」。于是反射式带上该参数的模型往往填它已经在的那个级别，调用在执行前就死掉："sandbox escalation to \"workspace-write\" is not strictly wider than this call's current \"workspace-write\" mode"，某些模型还会为此烧掉一整轮重试。本插件只注册一个 tools/execute waterfall 监听器，且仅在那一条文档化拒绝上、且参数里确实带了升级字段时，把同一个调用去掉该参数重投一次。安全性由 DSH 自己的文档保证：拒绝发生在任何执行之前（"nothing has run"），且改过的参数无法再次匹配，因此重投在结构上不成环。已端到端复现并验证——改造前 isError 为 true 且命令从未执行；改造后拿到命令的真实输出、isError 为 false，会话里只有一个 tool/call 与一个 tool/result。零依赖。

description.en: Writes a model-generated annotation into every DSH escalation approval prompt — what the command does, what the model intends, how risky it is and why, and what each choice means — and keeps a searchable history of past approvals at /dsh-approval/history, with a diagnostics page at /dsh-approval/diag.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的每一次提权审批弹窗加一份由模型生成的注释：这段代码做什么、模型想达成什么、风险多大以及原因、每个选项意味着什么；并提供 /dsh-approval/history 历史授权查询（可搜索、可筛选、记录当时选了什么）与 /dsh-approval/diag 诊断页。

description.en: Turn-scoped “Allow for this task” approvals: automatically allow matching `danger-full-access` escalations only for the current task, then expire.
description.zh: DSH「允许本次任务」临时授权：仅在当前任务内自动放行同类 `danger-full-access` 请求，任务结束自动失效。

plugins.name: dsh-jev-interceptor
