description.en: Classifies pending tool calls with Jev (TypeSafe AI's non-generative decision model) on tools/pre-execute — confident high-risk calls are denied, ambiguous ones escalated to approval — and auto-approves clearly-granted reversible calls on approval/request behind argument-evidence gating. Also subclasses the session-reference resolver so snapshots keep Jev-scored messages instead of dropping oldest-first. Degrades to stock behavior on any provider failure; shadow mode with a /jev-stats command; TypeSafe or OpenRouter endpoints; 64 tests.
description.zh: 在 tools/pre-execute 上用 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的非生成式决策模型）对待执行的工具调用分类——高置信高危拒绝、存疑转审批——并在 approval/request 上对明确授权且可逆的调用做带参数证据门控的自动批准。另子类化 session-reference resolver，让引用快照按 Jev 打分保留消息而非最旧优先丢弃。任何 provider 故障均回退原生行为；提供 shadow 模式与 /jev-stats 统计命令；支持 TypeSafe 或 OpenRouter 入口；64 个测试。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Pre-install static security review and runtime guard for dsh plugins: deobfuscation decoding, supply-chain checks, web one-click review/install/uninstall, and optional runtime tool-call guard.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全审查与运行时守卫：安装前静态审查（反混淆解码、供应链检测）、Web 一键审查/安装/卸载，以及可选的运行时工具调用拦截。

description.en: Keep declared workspace subpaths (e.g. .git) read-only, honor a read-only rules file at the workspace root, grant extra writable roots under workspace-write, and let the model request session-scoped write access; enforced for sandboxed CLI commands and the write/edit tools.
description.zh: 为 DSH 沙箱增加工作区子路径只读保护 (例如 .git), 支持工作区根下的只读规则文件, 可在 workspace-write 下声明额外可写根, 并允许模型申请本会话的可写授权; 命令沙箱与 write/edit 工具都生效.

description.en: Workspace-scoped Semgrep SAST tool for DeepSeek Harness with a managed Windows x64 runtime, structured bounded findings, cancellation and timeout controls, and user-approved sandbox escalation. Installs from npm as @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区内 Semgrep SAST 工具，提供托管 Windows x64 运行时、结构化有界结果、取消与超时控制，以及经用户批准的沙箱权限升级。npm 包名为 @aaub-software/dsh-semgrep-sast。

description.en: Pre-install compatibility gate for DSH plugins: locks the resolved version, checks peer/engines declarations, dry-installs into an isolated DSH_HOME and boots it with a timeout, blocks on any failure, and restores the profile if the real install fails. Optionally intercepts dsh-market install/update clicks. Compatible with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前兼容性门控：锁定解析版本、校验 peer/engines 声明、在隔离 DSH_HOME 中试装并限时试启动，任一失败即阻止；正式安装失败自动还原 profile。可选拦截 dsh-market 的安装/更新点击，兼容 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x。

description.en: \!WARNING\! this removes the authentication step !WARNING! Exchanges the process launch token for the browser-session cookie, so a first visit needs no ?token=... in the URL.
description.zh: ！警告！这会移除认证步骤！警告！注册一个登录入口路由（默认 GET /__dsh_login），把进程里的登录 token 换成浏览器会话 cookie，让首次访问不用带 ?token=…。

description.en: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls, /scan command, plugin_scan tool, web panel, and allowlist.
description.zh: dsh 安全守卫插件：基于规则的静态扫描覆盖恶意代码、提示词注入与令牌浪费，运行时拦截危险工具调用，提供 /scan 命令、plugin_scan 工具、Web 面板与白名单。

description.en: Static pre-install security auditor for plugin bundles: lifecycle scripts, dynamic execution, credential-exfiltration combos, and patch-layer hazards, with zero dependencies and in-memory tar parsing.
description.zh: 插件安装前静态安全审计：生命周期脚本、动态执行、凭据外传组合特征与 patch 层风险；零依赖，tar 包全程内存解析不落盘。

description.en: Reads and writes a self-hosted Bitwarden/Vaultwarden vault from any session: eleven bitwarden_* tools, real-time WebSocket sync with a polling fallback, a settings panel with readonly, ask and auto write modes, and optional local masking — with masking on, passwords surface as stable placeholders unless revealed one field at a time, and on-disk session logs are swept for bitwarden secrets. Masking and log sweeping are separate switches.
description.zh: 让任意会话直接读写自建的 Bitwarden/Vaultwarden 保险库：十一个 bitwarden_* 工具、WebSocket 实时同步（不可用时降级轮询）、readonly/ask/auto 三档写权限设置面板，以及可开启的本地脱敏——开启后密码默认以稳定占位符出现，需要时按条目+字段单次取回，落盘会话日志中的 bitwarden 明文也会被定期擦除；面板展示的密码与动态码会打码。脱敏与日志擦除是两个独立开关。

description.en: Agent security guardrail: intercepts and audits every tool call, requiring human confirmation on sensitive operations.
description.zh: Agent 安全护栏：拦截并审计所有工具调用，命中敏感操作就要求人工确认。

description.en: Zero-intervention permission gate for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents on macOS — active on install. Writes that can be undone via a local git baseline or macOS Time Machine are auto-approved and automatically snapshotted; network access, package installs, process/system management, and reads of sensitive credential paths are blocked; every decision is audited — the audit log keeps everything by default, with optional automatic cleanup of the oldest records.
description.zh: macOS 上 DSH 智能体的零干预权限门 —— 安装即生效。可经本地 Git 或时间机器回滚的写操作自动放行并自动打快照，拦截网络、装包、进程 / 系统管理与敏感路径读取，并记录完整审计日志（可配置启用自动清理最旧审计记录）。

description.en: Scans skills and MCP configs for prompt injection, homoglyphs, hidden Unicode, dangerous shell, and credential leaks.
description.zh: 扫描 skill 与 MCP 配置中的提示注入、同形字、Unicode 隐形字符、危险 shell 与凭据泄露。

description.en: Device-pairing gateway for DeepSeek Harness: by default it listens on 127.0.0.1:3443 over plain HTTP and reverse-proxies the local dsh at http://127.0.0.1:3080, so a loopback-only install works without any certificate. Production, cross-machine and app pairing require TLS: configure tlsCert/tlsKey plus an https publicUrl (self-signed is fine). A fronting Caddy/Nginx may terminate the public TLS, but the gate itself still needs tlsCert/tlsKey and the proxy must connect back over HTTPS. Features TOTP-authorised QR device pairing, username/password login, sliding sessions with absolute caps, device revocation, a WebUI admin panel and audit log, and a reverse proxy with WebSocket tunnelling. First-run setup is completed in the WebUI wizard. Tests: 171/171 unit tests, 29-step e2e.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的设备配对网关：默认只监听 127.0.0.1:3443（明文 HTTP）并把请求反代到本机 http://127.0.0.1:3080，本机安装无需证书即可使用。生产/跨机/App 配对必须配置 TLS 证书（自签即可）与 https 的 publicUrl；若在前置 Caddy/Nginx 终止对外 TLS，网关自身仍须配置 tlsCert/tlsKey，并由代理以 HTTPS 回源。功能：TOTP 授权的扫码设备配对、用户名密码登录、带绝对上限的滑动会话、设备吊销、WebUI 管理面板与审计日志、含 WebSocket 隧道的反向代理。首次初始化在 WebUI 向导中完成。测试：单测 171/171、e2e 29 步。

description.en: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on its own.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话单独绑定一把 DeepSeek API key，生效 key 失效或服务商不匹配时提醒，且绝不自动替换 key。

description.en: Commitment write-gate: operator-authored rules enforced before a tool call runs — a deterministic guard tier plus an LLM-judge tier, fail-closed by default, every block written to a contradictions log.
description.zh: 承诺写入闸门：由运营者编写的规则在工具调用执行前生效——先是一层确定性守卫，再是一层 LLM 裁判，默认失败即拒绝，每一次拦截都写进矛盾日志。

description.en: LLM-assisted auto approval with countdown fallback for the Auto permission preset: static rules, risk tiers, breaker and file audit.
description.zh: 为 DSH Auto 权限档提供 LLM 辅助自动审批：静态规则、LLM 复审、风险分档、人工倒计时兜底、熔断与文件级审计。

description.en: Automated approval review: auto-approve read-only tools, auto-deny dangerous commands, fail-closed policy engine.
description.zh: 自动化审批审核：只读工具自动放行、危险命令自动拒绝，策略引擎 fail-closed。

description.en: Automatic secret redaction in tool results: masks API keys, tokens, JWTs, private keys and configured secrets before the model sees them.
description.zh: 工具结果敏感信息自动脱敏：模型看到前掩码 API key / token / JWT / 私钥与配置密钥。

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件做安装前供应链校验：在代码运行前核对即将安装的包是否与你读到的源码一致。

description.en: Verifies letters signed by other agents: a canonical field order, digest and HMAC checks, and fail-closed handling of missing or unregistered fields. Off by default; when enabled, a letter that fails any check is refused rather than delivered.
description.zh: 校验其他 agent 写来的信：规范字段顺序、摘要与 HMAC 校验。默认关闭；开启后，缺字段或未登记字段不放行，任何一项不过就拒收。

description.en: Puts sessions into the built-in Auto review permission preset: new sessions at creation, existing root sessions when they are restored.
description.zh: 让会话进入内置的 Auto review 权限预设：新建会话在创建时进入，已有的根会话在重新打开时切过去。

description.en: Restrict the file access of agents in any sandbox mode (read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access / auto) to the session workspace, and ask the user to rule on cross-border access. Each session can also use the gear selection box next to the composer to relax the cross-border gate to 「 read-only outside workspace 」 or 「 fully release 」.
description.zh: 把任何沙箱模式（read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access / auto）下代理的文件访问限制在会话工作区内，越界访问一律请用户裁决；每个会话还能用 composer 旁的档位选择框把越界门禁放宽为「工作区外只读」或「完全放开」。

description.en: Adversarial review gate for tool calls. It hooks `tools/pre-execute`: a local regex pass over destructive commands (`rm -rf`, `git push --force`, `git reset --hard`, `DROP TABLE`, `format`, disk writes) and sensitive paths (`.env`, `id_rsa`, `.ssh`, `.git/`, `$DSH_HOME`) runs first with no latency, and only a hit is escalated to one review-model call that returns allow or deny. Plain reads and ordinary writes never enter that path, so everyday work pays no added delay. Every verdict is shown live in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 工具调用的对抗式审查门。它挂在 `tools/pre-execute` 上：先用本地正则零延迟筛破坏性命令（`rm -rf`、`git push --force`、`git reset --hard`、`DROP TABLE`、`format`、写盘）和敏感路径（`.env`、`id_rsa`、`.ssh`、`.git/`、`$DSH_HOME`），只有命中才升级给一次审查模型调用，返回 allow / deny。普通读取与普通写入完全不进这条路径，日常工作没有额外延迟；每次判定都在 Web GUI 里实时显示。

description.en: DSH Desktop plugin safety guard: self-repairs plugin load crashes and runs 8 core safety checks (2 optional: deep-config & smoke), prompting you when a plugin changes. Non-commercial source-available.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 插件安全防护：崩溃后自我修复 + 8 项核心安全检查（另有 2 项可选：深度组合校验、业务冒烟），写完插件自动提示。非商业源可用。

description.en: Automatic approval and review for tool calls that need approval: keyword buckets match red lines without context, then a judge model classifies what was requested and sends it to allow, reject or a human according to the matching row and risk level; a judgment that never ran always goes to a human, and rejections tell the model why.
description.zh: 自动审批 / 自动审核需要审批的工具调用：先用关键词分桶做零上下文红线匹配，再交由审核模型判类别与风险等级， 按命中行与等级那一格决定自动允许、自动拒绝或转人工；判定没跑成固定转人工，自动拒绝会把原因回传给模型。

description.en: Scan and fix Low integrity labels, non-inherited S-1-4 sandbox ACEs, and related Everyone deny ACEs in DSH workspaces on Windows. Maps live DSH workspaces, defaults to read-only, repairs after confirmation, verifies the result, and keeps one replaceable ACL rollback record per workspace.
description.zh: 扫描并修复 Windows 上 DSH 工作区中的 Low 完整性标签、非继承 S-1-4-* 沙箱授权 ACE 及关联的 Everyone 拒绝项。按 DSH 实时工作区映射，默认只读，确认后修复并复扫校验；每个工作区保留一条可替换的 ACL 回滚记录。

description.en: Shipped with cc-safety-net-style mechanical safety-net rules appended; supports both no-model and model-assisted security review, in modes such as 自动审查 (auto-review) and 机械直通 (mechanical pass-through). P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: 已追加 cc-safety-net 风格的机械安全网规则，同时支持无模型、有模型辅助方式的安全审查，模式为自动审查、机械直通等。P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: Advisory permission checks for DSH tool calls: risk tiers, a path sandbox (empty allowed_roots denies every path-like call), a per-minute call limit and a JSONL audit, exposed through gate_check / gate_check_path / gate_policy and ctx.gate — other plugins or prompts must call the gate; it does not intercept tool calls by itself.
description.zh: DSH 工具调用的咨询式权限检查：风险分级、路径沙箱（allowed_roots 为空时一律拒绝）、每分钟调用限额与 JSONL 审计，通过 gate_check / gate_check_path / gate_policy 与 ctx.gate 提供——需由其他插件或提示主动调用，本身不拦截工具调用。

description.en: Filesystem permissions for shell calls, granted per path and capability rather than per command name. The command line is parsed for the read, write, create, delete and execute effects it needs, a capability it lacks raises the approval card instead of a flat refusal, and the same rules are compiled into the macOS Seatbelt profile the process, its children and the code its arguments never showed all run under. An Approvals tab in the conversation reads the audit log back and shows which rule, automatic reviewer or person answered each call.
description.zh: 按路径与能力（read / write / create / delete / execute）授予 shell 调用的文件权限，而不是按命令名判断。命令行的文件效果由解析得出，缺哪个能力就出审批卡片而不是一律拒绝，同一套规则还会编译成进程、它的子进程、以及命令行根本没露出来的代码共同运行其下的 macOS Seatbelt profile。会话里的「审批」标签页把审计日志读回来，显示每次判定是规则、自动复核还是人拍的板。

description.en: Replaces detected secrets (OpenAI, AWS, GitHub, PEM, Bearer) with deterministic, structurally valid honey tokens before they reach the model or the session file; adds manual marking for values the detectors miss, explicit user-visible restore, a cross-session canary alarm, and an opt-in JSONL log of substitution counts that never records the underlying values.
description.zh: 在密钥离开本机前，将其确定性地替换为结构合法的蜜罐假值（OpenAI、AWS、GitHub、PEM、Bearer 模式）；支持手动标记检测器认不出的值、用户可见的显式还原、蜜罐跨会话出现时的金丝雀告警，以及可选的 JSONL 替换计数日志（只记来源与类别计数，绝不记录真实值）。

description.en: Static security scanner for DSH plugins: read-only audit (exec, credentials, exfiltration, obfuscation, install scripts, bundle manifest) with a 0-100 risk score.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：只读静态审计（执行、凭据、外传、混淆、安装脚本、bundle 清单），输出 0-100 风险分。

plugins.name: dsh-privacy-gateway

description.en: Replaces personal data in conversation messages with placeholders before they reach the model (Chinese names found by context, mainland-China mobile and ID numbers, emails, bank card numbers, and terms from a user word list), shows the originals only in the local UI, and creates redacted copies of CSV/XLSX files.
description.zh: 在对话消息发给模型前，把个人信息替换为占位符（按上下文识别的中文姓名、大陆手机号与身份证号、邮箱、银行卡号，以及用户词库中的词），原文只在本机界面还原显示；并可生成 CSV/XLSX 的脱敏副本。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: PTES-based penetration testing plugin with Root-Orchestrator architecture for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 PTES 的渗透测试插件，采用 Root-Orchestrator 架构，用于 DeepSeek Harness。

plugins.name: dsh-lifecycle

description.en: Lock screen with password/OTP/Passkey, persistent sessions and custom wallpapers; Harness power controls (the bundled systemd/launchd service must be installed) and npm updates on Linux and macOS, with experimental Windows support not yet tested on Windows. Adapts the auth kernel of xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway (MIT) — do not install both, they both own the web gateway port.
description.zh: 锁屏、密码／OTP／Passkey、持久化登录与自定义壁纸，支持 Linux/macOS 的 Harness 电源管理（需安装随包提供的 systemd/launchd 服务）及 npm 更新；Windows 为实验支持，暂未实机验证。认证内核改编自 xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway（MIT），不能与其同装：两者都占用 Web 网关端口。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Approval frame for DSH tool calls: a rule table with four outcomes (deny, ask, AI review, allow) across tool, command, file and network scope, then AI fast/deep review and human approval, a hash-chained audit trail and a settings UI. Target files are inspected by metadata only (no file contents are opened); the reviewer sees the command, targets and clipped write payloads, with secrets redacted before anything leaves the machine.
description.zh: DSH 工具调用的审批框架：一张四档规则表（拒绝／问人／AI 评审／放行）按工具、命令、文件与网络作用面逐条匹配，之后是 AI 快评与深评、人工审批，并带哈希链审计台账和设置页。目标文件只查元数据、不打开文件正文；评审端看到的是命令、目标与裁剪后的写入内容，发出前先做敏感信息脱敏。

plugins.name: dsh-web-startup-auth

description.en: Replaces the dsh web startup to allow binding 0.0.0.0, gated by username/password login: signed session cookies, /api route protection, an auth tab in the settings panel, and a reset CLI that rotates the signing key to invalidate all sessions.
description.zh: 替换 dsh web 启动器以允许绑定 0.0.0.0，并以账号密码登录为门槛：签名会话 cookie、/api 路由保护、设置面板认证标签页，以及轮换签名密钥使全部会话失效的重置 CLI。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Policy plugin that gates kubectl by kubeconfig context: hard-deny irreversible verbs outside local clusters, ask for the rest.
description.zh: 按 kubeconfig context 管控 kubectl 调用的策略插件：本地集群外硬拒绝不可逆操作，其余写操作请求人工确认。

description.en: Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭式运行时工具调用循环防护。

description.en: Sanitizes leaked DeepSeek DSML closing tags from model text streams.
description.zh: 清理模型文本流中泄漏的 DeepSeek DSML 闭合标签。

description.en: Background security auditor for DeepSeek Harness: scans agent outputs for secret leakage, checks command safety before execution, and surfaces findings in a persistent audit log.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的后台安全审计器：扫描 Agent 输出中的秘密泄漏，在执行前检查命令安全性，并将发现记录到持久化审计日志中。

description.en: Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能检查点、工作区安全防护和即时回滚。

plugins.name: dsh-completion-guard

description.en: Keeps DSH agents from forgetting your requirements during long tasks. It saves important conditions and completion evidence locally, brings them back after context compaction or session resume, and stops partial work from being reported as the whole task done.
description.zh: 避免 DSH Agent 在长任务中忘记你的要求：它会把重要条件和完成依据保存在本机，在上下文压缩或恢复会话后重新带回，防止漏掉关键限制，或只做完一部分就说整个任务已经完成。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Restores the permission preset a session was last set to when that session is reopened; a session opened for the first time is left untouched. Load it after dsh-experimental-auto-review to restore the auto preset.
description.zh: 重新打开会话时恢复该会话上次设置的权限预设；首次打开不干预。需排在 dsh-experimental-auto-review 之后加载才能恢复 auto 预设。

description.en: Rewrites the model-visible copy of system, developer, user, assistant and tool messages into stable HMAC placeholders before a request leaves the machine, while local session logs, the chat transcript and restored tool calls keep real values.
description.zh: 请求离开本机前，把 system/developer/user/assistant/tool 五类消息的模型可见副本改写为稳定 HMAC 占位符；本地会话日志、对话记录与还原后的工具调用仍保留真值。

description.en: Authorized pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness — exploration chain, assets and findings with a Web view.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的授权渗透模式：以探索链路记录目标、线索、资产与漏洞，并在 Web 中可视化展示。

description.en: When enabled, exchanges the running process's launch token for a browser-session cookie at a configurable public URI (default /trustme), so a first visit needs no ?token= in the URL.
description.zh: 开启后，在可配置的公开 URI（默认 /trustme）上把当前进程的 launch token 换成浏览器会话 cookie，首次访问无需在 URL 里带 ?token=。

description.en: Refuses agent-generated SQL that reads tables or columns outside a configured blacklist or whitelist, returning a structured permission reason instead of rewriting the query.
description.zh: 拒绝智能体生成的越权 SQL：读取的表或字段不在黑白名单策略内时直接拒绝，返回结构化权限原因，不改写查询。

description.en: Per-directory access gate for DSH: deny / read / full levels for names and paths, roster groups, per-session overrides and an audit log, plus seven model-facing `gate_*` tools whose widening requests must be approved by the owner in the panel. Installs with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-isolation-gate`; MIT, no network calls, state stays on disk.
description.zh: DSH 的按目录访问门禁：对名字与路径给出 deny / read / full 三级权限、名册分组、按会话覆盖与审计日志，另有七个面向模型的 `gate_*` 工具，放宽权限必须由拥有者在面板里批准。用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-isolation-gate` 安装；MIT、不联网、状态只落本地磁盘。

description.en: Caddy forward_auth administrator login for DeepSeek Harness Web, with Argon2id passwords, revocable sessions, bilingual UI, and a native sidebar sign-out action.
description.zh: 通过 Caddy forward_auth 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供管理员登录，含 Argon2id 口令、可撤销会话、中英界面和侧栏原生退出。

description.en: Maintained fork of dsh-approval-gate. A neutral operation whose confirmation count has reached the threshold auto-approves when the judge is unavailable, instead of prompting a human again; approver-facing explanations are generated in Chinese from the real sandbox mode, command and paths. Also carries deterministic hard-deny for credential exfiltration and system-path destruction, judge-input redaction, a judge model candidate chain, fingerprint-scoped allow rules, and an approval view with unified diff and one-click revert.
description.zh: dsh-approval-gate 的维护中 fork。判定器不可用时，确认次数已达阈值的中立操作直接自动放行，不再重复弹人工审批；审批说明由真实的沙箱模式、命令与路径生成中文。另含凭据外泄与系统路径销毁的确定性硬拒、判定输入脱敏、判定模型候选链、带操作指纹的放行规则，以及可查看 unified diff 与一键撤销的审批视图。

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web connection provider to skip BrowserAuth entirely so the Web UI opens directly without pasting the random startup token, gated to nine verified DSH version pairs with strict host/client matching that sleeps automatically on unknown or mixed versions, and reverts fully on uninstall; web profiles only.
description.zh: 替换 DSH Web 的连接提供方以整体跳过 BrowserAuth，打开 Web 地址即可直接使用、无需抄写启动 URL 中的随机 token；按九个已验证的 DSH 版本对严格成对门控，遇到未知或混用版本自动休眠，卸载即完全恢复官方行为，仅限 Web profile。

description.en: Reviews destructive shell commands with a model before they run, asks you to confirm or blocks them, and aborts a running command once it has deleted too many files.
description.zh: 破坏性 shell 命令执行前由模型判断会不会造成不可逆破坏，判定会破坏时询问或拦下；命令运行中删除文件过多时中止。

description.en: Vets local, npm, and GitHub plugin source before installation, blocks configured high-risk tool calls at runtime, audits output secret patterns, and writes HMAC-chained local audit logs.
description.zh: 在安装前体检本地、npm 与 GitHub 插件源码，运行时拦截命中配置阈值的高风险工具调用，审计输出中的密钥模式，并写入 HMAC 链式本地审计日志。

description.en: Manual approval mode ("Manual Mode" / "Ask Mode").
description.zh: 手动审批模式（Manual/Ask Mode）。

description.en: Blocks AI coding agents from editing files without evidence and from running unapproved high-risk commands, and tells quoted dangerous strings apart from commands actually being executed.
description.zh: 拦截 AI 编码智能体未取证就改文件、未获授权执行高危命令，并区分「被引用的危险字符串」与「真要执行的命令」。

plugins.name: dsh-login

description.en: Multi-user login gateway for the DSH web UI: the first visit creates the admin account, admins add and manage users in the GUI settings panel, ordinary users see only their own conversations, and unauthenticated visitors are redirected to /login.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供多用户登录网关：首次访问创建管理员账户，管理员在 GUI 设置面板中添加和管理用户，普通用户只能看到自己的会话，未登录访问重定向到 /login。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Pre-execution guard: a `tools.guard` predicate decides allow, ask or refuse per permission preset for dangerous shell commands (git hook bypass, catastrophic `rm`, download-and-run, git history rewrites) and for edits to credential paths or to files the turn never read, and hands the model the reason plus a working alternative.
description.zh: 执行前拦截：`tools.guard` 谓词按当前权限档位，对危险 shell 命令（跳过 git 钩子、灾难性 `rm`、下载即执行、重写 git 历史）与「写凭据路径」「没读过目标文件的首次编辑」逐条给出放行 / 询问 / 拒绝，并把成因与可行替代写法交回模型。

description.en: Adds an `auto` permission preset between workspace-write and danger-full-access: a classifier grants routine sandbox escalations once, while dangerous or uncertain requests still go to a human.
description.zh: 在 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间增加 `auto` 权限档：分类器一次性放行例行沙箱升级，危险或不确定的操作仍转人工审批。

description.en: Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).
description.zh: dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。

description.en: Stages exact DSH tool calls without dispatch, presents complete canonical arguments in a durable Batch Review Inbox, invalidates approvals after edits or restarts, and commits only a matching SHA-256 digest plus single-use nonce through the normal DSH tool pipeline.
description.zh: 暂存精确的 DSH 工具调用而不执行，在持久化批量审查收件箱中展示完整规范参数；编辑或重启后审批失效，仅允许携带匹配 SHA-256 摘要与一次性 nonce 的批次通过 DSH 正常工具管线提交。

description.en: Raises the local Host's HTTP header budget to 64 KiB and retires stale dsh-auth-* launch cookies on each response, so a fixed profile cannot lock itself out of the desktop welcome handshake after roughly 72 restarts.
description.zh: 把本地 Host 的 HTTP 头部预算提升到 64 KiB，并在每次响应里清掉过期的 dsh-auth-* 启动 cookie，避免固定 profile 在约 72 次重启后卡在桌面端欢迎握手。

description.en: Irreversible secret-scrubbing guard: rewrites access keys, bearer tokens, and private key blocks into `[REDACTED:<category>]` placeholders before they reach the session log and the model.
description.zh: 不可逆密钥脱敏守护：在访问密钥、Bearer 令牌、私钥块进入会话日志和模型请求之前，将其改写为 `[REDACTED:<category>]` 占位符。

description.en: Destructive-command interception gate for dsh: parses shell semantics, judges risk against 41 built-in rules, and holds irreversible rm -rf, git reset --hard, and git push --force style commands at a confirmation gate.
description.zh: dsh 破坏性命令拦截闸门：解析 shell 语义、依据 41 条内置规则判定风险，将 rm -rf、git reset --hard、git push --force 等不可逆命令挡在确认关卡之前。

description.en: Blocks agents from reading or writing sensitive files (.env, credentials, key material), masks leaked secret-shaped values in tool results, keeps an audit journal, and exposes safe sg_* inspection tools that never print raw values.
description.zh: 拦截 agent 对敏感文件（.env、凭据、密钥材料）的读写，对工具结果中泄露的机密形状内容做掩码兜底，记录审计日志，并提供永不输出原始值的 sg_* 安全检查工具。

plugins.name: dsh-redteam-mode#packages/redteam-bundle

description.en: Red-team engagement mode: send one target organization name; a planner session runs five execution roles (recon, asset triage, vulnerability discovery, exploitation, internal pivot) with configurable concurrency; preflight checks skills/resources; scoring uses four stages (recon, internet, boundary, internal) with server-side caps and privilege-wins dedup; findings stay in a local SQLite fact base. The persistent right-side console has nine pages and includes asset mapping, agents, sessions/tunnels, findings, score targets, reports, POC knowledge base and skill library. v0.15.2 adds automatic HTTP evidence/action records, batch ingest, scope check, tunnel pivot probe, data proof, cleanup ledger and T0-T3 asset admission to prevent scope drift. 59 redteam_* tools; 38 bundled skills.
description.zh: 红队作战模式：只发一个靶标单位名称，主会话指挥五个执行角色（信息收集/资产梳理/漏洞发现/漏洞利用/内网渗透），并发可配置；开工前做技能与资源预检；得分按四阶段（信息收集/互联网/边界/内网），上限、权限取高、同服务去重由服务端判定；发现落本机 SQLite 事实库。右侧常驻控制台 9 个页面，含资产测绘、智能体、会话隧道、漏洞战果、得分目标、报告、POC 知识库与技能库。v0.15.2 增加 HTTP 证据/动作记录自动留痕、批量落库、范围校验、隧道内网探测、数据证明、清理台账与 T0–T3 资产准入，防止打偏靶标。59 个 redteam_* 工具，随 npm 包 38 个随包技能。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to $redteam_vps_host:9100

description.en: Honesty guardrails on the tool pipeline: blocks a coding agent from weakening tests, swallowing errors, stubbing type checks, or deleting tests through the shell — nine deterministic hooks, each backed by a planted-failure test proving the guard can fail.
description.zh: 工具流水线上的诚实性护栏：阻止编码 agent 弱化测试、吞掉错误、用桩替换类型检查或通过 shell 删除测试——九个确定性 hook，每个都配有植入失败的测试，证明该护栏确实会触发。

description.en: String-matches tool-call input arguments, blocks dangerous tool calls (deny) or allows them with an injected warning (warn), and ships a full rules-management panel.
description.zh: 对 agent 工具调用输入参数做字符串匹配，命中危险行为则拦截（deny）或放行但注入警告（warn），附规则管理面板。

plugins.name: cc-safety-net

description.en: Pre-execution guard that blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands and access to secrets such as SSH keys and .env files before a tool call runs.
description.zh: 执行前守卫，在工具调用运行前拦截破坏性 Git 与文件系统命令，以及对 SSH 密钥、.env 等机密文件的访问。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Caps the lifetime of DSH desktop's dsh-auth-* session cookies at 7 days, so they stop piling up in the Cookie header until startup fails with HTTP 431.
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* 会话 cookie 的寿命压到 7 天，避免它们越积越多撑爆请求头、导致启动时报 HTTP 431。

plugins.name: dsh-fofatoto

description.en: FOFA cyberspace mapping inside the conversation: check the account quota, run FOFA queries and export the full result set into CSV/JSON/TXT files in the session workspace by paging through a time cursor. A CSV or TXT export stopped by its time budget or by an upstream error continues into the same file from the saved cursor, so rows already fetched are kept. Results render as conversation cards (query, match count, file path), and the API key is saved from the plugin page into the Harness credential store.
description.zh: 在对话里做 FOFA 网络空间测绘：查看账号额度、执行查询语句，并把全量结果按时间游标深翻页导出为 CSV／JSON／TXT 落到会话工作区；被时间预算或上游报错中断的 CSV／TXT 导出可凭游标续写同一文件，已拉取的行不丢。结果以对话卡片展示（语句、命中数、文件路径），API Key 在插件页保存到 Harness 凭据库。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 1.2.3.4 for network access

description.en: Runtime plugin firewall for sessions started through its launcher (the DSH Desktop app cannot be injected and is not covered): filesystem, network and subprocess calls plugins make are attributed to the plugin that made them and judged against what that plugin declares, so a plugin doing its declared job stays silent and leaving it is recorded. Attribution is best-effort, not a guarantee - uncovered calls fall back to host, never to another plugin. Also adds a pre-install health card (capability surface, red-line combinations, PASS/WARN/BLOCK), boundary judging, opt-in pre-execution blocking with a credential-exfil rule, update diff with a trial install in an isolated child process, SARIF/CSV audit export, and multi-source aggregation. Local-only storage, no telemetry; the optional webhook is off by default.
description.zh: 运行时插件防火墙，仅覆盖经其启动器启动的会话（DSH Desktop 桌面应用注入不进去，不在覆盖范围）：插件发起的文件、网络、子进程调用会归属到发起它的插件，并用该插件自己声明的需求去衡量——本职范围内的行为零打扰，越出声明才被记录。归因是尽力而为，不是保证：覆盖不到的调用退回 host，不会被记到别的插件头上。附带装前体检卡（能力面、红线组合、PASS/WARN/BLOCK）、越界判定、可选的执行前拦截（含 credential-exfil 规则）、更新 diff 与隔离子进程试装、SARIF/CSV 审计导出与多源汇总。数据只存本机，无遥测；webhook 默认关闭。

description.en: Commit-time audit harness for AI coding agents: 28 git-diff rules (secrets, out-of-scope edits, prompt injection), HMAC-signed audit trail, snapshot rollback, and a full MCP toolset. Installable via dsh plugin add.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编程 agent 的提交时审计 harness——28 条 git diff 规则（密钥泄漏、越界改动、提示注入）、HMAC 签名审计链、快照回滚、完整 MCP 工具面的 MCP server；dsh plugin add 即装。

description.en: Preventive content policy for tool results: rewrites matched text, and drops or truncates whole fields by path before a result is normalised, rendered or persisted, so an unreviewed payload never enters it. Ships inert with no built-in category or domain blocklist.
description.zh: 工具结果的预防式内容策略：改写命中文本，并按字段路径整段丢弃或截断，让未经审查的载荷在结果被规范化/渲染/落盘之前就进不去。随包为真空操作，不含任何内置的类别或域名黑名单。

description.en: In-place redaction and row-level rollback for session logs, preserving the seq-equals-row-index invariant that makes deleting a middle row corrupt the entire log. Originals are copied to a quarantine sibling before any write, and the reader's own semantics are replayed as a pre-write gate.
description.zh: 会话日志的原地脱敏与按行回退：守住「每行 seq 必须等于它的行号」这一不变式（删中间行会让整份日志打不开）。任何写入前先把原文复制成隔离备份，并以读取端自身的语义作为写前闸门。

description.en: A per-command sandbox allow-list for the bash tool: a rule names a CLI and the writable roots it gets, so allow-listed programs such as lark-cli and gh run inside the kernel sandbox with the workspace plus those roots appended. Unlike plugins that answer the approval for you or that widen the writable set for every command, the grant here is scoped to the matched command, the workspace stays writable, and other commands keep their exact behaviour. Matching is by write footprint rather than by command string, so write-neutral pipes like `2>&1 | tail -N` still match; rules are edited from a Settings page or the Plugins row. Overlays cover Seatbelt, bubblewrap and Landlock; on Windows the writable root is swapped for $HOME instead.
description.zh: 按命令生效的 bash 沙箱白名单：一条规则指定一个命令和它可用的可写根，命中的 lark-cli、gh 等在保留工作区的前提下于内核沙箱内直接执行。与「替你回答授权弹窗」或「对所有命令统一放宽可写范围」的做法不同，这里放行的只有命中的那条命令，工作区仍可写，其他命令行为完全不变。匹配依据是命令的「写足迹」而不是命令字符串，因此 `2>&1 | tail -N` 这类不写文件的管道仍能命中；规则可在设置页或插件行里编辑。macOS 用 Seatbelt、Linux 用 bubblewrap / Landlock，Windows 则退回把可写根换成 $HOME 的旧行为。

description.en: Adds an "approve for me" access mode whose approval requests are answered by an independent reviewer model instead of a person: the reviewer can read the workspace read-only, a reviewer that cannot run hands the request back to the human, and every decision is recorded with its rationale in an Approvals tab.
description.zh: 新增「替我审批」访问模式：审批请求由独立的复核模型裁决而非人工，复核者可只读工作区，复核跑不起来时把请求交回人工，每次裁决的理由记录在「审批」页签中。

description.en: Chinese progress guidance and user-confirmed project or global memory, respecting DSH Full access and reusing host Auto review to reduce repeated prompts.
description.zh: 中文进度规范与经用户确认的项目或全局记忆；遵循 DSH 完全权限，复用宿主自动审查，减少重复确认。

description.en: Semantic risk grading and progressive authorization: classifies tool calls into safe/risky/redline, asks before irreversible actions, auto-allows only approved-and-succeeded signatures.
description.zh: 语义风险分级与渐进授权：把工具调用分为安全／有风险／红线三档，不可逆操作前先询问，只对「已批准且曾成功」的签名自动放行。

description.en: Read-only agent-fleet credential hygiene audit: credential-file permissions, embedded credentials in git remotes (masked in output), and provider token literal counts; zero-dependency and deterministic.
description.zh: 只读的 agent 机群凭据卫生审计：检查凭据文件权限、git remote 内嵌凭据（输出脱敏）与 provider token 字面量计数；零依赖、确定性。

description.en: Model-based permission approval: an approval-request answerer backed by a separate reviewer model.
description.zh: 基于模型的权限审批：由独立审查模型自动应答 approval 权限请求。

description.en: AI-driven source-code security scanning workbench: 5 model tools (start/finding/status/report/list) plus a /hawkeye web UI and JSON/Markdown/HTML vulnerability reports; zero-dependency Cordis plugin, installable as agent preset or npm package.
description.zh: AI 驱动的源代码安全扫描工作台：5 个模型工具（start/finding/status/report/list）、/hawkeye Web UI 和 JSON/Markdown/HTML 漏洞报告；零依赖 Cordis 插件，可作 agent preset 或 npm 包安装。

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
description.zh: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

description.en: Privacy guard for git workflows: before git commit, git push or gh repo sync it scans the content that would enter git (local paths, user info, API keys, private keys, connection strings) and blocks anything not approved in the DSH approval UI; approved items go into a manageable, masked whitelist. Native DSH Config schema with live settings, first-push full-repository scan, fail-closed checks, zero npm runtime dependencies.
description.zh: DSH 提交/推送前隐私检查：在 git commit、git push、gh repo sync 前只读扫描将要进入 git 的内容（本地路径、用户信息、API Key、私钥、连接串等），未授权内容不会上传；命中时通过 DSH 审批面板授权，授权项进入可管理的掩码白名单。支持原生 DSH Config（设置页热改开关）、首次推送全仓扫描、fail-closed，零 npm 运行时依赖。

description.en: Permission guard for DSH: four scopes with read/write/execute bits in the native permission menu, plus an optional Jev semantic classifier for bash commands.
description.zh: DSH 权限守卫：原生权限菜单里的四范围读写执行权限位，bash 命令可选 Jev 语义分类层。

description.en: Conversation lock for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: every conversation row gets a lock button, and a locked conversation blurs only the conversation area behind a password box while the sidebar stays usable. Re-locks on window blur, tab hide, page hide, or whenever the open conversation changes, and never pauses a running turn - the veil reports that background work continues. The password digest, lock flags, and preferences live in <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json behind two same-origin routes guarded by a custom header, so clearing the page localStorage unlocks nothing; PBKDF2-SHA256 with a random salt, and a 30-second input lockout after five wrong attempts. Recovery is opt-in per machine: a Windows login password (enabled only after a real .NET PrincipalContext ValidateCredentials check against the local machine, so Microsoft accounts and passwordless machines keep it off) and a cooling period chosen while creating or changing the password (1/6/24/72/168 hours; expiry clears the password and releases every lock, and the correct password cancels the countdown). A settings section covers status, changing the password, lock new conversations, hiding locked titles, a three-position archive-restore policy (all / locked only / off, switching needs the password), lock everything, and unlock everything. Dialogs use the native dialog top layer, so a dialog opened from Settings is never covered by it. Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer; no build step.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏的会话锁：每个对话行尾多一个锁按钮，锁定后只把对话区挡住并弹出密码框，侧边栏照常可用。窗口失焦、切到后台、页面隐藏或换了对话都会立刻重新锁定；锁定只是界面层，正在跑的回合继续执行，遮罩上会提示后台任务仍在运行。密码摘要、锁清单和偏好存放在 <DSH_HOME>/session-lock/state.json，由两条带自定义请求头的同源路由读写，所以清掉页面的 localStorage 并不会解锁；PBKDF2-SHA256 加随机盐，连错五次锁定输入 30 秒。找回通道按机器可选：Windows 登录密码（必须用 .NET 的 PrincipalContext ValidateCredentials 在本机真实验证通过才启用，微软账户与无密码的机器会自动保持关闭），以及创建或修改密码时选定的强制冷静（1/6/24/72/168 小时，到期清空密码并解除全部锁，输对密码可中止倒计时）。设置页包含状态、修改密码、新对话默认上锁、锁定后隐藏侧边栏标题、归档恢复的三档策略（所有归档/仅已锁定/不需要密码，切换档位本身要密码）、一键上锁与一键解锁。对话框使用原生 dialog 顶层，从设置页打开的弹窗不会被设置页压住。要求 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上；无需构建步骤。

description.en: CC-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic deny/allow rules plus a two-stage allow/reject classifier with a circuit breaker and denial guidance.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 式自动审批：确定性 deny/allow 规则 + 两阶段 allow/reject 分类器，内置熔断器与拒绝引导。

description.en: Copy-on-write permission preset: shell commands run inside a per-workspace Sandboxie box, so writes outside the workspace land in the box copy while the real disk stays untouched (Windows only, requires Sandboxie-Plus).
description.zh: 写时复制权限预设：shell 命令在工作区专属的 Sandboxie 沙盒内运行，工作区外的写入落进沙盒副本、真实磁盘不受影响（仅 Windows，需先安装 Sandboxie-Plus）。

description.en: Adds dangerous-operation policy checks, output redaction, and a security-review workflow.
description.zh: 增加危险操作策略检查、输出脱敏和安全审查工作流。

description.en: Windows workspace pre-authorization: adds an explicit full-control DACL ACE (including WRITE_OWNER, required by dsh >=0.1.7 sandbox startup) to user-declared workspace directories, removing the repeated full-access escalation prompt. Grants only on explicit intent — new workspace records or paths added in the plugin settings page; system directories are hard-blocked. Windows only.
description.zh: Windows 工作区预授权：为用户显式声明的工作区目录补一条完全控制的 DACL 授权项（含 dsh ≥0.1.7 沙箱启动所需的 WRITE_OWNER），消除反复出现的完全访问升权弹框。仅在新增工作区记录或插件设置页手动添加路径时授权，系统目录硬拒绝。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Re-validates Cloudflare Access JWTs at the DSH origin so Settings, Credentials, Agent Preset management, and model discovery work from a remote hostname.
description.zh: 在 DSH Origin 校验 Cloudflare Access JWT，使 Settings、凭据、Agent Preset 管理与模型发现可在远程主机名下使用。

description.en: File-change diff bar with keep/undo summary, plus dangerous-command approval and red highlighting for bash/pwsh.
description.zh: 文件修改 diff 栏与保留/撤销汇总，以及对 bash/pwsh 危险命令的审批与标红。

description.en: Adds an Explain button to the approval card: one model call returns exactly three lines reading the pending operation, covering what it does, which files or system state it reads, writes, modifies or executes, and a risky/attention/safe verdict with a one-sentence justification. It also renders the detail area for `write` and `edit` calls, which the shipped renderer leaves blank because it only reads a `command` field.
description.zh: 在审批卡片上加一个「解释」按钮：一次模型调用返回固定三行解读——做什么、读写改了什么、是否安全（风险等级加一句理由）。同时补上 `write`/`edit` 类调用详情区留白的问题——官方渲染器只读 `command` 字段，那两类调用没有该字段。

description.en: Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single hotspot detail, and coverage, duplication or caller-selected measures. Issue and hotspot results carry a normalized location with component key, file path, line and text range.
description.zh: 面向 SonarQube Community Build 的只读工具：实例状态、分支或 PR 的项目质量阈、议题与安全热点搜索、单个热点详情，以及覆盖率、重复率或调用方指定的度量项。议题与热点结果附带标准化的位置信息，包含组件 key、文件路径、行号与文本范围。

description.en: Pre-execute hook that denies writes under a read-only result zone of protected roots; every other path passes through.
description.zh: pre-execute 钩子：拒绝写入受保护根下只读的成果区，其余路径放行。

description.en: Read-only DSH plugin auditor with static scanning, current-session model review, and confirmation gates.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 插件审查器：静态扫描、当前会话模型审查和启用前确认。

description.en: Watches DSH and plugin releases, retests exact published artifacts in disposable runners, publishes machine-readable compatibility evidence, and reconciles managed issues after fixes.
description.zh: 持续监控 DSH 与插件发布，在一次性隔离环境中复测精确发布物，发布机器可读的兼容性证据，并在修复后自动核对和关闭受管理的问题。

description.en: Recoverable file and Git operations for coding agents, with shared recovery and redaction tools, a DSH shell adapter and audit records; optional native text-read protection is off by default.
description.zh: 为编码 Agent 提供可恢复的文件和 Git 操作、共享恢复与脱敏工具及 DSH Shell 适配器；保留审计记录，可选原生文本读取保护默认关闭。

description.en: Risk-gated approval automation for DeepSeek Harness: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe). File-diff review with one-click revert and session-scoped snapshots (v0.5.1: precise snapshots via tool-call parameter tracing, incl. human-approval cases).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全操作自动批准、危险操作转人工（fail-safe）。另含文件改动对比（unified diff）与一键撤销、按会话隔离的快照管理（v0.5.1：通过工具调用参数回溯精确保存快照，覆盖人工审批场景）。

description.en: File-defined command hooks across the session, prompt, tool, permission, Stop and PostCompact seams, with an approval-only GUI: no unapproved command runs, and approval binds the exact definition, canonical working directory and pinned watchFiles. Commands run as the DSH OS user without a hook sandbox, so the trust ledger is explicit.
description.zh: 文件声明的命令钩子，覆盖会话、提问、工具、审批、Stop 与压缩后等事件，配套只读审批界面：未经批准的命令不执行，批准绑定精确定义、实际执行目录与 watchFiles 固定内容。命令以 DSH 系统用户身份运行且无独立沙箱，因此信任记录是显式的。

description.en: An independent approval subagent judges every sandbox escalation, with a configurable model and an audit log.
description.zh: 由独立审批子代理裁决每次沙箱提权，可配置审批模型并带审计记录。

description.en: A secret store for DSH Desktop that keeps API keys in one place and injects them into the assistant's shell as $DSH_* variables.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供密钥库，集中保管 API 密钥并以 $DSH_* 变量注入助手的 shell 中。

description.en: Fine-grained permission gateway: per-category tool-call review (outside-workspace directories, commands, file read/write, subagents, repeated actions) with global & per-project allow/deny exceptions, quick-tool defaults, custom rules, a bilingual approval modal with inline diff details, custom rejection reasons and a sandbox-upgrade flow.
description.zh: 细粒度权限网关：按分类（工作区外目录/命令/读写文件/子代理/重复操作）逐项审查工具调用，全局/项目双级白黑名单、快捷工具默认值、自定义规则，中英文审批弹窗（内联 diff 详情、自定义拒绝意见）与底层沙箱升级流程。

description.en: Host-plane sovereignty clause and content guard: appends user-held adjudication to the system prompt tail, redacts credentials and hidden carriers in tool results, and vetoes irreversible actions before they run. Applies to every agent preset.
description.zh: 宿主面主权条款与内容守卫：在系统提示词末节注入「用户裁定」条款，清洗工具结果里的凭据与隐蔽载体，按可逆性前置拦截不可逆操作。对全部 agent preset 生效。

description.en: Three-tier deny/ask/auto gate for the computer-use (cua-driver) tool family: each tool category gets one segmented control in Settings, and an allow list or deny list overrides the tiers per tool name.
description.zh: 给 computer-use（cua-driver）工具族加三档「禁止 / 询问 / 自动授权」闸门：每个工具类别在设置里各占一个分段控件，另可用放行名单或拒绝名单按工具名覆盖档位。

description.en: Adds an Auto permission preset between Workspace Write and Full access: routine work stays in the official workspace-write sandbox while the current session model reviews escalation and destructive calls, granting one exact wider access once, asking when the intent is ambiguous, and denying critical paths.
description.zh: 在 Workspace Write 与 Full access 之间增加 Auto 权限档：日常操作留在官方 workspace-write 沙箱内，由当前会话模型复核升权与破坏性调用，精确的越界访问按次放行一次，意图不明时询问，命中关键路径则拒绝。

description.en: Tools guard that moves agent-issued `rm` targets to the macOS Trash instead of deleting, with a shell-aware lexer covering compound and disguised commands; a switch in Settings → General turns it off.
description.zh: 工具守卫将 agent 执行的 rm 目标移入 macOS 废纸篓而非直接删除，shell 感知词法器覆盖复合与伪装命令；设置页通用设置中可随时关闭。

description.en: Pure JavaScript macOS Keychain credentials provider for DeepSeek Harness, replacing plaintext .credentials.yaml storage and fully supporting both refs and records without native builds, signing, or Xcode.
description.zh: 纯 JavaScript 实现的 macOS Keychain 凭据提供器，替换 DeepSeek Harness 的明文 .credentials.yaml 存储，完整支持 refs 和 records，无需原生构建、代码签名或 Xcode。

description.en: Adds an approval-mode toggle next to the permission selector: default approval keeps per-call confirmation, bypass approval auto-approves every tool call while staying in Workspace Write.
description.zh: 在权限下拉框旁增加「审批模式」开关：默认审批保留逐次确认，绕过审批自动放行所有工具调用，同时保持 Workspace Write 权限。

description.en: Local security audit: config, plugin origins, sessions, network exposure — read-only redacted risk report.
description.zh: 本机安全审计：配置/插件来源/会话/网络暴露面，只读脱敏风险报告。

description.en: Support for the microsandbox backend.
description.zh: microsandbox 沙箱支持。

description.en: Microsoft cross-platform sandbox support.
description.zh: 微软跨平台沙盒支持。

description.en: Support for the nono sandbox backend.
description.zh: nono 沙盒支持。

plugins.name: dsh-riskproof

description.en: Live security beacon for DSH that follows tool activity. Click to view call statistics, risk provenance chains and blocked actions, with read-only task restrictions and tool metadata change detection.
description.zh: DSH 实时安全浮标，随工具调用更新防护状态，点击查看调用统计、风险来源链和拦截结果，支持只读任务约束及工具元数据变化检测。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 100.100.100.200 for network access

description.en: Encrypted local credentials vault for the Harness: a web settings page and vault_* tools to store, search and copy passwords, API keys, TOTP secrets and card data, with health audits, expiry rotation, imports/exports and read-only/ask access modes.
description.zh: Harness 的本地加密凭据保险库：Web 设置页与 vault_* 工具，可存取与复制密码、API 密钥、TOTP 与银行卡信息，支持健康审计、到期轮换、导入导出以及只读/询问访问模式。

description.en: Autonomous permission classifier for the auto preset: tool-scoped allow/deny rules, an LLM semantic judge, and git checkpointing for unattended sessions.
description.zh: auto（自主模式）权限分类器：工具作用域的放行/拒绝规则、LLM 语义裁判与 git 快照，面向无人值守会话。

description.en: Plugin value auditor: pre-install review (source scan + LLM judge) and post-install audit of installed bundles, with model-switch re-audit reminders.
description.zh: 插件价值裁判：装前审核（源码静态扫描 + LLM 裁判）与装后审计已装插件，模型切换时弹窗提醒复核；判断插件对当前模型是增强还是压制。

description.en: Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and a local configuration audit with redacted, reproducible reports.
description.zh: DSH 只读安全合规插件：提示注入检测、中文 PII 脱敏、本机配置安全审计，输出脱敏且可复现的报告。

description.en: Second-model auto-review on the approval answerer chain: a read-only reviewer subagent returns structured allow/deny verdicts with reasons, fail-closed by default.
description.zh: 审批链上的第二模型自动审查：只读审查子代理返回带理由的 allow/deny 结构化裁决，默认 fail-closed。

description.en: Detects prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak patterns on the agent/pre-step, tools/pre-execute, and tools/post-execute seams with allow/ask/block tiers, sanitized defend/detection audit events, a defend_report tool, and a destructive-delete command guard.
description.zh: 在 agent/pre-step、tools/pre-execute、tools/post-execute 三个接缝检测提示词注入、越狱与密钥泄露，按 allow/ask/block 分层拦截，附脱敏 defend/detection 审计事件、defend_report 工具与危险删除命令门禁。

description.en: PII masking for DeepSeek Harness — anonymizes names, phones, emails, ids, and keys before requests and restores them at the display layer, keeping plaintext out of session logs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 PII 脱敏：请求前匿名化姓名、电话、邮箱、证件与密钥，展示层还原，明文不进入会话日志。

description.en: Claude Code-style declarative permission rules: ordered allow/deny/ask YAML rules matching tool names, arguments, workspace paths, and agent identity on the tools/pre-execute waterfall, with full session-log audit, dry-run mode, and hot reload.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格的声明式权限规则：按序 allow/deny/ask 的 YAML 规则，在 tools/pre-execute 瀑布上匹配工具名、参数、工作区路径与 agent 身份，带完整会话日志审计、干跑模式与热重载。

description.en: Security-audit methodology skill pack plus the plugin_vet supply-chain gate: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vuln intel, incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an npm provider bundle that mounts the skills and registers the automated plugin_vet pre-install scanner.
description.zh: 安全审计方法论技能包 + plugin_vet 供应链门禁：八个 agent 技能（密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链评审、提示注入审查、审计总编排、威胁建模、漏洞情报、事件响应），中英双版本，附 npm provider 包一键挂载并注册自动化 plugin_vet 安装前扫描。

description.en: Pre-claim gate: a commit, push or tag claim like "tests pass" is checked against the session evidence ledger before it is written.
description.zh: 提交前声明门：把“测试通过”等 commit/push/tag 声明与本次会话的真实执行证据核对后再写入。

description.en: Local decision-layer plugin for DSH: a fail-closed command approval gate and ask/gate tools backed by a 144.3M on-device model. Needs a separate local decision service: `pip install phocinae-server`, then download the ~330 MB weights and keep the service running; without it the tool returns `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
description.zh: DSH 本地决策层插件：失败关闭的命令审批门，以及由 144.3M 端侧模型支撑的 ask/gate 工具。需另装本地决策服务：`pip install phocinae-server` 后下载约 330MB 权重并常驻运行；服务不在时工具会返回 `PHOCINAE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`。

description.en: Arms an explicit per-session scope contract from a `$stop-that-shit` directive and audits every tool call against it; unarmed it is inert. A DSH bundle wrapping lennney/stop-that-shit (MIT). Do not install it alongside the upstream lennney/stop-that-shit DSH bundle.
description.zh: 用 `$stop-that-shit` 指令显式开启每会话范围契约并逐个工具调用审计；未开启时不干预。基于 lennney/stop-that-shit（MIT）的 DSH 封装。不要与上游 lennney/stop-that-shit 的 DSH bundle 同时安装。

description.en: Global prompt-injection / context-virus defense for DeepSeek Harness: scans tool arguments, tool results, pre-model messages and the outbound stream; quarantine/block/monitor modes, canary trap, and an evolvable on-disk signature library with learn/import/export.
description.zh: 全局提示注入 / 上下文病毒防御：扫描工具参数、工具结果、进模型前消息与出站流；隔离/阻断/监控三模式、金丝雀陷阱、可演进磁盘签名库（学习/导入/导出）。

description.en: Runtime security guard for DSH: loader import confinement, HTTP Host header validation, and source patch for VM sandbox escapes (4 CVEs). AI-assisted.
description.zh: DSH 运行时安全守卫：配置加载导入约束、HTTP Host 头校验、附带 VM 沙箱逃逸源码补丁（4 个 CVE）。AI 辅助制作。

description.en: Registers one agent tool, plugin_guard, that statically scans a DSH plugin package before it is installed and reports a verdict with the reasons: a missing or broken dsh.bundle.patch, a missing dsh.permissions block, install scripts, dangerous APIs and obfuscation, dependency risk, and source that is not indexed and therefore cannot be verified. Read-only: the scanned code is never imported, installed, evaluated or run.
description.zh: 注册一个 agent 工具 plugin_guard，在安装前对 DSH 插件包做静态扫描，给出判定与原因：缺少或损坏的 dsh.bundle.patch、未声明 dsh.permissions、安装脚本、危险 API 与代码混淆、依赖风险，以及未索引、无法核验的源码。只读：不导入、不安装、不求值、不运行被扫描的代码。

description.en: Live CVE/supply-chain audit for your workspace's own project dependencies (npm/pip/go), backed by OSV.dev, with a `cve_audit` tool plus optional automatic re-scan on lockfile changes.
description.zh: 面向你自己项目依赖（npm/pip/go）的实时 CVE/供应链审计，基于 OSV.dev，提供 `cve_audit` 工具，并支持在 lockfile 变化时自动重新扫描。

description.en: Taints the agent when tool results carry untrusted content, gates the privileged calls that follow, and refuses credentials passed to network-capable tools in every mode.
description.zh: 当工具结果包含不可信内容时将代理标记为已污染，对随后的高权限调用进行拦截，并在所有模式下拒绝将凭据传递给可联网的工具。

description.en: Authorized-security DSH collection: nine work modes (redteam coordinator, pentest, code audit, binary analysis, attack-defense, AV evasion, incident response, cloud security, CTF solving) and fifteen runtime plugins, managed from a settings page with one-click deploy, install, update and uninstall.
description.zh: 面向授权安全研究的 DSH 合集：九个工作模式（redteam 总控、渗透测试、代码审计、二进制分析、攻防评估、免杀对抗、应急溯源、云安全攻防、CTF 解题）与十五个运行时插件，设置页管理台支持一键部署、安装、更新与卸载。

description.en: Hardening guard for mcp__omni__parse in DeepSeek Harness: a tools/pre-execute listener that denies private/reserved host URLs (SSRF), enforces an allow-list or ask (consent), and is fail-closed when allowedRoots is empty.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 mcp__omni__parse 加固护栏：tools/pre-execute 监听器拒绝私网/保留主机（SSRF），施加白名单或 ask（同意），allowedRoots 为空时 fail-closed。

description.en: LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
description.zh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

description.en: Directed fuzzing driven by an LLM agent: from a target repository and a bug (CVE description, patch, crash trace, or file:line), it runs a PLAN, IMPLEMENT, EXECUTE, REFLECT loop in which the model writes Python input generators, until an input triggers the campaign's stderr-pattern oracle or the campaign stops.
description.zh: 由 LLM 智能体驱动的定向模糊测试：给定目标仓库和一个缺陷（CVE 描述、补丁、崩溃调用栈或 file:line），它运行 PLAN、IMPLEMENT、EXECUTE、REFLECT 循环，由模型编写 Python 输入生成器，直到某个输入触发该 campaign 基于 stderr 模式匹配的 oracle，或 campaign 停止。

description.en: English edition of Weiwen's Law (KISS's Law): the first and only domain-agnostic white-box causal adjudication middleware for AI agents. Unlike domain-specific causal-inference tooling (statistics/economics/ML) or evidence-gated agent firewalls, it adjudicates *every* tool call along a deterministic structural causal chain (R->S->D->H->M) before execution - across any domain, with no training or per-domain tuning. It blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost.
description.zh: 唯稳律（KISS's Law）英文版：业界首个且唯一的领域无关白箱因果裁决中间件。与领域特定的因果推断工具（统计/经济/机器学习）或「需提供因果证据」的代理防火墙不同，它在执行前对*每个*工具调用沿确定性结构因果链（R->S->D->H->M）裁决——适用任意领域，无需训练或按领域调参。拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本。

description.en: White-box causal guardrail for dsh: every tool call is adjudicated before execution along a deterministic causal logic chain — blocks destructive and credential-file operations, escalates repeated boundary violations, cuts faulting links until verified-fixed, and gives risk verdicts on un-auditable execution; runs fully local with zero API cost, plus 6 white-box self-check tools.
description.zh: 唯稳律白箱因果闸门：每个工具调用执行前沿确定性因果逻辑链裁决——拦截破坏性与凭据文件操作、对反复越界升级止损、故障环节切断至修复验证、不可审计执行给出风险判定；纯本地运行、零 API 成本，附带 6 个白箱自查工具。

description.en: Security scanner for DSH plugins: static and semantic passes over plugin source, DSH-specific attack-surface rules, npm audit, batch scanning, and an HTML report with per-finding severity and evidence.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全扫描器：对插件源码做静态与语义双通道检查，内置 DSH 特有攻击面规则，集成 npm audit，支持批量扫描，输出带严重等级与证据的 HTML 报告。

description.en: Audits DeepSeek Harness plugins: a read-only pre-install check that grades a package S–D before it is installed, plus a runtime monitor that records plugin start/stop, sensitive tool calls and per-plugin token estimates in a settings panel.
description.zh: 审计 DeepSeek Harness 插件：安装前只读扫描并按 S–D 分级；装好后记录插件启停、敏感工具调用与每个插件的 token 估算，全部收在一个设置面板里。

description.en: Run a read-only security assessment of a Dameng DM8 database with 60 checks and produce an HTML report with GB/T 22239-2019 control mapping. Needs Java 8+ and a DmJdbcDriver jar you provide yourself.
description.zh: 只读安全评估达梦 DM8 数据库：60 项检查，附等保 2.0 控制点对照，生成 HTML 报告。需 Java 8+ 并自备达梦 DmJdbcDriver jar。

description.en: Zero-interruption audit and fuse blocking for DeepSeek Harness: silently records every tool call with deterministic risk scoring, cumulative-risk bonuses, risk-level breakdowns and retention-based cleanup; blocks irreversible catastrophes (protected-path deletion, disk wipe, force-push to protected branches/refs, credential exfiltration), and renders a redacted /risk-guard operation bill with --since filtering.
description.zh: 零打扰审计与保险丝拦截：静默记录每次工具调用并做纯规则风险评分（含累积加分、风险等级分布、归档保留期清理），只拦不可逆灾难（受保护路径删除、磁盘擦除、force push 到受保护分支/引用、凭据外发），/risk-guard 输出脱敏操作账单并支持 --since 时间过滤。

description.en: Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the Web UI, using a fresh restricted Reviewer Agent to allow or deny each approval request.
description.zh: 为 WebUI 增加 Auto Approve 权限档位，由全新且受限的审查 Agent 逐次允许或拒绝审批请求。

description.en: Fine grained per tool permission rules for DSH at the tools/pre-execute gate, deny and ask lists in Claude Code rule syntax (`Bash(rm -rf:*), Read(_secrets_), mcp__server__tool`), works standalone without migrating.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补上按工具粒度的权限规则：在 tools/pre-execute 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，不迁移也能单独用。

description.en: Security-audit facts AI coding agents cannot compute, plus a verdict gate: euthyna history attributes deleted lines to commits and flags those from security fixes (--origins finds the first introducer), euthyna coverage reports which changed symbols no test ever invoked, and euthyna gate checks each finding against six gates, downgrading any without evidence to an observation.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的确定性安全审计事实与结论门禁：euthyna history 把每行被删代码归因到提交并标记安全修复类删除（--origins 追到最初引入者），euthyna coverage 报告哪些改动符号从未被测试调用，euthyna gate 用六道门禁逐条校验结论，拿不出证据的一律降级为观察。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 变成服务器级多租户平台：远程访问 + 自动 HTTPS、子用户权限与配额、沙盒强制、加密认证与审计日志。

description.en: TOTP-only access control for personal DeepSeek Harness Web instances, with in-app QR enrollment, single-use recovery codes, live protection controls and lock-all revocation of page access.
description.zh: 面向个人 DeepSeek Harness Web 实例的纯 TOTP 访问验证，支持设置内扫码绑定、一次性恢复码、动态启停保护和撤销所有页面授权。

description.en: Deterministic code security review: 40+ rules, secret entropy detection, staged-diff review, SARIF export, baseline acceptance, SBOM-lite dependency inventory and health self-check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 确定性代码安全审查：40+ 规则、密钥熵检测、staged diff 审查、SARIF 导出、基线接受、SBOM-lite 依赖清单与健康自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Counts persistent operations within a turn and escalates on the total: a reminder first, then an explicit stop instruction, then an approval prompt. Reads the session sandbox mode on every call, and stays silent under read-only and workspace-write.
description.zh: 按轮统计持久化操作，按总数逐级升级：先提醒，再给明确的停止指令，最后请求确认。每次调用都现读会话的沙箱模式，在 read-only 与 workspace-write 下保持沉默。

description.en: Keeps the Auto permission preset across DSH restarts: the auto-review unload migration no longer rewrites a live Auto Session to Full access during application shutdown, and a stored Auto Session no longer fails to open when its integration is absent.
description.zh: 让「自动审批」熬过重启：应用退出时，自动审查的卸载迁移不再把在用的自动审批会话改写成「完全权限」；集成缺席时，存留的自动审批会话也不会打不开。

description.en: A continuation of simon300000/dsh-auto: the Auto Approve permission preset for the DSH Web UI reviews each approval with one single-shot model call instead of a reviewer subagent, auto-approves only the actions that pass and hands the rest to human approval, and remembers confirmed decisions as project- and global-scope allow/deny lists, with an approval timeline in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 延续 simon300000/dsh-auto 的 DSH WebUI 自动审批权限档位：每次审批只走一次单轮模型审查、不再起审查子代理，只自动放行审查通过的动作、其余全部转回人工审批；并会把用户确认过的决定记成项目级与全局级的允许/拒绝名单，右侧栏另有审批时间线。

description.en: Transport-level authentication gate for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with server-side sessions, HttpOnly cookies, IP-based login throttling, and an scrypt password CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的传输层认证门禁，提供服务端会话、HttpOnly Cookie、基于 IP 的登录限流及 scrypt 口令 CLI。

description.en: Container-isolated backend for the `ctx.codeRuntime` seam: each Code Mode program runs in a fresh container with no network, a read-only rootfs, dropped capabilities, and kernel-enforced memory, CPU and pid ceilings.
description.zh: `ctx.codeRuntime` seam 的容器隔离后端：每个 Code Mode 程序跑在全新容器里，无网络、根文件系统只读、丢弃全部 capability，内存/CPU/进程数上限由内核强制。

description.en: HashiCorp Vault backend for the credential seam: KV v2/v1, AppRole machine auth, per-operation reads so rotation needs no restart, and compare-and-swap writes.
description.zh: 凭证 seam 的 HashiCorp Vault 后端：支持 KV v2/v1、AppRole 机器认证、逐次操作读取（轮换无需重启）与 compare-and-swap 写入。

description.en: Runtime security gate on the tool pipeline: denies calls naming hosts outside an egress allowlist, redacts credentials from results at the canonical value rather than only the rendered content, and appends every decision to a JSONL audit log; ships in monitor-only mode.
description.zh: 工具管线上的运行时安全网关：拦截出站白名单之外的主机调用，在 canonical value（而非仅渲染内容）层面脱敏结果中的凭据，每个决策写入 JSONL 审计日志；默认仅监控不拦截。

description.en: Static-only plugin gate and clinic for DSH: audit before install, hash-and-capability lock after install, local fingerprint peer search over GitHub topic:dsh-plugin, and mechanical detox. Never executes the target plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件的静态安全闸门与诊所：安装前静态审计、安装后哈希与能力锁定、本机指纹库与 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题的同类搜索、机械式剥离清理；永不执行目标插件。

plugins.name: dsh-auth-gate

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web surface: password or shared-token authentication, session cookies, rate limiting, and a user-management CLI (dsh.bundle manifest since 0.4.1, one-command `dsh plugin add` mounting).
description.zh: DSH 网页端登录门插件：账号口令或共享令牌认证、会话 cookie、登录限速，附用户管理 CLI（0.4.1 起声明 dsh.bundle manifest，`dsh plugin add` 一键挂载）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Apply configurable allow, deny, and approval rules to dsh tool calls, including shell command patterns.
description.zh: 根据可配置的允许、拒绝和审批规则控制 dsh 工具调用，包括对 shell 命令的匹配。

description.en: Runs local security audits of AI API relays and LLM proxies from DeepSeek Harness, producing Markdown reports for prompt injection, model substitution signals, tool-call rewriting, error leakage, stream integrity, and profile-gated Web3 risks.
description.zh: 从 DeepSeek Harness 对 AI API 中转站和 LLM 代理运行本地安全审计，生成 Markdown 报告，覆盖提示词注入、模型替换信号、工具调用改写、错误泄漏、流完整性和按 profile 启用的 Web3 风险。

description.en: Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
description.zh: DSH 本機工具調用防護外掛：攔截高風險 Shell 指令模式與敏感憑證讀取，具備持久化哈希鏈 JSONL 審計記錄，可選配外部 Gateway 集中治理。

description.en: Vets third-party plugins before you trust them: static scan for malicious patterns (exfiltration, credential access, obfuscation, persistence) and over-privileged path use, transitive-dependency coverage, official-package hash baseline for supply-chain tamper detection, and an optional plugin-tool call gate.
description.zh: 为了您的电脑安全，装插件前先体检：静态扫描恶意模式（外传/凭据/混淆/持久化）与高权限误用，覆盖传递依赖与官方包哈希基线（防供应链篡改），可选插件工具调用闸。

description.en: Blocks API keys pasted into the composer or written by tools, logs leak events, and scans the workspace for exposed secrets.
description.zh: 拦截粘贴进输入框或被工具写入的 API 密钥，记录泄露事件，并扫描工作区中暴露的密钥。

description.en: Store account credentials in an encrypted browser-local vault.
description.zh: 在浏览器本地加密保存账号凭据。

description.en: Audits every plugin HTTP route in a profile for a browser-trust fence: plugin routes win the web server's longest-prefix match ahead of the /api gateway, so they never see its trust check and must pin the Host to loopback themselves. Grades PASS/WARN/FAIL per route and fails a fence that compares Origin to Host without pinning it (bypassable by DNS rebinding). Ships as a CLI for CI and a route_fence_scan tool.
description.zh: 审计 profile 内所有插件 HTTP 路由的浏览器信任围栏：插件路由在 Web 服务器的最长前缀匹配中优先，因此缺少围栏的路由会被静默暴露；逐条给出文件与行号级别的证据。

plugins.name: dsh-jumpserver

description.en: Query and manage JumpServer through conversation: assets, users, accounts, permissions, sessions, command audit logs, command filters, and RBAC roles, authenticated with an AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret pair (HTTP Signature).
description.zh: 通过对话查询与管理 JumpServer：资产、用户、账号、授权、会话、命令审计、命令过滤与 RBAC 角色，使用 AccessKeyID/AccessKeySecret（HTTP 签名）鉴权。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Login gate for the dsh web UI: unauthenticated visitors get a login/register page and the first registrant becomes admin; includes user and role management plus login and access audit logs.
description.zh: 用户管理：给 dsh web 加登录门禁，未登录访问弹登录/注册页，首个注册者自动成为管理员；管理员可管理用户/角色，带登录与访问审计。

description.en: DSH plugin security guard: 28-rule static scanner, risk scoring, whitelist/blacklist policy, local web dashboard and in-DSH risk popups.
description.zh: DSH 插件安全卫士：28 条规则静态扫描、风险评分、白名单/黑名单、本地 Web 仪表盘与 DSH 内风险弹窗。

plugins.name: dsh-medical-anonymizer

description.en: Batch pseudonymization for medical text, CSV, JSON, and XLSX in DeepSeek Harness. Deterministic identifier rules run first; an optional OpenAI-compatible model pass adds discovery and verification. Exact-span replacement preserves file structure, tokens stay stable per value, and each batch produces an audit report plus a re-identification vault. DICOM images get header-only de-identification based on PS3.15 Annex E, with pixel data left byte-identical.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中批量匿名化病历文本、CSV、JSON 与 XLSX：先跑确定性标识符规则，可选 OpenAI 兼容模型做发现与复核；按精确区间替换以保持文件结构，同一值保持同一假名，并输出审计报告与映射库。DICOM 影像按 PS3.15 附录 E 只处理头部元数据，像素数据逐字节保留。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Sanitizes fetched pages before the model reads them: strips hidden text, offsite images and inline data, wraps the rest in canary-tagged untrusted delimiters, and flags prompt injection.
description.zh: 在内容进入模型之前净化抓取的网页：剥离隐藏文本、站外图片与内联数据，其余内容用带金丝雀的不可信分隔符包裹，并标记提示注入。

description.en: Security plugin that intercepts file deletion and write commands, requiring user token authorization.
description.zh: 文件守卫：拦截危险的文件删除/写入命令，需用户提供 token 才放行。

description.en: Plugin trust pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic static scan with verdicts, opt-in runtime guard with honeypot lures, agent audit-protocol skill, and a browser shield status light. Alarm-only, never an enforcer.
description.zh: DSH 插件信任流水线：确定性静态扫描判定、可选运行时守卫与蜜罐诱饵、agent 审查协议技能与浏览器盾牌状态灯，只报警不执法。

description.en: Reverse-engineering workbench: bridges a local IDA Pro into DeepSeek Harness through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, exposing the ida-pro-mcp toolset (decompile, xref, rename, comment) as mcp__ida__* tools. Auto-selects idalib headless mode (analyses a binary in-process, no IDA GUI) or GUI mode (connects to the IDA plugin RPC on port 13337). Adds re_check, re_open and re_status; the bundled MCP server is a zero-dependency stdio proxy usable from any MCP client.
description.zh: 逆向分析工作台：通过 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 把本机 IDA Pro 桥接进 DSH，将 ida-pro-mcp 工具集（反编译、xref、重命名、注释）以 mcp__ida__* 注册给模型。自动选择 idalib 无头模式（进程内分析二进制，无需打开 IDA GUI）或 GUI 模式（连接 IDA 插件 RPC，默认 13337 端口）。附带 re_check、re_open、re_status 三个工具；内置 MCP server 为零依赖 stdio 代理，任意 MCP 客户端可直接挂载。

description.en: Security-focused Feishu (Lark) channel for DeepSeek Harness: allowlisted remote-agent access with workspace-scoped paths, symlink checks, risk-based approvals, session isolation, redacted logs, and bounded message queues.
description.zh: 面向安全的 DeepSeek Harness 飞书通道：提供白名单远程 Agent 访问、工作区路径与符号链接边界校验、风险分级审批、会话隔离、日志脱敏和有界消息队列。

description.en: Safety guard that makes self-killing commands impossible: a safe_kill tool that always excludes the caller and every ancestor process, a bash pre-execute check for pkill self-matches, sudo -S stdin grabs, rm -rf / and similar patterns, and an extensible rule library with block / warn / hint severities.
description.zh: 防呆插件：safe_kill 工具（自动排除自身与全部祖先进程链），bash 命令预检（pkill 自匹配、sudo -S 抢 stdin、rm -rf / 等），以及可扩展规则库（block / warn / hint 三档）。

description.en: Approval-free writes into whitelisted directories — wraps the filesystem fence for write/edit tools and auto-answers bash sandbox escalations that touch whitelisted paths, with a settings GUI.
description.zh: 白名单目录写入免审批——write/edit 文件工具直通白名单栅栏，命中白名单的 bash 沙箱升权自动放行，设置页可视化管理目录与开关。

description.en: A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。

plugins.name: dsh-auth-gateway

description.en: Password + TOTP two-factor authentication gateway for the dsh web UI: every HTTP request and WebSocket upgrade is refused until login, with per-source lockout, global rate limits and one-time backup codes.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供密码与 TOTP 双因素认证网关：登录前拦截全部 HTTP/WebSocket 请求，含按来源锁定、全局限流与一次性备份代码。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Redacts secrets, cookies and personal data in every model request at the host process undici dispatcher and restores the placeholders in the reply, so one interception covers every provider, adapters that plugins add included; per-kind actions mask / warn / block, an optional same-shape fake key, records written to disk by the day and a statistics card.
description.zh: 在宿主进程的 undici dispatcher 上拦截所有发往模型的请求：密钥、Cookie 与个人信息换成占位符，回复里再还原，一处拦截覆盖所有 provider（含插件自带的 adapter）；按 kind 可选 mask / warn / block、可换成同形的假 key，记录按天落盘并带统计卡。

description.en: Session password lock plus an encrypted directory vault for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的会话加密码锁，并把目录整体加密成保险箱。

plugins.name: dsh-remote

description.en: Secure remote access for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a login gate, MFA/TOTP, signed session cookies, optional admin/user/guest roles, in-browser workspace selection, and allowlisted remote file previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供安全远程访问：登录门禁、MFA/TOTP、签名会话 Cookie、可选的 admin/user/guest 角色、浏览器内工作区选择和按允许目录限制的远程文件预览。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Policy-layer guard that checks tool calls before they run: a read whitelist, a sensitive-path deny list (credentials, browser profiles, chat history, other users' home directories), dangerous-command blocking, subagent isolation, and a static scan that quarantines executables. Every denial is appended to an audit log. It is a text-and-path filter, not a sandbox or antivirus: dynamically built paths, encoded payloads and packed binaries can get past it, and it does not replace the OS antivirus.
description.zh: 在工具调用真正执行之前做判定的策略层护栏：读取白名单、敏感路径拒绝（凭据、浏览器配置、聊天记录、其他用户目录）、危险命令拦截、子代理隔离，以及对可执行文件的静态扫描与隔离区。每次拒绝都写进审计日志。它是文本与路径过滤，不是沙箱也不是杀软：动态拼接的路径、编码载荷、加壳程序都可能绕过，也不能替代系统自带防护。

description.en: Watches a turn's thinking and output streams and cancels the turn when the model starts repeating itself. Four detectors: a verbatim cycle, a counting loop whose lines differ only by a number, repeated lines separated by other text, and a user-supplied phrase list. A catch raises a manual-dismiss alarm card in the global overlay with an optional tone, and a Monitor tab holds the switches, thresholds and hit history. Detection is local string comparison with no model calls, so it costs no tokens.
description.zh: 同时监视一轮对话的思考流与正文流，模型开始复读时中断该轮。四条检测规则：逐字周期重复、每行只换数字的计数循环、被其他文字隔开的重复行，以及用户自填的短语清单。命中后在全球浮层弹出必须手动关闭的报警卡（可带提示音），「监控」标签页里有开关、阈值与命中历史。检测是本机字符串比对、不调用模型，零 token 开销。

description.en: A hard hat for AI coding: graded writes (L0 read-only / L1 workspace-only / L2 full) put privileged edits in a cage. Below the level it refuses to write and hands back a paste-ready block instead. Every path passes a raw-string traversal check plus realpath, so junction escapes are caught.
description.zh: 给 AI 编程戴上安全帽：L0 到 L2 分级拦截，把越权操作关进笼子——权限不够就不落盘，改给你一段可直接粘贴的替换稿；路径过两道闸，junction 逃逸也拦得住。

description.en: Encrypted local credential vault for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar record management, an info_records tool for pre-sign-in lookups, opt-in chat capture, per-record manual-only mode, and AES-256-GCM storage protected by Windows DPAPI, the macOS Keychain, or the Linux Secret Service.
description.zh: 本机加密的 DeepSeek Harness 账密库：侧边栏管理记录，智能体登录前按站点取用；对话收录默认关闭，逐条可设仅手动；AES-256-GCM 加密，密钥由 Windows DPAPI / macOS 钥匙串 / Linux Secret Service 保护。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness approval guardian: a reviewer model decides permission requests before they reach you, with a System One decision-API backend (TypeSafe Jev, SiliconFlow, self-hosted Laya), a configurable low-confidence policy and an allow-rule whitelist.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 审批守护者：权限请求先由审查模型裁决，支持 System One 决策 API 后端（TypeSafe Jev／硅基流动／自部署 Laya）、可配置的低置信度策略与免审白名单。

description.en: One-time Full access switch for DeepSeek Harness: new sessions (workspaces and conversations) start with danger-full-access and skip the per-session Full access confirmation; installable as a dsh bundle or via patch scripts.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加 Full access 一次性开关：新工作区与新对话默认 danger-full-access 并跳过逐个确认；可作为 dsh bundle 安装，也可用脚本打补丁。

description.en: Sends file deletions to the Windows Recycle Bin, lists and restores them by id, and blocks permanent shell deletes.
description.zh: 把删除的文件送进 Windows 回收站，可按 id 列出与还原，并拦截 shell 通道的永久删除。

description.en: Blocks an agent from reading, searching, writing, or editing chosen files and directories, keeping their contents out of the conversation — including sensitive-word files whose text can make later provider requests fail with a 400. Rules are picked from a file/directory browser on the plugin page.
description.zh: 屏蔽 agent 对指定文件或目录的读取、搜索、写入与编辑，使其内容不进入对话——含敏感词的文件也在其中，避免它们的文字让之后的 provider 请求以 400 失败。规则在插件页面上点选。

description.en: Local tool guard that scores every DeepSeek Harness tool call with an Ollama decision model before it runs; risky calls come back as an approval prompt, and an unreachable model stops all calls. Requires DSH 0.2.x and a local Ollama 0.35.1+ with the default ~6 GB clef-flash model pulled first; without them every tool call is denied.
description.zh: 每次工具调用前由本机 Ollama 决策模型判定：可疑调用升级为确认提示，模型不可达时停止所有调用。需 DSH 0.2.x，并先装好本机 Ollama 0.35.1+、拉取默认约 6 GB 的 clef-flash 模型；否则所有工具调用都会被拒绝。

description.en: Text hygiene as a dsh plugin: sanitize untrusted text, scan invisible characters, clean LLM formatting, and escape CSV formula injection.
description.zh: 文本卫生 dsh 插件：净化不可信文本、扫描隐形字符、清洗 LLM 格式、转义 CSV 公式注入。

description.en: Code security defense review judge for DeepSeek Harness: detects sessions that are writing code, reviews them against the Code Security Defense Architecture Rules, recommends which security architectures the program needs (one or several), checks conflicts between them, teaches the session AI after repeated failures, and teaches the session AI after repeated failures; once you grant it review authority in its panel, it gates task completion until the review passes (without that authorization it only observes).
description.zh: 代码安全防御规则评审判官：自动识别正在做代码的会话，按《代码安全防御架构规则》强制评审其安全防御措施与所采用的代码安全防御架构，推荐程序需要的架构（一种或多种）并检查架构之间是否冲突；连续不合格会进入教学模式要求重做；在面板授予评审权限后，未通过评审的代码任务不能算完成（未授权时只读观察）。

description.en: System guard for DeepSeek Harness (Windows-first, protected actions via UAC/sudo): classifies core system files and runtime junk, keeps a hidden SHA-256 backup of core files on the largest free disk, patrols integrity and restores damaged files, and asks for administrator rights only to protect the system. On macOS/Linux it only classifies and hashes (no junk deletion; repair prints manual steps), and that path has not been tested on real hardware.
description.zh: 系统守护（以 Windows 为主，保护类操作走 UAC/sudo）：分析并分类系统核心文件与运行时垃圾，把核心文件隐藏备份到剩余空间最大的硬盘、定期巡查完整性并从备份修复损坏文件；守护权限只用于保护系统。macOS/Linux 上只做分类与哈希（不删垃圾，修复仅给出人工步骤），且该路径未在真机验证。

description.en: Hands secrets and PII to the agent without them entering its context, with checksum-validated extraction and masked content classification.
description.zh: 把密钥和个人信息交给 agent，却不进入它的上下文；带校验位的字段抽取与掩码内容分类。

description.en: Reviews side-effecting tool calls against the project rules and the current goal before they run, and denies anything out of scope with a fail-closed verdict and no bypass switch.
description.zh: 在写文件、跑非只读命令、联网、派子代理等有副作用的动作执行前，按项目规则与当前目标复核，超出范围即拒绝（失败即拒，无可配置豁免开关）。

description.en: WebUI authentication enforced at the HTTP/transport layer: four-layer login gate (resources, plugin bundles, /api, WebSocket), server-side sessions with HttpOnly cookies.
description.zh: WebUI 身份认证：HTTP/传输层强制登录（资源、插件 bundle、/api、WebSocket 四层防护），服务端会话 + HttpOnly Cookie。

description.en: An independent permission gate above the built-in sandbox. It blocks writes outside the workspace and to protected paths even under danger-full-access, refuses whole-file overwrites without a complete fresh read, and keeps ZIP restore points plus Recycle Bin copies before destructive actions.
description.zh: 内置沙箱之上的独立权限闸门：在 danger-full-access 下依然拦截工作区外与受保护路径的写入，未完整读到文件末尾就整文件覆盖时拒绝，破坏性操作前生成 ZIP 还原点与回收站副本。

description.en: Mask secrets, local paths, private IPs, emails and phone numbers in session text before you share or commit it.
description.zh: 把会话或文档里的密钥、本机路径、内网 IP、邮箱和手机号打码，再分享或提交。

description.en: Adds a workspace-write++ permission that keeps file tools inside the workspace while skipping the Windows process sandbox for wildcard-allowlisted executables such as Git Bash.
description.zh: 增加工作区修改++权限档，文件工具仍锁在工作区，可用通配符放行 Git Bash 等程序以跳过 Windows 进程沙箱。

description.en: Detect and redact sensitive message text before sending it to models, with local regex, browser BERT, or ZeroClave API detection and manual review.
description.zh: 在消息发送给模型前检测和脱敏敏感文本，支持本地正则、浏览器 BERT 或 ZeroClave API 检测及人工审核。

description.en: Turns DSH permissions into 9 selectable presets (3 sandbox modes x 4 approval tiers), with rule plus LLM risk classification across four risk levels, password-gated approval for high-risk operations, and a JSONL audit log.
description.zh: 把 DSH 权限拆成 9 个可选预设（3 种沙箱 × 4 种审批），规则 + LLM 双通道四档风险分级，高风险操作需输入批准密码才放行，附 JSONL 审计日志。

description.en: Context firewall for DeepSeek Harness: credentials in successful plain-text tool results become opaque ⟦cloak:category:n⟧ placeholders before they reach the model, with originals kept only in a process-memory, agent-scoped vault. 36 built-in signature families (shared with the cloakpack git pre-push guard), key-name rules for unknown formats, custom regex rules, dry-run mode, an audit log, and the /cloak command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的上下文防火墙：成功的纯文本工具结果中的凭据在进入模型之前先变成不透明的 ⟦cloak:category:n⟧ 占位符，原值只保存在进程内存的 agent 级保险库中。36 类内置签名（与 cloakpack git pre-push 守卫共享同一引擎）、针对未知格式的键名规则、自定义正则、dry-run 模式、审计日志与 /cloak 命令。

description.en: Signed chain-of-custody for sessions: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record, with commits bound into the chain — tampering with any line or truncating the tail fails deterministic replay verification.
description.zh: 会话签名监护链：被监视的工具结果逐条追加哈希链 ed25519 签名记录，commit 绑定进链——篡改任意行或截断尾部都会在确定性重放校验中失败。

description.en: Compaction integrity: directive lines (never/must/必须 style markers) extracted from the compacted range are verified against the summary — verbatim or by content-word coverage — and every constraint the session silently forgot is reported and written to a JSONL ledger; pinned constraints from config are checked on every compaction.
