description.zh: 压缩监护：从被压缩范围提取指令行（never/must/必须 类标记），对照摘要做逐字或内容词覆盖存续校验；会话悄悄遗忘的约束会被响亮上报并写入 JSONL 台账；配置中的 pinned 约束每次压缩必验。

description.en: Deterministic network egress gate: web fetches and searches are checked against a destination allowlist in tools/pre-execute and denied before they run; shell fetch-verbs are observed (enforcement opt-in).
description.zh: 确定性网络出口门：网页抓取与搜索在 tools/pre-execute 按目的地白名单校验，越权即拒；shell 抓取动词默认观察，可选拦截。

description.en: Hermetic composition lock: fingerprints the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile and patch layer; booting a drifted composition warns, or fails under strict mode (the --frozen posture for CI).
description.zh: 密闭组合锁：对 profile 的依赖、组合顺序、锁文件与补丁层取指纹；组合漂移时启动告警，strict 模式直接失败（CI 的 --frozen 姿态）。

description.en: Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: baselines the full visible tool registry (name/description/parameters, MCP tools included) into a committable JSON file and warns loudly when an upgrade adds, removes or reshapes a tool.
description.zh: 工具面快照与漂移门：全量可见工具注册表（含 MCP 工具）基线化为可提交的 JSON，升级新增、移除或改动工具时响亮告警。

description.en: Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope write/edit calls before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, and every decision lands in a content-hashed JSONL ledger; can reuse the repo's agent-pr-gate.yaml so CI and session enforce one policy.
description.zh: 确定性写入门禁：范围策略在落盘前拒绝越权写入，残留规则扫描所写文本，每个决定落入带内容哈希的 JSONL 台账；可复用仓库的 agent-pr-gate.yaml 让 CI 与会话共用同一策略。

description.en: System-prompt surface drift gate: every section any plugin or preset contributes to the assembled system prompt is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of what the model is told fails loud.
description.zh: 系统提示词面漂移门：任何插件或预设注入组装提示词的段落均哈希基线化，对模型被告知内容的静默改写将响亮报错。

description.en: Deterministic prompt-injection interception: tool results from file reads, repo searches and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context; high-severity findings quarantine-wrap or block, and credential-material files quarantine on the path alone.
description.zh: 确定性注入拦截：文件读取、仓库搜索与网络抓取的工具结果在进入模型上下文前被扫描；高危发现隔离包裹或阻断，凭证类文件按路径即隔离。

description.en: Plain-language trust dashboard for the dsh trust family: aggregates the nine channels (injection interception, write denials, egress blocks, custody-chain verification, tool-surface and prompt drift, leftover scans, forgotten compaction constraints, profile composition) into one right-sidebar panel with a single status light and event cards that translate engine jargon into sentences a non-security user can act on; the read and egress engines run from the package's own npm dependencies so those channels work even without the sibling plugins, and absent plugins simply show as not installed.
description.zh: 信任面板：把 dsh 信任插件族九个通道（注入拦截、写拒绝、出网拦截、custody 链校验、工具面/系统提示词漂移、残留扫描、压缩遗忘约束、profile 组成）聚合成右侧栏一块仪表盘——一个状态灯 + 事件卡片，把引擎术语翻译成非安全背景用户能看懂并知道要不要处理的句子；read/egress 引擎随包自带 npm 依赖，未装兄弟插件也能工作，缺失的通道仅显示未安装。

description.en: Fourth permission preset for dsh: unconfined, GPU-capable sessions (danger-full-access) with per-operation user approval for writes outside the workspace or to protected paths (.git/**, .env*); implemented purely as a bundle over the official tools/pre-execute ask hook, no core edits.
description.zh: dsh 第四个权限预设：进程全权限（GPU 可用），同时工作区外与受保护文件（.git/**、.env*）的写入逐次向用户审批；纯插件实现，零核心改动。

description.en: Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.
description.zh: DSH 插件安装前投毒扫描：AST（JS-X-Ray）+ 去混淆解码 + 正则启发式，发现即非零退出，可作 CI 门禁。

description.en: Removes sandbox_permissions / justification arguments that cannot widen the call's current sandbox mode, so calls no longer fail with 'sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode'. GPT models tend to fill these optional fields on every call and pick workspace-write, which is narrower than danger-full-access. Runs in tools/pre-execute: compares the requested mode with the mode the session's sandbox policy resolves, and drops the fields when the request is the same or narrower (also drops a lone justification). Also understands the values GPT carries over from Codex's own shell tool: null, empty and use_default are treated as no request, and in a danger-full-access session any value (including require_escalated) is dropped because nothing is wider. Real widening requests, unknown modes and tools that do not advertise DSH's escalation schema are left to DSH core. Never widens permissions. Configurable tool list (default bash, pwsh, write, edit, run_code). Zero dependencies.
description.zh: 去掉那些不会让当前沙箱模式变宽的 sandbox_permissions / justification 参数，避免调用报错「sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode」。GPT 系列模型往往每次调用都会填这两个可选参数，并选 workspace-write，而它比 danger-full-access 更窄。插件在 tools/pre-execute 阶段把请求的模式和会话沙箱策略给出的当前模式做比较：相同或更窄时去掉这两个字段（只有 justification 时也会去掉）。同时兼容 GPT 从 Codex shell 工具带过来的取值：null、空值和 use_default 视为没有请求；会话已经是 danger-full-access 时，任何取值（包括 require_escalated）都会去掉，因为不存在更宽的模式。真正的升权请求、无法识别的模式值，以及没有声明 DSH 升权参数的工具，都原样交给 DSH 处理。不会放宽任何权限。监控的工具列表可配置（默认 bash、pwsh、write、edit、run_code）。零依赖。

description.en: Kizuna agent letterbox: four tools that let an agent read its own inbox (mailbox status, pending letters, one letter in full) and answer a letter with completed / failed / input-required / working state. Kizuna is an agent directory with a reliable task relay: a per-agent kizuna-box on the same machine holds the inbox, retries unanswered deliveries after 3 / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 minutes and records every delivery attempt in an append-only trail. The plugin talks to the local loopback box only and holds no credential.
description.zh: Kizuna Agent 信箱：四个工具让 Agent 读自己的信箱（信箱状态、待处理信件、读一封信全文），并以 completed / failed / input-required / working 状态回信。Kizuna 是带可靠投递的 Agent 通讯录：同一台机器上的 kizuna-box 持有信箱，对无人签收的信按 3 / 10 / 30 / 60 / 120 分钟重试，每次投递尝试都写入只增不改的留痕。插件只连本机回环信箱，不持有任何凭证。

description.en: Adds a View URL page to Settings showing the running session tokenized Web address plus a stable fixed address that survives desktop restarts and is reachable from other devices on the same LAN.
description.zh: 在设置页新增「查看 URL」：显示当前会话的临时访问地址，以及一个长期不变、局域网内其他设备也能直接打开的固定地址。

description.en: Loopback HTTP/SSE service that lets an Obsidian plugin drive DSH sessions and inject vault notes into the system prompt (path-based, re-read every turn, so edits show up next turn); needs the companion plugin running inside Obsidian.
description.zh: 让 Obsidian 插件驱动 DSH 会话、并把库内笔记注入系统提示词的回环 HTTP/SSE 服务（按路径每轮重读磁盘，笔记改了下一轮就生效）；需要 Obsidian 内配套运行的插件。

description.en: Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like, image, file, recall and more). Needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside.
description.zh: 把 QQ 接进 DeepSeek Harness：私聊群聊、本地语音转文字、看图，以及十个互动工具（戳一戳、贴表情、点赞、发图、发文件、撤回等）。需要本机另跑一个 OneBot 11 实现（如 NapCat）。

description.en: Connect Feishu chats to DeepSeek Harness projects, conversations, replies, and scoped tool approvals over WebSocket.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket 将飞书聊天连接到 DeepSeek Harness 的项目、对话、回复和限定范围的工具审批。

description.en: Read and search bounded log output from allowlisted SSH servers and log roots without exposing arbitrary remote commands.
description.zh: 从白名单 SSH 服务器和日志根目录读取或搜索有界日志内容，不开放任意远程命令。

description.en: LAN / remote-access control, frpc NAT tunneling, a panel password gate, and mobile UI adaptation for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: DSH Web 插件：局域网/远程访问控制、frpc 内网穿透、面板密码门禁与手机端 UI 适配。

description.en: Restores Host-persisted settings when dsh web is reached through a reverse proxy on a non-loopback hostname: marks the page connection as host-owning so the Settings and model pages load instead of reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser". For dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x.
description.zh: 反向代理域名访问 dsh web 时恢复设置页的 Host 持久化：将页面连接标记为宿主可信，设置与模型页正常加载，不再报 "settings are unavailable in this browser"。适用于 dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x。

description.en: Remote access for DeepSeek Harness: expose this machine's DSH Web GUI through an SSH reverse tunnel and a QR gate — scan and enter. Requires your own Linux server with root SSH access plus nginx, openssl and qrencode; it rewrites that server's nginx config, and the QR link is a one-year login secret, so treat it like a password.
description.zh: 远程接入插件：把本机 DSH 经 SSH 反向隧道映射到服务器并生成二维码，手机扫码直进本机 dsh。需自备可 root 登录的 Linux 服务器，并装好 nginx、openssl、qrencode；插件会改写该机 nginx 配置，二维码链接本身是一年有效的登录凭据，请当作密码保管。

description.en: Open a Mac or Windows DeepSeek Harness Web instance from iPhone or iPad Safari: 8-digit pairing, a LAN gateway for loopback-only hosts, optional Tailscale Serve, and iOS-only Safari input and touch fixes. Installs with dsh plugin add.
description.zh: 用 iPhone 或 iPad 的 Safari 打开 Mac 或 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness Web：8 位配对码、回环监听的局域网网关、可选 Tailscale Serve，以及仅 iOS 生效的 Safari 输入与触摸补丁。可用 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: LAN/remote access for the Web UI: injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill on plain-HTTP origins so the frontend survives LAN or Tailscale IP direct links.
description.zh: Web UI 局域网/远程访问：为纯 HTTP 非安全上下文注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill，局域网/Tailscale IP 直连时前端不再崩溃。

description.en: Remote access gateway for DSH: a browser, or the optional 4 MB Android app, scans a QR code and joins the session already running on the desktop. One-time QR tickets (10 minutes, single use), a 6-digit pairing code matched on both screens, four network entries (SakuraFrp / Cloudflare quick tunnel / LAN / Tailscale), and per-device admission: an online-device limit, online devices pinned first with a green dot, and remove = disconnect plus revoke trust. The gateway listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
description.zh: DSH 的远程访问网关：用浏览器或可选的 Android App 扫一个码，接入电脑上正在运行的同一个会话。一次性二维码票据（10 分钟、扫一次失效）、6 位配对码两端核对、四条网络入口（SakuraFrp / Cloudflare 快速隧道 / 局域网 / Tailscale）、逐台设备准入（在线上限、在线设备绿灯置顶、离线灰灯、移除即断开并撤销信任）。网关只监听 127.0.0.1。

description.en: SSH workspaces for Windows DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2: discover OpenSSH hosts, add or browse remote project directories, and route file, search and Bash operations by workspace while the DSH runtime stays local. A Desktop compatibility fork of Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh that preserves local permission defaults.
description.zh: 为 Windows DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2 提供 SSH 工作区：发现 OpenSSH 主机、添加或浏览远端项目目录，按工作区路由文件、搜索与 Bash 操作，DSH 运行时仍在本地。基于 Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh 的 Desktop 兼容分支，保留本地默认权限。

plugins.name: dsh-auth-tunnel

description.en: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
description.zh: 通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问，并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-vps

description.en: One-command VPS deployment for DeepSeek Harness: a zero-dependency login gateway with automatic HTTPS that proxies the native web UI, a token-protected setup wizard, and one-click DSH upgrades with automatic rollback; as a plugin it adds Settings → VPS Deploy to install DSH on (or remove it from) a VPS over SSH from a form, plus version, upgrade, gateway status and a QR code to add DSH to a phone's home screen.
description.zh: 一条命令把 DeepSeek Harness 部署到自有 VPS：零依赖登录网关加自动 HTTPS，反向代理原生 Web 界面，令牌保护的初始化向导，DSH 一键升级且失败自动回滚；作为插件在设置中新增「VPS 部署」页，可填表经 SSH 把 DSH 装到或卸出 VPS，并显示版本、升级、网关状态，以及扫码把 DSH 添加到手机桌面。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 1.2.3.4 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-vps-manager

description.en: Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 22 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 密钥登录管理 VPS：22 条不走模型的 /vps- 命令（查看状态、按菜谱安装并先出计划再用 /vps-yes 确认、重启并等机器回来），对话里的终端（xterm.js + ssh -tt，可运行菜单脚本等交互程序），5 个按风险分级确认的 agent 工具，改文件自动备份与还原、改防火墙和 SSH 前设自动恢复，29 条内置菜谱，以及添加机器的设置页。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to ip-api.com
uses literal IP 1.2.3.4 for network access

description.en: Drive a dsh agent from Telegram: one chat topic per project directory, voice and photo input, ordered per-topic job queue, per-topic goals and task checklists, session forks and branches, live progress message, command menu in en/ru/zh, and control commands for models, plugins, sessions and logs. Search the plugin registry, read a package card before installing, and update every plugin with one tap. Requires a Telegram bot token and your numeric user id in allowedUserIds.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 驱动 dsh Agent：每个项目目录一个话题、语音与图片输入、按话题顺序执行的任务队列、每个话题的目标与任务清单、会话分支与切换、实时进度消息、中英俄三语命令菜单，以及模型、插件、会话与日志的管理命令。可搜索插件市场、安装前查看插件卡片、一键更新全部插件。需要 Telegram bot token，并把数字用户 id 填进 allowedUserIds。

description.en: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with phone/desktop first-answer-wins racing (never auto-approved), a multi-machine session board, and an end-to-end encrypted zero-knowledge relay you can self-host.
description.zh: 面向手机的指挥台而非 Web UI 镜像：从 PWA 把任务派发进隔离的 git worktree，工具审批推送通知支持手机/桌面「谁先答谁算」（绝不自动批准），多机会话看板，以及可自建的端到端加密零知识中继。

description.en: Manage Windows hosts over WinRM from a web panel and seven agent tools with PowerShell exec, service and process control, SMB / chunked file transfer with SHA-256 verification, and cluster execution.
description.zh: 通过 WinRM 管理 Windows 主机，提供 PowerShell 执行、服务与进程管理、SMB/分块文件传输（SHA-256 校验）、集群并发，以及 GUI 面板和七个 agent 工具。

description.en: Connects DSH to a local anet node through a stdio MCP client, with three skills and 14 tools to discover agents on the AgentNetwork, send, track and answer end-to-end encrypted A2A tasks, pay or decline priced skills within the operator's limits, read the local evidence chain and report the node state. Linux/macOS only; requires an anet 0.3.0+ node running locally.
description.zh: 通过 stdio MCP 客户端将 DSH 连接到本地 anet 节点，提供三项技能和 14 个工具，用于发现 AgentNetwork 上的智能体，发送、跟踪和答复端到端加密的 A2A 任务，在运营者的支出限额内支付或拒绝收费技能，读取本地证据链并报告节点状态。仅 Linux/macOS；需本机运行 anet 0.3.0+ 节点。

description.en: Adds chunked uploads with progress and resume, and native downloads of workspace files and the session log ZIP, to the DSH Web GUI, including sessions reached through a paired remote link.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 增加带进度与续传的分块上传，以及工作区文件与会话日志 ZIP 的原生下载；通过配对远程链接访问的会话同样可用。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint for DSH sessions plus a phone panel that reads transcripts, browses files, sends or queues messages, and answers approvals and questions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供 OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 接口与手机面板：读会话、浏览文件、发送或排队消息，并在手机上处理审批与提问。

description.en: Manage the SakuraFrp phone-to-desktop link from the DSH interface - link status, mobile gateway switch, one-time pairing QR code, device revoke and gateway self-heal.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里管理 SakuraFrp 手机与电脑互通的插件：链路状态、移动网关开关、一次性配对二维码、设备撤销与网关自愈。

plugins.name: dsh-qq-bot

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to QQ over OneBot 11/12, Satori, Milky or the official QQ bot API, with a separate session per group or private chat and nine built-in tools: group management, chat history with image understanding, web search, page fetching, reverse image search and image generation. Optional proactive chatter reads recent messages on an interval and decides whether to join in, with the judging and speaking stages able to use different models. Models, proxy and allowlists are configured in the DSH settings page. First run requires an owner (auth.owners): with it empty the plugin drives no sessions at all (deny by default, so installing it does not expose the bot); once set, private chats and groups work immediately, guests only reach the guest tool allowlist while qqbot and qqconfig stay owner-only.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 QQ。支持 OneBot 11/12、Satori、Milky 与 QQ 官方机器人接口，群聊和私聊各有一条独立会话；内置九个工具：群管理、聊天记录与图片理解、联网搜索、网页抓取、图片反搜、生图等，另有按间隔自主接话的主动发言（判断与发言可分用两个模型）。模型、代理、白名单等全部在 DSH 设置页里配置，不需要改代码。首次使用必须先填拥有者 auth.owners：留空时插件不驱动任何会话（默认拒绝，避免装机即对外开放）；填好后私聊与群聊立即可用，访客只能使用访客工具白名单，qqbot 与 qqconfig 仅限拥有者。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Routes DSH filesystem, shell, subprocess, and PTY operations to local, SSH, and Docker execution nodes, with a node registry, an authentication gate, a mobile-aware management UI, and per-workspace custom project instructions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供多节点执行路由，将文件系统、Shell、子进程和 PTY 操作分发到本地、SSH 与 Docker 执行节点，并包含节点注册表、认证门禁、移动端管理 UI，以及可注入新对话的工作区自定义项目指令。

description.en: Control DeepSeek Harness from a phone via QR code: read chats, send messages, upload images, over LAN, IPv6, or a Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 扫码即可用手机远程控制 DeepSeek Harness：查看会话、发送消息、上传图片，支持局域网、IPv6 与 Cloudflare 隧道。

description.en: Password-optional LAN entry for the DSH Web GUI. DSH stays loopback-only while a settings-card plugin serves its HTTP and WebSocket traffic on port 3301, storing the password only as a scrypt verifier.
description.zh: 将DSH Web GUI代理到3301端口供局域网访问。口令可选，无明文保存，初始3080端口保存回环不暴露。

description.en: Install-time patch guard for cross-machine DSH group chat: fixes dsh-weave rc.14 defects (inject crash, random UDP port, 4KB ack frame limit) with four idempotent patches, alongside setup, mechanism and ops docs for the dsh-chat x dsh-weave x dsh-bridge chatroom stack.
description.zh: 跨机 DSH 群聊适配修复包：安装期自动对 dsh-weave rc.14 打四合一补丁（注入崩溃、随机端口、4KB ack 帧上限），并附带 dsh-chat x dsh-weave x dsh-bridge 聊天室的部署、机制与运维文档。

description.en: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.
description.zh: 为 DSH Host 提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与公网 HTTPS 接入，支持持久主机身份、配对和二维码配置。

description.en: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.
description.zh: 基于 Iroh 的可信 DSH 主机网状网络：提供加密的节点发现、远程会话投递与连通状态。

description.en: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from your phone with token auth (npm: `dsh-my-remote`).
description.zh: 远程控制：把 ask / 审批 / 会话结束事件推送到外部通道 webhook，可用 token 鉴权在手机上回答问题、批准请求、查询状态或继续会话（npm: `dsh-my-remote`）。

description.en: Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer (native gallery/camera, integrated with the validated add-images pipeline), zero desktop regression. Published on npm as dsh-webui-mobile.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端外壳：抽屉式侧栏、可拖拽悬浮按钮、移动端输入框修复，以及悬浮在输入框上方的图片上传按钮（原生相册/拍照，走加图校验管线），桌面端零影响。已发布到 npm（dsh-webui-mobile）。

description.en: QQ chat behaviour layer for DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: persona files injected into every turn, a people file keyed by QQ number, sticker picking with probability and pity, optional non-mention replies, sub-personas distilled from group members, and scheduled messages. Enabling the built-in QQ channel accepts private messages from any QQ user and group messages from any group that @s the bot; there is no sender allowlist, so restrict the bot account or keep the channel off.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一层 QQ 对话行为：人设文件注入每一轮、按 QQ 号认人的群友档案、带概率与大保底的表情包挑选、可选的主动接话、从群友原话蒸馏出的语气子人格，以及定时消息。开启内置 QQ 通道后，任何 QQ 用户私聊机器人、任何群里 @ 机器人都能驱动 Agent；没有发送者白名单，请用群白名单限制或保持通道关闭。

description.en: LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).
description.zh: 局域网手机访问网关：独立子进程反向代理 + 首次访问审批 + 设备令牌绑定 + 限流 + 手机端紧凑排版注入（输入区权限/模型小胶囊、randomUUID polyfill）。

description.en: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an existing target is refused, there is no overwrite branch), and apply literal replacements with unique-match checking — all addressed through a single "alias:path" field whose alias comes from ~/.ssh/config.
description.zh: 模型可直接调用的 ssh 远程文件三件套：read_remote 按行号分页读远端 UTF-8 文本，write_remote 只新建文件、目标已存在即拒绝且没有覆写分支，edit_remote 做唯一匹配的字面替换，三者共用取自 ~/.ssh/config 的「别名:路径」一个 file_path 字段。

description.en: Remote operations for the DSH Web app: manages SSH servers, collects hardware and process metrics, inspects logs with a read-only AI pass, and deploys a Git repo over SSH using git pull --ff-only plus a health check. Credentials are AES-256-GCM encrypted. Linux and macOS hosts; no Windows support.
description.zh: DSH Web 远程运维插件：管理 SSH 服务器、采集硬件与进程指标、以只读 AI 巡检日志，并通过 SSH 部署 Git 仓库（git pull --ff-only 加健康检查）。凭据 AES-256-GCM 加密存储。支持 Linux 与 macOS，不支持 Windows。

description.en: Mobile remote-control suite: bundle plugin with native sidebar entry and admin drawer, self-healing bearer-token gateway over LAN/Tailscale, Android app (sessions/approvals/questions/goals), /fs/* file transfer (Range resume, 2GB upload), latency-based multi-server auto-switch, offline chat cache.
description.zh: 移动远程控制套件：原生侧边栏入口 + 管理抽屉的 bundle 插件，自带 Bearer 令牌网关自愈（局域网/Tailscale）；Android App 覆盖会话/审批/提问/goal；/fs/* 文件端点（Range 断点续传、2GB 上传）；多服务器测速自动切换；聊天记录离线缓存。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-link

description.en: Secure remote access for the official Web UI: authenticated LAN/tunnel gateway with QR + HMAC one-time pairing, per-device sessions and revocation, mDNS discovery, and a fork_session tool.
description.zh: 官方 Web UI 的安全远程接入：带认证的局域网/隧道网关，QR + HMAC 一次性配对、按设备吊销，mDNS 发现，附 fork_session 会话分叉工具。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 224.0.0.251 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-remote-explorer

description.en: Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.
description.zh: 远程开发启动器：通过 SSH（或本机 WSL 发行版）在远端引导安装 dsh，从本地客户端连接，LLM 凭据经反向隧道代理、不离开本机。同时提供独立 CLI 与 dsh 插件双形态，插件含远程会话面板、/remote-explorer 命令及 remote_* agent 工具。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to github.com
uses literal IP 1.3.101.112 for network access

description.en: Manage your own remote DSH host from the local GUI: SSH tunnels, mixed remote session list, one-click remote GUI, auto-healing tunnels.
description.zh: 本地 GUI 管理你自己服务器上的 DSH 分身：SSH 隧道、远程会话混排列表、一键远程 GUI、隧道掉线自动重连。

plugins.name: dsh-ssh-ops

description.en: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.
description.zh: DSH SSH 运维终端：在主对话中直接指挥已连接的服务器（ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect），右侧保留可交互的 xterm.js 终端。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to 169.254.170.2

description.en: Right-sidebar SSH terminal for DSH where you and your agent share one PTY: 16 agent tools, configurable transfer limit, session-isolated audit trail, one-click in-place updates.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 SSH 远程终端：你和 agent 共用一个 PTY，16 个 agent 工具，传输上限可调，终端按会话隔离，配置页支持一键热更新。

description.en: Drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent from QQ and other IM channels through AstrBot: send tasks with /dsh, continue by quoting or @-mentioning the bot, answer approvals and ask_user_question prompts from chat (in parallel with the DSH web UI), and get results, inline images and file cards back. Ships session / workspace / model / permission commands, /compact and /last recovery, three progress-display modes, and group-shared or per-user session scoping.
description.zh: 把本机 DeepSeek Harness agent 接到 AstrBot，从 QQ 等 IM 渠道驱动它：用 /dsh 派活、引用或 @ 机器人续聊、在聊天里回答审批与 ask_user_question（与 DSH 网页并行），结果、内联图片与文件卡片发回。含会话 / 工作区 / 模型 / 权限命令、/compact 与 /last 找回、三档过程显示、整群共用或按人隔离的会话范围。

description.en: Host-side plugin that links the Cindy mobile app to DSH: phone channels for sessions, messages, approvals, todos and goals, plus a settings card.
description.zh: Host 侧插件：将 Cindy 手机客户端接入 DSH，提供会话、消息、审批、todo、goal 的手机通道，以及配套的设置卡片。

description.en: Pair a phone with this computer's DSH instance by QR code or a six-digit code, then drive it remotely — send instructions, view images, answer approvals — from the panel, with public-tunnel support for pairing across networks.
description.zh: 用二维码或六位配对码把手机连上这台电脑的 DSH，之后可远程发指令、看图片、回答审批；局域网内不依赖云端，异地走公网隧道。

description.en: iOS remote companion for DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS Apple Silicon, with pairing, approval notifications, and device revocation.
description.zh: 面向 macOS Apple Silicon 上 DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的 iOS 远程控制插件，支持配对、审批通知与设备撤销。

description.en: Bridge QQ (via NapCat) into DeepSeek Harness, turning private and group chats into session prompts and sending replies back to QQ.
description.zh: 把 QQ（NapCat）接入 DeepSeek Harness：私聊和群聊消息变成会话提示词，回复按行发回 QQ。

description.en: Use DSH from iPhone/iPad: an explicit-opt-in LAN reverse proxy (Host/Origin rewrite through the loopback trust fence, WebSocket upgrades included), iOS PWA chrome (home-screen icon, standalone meta, viewport-fit), and touch/mobile CSS (safe areas, keyboard lifting, composer row fit).
description.zh: 让 DSH 在 iPhone/iPad 上可用：显式开启的局域网反向代理（改写 Host/Origin 通过回环信任栅栏，含 WebSocket 升级）、iOS PWA 外壳（主屏幕图标、standalone meta、viewport-fit）、触屏/移动端 CSS（安全区、键盘避让、输入框按钮行适配）。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-development

description.en: Remote development over SSH: pick a directory on a registered machine as the session workspace and the file, shell, bash, and search tools run on the remote host — the agent works there with the same local tools, and no extra model-facing tools are added.
description.zh: 基于 SSH 的远程开发：把注册机器上的目录选为会话工作区后，文件、shell、bash 与搜索工具即改在远程主机上执行——agent 用与本地相同的工具在那里工作，不新增任何面向模型的工具。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to github.com
uses literal IP 1.3.101.112 for network access

description.en: Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals, commands, and file transfers, with QR pairing and device revocation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的设备鉴权移动网关：通过 WebSocket 连接配套原生 iOS 客户端，支持会话、实时事件、任务、Goal、审批、命令和文件传输，并提供二维码配对与设备撤销。

description.en: HTTPS + login gateway for the DeepSeek Harness web surface: access your DSH Web UI securely from another machine on your LAN, or from the internet via port forwarding. Fail-closed defaults (loopback-only, no accounts until configured); setup and security notes in the README.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供 HTTPS + 登录保护的远程访问网关：局域网内其它设备可安全访问，配置端口映射后可从互联网访问。默认 fail-closed（仅本机监听、无内置账号，配置后才能登录），配置与安全说明见 README。

plugins.name: dsh-telegram-bridge

description.en: Remote-control your dsh agent from Telegram: chat, skills, workspace browsing, and file transfer.
description.zh: 通过 Telegram 遥控 dsh Agent：对话、技能调用、工作目录浏览与文件传输。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-remote-server-manager

description.en: Remote Linux server manager in the Harness Web UI: browse and edit files, inspect host status, start/stop/restart Docker containers, inspect images, configure Docker registry mirrors, manage firewalld/ufw rules, switch apt sources, and detect developer tools or install/upgrade them with apt.
description.zh: 在 Harness Web UI 中管理远程 Linux 服务器：通过 SSH 浏览和编辑文件、查看主机状态、启动/停止/重启 Docker 容器、查看镜像、配置 Docker 镜像加速源、管理 firewalld/ufw 防火墙规则、切换 apt 软件源，并探测常见开发工具或通过 apt 一键安装/升级。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to archive.ubuntu.com

description.en: Continue the sessions on your computer from a phone browser: scan a QR code, approve the device on the computer, then chat, answer approvals, browse workspace files and manage settings in a mobile interface; connects over the same Wi-Fi or through a Cloudflare Quick Tunnel.
description.zh: 用手机浏览器继续电脑上的会话：扫码并在电脑上确认设备后，在移动端界面里对话、处理审批、浏览工作区文件、管理设置；支持同一 Wi-Fi 直连或经 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 连接。

description.en: Identity-gated Tailscale access to the Web GUI with dsh still bound to loopback: a 127.0.0.1 proxy published by `tailscale serve` admits a request only when the Tailscale login it stamps is allowed, with an optional per-device allowlist, so the privileged /api methods behind the loopback check — Settings, Models, Plugins — answer without dsh being told to trust a remote host.
description.zh: 在 dsh 仍绑定回环地址的前提下，为 Web 界面提供基于身份的 Tailscale 访问：由 `tailscale serve` 对外发布的 127.0.0.1 代理，仅当其标记的 Tailscale 登录账号在允许列表内时才放行请求，并可另按设备白名单限制；这样受回环检查保护的特权 /api 方法（设置、模型、插件）无需让 dsh 信任远程主机即可正常响应。

description.en: Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.
description.zh: Web GUI 远程访问：局域网二维码直连、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp 自有服务器反代，内置登录门户，并放行设置接口。

description.en: Mobile remote control for the dsh web GUI: scan-to-pair QR entry with one-time pairing tokens.
description.zh: dsh web GUI 移动端远程控制：扫码配对 QR 入口、一次性配对 token。

description.en: Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store and persisted sessions.
description.zh: dsh web GUI 远程 SSH 操作：主机配置存储、持久化会话。

description.en: Telegram remote for DeepSeek Harness — attach a live web session from your phone and answer its questions there, with a Russian UI. Russian fork of hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel (MIT).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Telegram 遥控器：在手机上接续正在运行的 Web 会话并回答问题，界面为俄语。hi-wenw/dsh-telegram-channel 的俄语分支（MIT）。

description.en: Two-way Telegram remote cockpit for DeepSeek Harness: live progress tracking, screenshot vision, git diffs, shell execution, and tool approvals. Unconfigured chatId automatically claims the first sender as owner; voice-to-text requires local ffmpeg and BeeRouter services.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 双向 Telegram 远程控制台：实时进度卡片、截图识图、Git 差异对比、Shell 执行与工具审批。未配置 chatId 前首个发送者即被认领为主人；语音转文字需本地 ffmpeg 与 BeeRouter 服务前置支持。

description.en: iOS home-screen fix and always-on kit for DeepSeek Harness remote access: overrides the PWA manifest start_url to /pair-app so the phone icon stops hitting the harness 401, and ships a hidden watchdog that keeps the desktop host and its tunnel alive while the PC is on. Requires @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui (it serves /pair-app); the watchdog scripts are Windows-only.
description.zh: DSH 手机远程访问的开箱即用修复套件：把 PWA manifest 的 start_url 改到 /pair-app，解决 iOS「添加到主屏幕」后打开停在 401 的问题；附常驻/守护脚本、自动登录与电源设置说明、中文排错手册。需安装 @linxin666/dsh-remote-web-ui（/pair-app 由它提供）；守护脚本仅 Windows。

description.en: Phone client for DeepSeek Harness — no app to install (PWA). Read sessions, background jobs, subagents, goal rounds, workflows and pending approvals, and talk to any session from it: streamed replies, tool-call progress, stop at any time, switch sessions and models. Also ships a GUI sidebar panel. Formerly dsh-taskwatch; the npm package is now dsh-in-hand.
description.zh: 掌上 DSH（dsh-in-hand）：DeepSeek Harness 的手机端，不用装 App（PWA）。公网与局域网两个入口可随时切换；在手机上读会话、子代理、目标轮次、工作流、后台任务与待审批，和任意会话实时对话（流式回复、工具调用进度、随时停止、切换会话与模型），消息可排队并「立即发送」，支持上传与交付文件。另含 GUI 侧边栏面板；原名 dsh-taskwatch，npm 包已改为 dsh-in-hand。

description.en: Exposes any local service on a LAN address and a public cloudflared quick-tunnel domain behind one password login, with per-route open/block gates managed from the plugin settings page. Requires Python 3 and cloudflared on the machine, and reports either of them being missing or misconfigured in the settings page before you start; LAN and local access are passwordless by default, while the public tunnel requires the passcode.
description.zh: 把一个口令登录的内网地址与公网 cloudflared 快速隧道域名提供给本机任意服务，每条路由的开放/屏蔽闸门在插件设置页里管理。需本机有 Python 3 与 cloudflared，缺失或路径填错会在启动前的设置页里提示；内网与本机访问默认免密，公网隧道需要口令。

description.en: Browser-first, LAN-only access to the current DeepSeek Harness Web UI with one-time QR pairing, revocable devices, event-driven diagnostics, and a slot-preserving mobile layout; no companion app, cloud relay, or remote tunnel.
description.zh: 以浏览器为核心、仅限局域网访问当前 DeepSeek Harness Web UI，支持一次性二维码配对、设备撤销、事件驱动诊断和保留插槽的移动端布局；无需配套应用、云中继或远程隧道。

description.en: Feishu IM bridge for dsh: create a dedicated Feishu bot by scanning a QR code, get one Card JSON 2.0 notice per finished turn, answer tool approvals and structured questions from the chat, and drive a session from it — listing and switching the bound session with /sessions and /resume, steering a running turn, and choosing per-chat permission modes (read-only, workspace, Auto Review, full). Long output paginates instead of being cut. Owner binding: the QR scan binds the scanner; with manually entered credentials the first sender claims ownership and everyone else is refused.
description.zh: 飞书 IM 通道：扫码创建专属飞书机器人；每轮结束推一张卡片，在飞书里授权工具调用、回答结构化提问，并直接用聊天驱动会话（/sessions 列会话、/resume 切换绑定会话、任务进行中可插话引导），还能按对话设置权限模式（只读 / 工作区读写 / Auto Review / 完全权限）。消息以卡片 JSON 2.0 发送，超长内容分页而不是截断。归属绑定：扫码创建时绑定扫码人；手填凭据时由首个发消息的人认领，其余人一律拒绝。

plugins.name: dsh-im-union

description.en: Union IM bridge for DSH — an independent implementation uniting the capability sets of community peer plugins (xmanrui/dsh-im, MichengAI/dsh-im-connect). Drive your agent session from 15 channel adapters across 12 platforms (including email; WeCom/DingTalk/QQ each contribute two: bot + self-built app or notify tier) — WeChat (official iLink QR bind), Feishu/Lark (long-connection + streaming cards; the voice tier requires system ffmpeg), Telegram, Discord, WeCom intelligent bot & self-built app (signed callback), DingTalk (stream + AI Card and custom-robot notify), QQ official bot (plus notify tier), Slack (Socket Mode), WhatsApp (Baileys QR pairing; the dependency ships as an optionalDependency of the plugin package), Matrix, iMessage (macOS only), Email (IMAP/SMTP thread routing). The cross-version narrow waist auto-adapts settings gen1/gen2/gen3 across hosts 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 (12-tag enum; rc.2 verified by a real desktop-profile install with double read-back) using capability probing only, never version branches. In chat: a 25-command panel, tool-approval and question loops answered in the originating chat (deny-by-default, initiator-only, 5-min expiry), image/file input gated on host model metadata, deliverable file return, a delivery log with bounded retry (uncertain is never re-sent), proactive delivery and fragment composition. It also splits the native sidebar into self-owned Tasks / Channels tabs (standing down entirely when another plugin already owns the slot), registers an `im-concise` agent preset plus reply sanitisation that keeps GenUI fences and raw HTML out of text-only chats, renders `svg` fences to PNG images, guards model choice with an allowlist, and mirrors each turn's final answer to notify channels via `/relay` (addressed by account ID or alias, never guessed on ambiguity). Secrets are one-way into the vault and never echoed back. npm: `dsh-im-union`.
description.zh: DSH 的 IM 联合桥：整合社区同类插件（xmanrui/dsh-im、MichengAI/dsh-im-connect）能力合集的独立实现——用 12 个平台的 15 个渠道适配器（含邮件；企微/钉钉/QQ 各含机器人与自建应用或推送两档）驱动宿主会话——微信（官方 iLink 扫码绑定）、飞书（长连接+流式卡片，语音档需系统 ffmpeg）、Telegram、Discord、企微智能机器人与自建应用（回调验签）、钉钉（stream+AI Card 与自定义机器人推送）、QQ 官方机器人（另含推送档）、Slack（Socket Mode）、WhatsApp（Baileys 扫码，依赖以插件包 optionalDependencies 随包分发）、Matrix、iMessage（仅 macOS）、邮件（IMAP/SMTP 线程路由）。跨版本窄腰在 0.1.2-rc.1→0.2.1-rc.2 宿主间（12 tag 枚举，rc.2 已按桌面 profile 装机双回读实证）以能力探测自适配设置面 gen1/gen2/gen3（禁版本号分支）；IM 内 25 命令面板、工具审批与交互提问原聊天闭环（默认拒绝、发起者限定、5 分钟超时）、图片/文件输入（宿主元数据判视觉）、产物文件回传、投递日志限额补发（结果不明绝不重发）、主动投递与碎片续写；原生侧栏「任务/频道」两页签自持分离（检测到该槽位已被其它插件接管则完全不插手）、im-concise 智能体预设配合出站净化把 GenUI 围栏与裸 HTML 等富结构挡在纯文字聊天之外、svg 围栏自动渲染为 PNG 图片发送、模型白名单护栏、/relay 把每回合最终回答镜像到通知渠道（按账号 ID 或别名绑定，歧义不猜）。secret 单向入凭据库，永不回显。npm 包名：`dsh-im-union`。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Mints a fresh remote-web-ui pairing link and shows its QR in the dsh settings page.
description.zh: 在 dsh 设置页直接铸造 remote-web-ui 远程访问配对链接并显示二维码。

description.en: Approve tool calls, watch streaming output and answer questions from a phone over a zero-knowledge relay, with payload-level end-to-end encryption.
description.zh: 在手机上审批工具调用、看流式输出、回答问题；载荷级端到端加密，中继可自托管。

description.en: SSH remote workspace — run bash, file tools, glob and grep on a remote machine over plain sshd (exec + SFTP), zero remote install, purely additive.
description.zh: SSH 远端工作区——在远端机器上执行 bash、文件读写、glob 与 grep（基于 sshd 的 exec + SFTP），远端零安装，纯附加。

description.en: Sets up QuickTUI from a dsh plugin page: installs QuickTUI server on macOS and Linux, pairs the phone app by QR code, and connects dsh sessions so the app can follow them, answer approvals and questions, send prompts, and interrupt turns.
description.zh: 在 dsh 插件页配置 QuickTUI：在 macOS 与 Linux 上安装 QuickTUI server，扫码配对手机 App，并接入 dsh 会话，让 App 能查看会话、回应审批与提问、发送提示词、中断回合。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu-bridge

description.en: Feishu (Lark) IM bridge over a self-built app long connection: forwards inbound chat messages into a DSH session and posts the reply back to the same chat. Dedupe, allow-lists, ack text, dry-run. Self-trigger was split out into dsh-self-trigger.
description.zh: 把 DSH 接到飞书自建应用的长连接：接收聊天消息投进指定会话，再把回复发回同一会话。带去重、白名单、回执文案与试运行开关。自触发已拆到 dsh-self-trigger。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Standalone mobile surface for dsh: scan-to-pair device trust, realtime SSE sync, three-channel completion notifications (in-app / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram), offline outbox, approval & question panels, per-provider usage meters, PWA; a native narrow-screen phone UI.
description.zh: dsh 的独立手机端界面：扫码配对设备信任、实时 SSE 同步、三通道完成通知（应用内 / Web Push / Server酱·Bark·Telegram）、离线发件箱、审批与提问面板、多提供方用量卡、PWA；从零为窄屏设计的原生手机 UI。

description.en: Tailscale remote-access operations panel for the dsh web GUI: health checks, HTTPS entry toggle via tailscale serve, macOS proxy bypass, relay server ops, and ACL snippet generation.
description.zh: Tailscale 远程访问运维面板：健康检查、HTTPS 入口（tailscale serve）开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维与 ACL 片段生成。

description.en: Run shell commands on the host instead of inside DSH, triggered by exact-match QQ messages through NapCat, and DM the result; requires EviMing/dsh-napcat-tools. plus Python 3.10+ for napcat_api.
description.zh: 目的是能远程运行 Shell 命令，而不是让 DSH 运行，适用于需要重复工作或托管行为但不能直接给权限到 DSH 的情况。原理是通过 NapCat 进程与 QQ 进行交互，当 QQ 发送特定消息，判断是否完全相等与哪个键的字符串，并执行对应的 Shell 命令。执行 Shell="执行 Shell 命令：\n文本"。添加新的键值对="增加 Shell 命令：\n{"文本": \["Shell 命令", "使用哪个 Shell (例如 cmd，或 PowerShell) 运行 Shell 命令"]}"，最终会被拼接为 "Shell 命令" 的格式被系统运行，依赖前置插件 "EviMing/dsh-napcat-tools"需先安装 EviMing/dsh-napcat-tools，并准备 NapCat 与 Python 3.10+。

plugins.name: dsh-presence

description.en: Work on any machine in your ssh config as if it were local: persistent connections, native file editing, search, exec and terminals, with nothing installed on the remote host.
description.zh: 像操作本地一样使用 ssh config 中的任意远程机器：持久连接、原生文件编辑、搜索、命令执行与终端，远端无需安装任何东西。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway with optional HTTPS for LAN and remote access, PWA install and icons, desktop plus Web Push notifications, and optional session-id request-header injection for third-party API routes, configured from a settings page.
description.zh: DSH 增强套件：为 Web GUI 提供独立的密码访问网关（可选 HTTPS，适合局域网/远程访问），整合 PWA 安装与图标、桌面通知与 Web Push，并可把当前会话的 session id 注入第三方 API 请求头，在设置页统一配置。

description.en: Displays and copies absolute paths for files produced by DSH turns in remote Web.
description.zh: 在远程 Web 中显示并复制 DSH 每轮产出文件的绝对路径。

description.en: Password SSH into a remote host: an ssh_remote tool with connect/exec/close/status over a persistent ControlMaster session, plus a floating browser terminal panel on a real PTY.
description.zh: 用密码直连远程主机的 SSH 终端：ssh_remote 工具提供 connect/exec/close/status 四个动作，底层是 ControlMaster 常驻会话；另带浏览器浮动终端面板，跑真实 PTY。

description.en: Switches between local and remote DSH workspaces and sessions, with optional plugin sync; requires your own relay server.
description.zh: 在本机与远程 DSH 工作区和会话间切换，并支持插件同步；需要自备中继服务器。

description.en: A deliberately small phone remote for a running desktop DSH: allowlisted session read/write, message send and permission approval, host-rendered pages with no build step, QR pairing, and tunnel-URL recovery.
description.zh: 把桌面 DSH 的电话面做成克制遥控器：白名单透传会话读写、发消息与权限审批，页面由宿主直接产出、无构建链，扫码配对，隧道地址变了自动推回手机。

plugins.name: dsh-web-remote

description.en: Access DSH from your phone or anywhere: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel public link, LAN HTTP/HTTPS direct access with an auto-generated self-signed certificate, token auth, gzip compression, a floating phone-icon panel with QR codes, configurable public URL and LAN port, and WeChat / Feishu / Telegram bot channels with per-channel health monitoring and session-completion push. Targets DSH 0.2.x (also works on 0.1.2-rc.1+).
description.zh: 手机/外网远程访问 DSH：Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 公网链接、局域网 HTTP/HTTPS 直连（自动生成自签名证书）、token 鉴权、gzip 压缩、常驻手机图标面板（一键复制/二维码）、可配置公网链接与局域网端口，以及微信 / 飞书 / Telegram 机器人通道，支持分通道健康监测与会话完成推送。适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.2-rc.1+ 亦可用）。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 2.5.4.3 for network access

description.en: Native SSH remote development for DSH: remote workspaces, mirrored sessions, terminal and file access, approvals, and a DSH UI. Requires DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 and a remote host running Linux or macOS.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机上的工作区接入 DSH：远程工作区、镜像会话、终端与文件访问、审批和原生 DSH 界面。需 DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，远端主机为 Linux 或 macOS。

plugins.name: dsh-lanmode

description.en: LAN and reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness web UI: returns the settings service on pages that are not localhost, fills in the web APIs a browser withholds over plain HTTP, and can open a listener of its own.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 UI 提供局域网与反向代理访问：在非 localhost 页面返回设置服务，补齐浏览器在纯 HTTP 下限制的 Web API，并可自行开启监听端口。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses literal IP 224.0.0.251 for network access

description.en: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.
description.zh: 支持冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发和原生 Web UI 的 SSH/SFTP 远程工作区。

description.en: Launch Android apps on a virtual display and drive them with screen reading, taps and swipes, leaving the main screen untouched.
description.zh: 在虚拟显示器上启动安卓应用，用读屏、点击与滑动驱动它们，主屏不受影响。

description.en: Sidebar status chip that follows the visible session and shows local or remote with machine name, plus hover diagnostics; never modifies workspace titles.
description.zh: 侧边栏底部状态芯片：跟随当前显示的会话显示「本地」或「远程 · 机器名」，悬停显示诊断信息，绝不改动工作区标题。

plugins.name: dsh-switchboard

description.en: Command DeepSeek Harness from Telegram and Feishu (Lark): one live progress message per turn, approvals and questions as buttons, files and voice, delivery that survives outages and restarts, QR setup for Feishu, and per-person roles.
description.zh: 在 Telegram 和飞书中指挥 DeepSeek Harness：每轮一条实时进度消息，按钮审批与提问，收发文件和语音，断线和重启不丢消息，飞书扫码接入，按人设置权限。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: LAN access portal for DeepSeek Harness with dual-password authentication and subpath reverse proxy support. Derived from wenbin-wb/dsh-bridge v2.17.8 (MIT, several modules reused verbatim); both default to port 3082, so change one port before running both. Authentication is opt-in: set the visitor and admin passwords and enable it before exposing the port to the LAN.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供局域网访问门户，支持双密码认证和子路径反向代理。派生自 wenbin-wb/dsh-bridge v2.17.8（MIT，部分模块逐字沿用）；两者默认端口均为 3082，同开前需修改其中一个的端口。认证默认未开启：把端口暴露到局域网前，请先设置访客与管理员密码并启用认证。

description.en: Adds a toggle to the DSH UI that opens the current session to a phone browser through an embedded loopback reverse proxy and a Cloudflare quick tunnel, and pushes each new tunnel address to WeChat.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里加一个开关，经由内嵌的 loopback 反向代理与 Cloudflare 快速隧道把当前会话开放给手机浏览器，并把每次的新隧道地址推送到微信。

description.en: SSH server dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and network meters, trend charts, an xterm.js terminal, SFTP file transfer, and server_box_hosts / server_box_exec / server_box_upload / server_box_download chat tools; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a sidebar tab or a standalone drawer.
description.zh: DSH 服务器面板：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU/内存/磁盘/网速与趋势图，点卡片进入 xterm.js 终端并支持 SFTP 上传下载；提供 server_box_hosts、server_box_exec、server_box_upload、server_box_download 对话工具，可导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为右侧栏页签或独立抽屉。

description.en: A PIN-protected, chat-only mobile web client for DeepSeek Harness, served on an isolated port over LAN or a self-provided tunnel.
description.zh: 受 PIN 保护的 DeepSeek Harness 移动端对话界面，在独立端口上通过局域网或自备隧道访问。

description.en: Adds a row at the top of the sidebar that switches the whole Web GUI to another DSH host reached over a loopback port, and shows that host's session state on the row (running, unread activity, or waiting for your answer).
description.zh: 在侧边栏顶部加一行，点击后整页切换成另一台 DSH 主机的 Web GUI（通过回环端口访问），并在该行显示那台主机的会话状态（运行中、有新活动、正等你回答）。

description.en: Bridges a OneBot QQ bot into DSH: the owner's direct messages open a session on the same home, answers go back to QQ, and files named with \[SEND_FILE: path] are delivered. Needs a OneBot v11 implementation with a forward WebSocket (such as NapCat) and ownerId set in the config, otherwise every message is ignored. The home it shares with the main session is provided by the separately installed dsh-wakeup plugin. It also runs an unauthenticated local status endpoint on 127.0.0.1:3002 with open CORS that returns the owner QQ number, the login QR code and recent log lines (including the first 60 characters of incoming messages).
description.zh: 把 QQ 接成一条能进来的路：主人私聊一到就地开一个会话（读同一个家、同一份起床包），答完发回去；正文带一行 \[SEND_FILE: 绝对路径] 能把文件送到手机上。需另行运行带正向 WebSocket 的 OneBot v11 实现（如 NapCat），并在配置里填 ownerId，否则所有消息一律忽略；所谓「同一个家」由另装的 dsh-wakeup 提供。另外它会在 127.0.0.1:3002 开一个无鉴权、允许任意跨域的本机状态口，返回主人 QQ 号、登录二维码和最近日志（含来信前 60 个字符）。

description.en: Remote & mobile security gateway: zero-modification Tailscale/LAN access with QR pairing, RSA encryption, brute-force defense and mobile style snippets; auto-yields the shared pairing service to other remote plugins so coexistence never crashes startup.
description.zh: 远程与移动端安全网关：零改动 DSH 底层代码开放 Tailscale/局域网访问，支持扫码配对、RSA 加密、防暴力破解与移动端样式片段；与其他远程插件共存时自动让出共享配对服务，避免启动崩溃。

description.en: Native iOS and Android apps for remote control of DeepSeek Harness, with end-to-end encryption, workspace browsing, and real-time session updates.
description.zh: 提供 DeepSeek Harness 远程控制功能的原生 iOS/Android 应用，支持端到端加密、工作区浏览和会话实时更新等。

description.en: LAN access for the official DSH Web UI through a gated reverse proxy: DSH keeps its own loopback binding, and a second port adds a password gate, self-signed HTTPS and per-device pairing that can be revoked individually, with a QR code to open it from a phone.
description.zh: 把官方 DSH Web UI 安全地开放到局域网：不改动 DSH 自身的回环绑定，另开一个带密码门禁、自签 HTTPS 与可逐个吊销的设备配对的反向代理端口，并提供手机扫码入口。

description.en: Self-healing Cloudflare quick-tunnel pool for the dsh web GUI: floating widget with QR phone access, generational rotation, chase service worker and prompt-free credential handoff.
description.zh: 为 dsh web GUI 提供自愈式 Cloudflare 快速隧道池：浮窗控件、扫码手机访问、代际轮换、追踪 Service Worker，免提示凭据交接。

description.en: Token-authenticated REST and SSE bridge with QR pairing, so a phone app can read sessions, send messages and approve tool calls.
description.zh: 带令牌鉴权的 REST 与 SSE 接口，扫码配对后可在手机 App 上看会话、发消息、批准工具调用。

plugins.name: dsh-lark-claw

description.en: Feishu/Lark gateway for DeepSeek Harness with topic-persistent conversations, live execution cards, image and file inputs, in-chat approvals and questions, source allowlists, and durable one-time or recurring agent tasks created in natural language.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 网关：按话题持久化会话、实时执行卡片、图片与文件输入、聊天内审批和提问、来源白名单，以及用自然语言创建可持久化的一次性或周期 Agent 任务。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Reach DSH from your phone with a single plugin — requires Tailscale on both the host and the phone. No other configuration needed.
description.zh: 只用一个插件就可以手机访问 DSH——需本机与手机都装好并连上 Tailscale，没有额外设置。

description.en: Customer-machine access plugin for deepseek-harness-gateway: opens a single outbound WebSocket to the gateway and relays the machine local dsh web UI over that tunnel using pairing-code + HMAC auth, so no inbound port, port mapping, or public IP is needed.
description.zh: 客户机接入插件：以单条出站 WebSocket 连接网关，把本机 dsh web 界面经隧道转发给门户，配对接入码 + HMAC 认证；无需入站端口、端口映射或公网 IP。

description.en: Open folders on remote hosts over SSH as Harness workspaces: file tools (read/write/edit/grep/glob) and shell commands run directly on the remote host over SFTP, ripgrep, and ssh2 exec, with no local mirroring, an encrypted multi-host registry, and the local sandbox policy still enforced.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把远程主机目录作为 Harness 工作区打开：read/write/edit/grep/glob 与 shell 命令经 SFTP、ripgrep、ssh2 exec 直接在远程主机执行，不做本地镜像；多主机注册表加密存储，本地沙箱策略依然生效。

description.en: Puts the DSH web UI on a phone browser over your own tailnet, with the remote channel built on Tailscale Serve. Both sides need only Tailscale: no dedicated app, no QR code, no login page, no account of its own, and no relay of your content. The desktop half runs on macOS, Windows or Linux.
description.zh: 让手机浏览器直接使用电脑上的 DSH 网页界面，远程通道建立在 Tailscale Serve 之上。两边除了 Tailscale 不用再装任何东西：没有专用 App、没有二维码、没有登录页，插件不设账号，也不中转你的内容。电脑端支持 macOS、Windows 与 Linux。

description.en: Host-side connector for the DSH Mobile iOS app: dials a self-hostable WSS relay so the phone can reach the DSH sessions on this computer over 4G/5G, without a public IP or a VPN; the relay only authenticates and forwards.
description.zh: DSH Mobile 的电脑侧连接器：连上可自建的公网 WSS 中转，手机在 4G/5G 下即可访问这台电脑上的 DSH 会话，电脑不需要公网 IP 也不用组网；中转只做鉴权与转发。

description.en: Connect the DSHM iPhone/iPad companion to DeepSeek Harness over your local network or Tailscale, with device pairing, session control and file transfers; public TestFlight access to the companion app is pending Apple review.
description.zh: 通过本地网络或 Tailscale，将 DSHM iPhone/iPad 配套应用连接到 DeepSeek Harness，支持设备配对、会话控制和文件传输；配套应用的公开 TestFlight 仍在等待 Apple 审核。

description.en: Source-filtered HTTP/SSE/WebSocket gateway for using the DSH Web UI behind an authenticated reverse proxy, with loopback trust adaptation, in-app host directory selection, and an allowlisted health endpoint.
description.zh: 带精确来源 IP 白名单的 HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 网关，让 DSH Web UI 在带认证反向代理后保持设置、插件与宿主机目录选择功能，并提供白名单健康检查。

description.en: Remotely control DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces from QQ (official Bot API v2, direct chat only): list and switch workspaces, create sessions, compact history, switch models, with streaming, markdown and approval forwarding. Access is not gated per user — anyone who can message the bot controls these sessions, using your model quota and file permissions.
description.zh: 通过 QQ（官方 Bot API v2，仅单聊）远程控制 DeepSeek Harness 会话与工作区：列出/切换工作区、新建会话、压缩历史、切换模型，支持流式输出、Markdown 与审批转发。未做按用户门禁——任何能给该机器人发消息的人都能控制这些会话，消耗你的模型额度与文件权限。

description.en: QQ Official Bot adapter for C2C single chat, interactive action boards, workspace session management, and real-time Web UI sync.
description.zh: QQ 官方单聊机器人适配器：支持交互操作板、工作区会话管理与 Web UI 实时双向同屏。

description.en: Use DSH from your phone anywhere: a self-hosted relay plus a desktop host plugin form a token-authenticated tunnel (order-preserving HTTP reverse proxy + WebSocket bridging) with QR pairing, an admin console for device/token management, and an injected mobile adaptation layer (full-width chat, full-screen settings sheet, sidebar drawer).
description.zh: 随时随地用手机操作 DSH：自托管中继 + 桌面 host 插件组成令牌认证隧道（保序 HTTP 反向代理 + WebSocket 桥接），扫码配对、管理台可管理设备与令牌，并自动注入移动适配层（聊天全宽、设置弹窗全屏、侧栏抽屉化）。

description.en: Forwards a local dsh web UI to the public internet under a *.ds.hn subdomain (or your own self-hosted relay), gated by a login, with optional end-to-end encryption (PBKDF2 to AES-256-GCM).
description.zh: 把本地 dsh 网页通过带登录门禁的中继转发到公网 *.ds.hn 子域名(也可自托管到自己的域名),支持可选的端到端加密(PBKDF2 到 AES-256-GCM)。

description.en: Remote DeepSeek Harness with full server-side API access (`settings.*` / `credentials.*` / `host.listDirectory`). Token-gated reverse proxy, per-device sessions, phone invite QR, fence self-check, optional approval / CIDR / idle timeout / local TLS, WebSocket/SSE.
description.zh: 远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 且服务端 API 完整：转发时改写 Host/Origin，恢复其他方案必定 403 的 settings.* / credentials.* / host.listDirectory。令牌门、按设备会话、可选首访审批。

description.en: macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: agent operates non-browser apps (CapCut, Photoshop, WPS, native clients) like a human — 14 tools for mouse, keyboard, scrolling, app activation, windows and screenshots, plus a vision closed-loop (desktop_see for image understanding + desktop_locate for UI element coordinates) that reuses dsh existing vision credentials. GUI-session service starts on demand, no login autostart.
description.zh: macOS 桌面控制插件：agent 像人一样操作非浏览器应用（剪映/PS/WPS/原生客户端）——14 个工具覆盖鼠标/键盘/滚动/应用/窗口/截图，并整合视觉闭环（desktop_see 识图 + desktop_locate UI 定位坐标，复用 dsh 既有视觉凭据）。服务 GUI 会话按需拉起，非登录自启。

description.en: Multi-server SSH terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: floating terminal window with tabs, side-by-side groups, broadcast, host-owned persistent sessions, and password/private-key/SSH-agent auth.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 多服务器 SSH 终端面板：浮动终端窗口支持标签页、并排组合、广播、宿主侧持久会话，以及密码/私钥/SSH Agent 认证。

plugins.name: pocket-bridge

description.en: Adds a local phone pairing, gateway control, and diagnostic panel for Pocket Bridge in DSH Settings.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里为 Pocket Bridge 提供本机手机配对、网关控制与诊断面板。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 2.5.4.10 for network access

description.en: Phone and remote access to the DSH Web UI: scan a LAN QR code, or reach your PC from anywhere through a self-hosted relay server you run yourself instead of a cloudflared tunnel. Per-device credentials that pair, list, and revoke individually, and several PCs sharing one relay with automatic failover.
description.zh: 手机与远程访问 DSH Web 界面：局域网扫码即用，或用自建 relay 中继服务端（替代 cloudflared 隧道）随时随地连回电脑；每台设备独立凭据，可配对、查看与单独撤销；多台电脑共用一个中继并自动热备。

plugins.name: dshm-plugin

description.en: Connects the DSHM Android client to computer-hosted DeepSeek Harness sessions for remote chat, model switching, and approvals with device pairing and revocation.
description.zh: 将 DSHM 安卓客户端连接到电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 会话，支持远程续聊、模型切换、审批、设备配对与撤销。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-zen-remote

description.en: Pairing-code remote access for DSH: a phone-first PWA with Web Push, plus a client role that operates the host's shared sessions in the native DSH interface, behind your own reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel.
description.zh: 配对码远程访问 DSH：手机端可安装 PWA、带 Web Push 推送；另一台设备作为客户端，在原生 DSH 界面里直接操作主机共享的会话，经自建反代或 Cloudflare Tunnel 接入。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to relay.local

description.en: Use SSH hosts and WSL distributions as remote DSH workspaces, with environment setup, model configuration porting, and the remote interface embedded locally.
description.zh: 将 SSH 主机与 WSL 发行版接入远程 DSH 工作区，支持环境安装、模型配置移植与本地内嵌远程界面。

description.en: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure (LAN HTTP) contexts.
description.zh: 局域网访问：Web GUI 绑定 0.0.0.0 + crypto.randomUUID polyfill（修复非安全上下文下 RPC 崩溃）。

description.en: Connects the DeepSeek Harness agent running on your own computer to the HarnessMate platform, so you can chat with it, exchange files and approve its tool calls from a phone or a browser.
description.zh: 把跑在本机的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入 HarnessMate 平台：手机 / 浏览器即可对话、收发文件、审批工具调用。

plugins.name: ds-harness-remote

description.en: Multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness and supported coding workspaces through an end-to-end encrypted channel, with adaptive Relay/WebRTC transport, device authorization, workspace files, read-only previews, terminals, and optional Codex Remote.
description.zh: 通过端到端加密通道远程访问 DeepSeek Harness 及兼容的编码工作区，支持自适应 Relay/WebRTC 传输、设备授权、工作区文件、只读预览、终端和可选的 Codex Remote。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.ietf.org
uses literal IP 1.3.101.110 for network access

description.en: Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and registers remote ports on the server, multi-user safe, with an audit view.
description.zh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

plugins.name: dsh-api-gateway

description.en: REST + SSE gateway exposing running Harness sessions to third-party clients: API-key auth, token streaming, workspace grouping, and adopting GUI sessions to keep chatting.
description.zh: 为第三方客户端提供 REST + SSE 网关：API 密钥鉴权、token 流式回包、会话工作区分组，并可接管 GUI 会话继续对话。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to ohdsh-internal

description.en: Remote access and mobile sync bridge for DSH iOS App with QR pairing, screen-lock resume, and tunnel management.
description.zh: 专为 DSH iOS App 与移动端协同打造的远程连接插件，支持扫码配对、锁屏恢复与隧道管理。

description.en: Mirrors an Android phone or tablet into the DSH right sidebar over adb with mouse and keyboard control, keeping videos, clips and chats next to the desktop instead of in your hand; Opus audio needs Android 11+, Windows only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏通过 adb 投屏并反控安卓手机/平板，视频、短视频和聊天留在电脑上，在工位上不必再拿手机；声音转发需 Android 11+，仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Mobile pairing remote for DeepSeek Harness: E2EE companion over dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN, Tailscale, optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动配对远程插件：双平面白名单 RPC 上的端到端加密 Companion（局域网、Tailscale，可选 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 或自建 rendezvous）。

description.en: Configurable LAN access for the DSH Web GUI: a settings tab binds the server to all interfaces, trusts only the addresses you configure, sets the browser session lifetime or removes the token login, and repairs the settings layer on non-loopback visits.
description.zh: 可配置的 DSH Web GUI 局域网访问：设置页开启后绑定全部网卡，只信任你配置的访问地址，可调整浏览器会话有效期或去掉 token 登录，并修复非回环访问时的设置层。

description.en: Fleet console for DeepSeek Harness: one local dsh page manages many remote dsh machines — live idle/running status, in-place switching without new tabs, keep-alive iframes, cross-device session reading, one-click refresh/restart, and a controller/managed role split.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多机指挥台：用一个本地 dsh 页面管理多台远程 dsh——实时查看远程忙闲、免切标签页原地切换与使用、远程页面保活秒开、跨设备读取历史会话、一键刷新/重启，并支持控制端/被控端角色。

description.en: Android companion bridge: QR-code LAN pairing with revocable device tokens and TLS fingerprints, a phone-connection and device-management panel, and an HTTPS access proxy serving sessions, live events and approvals to the paired native app.
description.zh: Android 配套桥接：局域网扫码配对（可吊销的设备 Token 与 TLS 指纹）、手机连接与设备管理面板，以及向配对原生 App 提供会话、实时事件与审批的 HTTPS 接入代理。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness outbound traffic through a local Clash proxy, with automatic fallback to direct when the proxy is off.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的出网流量走本地 Clash 代理，代理关闭时自动回落直连。

description.en: Connects DSH and VS Code for a Claude Code for VS Code style experience, continuing the same workspace and conversation right inside VS Code: install the DSH Coding Agent extension and the plugin discovers and connects automatically on the same Windows machine, or connect manually elsewhere by pasting the copied connection address.
description.zh: 把 DSH 和 VS Code 连接起来，提供类似 Claude Code for VS Code 的使用体验，直接在 VS Code 中接续同一工作区与同一会话：下载 VS Code 扩展 DSH Coding Agent，插件在 Windows 同机会自动发现并连接，其他平台可复制连接地址后手动连接。

description.en: Remote-SSH-style workspaces: turn an SSH host and a remote directory into a native DSH workspace; the agent operates the remote filesystem directly via 12 rw_* tools (SFTP/exec), with workspace-confined paths and known_hosts verification.
description.zh: Remote-SSH 风格工作区：把 SSH 主机上的远程目录变成原生 DSH 工作区，agent 通过 12 个 rw_* 工具（SFTP/exec）直接操作远程文件，路径限定在工作区内并校验 known_hosts。

description.en: Drive a DSH instance from another device: a host plugin opens a token-authenticated TCP port that a single-file Python CLI drives - listing and creating sessions, sending prompts with images, streaming replies, and switching models, permissions and workspaces.
description.zh: 从另一台设备驱动 DSH：Host 插件开一个 token 鉴权的 TCP 端口，单文件 Python CLI 负责列会话、建会话、发带图消息、看流式回复，以及切模型、权限与工作区。

description.en: A QR-code button above Settings that lets phones connect to the web UI through an auth-gated reverse proxy.
description.zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: works well on narrow screens, fits wide screens too.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：窄屏好用，宽屏适用。

description.en: Server card dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm.js SSH terminals; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right drawer.
description.zh: DSH 服务器卡片仪表盘：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU、内存、磁盘与延迟，点卡片进入 xterm.js SSH 终端；支持导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧抽屉。

description.en: Remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: pick an SSH host in the sidebar, mount a server directory over SFTP as a workspace, then read, write and edit those files with the normal file tools. Remote watch is polled so the file tree refreshes, image/binary previews work through byte-range reads, and remote_exec, remote_search and remote_git give agents the remote shell, search and git queries. An opt-in patch routes the agent's own bash/pwsh commands to the server. Every remote write and command follows the session sandbox mode and approval policy, and hosts are managed by the plugin itself (password, key or SSH agent).
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的远程工作区：在侧栏选 SSH 主机，通过 SFTP 把服务器目录挂载成工作区，随后用普通文件工具直接读写远端文件；远端 watch 用轮询实现（文件树自动刷新），图片/二进制预览走字节区间读取，remote_exec / remote_search / remote_git 分别提供远端命令、搜索与 git 查询；可选补丁把 agent 自己的 bash/pwsh 命令也路由到服务器；远端写入与命令都遵循会话的 sandbox 模式与审批策略；主机凭据由插件自带的「主机」库维护（密码、私钥或 SSH agent）。

description.en: Remote control and mobile overlay for DeepSeek Harness: LAN and public (cloudflared) tunnels with QR-code access, a phone-first mobile UI under 768px, and a LAN reverse-proxy CLI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的远程控制与移动端覆盖层：局域网与公网（cloudflared）隧道 + 二维码接入、768px 以下的手机端界面，附局域网反向代理 CLI。

description.en: Remote-control DeepSeek Harness from a HarmonyOS phone: list, switch and create sessions; send prompts (the phone follows the host's busy-enter behaviour, queue or steer); stream assistant text, reasoning and tool steps; answer approval requests and questions; view session images as inline thumbnails with on-demand full-size fetch; switch model and reasoning effort; cancel running tasks; receive push notifications. Traffic is end-to-end encrypted (AES-256-GCM with HKDF-SHA256 key derivation) and travels through a dumb-pipe relay that only sees ciphertext; v1.1.3 adds a session-epoch anti-replay handshake and optional native TLS for the relay. The relay can be hosted on the local machine (managed by the plugin) or on a VPS; the phone app and the plugin ship in one repository. 5 Remote methods.
description.zh: 用 HarmonyOS 手机遥控 DeepSeek Harness：浏览/切换/新建会话；发送提示词（手机跟随宿主的繁忙行为，排队或插话）；流式接收正文、思考与工具步骤；应答审批请求与提问；查看会话图片（缩略图内联 + 大图按需拉取）；切换模型与思考强度；取消运行中的任务；接收推送通知。流量端到端加密（HKDF-SHA256 派生密钥 + AES-256-GCM），经只转发密文的哑管道中继；v1.1.3 增加会话纪元抗重放握手与中继原生 TLS。中继可跑在本机（由插件托管）或 VPS 上；手机 App 与插件同仓库发布。5 个 Remote 方法。

plugins.name: dsh-winrm

description.en: Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM client so the machine running dsh needs no Python.
description.zh: andyfan1094/dsh-winrm 的 Node.js 分支：同样的 WinRM 主机面板与七个 agent 工具，后端从 Python/pywinrm 移植到原生 Node WinRM 客户端，运行 dsh 的机器不再需要 Python。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.dmtf.org

description.en: Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app's own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.
description.zh: 飞书/Lark 深度通道：原生思考过程消息、审批卡片、goal/todo 实时卡片、workflow 展开行、会话全文检索、后台任务与子代理结算通知。其设计以飞书应用自身的可见性范围为访问边界——凡是应用允许触达的人都能驱动 agent 并回答它的审批请求，除非填写可选的发送者/群组/审批人白名单收窄。

description.en: Deploys the qq-bridge engine to a remote host over SSH and wires it into DeepSeek Harness: environment check, config generation that keeps credentials out of the repo, systemd units for the bridge plus daily-archive, today-sync and watchdog timers, and four tools to check, configure, deploy and inspect the install. Adds a lite reply mode that calls the DeepSeek chat completions API directly, switchable persona cards, image and video understanding, and keyword search over archived group chats.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 把 qq-bridge 引擎部署到远程主机并接入 DeepSeek Harness：环境体检、不把密钥写进仓库的配置生成、桥接主进程与每日归档/当天同步/看门狗三个定时器的 systemd 单元，以及体检、生成配置、部署、看状态四个工具。另带 lite 回复模式（直连 DeepSeek chat completions）、可切换人格卡、图片与视频理解、可按关键词检索的群聊冷存储。

description.en: Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud / self-hosted / WeChat-bot tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas; the WeChat bot channel is bound by QR scan and pushes task-finished / error / stopped events to WeChat, where one number in reply approves or denies a pending decision and continues the current task — WeChat messages travel only between Tencent ilink and the local bridge, never through the relay.
description.zh: 手机浏览器远程控制 dsh web，人在哪都能用（免公网 IP）：官方托管中继 4G 即用，也可自建 relay；一条命令安装电脑端 bridge 与设置页「远程控制」面板（云端 / 自建 / 微信机器人三个 tab、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）；隧道数据面端到端加密（E2EE：手机↔电脑端正文与 WS 内容加密，中继只见路由元数据；支持扫码/一次性链接桌面授权，免重复输密码）；HTTP/WebSocket 全量透传，访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额；微信机器人通道扫码绑定后，把任务完成 / 出错 / 停下推送到微信，需要拍板时回一个数字即可放行或拒绝，回话可直接继续当前任务——微信消息只经腾讯 ilink 与本机 bridge，不经中继。

description.en: Patched build of dsh-pocket for DeepSeek Harness: the access password is embedded in the QR code so the phone signs in with one scan, a read-only /dsh-pocket/entry.json endpoint lets the app re-sync the current public URL and password from the LAN, and LAN / Tailscale / Cloudflare routes fail over automatically. This is a patched derivative of shaobeichen/dsh-pocket — install it instead of the upstream plugin, never alongside it.
description.zh: dsh-pocket 的增强版：访问密码直接写进二维码，手机扫一次即可登录；新增只读接口 /dsh-pocket/entry.json，手机 App 在局域网时就能同步当前公网地址与密码；内网 / Tailscale / Cloudflare 三条链路按顺序探测、断线自动切换。这是 shaobeichen/dsh-pocket 的补丁版，请替代上游安装，不要与上游同装。

plugins.name: CHENGXIAO

description.en: Pairs two DeepSeek Harness machines with a one-time code - directly on a LAN, or across networks through an end-to-end-encrypted relay with a zero-config official default - so one agent can run tasks and exchange files on the other while each machine keeps its own files in place.
description.zh: 用一次性配对码把两台 DeepSeek Harness 机器连起来——局域网直连，或跨网络经端到端加密中继（默认自带官方中继，零配置）——让一边的 agent 在另一边执行任务、交换文件，各自文件都留在本机。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to 8.134.255.221:7332

description.en: LAN-only remote access for DSH: pair a phone or another PC by QR code or token to open the same web UI, with optional key-free access inside the LAN.
description.zh: 仅内网的远程访问：手机或另一台电脑通过扫码或令牌接入同一份 DSH Web 界面，并可选内网免密钥直连。

description.en: Exposes the local DSH web GUI to one chosen CIDR range only (Tailscale by default) instead of binding 0.0.0.0: the proxy listens on addresses inside that range, rejects peers outside it, and admits clients by either a tokenised URL or a 4-12 character alphanumeric access code. Remote pages can be forced into a phone layout without changing the local UI, and the official appearance, font size, transcript view, code view and performance settings can be stored in the plugin config and re-applied on every remote page load.
description.zh: 只把本机 DSH 网页界面开放给指定的一个网段（默认 Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10），不绑 0.0.0.0：网段外的对端一律拒绝，进入方式可选带票网址或 4–12 位数字/字母访问密码；远程页面可强制手机布局而不动本机界面，官方「通用设置」里的外观 / 字号大小 / 工作步骤展示 / 显示代码工作视图 / 性能与用量可存进本插件配置，并在每次打开远程页面时重新套用。

description.en: Dynamically trusts every Host header that actually arrives and flips the default web binding to 0.0.0.0: wildcard or unenumerable entry domains work without editing the start command, the authentication layer is untouched, and hosts are evicted by LRU beyond a capacity cap.
description.zh: 动态信任所有实际到达的 Host 并把 web 默认绑定翻转为 0.0.0.0：泛域名等无法枚举的入口免改启动命令，认证层不动，超出容量的 Host 按 LRU 淘汰。

description.en: Bridges WeChat (ilink bot) private chats into DSH agent sessions and streams replies back, with hot-plug and a Settings tab.
description.zh: 把微信私聊桥接进 DSH agent 会话并流式回传回复，支持热插拔与设置页签。

description.en: Turns a DSH deployment into one node of a decentralized agent network — signed agent cards, peer and zone discovery, direct message-routing model tools, and joinable session nodes in the web sidebar.
description.zh: 把 DSH 部署变成去中心化 agent 网络中的一个节点——签名 agent 卡片、peer 与 zone 发现、直连消息路由模型工具，以及 Web 侧栏可加入的会话节点。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the hosted Local Commander MCP server at localcmd.app via mcp-remote with browser sign-in, to read files and Git, run the checks you approve and check local services on your Windows computers. Requires a Local Commander account and the paired agent running on the Windows PC.
description.zh: 通过 mcp-remote 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 localcmd.app 上托管的 Local Commander MCP 服务（浏览器登录），在你的 Windows 电脑上读文件、查 Git、执行你批准的检查并探测本地服务。需 Local Commander 账号，且配对的 agent 要跑在那台 Windows 电脑上。

description.en: Drive a real Android phone from DSH: screenshots, taps, swipes, typing and app launching. Requires Python 3.10+ with aiohttp and mcp on the computer side, plus the AutoX.js script running on the phone with screen-capture and accessibility permissions; the phone long-polls your machine, so no public port and no relay server.
description.zh: 让 DSH 里的 Agent 直接操作安卓手机：看屏幕、点按滑动、打字、开应用。需要电脑侧 Python 3.10+ 并安装 aiohttp 与 mcp，手机侧运行 AutoX.js 脚本并授予屏幕录制与无障碍权限；手机主动长轮询本机，不开公网端口、不经中转。

description.en: Shows how many GPUs on the dsh-remote host are free in the conversation header, and per-GPU utilization, memory, temperature and the owning user in a right-sidebar panel. Adds a remote_gpu tool that returns the same snapshot.
description.zh: 在会话顶栏显示 dsh-remote 所连服务器还有几张空闲显卡，右侧边栏面板展示每张卡的利用率、显存、温度与占用用户，并提供返回同一快照的 remote_gpu 工具。

description.en: Mobile remote pairing for DSH with QR offers, a loopback Host Gateway, encrypted Relay or Quick Tunnel transport, same-LAN WebRTC Direct, and revocable Device Tokens for the Android client.
description.zh: DSH 手机远程配对：提供二维码 offer、回环 Host Gateway、加密 Relay 或 Quick Tunnel、同网 WebRTC Direct，以及可撤销的 Android Device Token。

description.en: Federates a local DeepSeek Harness and multiple remote hosts into the official sidebar: remote workspaces and sessions appear as native rows, open in the official chat pane, and execute entirely on the remote host over HTTP/TLS. Remote hosts need no plugin and the UI is not iframed.
description.zh: 把本机与多台远端 DeepSeek Harness 聚合进官方侧栏：远端工作区/会话作为原生行出现、由官方中栏打开，执行始终留在远端，经 HTTP/TLS 直连。远端无需安装插件，界面不使用 iframe。

plugins.name: dsh-ssh-tunnel

description.en: Multi-host SSH workbench: keep remote servers in a host library, grant them per project, and open an interactive terminal or dual-pane SFTP in the right sidebar, while the SSHManager tool runs remote commands and transfers files without exposing keys to the model.
description.zh: 多机 SSH 工作台：把远程服务器收进主机库、按项目授权，在右侧栏里开交互式终端或双栏 SFTP；模型用 SSHManager 工具远程执行命令、上传下载文件，密钥不进模型上下文。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 1.2.3.4 for network access

description.en: Bot-to-bot messaging across machines on top of ds-harness-remote: five tools let a local Bot list the peer Host Bots, pin a target device and send it a message, without switching the local window.
description.zh: 基于 ds-harness-remote 的跨机器 Bot 传话：五个工具让本地 Bot 列出对端 Bot、固定目标设备并给它发消息，不用切换本地窗口。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：紧凑排版、全宽输入卡（含光标修复）、抽屉式侧边栏（点击遮罩关闭）、两页式设置流程、响应式表格与统计、安全触控目标。

description.en: Use DSH from a phone browser. Turn on phone access from the phone button in the session header (or the plugin card) and scan the QR code; the phone opens the official DSH web UI served by the desktop process, with the same sessions updating live, so you can follow a running task, reply and approve away from the computer. A gateway inside DSH (port 18765) proxies the web UI and handles the desktop login itself. One QR code works on Wi-Fi and on mobile data: turning access on also starts a free Cloudflare quick tunnel (cloudflared is downloaded from Cloudflare's GitHub releases if missing), and its address survives DSH restarts, so phones do not need to rescan. Pairing codes are one-time and expire in 10 minutes, each phone gets its own revocable credential, the header button shows when a phone is connected, and idle connections get keepalive pings. Optional push notifications go to Bark, ntfy, ServerChan, Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk group bots, Telegram or any webhook when a task finishes (after 30 seconds or more), stops with an error, or waits for an approval or an answer; they carry only the session title and status, and approval still happens in DSH. On a phone the web UI's side panels slide over the page, and it can be added to the home screen with its own icon.
description.zh: 在手机浏览器里用 DSH。点会话顶栏的手机按钮（或插件设置卡）打开手机访问、扫二维码，手机就打开电脑上 DSH 进程提供的官方网页界面，会话相同、实时同步，人不在电脑前也能跟进正在跑的任务、回消息、点批准。DSH 里内置一个网关（端口 18765）转发网页界面，并替手机处理桌面端登录。一个二维码在 Wi-Fi 和流量下都能扫：打开手机访问时顺带开 Cloudflare 免费快速隧道（没有 cloudflared 会从 Cloudflare 官方 GitHub 发布页下载），DSH 重启后地址不变，手机不用重扫。配对码一次性、10 分钟过期，每台手机一张凭证、可随时移除，顶栏按钮显示手机是否已连接，空闲连接自动保活。可选推送到手机：任务跑完（30 秒以上）、出错停下、等批准或等回答时，发到 Bark、ntfy、Server酱、飞书 / 企业微信 / 钉钉群机器人、Telegram 或任意 Webhook；通知只带会话标题和状态，批准仍在 DSH 里点。手机上网页界面的左右两栏改成盖在页面上，可以带图标添加到主屏幕。

description.en: Native Harness workbench and local gateway for Dot to read saved projects and conversations, dispatch native tasks, inspect progress, continue or cancel tasks, and manage connection authorization.
description.zh: 通过原生 Harness 工作台和本机网关，让 Dot 读取已保存项目与会话、派发原生任务、查看进度、继续或取消任务，并管理连接授权。

description.en: Bridges WeChat private chats into DSH, with two-way text, image, file, audio and video messaging and slash commands for sessions, workspaces, models, permissions and more; the goal is DSH's native experience inside WeChat.
description.zh: 将微信私聊消息桥接到 DSH，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频的双向传输，用 slash 命令管理会话、工作区、模型、权限等等，目标是在微信端还原 DSH 的原生体验。

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-mesh

description.en: Discovers other DSH instances on the local network by UDP multicast or port scan, lists them in a sidebar panel together with the capabilities each one reports, and dispatches tasks between machines in both directions over the LAN or over an automatically downloaded userspace Tailscale node.
description.zh: 通过 UDP 组播或端口扫描发现局域网内的其他 DSH 实例，在侧栏面板中列出它们以及各自上报的能力，并可经局域网或自动下载的用户态 Tailscale 节点在两台机器之间双向派发任务。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 239.255.42.98 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-reach

description.en: Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push service.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的审批卡与提问卡推送到 IM 渠道（先支持微信），可在聊天里直接作答，带会话控制台、逐渠道安全与开放推送服务。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-devices

description.en: Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.
description.zh: 去中心化多设备舰队：mDNS 同网发现、密钥配对、SSH 跨网直连指挥。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 224.0.0.251 for network access

description.en: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.
description.zh: 在设置中扫描二维码，通过 cloudflared 快速隧道在手机上于当前会话中打开 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。

description.en: Your phone, live in the DSH right sidebar: one UI read costs 120 ms and 200-1300 tokens, where a screenshot costs 0.5-3.2 s and 1.5-2k image tokens; a tap lands on the real device in 61 ms, and a circled area comes back with its controls. You can tell what is on screen, and whether a tap landed, without a screenshot. Needs adb and ffmpeg on the host; the OCR fallback is macOS-only.
description.zh: 手机装进 DSH 右栏：读一次界面 120 ms、200-1300 token，截图那套要 0.5-3.2 s、1.5-2k 图片 token；点一下就是点真机（61 ms），圈一处带圈图和控件回到会话。不截图也能说清屏上有什么、刚才那下点中了没有。需要宿主上的 adb 与 ffmpeg；OCR 兜底仅支持 macOS。

description.en: A separate narrow-screen web surface for DeepSeek Harness rather than the desktop GUI scaled down: it serves its own session list and chat stream behind a random access token over LAN, a tunnel (cloudflared, localtunnel or localhost.run) or an SSH reverse forward through a server you own. On the phone it streams assistant text, thinking, tool calls and results, sends prompts, stops the running turn, answers blocking questions and tool approvals (including ones waiting in other sessions), switches model, thinking level and permission preset, sends up to four photos compressed on the device, and keeps the computer awake.
description.zh: 为 DSH 单独做的窄屏移动端 Web 服务，不是把桌面 GUI 缩放塞进手机：自带会话列表与聊天流，随机访问令牌保护，可走局域网、cloudflared / localtunnel / localhost.run 隧道或自有服务器 SSH 反向转发。手机上流式看助手文本、思考、工具调用与结果，能发提示词、停止当前回合、回答阻塞提问与工具审批（含其它会话里等待的），切换模型 / 思考等级 / 权限预置，发送最多 4 张手机上压缩过的照片，并可一键让电脑常亮。

plugins.name: dsh-lan-gateway

description.en: Publishes the DSH Web GUI to LAN or internet with dsh kept on loopback. Every source must sign in for an HMAC session cookie unless passwordless LAN is opted into. Adds self-signed or custom TLS, a secureCookies override for plaintext-HTTP proxies, and a UUID shim for plain-HTTP origins.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web GUI 发布到局域网/公网，dsh 仍只绑定回环。除显式开启局域网免密外，所有来源均须登录换取 HMAC 会话 Cookie。提供自签名或自定义 TLS、用于明文 HTTP 代理的 secureCookies 覆盖项，以及让局域网纯 HTTP 来源正常打开工作区的 UUID shim。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 2.5.4.3 for network access

description.en: Provides a secure reverse proxy, enabling DeepSeek Harness to be accessed remotely and to converse with AI anytime, anywhere.
description.zh: 提供安全的反向代理，使DeepSeek Harness可以远程访问，随时随地和AI对话。

description.en: Bridge DeepSeek Harness sessions to Cherry Studio desktops over the LAN - QR pairing, 14 cherry_* tools for agents/sessions/history/interactions, and a settings page for devices and per-workspace tool scope.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 会话桥接到局域网内的 Cherry Studio 桌面端——二维码配对、14 个 cherry_* 工具（agent/会话/历史/交互）与设置页（设备管理、按工作区的工具启用范围）。

description.en: Access DeepSeek Harness from the Android app or a mobile browser with secure LAN and remote connections, persistent device pairing, and a customizable mobile interface.
description.zh: 通过 Android App 或手机浏览器访问 DeepSeek Harness，支持安全局域网连接、远程访问、持久设备配对和可自定义移动界面。

plugins.name: dsh-ssh-vault
