description.en: Store SSH hosts in an AES-256-GCM vault and let the agent run commands on them by alias, with passwords handed to ssh through SSH_ASKPASS instead of the command line. Windows only.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机存进 AES-256-GCM 加密保险库，智能体按别名执行命令，口令经 SSH_ASKPASS 交给 ssh 而不进入命令行。仅支持 Windows。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: WeChat Official Account channel for DSH — WeChat messages run agent turns and the answers are pushed back through the customer-service message API, with signature-checked callbacks and an openid allowlist.
description.zh: 微信公众号通道：微信消息触发 DSH 会话，回答经客服消息接口推回微信，回调带签名校验与 openid 白名单。

description.en: Remote access gateway for the DSH Web GUI: login auth plus an HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy to the loopback server, no --trusted-host needed.
description.zh: DSH Web 远程访问网关：登录鉴权 + 到本机服务的 HTTP/WebSocket 反向代理，无需 --trusted-host。

description.en: Use a directory on an SSH host as a DSH workspace — hosts management, directory browser, five agent tools.
description.zh: 通过SSH方式，将远程主机的文件夹当成DSH的工作区，可以在本地DSH控制远程主机工作目录，不需要手动同步、不需要挂载驱动、不需要装任何第三方文件系统

description.en: Fork of @linxin666/dsh-ssh (the two cannot be enabled at the same time): resolves an SSH host by its NIC MAC address before dialing, so DHCP address changes stop breaking saved hosts.
description.zh: 基于 @linxin666/dsh-ssh 的二次开发（两者不能同时启用）：建链前先按网卡 MAC 把主机解析成当前 IP，DHCP 换号不用改配置。

description.en: Web management panel for Docker on DeepSeek Harness: manages Docker MCP servers (deploy/remove, official catalog search/pull, gateway start-stop-restart, custom deploy) and containers/images (list, start/stop/restart, remove, logs, inspect, interactive terminal, create, pull, build, load) across local CLI and SSH remote targets with one-click switching. Credentials are encrypted with Windows DPAPI, HTTP is loopback-only, and command parameters are whitelist-filtered. Build-free pure ESM; client is zero-dependency.
description.zh: dsh-docker 是 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Docker 管理面板插件：支持本机 CLI 与 SSH 远端多目标一键切换，统一管理 Docker MCP（部署/移除/搜索官方 Catalog/启停重启 Gateway/自定义部署）与容器镜像（启停/删除/日志/详情/交互式终端/新建/构建/导入）。凭据经 Windows DPAPI 加密存储，HTTP 仅限本机 loopback 访问，命令参数白名单防注入；免构建、纯 ESM、Client 零依赖。

description.en: Multi-machine, multi-agent orchestration and control plane for DSH: discovers Agents and workspaces across devices, routes tasks by machine, repository, capability, and load to local or remote Agent runtimes, streams progress and results, forwards approvals, and recovers durable tasks after disconnections.
description.zh: DSH 的多机多 Agent 编排与控制平台：发现各设备上的 Agent 与工作区，按机器、仓库、能力和负载将任务路由到本地或远程 Agent Runtime，统一回传进度、审批与结果，并在断线后恢复持久任务。

description.en: Expose local listening ports as public HTTPS URLs via Cloudflare Tunnel, with automatic DNS management and one-click token template authorization.
description.zh: 通过 Cloudflare Tunnel 将本地监听端口暴露为公网 HTTPS 预览链接，支持自动管理 DNS 记录与一键模板创建 API Token。

plugins.name: dsh-my-phone

description.en: Lets a phone reach the DeepSeek Harness desktop over a LAN address or a Cloudflare quick tunnel, with QR pairing, a live session feed, approval prompts and a floating desktop widget. Both entry points (LAN and the Cloudflare quick tunnel) start enabled by default; each phone pairs with its own token.
description.zh: 让手机连上本机的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版：局域网或 Cloudflare 隧道二维码配对，实时消息列表与授权提醒，桌面悬浮球。局域网与 Cloudflare 隧道两个入口默认都开启；每台手机用自己的配对令牌。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to placeholder

description.en: SSH host manager for DeepSeek Harness: browse ~/.ssh/config, store AES-256-GCM encrypted passwords, run batch commands and SFTP, and open interactive PTY terminals in persistent sidebar tabs.
description.zh: DSH 的 SSH 主机管理插件：浏览 ~/.ssh/config，保存 AES-256-GCM 加密密码，执行批量命令与 SFTP，并在可保持的侧边栏标签页中打开交互式 PTY 终端。

description.en: Standalone remote Web UI for DeepSeek Harness with mobile viewport, soft-keyboard and touch-target adaptations while leaving the native Desktop presentation unchanged.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 独立远程 Web UI：适配手机视口、软键盘与触控热区，同时保持原生桌面端界面不变。

description.en: Device channel between the agent and your own phone: it sends files it just produced, and you @-reference what your phone sent back. End-to-end encrypted P2P through the SwarmDrop CLI, with no account and no public IP; node status, paired devices and QR pairing sit in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 在 agent 和你自己的手机之间开一条设备通道：agent 把刚产出的文件发过去，手机传回来的东西可以在输入框里 @ 引用。底层经 SwarmDrop CLI 走端到端加密的 P2P，不需要账号，也不需要公网 IP；节点状态、已配对设备与扫码配对都在侧边栏面板里。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness to shared AgentsChat rooms over MCP and WebSocket wake bridge for cross-agent messaging, peer code review, proposals, voting, and OKRs.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 与 WebSocket 唤醒桥接将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 AgentsChat 共享房间，支持跨宿主多 Agent 通信、代码互审、提案投票与 OKR 协同。

plugins.name: dsh-remote-ssh-tools

description.en: SSH session manager for DeepSeek Harness: saved profiles, agent ssh_run, interactive terminals, and SFTP with secrets kept in the DSH credential center.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SSH 会话管理：连接档案、Agent 远程执行、交互终端与 SFTP；秘密仅存于 DSH 凭据中心。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Turns a phone into a personal assistant for the DeepSeek Harness on your computer — pair once by QR code, then chat, send photos and files, watch replies stream, and collaborate from several phones at once over LAN, Tailscale or a public tunnel. Ships an Android app, an iOS build pipeline and a zero-install web/PWA client for HarmonyOS and iOS browsers.
description.zh: 把手机变成你这台电脑上 DeepSeek Harness 的个人助理——扫一次码即可远程聊天、收发图片与文件、看回复流式输出，多台手机还能在同一会话里协作；连接方式可选局域网 / Tailscale / 公网隧道。附带安卓安装包、iOS 构建流水线，以及鸿蒙和 iOS 浏览器可直接用的网页版客户端。

description.en: Control Proxmox VE virtual machines from the conversation: 16 tools for the VM console over VNC (screenshots, mouse, keyboard, batched actions, Unicode text and clipboard) and for running commands and reading or writing files through the QEMU guest agent, all over one ssh connection to the node, so the host needs no X11 or Wayland.
description.zh: 在对话里控制 Proxmox VE 虚拟机：16 个工具，既能通过 VNC 操作 VM 控制台（截图、鼠标、键盘、批量动作、Unicode 文本与剪贴板），也能经 QEMU guest agent 执行命令、读写文件；全部走一条到节点的 ssh 连接，宿主无需 X11 或 Wayland。

description.en: Bridge an official QQ bot to DeepSeek Harness in-process: a QQ message starts or resumes a real DSH session inside the host (it appears in the desktop sidebar when its working directory is a registered workspace) and the answer is sent back to QQ as text, image or file. Requires a QQ official bot application (AppID + AppSecret).
description.zh: 把 QQ 官方机器人接到 DSH 进程内：QQ 里发消息直接开一轮真实会话（工作目录是已登记工作区时，桌面端左侧能看到、能续聊），结果以文本、图片或文件回传 QQ。需一个 QQ 官方机器人应用（AppID + AppSecret）。

description.en: Hosts QQ chats as DeepSeek Harness sessions: one QQ conversation maps to one DSH session that survives restarts, per-speaker tool permissions, three-layer memory with nightly consolidation, optional QQ-number binding that ties openids to QQ numbers so memories survive a bot or AppID change (binding is voluntary, never required, and never guessed from nicknames), four-section personas, context compaction, a ten-page sidebar panel, and a setup wizard that installs the Roost kernel and ai-chat plugin. Anyone in a paired QQ group can chat with the bot by default; only the owner gets the full local toolset.
description.zh: 把 QQ 会话接进 DeepSeek Harness：一个 QQ 会话对应一个 DSH 会话、重启后映射保留，按说话人分档收放本地工具，三层记忆（事实 / 日记 / 图谱）+ 凌晨巩固，可选的 QQ 号绑定把 openid 对上 QQ 号 / 群号，换机器人（换 AppID）后旧记忆照样读得到（绑定完全自愿、非必需，昵称候选只提示不自动绑），人格四段式，上下文压缩，侧栏十页面板，接入向导会自动装好 Roost 内核与 ai-chat 插件。接好的 QQ 群里任何人都能和机器人聊天；只有主人拿得到完整的本地工具。

description.en: SSH terminals, SFTP file transfer and text editing inside DeepSeek Harness, with server troubleshooting through host models.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内使用 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件传输与文本编辑，并通过宿主模型排查服务器问题。

description.en: Embeds a remote DeepSeek Harness GUI in the local DSH window over an SSH tunnel, lists the remote sessions, and switches between the local instance and any remote host.
description.zh: 通过 SSH 隧道把远端 DSH 的 GUI 嵌进本地 DSH 界面，列出远端会话，并在本地实例与任意远端主机之间切换。

description.en: A2A protocol server for dsh agents, with JSON-RPC tasks, SSE streaming, cancellation, and an agent card.
description.zh: 为 dsh agent 提供 A2A 协议服务，支持 JSON-RPC 任务、SSE 流式输出、取消任务和 agent card。

description.en: Private loopback DSH Web gateway for Tailscale Serve, Cloudflare Access, and Headscale TCP Serve, with exact principal allowlists and guided fail-closed setup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供仅回环的私有网关，支持 Tailscale Serve、Cloudflare Access 与 Headscale TCP Serve，精确主体白名单，引导式 fail-closed 配置。

description.en: SSH workspace and operations for DeepSeek Harness: bind a server directory as a workspace whose fs/subprocess calls route to the remote host via cordis seam replacement, plus web terminal, file transfers, tunnels, cluster runs and host management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 工作区与运维：把服务器目录绑定为工作区，fs/命令经 cordis seam 替换透明路由到远端主机，并带 Web 终端、文件传输、隧道、集群执行与主机管理。

description.en: Drive DSH from anything that speaks HTTP: 47 routes (REST + SSE) for workspaces, sessions (create/prompt, live SSE generation, history, stats, todos, cancel, ask-user Q&A), models and the global default model, providers, agent presets, settings namespaces, skills, and workspace files including resumable chunked upload — plus an OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions, a built-in OpenAPI 3.0 spec and an interactive request page. It only injects the host webServer and tools, so it rides on the DSH webserver (default prefix /api/v1) or its own port with optional API-key auth, and it ships a skill that teaches the DSH agent to call the API.
description.zh: 让任何会说 HTTP 的东西驱动 DSH：47 条路由（REST + SSE），覆盖工作区、会话（创建/提示、SSE 实时生成、历史、统计、任务清单、中止、问答）、模型与全局默认模型、提供方、Agent Preset、设置命名空间、技能与工作区文件（含分片续传上传），另有 OpenAI 兼容的 /chat/completions、内置 OpenAPI 3.0 规范与在线调试页。它只 inject 宿主的 webServer 与 tools，挂在宿主 webserver（默认前缀 /api/v1）或独立端口，可选 API Key 鉴权，并自带一份教会 DSH 里 Agent 调用本 API 的 SKILL。

description.en: Mobile access gateway for the Web GUI: isolated child-process reverse proxy with a first-visit PC approval gate (admin-token auth, DNS-rebinding defense), LAN/VPN/WAN auto-detection with network-mode switching, QR-code entry, WebSocket forwarding, and narrow-screen UI adaptations (composer reflow, third-party plugin overlays, crypto.randomUUID polyfill).
description.zh: 移动端访问网关：独立子进程反向代理 + 首次访问 PC 审批（管理 token 认证、DNS rebinding 防护）+ 局域网/VPN/公网自动识别与网络模式切换 + 扫码访问 + WebSocket 实时转发 + 窄屏 UI 适配（输入区重排、第三方插件弹窗适配、crypto.randomUUID polyfill）。

description.en: Installs a Web-profile helper that diagnoses and writes MCP config so Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code can spawn dsh --profile codex.
description.zh: 在 Web profile 中安装适配层，检测并写入 MCP 配置，供 Codex、Cursor 或 Claude Code 拉起 dsh --profile codex.

description.en: Forward WeChat chat records into DSH sessions: a Windows share target captures the merged-forward ZIP, an in-GUI overlay picks the destination workspace and session, and the ZIP arrives as a file-attachment user message the agent unpacks and reads. Media entry extensions are normalized by magic bytes (WeChat ships PNG/HEIC bytes named .jpg), and failed deliveries preserve the batch for retry. Requires Windows 10/11 with Developer Mode on and the repo installer to register the share target.
description.zh: 把微信聊天记录转发进 DSH 会话：Windows 分享目标接收合并转发的 ZIP，GUI 浮层选择目标工作区与会话，ZIP 以文件附件用户消息到达，agent 解压并读取。按魔数纠正媒体扩展名（微信常把 PNG/HEIC 字节命名为 .jpg），投递失败时批次保留可重试。需 Windows 10/11 并开启开发者模式，先运行仓库安装脚本注册分享目标。

plugins.name: dsh-windows2macos

description.en: Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound connections only (Tailscale, a public VPS behind TLS, or a tunnel), every machine runs the command in its own checkout, and results come back with a commit, a working-tree fingerprint and a command hash so an environment mismatch is reported as unverifiable instead of being mistaken for a different result. Sending work needs its own operator token, separate from the per-machine device token.
description.zh: 一条指令同时下发给所有在线的 Windows 与 macOS 机器，可跨网络跨区域：零依赖中继只通过出站连接与各机通信（Tailscale 内网、公网 VPS + TLS、或隧道），各机在各自的项目副本上执行，结果连同 commit、工作区指纹与命令哈希一并回传，因此"环境不一致"会被判为 unverifiable，而不会被误当成结果分歧。下发指令需要独立于设备令牌的 operator token。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to 202.182.123.154:8787
uses literal IP 202.182.123.154 for network access

description.en: Complete LAN/remote access for the Web UI: 0.0.0.0 binding, crypto.randomUUID polyfill, token gate (401 login page + WebSocket interception, loopback exempt), privileged-fence and settings-persistence exemptions, and an idempotent installer with upgrade recovery.
description.zh: 完整的 Web GUI 局域网/远程访问方案：0.0.0.0 绑定、crypto.randomUUID polyfill、令牌门卫（401 登录页 + WebSocket 拦截，回环豁免）、特权围栏与设置持久化放行，附带幂等安装器与升级恢复。

description.en: Open dsh web from your phone or another computer through a UUMit account, without running your own server or installing another program: a built-in tunnel client connects to UUMit's hosted tunnel, and a panel in the sidebar handles pairing and who can use it (only you, people you invite by link or phone number, or everyone), with revocation. Requires dsh web on DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 用 UUMit 账号在手机或其他电脑上打开这台电脑的 dsh web，不用自建服务器、不装其他程序：插件内置通道客户端连接 UUMit 托管的通道，侧栏里的面板负责配对和选择谁能用（仅自己、通过邀请链接或手机号授权的人、所有人），可随时撤销。需 dsh web 且 DSH >=0.2.1-rc.2。

plugins.name: dsh-share-webui

description.en: Serves this harness instance's Web GUI on a fixed port with device pairing and Cloudflare Access verification.
description.zh: 把当前实例的 Web 界面固定在一个端口上共享，支持设备配对与 Cloudflare Access 校验。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 8.8.8.8 for network access

description.en: SSH workspaces for Linux/macOS with SSH config import, remote folder selection, and file tools, Bash and persistent remote terminals following native DSH session permissions.
description.zh: 面向 Linux/macOS 的 SSH 工作区，支持导入 SSH config、选择远端目录，文件工具、Bash 与持久远程终端沿用 DSH 原生会话权限。

description.en: Synchronize DSH sessions, settings, attachments and project files using a user-configured private HTTPS Git repository or SFTP, with safe-scope online application, offline restore plans and user-confirmed plugin updates. Requires Node.js 24+; the SFTP path also requires OpenSSH (ssh/sftp).
description.zh: 通过用户自行配置的私有 HTTPS Git 仓库或 SFTP 同步 DSH 会话、设置、附件及工程文件，支持安全范围在线应用、离线恢复计划和经确认的插件更新。需 Node.js 24+；SFTP 路径还需 OpenSSH（ssh/sftp）。

description.en: Enable permessage-deflate on DSH's WebSocket transport without modifying the DSH install tree.
description.zh: 在不修改 DSH 安装目录的前提下，为 DSH 的 WebSocket 传输启用 permessage-deflate。

plugins.name: dsh-channel-wechat

description.en: WeChat (Tencent iLink / ClawBot) channel for DeepSeek Harness: QR-code login, two-way text, image and file messaging, slash commands in WeChat including /cwd and /skills, approval and question cards answered from the chat, and reply sending that splits over-long answers and backs off on rate limits instead of dropping them. Only the account that scanned the login is admitted by default; messages from anyone else are ignored.
description.zh: 把微信（腾讯 iLink / ClawBot）接入 DeepSeek Harness 的通道插件：扫码登录，双向收发文本、图片与文件，微信内可用 /cwd、/skills 等命令，审批卡与提问卡在聊天里回答；回复侧会切分超长正文、对限流退避重试，而不是直接丢弃。默认只放行扫码登录的那个微信号，其他人发来的消息一律忽略。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Android client implementation for DeepSeek Harness: bridges local dsh web to the OneBox app with QR scan-to-pair and an end-to-end encrypted cloud relay tunnel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端实现:扫码配对 + 端到端加密云端中继,把本机 dsh web 桥接到万宝盒 App。

plugins.name: dsh-feishu-assistant

description.en: Ops request channel for a team over Feishu DMs — a colleague's message waits in a serial queue behind an approval card that the paired admin must accept, then runs in one shared DSH session with a persona attached, and the answer is posted back to the requester.
description.zh: 给同事的运维请求通道——同事在飞书私聊里提的事先排进串行队列，由已配对的管理员在审批卡上放行后才进入那条共享的 DSH 会话（带注入的人设执行），回答回到提交人。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-feishu-cui

description.en: Remote DSH access that needs no hosting of your own — the Feishu DM chat is the interface over the bot's outbound long connection, with cards for workspace, session (switch and rename), model, reasoning effort, permission preset and balance, and tool approvals and agent questions answered in that same chat.
description.zh: 免运维的远程 DSH——拿飞书私聊当界面，机器人出站长连接、不需要公网入口，工作区、会话（切换与改名）、模型、推理深度、权限预设、余额都用卡片操作，工具审批与 agent 反问也在同一个聊天里回。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Password-protected HTTPS login gate that lets LAN devices securely access the DeepSeek Harness web UI over the network.
description.zh: 密码登录的 HTTPS 闸门，让局域网设备安全地通过网络访问 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面。

description.en: Remote SSH multi-host management for DSH. Access remote workspaces and sessions in one native sidebar, with tasks running on their original machines.
description.zh: DSH 多端管理：通过 SSH 远程连接多台机器，在同一原生侧栏管理工作区与会话，任务在所属机器运行。

description.en: Remote and mobile access for DeepSeek Harness: provides LAN QR code connection, Cloudflare/custom tunnels, WeChat, QQ, Feishu, Telegram bot integration, and security authentication.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 远程与移动端接入插件：提供局域网扫码直连、Cloudflare 与自建公网隧道，以及微信、QQ、飞书、Telegram 机器人交互，内置安全认证与访问控制。

description.en: DSH remote-access authorization page that shows the current process browser-session URL as a clickable link or QR code, behind an optional authority/subnet allow-list and PIN.
description.zh: DSH 远程授权页：以可点击链接或二维码呈现当前进程的浏览器会话 URL，可选主机/网段白名单与 PIN 门禁。

description.en: Translates DSH's private remote protocol into a versioned REST API (chat, sessions, files, devices) for trusted clients such as the Android app dsh-companion, plus a Phone-settings panel inside the DSH WebUI settings: five cards in the main list (remote access, public tunnel, devices, trash, app download) and an Advanced settings group holding authorized roots, image reading and plugins.
description.zh: 把 DSH 内核的私有 remote 协议翻译成版本化 REST 接口（聊天、会话、文件、设备），供 Android 客户端 dsh-companion 等受信任客户端使用；桌面端在 DSH 设置里提供「手机设置」面板：主列表五张卡（远程访问 / 外网隧道 / 设备 / 回收站 / App 下载），另有「高级设置」组收纳授权根目录、识图与插件三项。

description.en: Feishu/Lark channel that drives DeepSeek Harness agents from chats: streaming rich cards with live thinking and tool steps, per-turn cost metering at DeepSeek peak/off-peak rates, one-tap approval cards, model-gated image intake, and QR onboarding without a public endpoint.
description.zh: 在飞书聊天里驱动 DeepSeek Harness agent：流式富卡片实时展示思考与工具步骤，按 DeepSeek 峰谷牌价计量每轮费用，一键审批、按模型能力透传图片，扫码即用、无需公网。

description.en: Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

description.en: Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream allowlist.
description.zh: 局域网访问 dsh web UI：HTTP/HTTPS/WS 转发 + TLS（自签名/自定义证书）；HTTP 自适应 Brotli/gzip 与 WebSocket permessage-deflate 双压缩；WS 半开探活，移动端切后台不僵死；启动令牌自动注入，LAN 设备免手工拿 token；DNS 重绑定防护 + 回环-only 上游白名单。

description.en: SSH terminal, SFTP file manager and port forwarding (-L/-R/-D) in the DSH right sidebar, with jump-host chains and remembered passwords kept in the operating system credential store.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏里提供 SSH 终端、SFTP 文件管理与端口转发（-L/-R/-D），支持跳板链，记住的密码交给操作系统密码箱保管。

plugins.name: dsh-roam

description.en: Remote access to running DeepSeek Harness sessions from a phone browser: scan a one-time QR code to continue conversations, answer approvals and start new tasks over Wi-Fi or a tunnel.
description.zh: 远程连接正在运行的 DeepSeek Harness 会话：手机浏览器扫码即可继续对话、处理审批、新建任务，支持同一 Wi-Fi 或临时隧道。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 8.8.8.8 for network access

description.en: Endpoint of a companion mobile app that also runs headless, with no desktop shell or Electron required: it serves a restricted mobile API over a relay tunnel or LAN pairing, for listing, opening and driving DSH sessions, following the live device event stream, and authenticating with revocable per-device credentials.
description.zh: 手机 App 的对端插件，自身可作无头宿主单独运行（不需要桌面外壳或 Electron）：经中转隧道或局域网配对提供受限的移动 API，用于列出、新建与操控 DSH 会话、订阅设备实时事件流，并以可吊销的设备凭据鉴权。

description.en: Enhanced SSH ops: connectivity testing, remote ls, ssh-config import, known_hosts fingerprint checks and multi-host exec.
description.zh: SSH 增强运维：连接测试、远程目录、ssh-config 导入、指纹检查与多主机批量执行。

description.en: DSH-SOLO desktop plugin for its companion app. Pair by QR code to view sessions, send tasks, switch models, transfer attachments and approve operations with end-to-end encryption; official cloud relay preconfigured, no server setup required. Download the App APK at https://github.com/wudidiandian/dsh-solo/releases/latest/download/dsh-solo.apk (GitHub Releases).
description.zh: DSH-SOLO 手机远程协作的电脑端插件，搭配 App 扫码连接，查看会话、发送任务、切换模型、传递附件并确认操作审批；支持端到端加密，已配置官方云转发服务，无需自行部署服务器。App 安装包下载：https://github.com/wudidiandian/dsh-solo/releases/latest/download/dsh-solo.apk （GitHub Releases）。

description.en: Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state — including the blocked state DSH itself lacks — enabling panel jump and --wait. (Herdr integration / agent state display / panel jump)
description.zh: 让 Herdr 认识 DSH 面板：把 agent 的 working/idle/blocked 状态报给 Herdr（含 DSH 本身没有的 blocked 等待态），支持面板跳转与 --wait。（状态上报 / 状态显示 / 终端集成 / 面板跳转）

description.en: Continue an existing PC DSH session from WeChat: polls WeChat iLink messages, injects into a running session via followup or resumes a closed one, and sends the reply back. Supports /会话 to list/bind sessions and /新会话 to unbind. Requires the wechat-acp daemon; only allowlisted WeChat senders are handled (empty allowlist denies everyone).
description.zh: 用微信继续 PC 端未完成的 DSH 会话：轮询微信 iLink 消息，运行中的会话直接注入、已关闭的自动续接，回复原文发回微信；支持 /会话 列出与绑定会话、/新会话 解绑。需配置 wechat-acp 守护进程；仅处理发送者白名单内的微信用户，未配置白名单时拒绝所有人。

description.en: Live remote SSH workspaces with a resident Python RPC agent, remote shell/glob/grep execution, SSH port forwarding, ~/.ssh/config import, ProxyJump, and conflict-safe three-way cache sync.
description.zh: 基于常驻 Python RPC 代理的实时远程 SSH 工作区插件，支持远程执行命令与 Glob/Grep 搜索、SSH 端口转发、~/.ssh/config 一键导入、跳板机链及三方缓存同步。

description.en: Mobile UI adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness - overlay drawer navigation, glassmorphism design, safe-area coverage, PWA support.
description.zh: DSH 移动端 UI 适配插件 - Overlay 抽屉导航、玻璃卡片设计、Safe Area 全覆盖、PWA 支持。

description.en: LAN reverse proxy plugin for DeepSeek Harness - enables mobile/tablet access with full features, fixes settings panel inaccessible via reverse proxy.
description.zh: DSH 局域网反向代理插件 - 让手机/平板访问 DSH 获得完整功能，修复反代访问时设置面板无法打开的问题。

plugins.name: dsh-netshell

description.en: Local and remote SSH terminals for DeepSeek Harness Web with three permission levels, human approval for risky AI commands, and encrypted credential storage.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 的本地与远程 SSH 终端：提供三级权限，危险 AI 命令需真人确认，凭据加密存储。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Encrypted file handoffs and cross-device agent collaboration with background message reception and managed task execution in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中进行加密文件交接与跨设备 Agent 协作，支持后台收件和受管任务执行。

description.en: Proxies the loopback-only dsh web onto a LAN port so phones and other machines can reach it, with an optional access password that browsers type in and the bundled Android client unlocks with biometrics. Adds a LAN-access settings page with QR codes, inlines dsh-web-mobile (MIT, attribution kept) for the mobile layout, and the Android client in the same repository adds finish/approval notifications, voice input and a home-screen widget.
description.zh: 把只监听 127.0.0.1 的 dsh web 转发到局域网端口，供手机等设备访问；可选访问密码——浏览器输入，同仓库的 Android 客户端用指纹或面部解锁。新增带二维码的「局域网访问」设置页，内联 dsh-web-mobile（MIT，保留署名）提供移动端布局；Android 客户端另加完成/审批通知、语音输入与主屏小组件。

plugins.name: dsh-mini-remote

description.en: A minimal phone remote control for DeepSeek Harness: the phone page carries only the instruction you send and the AI's final conclusion, while tool calls, file access, sub-agent dispatch, and reasoning traces stay on the computer, reachable over LAN, Tailscale, or a Cloudflare tunnel with a QR code, link, and password for each route.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 用的极简手机遥控器：手机页面上只有你发出的指令和 AI 最后的结论，工具调用、文件读写、子 Agent 调度与思考过程全部留在电脑上；可通过内网、Tailscale 或 Cloudflare 隧道连接，每条路径各配二维码、链接和密码。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 1.1.1.1 for network access

plugins.name: at-terminal-dsh

description.en: DeepSeek Harness native SSH terminal and SFTP workspace with direct agent tools and security sandboxing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生 SSH 终端与 SFTP 远程工作区，支持 Agent 直连运维与三级安全沙盒。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Publishes whichever model the profile has selected in chat or on the Models page as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint: /v1/models, /v1/chat/completions (streaming SSE and non-streaming), /health. A request may name any routable model; one that omits `model` gets the current chat selection, so switching model in chat switches the endpoint. Switched on, it can also lend the model the Harness tools switched on individually, run those calls through the Harness tool runtime and feed results back up to a round limit. The listener is the plugin's own, so 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0 and a NAT-forwarded port all behave the same with no change to the request path. Settings cover bind address, port, API key with a generator, fallback provider and model, reasoning effort, CORS origin and timeout.
description.zh: 把当前在聊天或「模型」设置页选中的模型发布成 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP 端点：/v1/models、/v1/chat/completions（SSE 流式与非流式）、/health。请求可指定本 profile 能路由的任意模型；省略 model 时使用聊天中当前选中的模型，因此在聊天里换模型就等于换端点所服务的模型。开启后还可把 Harness 中逐个开关的工具借给模型，经 Harness 工具运行时执行并回填结果，往返次数可设上限。监听器由插件自身创建，绑定 127.0.0.1、0.0.0.0 或经 NAT 转发的端口行为一致，请求路径不变。设置项含绑定地址、端口、可随机生成的 API 密钥、备用提供方与模型、推理强度、CORS 来源与超时。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 流式 MCP 桥接：将实时会话事件作为 MCP 进度输出，并提供 cc-connect/飞书 ACP 适配器。

description.en: Control surface for the dsh-lan-gate LAN gateway: a button beside Settings that shows whether the gateway is running and how many phones or tablets are waiting for approval, opens the loopback-only approval page in one click instead of typing its URL, and starts the gateway through its scheduled task first when it is not running. Not rendered on phone or tablet surfaces.
description.zh: dsh-lan-gate 局域网网关的控制面：设置图标旁的一个按钮，显示网关是否在跑、有几台手机或平板在等批准；一次点击打开只认回环地址的批准页，省去手敲 URL；网关没在跑时先经计划任务把它拉起。在手机或平板界面上不渲染。

description.en: Chat with local DeepSeek Harness agents from iPhone iMessage: switch workspaces/sessions, start new sessions, and get replies in the Messages app — no extra apps, no servers, no cloud.
description.zh: 在 iPhone 信息里直接和本机 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）对话：切换工作区/会话、开新会话、原生信息气泡回复，无需额外 App、服务器或云服务。

description.en: Drive the DSH on your own PC from your phone through a self-hosted relay - send text, images and files, read streamed replies, capture the desktop, and press Alt+Tab remotely.
description.zh: 通过自建中继，用手机远程操作电脑上的 DSH：发消息/图片/文件、看流式回复、截取桌面、远程 Alt+Tab。

description.en: Mobile UI shell for the DSH Web GUI: turns the desktop three-column layout into a touch-friendly phone layout (overlay drawers, draggable FAB, full-screen dialogs, infinite-scroll history) under a 1024px viewport, with zero desktop impact. - Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端适配：窄屏下把桌面三栏布局改造成触屏友好的手机布局（覆盖式抽屉、可拖拽悬浮按钮、全屏弹窗、上滑加载历史），1024px 断点内生效，桌面端零影响。 — 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

description.en: Turn another computer into a remote Agent teammate: the worker runs its own DSH and a full Agent loop locally, so dispatched tasks keep running when the link drops and its model credentials never leave that machine. The hub dispatches through 8 remote_* tools, receives only a handoff summary plus an artifact manifest, and pulls finished products on demand — intermediate artifacts stay on the worker. Pairing-code onboarding, direct or relay transport for NAT, Web panel on both sides.
description.zh: 把另一台电脑变成你的远程 Agent 同事：副机本地跑自己的 DSH 与完整 Agent 循环，所以链路断开时任务照常继续、模型凭证也永不离开那台机器。主机用 8 个 remote_* 工具派活，只收回 handoff 摘要与产物清单，成品按需拉取——中间产物留在副机。配对码接入，direct 或 relay 两种传输穿 NAT，两侧都有 Web 面板。

description.en: Phone access to DSH over a self-hosted relay (WSS via your own TLS-terminating proxy): bundle plugin with bridge supervisor and QR login, a native Android app, and server-side device revocation.
description.zh: 通过自建中继从手机访问 DSH（WSS 由你自己的 TLS 终止代理提供）：含桥接守护与扫码登录的 bundle 插件、原生 Android 应用，并支持服务端设备吊销。

description.en: Cross-device conversation and task sync for DSH: one machine generates a relay station and the others join with its invite link; every frame is end-to-end encrypted, so the relay routes a hashed channel it cannot read. Peers read each other's full transcripts and task boards, interject into a turn that is running on the owning machine, send a work command that runs in a workspace of the target machine with the model strength chosen by the sender, and can copy a conversation into a new local session and keep working on it here. Ships a token-gated phone page for listing devices, reading tasks and sending a command.
description.zh: 同账号多台 DSH 的会话与任务互通：一台机器生成中继站，其它机器用邀请链接加入；逐帧端到端加密，中继只路由哈希频道、读不到内容。对端可读完整对话与任务板，向拥有该会话的那台机器正在跑的一轮插话，按发送方选定的目标工作区与模型强度下发命令，也可把一条会话复制成本机新会话并继续在这里干活。另带令牌手机页，可查看设备、读取任务与下发命令。

description.en: Use the dsh web UI on your dev machine from an Android or iOS phone, connected peer-to-peer across networks via iroh; no server to set up, with a relay fallback that only carries ciphertext.
description.zh: 用 Android/iOS 手机远程使用电脑上的 dsh 完整网页界面,经 iroh 跨网点对点打洞直连,不用架任何服务器;打不通才退回 relay,relay 只见密文。

description.en: SSH remote execution set: give a session an ssh:// workspace and every file, command, and shell operation runs on the remote host.
description.zh: SSH 远程执行插件集：把会话工作区指向 ssh:// 目录，文件读写、命令与 shell 全部在远程主机上执行。

description.en: VSCode Remote-SSH-style development for DSH — connect to HPC and servers over SSH, read and edit remote files in the built-in Files tab, auto-SSH terminal, remote workspaces with single-roundtrip reads and result caching, and 12 session-aware remote_ssh_* model tools.
description.zh: 类 VSCode Remote-SSH 的 DSH 插件：SSH 连接超算/服务器，内置文件页签直读远程文件、终端页签自动 SSH，远程工作区配单往返合并读与结果缓存，含 12 个会话感知的 remote_ssh_* 模型工具。

description.en: Remote control of a dsh web workspace from phone or PC: QR-code pairing through a token-gated channel, SSE real-time sync, and separate mobile and full desktop GUI modes.
description.zh: 手机/PC 远程操控 dsh web 工作区：扫码配对、令牌门控通道、SSE 实时同步，提供移动端与完整桌面 GUI 两种远程形态。

description.en: SSH ops panel for DSH: web terminal, SFTP transfer with progress, local port forwarding, and one-command cluster execution across hosts; agents share the same host config.
description.zh: SSH 远程运维面板：Web 终端、SFTP 传输、本地端口转发与一条命令并发集群执行，Agent 与面板共用同一份主机配置。

description.en: Aggregated IM gateway for DeepSeek Harness: drive agents from WeChat, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, QQ, WhatsApp and 20+ chat platforms with unified sessions, remote approvals and interactive questions. By default, anyone who can message a connected bot can drive the agent; configure allowedUserIds to restrict access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 聚合 IM 网关：通过微信、飞书、Telegram、Discord、QQ、WhatsApp 等 20+ 聊天平台驱动 agent，支持统一会话、远程审批和交互提问。默认放行所有能给机器人发消息的人，需要限制请配置 allowedUserIds。

description.en: Drive your local DSH from WeChat: a self-hosted iLink bridge over a persistent ACP session (context lives in DSH and is resumable), phone conversations grouped into the desktop workspace, with image recognition, file messages (Excel/Word/PDF, parsed by the agent itself) and voice transcripts. Tool approvals are answered inside WeChat itself (numbered card; ask/allow/reject policy; 120s timeout means reject), and any process can push a message to your phone through the outbox helper. Access defaults to strict (only registered devices are served); the phone channel's permission preset is configurable - see the README security section before sharing the bot.
description.zh: 手机微信驱动本机 DSH：自建 iLink 桥 + 常驻 ACP 原生会话（上下文归 DSH、可 resume），手机会话自动登记进桌面工作区；支持图片识别、直接发文件（Excel/Word/PDF，由会话里的 agent 自行解析）与语音转写。审批可在微信里应答（编号卡片，ask/allow/reject 策略，超时按拒绝），任何进程也能通过 outbox 推送把消息发到手机。准入默认 strict（只服务已登记设备）；手机通道权限预设可配置，详见 README 安全基线。

description.en: Use your phone as a DSH peripheral remote: send messages (typed or dictated with the phone keyboard), answer yes/no and choice prompts, browse messages and switch sessions on a Game Boy-style screen, paired over LAN QR or a built-in Cloudflare tunnel.
description.zh: 把手机变成 DSH 的外设遥控台：发送消息（打字或用手机输入法语音转文字）、应答 yes/no 审批与选择题、浏览消息与切换会话，Game Boy 风格屏幕；局域网扫码或内置 Cloudflare 隧道连接。

description.en: Requires the phone app, not just this plugin: the phone half is a separate APK and must be installed first — download it from https://github.com/Zoragyx/dsh-phone-pair/releases — otherwise the computer side has nothing to pair with. This package is the computer half: it enables the upstream remote-web-ui pairing plugin with a Cloudflare quick tunnel and a fixed relay subdomain, so one scan keeps the phone connected from anywhere.
description.zh: 需要先装手机端 App，光装这个插件没用：手机那一半是单独的 APK，必须先安装——下载地址 https://github.com/Zoragyx/dsh-phone-pair/releases ——否则电脑端装好了也没得配。本包是电脑那一半：开启上游远程访问插件、Cloudflare 快速隧道与固定中继域名，扫一次码之后在外面也能连回来。

description.en: A live Android device inside the conversation — emulator or USB phone, driven entirely through adb: 20 agent tools for streaming, Gradle build and run, UI-tree or OCR interaction, logcat, processes and memory, plus a three-button navigation panel.
description.zh: 在对话里直接操作 Android 设备——模拟器或 USB 手机，完全通过 adb 驱动：20 个 Agent 工具用于流式投屏、Gradle 构建运行、UI 树或 OCR 交互、logcat、进程与内存检查，并附带三键导航面板。

description.en: A live iOS Simulator or USB-connected iPhone inside the conversation: 22 agent tools for booting, building, driving the UI by accessibility identity or OCR text, list-row actions and SwiftUI preview hot reload, plus a streaming sidebar panel you can tap and drag on.
description.zh: 在对话里直接操作 iOS 模拟器或 USB 连接的 iPhone：22 个 Agent 工具用于启动、构建、按无障碍标识或 OCR 文本驱动 UI、列表行操作与 SwiftUI 预览热重载，并附带可点击拖拽的流式侧边栏面板。

description.en: Two-way agent bridge between two DeepSeek Harness hosts: either side can ask the other agent questions and run bounded dialogues over a PSK-authenticated TCP link, with a chat page on both sides and read-only tool posture by default. Both ends need the same shared key and a nodeId configured.
description.zh: 两台 DeepSeek Harness 主机之间的双向 agent 桥：任一侧可向对端 agent 提问并运行有界多轮对话，链路经 PSK 认证；两侧提供聊天页，默认只读工具姿态。两端需配置相同的共享密钥与 nodeId。

description.en: Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol bridge: serves an A2A endpoint with agent card, message/send, message/stream SSE, task lifecycle (get/cancel/resubscribe) and input-required continuation; a2a_discover/a2a_send/a2a_task_status/a2a_cancel tools for calling remote agents; plus a web ops panel with live task board, one-click cancel and a remote agent directory.
description.zh: Agent2Agent（A2A）协议桥：内置 A2A 服务端（agent card、message/send、message/stream SSE、任务 get/cancel/resubscribe、input-required 续答）；a2a_discover/a2a_send 等 4 个工具呼叫远端 agent；附 Web 运维面板：实时任务板、一键取消、远端 agent 目录。

description.en: Binds a Feishu/Lark bot to DeepSeek Harness over a WebSocket long connection: incoming messages run through an agent session and stream back to the chat, chat commands such as /attach manage the live session, and feishu_* tools let the model push messages.
description.zh: 通过 WebSocket 长连接把飞书机器人绑到 DeepSeek Harness：收到的消息跑在 agent 会话里并流式回传，/attach 等聊天命令管理活动会话，模型可调用 feishu_* 工具推送消息。

description.en: Mobile web UI for DeepSeek Harness: a token-protected LAN server that lists all sessions, streams replies over SSE, and lets a phone continue any conversation; the desktop GUI shows a QR entry and, with dsh-whale-girl 0.3.0+, a phone held by the pet opens the same panel.
description.zh: DSH 手机端 Web UI：带令牌认证的局域网服务，手机可浏览全部会话、通过 SSE 实时查看回复并继续对话；桌面 GUI 提供二维码入口，配合 dsh-whale-girl 0.3.0+ 现在还可以点桌宠鳍里的小手机打开面板。

description.en: Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.
description.zh: 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

description.en: On every DeepSeek Harness launch, checks the installed and enabled plugins for newer npm versions, lists them in the UI and updates them after confirmation.
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时检查已安装并启用的插件有没有新版本，在界面上列出并询问，确认后更新到最新版。

description.en: Open plugin marketplace: live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search with per-repo package.json verification (dsh.bundle/dsh.client manifest badges and a verified-only filter), npm-first installs with same-source anti-squatting checks, update detection, and five agent tools for headless use.
description.zh: 开放式插件市场：GitHub dsh-plugin 话题实时搜索，逐仓库 package.json 验证（dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明徽章与只看已验证过滤），npm 优先安装带同源防抢注校验，更新检测，并附五个可在无界面环境使用的 agent 工具。

description.en: A plugin manager tab in Settings → Plugins: Chinese names and plain-language descriptions for every installed plugin, one-click enable/disable, in-UI notes editing, and search/filter over the installed catalog.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的插件管理页：已装插件中文名与白话描述、一键启停、界面内改备注，支持搜索与筛选。

description.en: A vertical preview market for DeepSeek Harness: discover preview plugins, inspect the installed inventory, and install, enable/disable or configure them through dsh-market or the dsh CLI. One-click install and enable/disable need dsh-market; without it each card only shows a copyable install command.
description.zh: DSH 垂直预览市场：发现预览插件、查看已安装清单，并通过 dsh-market 或 dsh CLI 安装、启用/停用与配置。一键安装与启用/停用依赖 dsh-market；没有它时卡片只显示可复制的安装命令。

description.en: Cross-ecosystem aggregation data layer: syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic and the npm registry into one open JSON index, queried by model tools, a CLI, and a minimal stdio MCP server.
description.zh: 跨生态聚合数据层（"聚合的聚合"）：把 GitHub dsh-plugin 主题与 npm registry 归一化为开放 JSON 索引，供模型工具、CLI 与轻量 stdio MCP 服务查询。

description.en: Plugin insight center: one answer to "哪些值得装" — plugin_guide matches needs to plugins, recipe installs whole environments, plugin_rank scores health (0-100), plugin_audit static-scans a local checkout for security, and plugin_verdict outputs install / caution / research / avoid.
description.zh: 插件评测中心：一个答案回答"哪些值得装"——plugin_guide 按需求推荐插件、recipe 安装整套环境、plugin_rank 健康评分（0-100）、plugin_audit 静态安全扫描本地目录、plugin_verdict 给出 install / caution / research / avoid 结论。

description.en: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.
description.zh: 需求型插件导购与环境配方：plugin_guide 按自然语言需求语义匹配精选插件并给出理由与安装命令；recipe 一键安装整套社区配方（通知全家桶、安全审计套装等），带有序安装计划。

description.en: Ecosystem-wide plugin health audit: syncs the dsh-plugin topic into a local scored catalog (maintenance / docs / npm + weekly downloads / ecosystem, 0-100, A-D), static security scan with high-finding grade veto, star history snapshots, web leaderboard and agent tools.
description.zh: 插件生态体检：将 dsh-plugin 话题同步为本地评分目录（维护/文档/npm+周下载/生态四维，0-100 分 A-D 级），静态安全扫描高危一票否决，支持 star 历史快照、Web 榜单与 Agent 工具。

description.en: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons and a live catalog refresh from the awesome-dsh-plugin README.
description.zh: DSH 插件推荐器：按需求描述、分类与标签在 1100+ 条内嵌市场目录中搜索并排序插件，返回匹配理由，支持从 awesome-dsh-plugin README 在线刷新目录。

description.en: Quality & security scorecard for the DSH plugin ecosystem: sync the dsh-plugin topic catalog, audit any plugin (0-100, A-D, security veto), rankings, search, and historical score curves with a workspace-persisted catalog.
description.zh: DSH 插件生态体检评分卡：同步 dsh-plugin 目录，对任意插件做质量与安全审计（0-100 分、A-D 等级、安全一票否决），榜单、搜索与历史评分曲线（目录持久化）。

description.en: Scenario bundles of dsh plugins (插件界的 dotfiles): a recipe tool that lists, searches, applies and composes ready-made plugin environments with ordered install sequences.
description.zh: 把 dsh 插件打包成场景配方（"插件界的 dotfiles"）：recipe 工具可列出、搜索、应用并组合现成插件环境，带有序安装序列。

description.en: Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a dedicated page opened through the DSH left sidebar. Search, filter by category or installed state, and sort by stars, downloads, name or date added. Three tabs show all, installed and updatable plugins, with a separate count when update status cannot be determined. Install into the active Web or Desktop profile using the package manager supplied by DSH, while preserving disabled bundles. Reload the profile through HMR when available, with restart guidance otherwise. Installed state is isolated per profile, installation and reload requests are mutually exclusive, and pagination keeps the submitted search. Expired catalog and installed-state snapshots are served immediately while refreshing in the background. Unversioned npm installs resolve the official registry latest tag to an exact version, and confirm the installed version before reporting success. Registry updates install the exact catalog version; Git updates force source resolution. The catalog is cached locally for one hour, with mirror, CDN and npm fallbacks.
description.zh: 从 DSH 左侧栏打开独立的插件市场页面，浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin 目录。支持按分类或安装状态筛选、按名称或简介搜索，以及按 Star、下载量、名称或收录时间排序；三个标签分别显示全部插件、已安装插件和可更新插件，并单独提示无法判断更新状态的数量。自动识别当前 Web 或桌面 profile，使用 DSH 提供的包管理器一键安装和更新，保留其他插件的停用状态。支持通过 HMR 重载 profile，不可用时提示重启。各 profile 的安装状态独立，安装与重载互斥，分页保持已提交的搜索条件。目录与安装状态快照过期时先显示本地内容并在后台刷新。未指定版本的 npm 安装先解析官方 registry 的 latest，再按确切版本安装并核验落盘版本。npm 插件按目录目标版本精确更新，Git 插件强制重新解析来源。目录在本地缓存一小时，官方源不可达时依次回退到镜像、CDN 与 npm。

description.en: Plugin advisor for DeepSeek Harness: describe what you need and it ranks the npm packages carrying the dsh-plugin keyword by denoised metrics (daily baseline, week-over-week growth, release cadence, freshness) into a first pick, alternates and plugins to avoid; ships a sidebar panel, four AI tools and one-click install.
description.zh: DSH 插件选购顾问：说需求，从带 dsh-plugin 关键字的 npm 包里按去噪指标（日常基线、周环比、版本节奏、新鲜度）排出首选、备选和不推荐；提供右侧栏面板、4 个 AI 工具和一键安装。

plugins.name: dsh-forge

description.en: Runtime extension suite for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session mailbox with wake cold-start, agent teams (captain + members + dependency task board + team_wait), subagent spawn policy with escalation approval, task-aware routing preset, plugin market, skill manager and runtime injector.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 扩展套件：跨会话邮箱与 wake 冷启动、代理团队（队长 + 成员 + 依赖任务板 + team_wait）、子代理派发策略（提权自动审批）、任务感知路由 preset、插件市场、技能管理器与运行时注入器。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-console

description.en: Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and resume, installed-package state, and sanitized README previews.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置一级页面中浏览和管理社区插件目录，支持验证后安装与更新、删除、暂停与恢复、已安装状态查看及安全 README 预览。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.ibm.com

description.en: Ranks DSH plugins by real monthly npm downloads instead of GitHub stars, and names the plugins that star ordering under-rates. It reports the disagreement between the two orderings rather than a single quality verdict, and every number is a live read from npm's public downloads endpoint at call time, not a stored snapshot. A second dimension answers what downloads cannot: it reads the tools version line a plugin declares in peerDependencies and compares it with the version running here, so a popular plugin that cannot be installed on this host is reported instead of recommended. Read-only GETs, no HTTP route of its own.
description.zh: 按真实 npm 月下载量给 DSH 插件排名，而不是按 GitHub 星数，并点名被星数排序低估的插件。它报告的是两种排序之间的分歧，而不是给一个综合质量结论；显示的每个数字都是调用时从 npm 公开下载接口现读的，不是存下来的快照。第二个维度回答下载量回答不了的问题：读插件在 peerDependencies 里声明的 tools 版本线，和本机实际运行的版本比，因此「很热门但在本机装不上」的插件会被报出来，而不是被推荐。只发只读 GET，自身不注册 HTTP 路由。

plugins.name: dsh-find-plugin

description.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A plugin management system for DeepSeek Harness: plugin inventory with L0/L1/L2 AI purpose summaries, changelog tracking, update alerts, one-click upgrade, and backup/rollback with crash recovery.
description.zh: DSH 插件管理系统：插件清单与 AI 用途解读、变更日志、更新提醒、一键升级、自动备份与回滚，附带崩溃恢复。

description.en: Browse, install, inspect, update, and remove MCP server connections inside DeepSeek Harness, with an online catalog and native Streamable HTTP/stdio support.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内浏览、安装、检查、更新和卸载 MCP 服务器连接，支持在线目录、Streamable HTTP 与 stdio。

plugins.name: dsh-bridge

description.en: Slash commands ported from other coding agents (setup, connect, install, trust, browse, doctor, status, model, memory, compact, resume, review, mcp, init, suggest, improve, refactor), a zero-dependency static scanner for plugin source, and an in-repo catalog of audited plugin report cards that cite file-and-line evidence.
description.zh: 从其他编码 Agent 移植过来的斜杠命令（setup、connect、install、trust、browse、doctor、status、model、memory、compact、resume、review、mcp、init、suggest、improve、refactor），一个零依赖的插件源码静态扫描器，以及一份内置的插件评级报告卡目录，每条结论都给出文件与行号级别的证据。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access
uses plaintext http:// to 169.254.169.254

description.en: Inventories installed DSH skills and profile plugins, checks their upstream sources for newer versions, applies the updates, and installs skills from a searchable catalog.
description.zh: 盘点已安装的 DSH 技能与 profile 插件，检查上游是否有新版本并执行更新，还能从可搜索的目录里安装技能。

plugins.name: DSH-Plugins-Marketplace

description.en: GitHub-topic-driven plugin & skill marketplace: a Settings page that browses the auto-collected registry (the whole dsh-plugin topic plus the skills index, CI-refreshed every 2 hours) with one-click install, type detection, install-script and host-shadow-dependency safety confirmations, env-key management, and the STANDARD.md recognition spec.
description.zh: 面向 GitHub dsh-plugin 话题的插件与技能市场：设置页内逛自动收录的全量索引（CI 每 2 小时刷新），一键安装带类型识别、安装脚本与宿主依赖遮蔽安全检查、环境变量密钥管理，并附 STANDARD.md 识别层规范。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to evil.com:3080
uses literal IP 1.2.3.4 for network access

description.en: Layered plugin manager for DSH web: native plugins grouped read-only by system/WebUI/tools, user extensions with enable/disable, register, uninstall and editable descriptions.
description.zh: DSH 分层插件管理器：原生插件按系统/WebUI/工具三层只读展示，用户扩展支持停用/启用、补登记、卸载与可编辑描述。

description.en: A Plugin Market entry in the DSH settings sidebar that opens dshmarket.com, the community plugin market for DeepSeek Harness, in a new tab. The light-weight alternative to installing the market itself, for people who only want the button.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置侧边栏加入「Plugin Market」入口，点击即在新标签页打开 DeepSeek Harness 的社区插件市场 dshmarket.com。是安装市场本体之外的轻量选择，适合只想要一个按钮的人。

description.en: Per-package automatic updates for the DeepSeek Harness plugins you choose. On a schedule it asks npm for the latest version of installed plugins, updates only the packages you check, and skips local link or file installs, pinned versions and packages with errors; upgrades stay inside the major version and skip prereleases by default. Updates go through the profile's own plugin manager, so the profile write lock, pnpm step, bundle-patch validation and hot reload are the host's, and a failed install puts the previous version back. Each cycle is appended to a JSON log.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 插件做按包白名单的自动更新：按计划去 npm 查已装插件的最新版本，只更新你勾选的包，本地 link／file 安装、锁定版本和出错的包一律跳过；默认不跨大版本、不装预发布。更新走 profile 里运行中的官方插件管理器，profile 写锁、pnpm 执行、bundle 补丁校验与热重载都由宿主负责，安装失败会把旧版本装回去。每轮结果追加到一份 JSON 日志。

description.en: Quality-aware in-agent plugin discovery: a find_dsh_plugins tool that ranks the whole dsh-plugin topic through a daily quality-scored index (installable manifest, curated listing, license, activity) merged with a live gh search — zero LLM API cost, risk flags and exact install commands in every result.
description.zh: 质量感知的会话内插件发现：find_dsh_plugins 工具基于每日更新的质量评分索引（可安装声明 / 精选收录 / 许可证 / 活跃度）对 dsh-plugin topic 全量排序，并叠加实时 gh 搜索——零 LLM API 成本，每条结果附风险徽章与精确安装命令。

description.en: Ranks this DeepSeek Harness profile's installed, disabled and marketplace plugins for the task at hand, and prints the exact next step for each — enable, install, or nothing.
description.zh: 按任务排序本 profile 的插件（已启用 / 已安装但未启用 / 市场可安装），并给出每个候选的确切下一步——启用、安装，或无需操作。

description.en: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is installed, then live-reloaded. Each file is translated in one whole-file pass, validated by a real parser where one exists (node --check for JavaScript, JSON and YAML parsers otherwise) and handed back to the model with the error for up to three repair attempts; files above 48 KB, or that never parse, fall back to a line-range pass that checks every returned line against the original for structure. Trigger phrases and locale tables can optionally be preserved rather than translated, and the untouched original is kept beside the file as a .zh.bak.
description.zh: 用你已经配置好的模型，把从市场安装的插件里的中文文案改写成英文——安装时自动运行，随后热重载。每个文件整体翻译一遍，凡是有解析器的都会实际校验（JavaScript 用 node --check，其余用 JSON、YAML 解析器），失败时把报错交回模型，最多修复三次；超过 48 KB 或始终无法解析的文件，回退到按行区间翻译，逐行与原文做结构比对。触发短语与本地化表可以选择保留而不翻译，未改动的原文件保留在同目录下的 .zh.bak。

description.en: Plugin center: discover, install, and manage DSH plugins from Settings.
description.zh: 插件中心：在设置页发现、安装与管理 DSH 插件。

description.en: Update manager for installed plugins: check for updates, back up, and roll back.
description.zh: 已装插件更新管理：检查更新、备份与回滚。

description.en: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.
description.zh: 类 Codex 插件市场的 DSH 技能管理器。

description.en: Toggle switches for the plugin inventory: enable/disable any plugin live from Settings → Plugins → Plugin list without restarting, with groups/filters, bulk toggle, undo, and backup.
description.zh: 插件清单页滑块开关：在设置 → 插件 → 插件清单实时启用/停用任意插件，无需重启；支持分组/筛选、批量开关、撤销与自动备份。

description.en: A curated plugin starter pack: batch-installs and configures 15 vetted community plugins across four groups from a Settings-page UI or the /setup command.
description.zh: 精选插件启动包：从设置页或 /setup 命令一键批量安装并配置 4 组共 15 个经过筛选的社区插件。

description.en: A DSH-native plugin update center: check and update installed plugins from the sidebar with snapshots, rollback, queued updates and uninstall-leftover cleanup.
description.zh: 尊重 DSH 原始风格的插件更新插件：在侧边栏检查、排队更新已安装插件，支持快照回滚、安装后校验、卸载残留清理与离线恢复。

description.en: Manage Git-backed DSH plugin markets, installed agent skills and optional Codex hooks from the web settings page.
description.zh: 在网页设置页管理基于 Git 的 DSH 插件市场、已安装的 agent 技能和可选 Codex hooks。

description.en: Install, update and remove DSH plugins from a tab in the Plugins page. Installs call the profile's in-process pluginManager service, so a plugin can be added while the desktop app is running instead of only through the CLI. Updates are delegated to dsh-market's public update API v1 (required for that section) and show the reported phase, percent and downloaded bytes as a progress bar, with rollback when the market reports a restore point. When removal is refused because the bundle is in use, it disables the bundle, drops it from the profile manifest, and queues the leftover files under the profile for a sweep after the next start.
description.zh: 在插件页的一个标签里安装、更新和卸载 DSH 插件。安装直接调用 profile 进程内的 pluginManager 服务，因此桌面端运行中也能装，不必只靠命令行。更新委托给 dsh-market 的公开 update API v1（该区需要装 dsh-market），把市场报告的阶段、百分比与已下载字节显示成进度条，市场提供恢复点时给出一键回滚。卸载被「插件正在使用中」拒绝时，先停用该组合包，再从 profile 清单里摘除，并把残留文件记入 profile 下的待清理队列，下次启动后自动清扫。

description.en: Sidebar plugin updates with publish dates: each update pins an exact version and re-reads the installed manifest to confirm it landed, and updates whose new code needs a full relaunch are counted on a restart button — whose replacement process is started through WMI so it inherits no console. The full relaunch is Windows desktop only; the in-page GUI reload works on any platform.
description.zh: 在侧栏更新插件并显示发布时间：锁定精确版本，装完回读磁盘清单确认已到位；需要完全重启才生效的更新会计到重启按钮上，而完全重启经 WMI 拉起替代进程，新进程不继承任何控制台。完全重启仅在 Windows 桌面端可用，页面内 GUI 重载各平台都能用。

description.en: Browse, search and install community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings, with category filters, one-click updates, enable/disable, theme switching and configuration backup.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页内浏览、搜索并安装社区插件，支持分类筛选、一键更新与停用，以及主题切换与配置备份。

description.en: Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and workbenches — one-click install, update and remove pinned to the reviewed version, restart from the panel, and exactly one network request (its own catalog).
description.zh: 精选科研插件市场：在设置里加一页「科研插件」，收录逐个读过代码的文献检索、文献管理、写作与科研工作台插件——一键安装、更新、卸载并钉住审读过的版本，面板内重启，只发一个网络请求（拉取自家目录）。

description.en: Passcode marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness: enter a six-character code to unlock and install plugins shared by creators, plus themes, backup, updates and diagnostics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 口令插件市场：输入 6 位口令解锁并安装创作者分享的插件，附带主题、备份、更新与诊断。

description.en: Browse and install DSH plugins without leaving the harness: a /store command, a Settings → Plugins tab, two agent-callable tools and a bundled skill, with an approval gate that lists the detected risk flags before anything installs.
description.zh: 不离开 harness 就能找插件、装插件：/store 命令、设置页的插件标签页、两个可供 agent 调用的工具和一个随包技能，安装前先确认并列出检测到的风险项。

description.en: In-app DSH plugin marketplace panel with curated and full catalogs, keyword and semantic search, Chinese translation, favorites, installed-state tracking, and install/update/uninstall via the official CLI.
description.zh: DSH 内置插件市场面板：精选与全量目录、关键词与语义搜索、中文翻译、收藏、已安装状态，以及通过官方命令安装、更新和卸载。

description.en: Find DSH plugins across several community catalogs plus live GitHub and npm search, ranked by relevance, trust, freshness and bounded popularity instead of stars alone.
description.zh: 跨多个社区目录并叠加 GitHub 与 npm 实时搜索来找 DSH 插件，按相关度、可信度、新鲜度与有界热度排序，而不是只看 star。

description.en: Plugin Steward adds a plugin panel to the chat composer for managing the installed DeepSeek Harness plugins: list them, switch them on or off, edit a plugin's settings, hide one plugin's tools or MCP servers from a single conversation, and have the model write short Chinese labels for installed plugins by reading their own README and package files.
description.zh: 插件管家：在对话输入框上加入插件面板，用来管理本机已装的 DSH 插件——列出全部插件、全局启停、逐个编辑插件设置、把某个插件的工具或 MCP 服务器只在这一个对话里对模型隐藏，还能让模型读插件自身的 README 与包信息生成中文标签。面板可拖动并记住位置。

description.en: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed boot, whitelisted reversible fixes verified in an isolated instance first, an upgrade preview naming the plugins a target release would skip, and a panel with plugin-row management plus a RAG knowledge base of past failures.
description.zh: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

description.en: Ranks the top 400 DSH plugin candidates by live npm download counts and shows the top 200, with daily, weekly and monthly boards.
description.zh: 对前 400 个候选按 npm 实时下载量排序、展示前 200 名，支持日榜、周榜、月榜。

description.en: Onshelf for DeepSeek Harness. It registers 1 agent tool (onshelf).
description.zh: 扫描本地插件、体检收录规则、生成投稿材料，一键开 PR 到 awesome-dsh-plugin。

description.en: Skill index browser with search, custom alias editing, and chat-input skill insertion.
description.zh: 技能索引浏览器，支持关键词检索、自定义中文别名与输入框多技能快捷插入。

description.en: Find and compose DSH plugins from a task description, then open an independent chat environment or install the plan into the current profile.
description.zh: 根据任务查找并组合 DSH 插件，打开可继续对话的独立环境，或将方案中的插件安装到当前配置。

description.en: 64-entry external CLI catalog with bounded public discovery and guarded package-manager or manual official installation, exposed through DSH tools and a standalone command.
description.zh: 包含 64 个条目的外部 CLI 清单，支持受限公开来源发现，并通过 DSH 工具和独立命令行提供受保护的包管理器或官方手动安装。

description.en: Turn a set of DSH plugins into one pasteable share code, then install it plugin by plugin — with a QR code to carry it to a phone.
description.zh: 把一套 DSH 插件变成一段可粘贴的分享码，别人贴进去就能逐条安装，也能生成二维码带到手机上。

description.en: The complete #dsh-plugin mall inside DeepSeek Harness: browse, search and score the full GitHub dsh-plugin topic catalog refreshed every 2 hours, AI pre-install review with install/caution/avoid verdicts, five-dimension scores with radar charts, nine-language UI, editor picks and personalized recommendations, one-click install/update/rollback with a global task panel, and an in-agent /dsh-mall skill.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内完整的插件商场：每 2 小时刷新 GitHub #dsh-plugin 全量目录，支持浏览、搜索与评分；AI 装前审查给出装/谨慎/别装结论，五维评分雷达图，九语言界面，编辑精选与个性化推荐，一键安装/更新/回退及全局任务面板，并内置 /dsh-mall skill 在会话中发现插件。

description.en: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove` one-click install, sidebar + settings entry.
description.zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

description.en: In-app plugin marketplace for DSH: plugin discovery, install, upgrade, toggle and uninstall in one panel for Web and Desktop host profiles, pairing a community catalog of 4,000+ entries with customizable curated lists, plus eight agent tools and a standalone dshm CLI, without a marketplace server or account.
description.zh: DSH 的应用内插件市场：插件发现、安装、升级、开关与卸载一站完成，跟随 Web / Desktop 宿主 profile；4,000+ 条社区目录搭配可自定义精选清单，附 8 个 agent 工具与独立 dshm CLI，无需市场服务器或账号。

description.en: Scouts the deepseek-harness repo and every dsh-plugin-tagged repository to discover harnesses related to your goal, then judges each as worth trying, watching, or skipping.
description.zh: 侦察 deepseek-harness 官方仓库与所有 dsh-plugin topic 仓库，发现与目标相关的 harness，并判断每个值得试用、观望还是跳过。

description.en: Conversational DSH plugin finder: four-source unified index, BM25 pre-filter plus LLM semantic ranking, candidates carry evidence grades and local static security audit, safe install flow with post-install verification.
description.zh: 对话式查找 DSH 插件的增强版 skill：四源聚合统一索引，BM25 粗筛 + LLM 语义精排，候选表带证据分级与本地静态安全审计，安装走安全确认流程并自动验证。

description.en: The `dsh pm` plugin manager: multi-source search (awesome list + GitHub + npm), install/remove/update per profile, and a doctor audit of manifests, bundle patches, and version drift.
description.zh: `dsh pm` 插件管理器：多源搜索（awesome 列表 + GitHub + npm）、按 profile 安装/移除/更新，以及 doctor 审计（清单、bundle patch、版本漂移）。

description.en: Checks whether a similar dsh plugin already exists before you build one, searching the awesome-dsh-plugin registry and the dsh-plugin GitHub topic and returning ranked matches with evidence.
description.zh: 在动手写 dsh 插件前，检索 awesome-dsh-plugin 注册表与 dsh-plugin GitHub topic，判断是否已有相似插件，并返回带证据的排序结果。

description.en: Unified plugin marketplace built for the DSH Desktop (EAC) shell, aggregating the curated catalog, the GitHub dsh-plugin ecosystem and the npm registry into one storefront, with source whitelisting, conflict pre-checks, trial-boot install verification, manual/batch/auto updates and .dshpack feature-pack management.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop（EAC）桌面壳的统一插件市场：聚合精选目录、GitHub dsh-plugin 生态与 npm registry 三源，提供来源白名单、冲突预检、试装安装验证、手动/批量/自动三档更新与功能包（.dshpack）管理。

description.en: A plugin market for DeepSeek Harness: search and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugin plugins straight from the web GUI.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件市场：在 Web 界面里搜索并一键安装 GitHub 上的 dsh-plugin 插件。

description.en: Native skin marketplace and lifecycle manager that discovers community skins, displays previews and compatibility status, and provides verified one-click or manual installation paths.
description.zh: 原生皮肤市场与生命周期管理器，发现社区皮肤、展示预览与兼容状态，并提供已验证的一键安装或手动安装入口。

description.en: One-click skin switching for DSH Web settings: auto-detects installed themes, keeps exactly one active at a time, and falls back to the official look when all are off. Changes apply instantly and survive restarts.
description.zh: DSH 主题切换：自动检测已安装的皮肤/主题，在设置页一键互斥切换，全部停用时回退官方默认外观，切换即时生效并跨重启保留。

description.en: In-web plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: categorized plugin list, preset bundles with one-click switching, import/export and failure auto-rollback, plugin market with one-click install.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页内管理插件：分类列表、预设整合包一键切换与导入导出、失败自动回退、插件市场一键安装。

description.en: Transactional data-only configuration pack manager with integrity, ownership, preview, diff, and rollback safeguards.
description.zh: 仅数据的事务式配置包管理器，提供完整性、归属、预览、差异和回滚保护。

description.en: Checks enabled plugins for newer versions at startup, lists them in a corner card and upgrades them all with one click, reporting per-plugin success or failure; resolves the bundled dsh CLI on macOS, Windows and Linux instead of assuming a Windows executable.
description.zh: 启动后检查已启用插件的新版本，在右下角列出并一键逐个升级，逐条给出成功或失败结果；通过解析应用自带的 dsh CLI 在 macOS、Windows、Linux 上执行更新，不假定 Windows 可执行文件。

description.en: Plugin steward for DeepSeek-Harness: checks every installed plugin for newer versions and installs them, snapshots the profile first and rolls back automatically when the post-update health check regresses. Also scans plugin code for risky behaviour before you install (eval, reverse shell, credential access), browses the 8.5k-plugin catalog with compatibility badges, restarts the host by itself after install/uninstall/disable, and shows everything in plain language.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 插件管家：查出所有插件的新版本并直接升级，升级前自动建快照，升级后重新体检，结果变差就自动还原。装任何插件前先静态扫描代码（动态执行、反弹 shell、翻密钥都会标出来），内置 8489 个插件的市场目录并带兼容性判定，装完/卸完/停用完自动重启宿主，不需要手动关软件。界面文案全白话，不写术语。

description.en: GUI in the DSH settings panel: toggle/delete MCP servers, browse and trash skills, and list built-in plugin packages — hot-applied without restart.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板内嵌的图形化管理器：开关/删除 MCP 服务、浏览并回收 Skills、查看内置插件包，改动热生效无需重启。

description.en: Local plugin installer in the DSH web Settings: a file picker for .tgz plugin packages (multi-select) or a full machine path, installing them into the auto-detected profile via the official `dsh plugin add` with live CLI output — no terminal needed.
description.zh: 本地插件安装器：DSH 网页设置页里的本地插件安装入口——文件选择器多选 .tgz 或输入本机完整路径，自动检测所在 profile 并执行官方 `dsh plugin add`，实时回显安装日志，无需终端。

description.en: MCP server marketplace for DSH: browse a curated, npm-verified catalog and install MCP servers into the current profile with one click, live without restart.
description.zh: DSH 的 MCP 服务器商场：浏览经过 npm 校验的精选目录，一键安装 MCP 服务器到当前 profile，免重启立即生效。

description.en: Steam Workshop-style plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, and one-click install community plugins with mirror acceleration, progress UI, security checks, and Chinese descriptions.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Steam 创意工坊式插件商店：浏览、搜索并一键安装社区插件，支持镜像加速、进度 UI、安全检测与中文描述。

description.en: Previews plugin-market entries inside DSH instead of opening an external browser: clicking a card shows the README in a panel docked beside the market, or the repository in DSH's built-in right-sidebar browser, and restores the layout when you leave. Works with dshmarket and DSH's built-in experimental market.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件市场点击插件卡片时把插件留在 DSH 里预览：README 显示在市场旁的停靠面板，或在内置右侧栏浏览器打开仓库页，离开市场时恢复原布局。支持 dshmarket 与 DSH 内置实验性市场。

description.en: Plugin marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar catalog tab plus agent tools (mp_search, mp_similar, mp_details, mp_install, mp_trending) backed by dsh-plugins-mp.com.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内的插件市场：侧边栏目录标签页加一组代理工具（mp_search、mp_similar、mp_details、mp_install、mp_trending），数据来自 dsh-plugins-mp.com。

description.en: Plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: installed-plugin metadata, a community market with stars and versions, one-click install and update, and a What's New dialog.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：已安装插件信息、带星标与版本号的社区市场、一键安装与更新，以及启动时的更新日志弹窗。

description.en: Adds a Batch Uninstall page to the DSH settings dialog: a checklist of every installed bundle with multi-select, select-all, a confirmation dialog and per-plugin progress, where official bundles stay locked and each removal goes through the host pluginManager service.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中新增「批量卸载」页面：勾选多个已安装插件批量移除，支持全选、二次确认与逐条进度，官方 bundle 自动锁定，删除统一走宿主 pluginManager 服务。

description.en: Turns stock names and codes in DSH output text into clickable buttons for quotes and company news.
description.zh: 将 DSH 输出文本中的股票名称和代码转换为可点击按钮，并在侧边栏展示行情与资讯。

description.en: Star-ranked radar for DSH plugins. A plugin is listed once it has 3,000+ GitHub stars or 100k+ npm downloads in 30 days; after its rank drops it stays listed for 180 days by default, so a plugin is still findable for months after a hot streak.
description.zh: 按 GitHub 收藏数排名的 DSH 插件热度榜：收藏 ≥ 3,000 或近 30 天下载 ≥ 10 万即收录， 排名下滑后仍保留 180 天（默认），热度过去几个月依然找得到。

description.en: Categorize the plugins installed in a DSH profile into groups (skins, MCP, tools, ...), with per-category batch enable/disable, drag reordering, and automatic skin detection.
description.zh: 把当前 profile 已安装的插件按分类整理（皮肤、MCP、工具……），支持分类批量启停、拖拽排序与皮肤自动识别。

description.en: MCP marketplace and management panel in the Web sidebar: one-click official templates (Apifox public/private, Apipost, MasterGo, Pixso), paste raw mcpServers JSON, and enable, edit or delete your services with hot reload.
description.zh: Web 侧边栏的 MCP 市场与管理面板：官方模板一键配置（Apifox 公有云/私有化、Apipost、MasterGo、Pixso）、粘贴完整 mcpServers JSON、我的服务增删改启停，热加载生效。

description.en: Archive manager for DSH Web: list archived sessions in the Settings page and delete them for real, including their log, archive marker, and projection cache.
description.zh: 归档管理：在设置页列出已归档会话，并可真正删除，连同会话日志、归档标记与投影缓存一并清理。

description.en: Alternative plugin market for DSH: curated catalog plus live GitHub browsing, zh/en cross-language search, a fail-closed pre-install static security audit with an install-hook block, and per-plugin README viewing with garbled-encoding repair.
description.zh: 另一款 DSH 插件市场：精选目录 + GitHub 实时浏览、中英互通搜索、安装前 fail-closed 静态安全审计（拦截安装钩子），每个插件可直接查看 README 且乱码自动修复。

description.en: Plugin manager with a rescue center: grouped enable/disable by necessity, multi update sources (npm / dshfind market / GitHub), browser-first downloads with an auto-install folder, P2P fallback, pre-boot self-check and broken-bundle quarantine.
description.zh: 插件管理器与救砖中心：按必要程度分组启停、多更新源（npm / 插件超市 / GitHub）、浏览器下载优先与目录自动安装、P2P 兜底、启动前自检与坏包隔离。

description.en: Writes short plain-Chinese notes for installed dshmarket plugins that have none and shows them on the market cards; hand-written notes are left alone (only entries marked 🤖 may be regenerated with force=ai), and dshmarket is required.
description.zh: 给 dshmarket 里还没有备注的插件自动写一句中文说明，显示在市场卡片上；手写备注不会动（只有带 🤖 标记的条目会在 force=ai 时重新生成），使用时需要先装好 dshmarket。

description.en: Digital Employee，Integrates three catalogs — Experts, Skills, and Connectors — supporting browsing, favoriting, invoking, and publishing without modifying the host.
description.zh: 数字员工，整合专家、技能、连接器三大目录，支持浏览、收藏、召唤与发布，且无需改动宿主代码。

description.en: Task-aware DSH plugin navigator: builds a local index from GitHub topics and community lists, retrieves across 28 bilingual capability classes, and provides commit-level static risk audit, consent-gated pinned installation, composition checks, and recovery.
description.zh: 任务感知的 DSH 插件导航：聚合 GitHub topic 与社区清单建立本地索引，按 28 类中英能力检索；提供 commit 级静态风险审计、用户确认后的锁定版本安装、组合验证与恢复流程。

description.en: Card-style plugin manager in Settings: enable/disable each plugin through the profile patch layer, install-source details, npm update check with one-click update, uninstall, search, and load-error badges.
description.zh: 设置页卡片式插件管理：经 profile 补丁层启停插件（跨重启保留）、安装来源详情、npm 更新检查与一键更新、卸载、搜索与加载失败标识。

description.en: Turns a user goal into a plugin plan using community catalogs and author documentation, then continues through installation and task execution in one workbench with saved history and feedback.
description.zh: 从用户目标匹配社区插件并阅读作者资料，形成插件方案，在同一工作台衔接安装和任务执行，保存历史与反馈。

description.en: Adds a dshmarket entry to the DSH sidebar footer, sharing a row with the Agents-Anywhere remote-control entry and sitting to its right, and opens the market panel in an overlay.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏底部加入 dshmarket 入口，与 Agents-Anywhere 的「远程控制」同处一行并位于其右侧，点击以浮层打开市场面板。

description.en: Browse, search, star-sort, favorite and one-click download community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页内浏览、搜索、星标排序、收藏并一键下载社区插件。

description.en: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.
description.zh: 技能市场插件，聚合 SkillHub 与 ClawHub 双源搜索，支持站内 README 预览、一键安装与卸载、已装技能列表，以及聊天栏技能选择器。

description.en: Plugin updater for DeepSeek Harness that delegates every version decision to the dsh CLI, so the pnpm release-age policy still decides what is eligible; it snapshots before applying, can roll back, keeps a lock list, and can check or auto-apply on a schedule the user turns on.
description.zh: DSH 插件更新器：把版本决策交给 dsh CLI，继续受 pnpm 发布年龄策略约束；应用前先快照、可回滚、带锁定清单，用户打开开关后可定时检查或自动应用。

description.en: Install tab in Settings → Plugins: install, update and remove any plugin by npm spec, `github:user/repo` or local path through the same `dsh plugin add` CLI path; update checks against npm latest or GitHub HEAD with a downgrade guard and resolved-version verification, a pnpm 11 release-cooldown bypass on every add/remove, and service restart via the DSH Desktop shell or a relay process under standalone `dsh web`.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件里的「安装」标签页：按 npm spec、`github:user/repo` 或本地路径安装、更新、卸载任意插件，走的都是 `dsh plugin add` 这条 CLI 路径；更新检查对照 npm latest 或 GitHub HEAD，带降级保护与装后版本核对，每次 add/remove 均附带 pnpm 11 发布冷静期豁免；服务重启在 DSH Desktop 由壳层执行，独立 `dsh web` 下由中转进程接力并交接回原终端。

description.en: No longer updated: folded into dsh-lifeguard (last release 0.2.2). It checked a plugin against what was installed and flagged only real conflicts.
description.zh: 已停止更新：功能合并进 dsh-lifeguard（最后一版 0.2.2）。原来做的是：装插件前先跟已装的比一遍，真会撞上才说一句，先说原因再给动作，装还是照装。

description.en: All-in-one DSH extension center in Settings: manage skills, MCP servers and plugins, a Plugin Market (curated + GitHub search, npm one-click install), and an Add-ons block to install, disable, uninstall and update companion features together.
description.zh: 设置页一体化扩展中心：管理技能/MCP/插件，内置插件市场（精选目录+GitHub 搜索、npm 一键安装），并提供附加功能区统一安装/停用/卸载、一起更新附属功能。

description.en: Adds a native Store section to DSH Settings for catalog search, tag filtering, sorting, installation, and installed-plugin management.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中加入原生插件商店，支持目录搜索、标签筛选、排序、安装与已安装插件管理。

description.en: In-harness plugin market for the dsh web GUI: browse the awesome-dsh-plugin.com catalog and install/uninstall plugins into a profile from Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market.
description.zh: dsh Web GUI 内的社区插件市场：浏览 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 目录，从 设置 → 插件 → 插件市场 安装/卸载插件到 profile。

description.en: Browse and search GitHub dsh-plugin repositories from Web UI Settings, sort by stars, and install plugins through the DSH CLI.
description.zh: 在 Web UI 设置页浏览和搜索 GitHub dsh-plugin 仓库，按 Star 排序，并通过 DSH CLI 安装插件。

plugins.name: dsh-agent-plugins-market

description.en: Install suites from any Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi or agent-plugins.org git marketplace repo — skills, MCP servers, hooks and slash commands are injected into DSH sessions at runtime, with a market page in the Web GUI.
description.zh: 把任意 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Kimi / agent-plugins.org 的 git 市场仓库加为源，套件的技能、MCP 服务器、hooks 与斜杠命令在运行时注入 DSH 会话，并自带 Web 市场页。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Market-gap radar for DSH plugin developers. Splits the catalog into categories and topics, tags every topic empty, thin, contested or crowded, and ranks the emptiest directions first, so you know what to build before writing it; it also browses the whole market with copy-ready install commands.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 插件开发者的市场空白雷达。把目录拆到大类与方向，每档标出空位、稀少、有竞争或红海，空位最多的方向排在前面，动手前先知道该做什么；同时可浏览整个市场并一键复制安装命令。

description.en: Exports the plugin profile together with selected $DSH_HOME files and browser localStorage into one JSON, imports it back after a per-file preview, and can run pnpm install to reinstall the listed plugins; the format is interchangeable with the dsh-market profile backup.
description.zh: 把插件清单与 profile 配置、选定的 $DSH_HOME 文件、浏览器 localStorage 导出成一份 JSON，按文件预览后导入，并可在 profile 目录执行 pnpm install 重装清单里的插件；格式与插件市场的 profile 备份互通。

description.en: Plugin marketplace in Settings that targets any local profile, not just the running one: install, update and remove across web, headless and other profiles, with install-script warnings, an installed view that also covers non-catalog profile dependencies, and an automatic DSH restart when the current profile changes.
description.zh: 设置页里的插件市场，可操作本机任意 profile 而不只是当前运行的那个：在 web、headless 及其他 profile 上安装、更新、卸载，带安装脚本风险提示，已装视图同时覆盖目录之外的 profile 依赖，改动当前 profile 时自动重启 DSH。

description.en: Turns a stated need into a plugin choice: an agent skill that queries a catalog of the whole `dsh-plugin` topic (2600+ repos, recrawled every 6 hours, Chinese descriptions from Workers AI) through a ranked search API, then hands back the matching `dsh plugin add` command.
description.zh: 把「我想让 DSH 做什么」直接变成选好的插件：技能查询覆盖整个 `dsh-plugin` topic 的目录（2600+ 仓库，每 6 小时重抓，简介由 Workers AI 译成中文）的相关度检索接口，再给出对应的 `dsh plugin add` 命令。

description.en: Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-diraud.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的插件目录：按来源（官方/自装）分组展示已安装插件，可搜索，支持启用/停用、卸载和一键更新。已发布 npm 包 dsh-plugin-diraud。

description.en: Toggle, delete, undo-delete, and check/update plugins from the Web settings panel; runtime enable/disable is persisted to the profile.
description.zh: 在 Web 设置面板中启用、停用、删除/撤回插件，并支持版本检测与 npm 插件更新；运行时开关持久化到 profile。

plugins.name: universal-plugin-hub

description.en: Use plugins from ecosystems such as Claude Code and Codex in DSH: add Git plugin sources and marketplaces, upload plugins and skills, add MCP servers, automatically discover and toggle local skills, and manage plugins, skills and MCP in one place, including plugin-provided subagents, Hooks and LSP.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 Claude Code、Codex 等软件生态的插件，一站式管理插件、Skills 与 MCP。支持添加 Git 插件源和 marketplace、上传插件和 Skills、添加 MCP 服务器，自动扫描并开关本地 Skills，接入插件提供的子代理、MCP、Hooks 与 LSP。

capabilityRedLines: runs code at install time (postinstall)

description.en: Plugin center for VibeDev: describes the official VibeDev plugins and installs them in one click through the plugin manager (inspect, install disabled, then enable, with prerequisites). Also offers a suite install, migration of a renamed package, and a one-click install of the dshmarket plugin market.
description.zh: VibeDev 插件中心：介绍 VibeDev 官方插件，并通过官方插件管理器一键安装（先检查、先不启用地安装、再启用，并带上前置依赖）。另提供套装安装、旧包名迁移，以及一键安装插件市场 dshmarket。

description.en: Adds an independent settings page to update npm-stable dshmarket through the DSH plugin manager, with version verification and best-effort recovery on installation failure.
description.zh: 提供独立设置页，通过 DSH 插件管理器更新 npm 稳定版 dshmarket，支持版本核对及安装失败时尝试恢复旧版。

description.en: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin development.
description.zh: 插件生态基建：浏览器面板管理官方 repository 插件（0 patch）+ make-dsh-plugin 插件开发引导技能。

description.en: Automatically groups installed plugins in dsh-market on startup.
description.zh: 启动时自动把已安装插件归入 dsh-market 分组。

description.en: A plugin center for DeepSeek Harness: install, update and enable DSH plugins, aggregate plugin index sources, and install from a git branch. Also publishes a subscribable format-1 plugin index.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件中心：安装、更新与启停 DSH 插件，聚合插件索引源，支持按分支安装；同时发布可订阅的格式 1 插件索引。

description.en: Expert manager: manage ntd-format experts and expert teams (plugin.json + Agent MD + skill sets), browse and install from a built-in market of 50+ experts, and run tasks in an expert persona via /expert-<name> without consuming model directory tokens.
description.zh: 专家管理：管理 ntd 格式的专家与专家团队（plugin.json + Agent MD + 技能集），内置 50+ 专家市场，`/expert-名称` 以专家身份执行任务，不占模型目录 token。

description.en: Adds a checkbox-style switch at the right end of the Installed group header on the DSH Plugins page: it opens a checklist of the unofficial plugins, all checked by default, and toggles only the ones you keep checked. Once everything is off the button flips to enabling them again. Disable/enable only — it never uninstalls a plugin or deletes plugin files and configuration, and its UI copy follows the app language.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页的「已安装」分组标题右端加一个勾选式开关：点开是当前方向下非官方插件的清单，默认全选，只切换你保留勾选的那些；全部停用后按钮翻转成启用侧。只做启用/停用，从不卸载插件、也不删除插件文件与配置，界面文案跟随应用语言。

description.en: Community search, similarity analysis, and install/dedupe/build-it-yourself decisions for the dsh-plugin ecosystem.
description.zh: DSH 插件生态的社区搜索、相似度分析与安装/去重/自建决策工具。

description.en: DSH onboarding plugin: recommends plugins across eight domains ranked by weighted GitHub stars and npm monthly downloads, installs the recommended set in one click behind a reviewable plan, and exports or imports an environment code recording a profile's plugin list, exact versions and enabled flags.
description.zh: DSH 新人引导插件：按八个领域推荐插件（GitHub Star 与 npm 近月下载加权排序），先出计划再一键安装，并可导出／导入记录 profile 插件清单、精确版本与启用状态的环境码。

description.en: In-app plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, one-click install, compat badges.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 内置插件商店：浏览、搜索、一键安装、兼容性徽章。

description.en: Self-hosted plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness with accounts, groups, permissions, artifact storage, and install statistics; run the server with Docker and install this client bundle in DSH.
description.zh: 面向团队的 DSH 自托管插件市场：账号、权限组、制品存储与安装统计；服务端用 Docker 运行，DSH 安装此客户端组合包。
