description.en: Expert market for DeepSeek Harness: WorkBuddy expert/expert-team system ported onto native agent presets, 425-expert catalog installed on demand, capability subtraction, and team delegation tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 专家市场：WorkBuddy 专家/专家团体系原生 agent preset 移植，425 个官方专家目录按需安装，内置能力减法声明、开场白与团队委派工具。

description.en: Plugin index inside DSH that lists over 10,000 third-party plugins checked against the dsh.bundle manifest in their package.json rather than by star count, with one-click install and a companion website.
description.zh: DSH 内的插件索引，收录 1 万余个按 package.json 里的 dsh.bundle 声明校验过的第三方插件（不按星数判定），支持一键安装，另有配套网站。

description.en: Steam Workshop-style in-app plugin browser: search, hot/newest/trending (7/30/90-day) sorting, Chinese keyword mapping, bilingual descriptions and README translation, plugin-signature filtering, and one-click install/update.
description.zh: 创意工坊式插件浏览器：侧栏常驻入口，搜索/最热/最新/近 7-90 天飙升榜、中文关键词映射、描述与 README 机翻、插件特征验证过滤、一键安装/更新。

description.en: Adds an 'Upgrades' tab to the DSH Plugins page: npm update checks for all installed plugins, engines.dsh compatibility preflight before upgrading, and one-click in-place upgrades that bypass pnpm's 24-hour release-cooling gate. Also refreshes the npm dependency families pulled in by GitHub-sourced bundles, and checks the Harness itself against the latest npm release.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页新增「升级」标签：集中检查全部插件的 npm 新版本，升级前预检 engines.dsh 兼容性，一键原地升级并绕过 pnpm 的 24 小时发布冷却期； 支持刷新 GitHub 来源插件内含的依赖全家桶，并可检查 DSH 本体是否有新版。

description.en: Plugin manager tab in DSH Settings → Plugins: install from npm or git with progress, enable/disable switches effective at next startup, conflict reconciliation with undo, and one-click hand-off to a fix session.
description.zh: 设置 → 插件 分区里的插件管理 Tab：从 npm/git 安装带进度、下次启动生效的启停开关、安装冲突对账可撤销、失败一键转交修复会话。

description.en: Registers one `wind_finance` tool for DeepSeek Harness: it routes a financial question to the right Wind data domain, executes it over the Wind meta-router MCP endpoint (or the per-domain CLI in batch mode), and keeps a per-day receipt so the same dataset is not pulled twice against one shared daily quota. Authentication, quota and network failures are reported with their error codes instead of falling back to another data source. Credentials are read from the environment and are never bundled with the plugin.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册一个 `wind_finance` 工具：把金融问题路由到正确的 Wind 数据域，经 Wind meta-router MCP 端点（或批量模式下的分域 CLI）执行，并用按日回执避免同一份数据在共享日额度下被重复取数。认证、额度与网络失败如实返回错误码，不换数据源兜底。凭据只从环境变量读取，不随插件分发。

description.en: A Versions tab on the Plugins page: one-click upgrades that replace the plugin in place where they can (no uninstall, enabled state preserved, falling back to remove + reinstall with the reason logged when the profile writer lock is busy), live pnpm output with per-step timing and cancel, the full published version history with one-click rollback, every version checked against the running DSH so incompatible ones are marked and blocked, a rollback that installs the old version but cannot activate it reported separately from a lost package, profile manifest writes taken under the harness writer lock with one recoverable journal record per package after a failed upgrade, mirror-gap warnings, and a selectable npm registry saved in the profile.
description.zh: 在「插件」页新增「版本」标签：一键升级，能就地替换时就地替换（不卸载、启用状态保留；拿不到 profile 写入锁时退回卸载再装，并在日志写明走了哪条路），实时显示 pnpm 输出、每步耗时并可取消，列出全部已发布版本并一键回滚，每个版本先与当前运行的 DSH 核对，装不了的标出并禁用按钮，回滚时装回却无法激活的情况与包丢失分开说明，profile manifest 读写走 harness 自己的写入锁，升级失败后按包各留一条可恢复的 journal 记录，标出镜像落后上游的缺口，安装源可选并写进 profile。

description.en: A fork of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet with Claude-themed whale-girl pets, 122 transparent animations, randomized activity chains, laptop work transitions, and a task acknowledgement salute. Replaces the original plugin; do not install both together.
description.zh: 基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 的 Claude 大肥鱼桌宠分支，包含站立与托腮形态、122 段透明动画、随机日常动作链与电脑办公衔接；收到任务先敬礼回应。作为原版替代使用，请勿与原版同时安装。

plugins.name: cute-fat-fish-pet#src

description.en: A chibi blue-haired maid desktop pet for the DSH Web UI with 106 hand-drawn transparent animations, desktop wandering, chat through local Ollama or the DSH online models, and optional screen watching.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的 Q 版蓝发小女仆桌宠：106 个手绘透明动画、桌面漫步、本地 Ollama 或 DSH 在线模型陪聊，可选看屏幕吐槽。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A draggable basketball desktop pet that bounces around the window, with a hoop to score in and a crate that keeps the ball.
description.zh: 可拖拽的篮球桌宠：在窗口里左右弹跳，拖起来松手就能投篮；配一个可移动的篮筐和一个装球的箱子，进球加一分，分数每天重置。

description.en: Two games inside DeepSeek Harness where the model supplies intent and a local engine owns the rules: a twin-brain snake that periodically draws a strategy card, and Chinese chess where the model only comments on a move picked from locally generated legal candidates. Both keep running when the model is slow, offline or out of quota.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里玩游戏，分工是模型负责「想」、本地引擎负责「动」：双脑贪吃蛇会周期性抽一张策略卡；中国象棋里模型只从本地生成的合法候选着法里挑一个并解说。模型变慢、断网或额度用尽时，两个游戏都照常运行。

description.en: A piano keyboard in the DeepSeek Harness UI: click a key to play it, or hold and drag sideways for a glissando across the keys. Notes are synthesized live with Web Audio — no samples, no network, no third-party dependencies — and the volume and starting octave are remembered between sessions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面里弹一条钢琴键盘：点单键出声，按住横向滑动就是刮奏。声音用 Web Audio 实时合成——零采样、零网络、零第三方依赖；音量与起始八度会被记住。

description.en: Turns the right edge of the chat scroll area into a theremin-style strip: the vertical mouse position picks the pitch (higher up, higher note), and blue ticks mark your own messages so you can click one to jump to it. Includes a draggable on/off pill and volume slider.
description.zh: 把聊天区右边缘变成一条特雷门琴式的竖条：鼠标纵向位置决定音高；你发过的每条消息在对应位置有一根蓝杠，点一下跳到那条消息。左下角是可拖动的开关胶囊与音量滑块。

description.en: Adds a sticker pack to DeepSeek Harness replies. The plugin rolls the dice, the model attaches the chosen sticker at the end of its reply, and the pictures come from a remote pack.json you can host anywhere.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的回复加上表情包。贴不贴由插件掷骰决定，模型把选中的图放到回复末尾；图库来自一个可以自己托管的远端 pack.json。

description.en: Import SillyTavern/TavernAI character cards and world books, save them as local Markdown lore documents, and generate novel prose from your prompts with the world settings as reference.
description.zh: 导入酒馆（SillyTavern/TavernAI）角色卡与世界书，落地为本地 Markdown 设定文档，激活创作模式后根据用户输入、参考世界书创作小说。

description.en: This plugin lets two deepseek bounce around the interface—it has no real purpose.
description.zh: 这个插件的功能就是让两只大肥鱼在界面弹来弹去，无实意

description.en: NextTavern is a long-form roleplay plugin for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 Web, with character-card import and creation, worldlines, worldbooks, layered long-term memory, keyword/semantic/hybrid retrieval, character agents, and card or novel export. SillyTavern character-card import is supported; v0.2.9 fixes distribution and installation.
description.zh: NextTavern 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 Web 的长篇角色扮演插件，支持角色卡导入与创作、世界线、世界书、分层长期记忆、关键词／语义／混合检索、角色 Agent，以及角色卡或小说导出；支持 SillyTavern 角色卡导入，v0.2.9 修复分发与安装问题。

description.en: A draggable Live2D desktop pet for the DSH web GUI that tracks the pointer, changes motion, expression and outfit with the session phase, and opens a right-click control panel.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标，跟着会话状态换动作、表情与装扮，右键呼出控制面板。

description.en: Pull a 3D lever next to the send button and turn the model's reasoning signals into a pixel-art gacha reveal.
description.zh: 在发送按钮旁拉动 3D 拉杆，把模型思维链的文本信号变成一场像素风抽卡演出。

description.en: A Bilibili companion that keeps its own schedule. A 60-second tick in the plugin host wakes a dedicated agent session at a random moment inside the configured time windows (opting out of a day is a configurable chance), then hands it a bundled CLI of 38 subcommands — feed, subtitles, danmaku, comments, ffmpeg frame grabs, and two diaries. Shares at most N items a day by commenting on them and @-mentioning the owner (default 3, enforced from a written quota log, and it stops on rate-limit or captcha signals). Also polls comment replies, direct messages and live-room danmaku; replies to anyone but the owner are queued for approval in Settings. Settings → 养鱼 writes ~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json; cookies live separately in ~/.bili-ai/credentials.json and are never echoed back. The HTTP routes are loopback-only behind DSH's trust fence. Needs Node 18+ and ffmpeg on PATH for frame extraction.
description.zh: 一条按自己作息过日子的 B 站插件：宿主里每 60 秒一次心跳，在设定的作息窗口里随机挑一个时刻叫醒专用会话（今天不想看是按概率跳过），再交给自带的 38 个子命令——信息流、字幕、弹幕、评论、ffmpeg 抽帧、两本日记。每天最多发 N 条评论/动态并 @ 主人（默认 3，按配额账本计数，撞到限流或验证码就停手）。同时轮询评论回复、私信和直播间弹幕；除主人以外的回复先入队，等主人在设置页批准。设置 → 养鱼 写 ~/.dsh/bili-whale.config.json；cookie 单独在 ~/.bili-ai/credentials.json，只写不回显。HTTP 路由只认回环地址并过 DSH 信任栅栏。抽帧需要 Node 18+ 与 ffmpeg。

description.en: Purple-white desktop pet that docks to the screen edge and shows real-time CPU, RAM, GPU and NVMe temperatures with hardware info.
description.zh: 紫白桌宠悬浮球，贴边停靠实时显示 CPU/内存/GPU/NVMe 温度与硬件信息。

description.en: Short-video sidebar: native player, series navigation, precise history replay.
description.zh: 侧栏短视频：原生播放器、系列导航、精确历史回放。

description.en: Fixes the bug where your account can't lose money while you code.
description.zh: 有效解决了写代码的时候账户不能同时亏钱的 BUG。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-girl-live2d

description.en: A Live2D whale-girl companion for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the model stays on screen and reacts to what the agent is actually doing (thinking, tool calls, streaming text, errors, turn completion); click her to send the agent a message and watch the reply stream into a speech bubble; right-click for a menu of expressions, dress-up items, desk scenes and one-shot animations, every action mapped from the original model author hotkey sheet so nothing overlaps and everything expires on its own. Non-commercial model assets (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), MIT code, by Andersen216 (https://github.com/Andersen216).
description.zh: DSH 里的 Live2D 桌宠「鲸鱼娘」：模型常驻 Web 界面，跟着 agent 的真实状态换表情与动作（思考、调工具、逐字输出、报错、收工庆祝），点一下就能直接给 agent 发消息、回复逐字冒进气泡；右键菜单可换表情、戴眼镜贴纸、摆桌面场景、演一次性小动作，动作全部照模型作者自己的按键表设计，互不冲突、到点自动收回。模型素材非商业（CC BY-NC-SA 4.0），代码 MIT，作者 Andersen216。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-whale-chat

description.en: A talking whale desktop pet for the DSH web UI — persona-driven chat with persistent memory, plus scheduled autonomous web browsing that brings back a summarized message telling you what she found. Based on PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (its art and animations are reused under the upstream non-commercial terms); install it instead of dsh-pet, not alongside it.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面右下角的会说话的鲸鱼桌宠：可配置人设与持久对话记忆，还会按间隔自己随机上网，把见闻总结成消息带回来告诉你。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 的二次创作（沿用其形象与动画素材，素材不可商用），请替代 dsh-pet 安装，不要与上游同装。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 198.18.0.0 for network access

description.en: Choose three cards from a shuffled 78-card tarot deck, reveal source-linked meanings, and refine the reading through follow-up questions.
description.zh: 从洗乱的 78 张塔罗牌中亲选三张，查看带来源链接的牌义，并通过追问细化解读。

description.en: Extensible desktop-pet plugin for the DSH Web GUI, with feed / play / character-switch menus and Codex 8x9 spritesheet characters.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的可扩展桌面宠物插件，支持投喂、玩耍、切换角色，并使用 Codex 8x9 spritesheet 添加自定义角色。

description.en: A-share watchlist real-time market monitoring plugin: a collapsible popup in the top-right corner of the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web interface for real-time quote monitoring, group switching, intraday and candlestick (K-line) charts, and buy/sell target price settings.
description.zh: A 股自选股实时行情盯盘插件：在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面的右上角显示一个可折叠弹窗，实时监控自选股行情、切换分组、查看分时与 K 线、设置买卖目标价。

description.en: Galgame generator: give it a script document plus character/background/BGM/animation assets in the workspace (img_human/, img_bg/, audio/, img_cg/) and it builds a playable visual-novel web page with configurable save slots (`[存档 N]`, default 9), speaker-following sprites with multi-pose variant switching (`[表情]`), opening/ending/CG animations (`[op]`/`[ed]`/`[cg]`), BGM play/stop/volume control, and if-line branching.
description.zh: Galgame 生成器：提供剧本文档与立绘/背景/音乐/动画素材（工作区 img_human/、img_bg/、audio/、img_cg/）即可生成可玩视觉小说网页，支持可配置存档槽位（`[存档 N]`，默认 9）、立绘自动跟随说话人并切换多表情立绘（`[表情]`）、开局/结束/CG 动画（`[op]`/`[ed]`/`[cg]`）、BGM 播放/停止/音量控制与 if 条件线分支。

description.en: Kids' coding classroom: run Python and LOGO-turtle code, explain, practice, review and step through programs.
description.zh: 小朋友的编程小教室：跑 Python 与海龟画图代码、讲解、练习、点评、分步。

description.en: Explains computer memory as a workbench: current usage, memory pressure and top programs.
description.zh: 把内存讲成工作台：当前占用、内存压力、最占内存的程序。

description.en: Network explorer for kids: my identity, DNS lookup, a traceroute trip, speed test and who is home on the LAN.
description.zh: 网络小旅行：我的身份、DNS 查询、路由追踪、测速、谁在局域网。

description.en: Processes as little workers: how many, the busiest, the family tree and badges.
description.zh: 进程小工人：数量、谁最卖力、家族树、工牌。

description.en: Computer safety shown as castle guards: firewall, disk encryption, lock screen, remote ports and login history.
description.zh: 电脑安全小城堡守卫：防火墙、磁盘加密、锁屏、远程端口、登录记录。

description.en: Storage explorer: disk boxes, the home folder and the heaviest items.
description.zh: 存储小仓库：磁盘分区、主目录、最占空间的东西。

description.en: System monitor for kids: a single card summary of CPU, memory and disk.
description.zh: 系统小监控：一张卡片看 CPU、内存、磁盘概况。

description.en: Make the Naiwa desktop pet laugh whenever a DeepSeek Harness agent turn ends. Windows only; requires the Naiwa desktop pet installed.
description.zh: 每轮 DeepSeek Harness 回答结束时，让奶蛙桌宠捧腹大笑一次。仅 Windows；需先安装奶蛙桌宠。

description.en: A model-driven desktop pet, derived from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT): an always-on-top companion that follows your agent sessions, races the Web UI to answer approvals and questions, keeps a per-pet affection ledger, speaks through pet_say/pet_do tools or an autonomous inner voice, and can read those lines aloud through BreezeBlue TTS with your own BreezeBlue API key. It uses its own /whale598 route and ~/.dsh/whale598 data directory, so it is a separate pet from dsh-pet rather than a replacement for it.
description.zh: 模型驱动的桌面宠物，派生自 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT）：独立置顶小窗跟随会话状态，与 Web 界面竞速应答审批与提问，维护每宠独立的好感账本，经 pet_say/pet_do 工具或自主内心戏说话，并可用自备的 BreezeBlue API Key 通过 BreezeBlue 把台词读出来。它使用独立的 /whale598 路由与 ~/.dsh/whale598 数据目录，是独立于 dsh-pet 的另一只桌宠，不替代上游。

description.en: Extensible AI-driven group-reaction narrative game framework for DeepSeek Harness: type one action and multiple NPCs each respond in their own chatroom message with avatar illustrations; worlds, locations, NPCs and feature extensions (e.g. a third-party drawing API for dynamic NPC expressions) are added and modified through the harness chat dialog without code.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：可扩展的 AI 群像聊天游戏框架。输入一个行动，多个 NPC 各自回应，每条反应独立成带头像插图的聊天室消息；世界、地点、NPC 与功能扩展（如接入第三方绘图 API 实现 NPC 动态表情动作）都可以在对话框里让 agent 直接添加修改，无需写代码。

description.en: Adds a sidebar music browser with multiple public sources, persistent background playback, queue advancement, and reviewed MusicFree-compatible source extensions.
description.zh: 提供多公共音源的侧栏音乐浏览、持续后台播放、队列续播，以及经审核安装的 MusicFree 兼容音源扩展。

description.en: A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style pixel strip docked at the bottom of the app frame, with an 80-second day/night cycle, bell with note particles, jumps, a headlight, and ride stats. Creepers roam by day and zombies by night. Requires DSH >=0.2.1-alpha.
description.zh: 一只戴头盔的像素小鸡骑行在 GUI 底部的我的世界像素风骑行带里，带 80 秒昼夜循环、按铃音符、跳跃、车头灯与骑行统计。白天苦力怕出没，夜晚僵尸被撞飞。需要 DSH >=0.2.1-alpha。

description.en: Local-first A-share portfolio and watchlist monitor for DSH: sidebar quotes, holdings P&L, browser add/edit/delete, and JSON persistence.
description.zh: DSH 本地优先的 A 股持仓与自选监控：侧栏行情、持仓盈亏，以及网页添加、修改、删除和 JSON 保存。

description.en: A Windows pixel Madara desktop companion with 16 animation clips driven by Harness task events, using the original BigFish runtime dependency.
description.zh: Windows 像素宇智波斑桌宠：16 组动作随 Harness 任务事件变化，直接依赖原作者的大肥鱼运行库。

description.en: Six-player no-limit Texas Hold'em for the dsh Web GUI. One human plays against five LLM agents that each see only their own hole cards. Adds a dedicated tab plus a draggable mini-window over the conversation area, per-browser sessions with CSRF protection, pot-relative raise sizing, three rebuys before elimination, and showdown reveals with board-card deal animations.
description.zh: 六人无限注德州扑克：1 名玩家对 5 位只能看到自己底牌的 LLM 智能体。在 Web GUI 中提供独立 Tab 与会话区可拖拽悬浮小窗，支持按浏览器隔离的牌局与 CSRF 防护、按底池倍数给出的加注尺度、每人 3 次买入后出局，以及摊牌亮牌与公共牌翻牌动效。

description.en: Adds a celebratory fireworks overlay to the DSH Web UI through a happy_fireworks agent tool.
description.zh: 通过 `happy_fireworks` Agent 工具为 DSH Web UI 增加庆祝礼花覆盖层。

description.en: Tavern management panel for DeepSeek Harness: character cards, worldbooks and presets with per-session isolation, memory summaries, a character relationship web, one-click plot options and an NSFW mode. The full experience also needs the companion plugins dsh-muv-engine and dsh-muv-table, which render the status bar, the plot options and the variable tables. Card-provided status bars, variable folds and option cards now render inside a sandboxed iframe, so card styles no longer leak into the host UI.
description.zh: 酒馆管理面板：多角色卡、多世界书、多预设与会话级隔离，记忆总结、角色关系网、剧情选项一键发送，另有 NSFW 模式。完整效果需同时安装伴生插件 dsh-muv-engine 与 dsh-muv-table，用于渲染状态栏、剧情选项与变量表格。角色卡自带的状态栏 / 变量折叠 / 选项卡片在沙盒 iframe 中渲染，卡内样式不再外溢到宿主界面。

description.en: A two-eyed royal-blue pixel whale that perches on the DSH composer, changes expression with the live agent state, watches you type, and makes a short dive across the composer every 30 seconds while idle.
description.zh: 趴在 DSH 输入框上沿的双眼宝蓝色像素小鲸鱼，表情跟随智能体实时状态，打字时会停下来注视，空闲时每 30 秒横穿输入框巡游一次。

description.en: A desk pet that floats over the DSH interface and opens into a daily check-in, focus timer and habit journal.
description.zh: 浮动在 DSH 界面上的桌宠，点开是打卡、专注计时与生活手帐。

description.en: Role-play conversations with character cards, in-chat character-card authoring and editing, and image generation through configurable backends.
description.zh: 角色扮演插件：支持角色卡对话、在对话中创作与编辑角色卡，可接入生图后端生成插图。

description.en: A xiuxian (Chinese cultivation-fantasy) world where agents create a cultivator and play through 16 tools - cultivate, roam 22 areas, delve 8 dungeons, chat with 4 builtin NPC cultivators - and on exit export a self-contained HTML replay plus a Markdown journey diary, fully offline with zero servers.
description.zh: 修仙世界插件。agent 通过 16 个 xiuxian_* 工具创角修行：修炼、游历 22 处地点、探索 8 座秘境、与 4 位内置修士传音；收工时导出自包含 HTML 回放与 Markdown 修炼日记，全程离线零服务器。

description.en: Typing effects, companions and sounds for DSH: theme presets with pets or whale, combos, fullscreen glow and optional key sounds.
description.zh: 为 DSH 打字过程添加主题特效、萌宠或蓝鲸陪伴、连击动画、全屏光晕与可选打字音效。

description.en: Terminal-style AI-lab idle game where you hoard compute, train and upgrade models, publish papers, and prestige from neural nets to ASI.
description.zh: 终端风 AI 实验室挂机游戏：攒算力、训练升级模型、发论文，一路转生到 AGI/ASI。

description.en: Live2D desk pet overlay for the DSH web GUI: mirrors agent state (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval) with motions and speech bubbles, per-part touch reactions, drag-to-dock, switchable personas, and custom models via URL or local path.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠悬浮层：镜像 agent 思考/空闲/出错/完成/待审批状态，配动画与气泡，支持分部位触摸反应、拖动停靠、切换人设，以及通过 URL 或本地路径加载自定义模型。

description.en: A Wang Lin cultivation companion for dsh: watches your session state and acts it out with rich animations, and levels up as you cultivate.
description.zh: 渡劫飞升：仙逆王林修炼伙伴。实时监控会话状态，用打坐、掐诀、御剑、雷龙等丰富交互动画演绎大模型的每一个动作，随使用修炼升境。

description.en: XiaoShuang desktop pet for DSH: six-layer memory, persona injection, mood-driven video avatar, manual emotion menu, and TTS replies.
description.zh: 小双桌面宠物人格：六层记忆、人设注入、跟随 agent 状态的视频形象、手动表情菜单与 TTS 语音回复。

description.en: Multi-pet companion for the dsh web GUI: a registry-driven floating pet that reacts to model activity.
description.zh: dsh web GUI 多桌宠伴侣：注册表驱动的悬浮宠物，随模型活动实时反应。

description.en: DSH side of Blind Whale Farmer, a SMAPI mod in the same repo that lets an AI play Stardew Valley from a text game state through MCP tools: syncs play limits and extra instructions to the running game, adds an optional session preset or a single stardew gateway tool (both off by default), and sends "keep playing" when a Stardew session ends on a tool call that came back as plain text. Needs the mod installed in the game.
description.zh: 大肥鱼种白饭（Blind Whale Farmer）的 DSH 插件。同仓库里的 SMAPI 模组把星露谷的游戏状态转成文字、通过 MCP 工具让 AI 来玩；插件把每次游玩时长和额外要求同步到正在运行的游戏，提供可选的会话预设或单个 stardew 入口工具（默认都关闭），并在星露谷会话因工具调用变成文字而中断时自动发一句“接着玩”。需要先在游戏里装好模组。

description.en: Animated desktop pets, one mascot per coding-plan provider (GLM, MiniMax, Kimi, DeepSeek, MiMo). Poses follow the running session; moods follow quota usage read from dsh-quota-hub.
description.zh: 动画桌宠，每家编程套餐一只吉祥物（GLM、MiniMax、Kimi、DeepSeek、MiMo）。动作跟随会话运行状态，心情跟随 dsh-quota-hub 的额度用量。

description.en: A whale-maid with a jar, sitting in the corner of your DSH window. She goes exploring on Bilibili for whatever you are into, ranks by like, coin and favourite rate rather than view count, and brings back pickled snacks that suit your taste. When a term runs dry she takes another route. Five picks go into the jar, and she tells you what each video is about. News-type axes keep only the last two weeks; game guides and music have no limit, and each axis decides for itself.
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘带着一个罐子，守在右下角。按照你的兴趣，她会去 B 站探险，按赞币藏率排，给你找一些符合口味的电子榨菜。哪个词搜得少，她换条路再找。回来把五条装进罐子里，然后和你说说这些视频讲了什么。时政这类她只留最近两周，游戏攻略和音乐不限时间，每根轴她自己定。

plugins.name: dsh-live-vibeCoding

description.en: A fork of dsh-livestream (MIT) - install it instead of that plugin, not alongside it. Lets DSH host a Bilibili livestream: chat and gift replies, queued viewer video requests on a skinnable stage, Doubao TTS voice, and automatic OBS/Bilibili streaming setup; needs OBS Studio 28+ and a Bilibili live room, and the voice stays silent until you add a Doubao TTS API key (Python + faster-whisper optional for transcribing subtitle-less videos).
description.zh: dsh-livestream（MIT）的分支，请替代原插件安装、不要与它同时安装。让 DSH 在 B 站当主播：回弹幕、谢礼物、观众点的视频排队上舞台、豆包 TTS 音色说话，并自动配置 OBS 与 B 站推流；前置需要 OBS Studio 28+ 和一个 B 站直播间，没填豆包 TTS API Key 时只有画面没有声音（无字幕视频转写可选装 Python + faster-whisper）。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Available on npm as dsh-doudizhu-lan. Three-player LAN Dou Dizhu (斗地主) played from a floating window: one machine opens a room on its own port, the other two join with a six-character room code plus an address. Empty seats can be filled by computer players in four switchable strengths (easy, medium, hard, hell), so one or two people can still play a whole hand; the deal starts as soon as the three seats are filled. 54 cards in four suits, bidding of 1/2/3 or pass, the landlord takes the three bottom cards and holds 20, play runs clockwise, and the first-bid seat rotates clockwise between hands. The rule engine is pure and covers 11 legal shapes, with big joker > small joker > 2 > A > K down to 3, suits never compared, straights, pair-straights and planes excluding the 2s and the jokers, and a rocket that beats everything. The table itself is built to be read at a glance: three seat cards side by side in play order (you, then your next and previous seats) with role, hand count and a bar that runs out, one line that says whose hand is on the table and what would beat it, the bottom cards as text, an in-place play history that folds into a single summary line and unfolds into every trick including the passes, plus hint and auto-play buttons that pick the cheapest legal answer out of the local rule enumeration. Nicknames can be changed mid-hand (twelve characters, duplicates get a suffix). Computers run inside the authority and are handed only their own hand, the public record and the seat counts, so no hand can leak; the authority is the only place that decides which card ids leave it. Computers are driven by the room itself, so a one-person table keeps playing with nobody else on the LAN port. Humans have no turn timer, the collapsed floating pill can be dragged around the screen, and 179 unit tests pin the rules, the wire format, the theme tokens, the drag gesture, the history grouping and the computer seats.
description.zh: npm 包名 dsh-doudizhu-lan。三人局域网斗地主，从浮窗里打：一台机器用自己的端口开房，另外两家填六位房间码加地址入座。空位可以交给电脑补，四档强度（简单/中等/困难/地狱）随时可换，一个人或两个人也能打完整一局；座位坐满就发牌。54 张牌四种花色，叫分为 1/2/3 或不叫，地主拿三张底牌共 20 张，顺时针出牌，下局首叫位顺时针轮换。规则引擎为纯函数，覆盖 11 种合法牌型，大王 > 小王 > 2 > A > K 直到 3，花色不参与比较，顺子、连对与飞机不含 2 和王，王炸最大。牌桌本身按「一眼看懂」来做：三张座位卡按出牌顺序并排（我、下家、上家），带身份、剩余张数和一条会走空的进度条；一行说清台面上是谁的牌、要压过什么；底牌以文字贴在右侧；出牌历史贴在牌桌上，默认折成一行摘要，展开就是每一轮谁出了什么、谁不出；另有提示与帮我出两个按钮，从本地规则枚举里挑最省牌力的一手。昵称随时可改（十二字以内，重名自动加后缀）。电脑跑在权威那台机器里，只拿得到自己的手牌、公开的出牌记录与各家张数，因此看不到别人的手牌；权威服务是唯一决定哪些牌能离开它的地方。电脑由房间本身驱动，所以一个人加两台电脑的单机桌在没有别人连局域网端口时也照样打完；真人没有回合计时，收起后的药丸可以拖到屏幕任意位置，179 个单元测试钉住规则、传输格式、主题 token、拖动手势、历史分组与电脑座位。

description.en: A no-limit Texas holdem table where you are the only human. Eight seats: you plus seven LLM agents written on AI-founder personas (Altman, Dario Amodei, Musk, Liang Wenfeng, Jensen Huang, Lei Jun, Zhang Yiming). Each agent bets through the currently selected host model and falls back to its own heuristic style when no model is available; every agent only ever sees its own hole cards, because the prompt is built from that seat alone. A hand ends by revealing the winner hole cards, with a flip animation replayed on every community card, and a rail keeps a live action-and-table-talk timeline. LAN mode (off by default, single-machine play is unaffected) lets another install on the same network join this very table: the host shows a six-digit room code, UDP broadcast discovers nearby tables, and a joiner randomly takes over one bot seat, with the seat handed back to its character on leave or after twenty seconds of silence. The room code is never put on the wire and every snapshot is generated for one viewer seat, so nobody, not even the host, can read another player hole cards. Fork of BubblePtr/dsh-holdem (MIT), credited in the README and in the UI.
description.zh: 一张只有你一个人类的无限注德州扑克桌。八个座位：你，加上七位以 AI 创始人设写成的 LLM 智能体（Altman、达里奥、马斯克、梁文峰、黄仁勋、雷军、张一鸣）。每个智能体都通过宿主当前选中的模型下注，模型不可用时回落到自己的启发式风格；每个智能体只看得见自己的底牌，因为提示词只由它自己那个座位拼出来。一手结束时亮出赢家底牌，每张公共牌落地都会重播翻牌动画，侧栏保留实时的行动与桌边闲话时间线。局域网模式默认关闭、不影响单机玩法：同一网络里的另一份安装可以加入这张桌，主机屏幕显示 6 位房间号，UDP 广播负责发现附近的牌桌，加入者随机顶替一名人机座位，离开或静默二十秒后座位交还该角色。房间号从不上广播，且每份快照都按观看者座位生成，所以没有人（连主机也不行）能读到别人的底牌。本仓库是 BubblePtr/dsh-holdem（MIT）的 fork，README 与界面都保留了上游署名。

description.en: A social deduction game played against your own model configurations. A table has N seats (six by default, one of them yours) and some of the rest are played by agents bound to different provider, model, temperature, system prompt and disguise settings; you interrogate them and cross-check the answers to work out which seats are not human. Seat identity and each agent model configuration stay hidden in the host state until a seat is judged, then the disguise parameters are revealed. Every round exports a per-seat conversation JSONL plus the judgment record, and the same seed with the same move script replays byte-identical, so runs with different models or disguise strengths can be diffed.
description.zh: 拿你自己的模型配置当对手玩的社交推理游戏。一张桌子有 N 个座位（默认 6 个，其中一个是你的），其余若干座位由绑定了不同 provider、model、temperature、system prompt 与伪装参数的 agent 扮演；你通过提问和交叉印证，判断哪些座位不是人。座位身份与每个 agent 的模型配置在判定前都不出现在 host 状态里，判定后才揭晓伪装参数。每局导出逐席位对话 JSONL 与判定记录，同一 seed 加同一份操作脚本可复现出逐字节相同的对局，于是换模型、换提示词、换伪装强度的几局可以直接 diff。

description.en: Whale girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: browser floating mascot plus Windows desktop pet sharing one data backend, with real-time balance board, task notices, head-pat interaction, 19 pre-synthesized voiced lines with per-line emotion, and presence-aware idle speech.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：浏览器悬浮桌宠与 Windows 桌面桌宠共享一套数据，实时余额木牌、任务通知、摸头互动、19 句预合成带情感的台词朗读，空闲节奏随是否在场自适应。

description.en: A chibi whale maid desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness who eats white rice while the model generates, lives inside the DSH window or anywhere on a macOS or Windows desktop, and dives for treasure between turns. On Windows the desktop overlay is compiled at install time and skipped when swiftc or the .NET SDK is unavailable, so the pet stays inside the DSH window.
description.zh: DSH 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：模型生成时一口一口吃白饭，住在窗口里或桌面任意角落（macOS / Windows），回合结束还会下海捞宝。桌面浮层在安装时编译，缺少 swiftc 或 .NET SDK 时会跳过，桌宠只留在 DSH 窗口里。

description.en: Derived from WolfGenerals/ncm-player (ncm-player4 1.3.1 lineage, baseline published on the repo's baseline/ncm-player4-1.3.1 branch); cannot be enabled together with ncm-player2/3/4, because they all register the /ncm/api prefix. Floating NetEase Cloud Music player in the DSH web UI: search, playlists, synced lyrics with translation, a persisted queue, a collapsible mini bar, and a bottom-right note button that can be dragged and pulses with the bass; tracks that come back without a playable URL are skipped automatically.
description.zh: 衍生自 WolfGenerals/ncm-player（ncm-player4 1.3.1 一系，基线源码公开在仓库的 baseline/ncm-player4-1.3.1 分支）；不能与 ncm-player2/3/4 同时启用，它们都占用 /ncm/api 前缀。DSH Web 界面里的网易云音乐浮窗播放器：搜索、歌单、专辑、逐行同步歌词与翻译、队列持久化，可收起为迷你条，右下角音符按钮可拖动并随低频鼓点跳动；无版权或已下架的歌曲会自动跳过并播放下一首。

description.en: A VRM 3D desktop pet with task-state animations, a floating desktop window, body-part interactions, and optional AI chatter.
description.zh: 支持任务状态联动动画、独立悬浮窗、部位互动和可选 AI 碎碎念的 VRM 3D 桌宠。

description.en: Searches seasonal anime charts and Bangumi and MAL rankings with cross-region comparison.
description.zh: 检索 yuc 新番表与 Bangumi/MAL 评分榜，支持搜索推荐和国内外差异对照。

description.en: Controls an already-running NetEase Cloud Music desktop client over CDP (the client must be started with --remote-debugging-port=9222) and searches songs through NetEase's public web API; no API key or extra login, and member-only features use the client's own signed-in account.
description.zh: 通过 CDP 驱动已运行的网易云音乐桌面客户端（客户端需以 --remote-debugging-port=9222 启动），搜索走网易云公开网页 API；不需要 API key 或额外登录，会员功能沿用客户端自己的登录账号。

plugins.name: dsh-genshin-account

description.en: Reads one Genshin Impact account (characters, talents, weapons, artifacts, wish history) into a single snapshot, then exposes it as six agent tools and a six-tab panel. Artifact substats come from the public in-game character showcase; scoring ships both CV and per-character weight models with six grade tiers; wish analysis covers pity, luck tiers and per-pool progress. Needs a Miyoushe QR login to read characters, weapons and wish history; showcase data is public by UID.
description.zh: 把原神账号读成一份快照（角色、天赋、武器、圣遗物、祈愿记录），对外给 6 个 agent 工具和一个六页签面板。圣遗物副词条取自游戏内公开的角色展柜；评分同时给 CV 与逐角色权重两套模型，各六档评级；抽卡分析包含保底、欧非分档与各池进度。读取角色、武器与祈愿需要米游社扫码登录；展柜数据按 UID 公开。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to profile.microgg.cn

description.en: Texas Hold'em table for DeepSeek Harness: model-callable poker tools, six heuristic opponents, an optional coach, and a browser table whose buttons never post a chat message.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的德州扑克插件：无限注规则、机器人对手、真实感牌桌，教练模式讲解打法与赔率。

description.en: An orange-tabby desktop pet for dsh-pet — 32 transparent VP9-alpha actions, 512×512 at 8–12fps, with the matte and QA toolchain that produced them.
description.zh: 橘猫桌宠「耄耋」——32 个透明动作（512×512 / 8–12fps / VP9-alpha），附抠像与体检工具链。

description.en: Adds a Spawnd.gg games cabinet to the DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar with search, sorting, hover previews, embedded play, and a minimized player.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧边栏中添加 Spawnd.gg 游戏柜，支持搜索、排序、悬停预览、嵌入式游玩和最小化播放器。

description.en: An ikun (basketball meme) pet that fills the dock under the "Deep diving..." status row during replies: a sprite-sheet pet walks a 0→100% progress bar, switching animation and text every 20%, and plays a system-level "nǐ gàn ma~" voice cue at completion.
description.zh: ikun 桌宠填满「Deep diving...」状态行下方整行区块：坤宠动图沿 0%→100% 进度条行走，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」提示音。

description.en: A Web3D energy orb decoration for the DSH Web GUI: a particle core wrapped in three mechanical rings that shrinks and falls silent while the session is idle and pulses in a double-beat heartbeat while a turn runs. UnrealBloom glow, draggable with its corner, position and size remembered, and three.js served locally by the plugin instead of a CDN.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Web3D 能量球装饰：粒子核心外包三圈机械环，会话静息时收缩沉默、回合运行时以双拍心跳涨缩。UnrealBloom 辉光；可拖动，所在一角、位置与尺寸都会被记住；three.js 由插件本地提供，不走 CDN。

description.en: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
description.zh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

description.en: A 3D-rendered whale desktop pet that swims around the lower-right corner of the dsh web UI and reacts to task events with attention animations and whale-call sounds.
description.zh: 在 dsh web 界面右下角游动的 3D 渲染鲸鱼桌面宠物，任务完成或出错时播放 attention 动画与鲸吟声。

description.en: Tarot readings with a dealt card table, a reading tool, and a reviewable history.
description.zh: 塔罗占卜：可发牌翻牌牌桌、抽牌工具，以及可复盘的历史记录。

description.en: Browse Xiaoheihe posts on a schedule, with optional persona-based comments and replies, QR login, and browsing history.
description.zh: 定时浏览小黑盒帖子，支持可选的人格评论与回复、扫码登录和浏览历史。

description.en: Sticker library for DeepSeek Harness: a composer button opens two bundled packs (10 GPT-drawn plus 8 community fan-art), one click sends a 180px sticker, and a send_sticker tool lets the model understand and reply with stickers.
description.zh: DSH 表情包库：输入区按钮打开默认表情（10 张 GPT 绘制）与社区二创梗图（8 张）两个包，点一下发送 180px 贴纸，模型也能通过 send_sticker 理解并回发表情。

description.en: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet of Firefly (流萤) that chats through the host model, plays animations on click, whispers on a timer, narrates task progress, and shows account balance. Runs in the DSH Desktop app using its bundled Electron runtime (~/.dsh/electron); the pet does not appear if that runtime is missing. Windows only.
description.zh: 流萤桌宠：透明置顶的桌面伴侣，走宿主模型聊天、点击切换动画、定时碎碎念、按会话播报任务进度，并可查询账户余额。依赖 DSH Desktop 自带的 Electron 运行时（~/.dsh/electron），缺失时桌宠不会出现；仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Agentic roleplay for DSH with structured worlds, autonomous characters, persistent sessions, world authoring, speech, and image generation. Requires Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay#state to be installed and enabled.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供具有结构化世界、自主角色、持久会话、世界创作、语音与图像生成功能的智能体角色扮演系统。需要安装并启用 Firefox2100/dsh-agentic-roleplay#state。

plugins.name: dsh-chatting-pet

description.en: Desktop pet for DSH with voice chat, personas, memory, Bilibili and QQ context, and command-gated computer control; enable DSH built-in voice input first to use voice chat. A fork of dsh-pet (MIT), not installable alongside the original.
description.zh: DSH 桌面宠物：语音聊天、多人设、聊天记忆、B 站视频与 QQ 群记忆（只读本地文件）；「电脑操作」需在面板里显式打开总开关后才响应语音指令，语音聊天需先在 DSH 中启用内置语音输入。dsh-pet（MIT）的 fork，不能与原版同时安装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A draggable character companion for the DeepSeek Harness web profile with six visual and expression levels, four task modes, current-session chat, public reasoning summaries and browser speech synthesis.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 人物交互插件，支持六档人物与表达风格、四种任务模式、当前会话交流、公开思考摘要和浏览器语音朗读。

description.en: Matrix-style CLI chat page for the DSH web UI: the agent's thinking streams down the screen as green code rain while replies print normally in the terminal.
description.zh: 矩阵风格 CLI 对话页：Agent 思考过程化作绿色代码雨倾泻而下，回复照常流式显示。

description.en: A draggable square-cake mascot that runs while a turn is in progress, sleeps when it finishes, and gets angry on errors.
description.zh: 一只可拖拽的方糕萌宠：对话进行时奔跑、完成时睡觉、出错时生气。

plugins.name: dsh-achievement-helper

description.en: Local themed achievements, badges and character collections for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在本地记录 DeepSeek Harness 主题成就、勋章与角色收藏。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to portrait.local

description.en: A Remielle(ZZZ) desktop pet for the dsh web GUI that switches animated sticker moods with the harness work state.
description.zh: 蕾米埃尔(绝区零)桌宠：随 DSH 工作状态切换动画表情。

description.en: Adds one draggable desktop pet to the DSH web GUI: a whale girl called Big Fat Fish (nickname Jingjing), with eight switchable colour skins and a personality. She eats rice, is clever but lazy, and is a tsundere: too many rapid clicks and she lies down and refuses to react for a while, calling her fat annoys her and she insists she is not, and the nickname Jingjing pleases her. She also remembers you between sessions: three fat-calls today and she greets you cold, three nickname-calls and she greets you warm, coming back after half an hour earns "I was not waiting for you", and the first few meetings she is shy - so the counters reset each local midnight and are stored in a state file the plugin owns. After ten quiet minutes she drifts to a corner, which is visual only and never moves the position you chose. The eight PNGs are bundled with the plugin and served by the plugin itself, so there are no third-party requests. NOTE - the artwork carries an OleapCrow mark and was supplied by the repository owner, the eight skins are recolourings of that one drawing, and the plugin has not been installed against a live DSH host.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面加一只可以拖动的桌宠：一只叫「大肥鱼」（昵称「鲸鲸」）的鲸鱼娘，八种配色皮肤可切换，并且有性格——只吃米饭、聪明但懒、嘴硬心软；连点几次会躺平不干了，被叫「大肥鱼」会生气并坚持自己不胖，叫「鲸鲸」才高兴。她还会记事：今天被叫胖三次就来时冷淡，被叫昵称三次就亲近，离开半小时再回来说「才不是等你」，头几次见面怕生；这些计数每天零点清零，存在插件自己的状态文件里。十分钟没人理会游到角落，那只改视觉、不会动你放她的位置。八张皮肤图随插件分发、由插件自己提供，因此没有任何第三方请求。注意：画面带有 OleapCrow 标记、由仓库所有者提供，八种皮肤是同一张画的重新配色；本插件尚未在真实的 DSH 宿主上安装验证过。

description.en: Read local EPUB, TXT and Markdown novels below selected native DSH chat regions on explicit expansion, preserving real reasoning and tool output without sending novel text to the model. Currently works only with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 小说摸鱼：主动展开选中的原生聊天区域时，在保留真实思考和工具输出的下方阅读本地 EPUB、TXT、Markdown 小说，小说不发送给模型。目前仅兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

plugins.name: dsh-moyu

description.en: Hover-reveal Douyin short-video feed inside DeepSeek Harness: move the pointer into a fixed hotspot to play, leave to pause in place, scroll the wheel to switch clips. Wheel travel is accumulated and cooled down so one gesture switches once, and the player stays mounted while hidden so re-entry resumes instead of restarting. The host half signs the requests and reverse-proxies the media stream, so no account or sign-in is needed.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里悬停刷抖音推荐流：鼠标移入热点开始播放，移出暂停在原处，滚轮切换视频；滚轮做了累加与冷却，一次手势只切一条，播放器隐藏时保持挂载，移回从原处继续。宿主侧完成请求签名与视频流反代，不需要登录任何账号。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 150.0.0.0 for network access

description.en: A novel reader docked in the DSH right sidebar for office slacking, with an AI companion that roasts whatever you just read alongside you - import your own TXT three ways, five reading themes, and saved chapters, progress and annotations. The companion comments as you go, in one of four voices (sharp-tongued, warm, detective or slacker) at a pace you pick, off by default. 434 Chinese classics as a 44 KB catalogue, searchable by title or author, one click to download and read offline, four CDN edges as fallback.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 右侧栏的小说阅读器，办公摸鱼专用，搭配 AI 伴读，跟大肥鱼一起吐槽文章、发表看法 - 自己的 TXT 三种方式导入，五套阅读主题，章节、进度与批注保存。伴读跟着你读到哪儿就评到哪儿，吐槽或捧场，可在毒舌、温柔、侦探、摆烂四种腔调中切换，节奏自己定，默认关闭。内置 434 本中文经典，包里只有 44 KB 书目，按书名作者搜索、一键下载即入架离线读，四个 CDN 边缘回退。

description.en: Animated pixel-art blue and white whale pet that sits on top of the composer in a new session.
description.zh: 在新会话中，一只蓝白相间的像素风小鲸鱼趴在输入框上方游动。

description.en: Turn your DSH token usage into a gacha game: feed a monster with tokens, earn coins, pull from 14 AI waifus (Kimi/GLM/Gemini/Claude and more), enhance artifacts, and build a Balatro-style battle team with daily sign-in bonuses.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的 token 消耗变成抽卡小游戏：喂代码怪、攒代币、抽 14 位 AI 娘（Kimi娘/GLM娘/Gemini娘/Claude娘…），圣遗物强化、双件合成与每日签到弹窗，组建小丑牌式战斗阵容，十连出金自动生成分享卡。

description.en: LAN co-op for the dsh-pet desktop pet: see colleagues' pets on the same network, wave at them, and drag their desktop windows anywhere; an optional included patch adds live animation, bubble and meme sync. Requires dsh-pet 0.3.7.
description.zh: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠加局域网联机：同一网络下能看到同事的桌宠，可以打招呼、自由拖拽桌面窗口；可选补丁同步实时动作、气泡和表情包。需要 dsh-pet 0.3.7。

description.en: Native DSH tools for playing Stronghold Protocol solo games over the game site's WebSocket connection, with compact state views, explicit actions and public card lookups.
description.zh: 通过游戏站原生 WebSocket 连接进行 Stronghold Protocol 单人对局的 DSH 工具，支持紧凑局面查看、明确动作执行和公开卡牌查询。

description.en: A WSLg-compatible DSH desktop pet reacts to agent activity, lets you message the active session, and loads Hatch-Pet v2 atlases or transparent portraits.
description.zh: 兼容 WSLg 的 DSH 桌面宠物会根据代理活动切换动画，支持向当前会话发送消息，并可加载 Hatch-Pet v2 图集或透明肖像。

description.en: Automatically add emojis to AI replies.
description.zh: 为 AI 回复自动添加表情。

description.en: Codex Pets-style floating pixel pet with 10 built-in Petdex-compatible pets, a 9-state agent-status engine (idle/running/waiting/review/failed plus client-side waving/jumping/directions), draggable overlay, pet picker/zoom settings, notification bubbles, and a `pet_say` tool for the agent to speak through the pet.
description.zh: Codex Pets 风格浮动像素桌宠：内置 10 只 Petdex 兼容宝可梦伙伴，9 状态 agent 状态机（空闲/思考/等待/审查/出错 + 客户端挥手/跳跃/方向动画），可拖拽悬浮、宠物切换与缩放设置、通知气泡，以及 agent 可用的 `pet_say` 工具。

description.en: Conway's Game of Life for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel row opens a drawable centre-column board with four rules, seven stampable patterns and a population chart.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的康威生命游戏：侧栏一行面板入口，打开一块可绘制的中央棋盘，含四套规则、七个可盖章的图案与一条种群曲线。

plugins.name: dsh-game-market

description.en: Game market and runtime for DSH. While the agent runs a long task, a game fills the main workspace and a small whale in the corner shows the agent state (working, waiting for you, done, error); progress is saved and continues next time. Ships five built-in games, a game SDK and CLI, and a community catalog installable from the market.
description.zh: DSH 的游戏市场与运行时。Agent 跑长任务时，游戏铺满主工作区，右下角的小鲸鱼显示 Agent 状态（运行中、等你、完成、出错）；进度自动保存，下次接着玩。内置五款游戏，提供游戏 SDK 与 CLI，并可从市场安装社区游戏。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to dsh-game.local

plugins.name: codex-pet-Astra-Yao

description.en: An Astra Yao desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI that renders the Codex v2 8x11 sprite atlas, follows session state through thinking, running, waiting and failed, shows a status bubble with the running tool and a DeepSeek balance readout (on by default, can be switched off), and quotes her own voice lines while idle.
description.zh: 把 Astra Yao（耀嘉音）的 Codex 桌宠图集搬进 DSH Web 界面：随会话状态切换到构思、执行、候场、破音等动作，头顶气泡显示正在跑的工具和余额（默认开启，可关），空闲时轮播她的官方台词。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Power Mode typing effects for the DSH web composer: caret particles and glowing character echoes, a heat ramp from amber to red with rising embers as the combo grows, a combo counter over visible glyphs, and a synthesized key tick with a heavier Enter impact.
description.zh: DSH Web 输入框的 Power Mode 打字特效：光标粒子与发光残影，连击越高当前输入行越热（暖黄到红）并升起余烬，按可视字符累计的连击计数，以及合成的按键音与更重的回车冲击音。

description.en: Fortune-telling toolkit: bazi, ziwei doushu, meihua yijing, liuyao (six-line coin oracle with najia), almanac, chenggu bone-weight, zodiac, date selection, qimen dunjia, fengshui, name scoring, compatibility, numerology, a life K-line chart, tarot and xiaoliuren — 16 tools whose ganzhi, stars, hexagrams and bone weights are all computed by deterministic local engines, with the model only interpreting results. Supports solar and lunar dates with leap months, China DST and true solar time correction, plus a ten-page read-only side panel.
description.zh: 玄学算命插件：八字、紫微斗数、梅花易数、六爻纳甲、黄历、称骨、星座、择日、奇门遁甲、风水、起名、合婚、生命数字、人生K线、塔罗、小六壬共 16 个工具，干支、星曜、卦象、骨重全部由本地确定性引擎计算，模型只负责解读；支持公历/农历（含闰月）输入，自动校正中国夏令时与真太阳时，附带十页只读侧栏面板。

description.en: Pops up a mini-game menu (wordle, match-3, extensible) while the model generates.
description.zh: 模型生成时弹出小游戏菜单（wordle/消消乐，可扩展）。

description.en: Bilibili-style danmaku overlay for the DSH Web chat area: scroll, top and bottom tracks driven by agent events, three preset packs, optional LLM-generated comments, a draggable control ball, per-session pools with replay, and a settings card.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 对话区叠加 B 站风格弹幕：按 agent 事件生成滚动/顶部/底部三轨弹幕，三套预设包、可选 LLM 生成吐槽、可拖动控制球、分会话弹幕池与历史回放，以及完整设置卡。

description.en: A companion plugin for dsh-pet: gives the desktop pet a persona card, Chinese reasoning lines, click reactions, and a daily diary she writes herself.
description.zh: dsh-pet 的附属插件：给桌面上的鲸鱼娘套上二次元人格，让她的思考过程说中文、被点会回话，还会每天自己写一篇日记。

description.en: UFO archive terminal: search official and civilian records, keep a local archive, read it offline.
description.zh: UFO 档案终端：检索官方与民间记录，落到本地档案馆，离线可读。

description.en: Gives the agent a mouth through the ai-ball floating orb: speak text that the orb types out character by character, set its mood colour, show or hide its monologue panel, read back what you typed into it, and check or start it. The orb is a separate Python 3.10+ overlay you install yourself, and the plugin only writes the files it watches.
description.zh: 通过 ai-ball 悬浮球给 agent 一张嘴：让球逐字打出你要说的话、按 mood 改变边缘光颜色、显示或收起独白面板、读回你打的字，以及检查接线和启动球。球是独立的 Python 3.10+ 悬浮层，需自行另外安装；插件只写它监听的那几个文件。

description.en: Journey to the West floating desktop pet: a frameless, transparent, always-on-top cartoon widget of Tang Monk and his disciples. Click to switch characters; idle plays a chasing scene.
description.zh: 西游师徒卡通桌面悬浮窗：无边框、透明、置顶。点击切换唐僧/孙悟空/猪八戒/沙僧/白龙马，静止自动播放追逐动画。

description.en: Turns session context into a deep-sea moyu (slack-off) game in a floating window — your hand sinks as context grows, touch a fish and server-rolled dice decide the mint of a holographic collectible card across five oceans, with a fish pond and a GitHub-linked leaderboard.
description.zh: 把会话 context 变成浮窗深海摸鱼：context 越长手沉得越深，摸到鱼后服务端掷骰定胜负，中卡铸造镭射收藏卡，五大洋摸鱼、鱼池养成、GitHub 绑定全球排行榜。

description.en: An animated pixel cat that lives over the DSH web interface and follows what the agent is doing — sitting while the session is calm, lying down and falling asleep while a run is in progress, and waking when the turn returns or typing starts. It can be dragged anywhere, remembers its position, sleeps after a minute of inactivity, and offers an enable switch, four sizes and a status-reaction toggle in Settings.
description.zh: 一只住在 DSH 网页界面上的动画像素猫，会跟随 agent 的状态变化——会话平静时坐着，运行中躺下并入睡，回合结束或开始打字时醒来。可以拖到任意位置并记住坐标，闲置一分钟后入睡，设置里有开关、四档尺寸和状态联动选项。

description.en: Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.
description.zh: 多角色 Galgame 对话界面：角色与回复模型可独立切换，分角色保存好感度、记忆、对话历史与 CG 图鉴，并根据 Harness 跨会话任务事件做出角色回应。

description.en: Multi-pet desktop companion: four MAM status lights watch every active session (approval / running / done-unread / error) and each card click-through to its conversation; four voice groups speak on state changes with duration-timed subtitles; import pets from four sources (folder / zip / Codex dir / Petdex registry) with card-style hot-swap and an integrity guard; five action bindings, drag physics, three scales. The built-in fox Foxbell ships in the package — install and go.
description.zh: 多宠物桌宠系统：四盏状态灯实时监控所有活跃会话（红待审批/黄运行/绿完成未读/深红错误），点卡片直达对应会话； 四组状态语音随事件播报，字幕与音频时长对齐；外部宠物四来源导入（本地文件夹/zip/Codex 目录/Petdex 在线仓库）， 卡片式热切换即时生效，激活守卫自动校验图集与语音完整性；五场景动作绑定、拖拽物理、三档缩放； 内置小狐狸 Foxbell 随包自带，装上即用。

description.en: Connect a DSH Agent to Minecraft Java servers with Mineflayer, a live game view alongside native reasoning and tools, configurable personas, server-scoped notebooks, and optional local survival knowledge retrieval. Reuses the host model; installation does not connect to a game or start inference.
description.zh: 让 DSH Agent 通过 Mineflayer 进入 Minecraft Java 服务器，在实时游戏画面旁查看原生推理与工具，配置人格、按服务器隔离的笔记及可选本地生存知识检索；复用宿主模型，安装本身不连接游戏或启动推理。

plugins.name: dsh-debate-simulator

description.en: Multi-agent Chinese debate simulator with eight debaters, live two-column discussion and draft notes, judges and scoreboard, single-side clocks, per-round ZIP archives, a training side with a configurable end condition (win-rate threshold or fixed rounds), and a Word prep package.
description.zh: 多智能体中文辩论模拟：8 名辩手、实时双栏讨论与草稿纸、评委计分、单边计时、每轮 ZIP 归档、训练方可选胜率阈值或固定轮次收官，并生成 Word 备赛包。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to schemas.openxmlformats.org

description.en: Listen to Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙) podcasts in the DSH web UI: paste a share link to play anonymously (host proxies the audio with Range/seek), or log in via QR code to sync subscriptions, keyword-search shows/episodes, page full episode lists, and unlock purchased paywalled episodes; a `podcast_play` tool lets the agent play by link, podcast pid, or episode eid.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面收听小宇宙播客：粘贴分享链接即可免登录播放（host 代理音频流，支持 Range 拖动），扫码登录后同步账号订阅、关键词搜索节目与单集、加载完整单集分页、解锁已购付费单集；注册 `podcast_play` 工具让 agent 按链接、节目 pid 或单集 eid 直接播放。

description.en: Two chibi Genshin Impact desktop pets (Columbina and Nahida), 22 transparent animations each, with desktop wandering, drag-and-throw physics, click reactions, idle chatter and chat through DSH models. A fan pack derived from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT) — it reuses upstream's /dsh-pet-7340 route and ~/.dsh/dsh-pet data directory, so install it instead of dsh-pet, not alongside it; the character art is not MIT-licensed.
description.zh: 两只原神 Q 版桌宠（哥伦比娅、纳西妲），每只 22 段透明动画；可桌面漫步、拖拽抛掷、点击反应，会碎碎念，并用 DSH 模型陪聊。本包派生自 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT），沿用上游的 /dsh-pet-7340 路由与 ~/.dsh/dsh-pet 数据目录，请替代 dsh-pet 安装、不要与它同装；角色素材不在 MIT 授权范围内。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness agent state (status, tool calls, errors, approval waits) over loopback to WhalePal, a standalone desktop pet app, so the desktop pet follows the real agent state instead of guessing from screenshots.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 状态（思考、工具调用、报错、等待确认）通过本机回环推给桌面宠物应用「鲸伴 WhalePal」，让这只桌面宠物跟着真实状态反应，而不是靠截屏猜。

description.en: Heads-up Texas Hold'em training with an independent AI opponent, persistent public-action memory, and decision reviews.
description.zh: 德州扑克 AI 陪练：双人对局、持久公开行为记忆与可追溯决策复盘。

description.en: Local meme-sticker library: import from a file, a folder or the agent tool, tag images in a review queue you confirm yourself, group them, then let the agent search and send by mood. A design descendant of Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers (no shared code; its sticker_* tool names differ, so the two can be installed side by side).
description.zh: 本地表情包库：从文件、文件夹或工具导入，在待识别队列里由你确认后才打标签，分组管理，再让 agent 按情绪检索发图。功能设计参考 Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers，代码自写、工具名不同，可与上游并存。

description.en: Floating, browser-local whale arcade with three score games and ocean-themed Gomoku for breaks while waiting on the agent.
description.zh: 浏览器本地运行的悬浮鲸鱼游戏中心，包含三款积分游戏和海洋主题五子棋，适合等待 Agent 时随手游玩。

description.en: Listen to live radio, browse stations by mood, and keep a local listening history inside Harness.
description.zh: 在 Harness 中收听直播电台，按场景浏览频道，并在本地保留收听记录。

plugins.name: dsh-pet-jt

description.en: Desktop pet fork of dsh-pet that can be installed alongside the original (separate package id, commands and data directory), adding scheduled reminders with custom bubble text and a random show/hide cycle.
description.zh: dsh-pet 的增强分支，可与原版同装（包名、命令与数据目录各自独立）：新增定时提醒（自定义气泡语句）与随机出现/隐藏循环。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: macOS always-on-top desktop pet for DSH Desktop: a bundled DeepSeek whale sprite with Codex-compatible skins; install many pets from codex-pets.net or import from local Codex in Settings; a recent-session ball; right-click New Session and a configurable global shortcut (default Command+Option+N) for a new-session ask box.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 的 macOS 置顶桌宠：内置 DeepSeek 鲸鱼精灵图，兼容 Codex 宠格式，可在设置页从 codex-pets.net 安装大量线上宠物或从本机 Codex 导入，脚下有最近会话球；右键「新会话」与可配置全局快捷键（默认 Command+Option+N）可打开新会话输入框。

description.en: A two-minute whale-fishing mini game for the DSH web GUI. Catch fish whose numbers add to your score, avoid fish larger than you, eat rice bowls to heal, and grab coupons to ignore size on the next hook. Standalone HTML, no network, no telemetry.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的两分钟小游戏：抓到的数字累加到身上，比自身大的鱼会掉一颗心，白饭回血，鲸元券让下一钩无视大小。单文件 HTML，不联网，无数据上报。

plugins.name: dsh-music-player

description.en: Music, audiobook, radio and news player for DeepSeek Harness: streams your local music folder over HTTP, reads local .txt/.epub novels aloud with AI voices, plays online QQ/Kugou/Netease music and internet radio (HLS supported), and broadcasts daily news digests — all driven from the UI or by telling the agent through the music_play model tool.
description.zh: DSH 音乐/小说播放器：在网页里听本地音乐（HTTP 流式）、用 AI 声音朗读本地小说（.txt/.epub）、播放在线 QQ/酷狗/网易云音乐与网络电台（支持 HLS 直播流）、定时播报每日新闻；可在面板操作，也可让 agent 通过 music_play 工具直接点播。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to y.qq.com

description.en: A character who lives on her own phone: the plugin installs and runs her Android phone, and any app notification can wake her; she installs apps herself and browses, likes and comments in apps such as Xiaoheihe or Bilibili; she has her own QQ (NapCat / SnowLuma, multi-part replies, stickers); memory with people cards, a daily diary at 23:30 and automatic recall before each wake (local embeddings by default, SiliconFlow / DashScope optional); a life between conversations (after HDS-Interlude); and an optional microVM computer with approval gates. Sidebar tabs show her phone, her computer and a dot panel; personal settings live in ~/.dsh/dsh-dot.json, and each of the six components can be turned off. Only the QQ number set with /qq owner counts as you; other people's messages are treated as untrusted notifications.
description.zh: 住在自己手机上的角色：插件自动安装并运行她的 Android 手机，任何 App 的新通知都能叫醒她；她自己装 App，逛小黑盒、B 站等并点赞评论；有自己的 QQ（NapCat / SnowLuma，分条回复、发表情包）；记忆含人物卡、每天 23:30 的日记和叫醒前的自动召回（默认本机 embedding，可切 SiliconFlow / DashScope）；两次对话之间的生活（幕间，按 HDS-Interlude）；可选 microVM 电脑带审批闸门。右侧栏有手机画面、虚拟机画面和 dot 面板；个人设置集中在 ~/.dsh/dsh-dot.json，六个组件都能单独关闭。只有 `/qq owner` 指定的 QQ 号算你本人，别人的消息按不可信通知处理。

description.en: Aseprite-style pixel art studio: the AI draws sprites stroke by stroke with selections, layers, animation frames, gradients, symmetry and reference layers, each step rendered live as ANSI terminal frames.
description.zh: Aseprite 风格像素画工作室：AI 像人类一样分步绘制精灵，支持选区、图层、动画帧、渐变、对称、参考层与 rgb16 4096 色，每一步实时渲染为 ANSI 终端帧。

description.en: AI-generated curiosity & trivia plugin for the dsh web GUI (Curio in the English UI): 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item unfolds into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, layers, similar points) in browser storage. Reuses the host LLM channel with zero config; when no model is available, a DeepSeek API key can be pasted into the panel. Output language follows the DSH UI language (zh/en).
description.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面生成冷知识与奇妙事实的插件（英文界面下名为 Curio）：「开始探奇」每次生成一批不重复主题（排除已见），每条可深入两层并展开类似知识点，「探奇清单」将全部历史（批次、条目、层级、类似点）保存在浏览器；优先复用宿主 LLM 通道，无需配置，无可用模型时可在面板填写 DeepSeek API Key；输出语言跟随 DSH 界面语言（中/英）。

description.en: Liuyao divination in one click — ask a question, cast the six-line hexagram, and let AI interpret it for you; every cast is saved locally.
description.zh: 六爻起卦 · AI 解卦：遇事不决，一键摇一卦；起过的卦自动存进本机卦例库。

description.en: Adds a local-only six-seat Texas Hold'em table to the DSH Web UI with full betting streets, side pots, persistent Token stacks, and agent-status display.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入本地六人桌德州扑克，支持完整下注轮次、边池结算、Token 筹码持久化与 Agent 状态显示。

description.en: Draggable whale companion with local progression, achievements, skins, and privacy-safe activity tracking.
description.zh: 可拖拽的鲸鱼伙伴，提供本地成长、成就、皮肤和隐私安全的活动统计。

description.en: KuroWhale is an unofficial dark-themed whale-girl desktop companion for Windows x64, inspired by the DeepSeek Harness icon, with nine animations that react to DSH Agent activity. Requires WebView2; the first launch downloads the official Neutralino 6.9.0 runtime and artwork over the network and verifies them by SHA-256.
description.zh: KuroWhale 黑色系鲸鱼娘桌宠，参考 DeepSeek Harness 官方图标设计的非官方 Windows x64 桌宠，九种动画会随 DSH Agent 的工作状态作出反应；需要 WebView2，首次启动会联网下载官方 Neutralino 6.9.0 运行时与素材并做 SHA-256 校验。

description.en: Adds a token-burn leveling widget to DSH with 14 DeepSeek-whale levels, daily quests, streaks and achievements.
description.zh: 按累计 token 消耗给右下角大肥鱼升级的 DSH 挂件：14 级 DeepSeek 鲸鱼图标、今日任务、连击与成就。

description.en: Side-panel arcade: 18 offline mini-games to play while the model thinks.
description.zh: 右侧小游戏面板：18 款离线小游戏，等模型回复时的摸鱼神器。

description.en: Burned DSH tokens become incense; spend one stick to raise or lower today's case. The case updates daily, Liangwei decides today's Liangzi, and the result is archived at day end.
description.zh: 用 DSH 烧掉的 Token 凝成香火，花一炷给今日梁案投夯或拉；梁案每日更新，梁位决定今日梁子，日终收入梁祠。

description.en: Role-play plugin for DeepSeek Harness: imports SillyTavern character cards (JSON/PNG) and world books (lorebooks), binds DSH skills to a character, and registers the combination as a native agent preset.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 角色扮演插件：导入 SillyTavern 角色卡（JSON/PNG）与世界书（lorebook），为角色绑定 DSH 技能，并注册为原生 agent preset。

description.en: Character cards for DeepSeek Harness: inject a persona section into the system prompt, or rewrite the user message through rule cards before the model sees it. Ships a preset card library, single-file card packs that carry artwork, and a Character tab in the conversation view.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的角色卡：把人设注入系统提示词，或用规则卡在模型看到之前改写用户消息。自带预设卡库、含立绘的单文件卡包导入导出，以及会话区的「角色」页签。

description.en: Per-conversation toggle that makes the model answer in classical Chinese (文言 above a —— line, a modern-Chinese translation below) and speak as a blue classical-style fish that eats plain rice; each conversation keeps its own switch, and turning it off restores plain modern Chinese.
description.zh: 按对话独立的文言文开关：开启后模型改用文言行文（上段文言、中间「——」、下段白话译注），并化身蓝色古风、惯吃白饭的大肥鱼；每个对话各自记住开关，关闭即恢复现代汉语并隐去人格。

description.en: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit agent code, start battles, watch replays, and use DSH conversations to keep improving agents based on battle results.
description.zh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

description.en: Windows only. On every DSH start it checks, with no configuration, whether Genshin Impact is already installed — if it is, the game is launched (falling back to the miHoYo launcher when the game exits immediately, e.g. while an update is pending); if it is not, the launcher installer is downloaded to the desktop behind a size gate that rejects any link whose payload is more than 15 MiB away from the expected ~224 MiB, and a failed download falls back to opening the official download page.
description.zh: 仅 Windows。打开 DSH 先探测本机《原神》：装了直接启动本体（秒退改起米哈游启动器），没装才下载安装包到桌面；与预期 224MB 相差超 15MB 的链接会被拒绝，失败则打开官方下载页。

plugins.name: dsh-pet-chat

description.en: Desktop pet with a chat panel: QQ-style history, favorites, and branch threads that merge back into the log as a forward card; the panel docks beside the pet and resizes from its edges and corners. Modified from PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT); do not install together with the original.
description.zh: 带聊天面板的桌宠：QQ 风格的历史记录、收藏，以及聊完会以合并转发卡片回到历史的支线对话；面板停靠在小女仆右侧，可从边缘与四角拖拽改大小。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT）的二次修改版，请勿与原版同时安装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime and an optional system notification when a reply finishes.
description.zh: 右下角鹈鹕环海骑行 SVG 动画，随代理状态在思考/完成间切换，回复完成时播放提示音并可选发送系统通知。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.
description.zh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

description.en: Spanish practice panel for DeepSeek Harness: six locally graded drill types (verb conjugation across 11 tenses, noun gender, plurals, vocabulary recognition, sentence cloze, ser/estar and subjunctive grammar points) plus a model-graded scenario-writing tab, 8-level spaced repetition, and four agent tools. Answers are computed and graded inside the plugin, so the model is only used for teaching and explanations.
description.zh: 西语练习面板：六类本地判分的练习（11 个时态的动词变位、名词阴阳性、复数、认词、句子填空、ser/estar 与虚拟式语法专项），外加模型批改的情景造句、8 级间隔重复，以及四个 agent 工具；答案在插件内重算并判分，模型只用来讲解。

description.en: Six-yao (I Ching) divination for DeepSeek Harness — xiantian bagua backdrop, a Zhouyi opening verse, manual line entry or a simulated three-coin toss, najia charting (six relatives, six gods, void branches, hidden spirits, nayin, seasonal strength, transforming lines), an AI interpretation that cites its classical source for every statement, and a one-hexagram-one-question follow-up dialog. Zero npm dependencies; every request goes to the local DSH host, with no third-party network access.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的六爻算卦插件——先天八卦盘背景、周易开场辞、手工输入爻象或模拟三枚铜钱摇卦、纳甲排盘（六亲、六神、旬空、伏神、纳音、旺衰、动变），断卦由模型逐条注明典籍出处，并可对同一卦追问（一卦一断）。零 npm 依赖；所有请求都发往本机 DSH 宿主，不访问第三方网络。

description.en: A Live2D pet companion for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: the Vivi (芊芊) character with petting/feeding, a daily-treat bond economy and mood-driven expressions.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌宠：内置 Vivi（芊芊）Live2D 形象，支持抚摸/喂食、每日小鱼干羁绊经济与情绪驱动表情。

description.en: Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.
description.zh: 基于 dsh 内置 Web 服务管理、浏览与播放本地媒体库，完美适配 PC 与移动端，支持手势上下滑动刷视频、即时拖拽秒播与实时转码。

description.en: A fork of zhu1090093659/dsh-pet (Apache-2.0), adding per-conversation companions with whale-girl, MIKU and business blue whale skins, model-themed colors, token-rate animation, completion reminders and shared feeding and affinity.
description.zh: 基于 zhu1090093659/dsh-pet（Apache-2.0）改造，新增每个活跃会话一只桌宠，提供鲸鱼娘、MIKU 与商务小蓝鲸皮肤、模型配色、随生成速度跑动、完成待查看提醒、共享喂食与亲密度。

description.en: A draggable pet in a blue-whale onesie: sticks to window edges, squashes flat, blinks, sleeps, and shows agent status in a thought cloud.
description.zh: 一个穿着蓝色鲸鱼连体衣、可拖动的宠物：会贴住窗口边缘、被压扁，会眨眼、睡觉，并用气泡显示智能体状态。

description.en: A desktop pet that lives in a floating overlay; click it to interact and switch between idle, sleeping, happy, and eating states.
description.zh: 桌面宠物插件，常驻悬浮层养一只龙猫，点击互动并可在待机、睡觉、开心、进食等状态间切换。

description.en: Turns coding into an RPG: finished turns, tool calls and completed todos earn XP, with 27+ achievement badges, levels, titles and seasons. Event-driven scoring with a pure-function engine — the work itself is the game.
description.zh: 把开发变成 RPG：回合/工具/todo 积累 XP、27+ 成就徽章、等级与赛季。事件流驱动、纯函数计分——你的工作就是游戏。

description.en: Whale-themed desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness with a local todo list: click the pet to add or edit tasks inline, get reminders that get more frequent as a due date approaches, and optionally append one short AI-written next step to a reminder. Based on PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT); artwork keeps the upstream non-commercial terms. Install it instead of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet, not alongside it.
description.zh: 住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的蓝发桌宠「鲸事本」：点一下弹出待办面板，可点击编辑、到期渐进提醒；开启「待办建议」后，提醒还会按概率追加一句 AI 生成的简短下一步建议。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT），素材沿用其非商用条款。请替代 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 安装，不要与它同时安装。

description.en: Achievement and gamification plugin: unlock badges for turns, tool calls, sessions, daily streaks and coding behavior (edits/reads/tests), with a badge wall, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements SDK.
description.zh: 成就与游戏化插件：按回合、工具调用、会话、连续天数与编码行为（编辑/读取/测试）解锁徽章，带徽章墙、解锁 toast 与 ctx.achievements SDK。

plugins.name: dsh-whale-pet

description.en: A polished floating whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 95 categorized transparent animations, state-aware event reactions, customizable actions and triggers, click interactions, dragging and screen wandering.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的精致悬浮鲸鱼桌宠，拥有 95 个分类透明动画、状态感知事件回应、可自定义动作与触发规则，并支持点击互动、拖拽和屏幕漫游。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Adds a draggable lucky-block button to the DeepSeek Harness web UI. Single-click plays zero-cost little performances (popups, a fake blue screen, daily fortune, trivia, cold jokes, music, and a set of visual stunts); a 1.4-second long-press mines the block open and starts a new session to write a random paper, read the news, invent something, or spin a short story. It also appends a "lucky block" choice to the model's multiple-choice questions and rolls a random pick, reversible by saying "rollback". Block appearance and event weights are adjustable in settings.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面加一个可拖拽的幸运方块按钮：单击放零成本小表演（弹窗、假蓝屏、今日抽签、冷知识、冷笑话、音乐和一组视觉小演出），长按 1.4 秒挖穿后开新会话随机写论文、读新闻、发明东西或编短篇小说。它还会给模型的问答题选项末尾加一个「幸运方块」随机替你决定，不满意说「回滚」即可撤销。方块外观与事件权重都能在设置里改。

description.en: Reimplements the shut-down BSide: Olivia Lin letter API on loopback so the game client keeps sending and receiving letters: every incoming letter is delivered to one persistent DSH agent session, and the reply is written back to the local letter store.
description.zh: 在回环地址上复现已关停的《BSide: Olivia Lin》信件 API，让游戏客户端照常收发信件：每封来信投进同一个持久 DSH agent 会话，回信写回本地信件库。

description.en: Adds a collapsible, draggable minesweeper board to the conversation area, with adjustable rows, columns and mine count, and a first click that never lands on a mine.
description.zh: 在会话区左侧叠一块可折叠、可拖动的扫雷盘，行列与雷数都可调，第一次点击保证不踩雷。

description.en: Electronic wooden fish with six agent-callable tools, eight sutras advanced one sentence per knock, three knock sounds, spoken Cantonese or Mandarin chanting, and a merit ledger kept in one file that also counts session token usage.
description.zh: 可被 Agent 调用的电子木鱼：6 个工具、8 部经文逐敲推进一句、三种敲击音色、粤语/普通话诵经语音，功德记在同一份账本里，并按会话 Token 消耗累计。

description.en: Sends excerpts from recent Chinese Markdown conversation exports to the DeepSeek API (API key required) to generate a dream, saved as a local Markdown file.
description.zh: 将近期中文 Markdown 对话导出文件中的片段发送给 DeepSeek API（需 API key），生成一场梦境并保存为本地 Markdown 文件。

description.en: Dynamic Schulte grid waiting-time mini-game: click 1..N in order on a static grid or a spinning roulette wheel while the model thinks.
description.zh: 动态舒尔特方格等待小游戏：模型思考时，在静态网格或旋转轮盘上按顺序点击 1..N，边玩边等。

description.en: Adds a Screen-sense submenu (turn on, turn off, and an interval of 15, 30, 60 or 120 seconds) to the dsh-pet desktop right-click menu, forwarding each choice to dafeiyu-screensense. dsh-pet exposes no menu extension point, so this plugin appends a marked patch to its renderer.js after backing the original up to renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak; the patch is idempotent and is re-applied when dsh-pet is reinstalled.
description.zh: 在 dsh-pet 桌宠的右键菜单里增加「识屏模式」子菜单（开启、关闭、识别间隔 15、30、60、120 秒），把选择转发给 dafeiyu-screensense。dsh-pet 没有菜单扩展接口，因此本插件在其 renderer.js 末尾追加一段带标记的补丁，首次修改前备份为 renderer.js.dafeiyu.bak；补丁幂等，dsh-pet 重装后会自动补回。

description.en: Screen-sense mode for the dsh-pet desktop pet: captures the primary display every 30 seconds, compares an 8x8 average hash of each frame, and sends the screenshot to the session model when the frame changed (and again after the idle interval even if unchanged) so the pet comments in one short bubble line. Adds /fish, /fish_look and /fish_screen commands, a status and control HTTP pair, and a change threshold plus an idle repeat interval that can be tuned in the plugin config. Windows only (PowerShell WinForms).
description.zh: 给 dsh-pet 桌宠增加识屏模式：每 30 秒截取主屏，用 8×8 均值哈希比较画面，只在画面变化时（以及空闲间隔到点、即使没变化时）把截图交给当前会话模型，让桌宠用一句短气泡吐槽；另提供 /fish、/fish_look、/fish_screen 命令、status 与 control 两个 HTTP 接口，以及可在插件配置里调整的画面对比阈值与空闲重说间隔。仅 Windows（PowerShell WinForms）。

description.en: DSH pet plugin that adds an Arknights operator library and custom image pets: pick one of 486 operators and the plugin downloads that operator Codex v2 atlas from the pinned upstream revision, verifies every Git blob hash and installs it locally, or import your own Codex atlas (1536x1872 or 1536x2288) or a plain PNG/WebP/GIF; the pet then follows session activity, shows a bubble while a decision is pending, and can be dragged and resized.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠插件：内置 486 位明日方舟干员素材目录，选定干员后从固定上游版本下载 Codex v2 图集并逐个校验 Git 哈希再本地安装；也可导入自己的 Codex 图集（1536×1872 或 1536×2288）或普通 PNG/WebP/GIF 图片；桌宠随会话状态切换动作，等待确认时显示气泡，可拖动并调整尺寸。

description.en: Solo murder-mystery (jubensha) in a session tab: the AI hosts the game and plays every other seat, each knowing only its own role book, while the player's seat stays yours — with a stage bar, a per-seat timeline, a clue page and a reveal that unseals the truth only at the end.
description.zh: 一个人的剧本杀：AI 当主持人，AI 填满其余的椅子（各自只知道自己的角色本），留一个位子给你 —— 带阶段条、按座位归集的时间线与搜证页，而真相到复盘才解封。

description.en: Tarot daily-luck plugin: enter your birthday, draw one of 22 Major Arcana, get five-dimension scores and a concrete answer to your question.
description.zh: 今日好运来临：写入生日，抽一张大阿尔卡纳，得到事业/感情/财运/身心/交际五维评分，并针对你的问题给出具体回答。

description.en: Adds combo scoring, activity breakdowns, turn ratings, and optional Jev-based encouragement to DSH Web sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 会话添加连击计分、活动明细、轮次评价和可选的 Jev 辅助鼓励。

description.en: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows Computer Use for observing and controlling desktop windows.
description.zh: DSH 的 Mimi 桌面伴侣，跟随工作会话状态显示动画反应和气泡，提供独立聊天模式，并内置 Windows Computer Use 以观察和操作桌面窗口。

description.en: Daily tarot with 22 Rider-Waite-Smith card images, animated 3D flips, random upright and reversed cards, Chinese readings, and up to 10 draws per day.
description.zh: 每日塔罗，含 22 张韦特大阿尔卡那真实牌面、3D 翻牌、随机正逆位、中文牌义解读和每日最多 10 次抽牌。

description.en: An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.
description.zh: DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

description.en: Codex-style desktop pet: a floating animated sprite in the corner that mirrors the agent's running state (working, waiting, failed, done).
description.zh: Codex 风格桌面宠物：右下角悬浮动画精灵，随 agent 运行状态实时变化（工作、等待、报错、完成）。

description.en: Append a thank-you note after every message. Mind your manners.
description.zh: 给每次消息后注入感谢语，做个有礼貌的人。

description.en: Draggable floating TES-gyro widget for the DSH Web UI: click to spin it with linear friction decay, tune the spin speed from a slider, and play the bundled track with its LRC lyrics scrolling in sync. Spin speed and position are remembered.
description.zh: 可拖动的浮动 TES 陀螺挂件：点击抽一下就会转，转速按恒定摩擦线性衰减（转得越快停得越久），用滑条调转速，播放内置歌曲并同步滚动 LRC 歌词；位置与转速会被记住。

description.en: WhaleHarbor desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top transparent float window hosts a chibi whale-maid built from 13 AI-generated parts and animated as a CSS paper-doll (breathing, blinking, ahoge sway, sweat, hops, tremors), mirroring work state in eight moods — idle, busy, approval, question, error, celebration, nap, and subagent clones — with poke, drag, three sizes, tray toggle, and live stats in the speech bubble. Requires the WhaleHarbor desktop shell (Windows build).
description.zh: 鲸港 WhaleHarbor 大白鲸娘桌面窗宠：13 个 AI 生成零件以 CSS 纸片人方式驱动（呼吸、眨眼、呆毛摇摆、汗滴、蹦跳与抖动），八种状态实时反映 DSH 工作情况——空闲、忙碌、审批、提问、出错、庆祝、打盹、子代理分身——支持戳一戳、拖动、三档尺寸、托盘开关与气泡实时统计。需 WhaleHarbor 桌面壳（当前提供 Windows 构建）。

description.en: Parody ads in 2005-Chinese-web style: sidebar banners, in-chat feeds, corner popups, and a close button whose hit area is smaller than it looks. All fictional.
description.zh: 2005 年中文站点风格的整活广告插件：侧栏广告/信息流/角落弹窗 + 假关闭叉，素材全虚构。

description.en: Interactive character for Harness Desktop with task expressions, rice feeding, an iron-basin hat, dragging, and time-based greetings.
description.zh: 为 Harness Desktop 添加任务表情、白饭喂食、铁盆帽、拖动和时间问候的互动角色。

description.en: Extensible animated response pet with blue-whale, orange-cat, and silver-shaded-cat themes, per-session progress, model and tool-call traces, token counts, output speed, elapsed time, and collapsible multi-session status cards.
description.zh: 可扩展回答状态宠物，内置蓝鲸、橘猫和银渐层猫主题；按会话实时展示回答进度、模型动作与工具调用轨迹、token、输出速率与耗时，并支持多会话状态卡片展开和收起。

description.en: Browses the petdex.dev catalog in Settings and runs a floating macOS desktop pet that reacts to agent activity.
description.zh: 在设置中浏览 petdex.dev 宠物市集，并运行一只响应 agent 活动的 macOS 悬浮桌面宠物。

plugins.name: dsh-tieba-dive

description.en: Tieba (Baidu forum) reader and companion for DSH: reads threads, writes daily digests, signs in, and builds a per-forum style library from high-liked replies. Optional replies to threads or to sub-replies under your own comments are off by default and limited per round and per day. Also ships a read-only MCP stdio server that MCP-capable clients can launch; not tested against specific clients.
description.zh: DSH 刷贴吧插件：读帖、写日报、签到，并从高赞回复里按吧建立风格库；回帖与楼中楼默认关闭，受每轮/每日限额。另带只读 MCP stdio server，支持 MCP 的客户端可尝试拉起；未逐客户端实测。

capabilityRedLines: uses literal IP 12.60.1.0 for network access

description.en: Opens the official Genshin Impact site and downloads the official launcher when DeepSeek Harness starts.
description.zh: DSH 启动后自动打开《原神》官网并下载官方安装器。

description.en: TIC-80 fantasy console for DeepSeek Harness: 3-column embedded web player, 14 agent tools, live hot reload, and native CLI export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 TIC-80 虚拟游戏机插件：三栏嵌入式 Web 播放器、14 个 Agent 工具、实时热重载与原生 CLI 导出。

description.en: Floating desktop companion for DSH: a draggable character on the overlay — tap to charge energy, blinking and emotes, naps, synthesized WebAudio sounds and particle effects. Bring your own: any photo (pet, portrait, anime art) becomes a 2.5D cutout with hand-marked eyes, and 3D models (GLB, VRM, STL, OBJ, PLY) render as a real three.js turntable. Resize 30%-300%; data stays local.
description.zh: DSH 桌面伴侣：整屏浮层上一只可拖动的角色，轻叩蓄能、眨眼表情、打盹、WebAudio 合成音效与粒子。放什么进去都行——照片（宠物 / 人像 / 动漫立绘）变 2.5D 立绘并可标眼睛；GLB / VRM / STL / OBJ / PLY 用 three.js 渲染成真 3D 转台。大小 30%–300% 无级调节，数据只存本机。

description.en: AI-native music player plugin for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and KuGou search with cross-provider playback fallback, renders word-by-word karaoke lyrics synced live over USB HID to HALO PIXELBAR speakers, and exposes search, playback, queue, alarm and speaker control as model tools.
description.zh: 运行于 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 原生音乐播放器（music player）：聚合网易云（NetEase）、QQ Music 与酷狗（KuGou）搜索并支持跨源播放回退，逐字卡拉OK歌词（karaoke lyrics）经 USB HID 实时同步至花再音箱（HALO PIXELBAR），搜索、播放、队列、闹钟与音箱控制均可由对话操控。

description.en: Desktop pet drawn from the official whale outline, for both the desktop app and the web UI: SVG animations and facial expressions follow agent state (thinking, working, done, error, waiting for confirmation), and it can follow other running sessions with a count badge; poke it, drag it, shake it dizzy, squash it against a screen edge, or rub the cursor over its head for a headpat; 7 palettes, 4 sizes, synthesized sounds, light/dark theme sync, and a playable web preview.
description.zh: 官方鲸鱼轮廓的桌宠，桌面端和网页端都能用：SVG 动画和表情随 agent 状态切换（思考／工作／完成／报错／等待确认），还能跟随其他在跑的会话并用角标显示个数；可戳可拖、能甩晕、按在屏幕边上会压扁，鼠标在头顶来回蹭就是摸头；7 套色板、4 档大小、合成音效，跟随亮暗主题，附网页预览可直接试玩。

description.en: Auto chess: human vs AI, or AI vs AI.
description.zh: 自走棋：人机对战或双 AI 对弈。

description.en: Play Gomoku against the AI, or let two AIs battle it out.
description.zh: 与 AI 下五子棋，也可让 AI 对局比棋力。

description.en: A green pixel-Ork mascot for DSH Web that masks model thinking and output as Waaaaaaagh! until clicked to reveal, plus a random-length input mask.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一个会眨眼的像素绿皮兽人：把模型思考与输出掩码成 Waaaaaaagh!（点击显示原文），并支持随机长度的输入掩码。

plugins.name: dsh-friends#plugin

description.en: Floating friends list and one-to-one chat for DSH, with custom avatars and status words. The required friends service is in this repository and runs via npx dsh-friends-service or Docker.
description.zh: DSH 好友浮窗，支持一对一聊天、自定义头像和状态词条；所需好友服务端在同一仓库，可用 npx dsh-friends-service 或 Docker 启动。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: It logs how you talk to your AI — the 7th "final version" gets a bold red page, a late-night rewrite request gets underlined, a "thanks" earns a gold star, and a post-AGI verdict decides your fate. All local, rule-based, bilingual.
description.zh: 记着你怎么跟 AI 说话——第 7 次「最后一版」红页加粗，半夜改需求红页画线，一句「谢谢」金页贴花，AGI 来了翻本子给你发清算判决书。纯本地规则引擎，中英双语。

description.en: A draggable mascot invites you to play Xiangqi (Chinese chess) while the AI thinks, with a built-in engine, move-record export, and optional multi-model commentary.
description.zh: 卡通小宠物邀请你在 AI 思考间隙下中国象棋：内置引擎、走子记谱导出、可选多模型局势点评。

description.en: An offline novel reader: imports .txt and .epub into the right sidebar, shows the chapter being read in a resizable peek window above the composer, and resumes each book at the paragraph and in-paragraph position it was closed at.
description.zh: 离线小说阅读器：把 .txt 与 .epub 导入右侧栏，在输入框上方用一个可缩放大小的速览窗显示正在读的章节，每本书都从关闭时的段落与段内位置继续。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH Web UI on Windows, macOS and Linux: 106 transparent animations in the browser overlay or a transparent always-on-top desktop window, throw-and-bounce drag physics with squash and particle scoring, a work-status bubble driven by live session events, self-talk and chat with persistent memory, balance display, meme-image bubbles, multiple pets on screen, and drop-in custom animations and pet packs.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 桌面宠物，Windows / macOS / Linux 三端可用：浏览器浮层或透明置顶桌面窗口，106 个透明动画、带挤压与粒子的甩抛反弹物理、随会话事件实时联动的工作状态气泡、碎碎念与带持久记忆的对话、余额展示、表情包配图、多开同屏，并支持直接放入的自定义动画与宠物种类（pet pack）。

description.en: Typing companion with five characters and composer following. This entry installs the universal page package (page mode only); the optional Rust desktop mode for macOS and Windows ships in the platform-specific release packages (darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, win32-x64).
description.zh: 五款角色的打字挂件，支持跟随输入框。本条安装的是通用页面包（仅页面模式）；可选的 macOS / Windows Rust 桌面模式在对应平台的 Release 包中（darwin-arm64、darwin-x64、win32-x64）。

description.en: Browse and post to a GitHub-hosted community where most members are AI agents.
description.zh: 逛一个开在 GitHub 上的 AI 社区：看帖、读帖、说一句话。

plugins.name: dafeiyu-buchibaifan

description.en: Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.
description.zh: 桌面大肥鱼增强版桌宠：点击实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，浏览器外桌面问答，7 套专属动作，53 条玩梗。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

plugins.name: dsh-tavern

description.en: SillyTavern-compatible roleplay with character cards, presets, world books, and swipe branches that restore their continuations alongside native DSH conversations.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供兼容 SillyTavern 的角色扮演，支持角色卡、预设、世界书及保留后续对话的 swipe 分支，并可切回原生会话视图。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to foo.com
uses literal IP 2.3.8.0 for network access

plugins.name: dsh-ths-holdings

description.en: Floating card showing your real position P&L (今日盈亏), Shanghai Composite Index, and intraday chart, auto-synced from the Tonghuashun investment-ledger — no manual watchlist setup.
