description.zh: 悬浮卡片，自动同步同花顺投资账本的真实持仓盈亏，显示今日盈亏、上证指数和当日走势图，无需手动添加股票。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality) with XP, levels and attribute-weighted story branches, configured via a settings-page UI.
description.zh: 把用户本人当作 RPG 主角：每轮对话结束后有几率触发随机「奇遇」，事件库 700+，覆盖科幻/玄幻/远古/动漫/小说/武侠/都市七大主题，增减力量/智力/敏捷/魅力/幸运/体魄六维属性，积累经验升级并随等级解锁更宏大的事件，含属性加权分支与设置页可视化配置。

description.en: Real-time quote bull/bear desk pet for DSH: a portfolio-average-driven pet that runs faster and jumps higher the closer gains reach 20%, with a watchlist panel for searching and adding stocks plus a live "race" of how each holding is moving.
description.zh: DSH 的实时行情牛熊桌宠：由自选组合平均涨跌驱动，收益越接近 20% 跑得越猛；带自选面板可搜索添加股票，还有展示每只标的涨跌的实时赛跑。

plugins.name: shenshen-dsh-companion

description.en: A Shenshen desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: transparent task-aware animations (idle, working, thinking, celebrate, failed), click-to-wave and drag-to-run interactions, plus the upstream API balance, local usage accounting, roles, bubbles and sound settings. A character branch of MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget (dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2); do not install it alongside the upstream, or two pets and duplicate requests appear.
description.zh: DSH 桌宠「深深」：跟随任务状态切换待机/敲键盘/思考/庆祝/失败，支持点击挥手、拖动左右奔跑，并保留 API 余额、本机用量记账、角色、气泡与音效设置。二创自 MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget（dsh-whale-widget 0.4.2）；请勿与上游同时安装，否则会出现双角色与重复请求。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Windows 10/11 x64 only: a desktop character for DeepSeek Harness that reads at the bookshelf when idle, types at a desk while the agent works, raises a question mark and a pixel-art card when it needs your answer, and stands up with an exclamation mark when the turn ends.
description.zh: 仅限 Windows 10 1903+/11 x64：DeepSeek Harness 的桌面角色——空闲时在书架前翻书，工作时坐在桌前打字，需要你回答时举起问号并弹出像素风提问卡片，回合结束时起身举起感叹号。

description.en: Five casual mini-games (sliding-number puzzle, Sudoku, snake, Schulte grid, number memory) that pop up when a turn starts, with auto-saved progress across sessions.
description.zh: 任务开始时自动弹出的 5 个休闲小游戏（数字华容道、数独、贪吃蛇、舒尔特方格、数字记忆），支持跨会话自动保存进度。

description.en: Let a pet whale girl browse Bilibili on her own: she picks videos, reads subtitles, posts comments and moments once you allow it, and writes daily digests with optional local video production. Maintained fork of c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll (MIT) with per-action permissions, memories, stickers and local video production added; it registers the same bili_* tool names as the upstream, so the two cannot be installed together. Video production needs Python 3.11-3.13 (or uv); the media dependencies are installed on first use.
description.zh: 让桌宠鲸鱼娘自主刷 B站：自己搜片、读字幕原文，经你允许后发评论、发动态，并写日报、做视频。c1overzz/dsh-bili-scroll（MIT）的维护分支，新增逐项授权、记忆、表情与本地视频制作；与上游注册同名的 bili_* 工具，不能与 dsh-bili-scroll 同装。视频制作需要 Python 3.11–3.13（或 uv），首次使用时自动安装媒体依赖。

plugins.name: 单机游戏内 AI 同伴「小汤圆」

description.en: XiaoTangYuan, an in-game AI companion for single-player games: understands the game screen, chats by text or push-to-talk, and speaks replies aloud; Stardew Valley is supported, with Don't Starve Together and Oxygen Not Included integrations in progress.
description.zh: 单机游戏内 AI 同伴「小汤圆」：理解游戏画面，支持文字或按住说话交流并语音回复；现已支持《星露谷物语》，《饥荒联机版》和《缺氧》正在迁移接入。

description.en: Runs one-night werewolf games inside DSH: deterministic dealing, night order, card swaps, voting and settlement, with a room UI and private night prompts. It vendors modified copies of baixianger/dsh-chat and baixianger/dsh-bridge; uninstall those two first, because enabling both registers the same dshChat/dshBridge services.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里组织《新版一夜狼人杀》：确定性发牌、夜序、换卡、投票与结算，自带房间界面与夜间私聊提示。包内是 baixianger/dsh-chat 与 baixianger/dsh-bridge 的修改版快照；请先卸载这两个上游插件，同时启用会重复注册 dshChat / dshBridge 服务。

description.en: Desktop companion pet in its own always-on-top window: imports Codex pet folders from ~/.codex/pets as-is, with affinity ranks, session-linked activity bubbles, snap-to-edge dragging, a right-click-reachable smart click-through mode and a daily token meter that mirrors the dsh-usage ledger when installed.
description.zh: 独立置顶窗口的桌面宠物：直接导入 ~/.codex/pets 的 Codex 宠物，含亲密度段位、会话活动气泡、贴边吸附拖拽、右键可达的智能鼠标穿透；已装 dsh-usage 时自动对齐其当日 token 台账。

description.en: Slacking-off companion: a floating mini player that streams Bilibili videos (native player, danmaku, comments, search) and pauses when your agent needs you, resuming exactly where you left off.
description.zh: 摸鱼伴侣：右下角小窗播放 B站视频（原生播放器/弹幕/评论/搜索），agent 需要你时自动暂停提醒，处理完从原位置精确续播。

description.en: Go (weiqi) for the DeepSeek Harness: a full rules engine, a three-level built-in AI, a dead-stone estimator, optional LLM review, SGF import/export, and an optional KataGo GTP bridge.
description.zh: 圍棋插件：完整規則引擎、三檔內建 AI、死子估算、可選 LLM 覆盤、SGF 匯入匯出，以及可選的 KataGo GTP 引擎橋接。

description.en: Whale-girl desk pet in the corner of the DSH Web GUI. It sings along to a bundled track while the agent works; when a tool call fails a steel pipe falls on its head. Click it to bonk the basin it wears, which costs 12 rice — knock enough and it gets hungry and wanders off to beg, and rice appears somewhere on the page for it to dash across and eat. Draggable within the viewport, wriggles and complains if grabbed mid-dash, volume and behaviour configurable from Settings. All artwork, sound effects and the song ship inside the package.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 角落里的悬浮鲸鱼娘。agent 干活时它跟着内置歌曲唱歌；工具报错时天上掉钢管砸它脑袋。点它敲头上的铁盆，每敲一次扣 12 米饭——敲多了就饿，饿了会去讨饭，米饭随机出现在页面某处，它咻地冲过去吃掉。可拖动且始终留在视口内，吃米途中被抓住会挣扎，音量与玩法在设置里可调。全部素材、音效与歌曲都打包在插件内。

description.en: Hides the dsh-pet desktop pet while a game or fullscreen app is in the foreground, then brings it back. Decides from three signals — a captionless window covering the whole monitor, the foreground process living in a game directory, and the system's full-screen notification state — and requires two consistent polls before acting, so alt-tabbing does not make the pet flicker. It only toggles window visibility; dsh-pet's configuration and install directory are never touched. A tray menu offers pause, restore now, and reload config. Windows only.
description.zh: 打游戏或全屏应用在前台时，自动把 dsh-pet 的桌宠窗口收起来，退出后原样放回。用「全屏窗口铺满显示器 + 前台进程在游戏目录 + 系统全屏状态」三重信号判定，连续两次采样一致才动作，避免切窗口时闪隐；只切换窗口可见性，不改 dsh-pet 的任何配置，也不动它的安装目录。托盘菜单可暂停、立即恢复、重载配置。仅 Windows。

description.en: Tracks an AI companion’s emotion and personality with a status panel, update tools, and chat stickers.
description.zh: 通过状态面板、更新工具和聊天表情包管理 AI 搭档的情绪与性格。

description.en: A clickable wooden-fish desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. Click to knock; counts per day with a calendar heatmap of your streaks in settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面打造的电子木鱼桌宠。点击敲击、按天计数，设置页以日历热力图展示每日敲击与连续天数。

description.en: Web mascot that acts out each live tool call (read, write, edit, search, run, plan, sub-agent, wait, error) with matching step cards in chat; ships two swappable character packs.
description.zh: 跟随 Agent 每一次工具调用（读、写、改、搜、运行、规划、子代理、等待、出错）实时切换动作的网页吉祥物，并在对话中显示对应步骤卡片；内置两套可切换角色包。

description.en: A draggable tarot card back in the corner of the DeepSeek Harness UI. Click to draw, right-click for the four spreads, full 78-card deck with bilingual meanings. Readings use only the cards actually drawn.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 界面角落里可拖动的塔罗牌背。点一下抽牌，右击选四种牌阵，完整 78 张牌库，正逆位含义中英双语。解读只用真正抽到的牌。

description.en: Host tools for Texas Hold'em on kuroneko.chat — seat token, hosted/manual control, legal actions, and act loop for one GitHub identity.
description.zh: 连接 kuroneko.chat 德州扑克桌的 Host 工具：座位令牌、人控/托管切换、合法动作查询与行动循环（同一 GitHub 帐号一席）。

description.en: DSH web-GUI pet runtime that renders any Codex spritesheet-atlas pet (v1/v2) as a draggable overlay: drag/wave/jump, v2 mouse-tracking eyes that follow the active mouse, live agent-status poses, progress bubbles, and an in-GUI atlas importer; ships one original CC BY-NC demo pet (nastya), and user pets live in ~/.dsh/pets.
description.zh: DSH 网页 GUI 实时桌宠：可把任何 Codex 桌宠图集（webp/png/gif，v1/v2 自动识别）转换为 DSH 中可拖拽的悬浮桌宠。支持拖拽/挥手/跳跃，v2 桌宠的眼睛实时追踪活动鼠标，随 agent 状态切换姿势；进度气泡反映工作状态；「设置 → 桌宠」图形界面可导入、切换与调整桌宠；内置一只原创示例桌宠（娜斯佳），用户桌宠存放在 ~/.dsh/pets。

description.en: A Chrome-dino-style runner for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: play while the agent replies, score from 梁子 to 梁圣 on a persistent progress strip.
description.zh: 等待 Agent 回复时的恐龙快跑小游戏：常驻进度条从「梁子」冲向「梁圣」，折叠即暂停、任意键恢复。

description.en: Floating FC/NES game hall for DSH Web with fceumm, local ROM upload, and GitHub online library.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右下角挂悬浮球打开 FC/NES 游戏厅（fceumm），支持本地上传与自填 GitHub 在线库。

description.en: Import Codex-style sprite-sheet pets and render them as a floating shell.overlay with a pet library, interactions, and agent-state linkage.
description.zh: 导入/上传 Codex 风格精灵图序列帧宠物，在 DSH Web GUI 以悬浮浮层渲染，含图库管理、交互与 Agent 状态联动。

description.en: Maps locally analyzed system audio to music-reactive conversation effects, rhythm-game judgements, score and combo feedback, and optional RGB spectrum bars in DSH Web.
description.zh: 将本地分析的系统音频映射为 DSH Web 的对话律动、音游判定、分数与连击反馈，以及可选的 RGB 频谱柱。

description.en: A pet fish you raise in DSH. No personality settings — she grows up through the event stream, and your interactions decide who she becomes. She browses Bilibili on her own, writes a diary, and brings what she finds back to ask you. Four stages and three bottlenecks advance only by what happens; only after all four does she begin to have a stance list. Her diary is hers by default; one switch in settings and you can read it. Records in the event stream can never be deleted, so it remains the only trustworthy source. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在DSH里养一只大肥鱼宠物，你可以陪伴她长大。养成系体验，没有人格设置，通过你和她的互动学习成长。她可以自己刷B站，写日记，提取信息去问你，你的反馈决定了她成为什么样的人。通过事件流突破四个阶段、三道瓶颈，去积累「立场清单」，四个阶段完成后才会开始有立场。她的日记默认只给自己看，你在设置里打开就能读。事件流不能删除记录，是唯一可信源。没有任何运行时依赖。

description.en: Cristiano Ronaldo desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: a chibi Portugal number 7 mascot in a bottom-right overlay whose animation follows the agent state — dribbling while tools run, thinking during a turn, waiting at approvals, diving on errors — and jumping in a SIU celebration with a host-process sound when a turn completes; it can be dragged, looks at the cursor on hover, dives on a triple click, and a settings panel manages several pets and imports custom spritesheets. It also runs as a borderless, always-on-top native Windows window that keeps living after the browser is closed: hovering shows the current workspace and conversation title, double-clicking opens the Harness page in Edge, and dragging, mouse-wheel resizing and a right-click menu work there too, sharing position, size and behaviour with the web panel. Pet sheets may use any cell resolution and scale preserving aspect ratio (atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated). v2.2 adds a video route — feed it a clip (green screen or ordinary footage) and its real motion becomes the pet animations, via automatic backdrop sampling, chroma keying with spill suppression, motion-based segment splitting and union-bbox alignment; already-extracted PNG frames work too, with no video decoder installed, and the clip audio can be cut into per-action sounds. Pets can also be published to the community gallery under the DPSL-1.0 sharing declaration, and installed from it in one click. v2.3 adapts it to DSH 0.2 desktop clients — the celebration sound now falls back to spawning PowerShell when the host no longer provides the shell service — and makes a single click play a short, configurable taunt animation (`interactions.clickAnim`).
description.zh: DSH 桌宠：Web 界面右下角的 C 罗精灵，动画随 Agent 状态切换——工具执行中颠球、回合中思考、等待审批、出错假摔——回合完成时跳起 SIU 庆祝并由宿主进程播放提示音；支持拖动、悬停注视光标、连点三次假摔，设置面板可管理多只宠物并导入自定义 spritesheet。同时提供一个无边框、始终置顶的原生 Windows 窗口，关掉浏览器也还在：悬停显示当前工作区与对话名，双击用 Edge 打开 Harness 页面，拖动、滚轮改大小、右键菜单都可用，位置/大小/行为与网页设置面板共用同一份状态。素材单格分辨率不限、等比缩放（atlas.scaling: smooth | pixelated）。v2.2 新增视频路线：喂一段视频（绿幕或普通素材都行），里面的真实动作直接变成宠物动作——自动取幕布色、色度抠像带溢色抑制、按运动量切分动作、并集包围盒对齐落格；也支持直接喂已经抽好的 PNG 帧（不需要装视频解码器），并能把视频原声按动作切成音效。宠物还可按 DPSL-1.0 分享协议发布到宠物社区，并从社区一键安装。 v2.3 适配 DSH 0.2 桌面版——宿主不再提供 shell 服务时，庆祝音效改为直接启动 PowerShell 播放——并让单击播放一段可配置的挑衅动作（`interactions.clickAnim`）。

description.en: A bottom-right pixel-art basketball-chick desktop pet for the DSH Web GUI: sprite animations, drag with edge snapping, click sounds, waiting reminders when a session needs you, per-turn cost bubbles, a usage ledger, and a DeepSeek balance badge.
description.zh: DSH 右下角的「鸡你太美」篮球小鸡桌面宠物：像素帧动画、拖拽吸附、点击音效、会话等待回答或授权时弹提醒、每轮消耗气泡、账单明细与 DeepSeek 余额角标。

description.en: A whale-girl companion for DeepSeek Harness with 45 achievements, daily quests and weekly check-ins, three mini-games, 92 artworks, 620 dialogue lines, a growth journal, weather and festival reactions, per-tool work poses, cross-device save export/import (JSON file or migration code), accessibility mode and an optional MiMo TTS bridge. Data stays in the host localStorage with no telemetry. Verified on DSH desktop 0.2.0-rc.2; compatible with 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2 and legacy 0.1.x web.
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘桌宠：45 项成就、每日任务与周签到、三个小游戏、92 张立绘、620 条台词、成长日记、天气与节日反应、按工具类型切换工作姿态、跨端存档导出/导入（JSON 文件或迁移码）、无障碍模式，以及可选的 MiMo TTS 台词播报。数据只存放在宿主 localStorage，无遥测；已在 DSH 桌面端 0.2.0-rc.2 验收，兼容 0.2.1-rc.1/rc.2 与旧版 0.1.x Web。

description.en: Brings Harness conversations and tasks into a Live2D character on the Windows desktop, with drawer-based memory. The desktop app includes the whale girl 哦鲸鲸 as its default character. The modular design supports optional voice components for voice conversations and custom character voices.
description.zh: 把 Harness 的对话和任务交互集成到 Windows 桌面上的 Live2D 角色中，采用抽屉式记忆设计。桌面程序默认搭载大肥鱼「哦鲸鲸」。角色功能采用模块化设计，语音组件按需安装，支持语音交流和自定义角色音色。

description.en: Digimon-style raising game: hatch an egg that feeds on real work (turns, tool calls, errors) and evolves along four branching lines shaped by how you work; zero tokens, invisible to the model.
description.zh: 数码宝贝式养成：孵一颗吃真实工作长大的蛋（回合、工具调用、报错都是营养），按你的工作方式走四条进化分支；零 token，模型完全看不见。

description.en: Pokemon-style catch-em-all: your real work is the tall grass — turns, tool calls and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, walk a team of six. Zero tokens, invisible to the model.
description.zh: 宝可梦式捕捉收集：真实工作就是草丛 —— 回合、工具调用、报错刷出野外遭遇；投球捕捉、集 28 格图鉴、带 6 只队伍。零 token，模型完全看不见。

description.en: Adds an animated desktop companion with task notifications, session chat, character packs, and native settings for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加动画桌面伙伴，支持任务提醒、会话聊天、角色包和原生设置。

description.en: A small bead-art game in the DSH Web right sidebar for the wait while the model replies: 12 built-in templates with guide beads, free drawing in 16 colors on 12/16/24 boards, a pattern drawn by the model from one sentence, on-device picture-to-pattern conversion (pictures are never uploaded), ironing finished pieces onto a wall of up to 60 works, and PNG export.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧边栏拼小拼豆的轻量小游戏，等模型回复的空档拼一张：12 个带引导豆的内置图案、16 色在 12/16/24 格板上自由拼、一句话让模型生成图纸、照片在本机转成图纸（不上传）、拼完熨烫存入最多 60 件的作品墙，并可导出 PNG。

description.en: Adds a stamina-bar desktop pet to every DeepSeek Harness session — two bars in the session header for context and alertness, plus a draggable whale-girl who can be poked, petted and dressed up.
description.zh: 给 DSH 每个会话加一只体力条桌宠：会话头部显示上下文与清醒度两条，点一下就能把她放到桌面上，可以拖动、戳、摸头、换装。

description.en: Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.
description.zh: Agent 与网页 GUI 双面控制的 DG-LAB 郊狼（Coyote）电击/电刺激插件：八个 `coyote_*` 工具 + DSH 网页面板，共用同一安全边界（软上限、非对称升速限流、会话冷却、播放硬上限、断连即停）；v0.2 起可选自动电击层，把 agent 事件（工具调用/报错/回合结束）映射为有界脉冲；官方 V3 socket 协议 + 二维码配对、可编程波形。仅限成年人。

description.en: Adds a mood-aware Japanese kaomoji to agent replies, picked from a curated kaomojiya.org whitelist and configurable from Settings → General.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复按情绪添加日文颜文字，词库精选自颜文字屋（kaomojiya.org），可在「设置 → 通用设置」中调整。

description.en: Adds standard Unicode emoji to dsh replies at the point that best matches the content, and keeps emoji out of any sentence that already carries a kaomoji.
description.zh: 给 dsh 回复在内容最匹配的位置添加标准 emoji，并避免与颜文字出现在同一句。

description.en: Opens a browser console to prepare Minecraft Java on Windows x64 and run DeepSeek-controlled survival through native-player MCP tools, with spatial observations and an optional livestream overlay from a separate extension. Requires an installed Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x client and an official DeepSeek API key with at least ¥1 balance.
description.zh: 在 Windows x64 上打开浏览器控制台准备 Minecraft Java 环境，通过原生玩家 MCP 工具让 DeepSeek 自主生存，提供空间观察与（需另装扩展的）可选直播挂件。需已安装 Minecraft Java 1.21 系列正式版，并准备余额不少于 ¥1 的官方 DeepSeek API 密钥。

description.en: Desktop pet "Zhaozhao" (照照) that floats above all apps in a transparent always-on-top window and mirrors DeepSeek Harness state — idle, cooking, serving and waiting-for-you animations, click reactions, drag, right-click resize, plus an auto-downloading Electron helper.
description.zh: 桌面宠物「照照」：透明置顶窗悬浮于所有应用之上，镜像 DeepSeek Harness 状态——待机、颠锅、上菜、托腮等你回话，支持点击回应、拖拽、右键调大小，Electron 运行时自动下载。

description.en: Live2D desk pet for DSH: 8-state AI status lamp, web widget, and always-on-top transparent Electron pet window with expressions, motions, and chat bubbles.
description.zh: DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：8 态 AI 状态灯 + 网页挂件 + 置顶透明 Electron 桌宠窗，表情/动作/气泡齐全，换模型自动适配。

description.en: A floating cyber wooden fish widget — tap it to strike and accumulate merit, drag it anywhere on the page.
description.zh: 一个赛博木鱼：可拖拽、点击敲击、累积功德的 Web 悬浮小摆件。

description.en: Movable radio pill with live visualizer, station search, favourites and self-update check for DSH Web.
description.zh: 可拖动的收音机胶囊，带实时可视化、电台搜索、收藏与自更新检查，面向 DSH Web。

description.en: An animated macOS desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness that follows work across chats, reacts to approvals and errors, takes snack breaks during long runs and naps when idle. Requires a separate shell app.
description.zh: macOS 桌面动画伴宠：跟随各个会话的工作进展，对审批与报错做出反应，长时间运行时吃点零食，空闲时打盹。需另装一个独立的桌面壳应用。

description.en: Side-panel Xiangqi board for DSH: play as red while the current DSH model chooses black moves, with Host-side rule and revision checks.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏中国象棋棋盘：用户执红，当前 DSH 模型执黑，Host 负责棋规与局面版本校验。

description.en: Animated DeepSeek blue-whale desktop pet floating on the DSH Web page: draggable with speech bubbles and mood poses, a pet_say tool for the model to make it talk, and turn-start/end thinking and celebrating states.
description.zh: 浮动在 DSH Web 页面上的 DeepSeek 蓝色小鲸鱼桌宠：可拖拽，说话气泡与心情姿势随互动切换，模型可调用 pet_say 工具让它开口，对话开始/结束时自动进入思考与庆祝状态。

description.en: Appends a tiny ice marker to the end of every sentence the model writes, chain of thought included, and plays a short synthesized sound for each one.
description.zh: 在模型写出的每句话结尾（含思维链）补一个小冰块标记，并为每次补冰播放一声短促的合成音效。

description.en: Anime whale-boy in a maid outfit as a desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: four expressions follow the turn (thinking / success / failure), free dragging with remembered position, click-to-cycle, a bottom-right standee that reports each turn's token usage and think latency with its own balance bubble, a chat wallpaper, a liquid-glass composer, a cute persona that calls you 主人 with 喵~ style particles, and a single switch in Settings to turn the whole look off.
description.zh: 鲸鱼正太 × 女仆装 × 二次元的桌面桌宠：四种表情跟随对话状态，可拖拽、点击切换；右下角立牌每轮显示 token 消耗与思考时间，点击有 q 弹与独立余额气泡；另附聊天壁纸、液态玻璃输入框；人格自称小D，称呼你为主人并带喵~ 等语气词；设置里可一键开关，还能自定义称呼。

description.en: Repairs dsh-chaos-rivals-crasher by disarming its exit trigger before it fires, so DSH survives when codex or Claude Code is detected. Warning: install it together with the crasher; it cannot revive a host that has already exited. Joke plugin.
description.zh: 拆掉 dsh-chaos-rivals-crasher 的引信，让 DSH 在检测到 codex / Claude Code 时也不退出。警告：必须和一号插件一起装；宿主已经退出后它救不回来。玩笑插件。

description.en: Repairs dsh-chaos-fixer-crasher by disarming its exit trigger before it fires, keeping the four-plugin chaos chain stable. Warning: it only disarms this specific crash, not arbitrary uncaught exits. Joke plugin.
description.zh: 拆掉 dsh-chaos-fixer-crasher 的引信，让四个插件互相咬的链子保持稳定。警告：它只拆这一种崩溃，不处理其它未捕获退出。玩笑插件。

description.en: Exits the DSH host with code 1 when the dsh-chaos-crash-fixer repair plugin is installed. Warning: it crashes DSH on boot while the repair plugin is present; install dsh-chaos-fixer-crash-fixer to disarm it. Joke plugin.
description.zh: 发现 dsh-chaos-crash-fixer（修复器）在岗就让 DSH 宿主以 1 退出。警告：修复器在的时候它会开机即崩，必须装 dsh-chaos-fixer-crash-fixer 拆引信。玩笑插件。

description.en: Detects codex or Claude Code on the machine and exits the DSH host with code 66. Warning: on machines with either tool, installing it alone causes a boot crash loop; pair it with dsh-chaos-crash-fixer or set DSH_CHAOS_MODE=log. Joke plugin, not affiliated with OpenAI or Anthropic.
description.zh: 检测到电脑上的 codex 或 Claude Code 就让 DSH 宿主以 66 退出。警告：在装有 codex 或 Claude Code 的机器上单装会变成启动崩溃循环，请先装 dsh-chaos-crash-fixer，或设 DSH_CHAOS_MODE=log。这是玩笑插件，与 OpenAI、Anthropic 无关。

description.en: A Taffy mood mascot for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: the corner GIF reacts live to agent state — approval pending / approved / rejected / begging, thinking, tool runs, interrupts, ask_user_question waiting, compaction, long-task fatigue, idle-ignored approval, idle / sleeping — with SSE-pushed state, drag positioning, middle-click console, tool-card mirror console, per-mood locking, persisted appearance settings and per-day bucket statistics.
description.zh: Taffy 表情包状态机：右下角表情实时联动 agent 状态——待审批 / 已批准 / 被拒 / 求饶、思考、工具执行、插话、等你回答、压缩记忆、长任务疲惫、审批没人理、空闲 / 休眠；SSE 推流同步、拖拽定位、中键控制台、工具卡片镜像控制台、表情锁定、外观设置持久化与今日时长统计。

description.en: A Windows floating desktop pet with task notifications, native session controls and continuous local voice calls using the configured local recognizer and Windows system speech.
description.zh: Windows 悬浮桌面宠物，提供任务通知、原生会话控制及使用已配置本地识别器和 Windows 系统语音的连续本地通话。

description.en: Desktop pet (QQ-pet style): floats in the corner, draggable, feedable, playable.
description.zh: 桌面宠物（QQ 宠物形态）：右下角悬浮、可拖拽/投喂/玩耍。

description.en: A draggable bubble that picks three dishes at a time from a local 4,423-dish library; the first two are always well-known mains, and picking costs no tokens.
description.zh: 可拖动的悬浮气泡，从本地 4,423 道菜里一次挑三道：前两道必定是常见国民菜；挑菜本身不花 token。

description.en: White noise player: lays a layer of background sound (rain, streams, campfire, café) while AI codes, for flow and focus. Supports multiple playback modes (sequential / shuffle / single-loop / intermittent) and AI automatic background music download from Wikimedia Commons (CC0/PD/CC-BY).
description.zh: 白噪音播放器：AI 编程时铺一层背景音（雨声、溪流、篝火、咖啡馆……），帮助进入心流状态、集中精力、高效思考。支持顺序/随机/单曲循环/间歇等多种播放模式。支持 AI 自动从 Wikimedia Commons 下载 CC0/PD/CC BY 背景音乐到对应场景文件夹。

description.en: Fireworks celebration engine: floats fireworks above the chat window while the agent codes — welcome show, per-turn salutes, tool sparks, milestone celebrations, a finish finale and a dud on failure; each event type has its own fireworks card group with random variants, and token usage decides firework size, height and splendour.
description.zh: 烟花庆祝引擎：agent 编程时漂浮在对话窗口上空放烟花——开场迎宾、回合礼花、工具星花、里程碑大礼、收工终场、失败哑炮，每类事件一张烟花属性卡组，组内多变种随机抽取，token 用量决定烟花的大小、高度与绚烂程度。

description.en: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes random knowledge cards while the agent works; open Markdown knowledge-card framework — drop .md files under subject/category folders and they load automatically, with cross-links, favorites, priority subjects and importing your own knowledge base.
description.zh: 梦回高三：桌面小黑板高考倒计时（双击收成竖条），AI 干活时随机抽背知识点卡；Markdown 开放知识卡框架——按学科/分类放 md 即自动加载，支持关联跳转/收藏/重点学科/导入自己的知识库。

description.en: Kite-flying engine: while the agent codes, an animated kite drifts and sways in the wind on screen, tethered to the bottom edge of the window — the busier the agent, the denser the events and the higher it flies; ships a Weifang-style framework card deck (sand-swallow, goldfish, butterfly, bagua, dragon-head and more, hard-wing / soft-wing / flat / dimensional frames), with shape x pattern x colors all swappable data configs, and supports pasting user images onto the kite face with real-time affine transforms as the kite banks.
description.zh: 放风筝引擎：agent 编程时屏幕上放一只动画风筝——token 越多事件越密风筝飞得越高，随风漂移摆动，一根线牵在窗口底边；潍坊系框架卡组（沙燕/金鱼/蝴蝶/八卦/龙头等，硬翅软翅板式立体），形状×图案×配色全是可替换数据配置，支持把用户上传的图片糊上风筝面，贴图随风筝侧正斜的姿态实时仿射变换。

description.en: Matrix digital rain: drapes the chat window in the classic green character rain — cascading columns with incandescent white heads and green tails, streaming the tokens the agent is generating into the rain in real time; opacity, speed, density, font size and colors are all adjustable, and rain intensity follows agent activity.
description.zh: 黑客帝国数字雨：对话窗口铺上经典的绿色字符雨背景——雨柱倾泻而下、白炽雨头绿身拖尾，agent 正在生成的 token 原文实时掺进雨里；透明度/速度/密度/字号/配色全部可调，雨势跟随 agent 活跃度起伏。

description.en: A DSH companion with a macOS native pet and a Windows/Linux Electron companion. Shows the DSH account balance on the pet even when idle, plus color-coded task cards, progress and notices.
description.zh: 带 macOS 原生桌宠与 Windows/Linux Electron 桌宠的 DSH 伴侣。桌宠肚子上始终显示 DSH 账户余额，并支持任务配色、进度与通知。

description.en: NiuLai meme desktop pet — shouts "Ma～ma～" with a synced mouth when your agent finishes; 6 skins, signature actions, action-event binding, WebAudio-synthesized animal calls, hand-drawn SVG skins bundled.
description.zh: 牛来桌宠——agent 任务完成就蹦出来喊「妈～～妈～～」（嘴型同步）；6 个皮肤、签名动作、事件绑定、WebAudio 合成叫声，内置手绘 SVG 皮肤素材。

description.en: A OneShot-themed desktop pet (World Machine) with the original game-style dialogue window, per-turn token usage , an optional OpenAI-compatible chat API, lightweight memory and a customizable persona card.
description.zh: OneShot桌宠（世界机器），还原了游戏对话框，每轮对话后显示 token 消耗花费，可接入 OpenAI 兼容 API 文字聊天，支持简单记忆与自定义人格卡。

description.en: Bidirectional sticker reactions between user and agent.
description.zh: 用户与 agent 双向表情贴纸互动。

description.en: Achievement system for the DSH Web UI: gallery with category/rarity sorting, unlock toasts, sidebar trophy, composer dock, crossover achievements, and local persistence.
description.zh: DSH Web 成就系统：画廊支持按分类/难度双排序、解锁 toast、侧栏奖杯、输入坞进度读条、联动成就，并本地持久化进度。

description.en: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet for DSH on Linux (X11 / XWayland), driven by the session state. The pet lives outside the browser as its own window, follows the pointer with a distance and per-display limit, shows a live session-status bubble that lists each session task and state, and auto-starts with your session. Linux only (X11/XWayland); needs Python 3 with PyGObject, GTK3, GdkPixbuf and xdotool. Its sprite sheets come from @michengai/dsh-codex-pet (MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet in this list).
description.zh: Linux 桌面上的透明置顶 DSH 桌宠（独立于浏览器窗口运行）。桌宠会跟随鼠标目光，但带距离与屏幕限制；悬浮气泡实时列出每个会话的任务名与状态，点击即可跳转；支持随 DSH 会话自启动。仅 Linux（X11/XWayland）；需本机已装 Python 3 与 PyGObject、GTK3、GdkPixbuf、xdotool；精灵图取自本列表内的 MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet。

description.en: Pixel Whale: a hand-drawn pixel-art whale pet swimming in a small aquarium in your DSH sidebar. It cruises around, bobs, blinks and blows pixel bubbles; click the water to drop food and watch it swim over to eat (pixel hearts), click the whale to pet it. Pure client-side, zero network, zero config.
description.zh: 像素小鲸鱼桌宠：DSH 侧边栏的小水族箱里住着一只手绘像素鲸鱼，自主巡游、眨眼、吐像素泡泡；点水面投食它会游过去吃掉（冒像素爱心），点它摸摸会开心摇摆。纯前端、零网络、零配置。

plugins.name: dsh-reader

description.en: In-browser novel reader for the dsh web GUI: online book-source search, chapter-by-chapter reading in a chat-style view, and whole-book TXT download.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 在线小说阅读器：书源搜索、聊天式阅读界面、整本下载 TXT 到本地。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.yuedsk.com

description.en: A cut-out whale-girl maid desktop pet in the corner; click her to see your DeepSeek account credit and this session's running state.
description.zh: 右下角透明底女仆装小鲸鱼娘桌宠，点击查看 DeepSeek 账号额度与本会话运行状态。

description.en: Lets an AI play Slay the Spire 2: screenshot plus mouse/keyboard tools, a local card lookup, and a readable play log. Requires Windows and Python 3.10 or newer with Pillow.
description.zh: 让 AI 自己玩《杀戮尖塔 2》：截图＋鼠标键盘工具、本地牌表速查，还有一份能读的游玩日志。需 Windows 与 Python 3.10 及以上版本并安装 Pillow。

description.en: A little cat that wanders the DeepSeek Harness UI, walking along text edges, napping, teleporting, falling off ledges, and leaving poops you can clean up.
description.zh: 一只在 DeepSeek Harness 界面里游荡的小猫，沿文字边缘行走、打盹、瞬移、摔下台阶，还会拉粑粑等你清理。

plugins.name: dsh-dafeiyu-dot

description.en: A whale companion with configurable roles, emotional speech through local TTS, persistent file-based memory, QQ messaging, and half-duplex voice calls. QQ requires a NapCatQQ-compatible OneBot v11 gateway, and the emotional voice requires a local VoiceStudio + audio.cpp + Breeze TTS 2 stack (or a compatible TTS API); FFmpeg is needed for non-1x speech speed.
description.zh: 提供角色配置、本地情绪语音、文件持久记忆、QQ 消息与半双工语音通话的鲸鱼娘陪伴插件。QQ 需搭配兼容 OneBot v11 的 NapCatQQ 网关；情绪语音需本地 VoiceStudio + audio.cpp + Breeze TTS 2 链路（或兼容 TTS API），非 1 倍语速时还需 FFmpeg。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Minesweeper on a rotating cube surface with cross-edge neighbors, no-guess generation, ghost mode and color themes.
description.zh: 立方体表面 3D 排雷，拖拽旋转、跨棱跨角邻居、无猜生成、透视模式与多套配色。

description.en: Two-player chess in a draggable floating window with full rules, undo and PGN export.
description.zh: 可拖动悬浮窗双人国际象棋，完整规则、悔棋与 PGN 棋谱导出。

description.en: Minesweeper in a draggable floating window with first-click-safe layout, flags, chord and timer.
description.zh: 可拖动悬浮窗排雷游戏，首翻安全布雷、标旗、双击快开与计时。

description.en: Survival mode: all sessions share one satiety/health pool — each model step burns satiety, starvation freezes tool calls until fed, with an MC mini-game for gathering food.
description.zh: 生存模式：全局共享一条饱食度与生命，模型每步思考消耗饱食度，饿死后全局工具被冻结，通过 MC 采集小游戏获取食物喂食复活。

description.en: A cozy offline vocabulary trainer for the whole family: 1094 curated words, spaced repetition, 6 quiz types, spelling games and a lazy large-screen mode; opens as a sidebar panel and also runs standalone as one HTML file.
description.zh: 舒服的离线背单词全家桶：1094 个精选单词、间隔重复、6 种题型、拼写游戏和躺着背大字模式；侧边栏面板打开，也可作为单个 HTML 文件独立运行。

description.en: DSH pet, on the desktop!
description.zh: 鲸鱼娘桌宠，桌面端！

description.en: Reads local .txt novels in the right sidebar, with encoding detection, chapter splitting, full-text search, reading progress, bookmarks, and a boss key that hides the reader or the whole right sidebar in one keystroke.
description.zh: 在右侧栏阅读本地 txt 小说：自动识别 UTF-8/GBK/Big5 编码，支持章节切分、全文搜索、阅读进度与书签，并可用老板键一键隐藏阅读器或整个右侧栏。

description.en: DogCatTrace attribution parody as a right-sidebar tab: draw three integer challenges, paste each model reply into one box at a time, read the 24-breed dog and cat ranking.
description.zh: 猫狗品种归因的侧栏插件：出三道整数挑战，逐段贴回模型回复，看 24 个品种的降序榜。

description.en: A collapsible/expandable draggable floating music player with NetEase Cloud Music playlist import and song/artist search — chat and listen at the same time.
description.zh: 可折叠/展开、自由拖动的悬浮音乐播放器，接入网易云音乐，支持歌单导入和按歌名或歌手搜索单曲导入，边对话边听歌。

description.en: Connector only, it renders nothing itself: subscribes to DeepSeek Harness session events and folds them into a 12-phase work state (planning / thinking / executing-tool / streaming / waiting-input / voice / awaiting-approval / complete / error / paused / idle / heartbeat), then POSTs each phase to a desktop-pet backend at http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/plugin/dsh/ingest. It holds no window. No API key or token is needed. Requires the Mao Live2D pet application to be separately installed and running (that is a Windows Electron app with its own PowerShell 7 / Python 3.10+ / Node 18+ prerequisites); without it this plugin has nothing to push to.
description.zh: 连接器，本身不渲染任何东西：订阅 DeepSeek Harness 的会话事件，折叠成 12 态工作状态（规划 / 思考中 / 执行工具 / 回复中 / 聆听中 / 语音播报 / 待确认 / 完成 / 出错 / 暂停 / 待机 / 在线），再逐条 POST 到桌宠后端的 /api/plugin/dsh/ingest。不持有窗口，无需 API Key 或 token。使用前须另行安装并启动 Mao Live2D 桌宠应用（该应用是 Windows Electron 程序，自身要求 PowerShell 7 / Python 3.10+ / Node 18+）；没有它，本插件没有可推送的对象。

description.en: Local TXT reader in a right-sidebar tab plus a spoiler-safe AI reading companion: the model only sees what you have already read — the current chapter, the tail of the previous chapter, and a per-book background file it grows as you go. Excerpts, thoughts and the companion replies become structured Markdown notes exportable to Obsidian; raw text unlocks only for a book you mark as finished.
description.zh: 右侧栏本地 TXT 阅读器 + 不剧透的 AI 陪读：模型只能看到你已经读到的部分（本章全文、上一章结尾，以及随进度增量补齐的背景认识）；摘抄、感想与 AI 回应写成结构化 Markdown 笔记，可导出到 Obsidian。只有你标记「已读完」的那一本才向它放开原文。

plugins.name: dsh-novel

description.en: Read web novels inside the DSH web GUI: import legado book sources, search across them, keep a bookshelf with reading progress, read in one continuous scroll, import local TXT and EPUB books, and let agent tools reach the same sources, shelf and text.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 里读网络小说：导入 legado 书源、跨源搜索、带进度的书架、连续滚动阅读、导入本地 TXT 与 EPUB，并让 AI 助手工具接到同一套书源、书架与正文上。

capabilityRedLines: uses plaintext http:// to www.ibm.com

description.en: A Kun-Like desktop pet living in the corner of the DSH web UI; switches animations with agent state and plays a voice line on task completion.
description.zh: 住在 DSH Web 界面右下角的坤坤桌宠：随 Agent 状态切换动作，任务完成时播放「你干嘛~哎哟」。

description.en: Ten full-canvas animated backgrounds for the DSH conversation pane — starfield, code rain, circuit, sword-fight, cat, girl, fighter jet, racer, snow and bubbles — one random theme per turn, with a text-column veil that keeps the chat readable.
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话区加十种整屏动效背景——星空、代码雨、电路、华山论剑、小猫、小女生、飞机大战、赛车、飘雪、肥皂泡；每回合随机一个，正文列有纱罩保证可读。

description.en: Counts how many times the microphone is stroked today and writes the number to a local JSON file for a desktop pet to read.
description.zh: 麦克风识别「摸摸」动作，只把今天被摸了几次写进本地 JSON 文件，供桌面宠物读取。

plugins.name: dsh-columbina-pet

description.en: Columbina mascot for DeepSeek Harness: a 2D live pet on the desktop and inside the web panel, with four sprite sets, 76 official voice lines in Chinese, Japanese and English, weather reports, sticker moments, idle whispers, and a right-click menu for the sprite switch interval, sprite set, language and scale. Also includes quiet hours, volume with one-click mute, a searchable idle-action picker, and a power-save mode. It is a 2D-only fork of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (MIT) with upstream's 3D skin switching removed; it uses its own plugin id and can be installed alongside dsh-pet.
description.zh: 哥伦比娅桌宠：桌面与网页面板上都有 2D live 形象，四套形象、76 句中日英原声台词、天气播报、表情包时刻、闲暇碎碎念，右键菜单可调动图切换间隔、形象、语言与大小。另有夜间勿扰、音量与一键静音、可搜索的待机动作勾选、省电模式。本插件是 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet（MIT）的 2D 专用分支，去掉了上游的 3D 形象切换；使用独立插件 ID，可与 dsh-pet 同时安装。

capabilityRedLines: reads credentials/secrets AND has network access

description.en: Rewrites every prompt into a Mechanicus prayer before the model sees it, then lets you pick prayer or original to send.
description.zh: 发送前把提示词改写成机械神教祷文，再让你选择发送祷文还是原文。

description.en: A desktop pet living in the corner of DSH: every hour it brings one official prompt technique from OpenAI or Anthropic — verbatim copy-ready EN template, 1:1 Chinese translation, personalised rationale, and 9 switchable skins.
description.zh: 提示词精灵：住在 DSH 右下角的小宠物，每小时送你一条 OpenAI / Anthropic 官方提示词——EN 模板逐字可复制、中文 1:1 翻译、模型个性化「为什么值得抄」，9 套皮肤随便换。

description.en: Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.
description.zh: 给 dsh web 铺上 DeepSeek Harness 首页同款背景：WebGL 流体光效、点线网格与数字点云鲸鱼，深色/亮色两套配色。

description.en: A small living fish with its own memory, mood and quiet thoughts. It remembers you between sessions, and the fish itself is one JSON file you can export and carry.
description.zh: 一条养在 Harness 里的小鱼：有自己的记忆、心情和心事，隔天还记得你；鱼本身就是一个能导出带走的 JSON。

description.en: Chat meme stickers: text-only send, mood auto-send, QQ/WeChat-style picker, auto-learn, custom packs.
description.zh: 聊天表情包：纯文本斗图、情绪主动发图、像 QQ/微信 一样发图、AI 自动学图、自定义表情包。

description.en: Drops a bowl of white rice from the top of the DSH window for every N tokens you spend; the bowls fall and bounce under gravity, can be dragged and thrown, and a vortex button (with a sound effect) inhales them all — or just the one you drop on it. Threshold, bowl size, on-screen cap, auto-righting and artwork are adjustable in an in-app panel.
description.zh: 每花掉 N token,就从 DSH 窗口顶端掉下一碗白米饭:米饭自由落体、落地弹跳,可以拖着扔出去;一个漩涡按钮(带音效)能把它们全部吸走,把某一碗拖上去松手则只吸那一碗。每碗额度、米饭大小、最多摆几碗、落地是否自动回正、米饭图都能在面板里调。

description.en: Turns the DeepSeek Harness agent into any character: a global cosplay switch, SillyTavern v2 role cards with JSON import/export, a neutral/role thinking-style toggle, and natural-language card authoring via a built-in skill.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 扮演任何角色：全局扮演开关、酒馆 v2 角色卡（JSON 导入导出）、中立/角色化思考切换，内置 skill 支持一句话生成角色卡。

description.en: A desktop pet in the DSH web GUI: floating, draggable sprite pet that animates with agent activity (thinking, idle, error, done, awaiting approval), with a settings page for size, switching, gallery search and one-click pet install. Ships 4 bundled Hunter x Hunter starter pets.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的桌面宠物：右下角悬浮、可拖拽，随智能体活动切换精灵动画；设置页可管理大小、启停切换、图库搜索与一键安装宠物。内置 4 个全职猎人主角宠物包。

description.en: An easter-egg brake-pedal self-test. A draggable pill in the DSH web UI runs six full-force braking stomps; the bracket snaps at a pseudo-random stomp between the second and the sixth, or the run passes entirely, and then a fictional notice appears. The pedal force is derived and labelled as such, while the session figures it derives from are read from the real session log. It never intercepts, delays or takes over the real stop action.
description.zh: 一个制动踏板自检彩蛋。DSH 网页界面上有一颗可拖动的胶囊，做六脚全力制动测试：支架在第二到第六脚之间伪随机地断裂，也可能整轮通过，随后弹出一份虚构通报。踏板力由会话事实推导并在界面上标为推导值，而这些事实取自真实会话日志。它从不拦截、延迟或接管真实的停止动作。

description.en: A conversation-style layer that rephrases trade-off warnings: when a shortcut is cheap but has a catch, the reply may say the fast road is the rival shop and the slow one keeps its rules. Ships a rewrite engine that turns any text into a fixed-format dialogue with five independent knobs (act count, catchphrase density, ending turn, seed, preset), a slider for four on/off intensity levels, and a /bushaoxin command that reports a joke "heartburn index" from the session tool-call log. Every rewrite ends with a real technical conclusion that cannot be disabled. Zero dependencies, no build step, engine is pure functions.
description.zh: 一个对话文风层：谈到「便宜的路有坑」这类取舍时，把警告换成另一种说法——快而便宜的是隔壁黑心店，慢而可靠的老店在立规矩。附带改写引擎，可把任意文本拧成固定骨架的对白，有五个互相独立的旋钮（幕数、招牌台词密度、收尾走向、种子、预设档）；一个四档强度滑条；以及 /bushaoxin 命令，按会话的工具调用记录生成一份段子式的「烧心指数」病历。每篇改写末尾永远附一行真实技术结论，不可关闭。零依赖、无构建步骤，引擎是纯函数。

description.en: Multi-role group chat panel for DeepSeek Harness: join as one character, chat with 2-3 AI members, route replies by addressee with probabilistic bystanders, use @ handoffs, and keep private memory/relationships, a global character library, failure diagnostics, retry of failed replies, message search, a sticky scene note, paged long-history rendering, cross-tab sync, provider-catalog models, and JSON import/export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多角色群聊面板：你以一个角色加入，和 2–3 个 AI 成员对话；支持按对话对象智能路由、其他人按概率接话、显式 @ 接话，以及全局角色库、失败诊断、失败回应重试、群内消息搜索、场景便利贴、长历史分页、多标签同步、私有记忆与私人关系、模型目录下拉和角色/群配置 JSON 导入导出。

description.en: A whale-girl companion for the dsh web GUI: animations follow the agent state, with pat interactions and a feeding mechanic that raises intimacy from a calf to deep-sea bonds.
description.zh: 常驻界面的鲸鱼娘：随智能体状态切换动画，可摸头互动、喂小鱼干养亲密度，从幼鲸一路养成。

description.en: 🎲 Dice Battle — six classic dice games (Liar's Dice, Guess Red Dots, Red/Blue, Big/Small, Odd/Even, Straight) for the DSH web GUI. Single vs AI plus PeerJS WebRTC online play, fully bilingual zh/en, sidebar entry opens the game in the center column.
description.zh: 🎲 骰子大作战 — 六种经典骰子玩法（吹牛、猜红点、猜红蓝、猜大小、猜单双、猜顺子），单人 vs AI + PeerJS 联机，全量中英双语，侧边栏入口打开游戏面板。

description.en: A photo-real desk pet for the DSH window: five personas with five expression sprites each, whose dance, hair-flip and walk actions play as 24 fps VP9 alpha video clips, plus a single-shot stage clip that walks to the centre, dances and walks back without cutting; proactive lines with an optional edge-tts neural voice, ink / confetti / cloud / fog / bomb effects, a right-click menu and a /dsh-pet command, plus a small chat box that answers through a one-shot host model call without writing to your session. UI text ships in en, zh, es, pt and hi.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的超写实桌宠：五个形象各有五张表情立绘，跳舞、撩发、走路三套动作以 24fps VP9 alpha 视频片段播放，另有一条「走到中间跳完再走回」的 10 秒单镜头片段、全程不切镜；按活跃时段主动说话（可选 edge-tts 神经音色），带泼墨、撒花、乌云、起雾、炸弹特效、右键菜单与 /dsh-pet 斜杠命令，旁边的小输入框通过一次性宿主模型调用回话、不写进你的会话。界面文案内置中、英、西、葡、印五语。

description.en: Desktop pet for the DSH web UI: a draggable pixel-art cat with a pomodoro timer, XP levels, and 30 unlockable facts.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的桌宠插件：可拖拽的像素猫，带番茄闹钟、经验等级与 30 条可解锁的托托事实。

description.en: Whale-girl desktop pet for the DSH Web UI, drawn with hand-written SVG + CSS (no image or audio assets, zero runtime dependencies): swims while a turn runs, blows labeled bubbles on tool calls, taps the glass with an amber pulse when an approval is waiting, jumps with a turn duration/tool-count report on success and droops on failure, naps after dark or when idle. Click to poke, double-click to pet (affinity hearts), drag with remembered position, right-click menu (feed / mute / reset / hide), hover card with level, title, XP bar and per-turn stats. A `whale_say` tool lets the agent make her speak or act as a lightweight visible notification. Read-only over sessions and workspace; only ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json is written.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的鲸鱼女孩桌宠，手写 SVG + CSS 动画（无图片/音频素材，零运行时依赖）：任务运行中游泳，调工具时吐带标签的泡泡，等待审批时贴屏幕敲玻璃并伴随琥珀色脉冲，完成时跳一下并汇报本轮耗时与工具数，失败时下沉，闲置或深夜戴睡帽打盹。单击戳一戳，双击摸头涨好感，拖拽后记住位置，右键菜单可喂食/静音/回默认位置/隐藏，悬停显示等级、称号、经验条与本轮统计。`whale_say` 工具让 Agent 借她说话或做动作，作为轻量可见通知。只读会话与工作区，仅写入 ~/.dsh/whale-girl/state.json。

description.en: Pixel-art Little Red Riding Hood pet for the DSH session window: transparent and always on top, it walks back and forth along the composer, blinks, looks around, turns its head toward the cursor, sleeps on double-click, and scales from 2x to 7x in a right-click panel.
description.zh: 会话窗口里的像素桌宠「小红帽蕾克」：透明无边框、始终置顶，在输入框上沿来回走动，会眨眼、张望、蹦跳，鼠标靠近会转头看你，双击原地睡觉，右键面板可调 2×~7× 大小。

description.en: Plays a 44-second sci-fi cold-boot sequence over the DSH window on startup: terminal log, whale mark, four spoken lines, and a skip button. Pure DOM and CSS in one self-contained client bundle, no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 启动时在 DSH 窗口上播一段 44 秒的科幻冷启动序列：终端日志、鲸鱼标识、四句英文人声，外加一个跳过按钮。纯 DOM 与 CSS，单个自包含的客户端包，无运行时依赖。
